title: DPRK Will Dynamically Advance along Road Chosen by Itself
body: The service personnel and people of the DPRK are foreseeing rosier future while looking back upon this year with great pride and honor. 2017 when humankind greeted with great hope and expectation has not passed uneventfully. From the beginning of the year the world fell in the mire of mayhem. The U.S. has been engrossed in aggression and interference in sovereign states under the pretext of "anti-terrorism" and "peace-keeping". Sovereignties of various countries are violated and many people were drawn into wars and conflicts. Some countries worked hard to keep their security with the help of big powers. However, they failed to check the U.S. infringement on their sovereignties, and conflicts among nations, tribes and sects have still persisted. Some countries opted for submission, abandoning their principles before the U.S. high-handed and arbitrary practices. Even countries styling themselves big powers chose compromise with the U.S. while thinking about only their immediate interests without their own views, though the latter's practice was wrong. Justice was abused in the international arena in line with big powers' interests. Under the grim situation only socialist Korea has dynamically advanced along the road chosen by itself without the slightest deviation and smashed the U.S. arbitrary practices. In 2018 the world will be further shocked by Juche Korea which will successfully build a powerful socialist nation by giving full rein to the great might of self-reliance and self-development. Ri Hak Nam

title: Lunatic Action of Precipitating Self-Destruction
body: Soon after the UN fabrication of "sanctions resolution" 2397 against the DPRK, Japanese Prime Minister Abe in a news conference said that it is necessary to implement the resolution more strictly so as to force the DPRK to change the policy. Taking advantage of his position as president of the UNSC, Abe in December held UNSC emergency and ministerial meetings, in which he stressed the need for the international community to put maximum pressure on the DPRK, pulling up it over its test-fire of Hwasong-15 and "human rights" issue. This is no more than a lunatic action taken only by Japan keen on taking issue with others to draw water to its own mill. Japan is the sworn enemy of the Korean nation as Japan has perpetrated such crimes against it that its wounds will never be healed. Japan is working hard to realize its militarist ambition, hell-bent on international sanctions and pressure on the DPRK over its nukes of justice, not content with offering its whole territory to the U.S. as a logistic base to carry out the war of aggression against the DPRK. This makes blood boil in the hearts of the Koreans at the thought of Japan. The most impudent and vicious Abe forces should no longer be pardoned and the island of Japan be brought to the bottom of the sea. This is the Korean people's bad blood towards Japan. The Japanese authorities should behave themselves, well aware that the heightened resolution of the Korean people to retaliate Japan with the treasured nuclear sword will put it at greater peril. Ri Hyon Do

title: Celebration Performance of Workers
body: The Workers' Art Group of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea (GFTUK) gave a performance at the Central Hall of Workers on Dec. 29 to celebrate the sixth anniversary of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's assumption of the supreme commandership of the Korean People's Army. Among the audience were Ju Yong Gil, chairman of the GFTUK Central Committee, trade union officials and members and workers. The performance began with chorus "Glory to General Kim Jong Un". Extending glory and congratulations to the Supreme Leader, the performers sang of the happiness and joy of the Korean army and people blessed with the illustrious leaders generation after generation. They also represented numbers making the audience recall the devoted efforts of the peerlessly illustrious commander who increased the might of the KPA in every way and ushered in a new heyday of bolstering the military capability. And they showed the stamina of the heroic Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il working class working fresh miracles and innovations in the building of a powerful and prosperous country. Rodong News Team

title: Statues of Kim Il Sung, Kim Jong Il Erected at Korean Revolution Museum
body: Colored statues of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il were erected at the general review room of the Korean Revolution Museum. A ceremony of laying floral baskets at the statues took place on Dec. 31. Present at the ceremony were officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, the Cabinet, working people's organizations, ministries, national institutions and organs and industrial establishments in Pyongyang and employees of the museum. A basket of flowers in the name of Kim Jong Un, Supreme Leader of the Party, the State and the army, was placed at the colored statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il. Also laid were floral baskets in the joint name of the Central Committee and the Central Military Commission of the WPK and the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and in the joint name of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly and the Cabinet of the DPRK. The participants made a deep bow to the statues of the great leaders. They went round several rooms of the museum. Rodong News Team

title: Floral Baskets to Statues of Kim Il Sung, Kim Jong Il
body: Ya. T. Nobichenko, an internationalist soldier, and Jong Il Sim, widow of DPRK Hero An Tong Su, sent floral baskets to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on the occasion of the New Year Juche 107 (2018). The baskets were placed before the statues on Dec. 31. Rodong News Team

title: Letter to Kim Jong Un from Central Committee of AINDF
body: Respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a congratulatory letter from the Central Committee of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front (AINDF) on January 1 on the occasion of the New Year Juche 107(2018). Last year 2017 was a year of epochal changes, a year of great victory in which the dignity of the DPRK and its tremendous might and powerful spirit were displayed at the highest level and the strategic position of Juche Korea was put on the ranks of powers to steer the international political trend under the outstanding leadership of respected Marshal Kim Jong Un, the letter said, and went on: The spectacular scenes presented on the homeland of Juche aroused strong yearnings among the south Koreans for the genuine society where the popular masses' dream and ideals come true under the leadership of the father of the nation. Last year every ferocious "sanctions resolution" against the DPRK cooked up by the U.S. and its vassal forces and their war moves for aggression on it were foiled, and the conservative group of traitors keen on sycophancy toward the U.S. and confrontation with the fellow countrymen were brought to the grave of history. This strikingly manifested the validity of the DPRK's idea and line on independent reunification and their justice and vitality. Your long journey of patriotic devotion and noble exploits by which you glorified 2017 as a year of great victory to be specially recorded in the history of confrontation with the U.S., in building a socialist power and in accomplishing the cause of national reunification through your outstanding ideology, iron faith and rare leadership would shine generation after generation. The letter vowed to flare up higher the candlelight of justice to bury the anti-reunification traitorous forces making last-ditch efforts after being sternly judged by history and forsaken by the people, and to bring about new politics, new social system and new society desired by the people to south Korea. Rodong News Team

title: Congratulatory Letter to Kim Jong Un from Chongryon Central Standing Committee
body: Respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a congratulatory letter from the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) on January 1 on the occasion of the New Year Juche 107 (2018). Respected Supreme Leader Marshal Kim Jong Un is the best man ushering in the bright future of the country and people as he sees to it that epochal progress has been made in implementing the decisions of the 7th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea through an all-out general charge for hitting the goals of the five-year strategy for national economic development, despite the frantic nuclear war racket of the U.S. imperialists and their vassal forces and the harshest sanctions manipulated by them, the letter said, and went on: Last year, you bestowed all possible loving care and solicitude on Chongryon and Koreans in Japan, leading us step by step. We will fully discharge our mission and patriotic duty before the country and the nation by making tangible contributions to the prosperity of the socialist homeland and the national reunification as required by the stirring present situation in which the final victory in the revolutionary cause of Juche is accelerated through dynamic building of a powerful socialist nation while settling accounts with the U.S. in confrontation, under your outstanding guidance. The letter vowed to adorn Juche 107 (2018) as a year of victory of strengthening the movement of Koreans in Japan onto a higher stage despite the grim situation in which Japan, a puppet of the U.S., gets hell-bent on the hostile policy and sanctions and pressure moves against the DPRK while intensifying the persistent suppression of Chongryon and Koreans in Japan, and thus present a report of delight to respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Greets Chongryon Chairman on New Year
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a message of greeting to Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), on the occasion of the New Year Juche 107(2018). He in the message extended warm congratulations and compatriotic greetings to all the officials of Chongryon including the chairman and other compatriots in Japan at a time when 2017 recorded with great events to be specially recorded in the history of the country is sent off and hopeful New Year 2018 is greeted in. Last year Chongryon recorded the whole year with patriotic days and months in ardent reverence for President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il despite the vicious suppression by the Japanese reactionaries, and made great progress in the drive for opening up a new heyday in the movement of Koreans in Japan, the message said. Kim Jong Un highly appreciated the noble loyalty and patriotic devotion made by Chongryon officials and all the Koreans in Japan who have invariably and vigorously fought for the victory of the Juche cause, the patriotic cause of Chongryon, braving manifold difficulties and trials in the alien land. New Year 2018 is a significant year marking the 70th birthday of the DPRK and will be a year of a grand advance in which a decisive breakthrough is to be made in the drive for developing the movement of Koreans in Japan onto a higher stage with the 24th Plenary Meeting of Chongryon as an occasion, the message said, adding: I express firm belief that Chongryon and all Koreans in Japan would strikingly demonstrate once again the true nature of Chongryon, a dignified overseas Koreans' organization of the DPRK, and build a new landmark in the sacred course for the strengthening and development of the movement of Koreans in Japan this significant year. He said that he would cherish Chongryon, associated with the noble patriotism and compatriotism of the peerlessly great persons of Mt Paektu, as a valuable treasure of Juche Korea, and do his best for its strengthening and happy life of Koreans in Japan. He wished Chairman Ho Jong Man and all other Chongryon officials and compatriots in Japan good health, and hoped that the families of all compatriots in Japan would be filled with greater happiness and laughter in the hopeful New Year. Rodong News Team

title: Floral Basket to Kim Jong Un from Bereaved Family of DPRK Hero
body: Respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a floral basket from Jong Il Sim, widow of DPRK Hero An Tong Su, on Dec. 31 on the occasion of the New Year Juche 107 (2018). Rodong News Team

title: Japan Comes under Fire for Its Past Aggression Crimes
body: Members of young people's organization in south Korea staged a demo in Seoul on Dec. 27, 2017 to protest against the crimes of the Japanese imperialists against the Korean nation during their occupation of Korea. The demonstrators condemned the Japanese authorities for failing to apologize for the past aggression crimes, carrying signboards bearing letters such as "Japan has not apologized". Rodong News Team

title: Repeal of "Agreement" on Sexual Slavery with Japan Urged in S. Korea
body: The "Peace Butterfly Taejon Action" of south Korea on Dec. 29, 2017 told a news conference before the statue of girl sexual slave in Taejon where it demanded the puppet authorities immediately repeal the humiliating "agreement" on the sexual slavery with Japan, according to media report. The body disclosed that the "agreement" was made in secret between south Korea and Japan. The speakers asserted that the "government" should put a blanket end to the treacherous "agreement". Then a press release was read out. It said the "government" should urge the Japanese government to stop all acts of distorting and denying its history of sexual slavery. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korean Chief Executive Blasted for Excluding All Prisoners of Conscience from Those to Be Set Free
body: The south Korean online paper Voice of People said that the committee for pushing ahead with the struggle to make prisoners of conscience released held an emergency news conference before Chongwadae on Dec. 29, 2017 to denounce the south Korean chief executive for excluding all the prisoners of conscience from the list of those to which the pardon is granted. Speakers said that he turned down the public demand for the rights to labor and existence by not allowing prisoners of conscience to be released. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Sportspersons Resolve to Achieve Fresh Victory
body: Upon receiving the New Year Address made by respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, sportspersons in the DPRK are filled with firm determination to achieve fresh victory. Last year witnessed signal achievements made in the field of DPRK sports. The DPRK produced champions in various events, including weightlifting, Taekwon-Do, marathon and diving. And its women footballers took the first place at the 2017 AFC U-16 Women's Championship for the third time and had three consecutive wins at the EAFF E-1 Football Championship. It is the determination and will of all sports officials, players and coaches to produce more excellent results in international games in 2018. Ro Chol Ok, deputy head of the Kigwancha Sports Team, said that he would give full rein to the spirit of players and coaches, intensify the training and put the training on a higher scientific basis to win more gold medals in 2018. Kim Kuk Hyang, a diver of the April 25 Sports Team, said that she would train harder to live up to the people's expectation with more medals. Rodong News Team

title: Koreans Celebrate New Year's Day
body: The New Year's Day was significantly celebrated in the DPRK. An endless stream of visitors flew to the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun where President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il lie in state. Servicepersons and civilians across the country visited the statues of the great leaders and their smiling portraits to pay tribute to them. Art performances were given in Pyongyang and provinces to rev up the festive atmosphere. There were schoolchildren's folk plays at Kim Il Sung Square and other parts of Pyongyang and in Hamhung and Kaesong Cities. Catering service facilities in Pyongyang and others in provinces were full of guests who came to enjoy New Year's Day. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Il's Work Posted by Brazilian Organization
body: Leader Kim Jong Il's work "On the Juche Idea" was posted by the Brazilian Center for the Study of the Juche Idea on its website on December 21 last year to mark the 26th anniversary of his assumption of the supreme commandership of the Korean People's Army. The work, published on March 31, Juche 71 (1982), deals with the immortal historic exploits of President Kim Il Sung who founded the Juche idea and their significance, and the founding, philosophical, socio-historic and guiding principles and historical significance of the Juche idea. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's Work Published in Ethiopia
body: Respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "On the Basic Tasks Facing Kim Il Sung University in the New Era of the Juche Revolution" was brought out in booklet at the Penguin Publishing House of Ethiopia. A book releasing ceremony took place at the publishing house on Dec. 22, 2017. Rodong News Team

title: New Year Performance of Schoolchildren
body: A New Year performance of schoolchildren for Juche 107 (2018) took place at the Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace on Dec. 31. Among the audience were Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, Pak Pong Ju, Presidium member of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK, vice-chairman of the DPRK State Affairs Commission and premier of the Cabinet, and other senior party and state officials, the chairman of the C.C., Korean Social Democratic Party, the first secretary of the C.C., Youth League, officials of the party, the Cabinet, ministries and national institutions, persons of merits and teaching staff of Mangyongdae Revolutionary School and Kang Pan Sok Revolutionary School. Present on invitation were diplomatic envoys, representatives of international bodies and military attaches of foreign embassies here and their spouses and overseas compatriots staying in Pyongyang. The performance began with song and dance "We Offer Glory to Respected Marshal Kim Jong Un, Our Father" and sextet and chorus "The Best". The performers extended New Year's greetings to respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in reflection of the best wishes of all the people and schoolchildren in the country. They sang loudly of the warm love for younger generations shown by Generalissimos Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il who put forward the children as the king of the country and firmly protected their happiness and future. They also presented numbers reflecting the strong will of schoolchildren to become juvenile revolutionaries and guards who will shoulder the future of prosperous and powerful Korea by inheriting the tradition of the Anti-Japanese Children's Corps. The performance vividly showed the bright looks of the rising generations who are preparing themselves as true sons and daughters of the socialist country equipped with knowledge, good moral character and good health under the loving care of Marshal Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Il Remembered in Different Countries
body: Events took place in different countries on December 13 and 14 last year to commemorate the 6th anniversary of demise of leader Kim Jong Il. They included seminars, book and photo exhibitions and film shows in Nepal, India and Thailand. Displayed at the venues of the events were photos dealing with the exploits of President Kim Il Sung, leader Kim Jong Il and respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Also on display there were their works, and books and photos introducing the struggle of the Korean army and people. "My Country Has Emerged Victorious by Dint of Single-minded Unity" and other Korean films were shown. C. P. Mainali, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Nepal Communist Party (Marxist-Leninist), and Manju Ratna Sakya, chairman of the Nepal Journalist Association, praised Kim Jong Il as not only the great leader of the Korean people but also the most distinguished leader representing the whole world. S. P. Pathak, chairman of the Indian Society for the Study of Works of Kim Jong Il, said that under the energetic leadership of HE Kim Jong Il the DPRK proudly turned into a nuclear weapons state and demonstrated its might as an invincible military power any formidable enemy dares not provoke. Songchit Pullarp, chairman of the Thai committee for remembering leader Kim Jong Il, praised him for devoting his all to the happiness of the people in his life while regarding the idea of believing in the people as in Heaven as his motto. Messages to Kim Jong Un were adopted at the events held in Nepal. Rodong News Team

title: Editorial
body: Let Us Vigorously Advance for Fresh Victory The New Year Address of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un reflects his steel-strong will to achieve a new victory in the building of a powerful socialist country this year greeting the 70th birthday of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea by giving full play to the might of our single-minded unity and self-reliance and self-development capability. The Supreme Leader's New Year Address serves as an inspiring banner that gives the confidence in sure victory to the Korean army and people. He in the New Year Address proudly declared that we have realized the wish of the great leaders who devoted all their life to providing the strongest national defence capability for reliably safeguarding the country's sovereignty, and we have created a mighty sword for defending peace, as desired by all our people who had to tighten their belts for long years. He also set forth the revolutionary slogan "Let us launch a revolutionary general offensive to achieve fresh victory on all fronts of building a powerful socialist country!" and clearly indicated the tasks and ways for this year's struggle. No force on the earth can block the vigorous advance of Juche Korea as it is under the outstanding and tested guidance of the Workers' Party of Korea which leads our style socialism to victory, weathering the tempest of history in the van, and its army and people are steadily carrying into practice the idea and resolution of the Party Central Committee. All the people should achieve a fresh victory on all the fronts of building a powerful socialist country this significant year, in hearty response to the New Year Address of the Supreme Leader.

title: Russian Media Praise Kim Jong Il's Feats
body: Media of Russia edited special write-ups interwoven with portraits of smiling leader Kim Jong Il and his photos from Dec. 14 to 17 last year in commemoration of the sixth anniversary of his demise. The newspaper Komsomolskaya Pravda in an article under the title of "Eternal leader of Korean people" said that the ideas and lines of Kim Jong Il serve as the eternal banner showing the road ahead of the Korean people. The article stressed that his feats are the eternal foundation guaranteeing the prosperity of Korea and happiness of the Korean people. The newspaper Zavtra in an article "Snow and Kim Jong Il" said that his life was a pure one like snow. The noble life of leader Kim Jong Il who had continued the journey of field guidance till the last moments of his life will be kept in the minds of the Korean people and the world progressive mankind forever, the article added. The newspaper Kuban Segodnya carried an article titled "Leader Kim Jong Il of DPRK will be immortal" praising him as an outstanding thinker-theoretician, a great master of art of leadership and a benevolent father of the people. The internet newspaper Forum in an article "Sixth anniversary of demise of Korean people's leader Kim Jong Il" elaborated on the fact that the cause of immortalizing the great leaders has been brilliantly realized in the DPRK under the guidance of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. The Novosibirsk Regional Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation and the Eastern Siberian Publishing House in Irkutsk Region carried articles praising the ideo-theoretical and Songun leadership feats of Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Il's Feats Praised by Foreign Figures
body: Seminars on the exploits of leader Kim Jong Il were held in Nigeria, the Czech Republic, Germany and Bulgaria from Dec. 12 to 15 last year to commemorate the sixth anniversary of his demise. The national chairman of the People's Progressive Party of Nigeria stressed that Generalissimo Kim Jong Il is a great guardian of the socialist cause as he instilled faith and courage into the world progressive people by turning the DPRK into a politico-ideological power and a military power despite the severe tempest of history with the Songun politics. The chairman of the Paektusan Czech-Korean Friendship Association said the special feats of Kim Jong Il were that he firmly defended socialism and the revolutionary gains with the treasured sword of Songun and laid a solid foundation for building a powerful country. The chairman and members of the Anti-Imperialist Forum of Germany praised Kim Jong Il as a peerless politician and his feats of Songun leadership. The chief of the DPRK cultural and information centre in Vratsa City of Bulgaria and other speakers said: Leader Kim Jong Il regarded the people as Heaven and had devotedly worked for them. He is, indeed, a true popular leader. The world is envious of the Korean people living in the socialist system where everything serves them. The struggle of the Korean people to defend the system and bring about a bright future is just and they will surely emerge victorious. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's Work Published in Russia
body: "Let Us Usher in a New Golden Age of the Movement of Koreans in Japan True to the Intention of the Great Comrade Kim Jong Il", a letter of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un to the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan and compatriots in Japan on the 60th anniversary of the Association, was brought out in booklet at the Forum Book Publishing House of Russia on the occasion of the 100th birth anniversary of the anti-Japanese war heroine Kim Jong Suk. A book releasing ceremony took place at the publishing house on Dec. 25 last year. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to President of Myanmar
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, sent a message of greetings to Htin Kyaw, president of Myanmar, on Jan. 4 on the occasion of the 70th anniversary of its independence. The message wished the president of Myanmar greater success in his responsible work for the progress and prosperity of the country. Rodong News Team

title: Works of Kim Jong Il and Kim Jong Un Introduced in Poland
body: The International Friendship Initiative "Explore DPRK" of Poland posted leader Kim Jong Il's work "Socialism Is What Keeps Our People Alive" and respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us Step Up the Building of a Thriving Country by Applying Kim Jong Il's Patriotism" on its website to commemorate the 6th anniversary of demise of Kim Jong Il. The work "Socialism Is What Keeps Our People Alive", published on November 14, Juche 81 (1992), stresses the necessity to defend the world socialist movement and the cause of socialism and indicates the tasks and ways for defending and advancing the cause of socialism. The work "Let Us Step Up the Building of a Thriving Country by Applying Kim Jong Il's Patriotism", published on July 26, Juche 101 (2012), deals with the essence of Kim Jong Il's patriotism and the noble life of leader Kim Jong Il dedicated to the country and the people. The website carried a portrait of smiling Kim Jong Il and his photos. Rodong News Team

title: Officials of Chongryon Renew Will to Display Its Nature
body: Upon receiving the New Year Address of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and his New Year greetings, officials of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) have renewed their will to make a decisive breach in the struggle for developing the movement of Koreans in Japan onto a higher stage. Jo Han Ju, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Korean Teachers in Japan, vowed to inspiringly arouse all the union members to the drive for carrying out the New Year tasks with the intense loyalty to Marshal Kim Jong Un and take the lead in the drive. Pae Chang Ryol, chairman of the Central Standing Management Board of the Korean Youth Commercial Association in Japan, expressed the will to fulfill his duty in displaying all over the world the nature of Chongryon once again, true to the intention of Kim Jong Un who set 2018 as a year of great advance in which a decisive breach will be made in the work for developing the movement of Koreans in Japan onto a higher stage with the 24th Congress of Chongryon as an occasion. Jo Il Yon, chairperson of the Tokyo Metropolitan Headquarters of Chongryon, pledged to live and work with unshakable faith, indomitable spirit and offensive work-style and power of execution. Kim Sang Il, chairman of the Kyoto Prefectural Headquarters of Chongryon, made up his mind to tide over all the ordeals and launch a general offensive in the work of the headquarters. Wi Kyong Ho, chairman of the Yokohama Branch, Kanagawa Prefecture, of Chongryon, and Kim Song Guk, chairman of the Sapporo Branch, Hokkaido, of Chongryon, expressed the will to devote all their zeal to the patriotic work for the new year. Rodong News Team

title: Kimjongilia Shows Held in Russia and China
body: Kimjongilia shows took place in Russia and China between December 23 and 28 last year to mark the 26th anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il's assumption of supreme commandership of the Korean People's Army, the 6th anniversary of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's assumption of KPA supreme commandership and the 100th birth anniversary of the anti-Japanese war heroine Kim Jong Suk. Among those present at their opening ceremonies were personages of various circles and masses in those countries and officials of the DPRK missions. The manager of the Delonoye Khozaistvo Company of Russia said that Kimjongilia has been widely known to many countries and highly appreciated at the international flower shows. He expressed the will to keep the flower more beautiful and disseminate it in larger areas of Russia in the future. The deputy general manager of a Chinese company in Shenyang said that December is a month when the progressive mankind's reverence for Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il, the great leaders of the Korean people, and for the anti-Japanese war heroine Kim Jong Suk grows deeper, adding that the birth of Kimjongilia is a common auspicious event of mankind to be specially recorded in the world circle of floriculturists. The director of another company in Shenyang of China said that they are pleased to see the splendid Kimjongilia show in Shenyang associated with the sacred traces of the great leaders of the DPRK, adding: The exploits of Kim Jong Il, who was praised as a peerless political master as he smashed the moves of the hostile forces and reliably defended the destiny of the country and the nation with his iron will and ever-victorious strategy and through his energetic activities, would remain forever with the century. The secretary general of the Dalian City Flower Association said that Kimjongilia is still now called the flower of the sun by the world people, and hoped that the Korean people would register greater successes in building a powerful socialist country under the leadership of Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: Pyongyangites Meet
body: Pyongyangites met at Kim Il Sung Square on Jan. 4 to express their resolution to carry out the important tasks advanced by respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address. Present there were Premier Pak Pong Ju, Presidium member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, senior party and state officials, officials of party and power organs, working people's organizations, industrial establishments, cooperative farms, labor innovators and other working people in Pyongyang. Kim Su Gil, alternate member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee and chairman of the Pyongyang City Committee of the WPK, made a report. The reporter said the respected Supreme Leader's New Year Address serves as important guidelines instilling confidence in the sure victory of the revolutionary cause of Juche and optimism into the Korean people and clearly indicating the path to be taken by them and as a banner inspiring the army and people to the general offensive for making new upsurge and innovation in all sectors of building a socialist power. He called on all officials and Party members and other working people to turn out in the all-people struggle to foil the last-ditch challenge by the hostile forces and put the overall power of the DPRK on a new stage of development by holding high the revolutionary slogan "Let us launch a revolutionary general offensive to achieve fresh victory on all fronts of building a powerful socialist country!" this year marking the 70th birthday of the DPRK, the glorious motherland. He underlined the need for them to get united more firmly around the great Party and stage a more dynamic struggle to hasten the final victory of the Juche revolution according to the blueprint unfolded by the Supreme Leader in his New Year Address. Pledge-taking speeches were made. The speakers reiterated their resolution to thoroughly carry out this year's tasks set forth by the Party without fail by cherishing the truth that the plan and determination of the Party Central Committee just mean science, truth and practice and giving fullest play to the spirit of devotedly implementing the Party polices and the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance and fortitude. Then there was a procession of the participants. Rodong News Team

title: Congratulatory Letter to Kim Jong Un from General Association of Koreans in China
body: Respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a congratulatory letter from the General Association of Koreans in China on Jan. 1, the New Year Juche 107 (2018). Juche 106 (2017) was a year of victory when the army and people of the DPRK brought about a great leap forward in building a powerful country of Juche with the mental power of self-reliance and self-development under the bright blueprint for building a powerful socialist nation unfolded by Marshal Kim Jong Un, the letter said, and went on: You not only invited the delegation of the General Association to the celebrations of the 105th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung and the 75th birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il and showed the warmest love for it but also repeatedly bestowed trust and solicitude for the strengthening of the General Association. Under your warm compatriotic love and wise guidance, the Koreans in China could most significantly celebrate the Day of the Sun and the Day of the Shining Star as the greatest holiday of the nation and dynamically conduct the patriotic movement for contributing to the national reunification and the building of a powerful socialist country by further strengthening the General Association of Koreans in China into a patriotic organization and uniting the broad masses of compatriots. You are, indeed, the Supreme Leader of the revolutionary cause of Juche whom all the fellow countrymen heartily uphold and the great father of the nation to whom they entrust their destiny and future. The officials of the General Association of Koreans in China and all the Koreans in China will make a tangible contribution to the patriotic work for the prosperity of the homeland and wage a vigorous struggle to resolutely foil the anti-DPRK deeds and aggression war moves of the U.S. and its vassal forces by the concerted efforts of the nation and accelerate the reunification of the country. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's New Year Address Hailed Abroad
body: Organizations of Nigeria and Benin issued joint statements on Jan. 2 in support of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address. The National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, the Group for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, the Group for the Study of the Juche Philosophy, the Group for the Study of the Songun Politics and the Group for Self-Reliance Studies in Nigeria said in their joint statement that all the nuclear war drills with foreign forces and any move to introduce U.S. nuclear equipment and aggressor forces should be halted in the Korean peninsula. They expressed firm belief that the Korean people would achieve new victories in the struggle for the reunification of the country and the building of a powerful socialist country. The Benin-Korea Amicable Association "Long Live Kim Jong Il, Supreme Leader" and the Benin National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea said that the south Korean authorities should respond to the sincere efforts of the DPRK for détente, instead of getting involved in the U.S. reckless anti-DPRK nuclear war moves to escalate the tension. They stressed that the Korean people would smash the moves of the anti-reunification forces at home and abroad by concerted efforts and usher in a new phase for the independent reunification. Rodong News Team

title: Anti-DPRK "Sanctions Resolution" Rejected in Russia
body: Russian bodies issued statements on Dec. 26 and 27 last year to slam the adoption of another "sanctions resolution" against the DPRK. The All-Russia Lenin Young Communist League said in a statement: It is more clearly revealed that the UN has turned into a tool speaking for the interests of the U.S. and its stooges. We will always stand by the Korean working youths and other people, fully supporting the line of simultaneously developing the two fronts set forth by the Workers' Party of Korea. We urge the U.S. to roll back its hostile policy towards the DPRK and stop its nuclear threat against the latter. The Lenin Young Communist League of the Russian Federation said in a statement: The U.S. works hard to deny the fact that the DPRK, though it is not big, can make a counterattack on the American empire. It had better learn how to co-exist with the DPRK, and before this, acknowledge the fact that the latter is a nuclear power. We reject the "sanctions resolution" aimed at destroying human civilization and stifling the DPRK. The Regional Social Organization of Russia "Borozino" said that the UNSC "sanctions resolution" is a criminal document deceiving humankind and blocking the DPRK's development. The U.S. should acknowledge the entity of the DPRK and no longer escalate the tensions on the Korean peninsula, it added. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korean Confederation of Trade Unions Declares Fresh Campaign This Year
body: According to the south Korean online newspaper Jaju Sibo, the south Korean Confederation of Trade Unions held a meeting before the grave of Jon Thae Il in Kyonggi Province on Jan. 2 and declared its will to carry on the struggle for realizing the demands of workers this year. At the meeting, the chairman of the confederation newly elected last year made a speech. He said that now is the time for all to join efforts for social solidarity. Earlier on January 1 the chairman announced the confederation's action program for this year. He said that the confederation would conduct a joint campaign together with the Federation of Trade Unions to have the demands of workers met. He stressed that they would wage a vigorous struggle for peace against war, conclusion of DPRK-U.S. peace accord, independent national reunification, probe into the truth about "Sewol" tragedy, repeal of the "agreement" on sexual slavery and halt to the deployment of THAAD. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korean Students Call for Detention of Lee Myung Bak
body: The preparatory committee for the Students Progressive Alliance in south Korea called a press conference in Seoul on January 4 to declare the inauguration of the Students Commando for Getting Traitor Lee Myung Bak Punished, according to a CBS report of south Korea. Recalling the sins committed by Lee in power, speakers at the conference demanded an investigation into the crimes he committed by throwing the people's life into destitution and breaking the ties with the north. Branding Lee as kingpin of evils, they said they would hold a rally every week in demand of his detention. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK's Strategic Decision Is Just
body: Last year international laws and fundamental principles of international relations were openly ignored on the international arena and sovereignties of various countries violated owing to the outrageous infringement and intervention by the hegemonic forces. Anyhow, a nuclear war, feared so much by the world people, has not broken out on the Korean peninsula, the hottest spot in the world. This was because nukes of tyranny were contained by nukes of justice. The army and people of the DPRK got more confident that the road of holding the new line of simultaneously pushing forward the economic construction and the building of nuclear force advanced by the Party and bolstering up the nuclear deterrence in every way is the most correct one to be followed by them to the end. Their will to defend peace on the Korean Peninsula and the region grew stronger. The DPRK emerged a world-level nuclear power and rocket power possessed of A-bomb, H-bomb and ICBM. The U.S. got hell-bent in nuclear war drills but dared not to provoke the DPRK possessed of powerful war deterrent. The two law-governed traditions in which victory belongs to the DPRK but defeat to the U.S. continued last year, a proof that the DPRK's line of simultaneously developing the two fronts is the most just one and the way of rapidly bolstering the nuclear force chosen by the latter was entirely right. Ri Hyon Do

title: Editorial
body: Let Us Make Dynamic Advance under Guidance of WPK The whole party and army and all the people should achieve fresh victory on all fronts of building a powerful socialist country, in hearty response to respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address. In order to glorify 2018 as a year of great victory, all the people should make redoubled efforts and wage a more dynamic campaign with revolutionary optimism. Kim Jong Un's guidance serves as the vibrant might of powerful socialist Korea and as the invincible banner of the Korean revolution. The U.S. imperialists and their vassal forces are now making every desperate effort to break our army and people's steadfast faith in the Party and their firm confidence in victory and optimism, fearing them most. In the face of such last-ditch efforts of the enemies, all the party members, servicepersons and people should more vigorously struggle, full of confidence in victory and optimism and thus display the mettle of the heroic Korean people carrying into practice the plan and decision of the Party Central Committee. All the people should make a dynamic advance toward the final victory in building a powerful socialist country while displaying the valiant mettle of heroic Korea under the leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea.

title: Cuban Embassy Officials Visit Pyongyang Maternity Hospital
body: Officials of the Cuban Embassy here on Jan. 5 visited the Pyongyang Maternity Hospital on the 59th anniversary of the victory in the Cuban revolution. The visitors went round treatment rooms and sickrooms of the hospital turned into an overall and modern medical service center for women and babies. They presented a souvenir to the hospital. Rodong News Team

title: First Friday Labor of Officials Conducted in DPRK
body: Officials of ministries and national institutions in the DPRK did the first Friday labor for this year at farms in Pyongyang on January 5. With farm implements and compost, they left Kim Il Sung Square for the Mangyongdae Vegetable Farm in Mangyongdae District, the Jangchon Vegetable Cooperative Farm in Sadong District and other farms. The officials did farm work together with agricultural workers at the farms and conducted political work among peasants, encouraging them to register significant success in this year' farming. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Il Remembered in Different Countries
body: Events took place in various countries from December 11 to 18 last year to commemorate the 6th anniversary of demise of leader Kim Jong Il. They included remembrance meetings, book and photo exhibitions and film shows in Brazil, Singapore, Thailand, Guinea, Nigeria, Senegal, Libya, Tanzania, Algeria and Angola. Displayed at their venues were photos showing the exploits of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il. There were also books and photos introducing the struggle of the Korean army and people. Such Korean films as "The Sun of Songun Shedding Its Rays All over the World" and "My Country Has Emerged Victorious by Dint of Single-minded Unity" were shown. The chairman of the Committee of the Party for Free Motherland of Brazil for Remembering Comrade Kim Jong Il praised the life of Kim Jong Il who devoted his all to the happiness of the people. A department director of the Guinean Ministry of Education said it is thanks to the tested leadership of Kim Jong Il that the DPRK could register shining successes despite the worst adversity and that's why the Korean people have missed him very much. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's New Year Address Supported by Mexican Political Party Leader
body: I extend invariable solidarity to the just cause of the Workers' Party of Korea and the Korean people, expressing full support for all the lines and policies set forth by respected Comrade Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address. Jesus Antonio Carlos Hernandez, general secretary of the Central Committee of the People's Socialist Party of Mexico, said this in a statement on Jan. 3. He went on: Comrade Kim Jong Un, Supreme Leader of the Korean people, said in his New Year Address that the DPRK has at last come to possess a powerful and reliable war deterrent, which no force and nothing can reverse, by conducting tests of various means of nuclear delivery and super-intense thermonuclear weapon, and that its nuclear forces constitute a powerful deterrent that prevents the United States from starting an adventurous war. He clarified major tasks and ways for enhancing the independence and Juche character of national economy and improving the people's standard of living. He offered a blitzkrieg and bold proposal for easing the acute military tension between the north and the south, create a peaceful environment on the Korean peninsula and establish a climate favorable for national reconciliation and reunification. This enjoys warm welcome from the world peace-loving progressive people. I sincerely congratulate the heroic Korean people on winning a brilliant victory in the standoff with the U.S. imperialists by accomplishing the great, historic cause of perfecting the national nuclear forces. I hope that the DPRK would achieve bigger successes in the struggle for building a powerful country and improving the people's standard of living this year, too. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's Line of Independent Reunification Supported Abroad
body: The African Regional Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea made public a statement on Jan. 3 in support of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address. The statement said: With deep interest we heard the New Year Address of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un carrying the profound policies. In the New Year Address, he clarified the tasks for achieving fresh victory in the building of a powerful socialist country with the historic victory won in the building of state nuclear force as a springboard for fresh progress. He expressed the bold decision to have in-depth discussion on the north-south relations and open the way for their improvement by the Koreans themselves without foreign interference. We demand that the south Korean authorities no longer turn down the nation's desire for improved north-south relations and join in the outsiders' moves fostering the national division. We are confident that the entire Korean nation will thwart the moves of the separatist forces and realize the independent reunification of the country by its united efforts and thus contribute to ensuring the regional and global peace. Kim Jong Un in the New Year Address solemnly declared that the DPRK, as a peace-loving responsible nuclear power, would neither have recourse to nuclear weapons unless the hostile forces of aggression violate its sovereignty and interests nor threaten any other country or region by means of nuclear weapons. We fully support his line of independent reunification and foreign policy stand. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's New Year Address Reported in Guinea
body: The Guinean National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism on Jan. 2 carried on its bulletin the full text of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address. Rodong News Team

title: Steadfast Foreign Policy Stand of DPRK
body: The foreign policy stand of the Workers' Party of Korea and the DPRK government, clarified by respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address, serves as highly important guidelines that should be consistently adhered to in further enhancing the dignity of the DPRK and its international influence and expanding the relations with other countries on the initiative. The validity of the external policy idea and stand of the WPK and the DPRK government is clearly proved by the fact that the DPRK has developed the external relations while reliably defending its social system and sovereignty and displaying its dignity in any adversity. Our Party and the DPRK government have steadily developed the good-neighborly, friendly and cooperative relations with all countries that respect our national sovereignty and are friendly to us, transcending differences in ideology and social system. They have also improved the relations with those countries which had been hostile toward the DPRK in the past but want to develop the relations with the DPRK after repenting of their past wrongdoings. It is thanks to the independent external policy of the great leaders that our country established diplomatic relations with scores of countries over the past three decades; joined many international and regional bodies; expanded and developed economic and cultural exchanges with many countries including capitalist countries and strengthened the bonds and solidarity with the world progressives advocating independence and justice. It is the stand of the DPRK government to play the role of the vanguard steering the building of a new world, just and peaceful, and the master of propelling the world revolution. Son So Yon

title: Workers' Party of DR Congo Signs Pyongyang Declaration
body: The Workers' Party of DR Congo signed the Pyongyang Declaration "Let Us Defend and Advance the Cause of Socialism." At an emergency special meeting of the party held on Jan. 2 the Pyongyang Declaration was read out and then signed by National President of the party Steve Mbikayi Mabuluki. The special secretary of the national president conveyed the signed document to the DPRK mission, quoting the national president as saying to sign the Pyongyang Declaration shows that the Workers' Party of DR Congo wishes Chairman Kim Jong Un good health in the New Year, too, and bigger victory in the building a powerful socialist nation, and the party's support for his historic New Year Address and the will to develop the friendly and cooperative relations between the two parties aspiring after socialism. Rodong News Team

title: UNSC "Sanctions Resolution" Flayed in France, Nepal
body: A French political party and a Nepalese figure bitterly slammed another "sanctions resolution" cooked up by the U.S. at the UNSC. The Revolutionary Communist Party of France, in a solidarity message "We oppose the criminal resolution together with the DPRK and Korean people" made public on Dec. 26 last year, said: The UNSC "sanctions resolution" is an attempt to bring the Korean people to their knees, pursuant to the U.S. committing crimes against humanity. The UNSC submitted to the U.S., which is threatening other countries in breach of the UN resolutions and is the only country that used nuclear weapons in the world. "Nuclear threats" from the DPRK is a lie. Any country cannot force its demands down the throat of the DPRK, an independent state. The DPRK will never surrender. It is the U.S. that divided the Korean peninsula, ignited a war of aggression against the DPRK and continues committing moves hostile to it. We appeal to all peace-loving forces to intensify solidarity movement with the Korean people. Manju Ratna Sakya, chairman of the Nepal Journalist Association, made public the following statement on Dec. 27 last year: We strongly censure the U.S. for fabricating another "sanctions resolution" against the DPRK over its successful test-launch of ICBM Hwasong-15. We urge the U.S. to repeal its hostile policy towards the DPRK and immediately stop inhuman acts of ruining the life of the Korean people. We back the steps for self-defense being taken by the DPRK to protect its sovereignty and global peace. The DPRK is sure to win in the standoff with the U.S. Rodong News Team

title: People of Various Localities Vow to Fulfill This Year Tasks
body: Mass rallies took place in North and South Phyongan and Hwanghae provinces, Jagang Province and Nampho City of the DPRK on Jan. 6 and 7 to pledge the implementation of the tasks set forth in the New Year Address of respected Supreme LeaderKim Jong Un. Attending them were officials of local party and power organs, working people's organizations, industrial establishments, farms, universities and other units and working citizens and youths and students. Reports and pledge-making speeches were made at the rallies. The reporters and speakers said the New Year Address serves as a militant banner giving the firm faith in victory in the revolutionary cause of Juche and optimism to the army and people and greatly encouraging them to the building of a powerful socialist country. They appealed to all the officials and Party members and other working people to launch a revolutionary general offensive dynamically to achieve fresh victory on all fronts of building of a powerful socialist country by taking the historic victory in the building of the DPRK's nuclear forces as a springboard for fresh progress. They called for making vigorous efforts to bring earlier the final victory in the Juche revolution under the bright blueprint unfolded by the Supreme Leader in the New Year Address, rallied closer around the Workers' Party of Korea. At the end of the rallies there were demonstrations. The demonstrators marched through the plazas and streets, chanting revolutionary and militant slogans. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Workers Meet to Pledge New Year Tasks Fulfillment
body: Jan. 7 witnessed meetings of workers, trade union members, agricultural workers and members of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea to vow the implementation of the tasks set forth in the New Year Address of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in the plaza in front of the Monument to Party Founding and at the Chongsan Co-op Farm in Kangso District, Nampho City. Reports were made and vowing speeches also delivered at the meetings. The reporters and speakers said that the New Year Address serves as a guideline which all the more inspired the people with the confidence in final victory in the accomplishment of the revolutionary cause of Juche and with optimism and which illuminates the way ahead. They also noted that it serves as a militant banner of encouraging all the service personnel and people to speed up the grand Mallima advance. They called for upholding this year's slogan "Let us launch a revolutionary general offensive to achieve fresh victory on all fronts of building a powerful socialist country!" to frustrate the challenges of the hostile forces making last-ditch efforts and raise the overall power of the Republic to a new stage of development. They also appealed to the people to make more vigorous efforts to bring earlier the final victory of Juche revolution under the great plans in the New Year Address. The outline for the socialist emulation for the creation of Mallima speed 2018 was made public at the meetings. Rodong News Team

title: Warmonger Wrecking Global Peace
body: At the end of last year U.S. President Trump announced a report on national security strategy. Terming this new security strategy a dangerous one for confrontation and domination that may drive the global peace into an irretrievable phase of destruction. The report shows that the U.S. is more viciously trying to block the advance of mankind desirous of progress and peace. The swollen-headed Trump group thinks that it can easily deal with any international issue on the strength. For the U.S. strength means "justice" and doctrine for existence as it is vociferating about "doctrine of strength being all-powerful". Former U.S. President Obama pursued the policy of "strategic patience" to isolate and stifle the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the present Trump administration adopted a new policy of "maximum pressure and engagement". They are, in fact, a "big-stick policy". This is nothing but an extension of the hostile policy toward the DPRK aimed to bring it down by putting maximum pressure and strangling it in all aspects of politics, economy and culture on the basis of military muscle. Public opinions brand Trump's new national security strategy as unbalanced, prejudiced and foolish strategy consistent with Cold War-mode of thinking, viewpoint and futile attempt. History will mete out punishment of destruction to the U.S., empire of evils which has pursued the "big-stick policy" down through centuries. Ra Myong Song

title: Congratulations to Liberian President-elect
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, on January 8 sent a congratulatory message to George Weah upon his election as president of Liberia. Expressing belief that the friendly relations between the two countries would expand, Kim in the message sincerely wished the Liberian president success in his work for stability of the country and its socio-economic development. Rodong News Team

title: Israel Withdraws from UNESCO due to Wire-pulling of U.S.
body: At the end of last year, the foreign minister of Israel sent a letter to the director-general of UNESCO informing her of its withdrawal from the UNESCO under the pretence that the body organizationally attacks Israel and tries to separate the land of Israel from the history of Jews. According to this, Israel's withdrawal from UNESCO will take effect from Dec. 31 this year. Israel's decision of withdrawal from UNESCO was due to the instigation and wire-pulling of the present U.S. administration which unhesitatingly breaks the international order and disturbs global peace and stability for its selfish purpose. Following the U.S. scenario, Israel repaid its master U.S. "grace" by withdrawing from UNESCO whose mission is to build a peaceful and civilized world. In this way the U.S. is making all its vassal forces follow it in a bid to justify its blackguardly behavior and realize the wild ambition for world supremacy at any cost. If the U.S. is allowed to go scot-free, it is difficult to expect peaceful development and sustainable future of mankind. The U.S. should clearly know that its persistent high-handed and arbitrary practices would bring international isolation. Israel will not be able to escape such fate either. An Chol Gwon

title: Sophism of Losers Frightened by Emergence of New Strategic State
body: Recently, U.S. President Trump said through a formal website of the White House that enforcement of sanctions and pressure against the Democratic People's Republic of Korea on a high level to remove the threats to American citizens and the mainland was the "diplomatic success" in the first year of his office. Meanwhile, U.S. Secretary of State Tillerson in an article contributed to the New York Times let out the similar piffle. The shameless remarks about "diplomatic success" made by bosses of American politics and diplomacy are ridiculous sophism of the losers who made the DPRK rapidly emerge a strategic state by enforcing inhuman and illegal sanctions and blockade. Last year the U.S. administration ran amuck with the unprecedented moves to stifle the DPRK by gambling on the security of the mainland and destiny of Americans. As a result the whole of the U.S. mainland came within the range of nuclear strike of the DPRK. It is very deplorable to see the U.S. politicians boasting of their diplomatic failure as "diplomatic success." World people call such men "Don Quixote". The U.S. obsessed with anachronism will surely witness how the DPRK will achieve fresh victories on all fronts of building a powerful socialist country this year with the peace-guaranteeing powerful treasured sword. Ri Hyo Jin

title: Meetings Held to Vow to Implement Tasks for This Year
body: Meetings took place at units of pace-setting and major industrial sectors of the national economy in the DPRK to carry out the tasks advanced by respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address. The reporters and speakers at the meetings noted that the Supreme Leader in his New Year Address reviewed the work of 2017 which marked an immortal milestone in the history of building a powerful socialist country with the spirit of self-reliance and self-development as the dynamic force and comprehensively indicated the tasks and ways for this year. They stressed the need for all the officials, party members and working people to make steady miracles and innovations at every worksite of the vanguard sectors and major industrial sectors of the national economy through an all-out general offensive, in hearty response to the militant call of the Party and thus demonstrate the indomitable mental power and brave mettle of the heroic Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il working class. Rodong News Team

title: More Pledge-making Rallies Held
body: Rallies took place in Kangwon, North and South Hamgyong and Ryanggang provinces and Rason City to vow to carry out the tasks set forth by respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address. Present there were officials of local party and power organs, working people's organizations, industrial establishments, farms, universities and other units and working people, youth and students. The reporters and speakers there said that the Supreme Leader's New Year Address is the important guidelines enhancing optimism and faith in the final victory of the revolutionary cause of Juche and indicating the bright path to it and a militant banner encouraging the army and people to the grand Mallima advance. They appealed to all the officials, party members and other working people to speed up the drive for strengthening the independence and Juche character of the national economy and improving the people's standard of living as required by the revolutionary counteraction strategy set forth at the 2nd Plenary Session of the 7th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. They stressed the need to make uninterrupted innovations and progress, rallied closer around the Party until the final victory of the revolution is won by carrying forward the tradition of the heroic struggle and collective innovation established in the course of state-building and development of Juche Korea. At the end of the meetings there were mass demonstrations. Rodong News Team

title: Winter Camping Begins at Songdowon Int'l Children's Camp
body: The first batch of winter campers began camping with due ceremony at the Songdowon International Children's Camp on Jan. 8. Present at the ceremony were officials concerned, officials and teaching staff of the Camp and campers. The reporter and speakers there called upon all the officials, teaching staff and campers to grasp and glorify the exploits of President Kim Il Sung, leader Kim Jong Il and respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un for the camp. They said that the teaching staff should well organize the camping activities with main stress put on cultivating the schoolchildren's sense of organization, independence and collectivism and take warm care of the campers' life. They stressed that the campers should possess noble moral traits and collectivism and train their physical bodies while brushing up their knowledge. Rodong News Team

title: Youths and Women Vow to Carry through Tasks Set Forth in New Year Address
body: Members of the youth vanguard and women's union officials and members met at the Youth Park Open-Air Theatre and the plaza of the Tower of the Juche Idea here on Jan. 8 to vow to carry through the tasks set forth by respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address. Reports were made at the meetings to be followed by speeches. The reporters and speakers said that Kim Jong Un's New Year Address serves as the militant banner redoubling the firm faith in the revolutionary victory enshrined in the hearts of the people and encouraging them to ceaselessly work fresh miracles through a great campaign for creating the Mallima speed. They stressed that all the youths should become the first-line death-defying corps in defending the leader to make a breakthrough for advance in building a powerful socialist country and the first-line standard-bearers devotedly implementing the Party's policy. They also contended that the women's union officials and members should devote their patriotism in such major construction projects of the country as the construction of the Wonsan-Kalma coastal tourist area, the renovation of Samjiyon County, the construction of the Tanchon Power Station and the second-stage waterway project in South Hwanghae Province. And they underscored the need to fully display the militant power and might of the women's union on all fronts for building a powerful socialist nation this year. Rodong News Team

title: Choe Ryong Hae Inspects Songdowon General Foodstuff Factory
body: Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, inspected the Songdowon General Foodstuff Factory. Going round the factory, he gave pep-talks to its employees striving to modernize the production processes and operating the equipment at full capacity. He stressed the importance of the factory's role in improving the provincial people's standard of living, and urged it to produce more world-famous products and commodities in reliance on locally available raw material resources. Choe also inspected the Kalma Foodstuff Factory associated with the feats of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. He called on the factory to thoroughly implement the Party's intention for providing the people with tasty processed fish. Rodong News Team

title: New Year Performance of Schoolchildren Goes On
body: A New Year performance of schoolchildren for Juche 107 (2018) is going on at the Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace in Pyongyang. Put on the stage were such colorful numbers as small chorus "Thank You, Generalissimo Kim Il Sung" and male solo and pangchang "Let's Sing More Loudly the Song of General Kim Jong Il". The performers impressively sang of the happiness of the Korean schoolchildren who have enjoyed all blessings under the care of the Party, holding the great Generalissimos Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il in high esteem as the eternal sun. They well represented respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's warm love for posterity. There were also numbers dealing with the pride of the schoolchildren who are growing up to be masters of a sci-tech power and skillful revolutionary talents and pillars of thriving Korea. Among the audience were working people of various circles and school youth and children in the city of Pyongyang, overseas compatriots and foreign guests. Rodong News Team

title: Foreign Media Praise Kim Jong Il's Feats
body: Foreign media carried articles such as "Great Life of Peerless Patriot" in the period between Dec. 11 and 19 last year to commemorate the 6th anniversary of demise of leader Kim Jong Il. The Egyptian paper Al Akhbar Al Massay said: The life of HE Kim Jong Il was like a leaping flame. 2011, the last year of his great life, in particular, was the year when he worked harder for the prosperity of the country and the happiness of the people with his iron will and superhuman energy. He walked in the van for the building of a powerful socialist country throughout the year 2011. The paper introduced the world-startling miracles and innovations wrought one after another in the DPRK in 2011 alone thanks to his devoted efforts. An article praising his feats for the cause of national reunification was posted on the website of the British Association for the Study of Songun Policy. The Cambodian state radio and the website of the Communist Party of Italy, too, reported about the career of Kim Jong Il who had continued his journey of field guidance for the people till the last moments of his life. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's Feats Praised by Foreign Figures
body: Events took place in various countries to celebrate the 6th anniversary of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's assumption of the supreme commandership of the Korean People's Army (KPA). There were a seminar in Uganda, round-table talks in Ethiopia and book exhibitions and film shows in Nigeria between Dec. 22 and 29 last year. Personages of the Ugandan National Executive Committee of the Pan-African Movement and the Ugandan National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea said that the KPA has further developed into an invincible army since Kim Jong Un's assumption of its supreme commandership. And they stressed that the achievements made by the Korean people in the struggle to defend the sovereignty of the country would have been unthinkable without the outstanding guidance of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il and Kim Jong Un carrying forward their revolutionary cause. Speakers at the round-table talks in Ethiopia said that Kim Jong Un is a great man to be followed by heads of state of all other countries and the strongest leader in the world, adding that they envy the Korean army and people their good fortune of having him as the Supreme Commander. Figures of Nigeria noted that HE Kim Jong Un has trained the KPA to be an invincible army and bolstered up the military capability of the country, stressing that the Korean people led by him will surely emerge victorious in the standoff with the U.S. imperialists. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's Work Off Press in Russia
body: Respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us Add Eternal Brilliance to Comrade Kim Jong Il's Great Idea and Achievements of the Songun Revolution" was brought out in booklet by Nakhodka Format Publishing House of Russia on Dec. 25 last year to mark the 26th anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il's assumption of the supreme commandership of the Korean People's Army (KPA) and the 6th anniversary of Kim Jong Un's assumption of the KPA supreme commandership. The work, published on Aug. 25, Juche 102 (2013), deals with the Songun revolutionary leadership feats of Kim Jong Il and the essence and originality of the Songun revolutionary idea and clarifies the tasks for brilliantly accomplishing the revolutionary cause of Songun. Rodong News Team

title: Editorial
body: Let's Enhance Independence and Juche Character of National Economy It is the strategic line consistently maintained by the Workers' Party of Korea in building the socialist economy to enhance independence and Juche character of the national economy. To enhance the degree of independence and Juche character of national economy is a work of vital importance in defending and glorifying most advantageous Korean-style socialism as well as firmly defending our independent life. We are required to conduct all-out general offensive for further enhancing the independence and Juche character of the national economy on the basis of the valuable achievements and experience with confidence in sure victory and thus bring about a fresh turn in building a socialist economic power. The drive for strengthening independence and Juche character of the national economy is not just a business-like issue but a struggle for ensuring the absolute prestige of the Party Central Committee and the Party policies and defending our socialist ideology and system. Everybody has to carry out the militant tasks set forth by the Party under whatever conditions and circumstances, deeply aware that the implementation of the national economy plan for this year precisely leads to enhancing the independence and Juche character of the national economy. Let us all wage a dynamic drive for enhancing the independence and Juche character of the national economy, rallied close around the Party and thus let the loud gunfire of victory in building an independent economic power ring out nonstop this year.

title: U.S. Should Seek Out Way for Coexisting with DPRK
body: The chief of the Tokyo Bureau of the Washington Post said that last year was one when the Democratic People's Republic of Korea registered success in the all-out confrontation with the U.S. and the latter's hostile policy towards the former totally failed, adding that 2017 was a very successful year for the DPRK. Many experts on international affairs contended that the DPRK would further cement its position as a nuclear weapons state this year and the U.S. can not but be susceptible of the reality in which the former had access to nuclear weapons. No matter what desperate effort the U.S. may make, it can never save its anachronistic hostile policy towards the DPRK from its total bankruptcy. This being a hard reality, the U.S. fails to draw a lesson. Haley, U.S. ambassador to the United Nations, let out piffle that as long as the DPRK does not abandon its nuclear program, the U.S. can never regard dialogue with the DPRK as important and it can never acknowledge it as dialogue partner as it is possessed of nuclear weapons, talking about "provocation" at the very outset of the new year. This is little short of revelation of the intention of the U.S. to persist in the showdown with the DPRK like the previous year. The U.S. would be well advised to rack its brain for seeking out a way for coexistence with the DPRK, a nuclear weapons state both in name and reality, instead of precipitating its ruin with its bluffing and reckless and foolish acts. Ri Hyon Do

title: Political Gambling under Pretence of "Protecting People"
body: The Japanese reactionaries viciously pull up the Democratic People's Republic of Korea over its measures for bolstering the nuclear force. Prime Minister Abe at a lecture in Tokyo expressed the will to continuously pressurize the DPRK and face up to the grave situation, underscoring the need to reinforce practically necessary defense capability to protect the people. However, the Japanese people do not fear the "nuclear and missile threats" from the DPRK but feel the imminent danger coming from the authorities' arms buildup under the pretext of it. The Japanese reactionaries' arms buildup is aimed to lay a military foundation for a warring state. It is their real intention to draw water to their mill by pulling up others. The Japanese people should not consider as the tragedy of the past the massacre committed by the U.S. in which Japan became the first country that suffered the nuclear disasters at the end of the Second World War. They should clearly see the attempt of the U.S. to drive the Japanese people into a nuclear war by zealously backing and prodding the Japanese reactionary ruling quarters. The authorities of Japan should not recklessly gamble on the destiny of its people under the pretence of "protecting" them. They should be prudent and behave themselves, if they truly want the security of the Japanese people. If they run amuck depending on the U.S. like a tiger moth, they would not escape a miserable end. Pak Song Yong

title: Banner of National Independence Should Be Held Aloft
body: The DPRK will as ever resolve all issues by the concerted efforts of the Korean nation under the unfurled banner of national independence and frustrate the moves of the separatist forces within and without on the strength of national unity, thus making a new history of national reunification. National independence is the basis for resolving the national issues and the lifeline of the national reunification movement. To adhere to the stand of national independence serves as an important way for settling the issue of the north-south ties. Inter-Korean relations are, to all intents and purposes, an internal matter of our nation, which the north and the south should resolve on their own responsibility. The foreign forces do not want the military tension of the Korean Peninsula to be defused and the emergence of a reunified power there through improvement of the north-south relations. The matter of north-south relations should be settled by the Korean nation itself responsible for it. If the north and the south cooperate with each other, rejecting outsiders' intervention, it will be possible to settle all the issues in keeping with the nation's desire and demand and its common interests. When they join efforts on the principle of national independence, there can be no hardship and obstacle impossible to overcome. The north and the south authorities should discuss and settle all the issues arising in improving the north-south relations by our nation itself and independently, with pride and honor of the nation and confidence in its strength. The DPRK remains steadfast in its stand and will to resolve the north-south issue, the issue of national reunification, independently on the principle of national independence and by the concerted efforts of the nation, rejecting outsiders. Sim Chol Yong

title: Inter-Korean High-Level Talks Held
body: Inter-Korean high-level talks were held on Jan. 9 at the "house of peace" in the south side portion of Panmunjom amid great expectation and interest of all the fellow countrymen and the public at home and abroad. Present there were a delegation of the north side led by Ri Son Gwon, chairman of the Committee for the Peaceful Reunification of the Country of the DPRK, and a delegation of the south side with Minister of Unification Jo Myong Gyun as chief delegate.
