At the talks the north and south authorities discussed in earnest the principled issues arising in successfully holding the 23rd Winter Olympics in south Korea and improving the inter-Korean relations, and adopted the following joint press release: Joint press release of inter-Korean high-level talks Inter-Korean high-level talks were held at Panmunjom on Jan. 9. At the talks both sides had sincere discussions on the participation of a delegation of the north side in the 23rd Winter Olympics andParalympics and the improvement of the inter-Korean relations in conformity with the desire and expectations of all Koreans and agreed as follows: The north and the south agreed to proactively cooperate in ensuring that the 23rd Winter Olympics and Paralympics in the south side area would be successfully held, providing an occasion for enhancing the prestige of the nation. In this regard the north side agreed to send a delegation of the National Olympic Committee, sports team, a cheer group, an art troupe, a Taekwon-do demonstration group and a press corps along with a high-level delegation to the Olympics, and the south side agreed to provide conveniences needed for them. Both sides agreed to open working-level talks with regard to the north's dispatching of an advance party for a field tour beforehand and participation in the Winter Olympics, and agreed to discuss a schedule in the way of exchange of documents hereafter. The north and the south agreed to make concerted efforts to ease the military tension, create a peaceful environment in the Korean peninsula and promote national reconciliation and unity. They shared the viewpoint that the present military tension should be ironed out and agreed to have talks between the military authorities to this end. They agreed to promote national reconciliation and unity by invigorating contacts and travels, and exchange and cooperation in various fields. The north and the south agreed to respect the north-south declarations and solve all problems arising in inter-Korean relations through dialogue and negotiations on the principle of By Our Nation Itself. To this end, both sides agreed to have talks of every field along with high-level talks between the north and the south aimed at improving the inter-Korean relations. Rodong News Team

title: Workers in Several Sectors Vow Fulfillment of This Year's Tasks
body: Workers in the light industrial, agricultural and fishery sectors of the DPRK met to pledge the fulfillment of the tasks set forth by respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address. At the meetings, reporters and speakers said that the Supreme Leader's New Year Address serves as a signpost for constant innovations and progress as it helps put the overall might of the country on a new stage of development by frustrating the challenges of the hostile forces making last-ditch efforts to deprive the DPRK of its rights to independence, existence and development and a banner inspiring the army and people with the confidence in sure victory. They called for making a breakthrough in reenergizing the overall economic front this year when the country is to mark the 70th anniversary of the founding of the DPRK and bringing about a radical turn in the improvement of the people's standard of living. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Inspects State Academy of Sciences
body: Respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un gave field guidance to the State Academy of Sciences. The Supreme Leader, accompanied by officials, made a bow before the statues of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il at the academy. He went round the newly remodeled revolutionary museum there. Watching with keen interest the valuable historic data and relics, he said that the academy, founded in December 1952 on the initiative of Kim Il Sung, could advance along the road of glorious development under the care of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il. He underscored the need to do well the ideological education through the revolutionary museum so as to let all scientists bear in mind the unshakable faith that science knows no frontiers but they have the base of science and the precious socialist country which they should serve with science and that they will engage themselves in science only under the red flag of the Workers' Party of Korea and thus make them glorify the noble ideas of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il with great successes in scientific researches. He looked round the Exhibition of Scientific Research Successes. Noting that the exhibition was remodeled well and a great deal of scientific research achievements and exhibits are on display, he said that fruits of our scientists' brains are very admirable and this place is a treasure house of self-reliance and self-development and the academy is the birthplace of self-reliance and self-development. Though they are hard pressed for everything under the difficult conditions, our scientists do a great work in the struggle for developing the national economy and improving the people's standard of living, he said. He sent his warm greetings to all the scientists and technicians across the country and bestowed great favors on the academy with special bonus. He said the one of the secrets that the Korean revolution could make great strides despite stern ordeals and difficulties and the strategic position of our Republic could be strengthened considerably was that we have staked the sovereignty and prestige of the country and nation and the destiny of socialism on science and technology and directed primary efforts to the sci-tech development. Thanks to the foundation of self-supporting national economy, scientific and technical forces trained with our own efforts and their clear heads, there are no difficulties insurmountable for us despite the enemies' sanctions of 10 years or 100 years, he added. We should channel big efforts into the work with talents of science and technology, respect them, solve in good time knotty problems so that they may not feel inconvenience in their researches and life and, at the same time, continue to increase investment in scientific researches, he said. He discussed the measures to better the State Academy of Sciences and Wisong Scientists Residential District. He expressed expectations and belief that the officials and scientists of the academy would make a tangible contribution to building a prosperous and powerful country with scientific research successes before having a photo session with them. Accompanying him were Pak Thae Song, vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, Choe Tong Myong, department director of the C.C., WPK, and Jo Yong Won, vice department director of the C.C., WPK. Political News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's New Year Address Supported by Nepalese, Nigerian Organizations
body: Nepalese and Nigerian organizations issued statements in support of the proposals for national reunification and foreign policy stand of the Workers' Party of Korea advanced by respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address. The Nepalese Association for Supporting the Songun Politics in its statement on Jan. 4 said that Kim Jong Un's New Year Address is the highly important guideline illuminating the most correct way for durable peace and security on the Korean peninsula and the DPRK's prosperity. We extend full support to the just cause of the heroic Korean people for the country's independent reunification and final victory of revolution, it added. The Nigeria-Korea Friendship Association stated on Jan. 1: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address reviewed the miraculous successes registered by the Korean people last year and advanced just and realistic proposals for reunifying the country by the concerted efforts of the nation under the uplifted banner of national independence. He clarified that the WPK and the government of the DPRK will develop good-neighborly and friendly relations with all the countries that respect the DPRK's sovereignty and are friendly to it and make positive efforts to build a just and peaceful new world. We support the proposals for national reunification and the DPRK's foreign policy stand clarified in his New Year Address. Rodong News Team

title: Military Confrontation Is Source of Exacerbated Tension
body: Defusing military tension and removing the danger of a war from the Korean Peninsula at present are an essential issue for achieving the national unity and reunification. It would not be possible to remove the distrust and conflict between the north and the south nor would it be possible to cover the path to reunification as long as the military tension mounts. The north and the south should end the extreme military tensions at an early date and open up the way for independent reunification. It is the consistent stand and will of the DPRK to foil the outsiders' aggression moves and safeguard the wellbeing of the fellow countrymen and defend the peace of the country. We will as ever strive hard to defend the peace on the Korean Peninsula and security of the nation. Not hoping for the Korean nation getting reconciled and reunified, the U.S. is rendering the situation constantly tense on the Korean Peninsula in order to invade the DPRK and to realize the ambition for world domination. The arms buildup and the large-scale joint military exercises with foreign forces aimed at threatening and invading the other partner are key factors straining the military tension between the north and the south and driving the situation on the Korean Peninsula to unpredictable phase of danger. The north and the south can certainly avert a war and defuse the tensions on the Korean Peninsula if they make up their mind to. Neither aggressive challenge nor obstructive moves of the anti-reunification forces can ever check the advance of the Korean nation to write a new history of the national reunification by its concerted efforts. Sim Chol Yong

title: DPRK's Nuclear Deterrent Guarantees Peace
body: The nuclear force of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea is the powerful deterrent to the adventurous war gambles of the United States, disturber of global peace, and the treasured sword for safeguarding peace. Thanks to this, the DPRK is foiling the sinister attempts of the U.S. to stifle it by force and realize the wild ambition for world domination and firmly protecting peace on the Korean Peninsula and in the region despite the anti-DPRK aggression moves. The nuclear deterrent of the DPRK is the life and soul of the nation that can not be bartered for anything and the eternal foundation for rosy future of the country. It is the mission of the nuclear force of the DPRK to ensure durable peace of the Korean Peninsula and the region and happiest life of the Korean people in peaceful environment. The nuclear force of the DPRK is not a bargaining chip for political purpose and business. The nature of the U.S. to stifle the DPRK with nukes still remains unchanged. This tells that the DPRK should continue to bolster up the nuclear force under the unfurled banner of the line of simultaneously pushing forward the two fronts. With the powerful treasured sword for defending peace the DPRK has nothing to fear and always remains assured. Ri Hak Nam

title: DPRK Embassy in Cuba Hosts Reception
body: The DPRK embassy in Havana on Jan. 5 hosted a reception to mark the 59th anniversary of the victory in the Cuban revolution. Present there on invitation were the commander of the Air and Anti-Aircraft Defense Forces of Revolutionary Armed Forces of Cuba, figures from Cuban political party, government and bodies including the international department of the C.C., Communist Party of Cuba, Foreign Ministry, Ministry of Revolutionary Armed Forces and the Cuban Committee for Supporting Korea's Reunification, and Lourdes Cervantes, secretary general of the Organization of Solidarity of the Peoples of Africa, Asia and Latin America. Pak Chang Yul, DPRK ambassador to Cuba, and his embassy members were on hand. Rodong News Team

title: Foreign Media Feature Articles on Peerlessly Great Men
body: In the period between Dec. 18 and 22 last year, foreign media gave special write-ups to the 26th anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il's assumption of the supreme commandership of the Korean People's Army (KPA) and the 6th anniversary of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's assumption of the KPA supreme commandership. The Indian newspaper Ocean News Point carried an article illustrated with a photo of Kim Jong Un under the title of "Ideal State Leader". The article praised him as the most ideal state leader with fine personality and qualifications in the present times, saying that the DPRK would emerge a more powerful and prosperous state under his leadership. Articles praising the feats of Kim Jong Il were posted on the websites of the Nigerian National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism and the African Regional Committee for Friendship and Solidarity with the Korean People headquartered in Nigeria. The Bangladeshi paper Daily Nauroz in an article titled "Advance of DPRK Which No Force Can Stop" introduced in detail the fact that the DPRK has consistently adhered to the line of simultaneously pushing forward the economic construction and the building of nuclear force despite the vicious schemes of the U.S. imperialists and their vassal forces, adding that no force on the earth can prevent the DPRK from advancing under the line chosen by itself. The National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of Democratic Congo posted an article titled "Invincible Power DPRK" on its website. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Book, Photo and Handicraft Exhibitions Held Abroad
body: There were DPRK book, photo and handicraft exhibitions in Guinea, Turkey, Sweden and Mexico to mark the 26th anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il's assumption of the supreme commandership of the Korean People's Army (KPA), the 6th anniversary of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's assumption of the KPA supreme commandership and the 100th birth anniversary of the anti-Japanese war heroine Kim Jong Suk. On display at the venues were photos showing the feats of President Kim Il Sung, leader Kim Jong Il and respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Also there were works of the peerlessly great men, books and photos introducing the reality of Juche Korea and handicrafts showing the creative skills of the Korean people. The general secretary of the Democratic Rally of Africa-Democratic Party of Guinea said that the DPRK, which developed under the guidance of President Kim Il Sung and HE Kim Jong Il, is making signal achievements in all sectors under the leadership of HE Kim Jong Un. Personages of Sweden said that the exhibition underway despite the situation more acute than ever before due to the U.S. and other hostile forces' nuclear threats and moves to isolate and stifle the DPRK, was of great significance in having correct understanding of the DPRK. They underlined the need to hold such exhibitions more frequently in the future, too, so as to further develop the bilateral cultural and friendly ties. Rodong News Team

title: Meetings Held to Vow to Carry Out Tasks for This Year
body: Meetings were held by units in the fields of construction, land management, science, education, public health, sports and literature and arts to vow to carry through the tasks set forth by respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address. At the meetings reporters and speakers said that the Supreme Leader's New Year Address is the highly important guidelines giving the firm confidence in the final victory of the revolutionary cause of Juche and optimism to the Korean people and clearly showing the road ahead of them and the militant banner encouraging the army and people to an all-out onward movement for making fresh leap and innovations. They called for smashing the challenges of the hostile forces and conducting an all-people general offensive this year marking the 70th birthday of the DPRK to speed up the building of a powerful socialist country. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's New Year Address Introduced by Argentine Political Party
body: The Communist Party of Argentina on Jan. 3 posted the detailed gist of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address on its online bulletin "De Todas Partes". Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung's Work Introduced in Brazil
body: The Brazilian Center for the Study of the Juche Idea posted the full text of President Kim Il Sung's work "Let Us Overthrow Imperialism" on its website on January 5. The work, published on October 17, Juche 15 (1926), clarifies the idea that it is necessary to fight to the last against the Japanese imperialists to free the popular masses from colonial slavery. It also sets forth tasks to overthrow the Japanese imperialists and achieve the independence of Korea so as to make sure that the Korean people lead a free and happy life and creditably carry out the sacred cause of overthrowing all imperialism on the earth to make the oppressed working people of the whole world lead a free and happy life. Rodong News Team

title: Mongolian President Wishes Korean People Bigger Successes
body: O Sung Ho, DPRK ambassador to Mongolia, on Jan. 8 presented his credentials to Khaltmaa Battulga, president of Mongolia. The president said that he wished the Korean people bigger successes under the guidance of respected Supreme Leader HE Kim Jong Un this year. Referring to the long-standing traditional ties of friendship between the two countries, he said he would pay special attention to successfully holding the events marking the 70th anniversary of the establishment of bilateral diplomatic relations. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Suk Praised by Foreign Media
body: In the period between December 18 and 24 last year, media of different countries gave special write-ups to the 100th birth anniversary of the anti-Japanese war heroine Kim Jong Suk. They carried a photo of President Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Suk, a woman commander of Mt Paektu, standing together and photos and art works depicting her. The Iranian Ilna and the Nepalese online magazine Nepal Today said that the exploits of Kim Jong Suk, a prominent woman revolutionary produced by the Korean nation, would remain forever with the victorious advance of Juche Korea, reporting in detail about her transparent spirit of devotedly protecting the leader, rare military strategy, incredible marksmanship, matchless pluck and warm humanity. The Congolese newspaper Le Patriot wrote that there have been many prominent women in history but no such distinguished woman political activist as Kim Jong Suk who devoted her all to the freedom and happiness of the people. Her noble career left unforgettable mark in the modern history of Korea, it added. The newspaper Zavtra, DV-Ros News Service and other media of Russia introduced her revolutionary career and exploits. Rodong News Team

title: Art Troupe of Korean Schoolchildren from Japan Feted
body: A reception was given in Pyongyang for an art troupe of Korean schoolchildren in Japan on Jan. 11 under the care of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. The troupe took part in the New Year celebration performance. Present there on invitation was the art troupe of Korean schoolchildren in Japan headed by Jon Jin Song, principal of Kyusu Korean Middle and High School. On hand were Kim Yong Chol, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Kim Jin Guk, director of the Overseas Koreans' Affairs Administration, and officials concerned. Kim Yong Chol said in his speech that Marshal Kim Jong Un bestowed warm loving care on the members of the art troupe of Korean schoolchildren in Japan even though he was busy leading the building of a powerful socialist country. He expressed belief that Korean schoolchildren in Japan would prepare themselves to be pillars of the patriotic cause of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) only following the Marshal and the competent patriotic talents equipped with knowledge, good moral character and good health. Jon Jin Song thanked Marshal Kim Jong Un for having invited the Korean children in Japan to the New Year celebration performance and shown warm loving care for them with parental affection. He said that Korean schoolchildren in Japan would prepare themselves to be the reliable successors to the movement of Koreans in Japan and the true pillars of the patriotic movement. Schoolchildren in Pyongyang and members of the art troupe gave a joint performance at the reception. Rodong News Team

title: Bright Lodestar of National Reunification
body: The cause of Korea's independent reunification is sure to be accomplished despite the persistent challenges and obstructive moves of the separatist forces as the Koreans have respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un as the sun of the nation and the bright lodestar of national reunification. It is the noble patriotic will of the father of the nation to decisively end the confrontation era woven with distrust and antagonism and usher in a new era of national reconciliation and unity. It is time that the north and the south of Korea sit face to face with a view to holding sincere discussions over the issue of improving inter-Korean relations by our nation itself and seek a way out for its settlement in a bold manner. The north and the south should remove mutual misunderstanding and distrust, open a broad avenue of improving relations through reconciliation and cooperation and thus fulfill their responsibility and role as the motive force of national reunification. To defuse the grave military tension and create a peaceful environment on the Korean Peninsula is the primary task for improving the north-south relations at the lowest ebb, saving the nation's destiny from crisis and ushering in a new era of national reunification. The recent inter-Korean high-level talks are a precious fruition of the new policy set forth by the respected Supreme Leader in his New Year Address to improve the north-south relations. He is a peerless patriot and the supreme incarnation of love and benevolence as he is creditably carrying forward the patriotic history with the same warm love for the nation and benevolence as those of the great leaders. A new dawn of national reunification is breaking thanks to his warm patriotic will and under his extraordinary leadership. Un Jong Chol

title: Kim Jong Un's New Year Address Is of Great Significance: Swiss Bodies
body: Comrade Kim Jong Un's New Year Address is of weighty significance as it indicates the effective ways for accomplishing the cause of building a powerful socialist country and achieving the national reunification at an early date true to the behests of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il. The Switzerland-Korea Committee and the Swiss Group for the Study of the Juche Idea said this in a joint statement on Jan. 1 in support of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address. The statement said that as Kim Jong Un clarified in his New Year Address, the year 2017 of the DPRK was a year of heroic struggle and great victory, a year when the DPRK set up an indestructible milestone in the history of building a powerful socialist country with the spirit of self-reliance and self-development as the dynamic force, adding: An outstanding success the Party, state and people of the DPRK won last year was the accomplishment of the great, historic cause of perfecting the national nuclear forces. This year will mark the 70th anniversary of the founding of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. Marshal Kim Jong Un set forth in his New Year Address the slogan "Let us launch a revolutionary general offensive to achieve fresh victory on all fronts of building a powerful socialist country!" He clarified that as a responsible, peace-loving nuclear power, the DPRK will neither have recourse to nuclear weapons unless hostile forces of aggression violate its sovereignty and interests nor threaten any other country or region by means of nuclear weapons. We hope that a rosy future would be promised for the DPRK. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's New Year Address Backed Abroad
body: Personages of Cyprus and Uganda on Jan. 2 and 3 made public statements in support of the New Year Address delivered by respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Adamos Katsantonis, chairman of the Cyprus-DPRK Cultural Friendship Association, said that Kim Jong Un set forth tasks for vigorously advancing socialism in his New Year Address, adding: Entirely just are the ways for the economic development in the DPRK and global peace and security, indicated by him. I offer warm wishes to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un devotedly working for the country's prosperity and the global peace. Daniel Rugarama, chairman of the Ugandan National Executive Committee of the Pan-African Movement, said that last year the DPRK achieved gigantic development despite the U.S. unprecedented sanctions and thus gave full play to its prestige before the world eyes. He went on: HE Kim Jong Un's New Year Address clearly indicates the orientation and ways for the Korean people's struggle for this year and reflects the future of the strategic state. The New Year Address overflowing with compatriotic feelings is run through with positive contents for the sake of Korea's reunification. The U.S. must roll back its hostile policy towards the DPRK in keeping with the wishes of humankind for peace and justice. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's New Year Address Introduced in Venezuela
body: The Venezuelan National Society for the Study of the Juche Idea on January 2 carried the full text of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address in its bulletin. Rodong News Team

title: Editorial
body: Let Us Fully Demonstrate Dignity and Might of Juche Korea All the people launched a revolutionary general offensive under the leadership of the great Party so as to fully demonstrate the dignity of Juche Korea and its spirit of rapid progress. The all-people general offensive - this is the one based on single-hearted unity that can be seen in the DPRK only where the great Party and the people share the destiny and future to the last. All the people should adorn every day of the offensive with fresh struggle and feats in hearty response to the ardent calls of the Party. The whole Party, the entire army and all the people should turn out as one in the campaign to carry through the militant tasks set forth in the New Year Address of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un with high awareness and passion. We should channel all our energies into implementing the tasks with his New Year Address as a banner and signpost for the victory of the revolutionary general offensive and glorify the indomitable heroic era with the might of great harmonious whole. All sectors and units have to certainly attain the goals set by the Party this year despite the tenser situation and the worst adversity. We should make rapid progress in the building of a powerful socialist country by taking the historic victory in the building of the state nuclear force as a springboard for fresh progress.

title: Investigation into Lee Myung Bak's Scandals Urged in S. Korea
body: According to the south Korean online newspaper Jaju Sibo, organizations in Pusan including the Pusan Regional Headquarters of People's Solidarity held a news conference before the Pusan District Prosecutor's Office on Jan. 9 in demand of the investigation into scandals of traitor Lee Myung Bak. Speakers said that it is necessary to investigate all crimes committed by Lee Myung Bak, Park Geun Hye and the "Liberal Korea Party" to the end and punish them. A press release was read out there. The release urged the prosecution to divest Lee Myung Bak of his privilege as former "president", arrest him at once and start the investigation. Rodong News Team

title: Intentional Provocation Going against Detente
body: Shortly ago, the U.S. military announced that it planned to deploy the nuclear carrier Stennis in the West Pacific soon in the wake of making public the deployments of Ronald Reagan staying in Japan and Carl Vinson in the U.S. mainland in the waters off the Korean Peninsula. Meanwhile, the U.S. reinforced various type fighters and troops in its air bases in south Korea and Japan from its mainland. Such moves are an unpardonable military provocation chilling the atmosphere for improved inter-Korean relations created by the DPRK's pro-active proposal and efforts and challenging the unanimous desire and demand of the public at home and abroad for detente and peace on the Korean Peninsula. The U.S. reckless military provocations are reminiscent of a pack of wolves eyeing a feast at other's wedding house. The U.S. aggressor forces deployed in and around the Korean Peninsula would become the best prey of the Hwasong artillerymen that put Guam and the U.S. mainland in their striking range. The U.S. had better awake from an illusion, properly facing up to the strategic position and entity of the DPRK as a world-level military power. The U.S. imperialist warmongers would be well advised to ponder over disastrous consequences to be entailed by their military provocations against the DPRK possessed of powerful nuclear deterrence, cool down their heads heated with war hysteria and stop acting rashly. Sim Chol Yong

title: Independence is Justice and Victory
body: The imperialists are making desperate efforts to stem the violent trend of the world people advancing along the road of independence, but no force on the earth can check the onward movement of the world people advancing independently with their destiny in their own hands. Independence is justice and victory and victory is sure to come when struggling with firm faith on the basis of the correct methodology. Independence should be maintained in politics, self-support achieved in the economy and self-reliance in national defence enhanced. The countries aspiring after independence should unite and struggle for international justice. An independent new world can be built when unity is achieved. The imperialists fear most the world people following the road of independence in close unity and solidarity. When the broad people of the world struggle, united close under the uplifted banner of independence and justice, they can foil any aggression moves of the imperialists and their strategy of strength and realize the global independence. Nothing can check the current of development of history toward independence. The world progressive people should vigorously wage the struggle against imperialism and hegemony, with the faith that independence is justice and victory. Son So Yon

title: Barrier of Mistrust and Confrontation Should Be Demolished
body: The new policy for improving the relations between the north and the south, clarified by respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address, is a brilliant embodiment of the Juche-based line for national reunification which the DPRK has consistently maintained and a revelation of his noble patriotic will to write a new history of national reunification by the concerted efforts of the Korean nation itself. It is the most positive policy for reunification as it correctly reflects the immensely increased comprehensive national strength of the DPRK, strategic structure on the Korean Peninsula dramatically changed by it, the prevailing situation and the ever-growing desire for reunification. The issue of easing the acute military tension between the north and the south and creating a peaceful environment on the Korean Peninsula, the issue of positively establishing a climate favorable for national reconciliation and reunification and the issue for the authorities in the north and the south to hold aloft the banner of national independence serve as a precious guideline that should be held fast to in defusing the tensions and improving the inter-Korean relations at present. The recent north-south high-level talks, held under this new policy, proved again that there is no problem unsolvable if the north and the south pool their efforts. Now is the time for the north and the south to have sincere discussion on the issue of improving their relations and seek a way out for the nation in a bold manner by the concerted efforts. The issue of improving inter-Korean relations is an important matter to be solved by the concerted efforts of not only the authorities but also the entire nation. We will open the door of dialogue, contact and travel to anyone in south Korea, including the ruling party and opposition parties, organizations and individual personages of all backgrounds, if they truly want national reconciliation and unity. Pak Chol Jun

title: DPRK FM Spokesman's Statement Distributed as UN Document
body: A statement issued by a spokesman for the DPRK Foreign Ministry over the UN Security Council "sanctions resolution" 2397, which was cooked up by the U.S. denouncing the DPRK's successful test launch of ICBM Hwasong-15, was distributed as an official document A/72/690-S/2017/1106 of the UN General Assembly and the UN Security Council on Jan. 9. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Suk's Noble Career Praised Abroad
body: Foreign bodies posted on their websites articles marking the centenary of birth of the anti-Japanese war heroine Kim Jong Suk between December 21 and 24 last year. The websites carried photos and pictures of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il and Kim Jong Suk and art pieces depicting her image. The Brazilian Center for the Study of Songun Politics and the Brazilian Center for the Study of the Juche Idea posted on their websites articles praising the noble revolutionary career of Kim Jong Suk, an outstanding woman political activist who left clear mark in the history of modern Korea by making a distinguished contribution to the liberation of the country and the building of a new country. The France-Korea Friendship Association posted an article saying that Kim Jong Suk was born into a patriotic and revolutionary family and the International Friendship Initiative "Explore DPRK" of Poland an article dealing with her undying feats. The Nigerian National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism posted an article telling about the military exploits of Kim Jong Suk who delivered wholesale death to the enemy in battles during the anti-Japanese war. The British Association for the Study of Songun Policy posted an article lauding the feats of Kim Jong Suk, noting that her career was a brilliant one of a revolutionary who devoted her all to supporting the noble intention of President Kim Il Sung. Rodong News Team

title: Punishment of Hirelings of Traitor Park Demanded in S. Korea
body: The South Kyongsang Provincial Movement Headquarters for Eradicating the Deep-rooted Evils and Building Democratic Society called a press conference on Jan. 8 over the case in which an exhibit was displayed to praise "yusin" dictator Park Chung-Hee and traitor Park Geun Hye. The organization demanded an investigation into the case and the punishment of those responsible for it, according to the south Korean online paper Ohmy News. Rodong News Team

title: Candlelight Rally against THAAD in S. Korea
body: A candlelight rally was reportedly held in Kimchon City, North Kyongsang Province on Jan. 7 to declare a struggle for the withdrawal of illegally-deployed THAAD. Taking part in it were members of civic and trade unions and inhabitants in Kimchon City and Songju County. Speakers at the rally called for a concerted action to have THAAD withdrawn this year without fail. A resolution, read out there, stressed that the action for withdrawal of THAAD is a struggle for independence and life and for peace in the Korean Peninsula and Northeast Asia and the rest of the world. Rodong News Team

title: Misguided Public Opinion May Mess Up Great Event of Nation
body: The conservative media of south Korea obsessed by the conception of confrontation with the fellow countrymen are misleading the public opinion, while describing the DPRK's proposal and sincere efforts for north-south dialogue as "double-dealing tactics". They even admonished the authorities to be vigilant against "the north's trick to impair the south Korea-U.S. alliance". Even novices ignorant of the DPRK called the DPRK's dispatch of a cheer group and artists' group the one "aimed to use the Olympics as a promotion ground" and did not hesitate to say that north-south high-ranking talks are to "evade sanctions". Such despicable acts of the conservative media keen on finding out things accusing their fellow countrymen are a deliberate deed of chilling the atmosphere for improved north-south ties welcomed by the world. Because of the conservative media keen on reeling off all sorts of vituperation against the fellow countrymen even before the north-south relations make a good start to depart from their frozen state, the "peace Olympics" so much advertised by the south Korean authorities may turn into "confrontation Olympics". Tongue may bring calamity and miswritten pen may become a sword beheading oneself. They should know that they may mess up the great event of the nation should they get on the nerves of the dialogue partner and wag their tongue and writing brush at will. If the present situation turns into the freezing state which is not wished for by anyone, the blame will entirely rest with those who made fun of and went against the active proposal and efforts made by the DPRK for the improvement of the north-south ties. The south Korean authorities may find the wedding ceremony turning into a mourning ceremony if they fail to hold tight control of media and of their own tongue. Kim Chol Guk, Department Director of Central Committee of Journalists Union of Korea

title: Chongryon Officials Meet
body: Officials of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) held a meeting at the Korean Hall in Tokyo on Jan. 12 to vow to implement the tasks set forth by respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address for Juche 107 (2018) and his New Year message. Attending it were Chairman Ho Jong Man and vice-chairmen of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, advisers and department directors of the Chongryon Central Committee, the director of the Research Institute on History of Korean Residents in Japan, chairmen of Chongryon headquarters in Kanto, leading officials of Chongryon organizations and businesses, officials under Chongryon headquarters in Kanto and teachers of Korean schools at all levels. Read out at the meeting was Kim Jong Un's New Year message to the chairman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee. Making a report, Ho Jong Man said that the Supreme Leader's New Year Address is a treasured sword of sure victory as it advanced the outstanding strategy, tasks and radical proposals for winning in the final showdown with the U.S. when the Juche cause is in its new higher stage, and it is a militant banner encouraging the army and people in the homeland to a revolutionary general offensive. He stressed the need for Chongryon officials to take the lead in fully displaying the true nature of Chongryon, a dignified overseas citizens organization of the DPRK, and setting up a new milestone on the sacred road for strengthening the movement of Koreans in Japan this year. Speeches were made there. A letter to Kim Jong Un was read out. Rodong News Team

title: South Korean Authorities Should Not Be Dreaming
body: The happy environment for the north-south reconciliation, created by the great magnanimity and initiative measures taken by the DPRK, has greatly excited all the Koreans including those in the south. The international community is also positively appreciating the efforts made by the north and the south, hoping to see the trend of detente persisting on the Korean Peninsula. At this time, ill-boding remarks chilling the atmosphere for reconciliation are heard from south Korea, upsetting the people. That was uttered by the south Korean chief executive at the new year press briefing. The south Korean chief executive said that the beginning of the south-north dialogue can be described as the effect made by the U.S.-led sanctions and pressure and President Trump played a big role, showing his willingness to express thanks to him. He even made such rubbish that the north was led to dialogue to open up the chapter for "the north's denuclearization", not for the improvement of the south-north relations. He said that he would not be so weak as to only pursue dialogue with the north. Saying the start of the dialogue does not mean the solution to "north's nuclear issue", he vowed to keep step with the international community in applying sanctions and not to alleviate the sanctions of its own accord. Through his remarks that the improvement of the ties with the north must accompany the solution of the "north's nuclear issue", he openly disclosed his dirty intention. The "solution of the north's nuclear issue" touted by him is the revised version of the "north's nuclear dismantlement". Saying that dialogue should never be held for the mere form's sake, the chief executive even made such ignorant and unreasonable remarks that summit can be possible only when preconditions are set and expected results are certain. His coarse invectives made us think how can he be so ruthless and ignorant of his dialogue partner even though his position is so poor as to read the face of his master. It is known to all that the U.S. is putting pressure on the south Korean authorities, saying that the improvement of the north-south ties unhelpful to the "north's nuclear dismantlement" would be meaningless, being much upset by the upcoming north-south dialogue, even though it is outwardly voicing "support" and "welcome". It is needless to say that the new year press briefing of the south Korean chief executive was to curry favor with his discontent master. It is by no means accidental that media at home and abroad deride the south Korean chief executive's attitude as the one helping to learn the state of mind of the U.S. It is the obligation of human being to respond favor with favor and sincerity in kind. This is exactly the case for the north and south authorities who have just begun to kindle the flame for reconciliation and improvement of the relations from the phase of worst confrontation. The present south Korean chief executive's attitude casts doubt as to his intent to improve the north-south ties and build confidence. To claim to hold talks which can only be successful is little short of hoping for a meal without cooking it. Only when talks are held, can there be joint statement and joint press release and can there be an agreement both sides share. This is a common sense. People ask without dissenting voice if he is truly "president" who hopes for results and success first, before sitting face to face with each other. What should be respected, one's face or results for the nation, at a time when the nation is about to sit together for betterment. Dialogue partners have to sit together first to make sincere efforts to produce good results. But the south Korean chief executive said that talks can be held only when results are expected. How can he be viewed as having proper stand toward the settlement of north-south relations. Trump said that the north-south dialogue has become possible thanks to the international sanctions and pressure spearheaded by the U.S. The south Korean chief executive expressed gratitude to Trump and pledged to lead the north-south talks to the DPRK-U.S. talks for the "north's nuclear dismantlement". His brownnosing attitude is something beyond imagination. Therefore, it can be viewed that the south Korean authorities' approach to let the DPRK take part in the Winter Olympics is in the end aimed to induce the DPRK into responding to its demand, while looking far into the "north's nuclear dismantlement" rather than the issue of the north-south ties. We have made all efforts for the high-level talks and other things in the direction of having everything, wished by the south Korean authorities regarding our participation in the Winter Olympics, settled out of the sincere willingness to improve the north-south ties in line with the ardent expectation and wish of all Koreans. Now is the first process for improving the north-south ties and building confidence and, therefore, this should be valued. After making good first step, one should make efforts to solve something possible one by one on the principle of mutual respect while building confidence with each other so that both sides can have good feelings. But the south Korean authorities have an axe to grind, hoping to eat corn without teeth. Not content with advertising the north-south dialogue as the result of sanctions and pressure and as "successes" derived by them, the south Korean authorities who announced to postpone the joint military exercises with the U.S. are now bringing into waters off south Korea and its vicinity the U.S. strategic assets like nuclear carrier task force timed for the holding of the Winter Olympics, an occasion for the north and south to sit together and open up a chapter for peace, thereby deliberately straining the situation. What could be the reason behind such military act? We have met all the demands raised by them, out of sincerity and magnanimity. Now they are going arrogant, with their head raised. This proves that the south Korean authorities are not concerned for the interests and demands of the nation but they are a group of pro-U.S. traitors who are only keen on currying favor with their master and keeping their power even at the sacrifice of the Winter Olympics and the valuable sprout of the improvement of the north-south ties. The south Korean chief executive should not be dreaming. We will as ever strive to improve the north-south ties but will never remain an on-looker to sordid acts of chilling the efforts. Everything is now at the beginning. They should know that train and bus carrying our delegation to the Olympics are still in Pyongyang. They should discard the impudent idea that someone will cook meal and feed them. One has to cook one's own meal. The south Korean authorities had better ponder over what unfavorable results may be entailed by their impolite behavior. Jong Kyong Sik, Section Chief of National Reunification Institute

title: American Gangsters Running Amuck to Spoil Significant Event of Korean Nation
body: The U.S. ruling quarters are viciously scheming to spoil the significant event of the Korean nation. It was at a dazzling speed that the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) has emerged a strategic state acknowledged by the world with the accomplishment of the great historic cause of completing the national nuclear force. The new policy for improved north-south relations, announced on the New Year's Day in this country, turned the swirling trend of the situation toward the direction of detente, peace and improvement of ties. Thanks to the initiative proposal and active measures taken by the DPRK, successful north-south high-level talks were held at Panmunjom to delight all Koreans and this opened up the first breakthrough toward the improvement of the ties. But the present ruling quarters in the U.S. are behaving mischievous, following with uneasiness the progress made in the spirit of By Our Nation Itself. When the historic New Year Address was made public in the DPRK, there heard from the U.S. political circle such rubbish as "tactic of opening to the south and shutting out the U.S.", "act of driving a wedge" between the south Korea and the U.S. and such remarks that north Korea can again opt for additional missile "provocation" at the end of Olympics. Before the north-south high-level talks, the U.S. called them a trick to divide Seoul and Washington and weaken sanctions and pressure. It even began to spread the story that talks that can weaken the U.S.-led sanctions and pressure on the DPRK should never be allowed and that the improvement of the north-south relations is inseparable from the solution of the "north's nuclear issue" and, therefore, it can never be advanced separately, which came as a threat to the south Korean authorities. As the DPRK's big magnanimity and good favor resulted in successful north-south high-level talks far beyond expectation, the U.S. authorities including Trump, hiding their upset mind, made a U-turn in their stand to describe them as the direct result of the unprecedented pressure on the DPRK put by the U.S., a daring act of attributing the result common to the north and the south to its "merit". It is the bad habit of the U.S. to deliberately strain the situation on the Korean peninsula and check the improvement of the north-south ties while intervening in the internal issue of the Korean nation and instructing others to do this or that. By nature, the U.S. dislikes to see the situation on the Korean Peninsula defused and the peaceful atmosphere created in Asia-Pacific. What is all the more dangerous is that the U.S. military actions are pursuant to the lunatic president's ignorance and frenzy, not prompted by any political demand and reasonable judgment. The U.S. should be deliberate. The U.S. styling itself the "super power" is being taken to the cliff of destruction led by the lunatic president whose thinking faculty is at the level of preschooler and who has the symptom of dementia. The warmongers may storm us if they have certainty of handling the responsibility. This is the pluck of the DPRK, the world-level nuclear power and rocket power. The U.S. nuclear carriers are just good prey for the Hwasong artillerymen of the DPRK who have already put Guam and even the U.S. mainland in their striking range. Choe Kang Chol, Researcher of Institute of International Studies of Korea

title: Group Running of Government Officials in DPRK
body: A group running by officials of ministries and national institutions in the DPRK took place on Jan. 14, the first sports day of the new year. The participants began running at Kim Il Sung Square in Pyongyang, divided into two groups. They ran along the streets of the city, with determination to make collective innovation in a great campaign for creating the Mallima speed. The group running displayed the might of unity and team spirit. In the wake of group running, there were demonstrations of the Taekwon-Do exercise for health and mass rhythmic exercise. Meanwhile, diverse sports events were held at institutions and industrial establishments in Pyongyang, including the Kim Jong Suk Pyongyang Textile Mill and the Pyongyang Electric Cable Factory 326. Similar events took place in provinces, cities and counties of the country. Earlier, group running and other sports events were held in co-op farms across the country. Rodong News Team

title: Conservative Forces in S. Korea Should Give Up Intent for Confrontation
body: Though voicing "support" for the opening of high-level talks between the north and the south of Korea, the conservative forces in the south including the "Liberal Korea Party" claimed that "the south should not be deceived by the camouflaged peace offensive of the north" and that "nuclear dismantlement should be a precondition for dialogue". This is an anti-reunification behavior to chill the whole nation's desire for dialogue and improved relations between the north and the south and keep the relations at the low ebb. Their behavior shows that the bad habit of sustaining their existence by hurting the north, escalating the north-south confrontation and distrusting everything of the north has not changed at all. It is only the "Liberal Korea Party" and other conservative forces of south Korea that conduct such improper behavior as branding the north's patriotic efforts for improved north-south relations and national reunification as a "camouflaged peace offensive". If the conservative forces of south Korea go against the trend of the times for improved north-south relations, being obsessed with view on the past, they would be ostracized by the nation and history forever. The "Liberal Korea Party" and other conservative forces of south Korea should not turn blind eyes to our sincere proposal for opening the door of dialogue, contact and visits to the ruling and opposition parties of south Korea. Those who betray the mindset of the people while swimming against the trend of the times will have no future. The south Korean conservatives should give up the treacherous intent for confrontation, mindful that to improve the north-south relations is the aspiration and demand of all Koreans. Ra Sol Ha

title: National Unity Is Vital to Improved Inter-Korean Relations
body: To realize the national reconciliation and unity is important for improving the relations between the north and the south of Korea and providing a favorable environment for national reunification at present. To the Korean nation who has undergone the tragedy of division for many years, it is vital demand which can no longer be delayed to end the history of confrontation and realize the national unity and reunification. The north and the south should be aware of their responsibility and duty before the times and history and positively create an atmosphere for national reconciliation and reunification. The atmosphere of national reconciliation and reunification never comes by itself. It is realized through contact, travel, cooperation and exchange. It is our stand to open the door to anyone from south Korea, including the ruling and opposition parties, organizations and individual personages of all backgrounds, for dialogue, contact and travel, if they sincerely wish for national reconciliation and unity. The future orientation of the inter-Korean relations depends on the south Korean authorities' efforts for creating the atmosphere of national reconciliation and reunification. The south Korean authorities should lend an ear to the voices of the people, remove the walls of confrontation and sincerely come out to the road for improved north-south relations and independent reunification, not reading others' faces. No one can present an honorable appearance in front of the nation if he or she ignores the trend of the times toward national reconciliation and reunification. Pak Chol Jun

title: Kim Jong Un's New Year Address Supported Abroad
body: Personages of different countries issued statements on Jan. 4 and 5 in support of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address. Benigno Gonzales Villasana, chairman of the Mexico-Korea Friendship Association, said that Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address declared that the great, historic cause of perfecting the national nuclear forces was accomplished. At last, the DPRK emerged a world-level nuclear power and it is clear that the U.S. can not dare to ignite a war against the DPRK, he noted. He said Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address set forth the tasks for socialist economic construction. He noted that Kim Jong Un also made proposals for mending the north-south relations, which are enjoying full support and welcome from the world peace-loving progressive peoples. Vasile Orleanu, chairman of the National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of Romania, expressed the full support for the New Year Address of Kim Jong Un, the Supreme Leader of the Korean people, stressing: We urge the U.S. to do things helpful to the settlement of affairs on the Korean Peninsula, far from its anachronistic hostile policy towards the DPRK. We will always support the struggle of the independent and peace-loving Korean people. Abdi Kedir, chief of the Ethiopian Group for the Study of the Juche Idea, said the proposals for national reunification advanced by Kim Jong Un are the most just and realistic ones, adding that the progressive humankind wants Korea's independent reunification. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Sends Wreath to Bier of Kim Kwang Suk
body: Respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un sent a wreath to the bier of People's Artiste Kim Kwang Suk, a vocal music instructor of the Pyongyang Schoolchildren's Palace, on Jan. 14, expressing deep condolences over her death. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Visits Newly-Remodeled Pyongyang Teacher Training College
body: Respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un visited the newly-remodeled Pyongyang Teacher Training College. In February last year he gave instructions to turn the college into a model put on a scientific, IT and modern basis at a high level and generalize it across the country and solved all problems arising in its reconstruction. Officials, party members and working people of Pyongyang City completed the project for updating the college with a total floor space of more than 24 100 square meters in a short period, true to his intention. The Supreme Leader highly appreciated them for having successfully turned the college into a world-level exemplary one. Going round a room dedicated to the history of the college, an education science exhibition hall, an education control room, a multi-function classroom, a library, a gymnasium, a dormitory and other parts of the college, he learned in detail about its modernization and educational work. The college, founded in September 1968, could cover a proud course of development under the wise and meticulous guidance of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il in the past period, he said, stressing that its officials and teaching staff should devote their wisdom and passion to the educational work, well aware of their important duty, and thus add shine to the immortal exploits of the great leaders. Saying that he was very glad to see the college equipped with ultra-modern education facilities, school things and operation facilities, he expressed his great satisfaction over them. Educational work is a patriotic work of lasting significance for the country's future and the teacher training colleges have an important role to play in glorifying the DPRK as a country of education and a talent power by bringing about a radical improvement in education in the new century, he said. He noted that the Party remodeled Pyongyang Teacher Training College with much care as it attaches importance to the teacher training colleges, a pedigree establishment for training teachers in charge of the education of children, and instructed that every province should spruce up the teacher training colleges with it as a model. He stressed that the teaching staff of the country, including teachers of the college, should dedicate their ardent patriotism and pure conscience to the educational work, well conscious of being the master of education and the work for improvement in education in the new century. Expressing belief that the officials, teachers and students of the college would fulfill their duty in the work to put the preschool and primary school education on a fresh scientific basis, he had a photo session with them. Accompanying him were Pak Thae Song, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and Jo Yong Won, vice department director of the C.C., WPK. Political News Team

title: Desperate Scream of Half-Witted Dotard
body: Recently, Trump who is crazy about the hostile policy toward the DPRK has once again stunned the world by twitting that he has a "big and strong nuclear button." After these reckless remarks were twitted, they have become the target of scoff and criticism from not only world media and experts on the Korean issue, but also high-level officials in the former U.S. administration. Trump's bluff is regarded by the DPRK as just a spasm of a lunatic frightened by the might of Juche Korea and a bark of a rabid dog. The spasm of Trump in the new year reflects the desperate mental state of a loser who failed to check the vigorous advance of the army and people of the DPRK all out to carry out the line of simultaneously developing the two fronts. The Trump clans have quite often claimed that the international community should cooperate in exerting pressure upon the DPRK, asserting that it is "threatening the world peace". But Trump revealed over twitter who defends peace and who wants a nuclear war. Experts on the Korean issue said that it is not fitting for the president to put the dangerous and serious issue like a nuclear war on twitter and it is an irresponsible behavior leading the situation to the brink of a war. Trump earns strong criticism for his tongue-lashing. He is making bluff only to be diagnosed as a psychopath. The U.S. shouldn't doubt even a bit the DPRK's nuclear deterrent bolstered to settle the showdown with the U.S. but behave with prudence. Ri Hyon Do

title: Malicious Scheme to Profit from Aggravated Situation
body: Thanks to the DPRK's active measure, the situation on the Korean Peninsula is going towards detente. In a bid to reverse the trend some Japanese VIPs such as Prime Minister Abe; Chief Cabinet Secretary Suga; Defense Minister Onodera and Chief of the Asia and Oceania Bureau of Foreign Ministry Kanasuki said that Japan remains unchanged in the policy to leave no stone unturned to put maximum pressure on the DPRK and will not respond to the full-dress dialogue so long as the DPRK fails to take concrete action for denuclearization. It is nothing but the base and malicious scheme of the Japanese reactionary ruling quarters to draw water to their mill by deliberately exacerbating the tension on the Korean Peninsula. This is motivated by the Abe group's ulterior intention to remain in office long. So they are working hard to get rid of the crisis by diverting elsewhere the sharp criticism from the public at home. This is also mainly aimed at turning Japan into a military giant and realizing the militarist ambition. Abe group's "long-cherished desire" is to make Japan a war state. The detente on the Korean peninsula is unfavorable for the Abe group whose ultimate goal is to convert Japan into a war state. That is why they persist in their policy to stifle the DPRK. Japan would be well advised to liquidate the worst crimes against the Korean nation instead of running amuck. Son So Yon

title: Issue of Inter-Korean Relations Should be Independently Settled
body: The inter-Korean high-level talks were held recently and an agreement has been reached. In order to lead this to national reunification by expanding these successes, it is necessary to reject interference of foreign forces and surely maintain the stand to independently solve the issue of the north-south relations by the Korean nation itself under the unfurled banner of national independence. The inter-Korean relations are the internal affair of our nation from A to Z. No foreign forces have qualifications and justification to poke their noses into the issue of inter-Korean relations. If foreign forces interfere in the issue, there would be difficulties in realizing the will and demands of our nation because of their interests. Dependence on the United States and cooperation with it make it impossible to realize fundamental interests of the nation as the U.S., clean indifferent to the destiny of other countries and nations, seeks only its interests for aggression, opposes reconciliation and unity of our nation and reunification and puts break on them. It is the height of folly to curry favor with foreign forces and get support from them in solving the issue of inter-Korean relations. The issue of inter-Korean relations is the internal affair of the Korean nation and so it is necessary to reject the intervention of outsiders and for the north and the south to solve the issue independently. Only then, the issue of inter-Korean relations, the issue of national reunification, can be smoothly solved in keeping with the aspiration and demand of our nation. Our nation has either strength or wisdom for improving the inter-Korean relations. And the will and way to improve the inter-Korean relations rest with our nation. Our nation has the strength enough to hew out its destiny by itself with independent view. The stand and viewpoint on national independence serve as clear touchstone to distinguish who wants to improve inter-Korean relations or not. Un Jong Chol

title: Choe Ryong Hae Inspects Various Units in Sinuiju
body: Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, made a field survey of the Sinuiju Cosmetics Factory and the Sokha Cooperative Farm in Sinuiju City. Going round various places of the factory, Choe encouraged the producers in their devoted struggle and stressed the need to turn the production process into the labor and electricity-saving one to ensure the quality and quantity of products on a high level. Then, he went round the Sokha Cooperative Farm which has undergone a radical change as befitting the modern socialist farm. Saying that the farmers should do farming by dint of science and technology, not forgetting the benevolence of the Party and thus overfulfill their plan for the state cereals production this year, he underscored the need to conduct dynamic campaigns in which one overtakes and learns from others and swaps experiences with each other. Rodong News Team

title: Inter-Korean Working-Level Talks Held
body: Working-level talks between the north and the south of Korea for the dispatch of the north side's art troupe were held at the Thongil House in Panmunjom on Jan. 15. Present there were members of the north side's delegation led by Kwon Hyok Bong, department director of the Ministry of Culture, and members of the south side's delegation with Ri U Song, section head of the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism, as its chief delegate. At the talks both sides had a sincere discussion on the practical matters related to the performances by the north side's art troupe to be dispatched to the south side's area with the 23rd Winter Olympics as an occasion and adopted a joint press release. According to the release, the north side will dispatch its art troupe comprised of more than 140 members to the south side and give its performances in Kangrung and Seoul. Various technical matters for performances will be smoothly settled through consultation with the south side. Reflected in the joint press release is the content that the north side will send a field survey delegation as early as possible and the south side will ensure the safety and convenience of the north side's art troupe to the maximum, and other working matters will be discussed in the way of exchanging documents through Panmunjom liaison channel. Rodong News Team

title: Art Performance Marks Anniversary of Kanggye Spirit
body: Art performance "Kanggye Spirit Will Be Everlasting" was given on Jan. 15 to celebrate the 20th anniversary of the creation of the Kanggye spirit by leader Kim Jong Il. The performance began with chorus "The General Is the Banner of Victory". Put on the stage were colorful numbers praising the revolutionary feats of Kim Jong Il who visited Jagang Province and made its inhabitants create the spirit of the times so as to open up a new history of a land of bliss. Its numbers included narration and music "The Immortal History of Revolutionary Activities in Jagang Province", mixed duet and chorus "We Will Never Forget", female solo "Bright Moon over My Country" and serial songs "Jagang Province Is the One My Country Boasts of". There were also numbers representing the local people's revolutionary will to turn the province into a socialist land of bliss and make a dynamic advance in the van of the era as befitting the creators of the Kanggye spirit, true to the behests of Kim Jong Il. The performance was enjoyed by officials of the party and power organs and working people's organizations, industrial establishments and co-op farms and working people in the province. Rodong News Team

title: Jagang Provincial Photo Exhibition Opens
body: A Jagang provincial photo exhibition opened with due ceremony in Kanggye City on Monday to mark the 20th anniversary of the creation of the Kanggye Spirit by leader Kim Jong Il. On display at the exhibition are a photo of leader Kim Jong Il visiting Jagang Province and pictures showing the exploits of the leader who put forward the workers and other inhabitants in the province as the creators of the Kanggye Spirit and wisely led them. There are also photos showing the greatness of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Present at the opening ceremony were officials of party and power organs, working people's organizations and industrial establishments and cooperative farms and working people in the province. At the end of the ceremony its participants looked round the venue of the exhibition. Rodong News Team

title: Anniversary of Paper Saenal (New Day) Marked
body: A meeting took place at the Central Youth Hall on Jan. 15 to mark the 90th anniversary of the launch of the paper Saenal (New Day) by President Kim Il Sung. Attending it were Choe Hwi, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), and Pak Chol Min, first secretary of the Central Committee of the Youth League. Choe Hwi said in his report that in the 1920s Kim Il Sung formed the Down-with-Imperialism Union (DIU) and organized revolutionary organizations consisting of young people and children and other people from all walks of life and led the work to found the revolutionary paper, well aware of the importance of publications. Thanks to his efforts and leadership, the first revolutionary paper whose title is Saenal was founded on Jan. 15, Juche 17 (1928), the reporter noted, adding: The President launched a lot of revolutionary publications on the basis of his experience in the founding of Saenal and in this course provided the revolutionary tradition of the Workers' Party of Korea on media. The Juche-based tradition was carried forward by leader Kim Jong Il. The history of publications of the WPK, along with Saenal, is a history of leadership and love of the peerlessly great persons and a proud history in which the publications have served as an ideological weapon ensuring the idea and guidance of the leader and as a treasured sword of revolution giving full play to the mental strength of the army and people. The reporter called for adding luster to the honor of being the ideological vanguard and the first death-defying corps of the WPK in the general onward movement for a fresh victory of revolution under the guidance of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, wielding the writing brush of the revolution. Rodong News Team

title: Korean People's Cause Supported by Nepali Political Party, UK Organization
body: A Nepalese political party and British body issued statements in support of the New Year Address made by respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. The Central Committee of the Nepal Communist Party (Marxist-Leninist) said in its statement on Jan. 9 that Kim Jong Un's New Year Address is a valuable document correctly analyzing the political and strategic situation on the Korean Peninsula. Noting that his proposals for durable peace on the Korean Peninsula, national reunification and world peace and security are very profound and just ones, the statement went on: The world-startling successes being registered by the Korean people in every sector under the energetic guidance of H.E. Kim Jong Un are the examples to be followed by the world people. Socialist Korea will be more prosperous and more fully demonstrate its dignity and might as the Juche-oriented nuclear weapons state and world-level military power as it is led by him. We extend invariable support and solidarity to the Korean people's just cause. The British Solidarity Committee for Peace and Reunification of the Korean Peninsula said on Jan. 3 that Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address set forth landmark proposals for peace and national reunification of the Korean Peninsula. He said that it is necessary to defuse the acute military tension between the north and the south and create a peaceful climate on the Korean Peninsula, the committee noted. It said this is possible only when the south Korean authorities halt the nuclear war drills with the U.S. against the DPRK. It pointed out that the south Korean authorities should no longer depend on the U.S. but stop letting outsiders meddle in the issue of Korea's reunification. It added that thanks to him, the dawn of reunification will certainly break. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's Work Published in Romania
body: Respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Making Selfless, Devoted Efforts for the Good of the People Is the Mode of Existence and Source of Invincible Might of the Workers' Party of Korea" was brought out in booklet by the Socialist Party of Romania. The work, published on October 10, Juche 104 (2015), says that the history of the WPK is a proud course in which it has led the Korean revolution to victory, being responsible for the people's destiny under the guidance of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il. A book releasing ceremony took place at the building of the party on Jan. 5. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's New Year Address Supported by Foreign Political Figures
body: Political figures of various countries issued statements from Jan. 4 to 8 in support of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address. Ristiyanto, general secretary of the National Guidance Council of the Pioneer Party of Indonesia, said that Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address called for further bolstering the DPRK's nuclear forces and indicated clear ways for mending the north-south relations. He stressed that Kim Jong Un's proposals for ensuring peace and security on the Korean Peninsula and improving the north-south relations are very just. Sazhi Umalatova, chairperson of the Party for Peace and Unity of Russia, said that Kim Jong Un's New Year Address is the important guideline helping the Korean people steadily advance along the road of socialism and he in his New Year Address proved before the world that the DPRK is a peace-loving state. Gyula Thurmer, chairman of the Hungarian Workers' Party, expressed full support for the proposals for national reunification set forth by Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address. Mozgovoy, first secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union, said that he wished the great Korean people a fresh victory in building a powerful socialist country under the wise guidance of Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's Greatness Lauded by Russian Websites
body: Russian online magazines and websites dedicated special write-ups interwoven with photos of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and articles titled "Mettle of leader Kim Jong Un", "Rare leadership", "Man who loves the future" and others from Dec. 27 to 30 last year to mark the 6th anniversary of his assumption of the supreme commandership of the Korean People's Army. The Russian online magazine Live Journal said: Supreme Commander Kim Jong Un values soldiers as the most powerful and precious beings than any modern weapons and equipment. It is quite natural that soldiers regard Kim Jong Un as their father as he meticulously takes care of their life while visiting them and makes himself responsible for their destiny to the end. The Russian online magazine Lemchich introduced in detail Kim Jong Un's noble view on the rising generation and future, saying that his ardent love for them impress all people. The website Patrioti Moskva said that the U.S. strategists are much upset by Kim Jong Un's activities in the confrontation with the U.S. as they are very difficult equations hard to solve. It praised him for striking terror into enemies with his unimaginable and bold decision and unpredictable strategy and bringing world-startling miracles and changes through his energetic activities. The website DPRK Today said that the world community is admiring the leadership art of Kim Jong Un who is making world-startling miracles in building a powerful nation while wisely leading all the service personnel and people. The East Siberian Publishing House in Irkutsk Region and other websites posted articles on his greatness. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korean Public Demand Lee Myung Bak's Arrest
body: The "Commando for Seizing MB" and the Headquarters of the Action for Trial of Lee Myung Bak and Park Geun Hye in south Korea held a demonstration and candlelight rally in Seoul on Jan. 13 in demand of traitor Lee Myung Bak's arrest, the south Korean internet paper Voice of Seoul said. Attending there were people from across south Korea. The participants marched towards the traitor's house, condemning his crimes. They called for continuing actions until he is arrested. Rodong News Team

title: U.S. Should Not Meddle in Issue of Inter-Korean Relations
body: Haley, U.S. ambassador to the United Nations, recently said that the U.S. will not regard the resumption of the north-south talks as prudent and it will not acknowledge nor allow any dialogue if it will not have any impact on making north Korea abandon nuclear weapons. Senator from the Republican Party Lindsey Graham and other riff-raff said south Korea should refuse dialogue and the U.S. would not participate in the Winter Olympics if north Korea takes part in it. The inter-Korean relations are the internal issue of the Korean nation and the U.S. is not entitled to meddle in it. However, the U.S. is raising its head to interfere in the north-south dialogue. In fact, the U.S. wants a war, not peace on the Korean Peninsula. It is the trite method employed by the U.S. to seek its own interests by meddling in the internal issue of the Korean nation. The U.S. is miscalculating. Things will not turn out as the U.S. wishes. Although the U.S. makes desperate efforts to disturb peace while wielding a nuclear stick, it can not provoke us as long as we have the strong nuclear deterrent. The U.S. would be well advised to stop impudently meddling in other's matters only to avoid a hot agony of shame. It had to mind its own destiny rushing headlong into self-destruction. Ri Hak Nam

title: Inappropiate Utterances Chilling Atmosphere of Dialogue
body: At the New Year news conference, the south Korean chief executive let out stupid remarks that the beginning of the south-north dialogue can be described as the effect made by the U.S.-led sanctions and pressure, "Trump's feats are very great" and "he wanted to express thanks" to Trump. Not content with such vituperation, he said that the south side began dialogue to "provide a chapter of dialogue" for "denuclearization, not to improve the relations with the north. That day he noted that he would not pursue dialogue only and would keep pace with the international community's sanctions, and added that the improvement of the north-south ties and "the settlement of the nuclear issue" are inseparable. As to the summit, he even went the lengths of claiming that it would be held when the conditions are created and there should be results. What he mouthed is hardly believable as the remarks of dialogue partner. The every word vividly expressed the humiliating mind to curry favor with the U.S. The south Korean authorities are sadly mistaken. We will make positive efforts to improve the north-south ties but never pardon the anti-reunification reckless acts swimming against the trend. The south Korean authorities would be well advised to behave themselves, properly understanding the stand and will of the DPRK on the inter-Korean relations. Jo Nam Su
