title: S. Korean Authorities Should Stop Nuclear War Drill with Foreign Forces
body: Today, easing the acute military tension and creating a peaceful atmosphere on the Korean peninsula are the burning issue for removing the danger of war and putting the north-south relations on the orbit of national reconciliation and unity. The south Korean authorities' termination of all the nuclear war drills with foreign forces is important for easing tensions and creating a peaceful atmosphere on the Korean peninsula. The south Korea-U.S. joint military drills are the typical offensive drills and nuclear war exercises aiming at the preemptive nuclear strike at the DPRK. The north-south relations will never be mended if the south Korean authorities get involved in the criminal moves of the U.S. to invade the DPRK and dominate the Korean peninsula and Northeast Asia while encouraging confrontation between the north and the south, and cling to the military confrontation with the compatriots. The north and the south can prevent war and ease tensions on the Korean peninsula if they have a will. Now that the DPRK has enough deterrent to foil U.S. nuclear war scheme, the north and the south should join hands for peace. Easing tensions and creating durable peace on the Korean peninsula are the invariable stand and will of the DPRK. The south Korean authorities should have the courage to stop the joint military drills with the U.S. aggravating the situation on the Korean peninsula and throwing hurdles on the way of dialogue and improved relations between the north and the south. Sim Chol Yong

title: Russian Bodies Wish Korean People Victory
body: Russian bodies made public statements backing the New Year Address of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un on Jan. 4-6. The Lenin Young Communist League of the Russian Federation said it hoped to see fresh victories for the Korean people, fully supporting his New Year Address. The Rostov Association for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism of Russia stressed that the Korean people won victory by dint of strength of justice in the standoff with imperialist aggressive forces attempting to disturb global peace and security and bring nuclear disaster to humankind. The Russian Group for Solidarity with the DPRK said that Kim Jong Un underscored the need to develop economy by taking the historic victory in the building of the DPRK's nuclear forces as a springboard for fresh progress. The Regional Social Organization of Russia "Borozino" noted that the peace-loving peoples of all countries are actively backing the wish of the Korean nation for reunification. The Russian Association for Friendship and Cultural Cooperation with the DPRK said that they wished the Korean people peace and happiness, hoping that their wish for national reunification would surely come true. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's New Year Address Backed by Serbian Party, Body
body: Serbian political party and body on Jan. 8 made public a joint statement in support of the New Year Address of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. The New Yugoslav Communist Party and the League of the Yugoslavian Communist Youth said in the statement that they fully support the New Year Address of Kim Jong Un. They said that last year the U.S.-led hostile forces resorted to unprecedented military threat and super-intensity sanctions and pressure against the DPRK, but the Korean people worked world-startling miracles in defense and economic construction under the leadership of Kim Jong Un. They noted that the successes achieved by the Korean people greatly encouraged the world progressive peoples aspiring after independence and justice. They pointed out that Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address clarified fair and aboveboard proposals aimed at improving inter-Korean relations and making a breakthrough for independent reunification. Korea's reunification is the internal issue of the nation to be solved by the north and the south without any interference of outsiders, they said. The U.S. must take hands off the Korean peninsula at once and pull its troops from south Korea, they noted. They expressed belief that the Korean people will achieve bigger success in the struggle for building a powerful socialist country and reunifying the country under the wise guidance of Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's Exploits Praised by Polish, Nigerian Bodies
body: Polish and Nigerian bodies carried special write-ups on their websites to mark the 6th anniversary of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's assumption of the supreme commandership of the Korean People's Army. The International Friendship Initiative "Explore DPRK" of Poland posted an article titled "Ceaseless on-site inspections" illustrated with photos of Kim Jong Un on Dec. 30 last year. The article praised him for further strengthening the KPA into the matchless revolutionary army. The Nigerian National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism posted articles titled "Ideal state leader" and "Korea, marvelous country," on Dec. 27 last year. The articles referred to the greatness of Kim Jong Un, who is the leader possessed of noble virtues and outlook on the people, tested leadership, extraordinary sweep and persevering fortitude, lauding him as the most ideal state leader of good quality and qualifications in the present times. It is just the DPRK where the leader and the people are linked by blood ties and they are dynamically stepping up the building of a powerful country in the face of the hostile forces' harsh sanctions and moves to stifle it and adhering to its cause against the U.S. styling itself the "only superpower", the articles stressed. The DPRK's mystery lies, in a nutshell, in the outstanding political caliber of Kim Jong Un and the powerful mental power of all the service personnel and people who are firmly united around him, the articles commented. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's Work Introduced in Russia
body: The full text of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Concluding Speech at the March 2013 Plenary Meeting of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea" was posted on the Russian website Patrioti Moskva on Jan. 7. The work, published on March 31, Juche 102 (2013), deals with the justice of the fresh strategic line of simultaneously pushing forward economic construction and the building of nuclear forces set forth by the WPK and the Party's intention for it. The website carried a photo of Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: 22nd Kimjongilia Festival to Be Held
body: The 22nd Kimjongilia Festival will be opened at the Kimilsungia-Kimjongilia Exhibition in Pyongyang in mid-February on the occasion of the birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il. It will bring together armed forces organs, ministries, national institutions, organizations of overseas compatriots including the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan, working people of different strata, school youth and children and foreigners. During the festival, there will be immortal flower shows and visits to Kimilsungia-Kimjongilia greenhouses in local areas. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Will Vigorously March toward Final Victory
body: The service personnel and people of the DPRK who have been trained to be those strong in faith and will under the leadership of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un will win new victories this year, too. Thanks to the Supreme Leader's keen insight, wealth of knowledge of all fields and foresightedness that clarifies bright ideas for the growth of production and modernization, lots of model factories and enterprises put on a Juche, modern and scientific basis have been erected across the country and the advanced management and experiences are generalized throughout the country. The people's standard of living is being improved day by day thanks to the remarkable development in the light industry. The might of the national defense industry of self-defense with the nuclear forces as its pivot has been rapidly strengthened and the DPRK emerged as the world-level military power with ultra-modern strategic weapons and H-bomb. The service personnel and people of the DPRK have never achieved all those with the help of others or in good conditions. They have made these achievements, cherishing the firm faith that they will surely win victory if they are led by the Supreme Leader despite the continuing harsh sanctions and pressure of hostile forces including the U.S. aiming at the "total destruction" and "extermination" of the DPRK. Matchless are the national pride and honor of the service personnel and people of the DPRK of holding in high esteem Kim Jong Un, the peerlessly illustrious commander in the van of the revolution, and they are in sky-high spirits. No force on earth can check the advance of the DPRK. And nothing can bring it to its knees. The will of the people of the DPRK to weather the difficulties and trials on the self-development-first principle is being remarkably reinforced. Jo Thaek Bom

title: Let Us Intensify Class Education
body: It poses itself as a very important problem to intensify the class education for the Party members and other working people. Socialist construction is attended by a serious class struggle. The more successfully the masses' cause of independence, the cause of socialism, makes an advance, the more desperately the imperialists try to stop it. The victorious advance of revolution is guaranteed by the struggle of the service personnel and people with strong class consciousness. Our revolution has performed miracles and achievements as all the Party members and other working people and the service personnel have waged a do-or-die struggle with burning hatred against the class enemy trying hard to stop them from achieving the prosperity of the country and the happiness of the people. Our people are now carrying on the revolutionary general offensive for a fresh victory in the building of a powerful socialist country under the leadership of the Party. Much upset by this, the U.S. imperialists and their vassal forces are making desperate efforts to stop our advance. It is very important to intensify the class education as the U.S. imperialists are going reckless in the most barbarous aggression war moves and sanctions, crying out for "exterminating" our state and people. The bitter lesson that a large number of residents in Sinchon met massive deaths as they had no class consciousness is not bygone tragedy. It is necessary not to neglect the class education even a moment but intensify it for both preventing recurrence of the bloody history and making the red flag of revolution flutter on the victorious peak of socialism. Kim Pyong Jin

title: Inter-Korean Working-Level Talks
body: Working-level talks between the north and the south of Korea for the north side's participation in the 23rd Winter Olympics and Paralympics were held at the "house of peace" in the south side portion of Panmunjom on Jan. 17 under the agreement of the north-south high-level talks. Present there were a delegation of the north side led by Jon Jong Su, vice-chairman of the Committee for the Peaceful Reunification of the Country of the DPRK, and a delegation of the south side with Chon Hae Song, vice-minister of Unification, as its chief delegate. At the talks both sides thrashed out the practical matters arising in the successful holding of the Winter Olympics and adopted a joint press release. The joint press release dealt with the scales and action programs of the north side's National Olympic Committee delegation, sports team, cheer group, Taekwon-do demonstration group and press corps to take part in the 23rd Winter Olympics, the south side's offer of conveniences for them and the dispatch of an advance team for field survey. Matters related to the International Olympic Committee will be settled by both sides in cooperation with the Committee, according to the joint press release. It also mentioned the practical matters on joint training of north-south ski runners and north-south joint cultural event to be held at the Masikryong Ski Resort and in Mt Kumgang from late January to early February. Both sides will agree in the way of exchange of documents on such other practical matters as dispatch of the north side's Paralympic Committee delegation, sports team, cheer group, art troupe and press corps to the Winter Paralympics, the joint press release said. Rodong News Team

title: Art Squad of Korean Youth Gives Performance
body: The art squad of the Central Committee of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League gave a performance at the Central Youth Hall on Jan. 17, the 72nd anniversary of the founding of the Youth League. Among the audience were Choe Hwi, vice-chairman of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea, Pak Chol Min, first secretary of the C.C., Youth League, and officials of the youth league, youths and students. Colorful numbers were put on the stage at the performance that began with light music and chorus "March of Korean Youth". The performers praised President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il for building a youth power without an equal in the world. They depicted the fact that the victorious history of the Korean youth movement invariably continues thanks to respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Also put on the stage were numbers reflecting the zeal of the Korean youths who are determined to devotedly defend the Party Central Committee and perform heroic feats on all fronts of defending socialism and building an economic power. Rodong News Team

title: U.S. Imperialists Hit for Their Moves to Stifle DPRK
body: The People for Achieving Peace and Reunification in south Korea reportedly held a rally outside the U.S. embassy in Seoul on Jan. 16 in denunciation of the U.S. imperialists' moves to stifle the DPRK. Speakers at the rally recalled that Trump's draft "nuclear posture review" the keynote of which is to develop the latest nuclear bomb was recently opened to the public, adding that the development is targeted against the north. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korean Trade Union Demands Workers' Right to Existence
body: A Seoul-Inchon public service branch of the Public Transport Workers' Union of south Korea held a rally in front of Yonsei University on Jan. 17, demanding the recruit of workers and their right to existence, according to the south Korean paper Nodong and Segye. Speakers at the rally said that the university where students are educated shouldn't cut down the wages of low-paid workers. The conservative media are misleading the public opinion, blaming this crisis for the workers' struggle for hike of minimum wage but the university authorities are to blame as they are bleeding the workers white, they said. They declared that they would struggle against the restructuring to the last. Rodong News Team

title: Distortion of Ferry Sewol Disaster Slashed in S. Korea
body: The Taegu Citizens Measure Committee on the Ferry Sewol Disaster in south Korea reportedly denounced the conservatives' attempt to distort the truth behind the ferry Sewol disaster on Jan. 17. A pro-Park Geun Hye body attempted to distort the truth of the ferry Sewol disaster by hanging out large suspension posters in street from Jan. 12, asserting that the disaster was planned on the north's instruction. In this regard, the Taegu Citizens Measure Committee demanded that the conservative body bring the posters down. Rodong News Team

title: Arrest of Lee Myung Bak Urged in S. Korea
body: The south Korean online paper Minjok Ilbo carried an editorial demanding the arrest of Lee Myung Bak on January 17. The editorial stressed it is the steadfast will of the people to detain Lee and liquidate the evils. If the "government" has a real intention to liquidate the evils it should arrest Lee at once, it said. It warned that if Lee is not arrested and punished as early as possible the angry people's mindset against Lee would be naturally directed to the present "government". Rodong News Team

title: Day of Shining Star to Be Marked in Tanzania
body: A Tanzanian preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il (Day of the Shining Star) was formed in Dar es Salaam on Jan. 6. Maina, vice-chairperson of the Tanzanian National Coordinating Committee of the Juche Idea Study Groups, was elected chairperson of the preparatory committee. The committee decided to organize colorful political and cultural events in praise of the revolutionary career and feats of Kim Jong Il in the period from Jan. 6 to Feb. 16. Rodong News Team

title: Seminars on Kim Jong Un's New Year Address Held Abroad
body: Seminars on the New Year Address of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un were held in the Czech Republic, Switzerland, Sweden, Austria, Spain and Egypt on Jan. 4-10. The vice general secretary of the C.C., Czechoslovak Communist Party said that Kim Jong Un's New Year Address serves as guidelines clearly indicating the path for the Korean people this year and a banner instilling hope into the progressive people in the struggle for a just society. The chief of the Swiss Group for the Study of the Juche Idea expressed the will to intensify the campaign of supporting the just cause of the Korean people this year, too, saying that the orientation and ways for building a powerful socialist country, improving the north-south relations and reunifying the country were set forth in the New Year Address. The chairman of the Sweden-Korea Friendship Association hoped that the Korean people would achieve greater victories in the struggle for the country's prosperity and accomplishment of the cause of national reunification in hearty response to Kim Jong Un's New Year Address this significant year marking the 70th birthday of the DPRK, a national auspicious event. The chief of the Youth Group for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism formed in Austria and other speakers said that the Korean people won eye-opening successes in all fields despite all challenges of the U.S. and its vassal forces last year. Personages of the Madrid Group for the Study of the Juche Idea of Spain and the Egyptian political parties and organizations explained the main contents of Kim Jong Un's New Year Address, stressing that the DPRK's nuclear weapons are formidable deterrent to the U.S. nuclear threat. They also referred to the tasks for the reunification of the Korean Peninsula. A letter to Kim Jong Un was adopted at the seminar in the Czech Republic. Rodong News Team

title: Mighty Military Strength Guarantees Nation's Everlasting Prosperity
body: Only when a country has a mighty military capability can it firmly defend its dignity, people's happiness and peace. To bolster up the military strength is not a temporary work but a nation's everlasting top priority. The arms of the service personnel equipped with no ideology, with no anti-imperialist class consciousness, are more useless than a stick. They would make a trouble. Recorded in history are not a few events that such service members destroyed the gains of revolution achieved by the forerunners and made no scruple of aiming at the people in the struggle to defend their own social system. The arms not relying on the self-supporting defense industry can not safeguard the nation's dignity, the people's happiness and peace to the last. For a country to equip its forces with arms of so-called developed countries leads to military subordination. Some countries known as regional powers and relatively rich countries failed to augment the military capability due to the sanctions of the U.S. and other imperialist powers. The main reason is that they met the demand for the weapons by purchasing them from other countries as they failed to firmly arm the service personnel with the anti-imperialist independent consciousness and had a weak self-supporting defense industry foundation. It resulted in the imperialists' trampling on the sovereignty of those countries and turning them into war-torn ones. The army and people of the DPRK will hold fast to the Workers' Party of Korea's new line of simultaneously developing the two fronts, put greater efforts to its implementation and thus further bolster up the military capability for self-defense. Son So Yon

title: Korean People's Struggle Backed in Mexico
body: The People's Socialist Party, National Coordinating Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea, Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, Institute for the Study of the Juche Idea and the Friend Association for Memory of President Kim Il Sung and Leader Kim Jong Il in Mexico and the Mexico-Korea Friendship Association made public a joint statement on Jan. 10 in support of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address. Noting that the Korean people and the world's progressives have read his New Year Address with great excitement, the statement said: We warmly congratulate the Korean people on having realized the great, historic cause of perfecting the national nuclear forces in the face of the imperialists' vicious anti-DPRK moves. We are convinced that they will celebrate the 70th anniversary of the DPRK with splendor by making signal successes in the efforts to consolidate the independence and Juche character of the national economy and improve the people's standard of living. We extend full support to the righteous proposals set forth by Comrade Kim Jong Un for the sake of improvement of inter-Korean relations and reunification of the country. We flatly reject any attempt to disturb the peace of the Korean Peninsula, let alone joint military exercises. We bitterly blast the UNSC "sanctions resolutions" against the DPRK, a full-fledged member of the UN, as they only inflict pain on the Korean people. We appeal to all progressive peoples around the world opposing the imperialists' high-handed and arbitrary practices and loving independence, peace and justice to extend support and solidarity to the Korean people in the heroic struggle for protecting the country's sovereignty and national right to existence. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Foreign Ministry Hosts Reception
body: The Foreign Ministry of the DPRK on Jan. 18 gave a reception for the diplomatic corps in Pyongyang on the New Year Juche 107 (2018). Present there on invitation were diplomatic envoys and representatives of international bodies here. Officials of the Foreign Ministry including Foreign Minister Ri Yong Ho were on hand. Ri Yong Ho in his speech noted that the Korean people have turned out in a drive to achieve the victory in the socialist cause and make a breakthrough for the independent reunification this year. And he emphasized the foreign policy stand of the Workers' Party of Korea and the DPRK government. Vietnamese Ambassador Pham Viet Hung in a speech thanked the DPRK Foreign Ministry for hosting the reception on behalf of the diplomatic corps and wished the Korean people and the world people peace, prosperity and happiness. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's New Year Address Studied Abroad
body: Reading sessions and lectures on the New Year Address of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un were held in India, Tanzania, DR Congo, Finland, Denmark and Mexico on Jan. 4-15. The vice-chairman of the Tanzanian National Coordinating Committee of the Juche Idea Study Groups hoped that the heroic Korean people would achieve fresh victory on all fronts of building a powerful socialist country this year, too, by taking the historic victory in the building of the state nuclear forces as a springboard for fresh progress, firmly united around Kim Jong Un, this year. The chairman of the National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of DR Congo stressed that the U.S. must no longer resort to sanctions and pressure against the DPRK but repeal its hostile policy and learn how to co-exist with the DPRK, a nuclear-armed country. The Korean people guided by the prominent leader will achieve bigger successes in the building of a powerful socialist country despite the hostile forces' anti-DPRK moves this year, too, he added. The international secretary of the Finnish Communists' League noted that the Korean people are waging a dynamic struggle for the country's sovereignty and national reunification in hearty response to the New Year Address of Kim Jong Un. The chairman of the Denmark-DPRK Friendship Association expressed the will to lift up the voice of support and solidarity with the just cause of the Korean people. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's Work Published in Algeria
body: Respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Making Selfless, Devoted Efforts for the Good of the People Is the Mode of Existence and Source of Invincible Might of the Workers' Party of Korea" was brought out in booklet at the Tarzalt Publishing House in El-Djezair of Algeria on Jan. 10. The work, published on October 10, Juche 104 (2015), says that the history of the WPK is a proud course in which it has led the Korean revolution to victory, being responsible for the people's destiny under the guidance of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: Ideological and Cultural Poisoning by Imperialism Should Be Smashed
body: For all the nations aspiring to independence and opposing imperialism to combat the poisoning of decadent ideologies and culture of every description precisely means a fierce struggle to defend their sovereignty and dignity. The imperialists regard the reactionary ideological and cultural poisoning as the most effective way for attaining their aggression and predatory aims with ease. The degenerate reactionary ideology and the American outlook on value, which were employed as a guide to aggression, play the main role in aggression at present. The imperialists consider the rising generation as the main target of their corrupt ideological and cultural poisoning. Through films, newspapers, magazines and intranets and other media which the young people enjoy very much, the imperialists make them corrupt and degenerate and spread illusions about imperialism. Those young people infected with luxury and enjoyment are reduced to renegades of their countries and stooges of imperialism unwittingly. Some countries witnessed regime changes and government falls and the young people took the lead in causing such abnormal situations. That is because they were infected with the imperialist ideological and cultural poisoning. The struggle in the ideological and cultural field is a war without gunfire. And a wrong struggle results in the worse consequences than the defeat in war. The bourgeois ideological and cultural poisoning is more dangerous than a formidable enemy coming in attack with guns. Any hesitation and concession to the ideological confrontation would give way to the bourgeois ideological and cultural poisoning and then it would make mess of the destiny of a nation and country. Ra Myong Song

title: Revolutionary Spirit of Paektu Is Mighty Weapon of Korean Revolution
body: Steadfast is the faith of the Korean army and people to go along the road of socialism of Juche following the Party to the end, regarding the revolutionary sprit of Paektu, the spirit of the blizzards of Paektu, as an eternal ideological and mental weapon. The revolutionary spirit of Paektu, the spirit of the blizzards of Paektu is the unyielding offensive spirit of weathering obstacles and difficulties and the staunch spirit of fighting it out no matter how often one may fall. The said spirit has been the lifeline of Juche Korea and its strongest weapon. The DPRK wrought the historic miracles of defeating the two formidable imperialist enemies with young armed forces and performed heroic feats on the ruins and debris and despite harsh sanctions and blockade of the enemies. Such mysterious achievements would have been unthinkable without this spirit. The revolutionary faith, fighting spirit and pluck of the anti-Japanese revolutionary forerunners were displayed to the full in the advance for the new century of Juche. As a result, the lifeline of the Party, revolution and Korean-style socialism has been firmly maintained and great victories and changes to be specially recorded in the history of the nation spanning five thousand years have been made one after another. When the revolutionary spirit of Paektu, the spirit of the blizzards of Paektu, symbol of the great mental power of Kim Il Sung's nation and Kim Jong Il's Korea, is given full play, the invincibility of the Juche revolution and the mightiness of socialist Korea would be demonstrated more strikingly. Kim Chol Hwan

title: DPRK's Principled Stand Hailed Abroad
body: Personages of Nigeria and Indonesia made public statements in support of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address. Goodswill Nnaji, national chairman of the Better Nigeria Progressive Party, in a statement on January 12, highlighted the foreign policy stand clarified by Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address and appealed to the progressive mankind to side with the DPRK, backing its principled stand for global peace and security. The manager of the Millennia Armada Express Co. of Indonesia said in a statement on Jan. 9 that the proposals for national reunification advanced by Kim Jong Un are the most just guidelines, extending invariable solidarity to the just cause of the Korean people. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Shining Star to Be Marked in Ethiopia
body: An Ethiopian preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il (Day of the Shining Star) was formed in Addis Ababa on Jan. 9. Nigatu Dagnachew, chairman of the Ethiopia-Korea Friendship and Solidarity Committee, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee decided to organize diverse political and cultural events praising the exploits of Kim Jong Il for the cause of global independence in the period from Jan. 11 to Feb. 17. Rodong News Team

title: Americans Suffer from Nuclear-phobia
body: Nuclear-phobia by the nuclear force of the DPRK has now caused a tragicomedy in the U.S. On January 16 a meteor fell from the sky between Ohio and Michigan with a great bang, brightening the sky. This sparked off the explosive postage of stories about the "fireball in the nocturnal sky" on the U.S. internet websites. Internet users admitted that they worried the meteor in question could have been a nuclear bomb flown from north Korea. A twitter user posted words that when meteor brightened the sky between Ohio and Michigan, all internet network users hoped that it would be a meteor, not north Korea's missile. Another twitter user wrote that it was sad to have taken the meteor as a bomb flown from north Korea and to have hurried the car in fear. Lots of people were reported to have greatly worried about it, taking the meteor as an attack from north Korea. A people said that it was greatly relieving that the meteor did not pass the sky last weekend when there was a misinformation about the flight of a nuclear bomb. What was all the more irony was the fuss in Hawaii on January 13. At 08:07 citizens and tourists on Hawaii received all at the same time the ballistic missile threat warning which urged them to evacuate as there was ballistic missile threat and which stressed that it was not just training. The citizens and tourists in great disarray went busy evacuating amid the heightened fear and delusion of persecution about the nuclear force of the DPRK. What is all the more ridiculous is that the U.S. Federal Communications Commission put it that the ballistic missile attack evacuation warning which threw the whole of Hawaii in a great chaos was caused by a mistake of a man who pressed the button during shift period. The field repercussion is that it is quite natural that the whole state was thrown into fear as the citizens and tourists were fed the warning message as serious as the one warning of "imminent and actual drop of missile" which could be the most dreadful moment in life. In recent days the U.S. forces in south Korea and their families were informed to leave south Korea by messages sent through hand phones or broadcasting means which made them get flurried in fear that a war may break out. In the U.S. people caught in extreme fear vied with each other to buy frozen foods, gas masks and goods for emergency use, indicative of the pain suffered by the Americans stricken by war-phobia. The consecutive fuss in the U.S. and fear caused by even the natural phenomenon being mistaken as a rocket from the DPRK are the natural outcome of the acts done by the U.S. itself. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's New Year Address Backed by Political Party, Body of DR Congo
body: A political party and a body of DR Congo made public statements on Jan. 10 and 11 supporting the New Year Address made by respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. The Communist Party of DR Congo said that it can foresee the victory of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea in the meaningful year 2018 after reading the New Year Address of Kim Jong Un. It noted that Kim Jong Un, who completely contained the U.S. with his rare wisdom and matchless pluck, stressed the need to glorify this meaningful year as an eventful one noteworthy in the history of the nation by improving the inter-Korean relations. It pointed out that it expresses full support to his proposals for Korea's reunification based on the idea of national independence. The Youth Group for the Study of the Juche Idea in DR Congo sincerely wished, together with the Juche idea followers and peace-loving people across the world, the Korean people bigger success this year marking the 70th anniversary of the founding of the DPRK. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's Work Published in Russia
body: Respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us Step Up the Building of a Thriving Country by Applying Kim Jong Il's Patriotism" was brought out in booklet at the Knizhnii Mir Publishing House of Russia. The work published on July 26, Juche 101 (2012) deals with the essence of Kim Jong Il's patriotism and his noble career of loving the country and its people. It also indicates important matters arising in embodying Kim Jong Il's patriotism. A book releasing ceremony took place at the publishing house on Jan. 17. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's New Year Address Studied Abroad
body: Reading sessions and briefings on the New Year Address of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un were held in Russia, Romania, Germany, Ethiopia and Nigeria between Jan. 2 and 15. The first secretary of the Khabarovsk Territorial Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation praised Kim Jong Un, who has creditably carried forward the cause of the preceding leaders, for firmly protecting the country's prestige and interests from the moves of the U.S. styling itself the "only superpower". The secretary general of the Romania-Korea Friendship Association said that last year the Korean people laid an eternal foundation for ensuring peace and security of the Korean Peninsula by accomplishing the great, historic cause of perfecting the national nuclear forces and that all the successes made in the Democratic People's Republic of Korea would have been unthinkable without the wise guidance of Kim Jong Un. The chairman of the Anti-Imperialist Forum of Germany and the chief of the Franken Group for the Study of the Juche Idea of Germany said that the year 2017 was a proud year of victory when the Korean people made eye-opening development in the face of the hostile forces' sanctions and a year when the imperialists' moves to stifle the DPRK went bankrupt and that before long the world will clearly see how the DPRK becomes a powerful socialist country. The chief of the Ethiopian Group for the Study of the Juche Idea and other speakers stressed that the New Year Address of Kim Jong Un brightly indicated the path for the Korean people and that Korea will surely be reunified in the near future when it does as indicated by him in his New Year Address. Rodong News Team

title: "Liberal Korea Party" Coteries Going against Trend of Times
body: The south Korean conservatives including the "Liberal Korea Party" are now talking about sort of "lobbying" and "intention of provocation behind the sports exchanges" over the participation of the DPRK in the coming Winter Olympics and the dispatch of a cheering group and an art troupe, claiming that this may undermine the international cooperation for "sanctions on the north". They are also touting hoarse that "Olympics is a tribute offered to the north" and the "Olympics should not be a ground for political promotion of the north," getting perverse over the mounting enthusiasm of the south Korean public over the news of the north-south technical talks for the dispatch of art troupe. This proves that the coteries of the "Liberal Korea Party" are a group of hideous traitors only concerned for escalating confrontation with the fellow countrymen and meeting their greed for power, being indifferent to the desire and wish of the nation. Needless to say, the flurry of invectives uttered by the conservative forces are aimed to chill the atmosphere for the improvement of the north-south relations. It is clear that there can neither be the successful Olympics nor the improvement of the north-south ties and the peaceful environment on the Korean peninsula should the "Liberal Korea Party" coteries be allowed to go on challenging the nation's enthusiasm for reunification in their moves to tide over the extreme political crisis and prolong their remaining days. Ra Sol Ha

title: No Statute of Limitations Is Applicable to Crimes against Korea
body: by Japanese Imperialists January 22 marks the anniversary of intoxication of Emperor Kojong, representative of the sovereignty of the Korean nation, by the Japanese imperialists. The intoxication of Emperor Kojong on January 22, 1919 was a hideous crime committed by the Japanese imperialists to more thoroughly enforce their colonial rule over Korea. The fact is stark evidence showing that the Japanese imperialists did stoop to any infamy to realize their colonial rule over Korea. The Japanese imperialists' decades-long colonial rule over Korea was unprecedented hideous crimes aimed at exterminating the Korean nation. History records lots of data about colonial rules enforced by imperialists but there is no such ferocious imperialism as Japanese imperialism as it went wild to trample the history and tradition of a nation that had been inherited century after century and to deprive the nation of even its spoken and written languages. The Japanese imperialists' crimes against humanity can never be written off. State reparations should be made for those hideous crimes committed by the Japanese imperialists in the first half of the last century as they were state-sponsored, organized crimes. No statute of limitations is applicable to the hideous crimes committed by the Japanese imperialists against the Korean nation. Ri Chol Hyok

title: No Force Can Block Advance of DPRK
body: The imperialists are getting evermore pronounced in their moves to isolate and stifle the Democratic People's Republic of Korea as they do not hope that it would become strong and rich. The moves of hostile forces against the DPRK were the most brutal ones unprecedented in history. However, the DPRK became a nuclear power of Juche and world military power which no formidable enemy dares provoke and achieved a series of successes in the building of a powerful socialist country last year. The U.S. and its vassal forces are now making last-ditch efforts to deprive the DPRK of its sovereignty and rights to existence and development. The U.S. imperialists run amuck in the barbarous sanctions and blockade against the DPRK by dint of all economic and diplomatic means, unprecedentedly increasing the danger of a nuclear war on the Korean Peninsula by massively deploying the nuclear strategic assets in and around the peninsula. The enemies' sanctions will never work on the DPRK as it has the foundation of self-supporting national economy and a huge army of reliable scientists who are fully supporting the policies of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and devotedly working to implement them. Victory and glory are in store for Juche Korea and its future is rosy thanks to the wise guidance of the WPK and the single-hearted unity of all the service personnel and people united close around it. Sim Chol Yong

title: Editorial
body: Let Us Open Broadway of Building Powerful Socialist Nation on Strength of Science and Technology Respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's field guidance to the State Academy of Sciences was a historic event in which he once again powerfully demonstrated to the world the firm determination and will of the Workers' Party of Korea to open up a broad avenue for the building of a powerful socialist country and hasten final victory on the strength of science and technology. Steadfast is the determination of the WPK to lay the groundwork of a powerful country, pave a wide avenue for building a prosperous country on the strength of science and technology and make the people enjoy all blessings with scientific and technological successes. Now is the time for the scientists and technicians of socialist Korea, who have grown up under the care of the Party, to give free rein to their prominent intelligence and give full play to their high spirit of creation and patriotism. All the scientists and technicians should fulfill the honorary mission and duty as standard-bearers and frontline soldiers in the struggle for opening up a broad avenue for the building of a powerful socialist country and hastening the final victory on the strength of science and technology. The powerful socialist country that we are building now is a knowledge-based economic giant which will be propelled and guaranteed by world-level advanced science and technology. All the scientists, technicians, officials and working people should achieve fresh victories on all fronts of building a powerful socialist country by making continued innovations and progress on the strength of science and technology in hearty response to the WPK's idea of prioritizing science and technology.

title: Intentional Provocation Aimed at Aggravating Regional Situation
body: Shortly ago, the U.S. organized a foreign ministers' meeting of its satellites in Canada against the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. The meeting brought together those in charge of foreign affairs of mainly U.S. allies that participated in the past Korean War. The meeting chaired by U.S. Secretary of State Tillerson was reported to discuss the issues to intensify sanctions and pressure for "denuclearization" of the DPRK. This runs contrary to the aspiration and wishes of all the Koreans for the country's peace and reunification and is an unpardonable provocation aimed at aggravating the regional situation. What the U.S. seeks in the meeting is to realize its aggressive goals by wrecking peace and stability on the Korean Peninsula and exacerbating the tension. That's why the U.S. is hell-bent on the sanctions and pressure against the DPRK by mobilizing even its vassal forces in a bid to cast a chill over the atmosphere of north-south dialogue and refrain the tension on the Korean Peninsula from being defused. What merits a more serious attention is the fact that the south Korean authorities spouted undesirable remarks at the U.S.-led meeting in Canada. The south Korean authorities would be well advised to think twice about inglorious consequences to be entailed by their behavior. With no sanctions and blockade can the hostile forces frighten the DPRK. Even though the U.S. gets more desperate in anti-DPRK sanctions by mobilizing riffraff, unaware of the DPRK's strategic position and the trend of the times, the U.S. will never reverse the fate of the American empire rushing headlong to doom. Un Jong Chol

title: Conservative Media Should Be Thrown into Dustbin of History
body: Chosun Ilbo, Choongang Ilbo and other south Korean conservative media are reeling off a litany of such malignant vituperation as "propaganda for the social system" and "camouflaged peace offensive", faulting the broadminded measures and sincere efforts of the DPRK. Worse still, they are absurdly finding fault with the Masikryong Ski Resort and the Kalma Airport we provided for joint training with south side's players, describing them as "outdated and imperfect" and "dangerous places". This is the grave provocation against the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the traitorous act which could be done by the matchless scoundrels devoid of elementary etiquette for the other side and the rubbish media obsessed with confrontation. It is a lesson of the history that a distorted report would bring dreadful consequences. The south Korean puppet conservative hack writers devoid of elementary moral principle of media and conscience can never be safe under the sky. Chosun Ilbo, Choongang Ilbo and other south Korean conservative media will keenly feel what dear price they will have to pay for taking the lead in inciting mistrust and confrontation among the nation. Pak Chol Jun

title: North Side's Delegation for Field Survey Visits South Side's Area
body: The delegation for field survey headed by Hyon Song Wol, head of the Samjiyon Orchestra, visited the south side's area from Jan. 21 for a one-night and two-day visit in accordance with the agreement at the inter-Korean working-level talks for the dispatch of our art troupe held on Jan. 15. The delegation consisting of seven persons learned about the preparation for the ensuring of the performance of our art troupe to be given in Kangrung and Seoul of south Korea with the 23rd Winter Olympics as an occasion. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Il's Birth Anniversary to Be Marked in Russia
body: A preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il was formed by the Moscow Group for the Study of the Juche Idea of Russia on Jan. 12.
