Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Foreign Ministry Delegation Leaves for Sweden
body: A delegation of the DPRK Foreign Ministry led by Vice-Minister Han Song Ryol left here Saturday to visit Sweden. The delegation will have an exchange of views with the Swedish side on bilateral relations and DPRK-EU relations. Rodong News Team

title: Confrontation Moves Going against Improved Inter-Korean Relations
body: The U.S. and the south Korean authorities held the second high-level meeting of the diplomatic and defense council for carrying out the extended deterrent strategy in Washington recently. The meeting decided to further intensify the two sides' cooperation for extended deterrence in order to settle the "nuclear issue". It also discussed such issues as constant rotation deployment of the U.S. strategic assets in south Korea and its vicinity under the pretext of "nuclear and missile threat" of someone. The said meeting is just offending as it is aimed to tighten cooperation in stifling the DPRK, only to chill the atmosphere of improving the north-south relations. Historically, the U.S., displeased with any sign of improving north-south relations and detente on the Korean peninsula, always poured cold water on such development. What matters is the behavior of the south Korean authorities going against the desire of the nation for reunification at the U.S. beck and call. Now the south Korean authorities persist in stoking military confrontation to do harm to the compatriots in the north, pursuant to the U.S. policy aimed to hamstring the efforts for detente on the Korean peninsula and repair of the inter-Korean relations. Right after the meeting the south Korean military talked about earlier establishment of the "triad strike system" for tackling someone's "nuclear and missile threat", regular deployment of U.S. strategic assets and tightened military cooperation with the U.S. Now is the time for the authorities of south Korea to behave more reasonably than ever before. They should know that such ill-intended military confab with the U.S. is just a foolish act of pouring water on the spark of the improved north-south relations and ruining their destiny. Sim Chol Yong

title: Policy of Pressure against DPRK Is Doomed to Failure
body: Tillerson and other riffraff of the U.S. Department of State are now claiming that they "welcome" the inter-Korean dialogue but it is necessary to put persistent pressure upon the DPRK and the U.S. will pursue a policy of "maximum pressure". Japanese Prime Minister Abe, during his recent junkets to European countries, begged for sanctions and pressure on the DPRK. Shortly ago, delegates of the countries that participated in the Korean War and Japan were closeted over intensified pressure against the DPRK in Canada, under the U.S. scenario. It is not particular that the U.S. and its followers talk about sanctions and pressure against the DPRK from the beginning of the year. It was a miscalculation of the U.S. that the DPRK would surrender like some countries that destroyed their hard-gained war deterrence, yielding to its persistent sanctions, pressure, military threat and blackmail. However, the army and people of the DPRK have made eye-opening successes on all fronts of building a powerful socialist country by giving vent to their soaring hatred against enemies and enthusiasm for retaliating against them despite the harshest sanctions. The reality clearly proves that no sanctions, blockade and military pressure of the U.S. can ever check the dynamic advance of Juche Korea based on the spirit of self-reliance and self-development. The U.S. hostile policy and sanctions against the DPRK are, in a nutshell, bound to go bankrupt. It is ridiculous that the U.S. and its followers talk about "additional and unilateral sanctions" as they have no economic dealings and contact with the DPRK. Ri Hyon Do

title: MOU Signed between DPRK and Iran
body: A 2018-2021 memorandum of understanding between the governments of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Islamic Republic of Iran on cooperation in the fields of culture, art, education, mass media, sports and youth was signed in Teheran of Iran on Jan. 24. DPRK Ambassador to Iran Kang Sam Hyon and Vice-Chairman for International Affairs of the Islamic Culture and Relations Organization of Iran Abbas Khamehyar signed the document respectively. Rodong News Team

title: South Side's Advance Team Visits North Side's Area
body: An advance team of the south side consisting of Ri Ju Thae, department director of the Ministry of Unification, and eleven other persons, visited the north side's area from Jan. 23 for a two-night and three-day trip, under the agreement of inter-Korean working-level talks held on Jan. 17. The advance team toured the Masikryong Ski Resort, Mt Kumgang area, etc. where a joint training of north-south skiers and a north-south joint cultural event are to be staged with the 23rd Winter Olympics just ahead. Rodong News Team

title: Indian Ambassador Hosts Reception
body: Indian Ambassador to the DPRK Jasminder Kasturia on Jan. 26 gave a reception at the Taedonggang Diplomatic Club to mark the Day of the Republic. Present there on invitation were DPRK Minister of Public Health Jang Jun Sang, Vice Department Director Ryu Myong Son of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea, Vice-Minister of Foreign Affairs Choe Hui Chol, officials concerned and foreign diplomatic envoys and representatives of international bodies here. Indian embassy officials were on hand. Speeches were made at the reception. Rodong News Team

title: U.S. Urged to Completely Stop Joint Military Exercises
body: The permanent representative of the DPRK to the UN Office and international organizations in Geneva, at the first session of the Geneva Disarmament Conference that opened on Jan. 23, clarified the following principled stand as regards military moves going against the atmosphere for detente on the Korean Peninsula: A dramatic change is taking place in the situation of the Korean Peninsula thanks to the initiatives and sincere efforts of the DPRK government in the New Year. But the U.S. is massively introducing nuclear strategic assets in and around the Korean Peninsula, going against this trend. This is a dangerous act to chill the hard-won atmosphere for the improved north-south ties and push the situation back to the extreme phase of confrontation. The U.S.-led reckless joint military exercises staged every year targeting the preemptive attack on the DPRK are a root cause of the escalating tension on the peninsula. If the U.S. truly wishes for the improvement of the north-south ties and has a willingness to provide a peaceful environment on the peninsula, it should completely halt the joint military exercises, not just postponing them, and completely stop all nuclear war drills aimed at a preemptive attack on the DPRK. As a responsible, peace-loving nuclear power, the DPRK will never use nuclear weapons nor pose any nuclear threat as long as the aggression hostile forces do not encroach upon the sovereignty and interests of the country, but will resolutely counter any act of harassing peace and security on the peninsula. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korean Conservative Group Should Stop Anti-Reunification Campaign
body: The conservative group of south Korea are behaving mischievously, finding fault with every matter the north and the south are pushing ahead over the Winter Olympics. It is the last-ditch effort to spoil the hard-won climate for improved north-south relations and block our participation in the Winter Olympics. Clear is the reason why the south Korean conservatives are making a desperate bid with blood-shot eyes. Having prolonged remaining days with dependence on outsiders and confrontation with the compatriots, they consider the improvement of the north-south relations as a horrible nightmare of tightening their windpipes. The tragedy of national division has been going on for over seven decades and a grave situation fraught with the danger of war has persisted on this land owing to the flunkeyist and treacherous confrontation moves of the south Korean conservative group being parasitic on the U.S. However, they are getting ever more desperate in their moves of confrontation with the compatriots although they were ousted from power, far from reflecting on their unpardonable crimes against reunification. All these facts clearly show once again that the south Korean conservatives are a cancer-like being in the way for improvement of the north-south relations, peace and national reunification and a group of top-class traitors that should be no longer allowed to go at large. No matter how desperately they may try to mislead the public opinion, nobody will lend an ear to their trumpeting. The south Korean conservatives would be well advised to stop at once such foolish smear campaign making their end more miserable and prepare themselves to stand their trial for the thrice-cursed crimes they committed against the nation. Ri Song Ho

title: "America First" Drives U.S. into Isolation and Ruin
body: "America first" is the chauvinist doctrine which is driving the U.S. into isolation and ruin as it persists in inequality and racial discrimination in the international relations and the war-first doctrine wrecking global peace, prompted by its hegemonic nature. It is also extreme state egoism driving the U.S. into isolation politically and economically. The burglarious logic for aggression "America first" justifying the act of depriving other countries and nations of sovereignty and rights to existence and development serves as strong catalyst accelerating ruin of the empire of evils in every part of the world. "America first" calling for sacrificing the world for its own abundant life drives even the allies and henchmen of the U.S. into a dilemma and creates a chaos in the overall West economy. "America first" is being buffeted by criticism of the international community as it is a doctrine to turn the world into a theatre of rampage by the jungle law through highhanded and arbitrary practices. It is natural in the light of the law of causality that the empire of evils wielding "America first" stick for aggression and plunder in the world is hit by the international community. "America first", Yankee-style hegemonic doctrine saying that everything should exist for the U.S., accelerates isolation and ruin of the empire of evils in all aspects of politics, economy, military affairs and diplomacy. Ri Hyo Jin

title: Editorial
body: Let Us Mark 70th Birthday of DPRK as Festival of Victors All the people should more fully demonstrate the heroic spirit of Juche Korea, firmly united in one thought and purpose around the great Workers' Party of Korea, this year when they will celebrate the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. Great leap forward and innovation should be made in the present general offensive to greet the 70th birthday of the DPRK with splendor in the spirit of the great unity. By steadily inheriting the precious tradition of the great Chollima upswing that was created in the difficult postwar period to devotedly defend the idea and authority of President Kim Il Sung with trust in him only, we have to go all out for the campaign to carry through the tasks set forth in the New Year Address of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. We should perform praiseworthy feats through the general offensive this year in the same spirit and traits as displayed by the defense scientists who made devoted efforts last year to demonstrate to the world that the Party's plan and decision is a science and truth and that they automatically mean their materialization. We must complete the construction of the Wonsan-Kalma coastal tourist area in the shortest period of time on the strength of the army-people great unity and accelerate the major construction projects. Under the slogan "One for all and all for one!" all the sectors and units should help each other and launch a socialist emulation and make joint innovations. It is the firm will of the Party to bring about a new upswing in the revolution and bring earlier the final victory of socialism by further strengthening the might of the single-minded unity.

title: KNPC Spokesman Calls for Foiling U.S. Nuclear War Moves
body: A spokesperson for the Korean National Peace Committee issued a statement on Jan. 28 with the approach of 60 years since the U.S. officially published the introduction of nuclear weapons into south Korea. The U.S. officially announced the above-said introduction on January 29, 1958 and undisguisedly opened to public nukes including atomic guns and Honest John nuclear missiles. Thenceforth the Korean Peninsula, once a nuclear free zone, has turned into a nuclear powder magazine and a source of nuclear war of the U.S. and the Korean nation has been at constant peril of nuclear war due to its nuclear stick. Even at this time when the climate of national concord, unity and detente is growing strong on the Korean Peninsula thanks to our proactive measures and sincere efforts, the U.S. is bringing nuclear carrier task forces, nuclear strategic bombers and other huge nuclear war means to south Korea and its vicinity, imposing constant nuclear war threat and blackmail on our nation. What should not be overlooked is the fact that the U.S. is planning to designate the DPRK as "potential state of nuclear threat" and stipulate even the scenario for preemptive nuclear strike in the "2018 nuclear posture review report" to be published around early February. The past sixty years are a history of heinous aggression and crimes in which the U.S. reduced south Korea into the world's biggest nuclear weapons arsenal and most dangerous seat of nuclear war and has constantly threatened the destiny of the Korean nation with nukes. The U.S. would be well advised to behave itself, aware that the days have gone for good when it could pose its unilateral threat to the DPRK with a nuclear stick. The south Korean authorities should stop the shipment of U.S. nuclear strategic assets and aggressor forces which will spawn bloodshed on this sacred territory, cease the nuclear war exercises with the U.S. and respond to our sincere efforts for detente. All compatriots in the north and the south and abroad should reject the anti-DPRK moves of the U.S. to bring clouds of a nuclear war to hang over Korea, and conduct more vigorous anti-U.S., anti-war struggle to drive the U.S. nuclear hardware and aggression forces out of south Korea. Rodong News Team

title: Challenge of Anti-Reunification forces Should Be Smashed
body: The U.S. and Japanese reactionaries and the south Korean confrontational maniacs opposed to reunification are going so reckless as to chill the climate of detente on the Korean Peninsula, being created by the proactive and sincere efforts of the DPRK, and thus realize their sinister ambition. As the DPRK exerts sincere efforts to improve the north-south relations, the anti-reunification forces at home and abroad are getting more pronounced in the moves to stem the trend of the times and realize their ambition for stifling the former. It is the desire of the compatriots and demand of the times to mend the inter-Korean relations and bring about a signal turn in reunifying the country independently. The present reality of the north-south relations clearly proves the validity and vitality of the DPRK's fresh policy for improving the relations. It is a fruition of the above-said policy that dialogue, contact and exchange between the north and the south of Korea started, though they had remained frozen for a long time owing to the moves of the separatist forces at home and abroad, and climate of detente was created on the Korean Peninsula. The north and the south should pave a broad avenue to their improved relations which made a good start despite the difficult situation. The Korean nation is greatly angered by the reckless moves of the anti-reunification forces at home and abroad to incite confrontation while going against the trend of the improvement of the north-south relations. All Koreans in the north and the south and abroad should dynamically pave the road of national reunification under the uplifted banner of national independence while resolutely smashing with their concerted efforts the criminal moves of the separatist forces at home and abroad to check the improvement of the north-south relations and realize their ambition for stifling the DPRK. Un Jong Chol

title: U.S. Is Arch Criminal Harassing Peace on Korean Peninsula
body: The United States is the arch criminal harassing peace as it has spawned political confusion, conflict and bloodshed by sowing discord and antagonism among other countries and regions. The U.S. is the harasser of peace as it has constantly exacerbated the situation on the Korean Peninsula through military provocations and war threat. Peaceful climate was urgently needed for the DPRK which suffered serious damage from the war imposed by the U.S. in the 1950s and rose from the debris. However, only vicious cycle of mounting tension has prevailed on the Korean Peninsula for the past several decades. Nuclear war drills have persisted to drive the situation to the brink of a war. The Korean Peninsula has turned into the biggest hotspot of the world owing to the U.S. reckless military threat and blackmail. The reality proves once again the truth that it is necessary to stand up with force of justice only against the imperialist aggressors keen to disturb the world peace and security and impose a nuclear disaster upon humankind. As a responsible nuclear power, the DPRK will resolutely smash any act of harassing peace and security on the Korean Peninsula. Ri Chol Hyok

title: Kim Jong Il's Birth Anniversary to Be Marked in Belarus
body: A preparatory committee for celebrating the 76th birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il was formed in Belarus on Jan. 16. L. Shukolinikov, chairman of the Permanent Standing Committee of the Belarus National Association of Friends of Korean People Named after Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee decided to give wide publicity to Kim Jong Il's revolutionary career and exploits and organize various political and cultural events. Rodong News Team

title: Our Advance Team Visits South Side's Area for Field Survey
body: An advance team led by Yun Yong Bok, vice department director of the Ministry of Physical Culture and Sports, visited the south side's area for field survey on Jan. 25-27 as regards the DPRK's participation in the 23rd Winter Olympics. The 8-person advance team learned about the situation, going round the places to be used by the DPRK National Olympic Committee delegation, players team, cheering group, Taekwon-do demonstration group and press corps during the Olympics. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Shining Star to Be Celebrated by Koreans in China
body: A preparatory committee of the General Association of Koreans in China for celebrating the birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il (the Day of the Shining Star) was formed on Jan. 24. Choe Un Bok, chairwoman of the association, was elected chairwoman of the preparatory committee. The committee decided to organize colorful events including meeting, film show and art performance praising Kim Jong Il's revolutionary career and exploits. The Zhongnan Regional Association, the Yanbian Regional Association and other organizations under the General Association of Koreans in China, too, decided to hold various events. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Delegation Leaves for China
body: A delegation of the General Administration of Civil Aviation led by its General Director Rim Kwang Ung left here on Jan. 30 to attend a ministerial meeting of civil aviation in the Asia-Pacific region to be held in China. Rodong News Team

title: AP Vice-President Leaves
body: Ian Antony Phillips, vice-president of the Associated Press of the U.S., left here for home on Jan. 30. Rodong News Team

title: Cunning Tricks for Overseas Expansion
body: Shortly ago, the NHK of Japan gave out false news on "missile launch by the DPRK" plunging the whole archipelago into terrible turmoil. In the wake of the appalling confusion, there was an evacuation drill in Tokyo, Japan under the scenario that "missile is coming." Last year more than 20 evacuation drills were waged across Japan but this was reportedly the first time in Tokyo. It is part of the Japanese reactionary ruling quarters' cunning tricks to realize its ambition for overseas expansion by creating an atmosphere of terror in Japanese society and revising the constitution with it as an occasion. Through false report such as "missile fire" and repeated evacuation drills the Abe group attempts to cause uneasiness and tension among Japanese people in a bid to make them support the constitution revision. The Japanese politicians had better stop resorting to thinly veiled tricks. It will be wise that they should remember the past lessons of the defeated nation and accede willingly to the present environment of the region whose strategic structure changed completely. The international community never allows Japan's overseas expansion. The militarist revival of Japan will lead to its self-destruction. Ri Hyo Jin

title: Doom of U.S. Is Inevitable
body: Shortly ago, the CBS of the U.S. conducted a poll on its nationals. Most of the respondents said that society was divided, ethnic and racial tensions mushroomed and they don't trust the political system which enforces policies only for the good of the few. This is the reality of the U.S. The daily-growing socio-economic inequalities in the U.S. are a realistic factor which quickens the national division. The U.S. is seen as a country with the worst socio-economic inequalities in the world, where the gap between the rich and the poor is increasing day by day and a large number of people live in poverty, whereas the privileged circles no more than one percent of the population have the majority of social wealth. As a result, the rich get richer and the poor poorer and class contradictions go from bad to worse. That's because the government backed by monopolies enforces unfair economic policy for the sake of the few. Not a few Americans are doing extreme actions with discontent with the unreasonable policies enforced by the authorities and social system which drive them into catastrophe. Downhill is the inevitable fate of the U.S., the empire of evils. Ri Hak Nam

title: U.S. Is Mastermind of Nuclear War
body: The U.S. imperialists are the root cause of all misfortunes and sufferings of the Korean nation and heinous enemy of peace. On July 15, 1957 the U.S. declared that it would start to arm its imperialist aggression troops in south Korea with nuclear weapons. On Jan. 29, 1958 it announced that it introduced nuclear weapons into south Korea. From long ago, the U.S. has turned south Korea into a nuclear advanced base, running amuck to realize its design for aggression on the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and Northeast Asia. After the emergence of the Trump administration the moves of the U.S. imperialists to ignite a nuclear war have reached climax. They try to browbeat the DPRK by sending three nuclear aircraft carrier strike groups to the waters off the Korean Peninsula and its vicinity. This goes to prove that the U.S. imperialists are frantic with the moves to ignite a nuclear war at any cost on the Korean Peninsula, trampling down the aspiration and demand of the Korean nation for peace and reunification. The U.S. spawned the nuclear issue of the Korean Peninsula and it is the mastermind of nuclear war. It is very shameless that such heinous nuclear criminal talks about "dismantlement of nukes," under the pretext of "nuclear threat" from someone. The harsher nuclear threat and blackmail the U.S. poses, the further the DPRK will bolster up nuclear deterrent for self-defence. Ra Sol Ha

title: Appeal of DPRK Government, Political Parties and Organizations Supported
body: Nam Sung U, vice-chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), made public a statement on January 27 in support of the appeal of the joint conference of the DPRK government, political parties and organizations which called upon all Koreans to turn out as one in the struggle for glorifying this significant year as a year of great changes and great events to eternally shine in the history of national reunification. The statement said that the appeal of the joint conference to improve the north-south relations and make a breakthrough for independent reunification true to the noble patriotic intention of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un reflects the unanimous desire and aspiration of all the fellow countrymen for leading the first step of the hard-won climate for improved north-south relations to an epochal advance for independent reunification. It went on: We will hold Marshal Kim Jong Un in high esteem as the great loadstar of national reunification and implement his idea and line for independent reunification with the patriotic enthusiasm and will. We will actively join in the anti-U.S. sacred struggle to put a definite end to the war drills against the DPRK which will bring nuclear disaster to the homeland, and bring about a new era of peace and reunification, holding fast to the banner of national independence, By Our Nation Itself, as the eternal lifeline for the movement for national reunification. The statement expressed the will to make tangible contribution to strengthening the solidarity of the fellow countrymen in the north and the south and abroad and realizing a pan-national gathering for reunification and joint national events this significant year marking the 70th anniversary of the historic Joint Conference of Representatives of Political Parties and Social Organizations in North and South Korea. Rodong News Team

title: U.S. Hit for Policy Hostile to DPRK
body: The Nepal Worker-Peasant Party supported the just cause of the Korean people and denounced the U.S. policy hostile to the DPRK. The resolution adopted at a recent meeting of the Party expressed support and solidarity for the measures taken by the DPRK to increase its military capability for defending its sovereignty from the U.S. war threat. It also urged the U.S. to repeal its anti-DPRK sanctions that have been imposed for decades, pull out its troops from south Korea at once and create a favorable climate for the reunification of the Korean Peninsula. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Il's Birth Anniversary to Be Marked in Egypt
body: An Egyptian preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il was formed on Jan. 17. Yehia Zakaria Khairullah, vice-chairman of the Socialist Freedom Party of Egypt and chairman of the Egypt-Korea Friendship Association, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee set a celebration period from Jan. 17 to Feb. 16 and decided to hold a seminar, a film show, a photo exhibition and other political and cultural events praising Kim Jong Il's revolutionary career and exploits in the period. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Shining Star to Be Marked in Kuwait
body: A Kuwaiti preparatory committee for celebrating leader Kim Jong Il's birth anniversary (the Day of the Shining Star) was formed on Jan. 18. Javid Ahmad, director of the Administrative Department of the Kuwait Times who doubles as chairman of the Kuwait Asian Journalist Association, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee set a celebration period from Jan. 18 to Feb. 18 and decided to organize colorful political and cultural events including seminar and film show praising Kim Jong Il's revolutionary career and exploits in the period. Rodong News Team

title: New Stamps Issued
body: The DPRK State Stamp Bureau issued new stamps (two sheets and four sheetlets) dealing with the New Year Address of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Seen in upper parts of the sheets are letters "Let us launch a revolutionary general offensive to achieve fresh victory on all fronts of building a powerful socialist country!" One of the sheets carries a photo of Kim Jong Un making his New Year Address for Juche 107 (2018). Printed in its lower part are letters reading "Single-minded unity". The sheetlets reflect the ideas on consolidating the independence and Juche character of the national economy, improving the people's standard of living, developing the socialist culture in an overall way and further increasing the military capabilities for self-defense. Rodong News Team

title: New Posters Produced
body: New posters were produced in the DPRK to encourage the army and people to the struggle for carrying out the tasks set forth in the New Year Address of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. The poster reading "Long Live the 70th Founding Anniversary of the DPRK!" reflects the great joy and excitement of the Korean army and people who will mark the 70th birthday of the DPRK with splendor. Some posters call for turning out in the struggle to frustrate the last-ditch challenges of the hostile forces and put the overall national power of the DPRK on a new stage of development by launching an all-people general offensive under the leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea. There are also posters calling for strengthening the independence and Juche character of the national economy and improving the people's standard of living. Some posters show the Korean army and people's will to accelerate the major construction projects and reach the high peak of a sci-tech power and highly civilized power. Rodong News Team

title: True Intention of Evacuation Drills in U.S., Japan
body: Days ago, a false warning that "ballistic missile is coming from the DPRK" was sounded in Hawaii of the U.S. to demand an immediate evacuation, plunging the whole island into appalling confusion. And the U.S. media reported that inhabitants of Michigan of the U.S. took the explosion of a meteorite for a missile attack, being stupefied with terror, which added to uneasiness. Meanwhile, the Japanese reactionaries waged a large-scale evacuation drill under the stimulated missile attack by someone in downtown Tokyo. Earlier, the NHK of Japan posted on the internet a message of the government to recommend taking shelter in a building or underground over the missile presumed to be fired by the DPRK, striking the citizens with horror. What is the true intention sought by the U.S. and the Japanese reactionaries in advertising "missile threats" and kicking up a row of evacuations as never before? First of all, they attempt to build up public opinion against the DPRK in the international community as well as at home by purposely setting afloat the horror of the DPRK's nukes and rockets through those anti-missile evacuations. What merits a more serious attention is that the anti-missile evacuation rows in the U.S. and Japan were neither regular ones nor ones by misinformation but premeditated moves to examine war preparations any time under war scenario targeting the DPRK. Their anti-missile evacuations are clearly aimed at igniting a war of aggression against the DPRK. Jang Jong Chol

title: Let Us Work and Live in Militant Way
body: It presents itself as a more urgent requirement to establish a revolutionary habit of working and living in a militant way in the fiercer struggle for realizing independence of the popular masses. For all the people to live and struggle in a revolutionary and militant way is essential for reliably defending the socialist country and the gains of the revolution. The objective sought by the imperialists for aggression is to disintegrate the people of the targeted nation ideologically by introducing their corrupt ideology and culture and persistently pursue sanctions and pressure to lead them to hardships in living and unrest. This is the method of the imperialists to achieve their purpose of aggression and plunder with ease by neutralizing the strength of the targeted country and it is also a curtain raiser to a war of aggression. The security of the country and the people is not guaranteed by the modern arms and equipment. Only when all our service personnel and people heighten the revolutionary vigilance and are fully ready for action, can the might of our powerful war deterrent, the treasured sword of defending the peace, be given full rein. The socialist country will be further strengthened into an impregnable fortress only when all the people live and struggle in a revolutionary and militant way, remaining alert and prepared at all times with transparent class consciousness. Kim Song Nam

title: Meeting of Chapter Chairpersons of Chongryon Held in Tokyo
body: A meeting of chapter chairpersons of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) took place at the Korean Hall in Tokyo on Jan. 26 to glorify this year as a year of great advance that makes a decisive breakthrough in the development of the movement of Koreans in Japan, in hearty response to respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address and New Year message and concentrate all efforts on the chapter work of Chongryon. Present there were Chairman Ho Jong Man and vice-chairpersons of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, and chairpersons of the Chongryon headquarters and chapters across Japan and officials of the Chongryon headquarters in Kanto. Ho Jong Man said in his report that the officials of Chongryon should stage an all-out organized movement for the 24th Chongryon Congress with main stress put on the chapter work. The chapter chairpersons of Chongryon should cherish deep in their mind the main ideas contained in Kim Jong Un's New Year Address and New Year message and carry them into practice without condition, he said. Noting that the respected Supreme Leader set it as the general orientation of Chongryon's struggle for this year to make a decisive breakthrough in the work for developing the movement of Koreans in Japan into a higher stage with the 24th Chongryon Congress as an occasion, the reporter stressed that all the Chongryon officials should turn out as one to carry out this task. Then followed speeches. The speakers expressed their resolution to thoroughly establish the unified leadership system of Kim Jong Un, enhance the function and role of the chapter standing committees, strengthen the organizations as firm as a rock and thus reap actual results in carrying out the patriotic tasks, in hearty response to his New Year Address and New Year message. Rodong News Team

title: White Paper on Human Rights Violations in U.S. in 2017 Issued in DPRK
body: The DPRK Institute of International Studies on Jan. 30 released the "White Paper on Human Rights Violations in U.S. in 2017". According to the white paper, soon after being inaugurated as president, Trump filled the important posts of his administration with billionaires, who had "contributed" to his election campaign, and their mouthpieces. Secretary of State Tillerson, Secretary of Commerce Ross and also the secretaries of Treasury and Defense are all billionaires from conglomerates. The total assets of public servants at the level of deputy secretary and above of the current administration are worth of 14 billion US$. The anti-popular policies the Trump administration pursued openly in one year were, without exception, for the interests of a handful of the rich circles. In the U.S., where genuine freedom of the press and expression does not exist, intervention in and crackdown on the press grew more intensified over the past one year. In 2017 the cases of searching and confiscation against journalists accounted for 12 and the cases of violation against them for 11. Moreover, 19 persons in the domestic press circles and four foreign journalists were arrested or detained. Racial discrimination and misanthropy are serious maladies inherent to the social system of the U.S., and they have been aggravated since Trump took office. The racial violence that took place in Charlottesville, Virginia, on August 12 is a typical example of the acme of the current administration's policy of racism. In the U.S. the absolute majority of the working masses, deprived of elementary rights to survival, are hovering in the abyss of nightmare. As a result, during the first week of March, 241 000 persons joined the large contingent of the unemployed; in May 9 000 public servants were fired from governmental agencies; in September the number of the unemployed increased by 33 000 as compared to that of the previous month. In particular, unemployment of young people has become a matter of serious social concern; currently the unemployment rate of young people under 25 is 7.9%, and 31% of graduates from high schools do not have proper jobs. According to what the U.S. administration made public, in 2017 the homeless numbered 554 000, about 10% increase as compared to that two years ago, and number of the poor families, living in rented rooms devoid of elementary facilities for living, is on the steady rise. The soaring school expenses are plunging the students into the hell of loans. Those who are diagnosed with a disease but cannot afford to pay their medical fees total 50 million. Flu, lung diseases and asthma cause 36 000, 40 000 and 150 000 deaths, respectively, on an annual average. On the other hand, health-hazardous disqualified products are on sale across the country, which often leads to an outbreak of infectious diseases. The U.S. is one of the world's two countries that have yet to embrace paid maternity leave. Over the past decade the proportion of American women who live below the poverty line has risen from 12.1% to 14.5%, and they usually receive 25% less salary than their male colleagues of the same post. A woman is sexually abused every 89 seconds. According to basic statistics, about 61 100 gun-related crimes took place in the U.S. last year, leaving 15 488 dead and 31 058 wounded. According to data, the number of marijuana users in the U.S. was more than 20 million, a 3% increase as compared with that a decade ago; and over 90 people lose their lives on a daily average from drug abuse. In the U.S. where crimes and evil are rampant, the number of imprisoned criminals tops 2.3 million and 70 million are ex-offenders. The U.S., "guardian of democracy" and "human rights champion", is kicking up the human rights racket but it can never camouflage its true identity as the gross violator of human rights, the white paper said. Rodong News Team

title: Art Troupe of Koreans in Japan Here
body: An art troupe of Koreans in Japan headed by Ha Yong Su arrived here on Jan. 30 to celebrate the Day of the Shining Star, the birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: European Politicians Here
body: A delegation of politicians from various political parties in Europe led by Jonathan Powell of the British Labor Party, former Downing Street Chief of Staff to Prime Minister Tony Blair, arrived here on Jan. 30. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Inspects Pyongyang Trolley Bus Factory
body: Respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un gave field guidance to the newly-remodeled Pyongyang Trolley Bus Factory. Looking at the factory with a bright smile on his face, he said that all buildings are neat and fine and environment around the factory is clean and it can be felt that much effort was made to do so. He went round the room for education in the revolutionary history and the room dedicated to the history of the factory. He noted that the Pyongyang Trolley Bus Factory was founded thanks to the noble intention of President Kim Il Sung who set forth a policy of operating trolley buses in the capital to make its citizens live in a cultured way in the pollution-free city. He said that the pictures of the President watching "Chollima-72" type trolley bus in May 1972 and of leader Kim Jong Il watching a large bus "Kwangbok Sonyon" in April 1990 reminded him of their devotion and efforts made to solve the traffic problem of the capital city. He said that the officials and workers of the factory should bear in mind the honor and pride of working at the glorious worksite associated with patriotic sweats of the great leaders and their love for the people and make constant innovations and continued progress. Going round processing, electromotor, trolley bus assembly and overhaul workshops and other parts of the factory, he learned in detail about the modernization and production. He watched new-type trolley buses produced at the factory. In the trolley buses he learned in detail about their performance and quality of fittings. And he said that they are a proud product of the Korean workers' revolutionary spirit of self-reliance and he is encouraged and pleasant to see them, adding that Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il would have been very glad to see happy citizens going to and from worksites aboard new-type trolley buses. He stressed the need to better the design of trolley bus, create its mark in a peculiar style and coat it more presentable and make fittings as required by the people so that they may not feel inconvenience and thus make the trolley bus, a mass transport means, represent the looks of the capital city of Pyongyang. Saying it is his intention to turn the Pyongyang Trolley Bus Factory into a world-class trolley bus producer, the Supreme Leader set the goal of second-phase modernization to be attained by the factory and took a benevolent measure for it. Expressing expectation and belief that its officials and workers would fulfill their duty in the work to attain the new goal set by the Party, he had a photo session with them. Accompanying him were Vice-Chairman O Su Yong and Vice Department Director Jo Yong Won of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Political News Team

title: Day of Shining Star to Be Marked in Uganda
body: A preparatory committee for marking the birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il (Day of the Shining Star) was formed in Kampala on Jan. 22. title: U.S. Is Heinous Enemy of Peace, War Maniac
body: The U.S. is transferring huge armed forces to the Korean Peninsula when the whole world is welcoming the inter-Korean talks for successful Winter Olympics. The U.S. is bringing dark clouds of a nuclear war to the peninsula over which doves should fly, revealing that it is the heinous enemy of peace and war maniac which should not exist on the earth. The U.S. is running amuck, making public the military option, but the DPRK remains unfazed by it. It is a foolish act to seek to bring down the country where the people are single-mindedly united and which possesses powerful nuclear striking means. The army and people of the DPRK remain steadfast in their will to decisively frustrate the U.S. nuclear war scenario aimed at deliberately coiling up the tension on the peninsula quite contrary to the aspiration and desire of the world for peace. If one knows neither the rival nor oneself, he is certain to fail. If the U.S. imperialists start another war on this land, they will meet their final doom. The U.S. would be well advised to get well aware that there would be no person to confess that they fought against the wrong rival in the wrong war at the wrong time and place. Ri Hyon Do

title: Ri Su Yong Meets European Politicians
body: Ri Su Yong, chairman of the Foreign Affairs Committee of the DPRK Supreme People's Assembly who is member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, on Jan. 31 had a talk with the visiting delegation of politicians from various political parties in Europe led by Jonathan Powell of the British Labor Party, former Downing Street Chief of Staff to Prime Minister Tony Blair. Ri Su Yong said that the Party and people are launching a revolutionary general offensive to achieve fresh victory on all the fronts of building a powerful socialist country true to the New Year Address made by respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. He informed the delegation of the situation on the Korean Peninsula in which the climate of national reconciliation, unity and détente is being created thanks to the DPRK's proactive measure and sincere efforts. Jonathan Powell welcomed the recent phase of détente on the Korean Peninsula thanks to the DPRK's proactive proposal, hoping that such trend will be kept. Members of the delegation acknowledged that development of the relations between the DPRK and Europe is a contribution to interests of both sides and peace and stability of the world, expressing their will to continue dialogue between the Workers' Party of Korea and various political parties and politicians of Europe in the future, too. Rodong News Team

title: Youth League Officials Start Study Tour of Kim Jong Il's Birthplace
body: Officials of the youth league from across the country started their study tour of leader Kim Jong Il's birthplace in the Paektusan Secret Camp in the run-up to his birth anniversary. There was a kick-off meeting before the statues of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il in Hyesan City, Ryanggang Province on Feb 1. Officials concerned, youth league officials and study tour makers were present there. They laid a floral basket and bouquets at the statutes of the great leaders and paid tribute to them. A reporter and speakers at the meeting called on the study tour makers to more firmly arm themselves with the revolutionary spirit of Paektu, the spirit of the blizzards of Paektu and fully demonstrate their indomitable will and spirit to carry forward to completion the revolutionary cause of Juche generation after generation. After the meeting the study tour group headed for Pochonbo, flying the flags of the DPRK, youth league and the study tour group. Working people and school youth and children in Hyesan City warmly saw off the members of the study tour group. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK FM Delegation Meets Swedish Prime Minister
body: A delegation of the DPRK Foreign Ministry led by Vice-Minister Han Song Ryol had a talk with Stefan Lofven, prime minister of the Kingdom of Sweden, on Jan. 30. Stefan Lofven said that Sweden would make efforts to develop the long-standing relations with the DPRK, expressing pleasure over the fact that the climate of detente and reconciliation is being created on the Korean Peninsula recently. On the same day Han Song Ryol paid a courtesy call on the Swedish foreign minister and had talks with the state secretary for the Swedish Foreign Ministry. Views on developing the bilateral relations and DPRK-EU relations were exchanged during the courtesy call and talks. Rodong News Team

title: Minimum Wage Hike Demanded in S. Korea
body: According to the south Korean online newspaper Voice of People, the south Korean Confederation of Trade Unions held a rally in Seoul on Jan. 30 in demand of minimum wage hike. Speakers urged the "government" to set right the illegal acts of checking the minimum wage hike. Other organizations held a press conference in Seoul that day to denounce gentries of the conservative opposition parties for opposing the minimum wage hike. Rodong News Team

title: European Politicians Visit Various Places
body: A delegation of politicians from various political parties in Europe led by Jonathan Powell of the British Labor Party, former Downing Street Chief of Staff to Prime Minister Tony Blair, visited the Sci-Tech Complex. It went round e-reading room, applied sci-tech hall and other parts of the complex. It also toured the Pyongyang Cosmetics Factory and the Masikryong Ski Resort. Rodong News Team

title: Illusion about Imperialism Is Deadly Virus
body: Illusion about imperialism makes it impossible to maintain independence in politics and self-sustenance in economy. If a country is obsessed by illusion about imperialism, its sovereignty is violated and flouted and it won't escape from doom. The tragic situation in Iraq and Libya clearly proved this. Today, the imperialists' strong-arm policy is facing the fate of doom. Creating such illusion is no more than last-ditch efforts of the imperialists to realize their ambition to dominate the world. If one fails to discern this and harbors such illusion, one will cook one's own goose as well as help the imperialists prolong their remaining days. The countries aspiring after independence should keep strict vigilance over and root out the slightest illusion about imperialism and adhere to the Juche character and national character. It is the lesson of history and the truth that illusion about imperialism precisely means death. Son So Yon

title: World Peace-loving People Called to Join in Creating Climate for Korea's Reunification
body: The Congolese Association for Friendship among Peoples issued an appeal to the world peace-loving people on Jan. 22 in support of the independent reunification of Korea. The year 2018 is a significant year marking the 70th birthday of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, the great feat and legacy of immortal President Kim Il Sung, the appeal said, expressing support for the occasions created for improving the inter-Korean relations thanks to the noble love for the nation and the peace-loving will of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, the great guardian of peace and justice. It noted that since its founding, the DPRK has made efforts for its independent development and the peace and security of the Korean Peninsula. It called upon the world peace-loving people to actively join in creating the climate for the improved inter-Korean ties and the independent reunification of Korea. Rodong News Team

Torsten Schoevitz, chairman of the Communist Party of Germany, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. title: Seminar Held
body: Social scientists of the DPRK had a seminar on the feats of President Kim Il Sung, leader Kim Jong Il and respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un for the building and strengthening of regular revolutionary armed forces at the Korean Revolution Museum on Feb. 1. Attending it were teachers, researchers, lecturers, journalists, editors and officials in the fields of science, education, media and preservation of revolutionary relics and institutions for training party cadres. The seminar heard the papers explaining and proving the feats and wise leadership of the peerlessly great men who founded the Korean People's Army (KPA) and developed it into an invincible revolutionary army. Speakers said that Kim Il Sung's idea on building regular armed forces through development of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army into the KPA is the perfect idea of army building as it formulated the essence and mission of the revolutionary armed forces and the law-governed stage and method of their building in a scientific way. The foundation of the KPA is a historic event that declared the accomplishment of the cause of building regular revolutionary armed forces, and it is the fruition of the President's idea of Juche-based army building and distinguished and seasoned leadership, they stressed. They said Kim Jong Il had strengthened the KPA into the army of the leader and the party. To thoroughly ensure the idea and guidance of Kim Jong Un is a fundamental guarantee for developing the KPA into a strong support to firmly defend the cause of the Party and an army strong in idea and faith with indomitable mental power, they said. Rodong News Team

title: Trial Run of New-type Trolley Bus Made in Presence of Kim Jong Un
body: A trial run of new-type trolley bus was conducted in the presence of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, together with Ri Sol Ju. The Supreme Leader went round the city aboard a trolley bus at midnight despite his busy time, saying that he would feel easy when he personally examines the test of new-type trolley bus with which he acquainted himself during his recent visit to the remodeled Pyongyang Trolley Bus Factory. The trolley bus is comfortable and reliable as its damper and speed are good and it has no vibration and noise, he noted, appreciating its technical conditions. He feels easy and proud and great as it was made by our workers, he said, adding that he would be very glad and satisfied to see the products of the strength of self-reliance. Stressing the need to not only turn out a new thing but also steadily improve it in a technical way and further perfect its production process, he said that he would offer useful technological data and that it is needed to better the technical specifications of trolley bus and mass-produce it so as to normalize the passenger service in the capital city. He earnestly called on the sector of the passenger service in the capital to strive to satisfactorily provide traffic convenience for the citizens in the cold winter days in particular, always regarding the popular masses' demand and appreciation as absolute standard and with the revolutionary outlook on the masses strictly based on this and the spirit of devoted service to the people. Accompanying him were Vice-Chairman O Su Yong and Vice Department Director Jo Yong Won of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Political News Team

title: KPA Birthday to Be Marked in Nigeria
body: A Nigerian preparatory committee for marking the 70th birthday of the Korean People's Army (KPA) was formed in Abuja on Jan. 25. Ibrahim Mantu, member of the Credit Committee of the People's Democratic Party of Nigeria and chairman of the Nigeria-Korea Friendship Association, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. title: Chongryon Officials Back Appeal of DPRK
body: Officials of the organizations of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) on Jan. 30 made public statements in support of an appeal of the joint conference of the DPRK government, political parties and organizations to all the Korean nationals at home and abroad. Ri Tong Je, chairman of the Association of Koreans in Japan for Peaceful Reunification, stressed that he would spare no effort to stick to and carry forward the spirit of the joint conference of representatives of political parties and public organizations in north and south Korea and ensure that a joint national event to be attended by all political parties, organizations and personages at home and abroad would be successfully held on such occasions as the anniversaries of north-south declarations and the 73rd anniversary of national liberation this year marking the 70th anniversary of the said joint conference. Kim Yong Ju, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the Korean Youth League in Japan, said that the Korean youth and students in Japan would always stand in the van of the struggle to decisively smash the nuclear war exercises and all other obstructive moves of the U.S. and anti-reunification forces and bring about a fresh era of peace and reunification on the Korean Peninsula under the unfurled banner of By Our Nation Itself by further strengthening solidarity and unity with the fellow countrymen in the north and the south and abroad. Ryang Ok Chul, vice-chairperson of the Central Standing Committee of the Korean Democratic Women's Union in Japan, said that the union officials and all other Korean women would fulfill their mission and duty they assumed before the country and the nation, with the strong will to go all out to glorify this year as a year of great change and great event to be noteworthy in the history of national reunification. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korean Conservatives Should Stop Impudent Remarks against Event of North
body: Now heard from south Korea are a flurry of improper remarks criticizing an event to be held in the DPRK in celebration of the birthday of the Korean People's Army. Since the middle of January, such puppet conservative media as Yonhap News, Chosun Ilbo, Choongang Ilbo and Dong-A Ilbo have made such coarse invectives that the "north is preparing for a large-scale military parade to mark the 70th anniversary of the KPA" and "it is its intention to dramatize the political effect that it completed the nuclear weaponization". Reckless remarks are being made by gentries of the conservative opposition parties such as Kim Song Thae, floor leader of the "Liberal Korea Party", Kim Yong Thae, a lawmaker from the same party, Jang Je Won and Jong Thae Ok, spokespersons of the party, Ryu Sung Min, representative of the Parun Party, and Ha Thae Gyong, executive chairman of the same party. The puppet conservative group criticize the DPRK's event for celebrating the founding anniversary of the KPA as a "provocation", "show of nuclear weapons" and "part of the war preparations", asserting that the planned event should be canceled at once. All the facts clearly show how wicked, narrow-minded and tricky the puppet conservatives engrossed in pro-U.S. flunkeyism and confrontation with fellow countrymen are and that they are a despicable group of traitors. What matters is that the south Korean authorities are taking a noncommittal and irresolute attitude, reading minds of the conservatives clinging to heinous confrontational acts to stem the trend of mending the inter-Korean relations. If the south Korean authorities continue taking an indecisive stand, allowing the reckless confrontational acts of the anti-reunification conservative forces going against the desire of the nation and trend of the times, it will only bring about the consequences of souring the successful opening of the Winter Olympics and the blame for this will be with them as well as the conservative group. The puppet conservative group should immediately stop their impudent and shameless remarks against the event of fellow countrymen, properly facing up to the surging resentment of the army and people of the DPRK and the whole nation. Jon Jong Ho

title: Ski Players of North and South of Korea Undergo Joint Training
body: Ski players of the north and the south of Korea conducted a joint training at the Masikryong Ski Resort on Jan. 31 and Feb. 1 with the approach of the 23rd Winter Olympics. They acquired skiing skills at the resort. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Shining Star to Be Marked in Myanmar
body: A Myanmar preparatory committee for celebrating the 76th birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il (Day of the Shining Star) was formed with due ceremony at the building of the Yangon Regional Committee of the Union Solidarity and Development Party of Myanmar on Jan. 23. A press release was made public at the inaugural ceremony on significantly celebrating the Day of the Shining Star as a holiday common to humankind. It said that the institution of the Day of the Shining Star represented the unanimous wishes of the Korean people and the world progressives for celebrating Kim Jong Il's birthday as a holiday common to humankind, adding: The life of HE Kim Jong Il was a noble life of the peerless patriot and outstanding leader who devoted his all to the victory in the cause of human independence. The world peace-loving people pay the highest homage to leader Kim Jong Il. The press release said that the preparatory committee with Tha Win, secretary of the Yangon Regional Committee of the Union Solidarity and Development Party of Myanmar, as its chairman decided to hold political and cultural events such as celebration meeting, film show and photo exhibition in the period from Jan. 29 to Feb. 17. It also appealed to the world peace-loving people to extend invariable support and solidarity to the Korean people's struggle for building of a powerful socialist country and national reunification. Rodong News Team

title: Premier Inspects Dental Hygiene Products Factory
body: DPRK Premier Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, inspected the Pyongyang Dental Hygiene Products Factory. Going round various parts of the factory, he encouraged its officials and employees in dedicating wisdom and enthusiasm to keeping the production going at a high rate and providing the people with quality dental hygiene products. At a consultative meeting there, measures were taken to meticulously organize the management and produce more diverse products conducive to promoting the people's health. The premier also inspected the science exhibition hall of the State Academy of Sciences and the Pyongyang Pharmaceutical Factory, where he called for introducing earlier innovative successes made by scientists and technicians into major sectors of the national economy, and urged the relevant units to satisfactorily supply raw and other materials to the factories related to public health. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Sri Lankan President
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on Feb. 4 sent a message of greeting to Maithripala Sirisena, president of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, on the occasion of the 70th anniversary of its independence. Kim in the message wished the Sri Lankan president success in his responsible work for the country's socio-political stability and economic development, expressing the belief that the friendly and cooperative relations with a long tradition between the two countries would grow stronger in the common interests. Rodong News Team

title: Rash Acts of Marring Atmosphere of Improved Inter-Korean Ties
body: The U.S. has recently tried hard to drive the situation on the Korean Peninsula into confrontation again by marring the atmosphere for detente and improvement of the inter-Korean relations created thanks to the patriotic and proactive efforts of the DPRK. It shows that the U.S., upset by the hard-won climate of national reconciliation and unity and the improvement of the inter-Korean ties on the peninsula, is making desperate efforts to prevent the trend at any cost. The U.S. claims to "back" the inter-Korean dialogue, but it is nothing but an artifice to cover up its sinister intention to persistently coil up the tension on the peninsula. Such criminal act is a dangerous scheme to start a war for aggression on the DPRK. Watching the Trump group seek to hinder the inter-Korean dialogue and openly aggravate the situation, the Korean nation and the international community clearly see once again through the black-hearted intention of the U.S., harasser of dialogue and peace and nuclear war maniac. The reality proves that so long as the U.S. persists in its sinister scheme and anti-reunification interference, it is impossible to expect smooth development of the inter-Korean ties and achieve the peace and stability of the peninsula. Un Jong Chol

title: Revolutionary Traits of Korean People Living for Tomorrow
body: The Korean people devote themselves to the work for rosy future of the country despite the grim tempest of history. The revolutionary traits of the Korean people living for tomorrow is manifested in the fact that they are staunchly advancing along the road of socialism. They devotedly work at their revolutionary posts to make everything flawless even in the distant future. Now the Korean people vigorously push forward the all-out revolutionary offensive to achieve a fresh victory on all fronts of building a powerful socialist country. They have turned out in the charge for increased production and creation, with the single mind to devote themselves to the future. The hostile forces are now getting evermore vicious in their challenges, but nothing can block the advance of the revolutionary people possessed of the noble view of life to live for tomorrow. All our party members, servicepersons and working people will make uninterrupted innovations and progress to build as early as possible a socialist fairyland, the best powerful and prosperous country where the people enjoy a happy life to the full with nothing to envy in the world. Kim Yong Il

title: DPRK High-level Delegation to Visit S. Korea
body: A high-level delegation of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea led by Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the DPRK Supreme People's Assembly, will soon visit south Korea to attend the opening ceremony of the 23rd Winter Olympics. Rodong News Team

title: Japan Police's Search of Tokyo Metropolitan Headquarters of Chongryon under Fire
body: A combined investigation headquarters of the Metropolitan Police Office and the Saitama Prefectural Police of Japan conducted a search of the Tokyo Metropolitan Headquarters of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) on Feb. 1. That day 100-odd armed policemen and police vehicles including three large buses encircled the Tokyo Metropolitan Headquarters and the combined investigation headquarters carried out an exhaustive search of the headquarters despite the protest of Chongryon officials. What should not be overlooked is the fact that the Japanese authorities are trying to stir up the anti-Chongryon atmosphere, building up public opinion over this case through media. Officials of Chongryon and its affiliated organizations and Tokyo Metropolitan Headquarters, members of the Korean Youth League and other Korean residents in Japan staged a strong protest outside the office of the Tokyo Metropolitan Headquarters, holding slogan boards and placards reading "We denounce the Japanese police authorities' unwarranted oppression of Chongryon". Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Sure to Win in Standoff with U.S.: Benin Bodies
body: The Benin-Korea Amicable Association "Long Live Kim Jong Il, Supreme Leader" and the Benin National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea on Jan. 29 made public a joint statement ahead of the 70th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Army (KPA). The statement said that President Kim Il Sung set the founding of a regular army as an essential requirement of the building of an independent and sovereign state and founded the KPA, the revolutionary regular armed forces, with his outstanding idea of army building and energetic leadership. The accomplishment of the cause of building the regular armed forces enabled the Korean army and people to win in the three-year Fatherland Liberation War and build a powerful socialist country independent in politics, self-supporting in the economy and self-reliant in defence, it added. The statement noted that respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un has further strengthened the KPA into the invincible revolutionary ranks by consolidating its politico-military might in every way. Under his guidance the Korean army and people will defend the country's sovereignty and dignity and surely win in the anti-imperialist and anti-U.S. confrontation struggle, it stressed. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Shining Star to Be Marked by Political Parties and Bodies under CPSU
body: A joint preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il (Day of the Shining Star) was formed by the political parties and bodies under the Communist Party of Soviet Union on Jan. 24. The preparatory committee with Mozgovoy, first secretary of the C.C., Communist Party of Soviet Union and chairman of International Social Federation "for the Union and Union's Communist Party", as its chairman consists of figures of the Communist Party of Kyrgyzstan, the Communist Workers Party of Russia, the Communist Workers' Party of Belarus, Communist Party of Azerbaijan, the Russian Association for Friendship and Cultural Cooperation with the DPRK, and other parties and organizations. It decided to hold political and cultural events in praise of the revolutionary career and feats of Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: Chongryon Headquarters Chairmen Vow to Contribute to National Reunification
body: Chairpersons of the Headquarters of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) issued statements on Jan. 31 in support of the appeal of the joint conference of the DPRK government, political parties and organizations. Jo Il Yon, chairman of the Tokyo Metropolitan Headquarters of Chongryon, said that the Chongryon officials and Koreans in the metropolis would make patriotic efforts to create the climate of national reconciliation and reunification and open a new phase of national reunification under the banner of national independence, By Our Nation Itself. Kim Sang Il, chairman of the Kyoto Headquarters of Chongryon, vowed to resolutely reject the U.S. reckless nuclear war provocation moves against the DPRK and strengthen the unity of compatriots under the unfurled banner of national independence, By Our Nation Itself. Ri Ju Hak, chairman of Fukuoka Prefectural Headquarters of Chongryon, noted that the officials and compatriots would turn out as one in the campaign to frustrate the U.S. war moves against the DPRK and bring about the climate of peace on the Korean Peninsula so as to fulfill their responsibility and role as the driving force of the movement for national reunification. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Blasts Trump
body: A spokesperson for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea gave the following answer to a question put by KCNA on February 4, as regards "State of the Union Address" made by Trump. In the "State of the Union Address", Trump described last year as a year fully recorded with "incredible progress and extraordinary success"- the year during which he pushed the American society and the world into disturbance through his reckless words and deeds as well as aggression moves dumbfounding the world public. This is indeed the height of Trump-style arrogance, arbitrariness and self-conceit. The whole world is deeply concerned, seeing as an omen of new disaster the Address of Trump who asserted "America First" and "unmatched power" based on nuclear weapons while forcing other countries to submit themselves to the U.S. chauvinistic interest. Trump also insisted upon the "maximum pressure" against our country, viciously slandering our most superior people-centered social system. However, it is no less than screams of Trump terrified at the power of the DPRK that has achieved the great historic cause of completing the state nuclear force and rapidly emerged as the strategic state recognized by the world, and it is purely a nasty perversity aimed to disturb the advance of inter-Korean relations. Trump even reveals his sinister intention to do something against us by relying on strength while talking about "American resolve". Our self-reliant defense capability with the nuclear force as its backbone will, however, completely deter Trump and his lackeys from showing off on the Korean peninsula. If Trump does not get rid of his anachronistic and dogmatic way of thinking, it will only bring about the consequence of further endangering security and future of the United States. Rodong News Team

title: Japanese Reactionaries' Suppression of Chongryon Blasted
body: A spokesman of the Committee for Aiding Overseas Compatriots of the DPRK in a statement Tuesday denounced the Japanese reactionaries for getting frantic in their suppression of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon). The joint investigation headquarters, made up of policemen from the Metropolitan Police Office and Saitama Prefecture of Japan, on Feb. 1 hurled more than 100 armed policemen to search the Tokyo Metropolitan Headquarters of Chongryon and the house of a Chongryon official and the Future Foundation set up for rendering support for the Korean school. Earlier on Jan. 31, the Japan police authorities walked off the former chairman of the Katsushika branch of Chongryon on charges of "violation of the law on secondhand dealers". Charging that the banknote of the former Chongryon branch chairman had a record of remitting money to Chongryon organization, they ransacked the Tokyo Metropolitan Headquarters of Chongryon and the house of a Chongryon official who had nothing to do with the remittance. Lurking behind the recent acts hostile toward the DPRK and Chongryon which the Japanese reactionaries committed in broad daylight is a crafty and sordid political attempt peculiar to the island country, the spokesman said, and went on: Clear is the aim sought by Japan through its rare act of swindling which it orchestrated with much effort. That is to charge Chongryon, a dignified overseas citizens' organization of the DPRK, as an "illegal organization" and "lawless body", heighten atmosphere against the DPRK and Chongryon throughout Japan, escalate the tension on the Korean peninsula with it as an occasion and thus pave the way for realizing Japan's dirty militarist ambition. The Japanese authorities' frantic anti-Chongryon and anti-Korean moves will only disclose the despicable and shameless nature of Japan as the tundra of human rights and a political dwarf. If the Japanese authorities do not stop at once such vicious and childish suppression of Chongryon and Koreans in Japan, they will be made to hold full responsibility for the catastrophic consequences to be entailed by such acts. Rodong News Team

title: Symposium on Kimjongilia Held
body: A national symposium on Kimjongilia was held at the Sci-Tech Complex on Feb. 6 on the occasion of the 30th anniversary of the naming of immortal flower Kimjongilia. Present there were Vice-Premier Jon Kwang Ho, Department Director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea Choe Tong Myong, President of the State Academy of Sciences Jang Chol, Chairman of the Korea Kimilsungia-Kimjongilia Committee Kim Chang Do, officials and teachers and researchers in the fields concerned and in the fields of scientific researches. Presented to the symposium were papers which dealt with the biological factors of Kimjongilia, and achievements and experience gained in the scientific researches for the cultivation and dissemination of the flower. The speakers referred to research data on new compound fertilizer made for the growth of Kimjongilia. They noted that they developed vegetable agrochemicals which remove various harmful insects that may occur during the cultivation of the flower and which are safe for both human body and plants. Recounted at the seminar are the research achievements made in the course that the flower was brought into full bloom to be bigger and more beautiful while bringing earlier more than one month the duration of growth after acclimatizing seedlings to outdoor cultivation conditions for the successful holding of the Kimjongilia Festival. Rodong News Team

title: Korean Film Show Given for Celebrating Day of Shining Star
body: A Korean film show was given at the Taedongmun Cinema here on Feb. 6 to celebrate the birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il (Day of the Shining Star). Present there on invitation were diplomatic envoys of various countries and representatives of international organizations and officials of foreign embassies in the DPRK. Kim In Bom, vice-minister of Culture and general director of the General Bureau of Film Arts, officials concerned, and creators and artistes in the field of film arts were on hand. The participants watched a Korean feature film "The Story of a Blooming Flower" showing the warm sincerity and total dedication of a Japanese gardener who bred Kimjongilia, flower of the sun, for decades. Rodong News Team

title: Actions against U.S. Worsening Tension Launched in S. Korea
body: Large scale anti-U.S., anti-war actions were launched all at once in Seoul and other parts of south Korea on Feb. 3, according to the south Korean internet paper Jaju Sibo. The participants in the action held in Seoul charged that Trump is laying hurdles in the way for settlement of the issue of the Korean nation, and called upon all the citizens to stage a massive struggle against the U.S. and war. Meanwhile, the Pusan-Kyonggi Association of the Pan-National Alliance for Korea's Reunification and other organizations in Pusan region held a rally opposing the deployment of U.S. strategic weapons and demanding the closure of its germ weapons laboratory. In Taegu members of organizations and citizens staged a rally and a demo outside the U.S. forces base, holding such slogans as "U.S. troops, go out of south Korea" and "Peace Olympics disturber Trump, shut up". Similar actions were also launched in Kwangju and other parts of south Korea. Rodong News Team

title: Trump Should Be Urgently Sent to Lunatics Asylum
body: In the recent "State of the Union Address", old lunatic Trump said that the DPRK is threatening the U.S. mainland by "reckless nuclear and missile pursuit". Not content with slandering the DPRK over "degeneration" and "oppression", he took issue with the non-existent "human rights". This is the intolerable politically-motivated provocation and tyrannical blackmail of the boss of gangsters and hysteric fit of a lunatic against the DPRK. No matter how desperately Trump may try to defame the dignified and just system in the DPRK with worst invectives, he can not deodorize nasty smell from his dirty body woven with frauds, sexual abuses and all other crimes nor keep the U.S. from rushing to the final destruction. There is a foolish attempt to make pretence for provocation and pave the road for invasion ahead of conducting the military adventure "bloody nose strategy" in the invectives of Trump recalling Bush's reckless remarks of "axis of evil". Dolt-like Trump should know that his backbone would be broken, to say nothing of "bloody nose", and the empire of America would go to the hell and the short history of the U.S. would end forever, the moment he destroys even a single blade of grass on this land. It is the only way for the U.S. and the world concord and peace to urgently detain Trump, who is putting the U.S. and the world in turmoil, in the isolated hospital of psychopaths. Pak Chol Jun

title: U.S. Should Make Switchover in Policy toward DPRK
body: Former U.S. high-ranking officials and experts in international issues have recently asserted that it is impossible to make the DPRK dismantle the nukes and so it is necessary to recognize it as a nuclear weapons state, according to the website for political affairs "The Hill", CNBC and other U.S. media. U.S. financier Soros at a press conference held on the sidelines of an international conference said that the U.S. is causing conflict with the DPRK while seeking a nuclear war against it, adding that theonly way out is to recognize the DPRK as a nuclear weapons state and conclude an agreement to prevent war. Those who took the lead in pursuing the policy toward the DPRK doubt the policy and call for its switchover as the DPRK has access to a powerful and reliable war deterrent, which no force and nothing can reverse, by completing its nuclear forces. It is tragedy that the Trump group persists in the outdated hostile policy towards the DPRK at a time when the result of DPRK-U.S. showdown is made clear. It shows that the U.S. seeks to find a way out in persisting in the outdated hostile policy toward the DPRK and provoking nuclear war. But it is not the way out. If the U.S. persists in the hostile policy toward the DPRK, the former will certainly meet the catastrophic end. The DPRK is the only and one country with tremendous capability, extraordinary readiness and indomitable will to react to any war mode of the U.S. The U.S. would be well advised to make a policy switchover, though belatedly.
