It should properly understand the strategic position of the DPRK as befits the world's military power and nuclear power and the trend of the times and make a bold decision to drop the hostile policy toward the DPRK. This is a good prescription for the U.S. Ri Hyon Do

title: Sinister Intention to Mess Up Inter-Korean Relations
body: Japanese Prime Minister Abe reportedly made up his mind to take part in the opening ceremony of the Winter Olympics. Days ago, Abe said that he would meet the south Korean chief executive to clearly convey his opinion that "the principle of maximum pressure on the north" should not be changed in the least and he is opposed to the humanitarian cooperation as it would send a "wrong message to the north". Meanwhile, he asserted that he would not accept the demand of the south Korean authorities for additional steps related to the "agreement" on the issue of sexual slavery for the Imperial Japanese Army and would strongly demand the removal of the statue of girl sexual slave outside the Japanese embassy in Seoul. Abe is mulling attending the Winter Olympics in a bid to chill the warming climate of inter-Korean dialogue and turn the theatre of Olympics into the ground of confrontation between compatriots, not content with forcing the south Korean authorities to tighten sanctions and pressure against the Democratic People's Republic of Korea in Japan. Abe's participation in the Winter Olympics is pursuant to the scenario of the U.S. to bind the south Korean authorities to the chains for tightening "sanctions against the north" and tri-angular cooperation by using Japan. What is more intolerable is the fact that Abe tries to make his participation in the Winter Olympics a good opportunity for forcing the south Korean authorities to implement the "agreement" on the issue of sexual slavery for the Imperial Japanese Army. The Japanese reactionaries should clearly know that their cynical ploy to behave mischievously by interfering in the issue of inter-Korean relations would add to their thrice-cursed crimes committed against the Korean people and touch off bitterer anti-Japanese sentiment. Ra Sol Ha

title: MOU on Mutual Cooperation Signed between DPRK, Mongolia
body: A memorandum of understanding on mutual cooperation between the State Emergency Disaster Committee of the DPRK and the National Emergency Management Agency of Mongolia was signed at the People's Palace of Culture on Feb. 5. It was endorsed by Kang Il Sop, chairman of the State Emergency Disaster Committee of the DPRK, and T. Badral, chief of the National Emergency Management Agency of Mongolia. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Art Troupe Leaves
body: An art troupe of the DPRK led by Kwon Hyok Bong, department director of the Ministry of Culture, and Hyon Song Wol, head of the Samjiyon Orchestra, left here on Feb. 5 to give congratulatory performance for the 23rd Winter Olympics due in south Korea. The art troupe will go to Wonsan by train and then visit south Korea aboard the ship "Mangyongbong-92". Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's Speech at Military Parade
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and supreme commander of the Korean People's Army (KPA), made a congratulatory speech at the military parade held in celebration of the 70th founding anniversary of the KPA. The following is the full text of the speech: Officers and men of the heroic Korean People's Army, Commanders and combatants of the units participating in the parade to be held in celebration of the 70th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Army, Dear Pyongyang citizens and other people across the country, Today, marking the 70th anniversary of the founding of the Korean People's Army, revolutionary regular armed forces, by the great leader Comrade Kim Il Sung, we are holding a grand parade of the combat units of the Korean People's Army. The first parade of the regular armed forces held 70 years ago in the square in front of the Pyongyang Railway Station demonstrated the proud image of the newly-emergent Korea, and today's military parade will demonstrate the mettle of the powerful Democratic People's Republic of Korea which has developed into a world-class military power. Availing myself of this opportunity when we are looking back with deep emotion on the proud militant course of history of the heroic Korean People's Army, and reflecting the great emotion overflowing in the hearts of all our service personnel and people, I would like to extend noblest respect and infinite glory to the great Comrades Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il, who founded and built up the Juche-oriented revolutionary armed forces. I also would like to extend noble respect to the fighters of the anti-Japanese revolution and soldiers of the People's Army who fought with revolutionary arms in their hands, dedicating their youth and even lives without hesitation to the reunification and sovereignty of their country, to the liberation of their fellow people and to socialist construction, and greeting the army founding day, I offer my warm congratulations and militant salute to the war veterans, discharged soldiers and all the officers and men of the army. My heartfelt thanks go to the working class, agricultural working people and other people across the country, who readily placed their sons and daughters, whom they had brought up with great care, at the posts of national defence, and have provided on a top priority basis, even in the face of difficulties and trials, everything needed for increasing the combat capabilities of the army. Comrades, Together with April 25, when Comrade Kim Il Sung founded the Korean People's Revolutionary Army, February 8, when he founded the Korean People's Army, revolutionary regular armed forces, is a day of historic significance in building up the revolutionary armed forces and accomplishing the revolutionary cause of Juche. Our people, who had to experience the miserable fate of a ruined nation for lack of an army worth mentioning, ardently desired for a powerful army of their own. This centuries-old desire of our people was achieved 70 years ago this February 8 under the wise leadership of the great Comrade Kim Il Sung. After the country's liberation the great Comrade Kim Il Sung set the founding of a powerful regular army as a prerequisite for developing the country into an independent and sovereign state. He stepped up the cause of army building by dint of his outstanding ideas and energetic leadership, thereby founding the Korean People's Army, the revolutionary regular armed forces of the Juche type, in a matter of less than three years. The Korean People's Army is, both in name and in reality, a revolutionary army that inherited the traditions of the anti-Japanese struggle–the indomitable revolutionary spirit of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army and its rich fighting experience and adroit art of warfare. Thanks to the birth of this Juche-oriented regular army our Republic, from the very beginning after its founding, enjoyed the prestige of being a dignified people's country with its own strong armed forces; it defeated the imperialist aggressor forces that had been boasting of being the "mightiest" in the world and achieved a great victory in the Fatherland Liberation War. April 25, 1932, the day when our revolutionary armed forces began to take historical roots, was fundamental to vanquishing the brigandish Japanese imperialists and realizing the sacred cause of national liberation; February 8, 1948, the birthday of our regular armed forces that inherited the traditions of the anti-Japanese struggle, was crucial to the great victory of the Fatherland Liberation War and the successful advance of our socialist cause. The whole course of historic development of the Korean People's Army has been accompanied by constant tension and intense confrontation in the world's largest powder-keg and hottest spot which is pregnant with the danger of outbreak of a war. Being faithful to its mission of defending the country, the revolution and the people, our army has smashed the enemy's adventurous provocations at every step, upholding the military line of self-reliant defence and the banner of "a-match-for-a-hundred." In the course of this, it has been developed into an invincible combat force capable of defeating any enemy, however formidable, at a stroke. In the grimmest and most difficult period when it had to fight against the allied imperialist forces of the world single-handed, with no flanks and with no support from outside, our People's Army performed remarkable exploits by waging a heroic, do-or-die struggle in the first line of the revolution under the leadership of the great Comrade Kim Jong Il. As this elite revolutionary army played the role of the standard-bearer and solid cornerstone for defending socialism and the revolution at the forefront of the anti-imperialist military front and the construction of a prosperous country, our Republic has won one brilliant victory after another in the battle to safeguard socialism and gained the high reputation of a world-class military power. In world history cannot be found any other nation that accomplished the great cause of army building from scratch by relying on its internal forces and built an elite army in spite of the protracted, worst-ever challenges and blockade; such brilliant exploit of building a powerful army for the sake of national prosperity is a miracle that can be wrought only by the great Comrades Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il, the peerless patriots and iron-willed commanders. Officers and men of the People's Army, The Korean People's Army, which made its first fine appearance through a magnificent parade 70 years previously, has become what it is today, hoisting the flag of victory in the fierce battle fields in defence of the country and people. Our army, which has grown up into a world-class powerful army, is a stout pillar in preventing the catastrophe of war and defending peace on the Korean peninsula and in the region and a force that makes breakthroughs in the vanguard of the grand march of our people towards final victory for the socialist cause. Now our people regard as their great pride our brave People's Army which is struggling with the spirit and stamina of Paektu, and are gaining fresh strength and courage from the militant might of our army which is growing stronger day by day. The People's Army has won the sincere affection and trust of the people at the cost of blood, sweat and death-defying devotion, achieved oneness with them enjoying their enthusiastic support and assistance, and performed feats on the fronts for defending the country and building socialism. It is a source of pride for our Party and state and a great fortune of our people that they have such a dignified and powerful revolutionary army, an army of the people. I deem it the highest honour to have assumed the heavy responsibility of supreme command of the courageous revolutionary army. On behalf of the Workers' Party of Korea, the government of the Republic and all the people, I once again warmly congratulate all the officers and men on the occasion of the 70th founding anniversary of the heroic Korean People's Army, and extend militant greetings to them. Combatants of the units participating in this parade and all the other officers and men of the People's Army, As the Party and the country have high expectations of it and the people are sincere in their affection for it, the People's Army must defend the country and the people reliably through faithful service and devoted struggle as befits the army of the Party and people. The People's Army should increase its political and military capabilities to the maximum as suited to the status of our dignified state to meet the demands of the times and the developing revolution, and firmly guarantee by force of arms the struggle of our Party and people to accomplish the socialist cause. The central task facing the People's Army at present is to perfect its combat capabilities as befitting a revolutionary army by holding aloft the banner of modelling the entire army on Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism and implementing to the letter the strategic lines and tasks for increasing the military strength put forward by the Party. The People's Army should be boundlessly loyal to the leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea. The Korean People's Army is the army of our Party which was born and built up in the embrace of the Party; the source of its mightiness lies in the Party's revolutionary ideas and leadership. It should become the first death-defying corps, the first guards unit, sharing its destiny with the Workers' Party of Korea and defending its Central Committee with arms. It should firmly establish the unified leadership system of the Party within itself, create a revolutionary military climate in which all its service personnel move as one under the command of the Party, and organize and conduct all types of military work on the basis of the Party's lines and policies. It should maintain strengthening itself politically and ideologically and making itself morally sound as its two major tasks, and concentrate all its efforts on preparing itself as an army that is strong in ideology and faith like the 7th Regiment during the anti-Japanese war and the Guards units during the Fatherland Liberation War. It should raise more fiercely the flames of the revolution in training to improve its capability of fighting a war. Training is precisely the way to defending the socialist country and the people, and the short-cut to turning the People's Army into a powerful army is to make the most exacting demand upon its soldiers under training. It should steadily improve the content, style and method of training in line with the Party's ideas on military strategy and tactics, with the demands of the Juche-oriented tactics and with the demands and features of modern warfare, and should not stop even a day practical training in a virtual combat environment. In the present situation, in which the United States and its vassal forces are making a fuss around the Korean peninsula, the People's Army should remain on full alert and give a spur to perfecting its combat preparedness. Thus we must prevent any aggressive forces from violating or offending the dignity and sovereignty of our sacred country in the slightest. Units of all services, arms and corps must intensify training aimed at having a command of their military hardware and improving their specialist levels, so as to make full preparations for waging hi-tech warfare in any operational space. In particular, the People's Army must present building itself up into an army, which is excellent in all aspects, as an important strategic task in line with the requirements of the new, higher stage of turning the entire army into an army of cadres and modernizing it, and give top priority to its implementation. The People's Army must establish rigid ethos and assume the appearance of a perfect regular army. All the service personnel, from privates to generals, should be well versed in military regulations and manuals, and make it part of their habit to abide by them, thus ensuring that all units, sub-units and other places where there are soldiers always present regularized features. All the officers and men of the army, always bearing in mind that the People's Army cannot exist even a moment separated from the people, must boundlessly respect and love them, and constantly sustain the fine traits of the revolutionary army, whose soldiers defy death if it is for the sake of the people. The People's Army must not weigh the importance of undertakings intended for the people, but regard it as a revolutionary military climate to devote all its sincerity with the most honest attitude. Holding higher the patriotic, revolutionary slogan "Let us take upon ourselves both national defence and socialist construction," it should give free rein to its unexcelled heroism in all places for translating the people's dreams and ideals into reality by displaying fortitude and creativity, not knowing the word impossible, and continuously take the lead in the struggle for transforming the country into a more beautiful land. Comrades, As long as imperialism exists on the globe and the United States persists in following its hostile policy against our country, the mission of the People's Army, as a powerful sword for defending the country, people and peace, can never be changed. Final victory belongs to our Party and people with a firm grip on the arms of the revolution. Our Party and people are fully convinced that the Korean People's Army, which has provided a military guarantee for the revolutionary cause of Juche, will continue to reliably defend the Party and the revolution, the country and the people, and increase its strength in every way possible to safeguard justice and peace. As long as we have the Korean People's Army that is unfailingly loyal to the leadership of the Workers’ Party of Korea, our glorious motherland–the Democratic People's Republic of Korea–will grow more powerful and more prosperous. All the service personnel of the People's Army, The flag of the ever-victorious Workers' Party of Korea will always lead the way ahead of you, giving you a great encouragement and rousing you to fresh struggle and victory. Let us fight bravely for the Party and the revolution, the country and the people.

title: Military Parade Marks 70th Founding Anniversary of KPA
body: A grand military parade for celebrating the 70th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Army was held at Kim Il Sung Square in Pyongyang on Feb. 8. Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and supreme commander of the Korean People's Army, arrived at the square together with Ri Sol Ju. A ceremony of the guard of honor of the KPA three services took place to greet respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. When he appeared at the platform of the square together with Ri Sol Ju, all members of the parade burst into cheers of "Hurrah!" looking up to him, and chanted slogans "Kim Jong Un" and "Devoted Defence". The Supreme Leader waved back to the participants in the parade and the crowds. Taking the platform were KPA Vice Marshal Kim Jong Gak, director of the KPA General Political Bureau, KPA Vice Marshal Ri Myong Su, chief of the KPA General Staff, Army General Pak Yong Sik, minister of the People's Armed Forces, and other commanding officers of the General Political Bureau and the General Staff of the KPA and the Ministry of the People's Armed Forces and commanders of large combined units. The box of the platform was taken by Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the DPRK Supreme People's Assembly, Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, and Premier Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK and vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK. It was also occupied by leading officials of the party and government. Taking the tribune of honor were officials of the party, armed forces and power organs, working people's organizations, ministries and national institutions, officers and men of the Korean People's Army and the Korean People's Internal Security Forces, teachers and students of Mangyongdae Revolutionary School and Kang Pan Sok Revolutionary School and officials of industrial establishments and persons of merits in Pyongyang. Present there on invitation were overseas compatriots and diplomatic envoys and their spouses, military attaches and their spouses here and other foreigners. The guard of honor of the three services and the combined military band of the KPA began the opening ceremony. The flags of the DPRK and the WPK were hoisted. The commanding officer of the military parade reported the minister of the People's Armed Forces of the DPRK that the military parade units have lined up to get inspection for parade celebrating the 70th birthday of the KPA. The minister of the People's Armed Forces inspected the parade units, congratulating them on Feb. 8 holiday. Then he reported Marshal of the DPRK Kim Jong Un that the military parade would begin. A signal trumpet for the start of the military parade was sounded and a 21-gun salute boomed. Kim Jong Un made a congratulatory speech. Cars carrying the flags bearing the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il entered the square, being escorted by generals and officers of the KPA. The guard of honor of the three services of the KPA and all the members of the military parade paid high tribute, looking up to the flags bearing the portraits of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il. Then the military parade began. Columns symbolic of the period of building the regular armed forces took the lead. Then led by a car with the commanding officer of the parade aboard, columns of the three services, corps-level units, arms, specialists and army surgeons marched past the square. Fighters in the formation of number "70" flew past the sky above the square, letting off fireworks. The columns of mechanized units, strategic forces units, Hwasong artillery men marched past the square in fine array. Fighters left a trail of the shape of a five-color fan to specially decorate the end of the parade. When the parade ended, thunderous cheers of "Hurrah!" reverberated far and wide, fireworks were displayed and balloons were let loose. Kim Jong Un stepped to the balcony of the platform and acknowledged the enthusiastically cheering crowds. The military parade for celebrating the 70th anniversary of the KPA demonstrated the faith and will of the Korean army and people to further consolidate the DPRK as the invincible fortress of socialism and bring earlier the final victory of the Juche revolution. Political News Team

title: Floral Basket to Kim Jong Un from Nigerian President
body: Respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a floral basket from Muhammadu Buhari, president of the Federal Republic of Nigeria, on the occasion of the 70th birthday of the Korean People's Army. The charge d'affaires ad interim of the Nigerian embassy here conveyed the floral basket to an official concerned on Feb. 7. Rodong News Team

title: Floral Basket and Congratulatory Letter to Kim Jong Un from Military Attaches Corps
body: Respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a basket of flowers and a congratulatory letter from the military attaches corps here ahead of the 70th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Army. The basket and letter were conveyed to Army General Pak Yong Sik, minister of the People's Armed Forces, by Russian Military Attache Alexei Bartusov, doyen of the corps, on Feb. 7. Rodong News Team

title: Congratulations to Cyprus President
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the DPRK Supreme People's Assembly who is Presidium member of the Political Bureau of the Workers' Party of Korea Central Committee, on Feb. 6 sent a congratulatory message to Nicos Anastasiades on his reelection as president of the Republic of Cyprus. Kim in the message wished the Cyprus president greater success in his responsible work for the prosperity of the country and wellbeing of its people, expressing belief that the relations between the two countries would develop on good terms in their common interests. Rodong News Team

title: Performance of UAWK Art Squad
body: The art squad of the Central Committee of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea gave a performance at the Samjigang Co-op Farm in Jaeryong County of South Hwanghae Province on Feb. 6 in celebration of the 70th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Army (KPA). Put on the stage of the performance which started with chorus "Long Live Generalissimo Kim Il Sung" and "Song of the Korean People's Army" were colorful numbers such as female duet "General's Way to Front" and male quartet "A Soldier Hears Rice Ears Sway". The performers sang high praises of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il who set a brilliant example in the building of revolutionary armed forces in the era of independence with their unique military idea and outstanding commanding art and made an ever-victorious history of the heroic KPA. Serial songs "Cheers of the People" and "The Best Bosom" mesmerized the audience with deep reverence for respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un who turned the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, the greatest patriotic legacy of the great leaders, into a dignified nuclear power of Juche and world military power. They showed well the ardent patriotic will of the agricultural workers to keep the first line trench of the first echelon in defending socialism through mixed duet "Arirang of Army-People Unity", jugglery, comic story and other numbers. Rodong News Team

title: Performance of Women's Union Art Squad
body: The art squad of the Central Committee of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea on Feb. 6 gave a performance at the Hall of Women in celebration of the 70th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Army. The numbers of the performance included chorus "Long Live Generalissimo Kim Il Sung" and "Song of the Korean People's Army". The performers sang loudly of the exploits of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il who set a brilliant example in building the regular armed forces of Juche and developed the KPA into the matchless revolutionary armed forces. They represented the Korean women's will to actively assist the servicepersons like their own flesh and blood and bring up their children ideologically, morally and physically for military service and thus contribute to consolidating the defence capabilities of the country. They also showed the enthusiasm of all the women to staunchly advance along the road of the revolution following the Party in single mind with the pride of being citizens of socialist Korea which is demonstrating its tremendous strength under the line of simultaneously developing the two fronts. Rodong News Team

title: Poster for 22nd Kimjongilia Festival Produced
body: A poster for the 22nd Kimjongilia Festival to be held on the occasion of the birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il was produced. Depicted on its centre is immortal Kimjongilia in full bloom with grandiose sublime appearance of Jong Il Peak as background. On its upper part are slogan reading "The great leader Comrade Kim Jong Il will always be with us" and letters "The Day of the Shining Star" with the festival logo. On its lower part are letters "The 22nd Kimjongilia Festival", festival venue and period. Rodong News Team

title: Zimbabwean Military Delegation Visits Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: A military delegation of the Republic of Zimbabwe led by Moyo Elson, commander of the Air Force of the Zimbabwe National Army, on Feb. 7 visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun to pay tribute to President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il. Members of the delegation paid high tribute to the peerlessly great men before their statues. They paid homage to Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il who lie in state. They went round the halls where the orders the great leaders received are on display and the halls that house cars, electric car, boat and train coaches used by them for their field guidance and foreign tours till the last moments of their lives. Rodong News Team

title: Zimbabwean Military Delegation Visits Mangyongdae
body: A military delegation of the Republic of Zimbabwe headed by Moyo Elson, commander of the Air Force of Zimbabwe, visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. Being briefed on the revolutionary history of Kim Il Sung, the guests looked round the historical mementoes preserved at his old home. The delegation also toured Mangyongdae Revolutionary School, the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum, the Sci-Tech Complex, etc. Rodong News Team

title: Pak Yong Sik Meets Zimbabwean Military Delegation
body: Army General Pak Yong Sik, minister of the People's Armed Forces, on Feb. 9 met and had a talk with a military delegation of the Republic of Zimbabwe led by Moyo Elson, commander of the Air Force of Zimbabwe, which paid a courtesy call on him. Rodong News Team

title: National Photo Exhibition Opens
body: A national photo exhibition titled "The peerless Songun brilliant commander" was opened with due ceremony at the People's Palace of Culture on Feb. 9 to celebrate the 76th birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il. On display at the exhibition are photos dealing with the revolutionary activities of Kim Jong Il who provided a solid military foundation for the country's prosperity and people's happiness. There are also photos documenting the greatness of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un who made sure that the revolutionary lives of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il shine forever by opening a fresh page in accomplishing the cause of immortalizing the great leaders. Seen in the exhibition are photos showing the firm faith and will of the army and people to translate the patriotic desire of Kim Jong Il for a powerful nation into reality and the majestic feature of the revolutionary elite army firmly defending the security of the country and nation. Attending the ceremony were Pak Kwang Ho, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Jon Kwang Ho, vice-premier of the Cabinet, officials concerned and working people in the city. Rodong News Team

title: Youth League Officials Tour Samjiyon Revolutionary Battle Site
body: The expedition of youth league officials from across the country to leader Kim Jong Il's birthplace in the Paektusan Secret Camp went round the Samjiyon Revolutionary Battle Site and the Paektusan Hero Youth Power Station No. 1. The expedition arrived at the battle site on Feb. 6. Its members visited the Samjiyon Grand Monument to place a floral basket and bunches of flowers at the statue of President Kim Il Sung and pay tribute to him. Being briefed on the fact that the site was built into an excellent center for education in the revolutionary traditions, they looked round the grand monument. In front of the statue of leader Kim Jong Il in Samjiyon County, they vowed to build an invincible powerful socialist country true to the patriotic desire of the great leaders for a powerful and prosperous country. They also went round Samthogong log cabin, where Kim Jong Il stayed overnight together with the expedition members in June Juche 45 (1956) when he paved the way for the study tour of the revolutionary battle sites in the area of Mt Paektu. They toured other places of Samjiyon County Town. And they worked together with shock brigade members participating in the project to spruce up Samjiyon County and handed them aid supplies. On February 8 they visited the Paektusan Hero Youth Power Station No. 1. Rodong News Team

title: Week of Film Show Opens
body: A week of film show opened with due ceremony at the People's Palace of Culture on Feb. 9 to mark the Day of the Shining Star, the birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il. Such documentary films as "Shining Star of Paektu" and "Shine, Jong Il Peak" dealing with the revolutionary life of Kim Jong Il will be shown at cinemas and halls of culture in Pyongyang and local areas. Also screened will be feature films showing the ideological and moral qualities of the Korean army and people and their struggle. Present at the ceremony were officials concerned, creators and artistes in the field of film art and working people in Pyongyang. At end of the ceremony, the participants watched "Life of Love for People", Part 1 of the documentary film "General Kim Jong Il, Peerless Patriot". Week of film show opened in provinces, too, on the same day. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korean Body Stages Anti-Trump, Anti-U.S. Action
body: A rally denouncing Trump's war rhetoric and demanding a stop to DPRK-targeted nuclear war exercises was held outside the U.S. embassy in Seoul on Feb. 5 by the Anti-Trump and Anti-U.S. Action Headquarters in south Korea, according to the south Korean internet newspaper Minjok Ilbo. The speakers disclosed that Trump made a declaration of a war while faulting the "human rights" in the north. They flailed the U.S. vice-president for making such senseless words that he would go to south Korea to check the peaceful opening of the Winter Olympics. They denounced the U.S. for committing bellicose acts while introducing nuclear carriers and bombers into the area around the Korean peninsula, timed to coincide with the opening of the Olympics. A statement titled "War lunatic Trump, stop at once war rubbish and provocation of a nuclear war against north!" was released at the rally. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Art Troupe Gives Congratulatory Performance in Kangrung of S. Korea
body: The art troupe of the DPRK on Feb. 8 began a congratulatory performance in Kangrung of south Korea ahead of the opening of the 23rd Winter Olympics. The venue of the performance was crowded with many people from across south Korea to enjoy the congratulatory performance. The performance were enjoyed by Jo Myong Gyun, minister of Unification, Chu Mi Ae, representative of the Minju Party, Choe Mun Sun, governor of south Kangwon Province, and other personages of the south side and south Koreans. Among the audience were Kwon Hyok Bong, Hyon Song Wol and other leading members of the art troupe of the DPRK. Put on the stage of the performance, which began with overture "Glad to See You" and "Fall, White Snow," were colorful numbers such as light music "My Country Is Best" and string ensemble and female solo "Morning Star". The performers well represented through their rich voice and skilled rendition the musical emotion of the resourceful and intelligent Korean nation with the history of 5 000 years and brilliant culture. The DPRK artistes well portrayed world famous songs including "Arirang" from orchestra "Dear Melodies". They also put on the stage south Korean songs. The audience broke into cheers and loud applause whenever numbers changed as they were mesmerized by the peculiar arts spiced with strong national flavor. The performers concluded with female trio "Mts. Paektu and Halla Are Part of My Motherland" and finale "Our Wish Is Reunification" and "See You Again" reflecting the will of all Koreans to put an end to the tragedy of national division as soon as possible and bring earlier the national reunification by their concerted efforts. The performance was enthusiastically applauded by the audience. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Players Team Enters Players Village for Winter Olympics
body: The DPRK players team which will take part in the 23rd Winter Olympics entered Kangrung players village of south Korea with due ceremony on Feb. 8. Present at the ceremony were members of the players team and the cheering group of the DPRK and those concerned organizing the Olympics. The flag of the DPRK was hoisted amid the solemn playing of the Patriotic Song, its national anthem. Lilting female band music and spirited rhythmic movements by the DPRK's cheering group revved up the atmosphere of the ceremony. Rodong News Team

title: Music and Dance Performance Given to Celebrate KPA Birthday
body: The State Merited Chorus, the Moranbong Band and the Wangjaesan Art Troup gave a music and dance performance here on Feb. 8 in celebration of the 70th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Army. Among the audience were teachers and students of military academies at all levels, Mangyongdae Revolutionary School and Kang Pan Sok Revolutionary School, persons of merits in army-assisting, labor innovators and other working people, youth and students in Pyongyang. The performers impressively represented the proud 70-year-long history of the Korean revolutionary armed forces. The performers sang high praises of the army-building exploits of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il who founded the KPA, the revolutionary regular armed forces of Juche type, and strengthened it into an invincible revolutionary army, thus providing sure military guarantee for prosperity of socialist Korea. Rodong News Team

title: Stamp Exhibition Opens
body: A collection of Korean stamps was displayed at the Korean Stamps Museum and the Korean Stamp Exhibition House on Feb. 10 on the occasions of the 76th birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il and the 30th anniversary of naming of immortal flower Kimjongilia. On display at the exhibition halls are photos reflecting stamps bearing the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il. Hundreds of kinds of stamps under the themes of "Sun of Mankind" and "Sunny Smile" comprehensively deal with the revolutionary career of Kim Jong Il who rose up as the bright star over Mt Paektu and provided a solid foundation for accomplishing the human cause of independence, the socialist cause. There are stamps portraying immortal flower Kimjongilia and gift plants. Some stamps deal with the stirring reality of the country in which a great heyday of prosperity is opened up and all the wishes of the people come true under the guidance of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. The exhibition will last until Feb. 18. Rodong News Team

title: Nepalese Political Party Delegation Arrives
body: A delegation of the United Socialist Nationalist Party of Nepal headed by Chairman of its Central Committee Kamal Prasad Chaulagain arrived in Pyongyang on Feb. 10 on the occasion of the Day of the Shining Star. Rodong News Team

title: Despicable Act of Abusing Sacred Olympics for Confrontation Plot
body: Pence, who is visiting south Korea to attend the opening ceremony of the Winter Olympics, is rebuffed and blasted at home and abroad for his anti-DPRK confrontation hysteria unfit for the atmosphere of the Olympics. Pence let out a torrent of abuse pointing an accusing finger at the others' event, instead of just sitting to watch it as a guest. His behavior is nothing but an ugly sight being reminded of crazy Trump. We never sent the high-level delegation to south Korea in order to create the possibility of a dialogue with Americans by meeting them who are not worth human beings. We do not do such mean and nasty things like the U.S. abusing such sports festival as Olympics for a political purpose. We are ready for a variety of plans to cope with any attempts of the U.S., such as military strike, sanctions and pressure and confrontational racket. Pence must know that his frantic acts of abusing the sacred Olympics for confrontational ruckus are as foolish and stupid an act as sweeping the sea with a broom. As exemplified by the Winter Olympics that opened with splendor by the concerted efforts of the north and the south, the whole Korean nation's ardent aspirations and wishes for concord, unity and reunification can't be dampened with anything. If Pence wants to avoid experiencing a hot agony of shame on the stage of the Olympics, he had better stop behaving imprudently and clearly learn about how ardently the compatriots of the north and the south of Korea wish to reunify the country by their concerted efforts and quietly disappear. Kim Chol Myong

title: Zimbabwean Military Delegation Leaves
body: A military delegation of the Republic of Zimbabwe headed by Moyo Elson, commander of the Air Force of Zimbabwe, left for home Feb. 10 after visiting the DPRK on the occasion of the 70th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Army. Rodong News Team

title: Serbian Lawmaker Returns Home
body: Miroslav Lazanski, a lawmaker from the Serbian Progressive Party, left Pyongyang for home Feb. 10. Rodong News Team

title: More Truth behind Kwangju Massacre Disclosed
body: More information about the barbaric massacre of the participants in the Kwangju Popular Uprising by the Chun Doo Hwan military fascist clique was reportedly revealed in south Korea. The May 18 Special Investigation Committee collected and analyzed data of 620 000 pages and carried out survey among 190 military units and 120 military persons, who had been concerned with the case at that time, for five months to find out that Chun Doo Hwan ordered several times from May 21, 1980 to strafe the uprisers and citizens from gunships. Accordingly, more than 40 helicopters mobilized for putting down the uprising strafed Kwangju citizens on May 21 and 27. Information also proved that bombers and fighters were on standby with live bullets aboard to bomb Kwangju City. It was confirmed that the crackdown on Kwangju uprisers was directly conducted by Chun and the three services of south Korea were mobilized for it. Rodong News Team

title: U.S. "2018 Nuclear Posture Review" Blasted
body: A spokesman for the Korea Asia-Pacific Peace Committee in a statement on Feb. 10 said that the U.S. has come under fire worldwide for its "2018 Nuclear Posture Review" (NPR) as it poses a serious threat to the peace of the Korean Peninsula and the world and deals with an extremely dangerous nuclear attempt which will result in a new cold war. The statement said: The NPR stipulates that since the DPRK as well as China, Russia and Iran pose a "serious threat" to the U.S. and its allies, the U.S. will start updating the strategic nuclear weapons and developing the "low intensity smaller nuclear weapons" to cope with the "threat" and that it will use nukes to counter the non-nuclear weapons attack on the U.S. and its allies as well as nuclear attack on them. In particular, describing the DPRK's self-defensive nuclear deterrent as a "threat" to the world peace, the U.S. virtually legalized the updating of nukes and the preemptive nuclear strike at the DPRK. The U.S. let out a stream of provocative outbursts that it would never pardon the DPRK's nuclear attack on the U.S. and its allied nations, the DPRK would never exist after using nukes and any attack by the latter would lead to the "end of the regime". It indicates that the reckless nuclear hysteria of the Trump group has reached an extreme phase as it has been hell-bent on stifling the DPRK by force of arms by misrepresenting its just access to nuclear weapons to cope with the nuclear threat of aggression from the U.S. This is another intolerable provocation to the DPRK. The NPR is a war declaration of the rogue state as it is a criminal war document making the preemptive nuclear strike at the DPRK a fait accompli and means to dare make a preemptive nuclear strike at the world including the Korean Peninsula and unleash a nuclear war. The gangster-like U.S. is pulling up the DPRK over "nuclear threat" and "denuclearization" while threatening to use nukes as conventional weapons though it has possessed the largest number of nukes in the world. It is the height of impudence and action that a guilty party files the suit first. The reality eloquently shows it was a wise option that the DPRK accomplished the historic great cause of completing its state nuclear forces true to the line of simultaneously developing the two fronts to cope with the increasing nuclear threat from the U.S. The U.S. would be well advised not to run amuck, well aware that it will meet its miserable doom while recklessly brandishing its nuclear stick of tyranny, obsessed with the anachronistic design for world hegemony. Rodong News Team

title: 23rd Winter Olympics Opens
body: The 23rd Winter Olympics opened in Phyongchang of south Korea. Its opening ceremony was held at Phyongchang Olympic Stadium on Feb. 9. Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly who is heading a high-level delegation of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, and Kim Yo Jong, first vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, took the platform of the opening ceremony. Present there were members of the high-level delegation of the DPRK and its National Olympic Committee delegation, art troupe and cheering group and a cheering group of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan. Attending it were President Moon Jae In and personages of political and social circles of south Korea, President of the International Olympic Committee Thomas Bach, heads of state and government of different countries, foreign guests and sports fans. The players participating in the 23rd Winter Olympics from across the world entered the stadium. Spectators broke into cheers and applause as players of the north and the south of Korea entered the stadium, led by the flag of the Korean Peninsula amid the playing of the song "Arirang." Kim Yong Nam, Kim Yo Jong and President Moon Jae In and his wife all stood up to wave to the players of the north and the south. The participants in the opening ceremony warmly encouraged the players of the north and the south who were marching together, holding the flag of the Korean peninsula bearing the Korean map. The chairman of the Olympic Organizing Committee and the IOC president made congratulatory speeches before President Moon Jae In declared the Winter Olympics open. The Olympic flag was hoisted amid the playing of the song of Olympics and the Olympics oath was made. There took place a ceremony of lighting the cauldron of the Olympics. Prior to the ceremony, Taekwon-Do players from the north and the south of Korea gave a demonstration performance. That day Kim Yo Jong, first vice department director of the Central Committee of the WPK, exchanged warm greetings with President Moon Jae In and his wife, shaking hands with them. The 23rd Winter Olympics will close on Feb. 25. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Yong Nam Meets Moon Jae In
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, who is heading a high-level delegation of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on Feb. 9 attended the pre-opening ceremony reception held before the 23rd Winter Olympics and met with Moon Jae In, president of south Korea. Kim Yong Nam exchanged warm greetings with Moon Jae In and had a photo session with him. Kim Yong Nam also exchanged greetings with heads of state and government of different countries who came to attend the opening ceremony of the Olympics at the said reception. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Iranian President
body: Kim Yong Nam, Presidium member of the Political Bureau of the Workers' Party of Korea Central Committee and president of the Presidium of the DPRK Supreme People's Assembly on Feb. 11 sent a message of greeting to Hassan Rouhani, president of the Islamic Republic of Iran, on the occasion of the 39th anniversary of the victory of the Islamic revolution of Iran. The message noted that after the victory in the revolution the Iranian people have achieved a lot of successes in the struggle to defend the gains of revolution and build a powerful state while repelling the ceaseless pressure and interference by the hostile forces. The message expressed the belief that the good ties of friendship and cooperation between the DPRK and Iran would grow stronger, wishing the Iranian president bigger success in his work for the country's development and stability and the people's wellbeing. Rodong News Team

title: New Stamp Issued in DPRK
body: The State Stamp Bureau of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea issued a stamp (one sheet) to commemorate the 30th anniversary of naming of Kimjongilia. Immortal flower Kimjongilia is depicted in the oval sheet. Seen on the upper part of the sheet are letters "30th anniversary of naming of immortal flower Kimjongilia" and "Juche 77 (1988)-Juche 107 (2018)". Rodong News Team

title: Japan Should Relinquish Ambition for Overseas Expansion
body: The Japanese authorities recently made a survey of evacuation places including the underground parking lots near Olympic stadium under the pretence of making preparations for rapid evacuation of Japanese tourists in case the DPRK's "missile attack" aiming at the Winter Olympics is made. Joining in it, the House of Representatives of Japan worked out a plan for emergency evacuation of more than 460 dietmen out of meeting place to cope with "missile" fired by the DPRK. These are hysteric fits of the wicked Japs trying to re-kindle a charcoal burning out to make a fire for coiling up the tension on the Korean Peninsula. The Japanese reactionaries' rubbish about "missile attack" aiming at the Olympics is nothing but invective of political imbeciles hell-bent on confrontation with the DPRK, shameless outbursts which make even Don Quixote blush and sophism making profound confusion of right and wrong. The arch criminals for creating a state of emergency for escalating tension on the peninsula are the U.S. which vociferates the "maximum pressure" and military option day and night and the Japanese reactionaries who are crazy for overseas expansion while dancing to the tune of their master. The world clearly sees who is a real harasser of peace going frantic across the Korean Straits, holding daggers of confrontation in mouths, not content with spraying ashes at the other's event to disturb stability on the peninsula. Their imprudent ambition would invite an irretrievable disaster to the island country. Ri Hyo Jin

title: DPRK High-level Delegation Arrives
body: The high-level delegation of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea led by Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the DPRK Supreme People's Assembly, which attended the opening ceremony of the 23rd Winter Olympics arrived in Pyongyang on Feb. 11. "Chammae-2", a personal jet of the DPRK government flying corps, carrying the delegation aboard, took off Inchon International Airport around 21:55 and landed at Pyongyang International Airport around 22:40. Kim Yong Nam reviewed the guard of honor of the KPA services after receiving a salute from its first deputy chief. Accompanying him were Kim Yo Jong, first vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Choe Hwi, chairman of the National Sports Guidance Committee, Ri Son Gwon, chairman of the Committee for the Peaceful Reunification of the Country, and other suite members. The delegation was greeted by senior party and government officials Kim Yong Chol, Yang Hyong Sop, Ri Su Yong and Ri Yong Ho and leading officials of armed forces organs Pak Yong Sik and Choe Pu Il. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Delegation with S. Korean President Enjoys Performance of DPRK Art Troupe
body: The high-level delegation of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea led by Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the DPRK Supreme People's Assembly, together with south Korean President Moon Jae In and his wife enjoyed a congratulatory performance of the art troupe of the DPRK in Seoul on Feb. 11. Among the audience were members of the DPRK high-level delegation including Kim Yo Jong, first vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and leading members of the art troupe and Jo Myong Gyun, minister of Unification, To Jong Hwan, minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism, Pak Won Sun, mayor of Seoul City, and other personages and masses of the south side and foreign diplomatic envoys in Seoul. The DPRK art troupe led by Kwon Hyok Bong, department director of the Ministry of Culture, and Hyon Song Wol, head of the Samjiyon Orchestra, gave its performance again in Seoul in the wake of a congratulatory performance in Kangrung of south Korea on Feb. 8 ahead of the opening of the 23rd Winter Olympics. When its introducer conveyed the compatriotic greetings of the people in the north amid the playing of the music of prelude "Glad to See You", the spectators broke into enthusiastic applause and cheers. Our artistes put on the stage female chorus "Fly High, Doves", light music "My Country Is Best", string ensemble and female solo "Morning Star" and other colorful numbers. Through serial orchestra "Dear Melodies" newly and specifically depicted with world famous songs, the performers showed their excellent skills. When our artistes sang south Korean songs, the spectators followed the songs, waving their hands, and encored songs. When the mood of performance was being revved up, Hyon Song Wol mounted the stage, expressed her impressions about the visit to the south side and sang the song "Mts Paektu and Halla Are Part of My Motherland", delighting the spectators. The performance ended with choruses "Our Wish Is Reunification" and "See You Again" sung by artistes of the north and the south. At the end of the performance, Kim Yong Nam and Kim Yo Jong together with Moon Jae In and his wife extended greetings to the performers and spectators. Jo Myong Gyun, To Jong Hwan and Pak Won Sun mounted the stage to congratulate our artistes upon their successful performance, giving bouquets to them. The performance was highly acclaimed by the spectators. Meanwhile, the DPRK high-level delegation was invited to a luncheon hosted by Ri Rak Yon, prime minister of south Korea, on the same day. Present at the luncheon were all the members of the DPRK high-level delegation, Jo Myong Gyun, To Jong Hwan and others concerned of the south side. Prior to the performance, the delegation was also invited to a send-off dinner hosted by Im Jong Sok, presidential chief of staff of Chongwadae. The luncheon and dinner took place in an amicable atmosphere. Rodong News Team

title: Korean Books Donated to Russian Library
body: A Korean book-donating ceremony took place at the Science Library in Sakhalin Region of Russia on Jan. 30 with the approach of the birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il. Present at the ceremony were several figures such as the curator of the library and officials of the DPRK mission in Vladivostok. Works of President Kim Il Sung, leader Kim Jong Il and respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un were donated. The curator said that the world people were pleased that the DPRK, not a big country in its territory and population, is firmly defending its sovereignty and dignity while proudly standing up against the imperialist forces in the international arena. The curator noted that the Korean people would as ever make a dynamic advance along the road chosen by them. The deputy curator sincerely congratulated the Korean people upon their successes in the efforts for bolstering up national defense capability and improving the people's living under the wise guidance of the Workers' Party of Korea, adding that the ones would know better about the DPRK reading the donated works. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Shining Star to Be Marked in France
body: A French preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il (the Day of the Shining Star) was formed in Paris on Feb. 5. Benoit Quennedey, president of the France-Korea Friendship Association, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee decided to organize political and cultural events in praise of the revolutionary career and feats of Kim Jong Il on the occasion of the Day of the Shining Star. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Shining Star to Be Marked in Algeria
body: A preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il (the Day of the Shining Star) was formed by the General Youth Union of Algeria on Feb. 4. Muhammad Nouwar Al Rabie Kabaili, chairman of the union, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee decided to hold colorful political and cultural events such as a meeting and film show from Feb. 4 to 16. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Shining Star to Be Marked in Russia
body: A preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il (the Day of the Shining Star) was formed by the Lenin Young Communist League of the Russian Federation on Feb. 2. V. P. Isakov, first secretary of the league, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee set the celebration period from Feb. 2 to 17 and decided to organize colorful political and cultural events such as a seminar and film show in praise of the revolutionary career and feats of Kim Jong Il in this period. Rodong News Team

title: Message of Sympathy to Russian President
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, sent a message of sympathy to Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation, on Feb. 12 in connection with the passenger plane crash in Russia which caused huge casualties. The message expressed deep sympathy and condolences to the president and through him to the victims and the bereaved families. It sincerely hoped that the sorrow of the bereaved families will be overcome at the earliest date and stability be settled. Rodong News Team

title: Congratulatory Group of Koreans in Japan Arrives
body: A congratulatory group of Koreans in Japan for celebrating the Day of the Shining Star arrived in Pyongyang on Feb. 13. The group is led by Ko Tok U, chairman of the Nishi Tokyo Headquarters of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan. Rodong News Team

title: Delegations of Juche Idea Study Groups in Pyongyang
body: Delegations of Juche idea study organizations in different countries arrived in Pyongyang on Feb. 13 to celebrate the birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il. They include a delegation of the Mongolian Juche idea study organization led by N. Bold, chairman of the Mongolian Centre for the Study of Juche, and a delegation of the Japanese Juche idea study society led by Yasuhito Fujii, deputy representative of the Gunma Liaison Council of Societies for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism. Rodong News Team

title: Hysterical Acts of Those Mad with Confrontation
body: The conservatives of south Korea, including the "Liberal Korea Party", incite anti-DPRK confrontation atmosphere, claiming that the DPRK art troupe's entry into Mukho port is "a serious issue weakening the sanctions" and "the entry should be prevented". And they staged such dirty farces as "press conference against Pyongyang Olympics", "demo against the visit of the art troupe" and "rally for the south Korean flag" almost every day. Against this background, the conservative clan committed another never-to-be-condoned rowdyism at the Mukho Port where the ship "Mangyongbong-92" carrying the art troupe of the DPRK was set to arrive. Such moves as hysterics of human scum devoid of elementary etiquette, despicable confrontation maniacs that cannot exist even a moment without slandering the fellow countrymen. The provocative moves of the conservative group spoiling the atmosphere for the improvement of inter-Korean relations are a last-ditch effort of those marginalized by the trend of the times. Those displeased with the atmosphere of improved north-south relations and challenging the aspiration of the nation are only a handful. But if the outrages of such conservative gangsters trying to turn the Winter Olympics into a theater of confrontation, far from appreciating the sincere efforts of the fellow countrymen who share the joy for national event, are allowed, the trend toward improved north-south relations which has just started will be stemmed again and national reconciliation and unity can never be achieved. The traitors to the nation who can never be reformed, the conservative group trying to dare to do harm to the DPRK's dignity, not content with viciously insulting the good intentions of the fellow countrymen, should be no longer allowed to exist within the nation. Ra Sol Ha

title: Empire of Evil Is Doomed to Ruin
body: Terming the DPRK's self-defensive nuclear deterrent a "threat" to the world peace, the U.S. recently made public a "2018 nuclear posture review" (NPR), in which it legalized the updating of nuclear weapons and the preemptive nuclear attack on the DPRK. It is nothing but an open declaration of war by the rogue state, which means to dare make a preemptive nuclear strike on the DPRK in order to bring the Korean peninsula and the world into a nuclear holocaust. The NPR invented by the Trump group is a product of the black-hearted intention to realize the ambition for aggression by starting a nuclear war on the Korean Peninsula at any cost. The Trump group, that shaped the DPRK policy billed "maximum pressure and engagement", is leaving no means untried to isolate and stifle the DPRK, while crying out for its "nuclear threat" and "denuclearization". There prevails on the Korean Peninsula the atmosphere of detente and peace thanks to the DPRK's initiative and proactive compatriotic measure. But in the wake of the rapid deployment of nuclear strategic assets and special warfare forces to south Korea and its vicinity, the U.S. announced that it would resume the U.S.-south Korea joint military exercises right after the Winter Olympics. It is also a deliberate provocation to turn the trend of the present situation back to confrontation and war. The Trump group's racket for confrontation with the DPRK is a suicidal act of digging a pitfall of ruin by itself. Once the DPRK starts its decisive military strike, the mainland of the U.S. as well as its military bases in the Pacific area of operations will never be safe. Sim Chol Yong

title: DPRK Art Troupe Returns Home
body: An art troupe of the DPRK led by Kwon Hyok Bong, department director of the Ministry of Culture, and Hyon Song Wol, head of the Samjiyon Orchestra, came back to Pyongyang on Feb. 12 after successfully completing its program of congratulatory performances for the 23rd Winter Olympics. The troupe left Seoul on Feb. 12 and came back via Kaesong around 11:00. It was greeted by senior officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea including Kim Yo Jong, first vice department director of the C.C., the WPK, and officials of the Ministry of Culture. The performances given by it in Kangrung and Seoul of south Korea before full houses in celebration of the 23rd Winter Olympics deeply impressed the fellow countrymen aspiring after the national reconciliation and unity, evoking lively response among the people from all walks of life. Rodong News Team

title: Oath-taking Meeting Takes Place in Mt Paektu
body: An oath-taking meeting for accomplishing the cause of the Juche revolution under the guidance of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, holding Kim Jong Il in high esteem as the eternal leader of the Korean revolution, took place at the secret camp in Mt Paektu on Feb. 12. Present there were senior party and government officials Pak Kwang Ho, An Jong Su, Ro Tu Chol and No Kwang Chol, Chairman of the Ryanggang Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea Ri Sang Won, officials of the Party Central Committee, armed forces organs, working people's organizations, ministries and national institutions, officers and men of the Korean People's Army, commanding officers and shock brigade members of the 216 Division, officials of Ryanggang Province and Samjiyon County and merited persons. Speeches were made there to make a pledge. The speakers noted that leader Kim Jong Il performed undying feats before the party, the revolution, the country and its people all his life, true to the noble intention of President Kim Il Sung. They stressed the need to further spruce up Samjiyon County, where the native home of Kim Jong Il is situated, as a large open-air museum for educating in the revolutionary traditions and as a paradise for the people without an equal in the world. They said they would consider the historic victory won in building the nuclear force of the Republic as a springboard for new progress and wage a dynamic struggle to accomplish the patriotic cause of Kim Jong Il, the cause of building a powerful socialist nation, through an all-people all-out offensive. They vowed to become thousand-fold fortresses and shields to devotedly defend the Party Central Committee headed by Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: Talks Held between Vice-Chairman of C.C., WPK and Chairman of C.C., USNPN
body: Talks were held in Pyongyang on Feb. 12 between Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and Kamal Prasad Chaulagain, chairman of Central Committee of the United Socialist Nationalist Party of Nepal (USNPN). Ri Su Yong informed that the Workers' Party of Korea and people of the DPRK are making a dynamic drive for implementing the decision of the 7th Congress of the WPK by dint of the single-minded unity and spirit of self-reliance and self-development, closely united around respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, and stressed the need to boost the friendly relations between the two parties. Kamal Prasad Chaulagain said that he was pleased that the WPK is courageously breaking through the bottlenecks and difficulties under the wise guidance of Kim Jong Un. He stressed that the USNPN would extend full support to the WPK in its struggle against imperialism and deepen many-sided exchange and cooperation between the two parties. Present at the talks from the DPRK side were Ryu Myong Son, vice department director of the C.C., the WPK, and officials concerned and from the opposite side were members of the USNPN delegation. Rodong News Team

title: Reception Given at Iranian Embassy
body: The Iranian embassy here hosted a reception at the Taedonggang Diplomatic Club on Feb. 12 to mark the 39th anniversary of the victory in the Islamic revolution of Iran. Present there on invitation were Thae Hyong Chol, president of Kim Il Sung University and concurrently minister of Higher Education who is chairman of the DPRK-Iran Friendship Parliamentary Group, Ri Yong Chol, vice department director of the Workers' Party of Korea Central Committee, Choe Hui Chol, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, officials concerned and diplomatic envoys of different countries and representatives of international organizations and military attaches of foreign embassies here. Ambassador Seyed Mohsen Emadi and staff members of the Iranian embassy were on hand. Rodong News Team

title: Congratulatory Group of Koreans in Japan Visits Mangyongdae
body: A congratulatory group of Koreans in Japan for celebrating the birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il (the Day of Shining Star) led by Chairman of the Nishi Tokyo Headquarters of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan Ko Tok U visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung, Feb. 14. The members of the group visited the Mangyongdae Revolutionary Museum in which historical data and relics showing the revolutionary activities of Kim Il Sung and the members of the Mangyongdae family are on display. At the old home of the President in Mangyongdae, they looked round the relics preserved there, being briefed on his revolutionary history. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Yong Nam Meets Nepalese Party Delegation
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, met and had a talk with the delegation of the United Socialist Nationalist Party of Nepal headed by Chairman of its Central Committee Kamal Prasad Chaulagain, which paid a courtesy call on him, at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Feb. 14. Rodong News Team

title: Foreign Embassy Officials Visit National Pencil Drawing Festival
body: Officials in charge of cultural and friendship relations of foreign embassies in Pyongyang visited the venue of the 7th National Pencil Drawing Festival for celebrating the birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il (Day of the Shining Star) on Feb. 14. They looked round pencil drawings of various themes including those showing the exploits of Kim Jong Il who laid a firm guarantee for prosperity of Juche Korea and its final victory and the struggle of the Korean army and people speeding up the building of a powerful socialist country under the guidance of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: Congratulations to Communist Party of Russian Federation
body: The Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) sent a congratulatory message to the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation on Feb. 14 on the occasion of its 25th founding anniversary. The message said that the WPK has observed the activity of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation to adhere to the socialist idea, defend the well-being of the working masses and strengthen the party ranks, and supports it. It expressed the belief that the friendly and cooperative relations between the two parties would grow stronger through the struggle to materialize the shared idea of socialism. Rodong News Team

title: War Games Aimed at Aggravating Tension
body: The south Korean military recently staged a military maneuver Warrior Strike for "destroying WMDs" of the DPRK together with the 2nd Division of the U.S. imperialist aggression forces in south Korea. In the wake of it, the warmongers of the military staged a "coldest period exercise" in the area of Kyonggi Province from Feb. 5, going frantic with the military confrontation. The south Korea-U.S. war exercises is an anachronistic military action to spoil the atmosphere of improving the inter-Korean relations and easing the tension created thanks to the proactive measure of the DPRK and throw a wet blanket over the spirit of reunifying the country through alliance with the north among south Korean people from all walks of life. A dramatic change is happening in the north-south relations just as every one witnesses. The saber-rattling of warmongers at home and abroad, quite contrary to the Winter Olympics, clearly shows who is the harasser of peace on the Korean Peninsula. The U.S. and the south Korean military trigger-happy forces must stop at once the ill-intentioned military action against the unanimous desire of our nation for peace and reunification and the trend of the times, properly understanding who is their rival. If the enemies persistently block the way ahead of the nation, obstructing the improvement of the inter-Korean ties and detente, they will have to pay dearly for it. Jang Jong Chol

title: Outrageous Mangling of Insular Gangsters
body: The Japan police authorities recently arrested the former chairman of the Katsushika Branch of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) on the charges of "violation of the law on secondhand dealers". Afterwards the joint investigation headquarters, made up of policemen from the Metropolitan Police Office and Saitama Prefecture of Japan hurled more than 100 armed policemen to search the Tokyo Metropolitan Headquarters of Chongryon and the house of a Chongryon official and the Future Foundation set up for support for the Korean schools, charging that the bankbook of the former Chongryon branch chairman had a record of remitting money to Chongryon. This case is not an investigation into the "violation of the law on secondhand dealers" but a product of premeditated politically-motivated plot targeting Chongryon. The reality glaringly shows that the island country Japan has been turned into a state of gangsters and source of crimes. It is the sinister intention of the Abe group to fan up the anti-DPRK, anti-Chongryon atmosphere across Japan by branding Chongryon, a dignified overseas citizens' organization of the DPRK, as an "illegal body" and "unlawful body" and aggravating the situation on the Korean Peninsula and thus pave the way for realizing the militaristic ambition. Chongryon is part of the DPRK and the Japanese reactionaries' suppression of Chongryon means a hostile act to the DPRK. The Japanese authorities would be well advised to bear in mind that they would face a miserable destruction if they resort to such provocations as despicable and brutal suppression of Chongryon and Koreans in Japan in disregard of our repeated warnings. Pak Chol Jun

title: Russian Ambassador Hosts Reception to Mark Russian Day of Diplomatic Officials
body: Alexandr Matsegora, Russian ambassador to the DPRK, hosted a reception at the Taedonggang Diplomatic Club on Feb. 13 on the occasion of the Russian Day of Diplomatic Officials. Present there on invitation were Vice-Minister of Foreign Affairs Sin Hong Chol, Vice-Director General of the General Bureau for Affairs with Diplomatic Corps Mun Jae Chol, officials concerned and representatives and staff members of foreign embassies in Pyongyang. Officials of the Russian embassy were on hand. Rodong News Team

title: Choe Ryong Hae Inspects South Hwanghae Province
body: Choe Ryong Hae, Presidium member of the Political Bureau of the Workers' Party of Korea Central Committee, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, made a field survey of various units in South Hwanghae Province. Going round the Samjigang Co-op Farm in Jaeryong County associated with the leadership feats of the peerlessly great men, he encouraged its peasants in working innovations in farming preparations and explained the requirements of the Party policy and the ways in introducing the scientific farming methods. He also inspected the Sinchang Co-op Farm in Sinwon County, the Haeju Trailing Farm Machine Factory and the South Hwanghae Provincial Branch of the Academy of Agricultural Science, stressing the need for their party organizations and officials to fully discharge their mission as vanguard and standard-bearer in implementing the Party policies. Field consultative meetings were held to discuss the measures for attaining the agricultural production goal for this year on the basis of the past successes and experience. Rodong News Team

title: Japan's Intention of Crying Out for "Threats" from DPRK
body: The Korean nation and the whole world are welcoming the hard-won atmosphere of reconciliation being created on the Korean peninsula, a land that had been frozen with confrontation and mistrust, and are unanimously expecting it to lead to the thaw in spring. But Japan is making desperate efforts to chill the atmosphere, being displeased over the dramatic change taking place in the situation on the Korean peninsula. What the Abe group seeks while persistently calling for "maximum pressure" is none other than exacerbation of the situation on the Korean peninsula to the extremes. What is the reason why the Japanese authorities are persistently crying out for the "threats" form the DPRK? First, it is to lay a political groundwork for building a war state with "threats" from the DPRK as an established pretext. Throughout history, Japan has used "foreign pressure" for realizing its ambition for becoming a big country. Japan nurtured the vaulting ambition of the "conquest of Korea" after the "1868 Meiji Restoration". It annexed Korea as its colony while talking about threats from Qing Dynasty and Czarist Russia, and went crazy to put the Asian continent under its control with the Second World War as an occasion. After its defeat, Japan used the Korean War and the Vietnamese War as occasions for "rapid growth" and rearmament and after the end of the Cold War, it paved the path for overseas dispatch of troops under the pretext of the U.S. "war on terrorism". The present authorities of Japan are effectively using "threats" from the DPRK for suppressing the political forces standing in the way of establishing a war state. Second, Japan aims at rebuilding a socio-economic foundation of a "country capable of fighting a war" with "threats" from the DPRK as a golden pretext. Over more than half a century since the defeat of militarist Japan, the feelings of frustration following the defeat and war-weariness has pervaded the Japanese society and the new generation who had not experienced a war has emerged as the main players of society. In the economic structure, the munitions industry has markedly shrunken as compared with the civilian industry or it has been deformed after being held down by the U.S. munitions-industrial conglomerates. The awareness of urgency felt by the Japanese authorities is that unless Japan makes a fundamental change in such socio-economic structure, it would reduce into a country which can never fight a war. So they found "nuclear and missile threats" from the DPRK as the most appropriate pretext. Third, Japan's aim is to distract the international community's serious eyes from its push for emerging as a military giant by citing "threats" from the DPRK as a pretext. For over five years in office, the Abe regime made a giant stride forward for turning Japan into a military giant as evidenced by the identification of security strategy and the establishment of new state security council in 2013, institution of three principles on the transfer of defence hardware in 2014, the adoption of all-inclusive security law in 2015 and the revision of Japan-U.S. agreement on mutual provision of goods and labor in 2016. This arouses due vigilance and serious concerns of the international community including the neighboring countries as it is a vivid revelation of dangerous ambition to retake the old position of the "leader of Asia". To calm down and distract attention from it, Japan is going to use "nuclear and missile threats" from the DPRK as a shield. As a responsible nuclear power which loves peace, the DPRK will never use nuclear weapons nor threaten any country or any region with nuclear weapons unless aggression-minded hostile forces encroach upon the sovereignty and interests of the DPRK, but will resolutely counter any acts of harassing peace and security of the Korean peninsula. Jang Chol, Researcher of Institute for Asian Studies at Institute of International Studies

title: Kim Jong Un Visits Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and supreme commander of the Korean People's Army, visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun at 00:00 on Feb. 16, the birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il (the Day of the Shining Star), the national greatest auspicious holiday to pay high tribute to him. Respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un entered the hall where the statues of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il stand. A floral basket in the name of Kim Jong Un was placed before the statues. Also laid before the statues was a floral basket in the joint name of the Central Committee and the Central Military Commission of the Workers' Party of Korea and the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK. Kim Jong Un together with the senior officials of the Party Central Committee paid high tribute to Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il before their statues. He entered the hall of immortality where Kim Jong Il lies in state. He paid deep homage and made bow to Kim Jong Il. Accompanying him were Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., the WPK, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the C.C., the WPK, Pak Kwang Ho, Ri Su Yong, Kim Phyong Hae, Thae Jong Su, O Su Yong, An Jong Su, Pak Thae Song, Kim Yong Chol, Choe Hwi and Pak Thae Dok, vice-chairmen of the C.C., the WPK, and other senior officials of the Party Central Committee. Political News Team

title: Fireworks Displayed in Pyongyang
body: Fireworks were displayed in the sky above Pyongyang on Feb. 16 evening in celebration of the birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il.
