Kim Il Sung Square, Mansu Hill and Okryu Bridge centering on the bank of the Taedong River where the Tower of the Juche Idea stands and other places of the capital city were crowded with citizens from all walks of life and school youth and children eager to see the fireworks. At 19:00, the display of celebration fireworks began amid the playing of song "We Present You Bouquet". The loyal mind of all the army and people to glorify the greatest auspicious day of the nation, the revolutionary holiday when the heaven-sent great man was born, represented a beautiful scene in the February sky. Rodong News Team

title: Government Officials Visit Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: Officials of the DPRK government visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on Feb. 16 to pay homage to leader Kim Jong Il on the occasion of the Day of the Shining Star, his birth anniversary. Among them were Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, and others and the chairman of a friendly party and officials of the Cabinet, working people's organizations, ministries and national institutions. Seen before the statues of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il at the palace was a floral basket bearing the august name of Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and supreme commander of the Korean People's Army. Also there was a floral basket in the joint name of the WPK Central Committee, the WPK Central Military Commission and the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK. A floral basket in the joint name of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly and the Cabinet of the DPRK was placed before the statues. The participants paid tribute to the great leaders before their statues. At the hall where Kim Jong Il lies in state, they made deep bow to him. The visitors went round the hall where orders Kim Jong Il received are on display and halls that house a car, an electric car, boat and train coach used by him during his field guidance and foreign tours till the last moments of his life. Also visiting the palace were servicepersons of the Korean People's Army and civilians from all walks of life. Rodong News Team

title: Delegations of Juche Idea Study Groups Visit 22nd Kimjongilia Festival Venue
body: Delegations of the Mongolian Juche idea study organization and the Japanese Juche idea study society staying in Pyongyang to celebrate the birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il visited the 22nd Kimjongilia Festival venue on Feb. 16. They looked round the immortal flowers in full bloom by the reverence and utmost sincerity of the Korean army and people and the world progressives for Kim Jong Il. Earlier, they visited the Korean Revolution Museum and the Arch of Triumph. Rodong News Team

title: Youth and Students Dance to Mark Day of Shining Star
body: Dancing parties of youth and students took place across the DPRK on Feb. 16 to celebrate the birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il, the Day of the Shining Star. They began in different parts of the capital city including the Monument to Party Founding and the plaza of the Arch of Triumph amid the playing of song "We Will Hold Our General in High Esteem". The participants expressed highest glory to Kim Jong Il, who provided a solid foundation for eternal prosperity of the nation and future of a socialist power with his unique idea and distinguished leadership, while dancing. Youth and students danced to the tune of such songs as "Our General Is the Best", "The General Star beyond the Clouds" and "Thunder over Jong Il Peak", with profound reverence for the fatherly general who built a youth power without an equal on this land. They enthusiastically danced, full of conviction that thanks to respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, the great leaders' patriotic wishes for a powerful nation will surely come true, to the tunes of such songs as "Our Leader Loved by People" and "We Will Defend General Kim Jong Un with Our Lives". On the same day, similar dancing parties took place in provincial seats, cities and counties. Rodong News Team

title: Joint National Meeting of KCU Organizations Held
body: A joint national meeting of the Korean Children's Union organizations took place in Pyongyang on Feb. 16 in celebration of the 76th birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il. Attending it were delegates of the KCU from provinces and schoolchildren in Pyongyang and pupils joining the KCU. Present on invitation were Vice-Chairman Choe Hwi of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Vice-Premier Jon Kwang Ho, Chairman Kim Sung Du of the Education Commission, officials of relevant fields and the youth league, war veterans and persons of merit. Pak Chol Min, first secretary of the Central Committee of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League, made a report. The reporter recalled that Kim Jong Il had visited many schools and schoolchildren's palaces, though he was very busy providing the revolutionary leadership, and showed loving care so that the KCU members would grow up stoutly to be knowledgeable, moral and healthy. He said that the history of loving care shown by the leader is being given a steady continuity on this land as there is respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. He called on the KCU members to grow up to be dependable pillars of socialist Korea true to the pledge they made before the flag of the KCU, with the pride of having become a member of the glorious Kim Il Sung's and Kim Jong Il's Children's Union. A ceremony for admission to the KCU was held at the meeting. The pupils joining the KCU made an oath, led by Choe Hwi. Officials, war veterans and persons of merit tied red neckties around their necks and attached KCU badges on their chests. The pupils made the first greetings of the KCU member, responding to the slogan "Let us be always ready for socialist country". Then followed congratulatory speeches. Rodong News Team

title: Floral Tribute Paid to Great Leaders
body: Servicepersons and civilians from all walks of life and school youth and children in the DPRK visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il across the country on the occasion of the birth anniversary of Kim Jong Il. Seen before the statues of the great leaders on Mansu Hill in Pyongyang was a floral basket from Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and supreme commander of the Korean People's Army. Laid at the statues were floral baskets in the names of the party, armed forces and power organs, social organizations, ministries and national institutions and units of the Korean People's Army and the Korean People's Internal Security Forces and institutions and enterprises at all levels, factories and schools in Pyongyang as well as bouquets. Also placed was a floral basket in the name of the Pyongyang mission of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front. The participants paid tribute to the great leaders before their statues. Floral tribute was also paid to the statues at Kim Il Sung University, Ministry of the People's Armed Forces, Ministry of People's Security, the Mansudae Art Studio and other parts of the city. Servicepersons, working people and school youth and children in different parts of the country, too, visited the statues of the great leaders and their smiling portraits in their residential areas to pay deep respects to them. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of DPRK-Russia Fishery Joint Committee Leaves for Russia
body: A delegation of the DPRK-Russia Fishery Joint Committee headed by Vice-Minister of Fisheries Kim Chang Do left Pyongyang on Feb. 16 to attend the 30th meeting of the DPRK-Russia Joint Committee on cooperation in the fishery due in Russia. Rodong News Team

title: Foreigners, Overseas Koreans Visit Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: Foreigners and overseas Koreans visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on Feb. 16 on the occasion of the Day of the Shining Star, the birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il. Among them were representatives of foreign embassies and international organizations here, military attaches, a delegation of the Mongolian Juche idea study organization, a delegation of the Japanese Juche idea study society, a congratulatory group of Koreans in Japan for celebrating the Day of the Shining Star and a delegation of the General Association of Koreans in China. The visitors paid high tribute to President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il before their statues at the palace. They paid homage to leader Kim Jong Il at the hall where he lies in state. They went round a hall where orders Kim Jong Il received are on display and halls that house a car, electric car, boat and train coach used by him for field guidance and foreign tours till the last moments of his life. Rodong News Team

title: Japan Should Stop Unpardonable Outrage against Chongryon
body: The Japanese police authorities arrested the former chairman of the Katsushiga chapter of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) on Jan. 31 on suspicion of the "violation of secondhand dealer law". The next day, under the pretext that remittance to Chongryon was recorded in his bankbook, the police searched the Tokyo Metropolitan Headquarters of Chongryon and the house of its vice-chairman and concurrently director for publicity and culture and the office of the "Mirae Foundation" set up for supporting the Korean schools. Such an anti-Chongryon campaign is aimed at creating an anti-DPRK and anti-Chongryon climate in the Japanese society and destroying the dignified organization of overseas citizens of the DPRK. The Abe group is also seeking conditions and pretext to realize its consistent militarist ambition by escalating the tension on the Korean Peninsula. Historically the Japanese right-wing reactionaries had suppressed Chongryon whenever their hostile policy towards the DPRK and design to convert Japan into a military giant faced a serious crisis. They use the suppression of Chongryon as a lever to enforce the hostile policy toward the DPRK. Their desperate anti-Chongryon moves will only reveal Japan's true colors as a brazen-faced war criminal state and an ugly human rights abuser. An Chol Gwon

title: ITF President Arrives
body: Ri Yong Son, president of the International Taekwon-Do Federation (ITF) who doubles as chairman of the International Martial Arts Games Committee, and his party arrived in Pyongyang on Feb. 17. Rodong News Team

title: Samjiyon Orchestra Gives Performance
body: A performance was given by the Samjiyon Orchestra, which successfully finished congratulatory performances to congratulate the 23rd Winter Olympics, at the Mansudae Art Theatre on Feb. 16. The performance was enjoyed by Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, and cadres of the C.C., WPK and officials, creators and artists in the field of art. Put on the stage were diverse pieces including female chorus "Fly High, Doves" and light music "My Country Is Best". The performers well showed the aspiration of our people for making the opportunity of reconciliation and unity provided by the noble patriotism and great decision of the peerlessly great man produce a good fruition with fresh songs and enthusiastic and high artistic skills. The performance was acclaimed by the audience as they represented the musical emotion of the Korean nation. In orchestra "Dear Melodies" the performers successfully played world famous songs including "Arirang". They sang south Korean songs which deeply impressed south Korean people. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of Koreans in China Visits 22nd Kimjongilia Festival Venue
body: The visiting delegation of the General Association of Koreans in China led by First Vice-Chairman Choe Su Bong on Feb. 17 visited the venue of the 22nd Kimjongilia Festival. The delegation members looked around the venue of the festival praising the great man with deep emotion. It also visited the Korean Revolution Museum. Rodong News Team

title: Juche-oriented Musical Art Museum Opens
body: The Juche-oriented Musical Art Museum has been wonderfully built at the Mansudae Art Theatre on the occasion of the birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il. This is a treasure-house of socialist Korea's musical art as it comprehensively and intuitively showcases the history of the revolutionary musical art of Korea that has made brilliant development century after century and decade after decade since the period of the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle. On display there are famous songs, including the songs praising the leaders significantly recorded in the protracted course of the Korean revolution which started and has advanced victoriously with songs, and data on the creative and performing activities of creators and artistes. Its opening ceremony took place on Feb. 16. Present there were Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Workers' Party of Korea Central Committee, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the WPK Central Committee, and Pak Kwang Ho, Ri Su Yong, Kim Phyong Hae, Thae Jong Su, O Su Yong, An Jong Su, Pak Thae Song, Kim Yong Chol, Choe Hwi, Pak Thae Dok, Ri Man Gon and other cadres of the WPK Central Committee, officials, creators and artistes in the field of literature and arts and officials and employees of the house. Pak Kwang Ho, Politburo member and vice-chairman of the WPK Central Committee, made an opening address. He said that the museum is a great treasure-house of musical art reflective of the great feats performed by the peerlessly great men in the musical art field. The museum is a brilliant fruition of the noble intention and energetic guidance of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un to firmly defend and eternally glorify the musical art leadership feats of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il, he said. At the end of the ceremony, the participants looked round the museum. Seen before the color statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il at the central hall of the museum was a floral basket in the name of Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and supreme commander of the Korean People's Army. The participants placed floral baskets and bouquets before the color statues of the great leaders and paid tribute to them. Rodong News Team

title: Chinese and Koreans in China Visit Mangyongdae
body: The Chinese guests and Koreans in China who participated in the 22nd Kimjongilia Festival visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. At the old home in Mangyongdae, they looked round historic relics, being briefed on the revolutionary history of the President and careers of his family members. They also toured the Korean Revolution Museum, the Monument to Party Founding, the Natural History Museum, etc. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Yong Nam Meets Art Troupe of Koreans in Japan
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, met and had a talk with the art troupe of Koreans in Japan giving a music and dance performance in celebration of the Day of the Shining Star at the Pyongyang Grand Theatre on Feb. 17. Attending it were Ko Tok U, chairman of the Nishi Tokyo Headquarters of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan who is leading the congratulatory group of Koreans in Japan for celebrating the Day of the Shining Star, and officials concerned. Rodong News Team

title: Art Performance Celebrates Day of Shining Star
body: An art performance celebrating the Day of the Shining Star was given at the East Pyongyang Grand Theatre on Feb. 16. Enjoying it were senior party and government officials, the chairman of a friendly party, officials of the Workers' Party of Korea Central Committee, armed forces organs, the Cabinet, working people's organizations, ministries and national institutions, servicepersons and women of merit from Jagang Province and officials of institutions and industrial establishments, labor innovators and working people in Pyongyang. Among the audience were congratulatory groups and delegations of overseas compatriots including a congratulatory group of Koreans in Japan. Present on invitation were representatives of foreign embassies and international organizations here and their spouses, military attaches and their spouses and other foreign guests. The numbers of the performance included female chorus "Snow-covered Native Home", male solo and female pangchang "Tell, O Road of Songun" and female sextet and chorus "We Call You Father". The performers sang high praises of the revolutionary life and feats of leader Kim Jong Il who laid an eternal foundation for prosperity of Kim Il Sung's Korea and happiness of posterity by making the forced march of field guidance day and night with his iron will, out of the high sense of obligations before the country and the revolution. Touching the heartstrings of the audience were female solo and pangchang "Thinking of the General" and female chorus "Song of Love for People", which represent the deep yearning for Kim Jong Il. Mixed duet and chorus "Cheers of the People" and chorus "Song of Socialist Advance" marked the climax of the performance, pieces that sang of the joy and happiness of the Korean people dynamically advancing toward the final victory of socialist cause under the guidance of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: U.S. Should Feel Shame
body: The poor plight of U.S. Vice-President Pence at the opening ceremony of the 23rd Winter Olympics was disclosed. Pence could not mix himself among the participants in the Olympic event, being a common object of hatred wherever he went during his recent south Korea visit. Notably when our high-level delegation happened to meet up with him, he dared not look at it. On the afternoon of Feb. 9 he was late at the pre-opening reception as he had a photo session with Japanese Prime Minister Abe. Then he left the event stealthily in less than five minutes, not listening to the congratulatory speech there. At the opening ceremony of the Winter Olympics, he took the seat just before our delegation but did not dare turn his eyes towards it. His behavior reminded one of a criminal wishing to sink through the floor. Pence remarked that he didn't require any contact with the north Korean delegation and he asked the south side authorities to fix schedule lest he encounter it. In this regard, the DPRK made clear its stand that it has never begged the U.S. for dialogue and will never do so in the future, too, that the DPRK has no intention to meet with the U.S. side during the visit to south Korea and that it doesn't want to use the sports festival such as the Winter Olympics as a political leverage nor feel the necessity. After all, Pence, a backseat driver, had to go back to his den after exposing himself to public disgrace. As seen in Pence's recent tour of south Korea the harder the Trump group resorts to such foolish acts, the more vividly the poor plight of the beleaguered U.S. will be shown. If Trump and his group want to avoid more disgrace and shame before eyes of the world, they had better reflect on all their crimes against the DPRK and honestly regret for having sent such human scum as Pence to the gathering of peace. Jong Hyon

title: Art Performance of Koreans in Japan Marks Birth Anniversary of Kim Jong Il
body: An art performance of Koreans in Japan for celebrating the 76th birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il was given at the Korean Hall of Culture in Tokyo of Japan on February 15. Watching the performance were Chairman Ho Jong Man and vice-chairpersons Nam Sung U, Pae Ik Ju, Pae Jin Gu and Kang Chu Ryon of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), Chairman of the Central Audit Committee of Chongryon Hong In Hum, advisers and directors of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, the director of the Research Institute on History of Korean Residents in Japan, leading officials of Chongryon organizations and business groups, chairpersons of the Chongryon headquarters in Kanto area and other Chongryon officials, compatriots and teaching staff and students of Korean University. Taking part in the performance were artistes of the Kumgang-san Opera Troupe of Chongryon, women's union members and students of Korean University. The number of the performance, which began with symphony orchestra "Patriotic Song", included chorus immortal revolutionary paean "Song of General Kim Jong Il" and Jangsaenap instrumental solo "Attraction and Reverence". The performers well represented the world of deep yearnings of Chongryon officials and Koreans in Japan for Kim Jong Il. Female chorus "Voice of My Heart" and male chorus "We Are Mallima Riders" portrayed well the will of the Koreans in Japan to keep pace with the dynamic advance of the homeland, with boundless reverence for respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: Diploma to Kim Jong Il from Venezuela
body: Leader Kim Jong Il was awarded a diploma from the United Left Party of Venezuela on his birth anniversary. The diploma was conveyed on Feb. 14 to the DPRK ambassador to Venezuela by Felix Jesus Velasquez Castillo, general coordinator of the Federal Political Secretariat of the Party. Rodong News Team

title: Delegations of Juche Idea Study Organizations Leave
body: The delegation of the Mongolian Juche idea study organization led by N. Bold, chairman of the Mongolian Centre for the Study of Juche, and the delegation of the Japanese Juche Idea Study Society led by Yasuhito Fujii, deputy representative of the Gunma Liaison Council of Societies for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, went back home on Feb. 20. Rodong News Team

title: Annual Meeting of Korean Committee for Solidarity with Cuba Held
body: An annual meeting of the Korean Committee for Solidarity with Cuba was held in Pyongyang on Feb. 20. Present there were Kim Sung Du, chairman of the Education Commission who is chairman of the Korean Committee for Solidarity with Cuba, So Ho Won, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries, and other members of the solidarity committee and Ambassador Jesus De Los Angeles Aise Sotolongo and officials of the Cuban embassy here. The meeting reviewed the work conducted by the solidarity committee in the last one year to actively support the just cause of the fraternal Cuban people vigorously struggling for independence against imperialism and for socialism under the leadership of the Communist Party of Cuba, and discussed its action program for this year. Rodong News Team

title: Traitor Park Chung-Hee's Crime Disclosed in S. Korea
body: Yonhap News of south Korea disclosed another fact that traitor Park Chung-Hee hurled airborne commandoes into brutally quelling the October resistance for democracy that broke out in Pusan and Masan to protest the "yusin" fascist dictatorship. The findings of a recent survey made public on Feb. 19 revealed that traitor Park ordered the "martial law" commander to send a brigade of airborne commandoes to Masan to suppress the resistance on Oct. 18, 1979. Besides, the "martial law" command organized a joint investigation team to conduct a probe into the participants in the resistance and tried to link the force behind them with the DPRK, according to the findings. Rodong News Team

title: U.S. Has to Stop Making blusters
body: The Trump group is spouting rubbish that if the DPRK's nuclear issue is not settled through diplomatic way, it can not but take a military option, while clamoring for "possibility of dialogue" with the DPRK. This is an open threat to mount a military attack if the DPRK does not respond to the denuclearization negotiations. It is foolhardy for the U.S. to try to threaten the DPRK with such nonsense and it is nothing but a reckless act ignorant of the faith, will and pluck of Juche Korea. The DPRK is a self-defensive nuclear power no one can dare provoke, and we are not afraid of sanctions and pressure as we are exploring our future under the banner of self-reliance and self-development. We are ready for both dialogue and war. If the U.S. attacks the DPRK, it will not be safe in face of a stern punishment by the Korean army and people. Recently the trump group is advising the Americans to leave last messages if they want to travel Korea. They had better pay heed to our warning, not making such nonsensical rubbish. If the U.S. dare provokes a war, there will never be a man left who would keep last messages and bury the coffins. This is our answer. The U.S. has to stop going ill-mannered, clearly understanding who its rival is. Sim Chol Yong

title: Foolhardy Acts to Plunge World into Calamity
body: Trump in his "state of the union address" threatened to bring down the DPRK through "American-style decisive action" while bluffing the "maximum pressure" on it. Such frantic outburst is nothing but shriek of a mentally deranged man to get rid of the extreme uneasiness before his logic of strength no longer working and before the DPRK that has towered as a strategic state. It is foolish to think of bringing to knees through "maximum pressure" the DPRK that has risen as a world-level nuclear power and military power. The Trump group has to worry about the security and future of the U.S. that can be affected by its vicious push to bring down the DPRK through "maximum pressure", being guided by the anachronistic and self-righteous perspective. The world has witnessed the U.S. bluffing before the weak but being left helpless before the DPRK, a strong country. Trump's hysteric act will only reveal the servile face of the weak. Words will not work on the U.S. going reckless, being carried away by the foolish ambition for world domination. Jo Thaek Bom

title: Day of Shining Star Marked Abroad
body: Events took place in different countries to celebrate the birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il, the Day of the Shining Star. Seminars, lectures, book and photo exhibitions and film shows were held in Bangladesh, Indonesia, Russia, Germany, Slovenia, Benin, Nigeria and Mexico between Jan. 19 and 30. Displayed at their venues were works of President Kim Il Sung, leader Kim Jong Il and respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. There were also books and photos dealing with the successes made by the army and people of the DPRK in building a powerful socialist country. "My Country Has Emerged Victorious by Dint of Single-minded Unity" and other Korean films were shown. The secretary general of the Chittagong Branch of the Bangladesh Institute of the Juche Idea said that the special feat of Kim Jong Il is that with his treasured sword of Songun he firmly safeguarded the peace and security of the Korean peninsula and the world by making a breakthrough in the world political structure centered on big powers led by the U.S. The chairman of the Anti-Imperialist Forum of Germany and other speakers praised Kim Jong Il for strengthening the party, state and army of the DPRK on the basis of the Juche idea and laying solid foundations for building a powerful socialist country. The chairman of the Beninese National Preparatory Committee for Celebrating the Birth Anniversary of General Kim Jong Il stressed that Kim Jong Il devoted his all to meeting the interests of the people. The chairman of the Mexican Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism and other speakers said that the DPRK is demonstrating its might as a nuclear power of Juche and a world military power under the experienced guidance of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: Message of Sympathy to Iranian President
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, sent a message of sympathy to Hassan Rouhani, Iranian president, on Feb. 19 in connection with a recent passenger plane crash in Iran, that claimed huge casualties. The message expressed deep sympathy and condolences to the Iranian president and, through him, to the bereaved families of the deceased. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Yong Nam Meets Delegation of Koreans in China
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, met and had a talk in a compatriotic atmosphere with a delegation of the General Association of Koreans in China led by First Vice-Chairman Choe Su Bong at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Feb. 19. Rodong News Team

title: U.S. Is Nuclear Criminal State Threatening Mankind
body: Some days ago, the U.S. released a 2018 nuclear posture review. The review is peppered with warlike logic and aggression scenarios aimed to further increase and modernize all types of nuclear hardware and mount preemptive nuclear attacks on other countries any moment. The U.S. betrayed once again its scheme to control other countries and nations and dominate the world with nukes. The U.S. is the very one which sparked a nuclear arms race on the earth and spawned threat of a nuclear war by making nuclear weapons for the first time in history. The U.S. is the worst nuclear criminal state as it has stockpiled all types of nuclear hardware as much as possible, driving the world into a nuclear war. As long as the U.S. exists on the earth, the nuclear threat to mankind will steadily increase and the high-handedness and war moves based on the nuclear edge will get ever more pronounced. The DPRK's access to nukes and build-up of the nuclear force is a just self-defensive measure to cope with the increasing nuclear threat and blackmail of the U.S. Peace and security of the Korean Peninsula and the rest of the world are guaranteed by the DPRK's increasing nuclear force. The U.S. imperialists' more desperate efforts based on nuclear stick against our state convince us that our choice was quite right, and so we will go all out for implementing the line of simultaneously pushing forward the economic construction and the building of nuclear forces. Ri Chol Hyok

title: Syrian Ambassador Hosts Reception
body: Tammam Sulaiman, Syrian ambassador to the DPRK, hosted a reception at the embassy on Feb. 20 on the occasion of the birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il. Present there on invitation were Ri Yong Ho, minister of Foreign Affairs, So Ho Won, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries, and other officials concerned. Attending it were staff members of the Syrian embassy. In his speech at the reception, the Syrian ambassador referred to the undying exploits of Kim Jong Il who firmly protected the sovereignty and dignity of the DPRK and laid a strong foundation for the building of a powerful socialist country with his unique Songun politics. The Syria-DPRK relations forged by the preceding leaders have continued to develop under the care of Syrian President Bashar Al-Assad and respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, said the ambassador, wishing the friendly Korean people fighting against the world imperialists in the first line greater progress and prosperity. The DPRK foreign minister said that Syrian friends' celebration of the Day of the Shining Star together with the Korean people every year is an expression of boundless reverence for Kim Jong Il and the will of the leadership of Syria to boost the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation between the two countries forged by the preceding leaders. The DPRK government will as ever extend invariable support and encouragement to the righteous struggle of the Syrian government and people to smash the aggression moves of the U.S. imperialists and Zionists and defend the sovereignty, stability and territorial integrity of the country, he added. Rodong News Team

title: Pak Pong Ju Inspects Chollima Steel Complex
body: Premier Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, made field survey of the Chollima Steel Complex. Going round several places of the complex, the premier encouraged the workers and technicians in their efforts. A consultative meeting on the field discussed measures for satisfactorily meeting the demand for iron and steel needed for the national economy. Earlier, the premier inspected the Pothonggang Organic Compound Fertilizer Factory and the Pyongyang Automation Appliances Factory to take measures to drastically increase the production of compound fertilizer and provide the firm guarantee for increased production of grain and to hasten the production of machines and equipment to be sent to the field of coal industry. Rodong News Team

title: 22nd Kimjongilia Festival Closes
body: The 22nd Kimjongilia Festival for Celebrating the Day of the Shining Star closed with due ceremony at the Kimilsungia-Kimjongilia Exhibition on Feb. 20. The festival venue drew more than 430 000 people, including officials of party, armed forces and power bodies, working people's organizations, ministries and national institutions, servicepersons, citizens of different social standings, school youth and children, overseas compatriots and foreigners. On the Day of the Shining Star alone, the festival venue was visited by officials and working people of at least 200 units including Kim Il Sung University, Mangyongdae Revolutionary School and the Ministry of Agriculture. Present at the closing ceremony were Pak Kwang Ho, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea; Yang Hyong Sop, vice-president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly; Jon Kwang Ho, vice-premier of the Cabinet; and officials of the festival organizing committee and the units which presented flowers of the sun to the festival, and working people and school youth and children in the city. Also attending it were the congratulatory group of Koreans in Japan for celebrating the Day of the Shining Star and other overseas compatriots and members of the association for disseminating and supporting the immortal flower. Certificates of the festival prize were awarded to many units, officials, cultivators and individuals, the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan and overseas compatriots and foreigners. The participation certificates were also conferred on the units, working people and school youth and children who presented the flowers to the festival. Kim Chang Do, chairman of the Korea Kimilsungia-Kimjongilia Committee, made a closing address. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK's Hwaebul Team Gets Qualification for League Matches of AFC Cup
body: The second preliminary match between the DPRK's Hwaebul team and Mongolia's Erchim team belonging to Group I (East Asia) of the 2018 AFC Cup took place at Kim Il Sung Stadium in Pyongyang, the DPRK on Feb. 20. At the home match, the Hwaebul team beat the Erchim team 3:0. Jang Kuk Chol of Hwaebul team scored the first goal at about 27 minutes and Choe Kwang Jin and Jon Chung Il scored at about 41 minutes and 45 minutes respectively. The Hwaebul team recorded 7:0 in total points in the two preliminary matches, getting the qualification for the league matches of Group I of the 2018 AFC Cup. The league matches of the Group I will start on March 7. The DPRK's April 25 team and Hwaebul team will have the first match on the day. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Il's Feats Praised in Nepal
body: Nepalese political party and body issued statements on Feb. 8 and 10 on the occasion of the birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il. The United Socialist Nationalist Party of Nepal said in its statement: We pay the highest tribute to the great leader Comrade Kim Jong Il, the eternal head of the Workers' Party of Korea, on the occasion of his birth anniversary. He is a prominent leader who developed in depth President Kim Il Sung's Juche idea into the guiding idea in the era of independence and performed undying feats in accomplishing the human cause of independence. He is a great guardian as he not only protected socialism in Korea, but also led the socialist cause of the world to revival and new upswing from collapse and frustration in the worst difficulties and trials towards the close of the last century. His distinguished feats in turning the DPRK into a political and military power and a nuclear weapons state will remain long in the human history. The Nepal Journalist Association said that thanks to the original Songun politics enforced by Kim Jong Il, the Korean revolution could advance along the road of victory and glory, adding that he would always be remembered by the Korean people and the world progressives for his exploits for the times and history. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's Work Printed in Bangladesh
body: Respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Concluding Speech at the March 2013 Plenary Meeting of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea" was brought out in booklet at a Bangladeshi publishing house on Feb. 2 on the occasion of the birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il, the Day of the Shining Star. The work, published on March 31, Juche 102 (2013), deals with the validity of the new strategic line of simultaneously pushing forward the economic construction and the building of nuclear forces set forth by the WPK and why the Party adopted this line. Rodong News Team

title: U.S. Mulls Deploying Latest Attack Drones in S. Korea
body: The U.S. imperialists are going to deploy latest Grey Eagle drones at units of their aggression forces in south Korea by early March, according to reports from south Korea. They openly claim that the drones equipped with precision guided bombs and missiles target the supreme leadership of the DPRK and its major objects in contingency. The U.S. persistent introduction of new war equipment is aimed to spoil the atmosphere for improvement of the north-south relations and extremely aggravate the situation on the Korean peninsula and thus ignite a war of aggression on this land. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung's Work Introduced in Czech Republic
body: The Paektusan Czech-Korean Friendship Association posted the full text of President Kim Il Sung's work "On the Occasion of the Founding of the Korean People's Army" on its website on February 4. The work, published on February 8, Juche 37 (1948), is an immortal great programme as it proclaimed the birth of the Korean People's Army (KPA) and indicated the tasks for developing the KPA into the invincible people's armed forces, a revolutionary regular army. The website carried a photo of the President. Rodong News Team

title: Japan Can Never Evade Responsibility for Crime of Sexual Slavery
body: When people come up with the words "sexual slavery", they call to mind a country, called Japan. That is because Japan is the most despicable and audacious country in the world, which in the first half of the last century forced hundreds of thousands of women from Korea and several other countries into the humiliating sexual slavery and neither felt the slightest remorse nor reflected on its past for over a century. Nevertheless, Japan recently keeps harping on "championing women's empowerment" deceitfully in the international arenas including the UN. What is worse, it impudently seeks to cover up its past crime by paying a trivial sum of money. The sexual slavery was a crime of organized and massive abuse of women's right, perpetrated by the Japanese government and military from its contrivance to the execution as a state policy. Japan is bent on refusing to recognize its legal and moral state responsibility for the sexual slavery. Underlying it is its intention to repeat its history of aggression and crime by training not only the rising generations but also all its citizens in the spirit of revanchism and militarism. For that reason, the international community vehemently denounces the Abe government for making frantic efforts to repeat Japan's crime-ridden past by turning Japanese citizens into brutes in human skin again. However strongly it advocates "women's human rights" and whatever cunning tricks it employs, Japan cannot cover up its past crimes for the sexual slavery--the A-class state-sponsored crime against humanity that has left an indelible mark in mankind's history. If Japan refuses to reflect honestly on the nation's wrongful past and make a sincere apology for its past crime, it will continue to be subjected to strong international condemnation and it cannot evade the responsibility for the disgraceful crime of sexual slavery. Ri Hye Yong, Researcher at the Human Rights Division of the DPRK Institute of International Studies

title: Kim Yong Nam Meets Congratulatory Group of Koreans in Japan
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, on Feb. 22 met and had a talk in a compatriotic atmosphere with a congratulatory group of Koreans in Japan for celebrating the birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il (the Day of the Shining Star) led by Chairman of the Nishi Tokyo Headquarters of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan Ko Tok U at the Mansudae Assembly Hall. Rodong News Team

title: Juche Idea Lauded in DR Congo
body: It is a clear proof of the validity and vitality of the Juche idea founded by President Kim Il Sung and enriched by leader Kim Jong Il that its adherents are steadily increasing in number. Andre Lohekele Kalonda, chairman of the National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of DR Congo, said this at the inaugural ceremony of the Group for the Study of the Juche Idea for Independence in DR Congo held in Kinshasa on Feb. 8. They are pleased to see the emergence of one more Juche idea study group in DR Congo on the occasions of the 76th birth anniversary of Kim Jong Il and the 70th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Army, he said, adding: Visiting the DPRK several times, I witnessed the indomitable Korean people vigorously advancing, thwarting the vicious anti-DPRK sanctions and pressure moves of the hostile forces by dint of self-reliance and self-development. It is our bounden duty to intensify the study and dissemination of the Juche idea illumining the road ahead of the human cause of independence and extend firm support and solidarity to the Korean people in the struggle to defend the sovereignty and dignity of the country and socialism. Rodong News Team

title: Pyongyang Declaration Signed by Venezuelan Party
body: The Tupamaro Revolutionary Movement of Venezuela signed the Pyongyang Declaration "Let Us Defend and Advance the Cause of Socialism". Its National Leadership made it clear in a letter sent to the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea on Feb. 15. Rodong News Team

title: Juche Idea Study Group Formed in DR Congo
body: The Group for the Study of the Juche Idea for Independence in DR Congo was inaugurated in Kinshasa on February 8. Rodong News Team

title: Officials in Field of Forest Restoration and Land and Environment Protection Meet
body: A meeting of officials in the field of forest restoration and land and environment protection was held at the People's Palace of Culture on Feb. 21. Attending it were Premier Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea and vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, O Su Yong and other senior party and government officials, officials of ministries and national institutions and provincial, city and county party and power organs, officials in the field of forest restoration and land and environment protection and those concerned. Also present were Pak Yong Sik and other officials of the armed forces organs. The meeting analyzed and reviewed the results in carrying out the first-phase tasks for the forest restoration campaign and the successes and lessons gained in last year's general mobilization for land management, and discussed measures for achieving greater success in the work for this year. The participants watched a multimedia dealing with the performance of the first-phase tasks for the forest restoration campaign and last year's general mobilization for land management. Introduced there were the achievements made in sprucing up streets and villages as required by a highly civilized socialist country and protecting the marine resources and cultural heritages of the nation. The meeting analyzed and reviewed deviations manifested in the forest restoration campaign and the general mobilization for land management. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of Federation of Koreans in Australia Leaves
body: A delegation of the Federation of Koreans in Australia led by Chairman Pak Yong Ha left here on Feb. 21. Rodong News Team

title: Russian Embassy Officials Visit Liberation Tower
body: Staff members of the Russian embassy here laid a wreath at the Liberation Tower on Feb. 23, on the occasion of the Day of Defenders of the Motherland. Those present at the wreath-laying ceremony were Ambassador Alexandr Matsegora and Military Attache Alexei Bartusov. A wreath was laid at the tower in the name of the Russian embassy. The participants paid a silent tribute to the fallen fighters of the Soviet Army and looked round the tower. The staff members of the Russian embassy also laid a wreath and flowers at the cemetery of fallen fighters of the Soviet Army in Sadong District of Pyongyang. Earlier, they placed bouquets at liberation towers, statues of Soviet soldiers and monuments to the fallen Soviet soldiers in local areas. Rodong News Team

title: Sojourn in Pyongyang of Congratulatory Group of Koreans in Japan
body: A congratulatory group of Koreans in Japan for celebrating the Day of the Shining Star, the birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il, visited the Sci-Tech Complex. The group is led by Chairman of the Nishi Tokyo Headquarters of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan Ko Tok U. The visitors went round different parts of the complex that was wonderfully built as a model of the Juche-based architecture and a modern base for disseminating science and technology. The group also toured the Phyongchon Revolutionary Site, Pyongyang Primary School for Orphans and Pyongyang Middle School for Orphans, the Pyongyang Cosmetics Factory, etc. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Sultan of Brunei Darussalam
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, on Feb. 23 sent a message of greeting to Haji Hassanal Bolkiah, sultan and head of state of Brunei Darussalam, on the occasion of its national holiday. Expressing pleasure over the development of the friendly relations between the two countries on good terms, Kim Yong Nam in his message sincerely wished the sultan good health and happiness and the people of Brunei Darussalam well-being and prosperity. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to President of Guyana
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, on Feb. 23 sent a message of greeting to David Arthur Granger, president of the Cooperative Republic of Guyana, on the occasion of the 48th anniversary of its proclamation. Expressing belief that the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation between the two countries would grow stronger, the message sincerely wished the president good health and bigger success in his responsible work for progress and prosperity of the country. Rodong News Team

title: GFTUK Delegation Leaves for Iran
body: A delegation of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea (GFTUK) led by Kim Tong Son, vice-chairman of its Central Committee, left Pyongyang on Feb. 23 to take part in the meeting of the Presidential Council of the World Federation of Trade Unions to be held in Iran. Rodong News Team

title: Nuclear Force of DPRK Is Powerful Weapon for Defending Peace
body: The nuclear force of the DPRK is the powerful treasured sword for defending peace as it can decisively tackle the nuclear threats and blackmail from the U.S. It is entirely just for the DPRK to bolster up its strength. Concession to the imperialists and asking them for aid is a foolish act of inviting self-destruction as their nature is aggression and plunder. Every country can guarantee genuine peace and security only when its military strength is strong enough to smash any move of aggressors and provokers. Our army is putting spurs to deploying nuclear warheads and ballistic rockets whose power and reliability have already been proved. The U.S. and its vassal forces brand the nuclear force of the DPRK as "threat to world peace and security". This is nothing but a miserable scream made by those who have a premonition of their destruction. It goes to prove that our nuclear force becomes the means meting out a horrible punishment to the aggressors. Neither sanctions nor provocations nor threats can ever undermine our position of nuclear weapons state. Hoping that the DPRK would abandon its nuclear programs is as foolish an act as trying to wish seas to get dried up. It would be a wise option to take the stand to peacefully co-exist with the DPRK which has towered as a strategic state. An Chol Gwon

title: Russian Ambassador and Military Attache Host Reception
body: Ambassador Alexandr Matsegora and Military Attache Alexei Bartusov of the Russian embassy in Pyongyang gave a reception at the Taedonggang Diplomatic Club on Feb. 22 to mark the Day of Defenders of the Motherland. Present there on invitation were Army Col. General Kim Hyong Ryong, vice-minister of the People's Armed Forces, generals and officers of the Korean People's Army, officials concerned, and representatives and military attaches of foreign embassies in Pyon gyang. Staff members of the Russian embassy were on hand. Rodong News Team

title: KNPC Spokesman Blasts U.S.-Japan War Drills
body: A spokesman for the Korean National Peace Committee in a statement on Feb. 22 accused the U.S. and Japanese warmongers of staging "combined air-defence and missile-shielding drill" from Feb. 16 under the pretext of tackling "threats" from the DPRK's ballistic rocket and fighters. The exercises which will last until Feb. 23 reportedly include the inspection of the system for joint detection, tracking and interception of the DPRK's ballistic rockets and fighters through the coordinated operation of the air-defence network of the U.S. and Japan, and also the interception drill of Patriot missile units under the Japan Air "Self-Defense Force" and the emergency sortie drill of its fighters. The recent drill assumes greater bellicosity and danger as its scope has been expanded as never before with the involvement of the Japan Air SDF and U.S. marines and air force units as well as the Japan Maritime SDF and units of the U.S. navy. Branding this as a ferocious gangster-like act aimed to tarnish the hard-won atmosphere for the improvement of the north-south ties and for peace on the Korean peninsula, and as a dangerous military provocation to ignite the train of a war, the statement said: The American empire is a heinous rogue state which seeks to maintain a military edge and achieve its hegemonic ambition under the signboard of "defence of allies" in Asia-Pacific. The islanders of Japan are crafty men eyeing militarist revival and the materialization of their old dream of the "Greater East Asia Co-prosperity Sphere" with the help of the U.S. master. The reckless war hysteria of the U.S. and Japan proves who the chieftain standing against Korea's reconciliation and unity and harassing peace on the Korean peninsula is. We will never remain an onlooker to the gangsters about to brandish swords. The U.S. and Japanese reactionaries should not run wild, mindful that if they dare provoke the DPRK which has towered as a nuclear power in the East, a world-level strategic state, not properly facing up to the changed world, that will only endanger their security and existence. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Il's Birth Anniversary Marked in DR Congo
body: The preparatory committee of DR Congo for celebrating the birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il issued a bulletin on Feb. 1. The bulletin carried an article titled "Birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il" and articles under the subtitles of "Mysterious wonders of nature," etc. Elaborating on the mysterious natural phenomena that presented themselves on Mt Paektu at the time of Kim Jong Il's birth, the bulletin said: Though the Koreans suffered from the Japanese imperialists' military occupation, they regarded as a beacon of hope Mt Paektu where General Kim Il Sung was conducting brisk activities while leading the anti-Japanese armed units. So, the news of the birth of the Shining Star of Mt Paektu Kim Jong Il, who would carry forward the cause of Kim Il Sung, was the greatest event for the Korean people. Anti-Japanese fighters couldn't suppress the impulse to make the happy news known to all Koreans and so they carved words on barked trees in the forest. Leader Kim Jong Il carried forward the idea and cause of President Kim Il Sung without an inch of deflection true to the wishes and expectations of anti-Japanese fighters and the people. He enjoyed boundless reverence from the world progressives as a peerlessly great man as he glorified socialist Korea and dynamically advanced the human cause of independence. Rodong News Team

title: Art Troupe of Koreans in Japan Leaves
body: An art troupe of Koreans in Japan for celebrating the Day of the Shining Star headed by Ha Yong Su left Pyongyang on Feb. 24. Rodong News Team

title: Congratulatory Group of Koreans in Japan Leaves
body: A congratulatory group of Koreans in Japan for celebrating the Day of the Shining Star led by Ko Tok U, chairman of the Nishi Tokyo Headquarters of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan, left Pyongyang on Feb. 24. Rodong News Team

title: Dangerous Scheme for Cyber-attack on DPRK
body: The Trump administration put all the intelligence agencies on an alert, ordering them to get ready to mount cyber attack prior to the launch of a military attack on the DPRK after working out a plan for it, according to the U.S. magazine Foreign Policy. The U.S. preparations for cyber attack on the DPRK clearly reveal once again the despicable nature of the American rogue state as the harasser of reunification, disturber of peace and the chieftain of aggression. The U.S. should drop its pipedream to realize its aggression ambition through cyber attack on the DPRK. The DPRK is an invincible military power acknowledged by the world. We can certainly respond to any war mode wanted by the U.S. as we have everything in place and are ready to cope with anything. If the U.S. finally ignites a train of a war in pursuit of its reckless ambition for the invasion of the DPRK, that will end up in the final ruin of the American empire. The U.S. should not run wild, clearly understanding its rival. Un Jong Chol

title: Illusion about Imperialists' "Aid" Will Lead to Ruin
body: To expect to get benefit from the "aid" of the imperialists, while pinning hope on it, is little short of pricking one's own eyes with one's own hands. The imperialists' "aid" is a noose for plunder and subordination for usurping more from what was given and a tool for realizing their strategy for world domination. To hope for "aid" from the imperialists will precisely lead to ruin and to harbor illusion about the imperialists will end up in destruction. This is an iron truth and lesson taught by history. One should never pin hope nor harbor illusion about "aid" from them but maintain Juche character and national identity. This is the only way for defending a country, achieving its prosperity and building earlier a new independent world. To build economy in reliance on others while failing to build an independent national economy would never guarantee the independent development of a country and a nation. The practical experience of our revolution is a living example proving that only when Juche character and national identity are preserved and strong self-supporting national economy is built, can the sovereignty of a country be defended and the dignity and honor of a nation be glorified. We have so far built the self-supporting national economy while maintaining the Juche-oriented line all the time, unperturbed by any pressure. That's why we are dynamically advancing toward the final victory of building a powerful socialist nation despite the vicious sanctions and blockade imposed by the imperialists. Ri Hak Nam

title: Seminar on Juche Idea Held in India
body: An Indian national seminar on the Juche idea took place in New Delhi on Feb. 9 under the theme of "The Basic Key to World Peace - Equality and Emancipation" on the occasion of the birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il. Attending it were personages of the Society for the Study of Kim Jong Il's Works, the Juche Philosophy Study Committee, the Delhi State Government and University of Delhi in India, the Asian Regional Institute of the Juche Idea and the International Institute of the Juche Idea (IIJI) and followers of the Juche idea. Present on invitation were the DPRK ambassador to India and his embassy officials. Harish Gupta, director general of the Asian Regional Institute of the Juche Idea who is vice-director general of the IIJI, made a keynote report at the seminar before speeches. The reporter and speakers praised the ideo-theoretical feats of leader Kim Jong Il who developed in depth the Juche idea, founded by President Kim Il Sung, into the guiding idea in the era of independence. They said that the reality of the DPRK, which is dynamically advancing towards a socialist power despite the ceaseless challenges and extreme sanctions and pressure of the imperialist allied forces, clearly proves the validity and vitality of the Juche idea. Kim Jong Il's famous works including "On the Juche Idea" and "Socialism Is a Science" serve as priceless ideological and theoretical pabulum and an inspiring banner for the progressives advocating independence, they stressed. They noted that he firmly defended socialism with the treasured sword of Songun in the period of unprecedented ordeals and put the DPRK on the position of a nuclear weapons state. The DPRK is a beacon of hope giving great strength and courage to the progressive people aspiring after equality, emancipation, peace and justice, they stressed. A letter to respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was adopted at the seminar. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Shining Star Observed Abroad
body: Events took place in different countries between Feb. 7 and 16 to celebrate the birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il. There were Kimjongilia show and book and photo exhibition in Russia and Mongolia and visit to the Kimilsungia greenhouse in Guinea. Displayed at their venues were photos showing the revolutionary careers and feats of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il and the revolutionary activities of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. There were also flowers of the sun in full bloom, works of the peerlessly great men and books and photos introducing the reality of the DPRK. Speeches were made there. The director of the Bureau for International Cooperation of the Maritime Territory Administration of Russia said Kim Jong Il is a great man and a world-famous statesman recognized by mankind and that the sacred marks he left in Vladivostok City are kept in the hearts of the Russian people. The secretary of the Regional Political Council of the Maritime Territorial Branch of the United Russian Party stressed that the feats of Kim Jong Il who put the dignity and national strength of the DPRK on the highest stage would remain forever. The chairman of the Kimjongilia Association of Mongolia said that they would make a positive contribution to the development of the friendly relations between the two countries by organizing Kimjongilia shows on important occasions in the future, too. The vice-chairman of the Kimilsungia-Kimjongilia Association of Guinea said that Kim Jong Il is always alive in the hearts of the Korean people and the world progressives with the immortal flower Kimjongilia. The secretary to the minister of Higher Education and Scientific Research of Guinea said that the Korean people are a happy people blessed with the illustrious leaders generation after generation and their future is rosy as they have another illustrious leader. Rodong News Team

title: Best Scientists and Technicians of State for 2017 Selected
body: Five persons were selected as the best scientists and technicians of the state for Juche 106 (2017) in the DPRK. According to an official concerned, they played a key role in achieving distinguished sci-tech successes conducive to sci-tech and economic development and the improvement of people's living standard. Dr. Rim Chang Ho, head of the Medical Sci-tech Exchange Company of Pyongyang Medical College of Kim Il Sung University, made a great contribution to developing visual electrodiagnostic testing system. Dr. and Associate Prof. Choe Tong Il, head of the Machine Designing Institute of Pyongyang University of Mechanical Engineering, conducted researches into putting the sanitary goods production process of the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Silk Mill on unmanned basis and established the unmanned production processes at some units. Dr. and Associate Prof. Ryang Ji Song, a researcher of the IT Institute of Kim Chaek University of Technology, presented a new principle and method for developing and introducing a perfect information preserving translation system based on compress representation of a finite structured object. Dr., Associate Prof. and Merited Scientist Ri Yong Il, head of the Paper Engineering Institute of the State Academy of Sciences, developed more than 10 kinds of functional paper goods like precision filter tip and high efficiency air filtration paper and completed the multi-functional paper production process. Dr., Associate Prof. and Merited Scientist Kim Tok Su, head of the Electric Power System Institute of Kim Chaek University of Technology, suggested a plan for controlling high-speed ski lift of the Masikryong Ski Resort and established electric power control system at the ski resort. He also played a key role in developing the CNC-based load power control system and contributed to establishing the national integrated power control system and putting several industrial establishments on a modern basis. Rodong News Team

title: Sci-tech Festival of Kim Chaek University of Technology Held
body: The 33rd Festival of Science and Technology of Kim Chaek University of Technology took place on Feb. 20-23. The festival was held in the form of presentation and exhibition, divided into nine panels including machine industry, IT, metal and mining, energy and basic science. It was attended by teachers, researchers, postgraduates and students at the university. Presented to the festival were more than 200 scientific research achievements and hi-tech products conductive to the integration of science and technology and economy. Rodong News Team

title: Seminar of Korean Social Scientists in Japan
body: A seminar of Korean social scientists in Japan was held at the Central Hall of Chongryon (the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan) in Tokyo on Feb. 17 to celebrate the 76th birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il. Attending it were Kim Song Hun, director of the Department for Publicity and Culture of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, Chairman Ri Yong Su and members of the Korean Social Scientists Association in Japan and other officials of Chongryon. Ri Yong Su said in a report that Kim Jong Il devoted his whole life to providing the strongest national defense capabilities to reliably defend the nation's dignity and the country's sovereignty and performed undying feats. He praised respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un for translating into brilliant reality Kim Jong Il's patriotic wish for a powerful nation. He noted that the New Year Address of Kim Jong Un is a highly important document as it carries his far-reaching plan and resolution and fighting strategy to usher in a new era of the country's prosperity by taking the historic victory in the building of the DPRK's nuclear force as a springboard for fresh progress. Speakers at the seminar gave detailed explanations of the present context and the future of the standoff between the DPRK, which towered as a strategic state with dignity, and the U.S. and the struggle of all compatriots for making a breakthrough for independent reunification. Rodong News Team

title: 23rd Winter Olympics Closes
body: The 23rd Winter Olympics which opened in Phyongchang of south Korea on Feb. 9 came to a close. Its closing ceremony was held at the Phyongchang Olympic Stadium on Feb. 25. Present there were a high-level delegation of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea led by Kim Yong Chol, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and its National Olympic Committee delegation and cheering group and a cheering group of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan. Attending it were President Moon Jae In and personages of political and social circles of south Korea, President of the International Olympic Committee Thomas Bach, high-ranking personages from different countries, foreign guests and sports fans. When the players of the north and south of Korea and other players and agents of different countries and regions of the world participating in the 23rd Winter Olympics entered the stadium, the spectators welcomed them with applause. Kim Yong Chol and President Moon Jae In and his wife stood up to wave to the players of the north and the south when they were going past the platform. Amid the playing of the Olympic anthem, the Olympic flag was pulled down and conveyed to the host country of the 24th Winter Olympics. The chairperson of the organizing committee of the 23rd Winter Olympics and the president of IOC made speeches to be followed by a declaration of the close of the Olympics and the fire on the cauldron was put out. Prior to the closing ceremony, Kim Yong Chol met and exchanged warm greetings with the DPRK players participating in the Olympics. Rodong News Team

title: Press Statement of DPRK Permanent Mission to UN
body: The Permanent Mission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) to the United Nations on February 22 issued the following press statement with regard to the inappropriate remarks made by the UN secretary-general against the DPRK at the Munich Security Conference: As is known to all, the UN secretary-general, in his address at the Security Conference held in Munich of Germany, made senseless remarks about the so-called "pressure through sanctions" against the DPRK, while referring to the strengthening of nuclear force of the DPRK as contradiction to the will of the international community. This is completely unreasonable sophistry that does not befit at all his position as UN secretary-general, giving us an impression that he is an advocate of the United States. The nuclear issue of the Korean peninsula came into being and reached the present point, entirely due to the U.S., and thus, the U.S. should bear full responsibility for it. The nuclear issue of the Korean peninsula would not have been brought up at all, if there had not been anti-DPRK hostile policy pursued by the U.S. from the first day of the foundation of the DPRK and if the hostile policy had not been developed to take the form of undisguised nuclear blackmail and threats against the DPRK. The remarks of the secretary-general cannot be construed otherwise than a disgraceful behavior driven by extreme prejudice and injustice, as he condemned the righteous measure of the DPRK, without saying a word about the U.S., a culprit of aggravated situation, intentionally turning a blind eye to the essence and its underlying cause of the nuclear issue of the Korean peninsula. The secretary-general should be clearly aware that nuclear threats come from the U.S. that is developing all kinds of sophisticated nuclear weapons and exposing its wild ambition for nuclear preemptive strike, and he would be well advised not to behave like somnambulist. Our state nuclear force serves as strong deterrent to any nuclear threat and reckless military provocation of the U.S., and therefore, it will never pose threat to any country or region unless they infringe upon the sovereignty and interests of the DPRK. If the secretary-general is truly interested in addressing the nuclear issue of the Korean peninsula, it would be advisable that he immediately brings to the attention of the UN Security Council the issue of welcoming the process of improved inter-Korean relations and discouraging neighboring countries from disturbing the process, as has been requested by the letter dated 31 January of the DPRK foreign minister forwarded to the secretary-general. Rodong News Team

title: KAPPC Urges Japanese Authorities to Prevent Terrorism against Chongryon and Koreans in Japan
body: A spokesman for the Korea Asia-Pacific Peace Committee (KAPPC) on Feb. 25 issued a statement as regards the fact that in recent days the Japanese authorities and right-wing reactionaries are getting very serious in their hysteria against our Republic and the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon). Around 03:50, Feb. 23 two Japanese right-wingers with arms committed the heinous terrorist crime, firing several bullets at the hall in which Chongryon headquarters. The Chongryon Central Standing Committee speaks for the dignity, right and interests of Chongryon organizations and Koreans in Japan and is playing the role as a diplomatic mission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea under the present situation that the diplomatic ties have not been established between the DPRK and Japan. The statement said that from the formation of Chongryon up to this date the successive Japanese governments and right-wing reactionaries have made all sorts of misdeeds against Chongryon organizations and Koreans in Japan, but they did not fire at the Central Hall of Chongryon, the inviolable area in which the DPRK's sovereignty is exercised. It went on: The Japanese right-wing gangsters' terrorism against the Central Hall of Chongryon is not merely an accident but a deliberate politically-motivated provocation and heinous crime against the DPRK and Chongryon committed by the Japanese reactionaries with the sinister intention to extremely strain the situation on the Korean peninsula and revive militarism and realize their old dream of the "Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere" taking advantage of it. The Japanese authorities are misleading public opinion as if the recent incident happened by an individual body and person while investigating the criminals arrested but it is little short of a clumsy excuse to cover up their sinister intention. It is an open challenge to the DPRK and a prelude to overall crackdown upon Chongryon that the Japanese authorities made right-wing gangsters fire at the hall, not content with making desperate efforts to realize their impossible pipedream. The more desperately the Japanese reactionaries go in their moves against the DPRK and Chongryon, the more clearly they reveal their despicable true color as disturber of peace and war servant before the world. The Japanese authorities would be well advised to disclose the background and truth behind the shooting spree to the end, mete out a stern punishment to the chief culprits and accomplices and take a special measure to prevent the reoccurrence of violent crime and terrorism against Chongryon and Koreans in Japan. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Kuwait Emir
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on Feb. 25 sent a message of greeting to Sabah Al－Ahmad Al－Jaber Al-Sabah, emir of the State of Kuwait, on the occasion of the 57th anniversary of its independence and the 27th anniversary of its liberation. Kim in his message wished the emir good health and bigger success in his work for the country's development and prosperity, expressing belief that the friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries would develop in the common interests. Rodong News Team

title: Unpardonable Maneuvers to Aggravate Situation on Korean Peninsula
body: The U.S. is trying to resume joint military exercises in collusion with the south Korean military warmongers under the veil of annual ones. It is the dangerous reckless act bringing the situation on the Korean peninsula in which the climate of detente is created back to the super tensions that the U.S. tries to resume joint military exercises by instigating south Korean military warmongers. The U.S. is going to kick off nuclear war exercises at any cost, going against the climate of detente on the Korean peninsula. Its act is designed to bedevil the situation by fanning up confrontation between the north and the south and provide justification for open interference in south Korea and keep up strategic control over it which is shaken to its foundation. The joint maneuvers are a heinous aggression war, nuclear war of the U.S. which works hard to impose nuclear disaster upon the Korean nation and stain the inviolable land of the DPRK with the blood of its people, both in name and in reality. The service personnel and people of the DPRK can never allow them. If the U.S. resumes the joint military exercises together with the south Korean puppet forces, all the army and people of the DPRK will resolutely cope with them. Ri Kyong Su

title: Reckless War Hysteria of Peace Wreckers
body: The U.S. and Japanese warmongers staged "combined air-defence and missile-shielding drill" from Feb. 16 to 23. In the war gamble they went frantic with joint detection, tracking and interception of the DPRK's ballistic rockets and fighters through the coordinated operation of the air-defence networks of the U.S. and Japan, interception drill of Patriot missile units under the Japan Air "Self-Defense Force" and the emergency sortie drill of fighters. The U.S. and Japanese reactionaries' reckless act is the dangerous military provocation for spoiling the hard-won atmosphere for improvement of the north-south relations and peace on the Korean peninsula and provoking a war. It is the headache for the U.S. obsessed with its stratagem for dominating Asia-Pacific and Japanese reactionaries going frantic with moves for reviving militarism and reinvasion that the situation on the Korean peninsula is eased. The U.S. is working hard to realize its ambition for hegemony at any cost by building up armed forces in the Asia-Pacific region and staging frantic war exercises under the pretext of the "threat" from someone. The Japanese reactionaries are also foolishly trying to realize their old dream of the "Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere" with the backing of their U.S. master overheated with war fever. The U.S. and Japanese reactionaries' reckless war hysteria clearly proves who the arch criminal bringing clouds of a nuclear war to hang over the Korean peninsula is while disturbing the reconciliation and unity of the Korean nation. Tiger moth fond of playing with fire is bound to perish in the flames. The U.S. and Japanese reactionaries should stop acting rashly, properly understanding who their rival is. Jang Jong Chol

title: U.S. Blasted for Hurling Stream of Abuse
body: The Trump group is going frantic with the anti-DPRK smear campaign, much upset by the daily-increasing climate of the improvement of inter-Korean ties. U.S. Vice-President Pence said at a conservative group meeting in Maryland State on Feb. 23 that an era of strategic patience for the DPRK ended and the U.S. would show its decisive will until the DPRK stops threatening the U.S. and its allies and totally abandons the nuclear and missile program. What is more intolerable is that he dared to describe the first vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, who attended the opening ceremony of the Winter Olympics in south Korea as a congratulatory mission, as "center of vicious regime" or "pillar of oppressive regime". In this regard, a spokesman for the Korea Asia-Pacific Peace Committee on Feb. 24 issued a statement condemning Pence's disgraceful behavior as an act of rogue without an equal in the world. Unpardonable are that Pence dared to defame the inviolable DPRK government, terming it "dictatorial regime", and absurdly slandered our congratulatory missions including the first vice department director of the WPK Central Committee, the statement said, adding: It is the mettle of our army and people sharing their destinies with their leader and their social system to find out and punish without mercy those insulting the dignity of the supreme leadership and the social system of the DPRK no matter whoever and wherever they are. Pence will have a wearing time, witnessing what quagmire his crazy remarks threw the U.S. and himself into. Trump, who is taking such bete noire as Pence under his wings, should be well aware that we will never beg for dialogue in any case and, particularly, have no dealings with those viciously slandering the dignity of our supreme leadership and government. We will never have face-to-face talks with them even after 100 years or 200 years. This is neither an empty talk nor any threat. The U.S. will have to pay dearly for stupid and wild vituperation. Rodong News Team

title: Chongryon Blasts Terrorism of Japanese Right-wing Gangsters
body: Nam Sung U, vice-chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), called a press conference at the Central Hall of Chongryon in Tokyo on Feb. 23 as regards terrorism by Japanese right-wing gangsters. Present there were media persons of Chongryon, Japan and south Korea. The vice-chairman made public a statement at the conference. The statement branded the terrorism against Chongryon as an unpardonable challenge to the DPRK and the Korean residents in Japan. The Chongryon Central Standing Committee resolutely denounces such sordid terrorism in the name of all Koreans in Japan, it stressed.
