The recent shooting spree is not simply an accident but a planned crime committed against the background of the Japanese authority's hostile policy toward the DPRK and Chongryon, the statement pointed out. It said that the Japanese authority can never evade the blame for failing to prevent such terrorism. The statement strongly demanded that the Japanese authority bring the two criminals to heavy punishment and inquire into the hidden circumstances of the case and take proper measures to prevent the reoccurrence of such case. Then, he answered questions put by reporters. Rodong News Team

title: Japanese Right-wing Roughs Take Potshots at Chongryon Central Hall
body: Japanese right-wing roughs committed an act of terrorism by taking potshots at the Central Hall of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) in Tokyo on Feb. 23. At dawn that day two gangsters, who got off a black car before the hall and hanged around there, sprayed bullets into the gate and were arrested while fleeing. According to the confirmation of the case, the chief plotter is Satoshi Katsurada, who drove the car, and the shooter is Yoshinori Kawamura. Satoshi Katsurada is reportedly a diehard right-wing extremist terrorist who was once deputy head of a Japanese right-wing organization. His stooge Yoshinori Kawamura was the ringleader of a gang of roughs and his present regular job is to perpetrate terrorism. When those terrorists were arrested by the police, several rightist gangs of Japan thronged into the Chongryon Central Hall, raising a disturbance. The said crime is not an accident but an intolerable reckless act against the DPRK and the Koreans in Japan. It was a deliberate act of terrorism of the right-wing gang timed to coincide with the enforcement of the provocative anti-DPRK tough policy by the Abe group and the creation of the gruesome climate of the daily-escalating suppression of Chongryon. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korean Body Slams U.S. Moves for Stifling DPRK
body: The Headquarters for the Actions against Trump and the U.S. in south Korea held a press conference in Seoul on February 24 in protest against the U.S. new sanctions and moves for igniting a nuclear war against the DPRK, according to the south Korean internet newspaper Minjok Ilbo. Speakers at the conference slammed Trump for slapping the worst sanctions against the DPRK and disturbing the peaceful reunification of the Korean peninsula at a time when an atmosphere of peace and reunification was growing strong in the peninsula. A press release was read out there. It branded Trump as the arch criminal scuttling the reconciliation and unity between the south and the north of Korea, blocking the peace and reunification of the Korean peninsula and increasing the danger of war. It expressed the will to intensify the struggle against Trump, the U.S. and war. Rodong News Team

title: Japan Should Chuck Up Ambition for Reinvasion
body: The Japanese aggressors forced the feudal government of Korea to sign the "Kanghwa Island Treaty", an aggressive, subordinate and unequal treaty, on Feb. 27, 1876. On the strength of this treaty, the Japanese militarists thrust their tentacles of aggression into politics, economy, military and other fields of Korea. They cooked up "Ulsa Five-point Treaty" in 1905 to totally occupy Korea by force of arms and had imposed immeasurable sufferings, misfortune and disasters upon the Korean people by enforcing a cruel colonial rule for more than 40 years. It is the legal and moral obligation for Japan to make a sincere apology and reparation to the Korean nation for its past crimes. However, Japan has distorted the blood-stained history of aggression, openly revealing its ambition for reinvasion through the retrogressive revision of the constitution, scenario to turn Japan into a military power and large-scale joint military exercises with the U.S. But these reckless acts are nothing but ridiculous and foolish behavior of the Japanese militarists. The Korean nation is no longer a weak nation which had to sign such brigandish and unequal treaty and live as a colonial slave with no force to protect itself. Jong Won Jun

title: Brazen-Faced Utterance for "Justifying" Modernization of Nukes
body: U.S. President Trump called governors and mayors to the White House some days ago where he said that the U.S. expands nuclear arsenal and modernizes nuclear weapons because other countries do so. He expressed his hope that those countries would abandon nuclear ambition, adding that if they suspend the development of nuclear weapons and their sophistication, the U.S. will also do in just two minutes. This is sophism distorting the essence of the event and its historical ground and phenomenon. The U.S. was the first country to produce a nuclear weapon on this planet and it is the only nuclear criminal that used it. It is the U.S. which must abandon nuclear ambition before others. If the U.S. opts for nuclear dismantlement, away from the wild ambition to dominate the world with absolute nuclear upper-hand, the denuclearization issue of the world will be easily settled. Trump's rhetoric that other countries have to suspend nuclear development and modernization first is a far-fetched assertion of a political idiot completely reversing the priority concerning the settlement of the issue. The more the U.S. justifies its nuclear modernization through the hackneyed way of vociferating about the nuclear threat from outside, the more fully it will disclose its nature as a shameless nuclear criminal. With no sleight of hand can the U.S. evade its responsibility as the world's worst nuclear criminal state. Ri Hyo Jin

title: Outbursts about "Threat"of Those Mad with Reinvasion
body: Days ago, Prime Minister Abe and Defense Minister Onodera of Japan at a public meeting said that hundreds of Rodong missiles with the whole land of Japan in the striking range have been deployed in the DPRK, stressing the need to introduce long-range missiles capable of removing "threat from north Korea" into Japan on the principle of "exclusive defense". The Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology of Japan is going to distribute the "guidelines to cope with crisis" containing the way of evacuation from ballistic missile launch of the DPRK to schools across Japan to be used from March. Meanwhile, the Japanese reactionaries let conservative experts spread rumor that an "assassination unit" of the DPRK may be hidden in Tokyo or Osaka and that big cities of Japan would be targets of such terrorism in case of a war between the DPRK and the U.S. This tells that they are making desperate efforts to create terror-ridden atmosphere in the society of Japan under the pretence of "threat" from the DPRK. The Abe group is seeking to attain its vile political aims for revival of militarism and reinvasion by actively spreading the rumor of "threat" from the DPRK. Their campaign is designed to justify their frantic suppression of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan and anti-DPRK hostile acts and thus evade the denunciation from the international community. The arch criminal fostering unrest and terror in the society of Japan is none other than the Abe group and it is the Japanese people that are suffering the biggest damage from it. Japan should stop such foolish act of inviting disasters to it, clearly understanding the strategic position of the DPRK and the trend of the times. Ra Sol Ha

title: DPRK National Olympic Committee Delegation Arrives in Pyongyang
body: A delegation of the National Olympic Committee of the DPRK led by Minister of Physical Culture and Sports Kim Il Guk who is chairman of the DPRK Olympic Committee, arrived in Pyongyang on Feb. 26 after taking part in the 23rd Winter Olympics in south Korea. The delegation came back together with the DPRK's sports team, cheering group and press corps, via Kaesong. Earlier, the Taekwon-do demonstration group of the DPRK returned in Pyongyang after finishing the scheduled joint demonstrations of the north and south Taekwondoists. Rodong News Team

title: U.S. Imperialists Are Sworn Enemy of Korean People
body: The U.S. imperialists are the sworn enemy of the Korean people. The U.S. imperialists' occupation of south Korea and their policy for aggression on Korea are the root cause of all misfortunes of the Korean nation. It is the U.S. imperialists that divided the homogeneous nation of the same blood, which has lived in one territory for over 5 000 years, into two. It is also the aggressor U.S. which occupied south Korea militarily and has imposed untold misfortunes and sufferings on our people, resorting to the ceaseless nuclear war provocations against the DPRK. The DPRK and the U.S. are still at a truce. The U.S. imperialists are our belligerent. Much upset by the situation that our Republic rapidly emerged a world-level nuclear power, military power, the Trump group is recklessly persisting in the nuclear war moves. The U.S. imperialists remain unchanged in their black-hearted intention to invade our republic. They never present peace and reunification to the Korean nation. Our nation will never forget their crimes for all ages but make them pay dearly for the crimes. Ri Hyon Do

title: Resumption of Military Exercises Is Challenge to DPRK
body: As known, as the door to dialogue was opened between the north and the south after a long stall and the trend for improvement of their relations was seen, the Trump group became vociferous about the immediate resumption of Key Resolve and Foal Eagle joint military drills after the Winter Olympics. The resumption of joint military exercises is a vicious challenge to the entire Korean nation hoping for détente and durable peace on the Korean peninsula and the DPRK making all possible efforts for the improvement of the north-south relations. It, therefore, can never be tolerated. The peaceful environment on the Korean peninsula is a prerequisite to the improvement of the north-south ties. However, the U.S. and its followers are trying hard to resume the exercises and thus quench the spirit for the improvement of the north-south ties and strain the military stand-off and tension to the maximum and, furthermore, stifle the DPRK by force at any cost. Now the Trump group is calling for the resumption of the exercises on one hand and it is introducing huge preemptive attack means such as nuclear carrier and nuclear strategic bombers to and around south Korea on the other hand while spreading the story about "preventive preemptive attack" on someone. If the U.S. resumes the joint military exercises, we will resolutely counter them. Pak Chol Jun

title: Driving Force of Korea's Reunification Is Korean Nation
body: For the north-south relations to continue to make progress, it is important to firmly maintain the stand of settling the issue of the north-south relations by the Korean nation itself on the principle of national independence. The driving force of the country's reunification is the Korean nation itself. It is the Korean nation which has vital interests in the reunification and it is also the Korean nation which has the ability for it. Only when the Koreans with ardent desire for the country's reunification pool their thinking and efforts, will it be possible to smoothly settle the reunification issue in line with the desire and interests of the nation. If the north and the south pool intention and will while firmly maintaining the independent stand, no anti-reunification moves of outsiders can prove successful and a new turning phase will surely open in the improvement of the north-south ties. All the Koreans in the north and the south and abroad should wage more courageous actions for independent reunification of the country, resolutely foiling the outsiders' interference in the internal issue of the nation, the country's reunification issue and obstruction moves against it, under the uplifted banner of By Our Nation Itself. Ra Sol Ha

title: S. Korean Conservatives' Bid to Come Back to Power
body: Now the atmosphere of improved inter-Korean relations prevails on the Korean Peninsula thanks to the DPRK's proactive and sincere efforts and the expectation and interest of south Korean people are towering as the days go by. Whereas, the conservatives in south Korea, including the "Liberal Korea Party", are trembling with fear. The south Korean conservatives, obsessed with fear that they would totally be defeated, make desperate efforts to win the mindset of people who turned their backs on them, vociferating about "nuclear threats" from the DPRK, "strengthened alliance" with the U.S. and "mega-merger of conservatives". The reality shows that while disturbing the improvement of the north-south relations in every way, they leave no means untried to take the initiative in political situation and rally the conservatives and thus lay a springboard for coming back to power in the elections for local governing bodies due in June. For this sinister purpose they add to the atmosphere for confrontation between fellow countrymen in the society of south Korea, talking about "nuclear threats" from the DPRK and building up public opinion that their only way is to strengthen the "alliance" with the U.S. in an attempt to justify their sycophantic treacheries. And they try to put down the demand of the south Korean people for removing evils, talking about "renovation" and "new conservatism", and seek "mega-merger of conservatives." No matter how desperately the south Korean conservatives may try to go against the trend of the times, they can never save their declined destiny, and the destruction of conservatism is a matter of time. Ri Hong Chol

title: Kim Yong Nam Meets Indian Ambassadress
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the DPRK Supreme People's Assembly, had a talk with Jasminder Kasturia, Indian ambassadress to the DPRK who made a farewell call on him, at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Feb. 27. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to President of Dominica
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, on Feb. 27 sent a message of greeting to Danilo Medina Sanchez, president of the Republic of Dominica, on the occasion of the 174th anniversary of its independence. Extending sincere congratulations to the president and people of Dominica, Kim in the message wished the president success in his work for the prosperity of the country and wellbeing of its people. Rodong News Team

title: Discrimination against Korean Schools Unabated in Japan
body: The Gunma prefectural authorities of Japan suspended the payment of subsidies to the Korean junior and middle school in the prefecture on Feb. 26 amid the Japanese government's unabated discrimination against Korean schools in Japan. The authorities decided not to include the subsidies to the school in their 2018 budget on the unreasonable grounds that the school has not been true to the "provisions" it is obliged to carry out. Those "provisions" are that the school should specify the "abduction issue" in textbooks and cease its ties with the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan. Rodong News Team

title: WPK Congratulates Mongolian People's Party
body: The Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) in a message on Feb. 28 congratulated the Central Committee of the Mongolian People's Party (MPP) on its 97th founding anniversary. The message said the MPP has registered big successes in the work for achieving the national unity and the independent development and prosperity of the country. Expressing belief that the friendly and cooperative relations between the two parties based on long history and good traditions would further develop in the interests and desire of the peoples of the two countries, the message sincerely wished the MPP bigger success in its activities. Rodong News Team

title: Japan Authorities Can Never Evade Blame for Shooting Spree against Chongryon
body: Two armed right-wing elements of Japan went roughshod outside the Central Hall of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), firing several bullets into its entrance. This seriously threatened the safety of officials of Chongryon, an overseas citizens' organization of the DPRK, and other Koreans in Japan, and damaged the building. The Japanese authorities, who started investigation into the arrested criminals, have so far pretended ignorance, to give impression that the case was committed by an individual organization or person. The crafty moves of the Japanese authorities are the hackneyed method used by them to connive at and foster the criminal acts whenever right-wing gangsters committed terrorist acts against Chongryon. The Japanese authorities let the right-wing gangsters hold arms and open fire into the Central Hall of Chongryon, being seized by the ambition for reinvasion. This unpardonable act is an open challenge to the DPRK and a prelude to the overall suppression of Chongryon. The Japanese reactionaries should clearly understand that their frantic moves to stamp out the DPRK and Chongryon will only reveal their dirty nature as the chieftain of terrorism and harasser of peace, and bring them bitterer shame in the world's eyes. The circumstances and truth about the shooting incident have to be probed into in an all-round way. The Japanese authorities can never get rid of the responsibility for the incident and they should bring the chief criminals and accomplices to severe punishment and take special measures so that violent crimes and terrorist acts against Chongryon and Koreans in Japan would never happen again. The Japanese authorities and right-wing gangsters should not run wild, pondering over the serious consequences to be entailed by all sorts of discrimination and suppression of Chongryon and Koreans in Japan. Jo Nam Su

title: Trump Group's Scheme to Spoil Mood for Improved Inter-Korean Ties
body: Top officials of the U.S. intelligence bodies, including the directors of the National Intelligence Agency and the Central Intelligence Agency, at Congressional hearing and other public appearances claimed that the DPRK's ultimate goal is to achieve unification by communizing the south through the nuclear weapons. The assistant to the president for National Security of the White House said that the DPRK's nuclear weapons are to be used for threatening for the purpose of unifying the Korean peninsula under the red flag. The commander-in-chief of the U.S. Forces in the Pacific went vocal that the DPRK is pursuing more than just defending its social system through the access to the nuclear weapons and its purpose is to reunify the Korean peninsula under the communist system. He also called for focusing on removal of the nuclear weapons even though dialogue is held. This is just last-ditch struggling of those much upset by the international opinion being built to the effect that the nuclear possession of the DPRK was attributable to the U.S. nuclear threat and hostile policy toward the DPRK, and by the dramatic phase of reconciliation being created between the north and the south of Korea entering this year, in particular. The sordid aim sought by the U.S. is to brand the DPRK's nuclear weapons as the ones for "achieving unification by communizing the south" and then justify arms buildup in and around the Korean peninsula under the pretext of "defending allies", incite hostility toward the DPRK among south Koreans, drive a wedge between the north and the south and thus spoil the atmosphere for the improvement of the ties. The Trump group should not make senseless remarks that would provoke laughter of the world but be well aware of their own position and withdraw the hostile policy toward the DPRK before plunging into deeper quagmire. Pak Chol Jun

title: Steadfast Is DPRK's Will for Peace and Reunification
body: It is the consistent stand and steadfast will of the Workers' Party of Korea and the government of the DPRK to defend peace from the U.S. war moves with strong war deterrent and surely achieve the national reunification desired by all Koreans by improving the north-south relations and creating peaceful climate. The DPRK gave further momentum to the enthusiasm of the Korean nation for national reunification with the Winter Olympics as an occasion. In a short span of time it mended the north-south relations which had been in the phase of freeze and provided a climate of reconciliation and dialogue. Now no one can fault or disregard the peace-loving sincere efforts and measures made by the DPRK to provide a peaceful climate on the Korean Peninsula. The DPRK has so far made every possible effort with maximum of restraint in order to defuse the acute tension between the north and the south and create a peaceful climate. Peace is guaranteed on the Korean Peninsula by our proactive and energetic efforts as in the past. Thanks to the peerlessly great man, the future of our nation is rosy and national reunification, long-cherished desire of the nation, will be surely achieved. Ri Hak Nam

title: Iranian Embassy Hosts Reception
body: The Iranian embassy in Pyongyang hosted a reception on Feb. 27 on the occasion of the birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il. Present at the reception on invitation were Kim Yong Dae, vice-president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, Thae Hyong Chol, president of Kim Il Sung University and concurrently minister of Higher Education who is chairman of the DPRK-Iran Friendship Parliamentary Group, Kim Jong Suk, chairwoman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries, Ryu Myong Son, vice department director of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea, etc. Seyed Mohsen Emadi, Iranian ambassador to the DPRK, and staff members of the embassy were on hand. Seyed Mohsen Emadi said in his speech that the historic relations between the two countries forged by their preceding leaders had been further strengthened thanks to Kim Jong Il. He expressed the will to continue mutual cooperation in line with the desire and aspiration of the two peoples. Kim Yong Dae said in his speech that Kim Jong Il is the peerlessly great man who provided the eternal foundation for the country's prosperity and the happiness of the generations to come and led the cause of independence against imperialism and the cause of socialism to victory with his outstanding idea and leadership. He stressed that the Korean people would as ever value the friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries forged in the joint struggle for independence against imperialism, sincerely wishing the Iranian people success in their struggle for ensuring regional peace and stability. Rodong News Team

title: North-South Working-Level Talks Held
body: Working-level talks between the north and the south of Korea for the north side's participation in the 12th Winter Paralympics were held at the Thongil House in Panmunjom on Feb. 27. At the talks both sides had discussions of the practical matters arising in the north side's participation in the Winter Paralympics and adopted a joint press release. The joint press release reflects the matter related to the participation by the National Paralympics Committee delegation of the DPRK and its sports team in the 12th Winter Paralympics and route and period of their visit as well as the south side's offer of convenience to them. According to it, detailed practical matters in this regard will be consulted in the way of exchange of documents. Rodong News Team

title: Russian Delegation Visits Mangyongdae
body: The delegation of the Far Eastern Branch of the Russian Academy of Sciences led by Academician Valentine Sergiyenko, chief of the Branch who is vice-president of the Academy of Sciences, visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. At the old home in Mangyongdae, the visitors looked round historic relics, being briefed on the revolutionary history of the President. The delegation also toured the Tower of the Juche Idea, the Sci-Tech Complex, the Bioengineering Branch of the State Academy of Sciences, etc. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korean Bodies Vow to Fight against U.S.
body: The South Headquarters of the Pan-National Alliance for Korea's Reunification, the Association for Supporting Prisoners of Conscience of the Family Movement for Realizing Democracy, the Society of April Revolution and other organizations of south Korea held a news conference in Seoul on Feb. 27 to pledge to vigorously fight against the U.S. preventing the peace process on the Korean Peninsula, according to the south Korean online paper Tongil News. The speakers said that they would continue the struggle together with all the anti-U.S. forces until the north-targeted nuclear war drills including the U.S.-south Korea joint military exercises are terminated forever, a DPRK-U.S. peace accord is concluded and the U.S. troops are withdrawn from south Korea. Rodong News Team

title: Editorial
body: Let Us Resolutely Smash Aggressive Machinations of Outsiders 99 years elapsed since the March First Popular Uprising. The army and people of the DPRK will force Japan to pay dearly for its past crimes. In the early part of the last century the Japanese imperialists occupied Korea and mercilessly violated sovereignty and right to existence of the Korean nation, turning the whole land into sea of blood through the most brutal colonial fascist rule. The Korean people were more miserable than a dog in the house of death under the medieval military rule by the Japanese imperialists. Their pent-up grudge and wrath erupted as a nationwide anti-Japanese resistance on March 1, 1919. The March First Popular Uprising, which stroke terror into the Japanese imperialist aggressors, was a nationwide patriotic anti-Japanese resistance as it fully demonstrated the indomitable spirit of the Korean nation not to live as slaves of outsiders though they may die. Nearly one century has passed since the March First Popular Uprising, but the Korean nation has not yet achieved sovereignty across the country. The more the U.S. and its vassal forces tyrannically resort to the anti-DPRK moves to ignite a nuclear war, the further the Korean army and people will bolster the self-defensive war deterrence as they always remember the lesson of the March First Popular Uprising.

title: U.S. Blasted for Derailing Inter-Korean Ties
body: The Kwangju Regional Headquarters of the People's Solidarity for Sovereignty in south Korea held a rally outside the U.S. military base in Kunsan on Feb. 26 to condemn the U.S. moves to hinder the improvement of inter-Korean relations and resume the war exercises against the north, according to the south Korean internet newspaper Jaju Sibo. Speakers at the rally charged that the U.S. is putting economic and diplomatic pressure on south Korea to spoil the improved south-north relations. A statement was made public at the rally. No matter how desperately the U.S. is working to stop the south and north of Korea from achieving reconciliation and unity, it can never check the advance of the Korean nation towards the reunification of the country, the statement stressed. Rodong News Team

title: Ridiculous Anti-DPRK Racket of Abe Group
body: The Abe group goes frantic with the racket against the DPRK, spouting vituperation that they agreed with the U.S. president on the maximum pressure against the DPRK and dialogue without condition should not be held with the DPRK. This is a ludicrous act of dwarf politicians of Japan which is tantamount to one state of the U.S. Japan is an island nation parasitic on the U.S. It is Japan's bad habit to give impertinent admonition to others though it is in a poor position to beg for something with the backing of the U.S. It was more glaringly revealed at the opening ceremony of the 23rd Winter Olympics and so Japan became a butt of ridicule. The work on the Korean Peninsula is the issue to be solved by our nation responsible for it. Japan has no justification to meddle in it. Nevertheless, the Abe group persists in childish and humiliating mendicant diplomacy in an attempt to realize its black-hearted intention. The jargon that dialogue without condition should not be held with the DPRK makes even a cat laugh. Those who committed thrice-cursed crimes against the Korean nation are not qualified to talk about dialogue. The only condition for Japan to deal with the DPRK is to make reparation for its hideous crimes committed against the Korean people. Abe and his stooges should think of consequences to be entailed by their refusal to do so and their reckless act to realize the wild ambition for reinvasion at any cost. Son So Yon

title: Korean-style Socialism Remains Unfazed
body: March 1 marks the 25th anniversary of the publication of leader Kim Jong Il's work "Abuses of Socialism Are Intolerable". The work, published on Mar. 1, Juche 82 (1993), deals with the falsity and reactionary nature of the sophistry of the renegades of revolution slandering socialism as "totalitarian", "barracks-like" and "administrative and commanding". It gives clear exposition of such theoretical and practical matters arising in socialist construction as the issues of making the people have an unshakable faith in socialism and regard it as their morale to defend it, displaying the superiority of socialism to the full, and adhering to the principle of collectivism. Notably it clarifies the idea that all the people should have an unshakable faith in socialism. The years after the publication of the work have been a proud course during which the indomitable revolutionary spirit of the Korean army and people regarding socialism as their lifeblood has been fully displayed. In those days the imperialists went all the more frantic in their moves to isolate and suffocate and disintegrate Korean-style socialism. The danger of war has never been removed on this land. As our people had firm faith, they could brave ordeals of history, invariably holding high the red flag of revolution at a crossroads: whether to choose independence or submission, and whether to defend socialism or opt for capitalism. Thanks to the army and people with the iron will to firmly defend their country, Korean-style socialism remains unfazed under any trial. Ri Hyo Jin

title: Protocol on Collaboration between Science Academies of DPRK and Russia Signed
body: A 2018-2020 protocol on science collaboration between the Unjong Branch of the State Academy of Sciences of the DPRK and the Far Eastern Branch of the Russian Academy of Sciences was signed in Pyongyang on Feb. 28. Present at the signing ceremony were To Jong Chol, vice-president of the State Academy of Sciences, and other officials concerned from the DPRK side and members of the delegation of the Far Eastern Branch of the Russian Academy of Sciences led by Academician Valentine Sergiyenko, vice-president of the Academy of Sciences and concurrently chief of the Branch, from the Russian side. The protocol was inked by To Jong Chol and Valentine Sergiyenko. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of DPRK-Russia Fishery Joint Committee Back to Pyongyang
body: A delegation of the DPRK-Russia Fishery Joint Committee headed by Vice-Minister of Fisheries Kim Chang Do came back to Pyongyang on Feb. 28 after attending the 30th meeting of the DPRK-Russia Joint Committee on cooperation in the fishery in Russia. Rodong News Team

title: Sci-Tech Festival of Pyongyang University of Architecture Held
body: The 33rd Science and Technology Festival of Pyongyang University of Architecture took place on Feb. 26-28. The festival was held in the form of presentation, exhibition and exchange of new technology, divided into panels of architecture, city management, land and environment protection, construction engineering, construction management, architectural materials, construction machinery and IT. Presented to it were more than 130 scientific and technological proposals, and successes and experience were exchanged during the festival. Rodong News Team

title: Russian Delegation Arrives in Pyongyang
body: A delegation of the Center for Energy and Security Studies of Russia led by Director Anton Khlopkov arrived in Pyongyang on Mar. 3. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Bulgarian President
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, on Mar. 3 sent a message of greeting to Rumen Radev, president of the Republic of Bulgaria, on its national day. Kim in the message expressed belief that the friendly relations between the DPRK and Bulgaria would favorably develop in the interests of the peoples of the two countries. Rodong News Team

title: U.S. Cannot Escape Doom
body: The government shutdown in the U.S., the second one in the past three weeks, is a laughing stock worldwide and showed the wretched plight of the U.S. on the decline. The government shutdown is a product of the political confrontation spawned by the reactionary bipartisan ruling system in the U.S. and an inevitable result of the serious crisis of the U.S. economy which has plunged into an irretrievable structural contradiction due to its war policy of aggression. There were such shutdowns during the Clinton and Obama administrations. At that time only one man had to patrol the 8 900 km-long border with Canada. Such case has become a commonplace under the Trump administration. Now the Republicans are unilaterally taking the initiative in both houses not like during the Clinton and Obama administrations. However, the present administration's government budget bill can not pass Congress. This is because the Trump administration is being forsaken by even Republican lawmakers. The political camp of the U.S. is suffering from serious dissension and division. Festering division deepens confrontation and conflict in social relations. It is not fortuitous that those who advocated America's hegemonism yesterday are concerned of its fate. The consecutive government shutdown heralds the tragic destiny of the imperialist boss. Ri Hyo Jin

title: It Is Legitimate Right to Increase National Defense Capability: DPRK Permanent Representative
body: It is a legitimate right of a sovereign state to take measures to increase its national defense capability for coping with threat from outside. The permanent representative of the DPRK to the UN Office and international organizations in Geneva stressed this at the plenary meeting of the Geneva Disarmament Conference on February 27. He further said: The DPRK was compelled to possess nuclear deterrent in order to protect its sovereignty and the security of its nation from the harsh hostile policy and nuclear threat of the U.S. that have persisted for years. However, the hostile forces led by the U.S. labeled the exercise of this legitimate right as a "threat to global peace" and misused the voting mechanism of UN Security Council to cook up several "sanctions resolutions" in an attempt to deprive the DPRK of its self-defensive right. A dramatic change is taking place in the situation on the Korean peninsula thanks to the proactive initiative and sincere efforts of the DPRK. However, the U.S. quite contrary to this is amassing huge strategic assets in and around the Korean peninsula, deliberately straining the situation. It is mulling staging joint military exercises aimed at a preemptive nuclear attack on the DPRK the moment the Winter Olympics are over. In order to defend itself from such threat, the DPRK had access to nuclear weapons, treasured sword of justice. As we have stated on numerous occasions, we will consider any type of blockade as an act of war against us, and if the U.S. has indeed the guts to confront us in any "rough" manner, we will not bother to respond to it. Those countries who talk this or that way of the DPRK should not follow the U.S. hostile policy aimed at intentionally deteriorating the situation on the Korean peninsula but refrain from using this august platform for disarmament as a tool for their political propaganda. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Acrobats Back Home
body: DPRK acrobats returned home on Mar. 2 after attending the 7th Gold Elephant Prize International Acrobatics Festival. Taking part in the festival, held in Spain on Feb. 22-26, were acrobats from 18 countries and regions including the DPRK, Russia, Brazil, China and Cuba. The DPRK acrobats were acclaimed by members of the festival organizing committee, acrobatic experts and spectators as they displayed their unique and refined skills in the physical acrobatics such as wire-dancing. Their physical acrobatics "Flight on Iron Bar" and "Wire-dancing" won Gold Elephant Prize and "Handstand Etude" Silver Elephant Prize. Three pieces given by the DPRK acrobats also won Popular Prize. Rodong News Team

title: Russian Delegation Leaves
body: The delegation of the Far Eastern Branch of the Russian Academy of Sciences led by Academician Valentine Sergiyenko, chief of the Branch who is vice-president of the Academy of Sciences, left Pyongyang for home on Mar. 2. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Algerian President
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, on Mar. 2 sent a message of greeting to Abdelaziz Bouteflika, president of Algeria, on his birthday. Kim in the message wished the president bigger success in his responsible work for the country's independent development, expressing belief that the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation between the two countries would invariably develop in future, too. Rodong News Team

title: Editorial
body: Let Us Turn Out in Spring Tree-Planting Campaign Planting trees and caring them are a patriotic work for the eternal future of the country. In recent years the army and people of the DPRK have turned out in the nature-harnessing campaign and forest restoration campaign and made big progress in forestation and protection under the leadership of the Party. The ardent enthusiasm to leave footprints of patriotism for the prosperity of the country and happy life of the future generations has resulted in the completion of the first-phase task for the forest restoration campaign. This is praiseworthy achievement. This is a bright fruition brought about by the patriotism and loyalty of the army and people of the DPRK to turn the country into a socialist paradise in thick verdure under the guidance of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. We still have many things to do in order to turn all mountains into treasure mountains as intended by the Party. We should actively turn out in the spring tree-planting with ardent patriotism and make fresh progress in the work for turning the whole country into thick woodland and greenery this significant year.

title: Heightened Vigilance Should Be Kept against Imperialists' Break-up Strategy
body: The imperialist reactionary forces are making desperate efforts to stop the independent forces from growing stronger and maintain domination. To this end, they are attaching big significance to the strategy of dividing countries and nations desirous of independence and estranging them from each other as well as means of military coercion. The situation requires all the countries and nations desirous of new independent world to heighten vigilance against the moves of the imperialists and turn out in action to foil them. The imperialists are the enemy common to the world progressives struggling for independence and peace, and they are the main target that the world progressives should struggle against by their concerted efforts irrespective of ism, religious belief, nation and race. Countries and nations desirous of independence and justice should oppose and reject the outsiders' intervention and domination and struggle against the imperialists by pooling efforts. No illusion should be harbored about the imperialists. History eloquently proves that only when non-aligned and developing countries build their own strength and intensify south-south cooperation, can they defend political independence and achieve self-sustenance in economy. The DPRK has closely cooperated with non-aligned and developing countries in the struggle for independence, peace and international justice against imperialism. Immutable is the stand of the DPRK to foil the imperialists' aggression war moves and firmly defend the world peace and security in firm unity with the world progressive people advocating independence. Ri Hak Nam

title: Kim Jong Un Meets Delegation of Special Envoy of S. Korean President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and supreme commander of the Korean People's Army, received the members of a delegation of special envoy of the south Korean president who arrived in Pyongyang on Mar. 5. Present there were Jong Ui Yong, chief of the State Security Office of Chongwadae who is special envoy of President Moon Jae In; So Hun, director of the National Intelligence Service; Chon Hae Song, vice-minister of Unification; Kim Sang Gyun, vice-director of the National Intelligence Service; and Yun Kon Yong, chief of the State Affairs Office of Chongwadae. Kim Yong Chol, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the WPK, and Kim Yo Jong, first vice department director of the Central Committee of the WPK were on hand. Shaking hands of the special envoy and his party one by one, respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un warmly welcomed them to Pyongyang. Jong Ui Yong courteously conveyed a personal letter of President Moon Jae In to the Supreme Leader. The members of the special envoy delegation presented gratitude to the Supreme Leader for having dispatched high-level delegations and various large-scale delegations with the 23rd Winter Olympics as a momentum to ensure its successful holding. Expressing thanks for this, Kim Jong Un said it is natural to share the joy over an auspicious event of fellow countrymen of the same blood and help them. The recent Winter Olympics served as a very important occasion in displaying the stamina and prestige of our nation and providing a good atmosphere of reconciliation, unity and dialogue between the north and the south, he added. Then he had an openhearted talk with the south side's special envoy delegation over the matters arising in actively improving the north-south relations and ensuring peace and stability on the Korean Peninsula. He repeatedly clarified that it is our consistent and principled stand and his fixed will to vigorously advance the north-south relations and write a new history of national reunification by the concerted efforts of our nation to be proud of in the world. After being told about President Moon Jae In's intention for a summit by the special envoy of the south side, the Supreme Leader exchanged views and reached a satisfactory agreement. He gave an important instruction to the relevant field to rapidly take practical steps for it. He also had an exchange of in-depth views on the issues for easing the acute military tensions on the Korean Peninsula and activating the versatile dialogue, contact, cooperation and exchange between the north and the south. The talk proceeded in a compatriotic and sincere atmosphere. Kim Jong Un had a photo session with the members of the delegation. Political News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Hosts Dinner for Special Envoy Delegation of S. Korean President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and supreme commander of the Korean People's Army, on Mar. 5 hosted a dinner for the members of the delegation of special envoy of the south Korean president on a visit to Pyongyang. At the dinner hall, respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, together with his wife Ri Sol Ju, warmly greeted Jong Ui Yong, chief of the State Security Office of Chongwadae who is special envoy of President Moon Jae In; So Hun, director of the National Intelligence Service; Chon Hae Song, vice-minister of Unification; Kim Sang Gyun, vice-director of the National Intelligence Service; and Yun Kon Yong, chief of the State Affairs Office of Chongwadae. Attending it were Kim Yong Chol, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the WPK; Kim Yo Jong, first vice department director of the Central Committee of the WPK; and officials concerned. The dinner proceeded in a warm atmosphere overflowing with compatriotic feelings. Political News Team

title: Centenarian Receives Birthday Spread
body: Respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un sent a birthday spread to Song Phil Son, a woman centenarian living in Sampho-ri, Yonsa County of North Hamgyong Province. Born as a daughter of a poor peasant family in Orang County of North Hamgyong Province during the period of the colonial rule of the Japanese imperialists, she experienced the sorrow of being a member of the stateless nation. It was not until President Kim Il Sung liberated Korea that she could live a genuine and happy life. She devoted herself to performing her revolutionary duty in the past. After becoming a pensioner, she leads her life optimistically, keeping herself busy. She always tells her children to work hard for the grateful party and country, saying that she lives long thanks to the best socialist system in the world. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of Special Envoy of S. Korean President Arrives in Pyongyang
body: A delegation of special envoy of the south Korean president, including Jong Ui Yong, chief of the State Security Office of Chongwadae, arrived in Pyongyang on Mar. 5. Rodong News Team

title: GFTUK Delegation Back Home
body: A delegation of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea (GFTUK) led by Kim Tong Son, vice-chairman of its Central Committee, on Mar. 5 returned home after attending the meeting of the Presidential Council of the World Federation of Trade Unions held in Iran. Rodong News Team

title: Unpardonable Challenge to Sovereignty of DPRK
body: The U.S. recently worked out another "independent sanctions" by which it included 56 objects including maritime and trade companies, vessels and individuals of the DPRK and third countries within the "list of specified sanctions" while calling for "cutting off the line financing nuclear and missile development". It even made public "international transport advice", saying that individuals and marine transport companies which are involved in sea trade with the DPRK can be subject to sanctions imposed by the U.S. The recent despicable additional sanctions farce staged by the Trump group is a gangster-like act aimed to totally check the legitimate foreign trade of a sovereign state, and another vicious provocation violating the sovereignty and dignity of the DPRK. The wild act of the Trump group is nothing but a last-ditch struggle of those who sustained a bitter defeat in the DPRK-U.S. decades-long nuclear standoff. The DPRK turned itself into a great power, world-level military giant looked up by the world, while resolutely foiling the U.S. most barbarous and gangster-like toughest sanctions and pressure with the might of single-minded unity and the self-reliance and self-development. The U.S. must clearly understand the strategic position of the DPRK and behave with reason, thinking about an option that meets its interests. If the U.S. and its vassal forces violate even a bit the sovereignty of the DPRK while clamoring for "sea blockade" and "cutting off financing line", that will incur strong countermeasures. The U.S. has to stop senseless and thoughtless act and make realistic thinking and judgment suited to the trend of the times. Ra Sol Ha

title: Hysterical Acts of Confrontational Maniacs
body: The "Liberal Korea Party" (LKP) group including Hong Jun Phyo and Kim Mu Song staged disgusting confrontational farce while talking about "sinking of 'Cheonan' warship" and "bombing" as regards the south Korean visit by the DPRK's high-ranking delegation. The wild act of the south Korean conservative group is an intolerable provocation to the DPRK's efforts and measures for national concord and the improvement of the north-south relations, and a hysterical fit to get rid of the crisis of destruction. It is utterly shocking for the conservatives including those of the LKP to kick up the racket even by faulting the DPRK high-ranking delegation's south Korea visit. It is the elementary etiquette of human being to respond to good faith in kind. But the south Korean conservative maniacs slandered the guests who came to congratulate their feast, going rude and ill-mannered. They only nurture dirty political ambition, being indifferent to the destiny of the nation and peace and reunification of the country. The south Korean conservative hooligans kicked up the racket of confrontation against the south Korea visit of the DPRK's high-ranking delegation by taking issue with the hackneyed case of "Cheonan" warship sinking, only to disclose their disgusting nature dead-set against the reunification of the country, and to provoke laughter of the world people. It is shame on the nation that a handful of confrontational maniacs and dirty human rejects are still agitating the world. Un Jong Chol

title: 39th Meeting of Union of Korean Students in Japan Held
body: The 39th meeting of the Union of Korean Students in Japan took place at the Korean Hall in Tokyo on Feb. 27. Present at the meeting were Han Tong Song, director of the organization department of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), Kim Hyon Il, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Korean Students in Japan, and other deputies. Kim Hyon Il in his report referred to the achievements of the union in the work for implementing the patriotic tasks of Chongryon and for branch-expanding, science research and talent-training, etc. after the 38th meeting. He stressed the need to strengthen the ideological education among Korean students in Japan so that they may keep pace with the socialist homeland and to make a decisive breach in the drive for developing the movement of the union on a higher stage this year greeting the 70th birthday of the DPRK and the 24th Congress of Chongryon. He said that all the branches of the union should be cemented as reliable citadel stones of patriotism and its organizations should be expanded and a radical progress made in the work for training talents to realize the "2018 plan of the Union of Korean Students in Japan". Speeches were made before the results of the "2017 movement for creating new history of the Union of Korean Students in Japan" were announced. Citations were awarded to the best headquarters and branch of the union. Kim Hyon Il was reelected chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Korean Students in Japan. Rodong News Team

title: 5th Meeting of 23rd Central Committee of Chongryon Held
body: The 5th meeting of the 23rd Central Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) was held at the Central Hall of Chongryon in Tokyo on March 2. Among those present there were Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of Chongryon, Nam Sung U and Pae Ik Ju, its vice-chairmen, Pae Jin Gu, its vice-chairman and concurrently director general of the General Affairs Department, Kang Chu Ryon, its vice-chairwoman and chairwoman of the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Democratic Korean Women in Japan, Hong In Hum, chairman of the Central Audit Committee of Chongryon, directors and advisers of the Central Standing Committee of Chongryon, the director of the Research Institute on History of Korean Residents in Japan and members of the Central Committee and the Central Audit Committee of Chongryon. Ho Jong Man made a report on the first agenda item "On Greeting the 24th Congress of Chongryon as Occasion for Making Decisive Breakthrough for the Development of Movement of Koreans in Japan in the Great Kim Jong Un's Era". Then the floor was taken by Kim Sang Il, chairman of the Kyoto Prefectural Headquarters of Chongryon, Ri Sang Sok, chairman of the Tokyo Metropolitan Atachi branch of Chongryon, Ri Pak Ji, chairman of the Toshun branch, Aichi Prefecture, of Chongryon, Ri Jong Man, managing director of the Standing Council of the Korean Federation of Workers in Commerce in Japan, Kim Yong Ju, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the Korean Youth League in Japan, Pu Jong Saeng, chairwoman of the Osaka Prefectural Headquarters of the Union of Democratic Korean Women in Japan, and Jo Su Rae, chairman of the Korean Youth Commercial Association in Hyogo Prefecture, who are members of the Central Committee of Chongryon. Vice-Chairman Nam Sung U made a report on the second agenda item "On Convening the 24th Congress of Chongryon". Decisions on agenda items discussed were adopted at the meeting. A report on the examination of qualifications was made and there were dismissal and by-election of some members of the Central Committee. A letter to respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was read out at the meeting. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of Special Envoy of S. Korean President Leaves
body: A delegation of special envoy of the south Korean president left Pyongyang on Mar. 6. Earlier, Kim Yong Chol, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, met and had a talk with members of the delegation at their lodgings and saw them off. Rodong News Team

title: End Should Be Put to U.S. History of Nuclear Crimes
body: The H-bomb test carried out by the U.S. imperialists on Bikini of the Marshall Islands on March 1, 1954 was a deliberate and cruel guinea pig test done by the nuclear devil to confirm the scope of dispersion and concentration of radiation caused by a nuclear explosion and its power of killing and wounding on a normal earth environment. The test was a hideous crime against humanity which provoked fierce thermo-nuclear weapons development race on the planet. The world peace-loving people have firmly opposed the U.S. imperialists' nuclear war provocation moves, hoping that the nuclear disaster on Bikini which followed that on Hiroshima and Nagasaki would not be repeated again. But the dark clouds of a nuclear war still hang heavily over the earth due to the U.S. invariable aggression ambition and nuclear war moves aimed at putting the world under its domination by force. As a result, humankind is still exposed to the danger. Not content with becoming first in imposing the nuclear holocaust on humankind, the U.S. is getting keen on nuclear weapons modernization in order to hold an absolute nuclear edge in the world. It is, indeed, the sworn enemy common to humankind as it intends to push the planet into another dreadful nuclear disaster and destroy the world peace and security. The situation eloquently proves how just the DPRK is when it has strengthened the capabilities for self-defence in quality and quantity with the nuclear force as a pivot, under the uplifted banner of the line of simultaneously developing the economic construction and the building of nuclear force, to cope with the ever-increasing nuclear threats from the U.S. Ra Myong Song

title: Let Us Make Revolutionary Climate Prevail throughout Party
body: To thoroughly establish the revolutionary party traits presents itself as an important issue in steadily enhancing the militancy and the leadership role of the Workers' Party of Korea and further strengthening the political and ideological might of the Korean revolution. In order to carry to completion the socialist cause down through generations, it is essential to strengthen in every way the party leadership over the revolution and construction. To this end it is necessary to continue to push forward the work of establishing the revolutionary traits within the party. Thoroughly establishing the revolutionary party traits provides a sure guarantee for developing our party into an invincible party strong in the sense of organization and discipline. Not all parties making revolution are able to realize the high level of organization and discipline. They are achieved and consolidated only through the process for establishing the revolutionary party traits. It is also an important requirement for consolidating the kindred relations between the party and the popular masses to thoroughly establish the revolutionary party traits. An important characteristic that can be found only in the party which has firmly established the party traits of devotedly serving the people is the kindred ties between the party and the popular masses. The Workers' Party of Korea is a revolutionary party of Juche which has consistently maintained the principle of devoted service for the people as its mode of existence and unique party traits under the guidance of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il. Pak Chol

title: Day of Shining Star Observed Abroad
body: Seminars, lectures, round-table talks, book and photo exhibitions and film shows were held in Ethiopia, Angola, Finland and Mongolia to mark the birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il, the Day of the Shining Star. Displayed at their venues were photos showing the revolutionary careers and feats of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il and the revolutionary activities of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. There were also works of the peerlessly great men and books and photos introducing the signal achievements made by the Korean army and people in building a powerful socialist country. "My Country Has Emerged Victorious by Dint of Single-minded Unity" and other Korean films were shown. The chairman of the Ethiopian Association for the Study of the Juche Idea said that Kim Jong Il developed the Workers' Party of Korea into the general staff of revolution ensuring the idea and guidance of the leader and into the genuine motherly party. The chairman of the Finnish Communists' League stressed that Kim Jong Il is the peerlessly elder statesman as he enriched and developed the Juche idea into the guiding idea in the era of independence to clearly show the road ahead of mankind and convinced again the world people of the validity of the socialist cause by protecting the country's sovereignty and dignity with his Songun politics when the imperialist allied forces' anti-DPRK moves went to the extremes. A congratulatory message to Kim Jong Un was adopted at the event in Finland. Rodong News Team

title: Pak Pong Ju Inspects Metal Industrial Establishments in North Hamgyong Province
body: Premier Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, inspected metal industrial establishments in North Hamgyong Province. Officials and workers at the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex, the Musan Mining Complex, the Chongjin Steel Plant, and the Puryong Ferroalloy Factory are waging a high-pitched drive to increase the production with a single determination to support the Party by producing more iron and steel and concentrated iron ore. Inspecting the metal industrial units in the province, the premier gave pep talks to the officials and workers taking the lead in making a breakthrough in building a powerful socialist country. There took place consultative meetings on the spot, at which measures were taken to further perfect the Juche-oriented iron and steel making technologies and boost the production of iron and solve the problems arising in putting the concentrated iron ore production at the Musan Mining Complex on a normal footing. He also went round the Chongjin Theatre under construction to discuss the ways of completing the construction at the best level. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's Work Introduced in Czech Republic
body: The Czechoslovak Communist Party posted on its website the full text of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us Brilliantly Accomplish the Revolutionary Cause of Juche, Holding the Great Comrade Kim Jong Il in High Esteem as the Eternal General Secretary of Our Party" on Feb. 14 to mark the birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il. The work, published on April 6, Juche 101 (2012), clarifies that it is the principled requirement for victoriously advancing the Korean revolution to hold Kim Jong Il in high esteem as the eternal general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). It also indicates the tasks for steadily strengthening the WPK into the glorious party of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's Work Printed in Russia
body: The Knizhnii Mir Publishing House of Russia on February 15 brought out in booklet respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us Usher in a New Golden Age in Building a Sports Power in the Revolutionary Spirit of Paektu" on the occasion of the birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il. The work, published on March 25, Juche 104 (2015), says that President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il showed the road ahead of the Juche-based physical culture and sports with their distinguished idea and leadership and opened a new history of building a sports power. It also indicates the tasks and ways for building a sports power. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK National Paralympics Committee Delegation Leaves for S. Korea
body: A delegation of the National Paralympics Committee of the DPRK led by Chairman of the C.C., Korean Federation for the Protection of the Disabled Kim Mun Chol left Pyongyang on Mar. 6 with a players' group to take part in the 12th Winter Paralympics Games due in south Korea. The delegation and the players' group headed for the south side area in Kaesong on Mar. 7 morning. Rodong News Team

title: March 8 International Women's Day Marked
body: There took place sports and amusement games of officials and members of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea at the Pyongyang Indoor Stadium on March 5-7 to mark the 108th anniversary of March 8 International Women's Day. More than 300 players selected from Pyongyang and each province competed in such games as volleyball and yut-game. The Pyongyang City team took the first place in total points. Rodong News Team

title: Clumsy Farce of Cyber Terrorists
body: Shortly ago, a U.S. broadcasting service aired that a DPRK hacker organization has improved its hacking skill to conduct a large-scale cyber terror, quoting a "report" made by cyber security companies at home. It also floated a cock-and-bull story in which the DPRK is collecting information, destroying network and taking money through hacker organizations, introducing its non-existent hacker entity. Meanwhile, the Japanese reactionaries claimed that several cyber attacks on Japan such as the recent hacking against a major virtual currency exchange are stemmed from a DPRK organization in charge of "funds for developing nuclear weapons and missiles". This is another unpardonable provocation and wicked and mean smear campaign against the DPRK. It is a hackneyed method for the U.S. and its stooges to go mad with the confrontation with the DPRK, groundlessly faulting it, whenever hacking cases happen. Whenever hacking cases happened at home, the U.S. and its followers have worked hard to tarnish the dignified image of the DPRK while linking them with it for no ground. Lurking behind the smear campaign is a cynical ploy to expand the sphere of pressurizing the DPRK, labeling it a "cyber terrorist", not content with pulling up it over the nuclear and "human rights" issues. It is the purpose of the U.S. and its followers to justify their criminal hostile policy towards the DPRK and give further momentum to the atmosphere of sanctions and pressure against it on an international scale by linking with it hacking cases, a headache of the world community. Ri Song Ho

title: DPRK's Access to Nukes Is Just Option
body: Miroslav Lazanski, a lawmaker from the Serbian Progressive Party and a political and military commentator of the newspaper Politika, and other international affairs experts of different countries become more vocal in stressing the justification of the DPRK's nuclear possession. It is eloquently proved by the history of the DPRK-U.S. confrontation. Historically the U.S. has posed nuclear threat and blackmail to the DPRK for several decades after adopting it as a policy to mount nuclear attack on the DPRK. In the present century its nuclear threat and blackmail against the DPRK have got more frantic. There was no other option for the DPRK in the phase of acute confrontation in which it had to protect its system and destiny of the nation in one-on-one showdown with the world's biggest nuclear possessor U.S. We openly and squarely possessed nuclear weapons to defend the supreme interests of the country from the U.S. nuclear threats. We have scuttled all the nuclear attack operation scenarios of the U.S. which tried to drive the Korean nation into nuclear disaster with hysteric war games. We have drastically weakened its unchallenged position in the world. Peace and security on the Korean Peninsula, Northeast Asia and the rest of the world have been reliably guaranteed by the DPRK's bolstering of nuclear deterrent. The DPRK has defended the world peace and security by single-handedly frustrating the U.S. reckless nuclear moves to stifle it by force and dominate the world. Its feats deserve the praise of the world. Ri Hak Nam

title: Swiss Organizations Urge Punishment of Japanese Gangsters
body: The Switzerland-Korea Committee and the Swiss Group for the Study of the Juche Idea issued a joint statement on February 25 to denounce the right-wing reactionaries of Japan for having fired bullets at the Central Hall of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon). Noting that two armed right-wingers of Japan committed such heinous terrorism as firing several bullets at the hall in which the Chongryon Central Standing Committee headquarters, the statement said: The Chongryon Central Standing Committee speaks for the dignity, rights and interests of Chongryon organizations and Koreans in Japan and plays the role as a diplomatic mission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea under the present situation where no diplomatic ties exist between the DPRK and Japan. Therefore, terrorism against Chongryon is just a wanton violation of the DPRK's sovereignty. Japan is an unethical state as it turned Korea into its colony and maltreated and incriminated the Korean nation in the past. We scathingly condemn the recent terrorist act of right-wing gangsters of Japan and strongly demand severe punishment of the criminals. Stop the suppression of Chongryon! Rodong News Team

title: Press Conference at Russian Embassy Marks Anniversary of Stalingrad Battle
body: There was a press conference at the Russian embassy in Pyongyang on Mar. 6 on the occasion of the anniversary of Russia's victory in Stalingrad battle. Present there were journalists of the DPRK and embassy officials. Prior to the conference, the participants saw the photos introducing the Stalingrad battle and modern armed equipment of Russia. Alexandr Matsegora, Russian ambassador to the DPRK, made an address at the conference. He referred to the victory of the battle which opened up a turning phase of the Patriotic War of Russia and gave a heavy blow to the fascist German invaders. He then answered questions raised by journalists. The participants saw a feature film of the Russian Federation. Rodong News Team

title: Bulgarian Charge d'Affaires ad Interim Hosts Reception
body: Ivaylo Iordanov, charge d'affaires ad interim of the Bulgarian embassy here, hosted a reception on Mar. 6 to mark the national day of Bulgaria. Present there on invitation were officials of the DPRK Foreign Ministry and representatives of foreign embassies and international bodies in Pyongyang. Speeches were made there. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Players Back Home
body: DPRK players returned home on Mar. 6 after taking part in the 2018 Asian Wrestling Championship. Rodong News Team

title: Friendship Meeting of Aged Women Held
body: A friendship meeting of aged women took place at the Taedonggang Diplomatic Club on Mar. 6. Present there were Choe Il Hong, vice-chairperson of the Central Committee of the Federation for the Care of the Elderly of Korea, officials of the unit concerned, aged women in Pyongyang, women of foreign embassies and missions of international organizations here, and overseas Korean women. Speeches were made there. Speakers talked about the advantages and vitality of the policy of the Workers' Party of Korea and the state for the care of the elderly and the pride and honor of the aged devoting their wisdom and passion to the building of a socialist power. The participants watched TV program and photos showing the aged women who enjoy a happy life, being loved and respected by families and the collective. Rodong News Team

title: Memorial Service for Koreans Killed during Horrible Air Raid on Tokyo Held
body: A memorial service for the Korean victims was held at the Tokyo metropolitan memorial hall on March 4 on the lapse of 73 years since the U.S. forces made an air raid on Tokyo. Present there were Jin Kil Sang, director of the Rights and Welfare Department of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), Jo Il Yon, chairman of the Tokyo Metropolitan Headquarters of Chongryon, Koreans in Japan, Kiyoshi Nishizawa, representative of the Tokyo fact-finding group for the probe into the truth about the forcible drafting of Koreans, and Japanese figures. The participants paid silent tribute to the victims. Read out there was a memorial address from the Korean Committee on Measures for the Sexual Slavery for Japanese Army and Drafting Victims. The memorial address said that Japan disguised itself as a victim to distort the truth. It urged the Japanese authorities to apologize to drafting victims, pay reparations to them and take immediate practical measures to find remains to bury according to the wishes of bereaved families. The representative of the Tokyo fact-finding group said that he would share pain with victims of the air raid and continue to make efforts to prevent the recurrence of such a disaster. Rodong News Team

title: Organization of DR Congo Introduces Korean Women
body: The National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of DR Congo posted an article titled "Society respecting the women" on its website on March 3. The article said: Acts of violating the dignity and right of women are now committed in different parts of our planet. But in the DPRK, the socialist state centered on the popular masses, all the rights of women as social human beings are guaranteed comprehensively. The Korean women take an active part in the socio-political life with equal rights with men as mistresses of the country. They also receive special benefits from the state and society. They live free from all sorts of worries about giving birth to babies and bringing up them, educating children and treating sick ones, etc. The world-famous Pyongyang Maternity Hospital eloquently shows what special benefits they enjoy. The article noted that the dignity and right of the women are guaranteed on the highest level in the DPRK, evidenced by the facts that grandiose state events have been held on the occasion of March 8 International Women's Day, an excellent hostel was built in a short span of time to provide ample convenience for women workers' everyday life, adding that the DPRK is the only and one country that the norm of international law on sex equality comes true and women are respected and prioritized. Rodong News Team

title: National Meeting Held to Mark March 8 International Women's Day
body: A national meeting was held at the People's Palace of Culture on Mar. 8, the 108th March 8 International Women's Day. It was attended by senior party and government officials Yang Hyong Sop, Choe Hwi and Kim Su Gil, Vice-Premier Jon Kwang Ho, Chairwoman of the C.C., Socialist Women's Union of Korea Jang Chun Sil, women officials, persons of merit and exemplary officials and members of the women's union of ministries, national institutions, institutions and industrial establishments in Pyongyang. Present there on invitation were overseas Korean women, women of foreign embassies and missions of international bodies here and foreign guests. Choe Hwi, alternate member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea, made a report. The reporter stressed that the women's movement of Korea is the Juche-oriented women's movement that was pioneered by President Kim Il Sung and has covered the proud course of development under the wise guidance of the President and leader Kim Jong Il. The history of the Korean women's movement is closely associated with the exploits of Kang Pan Sok, an outstanding leader of the Korean women's movement, and the anti-Japanese war heroine Kim Jong Suk, who dedicated themselves to resolving the women's problem, the reporter said, adding: Today the Korean women's movement of Juche is ushering in the greatest heyday of its development as it holds respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in high esteem. The Korean women's movement has taken only the road of victory as a revolutionary and militant movement generation after generation and prided itself on being an example of the movement of world progressive women. The reporter called upon all women to make a positive contribution to glorifying the glorious history and tradition of the Korean women's movement of Juche and achieving fresh victory on all fronts of building a powerful socialist country. Rodong News Team

title: Forcing Japan to Pay for Its Crimes against Korean Nation Called for
body: A spokesman for the Korean Committee on Measures for the Sexual Slavery for Japanese Army and Drafting Victims in a statement dealt with the new disclosure in south Korea of a video showing the barbaric massacre of Korean sexual slaves by the Japanese imperialists toward the end of the Second World War. The video, kept at the U.S. National Archives, shows the footage of the scene of Korean women mercilessly killed by the Japanese imperialist aggressor troops in Yunnan Province of China on September 15, 1944 after being forced into the sexual slavery at battle fields. An allied force operational journal was also disclosed to the effect that the Imperial Japanese Army shot to death 30 Korean women on September 13, 1944, whom they used to carry as sexual slaves. The recently disclosed video and data indict for the barbarous acts committed by the Japanese imperialists, which can not be found in history of wars of any other country of the world, the statement said, and went on: The facts clearly prove that Japan is the sworn enemy of the Korean nation as it committed hideous crimes against humanity that can never be redeemed for generations to come. No statute of limitations is applicable to the hideous sexual slavery crime committed by Japan. Still remaining unsettled is the resentment of the Korean women who were buried in desolate alien land after falling victim to the sexual slavery of the Japanese imperialists with their human dignity and chastity crudely violated. However, the Abe group of Japan has gone impudent to say that "there is no data proving the forcible drafting of comfort women for the Imperial Japanese Army" and that "it was voluntary service for making money", insulting the victims of the sexual slavery. They even offered a few penny of money to traitor Park Geun Hye's group to cook up sort of "agreement" which they called "final and irreversible". Faulting the reports of international organizations which pointed out Japan's despicable crimes, Japan openly forced their modification, and stubbornly called for the removal of statues of a sexual slave for the Imperial Japanese Army built in different countries. On the other hand, it has gone mischievous, persisting in brazen-facedly raising the "abduction issue". Far from repenting of the unprecedented crimes, Japan calls for "normal state" capable of fighting a war with the backing of the U.S., openly disclosing its ambition for reinvasion of the Korean peninsula and the Asian continent. The cursed act of the Japanese reactionaries enough to enrage others and make blood boil is an intolerable mockery and insult to the Korean nation. We will never pardon all crimes committed by Japan against the Korean nation in the past, including the crimes related to the sexual slavery and will certainly force it to pay thousands-folds. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to United Socialist Party of Venezuela
body: The Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea sent a message of greeting to the National Leadership of the United Socialist Party of Venezuela on Mar. 8 on the occasion of the 10th anniversary of its founding. The message expressed the firm support and solidarity to the struggle of the United Socialist Party of Venezuela for defending the sovereignty of the country and the social and political stability under the banner of the Bolivarian revolution. It wished the party greater success in its activities, expressing belief that the solidarity and cooperative relations between the two parties will grow stronger in the common struggle for independence and socialism against imperialism. Rodong News Team

title: Russian Delegation Leaves
body: The delegation of the Center for Energy and Security Studies of Russia led by Director Anton Khlopkov left here for home on Mar. 8. During the visit the delegation paid a courtesy call on Vice Foreign Minister Choe Son Hui and met with officials concerned of the Foreign Ministry and the Institute of International Studies of the DPRK and exchanged views over the issues of mutual concern, including the situation on the Korean peninsula and the relations between the DPRK and Russia. Rodong News Team

title: Hideous Unethical Crimes of Japan
body: The massacres committed by Japanese imperialists against demonstrators in Taegu at the time of the March First Popular Uprising are recorded in the history. The uprising that started with the large-scale anti-Japanese demonstration in Pyongyang on March 1, 1919 as the torch spread across the country including Seoul in the flash. Tens of thousands of students and patriotic people waged an unflinching action in Taegu on March 8 in defiance of the Japanese imperialist police's suppression, chanting slogans like "Long Live Independence of Korea!" and "Japanese and Japanese Army, Leave!" Much upset by this, the Japanese imperialist aggressors buckled down to barbarous suppression. The Japanese imperialist police and military police fired bullets into peaceable empty-handed demonstrators, killing a number of Koreans. The massacres in Taegue were just a tip of iceberg of the hideous massacres of Koreans committed by the Japanese imperialists. The suppression and massacres of the Koreans by the Japanese imperialists were hideous crimes against humanity baffling human imagination in view of barbarity and brutality.
