But the Japanese reactionaries are still resorting to all kinds of tricks, neither admitting nor making reparations for the hideous crimes committed by them. The Japanese imperialists' hideous crimes against humanity should be settled accounts with to the last. An Chol Gwon

title: Pitiful Mendicant Diplomacy
body: At the recent talks with the foreign minister of Finland, Japanese Foreign Minister Kono spat out rubbish that they should jointly cope with the DPRK's "nuclear and missile issue". Earlier, he met his Singaporean counterpart to beg for cooperation of Southeast Asian countries in pressurizing the DPRK, talking about its "evasion of sanctions". When meeting the minister of Foreign Affairs of Mongolia, he called upon all the countries to implement the sanctions against the DPRK. He insisted that Japan "agreed" with Mongolia to put pressure upon the DPRK in every way. The so-called "agreement" made public by the Abe group including Kono is a lie. This is a mendicant diplomacy of Kono who is going round the international arena and Japan's inveterate fraudulent diplomacy. It is a miserable plight of Japan to dance to the tune of the U.S. master for the pressure on the DPRK. That is why the Japanese diplomacy is also mendicant one pursuant to the scenario written by the U.S. Kono's nonsense against the DPRK is gibberish of a stupid whose ability to distinguish the situation is paralyzed. It is ludicrous for the Japanese reactionaries to go against the trend of detente on the Korean peninsula. Ri Hyo Jin

title: Editorial
body: Korean Women Should Powerfully Demonstrate Their Revolutionary Mettle The International Women's Day is a militant holiday to boost the international unity among working women of the world and demonstrate its might. There are billions of women in the world but no one but the Korean women leads a worthwhile life and fulfills the mission and duty for the country and nation. They resolutely defended President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il in stern years of the revolution and devotedly implemented the lines and policies set forth by the leaders in any adversity. The priceless efforts of our women permeate the development of Juche Korea shining with gigantic creations and epoch-making changes. Let us live not merely for today but for tomorrow. This is a patriotic will of our women turning out in the grand Mallima march. Our women are creators of happiness, who beautify the grand flower garden of socialism with love and affection. They are flowers of family, life and the country as they are devoting their clean and pure conscience to the future of the revolution and the motherland. The reality seething with the revolutionary general offensive calls upon our women to perform miracles and feats. Let all Korean women powerfully demonstrate their revolutionary mettle in the all-people general offensive towards the grand festival in September, single-heartedly united around the Party.

title: Works of Peerlessly Great Men Introduced in Brazil
body: The Brazilian Center for the Study of Songun Politics on February 18 and 19 posted on its website President Kim Il Sung's works "For the Establishment of a United Party of the Working Masses", "Let Us Overthrow Imperialism" and "Let Us Intensify the Anti-Imperialist, Anti-U.S. Struggle", leader Kim Jong Il's works "On Having a Correct Understanding of Nationalism", "On the Juche Idea", "Socialism Is a Science" and "Abuses of Socialism Are Intolerable" and respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us Step Up the Building of a Thriving Country by Applying Kim Jong Il's Patriotism". title: U.S. Military Force, Sanctions and Blockade Will Not Work on DPRK
body: The U.S. recently declared that it would impose sanctions on 56 designations -- 27 shipping and trading companies, 28 vessels and one individual of the DPRK and other countries -- under the pretext of preventing the DPRK from "attempting at evasion of sanctions" and of stopping illegal means that can help the transactions with the DPRK in the open sea. The U.S. is staging the farce, not content with cooking up illegal "sanctions resolutions" to stamp out the DPRK's sovereignty and rights to existence and development by abusing the UN Security Council. This is an open violation of international laws and an encroachment upon the sovereignty of the DPRK. By nature, the U.S., out of inveterate repugnancy against the DPRK, goes ill-natured whenever it sees things going well in the DPRK. But the U.S. could not stop the DPRK from making a dash toward the final victory in building a powerful socialist nation. What matters is that the U.S. sanctions and blockade are very dangerous acts that may bring a war. It is now making desperate efforts to stifle the DPRK while getting keen on the racket for sanctions and military pressure on the DPRK. But the army and the people of the DPRK will never be browbeaten. Neither military force nor sanctions and blockade can ever work on the DPRK. Ri Hak Nam

title: Japan Can Never Get Rid of Ill-Fame as War Criminal State
body: A video showing the massacre committed by the Imperial Japanese Army against sexual slaves in 1944 was recently disclosed. The 19-second footage was taken in Yunnan Province of China. Together with the video, 14 documents and 2 photos were disclosed which proved that the Imperial Japanese Army shot to death 30 Korean women. This has brought to light once again the barbarity and cruelty of the Japanese imperialists. Japan's right-wing conservative forces including the Abe group are making a far-fetched assertion that there has never been such a thing as the sexual slavery for the Imperial Japanese Army and insulted the victims of the sexual slavery as "prostitutes" and tried to shift the blame on to the victims, claiming that "they provided sex out of their own accords for money". But the recent video clearly proves that there actually existed the sexual slavery system for the Imperial Japanese Army. The aim sought by Japan in persisting in its moves to cover up the crime related to the sexual slavery is not just to evade shame as a war criminal state. Those who deny crimes are bound to repeat them any time in the future. The aim sought by the Abe group is to deny the history of crimes, bring back the past history of aggression and crimes and thus realize the ambition for putting Asia under its control which Japan failed to do in the past. Japan is trying to imbue the new generations with the militarist idea and nurture the spirit of avenge among the Japanese. It is making desperate efforts to cover up the hideous crimes against humanity and paint Japan as a "normal state". But Japan is gravely mistaken. With neither sleight of hand nor a few penny of money can Japan get rid of the ill-fame as a war criminal state. Son So Yon

title: 12th Winter Paralympics Opens
body: The 12th Winter Paralympics opened in Phyongchang of south Korea on Mar. 9. Players and agents of different countries and regions including the DPRK entered the venue of the opening ceremony. Congratulatory speeches were made there. The opening was declared and the flag of the Winter Paralympics hoisted. There took place a ceremony of lighting the cauldron of the Winter Paralympics. The 12th Winter Paralympics will close on March 18. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Shining Star Celebrated Abroad
body: Meetings, lectures, round-table talks and book and photo exhibitions took place in India, Mexico and Zambia to celebrate the birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il, the Day of the Shining Star. On show at the venues of the exhibitions were photos dealing with feats of President Kim Il Sung, leader Kim Jong Il and respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Also there were works of the peerlessly great men and books and photos introducing the reality of Juche Korea making rapid progress day by day. The secretary general of the Indian Youth Group for the Study of Works of Comrade Kim Il Sung said Kim Jong Il is the leader of the people who had done all the work, absolutely trusting and relying on them and that his noble image as the genuine leader of the people would be always kept in the minds of the Korean people and the world progressives. The national leader of the Workers' Party of Mexico and the president of the Mexican Friend Association for Memory of President Kim Il Sung and Leader Kim Jong Il praised the Songun leadership feats of Kim Jong Il and mentioned the praiseworthy successes made by the army and people of the DPRK under the leadership of Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: Founding Anniversary of Peasants' Union Marked
body: The DPRK celebrated the 90th anniversary of the Peasants' Union formed by President Kim Il Sung. Kim Il Sung regarded the peasant issue as an important one deciding the victory of the revolution after he embarked on the road of the revolution and had wisely led the work for awakening and organizing the broad masses of peasants to inspire them to the revolutionary struggle. He personally went to vast rural areas including Kalun and Wujiazi to bring up hard cores there and founded the Peasants' Union, the first revolutionary organization of peasants in Korea, on March 10, Juche 17 (1928) on the basis of full preparations. Leader Kim Jong Il steadily developed the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea so that it could fully discharge its historic mission as the Party’s reliable transmission belt and peripheral organization. The idea of building the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea and leadership exploits of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il are being successfully carried forward by respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. A meeting was held at the Central Hall of Workers on Mar. 9 to mark the anniversary. Present there were Choe Hwi, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea, Ko In Ho, vice-premier of the Cabinet and minister of Agriculture, officials of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea and agricultural workers. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Il Lauded by Foreign Papers
body: To mark the birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il, newspapers of different countries featured articles: "Comrade Kim Jong Il's Great Feats for Korean Revolution", "People's Leader Kim Jong Il", etc. Those papers carried a portrait of smiling Kim Jong Il and his photos. The Lao paper Vientiane Mai said that the reality of the DPRK pushing ahead with the building of a powerful socialist country despite ordeals of every description is inseparable from the feats of Kim Jong Il. The Iranian paper The Iran News said that he devoted himself to the people, regarding them as the most precious being in the world and a teacher, adding that his benevolent image as the genuine leader of the people would be always remembered by the Korean people and the world progressives. The Myanmar paper The New Age referred to the feats of the peerlessly great man who developed comprehensively and in depth the Juche idea through his rare ideological and theoretical activities to clearly show the road ahead of the progressive people, praising him as the great sage of mankind. The Zambian paper Brandline News, the DR Congo paper La Prosperite and the Belarusian paper Buperyod, too, carried articles praising his ideo-theoretical feats and Songun leadership feats. The Angolan paper O Pais told about his feats for national reunification; the Congolese paper La Patriot about the noble traits of Kim Jong Il who took care of all people with warm human love; and the Nigerian paper Nigerian Observer about how the immortal flower Kimjongilia came into being. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Receives Reply Message from Syrian President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a reply message from Bashar Al-Assad, president of the Syrian Arab Republic, on Mar. 8. The president in the message expressed thanks to Kim Jong Un for his kind congratulations on the 55th anniversary of the March 8 revolution in Syria. He appraised Kim Jong Un's support for the Syria's Baath Arab Socialist Party and the army of Syria and their righteous cause for the restoration of the country's stability. The message wished him good health and happiness and the friendly Korean people greater progress. Rodong News Team

title: Korean Book, Photo, Fine Art Exhibitions Held in Different Countries
body: Korean book, photo and fine art exhibitions were held in India, China, Venezuela, Nigeria and Uganda to mark the birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il. Displayed at the venues were photos showing the revolutionary activities of President Kim Il Sung, leader Kim Jong Il and respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. There were also works of the peerlessly great men, and books, photos and art pieces dealing with the reality of the DPRK and appearance of its people. Personages of various strata of the relevant countries, who went round the exhibitions, admired the struggle of the Korean people who are creating miracles and innovations in building a powerful socialist country under the leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea, demonstrating the country's dignity and prestige. Personages of India noted that they came to have a fresher understanding of the DPRK, the world progressives loving justice and peace are admiring the Korean people who are dynamically advancing along the road of independence and that the reality of the DPRK is the brilliant fruition of the wise leadership of the outstanding leaders. Personages of the political and public circles of Nigeria and Uganda emphasized that the noble image of Kim Jong Il will be kept forever in the hearts of the progressives as well as the Korean people, praising him as a genuine people's leader and an outstanding elder statesman who made an immortal contribution to accomplishing the global independence. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Il's Work Published in Algeria
body: The Tarzalt Publishing House in El-Djezair of Algeria brought out in booklet leader Kim Jong Il's work "Abuses of Socialism Are Intolerable". The work, published on March 1, Juche 82 (1993), deals with the reactionary nature and falsity of the sophistry of the imperialists and the renegades of socialism calling socialism "totalitarian", "barracks-like" and "administrative and commanding". It also elucidates the principled issues arising in defending and accomplishing the socialist cause, including the issue of making the people have an unshakable faith in socialism and regard it as their moral duty to defend it and the issue of giving full play to the advantages of socialism. A ceremony of releasing the work took place at the publishing house on March 1. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Sun to Be Marked in Slovenia
body: A Slovenian preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (the Day of the Sun) was formed in Maribor City of Slovenia on February 21. Igor Jurisic, chairman of the Slovenia-Korea Friendship Association, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee decided to organize seminar, lecture, film show and other colorful political and cultural events praising the exploits of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il on the occasion of the Day of the Sun. Rodong News Team

title: C.C. of UDKWJ Meets
body: The 4th meeting of the 29th Central Committee of the Union of Democratic Korean Women in Japan (UDKWJ) took place at the Korean Hall in Tokyo on March 3. Present there were Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), Kang Chu Ryon, its vice-chairwoman and chairwoman of the Union Central Standing Committee, Han Tong Song, director of the organization department of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, and members of the Union Central Committee. Ho Jong Man in his speech noted that the Union has achieved great successes in rallying broad segments of Korean women in Japan including the rising generation behind the organization through the work celebrating its 70th founding anniversary last year. He called for striving to significantly greet the 24th Congress of Chongryon and the 30th Congress of the Union. Kang Chu Ryon in her report said that the Union has firmly carried forward the tradition of it, which had traversed the road of patriotism under the care of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il, through an innovation movement conducted to greet the 70th anniversary of its formation. She stressed the need to consolidate all successes achieved in the innovation movement by further strengthening each branch of the Union, calling for significantly greeting the 24th Congress of Chongryon and the 30th Congress of the Union with the pride of being an overseas women organization which inherited the glorious tradition of the Korean women's movement. Then followed speeches. The meeting decided to hold the 30th Congress of the Union at the Korean Hall on June 8. A letter to respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was read out there. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK's Delegation Leaves for Cuba
body: A delegation of the Central Public Prosecutors Office of the DPRK headed by Director Kim Myong Gil left here for Cuba on Mar. 12. Rodong News Team

title: Intellectuals of Merit Receive Birthday Spreads
body: Respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un sent birthday spreads to Han Um Jon, a researcher at the Institute of International Studies, and Candidate Academician, Prof. and Dr. Ri Yong Su, a researcher at Wonsan University of Agriculture, on their 70th birthdays. President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il ensured that Han Um Jon, who was born in an alien land in March Juche 37, 1948, came to the socialist homeland, and bestowed favors on Han. Kim Jong Un has shown warm love tantamount to the one of the great leaders for Han, ensuring that Han works at a revolutionary post and inherits the tradition of the nation and patriotism. Ri Yong Su has devoted his wisdom and passion to education and scientific research, contributing to the development of the country's agriculture and the training of talented agronomists. While working as a teacher and a researcher for many years after his graduation from a university, he wrote dozens of kinds of textbooks and reference books and 100-odd scientific papers and trained many holders of academic degree. Han and Ri were awarded commendations of the President and watches bearing his august name and had honor of participating in various significant meetings including the Sixth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea. Rodong News Team

title: History of Crimes Should Be Surely Settled Accounts with
body: A new video showing the thrice-cursed atrocities of the Japanese imperialists who slaughtered Korean sexual slaves in the past was recently made public in south Korea. The video, stored at the U.S. National Archives, deals with the scene showing Japanese imperialist brutes cruelly killing the Korean women who were subjected to sexual slavery at the end of the Second World War. It shows a horrible sight of burnt, naked bodies which were thrown into a pit. Along with this video, an operation log of the allied forces was disclosed to show that Japanese imperialist aggression forces shot to death 30 Korean women who suffered from the sexual slavery on Sept. 13, 1944. This once again proves that Japan is the sworn enemy of the Korean people as it committed thrice-cursed crimes against the Korean nation. Nevertheless, the Japanese reactionaries try to justify the sexual slavery, far from acknowledging their history of crimes dotted with blood and making an apology and reparation. Not content with this, they lay bare their attempt for reinvasion, getting more frantic with revival of militarism with the backing of the U.S. The Japanese imperialists' hideous crimes against the Korean nation can never be pardoned, and if the Japanese reactionaries continue to deny their past crimes and behave imprudently, they will face a tragic end only. Ra Sol Ha

title: Editorial
body: Let Us Open Road For Final Victory in Spirit of Mt. Paektu All the people should get rallied close around respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and strikingly demonstrate the mightiness and invincibility of Juche Korea in the revolutionary spirit of Mt. Paektu, the spirit of blizzards of Mt. Paektu. The revolutionary spirit of Mt. Paektu, the spirit of blizzards of Mt. Paektu is the strong offensive spirit of braving all difficulties and hardships and the staunch spirit of fighting back after succession of falls. It is the iron truth cherished in the course of the advancement of the DPRK shining with victory and glory that nothing will be un-surmountable if one lives in the revolutionary spirit of Mt. Paektu, the spirit of blizzards of Mt. Paektu. Steadfast is the determination of the army and people of the DPRK to mercilessly meet the challenges of the hostile forces in the above-said spirit and to display to the full the dignity, might and invincibility of Juche Korea. All the party members, service personnel and other people should fully display the revolutionary spirit of Mt. Paektu, the spirit of blizzards of Mt. Paektu in the on-going revolutionary general offensive for bringing the bright future of a powerful socialist country to this sacred land associated with the noble souls, breaths, blood and sweats of the anti-Japanese revolutionary forerunners. Still far and difficult is the march of the Juche revolution that started in Mt. Paektu, but firm is the faith of the army and people of the DPRK and bright is its future. The final victory is in store for Korea fighting in the revolutionary spirit of Mt. Paektu, the spirit of blizzards of Mt. Paektu.

title: Rural Youth Activists Visit Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: The participants in the National Meeting of Activists of Rural Youth Workteams and Youth Subworkteams visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on Mar. 11. The participants paid tribute to President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il before their statues. At the halls where Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il lie in state, the participants made deep bows to them. They went round the halls where orders the great leaders received are on display and halls that house cars, electric car, boat and train coaches used by them during their field guidance and foreign tours till the last moments of their revolutionary life. Rodong News Team

title: Federation of National Writers Formed in S. Korea
body: A federation of national writers was formed in south Korea on March 10, according to the south Korean internet newspaper Jaju Sibo. Kim Hae Hwa, a worker poet, was elected permanent representative at the inaugural meeting held at the Seoul City Office. Its inaugural declaration said that the federation would reject the unjust interference and domination of foreign forces and contribute to building a world in which human beings live as befitting masters. Rodong News Team

title: "Human Rights" Racket of Imperialists Should Be Foiled
body: The imperialists' "human rights" racket should no longer be overlooked in order to build an independent new world in which the sovereignty and equality are ensured for all the countries and nations free from domination, subjugation, aggression and interference. The imperialists are the kingpin of human rights abuses and human rights criminals who have to face stern punishment by the international community. The politicization of human rights and application of double standards have to be rejected at international organizations including the UN Human Rights Council. No specified nation can be a judge. But the imperialists, claiming as if they are "human rights judges", are politicizing human rights and attacking and pressurizing progressive countries after singling them out. This strains confrontation and has an adverse impact on the worldwide efforts for protecting human rights. Human rights can never come true as long as the imperialists remain on the earth. In order to ensure genuine human rights, one has to build one's own strength. Without strength one cannot fight against those standing against human rights and safeguard genuine human rights, falling victim to the strong. The imperialists are resorting to all sorts of sleights of hands under the signboard of "guarantee of human rights", but with nothing can they cover up the deceptive and aggressive nature of their racket for "human rights". Ri Hak Nam

title: Korean Film Shows Held Abroad
body: Korean film shows were held in Mongolia, Singapore, Nigeria, Angola and Algeria to mark the birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il. Personages of various circles and masses in those countries watched Korean film "Eternal Treasures in Praise of Sun", "Monument to Party Founding" and "My Country Has Emerged Victorious by Dint of Single-minded Unity". The director of the Ulan Bator Carpet Company said the DPRK is working miracles in all fields under the wise guidance of H.E. Kim Jong Un creditably carrying forward the idea and cause of H.E. Kim Jong Il. The director of the World Travel Agency of Singapore praised the great H.E. Kim Jong Il as the prominent leader who defended the sovereignty of the country with his unique Songun politics. Speakers at the film shows in Nigeria lauded Kim Jong Il for consolidating the DPRK as an invincible socialist fortress and training the Korean people to be strong in independence. The director of the Construction Company No. 1 of Angola said: Kim Jong Il is the iron-willed brilliant commander as he reliably defended peace and security on the Korean peninsula by increasing the country's defence capabilities in every way, adding: The might of the DPRK lies in the single-hearted unity of the leader, the party and the masses and no force on earth can match it. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Sun to Be Celebrated in Austria
body: An Austrian preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (the Day of the Sun) was inaugurated in Vienna on February 23. Thomas Losh, general secretary of the Society for the Promotion of the Relations between Austria and DPRK, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The preparatory committee decided to organize political and cultural events in praise of the exploits of the peerlessly great persons on the occasion of the Day of the Sun. Rodong News Team

title: National Meeting of Activists of Rural Youth Workteams and Sub-workteams Held
body: A national meeting of activists of rural youth workteams and sub-workteams took place at the People's Palace of Culture on Mar. 12. Present at the meeting were Ko In Ho, vice-premier and minister of Agriculture, Ri Il Hwan, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials concerned, officials of the youth league and activists in the movement of rural youth workteams and sub-workteams. Pak Chol Min, first secretary of the C.C., Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League, in his report said that the movement of rural youth workteams and sub-workteams has developed into a powerful mass movement in the struggle to build an economic power and improve the people's living standard under the unfurled banner of the theses on the socialist rural question by the initiative and wise guidance of President Kim Il Sung, leader Kim Jong Il and respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Members of the rural youth workteams and subworkteams have fully demonstrated the heroic spirit and invincible might in agricultural production as youth vanguard, the reporter noted. Referring to the fact that more than 1 400 youth workteams and subworkteams have become model, twice or thrice model youth workteams and subworkteams in the flames of the movement, the reporter stressed the need for all members of rural youth workteams and subworkteams to fully display the spirit of youth vanguard in a drive for implementing the theses on the socialist rural question. Speakers at the meeting noted that the members of rural youth workteams and subworkteams across the country have grown into the core of the socialist countryside and into enthusiastic young revolutionaries through the struggle for implementing the Party's plan for socialist rural construction. They analyzed and reviewed such faults of some rural youth workteams and subworkteams as failing to launch their movement in a revolutionary way in keeping with the Party's intention and the demand of the developing revolution and lessons from them. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's Work Introduced in Austria
body: The Society for the Promotion of the Relations between Austria and DPRK posted on its internet homepage respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "The Great Comrade Kim Il Sung Is the Eternal Leader of Our Party and Our People" on February 27 on the occasion of the Day of the Sun, the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. The work, published on April 20, Juche 101 (2012), deals with the revolutionary exploits performed by President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il in their lifetime. It also indicates the tasks for resolutely defending and glorifying the idea and exploits of the great leaders. Rodong News Team

title: Park Geun Hye Group's Plot to Suppress Demonstrators by Force Revealed
body: The Park Geun Hye group of south Korea was newly disclosed to have hatched a plot to suppress the massive candlelight demonstration by invoking the fascist "garrison order". The director of the army human rights center told reporters in Seoul on March 8 that Chongwadae and the Defence Ministry pushed forward the preparations in secrecy to hurl the troops depending on the dismissal of the impeachment of Park at the "constitutional court", adding that it was part of preparations to quell by force the candlelight demonstrators by declaring the "garrison order" till Park returned to office. The "garrison order" is similar in nature to the "martial law" but it can be invoked by the "president" without consent from the "National Assembly", he said. Rodong News Team

title: Japan Must Set Right Its Own Human Rights Issue
body: Recently the Japanese newspaper Yomiuri Shimbun disclosed the fact that the number of cases of maltreatment of disabled persons is increasing in Japan and it was more than 2 500 in 2016 alone, saying that the wrongdoers were victims' family members or employees of homes for the aged and businesses. The disabled people who should be protected in society are subject to discrimination and contempt in Japan. Corrupt and ailing Japan is the tundra of human rights where all sorts of social evils and inhumane crimes prevail. However, human rights abuser Japan is shamelessly faulting other countries over the situation of human rights in the international arena. This is an insult to the genuine international justice and human rights. See your own shadow, as the saying goes. It urges a man to find his own fault before detecting others'. If Japan foolishly continues faulting others, it would face international isolation and contempt. Japan would be well advised to reflect itself with cool head and mend its own human rights issue. Ri Hak Nam

title: Kim Jong Il's Exploits Praised by Russian Newspapers
body: Russian newspapers gave special write-ups under such titles as "Birth of leader Kim Jong Il and the world", "Undying exploits for peace" and "Feature of a great man" to his birth anniversary. They carried portraits of smiling Kim Jong Il and his photos. The paper Komsomolskaya Pravda said that Kim Jong Il developed in depth the Juche idea through his energetic ideo-theoretical activities and scientifically clarified the theoretical and practical matters arising in accomplishing the human cause of independence and thus provided the progressive people with the powerful ideo-theoretical weapon for building an independent and peaceful new world free from aggression and war. The papers Serp I Molot and Moskovskii Komsomolets stressed that Kim Jong Il performed the exploits to be specially recorded in history while guiding the party, state and army and it is his greatest exploit that the DPRK has demonstrated before the world its dignity as the invincible politico-military power. Glasnosti, Nakhodkinski Rabochi, Nizhegorodskaya Pravda, Byvor, Zavtra, Tsumenskaya Pravda, Khabarovski Express and other newspapers and the Khabarovsk territory online newspaper Zebri Deve conveyed in detail the revolutionary career and exploits of Kim Jong Il, adding that Kimjongilia, immortal flower, has come into full bloom in many countries. Rodong News Team

title: Birth Anniversary of Kim Il Sung to Be Marked in Nigeria
body: A preparatory committee of the People's Progressive Party of Nigeria for celebrating HE Generalissimo Kim Il Sung was formed in Abuja on March 7. Damian Ogbonna, national chairman of the People's Progressive Party of Nigeria, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee decided to organize colorful political and cultural events such as round-table talks, book exhibition and film show to praise the revolutionary career of President Kim Il Sung and introduce successes registered by the army and people of the DPRK in the struggle for building a powerful socialist nation and reunifying the country on the occasion of his birth anniversary, the Day of the Sun. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung's Brief Biography, Kim Jong Un's Work Introduced in Hungary
body: The Hungarian Preparatory Committee for Celebrating the Day of the Sun posted on a website President Kim Il Sung's brief biography and respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "The Great Comrade Kim Il Sung Is the Eternal Leader of Our Party and Our People" on Feb. 28. The work, published on April 20, Juche 101(2012), deals with the revolutionary exploits President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il performed all their life. It also indicates the tasks for firmly defending and adding eternal luster to the ideas and feats of the great leaders. Rodong News Team

title: U.S. Is World's Worst Human Rights Abuser
body: The U.S. is making desperate efforts to tarnish the international image of the DPRK while resorting to the frantic human rights campaign against it. This is the height of shamelessness and a mockery and an insult to genuine human rights. It is the height of folly for the U.S., which has seriously threatened the right to existence of the Korean people through persistent sanctions and blockade to violate the sovereignty of the DPRK with nuclear weapons for decades, to voice "concern" about its "human rights performance". The world's worst human rights abuser is none other than the U.S. The U.S. is the matchless tundra of human rights in the world where democracy is crudely violated. There are over 200 countries and regions in the world but there is no such a vicious human rights abuser as the U.S. in which all kinds of crimes stalk and police indiscriminately kill defenseless people. Barbarous acts committed by the U.S. in other countries shock the world. The U.S. is the kingpin of human rights abuses and harasser of peace as it is not hesitating even sanguinary massacre in order to realize its domination ambition. The U.S. is behaving foolish to realize its ambition for stifling the DPRK over its "human rights" issue but such an attempt will never work on the DPRK. Explicitly speaking, our socialism is a society centered on the popular masses which regards man as dearest. Serious human rights issue lies in the U.S. Ri Hyon Do

title: Japan's Past Crime of Sexual Slavery Can Never Be Hidden
body: The Japanese reactionaries are leaving no stone unturned to hide the past sexual slavery with the lapse of time but can never cover up the worst unethical crime through every possible form of tactics. Several data on the sexual slavery by the Japanese imperialists were revealed in less than one year from April last year. Those data once again clearly show that the sexual slavery by the Japanese imperialists was the heinous kidnapping and forcible drafting committed by the government and the military in an organized way. The Korean nation is grinding their teeth with indignation at the sworn enemy who committed the most hideous unethical crime against the nation and the international community is stunned by the atrocities of the Japanese imperialists without an equal in any war history of the world. The hideous crimes against humanity have no statute of limitations. Our people will force Japan to pay dearly for all the past crimes against the Korean nation. The Abe group can never be pardoned as they are brazen-facedly denying the history of sexual slavery while insisting on the trifling "agreement" they fabricated with the worst pro-Japanese traitor Park Geun Hye group by giving a petty amount of money to it. The Abe group would be well advised to ponder over their action, properly understanding the burning wrath of the Korean nation and its will to take retaliatory actions against Japan. Ri Hyo Jin

title: Day of Sun to Be Marked in Czech Republic
body: A Czech preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, the Day of the Sun, was formed in Prague on March 6. Jozef Servista, first vice-chairman of the Paektusan Czech-Korean Friendship Association, was elected chairperson of the preparatory committee. The committee set the celebration period from March 6 to April 20 and decided to organize various political and cultural functions including a seminar and film show to praise the revolutionary careers and exploits of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il and the personality of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un as a peerlessly great man in this period. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Wins Gold Prize in Izhevsk Int'l Acrobatics Festival
body: The physical acrobatics "Horizontal bar and flying from swing" by acrobats of the DPRK won the gold prize, the highest prize, at the 11th Izhevsk International Acrobatics Festival. The festival took place in Izhevsk City of the Republic of Udmurtiya of Russia from Mar. 7 to 11. The festival brought together more than 200 excellent acrobats from 17 countries including the DPRK, Russia, Romania, France and Italy. Rodong News Team

title: Friendly Gathering Held
body: The DPRK Foreign Ministry arranged a friendly gathering with the staff members of the Cuban embassy here Wednesday, the 32nd anniversary of the DPRK visit by Fidel Castro Ruz. Present there on invitation were Jesus De Los Angeles Aise Sotolongo, Cuban ambassador to the DPRK, and his embassy officials. On hand were Ho Yong Bok, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, and officials concerned. The participants recalled with deep emotion the historic days when President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il had an emotion-charged meeting with Fidel Castro Ruz. They talked about further strengthening the bilateral relations of friendship and cooperation provided by the preceding leaders and being reliably inherited by respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and Raul Castro Ruz and played sports and amusement games. Rodong News Team

title: Youth Activists in Rural Areas Visit Mangyongdae
body: The participants in the national meeting of activists of rural youth workteams and sub-workteams visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. After visiting the Mangyongdae Revolutionary Museum, they went to the old home of Mangyongdae. They looked round the mementoes preserved there, recalling the revolutionary careers of the President and his family members in Mangyongdae. They also went round the Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery on Mt Taesong, the Korean Revolution Museum, the Youth Movement Museum, the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum, the Phyongchon Revolutionary Site and the Sci-Tech Complex and enjoyed a pleasant time at the Central Zoo, the Kaeson Youth Park and the Rungna People's Pleasure Park. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung's Birth Anniversary to Be Celebrated by Koreans in China
body: A preparatory committee of the General Association of Koreans in China for significantly celebrating the 106th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, the Day of the Sun, as the greatest national holiday was formed on March 5. Choe Un Bok, chairwoman of the general association, was elected chairwoman of the preparatory committee. The committee decided to lay floral baskets before the statue of Kim Il Sung at Yuwen Middle School in Jilin and significantly hold events such as a meeting, photo and book exhibition and art performance to praise his revolutionary career and exploits on the occasion of the Day of the Sun. Meanwhile, the Zhongnan Regional Association, the Liaoning Regional Association and the Yanbian Regional Association and branches under the General Association of Koreans in China decided to organize various celebration events. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung's Birth Anniversary to Be Celebrated in Nigeria
body: A Nigerian national preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung was formed in Abuja on March 7. Ibrahim Mantu, member of the Credit Committee of the People's Democratic Party of Nigeria and chairman of the Nigeria-Korea Friendship Association, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee decided to introduce the revolutionary career and exploits of Kim Il Sung, personality of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un as a peerlessly great man and successes made by the Korean people in safeguarding the country's sovereignty and building a powerful socialist country under his guidance and to hold colorful political and cultural events such as a celebration meeting and film show on the occasion of the birth anniversary of Kim Il Sung, the Day of the Sun. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung's Birth Anniversary to Be Marked in India
body: An Indian preparatory committee for celebrating the 106th birth anniversary of HE Kim Il Sung was formed in New Delhi on March 5. Atul Kumar Anjan, secretary of the National Council of the Communist Party of India who doubles as chairman of the All India Indo-Korean Friendship Association, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee set the celebration period from March 5 to April 15 and decided to organize political and cultural events to praise the exploits performed by President Kim Il Sung for the Korean revolution and global independence in this period. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung's Birth Anniversary to Be Marked in Benin
body: A Beninese national preparatory committee for celebrating the 106th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung was formed in Cotonou on March 6. Hessou Kohovi, chairman of the Benin-Korea Amicable Association "Long Live Kim Jong Il, Supreme Leader" and chairman of the Benin National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee decided to hold colorful political and cultural events on the occasion of the President's birth anniversary. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Sun to Be Marked in Belarus
body: A preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, the Day of the Sun, was formed in Belarus on March 9. L. Shukolinikov, chairman of the Permanent Standing Committee of the Belarus National Association of Friends of Korean People Named after Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee decided to give wide publicity to the President's revolutionary career and exploits through media and organize political and cultural events such as celebration meeting on the occasion of his 106th birth anniversary. Rodong News Team

title: Schoolchildren's Study Tour Starts
body: There began study tour of schoolchildren from across the country on the occasion of the 95th anniversary of the 250-mile journey for learning made by President Kim Il Sung. The journey made by the President at 11 was a patriotic and revolutionary one through which he set a great aim to know the country well, crush the Japanese imperialists by the Korean people themselves and liberate the country. The tour group will leave Phophyong and arrive in Mangyongdae through the 250-mile journey made by the President. A ceremony for starting the tour took place in Phophyong, Kim Hyong Jik County, Ryanggang Province on Mar. 16. Attending it were officials concerned and youth league officials, study tour group members and schoolchildren of the county. The participants laid a floral basket before the statue of the President at the Phophyong Revolutionary Site and made a bow to him. A report and speeches were made there. The reporter and speakers called on all the study tour group members to bear in mind the lofty revolutionary will of the President and his burning hatred against the enemy and warm love for the country and the people. At the end of the ceremony the study tour group members left Phophyong. Officials, working people and schoolchildren in the county gave a good send-off to them. Rodong News Team

title: Vigilance Should Be Sharpened against Imperialists' Moves for Expanding Sphere of Domination
body: The imperialists are perpetrating open interference in the internal affairs of other countries and aggression on them under the deceptive slogans "peace" and "ensuring security" in a bid to achieve their hegemonic purpose. The world progressives and countries aspiring after independence have to see through the hegemonic moves of the imperialists veiled with falsehood and deception and counter them with vigilance. The "peace" much touted by the imperialists precisely means the slogan for aggression for expanding the sphere of domination. They are finding their way out of ruin in escalating the invasion of other countries and the meddling in their internal affairs. It is proven by the present reality that sovereignty of countries and nations is violated and there are ceaseless wars and disputes in different countries due to the aggression and interference by the imperialist and hegemonic forces. The moves to maintain and expand the sphere of domination by the U.S.-led imperialists are doomed to fail as they are outdated and reactionary ones going against the trend of the times toward independence. The arbitrary practices and blusters of the imperialists rampant in the international arena are nothing but the last-ditch efforts of the doomed reactionaries of history. No challenge of the imperialists can ever stop mankind from building an independent world. Ri Hyo Jin

title: DPRK FM Leaves for Sweden
body: Foreign Minister of the DPRK Ri Yong Ho and his party left here on Mar. 15 to visit the Kingdom of Sweden. During the visit Ri Yong Ho will meet with Swedish Foreign Minister Margot Elisabeth Wallstrom to exchange views on the bilateral relations and issues of mutual concern. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK National Paralympic Committee Delegation Here
body: The delegation of the National Paralympic Committee of the DPRK led by Chairman of the C.C., Korean Federation for the Protection of the Disabled Kim Mun Chol arrived here on Mar. 15 after attending the 12th Winter Paralympics being held in south Korea. The delegation came here via Kaesong, together with the players' group after the completion of its matches. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK, Cuba Ink Agreement on Cooperation
body: An agreement on cooperation between the Central Public Prosecutors Office of the DPRK and the Supreme Prosecutor's Office of the Republic of Cuba was signed in Havana on Mar. 14. Present at the signing ceremony from the DPRK side were members of the delegation of the Central Public Prosecutors Office headed by Director Kim Myong Gil and DPRK Ambassador to Cuba Pak Chang Yul and from the Cuban side were Dario Delgado Cura, attorney general of the Supreme Prosecutor's Office, and others concerned. Kim Myong Gil and Dario Delgado Cura inked the agreement. Rodong News Team

title: Congratulations to Nepalese President
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK on Mar. 15 sent a congratulatory message to Bidya Devi Bhandari on her reelection as president of Nepal. In the belief that the bilateral relations of friendship and cooperation would continue to develop on good terms, the message wished the Nepalese president great success in her precious work for the political stability and independent development of the country. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Sends Reply Messages to Syrian President, IIJI Director General
body: Respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un sent messages to the president of the Syrian Arab Republic and the director general of the International Institute of the Juche Idea (IIJI) in reply to their congratulatory messages on the 76th birth anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il. In the messages he expressed deep thanks for sending warm congratulations and best wishes on the birth anniversary of Kim Jong Il. He wished them good health and bigger successes in their work. He also sent a reply message to the co-chairman of the Board of Directors of the Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation. Rodong News Team

title: Full Investigation into Lee Myung Bak's Crimes Urged in S. Korea
body: The Citizens Solidarity for Democratic Society of south Korea reportedly issued a statement urging a thorough investigation into the crimes of traitor Lee Myung Bak and a severe punishment of him on Mar. 14. The statement stressed that social justice can not be established in south Korea without punishment of his felonies. It demanded that the prosecution expose the worst crimes of Lee as soon as possible through full investigation. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Photo Exhibition Held in Mongolia
body: A photo exhibition took place at the Mongolian Ministry of Foreign Affairs on March 9 to mark the 70th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the DPRK and Mongolia. On display at its venue were photos dealing with the exploits performed by President Kim Il Sung for the development of the friendly relations between the two countries. Also there were photos showing the history of the development of the bilateral relations. The visitors to the exhibition included Minister of Foreign Affairs D. Tsogtbaatar and Chairman of the Mongolia-Korea Friendship Parliamentary Group O. Baasankhuu, who are members of the State Great Hural, and personages of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Ministry of Defence, the National Emergency Management Agency and the Mongolian Mt. Paektu Association for Independent Development, the DPRK ambassador to Mongolia and members of his embassy, diplomatic envoys of various countries and media persons. The Mongolian minister of Foreign Affairs stressed that Mongolia would as ever continue to develop the traditional friendly relations with the DPRK, saying that the photos showing the development of the bilateral relations are a precious asset helping the new generation carry forward the tradition of the friendly relations. He expressed conviction that the friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries would be enriched with more fresh contents for regional peace, security, prosperity and development. Rodong News Team

title: More Crimes of Lee Myung Bak Disclosed in S. Korea
body: An extra-large corruption of traitor Lee Myung Bak was disclosed, according to the south Korean Yonhap News on March 9. It was proved that he had possessed more than 80 percent of assets of a company under the name of other person. From 2002 he illegally grabbed at least 30 billion won by the method of increasing the money allocated for subcontract business by the company. Rodong News Team

title: Foolish Moves of Swimming against Trend of Times
body: Much upset by the fact that the situation on the Korean Peninsula is being defused thanks to the proactive and sincere efforts of the DPRK, the conservatives of south Korea, including the "Liberal Korea Party," are trying hard to prevent such trend. It is the last-ditch attempt of the group of the worst traitors doomed to meet their miserable end as they have been marginalized by the trend of history towards national reconciliation and unity and peace and reunification. The reckless confrontational moves of the LKP are a revelation of its sinister scheme to mar the atmosphere of national reconciliation and reunification through alliance with the north prevailing among south Koreans from all walks of life with "security" offensive and rally the conservatives ahead of the upcoming elections to the local self-governing bodies. The tight-cornered group of traitors is crying out for "security" while creating the climate of hatred against the fellow countrymen in the south Korean society in a bid to rally the dispersed conservatives and provide a foothold for coming back to power through the above-said elections. Those conservatives are a group of traitors without an iota of blood and spirit of the nation and a group of rabid dogs keen only on the confrontation with fellow countrymen in the north as they leave no stone unturned to achieve their base political ambition. No matter how desperately those dregs of the times are working, history will dynamically advance and those running counter to the public mindset are bound to meet a stern judgment. Un Jong Chol

title: Kim Il Sung's Birth Anniversary to Be Marked in DR Congo
body: A DR Congolese preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung was formed in Kinshasa on March 8. Andre Lohekele Kalonda, chairman of the National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of the DR Congo, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The preparatory committee set a celebration period from March 10 to April 15 and decided to hold political and cultural events praising the exploits of the peerlessly great men and conduct a vigorous movement for solidarity with the Korean people in the period. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung's Birth Anniversary to Be Marked in Switzerland
body: A Swiss preparatory committee for celebrating the 106th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung was formed in Basel on March 10. Martin Lotscher, chairman of the Switzerland-Korea Committee, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The preparatory committee set a celebration period from March 15 to April 16 and decided to organize colorful political and cultural events in this period. Rodong News Team

title: Meeting of Korean Youth League in Japan Held
body: The 5th Meeting of the 23rd Central Committee of the Korean Youth League in Japan was held at the Korean Hall in Tokyo on Mar. 12. Among those present were Han Tong Song, director of the Organizational Department of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), Kim Yong Ju, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the Korean Youth League in Japan, and members of the Central Committee of the league. Chairman Kim Yong Ju made a report at the meeting. The reporter said that the league has made precious successes in consolidating itself into an organization loved by the compatriots and trusted and relied on by the youth and students through an offensive mass movement. He stressed the need to intensify the movement with the branches of the league as a main force up to the forthcoming its 24th Congress as required by the mass drive which is waged in an organized way in hearty response to the New Year Address and New Year message of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. The congress will be a historic one through which to provide a new milestone in the Korean youth movement in Japan in the great Kim Jong Un's era, the reporter said, and called for glorifying the congress of the league, as well as the 24th Congress of Chongryon, as a congress of glory and loyalty and a congress of victory and unity. Then speeches were made. A letter to Kim Jong Un was read out at the meeting. Rodong News Team

title: Imperialists' Aggression and Interference Should Be Resolutely Foiled
body: Today when the imperialists' moves to put other countries and nations under their control and dominate the world have become all the more crafty and vicious, it is a vital issue on which hinges the destiny of each country and nation to fight against aggression and interference in the internal affairs of other countries by the imperialists. The imperialists are citing all sorts of pretexts to dominate other countries and nations and to subjugate them. "Democracy", "human rights" and "war on terrorism" at present are sloganboards which the imperialists have always put up in their aggression and interference in the internal affairs of other countries. The imperialists are trumpeting about "human rights" and "democracy" while giving impression that they are trying to realize justice. This is aimed to justify the aggression and interference in the internal affairs of other countries. The "war on terrorism" committed by the U.S. is a state-sponsored terrorist act against anti-U.S. and independent countries and it is a revised version of undisguised interference in the internal affairs and aggression war moves. It is the unanimous desire and wish of the world peace-loving people to live in the world without domination, subjugation, aggression and interference. Those countries valuing sovereignty of the country and dignity of the nation should heighten vigilance against the imperialists' aggression and interference in the internal affairs and wage high-intensity struggle to thoroughly foil them. Ri Hyon Do

title: S. Korean Conservative Forces Can Not Evade Stern Punishment by History
body: It has been one year since worst traitor Park Geun Hye was impeached by the stern punishment of history in south Korea. The impeachment and detention of traitor Park were an eruption of pent-up wrath and indignation of the public against her and the conservative forces which enforced unprecedented unpopular rule and committed acts of flunkeyism and treachery and heinous moves for escalating confrontation with the fellow countrymen by defying the public mindset and challenging the desire of the nation, and was stern punishment by history. The Park regime, den of evil, was finally sternly punished by history and came to an end. This proved that the traitorous forces going against the desire of the public and the trend of the times are bound to ruin and nothing can quench the desire of the popular masses for justice. The conservative forces including the "Liberal Korea Party" which have resorted to all sorts of evils while living in luxury with the support of the conservative regime are a group of accomplices that have to be buried in the grave of history together with traitors Lee Myung Bak and Park Geun Hye. However, the "Liberal Korea Party" and other conservative forces are desperately trying to check the trend of the times toward national unity and reunification while defending traitor Park. The conservative forces' wild act to get rid of the abyss of ruin is an intolerable insult to the candlelight demonstrators of south Korea and a shame on the nation. The situation proves that the south Korean conservative forces are group of evils and detestable political philistines deceiving the public and dreaming of reviving the fascist dark age, without even an iota of guilty conscience. Ra Sol Ha

title: Editorial
body: Let Us Launch More Vigorous Socialist Emulation for Fresh Victory of Revolution The hostile forces' brutal sanctions and pressure upon the DPRK lay grave ordeals on the way of its advance. For us to bravely overcome manifold hardships and difficulties and leap higher and faster is to actively launch the socialist emulation. The degree of the socialist emulation is the speed of the grand Mallima march. The more active the socialist emulation becomes, the higher the enthusiasm of the struggle becomes, and a great surge will be brought about in production and construction. To help and lead each other forward and bring about the collective innovation is the nature and advantage of Korean-style socialism. Vitality of the socialist emulation is to achieve the unity of the collective with one thought and purpose and give fullest play to the creative wisdom and enthusiasm of the masses. The dynamic socialist emulation is the source of popular heroism and representation of the indomitable offensive spirit of our people to outpace the world. When all the units and fields redouble their efforts and achieve fresh leaps and bring about joint innovations, the invincible spirit of Korean-style socialism will be fully displayed.

title: Executive Committee Meetings of Chongryon Headquarters Take Place
body: Meetings of executive committees of headquarters of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) took place in different parts of Japan from March 8 to 13 to carry out the decision of the 5th Meeting of the 23rd Central Committee of Chongryon true to the letter respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un sent to Chongryon and Koreans in Japan on the 60th anniversary of its formation. The meetings discussed tasks and measures to glorify the 24th Congress of Chongryon as the one of glory and loyalty and more vigorously launch with branches as the center the drive for making a decisive breakthrough for the patriotic movement and adopted the relevant decision. The 5th Meeting of the 23rd Executive Committee of the Tokyo Metropolitan Headquarters of Chongryon was held in Tokyo on March 10. Jo Il Yon, chairman of the Tokyo Metropolitan Headquarters of Chongryon, and other executive members took part in the meeting. Jo Il Yon in his report said that Chongryon conducted a 100-day campaign and a 90-day campaign according to the decision of the Chongryon Central Committee under the leadership of Kim Jong Un last year despite the strained situation and it is vigorously launching the drive for strengthening Chongryon branches this year. He appealed to all Koreans in Japan to bear in mind the absolute trust in Kim Jong Un and pride and honor of having the motherland and intensify the struggle for bringing earlier the final victory under whatever situation. Then followed speeches. The meeting decided to hold the 24th Congress of the Tokyo Metropolitan Headquarters of Chongryon on June 10 at the Korean Hall of Culture in Tokyo. A letter to Kim Jong Un was read out at the meeting. Rodong News Team

title: Japanese Government Urged to Punish Criminals of Shooting Case
body: An inquiry group of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) on March 12 urged the Japanese government to probe into the truth behind the case of firing at the Chongryon Central Hall committed by the Japanese right-wing reactionaries, prevent recurrence of such case and withdraw discriminative rules against Chongryon and Koreans in Japan. The inquiry group consisting of Nam Sung U, vice-chairman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, the department director for Rights and Welfare of Chongryon and representatives of the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Democratic Korean Women in Japan and the Tokyo Metropolitan Headquarters of Chongryon went to the Cabinet Office in Tokyo and met officials of the Cabinet Secretariat, the National Police Agency and the Ministry of Justice. The group handed over a letter of request, adopted at the emergency meeting of Koreans in Japan condemning the Japanese right-wing reactionaries for firing at the Chongryon Central Hall on Feb. 28, to the Japanese government. Nam Sung U said that the reckless shooting case against Chongryon was an unpardonable crime. The Japanese government's persistent sanctions and pressure upon the DPRK and political suppression of Chongryon and Koreans in Japan sparked off the shooting case, he stressed. He urged the Japanese government to withdraw its hostile policy toward the DPRK as early as possible and give up at once the steps of politically suppressing and controlling legitimate and fair activities of Chongryon. Kiyohiko Toyama, member of the House of Representatives and chairman of the International Affairs of the New Komeito Party of Japan, accompanying the inquiry group, contended that the Japanese government should accept the demand of Chongryon and take a responsible measure. Rodong News Team

title: World Progressives Should Dynamically Struggle against Imperialists
body: The world progressive peoples should keep a firm anti-imperialist and independent stand and dynamically struggle against the imperialists to defend independence. The independent world is the world free from domination, subjugation, aggression and interference in which the sovereignty and equality are ensured for all the countries and nations. If the interference and domination by foreign forces are allowed and one's destiny is not hewed out independently, one can not but become neo-colonial slave of the imperialists. The imperialists are the biggest obstacles as they imprudently abuse the sovereignty of other countries and dignity of nations and check the struggle of the countries to build a new society. They have ceaselessly committed military interference and aggressive acts against sovereign states in all parts of the world to satisfy their cupidity. Aggression and domination are ineffective before the strength of the unity. That's why the imperialists have enforced the policy for division and estrangement to easily realize aggression, domination and subordination on other countries. It is the consistent stand of the DPRK to get united and cooperate with all countries and nations aspiring after independence and loving justice, irrespective of differences in ideology and social system, with broad magnanimity and generosity. To strengthen the international solidarity makes one take common steps in the struggle for independence against the imperialists in line with the common aspiration for independence and thus strengthen its might. Ra Myong Song

title: DPRK FM Pays Courtesy Call on Swedish PM
body: DPRK Foreign Minister Ri Yong Ho visited the Kingdom of Sweden from March 15 to 17. He paid a courtesy call on Stefan Lofven, prime minister of Sweden, and had talks with Margot Elisabeth Wallstrom, Swedish foreign minister. The issue of bilateral relations and other issues of mutual concern were discussed at the courtesy call and talks. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Acrobats Back Home
body: DPRK acrobats returned home on Mar. 17 after attending the 11th Izhevsk International Acrobatics Festival. Rodong News Team

title: New Remains Discovered in S. Korea to Reveal Massacres
body: Remains of people, who were killed by the military police and right-wing gangsters during the Korean War, have been continuously unearthed in south Korea. Remains of hundreds of people massacred by the police and the "Homeland Defence Group", a right-wing reactionary organization, between October 1950 and January 1951 were discovered under a dead pit in Jung-ri, Paebang-myon of Asan City, South Chungchong Province, according to the south Korean internet paper Voice of People on March 16. Bones of women and children were piled up on the spot. There were silver hairpins, ring pair, toys, buttons, hair, rubber shoes and bullets and empty cartridges of U.S.-made carbines. The murderers massacred at least 300 people for the reason that they helped the People's Army. According to the witnesses, 70-80 percent of those were women and children. After killing those people, the murderers did not hesitate to burn the corpses to cover up their crimes. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung's Birth Anniversary to Be Marked in Lebanon
body: A Lebanese preparatory committee for celebrating the 106th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung was formed on March 12. Zaher al Khatib, secretary general of the Lebanon Federation of Workers and chairman of the Lebanese Committee for Support to the Reunification of Korea, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee set a celebration period from March 12 to April 15 and decided to give wide publicity to the exploits of Kim Il Sung through media and hold various political and cultural events in this period. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Sun to Be Marked in Algeria
body: A preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung - the Day of the Sun - was formed by the General Youth Union of Algeria on Mar. 12. Muhammad Nouwar Al Rabie Kabaili, chairman of the union, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee decided to organize such political and cultural events as celebration meeting, photo exhibition and film show to mark the 106th birth anniversary of the President. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Sun to Be Marked in France
body: A French preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, the Day of the Sun, was formed on March 9. Benoit Quennedey, president of the France-Korea Friendship Association, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee decided to organize a seminar, lecture and other political and cultural events on the occasion of the 106th birth anniversary of Kim Il Sung. Rodong News Team

title: Participants in Technological Innovation Exhibition Visit Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: The participants in the 5th national technological innovation exhibition of three-revolution teams visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on Mar. 20. They paid tribute to President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il before their statues in the palace. At the halls where Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il lie in state, the participants made bows to them. They went round the halls where orders the great leaders received are on display and halls that house cars, electric car, boat and train coaches used by them for field guidance and foreign tours till the last moments of their revolutionary life. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Foreign Minister Returns Home
body: Ri Yong Ho, foreign minister of the DPRK, and his party came back home on Mar. 20 after visiting the Kingdom of Sweden. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK SPA Delegation Leaves for Switzerland
body: A delegation of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK led by deputy Ri Jong Hyok, director of the National Reunification Institute, left Pyongyang on Mar. 20 to take part in the 138th Conference of the Inter-Parliamentary Union due in Geneva of Switzerland. Rodong News Team

title: Russian Ambassador Hosts Reception
body: Russian Ambassador to the DPRK Alexandr Matsegora gave a reception at his embassy on Mar. 19 to mark the 69th anniversary of the conclusion of the DPRK-Russia agreement on economic and cultural cooperation. Present on invitation were Kim Yong Jae, minister of External Economic Relations and chairman of the DPRK side to the DPRK-Russia Inter-governmental Committee for Cooperation of Trade, Economy, Science and Technology, Sin Hong Chol, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, So Ho Won, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries who is chairman of the DPRK-Russia Friendship Association, and officials concerned. Speeches were made there. Rodong News Team

title: Last-Ditch Efforts to Reverse Trend of Times
body: Recently Prime Minister of Japan Abe said the present situation on the Korean Peninsula serves as evidence of effect of sanctions upon the DPRK, stressing the need to be cautious of the circumstances of the peninsula. Meanwhile, the foreign minister, chief Cabinet secretary, defense minister and other heavyweights of Japan vied with each other to say that "maximum pressure" upon the DPRK should be maintained as ever and that Japan supports the U.S. statement that all the options related to the Korean issue including military action are on the table, underscoring the need to take cautious approach toward the DPRK's intention. This is a revelation of the inveterate habit of Japan to fish in troubled waters by aggravating the situation on the Korean Peninsula and it is nothing but the last-ditch effort to reverse the good trend of the times. The Japanese reactionaries' intention is to instill the Japanese people with the necessity for turning Japan into a military giant and create international circumstances favorable for Japan to legally embark on the road of overseas aggression. The trend of the times will not change no matter how desperately the Japanese reactionaries may try. If they persistently come out as shock brigade in ratcheting up pressure on the DPRK, reeling off reckless remarks, they would face a catastrophic fate. The Abe group should behave themselves, mindful that their illiberal moves would result in pricking their own eyes. If Japan continues to do as now, it will be an outcast. Ri Hyon Do

title: World Water Day Observed in DPRK
body: A workshop took place at the Grand People's Study House in Pyongyang on Mar. 21 to observe World Water Day for 2018. Present there were officials of relevant units including the Ministry of Urban Management and the Grand People's Study House and members of UNDP, UNICEF, WHO, the mission of the European Union Programme Support, the Swiss Agency for Development and Cooperation here and a delegation of the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies working in the DPRK. Speakers at the workshop referred to the efforts made by the DPRK government to preserve water resource and put its management and use on a rational way. They underscored the need to intensify the preservation of natural environment on a worldwide scale so as to settle the serious water issue arising in many countries and regions. The participants watched a TV program and photos on the securement and sustained use of water, a precious natural resource vital for existence and development of mankind. Rodong News Team

title: Russian Delegation Visits Liberation Tower
body: A Russian government economic delegation headed by Alexandr Galushka, minister of Development of Far East who is chairman of the Russian side to the DPRK-Russia intergovernmental committee for cooperation in trade, economy and science and technology, visited the Liberation Tower on Mar. 21. It was accompanied by officials concerned and the Russian ambassador to the DPRK and his embassy officials. The visitors laid bouquets before the tower and observed a moment's silence in memory of the fallen soldiers of the Soviet Army. The delegation also toured the Jongbaek Church on the same day. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to President of Iran
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, on Mar. 21 sent a message of greeting to Hassan Rouhani, president of the Islamic Republic of Iran, on the occasion of the New Year of Iran. Kim Yong Nam in the message wished happiness and prosperity to the government and people of Iran, expressing belief that the friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries with a long history and tradition would grow stronger in the common interests of the two peoples. Rodong News Team

title: Study Tour Group Meets in Kanggye
body: The expedition of schoolchildren from across the country, who are making a 250-mile journey for learning, arrived in Kanggye City on Mar. 19. After leaving Phophyong on Mar. 16, its members reached Kanggye through Wolthan, Hwaphyong, Huksu and Janggang areas. Kanggye, associated with the traces of President Kim Il Sung, is a place where he dropped in to send his father Kim Hyong Jik a telegraphic message saying "Safe Arrival at Kanggye" during his 250-mile journey for learning. Working people and school youth and children in the city gave warm welcome to those marchers coming while singing revolutionary songs. The study tour makers placed a floral basket at the statues of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il in the city and made bows to them. They had a meeting for sending a telegraphic message on their arrival to respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un at the Kanggye Post Office Revolutionary Site on Mar. 20. The message to Kim Jong Un was read out at the meeting. The tour group makers in the message made a report to Kim Jong Un that they had arrived in Kanggye safely after leaving Phophyong on the day when the President started the journey for learning. After the meeting they went round the Kanggye Post Office, Kanggye Inn Revolutionary Site and the Jagang Provincial Revolutionary Museum. The study tour of Mangyongdae continues. Rodong News Team

title: 33rd Sci-Tech Festival of Ministry of Railways Opens
body: The 33rd sci-tech festival of the Ministry of Railways was opened with due ceremony on Mar. 20. Divided into machine, construction, electronic data operation and electricity panels, the festival will take the forms of sci-tech achievements presentation, show and new technology swapping. Presented to the festival were more than 100 data. Rodong News Team

title: Russian Government Economic Delegation Arrives in Pyongyang
body: A Russian government economic delegation led by Minister of Development of Far East Alexandr Galushka, chairman of the Russian side to the DPRK-Russia intergovernmental committee for cooperation in trade, economy and science and technology, arrived Pyongyang on Mar. 20 to take part in the 8th meeting of the committee. Rodong News Team

title: Congratulations to Chairman of China's NPC Standing Committee
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, on March 17 sent a congratulatory message to Li Zhanshu, chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress of the People's Republic of China. In the message Kim Yong Nam extended warm congratulations to him on his election as chairman of the NPC Standing Committee at the first meeting of the 13th NPC. Hoping that the Chinese people would make good success in building socialism with the Chinese characteristics in the new era under the leadership of the Communist Party of China, the message wished him success in his responsible work. Rodong News Team

title: Russian Delegation Pays Tribute to Kim Il Sung, Kim Jong Il
body: The Russian government economic delegation led by Minister of Development of Far East Alexandr Galushka, chairman of the Russian side to the DPRK-Russia intergovernmental committee for cooperation in trade, economy and science and technology, on Mar. 21 visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill. The members of the delegation laid bouquets before the statues of the great leaders and paid tribute to them. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Sends Wreath to Bier of Ko Su Yong
body: Respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un sent a wreath to the bier of Merited Artist Ko Su Yong, a composer of the National Symphony Orchestra, on Mar. 21, expressing deep condolences over his death. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung's Birth Anniversary to Be Marked in Russia
body: A preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung was formed by the Moscow Group for the Study of the Juche Idea on March 15. Mikhail Vikulin Mikhailovich, chief of the group, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee decided to hold colorful political and cultural events such as a seminar on Kim Il Sung's work on the occasion of his birth anniversary, the Day of the Sun. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's Speech Posted on Russian Website
