body: The full text of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's speech "Let KCU Members Become True Sons and Daughters, Young Revolutionaries, of the Socialist Country" made at the 8th Congress of the Korean Children's Union was posted on the Russian website Irkutskblogspot. Ru on March 15. Rodong News Team

title: Russian Delegation Leaves
body: The Russian government economic delegation led by Minister of Development of Far East Alexandr Galushka, chairman of the Russian side to the DPRK-Russia intergovernmental committee for cooperation in trade, economy and science and technology, departed Pyongyang on Mar. 22 after taking part in the 8th meeting of the committee. Rodong News Team

title: Congratulations to Russian President
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, on Mar. 20 sent a congratulatory message to Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin on his reelection as president of the Russian Federation. In the belief that the traditional relations of friendship between the two countries would continue to expand in the future, too, the message wished the Russian president greater success in his responsible work for the development of the country and the well-being of the people. Rodong News Team

title: SPA Session to Be Convened
body: The 6th Session of the 13th Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea will be convened in Pyongyang on April 11, Juche 107 (2018), according to a decision announced by the SPA Presidium on March 15. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Book and Fine Art Exhibition Held in Serbia
body: A DPRK book and fine art exhibition took place in Subotica City, Serbia from Mar. 4 to 7 to mark the 34th anniversary of President Kim Il Sung's visit to Yugoslavia. On display at its venue were works of President Kim Il Sung, leader Kim Jong Il and respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, books on the advantages of Korean-style socialism and the happy life of the Korean people and fine art works showing the creative wisdom and talents of the Korean nation. Attending the exhibition opening ceremony were personages of different circles and citizens of Serbia and the DPRK ambassador to this country and his embassy officials. The chairman of the Subotica City Committee of the Communist Party of Serbia said that Kim Il Sung is a prominent leader of the world socialist movement, expressing the belief that the exhibition would serve as a good occasion in having a correct understanding of the DPRK. The chairman of the Novy Sad Branch of the New Yugoslav Communist Party noted that the Korean people have made great progress under the wise leadership of Kim Jong Un despite the vicious sanctions and pressure by the imperialists. And he said that they would as ever conduct vigorous activities of supporting the just cause of the Workers' Party of Korea and the Korean people. Rodong News Team

title: 8th Meeting of DPRK-Russia Intergovernmental Committee for Cooperation
body: The 8th meeting of the DPRK-Russia intergovernmental committee for cooperation in trade, economy, science and technology took place at the People's Palace of Culture on Mar. 21. Present there from the DPRK side were Minister of External Economic Relations Kim Yong Jae, chairman of the DPRK side to the committee, and officials concerned and from the Russian side were members of the Russian government economic delegation led by Minister of Development of Far East Alexandr Galushka, chairman of the Russian side to the committee, and Russian Ambassador to the DPRK Alexandr Matsegora. The meeting discussed the matters of boosting the bilateral cooperation in trade, economy, science and technology. That day a reception for the Russian delegation was given at Pyongyang Koryo Hotel. Rodong News Team

title: Protocol Inked between DPRK, Russia
body: A protocol of the 8th meeting of the DPRK-Russia inter-governmental committee for cooperation in trade, economy, science and technology was signed at the People's Palace of Culture on Mar. 21. Present at the signing ceremony were Kim Yong Jae, minister of External Economic Relations who is chairman of the DPRK side to the committee, and officials concerned and the members of the Russian government economic delegation led by Alexandr Galushka, minister of Development of Far East who is chairman of the Russian side to the committee, and Alexandr Matsegora, Russian ambassador to the DPRK. Kim Yong Jae and Alexandr Galushka signed the protocol. Rodong News Team

title: Gift to Kim Jong Un from Russian Minister
body: Respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a gift from the minister of Development of Far East of the Russian Federation. The gift was conveyed to Ro Tu Chol, vice-premier and chairman of the State Planning Commission, on Mar. 21 by Minister of Development of Far East Alexandr Galushka, chairman of the Russian side to the DPRK-Russia intergovernmental committee for cooperation in trade, economy and science and technology who is heading the Russian government economic delegation on a visit to the DPRK. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Sun to Be Marked in Bulgaria
body: A preparatory committee for marking the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (the Day of the Sun) was formed in Sofia on Mar. 15. Mincho Minchev, chairman of the Bulgaria-Korea Friendship Association, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee set a celebration period from Mar. 16 to April 15 and decided to hold colorful political and cultural events such as celebration meeting, seminar and book and photo exhibition in the period. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Sun to Be Marked in Pakistan
body: A Pakistani national preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (the Day of the Sun) was formed in Karachi on Mar. 14. A senator was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee decided to give wide publicity to the feats performed by the President for the Korean revolution and global independence and the successes made by the Korean people in the building of a powerful socialist country and to hold colorful political and cultural events on the occasion of the Day of the Sun. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung's Birth Anniversary to Be Marked in Russia
body: A preparatory committee for marking the 106th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung was formed by the Russian Group for Solidarity with the DPRK on Mar. 14. Lebedev, chief of the Group, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee fixed a celebration period from Mar. 14 to April 15 and decided to give wide publicity to the revolutionary career and feats of the President through media and organize a seminar, film show and other political and cultural events in the period. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung's Work Introduced in Nigeria
body: The Nigerian National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism posted on its website President Kim Il Sung's work "Strengthening the Party and Enhancing Its Role Is the Basic Guarantee for the Victory of Revolution" on March 16. The work, published on October 10, Juche 79 (1990), clarifies the idea that in order to successfully carry out the revolutionary tasks, it is important to further strengthen the Workers' Party of Korea and steadily enhance its role. It also stresses the need to further develop the WPK into a revolutionary party of Juche, closely united in an organizational and ideological way and possessed of the invincible fighting efficiency, by thoroughly embodying the party-building principle of Juche. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Central Public Prosecutors Office Delegation Back Home
body: The delegation of the DPRK Central Public Prosecutors Office led by Director Kim Myong Gil returned home on Mar. 23 after visiting Cuba. Rodong News Team

title: Traitor Lee Myung Bak Detained
body: Traitor Lee Myung Bak was detained at dawn of Mar. 23 for high-profile graft, according to KBS and MBC of south Korea. The authorities of the Seoul Central District Court issued a warrant for his detention in judgment that traitor Lee may destroy evidence. The traitor became the fourth former "president" who was jailed after traitors Chun Doo Hwan, Roh Tae Woo and Park Geun Hye. Rodong News Team

title: 1st Pyongyang Int'l Vocal Concours to Be Held
body: The First Pyongyang International Vocal Concours will take place here to celebrate the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. It will bring together international and national vocal concours winners and ace singers from the DPRK and other countries. The concours is to be held at the Moranbong Theatre from April 5 to 12, divided into male and female groups. During the concours there will be a Pyongyang international seminar on the times and musical art. Rodong News Team

title: U.S. and Its Vassal Forces Should Stop Sanctions Racket against DPRK
body: Dignitaries of the White House and departments of state and defense of the U.S. are crying out for "maintaining the policy of maximum pressure" on the DPRK, whenever they open their mouths. Vassal forces including Japan are echoing it, saying that the prevailing situation on the Korean peninsula is a proof of effective sanctions and the sanctions should be maintained as ever. This is a sheer nonsense of those hell-bent on sanctions racket. The positive climate prevailing on the Korean peninsula was created thanks to the proactive measures and efforts of the DPRK and it can by no means be the result of the U.S. and its vassal forces' sanctions. U.S. sanctions do not work on the DPRK. The more pressure the U.S. puts on the DPRK, the stronger Juche Korea becomes, endangering the destiny of the U.S. The U.S. and its vassal forces are desperately resorting to the toughest sanctions and pressure racket against the DPRK by employing all means and methods. But this is just a last-ditch effort to get rid of fear and despair caused by their defeat and wretched plight. If the U.S. persists in acting rashly, not drawing a lesson from its failure in the showdown with the DPRK, the former is bound to face bitterer disgrace and defeat. Ri Hyon Do

title: Editorial
body: Let Us Make Turn in Improvement of People's Standard of Living The Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) set it as the main task for socialist economic construction this year to strengthen the independence and Juche character of the national economy and improve the people's standard of living. This represents the noble intention of our Party to make the 70th birthday of the DPRK the greatest event of significance by bringing about a decisive turn in the improvement of people's standard of living. We have solid material and technical foundations for consumer goods production, laid in Pyongyang and localities under the wise leadership of the Party, and excellent models and plenty of experience for the rapid development of the light industry. When the potentials of light industry are given full reign to effect a great upsurge in production, can cheers for the WPK and socialism resound far and wide in the sky of September. The U.S. imperialists and their vassal forces are now making desperate efforts to hold in check our vigorous advance and stamp out our idea and system. The great spirit of self-reliance displayed in the light industrial field and all the consumer goods produced with our resources and efforts will be a merciless telling blow to the hostile forces. All the officials and workers in the field of light industry should redouble their efforts to bring about a great turn in the improvement of people's standard of living through the on-going revolutionary general offensive in hearty response to the Party's militant call.

title: U.S. "Human Rights" Racket against DPRK Is Absolutely Unjust
body: The U.S. anti-DPRK "human rights" racket is absolutely unwarranted. The injustice of the U.S. "human rights" racket against the DPRK finds a manifestation in its abuse of the UN as a means for encroaching upon the sovereignty of independent states and for establishing the world domination order. The UN is a stage for facilitating cooperation and exchanges among its member nations over human rights. It can never be a stage for justifying interference in the internal affairs of other countries and the racket for putting pressure on them. But the U.S. is using the UN Human Rights Council entrusted with the mission and duty to contribute to guaranteeing human rights in the world as a means for interference in the internal affairs of those countries incurring its displeasure and subversion of their social systems. Question is why the U.S. is getting keen on kicking up the groundless "human rights" racket. By nature, the U.S. has left no means untried to stifle the DPRK out of its inveterate bitter repugnancy against the latter. Its practice never works on the DPRK. The U.S. hostile policy toward the DPRK has faced the fate of bankruptcy. Just as a drowning man catching at a straw, the U.S. is resorting to the false "human rights" racket against the DPRK in the face of successive bitter defeats. Its aim is to internationalize "human rights" issue in the DPRK and kick off a worldwide campaign for putting the "maximum pressure" on the DPRK. In the end, it seeks to bring down the social system in the DPRK. The situation makes one bear in mind the immutable truth that human rights precisely mean the state right and the sovereignty of the country and the nation, and that the military capabilities for self-defence have to be strengthened to defend them. Ri Hak Nam

title: Day of Sun to Be Marked in Romania
body: A Romanian national preparatory committee for marking the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, the Day of the Sun, was formed on Mar. 15. Vasile Orleanu, chairman of the Supreme Council of the Nationalist Socialist Party of Romania and chairman of the National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of Romania, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The preparatory committee set a celebration period from Mar. 16 to April 15 and decided to hold political and cultural events in praise of the revolutionary career and feats of the President in the period. Rodong News Team

title: Pakistani Embassy Gives Reception
body: The Pakistani embassy here arranged a reception at the Taedonggang Diplomatic Club on Mar. 23 to mark the Day of Pakistan. Present there on invitation were Pak Chun Nam, minister of Culture, Ryu Myong Son, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Choe Hui Chol, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, officials concerned and foreign diplomatic envoys and representatives of international bodies in Pyongyang and staff members of foreign embassies. Charge d'Affaires ad interim Syed Sajjad Haider and officials of the Pakistani embassy were on hand. Speeches were made there. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Il's Work Introduced in Brazil
body: Leader Kim Jong Il's work "Abuses of Socialism Are Intolerable" was posted on a website by the Brazilian Center for the Study of the Juche Idea on March 1. The work, published on March 1, Juche 82 (1993), deals with the reactionary nature and falsity of the sophistry of the imperialists and the renegades of socialism calling socialism "totalitarian", "barracks-like" and "administrative and commanding". It elucidates the principled issues arising in defending and accomplishing the socialist cause, including the issue of making the people have the unshakable faith in socialism and regard it as their moral duty to defend it and the issue of giving full play to the advantages of socialism. The website carried the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung's Birth Anniversary to Be Marked in Germany
body: A preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung was formed by the Anti-Imperialist Forum of Germany on March 16. The chairman of the forum was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee set a celebration period from March 16 to April 15 and decided to organize colorful political and cultural events in this period. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung's Birth Anniversary to Be Marked in Jordan
body: A Jordanian preparatory committee for celebrating the 106th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung was formed on Mar. 15. Marwan Sudah, chairman of the Arab Committee for Solidarity with Korean People and Supporting the Reunification of Korea, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The preparatory committee fixed a celebration period from Mar. 15 to April 15 and decided to conduct various activities of introducing the feats of the President and the invincible might of the DPRK in the period. Rodong News Team

title: Reply Message to Kim Jong Un from General Secretary of LPRP
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, received a reply message from Bounnang Vorachith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party (LPRP) and president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic, on Mar. 22. The message said: I express my heartfelt thanks to you on behalf of the Central Committee of the LPRP and on my own behalf for extending warm congratulations and wishes and sending a beautiful flower basket on the occasion of the 63rd anniversary of the founding of the LPRP. I express my belief that the DPRK would as ever register bigger fresh achievements in defending a socialist powerful nation and accomplishing the cause of building it under the wise and resolute leadership of the WPK headed by you. I wish you good health and success in your noble work. I hope that the long-standing friendly and cooperative ties between the two parties, governments and peoples would grow stronger. Rodong News Team

title: Centenarian Receives Birthday Spread
body: Respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un sent a birthday spread to Han Jin Ok, a woman centenarian in Ryongdu-ri, Tongchang County, North Phyongan Province. She keeps her busy cultivating kitchen garden and doing household chores. She always leads an optimistic life, having balanced diet. Saying that thanks to the Party and the state which spare nothing for the people, all people lead a happy and comfortable life, she tells her children to do more work for the social system. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Bangladeshi President
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, on Mar. 26 sent a message of greeting to MD. Abdul Hamid, president of Bangladesh, on its independence day. Kim Yong Nam in his message wished the Bangladeshi people prosperity and welfare, expressing belief that the friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries will develop in the mutual benefits of the peoples of the two countries. Rodong News Team

title: "Globalization" Is Imperialists' World Hegemony Strategy
body: "Globalization" is the imperialists' world domination strategy aimed to achieve the hegemonic ambition with ease through the Western view of value. As each country and nation has its own ideology, system and culture, the world "integration" is absolutely impossible. However, the imperialists force "globalization" on other countries, asserting that it gives everyone an equal opportunity and makes it possible to create global ideology and culture that can be shared by all and to increase the productivity and efficiency by optimizing the use of resources. Their objective is to make the globe a Western-style liberal world and subordinate and assimilate all the countries and nations to them. It has been already proved by the reality of not a few countries which were involved in "globalization". The "globalization" much touted by the imperialists is not for the development and prosperity of other countries and nations but for the establishment of an international order through which they can put the world under their control. The imperialists have disturbed peace and security of the world and gravely threatened the independent development of mankind under the signboard of "globalization". It is a hard fact that no one can deny. Ri Hak Nam

title: War Merchant Spawning Conflicts and Massacre
body: Shortly ago, the Stockholm International Peace Research Institute made public the latest report on worldwide arms deal. According to it, the worldwide export quantity of heavy weapons between 2013 and 2017 increased 10 percent as compared with that between 2008 and 2012. The U.S. is the world biggest arms seller as in the past. In the period the U.S. arms export increased 25 percent and U.S.-made weapons were sold to 98 countries at the least. What matters is that the situation is aggravated, the war and conflicts are getting ever more pronounced and more innocent people are killed in different parts of the world with arms export bringing greater profits to U.S. munitions monopolies. U.S. arms are flooding the countries and areas in which the military confrontation is acute. Japan, which is importing many offensive weapons from the U.S., has emerged a dangerous force for reinvasion and a fanatical entity of militarism threatening peace and stability in Northeast Asia while stepping up the scheme to turn itself into a military giant. The U.S. seeks two purposes in arms export. One is the gain of the pecuniary benefit through huge arms sales and the other is export of disputes and war to the strategic vantages. More than 70 years have passed since the end of the world war and scores of years elapsed since the end of the Cold War. But, the danger of war is increasing and another cold war is imminent rather than peace on this planet. It is due to the U.S., the top class war merchant that spawns war and massacre in different parts of the world through large-scale arms sale, going against the desire of mankind for peace and stability. The warmonger is not in a position to talk about peace. Ri Hyo Jin

title: Only National Cooperation Can Ensure Peace and Reunification
body: If the relations between the north and the south of Korea are to develop as desired by all the fellow countrymen, national cooperation should be realized before anything else. However, the moves for cooperation with foreign forces, contrary to the desire of the fellow countrymen, are still witnessed in south Korea. It is a pressing requirement of history and reality to settle the national issue through cooperation with fellow countrymen, not outsiders. Dependence on the foreign forces, the chieftain of division and hurdle in the way of reunification, makes it impossible to improve the inter-Korean relations and reunify the country. It is impossible to remove distrust and confrontation between the north and the south if one follows and cooperates with the outsiders seeking the inter-Korean confrontation and constant tension on the Korean Peninsula and getting frantic with the anti-DPRK provocations. The internal affairs of the nation should be settled through dialogue between the north and south responsible for it. Dependence on foreign forces leads to national ruin, but only the national cooperation can ensure peace and reunification. If the north and the south cooperate with each other, with national pride and honor and confidence in the strength of the nation, there will be no insurmountable difficulties. The catastrophe of the inter-Korean ties caused by the Lee Myung Bak and Park Geun Hye groups that engaged themselves in sycophancy and dependence on foreign forces, disregarding the national cooperation, clearly shows that the cooperation with foreign forces precisely is the source of escalating distrust and confrontation between the north and the south. It is important to discard the illusion about foreign forces. It is the only way out to solve the national issue through cooperation with the fellow countrymen, not with foreign forces. Sim Chol Yong

title: Meeting of Co-Chairmen of Pomminryon Held
body: The 18th meeting of co-chairmen of the Pan-national Alliance for Korea's Reunification (Pomminryon) was held on Mar. 25 by way of exchanging facsimile messages among its north, south and overseas headquarters. The meeting discussed an action program of Pomminryon for glorifying this significant year as an eventful year to be specially recorded in the national history, under the banner of national independence. A report was made at the meeting. It noted that Pomminryon has made great efforts to positively arouse all Koreans to the struggle for peace against war and realize solidarity and unity of the pro-reunification patriotic forces. The report clarified the following tasks and ways for speeding up the grand march for reunification to glorify this significant year as an eventful year to be specially recorded in the national history with redoubled courage and belief in the rosy future of the nation and the country's reunification: Pomminryon will vigorously promote the improvement of the north-south relations under the banner of By Our Nation Itself. It will stand in the van to positively create an atmosphere for national reconciliation and reunification. It will as ever lead the nationwide movement for rejecting all the war and confrontation moves that threaten the destiny of the fellow countrymen and ensuring lasting and durable peace on the Korean peninsula. The report stressed the need for Pomminryon to fully discharge its responsibility and role before the times and the nation as vanguard for independent reunification and standard-bearer of great national unity. A joint resolution was adopted at the meeting. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Wins Gold Medal in Gymnastics World Cup
body: DPRK player Kim Su Jong grabbed a gold medal in the women's floor exercises of the 11th FIG Artistic Gymnastics Individual Apparatus World Cup held in Qatar from March 21 to 24. Meanwhile, DPRK player Pyon Rye Yong placed the second in the women's vault. The tournament brought together more than 150 excellent players from 29 countries and regions including the DPRK, Germany, Ukraine and UK. Rodong News Team

title: Pomminryon Issues Joint Resolution
body: The North, South and Overseas Headquarters of the Pan-National Alliance for Korea's Reunification (Pomminryon) adopted a joint resolution at the 18th meeting of co-chairmen of Pomminryon held on Mar. 25. The resolution stated as follows: 1. Pomminryon will spur the improvement of the north-south ties under the uplifted banner of By Our Nation Itself. In particular, all the valuable achievements of the June 15 era would be recovered and the June 15 era of independent reunification would be revived to further advance into the second June 15 era in the spirit of By Our Nation Itself. Pomminryon will resolutely reject all the sycophantic and traitorous moves aimed to leave the interests of the nation and the destiny of the fellow countrymen at the tender mercy of outsiders and actively struggle against any sinister attempt on the part of outsiders to estrange the fellow countrymen and foster confrontation between them by creating any artificial block in the improvement of the north-south ties and seeking interference and arbitrary practices. 2. Pomminryon will take the lead in the efforts to actively foster the atmosphere for national reconciliation and reunification. Pomminryon will play a pace-setter role to promote great unity of the nation and fan up the hot air of independent reunification by carrying forward the spirit of the historic April Joint Conference of Representatives of Political Parties and Public Organizations in North and South Korea. In particular, it will ensure successful events common to the nation on major occasions this significant year including the anniversaries of the north-south declarations and thus demonstrate the will for great unity of the nation and the independent reunification. 3. Pomminryon will lead the nationwide movement for ensuring lasting and durable peace on the Korean peninsula. Pomminryon will as ever conduct in the van the nationwide movement for rejecting all acts of war and confrontation that threaten the destiny of the nation and ensuring lasting and durable peace on the Korean peninsula. 4. Pomminryon will strengthen itself and further enhance its function and role. Pomminryon will go among the people of all social standings, breathe the same breath with them, strengthen regional and lower organizations and steadily expand ranks and further consolidate itself through diverse practices for independent reunification and peace against war. The resolution appealed to all its members to more dynamically advance to the eminence of independent reunification with faith and optimism about sure victory. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Greek President
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, on Mar. 25 sent a message of greeting to Prokopis Pavlopoulos, president of the Republic of Greece, on its national day. In the message Kim Yong Nam extended congratulations to the president and people of Greece, sincerely wishing the Greek people progress and prosperity. Rodong News Team

title: 50th Anniversary of Kim Il Sung's Work Marked
body: A meeting was held at the Central Youth Hall on Mar. 26 to mark the 50th anniversary of the publication of President Kim Il Sung's work "On Combating Epidemics More Effectively". The work, published on March 26, Juche 57(1968), indicates tasks and ways arising in improving the public health service. Present at the meeting were Pak Thae Song, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), Jon Kwang Ho, vice-premier of the Cabinet, officials concerned, officials of the fields of public health, medical science and education in Pyongyang. Jang Jun Sang, minister of Public Health, said in his report that Kim Il Sung's work is an immortal great programme that gives the clear-cut answers to the theoretical and practical questions arising in implementing the Party's policy of the preventive medicine. The reporter said that great successes have been achieved in the public health service under the leadership of the peerlessly great men for the last 50 years since the work was made public. He called for attaining without fail the grand goal for building a highly-civilized powerful socialist country set at the Seventh Congress of the WPK by making a fresh turn in the public health service under the leadership of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: 60th Anniversary of Sinchon Museum Marked
body: The Sinchon Museum marked its 60th founding anniversary. The museum is a historic place bearing witness to the brutality of the U.S. imperialists and class enemies and massacres committed by them, the source of the will to take revenge upon the enemies and a powerful base for anti-imperialist class education teaching the truth of class struggle and lessons. President Kim Il Sung visited Sinchon County of South Hwanghae Province shortly after the Fatherland Liberation War to give the instruction to build a museum there to expose brutality, viciousness and cruelty of the U.S. imperialists and saw to it that the Sinchon Museum, the first class education center in the country, was established on March 26, Juche 47 (1958). Leader Kim Jong Il visited the Sinchon Museum several times, indicating detailed orientation and ways to reject any illusion about the U.S. imperialists and instill the burning hatred and the spirit of uncompromising struggle against them into the minds of all the people. Over the past 60 years the Sinchon Museum has developed into a school for class education that implants the thoroughgoing class consciousness and retaliatory spirit into the hearts of the servicepersons and civilians of the DPRK. A meeting was held on Mar. 26 to mark its founding anniversary. Present there were Choe Hwi, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), Pak Yong Ho, chairman of the South Hwanghae Provincial Committee of the WPK, officials concerned and lecturers and employees of the Sinchon Museum. Rodong News Team

title: Premier Inspects Industrial Establishments in Tokchon Area
body: Premier Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, made a field survey of several units in Tokchon area. Going round different parts of the Sungri Motor Complex whose officials and workers are speeding up the production of new-type trucks, the premier encouraged them waging a strenuous onward drive while overcoming obstacles and difficulties by their own efforts and technology. At a field consultative meeting, measures were taken to settle the matters arising in accelerating the modernization of the complex and develop world-level trucks in Korean style. He also inspected the Tokchon Coal-mining Machine Factory and the Wolbong Coal Mine of the Tokchon Area Coal-Mining Complex and discussed the issues of producing more equipment and small tools and increasing the coal production. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Praised by Nigerian Body
body: The Nigerian National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism posted an article titled "Attraction of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un" on its website on Mar. 16. The article said: A politician can become a popular one and pursue successful politics only when he has good qualities and traits. The Supreme Leader of the DPRK is drawing the interest of the international community as a very charismatic and popular statesman. Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un is a very strong leader. The stance and resolute decisions shown by him in recent years' standoff with the U.S. help one grasp his strong disposition. Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un is also tender-hearted while being strong. He is very kind and open-minded to the people. He always bows to people's salutation and unreservedly talks in whispers with them with a smile on his face at all times. His attraction is that he is a very trust-worthy man who doesn't make any empty talk. His judgment is correct and he surely does whatever he is determined to do. The Korean people are firmly convinced that they are sure to win as they are led by him. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Sends Message of Thanks to Xi Jinping
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a message of thanks to Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and president of the People's Republic of China, on Mar. 28. The message said: Leaving for home after winding up my first successful visit to the People's Republic of China, our friendly neighbour, I express deep thanks to you, cadres of the central authorities and Beijing and other people for the warm reception and cordial hospitality they have accorded to us. Our first-ever meeting held in an important period, when the socialist cause of the two peoples has entered a new stage of its development, proved a wonderful occasion in setting up a new milestone for the development of traditional friendship between the two countries in line with the demands of the new era. Feeling satisfied for having achieved a consensus of views on matters of mutual concern with you during our meeting and talks, I believe that the DPRK-PRC friendship, a valuable legacy left by our revolutionary forerunners and a treasure common to us, will be strengthened and developed continuously to meet the interests of peoples of our two countries in the future. I sincerely hope that the fraternal Chinese people will achieve great successes in their efforts to build socialism with Chinese characteristics in the new era under the leadership of the Central Committee of the CPC with you as the core and, at the same time, I wish you good health.

title: Kim Jong Il's Work Introduced in DR Congo
body: The preparatory committee of DR Congo for celebrating the Day of the Sun posted the full text of leader Kim Jong Il's work "Let Us Hold the Great Leader Comrade Kim Il Sung in High Esteem as the Eternal President of Our Republic" on the internet homepage of the National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of DR Congo on March 18 with the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung as an occasion. The work, published on July 11 and 19, Juche 83 (1994), calls for holding the President in high esteem for all ages and sets forth the tasks for defending and creditably carrying forward his idea and exploits. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Sun to Be Marked in Uganda
body: A Ugandan preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, the Day of the Sun, was formed in Kampala on March 19. Kirunda Kivejinja, second deputy prime minister, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. At an inaugural ceremony of the preparatory committee the chairman underscored the need to highly praise Kim Il Sung as the father of socialist Korea and eternal leader of the Korean people, give wide publicity to his career and exploits through media and hold seminar, lecture, film show and other political and cultural events on the occasion of the Day of the Sun. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Sun to Be Marked in Slovakia
body: A Slovak preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, the Day of the Sun, was formed in Bratislava on March 17. Ivan Draxler, chairman of the Slovak Association for Supporting and Studying the Juche Idea and chairman of the Slovakia-Korea Friendship Association, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee set a celebration period from March 20 to April 20 and decided to organize colorful political and cultural events praising the revolutionary careers and exploits of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il and introducing the achievements made by the Korean people in building a powerful socialist country under the guidance of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Children Prove Successful at Int'l Music Competition-Festival
body: Hong Ta Yong and Jo Mi Rae, children of the DPRK, proved successful at the 7th International Polish Grand Piano Music Competition-Festival dedicated to Fryderyk Chopin in Lithuania. Taking part in the competition-festival held on March 15-17 were excellent pianists from different countries including the DPRK, Lithuania, Poland and Italy. Hong and Jo, children of Kyongsang Kindergarten, were embraced in the 6-10 age group. They successfully played world famous musical pieces requiring high skill and artistic talent to win the admiration of members of the jury and experts. Hong received the prize for the second place and Jo the prize for the third place at the prize-giving ceremony. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Sun to Be Marked in UK
body: A UK preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (the Day of the Sun) was inaugurated in London on March 19. Dermot Hudson, chairman of the British Association for the Study of Songun Policy, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The preparatory committee fixed the celebration period from March 19 to April 15 and decided to give publicity to the revolutionary career and exploits of the President and hold diverse political and cultural events in the period. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Sun to Be Marked by Russian Political Party
body: A preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (the Day of the Sun) was formed by the Party for Peace and Unity of Russia on March 19. Sazhi Umalatova, chairwoman of the party, was elected chairwoman of the preparatory committee. The committee decided to hold political and cultural events praising the revolutionary career and exploits of the President on the occasion of the Day of the Sun. Rodong News Team

title: Study Tour Group Passes Hyangsan
body: The group of schoolchildren from across the country, who is making a 250-mile journey for learning, passed through Hyangsan. The members of the study tour group, who crossed Myongmun Pass on Mar. 24, continued their journey via Tongsin and Huichon through which President Kim Il Sung went keenly realizing the reality of the country groaning under the bayonets of the Japanese imperialists. Officials of the local party and power organs and working people's organizations greeted the study tour makers and encouraged them, marching together with them. The study tour makers dropped in at Chongwun Lodge and Huichon Inn Revolutionary Site to deeply grasp the revolutionary feats of the President who cherished a lofty idea to save the destiny of the country and the nation, making 250-mile journeys for learning and national liberation when he was young. During a break they had a meeting to express their impressions of the reminiscences of anti-Japanese guerrillas and their compositions and danced and held a recreation party. They arrived in Hyangsan Township on Mar. 26. They were warmly welcomed by working people from all walks of life and school youth and children. They placed a floral basket at the statue of the President in the township and made bows to him. They left Hyangsan Township on Mar. 27 and are on march for Mangyongdae. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Players Back in Pyongyang
body: DPRK players returned to Pyongyang on Mar. 27 after taking part in the 11th FIG Artistic Gymnastics Individual Apparatus World Cup. Rodong News Team

title: Message of Sympathy to Russian President
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, sent a message of sympathy to Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation, on March 26 over the fire accident at a commercial centre in Kemerovo City of Russia that claimed huge casualties. Kim Yong Nam in the message expressed deep sympathy and condolences to the president and, through him, to the victims and the bereaved families. He hoped that the sorrow of the bereaved families and the aftermath of the accident would be eradicated as early as possible to return the life to normal. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Team Gets Qualification for 2019 AFC Asian Cup
body: The second match between the DPRK team and Hong Kong team of China belonging to Group B for the 2019 AFC Asian Cup qualification was held at the Kim Il Sung Stadium in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, on Mar. 27. At the match, the DPRK team beat its rival 2:0. Jong Il Gwan and Pak Kwang Ryong of the DPRK team scored at around 19 minutes and 25 minutes respectively. The DPRK team recorded three wins, two draws and one lose in six matches of the Group B, getting the qualification for the 2019 AFC Asian Cup. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung Praised by Foreign Media
body: Foreign media featured articles from Mar. 11 to 19 to observe the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. A special write-up was posted on the Russian internet homepage Patrioti Moskva with a portrait of smiling President. It said: Human history knows many famous men but there is no such a great man as President Kim Il Sung of socialist Korea who is boundlessly revered by all people century after century. One of his greatest exploits is that he founded the Juche idea and thus indicated the path to be covered by humankind. It detailed his life as a genuine internationalist. Another website Today's DPRK introduced what famous personages of various countries said to praise his personality as a great man with his photos. President Kim Il Sung of the DPRK is a peerlessly great man highly praised by all, irrespective of their idea, social system, political view and religious belief, it said, adding that he will be always remembered by humankind as a prominent leader representing the 20th century. An article dealing with the International Kim Il Sung Prize was posted with photos on the Russian online magazine Lemchich. A Bangladesh newspaper said that his august name means the sun, adding it is shining as a symbol of national liberation, the era of independence, noble virtue and sense of obligation and the banner of eternal victory. Streets, institutions and organizations of many countries were named after his august name, it noted. A preparatory committee of the People's Progressive Party of Nigeria for celebrating the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung posted on its website an article dealing with the exploits of the President who built the socialist system centered on the popular masses in Korea, regarding it as its maxim to believe in the people as in Heaven. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's Work Published in Ethiopia
body: Respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "The Great Comrade Kim Il Sung Is the Eternal Leader of Our Party and Our People" was brought out in pamphlet with due ceremony on Mar. 21 by the Penguin Publishing House of Ethiopia on the occasion of the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (Day of the Sun.) The work, issued on April 20, Juche 101 (2012), deals with the revolutionary exploits performed by the President and leader Kim Jong Il throughout their lives. It also indicates tasks to firmly preserve and glorify the idea and exploits of the President and the leader. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Ambassador to Nigeria Appointed
body: Jon Tong Chol was appointed as the DPRK ambassador to the Federal Republic of Nigeria, according to a decree of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly. Rodong News Team

title: Study Tour Group Arrives at Mangyongdae
body: A study tour group of schoolchildren from across the country for 250-mile journey for learning to mark the lapse of 95 years since President Kim Il Sung made the 250-mile journey for learning arrived at Mangyongdae, his birthplace. The group left Phophyong on March 16 to go along the course associated with the footprints of the President and which was covered by leader Kim Jong Il. Its members marched more than 320 kilometers past Hwaphyong, Janggang, Kanggye, Jonchon, Hyangsan, Kujang and other areas to reach Kaechon, where they took train to get to Pyongyang on Mar. 29. Amid welcome by citizens, the marchers arrived at Mangyongdae. Vice-Chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea Choe Hwi, First Secretary of the Central Committee of the youth league Pak Chol Min, Chairman of the Education Commission Kim Sung Du, officials concerned and officials of the youth league greeted the marchers and joined them in the journey. A meeting marking the arrival of the study tour group at Mangyongdae took place at Mangyongdae Revolutionary School. Before the meeting, the participants laid a floral basket at the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il at the school and paid respects to them. Pak Chol Min made a report at the meeting to be followed by speeches. Rodong News Team

title: IOC Delegation Arrives in Pyongyang
body: A delegation of the International Olympic Committee (IOC) led by President Thomas Bach arrived in Pyongyang on Mar. 29. Rodong News Team

title: High-level Talks for Inter-Korean Summit Held
body: High-level talks for the inter-Korean summit took place at the Thongil House of Panmunjom on Mar. 29 amid mounting enthusiasm for national reconciliation and unity. Present there were the north side delegation headed by Chairman of the Committee for the Peaceful Reunification of the Country of the DPRK Ri Son Gwon and the south side delegation with Minister of Unification Jo Myong Gyun as the chief delegate. At the talks both sides had an in-depth discussion on technical matters related to the north-south summit and adopted a joint press release. The press release specified the time and place of the north-south summit. Clarified in it was the fact that an agreement was reached on holding several working-level talks for its preparations and that other issues would be discussed by way of exchanging documents. Rodong News Team

title: Session of DPRK Olympic Committee Held
body: The session of the Olympic Committee of the DPRK Juche 107 (2018) took place at the People's Palace of Culture in Pyongyang on Mar. 29. Attending it were members of the committee and officials of the sports field. The session reviewed the work of the committee for Juche 106 (2017) and discussed its work orientation for Juche 107 (2018). Minister of Physical Culture and Sports Kim Il Guk, chairman of the committee, made a report at the session before speeches. The session discussed the matters for bringing about a revolutionary turn in the national sports this year marking the 70th birthday of the DPRK. Rodong News Team

title: Spring Tree Planting Ceremony Held
body: A spring tree planting ceremony of young Red Cross volunteers took place in Sambong-ri, Phyongwon County, South Phyongan Province on Mar. 29 on the occasion of the spring period of the general mobilization for land administration. Present there were officials of the DPRK Red Cross Society, young RC volunteers and other volunteers, officials concerned and members of the delegations of the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies and the International Committee of the Red Cross active in the DPRK. Speeches were made there. Speakers referred to the activities of the young RC volunteers for forest restoration. Saying that planting trees is an important work for the future, they underscored the need to create many forests and take good care of them in order to improve the ecological environment and ensure the human's activities for existence. The participants planted trees of good species including pine-nut tree. The spring tree planting campaign of young RC volunteers will go on throughout the country till April. Rodong News Team

title: Posters on 1st Pyongyang Int'l Vocal Competition Produced
body: Posters on the First Pyongyang International Vocal Competition were produced. Printed on them are letters "The First Pyongyang International Vocal Competition" as well as the logo, period and venue of the competition. Korean and foreign women singers and the Moranbong Theatre, the venue of the competition, are also depicted on the posters. The posters well show the common desire of the Korean people and the world progressives to promote friendship among countries and develop the international cultural and art exchange and cooperation. title: Kim Jong Un Receives IOC President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and supreme commander of the Korean People's Army, received Thomas Bach, president of the International Olympic Committee (IOC), and his party on a visit to the DPRK. Respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un met the IOC president and had a souvenir photo taken with him. He warmly welcomed the IOC president's visit to the DPRK and had a talk with him in a warm and friendly atmosphere. The IOC president said the purpose of their visit to Pyongyang is to express the most heartfelt thanks to respected Chairman Kim Jong Un of the State Affairs Commission for his contribution to making the 23rd Winter Olympics successful ones symbolic of peace. At the Olympics the teams of the north and the south jointly entered the venue of the opening ceremony in the Olympic ideal, competed in games as a single team for the first time in the history of Olympics and thus showed the whole world their will to achieve peace and reconciliation and made the Olympics the ones which evoked the greatest emotion, the president said. He expressed his will to make sure that the IOC would cooperate with the DPRK in the long-term preparation for its participation in the 2020 Tokyo Olympics and the 2022 Beijing Winter Olympics and greatly contribute to the development of sports in the DPRK by proactively using the international sports arena including the Olympic forum with his Pyongyang visit as a momentum. The Supreme Leader thanked him for it and said that he was very thankful that the IOC paid special attention to the DPRK players' participation in the 23rd Winter Olympics and made active cooperation while taking special measures beyond rules and precedents. Noting the Winter Olympics were not only successful ones as Olympics but also ones of special significance which opened a new chapter of concord between the north and the south, he said that the once frozen north-south relations greeted a dramatic thawing season with the Olympics as a momentum and it was totally attributable to the efforts of the IOC which offered an opportunity and paved a path for it. Expressing deep thanks to the IOC for having sincerely cooperated with the DPRK, regardless of any political climate and conditions, he hoped that the positive and proactive cooperative relations between the DPRK Olympic Committee and the IOC would as ever favorably develop. Explaining the IOC president about the sports policy of the DPRK and its prospect, he said he expects close contact and excellent cooperation with the IOC in further developing and improving various sports events including winter sports events in line with the world trend. He warmly invited the IOC president to frequently visit the DPRK as a friend. Present there were Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, Choe Hwi, chairman of the National Sports Guidance Committee and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, Kim Il Guk, chairman of the DPRK Olympic Committee and minister of Physical Culture and Sports, and other cadres. That day the Supreme Leader, together with the IOC president and his party, enjoyed a football match between the State Women's Football Team and the Women's Football Team of the Pyongyang Sports Team. Political News Team

title: Kim Il Sung's Work Introduced in Germany
body: The Anti-Imperialist Forum of Germany posted on its internet homepage the full text of "3. Let Us Reunify the Country Independently and Peacefully" of President Kim Il Sung's work "Report to the Sixth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea on the Work of the Central Committee" on March 22. This part of the work, published on October 10, Juche 69 (1980), refers to the struggle of the Workers' Party of Korea for national reunification in the period under review and to the tasks for achieving the independent and peaceful reunification of the country. It also sets forth a new reunification proposal for founding the Democratic Federal Republic of Koryo (DFRK) on the three principles of national reunification and the 10-point policy to be enforced by the DFRK. title: Congratulations to President of Myanmar
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, on Mar. 29 sent a congratulatory message to Win Myint on his election as the president of the Republic of the Union of Myanmar. The message wished the president great success in his responsible work for the independent development of the country and the welfare of the people, expressing belief that the friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries with long history and tradition would grow stronger. Rodong News Team

title: Japan Should Not Run Amuck
body: An ultramodern submarine has recently been commissioned into the Maritime "Self-Defense Force" of Japan. It is reported that the sub is able to submerge 500 meters deep and its military hardware ensures a powerful precision and long-distance strike at a target. Japan plans to introduce the latest submarines into MSDF. Of late the Japan "Self-Defense Forces", together with the U.S. forces, staged joint military exercises aimed to track and destroy submarines in the Pacific Ocean. Japan increases the capability for preemptive attack and surprise strike by use of submarines. This is part of its sustained efforts to turn itself into a military giant with an aim of realizing its ambition for overseas expansion with the backing of the U.S. Japan is clinging to the U.S. like a leech, thinking that it can realize without difficulties the ambition for overseas expansion with the backing of a big country. It frequently stages joint military exercises with the U.S., accelerating the modernization of military hardware of the SDF under the patronage of its master to accumulate war experience for invading other countries. The danger of war is increasingly becoming a reality in Asia due to the Japanese militarist forces. Peace and security in the region are endangered owing to the Samurai descendents who are making desperate efforts to make up for defeat. The Japanese reactionaries should discern the trend of the times. They may get into trouble if they view Asia today as what it used to be in the past. Jo Thaek Bom

body: The conservatives of south Korea are a group of traitors as they destroyed the favorably developing north-south relations and increased the danger of war to the extreme by getting hell-bent on the unprecedented confrontation moves. When the conservatives run amuck, the inter-Korean ties are driven to the lowest ebb, the climate of war prevails and the people are put in dire destitution. title: Editorial
body: DPRK-China Friendship Will Be further Strenghthened The recent unofficial visit to the People's Republic of China by respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un is a historic event of weighty significance in glorifying the long-standing traditions of the DPRK-China friendship and successfully carrying forward and developing the relations between the two countries down through generations. Great significance of the Supreme Leader's China visit is that it affirmed the common will to consolidate the socialist systems of the two countries and provide their peoples with happiness and future. True to the intention of the preceding leaders, the Supreme Leader paid an unofficial visit to China to put the DPRK-China friendship on a new high stage. The large tree of DPRK-China friendship, cultivated by President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il together with the preceding leaders of China in their lifetime, is spreading fresh and green twigs thanks to the Supreme Leader. His unofficial visit to China is a revelation of his will to invariably preserve the long-standing historical traditions of the DPRK-China friendship, a valuable legacy left by the preceding leaders and common wealth, and remain loyal to the revolutionary obligation and creditably develop the bilateral relations down through generations. The Workers' Party of Korea and the government of the DPRK will as ever further strengthen the bonds of fraternal friendship that have taken deep roots in the hearts of the peoples of the DPRK and China and more vigorously carry them forward.

title: Kim Jong Un Enjoys Performance of South Side Art Troupe
body: Respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, together with his wife Ri Sol Ju, enjoyed a performance "Spring Comes" given by the art troupe of the south side on a visit to Pyongyang at the East Pyongyang Grand Theatre on April 1. He was greeted by the leading members of the south side art troupe including To Jong Hwan, minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism, and Yun Sang, music supervisor, at the theatre hall. He exchanged warm greetings with them and warmly welcomed their Pyongyang visit. He said that as he may have no time because of his complicated political program early in April, he came to enjoy the performance of the south side art troupe he invited to visit here, though it was given late. And he expressed thanks to them for coming here with good performance prepared by them with sincerity in a short span of time. When Kim Jong Un and Ri Sol Ju appeared at the stalls together with To Jong Hwan and other figures of the south side, all the audience enthusiastically cheered them with loud applause. South side's stars sang their favorite songs energetically on the stage where the performance's title "Spring Comes" was seen. The performers were greatly excited to see the stage being provided with reconciliation with the north and the south being as one again, while exchanging greetings with the audience and telling about their Pyongyang visit with warm compatriotism. The performance ended with the song "Our Wish Is Reunification." The performance was acclaimed by the audience as it made them keenly feel once again that the people in the north and the south are the fellow countrymen with their ardent desire and mind desirous of national concord pooling. At the end of the performance, audience presented bouquets to the south side artistes. Kim Jong Un and Ri Sol Ju congratulated the performers on their successful performance, warmly waving to them. After the performance ended, he met and shook hands with the leading actors and actresses of the south side art troupe one by one and expressed his deep thanks to them for pleasing our people through their fine performance. He said that he was deeply moved to see our people sincerely acclaiming the performance, deepening the understanding of the popular art of the south side. Saying that the Pyongyang performance by the south side art troupe has brought spring of peace to the entire nation in the north and the south along with the performance title "Spring Comes", he added that when such good atmosphere is preserved carefully and continuously, only the beautiful spring when new buds sprout and flowers blossom and the rich autumn when the crops are abundant will always be in the way of our fellow countrymen. Expressing expectation that the Pyongyang visit by the south side art troupe would mark a significant occasion of demonstrating the appearance of the one nation, he had a souvenir picture taken with the members of the art troupe. Among the audience were Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, Choe Hwi, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the WPK, Kim Yo Jong, first vice department director of the Central Committee of the WPK, Ri Son Gwon, chairman of the Committee for the Peaceful Reunification of the Country, Pak Chun Nam, minister of Culture, and citizens in Pyongyang. Political News Team

title: Former S. Korean Defense Minister Referred to Court
body: Traitor Kim Kwan Jin, former Defense Minister of south Korea, on March 28 was referred to the court on charges of illegal intervention in the 2012 "presidential" election and "National Assembly" election by directly leading the army cyber command to build up opinion in favor of the conservative group, according to the south Korean CBS. title: IOC Delegation Visits Various Places
body: A delegation of the International Olympic Committee (IOC) led by President Thomas Bach visited Sports Village, Chongchun Street, on Mar. 30. The visitors went round various gymnasiums of the village including the Weightlifting Gymnasium and the Table-Tennis Gymnasium which were successfully remodeled as a comprehensive sports and cultural center. The delegation also toured the May Day Stadium. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korean Conservative Party Condemned for Its Misbehavior
body: The south Korean internet paper Voice of People on March 30 carried an editorial titled "Liberal Korea Party, Head is problem, not the mouth". Referring to the fact that a spokesman of the "Liberal Korea Party" said that the people should make an apology for having doubted 7 hours after ferry Sewol disaster, defending Park Geun Hye on March 28 when the prosecution made public the result of the investigation into the disaster, the editorial said: The behavior of the "Liberal Korea Party" shows that heavyweights of the party including Hong Jun Phyo do not think normally. What matters was the head of the party, not the mouth. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Sun to Be Marked in Sweden
body: A Swedish preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, the Day of the Sun, was formed in Stockholm on March 21. Christer Lundgren, chairman of the Sweden-Korea Friendship Association, and Oskar Molleby, chief of the Swedish Group for the Study of the Juche Idea, were elected co-chairmen of the preparatory committee. The committee decided to organize colorful political and cultural events praising the revolutionary career and exploits of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il on the occasion of the Day of the Sun. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung's Work Introduced in Bulgaria
body: The Bulgarian Group for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism posted on its internet homepage the full text of President Kim Il Sung's work "Enhancing the Role of the Popular Masses Is the Guarantee for Victory in the Cause of Independence" on March 27 on the occasion of his birth anniversary. The work, published on April 15, Juche 81 (1992), says that the President's life of 80 years is that of struggle in which he devoted himself to the people as their son. It also clarifies that the Workers' Party of Korea has firmly maintained the Juche-based stand and principle, always with the Juche idea as its guideline in the whole course of the revolution and construction, and that the common task facing the Koreans and the world people is to build an independent new world. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung's Birth Anniversary to Be Marked in Russia
body: A preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung was formed with due ceremony at the Russian Institute for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism on March 25. Vadim Kudimin, director of the Russian institute, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The chairman said that the life of the President who set forth the scientific ideology and theory and led the Korean revolution to victory was a career for the country and the people and his exploits are brilliantly recorded in history. He went on: The President's ideology and theory serve as a precious guideline for the world progressives who advance along the road of independence. Inheriting the revolutionary traditions provided by the President arises as an especially important issue for the Korean people at present. The struggle of the Korean people for opposing invaders and bringing about happy life is based on the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance. We should disseminate the spirit to not only Russia but the world. We would celebrate the birth anniversary of the President and positively conduct the study and dissemination of the Juche idea whose scientific accuracy and truth have been proved in practice. Rodong News Team

title: Redemption of Past Is Legal, Moral Obligation of Japan
body: A spokesman for the Association of Korean Victims of Forcible Drafting and Their Bereaved Families made public a statement on Mar. 1 on the elapse of 80 years since the Japanese imperialists fabricated and proclaimed the criminal "National Mobilization Law". The spokesman said that the Japanese reactionary ruling circles obsessed with the ambition for overseas invasion made public the above-said fascist law on April 1, 1938 to make up for human and material resources needed for the expansion of war and severely clamped down on the Korean people. He went on: The Japanese imperialists took the Korean people to battlefields for war of aggression, forced labor and disgraceful sex slavery and inflicted pain and death upon them. These atrocities against mankind can never be pardoned as they are the hideous human rights abuses unprecedented in history. Nevertheless, the Japanese authorities and right-wing reactionaries force the history textbook full of embellishment and falsity to be used for education, claiming that there was no the forcible drafting of Koreans and it was a "legal" in those days. Worse still, they are taking the lead in crying out for the sanctions and pressure upon the DPRK in the international arena, not content with slandering the DPRK, the biggest victim, and are laying bare an attempt for reinvasion of the Korean peninsula while positively joining in the reckless U.S. military exercises against the DPRK. What should not be overlooked is that they are severely infringing upon the democratic national rights and right to existence of the victims of forcible drafting and Korean citizens in Japan, their descendants. Behind the Japanese reactionaries' vicious moves against the DPRK and the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) is a sinister aim to divert elsewhere the spearhead of bitter denunciation of the international community for their evading liquidation of past and, furthermore, to bury in oblivion the blood-stained past and carry out their old dream of the "Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere" by doubling the efforts for a military giant. The liquidation of past is Japan's legal and moral obligation and historic task. The Japanese authorities should immediately stop the anachronistic hostile policy toward the DPRK and all human rights abuses against Koreans in Japan and thoroughly make an apology and reparation for the victims and their bereaved families as early as possible. Rodong News Team

title: Escalated Contradiction and Confrontation Are Inevitable Consequence of Capitalism
body: The imperialists become vociferous about "advantage" of capitalism as never before, but they can never hide the rotten capitalist society with any honey words and false propaganda. The escalation of the socio-class contradiction and confrontation is an inevitable product of the capitalist society. The political system of capitalism is the most reactionary one trampling down the independent right of the popular masses. The politics in the capitalist society is under the monopoly financial combine's thumb and speaks for the interest of the exploiting classes from A to Z. The capitalist economic system is the most reactionary one spawning bipolarization such as the rich getting ever richer and the poor ever poorer. The capitalist economic system is the vicious exploitative society in which capitalists meet their limitless greed in return for leaving no stone untried to violate the interest of the working masses in all economic levers. The capitalist cultural system is the most reactionary one serving only the realisation of the interests of the capitalist class. The reactionary culture prevalent in the capitalist society is a tool for paralyzing the revolutionary consciousness of the working masses and oppressing and exploiting them in the interests of the exploiting class who has the means of production. Capitalist society is "heaven" for a handful of the privileged classes, but it is a living hell for working people who have no money. Inevitable is the escalation of the socio-class contradiction and confrontation in this system. An Chol Gwon

title: Chinese Delegation Arrives in Pyongyang
body: A delegation of the Yuwen Middle School in Jilin of China headed by Principal Jiang Guofu arrived in Pyongyang on Mar. 31. Rodong News Team

title: Art Troupe of South Side Arrives in Pyongyang
body: An art troupe of the south side led by Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism To Jong Hwan arrived here on Mar. 31. Arriving here together with it was the south side's Taekwon-Do demonstration group. Rodong News Team

title: Letter to Kim Jong Un from General Association of Koreans in China
body: Respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a letter from the General Association of Koreans in China on Mar. 28. The letter said all the officials of the General Association and the Korean nationals in China extend the warmest congratulations and glory and deep gratitude to the Supreme Leader who made the first historic visit to China and thus developed the traditional DPRK-China friendship, provided by the leaders of the elder generations of the two countries, into a new high stage and made undying contributions to the cause of global independence while giving great strength and courage, national pride and self-confidence to all Koreans in China. It stressed that his first China visit is a historic event as it demonstrated the steadfast stand of the Workers' Party of Korea and the DPRK government to develop on a new height the friendly relations between the DPRK and China, which were established in the sacred common struggle for the socialist cause and whose nature has been protected in the face of all sorts of storms and stress of history, true to the noble intention of the preceding leaders. Seeing the Chinese party and state leaders give warm welcome and cordial hospitality to the Supreme Leader with utmost sincerity, the Korean residents in China have keenly felt again the distinguished personality and greatness of the Supreme Leader who is identical to the great Generalissimos Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il and more deeply the pride and honor of the nation being blessed with the great men generation after generation, the letter said. It said the firm faith more deeply cherished in the minds of the Korean nationals in China is that the socialist homeland and the dignity and happiness of Koreans in China and the life and future of all other overseas compatriots are guaranteed by the Supreme Leader. Rodong News Team

title: Red Herrings by Park Geun Hye Group Disclosed in S. Korea
body: Red herrings cooked up by the traitorous Park Geun Hye group were disclosed, according to news reports from south Korea. The group mobilized media to beautify its unpopular rule and cover up the scandals during her stay in power. A committee for reforming administration of employment and labor made public on March 28 the results of investigation into the red herring operation committed by the Park Geun Hye group to justify its policy for retrogressive revision of labor law by using MBC. The MBC headquarters of the press union charged that the Park's regime and its servants destroyed the function of a public broadcasting service for democracy, urging thorough probe into the truth and punishment of those responsible. It was also disclosed that U Pyong U, former chief secretary for civil administration of Chongwadae, cooked up red herring by dint of power to calm down the mounting protest against scandals of his clans in 2016. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korean Authorities Should Behave with Discretion
body: Shortly ago, in south Korea there was a confrontational farce called a "ceremony for the day of defending West Sea" at the "State Taejon Hyonchung Cemetery" with the attendance of high-ranking authorities, those concerned with ruling and opposition parties and the commander of the U.S. imperialist aggression forces in south Korea on the lapse of 8 years since the warship Cheonan was sunk. The "prime minister" of south Korea said in his "commemorative address" that the West Sea was exposed to constant threat and even an inch on the sea should not be allowed to be intruded. The "ceremony" was an unpardonable confrontational act of throwing a wet blanket over the atmosphere for the improved inter-Korean relations and going against the trend of peace on the Korean peninsula. The "ceremony for the day of defending West Sea" is well known to the world as an anti-DPRK confrontational farce invented by the Lee Myung Bak-Park Geun Hye conservative group to completely destroy the north-south relations. Nevertheless, the present south Korean authorities, crying out for combating evils, are chiming in with the anti-DPRK smear incident, fabricated by traitor Lee during his office and embellished by the Park group of traitors. This is, indeed, a funny behavior. Worse still, they hosted an anti-DPRK farce and spouted the heinous outburst calling for confrontation in league with conservatives, far from working hard to create atmosphere for national reconciliation and unity as unanimously demanded by the people at home and abroad. Their act invites astonishment and indignation. If they keep double-dealing tactics such as talking about dialogue and the improvement of the relations and slandering the dialogue partner behind the scene, there will be no expectation for smooth development of the north-south relations. The south Korean authorities would be well advised to behave with discretion, mindful that they may get a serious trouble if they act hastily at the crucial time. Un Jong Chol

title: Irresistible is Aspiration for Independence, Democracy, Reunification
body: 70 years have elapsed since the April 3 Popular Uprising on Jeju Island. The April 3 Popular Uprising was a righteous anti-U.S., anti-fascist resistance to oppose the U.S. imperialists' colonial enslavement policy in south Korea and their moves for national division and achieve democracy of society and national reunification. The south Korean people do not allow their aspiration and demand, democratic rights and livelihood to be trampled down by the U.S. and the pro-American conservative forces. They are turning out to decisively punish the aggressors and traitors. Just is their struggle to uproot the evils of the conservatives and realize the dream of new politics and new society. 70 years have passed since the April 3 Popular Uprising on Jeju Island in south Korea. Independence and democracy of the south Korean society and national reunification, so ardently desired by the uprisers, should be realized without fail. The conservative group of south Korea is making last-ditch efforts to seek a way for revival while insulting the April 3 Popular Uprising as "riot by the leftist forces" and justifying its crime-woven history. A severe punishment should be given to the satanic group which is betraying the nation, beautifying the pro-U.S. sycophancy and fascist dictatorship and seeking a way out in confrontation with the fellow countrymen. Pak Chol Jun

title: North, South Taekwon-do Demonstration Groups Perform Together
body: A joint demonstration performance of the north and the south Taekwon-do demonstration groups of Korea was given at the Pyongyang Grand Theatre on Apr. 2. Watching the performance were Choe Hwi, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea who is chairman of the National Sports Guidance Committee (NSGC), Ri Il Hwan, department director of the WPK Central Committee and vice-chairman of the NSGC, Kim Kyong Ho, chairman of the Korean Taekwon-Do Committee, officials concerned, sportspersons and Pyongyang citizens. Also watching it were the south side art troupe including To Jong Hwan, minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism, and leading members of the Taekwon-do demonstration group. The members of the Taekwon-do demonstration group from the south side displayed their diverse martial art skills and methods to the tune of music. They satisfactorily performed Taekwon-do movements requiring high techniques with the use of attack and defence skills, including various attack movements and diverse defeating movements, to be applauded by the spectators.
