The members of the Taekwon-do demonstration group from the north side perfectly performed every detail of pattern movements, exciting the spectators. They showed well the might of our Taekwon-do through the demonstration of self-defense art by which they put under control the enemies in an instant by the use of refined techniques such as accurate attack, crushing and throwing down. The members of our Taekwon-do demonstration group broke bricks, tiles, granite slates with explosive strength to be applauded by the spectators. The dynamic group pattern movements of the members of the demonstration groups of the north and the south decorated the end of the demonstration performance. At the end of the performance, the spectators waved their hands and warmly congratulated the Taekwon-do players. Rodong News Team

title: S. Side Taekwon-do Demonstration Group Performs in Pyongyang
body: A demonstration performance of the Taekwon-do demonstration group of the south side was given at the Taekwon-Do Hall on Apr. 1. Watching it were Choe Hwi, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the National Sports Guidance Committee, and Kim Yong Ho, secretary general of the Cabinet, Kim Kyong Ho, chairman of the Korean Taekwon-Do Committee, officials concerned, sportspersons and Pyongyang citizens. Also watching it were leading members of the demonstration group. The members of the demonstration group showed diverse martial art techniques and methods to the tune of music. Whenever they skillfully showed Taekwon-Do technical movements through attack and defence methods including diverse movements and other movements for defeating targets in different positions, the spectators applauded them with warm compatriotism. At the end of the demonstration performance, Choe Hwi and our officials concerned and the leading members of the south side Taekwon-Do demonstration group met and congratulated the performers. Rodong News Team

title: Mangyongdae Prize Sports Contest Opens
body: The Mangyongdae Prize Sports Contest opened to mark the Day of the Sun, the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Competitions in dozens of sports events including football, basketball, volleyball, table-tennis and synchronized swimming will be made in Pyongyang, Nampho, Phyongsong and Sariwon cities during the contest. Its opening ceremony took place at the Basketball Gymnasium in Chongchun Street in Pyongyang on Apr. 2. Present there were Vice-Premier Jon Kwang Ho, officials concerned, players, coaches and Pyongyangites. At the end of the ceremony there was a senior men's basketball game (first class) between the April 25 Sports Team and the Amnokgang Sports Team. Rodong News Team

title: Foreign Artistes Arrive in Pyongyang
body: Artistes of Russia, Belarus, Kazakhstan and Armenia arrived in Pyongyang on Apr. 2 to take part in the First Pyongyang International Vocal Competition. Rodong News Team

title: Pak Pong Ju Inspects Construction Sites in Samjiyon County
body: Premier Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, made a field survey of the construction in Samjiyon County. Going round various parts of the construction site such as the Samjiyonmotka Railway Station and the Samjiyon Youth Railway Station, he encouraged soldier-builders and members of the shock brigade making successes in the construction. A field consultative meeting called for commanding officers to unconditionally carry out the assignments of the project till the fixed date by meticulously organizing operation and guidance as required by the plan for every process and referred to measures for fully supplying construction materials. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK SPA Delegation Back Home
body: A delegation of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK led by deputy Ri Jong Hyok, director of the National Reunification Institute, returned home on Apr. 2 after taking part in the 138th Conference of the Inter-Parliamentary Union held in Geneva of Switzerland. Rodong News Team

title: 23rd Cooking Festival Held in DPRK
body: The 23rd Cooking Festival took place at the Pyongyang Noodle House from April 2 to 4 to mark the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, the Day of the Sun. The festival brought together more than 70 units selected from the committees at all levels of the Korean Association of Cooks. It was divided into exhibitions of inventive dishes, compulsory dishes and sci-tech achievements in cooking and contests of serving dishes, practical skills and demonstration of cooks and waiters and waitresses and cooking skills of students whose major is culinary art. Presented to it were more than 1 100 traditional foods, famous dishes, different kinds of drinks and sweet foods newly invented by servants across the country. Rodong News Team

title: National Photo Exhibition Opens
body: A national photo exhibition opened to celebrate the 6th anniversary of respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's assumption of the top posts of the Party and state. On display at the venue of the exhibition is a photo of Kim Jong Un standing on Mt Paektu. Displayed there are photos dealing with his revolutionary exploits. There are also photos showing the reality of the DPRK which is registering eye-opening successes day after day, turning misfortune into blessing under the guidance of the Party. Its opening ceremony took place at the People's Palace of Culture on Apr. 4. Present at the ceremony were Pak Kwang Ho, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Jon Kwang Ho, vice-premier of the Cabinet, officials concerned and working people in the city. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of "Prominent Personages in Asia" Visits Mangyongdae
body: A delegation of "Prominent Personages in Asia" headed by Dino Patti Djalal, founder of the Foreign Policy Community of Indonesia, visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung, on Apr. 4. They laid bouquets in front of the old home of the President. Being briefed on the revolutionary history of the President, they looked round historic relics preserved with care. Rodong News Team

title: 70th Anniversary of April 3 Popular Uprising Marked in S. Korea
body: Civic and social organizations including the Jeju Headquarters of the south Korean Confederation of Trade Unions reportedly held an all-people meeting outside the Jeju City Office on March 31 ahead of the 70th anniversary of the April 3 Popular Uprising. At the meeting speakers said that the truth behind the uprising has not been made public without a formal and legal name. They stressed that workers should take the lead in forcing the U.S. responsible for suppressing the uprising at the point of bayonet to make an apology. Rodong News Team

title: Chinese Delegation Goes Back Home
body: A delegation of the Yuwen Middle School in Jilin of China headed by Principal Jiang Guofu went back home on Apr. 4. Rodong News Team

title: Desperate Effort to Maintain Hegemonic Position
body: The U.S. increased the budget of the State Missile Defense Agency for fiscal 2018 to the largest ever of 11.5 billion U.S. dollars. This is a desperate effort to maintain its hegemonic position on the decline in different parts of the world even by squandering astronomical amount of fund. What is ridiculous is that the U.S. is claiming that the increased budget is to cope with "threats" from the DPRK. Even though the U.S. vociferates about "threats" from the DPRK, it seeks its own aim. Its intention is to perfect the missile defense system, neutralize the military attack by its potential rivals China and Russia and mount a preemptive attack. The U.S. administration designated China and Russia as "revisionist states" set to change the current world order and its rivals challenging its strength in its new national security strategy. In nuclear posture review it lowered the nuclear weapons use threshold. No country will remain an onlooker to its security being threatened. China and Russia have taken substantial countermeasures such as increasing military capabilities in order to cope with the U.S. moves. The wave of arms race sweeping the world is further increasing the danger of a nuclear war. As the U.S. is going to put the Asia-Pacific region under its control by force and put the world under its domination, the regional situation is being rendered unstable. Ri Hyon Do

title: Unpardonable Anti-DPRK Human Rights Racket
body: The south Korean authorities expressed support for the anti-DPRK "human rights resolution" cooked up at the 37th meeting of the UN Human Rights Council. The "resolution", invented by the U.S., Japan and the European Union, is woven with impure and tricky words slandering the DPRK such as "violation of human rights" and "confession to crimes". It is a vicious insult to the dignity and system of the DPRK and an unpardonable challenge to the dialogue partner. The "resolution", cooked up again by the hostile forces, is a product of the criminal scheme designed to tarnish the sovereignty and dignity of the DPRK and undermine the sacred socialist system. Nevertheless, the south Korean authorities welcomed unreasonable "resolution". This is a political provocation to the DPRK and an unpardonable act of chilling the atmosphere of dialogue. They would be well advised to think twice and act with discretion as required by the hard-won phase of the improved north-south relations and reconciliation. Sim Chol Yong

title: Reactionary Nature of Bourgeois Democracy Cannot Be Veiled
body: No matter how noisily the imperialists talk about "advantages" of bourgeois democracy, they can never cover up its reactionary nature. Bourgeois democracy is the reactionary democracy where a tiny handful of the privileged classes oppress and exploit the overwhelming majority of the working masses. The imperialists seek to spread bourgeois democracy in those countries, which incur their displeasure, and to shake the people's trust in the social systems and power bodies and stir up discontent and separate the public mindset from the leaderships. It is the trite method of the U.S. imperialists to interfere in internal affairs of other countries, vociferating about "freedom" and "democracy", and occupy disagreeable countries by sudden invasion when an opportunity is given. Before the Afghan War the U.S. claimed that it was for "freedom" and it would provide the Afghan people with "genuine democracy". The slogan which the U.S. put up to invade Iraq was to offer "freedom" and "democracy". But the Iraqi people did not receive freedom and democracy but suffered all sorts of misfortunes, pain, social disorder and chaos and deaths. Long-standing stability and orders in different countries of Europe, Africa and the Middle East were destroyed owing to the "export of democracy" in the names of "rose revolution", "orange revolution", "Arab spring", etc. The countries aspiring after independence should clearly understand the reactionary nature of bourgeois democracy and decisively reject it. Jong Il Gon

title: South Side Art Troupe Leaves
body: An art troupe of the south side led by Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism To Jong Hwan left Pyongyang on April 4 after successfully completing its performance program. Leaving together with it was the south side's Taekwon-Do demonstration group. Rodong News Team

title: Floral Baskets Laid at Friendship Tower
body: Staff members of the Chinese embassy here laid a floral basket before the Friendship Tower on April 5 on the occasion of Chongmyong (one of the 24 seasonal divisions in Korea). Present at the floral basket-laying ceremony were officials concerned and Li Jinjun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK, and staff members of his embassy and Chinese guests. Placed at the tower were floral baskets in the names of the Chinese embassy and various Chinese delegations. Also placed there were wreaths in the names of the Ministry of Urban Management, the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries, the DPRK-China Friendship Association and the Pyongyang City People's Committee. The participants observed a moment's silence in memory of the martyrs of the Chinese People's Volunteers before going round the tower. Then, they visited the Songhung Revolutionary Site in Hoechang County, South Phyongan Province and laid floral baskets at the cemetery of martyrs of the Chinese People's Volunteers there. Rodong News Team

title: Women's Union Officials and Members Meet
body: Women's union officials and members met at the Hall of Women on Apr. 6 to celebrate the 25th anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il's election as chairman of the National Defence Commission of the DPRK. Present there were Ri Il Hwan, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials concerned, officials and members of the women's union. Jang Chun Sil, chairwoman of the Central Committee of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea, made a report to be followed by speeches. The reporter and speakers said the DPRK could foil the outrageous challenges by the imperialists, firmly defend socialism and demonstrate the dignity of Juche Korea as it held Kim Jong Il in the highest post of the state. They said Kim Jong Il provided a firm military guarantee for successfully advancing the building of a powerful socialist country, out of his maxim that military muscle precisely means the national strength and strong arms guarantee socialism and safety and happiness of the people. They urged all women's union officials and members to dedicate their all to the struggle for accomplishing the great historic cause of building a powerful socialist nation, true to the intention and wishes of Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: Imperialist Idea and Culture Should Be Rejected
body: The ideological and cultural poisoning by the imperialists is a hideous reactionary offensive to stamp out the popular masses' consciousness of independence and undermine their faith in socialism. The imperialists, who are keen on aggression and plunder, domination and subjugation, are afraid of the unity of the politically awakened independent people. So they are working hard to stamp out the people's consciousness of independence and estrange and divide them. It is the truth proven by the practical experience of the Korean revolution that one can become a victor when one preserves his own ideology. The Workers' Party of Korea gave the fullest play to revolutionary enthusiasm of the popular masses by dynamically conducting the ideological work moving all people in all the stern annals of the revolution, and thus worked epochal miracles in socialist construction. When red flags of the revolution were lowered in various countries due to the vicious moves of the imperialists against socialism, Korean socialism triumphantly advanced. To give priority to ideology is the main key to achieving a decisive victory in the fierce showdown with the imperialists and successfully advancing and accomplishing the cause of socialism. The man who fails to equip himself with the socialist idea is bound to be poisoned by the imperialists' reactionary idea. It is important to set up double and treble mosquito nets in all fields of social life and resolutely reject the imperialist idea and culture. No matter how desperately the imperialists work, they can never subdue the people firmly equipped with the socialist idea. Ri Hyo Jin

title: First Pyongyang International Vocal Competition Opens
body: The First Pyongyang International Vocal Competition opened with due ceremony at the Moranbong Theatre on Apr. 5. Attending it were Pak Chun Nam, minister of Culture who is chairman of the organizing committee of the competition, officials concerned, creators and artistes of national art organizations and teachers and students of art educational bodies, Pyongyangites, foreign artistes, international jury members and honorary guests. Present there on invitation were foreign diplomats and representatives of international bodies and officials of foreign embassies here. Pak Chun Nam said in his opening address that the competition would contribute to further raising the level of artistic representation of Korean and world famous songs and developing international cultural and art exchange and cooperation. Mario Antonio Diaz Varas, professor of Mozarteum University in Salzburg, Austria who is international jury member, in his congratulatory speech expressed belief that the competition would become a good opportunity of boosting art exchange and cooperation among countries and deeply impressing Korean people and world music lovers. Then the international jury members were introduced and the order of singers for the competition was read out there. The participants enjoyed a concert given by the National Symphony Orchestra to congratulate the opening of the competition. Rodong News Team

title: Foreign Marathoners Arrive
body: Marathoners of Morocco, Zimbabwe, Kenya, Ethiopia and Uganda arrived here on Apr. 5 to participate in the 29th Mangyongdae Prize International Marathon to be held on the occasion of the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Rodong News Team

title: Japanese Reactionaries Can Never Block Advance of DPRK
body: Japan, vociferating about the "effectiveness" of its unilateral sanctions against the DPRK, made a decision that all foreign ships entering it should regard it a duty to make "a report on records of portcall on north Korea." It also decided to fine those concerned and inflict legal punishment such as prison sentence on them in case ships which dropped in at Korea enter ports of Japan after concealing the fact. It is a useless act which can be made only by the islanders politically ignorant and senseless to the times. With no desperate efforts can the Japanese reactionaries ever block the advance of the DPRK. Japan is trying to provoke the DPRK through unilateral sanctions while following the U.S. but it is as foolish as trying to pluck a star from the sky. We will never allow any slightest act of violating the sovereignty of the country. The Japanese reactionaries should seriously pay heed to this warning of the DPRK. Ri Hak Nam

title: DPRK's Stand on Independent Reunification
body: It is the consistent and steadfast stand of the DPRK to advance along the path of independence, socialism and independent reunification without the slightest vacillation under any changing situation. A dramatic turn is taking place in the relations between the north and the south of Korea and the situation on the Korean Peninsula thanks to the consistent stand of the DPRK on independent reunification. The DPRK's Juche-based line of national reunification is the most just line as it reflects the aspiration and demand of all the countrymen in the north and the south and overseas for the reunification of the country, peace on the Korean peninsula and the prosperity of the nation. No one can substitute in accomplishing the cause of national reunification and it can be achieved only by the concerted efforts of the Korean nation responsible for it. The DPRK has worked hard to reunify the country by the concerted efforts on the principle of national independence while rejecting outside forces opposed to reunification. The patriotic efforts of the DPRK to reunify the country independently under the unfurled banner of national independence have garnered support and approval of all the countrymen and it has become the factor of propelling the victorious advance of the cause of national reunification. History and reality clearly prove how just the DPRK was when it has pushed ahead with the building of a socialist powerful nation and the cause of national reunification along the immutable orbit by taking the principle of independence as the lifeline. The DPRK will as ever more dynamically advance along the road of independence and socialism and work hard to write a new history of independent reunification By Our Nation Itself. Pak Chol Jun

title: DPRK Government Delegation Arrives in Baku
body: A DPRK government delegation headed by Foreign Minister Ri Yong Ho arrived in Baku on Apr. 4 to participate in the foreign minister's meeting of the non-aligned movement to be held in Azerbaijan. Rodong News Team

title: Congratulations to Egyptian President
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK on Apr. 4 sent a congratulatory message to Abdel Fattah al-Sisi upon his reelection as president of the Arab Republic of Egypt. Expressing belief that the traditional friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries would invariably grow stronger, the message wished the president bigger success in his responsible work for the country's stability and development. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Sun to Be Marked in Italy
body: An Italian preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, the Day of the Sun, was formed in Rome on April 1. Alfonso Galdi, director of the International Department of the Communist Party of Italy, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee fixed a celebration period from April 1 to 30 and decided to hold colorful political and cultural events such as meeting, seminar, film show and book and photo exhibition in the period. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Sun to Be Marked in Congo
body: A Congolese preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, the Day of the Sun, was formed in Brazzaville on Mar. 30. Vital Balla, chairman of the Congolese Association for Friendship among Peoples, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee set a celebration period from April 1 to 30 and decided to give wide publicity to the revolutionary career and feats of the President and the personality of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un as the great man through media and hold colorful political and cultural events such as meeting, lecture and film show in the period. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Sun to Be Marked in Russia
body: A preparatory committee for marking the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, the Day of the Sun, was formed by the Amur Regional Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation on Mar. 30. First Secretary L. A. Kobuizov was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The preparatory committee fixed a celebration period from April 3 to 17 and decided to hold colorful political and cultural events in the period. Rodong News Team

title: Poster for 20th Kimilsungia Festival Produced
body: A poster was produced for the 20th Kimilsungia Festival to be held in Pyongyang on the occasion of the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Depicted in the poster is the immortal flower Kimilsungia in full bloom against the background of the sky in spring with the fascinating drifting fireworks. Written there are the slogan "The great leader Comrade Kim Il Sung will always be with us" and letters "The Day of the Sun", "Celebration" and "The 20th Kimilsungia Festival". Also reflected there are the logo of the festival and its venue and period. Rodong News Team

title: 23rd Cooking Festival
body: The 23rd Cooking Festival took place at the Pyongyang Noodle House in Rangnang District, Pyongyang some days ago to celebrate the Day of the Sun, the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Held on its first day was the exhibition of famous dishes presented by restaurants under the General Bureau of Public Catering Service, national institutions and provincial public catering establishments. What drew attention of visitors was the entertaining and serving contest in which the public catering establishment from South Hamgyong Province and Hyangmanru Restaurant in Pyongyang won high appraisal for their tasty dishes and good service. The festival also included the exhibition of compulsory dishes, cooking demonstrations of management staffs, cooks and waiters, cooking contest of students and exhibition of sci-tech achievements made in cooking to be highly admired by spectators. The festival came to be an important occasion in developing the cooking techniques and culinary culture of the country and improving cooks' skills and abilities. Rodong News Team

title: Remodeling of Cemetery of Fallen Soldiers of CPV Starts
body: Remodeling of the Cemetery of Fallen Soldiers of the Chinese People's Volunteers (CPV) in Kangdong County, Pyongyang City started with due ceremony on Apr. 6 on the occasion of Chongmyong (one of the 24 seasonal divisions in Korea). In the cemetery there are remains of soldiers of the CPV, who fell in the fight against the imperialist allied forces during the Fatherland Liberation War. Present at the ceremony were Choe Song Chol, vice-minister of Urban Management, officials concerned and working people in Kangdong County, Li Jinjun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK, and his embassy officials and Chinese guests staying here including various delegations. Wreaths in the names of the Ministry of Urban Management, the Pyongyang City People's Committee, the Chinese embassy and several Chinese delegations were laid at the cemetery. The participants paid a silent tribute in memory of the fallen CPV soldiers. Li Jinjun said that the Chinese People's Volunteers and the army and people of the DPRK waged a hard-fought struggle shoulder to shoulder during the Korean War and that the contributions made by the fallen soldiers who showed the militant friendship between the two peoples by devoting their precious lives and youths would be remembered. He hoped that the remodeling of the cemetery, which is of important significance in developing the traditional China-DPRK friendship, would be completed on the highest level by the joint efforts. Choe Song Chol referred to the heroic feats of the CPV fighters who bravely fought with the Korean people against the common enemy under the banner of resisting America and aiding Korea, safeguarding the home and defending the motherland during the Fatherland Liberation War. He stressed the need to finish the remodeling of the cemetery by the appointed day and thus contribute to making the feats of the fallen soldiers be long cherished in the minds of the armies and peoples of the two countries. The participants broke ground. Rodong News Team

title: Seminar Held by Workers and Members of GFTUK
body: A seminar on the Songun revolutionary feats of leader Kim Jong Il was held by workers and members of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea (GFTUK) at the Central Hall of Workers on Apr. 6 to mark the 25th anniversary of his election as chairman of the National Defence Commission of the DPRK. Speakers at the seminar stressed that the country was firmly defended under the guidance of Kim Jong Il elected as chairman of the NDC. They noted that Kim Jong Il developed in depth President Kim Il Sung's idea of attaching importance to the arms into the Songun revolutionary idea and the Songun political theory and set forth the theory on the building of a socialist powerful nation, thus indicating a shortcut to frustrating the imperialists' high-handed and arbitrary practices and speeding up the victorious advance of the revolutionary cause of Juche. To hold Kim Jong Il in high esteem as the eternal chairman of the NDC of the DPRK is the principled demand for victoriously advancing the revolutionary cause of Juche by invariably holding fast to his idea and line, they stated. They called upon all the workers and members of the GFTUK to glorify the idea and feats of Kim Jong Il and fully display the might of the heroic Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il working class in the all-out drive to celebrate the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK with labor achievements under the guidance of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Present at the seminar were officials concerned, officials and members of the GFTUK and other workers. Rodong News Team

title: Mangyongdae Prize Martial Art Championship Opens
body: The Mangyongdae Prize National Martial Art Championship opened in Pyongyang to mark the Day of the Sun. At least 500 men and women players from 20 odd organizations including Taekwon-Do teams throughout the country will compete in various events including Taekwon-Do and Paduk during the championship. Its opening ceremony took place at the Taekwon-Do Hall on Apr. 6. Present there were Choe Hwi, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the National Sports Guidance Committee, Kim Yong Ho, secretary general of the Cabinet, Kim Chun Sik, secretary general of the National Sports Guidance Committee, officials concerned, sports persons and Pyongyangites. Kim Kyong Ho, chairman of the Korean Taekwon-Do Committee, made an opening address. At the end of the ceremony there was a march-past by the players and a demonstration by players of the Taekwon-Do Team of the Korean Taekwon-Do Committee. Rodong News Team

title: National Industrial Art Exhibition Opens
body: A national industrial art exhibition on the theme of "Great Heyday of Juche Industrial Art Development" opened with due ceremony at the National Industrial Art Exhibition House on Apr. 6 to celebrate the Day of the Sun, the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Presented to it are more than 800 designs, models and products including the design of a tram for the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, designs related to the Samjiyon Potato Farina Production Factory, designs of Korean-style metro trams and trademark designs for products of the Ryongaksan Soap Factory. Also on display are at least 700 designs, products, models and video clips in different fields made by creators, teachers, researchers, students and amateurs from across the country. Present at the opening ceremony were officials concerned, creators, teachers, researchers and students. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's Successful Visit to China Hailed in Bangladesh
body: Mostafa Jamal Haider, secretary general of the Bangladesh Jatiya Party, issued a statement on April 2 in congratulation of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's successful visit to China. The statement said: News of HE Kim Jong Un's visit to China has aroused great sensation in the world. His visit is of important significance in adding shine to the long-standing tradition of the DPRK-China friendship and carrying forward and developing the bilateral relations generation after generation. In particular, his visit was made at a time when the situation on the Korean peninsula was undergoing a sudden change, a clear indication to the importance of the DPRK-China friendship. Convinced that the two parties and peoples of the DPRK and China will creditably accomplish the cause common to them, we warmly congratulate HE Kim Jong Un upon his successful China visit. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's Work Published in Czech Republic
body: The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Concluding Speech at the March 2013 Plenary Meeting of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea" was brought out in booklet at the Poligraficka Birova Publishing House of the Czech Republic, on March 29. The work, published on March 31, Juche 102 (2013), deals with the validity of the new strategic line of simultaneously pushing forward the economic construction and the building of a nuclear force set forth by the WPK and explains why the Party adopted this line. Rodong News Team

title: Meeting of Political Bureau of C.C., WPK Held under Guidance of Kim Jong Un
body: A meeting of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea was held on Apr. 9 under the guidance of Kim Jong Un, chairman of the WPK and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK. Attending the meeting were members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and members and alternate members of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK. Also present as observers were vice premiers of the Cabinet. Upon the authorization by the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK, the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un chaired the meeting. The meeting discussed "On the execution of the state budget for Juche 106 (2017) and the state budget for Juche 107 (2018)" to be presented to the Sixth Session of the 13th Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK. A report was made by Premier Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK. The Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK examined and ratified the state budget compilation for next year and unanimously adopted a decision for presenting it to the Sixth Session of the 13th Supreme People's Assembly. Then, at the meeting Kim Jong Un made a report on the recent development of the situation on the Korean peninsula. In his report the Supreme Leader referred to the north-south summit meeting and talks to be held at the "House of Peace" in the south side portion of Panmunjom on April 27. He made a profound analysis and appraisal of the orientation of the development of the north-south relations at present and the prospect of the DPRK-U.S. dialogue and clarified the strategic and tactical issues to be maintained by the WPK including the future policy of international relations and the orientation corresponding to them. Then, he pointed out in detail the recent work of the members of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK and stressed the need for them to give fuller play to their responsibility and role as the commanding members of revolution. He called upon all the sectors and units of the state to constantly hold fast to the revolutionary banner of self-reliance and carry out without fail the tasks for this year, the third year of implementing the five-year strategy for national economic development by enlisting their technological forces and economic potentials to the full and thus make a breakthrough in revitalizing the overall economy. Political News Team

title: New Stamp Issued
body: The State Stamp Bureau of the DPRK issued a new stamp (sheetlet) to mark the 25th anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il's election as chairman of the DPRK National Defence Commission. At the center of the stamp there is a portrait of smiling Kim Jong Il, eternal chairman of the NDC. Written on its upper part are letters reading "The most profound respect and eternal glory to the great leader Comrade Kim Jong Il". And a picture symbolic of the glory, dignity and invincible military might of the DPRK is depicted on its lower part. Rodong News Team

title: 29th Mangyongdae Prize Int'l Marathon Held
body: The 29th Mangyongdae Prize International Marathon was held in Pyongyang to mark the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Marathoners from the DPRK, China, Morocco, Zimbabwe, Kenya, Ethiopia and Uganda and many amateurs from various countries and regions competed in marathon, half marathon, 10 km and 5 km races. Its opening ceremony took place at the Kim Il Sung Stadium on Apr. 8. Present there were Choe Hwi, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the National Sports Guidance Committee, Vice-Premier Jon Kwang Ho, Pak Hun, minister of Construction and Building-Materials Industry who is chairman of the DPRK Marathon Association, officials concerned, Pyongyangites and foreign guests. An opening address was made and the games began. Citizens from all walks of life, youths and students cheered the players along the courses. Men and women players of the DPRK won gold, silver and bronze medals in the marathon and half-marathon. In the marathon of amateurs, the first place was taken by Tibbs Hugh Samuel (man) of Britain and Andersen Stine Laura Muldbak (woman) of Denmark, the second place by Sven Thelin (man) of Sweden and Tai Hsiheng (woman) of China's Taipei, and the third place by Kelly Daniel Patrick (man) of Britain and Dideriksen Line Rejkjaer (woman) of Denmark. At the closing ceremony after the games, cups, medals, diplomas and certificates were awarded to the successful runners and amateurs. Rodong News Team

title: Stamp Exhibition Celebrates Day of Sun
body: A collection of Korean stamps were displayed at the Korean Stamp Exhibition House on Apr. 8 in celebration of the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. On display there is a photo showing the stamp carrying pictures of smiling President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il. Hundreds of stamps exhibited under the theme of "The Sun of Juche" help the visitors look back upon the revolutionary life of the President. Some of them reflect his exploits and noble virtue and his external activities. The stamp exhibition will last until April 17. Rodong News Team

title: Korean Books Donated to Russian University
body: There took place a Korean book-donating ceremony at Amur State Humanities-Education University of Russia on April 2 on the occasion of the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Conveyed at the ceremony were works of President Kim Il Sung, leader Kim Jong Il and the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, books in praise of the exploits of the peerless great men and those introducing the proud reality of daily prospering Juche Korea and the Korean nation with a history and culture spanning five thousand years. Attending the ceremony were the vice-president, teachers and students of the university and officials of the DPRK mission in Khabarovsk. Rodong News Team

title: Premier Inspects Wonsan-Kalma Coastal Tourist Area under Construction
body: Premier Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, made a field survey of the Wonsan-Kalma coastal tourist area under construction and the livestock farming base in the Sepho area. Going round various parts of the tourist area under construction, he encouraged its builders who were waging a vigorous offensive, creating a Mallima speed. A consultative meeting held on the spot discussed measures to settle the problems arising in the construction project in time. He also went round the livestock farming base in the Sepho area, stressing the need to increase the production of meat, egg and milk by establishing a proper breeding-system and meticulously organizing the breeding and caring of domestic animals and the manuring and cultivation of grass fields. Rodong News Team

title: Editorial
body: Kim Jong Il's Immortal Exploits for Prosperity of DPRK Will Shine Forever President Kim Il Sung's idea and cause of building a powerful country was successfully carried forward and a grand era when the DPRK was dashing forward to be a socialist powerful nation opened on this land thanks to April 9 when Kim Jong Il assumed the heavy responsibility as the chairman of the National Defence Commission of the DPRK by the unanimous will and aspiration of the army and people. Kim Jong Il was the peerless patriot and elder statesman who laid the strong foundation for the prosperity of the country and its people. He put the dignity of the DPRK on the highest level by the steadfast independent politics and turned the DPRK into the matchless military power with his unique Songun politics. This is the exploit that will shine forever in the history of the country. It was the exploit noteworthy in the history of the nation that he made the DPRK a great family of socialism with his noble politics of love for the people. It is the greatest exploit he performed for the everlasting prosperity of the DPRK that he successfully settled the issue of succession to the leadership. He did everything possible for the country and its people, making his way through virgin snow of the history as chairman of the National Defence Commission of the DPRK. His exploits will shine for all ages.

title: DPRK Government Delegation Arrives in Russia
body: The DPRK government delegation headed by Foreign Minister Ri Yong Ho arrived in Moscow on Apr. 9 to make an official visit to Russia. That day the delegation left Ashkhabad after wrapping up its visit to Turkmenistan. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Government Delegation Visits Turkmenistan
body: The DPRK government delegation led by Foreign Minister Ri Yong Ho visited Turkmenistan on April 7-8. During the visit, Ri Yong Ho had talks with Rashid Meredov, foreign minister of Turkmenistan. Exchanged at the talks were views on a series of matters arising in further developing the traditional friendly relations between the two countries and international and regional issues of mutual concern. Rashid Meredov expressed the will to develop the friendly relations with the DPRK in the future, hailing the fact that the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un made important proposals for improving the north-south relations from the beginning of the year and the course of détente started on the Korean peninsula thanks to the practical measures for implementing them and the progress is being made in developing the inter-Korean relations. Ri Yong Ho paid a courtesy call on Mammedowa Gulsat, speaker of the Parliament. Rodong News Team

title: WHO Representative Hosts Reception
body: Thushara Fernando, representative of the World Health Organization in Pyongyang, on Apr. 9 hosted a reception on the World Health Day. Present there on invitation were Kim Hyong Hun, vice-minister of Public Health, officials concerned, and foreign diplomatic envoys and representatives of international bodies in Pyongyang. Attending it were members of the WHO mission. Rodong News Team

title: Overseas Compatriots Art Troupes in Pyongyang
body: Art troupes of Koreans in Japan and China arrived in Pyongyang to take part in the 31st April Spring Friendship Art Festival. Rodong News Team

title: Russian Political Party Figure in Pyongyang
body: Aleksei Kozitski, chairman of the Maritime Territorial Branch Committee of "A Just Russia", and his party arrived in Pyongyang on Apr. 9. Rodong News Team

title: Foreign Artistes, Delegations, Delegates Arrive
body: The Chelyabinsk State Ural Dance Group of Russia, the Volinaya Stepi Cossack Art Troupe of Russia, a Portuguese conductor, the Lao State Art Troupe, a soloist of the Japan-Korea Society for Music and Art Interchange, a Polish soloist, the Classical Ballet Group of the State Music Academy Theatre of Belarus, the Circus of State Acrobatic Company of Russia, the Moscow Bolshoi State Circus of Russia, the Belarusian National Circus and a Singaporean magician arrived in Pyongyang on Apr. 9 to take part in the 31st April Spring Friendship Art Festival. Also arriving here on the same day were a delegation of the China International Culture Dissemination Centre, delegation of Kaifeng City, China for Cultural Exchange and a vice mayor of Mozhajsk City of Russia. Rodong News Team

title: World Health Day Marked
body: An event for marking the World Health Day took place at the Grand People's Study House on Apr. 9. Present at the event were officials of ministries and national institutions and those in the fields of public health and media and members of missions of international bodies here including representative of the WHO, the UN resident coordinator and concurrently UNDP resident representative. At the event speakers talked about the advantages of the socialist healthcare system of the DPRK in which the state takes the full responsibility for the lives and health of the people with care. They stressed the need to establish the system for health service for all people in all countries for the purpose of the sustained development and advanced health service, and to secure enough number of health service workers. The event heard data on universal health service and the section doctor system which is being enforced in the DPRK. The participants looked round posters and photos dealing with the prevention of noninfectious diseases and universal health services. They toured the Ryugyong General Ophthalmic Hospital. On the same day the intensive hygienic information service took place in every province. Rodong News Team

title: Dancing Parties of Youth and Students Held
body: Dancing parties of youth and students took place across the country on Apr. 9 to celebrate the 25th anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il's election as chairman of the National Defence Commission of the DPRK. Dancing parties began in different parts of the capital city including the plazas of the Monument to Party Founding and the Pyongyang Indoor Stadium amid the playing of song "Please Accept Best Wishes of People". The participants danced to the tune of songs "The General Star beyond the Clouds" and "We Will Hold Our General in High Esteem", with gratitude for Kim Jong Il. They also danced with honor and pride of upholding the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, singing the song "Our Comrade Kim Jong Un" in chorus. Dancing parties revved up the festive mood when "Song of Youth" and "We Are Mallima Riders" resounded forth. On the same day, dancing parties took place in provincial seats. Rodong News Team

title: Film Show Week Opens to Mark Day of Sun
body: A week of film show opened with due ceremony at the Pyongyang International Cinema House on April 9 in celebration of the Day of the Sun. During the week, documentaries about the revolutionary career and feats and popular personality of President Kim Il Sung will be on show at cinemas and houses of culture in Pyongyang and other parts of the country. It includes "Always in the Hearts of Mankind," "The Eternal Sun of Mankind", etc. "Star of Korea", "Mt Paektu", "Bright Morning" and other feature films will be shown. Attending the ceremony were officials concerned and creators and artistes in the cinematic art field and Pyongyangites. On the same day, the film show week opened in each province. Rodong News Team

title: Dancing Party of Women's Union Officials and Members Held
body: A dancing party of officials and members of the women's union was held at the plaza of the Monument to Party Founding on Apr. 11 on the occasion of the 6th anniversary of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's assumption of the top posts of the party and the state. With song "Cheers of the People" reverberating, the participants began to dance, extending the glory and congratulations to Kim Jong Un. As they danced to the tune of "His Embrace Is the Best", they were proud of being Korean women pushing one of the two wheels of revolutionary chariot under the leadership of the Party. The enthusiasm of patriotic Korean women pervaded the dancing venue along with songs "I Will Live like a Star Following Party" and "My Prospering Country". The participants sang songs like "We Will Go to Mt Paektu" with firm pledge to demonstrate the revolutionary stamina of Korean women in the great Mallima advance today, revving up the atmosphere of the dancing party. Rodong News Team

title: Japan Should Control Its Tongue
body: Japan's Foreign Minister Kono at a recent lecture talked rubbish that "one should not respond in haste to the DPRK's charm offensive", "there is no need to hurry" and "the DPRK may take advantage of it". The Japanese newspaper Asahi Shimbun reported that "Japan fears it might be isolated in the hot wind of diplomacy in Northeast Asia". Meanwhile, a member of the House of Representatives of Japan expressed displeasure over the incompetence of the government, saying Japanese people are concerned that Japan is left alone in Northeast Asia. Kono's remarks are no more than grumbling by the lonely island nation which was sidelined under the developing regional situation. Japan is worrying about the fact that it is being isolated in Northeast Asia by the rapidly changing situation focusing on the DPRK. Now those countries related to the issue of the Korean Peninsula make diplomatic efforts to join in the good development of the situation in the region. However, only Japan is reeling off the reckless confrontation remarks which will get nowhere, going against the trend of the times. That's why Japan is to be censured by the public at home and abroad as a senseless one with poor thinking ability. Japan is being more ignored like foam in the kaleidoscopic regional situation. Japan would be well advised to control its tongue. Ri Hyo Jin

title: Posters for 31st April Spring Friendship Art Festival Produced
body: Posters were produced for the 31st April Spring Friendship Art Festival to be held on the occasion of the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. The posters reflect the desire of the participants in the festival to hold the President who made immortal contribution to the development of friendly relations among countries and the cause of global independence, in high esteem as the eternal sun of mankind and sing songs in praise of the great man generation after generation. The posters show performing scenes of experienced art troupe, acrobatic troupe and dancing troupe, international concours winners and other famous artistes of different countries. Depicted on them are Kimilsungia and Kimjongilia, famous flowers praising the great men, and the festival logo and the names of the participating organizations and period of the festival. Rodong News Team

title: Chinese Art Troupe to Take Part in April Spring Friendship Art Festival
body: A Chinese art troupe led by Song Tao, head of the International Liaison Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, will visit the DPRK to take part in the 31st April Spring Friendship Art Festival. The prestigious large-scale art troupe of China will contribute to consolidating the cornerstone of the DPRK-China cultural exchange and developing the traditional DPRK-China friendly relations on a new high stage as it is the first to visit the DPRK after the supreme leaders of the two parties and countries agreed on strengthening the cultural exchange during the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's first historic visit to China. The Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea will warmly welcome and specially greet the artistes of the friendly neighboring country with utmost sincerity. Rodong News Team

title: Foreign Artistes Arrive
body: The Russian State Academic People's Chorus Named after M. E. Pyatnichki, the Song and Dance Ensemble of the Mongolian Army, an opera singer of Bulgaria, the string quartette of the Chamber Orchestra Alberic Magnard of France, a clarinet soloist of Cuba, a Cyprus musical company, the Flamenco Band of Spain and a Thai jugglery troupe arrived in Pyongyang on Apr. 10 to take part in the 31st April Spring Friendship Art Festival. A Chelyabinsk Regional government cultural delegation of Russia and the general manager of the State Acrobatic Company of Russia and his party came here on the same day. Earlier, arriving was a vocalist of the art troupe of the International United Confederation of Koreans. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of Kimjongilia Association of Mongolia Arrives in Pyongyang
body: A delegation of the Kimjongilia Association of Mongolia led by Dorjgotov Jargalsaikhan arrived in Pyongyang on Apr. 10 to take part in the 20th Kimilsungia Festival. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of Communist Party of People of Spain Arrives in Pyongyang
body: A delegation of the Communist Party of the People of Spain led by Maria Teresa Pantoja Bargueno, member of the Political Bureau of the party who is secretary of the Anti-imperialist Solidarity, arrived in Pyongyang on Apr. 10 ahead of the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Rodong News Team

title: Deputies to SPA Visit Korean Revolution Museum
body: Deputies who will take part in the Sixth Session of the 13th Supreme People's Assembly visited the Korean Revolution Museum on Apr. 10. They paid tribute to the colored statues of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il in its general review room. Being briefed on immortal exploits of Kim Il Sung who built our style socialist system centred on the popular masses on this land, they went round various rooms of the hall dealing with the period of laying the foundations of socialism. The deputies also toured the Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery on Mt Taesong and the Pyongyang Teacher Training College. Rodong News Team

title: Art Performance Given by Agricultural Workers
body: Agricultural workers and members of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea (UAWK) gave an art performance at the Jangchon Vegetable Cooperative Farm in Sadong District of Pyongyang on Apr. 10 to mark the 6th anniversary of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's assumption of the top posts of the Party and state. Put on the stage which began with narration and song "Glory to General Kim Jong Un" were colorful numbers including real story-telling "The peerlessly great men and Jangchon Farm" and female folk solo "Sea of Apples at Foot of Chol Pass". Performers praised Kim Jong Un for glorifying the Party and state as the ones of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il and ushering in a new golden age of the Juche revolution. Serial songs "Cheers of the People" and "O My Motherland Full of Hope" and female folk solo "Song of Big Fish Haul", reflecting the reality of the country bringing about eye-opening changes, added to the atmosphere of the performance. Kim Chang Yop, chairman of the Central Committee of the UAWK, officials concerned and union officials and agricultural workers enjoyed the performance. Rodong News Team

title: Order of DPRK Conferred on Austrian Personage
body: Order of the DPRK Friendship Second Class was awarded to Oliver Jonischkeit, federal secretary of the Left Bloc of the Austrian Trade Union Federation, with due ceremony at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Apr. 12. He has fully supported the Korean revolutionary cause and rendered material and moral assistance to the Korean people in the efforts to build a powerful socialist country, with deep reverence for President Kim Il Sung, leader Kim Jong Il and the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: Foreign Guests Visit Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: Foreign guests including Aleksei Kozitski, chairman of the Maritime Territorial Branch Committee of "A Just Russia", and his party and a delegation of the Communist Party of the People of Spain led by Maria Teresa Pantoja Bargueno, member of the Political Bureau of the party who is secretary of the Anti-imperialist Solidarity, visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on Apr. 12. They paid tribute to President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il before their statues in the palace. At the halls where the great leaders lie in state, the visitors made bows to them. They went round the halls where orders the great leaders received are on display and halls that house cars, electric car, boat and train coaches used by them for field guidance and foreign tours till the last moments of their lives. Rodong News Team

title: Report on Fulfillment of State Budget for Last Year and on State Budget for This Year
body: Deputy Ki Kwang Ho, minister of Finance, made a report on the fulfillment of state budget for Juche 106 (2017) and on the state budget for Juche 107 (2018) of the DPRK at the 6th Session of the 13th Supreme People's Assembly held on Apr. 11. According to the report, last year the state budgetary revenue plan was over-fulfilled by 1.7 percent or 4.9 percent increase from the previous year. The local budgetary revenue plan was carried out at 100.5 percent. Last year the state budgetary expenditure plan was carried out at 99.8 percent. 15.8 percent of the total expenditure was earmarked for the increasing of the military capabilities of the country and 47.7 percent for the development of the national economy. Investment in the field of science and technology increased 8.5 percent as over the previous year, thus contributing to settling the scientific and technological problems arising in the economic development and to accomplishing the tasks for studying ultra-modern field. 5.2 percent more fund was allocated to key sectors of the national economy and for the improvement of people's livelihood than the previous year, thus actively promoting the drive for putting power, coal, metal, chemical, machinery and light industrial fields on a Juche basis and updating their production processes. In particular, it helped build a Korean-style oxygen heat blast furnace at the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex and attain the goal of producing new type tractors and trucks. 2.6 percent more investment was made for the construction field than the previous year, while 36.3 percent of the total expenditure was directed to facilitating the building of a highly-civilized socialist power, thus contributing to the implementation of the Party's policies of prioritizing the education and health care and to the development of sports and literature and arts. According to the report, the state budgetary revenue and expenditure for this year have been shaped in such a way as to carry out the five-year strategy for the national economic development. The state budgetary revenue envisages 3.2 percent increase over last year, of which the transaction tax, key item of the budgetary revenue, is expected to swell 2.5 percent while the profits from state enterprises is expected to grow 3.6 percent, to hold 85.3 percent of the total revenue. The income from cooperative organizations is expected to grow 0.9 percent, the real estate rent 1.8 percent, the social insurance fee 1.2 percent, while the revenue from property sales and price differences is to grow 0.5 percent and other revenue 0.8 percent. The revenue from economic trade zones is expected to increase 2.5 percent. The central budgetary revenue out of the state budgetary revenue stands at 73.9 percent which means that the revenue from the central economy holds an overwhelming proportion. Provinces, cities and counties are expected to balance expenditure with their own revenue and contribute lots of funds to the central budget. The state budgetary expenditure is to grow 5.1 percent over last year's. An investment in strengthening the independence and Juche character of the national economy and improving the standard of people's living will increase 4.9 percent as against last year and thus relevant fund will go to 47.6 percent of the total expenditure. An investment in the field of science and technology will increase 7.3 percent. Expenditure for the overall national economy including power, metal, coal, chemical and machine industries, railway transport, light industry, agriculture and fisheries will increase 5.5 percent. The financing necessary for actively promoting the capital construction and further expanding the achievements of forest restoration campaign will swell 4.9 percent. 5.9 percent more fund will go to the education field, 6 percent more fund to public health, 5.1 percent more to sports field and 3 percent more to literature and art. 15.9 percent of the total expenditure will go to increasing the military capabilities for self-defence. This year also, lots of educational aid fund and stipends will be sent for the children of Koreans in Japan. The reporter said that the state budget for this year will be successfully carried out through meticulous organization of economic operation and command and thus financially back the building of a powerful socialist country. Rodong News Team

title: Report on Fulfillment of Cabinet Work for Last Year and Its Tasks for This Year
body: Deputy Pak Pong Ju, premier of the Cabinet, delivered a report on the fulfillment of the work of the Cabinet for Juche 106 (2017) for carrying out the five-year strategy for national economic development and its tasks for Juche 107 (2018) at the Sixth Session of the 13th Supreme People's Assembly held on Apr. 11. Last year was a year of great victory in which a great progress had been made in carrying out the five-year strategy for the national economic development under the outstanding and seasoned guidance of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, repelling unprecedentedly grave challenges stemming our advance, the reporter said. According to the report, last year the Cabinet organized a drive for putting the nation's overall economy on a higher stage with a main emphasis put on revitalizing the production by locally producing equipment, raw and other materials on the principle of self-support and self-sufficiency while focusing the state efforts on augmenting the foundation for electricity production, rounding off the system of Juche iron production and realizing the independence of chemical industry in line with the five-year strategy for national economic development set forth by the Party. All sectors and units of the national economy carried out a high-pitched drive for creation in the spirit of self-development and, as a result, lots of factories and enterprises honored their yearly gross industrial output value plans and those units associated with the leadership feats of our Party carried out their yearly national economy assignments. The achievements made last year, a year of crucial importance in carrying out the five-year strategy for national economic development, proved once again that no desperate sanctions and pressure moves of the U.S. and its vassal forces to destroy the sovereignty of the DPRK and its rights to existence and development can ever check the progress of the Korean people dynamically advancing with firm faith in the validity of their cause and its final victory under the wise guidance of the Party and that the cause of building a powerful socialist country is sure to be accomplished. Saying that this year we are faced with the tasks to make a breakthrough of revitalization in the economic front as a whole while frustrating the challenges of the hostile forces, who are making last-ditch efforts, through all-people offensive under the militant slogan of "Let us launch a revolutionary general offensive to achieve fresh victory on all fronts of building a powerful socialist country!", the reporter specified them. The fighting goals for the third year of the five-year strategy for national economic development should be attained without fail with a firm hold on the key tasks of strengthening the independence and Juche character of the national economy and improving the standard of people's living. The power industrial sector should put defective generating equipment into good shape and reinforce them, take scientific and technological measures for lowering the standard of coal consumption at thermal power plants and put the operation of generating equipment additionally installed at the Pukchang Thermal Power Complex on a normal track and thus increase the electricity production with the use of thermal power source onto a high stage. The coal industrial field should attain the monthly and quarterly coal production goals and create more coal fields so as to fully meet the demand for coal increasing in different sectors of the national economy. In the field of metal industry, Korean-style Juche-based iron making production system should be further perfected by the use of oxygen heat blast furnace and efforts be put into improving the quality of steel and diversifying the kinds of steels through introduction of advanced technologies so as to fully meet the demand for iron and steel of the national economy. The field of chemical industry should unconditionally hit the fertilizer production target to timely provide nitrogenous fertilizer to the agricultural field ahead of farming processes. The production at the February 8 Vinalon Complex should be invigorated to fully supply various chemical products including vinalon, caustic soda and vinyl chloride to various sectors of the national economy. Along with the establishment of various catalyst production bases, the construction of main production processes should be pushed forward at the Sunchon Phosphate Fertilizer Factory and the process for production of carbonate of soda with glauberite as starting raw material should be renovated and perfected. The machine industrial sector has to step up the modernization of machine factories, unconditionally hit the target for production of tractors and trucks and put the quality of machinery on the world level. Advanced mining methods should be widely introduced to increase the production of minerals and nonferrous metal. The railway transport sector should ensure in a responsible manner the transportation of materials necessary for various sectors of the national economy and capital construction projects. The Cabinet will bring about a remarkable turn in improving the standard of people's living through production surge in the fields of light industry, agriculture and fisheries this year. Equipment and production processes should be rearranged on a manpower-saving and electricity-saving basis, diverse and quality light industrial goods produced on a larger quantity with locally available raw and other materials, and local economy should be developed in a peculiar way with reliance on the domestic resources. High-yielding farming methods should be positively introduced and the proportion of farm work done by machines should be drastically increased to attain the grain production goal for this year without fail. The fisheries field should unconditionally hit the fish production target and at the same time finish the construction of projects for consolidating the material and technical foundation of fisheries ahead of schedule. Big efforts should be directed to sprucing up Samjiyon County into a standard and model county under socialism and the construction of the Wonsan-Kalma coastal tourist area should be finished within specified date. And such capital construction projects as the Tanchon Power Station and the second-phase waterway project in South Hwanghae Province should be pushed forward. The rate of rooting of saplings should be ensured at more than 90 percent through efficient tree planting and meticulous cultivation of planted trees and the appearance of the country be bettered through the technical renovation and repairing of highways and tourist roads in a qualitative way and the rearrangement of key rivers and streams based on an all-people movement. All the sectors and units should solve the sci-tech problems arising in completing the domestic production of materials and equipment and the structure of self-supporting economy with firm reliance on science and technology. The reporter stressed that the Cabinet and other state economic guidance organs would work out in a practical way an operation plan for hitting this year's targets and push forward its implementation in a responsible manner through skillful operation and command to successfully attain the fighting goals set forth by the Party and thus fully discharge their responsibility and duty in glorifying this year marking the 70th anniversary of the DPRK as a year of victory to be specially recorded in the history of the country. Rodong News Team

title: Sixth Session of 13th SPA Held
body: The Sixth Session of the 13th Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK took place in Pyongyang on Apr. 11. Attending it were Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the SPA Presidium of the DPRK; Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK; Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet; leading officials of the Party and government, the chairman of the C.C., Korean Social Democratic Party, deputies to the SPA, members of the SPA Presidium and senior officials of the armed forces organs. Officials of party, armed forces and power organs, the Cabinet, social organizations, ministries and national institutions, factories, enterprises, co-op farms and educational and scientific research organs were on hand as observers. The agenda items of the Sixth Session of the 13th SPA were decided at the session. 1. On review of the Cabinet's work for Juche 106 (2017) for carrying out the five-year strategy for national economic development, and tasks for Juche 107 (2018) 2. On summing up the execution of the state budget of the DPRK for Juche 106 (2017) and state budget for Juche 107 (2018) 3. Organizational matters Deputy Pak Pong Ju, premier of the Cabinet, made a report on the first agenda item at the session. Deputy Ki Kwang Ho, minister of Finance, made a report on the second agenda item. Deputies made speeches on the first and second agenda items. Speakers said that last year the army and people of the DPRK made great progress in implementing the five-year strategy for the national economic development set forth at the Seventh Congress of the WPK. They noted that the work of the Cabinet and the execution of state budget for last year were correctly reviewed and settled. Saying that the tasks of the Cabinet and the state budget for this year were properly set out, they expressed support and approval for them. They expressed their will to fulfill their responsibility and role in the drive for strengthening the independence and Juche character of the national economy and improving the people's standard of living. Adopted at the session were a decision of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK "On approving the report on the work of the DPRK Cabinet and the summing up of the execution of the state budget for Juche 106 (2017)" and an ordinance of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK "On state budget of the DPRK for Juche 107 (2018)". Organizational matters, the third agenda item, were discussed at the session. At the proposal of the chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, Deputy Hwang Pyong So was dismissed from the post of its vice-chairman and Deputy Kim Ki Nam, Deputy Ri Man Gon and Kim Won Hong were dismissed from the posts of its members. Upon the authorization of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, Deputies Kim Jong Gak, Pak Kwang Ho, Thae Jong Su and Jong Kyong Thaek were elected as members of the SAC of the DPRK to fill vacancies. Upon the authorization of the C.C., WPK, Deputy Pak Thae Song was dismissed from the post of member of the SPA Presidium due to the transfer to other post and Deputy Jong Yong Guk was elected as secretary general of the SPA Presidium and Deputies Kim Su Gil, Pak Chol Min and Kim Chang Yop as members of the SPA Presidium to fill vacancies. Deputy Pak Thae Dok was dismissed from the post of member of the Legislation Committee of the SPA and Deputies Ryang Jong Hun and Kim Myong Gil were elected as members of the Legislation Committee of the SPA to fill vacancies. Rodong News Team

title: 31st April Spring Friendship Art Festival Opens
body: The 31st April Spring Friendship Art Festival opened at the East Pyongyang Grand Theatre in Pyongyang on Apr. 11 with due ceremony. Taking part in the festival are prestigious and talented artistes of different countries and vocalists who proved successful in the First Pyongyang International Vocal Competition. When foreign artistes and overseas Korean artistes arrived at the East Pyongyang Grand Theatre, working people in the city warmly welcomed them, waving bouquets. The atmosphere of the festival opening ceremony revved up when a female brass band played cheerful music and artistes presented graceful dances and acrobatic pieces and children displayed skills. Present at the ceremony were Pak Kwang Ho, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Yang Hyong Sop, vice-president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, Jon Kwang Ho, vice-premier of the Cabinet, officials concerned, working people in the city, foreign artistes, overseas Korean artistes, delegations of different countries, foreign diplomatic envoys and representatives of international bodies here, military attaches and officials of foreign embassies here and overseas Koreans staying in the socialist homeland. Pak Chun Nam, minister of Culture who is chairman of the festival organizing committee, made an opening address. He warmly welcomed the participants in the 31st April Spring Friendship Art Festival marking the 106th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. He thanked governments and culture and art circles of different countries for their positive cooperation for a successful festival, true to the idea of independence, peace and friendship. He expressed the expectation that the excellent cultures and traditions of relevant countries and nations would be fully shown on the stages of the festival. The head of the Russian State Academic People's Chorus Named after M. E. Pyatnichki and the head of the Song and Dance Ensemble of the Mongolian Army made congratulatory speeches. A performance of Korean artistes was given at the ceremony. Rodong News Team

title: April 25 Team Beats Benfica Macao Team
body: Matches between teams belonging to Group I (East Asia) of the 2018 AFC Cup continue. The first match between the April 25 team of the DPRK and the Benfica Macao team of Macao of China was held at the May Day Stadium here on Apr. 11. The April 25 team beat its rival 8:0. Rodong News Team
