title: Talks between Foreign Ministers of DPRK and Russia Held
body: Talks were held between DPRK Foreign Minister Ri Yong Ho and his Russian counterpart Sergei Lavrov on Apr. 10. Ri is heading the DPRK government delegation on an official visit to the Russian Federation. Present at the talks from the DPRK side were members of the delegation and the DPRK ambassador to Russia and his embassy officials, and from the Russian side were officials concerned of the Foreign Ministry. At the talks the two sides reached a consensus of their views that it conforms to the aspiration and desire of the peoples of the two countries to further develop the DPRK-Russia friendly and cooperative relations with a long history and tradition. They agreed to boost the reciprocal good-neighborly cooperative relations in various fields including politics and economy this significant year marking the 70th anniversary of the establishment of DPRK-Russia diplomatic relations and exchanged their views on the regional and international matters of mutual concern. The Russian side expressed the stand fully supporting the detente and peaceful atmosphere created recently on the Korean peninsula thanks to the peace-loving stand and bold decision by the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Ri Yong Ho met Nikolai Patrushev, secretary general of the Security Council of the Russian Federation on Apr. 9. Rodong News Team

title: Global Independence Is Historic Task of Times
body: The reality urgently calls upon all the countries and nations to turn out in the struggle for realizing global independence by frustrating the imperialist reactionary forces' invasion and interference. Global independence can't come true by the efforts of individual country only, and it can come true only when all the countries and nations turn out in the struggle for independence. In order to build an independent, new world, each country should hold fast to independence. The establishment of relations among countries based on independence is fundamental to global independence. Now that the imperialists resort to more vicious moves to dominate other countries and nations and, furthermore, the world, the struggle against them is vital for the destiny of each country and nation. All the progressive forces should firmly stick to the stand of anti-imperialist independence and direct the spearhead of struggle to the imperialists. The basic aim of the struggle against the imperialists is to thwart and frustrate the moves of the U.S. and its vassal forces for aggression and war and defend global peace and security. The world progressives should strive for international justice, irrespective of differences in political view, religious belief and development of economy and culture. The DPRK will as ever work hard for global independence. Ri Hyon Do

title: 40th Anniversary of IIJI Marked
body: A meeting took place in Mongolia on April 8 to mark the 40th founding anniversary of the International Institute of the Juche Idea (IIJI). Present there were the director-general, the secretary general and directors of the IIJI, members of the Juche idea study organizations in Asia, Africa, Europe and Latin America, public personages of Mongolia and Japan, the DPRK ambassador to Mongolia and his embassy staff members and a delegation of the Korean Association of Social Scientists. Introduced at the meeting were congratulatory messages from Juche idea study organizations of different countries and the Korean Association of Social Scientists. Director-General Ramon Jimenez Lopez made a report to be followed by speeches. The reporter and speakers said that the founding of the IIJI was a reasonable fruition borne to meet the requirements of the era and the desire of mankind and its significance has been proved in its 40 year-long history. They stressed the need to further enhance the IIJI's position and role and intensify the study and dissemination of the Juche idea as required by the times and desired by the world progressives. A letter to the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was adopted at the meeting. On the same day a reception and an art performance were given to celebrate the 40th founding anniversary of the IIJI. The 21st meeting of the IIJI Board of Directors took place on April 7. The meeting reviewed the work in the past period and discussed action programs for the regional and national Juche idea study organisations to conduct the brisk study and dissemination of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism in keeping with their specific conditions. Rodong News Team

title: First-day Performances of 31st April Spring Friendship Art Festival Held
body: First-day performances of the 31st April Spring Friendship Festival were given at theaters and music halls in Pyongyang on Apr. 12. International and home concour prize winners of various countries, famous artistes and Korean artistes from abroad gave a beautiful and gorgeous artistic depiction of the world people's reverence for the peerlessly great men. Colorful numbers reflecting the desire and wishes of mankind to build a new world free from war and servitude in the idea of independence, peace and friendship were put on the stage. Among the audience were members of the festival organizing committee, officials concerned, Pyongyangites, youths and students, foreign embassy officials and foreign guests staying here also watched the performances. Performances were given at the Pyongyang Grand Theater by the Volinaya Stepi Cossack Art Troupe of Russia, the Classical Ballet Group of the State Music Academy Theatre of Belarus, the Lao State Art Troupe, the Song and Dance Ensemble of the Mongolian Army, the Flamenco Band of Spain and the art troupe of Koreans in Japan. The Russian State Academic People's Chorus Named after M. E. Pyatnichki, the Chelyabinsk State Ural Dance Group, a soloist from the Japan-Korea Society for Music and Art Interchange of Japan, the art troupe of Koreans in China and a singer of the art troupe of the International United Confederation of Koreans performed at the Ponghwa Art Theater. At the music hall of Kim Won Gyun University of Music there were performances by a Bulgarian opera singer, a Polish soloist, a Cyprus musical company and a Portuguese conductor. Performances were given at the Pyongyang Circus Theatre by the Circus of State Acrobatic Company of Russia, the Moscow Bolshoi State Circus of Russia, the Belarusian National Circus, a Thai jugglery troupe and a Singaporean magician. Performances go on. Rodong News Team

title: DR Congo Political Party Delegation Feted
body: The Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea hosted a reception for the visiting delegation of the Communist Party of DR Congo on Apr. 12. The delegation is visiting the DPRK to mark the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, the Day of the Sun. Invited to the reception was the delegation headed by General Secretary Boswa Isekombe Sylvere. Present were Ryu Myong Son, vice department director of the C.C., WPK, and officials concerned. Speeches were made at the reception. Rodong News Team

title: Home-visiting Groups of Chongryon Arrive
body: A home-visiting group of Koreans in Japan led by Pak Hae Chol, vice department director of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), and a home-visiting group of students of Korean University under Chongryon led by Hong Yong Chol arrived in Pyongyang on Apr. 12. Rodong News Team

body: The military attaches corps in Pyongyang visited the 20th Kimilsungia Festival venue on Apr. 12 on the occasion of the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. The visitors looked round the famous flowers praising the great man which have come into full bloom thanks to the sincerity of the Korean people and the world progressives for the President. title: Delegation of Association of Koreans in Canada Arrives in Pyongyang
body: A delegation of the Association of Koreans in Canada led by Chairman Kim Su Hae arrived in Pyongyang on Apr. 12 to mark the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Rodong News Team

title: Families of Those Related to Anti-Japanese Revolutionary Struggle Arrive
body: The Family of Zhou Baozhong, a Chinese related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, and families of Kim Sun Ok and So Sun Ok, China-resident Koreans related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, arrived here on Apr. 12 on the occasion of the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Also arriving was Choe Mun Sik, chairman of the Society for Preservation of Revolutionary Sites in Yanbian of China. Rodong News Team

title: First Pyongyang Int'l Vocal Competition Closes
body: The First Pyongyang International Vocal Competition, which began on April 5, closed on on Apr. 12 with due ceremony at the Moranbong Theatre. Attending the closing ceremony were Pak Chun Nam, minister of Culture who is chairman of the organizing committee of the competition, officials concerned, creators and artistes of national art organizations and teachers of art educational bodies, concours prize winners, foreign artistes, members of the international jury and honorary guests. Present on invitation were foreign diplomatic envoys and representatives of international bodies and officials of foreign embassies here. Cups, medals, diplomas and prizes were awarded to those artistes who proved successful at the competition. Kim Kyong Ju (DPRK) took the first place, Bayarsaikhan Batjargal (Mongolia) and Li Stanislav (Kazakhstan) the second place, and So Un Hyang (DPRK), Ryu Kum Chol (DPRK) and Martirosyan Marianna (Armenia) the third place. A technical prize and an acting prize went to Baasansuren Enkhnaran (Mongolia) and Kapachinskikh Kirill (Kazakhstan). Pak Chun Nam made a closing address. At the end of the closing ceremony, there was a performance by prize winners of the competition. Rodong News Team

title: First Lady of DPRK Enjoys Performance of Chinese Art Troupe
body: The Chinese art troupe gave its premiere for the 31st April Spring Friendship Art Festival at the Mansudae Art Theatre on April 14. First Lady Ri Sol Ju enjoyed a ballet choreodrama "Giselle" given by the National Ballet of China, together with Choe Ryong Hae, Ri Su Yong, Kim Yong Chol, Kim Yo Jong, Pak Chun Nam and other senior party and government officials. When the First Lady arrived at the theatre, she was warmly greeted by Song Tao, head of the International Liaison Department of the C.C., Communist Party of China, Li Qun, vice-minister of Culture and Tourism of China, and Li Jinjun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK. She warmly welcomed the Chinese art troupe's visit to the DPRK and had a friendly talk with the guests in an amicable atmosphere before watching the performance. The National Ballet of China wonderfully represented "Giselle" with high artistry, touching the heartstrings of the audience. At the end of the performance, spectators mounted the stage to present bouquets to the performers, raising loud applause. Ri Sol Ju, together with senior party and government officials, congratulated the performers on their successful performance and extended warm greetings to them. Political News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Gives Grand Banquet for Chinese Art Troupe
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, gave a grand banquet on April 14 evening in welcome of the DPRK visit by the Chinese art troupe headed by Song Tao, head of the International Liaison Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China. Present there were Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, Ri Su Yong and Kim Yong Chol, members of the Political Bureau and vice-chairmen of the C.C., WPK, Kim Yo Jong, alternate member of the Political Bureau and first vice department director of the C.C., WPK, Jo Yong Won, Kwon Hyok Bong, Kim Pyong Ho, Hong Kwang Sun, Kim Song Nam, Ri Chang Gun and Ryu Myong Son, vice department directors of the C.C., WPK, Pak Chun Nam, minister of Culture, and other officials of the C.C., WPK and those concerned. Present there on invitation were Song Tao, head of the International Liaison Department of the C.C., CPC, all the members of the Chinese art troupe, Li Jinjun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK, and officials of the Chinese embassy here. When the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and his wife Ri Sol Ju appeared at the banquet hall together with Song Tao and other Chinese guests, all the participants enthusiastically welcomed them with loud applause. Kim Jong Un warmly welcomed the Chinese art troupe's visit to the DPRK. First, a performance was given by the Korean artistes including those of the Samjiyon Orchestra in welcome of the Chinese art troupe at the banquet. Then, toasts were made by Choe Ryong Hae and Song Tao. The speakers expressed the steadfast will of the two parties and two peoples to more beautifully decorate the flower garden of the DPRK-China friendship and fully demonstrate the invincible friendship and unity at home and abroad and further develop them, which have been brought by the supreme leaders of the two parties and two peoples. The banquet proceeded in a friendly and amicable atmosphere. Political News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Meets Song Tao
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on April 14 met with Song Tao, head of the International Liaison Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China who is on a visit to the DPRK by leading the Chinese art troupe. He warmly welcomed Song Tao and his party visiting the DPRK with a prestigious large-scale art troupe and had a cordial talk with them. At the meeting Song Tao conveyed the warm greetings of General Secretary Xi Jinping to Chairman Kim Jong Un. Kim Jong Un expressed thanks for this and extended his greetings to Xi Jinping and other Chinese party and government leaders. Then, he said with deep emotion that the Chinese comrades accorded cordial hospitality to him with utmost sincerity in token of warm comradely friendship during his recent unforgettable visit to China. Song Tao gave his impressions of DPRK visit, saying that they have personally experienced and been specially and deeply impressed by the warm feelings and intense and special hospitality of the Korean party and government to the Chinese art troupe from the first moment of its arrival. He expressed their heartfelt thanks to Kim Jong Un and to the WPK and the DPRK government and the Korean people. Kim Jong Un said that it is due obligation and behavior of the host and close friend for him to personally undertake the reception of the art troupe and give special treatment to it as the art troupe was personally selected and dispatched by Xi Jinping with special attention. All the relevant fields of the Korean party and government would provide all conditions for the Chinese art troupe at the highest level and on a top-priority basis during its stay, he added. He wished the Chinese art troupe good success in its performances during its visit to Pyongyang and hoped that the peoples of the two countries would further deepen their understanding of each other and a new era of the DPRK-China art exchange be made with this visit as a momentum. Exchanged in earnest at the meeting were profound views on the important matters of mutual concern of the WPK and the CPC and the international situation. Expressing satisfaction over the recent development of the relations between the two parties and countries, the Supreme Leader said that he would positively carry forward and develop the traditional DPRK-China friendship into a fresh phase of development as required by a new era by further strengthening of the bilateral relations between the two parties including exchange of high-level delegations and undertaking the brisk cooperation and visits in various fields and sectors. Noting it is the unshakable policy of the Chinese party and government to creditably preserve, consolidate and develop the China-DPRK relations, Song Tao said that they would make a fresh contribution to promoting the prolonged and stable development of the China-DPRK relations, providing the two countries and their peoples with happiness and ensuring peace and stability on the peninsula. Political News Team

title: Talks between Officials of WPK and CPC Held
body: Talks were held in Pyongyang on Apr. 14 between Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), and Song Tao, head of the International Liaison Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC). At the talks both sides exchanged deep views on further developing the relations between the WPK and the CPC on the basis of the agreement made at the historic meeting of the top leaders of the two countries. The talks proceeded in a friendly atmosphere. Present at the talks from the DPRK side were Ryu Myong Son, vice department director of the C.C., WPK, and officials of the International Department of the C.C., WPK, and from the Chinese side were officials of the International Liaison Department of the C.C., CPC, and Li Jinjun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK. Artistes from various countries and Korean artistes from abroad taking part in the festival were invited to the reception. body: Foreign singers and international jury members left Pyongyang on Apr. 14 after taking part in the First Pyongyang International Vocal Competition. Rodong News Team

title: Ri Su Yong Meets Mongolian Party Delegation
body: Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea,on Apr. 14 had a talk with the delegation of the Mongolian People's Party led by General Secretary Dashzegve Amarbayasgalan on a visit to the DPRK to mark the Day of the Sun. Ri Su Yong said that the WPK and the Korean people are registering successes in the efforts to glorify the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK as a grand festival of victors by dint of self-reliance and self-development and single-minded unity under the wise guidance of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. He expressed the will to strengthen the friendly and cooperative relations between the two parties and countries this year marking the 70th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the DPRK and Mongolia. Dashzegve Amarbayasgalan said that they wished the Korean people bigger success in the struggle to achieve the country's prosperity under the guidance of HE Marshal Kim Jong Un. He expressed belief that the Mongolian People's Party would attach importance to the relations with the WPK and expand and develop the traditional relations between the two parties. Rodong News Team

title: Group and Separate Performances of Friendship Art Festival Given
body: There took place group and separate performances of the 31st April Spring Friendship Art Festival at theaters and concert halls in Pyongyang on Apr. 14. Colorful numbers including song, dance and instrumental music were put on the stage by foreign artistes and Korean artistes from abroad. They sang songs including "Leader, the Night Is Far Advanced" and "General, Here Is the Forefront" in reflection of their yearning for President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il. Songs praising the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un as a peerlessly great man were also put on the stage. Songs, dances and instrumental music reflecting ardent patriotism, traditional customs and national emotion of peoples of various countries were presented. Folk songs, dances and instrumental music of strong national flavor by Korean artistes from abroad added to the atmosphere of the performances. Acrobats displayed their stunts smartly, exciting the audience. The performances go on. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Yong Nam Meets Mongolian Party Delegation
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, had a talk with the delegation of the Mongolian People's Party led by General Secretary Dashzegve Amarbayasgalan which paid a courtesy call on him at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Apr. 14. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of Koreans in China in Pyongyang
body: A delegation of the Association for Economic and Cultural Exchange of Korean Nationality in Dandong City of China led by Chairman Kim Thaek Ryong arrived in Pyongyang on Apr. 14 to mark the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Rodong News Team

title: Japanese Delegation Arrives
body: A delegation of the Japanese Society for the Study of the Juche Idea led by Shinjiro Takeda arrived in Pyongyang on Apr. 14 to mark the Day of the Sun. Rodong News Team

title: Collection of Memoirs "Among the People" Vol. 107 Published
body: Vol. 107 of "Among the People", a collection of memoirs, was brought out in the DPRK to mark the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. The book contains 18 memoirs dealing with the exploits and noble popular traits of Kim Il Sung. A memoir "'Reed Precisely Means Silk'" says that the President saw to it that the Sinuiju Chemical Fibre Mill was built and that he set forth tasks to increase the production of reed, raw material for fibre. Some memoirs deal with the energetic leadership of the President who made a long journey for field guidance to provide the people with more affluent and happy life. Others tell the loving care shown by the President for the living conditions of the People's Army soldiers. The book also tells the stories that the President met an ordinary table tennis player to give her strength and courage to demonstrate the honor and dignity of the Korean nation in games and that during his foreign tour, he dropped in at the school where the war orphans studied and showed warm love for them. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Gives Dinner for Song Tao and Art Troupe of China
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, gave a dinner for Song Tao, head of the International Liaison Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, and artistes of the Chinese art troupe on April 17. Present there were his wife Ri Sol Ju, Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, Kim Yo Jong, alternate member of the Political Bureau and first vice department director of the C.C., WPK, Jo Yong Won, Kwon Hyok Bong, Kim Pyong Ho and Kim Song Nam, vice department directors of the C.C., WPK, and other officials of the C.C., WPK and Korean artistes. Present on invitation were Song Tao, head of the International Liaison Department of the C.C., CPC, Li Qun, vice-minister of Culture and Tourism of China, artistes of the Chinese art troupe and Li Jinjun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK. In front of the dinner hall the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and his wife Ri Sol Ju greeted Song Tao and artistes of the Chinese art troupe. The dinner proceeded in a friendly and amicable atmosphere as it took place together with Chinese comrades who came into genuine feelings and became more familiar with Korean people. After the dinner was over, Kim Jong Un and Ri Sol Ju exchanged warm farewell greetings with Song Tao and other Chinese comrades, ardently sending them off. Song Tao, on behalf of all the members of the Chinese art troupe, expressed once again deep thanks to Kim Jong Un for having accorded special and exceptional hospitality during their visit to Pyongyang. Political News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Meets Song Tao Again
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, once again met and had a talk with Song Tao, head of the International Liaison Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, on April 17. The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un congratulated the Chinese art troupe led by Song Tao upon its successful visit to the DPRK under the special care and expectation of the parties and governments of the two countries and highly appreciated the efforts made by the Chinese comrades to brilliantly decorate the 31st April Spring Friendship Art Festival. He said the art troupe's visit to the DPRK this time was a very good one that brought about excellent results in the good period. It further deepened the special ties and the feelings of mutual respect between the two parties and the two peoples of the DPRK and China and set a good model of DPRK-China cultural and art exchange, he added. Song Tao noted with deep emotion that the Korean people most warmly and grandly welcomed them with fraternal friendship wherever they went, adding that through the visit they keenly felt the particular and kind feelings of the Korean party and people toward the Chinese party and people. In particular, he expressed deep thanks once again to Kim Jong Un for his personal measures for them, saying that the successful visit of the Chinese art troupe was entirely thanks to the special friendly relationship and deep care and solicitude of the supreme leaders of the two parties and two countries. Kim Jong Un said that the WPK Central Committee would continue to work hard to further deepen the political trust between the two parties and two countries and develop the DPRK-China relations into a fresh high level as required by the new era on the basis of their traditional foundations of friendship and unity. He exchanged with Song Tao in-depth views on several matters for activating exchanges and visits in different fields and further strengthening the strategic and tactical cooperation between the two parties. He asked Song Tao to certainly convey his warm greetings to General Secretary Xi Jinping, the best friend and closest comrade of the Korean people who dispatched the art troupe in the significant period to greatly delight the Korean people, and to the Chinese people. The talk proceeded in an atmosphere overflowing with the comradely, sincere and friendly feelings. Political News Team

title: Chinese Art Troupe Visits Friendship Tower
body: The Chinese art troupe for the 31st April Spring Friendship Art Festival led by Song Tao, head of the International Liaison Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, on Apr. 16 visited the Friendship Tower. The guests were accompanied by Ri Chang Gun, vice department director of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea, Li Jinjun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK and staff members of his embassy. Floral baskets in the names of Song Tao and Li Jinjun were placed at the tower. The participants observed a moment's silence in memory of the fallen soldiers of the Chinese People's Volunteers, who bravely fought in the Korean front against the imperialist invasion under the unfurled banner of resisting America and aiding Korea, safeguarding the home and defending the motherland. Then they went round the tower. Song Tao made an entry in the visitor's book that "China- DPRK friendship will be everlasting." Rodong News Team

title: Ballet Choreodrama "Red Women Company" Given by Chinese Art Troupe
body: The Chinese art troupe for the 31st April Spring Friendship Art Festival gave a ballet choreodrama "Red Women Company" at the East Pyongyang Grand Theatre on Apr. 15. Kim Yong Nam, Presidium member of the Political Bureau of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the DPRK Supreme People's Assembly, Pak Kwang Ho and Ri Su Yong, members of the Political Bureau and vice-chairmen of the C.C., WPK, and other senior officials of the party and government arrived at the theatre and exchanged greetings with Song Tao, head of the International Liaison Department of the C.C., Communist Party of China, and Li Jinjun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK. Then they enjoyed the performance together with artistes and Pyongyangites. Among the audience were foreign diplomatic envoys and representatives of international bodies here and their wives, military attaches and their wives and foreigners here. Through the ballet choreodrama "Red Women Company", a model of the ballets with the Chinese characteristics, the artistes of the prestigious National Ballet of China wonderfully depicted the course in which the Chinese women, who suffered from exploitation and humiliation, grow to be revolutionary fighters under the guidance of the Communist Party of China in the 1930s with the graceful and beautiful dances. Rodong News Team

title: Reception Given to Mark Day of Sun
body: A reception was given at the People's Palace of Culture on Apr. 15, the 106th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Present there were Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the WPK Central Committee, Premier Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and vice-chairman of the SAC, and other party and government officials, the chairman of a friendly party, officials of armed forces organs, ministries and national institutions, merited persons, members of overseas compatriots' congratulatory groups and delegations including the group of Koreans in Japan for celebrating the Day of the Sun, and the chief of the Pyongyang mission of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front. Foreign diplomatic envoys, representatives of international bodies and military attaches and their spouses and other foreign guests here were invited to the reception. Choe Ryong Hae in his speech said President Kim Il Sung remains the eternal benefactor of the nation, the father of socialist Korea and a great sage of the revolution as he illuminated the road ahead of the country, the revolution and mankind with bright rays of the Juche idea and performed undying exploits for carving out of the destiny of the Korean people and global independence. The speaker extended high respects and glory to the President in reflection of the feelings of all service personnel and people of the DPRK and the world progressive people. He called for holding in high esteem President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il for all ages, dynamically advancing toward the victory of socialism under the guidance of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and thus realizing the patriotic desire of the great leaders for building a powerful country. Rodong News Team

title: Cambodian King, Great Queen Send Large Floral Baskets to DPRK Embassy
body: Cambodian King Norodom Sihamoni and Great Queen Norodom Monineath Sihanouk sent large floral baskets to the DPRK embassy in Phnom Penh on April 12 with the approach of the 106th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Upon the authorization by the king and the great queen, a delegation of the Cambodian Ministry of Royal Palace led by Kong Sam Ol, deputy prime minister for Royal Palace, laid the floral baskets before the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il and paid tribute to them. Kong Sam Ol said that he regards it as an honor the delegation paid a congratulatory visit to the DPRK embassy on the occasion of the 106th birth anniversary of Kim Il Sung, and went on: The king and the great queen authorized me to pay high tribute to HE the great Generalissimo Kim Il Sung most ardently revered by the Cambodian people on the occasion of the auspicious Day of the Sun. They also authorized me to convey their warm wishes to HE Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the Korean People's Army, and all the Korean people. I wholeheartedly wish HE Kim Jong Un, the Supreme Leader of the Korean people, good health and happiness and hope that he would lead the country and people to a brilliant victory and prosperity. Rodong News Team

title: Joint Performances of April Art Festival
body: Joint performances of the participants in the 31st April Spring Friendship Art Festival were given at the Pyongyang Grand Theatre, the Ponghwa Art Theatre and the Pyongyang Circus Theater in the city of Pyongyang on Apr. 15. Among the audience were Choe Ryong Hae, Presidium member of the Political Bureau of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the DPRK State Affairs Commission and vice chairman of the C.C., WPK, Pak Pong Ju, Presidium member of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK, vice-chairman of the DPRK State Affairs Commission and premier of the Cabinet, and other senior party and government officials, the chairman of a friendly party, officials of ministries and national institutions and working people in the city. Enjoying the performance were also overseas compatriots including the congratulatory groups of Koreans in Japan and the General Association of Koreans in China for celebrating the Day of the Sun, the chief of the Pyongyang mission of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front, diplomatic envoys and representatives of international bodies, military attaches, members of foreign embassies here and other foreign guests. Colorful numbers such as songs, musical instruments and dances were given by foreign and overseas compatriot artistes including a female soloist of the Lao State Art Troupe, Bulgarian opera singer, and artistes of the Russian State Academic People's Chorus Named after M. E. Pyatnichki, and the Volinaya Stepi Cossack Art Troupe of Russia. Put on the stages were acrobatic and magic pieces. Floral baskets were conveyed to the performers in congratulation of their successful performances. Rodong News Team

title: Fireworks Displayed in Pyongyang
body: Fireworks were displayed here on Apr. 15 in celebration of the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Both banks of the River Taedong centering around Kim Il Sung Square and the Tower of the Juche Idea were crowded with people from all walks of life Sunday evening to see the fireworks. Fireworks were displayed in the nocturnal sky amid the playing of the solemn song "Long Live Generalissimo Kim Il Sung". The moment the fireworks appeared, the spectators gave shouts of joy. The playing of song "Cheers of the People" revved up the festive mood. Rodong News Team

title: Foreign Guests and Overseas Koreans Visit Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: Foreign diplomatic envoys, representatives of international bodies and military attaches here, delegations of Juche idea study groups and party delegations from different countries and families of those related to the revolutionary activities of President Kim Il Sung from abroad, congratulatory groups of Koreans in Japan and the General Association of Koreans in China for celebrating the Day of the Sun and other overseas Koreans and foreign guests visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on Apr. 15, the birth anniversary of Kim Il Sung. They paid tribute to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il. They paid homage to Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il at the halls of immortality where they lie in state. They went round the halls where the orders the great leaders received are on display and the halls that house cars, electric car, boat and train coaches used by them for their field guidance and foreign tours till the last moments of their lives. Meanwhile, the chief and members of the Pyongyang mission of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun to pay tribute to the great leaders on the same day. Rodong News Team

title: Reckless Acts of Those Oblivious of Lesson of History
body: The Abe group of Japan set up a general ground force command for overall command over the military operations of the ground "Self-Defense Force". It also formed an "amphibious mobile force" called "Japan version of marines" and waged "exercises of seizing an island" with mobilization of this force. In the meantime, Japan held the ceremony of putting into commission ultra-modern attack submarine Seiru and mine sweeper Hirado and is stepping up the final assembly of F-35A fighters after introducing parts for 42 fighters as part of its strong push for arming the SDF with attack weapons. This is a vicious challenge to the positive developments created on the Korean peninsula. The crafty Japanese reactionaries, who have sought their own interests through escalation of north-south confrontation and the tension on the peninsula, calculate that they have to incite the atmosphere of military confrontation in order to realize Japan's growing ambition for reinvasion. That's why they have vociferated about "threats" from someone and are spurring the moves for turning Japan into a military giant under this pretext. Truly pitiful are the Japanese reactionaries as they hardly discard the narrow-minded habit of a political dwarf. Those who fail to remember the past have no future and those who follow in the footsteps of criminals are bound to meet a severer punishment. This is the lesson of history. The Japanese reactionaries should not run amuck, mindful that their act of kicking up the militarist frenzy in a bid to stem the trend of the times will push them deeper into the abyss of isolation and destruction. Ho Yong Min

title: Rosy Future of Korean Nation Holding Peerlessly Great Man in High Esteem
body: With the approach of the north-south summit meeting and talks to be noteworthy in the history of the national reunification movement, all Koreans are full of conviction in rosy future of the nation that holds the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in high esteem. The north-south summit meeting and talks are unthinkable without his rare wisdom, firm will for national reunification, broadminded magnanimity and noble compatriotism. On the summit meeting and talks to be held thanks to the steel-strong will for reunification and broadminded and compatriotic steps of Kim Jong Un, all Koreans at home and abroad praise him as the peerlessly great man taking the helm of the history and steering the trend of the world. They are convinced that the bright future is always in store for the nation when they value and maintain the good atmosphere of the north-south relations provided by him. Immensely rosy is the future of our nation holding Kim Jong Un, heaven-sent great man of Paektu, in high esteem. No persistent move of the anti-reunification forces can block the Korean nation vigorously advancing along the road of independent reunification under his leadership. Pak Chol Jun

title: Greetings to Zimbabwean President
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, on Apr. 18 sent a message of greeting to Emmerson Mnangagwa, president of the Republic of Zimbabwe, on the 38th anniversary of its independence. Believing that the friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries with a long history and tradition will continue to strengthen, the message sincerely wished the president of Zimbabwe happiness in good health and the president and government of Zimbabwe bigger successes in their work for the development and prosperity of the country. Rodong News Team

title: 31st April Spring Friendship Art Festival Closes
body: The 31st April Spring Friendship Art Festival closed with due ceremony at the East Pyongyang Grand Theatre on Apr. 17. It was opened in Pyongyang on April 11. Present there were Pak Kwang Ho, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Yang Hyong Sop, vice-president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, Jon Kwang Ho, vice-premier of the Cabinet, officials concerned and working people in the city. Also, present were the Chinese art troupe led by Song Tao, head of the International Liaison Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, and other foreign artistes and delegations, overseas Korean artistes, foreign diplomatic envoys and representatives of international organizations and their wives, military attaches and their wives, embassy officials here and overseas Koreans. At the closing ceremony, the results of the festival by the jury were announced and prizes awarded to successful art troupes and artistes. Team special prize, the best prize of the festival, was awarded to the National Ballet of China. And team prize went to the Russian State Academic People's Chorus Named after M. E. Pyatnichki, Classical Ballet Group of the State Music Academy Theatre of Belarus, Chelyabinsk State Ural Dance Group of Russia, Volinaya Stepi Cossack Art Troupe of Russia and the Song and Dance Ensemble of the Mongolian Army and prizes of merit, creation, individual and ensemble to several artistes and art pieces. Pak Chun Nam, minister of Culture who is chairman of the festival organizing committee, made a closing speech. At the end of the closing ceremony, an art performance was given by artistes from various countries. Chinese artistes made vivid representation of ballet pieces such as "From Act 2 of ballet drama 'Swan Lake'" with bright and refined skills. Serial choruses "Song of Changjiang", "Revolutionary Is Eternal Youth", "Dream of Glory" and other numbers reflecting patriotism and will of the Chinese people deeply impressed the audience. Artistes of Russia, Mongolia, Belarus, Spain and Armenia also put on the stage Korean songs including male solo and chorus "Song of Comradeship" and numbers of strong national flavor. Rodong News Team

title: Chinese Art Troupe Visits Kim Won Gyun University of Music
body: The Chinese art troupe led by Song Tao, head of the International Liaison Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, visited Kim Won Gyun University of Music on Apr. 17. The guests were accompanied by Ri Chang Gun, vice department director of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea, and Li Jinjun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK. Members of the Chinese art troupe were greeted by the teaching staff and students of the university with bouquets and a big clap. Being briefed on the history of the university, the guests went round the room dedicated to the history of the university, classrooms, halls, concert hall and others. Song Tao made an entry in the visitor's book that "Let's take over the valuable treasures of art and give free scope to the nation's culture." The Chinese art troupe toured the Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace and watched a performance given by art group members of the palace on Apr. 16. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Sun Marked in Indonesia
body: A Kimilsungia show and Korean book and photo exhibition was held in Jakarta on April 11 in the run-up to the Day of the Sun and the 53rd anniversary of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il's visit to Indonesia and the 53rd anniversary of the birth of Kimilsungia. On display at the event venue were photos showing the revolutionary activities of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. There were also the works of the peerlessly great men of Korea and books and photos dealing with the successes made by the Korean army and people in building a powerful socialist country at the venue, replete with Kimilsungias in full bloom. The venue was visited by personages of various strata and masses of Indonesia. Meanwhile, the DPRK embassy in Jakarta hosted a reception on Apr. 12. Present there on invitation were personages of the government, ministries, political parties and organizations, and institutions of Indonesia and foreign diplomatic envoys. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman of Italian General Investment Group Arrives
body: Giancarlo Elia Valori, chairman of the Italian General Investment Group, arrived Pyongyang on Apr. 17. Rodong News Team

title: Congratulatory Group of Koreans in China Leaves
body: A congratulatory group of the General Association of Koreans in China for celebrating the Day of the Sun led by Vice-Chairperson Ri Sun Nam left Pyongyang on Apr. 17. Rodong News Team

title: Congratulations to President-elect of Montenegro
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, on Apr. 17 sent a congratulatory message to Milo Djukanovic upon his election as president of Montenegro. Kim in the message wished the president bigger success in his responsible work for the country's prosperity, expressing the belief that the relations between the DPRK and Montenegro would develop on good terms in the interests of the peoples of the two countries. Rodong News Team

title: Families of Those Related to Anti-Japanese Struggle Leave
body: The family of Zhou Baozhong, a Chinese related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, and families of Kim Sun Ok and So Sun Ok, China-resident Koreans related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, left Pyongyang on Apr. 19. Also, departing on the same day was Choe Mun Sik, chairman of the Society for Preservation of Revolutionary Sites in Yanbian of China. Rodong News Team

title: 6th Sports Contest among Public Health Workers Opens
body: The 6th sports contest among public health workers opened. During the contest, competitions in basketball, volleyball, table tennis, tug of war and other events will be made at gymnasiums, stadiums and sports parks in Pyongyang and provinces. Its opening ceremony took place at the Pyongyang Indoor Stadium on Apr. 19. Present there were officials concerned and officials and players in the public health field and teachers and students of Pyongyang Medical College under Kim Il Sung University. Minister of Public Health Jang Jun Sang made an opening speech. At the end of the ceremony there were a Taekwon-Do demonstration by officials of central level healthcare institutions and a men's volleyball match between players from Pyongyang Medical College of Kim Il Sung University and the Korea General Red Cross Hospital. The contest will last until May 1. Rodong News Team

title: Delegations, Delegates of Juche Idea Study Groups Leave
body: Foreign delegations and delegates of Juche idea study groups left Pyongyang for home on Apr. 19. They were delegations of the Russian Institute of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, the Pakistani Organization for the Study of the Juche Idea, the Nepalese Association for Supporting the Songun Politics, the Study Forum for Self-Reliance of Nepal, the Bangladesh Group for the Study of the Songun Policy, the Italian Committee for the Study of Songun Idea for Independence and Sovereignty, the Czech Group for the Study and Materialization of the Juche Idea, and a Bulgarian delegate for the study of the Juche Idea. Departing earlier was a delegation of the Japanese Society for the Study of the Juche Idea. Rodong News Team

title: Foreigners, Overseas Compatriots Visit Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: Foreigners and overseas Koreans visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on Apr. 19. They included Jin Yuhya, director of the Board of Directors of the Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation, and her party, Lorena Pena, chairwoman of the Women's International Democratic Federation, and women delegations and delegates of different countries that came here to take part in meetings of the federation, and Giancarlo Elia Valori, chairman of the Italian General Investment Group. The visitors paid tribute to President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il before their statues in the palace. At the halls of immortality where the great leaders lie in state, they made bows to them. They went round the halls where orders the great leaders received are on display and halls that house cars, electric car, boat and train coaches used by them for field guidance and foreign tours till the last moments of their lives. Rodong News Team

title: DR Congo Party Delegation Leaves
body: The delegation of the Communist Party of DR Congo led by General Secretary Boswa Isekombe Sylvere left Pyongyang for home on Apr. 19. Rodong News Team

title: Chinese Delegation Leaves
body: The delegation of the Association for Economic and Cultural Exchange of Korean Nationality in Dandong City of China led by Chairman Kim Thaek Ryong left Pyongyang on Apr. 19. Rodong News Team

title: KFA Secretary Visits Pyongyang Mission of AINDF
body: Mana Sapmak, international organizational secretary of the Korean Friendship Association, on a visit to the DPRK to mark the Day of the Sun visited the Pyongyang mission of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front on Apr. 18. Chief Pak Su Chol and members of the mission greeted and had a talk with the secretary. At the talk, both sides informed each other of the activities of their organizations and discussed the matters for intensifying their solidarity activities. Mana Sapmak expressed the will to conduct more dynamic solidarity activities for Korea's reunification, zealously hailing the fact that a turning phase for improved north-south relations has been opened thanks to the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's firm will for reunification and his great magnanimity and noble compatriotism. Rodong News Team

title: Communiqué of Organizing Committee of Int'l Festival in Praise of Great Persons
body: The organizing committee of the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt. Paektu issued a communiqué on April 11. The communiqué said that the committee would further develop the festival into a grand international politico-cultural festival of the world's progressive peoples. It went on: For the immediate future, the Organizing Committee shall push ahead with the preparations to organize the 6th International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt. Paektu in Pyongyang and in the Mt. Paektu area in 2022, a year in which we mark the 110th birth anniversary of HE Kim Il Sung, the 80th birth anniversary of HE Kim Jong Il and the 10th anniversary of HE Kim Jong Un's assumption of the highest post of the Party and state of Korea. The Organizing Committee shall widely organize and unfold the activities in support and defence of the Korean people in their struggle for just cause. It shall condemn the most heinous sanctions and blockade schemes of the hostile forces against the DPRK, the bulwark and the banner of the anti-imperialist forces of independence, and champion Juche Korea. At the same time, it shall coordinate on a worldwide scale to widely organize the international solidarity movements in support of the Korean people in their struggle to frustrate moves of separatist forces at home and abroad and achieve the national reunification under the banner of national independence. The Organizing Committee shall launch widespread campaigns to realize genuine international justice and build an independent world. In joint efforts with different parties, organizations, international organizations across the world, and the world's progressive peoples aspiring to independence and justice, the Organizing Committee shall be in the vanguard of carrying on the struggle to denounce and reject the moves for aggression and war, and intervention in the domestic affairs of smaller countries perpetrated openly by the imperialist and dominationist forces under the pretext of "democracy" and "defending human rights", and to build an independent new world. Rodong News Team

title: Organizing Committee of Int'l Festival in Praise of Great Persons Formed
body: The organizing committee of the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt. Paektu was formed in Minsk of Belarus on April 11. Elected as co-chairpersons of the committee at its inaugural ceremony were Rachmawati Soekarnoputri, chairwoman of the Founding Committee of the Soekarno Foundation for Education of Indonesia, Jesus Antonio Carlos Hernandez, general secretary of the C.C., People's Socialist Party of Mexico, Damian Ogbonna, national chairman of the People's Progressive Party of Nigeria and chairman of the African Regional Committee for Friendship and Solidarity with the Korean People, Peter Woods, ambassador of Asia Pacific Region of the United Cities and Local Governments, Victor Petrov, chairman of the Russian Association for Friendship and Cultural Cooperation with the DPRK, Yehia Zakaria Khairullah, vice-chairman of the Socialist Freedom Party of Egypt and co-chairman of the Arab Regional Committee for Friendship and Solidarity with the Korean People, Fumihiro Himori, chairperson of the Japan Committee for Supporting the Independent and Peaceful Reunification of Korea, Anders Kristensen, chairman of the Denmark-DPRK Friendship Association, and Kim Jong Suk, chairwoman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries and chairwoman of the Korean Committee for Solidarity with the World People. And announced was the communiqué of the organizing committee. A letter to the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was adopted at the ceremony. Rodong News Team

title: New Stamp Issued in DPRK
body: The State Stamp Bureau of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea issued a new stamp (one sheetlet) in commemoration of the 70th anniversary of the Joint Conference of Representatives of Political Parties and Public Organizations in North and South Korea in Pyongyang in April 1948 guided by President Kim Il Sung. Seen in the stamp is a Korean painting which depicted the President waving back to the enthusiastically cheering masses at the conference hall, after opening up a brilliant chapter of great national unity by calling on patriotic forces from all walks of life in the north and the south for unity. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Yong Nam Meets Italian Personage
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, met and had a talk with Giancarlo Elia Valori, chairman of the Italian General Investment Group, who paid a courtesy call on him at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Apr. 20. Rodong News Team

title: Russia's Juche Idea Study Group Delegation Leaves for Home
body: A delegation of the Tynda Organization for the Study of the Juche Idea in Russia led by Gennadi Astakhov left Pyongyang for home on Apr. 20. Rodong News Team

title: Last-ditch Efforts of Those Marginalized by Trend of Era
body: Not only all Koreans in the north and the south and abroad but also the international community are supporting and hailing the inter-Korean summit and the DPRK-U.S. dialogue. But the south Korean conservative group including Hong Jun Phyo, representative of the "Liberal Korea Party," are making reckless remarks that "south Korea is rushing into catastrophe" and the authorities "are staging camouflaged peace farce" day after day. Meanwhile, they are making desperate efforts to check the north-south summit and the DPRK-U.S. dialogue, vociferating about "result of sanctions and pressure" and "strategy for gaining time." The hysterical moves of the south Korean conservative forces are the last-ditch efforts of those who are marginalized by the trend of the era. The successive south Korean conservative forces have been keen on the racket against the DPRK in league with foreign forces, regarding the north-south confrontation and the escalation of tension on the Korean peninsula as a means of living. They get jitters over the situation developing contrary to what they expected. The reckless remarks of the conservative forces taking issue with the above-said summit and dialogue are the abuses of the confrontational maniacs and lunatics to twist the truth, marginalized by the trend of times toward peace and reunification and a revelation of their cynical ploy to scuttle the hard-won atmosphere of dialogue. The south Korean conservative group including the "Liberal Korea Party" are nothing helpful to the north-south relations and the Korean nation as they are preoccupied with slinging mud at the compatriots. Sim Chol Yong

title: Korean Books Donated to Russia
body: A Korean book-donating ceremony took place at the Maritime Territorial Regional Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation on April 6 on the occasion of the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Displayed at the venue of the ceremony were works of President Kim Il Sung, leader Kim Jong Il and the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Attending the ceremony were personages of the maritime territorial regional committee and the Association for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism of Russia in the Far East Region, and other people and officials of the DPRK mission in Vladivostok. Dolgachev, first secretary of the Maritime Territorial Regional Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation who doubles as chairman of the Association for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism of Russia in the Far East Region, said that he regarded it as the great honor to receive the immortal works of the peerlessly great men of the DPRK on the occasion of the birth anniversary of Kim Il Sung, the common holiday of mankind. The works will become the good textbooks for the Russian people longing for the DPRK and aspiring after socialism, he added. Rodong News Team

title: Gold Prize to Kimilsungia and Kimjongilia
body: The organizing committee of the 15th China Azalea Exhibition awarded the gold prize to Kimilsungia and Kimjongilia. The gold prize and diploma were conveyed to an official concerned of the DPRK who participated in an opening ceremony of the exhibition held in Sichuan Province, China on April 9. Rodong News Team

title: Meetings of WIDF Open
body: A meeting of the Secretariat of the Women's International Democratic Federation and a meeting of its Directive Committee were opened at the People's Palace of Culture on Apr. 19. Present at the opening ceremony were Choe Hwi, vice-chairman of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea, Jang Chun Sil, chairwoman of the C.C., Socialist Women's Union of Korea, its officials, women in Pyongyang, Lorena Pena, chairwoman of the Women's International Democratic Federation, and members of its leadership, women delegations and delegates from different countries, and members of foreign diplomatic and international missions here. Choe Hwi made a congratulatory speech. He said that the meetings of the WIDF in Pyongyang give courage to the women and other people of the DPRK striving to bring earlier the future of a powerful socialist country, expressing the belief that the meetings would mark a significant occasion in promoting the development of the WIDF and the world women's movement. Speeches were made. Jang Chun Sil noted that the WIDF has grown into a powerful force in the struggle for realizing the genuine rights and social emancipation of women and international justice. She affirmed that the SWUK would fulfill its international obligation and duty as a member of the Secretariat and Executive Committee of the WIDF. Chairwoman Lorena Pena said that the meetings in Pyongyang are a demonstration of firm solidarity with the Korean people including the women in their just cause. The WIDF will hold aloft the banner of peace and independence against imperialism, take the lead in boosting friendship and solidarity among progressive women in the world and building a free and peaceful new world, she noted. That day the Central Committee of the SWUK hosted a reception for the participants at Pyongyang Koryo Hotel. Rodong News Team

title: Reception Given at Indonesian Embassy
body: The Indonesian embassy in Pyongyang hosted a reception at the Taedonggang Diplomatic Club on Apr. 19 to mark the 53rd anniversary of the visit to Indonesia by President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il. Present on invitation were Choe Hui Chol, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, and officials concerned. Ambassador Bambang Hiendrasto and staff members of the embassy were on hand. Speeches were made there. Rodong News Team

title: Japanese Friendship Delegation in Pyongyang
body: An Okayama prefectural Japan-Korea friendship delegation of Japan led by Seisuke Mihara, representative of the Association for Promotion of Friendship between Japan and North and South Korea, arrived in Pyongyang on Apr. 19. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman of Italian General Investment Group Leaves
body: Giancarlo Elia Valori, chairman of the Italian General Investment Group, left Pyongyang for home on Apr. 21. Rodong News Team

title: Overseas Korean Art Troupes Leave
body: Art troupes of Koreans in Japan and China left Pyongyang on Apr. 21 after taking part in the 31st April Spring Friendship Art Festival. Departing earlier was a vocalist of the art troupe of the International United Confederation of Koreans. Rodong News Team

title: Home-visiting Group of Koreans in Japan Leaves
body: A home-visiting group of Koreans in Japan led by Pak Hae Chol, vice department director of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan, left Pyongyang on Apr. 21. Rodong News Team

title: Japanese Friendship Delegation Visits Mangyongdae
body: An Okayama prefectural Japan-Korea friendship delegation of Japan led by Seisuke Mihara, representative of the Association for Promotion of Friendship between Japan and North and South Korea, visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. The guests laid bouquets at the old home of the President in Mangyongdae with deep reverence for him. They went round historical relics at the old home, being briefed on the revolutionary history of Kim Il Sung associated with it and on the patriotic life of his family members. The delegation also toured the Tower of the Juche Idea, the Ryugyong General Ophthalmic Hospital, etc. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of Koreans in Canada Leaves
body: A delegation of the Association of Koreans in Canada led by Chairman Kim Su Hae left Pyongyang on Apr. 21. Rodong News Team

title: Iranian Military Attache Hosts Reception
body: Mohammad Hassan Ghaffari Gerdvisheh, military attaché of the Iranian embassy in Pyongyang, hosted a reception at the Taedonggang Diplomatic Club on Apr. 20 on the occasion of the Army Day of Iran. Present there on invitation were Army Lieutenant General Kang Sun Nam, vice-minister of the People's Armed Forces, generals and officers of the Korean People's Army, officials concerned, foreign diplomatic envoys and military attaches of foreign embassies here. Iranian Ambassador to the DPRK Seyed Mohsen Emadi and his embassy officials were present there. Rodong News Team

title: National Schoolchildren's Festival of Loyalty Closes
body: The 21st National Schoolchildren's Festival of Loyalty closed. The festival which was held, being divided into political, art, sports and economic festivals in the period from the Day of the Shining Star to the Day of the Sun included a contest of youth explainers' agitation among officials of the youth league and youths and students and presentation of experience on reading march to Ryongnam Hill. Also included were colorful art and sports activities such as students' traveling agitation troupe contest, schoolchildren art squad contest, Taekwon-do for health contest and volleyball, basketball and table tennis contests of students of senior middle schools. Youths across the country briskly conducted mass movement including youth shock brigade activities, socialist emulation movement and youth march of science and technology at difficult and labor-consuming fields of building a powerful socialist country. Pyongyang City came first in team standings. A closing ceremony took place at the Central Youth Hall on Apr. 20. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of Int'l United Confederation of Koreans Leaves
body: The delegation of the International United Confederation of Koreans led by First Vice-Chairman Kim Chil Song left Pyongyang on Apr. 20. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Delegation Leaves for Russia
body: The joint working group delegation led by Vice-Minister of External Economic Relations Ri Kwang Gun left Pyongyang on Apr. 20 to take part in the 8th meeting of the joint working group for the implementation of the DPRK-Russia inter-governmental agreement on temporary labor activities to be held in Russia. Rodong News Team

title: Editorial
body: Let Us Implement Decision of Plenary Meeting of C.C., WPK The Third Plenary Meeting of the Seventh Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea held under the guidance of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un proudly declared the great victory of the line of simultaneously pushing forward the economic construction and the building of nuclear force and advanced a new strategic line. The WPK set forth the strategic line of simultaneously pushing forward the two fronts as required by the prevailing situation and the developing revolution at the historic March 2013 Plenary Meeting of the Party Central Committee. The historic tasks, laid down in the line, were successfully carried out and, after all, the arduous struggle of the Korean people to acquire a powerful treasured sword for defending peace came to successful conclusion and a firm guarantee was provided for the dignity and prosperity of all generations to come. The great victory of the said line made it possible for the DPRK to accelerate the economic construction as it pleases and our revolution has entered the high stage for hitting the final goal. In keeping with the demand of the historic period of the developing revolution, our Party convened the April plenary meeting and advanced a new strategic line for accomplishing the cause of socialist construction. The recent plenary meeting provided an epoch-making milestone for the final victory, and it helps the DPRK vigorously advance along the wide road of prosperity. All the people should turn out in a drive for implementing the decision of the Third Plenary Meeting of the Seventh Central Committee of the WPK, full of confidence and optimism about sure victory and thus achieve the final victory of the Juche revolution as early as possible.

title: Delegation of China Association for International Friendly Contact in Pyongyang
body: A delegation of the China Association for International Friendly Contact led by Deputy Secretary-General Zhou Xinzheng arrived in Pyongyang on Apr. 23. Rodong News Team

title: Congratulatory Group of Koreans in Japan Tours Various Places
body: The congratulatory group of Koreans in Japan for celebrating the Day of the Sun led by Ri Ki Sok, adviser of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan, visited Pyongyang Teachers Training College. The visitors went round educational science exhibition house, primary school teaching method rehearsal room, room for disseminating technology for developing intellectual faculty of children and other parts of the college, whose education has been put on a scientific, IT and modern basis of high level. The group also toured the Korean Revolution Museum, the Ryuwon Footwear Factory and the Pyongyang Primary School for Orphans. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Yong Nam Meets WIDF Chairwoman
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, met and had a talk with Lorena Pena, chairwoman of the Women's International Democratic Federation, and members of the federation leadership who paid a courtesy call on him at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Apr. 23.
