title: Korean Books Donated to Russian University
body: A Korean book-donating ceremony took place at University of Economic Management in Sankt-Petersburg of Russia on April 13. Present there were personages, teachers and students of the university. Conveyed at the ceremony were works of President Kim Il Sung, leader Kim Jong Il and the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and Korean books introducing the reality of daily prospering Juche Korea and the Korean nation's history of five thousand years and brilliant culture. Dmitriyev, vice-president of the university, said that those books would help teachers and students understand better the greatness of the preceding leaders of the DPRK and Kim Jong Un and the true picture of the developing Korean society. Rodong News Team

title: WIDF Solidarity March Held
body: A 2018 Women's International Democratic Federation solidarity march supporting the just cause of the Korean people and women took place in Pyongyang on Apr. 22. There was a starting ceremony of the solidarity march in front of the Monument to the Three Charters for National Reunification. Present there were Jang Chun Sil, chairwoman of the Central Committee of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea (SWUK), vice-chairpersons of the Korean Committee for Solidarity with the World People (KCSWP), officials of the SWUK Central Committee and women workers of different social strata. Attending it were Lorena Pena, chairwoman of the WIDF, and members of its leadership, women delegations and delegates from different countries taking part in WIDF meetings. Speeches were made there. The chairwoman and vice-chairwoman of the WIDF hailed the important decisions made at the Third Plenary Meeting of the Seventh Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, extending greetings to Chairman Kim Jong Un who set forth the new strategic line on channeling all efforts into the socialist economic construction and developing science and technology. The energetic activities and efforts made by the DPRK, creating the atmosphere of detente and peace on the Korean peninsula and the region are supported and welcomed by the international community, they said. The KCSWP vice-chairpersons called for strengthened solidarity among the world people aspiring after independence and justice and loving peace and expressed the will to fully discharge their international obligations in building a new world free from aggression, war, domination and plunder. A solidarity statement of the WIDF supporting the just cause of the Korean people and women was made public. The participants of the march started from the Monument to the Three Charters for National Reunification. The crowd ardently welcomed the marchers positively conducting the righteous international solidarity activities. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korea: Struggle for Probe into Case of Ferry Disaster
body: The April 16 Consultative Council of Families of Victims and other organizations in south Korea called a press conference on April 17 in demand of the resignation of those who hindered the probe into the truth behind the ferry Sewol disaster, according to the south Korean internet newspaper Jaju Sibo. They declared that those who stood against the probe into the case can never be pardoned. Rodong News Team

title: Mock Trial of S. Korean Army for Massacre of Civilians during Vietnam War Held
body: 50 civic and public organizations of south Korea including the Bar Association for Democratic Society held a civilian court for peace in Seoul on April 21 and 22 to have a mock trial of the south Korean army which committed massacre of civilians in the Vietnam War, according to CBS of south Korea. The court charged that the massacre of hundreds of civilians at two small villages was a deliberate murder committed by the south Korean army. It ruled that the "government" should make an official apology for the army's massacre of civilians, thoroughly investigate into the truth about the case and compensate the victims. Rodong News Team

title: Great Event to be Recorded Forever in History of WPK and DPRK
body: The news about the Third Plenary Meeting of the Seventh Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea in which the great victory of the WPK's line of simultaneously pushing forward the economic construction and the building of a nuclear force was declared and the WPK's fresh strategic line was presented is lashing the whole country into great emotion and joy. The servicepersons and people of the DPRK are determined to turn out as one in the grand advance of economic construction in high spirits with pride and self-confidence of victors, conviction and optimism about hopeful future. Kim Yong Nam, vice-minister of Coal Industry, said that the April 2018 Plenary Meeting of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea is a great event to be recorded forever in the history of the WPK and the DPRK. The victory of the WPK's line of simultaneously pushing forward the economic construction and the building of nuclear force would be unthinkable without the "do-or-die" forced march and wise leadership of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. The Supreme Leader set forth the militant slogan "Let us further accelerate the advance of our revolution by concentrating all our efforts on socialist economic construction!" at the plenary meeting. Our goal is vast, but we will certainly carry out the goal for producing coal set forth at the five-year strategy for national economic development with the conviction that we are sure to win when we advance along the road indicated by the Supreme Leader. To Jong Chol, vice-president of the State Academy of Sciences, said: Keeping in mind the Supreme Leader's instructions that the spirit of self-reliance and science and technology are the powerful driving force of socialist economic construction, we will put spurs to the grand march of science and technology to activate the overall national economy and put it on an upward spiral track as required by the new strategic line set forth at the historic April plenary meeting. Pyon Kyu Sun, president of Kim Hyong Jik University of Education, said: The second agenda adopted in the plenary meeting serves as important guidelines in indicating the orientation of developing the Juche education and in clarifying the position of our educators again. We will create and complete Korean-style educational method as required by a higher stage of the developing revolution and thus fulfill the mission as a pedigree establishment for the education of the rising generation. Rodong News Team

title: Decisions of WPK Backed in Ukraine
body: The Ukrainian "Treasured Sword of Songun" Association for the Study of the Juche Idea made public a statement on April 21 in support of the decisions adopted at the Third Plenary Meeting of the Seventh Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Noting that the said plenary meeting declared the great victory of the line of simultaneously developing the two fronts and unfolded a new strategic line of concentrating all efforts on socialist economic construction, the statement said: The meeting set forth the militant slogan "Let us further accelerate the advance of our revolution by concentrating all our efforts on socialist economic construction!" and underscored the need to channel all human, material and technical potentials of the country into its economic development and solve all problems arising in the economic construction by relying on science and technology under the slogan of self-reliance and self-sufficiency. We urge various countries of the world to take relevant measures in response to the positive efforts of the DPRK to ease the tension on the Korean peninsula and achieve its reunification. On the same day, a spokesperson of the Press Department of the Mongolian Ministry of Foreign Affairs issued a statement backing the above-said decisions. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK's Books Donated to Indonesia
body: A Korean book-donating ceremony took place at Bungkarno University of Indonesia on April 19 to mark the 53rd anniversary of the historic visit to Indonesia by President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il and the 53rd anniversary of naming of Kimilsungia. Present there were personages of the Founding Committee of the Soekarno Foundation for Education, the Pioneer Party and Bungkarno University and masses of Indonesia and the ambassador and staff members of the DPRK embassy in Jakarta. Works of the peerlessly great men of the DPRK were donated to the university. Rachmawati Soekarnoputri, chairwoman of the Founding Committee of the Soekarno Foundation for Education, said that the relationship between President Sukarno and President Kim Il Sung was very firm and close one based on the community of thought and idea opposing imperialism and colonialism, stressing that the friendly ties between the peoples of the two countries should be invariably maintained. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung's Exploits Lauded Abroad
body: Seminar, book and photo exhibition and film show were held in Nepal, Bangladesh, Indonesia, Kuwait and Britain between April 5 and 13 to mark the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. The general secretary of the Central Committee of the Nepal Communist Party (Marxist-Leninist), the chairman of the Nepal Journalist Association and other speakers praised Kim Il Sung as an outstanding strategist and world elder statesman who founded the Juche idea and defeated the U.S. and Japanese imperialists in one generation. The chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party, the secretary general of the Jatiya Party, the president of the People's League and the chairperson of the Institute of the Juche Idea in Bangladesh lauded the exploits Kim Il Sung performed for the founding and development of the DPRK. The chairman of the Kuwait Asian Journalist Association stressed that Kim Il Sung is the great sage of mankind who proactively supported and encouraged the peoples of many countries in the struggle for national independence and the building of a new society and the eternal leader of the Korean people who devoted all his life to the people's happiness. The general secretary of the Central Committee of the New Communist Party of Britain said that the President led the revolution and construction with belief and reliance on the inexhaustible strength of the popular masses and pursued the politics of love centered on the people. The chairman of the British Association for the Study of Songun Policy stressed that the birth of the Juche idea and the brilliant settlement of the issue of succession to the leadership were the greatest of the President's exploits. A congratulatory message and a letter to the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un were adopted at the events in Nepal and Britain. Rodong News Team

title: WIDF Meetings Close
body: The meeting of the Secretariat and the meeting of the Directive Committee of the Women's International Democratic Federation (WIDF) closed on Apr. 23. Present at the meetings of the Federation held here from April 19 to 23 were Chairwoman of the WIDF Lorena Pena, members of the leadership of the Federation, women's delegations and delegates of various countries and officials of the Central Committee of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea. The meetings reviewed the work done by the Federation over the last one year to strengthen friendship and solidarity among the world women's organizations and level off the social inequalities of women and defend their rights under the uplifted banner of peace and independence against imperialism and discussed its future action program. A letter to the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was adopted at the meeting of the Directive Committee of the WIDF. The Directive Committee decided to confer the title of an outstanding anti-imperialist revolutionary fighter, a hope of the struggle of world women on the anti-Japanese war heroine Kim Jong Suk for her enormous contribution to the strengthening and development of the Korean women's movement. Rodong News Team

title: 33rd National Festival of Science and Technology Opens
body: The 33rd national festival of science and technology opened. Attending the festival, whose theme is the local production of raw and other materials and equipment and integration of science and technology with economy, are scientists, technicians and officials of more than 500 units selected at the festivals of commissions, ministries, national institutions and provinces (municipality). The festival will be divided into 29 panels including power, metal, chemistry, machinery, coal, construction, IT and bio-engineering. There will be exhibition and presentation of scientific and technical achievements, made in the drive for putting the national economy on a Juche, modern, IT and scientific basis, and exchanges of new technologies and service of new goods exchange. Its opening ceremony took place at the Three-Revolution Exhibition House on Apr. 23. Present there were Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, Pak Thae Song, vice-chairman of the WPK Central Committee, Kim Sung Du, chairman of the Education Commission, Jang Chol, president of the State Academy of Sciences, and officials concerned and working people. At the end of the ceremony the participants looked round the festival venue. Rodong News Team

title: Letter to Kim Jong Un from Participants of WIDF Meeting
body: The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a letter from the participants in the meeting of the Directive Committee of the Women's International Democratic Federation on Apr. 23. The letter expressed thanks to Kim Jong Un for having shown hospitality and care for delegates of the WIDF and taken political, organizational and material measures for successful holding of WIDF meetings. It said that they were struck with admiration for the reality of the DPRK which has the economic system based on self-development, the top-notch educational system equipped with the latest technology and the wonderful conditions for the children and women. It sincerely wished the party, the state and the people of the DPRK success in the struggle to defend peace and achieve the country's independent reunification and implement the five-year strategy for national economic development for building a powerful socialist country. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's Work Printed in Russia
body: The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "The Great Comrade Kim Il Sung Is the Eternal Leader of Our Party and Our People" was brought out in booklet at the Arton Publishing House of Russia on April 10. The work, published on April 20, Juche 101 (2012), deals with the revolutionary exploits performed by President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il in their lives. It also indicates the tasks for staunchly defending and adding eternal luster to the ideology and feats of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's Successful Visit to China Hailed in Nigeria, Uganda
body: Personages from Nigeria and Uganda issued statements on April 6 and 10 in congratulation of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's successful visit to China. Goodswill Nnaji, national chairman of the Better Nigeria Progressive Party, said that Kim Jong Un met with President Xi Jinping and deepened the traditional friendship between the DPRK and China during his visit to China. He went on: His China visit is of important significance in boosting cooperation among the world progressive forces. We appeal to the world people to become vocal in expressing support and solidarity with the just cause of the Korean people. Damian Ogbonna, national chairman of the People's Progressive Party of Nigeria and chairman of the African Regional Committee for Friendship and Solidarity with the Korean People, stressed that Kim Jong Un's China visit was a great event which marked an epochal occasion in glorifying the long tradition of DPRK-China friendship and carrying forward and developing it onto a new high level in keeping with the requirements of the new period. Daniel Rugarama, chairman of the Ugandan National Executive Committee of the Pan-African Movement, hailed Kim Jong Un's successful China visit, saying he is an outstanding leader who smashed the imperialists' moves for invasion and protected global peace and the human cause of independence under the unfurled banner of the Juche idea. His China visit made a great contribution to ensuring peace and stability on the Korean peninsla and in the region, the chairman added. Rodong News Team

title: Senegalese Politician Lauds Kim Il Sung
body: Amadou Sar, permanent secretary of the Workers' Party for the Independence of Senegal, made public a statement titled "The Day of the Sun and the DPRK in the 21st century" on April 20. He said that the Day of the Sun is the greatest national holiday of the Korean people, noting: President Kim Il Sung devoted his whole life to the country and its people and the accomplishment of the socialist cause. That's why the Korean people are celebrating his birthday as the Day of the Sun. Today the DPRK's strategic position has reached the highest level. The DPRK struggling to defend the sovereignty of the country and nation and realize genuine international justice is an example in securing global peace and stability and maintaining independence. Progressive humankind sincerely want the DPRK to lead more dynamically the cause of independence against imperialism as a world's power that foils the imperialists' high-handed and arbitrary practices and establishes a just international order. Rodong News Team

title: Decisions of WPK Backed in Switzerland
body: The Switzerland-Korea Committee and the Swiss Group for the Study of the Juche Idea made public a joint statement on April 21 in support of the decisions adopted at the Third Plenary Meeting of the Seventh Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. The joint statement said that the said plenary meeting is of great historical significance. It went on: The meeting declared the great victory of the line of simultaneously developing the two fronts set forth at the March 2013 Plenary Meeting of the Central Committee of the WPK. It also showed the world the responsible and pro-active efforts of the WPK and DPRK government for defending peace. We fully support the decisions adopted at the plenary meeting. On the same day, the Egyptian Foreign Ministry issued a statement welcoming the above-said decisions. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of China Association for International Friendly Contact Places Wreath before Friendship Tower
body: A delegation of the China Association for International Friendly Contact led by Deputy Secretary-General Zhou Xinzheng laid a wreath before the Friendship Tower on Apr. 24. The wreath in the name of the delegation of the China Association for International Friendly Contact was placed before the tower. The members of the delegation looked round the tower after paying silent tribute to the martyrs of the Chinese People's Volunteers who fought heroically on the Korean front against the U.S. imperialists' invasion. Rodong News Team

title: Indonesian Embassy Officials Visit Fatherland Liberation War Historic Site
body: Staff members of the Indonesian embassy here visited the Fatherland Liberation War Historic Site on April 23 to mark the 53rd anniversary of the visit to Indonesia by President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il. They went round various parts of the site, being briefed on the fact that Kim Il Sung drove the U.S. imperialist aggressors into the abyss of ruin with his unique military idea and superb strategy and tactics and Kim Jong Il cultivated his pluck and guts as a Songun brilliant commander while staying there during the war. They also toured the Electronics Industry Hall at the Three-Revolution Exhibition House on the same day. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Yong Nam Meets Congratulatory Group of Koreans in Japan
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, met and had a talk with the congratulatory group of Koreans in Japan for celebrating the Day of the Sun led by Ri Ki Sok, adviser of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan, at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Apr. 24. Rodong News Team

title: Floral Basket to Statues of Great Leaders from DR Congo
body: The Federation of Students and Pupils of DR Congo sent a floral basket to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill in Pyongyang on the occasion of the 86th anniversary of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army. The floral basket was placed at the statues on Apr. 24. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Sees Off Train Carrying Chinese Bodies, Wounded
body: The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un went to Pyongyang Railway Station on Apr. 25 night to see off a special train for the purpose of carrying the bodies of Chinese who died in a tragic traffic accident and the wounded. After hearing Chinese comrades' suggestion that the bodies and the wounded would be sent to the Chinese proper as soon as possible, the Supreme Leader saw to it that the formation of a train was made and took measures to ensure that the bodies and the wounded were sent in a responsible manner, accompanied by leading officials of the Party and Government, technical officials and medical workers. He went to Pyongyang Railway Station on Apr. 25 night and learned about preparations for carrying the bodies and got on the train to meet again the wounded and offer them words of consolation. At the railway station he met Li Jinjun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK, and once again expressed deep condolences and apology to the bereave families of the victims over the unexpected, tragic disaster the close Chinese friends suffered in our land. He said that he and the Party and Government are poignantly feeling the responsibility for the accident. Though he knows well neither word nor consolation nor compensation can allay the pain of the people who lost their beloved family members, he wanted to console the Chinese comrades even a bit with all efforts we can do, he said, and conveyed a consolatory message and money. And he said that he would strictly investigate and handle the serious accident and take strong measures to thoroughly prevent the recurrence of such accident. He saw off the train in a bitter grief, together with Premier of the Cabinet Pak Pong Ju and other senior officials of the Party and Government. Political News Team

title: Anti-Reunification Moves against Aspiration of Nation
body: The conservative group of south Korea is working hard to stoke discord and antagonism among compatriots while painting a black picture of the DPRK's positive efforts for mending the inter-Korean relations. The reckless moves of the conservative group are an unpardonable crime against the nation which is aimed to chill the hard-won atmosphere of improved north-south relations at any cost and carry out a sinister political design. Historically, the conservative coteries of south Korea have gotten desperate in escalating confrontation with the compatriots whenever the atmosphere of the north-south relations grows strong as they were displeased with the national reconciliation, unity and reunification. They are now getting desperate in hurling mud at the DPRK, manifesting their bad habit again. Such behavior is peculiar to the ugly traitors who are working hard to attain their partisan interests only in disregard of the destiny of the nation and the great event of the nation. The anti-reunification forces who are desperately going against the current trend of the national history, regarding the north-south relations as a plaything for attaining their politically-motivated wild ambition, can never escape the curses by the public and stern punishment by history. Pak Chol Jun

title: Pak Pong Ju Inspects Various Units
body: Premier Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, made a field survey of the Institute of Agricultural Science. He encouraged the officials, scientists and technicians of the institute, who managed to manufacture a high-performance fertilizer molding machine badly needed for countryside, and called on them to wage a dynamic campaign for research and creation in order to push forward the agricultural front by dint of science and technology true to the spirit of the April Plenary Meeting of the Party Central Committee. A consultative meeting held on the spot discussed the issues arising in rebuilding the institute on an expansion basis and making sure that the scientific research findings prove effective in agricultural production. Earlier, the premier inspected the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex and the Ryongnam Dockyard to discuss the measures for consolidating the independent foundation of the chemical industry and increasing shipbuilding successes. Rodong News Team

title: Results of 2018 AFC Cup (East Asia)
body: The second match between the April 25 Team of the DPRK and the Benfica Macao Team of Macao of China belonging to Group I (East Asia) of the 2018 AFC Cup was held in Macao of China on April 25. The April 25 Team beat its rival 2:0 at the away match, taking the first place in the group with four wins in four matches. An Il Bom scored at around 24 minutes and 31 minutes. The April 25 Team overwhelmed the Benfica Macao Team 8:0 at the home match. The team will compete with the Hwaebul Team of the DPRK on May 2 and the Hang Yuen Team of China's Taipei on May 16 in Pyongyang. Meanwhile, the Hwaebul Team beat the Hang Yuen Team 2:0 in the second match held in Taipei of China on April 25. Rodong News Team

title: Japanese Politicians' Group Visit to Yasukuni Shrine Slammed
body: A spokesman for the Korean Committee on Measures for the Sexual Slavery for Japanese Army and Drafting Victims issued a statement on Apr. 25 over the fact that Prime Minister of Japan Abe recently made offering to Yasukuni Shrine, symbolic of militarism, and 150 dietmen belonging to the "Dietmen's society for visiting the Yasukuni shrine" paid a group visit to it. The statement branded such deed as a blatant challenge to justice and peace and a sinister political bullying act. This is a total denial of the blood-stained past and an act that can never be justified with any pretext or excuse as it is revelation of dangerous militarist frenzy to agitate revanchism in the Japanese society and stage reinvasion of Korea and other Asian countries and realize without fail the wild dream of the "Greater East Asia Co-prosperity Sphere", the statement said, adding: The reactionary ruling quarters and right-wing elements of Japan flocked to the shrine and called back the departed soul of militarism. The aim is to reverse the crime-woven past, instill the frantic "view on Japanese subjects" and militarism into all the Japanese nationals including the new generation and thus hurl them into the path of aggression against humanity. The Japanese authorities and right-wing reactionaries going against the requirements and trend of the times, far from repenting of the crimes, will never be able to evade divine punishment. The issue of visit to the shrine is not just an issue related to the freedom of individual or diplomacy among countries but it is a cornerstone distinguishing the stand on war and injustice from that on peace and justice and it is an issue related to the attitude and stand to history. The Japanese politicians should know well about history before discussing politics and must be sincere before history. They should beg for pardon before the victims in the past and their bereaved families, with their knees knelt down, not visiting the shrine. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung Lauded Abroad
body: Meetings for celebrating the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung were held in Switzerland, Denmark, Norway, Germany, Luxembourg, Thailand and Libya from April 5 to 7. The chairman of the Switzerland-Korea Committee praised Kim Il Sung for working energetically for the happiness of the Korean people, the country's reunification and the global cause of independence all his life. The chairman of the Denmark-DPRK Friendship Association said that the President made a titanic contribution for the country and its people, the times and history and his exploits would be immortal along with the cause of independence steadily making progress. The chairman of the Ostfold County Committee of the Communist Party of Norway said the President was a prominent thinker-theoretician who founded the immortal Juche idea after embarking on the road of revolution in his teens. Speakers at the meeting in Germany praised the President as the eternal sun of humankind and the peerlessly great man who defeated the U.S. and Japanese imperialists in one generation and built a genuine people's country in Korea. The secretary general of the Sunbula International Friendship Club of Libya said that the exploits of Kim Il Sung, who turned the DPRK into a socialist fortress independent in politics, self-supporting in the economy and self-reliant in national defence, will shine forever in history. Congratulatory messages to the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un were adopted at the meetings in Switzerland, Norway and Germany. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's Work Posted on Russian Website
body: Russian internet news Erofei-Deve introduced the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "The Great Comrade Kim Il Sung Is the Eternal Leader of Our Party and Our People" on April 9 to mark the Day of the Sun. The work, published on April 20, Juche 101 (2012), deals with the revolutionary exploits performed by President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il in their lives. It also indicates the tasks for staunchly defending and adding eternal luster to the idea and feats of the great leaders. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Leaves Pyongyang for North-South Summit
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, left Pyongyang early on Friday morning for the historic north-south summit meeting and talks to be held in the south side portion of Panmunjom. The north-south summit meeting and talks are to take place in the south side for the first time in the history of the nation's division. The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un is to cross the demarcation line at Panmunjom at 9 a.m. on Friday to meet and have historic talks with President Moon Jae In. He will open-heartedly discuss with Moon Jae In all the issues arising in improving inter-Korean relations and achieving peace, prosperity and reunification of the Korean peninsula. After concluding the itinerary of the north-south summit meeting and talks from morning and afternoon to evening of Friday, Kim Jong Un will come back to Pyongyang. Political News Team

title: Spokesperson of Korea-Japan Interchange Association Flays NHK
body: The NHK of Japan aired a so-called "special programme" several times in mid-April by hurling good-for-nothing riffraff in a bid to cast a vicious slur on the DPRK as a "criminal state" and, not content with this, heavily maligned the dignity of its supreme leadership, which is an unpardonable hideous crime. A spokesperson for the Korea-Japan Interchange Association, in a statement on Apr. 26, condemned the NHK, no more than a Japanese right-wing reactionaries' mouthpiece, for daring hurt the supreme leadership of the DPRK just like a fool always rushing to the fore, branding it as an intolerable insult and a grave challenge to the DPRK. The statement censured the criminal acts of the NHK as the height of an evil deed that can be done only by those villains who are steeped in hostility towards the DPRK to the marrow, nasty hack writers who are parasitic on power. The "special programme" aired by the NHK is a hideous fraud made up of forgery and fabrication from A to Z, the statement said, and went on: As well known worldwide, the NHK is a notorious den of hack writers which is famed to often ransack a "dustbin." The mad acts of the NHK lay bare the disturbed feelings of the Japanese reactionaries taken aback by the formidable power and influence of the DPRK that has towered as a world's strategic state with pride. It is nothing but a last-ditch effort of the political dwarfs of the lonely island nation that has been marginalized from the fresh stream of history and doomed to sink like a setting sun. Lurking behind the hideous provocation is a sinister intention of the Abe regime to prolong its remaining days on the wane by diverting elsewhere the public opinion critical of it, as it faces impeachment for its political immaturity and corruption. The Japanese conservative media that stoke confrontation and war and abet injustice are a very high-profile crime syndicate spelling all evils. A short tongue can put a long neck at stake. The NHK must be dearly punished for running helter-skelter with its anti-DPRK propaganda. It must kneel down and make an apology to the people of the DPRK, well aware of the catastrophic consequences to be entailed by its anti-DPRK false propaganda. The Japanese reactionary media will have to pay dearly for such hideous crimes as daring point an accusing finger at the sun. Rodong News Team

title: Decisions of 3rd Plenary Meeting of 7th C.C., WPK Hailed in India
body: Indian personages issued statements on April 22 and 23 in support of the decisions made at the 3rd Plenary Meeting of the 7th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Vipin Gupta, chairman of the Juche Philosophy Study Committee of India, said: It was entirely thanks to the wise guidance of respected HE Kim Jong Un that the historic tasks, set forth at the March 2013 Plenary Meeting of the C.C., WPK to simultaneously push forward the economic construction and the building of nuclear force, could be successfully carried out. If the DPRK concentrates all its efforts on the socialist economic construction under a new strategic line advanced at the 3rd Plenary Meeting of the 7th C.C., WPK, it will put the national economy on a Juche, modern, IT and scientific basis of higher level and provide all the Korean people with an affluent and highly-civilized life. We are convinced that the decisions made at the plenary meeting will help activate the overall national economy and further develop the self-supporting and modern socialist economy and thus the DPRK will be more prosperous. Suneet Chopra, secretary general of the All India Indo-Korean Friendship Association, said: The measures taken by the DPRK are being warmly supported by the world progressive peoples. We will as ever conduct the brisk movement for solidarity with the Korean people. We are convinced that Korea will be certainly reunified under the guidance of Comrade Kim Jong Un and sincerely wish the Korean people bigger success in their struggle for achieving the country's prosperity and building a powerful socialist country. Rodong News Team

title: Iranian Embassy Hosts Reception
body: The Iranian embassy here hosted a reception on Apr. 26 to mark the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Present there on invitation were Choe Thae Bok, chairman of the Supreme People's Assembly, Thae Hyong Chol, minister of Higher Education who is president of Kim Il Sung University and chairman of the DPRK-Iran Friendship Parliamentary Group, Kim Jong Suk, chairwoman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries, Ryu Myong Son, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Kim Ik Song, director general of the General Bureau for Affairs with Diplomatic Corps, and officials concerned. The Iranian ambassador and staff members of his embassy were on hand. Seyed Mohsen Emadi, Iranian ambassador to the DPRK, said in his speech that Kim Il Sung paid deep attention to the development of the friendly relations between the DPRK and Iran, adding that the traditional friendly relations provided by the preceding leaders of the two countries have covered the path of development for many years. He stressed that they heartily hope for the common prosperity and development of the two countries, referring to the reality of the DPRK steadily developing under the wise guidance of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Choe Thae Bok said it is an expression of deep reverence for Kim Il Sung that the friends of Iran have splendidly celebrated the Day of the Sun every year. It is also the reflection of the Iranian government and people's firm will to strengthen the friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries, he added. He stressed that the DPRK would as ever extend full support and solidarity to the just struggle of the Iranian government and people, expressing the stance of the DPRK government to expand the friendly and cooperative relations with Iran in various fields. Rodong News Team
