title: Panmunjom Declaration on Peace, Prosperity and Reunification of Korean Peninsula
body: The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and President Moon Jae In signed the "Panmunjom Declaration on Peace, Prosperity and Reunification of Korean Peninsula" on April 27, the full text of which reads: Chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea Kim Jong Un and President of the Republic of Korea Moon Jae In had the north-south summit talks at the "House of Peace" in Panmunjom on April 27, 2018 at the significant time when a historic turn is being made in the Korean peninsula, reflecting the unanimous desire of all the Koreans for peace, prosperity and reunification. The top leaders of the north and the south solemnly declared before the 80 million Koreans and the whole world that there would be no longer war and a new era of peace has opened on the Korean peninsula. They declared as follows in the historic land of Panmunjom, reflecting the firm will to put an end to division and confrontation, an outcome of the Cold War, at the earliest date, courageously open up a new era of national reconciliation, peace and prosperity and more actively improve and develop the north-south ties: 1. The north and the south will achieve comprehensive and epochal improvement and development in the north-south ties and thus relink the severed blood vessel of the nation and bring earlier the future of common prosperity and independent reunification. It is the unanimous desire of all the Koreans and urgent requirement of the times which brooks no further delay to improve and develop the north-south ties. ①The north and the south confirmed the principle of national independence which specifies that the destiny of our nation is set by ourselves and agreed to open up a drastic phase in the improvement and development of the ties by thoroughly implementing the north-south declarations and all the agreements that had already been adopted. ②The north and the south agreed to hold dialogues and negotiations in all fields including the high-level talks at the earliest possible date and take active measures to implement the matters that have been agreed on at the summit talks. ③The north and the south agreed to set up a north-south joint liaison office where authorities of both sides will permanently reside in Kaesong area in order to ensure close discussion between the authorities and to satisfactorily provide NGO exchanges and cooperation. ④The north and the south agreed to invigorate multi-faceted cooperation, exchanges, visits and contacts of people of all social standings in order to give further momentum to the atmosphere of national reconciliation and unity. They agreed to actively promote joint national events participated in by people of all social standings including the authorities, parliaments, political parties, local autonomous bodies, and NGOs on the significant occasions of the north and south including June 15 and thus boost the atmosphere of reconciliation and cooperation inside while making joint advance into international games including 2018 Asian Games in order to demonstrate to the world the nation's resourcefulness, talents and unity. ⑤The north and the south agreed to exert efforts for the rapid settlement of humanitarian issues that are attributable to the national division and have north-south Red Cross talks in order to discuss and settle all the issues including the reunion of separated families and relatives. For the present, they agreed to hold the reunion of separated families and relatives with the upcoming August 15 as an occasion. ⑥The north and the south agreed to actively promote the projects agreed in the October 4 declaration in order to achieve the balanced development and common prosperity of the nation's economy, and to take practical measures to relink and modernize railways and roads on the eastern and western coasts on a priority basis for their active use. 2. The north and the south will make joint efforts to defuse the acute military tensions and to substantially defuse the danger of a war on the Korean peninsula. It is a very important issue related to the destiny of the nation and a very crucial issue for ensuring peaceful and stable life of the Koreans to defuse military tensions and remove the danger of war from the Korean peninsula. ①The north and the south agreed to totally stop all hostile acts against the other side in all spaces including the ground, sea and air, the root cause of military tension and conflicts. For the present, they agreed to stop all the hostile acts including the loud-speaker broadcasting and scattering of leaflets in the areas along the Military Demarcation Line from May 1, dismantle their means and make the DMZ a substantial peace zone in the future. ②The north and the south agreed to turn the area of the "northern limit line" in the West Sea into peace waters and take substantial measures to prevent accidental military conflicts and ensure safe fishing operations there. ③The north and the south agreed to take various military measures depending on the invigoration of mutual cooperation, exchanges, visits and contacts. The north and the south agreed to often have military authorities talks including the talks between the defence ministers in order to discuss and settle the military issues that may arise between the two sides without delay, and to hold General-level military talks within May, to begin with. 3. The north and the south will closely cooperate with each other to build a durable and lasting peace mechanism on the Korean peninsula. It is a historic task which brooks no further delay to terminate the present abnormal armistice situation and establish a firm peace mechanism on the Korean peninsula. ①The north and the south agreed to reconfirm the non-aggression agreement on non-use of any form of armed forces and strictly abide by it. ②The north and the south agreed to realize disarmament in a phased manner depending on the removal of military tension and the substantial building of military confidence between the two sides. ③The north and the south agreed to declare the end of war this year, the 65th anniversary of the Armistice Agreement, replace the AA with a peace accord and actively promote the holding of north-south-U.S. tripartite or north-south-China-U.S. four-party talks for the building of durable and lasting peace mechanism. ④The north and the south confirmed the joint target on turning the Korean peninsula into a nuclear-free zone through the complete denuclearization. The north and the south shared the acknowledgment that the active measures being taken by the north side are very significant and crucial steps for the denuclearization of the Korean peninsula, and agreed to fulfill each other's responsibility and role in the future. The north and the south agreed to make active efforts to elicit support and cooperation from the international community for the denuclearization of the Korean peninsula. The top leaders of the north and the south agreed to frequently have an in-depth discussion on the important matters for the nation through regular talks and hotlines, deepen confidence and jointly work hard to further expand the favorable trend toward the sustained development of the north-south ties and peace, prosperity and reunification of the Korean peninsula. For the present President Moon Jae In agreed to visit Pyongyang this fall.

title: Historic North-South Summit for National Reconciliation and Unity, Peace and Prosperity
body: Kim Jong Un Says Goodbye to Moon Jae In The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un successfully concluded the historic north-south summit meeting and talks and said goodbye to President Moon Jae In. When Kim Jong Un and his wife Ri Sol Ju came out of the "House of Peace" together with Moon Jae In and his wife, the personages from the north and the south broke into thunderous applause. Kim Jong Un and Ri Sol Ju took the reserved seats installed outdoor with Moon Jae In and his wife and watched a farewell performance "One spring" prepared by the south side. At the end of the performance Kim Jong Un shook hands with the personages from the south and Moon Jae In with those from the north one by one, exchanging farewells. Kim Jong Un and Moon Jae In took hands and said goodbye to each other, promising a fresh start. Kim Jong Un left the "House of Peace" amid a warm send-off of personages from the south side. Political News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Proposes Resetting Standard Time of DPRK
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, proposed resetting the standard time of the DPRK. During his visit to the south side area for the historic Third North-South Summit Meeting and Talks, Kim Jong Un, Supreme Leader of the party, the state and the army of the DPRK, discussed with south Korean President Moon Jae In the matter of unifying the standard times of the north and the south. Noting that it was a painful wrench to see two clocks indicating Pyongyang and Seoul times hanging on a wall of the summit venue, he proposed unifying the times of the north and the south before doing anything else. It is not an abstract meaning that the north and the south become one but it is just a process in which the north and the south turn their different and separated things into the same and single ones, he said, expressing his resolution to unify the two times now existing on the Korean peninsula as the first practical step for national reconciliation and unity. True to his suggestion that a relevant field of the DPRK should examine and approve this proposal, the Presidium of the DPRK Supreme People's Assembly adopted a decree "On Resetting Pyongyang Time". Political News Team

title: Kim Il Sung's Programme for National Reunification Hailed in Switzerland
body: Swiss organizations issued a joint statement on April 7 to mark the 25th publication anniversary of President Kim Il Sung's work "10-Point Programme of the Great Unity of the Whole Nation for the Reunification of the Country". The Swiss Preparatory Committee for Celebrating the 106th Birth Anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, the Switzerland-Korea Committee and the Swiss Group for the Study of the Juche Idea said in their joint statement: The 10-point programme of the great unity of the whole nation, announced by Kim Il Sung, reflects his unbounded patriotic will. Its publication laid a groundwork for realizing détente, reconciliation, cooperation and exchange between the north and the south of Korea. The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address for this year also reflects the spirit of the 10-point programme. Positive changes are now being made in the inter-Korean relations thanks to the energetic guidance of Kim Jong Un carrying forward the preceding leaders' idea and cause of national reunification. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Il's Exploits Praised by Nigerian Body
body: The Nigerian National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism posted an article on its website on April 9 to mark the 25th anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il's election as chairman of the National Defence Commission of the DPRK. The article said: The period in which leader Kim Jong Il worked as the chairman of the National Defence Commission of the DPRK was days when he defended socialism and turned the DPRK into an invincible political and military power that no one dares to provoke, in the face of the harshest ordeals and difficulties ever known history. He, who took upon himself the destiny of the country and people, applied the Songun politics comprehensively and consolidated the military muscle of the country in every way. Under his care, the Korean People's Army grew into the elite ranks of defending the leader unto death and the invincible army and the all-people and nationwide defence system was firmly established and the powerful defense industry provided. His undying feats will shine long in history. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung's Work Printed in Russia
body: The Forum Book Publishing House of Russia brought out in booklet President Kim Il Sung's work "On the Five-Point Policy for National Reunification" on April 10 to mark his birth anniversary. The work, published on June 25, Juche 62 (1973), deals with the content of the five-point policy and significance and validity of its publication. The main idea of the said policy is: To remove military confrontation and lessen the tension between the north and the south, achieve multilateral collaboration and interchange between the north and the south, convene a Great National Congress comprising representatives of people of all levels, political parties and social organisations from the north and the south, institute a north-south federation named the Federal Republic of Koryo and work together for the north and the south in the field of external activities and enter the UN under the name of the Federal Republic of Koryo. Rodong News Team

title: Decisions of 3rd Plenary Meeting of 7th C.C., WPK Hailed by African Regional Body
body: The African Regional Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea issued a statement on April 24 in support of the decisions made at the 3rd Plenary Meeting of the 7th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. The statement said: The 3rd Plenary Meeting of the 7th C.C., WPK declared the great victory of the line on simultaneously developing the two fronts and advanced a fresh strategic line on concentrating all efforts on the socialist economic construction. The DPRK smashed the hostile forces' unprecedented moves for stifling it and made unimaginable historic events one after another in less than five years, bringing about dramatic changes in the international political landscape. This is an outcome of the efforts made by socialist Korea to ease tensions and ensure peace in the Korean peninsula and the region. The African people fully support all the efforts of the DPRK to concentrate all its strength on developing the economy and remarkably improving the standard of people's living and strengthen close cooperation and dialogue with its neighboring countries and the international community to defend peace and stability of the Korean peninsula and the rest of the world. The DPRK's peace-loving stance is zealously hailed by the world society. We extend firm support and solidarity to the Korean people in the struggle for implementing the decisions of the 3rd Plenary Meeting of the 7th C.C., WPK. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of Brazilian Senators Feted
body: The Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK hosted a reception for the visiting delegation of Brazilian senators on Apr. 27. Present there on invitation were members of the delegation led by Fernando Collor, former president and head of the Senate Foreign Affairs and National Defence Committee. An Tong Chun, vice-chairman of the Supreme People's Assembly, Kim Tong Son, member of the SPA Foreign Affairs Committee and vice-chairman of the C.C., General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea, and officials concerned were present. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of Korean Youth League in Japan Arrives
body: A delegation of the Korean Youth League in Japan led by Jong Hui Chol, vice-chairman of its Central Standing Committee, arrived in Pyongyang on Apr. 27. Rodong News Team

title: Chinese Delegation Visits Mangyongdae
body: A delegation of the China Association for International Friendly Contact led by Deputy Secretary-General Zhou Xinzheng visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. Being briefed on the revolutionary history of Kim Il Sung, the guests looked round the historical relics. The delegation also toured the Korean Revolution Museum, the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum, the Songhung Revolutionary Site, etc, and laid wreaths at the cemeteries of fallen soldiers of the Chinese People's Volunteers in Hoechang County, Anju City and Hyongjesan District. Rodong News Team

title: Imperishable Feats for Independence against Imperialism
body: President Kim Il Sung performed exploits to accomplish the global cause of independence under the uplifted banner of anti-imperialist struggle in the 20th century. The President provided eternal ideological and theoretical guidelines in the history of struggle for the human cause of independence and led the cause of global independence through revolutionary practices. By founding the Juche idea, he indicated the way for independently carving out the destiny of human being for the first time in history and ushered in a new era of the greatest change, the era of independence. By consistently embodying the Juche idea throughout the course of the revolutionary struggle, he created the worldwide model of struggle for national liberation in colonies and built a socialist fortress, independent in politics, self-supporting in the economy and self-reliant in national defence on this land. Under his outstanding leadership, a great turn was made in the struggle of progressive humankind to build a peaceful and prosperous, new world free from aggression and war. His history of external activities is the one shining with his endless devotion to the cause of global independence and noble internationalist obligation. After setting it as the avowed idea of foreign policy of the DPRK to promote independence, peace and friendship, he expanded and developed the relations of good-neighborliness, friendship and cooperation with various countries of the world which respect the sovereignty of the DPRK and which are friendly toward it. He also strengthened bonds and solidarity with the world progressive peoples aspiring after independence and justice. As there was the President, the 20th century could leave its clear footprints as the era of independence occupying the highest and the most brilliant position in the development of human history. Ri Hyo Jin

title: Socialism is Common Ideal of Mankind
body: The future of mankind is socialism. The popular masses have long desired an independent new society in which all of them live well on an equal footing free from exploitation, oppression, domination and subordination. Socialism makes it possible to realize such an ideal and capitalism tramples it down. Socialism provides genuine freedom and equality for all people. In the capitalist society complete equality cannot be provided as it is based on individualism and divided into hostile classes. Socialism is the just cause of realizing the requirements of the popular masses for independence and their ideal and it is the law of human history to advance toward socialism, which no one can hold in check. Transition from capitalism to socialism is a law-governed process of the development of human society. Socialism is an inevitable phase in the development of history and it is a rule, but it does not come true of itself. Socialism advances amid a fierce struggle against all hues of counter-revolutionary forces including the imperialists. No matter how desperately the imperialists work, they can not check the advance of mankind toward socialism. Ri Hak Nam

title: WPK's New Strategic Line Supported by Ecuadorian Bodies
body: The Ecuadorian Culture Institute for the Study of the Juche Idea, the Ecuadorian Committee for Supporting the Independent and Peaceful Reunification of Korea and the Guaranda Association for Friendship, Culture and Solidarity with the Korean People of Ecuador released a joint statement on April 24 in support of the decisions made at the 3rd Plenary Meeting of the 7th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. The statement said: Respected HE Kim Jong Un convened the 3rd Plenary Meeting of the 7th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea at a time when new changes for detente and peace were witnessed on the Korean peninsula and in the region thanks to the positive efforts of the DPRK. At the meeting he proudly declared the great victory of the WPK's line of simultaneously developing the two fronts and advanced a new strategic line of concentrating all efforts on socialist economic construction. The victory of the line of simultaneously developing the two fronts is a brilliant fruition of the heroic struggle of the Korean people who have turned out as one to defend the sovereignty of the country and the dignity of the nation under his wise leadership. The Korean people will successfully implement the new strategic line under the uplifted banner of the Juche idea as they are led by HE Kim Jong Un. The world will soon witness the victory of the new strategic line of the WPK. Rodong News Team

title: SPA Presidium of DPRK Decides to Reset Pyongyang Time
body: The Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK adopted a decree "On Resetting Pyongyang Time" on Monday. The decree reads: The Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK decides as follows to unify the times of the north and the south: Firstly, Pyongyang time shall be reset into GMT+09:00(30 minutes earlier than the present time) with the 135th degree of east longitude as prime meridian. Secondly, the reset Pyongyang time shall be applied from May 5, Juche 107 (2018). Thirdly, the Cabinet and relevant organs of the DPRK shall take practical steps to implement the decree. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Bags 19 Gold Medals at 2018 Asian Weightlifting Championships
body: DPRK weightlifters won 19 gold medals and 3 silver medals at the 2018 Asian Junior and Juvenile Weightlifting Championships in Uzbekistan. The championships started on April 20, bringing more than 240 men and women players from at least 22 countries and regions including the DPRK, India and Thailand. Ri Suk, Kim Il Gyong and Kim Kyong Ryong of the DPRK placed first in snatch, jerk and total of junior and juvenile women's 53kg, 58kg and 69 kg categories, each bagging six gold medals. Pak Jin Hae came first and second in juvenile and junior women's 48kg snatch, securing one gold medal and one silver medal, and Choe Kyong Sun took the second place in the snatch of junior and juvenile women's 63kg category, bagging two silver medals. Rodong News Team

title: Spring Amateur Riders Competition
body: A spring amateur riders competition took place at the Mirim Riding Club on April 22 and 29 under the sponsorship of the Korean Equestrian Association. Members of the association and amateur riders participated in the competition, which is divided into showjumping contest, low-horse amusement game, and amateur horse race. During the competition there was a lottery on the riders of the club. Rodong News Team

title: Product Exhibition and Processed Corn Show
body: The 8th Product Exhibition of Provincial General Foodstuff Factories and Processed Corn Show took place at the exhibition hall of mass consumption goods under the Ministry of Local Industry from April 26 to 29. Exhibited there were more than 2 500 foodstuffs and processed corn of 45 kinds presented by at least 90 provincial, city and county foodstuff factories. During the exhibition period, there were a visit to the Sonhung Foodstuff Factory and a lecture on technological matters arising in improving the quality of products, ensuring their safety and producing good foodstuffs. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to King of Netherlands
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, Friday sent a message of greeting to Willem Alexander, king of the Kingdom of Netherlands, on its national day. Kim in the message extended congratulations to the king and sincerely wished the people of the Kingdom of Netherlands prosperity and happiness. Rodong News Team

title: Japanese Reactionaries' Reckless Tongue-lashing
body: The Japanese reactionaries, who were driven to a serious political crisis and irritated by their plight of being pushed aside from the diplomatic current around the Korean peninsula, are going mischievous. The authorities of the island country including Abe and the ministers of Finance, Defense and Foreign Affairs are noisily talking about "complete, verifiable and irreversible dismantlement of the DPRK's nukes, WMDs and missiles." They cry out for "maintaining such stance as putting maximum pressure on the DPRK to make it abandon its nukes and missiles." During his recent junket to the U.S., Abe asked his American master to tighten sanctions to pressurize the DPRK, raising the nuclear issue and even the issue of "abduction." Such moves of the Japanese reactionaries only reveal their ill-intention to do harm to the DPRK by persisting in the racket of sanctions and pressure on it. Such awful behavior is just a hysteric fit caused by their plight of being left alone away from the current trend of the times. It is also a manifestation of their extreme uneasiness that their wild ambition for building a military giant and carrying out overseas expansion is going belly-up. Japan had better properly calculate what behavior is wise in the present changed world and behave prudently. It should bear in mind that its persistent mischievous acts will only build a higher barrier on the road to Pyongyang, isolated and rejected by the world. Ho Yong Min

title: World Progressives Should See through Absurdity of American-Style Democracy
body: The U.S. ruling quarters are using the American-style democracy as the means for their world domination strategy, advertising it is the democracy with universality to be applied in every country. The American-style democracy is the most reactionary and unpopular ruling system mercilessly trampling down the desire and demand of the popular masses for freedom and democracy and a tool of aggression and interference. The U.S. rulers, who have no face to talk about human rights, freedom and democracy, are eagerly talking about them in a bid to realize their ambition for hegemony by advertising the American-style democracy as "model" of the international community. The U.S. describes its stooges as "champion for democracy". Those against the West including the U.S. are branded as dictator and terrorist organization and become a target of the West's attack. This is the true picture of the cock-and-bull "defence of democracy" by the U.S. The U.S. works hard to encourage anti-government forces to harass the governments in those countries incurring its displeasure, claiming that they are oppressing "freedom". It does not hesitate to resort to armed intervention against those countries not yielding to its demand or incurring its displeasure. The reality clearly proves that the American-style democracy is unsuitable to other countries and each country should not follow other's model but choose its own political mode suitable to its specific environment and actual situation and advance along the road of independence. The world progressives should face up to the reactionary nature and danger of "democracy" trumpeted by the U.S. with vigilance. Ri Hyon Do

title: Chinese FM, State Councilor, to Visit DPRK
body: Wang Yi, state councilor and foreign minister of the People's Republic of China, will soon visit the Democratic People's Republic of Korea at the invitation of DPRK Foreign Minister Ri Yong Ho. Rodong News Team

title: U.S. Is World's Worst Human Rights Abuser
body: "Country Reports on Human Rights Practices for 2017" made public by the U.S. is a false document peppered with prejudice and fabrication. It is an illegal act in violation of the universally recognized principle of international law to say this or that about the human rights policies and human rights systems in other countries, an internal issue pertaining to the sovereignty of independent countries, and to admonish them to do this or that. By making public "human rights report" every year, the U.S. seeks to always maintain its hegemonic position in human rights issue, place other countries in the dock and prevent its own hideous human rights situation from being questioned. Its aim is to justify and legitimize interference in the internal affairs of other countries. The U.S. trick by which it finds fault with other countries is a suicidal act of putting itself in human rights dock. The U.S. is the world's matchless barren land of human rights and tundra of democracy. It is illogical for this country to trumpet about human rights. The U.S. is resorting to all kinds of sleight by putting up the signboard of "defence of human rights" but with nothing can the deceptive and aggressive nature of their racket of "human rights" be concealed. It is quite natural for the international community to demand that the U.S. should be taken to the dock of human rights court and called to task, while branding it as the kingpin of human rights abuses which has lost the qualifications to talk about human rights. The U.S. ill-famed as the world's worst human rights abuser should seriously repent of its human rights crimes, before admonishing other countries while going arrogant as to reel off "human rights" rhetoric. Ri Hyon Do

title: National Meeting Marks 128th May Day
body: A national meeting took place at the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex on Tuesday to mark the 128th May Day, international holiday of the working people in the world. Present there were workers of the complex, industrial establishments and institutions in Songrim City. Also present there were Premier Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea and vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission, O Su Yong and Choe Hwi, vice-chairmen of the Central Committee of the WPK, Kim Tok Hun, vice-premier, Im Hun, chairman of the North Hwanghae Provincial People's Committee, Pong Won Ik, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea, to congratulate the workers on their holiday. Pak Pong Ju made a report. Upon authorization by Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK who is the Supreme Leader of the party, the state and the army, the reporter congratulated all the working people across the country who devote patriotic enthusiasm and efforts for the victory of the Juche revolution and the prosperity of the country as well as the working masses in the south and all overseas compatriots. He also extended militant greetings and solidarity to the working people all over the world who are struggling for justice and peace against aggression and war. He said the workers of the DPRK left the traces of intense loyalty and heroic feats in the history of the struggle for the prosperity of the country and the victory of the cause of socialism under the leadership of the WPK, thanks to the warm loving care and trust shown by the peerlessly great men who put forward them as masters of the revolution and the times. He stressed that all industrial establishments should keep production going at full capacity and agricultural workers should reap a rich harvest in all agricultural fields and thus make the people's laughter resound far and wide across the country, true to the militant slogan "Let us further accelerate the advance of our revolution by concentrating all our efforts on socialist economic construction!" He underscored the need for all workers to hasten the building of a powerful socialist country and the final victory of the cause of Juche revolution by thoroughly implementing the decisions made at the third plenary meeting of the seventh WPK Central Committee, single-mindedly rallied close around the respected Supreme Leader. Rodong News Team

title: Director General of Iranian Foreign Ministry Arrives
body: Mahmoud Farazandeh, director general of the Department of East Asia and Oceania of the Iranian Foreign Ministry, arrived in Pyongyang on Tuesday. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Joint Working Group Delegation Returns from Russia
body: The DPRK delegation of joint working group led by Vice-Minister of External Economic Relations Ri Kwang Gun came back home Tuesday after taking part in the 8th meeting of the joint working group for the implementation of the DPRK-Russian intergovernmental agreement on temporary work held in Russia. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of Swedish Institute for Security and Development Policy Arrives
body: A delegation of the Swedish Institute for Security and Development Policy led by Director Niklas Swanstrom arrived in Pyongyang Tuesday. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of Korean Medical Persons in U.S. Arrives
body: A delegation of Korean medical persons in the U.S. led by Park Kee Bum arrived here Tuesday to take part in the 20th Pyongyang Symposium on Medical Science of Compatriots at Home and Abroad. Rodong News Team

title: Official Fun Run of 18th Asian Games Held
body: The Official Fun Run of the 18th Asian Games was held in Pyongyang. Its opening ceremony took place outside the Weightlifting Gymnasium in Chongchun Street on Tuesday. Present there were Vice-Minister of Physical Culture and Sports Won Kil U who is vice-chairman of the DPRK Olympic Committee, officials concerned, sportspersons and representatives of the Olympic Council of Asia, members of foreign embassies here and foreign guests. Speeches were made at the opening ceremony. Then there was a run. Sportspersons and embassy officials run 3 km course. At its closing ceremony, medals and certificates were awarded to the participants in the run. A press conference over the fun run was held outside the Weightlifting Gymnasium on the same day. The secretary general of the DPRK Olympic Committee at the conference noted that the DPRK Olympic Committee would further develop the physical culture and sports in the Olympic idea and the noble sports spirit, and thus fulfill their responsibilities and role in turning our country into the world-level sports powerhouse. A member of the Olympic Council of Asia, referring to the official fun run held in Pyongyang, expressed thanks to the DPRK Olympic Committee which made great efforts for the successful holding of the fun run. Rodong News Team

title: Party and Government Officials Celebrate May Day with Workers
body: Senior party and government officials of the DPRK celebrated the May Day with working people across the country on Tuesday. They went to institutions, industrial establishments, construction sites and farms to congratulate workers, agricultural workers and intellectuals greeting the holiday. Among those officials were Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, party and government senior officials Pak Kwang Ho, Kim Phyong Hae and Thae Jong Su and vice-premiers, and officials of the party and power organs. They placed floral baskets and bouquets before the statues of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il and portraits depicting their smiling images and mosaics depicting their images, and paid tribute to them. They went round the revolutionary museums showing the hard efforts and leadership exploits of the peerlessly great men built at those units and the rooms dedicated to their history. The senior party and government officials met innovators and gave pep-talk to them. They joined the working people doing colorful sports and entertainment games including tug-of-war and enjoyed art performances. They called for remaining loyal to the guidance of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and strikingly displaying the heroic stamina and mettle of the workers of Juche Korea in the present grand revolutionary march. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Meets FM of China
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Thursday met Wang Yi, state councilor and foreign minister of the People's Republic of China who is on a visit to the DPRK. Present at the meeting were Chinese Vice-Minister of Foreign Affairs Kong Xuanyou and Chinese Ambassador to the DPRK Li Jinjun. Kim Jong Un, the respected Supreme Leader of the party, state and army of the DPRK, was so pleased to see Wang Yi again in more than one month and exchanged warm greetings with him. Then, he had a talk with Wang Yi. Wang Yi courteously conveyed to Kim Jong Un warm greetings from Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and president of the People's Republic of China. The Supreme Leader expressed thanks for it and requested Wang Yi to convey warm greetings from him and the party, government and people of the DPRK to respected Xi Jinping and the fraternal Chinese people. At the meeting there were wide-ranging and in-depth exchanges of opinions on the matter of comprehensively carrying forward and developing in depth the unity and traditional friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries and the issues of mutual concern including the direction and prospect of the development of the situation on the Korean peninsula. The talk proceeded in a comradely and amicable atmosphere. Kim Jong Un expressed great satisfaction over the excellent talk with Wang Yi which reconfirmed the views of the DPRK and China on important issues and exchanged opinions on them. He warmly embraced Wang Yi and exchanged good-byes with him. Political News Team

title: Home-visiting Group of Koreans in Japan Leaves
body: The home-visiting group of Koreans in Japan led by Jong Hyon left Pyongyang on Thursday. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Ambassador to Syria Appointed
body: Mun Jong Nam was appointed as DPRK ambassador to the Syrian Arab Republic, according to a decree of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly. Rodong News Team

title: Noble Traits of Korean Working People Loving Their Jobs
body: Excellent is the spiritual world of the Korean people devoting their sweats of patriotism to the struggle for building a powerful socialist country with immense love for their jobs. Today the Korean people value their own worksites and the work they do and creditably fulfill their revolutionary tasks by displaying tremendous responsibility and devotion. It is the work style and the traits of labor for our working people to try to do more work and to find arduous work by themselves. The ardent love for their jobs displayed by the Korean people and their love for labor have something to do with the reality in the society where every job is considered to be noble and becomes worthwhile. Any job in our society is considered to be honorable work for the country and the people. Today our party members and other working people love their jobs and work with devotion at their posts. This is the demonstration of the noble thought and spirit to live up to the conscience and obligation as citizens of the Republic. All the jobs in our society are worthwhile work for glorifying their life to be most worthwhile. There are manifold difficulties and trials but the army and people are working with redoubled efforts with the view on the revolution, patriotism and the future that one year of hardship would advance the country a decade more. The Korean people creating the Mallima speed through the general revolutionary offensive under the far-reaching plan of the party are full of the ardent desire to make Kim Il Sung's nation, Kim Jong Il's Korea to be the one looked up by the whole world. Jang Im Hyang

title: Hazardous Acts Harassing Peace
body: The Japanese chief executive made offering to Yasukuni Shrine and Japanese dietmen numbering 150 paid a group visit to it on the occasion of the spring ancestral rite day. The chief executive during his presence at the meeting of a local organization of the Liberal Democratic Party called for mutual cooperation for the retrogressive revision of the constitution, pledging to "specify the existence of the Self-Defense Forces in the constitution and put an end to the controversy over the constitution". This proves that the Abe group is keen on realizing militarism and the ambition for overseas expansion. The Japanese politicians' visit to the shrine is not just an issue pertaining to the internal issue of Japan, but it is an issue related to Japan's viewpoint of aggression and colonial domination committed by it against Asian countries in the past. The group visit and tribute paid to the shrine by the Japanese dietmen are a total denial of Japan's past crimes and it constitutes an insult and mockery of Asian countries. Japan has now almost taken up its appearance as a militarist state. Only stumbling block lying in the way is the present constitution. The Japanese chief executive tries to rewrite the present constitution at any cost and specify the existence of the "Self-Defense Forces" as attack forces there and thus remove the legal stumbling block lying in its way of launching reinvasion. Japan's dream is to turn the country into the one capable of fighting a war and thus realize the old dream of the "Greater East Asia Co-prosperity Sphere". The scope of military operation of the Japan "Self-Defense Forces" has been expanded to even the Indian Ocean, to say nothing of the Pacific. Japan is now seeking to launch reinvasion with the backing of the U.S. This is a reckless act of digging its own grave. Pak Ye Gyong

title: Unity Based on Independence Guarantees Victory of Cause of Independence
body: The unity of the independent forces against the imperialists provides a sure guarantee for accomplishing the human cause of independence. The popular masses' struggle for realizing the desire for independence is an arduous struggle against the imperialists and all sorts of reactionaries putting a brake on it. The confrontation between the independent forces and the hegemonic forces inevitably accompanies the confrontation of strength. The tremendous might pushing forward the struggle for independence against the imperialists lies in the unity of the independent forces. Unity provides a fundamental way of strengthening the driving force for accomplishing the cause of global independence. The respect for sovereignty is a fundamental principle to be maintained by the progressive people of all countries in their struggle against the imperialists. Independence is the lifeline of a country and nation and also the lifeline of humankind. The imperialists are dregs of history who have outlived their days but they are reluctant to come down from the stage of history of their own accord. Today the imperialist reactionaries leave no stone unturned to stamp out the forces for independence against imperialism in collusion. They are trying desperately to divide and disintegrate the forces for independence against imperialism including the non-aligned movement and establish their order of domination. This has seriously violated and encroached upon the sovereignty of countries and nations and harassed the world peace and security. The situation urgently demands that all the countries advocating independence strengthen unity and solidarity and strenuously wage the struggle against the imperialists by their concerted efforts. Ri Hyo Jin

title: Decisions of WPK Backed by Romanian Party
body: The National Socialist Party of Romania made public a statement on April 26 in support of the decisions adopted at the Third Plenary Meeting of the Seventh Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). The statement said: We congratulate Comrade Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, upon having declared a great victory of the line on simultaneously developing the two fronts at the Third Plenary Meeting of the Seventh Central Committee of the WPK. This miraculous victory is a brilliant success which can be achieved only by the heroic Korean people under the leadership of the WPK. Comrade Kim Jong Un clarified that at the present stage in which the DPRK was successfully put on the position of the world-level politico-ideological and military power, it is the strategic line of the WPK to concentrate all efforts of the whole party and country on socialist economic construction. Just is the fresh strategic line set forth by him. We fully support the decisions of the plenary meeting. We firmly believe that the Korean people would make only miracle in building socialism. We strongly demand the U.S. withdraw its forces from south Korea at once and stop sanctions on the DPRK. Rodong News Team

title: Korean Books Donated to South Africa
body: Korean book-donating ceremonies took place in South Africa on April 19 and 20. Conveyed at the ceremonies were works of President Kim Il Sung, leader Kim Jong Il and the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and books introducing achievements gained by the Korean army and people in building a powerful socialist country. The chairman of the Group for the Study of the Progressive Ideas of South Africa said that works of Kim Il Sung, Kim Jong Il and Kim Jong Un and books introducing the DPRK serve as very precious wealth as they greatly help study and disseminate the Juche idea. The chairman of the Mfumalanga Provincial Group for the Study of the Juche Idea of South Africa noted that he would deeply study the donated books in order to more broadly disseminate among the south African people the DPRK in which the Juche idea has been embodied. Rodong News Team

title: Kimilsungia-Kimjongilia Exhibitions Held in China and Guinea
body: The Kimilsungia-Kimjongilia exhibitions were held in China and Guinea in the period between April 6 and 16 on the occasion of the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Displayed at their venues presenting spectacular scenery with flowers of the sun were works of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il and books and photos introducing the true picture of the DPRK. Present there were personages of various circles and masses of the relevant countries. Meanwhile, the visit to the venue of the Kimilsungia-Kimjongilia exhibition took place in Dalian, China in the period between April 12 and 23. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Yong Nam Meets Delegation of Ecumenical Organizations
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, met and had a talk with the delegation of ecumenical organizations comprising representatives of the World Council of Churches and the World Communion of Reformed Churches led by Olav Fykse Tveit that paid a courtesy call on him at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Friday. Rodong News Team

title: Director General of Iranian Foreign Ministry Leaves
body: Mahmoud Farazandeh, director general of the Department of East Asia and Oceania of the Iranian Foreign Ministry, left Pyongyang for home on Friday. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korean Organizations Erect Statue of Forcible Laborer outside Japan Consulate General in Pusan
body: The Pusan Headquarters of the Movement for Uprooting Deep-seated Evils and Realizing Great Social Reforms and other civic and public organizations in south Korea erected a statue of a worker portraying a forcible laborer who had been forced into hard work after being taken to Japan during the Japanese imperialists' colonial rule in the vicinity of the Japanese Consulate General in Pusan, according to the south Korean KBS. The organizations tried to erect the statue alongside the statue of a sexual slave girl outside the Consulate General on April 30 only to be resisted by police suppression. There was a clash with hundreds of police as a result of which more than 10 persons were wounded. The members of the organization denounced the south Korean Foreign Ministry and the Pusan City authorities for rejecting the erection of the statue of the forcible laborer outside the Consulate General, being worried about diplomatic conflict with Japan. Rodong News Team

title: May Day Commemorated by Labor Movement Organizations in S. Korea
body: Commemorative events were held in Seoul on May 1 by labor movement organizations on the occasion of the May Day, according to the south Korean KBS. A rally was held at Seoul Square with the attendance of more than 10 000 members of the south Korean Confederation of Trade Unions. The speakers stressed the need to fight it out for the revision of the labor law, abolition of part-time jobs, conglomerate reform and the abolition of other labor evils and for the provision of the right to labor. They urged to stop the structuring which deprives workers of their jobs and to turn part-time jobs into full-time jobs and immediately raise the lowest wage. The organization waged a demonstration along the downtown after the rally. It called for providing workers with good jobs and building society where labor is respected. Rodong News Team

title: Korean Book, Photo, Fine Art Exhibitions Held Abroad
body: There took place Korean book, photo and fine art exhibitions in Russia, South Africa and Venezuela to observe the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. On display at the venues of the events were photos showing the exploits of President Kim Il Sung, leader Kim Jong Il and the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Also displayed were works of the peerlessly great men, books and photos introducing Juche Korea making a leap forward on a daily basis, and the fine art pieces showing creativity of the Korean people. Personages and masses in those countries went round the exhibitions. The chairman of the Russian Association for Friendship and Cultural Cooperation with the DPRK said that he was deeply moved to see the Korean people remaining true to the leadership of Kim Jong Un during his several visits to the DPRK. The Russia-DPRK friendly relationship is very precious and the Russian people will always support the struggle of the Korean people, he noted. The secretary of the Mfumalanga Provincial Committee of the South African Communist Party said that under the wise guidance of Kim Jong Un the DPRK is demonstrating its might as an invincible socialist fortress, resolutely foiling the hideous sanctions by the U.S. to stifle it. The director for foreign affairs of the Ministry of Culture of Venezuela said that he was pleased to see the Korean exhibition open, adding it would help Venezuelan people know better about the DPRK which is dashing toward the future always with pride and confidence. Rodong News Team

title: Chinese FM Leaves
body: Wang Yi, state councilor and foreign minister of the People's Republic of China, and his party, flew back home on Thursday after winding up their visit to the DPRK. Rodong News Team

title: Chinese Foreign Minister Visits Tower of Juche Idea
body: Wang Yi, state councilor and foreign minister of the People's Republic of China, and his party, visited the Tower of the Juche Idea on Thursday. Accompanying them were Ri Kil Song, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, and Li Jinjun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK. The guests looked round the body of the tower and group of sculptures, being briefed on the revolutionary exploits of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il. They went up to the tower observation platform to have a bird's eye view of Pyongyang. The Chinese foreign minister wrote in the visitor's book that "Advance of Korea is led centering on the people". He and his party toured the Ryuwon Footwear Factory and the Okryu Children's Hospital on the same day. Rodong News Team

title: Seminar of Social Scientists Held
body: A seminar of social scientists for deeply grasping and embodying the basic spirit of the Third Plenary Meeting of the 7th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea was held at the Grand People's Study House on Thursday. Presented to the seminar were papers explaining and proving the exploits of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un who brought about the great victory of the line of simultaneously developing the two fronts and is opening up an epochal turn for the prosperity of the country and the issues arising in attaining the higher goals for socialist construction set forth at the plenary meeting. The speakers explained that the Supreme Leader clarified the line on simultaneous development of economic construction and the building of nuclear force at the March 2013 Plenary Meeting of the Party Central Committee and led the army and people of the whole country in their struggle with his patriotic devotion and efforts and energetic leadership day and night. The main idea of the new strategic line set forth by the Third plenary meeting of the Seventh C.C., WPK is to prioritize the economic affairs in the overall work of the party and the state, tap all human, material and technical potentials for the economic development and thus build robust socialist economy and drastically improve the standard of the people's living, they said. Making a fresh drastic turn in the scientific work, as required by the times and the developing revolution, is the shortcut to paving a broad avenue to economic construction and a substantial guarantee for ceaselessly promoting self-reliance, they stressed, and went on: To bring about a great revolution in education is a sure guarantee for realizing the party's plan on building a talent power. They pledged to discharge the responsibility and duty in accelerating the grand advance of economic construction and hastening the building of a scientific and technological power and an education power in the spirit of self-reliance true to the new strategic line set forth at the Third Plenary Meeting of the 7th Central Committee of the WPK under the leadership of Kim Jong Un. Present there were teachers, researchers, lecturers, journalists, editors and officials in the fields of science, education, preservation of revolutionary relics, media, preservation of national heritage and party cadre training institutions including Ri Hye Jong, president of the Academy of Social Sciences. Rodong News Team

title: Korean Players Return Home
body: Korean players came back home on Thursday after taking part in the 2018 Asian Juvenile and Youth Weightlifting Championships. Rodong News Team

title: April, 2018 Issue of Magazine Thongil Issued
body: The International United Confederation of Koreans (International Kothongryon) issued the April, 2018 issue of Thongil, monthly socio-political magazine. Carrying the photo of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un entering the Great Hall of the People, venue for welcome ceremony, together with Xi Jinping, the magazine reported the news of his visit to China. It dealt with the news about the visit carried by TASS and Ria-Novosti. The magazine reported about the news of Kim Jong Un receiving the delegation of special envoy of the south Korean president and the chairman of the IOC on a visit to Pyongyang. It also carried work of President Kim Il Sung "On the Three Principles of National Reunification". The news of the 20th Kimilsungia Festival and the First Pyongyang International Vocal Competition which were held with splendor on the occasion of the Day of the Sun is also carried by the magazine. The magazine also carried an article denouncing the south Korean conservative forces for going against the trend of the times for the improvement of the north-south ties and documents rejecting the "resolution" on human rights on the DPRK fabricated by the U.S., Japan and hostile forces at the 37th meeting of the UN Human Rights Council. Rodong News Team

title: Delegations of Overseas Koreans Leave
body: A delegation of the Korean Health Workers Association in Japan headed by Chairman Kang Gyong Bu, a delegation of Hyogo officials of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) led by Kim Chun Gwon, chairman of the Hyogo Prefectural Headquarters of Chongryon, and a delegation of Korean medical persons in the U.S. led by Park Kee Bum left Pyongyang on Saturday. title: Editorial
body: Let Us Step Up Grand Advance of Economic Construction All the people of the DPRK turned out to brilliantly realize the plan and decision of the Workers' Party of Korea by channeling all efforts into the socialist economic construction with a firm hold on its new strategic line. "Let us further accelerate the advance of our revolution by concentrating all our efforts on socialist economic construction!" -- this is a militant slogan to be held high by the Korean people. The new strategic line on channeling all efforts into the economic construction is a revolutionary line reflecting the brilliant wisdom and the strategic decision of our Party which is wisely guiding the revolution and construction with firm confidence in the victory of the socialist cause. Our Party set forth the grand goal of building a socialist state, independent and prosperous, in the whole course of the revolutionary leadership and has waged a strenuous struggle for achieving it. It is the fixed will of our Party to speed up the advance of the revolution, pave a wide avenue to prosperity and provide the people with an affluent and highly civilized life with no more to desire in the world. Reflected in the grand advance of the economic construction are the urgent requirements of our revolution and the desire of our people and also the law-governing requirements of the socialist construction. When our Party's grandiose plan is realized, our Republic would further prosper and the whole country will overflow with happiness of people and the song "We Are the Happiest in the World" will resound forth.

title: WPK's Decisions Backed Abroad
body: Personages of various countries issued statements in support of the decisions of the Third Plenary Meeting of the Seventh Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Abdoulaye Diallo, secretary general of the Guinean National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism and chairman of the Guinean Society for the Study of the Juche Literary Idea, in a statement on April 25, said: The respected Supreme Leader HE Kim Jong Un proudly declared the great victory of the line of simultaneously promoting the two fronts and set forth a new strategic line of the Party at the said plenary meeting. Today a fresh stream towards detente and peace has been created on the Korean peninsula and dramatic changes are occurring in the political structure of the world. This is attributable to the wise guidance of respected HE Kim Jong Un. Manju Ratna Sakya, chairman of the Nepal Journalist Association and chairman of the Nepal Journalist Association for the Study of the Juche Idea and Songun Politics, said in a statement on April 26: I laud the DPRK for firmly protecting its sovereignty and dignity. I came to know well through the reality of the DPRK that not a big country can become a power when it builds up its own strength and bolsters national power. Shunichi Narita, a media person of Japan, extended full support to the decisions of the 3rd Plenary Meeting of the 7th WPK Central Committee, stressing that Kim Jong Un is a gifted strategist and diplomat. Rodong News Team

title: 20th Pyongyang Symposium on Medical Science Held
body: The 20th Pyongyang Symposium on Medical Science of Compatriots at Home and Abroad took place at the People's Palace of Culture on May 3 and 4. Attending it were officials in the public health including the Central Committee of the Medical Association of Korea, scientists and teachers and members of the delegation of the medical association of Koreans in Japan headed by Chairman Kang Kyong Bu and the delegation of Korean medical persons in the U.S. led by Park Kee Bum. Kim Hyong Hun, chairman of the Central Committee of the Medical Association of Korea, made an opening address to be followed by speeches. Speakers said that the symposium would serve as a significant occasion of putting medical science and technology of the Korean nation onto the world's advanced level and developing cooperation and exchange. They expressed the will to keep to the patriotic road in the future, too. Then there took place a lecture titled "The idea of thoroughly implementing the Party's policy of prophylactic medicine set forth by the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and its brilliant vitality." The meeting heard papers on the achievements and experience in the development of the national medical science and technology and public health service and on the theoretical and practical problems. Rodong News Team

title: 33rd National Festival of Science and Technology Closes
body: The 33rd National Festival of Science and Technology closed with due ceremony at the Three-Revolution Exhibition House on Friday. During the festival there was an exchange of valuable successes and experience gained by scientists, technicians and officials from across the country, conducive to quickly putting the national economy on a Juche, modern and IT basis and developing the technical engineering of various sectors including IT, nano-technology and bioengineering. Present at the closing ceremony were Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, Kim Sung Du, chairman of the Education Commission, Jang Chol, president of the State Academy of Sciences, and officials concerned. The results of examination were announced at the ceremony. The special place of the festival was taken by the Ultra-modern Sci-tech Exchange Company of Kim Il Sung University, the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex and four other units and the first place by more than 80 units. Rodong News Team

title: 10th Meeting of DPRK-Syria Joint Economic Committee Held
body: The 10th meeting of the DPRK-Syria Joint Economic Committee took place in Pyongyang from May 2 to 4. Attending the meeting were Kim Yong Jae, minister of External Economic Relations, and officials concerned, and members of the Syrian government economic delegation led by Mamoun Hamdan, minister of Finance. The meeting reviewed the implementation of the protocol signed at the 9th meeting of the DPRK-Syria Joint Economic Committee and discussed ways for expanding economic, scientific and technological cooperation. Concluded at the meeting were letters of understanding on cooperation in several fields and execution plans. A protocol of the 10th meeting of the DPRK-Syria Joint Economic Committee was signed there. Rodong News Team

title: Birth Anniversary of Kim Il Sung Celebrated in Nordic Countries
body: A joint meeting of Nordic progressive political parties and friendship bodies took place in Sweden on April 14 to celebrate the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. On display at the center of its venue was an art work depicting the President standing together with leader Kim Jong Il. There were photos showing the revolutionary careers and exploits of the great leaders. Also displayed were books and photos introducing the reality of Juche Korea rapidly developing under the guidance of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. The participants of the event laid bouquets and flowers before the art work and paid tribute to it. Christer Lundgren, chairman of the Sweden-Korea Friendship Association, and Anders Kristensen, chairman of the Denmark-DPRK Friendship Association, and other personages made speeches. The speakers praised the exploits of the President who dedicated his all to Korea's liberation and prosperity. A message of greeting to Kim Jong Un was adopted at the meeting. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of Ecumenical Organizations Leaves
body: The delegation of ecumenical organizations comprising representatives of the World Council of Churches and the World Communion of Reformed Churches led by Olav Fykse Tveit left Pyongyang on Monday. During the visit, the members of the delegation visited Mangyongdae, the Tower of the Juche Idea, Pyongyang Baby Home, Pyongyang Orphanage, Ryugyong General Ophthalmic Hospital, etc. Rodong News Team

title: Representative of LKP Condemned for Reckless Remarks
body: The floor leader of the Minju Party of south Korea reportedly condemned Hong Jun Phyo, representative of the "Liberal Korea Party", the conservative opposition party, for slandering the historic Panmunjom Declaration on April 3. He said that Hong Jun Phyo kicked off a coloring offensive while slandering the south-north summit. Even the candidates of the LKP for elections to the local self-governing bodies expressed their dissatisfaction to the leadership of the party including Hong and turned their back to it. He said that the LKP-mouthed "security" in all elections is going against the will of the people, adding that the LKP should know this will not work on any more. Rodong News Team

title: Confrontational Maniacs Should Be Thrown into Dustbin
body: The group of the "Liberal Korea Party" including Hong Jun Phyo is making desperate efforts to mar the atmosphere of improving the inter-Korean ties. The disgraceful behavior of the Hong Jun Phyo group to revile the Panmunjom summit meeting and Panmunjom declaration is hysterics of the traitors to the nation against the reunification keen on the confrontation and an anachronistic reckless act of the traitors like a living corpse. All the Koreans in the north, the south and abroad and a lot of countries and even hostile ones are positively supporting the recent summit provided by the warm patriotism and infinite generosity of the peerlessly great man. South Koreans from all walks of life are unanimously appealing to all to positively cooperate in the implementation of the Panmunjom declaration, praising the historic summit meeting as a great turning point for peace on the Korean Peninsula and the development of the inter-Korean ties. This being a hard reality, the group of the "Liberal Korea Party" including Hong Jun Phyo is hurling a heap of abuses, which is hysterics, regarding the success in the summit meeting as a thorn in their flesh. This clearly shows once again that those are the extremely vicious group of traitors opposing the reunification who exist only through the confrontation with fellow countrymen, indifferent to the desire and requirement of the nation. So long as there is such a party that has inveterate repugnancy towards the fellow countrymen in the north and is keen on prolonging its remaining days through the confrontation with fellow countrymen, it is not possible to improve the inter-Korean relations nor will it be possible to realize the national reconciliation and unity, and peace and prosperity. Ri Song Ho

title: National Independence Is Fundamental Principle of National Reunification
body: To maintain the principle of national independence is the basic way of reunifying the country independently, as intended and desired by all Koreans. To preserve the principle of national independence is vital to the destiny of the Korean nation and the prospect of the inter-Korean relations. National reunification is, in essence, the cause of reconnecting the blood vessel of the Korean nation which was severed into the north and the south by the outsiders and the one of achieving the sovereignty throughout the nation. The issue of national reunification can never be settled if one depends on outsiders, the chief architect of the Korean division and disturber of the reunification. If the north and the south reject the outsiders and pool their efforts, they can smoothly settle all issues as intended and demanded by all Koreans and in their common interests. There will be no difficulties and obstacles insurmountable if the north and the south hold their hands with each other on the principle of national independence. The Panmunjom declaration has the idea of By Our Nation Itself and the principle of national independence as its core. There will be nothing to achieve if one asks the outsiders to help settle the issue of the north-south ties. It will only offer the outsiders seeking sinister purposes an excuse of interference. Now all Koreans call for achieving peace, prosperity and reunification under the uplifted banner of national independence, rejecting sycophancy toward big powers and dependence on outsiders. No trial and difficulties can ever check the struggle of all Koreans to build a prosperous reunified power admired by the world in Korea under the unfurled banner of national independence. Sim Chol Yong

title: Indian Political Party Welcomes North-South Summit of Korea
body: The 23rd Congress of the Communist Party of India adopted a decision on April 28 as regards the historic north-south summit. The decision sincerely welcomed the north-south summit of Korea, noting that the summit serves as a new starting point for durable peace on the Korean peninsula. It said "Panmunjom Declaration on Peace, Prosperity and Reunification of Korean Peninsula" signed by the top leaders of the north and the south clarifies that the north and the south would make joint efforts to substantially defuse the danger of a war on the Korean peninsula. It noted that the Panmunjom Declaration is greatly supported by the progressive people in the world as it reflected the desire of the whole Korean nation. The 23rd Congress of the Communist Party of India extends a salute to the Workers' Party of Korea, it added. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Missions Mark Day of Sun
body: There took place seminars, remembrance meetings, book and photo exhibitions, receptions and film shows to mark the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, the Day of the Sun, at DPRK missions abroad. The events were held at the DPRK missions in China, Cuba, Mongolia, Laos, Vietnam, Nepal, Malaysia, Myanmar, Bangladesh, Singapore, Cambodia, Pakistan, Iran, India, Guinea, Nigeria, DR Congo, Senegal, Equatorial Guinea, Algeria, Angola, Uganda, Ethiopia, Egypt, Mexico, Brazil, Venezuela, Germany, Romania, Bulgaria, Switzerland, the Czech Republic, Austria, Italy, Belarus and Spain and the DPRK permanent mission at the UN Office and international organizations in Geneva and the DPRK permanent mission at the UN. Such Korean films as "Kimilsungia, Flower of the Sun" and "Song of Sun Will Be Everlasting" were shown at the film shows. Present at the events on invitation were personages of governments, political parties, organizations and organs and masses in the relevant countries and representatives of international and regional bodies. Rodong News Team

title: Japan Should Correct Its Ill Practices
body: Japan is resorting to a sleight of hand to cross the doorsill to Pyongyang even by flattering the American master, neighboring big powers and even the south Korean authorities but it will never step on the sacred land of the Republic unless it drops its inveterate repugnancy and bad habit. Half-witted Japanese politicians are now calculating to find a way-out in the DPRK-Japan relations. What matters is if they are truly willing to improve the relations with sincerity. But its behavior now shows that it is not ready to join the trend of the times, finding fault with this or that. Now Japan is going crafty to cross the river by clinging to the horse tail, while waiting for the result of the DPRK-U.S. dialogue, but it may cut off nose to spite its own face. What it has to remember is that it can never evade the fate of left-out person if it behaves disgusting while repeating the old cliche of "sanctions" and "pressure" as now. But who will hold the thorny hand. An old Korean adage goes that give one more cake to a child whom you don't like, but it does not fit for Japan. It has to know that doorsill is higher than mountain. Japan has to correct its ill practices before making preparations for journey. Jo Nam Jin

title: Mexican Politician Hails North-South Summit
body: Jesus Antonio Carlos Hernandez, general secretary of the C.C., the People's Socialist Party of Mexico, made public a statement on April 29 in congratulation of the historic north-south summit meeting. The statement said that all the members of the People's Socialist Party of Mexico are sincerely pleased with the successful north-south summit held by the pro-active efforts of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, an outstanding politician and great master of diplomacy, extending warm congratulations to him. It noted that Kim Jong Un said in his New Year Address for this year that now is the time for the north and the south to sit face to face and candidly discuss the issues of improving inter-Korean relations by Our Nation Itself and bravely find out a way. His words served as a spark of fire and have burst into flames of north-south summit today and in this way a series of measures for peace of the Korean peninsula were taken one after another stunning the world, it said, adding: The world is witnessing a new era where not only the reunification of the Korean peninsula but also the peace of humankind are coming true. The People's Socialist Party of Mexico extends full support and solidarity to the just cause of the Workers' Party of Korea and the Korean people for achieving peace and reunification on the Korean peninsula. Rodong News Team

title: WPK's Decisions Supported by Hungarian Political Party
body: The Hungarian Workers' Party issued a statement in support of the decisions of the Third Plenary Meeting of the Seventh Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea on April 25. The statement said the said plenary meeting declared the great victory of the line of simultaneously promoting the two fronts and adopted crucial decisions to ensure the victorious advance of socialist construction under the prevailing situation and that these decisions proved the peace-loving stand of the WPK. It went on: The plenary meeting set forth a new strategic line of concentrating all efforts on socialist economic construction, which is the historical line ensuring that the people of the DPRK further accelerate socialist construction under the leadership of the WPK. The statement extended firm support to the Korean people's struggle for implementing the new strategic line. Rodong News Team

title: International Day of Midwife Marked
body: An event took place at the Taedonggang Diplomatic Club on Tuesday to mark the International Day of the Midwife 2018. Present there were officials in the field of public health, those of ministries and national institutions and media, members of missions of international organizations here including the acting UN resident coordinator and concurrently representative of the WFP and the representative of the United Nations Population Fund and staff members of foreign embassies here. Speakers said that the International Midwives Federation proposed "Midwife leading the way with quality care" as the theme of this year and are conducting diverse activities to enhance the responsibility and role of the midwives. They stressed the need to positively increase the ranks of midwives in different countries and provide the pregnant women and nursing mothers with the high-quality healthcare of the able midwives in the period of pregnancy and parturition and after childbirth. The participants enjoyed an art performance given by officials in the field of public health and looked round the photos showing the Korean women leading a happy life. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Sends Letter of Thanks to Xi Jinping
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a letter of thanks to Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and president of the People's Republic of China, on his way home after successfully winding up his visit to China on Tuesday. He in the message extended heartfelt thanks to Xi Jinping who warmly greeted and gave sincere hospitality to his party, leaving for home after successfully winding up the visit to China, a close neighbor. He also expressed deep thanks to senior officials of the Chinese party and government and senior officials and people in Liaoning Province and Dalian City. The message noted that the significant meeting between Kim Jong Un and Xi Jinping, in the significant historic period when the DPRK-China friendship which has been carried forward through centuries and generations is developing as required by the new era, served as an important motive force in further promoting the special and close relations, friendship and comradely trust between them and strengthening the support and cooperation for the cause of socialism in the DPRK and China and more viably advancing the DPRK-China friendship. It said that the meeting and talks would actively contribute to ensuring the closer strategic cooperation between the two countries and establishing durable and solid peace and stability in the Korean peninsula. Expressing the conviction that the DPRK-China friendship, common wealth of the two peoples, would as ever steadily develop thanks to the joint efforts of the two parties, countries and peoples, Kim Jong Un in the message wished Xi Jinping good health.

title: Kim Jong Un Meets Xi Jinping Again
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, visited Dalian City of China from May 7 to 8 to meet again Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC) and president of the People's Republic of China. The meaningful meeting and talks between the supreme leaders of the two countries took place in Dalian City, Liaoning Province, China. Kim Jong Un left Pyongyang by plane for his personal use on the morning of May 7. He was accompanied by Ri Su Yong and Kim Yong Chol, members of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK and vice-chairmen of the C.C., WPK, Ri Yong Ho, member of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK and foreign minister, Kim Yo Jong, alternate member of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK and first vice department director of the C.C., WPK, Choe Son Hui, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs; and members of the C.C., WPK and the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK. Wang Huning, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the C.C., CPC and member of the Secretariat of the C.C., CPC, Wang Yi, state councilor and foreign minister, Song Tao, head of the International Liaison Department of the C.C., CPC, Chen Qiufa, secretary of the Liaoning Provincial Committee of the CPC, and Tan Zuojun, secretary of the Dalian City Committee of the CPC, were present at Dalian International Airport to greet him. At noon of local time the plane landed at the airport. Kim Jong Un alighted from the plane to shake hands with pleasure with those officials and exchanged kind greetings. A woman presented a bunch of flowers to him and offered him greetings. He expressed thanks and got on his car to head for Bangchuidao Guesthouse. When he arrived at the guesthouse, its employees warmly greeted him. There took place a meeting and talks between Kim Jong Un and Xi Jinping in the afternoon. Xi Jinping came to Dalian and kindly greeted Kim Jong Un. Kim Jong Un had a warm and emotional meeting with Xi Jinping and had a souvenir photo taken with him.
