The top leaders of the two countries exchanged warm salute, pleased to meet again after the lapse of over one month. Then there took place talks between Kim Jong Un and Xi Jinping. Present at the talks from the DPRK side were Ri Su Yong and Kim Yong Chol, members of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and vice-chairmen of the C.C., WPK, and Ri Yong Ho, member of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK and foreign minister. Present from the Chinese side were Wang Huning, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and member of the CPC Central Committee Secretariat, Ding Xuexiang, member of the Political Bureau of the C.C., CPC, member of the Secretariat of the C.C., CPC and director of the General Office of the C.C., CPC, Yang Jiechi, member of the Political Bureau of the C.C., CPC and director of the Office of the Foreign Affairs Commission of the C.C., CPC, Wang Yi, state councilor and foreign minister, and Song Tao, head of the International Liaison Department of the C.C., CPC. At the talks the two sides informed each other of the assessment and views on the recent trend and the development of the situation on the Korean peninsula on which global highlights are focused, and of the political and economic conditions of each country and stressed the need to more wonderfully promote the DPRK-China friendly and cooperative relations. And they had an in-depth exchange of views on the way to tackle the crucial issues of mutual concern. Kim Jong Un expressed his thanks to Xi Jinping for sparing time to come to Dalian and warmly greet him and providing the best convenience with utmost sincerity despite his tight political schedule. He said he was very pleased that the DPRK-China relations have recently greeted a fresh heyday and are undergoing further development. He, in particular, highly appreciated that the close high-level visits between the two parties and the two countries and the strategic communication between the supreme leaderships of the DPRK and China are underway on an unprecedented level. In those days the DPRK and China have become all the more close and inseparable in their inner feelings, he said, hoping to expand the friendly visits between the two countries and keep the close contacts in a flexible and diverse manner in the future, too. He analyzed and estimated the development of the situation around the Korean peninsula undergoing profound changes and mentioned the ways to more actively and closely boost the tactical cooperation between the DPRK and China by using the strategic opportunity. He expressed gratitude to the Chinese comrades, saying that their firm support and encouragement and comradely cooperation greatly encourage the party and people of the DPRK. Xi Jinping said that Kim Jong Un's visit showed the sincere willingness to set much store by the relations between the two parties and the two countries, trust him and the Chinese party and put into practice the consensus reached between them, and spoke highly of it. Expressing his pleasure over the positive developments being made in the China-DPRK relations and in the situation of the Korean peninsula after Kim Jong Un's first visit to China in March last, he expressed thanks once again to Kim Jong Un for personally visiting China again to promote and coordinate the mutual understanding of the two parties and the two countries. Saying that the two countries of China and the DPRK are the community of the same destiny and their relations are the invariable ones of lips and teeth, he said that it is the firm stand and the only correct option for the two parties and governments to consolidate and develop the China-DPRK relations no matter how frequently the situation changes. Hailing the new strategic line set forth by the Workers' Party of Korea on channeling all efforts on the socialist economic construction at the Third Plenary Meeting of the 7th WPK Central Committee, he expressed the conviction that the cause of socialist construction in the DPRK would surely emerge victorious under the leadership of Kim Jong Un. He highly appreciated the crucial decision and measures recently taken by Kim Jong Un and reiterated full support for them, saying that China, as a friendly neighbor, is making consistent efforts for regional peace and stability, paying deep attention to the development and change in the situation of the Korean peninsula. The talks proceeded in a frank, trusty and friendly atmosphere. Xi Jinping hosted a grand banquet in welcome of Kim Jong Un's visit to China. Present there on invitation were Ri Su Yong and Kim Yong Chol, members of the Political Bureau and vice-chairmen of the WPK Central Committee, Ri Yong Ho, member of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and foreign minister, Kim Yo Jong, alternate member of the Political Bureau and first vice department director of the WPK Central Committee, and other senior officials and suite members. Present were Wang Huning, member of the Standing Committee of the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau and member of the CPC Central Committee Secretariat, Ding Xuexiang, member of the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau, member of the CPC Central Committee Secretariat and director of the CPC Central Committee General Office, Yang Jiechi, member of the Political Bureau of the C.C., CPC and director of the Office of the Foreign Affairs Commission of the C.C., CPC, Wang Yi, state councilor and foreign minister, Song Tao, head of the International Liaison Department of the CPC Central Committee, and other senior officials of the Chinese party and government. When Kim Jong Un and Xi Jinping entered the banquet hall, all the participants enthusiastically welcomed them, extending the highest tribute to the top leaders of the two parties and the two countries opening up a new phase of the great DPRK-China friendship. Xi Jinping made a congratulatory speech first. He warmly welcomed Kim Jong Un who visited China again in a beautiful time enlivened with fresh and stirring spirit on behalf of the Chinese party, government and people and on his own behalf. The visit paid by Kim Jong Un fully showed the fact that he and the Korean Party Central Committee highly value the China-DPRK relations, the strategic communication between the two parties, in particular, and the firm will to implement the important joint agreement reached between the two sides, he said, stressing that this demonstrated once again the traditional and solid China-DPRK friendship to the whole world and will certainly have important impact on the China-DPRK relations and the situation of the Korean peninsula. Xi Jinping said that he, together with the Korean comrades, would continue to implement well the important agreement between the two sides, strengthen the strategic communication, expand exchanges and cooperation, give full play to the tradition of friendship and thus promote the fresh and greater development of the China-DPRK relations, provide happiness to the two countries and the two peoples and make active contributions to the regional peace, stability and prosperity. He continued to say that he is convinced that the Korean party and people would steadily achieve fresh and greater successes in the great course of socialist construction under the wise guidance of Chairman Kim Jong Un, and wishes for it. Kim Jong Un made a reply speech. Expressing great pleasure over the fact that he again had a significant meeting with Xi Jinping and the friendly Chinese comrades in a little more than 40 days and exchanged their inmost feelings, he expressed his most heartfelt thanks to the warm and cordial hospitality and warm-hearted concern shown by the Chinese Party Central Committee. Dalian is where President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il left their historic footprints that would remain forever in the annals of the DPRK-China friendship, he said, adding that the deep comradely confidence and obligation between the leaders of the two countries have been invariably carried forward century after century and generation after generation as the roots of bloody bonds that have linked the peoples of the two countries by the inseparable destiny. Noting that he feels again the pride and self-confidence of having such a great neighbor as China and such dependable and true friends as Chinese comrades, he said that he would advance hand in hand with the close Chinese comrades in the long historic course of achieving peace and prosperity in the Korean peninsula and Northeast Asia and building a fair and just new world in the future. Kim Jong Un sincerely hoped that the Chinese people would certainly bring into a brilliant reality the dream of China unfolded by Xi Jinping and thus fully demonstrate the might and stamina of the Chinese nation all over the world. Amicable atmosphere pervaded the banquet hall where officials of the two countries shared with each other warm and sincere feelings and the pleasure of meeting just like the same family members, beyond the diplomatic etiquette and ceremony. On Tuesday morning Kim Jong Un again met with Xi Jinping and talked without reserve while strolling the seaside. Then Kim Jong Un was invited to a luncheon hosted by Xi Jinping at Tingtao House of Bangchuidao Guesthouse. Before the luncheon Kim Jong Un and Xi Jinping appreciated the skills showing the tea culture and had an important talk. The luncheon helped further deepen the particular comradely intimacy between the top leaders of the two parties and the two countries. After the luncheon, Kim Jong Un expressed once again the gratitude to Xi Jinping for according particular hospitality with utmost sincerity during his stay in China and for expressing sincere and valuable opinions on the crucial work, and shook hands with him before parting. Some suite members visited Dalian Donggang Downtown and Hualu Group of China that day. Kim Jong Un wound up his schedule on Tuesday afternoon and left Dalian by his plane. He was seen off at Dalian International Airport by Wang Huning, member of the Standing Committee of the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau and member of the CPC Central Committee Secretariat, Song Tao, head of the International Liaison Department of the CPC Central Committee, Chen Qiufa, secretary of the Liaoning Provincial Committee of the CPC, and Tan Zuojun, secretary of the Dalian City Committee of the CPC. Kim Jong Un sent a letter of thanks to Xi Jinping on his way home. Political News Team

title: Provocative Moves of Militarist Maniacs
body: Recently, the "Self-Defense Forces" of Japan have staged for the first time the joint exercise with British navy at waters off Kanto for sea blockade against the DPRK. Meanwhile, the Japan Defense Ministry declared the Japan-U.S. joint military manoeuvres from May 9 to 24. This is the provocative reckless moves of militarist maniacs to realize their wild ambition for reinvasion of Korea by relying on the big powers including the U.S. The atmosphere of reconciliation and detente is prevailing in the Korean peninsula as a result of the pro-active and positive measures and efforts of the peace-loving DPRK. The international community, hailing and supporting the hard-won favorable climate on the Korean peninsula which was the biggest hotbed in the world, hopes that it will lead to durable peace. Going against the trend of the times, the U.S. and its vassal forces are getting more frantic in building up sanctions and pressure against the DPRK. Abe's group is joining in the U.S. sanctions and pressure against the DPRK. This is the act of pouring cold water on détente on the Korean peninsula. It is the inveterate bad habit of Japan to fish in troubled waters by stoking tensions on the Korean peninsula. There will be nothing favorable for Japan if it persists in militarism, unaware of its plight. Ri Hyon Do

title: WPK's Decisions Supported by Foreign Organizations
body: Organizations of different countries issued statements in support of the decisions of the Third Plenary Meeting of the Seventh Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) on April 24 and 25. The "Sun of Juche" Association of Journalists and Men of Culture for the Study of Kimjongilism in Ukraine said: Comrade Kim Jong Un, Supreme Leader of the Korean people, declared a great victory of the line on simultaneously developing the two fronts at the Third Plenary Meeting of the Seventh Central Committee of the WPK. He set forth a fresh strategic line and underscored the need to put up the banner of "Let us further accelerate the advance of our revolution by concentrating all our efforts on socialist economic construction!" We express full support to the decisions adopted at the plenary meeting. The Society for the Promotion of the Relations between Austria and DPRK pointed out that the Korean people would surely build a powerful socialist country, further demonstrating the sovereignty and dignity of the country under the wise leadership of HE Kim Jong Un. The Nepalese Association for Supporting the Songun Politics noted that the WPK is steadily performing world-startling miracles under the guidance of HE Kim Jong Un. It hoped that the Korean people would achieve great successes in their struggle for implementing the fresh strategic line. Rodong News Team

title: May 21 Architectural Festival Opens
body: The 18th May 21 Architectural Festival opened. The festival on the theme of "To highlight specific features of local areas in architectural creation by use of locally available building materials" is to be divided into architecture designing exhibition, construction gears and tools exhibition, and designing information exhibition. The festival will see the city and town (district) planning layout for sports and leisure parks, the green architectural layout, architectural layout for hall of culture in town, city, county and ri, the exterior and interior layout for hotel, etc. The festival will showcase more than 400 architecture designs, 40-odd kinds of construction gears and tools, above 30 IT-based design programs. An opening ceremony took place at the Sci-Tech Complex on Monday. Attending it were Vice-Premier Tong Jong Ho, officials, architects, technicians, teachers and researchers in the fields of architectural design, construction, building materials, supervision, scientific research and education. Rodong News Team

title: North-South Summit and Panmunjom Declaration Supported
body: Vice-Chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) Nam Sung U issued a statement hailing the historic north-south summit and the Panmunjom Declaration on May 5. The historic moment when the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un crossed the demarcation line in Panmunjom, the Koreans in Japan were convinced of the new era of reconciliation, unity and peace and prosperity opened before the nation amid pleasure and excitement, the statement said, and went on: "The Panmunjom Declaration for Peace, Prosperity and Reunification of the Korean Peninsula" signed by the respected Marshal becomes a new landmark of great significance in bringing earlier co-prosperity and independent reunification craved for by all the Koreans. The statement warmly supported and welcomed the north-south summit and the declaration provided by the patriotic bold decision and the devoted efforts of the Marshal, reflecting the unanimous mind of all the Chongryon officials and Koreans in Japan. It was a great event to be specially recorded in the nation's history which can be spearheaded by Kim Jong Un only as he is leading the whole nation to reunification with responsibility for the destiny of the nation that he provided a starting point for writing a new history of peace and reunification in Panmunjom, symbol of national division. Chongryon and Koreans in Japan will turn out as one in the drive for implementing the Panmunjom declaration and make tangible contributions to ushering in the new era of national reconciliation, unity and peace and prosperity of the Korean peninsula after foiling all challenges and obstructive moves of outsiders and the sycophantic traitors, the statement stressed. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung's Exploits Lauded by Russians
body: A seminar on the exploits of President Kim Il Sung and meetings took place in Russia on the occasion of his birth anniversary. Present there were figures of political parties, organizations and institutions and masses in the country. A vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Communist Party "Communists of Russia" highly praised the President as great man who illumined the way for mankind just as his august name implies the sun and provided a flower garden of human love with ardent passion and embraced all people with his great magnanimity. The first secretary of the Maritime Territorial Regional Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation who doubles as chairman of the Association for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism of Russia in the Far East Region lauded the President as the benefactor to Korean national liberation who set out on the road of revolution in his early years, founded the Juche idea and liberated the country, outstanding brilliant commander who brought about the beginning of a downhill turn for the U.S. imperialists by leading the Fatherland Liberation War to victory and distinguished great man who turned the DPRK into a socialist fortress. The chairperson of the Party for Peace and Unity of Russia and other personages stressed that the President who devoted his whole life to the people with boundless devotion to the people is a genuine leader of the people. At the seminar held by the preparatory committee for marking the birth anniversary of Kim Il Sung, the Day of the Sun, of the Amur Regional Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation, speakers highly praised the exploits performed by the President who embodied the Juche idea and turned the DPRK into a socialist country, independent in politics, self-supporting in the economy and self-reliant in national defence and expressed the will to positively conduct activities for supporting the Korean army and people in their struggle to build a powerful socialist country and realize national reunification. The first secretary of the Central Committee of the All-Russia Lenin Young Communist League, the first secretary of the C.C., Lenin Young Communist League of the Russian Federation, the chairman of the Regional Social Organization of Russia "Borozino" and the principal of the 11th Middle School in Khabarovsk City also spoke highly of the revolutionary career of the President who founded the guiding idea in the era of independence, defeated the U.S. and Japanese imperialists in one generation and made a great contribution to socialist construction and global independence. Congratulatory messages to the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un were adopted at the meetings held by the All-Russia Lenin Young Communist League and the Lenin Young Communist League of the Russian Federation. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung Lauded by Foreign Media
body: Foreign media carried special write-ups illustrated with portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung on the occasion of his birth anniversary. The Nepalese paper Arpan and online magazine Nepal Today carried and posted articles titled "Great man mixing unceremoniously with the people" and "The humblest person." These articles lauded the lofty popular personality and noble virtue of the President. The Congolese paper La Patriot and the internet homepage of the Agence Congolaise d'Information reported in detail in articles tilted "On the occasion of the 106th birth anniversary of the great leader President Kim Il Sung" and "Africa does not forget" the exploits of the President who devoted his all to the sacred cause for the freedom and happiness of the people and the fact that he never allowed any special privilege and favor in the whole period of his career. The Guinean paper Horoya edited a photo-illustrated article titled "Great man and famous flower," saying that Kimilsungia came into being, it won gold and top prizes at international flower expos and shows and flowers praising the sun are in full bloom across the world. A Guinean state TV broadcasting repeatedly dealt with Korean film "Kimilsungia, the Flower of the Sun". Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Meets U.S. Secretary of State
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Wednesday met Mike Pompeo, secretary of State of the United States of America who is on a visit to the DPRK. The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un warmly greeted Mike Pompeo and sincerely congratulated him on his recent official assumption as secretary of State. He welcomed the U.S. state secretary's visit to the DPRK and had a photo session with him. Mike Pompeo expressed thanks to Kim Jong Un for sparing time to meet him, saying that he came to the DPRK to personally convey the verbal message of the U.S. president and prepare the DPRK-U.S. summit. Then he conveyed Kim Jong Un the verbal message of Donald Trump, president of the U.S.A. After hearing the verbal message, Kim Jong Un expressed thanks, highly appreciating that the U.S. president has shown deep interest in settling the issue through dialogue. He exchanged with Mike Pompeo the appraisal and view on the acute situation of the Korean peninsula, which is now a pressing matter of the whole world's concern, and the stance and opinions of the supreme leaderships of the DPRK and the U.S. on their summit. He said that the coming DPRK-U.S. summit would be a historic meeting for the excellent first step toward promotion of the positive situation development in the Korean peninsula and building of a good future. At the meeting, an in-depth discussion was made on the practical matters for holding the DPRK-U.S. summit and its procedure and ways. Kim Jong Un reached a satisfactory consensus on the issues discussed with the U.S. state secretary. He accepted an official suggestion of the U.S. president for the release of Americans who have been detained in the DPRK for their anti-DPRK hostilities, and gave an order of the chairman of the DPRK State Affairs Commission on granting amnesty to them for their repatriation. He gave a high appreciation of the talks with Mike Pompeo that produced satisfactory results. Mike Pompeo expressed thanks to Kim Jong Un, saying that they are heartily grateful to him for the cordial hospitality accorded to them during their visit to Pyongyang and for the very beneficial talks which reached a full agreement. And he showed his resolution and will to strive for the successful DPRK-U.S. summit as the U.S. secretary of State. The respected Supreme Leader exchanged parting words with Mike Pompeo and saw him off, promising to meet again. Political News Team

title: Korean Culture Exhibition Held in China
body: A Korean culture exhibition took place in Harbin City, Heilongjiang Province of China, on April 15-30. Displayed at its venue were photos dealing with the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's historic visit to China. There were also works of President Kim Il Sung, leader Kim Jong Il and Kim Jong Un, books and photos introducing the happy life of the Korean people and handicrafts associated with the creative talents of the Korean nation. Present at the opening ceremony were personages of various circles and popular masses in Heilongjiang Province and a delegation of the Korean Overseas Exhibition General Bureau. Rodong News Team

title: Panmunjom Declaration Supported by Nigerian Personage
body: Damian Ogbonna, national chairman of the People's Progressive Party of Nigeria and chairman of the African Regional Committee for Friendship and Solidarity with the Korean People, issued a statement on May 3 in support of the Panmunjom Declaration. The statement said: The leadership of the People's Progressive Party of Nigeria and all the party members heard in great excitement the news that Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and President Moon Jae In had a north-south summit in Panmunjom and signed the "Panmunjom Declaration on Peace, Prosperity and Reunification of Korean Peninsula". In the declaration the top leaders of the north and the south solemnly declared before the 80 million Koreans and the whole world that there would be no longer war and a new era of peace has opened on the Korean peninsula. The Panmunjom Declaration serves as a new landmark of epochal significance in reconnecting the severed blood vessel of the Korean nation, hastening co-prosperity and the future of independent reunification and ensuring peace and security in Northeast Asia and the rest of the world. We hope that the north and south of Korea will open a new era of national reconciliation and peace and prosperity as indicated by the declaration. We also extend firm support and solidarity to the efforts of the Workers' Party of Korea and the Korean people for reunification of the Korean peninsula. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung's Birth Anniversary Observed
body: Special write-ups were posted on internet homepages of different countries and regions to mark the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, the Day of the Sun. A group for the study of the philosophy on Juche idea of a university of education in Maracay of Venezuela posted articles titled "Kim Il Sung, the eternal sun" and "Kimilsungia" with a portrait of smiling Kim Il Sung on its website Juche Idea. The Brazilian Center for the Study of the Juche Idea posted on its website an article titled "The great leader of the Korean people" illustrated with his photo. The Mexican national preparatory committee for celebrating the Day of the Sun posted on its website such articles as "Among the people" and "The reality of the DPRK society, its characteristics". The preparatory committee for celebrating the Day of the Sun of the German Group for the Study of Korean Culture posted on its website more than 50 photos dealing with his revolutionary activities in the periods of anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle and the Fatherland Liberation War and socialist construction. The Asian Regional Institute of the Juche Idea, the Nigerian National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism and the Italy-DPRK Association for Friendship and Culture posted on their websites articles praising feats performed by the President for the cause of human independence. The website of the British Association for the Study of Songun Policy introduced in articles that he put forward the three principle of national reunification, the proposal for founding the Democratic Federal Republic of Koryo and the ten-point programme of the great unity of the whole nation and put his heart and soul into the reunification of the country till the last moments of his life. The preparatory committee of the People's Progressive Party of Nigeria for celebrating the birth anniversary of Generalissimo HE Kim Il Sung introduced in detail his exploits for national reunification in an article posted on the website of the African Regional Committee for Friendship and Solidarity with the Korean People. Rodong News Team

title: Floral Baskets to Kim Jong Un from Abroad
body: The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received floral baskets from the family of Zhang Wei-hua, a Chinese anti-Japanese revolutionary martyr, and the Tokyo-Pyongyang Rainbow Bridge of Japan and the Association for Promotion of Friendship between Japan and North and South Korea on Wednesday on the occasion of the 2nd anniversary of his assumption of the chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea. Rodong News Team

title: Panmunjom Declaration Hailed in America
body: The American Regional Committee of the Overseas Side Committee for Implementing June 15 Joint Declaration issued a statement on April 28 in support of the north-south summit and Panmunjom Declaration. The statement said that the Panmunjom Declaration signed by the top leaders of the north and the south raised fresh hope and belief that the independent reunification could be realized by the will and efforts of the Korean nation. It stressed that the committee would positively turn out in the struggle for peace and prosperity and independent reunification of the country clarified in the above-said declaration with high sense of responsibility and firm will to be conducive to the historic turning-point. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korea: Treacherous Act of LKP Censured
body: The People's Party of south Korea held a press conference outside the "National Assembly" building in Seoul on May 4 to accuse the "Liberal Korea Party" of its treacherous act, according the south Korean online newspaper Jaju Sibo. Speakers there accused the LKP of playing down the successes made at the north-south summit and disturbing the efforts for peace and prosperity on the Korean peninsula. A press release was announced at the conference. It charged that the LKP is adding to its crimes, urging its representative Hong Jun Phyo to make an apology for his remarks about "Reds" and withdraw from the political arena. It also urged the LKP's floor leader Kim Song Thae to opt for helping get the motion on the Panmunjom Declaration ratified at the NA, instead of staging a hunger sit-in. At the end of the conference the participants launched a sit-in in protest against the coteries of LKP slandering the historic north-south summit and the Panmunjom Declaration. Rodong News Team

title: U.S. Should Refrain from Acts and Words Marring Atmosphere of Dialogue
body: The U.S. is playing down the historic significance of the inter-Korean summit at Panmunjom and the April 27 declaration, created by the proactive efforts of the DPRK, with such assertion that it is "result of maximum pressure" and "sustained sanctions and pressure should be maintained". It is a stupid behavior just like a saying that curses, like chickens, come home to roost. The world people are regarding such senseless remarks and behavior as the revelation of uneasiness and impatience of those who fear the anti-DPRK sanctions and pressure might break into pieces in a moment by the trend of the international community actively supporting the summit and declaration. It is clear that those calling for "tightened and sustained sanctions and pressure" will not be welcomed wherever they go but meet failure and disgrace only, today when the improvement of the inter-Korean relations and détente and peace on the Korean peninsula have become an irresistible trend. The U.S. is persistently clinging to the hostile policy toward the DPRK, misleading the public opinion. Such behavior may result in endangering the security of its own country. Besides, such impudent action against its partner of dialogue when the mutual confidence is required ahead of it will not be good for the U.S., but will put it in a more difficult situation. The U.S. should refrain from making words and acts that may destroy the hard-won atmosphere of dialogue. It should be aware that doing so will benefit itself, too, and make every effort to show its sincerity in line with the present situation. Pak Chol Jun

title: Executive Director of WFP Arrives
body: David Muldrow Beasley, executive director of the World Food Programme (WFP), and his party arrived in Pyongyang on Tuesday. They were feted on the same day. Rodong News Team

title: Russian Embassy Officials Lay Wreaths before Liberation Tower
body: Officials of the Russian embassy in Pyongyang laid a wreath before the Liberation Tower on Wednesday on the occasion of the 73rd anniversary of Russia's victory in the great Patriotic War. Present at the wreath-laying ceremony were Ambassador Alexandr Matsegora and officials of the Russian embassy and diplomatic envoys and military attaches of foreign embassies in Pyongyang. A wreath was laid at the tower in the name of the Russian embassy. The participants paid a silent tribute to the fallen soldiers of the Soviet Army and looked round the tower. The embassy officials also laid a wreath and bouquets at the cemetery of fallen soldiers of the Soviet Army in Sadong District of Pyongyang. The members of the Russian consulate general in Chongjin City laid bouquets at the liberation tower and the cemetery of fallen soldiers of the Soviet Army in the city. Earlier, the members of the Russian embassy placed bouquets before the liberation towers, statues of Soviet Army soldiers, cemeteries of fallen Soviet Army soldiers and memorial towers in local areas, and the Russian consulate general in Chongjin hosted a reception. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korea: Hong Jun Phyo Urged to Retire from Political Life
body: In south Korea, Hong Jun Phyo, representative of the "Liberal Korea Party", has been strongly urged to retire from the political circles as he ran down the successful Panmunjom summit meeting and talks, according to the south Korean "News 1". A candidate lawmaker from the People's Party on May 4 demanded that Hong apologize the people for his reckless remarks against the times and step down from the office of representative. Sim Sang Jong, a lawmaker from the Justice Party, at a news conference on May 3, charged that Hong and other conservative forces are playing down the success of the south-north summit meeting and talks. Rodong News Team

title: Eradication of Conservative Evils Urged in S. Korea
body: The Headquarters of All-People Action to Punish Lee Myung Bak-Park Geun Hye on May 2 made public a statement declaring a more vigorous struggle against the conservative evil forces, according to the Voice of Seoul, a south Korean internet newspaper. The statement said that May 2 is the historic day when people of all strata turned out in a candlelight action to impeach traitor Lee Myung Bak ten years ago. The candlelight action in 2008 could not succeed owing to the wholesale crackdown by the Lee Myung Bak regime but the spirit of resistance lived on and managed to impeach Park Geun Hye and detain Lee Myung Bak, it added. Charging that the conservative forces are running wild to bring to naught the success of the north-south summit and talks, the statement declared that the organization would set the eradication of the conservative evils as its main target of struggle. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Sun Marked Abroad
body: Meetings and seminars took place in Cuba, Myanmar, Pakistan, India, Germany, Austria, Sweden, Romania, Kyrgyzstan, Nigeria, Mexico, Venezuela and Ecuador between April 9 and 16 on the occasion of the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, the Day of the Sun. The chief editor of the organ of the League for National Democracy of Myanmar said that Kim Il Sung extended unsparing support and encouragement to the struggle of the progressive people aspiring after the anti-imperialist independence with his noble international obligation. The general secretary of the Society for the Promotion of the Relations between Austria and DPRK said that Kim Il Sung who devoted all his life to the country and its people was always be alive in the hearts of the Korean people and the progressive mankind. The chief of the Swedish Group for the Study of the Juche Idea praised the President as an extraordinary revolutionary who devoted his all to the struggle for building an equitable society without all sorts of exploitation and pressure. The general coordinator of the Federal Political Secretariat of the United Left Party of Venezuela said it was one of Kim Il Sung's exploits that he founded the Juche idea and led the cause of human independence to victory, noting that today's socialist Korea would be unthinkable without him. The chairman of the Ecuadorian Cultural Institute for the Study of the Juche Idea said that the President's revolutionary career was a life of an outstanding politician and the great leader who held high the banner of independence and led the Korean revolution and the world revolution to victory. He also said that the President would always be alive in the hearts of all people as the image of the sun and his exploits shine forever as noble heritages of humankind. Congratulatory messages to the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un were adopted at events held in Pakistan, Austria and Nigeria. Rodong News Team

title: Panmunjom Declaration Supported by Ecuadorian Organizations
body: The Ecuadorian Committee for Remembering President Kim Il Sung, the Ecuadorian Committee for Remembering Generalissimo Kim Jong Il, the Ecuadorian Committee for Supporting the Independent and Peaceful Reunification of Korea and the Guaranda Association for Friendship, Culture and Solidarity with the Korean People of Ecuador released a joint statement on May 2 in support of the Panmunjom Declaration. The statement said that they warmly welcomed and fully supported the "Panmunjom Declaration on Peace, Prosperity and Reunification of Korean Peninsula." It went on: The summit in Panmunjom and the announcement of the Panmunjom Declaration serve as a great contribution to reconciliation and prosperity of the Korean nation and the world peace. The historic event made on the Korean peninsula is a brilliant fruition brought about by the bold decision for patriotism of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, the outstanding politician and strategist in modern era who is recognized by humankind and his will to firmly guarantee peace and security in the Korean peninsula and the rest of the world. The reality proves again how just the DPRK's consistent line and policies of the national reunification are. The progressive people ardently revere Kim Jong Un who is conducting energetic activities for accomplishing the cause of human independence while steering the international political situation. We extend invariable support and solidarity to the Korean people in their vigorous efforts for building a powerful socialist country and accomplishing the national reunification under the wise leadership of Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: 9th National Medical Instruments Exhibition Held
body: The 9th National Medical Instruments Exhibition took place at the Sci-Tech Complex on May 8-10. Presented to it were more than 2 290 medical equipment, instruments and materials of over 460 kinds, devised by factories and enterprises under commissions, ministries and national institutions, educational and scientific institutions and health organs. Appreciated among them were electrocardiograph, electroencephalograph, mobile general dental equipment, electric gastroscope and mobile digital X-ray. During the exhibition there were a review of the production of medical instruments made by commissions, ministries and national institutions in Juche 106 (2017), and an exchange of experience, technical consultation, technical symposium and sample show. Its closing ceremony was held on Thursday. Rodong News Team

title: Spanish Delegation Arrives
body: A delegation of the Elcano Royal Institute of Spain led by Executive Director Charles Tito Powell Solares arrived here on Thursday. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Yong Nam Meets Executive Director of WFP
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, had a talk with David Muldrow Beasley, executive director of the World Food Programme (WFP), and his party, who paid a courtesy call on him, at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Thursday. Rodong News Team

title: Trend of History toward Independence Cannot Be Stemmed
body: The trend of history toward independence can never be stemmed no matter how desperately the imperialists may work. The history has dynamically advanced along the road of independence. It has been proved scientifically and theoretically that socialism is the independent ideal and justice and its victory is certain even in the adverse wind of anti-socialism. The worldwide struggle to defend and advance the socialist cause has been waged. The imperialist reactionary forces couldn't stem the trend of history. Instead, they fell into decay and ruin in the confrontation with the independent forces. The imperialists are taking much pain to get rid of the abyss of ruin. History has entered into a new phase, the era of crucial turn. Independence should be maintained under the banner of anti-imperialist independence. Countries and nations aspiring after independence and justice should reject the intervention and domination of foreign forces and shape their own destiny independently. It is necessary to struggle against the aggression and interference of imperialist and hegemonic forces. The struggle to realize international justice irrespective of political view and religious belief, economic and cultural development should be waged positively. It is necessary to vigorously struggle to defend and victoriously advance the socialist cause. The unity of the anti-imperialist independent forces should be intensified. No force can reverse the main trend of the times toward independence. Ri Hak Nam

title: Day of Sun Marked Abroad
body: Book and photo exhibitions and film shows took place in China, Russia, Vietnam, Mongolia, Singapore, Thailand, Germany, Slovenia, Ukraine, Austria, Guinea, Uganda, Nigeria, Senegal and Algeria to mark the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, the Day of the Sun. Displayed at the venues of the exhibitions were photos showing the revolutionary careers and exploits of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il and the revolutionary activities of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. There were also works of the peerlessly great men and books and photos introducing the reality of Juche Korea rapidly developing by dint of self-reliance and self-development. Such Korean films as "Eternal Treasures in Praise of Sun" and "Monument to Party Founding" were shown. The first vice-president of University of Economic Management in Sankt-Petersburg of Russia said that the great President Kim Il Sung is an invincible commander who defeated the U.S. and Japanese imperialists and an outstanding statesman who built Korean-style socialism and provided a happy life to the people. The rector of the College of Social Sciences and Humanities of Vietnam State University of Hanoi highly praised the exploits performed by Kim Il Sung for the development of the friendly relations between the two countries, saying it is high honor of the university to hold the event for celebrating his 106th birth anniversary. Rodong News Team

title: Panmunjom Declaration Hailed Abroad
body: Marwan Sudah, chairman of the Arab Committee for Solidarity with the Korean People and Supporting the Reunification of Korea, released a statement on April 30 in support of the Panmunjom Declaration. Hailing the "Panmunjom Declaration on Peace, Prosperity and Reunification of the Korean Peninsula", the statement said: The issue of the Korean peninsula has recently become a crucial matter of the global political situation. In particular, the plan and proposal of HE Kim Jong Un to achieve national reconciliation and unity and open a fresh era of peace and prosperity commands full support from the whole world. The Panmunjom Declaration is a declaration of historic significance in terminating the danger of war on the Korean peninsula. The Panmunjom Declaration brought a new morning of national prosperity to the Korean peninsula. We extend the warmest congratulations to HE Kim Jong Un who brought about this great victory. The cause of Korea's reunification is sure to be realized by HE Kim Jong Un, statesman of world stature and distinguished great man. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's Work Introduced in Russia
body: The Russian website DPRK Today posted the full text of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us Brilliantly Accomplish the Revolutionary Cause of Juche, Holding the Great Comrade Kim Jong Il in High Esteem as the Eternal General Secretary of Our Party" on May 8 to mark the second anniversary of his election as chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). The work, published on April 6, Juche 101 (2012), clarifies that it is the principled requirement for victoriously advancing the Korean revolution to hold leader Kim Jong Il in high esteem as the eternal general secretary of the WPK. It also indicates the tasks for steadily developing the WPK into the glorious party of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of Russian Political Party Arrives
body: A delegation of the Amur Regional Branch Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation headed by Roman Kobizov, member of the C.C., Communist Party of the Russian Federation and first secretary of its Amur Regional Branch Committee, arrived in Pyongyang on Friday. Rodong News Team

title: All-out Campaign against LKP Declared in S. Korea
body: According to the south Korean online newspaper Jaju Sibo, the People's Party of south Korea on Tuesday held a press conference outside the "National Assembly" building to declare an all-out campaign against the "Liberal Korea Party". Speakers charged that the LKP and Hong Jun Phyo are not still making apology for slandering the south-north summit. They declared an all-out campaign against Hong Jun Phyo and the LKP, saying that it is their mission to combat evils together with the people. Rodong News Team

title: Foolish Wile of Those Oblivious of Reality
body: The U.S. drastically increased the funds for espionage against the DPRK and is scheming to intensify ideological and cultural poisoning against it through e-media and radio. A recent plenary meeting of the U.S. Senate discussed the matter and the related act was passed with a unanimous approval, the keynote of which is to diversify the means and contents of information influx into the DPRK and increase the aid funds to scale up intelligence against it. U.S. politicians made it a matter of duty to intensify propaganda broadcasting against the DPRK, which was mainly done through radio, by use of diverse media. It was also formalized to use all e-media and information technologies including USB cards, mobile phones and wireless internet as means for ideological and cultural poisoning against the DPRK, and to spread corrupt music, films and dramas of the U.S. and other capitalist countries in the DPRK as diversification of its contents. This clearly shows that the U.S. conspiratorial moves to divide and paralyze the DPRK have reached an extremely dangerous phase. The U.S. has persisted in psychological warfare aimed at internal destabilization of the DPRK through espionage, propaganda broadcasting and awful propaganda literature century after century in a bid to stamp out the ideology and social system of the DPRK. The U.S. is making no scruple of committing mean and base acts by using modern sci-tech means in a bid to spread corrupt bourgeois ideology and culture within the DPRK. However, it is no more than a wild dream of the foolish ones oblivious of history and reality. Ri Hyo Jin

title: Panmunjom Declaration Is Historic Milestone for Independent Reunification
body: The Panmunjom Declaration is a great signal flare fired by the north and the south of Korea and serves as a historic milestone for connecting the broken vein of the nation and ushering in a new era of independent reunification. Thanks to the adoption of the declaration, the fellow countrymen received a programme for ushering in a new era of independent reunification and have became to more vigorously turn out in the patriotic struggle for the national reunification with confidence. The declaration is the most realistic and reasonable programme common to the nation as it is based on the idea of By Our Nation Itself and the principle of independence and reflects the intention and desire of the entire nation and meets the requirement of the international community aspiring after the peace and reunification on the Korean Peninsula. It is also a programme of independent reunification in the era of Kim Jong Un, the new historic one, successor to the June 15 joint declaration and the October 4 declaration provided by leader Kim Jong Il. It is a historic declaration through which to declare that the north and the south would make a new history of national reconciliation and usher in a new era of common prosperity by their concerted efforts. For the north and the south to pool efforts is a prerequisite for the national reunification and it is inseparable from independent reunification and peace and prosperity. It is a great declaration for ushering in a new spring of peace and security desired by all the fellow countrymen by defusing the danger of war on the peninsula and easing the military tensions. It is a crucial one which made a new breakthrough in ensuring peace and security not only in the Korean peninsula but also in Northeast Asia and the rest of the world and brought about a dramatic diastrophic change in the international political trend. Only when the declaration is implemented sincerely, can one expect the development of the inter-Korean ties and the bright future of the peace and independent reunification in the peninsula. Ho Yong Min

title: Editorial
body: Let Us Attain Higher Goals for Socialist Construction The Korean people have staged an indomitable offensive for implementing the decisions made at the Seventh Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea for the past two years since the congress. The past two years were the days during which the greatness of the WPK leading the Juche revolution to only victory was demonstrated to the world. The party has further developed into a steel-strong party with solid organizational and ideological foundation and mass foundation. The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un clarified with his far-sighted wisdom the unique party-building idea that to strengthen the primary party organizations and party cells is a shortcut to strengthening the whole party, and put primary efforts into developing the party's basic organizations into the best elite ranks. Today the WPK is demonstrating its might as a promising revolutionary party and invincible guiding force having the robust basic organizations which are boundlessly loyal to the cause of the leader. Its leadership prestige and militant might have been powerfully demonstrated for the past two years. Today it is confidently steering the cause of socialism with an unshakable faith in the victory of the revolution and absolute trust in the great people. The Korean people are now duty-bound to make turns in all fields of socialist construction by making a revolutionary general offensive for implementing the decisions made by the WPK Seventh Congress and thus hasten the final victory. All people should dynamically work to achieve a fresh victory of the revolution and attain higher goals for socialist construction with the historic successes they have made for the past two years as a springboard.

title: May 21 Architectural Festival Closes
body: The 18th May 21 Architectural Festival closed with due ceremony at the Sci-Tech Complex on Thursday. During the festival the participants exchanged their successes and experience gained in the work to build more monumental edifices of lasting value and put the country's architectural science and technology on the ultramodern level. What drew attention of the festival participants were architectural layouts which reflected state-of-the-art architectural technology including formative art, zero energy, zero carbon and green architecture. Also highly appreciated were construction gears and tools made with domestic technology. Valuable programs conducive to guaranteeing the scientific accuracy, correctness and speed of designing showed the rapid development of the architectural designing. Rodong News Team

title: Appeal Made by AINDF Central Committee
body: The Central Committee of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front made public an appeal on Thursday to encourage the south Koreans to implement the "Panmunjom Declaration on Peace, Prosperity and Reunification of the Korean Peninsula", according to the internet homepage Kuguk Jonson. Noting that the April 27 Panmunjom shock is steering the people's minds and garnering the world's cheers, the appeal said: The respected Chairman of the State Affairs Commission Kim Jong Un is a great creator of new reunification history, pillar of all the fellow countrymen's hope and the bright sun shining the land of the south and the north of Korea. Let's demonstrate the pride and honor of having him as the supreme leader of the nation to the whole world! Let's invariably follow him, the peerless patriot, as the loadstar of national reunification. National independence is the basic core of the Panmunjom Declaration. Let's build a dignified reunified power on this land by the efforts of our nation itself without fail, true to the Panmunjom Declaration, fruition of warm love for the nation and invariable will of independence! Peace, prosperity and reunification common to the nation can be achieved only by the concerted efforts of the fellow countrymen. Let's swim with the triumphant trend to realize the nation's great cause of peace, prosperity and reunification, irrespective of the progressive and the conservative, class and strata, ideal and religious belief! To remove the danger of war and ensure peace and security on the Korean peninsula is an important matter related to the destiny of our nation and indispensable prerequisite to its reunification. Let's never allow any military provocation, reckless deployment of strategic assets and war maneuvers which endanger peace and security on this land! Each of our people and members of our nation is the master of the era and maker of history whom nobody can substitute. The appeal stressed that a reunified powerful nation would surely emerge when all the fellow countrymen turn out in implementing the Panmunjom Declaration like an active volcano, true to the bright sun of the nation. Rodong News Team

title: Int'l Body Welcomes Inter-Korean Summit
body: The Coordinating Bureau of the Non-Aligned Movement released a communiqué on May 9 welcoming the inter-Korean summit. The communiqué said that the inter-Korean summit on April 27, 2018 constitutes a milestone in the improvement of inter-Korean relations and a positive step towards peace in the Korean Peninsula and stability in the region as a whole. Hoping that the "Panmunjom Declaration on Peace, Prosperity and Reunification of the Korean Peninsula" would be fully implemented, it made vows for further inter-Korean dialogue and the implementation of trust-building and reconciliation measures for peace on the Korean Peninsula. Rodong News Team

title: Executive Director of WFP Leaves
body: David Muldrow Beasley, executive director of the World Food Programme (WFP), and his party left Pyongyang on Friday. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung Praised by Foreign Media
body: Foreign media carried special write-ups illustrated with portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and his photos to mark his birth anniversary. The newspaper of DR Congo La Prosperite said in an article titled "Noble obligation of President Kim Il Sung" that he was a noble man with genuine human love and obligation before being a state leader and a politician. The organ of the Uganda National Resistance Movement Public Lens, the Ethiopian newspaper Fortune, the Angolan newspaper U Pais, the Nigerian newspaper Nigerian Observer, the Tanzanian newspaper Uhuru and the Egyptian newspaper Al Akhbar Almassay in articles under such titles as "Kim Il Sung, the great man in the 20th century", "Beaming smile of President Kim Il Sung" and "President Kim Il Sung's great revolutionary career" introduced in detail what prominent personages of various countries have said in praise of the undying feats and greatness of the President, a pioneer and pacemaker of the era of independence who founded the Juche idea to show the road ahead of humankind and an outstanding veteran statesman in the world who steered the human cause of independence all his life under the banner of anti-imperialist independence. They stressed that he is always alive in the mind of humankind as the sun is eternal. The Zambian newspaper Brandline News and the Zimbabwean newspaper The Herald cited detailed facts to tell that the President had rendered material and moral assistance to the national liberation struggle and the building of a new society in African countries. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's Exploits Praised by Swiss Organizations
body: The Swiss organizing committee of the International Festival in Praise of Great Persons of Mt Paektu, the Switzerland-Korea Committee and the Swiss Group for the Study of the Juche Idea released a joint statement on May 5 to mark the 2nd anniversary of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's election as chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). His election as chairman of the WPK is a revelation of boundless trust and reverence of all the Party members, service personnel and people for him, the statement said. It noted that he has invariably carried forward the idea and cause of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il with his unbounded loyalty to them. It said that he set forth a fresh strategic line of concentrating all efforts on the socialist economic construction at the historic Third Plenary Meeting of the Seventh Central Committee of the WPK. Under his guidance socialist Korea is now further demonstrating its might as politico-ideological and military power, it noted. Thanks to his rare political caliber the historic north-south summit was held and the Panmunjom Declaration announced some days ago, it said, and went on: This eye-opening event is a brilliant fruition of his boundless love for the country and the nation. Under his leadership Korea will be surely reunified. The future of Korea is rosy. Rodong News Team

title: Congratulations to Cambodian King
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, on Monday sent a congratulatory message to Norodom Sihamoni, king of Cambodia, on his 65th birthday. Kim in the message wished the king good health and happiness and bigger success in his work, expressing the belief that the traditional relations of friendship between the two countries, established by President Kim Il Sung together with great King Norodom Sihanouk, would invariably grow stronger. Rodong News Team

title: Editorial
body: Let Us Achieve Victory in Economic Construction by Dint of Self-Reliance All the people of the DPRK turned out in the struggle for paving a broad avenue to prosperity and bringing earlier the future of the building of a powerful socialist country by giving full play to the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance in implementing the decisions of the April Plenary Meeting of the Workers' Party of Korea Central Committee. When all the people give fuller rein to the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance and fortitude, a new strategic line of the WPK will surely emerge victorious and a great leap forward and innovations be made in socialist construction. All the officials, party members and working people should make a heroic epic of self-reliance in today's general march for economic construction and thus bring the plan and resolution of the Party Central Committee into a brilliant reality and fully demonstrate the invincibility of the DPRK and its spirit of leap forward. One should have firm ideological readiness to achieve the final victory in the spirit of self-reliance. Immutable is the truth of the Juche idea that one is the master of one's own destiny and has the power to carve out it. Only the people strong in the revolutionary spirit to bear full responsibility for their own destiny and hew out it by themselves can become the final victors. All the officials, party members and working people should intensify the drive to implement the ideas of the Party and uphold its policies, holding higher the slogan "Self-reliance is the only way out!"

title: Spring Table Tennis Tournament for Disabled and Amateurs Held
body: The 2018 Spring Table Tennis Tournament for Disabled and Amateurs was held at the Gymnasium of Kim Il Sung University from May 7 to 13. Taking part in it, divided into group of disabled and amateurs, age group of man and woman amateurs and group of mixed amateurs, were disabled and amateur players in Pyongyang and foreigners. Watching the games were Kim Mun Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the Korean Federation for the Protection of the Disabled, officials concerned, disabled, table-tennis amateurs, working people, youths and students in the city, foreigners and overseas Koreans. Yu Myong Sin and Jong Song Ryol players came first in the games of disabled and amateurs. Rodong News Team

title: Unity Is Sure Guarantee for Building Independent New World
body: Unity of the forces for independence against imperialism is a sure guarantee for building an independent, new world. If the non-aligned countries and other developing countries maintain firm stand of independence and get united closely to wage common struggle, it would be possible to marginalize the imperialist forces and successfully foil their aggression and interference, defend the sovereignty of countries and nations and realize the global independence. What is important above all is to maintain independence in achieving the unity of the forces of independence against imperialism. Unity is aimed to oppose all forms of domination and subjugation and build an independent new world and, therefore, it should be oriented toward the struggle against imperialism. The non-aligned movement constitutes the leading force for building a free and peaceful, new world. The movement has to be steadily strengthened as long as the imperialist forces pursuing domination, interference, aggression and plunder and expanding the military bloc for aggression exist on the earth. Actions should be waged against the moves to disintegrate and disable the non-aligned movement. The member nations of the non-aligned movement have to stand against the imperialists' separation and estrangement moves with the strategy of unity and get closely united on the principle of mutual respect, non-interference, equality and reciprocity. When the world progressive people stand strongly with the might of unity based on independence, will it be possible to make the imperialists helpless and accelerate the building of an independent new world. Kim Sung Gol

title: WPK's New Strategic Line Supported by Foreign Political Parties, Organizations
body: Political parties and organizations of Nigeria and South Africa issued statements in support of the decisions of the Third Plenary Meeting of the Seventh Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) on April 26 and 28. The People's Progressive Party of Nigeria said that it received with deep interest the news that the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un proudly declared the great victory of the line on simultaneously developing the two fronts at the Third Plenary Meeting of the Seventh Central Committee of the WPK and set forth a new strategic line. It went on: The miraculous victory achieved by the Korean people serves as a victory common to the progressive mankind aspiring after independence and justice and a worldwide event. We are sure that the WPK and the Korean people will achieve greater success in the struggle for independence and peace in the future, too, under the seasoned leadership of HE Kim Jong Un. The Nigeria-Korea Friendship Association said that as they are led by HE Kim Jong Un, the Korean people would successfully implement the new strategic line of concentrating all efforts on the economic construction just as they achieved a great victory of the line on simultaneously developing the two fronts. The Mfumalanga Provincial Group for the Study of the Juche Idea of South Africa said: The work of science and education was set forth as a top-priority task at the Third Plenary Meeting of the Seventh Central Committee of the WPK. This shows again before the world the steadfast independent stand to hew out one's own way ahead by strengthening its own forces. The plenary meeting is of great significance as it is a historic meeting that created the milestone of epoch-making change in the history of building Juche-oriented socialism. We extend consistent support and solidarity to the Korean people who have turned out in the struggle for implementing the new strategic line. The chairman of the African Party for the Solidarity and Justice of Mali in its message sent to the Central Committee of the WPK on April 25 expressed full support to the decisions of the April Plenary Meeting of the WPK Central Committee. Rodong News Team

title: Foreign Heads of State Welcome North-South Summit and Talks
body: Heads of state of different countries welcomed the historic meeting and talks between the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and south Korean President Moon Jae In. Bolivian President Evo Morales said that he congratulated the meeting of the top leaders of the north and the south of Korea held for putting an end to the decades-long confrontation, adding that the meeting serves as a significant opportunity for ensuring peace of the planet and that the issue on the Korean peninsula can be certainly resolved free from U.S. interference. Colombian President Juan Manuel Santos noted that it is very impressive to see the top leaders of the north and the south of Korea holding their hands, adding the whole world might have been impressed. Welcoming the top leaders of the north and the south for signing the Panmunjom Declaration, Luis Guillermo Solis, president of Costa Rica, stressed that he positively supports all measures for peace and reunification on the Korean peninsula. Finnish President Sauli Niinisto stated that the north-south summit talks are very positive, adding that he hopes that such trend would continue. Brazilian President Michel Temer said he expects that the recent meeting and talks would lead to peace in the region. Cambodian Prime Minister Hun Sen noted that the historic meeting and talks held between the Supreme Leader of the DPRK and the south Korean president serve as a very significant occasion for ensuring permanent peace on the Korean peninsula. Lao Prime Minister Thong Loun Sisoulith welcomed the historic north-south summit talks that were successfully held, and stressed that the Panmunjom Declaration serves as an important base for ending the war on the Korean peninsula. Rodong News Team

title: Message of Sympathy to President of Kenya
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, sent a message of sympathy to Uhuru Kenyatta, president of Kenya, on Saturday in connection with huge human and material losses caused by the flood in Kenya. Kim in the message expressed sincere sympathy and consolation to the president of Kenya and through him, to its government and inhabitants in the flood-afflicted area. He wished the government and people of Kenya success in efforts to eradicate the damage at the earliest possible date and achieve socio-economic development of the country. Rodong News Team

title: Press Release of Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Democratic People's Republic of Korea
body: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea issued the following press release on Saturday: In accordance with the decision of the Third Plenary Meeting of the Seventh Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, the Nuclear Weapon Institute and other concerned institutions are taking technical measures for dismantling the northern nuclear test ground of the DPRK in order to ensure transparency of discontinuance of the nuclear test. A ceremony for dismantling the nuclear test ground is now scheduled between May 23 and 25, depending on weather condition. Dismantlement of the nuclear test ground will be done in the following sequence― making all tunnels of the test ground collapse by explosion; completely blocking entries; removing all observation facilities, research institutes and structures of guard units on the ground. In parallel with dismantlement of the nuclear test ground, guards and researchers will be withdrawn and the surrounding area of the test ground be completely closed. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the DPRK is authorized, in this regard, to release the following decisions. First, it has intention to allow not only the local press but also journalists of other countries to conduct on-the-spot coverage in order to show in a transparent manner the dismantlement of the northern nuclear test ground to be carried out in accordance with the decision of the Third Plenary Meeting of the Seventh Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. In due consideration of small space of the test ground, journalists from other countries will be confined to those from China, Russia, United States, United Kingdom and south Korea. Second, the following steps will be taken for providing convenience of visit and coverage to international journalists. 1) All international journalists will be provided with charter flight from Beijing to Wonsan, and other related steps such as opening territorial air space will be taken. 2) Special accommodation will be arranged in Wonsan for stay of the international journalists, and press center be set up for their use. 3) Special charter train will be arranged from Wonsan to the northern nuclear test ground for the international journalists. 4) In consideration of the fact that the test ground is located in the uninhabited deep mountain area, the international journalists will be accommodated in the special charter train and be provided with appropriate conveniences. 5) Necessary conditions and cooperation will be provided to the international journalists so that they can transmit at the press center about dismantlement of the test ground which they have covered on the spot. The DPRK will, in the future, too, promote close contacts and dialogue with the neighboring countries and the international society so as to safeguard peace and stability on the Korean peninsula and over the globe. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung Lauded by Foreign Media
body: Foreign media carried special write-ups illustrated with portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung on the occasion of his birth anniversary. The Iranian Ilna and the Bangladeshi paper Daily Folk aired that the President left marks never to be written off in the history of world diplomacy with his transparent independent diplomacy in his lifetime, reporting some facts among lots of them. The Lao newspapers Pasason and Pathet Lao lauded the exploits performed by the President for the foundation and development of the DPRK, saying that it has held HE Kim Il Sung as the eternal President in high esteem for the great exploits he performed. The Thai paper Xing San Daily and the Myanmar paper The New Age introduced the rare ideological and theoretical wisdom of the President and his art of leadership and noble personality and the fact that monumental structures have been continuously built in the DPRK under the wise leadership of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. The Belarusian newspaper Buperyod stressed that so great are the merits of the President as the founder of the Korean Party, army and state and ever-victorious iron-willed commander who defeated the U.S. and Japanese imperialists in one generation. The German paper Rote Fahne reported: President Kim Il Sung made great efforts for bringing up the Korean people to be strong in the spirit of independence. He always believed in the people and led the revolution and construction by relying on their strength. Under his leadership the Korean people could make astonishing miracles and innovations in the socialist construction. His love for the people is associated with every place in the DPRK. So the Korean people are holding him as the benevolent father and eternal leader in high esteem. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korea: U.S. Urged to Admit Its Involvement in Kwangju Massacre
body: The May 18 students' inspection team of south Korea held a press conference outside the U.S. embassy in Seoul on May 12, urging the U.S. to admit its interference in the Kwangju massacre and offer an apology, according to the south Korean internet newspaper Jaju Sibo. Speakers at the conference denounced the U.S. for denying its interference in the massacre and turning its face away from the truth about the crime. They contended that the U.S. should admit its crime as protector and instigator of the massacre and make an apology for it. The team also called a press conference outside the house of traitor Chun Doo-Hwan that day, demanding his appearance at court. Rodong News Team

title: Inter-Korean Summit Hailed Abroad
body: A solidarity meeting and film shows took place in Nepal and Nigeria between April 28 and May 3 in congratulation of the 3rd inter-Korean summit. Screened at the shows was a Korean film dealing with the Panmunjom summit. Speakers at the solidarity meeting in Nepal highly lauded the feats of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un who provided the north-south summit to usher in a new era of peace, prosperity and reunification of the Korean peninsula. Adopted at the meeting were decisions on intensifying the activities to widely introduce the exploits President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il performed for the country and its people, the times and history among the Nepalese people. Personages of Nigeria said Kim Jong Un is steering the world trend toward peace and reunification of the Korean peninsula and that the Panmunjom Declaration serves as a fresh landmark for reunifying Korea. The exploits of Kim Jong Un who brought about a turning phase in developing the inter-Korean relations with his distinguished leadership will shine long, they stressed, wishing the Korean people great success in their struggle for national reunification. A seminar on the theme of "Peace on the Korean peninsula" took place in Firenze of Italy on May 4. Rodong News Team

title: 21st Pyongyang Spring Int'l Trade Fair to Be Held
body: The 21st Pyongyang Spring International Trade Fair is to be held at the Three-Revolution Exhibition House from May 21 to 25. The fair will bring together more than 260 companies from the DPRK, China, Iran and other countries. Presented to it will be high-tech products with strong competitiveness in electronics, machinery, building materials, transport, health care, light industry and food and consumer goods industries. Rodong News Team

title: Unpardonable Provocation against Dialogue Partner
body: In a statement issued on the occasion of "week for freedom" recently, the U.S. Department of State hurled mud at the DPRK, talking about "suppression", "violence" and "human rights abuses". And it blustered that "maximum pressure" would be maintained. At a press conference held on the next day, a spokesperson for the U.S. Department of State revealed the U.S. scheme to table the "human rights issue" at the talks, saying that they "clearly referred to the human rights situation in the DPRK" in the recently-published "report on human rights practices" and that they never stepped back from the issue. Meanwhile, the south Korean Ministry of Unification held a "consultative meeting on the policy of human rights in the north", at which discussion was made on a proposal for "promoting the human rights in the north" and the issue of setting up a "foundation for human rights in the north". It is an unpardonable challenge and blatant infringement upon the dignity and sovereignty of the DPRK. The U.S. gets hell-bent on putting pressure on the DPRK, raising the non-existent "human rights issue" ahead of the DPRK-U.S. dialogue. This is a senseless act of disregarding elementary etiquette towards the dialogue partner. For the U.S. to cling to the provocative anti-DPRK "human rights" racket is little short of turning the trend of dialogue and peace back to the phase of confrontation and tension and, this may spoil the last hard-won opportunity of solving the issue. Jo Nam Su

title: To Remove Obstacles to Reunification Is Demand of Times
body: It is important to remove obstacles lying in the way of reunification in order to open up the new era of national reconciliation, unity, peace and prosperity through the successful implementation of the April 27 declaration. This is an issue drawn from the lesson taught by the history of the checkered north-south ties. The Korean nation bitterly cursed traitor Park Chung-Hee, "yusin" dictator who went mad to create "two Koreas" with the backing of outsiders while crying out for "confrontation accompanied by dialogue" even after agreeing on the three principles of national reunification early in the 1970s. After taking office ten years ago from now, traitor Lee Myung Bak turned back the June 15 era full of enthusiasm and confidence into the past era of confrontation. It was a hideous act of treachery surpassing the anti-reunification moves of the "yusin" dictator. The group of traitors insulted the valuable June 15 era of reunification as a "lost decade" and asserted that "June 15-type reunification can never be allowed", invoking anti-reunification fascist laws and fundamentally blocking dialogue and cooperation between the north and the south. Traitor Park Geun Hye who followed him put into active use the anti-reunification mechanism which her predecessors used to check the national reconciliation and unity and the improvement of the north-south ties, kicking up the racket for confrontation with the fellow countrymen. The traitor also worked with bloodshot eyes in the moves to stifle the DPRK in collusion with outsiders out of the intention to hurt the fellow countrymen. The policy for confrontation pursued by the south Korean group of conservatives in a consecutive way and its anti-reunification mechanisms are a serious stumbling block lying in the way of the nation's reconciliation and unity and the cause of national reunification. It becomes an urgent requirement today to remove all sorts of obstacles in the way of reunification, which are not beneficial to the improvement of the north-south ties and national reunification. Pak Chol Jun

title: Decisions of WPK Central Committee Hailed in Bulgaria
body: The Bulgarian Group for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism issued a statement on May 3 in support of the decisions made at the Third Plenary Meeting of the Seventh Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and the Panmunjom Declaration. The statement said: The Korean people won a great victory in implementing the strategic line of simultaneously pushing forward the economic construction and the building of a nuclear force in a short period. As a result, they came to have a powerful treasured sword capable of defending their right to existence and reliably guaranteeing peace on the Korean peninsula. The decisions made at the above-said meeting serve as a signal contribution to ensuring peace in the Korean peninsula and the rest of the world.
