The Korean people will speed up the economic construction by dint of science and technology and self-reliance. The DPRK's pro-active measures created a climate of détente on the Korean peninsula. We fully support the inter-Korean summit Comrade Kim Jong Un had with President Moon Jae In and the Panmunjom Declaration signed by them. To replace the Armistice Agreement with a peace pact is an important step for ensuring peace on the Korean peninsula. We hope that the friendly Korean people will certainly reunify the country. Rodong News Team

title: Friendship Visiting Group of WPK Leaves for China
body: A friendship visiting group of the Workers' Party of Korea led by Pak Thae Song, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of its Central Committee, left Pyongyang on Monday to visit the People's Republic of China. It arrived in Beijing that day. Rodong News Team

title: Credentials of Indian Ambassador to DPRK Accepted
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, received credentials from Atul M. Gotsurve, Indian ambassador to the DPRK, at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Monday. He had a talk with the ambassador. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korean Conservatives Must Be Brought to Justice
body: The disgusting "Liberal Korea Party" group in south Korea made a spectacle of themselves, which is frowned upon by the public. From May 3 Kim Song Thae, floor leader of the LKP, and other riff-raff of it pitched a tent and staged a hunger strike outside the "National Assembly" to demand a special inspection of the scandal called an election rigging. The despicable behavior of the LKP is a hysterical fit of those who are marginalized from the stream of the times and doomed to death. The LKP group takes advantage of the said case in a bid to better their fate that was sealed after being marginalized from the trend of the times toward independent reunification and to get sympathy of the public, but to no avail. Hell is now open for the LKP, so it will only face the cold shoulder, shame and doom no matter how desperately it may struggle to stir up the public and attain its sinister purpose. The LKP coteries must think themselves why they face the curse and accusation from the public, before trumpeting about "terror" and "probe into truth", and face justice of history. If they continue to behave as now, the conservative group as a whole will get severe punishment and be taken into a grave tomorrow, though a single floor leader is punched today. Sim Chol Yong

title: Last-Ditch Efforts of Those Driven to Wretched Plight
body: Japanese Prime Minister Abe made sophism, during his recent foreign trip, that the DPRK should definitely and comprehensively abandon nuclear program and it is necessary to stop missile launches which put Japan in strike range. And Chief Cabinet Secretary Suga reeled off remarks that the DPRK's denuclearization should be done in a complete, verifiable and irreversible way. This is nothing but desperate efforts to escape from its situation getting deplorable day by day. Japan is denied access to the venue for discussing the issue of peace, the destiny of the Korean peninsula and the region, and it is left out alone by everyone as it is regarded as a trouble-maker creating only complexities. There is a way for it to evade the fate of being left out alone in the region. It is to give up its hostile policy towards the DPRK. Japanese politicians would be well advised once again to unconditionally remove chronic and bad habit of getting hostile to the DPRK if they have a bit of reason. If Japan continues to persist in its hostile policy towards the DPRK, it would face only isolation and political bankruptcy in the region. Ri Hak Nam

title: Indian Foreign Ministry Delegation Arrives
body: A delegation of the Indian Foreign Ministry headed by Vijay Kumar Singh, minister of the State for External Affairs, arrived in Pyongyang on Tuesday. The DPRK Foreign Ministry hosted a reception for the delegation on the same day. Rodong News Team

title: Panmunjom Declaration Backed by Indian Personages
body: Personages of Indian political parties and organizations released a joint statement on April 28 in support of the Panmunjom Declaration. They included Atul Kumar Anjan, secretary of the National Council of the Communist Party of India and chairman of the All India Indo-Korean Friendship Association, Harising Khang, member of the C.C., Communist Party of India (Marxist), G. Debarajan, secretary of the C.C., All-India Forward Bloc, and Vijay Jolly, senior leader of the Indian People's Party. In the statement they extended warm congratulations to respected HE Kim Jong Un who opened a new chapter for peace and prosperity in the Korean Peninsula. Clarified in the historic Panmunjom Declaration are the ways for putting an end to the decades-long division and confrontation and achieving the reconciliation, reunification and prosperity of the Korean nation, the statement noted, saying: This makes it possible for the Korean nation, divided by foreign forces, to advance along the road of peace and progress by its concerted efforts. The cause of Korea's reunification, the desire of HE Kim Il Sung and HE Kim Jong Il, will be surely accomplished. We extend support and solidarity to the struggle of the Korean people for implementing the Panmunjom Declaration provided by the iron will and bold decision of HE Kim Jong Un to defend the peace in the Korean Peninsula and the rest of the world. Rodong News Team

title: KCNA Blasts U.S. and S. Korea for Staging Large-scale Military Drill against DPRK
body: KCNA made public the following report on May 16: The south Korean authorities, together with the U.S., have been staging the large-scale 2018 Max Thunder joint air combat drill throughout south Korea since May 11 in a bid to make a preemptive air strike at the DPRK and win the air. Involved in the drill are more than 100 fighters of various missions including a B-52 strategic nuclear bomber and F-22 Raptor stealth fighters of the U.S. forces. The drill is to last till May 25, under the supervision of the U.S. imperialist aggressor forces in south Korea and the south Korean air force. Public opinions at home and abroad comment that the maneuver is the largest-ever and a reflection of the invariable stand of the U.S. and south Korea to persist in the "maximum pressure and sanctions" against the DPRK. The DPRK-targeted drill across south Korea is an undisguised challenge to the Panmunjom Declaration and a deliberate military provocation to the trend of the favorably developing situation on the Korean Peninsula. The north and the south of Korea solemnly stated in the declaration that a new peace era was ushered in and reached an agreement on making joint efforts to defuse the acute military tensions on the peninsula and substantially ease the danger of war. The U.S., too, expressed full support to it. However, even before the ink of the historic April 27 Declaration got dry, the south Korean authorities and the U.S. started such a drill against the DPRK, reacting to all the peace-loving efforts and good intentions shown by the DPRK with rude and wicked provocation and arousing serious concern and disappointment among all the fellow countrymen and the international community wanting the declaration to be implemented. If the U.S. and the south Korean authorities regard the phase of improving inter-Korean ties and the DPRK-U.S. dialogue provided by the proactive and broadminded efforts and measures of the DPRK as something allowed any time and any hour, then they are sadly mistaken. The south Korean authorities, in particular, are resorting to such improper acts quite contrary to the promise to make efforts for the peace, prosperity and reunification of the peninsula together with the north and leaving even human scum to brazenly hurl mud at the dignity of the supreme leadership of the DPRK and its system and play down the Panmunjom Declaration at the building of the "National Assembly". There is a limit in showing goodwill and offering opportunity. The historic Panmunjom Declaration cannot be implemented by the efforts of a single party, and it can result in a good fruition only when the two parties create favorable conditions and climate by pooling their efforts. We cannot but take a step of suspending the north-south high-level talks scheduled on May 16 under the awful situation that a reckless north-targeted war and confrontation racket is being kicked up in south Korea. The south Korean authorities, lost to all senses, should be held wholly accountable for the scuttled north-south high-level talks and the difficulties and obstacles in the way of the north-south relations. The U.S. will have to think twice about the fate of the DPRK-U.S. summit now on high agenda in light of the provocative military racket against the DPRK in league with the south Korean authorities. We will closely watch the ensuing behavior of the U.S. and the south Korean authorities. Rodong News Team

title: Italian Lawmaker Arrives
body: Antonio Razzi, chairman of the Italy-Korea Friendship Parliamentary Group, and his party arrived in Pyongyang on Tuesday. Rodong News Team

title: Russian Delegation Visits Mangyongdae
body: A delegation of the Amur Regional Branch Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation headed by Roman Kobizov, member of the C.C., Communist Party of the Russian Federation and first secretary of its Amur Regional Branch Committee, visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. At the time-honored old home of the President the guests looked round the historical relics, being briefed on his revolutionary career. The delegation also toured the Tower of the Juche Idea, the Korean Revolution Museum, the Ryuwon Footwear Factory, the Liberation Tower, etc. Rodong News Team

title: Sci-Tech Presentation and Exhibition in Field of Welding Opens
body: A national sci-tech presentation and exhibition in the field of welding was opened with due ceremony at the Pyongyang Thermal Power Complex on Tuesday, under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea. More than 70 papers and exhibits are presented to it with attendance of scientists, technicians, teachers, researchers and graduate students from scores of units, including the Welding Institute of the State Academy of Sciences, Kim Chaek University of Technology, Pyongyang University of Architecture and Pyongyang University of Railways. There will be lectures on new technologies and a work for showing during the presentation and exhibition, which will last till May 18. Rodong News Team

title: National Industrial Art Exhibition Closes
body: The national industrial art exhibition for celebrating the Day of the Sun closed with due ceremony at the National Industrial Art Exhibition House on Tuesday. The exhibition on the theme of "Great Heyday of Juche Industrial Art Development" was opened on April 6 to celebrate the 106th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Presented to it were more than 1 500 designs, products, models and video clips showing the appearance of the Korean industrial art making a leaping progress. The exhibition marked an important occasion in putting the nation's industrial art on a world level in the shortest time and further arousing the social attention to the industrial art. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Guides 1st Enlarged Meeting of 7th WPK Central Military Commission
body: The 1st Enlarged Meeting of the 7th Central Military Commission of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) took place. The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un guided the enlarged meeting. Attending it were members of the WPK Central Military Commission, commanding officers of military services and corps level and senior officials of the armed forces organs and the WPK Central Committee. The meeting discussed and decided on a series of organizational measures to further strengthen the revolutionary army of the Party militarily and politically and improve the overall work for defending the country as required by the developing revolution and on the basis of the comprehensive analysis of the present actual state of the People's Army. It also dealt with the organizational matter on relieving and appointing some members of the WPK Central Military Commission and relieving or transferring senior officials of the armed forces organs and appointing new ones. At the meeting the Supreme Leader analyzed and reviewed the implementation of the military and political tasks of the People's Army after the Seventh WPK Congress and indicated the main orientation and ways of the army building and the military activities, including the issues of establishing more thoroughly the Party's monolithic command system across the revolutionary armed forces, establishing the revolutionary military discipline, consistently holding fast to the Party's policies of bringing about a radical improvement in military training, pressing ahead with the ideological revolution and putting the army on a modern basis, and improving the military life. He stressed that the whole army should firmly safeguard and reliably guarantee the all-people struggle for implementing the decisions of the 3rd Plenum of the 7th WPK Central Committee with the matchless bayonet. Noting with high appreciation that the People's Army has fulfilled its duty as the vanguard and main force of the revolution on every major front of the socialist economic construction under the slogan of "Let us take charge of both national defence and socialist construction", he expressed the expectation and belief that it would always maintain its revolutionary character and nature as the army of the Party and the leader and creditably discharge its sacred mission and duty it has assumed before the country and the people in the future, too. Political News Team

title: Italian Lawmaker Visits Mangyongdae
body: Antonio Razzi, chairman of the Italy-Korea Friendship Parliamentary Group, and his party visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. The guests looked round the historical relics, being briefed on his revolutionary career. They also toured Pyongyang Teacher Training College, the Pyongyang Electric Cable Factory 326, etc. Rodong News Team

title: Spanish Delegation Leaves
body: The delegation of the Elcano Royal Institute of Spain led by Executive Director Charles Tito Powell Solares left Pyongyang for home on Thursday. During the stay in the DPRK, the delegation visited Mangyongdae, the Tower of the Juche Idea, the Korean Revolution Museum, Kim Il Sung University, etc. Rodong News Team

title: Indian Foreign Ministry Delegation Leaves
body: A delegation of the Indian Foreign Ministry headed by Vijay Kumar Singh, minister of the State for External Affairs, left Pyongyang for home on Thursday. Rodong News Team

title: WPK Friendship Visiting Group Meets Xi Jinping
body: A friendship visiting group of the Workers' Party of Korea led by Pak Thae Song, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of its Central Committee, on a visit to the People's Republic of China, met with Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and president of the People's Republic of China (PRC) at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing on May 16. Welcoming the friendship group's visit to China, Xi Jinping said that China is attaching very importance to the work to propel the traditional friendship between the two countries sealed in blood to a higher stage as required by the new era. He noted with pleasure that he met Chairman Kim Jong Un two times and exchanged the comprehensive and detailed views on the matters of concern including the development of the relations between the two parties and the two countries and the regional and international situation and reached the common understanding with him. Saying that the international community is extending widespread approval and support for the new strategic line Chairman Kim Jong Un set forth at the Third Plenum of the Seventh WPK Central Committee and China, too, highly appreciates it, he hoped that both sides would exchange experience in party and state building and intensify the unity, thus jointly propelling the cause of socialism in the two countries. Pak Thae Song expressed thanks to General Secretary Xi Jinping for paying special attention to the friendship group of the WPK's visit to China, and said that the visit would serve as an important occasion in making positive contribution to further consolidating and developing the traditional DPRK-China friendship. He referred to the fact that the Korean party and people are concentrating all their efforts on the economic construction, true to the new strategic line advanced at the Third Plenum of the Seventh WPK Central Committee. Sincerely wishing the Chinese people greater development in the building of socialism with the Chinese characteristics in the new era under the leadership of the Communist Party of China with General Secretary Xi Jinping as its core, Pak said that the exchange and cooperation in various fields would be strengthened to put the agreements reached by the top leaders of the two parties into practice. The conversation proceeded in a comradely and friendly atmosphere. Rodong News Team

title: Unchanged U.S. Ambition for World Hegemony
body: Some days ago, the U.S. House of Representatives shaped a bill on national defense right for fiscal 2019 which included the military budget to the tune of 717 billion U.S. dollars. Such huge military spending is used to maintain the U.S. military bases and various types of military hardware deployed in all most of regions and continents and the Department of Defense and other mechanisms, form new armed forces and develop cutting-edge military technology, etc. It shows that the U.S. is seeking to block multi-polarization of the world and keep the unipolar world at any cost. The U.S. has not given up even a moment its wild design to change the world in its favor, dominating it single-handedly. It regards military spending as the size of strength. After the end of the Cold War, the U.S. military appropriation has always been many times higher than the world's second largest nation in military spending, which is much more than the military spending of major powers put together. In the U.S., the military spending has been increased every year, though its economy has fallen into stagnation due to the swelling trade and financial deficits. The U.S. is running high fever in military reinforcement to check the military influence of its potential rivals and their expansion of sphere of force in the Pacific, the Atlantic, the Indian Ocean, etc. and other regions and continents and establish its supremacy over this planet. China, Russia and all other countries that challenge the unipolar world by the U.S. are regarded as targets of obstacle lying in the way of realizing "peace by strength". The U.S. ambition to dominate the world with strength remains unchanged in any case. Son Yong Nam

title: Message of Sympathy to Indonesian President
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, sent a message of sympathy to Joko Widodo, president of Indonesia, on Wednesday as regards the suicidal explosion in East Java of Indonesia that claimed huge casualties. Kim in the message expressed deep sympathy and consolation to the president, the victims and the bereaved families. Reiterating the consistent stand of the DPRK government against all forms of terrorism, he hoped that the Indonesian government would register achievements in exterminating terrorism and ensuring social stability. Rodong News Team

title: Enlarged Plenary Meeting of C.C., Youth League Held
body: The 7th enlarged plenary meeting of the 9th Central Committee of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League was held in Pyongyang. Present there were members and alternate members of the Central Committee of the youth league and league officials. Discussed at the meeting was the issue of carrying out the tasks set forth by the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un at the 3rd Plenary Meeting of the 7th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Pak Chol Min, first secretary of the C.C., the youth league, in his report stressed the need to give priority to the work for more thoroughly establishing the Party's monolithic leadership system and to conduct in an offensive way the political and ideological work so that all the youths would take the lead in implementing the decisions at the April Plenary Meeting of the WPK Central Committee. He called on all the youth league officials to become devoted fighters and energetic performers who have the same breath with youth league members at the sites for the great upswing and arouse the masses to implementing the Party's lines and policies by practice rather than by precept. The meeting underlined the need for all the young people to positively turn out in implementing the Party's plan to successfully settle the sci-tech problems arising in the development of the country's economy and the improvement of the people's standard of living and make the country a sea of talents by making a great revolution in education under the strategic slogan "Let us make a leap forward by dint of science and guarantee the future by dint of education!" Rodong News Team

title: Enlarged Plenary Meeting of C.C., GFTUK
body: The 6th enlarged plenary meeting of the 7th Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea (GFTUK) took place in Pyongyang on Wednesday. Present there were members and alternate members of the C.C., GFTUK and officials of the federation. The meeting discussed how to carry out the tasks set forth by the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un at the Third Plenary Meeting of the Seventh Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. A report was made at the meeting before speeches. The reporter and speakers said that trade union organizations at all levels should conduct the political and ideological education in an offensive way to make all the union members deeply grasp the spirit and tasks of the Third Plenary Meeting of the Seventh WPK Central Committee and the essence and validity of the Party's new strategic line and inspiringly arouse them to their implementation. They also mentioned the problems arising in conducting various mass movements to implement the Party's economic policies to the letter. They expressed the will to fully display the revolutionary spirit of the heroic Korean working class in the struggle to implement the decisions of the April 2018 Plenary Meeting of the WPK Central Committee. Rodong News Team

title: Russian Party Delegation Leaves
body: A delegation of the Amur Regional Branch Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation led by Roman Kobizov, member of the C.C., Communist Party of the Russian Federation and first secretary of its Amur Regional Branch Committee, left Pyongyang for home on Friday. Rodong News Team

title: Let Us Decisively Cope with Psychological Campaign of Imperialists
body: The imperialists are resorting to crafty psychological smear campaign along with the policy of strength to topple anti-imperialist independent countries. If one is taken in by the psychological campaign of the imperialists, one does not believe in one's own strength, loses conviction in justice and victory of one's cause and can not but surrender and turn one's coat. The situation urgently requires to decisively cope with the imperialists' psychological campaign. To foil the imperialists' base and vicious psychological campaign is an important way of defending the sovereignty of the country and the nation and victoriously advancing the cause of global independence. It is necessary to bring up the army and people to be strong in faith. Those with strong revolutionary faith and will are never afraid of the enemies nor will take a step backward. The DPRK is demonstrating its might as the power of Juche despite any tempests. This is because its army and people are transparent in their faith. As they are firmly equipped with the revolutionary idea of our party, the Juche idea, and are confident of the justice of the cause of the Juche revolution and the inevitability of its victory, they are never shaken by any psychological campaign of the imperialists. Ra Myong Song

title: World Red Cross and Red Crescent Day Observed
body: There took place a meeting for introducing Red Cross activities at the Taedonggang Diplomatic Club on Thursday to observe World Red Cross and Red Crescent Day. It was co-sponsored by the DPRK Red Cross Society and delegations of the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies and the International Committee of the Red Cross working in the DPRK. Present there were Paek Yong Ho, executive vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the DPRK Red Cross Society, officials concerned, the members of the delegations of the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies and the International Committee of the Red Cross and foreign embassies and missions of international bodies here. Introduced at the meeting were the achievements made in the past work of the DPRK Red Cross Society and the activities of the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies and the International Committee of the Red Cross. The participants watched a video on the activities of the DPRK Red Cross Society for the prevention of flu. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Comes First in Asian Taekwon-Do Championship
body: DPRK players proved successful at the 9th Asian Taekwon-Do Championship held in Ulan Bator of Mongolia from May 8 to 13. In the championship, which brought together more than 140 men and women Taekwondoists from 13 countries and regions including the DPRK, China, Mongolia, India, Iran and Malaysia, the players from the DPRK took the first place in country standings by winning five trophy cups, 29 gold medals, 8 silver medals and 6 bronze medals. The players returned home on Thursday. Rodong News Team

title: Chinese Delegation in Pyongyang
body: A delegation of the China Dongfangyi Tuozhan Association led by Chairman Guo Yi arrived in Pyongyang on Thursday. Rodong News Team

title: Skilled Workers' Contest Opens
body: A contest of skilled workers with different jobs in various sectors of national economy-2018 opened in the DPRK. The contest, divided into such occupational categories as welder, pipe-maker, caster and plasterer, will be participated in by more than 650 skilled workers selected in the earlier contests of skilled workers sponsored by ministries, national institutions and provincial people's committees. Its opening ceremony took place at the Central Hall of Workers on Thursday. Present there were O Su Yong, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Vice-Premier Ro Tu Chol, chairman of the State Planning Commission, officials of ministries and national institutions, organs and enterprises in Pyongyang, labor innovators and participants of the contest. Ro Tu Chol made an opening address. Rodong News Team

title: Enlarged Plenary Meeting of C.C., UAWK
body: The 7th enlarged plenary meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea (UAWK) took place in Pyongyang on Thursday. The meeting discussed how to carry through the tasks set forth by the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un at the Third Plenary Meeting of the Seventh Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. At the meeting, a reporter and speakers called upon the UAWK organizations at all levels to conduct effectively the ideological education in various forms and methods so as to encourage the union members to carry out the tasks advanced at the April Plenary Meeting of the C.C., WPK. They underscored the need to attain the grain production goal set in the five-year strategy for national economic development and increase livestock production. They called for scrupulously conducting education and the guidance over the organizational life to enhance the qualifications and responsibility of the union teachers of schools in rural areas and for establishing a climate of prioritizing science and education. Members and alternate members of the UAWK Central Committee and officials of the union participated in the meeting. Rodong News Team

title: Enlarged Plenary Meeting of C.C., SWUK
body: The 6th enlarged plenary meeting of the 6th Central Committee of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea (SWUK) was held in Pyongyang on Thursday. The meeting discussed the issue of carrying through the tasks set forth by the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un at the 3rd Plenary Meeting of the 7th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). At the meeting a reporter and speakers stressed the need for the union organizations to intensify the political and ideological work among its members so that they can deeply grasp the new strategic line advanced by the Party and dynamically turn out in the revolutionary general offensive, the grand march for economic construction. They said that the union organizations should enhance their militant function and role in every way and the union officials should become standard-bearers and engines inspiringly arousing its members to the grand march. They also underscored the need to establish the traits of attaching the utmost importance to science and education including giving priority to the educational work, respecting and cordially treating the scientists, technicians and teachers and helping their families well. Present at the meeting were members and alternate members of the SWUK Central Committee and officials of the union. Rodong News Team

title: Chinese Delegation Pays Respects to Statues of Kim Il Sung, Kim Jong Il
body: A delegation of the Dongfangyi Tuozhan Association of China visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill Thursday. The members of the delegation laid bouquets before the statues of the great leaders and paid tribute to them. Rodong News Team

body: A delegation of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League headed by Secretary of its Central Committee Jong Yong Won left Pyongyang on Saturday to attend the meeting of the General Council of the World Federation of Democratic Youth due in Nepal. Rodong News Team
