title: Self-Reliance Is Tradition of Juche Korea's Struggle
body: Self-reliance is a tradition of the Korean people's struggle and an invincible revolutionary spirit the might of which has been proved in the whole historical course of the Korean revolution. The revolutionary spirit of self-reliance, created during the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, became a tradition of the Korean people's struggle and their spirit and ushered in a new era of creating a thing out of nothing. Thanks to the solid foundations for the independent economy, the Korean people could successfully carry out the huge tasks for economic construction despite the harshest-ever economic blockade by the hostile forces to stamp out the country's sovereignty and rights to existence and development in recent years. Had they yielded to the pressure by outsiders, instead of believing in their strength, and abandoned the principle of self-reliance, socialist Korea of Juche would not have emerged on this planet and its nomenclature might have disappeared along with the collapse of the world socialist system. The history of the victorious Korean revolution clearly proves that there are neither difficulties insurmountable nor fortresses unconquerable if one has the spirit of self-reliance. Self-reliance is, indeed, the tradition of Juche Korea's struggle and the dynamics for its victorious advance. It is the fixed will and faith of the Korean people to build a prospering powerful socialist nation by dint of self-reliance and thus bring into reality the idea of independence and happiness. Ri Hak Nam

title: Editorial
body: Let Us Successfully Attain Grain Production Goal In order to successfully carry into practice the plan and determination of the Workers' Party of Korea to make a decisive turn in the development of the country's economy and improvement of its people's living standard, it is necessary to do farming well above all and direct all efforts to the rice-transplanting campaign as an immediate task. This year's rice-transplanting serves as an important political work for making a breakthrough for victory in the revolutionary general offensive of implementing the WPK's new strategic line, the general advance for economic construction, and as a campaign for implementing and defending the WPK's idea and policy meant to prove in practice the validity and vitality of the WPK's policy of scientific farming. The agricultural workers are just responsible for rice-transplanting. All of them should fully display their patriotic devotion in the rice-transplanting campaign with a noble sense of obligation that their farm fields are just part of the homeland they are defending. The whole Party and country and all the people should tangibly help the farm villages in terms of manpower and materials. All sectors and units of the national economy should supply in time manpower, equipment and materials needed for rice-transplanting unconditionally on the principle of subordinating everything to farming. All the people should make a breakthrough in rich harvest by successfully concluding the rice-transplanting campaign by dint of the single-minded unity in which they share their idea and feelings with the Party, and thus bring bumper harvests to all farm fields without fail this significant year.

title: WPK's New Strategic Line and Panmunjom Declaration Supported Abroad
body: Foreign political parties and organizations hailed the decisions of the Third Plenary Meeting of the Seventh Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and the Panmunjom Declaration. The Mfumalanga Provincial Committee of the South African Communist Party and the South African Association of Friendship and Solidarity with Korean People said in their statements on May 7 that the Third Plenary Meeting of the Seventh WPK Central Committee was a political event of great significance in accomplishing the socialist cause of Juche. They stressed that the DPRK came to advance along the road for final victory more dynamically with the plenary meeting as an occasion. They said that the historic Panmunjom summit was a brilliant fruition of ardent patriotism and firm will of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un to build a dignified and prosperous power by the concerted efforts of the nation. The Socialist Party of Senegal in a statement on May 11 hailed the new strategic line set forth at the April plenary meeting of the C.C., WPK and the Panmunjom Declaration. Besides, statements and a congratulatory letter in support of the decisions of the April Plenary Meeting of the WPK Central Committee were made public between April 25 and May 1 by the Japan Committee for the Independent and Peaceful Reunification of Korea, Japan Matsumoto Citizen's Council for Supporting the Independent and Peaceful Reunification of Korea, Gunma Prefectural Council for Japan-Korea Friendship and Solidarity and the Japan-Korea Society for Scientific and Educational Interchange. Rodong News Team

title: Symposium on Cosmetics
body: A national symposium on cosmetics took place at the Pyongyang Cosmetics Factory from May 16 to 18 under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea. Participating in it were scientists, technicians, teachers and officials of several units including the Ministry of Consumer Goods Industry, the Pyongyang Cosmetics Factory, the Sinuiju Cosmetics Factory, the State Academy of Sciences, Kim Il Sung University and the Pyongyang Han Tok Su University of Light Industry. More than 60 papers were introduced at the symposium divided into two panels. There were also a lecture and video show. Rodong News Team

title: Editorial
body: Let Us Bring about Revolutionary Turn in Science and Education The scientists and technicians and educators of the DPRK have turned out in the drive for hastening the victory of building a powerful socialist country by bringing about a revolutionary turn in the work of science and education under the leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). The Third Plenary Meeting of the Seventh Central Committee of the WPK set forth a new strategic line of concentrating all efforts on socialist economic construction, reflecting the requirement of the developing revolution, and discussed and decided on the issue of bringing about a revolutionary turn in the work of science and education for implementing it. Attaching importance to science and education is a consistent policy of our Party. "Let us make a leap forward by dint of science and guarantee the future by dint of education!" This strategic slogan reflects the firm will of our Party to gain the higher goal of socialist construction ahead of schedule by putting spurs to the building of a science and technology power and a talents power and to glorify Juche Korea as a prosperous socialist state and the best powerful country of the people. Great changes and leaps unprecedented in 5 000-year-long history of the nation are taking place in our country. The dignity and national power of the DPRK reach the highest ground, a new history of putting the national economy on a Juche, modern, IT and scientific basis opens and praiseworthy successes are being made in the drive to break through the cutting edge. These are the precious fruition of the foresightedness and wise leadership of our Party which has given priority to the development of science and technology and the training of talents despite the severe trials. Our revolution will courageously tide over any difficulties and more vigorously advance faster as there is the leadership of the Party attaching most importance to science and education and taking positive measures for their development.

title: Dependence on Outsiders Ruins Country
body: All countries and nations should cultivate and bolster their own strength and resolve everything with recourse to it in order to achieve independent development and prosperity. Dependence on others is a very dangerous virus which makes a nation mean and weak and ruins a country. Now that the imperialists are getting more desperate in their moves to dominate other countries and nations and the world, to try to get benefit from outsiders while depending on them, instead of depending on his strength, is just as foolish as an act of ruining oneself. The countries aspiring to independence and progress should not depend on others but carve out their destiny independently and creatively in order to preserve their political independence and achieve economic prosperity. When a country faces socio-economic difficulties and harsher pressure by the imperialist and hegemonic forces, it should advance, firmly believing in its strength. If it vacillates even a bit, it just leads to an irretrievable flop. The experience of the DPRK which has emerged victorious without any failure and frustration in its line clearly proves that self-reliance is just an ever-victorious weapon. Ri Hak Nam

title: Russian Organization Hails Climate of Reconciliation and Reunification in Korea
body: The Russian Group for Solidarity with the DPRK issued a statement on May 10 supporting the atmosphere of reconciliation and reunification being created on the Korean peninsula thanks to the guidance of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. The statement said that the group was viewing with emotion the fresh changes being made on the Korean peninsula thanks to the strategy of Kim Jong Un. It noted that the whole world is stunned by his wisdom and positively appreciates the stand of the party and government of the DPRK for détente and peace on the Korean peninsula. The recent successes registered under his guidance greatly encourage the Korean people in their struggle for economic construction, it said, adding: We wish the Korean peninsula durable peace and the Korean people bigger advance in their struggle for building socialism. Rodong News Team

title: Panmunjom Declaration Supported by Syrian Political Party
body: The Regional Leadership of the Syria's Baath Arab Socialist Party issued a statement on April 30 in support of the historic Panmunjom Declaration. The statement fully supported and welcomed all agreements made at the Panmunjom summit meeting, noting: The Panmunjom Declaration reconfirmed the common desire of the Korean nation for achieving the reunification and prosperity of the Korean peninsula. We positively support the independent stand of the Workers' Party of Korea and the DPRK to reunify the country and put an end to the outsiders' interference in the internal affairs of the Korean peninsula. All victories won by the Korean people in their struggle for ensuring peace and reunifying the country on the Korean peninsula mean the victory won by the progressive people to defend sovereignty. Extending warm congratulations to the friendly Korean people, we will steadily develop the cooperative relations with the WPK in the joint struggle for building a free and prosperous new world. Rodong News Team

title: Foreigners Visit Mangyongdae
body: Foreign guests to take part in the 21st Pyongyang Spring International Trade Fair on Sunday visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. They laid bouquets at the President's old home in Mangyongdae. Being briefed on the revolutionary history of the President and the careers of his family members in Mangyongdae, they went round the historical relics. Rodong News Team

title: Red Herring Is U.S. Trite Method
body: Red herring is a trite trick of the U.S., master at plot-breeding, to bring down those countries incurring its displeasure. It has been proved by the history. A clear proof of it is the Korean War in the 1950s. After igniting the war, the U.S. became all the more pronounced in plot-breeding to lay the blame for it at the door of the DPRK by abusing the name of the United Nations. And it made desperate efforts to militarily occupy the whole of Korea by mobilizing the huge aggression forces including one third of its ground force, one fifth of its air force and most of its Pacific Fleet, armies of 15 satellite countries, south Korean forces and Japanese militarists. But the U.S. was seriously defeated for the first time in the history. The U.S. is now vociferating about the non-existent "human rights issue" of the DPRK. This is aimed to stifle the DPRK at any cost by inciting the atmosphere against it in the international arena. The U.S. and its vassal forces are conducting base red herring by mobilizing criminals and imposters, who are hurling mud at the DPRK after selling everything of human being for a petty amount of money and fabricating their names and careers. The U.S. has persistently denied the reality of the DPRK in a bid to prevent the deceptive nature of its false propaganda from being brought to light. All countries aspiring after the independence should remain vigilant against the U.S. red herring and resolutely smash it. Kim Sung Gol

title: Foreigners Arrive to Take Part in Pyongyang Spring International Trade Fair
body: A delegation of China and a delegate of Germany came to Pyongyang on Saturday to take part in the 21st Pyongyang Spring International Trade Fair. Arriving earlier were a delegation of Iran and a delegate of Italy. Rodong News Team

title: Message of Sympathy to Palestinian President
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK,on Thursday sent a message of sympathy to Mahmoud Abbas, president of the State of Palestine, in connection with the fact that thousands of casualties were caused by Israeli occupation troops' bloody clampdown on the Palestinian demonstrators protesting against the relocation of the U.S. embassy in Kuds. Kim in the message expressed deep condolences to the victims and their families. He vehemently denounced Israel for its brutal massacre and indiscriminate use of violence against the peaceable demonstrators demanding their legitimate rights. He reaffirmed the DPRK's invariable support and solidarity with the just cause of the Palestinian people to build an independent state with East Kuds as its capital and gain their inalienable legitimate rights including the rights of the State of Palestine. Rodong News Team

title: Red Cross Society of DPRK Demands Repatriation of Abducted Women Citizens
body: A spokesman for the Central Committee of the Red Cross Society of the DPRK gave an answer to a question raised by KCNA Saturday over the full revelation of the truth about the "group defection of woman employees of the north's restaurant abroad" by south Korean media. The south Korean cable broadcasting JTBC recently put it that the "case of group defection of the north's employees" in April 2016 was proven to be a conspiratorial farce cooked up by the Park Geun Hye group of traitors, and that those women citizens of the DPRK were proven to have been forcibly abducted by the puppet Intelligence Service by interviews of a criminal involved in the case and victims, the spokesman noted, saying: After all, it has been clearly proven that the claim about the "group defection according to free will", made so far by the puppet conservative group, was an anti-DPRK farce cooked up to turn the table in favor of them in the then "National Assemblymen" election. What can not be overlooked is that the south Korean authorities, obliged to handle the issue, have adopted an equivocal stance to shun the demand of the public at home and abroad. The south Korean authorities are busy evading the responsibility while claiming that "there was limitation to grasping the truth as those directly concerned did not want to be interviewed". Meanwhile, they are feeding the media with an absurd story that those women citizens of the DPRK can be "exchanged" with criminals who have been detained in the DPRK after being legally punished for their spying and hostile acts against it. Do the south Korean authorities know that this has touched off towering grudge of the people in the DPRK including the families of the victims spending days and nights in tears and longing to see their beloved daughters come back. At the historic April north-south summit meeting and talks we stressed the need not to hoard up the agreements reached between the north and the south as in the past, and the south side expressed deep sympathy with it. However, the attitude taken by the south Korean authorities even before the ink on the Panmunjom declaration got dry has greatly disappointed us, not just arousing regret. We can not but remind them of our stand that how they tackle the case of group abduction by the puppet conservatives, an anti-DPRK confrontational farce and hideous crime against humanity, would have great impact on deciding the prospect of settling the humanitarian issue between the north and the south clarified in the Panmunjom declaration. Such hideous criminals as the Park Geun Hye group, who forced "defection" on our women citizens after luring and kidnapping them in group for confrontation with compatriots, in disregard of human ethics and morality and international law, must be brought to an international court for severe punishment. The south Korean authorities should admit the unheard-of atrocity of the Park regime, severely punish those involved in the case, send our women citizens to their families without delay and thus show the will to improve the north-south ties. We will prudently watch their future attitude. Rodong News Team

title: Panmunjom Declaration Hailed by Russian Website
body: The Russian website Patrioti Moskva carried an article titled "Panmunjom Declaration --shortcut to north-south reunification" on May 13. Noting that the inter-Korean summit took place at Panmunjom under the global spotlight on April 27, the article said: Notably, the historic Panmunjom Declaration for Korea's reunification was made public at Panmunjom, a symbol of standoff and hostility. This would have been unthinkable without the broad magnanimity and bold decision of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. With the will to make a new history of inter-Korean relations, he provided the north-south summit meeting and talks at Panmunjom, a symbol of the national division, and signed the declaration. Indeed, the Panmunjom Declaration is a programme for independent reunification in the era of Kim Jong Un and, it is the great declaration which declared before the world that a new history of national concord, a fresh era of co-prosperity will be opened up in the Korean peninsula. Rodong News Team

title: Japan's Shameless Assertion Condemned by S. Korean Internet Paper
body: South Korean internet paper Voice of People carried an editorial on May 16 to denounce Japan for presenting a diplomatic document which asserts the claim to Tok Islets and urges south Korea to implement the agreement on the issue of sexual slavery for the Imperial Japanese Army. The editorial stressed it admits of no argument that Tok Islets belong to the territory of the Korean nation from a historical point of view, saying Japan's claim to Tok Islets shows that it will not liquidate its past history woven with crimes against the Korean nation. It is the height of brazenness for Japan, a war criminal state, to urge the victim to implement the "agreement" on the sexual slavery issue, it said. Rodong News Team

title: Killings of Kwangju Uprisers with Swords Confirmed in S. Korea
body: The brutal killings of participants in the Kwangju Popular Uprising with swords by the Chun Doo Hwan military fascist clique were ascertained by a military document on May 17, according to Yonhap News of south Korea. The reckless stabs of citizens with swords by the martial law army during the uprising were a fait accompli by the testimonies of a lot of witnesses and the records, but the south Korean military has so far denied the fact. However, on May 17 a secret document of the military was revealed, so the military can not deny it any longer. Rodong News Team

title: Anti-DPRK Leaflet Scattering Operation Denounced in S. Korea
body: The People's Sovereignty Solidarity, the Phaju City Committee of the People's Party and the Progressive Federation of Students in south Korea held a press conference in Phaju City of Kyonggi Province on May 16 in denunciation of human scum's scattering of leaflets slandering the Panmunjom Declaration, according to the south Korean internet paper Jaju Sibo. Speakers said that the anti-DPRK leaflet scattering should be stopped at once to implement the Panmunjom Declaration. The chief culprit responsible for the leaflet scattering operation should be surely punished and the Ministry of Unification should take active measures against it, they held. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korean Military Authorities' Hiding of Kwangju Massacre Disclosed
body: Recently another fact showing the south Korean military authorities' hiding of the Kwangju massacre was disclosed amid the continued disclosure of the massacre committed by Chun Doo Hwan and Roh Tae Woo military fascist clique. The south Korean KBS on May 18 reported that it had been known that during the Kwangju Uprising the martial law enforcement forces opened fire in group on the uprisers in front of the South Jolla Provincial Office on May 21, but there is new evidence showing that the order of fire was made on May 20. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's Work Introduced in Russia
body: The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Making Selfless, Devoted Efforts for the Good of the People Is the Mode of Existence and Source of Invincible Might of the Workers' Party of Korea" was reported by the Russian online news Erofei-Deve on May 16. The work, published on October 10, Juche 104 (2015), says that the history of the WPK is a proud course in which it has led the Korean revolution to victory, being responsible for the people's destiny, under the guidance of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il. The news carried a photo of Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: Halt to U.S. War Drills Targeting North Demanded in S. Korea
body: People of various strata in south Korea are reportedly waging actions against the anti-DPRK war moves of the U.S. and south Korean authorities. The Taejon Headquarters of the South Side Committee for Implementing June 15 Joint Declaration, in a news conference outside the Taejon city office on May 18, charged that such air combat drills were launched in less than one month after the adoption of the Panmunjom Declaration due to the Cold-War forces who have no desire for peace. It demanded that the authorities stop all the war exercises staged with the U.S. Rodong News Team

title: 21st Pyongyang Spring Int'l Trade Fair Opens
body: The 21st Pyongyang Spring International Trade Fair opened with due ceremony at the Three-Revolution Exhibition House in Pyongyang on Monday. Presented to the fair attended by more than 260 companies from the DPRK, China, Iran and other countries are products made with cutting-edge science and technology in the field of electronics, machinery, building materials, transport, public health, light industry and food and consumer goods industry. Present at the opening ceremony were Ro Tu Chol, vice-premier of the Cabinet and chairman of the State Planning Commission, Kim Yong Jae, minister of External Economic Relations, officials in the field of economy and trade, delegations of different countries and representatives and staff members of foreign embassies in Pyongyang. The fair will run through May 25. Rodong News Team

title: Russian Youth Delegation Arrives
body: A delegation of the Federation of Youth Organizations of Russia led by Grigory Petushkov, chairman of the National Council of the Russian Association of Youth and Children, arrived here on Monday. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Premier Visits Various Places
body: Premier Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, inspected the construction site of the Mongkumpho Fishery Station and went round Jangyon and Sinchon counties of South Hwanghae Province to learn about farming. At a field consultative meeting, measures were taken to complete the construction of the fishery station at an early date and help west sea fishery stations make bigger fish hauls. The premier acquainted himself with farming in Jangyon and Sinchon counties, where he underlined the need to attain this year's grain production goal without fail by finishing the rice-transplanting timely and qualitatively. Rodong News Team

title: Truth behind Hideous Massacre by Fascist Junta Disclosed
body: Ra Kyong Thaek, who had been a journalist of Jonnam Daily during the Kwangju Popular Uprising in south Korea, disclosed the truth behind the brutal killings committed by the Chun Doo Hwan and Roh Tae Woo fascist junta at a meeting of Koreans in the U.S. held in Los Angeles on May 18, according to a report. He displayed some of the thousands of photos he had taken in May 1980 at the venue of the meeting to shed light on the brutal killings. He said he had witnessed killings of an innocent citizen and a youngster by martial law soldiers. He said he had been arrested by martial law soldiers while taking photos at the scene and interrogated several times by the soldiers pointing their guns at him. Noting he heard at that time an officer asking his inferiors as to whether his order to open fire was carried out and one of them answering they had begun opening fire, he charged that no one has been punished for giving an order to open fire. Rodong News Team

title: WPK's New Strategic Line Supported Abroad
body: The international society supported and hailed the new strategic line of concentrating all efforts on the socialist economic construction set forth at the April 2018 Plenary Meeting of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. The Hungarian Workers' Party said in a statement that the above-said line helps the Korean people more dynamically hasten the socialist construction under the guidance of the WPK. The secretary general of the Guinean National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism said in a statement that a fresh climate of détente and peace is being created on the Korean peninsula and dramatic changes are taking place in the world political structure, adding: They are a result of the guidance of respected HE Kim Jong Un. The Russian Group for Solidarity with the DPRK said that the decisions made at the April 2018 Plenary Meeting of the C.C., WPK would improve the living standard of the working Korean people and strengthen the single-hearted unity of the Korean society in every way. The Bulgarian Group for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism said in a statement that the above-said decisions serve as an important contribution to ensuring peace in the Korean peninsula and the world. The Mfumalanga Provincial Group for the Study of the Juche Idea of South Africa stressed in a statement that the above-said plenary meeting is of great significance as it provided a landmark in the history of the Juche-based socialist construction. The chairman of the Juche Philosophy Study Committee of India in a statement expressed the conviction that the decisions made at the plenary meeting would be implemented to revitalize the overall national economy and further develop the independent and modern socialist economy and thus the DPRK would emerge a more prosperous country. Rodong News Team

title: Interference and Sanctions on Other Countries Cannot Be Pardoned
body: U.S. Vice-President Pence at a recent session of the Organization of American States urged the regional countries and organizations to condemn the presidential election in Venezuela in chorus as there is great possibility that the election was "rigged" and to sever the relations with the country. Timed to coincide with this, the U.S. Department of Treasury announced its decision to include former and incumbent high-ranking officials and 20 companies of the country on the list of sanctions and freeze their assets under the pretext that they were involved in the drug trafficking and money laundering. It clearly betrayed once again the U.S. nature of aggression and sinister bad habit to interfere in the internal affairs of other countries and use the sanctions as a means of regime changes for the purpose of achieving its black-hearted aim. What matters is that the U.S. sanctions aimed at the regime change is not confined to Venezuela only. Those countries which the U.S. singles out for slapping sanctions are independent ones against imperialism like Cuba and Venezuela or those countries disobedient to it. The U.S. demands such countries accept something unacceptable and if they turn down this, it invents non-existing matters and builds public opinion and hurts their social systems and imposes sanctions on them. Such matters are absurd, and nothing but a pretext to topple the governments of those countries. The U.S. base interference and unethical sanctions aimed at overthrow of system and regime change in sovereign states are certain to be blasted by the international community. Ri Hak Nam

title: Congratulations to Venezuelan President
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, on May 21 sent a congratulatory message to Nicolas Maduro Moros upon his re-election as president of the Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela. Kim in the message said that the re-election of Nicolas Maduro Moros as president is an expression of the firm will of all the people of Venezuela to advance the Bolivarian revolution to the last and their trust in him. The message wished the president bigger success in his responsible work for the country's independent progress and prosperity, expressing again the belief that the friendly and cooperative ties between the two countries would expand in the common interests of the two peoples. Rodong News Team

title: U.S., S. Korean Military Hostilities against DPRK Condemned in India
body: The All India Indo-Korean Friendship Association made public a statement on May 17 to denounce the U.S. and south Korean authorities for staging the large-scale joint air combat drills contrary to the trend of the favorably developing situation on the Korean peninsula. Noting that the U.S. administration is leaving no means untried to block the implementation of the Panmunjom Declaration, the statement said: The Panmunjom Declaration clarified that the north and the south of Korea will stop all hostile acts toward each other -- a root cause of military tension and standoff in all spaces including the ground, the sea and the air. But the U.S. is viciously finding fault with the DPRK's human rights issue and, at the same time, staging the large-scale 2018 Max Thunder joint air combat drill all over south Korea. This presents an undisguised and intentional challenge to the declaration. The declaration can't be implemented through unilateral efforts, and only when the two sides pool their efforts to create favorable conditions and environment, it will lead to good fruition. We condemn the U.S. and south Korean authorities for their military hostile act against the DPRK and demand an immediate halt to it. We actively appeal to the Indian people and the world progressives to support the DPRK's peace-loving efforts. Rodong News Team

title: Panmunjom Declaration Supported by Ethiopian Organizations
body: The Ethiopian National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, the Ethiopian Association for the Study of the Juche Idea and the Ethiopia-Korea Friendship and Solidarity Committee issued a joint statement in support of the Panmunjom Declaration. The statement said: The world is praising the Panmunjom Declaration as a landmark of epoch-making significance in putting an end to the division of Korea as soon as possible and ushering in a new era of national reconciliation, peace and prosperity. The publication of the declaration for peace, prosperity and reunification at Panmunjom is a manifestation of the unanimous desire of the entire Korean nation for reunifying the country by its concerted efforts. We positively support and hail the Panmunjom Declaration, regarding it as the most reasonable line for defusing tension on the Korean peninsula and reunifying Korea. The United Nations and every country should recognize the historic significance of the above-said declaration and show their disinterested sincerity for its thoroughgoing implementation, not doing any hostile act contrary to it. Whoever wishes for global peace and security should positively back the Panmunjom Declaration reflecting the desire of the Korean nation. We extend firm support and solidarity to the fraternal Korean people. Rodong News Team

title: 5th National Children's Football Tournament Opens
body: The 5th national children's football tournament opened with due ceremony at the Phyongsong Youth Stadium on Tuesday. The football players who proved successful at city and county games and provincial preliminaries will play league matches and semifinals. And the finals will be held at the Songdowon International Children's Camp. At the end of the ceremony there was a football match (man) between South Phyongan Province and North Hwanghae Province. Rodong News Team

title: Centenarian in Chongjin Receives Birthday Spread
body: The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un sent a birthday spread to Pak Sun Jop, a woman centenarian living in neighborhood unit No. 8, Ryongje-dong, Chongam District, Chongjin City of North Hamgyong Province. Born as a daughter of a poor peasant family before the national liberation, she experienced the sorrow of being a member of the stateless nation, being maltreated and humiliated under the colonial rule of the Japanese imperialists. It was not until President Kim Il Sung liberated Korea that she could lead a genuine life. She had done a lot of good things for the society and the collective. She still goes in good health, living optimistically. She keeps herself busy, having balanced diet. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Inspects Completed Koam-Tapchon Railways
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the Korean People's Army, inspected the completed Koam-Tapchon Railways. Years ago, he unrolled a plan for building a large-scale fishing village zone in the areas of Koam, Tapchon and Chonapho favorable for developing the fishing industry and set forth the task for building modern Koam-Tapchon Railways as a preceding process. Builders, scientists and technologists successfully built a railway bridge across the rough sea of Sokjon Bay as a monumental edifice in the era of the Workers' Party and thus hewed out an unprecedented new ground in the DPRK's history of railway construction. Watching the railways across the rough sea, the respected Supreme Leader said it is fantastic and looks like a huge picture. Another problem about which the Party was concerned has been resolved, he added with great satisfaction. Noting that the completion of the railways linking Koam with the Songjon peninsula opened up a broad avenue for rapidly hastening the construction of the Tapchon fishing village zone as planned by the Party and satisfactorily transporting fishes caught in the fishing village zone, he highly appreciated the builders, scientists and technologists for having successfully carried out a difficult and enormous project with their own efforts. Noting with appreciation that they wonderfully designed the marine railway bridge in Sokjon Bay and carried out its construction qualitatively, he repeatedly expressed satisfaction, saying that the longer he sees it, the more pleasant and proud he feels. He added that one more valuable edifice was built on the east coast of the country. Pointing out that there is no impossibility for the Korean people dynamically advancing by dint of self-reliance and self-development, science and technology and they do whatever they make up their mind to do, he stressed the need to create and develop everything our own way by relying on our efforts, technology and resources in the future, too. The completion of the Koam-Tapchon Railways is remarkably raising the revolutionary and working zeal of the Korean people dynamically hastening the grand march for economic construction true to the decisions made at the Third Plenary Meeting of the Seventh Central Committee of the WPK, he said, adding that it once again made the people convinced of the powerful Juche-based might of our state making a steady leap forward on the solid foundations of the self-supporting economy. In high appraisal of the exploits of the builders and officials who successfully completed the Koam-Tapchon Railways through untiring heroic struggle, he gave thanks in the name of the WPK Central Committee to them. He was accompanied by Kim Yong Su and Jo Yong Won, senior officials of the WPK Central Committee. Political News Team

title: S. Korea: Ruling Party Demands Probe into Truth behind Kwangju Massacre
body: A spokesperson of the Minju Party of south Korea demanded probe into the truth behind the Kwangju massacre and the punishment of the chief culprit responsible for it on May 18, according to the south Korean News 1. The spokesperson noted that a recent formal document brought to light the truth behind the massacre committed by the Chun Doo Hwan military fascist clique during the crackdown on the Kwangju Popular Uprising. The crimes, committed by the Chun Doo Hwan military dictatorial forces during the uprising, such as the massive fire by the martial law enforcement troops, helicopter strafing and mass sexual assault have been fully revealed, but Chun Doo Hwan, the chief culprit of the massacre, denies the facts, refusing to show the slightest sign of self-examination, the spokesperson charged. The spokesperson stressed that the truth behind the suppression of the May 18 Kwangju uprising should be probed. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to President of Eritrea
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, on Thursday sent a message of greeting to Issaias Afewerki, president of the State of Eritrea, on its independence day. Kim in the message wished the president of Eritrea good health and greater success in his work for prosperity of the country, expressing belief that the friendly relations between the two countries would grow stronger in common interests. Rodong News Team

title: Undying Banner Guaranteeing Bright Future of Patriotic Cause
body: Leader Kim Jong Il sent a letter "On Developing the Movement of Koreans in Japan onto a New, Higher Stage" to the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) on May 24, Juche 84 (1995) on the occasion of its 40th founding anniversary. The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un sent a letter "Let Us Usher in a New Golden Age of the Movement of Koreans in Japan, True to the Intention of the Great Comrade Kim Jong Il" to Chongryon on May 25, Juche 104 (2015) on the occasion of its 60th founding anniversary. The works are shining as the most scientific and just working programme for opening up a decisive turn in the movement of Koreans in Japan and firmly ensuring its bright future and as a powerful ideo-theoretical weapon for the patriotic cause of Chongryon. The letter of Kim Jong Il comprehensively dealt with the exploits of President Kim Il Sung in the history of the movement of Koreans in Japan and indicated it as the primary working direction of Chongryon to do its every affair, as intended and desired by the President, and hold aloft the Juche idea as its guiding idea and banner. The letter of Kim Jong Un said that the course covered by Chongryon is a brilliant history of the great leaders' Juche-based idea on the movement of overseas compatriots, their wise guidance and warm loving care shown by them for overseas Koreans with noble patriotism. It also underlined the need for Chongryon to do its every work, as intended and desired by the great leaders. The truth and vitality of the historic works, which comprehensively deal with the main tasks that should be thoroughly implemented in the patriotic activities of Chongryon and the ways to do so, have been clearly proved in practice. Nothing can ever check the dynamic advance of the officials of Chongryon and other Koreans in Japan who have turned out in the campaign to open up a new heyday in the movement of Koreans in Japan with the important letters of the peerlessly great men as an undying banner. Ho Yong Min

title: Let Us Give Full Play to Advantages of Socialism
body: It presents itself as a very urgent requirement to fully display the advantages of socialism now that we are faced with the weighty task of further accelerating the advance of the Korean revolution with firm confidence in victory. The foundation of socialism is the people. Only when socialism preserves the nature as a genuine society of the people and fully demonstrates its advantages, can it display the might as invincible socialism that the popular masses resolutely defend and add luster to and as steadily prospering, vital socialism. To give full play to the advantages of Korean-style socialism is a noble work for adding luster to the undying feats of the great leaders who built true socialism centered on the popular masses. It is also an important undertaking for accelerating the advance of the revolution by providing all the service personnel and people with firmer confidence in socialism and by training the masses to be more powerful beings. Dr. U Hyang Suk

title: U.S.-S. Korean Military Drills Slammed in UK, Switzerland
body: British and Swiss organizations made public joint statements on May 16 to condemn the U.S. and south Korean authorities for their large-scale joint military exercises. The British Association for the Study of Songun Policy, the British Group for the Study of the Juche Idea, the Korean Friendship Association UK and the British Solidarity Committee for Peace and Reunification of the Korean Peninsula stated: We bitterly denounce the 2018 Max Thunder joint air combat drill aimed at preemptive strike upon the DPRK. The air combat drill is not only an undisguised challenge to peace but also an act of running counter to the Panmunjom Declaration, in which the north and the south of Korea agreed to totally stop all hostile acts against each other in all spaces including the ground, sea and air, the root cause of military tension and conflicts. The current military drill proves the U.S. imperialists' talk about "peace" is totally false. We strongly demand that the U.S. and south Korea immediately stop the joint air drill and sincerely respond to the DPRK's suggestion for peace. The Switzerland-Korea Committee and the Swiss Group for the Study of the Juche Idea said: The joint air combat drill, staged by the south Korean authorities with the U.S., is a naked challenge to the Panmunjom Declaration. Through military provocation the U.S. and the south Korean authorities are endangering the process of detente between the north and the south of Korea and between the DPRK and the U.S. The blame for suspended north-south high-level talks is entirely on the south Korean authorities. The U.S. had better think twice about the fate of the forthcoming DPRK-U.S. summit. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Wrestlers Win Gold Medals
body: Women wrestlers of the DPRK Jong Myong Suk and Mun Hyon Gyong came first respectively in the 55kg and 59kg categories of the 33rd World Military Wrestling Championship held in Moscow, Russia on May 14-20. Pak Un Gwang and Yon Jo Hwa bagged silver medals respectively in the men's 57kg freestyle and women's 57kg categories and Kwon Un Nam a bronze medal in the men's greco-roman 55kg category. The championship brought together more than 270 ace men and women wrestlers from 22 countries and regions including the DPRK, China, Russia, Germany, Hungary and Iran. The DPRK players returned home on Wednesday. Rodong News Team

title: Letter to Chairman of Non-Aligned Movement
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, sent a letter to President of Venezuela Nicolas Maduro Moros, chairman of the Non-Aligned Movement, on Monday with regard to the bloody suppression committed by the Israeli occupying forces that caused thousands of casualties among the Palestinian demonstrators opposing the moving of the U.S. embassy to Kuds. The letter said: We strongly condemn the brutal atrocities and indiscriminate act of violence of Israel upon the peaceful Palestinian demonstrators who demanded their legitimate rights. I would like to hereby recall the Paragraph 289 in Chapter 2 of the Final Document of the 17th Summit of the Non-Aligned Movement (NAM) which underscores the need for efforts to achieve the goal of establishing the legitimate state of the Palestinian people including their inalienable right to self-determination and freedom to build the independent State of Palestine with East Kuds as its capital. In accordance with the above Final Document I feel the urgent need for the action of the NAM to condemn the bloody suppression and atrocities of Israel and to express support and solidarity with the just cause of the Palestinian people to achieve their inalienable legitimate rights including the building of the independent State of Palestine with East Kuds as its capital. Availing myself of this opportunity, I would like to reaffirm the principled position of the DPRK to strengthen the close cooperation with all member states of the NAM as well as the Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela in adhering to the principles and purposes of the NAM and enhancing the role of the Movement. The letter was distributed to the member states of the NAM. Rodong News Team

title: National Sci-Tech Presentation in Field of Nature Conservation
body: A national sci-tech presentation in the field of nature conservation took place at the People's Palace of Culture in Pyongyang on Wednesday. Officials concerned, scientists, technicians and teachers in the field of nature conservation attended the presentation, at which Kim Song Nam, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Nature Conservation Union of Korea, made an opening address. At least 280 valuable papers, selected at the provincial sci-tech presentations, were presented to it, divided into such various panels as land protection, environment protection, management of water resources, protection of marine resources and protection of underground resources. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Sends Congratulatory Message to 24th Congress of Chongryon
body: The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un sent a congratulatory message to the 24th Congress of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) on Saturday. The message said: On the occasion of the 24th Congress of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan, which is held amid the great interest and expectations at home and abroad in the stirring period when a bright future is being unfolded on the road ahead for our country and nation, I extend warm congratulations to those attending the congress and all other officials of Chongryon and compatriots in Japan. The past four years since the 23rd Congress of Chongryon were a proud period when Chongryon officials and other compatriots in Japan performed brilliant exploits on the glorious road of clearly demonstrating its original features as a dignified overseas citizens' organization of Juche Korea, which was born and has developed under the care of the great leaders, and ushering in a new golden age for the movement of Koreans in Japan. Even in the unprecedentedly grave situation and circumstances, Chongryon, holding higher the banner of Juche, steadfastly defended its organizations, the patriotic legacy of the great Comrades Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il, and developed these organizations, affiliates and other bodies at all levels into fortresses of single-hearted unity, into bulwarks of patriotic loyalty. Through the political and cultural events that involved the entire Korean community, including the celebration held to mark the 60th anniversary of its establishment, Chongryon strived to carry forward the great leaders' ideas of and exploits in the Juche-oriented movement of overseas compatriots and aggressively conducted the five-point education, thus training its officials and other compatriots into the incarnations of thoroughgoing faith and willpower--this is the greatest success it achieved in the period under review. It ensured that all its organizations and all compatriots directed their efforts to bringing up the younger generation into dependable pillars, who will carry forward the baton of loyalty and patriotism; it also steadily unfolded the mass movement aimed at championing and expanding the rights and interests of the Koreans resident in Japan, thus further consolidating its motive force. Chongryon officials and other compatriots in Japan have shared the same destiny with their socialist homeland both in ordinary days and grim days, rendering active support to our Republic and making a great contribution to the struggle for the independent reunification of the country and its prosperity. I highly appreciate Chongryon for having overcome all manner of trials and difficulties during the period under review and creditably carried out the tasks set out at its 23rd Congress; I offer heartfelt thanks to Chairman Ho Jong Man, Chongryon officials and all other compatriots in Japan for following their motherland unwaveringly and supporting it with a single mind. As it is being held in the stirring period for an epochal turning-point in implementing the cause of Juche, the 24th Congress of Chongryon is a significant meeting that will set up a new milestone in effecting an overall upsurge in the movement of Koreans in Japan. To meet the requirements for the historic stage of a fresh era of prosperity that is unprecedented in the nation's 5 000-year history, Chongryon and the compatriots in Japan should consolidate their association that shines with the august names of the peerlessly great persons, both organizationally and ideologically, and step up their patriotic advance to hasten a new heyday in the movement of Koreans in Japan. Chongryon should thoroughly establish the ideological and leadership system of Juche across its organizations at all levels, strengthen the single-hearted unity of its ranks in every way possible and continue to prioritize ideological education to achieve a breakthrough for victory by relying on the inexhaustible mental strength of its officials and other compatriots. It should ensure that its organizations, affiliates and other bodies at all levels achieve a solid unity based on love for their motherland and nation. In particular, it should hold fast to the principle of prioritizing its chapters to turn all its grass-roots organizations into lively, working entities and build a harmonious Korean community that is overflowing with the beautiful trait of mutual assistance and warm affection. Democratic national education is the source of the greatest pride for Chongryon and an undertaking of everlasting significance that ensures the continuity of the movement of Koreans in Japan. Chongryon organizations at all levels should concentrate all their efforts on the education of the rising generations, with the focus of its building and patriotic movement put on national education; they should build up the teachers’ ranks at schools at all levels, including Korea University, and continuously increase the ranks of students, thus bringing about efflorescence of national education. Chongryon should channel its particular efforts into the work with people of younger generation and other compatriots of various strata in Japan to further consolidate the mass foundation of the movement of Koreans in Japan; it should also briskly conduct the national cultural work and mass sporting activities, highly demonstrating the pride and mettle of the Korean nation. Chongryon organizations at all levels and their officials should devote all their efforts to defending the rights and interests of the compatriots and to activities for providing them with a rich and happy life, holding high the compatriot-first slogan, "Let's make selfless, devoted efforts for the compatriots!" The genuine dignity and happy future of the overseas compatriots are guaranteed by their powerful motherland and the reunification and prosperity of their nation. In line with the demands of the new era of peace, prosperity and reunification on the Korean peninsula, Chongryon should work in a bold manner to achieve the national unity of compatriots of various strata, and organize and conduct more vigorously the patriotic movement for reunification, thus taking charge of and playing an important role in writing a new chapter in the history of national reunification. Chongryon should carry on positive external activities to give wide publicity to the policy and stand of our Party and the DPRK government with regard to foreign affairs in keeping with the current rapidly-changing situation and further develop its friendly ties with progressive figures and other people of Japan and international organizations, so as to create on its own initiative an environment favourable for its work and the movement of Koreans in Japan. Chongryon officials and other compatriots in Japan should ardently love their motherland, staunchly safeguard it, and cherishing the great Kim Jong Il's patriotism, make characteristic contributions to the building of a powerful socialist country. By doing so, they can invariably exalt their honour as a pacesetter for patriotism, a model of patriotic loyalty and an exemplary overseas compatriots' organization. Only victory and glory are always in store for Chongryon and the movement of Koreans in Japan that are dynamically advancing along the unchangeable track of patriotism, sharing their destiny with their socialist motherland of Juche. Believing that the 24th Congress of Chongryon will constitute a meeting of victory and glory noteworthy in the history of the movement of Koreans in Japan, a meaningful gathering that will consolidate the harmonious whole of Chongryon officials and other compatriots in Japan and provide all the compatriots and their children with hope and dream for the future, I sincerely wish the congress an excellent success.

title: Kim Jong Un Inspects Wonsan-Kalma Coastal Tourist Area under Construction
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the Korean People's Army, inspected the Wonsan-Kalma coastal tourist area under construction. The respected Supreme Leader was greeted by Army General Kim Su Gil, director of the General Political Bureau of the KPA, Army Col. General Son Chol Ju, vice-director in charge of organizational affairs of the General Political Bureau of the KPA, Army Lieut. General Kim Jong Gwan, vice-minister of the People's Armed Forces, commanding officers of the construction headquarters of the Wonsan-Kalma coastal tourist area and officials of the Designing Department of the State Affairs Commission. Looking at the panoramic view of the construction site along Myongsasipri seaside, where various buildings are taking their shapes, he encouraged builders, praising them for having done a lot in just several months. Saying the period when the Ryomyong legendary stories were created became an old period on this land where fresh leap and progress are taking place every day, he noted that new miracles in construction are being wrought again at the construction site of the Wonsan-Kalma coastal tourist area. Going round various places of the construction site, he acquainted himself with the overall construction, including its scale and progress and measures for supplying building materials and equipment, and discussed the issues arising in hastening the construction. He highlighted the need to set a day's feasible schedule of the construction and strictly adhere to the requirements of the standard of design and construction and building method in all construction projects on the principle of taking responsibility for the safety of the projects and guaranteeing their absolute quality for eternity and thus ensure the quality of buildings on the highest level. He said that frontline-style political work and collective emulation should be waged dynamically so that the whole construction site could seethe with the frontline-style agitprop, ardent patriotism and zeal for struggle and emulation. He stressed the need for the building-materials production sector and other relevant units across the country to supply in time the necessary equipment and materials and building fixtures to the construction site through a vigorous campaign for increased production and creation. It is the determination of the WPK to wonderfully build the Wonsan-Kalma coastal tourist area into a Korean-style coast city without an equal in the world and thus make the people enjoy the highest civilization at the highest level, he said, giving an instruction to complete the construction till the Day of the Sun next year. Accompanying him was Jo Yong Won, vice department director of the WPK Central Committee. Political News Team

title: Greetings to African Union
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, Friday sent a message of greeting to Moussa Faki Mahamat, chairman of the Commission of African Union, on the occasion of the Day of Africa. The message said that the Korean people sincerely wish the African people great fruition in their efforts to realize politico-economic integration of the continent, consolidate peace and stability and achieve the independent development and prosperity. The DPRK government and people extend support and solidarity to the African Union and the people in the struggle for enhancing the continent's prestige and voice in the international arena, it added. The message expressed belief that the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation between the DPRK and the African Union and its member nations would grow stronger in the future. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korea: Retrogressive Revision of Law on Minimum Wage Protested
body: People of different strata in south Korea reportedly launched actions protesting the authorities' scheme for retrogressive revision of the law on minimum wage in Seoul and other areas. The Confederation of Trade Unions went on a sit-in strike across south Korea on May 20. It declared that they would continue the full-scale strike until the ruling party has made clear its stand to prevent the retrogressive revision of the law. Meanwhile, a lawmaker from the People's Party called a joint press conference in support of the workers' struggle on May 21. Citizens from different walks of life have joined in the people's movement against the retrogressive revision of the law on minimum wage. Rodong News Team

title: Friendship Joint Gathering with Russian Youth Delegation
body: A friendship joint gathering with the delegation of the Federation of Youth Organizations of Russia was held at the Central Youth Hall on Thursday. Present there were Pak Chol Min, first secretary of the Central Committee of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League, officials of the youth league, youth and students, and members of the delegation led by Grigory Petushkov, chairman of the National Council of the Russian Association of Youth and Children. Speeches were made at the gathering. Pak Chol Min warmly welcomed the delegation's visit to the DPRK this significant year marking the 70th anniversary of the diplomatic ties between the DPRK and Russia. The visit will be a good occasion in promoting the friendly and cooperative ties between the youth organizations of the two countries onto a new high level, Pak said, hoping that the Russian youth and people would achieve bigger successes in the work to build powerful Russia. Grigory Petushkov said he could know well about the fact that the DPRK has attached big efforts to the work for youth, expressing the will to strive for the strengthening of the friendly relations with the youth league of the DPRK. He expressed the belief that the Korean youths would take the lead in the drive to implement the new strategic line set forth by the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un at the Third Plenary Meeting of the Seventh Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. There was a performance by the art squad of the Central Committee of the Youth League. Rodong News Team

title: War Criminal State Seeking Overseas Aggression
body: Japan's Ground and Maritime "Self-Defense Forces" recently waged joint exercises. An amphibious corps of the GSDF for recapturing a solitary island and the MSDF staged joint drills in the waters off Tanekashima, Kagoshima Prefecture on May 8-24 for the first time. During the period there were madcap drills for the rapid movement and deployment of AAV-7 amphibians from a MSDF transport ship and landing and air transport under the pretext of increasing the SDF operational capability. It shows that the Abe group is going reckless in making Japan a military giant and realizing the ambition for overseas expansion. The scenario of the Japanese militarists to carry out the overseas aggression is fraught with a very great risk. Japan has already and almost assumed full aspects as a militarist state and it is fully ready for reinvasion. The current constitution only remains a hurdle in the scenario. The chief executive of Japan seeks to revise the constitution at any cost so as to stipulate the SDF as the offensive armed forces and remove the legal obstacle to reinvasion. title: Speech of DPRK Minister of Public Health at 71st World Health Assembly
body: Jang Jun Sang, minister of Public Health who is heading the DPRK public health delegation, on May 22 made a speech at the 71st World Health Assembly in Geneva of Switzerland. He said: Our theme "Health for all: commit to universal health coverage", central to the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development, reflects the unanimous will of the international community aspiring for the realization of "Health for All", and we fully support this very theme. UHC, unless the health services are transformed from the money-based into the human-centered services, cannot practically contribute to the sound health and well-being of the people. UHC is inconceivable without the proficient medical staff, sufficient medicines, and furthermore, the government's investment to the health sector. More important is the political commitment of the relevant government responsible for their own people's health. Referring to the achievements made in the health service of the DPRK, he went on to say: It is our government's unwavering determination to continue to further display the advantages of our universal free health care system for our people. Today the hostile forces are enforcing the unprecedented unethical sanctions against the DPRK in order to stifle our socialist system, even people's life and health. The government of the DPRK is fully committed to make the supreme ideal of "Health for All" a model reality in favor of our people by further consolidating our people-centered socialist health system, thus contributing to the global health and prosperity of the world population. Rodong News Team

title: Northern Nuclear Test Ground of DPRK Dismantled
body: The northern nuclear test ground of the DPRK was completely dismantled under a decision made at the Third Plenary Meeting of the Seventh Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. After the publication of the decision at the April plenary meeting of the WPK Central Committee on dismantling the nuclear test ground, relevant institutions including the Nuclear Weapons Institute of the DPRK immediately stopped all preparations and projects for nuclear tests and had carried out phased dismantlement. The tunnels and all kinds of equipment, information communications and power systems and construction and operation equipment, that had been installed at the observation center, control center and research institute in the northern nuclear test ground, were dismantled and withdrawn. A ceremony for completely dismantling the northern nuclear test ground of the DPRK was carried out on May 24. The process of the dismantlement was covered in field by reporters from China, Russia, the U.S., Britain and south Korea. The members of the international press corps were briefed on the methods and order of dismantlement of the test ground, and went round tunnels where nuclear tests had been carried out in the past, tunnels ready for immediately and safely conducting powerful nuclear tests and the test observation centers. Then, a work for collapsing all tunnels of the nuclear test ground by means of explosion, shutting down their entrances and exploding all the ground structures including the test observation centers was carried out in order with transparency. At the end of the work, the Nuclear Weapons Institute of the DPRK issued a statement on the spot. The dismantlement of the nuclear test ground is a vivid manifestation of the DPRK government's fixed peace-loving stand to join in the international aspiration and efforts for total halt to the nuclear test and make positive contribution to building a nuclear free world. Rodong News Team

title: WPK Friendship Visiting Group Back Home from China
body: The friendship visiting group of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) led by Pak Thae Song, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the WPK Central Committee, returned home on Thursday after visiting the People's Republic of China. During the visit, the group went round various places of Beijing and localities under the deep care and comradely hospitality of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Meets Moon Jae In Again
body: The historic fourth north-south summit meeting and talks took place at the Thongil House in the north side area of Panmunjom on May 26, Juche 107 (2018) all of a sudden. Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, came to the Thongil House to meet and hold talks with President Moon Jae In of south Korea. Panmunjom, the historic land which had once come under global spotlights as a symbol of peace for making a new start of the north-south relations and opening up a new era of reconciliation and unity, witnessed another significant meeting between the top leaders of the north and the south of Korea in 29 days. Honor guards of the Korean People's Army lined up at the Thongil House, the venue of the talks, to receive President Moon Jae In. Kim Jong Un, Supreme Leader of the party, state and army of the DPRK, warmly greeted President Moon Jae In and exchanged greetings with him who arrived at the Thongil House after crossing the demarcation line at Panmunjom. The two top leaders were so pleased to have a historic meeting once again at the historic place after the lapse of one month, and warmly shook their hands with each other. Prior to the talks, President Moon Jae In made an entry in the visitors' book of the Thongil House in memory of his visit to the north side area, which reads: "Peace and Prosperity of the Korean Peninsula, together with Chairman Kim Jong Un of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea! May 26, 2018. President of the Republic of Korea Moon Jae In". Kim Jong Un and Moon Jae In, their hands firmly held with each other, had a souvenir photo taken to commemorate the historic fourth north-south summit. Kim Jong Un shook hands one by one with the personages of the south side who accompanied Moon Jae In, sharing pleasure of meeting with them. Then, there were talks between Kim Jong Un and Moon Jae In. Present at the talks from the north side was Kim Yong Chol, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and from the south side was So Hun, director of the National Intelligence Service. At the talks there were in-depth exchanges of opinions to tackle the matters that should be resolved to quickly implement the Panmunjom Declaration agreed upon at the third north-south summit and to realize the denuclearization of the Korean peninsula and achieve regional peace, stability and prosperity, and the matters the north and the south are now faced with, and the one of successfully holding the DPRK-U.S. summit. Kim Jong Un and Moon Jae In shared the view that the two sides should trust and take care of each other and exert joint efforts to make sure that the Panmunjom Declaration reflecting the unanimous desire of all Koreans is implemented at an early date. They agreed to hold the north-south high-level talks on coming June 1 and further accelerate the talks of various fields including the ones of military authorities and Red Cross. They shared the opinion that they would meet frequently in the future to invigorate dialogue and pool wisdom and efforts, expressing their stand to make joint efforts for the denuclearization of the Korean peninsula. Kim Jong Un thanked Moon Jae In for much effort made by him for the DPRK-U.S. summit scheduled for June 12, and expressed his fixed will on the historic DPRK-U.S. summit talks. Kim Jong Un asked Moon Jae In to positively cooperate with each other as ever to improve the DPRK-U.S. relations and establish mechanism for permanent and durable peace. They reached a satisfactory consensus on the matters discussed at the talks. Kim Jong Un warmly embraced Moon Jae In and exchanged good-byes with him, promising to meet again one day. The top leaders of the north and the south open-heartedly listened to each other's opinions on the crucial pending matters without formality, and had a candid dialogue. The meeting offers another historic occasion in opening up a new chapter in the development of the north-south relations. The fourth north-south summit held at Panmunjom, recorded in history as a symbol of national reconciliation and unity, peace and prosperity, will provide all Koreans with a new hope and vitality. Political News Team

title: S. Korea: Traitor Lee Myung Bak's Sophism under Fire
body: The south Korean internet newspaper Voice of People carried an editorial sniping at traitor Lee Myung Bak. Criticizing traitor Lee for his rubbish rejecting the prosecution's accusation that he was behind the illegal establishment of a company and was bribed by Samsung Group, the editorial said that he is telling a sheer lie to cover up his already proven crimes. Lee should make an apology for his high-profile graft during his tenure of power, instead of making sophism, the editorial held. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korea: Ex-Chairman of KCTU Vows to Struggle for Workers
body: Former Chairman Han Sang Gyun of the South Korean Confederation of Trade Unions expressed his will to carry on his struggle for the workers at a meeting welcoming him held before a prison on May 21, according to the south Korean internet newspaper Chamsesang. He was reportedly released on parole amid the vigorous campaign for his release by civic and social bodies including the Bar Association for Democratic Society. He declared that he would turn the south Korean society into the one based on equality and justice and join the workers in the efforts to become responsible for changing the world. Rodong News Team

title: Venezuelan, Tanzanian Figures Support Panmunjom Declaration
body: Venezuelan and Tanzanian personages made public statements to support and welcome the historic Panmunjom Declaration. Julio Chavez, vice-chairman of the United Socialist Party of Venezuela in charge of Affairs in the Andes Region, said that recently the north and south of Korea agreed to advance toward peace and reunification of the Korean peninsula, stunning the world, noting that the division of the Korean nation was attributable to the imperialists' policy of aggression. Maina, vice-chairperson of the Tanzanian National Coordinating Committee of the Juche Idea Study Groups, expressed full support to the declaration, saying: The declaration is of epoch-making significance in removing the crisis of war and achieving peace, prosperity and reunification. The recent great event and big shocks conductive to ensuring peace and security of the Korean peninsula and the world are ascribable to HE Kim Jong Un's noble love for the nation and bold decision. We sincerely hope that the Korean people would reject the outsiders' interference and achieve national concord, unity and reunification, and peace and stability would settle in the Korean peninsula. Rodong News Team

title: Frantic Confrontation Moves of S. Korean "Liberal Korea Party"
body: Hong Jun Phyo, representative of the "Liberal Korea Party" of south Korea, issued an "open letter" addressed to his U.S. master. The letter carrying "seven-point request" is run through with paragraphs such as "adherence to the principle of denuclearization", "prohibition of the U.S. forces reduction and withdrawal", "dismantlement of the north's biochemical weapons" and "suggestion of human rights issue". Ho Yong Min

title: Japanese Reactionaries Hellbent on Ambition for Reinvasion
body: The Japanese authorities of late worked out a diplomatic blue paper claiming again that Tok Islets are "part of Japan's inviolable territory". It is the height of effrontery and a gangster-like and impudent conduct. The reactionaries of Japan are running high fever in making the public at home and abroad recognize its "dominium over Tok Islets". This is aimed to implant in the mind of their people including the younger generation the idea that the islets are "lost land", arouse their revengeful thought and thus use them as a shock brigade for realizing the old dream of the "Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere". No matter how hard they may try to make international bodies and other countries recognize Japan's dominium over the islets, it will prove futile. Recently Valeri Glushikov, professor at Moscow Physics Technology University of Russia and an expert on Asian geography, contended that the islets belong to Korea. He, in his book "Ullung Island and Tok Islets on East Sea", wrote that the treaties and agreements made by the Soviet Union with the U.S. and the UK between 1943 and 1951 show that Tok Islets are part of Korea's inviolable territory. Many experts on international affairs have ascertained that the islets are part of Korea's territory. The Japanese reactionaries should not dream about reinvasion while going reckless to grab the islets, but make an apology and reparation for the crime-woven history as early as possible. Son So Yon

title: One Should Resolutely Fight against Arbitrary Practices of Imperialists
body: The revolution can neither advance nor the country's sovereignty and the nation's dignity be safeguarded without an uncompromising struggle against the imperialists. The imperialists are becoming ever more high-handed and arbitrary on the international arena. The interference and war of aggression perpetrated by the imperialists in different parts of the world are putting the world into chaos. Independent development is hindered in various countries and their people are subject to great misfortune and pain. The world and its people can never rest in peace unless the high-handed and arbitrary practices of the imperialists are checked. This being a hard reality, not a few countries are remaining tongue-tied about the high-handed and arbitrary practices of the imperialists, far from resolutely fighting against them. Some countries are behaving feeble-minded, choosing the road of compromise and concession. The imperialists become servile before the strong but outrageous before the weak. Making a concession to the imperialists and compromising with them is little short of inviting one's own death. The aggressive nature of the imperialists will never change. It's the mode of existence of the imperialists to make it their regular job to invade and plunder other countries and nations until they meet an end. If there be any change in the imperialists, it is only the method of aggression, not their nature. Expecting any "benefit" from the imperialists, especially the U.S. while approaching them with illusions is an act of making concession in revolutionary principle and a servile act of stepping back from the anti-imperialist, anti-U.S. struggle. The concession and retreat in the struggle against the class enemies including the imperialists mean death. History teaches a bitter lesson that one should only resolutely fight against the imperialists, not harboring the slightest illusion about them. Ri Hyon Do

title: DPRK FM Briefings on Dismantlement of Northern Nuclear Test Ground
body: There took place briefings for diplomatic envoys and representatives of the international bodies in Pyongyang at the People's Palace of Culture on Friday in connection with a ceremony for completely dismantling the northern nuclear test ground of the DPRK according to a decision made at the Third Plenary Meeting of the Seventh Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Officials concerned including vice ministers of Foreign Affairs met the Chinese and Russian ambassadors to the DPRK, ambassadors and charge d' affaires ad interims of Asian, African, Arab and Latin American countries and diplomatic envoys of EU members and representatives of the international bodies in Pyongyang collectively or individually to inform them of the dismantlement of the northern nuclear test ground. At the briefings officials of the DPRK side informed them in detail of the dismantlement of the nuclear test ground before saying that the dismantlement was carried out with transparency and there were neither leakage of radioactive materials nor any adverse impact on the surrounding ecological environment. They stressed the proactive and peace-loving efforts of the government of the DPRK for ensuring peace and stability on the Korean peninsula and the rest of the world and the principled stand of the DPRK to build a nuclear-free peaceful world and an independent new world in which the dream and ideal of humanity are realized. They also said that 31 members of the international press corps from China, Russia, U.S., Britain and south Korea participated in the ceremony for dismantling the nuclear test ground to cover the course of the dismantlement with transparency. The diplomatic envoys and representatives of the international bodies here who participated in the briefings expressed welcome and support for the peace-loving stand of the DPRK government to contribute to the worldwide nuclear disarmament and peace and security, saying that the step for dismantling the northern nuclear test ground constituted the manifestation of the clear desire of the party and government of the DPRK to defuse tension on the Korean peninsula and create a climate of dialogue. Rodong News Team
