body: DPRK players came back home Friday after taking part in the 10th Konstantin Korotkov International Boxing Tournament held in Khabarovsk of Russia. Rodong News Team

title: "Complete Collection of Kim Il Sung's Works" Off Press
body: Published in the DPRK was enlarged edition Vol. 3 of "Complete Collection of Kim Il Sung's Works", a library of the Juche idea containing the works of President Kim Il Sung systematically and comprehensively in a chronological order. The book contains 98 works including speeches, talks, reports and conclusions made by the President from June Juche 26 (1937) to August Juche 34 (1945). The President in the works clearly analyzed the then international and domestic political situations and the new stage in the development of the Korean revolution and set forth outstanding ideas and theories and Juche-based lines and strategic and tactical policies to lead the sacred cause of national liberation to shining victory. In "On Preparing for the Great Event of National Liberation" and other works, he advanced the strategic policies and lines on preparing for the final decisive battles to defeat the Japanese imperialism on the basis of the feats and experience gained in the course of the anti-Japanese armed struggle as well as the tasks and ways for their materialization. Some of the works call for positively preparing for the final decisive battles against the Japanese imperialists with firm confidence in victory of revolution and rallying the patriotic forces from all walks of life as one so as to achieve the independence of the country by the Korean nation itself. There are also works carrying the outstanding ideas and theories and strategic and tactical policies that give exposition of such theoretical and practical matters arising in the revolutionary struggle as the issues of adhering to the principle of guerrilla warfare in organizing and commanding battles and carrying out the work of the Anti-Japanese Youth League of Korea as required by the characteristics of the youth. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Azerbaijan President
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, on Monday sent a message of greeting to Ilham Aliyev, president of the Republic of Azerbaijan, on the occasion of its national day. The message wished the president good health and happiness and big success in his work for the country's progress and prosperity, expressing the belief that the relations of friendship and cooperation between the two countries with a long history and tradition would grow stronger. title: Greetings to Ethiopian President
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, on Monday sent a message of greeting to Mulatu Teshome, president of the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia, on the occasion of its national day. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Will Continue to Adance according to Its Own Timetable
body: The positive measures taken by the DPRK for the dismantlement of the nuclear test ground have evoked a tremendous response from the world. The DPRK's active and bold measures are, in a nutshell, part of the efforts for implementing the decision of the Third Plenary Meeting of the Seventh Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. The DPRK permitted on-site coverage by the international press corps, to say nothing of domestic media, to show the transparency of the dismantlement of the nuclear test ground, and took technical measures for it. The world, stunned by the DPRK's declaration on dismantling the nuclear test ground, calling it a bold decision, is now admiring its practice in which the transparency was fully shown. The DPRK is advancing along the path taken by itself according to its timetable no matter what others may say and wherever wind may blow from in order to implement the decision of the Third Plenary Meeting of the Seventh Central Committee of the WPK. The whole course of dismantling the northern nuclear test ground eloquently proves the DPRK government's unshakable peace-loving stand to join the aspiration and efforts of the international community for a total stop to nuclear tests. The DPRK's steadfast will to join hands with the world peace-loving people in building a nuclear-free, peaceful world, a new independent world where the dream and ideal of humankind have come true, will remain unchanged in the future, too. Ri Hyo Jin

title: U.S. Hack Media Trying to Mislead Public Opinion
body: Fox News TV, CBS and CNN of the U.S. recently let U.S. high-ranking officials appear in their programs and quoted them as saying about the DPRK-U.S. talks. The U.S. has recently come to realise that the military strength, it regards as almighty, and the anti-DPRK sanctions, it pinned hope on, were all doomed to failure. After all, there could be no other way out for the U.S. The international community contends that the world-startling dramatic change in the DPRK-U.S. ties was entirely thanks to the DPRK's efforts for peace and stability of the Korean Peninsula and the world. As far as the "economic aid" advertised by the U.S. is concerned, the DPRK has never expected it. U.S. media would be well advised to stop talking nonsense as hack media and deeply study what the strategic line advanced at the historic April Plenary Meeting of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea means. Ri Hak Nam

title: Imperialist Idea and Culture Are Means of Aggression and Domination
body: The reactionary idea and culture of the imperialists paved the way for their aggression in the past, but today play the key role in aggression. The imperialists now leave no means untried to realize their design for domination over the world. One of the methods is the reactionary ideological and cultural poisoning. It is the calculation of the imperialists that they can attain their aims without firing a single shot if they make the people degenerate and disintegrate ideologically and foment social disorder. So they have long and persistently resorted to the reactionary ideological and cultural poisoning after they set it as the primary target to benumb the national independent consciousness of the peoples of countries advocating independence against imperialism and destroy their revolutionary faith. The main object of their ideological and cultural poisoning is to spread the bourgeois ideology and the capitalist way of life to other countries. The bourgeois ideology and culture are the dangerous ideological poison to benumb the sound consciousness of the people and make them ideologically degenerate and deformed. If a man degenerates ideologically and morally, he is hard to revive. If a nation becomes degenerate, its country becomes weak to be doomed to ruin. The imperialists' reactionary ideological and cultural poisoning is aimed at the overthrow of social systems and regime change by benumbing the revolutionary and class consciousness of the people and making them degenerate, disrupting the unity and cohesion of anti-imperialist independent countries and fomenting internal disorder. The reality shows that unless such poisoning is prevented, it would impossible to defend independence and socialism and achieve the independent development of each country and nation. Kim Su Jin

title: Inter-Korean Summit Hailed in Croatia, Sri Lanka
body: A political party of Croatia and organizations of Sri Lanka issued statements hailing the third inter-Korean summit. The Socialist Workers' Party of Croatia said: We watched with great emotion the moment when the top leaders of the north and the south of Korea met at the demarcation line of Panmunjom. We congratulate the success of the inter-Korean summit meeting and talks that opened up a bright prospect for reconnecting the severed blood vessel of the nation and ensuring peace and prosperity. We hope that the agreements and the Panmunjom Declaration made at the north-south summit would be surely implemented. The Sri Lanka-People's Korea Friendship Association, Sri Lanka Committee for the Reunification of Korea and the Study Forum for Self-Reliance of Sri Lanka stressed that they warmly hail the historic north-south summit provided thanks to the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's bold decision to build a prosperous and powerful, reunified country by the concerted efforts of the Korean nation. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Premier Inspects Factories in Pyongyang
body: Premier Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, inspected the Pyongyang Pharmaceutical Factory and the Pyongyang Dental Hygiene Products Factory. He went round various buildings under construction. The consultative meetings held on the spot underlined the need to ensure the best quality in construction and meticulously organize management activities and the need for the relevant units to fully supply materials necessary for the construction. The premier also acquainted himself with the technical conditions of major bridges in Pyongyang including Chongryu Bridge. Rodong News Team

title: Russian Youth Delegation Visits Mangyongdae
body: The delegation of the Federation of Youth Organizations of Russia led by Grigory Petushkov, chairman of the National Council of the Russian Association of Youth and Children, visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. The visitors went round the Mangyongdae Revolutionary Museum where historical data and mementos associated with the revolutionary history of the President and his family members are on display. At the old home of the President in Mangyongdae, they looked round the historical relics there, being briefed on his revolutionary history. The delegation also toured the Tower of the Juche Idea, the Youth Movement Museum and the Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace. Rodong News Team

title: Foreign Guests Leave
body: Foreign delegations and delegates left Pyongyang on Saturday after taking part in the 21st Pyongyang Spring International Trade Fair. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Il's Work Published in Russia
body: The Khabarovsk Territory Publishing House of Russia brought out in booklet leader Kim Jong Il's work "The Workers' Party of Korea Organizes and Guides All the Victories of Our People" on the occasion of the 54th anniversary of his start of work at the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. The work, published on Oct. 3, Juche 79 (1990), deals with the idea that the party's leadership is a decisive guarantee for the victory of the socialist cause, the issue of developing the Workers' Party of Korea into a Juche-type revolutionary party and the basic way for the WPK to discharge its mission and duty as a leading political organization. A book-releasing ceremony took place on May 22. Rodong News Team

title: Swiss, UK Bodies Issue Joint Statements
body: Swiss and British organizations respectively released joint statements on the occasion of the 38th anniversary of the Kwangju Popular Uprising in south Korea. The Switzerland-Korea Committee and the Swiss Group for the Study of the Juche Idea in the joint statement referred to the massive armed uprising during which south Koreans made do-or-die resistance against the colonial rule of the U.S. and the military fascist dictatorship and for independence and democracy of society and national reunification. The statement went on: The bloody suppression of the uprising was an unethical massacre and the wire-puller is none other than the U.S. The U.S. and those who took part in the massacre should admit their crimes and they deserve international trial. The British Association for the Study of Songun Policy, the British Group for the Study of the Juche Idea, the Korean Friendship Association UK and the British Solidarity Committee for Peace and Reunification of the Korean Peninsula in a joint statement said that the Kwangju Popular Uprising opened a new chapter in the struggle of the south Korean people for independence, democracy and reunification. The blood shed by the uprisers was not in vain, the statement noted, adding: We fully support the struggle of the south Korean people. U.S. forces, get out of south Korea. Rodong News Team

title: Indian Embassy Officials Tour Pyongyang University of Foreign Studies
body: Staff members of the Indian embassy here toured Pyongyang University of Foreign Studies on Tuesday. They went round various lecture rooms of the university, being told about its history. They donated education equipment to the university. Earlier, they visited the DPRK-India Friendship Pyongyang Leather Shoes Factory and Wasan Senior Middle School in Sosong District. Rodong News Team

title: U.S. Should Not Go against Atmosphere of Dialogue
body: The U.S. Department of Defence and the White House vociferate that the U.S.-south Korea joint military exercises are "defensive" ones, the "annual" joint military drills would continue and their scale would not be reduced. Meanwhile, American policy makers spit out unreasonable remarks, unsuited to the atmosphere of dialogue, that the military option on the DPRK has never been ruled out and that there will be no guarantee of the social system if the DPRK does not give up nukes. Such provocative remarks are intolerable mockery of the dialogue partner. The U.S. maneuvers which have been conducted in south Korea every year are the root cause of disturbing the peace and stability on the Korean peninsula as they are staged under the simulated conditions of a preemptive attack and total war against the DPRK without exception. When the DPRK and the U.S. are coming for face-to-face dialogue with the will to solve the pending issues, it is unnecessary for the U.S. to stage the joint military exercises, the main root cause of aggravating tension and bringing nuclear war to the Korean peninsula, together with south Korea. At present the issue of the joint military exercises serves as a touchstone showing whether the U.S. wants peace or pursues war. The world people say that the U.S. persists in staging the joint military drills as it does not hope for the detente on the Korean peninsula and has no interest in reconciliation with the DPRK. If the U.S. sincerely hopes for the talks, it should stop the acts of threatening its dialogue partner by force. It is high time the U.S. behaved properly, clearly seeing what is profitable for it. Ri Hyon Do

title: Gap between Rich and Poor is Inevitable Product of Capitalist Society
body: The gap between the rich and the poor is attributable to the exploiter society. The rich is getting richer and the poor poorer in capitalist society, which is attributable to the privatization of means of production in the society. The exploiter society is based on the system of private ownership. The system of private ownership gives rise to the gap between the rich and the poor in the exploiter society and the gap goes to extreme in capitalist society, in particular. An overwhelming majority of the means of production is in the hands of a tiny handful of monopoly plutocrats in capitalist society. The reactionary ruling quarters speak for and defend the interests of the monopoly plutocrats in capitalist society. The reactionary ruling circles offer the monopoly plutocrats privilege and preference, conniving at and defending their exploitation against humanity, but deprive the working masses of their wealth under all sorts of pretexts. Owing to the unequal and unpopular policy a handful of the privileged circle get richer and the working masses get poorer. Today bipolarization, the rich getting ever richer and the poor ever poorer, is becoming larger worldwide. The increasing disparity in wealth between the developed capitalist countries and the developing countries is attributable to the former's neo-colonial exploitation and plunder of the latter. The rich getting ever richer and the poor ever poorer is just the inevitable product of capitalist society and as long as the capitalist society exists, such phenomenon can never vanish. Rim Won

title: 24th Congress of Chongryon Held
body: The 24th Congress of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) took place at the Korean Hall of Culture in Tokyo of Japan on May 26-27. Present there were Chairman Ho Jong Man and vice-chairpersons Nam Sung U, Pae Ik Ju, Pae Jin Gu and Kang Chu Ryon of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, Chairman of the Chongryon Central Audit Committee Hong In Hum, members and advisers of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, an adviser to the Research Institute on History of Korean Residents in Japan, chairpersons of the Chongryon headquarters, leading officials of Chongryon central organizations and business groups, members of the Chongryon Central Audit Committee, and deputies chosen from institutions, organizations and businesses at all levels of Chongryon. A congratulatory message to the congress from the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was read out. Adopted were the agenda items of the congress "The report on the work of the Central Committee of Chongryon to the 24th Congress of Chongryon", "On financial settlement and budget" and "On election of officials of central institutions of Chongryon" after a report on the examination of qualifications. Chairman Ho Jong Man said in a report that Kim Jong Un's congratulatory message to the congress is an expression of political trust and glory. The 24th Congress of Chongryon is a meeting of glory and loyalty as it is held after Kim Jong Un was elected as chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, and a meeting of unity and victory for setting up a new milestone in developing the movement of Koreans in Japan in the great era of Kim Jong Un, the reporter stressed. Saying that the deputies to the congress have an important duty to take the responsibility for the happiness of Koreans in Japan and the future of generations to come, true to the trust of Kim Jong Un and the expectations of compatriots, the reporter called upon them to fully discharge their mission and responsibility in the struggle for bringing about the comprehensive prosperity of the movement of Koreans in Japan in the great era of Kim Jong Un. Speeches were made on the first agenda item. Introduced at the congress were congratulatory messages and letters and video programs from officials and institutions at all levels in the homeland including the Committee for Aiding Overseas Compatriots of Korea, organizations of overseas compatriots, foreign friendship bodies and personages of south Korea and different countries. Personages from Japanese political parties, social bodies and solidarity and friendship organizations made congratulatory speeches at the congress. Delegates of the Korean school youth and children in Japan entered the venue of the congress to congratulate the congress. The committee of model officials of the Chongryon Central Committee and the committee of financial settlement and budget examination were formed. The report of the congress was adopted as its resolution. After a report by the committee of financial settlement and budget examination on the second agenda item, the results of examination were adopted. Ho Jong Man was elected as chairman of the Central Standing Committee of Chongryon, Nam Sung U, Jo Il Yon, Pak Ku Ho and Kang Chu Ryon as vice-chairpersons and Pae Jin Gu as vice-chairman and concurrently director general of its General Affairs Department. Members of the Central Committee and members of the Central Audit Committee of Chongryon were elected. Chairman Ho Jong Man made a closing speech. A letter to Kim Jong Un was adopted at the congress. At the end of the congress, the Central Standing Committee of Chongryon was formed at the First Meeting of the 24th Central Committee of Chongryon and chairperson and vice-chairperson of the Central Audit Committee of Chongryon were elected. During the congress there was an exhibition of photos dealing with the exploits of Kim Jong Un and the struggle of the institutions at all levels of Chongryon and Koreans in Japan. There were also a music and dance performance and an exhibition showing the successes made by Chongryon in developing national education. Rodong News Team

title: Meeting of WFDY Supports Struggle of Korean People and Youth
body: A meeting of the General Council of the World Federation of Democratic Youth (WFDY) took place in Katmandu, Nepal on May 24-25. Present there were delegations and delegates of 38 countries including the delegation of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League. The meeting heard briefing about activities of the WFDY after the 19th World Festival of Youth and Students and the political situation of every country and discussed such issues as the action program for the year 2018. The speakers said at the meeting that the progressive people and youth and students in the world should unite as one and resolutely fight against the high-handed and arbitrary practices and war moves of the hegemonic forces. A political resolution was adopted at the meeting to extend solidarity to the struggle of the Korean people and youth for the building of a powerful socialist country and the independent reunification of the country. Extending full support and solidarity to the principled proposals of the DPRK for independent reunification, the resolution approved the Panmunjom Declaration adopted by the bold decision of the DPRK. It also supported the new strategic line of the Workers' Party of Korea to concentrate all efforts on the economic construction and extended solidarity to the drive of the Korean people and youth to carry out the line. Rodong News Team

title: Choe Ryong Hae Inspects Industrial Establishments
body: Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the WPK Central Committee, inspected the Sungri Motor Complex and the Tokchon City Ordinary Foodstuff Factory. He looked round various places of the motor complex. A field consultative meeting underlined the importance of the duty the complex party committee has assumed in accelerating the updating of the complex and developing and producing lorries in our own way, and discussed the ways for surely attaining the lorry production goal by the appointed day. The meeting also called for successfully completing the construction of a new general stock-farm so as to consolidate the material and technical foundation for the supply base and encourage the revolutionary zeal of the employees. Choe Ryong Hae also went round the Tokchon City Ordinary Foodstuff Factory, where he called for following the experience of advanced units to spruce up the factory, and stressed the need for its primary party committee to effectively help the party cells encourage the masses to the implementation of the Party policies. Rodong News Team

title: Russian Youth Delegation Leaves
body: A delegation of the Federation of Youth Organizations of Russia led by Grigory Petushkov, chairman of the National Council of the Russian Association of Youth and Children, left Pyongyang for home Monday. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Introduced by Russian Website
body: A Russian website Democratic People's Republic of Korea Today carried an article titled "Voice of 'Long Live Kim Jong Un!' rocks heaven and earth" on May 17. Noting that the voice of "Long Live Kim Jong Un!" is reverberating far and wide in the sky of Korea, the article said: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un declared the great victory of the line on simultaneously developing the two fronts and set forth a new strategic line at the Third Plenary Meeting of the Seventh Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea in April. He clarified that at the present stage when the DPRK rose up to the position of a world-level politico-ideological and military power, it is the strategic line of the WPK to concentrate all efforts on socialist economic construction. The DPRK proclaimed the discontinuance of nuclear test and inter-continental ballistic rocket test-fire from April 21. It also announced that it would dismantle the northern nuclear test site to ensure the transparency of discontinuance of nuclear test and invited the international press corps to the ceremony for dismantling the nuclear test site. Now the DPRK is concentrating all efforts on the struggle for socialist economic construction and the improvement of the people's standard of living. An atmosphere of détente has been created on the Korean Peninsula as evidenced by the north-south summit and the historic Panmunjom Declaration which were provided thanks to the pro-active measure of the DPRK. Rodong News Team

title: Measles Breaks Out in S. Korea
body: Three students of a senior high school in Seoul have been infected with measles, according to the south Korean KBS on May 28. It was reported that its virus is the same as one prevalent in Europe at present. Rodong News Team

title: Moral Corruption of Man is Inevitable Product of Capitalist Society
body: Human relations in capitalist society based on individualism are at the mercy of bourgeois morality. "The interests of an individual are sacred and inviolable" and "I must kill you to live" are the way of thinking and viewpoint of people corrupted by the bourgeois morality based on the extreme individualism in capitalist society. All sorts of social evils prevail and corrupt way of life is rampant in capitalist society dominated by the bourgeois morality. The bourgeois morality in capitalist society incites people to a struggle for existence under the jungle law and turns human relations into inhuman relationship in which people are antagonistic and hostile to each other and exploitation and oppression of man by man prevail. Trickery and dog-eat-dog relations for power, means for accumulating wealth, are a commonplace event in capitalist political circles. Murder, rape, abduction, human trafficking, theft and swindle are committed for money, individual honor and luxury. All the decadent acts are being justified by the bourgeois morality. In capitalist society, moral corruption of man is being further fermented by the reactionary ruling class. The moral corruption of man is an inevitable product of capitalist society and rampant immorality and corruption leads a country to ruin in the long run. An Chol Gwon

title: DPRK Wins Gold Medals at Int'l Track and Field Tournament
body: DPRK players Kim Son Hui and Kim Ran Yon won gold medals at the Chinese Taipei Athletics Open 2018 held on May 25-26. The tournament brought together more than 850 men and women players from 20 countries and regions including the DPRK, India, Vietnam, South Africa and Australia. Kim Son Hui came first in women's 1 500m and 5 000m races. Kim Ran Yon bagged gold and bronze medals in women's 3 000m hurdle race and 5 000m race. Ri Kwang Hak and Kim Chol Sun took the third place respectively in men's and women's 3 000m hurdle races. The players came back home on Tuesday. Rodong News Team

title: Russian FM to Visit DPRK
body: Foreign Minister of the Russian Federation Sergei Lavrov will soon visit the Democratic People's Republic of Korea at the invitation of DPRK Foreign Minister Ri Yong Ho. Rodong News Team

title: MOU on Cooperation Signed between DPRK, Iran
body: A memorandum of understanding on cooperation between the Grand People's Study House of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the National Library and Archives of the Islamic Republic of Iran was signed in Teheran on May 26. It was inked by the DPRK ambassador to Iran and the head of National Library and Archives of Iran. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of DPRK Youth League Back Home
body: A delegation of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League headed by Secretary of its Central Committee Jong Yong Won returned home on Tuesday after taking part in the meeting of the General Council of the World Federation of Democratic Youth held in Nepal. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korea: Abolition of Agreement with Japan Urged
body: South Koreans' struggle for the abolition of an agreement on protecting military intelligence with Japan has gained momentum. The People's Joint Action and the People's Action for Peace against War of south Korea started an all-people signature campaign for the abolition of the agreement on May 15. After holding a declaration ceremony outside Chongwadae, the organizations demanded a stop to the military cooperation with war criminal nation Japan which coils up military tension in Northeast Asia while getting keen on the revival of militarism. They vowed to conduct the campaign until the end of August and intensify the action on various occasions. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Public Health Delegation Back Home
body: The DPRK public health delegation led by Jang Jun Sang, minister of Public Health, Tuesday returned home after attending the 71st World Health Assembly held in Geneva of Switzerland. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Receives Russian FM
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Thursday received Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov on a visit to the DPRK at the Paekhwawon State Guesthouse. Present there were Igor Morgulov, vice foreign minister of Russia, Alexandr Matsegora, Russian ambassador to the DPRK, Oleg Stepanov, director of the External Policy Planning Department of the Russian Foreign Ministry, Oleg Burmistrov, roving ambassador of the Russian Foreign Ministry, and Igor Sagitov, deputy director of the Asia 1 Department of the Russian Foreign Ministry. The respected Supreme Leader gladly met and exchanged warm greetings with the foreign minister and had a photo session with his party. He warmly welcomed the visit of Foreign Minister Lavrov and his party to the DPRK and had a friendly conversation with them. On the occasion Lavrov courteously conveyed the personal letter of President of the Russian Federation Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin to Kim Jong Un. Kim Jong Un expressed thanks to President Putin for his warm and fine personal letter and offered gratitude to him. Exchanged at the conversation were opinions and views of the top leaderships of the DPRK and Russia on the trend of the situation and prospect of the Korean peninsula and the region, the recent world focus. Also discussed were the issues of further expanding and developing the relations of political and economic cooperation between the two countries and closely cooperating with each other. Noting with high appreciation that the situation in the Korean peninsula and the region has entered a phase of stability thanks to the DPRK, which has taken practical steps while successfully steering the relations between the north and the south of Korea and between the DPRK and the U.S., Lavrov said that Russia fully supports the DPRK's determination and stand on the DPRK-U.S. summit high on the agenda and the denuclearization of the Korean peninsula and wishes for good successes. Kim Jong Un said that the DPRK's will for denuclearization of the Korean peninsula still remains unchanged and consistent and fixed and he hoped that the DPRK-U.S. relations and the denuclearization of the Korean peninsula will be solved on a stage-by-stage basis by finding a solution to meet the interests of each other through a new method in a new era and under a new situation and the solution of the issues will progress through effective and constructive dialogue and negotiation. Agreed at the conversation was to invigorate high-level visits, activate exchange and cooperation in different fields and, especially, realize the meeting between the top leaders of the DPRK and Russia this year marking the 70th anniversary of the establishment of bilateral diplomatic relations so as to continue to develop the strategic and traditional relations between the two countries in the interests of both sides and in keeping with the requirement of a new era. Kim Jong Un expressed great satisfaction over the fact that his good conversation with Foreign Minister Lavrov confirmed the stand and intention of the Russian leadership and helped build the new political and strategic relations of mutual confidence. Political News Team

title: Traitor Park Chung-Hee's "Yusin" Dictatorship Law Abrogated in S. Korea
body: The "National Assembly" of south Korea on May 28 passed a bill on scrapping the "Law of the National Conference for Unification", a deep-rooted evil left by traitor Park Chung-Hee during his "yusin" dictatorial rule, according to the south Korean newspaper Hangyore. That law is one of the evil laws invented by traitor Park in a bid to become "lifelong president" after cooking up "the yusin constitution" in 1972. The law remained in force even after the assassination of traitor Park to help Choe Kyu Ha and Chun Doo Hwan's election as "president", the newspaper said. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korea: Former Investigator of Security Command Found Guilty
body: An investigator at the former security command of south Korea was reportedly sentenced to prison term on May 28 for having cooked up the spy case of a Japan-resident Korean. When serving the then security command as a core investigator in 1984, he arrested a Korean student in Japan who was studying in south Korea and tortured him to wrest a false confession. Thus the student was suspected of being a spy and had to serve 7-year prison term. Later he was found not guilty and a probe into the investigator was intensified. The victim called for a heavy punishment on the former investigator. Rodong News Team

title: LPK Denounced in S. Korea
body: Ruling and opposition parties of south Korea reportedly criticized the "Liberal Korea Party" for checking the passage of a bill on supporting the Panmunjom declaration at the "National Assembly." A spokesman of the Party for Democracy and Peace in a commentary on May 28 urged the LPK to refrain from backbiting and help preserve peace on the Korean peninsula. The floor leader of the ruling Minju Party termed the behavior of the LPK an act of disregarding the demand of the people aspiring after peace, adding the LPK should drop the confrontational way of thinking and opt for ensuring peace of the Korean peninsula. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Il Praised by Nigerian Newspaper
body: Nigerian newspaper Nigerian Observer on May 25 carried an article titled "Kim Jong Il, defender of the world peace and leader of the people" on the occasion of the 54th anniversary of the start of his work at the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. The article said: One of HE Kim Jong Il's feats for the cause of global independence is that he frustrated the moves of the imperialist allied forces and ensured peace and security of the Korean peninsula and the world with his original Songun politics. He applied in an overall way the Songun politics from the philosophical principle that the sovereignty and dignity of the country and nation and the lasting peace and security of the world can be defended only by the invincible military strength, arms for self-defense, in the present world where justice is mercilessly infringed upon due to the imperialists' high-handed and arbitrary practices. He decisively smashed the extreme military threat and provocations of the hostile forces and turned the DPRK into an invincible military power with his energetic Songun leadership. He is, indeed, a peerlessly great man as he defended and glorified Korean socialism despite the world political tempest and all challenges. He is also the leader of the people who advanced the revolution and construction by firmly believing in the people and relying on their strength. His love for the people was expressed in putting forward them as the most precious and almighty being and teacher in the world and devoting himself to them. His noble image as the genuine leader of the people will be always kept in the hearts of the progressive mankind as well as the Korean people. Rodong News Team

title: Russian FM Arrives
body: Sergei Lavrov, foreign minister of the Russian Federation, arrived in Pyongyang on Thursday at the invitation of Ri Yong Ho, foreign minister of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. Rodong News Team

title: Development of South-South Cooperation Destroying Old International Economic Order
body: The socio-economic progress and development of the developing countries are markedly restrained under the outdated international economic order established by the imperialists for their interests. The way out to achieve the economic revival and national prosperity of the developing countries is to establish a new and fair international economic order after destroying the old and unequal one. The best way is for the developing countries to expand and develop South-South cooperation. The South-South cooperation is a genuine cooperative relationship among the developing countries as it is based on the shared desire to advance along the road of independence and self-reliance free from the neo-colonial domination and plunder by the imperialists. To realize the South-South cooperation is an important way for each developing country to enhance its position and role as a sovereign state in the international arena. Only when they achieve the economic independence through collective self-reliance, can the developing countries consolidate the already gained political independence and maintain sovereignty. And it is possible to provide the powerful self-defensive military capability to cope with the interference of foreign forces. At present, South-South cooperation is going in a many-sided, wide-ranging and deep way. It is the trend of the times that the South-South cooperation is conducted not spontaneously but purposefully and consciously through regional and continental organizations. The developing countries have urgent interests in the South-South cooperation and are striving for its further development to carve out future jointly. This fully conforms with the trend of the times toward independence. An Chol Gwon

title: Koam-Tapchon Marine Railway Bridge Completed
body: The Koam-Tapchon marine railway bridge was opened to traffic with due ceremony on May 30 in the DPRK. The construction of this Korean-style marine railway bridge in the eastern coastal area helps consolidate the material and technical foundation for the development of the country's railway transport and fishing industry and provide the people with more convenient travel conditions. Attending the ceremony were Premier Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK; O Su Yong, vice-chairman of the WPK Central Committee; Kang Jong Gwan, minister of Land and Maritime Transport; Pak Jong Nam, chairman of the Kangwon Provincial Committee of the WPK; Han Sang Jun, chairman of the Kangwon Provincial People's Committee; and officials concerned and builders of the bridge. At the end of the ceremony, a train carrying builders of the bridge and other participants in the ceremony ran between Koam and Tapchon. Rodong News Team

title: Retrogressive Revision of Minimum Wage Law Protested in S. Korea
body: Organizations in south Korea on May 28 staged an action in protest against the retrogressive revision of the law on minimum wage, according to south Korean News 1. That day, an amendment to the law on minimum wage completely turning down the demands of the workers was passed through the Legislation and Judiciary Committee of the "National Assembly" and its full-dress session. Protesting the passage, the Confederation of Trade Unions went on a general strike in 15 parts of south Korea all at once. In the meantime the Federation of Trade Unions, too, called a news conference to express its will to wage actions for legal judgment of the amendment. Rodong News Team

title: Discrimination against Korean Schools Protested
body: Koreans in Japan held a rally in Hiroshima City on May 13, urging the Japanese government and the authorities of Hiroshima Prefecture and City apply tuition-free program for senior high schools to the Korean schools in Japan and resume the payment of subsidies to them. Speakers there said they had staged a campaign disclosing the injustice of the government and authorities' discrimination against the Korean schools, adding they would carry on their campaign until the Japanese authorities lift the discrimination step. The participants took a street demonstration. Rodong News Team

title: False Media Reports Are Rampant: CBS of S. Korea
body: CBS of south Korea reported on Thursday that false media reports negatively influencing the efforts for ensuring peace and security of the Korean peninsula are rampant in south Korea. Noting misinformation about the north is widely spread by the conservative camp to negatively affect peace and security of the Korean peninsula, CBS said there should be strict sanction and punishment against the spread of such lies. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung's Work Introduced in Russia
body: The Russian website DPRK Today posted the full text of President Kim Il Sung's work "Let Us Further Strengthen the People's Government" on May 28 to mark the 54th anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il's start of work at the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. The work, published on December 15, Juche 66 (1977), clarifies the principled issues of strengthening the people's power, a powerful weapon of the revolution and construction, and enhancing its function and role in every way. Rodong News Team

title: Concert Marks Anniversary of DPRK-Poland Diplomatic Ties
body: A concert was given by Korean children in Warsaw on May 22 to mark the 70th anniversary of the establishment of the DPRK-Poland diplomatic relations. Among the audience were figures of various Polish units including the Foreign Ministry, the Ministry of Land and Maritime Transport and the Federation of Businessmen, and diplomatic envoys of China, Russia, Cuba, Indonesia, the Philippines and Malaysia to Poland, and the chairman of the Organization of Railways Cooperation. Prior to the event, a Korean stamp show took place in Torun City of Poland to observe the anniversary. Rodong News Team

title: Russian FM Flies Back
body: Sergei Lavrov, foreign minister of the Russian Federation, flew back home on Thursday. Rodong News Team

title: Talks Held between FMs of DPRK and Russia
body: Talks were held between the foreign ministers of the DPRK and Russia at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Thursday. At the talks DPRK Foreign Minster Ri Yong Ho and his Russian counterpart Sergei Lavrov discussed the issues of further strengthening the relations between the two countries with a long history and tradition and marking the 70th anniversary of the establishment of their diplomatic relations with practical results in the development of the bilateral relations on the basis of the agreements reached at the top-level meetings. Besides, both sides had an exchange of views on the international issues of common interest, including the situation on the Korean peninsula positively developing thanks to the pro-active efforts of the DPRK. Present at the talks from the DPRK side were Sin Hong Chol, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, and other Foreign Ministry officials and from the Russian side the foreign minister's party and Alexandr Matsegora, Russian ambassador to the DPRK and staff members of his embassy. At the end of the talks, the Russian foreign minister had a press conference with domestic and foreign reporters. Rodong News Team

title: Technical Workshop on World No Tobacco Day
body: A technical workshop took place at the Grand People's Study House on Thursday to mark World No Tobacco Day. Attending it were health workers, officials of relevant units, the WHO representative and members of missions of other international bodies to Pyongyang. Speeches were made at the workshop. Speakers in titles such as "Impact of tobacco on socio-economic life" and "smoking and hear blood vessel system" referred to the side effect of tobacco on human health and overall social life. Smoking kills millions of people in the world every year, they said, referring to the negative consequences of cigarette, a major risk factor of non-infectious disease, and the importance of the no tobacco campaign of various forms and ways. The participants watched a multimedia program "A-class 'favorite article' threatening human life". Rodong News Team

title: Foreign Minister of Russia Feted
body: The DPRK government gave a reception at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Thursday to welcome the DPRK visit by the foreign minister of the Russian Federation. Present there were Foreign Minister Ri Yong Ho and officials of the DPRK Foreign Ministry. Present on invitation were Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov and his party and Russian ambassador to the DPRK Alexandr Matsegora. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Foreign Ministry Delegation Back Home
body: A delegation of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the DPRK led by Vice-Minister Choe Hui Chol came back home on Thursday after visiting Brunei Darussalam, Indonesia and Thailand. Rodong News Team

title: Historic Event Accelerating Implementation of Panmunjom Declaration
body: The fourth inter-Korean summit, provided by the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, is an event to be specially recorded in history that will further accelerate the development of the north-south relations and the trend of peace and prosperity in the Korean peninsula through thoroughgoing implementation of the Panmunjom declaration. The Panmunjom declaration is a historic landmark as it indicated the clearest way for re-linking the severed blood vessel of the nation and achieving the national reunification by developing the north-south relations. The adoption of the declaration is a demonstration of strong aspiration and will to end the tragic history of the Korean nation woven with division and confrontation and usher in a new era of peace, prosperity and reunification. The Korean nation is faced with an important task to achieve fundamental improvement of the north-south relations and peace and prosperity of the Korean peninsula by thoroughly implementing the historic Panmunjom declaration. The north and the south should be responsible for consistently implementing the declaration they promised to before all Koreans and the world, no matter how the situation and surrounding circumstances may change. They should also proactively create favorable conditions and circumstances to implement the declaration by pooling their efforts. They should neither read others' face nor seek their egoistic interests but honestly carry out those specified in the declaration, and thus decisively improve and develop the north-south relations. Sustained development of the north-south relations and peace, prosperity and reunification lie in thoroughly implementing the Panmunjom declaration. Un Jong Chol

title: Press Release of DPRK Permanent Mission in Geneva
body: The DPRK permanent mission to the UN Office and other international organizations in Geneva on May 30 issued a press release with regard to the recent revelation of the truth about the enticed group abduction of DPRK women citizens by the south Korean authorities. Noting that the "case of group defection of north Korean restaurant workers" in April 2016 was proven to be conspiratorial farce cooked up by the Park Geun Hye regime of south Korea, through interviews of the victims and the criminal involved in the case, the press release said: Consistent is our stand to continue our effort ceaselessly until the repatriation of our citizens abducted in group as well as another DPRK woman citizen Kim Ryon Hui who had been tricked to south Korea and now appeals for years to return back to her home in the north is realized, and to take appropriate measure whenever necessary. The south Korean authorities should admit the unheard-of atrocity of the former Park Geun Hye regime, severely punish those involved in the case, send our women citizens to their families without delay and thus show the will to improve the inter-Korean relations. What is disappointing concerning this case is the inaction with silence by UN agencies including the OHCHR. The OHCHR should abandon its prejudiced and partial attitude of paying attention to unconfirmed and absurd accusations spread by hostile forces against the DPRK and discharge its due mandate and responsibility by taking appropriate action aimed at an early return of the DPRK victims of abduction to their beloved families as unanimously desired by the international community. Rodong News Team

title: North-South High-Level Talks Held
body: The north-south high-level talks were held at the "House of Peace" in the south side portion of Panmunjom on Friday to implement the historic Panmunjom Declaration. Present at the talks were a delegation of the north side led by Ri Son Gwon, chairman of the Committee for the Peaceful Reunification of the Country of the DPRK, and a delegation of the south side with Minister of Unification Jo Myong Gyun as chief delegate. At the talks both sides confirmed the principled stand for the implementation of the Panmunjom Declaration, sincerely discussed problems for taking practical measures and adopted a joint press release. The joint press release says that a north-south joint liaison office shall be set up at the Kaesong Industrial Zone, and ways for significantly commemorating the 18th anniversary of the publication of the June 15 Joint Declaration be found and discussed by way of exchanging documents. It also clarifies the times and venues of north-south general-level military talks, sports talks and Red Cross talks. And it says that the times and venues of the subcommittee meeting for discussing the issue of connecting and modernizing the east and west coast railways and roads agreed at the October 4 declaration, the working-level talks for the DPRK's art troupe's performance in the south side area and other talks shall be agreed by way of exchanging documents and the north-south high-level talks for promoting the implementation of the Panmunjom Declaration shall be held on a regular basis. Rodong News Team

title: National Exhibition of Children's Science Fictions and Models - 2018 Opens
body: The National Exhibition of Children's Science Fictions and Models - 2018 was opened with due ceremony at the Central Youth Hall on Friday to mark the 72nd anniversary of the foundation of the Korean Children's Union. Presented to it are more than 360 works such as science fictions, models, diagrams and programs produced by schoolchildren across the country. They include science fiction "Lightning-catching Plane", scientific fictitious painting "King-size Apple" and models "Children's Science Space Station" and "Unmanned Chemical Factory", which show the desire, zeal, fantastic abilities and talents of students of senior and junior middle schools. Rodong News Team

title: Sports Contest for Pochonbo Torch Prize Opens
body: The Sports Contest for Pochonbo Torch Prize started in the DPRK with due ceremony at the Hyesan Gymnasium on Friday. Excellent players from national, provincial and university sports teams will compete in dozens of events including football, basketball, volleyball, table-tennis and swimming, divided into senior and junior classes. The contest will be held in Pyongyang and Phyongsong, Hamhung, Chongjin, Nampho and other cities from June 1 to 30. Rodong News Team

title: Joint Friendship Gathering Marks Int'l Children's Day
body: A joint friendship gathering took place at the Amusement Park of Kaeson Youth Park on Friday, the 68th anniversary of the International Children's Day. Attending it were Yang Hyong Sop, vice-president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK; Choe Hwi, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea; Jon Kwang Ho, vice-premier of the Cabinet; Kim Sung Du, chairman of the Education Commission; and officials concerned, kindergarteners, kindergarten teachers and women in Pyongyang. Present there were members of foreign embassies and missions of international bodies to Pyongyang, foreign children and women and other foreign guests and overseas compatriots. Jang Chun Sil, chairwoman of the Central Committee of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea, made an address at the gathering. Children danced to the tune of song "Flower Buds Holiday" and did a rhythmic exercise for kindergarteners. Then sports and amusement games were held. After the games children had a pleasant time, dancing and enjoying amusement facilities. Meanwhile, International Children's Day was marked in each province, city and county. Rodong News Team

title: Disabled Children Mark Int'l Children's Day
body: A gathering of disabled children took place at the Taedonggang District Gymnasium in Pyongyang on Friday, the 68th anniversary of International Children's Day. Attending it were Kim Mun Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the Korean Federation for the Protection of the Disabled, officials concerned, disabled children, kindergarteners of Tongmun Kindergarten 2 in the district and their teachers and parents, foreign guests and overseas compatriots. A speech was made by Song Hyang Chun, director of the Korean Rehabilitation Centre for Children with Disability, before an art performance and sports and amusement games by disabled children and kindergarteners. Rodong News Team

title: SPA Delegation of DPRK Leaves for Russia
body: A delegation of the DPRK Supreme People's Assembly (SPA) led by Hong So Hon, president of Kim Chaek University of Technology who is chairman of the DPRK-Russia Friendship Parliamentary Group, left Pyongyang on Friday to attend the first international forum on the development of parliamentary system to be held in Russia. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's Work Introduced in Germany
body: The Anti-Imperialist Forum of Germany on May 29 posted on its internet homepage the full text of "Let Us Usher in a New Heyday of the Movement of Koreans in Japan True to the Intention of the Great Comrade Kim Jong Il", the letter sent by the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un to Chongryon (General Association of Korean Residents in Japan) and the Koreans in Japan on the occasion of the 60th anniversary of Chongryon's founding. The letter, published on May 25, Juche 104 (2015), says Chongryon formed and guided by President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il has covered a glorious path of development for the past six decades, performing great exploits before the country and the nation. It also indicates the tasks for bringing about a fresh turn in the movement of Koreans in Japan. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korea: Authorities Denounced for Withdrawing Statue of Drafted Worker
body: The Youth Solidarity of south Korea issued a statement on June 1 in denunciation of the authorities' removal of the statue of drafted worker from outside the Japan Consulate General in Pusan, according to the south Korean internet newspaper Jaju Sibo. The statement noted that the authorities withdrew the statue by mobilizing more than 1 500 policemen. The authorities have to remember that Japan's past crimes and pro-Japanese acts should be redressed in order to truly pave the way to peace, it stressed. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Acrobats Bag Gold Prize
body: DPRK acrobats won the top prize at the first international circus festival held in Sankt-Peterburg of Russia from May 24 to 27. Physical acrobatics "A horizontal bar and flying on trapeze" was awarded a gold prize, the top prize of the festival, and another physical acrobatics a special prize. The festival brought together more than 200 acrobats from 12 countries including the DPRK, Russia, Romania, China, France and Portugal. DPRK acrobats returned home on Saturday. Rodong News Team

title: Premier Visits Various Units in Pyongyang
body: Premier Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, inspected various units in the capital city of Pyongyang. They included the Taedonggang Combined Fruit Farm, the Namsa Co-op Farm of Rangnang District, the forest conservation material and equipment factory under construction of the Ministry of Land and Environment Protection, and the Pyongyang Essential Oil Factory under construction. At the combined fruit farm, the premier encouraged its officials and workers in their vigorous campaign for implementing and defending the Party's idea and policies, true to leader Kim Jong Il and the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's popular politics. At a field consultative meeting, measures were taken to make a breakthrough in the development of fruit farming and put on a normal basis the management of the farm. Visiting the co-op farm and construction sites, he underlined the need for the agricultural workers to actively introduce the high-yielding farming methods and called for improving structural quality and speeding up construction from the stand that they may take responsibility for the safety of the projects and guarantee their absolute quality for all eternity. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's Greetings to Raul Castro Ruz
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, sent a message of greeting to Raul Castro Ruz, first secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba, on Sunday. Extending the warmest congratulations and comradely greetings to Raul Castro Ruz on his 87th birthday, Kim Jong Un in the message said: I am pleased with the fact that under your wise leadership, the Communist Party and people of Cuba have steadily advanced the socialist cause, the revolutionary cause pioneered by Comrade Fidel Castro Ruz, generation after generation. Expressing belief that the tradition of comradeship and friendship between the two parties and the two peoples would be creditably carried forward and developed in the future, too, I take this opportunity to heartily wish you good health and happiness and greater success in your responsible work. Rodong News Team

title: Syrian President on Development of Friendly Ties with DPRK
body: Bashar Al-Assad, president of the Syrian Arab Republic, received credentials from DPRK Ambassador Mun Jong Nam on May 30. Referring to the cornerstone of the historic relations between the two countries laid by President Kim Il Sung and former Syrian President Hafez Al-Assad, he said: I am going to visit the DPRK and meet HE Kim Jong Un. The world welcomes the remarkable events in the Korean peninsula brought about recently by the outstanding political caliber and wise leadership of HE Kim Jong Un. I am sure that he will achieve the final victory and realize the reunification of Korea without fail. The Syrian government will as ever fully support all policies and measures of the DPRK leadership and invariably strengthen and develop the friendly ties with the DPRK. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korea: KBS Calls for Judicial Reform
body: KBS of south Korea stressed the need to reform the Ministry of Justice. It referred to the fact that the ministry had abused trials for illegal dealings with Chongwadae during the conservative regime. It charged that the ministry dealt with major cases related to "state affairs" such as the Intelligence Service's intervention in elections and the case of the Teachers Union in accordance with Chongwadae's opinions. It stressed that the reform is necessary for the Ministry of Justice to retake impartiality and independence. Rodong News Team

title: Congratulations to President of DR Congo
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, on Monday sent a congratulatory message to Joseph Kabila Kabange, president of the Democratic Republic of Congo, on his 47th birth anniversary. The message sincerely wished the president good health and success in his responsible work for prosperity of the country, expressing the belief that the friendly and cooperative relations between the DPRK and DR Congo will invariably grow strong in the future, too. Rodong News Team

title: Statement of Nuclear Weapons Institute of DPRK Supported in Russia, Ukraine
body: Russian and Ukrainian personages made public statements in support of the statement of the Nuclear Weapons Institute of the DPRK. Dmitri Remizov, chairman of the Rostov Association for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism of Russia, in a statement on May 27, welcomed the step taken by the Democratic People's Republic of Korea leadership to ensure peace on the Korean Peninsula, saying: The DPRK has completely dismantled the northern nuclear test ground in a bid to ensure the transparency of a halt to its nuclear test. The honest-minded people in the world and countries desiring the stability of the Korean Peninsula support the peace-loving stand of the DPRK. Thanks to the efforts of the Korean people the imperialists' policy of aggression will come to an end and peace be certainly settled on the Korean Peninsula. Nikolai Polishk, chairman of the Ukrainian "Treasured Sword of Songun" Association for the Study of the Juche Idea, in a statement on May 26 said the news that the northern nuclear test ground of the DPRK was completely dismantled according to the decision of the 3rd Plenary Meeting of the 7th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea attracted great attention of the international community and that dismantling of the nuclear test ground demonstrated the peace-loving stand of the DPRK. Rodong News Team

title: Repeal of Revised Law on Wage Demanded in S. Korea
body: According to the south Korean Yonhap News, the Confederation of Trade Unions launched a sit-in strike outside Chongwadae on June 1 in demand of the repeal of the retrogressively revised law on minimum wage. In a press conference called before the strike, the confederation urged the authorities to repeal the revised law and exercise veto as desired by the workers and other people. It also expressed the will to stage a one-million signature campaign demanding the repeal of the law. Rodong News Team

title: Steadfast Stand of DPRK to Build Nuclear-free World
body: Though a certain time has passed since the DPRK dismantled the northern nuclear test ground, news of the dismantlement still remains the topic of world media. Many foreign media have contended that the explosion of the nuclear test ground showed the will of the DPRK to defuse tension and that the transparent dismantlement of the test ground clearly proved once again the DPRK's peace-loving efforts. It is the fixed stand of the Workers' Party of Korea and the DPRK government to make a positive contribution to building a world without nuclear weapons in conformity with the shared desire of mankind. Through the dismantlement of the nuclear test ground, the DPRK clearly demonstrated its will to join in the international aspiration and efforts for a total halt to nuclear test. Saying that the recent measure of dismantling the northern nuclear test ground was a demonstration of the clear desire and will of the Korean party and government to defuse tension and create a climate of dialogue in the Korean peninsula, representatives of foreign embassies and international bodies in the DPRK hailed and supported the peace-loving stand of the DPRK government to contribute to global nuclear disarmament, peace and security. The whole process of dismantling the northern nuclear test ground well showed the steadfast stand of the DPRK government to join in the international desire and efforts to build a nuclear-free world. The DPRK government will make steady efforts to have close contacts and dialogue with neighboring countries and the international community in the future, too, in order to defend peace and stability of the Korean peninsula and the world. Ri Hyon Do

title: Capitalist Society Is Most Unpopular and Corrupt One
body: Capitalist society is the most unpopular and corrupt one completely contrary to the intrinsic requirements of human beings as it mercilessly infringes upon the freedom and democratic rights of overwhelming majority of the working masses and causes social evils and ideological and moral poverty of every description. The reality of capitalist system itself clearly shows how reactionary and unpopular it is. First of all, the material life is decadent in capitalist society. Such decadent material life prevalent in capitalist countries has been a main factor of deepening social contradictions. In capitalist society the mental and cultural life of the people is getting all the more intolerable with each passing day. Such poor mental and cultural life can never be prevented in capitalist society based on rabid selfishness and under the reign of mammonism and the jungle law. The political life is also getting extremely reactionary in capitalist society. Such practice is inevitable since the politics becomes a plaything of the wealthy privileged in capitalist society. Such capitalism is doomed to come to an end. An Chol Gwon

title: Event for Solidarity with Korean People Held in Venezuela
body: An event for solidarity with the Korean people took place in Venezuela on May 29. Among those present were personages and members of the Venezuelan Institute of Ideological Education and the DPRK ambassador to Venezuela. The director of the institute and other speakers referred to the situation favorable for peace and security of the Korean Peninsula and the world being created by the bold decision and broadmindedness of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Saying that the new strategic line of the Workers' Party of Korea is a scientific and realistic one fully meeting the interests of the Korean revolution and people, they expressed solidarity with the Korean people vigorously accelerating socialist construction. A press statement congratulating the recent successes registered by the DPRK in different fields and supporting the just cause of the Korean people was made public at the event. Rodong News Team

title: New Natural Monuments Registered
body: Ryongaksan spring water, Hwapho auriferous spring water and Kumya Korean poplar were newly listed as natural monuments of the DPRK. The Ryongaksan spring water at the foot of Mt Ryongak in Wolro-ri, Mangyongdae District, Pyongyang has been known among people for its good taste and quality from long ago. Even the local name of Wolro-ri owes its origin to the area of quality water that has produced many macrobians. So many people have frequented the mountain to drink spring water. The Hwapho auriferous spring water in Hwapho-ri, Phyongsong City, South Phyongan Province is a rare one having peculiar effects of health improvement and medical treatment. It contains an eyeful of gold, silver, selenium, etc. with its association degree standing at 8. The Kumya Korean poplar is the tallest and oldest among Korean poplars in the country. It is 38 meters in height with its crown 26 meters wide from east to west and 26.5 meters from north to south. Rodong News Team

title: Choe Ryong Hae Inspects Various Units in North Hwanghae Province
body: Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the WPK Central Committee, inspected the Poman Co-op Farm in Sohung County, the Rinsan Catfish Farm, the Jongbangsan General Foodstuff Factory and the Migok Co-op Farm in Sariwon City. In the seat of Poman-ri associated with the guidance exploits of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il, he stressed the need for officials and agricultural workers to dynamically raise the hot wind of scientific farming. Going round the Rinsan Catfish Farm, the Jongbangsan General Foodstuff Factory and the Migok Co-op Farm in Sariwon City, he said that they should carry into reality the intention of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un by putting production process on a modern and scientific basis of higher level and increasing the grain production. And he urged the North Hwanghae Provincial Committee of the WPK to pay deep attention to the units associated with the guidance exploits of the great leaders and the respected Supreme Leader and encourage their officials and working people to achieve signal achievements in production. Rodong News Team

title: National Children's Football Games Close
body: The 5th national children's football games closed. There were boys' and girls' finals on the playground of the Songdowon International Children's Camp on Monday. The boys' team and the girls' team of Pyongyang City took the first place. The finals were followed by a closing ceremony of the games. Rodong News Team

title: Many Children Awarded Honor Prizes for Last Five Years
body: More than 1 200 members of the Korean Children's Union (KCU) have been awarded Kim Il Sung Children Honor Prize and Kim Jong Il Children Honor Prize for the last five years after the 7th KCU Congress. Among them are those who have studied hard, strictly observed socialist morality and distinguished themselves in doing good things. Some of them proved successful at quizzes and school contests. There are also pupils who took active part in the do-good-thing movement for prosperity and economic life of the nation and in the socio-political campaign to encourage their parents' labor efforts. Some KCU members distinguished themselves in the work to create Children's Union forests, breed rabbits and help war veterans and honored disabled soldiers. Rodong News Team

title: "Complete Collection of Kim Jong Il's Works" Vol. 21 Published
body: Vol. 21 of "Complete Collection of Kim Jong Il's Works", a library of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism in which leader Kim Jong Il's works are arranged in a chronological order, was brought out by the Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House. It contains 71 speeches and talks made by Kim Jong Il from June to October Juche 62 (1973). In some works, Kim Jong Il clarified that the essence of the party ideological work is to model the whole party and society on Kimilsungism and the victory of Kimilsungism is just the final goal of the Workers' Party of Korea. There are also works dealing with the tasks and ways to develop the country's economy and provide the people with wealthy and highly civilized life as early as possible as intended by President Kim Il Sung. The book contains works dealing with the orientation and ways for creating prototype of living man with independence in the movie production, perfecting popular words of a song and melody which suites the national sentiments, feelings and taste of the people and developing the Mansudae Art Studio into the nation's comprehensive fine art studio. Some works elaborate on successfully enforcing the universal eleven-year compulsory education, the first of its kind in the country, and developing the field of sports to suite the nature of socialist society and conducting well the selection of reserves for players. There are also works giving exposition of the theoretical and practical matters arising in accomplishing the Juche cause of socialism such as the issues of intensifying military drills among soldiers, properly conducting the publication of picture books on films, striving to implement the five-point policy for national reunification and steadily increasing the ranks of supporters for the Korean revolution. Rodong News Team

title: Repeal of Law on Minimum Wage Demanded by S. Korean Organizations
body: According to the south Korean online newspaper Jaju Sibo, the Civilian Joint Action in south Korea Monday held a press conference in front of Chongwadae to urge the "government" to immediately repeal the law on minimum wage. The action announced that it would launch a candlelight rally and sit-in strike outside Chongwadae and one million-signature campaign for the repeal of the law. On the same day the Minimum Wage Solidarity held a news conference in demand of the repeal of the law. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Swedish King
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Wednesday sent a message of greeting to Carl ⅩⅥ Gustaf, king of the Kingdom of Sweden, on its national day. Expressing belief that the long-standing friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries would develop on good terms in future, too, the message wished the Swedish people prosperity. Rodong News Team

title: Japan Should Behave Itself
body: The Abe group of Japan including Foreign Minister Kono are getting vocal about "maintenance of constant pressure of the international community on north Korea" and "abduction issue" here and there. The Japanese politicians' such impudent and thoughtless act is to cover up their deplorable look of having been marginalized from the structure around the Korean Peninsula and "make a show of its existence" and thus win popularity. Question is if they can maintain their face as they reel off litany of rhetoric prompted by foolish calculation. Lots of comments are heard from experts to the effect that such unbecoming behavior of the Japanese politicians stem from its worries that despite its persistent stand-off with the DPRK, it could be marginalized from the trend of the present times in which the atmosphere of dialogue is created between the north and the south of Korea, and China, the U.S. and others actively come out for dialogue with the DPRK. Comments also put it that they are desperately trying to get rid of the "exclusion of Japan" ahead of the DPRK-U.S. summit. Abe is engrossed in dizzying array of diplomacy with the White House, soliciting for "closer cooperation than before", but it is too late. Japan's desperate bid would not change the trend of situation on the Korean Peninsula and the region toward lasting peace and stability. Japan is lost to any qualifications and face to meddle in the Korean Peninsula issue. The only option for Japan to keep itself from being treated as a puppy dog is to be well aware of its plight and behave itself. Ri Hyo Jin

title: Editorial
body: Children's Union Members Are Masters of Future of Socialist Korea The members of the Korean Children's Union (KCU) are masters of the future of the country. Only when the members of the KCU grow up to be dependable pillars who would shoulder upon themselves the future of the country, will a steady continuity be given to the revolution and a bright future be opened for socialist Korea. Noble love of the Workers' Party of Korea for the younger generation and future is pabulum cultivating true young revolutionaries. The new generation can grow up to be pillars who would carry forward the revolution only under the warm loving care like the sun. No children are so happy as the members of the KCU who are growing up happily with no more to desire in the world under the warm care of the Party and the state, being blessed by all the people of the country. Even though they are young, they are sincere and admirable as they know how to uphold the Party and the country and they are displaying the honor of the nation in the international arena with outstanding talents while building the tower of knowledge to become world-renowned scientists and inventors. It is the great pride of Juche Korea to have a large contingent of such dependable young patriots. The dependable appearance of the members of the KCU greatly heartens our Party and people and in it they see the bright future of socialist Korea. Future Korea belongs to the members of the KCU and their look reflects the tomorrow of the country. Let all the KCU members firmly prepare themselves to be true sons and daughters of socialist Korea, fluttering the red neckties.

title: DPRK's Peace-loving Stand Supported in Russia, Austria
body: Russian and Austrian bodies made public statements in support of the statement of the Nuclear Weapons Institute of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. The Moscow Group for the Study of the Juche Idea of Russia in a statement on May 31 said: We welcome the peace-loving efforts of the Korean people who totally dismantled the northern nuclear test ground for the sake of peace of the Korean Peninsula and the region. The policy of the Workers' Party of Korea is peace-loving. We extend our heartfelt solidarity to the Korean people in their struggle for justice and peace. The Youth Group for Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism Formed in Austria said in a statement on May 28 that dismantlement of the nuclear test ground shows the stand and efforts of the DPRK government to defend stability on the Korean Peninsula and in the region and global peace, and that the world people warmly support and welcome them. Rodong News Team

title: WPK Central Committee Officials Visit Schoolchildren's Lodging Quarters
body: Officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) on Tuesday visited the lodging quarters of delegates to the celebrations of the 72nd founding anniversary of the Korean Children's Union (KCU). Department Director Ri Il Hwan and other officials of the WPK Central Committee and youth league officials congratulated the delegates participating in the celebrations. Learning about their conditions of food, sleep and living, they called on all the delegates to prepare themselves to be reliable talents and pillars of revolution by modeling after President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il in their glorious youth and childhood. Rodong News Team

title: Venezuelan Youth Delegation in Pyongyang
body: A delegation of the Communist Youth of Venezuela led by Hector Rodriguez, general secretary of its Central Council, arrived in Pyongyang on Tuesday. Rodong News Team

title: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of Kim Il Sung, Kim Jong Il
body: The delegates to the celebrations of the 72nd founding anniversary of the Korean Children's Union visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on Tuesday. They laid a floral basket and bouquets before the statues of the great leaders and paid tribute to them. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's Work Introduced in DR Congo
body: The National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of DR Congo on June 1 posted on its website the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Become Pillars Supporting a Prosperous Future Korea" ahead of the 72nd founding anniversary of the Korean Children's Union (KCU). In the work, a congratulatory speech made by him at the joint national meeting of the KCU organizations held on June 6, Juche 101 (2012) to mark its 66th founding anniversary, he expressed his firm will to invariably take over the noble outlook of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il on the future and younger generation. He also indicated the tasks and ways for training the KCU members to be knowledgeable, virtuous and healthy reserves who will take responsibility for the future destiny of the country and nation. Rodong News Team

title: Talks Held between FMs of DPRK and Singapore
body: Talks were held between the foreign ministers of the DPRK and Singapore at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Thursday.
