Vice Department Director Ryu Myong Son and other officials of the C.C., WPK, were on hand. Rodong News Team

title: Symposium on Greenhouse Vegetable Farming Opens
body: The sci-tech symposium on greenhouse vegetable farming-2018 opened with due ceremony at the Pyongyang Vegetable Science Institute under the Academy of Agricultural Science on Monday. Present at the ceremony were Pak Thae Dok, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Kye Hui Nam, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea, Kim Kwang Uk, president of the Academy of Agricultural Science, officials concerned and officials, technicians and cultivators of greenhouse vegetable production units. The symposium will last till June 26. Rodong News Team

title: National Exhibition of Furniture, Fittings and Acoustic Building Materials Opens
body: A national exhibition of sci-tech achievements in fields of furniture, fittings and acoustic building materials opened with due ceremony at the Sci-Tech Complex Monday. On display there are more than 400 research findings and products presented by 90-odd units. The exhibition will be held in such forms as exhibition, sci-tech presentation and exchange and service of new technologies and products. Attending its opening ceremony were Vice-Premier Jon Kwang Ho, officials concerned and officials and working people of the exhibiting units. The exhibition will last till June 15. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Returns Home
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the Korean People's Army, came back home on June 13 after successfully concluding the historic DPRK-U.S. summit meeting and talks held in the Republic of Singapore. Amid the great attention and excitement of mankind toward the epochal talks unprecedented in history which shocked the whole world, Kim Jong Un, the respected Supreme Leader of the party, army and state of the DPRK, left his lodging quarters on Tuesday night and set out on a return trip. Foreign Minister Vivian Balakrishnan and Minister of Education Ong Ye Kung of Singapore came out to Changi International Airport to see Kim Jong Un off. They congratulated him on his success at the historic DPRK-U.S. summit. He thanked the government of the Republic of Singapore once again for its much effort and sincerity for the successful DPRK-U.S. summit. He exchanged warm good-byes with the senior officials of the Singaporean government who came out to see him off and got on the plane for his personal use. The Chinese plane carrying him landed at Pyongyang International Airport at 7:00 a.m. Wednesday. A ceremony for greeting the Supreme Leader took place at the airport overflowing with the ardent desire of all the people for his safe return from foreign tour. He was warmly greeted by the leading officials of the party and government. Reflecting the unanimous desire of all the people, the leading officials wholeheartedly extended the warmest congratulations to Kim Jong Un who ushered in a new phase of the DPRK-U.S. relations while steering the trend of the political situation on the Korean Peninsula through his energetic external activities. He shook hands one by one with leading officials of the party and government and extended warm greetings to all his beloved people of the country. Political News Team

title: Works of Great Persons Studied Abroad
body: A seminar and reading sessions on works of leader Kim Jong Il and the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un took place in Austria and Angola between May 29 and June 4 to mark the 54th anniversary of Kim Jong Il's start of work at the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). The chief and members of the Youth Group for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism formed in Austria at the seminar on Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us Brilliantly Accomplish the Revolutionary Cause of Juche, Holding the Great Comrade Kim Jong Il in High Esteem as the Eternal General Secretary of Our Party" lauded Kim Jong Il for developing the WPK into organizer and guide of all victories of the Korean people and into the mother party. The reading sessions on Kim Jong Il's work "Let Us Reunify the Country Independently and Peacefully through the Great Unity of the Entire Nation" and Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us Step Up the Building of a Thriving Country by Applying Kim Jong Il's Patriotism" were held at different units of Angola. The participants praised the exploits of the peerlessly great men for national reunification. Rodong News Team

title: National Day of Russia Observed
body: Alexandr Matsegora, Russian ambassador to the DPRK, hosted a reception at the Taedonggang Diplomatic Club Tuesday on the national day of the Russian Federation. Present there on invitation were Kim Yong Jae, minister of External Economic Relations, Kim Ik Song, director general of the General Bureau for Affairs with Diplomatic Corps, So Ho Won, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries who is chairman of the DPRK-Russia Friendship Association, officials concerned and representatives of foreign embassies and international organizations and military attaches of embassies to Pyongyang. Staff members of the Russian embassy were on hand. Speeches were made there. Earlier, a similar reception took place at the Russian consulate general in Chongjin. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Yong Nam Leaves for Opening Ceremony of 2018 FIFA World Cup
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, left Pyongyang on the morning of Tuesday to attend the opening ceremony of the 2018 FIFA World Cup to be held in Moscow of Russia. A ceremony of sending Kim Yong Nam off took place at Pyongyang International Airport. Kim Yong Nam and his party were seen off by Yang Hyong Sop, vice-president of the SPA Presidium, Jon Kwang Ho, vice-premier of the Cabinet, Ri Kil Song, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, and Alexandr Matsegora, Russian ambassador to the DPRK, and Zhang Chenggang, charge d'affaires ad interim of the Chinese embassy to Pyongyang. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's Work Introduced in DR Congo
body: The National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of DR Congo on June 1 posted on its website the full text of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "The Cause of the Great Party of Comrades Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il Is Ever-Victorious" on the occasion of the 54th anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il's start of work at the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. The work, published on October 4, Juche 104 (2015), clarifies that the seven decades-long history of the Workers' Party of Korea is the one of victory which demonstrated the validity and invincibility of the cause of the party of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il. It also stresses that the cause of the party of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il is invincible. Rodong News Team

title: Congratulatory Letter to Kim Jong Un from Singaporean PM
body: The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un on Tuesday received a letter from Lee Hsien Loong, prime minister of the Republic of Singapore, congratulating the successful DPRK-U.S. summit talks. Extending congratulations to Kim Jong Un with regard to the successful conclusion of the historic summit between the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the United States of America, the letter said that the joint statement signed by Chairman Kim Jong Un and President Donald Trump is a dramatic advance and the first step of very important significance in the long course toward permanent peace and stability on the denuclearized Korean Peninsula. It said that Singapore deems it an honor to sponsor the important summit and congratulates together with the international community the successful summit and hopes that the DPRK and the U.S. will make achievements in implementing their agreements. Expressing belief that Chairman Kim Jong Un spent pleasant days in Singapore, touring vicinity of the Marina Bay, the letter said the Singaporean prime minister wished to meet him again in the near future. Rodong News Team

title: Medical Sci-tech Books Published
body: "Encyclopedia of Dermatology" in four volumes and "German-Korean Medical Glossary" were published in the DPRK. The encyclopedia consists of 7 parts with 44 chapters which deal with basic knowledge, including formation, anatomical tissues and function of skin, and the cause, symptom, diagnosis, prevention and cosmetic surgical treatment of over 1 500 skin diseases. The glossary carries over 148 300 German technical terms of medical science and its relevant scientific fields like physics, chemistry and biology. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korea: Probe into Truth behind Abuses of Judicature Urged
body: The south Korean online paper Voice of People on June 12 posted an editorial urging the prosecution to investigate Ryang Sung Thae, former president of the Supreme Court who abused judicature in collusion with the Park Geun Hye group of traitors, and probe the truth behind the scandal. The editorial referred to the fact that the delegates of judges from across south Korea had a meeting to underline the need to bring to account Ryang for abusing judicature. It also demanded that the incumbent president of the Supreme Court probe the truth behind the scandal with a correct judgment. Rodong News Team

title: Democracy and Reunification Movement to Be Steadily Waged in S. Korea
body: A ceremony for marking the 31st anniversary of the June Popular Resistance took place in Taejon City of south Korea on June 10, according to the south Korean internet newspaper Tongil News. Speakers there said that the history of the May 18 Kwangju Uprising and the June Popular Resistance led to the candlelight resistance and the struggle for democracy is still going on. They called for waging a vigorous struggle for equality against all kinds of discrimination and violence. They expressed the will to achieve democracy, reunification and peace in the spirit of June Resistance, hoping for an end to the history of fetters caused by division and for south-north reconciliation and brisk exchange. Rodong News Team

title: Aged People of DPRK and China Meet
body: A meeting of aged people from the DPRK and China took place at the Central Youth Hall in Pyongyang on Wednesday. Present there were officials of the Central Committee of the Federation for the Care of the Elderly of Korea, members of the Association of Culture and Arts of the Elderly of Korea and Chinese elderlies visiting the DPRK. Speakers referred to the fact that the traditional friendly relations provided and developed by the preceding leaders of the two countries were put on a new high level under the deep care of Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, and Xi Jinping, president of the People's Republic of China. Saying that it is a noble duty of the elder generation to make the younger generation firmly carry on the baton of the DPRK-China friendship, they added that they would strive to strengthen the exchange and cooperation between the aged people of the two countries. An art performance was given by aged people of the two countries at the meeting. Watching the performance, the participants further deepened the feelings of friendship and fraternity. Rodong News Team

title: 2018 ITTF Challenge Pyongyang Open Begins
body: The 2018 ITTF Challenge Pyongyang Open began at the Table-Tennis Gymnasium in Chongchun Street on June 13. The games brought together players of DPRK, China, Mongolia, Iran, Vietnam and Scotland. It will be divided into men's and women's singles and doubles in adult category and singles of U-21 men and women. They will play knock-out games after group league matches. There were men and women’s singles of group league matches that day. The games will last till June 17. Rodong News Team

title: Conference of Tokyo Metropolitan Headquarters of Chongryon Held
body: The 24th Conference of the Tokyo Metropolitan Headquarters of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) took place at the Korean Hall of Culture in Tokyo on June 10. Attending it were Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, and officials of the headquarters and other deputies. Read out at the conference was the congratulatory message from the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un to the 24th Congress of Chongryon. The conference discussed the headquarters' orientation of work and tasks to push ahead with the patriotic movement in hearty response to the congratulatory message. Jo Il Yon, vice-chairman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee and chairman of the Tokyo Metropolitan Headquarters, made a report on the work of the Executive Committee of the headquarters. He appealed to the officials of the headquarters and compatriots to consolidate the organization with confidence in the future, preserve the national character of the Korean community, take the lead in implementing the three patriotic tasks, etc. so as to make a breakthrough in ushering in a new heyday of the movement of Koreans in Japan. Deputy Ko Tok U was elected as chairman of the headquarters at the conference. Chairman Ho Jong Man made a speech. He called for bringing about comprehensive redevelopment of the movement of Koreans in Japan with the pride and honor of waging patriotic activities in the emotion-charged era when epoch-making great events are taking place under the leadership of Kim Jong Un. A letter to Kim Jong Un was read out at the conference. Rodong News Team

title: 30th Congress of Union of Democratic Korean Women in Japan Held
body: The 30th Congress of the Union of Democratic Korean Women in Japan took place at the Korean Hall in Tokyo on June 8. Present there were Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), Kang Chu Ryon, its vice-chairwoman and chairwoman of the Union Central Standing Committee, and vice-chairwomen of it and deputies selected at the union organizations at all levels. A congratulatory message from the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un to the 24th Congress of Chongryon was read out at the congress. Ho Jong Man said that Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's congratulatory message contains a high estimation of the warm patriotic loyalty of the members of the women's union and successes made by them in their work of encouraging their husbands to do patriotic work and of bringing up their children to be future pillars, while regarding hardships of all descriptions as pleasure. Kang Chu Ryon made a report to be followed by speeches. Japanese personages made solidarity speeches at the congress. Also read out there were congratulatory messages from Japanese personages. Kang Chu Ryon was reelected chairwoman of the Union Central Standing Committee. A letter to Kim Jong Un was read out at the congress. At the end of the congress there took place the first meeting of the 30th Central Committee of the Union. Rodong News Team

title: AINDF Pyongyang Mission Chief Interviewed
body: Pak Su Chol, chief of the Pyongyang mission of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front (AINDF), was interviewed by KCNA Wednesday on the occasion of the 18th publication anniversary of the June 15 joint declaration. In the interview the chief said that the whole life of leader Kim Jong Il is a history of devotion by the peerless patriot who opened a great chapter in the history of national reunification movement, adding: Koreans at home and abroad remember the venerable image of Kim Jong Il inking the reunification declaration that made a breakthrough in putting an end to the 55-year-long history of confrontation and antagonism. The June 15 joint declaration is a precious fruit of his idea and line of independent reunification and outstanding and seasoned leadership. A new milestone of independent reunification is shining in the path ahead of our fellow countrymen as a beacon. Kim Jong Un, respected chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, opened up an epoch-making phase in the development of the inter-Korean relations in the historic place Panmunjom, shouldering the destiny of the country and nation on himself. The Panmunjom Declaration is a programme of independent reunification in a new era of history, the era of Kim Jong Un, which inherited the June 15 joint declaration and the October 4 declaration provided by Kim Jong Il. Thanks to the great sun illumining the 3 000-ri land of Korea, the future of the 80 million fellow countrymen is rosy and a reunified powerful country is sure to emerge. The AINDF vanguard fighters and patriotic people from all walks of life will turn out to make a new history of peace, prosperity and reunification under the banner of the Panmunjom Declaration. Rodong News Team

title: Seminar on Kim Jong Un's Work Held in Switzerland
body: A seminar on the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "The Cause of the Great Party of Comrades Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il Is Ever-Victorious" was held by the Swiss Group for the Study of the Juche Idea on June 9. Martin Lotscher, chief of the group, made a report to be followed by speeches. Saying that the work of Kim Jong Un is the banner to dynamically rouse the Koran people to the general advance for building a powerful socialist nation, the reporter and speakers noted that the Korean people are working miracles and innovations in all fields by thoroughly implementing the idea and lines of their leader. They stressed it is thanks to Kim Jong Un's wise leadership that the Workers' Party of Korea has invariably defended the revolutionary character and nature as the party of the leader and always emerged victorious. And they expressed the will to positively study and disseminate the works of the peerlessly great men. Rodong News Team

title: June 15 All-Korean Committee Pledges to Implement Panmunjom Declaration
body: The north, south and overseas side committees for implementing June 15 Joint Declaration issued a resolution on Friday, the 18th anniversary of the June 15 joint declaration. All-Korean Committee for Implementation of June 15 Joint Declaration made public the following resolution with the will to take the lead in ushering in a new era of peace and prosperity, a new history of independent reunification: 1. We will hold fast to the June 15 joint declaration and its successor the Panmunjom Declaration as a milestone for reunification common to the nation. We will invariably maintain as the great programme for reunification common to the nation until the day of national reunification the June 15 joint declaration which declared a new start of our nation's history and vigorously advanced the June 15 era. We will firmly adhere to the principle of national independence that we decide the destiny of our nation by ourselves, as clarified in the June 15 joint declaration and reaffirmed in the Panmunjom Declaration. We will strive to make the north-south relations dynamically develop under the milestone clarified in the Panmunjom Declaration, and decisively reject any interference and arbitrary practices against the north-south relations, the internal affairs of the nation. 2. We will vigorously wage a nation-wide campaign for the implementation of the Panmunjom Declaration and thus positively promote the reconciliation and unity of the nation. We will jointly push forward the work to hold events common to the nation to be participated in by the authorities, parliaments, political parties and local self-governing bodies, non-governmental organizations and other people from all walks of life on the occasions of the anniversaries of the north-south declarations and other days significant for both the north and the south and, through such course, further fan up the atmosphere for national reconciliation and reunification. We will encourage the contacts and visits among bodies of different circles and sectional and regional organizations in the north and the south and abroad and reenergize diverse meetings for reunification in conformity with their specific characters, thus creating the warm climate of implementing the Panmunjom Declaration wherever Koreans live. 3. We will further invigorate the activities to defuse the military tensions and remove the danger of war from the Korean peninsula. We will jointly strive to build a mechanism for keeping lasting and durable peace on the Korean peninsula and stage a vigorous mass movement for preventing all forms of actions that may cause distrust and antagonism between the north and the south again and escalate the military tension, contrary to the desire of all the fellow countrymen and the spirit of the Panmunjom Declaration. We will fully display the spirit and will of our fellow countrymen to turn the demilitarized zone along the Military Demarcation Line, an acute hotspot, into a real peace zone and the West Sea into peaceful waters and usher in a new era of peace and prosperity free from worry about war. Rodong News Team

title: Anniversary of Inter-Korean Declaration Observed in DR Congo
body: The National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of DR Congo on June 4 released a bulletin titled "On the occasion of the 18th anniversary of June 15 north-south joint declaration", illustrated with a photo of leader Kim Jong Il. The bulletin said: There was the first north-south summit in Pyongyang in June 2000, at which the June 15 joint declaration calling for reunifying the country by the concerted efforts of the Korean nation was adopted. The second north-south summit was held in October 2007 amid the powerful demonstration of the great vitality of the June 15 joint declaration, resulting in the adoption of the October 4 declaration. HE Kim Jong Il, who protected the destiny of the country and the nation with his unique Songun politics and made a decisive turn in achieving Korea's reunification, is always lauded by the Korean people and the progressive mankind as a peerless patriot. Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un clarified in his New Year Address for this year that the relations between the north and the south of Korea should be improved to glorify the significant year 2018 as an eventful year to be specially recorded in the history of the nation. The historic north-south summit meeting and talks were held on April 27 and the "Panmunjom declaration for peace, prosperity and reunification of the Korean peninsula" was made public. The exploits of Kim Jong Un who ushered in a new era of independent reunification, shouldering the destiny of the country and the nation upon himself, will shine long. Rodong News Team

title: North-South General-Level Military Talks Held
body: The north-south general-level military talks were held at the Thongil House in the north side portion of Panmunjom on Thursday to thoroughly implement the historic Panmunjom Declaration. Present at the talks were a delegation of the north side led by Army Lieutenant General of the Korean People's Army An Ik San and a delegation of the south side with Major General Kim To Gyun as chief delegate. At the talks both sides sincerely discussed all the issues in defusing the military tension and practically removing the danger of a war on the Korean Peninsula and adopted a joint press release. The joint press release notes that both sides exchanged full views on the issue of halting all hostile acts causing the military conflict, the issue of turning the hotspot waters in the West Sea into waters of peace, the issue of taking measures for militarily ensuring cooperation, exchange, visit and contact between the north and the south, the issue of demilitarizing the joint security area of Panmunjom on a trial basis, etc. It also says that both sides reached a consensus of views on the issues of thoroughly implementing the agreement made at the north-south military talks on June 4, 2004 to prevent the conflict in the waters of the West Sea and of completely recovering the military communication in the areas near the East Sea and the West Sea, and agreed to continue discussing and settling the issues put at the current talks in the future. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of DPRK Ministry of Railways Back Home
body: A delegation of the DPRK Ministry of Railways led by Minister Jang Hyok came back home on Thursday after taking part in the 46th ministerial meeting of the Organization of Railways Cooperation held in Kyrgyzstan. Rodong News Team

title: World Blood Donor Day Marked in DPRK
body: An event took place at the National Blood Center under the Ministry of Public Health on Thursday to observe World Blood Donor Day. Present there were officials in the field of public health and those of relevant units, voluntary blood donors and the acting representative of the WHO office here and other foreign guests. Speakers at the event expressed thanks to those voluntarily donating their precious blood to save people's lives and recover their health, referring to the theme of World Blood Donor Day for this year. They stressed the need to fully supply safe blood and its products in the public health so as to make a positive contribution to treating patients, noting that the event will mark an important occasion in developing the blood transfusion service. The participants went round the blood-gathering room and photos showing blood-donating activities before enjoying a performance given by the Central Art Squad for Agitation for Increased Production. The Day was also observed in all provinces on the same day. Rodong News Team

title: Immortal Feats of Kim Jong Il for Independent Reunification
body: The June 15 joint declaration is a brilliant fruition of leader Kim Jong Il's noble patriotic will and steadfast resolution for reunification. Saying that Korea is like an organism that can survive only when whole, and cannot when chopped in two, he had worked heart and soul to hasten the independent and peaceful reunification of the country by concerted efforts of the entire nation. He unrolled a grand plan to put a definite end to the history of the north-south confrontation and usher in an era of independent reunification, peace and prosperity in the new century. At last he made a bold patriotic decision of arranging a historic north-south summit in Pyongyang, the first of its kind in the 55 years-long history of national division, and provided the Korean nation with the June 15 joint declaration, a great programme for national reunification. The declaration garnered an enthusiastic welcome at home and abroad as it fully reflected the unanimous aspiration and desire of the entire Korean nation and the requirements of the times. With the firm will to develop the north-south relations onto a higher stage in keeping with the demand of the era of independent reunification and the desire of the fellow countrymen and pave a broad avenue to peace and prosperity, he realized another round of north-south summit in October Juche 96 (2007), which culminated in the adoption of the October 4 declaration, a programme for the implementation of the June 15 joint declaration. After all, he provided the above-said declarations with far-sighted wisdom and energetic leadership, clearly showing the road ahead of the Korean nation in the new century and further developing the reunification movement on a nationwide scale. This is the great feats that will remain forever in the history of the nation. Pak Chol Jun

title: Kim Jong Il's Exploits Praised Abroad
body: Seminars and lectures took place in DR Congo, Guinea, Russia and Indonesia between June 4 and 8 to mark the 54th anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il's start of work at the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). The deputy general secretary of the C.C., Communist Party of the DR Congo who is chairman of the DR Congo-Korea Friendship and Solidarity Association and other speakers praised Kim Jong Il for proving the scientific accuracy and truth of socialism and the inevitability of its victory through his energetic ideo-theoretical activities, firmly defending socialism with his unique Songun politics and opening the bright future of national reunification in the idea of By Our Nation Itself. The chief of the Russian Group for Solidarity with the DPRK lauded the party leadership history of Kim Jong Il, saying that his start of work at the C.C., WPK was a historic event of important significance in carrying forward the revolutionary cause of Juche. The manager of the Rabitra Bahtera Pratama Co. of Indonesia noted that the exploits of Kim Jong Il serve as the driving force dynamically promoting the Korean people's struggle for socialist construction. Rodong News Team

title: Congratulatory Letter to Kim Jong Un from Chongryon
body: The Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) sent a congratulatory letter to the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un on June 13 as regards the historic first DPRK-U.S. summit. The letter said that June 12 is a historic day when an epoch-making great event happened in putting an end to the long-standing hostile DPRK-U.S. relations and establishing new relationship between them and making peace and prosperity settle in the Korean peninsula and the world. Noting the Supreme Leader, together with the U.S. president, declared that they committed to cooperating with each other for the development of new DPRK-U.S. ties and the promotion of peace, prosperity and security on the Korean peninsula and the world amid the attention of the whole world, the letter stressed this is a clear demonstration of his brilliant wisdom and outstanding political caliber. It said that he is the bright sun of mankind steering the 21st century as he provided a decisive guarantee for ensuring the peace and security of the country and nation and the world at the epoch-making talks with the U.S. through his matchless pluck and preeminent diplomatic activities that shocked the world. All the Chongryon officials and Koreans in Japan will hold only Marshal Kim Jong Un in high esteem to the end of the earth, carry through the important tasks advanced in his congratulatory message to the 24th Chongryon Congress and thus proudly make a new history of the movement of Koreans in Japan in the great era of Kim Jong Un on the sacred patriotic course associated with the undying leadership feats of the peerlessly great men, it said. Rodong News Team

title: Capitalism Has No Future
body: Capitalism is a gloomy society as it has no future. The imperialists talk much about "democracy" and "material prosperity" in capitalist society but it is nothing but a poor excuse to cover up the true colors of the society, unpopular, corrupt and declining. "Democracy" being advocated by the imperialist reactionaries is not for the toiling masses, and it is fake democracy for a handful of the exploiting classes. The multi-party system is also deceptive. Various parties are said to take the reins of government by turns in capitalist countries, but those parties are all the bourgeois political ones representing the interests of business tycoons which have different names. It is a malign tumor of capitalism that the rich get ever richer and the poor get ever poorer. The increase of the material wealth in capitalist society makes the inequality of the material life more unbearable, so that the toiling masses lead a miserable life. It is capitalist society where even those on a certain living standard always get anxious about the future as they may get poor any time. Capitalism is a corrupt society which is like heaven for the rich but like hell for the poor. Capitalism looks prosperous and developing, but it is capitalism that makes the society decay and people mentally and physically ill. Capitalism is neither a prosperous democratic society nor everlasting one. It is a corrupt society rushing headlong into its doom. Ri Hak Nam

title: Inter-Korean Summits Hailed by Slovak Organizations
body: The Slovak Association for Supporting and Studying the Juche Idea and the Slovakia-Korea Friendship Association issued a joint statement on June 9 hailing the historic north-south summit meetings. The statement said: We are pleased that the Korean people led by respected HE Kim Jong Un are steering the positive development of the situation on the Korean peninsula. The two north-south summit meetings held at Panmunjom showed the will of the Korean nation to reunify the country by its concerted efforts free from outsiders' interference. We wish the Korean people bigger success in the struggle for national reunification and prosperity under the wise leadership of respected HE Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: British Bodies Observe Anniversary of June 15 Inter-Korean Declaration
body: The British Association for the Study of Songun Policy, the British Group for the Study of the Juche Idea, the Korean Friendship Association UK and the British Solidarity Committee for Peace and Reunification of the Korean Peninsula released a joint statement on June 4 on the occasion of the 18th anniversary of the June 15 inter-Korean declaration. The statement said: The June 15 North-South Joint Declaration, the basic idea of which is By Our Nation Itself, reflects the will of the Korean people to reunify the country by their own efforts free from outside interference. The publication of the joint declaration is a fruition of the untiring efforts made by the great Comrade Kim Jong Il who devoted his all to the reunification of the country. There was a summit meeting in Panmunjom shortly ago, the April 27 declaration was adopted and an atmosphere of reconciliation and cooperation has been created on the Korean peninsula. We fully support the Korean people in their struggle to reunify the country at any cost. Rodong News Team

title: 2018 World Cup Opens
body: The 2018 FIFA World Cup was opened with due ceremony at the Luzhniki Stadium in Moscow on Thursday. Attending the ceremony were Russian President Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin and the president of the FIFA. Also on hand were Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, and heads of state and government of different countries. An art performance was given there and the Russian president and the FIFA president made congratulatory speeches. Then, there was a match between the teams of Russia and Saudi Arabia. The World Cup continues till July 15. Meanwhile, a concert was given by artistes from Russia and various countries at the Red Square in Moscow on June 13 to celebrate the 2018 FIFA World Cup. Kim Yong Nam enjoyed the concert together with Putin, the FIFA president and heads of state and government of different countries. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Yong Nam Meets Russian President
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) on a visit to Russia to attend the opening ceremony of the 2018 FIFA World Cup, met Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation, at the Grand Kremlin Palace on June 14. He politely conveyed warm greetings and personal letter from Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, to President Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin. Putin expressed deep thanks to Kim Jong Un for sending personal letter to him, and asked Kim Yong Nam to convey his most heartfelt greetings to Kim Jong Un. Saying he is glad that Kim Yong Nam came to Russia to attend the opening ceremony of the 2018 FIFA World Cup, Putin referred to the good and long-standing history between Russia and the DPRK marking the 70th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations. He said that he is pleased that the process of détente started and prospect of peace was opened on the Korean Peninsula, and highly appreciates it. Russia will as ever strive for peaceful settlement of the Korean Peninsula issue, he said, expressing the stand to develop the economic cooperation between the two countries. Kim Yong Nam noted that the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un personally met the Russian foreign minister who visited the DPRK recently and gave a precious instruction for continuously developing the strategic and traditional DPRK-Russia relations in conformity with the mutual interests and the demand of the new era. He stressed the need to further expand the bilateral relations through activated high-ranking level visits and brisk exchange and cooperation in various fields this significant year greeting the 70th anniversary of the establishment of the DPRK-Russia diplomatic relations. The talk proceeded in a warm and friendly atmosphere. Present there were Sin Hong Chol, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs of the DPRK, Kim Hyong Jun, DPRK ambassador to Russia, Sergei Lavrov, foreign minister of the Russian Federation, and Yuri Ushakov, presidential aide of Russia. Rodong News Team

title: Sports Contest for Technical Innovation Pioneer Prize Opened
body: A sports contest for technical innovation pioneer prize opened in the DPRK with due ceremony in Chongjin City on Friday. More than 2 500 players selected in provinces will compete in ten-odd events including football, basketball, table-tennis and tennis during the contest to be held in Phyongsong, Hamhung and other areas. The opening ceremony was followed by men's football match between North and South Hamgyong provinces at the Chongjin Stadium. Rodong News Team

title: Furniture, Fittings, Acoustic Building Materials Exhibition Closes
body: The national exhibition of sci-tech successes in the fields of furniture, fittings and acoustic building materials closed with due ceremony at the Sci-Tech Complex here on Friday. During the exhibition its participants exchanged successes and experience gained in the researches to put the furniture, fittings and acoustic building materials on a Juche, diversified and multifunctional basis and improve their quality and integrate the designs for buildings and furniture in conformity with the architectural features and the requirement of the times. Rodong News Team

title: Iranian Party Delegation Visits Mangyongdae
body: The delegation of the Islamic Coalition Party of Iran led by Mahdi Soli, vice general secretary for International Affairs, visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. Being briefed on the revolutionary career of the President, the delegation looked round the historical relics preserved at his old home. It also toured the Tower of the Juche Idea, Pyongyang Teacher Training College, Ryuwon Footwear Factory, etc. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korea: Memorial Service for Democratic Martyrs Held
body: Civic and public organizations in south Korea held an all-people meeting in Seoul on June 9 to honor the memory of those who fell in the struggle for the nation and democracy, with the 31st anniversary of the June Popular Resistance as an occasion, according to the south Korean internet newspaper Tongil News. At the meeting speakers called for realizing peace and reunification of the Korean Peninsula and building a society for the people by inheriting the spirit of the martyrs. In a resolution the participants declared that they would fully discharge their duty in building a reunified country where independence, democracy and peace are realized, true to the ardent wish of the martyrs. Rodong News Team

title: Desire of Mankind Can Come True Only in Socialist Society
body: The imperialists and their reptile media vociferate about the "advantage" of capitalism, claiming that socialism is an "inhumane society". The imperialists and bourgeois defenders are talking about "freedom" and "equality," but they can't justify the unpopular capitalist society with any deceptive propaganda. Genuine freedom and rights of the popular masses are unthinkable in capitalist society. Capitalism is not a "free" society advocated by the imperialists, but an unequal and dictatorial one. Reality vividly proves that capitalism is an unpopular society where the freedom and rights of the popular masses are ruthlessly violated. It is the capitalist society where the rich get richer and the poor poorer. Socialism is a society where the independence of the popular masses can be defended and realized. Socialism is the ideal society of humankind whose advantage and truth have been proved in severe ordeals of history. It has the eternal viability for its scientific accuracy and truth. Through their real living the Korean people came to have the faith that only socialism can provide them with genuine freedom, equality and a happy and worthwhile life and to advance to socialism is the only way of realizing the ideal of the popular masses for independence. Today there is no ideal society which can take the place of socialism in the world. The desire of humankind can come true only in socialist society. Ri Hyon Do

title: Joint Statement of Trade Unions in North and South of Korea
body: The Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea and south Korea's Federation of Trade Unions and Confederation of Trade Unions issued a joint statement on June 15, the 18th anniversary of the historic June 15 joint declaration. The statement said that the June 15 joint declaration, which all Koreans including the workers in the north and the south had firmly defended and implemented, was led to the Panmunjom declaration at last and the emotion of June 15 developed into the joy and passion of April 27 and then set the entire nation agog with excitement of May 26. Expressing full support for the two inter-Korean summits in Panmunjom and the adoption of the April 27 declaration again, the organizations of workers in the north and the south are filled with enthusiasm and will to take the lead in making a new history, a new era of peace and reunification, it added. Noting that all Koreans are now faced with the historic task of the nation to end the history of division and subordination, which has lasted for over 70 years, and realize the independent reunification, the statement said: Workers in the north and the south will discharge in the van the duty facing the nation at the historic turning point that our nation brought by its own efforts, overcoming the hill of ordeal and crisis. It is the most primary task for co-existence and co-prosperity of the nation to put an end to the history of mistrust and confrontation and establish a durable peace-keeping regime on this land. A total end should be put to the state of war which stopped on July 27, 1953. Moreover, a peace accord should be concluded to completely terminate the war crisis and realize lasting peace. At the historic turning point made in 73 years of division, the workers in the north and the south will do their best to settle the historic task facing our nation. All the workers in the north and the south will take the lead in getting the armistice agreement abrogated and realizing a peace accord. Today the idea of By Our Nation Itself, clarified in the June 15 joint declaration, was developed into the principle of national independence in the Panmunjom declaration. The party most responsible for peace and reunification is just our nation. The workers in the north and the south will conduct all their activities strictly in the spirit of By Our Nation Itself and the principle of national independence and stand in the van of struggle to decisively reject domination and interference of outsiders obstructive to peace and reunification. They will resolutely struggle against any attempt to impair the Panmunjom declaration and do their best for the unceasing implementation of the declaration. The statement expressed the firm resolve of all the workers in the north and the south to dynamically usher in a new era of peace and independent reunification. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Judo Players Return Home
body: Judo players of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea returned home on Sunday after taking part in the East-Asian Judo Championships held in Mongolia. Kim Jong Hung took the first place at the women's 48kg category, and Kim Yong Gwon and Ri Un Ju took the second place in men's 60kg category and in women's 57kg category respectively. Kim Jin Gang and Choe Yong Mi placed third in women's 63kg and 70kg categories. Rodong News Team

title: Independence, Equality and Mutual Respect Are Fundamental Principles in Int'l Relations
body: It is a requirement of the era reflecting aspiration of humankind to adhere to the principle of independence, equality and mutual respect in international relations. Global independence is the common aspiration of humankind and to realize it is an urgent historic task in the present era. Independence is a main criterion of an independent and sovereign state and it finds a vivid expression in state power. Without mutual respect of sovereignty, it is impossible to realize sincere cooperation and exchange and establish solid international relations among countries. That is why the UN Charter and other international conventions define it as an important principle to respect sovereignty of each country. To keep to the principle of equality is an important requirement for sound development of international relations. All countries and nations are equal as members of the international community. Countries have different territorial sizes, populations and social economic development levels but equality should be ensured in relations among themselves. All countries and nations should develop the friendly and cooperative relations on the principle of mutual respect, not violating the other's sovereignty. Only when they do so, can equality and sovereignty be ensured. The Democratic People's Republic of Korea is consistently holding fast to the stand to mend and develop the relations with any countries which respect its sovereignty and are friendly toward to it, although they were hostile and antagonistic towards it in the past. The world progressive countries and people should positively struggle to develop the international relations genuinely and soundly on the principle of independence, equality and mutual respect and build a new independent, peaceful and friendly world. Ri Hyo Jin

title: Anniversary of June 15 North-South Joint Declaration Observed Abroad
body: Seminars were held by the Juche Philosophy Study Committee of India and the Dresden Group for the Study of the Juche Idea in Germany and a lecture by a Guinean company from June 6 to 10. The chairperson of the Juche Philosophy Study Committee of India said: The north-south summit was held in June, 2000 for the first time in the history of the Korean division. By Our Nation Itself is the core of the joint declaration and the basic idea of Korea's reunification. It was the unbending will of HE Kim Jong Il to achieve reunification of the country by the concerted efforts of all Koreans. Thanks to HE Kim Jong Un who is invariably carrying forward HE Kim Jong Il's idea of national reunification, Korea will surely be reunified. The chief of the Dresden group and other speakers praised Kim Jong Il for performing feats for the national reunification, noting the publication of the June 15 joint declaration marked an occasion in heralding the new start of the movement for Korea's reunification. They said that the historic Panmunjom declaration was adopted thanks to the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un who is successfully carrying out the behests of the great leaders for national reunification. Rodong News Team

title: Anniversary of June 15 North-South Joint Declaration Observed by Foreign Bodies
body: Organizations of Russia and Ukraine released statements on June 12 to mark the 18th anniversary of the historic June 15 North-South Joint Declaration. The Moscow Group for the Study of the Juche Idea noted: The north-south joint declaration adopted in June, 2000 shows that the issue of Korea's reunification is the internal issue of the Korean nation and the outsiders' interference should be rejected in the accomplishment of the cause of reunification. Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un made a bold decision to put an end to the pain of national division and improve the north-south relations. As a result, the two north-south summits took place at Panmunjom and the historic Panmunjom declaration was adopted. The inter-Korean relations came to enter a new phase of development. We sincerely hope that the Panmunjom declaration would be implemented without fail. The Association for the Study of the Juche Idea in Lvov, Ukraine said: The June 15 North-South Joint Declaration clarifies the orientation and ways to achieve reconciliation, cooperation and reunification of the Korean nation. An atmosphere of peace and reconciliation has been created on the Korean Peninsula thanks to the bold decision by Comrade Kim Jong Un. The Korean people will always emerge victorious under the wise leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of Korea-Mongolia Friendship Parliamentary Group Back Home
body: A delegation of the DPRK-Mongolia Friendship Parliamentary Group of the DPRK Supreme People's Assembly led by Thae Hyong Chol, president of Kim Il Sung University and minister of Higher Education who is chairman of the parliamentary group, returned home on Saturday after visiting Mongolia. Rodong News Team

title: Conference of Osaka Prefectural Headquarters of Chongryon Held
body: The 24th Conference of the Osaka Prefectural Headquarters of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) was held at the Osaka Korean Hall of Culture in Japan on June 10. Present there were Pu Yong Uk, chairman of the Osaka Prefectural Headquarters of Chongryon, and other deputies. Read out at the conference was a congratulatory message from the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un to the 24th Congress of Chongryon. Pu Yong Uk made a report on the work of the executive committee of the headquarters. The reporter stressed that the Supreme Leader's congratulatory message is an immortal banner and treasured sword of victory for demonstrating the dignity of Chongryon to the whole world and leading the movement of Koreans in Japan to steady development. He called upon the deputies to fulfill their honorable mission and duty in the struggle for bringing about all-round prosperity of the patriotic movement with the strong will and firm faith that the victory in the cause of Juche and patriotic cause of Chongryon is a science and by dint of the single-hearted unity of the ranks and compatriotism. Japanese personages made solidarity addresses at the conference before congratulatory messages from institutions at all levels of Chongryon and Japanese personages were introduced. Then there were speeches. Pu Yong Uk was re-elected as chairman of the Osaka Prefectural Headquarters of Chongryon. A letter to Kim Jong Un was read out at the conference. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Visits People's Republic of China
body: Banquet Given in Welcome of Kim Jong Un's China Visit Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and president of the People's Republic of China, hosted a grand banquet in welcome of the China visit by Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, at the Great Hall of the People on Tuesday evening. Present at the banquet on invitation were Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK, vice-chairman of the DPRK State Affairs Commission and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK; Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK, vice-chairman of the DPRK State Affairs Commission and premier of the Cabinet; Ri Su Yong, Kim Yong Chol and Pak Thae Song, members of the Political Bureau and vice-chairmen of the C.C., WPK; Ri Yong Ho, member of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK and minister of Foreign Affairs; No Kwang Chol, alternate member of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK and minister of the People's Armed Forces; and other officials accompanying Kim Jong Un, Supreme Leader of the party, state and army of the DPRK, and suite members and Ji Jae Ryong, DPRK ambassador to China, and his embassy officials. Attending it were Li Keqiang, premier of the PRC State Council, and Wang Huning, member of the CPC Central Committee Secretariat, who are members of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the C.C., CPC; Wang Qishan, vice-president of the PRC; Ding Xuexiang, member of the Political Bureau, member of the Secretariat and director of the General Office of the C.C., CPC; Yang Jiechi, member of the Political Bureau of the C.C., CPC and director of the Office of the Foreign Affairs Commission of the C.C., CPC; Guo Shengkun, member of the Political Bureau and secretary of the Political and Legal Affairs Committee of the C.C., CPC; Huang Kunming, member of the Political Bureau, member of the Secretariat and head of the Publicity Department of the C.C., CPC; Cai Qi, member of the Political Bureau of the C.C., CPC and secretary of the Beijing Municipal Committee of the CPC; Wang Yi, state councilor and minister of Foreign Affairs; Song Tao, head of the International Liaison Department of the C.C., CPC; and other senior officials of the Chinese party and government. Kim Jong Un and his wife Ri Sol Ju entered Jinsedating, the banquet hall, guided by Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan. Prior to the banquet, its participants watched a video on the three historic meetings of the top leaders of the two parties and two countries. At the banquet Xi Jinping made a congratulatory speech and Kim Jong Un made a reply speech. Xi Jinping warmly welcomed Kim Jong Un's China visit, saying that this fully showed his fixed will to attach great importance to the strengthened strategic communication between the two parties of China and the DPRK and develop the traditional friendship of the two countries and demonstrated to the whole world the invincibility of the relations between the two parties and two countries. After Chairman Kim Jong Un's China visit in March, the China-DPRK relations have entered a new phase of development and the important joint agreements of both sides are being implemented one by one and the China-DPRK relations of friendship and cooperation are in new vigor, Xi Jinping stated. Noting that Kim Jong Un has made great efforts to protect peace and stability of the Korean Peninsula by leading the Korean people and further consolidated the trend of dialogue and détente on the peninsula, Xi Jinping said he is pleased to see it and highly appreciates it. He affirmed that China and the DPRK would learn, consult, unite and cooperate with each other as close friends and comrades to jointly open up rosier and beautiful future of the socialist cause in the two countries. Kim Jong Un said he is very glad to meet again Xi Jinping and other close Chinese comrades at the time when a new historic current is being created in the Korean Peninsula and the region with the successful DPRK-U.S. summit. He expressed heartfelt thanks to Xi Jinping for his cordial hospitality despite the pressure of work. Saying the picture of the DPRK and China sharing joy and sorrow and sincerely helping and cooperating with each other like family members clearly demonstrates at home and abroad that the relations between the two parties and two countries are developing into the unprecedentedly special relationship beyond the traditional ties, Kim Jong Un stated that he would make every possible effort to steadily develop the DPRK-China friendly relations onto a new high level, valuing affinity and affection forged with Xi Jinping. He said that he would closely cooperate with the Chinese comrades at the same staff in the historic journey of defending socialism and opening up a new future of the Korean Peninsula and the region, and fully discharge his responsibility and role to protect genuine peace. He expressed the belief and expectation that the Chinese people would surely realize the dream of China called the great prosperity of China in the near future under the leadership of Xi Jinping and the Communist Party of China. An art performance specially prepared by Chinese artistes was given to welcome Kim Jong Un's historic China visit. Kim Jong Un conveyed a floral basket to the performers on their excellent performance. Kim Jong Un and his wife Ri Sol Ju together with Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan mounted the stage to express thanks for the enthusiasm and efforts of the artistes who prepared the art performance with sincerity, and had a photo session with them. Kim Jong Un expressed thanks to the Chinese party and government for their special care and warm hospitality. Political News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Visits People's Republic of China
body: Talks between Kim Jong Un and Xi Jinping Talks were held between Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, and Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC) and president of the People's Republic of China, at the Great Hall of the People on June 19. Present there from the DPRK side were Ri Su Yong and Kim Yong Chol, members of the Political Bureau and vice-chairmen of the WPK Central Committee, and Ri Yong Ho, member of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and minister of Foreign Affairs. Present from the Chinese side were Wang Huning, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and member of the CPC Central Committee Secretariat, Ding Xuexiang, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, member of the CPC Central Committee Secretariat and director of the CPC Central Committee General Office, Yang Jiechi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and director of the Office of the Foreign Affairs Commission of the CPC Central Committee, Wang Yi, state councilor and minister of Foreign Affairs, and Song Tao, head of the International Liaison Department of the CPC Central Committee. At the talks the result of the historic DPRK-U.S. summit, which was successfully held amidst the unusual interest and expectation of the international community, and appreciation, views and stand on it were informed each other. And beneficial views on a series of issues of mutual concern including the prospect for the denuclearization of the Korean Peninsula were exchanged and a shared understanding on the discussed issues achieved. The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un expressed thanks to the Chinese party and government for positive and sincere support and good help for the successful DPRK-U.S. summit meeting and talks. Saying that he is much pleased with and values the recently strengthened strategic cooperation between the two parties and the mutual confidence getting further deepened, he expressed the determination and will to further develop the closer relations of friendship, unity and cooperation between the two parties and the two peoples of the DPRK and China. Xi Jinping gave high appreciation and extended heartfelt congratulations to Chairman Kim Jong Un for having steered the DPRK-U.S. summit meeting and talks successfully and put the situation of the Korean Peninsula on the track of dialogue, negotiation, peace and stability. Voicing full support for the stand and determination of the DPRK side for the denuclearization of the Korean Peninsula, he said that China will continue to play its constructive role in the future, too. The talks proceeded in a comradely, candid and friendly atmosphere. Political News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Visits People's Republic of China
body: Kim Jong Un Meets Xi Jinping Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, met Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and president of the People's Republic of China, at the Great Hall of the People at 5 p.m. Tuesday. When Kim Jong Un and his wife Ri Sol Ju arrived at the Great Hall of the People, they were warmly greeted by Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan. After gladly exchanging greetings, Kim Jong Un and Xi Jinping had a souvenir photo taken. Xi Jinping warmly welcomed Kim Jong Un who was visiting China again. The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un expressed thanks to Xi Jinping for sparing time to accord heartwarming hospitality. Kim Jong Un and Ri Sol Ju had a significant photo session with Xi Jinping and Peng Liyuan. A grand ceremony took place at the Great Hall of the People to welcome Kim Jong Un. At Beidating Kim Jong Un exchanged greetings with senior officials of the Chinese party and government, shaking hands with them one by one. Xi Jinping exchanged greetings with senior officials of the party and government of the DPRK. When Kim Jong Un and Xi Jinping stood on the platform, the national anthems of the two countries were played solemnly. Kim Jong Un received a salute from the chief of the guard of honor of the three services of the Chinese People's Liberation Army (CPLA). He reviewed the guard of honor of the CPLA three services, conducted by Xi Jinping. When they reached the welcoming group of children, the children warmly welcomed them, waving national flags of the two countries and bouquets. Kim Jong Un raised his hand to wave back to the cheering children. Political News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Visits People's Republic of China
body: Kim Jong Un Arrives in Beijing Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, arrived in Beijing, the capital of the People's Republic of China. The plane carrying him landed at Beijing Capital International Airport at 10 a.m. Beijing time. Present at the airport to greet him were Wang Huning, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC) and member of the CPC Central Committee Secretariat, Cai Qi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and secretary of the Beijing Municipal Party Committee, Song Tao, head of the International Liaison Department of the CPC Central Committee, and Li Jinjun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK. Also present there was Ji Jae Ryong, DPRK ambassador to China. National flags of the DPRK and China were hoisted and a guard of honor of the three services of the Chinese People's Liberation Army and a military band lined up at the airport. When Kim Jong Un together with his wife Ri Sol Ju got off the plane for his personal use, children presented bunches of flowers to them. The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un exchanged warm greetings with senior party and government officials of China. The senior officials of China warmly welcomed Kim Jong Un visiting China again, with deep respect and trust for him. He expressed thanks to the exceptional reception and hospitality of the Chinese party and government and got on a car for his personal use. The car carrying Kim Jong Un and Ri Sol Ju arrived at the Diaoyutai State Guesthouse, the lodging quarters, escorted by motorcycles. He was guided to the lodging quarters by Wang Huning and other senior officials who came to greet him. Political News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Visits People's Republic of China
body: Kim Jong Un Leaves for China Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, will visit the People's Republic of China from June 19 to 20. Kim Jong Un together with his wife Ri Sol Ju came out to Pyongyang International Airport on the morning of June 19 to visit China. A ceremony to see them off took place at the airport. The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was warmly seen off by members and alternate members of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK. He shook hands and exchanged greetings with the senior officials who came out to see him off one by one and boarded the plane for his personal use. The senior party and government officials heartily wished for good successes in his visit to China and safe return. The plane carrying the Supreme Leader took off at the airport at 09:20 amid the send-off by the senior party and government officials. He was accompanied by Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, Ri Su Yong, Kim Yong Chol and Pak Thae Song, members of the Political Bureau and vice-chairmen of the C.C., WPK, Ri Yong Ho, member of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK and minister of Foreign Affairs, No Kwang Chol, alternate member of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK and minister of the People's Armed Forces, and members of the C.C., WPK and the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK. Political News Team

title: Kim Yong Nam Back Home
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, returned home on Monday after attending the opening ceremony of the 2018 FIFA World Cup held in Moscow. A ceremony of welcoming the president took place at Pyongyang International Airport. The president and his party were greeted by Yang Hyong Sop, vice-president of the SPA Presidium, Jon Kwang Ho, vice-premier of the Cabinet, Ri Kil Song, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, Aleksandr Vostrikov, charge d'affaires ad interim of the Russian embassy to Pyongyang, and Sun Hongliang, councilor of the Chinese embassy to Pyongyang. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Books Donated to Russia
body: DPRK books were donated to the Triptikh Exhibition in Russia with due ceremony on June 13 on the occasion of the 54th anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il's start of work at the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Among them are works of President Kim Il Sung, leader Kim Jong Il and the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and books praising their exploits and introducing time-honored history and brilliant culture of the Korean nation. Expressing thanks for donation of those books, the curator of the exhibition said: The immortal exploits performed by leader Kim Jong Il for the development of the Russia-DPRK relations are kept deep in the minds of the Russian people. The donated books will help Russians know better about the greatness of the preceding leaders of the DPRK and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and about the daily developing DPRK. Rodong News Team

title: Premier Inspects Various Units in North Phyongan Province
body: Premier Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, inspected various units in North Phyongan Province. Going round the Rakwon Machine Complex, the Ponghwa Chemical Factory and other units, he called upon all units to generalize the already-gained sci-tech successes so as to bring about a leap forward in production. Field consultative meetings underlined the importance of the tasks facing industrial establishments in the province in implementing a new strategic line of the Party and discussed the ways for carrying out the tasks. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Visits People's Republic of China
body: Kim Jong Un Returns Home from China Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, returned to Pyongyang on Wednesday evening after successfully winding up his visit to the People's Republic of China. Present at Beijing Capital International Airport to see him off were Wang Huning, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC) and member of the CPC Central Committee Secretariat, Cai Qi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and secretary of the Beijing Municipal Committee of the CPC, Song Tao, head of the International Liaison Department of the C.C., CPC, and Li Jinjun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK. Kim Jong Un, the respected Supreme Leader of the party, state and army of the DPRK, exchanged parting words with those officials of China, expressing his satisfaction over the result of the visit as well as his heartfelt thanks for their sincere service and efforts made to kindly accompany him during the visit as a whole. Kim Jong Un and his wife Ri Sol Ju left Beijing by the plane for private use amid the warm send-off of close Chinese comrades. The plane carrying them landed at Pyongyang International Airport at 07:30 p.m. A ceremony of greeting Kim Jong Un and Ri Sol Ju took place at the airport. The members and alternate members of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, greeting Kim Jong Un and Ri Sol Ju, presented greeting of wishes to Kim Jong Un, who came back home in safety after recording another brilliant chapter in the annals of DPRK-China friendship, warmly congratulating him upon his successful China visit. The Supreme Leader met with the greeting senior party and government officials and extended warm greeting to all the beloved people. Political News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Visits People's Republic of China
body: Kim Jong Un Visits DPRK Embassy in Beijing Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, visited the DPRK embassy in Beijing on Wednesday afternoon. Kim Jong Un, the respected Supreme Leader of the party, state and army of the DPRK, was greeted by Ambassador Ji Jae Ryong and staff members of the embassy. Talking with the staff members of the embassy, he learned about its work and living conditions. He had a photo session with all the members of the embassy and their families and students studying in China. He gave a pep talk to the members of the embassy and the students, wishing them good health and greater successes in their work and study. Political News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Visits People's Republic of China
body: Kim Jong Un Visits Beijing Municipal Track Traffic Control Centre Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, together with his wife Ri Sol Ju went round the Beijing Municipal Track Traffic Control Centre on Wednesday afternoon. Accompanying him were Choe Ryong Hae, Pak Pong Ju, Ri Su Yong, Kim Yong Chol, Pak Thae Song, Ri Yong Ho, No Kwang Chol and other senior officials and technical officials. He visited the center together with Wang Huning, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC) and member of the CPC Central Committee Secretariat, Cai Qi, member of the Political Bureau of the C.C., CPC and secretary of the Beijing Municipal Committee of the CPC, Song Tao, head of the International Liaison Department of the C.C., CPC, Chen Jining, mayor of Beijing Municipality, and Li Jinjun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK. The director of the centre explained to Kim Jong Un, the respected Supreme Leader of the party, state and army of the DPRK, in detail about the centre that has made its development under the deep care of the Chinese party and government leaders. Carefully hearing the director's explanation, Kim Jong Un went round the Beijing Municipal subway construction history exhibition, the subway traffic control centre, the automatic ticket sale and ticket check system monitor centre to learn in detail about operation of the Beijing Municipal subway and its development prospect. Saying that he admires at the high-level automation and good combined control system of the centre, he hoped that the centre would further develop into a world-level traffic control centre and make greater progress. Political News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Visits People's Republic of China
body: Kim Jong Un Visits State Agricultural Sci-tech Innovation Institute of China Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, together with his wife Ri Sol Ju visited the State Agricultural Sci-tech Innovation Institute under the Chinese Academy of Agricultural Sciences on Wednesday morning. Kim Jong Un, the respected Supreme Leader of the party, state and army of the DPRK, went round the institute, together with Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, Ri Su Yong, Kim Yong Chol and Pak Thae Song, members of the Political Bureau and vice-chairmen of the C.C., WPK, Ri Yong Ho, member of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK and minister of Foreign Affairs, No Kwang Chol, alternate member of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK and minister of the People's Armed Forces, and other officials and suite members and Ji Jae Ryong, DPRK ambassador to China. Accompanying him were Wang Huning, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC) and member of the CPC Central Committee Secretariat, Cai Qi, member of the Political Bureau of the C.C., CPC and secretary of the Beijing Municipal Committee of the CPC, Song Tao, head of the International Liaison Department of the C.C., CPC, Chen Jining, mayor of Beijing, and Li Jinjun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK. The Supreme Leader was greeted by Tang Huajun, president of the Chinese Academy of Agricultural Sciences, and leading officials of the State Agricultural Sci-tech Innovation Institute. Going round the modern agricultural technology exhibition centre, the green vegetables cultivation technology research centre, the fruit vegetables cultivation technology research centre, the urban agriculture research centre, the residential area agriculture application exhibition centre and other places, Kim Jong Un learned in real earnest about the successes and experience gained in the researches of agricultural science and technology. He noted with high appreciation that the research group of the institute has registered good successes in science and technology researches conducive to the agricultural development of the country. He expressed thanks to leading officials of the Chinese Academy of Agricultural Sciences and the institute for their kind explanation and guidance. He made an autograph in memory of his visit as following: "I greatly admire at the good research successes gained by you. Kim Jong Un. June 20, 2018". The institute presented to Kim Jong Un flowering plants which it cultivated as a gift. Political News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Visits People's Republic of China
body: Kim Jong Un Meets Xi Jinping Again The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un met again with Xi Jinping at the Diaoyutai State Guesthouse on Wednesday. In the compound of the Diaoyutai State Guesthouse, the spruce which President Kim Il Sung planted on October 2, 1959 grows in thick verdure conveying the beautiful story of the DPRK-China friendship. Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan provided Kim Jong Un and his wife Ri Sol Ju with a reunion venue at this significant place and accorded special hospitality to them. Kim Jong Un and Ri Sol Ju gladly met again with Xi Jinping and Peng Liyuan on Wednesday morning. Exchanging warm greetings with respected Xi Jinping and Peng Liyuan, Kim Jong Un and Ri Sol Ju expressed heartfelt thanks for providing them again with a special place. Prior to the luncheon, Kim Jong Un had a talk with Xi Jinping. At the tete-a-tete talk, the top leaders of the DPRK and China exchanged serious views on the present situation and urgent international issues and discussed issues to further strengthen the strategic and tactical cooperation between the two parties and the two countries under a new situation. Then, they and their wives had a luncheon in a happy family atmosphere. The top leaders of the two countries and their wives, who got more familiar with each other on several significant meetings, exchanged their genuine feelings, having an amicable conversation. After the luncheon Kim Jong Un said good-bye to Xi Jinping. Saying that he paid a good and satisfactory visit to China under the tender care of Xi Jinping, Kim Jong Un expressed thanks to the Chinese party and government for warmly greeting him and according hospitality to him with special favor every time. Promising Xi Jinping and Peng Liyuan to have a new meeting, Kim Jong Un and Ri Sol Ju said good-bye to them. Political News Team

title: DPRK Olympic Committee Delegation Leaves for Switzerland
body: A delegation of the DPRK Olympic Committee led by Chairman Kim Il Guk, who is the minister of Physical Culture and Sports, left Pyongyang on Tuesday to attend an event marking the Day of Olympiad due in Switzerland. Rodong News Team

title: Korea's Peace and Reunification Supported in Venezuela
body: A Venezuelan solidarity committee for Korea's peace and reunification was formed in Caracas on June 12, with the 18th anniversary of the June 15 North-South Joint Declaration as an occasion. Felix Jesus Velasquez Castillo, general coordinator of the Federal Political Secretariat of the United Left Party of Venezuela, was elected the coordinator of the committee. Speakers said at the inaugural ceremony that Korea's reunification is the noble cause to which President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il devoted all their lives. And they praised the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un for realizing the historic cause of peace, prosperity and reunification of the Korean peninsula, true to the preceding leaders' idea and cause of national reunification. They expressed their will to conduct brisk solidarity activities for support to the Korean people's socialist construction and struggle for national reunification. Rodong News Team

title: Russian Embassy Officials Help Korean Farmers
body: As a token of friendship, staff members of the Russian embassy here helped farmers in weeding a dry field at the DPRK-Russia Friendship Kochang Vegetable Co-op Farm in Chollima District, Nampho City on Tuesday. They handed over aid materials to the farm. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Il's Exploits Praised by Foreigners
body: Events were held in different countries in the period between June 7 and 16 to mark the 54th anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il's start of work at the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). They included meetings in Mexico and Pakistan, a seminar in Bulgaria and film shows in Romania and Angola. "Prosperous Pyongyang" and other Korean film were shown.
