The general secretary of the Central Committee of the People's Socialist Party of Mexico said that Kim Jong Il developed the WPK into an ever-victorious iron-willed party and turned the DPRK into an invincible power. Thanks to his leadership the Korean people could firmly defend the sovereignty and dignity of the country and socialism, the general secretary added. The secretary general of the Karachi Branch of the Pakistan-Korea Friendship Association and other figures praised Kim Jong Il for making a great contribution to the era and history through his rare ideo-theoretical activities and wise guidance. At the event held in Bulgaria a reporter and speakers said that Kim Jong Il built the WPK into a party modeled on the revolutionary idea of the leader and into a powerful party attaching priority to the interests of the people while working at the Party Central Committee. The chairman of the Socialist Party of Romania said it is entirely thanks to the distinguished leadership of Kim Jong Il that the WPK has received absolute support and trust from the popular masses, adding: The world progressive people are praising him, who set a model of building a socialist ruling party, as the most prominent leader. The international secretary of the Youth Organization of the Popular Liberation Movement of Angola lauded Kim Jong Il for turning the DPRK into a political and ideological and military power with his unique Songun revolutionary leadership. A congratulatory message to the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was adopted at the event in Pakistan. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung to Be Remembered in Czech Republic
body: A Czech preparatory committee for remembering President Kim Il Sung was formed in Prague on June 12. Jozef Servista, deputy general secretary of the Central Committee of the Czechoslovak Communist Party and first vice-chairman of the Paektusan Czech-Korean Friendship Association, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee set the remembrance period from June 20 to July 10 and decided to organize political and cultural events in praise of the revolutionary career and exploits of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il and the personality of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un as the peerlessly great man. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Il's Work Published in Russia
body: The Khabarovsk Territory Publishing House of Russia brought out in booklet leader Kim Jong Il's work "Officials Should Become Devoted Servants of the People" on the occasion of the 54th anniversary of his start of work at the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. The work, published on October 28, Juche 92 (2003), indicates the tasks and ways for making all the officials work as devoted servants of the people. A book-releasing ceremony took place on June 15. Rodong News Team

title: Implementation of Panmunjom Declaration Urged in S. Korea
body: According to the south Korean online newspaper Tongil News, the Taejon Headquarters of the south Korean Confederation of Trade Unions held a news conference outside the Taejon City Office on June 19 to launch a campaign for urging the implementation of the Panmunjom Declaration. At the conference, speakers said that the April 27 Panmunjom Declaration clearly reflects the spirit of the era of peaceful reunification desired by the workers. They added that the inter-Korean summit and the DPRK-U.S. summit are historic events that realized the desire of the people. A press release was read out there. Expressing fully support for the Panmunjom Declaration and the DPRK-U.S. summit, the press release stressed that the headquarters would strive to establish a durable and lasting peace-keeping mechanism on the Korean Peninsula and usher in a fresh era of independent and peaceful reunification. Rodong News Team

title: Deputy Executive Director of UNICEF Leaves
body: Shanelle Marie Hall, deputy executive director of UNICEF, and her party left Pyongyang on Thursday. Rodong News Team

title: Japanese Reactionaries' Ploy to Bedevil Situation on Korean Peninsula
body: Recently Abe met the prime ministers of the two Southeast Asian countries on a visit to Japan and requested them for cooperation in putting the "international pressure" upon the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. This is a mean act of begging by one who is left alone. The military authorities from the U.S., south Korea and Japan, who attended the 17th Asia Security Conference recently held in Singapore, had tripartite talks. During the talks there were differences among them over the issue of pressure upon the DPRK. The Japanese defense minister said that the U.S., Japan and south Korea agreed to keep pressure upon the DPRK. But the issue of pressure was not mentioned at a joint press conference after the talks. The DPRK-U.S summit clearly proved that no matter how hard Japan kicks up a fuss, it can never stem the historic trend toward reconciliation, peace, stability and prosperity in the Korean Peninsula and the region. Abe, seized with uneasiness, is inveigling Southeast Asian countries into the sinister moves to bedevil the situation on the Korean Peninsula. Japan is beefing up its military muscle while persistently crying out for the "international pressure". But it is nothing but last-ditch efforts to hide its miserable position, being totally marginalized from the trend of the regional situation. Ri Hyon Do

title: Anti-Reunification Traitorous Parties Should Be Totally Buried
body: "Liberal Korea Party" and other south Korean conservatives are a group of traitors without an equal in the world as they are going reckless in the confrontation with the fellow countrymen in the north, persistently opposing the reconciliation and unity of the nation. Through the elections to the local self-governing bodies, the south Korean conservative group fully revealed their despicable true colors that they can not live even a moment without the confrontational hysteria, hurling mud at the fellow countrymen in the north. Those, quite indifferent to the improvement of the relations with the north and the peace on the Korean Peninsula, ran amuck like rabid dogs, calculating that the prospect of the elections would be gloomier due to the DPRK-U.S. summit. The "Liberal Korea Party" coterie invited bitter ire from the people as they made reckless efforts to scuttle the phase of DPRK-U.S. dialogue at any cost and prolong their remaining days. The "Parunmirae Party" coterie also left no stone unturned to achieve its political ambition by putting a brake on the process for improving the ties with the north and by stirring up the confrontation at the elections to the local self-governing bodies. The reality clearly proves that the "Liberal Korea Party" and other conservative political parties of south Korea are like insects as they are only harmful to the inter-Korean ties and the Korean nation. Every sin brings its punishment with it. The garbage of the times is bound to go to the dumping ground of history. Sim Chol Yong

title: Deputy Executive Director of UNICEF Visits Okryu Children's Hospital
body: Shanelle Marie Hall, deputy executive director of UNICEF, and her party visited the Okryu Children's Hospital. The guests went round various parts of the modernly-equipped hospital and had a friendly talk with children staying there to get medical treatment and their parents. They also visited the Tower of the Juche Idea and aid projects in Jungsan County, South Phyongan Province. Rodong News Team

title: Launch of 2017 DPRK Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey Findings
body: The Launch of 2017 DPRK Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey Findings took place at the Taedonggang Diplomatic Club on Wednesday. Present there were officials from the State Planning Commission, the Education Commission, the Ministry of Public Health and other relevant units, the deputy executive director of UNICEF and her party on a visit to the DPRK, the representative of UNICEF office in Pyongyang and members of missions of international bodies and foreign embassies to Pyongyang. Speakers noted the multiple indicator cluster survey of living conditions of households, children and women, and standards of health, education, nutrition and sanitary facilities across the DPRK has been conducted on the principles of objectivity, timeliness and scientific accuracy according to the international standard methodology. The survey would contribute to the DPRK government's policy-making for building a powerful socialist country and to implementing the action program for attaining the international sustainable development goals, they stressed. Then the process of the survey and sectional findings were presented. At the end of the launch, the participants looked round the photos and exhibits showing the aid of UNICEF to the DPRK. Rodong News Team

title: Anniversary of Kim Jong Il's Start of Work at WPK Observed Abroad
body: Events took place in various countries on the occasion of the 54th anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il's start of work at the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). They included a reading session of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us Step Up the Building of a Thriving Country by Applying Kim Jong Il's Patriotism" in Angola, friendly meetings, book and photo exhibitions and film shows in Equatorial Guinea, Iran and Myanmar and a lecture in Slovenia from June 7 to 15. Shown at the film shows were Korean films such as "Monument to Party Founding". The vice-director of the International Department of the Democratic Party of Equatorial Guinea said; I highly praise the great exploits performed by President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il in accomplishing the human cause of independence. Under the tested guidance of HE Kim Jong Un who is successfully carrying forward the cause of the preceding leaders, the WPK has been further developed into the invincible party which leads the Korean people in their struggle for defending the country's sovereignty, building socialism and reunifying the country and today the DPRK is making world-startling miracles one after another. I sincerely wish the WPK and the Korean people bigger successes in their struggle for world peace, stability and country's prosperity. A vice-general secretary of the Islamic Coalition Party of Iran said: The WPK was firmly consolidated as the invincible political general staff closely united with one idea under the wise leadership of HE Kim Jong Il. Respected HE Kim Jong Un is making great contributions to the prosperity of the country and the peace on the Korean Peninsula with his outstanding leadership and diplomatic strategy. I extend firm solidarity to the WPK and Korean people struggling under the guidance of another great man. Rodong News Team

title: Japan Should Sincerely Liquidate Its Past
body: The statue of a girl sexual slave for the Imperial Japanese Army erected in Manhattan, New York, has been recently exhibited on a rotation basis at the building of U.S. Congress. Japan made desperate efforts to check the exhibition but in vain. This goes to prove once again that truth and justice are sure to win and lie and injustice are doomed to fail. Japan is openly denying the crimes of sexual slavery committed by it in the past. Japan has claimed that the sexual slavery was spawned by non-governmental business persons in a bid to deny the state's involvement in the crimes, but now lays the blame at the door of the victims, asserting that the sexual slaves volunteered to earn money. Under the pretext of the "agreement" on the sexual slavery for the Imperial Japanese Army made with traitor Park Geun Hye, Japan is advertising that the thrice-cursed sexual slavery issue has been settled. Japan can neither cover up its past crimes nor flee from the blame. It can neither rewrite history of crimes stained with the blood of peoples of other countries nor beautify it. Its distortion and denial of the past add to the crimes. The only way out for Japan is to honestly admit its past crimes and make perfect reparation for them. Japan's future depends on sincere liquidation of the past. Ri Hyo Jin

title: Strength of Single-Mindedly United DPRK Is Inexhaustible
body: Inexhaustible is the strength of the DPRK where the leader and his people are firmly united in the idea, intention, affection and obligation. The single-minded unity is just the driving force pressing ahead with the Korean revolution even in any adversity without any slight stagnation and standstill and the mighty power for turning adversity into prosperity. The army and people's trust in the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un is boundless, and the might of our integrated whole has increased immensely. It is attributable to the army and people sharing their destiny with socialism that the DPRK has been emerging victorious despite manifold difficulties and trials. Korean-style socialism centered on the popular masses has taken deep roots in the hearts of the people. The destiny of socialism is linked with the destiny of the Korean people as one. The Korean people absolutely support and trust socialism as they have experienced the advantages of socialism centered on the popular masses without an equal in the world, through their actual life, not from a book. Socialism is enshrined in the hearts of the people as their life and soul. Herein lie the essential advantages and invincibility of Korean-style socialism and the key to its long drive. Ho Yong Min

title: Anniversary of Inter-Korean Declaration Observed Abroad
body: Media of different countries and regions gave special write-ups to the 18th publication anniversary of the June 15 North-South Joint Declaration on June 14-15. Russia's internet newspaper Forum and internet homepages the DPRK Today and Patrioti Moskva elaborated on the north-south joint declaration, which was adopted in June 2000 as a milestone for Korea's reunification, carrying photos of leader Kim Jong Il and the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. They stressed that the precious exploits performed by Kim Jong Il in the history of the movement for national reunification have been creditably carried forward by Kim Jong Un. The Bangladeshi newspaper Daily Industry said: By Our Nation Itself is the main idea for Korea's reunification and core of the June 15 North-South Joint Declaration. Leader Kim Jong Il made sure that it was stipulated in the joint declaration. It was his consistent and unshakable stand to solve the issue of the country's reunification by the efforts of the Korean nation. Korea's reunification will be surely achieved thanks to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un carrying forward his cause without an inch of deflection. The AKP of Cambodia, and Juche Africa, a website of the African Regional Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea, said that the idea of By Our Nation Itself is a fruition of Kim Jong Il's noble idea for national reunification and that the adoption of the joint declaration brought an era of national independence and great national unity to the Korean Peninsula. Rodong News Team

title: Books Donated to Classroom Named after Fidel Castro Ruz
body: The Cuban embassy here donated books to the classroom named after Fidel Castro Ruz at Pyongyang Foreign Languages School under Pyongyang University of Foreign Studies on Thursday. Ambassador Jesus De Los Angeles Aise Sotolongo and staff members of the embassy visited the school on the occasion of the month of solidarity with the Cuban people. They went round a transcription lecture room and other parts of the school before donating the books helpful to education to the classroom named after Fidel Castro Ruz. Rodong News Team

title: Iranian Embassy Officials Help Korean Farmers
body: Iranian Ambassador to the DPRK Seyed Mohsen Emadi and his embassy officials helped Korean farmers at the DPRK-Iran Friendship Ripsok Co-op Farm in Mundok County on June 21 on the occasion of the DPRK-Iran friendship week. They helped farmers in weeding a corn-field. Earlier, staff members of the Iranian embassy visited Pyongyang University of Foreign Studies and had a talk with students. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung to Be Remembered in India
body: An Indian committee for remembering President Kim Il Sung was formed in New Delhi on June 14. Atul Kumar Anjan, secretary of the National Council of the Communist Party of India and chairman of the All India Indo-Korean Friendship Association, was elected chairman of the remembrance committee. The committee set a remembrance period from June 15 to July 10 and decided to give wide media publicity to the revolutionary career of Kim Il Sung and his exploits for the Korean revolution and global independence and organize political and cultural events including remembrance meeting, seminar, photo exhibition and lecture. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's Work Published in Russia
body: The Leto-print Publishing House of Russia brought out in booklet the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us Hasten the Final Victory through a Revolutionary Ideological Offensive" on June 14. The work, published on February 25, Juche 103 (2014), says that the whole course of the Korean revolution was a history of ideological work to give the fullest play to the might of the truth of the revolutionary ideas of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il. It also indicates the tasks and ways facing the field of the party ideological work at present. Rodong News Team

title: Wreaths Laid at Bust of Revolutionary Martyr
body: Wreaths were placed at the bust of revolutionary martyr Kang Kon in the Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery on Mt Taesong on Saturday, the centenary of his birth. Seen there was a wreath from Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and supreme commander of the Korean People's Army. Present at the wreath-laying ceremony were Pak Kwang Ho, vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, Jon Kwang Ho, vice-premier of the Cabinet, Ryang Won Ho, director of the Party History Institute of the C.C., WPK, members of the C.C., WPK, officials of ministries and city-level organs and bereaved family members. Army General No Kwang Chol, minister of the People's Armed Forces, and other officials of the ministry and servicepersons were present. Laid at the bust was a wreath in the name of the WPK Central Committee. Also placed were wreaths in the names of the Ministry of the People's Armed Forces, ministries, party and power organs in the city of Pyongyang as well as bouquets. The participants paid a silent tribute to the memory of Kang Kon. Rodong News Team

title: Japan Blasted for Its Moves to Grab Tok Island
body: The Progressive Federation of Students and other organizations in south Korea held a news conference in Seoul on June 21 to condemn the Japanese reactionaries for their moves to grab Tok Island, according to the south Korean online paper Jaju Sibo. Speakers at the conference charged that the Japanese government is persistently claiming the "dominium over Tok Island". Such act can not be pardoned any longer as it poses a threat to the peace on the Korean Peninsula, they said. Rodong News Team

title: Socialist Public Health System Centred on Popular Masses
body: The socialist public health system in the DPRK is the best one based on the great Juche idea. The public health in the DPRK is symbolic of the advantages of Korean-style socialism centered on the popular masses, where the working masses are masters of everything and everything in society serves them. Under the socialist system in our country, the people live in happiness free from all worries about healthcare. Free medical treatment is a major state and social policy in our country. Various healthcare policies, including a section doctor system, a system for keeping the children and women healthy and a social security system, are in force in our country. Besides, such professional medical services as telemedicine system and emergency treatment are making steady progress. The Party's policy of preventive medicine has been implemented so fully that all the people work and live in good health under more hygienic and cultured environment. The socialist public health system in our country is the best advantageous popular system in view of its character and substance. Choe Suk Hyon

title: Centenary of Revolutionary Martyr Kang Kon's Birth Marked
body: A national meeting was held at the Central Youth Hall on Friday to commemorate the centenary of birth of revolutionary martyr Kang Kon. Present there were Yang Hyong Sop, vice-president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, Pak Kwang Ho and Choe Hwi, vice-chairmen of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea, Jon Kwang Ho, vice-premier of the Cabinet, Ryang Won Ho, director of the Party History Institute of the C.C., WPK, members of the C.C, WPK, officials of ministries and national institutions, officials of institutions and industrial establishments in Pyongyang and persons of merit. Born into a poor peasant's family in Sangju, North Kyongsang Province on June 23, Juche 7 (1918), Kang Kon keenly experienced the sorrow and pain of a stateless nation. So, he embarked on the revolutionary struggle in his early years. Army General No Kwang Chol, minister of the People's Armed Forces, said in a report at the meeting: The revolutionary life of anti-Japanese revolutionary fighter Kang Kon was the brilliant one of a hot-blooded fighter who remained loyal to the idea and cause of the Party and the leader with the unshakable faith. With the iron faith that the Korean revolution led by President Kim Il Sung is sure to win in any grim ordeals, he undauntedly fought and unconditionally and thoroughly implemented the leader's line, policy, order and instructions, accepting them as an absolute truth. The single-minded devotion of the fighter who always went straight ahead along the road indicated by the President is a paragon to be followed by all of us, and the life of Kang, who cherished the fixed revolutionary faith of trusting and following his leader only and remained loyal to the idea and cause of the Party, will go down in the history of the country. The reporter stressed the need to devotedly defend the Party Central Committee headed by the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un by carrying forward the tradition of loyalty created in the forest of Mt Paektu and share the intention, breath and step with the Party Central Committee under any circumstances. He called for pushing ahead with the grand march for economic construction in the spirit of self-reliance and by dint of science and technology, true to the spirit of the April 2018 Plenary Meeting of the Party Central Committee, and thus revitalizing the economy and bringing about a turn in the improvement of the people's standard of living in the shortest period. Rodong News Team

title: Inter-Korean Red Cross Talks Held
body: Inter-Korean Red Cross talks for implementing the historic Panmunjom Declaration were held in Mt Kumgang on Friday. Present there were a north side delegation led by Pak Yong Il, vice-chairman of the DPRK Committee for the Peaceful Reunification of the Country, and a south side delegation with Pak Kyong So, president of the "Korea National Red Cross", as chief delegate. At the talks both sides agreed to have the reunion of separated families and relatives from the north and the south in Mt Kumgang resort on the occasion of August 15 and discussed the practical issues for the preparations of the reunion. And they agreed to keep on having necessary Red Cross talks and working contacts in the future. A joint press release was adopted and made public at the talks. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Il's Exploits Praised by Foreign Media
body: Foreign media reported leader Kim Jong Il's exploits on the occasion of the 54th anniversary of his start of work at the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). Cambodia's AKP on June 18 said it was a noteworthy event of weighty importance in the development of the WPK that Kim Jong Il started his work at the Party Central Committee. It went on: He built the WPK into a party in which its leader's ideology and guidance system was firmly established, a motherly party making a harmonious whole with the popular masses and serving them and a revolutionary party with strong sense of organization and discipline. Under his seasoned leadership the WPK developed into an invincible party with powerful mass foundation. It is the unshakable faith and unanimous will of all members of the WPK to glorify it as the party of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il forever. The Syrian newspaper Al Baath on June 16 carried an article in praise of the feats of Kim Jong Il, who glorified the Juche idea founded by Kim Il Sung as a guiding idea of the WPK and turned the DPRK into an invincible power which no one dares to provoke by consolidating the single-minded unity of the leader, the party and the masses as firm as a rock. The Bangladeshi newspaper Daily Nauroz in an article on June 13 elaborated on Kim Jong Il's patriotism, stressing that it is a precious mental legacy for the Korean people and a beacon and compass leading all of them to display true patriotism. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung to Be Remembered in Kuwait
body: A committee for remembering President Kim Il Sung was formed in Kuwait on June 14. Javid Ahmad, director of the Administrative Department of the Kuwait Times and chairman of the Kuwait Asian Journalist Association, was elected chairman of the committee. The committee decided to hold political and cultural events including seminar and film show praising the revolutionary career and exploits of the President from June 15 to July 9. Rodong News Team

title: Letter to Kim Jong Un from Koreans in China
body: The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a letter from the General Association of Koreans in China on June 20. Noting that Kim Jong Un visited China three times in a matter of three months and performed another feat to be recorded in the history of the Korean nation by developing the traditional ties between the DPRK and China into special ones unprecedented in the world, the letter said: The officials of the General Association and all Koreans in China, inspired by your successive China visits, are full of enthusiasm to genuinely contribute to further strengthening the traditional DPRK-China friendship, true to your noble intention. Though we live abroad, we will always bear in mind that the existence of homeland as well as the life and future of Koreans in China are guaranteed by you and will become true patriots who remain faithful to your idea and leadership, trusting and following only you no matter what happens in the world. We will further consolidate the General Association, founded and guided by President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il, into an organization of overseas compatriots strong in the Juche and national characters, and add eternal luster to the exploits you performed by laying a fresh milestone for the development of the DPRK-China relations. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's Work Introduced in Austria
body: The Society for the Promotion of the Relations between Austria and the DPRK posted the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us March Forward Dynamically towards Final Victory, Holding Higher the Banner of Songun" on its website on June 18 to mark the 54th anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il's start of work at the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. The work is a speech the Supreme Leader delivered at the military parade in celebration of the centenary of birth of President Kim Il Sung on April 15, Juche 101 (2012). It says that the century-long history of Kim Il Sung's nation clearly proved the immutable truth that an outstanding leader guarantees the dignity and prosperity of the country and the nation. It also indicates the tasks for glorifying the dignity of Songun Korea for all ages and successfully accomplishing the cause of building a thriving socialist country. Rodong News Team

title: More Crimes of Lee and Park Groups Revealed in S. Korea
body: It was disclosed that the Lee Myung Bak and Park Geun Hye groups of traitors in south Korea let the police conduct illegal surveillance over civilians, according to Kukmin Ilbo of south Korea on June 20. The police, given an instruction from them, reportedly organized a cyber surveillance group of 50 to 100 persons in secrecy and monitored on internet those who criticized the regimes and the army. For guaranteeing secrecy, the agents of the group could not reportedly see each other's face while doing the same job and had to exchange their reports via emails only. Rodong News Team

title: Solidarity Action for Settling Issue of Sexual Slavery Waged in S. Korea
body: The Council for the Solution of the Issue of the Volunteers Corps in south Korea waged solidarity action for settling the issue of sexual slavery for the Imperial Japanese Army together with victims of sexual slavery from different countries in Geneva, Switzerland on June 19, according to the south Korean internet newspaper Tongil News. The organization said that the international community should make positive efforts not only for the reinstatement of the honor and rights of the victims of sexual slavery but also for the eradication of sexual violence being committed up to now in the areas of armed conflicts. It stressed that the world should become vocal urging Japan to make an apology and reparation for its crimes related to sexual slavery. Rodong News Team

title: Youth and Students Make Study Tour of Revolutionary Battle Sites in Mt Paektu
body: Youth and students from across the country made a study tour of revolutionary battle sites in the area of Mt Paektu from June 10 to 24 to mark the 62nd anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il's pioneering of the study tour of the revolutionary battle sites in the area of Mt Paektu. They left Hyesan and arrived in Pochonbo, where they laid a floral basket and made a bow before the statue of President Kim Il Sung in military uniform of anti-Japanese guerrilla. They went round the command post of the Battle of Pochonbo, the police sub-station, the subcounty office, the post office, etc. They passed the Spring Site in Poso-ri and the Tableland of Junghung and then arrived in Samjiyon County on June 12, where they hardened their will to turn the DPRK into an invincible powerful socialist country in front of the statue of leader Kim Jong Il. At the Samjiyon Grand Monument they went round the shore of Lake Samji, a torch tower, groups of subsidiary theme sculptures, etc, being briefed on the successful conversion of the Samjiyon Revolutionary Battle Site into a base for education in revolutionary traditions. They toured the Paektusan Hero Youth Power Station on June 15. They made study tours of the Monument to the Victorious Battle of Musan Area, the Sinsadong Revolutionary Battle Site, Mupho Bivouac, etc. and then passed Sinmusong and Mudu Peak and climbed Mt Paektu on June 20. On the top of Mt Paektu they vowed to invariably carry on the march started from Mt Paektu, following the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. At Kim Jong Il's birthplace in the Paektusan Secret Camp, they looked round the historical relics preserved at the old home with much care. They went round the Rimyongsu Revolutionary Site and Chongbong and Konchang Bivouacs. During the study tour the youth and students had such diverse political and cultural events as a meeting to hear impressions on the reminiscences of anti-Japanese guerillas and a question-and-answer study contest and handed over aid materials to shock brigade members making innovations in sprucing up Samjiyon County and worked together with them. Rodong News Team

title: Pollutants Found in Tap Water in S. Korea
body: A huge amount of new environmental pollutants and carcinogenic substances were found in tap water in Taegu City of south Korea, inviting public criticism, according to Kukmin Ilbo of south Korea on June 22. The citizens urged the authorities to examine the tap water and adopt measures as soon as possible. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to President of Mozambique
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, on June 18 sent a message of greeting to Filipe Jacinto Nwussi, president of the Republic of Mozambique, on the occasion of its national day. Kim in the message expressed the belief that the friendly and cooperative ties between the two countries with a long history and tradition would grow stronger, sincerely wishing the president and people of Mozambique bigger success in their work for the country's socio-economic development and prosperity. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung to Be Remembered in Ethiopia
body: An Ethiopian committee for remembering President Kim Il Sung was formed in Addis Ababa on June 19. Nigatu Dagnachew, chairman of the Ethiopian National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism and chairman of the Ethiopia-Korea Friendship and Solidarity Committee, was elected chairman of the remembrance committee. It decided to hold political and cultural events such as a seminar, remembrance meeting, photo exhibition and film show in praise of the President's revolutionary feats from June 20 to July 12. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung to Be Remembered in Hungary
body: A Hungarian committee for remembering President Kim Il Sung was inaugurated in Budapest on June 19. Gyula Thurmer, chairman of the Hungarian Workers' Party, was elected chairman of the committee. It decided to give wide media publicity to the President's feats and hold political and cultural events such as a remembrance meeting, lecture and film show on the occasion of the 24th anniversary of his demise. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung to Be Remembered in Iran
body: A committee of the Islamic Coalition Party of Iran for remembering President Kim Il Sung was formed on June 20. Mahdi Soli, vice general secretary for International Affairs of the Iranian party, was elected chairman of the committee. The committee set a remembrance period from June 20 to July 10 and decided to organize political and cultural events praising the revolutionary career and exploits of Kim Il Sung. Rodong News Team

title: Police's Red Herring for Lee Myung Bak Laid Bare in S. Korea
body: Economic Daily of south Korea on June 21 disclosed the fact that police committed red herrings in a bid to create favorable political situation for traitor Lee Myung Bak during his stay in office. Rodong News Team

title: Kangwon Provincial Tree Nursery Completed
body: A large-scale sapling-producing base has been built in Kangwon Province, the DPRK. The Kangwon Provincial Tree Nursery built in the area of scores of hectares has the sapling-producing district, managing building, general service establishment, dwelling houses, etc. The nursery has the integrated control system and was successfully put on a scientific, industrial and intensive basis. A ceremony of completing the nursery took place on the spot on Sunday. Attending the ceremony were O Su Yong, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Pak Jong Nam, chairman of the Kangwon Provincial Committee of the WPK, Jang Chol, president of the State Academy of Sciences, officials concerned, officials, scientists and technicians of the units which contributed to the construction, officials and working people of party and power organs, factories and enterprises in the province and employees of the nursery. Rodong News Team

title: Traitors Will Meet Only Ruin
body: There took place the elections to local self-governing bodies and by-election to the "National Assembly" in south Korea on June 13. The conservative group including the "Liberal Korea Party" made desperate efforts to turn the elections into a golden opportunity to get rid of their ruin and gain a foothold for retaking power. However, the pro-democratic reform forces won at the elections to the local self-governing bodies with the sweeping support in 14 areas including Seoul and Pusan. While they won 11 seats at the by-election to the "National Assembly", the conservative group managed to win one seat only to suffer a great defeat. The recent elections in south Korea prove that there is no future for the conservative group and the worst traitors forsaken by the public mindset are doomed to ruin. The outcome of the elections reconfirms the miserable end of those who go against the public mindset and the trend of the times. Ri Hyok Chol

title: Korean People's Struggle Supported in Czech Republic
body: A solidarity meeting for supporting the Korean people's struggle for justice took place in the Czech Republic on June 16. Attending it were figures of various political parties and organizations including the Czechoslovak Communist Party, Communist Party-21 of the Czech Republic and the Czech Group for the Study and Materialization of the Juche Idea and popular masses. The deputy general secretary of the C.C., Czechoslovak Communist Party and first vice-chairman of the Paektusan Czech-Korean Friendship Association wholeheartedly congratulated the Korean people upon continuous successes in their struggle for socialist construction and national reunification, saying: The north-south summit at Panmunjom, a symbol of division which nobody could cross in the past, was provided thanks to the bold decision and will of respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. Mankind is admiring at the successes made by the Korean people in the struggle for peace and stability of the Korean Peninsula and national reunification. I am convinced that the Korean people will certainly win the final victory while translating the plan and desire of their preceding leaders into reality under the tested guidance of respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. A statement supporting the Korean people's cause of justice was adopted at the meeting. The statement expressed full support for the DPRK's efforts for ensuring stability of the world and durable and lasting peace on the Korean Peninsula and reunifying the country. It wished the Korean people bigger successes in socialist construction with the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK as an occasion. Rodong News Team

title: Special Envoy of Swedish Government Arrives
body: Kent Rolf Magnus Harstedt, a special envoy of the Swedish government, and his party arrived in Pyongyang on Monday. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung to Be Remembered in Romania
body: A Romanian committee for remembering President Kim Il Sung was formed on June 20. Constantin Rotaru, chairman of the Socialist Party of Romania, was elected chairman of the remembrance committee. The committee decided to give wide publicity to the exploits of Kim Il Sung for the country and people and hold political and cultural events from June 20 to July 8. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Il's Work Published in Algeria
body: Leader Kim Jong Il's work "Giving Priority to Ideological Work is Essential for Accomplishing Socialism" was brought out in pamphlet by the Tarzalt Publishing House in El-Djezair of Algeria on June 19, the 54th anniversary of his start of work at the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. The work, published on June 19, Juche 84 (1995), elucidates the ideas that one should hold fast to the ideological work and give priority to it to successfully accomplish the socialist cause and that the main task to be carried out in the ideological work is to model the whole society on the socialist idea and the ideological work should be conducted on the principle and way suited to the intrinsic requirements of socialism. Rodong News Team

title: Credentials of Ethiopian Ambassador Accepted
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, received credentials from Berhane Gebre Christos, Ethiopian ambassador to the DPRK, at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Wednesday. After receiving the credentials, Kim had a talk with the ambassador. Rodong News Team

title: Vice-Chairman of C.C., WPK Meets New Namibian Ambassador
body: Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea on Wednesday met and had a talk with Kaiyamo Elia George, new Namibian ambassador to the DPRK, who paid a courtesy call on him. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Yong Nam Meets Special Envoy of Swedish Government
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, met and had a talk with Kent Rolf Magnus Harstedt, a special envoy of the Swedish government, and his party who paid a courtesy call on him, at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Wednesday. Rodong News Team

title: "Threat" Ballad Precipitating Isolation and Self-Destruction
body: Japan is working hard to deploy Aegis Ashore, a new-type interceptor missile system, at any cost, under the pretext of coping with "threat" from the DPRK. Minister of Defense Onodera was reported that he would visit Akita and Yamaguchi prefectures, the sites for the deployment of the new-type interceptor missile system, to discuss it. The DPRK cannot but take a serious note of such scheme as it is an act of blocking the peaceful climate on the Korean peninsula and bringing dark clouds of escalating tension to the region. It is preposterous for Japan to talk about the need to deploy the system for "defense." What matters is why Japan is citing "threat" from the DPRK so vociferously. "Threat" from the DPRK is used as an indispensable excuse for the Abe group to stay in power. Abe came to power, considering the hostile policy toward the DPRK as a means. Whenever the Abe regime found itself in a tight corner, it has defused a political crisis, talking about "threat" from the DPRK. That's why the Abe group driven into a predicament in the wake of scandals is talking a lot about "threat" again. Abe seeks to use "threat" from the DPRK for the purpose of making Japan a war state. If Japan revises the constitution, it will be a war state. The Japanese people want to keep up the existing constitution called the "Pacifist Constitution." The Abe group seeks to advertise "threat" from the DPRK so as to increase uneasiness and fear among the people and gain support for the revision of the constitution from them. If the Abe group rushes headlong into the road of building a war state, it will meet only isolation and self-destruction. Ri Hyon Do

title: North-South Talks of Panel for Cooperation in Railway Held
body: North-south talks of panel for cooperation in railway were held at the "house of peace" in the south side portion of Panmunjom on June 26 according to the agreement of the north-south high-level talks for the implementation of the historic Panmunjom Declaration. Present at the talks were the north side delegation led by Kim Yun Hyok, vice-minister of Railways, and the south side delegation led by Kim Jong Ryol, vice-minister of Land and Transportation, as chief delegate. At the talks both sides discussed the practical issues arising in reconnecting, updating and using the railways on the east and west coasts and adopted a joint press release. Rodong News Team

title: Nordic Seminar on Juche Idea
body: A Nordic seminar on the Juche idea for "The cause of independence in north Europe" took place in Finland on June 16. On display at the venue of the seminar were works of President Kim Il Sung, leader Kim Jong Il and the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and books on the praiseworthy reality of the DPRK. Juha Kieksy, deputy director-general of the European Society for the Study of the Juche Idea and chairman of the Finnish National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea, made a report and then several figures made speeches at the seminar. The reporter and speakers said that the seminar was more significant as it was held at a time when the whole world was excited to hear the news of the historic first DPRK-U.S. summit meeting and talks. They praised Kim Jong Un for having made a great contribution to ensuring peace and security in the Korean peninsula and the region and the rest of the world. They stressed that the Juche idea founded by Kim Il Sung and the principle of independence in politics, self-support in the economy and self-reliance in national defence based on it serve as a starting point for building an independent society where the popular masses are provided with genuine democratic rights. They referred to the facts that Kim Jong Il reliably defended the dignity and sovereignty of the country and nation, smashing all sorts of challenges with his resolute independent politics and that the DPRK is more fully demonstrating its dignity as a powerful country under the guidance of Kim Jong Un. They expressed their resolve to intensify the study and dissemination of the peerlessly great men's works. A letter to Kim Jong Un was adopted at the seminar. Rodong News Team

title: President of Norwegian Red Cross Society Here
body: Robert Mood, president of the Norwegian Red Cross Society, and his party arrived here on Tuesday. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Olympic Committee Delegation Returns Home
body: A delegation of the DPRK Olympic Committee led by Chairman Kim Il Guk, who is minister of Physical Culture and Sports, returned home on Tuesday after attending an event marking the Day of Olympiad held in Switzerland. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Delegation Returns Home
body: A delegation of the DPRK Ministry of Land and Environment Protection led by Minister Kim Kyong Jun came back home on Tuesday after participating in the international high level conference on International Decade for Action "Water for Sustainable Development" 2018-2028 held in Tajikistan. Rodong News Team

title: Crimes of Marital Law Army Disclosed in S. Korea
body: The south Korean CBS on June 25 disclosed the fact that during the last Kwangju Popular Uprising, the "martial law army" used lead bullets prohibited by international law against uprisers and innocent citizens. It said that the May 18 Commemoration Foundation found a document dealing with the fact at the library of California University in the U.S. Carried in the document are testimonies of American doctors who visited south Korea shortly after the uprising that the "martial law army" used lead bullets prohibited even in a war, it noted. Rodong News Team

title: Victims of RPR Rebuilding Case Found Innocent in S. Korea
body: According to the south Korean MBC on Wednesday, personages who had been in prison after being involved in a case of rebuilding the Revolutionary Party for Reunification were given a judgment of acquittal. The case was fabricated by traitor Park Chung-Hee to prolong his "yusin" dictatorial regime. In September 1979 a lot of people were sentenced to life imprisonment after being branded as those involved in the "case to rebuild the party on the directives of the north". The Seoul High Court issued a judgment of acquittal for five persons, contending that the confessions an investigation body forced on them after having illegally detained them can not be considered as testimonies. Rodong News Team

title: Floor Spokesman for LKP Hit for Reckless Remarks against Trend of Times
body: According to the south Korean News 1, the floor spokesman for the "Liberal Korea Party" made reckless remarks against the public mind-set for peace of the Korean Peninsula on Monday. That day the guy said in a commentary that it is necessary to shift the blame for the provocation of the June 25 War on to the DPRK and take more precautions to cope with it at a time when the climate of peace gains momentum. This is a reckless act of seeking confrontation again despite the people's mindset calling for dissolving the party of traitors even though it suffered the defeat in the recent elections to local self-governing bodies. As long as there is a group of traitors who regard the confrontation with fellow countrymen as the mode of existence like the LKP, the danger of war can neither be defused on this land nor the cherished desire of the nation come true. Rodong News Team

title: Japan Should Honestly Settle Its Past Crimes
body: Recently Japanese Prime Minister Abe appearing on TV chat spouted piffle that "Japan has a willingness to bear the expenses for the denuclearization of Korea". The pressing task facing Japan is to make unconditional and full apology and reparation for the past crimes committed against the Korean people. But Japan refuses to admit any of numerous crimes and has no idea of reparation. If the Japanese politicians have an iota of reason, they should come to their senses and do what they are obliged to do, though belatedly. It is the unavoidable historical responsibility and duty of Japan and the solemn requirements of the times to make an honest apology and reparation for the past crimes. The Japanese politicians are advised again to stop playing a trick to meddle in the issue of the Korean peninsula, showing off a purse. If they are interested in peace of the Korean peninsula and the region, they should honestly settle the past, to begin with. If Japan keeps on evading the settlement of the past as before, it will entail adverse consequences. Ri Hak Nam

title: Solidarity with Korean People's Struggle Expressed in Russia
body: The Buryatia's Republic Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation released a statement titled "On Solidarity with the Workers' Party of Korea and the Korean People" on June 10. Expressing solidarity with the Korean people in the struggle to build a powerful, independent and prosperous country under the guidance of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, the statement said: We praise the feats performed by Comrade Kim Jong Un for peace of the Korean Peninsula and the cause of Korea's reunification. They were evidently proven by the inter-Korean summit on April 27. The great Comrade Kim Jong Il's start of work at the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea is of important significance in strengthening the Party. The whole world knows about the feats Comrade Kim Jong Il performed for the development of the country. Sending our greetings to the Korean people, we heartily wish them successes in achieving peace on the Korean Peninsula and building socialism. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK-U.S. Summit Hailed in Bangladesh
body: Political parties and organizations of Bangladesh made public a joint statement on June 21 to hail the first successful DPRK-U.S. summit. They were the Workers' Party, National Socialist Party, Jatiya Party, Communist Party, Communist Party (Marxist-Leninist), People's League, Socialist Party, Bangladesh-Korea Friendship and Solidarity Committee, Institute of the Juche Idea, Group for the Study of the Songun Policy and the Media Persons' Group for the Study of the Juche Idea. The joint statement said: The recent summit meeting and talks are a historic event of weighty significance in bringing about a radical turn in the DPRK-U.S. ties as required by the developing era. We pay high tribute to HE Kim Jong Un, Supreme Leader of the Korean people, who made a great and courageous decision for peace and security of the Korean Peninsula and the world. We also extend invariable support and solidarity to the Workers' Party of Korea and the DPRK government striving for peace and security of the peninsula. Rodong News Team

title: Symposium Marks Founding Anniversary of Koryo
body: There took place a social science symposium at Koryo Songgyungwan University on Wednesday to mark the 1100th founding anniversary of Koryo. It was attended by Ri Hye Jong, president of the Academy of Social Sciences, and teachers, researchers, lecturers, writers, journalists, editors, university students and officials in the fields of science, education, media and national heritage conservation. Speakers there explained and proved the history and culture of Koryo, the first unified state of Korea, detailed by them during the course of scientific research on the national cultural heritages. They stressed that Koryo, the first unified state of Korea, which was founded in 918 and existed until 1392, had developed economy and culture and firmly defended the sovereignty of the country and the nation and thus fully demonstrated its dignity and mettle as a unified state. The historical significance of its foundation is that it carried forward the historical traditions of the Korean nation by inheriting Koguryo, a powerful state that had existed for a thousand years in the East, and that it provided an important occasion for the unified development of the Korean nation by accomplishing the historical cause of territorial unification, they noted. Koryo not only unified the territory as desired by Koguryo but also carried forward the customs of Koguryo and clearly showed that it was the state which inherited Koguryo, they added. Rodong News Team

title: National Children's Paduk Contest and National Amateur Paduk Contest Held
body: A national children's paduk contest and a national amateur paduk contest were held at the Taekwon-Do Hall in Pyongyang from June 20 to 27. Taking part in the contests were more than 250 children and more than 100 amateurs selected from across the country. Those contests were divided into Groups A, B and C. Their participants competed in men's and women's individual and team events and mixed doubles. Pyongyang City came first at both contests in total standings. Rodong News Team

title: Anniversary of Kim Jong Il's Start of Work at C.C., WPK Observed
body: Events took place in various countries to mark the 54th anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il's start of work at the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. They included seminar, Kimjongilia exhibition, book and photo exhibition, lecture and film shows in Mongolia, Nepal, Hungary and South Africa from June 16 to 21. The participants in the film shows watched Korean films such as "Kimjongilia". The chairman of the Kimjongilia Association of Mongolia said that he was pleased to hold the Kimjongilia exhibition on the occasion of the 54th anniversary of Kim Jong Il's start of work at the Party Central Committee. He went on: HE Kim Jong Un is developing the WPK into the party of Comrades Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il. The Korean people, single-mindedly united around him, are registering big successes in socialist construction. The director of the International Department of the Nepal Worker-Peasant Party noted that Kim Jong Il regarded it as the primary task of the party work to develop the WPK into the party of the leader. He said that Kim Jong Il also built up the Korean People's Army into the army of the leader and party and bolstered up the military muscle of the country with his energetic Songun revolutionary leadership and thus creditably defended Korean socialism. The chairman of the Hungarian Workers' Party praised Kim Jong Il as the peerlessly elder statesman and eternal head of the WPK. His work "Socialism Is a Science" is an immortal book that proved the scientific accuracy and truth of socialism and inevitability of its victory, and it clearly shows the correct road for socialist construction, the chairman said. Rodong News Team

title: Japan Must Be Honest
body: Prime Minister of Japan Abe recently said that the next is his turn and he would sit face-to-face with north Korea to resolve major pending issues and he expects a big decision by north Korea over the issue of abduction. Until quite recently, Abe talked rubbish that "dialogue for dialogue is meaningless and dialogue with north Korea is abnormal itself". But he suddenly made a U-turn and is talking about DPRK-Japan summit to the public surprise. As for the "issue of abductees", it had already been settled completely in 2002 on the occasion of the then prime minister's visit to Pyongyang and the publication of the historic DPRK-Japan Pyongyang Declaration. The "issue of abductees" much touted by the Japanese authorities is just the issue for which the DPRK has to reprimand Japan. It is because the Korean nation is the biggest victim of the state-sponsored abduction and terrorism by Japan. Japan's ulterior motive is to paint itself as a "victim" to cover up its true colors as an assailant who committed hideous crimes in the past, impair the high international prestige of the DPRK and gloss over the atonement for the crimes committed against the Korean nation and thus avoid the settlement of Japan's past. However, Japan should clearly know that there will never be the repair of relations between the DPRK and Japan without the solution of the fundamental issue. If the authorities of Japan, an island country, really want to visit Pyongyang, they have to be honest and responsible in the light of history and boldly drop their anachronistic hostile policy toward the DPRK. Kim Yon I

title: Steadfast Is Korean People's Will to Build Powerful Socialist State
body: The seven decades-long history of the DPRK is a proud one in which the Workers' Party of Korea and the Korean people have hewed out the way of prosperity by their own efforts and rushed ahead, racing against time. The Korean people could build an invincible socialist state with tremendous political and military strength and economic potential recognized by the world on this land where centuries-old backwardness and poverty had prevailed as they strived hard in reliance on their own strength. The history and reality teach the truth that dependence on foreign forces results in subordination and national ruin and only self-reliance and self-development is the way out for eternal prosperity. The world witnesses steady changes and development. No matter how much water has flowed under the bridge, the philosophical principle that prosperity depends on the spirit of self-reliance and self-development can never change. Steadfast are the resolve and will of the Korean people to build a dignified and powerful socialist state on this land revered by the world as early as possible by hastening the grand march for economic construction under the banner of self-development-first principle, irrespective of any change in the situation of the Korean peninsula and the international climate. Nobody can block our grand march for building a powerful state as there are the wise guidance of the great Party and the army and people fully armed with the spirit of self-reliance. So Song Bom

title: 24th Congress of Korean Youth League in Japan Held
body: The 24th Congress of the Korean Youth League in Japan (Jochong) was held at Korean University under Chongryon (General Association of Korean Residents in Japan) in Tokyo on June 24. Attending it were Jo Il Yon, vice-chairman and director of the Organizational Department of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, Kim Yong Ju, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of Jochong, and other deputies. Read out at the congress was a congratulatory message from the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un to the 24th Congress of Chongryon. And introduced were congratulatory messages from the Central Committee of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League, the Youth and Students Headquarters of the South Side Committee for Implementing June 15 Joint Declaration and the Children's Union of Wakayama Korean Elementary and Secondary School under Chongryon. Chairman Kim Yong Ju in his report recalled that the Korean Youth League in Japan pushed forward the patriotic movement during its work of 23rd-term in hearty response to the letter sent by Kim Jong Un on May 25, 2015. He referred to the tasks to be carried out by Jochong in the efforts to implement the decision of the 24th Congress of Chongryon. Solidarity addresses were delivered by the chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Korean Students in Japan, the chairman of the south Korean Youth League in Japan, the president of the Council of Young Men's Associations of Japan and the chairman of the League of Socialist Youth of Japan. Then speeches were made by officials of Jochong organizations at all levels. Deputy Jo Myong Jin was elected chairman of the Central Standing Committee of Jochong. Jo Il Yon made a speech. He stressed the need for Jochong to fully discharge its mission and role in the patriotic movement for implementing the decision of the 24th Congress of Chongryon. A letter to Kim Jong Un was read out at the congress. Rodong News Team

title: Talks of Inter-Korean Panel for Cooperation in Roads Held
body: The talks of inter-Korean panel for cooperation in roads were held at the Thongil House in the north side's portion of Panmunjom on Thursday under the agreement reached at north-south high-level talks for implementing the historic Panmunjom Declaration. Present there were the north side's delegation led by Vice-Minister of Land and Environmental Protection Pak Ho Yong and the south side's delegation with Vice-Minister of Land and Transportation Kim Jong Ryol as chief delegate. At the talks the north and the south agreed to simultaneously push forward the modernization of roads on the eastern and western coasts, discussed the ways for carrying it out and adopted and published a joint press release. Rodong News Team

title: Japanese Delegation Here
body: A delegation of the Japan Nagano Prefectural People's Council for Supporting the Independent and Peaceful Reunification of Korea led by Chairman Tomohiko Murayama arrived here on Thursday. Rodong News Team

title: Special Envoy of Swedish Government Leaves
body: Kent Rolf Magnus Harstedt, a special envoy of the Swedish government, and his party left here for home on Thursday. During the visit, the special envoy and his party paid courtesy calls on Chairman of the Foreign Affairs Committee of the DPRK Supreme People's Assembly Ri Su Yong, who is vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and Foreign Minister Ri Yong Ho. Discussed at their talks was the issue of further developing the relations between the two countries in different fields. And exchanged were opinions on the recent situation of the Korean Peninsula. Rodong News Team

title: Film Show Marks Anniversary of Kim Il Sung's Visit to Mongolia
body: There was a film show at the Taedonggang Diplomatic Club on Thursday to mark the 30th anniversary of President Kim Il Sung's second visit to Mongolia. Present there were Kang Mun Ryol, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries, officials concerned, Pyongyangites and Sukhbat Sodnomtsog, Mongolian charge d'affaires ad interim, and a staff member of his embassy here. Speeches were made there. The participants watched the Korean documentary film "The Great Leader Comrade Kim Il Sung Pays an Official Goodwill Visit to the People's Republic of Mongolia" (June 28-July 1, 1988). Rodong News Team

title: Congratulatory Letter to Kim Jong Un from Koreans in China
body: The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a congratulatory letter from the General Association of Koreans in China on Wednesday on the occasion of the second anniversary of his election as chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. The letter said that his election was a manifestation of the unanimous will and desire of all servicepersons and civilians in the homeland and other fellow countrymen and an auspicious great event in the nation's history as it made it possible to glorify the socialist homeland as everlasting Kim Il Sung's and Kim Jong Il's Korea all over the world. It noted that Kim Jong Un opened a new chapter in accomplishing the cause of immortalizing the great leaders to add luster to their undying revolutionary careers and priceless feats for all ages and that he made the army and people give full play to their mental strength under the banner of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism and thus opened up a new history of victory of Juche Korea. The letter also said that he indicated a bright path of the north-south relations and independent reunification and took positive and pro-active measures one after another so as to create the atmosphere of reconciliation and unity on the Korean peninsula plagued with the climate of confrontation and hostility and that he provided the historic north-south summits and the April 27 Panmunjom Declaration with his firm will for reunification and patriotic and courageous decision to open a broad avenue to peace and prosperity of the nation and independent reunification. The whole earth is overflowing with mankind's respect and reverence for and admiration at Kim Jong Un as he brought about a great event of weighty significance in making a radical turn in the DPRK-U.S. ties as required by the developing era, the letter pointed out. The officials of the General Association and all Koreans in China, who renewed the great pride and honor of being members of the Korean nation through Kim Jong Un's three visits to China, will value and add luster to the DPRK-China friendship which he is developing on a new high stage, the letter stressed. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Inspects KPA Unit 1524
body: The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un inspected Unit 1524 of the Korean People's Army (KPA). After receiving a salute, he went round the education room, barracks, wash-cum-bath room, bean warehouse, greenhouse and other parts of the unit, guided by its commanding officers, to take warm care of the living of soldiers as their own parents would do. At the education room, he acquainted himself in detail with the education of soldiers of the unit and stressed the need to intensify the political and ideological education and the education of faith in conformity with the specific character of the duty of the unit defending the outpost line of the socialist country and thus reliably defend the post and carry on service with the steadfast class stand. He learned about the soybean farming by the unit at the bean warehouse and told officers to increase the per-hectare soybean yield by positively introducing successes and experience of advanced units. He also said it is necessary to pay deep attention to providing good bean processing equipment for the combat units in remote areas like the unit so that the servicepersons can eat various bean dishes. Going round the greenhouse, he stressed the need for the unit to plant and introduce around the barracks the high yielding crops and vegetables of good species cultivated by Farm 1116 of KPA Unit 810 so that it may benefit from them. Being satisfied with the fact that the unit settled the cooking fuel issue with methane gas and has improved the servicepersons' diet with a good supply foundation, he repeatedly underscored the need to push forward with the work for laying living foundations so that the soldiers can devote themselves to the military service without any inconvenience. Expressing the expectation and belief that the servicepersons of the unit would creditably discharge their mission and role as frontline soldiers defending the gate to the socialist country with red arms of revolution in their hands, he had a photo session with them. Accompanying him were Hwang Pyong So, Han Kwang Sang and Jo Yong Won, senior officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and Kim Chang Son, department director of the State Affairs Commission. Political News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Inspects Sinuiju Chemical Fibre Mill
body: The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un gave field guidance to the Sinuiju Chemical Fibre Mill. He went round the room dedicated to education in the revolutionary history and learned about the production at the paper manufacturing workshop. Noting that one of those entangled in the education of the rising generation, a top-priority work for the Party, is the fact that the demand for paper has not been fully met, he stressed the need to upgrade the paper industry in reliance on the domestic resources and raw materials at any cost and thus sufficiently supply the paper necessary for the production of textbooks, reference books and notebooks for schoolers. Examining the paper produced on a trial basis with reed as raw material, he said that will serve the purpose, and stressing the need to further deepen the research for improving the quality and productivity of paper. He expressed satisfaction over the fact that the possibility of sufficient supply of raw materials was created with the increase of reed production on Pidan Island and the mill's project for expanding the capacity of reed-based paper production is going at the last stage to open the prospect for settling the paper problem. While acquainting himself with the upgrade of the factory, he pointed out deviations and gave instructions for developing the mill. He seriously reproved officials for failing to take pains to finish as early as possible the upgrading of the paper manufacturing process prioritized and looked for by the Party and to fulfill their responsibility and role. He instructed the officials to urgently finish the paper production process upgrading, concentrate efforts on sprucing up the production buildings and accelerate the dredging project of wharf for reed discharge. He set forth the tasks and ways for successfully upgrading the mill as befitting a unit associated with the leadership exploits of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il and massively producing paper with reed as basic raw material. Accompanying him were An Jong Su, Hwang Pyong So, Han Kwang Sang, Kim Song Nam, Jo Yong Won, O Il Jong and Hwang Yong Chol, senior officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Political News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Inspects Sinuiju Textile Mill
body: The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un gave field guidance to the Sinuiju Textile Mill. He went round the room dedicated to education in the revolutionary history and the room dedicated to the history of the mill. Noting that the Sinuiju Textile Mill, which went into operation in September 1959 thanks to the benevolent step taken by President Kim Il Sung, has a long history and tradition in producing cloth necessary for the people's living, Kim Jong Un said that all the spindles and looms of the mill are associated with efforts of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il who devoted themselves to solving the people's clothing problem. Going round various places of the mill, he learned in detail about its production and management. He was briefed on the reality of the mill failing to fulfill its national economic plan every year and felt heartbroken to see the experienced mill, which is much associated with the leadership exploits of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il and had made positive contribution to the development of the light industry of the country in the past period, not retaining its proud tradition. Learning about the supply service of the mill and the living conditions of its employees, he pointed out that its party committee had not paid attention to the work for improving the employees' working and living conditions. He set forth the detailed tasks and ways for rebuilding the mill on a modern basis as required by the present era, saying that to radically develop the textile industry is very important in making a breakthrough for the improvement of the people's standard of living. He said that the officials and workers of the mill should remodel the production buildings and the inside and outside of the mill while putting its production processes on a scientific and modern basis till the next year marking the 60th founding anniversary and thus proudly review the fact that the mill has grown to be a leading textile mill greatly conducive to the people's standard of living under the guidance of the great Party. He designated the site for building hostel and took a step for mobilizing the powerful building force, saying that he was told that the hostellers of the mill envied hostels of the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill and the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Silk Mill provided by the Party and that he would provide a hostel as wonderful as them. Accompanying him were An Jong Su, Hwang Pyong So, Han Kwang Sang, Kim Song Nam, Jo Yong Won, O Il Jong and Hwang Yong Chol, senior officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Political News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Inspects Sinuiju Cosmetics Factory
body: The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un together with his wife Ri Sol Ju gave field guidance to the Sinuiju Cosmetics Factory. He went round a room dedicated to education in the revolutionary history and a room dedicated to the history of the factory. Seeing with deep emotion the significant photos of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il on show at the room dedicated to the revolutionary history, he said that the factory traveled the path of its praiseworthy development under the wise leadership and particular care of Kim Il Sung who brought about the beginning of the cosmetics industry of the country and of Kim Jong Il who chose the site of the factory at the foot of a cozy mountain in the picturesque southern Sinuiju area with clean water and laid a firm foundation for the future development. Going round the soap, basic cosmetics and cosmetics workshops, the sample room, Pomhyanggi-trademarked cosmetics exhibition and other places of the factory for a long time, he learned in detail about the cosmetics production and the modernization of the factory. He praised the factory for updating the production processes of cosmetics for washing and hair and other various cosmetics which have been put on an automated, germ-free and dust-free basis in a short span of time. He said it is amazing that the factory has created the capacity of the development and mass-production of scores of kinds of new goods including good quality cosmeticsfor hair and remedy. He said with great satisfaction that it has really done a lot of work without being known to others during the period, extraordinary is the long-standing unit associated with the leadership exploits as he has heard and he admires at the assiduous spirit and diligent working manner of the officials and workers of the factory. He noted that the factory should not rest content with what it has already achieved but continue to make a leap forward to attain a higher goal and that it should never praise itself as Pomhyanggi-trademarked cosmetics are very popular among the people and in great demand. He underlined the need for the factory to push forward with the research for improving the quality of the products and increasing varieties in conformity with the characteristics of the liking, age and constitution of the users while analyzing Unhasu-trademarked cosmetics and other cosmetics of the country in contradistinction to world-famous cosmetics. Noting that the cosmetics container also plays an important role in enhancing the value of cosmetics, he gave instructions to produce containers of various shapes, sizes and colors so that their specific characters are seen well and they are suited to conveniences of the users, and to pack them in diversified forms so as to present cosmetics as gifts or souvenirs. He set forth detailed tasks and ways for producing cosmetics including the issue of developing and producing lots of cosmetics of various kinds. Looking round the sample room and the Pomhyanggi-trademarked cosmetics exhibition, he said with pleasure that they have been arranged in a peculiar way. He instructed officials to build a fashionable shop for Pomhyanggi-trademarked cosmetics produced by the factory in Pyongyang City. He expressed the expectation and belief that the officials and employees of the factory would take the lead in developing the cosmetics industry and make a true contribution to improving the people's standard of living, bearing in mind the high consciousness that they serve the people, and had a photo session with them. Accompanying him were An Jong Su, Hwang Pyong So, Han Kwang Sang, Kim Song Nam, Jo Yong Won, O Il Jong and Hwang Yong Chol, senior officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Political News Team

title: Greetings to Heads of State and Government of AU
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK on Saturday sent a message of greeting to the 31st assembly of heads of state and government of the African Union to be held in Mauritania. The message said that the initiative and efforts of the AU to achieve changes in Africa against corruption and irregularities and realize the peace, stability and political and economic integrity of the continent by its own efforts command full sympathy of the Korean people and the world progressive people. Expressing belief that the joint stand and struggle of the African countries to fully exercise their sovereignty and influence on the international arena would bring about good successes, the message extended firm support and solidarity to it. Reaffirming the invariable will of the DPRK to more vigorously boost the historic relations of friendship and cooperation with the AU and its member states in all fields, the message wished that the assembly would become a significant occasion in bringing about a decisive turn in achieving continental changes and prosperity. Rodong News Team
