title: Korean Federation of Workers in Commerce in Japan Meets
body: The 33rd regular general meeting of the Korean Federation of Workers in Commerce in Japan took place in Tokyo on June 23. Attending it were Nam Sung U, vice-chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), Ri Song Chol, director of the Economic Department of Chongryon, and officials of the federation and other deputies. The meeting reviewed the federation's work of last two years and discussed and decided on the orientation of its work and main tasks to be carried out for the coming two years for the implementation of the decision of the 24th Chongryon Congress in hearty response to the tasks advanced in the congratulatory message of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. The congratulatory message sent by him to the 24th Chongryon Congress was read out at the meeting. Pak Chung U, chairman of the federation, delivered an opening address and then Ri Jong Man, managing director of its Standing Council, made a report. The reporter said that the last two years were a historic period during which the DPRK rose to the position of a strategic state recognized by the world and days during which the federation braved the unprecedented ordeals together with Chongryon. He stressed the importance to develop the federation into a powerful body that takes deep roots among Korean workers in commerce by decisively enhancing its capability of assistance to compatriot businessmen and intensifying information work in the future, too, and thus building up the federation into a powerful one deeply rooted among the workers in commerce and paying greater efforts to national education. Introduced at the meeting was a congratulatory message from the DPRK Ministry of External Economic Relations. There was an awarding ceremony for the participants in the prize-winning movement of the federation. Deputy Pak Chung U was reelected chairman of the federation and Deputy O Min Hak elected managing director of its Standing Council. Nam Sung U made a speech. He called for achieving the comprehensive redevelopment of the movement of Koreans in Japan in a fresh way for the happiness of compatriots and the future of the rising generation. Rodong News Team

The venues of the exhibitions were visited by personages of various circles and masses in relevant countries. The curator of the DPRK Cultural and Information Center in Vratsa City said: The Korean people have made miraculous progress in socialist construction under the wise guidance of the great leaders. In recent years, in particular, the DPRK has registered big successes in bolstering up its military muscle and pushing ahead with the economic construction and improving the people's standard of living. I am convinced that the exhibition will help the Bulgarian people know better about the Korean people's struggle for the country's prosperity and make a positive contribution to the mutual understanding between the two peoples and development of their friendly relations. title: Settling Disputes Is Key to Ensuring Global Peace
body: Still continuous are disputes among countries, political forces and tribal and religious sects in different parts of the world. To put an end to the disputes is an important matter in ensuring peace and security. Disputes threatening world peace and security occur as the imperialists and some other forces still seek domination and hegemony. To be loose in vigilance over the cunning moves of the imperialists leads to serious consequences. For conflict-torn countries to achieve peace as early as possible is important to find out agreed points to meet mutual interests through dialogue. If one side imposes its requirements upon the other side for the egoistic purpose, it is impossible to find out a key to the solutions forever. One should not inveigle outside forces into the settlement of disputes. The parties concerned should be responsible for the disputes and settle them through negotiations on the principle of unity free from outsiders' interference. Every country should refrain from supporting or opposing one side in disputes of other countries. One-sided support will result in further aggravating disputes and confrontation. All the countries should positively help the parties concerned peacefully settle disputes in mutual interests out of fair stand. It is harmful to accept the prescription of the imperialists in settling disputes. Their prescription is aimed to paint themselves as "peace champion" and fish in troubled waters. Ri Hak Nam

title: Preventing Flood Damage Is Weighty Work
body: Today the Workers' Party of Korea calls on the entire party, the whole country and all the people for turning out in the efforts for preventing damage in the rainy season. To thoroughly prevent damage in the rainy season is a sacred patriotic work for protecting state and social property and people's lives and properties and a serious political struggle for defending and glorifying the absolute prestige of the Party and the image of socialism. It is also a worthwhile struggle for successfully hitting the goals of the five-year strategy for national economic development and bringing earlier the final victory. Of course, not a few manpower, materials and money are needed to prevent natural calamities including flood. The attitude and stand towards the work for thoroughly preventing flood damage are a touchstone of discerning the party's sense of responsibility and patriotism. All the people should fully demonstrate the might of the single-minded unity of Juche Korea and the spirit of carrying through the party policies in the efforts to prevent damage in the rainy season this year and thus make positive contributions to significantly celebrating the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK and further accelerating the advance of the Korean revolution. title: Japan Should Properly Redeem Pending Past
body: Speaking before the independent Dietmen's group some days ago, Abe said that Japan would "keep current sanctions until the DPRK takes specific steps toward denuclearization". In another development Japanese Foreign Minister Kono flew to Indonesia to ask for "cooperation in the efforts for the DPRK's complete denuclearization". At a Geneva disarmament conference, the Japanese delegate "urged the DPRK to make more efforts for denuclearization". They are impudent demeanor of those seized by the hostile policy towards the DPRK. It is quite natural that if the Japanese politicians have an iota of political sense, they have to think twice, seeing how the strategic structure in Northeast Asia and the rest of the world changes and how the wind blows. However, the Abe group is talking about the outdated sanctions only to show its pitiful plight. Japan should stop poking its nose into the issue of the Korean Peninsula and do what it is obliged. It is a criminal state which inflicted untold misfortune and sufferings upon the Korean people during the military occupation of Korea and colonial rule over it in the first half of the last century. It should properly redeem the pending past rather than trying to interfere in the issue of ensuring peace in the Korean Peninsula and the region. As long as Japan refuses to redeem the past, its top task, it will be left alone in the region. Ri Hyon Do

title: Immortal Programme for Independent Reunification
body: July 4 marks the 46th anniversary of the publication of the historic July 4 Joint Statement. President Kim Il Sung put his heart and soul into the work to reunify the country, regarding it as his lifelong mission. In impressive July Juche 61 (1972), the July 4 Joint Statement, whose keynote is the three principles of independence, peaceful reunification and great national unity, was made public under the energetic leadership of President Kim Il Sung. It was a great national historic event that dispelled the dark clouds of division and confrontation and gave all the fellow countrymen optimism and hope for national reunification. Thanks to the rare wisdom and indefatigable efforts of the President, the three principles of national reunification were advanced. They were a treasured sword helping the Korean nation settle the issue of national reunification by itself in conformity with its demand and basic interests and a sure guarantee for pressing ahead with the national reunification movement along the orbit of independence in any storms and stress. The President made sure that the three principles were abided by thoroughly despite the manifold hardships in the struggle for national reunification. And he set forth realistic reunification policies based on the principles and united all the fellow countrymen firmly under the banner of independent reunification and great national unity. It is the greatest feats for the country and nation that he put forward a proposal for founding the Democratic Federal Republic of Koryo and the 10-Point Programme of the Great Unity of the Whole Nation for the Reunification of the Country, thus laying a firm foundation for the accomplishment of the cause of national reunification. Pak Chol Jun

title: Chinese Delegation Leaves
body: The delegation of the China Dongfangyi Tuozhan Association led by Chairman Guo Yi left for home on Thursday. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Venezuelan President
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a message of greeting to Nicolas Maduro Moros, president of the Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela, on July 5 on the occasion of its independence day. The message expressed the belief that the friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries would develop on good terms in the future, too. It wished the president greater success in his responsible work for ending all sorts of interference in the internal affairs by foreign forces, defending the national independence and sovereignty and achieving the country's political stability. Rodong News Team

title: Unethical Violence Will Never Be Pardoned
body: On June 28, the Japanese customs authorities ransacked the belongings of the students of Kobe Korean High School under the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) who returned after visiting the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, their homeland, and seized the souvenirs from their families and relatives in the homeland and sportswear emblazoned with letter "Korea" and the national flag of the DPRK and necessities. The reckless act is a revelation of hysteric fit of those displeased with having found themselves isolated, marginalized by the powerful trend of peace in the Korean peninsula and the world and an unpardonable violation of Japan-resident Koreans' rights as well as humanitarianism and international law. The Japanese reactionaries' vicious political persecution, discrimination and suppression against Koreans in Japan and their children for the mere reason that they are Koreans can never flee from the curse and denunciation by the entire Korean nation and international community. Those who incite hostility against Chongryon for a sinister purpose and commit politically-motivated state-sponsored terrorism will face a merciless punishment. The Japanese reactionaries' mean political terrorism and persistent persecution against Chongryon and Koreans in Japan, which are going from bad to worse with each passing day, are touching off the Korean people's bitterer hatred for Japan, the sworn enemy, while hardening their will for merciless retaliation. The DPRK will never pardon the recent thrice-cursed fascist unethical violence against the children of Koreans in Japan. Ho Yong Min

title: Talks of Inter-Korean Panel for Cooperation in Forestry
body: Talks of inter-Korean panel for cooperation in forestry took place at the "House of Peace" in the south side portion of Panmunjom on Wednesday, under the agreement of the north-south high-level talks for the implementation of the historic Panmunjom Declaration. Present there were the north side's delegation led by Kim Song Jun, vice director-general of the General Bureau of Forest under the Ministry of Land and Environment Protection, and the south side's delegation with Ryu Kwang Su, vice-director of the Forestry Administration, as chief delegate. At the talks both sides discussed the practical issues arising in north-south cooperation in forestry and adopted a joint press release. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung to Be Remembered in Guinea
body: A Guinean committee for remembering President Kim Il Sung was formed in Conakry on June 30. Riyad Chaloub, chairman of the Guinean National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, was elected chairman of the remembrance committee. The committee decided to hold political and cultural events including a lecture and a reading session on the occasion of the 24th anniversary of demise of Kim Il Sung. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung to Be Remembered Worldwide
body: An international committee for remembering President Kim Il Sung was formed on July 3. Mikhail Panchenko, general secretary of the International Alliance of Societies for the Study of the Juche Idea and Songun Policy in East European and Central Asian Regions, was elected as chairman of the committee. The committee decided to give wide publicity to the revolutionary career and exploits of the President and hold political and cultural events on the occasion of the 24th anniversary of his demise. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung to Be Remembered in Venezuela
body: A Venezuelan committee for remembering President Kim Il Sung was formed on July 2. Felix Jesus Velasquez Castillo, general coordinator of the Federal Political Secretariat of the United Left Party of Venezuela and chairman of the Venezuelan Solidarity Committee for Korea's Peace and Reunification, and Omar Lopez, chairman of the Venezuelan National Society for the Study of the Juche Idea, were elected co-chairmen of the remembrance committee. The committee decided to organize political and cultural events praising the revolutionary career and exploits of Kim Il Sung who made a distinguished contribution to the accomplishment of the cause of human independence on the occasion of July 8, the 24th anniversary of his demise. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung to Be Remembered in France
body: A committee for remembering President Kim Il Sung was formed in France on June 29. Benoit Quennedey, president of the France-Korea Friendship Association, was elected chairman of the committee. The committee decided to hold political and cultural events praising Kim Il Sung's revolutionary career and exploits on the occasion of the 24th anniversary of his demise. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung to Be Remembered in Angola
body: An Angolan committee for remembering President Kim Il Sung was formed on June 29. Lawmaker Amalia Alexandr, international secretary of the Women's Organization of the Popular Liberation Movement of Angola, was elected chairperson of the committee. The committee decided to widely introduce exploits Kim Il Sung performed for the Korean revolution and global independence and his noble traits and organize political and cultural events. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung to Be Remembered in Russia
body: A committee for remembering President Kim Il Sung was formed by the Lenin Young Communist League of the Russian Federation on June 30. V. P. Isakov, first secretary of the Central Committee of the league, was elected as chairman of the remembrance committee. The committee decided to organize political and cultural events praising Kim Il Sung's revolutionary career and exploits. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korean Organizations Denounce Japanese Authorities
body: for Their Human Rights Abuses The South Side Committee for Implementing the June 15 Joint Declaration and 223 other civic and social organizations in south Korea held a press conference before the Japanese embassy in Seoul on July 3 to condemn the Japanese authorities for committing human rights abuses against Korean students in Japan, according to the south Koran online newspaper Tongil News. The speakers charged that the Japanese customs authorities seized all the belongings such as the souvenirs of the students of Kobe Korean High School when they arrived in Japan on June 28 after visiting the north. A press release issued there said that with nothing can they justify the discrimination against the Korean students in Japan. Rodong News Team

title: Inter-Korean Friendship Basketball Games Held
body: Inter-Korean basketball games for reunification took place at the Ryugyong Jong Ju Yong Indoor Stadium on Thursday. The stadium was crowded with Pyongyang citizens, sportspersons and overseas compatriots who came to see the games. The men and women teams from the north and the south held friendship games, being divided into the Red Team and the Blue Team. The players displayed high technique and noble virtue in the matches through good combination of assault and defense under team tactics. The Blue Team won in the women's match and the Red Team in the men's match. After watching the games, Choe Hwi, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the National Sports Guidance Committee, Jon Kwang Ho, vice-premier of the Cabinet, Ri Son Gwon, chairman of the Committee for the Peaceful Reunification of the Country, Kim Il Guk, minister of Physical Culture and Sports, and leading members of the south side's delegation and the players' group led by Minister of Unification Jo Myong Gyun congratulated the players upon their successful matches. Rodong News Team

title: Korean Book, Photo and Fine Art Exhibition Opens in Romania
body: A Korean book, photo and fine art exhibition opened in Bucharest on June 27 to mark the 70th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic ties between the DPRK and Romania. Displayed at the venue were photos showing the revolutionary activities of President Kim Il Sung, leader Kim Jong Il and the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Also displayed were their works, and books, photos and art pieces introducing the DPRK. Personages of Romanian government, political parties and organizations and masses were present at the opening ceremony. The chairman of the Supreme Council of the National Socialist Party of Romania and other speakers said that they were glad to see the exhibition open on the 70th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic ties between the two countries. They noted that the exhibits represent the true picture of socialist Korea where the popular masses are masters, and Korea today making leaps would be unthinkable without the outstanding leadership of HE Kim Jong Un. They added the exhibition would help people know better about the DPRK, hoping that the relations between the two countries would grow stronger in all fields with the exhibition as an occasion. Rodong News Team

title: South Side's Delegation, Players' Group Leave
body: The south side's delegation and players' group led by Minister of Unification Jo Myong Gyun left here on Friday after taking part in the inter-Korean basketball games for reunification. In the morning they visited the Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace. Meanwhile, the National Sports Guidance Committee hosted a farewell reception in honor of the south side's delegation and players' group at the People's Palace of Culture on Thursday evening. Rodong News Team

title: U.S. Delegation for DPRK-U.S. High-level Talks Here
body: A delegation of the United States of America led by State Secretary Mike Pompeo arrived in Pyongyang Friday. The delegation is to take part in the first DPRK-U.S. high-level talks for implementing the joint statement adopted and made public at the DPRK-U.S. summit meeting and talks. Rodong News Team

title: Memorandum on Peerlessly Great Leaders' Exploits for National Reunification
body: The Committee for the Peaceful Reunification of the Country of the DPRK on July 6 released a memorandum detailing the exploits the peerlessly great men performed for national reunification on the occasion of the 24th anniversary of the last autograph left by President Kim Il Sung on the document related to national reunification. President Kim Il Sung is the eternal sun of the nation and lodestar of reunification who set it as the top priority task of the nation to achieve the national reunification from the very day of the territorial and national division forced by the outsiders, consistently held fast to the line of one Korea and reunification and led the struggle for carrying it out, the memorandum said, and went on: After Korea's liberation the President convened the Joint Conference of Representatives of Political Parties and Social Organizations in North and South Korea and led the nation-wide struggle for frustrating the moves of the sycophants and traitors to divide the Korean nation. He proposed to enforce the federal formula of the north and the south in the 1950s and 1960s when the situation was extremely tense due to the confrontation and war racket by the separatists within and without. He saw to it that the July 4 joint statement was adopted, the keynote of which is the three principles of national reunification, in the early 1970s. In the 1980s and 1990s he newly advanced the proposal for founding the Democratic Federal Republic of Koryo (DFRK) which comprehensively embodies the three principles of national reunification and the 10-Point Programme of the Great Unity of the Whole Nation for the Reunification of the Country. They are the most realistic and square guidelines for achieving the national reunification as early as possible. He personally proposed the north-south summit and worked heart and soul for it, thinking of the great cause of the nation before anything else during the last moments of his life. The cause of national reunification pioneered and guided by the President had been victoriously advanced by leader Kim Jong Il. The memorandum said that Kim Jong Il formulated the three principles of national reunification, the DFRK founding proposal, the 10-Point Programme of the Great Unity of the Whole Nation for the Reunification of the Country as the three charters for national reunification to be held by the entire Korean nation, and inspiringly aroused all the fellow countrymen to the struggle for implementing them. It noted that in June 2000 he provided the north-south summit meeting for the first time in the history of national division and provided the Korean nation with the June 15 joint declaration. It pointed out that he arranged another north-south summit meeting in Pyongyang in October 2007 and provided the Korean nation with the "Declaration for Development of North-South Relations and Peace and Prosperity", a programme for implementing the June 15 joint declaration. The Korean people's movement for national reunification is now greeting a fresh heyday thanks to the guidance of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, it said. It noted that Kim Jong Un solemnly clarified his firm determination and will to accomplish the cause of national reunification without fail, true to the behests of the great leaders, through his on-site inspection of Panmunjom in March 2012 and his speech made at the military parade for celebrating the centenary of birth of Kim Il Sung. He provided the north-south summit meeting and talks in Panmunjom on April 27, 2018 and adopted the Panmunjom declaration, sparking emotion and cheers of the whole nation and the world, it stated. It said that he held the 4th north-south summit meeting and talks on May 26 in a blitz way and made important agreements for settling the matters arising in rapidly implementing the Panmunjom Declaration and thus propelled the development of the inter-Korean relations at a higher level. It stressed that the rosy future of the Korean nation and the decisive guarantee for national reunification lie in upholding and following Kim Jong Un, identical to the great leaders in idea, guidance and traits, as the sun of the nation and lodestar of national reunification. Rodong News Team

title: AINDF Pyongyang Mission Chief Interviewed
body: Pak Su Chol, chief of the Pyongyang mission of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front (AINDF), had an interview with KCNA on Friday with the approach of the 24th anniversary of the last autograph left by President Kim Il Sung on the document related to national reunification. President Kim Il Sung's whole life was a sacred life in which he laid a firm foundation for national reunification, the chief said, adding: The President made a historic signature on the document related to national reunification, staying up the whole night at the last moment of his life as he regarded the country's reunification as his noble mission and the biggest gift for the nation. His historic autograph "Kim Il Sung July 7, 1994" clearly reflects the holy revolutionary career and patriotism of the President who devoted his all to the work for national reunification and prosperity. History records careers of many great persons but does not know such a peerless patriot as President Kim Il Sung who had made superhuman efforts for the country and nation all his life. So, leader Kim Jong Il made sure that a monument inscribed with the President's last autograph for reunification was erected at Panmunjom to convey his patriotic and noble intention for all ages. The cause of national reunification pioneered and victoriously led by the peerlessly great men is greeting a fresh turning phase thanks to respected Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission. The noble desire of the father of the nation for reunification will be surely accomplished under his wise leadership. Rodong News Team

title: Symposium of Korean Women Held
body: Officials and members of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea held a symposium on the greatness of President Kim Il Sung at the Hall of Women on Thursday ahead of the 24th anniversary of his demise. Among those present were Jang Chun Sil, chairwoman of the Union Central Committee, and other officials of the union. Speakers said that the President is a gifted thinker-theoretician, prominent politician, outstanding strategist and tender-hearted father of the people whom the Korean nation acclaimed for the first time in its history spanning thousands of years. They noted that the President is a peerlessly great man as he founded the immortal Juche idea and clearly indicated the way for the popular masses to carve out their destiny with its brilliant rays. They pointed out that the President implanted his steadfast will to build an ideal society for the people in the programme of the Down-with-Imperialism Union at the outset of the Korean revolution and made a new history of the country's prosperity, fighting his way across tens of thousands of ri in the bloody war against the Japanese imperialists, taking the untrodden path for nation-building and making his way in the war flames and virgin snow for postwar rehabilitation and construction. They said that the President set forth the principle of Juche in ideology, independence in politics, self-support in the economy and self-reliance in national defense as the fundamental issue and lifeline of nation-building and maintained it with success. They praised him as the lodestar of national reunification and the world's elder statesman who set it as the supreme task of the nation to reunify the country and dedicated all his life to this cause so as to hand over a reunified country to posterity and made undying contributions to global independence. His revolutionary exploits are more brilliantly shining thanks to the outstanding and seasoned guidance of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, they added. Rodong News Team

title: Poem Recitation of Agricultural Workers
body: Officials of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea (UAWK) and agricultural workers had a poem-reciting event on July 5 on the occasion of the 24th anniversary of demise of President Kim Il Sung. The performers praised the President in their poems and songs. In an epic "What the people of this country say!" they lauded the noble traits of the President. In a long epic "The sun and all kinds of cereals and fruits", they expressed gratitude for the President who laid a material and technological foundation for the comprehensive mechanization of agricultural economy. Also put on the stage were a female solo "When we walk along the road between fields" and other numbers representing the revolutionary zeal of the agricultural workers. Attending the meeting were Kim Chang Yop, chairman of the UAWK Central Committee, and UAWK officials. Rodong News Team

title: Anniversary of Kim Il Sung's Visit to Mongolia Observed
body: Events took place in Mongolia from July 2 to 4 to mark the 30th anniversary of President Kim Il Sung's second visit to Mongolia. They included a friendly meeting and a film show at the hall of officers of the Ministry of Defence and a Korean book, photo and handicraft exhibition at the Art Gallery. On display at the venue of the exhibition were photos showing Kim Il Sung's visit to Mongolia. Also there were works of the peerlessly great men, books introducing the proud successes gained by the Korean people in socialist construction and handicrafts showing the wisdom and talents of the Korean nation. After watching the film dealing with Kim Il Sung's Mongolia visit, Minister of Foreign Affairs D. Tsogtbaatar said: Two visits to Mongolia made by President Kim Il Sung, the great leader of the Korean people, are brilliantly recorded in the history of the traditional friendly relations between the two countries. In his lifetime the President paid deep attention to the development of the relations with Mongolia. The Mongolian people and government awarded Order of Suhbaatar to him in praise of his exploits performed to lay a solid foundation for the development of the relations between the two countries. The Mongolian people are still looking back with deep emotion upon the historic days when President Kim Il Sung visited Mongolia. Rodong News Team

title: Floral Baskets to Statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il
body: The families of Ya. T. Nobichenko, an internationalist soldier, Kim Sun Ok, a person related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, and So Sun Ok, a China-resident Korean related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, sent floral baskets to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill ahead of the 24th anniversary of demise of the President. The floral baskets were placed at the statues of the great leaders on Friday. On the same day, floral baskets from the Japan Nagano Prefectural People's Council for Supporting the Independent and Peaceful Reunification of Korea and Japanese media person Shunichi Narita were laid at the statues of the great leaders. Rodong News Team

title: Floral Tribute to Statues of Kim Il Sung, Kim Jong Il
body: Members of UNDP and WHO missions here and Jong Il Sim, widow of DPRK Hero An Tong Su, visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on Friday ahead of the 24th anniversary of demise of the President. They placed the floral baskets before the statues of the great leaders and paid tribute to them. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Has Photo Session with Samjiyon County Party Committee Officials
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the Korean People's Army, summoned the officials of the Samjiyon County Committee of the WPK and had a significant photo session with them. He praised the officials of the Samjiyon County Party Committee for having taken the lead in the dynamic drive true to the idea and intention of the Party Central Committee for building the county, a sacred land of the revolution, into a model of the country and fairyland of communism, before having a photo session with them in front of the statue of leader Kim Jong Il in the county. Noting that a county in our country is very important as local base, he said that to strengthen the county is an urgent matter in realizing comprehensive prosperity of the country. The Party Central Committee attaches great importance to the duty and role of the county party committee, a hostess and staff which organizes and guides all the work of the county, he stressed. He stated that the officials of the county party committee should become core elements steeped in the idea of the Party Central Committee to the marrow of their bones and the county party committee should become the powerful driving force that accepts the Party policies in time and takes the lead in the efforts to carry them out. Hoping that the officials of the county party committee will be true servants of the people, he called on them to regard and uphold the people as Heaven and as leader Kim Jong Il. He earnestly said that the county party committee should be the home which the people frequent to tell of their inward thoughts and should take roots in the mind of the people. Saying that he would become a member of the Samjiyon County Party Committee to make contributions to sprucing up the county, a native place dear to our people, into the fairyland of the people best to live in our country, he ardently called upon the officials to work heart and soul for the modernization of the county with the mind to spruce up their own native homes. Political News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Inspects Samjiyon Potato Farina Production Factory
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the Korean People's Army, again gave field guidance to the modern Samjiyon Potato Farina Production Factory which was built in Samjiyon County. He again visited the factory to discuss measures on the spot with a determination to build a new process producing 2 000 tons of processed potato food in a year with potato farina as raw material, as the process of producing potato farina with a capacity of thousands of tons was built last year. Going round the potato farina production process, he said that the factory has not been operated in full capacity after its appearance but it should produce a huge amount of farina with the potatoes harvested this year so as to supply a lot of potato farina and processed potato food to the people. He underscored the need to equip the factory with modern machines for making a variety of foods, including noodle, zeppole, cake and nutritious rice, with potato farina and produce tasty and nutritious processed potato foods on a full scale. He called for building modern potato farina factories at the potato production bases in the northern alpine region on the basis of the experience and design gained in having built a standard factory that can produce potato farina and various kinds of processed potato foods for the first time in our country. He acquainted himself with the store of produced potato farina and highlighted the need to thoroughly ensure the quality of potato farina by keeping good conditions for the store and to establish a scientific quality check system. He also called upon the factory to take good care of and manage production facilities and equipment on a regular basis, ensure hygienic environment enough to fit for a foodstuff production process and organize manpower management to ensure profitability so as to put the production on normal footing at a high level. He looked round a Korean-style circulating fluidized-bed boiler newly built at the factory. He noted with high appreciation that the new boiler based on our own design, technology and efforts to suit the actual conditions can supply enough steam needed for production process with less coal consumption. Now that the factory has all production process in a perfect way, it is urgent to increase the output of potato for putting its production on a normal basis, he said. After learning about the potato farming of the county, he stressed the need to conduct sowing in right season and in a qualitative way, manure and cultivate potato fields in a scientific and technical way and realize the comprehensive mechanization to radically increase per hectare yield. The Party will solve the problem of vehicles necessary for organization of potato transport fleet to carry harvested potato, he said, adding that it is important to gather it in time without wasting even a potato and fully supply potato to the factory. Saying that the Party harbors great expectations over the Samjiyon Potato Farina Production Factory which opened up a new path in the potato processing industry of our country, he earnestly called on its officials and employees to keep the factory in full-capacity operation in the spirit of devoted service to the people and thus make the factory built by the Party with much care truly contribute to the improvement of the people's diet. He was accompanied by Hwang Pyong So, Jo Yong Won, O Il Jong and Kim Yong Su, senior officials of the WPK Central Committee. Political News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Inspects Construction Sites in Samjiyon County
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the Korean People's Army, gave field guidance to construction sites in Samjiyon County. Looking at the master plan of construction of a township in the county and a map showing the bird's-eye view of the township in the county at the observation deck on Pegae Hill, the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was briefed on it. He gave an instruction to include the plan of expanding and developing the area extending to the shore of Lake Samji in the plan of the township construction of the county in the future. Looking at the map showing the bird's-eye view of the township in the county, he said the color of coating materials and metal roofing materials of the buildings should be harmoniously matched to their use and features and the color of the exterior walls should be selected to suit well the natural forests of Mt Paektu. He said that the construction of Samjiyon County should be conducted, divided into the areas of education, dwelling houses, modern streets, industry, sports and cultural education, commercial service and tourism, in accordance with the ratified master plan. He said that a model of city with modern civilization in the mountains should be made in the construction of Samjiyon County and the appearance of all the counties in the mountains of our country should be spruced up and built well by generalizing the experience and this process should be an occasion of great leap and a revolution in local construction. As the township construction of Samjiyon County is conducted amidst the concern and support of the whole Party, state and society, it should be finished in the short period by scrupulously organizing the guidance and supply according to a three-dimensional and blitz war formula. He underscored the need to introduce the construction method suitable for the features of the northern area with heavy snowfall and low temperature and ensure the quality of construction on the highest level by intensifying the guidance and supervision of construction without concentrating on the speed only. He said it is necessary to make a good design of forestation and tree planting according to the districts of the township area of the county and stressed the need to plant a number of white birch, a favorite tree of leader Kim Jong Il. Going round the construction sites of the Management Office for Revolutionary Battle Sites in the Secret Camp of Mt Paektu and lodging houses for study tourists, he learned about the construction. Many units are engaged in the construction of the county and so state construction supervision institutions should establish an orderly supervisory system and make increasingly exact demands, he said. Going round the Rimyongsu area, he said that various types of dwelling houses and buildings should be placed in a diverse and peculiar way along the side of the ravine, preserving the characteristics of nature and topography. During the county construction forest mustn't be wrecked, he stressed, calling for preserving the ecological environment in Mt Paektu area intact, mindful that the area is a sacred place of revolution where every tree and every blade of grass can never be neglected. Through the work to spruce up Samjiyon County, we should renew not only the appearance of the township area but also the mental conditions of people and let the county play its role as a host, not making its independence and spirit of self-reliance fade while the whole country is aiding the county, he said, adding that the county should create a revolutionary spirit in the new century, a new spirit of the times in the course of building itself into a communist dreamland. Noting that the construction of the county has undergone a lot of progress, he gave thanks to the builders for faithfully devoting themselves to the work for sprucing up the county into the one flawless in every aspect. Accompanying him were Hwang Pyong So, Jo Yong Won, O Il Jong and Kim Yong Su, senior officials of the C.C., WPK. Political News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Inspects Junghung Farm in Samjiyon County
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the Korean People's Army, gave field guidance to the Junghung Farm in Samjiyon County. He went round a potato plot under the workteam 1 of the farm. Noting that potato blight and flood damage have an impact on potato harvest in July every year, he asked how it is this year. He underscored the need for the agricultural field to take thoroughgoing measures of agricultural technique to prevent damage by low temperature and blight, the most knotty problem in potato farming in northern alpine area. He said that the agronomists and persons in charge of plots should enhance their responsibility and role so as to intensify prediction and forecast of potato blight and that a strict step should be taken to secure agricultural chemicals and immediately and intensively spray them upon potato plants in sickness. He stressed the need to direct efforts to stockbreeding to establish the food production cycle of agriculture and animal husbandry, increase the fertility of soil of potato fields and conduct in a scientific and technical way the manuring and cultivation of potato fields including weeding, earthing up, fertilizing and extermination of harmful insects. Looking round farm machines and tractors of the workteam, he acquainted himself with how many tractors it has and how it operates them. Saying what he wanted to know with utmost care is the proportion and level of mechanization of potato farming, he noted that the level of the comprehensive mechanization of the farm should be raised decisively. He pointed out that the agricultural sector sets a good example for mechanization with the farm machines secured more than 20 years ago. Comprehensive mechanization should be realized with modern and efficient farm machines in line with the requirements of the steadily changing and developing reality and farm officials should add to their knowledge to know well the global trend of the development of farm machines and boldly set aim high, he added. He said that if they take into full account how many and what kinds of farm machines are needed to do all of the farm work with the help of machines without hesitation and inform the Party of it, it will work hard to carry it into reality and that it is the Party's firm determination to first build the farm into an exemplary unit for modernization of farm machines and, on this basis, turn Samjiyon County and its farms into the standard unit of our country whose comprehensive mechanization is realized perfectly on a high level and a farm of comprehensive mechanization where farmers' ideal has come true. Then he went to a storehouse of seed potatoes. Appreciating the introduction of the automatic control system of environment which makes it possible to put the store of seed potatoes on a scientific basis by automatically measuring and controlling temperature, humidity and concentration of carbonic acid gas in the storehouse, he underlined the need to increase the capacity by properly estimating the quantity of seeds to meet the increased potato fields. Now that seed is essential for potato farming it is necessary to establish an integral system of producing and keeping seed potatoes and put seed selection on a scientific and technical basis, he said. It is necessary to breed and introduce per-hectare high-yielding potato species and to select and introduce species of potato fit for food as the Potato Farina Production Factory has been built, he said, adding: All the farms should not plant some high-yielding species only, thinking of productivity, but introduce various species good to taste and ensure the quality of processed potato foods in production and thus raise the quality of potato production. Going round the farm, he set forth the plan and direction for sprucing up the seat village in Junghung-ri, Samjiyon County. He underscored the need to first remodel the units associated with leadership exploits of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il such as the Junghung Farm visited by them several times and then, on the basis of the experience, gradually change all the farms in the county, noting that the county shouldn't cling to only the remodeling of the township but propel it with the work to remodel the farm villages on a full scale. He said that the Party would actively help build the Junghung Farm into a standard unit of village development, and gave an instruction on properly estimating and reporting the necessary materials and labor. This meaningful year seeing the lapse of 20 years since the Party advanced the policy of bringing about a radical turn in potato farming, we have to realize without fail the wishes of Kim Jong Il, who was so anxious about the issue of potato farming in Ryanggang Province, by producing a high yield of potato in the native land of Kim Jong Il, he said. Accompanying him were Hwang Pyong So, Jo Yong Won and Kim Yong Su, senior officials of the C.C., WPK. Political News Team

title: Kim Yong Nam Meets President of WPO
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the DPRK Supreme People's Assembly, had a talk with Juan Samuel Delgado Cedillo, president of the World Peace Organization, and his party that paid a courtesy call on him at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Monday. Rodong News Team

title: Cambodian King and Great Queen Send Large Floral Baskets to DPRK Embassy
body: Cambodian King Norodom Sihamoni and Great Queen Norodom Monineath Sihanouk sent large floral baskets to the DPRK embassy in Phnom Penh on July 6 with the approach of the 24th demise anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Upon the authorization by the king and the great queen, a delegation of the Cambodian Ministry of Royal Palace led by Kong Sam Ol, deputy prime minister for Royal Palace, laid the floral baskets before the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il and paid tribute to them. Rodong News Team

title: Korean Documentary Film "Our Leader" Screened
body: A Korean documentary film "Our Leader" was screened at the People's Palace of Culture on Sunday, the 24th anniversary of demise of President Kim Il Sung. Watching the film were Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK; Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C.,WPK, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK; Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet; and other Party and government senior officials, the chairperson of a friendly party and officials of the Party Central Committee, ministries, national institutions, institutions and industrial establishments here. The film deals with the revolutionary career and feats of the President who made great contributions to the human cause of independence. The film contains historic scenes showing the President who embarked on the road of revolution in his early years, founded the immortal Juche idea and led to victory the two revolutionary wars and social revolution of various stages, thus building on this land a powerful socialist country independent in politics, self-supporting in the economy and self-reliant in defence and creditably solved the issue of succession to the revolutionary cause. The audience was admired by the benevolent image of the President who restlessly visited a large number of villages and families all over the country, always being on a people-bound train all his life, and took warm care of the people as their real father would do. It also deals with historic facts that the President advanced the idea of great national unity and put his heart and soul into the struggle for national reunification and met heads of many foreign political parties and states to indicate the bright road to be followed by mankind in the era of independence. Rodong News Team

title: Talks between Vice-Chairman of C.C., WPK and International
body: Secretary of C.C., CPC Held Talks between Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, on a visit to Cuba as head of the WPK delegation and Jose Ramon Balaguer, international secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba, were held at the building of the CPC Central Committee on July 6. At the talks both sides informed each other of their party activities and exchanged views on the issue of further developing the relations between the two parties. After the talks an agreement on exchange and cooperation between the WPK and CPC was inked at the guesthouse of the Council of State of Cuba. The WPK delegation was invited to a reception hosted by the international secretary of the C.C., CPC on the same day. Meanwhile, the WPK delegation laid a wreath before the monument to Jose Marti at Revolution Square in Havana. Rodong News Team

title: Foreigners, Overseas Koreans Visit Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: The diplomatic envoys, representatives of international bodies and military attaches here and the president of the World Peace Organization and his party and other foreign guests and overseas Koreans visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on Sunday, the 24th anniversary of demise of President Kim Il Sung. They paid homage to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il. They paid tribute to Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il at the halls of immortality where they lie in state. They went round the halls where the orders the great leaders received are on display and the halls that house cars, electric car, boat and train coaches used by them for their field guidance and foreign tours till the last moments of their lives. On the same day, the chief and members of the Pyongyang Mission of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun to pay homage to the great leaders. Rodong News Team

title: President of World Peace Organization Leaves
body: Juan Samuel Delgado Cedillo, president of the World Peace Organization, and his party left here on Tuesday. Rodong News Team

title: Singapore DPRK-U.S. Summit Hailed in Russia
body: Russian bodies made public statements to welcome the DPRK-U.S. summit meeting and talks in Singapore. The Russian Institute of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism said it was deeply stirred by the news about the historic DPRK-U.S. summit held in Singapore, adding: The meeting between the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un and the U.S. president is of great significance and proved that the only dialogue and negotiation can defuse the tensions on the Korean Peninsula. We pay our heartfelt tribute to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un who is energetically working for peace and stability of the Korean Peninsula and the region. The Russian Group for Solidarity with the DPRK said the achievements made in the Singapore DPRK-U.S. summit in the wake of the historic north-south summit meetings are the brilliant fruit of the far-sightedness and outstanding political ability ofKim Jong Un, adding that the world speaks well of his political ability. The Moscow Group for the Study of the Juche Idea said in a statement that the Singapore DPRK-U.S. summit was recorded as an important moment in the history of DPRK-U.S. relations and Kim Jong Un once again showed his will to achieve peace and prosperity of the Korean Peninsula this time. The Regional Social Organization of Russia "Borozino" and the All-Russia Lenin Young Communist League also congratulated the success in the DPRK-U.S. summit and talks, hoping that the Korean people would make bigger success in all fields in the future, too. Rodong News Team

title: Ridiculous Tongues of Political Dwarfs
body: At recent talks between Japanese Prime Minister Abe and U.S. Defense Secretary Mattis, Abe said that a Japan-U.S. alliance is the roots of the peace and security of Japan and a pillar of the regional peace and Japan's Defense Minister Onodera cried out for jointly pressing ahead with the work to make the DPRK dismantle all its nukes and ballistic missiles. If Japan sincerely wants the Korean peninsula to be denuclearized and the world to be free from nuclear weapons, it would not talk such nonsense. A dramatic event is happening on the Korean peninsula where the situation was driven into the verge of confrontation and war. Japan is very upset by this because the atmosphere of reconciliation and detente in the peninsula is throwing dark clouds over Japan seeking a war state. No wonder, the Abe group has gotten the jitters at the possible undesirable change on the peninsula since the DPRK-U.S. dialogue was high on the agenda. The Abe group is inventing a pretext of achieving its ambition for military giant and reinvasion at any cost, desperately inciting hostility towards the DPRK. If Japan sincerely wants the peace and stability in the region, it should make a bold decision to liquidate the crimes committed by Japan against the Korean nation in the past and drop its dagger hidden behind its waist. If Japan avoids the past liquidation and incites the hostility to the DPRK only, it would not escape from the political loneness for good. Ri Hyon Do

title: Ri Su Yong Meets Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez
body: Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, on a visit to Cuba as head of the WPK delegation, met and had a talk with Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez, president of the Council of State and president of the Council of Ministers of the Republic of Cuba, at the building of the Council of State on July 7. Ri Su Yong courteously conveyed the warm greeting and verbal personal message from Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, to Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez, president of the Council of State and president of the Council of Ministers of the Republic of Cuba. Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez expressed deep thanks for this and asked Ri to convey his most heartfelt greeting to Kim Jong Un. Expressed at the talk held in a friendly atmosphere were the stands on further developing the traditional ties between the two parties and two countries. Rodong News Team

title: Chairpersons of Chongryon Headquarters Meet
body: There took place a meeting of chairpersons of the headquarters of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) at the Korean Hall in Tokyo on July 6. The meeting was held to decisively enhance the responsibility and role of the chairpersons in speeding up the march of patriotism and make the whole organization turn out in the innovation movement in which they will mark the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK with high political enthusiasm and success of work, true to the congratulatory message from the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un to the 24th Congress of Chongryon. Present at the meeting were Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of Chongryon, vice-chairpersons, the chairman of the Central Audit Committee of Chongryon, members of the Central Standing Committee of Chongryon and chairpersons of the headquarters of Chongryon. Ho said in a report what's important in implementing the tasks set forth by Kim Jong Un in his congratulatory message is that the chairpersons of the headquarters of Chongryon consider what ideological consciousness they should have in carrying out their revolutionary missions. The chairpersons of the headquarters of Chongryon should further consolidate Chongryon shining with the august names of the peerlessly great men in the organizational and ideological way and concentrate all efforts on implementing the instructions of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il, so as to maximize the speed of the march toward victory, the reporter stated. He stressed the need for the chairpersons to make a breakthrough in implementing the tasks set forth in the congratulatory message from Marshal Kim Jong Un. It is important to arouse the whole organization to the innovation movement to glorify the 70th anniversary of foundation of the DPRK with high political enthusiasm and success of work, the reporter said. He appealed to all the officials, including the officials of central organization of Chongryon and chairpersons of its headquarters, to bear in mind the slogan "Let's make selfless, devoted efforts for the compatriots!" advanced by Kim Jong Un in his congratulatory message and make innovations in their jobs so as to report Kim Jong Un on successes of joy. Then followed by speeches. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Premier Inspects Various Units in Tanchon, Komdok Areas
body: Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, inspected industrial establishments in Tanchon and Komdok areas including the Tanchon Magnesia Factory, the third dressing plant of the Komdok Mining Complex and the Kumgol Mine. He encouraged the workers dynamically increasing production through the revolutionary general offensive and called for dynamically advancing toward a higher goal. At field consultative meetings the premier called upon the relevant sectors to actively help industrial establishments in Tanchon and Komdok areas and underlined the need for the leading economic officials to submit the management and business strategies to the implementation of the new strategic line of the Party and carry out the coordinated operation under a scrupulous plan for organizing and leading economic work. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Delegation of State Emergency Disaster Committee Returns
body: A delegation of the State Emergency Disaster Committee of the DPRK led by Chairman Kang Il Sop returned home on Monday after taking part in the Asian ministerial meeting on decreasing the danger of disaster held in Mongolia. Rodong News Team

title: UN Under-Secretary General Arrives
body: Mark Andrew Lowcock, under-secretary general for the UN Humanitarian Affairs, and his party arrived here on Monday. Rodong News Team

title: Gift to Kim Jong Un from Raul Castro Ruz
body: The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a gift from Raul Castro Ruz, first secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba. The gift was conveyed to Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, on a visit to Cuba as head of the WPK delegation, by an official concerned on July 7. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung's Work Introduced in Russia
body: The Russian internet homepage Patrioti Moskva posted the full text of President Kim Il Sung's work "Let the Women of the North and the South Unite and Hasten the Reunification of the Country" on July 3 on the occasion of the 24th anniversary of his demise. Posted on the website was also a portrait of the smiling President. Rodong News Team

title: UN Official Visits Pyongyang Children's Foodstuff Factory
body: Mark Andrew Lowcock, under-secretary general for the UN Humanitarian Affairs, and his party visited the Pyongyang Children's Foodstuff Factory. The guests went round various parts of the factory producing foodstuffs good for the growth of children. They also toured the Tower of the Juche Idea, the Korean Rehabilitation Centre for Children with Disability and aid projects in Unryul and Sinchon counties of South Hwanghae Province. Rodong News Team

title: World Population Day Observed
body: There was a seminar at the Grand People's Study House on Wednesday to mark the 2018 World Population Day. Present there were officials in public health and relevant units and members of international organizations including the acting representative of the UNPF and officials of foreign embassies. Speeches were made. The speakers stressed the need to strength the medical service for reproductive health in a qualitative manner in keeping with this year's theme of UNPF "Family planning is a human right". They explained the service of the family planning and its situation, results of canvass, and cooperative activities of the UNPF. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Yong Nam Meets Under-Secretary General for UN Humanitarian Affairs
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, met and had a talk with Mark Andrew Lowcock, under-secretary general for the UN Humanitarian Affairs, and his party who paid a courtesy call on him at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Wednesday. Rodong News Team

title: Abe Has Been Forsaken by Public
body: Recently, a mammoth public rally was staged in Okinawa Prefecture of Japan to protest against the transfer of the U.S. marines' air base in Futenma to Henoko. The protesters criticized Abe for pushing ahead with the project, holding such placards as "Do not bring earth and sand!" and chanting a slogan "Do not build base!" At an earlier memorial service for the war dead in Okinawa the participants called Abe "Morikake" (Moritomo and Kake schools related to the scandal of him and his wife) and urged him to step down. Some of them called him "liar" as he once said that he would "do his best to ease the burden caused by the base in Okinawa." As seen above, Abe has been forsaken by the public as he has done only evil deeds since he took power, being keen on anachronistic reactionary politics and unpopular policies, contrary to what the public think of. Since the very day he held office as prime minister, he has done his best for his profits only by abusing power. He is just the kingpin of corruption and irregularities and a crooked politician seeking to prolong his career and maintain his power by fawning upon big countries without his own opinion and principle in foreign affairs. The public in Japan are spiting at his corrupt politics and judgment has already been made on his political destiny. However, a leopard can not change its spots. Abe fails to straighten himself out but is impudently going about for shuttle diplomacy, asking other countries to help Japan's involvement in the settlement of the issue of the Korean peninsula. This is very ridiculous as he is unaware of where he is standing. Abe had better mind his political destiny at stake, instead of poking his nose into other's affairs. Ri Hak Nam

title: Korean Exhibition Held in Iran
body: A Korean book, photo and fine art exhibition took place in Teheran on July 2-7 to mark the 54th anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il's start of work at the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, the second anniversary of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's election as chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the 45th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic ties between the DPRK and Iran. On display at its venue were photos showing the revolutionary careers of President Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il and the exploits of Kim Jong Un. There were also works of the peerlessly great men and books, photos and art pieces dealing with the reality of Juche Korea and wisdom and talents of its people. Present at the opening ceremony were personages of various strata of Iran and staff members of the DPRK embassy in Teheran and a delegation of the Korean Overseas Exhibition General Bureau. The participants laid a floral basket before a photo of the President. Then speeches were made. The director for Exhibition of the Islamic Culture and Relations Organization of Iran hoped that the Korean people would achieve bigger success in building an economic power under the leadership of Kim Jong Un. The vice general secretary for International Affairs of the Islamic Coalition Party of Iran expressed the belief that the exhibition would contribute to expanding the friendly relations and cultural exchange between the two countries. Rodong News Team

title: Egyptian Ambassador Gives Reception
body: Egyptian Ambassador to the DPRK Sameh Lotfi Abdelhady gave a reception at the Taedonggang Diplomatic Club on Tuesday to mark the 66th anniversary of the July 23 revolution in Egypt. Present there on invitation were Kim Sung Du, chairman of the Education Commission who is chairman of the DPRK-Egypt Friendship Association, Ryu Myong Son, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Ho Yong Bok, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, So Ho Won, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries, Mun Jae Chol, vice-director general of the General Bureau for Affairs with Diplomatic Corps, and officials concerned and representatives of foreign embassies and international organizations here. Speeches were made at the reception. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung Remembered Abroad
body: Remembrance meetings were held in Syria, Denmark and Uganda and a lecture in Hungary on June 26 and 27 on the occasion of the 24th anniversary of demise of President Kim Il Sung. Present at the events were personages of various strata and masses of the relevant countries. The director of the Department of Workers and Farmers of the Syria's Baath Arab Socialist Party who is a member of its Regional Leadership said that HE Kim Il Sung in his lifetime supported with sincerity the peoples of many countries in their struggle for national liberation, adding: He is a close friend of the Syrian people as he laid a firm foundation for friendly relations between Syria and the DPRK. His august name will be always cherished in the hearts of the Syrian people. The chairman of the Denmark-DPRK Friendship Association said President Kim Il Sung was an outstanding political activist and the great leader of the Korean people. Some personages of Uganda praised the President for performing undying exploits before the times and history. The chairperson of the Hungarian Workers' Party praised the President as an invincible and iron-willed commander and a genius of creation and construction. A message to the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was adopted at the event in Denmark. Rodong News Team

title: Let Us Accelerate Advance of Korean Revolution
body: It is the historic review of the Korean revolution that the party strong in faith can never be disorganized and no force can reduce the army and people united with faith to submission. The slogan "Let's keep the revolutionary faith to the death" upheld by the first generation of the Korean revolution is the eternal motto and guide of victory for the Korean revolutionaries. We should creditably develop the ongoing all-people's general offensive, the revolutionary advance in the new century of Juche, into a grand advance based on idea and faith and thus fully display the heroic stamina and invincible might of Juche Korea before the world. We should cherish the immutable faith that we, guided by the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, are sure to win. We should usher in a fresh phase of prosperity with our own efforts on all fronts of the socialist economic construction in the same spirit and mettle with which we advanced without even a moment's halt to win the great victory of the line of simultaneously pushing forward the economic construction and the building of nuclear force despite the unprecedented sanctions and blockade threatening our existence. Faith means our life and soul, dignity and final victory. Only victory and glory will always be in store for Juche Korea whose army and people form a fortress of faith around the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and keep the same idea, intention and pace with the Party. Let us all further accelerate the advance of the Korean revolution with faith in sure victory and optimism and redoubled courage and in high spirits.

title: British, Swiss Bodies Support Korea's Reunification
body: British and Swiss organizations released joint statements on July 4, the 46th anniversary of the July 4 joint statement. The British Association for the Study of Songun Policy, the British Group for the Study of the Juche Idea, the Korean Friendship Association UK and the British Solidarity Committee for Peace and Reunification of the Korean Peninsula said in a joint statement that the publication of the July 4 joint statement was recorded as a historic event in the history of the struggle for Korea's reunification. It is a product of the indefatigable efforts of President Kim Il Sung who set forth the country's reunification as the greatest task of the nation, the statement said, adding: The July 4 joint statement carries the President's idea for national reunification and the desire and will of the Korean people to achieve the reunification of the country at any cost. A fundamental turn is being made in the national reunification movement under the energetic guidance of respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. The Swiss Organizing Committee for the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu, the Switzerland-Korea Committee and the Swiss Group for the Study of the Juche Idea said in their joint statement: The July 4 joint statement called for achieving Korea's reunification without interference of outsiders. The "Panmunjom Declaration on Peace, Prosperity and Reunification of Korean Peninsula" adopted on April 27 reflects the spirit of all the north-south joint statement and declarations. The statement and declarations adopted between the north and the south are the great patriotic exploits of the great leaders of the DPRK. We support the independent and peaceful reunification of Korea. Rodong News Team

title: Collection of Great Men's Works Published by Int'l Body
body: A collection of works of President Kim Il Sung, leader Kim Jong Il and the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was published with due ceremony by the Organization of Solidarity of the Peoples of Africa, Asia and Latin America on July 3 to commemorate the 24th anniversary of the President's demise. Among those present at the ceremony were the chairman of the Cuban Committee for Supporting Korea's Reunification who is vice-minister of Higher Education, personages of the Foreign Ministry, the Ministry of Revolutionary Armed Forces and the Cuban Institute of Friendship with the Peoples, the secretary general of the Organization of Solidarity of the Peoples of Africa, Asia and Latin America, the DPRK ambassador to Cuba and his embassy officials. Lourdes Cervantes, secretary general of the Organization of Solidarity of the Peoples of Africa, Asia and Latin America, said that the work collection helps have a better knowledge of the struggle of the Korean people dynamically advancing while resolutely frustrating the imperialists' moves to stifle the DPRK. He went on: The Korean people have diligence and noble spirit and no force can bring them to their knees. The DPRK has resolutely struggled to defend the sovereignty of the nation. We wish the Korean people greater success in the future, too. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung Remembered Abroad
body: Remembrance meetings and round-table talks took place in Switzerland, Ethiopia and DR Congo between June 30 and July 2 on the occasion of the 24th anniversary of demise of President Kim Il Sung. The chairman of the Switzerland-Korea Committee praised the President for advancing the just proposals for national reunification and energetically leading the struggle for their materialization. The chairman of the Ethiopian National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism noted that the President devoted himself to the country and people all his life and regarded it as his duty to realize the people's dream and ideal, always finding himself among them. A vice-chairperson of the Addis Ababa Youth Association of Ethiopia said: There are lots of legend-like anecdotes about the politics pursued by President Kim Il Sung for the people. It is the firm will of all the Korean people to hold the President in high esteem for all ages. There is no other country in the world but the DPRK where the leader and people are united as one. The chairman of the National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of DR Congo said that the President is an outstanding elder statesman in the 20th century as he founded the immortal Juche idea and successfully embodied it to build Korean-style socialism. The exploits he performed before the era and history will always be remembered by the progressives with the victorious advance of the human cause of independence, the chairman added. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's Work Introduced in Russia
body: The Russian newspaper Komsomolskaya Pravda on July 3 carried the full text of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "The Great Comrade Kim Il Sung Is the Eternal Leader of Our Party and Our People" on the occasion of the 24th anniversary of demise of President Kim Il Sung. The work, published on April 20, Juche 101 (2012), deals with the revolutionary exploits performed by President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il all their lives. It also indicates the tasks for staunchly defending and adding eternal luster to the idea and exploits of the great leaders. The newspaper carried a portrait of smiling Kim Il Sung. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of DPRK Football Association Leaves for Russia
body: A delegation of the DPRK Football Association headed by Vice-Premier of the Cabinet Ri Ryong Nam, chairman of the Association, left here for Russia on Thursday to watch the finale of the 2018 FIFA World Cup and attend its closing ceremony at the invitation of FIFA. Rodong News Team

title: Under-Secretary General for UN Humanitarian Affairs Leaves
body: Mark Andrew Lowcock, under-secretary general for the UN Humanitarian Affairs, and his party left here on Thursday. Rodong News Team

title: Korean-style Socialism Is Science
body: The world people's admiration and desire for the genuine socialism of Juche Korea are increasing day by day in their minds when seeing the country shining as socialism centered on the popular masses. This proves once again that Korean-style socialism is incomparably superior to capitalism and emerges victorious. In the past, advocates of capitalist advantages described capitalist society as the one in which "equality for all" and "welfare for all" could be realized. But they have now admitted the failure of capitalist countries' policy of "equality for all" and "welfare for all". Socialist society reflects the ideal and aspiration of mankind. The foundation of Korean-style socialism is the popular masses. It is the Workers' Party of Korea's viewpoint and philosophy of the people to push ahead with the revolution in reliance on the inexhaustible strength of the popular masses and devotedly serve them, viewing them as those responsible for the revolution. The scientific accuracy and truth of Korean-style socialism and its victory have been clearly proved in the vortex of history. Although our army and people have been hard pressed for everything, they have undauntedly and steadily advanced Korean-style socialism in the spirit of self-reliance and fortitude. Today the DPRK emerges a powerful country which no hostile country can dare to provoke, demonstrating its dignity all over the world. Korean-style socialism is a science, so is its victory. As long as there are the great Party, the great ideology and the great people, Korean-style socialism is invincible. Kang Chol

title: Reception Given at Chinese Embassy
body: Zhang Chenggang, charge d'Affaires ad interim of the Chinese embassy here, hosted a reception at the embassy on Wednesday to mark the 57th anniversary of the conclusion of the DPRK-China Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance. Present there on invitation were Yang Hyong Sop, vice-president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, Ryu Myong Son, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Ri Kil Song, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, and officials concerned. Staff members of the Chinese embassy and Chinese guests staying here were on hand. Zhang Chenggang said in his speech that the above-said treaty is a valuable treasure left by the leaders of the elder generation of the two countries and a symbol of deep friendship formed between the two parties and two peoples in the long revolutionary struggle and socialist construction. Saying it is the steadfast policy of the Chinese Party and government to excellently defend, consolidate and develop the China-DPRK ties of friendship and cooperation, he hoped that the Korean people would steadily achieve bigger and new success in socialist construction under the leadership of the WPK led by Chairman Kim Jong Un. Yang Hyong Sop noted in his speech that the DPRK-China friendship, noble heritage and a common treasure bequeathed by the preceding leaders, is further developing in line with the requirements of the new times thanks to the deep trust and intimacy of the supreme leaders of the two countries and joint efforts of the peoples of the DPRK and China. It is the immovable stand of the Workers' Party of Korea and the DPRK government to creditably carry forward the precious tradition of the DPRK-China friendship generation after generation, he stated. He hoped that the fraternal Chinese people would make bigger success in their work to achieve the great prosperity of China under the leadership of the Communist Party of China with General Secretary Xi Jinping as its core. Earlier, the Chinese consul general in Chongjin hosted a reception. Rodong News Team
