title: National Sci-Tech Presentation in Construction Field Held
body: The Central Committee of the Architects Union of Korea hosted a sci-tech presentation in the construction field at the Sci-Tech Complex on July 10 and 11. The presentation, divided into the panels of structure and construction, was attended by teachers, researchers, designers, technicians and officials in the fields of scientific education, design and construction. 140 odd valuable sci-tech successes, achieved in the development of the country's architectural techniques, were introduced at the presentation. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung's Work Introduced in Brazil
body: The Brazilian Center for the Study of Songun Politics on July 1 posted on its website President Kim Il Sung's work "The Path of the Korean Revolution". The work, published on June 30, Juche 19 (1930), clarifies the fundamental stand and attitude to be maintained by the communists in the revolutionary struggle, the character and tasks of the Korean revolution and the Juche-based line and policies for successfully carrying out the Korean revolution. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung's Work Published in Russia
body: The Leto-print Publishing House of Russia brought out in booklet President Kim Il Sung's work "Enhancing the Role of the Popular Masses Is the Guarantee for Victory in the Cause of Independence" on the occasion of the 24th anniversary of his demise. The work, published on April 15, Juche 81 (1992), says that the President's life of 80 years is that of struggle in which he devoted himself to the people as their son. It also clarifies that the Workers' Party of Korea has firmly maintained the Juche-based stand and principle, always with the Juche idea as its guideline in the whole course of the revolution and construction, and that the common task facing the Korean people and the world people is to build an independent new world. A book releasing ceremony took place on July 3. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's Exploits Praised by Foreign Media
body: Foreign media carried special write-ups and articles between June 24 and 29 to mark the 2nd anniversary of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's election as chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. They carried his photos. The Russian website DPRK Today posted the following article titled "Bright smile of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un": The image of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un who brightly smiles, always finding himself among the people, has been often carried in Russian media. Lots of people in the world are fascinated by the images of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un warmly encouraging servicepersons and civilians, patting children on the cheeks and having photo sessions with ordinary people. It is Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un who gives top priority to the convenience of the people. The Korean people will always register victories as they are guided by him. Russia's online magazine Lemchich introduced data telling about the loving care of Kim Jong Un for the younger generation and the newspaper Komsomolskaya Pravda praised him for steering the situation of the Korean Peninsula. The Egyptian newspaper Al Akhbar Almassay carried an article titled "Political philosophy of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un" and the Brazilian Center for the Study of Songun Politics posted on its website an article titled "Election of Leader Kim Jong Un as chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK". Rodong News Team

title: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of Great Leaders
body: Home-visiting groups of students of Korean University under the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan led by Faculty Dean Sin Yong Gun and Choe Yong Ho respectively visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill here. The members of the visiting groups laid bunches of flowers at the statues of the great leaders and paid homage to them. Rodong News Team

title: Singapore DPRK-U.S. Summit Hailed
body: The African Regional Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea released a statement on July 2 to welcome the DPRK-U.S. summit in Singapore. The statement said: We welcome the historic summit meeting and talks between HE Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, and Donald J. Trump, president of the United States of America, which opened a bright future for eliminating the prejudice, mistrust and decades-long hostile relations and establishing new DPRK-U.S. relations and permanent and durable peace-keeping regime on the Korean Peninsula. The talks and adoption of a joint statement are an important event that provided a turning point in promoting peace, stability and prosperity in the Korean Peninsula and the world. We call upon all the countries to help open a new era of cooperation between the DPRK and the U.S. on the principle of respect for the sovereignty. We extend warm congratulations to respected HE Kim Jong Un who made a great contribution to ensuring peace and security in the Korean Peninsula and the world with his distinguished diplomatic strategy and through his energetic external activities. We extend firm solidarity to the Korean people in their struggle for peace and prosperity. Rodong News Team

title: National Games of Orphans-2018 Held
body: The national games of orphans-2018 opened in the DPRK. Orphans will compete in football, volleyball, basketball, swimming and other events. An opening ceremony took place at Phyongsong Middle School for Orphans on Thursday. At the end of the ceremony, there took place a football match (boy) of middle school category between South Phyongan Province and North Hamgyong Province. The games will last until July 18 at Phyongsong primary and middle schools for orphans. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Players Return Home
body: DPRK players returned home on Thursday after taking part in the 2018 FAI Contests. At the contests held in Ulan Bator of Mongolia from July 4 to 6, the DPRK bagged three gold, three silver and two bronze medals. At least 80 players from the DPRK, China, Russia and other countries participated in the FAI Asian Cup 2018 for Free Flight Model Aircraft. Pak Hye Song and Kim Un Gwang of the DPRK came first respectively at the medium glider individual of the contest and the medium rubber-propelled aero model individual. Meanwhile, Kim Un Bok placed first at the big glider individual of the FAI Mongolian Cup 2018 for Free Flight Model Aircraft, Pak Hye Song second at the medium glider individual and Kim Un Gwang third at the medium rubber-propelled aero model individual. Rodong News Team

title: WPK Delegation Returns
body: A delegation of the Workers' Party of Korea led by Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea Central Committee, returned home on Thursday after winding up its visit to Cuba. During its stay in Cuba, the delegation visited the grave of the late Cuban leader Fidel Castro Ruz at Santa Ifigenia Cemetery to pay homage to him. It also toured various places including the July 26 History Museum at the Moncada Barracks. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of Int'l Gymnastic Federation Arrives
body: A delegation of the International Gymnastic Federation led by President Morinari Watanabe arrived here on Thursday. Rodong News Team

title: Case of Military Surveillance on Civilians Disclosed in S. Korea
body: MBC of south Korea on Tuesday disclosed the fact that a detachment of the "Army Metropolitan Garrison Command" obtained information on civic and public organizations to report it to the Defense Security Command (DSC). It was reported that the detachment stationed at the Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency got information from the police agency to convey it to the DSC during the Park Geun Hye regime. Rodong News Team

title: Singapore DPRK-U.S. Summit Hailed
body: Political parties and figures of different countries welcomed the DPRK-U.S. summit in Singapore. The Czechoslovak Communist Party in a statement said: We warmly congratulate Comrade Kim Jong Un, Supreme Leader of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on having opened a new turning phase for building a lasting and durable peace-keeping regime on the Korean Peninsula and achieving the reunification of the country as desired by the Korean nation through the meeting and talks with Donald J. Trump, president of the United States of America. Comrade Kim Jong Un showed the whole world that the Korean people are the most peace-loving people. The world came to know better about the desire of the Korean people for peace. We extend full support to the DPRK's efforts for resolving the issue of the Korean Peninsula. The Socialist Workers' Party of Croatia said in its statement: We fully support a joint statement adopted at the talks. We highly appreciate the Korean people's struggle to defend the sovereignty. And we wish them greater success in building a powerful socialist country. Vijay Jolly, senior leader of the Indian People's Party, extended heartfelt congratulations to HE Kim Jong Un, Supreme Leader of the Korean people, who made great contribution to ensuring peace and security in the Korean Peninsula and the world. Rodong News Team

title: Dissolution of DSC Urged in S. Korea
body: According to the south Korean Yonhap News, 16 civic and social organizations including the North Jolla Provincial Peace and Human Rights Solidarity held a news conference on July 12 to demand the dissolution of the Defense Security Command, which hatched a plot to suppress the candlelight demonstrators by force, and stern punishment of its bosses. Speakers at the conference charged that the command planned to suppress the demonstrators by force, deploying an armored division under the pretence of coping with the "provocation" from the north. They urged the present "government" to liquidate the evils of the command at once and sternly punish those concerned. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung's Work Introduced in India
body: The Voice of Millions, an internet news of India, reported the full text of President Kim Il Sung's work "On the Three Principles of National Reunification" on July 4, the 46th anniversary of the July 4 joint statement. The work, published on May 3 and November 3, Juche 61 (1972), clarifies the three principles of national reunification--independence, great national unity and peaceful reunification-- and the idea of realizing the cooperation between the north and the south of Korea. The news posted a photo of the President. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's Work Printed in Russia
body: The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us Step Up the Building of a Thriving Country by Applying Kim Jong Il's Patriotism" was brought out in booklet at the Radio Soft Publishing House of Russia on July 5 to commemorate the 24th anniversary of demise of President Kim Il Sung. The work, published on July 26, Juche 101 (2012), deals with the essence of leader Kim Jong Il's patriotism and his noble career of loving the country and people. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of Int'l Gymnastic Federation Leaves
body: A delegation of the International Gymnastic Federation led by President Morinari Watanabe left Pyongyang on Saturday. Rodong News Team

title: Reception Given at DPRK Embassy in Beijing
body: The DPRK embassy in Beijing hosted a reception on July 10 to mark the 57th anniversary of the conclusion of the DPRK-China Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance. Present at the reception on invitation were Wang Chen, member of the Political Bureau of the C.C., Communist Party of China (CPC) and vice-chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, Kong Xuanyou, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, Xu Luping, deputy head of the International Liaison Department of the C.C., CPC, and officials concerned of China. Ji Jae Ryong, DPRK ambassador to China, and staff members of his embassy were on hand. Ji Jae Ryong noted that President Kim Il Sung provided historic roots of DPRK-China friendship together with Comrades Mao Zedong and Zhou Enlai and that leader Kim Jong Il visited China even in the last period of his life to consolidate the firm foundation for the development of the traditional DPRK-China friendship. He said that the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un developed the DPRK-China friendship into special relations unprecedented in the world through his historic three visits to China. He noted that we will strive together with Chinese comrades to steadily develop the DPRK-China relations of friendship and cooperation, promote the cause of socialist construction in the two countries and defend peace and security in Northeast Asia and the world, true to the intentions of the top leaders of the two parties and countries. Wang Chen said that Premier Zhou Enlai and President Kim Il Sung concluded the China-DPRK Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance 57 years ago to fix the deep friendship, which the two countries established through the protracted revolutionary struggle and socialist construction, as a form of the legal treaty and to promote it as the national will. He noted that General Secretary Xi Jinping and Chairman Kim Jong Un had historic meetings this year to have a series of important common understanding of carrying forward the traditional China-DPRK relations of friendship and strengthening the strategic communication, thus opening a new chapter for the friendship and cooperation between the two countries. China supports the Workers' Party of Korea headed by Chairman Kim Jong Un steadily advancing along the road of socialism while leading the Korean people, he said, adding that China would make efforts for the development of the China-DPRK relations, taking the hands of Korean comrades. Meanwhile, the DPRK consulate general in Shenyang of China and its Dandong Branch hosted receptions on July 11 and 12 to mark the anniversary. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Friendship Delegation Leaves for China
body: A friendship delegation led by Hong Sun Myong, vice-general director of the General Bureau of Public Catering Service who is vice-chairman of the DPRK-China Friendship Association, left Pyongyang on Friday to visit China. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of Int'l Gymnastic Federation Visits Sports Village
body: A delegation of the International Gymnastic Federation led by President Morinari Watanabe visited the sports village in Chongchun Street on Friday. Members of the delegation went round various gymnasiums of the sports village and chattered with Korean players busy in their training. On the same day the delegation toured the Pyongyang Indoor Stadium and others. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Inspects Chongjin Bag Factory
body: The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un inspected the Chongjin Bag Factory. In recent years he established production processes of materials for manufacturing bags including cloth and zip capable of satisfying the needs of the country one by one and, on the basis of them, set forth the task for pushing ahead with the work to successfully build an independent factory for production of schoolbags in every province and to mass-produce and supply bags of good quality with supplied materials as an important policy. However, the North Hamgyong Provincial Party Committee did not sincerely accept the Party's policy on newly building a bag factory in line with the capacity while disregarding the work initiated by the Party to provide all necessary things for the schoolers with our own products, giving top priority to the education for the generations to come. It offered shabby rooms of the building at the Chongjin Regenerated Fibre Factory for a bag production base and thus caused great anxiety to Kim Jong Un who came to the factory to learn about the bag production in localities. The Supreme Leader pointed out that the Provincial Party Committee is working in a perfunctory manner, disregarding an important policy to be prioritized by it and that its attitude toward the acceptance and implementation of the Party policy is very wrong and the committee has no revolutionary spirit and responsible attitude of working hard to implement the Party policy. Looking round the sample room of the factory, he said that the factory's level of producing bags is high though its production began one and half a year ago and the skills of its employees are high and that the bags are diverse in color and size and they were well made with much care according to the ages. He said it is necessary to make the shoulder straps of bags with thicker sponge, noting that they should be made with twice thicker sponge than now so that their users may not feel pain Stressing the need to strive for further raising the quality of bags, he said that the central factories responsible for production of raw materials should produce the accessories of bags such as cloth, zip and tape with locally available materials and ensure their production on a high level. He called for qualitative and meticulous sewing to produce quality bags so that they should not get unfastened or ripped though children and pupils handle them at random. It is necessary to further reduce the bag production cost, he said, giving an instruction to reexamine the price of school things including Mindulle notebooks and bags being supplied to pupils. Saying that even though the state has more burdens, it should not give inconvenience to the people, he stressed it is needed to correct the price after listening to the view of inhabitants. He charged that there is a problem in the work of the Provincial Party Committee as it has not yet built a design room, paying no attention to a poor products show room. Noting that he gave an instruction for provincial party committees to build a schoolbag factory in a responsible manner in every province and learned about the construction of bag factories in some provinces and they are considerably different in level, he said such difference should be considered as a gap in the officials' ideological attitude toward the Party policy, not difference in the economic power of provinces. The overall economy of the country can vigorously progress when North Hamgyong Province with great industrial potentials stands up, he said, expressing belief that the Provincial Party Committee would rectify its faults as soon as possible and wage a dynamic struggle for implementing the Party policies and thus build up the province into a reliable key industry zone of the country and bring about a radical turn in improving the people's living standard. He was accompanied by Hwang Pyong So, Jo Yong Won, O Il Jong and Kim Yong Su, senior officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Political News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Inspects Jungphyong-ri, Kyongsong County
body: The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un inspected Jungphyong-ri, Kyongsong County, North Hamgyong Province with the idea of building a large-scale vegetable greenhouse farm in it. Kim Jong Un has given his whole mind to sufficiently supplying the vegetables to the people by massively cultivating them of various sorts even in the northern oceanic climate more unfavorable than the plain area. He went to the spot with the idea of building a large-scale vegetable greenhouse farm in the sector of an air force regiment in Jungphyong-ri to be removed according to a decision made by the Central Military Commission of the Party, personally learned about the site and clarified the long-term plan for building a huge vegetable greenhouse farm. Looking at the vast land of the sector in an airport, he said that if we build a vegetable greenhouse farm of one hundred hectares, it will be splendid, and such area of the greenhouse will fully meet the needs of the people in the province. He expressed great satisfaction, saying he is very pleased today and that he is most pleased when he does a worthy thing for the people one by one like this. Saying that the people's army should build the farm at lightening speed as it is the first gigantic and large-scale construction in the country, he stressed that it is necessary to build it at the highest level while ensuring both construction speed and quality as it is the farm to be provided by the Party with firm determination, not sparing the investment for the people in North Hamgyong Province. He called for building the farmers' residential area and cultural and welfare establishments in a modern and civilized way and thus successfully sprucing up the farm village as a model of socialist rural cultural construction and socialist paradise in which it is nice to live and work. He indicated a general orientation arising in building the farm and operating it including the issue of organizing the powerful headquarters for dynamically pressing ahead with the construction and permanent organs of different fields, the issue of manufacturing greenhouse equipment and supplying the construction materials and the issue of training the greenhouse engineers and securing seeds and manpower. He was accompanied by Hwang Pyong So, Jo Yong Won, O Il Jong and Kim Yong Su, senior officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Political News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Inspects Onpho Holiday Camp
body: The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un inspected the Onpho Holiday Camp. He visited it late at night and acquainted himself with its management, operation and situation. Looking round the bathroom of the camp, he pointed out its very bad condition, saying bathtubs for hot spring therapy are dirty, gloomy and unsanitary for their poor management. If the camp draws criticism by the people instead of their favor due to such poor operation and management though it is holding a signboard indicating that it is a building visited by President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il, it will commit a sin of bringing to naught the exploits of the great leaders who built a holiday camp for the people before anything else in the scenery place where hot spring water is gushing out all the year round, he said. He asked the chairman of the Kyongsong County Party Committee about the output of hot spring water and its temperature at the point of gust and accommodation capacity of the camp and the number of rest-home visitors, and gave a task to modernly and newly build the camp. Calling for sprucing up the area of the camp which is famous for spring water in the country to be a peculiar resort which meets the convenience and growing cultural and emotional demands of the people at the best level, he said he would make sure that the People's Army would excellently build it next year and present it to the people as a gift. He said the camp should be built excellently to be an all-round service center, therapy center with all catering establishments so that people can enjoy full rest and spring water therapy during their holiday, adding its design should be worked out in a peculiar manner to meet the features of the spring water area and thus build the camp into a model of the spring water holiday camps without an equal in the country. Having a talk with the chairman of the Kyongsong County Party Committee, he asked him about the work of the county party committee and the work it plans to do in the future, he gave precious teachings for developing the county in a peculiar manner. Noting that the county has fields, mountains and a sea and good traffic conditions, he said that as it has some foundation for developing industry, agriculture and fisheries, the county party committee should study and work hard for the earlier development of the economy of the county which has favorable natural and economic conditions. He expressed expectation and belief that the county party committee would bring about a decisive turn in the struggle for turning the county into a marvelous one good to live with its own efforts by inspiring the people in the county to the drive for implementing the party policy. He was accompanied by Hwang Pyong So, Kim Song Nam, Jo Yong Won, O Il Jong and Kim Yong Su, senior officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Political News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Inspects Yombunjin Hotel under Construction
body: The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un inspected the Yombunjin Hotel under construction. The construction of the Yombunjin Hotel began in July 2011 in hearty response to the teachings given by leader Kim Jong Il on several occasions to successfully build a hotel in Yombunjin with clean sea waters and good white sandy shore. The building of main structures has been finished and the interior building phase is underway. The Supreme Leader referred to the fact that the plastering of the inside hotel has not yet been finished though six years passed since the completion of its frame project. He called for taking a decisive measure to quickly complete the construction, saying that although leader Kim Jong Il chose the site of the hotel in the picturesque Yombunjin shore and paid attention to the construction till the last moments of his life while learning about it time and again, the project has not yet been finished and that it is a very mistake to delay the construction at a time when the entire Party is concentrating all its efforts on implementing the behests of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il while taking it as the main line and as lifeline. He indicated the construction orientation and ways to turn the Yombunjin area into a wonderful resort for the people, saying that the Party will take a step for supplying funds and materials and the North Hamgyong Provincial Party Committee should encourage the officials and builders of the province to the campaign for implementing the behests of the leader so as to build the hotel by Oct. 10 next year and make a report of loyalty to Kim Jong Il. Saying that Yombunjin is an ideal place for the people to take cultural rest anytime as its seashore scene is unusually beautiful and it has good traffic conditions as it is located near railways, shipping lane and roads, he stressed the need to turn the area into the Yombunjin coast park of peculiar style by building more lodging quarters and service facilities of various forms and purposes in the section of more than 600 meters along the shore around the hotel. Pointing out that the ground design for exterior of the hotel is not good and its accommodation capacity is small, he gave instructions for the central and provincial designing forces to make an overall examination of the design and redesign it in keeping with modern tastes from a new angle with their concerted efforts. Saying that he will send professional technical forces of national institutions to help the province conduct the finishing construction of the hotel with its own efforts, he stressed that the province should strengthen and develop its designing and building forces in this course. He said that if modern hotels with adequate communal amenities are built in Yombunjin and its vicinity as there are scenic spots and famous hot springs, the people in the province and other people from across the country would take enough rest and lead a cultural and emotional life to the full while enjoying mountain-climbing, sea-bathing, angling, river-fishing and hot-spring cure in the area. He was accompanied by Hwang Pyong So, Jo Yong Won, O Il Jong and Kim Yong Su, senior officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Political News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Visits Machine Factory of Ranam Coal-mining Machine Complex
body: The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un gave field guidance to the September 1 Machine Factory under the Ranam Coal-mining Machine Complex. He acquainted himself with the production of the factory, going round the room for education in the revolutionary history, sci-tech learning space, machine assembling ground and other places of the factory. Praising its workers for having conducted fierce offensive to build modern buildings for production and life and spruced up the inside and outside of the factory, he stressed the need to continuously push ahead with technical updating of production processes and equipment as well as regular management of production buildings. Going round workplaces busy with production of machines and ordered equipment, he stated that the officials, workers and technicians of the factory should intensify the creative cooperation and the mass technological innovation movement to increase the production capacity and realize the modernization and automation of machines at a high level. It is necessary to bring science and technology close to production and work out a plan in a bold and big way and stubbornly carry it into practice at the factory and thus further consolidate its material and technical foundations so as to produce machines requiring high technology, he said. The sci-tech learning space should be arranged better and study-while-working habit thoroughly established at the factory so that all its employees can master machine equipment and fully arm themselves with the modern science and technology to radically increase the quality of machines, he noted. He said that the factory should pay attention to improving the supply service for employees and providing them with good material and cultural living conditions to bring about a great upsurge in production. Saying that the factory's duty and role are very important, he set forth the tasks and ways for developing the factory into a leading machine producer. He had a picture taken with the officials and workers of the factory, expressing the belief that they would bring about a fresh leap in the production of high-efficiency and modern machines of various kinds urgently needed for different fields of the national economy and make positive contributions to the development of the machine-building industry of the country. He was accompanied by Hwang Pyong So, Jo Yong Won, O Il Jong and Kim Yong Su, senior officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and Ri Hi Yong, chairman of the North Hamgyong Provincial Committee of the WPK. Political News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Inspects Chongjin Shipyard
body: The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un gave field guidance to the Chongjin Shipyard. He went round the room for education in the revolutionary history at the shipyard. He said that its officials and workers should create new miracles and innovations in shipbuilding and glorify the undying leadership exploits of our Party by carrying forward the baton of loyalty and self-reliance recorded in the proud development course of the shipyard with great pride and honor of working at the glorious workplace visited by President Kim Il Sung 12 times and by leader Kim Jong Il 6 times. He learnt in detail about the overall situation of the shipyard, going round the anchor chains workshop inspected by Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il and other production processes and shipbuilding site. After acquainting himself with the structure and tactical and technical specifications of a newly built warship and its weapons and equipment, he boarded the warship on a trial navigation. He praised the workers of the shipyard for having successfully built the warship with excellent mobility and firepower capability to strengthen the navy by fully displaying the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance. The Chongjin Shipyard is able to build various ships better in the future as it has a history of shipbuilding and high technology, he said, indicating detailed tasks to further modernize the shipbuilding process. Noting with firm belief in the workers of the Chongjin Shipyard, he decided to entrust it with the building of a newly planned modern cargo-passenger ship, he said that the shipyard can easily carry out this task as it had already experienced building the ship Mangyongbong-92. The shipyard should launch and conduct the work in a bold and revolutionary way and, in this course, further develop its shipbuilding technology and put the production processes on a scientific and modern basis of higher level and thus take the lead in bringing about a great leap in the development of the country's shipbuilding industry, he added. He expressed belief that the officials and workers of the Chongjin Shipyard would perform shining feats in the struggle to attain the new goal set forth by the Party and creditably live up to the expectation of the Workers' Party of Korea Central Committee. He was accompanied by Hwang Pyong So, Jo Yong Won, O Il Jong and Kim Yong Su, senior officials of the C.C., WPK. Political News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Inspects Fish Farms
body: The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un gave field guidance to the Raksan Offshore Salmon Farm and the Sokmak Atlantic Salmon Pedigree Farm run by Unit 810 of the Korean People's Army. He visited the Raksan Offshore Salmon Farm. Going round the room for education in the revolutionary history and cage-net fish breeding ground, he acquainted himself in detail with the production at the farm. It is important to create clean environment and establish a strict hygienic and anti-epidemic system in fish breeding grounds like in stockbreeding, he noted with appreciation, adding that ten-odd settling troughs were newly arranged at rivers flowing to Raksan Bay and at waste water outlets of industrial establishments and seaweed and tangle culture grounds were built around cage-net fish breeding ground to prevent sea pollution and protect ecological environment. He said that advanced technology should be positively introduced to put the offshore fish farming, cage-net fish farming, on a scientific and industrial basis and big efforts be directed to the work for preserving the uncontaminated ecological environment of sea on a high level so as to expand the water areas fit for breeding Atlantic salmon and produce this kind of fish in a larger quantity. It is necessary to raise the level of putting the production of processed salmon on a scientific, automatic and modern basis, strictly ensure its hygienic safety and quality and realize its standardization, he said, adding that Atlantic salmon bred on the East Sea of Korea and processed fish should be intensively supplied to the Pyongyang Taedonggang Seafood Restaurant to improve the people's diet. He also toured the Sokmak Atlantic Salmon Pedigree Farm. Going round the room for education in the revolutionary history, open-air fishing pond and other parts of the farm, he learned about its management and operation. He highly appreciated the officials and employees of the farm for having done a lot of work through a dynamic drive for updating the farm on a high level over the last three years to carry out the tasks given by him on the spot in May 2015. They spruced up the room for education in the revolutionary history, established an automatic control system for water recycling by computer and newly built oxygen-generating station, cylinder caisson and ultraviolet sterilizing station to increase the capability of water purification and oxygen saturation. They also rebuilt the modern fattening ground in a hygienic and anti-epidemic way to raise the survival rate of fry salmon, remodeled 54 concrete fishing ponds at 6 indoor blocks into resin ones and settled the problem of disposing waste water to decisively decrease the death rate of fish. Besides, they newly built superfine grinder, bulking feed plant and 1 000-ton feed storehouse and established a system of feed production by antibiosis. Giving appreciation of such achievements, the Supreme Leader said it is vary admirable that our scientists established a technique for preventing group death of salmon fries and thus made it possible to breed hundreds of thousands of salmon fries at sea this year. Now it is possible to further activate the culture of salmon given the enough material and technical foundations for safety production of Atlantic salmon and the increase of the level of its scientification and modernization, he noted, expressing his great pleasure over the appearance of a promising delicious fish producer in the country. He had a photo session with the officials and employees of the pedigree farm, expressing the expectation and belief that they would be a model of the country in implementing the WPK's pisciculture policy by steadily adding to the achievements under the banner of putting the fish farming on a Juche, modern, scientific, industrial and intensive basis. Accompanying him were Hwang Pyong So, Jo Yong Won, O Il Jong and Kim Yong Su, senior officials of the WPK Central Committee. Political News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Inspects Orangchon Power Station under Construction
body: The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un inspected the Orangchon Power Station under construction. He exchanged greetings with the officials who greeted him, appreciating their services. He said that he came to personally learn about the situation and take measures as the project has not yet been completed although it has been more than 30 years since President Kim Il Sung gave an instruction to build the power station. He first went round the construction site of the Phalhyang Dam. Pointing out that only 70 percent of the project has been done although it has been 17 years since the construction started, he acquainted himself with the reason of the delayed project. Now upper organs, in disregard of the situation of lower organs, only make a wordplay that the construction of the Orangchon Power Station is a task to be fulfilled in the period of the 5-year strategy for the national economic development, he said, pointing out that the Cabinet has only specified the project as a target project that should be accelerated with concentration of efforts in reports of its series of joint meetings or on the list of its stereotyped work plan but never taken any practical and blitz measure for economic and organizational work. He reprimanded the leading officials of the Cabinet for leaving the project to the province only and not paying attention to it. Worse still, the officials who are responsible for the national economy make their appearances in every inaugural ceremony of power stations though they never inspected the power stations and dams when they were under construction, he added. Noting that if the Orangchon Power Station is constructed, it will tangibly contribute to promoting the economy and people's livelihood in North Hamgyong Province where industrial establishments are located densely, he criticized the officials of the province and county for having not sent a letter to him in connection with the situation though they were much concerned of the delayed construction of the power station which is vital and urgent for the work of the province, and for having neither worked in a far-sighted manner nor focused their effort on the construction for the mere reason that it gives no immediate benefits but requires heavy investment. He took a revolutionary measure by giving an instruction for the Party Central Committee to provide organizational guidance to the construction of the dam and the power station by mobilizing all party organizations and members and thus complete the project by October 10 next year. Then, he went round the Orangchon Power Station No. 5. Watching generating equipment installed at the power station, he said highly efficient and modern generating equipment should be installed and operated in full capacity to steadily increase the production of electricity, pointing out that the power station was built with so much effort but it fails to produce electricity in full capacity. Noting that if the loss of electricity in transmission is decreased, electricity reserves equivalent to building some new power stations will be gained, he said produced electricity should be effectively used by taking a decisive measure to decrease the loss of electricity in transmission though it may require much effort. Noting that the builders of the power station have so far done much with pure conscience despite difficulties, whether their efforts are known or not, and the dam is growing thanks to the intense loyalty and inexhaustible strength of the builders who have performed labor feats for implementing the Party policy, he ardently called on the whole country to turn out in the general drive, keeping step with the builders. He was accompanied by Hwang Pyong So, Jo Yong Won, O Il Jong and Kim Yong Su, senior officials of the Workers' Party of Korea Central Committee. Political News Team

title: Amnesty to Be Granted in DPRK
body: The DPRK will grant an amnesty to those who had been convicted of the crimes against the country and people on the occasion of the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. The amnesty will take effect from Aug. 1. The DPRK Cabinet and relevant organs will take practical measures to help the released people settle down to normal working life. The Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK promulgated a decree in this regard on July 12. The decree said it is the intrinsic demand of Korean-style socialist system and the consistent principle of state activities to protect the independent and creative life of the popular masses and make selfless, devoted efforts for them by thoroughly applying the people-first principle, the most vivid expression of the Juche-oriented view on the people and people-centered philosophy. Rodong News Team

title: Japan Should Thoroughly Liquidate Crime-Woven Past
body: The Japanese politicians never let a chance pass by without advertising "abduction issue". What sought by Japan in persisting in talking about the worn-out "abduction issue" is to use the issue as an excuse for evading the liquidation of the past and a political slogan for the hostile policy toward the DPRK and reinvasion. Historically, Japan is an unprecedented abduction state which abducted and forcibly drafted numerous Koreans and maltreated and massacred them. All the abductions by the Japanese imperialists against the Korean people are thrice-cursed crimes unprecedented in history of mankind. The criminal forced drafting, abduction and forced labor of Koreans are serious encroachment upon human rights that severely and wantonly violated justice and morality of the international community and international laws regarding humanity and slavery. The world urges Japan to thoroughly liquidate the crime-woven past. However, Japan has evaded sincere apology and reparation since it was defeated. Never can Japan bury in oblivion of history the hideous crimes of abduction against the Korean nation. Japan should liquidate the past crimes as soon as possible. Ri Chol Hyok

title: British VIPs Leave
body: Jonathan Powell, former chief of Staff of Downing Street from the British Labor Party, and his party left Pyongyang for home on Tuesday. Rodong News Team

title: Vice-Chairman of C.C., WPK Meets New Indian Ambassador
body: Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea, on Tuesday met and had a talk with Atul Malhari Gotsurve, new Indian ambassador to the DPRK who paid a courtesy call on him. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Missions Visited by Foreign Delegations and Figures
body: Delegations of political parties and organizations and figures of various circles of foreign countries visited the DPRK missions in the relevant countries from July 4 to 8 on the occasion of the 24th anniversary of demise of President Kim Il Sung. They laid floral baskets and bouquets before portraits of smiling Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il and art pieces depicting them standing together and paid tribute to them. They included the delegations of the Funcinpec Party of Cambodia, People's Socialist Party of Mexico, Mexican Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, Mexican Friend Association for Memory of President Kim Il Sung and Leader Kim Jong Il and the Mexico-Korea Friendship Association, chairwoman and vice chairman of the Party for Peace and Unity of Russia, chairman of the Russian Association for Friendship and Cultural Cooperation with the DPRK, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Nepal Communist Party (Marxist-Leninist), chairman of the Nepal Journalist Association who doubles as chairman of the Nepal Journalist Association for the Study of the Juche Idea and Songun Politics, chairman of the Nepalese Association for Supporting the Songun Politics, secretary general of the Bangladesh Jatiya Party, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Socialist Party of Bangladesh, president of the Bangladesh People's League and chairman of the British Association for the Study of Songun Policy. Meanwhile, the National Executive Committee of the Workers' Party of Mexico sent a floral basket to the DPRK mission on July 8. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK's Founding Anniversary to Be Marked in Slovakia
body: A Slovak preparatory committee for celebrating the 70th founding anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea was formed in Bratislava on July 4. Ivan Draxler, chairman of the Slovakia-Korea Friendship Association and chairman of the Slovak Association for Supporting and Studying the Juche Idea, was elected as chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee decided to organize various political and cultural events such as a lecture and film show to introduce the successes being registered by the Korean people in building a powerful socialist country. Rodong News Team

title: Illegal Watch on Social Body Members Disclosed in S. Korea
body: A document disclosing the illegal watch on members of the Bar Association for Democratic Society by the judiciary authorities was opened to the public in south Korea, according to south Korean MBC on July 12. The document was worked out when Ryang Sung Thae held the post of the president of the Supreme Court. It deals in detail with sentiments of lawyers of the association, the processes of their decision making and their activities. Rodong News Team

title: Fact about Military's Illegal Watch on Civilians Disclosed in S. Korea
body: According to the south Korean MBC on July 13, it was disclosed that the Army Metropolitan Garrison Command illegally monitored the candlelight demonstrators urging the impeachment of traitor Park Geun Hye. The fact was verified and disclosed by journalists of MBC through a document "Chongwadae's scenario for coping with the demonstration" worked out by the command. Contained in the document was the fact that if candlelight demonstrators attempt to enter the proximity to Chongwadae, the military would suppress them. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung's Work Introduced in Algeria
body: The Tarzalt Publishing House in El-Djezair, Algeria brought out in booklet President Kim Il Sung's work "Let Us Achieve the Great Unity of Our Nation" on the occasion of the 24th anniversary of his demise. The work, published on August 1, Juche 80 (1991), says that the Korean nation is the driving force for reunification of the country, indicating the tasks and ways for achieving the great unity of the entire nation. A book-releasing ceremony took place on July 8. Rodong News Team

title: Koreans in China Observe 24th Anniversary of Kim Il Sung's Demise
body: The General Association of Koreans in China and its affiliated organizations held events on July 8, the 24th anniversary of President Kim Il Sung's demise. Floral baskets were laid at the statue of the President at Yuwen Middle School in Jilin with due ceremony. After laying the floral baskets in the name of the General Association and the Jilin Regional Association, the participants paid tribute to the President. Floral baskets were laid before the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il and the art works depicting their images at the DPRK embassy in Beijing and the DPRK consulate general in Shenyang of China by Choe Su Bong, first vice-chairman of the General Association, and officials of the General Association and its Zhongnan Regional Association. A remembrance meeting of the General Association took place in Shenyang City. Present there were officials and part-time officials of the General Association, members of the Shenyang City Branch of the Liaoning Regional Association and Korean citizens in China. Speeches were made there. Meanwhile, the Yanbian Regional Association of the General Association held a remembrance meeting. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Receives Gift from Russian Figure and Body
body: The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was presented with a gift jointly by the minister of Development of Far East of Russia and the Russian Basketball Association. The gift was conveyed to Ri Ryong Nam, vice-premier of the Cabinet of the DPRK, on a visit to Russia, by Alexandr Kozlov, minister of Development of Far East of Russia who doubles as chairman of the Russian side to the DPRK-Russia intergovernmental committee for cooperation in trade, economy, science and technology, on July 16. Rodong News Team

title: Philippine Party Delegation Feted
body: The Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) gave a reception for the visiting delegation of the PDP LABAN on Wednesday. Present there on invitation were members of the delegation led by Vice-President Lutgardo Barbo. Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the WPK Central Committee, Ryu Myong Son, vice department director of the C.C., WPK, and officials concerned were on hand. Speeches were made at the reception. Rodong News Team

title: Talks between Senior Officials of Korean and Philippine Parties
body: Talks between Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea, and Lutgardo Barbo, vice-president of the PDP LABAN, were held here on Wednesday. Present there from the WPK side were Ryu Myong Son, vice department director of the C.C., WPK, and officials concerned and from the opposite side members of a delegation of the PDP LABAN. At the talks both sides informed each other of their party activities and had an exchange of views on developing the relations between the two parties. Signed at the end of the talks was an agreement on cooperation between the two parities. Rodong News Team

title: Vice Foreign Minister of Russia Visits Liberation Tower
body: Igor Morgulov, vice foreign minister of the Russian Federation, and his party visited the Liberation Tower on Wednesday. They laid a bouquet at the foot of the tower and paid silent tribute to the memory of martyrs of the Soviet Army who laid down their lives in battles for Korea's liberation. They looked round the tower. Rodong News Team

title: PDP LABAN Delegation Here
body: A delegation of the PDP LABAN led by Vice-President Lutgardo Barbo arrived here on Wednesday. Rodong News Team

title: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of Great Leaders
body: Igor Morgulov, vice foreign minister of Russia, and his party visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on Wednesday. The guests laid a bunch of flowers at the statues of the great leaders and made a bow to them. Rodong News Team

title: Vice Foreign Minister of Russia Here
body: Vice Foreign Minister of the Russian Federation Igor Morgulov and his party arrived here Wednesday. Rodong News Team

title: National Games of Orphans-2018 Close
body: The national games of orphans-2018 closed with due ceremony at Phyongsong Middle School for Orphans on Wednesday. Announced were the team standings. South Phyongan Provincial team took the first place. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Friendship Delegation Returns
body: A friendship delegation led by Hong Sun Myong, vice-general director of the General Bureau of Public Catering Service and vice-chairman of the DPRK-China Friendship Association, returned home on Wednesday after visiting China. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung's Works Posted on Brazilian Website
body: The Brazilian Center for the Study of Songun Politics posted President Kim Il Sung's works "The Tasks of Communists in the Strengthening and Development of the Anti-Japanese National-Liberation Struggle" and "On the Mission and Basic Tasks of the Korean Revolutionary Army" on its website on July 11. The work "The Tasks of Communists in the Strengthening and Development of the Anti-Japanese National-Liberation Struggle" published on Feb. 27, Juche 25 (1936) sets forth the line on moving the main force of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army to the border areas and gradually extending the theatre of struggle into the homeland. It also advances the policy on expanding and developing the anti-Japanese national united front movement and accelerating the preparation for founding the party. The work "On the Mission and Basic Tasks of the Korean Revolutionary Army" published on July 6, Juche 19 (1930) indicates an important issue arising in launching an armed struggle in an organized manner, the mission and duty of the Korean Revolutionary Army and the tasks facing the young communists of new generation. The website carried art pieces depicting Kim Il Sung. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Premier Inspects Various Units in North Phyongan Province
body: Premier Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, inspected various units in North Phyongan Province. Going round the Sinuiju Cosmetics Factory, the Sinuiju Textile Mill, the Sinuiju Chemical Fibre Mill and various places in Sindo County, he underscored the need for those units to regard it as their primary task and lifeline to glorify the leadership exploits of the Party and concentrate efforts on doing so. Discussed at field consultative meetings were the issues of perfecting the modernization of production processes with recourse to advanced science and technology, turning factories into manpower-saving, technology-intensive ones and thoroughly establishing cultured ways of production and life, and the practical issues arising in increasing the reed production and further consolidating the material and technical foundation of Sindo County. Inspecting the Rakwon Machine Complex, the December 5 Youth Mine, the Sinuiju Dockyard, the Sinuiju Footwear Factory, the Sinuiju Spinning Machine Plant and other units, he urged them to conduct the guidance over production and management in a scientific and rational way, and mentioned measures for successfully attaining the goals of the five-year strategy for national economic development. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman of Jongyojo of S. Korea Starts Hunger Strike
body: The chairman of the Teachers' Union of south Korea (Jongyojo) started a hunger strike demanding the legitimate status of the union outside Chongwadae on July 16, according to the south Korean internet newspaper Jaju Sibo. He said that refusal to lift the outlawing of the union is little short of the intention to tolerate the abuse of "state power" by the Park Geun Hye regime and carry on the evil doings. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korean Online Paper on LKP
body: The south Korean online paper Voice of People on Tuesday carried an editorial titled "The Liberal Korea Party (LKP) has no reason to exist". The people have already declared the LKP defunct, the editorial said, adding: If the LKP truly hopes for its reform to meet the people's demand, it should have a will to get all its sitting lawmakers resigned and face the public judgment. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korea: Thorough Probe into Truth behind Military Coup Plot Demanded
body: The people's action for judging the massacres of civilians and fabrication of conspiracies by Chun Doo Hwan in south Korea held a press conference at the "National Assembly" on July 17 to demand a thorough-going probe into the illegal acts of the Defense Security Command, according to the south Korean internet newspaper Saram Ilbo. Speakers said that the special investigation group for the purpose of probing the truth behind the military coup plot of the Command was formed and started its work. They demanded a NA hearing for bringing the procedures for the probe into the truth by the investigation group to the knowledge of the people. They stressed that the Command has to be disbanded at any cost as it conducted the illegal surveillance of civilians and played a role of a political agency. Rodong News Team

title: Foreign Guests Visit Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: Foreign guests visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on Thursday. Among them were a delegation of the PDP LABAN led by Vice-President Lutgardo Barbo and a delegation of the Vietnam Academy of Social Sciences headed by Vice-President Pham Van Duc. They paid high tribute to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il in the palace. At the halls where the great leaders lie in state, the visitors made deep bow to them. They went round the halls where orders the great leaders received are on display and halls that house cars, electric car, boat and train coaches used by them for field guidance and foreign tours till the last moments of their lives. They made entries in the visitor's book. Rodong News Team

title: Cuban Embassy Officials Visit War Museum
body: Jesus Del Amo Fernandez, charge d'affaires ad interim of the Cuban embassy here, and staff members of the embassy visited the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum on Thursday on the occasion of the month of solidarity with the Cuban people. They went round various rooms of the museum comprehensively showing President Kim Il Sung's feats for war victory. After the visit the charge d'affaires ad interim made an entry in the visitor's book. Rodong News Team

title: Philippine Delegation Tours Pyongyang Teacher Training College
body: A delegation of the PDP LABAN led by Vice-President Lutgardo Barbo toured Pyongyang Teacher Training College on Thursday. Being briefed on the fact that the college turned into a pedigree establishment for training educationists, the guests went round the educational science exhibition house, primary school teaching method rehearsal room, room for disseminating technology for developing intellectual faculty of children and other parts of the college. They also visited the Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of DPRK Football Association Back Home
body: A delegation of the DPRK Football Association headed by Vice-Premier of the Cabinet Ri Ryong Nam, chairman of the association, returned home on Thursday after attending the closing ceremony of the 2018 FIFA World Cup in Russia. Rodong News Team

title: Military Copter Crashes in S. Korea
body: A military copter crashed in Phohang City, North Kyongsang Province of south Korea on July 17, according to south Korean KBS. The crash left five persons dead and one wounded. Rodong News Team

title: Vain Ambition and Prejudice Would Cause Unjust Result
body: The south Korean authorities of late said on several occasions that they brought about a "great turning point of history" such as the north's participation in the Winter Olympics, the visits of high-level special envoy, south-north summits and the DPRK-U.S. summit out of common understanding that the north's nuclear issue should be settled on the basis of solid south Korea-U.S. alliance. This is misrepresentation of facts and shows that they are brazen-faced enough to admire themselves. They talked such nonsense that they created an atmosphere of the international support for the settlement of "the north's nuclear issue" through an array of diplomatic steps with neighboring countries. Not content with it, they went the lengths of making impudent remarks that unless the DPRK and the U.S. keep the promise they made before the international community, they "would severely be tried". The severity of the situation lies in that it is the deliberate building up of public opinion pursuant to the south side's "state policy", not just the view of some media or scholars, and that the high-ranking authorities came out as key advocates. One is free to comment on things happening and express one's opinions but one-sided thought and prejudice would cause an unjust result and would be a crime of misrepresenting justice and truth. The situation urges us to again shed light on and analyze the "theory of driver of the Korean peninsula", a theory serving as a foundation of the thinking of the south Korean authorities, ground of their speech and guarantee of their action. Everyone knows how there was the dispatch of teams with mission for reunification and peace that shook Phyongchang with the thunderous hurrah for reunification in the wake of the appeal made by the illustrious great man on the New Year's Day to make this year an eventful year of great turn to be specially recorded in the nation's history, an appeal that moved the earth and heaven. How was it possible for the world to see the two historic north-south summits in just 29 days that ushered in a new era of independent reunification, peace and prosperity and resulted in all the high-level talks and sub-sector talks and all the undertakings in Kaesong Industrial Zone and Mt Kumgang. The historic moment when there was the DPRK-U.S. summit in Singapore brought with it a great breakthrough toward another new era, the era of DPRK-U.S. cooperation, breaking away all of sudden their hostile relations. This stark fact clearly proves how abnormal the south Korean authorities are to come out with the "theory of driver of the Korean peninsula". The south Korean authorities cry out for implementing the Panmunjom declaration at negotiating talks with us. But they have not yet taken any practical measures for the fundamental improvement of the north-south relations, reading the face of their American masters, thereby leaving important issues between the north and the south permanently pending. It is a principle clear from the past history that south Korea fails to play the role of even an assistant, to say nothing of the "driver", as it is caught in the evil cycle in which it has to flatter the one only to see the other repelling and in which it has to see the other interfere after it submits to the one. To make useless "admonition", being seized by the absurd "theory of driver", may cause trouble to the peace process on the Korean peninsula and bring sad results of offering the dishonest forces the opportunity to fish in troubled waters. The south Korean authorities are wearing a veil of the improvement of the relations because of the public opinion but they fail to discard the improper way of thinking belonging to the era of confrontation. Tied by the chain of submission and confrontation created by the outdated and ruined conservative forces, the present south Korean authorities fail to make a great set-out in the new starting line of history. We closely follow the remarks and actions of the south Korean authorities. Sporadic confrontation words heard from authorities of the Unification Ministry are also taken note of. They must not run amuck at such an important time as now, being hell-bent on meeting their political interests and maintaining their face. They would be well advised to come to their senses, though belatedly, and not to follow the outsiders but to opt for the road of independent reunification and By Our Nation Itself, as wished by the people. Herein lies their future. Kim Chun Sun

title: DPRK Player Wins in 2018 ITTF World Tour Korea Open
body: DPRK player Ham Yu Song placed first in the 2018 ITTF World Tour Korea Open. It started in Taejon of south Korea on July 17. It brought together more than 230 ace men and women players from 28 countries and regions including the DPRK, China, Singapore, Germany and Spain. At U-21 men's singles Ham Yu Song defeated his rivals in quarter finals and semi finals to advance into the finals. In the finals on July 18, Ham beat his Japanese rival 3:1, thus winning the first victory in the games. Rodong News Team

title: 70th Birthday of DPRK to Be Marked in Ethiopia
body: An Ethiopian preparatory committee for celebrating the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK was formed in Addis Ababa on July 9. Nigatu Dagnachew, chairman of the Ethiopian National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism and chairman of the Ethiopia-Korea Friendship and Solidarity Committee, was elected as chairman of the preparatory committee. The preparatory committee set a celebration period from July 21 to September 11 and decided to organize various events. Rodong News Team

title: Anniversary of Kim Il Sung's Demise Observed Abroad
body: Events were held in various countries from July 4 to 8 to observe the 24th anniversary of demise of President Kim Il Sung. They included a visit to the Kimilsungia Greenhouse in Guinea, a Korean book, photo and fine art exhibition in Venezuela, a book and photo exhibition in Indonesia and an exhibition in Britain. On display at their venues were photos showing the noble careers and exploits of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il and the personality of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un as the peerlessly great man. And there were works authored by the peerlessly great persons, books introducing socialist Korea and art works showing the creative wisdom and talents of the Korean nation. The chairman of the Guinean Society for the Study of the Juche Literary Idea said that Kim Il Sung is an outstanding thinker and theoretician who founded the undying Juche idea and statesman and tender-hearted father of the people. Kimilsungia shining with his august name is the flower representing all people's praise for him and his great exploits will remain long in history, the chairman added. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung Remembered Abroad
body: Remembrance meetings took place in Belarus, Romania, Thailand, Zimbabwe and Tanzania on July 7 and 8 to mark the 24th anniversary of demise of President Kim Il Sung. The chairman of the Permanent Standing Committee of the Belarus National Association of Friends of Korean People Named after Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il said that the President performed great feats before the Korean people and the world progressives and founded the immortal Juche idea and thoroughly applied it to the reality of the DPRK. The chairman of the Romanian Committee for Remembering Comrade Kim Il Sung said that the President is a distinguished statesman and the great leader in the 20th century as he devoted his all to the people's happiness, reunification of the country and development of the cause of socialism. The chairman of the Thai Committee for Remembering H.E. President Kim Il Sung said that he is always alive in the hearts of the Korean people and the progressive mankind as his exploits are very precious and great. A vice-chairperson of the Tanzanian National Coordinating Committee of the Juche Idea Study Groups noted that the progressive mankind is recollecting again the noble career and immortal exploits of the President. His idea and cause are now creditably carried forward by respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, the vice-chairperson added. Rodong News Team

title: Truth of Abduction Can Not Be Hidden
body: The truth behind the hideous crime, a group abduction of DPRK women citizens engineered by the Intelligence Service (IS) of south Korea at the instruction of the Park Geun Hye group, has been disclosed in south Korea once again. Some days ago, an official of the UN human rights told journalists about face-to-face meeting with abducted women employees. Noting that those taken away to south Korea did not know where they were going, the official said if it is true, the abduction should be regarded as a crime. Meanwhile, the then boss of restaurant, who was involved in the abduction operation of the south Korean conservative group, confessed in a phone press interview that the IS urged him to bring the women employees, threatening to reveal his cooperation with it. This was a farce invented by the Park Geun Hye group of traitors to tip the unfavorable political situation in its favor ahead of the “National Assembly” election in south Korea. What matters is the shameless attitude of the present south Korean authorities as they are shielding this crime of the past conservative regime, persistently denying it though its truth has been fully revealed. How to approach our citizens abducted by the Park Geun Hye group is like a touchstone showing the will of the south Korean authorities for the improvement of the north-south relations. If the repatriation of our women citizens is not settled at an early date, it may throw obstacles not only in the way of the reunion of separated families and relatives between the north and the south now high on agenda but also in the way of the north-south relations. The south Korean authorities should admit the unethical crimes of the Park Geun Hye conservative regime, though belatedly, and strictly probe the truth about the case and severely punish those involved. And they should send back Kim Ryon Hui and other women citizens of the DPRK now in custody without delay, thus showing the earnest will to implement the Panmunjom declaration. We will watch the future attitude of the south Korean authorities. Sim Chol Yong

title: Tribute Paid to Statues of Kim Il Sung, Kim Jong Il
body: A home-visiting group of students of Korean University run by the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan led by Kim Yang Sung visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on Saturday. Members of the group laid bunches of flowers at the statues of the great leaders and paid tribute to them. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to King of Belgium
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, on Saturday sent a message of greeting to Philippe, king of Belgium, on its national day. The message sincerely wished the Belgian people prosperity and happiness. Rodong News Team

title: Vietnamese Delegation Leaves
body: A delegation of the Vietnam Academy of Social Sciences led by Vice-President Pham Van Duc left Pyongyang for home on Saturday. Rodong News Team

title: National Taekwon-Do All-Star Tournament for Jonsung Cup Opens
body: The National Taekwon-Do All-Star Tournament for Jonsung Cup opened with due ceremony at the Taekwon-Do Hall in Pyongyang Friday on the occasion of the 65th anniversary of the great victory in the Fatherland Liberation War. In the tournament, players selected from Taekwon-Do teams at all levels, Korea University of Physical Education and Central Physical Training College will compete in Taekwon-Do and Paduk events. Attending the opening ceremony were Ri Il Hwan, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and vice-chairman of the National Sports Guidance Committee, Kim Yong Ho, secretary general of the Cabinet, Kim Chun Sik, secretary general of the National Sports Guidance Committee, officials concerned, sportspersons and working citizens. Kim Kyong Ho, chairman of the Korean Taekwon-Do Committee, made an address there. At the end of the ceremony, there was a demonstration by players of the Taekwon-Do Team of the Korean Taekwon-Do Committee. Rodong News Team

title: Vice Foreign Minister of Russia Leaves
body: Igor Morgulov, vice foreign minister of the Russian Federation, and his party left Pyongyang for home on Friday. During the stay they paid a courtesy call on Foreign Minister Ri Yong Ho of the DPRK and had talks with Choe Son Hui and Sin Hong Chol, vice-ministers of Foreign Affairs, respectively. Exchanged at the talks were in-depth views on the DPRK-Russia relations, the issue of building a peace-keeping mechanism on the Korean Peninsula and other issues of mutual concern. Rodong News Team

title: Philippine Party Delegation Leaves
body: A delegation of the PDP LABAN led by Vice-President Lutgardo Barbo left Pyongyang for home on Friday. Rodong News Team

title: Young Koreans in Japan Meet Former Unconverted Long-term Prisoner
body: A delegation of Korean youth and students in Japan led by Choe In A, department director of the Central Standing Committee of the Korean Youth League in Japan, on Friday met Hong Myong Gi, an indomitable pro-reunification patriotic fighter who was an unconverted long-term prisoner. Hong Myong Gi said that he could remain true to the revolutionary principle despite the untold sufferings in jail for decades as he kept in mind as his firm faith the truth that soldier's worthwhile life is guaranteed when following the Party and the leader. Under the warm loving care of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un who has the same noble revolutionary obligation and comradeship as those of the great leaders, the former unconverted long-term prisoners are enjoying an honorable life, he added. Choe In A said that they were greatly encouraged by the fighting spirit of the pro-reunification patriotic fighters who undauntedly fought to keep the oath they made before the leader and the country, adding that the new generations of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan would invariably keep to the road of Juche and patriotism with the unshakable faith that they are sure to win as they are guided by Kim Jong Un. There was an art performance at the meeting. Rodong News Team

title: Vietnamese Delegation Visits Revolutionary Museum of Kim Il Sung University
body: A delegation of the Vietnam Academy of Social Sciences headed by Vice-President Pham Van Duc visited the revolutionary museum of Kim Il Sung University. Being briefed on the immortal exploits of the peerlessly great persons, the guests went round various rooms of the museum. The delegation also toured the Tower of the Juche Idea, the Arch of Triumph, Pyongyang Teacher Training College and other places. Rodong News Team

title: Meeting of Korean Sportspersons in Japan
body: The 23rd meeting of the Korean Sportsmen’s Federation in Japan took place in Japan on July 14. Attending it were Pae Jin Gu, vice-chairman and director general of the General Affairs Department of the Central Standing Committee of Chongryon (the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan), Kim Song Hun, director of the Department for Publicity and Culture, Ri Chong Gyong, managing director of the Standing Council of the Federation, and other deputies. Read out there was a congratulatory message from the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un to the 24th Congress of Chongryon. A congratulatory message from the DPRK Ministry of Physical Culture and Sports was introduced. Ri Chong Gyong said in a report that during the period under review, Marshal Kim Jong Un made sure that sportspersons of Chongryon took part in the 7th National Conference of Sportspersons held in Pyongyang and received his letter “Let Us Usher in a New Golden Age of Building a Sports Power in the Revolutionary Spirit of Paektu” and that they had a photo taken with him. Ri noted that under the Marshal, officials and players of the Federation were awarded Kim Jong Il Youth Honor Prize and title of Merited Athlete, and lots of Chongryon players could compete in several international games to represent the homeland. Ri stressed that the officials and players of sports organizations in Japan would conduct diverse activities for the development of sports of the homeland and Chongryon. There were speeches. Han Yong Sam was selected as chairman of the Federation and Kim Jong Chi as managing director of its Standing Council. There was also an address by Pae Jin Gu. A letter to Kim Jong Un was read out at the meeting. Rodong News Team

title: Korean Social Scientists in Japan Meet
body: The 21st meeting of the Korean Social Scientists Association in Japan took place at Korean University of Chongryon (the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan) in Tokyo on July 14. Attending it were Ri Yong Su, chairman of the Central Standing Council of the Association, and other deputies. Read out there was a congratulatory message from the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un to the 24th Congress of Chongryon. Introduced was a congratulatory message from the DPRK Academy of Social Sciences. Ri Yong Su noted in a report that in the period under review Marshal Kim Jong Un saw to it that Korean social scientists in Japan were awarded academic degrees and titles and high state commendations of the DPRK including professorship and doctorate and that a delegation of the Association attended the 3rd National Conference of Social Scientists and its head took the floor at the conference. The reporter stressed the need to further strengthen the Association organizationally and ideologically as required by a new era of Juche cause, the great era of Kim Jong Un, and contribute to accelerating the patriotic advance for hastening a new heyday of the movement of Koreans in Japan with signal research successes. Then there were speeches. Ri Yong Su was reelected as the chairman of the Association Central Standing Council at the meeting. A letter to Kim Jong Un was read out there. Rodong News Team

title: North-South Single Team Wins Gold Medal at 2018 ITTF World Tour Korea Open
body: A single team of the north and the south of Korea took the first place at mixed doubles of the 2018 ITTF World Tour Korea Open. Table-tennis players of the north and the south played at doubles as single team. Cha Hyo Sim and Jang U Jin from the north and the south defeated all their rivals to gain the final berth at the mixed doubles. They defeated their Chinese rivals 3:1 to take the first place on July 21. Rodong News Team

title: Park Geun Hye Sentenced Again
body: The Seoul Central District Court sentenced again traitor Park Geun Hye to 8 years in jail on charge of irregularities and corruption on July 20, according to the south Korean MBC. Park was sentenced to 24 years in prison and was decided to be fined at the first hearing for influence-peddling case. So, her jail terms increased to 32 years. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Inspects Kangwon Provincial Tree Nursery
body: The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un inspected the Kangwon Provincial Tree Nursery. He went round various places of the nursery. When he inspected the Tree Nursery No.122 run by the Korean People's Army, in which the production of tree saplings is put on a perfect scientific, industrial and intensive basis, two years ago, the Supreme Leader advanced the tasks for each province to build a modern land-saving and manpower-saving tree nursery capable of turning out twenty millions of saplings a year like the Tree Nursery No.122 and make the Kangwon provincial tree nursery a model and standard of nurseries to be built in provinces. And he took such detailed measures as provision of designing, construction, funds, materials and equipment and has wisely guided the work for building tree nurseries. Expressing great pleasure over the fact that another large-scale base capable of producing more than twenty millions of saplings a year was successfully built, he noted with high appreciation that Kangwon Province completed a huge project in a short span of time and properly took measures for matters arising in managing and operating the tree nursery in the last one year and thus built up a material and technical foundation for safe production of saplings.
