Saying that the rich forest resources are a precious asset for economic construction, he stressed it is necessary to build the tree nursery, which is like an arsenal for the forest restoration campaign for turning all the mountains in the province into gold mountains and natural raw material base, as a grand edifice of eternal value impeccable in the distant future, too, and to produce saplings on a large scale. Noting that if the newly-built imposing tree nursery fails to produce tree saplings to its full capacity, it will be of no use, he called for putting the production of saplings on a higher scientific basis, ensuring two rounds of production in a year and thus producing and supplying more saplings of good species which are of high economic and ornamental value and suited to the climatic and soil conditions of the province to substantially benefit from tree planting and make them prove effective. He called for finishing at an early date the construction of tree nurseries now underway in provinces on the basis of the achievements and experience gained in building a model nursery which has put the production of saplings on a higher scientific, industrial and intensive basis. He stressed the need to conduct on a regular basis the technical study through sci-tech learning space and set up experience-exchange and tele-consultation system among tree nurseries so as to further raise the level of technology and skills of the employees and actively develop and perfect the advanced sapling cultivation technology. Noting that administrative building, conference hall, general amenities and dwelling houses of employees were built at the same high level as those built by a central professional construction unit, he stressed the need to meet the requirements of the developing times and suit the level of high civilization as desired by the people even in building a dwelling house. He visited a house of discharged couple who are employees of the nursery on that day where he talked to them to take good care of their life. Saying that he was very satisfied to go round the nursery, he pointed out that the people in Kangwon Province have distinguished fighting spirit and mental world as they take the lead in upholding the Party's calls with devotion and are ready to turn out as one in the drive for implementing the Party policies. He added that he could not but admire them for building such a huge nursery under difficult conditions where everything is in need, and that he is pleasing to give assignments to the Kangwon Provincial Party Committee as it always takes the lead in implementing the Party policies and he wants to help even a bit its officials exerting themselves to do even one more thing. He took such warm solicitude of making sure that problems urgent for the economic work of the province are solved on the spot. He had a photo session with the officials and employees of the nursery, expressing belief that they would put the production of tree saplings on a high-level and regular basis with high sense of responsibility of being outpost and scout men in charge of the forest restoration campaign and thus make active contribution to turning the whole country into thick woodland. He was accompanied by Hwang Pyong So, Han Kwang Sang and Jo Yong Won, senior officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Political News Team

title: Swimming Contest of Public Officials Held
body: There took place a swimming contest of officials of commissions, ministries and national institutions from July 16 to 23 at the swimming pool of the Changgwang Health Complex on the occasion of the months for maritime physical culture, July and August. The participants, divided into four groups, had team and individual games. Winners in team games are those of the Ministry of Fisheries, the Foreign Trade Bank, the Moran Guidance Bureau and the Cheyuk Sinmun Office. In individual games, players from the Central Committee of the Journalists Union of Korea, the Foreign Languages Publishing House and the State Planning Commission came first respectively. Rodong News Team

title: 7th National Exhibition of 206 Sundry Goods Opens
body: The 7th National Exhibition of 206 Sundry Goods opened with due ceremony at the exhibition of consumer goods under the Ministry of Local Industry in Pyongyang on Monday. The exhibition will show achievements and experience gained in the production of sundry goods. On display there are more than 8 000 products of 300 kinds made at units under ministries, national institutions and provincial local industrial management bureaus and other units producing sundry products and daily necessities. The exhibits include cooking tools, electric and electronic goods and school things. During the exhibition there will be a workshop related to the production of 206 sundry goods and tours of the Pyongyang Bag Factory, etc. The exhibition will last till July 26. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of Korean Youth and Students in Japan Visits Mangyongdae
body: A delegation of Korean youth and students in Japan led by Choe In A, department director of the Central Standing Committee of the Korean Youth League in Japan, visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. They went round the Mangyongdae Revolutionary Museum where historical data and relics associated with the revolutionary activities of the President and his family members are on display. At the old home of the President in Mangyongdae they looked back upon his revolutionary career. The delegation also visited the Korean Revolution Museum, the Youth Movement Museum, etc. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Egyptian President
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, on Monday sent a message of greeting to Abdel Fattah al-Sisi, president of the Arab Republic of Egypt, on the anniversary of the July 23 revolution in Egypt. The message expressed the belief that the historic and traditional ties of friendship and cooperation between the DPRK and Egypt would invariably develop. And it wished the Egyptian people bigger progress and prosperity in their efforts for the country's stability and economic development under the correct guidance of the president. Rodong News Team

title: Park Geun Hye, Her Accomplices Should Be Severely Punished: Swiss Organizations
body: The Switzerland-Korea Committee and the Swiss Group for the Study of the Juche Idea released a joint statement on July 15 as regards the fact that the Park Geun Hye group's attempt at the barbarous armed suppression of peaceful candlelight demonstrators was disclosed. The statement said: Shortly ago, disclosed was the fact that traitor Park Geun Hye hatched a plot to suppress with armed forces the peaceful candlelight demonstration of the south Korean people who stood against her fascist and corrupt rule in south Korea. According to it, opening fire on demonstrators was also planned. Had the impeachment of Park Geun Hye been dismissed, there would have been the second Kwangju massacre in downtown Seoul. The statement called for severely punishing Park Geun Hye and her accomplices, expressing great indignation over the barbarous plot. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK's Founding Anniversary to Be Marked in Slovenia
body: A Slovenian preparatory committee for celebrating the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK was formed in Maribor City on July 15. Igor Jurisic, chairman of the Slovenia-Korea Friendship Association, was elected as chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee set the celebration period from July 20 to September 30 and decided to organize colorful political and cultural events praising exploits performed by President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il for the foundation of the DPRK and its development. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Inspects KPA Factory No. 525
body: The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un inspected Factory No. 525 of the Korean People's Army. He looked round the room for education in the revolutionary history at the factory first. He said that the officials and employees of the factory should always overfulfill the production plan on all indices, bearing in mind the noble intention of leader Kim Jong Il who spared nothing for the soldiers of the People's Army, and thus make sure that they still feel his loving care. He learnt in detail about the implementation of the teachings given by Kim Jong Il during his on-the-spot guidance and the production at the factory and the supply of raw materials in recent years. Highly appreciating the fact that the factory has over-fulfilled its plan every year, he said that it should direct its efforts to producing in a larger quantity various condiments of good taste to meet the demand of the science of nutrition and thus substantially contribute to improving the diet of the servicepersons. He went round the fermented soybean liquid spore production process newly built at the factory. Saying that it is necessary to provide the servicepersons with various soybean-based foods in line with the soybean production that has increased after the whole army gave foremost importance to soybean farming and, in particular, with fermented soybean good for eating and health on a regular basis, he stressed it is a great success that the factory is equipped with modern process capable of mass-producing the quality liquid spore for fermented soybean on an industrial basis. Going round various parts of the factory including the condiment workshop and the rice-cleaning workshop, he said that he heard it was upgraded three years ago and it is an impeccable and praiseworthy factory with all production processes put on an automated and unmanned basis at a high level and he was very pleased to see the equipment in full-capacity operation and production put on a normal track when he suddenly visited the factory. He highly estimated the master-like work attitude of the factory officials and employees, saying that the greening and pavement of the factory are satisfactory and they have put the interior and exterior of the factory on a hygienic and cultured level in an assiduous way as befitting foodstuff factory. He set forth the tasks for scrupulously managing equipment and improving technical control and for working hard with higher goal of putting the production processes on an automated, unmanned and germ-free basis. He had a photo session with the officials and employees of the factory, expressing the expectation and conviction that they would continue to make proud achievements in production to supply servicepersons with variety of tasty and highly nutritious foodstuffs in a larger quantity and thus perform a pioneer role in developing the foodstuff industry of the country in the future, too. He was accompanied by Hwang Pyong So, Han Kwang Sang and Jo Yong Won, senior officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Political News Team

title: WPK Delegation Leaves for African Countries
body: A delegation of the Workers' Party of Korea led by Ryu Myong Son, vice department director of its Central Committee, left Pyongyang Monday to visit the Republic of Equatorial Guinea and the Republic of Guinea. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of Korean Youth and Students in Japan Leaves
body: A delegation of Korean youth and students in Japan led by Choe In A, department director of the Central Standing Committee of the Korean Youth League in Japan, left Pyongyang Tuesday. Rodong News Team

title: Lawmaker from LKP of S. Korea to Serve Prison Term
body: Ri U Hyon, a lawmaker from the “Liberal Korea Party” of south Korea, was sentenced to seven years in prison at the first court hearing on July 19 for taking bribes of more than 1 billion won, according to the south Korean News 1. The accused reportedly didn’t miss the chance of grabbing money by prodding his assistant, and forced him to make a false testimony when he was detained recently. Rodong News Team

title: 5th National Conference of War Veterans to Be Held in DPRK
body: The 5th National Conference of War Veterans is to be held in Pyongyang on the occasion of the 65th anniversary of the victory of the Korean people in the great Fatherland Liberation War. Taking part in the conference will be war veterans across the country who honorably defended the dignity and sovereignty of the country and made a miraculous victory in the war. Rodong News Team

title: Pak Pong Ju Inspects Industrial Establishments
body: Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers’ party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, inspected the Pyongyang Wheat Flour Processing Factory and the Kumsong Tractor Factory. Going round the wheat flour processing factory, he encouraged its officials and workers in their drive to improve the people’s living standard, and discussed the issues arising in supply of raw materials and processing. At a consultative meeting measures were taken to ensure automated and streamlined production process to produce more tasty and nutritious wheat flour processed goods under the motto of self-reliance and self-sufficiency. At the tractor factory the premier discussed the issue of turning the factory into a manpower-saving, technology-intensive factory as befitting the unit visited by the great leaders, the issue of making the relevant units take thorough measures for fully supplying raw materials to the factory and the issue of decisively raising the quality of machine products. Rodong News Team

title: Japanese Reactionaries’ Terrorism against Chongryon
body: Some hooligans of Japan seriously broke the window of the front door of the Korean kindergarten in Tsurumi under the Kanagawa Prefectural Headquarters of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) at dawn of July 18. This case was not accidental at all as it was caused directly by the Abe regime’s hostile policy toward the DPRK and Chongryon, not merely by some intruders. The case is, in essence, similar to the shooting spree case which occurred outside the Chongryon Central Hall in February, and unpardonable act of terrorism. The DPRK can never overlook the fact that the life and security of children of the Koreans in Japan are exposed to a serious threat by the Japanese reactionaries. To socially protect children is an elementary issue pertaining to humanitarianism. Threat to their life is strictly banned under international law. However, the Japanese reactionaries even stretch their tentacles of crime to children, not content with committing utterly base evil deeds against the organizations of Chongryon and Koreans in Japan. This is just the height of atrocities against human rights, which can be perpetrated only by the despicable dastards of an island country. The DPRK will closely watch how the Japanese regime probes the truth and punishes those behind the case and takes a step for preventing its reoccurrence. Pak Chol Jun

title: Kim Jong Un Visits Songdowon General Foodstuff Factory
body: The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, together with Ri Sol Ju, gave field guidance to the Songdowon General Foodstuff Factory. Going round various production processes of the factory after hearing the explanation at the room dedicated to its history, he learned in detail about the technical facilities and production. Watching various foodstuffs being churned out at the worksites with food processing facilities in rows, he noted with high appreciation that the factory works hard to modernize production processes and improve the quality of products and thus has over-fulfilled its plan every year while mass-producing the products that the people highly demand and like. Watching each kind of foodstuff produced by the factory, he said that recently the level of product packaging and trademark design has been improved remarkably in the field of the foodstuff industry, adding that the varieties of foodstuffs being produced by the factory are numerous and diverse and the packaging is diverse and its level is very high. Saying it is very good that the products of the factory are supplied to the whole country as well as to the province and they were appreciated as being not inferior to the products of central foodstuff factories, he called for conducting active competition among foodstuff factories across the country and thus bringing about a surge in production and expanding successes through a drive in which one learns from others and overtakes others. Stressing the need to ensure the strict and correct inspection of quality and control over foodstuffs of different storage conditions in keeping with the increasing varieties of products, he said that in particular, it is necessary to strengthen the product inspection system for thoroughly guaranteeing the quality and hygiene security of the foodstuffs and medicine which have direct impact on the health and life of people and to improve and modernize the inspection method and means. Saying that the factory should push ahead with the modernization drive for putting more perfectly all production processes on an automated, unmanned and germ-free basis, holding aloft the banner of self-reliance and relying on our own technical force, materials and equipment and thus turn itself into a production base with Juche character which is operated with locally available raw materials, he stressed the need to set a correct long-term goal and make tenacious efforts to attain it. He said that the sci-tech learning space should be effectively operated to prepare the employees to be knowledge-based working people so that they do their shares in technical updating of production processes and modernization of equipment and to make sure that new ideas of technical innovations and original concepts are produced from among the producer masses. He had a photo session with the officials and employees of the factory, after voicing his expectation and conviction that they would conduct the management activities well and produce more quality foodstuffs and thus more fully demonstrate the honor of being a factory loved by the people and a factory serving them. He was accompanied by Hang Kwang Sang and Jo Yong Won, leading officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Political News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Visits Wonsan Disabled Soldiers' Bag Factory
body: The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, together with Ri Sol Ju, gave field guidance to the Wonsan Disabled Soldiers' Bag Factory. Going round several places of the factory, he learned in detail about the production of schoolbags. Now it is necessary to direct efforts to raising the quality of schoolbags as material and technical foundations have been satisfactorily laid for producing hundreds of thousands of schoolbags in each province, he said, stressing the need for the bag factories in provinces to conduct proper quality control over products, raise demand and thus put the schoolbags supplied to children and students of the whole country on the same qualitative level. He underlined the need for central organs to work out a plan for the responsible supply of raw and other materials for the production of bags including canvas, zipper, tape, synthetic leather, metal fixtures and plastic processed goods to make sure that the production is put on a regular basis at bag factories built in provinces. It is the intention of our Party to provide our children and students with quality notebooks, schoolbags, school things and school uniforms made in the country so as to make them cherish patriotism of taking their own things dear to them and loving them since their childhood, he said, repeatedly asking the official and employees of bag factories across the country to work heart and soul with devotion to ensure the quality of bags just as they would make bags for their own children. He stressed the need for the employees to put precedence to the work of enhancing the technical skill, strictly abide by the requirements of technical regulations in every production process, conduct technical exchanges among bag factories, learn with each other and brainstorm ideas in effecting a surge and innovation to improve the quality of bags. He had a photo session with the officials and employees of the Wonsan Disabled Soldiers' Bag Factory, highly appreciating their strenuous efforts to put the production going on at a high rate after building the factory to be proud of with their own efforts, technology and materials in a short time. Stressing the importance to value, respect and take good care of disabled soldiers, he asked the provincial party committee to help the factory with deep care so that they can devote their sweats of sincere labor in their worthwhile and honorable work for the future generations and thus continue to keep the revolution flourishing. Accompanying him were Han Kwang Sang and Jo Yong Won, senior officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Political News Team

title: Childish Act of Those in Awkward Position
body: Japanese Foreign Minister Kono, during his recent visits to different countries, cried out for keeping on imposing sanctions on the DPRK and forcing it to settle the abduction issue. He, at talks with his Malaysian counterpart, begged for cooperating with Japan in resolving the abduction issue, emphasizing the uninterrupted sanctions on the DPRK. When meeting his French counterpart in Paris Kono stressed the need to maintain economic sanctions against the DPRK. It is a childish and sinister act of the Japanese reactionaries persistently seeking to block the trend of the favorable situation prevailing in the Korean peninsula and get rid of the position of “passing Japan”. The Abe group is more persistently resorting to the moves for imposing sanctions and pressure on the DPRK. It is the ulterior intention of guys of an island nation to propel arms buildup and achieve the ambition for reinvasion under the pretext of the “threat” from the DPRK. It is the trite method of the Japanese reactionaries to draw water to their mill by hurting others whenever they are placed in a difficult position at home and abroad owing to their serious ruling crisis. The Japanese reactionaries, who are isolated from the public at home and abroad, are trying to reverse the trend of the situation in the region through the sordid act of making other countries join in cooperation for pressurizing the DPRK and attain their ambition to become a military giant at any cost. However, the Abe group’s reckless act is foolish as it will make them all the more isolated in the international political arena. If Japan keeps on behaving spitefully, it will be all the more isolated and rejected. The Abe group had better bear it in mind and behave themselves, though belatedly. Ri Hyon Do

title: Bourgeois Democracy Is Phony
body: The imperialists and reactionaries persistently tout “democracy” in capitalist society and “advantages” of bourgeois democracy, but it is sophism to cover up the reactionary and unpopular nature of the bourgeois dictatorship and the true colors of capitalist society going downhill. Bourgeois democracy, “democracy” in capitalist society, is not a genuine one. Democracy is politics which comprehends the will of the working popular masses. It is just democracy that a state makes policies in accordance with the will of workers, peasants and broad working people, implements them in their interests and substantially provides the popular masses with genuine freedom and rights and a happy life. Capitalism is a society where a tiny minority of exploiting classes holding privileged status rules a majority. Regime and means of production are gripped by the exploiting classes and all the state policies are under their control. It is obvious that “democracy” in capitalist society can’t be the one for the popular masses. Bourgeois democracy is for a minority of privileged circle and it is not democracy in the original meaning. If democracy exists in capitalist society, it is just “democracy” for the good of the rich and a minority of the exploiting classes. No matter how hard the imperialists wag their tongue to hurt socialist democracy, they can never sweep the unpopular nature of the bourgeois democracy and the corrupt nature of the capitalist system under the carpet. Ri Hak Nam

title: National Sci-Tech Presentation in Field of Mining Industry
body: A national sci-tech presentation in the field of mining industry took place at the Unpha Mine on July 24-25 under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea. Present there were officials, researchers, technicians, teachers and graduate students of various units including the Ministry of Mining Industry, the Central Mining Research Institute and the Ferrous Mining Research Institute of the State Academy of Sciences and Kim Chaek University of Technology. Presented to it, divided into excavating and dressing panels, were more than 100 valuable papers on research achievements conducive to developing the country’s mining industry. There were also a lecture and a video show on sci-tech successes and experience gained in increasing the rate of ore-mining and the tunneling speed and improving the technical indexes of ore dressing. Rodong News Team

title: War Veterans and Women’s Union Officials and Members Meet
body: Officials and members of the Socialist Women’s Union of Korea (SWUK) had a meeting with a war veteran at the Hall of Women on Tuesday to mark the 65th anniversary of the victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War. Present there were Jang Chun Sil, chairwoman of the C.C., SWUK, officials concerned and officials and members of the union. Labor Hero Jon Ku Gang, a lecturer at the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum, spoke at the meeting. She talked about the war days when they won victories on battlefields under the guidance of President Kim Il Sung. Noting that she had lived in the grief and agony as a member of the stateless nation, she said she became a student under the care of Kim Il Sung after the liberation of the country. She went to the war front and fought as a medical officer to defend the beloved homeland, she added. The ever-victorious history and traditions created by President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il invariably continue as the Korean revolution is guided by the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, another illustrious commander, she said. She requested all the officials and members of the women’s union to fully display the mettle of the heroic Korean women in the efforts to implement the decision of the April Plenary Meeting of the Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea. Rodong News Team

title: Seminar of Social Scientists Held
body: A seminar of social scientists was held at the Korean Revolution Museum on Tuesday to mark the 65th anniversary of the victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War. Made public at the seminar were papers explaining the revolutionary exploits of President Kim Il Sung, who organized and led the Fatherland Liberation War to victory, and his wise leadership and the heroic spirit displayed by the Korean army and people in defending their motherland. Speakers said that the victory in the Fatherland Liberation War was a military miracle brought by Kim Il Sung’s original military idea, adroit and preeminent strategy and tactics and distinguished commanding art. They stressed that Kim Il Sung was the sun of life, the future of Korea and the banner of victory to the defenders of the country in the 1950s. They called for more deeply grasping his exploits for the war victory and making positive contribution to the steady continuity of Juche Korea’s tradition of victory under the guidance of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Present at the seminar were Ri Hye Jong, president of the Academy of Social Sciences, teachers, researchers, lecturers, journalists, editors and officials in the fields of science, education, media, preservation of revolutionary relics and party cadre training institutions. Rodong News Team

title: Performance of Vocal and Instrumental Solo Contest Winners Given
body: A performance of winners in the national vocal and instrumental solo contest of youth and students for celebrating the 65th anniversary of the victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War was given at the Central Youth Hall on Tuesday. At the performance which began with chorus “Cantata to Marshal Kim Il Sung” and “Long Live Generalissimo Kim Il Sung”, the performers sang loudly of President Kim Il Sung’s feats for the war victory. They well represented the fighting spirit of heroic soldiers in the 1950s in violin solo “To a Decisive Battle” and male solo “My Song in the Trench”. Also staged were numbers showing the struggle and optimistic life of the people in the rear who devoted their all to the victory in the war as well as the will of the young vanguard to display the wisdom and bravery of youth in defending the country and building a powerful socialist nation by inheriting the spirit of the generation who won the war. Among the audience were Pak Chol Min, first secretary of the Central Committee of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League, youth league officials and youth and students. Rodong News Team

title: Congratulations to Kim Jong Un from Military Attaches Corps
body: The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a floral basket and a congratulatory letter from the military attaches corps here ahead of the 65th anniversary of the victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War. On behalf of the corps, Vietnamese Military Attache Nguyen Quoc Viet handed over the floral basket and letter to Army General No Kwang Chol, minister of the People’s Armed Forces, on Wednesday. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Visits CPV Martyrs Cemetery
body: The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un visited the Martyrs Cemetery of the Chinese People's Volunteers in Hoechang County, South Phyongan Province to lay a wreath on the occasion of the 65th anniversary of the victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War. Present at wreath-laying ceremony were Ri Su Yong, Kim Yong Chol, Ri Yong Ho and No Kwang Chol. Laid at the martyrs tower of the CPV were a wreath in the name of Kim Jong Un and a wreath in the joint name of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, the Central Military Commission of the WPK, and the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK. The Supreme Leader paid a silent tribute to the martyrs of the CPV in memory of them. Then, wreaths in the name of Kim Jong Un and in the joint name of the C.C., WPK, CMC of the WPK, and SAC of the DPRK were laid at the grave of Mao Anying. He paid a silent tribute to Mao Anying in memory of him. He went round graves of the martyrs of the CPV. He said with deep emotion that during the last Fatherland Liberation War, the party, government and people of China dispatched their fine sons and daughters to the Korean front without hesitation despite many difficulties in the early period of building a country to help the Korean people in their cause of justice at the cost of blood and made an immortal contribution to the victory in the war. The blood of the Chinese comrades permeated the mountains and streams, trees and plants on this land and the soul of the Korean revolutionaries settled on the vast land of China, he said, adding the DPRK-China relations are developing into special and durable friendly relations unprecedented in history as they were forged in firm militant friendship and genuine trust deepened at the cost of blood and life, not merely for the reason that the two countries are geographically close with each other. Noting that the feats the Chinese comrades performed by defending the just cause at the risk of their lives and achieving peace at the cost of their blood when the Korean people faced the hardest dead-or-alive situation will always remain in the hearts of the Korean people, he said that the Korean people would as ever take pride in having the creditable fraternal country and the great friend like the People's Republic of China. Saying that it is the due responsibility, moral sense of obligation and noble mission of the Korean people to add eternal luster to the exploits performed by the service personnel of the Chinese People's Volunteers who found themselves on the Korean front and displayed matchless bravery and self-sacrificing spirit, he underlined the need to spruce up and keep better the cemeteries of the martyrs of the CPV across the country in a sincere manner as their own flesh and blood would do. Political News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Has Photo Session with Participants in War Veterans Conference
body: The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un met the participants in the 5th National Conference of War Veterans and had a photo session with them in front of the Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery. Kim Jong Un came out at the photographing venue and warmly waved back to the war veterans. He made a deep bow to all the war veterans, saying that as there were the undying feats of the defenders of the country in the 1950s who bravely fought with the burning loyalty and ardent patriotism for the Party and the country to bring about the victory day of July 27, our Republic is now dynamically advancing toward the high eminence of a powerful socialist country while demonstrating its might as a dignified people's country. He had a photo session with the participants in the conference, voicing his expectation that the war veterans, benefactors who defended the country at the cost of their blood would remain full of energy despite advanced age and glorify their life as admirable teachers and educators instilling the same spirit of defending the country and the revolution as the heroic soldiers of the 1950s had into the hearts of the future generations. Political News Team

title: Kim Jong Un Visits Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery
body: The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un visited the Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery and paid homage to martyrs of the People's Army on Thursday on the occasion of the 65th anniversary of the victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War. He was accompanied by Army General Kim Su Gil, director of the General Political Bureau of the Korean People's Army, Army General Ri Yong Gil, chief of the KPA General Staff, Army General No Kwang Chol, minister of the People's Armed Forces, and war veterans Yang Hyong Sop, Ri Myong Su and Thae Jong Su. The Patriotic Song was played and amid the playing of the wreath-laying music, the wreath in the name of the Supreme Leader was placed. The Supreme Leader observed a moment's silence in memory of the martyrs who laid down their precious lives for the sacred war for the Party, the revolution, the country and the people. He said that the indomitable fighting spirit and the heroic feats of the Fatherland Liberation War martyrs who devotedly defended the Party, the revolution, the country and the people will shine long in the history of the country, expressing the conviction that all the service personnel of the KPA, party members and working people and the new generations would creditably carry forward the history and traditions of sure victory of powerful and dignified socialist Korea. Political News Team

title: Dancing Parties of Youth and Students Mark V-Day
body: A dancing party of youth and students was staged at Kim Il Sung Square on Friday, the 65th anniversary of the victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War. When the song "Long Live Generalissimo Kim Il Sung" resounded through the square, the participants presented a sea of dance in token of their highest tribute and eternal glory to President Kim Il Sung. To the tunes of songs "Let's Meet Each Other on the Front" and "Song of Youth", they enthusiastically danced with the zeal to fully demonstrate their wisdom and bravery at every site for defending the country and building a powerful socialist nation by carrying forward the strong spirit of the generation who won the victory in the war. The atmosphere reached its climax when the songs "Our Leader Loved by People" and "His Embrace Is the Best" were played to reflect the high pride and confidence of the members of the youth vanguard who are holding the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in high esteem. Similar dancing parties were also held in provincial seats, cities and counties on Friday. Rodong News Team

title: V-Day Marked in DPRK
body: The 65th anniversary of the victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War was significantly celebrated in the DPRK. People visited the plaza of the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the sacred temple of Juche where President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il lie in state, to pay tribute to the portraits of the smiling great leaders. Servicepersons, working people and school youth and children called at the martyrs' statues and cemeteries and the memorial towers for the fallen soldiers of the Korean People's Army and martyrs' graves across the country to pay tribute to the victors in the great years. Art performances were given in Pyongyang and localities to celebrate the V-Day. Artistes of the National Symphony Orchestra put on the stage orchestra "Cantata to Marshal Kim Il Sung", string ensemble "The Leader Has Come to Our Post", orchestras "Mungyong Pass" and "July 27 March" and other numbers. Those of the Phibada Opera Troupe and the National Folk Art Troupe gave their performances before the Pyongyang Grand Theatre and at the Ponghwa Art Theatre, revving up the festive atmosphere. Circus and magic performances were given at the Pyongyang Circus Theater and the jugglery theatre of the National Acrobatic Troupe and a one-act play at the National Theatre. Celebration performances of provincial art troupes and art squads were given in North and South Phyongan, Jagang, South Hamgyong and other provinces. There was also a stage of wartime songs performed by workers and trade union members of South Hwanghae Province. Rodong News Team

title: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of Great Leaders on V-Day
body: Servicepersons and civilians of the DPRK visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il across the country to pay homage on the occasion of the 65th anniversary of the victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War. Seen standing before the statues of the great leaders on Mansu Hill was a floral basket from the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Floral baskets in the names of party, armed forces and power organs, social bodies, ministries, national institutions, units of the Korean People's Army and the Korean People's Internal Security Forces, various organs, enterprises, factories and schools in Pyongyang and bouquets were laid before the statues. The participants paid tribute to the statues. Also, floral baskets in the names of units of KPA and KPISF, institutions, enterprises, etc. as well as bouquets and flowers were laid before the great leaders' statues in various parts of Pyongyang including Kim Il Sung University, the Ministry of the People's Armed Forces, the Ministry of People's Security and the Mansudae Art Studio. Meanwhile, servicepersons, working people and school youth and children across the country visited the statues and mosaics depicting the great leaders' smiling images in their residential quarters to pay high tribute to them. Rodong News Team

title: National Taekwon-Do All-Star Tournament Closes
body: The National Taekwon-Do All-Star Tournament for Jonsung Cup closed with due ceremony at the Taekwon-Do Hall on Friday. The ceremony was attended by Choe Hwi, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the National Sports Guidance Committee, Kim Chun Sik, secretary general of the National Sports Guidance Committee, officials concerned, sports persons and working people. The Korean Taekwon-Do Committee Team (men) and the Pyongyang City Taekwon-Do Team (women) took the first place in the Taekwon-Do open-weight sparring event. The South Phyongan Provincial Taekwon-Do Team (men) and the Pyongyang City Taekwon-Do Team (women) came first in the team sparring. The first place in the body-weight individual sparring was taken by men players from the Jagang Provincial Taekwon-Do Team, the Korean Taekwon-Do Committee Team and Central Sports School and women players from the Pyongyang City Taekwon-Do Team, the Korean Taekwon-Do Committee Team and the Jagang Provincial Taekwon-Do Team. In the Paduk games, men and women players from the team of the Korean Taekwon-Do Committee placed first in individual events and players of the Pyongyang City Taekwon-Do Team in the mixed doubles. The Pyongyang City Taekwon-Do Team won in the men's doubles and the South Hamgyong Provincial Taekwon-Do Team in the women's doubles and the Pyongyang City Taekown-Do Team in the team event. Rodong News Team

title: Wreaths Laid at Friendship Tower
body: Wreaths were laid at the Friendship Tower on Friday, the 65th anniversary of the victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War. Seen standing at the tower was a wreath from the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Attending the wreath-laying ceremony were Yang Hyong Sop, vice-president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, Ri Ryong Nam, vice-premier of the Cabinet, Ri Chang Gun, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), Army Col. General Kim Hyong Ryong, vice-minister of the People's Armed Forces, and others, officials concerned and Pyongyangites. Ambassador Li Jinjun and staff members of the Chinese embassy here and the delegation of the Chinese Foreign Ministry led by Vice-Minister Kong Xuanyou, Chinese guests and Chinese students studying in the DPRK and Chinese residents in the DPRK were on hand. Placed at the tower was a wreath in the joint name of the WPK Central Committee, the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK and the Cabinet of the DPRK. Also laid were wreaths in the names of the Ministry of the People's Armed Forces, the Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea, the Central Committee of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea, the DPRK-China Friendship Association, the Pyongyang City Committee of the WPK, the Pyongyang City People's Committee, the Chinese embassy here and other units. The participants paid a silent tribute to the memory of the martyrs. On the same day, wreaths were laid at the martyrs cemeteries and graves of the Chinese People's Volunteers in Hyongjesan District of Pyongyang, Hoechang County, Anju City and Kaesong City. Rodong News Team

title: Wreaths Laid at Statues and Cemeteries of Martyrs on V-Day
body: Wreaths were laid at the statues and cemeteries of martyrs, the memorial towers for the fallen soldiers of the Korean People's Army and graves of martyrs across the country on Friday, the 65th anniversary of the victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War. Taking part in the wreath-laying ceremonies were officials of local party and power organs, working people's organizations, industrial establishments, farms and schools, men and officers of the Korean People's Army and the Korean People's Internal Security Forces, working people and school youth and children. Placed were wreaths in the names of local party and power organs, working people's organizations, units of KPA and KPISF, industrial establishments, farms and schools as well as bouquets and flowers. The participants observed a moment's silence in memory of the martyrs. Rodong News Team

title: Wreaths Laid at Martyrs Cemeteries
body: Wreaths were laid at the Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery on Mt Taesong, the Patriotic Martyrs Cemetery in Sinmi-ri and the Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery on Friday, the 65th anniversary of the victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War. Seen standing on the wreath-laying stands of the cemeteries were wreaths in the august name of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Senior party and government officials Pak Kwang Ho, Thae Jong Su, O Su Yong, An Jong Su, Kim Yong Chol, Choe Pu Il, Choe Hwi, Jong Kyong Thaek and Kim Nung O, the chairman of a friendly party, members of the Workers' Party of Korea Central Committee and officials of the Cabinet, working people's organizations, ministries and national institutions and Pyongyang city institutions and enterprises took part in the wreath-laying ceremonies. Members of armed forces organs including No Kwang Chol were present there. Wreaths in the joint name of the WPK Central Committee, the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly were laid on the wreath-laying stands of the cemeteries on Mt. Taesong and in Sinmi-ri. A wreath in the joint name of the Central Committee and the Central Military Commission of the WPK and the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK was laid on the wreath-laying stand of the war martyrs cemetery. Also, placed were wreaths in the names of the Ministry of the People's Armed Forces, the Ministry of People's Security, working people's organizations, ministries, national institutions, units of the Korean People's Army and the Korean People's Internal Security Forces, scientific, educational, public health and media organs and party and power organs, organs, farms and universities in Pyongyang. The participants paid silent tribute to the memory of the martyrs. Rodong News Team

title: Floral Basket to Statues of Great Leaders from Belgium Friendship Association
body: The Belgium-Korea Friendship Association sent a floral basket to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on the occasion of the 65th anniversary of the victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War. The basket was laid before the statues of the great leaders on Friday. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK's Birthday to Be Marked in Czech Republic
body: A preparatory committee of the Czech Republic for celebrating the 70th founding anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) was formed in Prague on July 20. Jozef Servista, chairman of the Paektusan Czech-Korean Friendship Association who is chairman of the Czech Group for the Study and Materialization of the Juche Idea, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee decided to hold colorful political and cultural events including a lecture and a film show introducing successes gained by the Korean people in building a socialist power on the occasion of the above-said anniversary. Rodong News Team

title: Japan’s Scheme to Incite Confrontation
body: The Abe cult of Japan is talking about “forcible and surprise inspection of nuclear facilities in north Korea”, saying “it has not yet started dismantlement of its nukes and missiles” and “it doesn’t act if there is no strict condition”. The Abe group’s talk about “forcible inspection” is just aimed to check the trend of détente and peace created on the Korean peninsula, scuttle the process of the DPRK-U.S. dialogue and thus bring the situation back to confrontation and danger of war. Lurking behind it is also its design to deteriorate the situation by inciting confrontation with the DPRK and accelerate its moves for emerging as a military giant under that pretext. The Abe group, a pack of pygmy politicians, also seeks to curry favor with its master who talks about “declaration”, “verification” and “inspection” by doing so, get rid of its poor plight of “being nudged” from the trend of situation around the Korean peninsula and thus give a face-lift to its “status”. The Japanese reactionaries are, indeed, a group of heinous devils who make no scruple of committing sins in a bid to attain their wild political ambitions. The Abe cult should reflect on its sinful moves for the revival of militarism posing threat to peace in the Korean peninsula and the world before calling for “forcible inspection”. If Japan fails to drop that ill motive, it can never knock the door of the DPRK. If the Abe group persists in reckless confrontation with the DPRK and the foolhardy moves for realizing the wild dream for launching reinvasion against the trend of the times, it will be tossed out by the times. Ra Sol Ha

title: Japan Seeking to Become Military Giant
body: Japan’s Chief Cabinet Secretary Suga, at a recent lecture given in the area chosen for deployment of the modern MD system Aegis Ashore, said it is the most important responsibility for the government to secure the security and stability of the people, talking about “threat” from the DPRK. Defense Minister Onodera, too, made similar remarks there. This is just a sly trick of the Japanese regime to calm down the growing concern and discontent of the citizens in the area and step up the moves for emerging a military giant at any cost. No matter how frequently the Abe regime talks about the “security of people”, the Japanese people do not believe it. On the contrary, they feel great threat from consequences to be entailed by the regime’s crazy increase of military expenses. It was evidenced by the fact that the Japanese reactionaries’ trumpeting about “security of people” always drew public criticism only, instead of support. If the Japanese regime truly hopes for “security of people”, it should not seek to emerge a war state. Japan had better cool down its head heated up with the wild ambition for a military giant and keep its step with the regional trend oriented to peace, though belatedly. Ri Hyon Do

title: Participants in War Veterans Conference Feted
body: The Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea hosted a banquet in honor of the participants in the 5th National Conference of War Veterans. Present there on invitation were war veterans Yang Hyong Sop, Ri Myong Su, Thae Jong Su, Choe Yong Rim, Ri Yong Mu, O Kuk Ryol, Kim Si Hak and other participants. They were greeted by officials and employees at the Mokran House, People’s Palace of Culture, Okryu Restaurant, Chongryu Restaurant, Pyongyang Noodle House and general-service ship Mujigae, the venues of banquet. Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People’s Assembly of the DPRK, Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK, vice-chairman of the SAC of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, and other senior party and government officials and leading officials of the armed forces organs attended the banquet to congratulate the war veterans. Speeches were made there. The speakers noted that the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un hopes that the war veterans would live long in good health and well teach and lead the coming generations to steadfastly carry forward the baton of the revolution, saying he feels assured if they are just alive. They called upon the war veterans to glorify their life as the good forerunners of revolution and educators who instill more deeply the noble spirit and fighting traits into the rising generations, bearing in mind the intention of the Party. Rodong News Team

title: Music and Dance Performance Given for War Veterans
body: A music and dance performance of the Korean People’s Army Song and Dance Ensemble for the participants in the 5th National Conference of War Veterans was given at the April 25 House of Culture. Present there on invitation were war veterans Yang Hyong sop, Ri Myong Su, Thae Jong Su, Choe Yong Rim, Ri Yong Mu, O Kuk Ryol, Kim Si Hak and other participants in the conference. Watching the performance were Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the WPK Central Committee, Vice-Chairmen of the WPK Central Committee Pak Kwang Ho, Kim Phyong Hae, O Su Yong, An Jong Su, Pak Thae Song, Choe Hwi and Pak Thae Dok, officials of ministries of national institutions, teaching staff and students of revolutionary schools, youths and students. Among the audience were members of the armed forces organs including Army General Kim Su Gil, director of the General Political Bureau of the Korean People’s Army. The Patriotic Song was played solemnly. Put on the stage full of festivity on war victory day were colorful numbers like chorus “Cantata to Marshal Kim Il Sung”, “Our Supreme Commander”, male trio and chorus “Respects to Victors of Great Year” and mixed duet “Tell, Fireworks of War Victory”. The performers sang high praises of the undying revolutionary feats of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il who created the myth of war victory unprecedented in the world history of wars and won successive victories in the drive for defending socialism. Wartime songs “To a Decisive Battle”, “My Song in the Trench” and “Mungyong Pass” that resounded on heights during the hard-fought war days when passages of advance were opened despite hail of bullets for the valuable fatherland liberated by the President conjured up the deep memory among war veterans. Rodong News Team

title: Korean People’s V-Day Marked in Switzerland
body: A meeting, book and photo exhibition and film show were held in Switzerland on July 21 to mark the 65th anniversary of the victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War. Participating in the events were members of the Swiss Organizing Committee of the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu, Switzerland-Korea Committee and the Swiss Group for the Study of the Juche Idea. They looked round the works authored by the peerlessly great men and books dealing with their greatness and watched a Korean film. Martin Lotscher, chairman of the Switzerland-Korea Committee, said: 65 years ago, the Korean army and people won the brilliant victory in the Fatherland Liberation War under the wise guidance of the great President Kim Il Sung, the peerlessly brilliant commander and rare military strategist. This historic victory gave a great strength and courage to all the progressive and peace-loving peoples of the world and countries struggling for national liberation. The Korean people’s history and tradition of great victory will last forever as they are guided by the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. A congratulatory message to Kim Jong Un was adopted at the events. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of Union of Korean Teachers in Japan Arrives
body: A delegation of the Union of Korean Teachers in Japan Led by Ri Chang Hung, vice-chairman of its Central Standing Committee, arrived here on Friday. Rodong News Team

title: Chinese Foreign Ministry Delegation Leaves
body: A delegation of the Foreign Ministry of China led by Vice-Minister Kong Xuanyou left here for home on Friday. The delegation visited the Rungna Dolphinarium on the same day. Rodong News Team

title: Turkmen Foreign Ministry Delegation Leaves
body: A delegation of the Turkmen Foreign Ministry led by Vice-Minister Vepa Hajiyev left here for home on Friday. During the stay the delegation toured the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum, Pyongyang Teacher Training College, the Mirim Riding Club and other places. Rodong News Team

title: Chongryon Chapter Chairpersons Meet in Tokyo
body: Chairpersons of the chapters of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) met at the Korean Hall in Tokyo on July 24. Attending the meeting were Chairman Ho Jong Man and vice-chairpersons of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, the chairman of the Chongryon Central Audit Committee and chairs of Chongryon chapters and headquarters. The meeting discussed the issue for chairpersons of headquarters and chapters to turn out as one in the campaign to bring about a radical innovation in the building of basic organizations of Chongryon and their activities in hearty response to the idea of prioritizing the chapters set forth by the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in his congratulatory message to the 24th congress of Chongryon. Ho Jong Man made a report. He called for accelerating the work to consolidate Chongryon chapters as reliable patriotic stones of a citadel true to the congratulatory message of Kim Jong Un. The idea of prioritizing chapters was advanced by President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il, the reporter said, adding that it is a key issue of the policy of Chongryon construction developed in depth by Kim Jong Un as required by the exciting era of a radical turn and its implementation is the most urgent task facing Chongryon at present. Chairs of various chapters made speeches. They expressed their determinations to turn out as one in the struggle for the building of basic organizations and their activation, upholding the congratulatory message of Kim Jong Un so as to consolidate the chapters as reliable patriotic stones of a citadel. Ho Jong Man appealed to all the chapter chairs to fulfill their responsibility and duty in building all the basic organizations into active ones and harmonious villages where the traits of mutual support and assistance and warm affection prevail. Rodong News Team

title: Discrimination against Korean Children in Japan Protested
body: An emergency action was staged outside the Osaka City office of Japan on July 18 to protest against the city authorities’ exclusion of the Korean children from the aid list, under the sponsorship of the Liaison Council for Demanding System of Aiding Korean High Schools in Osaka. Taking part in it were parents of Korean children and other Koreans in Japan and Japanese citizens. The Osaka City authorities excluded seven classes of Korean kindergarteners in the city from the aid list, a clear discrimination against classes. The participants urged the authorities to impartially apply tuition free program to the Korean classes. Rodong News Team

title: LKP Lawmaker’s Corruption Exposed in S. Korea
body: The south Korean Yonhap News on July 24 reported about the data of the prosecution’s investigation into Won Yu Chol, a lawmaker from the “Liberal Korea Party” (LKP) who was bribed by tycoons with hundreds of millions won. According to the data, he received 55 million won from a business from 2011 to 2013 in collusion with his aide in return for solving a problem. He also took money amounting to about 180 million won from four businesses in Phyongthaek, Kyonggi Province. Rodong News Team

title: Strict Investigation into masterminds of Coup Demanded in S. Korea
body: Civic and social bodies of south Korea held a press conference outside the Seoul Central District Prosecutor’s Office on July 23, to demand an immediate investigation into those who plotted armed suppression of the candlelight demonstrators, according to the south Korean online paper Jaju Sibo. The participants submitted to the office a bill of indictment calling for thorough investigation into Jo Hyon Chon, former commander of the Defense Security Command, Kim Kwan Jin, former chief of the security office of Chongwadae, Pak Hung Ryol, former chief of presidential security, Han Min Gu, former minister of Defense, and other chiefs of the attempted coup. Rodong News Team

title: Dissolution of DSC Urged in S. Korea
body: The south Korean online paper Voice of People carried an editorial demanding the dissolution of the Defense Security Command on July. 26. The editorial noted that there was a flaming row at the “National Assembly” on July 24 over the defense minister’s remarks with regard to the documents concerning “martial law” drawn up by the Defense Security Command. It stressed that the dissolution of the Defense Security Command is the minimum way not to allow the military to meddle in politics. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Ambassador to Laos Appointed
body: Ri Yong Chol was appointed as DPRK ambassador to the Lao People’s Democratic Republic, according to a decree of the Presidium of the Supreme People’s Assembly. Rodong News Team

title: Greeting to King of Morocco
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People’s Assembly of the DPRK, Monday sent a message of greeting to Mohamed VI, king of Morocco, on the occasion of its national day. Kim in the message expressed the belief that the friendly relations between the two countries would be strengthened, wishing the king bigger success in his responsible work for the country’s development and prosperity. Rodong News Team

title: Talks Held between WPK and DPEG
body: Talks were held between Ryu Myong Son, vice department director of the C.C., Workers’ Party of Korea who is visiting the Republic of Equatorial Guinea as head of a WPK delegation, and Jeronimo Osa Osa Ecoro, general secretary of the Democratic Party of Equatorial Guinea, on July 27. The head of the WPK delegation highlighted the constant stand of the WPK on further developing the traditional ties of friendship and cooperation between the two parties. The general secretary of the DPEG said the friendly relations between the two countries with a long history are being carried forward through generations under the deep care of HE Kim Jong Un and President Obiang Nguema Mbasogo. He expressed the will to further boost the traditional ties of friendship between the two parties and two countries in the future, too. During the stay, the WPK delegation was invited to the receptions hosted by the DPEG. Rodong News Team

title: WPK Delegation Meets PM of Equatorial Guinea
body: A delegation of the Workers’ Party of Korea led by Ryu Myong Son, vice department director of its Central Committee, on a visit to Equatorial Guinea, met and had a talk with Francisco Pascual Obama Asue, prime minister of this country, on July 27. Noting that President Kim Il Sung rendered unsparing material and moral assistance to Equatorial Guinea which had just gained its independence, the prime mister said the Democratic Party and the government of Equatorial Guinea would remember it forever. He called for strengthened mutual support and solidarity in the struggle to maintain independence and realize the people’s interests, stating that Equatorial Guinea, a close friend of the Korean people, would develop the friendly relations between the two countries in the future, too. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korean Organizations Demand Declaration of Termination of War
body: The Committee for Implementing the Panmunjom Declaration and Promoting August 15 Grand March for Independent Reunification in south Korea made up of political parties, workers and civic organizations held an event at Kwanghwamun plaza in Seoul, according to the south Korean Yonhap News. Saying that now is the time to demand a peace treaty and put an end to the war with the right to decide, the participants called on all the people to make concerted efforts to ensure that the war is terminated and a peace treaty come true within this year. The Solidarity of People’s Sovereignty and the Students Solidarity for Progress held a rally around Kwanghwamun on the same day to demand the signing of a peace treaty. Rodong News Team

title: Gift to Kim Jong Un from Special Envoy of Indonesian President
body: The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a gift from the special envoy of the Indonesian president who visited the DPRK. The gift was conveyed to Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People’s Assembly of the DPRK, on July 30 by Puan Maharani, coordinating minister for Human Development and Cultural Affairs who is the special envoy of the Indonesian president. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to President of Switzerland
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People’s Assembly of the DPRK, Tuesday sent a message of greeting to Alain Berset, president of the Swiss Confederation, on the occasion of its national day. Kim in the message wished the president successes in his work for the well-being of the Swiss people, expressing the belief that the friendly and cooperative relations with Switzerland will continue to develop on good terms in line with the aspiration and desire of the two peoples. Rodong News Team

title: New Mode of Thinking, Viewpoint Is Needed in Dealing with Inter-Korean Relations
body: Now multi-faceted undertakings are underway between the north and the south of Korea but they are not substantial. There are rumors that the undertakings take place here and there but there are no substantial move. The whole nation wishes for a comprehensive and great change in inter-Korea relations, not a partial change, and permanent reconciliation and peace, not a temporary escape from the phase of confrontation and danger of war. The south Korean authorities’ approach to the north-south relations is the “promotion of improvement of relations depending on progress of denuclearization”. They are in a regretful and pitiful position of reading other’s face under the pretext of May 24 anti-north sanctions and UN sanctions and considering the feelings of that side. They intend to do “money-free things” such as “joint check”, “joint inspection” and “joint research” and idle away, insisting on the first and second meetings. When our side told the south side that deeds are more necessary than words, the latter said that “conditions have not yet been provided”. The south side’s oft-repeated “conditions” mean the lifting of the U.S. and UN sanctions against the DPRK in the wake of someone’s denuclearization, which reminds one of a Korean saying “wishes never can fill a sack.” The anti-north sanctions are an unreasonable step taken by the U.S. and other hostile forces for the mere reason that the DPRK conducted self-defensive nuclear tests and ballistic rocket fires to defend peace and security from the aggression and war threat by outsiders. Now that the DPRK made such bold decision as dismantling the northern nuclear test ground in the wake of the stop to nuclear test and ballistic rocket fire as part of denuclearization of the Korean peninsula, the corresponding measure should have been taken. If the south Korean authorities are concerned about the aspirations of all the fellow countrymen and other people for peace, prosperity and reunification of the Korean peninsula even a bit, they should take sincere attitude and correct stance toward the implementation of the Panmunjom Declaration. Something to believe in on the earth is one’s own effort and someone to depend on and take hands with is the nation of the same blood and the fellow countrymen. Two rounds of north-south summit meetings and talks took place in a matter of 29 days without someone’s approval and procedure. The Panmunjom Declaration made public before the whole nation and the world is based on the firm will to solve by the concerted efforts of the Korean nation all problems arising in inter-Korean relations regardless of change of situation and surrounding climate. What matters is that the south Korean authorities’ oft-repeated “provision of conditions” is not a wordplay but leads to a reckless act of keeping anti-north sanctions. The south Korean authorities deter and put pressure on the organizations and their members desirous of inter-Korean cooperation and exchange under all sorts of pretexts. The south Korean Ministry of Unification demands that the visitors to the north board foreign airplanes, not Air Koryo, and keeps them from buying even a cup of water. Its mean act is not different from that of the past conservative regime seeking confrontation with the fellow countrymen. The south Korean authorities talk about “adjustment of speed” of inter-Korean relations to curry favor with outsiders that are claiming that all-round sanctions and pressure make it possible to attain the goal of denuclearization of north Korea, the international community should pool efforts for sanctions and pressure and the lifting of sanctions and pressure slows denuclearization. Rumors set afloat in south Korea that when the United States across the ocean gets angry, Chongwadae trembles for fear. When the south Korean authorities handle the delicate issue of inter-Korean relations without any consideration and calculation, the ensuing consequences will be irretrievable. If they attach greater importance to the outsiders than the nation, they had better stop trumpeting about improvement of relations and do as they like putting efforts for “boosting alliance”. Now is the time for them to flee from the old order and doggedness and approach the inter-Korean relations with new mode of thinking and viewpoint. We hope that the south Korean authorities will come to their senses, though belatedly, and roll up their sleeves to improve inter-Korean relations. Kim Yon I

title: Symposium of Field of Revolutionary Relics Held
body: A symposium of the field of the revolutionary relics was held on Monday to mark the 70th anniversary of the foundation of the Korean Revolution Museum. Present there were officials and teachers of the fields of revolutionary relics and science and education and of party cadre training institutions in Pyongyang. At the symposium, the peerlessly great persons’ idea and theory on the education in revolutionary traditions were explained and ascertained and the recent achievements and experience gained in the field of the revolutionary relics were exchanged. Speakers said the Korean Revolution Museum has turned into a revolution museum of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il, which is a great historic event that set a model of the Juche-oriented revolution museum. They said that the museum shows in an integral and comprehensive way the revolutionary history and exploits of the peerlessly great persons and ensures the visualization and vivid expression of the exhibits in a new form and method of exhibition. Thanks to the noble loyalty and moral obligation of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il were erected on Mansu Hill and in all provinces, further strengthening the blood ties of the great leaders and the Korean people, they added. Introduced at the symposium were successes and experience gained in the discovery, study and comprehensive systemization of the data on the revolutionary relics associated with the greatness of the Workers’ Party of Korea and in the preservation of the revolutionary relics. Rodong News Team

title: Birthday Party Given for War Veterans
body: A birthday party was given for participants in the 5th National Conference of War Veterans at April 25 Hotel. Vice-Chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea Kim Phyong Hae and other members of the WPK Central Committee attended the party to congratulate the war veterans greeting their birthdays during the conference. In his congratulatory speech Kim Phyong Hae said that the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un who considers the war veterans as valuable assets who earn their weight in gold had photos taken with the participants in the conference and took all measures so that they would spend pleasant days during their stay in Pyongyang without the slightest inconveniences, and showed the loving care of making sure that birthday spreads are arranged for them. The birthday spreads are warmly associated with the paternal affection of the Supreme Leader for the war veterans, he said, asking them to keep the revolution flourishing in good health. The birthday party proceeded in a happy family-like atmosphere. Rodong News Team

title: Special Envoy of Indonesian President Leaves
body: Puan Maharani, coordinating minister for Human Development and Cultural Affairs who is a special envoy of the Indonesian president, left here for home on Monday. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Government Gives Reception for Indonesian VIP
body: The DPRK government hosted a reception at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on July 30 to welcome the special envoy of the Indonesian president on a visit to the DPRK. Attending the reception were Ri Ryong Nam, vice-premier of the Cabinet, Choe Hui Chol, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, and officials concerned. Present there on invitation were Puan Maharani, coordinating minister for Human Development and Cultural Affairs, who is the special envoy of the Indonesian president, and her party and Bambang Hiendrasto, Indonesian ambassador to the DPRK, and a staff member of his embassy. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Yong Nam Meets Special Envoy of Indonesian President
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People’ s Assembly of the DPRK, Monday met Puan Maharani, coordinating minister for Human Development and Cultural Affairs who is a special envoy of the Indonesian president. The special envoy requested Kim Yong Nam to convey the warm greeting and letter from President of the Republic of Indonesia Joko Widodo to the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. The special envoy also requested him to convey the greeting from Megawati Soekarnoputri, former Indonesian president, to the respected Supreme Leader. Kim expressed deep thanks for it and had a talk with the special envoy in a friendly atmosphere. Rodong News Team

title: Workers for Extracurricular Education Make Study Tour of Area of Mt Paektu
body: Officials, creators and teachers in the field of young people’s extracurricular education from across the country made a study tour of the revolutionary battle sites in the area of Mt Paektu from July 24 to 30. They had a meeting in front of the statues of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il in Hyesan City on July 24 before starting and left for Pochonbo. They reached Pochonbo, where they placed a floral basket and bunches of flowers at the statue of the President on the bank of Karim Stream and paid tribute to him. Being briefed on the personality of the President as a great man, they went round the command post of the Battle of Pochonbo, the Police Sub-station, the subcounty office, and others. At the Rimyongsu Revolutionary Site, Chongbong and Konchang bivouacs, etc., the visitors looked back with deep emotion on the feats of Kim Jong Il who explored the road for making a study tour of the battle sites in the area of Mt Paektu and thus made the revolutionary traditions of Paektu shine more brilliantly century after century as eternal cornerstone of the Workers’ Party of Korea and revolution. They also looked round the Samjiyon Grand Monument, groups of subsidiary theme sculptures, the shore of Lake Samji, trees bearing slogans and other historical mementoes. They visited the Paektusan Hero Youth Power Station and then went to the Monument to the Victorious Battle of Musan Area. They had a meeting to renew pledge on the top of Mt Paektu and visited Kim Jong Il’s birthplace in the Paektusan Secret Camp. They went round the historical mementoes preserved in the birthplace associated with the history of the peerless great persons. During the study tour, they had a meeting to hear impressions of the reminiscences of anti-Japanese guerrillas read by them, a question-and-answer study contest, presentation of artistry and works of the creators and teachers and other colorful political and cultural work. Rodong News Team

title: Ulterior Purpose Sought by Japan in Touting "Threat" from DPRK
body: The Japanese reactionaries, in its recent 2018 defense white paper, specified that "there is no change in their principal understanding of the 'threat' from north Korea" even after the DPRK-U.S. summit in Singapore, the first one in history, terming the DPRK an "unprecedentedly grave and urgent threat". This is fabulous sophism and a vivid manifestation of the Japanese regime's unchanged policy hostile toward the DPRK. The Japanese reactionaries put spurs to moves to emerge as a military giant, frequently touting "threat" from someone. In a nutshell, the story about "threat" has become a tool for use whenever it is necessary for turning Japan into a military giant. Today Japan's "Self-Defense Forces" have grown to be dangerous war forces. It is the wild ambition of the Japanese reactionaries to realize the old dream for the "Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere". Acts of distorting the past crime-woven history and creating the atmosphere for launching reinvasion are openly committed in Japan. It is the calculation of the Japanese reactionaries to occupy the Korean peninsula and launch continental advance with the peninsula as a springboard as Japan did in the past. The Abe cult is systematically scaling up the moves for a military giant and justifying them under the signboard of non-existent "threat" from the DPRK. But it is, indeed, stupid. The Abe cult should stop talk about "threat" as no one would believe it. It should drop its scenario for reinvasion. Ri Hyon Do

title: People's Genuine Life in DPRK
body: The DPRK is a socialist country which has been cherished in its people's mind as the benevolent bosom where they lead an independent and creative life and happiness of all generations is ensured for 70 years. The seven decades-long history of the DPRK is a history of gigantic struggle and renovation in which the people have become masters of the country and created the world example of genuine socialist construction under the guidance of the great leaders and the great Party and a history of high pride in which dreams and ideals of the people have come true. The Korean people have enjoyed the most dignified life in the bosom of the DPRK for 70 years. Ordinary workers, peasants and intellectuals have become deputies to the Supreme People's Assembly to discuss state affairs and conduct free socio-political activities. This is a true picture that can be found only in the Korean-style socialist society. Our society is the best in the world as everyone enjoys happiness in very stable living condition, helping and leading each other though their life is not so luxurious and rich. The principle of collectivism, "One for all and all for one!", definitely dominates the spiritual and moral life of the people and all of them live in harmony, forming a big family irrespective of the post, position and age. This is the true picture of our society. The Korean people have led a worthwhile and happy life to the full, along with the history of development of the most dignified and powerful DPRK. This is the greatest privilege granted on them who are blessed with the great leaders through generations. Jang Im Hyang

title: North-South General-Level Military Talks Held
body: The north-south general-level military talks took place at the "House of Peace" in the south side portion of Panmunjom on Tuesday to implement the Panmunjom Declaration. Present there were a delegation of the north side led by Army Lieutenant General of the Korean People's Army An Ik San and a delegation of the south side with Major General Kim To Gyun as chief delegate. At the talks the pending issues in defusing the military tension and removing the danger of a war on the Korean Peninsula were sincerely discussed and there was an agreement to continue discussing and settling the necessary issues in the future. Rodong News Team

title: Military, Naval and Air Attache of Chinese Embassy Gives Reception
