body: Military, Naval and Air Attache of the Chinese Embassy here Jin Tao gave a reception at the embassy Tuesday on the occasion of the 91st founding anniversary of the Chinese People's Liberation Army. Present there on invitation were Army Col. General Kim Hyong Ryong, vice-minister of the People's Armed Forces; General of the KPA Air Force O Kum Chol, vice-chief of the General Staff of the KPA;generals and officers of the KPA. Invited there were Ri Chang Gun, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Ri Kil Song, vice foreign minister, Pak Kyong Il, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries and chairman of the DPRK-China Friendship Association, officials concerned, diplomatic envoys of different countries and military attaches of foreign embassies here. Attending there were Li Jinjun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK, and staff members of his embassy. Rodong News Team

title: Participants in 5th National Conference of War Veterans Leave
body: War veterans left Pyongyang on Tuesday after participating in the 5th National Conference of War Veterans held on the occasion of the 65th anniversary of the victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War. The war veterans were sent off by vice-chairmen of the C.C., the Workers' Party of Korea Pak Kwang Ho, Kim Phyong Hae, O Su Yong, Choe Hwi and Pak Thae Dok and cadres of the Party Central Committee, officials concerned and working people at April 25 Hotel, Pyongyang International Airport and Pyongyang Railway Station. Meanwhile, the participants in the conference were greeted by officials of party and power organs, working people of various strata, school youth and children, families, relatives and neighbors in local areas. Rodong News Team

title: Korean Revolution Museum Marks 70th Founding Anniversary
body: The Korean Revolution Museum commemorated its 70th founding anniversary. The museum is the one and only revolutionary museum of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il, which houses their revolutionary history and exploits and the grand seat and museum of national treasure for education in revolutionary traditions truly conducive to modeling the whole society on Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism. Kim Il Sung founded the museum on Aug. 1, Juche 37 (1948) and visited it several times to ascertain the historical relics and brightly indicate the way ahead. Kim Jong Il saw to it that a statue of Kim Il Sung was erected on Mansu Hill where the museum, a centre for education in revolutionary traditions, is located and led the work of the museum in each period and stage of the developing revolution. The museum has discharged its duty in a responsible manner on the forefront of the education in revolutionary traditions for the past 7 decades. The commemoration meeting was held Tuesday. It was attended by Pak Kwang Ho, vice-chairman of the C.C., the Workers' Party of Korea, anti-Japanese revolutionary fighter Hwang Sun Hui, curator of the museum, and officials, lecturers and employees of the museum. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's Work Posted on Website of DR Congo
body: The National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of DR Congo posted on its website the full text of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "War Veterans Are Our Precious Revolutionary Forerunners Who Created the Indomitable Spirit of Defending the Country" on July 25 to mark the 65th anniversary of the victory in the Fatherland Liberation War. The website carried his photo. Rodong News Team

title: Dissolution of DSC Urged in S. Korea
body: The south Korean online paper Voice of People carried an editorial demanding the immediate dissolution of the Defense Security Command on July 31. The editorial pointed out that during Roh Moo Hyun regime the command committed an eavesdropping of phone message between the “president” and the defense minister and conducted illegal surveillance over millions of civilians. It demanded that the command be dissolved at once and its top echelons be investigated for their crimes. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Founding Anniversary to Be Marked in Syria
body: A Syrian preparatory committee for celebrating the 70th anniversary of the founding of the DPRK was formed on July 25. Mohammed Shaban Azzooz, director of the Department of Workers and Farmers of the Syria’s Baath Arab Socialists Party who is a member of its Regional Leadership, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee set a celebration period from July 25 to Sept. 11 and decided to organize colorful political and cultural events in praise of feats performed by President Kim Il Sung, leader Kim Jong Il and the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in founding and strengthening the DPRK in the period. Rodong News Team

title: Japanese Reactionaries Should Awake from Their Silly Dream
body: Shortly ago the Japanese authorities made public the measure for implementing the teaching manuals to the effect that Tok Island is “part of Japan” for senior high schools to be applied from 2019. Under the instructions given by the Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology of Japan in March this year to reflect the issue of Japan’s territory in the teaching program for senior high schools, a wrong education in “dominium over Tok Island” has already begun at senior high schools. The recent move is prompted by an ulterior intention to secure firmer legal guarantee for such education. The same is the case of the already-adopted teaching manuals. The manuals say that Tok Island is “pertaining to Japan” and it is “illegally occupied”. The brigandish education to grab territory at the primary, secondary and senior high schools proves that the Japanese reactionaries’ ambition for reinvasion has reached extremes. Clear is what they seek. They seek to persistently instill the idea that Tok Island is the “occupied territory of Japan” into the generations to come so as to train them as maniacs of revanchism and militarism for shock brigade of aggression and to invent pretext and external justification for provocation of territorial disputes. Their oft-repeated claim to “dominium over Tok Island” is a prelude to reinvasion. All the Korean People will never pardon the reckless act of those hell-bent on the ambition to grab territory. An Chol Gwon

title: DPRK Government Delegation Leaves to Pay Official Visit to Asian Countries
body: The DPRK government delegation headed by Foreign Minister Ri Yong Ho left Pyongyang on August 2 to pay official visits to Singapore and Iran. Ri Yong Ho is to attend the Ministerial Meeting of the ASEAN Regional Forum due in Singapore before making an official visit to it. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of UKTJ Visits Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: A delegation of the Union of Korean Teachers in Japan led by Ri Chang Hung, vice-chairman of its Central Standing Committee, Thursday visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun. Members of the delegation paid tribute to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il in the palace. At the halls where the great leaders lie in state, the visitors made a deep bow to them. They went round the halls where orders the great leaders received are on display and halls that house cars, electric car, boat and train coaches used by them for field guidance and foreign tours till the last moments of their lives. Rodong News Team

title: Swiss National Day Marked
body: Matthias Meier, director of Cooperation of the Cooperation Office of Swiss Agency for Development and Cooperation in the DPRK, gave a reception at the Taedonggang Diplomatic Club Wednesday to mark the national day of Switzerland. Present there on invitation were officials concerned and representatives of foreign embassies and members of international bodies here. Members of the Swiss office were on hand. Speeches were made there. Rodong News Team

title: Camping Starts at Songdowon International Children’s Camp
body: The 33rd camping began at the Sondowon International Children’s Camp in the DPRK with due ceremony on Wednesday. Present there were Jong Yong Won, secretary of the Central Committee of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League, Chae Il Ryong, vice-chairman of the Kangwon Provincial People’s Committee, officials concerned, camping groups of children from the DPRK, China, Russia, Laos and Vietnam and a camping group of overseas Korean children. They laid a floral basket and bouquets before the statues of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il at the camp and made bows. During the camping Korean and foreign campers will conduct multifarious activities including maritime activities, sports and amusement games and meetings of national day. Rodong News Team

title: Friendly Sports Games between DPRK Officials and Chinese Embassy Staff Members
body: Officials of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries and staff members of the Chinese embassy here had friendly sports games at the gymnasium of Changdok School Wednesday. Attending the events were Vice-Chairman Pak Kyong Il, who is chairman of the DPRK-China Friendship Association, and officials of the Committee and Ambassador Li Jinjun and staff members of the Chinese embassy. Players of both teams competed in volleyball and basketball events to show fine games. Through the games they further deepened friendship. Rodong News Team

title: Editorial
body: Let Us Wage Dynamic Campaign to Prevent Damage by High Temperature and Draught High temperature and serious draught are observed in the DPRK nowadays, which damages the crops like rice and maize on farms of different parts of the country. The present situation calls on all to turn out as one in the campaign for preventing damage by high temperature and draught. It is a very important and urgent task for agricultural sector in its work for attaining this year’s goal of agricultural production and tackling food problem of the people to strictly prevent damage by high temperature and draught. This year’s high temperature is an unprecedented natural disaster but it is not an insurmountable difficulty. As there are advantageous irrigation system and robust technical forces provided under the wise guidance of the Party and rich experience gained in the course of overcoming difficulties and making rich harvest by dint of the single-minded unity, there is no insurmountable natural disaster. Officials and working people in all fields and units, with awareness that they are responsible for the major thrust of the drive for defending socialism together with the agricultural workers, should turn out as one and devotedly work out of patriotism in the on-going campaign for preventing damage by high temperature and draught. All the people should fully display their patriotic zeal in the on-going campaign for preventing damage by high temperature and draught.

title: Provocative Acts Going against Climate of Peace
body: When the atmosphere of peace, stability and reconciliation is prevailing in Northeast Asia centering on the Korean peninsula, Japan is going against it. The Japan Defense Ministry has planned to increase the budget for military expenditure for the fiscal 2019 to the scale unprecedented in history and entered a full-scale stage for shaping it. Japan has staged the multinational maritime exercises involving Australia and other countries on the basis of the “Proliferation Security Initiative”. All these are openly committed under the pretext of “urgent threat” from the DPRK. This is a dangerous provocation of the Japanese militarists going against the climate of peace created by the DPRK’s peace-loving will and active efforts. It is no more than a foolish trick to realize the ambition for a military giant and overseas expansion and the old dream of the “Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere” which the ancestors left unaccomplished. The world is sincerely desirous of the end of the technical state of war and the settlement of durable peace and stability on the Korean peninsula. It wants to see the ever-growing atmosphere of reconciliation and the improvement of relations. But the Japanese reactionary ruling quarters set themselves against it. They are making desperate efforts to pave the way for the chariot of militarism by continuously creating confrontational phase on the Korean peninsula. Japan’s military spending is on the steady rise. Especially, the military spending has broken the previous record every year ever since the coming of heinous militarist Abe into power. The sphere of military operation by the Japan “Self-Defense Forces” is spreading to the Indian Ocean as well as to the Pacific Ocean. The present constitution still remains only and one hurdle. The Abe ruling forces are running amuck to revise it to turn Japan into a war state. The Japanese militarists should be mindful that if they go reckless to throw a wet blanket over the atmosphere of reconciliation and cooperation created on the Korean peninsula with a wild ambition for reinvasion, they are bound to meet their doom. Ra Myong Song, Researcher of Institute for Japan Studies

title: Congratulations to Chairman of United Socialist Party of Venezuela
body: The Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea Thursday sent a congratulatory message to Nicolas Maduro Moros upon his reelection as chairman of the United Socialist Party of Venezuela at its successful Fourth Congress. The message said that Nicolas Maduro Moros's reelection as the chairman of the party is an expression of deep trust and expectation of all its party members towards him. It expressed belief that the friendly and cooperative relations between the Workers' Party of Korea and the United Socialist Party of Venezuela would continue to develop favorably and sincerely wished the chairman great success in his responsible work for making a victorious advance in the Bolivarian revolution and developing the party. Rodong News Team

title: Sci-Tech Presentation in Field of Basic Science
body: A national sci-tech presentation in the field of basic science took place at Kim Il Sung University from August 1 to 3 under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea. It was attended by teachers, researchers and postgraduates in the field of basic science including Kim Il Sung University, Kim Chaek University of Technology, University of Sciences and the State Academy of Sciences. Presented to it, divided into panels of mathematics, physics, chemistry, laser, dynamics and geography, were more than 500 valuable papers. During the presentation there were lectures showing successes and experience gained in the basic scientific researches conducive to rapidly developing science and technology of the country and putting the national economy on Juche, modern, IT and scientific basis. Attending a closing ceremony held on Friday were Kye Hui Nam, vice-chairman of the C.C., the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea, officials concerned and the presenters. Rodong News Team

title: National IT Sci-Tech Presentation Held
body: A national sci-tech presentation in the IT field took place at the Sci-Tech Complex from August 1 to 3. Attending it were teachers, researchers, postgraduates from dozens of units including Kim Il Sung University, Kim Chaek University of Technology, Pyongyang University of Computer Science, the State Academy of Sciences and the Grand People's Study House. More than 200 valuable papers were presented to it, divided into IT, book-information and computer panels. The participants introduced successes and experience gained in developing the Korean-style ultra-modern IT. There were papers presentation and question-and-answer session through national network. There were also lectures during the presentation. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of DPRK-Laos Friendship Association Back Home
body: A delegation of the DPRK-Laos Friendship Association led by Cha Hui Rim, chairman of the Pyongyang City People's Committee and concurrently chairman of the Association, returned home Friday after visiting Laos. Rodong News Team

title: National Exhibition of Inventions Opens
body: The 16th National Exhibition of Inventions opened with due ceremony at the Sci-Tech Complex on Friday. On display at the exhibition were more than 1 000 inventions in the forms of products, models and diagrams. During the exhibition there will be a practical workshop and a technological presentation to improve the social knowledge on the work for sharing intellectual products and intellectual property and a data service on valuable inventive technologies. Present at the opening ceremony were Pak Thae Song, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Im Chol Ung, vice-premier of the Cabinet, Kim Sung Du, chairman of the Education Commission, Jang Chol, president of the State Academy of Sciences, officials concerned, officials of ministries and national institutions, scientists, technicians and inventors. The exhibition will remain open till Aug. 13. Rodong News Team

title: Gift to Kim Jong Un from Russian Politician
body: The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a gift from Sazhi Umalatova, chairwoman of the Party for Peace and Unity of Russia, on the occasion of the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. The gift was conveyed to the DPRK ambassador to Russia on July 31. Rodong News Team

title: WPK Delegate Meets Venezuelan President
body: Ri Sung Gil, DPRK ambassador to Venezuela, who attended the Fourth Congress of the United Socialist Party of Venezuela as a delegate of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), met with Nicolas Maduro Moros, president of Venezuela and chairman of the United Socialist Party of Venezuela. The delegate conveyed the greetings from Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, to Nicolas Maduro Moros, chairman of the United Socialist Party of Venezuela. Nicolas Maduro Moros expressed deep thanks for it and asked the delegate to convey his heartfelt warm greetings to Chairman of the WPK Kim Jong Un who sent a WPK delegate to congratulate the congress. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Watches New-type Trolley Bus and Tram
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the Korean People's Army, watched new types of trolley bus and tram made at the Pyongyang Trolley Bus Factory and the Bus Repair Factory. The first leg of his visit was the Pyongyang Trolley Bus Factory where he learned about the new-type trolley bus production. Visiting the trolley bus assembly workshop, he watched a new-type trolley bus made at the factory. He said that the trolley bus was made very well without any flaw and its quality was improved exceptionally as against half a year ago, that the level of processing precision of the flexion side of the outer surface of the bus body, degree of flatness of sides and the seam finishing was raised and coating has also been done well even though the phase-2 modernization has not yet been started. The quality and cultured level of all fittings were remarkably improved and the quality of rubber products including floor rubber and glass rubber frame and plastic decorative plywood is good, he said, adding that it is more pleasant and more and more thankful as all these things were produced at our factories. He highly appreciated them, saying he was very satisfied and they are perfect. Noting that this factory is a model factory of the country whose cultured practice in production and life is on a high level and it is the cleanest and tidiest one among all the rolling stock factories of the country just as he estimated while looking round the factory before, he was greatly pleased to see its officials and employees keeping the worksites clean, taking good care of equipment and conducting production and administration work well. He learned about the phase-2 modernization plan and gave detailed teachings concerning problems raised and ways for their solution. He specified one by one the issues related to the phase-2 modernization and production growth. Promising to actively back them and calling on them to set the goal in a bold and big way to wage the phase-2 modernization project in a sweeping way, the Supreme Leader set forth the militant tasks to turn the Pyongyang Trolley Bus Factory into the one that can represent the rolling stock factories of the country, a pillar-like factory actively contributing to easing the passenger transport situation and the public traffic transport situation of the country. The second leg of his visit was the Songsan Tram Station where he watched a new tram made by the officials, researchers, technicians and skilled workers of the Bus Repair Factory. He was pleased to listen to the report made by officials that they installed alternating current electric motor with less manufacturing and operational costs and introduced electric motor control converter and control software to the new-type tram so as to improve the specific features of its mobility, speed and brake and to serve the conveniences of passengers, and that they ensured the local production of most of mechanical and electric fittings and outfits including wheel, glass, rear-view mirror, floor rubber, plastic decorative plywood and chairs. Saying that the Guidance Bureau of Passenger Service in Pyongyang, the Pyongyang Trolley Bus Factory and the Bus Repair Factory have done really worthwhile and big things for the people, he highly appreciated them. Being considerate of the devoted efforts exerted by the Guidance Bureau of Passenger Service in Pyongyang, the Pyongyang Trolley Bus Factory and the Bus Repair Factory true to the Workers' Party of Korea's policy for the local production of trolley buses and trams and of the painstaking endeavors made by relevant units that displayed responsibility in supplying trolley bus tires, glass, all kinds of parts and interior finishing materials, he extended thanks to all the workers, scientists and technicians who contributed to the trolley bus and tram production. That night he personally guided the trial operation of new-type tram and trolley bus. Saying that he could notice improved interior environment and higher quality and cultured level of outfits, and the noise and vibration at time of operation that have reduced than the last time he was on trolley bus, and that all the technical specification indices are normal, he said that it will be wonderful to see the home-made trams and trolley buses running in streets and that the people will be greatly pleased. He said that it is our Party's intention to pick up even a star if it is desired by the people, adding that he used to feel a heavy heart when he used to see old public transport means giving inconveniences to the people and the number of taxis increasing in the streets as the high intention of the great leaders who worked heart and soul for the solution of the passenger transport in Pyongyang was not upheld. He said with delight that now he can see the bright prospect and he is satisfied. He expressed the expectation and conviction that the officials and workers of the Pyongyang Trolley Bus Factory and the Bus Repair Factory would fulfill their duty in attaining the new fighting goals set forth by the Party. He was accompanied by Choe Ryong Hae, O Su Yong, Kim Su Gil, Hwang Pyong So and Jo Yong Won. Political News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Inspects Samchon Catfish Farm
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and supreme commander of the Korean People's Army, inspected the Samchon Catfish Farm together with Ri Sol Ju. Going round the room for education in the revolutionary history, the room dedicated to the history of the farm, the sci-tech learning space, the general control room, open-air fishponds, the breeding catfish block and other various places of the farm, Supreme Leader of the Party, state and army Kim Jong Un learned in detail about the production there. Enjoying the front view of the farm building, he said with great satisfaction that the splendidly and tidily tiled outer walls, which had been painted before, look cleaner and nicer, adding it is a very spectacular and perfect farm flawless in production environment and architectural aesthetic aspects. He highly praised the officials and employees of the farm for further sprucing up it and overfulfilling the plan for producing 3 000 tons of catfish a year set by the Party. The farm, which used to turn out 300 tons of catfish on an annual average, produced 3 001 tons last year after its rebuilding on an expansion basis, he noted, adding this means that the farm has produced in just one year what it had to produce in more than 10 years. He said with great satisfaction that it is possible to supply servicepersons with 10 times more fish than before and that the renovation of the farm has taken effect and it is a farm whose modernization has paid off. Stressing the need for the farm to become an engine leading the fish farming field of the country and a pioneer, educator and pedigree farm for the dissemination of ultra-modern fish farming technology, he set forth the tasks and ways for it. He gave valuable teachings concerning the management and operation of the farm and the fish farming field, including the issue of keeping researches to meet the goal of shortening the catfish production cycle and lowering the feed unit to the worldwide level. Watching stacks of frozen catfish at a freezing warehouse, he said they looked like the piled gold ingots, repeatedly praising the farm as an asset farm. He called on the farm to greet the 70th anniversary of the founding of the Republic with proud labor achievements. He said that the Party is fully relieved as the Samchon Fish Farm is taken charge of by the People's Army, asking the farm to over-fulfill the catfish production plan without fail this year, too, and thus fully display the soldier spirit, stamina and traits. He was accompanied by Choe Ryong Hae, Hwang Pyong So, Jo Yong Won, O Il Jong, Kim Yong Su and Kim Chang Son. Political News Team

title: KAPPC on Extension of U.S.-Japan Atomic Energy Agreement
body: The Korea Asia-Pacific Peace Committee (KAPPC) issued a white paper on Saturday disclosing the dangerous attempt and criminal nature behind the U.S. and Japanese reactionaries' moves for the extension of the atomic energy agreement as the 30-year duration U.S.-Japan atomic energy agreement, that had been to be expired by July 16, was automatically extended. Japan has persistently and frantically sought nuclear ambition century after century, the white paper said, and went on: Historically, the Japanese reactionaries have called for resolutely opposing possession and use of nuclear weapons as Japan is the world's only nuclear victim. But, quite contrary to this repeated call, they have desperately worked for the realization of nuclear weaponization with vaulting ambition for it from long ago. Japan which had conducted nuclear researches from early in the 1930s began to earnestly push forward the A-bomb development upon entering the 1940s under the direct governance by the military just until its defeat. In 1956 they adopted the policy on the re-processing of spent nuclear fuel for the potential possession of nuclear capabilities and began to produce plutonium from 1977. In the 1980s they even manufactured fast breeder reactor called Monju for the mass-procurement of plutonium. After the adoption of the U.S.-Japan atomic energy agreement in 1988 Japan has been keen on the extraction of plutonium even by importing and re-processing spent nuclear fuel from other countries. The white paper disclosed the double-dealing attitude of the U.S. feigning ignorance of Japan's attempt at nuclear development. It continued: Japan is the only country the plutonium production through nuclear reprocessing by which is allowed in the world except the five permanent members of the United Nations Security Council. Through the 1988 U.S.-Japan atomic energy agreement, the U.S. granted Japan the right to reprocess spent nuclear fuel which heartened the Japanese reactionaries spur the stockpiling of plutonium for nuclear weaponization for the past 30 years. Far back in the middle of the 1950s the U.S. transferred uranium enrichment technology and other core technologies necessary for the nuclear weapons development to Japan under "Atomic Energy Marshall Plan" and by the end of the 1960s it offered Japan weapons-grade plutonium weighing 365 kg under the excuse of test. It was the Ford Administration of the U.S. which agreed on the construction of reprocessing factory in Japan in 1976 and it was the Carter Administration that hinted at Japan in 1977 that nuclear weapons can be made with atomic reactor-grade plutonium. The adoption of the July, 1988 U.S.-Japan atomic energy agreement granted Japan the right to plutonium extraction by reprocessing spent nuclear fuel and uranium enrichment, a step little short of giving free rein to the Japanese reactionaries' ambition for independent nuclear weaponization. Japan's nuclear weaponization and the worldwide nuclear disaster there-from can happen any moment. The amount of plutonium stockpiled in the world so far is 518 tons out of which 47 tons are held by Japan. However, the U.S. and the Japanese reactionaries openly committed unethical and anti-peace crime of making the U.S.-Japan atomic energy agreement get automatically extended. This, needless to say, is a product of conspiracy between the islanders keen on turning the island into a military power and realizing the old dream of the "Greater East Asia Co-prosperity Sphere" under the active patronage and at the tacit connivance of their master, and the U.S. thinking of holding control of its henchmen with " favor of special treatment" and use them as a shock brigade in realizing its Asia domination strategy. If the U.S. has the intent on the denuclearization of the Korean peninsula, it has to duly take issue with Japan's nuclear weaponization moves and judge the situation from a fair stand. Japan has to self-control itself, clearly understanding that its frivolous attitude will precipitate its international isolation and miserable self-destruction. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Zimbabwean President-elect
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, sent a congratulatory message to Emmerson Dambudzo Mnangagwa, Zimbabwean president-elect, on Aug. 4. In the belief that the bilateral friendly and cooperative ties with a long history and tradition would grow stronger, the message sincerely wished the president-elect good health and happiness and greater success in his responsible work for the development and prosperity of the country and the people's wellbeing. Rodong News Team

title: WPK Delegation Back Home
body: A delegation of the Workers' Party of Korea led by Ryu Myong Son, vice department director of its Central Committee, returned home Saturday after visiting the Republic of Equatorial Guinea and the Republic of Guinea. Rodong News Team

title: Immortal Banner for National Reunification
body: August 4 marks the 21st anniversary of the publication of leader Kim Jong Il’s work “Let Us Carry Out the Great Leader Comrade Kim Il Sung’s Instructions for National Reunification”. The work, published on August 4, Juche 86 (1997), deals with the exploits President Kim Il Sung performed for the cause of national reunification. In the work the three principles of national reunification, the 10-point programme of the great unity of the whole nation and the proposal for founding the Democratic Federal Republic of Koryo are formulated into the three charters of national reunification, and the tasks and ways for Korea’s reunification are specified on this basis. The work serves as a library specifying the most correct orientation and ways for accomplishing the cause of national reunification, the lifetime desire of the President, at any cost, and as a banner that inspires all Koreans to the patriotic struggle for bringing that desire into a reality. Thanks to the energetic guidance of Kim Jong Il, there were two historic north-south summits and the June 15 joint declaration and the October 4 declaration were adopted to usher in a new era of national reunification, the main idea of which is By Our Nation Itself. No matter how frequently the situation, conditions and environment change, there must be no change in the main principle of national reunification laid down by the great leaders. Whoever loves the country and nation should boldly turn out in a just patriotic struggle for reunifying the country, no matter where he or she lives. All Koreans in the north and the south and abroad should more vigorously wage a patriotic struggle for implementing the behests of the great leaders for national reunification and thus build a dignified and prospering reunified power on this land at any cost. Ho Yong Min

title: S. Korean Civic Body Criticizes Supreme Court’s Scandal
body: The Justice Preserving Solidarity for Settling the Issue of Sexual Slavery of the Imperial Japanese Army in south Korea in a statement on July 30 reportedly demanded strict investigation and punishment of Ryang Sung Thae, former president of the Supreme Court who attempted to turn down the damage suit filed by the victims of the sexual slavery. The administrative office of the court tried to turn down the damage suit filed by the victims of the sexual slavery against the Japanese government in 2016 when Park Geun Hye was in power, the statement pointed out. Scandals of Ryang Sung Thae should be thoroughly investigated until the truth behind them is probed, it said, adding this will be the first step toward the restoration of rights and honor of the victims. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korea: LKP Accused of Helping Examine “Martial Law”
body: The representative of the Minju Party in south Korea on August 3 said that the “Liberal Korea Party” was the very one responsible for the “martial law” case, according to the south Korean Kyunghyang Daily News. The LKP should admit the existence of document on planned “martial law” at the “National Assembly” and come out for probe into the truth behind the case, including the instructor and the background, the representative stated. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korea: Partial Reorganization of DSC Opposed
body: The south Korean online paper Voice of People in an editorial on August 3 expressed opposition to the partial reorganization of the Defense Security Command. Noting that a reform plan on reorganizing the command at the level of virtual dissolution was recommended, the editorial stressed that the illegal deeds of the command should never be pardoned. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK’s Birthday to Be Marked in Germany
body: A preparatory committee for celebrating the 70th founding anniversary of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea (DPRK) was formed in Berlin of Germany on July 30. The chairman of the Anti-Imperialist Forum of Germany was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee set a celebration period from July 30 to September 9 and decided to hold colorful political and cultural events in the period. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK's Founding Anniversary to Be Marked in Bulgaria
body: A Bulgarian preparatory committee for marking the 70th anniversary of the founding of the DPRK was formed in Sofia on July 31. Simeon Ignatov, president of the Central Council of the Bulgarian Anti-Fascist Union, was elected as chairman of the preparatory committee. It fixed a period from Aug. 1 to Sept. 9 for celebrating the anniversary and decided to organize political and cultural events such as celebration meeting, seminar and book and photo exhibition in the capital city and local areas in the period. Rodong News Team

title: DR Congo Body Releases Information Bulletin
body: The National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of DR Congo released an information bulletin, "On 73rd Anniversary of Korea's Liberation," on July 30. It carried an article titled "Peerless Patriot and Benefactor of National Liberation" together with a photo of President Kim Il Sung. It said that no matter how much water may flow under the bridge, President Kim Il Sung's feats in liberating the country are shining brilliantly. Korea's liberation opened up a way for the Korean people to make progress independently as the masters of their own destiny for the first time in the 5 000-year-long history, it noted, adding that after the liberation, the first democratic election took place and the democratic reforms including the agrarian one were successfully enforced in Korea in a short time. It concluded that it is thanks to the President that the cause of liberating the country was accomplished and that the DPRK could emerge a politically and ideologically strong country, a military power and a strategic state which is recognized by the world. Rodong News Team

title: Results of Investigation into DSC of South Korea Announced
body: A special investigation group of the Defense Ministry of south Korea made public the results of its investigation into the Defense Security Command on August 2, according to south Korean internet newspaper e-daily. The special investigation group noted that the original title of the document on coup made by the command was the "plan for coping with present situation." It said that the command also secretly operated a special inspection team for making the document on premeditated coup. It stressed that the command put the bereaved families of the ferry Sewol disaster under organized and premeditated surveillance in the wake of the disaster. Rodong News Team

title: Japanese Reactionaries Should Not Try to Justify Their Mean Policy of Discrimination
body: A member of the House of Councilors of Japan from the Liberal Democratic Party, called Satsuki Katayama, in a recent evening paper of Sankei Shimbun outfit, spouted a load of jargon justifying the Abe regime’s hideously discriminative policy toward the national education of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon.) Over the fact that the Korean schools were excluded from the list of tuition-free program for senior high schools and the Japanese authorities’ unreasonable act of seizing souvenirs of the Korean students who returned after visiting their homeland has been taken issue with by the UN Committee on the Elimination of All Forms of Racial Discrimination, the guy said if the Korean schools want support, “evidence proving the end of their unjust relations with north Korea is necessary”, and the seizure of souvenirs “is just the execution of law but not discrimination.” The rubbish talked by Katayama, acting chairman of the Policy Research Council of the ruling LDP of Japan, doesn’t reflect his individual opinion at all. This is just an illegal fascist violence to deprive the Koreans of their right to national education and stamp out the future of the Korean community in Japan as it is a vivid manifestation of chauvinism peculiar to Japan and its persistent anti-DPRK, anti-Chongryon policy. The moves of the Japanese reactionaries to justify their policy of discrimination and human rights abuses against the Koreans in Japan are no more than a last-ditch effort of those who have come under international criticism as they were prompted by the way of thinking of the pigmy politicians running wild in disregard of elementary human ethics and morality and international law. The Japanese reactionaries must be prudent, well aware of the towering anger of the Korean people at their ceaseless discrimination against the Korean schools and human rights abuses against Koreans in Japan. Ho Yong Min

title: DPRK Is Home of People’s Genuine Life
body: The DPRK is the home of the people’s genuine life and happiness. The Republic is the most popular state which was built and has been consolidated on the basis of the idea of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il about believing in the people as in Heaven, and the genuine state of the people which has put the status and role of the popular masses on the highest level. It is also the genuine country of the people where the popular masses are put forward as the masters of everything and the people’s genuine paradise which provides them with sound and highly civilized material and cultural life. The Republic is the people’s everlasting home that provides a firm guarantee of their worthwhile life and happiness of all generations to come. The people’s happiness and beautiful future depend on the invincible military forces. For the past decades a gun report of war has never been heard on the Korean peninsula which is recognized as the biggest hot spot in the world and our people lead a peaceful and stable life. It’s thanks to the wise leadership of the Workers’ Party of Korea which has consolidated the country’s military muscle in every way. The DPRK which rings with the glorious revolutionary careers and exploits of the great leaders under the people-loving politics of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un is the genuine motherland which all the service personnel and people should devotedly love and throw in their lot with forever. Sin Pun Jin

title: U.S. Will Get Nothing with Its “Pressure Diplomacy”
body: The State Department of the U.S. in charge of negotiations with the DPRK is nowadays claiming that it will not lift sanctions before the denuclearization and that the escalation of sanctions is the way to enhance the negotiating power. The U.S. Department of Treasury, too, claims that it has no plan to lift the sanctions against the DPRK and will further escalate the sanctions. As if to prove the facts, the U.S. Congress is drawing up bills related with the escalation of sanctions against the DPRK. And American media and experts are building up an opinion for sanctions, contending that the Trump administration reconfirmed the keynote of “denuclearization first, lifting of sanctions next” and it will turn to the policy of “maximum pressure” unless north Korea takes denuclearization step. How would the DPRK analyze the U.S. mysterious attitude of outwardly conducting a dialogue but inwardly putting sanctions against the DPRK. The Korean people have done all what they wanted and accomplished their will so far despite the U.S. vicious sanctions and blockade. As the DPRK has built the self-reliant economy unfazed in any alien trend and adversity, it could ensure the independent development and the happiness of its people, even under the barbarous sanctions and blockade, and emerge as a dignified strategic state. As for “effect” of the U.S. sanctions, it only helped the DPRK gain the status of a nuclear power and enhanced its self-development capability. Trump took the first step towards the new history by bringing the first DPRK-U.S. summit meeting and talks to success after declaring that he would not repeat the mistakes of the preceding presidents. But contrary to his decision, the U.S. administration including the State Department is going back to the past, clinging to the “strategy for sanctions and pressure” which the successive administrations had insisted on for more than half century but in vain. This is an unprecedented tragicomedy. The U.S. Department of State and other bureaucratic groups, obsessed with the outdated gangster-like logic, should deeply ponder over the lesson of failures made by the preceding administrations. Then they will get aware of the fact that they are committing a serious mistake in the mode of negotiation with the DPRK and of the reason that the wrong formula will entail another failure. It they are obsessed with the monarchical way of thinking that they can enforce their demands without any fulfillment of their commitments and promises made with their dialogue partner and the conception that “sanctions” can work on everything, they will never achieve what they want. They should be mindful that the “epoch-making handshakes” of the two countries are not a result of any “pressure” but a miracle of history brought about by trust and respect. Everything in the future will be decided depending on how much the U.S. will attach importance to the trust and respect, escaping from the old view on “sanctions and pressure”. Jo Nam Jin

title: Editorial
body: Let Us Wage Dynamic Drive for Increased Prodution in Attaining Goals of Five-Year Strategy A dynamic drive for the increased production in attaining goals of the five-year strategy for national economic development is a loyal movement for defending the authority of the Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea unto death and a grand march of self-reliance and self-development for successfully attaining the magnificent goals for building an economic power by consolidating the foundation of the independent economy. All the people including the heroic Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il working class should attain without fail the goals of the five-year strategy for national economic development by waging a high-pitched drive for the increased production true to the calls of the Party and thus powerfully demonstrate the spirit and mettle of Juche Korea advancing toward the bright future with confidence. All the Party members and working people should dynamically advance along the right course indicated by the Party, conscious of the fact that their posts are a forefront deciding the victory of the dynamic drive for the increased production. At every post and worksite there should be a high degree of responsibility for gaining the goals indicated by the Party at any cost, the stubborn spirit of resolutely overcoming the obstacles and making a breakthrough and the fighting spirit of creating a thing out of nothing. All the people should brace themselves with the high awareness that they have no right to step back before accomplishing the tasks undertaken. Everyone should abandon the idleness and indolence, weakness and a viewpoint on defeatism which are checking the dynamic drive for the increased production and display a high degree of the revolutionary spirit, the spirit of throwing oneself into revolution and the boundless devotion. All people should go out in the dynamic drive for the increased production and successfully attain the goals of the five-year strategy for national economic development.

title: Final Victory of Socialism Is in Store for People Strong in Faith
body: The final victory of socialism precisely means the victory of faith and the victory of the revolutionary principle. The future of socialism, independent ideal and happiness of the people are unthinkable apart from the revolutionary principle. To preserve the revolutionary principle in socialist construction just means defending to the last and implementing the idea and cause of the leader. To consolidate the Party, firmly maintain its leading role, steadily enhance the function and role of the socialist power, preserve and develop the socialist ownership and resolutely struggle against imperialism is also the inalienable revolutionary principle. The revolutionary traits of the Korean people, who set store by and add glory to their own things in all fabrics of their social life out of their firm faith that their idea, social system and cause are the best, are a clear manifestation of the strong revolutionary principle and class principle. When all the people have the firm faith, they can attain the higher goals for building a powerful socialist nation earlier in the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance and fortitude. The indomitable revolutionary faith remaining unfazed by any trials is based on the unbending belief in one’s own strength. The revolutionary faith of the Korean people is the immutable faith consolidated in turns and twists. Only victory and prosperity are in store for the service personnel and people of the DPRK who are dashing toward a bright future, forming a fortress of faith around the Party Central Committee, no matter how frequently the international situation may change. Yu Chol

title: DPRK Foreign Minister Meets Foreign Ministers of Various Countries
body: DPRK Foreign Minister Ri Yong Ho, who attended the ministerial meeting of the ASEAN Regional Forum, respectively met and had talks with the foreign minister of China, Vietnam, Indonesia, Laos, Thailand, Philippines and New Zealand, the Cambodian minister of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation and the high representative of the European Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy on August 3 and 4. Opinions on the issues of expanding and developing the bilateral relations and boosting cooperation were exchanged at the talk. The DPRK foreign minister also met the minister of International Cooperation of Myanmar and the minister of the State for External Affairs of India. Rodong News Team

title: Probe into Case of Abduction of DPRK Women Citizens Urged in S. Korea
body: The south Korean internet newspaper OhmyNews on August 2 posted an article demanding a thorough probe into the truth behind the group abduction of DPRK women citizens. The case should have been investigated at the beginning of the present “government”, the article said, adding it was disclosed that the Park Geun Hye regime deliberately invented the case to create election climate in its favor. So, the case is one of the major evils to be liquidated, it stressed. Rodong News Team

title: Probe into Truth behind Ri Sok Gi’s Rebellion Plot Urged in S. Korea
body: According to the south Korean MBC, ex-members of the Unified Progressive Party occupied the entrance to the Supreme Court building and started a stay-in strike on August 3. They reportedly served prison terms on the charges of involvement in the case of Ri Sok Gi’s rebellion plot under the Park Geun Hye regime. After the scandals of Ryang Sung Thae, former president of the Supreme Court, were disclosed, they have urged the incumbent president of the Supreme Court to probe into the truth behind suspected trials over the case. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Government Delegation Pays Official Visit to Singapore
body: The DPRK government delegation headed by Foreign Minister Ri Yong Ho paid an official visit to Singapore on Aug. 5 and 6. During the visit, Ri Yong Ho paid a courtesy call on Teo Chee Hean, deputy prime minister and coordinating minister for National Security of Singapore, and had talks with Vivian Balakrishnan, foreign minister of Singapore. And he was invited to a reception hosted by his Singaporean counterpart. At the courtesy call and talks both sides exchanged views on regional and international issues of mutual concern including the issue of further strengthening the DPRK-Singapore relations, which are developing on good terms after the historic DPRK-U.S. summit talks in Singapore, as required by a new situation and the issue of further developing the ties between the DPRK and ASEAN. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Birthday to Be Marked in Tanzania
body: A Tanzanian preparatory committee for marking the 70th birthday of the DPRK was formed in Dar Es Salaam on July 28. Francis F. Lyimo, chairman of the Tanzanian National Coordinating Committee of the Juche Idea Study Groups, was elected as chairman of the preparatory committee. The preparatory committee set a celebration period from July 28 to September 10 and decided to organize colorful political and cultural events in the period. Rodong News Team

title: Message of Sympathy to Indonesian President
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People’s Assembly of the DPRK, sent a message of sympathy to Joko Widodo, president of Indonesia, on Monday in connection with huge human and material losses caused by a strong earthquake which hit Lombok Island of Indonesia. The message expressed deep condolences to the Indonesian president and, through him, to the victims and their bereaved families. It hoped that the Indonesian government would eradicate the aftermath of the quake as early as possible and make an achievement in the work to help the people in the affected area return to normal life. Rodong News Team

title: 11th National Folk Sports Contest of Agricultural Workers Held
body: There took place the 11th national folk sports contest of agricultural workers in Pyongyang from August 2 to 6. The contest brought together more than 300 agricultural workers selected in each province. It was held at the Moranbong Youth Park and the participants contested in the games of Ssirum (Korean wrestling), Taekwon-Do, swing and see-saw. North Phyongan Province came first in total standings. Rodong News Team

title: Academic Degrees of DPRK Conferred on Korean Educationists in Japan
body: Academic degrees of the DPRK were conferred on educationists of the Korean University under the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon). Doctor’s degree in linguistics went to Vice Faculty Dean Ho Chol, Master’s degree in biology to Department Head Ri Kyong Su and Master’s dgree in mathematics to teacher Jang Song Gon. They have contributed to national education and scientific development of Chongryon, always holding President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il in high esteem as the sun of Juche and remaining true to the guidance of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. An awarding ceremony was held at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Monday. Rodong News Team

title: Danger of Japan’s Militarism
body: Now Japan loudly touts a rapid development in economy, culture, science and technology but the world sees Japan which is little different from that of yesterday when militarism was rampant. The wild ambition of the past Japanese militarists comes true with the desperate efforts of militarists of the modern version. Militarism is not a specter but actually exists in Japan. It is institutionalized in political, economic, military, cultural and all other fabrics of social life, and the idea poisons a lot of Japanese people. The retrogressive revision of the constitution is what remains to be done finally for the building of a militaristic state. The revision of the constitution will help Japan’s militarism rush into reinvasion. The “civilian”-veiled Abe group and other reactionary conservatives of Japan seek to revive “Empire of Japan” which boasted of its mightiness after occupying the Asian continent. Japanese militarism has grown to be forces of aggression threatening peace and security in the Asia-Pacific region. The world should keep the highest vigilance against the danger of Japanese militarism that will bring a catastrophic disaster to the region. Jang Chol

title: National Sports Contest of Workers Opens
body: A national sports contest of workers (in field of communications) opened with due ceremony at the Basketball Gymnasium in Chongchun Street in Pyongyang on Tuesday. The contest includes volleyball, table tennis and other events. Present at the opening ceremony were Ri Il Hwan, department director of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea, Kim Kwang Chol, minister of Posts and Telecommunications, officials concerned, officials of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea, players selected from all provinces and working people in the city. At the end of the ceremony there was a men's volleyball game. The contest will be held in various parts of Pyongyang until Aug. 14. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korean Military Authorities' Reform Proposal on DSC under Fire
body: Twenty seven organizations of south Korea including the Center for Human Rights in Army and the Citizens Solidarity for Democratic Society held a press conference in Seoul on August 3 in which they accused the military of the reform proposal on the Defense Security Command (DSC), according to the south Korean Yonhap News. The organizations said that the reform proposal is in fact for soothing the crimes committed by the DSC. They urged the "Liberal Korea Party" to immediately stop anachronistic behaviors of covering up illegalities of the DSC. Rodong News Team

title: Dangerous Act of Souring Atmosphere of Détente
body: Shortly ago, the Japan Air “Self-Defense Force” conducted a bomb dropping drill in the sky above the vicinity of the Korean peninsula in league with the U.S. air force. Two U.S. nuclear-capable B-52s on Guam and six F-15s under Japan’s SDF were reportedly involved in the drill. Organizers of the war drill are claiming that the strategic bombers were not loaded with nuclear bombs. This was to cover up the provocative nature of the joint military drill. It was the calculation of the Japanese reactionaries to turn back the trend of the regional situation toward the détente at any cost and then get benefit from such movement. The Japanese reactionaries seek to strain the situation and realize their wild ambition for a military giant under the pretext of it. The final goal of the Abe regime is to turn Japan into a war state. The Japanese reactionaries are anxious about the fact that they will lose their justification on turning japan into a military giant if a peace-keeping mechanism is set up on the Korean peninsula. They think that they can attain their goal by provoking a war under the cloak of “threat” from the DPRK and aggravating the situation. The true colors of the hostile Abe regime as a disturber of peace are more clearly revealed with each passing day. Ri Hyon Do

title: National Sci-Tech Presentation in Electric Power Industry Held
body: A national sci-tech presentation in the field of electric power industry was held at the Pyongyang Thermal Power Complex on August 7 and 8 under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea. Taking part in the presentation were teachers, researchers, technicians, three-revolution team members and postgraduates from different units including Kim Il Sung University, Kim Chaek University of Technology, the electric institute of the State Academy of Sciences, the Pukchang Thermal Power Complex and the Phyongsong City Power Distribution Station. Presented to it were 60 papers conducive to overhauling production processes and equipment of power stations and raising the efficiency of generators and keeping them in full-capacity operation. There was a lecture on sci-tech problems arising in raising the heat efficiency of boilers and securing stable combustion. Rodong News Team

title: Message of Sympathy to Swiss President
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, Tuesday sent a message of sympathy to Alain Berset, president of the Swiss Confederation, as regards the plane crash that claimed scores of casualties in Switzerland. Kim in the message expressed deep sympathy and consolation to the president, the victims and the bereaved families. Rodong News Team

title: Bangladeshi President Wishes DPRK Prosperity
body: Ri Song Hyon, DPRK ambassador to Bangladesh, paid a farewell call on MD. Abdul Hamid, president of Bangladesh, on Aug. 5. The president said that he is pleased to see positive events taking place on the Korean peninsula recently, wishing prosperity to the DPRK which decided to concentrate all efforts on the economic construction. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Birthday to Be Marked in Jordan
body: A Jordanian preparatory committee for marking the 70th birthday of the DPRK was formed on Aug. 1. Marwan Sudah, chairman of the Arab Committee for Solidarity with Korean People and Supporting the Reunification of Korea in Jordan, was elected as chairman of the preparatory committee. The preparatory committee set a celebration period from Aug. 1 to Sept. 15 and decided to give wide publicity to the undying feats of the peerlessly great men for the foundation and development of the DPRK as well as to the invincible might of Juche Korea in the period. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Birthday to Be Marked in Lebanon
body: A Lebanese preparatory committee for marking the 70th birthday of the DPRK was formed on July 31. Zaher al Khatib, chairman of the Lebanese Committee for Supporting Korea's Reunification who is secretary general of the Lebanon Federation of Workers, was elected as chairman of the preparatory committee. The preparatory committee set a celebration period from Aug. 1 to Sept. 12 and decided to organize colorful political and cultural events praising the feats of President Kim Il Sung, leader Kim Jong Il and the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un for the foundation and development of the DPRK in the period. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Introduced in Brazil
body: The Brazilian Center for the Study of Songun Politics posted the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us Hasten the Final Victory through a Revolutionary Ideological Offensive" on its website on Aug. 3. The work, published on Feb. 25, Juche 103 (2014), clarifies the fact that the whole course of the Korean revolution was a history of ideological campaign for fully displaying the strength of the truth of the revolutionary idea of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il. It also indicates the tasks facing the field of the Party's ideological work at present and the ways for carrying them out. The website carried a photo of Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of UKTJ Tours Pyongyang Teacher Training College
body: A delegation of the Union of Korean Teachers in Japan led by Ri Chang Hung, vice-chairman of its Central Standing Committee, Tuesday visited Pyongyang Teacher Training College. Being briefed on the fact that the college turned into the pedigree establishment for training educationists, the members of the delegation went round the room dedicated to the history of the college, the educational science exhibition house, the primary school teaching method rehearsal room, etc. The delegation also visited the Youth Movement Museum, the Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace and the Ryuwon Footwear Factory. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korea: LKP Floor Leader Goes Reckless over Disclosed Attempted Coup
body: Kim Song Thae, floor leader of the "Liberal Korea Party" of south Korea, is going desperate over the disclosure of the coup plotted by the Defense Security Command, according to the south Korean newspaper Seoul Economic Daily. At a parliamentary meeting on August 3, he cried out for probing the truth behind the leakage of secrets through a parliamentary inspection, adding the "government" is branding the military as an evil group plotting rebellion. He said he would file a suit against the spokesman of Chongwadae, the minister of Defense and the former commander of the DSC on charge of secrets leakage. Rodong News Team

title: Another Scandal of Court Disclosed in S. Korea
body: It has been disclosed in south Korea that Ryang Sung Thae, former president of the Supreme Court, sought to newly set up a court of final appeal in league with Chongwadae in a bid to increase his court's judicial power when traitor Park Geun Hye was in power. A related document was reportedly declassified on July 31. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Ambassadors to Bangladesh and Angola Appointed
body: Pak Song Yop and Jo Pyong Chol were appointed as DPRK ambassadors to the People’s Republic of Bangladesh and the Republic of Angola, according to decrees of the Presidium of the Supreme People’s Assembly. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to President of Singapore
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People’s Assembly of the DPRK, Thursday sent a message of greeting to Halimah Yacob, president of the Republic of Singapore, on its 53rd national day. Expressing expectation that the friendly and cooperative relations between the DPRK and Singapore with a long history and tradition will further expand and develop in the mutual interests of the two peoples in the future, the message wished the Singaporean president good health and success in her responsible work for the prosperity and development of the country. Rodong News Team

title: War Victory Day of DPRK Marked Abroad
body: Events took place in different countries to mark the 65th anniversary of the Korean people’s victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War. There were a seminar on exploits in Russia, a solidarity meeting in UK, a lecture meeting in Tanzania and a photo exhibition and a film show in Nigeria between July 23 and 31. Films introducing the reality of the daily developing DPRK were shown. Gribakov, chairman of the Russian Maritime Territorial Association for Friendship with the DPRK, said that President Kim Il Sung embarked upon the road of the revolutionary struggle in his early years, defeated the Japanese imperialists with arms and accomplished the historic cause of national liberation. He noted that the President won a shining victory to be recorded in the world history of wars by smashing the imperialist allied forces and defending the country. He pointed out that thanks to the guidance of the respected Supreme Leader HE Kim Jong Un, the DPRK’s international position is on the rise day by day and great successes are being made in socialist construction. Maina, vice-chairperson of the Tanzanian national Coordinating Committee of the Juche Idea Study Groups, said that July 27, 1953 was the day when the Korean people created the great myth of war victory for the first time in the world. The vice-chairperson went on: Today the DPRK has proudly gained the status of the strategic state. No one on the earth can match the strength of the DPRK in which the entire army and all the people are rallied as one around their leader. July 27 will shine forever in the history as the day of eternal victory of the Korean people. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Birthday to Be Marked in Ecuador
body: An Ecuadorian preparatory committee for marking the 70th birthday of the DPRK was formed in Quito on August 1. Milton Burbano Bohorquez, chairman of the Ecuadorian Cultural Institute for the Study of the Juche Idea, was elected as chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee decided to organize colorful political and cultural events in the capital and localities on the occasion of the 70th birthday of the DPRK. Rodong News Team

title: Leader Kim Jong Il’s Work Published in Russia
body: Leader Kim Jong Il’s work “The Democratic People’s Republic of Korea is a Juche-oriented Socialist State with Invincible Might” was brought out in booklet by the Forum Book Publishing House of Russia to mark the 70th birthday of the DPRK. The work, published on Sept. 5, Juche 97(2008), says that the invincible might of the DPRK rests with defending and adding eternal luster to the Juche-oriented nation-building idea and exploits of President Kim Il Sung. The book releasing ceremony took place on August 2. Rodong News Team

title: War-end Declaration on Korean peninsula Is Demand of Times
body: The DPRK-U.S. summit meeting and talks in Singapore took place with the noble purpose for ending the hostile relations between the DPRK and the U.S. which lasted century after century and ensuring peace and stability of the Korean peninsula and the world. Now is the time for the DPRK and the U.S. to make a war-end declaration which is the requirement of the times. To declare the war-end is the first process for ensuring peace and security not only in the Korean peninsula but also in the region and the world. If the military confrontation between the DPRK and the U.S. comes to a close with the publication of the war-end declaration, an atmosphere favorable for confidence-building will be provided. The DPRK government has long proposed declaring the war-end and replacing the Armistice Agreement with a peace accord as the most reasonable way for defusing tension and ensuring durable peace on the Korean peninsula. But, this has not yet come true. It shows that unilateral efforts cannot solve problems. But sides should make efforts to settle the problems. The Singapore DPRK-U.S. joint statement called for making joint efforts to build permanent and durable peace-keeping mechanism on the Korean peninsula. The DPRK-U.S. relations should make a big step forward as required by a new phase of the development of history. Jo Thaek Bom

title: Independence Guarantees Dignity, Prosperity of Nation
body: A country relying on foreign forces has to dance to the tune of others without its own view and faith and its people are reduced into slaves. Only when one moves forward along the road of independent development whatever others may say, can one defend the destiny of the country and nation. If one yields to the imperialists’ pressure with illusions and fear of them, one can never escape from domination and subjugation. When it maintains political independence, a nation can defend its already gained independence and sovereignty to the last and achieve the development and prosperity of its country. It is important for each country to shape the state line and policy in keeping with its actual conditions and its people’s desire and demands and consistently implement them whatever others may say. Independence in politics is unthinkable apart from the economic independence. If one fails to lay the groundwork for the independent national economy, one cannot frustrate the imperialists’ domination nor maintain political independence. To consistently realize self-reliance in national defense is the fundamental principle of building an independent and sovereign state. If one does not defend one’s country by one’s own efforts, the dignity and sovereignty of the nation will be trampled down by violent foreign forces. The world progressives should push ahead with a struggle for independence, mindful that it guarantees prosperity of each country and nation. Ra Myong Song

title: Kim Jong Il's Works Introduced by Brazilian Organization
body: Leader Kim Jong Il's works "Let Us Carry Out the Great Leader Comrade Kim Il Sung's Instructions for National Reunification" and "On Having a Correct Understanding of Nationalism" were posted by the Brazilian Center for the Study of Songun Politics on its website on August 3 and 5. The first work, published on August 4, Juche 86 (1997), deals with the immortal exploits performed by President Kim Il Sung for national reunification. It formulates the three principles of national reunification, the ten-point programme of the great unity of the whole nation and the proposal for founding the Democratic Federal Republic of Koryo as the three charters for national reunification and indicates the tasks and ways for accomplishing the cause of national reunification on the basis of them. The second work, published in February 2002, deals with the birth and essence of nationalism and the past view on it and an important issue arising in achieving independent development of the nation. Posted on the website were a photo of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il standing together and a photo of Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: Norwegian Party Delegation Arrives
body: A delegation of the Communist Party of Norway headed by international Secretary Svend Haakon Jacobsen arrived in Pyongyang on Thursday. Rodong News Team

title: Tok Island Belongs to Korea Forever: Spokesman for History Society of DPRK
body: Shortly ago, the Japanese authorities made public the measure for implementing the teaching manuals to the effect that Tok Island is “part of Japan” for senior high schools to be applied from 2019. The already-adopted teaching manuals say that Tok Island is “pertaining to Japan” and it is “illegally occupied”. According to this, senior high schools of Japan are to begin from 2019 the education that Tok Island marked as “Takeshima” is “part of Japan”. What is more serious is that the teaching manuals serve as the teaching guideline of the government which has a legal binding power and is surely to be reflected in the teaching program as a reference book for teaching. A spokesman for the History Society of the DPRK said in the statement on Thursday that Japan’s claim to “dominium over Tok Island” was a shameless distortion of history and a gangster-like move to grab the territory. The statement went on: Tok Island is pertaining to Korea as the Korean people have reclaimed and possessed one thousand and hundreds of years ago and all successive feudal governments of Japan have repeatedly recognized Korea’s dominium over Tok Island. As for the “admission of Tok Island into Shimane Prefecture” in 1905 which Japan insisted as the ground for the claim to “dominium over Tok Island”, it was an illegal occupation of the territory as it is a criminal product of the Japanese imperialists’ policy for occupying Korea. Japan’s claim to “dominium over Tok Island” is, in the final analysis, a move to revive militarism to legalize and justify the Japanese imperialists’ occupation of the territory and an unpardonable move against history. Historians of the DPRK warn Japan, the sworn enemy, against resorting to shameless move to grab territory, refusing to make an apology and reparation for the past colonial crimes and strongly demand that Japan immediately roll back a wrong decision to instill distorted history and militarism into new generations to come. Rodong News Team

title: Tribute Paid to President Kim Il Sung and Leader Kim Jong Il
body: A home-visiting group of Koreans in Japan visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill Thursday. They laid bouquets at the statues of the great leaders and paid tribute to them. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Team Leaves for 18th Asian Games
body: A DPRK team headed by Won Kil U, vice-minister of Physical Culture and Sports, left Pyongyang Friday to take part in the 18th Asian Games to be held in Indonesia. Rodong News Team

title: Ri Su Yong Meets Norwegian Party Delegation
body: Ri Su Yong, political bureau member and vice-chairman of the C.C., the Workers' Party of Korea, Friday met and had a talk with the delegation of the Communist Party of Norway headed by International Secretary Svend Haakon Jacobsen who paid a courtesy call on him. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Government Delegation Pays Official Visit to Iran
body: The DPRK government delegation led by Foreign Minister Ri Yong Ho paid an official visit to the Islamic Republic of Iran on Aug. 7-9. Head of the delegation Ri Yong Ho met and had a talk with Iranian President Hassan Rouhani on Wednesday. During the visit he paid a courtesy call on Ali Rarijani, speaker of the Iranian Majlis, and had talks with Foreign Minister Mohammad Javad Zarif. At the courtesy call and talks both sides expressed the will to further develop the friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries in various fields this year marking the 45th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic ties. Rodong News Team

title: New Books Published in Cyprus
body: Books were published in Cyprus to highly praise the peerlessly great persons and show the real appearance of the socialist system of the DPRK to mark its 70th founding anniversary. Anders Kristensen, chairman of the Denmark-DPRK Friendship Association, wrote the book "My understanding of the DPRK". On its first page were a photo of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il standing together and a photo of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. The author of the book composed of three chapters praised the President's rare ideological and theoretical wisdom, extraordinary leadership ability, noble human love, virtue and internationalist obligation and the feats of Kim Jong Il, who hewed out the cause of immortalizing the leader and successfully accomplished it with his pure loyalty and moral obligation, performed the exploits for the world history by leading the struggle for defending socialism to a victory with the treasured sword of Songun. And the author lauded Kim Jong Un for successfully turning the DPRK into a socialist paradise where the people enjoy happiness, stressing that Korea would be reunified and shine as a prosperous power under his guidance. Carried in the book "Korea seen with eyes of a Western artiste" written by Adamos Katsantonis, chairman of the Cyprus-DPRK Cultural Friendship Association, are photos of Kim Il Sung, Kim Jong Il and Kim Jong Un and photos of Kim Il Sung who had taken with the author and the participants in the April Spring Friendship Art Festival. The author is a musician who visited the DPRK more than ten times to take part in the art festival. He wrote the book with the facts he experienced in the DPRK. The book denied the distorted propaganda of the West and praised the genuine socialist system where a happy life of the people blooms under the care of the peerlessly great men. Rodong News Team

title: Pak Pong Ju Inspects Samjiyon County and Tanchon Power Station under Construction
body: Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, inspected Samjiyon County and the Tanchon Power Station under construction. Going round various places of the county including the construction sites of the Paektusan Museum, the Management Office for Revolutionary Battle Sites in the Secret Camp of Mt Paektu and Samjiyon Township Hotel and the Junghung Farm, he encouraged the shock brigade members and agricultural workers devoting a lot of their sweat to the area of Mt Paektu. At a consultative meeting held on the spot, measures were taken to ensure the speed and quality of the projects at the best level by widely creating and introducing the building methods suited to the characters of highlands, preferentially send cement and structural steel to Samjiyon County by the relevant units and realize the overall mechanization of rural economy. Inspecting the construction site of the Tanchon Power Station No. 1, waterway project and others, the premier underscored the need to raise the rate of mechanization in the projects and take thorough measures for providing materials. Rodong News Team

title: Commendations to Contributors to Successful Railway Project
body: Order of Kim Il Sung, Order of Kim Jong Il, the title of DPRK labor hero and Gold Medal (Hammer and Sickle) and Order of National Flag First Class, Kim Jong Il Prize, Kim Il Sung Youth Honor Prize, Kim Jong Il Youth Honor Prize and other titles of honor, orders and medals were awarded to the builders, scientists, technicians, volunteers and officials who contributed to the construction of the Koam-Tapchon Railways in the DPRK. The heroic Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il working class, scientists and technicians hewed out a new ground in the railway construction of the DPRK by successfully building the Koam-Tapchon Railways crossing the rough sea as monumental edifice in the era of the Workers' Party. According to a decree of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly on August 10, Order of Kim Il Sung went to Ham Ki Sok, Order of Kim Jong Il to Mun Jong Ung and Choe Jin Hong, the title of DPRK labor hero to Jang Chun Song, Kim Hak Chol and four other persons and Kim Jong Il Prize to Kim Kwang Su.
