Kim Il Sung Youth Honor Prize went to 4, Kim Jong Il Youth Honor Prize to 5, title of Merited Scientist to 2, title of Merited Designer to 2, title of Merited Builder to 1, title of Merited Crewman to 2, title of Merited Driver to 1, Order of National Flag First Class to 31, Order of Labour to 41, Order of National Flag Second Class to 482, Order of National Flag Third Class to 699, Distinguished Military Service Medal to 2 and Merit Medal to 1 083. Rodong News Team

title: Foreign Guests Visit Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: Foreign guests including the delegation of the Communist Party of Norway headed by International Secretary Svend Haakon Jacobsen visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on Sunday. The guests paid tribute to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il. At the halls where the great leaders lie in state, the visitors made a bow to them. They went round the halls where orders the great leaders received are on display and halls that house cars, electric car, boat and train coaches used by them for field guidance and foreign tours till the last moments of their lives. Rodong News Team

title: Nepalese National Seminar on Juche Idea Held
body: A Nepalese national seminar on the Juche idea for independence, peace and prosperity took place in Kathmandu on August 5 to mark the 70th founding anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK). On display at the venue of the seminar were photos dealing with their exploits of President Kim Il Sung, leader Kim Jong Il and the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Displayed there were works of the peerlessly great men and books and photos introducing the real picture of the DPRK. Attending it were personages of the national assembly, political parties, organizations, organizations for the study of the Juche idea and media persons of Nepal and the DPRK ambassador to Nepal and staff members of his embassy. The participants laid a floral basket and bouquets before the portraits of smiling Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il and made a bow. Congratulatory speeches were made at the seminar. Then followed a keynote report and speeches. Manju Ratna Sakya, chairman of the Nepal Journalist Association for the Study of the Juche Idea and Songun Politics, highly praised Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il as the peerlessly great men as they provided great ideas to the world progressive people. C. P. Mainali, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Nepal Communist Party (Marxist-Leninist) who doubles as chairman of the Nepal-Korea Friendship Association, lauded the great leaders for making contributions to the foundation and development of the DPRK. Manik Lama, chairman of the Nepalese Association for Supporting the Songun Politics, Sonkori Baroti, chairman of the Nepali Literary Forum for the Study of Songun Politics, and Subash Kaji Shrestha, chairman of the Study Forum for Self-Reliance of Nepal, said that in order to defend the sovereignty and build a new society, it is necessary to conduct everything on the basis of the Juche idea. Krichna Bahadur Mahara, speaker of the House of Representatives of Nepal, stressed that Kim Il Sung waged the revolutionary struggle by depending on the strength of the popular masses and achieved the liberation, development and prosperity of Korea. A letter to Kim Jong Un was adopted at the seminar. Rodong News Team

title: Letter to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Participants in Nepalese National Seminar on Juche Idea
body: The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a letter from Krichna Bahadur Mahara, speaker of the House of Representatives of Nepal, and C. P. Mainali, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Nepal Communist Party (Marxist-Leninist) who doubles as chairman of the Nepal-Korea Friendship Association, on August 5 on behalf of the participants in the Nepalese national seminar on the Juche idea for independence, peace and prosperity. The letter said that President Kim Il Sung founded the immortal Juche idea, provided a foundation of Juche-based socialism and firmly defended the sovereignty and dignity of the DPRK. It noted that leader Kim Jong Il performed the distinguished exploits by pursuing the Songun politics based on the Juche idea. Today the DPRK brought important changes to the political structure of the world under the wise guidance of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, it said. It wished Kim Jong Un fresh success in leading the Korean people's struggle for the independent and peaceful reunification of the country and a final victory of the Juche cause. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Government Delegation Back Home
body: The DPRK government delegation led by Foreign Minister Ri Yong Ho returned home Saturday after paying official visits to the Republic of Singapore and the Islamic Republic of Iran. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Venezuelan President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Nicolas Maduro Moros, president of the Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela, on July 27. The message extended congratulations to the people of the fraternal DPRK on behalf of the Venezuelan people, government and president on the occasion of July 27, 2018, marking the 65th anniversary of the victory of the Fatherland Liberation War, an auspicious event of world-historic significance in the history of anti-imperialist struggle. The popular day of celebration will be an important occasion in displaying the two countries' intention to further strengthen the friendly ties between them and through the process it will promote the development, wellbeing and prosperity of the two peoples, the message said. It noted that the day will also serve as an important occasion to demonstrate the will to continue the struggle to achieve peace and harmony between nations, common great goals, and to defend the sovereign right and right to self-determination of the people and consolidate the building of a multi-polar world free from the imperialists' moves for domination. It extended warm greeting to HE Kim Jong Un, expressing noble homage to the heroes of the Fatherland Liberation War and the brave, dignified people of the DPRK. Rodong News Team

title: Lao President on Friendly Relations with DPRK
body: Lao President Bounnang Vorachith received credentials from the DPRK ambassador to Laos on August 7. The president said that the friendly relations between the two countries, provided by President Kaysone Phomvihane and the great leaders of the Korean people Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il, are now being carried forward by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. He stressed that the Lao party and government would steadily strengthen the relations. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK's Birthday to Be Marked in Libya
body: A Libyan preparatory committee for marking the 70th birthday of the DPRK was formed on August 6. Ahmad Muhammad Al Couleibi, chairperson of the Libya-DPRK Friendship Association, was elected as chairperson of the preparatory committee. The committee decided to organize colorful political and cultural events including a book and photo exhibition and film show on the occasion of the 70th birthday of the DPRK. Rodong News Team

title: Angolan President on Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Contributions to National Reunification
body: Kim Hyon Il, DPRK ambassador to Angola, paid a farewell call on Angolan President Joao Manuel Goncalves Lourenco on August 9. The president said that the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un has made a great contribution to defusing tension on the Korean Peninsula, achieving peace and realizing the reunification of the country. He noted that he has paid deep attention to achievements made by the DPRK government and people in the struggle for bolstering up the national power and ensuring peace and security. Rodong News Team

title: Reception Given for Head of Mongolian Presidential Secretariat
body: The DPRK government Monday hosted a reception in honor of the head of the Mongolian presidential secretariat and his party on a visit to the DPRK at the Mansudae Assembly Hall. Invited there were Zandaakhuu Enkhbold, head of the Mongolian presidential secretariat, and his party and Suren Tsoggerel, Mongolian ambassador to the DPRK. Present there were DPRK Foreign Minister Ri Yong Ho and officials concerned. Rodong News Team

title: Talks Held between Veterans' Organizations of DPRK and Russia
body: Talks between leading members of the Korean Committee of Veterans against Imperialism and a delegation of the Russian Veterans' Union took place in Pyongyang on Monday. Present there from the DPRK side were Army General Pak Jae Gyong, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee of Veterans against Imperialism, and other leading members and from the Russian side were members of the Russian delegation headed by Reserve Army General Mikhail Moiseyev, chairman of the Veterans' Union, and Military Attache Alexei Bartusov of the Russian embassy to Pyongyang. At the talks both sides informed each other of their organizations' activities and exchanged views on boosting exchange and cooperation between the organizations of the two countries. On the same day the Korean Committee of Veterans against Imperialism hosted a reception in honor of the Russian delegation. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of Russian Veterans' Union Arrives
body: A delegation of the Veterans' Union of Russia led by Reserve Army General Mikhail Moiseyev, chairman of the union, arrived in Pyongyang on Monday. Rodong News Team

title: Head of Presidential Secretariat of Mongolia Arrives
body: Zandaakhuu Enkhbold, head of the presidential secretariat of Mongolia, and his party arrived in Pyongyang on Monday. Rodong News Team

title: Seminar and Exhibition of Successes of Workers and Trade Union Members Held
body: A seminar on the experience in technical innovations and an exhibition of successes of workers and trade union members across the country took place at the Central Hall of Workers from August 8 to 13. The successes and experience gained in the course of briskly conducting the mass movement for technical innovation were announced at the seminar. More than 200 new technical innovation schemes conducive to the drive for increased production for attaining the goals of the 5-year strategy for national economic development were presented to the exhibition. A closing ceremony took place on August 13 in the presence of technical innovators selected in commissions, ministries, national institutions and each provincial trade union committee, trade union officials and members and workers. Rodong News Team

title: Chinese Friendship Delegation Arrives
body: A Chinese friendship delegation led by Xie Yuan, vice-president of the Chinese People's Association for Friendship with Foreign Countries, arrived in Pyongyang on Monday. Rodong News Team

title: 16th National Inventions Exhibition Closes
body: The 16th national inventions exhibition closed with due ceremony at the Sci-Tech Complex on Monday. More than 1 000 inventions given certificate and patent were introduced and experience exchanged during the exhibition. They were made by scientists, technicians and workers throughout the country in their work for increased production. Inventions conducive to putting the national economy on a Juche, modern, IT and scientific basis were praised. The ceremony was attended by Pak Thae Song, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Jang Chol, president of the State Academy of Sciences, officials concerned and officials of ministries and national institutions, scientists, technicians and inventors. The results of general examination were announced. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Advances into Quarterfinals of 2018 FIFA U-20 Women's World Cup
body: The group league match of the 2018 FIFA U-20 Women's World Cup is under way. It started in France on August 5. It brought together teams from 16 countries and regions including the DPRK, China, France, Germany, Mexico and Brazil. In the group league which is divided into four groups, the DPRK women's football team played matches with teams of England, Mexico and Brazil in Group B. The DPRK team beat its Brazilian rival 2:1 in the last match of the group league on August 12 and advanced into quarterfinals. It will play quarterfinals with the French team on August 17. Rodong News Team

title: Football Tournament Held between Workers of North and South
body: A football tournament for reunification between the workers of the north and the south was held in Seoul of south Korea to implement the historic Panmunjom declaration. Games took place between the team of the building workers of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea (GFTUK) and the team of the Federation of Trade Unions of south Korea (FTUK) and between the team of workers in the field of light industry of the GFTUK and the team of the south Korean Confederation of Trade Unions (KCTU) on August 11. Watching the games were the major members of our delegation led by Ju Yong Gil, chairman of the Central Committee of the GFTUK, Kim Myong Hwan, chairman of the KCTU, Kim Ju Yong, chairman of the FTUK, and other figures of the south side and Koreans of various circles. When the players of the north and the south entered the stadium with a large flag of the Korean Peninsula in the van, the spectators warmly welcomed them with compatriotic feelings. Whenever players showed good skills, the spectators broke into the enthusiastic applauses and cheers. The games were held amid the hot air of national concord. Our delegation had a conference of workers' organizations of the north and the south and meetings of industrial and regional organizations of workers of the north and the south for implementing the Panmunjom declaration together with members of the KCTU and the FTUK, and went round various places. Rodong News Team

title: Chinese Friendship Delegation Visits Mangyongdae
body: A Chinese friendship delegation led by Xie Yuan, vice-president of the Chinese People's Association for Friendship with Foreign Countries, visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. The guests laid bouquets at the President's old home in reverence for him. Being briefed on the fact that the President was born into a patriotic and revolutionary family and led the anti-Japanese armed struggle to victory and liberated the once usurped country, they looked round the historic relics. The delegation also toured the Arch of Triumph and the Rungna Dolphinarium. Meanwhile, it visited the Friendship Tower to place a wreath in the name of the Chinese People's Association for Friendship with Foreign Countries. Rodong News Team

title: Gift to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Veterans' Union of Russia
body: The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a gift from the Veterans' Union of Russia. The gift was handed to Army General No Kwang Chol, minister of the People's Armed Forces, on Wednesday by Reserve Army General Mikhail Moiseyev who is chairman of the union and head of its delegation on a visit to the DPRK. Rodong News Team

title: Resolution of All-Korean Committee for Implementation of June 15 Joint Declaration
body: The North Side, South Side and Overseas Side Committees for Implementation of the June 15 Joint Declaration released a resolution on Wednesday, the 73rd anniversary of the liberation of Korea. Noting the country was liberated to end the heinous colonial rule by the Japanese imperialists which had lasted for more than 40 years but the pain of national division being suffered by the Korean nation has lingered on for more than 70 years, the resolution said: The two historic north-south summit meetings and the publication of the Panmunjom declaration have ushered in a new era of peace, prosperity and reunification. Calling for forcing Japan to pay at an early date for the Japanese imperialists' colonial rule and aggression against Koreans and preserving the dignity and full sovereignty of the Korean nation, the resolution went on: Though more than 70 years have lapsed since the defeat of Japan, it has not yet acknowledged the fact about its past cruel colonial domination over Korea, far from making apology, but makes no scruple of committing discrimination, human rights abuses, political persecution and suppression against the Koreans in Japan, claiming its "dominium over Tok Island" and being hell-bent on the moves for launching reinvasion. To force Japan to pay dearly for its colonial rule over the Korean nation and crimes of aggression against it is just the issue of clearing the disgrace suffered due to the Japanese imperialists, setting right the justice of history and restoring the self-respect of the Korean nation. Thanks to the historic north-south summit meetings and the Panmunjom declaration, the north and the south have come to advance toward a new future of peace and reunification after putting an end to the era of confrontation. However, there are still many challenges and obstacles blocking the development of the inter-Korean relations and the implementation of the Panmunjom declaration. If the north and the south do not let loose the hands firmly held with each other but invariably adhere to the principle of national independence, the future of a peaceful and prospering reunified country will soon come. When all Koreans at home and abroad unanimously defend and support the historic Panmunjom declaration and turn out in the drive for implementing it, all remnants and deep-rooted evils of the confrontational era will be cleared to advance toward peace and reunification. Let's make a new history of independent reunification with the concerted efforts of all Koreans, true to the noble spirit and patriotic intention for reunification of the top leaders of the north and the south! Rodong News Team

title: Minister of People's Armed Forces Meets Russian Veterans' Union Delegation
body: Army General No Kwang Chol, minister of the People's Armed Forces, Wednesday met and had a talk with the delegation of the Veterans' Union of Russia headed by its Chairman Reserve Army General Mikhail Moiseyev, which paid a courtesy call on him. Rodong News Team

title: Mongolian Guests Leave
body: Zandaakhuu Enkhbold, head of the presidential secretariat of Mongolia, and his party left Pyongyang for home on Wednesday. Rodong News Team

title: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of Great Leaders
body: Servicepersons, working people of various circles, school youth and children of the DPRK visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il on the occasion of the 73rd anniversary of Korea's liberation. Seen standing before the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill was a floral basket from Kim Jong Un, Supreme Leader of the party, state and army. Laid before the statues were floral baskets in the names of the party, armed forces and power organs, social organizations, ministries, national institutions, units of the Korean People's Army and the Korean People's Internal Security Forces and institutions, industrial establishments and schools of various levels in Pyongyang as well as bouquets and flowers. Also placed there was a floral basket in the name of the Pyongyang mission of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front. The visitors paid tribute to the statues. Floral baskets in the names of KPA and KPISF units, institutions and enterprises as well as bouquets and flowers were laid before the statues of the great leaders in various parts of Pyongyang including Kim Il Sung University, Kim Il Sung Military University, the Ministry of the People's Armed Forces and the Ministry of People's Security. Servicepersons, working people and school youth and children throughout the country visited the statues of the great leaders and mosaics depicting their smiling images in their residential quarters to pay homage to them. Rodong News Team

title: MOU Signed between Veterans' Organizations of DPRK and Russia
body: A memorandum of understanding on cooperation was signed between the Korean Committee of Veterans against Imperialism and the Veterans' Union of Russia on Wednesday. It was inked by Army General Pak Jae Gyong, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee of Veterans against Imperialism, and Reserve Army General Mikhail Moiseyev, chairman of the Veterans' Union of Russia. Rodong News Team

title: Russian Embassy Officials Lay Wreaths before Liberation Towers
body: Officials of the Russian embassy here laid a wreath before the Liberation Tower on Wednesday, the 73rd anniversary of Korea's liberation. Among the visitors were Ambassador Alexandr Matsegora and staff members of the embassy, the delegation of the Veterans' Union of Russia led by its Chairman Reserve Army General Mikhail Moiseyev, and diplomatic envoys of various countries. Wreaths in the names of the Russian embassy and the Veterans' Union of Russia were laid and the visitors paid silent tribute to the memory of the martyrs of the Soviet Army who fell in battles for liberating Korea. Officials of the Russian embassy also placed wreaths and bouquets at the grave of martyrs of the Soviet Army in Sadong District. Earlier, they laid bouquets before the liberation towers, statues of the Soviet soldiers, martyrs graves and memorial towers in local areas. Rodong News Team

title: Congratulations to President of Congo
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, Wednesday sent a congratulatory message to Denis Sassou Nguesso, president of the Republic of Congo, on the occasion of the 58th anniversary of its independence. Kim in the message extended congratulations to the president, government and people of Congo, expressing belief that the excellent friendly and cooperative relations between the DPRK and Congo would grow stronger in the future. He sincerely wished the government and people of Congo big successes in the work for the development and prosperity of the country under the wise leadership of their president. Rodong News Team

title: Russian Ambassador Hosts Reception
body: Alexandr Matsegora, Russian ambassador to the DPRK, hosted a reception at the Taedonggang Diplomatic Club on Thursday on the occasion of the 73rd anniversary of Korea's liberation. Invited to the reception were Sin Hong Chol, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, Kim Ik Song, director of the General Bureau for Affairs with Diplomatic Corps, Ri Kwang Gun, vice-minister of External Economic Relations, So Ho Won, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries and chairman of the DPRK-Russia Friendship Association, and others. Present there were staff members of the Russian embassy and a delegation of the Veterans' Union of Russia headed by its Chairman Reserve Army General Mikhail Moiseyev. Speeches were made there. Prior to this, a reception was given at the Russian consulate general in Chongjin. Rodong News Team

title: Friendly Meeting with Chinese Friendship Delegation
body: There was a friendly meeting with a Chinese friendship delegation at Kim Song Ju Primary School on Thursday. Present there were members of the DPRK-China Friendship Association, teachers and pupils of the primary school and members of a Chinese friendship delegation led by Xie Yuan, vice-president of the Chinese People's Association for Friendship with Foreign Countries. The participants went round the classroom visited by President Kim Il Sung, the room dedicated to education in the revolutionary history and the room dedicated to the history of the school. They also enjoyed an art performance by its pupils. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK's High-level Delegation Leaves for Indonesia
body: A DPRK's high-level delegation led by Vice-Premier Ri Ryong Nam left here on Thursday to take part in the opening ceremony of the 18th Asian Games to be held in Jakarta, Indonesia. Rodong News Team

title: 5th National Football Tournament of School Football Teams Held
body: The 5th national football tournament of school football teams took place in Pyongyang from August 7 to 16. The tournament was held, divided into a contest in football rhythmic exercise and football matches. It brought together more than 750 school boys and girls of football teams of primary schools and junior and senior middle schools selected in each province. In the events of primary schools the boy players of Tongan Primary School of the Central District and the girl players of Mangyongdae Primary School of the Mangyongdae District won the prize. In the events of junior middle schools the boy players of Tongsong Junior Middle School of the Central District and the girl players (junior middle class) of Samhung Middle School took the first place. In the events of senior middle schools the boy players of Tongan Senior Middle School of the Central District and the girl players(senior middle class) of Samhung Middle School came first. A prize awarding ceremony was held on Thursday. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Palestinian President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Mahmoud Abbas, president of the State of Palestine, on Wednesday. The Palestinian president in the message said that he is pleased to extend sincere and warm congratulations to Kim Jong Un and, through him, to the government and friendly people of the DPRK on behalf of the State of Palestine and its people and on his own behalf on the liberation day when the Korean people devoted valuable sacrifices to the freedom and dignity. It went on: We regard as pride the historic relations of friendship between our two peoples and the fact that you have always extended unshakable support and solidarity to the Palestinian people in the struggle for terminating the occupation and building an independent state with East Kuds as its capital. We extend congratulations to Your Excellency once again, wishing Your Excellency good health and happiness, and your country and people greater progress and prosperity. Rodong News Team

title: Industrial Publishing House Marks 70th Founding Anniversary
body: The Industrial Publishing House commemorated its 70th founding anniversary in the DPRK. The publishing house is a powerful publication and information service centre of the Workers' Party of Korea for promoting the economic development and development of science and technology of the country by editing and issuing diverse economic and technical publications conducive to putting the national economy on a Juche, modern, IT and scientific basis. President Kim Il Sung founded magazine "Industry" as organ of the Industry Bureau of the People's Committee of North Korea on August 16, Juche 37 (1948), indicated in detail the editorial orientation and led it to make more economic and technical publications. Leader Kim Jong Il took a measure to integrate the publishing organs in all sectors of the national economy as a comprehensive economic and technological publishing centre, fixed the foundation date of the publishing house and led the journalists, editors and officials to dynamically wage the writing and editing to contribute to carrying out the Party's economic policies. For the past seven decades, the publishing house has issued periodicals and books of dozens of varieties and discharged in a responsible manner its duty for arousing the broad segments of people to the building of an economic power. A commemoration meeting was held on Thursday. Rodong News Team

title: Russian Veterans' Union Delegation Visits Mangyongdae
body: A delegation of the Veterans' Union of Russia headed by its Chairman Reserve Army General Mikhail Moiseyev visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. Being briefed on the revolutionary career of the President, the guests looked round the historic relics there. The delegation also toured the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum and the Korean People's Army Museum of Weapons and Equipment. Rodong News Team

title: Japanese Authorities Hit for Suppression of Koreans in Japan
body: A south Korean body called the Citizens' Group for Defending the Korean Schools and Children reportedly held a press conference in Seoul on August 10 to publish an international declaration condemning the Japanese authorities' suppression of Koreans in Japan. The Japanese government is still pursuing a policy of discrimination against the Koreans in Japan, far from making an apology and atonement for its colonial rule over Korea in the past, the speakers charged. They expressed resentment at the base act of the Japanese authorities excluding only Korean schools from the application of the tuition-free program for senior high schools. Noting more than 1 110 peace-loving people in the world and Koreans in the U.S., Germany and Australia signed the international declaration protesting against the discriminative policy of the Japanese authorities, they said they would carry on their struggle until the Japanese authorities include the Korean schools in the list of the application of the tuition-free program. The international declaration protesting the Abe regime's suppression of Koreans and schools in Japan was published there. The declaration said that the Japanese government killed a little boy at the end of its massive suppression of the national education of Koreans in Japan in 1948, and though 70 years have passed since the killing, it still pursues the suppression. Exposing the criminal act of the Japanese custom authorities who confiscated the souvenirs of Korean school students in Japan who came back after visiting the homeland, the declaration expressed resentment at the human rights abuse. As the Korean schools are institutions for national education built by the Koreans who were taken to Japan during Japan's colonial rule over Korea, it deserves the protection by the Japanese government, it noted. Noting that solidarity struggle will be waged for the rights of compatriots, the declaration urged the Japanese authorities to make an apology for the past colonial rule over Korea, lift the hostile policy and the policy of sanctions against the north, halt the suppression of the Koreans in Japan and apply the tuition-free program to the Korean schools in Japan. Rodong News Team

title: Foreigners Visit Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: Foreign guests including a Chinese friendship delegation led by Xie Yuan, vice-president of the Chinese People's Association for Friendship with Foreign Countries, Thursday visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun. The guests paid tribute to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il. At the halls where the great leaders lie in state, the visitors made a bow to them. They went round the halls where orders the great leaders received are on display and halls that house cars, electric car, boat and train coaches used by them for field guidance and foreign tours till the last moments of their lives. Rodong News Team

title: President Kim Il Sung's Exploits Lauded Abroad
body: Lecture meetings took place in DR Congo and Guinea between Aug. 3 and 10 to mark the 73rd anniversary of Korea's liberation. Noting that Aug. 15, 1945 was a significant day when the Korean people could take a new path to development as masters of their own destiny, proud masters of state and society after liberation from the colonial rule by the Japanese imperialists, the chairperson of the Youth Group for the Study of the Juche Idea in DR Congo said: President Kim Il Sung, who embarked on the road of revolution in his teens, set forth the line on accomplishing the historic cause of national liberation by efforts of Koreans and waged the arduous anti-Japanese armed struggle to liberate the country. His exploits will shine long along with the prosperous DPRK through centuries. An official of a Guinean company said: The great HE Kim Il Sung, who liberated Korea through 15-year long anti-Japanese war, aroused all the people to the struggle for liquidating the remnants of the colonial rule by the Japanese imperialists and building a new country. Under the wise guidance of HE Kim Il Sung and HE Kim Jong Il the DPRK had developed into a socialist country of Juche, meeting every challenge of the hostile forces. The Korean people led by HE Kim Jong Un are dynamically advancing along the road of prosperity today. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Birthday to Be Marked in Denmark
body: A preparatory committee for celebrating the 70th birthday of the DPRK was formed in Copenhagen, Denmark on August 10. H. Jacobsen, member of the Leadership of the Central Committee of the Communist Party in Denmark, and Anders Kristensen, chairman of the Denmark-DPRK Friendship Association, were elected as co-chairmen of the preparatory committee. The preparatory committee decided to hold colorful political and cultural events to mark the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Inspects Preparations for Building Onpho Greenhouse Farm
body: The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un gave field guidance to the preparations for construction of the Onpho Greenhouse Farm in Kyongsong County of North Hamgyong Province. One month ago he visited Kyongsong County to appoint the site for a large-scale greenhouse farm capable of raising all sorts of vegetables all the year round. He came to the spot again to guide the preparations for its construction. He acquainted himself with the layout and present situation of the greenhouse farm and toured the area in person. He called for giving priority to the scientific calculation to build the farm at the best level to be flawless in the aspects of not only architectural beauty but also practical utility. He gave instructions to turn the area into the one in which the Party's popular and patriotic policies are embodied by adding to the area a modern tree nursery similar to the Tree Nursery No.122 of the Korean People's Army or the Kangwon Provincial Tree Nursery, given the huge site for the greenhouse farm. Underscoring the need to build the greenhouse farm at the best level by working out the most reasonable plan to suit the specific conditions of our country on the basis of the world's trend of the development of science and technology and in-depth research into the advanced scientific and technical data on greenhouse farming, he set forth tasks and ways for it. He said that the province should give precedence to the work of creating ranks of officials, technicians and employees of the greenhouse along with the construction of the greenhouse and tree nursery so that production and operation can be started straight away after the completion of the construction. The construction of the modern Onpho Greenhouse Farm in Kyongsong County is an important work for bringing benefits to the diet of the people in North Hamgyong Province, he said, calling for finishing the construction of the greenhouse and tree nursery at an early date and converting the area into a "gold land" so as to prove the validity and vitality of the Party's policies in practice and give full play to them. Being told that graduates from Chongjin University of Agriculture advanced to the farm before all others upon the news of construction of a modern greenhouse farm in Kyongsong County, he was very pleased and taught to give high appreciation of them. Accompanying him were Hwang Pyong So, first vice department director of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea, Jo Yong Won, O Il Jong, Pak Song Chol and Kim Yong Su, vice department directors of the C.C., WPK, Kim Chang Son, department director of the State Affairs Commission, and Ma Won Chun, bureau director of the SAC. Political News Team

title: Pak Pong Ju Inspects Namyang Salt Works, Posan Iron Works
body: Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, made field survey of the Namyang Salt Works and the Posan Iron Works. Going round the Namyang Salt Works, Pak highlighted the need to step up the industrialized and intensive salt production from sea water and underground ultra-saline water and to increase production by realizing the comprehensive mechanization. Inspecting the Posan Iron Works, Pak talked about increasing the number of operating days of a furnace, raising the quality of fire-proof material and improving the technical indices of equipment to put the Juche-based iron-making on a normal footing. He also underscored the need to satisfactorily provide good working and living conditions to the workers. The consultative meetings held on the spot discussed the measures for proactively introducing advanced science and technology into production under the unfurled banner of self-reliance and scrupulously organizing coordinated operations among industrial establishments. Rodong News Team

title: Norwegian Party Delegation Visits Mangyongdae
body: A delegation of the Communist Party of Norway headed by International Secretary Svend Haakon Jacobsen visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. The guests looked round the historical relics, being briefed on the story about the birthplace. The delegation also toured the Monument to Party Founding, the Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace, the Mirim Riding Club, etc. Rodong News Team

body: A Chinese friendship delegation led by Xie Yuan, vice-president of the Chinese People's Association for Friendship with Foreign Countries, left Pyongyang for home on Friday. Rodong News Team

body: The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Friday sent a wreath to the bier of Marshal of the Korean People's Army Kim Yong Chun, member of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, deputy to the DPRK Supreme People's Assembly and general adviser of the Ministry of the People's Armed Forces, expressing deep condolences over his death. Rodong News Team

title: Ecuadorian Honorary Citizenship to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un
body: Guaranda City, Bolivar Province of Ecuador, decided to award the title of honorary citizen to the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un on the occasion of the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. HE Kim Jong Un is the defender of peace in the Korean Peninsula and the world, the mayor of the city said, adding that all citizens regard it as their greatest honor to have him as an honorary citizen. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Inspects Construction Sites in Samjiyon County Again
body: The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, with his wife Ri Sol Ju, gave field guidance to the construction sites in Samjiyon County again. He said he came to the construction sites in Samjiyon township just in 40 days but the area has changed beyond recognition, noting with satisfaction that a majestic appearance finally began to emerge as a result of the dynamic struggle of the builders who upheld the Party's intention with loyalty like a white gem to face-lift Samjiyon County where the native home of the revolution is located into a rare modern city in the mountainous area in the era of the Workers' Party. This year marking the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK, dramatic changes are witnessed in the construction sites of Samjiyon County, the Wonsan-Kalma coastal tourist area, power station and others across the country and thus enormous edifices mushroom, and numerous units vie with one another in making big successes, he noted. Now the hostile forces' persistent sanctions and obstructive moves come as a serious setback to the advance of our socialism but the zeal of the elated people who rose up like a mountain in response to the Party's call is making a history of legendary miracles despite the most difficult conditions, he said, adding with great pride that this is a great manifestation of the high spirit of our army and people and the power of our country where everybody gets united in single mind around the Party. We mustn't regard it as a mere construction to remodel the county housing the native home of the revolution but keep a high sense of class consciousness that the construction is like an acute standoff with hostile forces and showily build a modern city in the mountainous area overflowing with our socialist civilization in the first village right at the foot of Mt Paektu, he stressed. Once again emphasizing that the education space with the statue of leader Kim Jong Il should be well built with due respect, he learned about the layout of the background forest of the statue, an assignment he gave one month ago, and about the measures for its implementation. This construction in the northern area to which the Party attaches so much importance is not just aimed to spruce up Samjiyon County alone but it is an important work to create experience and set an example in setting the future goal of face-lifting all the counties to be highly civilized ones, he said. He added that counties in our country have shown great difference in their development due to differing natural and geographic features and economic conditions, stressing the need to create models by sprucing up standard counties and build model counties in the flat areas, mountainous areas and coastal areas before generalizing them. He then went round the construction sites of dwelling houses and public buildings in the township, learning in detail about the overall construction. Highlighting the importance of good designing of afforestation and greening, he called for combining trees of various species to be in good harmony with the mountainous area of Mt Paektu so as to create a model in turning towns into park-like woodland. He also advanced tasks for sprucing up the County People's Hospital to be flawless in health and sanitation terms. He urged the need to take scientific and technological measures to ensure the standard quality of drinking water and water for living supplied to inhabitants in Samjiyon area, and thus to solve the water problem without fail. He also stressed the need to redo the railway roadbed repairing work in a qualitative way by next year to complete Hyesan-Samjiyon railway as a standard one, pointing out the fault that on his way to Samjiyon he could see that the newly paved Hyesan-Samjiyon railway section roadbed was not done well and scientific measurement and the requirement of technical method of construction was not ensured in terms of roadbed condition and evenness so that serious vibration could be felt on train and its speed was impeded. Calling for making the builders and skilled men acquire one step higher grade in the course of doing such a huge project as the construction of Samjiyon area and for rapidly strengthening the construction and designing force of the local areas, he underlined the importance to organize in a planned way with big efforts the work for strengthening construction technicians. He made the particular mention of the role the provincial Party committee plays in taking control of the work of enhancing the level of designing institutions in the local areas. He repeatedly stressed the importance to take measures against all kinds of accidents while doing projects as required by the method of construction by design and thus prevent even a single accident. He also mentioned the need to make good calculation of the total electricity demand to be needed by the county after its rebuilding, calling for readjusting and reinforcing the existent small and medium power stations in Samjiyon County and meticulously organizing their management and operation so as to increase electricity production by the county itself. Looking at the stirring construction site, he said that the whole country is devoting pure conscience and sweats of obligation to sprucing up the county housing the native home of leader Kim Jong Il as their own house at the call of the Party, and warmly asked to convey his comradely greetings to all the builders surely. Accompanying him were Hwang Pyong So, first vice department director of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea, Jo Yong Won, Pak Song Chol, Kim Yong Hwan and Kim Yong Su, vice department directors of the C.C., WPK, Kim Chang Son, department director of the State Affairs Commission, and Ma Won Chun, bureau director of the SAC. Political News Team

title: Home-visiting Group of Koreans in Japan Leaves
body: The home-visiting group of Koreans in Japan led by Han Pong Hui, vice department director of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan, left Pyongyang on Saturday. Rodong News Team

title: Meeting of Japanese Regional Committee for Implementing June 15 Joint Declaration
body: The 10th general meeting of the Japanese regional committee of the Overseas Side Committee for Implementing June 15 Joint Declaration was held in Tokyo on August 9. Among those present were Son Hyong Gun, chairman of the regional committee and chairman of the Association for Democracy and Unification of South Koreans in Japan, its Honorary Chairperson An Pyong Ok, its Vice-Chairpersons So Chung On, director of the Department for International Affairs and Reunification of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), and Ri Tong Je, chairman of the Association of Koreans in Japan for Peaceful Reunification, and other members of the regional committee, and the permanent representative of the South Side Committee for Implementing June 15 Joint Declaration. A solidarity message from the North Side Committee for Implementing June 15 Joint Declaration was read out at the meeting. Chairman Son Hyong Gun in a report underlined the need for the regional committee to actively conduct diverse information activities to firmly preserve the Panmunjom declaration as the landmark for reunification common to all Koreans. The regional committee, in hearty response to the nation-wide solidarity and alliance movement of the compatriots in the north and the south and abroad for implementing the Panmunjom declaration, will play a positive role in holding with splendor the joint national event to be hosted in Pyongyang on the occasions of the 11th anniversary of the publication of the October 4 declaration and the Foundation Day of Korea, he said. He stressed the need to strengthen the regional committee as required by the new era and help the Koreans of various circles in Japan turn out in the drive for implementing the Panmunjom declaration. Speeches were made. Rodong News Team

title: Reinstatement of Ex-official of Ministry of Education Opposed in S. Korea
body: According to south Korea news, Ra Hyang Uk, former policy planning official of the Ministry of Education of south Korea, was reinstated, provoking public criticism. Ra angered people of various circles for branding them as dogs and pigs. On Aug. 10 the Ministry of Education appointed Ra Hyang Uk as a section chief of the training institute under the ministry. The south Korean people demand that Ra make an apology for insulting them and the ministry immediately dismiss him. Rodong News Team

title: Solution to Issue of Sexual Slavery Demanded in S. Korea
body: According to the south Korean MBC, the 1348th Wednesday meeting and world solidarity action were held outside the Japanese embassy in Seoul on Aug. 15 in demand of the settlement of the issue of the sexual slavery for the Imperial Japanese Army. Attending there were more than 8 000 persons including students, citizens, sexual victims of various countries and the "south Korean Youth League in Japan" . A statement was issued there. The statement said that the solution to the issue of the sexual slavery for the imperial Japanese army is a way for eradicating wartime sexual violence worldwide and ensuring peace. On the same day, solidarity meetings took place in 43 places of ten countries to disclose and denounce the sexual slavery committed by Japan in the past. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Birthday to Be Marked in Thailand
body: A Thai preparatory committee for celebrating the 70th birthday of the DPRK was formed on August 10. Songchit Pullarp, chairman of the Organization for the Study of the Juche Idea of Thailand, was elected as chairman of the preparatory committee. The preparatory committee decided to bring out a work of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and hold colorful political and cultural events, including a seminar, meeting and film show, from Aug. 11 to Sep. 10. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Birthday to Be Marked in South Africa
body: A preparatory committee for celebrating the 70th birthday of the DPRK was formed by the South African Communist Party on August 10. Blade Nzimande, general secretary of the Central Committee of the South African Communist Party, was elected chairperson of the preparatory committee. The preparatory committee set a celebration period from Aug. 10 to Sep. 10 and decided to hold colorful political and cultural events. Rodong News Team

title: Congratulations to Malian President-Elect
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, Saturday sent a congratulatory message to Ibrahim Boubacar Keita on his reelection as president of the Republic of Mali. Expressing the belief that the friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries would grow stronger in the future, the message wished the Malian people bigger success in their struggle for achieving the country's stability and social development under the guidance of the president. Rodong News Team

title: 4th Ari Sports Cup U-15 Int'l Football Tournament Closes
body: The 4th Ari Sports Cup U-15 Int'l Football Tournament closed. Eight football teams, divided into two groups, played matches in the group league and on a diagonal match basis. The final match took place between the April 25 team and the team of Pyongyang International Football School of the DPRK at Kim Il Sung Stadium on Saturday. The April 25 team defeated its rival 6:5 to be on a four winning streak. Prior to the final match, there was a congratulatory match between the U-15 women's football players of the north and the south of Korea. Rodong News Team

title: Japanese Reactionaries’ Don Quixote-style Way of Thinking
body: Japanese Foreign Minister Kono at the recent ministerial meeting of the ASEAN Regional Forum talked rubbish that it is needed to keep sanctions on the DPRK for its complete denuclearization and block its attempt to evade sanctions, adding Japan would actively cooperate in doing so. When meeting a high-ranking UN official who visited Nagasaki, he said sanctions should be continuously slapped against the DPRK and every country should honestly carry out the sanctions resolution. This is a Don Quixote-style way of thinking. Now Russia, China and many other countries are strongly demanding that the sanctions on the DPRK should be lifted as the statute of limitations ran out. Only Japan is blustering as if it has faced a big disaster. It is working hard to check the trend of the times going favorably. Now it is resorting to clumsy solicitation diplomacy, going here and there with the issues of sanctions and abduction to ask other countries to put pressure on the DPRK. What did Japan get from that ill behavior? It has been left alone in the region, being branded as a country of pigmy politicians engaged in abnormal view on things and phenomena, anachronistic thought and stupid and unbecoming conduct. Japan will be left alone forever as a lonely island country if it persistently behaves like Don Quixote. Ri Hak Nam

title: Nullification of "Agreement" on Sexual Slavery Urged in S. Korea
body: The parliamentary spokesman for the Minju Party of south Korea on August 15 pressed for the nullification of the "agreement" on the sexual slavery for the Imperial Japanese Army signed under the Park Geun Hye regime, according to the south Korean Yonhap News. He said that the "government" should declare the nullification of the humiliating "agreement", a legacy of the Park regime, and clarify that it would not implement the "agreement". Rodong News Team

title: Birthday of DPRK to Be Marked in Uganda
body: A preparatory committee for the celebrating the 70th birthday of the DPRK was inaugurated in Uganda on August 13. Mayambala Lawrence, chairman of the Ugandan National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee decided to host diverse political and cultural events including seminar and lecture on the occasion of the 70th birthday of the DPRK. Rodong News Team

title: Birthday of DPRK to Be Marked in Russia
body: Preparatory committees for celebrating the 70th birthday of the DPRK were formed by Russian political parties and organizations from August 9 to 14. Dolgachev, first secretary of the Maritime Territorial Regional Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation and chairman of the Association for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism in the Far East Region, M. A. Suraikin, chairman of the Central Committee of the Communist Party "Russian Communists", Vadim Kudimin, director of the Russian Institute of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, Dmitri Kostenko, chairman of the Russian Association for the Study of the Juche Idea, and V. P. Isakov, first secretary of the Central Committee of the Lenin Young Communist League of the Russian Federation, were elected chairpersons of the preparatory committees. The preparatory committee decided to give wide publicity to the exploits of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il for the foundation and development of the DPRK and the reality of prospering Juche Korea through media, and host various political and cultural events. Rodong News Team

title: Birthday of DPRK to Be Celebrated in Serbia
body: A Serbian national preparatory committee for celebrating the 70th birthday of the DPRK was inaugurated in Belgrade on August 10. Marijann Kubik, international secretary of the New Yugoslav Communist Party, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The preparatory committee fixed a celebration period from August 10 to September 11 and decided to hold various political and cultural events in praise of the undying exploits of President Kim Il Sung, leader Kim Jong Il and the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un for the foundation and development of the DPRK in the period. Rodong News Team

title: 8th Rason International Trade Exhibition Opens
body: The 8th Rason International Trade Exhibition opened. Displayed at the venue of the exhibition are light industry and electrical and electronic products, building materials, food and consumer goods, medicines, vehicles, etc. presented by more than 120 units of the DPRK, China, Russia, Germany, Canada and other countries. An opening ceremony was held in Rason City on Monday. At the end of the ceremony the participants went round the exhibition venue. There was a reception that day to mark the opening of the exhibition. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK High-level Delegation Meets Indonesian President, Party Leader
body: A high-level delegation of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea led by Vice-Premier Ri Ryong Nam met Joko Widodo, president of the Republic of Indonesia, in a friendly atmosphere on August 18. The delegation is visiting Indonesia to take part in the opening ceremony of the 18th Asian Games. The delegation also met Megawati Soekarnoputri, general chairwoman of the Central Directive Council of the Indonesian Democratic Party of Struggle, in a friendly atmosphere on Saturday. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Inspects Myohyangsan Medical Appliances Factory
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the Korean People's Army, inspected the Myohyangsan Medical Appliances Factory. Looking round the room for education in the revolutionary history, sci-tech learning space and various workshops of the factory, the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un learned in detail about the production of medical appliances. Recalling that the Party had already given policies several times to remodel and modernize the units associated with leadership exploits of the great leaders including the Myohyangsan Medical Appliances Factory and turn them into model ones after the Seventh Congress of the Party by taking issue with the serious situation that the public health sector almost failed to do the work for consolidating its material and technical foundation in recent years, he said he cannot but be very concerned about and disappointed by the bad situation of the factory. He noted that he could not understand whether the factory was under remodeling and modernization or not and what had been remodeled and modernized as he could not see any sign of remodeling though it has been two years since the Party gave a warning to it. Other sectors have made remarkable leaps forward in recent years, but the public health sector has never done so but become more and more passive, he said, noting that there is nothing to be proud of in the public health sector, except the modern hospitals, the Medical Oxygen Factory and the Dental Hygiene Products Factory recently built under direct control of the Party. There is no unit keeping its environment well in the public health sector, to say nothing of equipment modernization, he charged. The Party has stressed the need to intensify its guidance over the public health work and called for the Cabinet and the people's power organs at all levels to fully discharge their responsibility and role in the work for consolidating the material and technical foundation of the public health sector as the public health policy in our country is premised on the state investment and supply of materials, but officials are very idle and irresponsible in doing so, he pointed out. The room for education in the revolutionary history is not so good in contrast with those of other units, and from the poor arrangement of the sci-tech learning space one can easily know with what ideological viewpoint the Party organizations in the public health sector accepted the Party policy on raising the hot wind of sci-tech study, and the hot wind for sci-tech learning can never be raised here, he said, criticizing the organizations for executing the Party policy in a very perfunctory manner. He earnestly called for successfully turning the Myohyangsan Medical Appliances Factory, which President Kim Il Sung founded and paid deep attention to till the last moments of his life, into the model one playing the leading role in the industry of medical appliances to realize his wishes and glorify his leadership exploits down through generations. It is necessary to stand in the van by destroying and transforming the outdated ones, not losing the heart, he said, adding that they should not repair some old buildings only but arrange the production environment, as required by the international standards, and modernize the production processes on the basis of the latest science and technology and turn the factory into the ultra-modern one capable of producing highly efficient quality medical equipment and appliances meeting the international standard. He called for newly building the Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism Study Hall and the room for education in the revolutionary history, and sci-tech learning space, products exhibition room and cultural and welfare facilities fashionably, and production buildings with scientific calculation, underlining the need to study the measures for radically improving the levels of domestic production, automation and modernization of medical appliances factories. He stressed the need to turn medical appliances factories of the country into modern ones producing excellent medical facilities on the basis of advanced science and technology by making practical annual and stage plans of three to four years and dynamically pushing forward the work through strict reviews on the execution of the plans in order for the prospective development of the industry of medical appliances. Calling on the officials and employees of the factory to turn out as one in the drive for its updating with consciousness of being the master, he said he would send the first Chollima of the public health sector to the factory, and encouraged them to take the lead in the public health sector and the industry of medical appliances of our country by riding on the Chollima. Noting that he would personally shoulder the burden of the work of updating the factory, he detailed the orientation to carry out the tasks facing the relevant fields. He was accompanied by Hwang Pyong So, first vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea; Jo Yong Won, Kim Yong Hwan, Pak Song Chol, O Il Jong and Kim Yong Su, vice department directors of the C.C., WPK; Kim Chang Son, department director of the State Affairs Commission; and Ma Won Chun, bureau director of the SAC. Political News Team

title: Funeral Service for Kim Yong Chun Held
body: A state funeral for Marshal of the Korean People's Army Kim Yong Chun, member of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, deputy to the DPRK Supreme People's Assembly and general adviser to the Ministry of the People's Armed Forces, solemnly took place here on Monday. Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the Korean People's Army, attended the ceremony of bidding the last farewell to the deceased. There was a ceremony of carrying the coffin out of the April 25 House of Culture. Members of the state funeral committee were on hand. The coffin was carried out of the house amid the playing of the funeral music. The armored car carrying the coffin left for the Patriotic Martyrs Cemetery in Sinmi-ri, escorted by motorcycles. In streets of the capital including Pipha Street, Hasin Street and Ryonmot-dong, men and officers of the KPA and the Korean People's Internal Security Forces and Pyongyangites bid farewell to the deceased in deep sorrow. A ceremony of bidding the last farewell to the deceased took place at the Patriotic Martyrs Cemetery in Sinmi-ri. Supreme Leader of the Party, state and army Kim Jong Un climbed the cemetery with members of the state funeral committee following the coffin. Army General Kim Su Gil, director of the KPA General Political Bureau, made a eulogy. He said that the career of Kim Yong Chun was a glorious life in which he enjoyed the most worthy life as a revolutionary under the warm and special loving care of President Kim Il Sung, leader Kim Jong Il and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and a brilliant life of a prominent political activist and skilful military cadre who had faithfully upheld the idea and leadership of the Party with his transparent revolutionary faith in the forefront for defending the leader, the revolution and the country. Although Marshal Kim Yong Chun passed away, his exploits will remain long in the history of the country, he stressed. The remains of the deceased were buried amid the playing of funeral music and the firing of a volley for the deceased. Kim Jong Un spread earth on the remains with his bitter mind as he lost the revolutionary comrade-in-arms intensely loyal to the Party. Leading officials of the armed forces organs and bereaved family members spread earth on the remains. Placed before the grave was a wreath bearing the august name of Kim Jong Un, wreaths in the names of the Central Committee and the Central Military Commission of the WPK, the Presidium of the DPRK Supreme People's Assembly and the DPRK Cabinet amid the playing of wreath-laying music. Kim Jong Un observed a moment's silence in memory of Kim Yong Chun. Members of the state funeral committee, bereaved family members and officials of the Party and armed forces' organs observed a moment's silence in memory of the deceased. Political News Team

title: Japanese Reactionaries’ Suppression of Chongryon and Koreans in Japan
body: Some days ago, the Japanese police searched the house and office of the vice managing director and concurrently international director of the Korean Football Association in Japan on the charge of dealing which violated UN sanctions resolution against the DPRK and Japan’s “law on foreign exchange”. The police gangsters seized his hand phone, computer and documents in brigandish search from early morning to early morning of the next day. This is a dreary scene which can be seen only under the Japanese-style “law-governed” system full of the extreme hostility and vicious prejudice against the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) and Koreans in Japan. The reckless move reveals the wickedness and despicableness peculiar to Japan to justify the criminal act of stamping out Chongryon by massively building the anti-Chongryon atmosphere in the society and its national chauvinistic dirty political climate. It is a sinister intention of the Japanese reactionaries to cut down the bloody link between the motherland and officials of Chongryon and Koreans in Japan by suppressing and persecuting them on groundless charges. Their suppression of Chongryon and Koreans in Japan can never be pardoned as it is a vicious political provocation to the DPRK and a wanton infringement on human rights and humanitarianism. It is the consistent stand and unshakable will of the DPRK to regard any persecution and suppression of Chongryon and Koreans in Japan as a grave infringement upon the dignity and sovereignty of the DPRK and take resolute counteraction. Ho Yong Min

title: Delegation of Academy of Social Sciences Back Home
body: A scholars delegation of the Academy of Social Sciences led by Vice-President So Kwang Ung returned home on Tuesday after taking part in an international symposium on Koreanology held in China. Rodong News Team

title: National Sci-Tech Presentation of Metal Industry Field Held
body: A national sci-tech presentation of the metal industry field took place at the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex on Monday and Tuesday under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea. Participating in the presentation were scientists, technicians, teachers, three-revolution team members, workers and officials of different units including the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex, Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex, Chollima Steel Complex, Steel Designing Institute under the Ministry of Metallurgical Industry, Ferrous Metal Research Institute of the State Academy of Sciences and Kim Chaek University of Technology. Published there were more than 140 papers dealing with the successes and experience gained in the course of settling the scientific and technological matters for further rounding off the Juche-based system of producing iron, raising the productivity and quality and expanding the variety of rolled steel. During the presentation there were a lecture on the production process at the oxygen heat blast furnace and a visit to the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK High-Level Delegation Back Home
body: A high-level delegation of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea led by Vice-Premier Ri Ryong Nam returned home on Tuesday after taking part in the opening ceremony of the 18th Asian Games held in Jakarta, Indonesia. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Players Bag Gold Medals in 18th Asian Games
body: DPRK players won gold medals in weightlifting and wrestling of the 18th Asian Games. Om Yun Chol placed first in men's weightlifting 56 kg category on Aug. 20, lifting 127 kg in snatch and 160 kg in jerk, 287kg in total. Ri Song Gum bagged a gold medal in women's weightlifting 48 kg category, lifting 87 kg in snatch and 112 kg in jerk, 199 kg in total. Women wrestlers Pak Yong Mi and Jong Myong Suk bagged gold medals in women's 53kg and 57kg categories. Kang Kum Song won a silver medal in men's freestyle wresting 57kg category and Kim Son Hyang a bronze medal in women's wrestling 50 kg category and Rim Jong Sim a bronze medal in women's wrestling 62kg category. Rodong News Team

title: Birthday of DPRK to Be Celebrated in Belarus
body: A Belarusian preparatory committee for celebrating the 70th birthday of the DPRK was formed in Minsk on August 11. L. Shukolinikov, chairman of the Permanent Standing Committee of the Belarus National Association of Friends of Korean People Named after Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il, was elected as chairman of the preparatory committee. The preparatory committee decided to hold various political and cultural events to mark the birthday of the DPRK. Rodong News Team

title: Important Days of DPRK Observed Abroad
body: There took place meetings and book and photo exhibitions in Russia, Switzerland and Romania from August 6 to 14 to mark the Day of Songun and the 73rd anniversary of Korea's liberation. Public personages and masses in those countries attended the events. The chief of the Center of Korean Culture in Sankt-Peterburg of Russia noted: President Kim Il Sung is a peerlessly great man who founded the Juche idea, built a socialist country independent in politics, self-supporting in the economy and self-reliant in defence in Korea and thus performed gigantic exploits to be eternally recorded in the human history. HE Kim Jong Il is an outstanding leader who laid an eternal foundation for building a powerful country by leading the party, state and army of the DPRK along the road of victory. Under the guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un the DPRK is registering world-startling miracles one after another. The chairman of the Switzerland-Korea Committee praised Kim Il Sung for accomplishing the historic cause of national liberation through the hard-fought anti-Japanese war and turning the DPRK into a socialist fortress, and Kim Jong Il for firmly defending the sovereignty and dignity of the country through the Songun revolutionary leadership. Thanks to the wise guidance of respected HE Kim Jong Un, the DPRK has emerged a full-fledged strategic state, he noted, adding the reunification of Korea and the victory of the socialist cause are sure to be achieved as the DPRK is led by the prominent leader. A congratulatory message to the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was adopted at the event in Switzerland. Rodong News Team

title: Int'l Preparatory Committee for Marking DPRK's Birthday Inaugurated
body: An international preparatory committee for celebrating the 70th birthday of the DPRK was inaugurated on August 14. Mikhail Panchenko, general secretary of the International Alliance of Societies for the Study of the Juche Idea and Songun Policy in East European and Central Asian Regions, was elected as chairman of the preparatory committee. The preparatory committee decided to hold diverse political and cultural events in praise of the exploits of President Kim Il Sung. Rodong News Team

title: Birthday of DPRK to Be Celebrated in Arab Region
body: An Arab regional preparatory committee for celebrating the 70th birthday of the DPRK was inaugurated on August 12. Yehia Zakaria Khairullah, vice-chairman of the Socialist Freedom Party of Egypt, and Zaher al Khatib, chairman of the Lebanese Committee for Support to the Reunification of Korea, were elected as co-chairmen of the preparatory committee. The preparatory committee decided to hold diverse political and cultural events in the celebration period from August 12 to September 11. Rodong News Team

title: Implementation of Panmunjom Declaration Ensures Peace, Prosperity and Reunification
body: It is important to strictly implement the Panmunjom declaration in order to develop the inter-Korean relations in keeping with the desire of the nation and the demand of the times and actively steer the trend of peace, prosperity and independent reunification. The declaration is a great programme for independent reunification as it indicates the most correct way for reconnecting the severed blood vessels of the nation and the divided territory and opening a broad avenue for national reconciliation and unity, peace and reunification. It is, indeed, the most realistic and reasonable reunification programme common to the nation, which entirely conforms with the will and desire of the whole nation and the aspirations of the international community for peace and reunification of the Korean peninsula. The thorough-going and sincere implementation of the declaration leads to the sustained development of north-south relations, peace, the prosperity common to the nation and national reunification. For the full implementation of the declaration, the adoption of war-end declaration is a task that brooks no further delay. Its adoption is of weighty significance in ensuring the peace and security of the Korean peninsula and the world, to say nothing of the confidence-building between the DPRK and the U.S. and the improvement of their relations. There is no need to read someone’s face and hesitate over the implementation of the declaration related to the destiny and interests of the Korean nation. It is very important to value and implement the Panmunjom declaration for the development of the north-south relations and peace, prosperity and reunification of the Korean peninsula. No challenge and obstructions of the anti-reunification forces can keep the Korean people from opening a broad avenue for independent reunification through the implementation of the declaration. Sim Chol Yong

title: Chongryon Delegation's Sojourn in Pyongyang
body: A delegation of educational officials of Chongryon (General Association of Korean Residents in Japan) led by Pak Ku Ryong, principal of Gifu Korean Elementary and Secondary School, visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. The visitors looked round the historical relics at the old home of the President, being briefed on his revolutionary career. The delegation also toured Pyongyang Teacher Training College, the Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace, etc. Rodong News Team

title: Exhibition of Sci-Tech Achievements Made by Youth
body: A national youth exhibition of scientific and technological successes was opened with due ceremony at the Sci-Tech Complex on Wednesday. The exhibition will show the achievements made by young people across the country in the brisk youth sci-tech movement. On display there are over 100 scientific and technological achievements and 700-odd inventions presented by the youth league organizations at all levels including the youth league committees in all provinces. Present at the opening ceremony were Choe Hwi, vice-chairman of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea, Ri Chung Gil, chairman of the State Science and Technology Commission, officials of the youth league, young scientists and technicians, working youths and the Three-revolution Team members. Rodong News Team

title: UNEP Executive Director Arrives
body: Erik Solheim, executive director of United Nations Environment Programme, and his party arrived in Pyongyang on Wednesday. Rodong News Team

title: 8th National Peasant Dance Contest
body: The 8th national peasant dance contest took place in Phyongsong and Hamhung cities on August 19 and 22, divided into the western coastal area and the eastern coastal area, on the occasion of the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. Attending it were working people of different farms selected through provincial contests. The participants presented the traditional peasant dance pieces which have been encouraged during their worthwhile labor and on folk holidays. Commendations were awarded to units and participants who were highly estimated at the contest. Rodong News Team

title: Trade Union Members Tour Revolutionary Battle Sites in Mt Paektu Area
body: Tour of the revolutionary battle sites in the area of Mt Paektu was made by officials and members of the trade union organizations across the country from August 13 to 22 on the occasion of the 58th anniversary of leader Kim Jong Il's start of the Songun revolutionary leadership. At Pochonbo, they placed a floral basket and bouquets before the statue of President Kim Il Sung on the shore of Stream Karim and made a bow to him. At the Rimyongsu Revolutionary Site, Chongbong and Konchang Bivouacs and other places, they looked back with deep emotion on the undying exploits of Kim Jong Il, who made sure that the revolutionary tradition of Mt Paektu further shined century after century. They held an oath-taking meeting before the Samjiyon Grand Monument. They toured the Paektusan Hero Youth Power Station, Sinsadong Revolutionary Battle Site and the Monument to the Victorious Battle of Musan Area before climbing Mt Paektu. Visiting Kim Jong Il's birthplace in the Paektusan Secret Camp, they called back the undying revolutionary life of the peerlessly great man, seeing the historical relics preserved there. Then they visited Kwangson Photographic Studio and Sokjon Tailor's at the Sinpha Revolutionary Site associated with the revolutionary activities of anti-Japanese war heroine Kim Jong Suk. During the tour, they went to the construction sites of Samjiyon Township, and held colorful political and cultural events including a meeting to hear impressions of the reminiscences of anti-Japanese guerillas read by them and a question-and-answer study contest. Rodong News Team

title: UNEP Official Visits Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Leader Kim Jong Il
body: Erik Solheim, executive director of United Nations Environment Programme, and his party Wednesday visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill to pay homage. They laid a bouquet before the statues and made a bow. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK's Birthday to be Marked in India
body: An Indian preparatory committee for celebrating the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK was formed on Aug. 13. Atul Kumar Anjan, secretary of the National Council of the Communist Party of India, was elected as chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee decided to organize colorful political and cultural events praising the exploits of the peerlessly great men in the period from Aug. 13 to Sept. 9. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK's Birthday to be Marked in Norway
body: A preparatory committee for celebrating the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK was formed in Fredrikstad of Norway on Aug. 12. Dag Norum, chairman of the Ostfold County Committee of the Communist Party of Norway, was elected as chairman of the preparatory committee. The preparatory committee decided to hold various political and cultural events in celebration of the 70th birthday of the DPRK. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK's Birthday to be Marked in Ukraine
body: A Ukrainian preparatory committee for celebrating the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK was formed in Kiev on Aug. 12. Konstantin Doroshenko, chairman of the "Sun of Juche" Association of Journalists and Men of Culture for the Study of Kimjongilism in Ukraine, was elected as chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee decided to give wide publicity to the proud reality of the DPRK through media and hold colorful political and cultural events. Rodong News Team

title: Victory of Socialism Is Truth
body: Today the imperialists noisily tout the eternity of capitalism, getting hell-bent on mud-slinging against socialism.
