But this is no more than a last-ditch effort to get rid of their miserable fate as they are mired in the abyss of ruin due to serious political and economic crisis. For its true nature the capitalist system can never overcome inequality in material life and imbalance between material life and impoverished mental and cultural life and between the popular masses’ demand for independence and the political life getting reactionary. Victory of socialism is truth and law of historical development. It is truth that the capitalist society based on individualism turns into the socialist society based on collectivism. The ideal of socialism has embodied the intrinsic demand of a social being who wants to live and develop as an independent social being. The intrinsic nature of social human being whose life and soul is independence can never change. And so the ideal of socialism embodying it cannot change at all. Since socialism is the ideal and future of humankind, it is sure to emerge victorious despite all challenges of history. It is clearly proved in the reality of the DPRK where the socialist ideal has been fully embodied. Politicians and bourgeois theorists of the U.S. and other capitalist countries admit that Korean-style socialism is a genuine one and its victory is inevitable. As the world unanimously recognized, the reality of the DPRK is potent evidence that victory of socialism is truth and law of historical development. Jo Thaek Bom

title: Birthday of DPRK to Be Celebrated by Communist Party of Soviet Union
body: A joint preparatory committee for celebrating the 70th birthday of the DPRK composed of personages of political parties and organizations under the Communist Party of the Soviet Union was inaugurated on August 14. The preparatory committee chaired by Mozgovoy, first secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union and chairman of the International Social Federation "For the Union and Union's Communist Party", consists of personages of political parties and organizations including the Communist Party of Kyrgyzstan, the Communist Workers Party of Russia, the Communist Workers' Party of Belarus, the Communist Party of Azerbaijan and the Russian Association for Friendship and Cultural Cooperation with the DPRK. The preparatory committee decided to hold diverse political and cultural events to mark the 70th birthday of the DPRK. Rodong News Team

title: Birthday of DPRK to Be Celebrated in Guinea
body: A Guinean national preparatory committee for celebrating the 70th birthday of the DPRK was inaugurated with due ceremony in Conakry on August 14. Riyad Chaloub, chairman of the Guinean National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee and plans of diverse political and cultural events were discussed at the ceremony. Rodong News Team

title: Birthday of DPRK to Be Marked in Finland
body: A preparatory committee for celebrating the 70th birthday of the DPRK was inaugurated in Helsinki, Finland on August 13. Juha Kieksi, international secretary of the Finnish Communists' League, and Pekka Kotkasaari, chairman of the Finland-Korea Society, were elected co-chairmen of the preparatory committee. The preparatory committee decided to hold diverse political and cultural events including a meeting, book and photo exhibition and film show to mark the 70th birthday of the DPRK. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Printed in Russia
body: The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us Brilliantly Accomplish the Revolutionary Cause of Juche, Holding the Great Comrade Kim Jong Il in High Esteem as the Eternal General Secretary of Our Party" was brought out in booklet at the Leto-print Publishing House of Russia on the occasion of the Day of Songun and the 73rd anniversary of Korea's liberation. The work, published on April 6, Juche 101 (2012), says it is the principled requirement for the victorious advance of the Korean revolution to hold leader Kim Jong Il in high esteem as the eternal general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea. It also indicates the tasks for steadily developing the WPK into the glorious party of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il. A book releasing ceremony took place on Aug. 17. Rodong News Team

title: Sci-tech Presentation in Textile Industry Field
body: A national sci-tech presentation in the field of textile industry took place at the Central Light Industrial Sample Exhibition on Aug. 22-23 under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea. Attending it were researchers, teachers, technicians and field officials in scientific, educational and textile industrial fields including the Textile Institute of the Management Bureau for the Textile, Pyongyang Han Tok Su University of Light Industry, the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill and the Sariwon Textile Mill. Introduced there were over 40 valuable papers showing the achievements made in the efforts for remodeling the equipment and production processes of textile mills with labor- and electricity-saving ones and producing quality textile goods with indigenous raw and other materials. During the presentation, there was also a lecture on the usage of PP fiber. Rodong News Team

title: Sci-Tech Presentation in Chemical Industry Field
body: A national sci-tech presentation in the chemical industrial field took place at Anju University of Technology on Aug. 22-23 under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea. Attending it were officials, teachers, researchers and postgraduates of various units including Kim Il Sung University, Hamhung University of Chemical Engineering, the Ministry of Chemical Industry, the Hamhung Branch of the State Academy of Sciences and the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex. Presented to it, divided into panels of C-1 chemical industry, phosphate fertilizer, catalyzer and rare-earth application technology, were more than 100 valuable papers conducive to putting the chemical industry field on a higher level. During the presentation, its participants conducted exchange activities for generalizing the successes and experience gained in putting the chemical industry on a Juche and modern basis. Rodong News Team

title: UNEP Executive Director Visits Central Tree Nursery
body: Erik Solheim, executive director of the United Nations Environment Programme, and his party visited the Central Tree Nursery under the Ministry of Land and Environment Protection on Thursday. Being briefed on the fact that the tree nursery was built as a modern sapling production base, the visitors went round the room dedicated to the history of the nursery, hard glass greenhouse and scientific research room. They also toured the e-library of Kim Il Sung University. Rodong News Team

title: Sci-tech Presentation in Field of Green Architecture
body: A national sci-tech presentation in the field of green architecture took place at the Paektusan Institute of Architecture on August 22-23 under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea. Attending it were officials, teachers, researchers, designers and graduate students of different units, including the Paektusan Institute of Architecture, the Green Architecture Institute of the State Academy of Sciences and Pyongyang University of Architecture. The presentation, divided into panels of green architecture and construction, environment and green building materials, heard over 70 valuable scientific and technological successes gained in the researches for developing the latest architecture technology. Exchanged there were views on the issues arising in producing various green building materials including energy and resources saving building materials and building materials for protection of environment and health. During the presentation there was a sci-tech lecture on the trend of developing zero-energy architecture technology. Rodong News Team

title: Sports Games Mark Day of Songun
body: Sports events were held in Pyongyang on Saturday on the occasion of the Day of Songun. Enjoying the games were officials concerned, working people and school youth and children in Pyongyang. There were men's football game between the Kigwancha team and Sobaeksu team at Kim Il Sung Stadium. The Kigwancha team beat its rival team 1:0. At the Taekwondo Hall there were team sparring games between men and women players of the Taekwon-do Players Team of the Korean Taekwon-Do Committee and the Pyongyang City Taekwon-Do Players Team. Men players of the Taekwon-do Players Team of the Korean Taekwon-Do Committee and women players of the Pyongyang City Taekwon-Do Players Team respectively placed first. There was a demonstration performance of players of the Taekwon-Do Players Team of the Korean Taekwon-Do Committee at the end of the games. There were also wrestling games of players of Amnokgang, Kigwancha and Pyongyang Sports Teams at Combat Sports Gymnasium in Chongchun Street. Kim Ju Song of the Amnokgang Sports Team and Ri Se Ung of the Pyongyang Sports Team placed first in the games, divided in two classes. Rodong News Team

title: 40th Anniversary of International Friendship Exhibition House Open Marked
body: The International Friendship Exhibition House marked the 40th anniversary of its open. The International Friendship Exhibition House is the only gift exhibition house reflecting the sincerity of all people and the great treasure house of Juche Korea conveying long the great glory and pride of the era of the Workers' Party to posterity. President Kim Il Sung made sure that the International Friendship Exhibition House was built in Mt Myohyang and then he personally came to the spot on August 26, Juche 67 (1978) to declare the exhibition house open. And the President visited it several times and gave important teachings to glorify generation after generation the pride that has come for the first time to the nation's history spanning 5 000 years. Leader Kim Jong Il set up a regular work system of preserving and taking care of the precious gifts reflecting the dignity of Kim Il Sung's nation and clarified the principles to be maintained in the exhibition of gifts and their explanation and promotion. He also left the noble footprints of leadership to the House till the last moments of his noble life. For the past 40 years the House has recorded the proud history along with the victorious advance of the Korean revolution, while remaining true to the noble mission of glorifying all over the world the personality of the leaders as the great men and the dignity of the country. A meeting took place to mark the anniversary on Saturday. Rodong News Team

title: Pak Pong Ju Inspects Agricultural Field
body: Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, inspected Kulloja Cooperative Farm in Sinchon County, Chimchon Cooperative Farm in Hwangju County, Unha Cooperative Farm in Onchon County and other farms and units of agricultural science research in South and North Hwanghae Provinces and Nampho City. Going round farms, construction sites and experimental plots, Pak learned about damage by natural disaster and crop growth, underscoring the need to actively introduce scientific farming method, raise the quality level of the construction projects and step up the research into the rice strains of salt resistance for tideland-turned rice field and its introduction. The consultative meetings held on the spots reviewed the successes and faults in carrying out the goals of the five-year strategy for national economic development, discussed immediate and long-term plans and measures for implementing the Party's policies for the agricultural field. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Players Win Gold Medals in 18th Asian Games
body: DPRK players Kim Hyo Sim and Kim Su Jong won gold medals respectively in women's weightlifting and floor exercises of women's individual apparatus finals of artistic gymnastics of the 18th Asian Games on Friday. Kim Hyo Sim lifted 113 kg in snatch and 137 kg in jerk, 250 kg in total in the women's weightlifting 63 kg category to win. Kim Su Jong took first place in the floor exercises of women's individual apparatus finals, second in balance beam, snatching gold and silver medals. In addition, Choe Hyo Sim and Pak Myong Won respectively took second place in women's weightlifting 63 kg category and men's 10 meter running target shooting event and Jon Myong Song third in men's weightlifting 85 kg category. Rodong News Team

title: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of Great Leaders
body: The entire army and all the people of the DPRK paid the highest homage and glory to President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il on the Day of Songun. Servicepersons, working people, school youth and children visited in boundless reverence the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill. Placed at the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il was a floral basket from the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Laid before the statues were floral baskets in the names of the party, armed forces and power organs, social organizations, ministries, national institutions, units of the Korean People's Army and the Korean People's Internal Security Forces and institutions at all levels, industrial establishments and schools in Pyongyang as well as bouquets and flowers. The visitors paid homage to the great leaders before their statues. Floral baskets in the names of KPA and KPISF units, institutions and enterprises as well as bouquets and flowers were laid before the statues of the great leaders in various parts of Pyongyang City, including Kim Il Sung Military University, Kim Il Sung University, the Ministry of the People's Armed Forces and the Ministry of People's Security. Servicepersons, working people and school youth and children throughout the country visited the statues of the great leaders and mosaics depicting the images of the smiling leaders in residential quarters to pay homage to them. Rodong News Team

title: Executive Director of UN Environment Programme Leaves
body: Erik Solheim, executive director of the United Nations Environment Programme, and his party left Pyongyang Saturday. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK's Birthday to Be Marked in Moldova
body: A Moldovan preparatory committee for celebrating the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK was formed on Aug. 15. Aleksei Bolynets, chairman of the Pridnestrovye Anti-Imperialism Songun Revolutionary Association for the Study of the Juche Idea of Moldova, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee decided to hold colorful events including a celebration meeting. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Algerian President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Abdelaziz Bouteflika, president of the People's Democratic Republic of Algeria, on Wednesday. Extending warmest congratulations to Kim Jong Un on behalf of the people and government of Algeria and on his own behalf on the occasion of the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK, Abdelaziz Bouteflika sincerely wished Kim Jong Un good health and happiness and the friendly Korean people bigger progress and prosperity. Underlining the traditional friendly and cooperative ties between the two countries, Abdelaziz Bouteflika confirmed the will to make steady efforts, together with Kim Jong Un, to further consolidate the bilateral relations in the interests of the peoples of the two friendly countries. Rodong News Team

title: Reply Message to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Lao President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, received a reply message from Lao President Bounnang Vorachith on August 17. The Lao president in the message expressed sincere thanks to Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and supreme commander of the Korean People's Army, for sending a beautiful floral basket and a congratulatory message carrying warm congratulations and best wishes on his 81st birthday. This is a demonstration of the tradition of comradely and fraternal unity between the two parties, the two governments and two peoples of the Lao People's Democratic Republic and the DPRK, the message said. The message wished Kim Jong Un good health and happiness and successes in his noble work. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Floral Basket
body: The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a floral basket from Jong Il Sim, widow of DPRK Hero An Tong Su, on the occasion of the Day of Songun. The floral basket was conveyed to an official concerned by Jong Il Sim on Aug. 24. Rodong News Team

title: Art Performance Marks Youth Day
body: The art squad of the Central Committee of the Youth League gave an art performance at the Central Youth Hall Monday to mark the Youth Day. The performance began with a prelude "We Are Successors to Revolution." The numbers on the program included mixed duet and chorus "We Will Carry Forward", poem-reciting and chorus "Golden Cushion" and male solo "Voice of My Heart". Performers showed the reverence for President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il, who trained the Korean youth to be brave generals for the accomplishment of the revolutionary cause of Juche and built a youth power without an equal in the world, and the trust in the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un who is ushering in the greatest heyday in the Korean youth movement. Put on the stage were the numbers showing the militant stamina and optimism of the Korean youth who are creating new legendary tales about heroic youth in every construction site of building an economic power, carrying forward the tradition that the youth have created history of miracles and feats in every year of revolution. There were also numbers representing the pledge of faith of five million youth vanguard. Among the audience were Choe Hwi, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea; Pak Chol Min, first secretary of the C.C., the youth league; officials of the youth league, teachers and students of Mangyongdae Revolutionary School and Kang Pan Sok Revolutionary School, youth and students in the city. Rodong News Team

title: Polish Delegation Here
body: A delegation of the Polish Institute of International Affairs led by Director Slawomir Debski arrived here Monday. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korean Conservative Groups' Traitorous Crimes Denounced
body: The Reunification Information Department of the Committee for the Peaceful Reunification of the Country of the DPRK issued an indictment on Monday disclosing the traitorous crimes of the south Korean conservative forces who have blocked the national reconciliation and unity and reunification in wanton violation of the agreements common to the nation, agreements that have commanded full support by all the Koreans and the international community. The indictment said that the conservative group of traitors is the chieftain that blocked reunification as they reneged on the July 4 joint statement that was adopted and made public in early 1970s. It noted that the Park Chung-Hee military fascist junta and the coteries of the "Democratic Republican Party" of south Korea totally rejected the joint statement as their confrontation system was shaken to the very foundation with the mounting of the spirit for national unity and reunification nationwide occasioned by the publication of the July 4 joint statement. It pointed out that the Park Chung-Hee military fascist clique forged "yusin" dictatorial system after declaring "emergency martial law" in October, 1972 under the excuse of "supporting peaceful reunification". On June 23, the next year, they pushed into a total stalemate the phase for dialogue between the north and the south that was provided with much effort, by making public the "special statement on diplomatic policy for peace and reunification" the core of which was making the permanent division of the Korean peninsula a policy, it charged. It said that the group of traitors challenged the June 15 joint declaration and the October 4 declaration. It noted that the publication of the June 15 joint declaration in June, 2000 opened up a new turning phase in improving the north-south relations and realizing the cause for national reunification and this ushered in the June 15 era, the new era of independent reunification, peace and prosperity in the history of the Korean nation. It charged that the group of conservatives made a far-fetched assertion that the joint declaration has to be abolished, saying that its implementation may lead to the "withdrawal of the U.S. forces" and "it is little short of making concession to the liberal democratic system and accepting the north's system of the Federal Republic of Koryo". By terming the dialogue, contacts and cooperation undertakings between the north and the south for implementing the June 15 joint declaration a "drain on resources", it put a brake on every try for the implementation, the indictment said. It noted that the traitorous and anti-reunification nature of the conservative group of traitors has been fully revealed in their acts of viciously slandering the Pyongyang summit between the top leaders of the north and the south and the October 4 declaration in October 2007 and blocking its implementation. It said that the conservative forces' confrontation frenzy to do away with the June 15 era of reunification and totally derail the north-south relations reached the zenith in the periods when traitors Lee Myung Bak and Park Geun Hye took power. It pointed out that the Lee Myung Bak group blocked one by one the north-south dialogue and cooperation after declaring "no nukes, opening and 3,000 dollars" as "north policy". In the wake of unilaterally suspending tour of Mt Kumgang, it fabricated the case of Cheonan warship sinking and with that as a pretext took "May 24 measure", thereby fundamentally blocking all the cooperation projects between the north and the south, the indictment noted. The Park Geun Hye group of traitors worked out confrontation declarations like "confidence building process on the Korean peninsula" and "Dresden Declaration", openly revealing its ambition for confrontation between social systems, it stated. It said that the Park group totally shut down the Kaesong Industrial Zone, the product of the June 15 era and the last lifeline of the north-south ties, and severed all the channels of contacts and visits between the north and the south that had been barely maintained. The indictment denounced the conservative group of traitors as vicious fanatics blocking the implementation of the Panmunjom Declaration, adding: It was an auspicious event to be specially recorded in the history of the movement for national reunification of the Korean nation that the north-south summit was held and the "Panmunjom Declaration for peace, prosperity and reunification of the Korean peninsula" was published in Panmunjom on April 27. But the conservative group of traitors that had categorically stood against the national reconciliation, unity and reunification rejected again the implementation of the Panmunjom Declaration. The coteries of the "Liberal Korea Party" slandered the Panmunjom Declaration as a "camouflaged peace show" and "declaration written by the north" following the north-south summit and the publication of the Panmunjom declaration. When the fourth north-south summit and talks were held all of a sudden on May 26, the group also went wild, saying that "south-north negotiations without the dismantlement of nuclear weapons is an enemy-benefiting act" and "it is a gesture to evade sanctions by the international community". The indictment stressed that the south Korean group of conservatives, who has blocked national reconciliation, unity, peace and reunification while viciously denying the valuable agreements common to the nation throughout history, will be forced to face stern trial by history without fail for its unpardonable thrice-cursed crimes before the nation. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Wins Gold Medal at 18th Asian Games
body: Rim Jong Sim, weightlifter of the DPRK, won a gold medal in the women's weightlifting event of the 18th Asian Games. She placed first in the women's weightlifting 75kg category held on August 26, lifting 116kg in snatch and 147kg in jerk, 263 kg in total, 26kg heavier than the second player. Meanwhile, DPRK player Kim Hye Song placed third in the women's marathon event. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK's Founding Anniversary to Be Marked in Romania
body: A Romanian preparatory committee for celebrating the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK was formed on Aug. 17. Constantin Rotaru, chairman of the Socialist Party of Romania, was elected as chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee set the celebration period from Aug. 17 to Sept. 10 and decided to organize various political and cultural events to praise the exploits of the peerlessly great men and introduce the successes made by the service personnel and people of the DPRK in socialist construction in the period. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK's Founding Anniversary to Be Celebrated in Bangladesh
body: A Bangladeshi preparatory committee for celebrating the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK was formed in Dhaka on Aug. 20. MD. Harun-Ar-Rashid, chairman of the Bangladesh-Korea Friendship and Solidarity Committee, was elected as chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee decided to hold colorful political and cultural events including a meeting, film show and photo exhibition in praise of the exploits performed by President Kim Il Sung, leader Kim Jong Il and the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in founding and developing the DPRK and accomplishing the human cause of independence. Rodong News Team

title: Concession to Bourgeois Ideology and Culture Leads to National Ruin
body: The main cause of the unending social disorder, confusion and collision in some countries lies in allowing the imperialists’ ideological and cultural poisoning, failing to remain vigilant against them. An inch of concession should not be allowed in the ideological and cultural work in a country and a step of concession brings the destiny of the country and the nation to ruin at last. The countries aspiring after independence, progress and prosperity should always remain vigilant against the imperialists’ bourgeois ideological and cultural poisoning. The poisoning of the bourgeois ideology and culture is the method of the imperialists for aggression. In the past the bourgeois ideology and culture played the role of guide of invasion but they are now playing the key role. The imperialists easily achieve their aggressive aim by the reactionary ideological and cultural poisoning although it is difficult to gain by the military force. They had already achieved their aim in several countries by the ideological and cultural poisoning and “color revolution”, a product of psychological warfare. The imperialists openly advertise it as “bloodless revolution”. Today the imperialists’ ideological and cultural poisoning gets more frantic to disintegrate the independent countries and peoples ideologically and mentally and bring down the governments. The countries and peoples aspiring after independent development and social progress should clearly understand the true nature and danger of the imperialists’ bourgeois ideological and cultural poisoning, never get implicated in it but thoroughly reject it. Ri Hak Nam

title: Dangerous Military Moves behind Dialogue
body: According to a south Korean radio, U.S. special units in Japan staged a drill of flying 1 200 km to the Philippines through air transport. The radio said one can confirm that the drill would be the drill aimed at “the infiltration into Pyongyang” in case of change of direction. Prior to the exercise, it was disclosed that the Michigan, the nuclear submarine belonging to the U.S. Navy, transported Green Berets, Delta Force and other special units present in Okinawa, Japan to the Jinhae naval base of south Korea in late July or early in August. It was extremely provocative and dangerous military moves to mar the hard-won atmosphere of the peace on the Korean peninsula and the dialogue between the DPRK and the U.S. and prevent the implementation of the Singapore DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement. Such acts prove that the U.S. is hatching a criminal plot to unleash a war against the DPRK and commit a crime which deserves merciless divine punishment in case the U.S. fails in the scenario of the unjust and brigandish “denuclearization first”. We cannot but take a serious note of the double-dealing attitudes of the U.S. as it is busy staging secret drills involving man-killing special units while having a dialogue with a smile on its face. The U.S. would be sadly mistaken if it thinks that it can browbeat someone through trite “gunboat diplomacy” which it used to employ as an almighty weapon in the past and attain its sinister intention. The U.S. should ponder over its deeds. Ho Yong Min

title: Indonesian Embassy Hosts Reception
body: The Indonesian embassy here hosted a reception at the Taedonggang Diplomatic Club on Tuesday to mark the 73rd anniversary of the independence of Indonesia. Present there on invitation were Kim Yong Dae, vice-president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, Choe Hui Chol, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, Pak Kyong Il, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries who is chairman of the DPRK-Indonesia Friendship Association, officials concerned and staff members of foreign embassies and international bodies here. Ambassador Bambang Hiendrasto and staff members of the Indonesian embassy were present. Speeches were made. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Player Bags Gold Medal in 18th Asian Games
body: DPRK player Kim Kuk Hyang bagged a gold medal in weightlifting event of the 18th Asian Games. She placed first in the women's weightlifting 75kg category held on Monday, lifting 126kg in snatch and 165kg in jerk, 291 kg in total. In addition, Pak Yong Won and Kang Un Ju placed second in the recurve archery mixed team event. Rodong News Team

title: Chinese Photo Exhibition Opens
body: An exhibition of photos on Chinese buildings opened here with due ceremony on Tuesday. Present there were Sim Yong Hak, chairman of the Central Committee of the Architects Union of Korea, officials concerned, architects and construction technicians in Pyongyang, a visiting delegation of the Architectural Society of China, and staff members of the Chinese embassy here. Speakers there expressed conviction that the exhibition would contribute to boosting exchange and cooperation in the field of architecture between the two countries and achieving new successes in architectural creation. The participants looked round the photos dealing with the architectural development of China including buildings reflecting the Chinese people's national traditions and aspiration and multi-purpose buildings of the latest world fashion. The exhibition will last until August 30. Rodong News Team

title: Events Held Abroad to Mark Birthday of DPRK
body: Seminars on exploits and photo exhibitions took place in Russia, Uganda and Nigeria from Aug. 13 to 15 on the threshold of the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. Present there were figures of various circles and masses in those countries. The first secretary of the Maritime Territorial Regional Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation said that the seventy-year-long history of the DPRK is the history of victory in which all the servicepersons and civilians have worked miracles under the guidance of the peerlessly great men. He went on: It is only socialist Korea which has victoriously advanced while courageously smashing all sorts of vicious moves of the imperialists and invariably enforced the popular policies including the free medical care and free education systems despite difficulties. It is our duty to give publicity to the reality of heroic Korea struggling for the people's happiness and the world peace under the uplifted banner of socialism. At a seminar in Uganda, speakers lauded the feats of President Kim Il Sung for nation-building, saying that he founded the DPRK and turned it into a people's country in which the Juche idea is thoroughly applied. Meanwhile, the Dagestan Association for the Study of the Juche Idea and Songun Policy of Russia gave a lecture on Aug. 14 to mark the 73rd anniversary of Korea's liberation. The lecture dealt with the exploits of Kim Il Sung, who led the anti-Japanese war to victory and thus accomplished the historic cause of national liberation. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Introduced in DR Congo
body: The National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of DR Congo posted on a website the full text of "Let Us Usher in a Golden Age of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth Movement", a speech made by the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un at the 9th Congress of the Kim Il Sung Socialist Youth League, on Aug. 20 on the occasion of the Youth Day. The work, published on Aug. 28, Juche 105 (2016), deals with the idea that the seventy year-long history of the youth league is one of brilliant victory of the great leaders' idea of attaching importance to the youth and their guidance and the Korean youth movement is the glorious Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist youth movement pioneered and developed by their great idea and guidance. It also indicates the tasks and ways for developing the youth league into one of the great leaders forever. The website carried a photo of Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: Dancing Parties Mark Youth Day
body: Youth and students held a dancing party on Tuesday, the Youth Day. The dancing party began in the dancing venue of the Central Youth Hall amid the playing of the song "Waltz of Youth Day". The young people danced with deep reverence for President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il. They enthusiastically danced to the tune of such songs as "Cheers of the People" full of happiness that they are holding in high esteem the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un who is ushering in a golden age of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist youth movement. The playing of songs reflecting the will of youth and students to bring about a leap forward in the great advance for economic construction revved up the atmosphere of the events. Similar events took place in all the provincial seats on the same day. Rodong News Team

title: Senior Party and Government Officials Congratulate Youth
body: Youth and students across the DPRK enjoyed the Youth Day. Senior officials of the party and government joined youth and students celebrating the Youth Day on Tuesday. Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, and Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, visited Pyongyang Teacher Training College, the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill and the Pyongyang Thermal Power Complex and congratulated youth and students on their holiday. Pak Kwang Ho, Thae Jong Su, O Su Yong and other senior party and government officials and officials in Pyongyang and provinces spent the holiday together with youth and students at industrial establishments, farms and universities across the country. The senior party and government officials placed floral baskets and bouquets before the statues of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il, portraits of the smiling great leaders and mosaics depicting their images and paid respects. After going round the revolutionary history museums, rooms for education in the revolutionary history, rooms dedicated to the history of the relevant units, production sites and other places, they encouraged exemplary youth and students taking the lead in the movement for increased production and in the drive for pushing back the frontiers of the latest science and technology. They enjoyed art performances given by youth and students, and attended colorful events including sports and amusement games. Rodong News Team

title: Editorial
body: Youth Should Perform Heroic Feats in Van of Grand March for Economic Construction The Youth Day is the eternal holiday of young Koreans which was provided by President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il. The history of the Korean youth movement is a proud history as it has always emerged victorious thanks to the great leaders’ original idea of attaching importance to the youth and their energetic guidance. In his early years President Kim Il Sung began his revolutionary activities with the youth work and opened up the path of the Korean revolution with the youth movement. Under his wise leadership, a new and proud history of the Juche-oriented youth movement started and our youth could grow up as passionate revolutionaries and perform distinguished feats in the building of a new country after the liberation and in the hard-fought Fatherland Liberation War, the postwar reconstruction and socialist construction. Leader Kim Jong Il glorified the immortal exploits of the President who put his heart and soul into the work with youth for all ages and made the history of our Party the history of attaching importance to the youth. He gave the torchlight of the revolution to the youth and developed the youth league into an organization of the leader shining with the august name of the sun and an organization of the Party. Now the Korean youth movement is ushering in the greatest heyday of its development under the energetic guidance of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. After deeply seeing through the realistic demand of the developing Juche-based youth movement and the unanimous desire of the young people, the Supreme Leader saw to it that the youth league went by the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League and gave the greatest glory and trust to it by personally awarding the flag of the Youth League. It is the great pride and might of the Workers’ Party of Korea and the Korean people to have the great army of youth. The young people should vigorously work for the final victory in building a socialist powerful nation along the course of the Korean revolution sailing with the blizzards of Mt Paektu.

title: "Complete Collection of Kim Jong Il's Works" Vol. 22 Published in DPRK
body: Vol. 22 of "Complete Collection of Kim Jong Il's Works", a library of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism in which leader Kim Jong Il's works are systematically and comprehensively compiled in a chronological order, was brought out in the DPRK. It contains 61 works authored by him from November, Juche 62 (1973) to February, Juche 63 (1974) including his statements and speeches. "On Some Immediate Tasks of Party Ideological Work for Modeling the Whole Society on Kimilsungism" and other works deal with the essence of Kimilsungism and clarify that it is the main task of the ideological work of the Workers' Party of Korea to model the whole society on Kimilsungism. There are works dealing with his guidance to make sure that the Korean People's Army fully discharges its mission and duty as the army of the leader and the Party. Many works authored by him advanced unique ideas and theories arising in bringing about a revolution in literature and art. Some works deal with the idea that activities of the traveling agitation troupes of the provincial broadcasting services should be intensified to inspire the party members and working people to the implementation of the party policies and the that the party paper should display its militant might as an agitator, educator and organizer mobilizing the masses. There are also encyclopedic works giving clear-cut answers to the theoretical and practical matters arising in revolution and construction. Rodong News Team

title: Immortal Exploits of Giving Strong Impetus to Socialist Movement
body: The Workers’ Party of Korea (WPK) has consistently led the popular masses' cause of independence, the socialist cause, to victory as a locomotive of the times both at a time when the world socialist movement won victory after victory and when it faced ordeals. The WPK has led the Korean people wisely to the road of independence and socialism, bearing the responsibility for the destinies of the people, the revolution and the country, and also creditably fulfilled its mission, taking upon itself the responsibility for the destiny of the human cause of independence, the world socialist movement. Socialism collapsed without any gunfire in several countries in the late 1980s or the early 1990s–a tragic situation-due to the moves of the imperialists and the socialist renegades. Availing themselves of the chaos in the world socialist movement, the imperialist reactionary forces described much “the end” of socialism as inevitable in history, directing the spearhead of invasion and suffocation to the DPRK. No progressive political party, politician and theorist delivered a telling blow at sophism of the reactionaries of history and advanced a scientific opinion on socialism. Only President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il, who founded and guided the WPK could decisively smash sophism of the enemies and instill the scientific accuracy of socialism and the inevitability of its victory into the world progressives. In the course of rigorous yet sacred struggle, the WPK fully demonstrated before the whole world that it is the guide of the popular masses’ cause of independence, the socialist cause. Kim Kyong Chol

title: National Youth Sci-Tech Successes Exhibition Closes
body: The national youth sci-tech successes exhibition closed with due ceremony at the Sci-Tech Complex on Wednesday. Appreciated were over 70 sci-tech successes and and products of technical innovations and inventions and rationalization proposals presented by Youth League committees of Pyongyang City and the State Academy of Sciences and others. During the exhibition the participants introduced achievements made in the mass technical innovation movement and exchanged experience. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from President of DR Congo
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, received a message of greeting from Joseph Kabila Kabange, president of DR Congo, on Aug. 18. The message said that he extended warm congratulations to Kim Jong Un on behalf of all the people of DR Congo and on his own behalf on the occasion of the 70th birthday of the DPRK. It hoped that the new strategic line for developing the DPRK economy and achieving the happiness and prosperity of all the Korean people would prove successful under Kim Jong Un's leadership. It wished Kim Jong Un good health and great success in his work to lead the country. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Gifts from Russian Personages
body: The respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received gifts from Russian personages on the occasion of the 70th birthday of the DPRK. Gifts were respectively handed on Aug. 23 to the DPRK ambassador to Russia by the chief of the Russian Group for Solidarity with the DPRK, the general manager of the CK Ilgar Company Ltd. and the general manager and manager of the CK Dalpitserstroi Company Ltd. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK's Birthday to Be Marked in Venezuela
body: A Venezuelan preparatory committee for celebrating the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK was formed on Aug. 21. Omar Lopez, chairman of the Venezuelan National Society for the Study of the Juche Idea, was elected as honorary chairman of the preparatory committee and Felix Jesus Velasquez Castillo, general coordinator of the Federal Political Secretariat of the United Left Party of Venezuela and chairperson of the Venezuelan Solidarity Committee for Korea's Peace and Reunification, as its chairman. title: DPRK's Founding Anniversary to Be Celebrated in Russia
body: Preparatory committees for celebrating the 70th birthday of the DPRK were formed by political parties and organizations of Russia on Aug. 21 and 22. Sazhi Umalatova, chairperson of the Party for Peace and Unity of Russia, C. M. Kramarenko, chairman of the Korean War Veterans' Council of Russia, and Podzorov, first secretary of the Central Committee of the All-Russia Lenin Young Communist League, were elected as chairpersons of the preparatory committees. The committees decided to organize various political and cultural events, including a meeting and film show, on the occasion of the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. Rodong News Team

title: Reckless Moves of War Criminal State
body: Referring to the bill on the retrogressive revision of the constitution aimed at stipulating the existence of the “Self-Defense Forces” (SDF) at a recent lecture, Abe said that the Liberal Democratic Party would accelerate the working out of the bill so that it could be submitted to the next Diet. When mentioning the September election of the president of the party, he noted that whoever became the president should perform the responsibility for that, which showed his intention to submit the bill to the extraordinary session of the Diet due in autumn at any cost. In the meantime, a group of supra-partisan Dietmen visited Yasukuni Shrine on the defeated day and Abe made a ritual offering to the shrine in the capacity of the president of the party. When judged by the fact that the Abe group took such provocative actions at a time when the international community demanded Japan properly look back on its history of aggression, deeply reflect on it and make the neighboring countries trust Japan through action, the aim of their reckless moves is crystal clear to all. The successive ruling forces of Japan ran amuck for the overseas invasion but did not dare to run reckless to amend even the constitution. One can see militarist venomous serpent running amuck to completely shake off the yoke of the defeated nation in the reckless action of the Abe group pledging to take revenge before the mortuary tablets of top class war criminals while getting hell-bent on the retrogressive revision of the constitution aimed at stipulating the existence of the SDF. The Japanese reactionaries are sadly mistaken. History shows through a serious lesson what fate those who started war to invade and conquer other countries met. The war criminal state Japan had better bear it in mind. Ri Hyon Do

title: DPRK Players Prove Successful at World Taekwon-Do Championships
body: DPRK players proved successful at the 13th World Junior and the 8th World Veteran Taekwon-Do Championships held in Belarus from Aug. 22 to 26. The junior championships brought together over 420 players from 38 countries and regions including the DPRK, Russia, Argentina and Kazakhstan. DPRK players bagged 21 gold medals, 6 silver medals and 4 bronze medals to come first in team standing. Hyon Mu Gang and Pak Ji Hyang were awarded individual technical prizes. The DPRK players came back home on Thursday. Rodong News Team

title: World Breastfeeding Week 2018 Observed
body: There took place a seminar in Pyongyang on Thursday to observe the world breastfeeding week 2018. It was attended by officials of public health and media fields and relevant units, women in Pyongyang, the acting representative of UNICEF and the representative of the WHO and members of the missions of international bodies here. Speeches were made there. And there took place a lecture and questions and answers on breastfeeding and child health. Prizes were awarded to exemplary public health officials, child caretakers, hygienic information workers and mothers. The participants watched "Breastfeeding" of Korean science film "Child health and nutrition" (2). Rodong News Team

title: DPRK's Founding Anniversary to Be Celebrated in Cambodia
body: A Cambodian preparatory committee for celebrating the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK was formed on Aug. 24. Kong Sam Ol, deputy prime minister for Royal Palace, was elected as chairman of the preparatory committee under the authorization of Cambodian King Norodom Sihamoni. The committee set a celebration period from Aug. 25 to Sept. 15 and decided to give wide publicity to the exploits of President Kim Il Sung and leader Kim Jong Il and personality of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un as an illustrious great man through media and organize various political and cultural events in the period. Rodong News Team

title: National Sci-tech Presentation of Fishery Sector
body: A national sci-tech presentation of the fishery sector was held at the Institute of Fishery of the Ministry of Fisheries on Wednesday and Thursday. It was sponsored by the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea. Present there were officials, teachers, researchers and postgraduates of various units. The presentation heard over 150 papers helpful to further developing science and technology of the fishery sector. It was divided into various panels such as fishing and marine resources and fishery information and machinery. Drawing the attention of the participants were data on the successes proving effective for developing the systems of scientific detection of fishing grounds and assistance, upgrading fishing vessels and equipment and boosting offshore culture and fish farming. There were lectures on protection and increase of marine resources and the trend of the development of offshore fish farming and culture during the presentation. Rodong News Team

title: Polish Delegation Visits Mangyongdae
body: A delegation of the Polish Institute of International Affairs led by Director Slawomir Debski visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. At the old home of the President in Mangyongdae, the guests looked round historical relics, being briefed on his revolutionary career. They toured the revolutionary relics on Mangyong Hill. The delegation also visited the Tower of the Juche Idea. Rodong News Team

title: 70th Founding Anniversary of Wonsan University of Agriculture Marked
body: Wonsan University of Agriculture marked its 70th founding anniversary. It is the first-born university of agriculture which was founded and developed under the care of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and a distinguished one which contributed to the development of the country's agriculture and training of agricultural sci-tech talents. President Kim Il Sung chose a suitable place as the site of the university and made sure that it was founded as the first university of agriculture for the people on September 1, Juche 37 (1948), and inspected it several times, wisely leading it to train many sci-tech talents who would shoulder the socialist rural construction. Chairman Kim Jong Il paid deep attention to the work of the university, led it to improve education and scientific research, as required by the developing reality, personally visited it and highly praised the exploits of its teaching staff. He repeatedly sent modern apparatuses for experiment and practice. For the past 70 years since its foundation, the university has developed into a prestigious university and a center for agricultural scientific research which systematically trains agricultural sci-tech talents, true to the line and policy of the Workers' Party of Korea. A meeting took place on Friday to mark the anniversary. It was attended by Pak Thae Song, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the WPK, officials concerned, teaching staff and students of the university. Rodong News Team

title: National Schoolchildren's Sports Contest for Jongilbong Prize Closes
body: The 44th National Schoolchildren's Sports Contest for Jongilbong Prize closed with due ceremony at the Central Youth Hall on Friday. In the contest Pyongyang City took the first place in total points and 50 players were selected as April 18 best players. Present at the closing ceremony were officials of the youth league, instructors of professional sports groups, players and school youth and children in Pyongyang. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Syrian President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Bashar Al-Assad, president of the Syrian Arab Republic, on August 28. In the message the Syrian president said that he was very pleased to extend sincere congratulations to Kim Jong Un and the people of the DPRK on behalf of the Syrian Arab people and on his own behalf on the occasion of the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK, its national holiday, wishing Kim Jong Un good health and happiness and the friendly people of the DPRK bigger progress and prosperity. The message affirmed the will to strengthen the friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries in conformity with the interests and well-being of the peoples of the two friendly countries. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK's Founding Anniversary Marked by Czech Organization
body: A Czech preparatory committee for celebrating the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK issued a bulletin on August 20. The bulletin carried articles under various titles illustrated with portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and photos showing the revolutionary activities of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. It elaborated on the brilliant course covered by the DPRK which has made a history of victory and glory under the peerlessly great men, and stressed that the DPRK is a powerful country, highly dignified with independence, prospering with self-support and impregnable with self-reliance. It also edited photos showing the proud reality of daily-leaping Juche Korea. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Songun Observed by Russian Media
body: Websites and online magazines and news of Russia gave special write-ups illustrated with portraits of smiling Chairman Kim Jong Il and his photos and photos of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Aug. 20 to 25 on the occasion of the Day of Songun. The website "DPRK Today" carried stories about the prominent personality of Kim Jong Il as the great man, saying that he is a man boundlessly admired by the world progressives. Website Patrioti Moskva and online magazine Lemchich carried articles under "Korea's Day of Songun" and other titles in praise of his Songun leadership exploits. Another website said under the title "Song in Praise of Great Man" that figures of various circles in many countries wrote books and poems in high praise of him. An internet news gave a special write-up in praise of the personality of Kim Jong Un as the peerlessly great man who is deeply respected by the international community. Rodong News Team

title: Works of Great Leaders Introduced in Brazil
body: The Brazilian Center for the Study of Songun Politics posted President Kim Il Sung's work "On Progressive Democracy" and Chairman Kim Jong Il's work "On Imbuing the Whole Society with Communist Moral Traits" on its website on Aug. 18 and 19. The website carried photos of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: Let Us Create Models in Drive for increased Production
body: To create a model, generalize it and bring about an upswing in revolution and construction is the traditional work method of the Workers’ Party of Korea. The model unit is the one representative of the era standing in the van of the drive for carrying out the cause of the Party. The grandiose idea and plan of the Party are crystallized in the work of the model unit, which specifies the exemplary working manner and style, the secret to tackling difficulties and methods of doing so. It is the truth proven by the history of the Korean people’s socialist construction that the hot wind of following and outdistancing the model unit brings about promotion in the ideological and mental traits of people and an advance in revolution. During the course of following the model units like Chollima workteam, Chollima factory and Chollima agricultural cooperative which were born in the hot wind of the Chollima movement, the country could emerge as an invincible power independent in politics, self-supporting in economy and self-reliant in defence. A heyday in the era of the Workers’ Party was opened up by the pioneers who made a breakthrough in the drive of the grand socialist construction. The model units showed in practice the level of development and upswing desired and demanded by the Party, and provided vitality to all sectors of revolution and construction, and that is just their exploits. All the Korean people should achieve a brilliant victory in the drive for increased production for carrying out the goals of the 5-year strategy by raising a hot wind of creating models in hearty response to Party’s call.

title: Experience-Share Meeting of Top University Students Held
body: An experience-share meeting of top university students across the country took place in the DPRK from August 18 to September 2. The top students selected from across the country toured every province to hold such meeting, divided into two groups. Experience gained by them during their study and scientific research was shared at the meeting. Speakers there expressed their resolution to remain true to the intention of the Party calling on the youth to be frontrunners and pioneers in the building of a sci-tech power. Rodong News Team

title: Delegations of Chongryon Visit Mangyongdae
body: A delegation of officials of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) led by Ri Myong Yu, chairman of the Central Audit Committee of Chongryon, and a delegation of branch chairmen of Chongryon led by Ho Myong Do, vice department director of the Central Standing Committee of Chongryon, visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. Being briefed on the undying exploits the President performed, they looked round the historical relics at his old home. Visit to Mangyongdae helps me recall again the sacred revolutionary career of the great leader Generalissimo Kim Il Sung, the head of the delegation of branch chairmen of Chongryon said, and went on: The might of our Chongryon demonstrating its honor as the dignified overseas citizens' organization of Juche Korea would be unthinkable apart from his great feats. We will consolidate branch organizations of Chongryon as the regional center of the movement of Koreans in Japan unfazed by any storm, true to the noble intention of the respected Supreme Leader Marshal Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Vietnamese President
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a message of greeting to Tran Dai Quang, president of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, on the occasion of the 73rd anniversary of its foundation, on Sunday. Expressing belief that the Vietnamese people would register bigger successes in the struggle for building prospering Vietnam, the message wished the Vietnamese president good health and successes in his work. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korean Bodies to Be Active in Implementing Panmunjom Declaration
body: 60 odd pro-reunification bodies of south Korea and representatives from 13 areas held a meeting in Seoul on August 28 to express their will to actively turn out in the implementation of the Panmunjom declaration, according to the south Korean internet newspaper Tongil News. Speakers said they would make efforts to implement the declaration on the principle of national independence specified by the declaration and by the concerted efforts of all Koreans, adding they would stage a mass struggle condemning and opposing the anti-DPRK sanctions and interference in the internal affairs of the Korean nation by the U.S. which is checking the implementation of the declaration. They appealed to all forces for reunification in the south, the north and abroad to firmly unite with each other and actively turn out in the implementation of the declaration. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK's Founding Anniversary to Be Celebrated in Ireland
body: An Irish preparatory committee for celebrating the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK was formed on Aug. 28. Irina Malenko, chairperson of the Ireland-Korea Friendship Association, was elected as chairperson of the preparatory committee. The committee decided to hold various political and cultural events to introduce the proud course of the development of Juche Korea on the occasion of the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK's Founding Anniversary to Be Celebrated in Luxembourg
body: A preparatory committee of Luxembourg for celebrating the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK was formed on Aug. 28. Robert Medernash was elected as its chairman. The preparatory committee decided to organize colorful political and cultural events including a seminar and film show to introduce the proud successes made by Juche Korea on the above-said occasion. Rodong News Team

title: Seminar on Exploits of Chairman Kim Jong Il Held in Russia
body: A seminar on exploits of Chairman Kim Jong Il was hosted by the Maritime Territorial Branch Committee of "A Just Russia" on August 24 to mark the 16th anniversary of his visit to the Far Eastern Region of the Russian Federation. Aleksei Kozitski, chairman of the Maritime Territorial Branch Committee, noted at the seminar: Chairman Kim Jong Il's visit to the Far Eastern Region of the Russian Federation in August 2002 made a new turn in the development of the Russia-DPRK relations. Chairman Kim Jong Il toured Ignat Trade Center and Vlad Khleb Bread Factory during his visit and met President Putin to discuss important issues for the development of the bilateral relations. His visit was of great significance. Meanwhile, there was a ceremony of laying bouquets and flowers before the tablet honoring him at Bureya Railway Station in Amur Region of Russia on Aug. 21 to mark the anniversary of his visit to Siberia and Far Eastern Region of the Russian Federation. Rodong News Team

title: President Kim Il Sung's Work Reported by Indian News
body: The full text of President Kim Il Sung's work "Let Us Uphold Independence" was reported by the Indian online news Voice of Millions on Aug. 26 on the occasion of the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. The work, made public on September 7, Juche 70 (1981), clarifies that it is the requirement of the present era to maintain independence in the activities of the party and the state and the Juche idea is a man-centered philosophy. Rodong News Team

title: Independence Is Life of Country
body: Today socialist Korea, the country of Juche, pushes ahead with the revolution and construction in an independent and dignified manner and fully displays its prestige as a country prospering by its own efforts and in its own way, a fortress of independence with high international authority and influence. At the time when the global socialist movement was in a state of chaos, we defended socialism without a slight vacillation and the DPRK became a country with high dignity and international authority as today. It’s because we have constantly pursued politics of independence. We have firmly established a political backbone and never read other’s face and allow the others to meddle in our affairs. We fixed all policies to meet the specific features of our country and the interests and demands of our people and then we implemented them by ourselves as the master. When the modern revisionists tried to hammer their policies to us, we flatly refused it. No pressure will work on our people. We have the great leader, great party and great people. That’s why we had no reason to look up to others or beg for help and, besides, to accept others’ order and pressure. The practical experience of our revolution and the review of the 70-year history of our Republic verify that independence is the life and future of a country and a nation and upholding high the banner of independence is a guarantee of the victory of the human cause of independence. Ra Myong Song

title: Only Victory Is in Store for DPRK
body: The DPRK is the genuine power of the people as it is absolutely supported and trusted by them and is demonstrating its dignity and might as the most durable one full of vitality. The solidity and might of the socialist power and its invincible vitality hinge on the greatness of the leader. The history of the prosperity of the DPRK is that of the experienced and tested leadership of the great leaders. President Kim Il Sung advanced the idea of building a Juche-oriented people’s power, establishing the people’s revolutionary government to create the origin of building a people’s power during the anti-Japanese armed struggle. After the country’s liberation, he provided a strong weapon for building a prospering country by building the power of the DPRK where the people are its master, resolutely foiling all obstructive moves of the enemy at home and abroad. Chairman Kim Jong Il authored many classical works including “Let Us Bring the Advantages of Our People’s Government into Fuller Play”, thus giving clear-cut answers to all issues including the principle of building the socialist power and tasks and ways of raising its function and role. Now the government of the DPRK is powerfully accelerating the work for successfully advancing and implementing the cause of independence of the popular masses, the cause of socialism, under the wise leadership of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. It is greatest fortune and honor of the country and its people to hold him, a peerless thinker and theoretician and prominent statesman, in high esteem. Only victory and glory are in store for the DPRK advancing under the guidance of the great Party. Hwang Kum Chol

title: Choe Ryong Hae Inspects Various Units in Kangwon Province
body: Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, inspected various units in Kangwon Province. Going around various production processes of the Kangwon Provincial Tree Nursery and the Wonsan Disabled Soldiers' Bag Factory, he encouraged the working people in their drive to make collective innovation in production of saplings and quality schoolbags. The consultative meetings held on the spots discussed the measures for fulfilling the national economic plans this year, third year for implementing the five-year strategy for national economic development, by mapping out proper business and management strategies and producing and economizing as much as possible. And he visited an agricultural sci-tech learning space, a hall of culture, dwelling houses and others of the Songchon Vegetable Co-op Farm in Wonsan City. He underscored the need to meticulously organize the management and operation, increase the per-hectare yield of vegetables by widely introducing the scientific farming method and to make the farmers enjoy the wealthy and highly civilized life and thus further glorify the honor as the unit associated with guidance exploits of the great leaders. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Captains Regent of San Marino
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, Monday sent a message of greeting to Stefano Palmieri and Matteo Ciacci, captains regent of the Republic of San Marino, on the occasion of its national day. Expressing belief that the relations between the two countries would develop in the interests and desire of the two peoples, the message wished the people of San Marino progress and prosperity. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Floral Basket from Nigerian President
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a floral basket from Muhammadu Buhari, president of Nigeria who is commander-in-chief of the Armed Forces, ahead of the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. The floral basket was conveyed to an official concerned by the Nigerian charge d'affaires ad interim here on Monday. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of Union of Korean Students in Japan Visits Mangyongdae
body: A delegation of the Union of Korean Students in Japan led by Chairman of its Central Standing Committee Kim Hyon Il visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. Members of the delegation went round the historical relics, being briefed on the fact that the President regained the lost country and built a country of the people, an invincible socialist state in Korea. At the end of the visit the head of the delegation said that the President was a peerless patriot and outstanding leader who devoted himself to prosperity of the country and nation. The President put forward the Koreans in Japan who lived in grief over being a stateless nation as overseas citizens of the dignified independent and sovereign state, he pointed out. He vowed that they would train compatriot students as reliable successors to the cause of patriotism true to the lofty intention of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. The delegation also toured the Tower of the Juche Idea, the Arch of Triumph, the Korean Revolution Museum, etc. Rodong News Team

title: 11th Pyongyang Int'l Science and Technology Book Fair to Open
body: The 11th Pyongyang International Science and Technology Book Fair is to be held at the Sci-Tech Complex on Sep. 10-12. It will be attended by many organizations from various countries and regions and international bodies. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK's Birthday Observed Abroad
body: Events were held in different countries to mark the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. They included meetings in Ukraine and Mexico, seminar in Egypt, lecture in Uganda and round-table talks in Romania in the period between August 19 and 23. The chairperson of the Dnepropetrovsk Branch of the Ukrainian "Treasured Sword of Songun" Association for the Study of the Juche Idea said that the DPRK demonstrates its dignity as a power which is commanding admiration of the world under the guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and it will prosper for all ages with the proud history. Yehia Zakaria Khairullah, vice-chairman of the Socialist Freedom Party of Egypt, referred to the fact that the DPRK has won only victories in its course under the leadership of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and to the positive changes in the situation on the Korean Peninsula by the bold will and decision of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. The participants in the lecture held in Uganda said that the Ugandan followers of the Juche idea deeply understand the advantages of Korean-style socialism. The socialist society is the genuine one for happiness of the people and the development of a country, they added. Constantin Rotaru, chairman of the Socialist Party of Romania, noted that the history of the DPRK is a brilliant one in which many things have been created in adversity and the DPRK turned adversity into prosperity, adding that this can be created only by the heroic Korean people who have steadfastly covered the road of socialism true to the guidance of the great leaders. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Off Press in Russia
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us Add Eternal Brilliance to Comrade Kim Jong Il's Great Idea and Achievements of the Songun Revolution" was brought out in booklet by the Arton Publishing House of Russia. The work, published on August 25, Juche 102 (2013), deals with the Songun revolutionary leadership feats of Chairman Kim Jong Il and the essence and originality of the Songun revolutionary idea and clarifies the tasks for brilliantly accomplishing the revolutionary cause of Songun. A book-releasing ceremony took place at the publishing house on August 24. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Visits Bier of Ju Kyu Chang
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), chairman of the DPRK State Affairs Commission and supreme commander of the Korean People's Army, Tuesday visited the bier of Academician, Prof. and Dr. Ju Kyu Chang, alternate member of the C.C., WPK, deputy to the DPRK Supreme People's Assembly and adviser to the C.C., WPK, to express deep condolences over his death. He was accompanied by Thae Jong Su, Kim Phyong Hae, Ri Pyong Chol, Hong Sung Mu, Hong Yong Chil and Kang Pong Hun. A wreath from Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was seen standing before the bier. Kim Jong Un paid silent tribute to Ju Kyu Chang with a bitter sorrow of losing precious revolutionary comrade. He met with family members of the deceased to express deep condolences and console them in their sorrow. Political News Team

title: Foreign Guests Here
body: Foreign guests arrived here on Tuesday to take part in the international events in celebration of the 70th founding anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. They are Anders Kristensen, chairman of the Denmark-DPRK Friendship Association and co-chairman of the Organizing Committee of the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu, and his party, a delegation of the International League of People's Struggle led by General Secretary Malcum Guy, a delegation of the Sweden-Korea Friendship Association led by Ola Obrant, a delegation of the France-Korea Friendship Association led by President Benoit Quennedey, and a Philippine friendship delegation led by Norma Binas. Earlier arriving here were Koen De Ceuster, professor at Leiden University of the Netherlands, and his party, and Peter Hediger, delegate of the Switzerland-Korea Committee. Rodong News Team

title: National Oratorical Contest Held
body: A national oratorical contest for celebrating the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK took place at the Hamhung Grand Theatre on Tuesday. Officials and working people successful at provincial and central contests took the floor. The performers spoke highly of the undying exploits of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and the personality of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un as the peerlessly great man who is opening up a new history of prosperity of Juche Korea. Rodong News Team

title: Chongryon Delegations Arrive
body: A delegation of headquarters chairmen of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) led by Kim Sang Il, chairman of the Kyoto Prefectural Headquarters, and a delegation of officials of the Union of Democratic Korean Women in Japan led by Pu Jong Saeng, chairperson of the Osaka Prefectural Headquarters, arrived here on Tuesday to take part in the celebrations of the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. Rodong News Team

title: Chinese Party and Government Delegation to Visit DPRK
body: The party and government delegation of the People's Republic of China will visit the Democratic People's Republic of Korea to take part in the celebrations of its 70th founding anniversary from Sept. 8, at the invitation of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and the DPRK government. The delegation is to be led by Li Zhanshu, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the C.C., the Communist Party of China (CPC) and chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress of the People's Republic of China (PRC), who is special representative of Xi Jinping, general secretary of the C.C. CPC, and president of the PRC. Rodong News Team

title: "Reminiscences of Participants in Fatherland Liberation War" Vol. 3 Published
body: Vol. 3 of the book "Reminiscences of Participants in the Fatherland Liberation War" was brought out in the DPRK. The book carries 19 reminiscences telling the stories about the exploits President Kim Il Sung performed for the war victory and the transparent spirit of defending the leader unto death, matchless bravery, self-sacrificing spirit and ardent patriotism displayed by the service personnel and people of the DPRK. Reminiscences entitled "'Kumhwa Offensive' defeated by Far-sighted Wisdom" tells about the wise leadership of the President who went to the dangerous frontline headquarters to set forth the operational policy and opened up a favorable phase for the final victory in the Fatherland Liberation War. Another one entitled "Football Game Which Hastened War Victory" impressively tells the personality of the President as the great man who organized a football game of commanding officers of the Korean People's Army during the hard-fought war and personally took part in the game to instill certain conviction and optimism about victory into the hearts of all service personnel and people. "By Force of One Squad", "By Dint of Mortars" and others tell about the feats of soldiers who bravely fought against the enemies by displaying mass heroism and self-sacrificing spirit. The book also contains stories about anti-aircraft artillerymen and communications men who made contributions to the war victory and tells about the creation of wartime songs which gave confidence and optimism about the war victory to the service personnel and people in the rear. Rodong News Team

title: Week of Film Show Opens
body: A week of film show opened here to mark the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. During the week documentary film "Making Selfless, Devoted Efforts for the Good of the People" (1), "Faith of Our People" and "Ryomyong Street Built at Mallima Speed" dealing with the revolutionary exploits of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il for the cause of the Juche-oriented nation-building will be shown at cinemas, houses of culture here and other parts of the country. "My Country", "The Great Care", "Song Full of Memories", "Wolmi Islet" and other feature films will be also shown. An opening ceremony took place at the People's Palace of Culture on Monday. On the same day, weeks of film show were opened in all the provinces. Rodong News Team

title: Military Attaches Corps Visits Pyongyang Teacher Training College
body: The military attaches corps here visited Pyongyang Teacher Training College on Sept. 4 on the occasion of the 70th birthday of the DPRK. The members of the corps looked around various places of the college where the education is put on a scientific, IT and modern basis at a high level. Rodong News Team

title: National Photo Exhibition Opens
body: A national photo exhibition "Seven Decades of Victory and Glory" opened at the People's Palace of Culture on Monday with due ceremony to mark the 70th birthday of the DPRK. Seen in the venue of the event are photos of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un atop Mt Paektu. Also seen there are photos of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il dealing with their nation-building feats and photos showing the personality of Kim Jong Un as a great man.
