Seen there are photos showing revolutionary feats of the President who honorably defended the freedom and independence of the country and the gains of revolution and built the DPRK into a socialist country, independent in politics, self-supporting in the economy and self-reliant in national defence. Displayed there are photos on the patriotic devotion of Kim Jong Il who developed the country into a political and ideological power of single-minded unity and an invincible military power and provided a firm springboard for making a leap forward for building an economic power and a highly civilized country. There are also photos showing the greatness of Kim Jong Un who energetically leads the struggle to put into practice the patriotic desire of the great leaders to build a powerful country under the unfurled banner of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism. Exhibited there are photos showing the DPRK which has covered the road of victory and glory under the leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea. Present at the ceremony were Pak Kwang Ho, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and officials concerned and others. Rodong News Team

title: Choe Ryong Hae Inspects Poultry Farms
body: Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, inspected the Mangyongdae Chicken Farm and the 927 Chicken Farm. Going round the Mangyongdae Chicken Farm, he encouraged its officials and employees who were conducting a devoted drive for more eggs. He acquainted himself with the situation of the 927 Chicken Farm, where he underscored the need to solve the problems arising in producing chicken and eggs by dint of science and technology and surpass its peak-year levels by conducting dynamic campaigns in which one overtakes and learns from others and swaps experience with each other. The consultative meetings held on the spots discussed the measures for further developing the poultry industry. Rodong News Team

title: Officials of Int'l Bodies Visit Statues of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Staff members of UNDP, UNICEF, UNFPA, FAO, WHO and WFP missions here visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu hill on Wednesday on the occasion of the 70th birthday of the DPRK. They laid floral baskets before the statues of the great leaders and paid tribute to them. Rodong News Team

title: Meetings of Working People's Organizations Mark Birthday of DPRK
body: Meetings were held by working people's organizations on Wednesday to mark the 70th birthday of the DPRK. Present there were Ri Il Hwan, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials concerned, trade union and agricultural workers' union officials, workers and trade union members, agricultural workers' union members and agricultural workers in Thaechon County. At the meeting held by the workers and trade union members at the Central Hall of Workers a reporter and speakers recalled that President Kim Il Sung founded the DPRK on September 9, Juche 37 (1948) and developed it into a socialist state with firm political and military foundation and strong self-supporting economy. Chairman Kim Jong Il formulated the Songun politics into the main political mode under socialism, established the state machinery system centered on national defence and thus provided a firm guarantee for accomplishing the Juche-oriented cause of socialism, they said. At the meeting held by agricultural workers and agricultural workers' union members at the Unhung Coop Farm in Thaechon County a reporter and speakers said the President provided a cradle of eternal happiness for the Korean people by building a strong socialist nation independent in politics, self-supporting in economy and self-reliant in national defence. Under his care the torch of agricultural revolution was kindled to realign hundreds of thousands of hectares of land to be worthy of the land of socialist Korea and large-scale orchards were built, they added. A heyday in the building of a powerful socialist nation has been ushered in under the guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, they said. They stressed the need to demonstrate the might of socialist Korea, rallied close around him and dynamically struggle to hasten the final victory of the revolutionary cause of Juche. Rodong News Team

title: Representative of Lebanese President Arrives
body: Milia Jabbour, representative of the president of the Republic of Lebanon, arrived in Pyongyang on Wednesday to take part in the events marking the 70th birthday of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. Rodong News Team

title: National Industrial Art Exhibition Opens
body: A national industrial art exhibition opened with due ceremony Wednesday in celebration of the 70th birthday of the DPRK. On show in the venue are over 1 900 designs of industrial arts, samples and models including ones of flag and emblem created under the guidance of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Attending the ceremony were An Jong Su, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea; Ri Ju O, vice-premier of the Cabinet; officials concerned, officials in the industrial art field and creators. Rodong News Team

title: Foreigners Arrive
body: A delegation of the China Institute of Contemporary International Relations headed by President Yuan Peng and Xu Jing, director of the Regional Department for Asia and the Pacific of the World Tourism Organization, arrived in Pyongyang on Wednesday to participate in events for celebrating the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Players Return Home
body: DPRK players bagged twelve gold medals, twelve silver medals and thirteen bronze medals, thirty seven medals in total at the 18th Asian Games held in Indonesia from Aug. 18 to Sept. 2. A delegation of the DPRK Olympic Committee headed by Chairman Kim Il Guk who is minister of Physical Culture and Sports, and the DPRK players group led by Won Kil U, vice-minister of Physical Culture and Sports, came back home on Wednesday. Players and coaches were greeted by Choe Hwi, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the National Sports Guidance Committee, Ri Ryong Nam, vice-premier of the cabinet, officials concerned and family members at the Pyongyang International Airport. Sportspersons congratulated the players upon their successful matches while putting garlands around their necks and presenting bouquets to them. The players and coaches laid a floral basket and bouquets before the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill and paid tribute to them. Rodong News Team

title: Families of Those Related to Anti-Japanese Revolutionary Struggle Arrive
body: The family of Fan Delin, a Chinese related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, and families of Kim Chol, Li Min and Li Zade, China-resident Koreans related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, arrived in Pyongyang Wednesday to take part in the celebrations of the 70th birthday of the DPRK. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Floral Baskets and Congratulatory Letters
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received floral baskets and congratulatory letters from the diplomatic corps, military attaches corps and the economic and commercial councilors corps here with the approach of the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. The floral baskets and congratulatory letters were conveyed to Foreign Minister Ri Yong Ho by Ismail Ahmed Mohamed Hasan, Palestinian ambassador to the DPRK who is the doyen of the diplomatic corps, and to Army General No Kwang Chol, minister of the People's Armed Forces, by Alexei Bartusov, military attaché of the Russian embassy who is the doyen of the military attaches corps, on Wednesday. On the same day a floral basket and congratulatory letter were conveyed to an official concerned by the economic and commercial councilors corps. Rodong News Team

title: Juche Idea Study Bodies Delegations and Delegates Arrive
body: Delegations and delegates of Juche idea study organizations arrived in Pyongyang on Sept. 6 on the occasion of the 70th birthday of the DPRK. They are a delegation of the Nigerian National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism led by Chairman Alhassan Mamman Muhammad, a delegation of the Ethiopian National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism led by Chairman Nigatu Dagnachew, a delegation of the Czech Group for the Study and Materialization of the Juche Idea led by Chairman Jozef Servista, a delegation of the Mongolian Association for the Study of the Juche Idea-Songun Idea led by O. Mashbat, a delegation of the Pakistan Association for Self-Reliance Studies led by Kashif ur Rehman, Manju Ratna Sakya, chairman of the Nepal Journalist Association for the Study of the Juche Idea and Songun Politics, and his party, Riyad Chaloub, chairman of the Guinean National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, Volodymyr Polishchuk, delegate of the Ukrainian "Treasured Sword of Songun" Association for the Study of the Juche Idea, and Pavlo Homonay, delegate of the "Sun of Juche" Association of Journalists and Men of Culture for the Study of Kimjongilism in Ukraine. Arriving earlier were Mukesh Sharma, secretary general of the International Kim Il Sung Prize Council and the International Kim Jong Il Prize Council, and his party, a delegation of the Japanese National Liaison Council of Societies for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism headed by Adviser Takao Kamakura, a delegation of the British Group for the Study of the Juche Idea headed by Chairman Dermot Hudson, a delegation of the Brazilian Center for the Study of Songun Politics led by Chairman Lucas Rubio and a delegation of the Swedish Group for the Study of the Juche Idea headed by Chief Oskar Molleby. Rodong News Team

title: Overseas Koreans Arrive
body: A home-visiting group of Koreans in Japan led by Pak Hae Chol, vice department director of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan, a delegation of the compatriots' organization in Canada led by Kim Su Hae, chairman of the Association of Koreans in Canada, and a delegation of the Society for Cooperation among Koreans in Germany led by Permanent Member Son Kyong Sok, arrived in Pyongyang on Thursday to take part in events for celebrating the 70th birthday of the DPRK. Arriving earlier was a delegation of the Federation of Koreans in Australia headed by Chairman Pak Yong Ha. Rodong News Team

title: Foreign Guests Arrive
body: O. Baasankhuu, chairman of the Mongolia-Korea Friendship Parliamentary Group, and his party, Wolfgang Nowak, former general director for Political Planning of Mr. Schroeder's Cabinet of Germany, and his party, Mamoru Kitahara, chairman of the Japan Fukuoka Prefectural Japan-DPRK Friendship Association, and his party, Belmonte Meewis Wivina, deputy regional director of the UNICEF East Asia and Pacific Region, arrived in Pyongyang on Thursday to take part in the events marking the 70th birthday of the DPRK. Rodong News Team

title: Foreign Delegations Arrive
body: A delegation led by Qiu Jianliang and a delegation of the German Support Association of the Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation headed by Thomas Karl Lichter arrived in Pyongyang on Thursday to take part in the events for celebrating the 70th birthday of the DPRK and the 2nd general meeting of members of the Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation. And Jin Yuhua and Jin Xian, directors of the Board of Directors of the Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation, arrived in Pyongyang. Rodong News Team

title: Foreign Party Delegations and Delegate Arrive
body: A delegation of the Party of Socialists in the Republic of Moldova led by Vladimir Golovatiuc, vice-chairman of its National Council, a delegation of the Communist Party of the People of Spain led by General Secretary Carmelo Suarez, Abdulla Juma Abdulla Saadalla, vice general secretary of the Revolutionary Party of Tanzania, and a delegation of the Foreign Affairs Committee of the British Labor Party led by member Glyn Ford arrived in Pyongyang on Thursday to take part in the celebrations of the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. Rodong News Team

title: Congratulations to Pakistani President
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, Thursday sent congratulations to Arif Alvi upon his election as president of Pakistan. The message expressed conviction that the friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries based on long history and tradition would further expand and wholeheartedly wished the Pakistani president success in his responsible work for the stability and prosperity of the country. Rodong News Team

title: Floral Tribute to President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Foreigners and overseas Koreans paid floral tribute to President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il before their statues on Mansu Hill Thursday. They included the congratulatory group of Koreans in Japan for celebrating the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK, the delegation of the International Taekwon-do Federation, the delegation of the Society for Cooperation among Koreans in Germany, families of Zhou Baozhong and Hu Zhenyi, Chinese related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, and their parties, families of Chai Shiying and Wang Xiaoming, Chinese related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, and foreign guests and overseas Koreans. They put bouquets before the statues of the great leaders and made a bow. Rodong News Team

title: National Seminar Held
body: A national seminar took place at the People's Palace of Culture on Thursday to deeply grasp the feats of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and glorify them. Attending it were Yang Hyong Sop, vice-president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, Pak Kwang Ho, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and officials of the Party and administrative bodies and working people's organizations, armed forces organs and science, education, literature and arts, media and party cadre training institutions and the field of the preservation of revolutionary relics in Pyongyang. The seminar heard papers dealing with the feats of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il and explaining the tasks and ways for realizing the peerlessly great men's patriotic desire for building a powerful country under the leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea. The speakers referred to the fact that the President ushered in the rise for building a socialist state and turned the DPRK into the Juche-oriented socialist country shining with independence, prospering with self-support and impregnable with self-reliance in national defence. They said that Kim Jong Il turned the DPRK into a politically and ideologically strong and dignified country and invincible military power through the Songun revolutionary leadership day and night. They noted that Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il were the great models of giving priority to the people and respecting them as they developed the DPRK government into the representative of the independent right of the popular masses and the organizer of their creative activities. They said Kim Jong Un is a peerlessly great man who is turning the DPRK into a dignified people's country and bringing earlier the final victory of building a Juche-oriented power under the banner of independence. They expressed their will to wage a dynamic struggle for bringing about the comprehensive prosperity of socialism under the leadership of Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: Government Delegation of Dominica Arrives
body: A government delegation of the Dominican Republic headed by Minister of Government Jose Miguel Mejia, secretary general of the United Left Movement of Dominica, arrived in Pyongyang on Thursday to take part in events for celebrating the 70th birthday of the DPRK. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK's Birthday Observed Abroad
body: Seminars were held in Russia, France, Indonesia and Nepal on August 29 and 31 to mark the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. Sazhi Umalatova, chairwoman of the Party for Peace and Unity of Russia, said that the foundation of the DPRK serves as a historic occasion which brought about a fundamental turn for the Korean people in hewing out their destiny. She noted that the life of President Kim Il Sung was a brilliant one consistent with the boundless loving care of the people and devotion to their happiness. She pointed out that Chairman Kim Jong Il defended the sovereignty and dignity of the country by pursuing the Songun politics. Harn Sinuraya, manager of the Rabitra Bahtera Pratama Co. of Indonesia, noted that President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il always live in the hearts of not only the Korean people but also the world progressive people as they performed exploits for the foundation and development of the DPRK. Sonkori Baroti, chairman of the Nepali Literary Forum for the Study of Songun Politics, said he firmly believes that the Korean people who are united single-mindedly around Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un would register only victory under the banner of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism. The Nepali followers of the Juche idea and people would positively conduct the activities for supporting the DPRK, socialist fortress, in the future, too, he added. A congratulatory message to Kim Jong Un was adopted at the seminar held in Nepal. Rodong News Team

title: Meeting for Adopting Joint Congratulatory Message to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Held
body: A meeting for adopting a joint congratulatory message to Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and supreme commander of the Korean People's Army, was held at the People's Palace of Culture on Friday on the occasion of the 70 founding anniversary of the DPRK. Present there were Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, and senior officials of the party, government and army. Also present were officials of the party and power bodies, the Cabinet, working people's organizations, ministries and national institutions, service personnel of the Korean People's Army and the Korean People's Internal Security Forces and officials of the institutions and industrial establishments in Pyongyang. Kim Yong Nam read the congratulatory message in the joint name of the C.C., WPK, the Central Military Commission of the WPK, the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK and the Cabinet of the DPRK. The message extended the highest glory and warmest congratulations to Supreme Leader of our party, state and army Kim Jong Un in reflection of the mind of all the people and service personnel on the occasion of the 70th birthday of the DPRK. It noted that the Supreme Leader put forward it as the fundamental principle of building a powerful nation to strengthen the DPRK into the state of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, successfully carried out it and thus provided the foundation of eternal prosperity of Juche Korea. The Supreme Leader also brought about a new turning phase in improving the north-south relations and carrying out the cause of national reunification and put the dignity and international prestige of the DPRK on the highest level through his prominent political caliber and energetic external activities, it pointed out. It underlined the need for the people and service personnel of the People's Army to dash like the wind toward the morrow of a powerful socialist country indicated by the Supreme Leader. Rodong News Team

title: Talks between Vice-Chairman of C.C., WPK and Deputy Regional Secretary of Syria's Baath Arab Socialist Party Held
body: Talks between Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, and Helal Al-Helal, deputy regional secretary of the Syria's Baath Arab Socialist Party, were held at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Friday. Exchanged at the talks were views on further developing the traditional and solid relations of friendship and cooperation between the two parties in keeping with the common interests of the peoples of the two countries. Present at the talks from the WPK side were Ri Il Hwan, department director of the C.C., WPK, Kim Yong Jae, minister of External Economic Relations who is chairman of the DPRK-Syria Friendship Association, and officials concerned and from the opposite party were members of the Syrian party and government delegation, Tammam Sulaiman, Syrian ambassador to the DPRK, and his embassy officials. At the end of the talks, an agreement on cooperation between the two parties was signed. Rodong News Team

title: Syrian Party, Government Delegation Here
body: The party and government delegation of the Syrian Arab Republic led by Helal Al-Helal, deputy regional secretary of the Syria's Baath Arab Socialist Party, arrived here on Friday to participate in events for celebrating the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. The delegation was greeted at Pyongyang International Airport by Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the WPK Central Committee, Ri Il Hwan, department director of the WPK Central Committee, Kim Yong Jae, minister of External Economic Affairs and chairman of the DPRK-Syria Friendship Association, officials concerned, Syrian Ambassador to the DPRK Tammam Sulaiman and his embassy officials. Pyongyang citizens welcomed the delegation, waving bouquets. Rodong News Team

title: 2nd General Meeting of Members of Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation Held
body: The second general meeting of members of the Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation was held in Pyongyang on Friday. It was attended by the members of the delegation of the 2nd general meeting of the members of the foundation led by Qiu Jianliang. Members of the foundation and its support association were present there as honorary guests. Speeches were made there. Speakers expressed deep thanks to the Workers' Party of Korea and the DPRK government which provided all conditions for the successful meeting held in the significant period marking the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. The meeting reviewed the work of the members of the foundation for the past two years and reported the successes and experience. Also discussed there were practical issues arising in giving wider publicity to the exploits of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and developing the work of the foundation. A letter to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was adopted there. That day a reception was given for the participants of the meeting. Rodong News Team

title: Reception Given for Syrian Party and Government Delegation
body: The Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and the government of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea hosted a reception at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Friday evening in welcome of the party and government delegation of the Syrian Arab Republic on a visit to the DPRK to take part in the celebrations for the 70th birthday of the DPRK. Invited there were members of the party and government delegation of Syria led by Helal Al-Helal, deputy regional secretary of the Syria's Baath Arab Socialist Party, and Tammam Sulaiman, Syrian ambassador to the DPRK. Present there were Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK; Ri Il Hwan, department director of the C.C., WPK; Kim Yong Jae, minister of External Economic Relations who is chairman of the DPRK-Syria Friendship Association; and officials concerned. Speeches were made there. Rodong News Team

title: Delegates to Celebrations for DPRK Birthday Here
body: Delegates to celebrations for the 70th birthday of the DPRK arrived here on Sept. 7. They were greeted by Kim Phyong Hae, Pak Thae Song and Choe Hwi, vice-chairmen of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and senior officials of the Party Central Committee and armed forces organs. Rodong News Team

title: S. African Party and Government Delegation Here
body: A party and government delegation of the Republic of South Africa led by Bonginkosi Emmanuel Nzimande, general secretary of the South African Communist Party and minister of Transport, arrived here on Friday to take part in events for celebrating the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. Rodong News Team

title: Foreigners Visit Mangyongdae
body: Foreigners visited Mangyongdae, birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. They included the delegation of the General People's Union Party of Russia, the delegation of the Party of Socialists in the Republic of Moldova, the delegation of the Foreign Affairs Committee of the British Labor Party, the delegation of Communist Party of the People of Spain, the party and state delegation of the Republic of Uganda, the delegation of the China Institute of Contemporary International Relations, the former general director for Political Planning of Mr. Schroeder's Cabinet of Germany and his party and the chairman of the Fukuoka Prefectural Japan-DPRK Friendship Association and his party. At the old home in Mangyongdae, the guests looked round the historical relics preserved there, being briefed on the revolutionary history of President Kim Il Sung. Rodong News Team

title: Lao Party Delegation Here
body: A delegation of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party led by Xaysomphone Phomvihane, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party and chairman of the Central Committee of the National Construction Front of Laos, arrived here on Saturday to take part in events for celebrating the 70th founding anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. Rodong News Team

title: Choe Hwi Meets Foreign Party Delegation and Delegates
body: Choe Hwi, alternate member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, met and had talks with the delegation of the Popular Liberation Movement of Angola led by Silva Americo Afonso, member of the Central Committee and chairman of the Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Party Central Committee, Faizle Hossain Badsha, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Bangladesh, and the international secretary of the Central Executive Committee of the Bangladesh National Socialist Party, which paid a courtesy call on him at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Saturday. Rodong News Team

title: Talks between Vice-Chairman of C.C., WPK and Chairman of Mongolian Democratic Party Held
body: Talks between Pak Thae Song, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), and S. Erdene, chairman of the Mongolian Democratic Party, were held at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Saturday. Present at the talks from the WPK side were Ryu Myong Son, vice-department director of the C.C., WPK, and officials concerned and from the opposite side were members of the delegation of the Mongolian Democratic Party. Rodong News Team

title: Letter to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Participants in Int'l Seminar
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a letter from the participants in the international seminar on the "Juche idea and the 70 years of the DPRK" on Saturday. The letter said that the Juche idea followers gathered in Pyongyang and held the international seminar on the "Juche idea and the 70 years of the DPRK" to celebrate the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. Socialist Korea has been developed thanks to the idea and leadership of President Kim Il Sung who believed in the people as in Heaven and regarded them as the master of the country, the letter stressed. It noted that Chairman Kim Jong Il defended socialism and laid the firm foundation for the building of a powerful country by leading the people under the banner of Songun in the struggle against the imperialist forces that were trying to stifle the DPRK. It pointed out that thanks to Kim Jong Un who is invariably carrying forward the idea and cause of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il socialist Korea has fully demonstrated its might in a short span of time. It said that the north-south summit talks were held on the initiative of Kim Jong Un who defends and carries forward the idea of national reunification and leadership exploits of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il. These talks brought delight and hope to all the Korean people and aroused support and sympathy from the international community that is desirous of permanent peace on the Korean peninsula and stability in the region, it added. It said that Kim Jong Un steered the first-ever DPRK-U.S. summit meeting and talks in Singapore and reached an agreement which was of historic significance in ensuring world peace. It noted that this year's historic events show that the people's happy future is sure to come when they advance along the road indicated by Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism. It stated that Juche idea followers who cherish the conviction that Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism is the ever-victorious banner for global peace and independence are hardening their determination to perform their historic duty to study and disseminate the immortal idea on an extensive scale. Rodong News Team

title: International Joint Meeting Marks 70th Anniversary of DPRK
body: An international joint meeting for celebrating the 70th founding anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea took place at the People's Place of Culture on Saturday. Present at the meeting were Yang Hyong Sop, vice-president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, Kim Jong Suk, chairwoman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries who doubles as a joint chairwoman of the organizing committee of the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu, Pak Kyong Il, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries who doubles as the secretary general of the organizing committee of the said festival, and officials concerned. Attending the meeting were Peter Woods, co-chairman of the Asia-Pacific Regional Committee for Supporting Peaceful Reunification of Korea, Damian Ogbonna, chairman of the African Regional Committee for Friendship and Solidarity with the Korean People, Yehia Zakaria Khairullah, co-chairman of the Arab Regional Committee for Friendship and Solidarity with the Korean People, Jesus Antonio Carlos Hernandez, first vice-chairman of the Latin American and Caribbean Regional Committee to Support the Reunification of Korea, Anders Kristensen, chairman of the Denmark-DPRK Friendship Association, Fumihiro Himori, chairman of the Japan Committee for Supporting the Independent and Peaceful Reunification of Korea, who are co-chairpersons of the Organizing Committee of the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu, and members of the organizing committee, delegations and delegates of the friendly and solidarity organizations with the Korean people and international democratic organizations. At the meeting a floral basket and silk banner in the name of the organizing committee of the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was conveyed to Yang Hyong Sop. Speeches were made there. A letter to Kim Jong Un was adopted there. Rodong News Team

title: Syrian Party, Government Delegation Visits War Museum
body: The party and government delegation of the Syrian Arab Republic led by Helal Al-Helal, deputy regional secretary of the Baath Arab Socialist Party, visited the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum on Saturday. They went round various rooms of the museum, being briefed on President Kim Il Sung's feats for war victory. On the same day the delegation visited Kim Il Sung University. Rodong News Team

title: Foreigners Visit Tower of Juche Idea
body: Riad Al Maliki, minister of Foreign Affairs and Expatriates, who is a special envoy of the president of the State of Palestine, and his party and Minister of Trade and Industry Ali Masoud Ali Al Sunaidy, a representative of the Sultan of Oman, and his party visited the Tower of the Juche Idea on Saturday. The guests made round of the body of the tower and group of sculptures, being briefed on the immortal ideological and theoretical exploits of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. They went up to the tower observation platform to have a bird's eye view of Pyongyang. On the same day they toured the Arch of Triumph and other places. Rodong News Team

title: Venezuelan Party, Governmental Delegation Here
body: A party and government delegation of the Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela led by Adan Chavez Frias, vice-chairman of the United Socialist Party of Venezuela and chairman of the International Relations Committee of the National Constituent Assembly, arrived here on Saturday to take part in events for celebrating the 70th founding anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. Rodong News Team

title: Foreign Delegations Arrive
body: A delegation of the Iclei East Asia Secretariat, a delegation of the China Association for International Friendly Contact and a delegation of the Chinese Taipei Book Publication Association arrived here on Saturday to attend the 11th Pyongyang International Science and Technology Book Fair. Rodong News Team

title: Foreign Delegations and Delegates Here
body: Delegations and delegates of various countries and international organizations arrived here on Saturday to take part in the celebrations for the 70th birthday of the DPRK. They are a state delegation of the Republic of Azerbaijan led by Huseyn Azar, roving ambassador of its Foreign Ministry, delegation of the government of the Republic of Singapore by Tan Wu Meng, senior parliamentary secretary in charge of the ministries of Foreign Affairs and Trade and Industry, delegation of the World Peace Organization by President Juan Samuel Delgado Cedillo, delegation of the Gauteng Parliament of South Africa by Deputy Chairperson of the GPL Mpapa Jeremia Kanyane, and Elia G. Kaiyamo, special envoy of the Namibian President, Bayney Karran, delegate of the government of the Cooperative Republic of Guyana, Leela Mani Paudyal, delegate of the government of the Federal Democratic Republic of Nepal, Lee Kok Ting, delegate of the government of Brunei Darussalam, Asaye Alemayehu Pejjenie, delegate of the government of the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia, Maria Gustava, delegate of the government of the Republic of Mozambique, Kent Rolf Magnus Harstedt, special envoy of the Swedish government, Marielza Couto E Silva De Oliveira, representative of the UNESCO, Alois Zwinggi, representative of the World Economic Forum, Thit Linn Ohn, delegate of the government of the Republic of the Union of Myanmar, M. Fazlul Karim, special envoy of the government of the People's Republic of Bangladesh, Alain Gaschen, delegate of the government of Switzerland, Winnie Natala Chibesakunda, delegate of the government of the Republic of Zambia, Jose Santiago L. Sta Romana, delegate of the government of the Republic of Philippines, Piriya Khempon, delegate of the government of the Kingdom of Thailand, Milan Bacevic, first-deputy prime minister of the government of the Republic of Serbia and special envoy of foreign minister, and Kaveh Zahedi, deputy executive secretary of the United Nations Economic and Social Commission for Asia and the Pacific. That day, a delegation of the Bangladesh Institute of the Juche Idea headed by Chairman Sheikh Rafiqul Islam Bablu also arrived in Pyongyang by air. Rodong News Team

title: Art Performances Given to Mark Birthday of DPRK
body: Art performances were given in provinces to mark the 70th birthday of the DPRK. Art performances "The Glorious Country" and "Do Prosper, My Motherland" were given in North Phyongan, South Hwanghae and North Hamgyong Provinces. Put on the stage were colorful numbers including chorus "Song of People's Power", male solo "Thunder over Jong Il Peak" and narration and chorus "We Are the Happiest in the World." The performers sang the high praises of the patriotic devotion of the great leaders who had built a new genuine country of the people and energetically led the great cause of building a prosperous country till the last moments of their life. A music and dance performance "The Great Country" was given by the artistes of the South Hamgyong Provincial Art Troupe, working people, youth and schoolchildren in the province at the Hamhung Grand Theater. A grand chorus and a dancing party "Pyongyang Is the Best" were given by women's union members at Kanggye Plaza. Similar performances were given by artistes of art troupes, students of conservatories, workers, trade union members, agricultural workers and women's union members at theaters, houses of culture and plazas in other provinces. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Founding Anniversary Marked by United Confederation of Koreans in Russia
body: The United Confederation of Koreans in Russia held a meeting on September 4 to celebrate the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. Attending it were Chairman Kim Chil Song and members of the confederation, members of Moscow-Sakhalin Society of Koreans, a vice-chairman of the All-Russia Society of Korean Scientists and members of the Russia-Korea Friendship Association and the Russian Group for Solidarity with the DPRK. The participants laid bouquets before the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. Kim Chil Song made a speech followed by other speeches. The speakers said that it is the greatest one of Kim Il Sung's and Kim Jong Il's immortal exploits that they built the country into an independent sovereign state and demonstrated the dignity and honour of the Korean nation to the world. They highly praised Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un for his amazing successes in leading the build-up of defence and the economic construction and in bringing about the Panmunjom Declaration and the DPRK-U.S. summit meeting to inspire the whole Korean nation with confidence in victory unfazed by the imperialist allied forces' unprecedented vicious "sanctions" and schemes to isolate and stifle the country. They said that Koreans in Russia would make an active contribution to the motherland's efforts to build itself into a powerful socialist country. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Yong Nam Meets Cuban Party and State Delegation
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, met and had a talk with the Cuban party and state delegation led by Salvador Antonio Valdes Mesa, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba, first vice-president of the Council of State and first vice-president of the Council of Ministers of Cuba who paid a courtesy call on him, at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Sunday. Present there were Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the WPK, Vice Foreign Minister Choe Hui Chol and officials concerned. Rodong News Team

title: Wreaths Laid at Cemeteries of Martyrs
body: Wreaths were laid at statues and cemeteries of martyrs, the Memorial Towers for the Fallen Soldiers of the Korean People's Army and the Cemeteries of Fallen Fighters of the KPA across the country on Sunday, the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. Present at the wreath-laying events were officials of local party and power organs and working people's organizations, officers and men of the KPA and the Korean People's Internal Security Forces, working people, school youth and children. Wreaths in the names of the local party and power organs, working people's organizations, units of the KPA and the KPISF, factories, enterprises and farms, and bouquets and flowers were placed at the statues and cemeteries of martyrs and the memorial towers and the cemeteries of fallen fighters of the KPA. The participants paid a silent tribute to the memory of the martyrs who had defended the country's freedom and independence, national sovereignty and gains of the revolution and sacrificed themselves for the patriotic cause of building a powerful socialist country. Rodong News Team

title: 70th Founding Anniversary of DPRK Marked by Koreans in China
body: The General Association of Koreans in China arranged events for celebrating the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. A meeting of the general association took place in Shenyang, China, on September 6. Present there were First Vice-Chairman Choe Su Bong and other officials of the general association and its affiliated organizations, members of the Federation of Korean Economic Workers in China and the Association of Young Korean Nationals in China, Korean nationals in Shenyang and the DPRK consul general in Shenyang and his staff. Choe Su Bong delivered a report to the meeting, in which he said he would, first of all, pay high tribute to President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il who had founded the DPRK and laid the everlasting groundwork for developing it into a socialist power. He referred to the fact that Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il put forward the Koreans in China as overseas citizens of Juche Korea, formed the General Association of Koreans in China as a genuine patriotic organization, and led it along the path of patriotism stage by stage. He also called upon those attending the meeting to turn out, with one accord, in the efforts for the prosperity and reunification of the nation. He continued to stress that to this end, they should be united rock-solid behind the general association, under the direction of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and true to the patriotic ideas and behests of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il. The report was followed by the adoption of a letter to Kim Jong Un amid enthusiastic applause. The participants watched a Korean documentary "The People Sing of Their Leader". A concert for celebrating the 70th birthday of the DPRK was given at Yanji, China, on September 4. In addition, other colorful events were held under the auspices of the Zhongnan Regional Association and other affiliated organizations of the above general association. Rodong News Team

title: Choe Ryong Hae Meets Cuban Party, State Delegation
body: Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the WPK Central Committee, on Sunday met and had a talk, at the Mansudae Assembly Hall, with the Cuban party and state delegation led by Salvador Antonio Valdes Mesa, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba, first vice-president of the Council of State and first vice-president of the Council of Ministers of Cuba. Rodong News Team

title: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Servicepersons, working people of various circles, youth and schoolchildren of the DPRK visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on the occasion of the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. Seen standing before the statues of the great leaders was a floral basket from Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Laid before the statues were floral baskets in the names of the Party, armed forces and power organs, social organizations, ministries, national institutions, units of the Korean People's Army and the Korean People's Internal Security Forces and institutions, industrial establishments, farms and schools of various levels in Pyongyang as well as bouquets and flowers. Also placed there was a floral basket in the name of the Pyongyang mission of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front. The visitors paid tribute to the statues of the peerlessly great men. Floral baskets in the names of KPA units, institutions and enterprises were laid before the statues of the great leaders in various parts of Pyongyang including Kim Il Sung University, the Ministry of the People's Armed Forces, the Ministry of People's Security and the Mansudae Art Studio. Servicepersons, working people and youth and schoolchildren across the country visited the local statues and mosaic murals depicting the beaming leaders, before paying homage to them. Rodong News Team

title: Ri Su Yong Meets Lao Party Delegation
body: Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, met and had a talk with the delegation of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party led by Xaysomphone Phomvihane, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party and chairman of the Central Committee of the National Construction Front of Laos, who paid a courtesy call on him Sunday. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Embassy in Moscow Hosts Reception
body: The DPRK embassy in Moscow hosted a reception on September 5 on the occasion of the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. Present there on invitation were personages of the government, political parties, bodies and organs of Russia including the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Ministry of Defense, the Ministry of Development of Far East, the Ministry of Economy and Development, the State Duma, the United Russia Party, the Communist Party of the Russian Federation, the Liberal Democratic Party, the Party for Peace and Unity and the Russian Association for Friendship and Cultural Cooperation with the DPRK. The DPRK ambassador to Russia and staff members of his embassy were on hand. The participants laid a floral basket and bouquets before an art piece depicting President Kim Il Sung standing together with Chairman Kim Jong Il and paid tribute to them. Speeches were made at the reception. Igor Morgulov, vice foreign minister, said that Russia and the DPRK are linked with ties of firm friendship and cooperation and good experience from the recent cooperation becomes the foundation of the development of many-sided and equally-beneficial relations between the two countries. Alexandr Fomin, vice-minister of defense, warmly congratulated the Korean people celebrating the 70th birthday of the DPRK. Wishing the Korean people greater success in their struggle for development, prosperity, peace and stability of the region, he said that the Korean people displayed heroism and courage in the defence of the country and creative work. He added that Russia will fully support the DPRK as ever. Rodong News Team

title: Receptions Given to Mark Birthday of DPRK
body: The State Affairs Commission of the DPRK hosted receptions on Sunday to mark its 70th founding anniversary. Present there were Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK; Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the WPK Central Committee; Premier Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK; and other senior officials of the Party, government and the army and delegates to the celebrations for the 70th birthday of the DPRK. Invited there were congratulatory groups and delegations of overseas compatriots including those from Japan, overseas compatriots staying in the socialist homeland and the chief of the Pyongyang mission of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front. Among the foreign guests were the delegations, special envoys, delegates, personages on a visit to the DPRK to attend the celebrations, diplomatic envoys and representatives of international bodies here, military attaches and their wives. Speeches were made at the receptions. Speakers said that the 70-year-long history of the DPRK is characterized by the patriotic devotion of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, and by the heroic Korean people's loyalty to them. They called for increasing the national strength of Juche Korea in every way possible, by developing its government as befits a mighty weapon for carrying out the cause of socialism and effecting a series of miraculous changes in all sectors and units under the direction of the WPK. They stressed the stand of the DPRK government to open up a broad avenue towards independent reunification based on the principle of By Our Nation Itself, promote the relations of friendship and cooperation with those countries that respect the sovereignty of the DPRK, and fulfil its responsibility and role in ensuring peace and security on the Korean peninsula and in the rest of the world. These receptions were given at the Mokran House, the People's Palace of Culture, the Okryu Restaurant, the Chongnyu Restaurant, the Pyongyang Noodle House, the floating restaurant Taedonggang and the general-service ship Mujigae. Rodong News Team

title: Chinese Associations Host Reception to Mark DPRK Birthday
body: The Chinese People's Association for Friendship with Foreign Countries and the China-Korea Friendship Association gave a reception on Sept. 7 on the occasion of the 70th birthday of the DPRK. Present there on invitation were Ji Jae Ryong, DPRK ambassador to China, and his embassy officials. On hand were Wang Qishan, vice-president of China; Li Xiaolin, president of the Chinese People's Association for Friendship with Foreign Countries; and officials concerned of the International Liaison Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, the Foreign Ministry, the Defense Ministry, the Ministry of Commerce, etc. Li Xiaolin in the speech referred to the historic significance of the foundation of the DPRK, adding that he was confident that the Korean people would continue registering fresh achievements under the guidance of the Workers' Party of Korea which is holding Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in high esteem. He said that the deep friendship between the two parties and the two peoples provided by the leaders of the elder generation of the two countries during the protracted revolutionary struggle and socialist construction serves as precious wealth. He expressed the willingness to sincerely implement with the Korean comrades the important common understanding achieved by the top leaders of the two countries, intensify the strategic communication and deepen the traditional friendship so as to achieve the greater development in the bilateral relations in the new situation and provide the people with wellbeing. Ji Jae Ryong mentioned feats of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in founding and strengthening the DPRK and the facts that Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un remarkably boosted the power of the country true to the desire of the great leaders and firmly defended peace on the Korean peninsula and in the rest of the world. He also said that the Korean people are turning out as one in the campaign for implementing the five-year strategy for national economic development to make a leap forward and innovations. He expressed the will to make efforts hand in hand with Chinese comrades to further develop the DPRK-China friendly ties at a new high level under the deep care of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and President Xi Jinping as required by the times. Rodong News Team

title: Chinese Party and Government Delegation Visits Friendship Tower
body: The party and government delegation of the People's Republic of China (PRC) led by Li Zhanshu, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the C.C., Communist Party of China and chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress of the PRC, who is taking part in the celebrations of the 70th birthday of the DPRK as a special envoy of Xi Jinping, general secretary of the C.C., CPC, and president of the PRC, visited the Friendship Tower on Monday. It was accompanied by Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea Central Committee, Ryu Myong Son, vice department director of the WPK Central Committee, Ri Kil Song, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs of the DPRK, and staff members of the Chinese embassy here. A floral basket in the name of the party and government delegation of the PRC was placed at the tower. The participants observed a moment's silence in memory of the fallen soldiers of the Chinese People's Volunteers, who displayed matchless braveness and self-sacrificing spirit in the Korean front against the imperialists' armed invasion under the banner of resisting America and aiding Korea, safeguarding the home and defending the motherland. Li Zhanshu wrote in the visitor's book: The Friendship Tower is a historic witness and eternal symbol of the China-Korea friendship. The Chinese and Korean peoples should cherish deep in mind and inherit and develop the history. That day the delegation visited Pyongyang Teacher Training College. Rodong News Team

title: Chairwoman of Russian Federation Council Leaves
body: Valentina Ivanovna Matvienko, chairwoman of the Russian Federation Council, left here on Monday after paying an official visit to the Democratic People's Republic of Korea to attend the celebrations of its 70th birthday. Rodong News Team

title: Mauritanian President Flies Back Home
body: Mohamed Ould Abdel Aziz, president of the Islamic Republic of Mauritania, left here by plane for his personal use on Monday after visiting the DPRK to attend the celebrations of its 70th birthday. The president and his party were seen off at Pyongyang International Airport by Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK; Ri Yong Ho, foreign minister; Ri Myong San, vice-minister of External Economic Relations; and Bal Mohamed El Habib, Mauritanian ambassador to the DPRK. Rodong News Team

title: Concert Given by National Symphony Orchestra
body: The National Symphony Orchestra gave a concert "Socialist Symphony" at the Moranbong Theatre on Monday to celebrate the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. Among the audience were Kim Yong Nam, Presidium member of the Political Bureau of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the DPRK Supreme People's Assembly, Pak Pong Ju, Presidium member of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK, vice-chairman of the DPRK State Affairs Commission and premier of the DPRK Cabinet, and other senior party and government officials, officials of the WPK Central Committee, military organs, ministries and national institutions and officials and merited persons of institutions and industrial establishments in Pyongyang. Invited to it were members of overseas compatriots' congratulatory groups and delegations, individual overseas compatriots and the chief of the Pyongyang mission of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front. Also present on invitation were diplomatic envoys of different countries and representatives of international organizations here, military attaches here and other foreign guests. The concert started with prelude "The Glorious Country" and the Patriotic Song (National Anthem) followed by seven movements such as "Ode to People's Republic", "My Country Is So Nice", "Great Guardian", "Prosperous Country", "Song of Socialist Advance", "Friendly Music" and "O Party, It's Thanks to Your Care". Its performers highly praised President Kim Il Sung for building the country into a people-centred socialist state, independent in politics, self-supporting in the economy and self-reliant in defence, and Chairman Kim Jong Il for devoting all his life to implementing the cause of building a powerful country under the banner of Songun. They well represented in mixed orchestra the people's deep reverence and trust in Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un who is glorifying the DPRK as a dignified people's country. Rodong News Team

title: Torchlight Procession of Young Vanguard Marks 70th Anniversary of DPRK
body: Torchlight procession of young vanguard for celebrating the 70th anniversary of the DPRK "Youth, forward, demonstrating valiant mettle of heroic Korea!" was held in Kim Il Sung Square of Pyongyang on Monday evening. The platform was taken by Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet of the DPRK, and other senior party, government and army officials, chairmen of the provincial committees of the WPK and the first secretary of the Central Committee of the Youth League. Also taking it were Salvador Antonio Valdes Mesa, first vice-president of the Council of State and first vice-president of the Council of Ministers of Cuba, Helal Al-Helal, deputy regional secretary of the Baath Arab Socialist Party, and heads of party, state and government delegations from different countries on a visit to the DPRK to attend the celebrations of the 70th birthday of the DPRK. Seen on the platform were heads of the congratulatory group of Koreans in Japan, the congratulatory group of the General Association of Koreans in China and the delegation of the International United Confederation of Koreans. Present there were delegates to the celebrations of the 70th anniversary of the DPRK, officials of party, armed forces and power organs, ministries and national institutions, officers and men of the Korean People's Army and the Korean People's Internal Security Forces and persons of merit. Present there on invitation were members of overseas Koreans congratulatory groups and delegations, individual overseas compatriots and the chief of the Pyongyang mission of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front, and members of foreign delegations, representatives of foreign embassies and international organizations and members of the military attaches corps here and other foreign guests. When the start of the torchlight procession was declared, letters reading "September 9" and "Celebrations 70" in celebration of the anniversary of the DPRK were displayed on the ground amid the playing of song "The Glorious Country". Open limousines carrying the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il passed the square, escorted by the young vanguard with torches in their hands. Youth and students portrayed large-size letters reading "Kim Il Sung's Nation" and "Kim Jong Il's Korea" and the sun with torchlight. They depicted the emblem of the WPK, the national flag and letters reading "Kim Jong Un's era", "Supreme Leader" and "Banner of Victory" with torchlight. The procession advanced, forming letters reading "Heroic Korea" and "Single-minded Unity" with well-organized formation changes and other letters demonstrating the dignity of socialist Korea and representing figures portraying the torchlight holder of the Tower of the Juche Idea and the Monument to Party Founding. The best wishes of all the people and the youth for Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un were reflected in the large letters reading "Glory to Marshal!" made with torchlight, and fireworks of celebration went off to significantly decorate the end of the torchlight procession. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Arranges Art Performance and Banquet for Chinese Party, Government Delegation
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and supreme commander of the Korean People's Army, arranged an art performance and a banquet on Monday for the party and government delegation of the People's Republic of China led by Li Zhanshu, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress of the People's Republic of China, who is a special envoy of Xi Jinping, general secretary of the C.C., CPC and president of the PRC. The art performance was given at the Mansudae Art Theatre for the Chinese guests of honour on a visit to the DPRK. Kim Jong Un and his wife Ri Sol Ju enjoyed the performance together with Li Zhanshu and his delegation members. Among the audience were Choe Ryong Hae, Pak Kwang Ho, Ri Su Yong, Pak Thae Song, Kim Yo Jong and other officials of the C.C., WPK and the State Affairs Commission. Invited to the performance were Li Jinjun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK, and his embassy staff. Kim Jong Un and Ri Sol Ju greeted the members of the party and government delegation of the PRC at the lobby of the art theatre. After exchanging warm greetings and posing for a photo with the Chinese guests, he had an amiable talk with them. When the Supreme Leader appeared at the auditorium, followed by the Chinese guests including Li Zhanshu, the audience broke into enthusiastic cheers, extending the greatest glory and the warmest greetings of best wishes for him who has performed imperishable exploits in strengthening the DPRK-China friendship. Put on the stage were such colorful numbers as male solo "Fly High, Our Party Flag", orchestral music for kayagum "Arirang", female solo "We Sing of the Party", female chorus and male chorus "Along the Road of Socialism", as well as Chinese songs including female solo and male chorus "Song of Changjiang", female chorus "The Fluttering Red Flag", female quartet "May You Be in Good Health", female chorus "I Love My Chinese Nation" and female solo and pangchang "New World". The performance culminated with the finale "Korea-China Friendship Will Be Ever-lasting". The performers sang high praises of the dignity and prestige of the DPRK dynamically advancing along the road to the victory of socialism under the wise leadership of the WPK. And they demonstrated the invincibility and durability of the DPRK-China friendship booming decade after decade, century after century, under the special care of the top leaders of the two parties and the two countries. A floral basket in the name of the Chinese delegation was presented to the performers as a token of congratulations for their successful performance. Kim Jong Un, together with Li Zhanshu, mounted the stage to congratulate the artistes. That evening he hosted a banquet in honour of Li Zhanshu and his delegation. Choe Ryong Hae, upon authorization of the C.C., WPK and the State Affairs Commission, made a speech to welcome the Chinese guests of honour. The Supreme Leader had an amiable talk with Li Zhanshu and his delegation members, while the banquet was proceeding in a friendly and amicable atmosphere. Political News Team

title: Reception Given for Participants in Int'l Book Fair
body: The organizing committee of the Pyongyang International Science and Technology Book Fair hosted a reception for the participants in the fair at the People's Palace of Culture on Tuesday. Present there on invitation were delegations and delegates taking part in the fair and foreign diplomatic envoys and representatives of international organizations here. Present were Pak Thae Song, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Kim Jong Suk, chairwoman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries and chairwoman of the organizing committee of the fair, and officials concerned. Rodong News Team

title: Enlarged Meeting of Organizing Committee of International Festival
body: An enlarged meeting of the Organizing Committee of the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu took place in Pyongyang on Tuesday. Present there were Kim Jong Suk, chairwoman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries and co-chairwoman of the organizing committee, Pak Kyong Il, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries and secretary general of the organizing committee, and officials concerned. Attending it were the co-chairpersons of the Organizing Committee of the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu including Peter Woods, co-chairman of the Asia-Pacific Regional Committee for Supporting Peaceful Reunification of Korea, and Damian Ogbonna, chairperson of the African Regional Committee for Friendship and Solidarity with the Korean People, and delegates from foreign organizations for friendship and solidarity with the Korean people. At the meeting, the work of the organizing committee and friendship and solidarity organizations in various countries after the inauguration of the organizing committee was reviewed, experience exchanged and the orientation of future activities informed. A press release of the enlarged meeting was published. It said that preparatory work would be stepped up to arrange with splendor the 6th International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu in Pyongyang and the area of Mt Paektu in 2022, the year marking the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il and the 10th anniversary of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's assumption of the top posts of the party and the state of the DPRK. It noted that activities for proactively accelerating the historic trend of peace and stability created in the Korean peninsula and the region thanks to the outstanding diplomacy and energetic leadership of HE Kim Jong Un will be conducted worldwide in diverse manner and methods. It called for strongly demanding the earlier lift of all sorts of sanctions upon the DPRK, materially and morally supporting the struggle of the Korean people for building a powerful socialist nation, promoting the independent and peaceful reunification of Korea by realizing a smooth unified coordination of the activities of solidarity with the Korean people and thus tangibly contributing to ensuring peace and security in the region and the world. Rodong News Team

title: Int'l March for Korea's Peace, Prosperity and Reunification Held
body: An international march for Korea's peace, prosperity and reunification took place here on Tuesday. There was a ceremony of starting the march in front of the Monument to the Three Charters for National Reunification. Present there were Kim Jong Suk, chairwoman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries and chairwoman of the Korean Committee for Solidarity with the World People, Ri Son Gwon, chairman of the Committee for the Peaceful Reunification of the Country, officials concerned and working people in the city of Pyongyang. Attending it were co-chairpersons of the Organizing Committee of the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu including Peter Woods, co-chairman of the Asia-Pacific Regional Committee for Supporting Peaceful Reunification of Korea, and Yehia Zakaria Khairullah, co-chairman of the Arab Regional Committee for Friendship and Solidarity with the Korean People, delegations and delegates of organizations for friendship and solidarity with the Korean people and international democratic organizations and overseas compatriots. Speeches were made there. Iraklis Tsavdaridis, executive secretary of the World Peace Council, said that the World Peace Council supports Korea's peace and reunification based on the north-south joint declarations and presses for the withdrawal of all sorts of sanctions against the DPRK. Fumihiro Himori, chairman of the Japan Committee for the Independent and Peaceful Reunification of Korea, expressed the will to demand the Japanese authorities' apology and reparation for the past crimes against the Korean people and halt to the suppression of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan and work hard to realize the early normalization of Japan-DPRK diplomatic relations. Kim Jong Suk noted that the Korean people's struggle for peace and reunification of the Korean Peninsula is associated with the support of the peace-loving people including friendship and solidarity organizations of all countries and international democratic organizations. An appeal to the world peace-loving people was read out. The appeal underscored the need to intensify the international solidarity activities for a lasting and durable peace-keeping mechanism on the Korean Peninsula. It called for vigorously conducting the activities for opposing and rejecting all forms of sanctions and unjust measures against the prosperity of the Korean people. It called for full support and solidarity with the Korean people in their struggle for achieving reunification of the country on the principle of national independence. The participants in the march left the Monument to the Three Charters for National Reunification. The crowds ardently welcomed the marchers expressing firm support and solidarity with the Korean people in their just cause, waving bouquets. Rodong News Team

title: Families of Those Related to Activities of President Kim Il Sung
body: Visit International Friendship Exhibition House Families of those related to the revolutionary activities of President Kim Il Sung from abroad visited the International Friendship Exhibition House on Tuesday. They paid tribute to wax replicas of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. They looked round gifts presented to the great leaders and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un by party, state and government leaders and prominent figures of many countries of the world. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Order Conferred on International Organizational Secretary of KFA
body: Mana Sapmak, international organizational secretary of the Korean Friendship Association (KFA), was awarded Order of DPRK Friendship 2nd Class. He, with reverence for the peerlessly great persons, is supporting the just cause of the Korean people for building a powerful socialist nation and achieving the country's independent reunification, and positively acting for the development of friendly ties with the DPRK. The awarding ceremony took place at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Tuesday. Rodong News Team

title: Vice-Chairman of C.C., WPK Meets Congolese State Delegation
body: Choe Hwi, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Tuesday had a talk with a state delegation of the Republic of Congo headed by President of the Senate Pierre Ngolo, general secretary of the Congolese Party of Labour, which paid a courtesy call on him, at the Mansudae Assembly Hall. Rodong News Team

title: Floral Basket to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from ANC General Secretary
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a floral basket from the general secretary of the African National Congress of South Africa, on Tuesday on the occasion of the 70th birthday of the DPRK. He also received a floral basket from the Central Committee of the Zimbabwe African National Union-Patriotic Front that day. Rodong News Team

title: Talks between SPA Chairman of DPRK and Congolese Senate President
body: There were talks between Choe Thae Bok, chairman of the Supreme People's Assembly (SPA) of the DPRK, and Pierre Ngolo, president of the Senate of the Republic of Congo, who is general secretary of the Congolese Party of Labour on a visit to the DPRK as head of the state delegation of the Republic of Congo, at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Tuesday. The issues of boosting the friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries were discussed at the talks. Present there from the DPRK side were deputies to the SPA and officials concerned and from the Congolese side were the Senate president's party. Rodong News Team

title: Foreign Guests Leave
body: Foreign delegations and guests left here for home on Tuesday after taking part in the celebrations of the 70th birthday of the DPRK. Among them were the delegations of the Democratic Party of Equatorial Guinea, the Party of Socialists in the Republic of Moldova and the Mongolian Democratic Party, the Azerbaijani state delegation, the delegations of the Popular Liberation Movement of Angola, the Foreign Affairs Committee of the British Labor Party and the Communist Party of the People of Spain, the vice general secretary of the Revolutionary Party of Tanzania, a UK senator and his party, a member of the House of Councillors of Japan and his party, the special envoy of the Bangladeshi government and his party, the special envoy of the Swedish government, the deputy executive secretary of the United Nations Economic and Social Commission for Asia and the Pacific and his party, the deputy regional director of the UNICEF East Asia and Pacific Region and a representative of the World Economic Forum. Rodong News Team

title: Families of Those Related to Anti-Japanese Revolutionary Struggle Leave
body: Family members of Shang Yue and Wang Xiaoming, Chinese related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, and those of Ryang Song Ryong, Ri Min and Pak Kil Song, China-resident Koreans related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, left here on Wednesday after taking part in the events marking the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. Leaving here earlier was the family of Li Zade, a China-resident Korean related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of International Ice Hokey Federation Arrives
body: A delegation of the International Ice Hokey Federation led by President Rene Fasel arrived in Pyongyang on Wednesday. Rodong News Team

title: German Political Party Official Arrives
body: Hans Modrov, chairman of the Veterans' Council of the Left Party of Germany, and his party arrived in Pyongyang on Wednesday. Rodong News Team

title: Foreign Guests Leave
body: Foreigners and foreign delegations left here on Wednesday after taking part in the international event for celebrating the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. They included the chairman of the African Regional Committee for Friendship and Solidarity with the Korean People and the co-chairman of the Arab Regional Committee for Friendship and Solidarity with the Korean People who are co-chairpersons of the Organizing Committee of the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu, the first vice-chairman of the Latin American and Caribbean Regional Committee to Support the Reunification of Korea, a delegation of the International League of People's Struggle, Turkish friendly delegation, France-Korea writers friendship delegation, Japanese delegation of the Forum for Peace, Human Rights and Environment, and a delegation of the Centre for Peace and Conflict Studies. On the same day, a friendship delegation of Tonghua City, Jilin Province of China, delegation of the Finland-Korea Society and a delegate of the Switzerland-Korea Committee left here. Rodong News Team

title: General People's Union Party of Russia Signs Pyongyang Declaration
body: The General People's Union Party of Russia signed the historic Pyongyang Declaration "Let Us Defend and Advance the Cause of Socialism." Chairman Sergei Bavrin who is leading a delegation of the General People's Union Party of Russia signed it on behalf of the party on Wednesday. The delegation attended the events marking the 70th birthday of the DPRK. Rodong News Team

title: Friendly Relations Established between Cities of DPRK and Ecuador
body: An agreement on establishment of friendly relations between Anju City, South Phyongan Province of the DPRK and Echeandia City, Bolivar Province of Ecuador was signed on Wednesday. Present at the signing ceremony from the DPRK side were Kim Jong Jin, secretary general of the Anju City People's Committee of south Phyongan Province, Ko Myong Hun, chairman of the DPRK-Ecuador Friendship Association, and officials concerned, and from the Ecuadorian side a delegation of Echeandia City, Bolivar Province of Ecuador led by its vice mayor. The secretary general and the vice mayor inked the agreement. Rodong News Team

title: World Alzheimer's Month Marked in Pyongyang
body: A seminar was held in the DPRK on Wednesday to mark World Alzheimer's Month. Present there were officials of the Central Committee of the Korea Federation for the Care of the Aged and the relevant units and officials of foreign embassies and missions of international organizations to Pyongyang. Speeches were made at the seminar. Noting that health of the aged has become an important issue worldwide, the speakers deeply explained the scientific issues of preventing and curing dementia such as Alzheimer's disease and protecting and promoting mental health. Rodong News Team

title: Ri Su Yong Meets Foreign Party Delegations
body: Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, respectively met and had a talk on Wednesday with a delegation of the Algerian National Liberation Front Party led by Gummama Mahmoud, member of the Political Bureau, and a delegation of the General People's Union Party of Russia led by Chairman Sergei Bavrin. On the same day Ri Su Yong also met with Wolfgang Nowak, former general director for Political Planning of Mr. Schroeder's Cabinet of Germany. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Yong Nam Meets Overseas Koreans
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, met and had a talk with a congratulatory group of the General Association of Koreans in China for celebrating the 70th birthday of the DPRK led by Chairwoman Choe Un Bok, a delegation of the International United Confederation of Koreans led by First Vice-Chairman Kim Chil Song, and Jon Sun Yong, advisor to the Association of Koreans in Canada, at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Wednesday. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of Institute for Int'l Studies of China Visits Mangyongdae
body: A delegation of the Institute for International Studies of China led by President Qi Zhenhong visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. At the old home in Mangyongdae, the visitors looked round the historical relics, being briefed on the revolutionary history of Kim Il Sung and the noble patriotic spirit of his family members.
