The delegation was also guided to the Arch of Triumph, the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum, the Friendship Tower, etc. Rodong News Team

title: Juche Idea Followers Leave
body: Juche idea followers left Pyongyang on Thursday after paying a visit to the DPRK on its 70th founding anniversary. Among them were a delegation of the Nigerian National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, a delegation of the Bangladesh Institute of the Juche Idea, a delegation of the Pakistan Association for Self-Reliance Studies, a delegation of the Mongolian Association for the Study of the Juche Idea-Songun Idea, a delegation of the Brazilian Center for the Study of Songun Politics, a delegation of the Czech Group for the Study and Materialization of the Juche Idea, the chairman of the Nepal Journalist Association for the Study of the Juche Idea and Songun Politics and his party, the representative of the Ukrainian "Treasured Sword of Songun" Association for the Study of the Juche Idea and the representative of the "Sun of Juche" Association of Journalists and Men of Culture for the Study of Kimjongilism in Ukraine. Earlier, departing were the secretary general of the International Kim Il Sung Prize Council and the International Kim Jong Il Prize Council and his party, a delegation of the Japanese National Liaison Council of Societies for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, a delegation of the British Group for the Study of the Juche Idea and the chairman of the Guinean National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism. Rodong News Team

title: Foreigners Leave
body: Foreigners left Pyongyang on Thursday after participating in the celebrations of the 70th founding anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. They included a delegation of the Algerian National Liberation Front Party, special envoy of the Ugandan president and his party, a Ugandan party and state delegation, a delegation of the World Peace Organization and the former secretary general of the Commission for Foreign Affairs of the Senate of Italy and his party. Earlier, departing were a party and government delegation of the Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela, a delegation of the Workers' Party of Mexico, a delegation of the Iranian Workers' House, the representative of the king of Bahrain and the representative of the Zambian government and his party. Rodong News Team

title: Panmunjom Declaration Distributed as U.N. Official Document
body: "Panmunjom Declaration on Peace, Prosperity and Reunification of Korean Peninsula" was distributed as an official document A/72/109-S/2018/820 of the UN General Assembly and the UN Security Council on Tuesday. Rodong News Team

title: Participants in Int'l Book Fair Visit Mangyongdae
body: The participants in the 11th Pyongyang International Science and Technology Book Fair visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. The guests looked round the historical relics at the old home of the President, being briefed on his revolutionary history and the patriotic life of his family members. They also toured the Tower of the Juche Idea, Ryuwon Footwear Factory, etc. Rodong News Team

title: Foreign Guests Leave
body: A delegation of the Overseas Side of the Jindallae Children's Foundation, a delegation of the France-Korea Friendship Association, a Pakistan friendship delegation, a delegation of the Slovakia-Korea Friendship Association, a delegation of the World Peace Council, the chairman of the Bangladesh-Korea Friendship and Solidarity Committee and the chief of the German Group for the Study of Korean Culture left Pyongyang on Thursday after attending the international event for celebrating the 70th birthday of the DPRK. Rodong News Team

title: Families of Those Related to Anti-Japanese Revolutionary Struggle Leave
body: The family of Zhang Weihua, a Chinese related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, Thursday left Pyongyang after attending the celebrations of the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. Also, leaving on the same day were families of Jiang Zihua, Liu Tongshi, Jie Qing, Fan Delin and Chai Shiying, Chinese related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, and families of So Sun Ok and Kim Chol, China-resident Koreans related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of Int'l Ice Hokey Federation Visits Ice Rink
body: A delegation of the International Ice Hokey Federation led by President Rene Fasel visited the Ice Rink on Thursday. The visitors looked round various parts of the Ice Rink and then watched the training of female players of ice hockey. Rodong News Team

title: Permanent Representative of DPRK at UN Appointed
body: According to a decree of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Kim Song was appointed as permanent representative of the DPRK at the UN. Rodong News Team

title: Precious Fruition of National Independence
body: The long history of territorial division teaches a lesson that the north and the south should improve their relations through reconciliation and unity on the principle of national independence and advance toward peace and reunification, not to be at odds and stand up in confrontation with each other, and doing so is the only way of living for the Korean nation. The north and the south should respect each other and jointly open an avenue of improving the inter-Korean relations. The Panmunjom Declaration indicates a correct way for connecting the severed blood vessel of the nation and opening a broad avenue to national reconciliation, unity, peace and reunification. The historic 3rd and 4th north-south summit meetings and talks and the Panmunjom Declaration were provided by the patriotic will and firm determination to put an end to mistrust and confrontation which has lasted decades after decades and courageously usher in a new era of national reconciliation, peace and prosperity with the concerted efforts of the north and the south. The adoption of the Panmunjom Declaration laid a valuable foundation for the development of the north-south relations, peace of the Korean Peninsula, prosperity common to the nation and independent reunification. The north and the south should make steady efforts to mend their relations under any situation and circumstances and sincerely implement the Panmunjom Declaration. They should independently carve out their destiny and handle their relations from the viewpoint of By Our Nation Itself in the present crucial times. There is no need for the north and the south to read other’s face and hesitate in the issue of their relations. The way for the north and the south to follow is always the road of national independence and unity. Sim Chol Yong

title: Delegation of Int'l Ice Hokey Federation Leaves
body: The delegation of the International Ice Hokey Federation led by President Rene Fasel left Pyongyang on Friday. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Government Economic Delegation Back Home
body: The government economic delegation of the DPRK led by Kim Yong Jae, minister of External Economic Relations, returned home Friday after participating in the 4th "Oriental Economic Forum" held in Russia. Rodong News Team

title: Gift to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from German
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a gift from the chairman of the Veterans' Council of the Left Party of Germany. The gift was conveyed to Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, on Friday by Chairman Hans-Georg Modrov on a visit to the DPRK. The gift to Kim Jong Un from the "Rosa Luxembourg" Foundation of the Left Party of Germany was also conveyed on the same day. Rodong News Team

title: Ri Su Yong Meets Germans
body: Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Friday met and had a talk with Hans-Georg Modrov, chairman of the Veterans' Council of the Left Party of Germany, and his party. Rodong News Team

title: Letter to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Chongryon
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a letter from the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) on September 11 as regards the congratulatory message he sent to the Chongryon officials and Koreans in Japan on the occasion of the 70th birthday of the DPRK. The letter said that the Chongryon Central Standing Committee extends heartfelt gratitude to Kim Jong Un who has always shown warm love and deep political trust for Chongryon and Koreans in Japan and takes firm oath to carry through with the revolutionary conscience and obligation the important tasks set forth by him in his congratulatory message. It further said: The Chongryon officials and Koreans in Japan will hold fast to your important congratulatory message as a treasured sword of sure victory and turn out in a drive for implementing the decisions of the 24th Chongryon Congress by keeping pace with the grand advance of the people in the homeland and thus bring earlier the new heyday in the movement of Koreans in Japan with peculiar pride and self-confidence with which they built a patriotic and loyal monument in the glorious 70 years of Kim Il Sung's and Kim Jong Il's Korea. They will always bear in mind the truth that the prosperity of the socialist country guarantees the dignity and happiness of overseas compatriots and the bright future of the coming generations, the letter said, reiterating their pledge to find the worth of their true life and happiness in the work for the country and the nation and leave clear footprints of patriotism and loyalty on the land of the motherland by making a peculiar contribution to the cause of socialist construction in the motherland in the spirit of great Kim Jong Il's patriotism, although they were in an alien land. The Chongryon officials and Koreans in Japan will speed up the patriotic advance to bring the overall prosperity in the movement of Koreans in Japan by thoroughly implementing the tasks set forth by Kim Jong Un in the congratulatory message and thus make positive contribution to bringing into a brilliant reality the desire of patriotism of the great leaders for building a powerful country. Rodong News Team

title: Foreign Guests Leave
body: Foreign guests left Pyongyang on Friday after participating in the international events for celebrating the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. Among them were delegations of the New Zealand-DPRK Society, the Indonesia-Korea Association for Friendship and Cultural Exchange and the Korean Friendship Association, a delegation of Echeandia City, Bolivar Province of Ecuador, the chief of the Russian Group for Solidarity with the DPRK and the delegate of the Ukraine-DPRK Association. Rodong News Team

title: Germans Visit Mangyongdae
body: Hans-Georg Modrov, chairman of the Veterans' Council of the Left Party of Germany, and his party visited Mangyongdae, birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. The guests looked round the historical relics at the old home of the President, being briefed on his revolutionary career. They also toured the Tower of the Juche Idea, the Arch of Triumph, the e-library and swimming pool of Kim Il Sung University, the Pyongyang Cosmetics Factory, etc. Rodong News Team

title: Reply Message to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Syrian President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a reply message from Bashar Al-Assad, president of the Syrian Arab Republic, on Wednesday. In the reply message, the Syrian president wished Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un happiness all the time and the friendly Korean people progress and prosperity, expressing deep thanks for having sent a kind message of greeting to him on his birthday. He also highly appreciated the sincere stance of the Supreme Leader who supports the Syria's cause for unity and stability. Rodong News Team

title: American Politicians Should Not Spread False Story about DPRK
body: Conservative politicians of the U.S. have cooked up and spread a series of cock-and-bull stories, saying that no one knows when and how the DPRK would carry out its promise, it is conducting a work for concealing its nuclear assets and the situation might make a U-turn. Untrustworthy is not the DPRK but just the conservative politicians of the U.S. seeking to disrupt the DPRK-U.S. dialogue at any cost by spreading a “story about doubtful north Korea.” The conservative politicians have done nothing for the building of trust between the DPRK and the U.S. But they are now crying out for resuming the south Korea-U.S. joint military drills, the halt of which had already been made public on the part of the U.S. Ridiculous is the fact that the conservative politicians are forcing more and more brigandish demands on the DPRK though they fail to do what they should do. As they don’t know well what’s going on now and are misjudging everything, the conservative politicians of America are going so foolish as to unhesitatingly attempt to get rid of the DPRK’s nukes just like disposing of the properties of a defeated nation. Taking this opportunity, we again warn the conservative politicians against their self-righteous way of thinking. They had better study more about the DPRK. They are well advised to remember the disgrace suffered by their predecessors who handed written apologies and surrender to the DPRK without caring about the decency of their American empire. Dialogue without mutual respect and trust is not dialogue at all. “Do not betray dialogue partners’ trust!”—this is what we have to say to the U.S., never vice versa. We are dealing with the U.S. with goodwill and patience. It is our mettle to do to the end what it is determined to do and once it begins to do. “Only north Korea is seen in the course of building trust between it and the U.S.” This is just what the international community says and the conservative politicians of the U.S. need to listen to it carefully. They should clearly understand that their base speech and conduct is turning the U.S. into an untrustworthy state and an isolated and closed country. No matter how frequently such human dregs nudged out of a strong trend of the times let out a string of paradox and put the brakes on the development, the peoples of the DPRK and the U.S. will do what they want to do as the engine for the improvement of the bilateral relations will never weaken. The more desperately the conservative politicians of the U.S. check the development of the DPRK-U.S. relations by spreading a “story of doubtful north Korea”, the more clearly it will betray their true colors as disgusting ones working hard to realize their wild political ambition only. Jo Nam Jin

title: DPRK Is Independent Power
body: The DPRK is a powerful country, dignified and invincible with independence, and its 70 year-long history is characterized by the sacred struggle to successfully carve out the destiny of the nation, being fully responsible for it. The DPRK, in the historical course of carving out the destiny of the nation, held aloft the banner of independence and positively struggled to defend the will and intThanks to the resolute decision and wise guidance of the President who consistently adhered to the principle of independence and courageously directed the construction of a prosperous country under the uplifted banner of self-reliance, the DPRK could dynamically advance along the road of prosperity. Under the prominent independent politics of Chairman Kim Jong Il, another peerlessly great man, the strength of the country was remarkably increased despite the imperialists’ hideous challenge and the DPRK turned into a socialist fortress of independence remaining unfazed under any tempest. He turned the country into a political and ideological power and a military power by making a day-and-night forced march till the last moments of his life and laid a solid groundwork for building a prosperous powerful country and achieving the independent reunification. These undying exploits will shine long in the history of the country. Today the Korean nation’s cause of independence and national reunification has greeted its new heyday under the wise guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Definite is the victory of the cause of Korean-style socialism as there are strong foundations of independence, self-support and self-reliance provided by the great leaders and the experienced leadership of the Supreme Leader. Pak Chol Jun

title: Lift of Anti-DPRK Sanctions and Adoption of War-end Declaration Urged in S. Korea
body: Civic and social organizations of south Korea reportedly launched a campaign demanding the lift of anti-DPRK sanctions and the adoption of a war-end declaration. The Taejon headquarters of the South Side Committee for Implementing June 15 Joint Declaration began an all-people signature campaign outside the Taejon City Education Office on September 4, explaining to the passers-by the need to adopt a war-end declaration, conclude a peace treaty and lift the anti-DPRK sanctions. Meanwhile, an organization called Seoulkyorehana launched an action demanding the lift of anti-DPRK sanctions and the adoption of a war-end declaration in Seoul. Members of the organization called on the public to make a war-end delegation with the concerted efforts, explaining to citizens how the sanctions are blocking the inter-Korean exchange. Rodong News Team

title: Jury Members of Various Countries Here for Pyongyang International Film Festival
body: International jury members from Russia, China and Poland arrived in Pyongyang on Saturday to take part in the 16th Pyongyang International Film Festival. Rodong News Team

title: Overseas Compatriots Leave
body: A delegation of officials of organizations under the General Association of Koreans in China, a delegation of elderly officials of the general association, a delegation of Korean war veterans in China, a delegation of Korean artistes in China and a home-visiting group of Koreans in Japan left Pyongyang on Saturday after attending the celebrations of the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. Departing earlier were a delegation of officials of the Union of Democratic Korean Women in Japan, a delegation of the International United Confederation of Koreans, a delegation of the Council of Koreans in New Zealand, a delegation of Koreans in Nakhodka of Russia, a delegation of Koreans in Ussuriysk of Russia and a delegation of Korean businessmen in the Commonwealth of Independent States. Rodong News Team

title: Congratulatory Group of General Association of Koreans in China Leaves
body: A congratulatory group of the General Association of Koreans in China for celebrating the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK led by Chairwoman Choe Un Bok left Pyongyang on Saturday. Rodong News Team

title: Foreigners Leave
body: Foreign guests left Pyongyang on Saturday after taking part in the international events for celebrating the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. They included the co-chairman of the Asia-Pacific Regional Committee for Supporting Peaceful Reunification of Korea and the chairman of the Denmark-DPRK Friendship Association who are co-chairmen of the Organizing Committee of the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu, a delegation of the Australia-DPRK Association for Friendship and Culture, a delegation of the Sweden-Korea Friendship Association, a delegation of the Luxembourg-Korea Friendship Association and a professor of Leiden University of the Netherlands and his party. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Indonesian President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Indonesian President Joko Widodo on Sep. 7. The president in the message extended the best wishes to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and the people of the DPRK on the occasion of September 9, the founding anniversary of the DPRK. He hoped in the message that the celebrations of the anniversary would bring the people of the DPRK greater happiness and instill greater patriotism into them. The message went on: Indonesia, as a friend of the DPRK, hopes for strengthening the bilateral relations and mutually beneficial cooperation to meet the common interests in a peaceful environment. Recently, historic meetings were held between the leaders of the north and the south of Korea and players from the north and the south took part as a single team in the 18th Asian Games 2018. This fact helped me have optimism about future when peace would come to promote the inter-Korean cooperation and expand it at an international level, the message stressed. The message paid the noblest homage to Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: Premier Inspects Different Units in Pyongyang
body: Premier Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, inspected different units in Pyongyang City. Visiting the Three-Revolution Exhibition House and the Central Botanical Garden, he stressed the need to step up the preparations for remodeling them on a modern basis as befitting scientific and cultural education centers for the working people and school youth and children. While inspecting the Pyongyang Dental Hygiene Products Factory and the Pyongyang Pharmaceutical Factory, the premier encouraged scientists, technicians and workers striving to turn out in a larger quantity various products conducive to the promotion of people's health. And he called for constructing in a qualitative way new buildings in keeping with their service purpose. Discussed at field consultative meetings were measures for unconditionally hitting the campaign goals for this year, the third year for implementing the five-year strategy for national economic development. Meanwhile, the premier went round the National Dance School under construction, urging the relevant units to smoothly supply building materials. Rodong News Team

title: No Obstacle Insurmountable When All Koreans Pool Efforts
body: Now the north and the south of Korea are going ahead with multi-faceted dialogue and cooperation in order to implement the Panmunjom declaration, and in that course good successes conducive to national reconciliation, unity, peace and prosperity were achieved to add to the pleasure of all Koreans. The north and the south should write a new history of peace, prosperity and reunification by pooling their efforts and wisdom, valuing all successes made in the efforts for implementing the historic Panmunjom declaration. Now the north-south relations are steadily developing under deep attention by all Koreans and the world. Unforeseen dramatic events were witnessed and good agreements were made in the north-south relations to set right the tragic long-frozen north-south relations and achieve excellent successes for national reconciliation and peace. This was a decisive turn in the advance toward the bright future of national reunification. Although many trials and difficulties exist to block the path toward the improvement of the north-south relations and national reunification, the Korean nation can easily overcome any obstacles and resolve everything when the north and south pool their efforts. The north and the south had already confirmed the principle of national independence in the Panmunjom declaration that the destiny of the nation should be determined by itself. The issue of the north-south relations, the internal issue of the Korean nation, should be settled, as desired and demanded by the nation, and no one is entitled to interfere in it. All Koreans in the north and the south and abroad, who are to make contributions to the improvement of the north-south relations, peace and reunification of the country, should turn out with a single patriotic mind in the drive for thoroughly implementing the Panmunjom declaration, setting store by the declaration and all successes brought about by it, irrespective of their differing ideologies, social systems, political views and isms. Pak Chol Jun

title: Celebrations of 70th Birthday of DPRK Recorded as Grand Political Festival
body: The celebrations of the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK were a great auspicious event unprecedented in the nation’s history spanning 5 000 years and a grand political festival that inspired the Korean people with higher pride and self-esteem of being citizens of the DPRK. The 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK was a great festival of glory which demonstrated the pride and self-esteem of the Koreans that their leader and party are the best. Loyalty of the Korean people to absolutely trust and follow Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un only was strikingly manifested with the anniversary as an occasion. Fully displayed during the celebrations were the advantages of the Juche idea which has been embodied in the practical reality of socialist Korea and the advantages of the Korean-style socialist system in which the people have become the masters of the state and society and everything serves them. The celebrations marked a great political festival that inspired the Korean people with the pride and self-esteem about the tremendous might of the country. Clearly displayed in the advance toward the grand festival of September was our state’s enormous potential for development. The celebrations shed light as a grand festival in which the invincible might of the DPRK, cemented in the course of 70 years, was fully displayed. The 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK has been recorded in history as a great political festival which inspired the Korean people with the immense pride and self-esteem that their state and Korean-style socialism are the best in the world. Pak Yon

title: Scores of Poems Composed to Mark DPRK Birthday
body: Scores of poems praising the homeland were composed to mark the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. Lyric poem "Song of My Heart" depicts the revolutionary careers and exploits of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. Poem "Our Home" and others reflect the powerful spirit of the DPRK which makes a leap forward with youthful vigor while racing against time, led by the peerlessly great persons through centuries, and instill confidence in the future of the country to prosper forever. There are also such poems as "My Citizenship Card" which sings of the people's high honor of adding luster to the great era of Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Reply Message to President Xi Jinping
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a reply message to Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and president of the People's Republic of China, on Saturday. Kim Jong Un in the message expressed deep thanks to Xi Jinping for sending his warm congratulations and heartfelt best wishes on the occasion of the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. The message said that Xi Jinping dispatched Li Zhanshu, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, as a special envoy on his part, and sent the Chinese party and government delegation to the celebrations for the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK, which was a sure sign of special friendly feelings of Xi Jinping, Chinese party, government and people to Kim Jong Un and the party, government and people of the DPRK. The message noted that the DPRK-China friendship personally formed and developed by the leaders of the elder generation of the two countries is now under fresh development to meet the requirements of the new era. Kim Jong Un in the message stated that he would proactively strive with Xi Jinping to further boost the close relations of friendship, unity and cooperation between the two parties and two peoples. He sincerely wished the Chinese people bigger success in the building of socialism with the Chinese characteristics in the new times under the wise guidance of the Communist Party of China with Xi Jinping as the core. Rodong News Team

title: Large Floral Basket to DPRK Embassy from Algerian President
body: Abdelaziz Bouteflika, president of Algeria, sent a large floral basket to the DPRK embassy in Algiers on Sept. 9, the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. Members of the Presidency of Algeria laid the floral basket before the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and made a bow to them. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Iranian President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a congratulatory message from Hassan Rouhani, president of the Islamic Republic of Iran, on September 9, the founding anniversary of the DPRK. The Iranian president in the message extended sincere congratulations to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and the Korean people. Hoping that the bilateral relations would expand in all spheres on the basis of the common will of the leaderships of the two countries and the present potentiality, the message wished Kim Jong Un good health and success in his work and the people of the DPRK prosperity. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Pakistani President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Arif Alvi, president of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, on September 9, the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. The president in the message extended the warmest congratulations to Kim Jong Un on behalf of the government and people of Pakistan. He said that the government and people of Pakistan set great store by the close and friendly relations with the leadership and people of the DPRK. The message expressed belief that the decades-long and well-meant bilateral relations provided by the leaderships of the two countries would as ever develop. It sincerely wished Kim Jong Un good health and the DPRK eternal peace, progress and prosperity. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Bangladeshi President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from MD. Abdul Hamid, president of the People's Republic of Bangladesh, on September 6. The president in the message extended warm congratulations to Kim Jong Un on the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. Hoping that the relations between the two countries would grow stronger on the basis of deeper understanding, he wished Kim Jong Un good health and the people of the DPRK progress and prosperity. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Myanmar President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Win Myint, president of the Republic of the Union of Myanmar, on September 4. The president in the message extended the greatest congratulations and best wishes to Kim Jong Un and the people of the DPRK on the occasion of the auspicious 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. He also expressed congratulations for the positive result made at the historic summit talks in Singapore, a progress for ensuring peace and stability in the Korean Peninsula and the region. Rodong News Team

title: U.S. Is to Blame for Stalemate in Dialogue
body: Three months have passed since the DPRK-U.S. summit and talks in Singapore and the adoption of the joint statement. The international community wished the DPRK-U.S. joint statement be implemented successfully, the extreme hostile relations between the DPRK and the U.S. that have been the sharpest confrontation be put to an end as soon as possible and durable peace and security be settle in the Korean peninsula and the region. The dialogue between the DPRK and the U.S. has been stalemated. The U.S. is totally to blame for the deadlocked DPRK-U.S. negotiations. The U.S. is stubbornly insisting on the theory of “dismantlement of nukes first” which was rejected in the past DPRK-U.S. dialogues, saying that other issues may be discussed only after the “complete, verifiable and irretrievable dismantlement of nukes” of the DPRK, while failing to show its will for confidence building including the declaration of the end of war which it had already pledged. The U.S. is demanding unilateral and gangster-like claim forcing the DPRK to act without showing its movement. The conservative politicians of the U.S. are taking the lead in persisting in such gangster-like logic. For implementation of the DPRK-U.S. joint statement, the U.S. which is the other side should adopt a sincere approach. The future of the DPRK-U.S. dialogue totally depends on the stand and action of the U.S. The U.S. should think twice and have an honest and diligent attitude toward the DPRK-U.S. dialogue with sincerity and bold decision. And this is also beneficial to the U.S. Ri Hak Nam

title: Japan’s Moves for War State
body: Japanese Defense Minister Onodera said in a recent round-table talk that he wants the Japanese to know that the security environment is serious, adding that the security of Japan is getting worse than last year due to the “threat” from the DPRK. It is a sinister artifice of the Japanese reactionaries to provide a springboard for achieving the black-hearted militarist ambition by inciting the hostility towards the DPRK in Japan. No matter how often Japanese politicians talk about the “threat”, the international community never believes it. The world people know that the trend of the situation of the Korean peninsula is turning to the détente thanks to the DPRK’s proactive measures. The international community unanimously demands that the hard-won atmosphere of détente be promoted. The black-hearted aim of the Japanese authorities is very clear to all. The ultimate goal of the Abe group is to make Japan a war state. They view this year as an important one for laying a foundation to carry out the retrogressive revision of the constitution. If so, Japan will have all looks of a war state. The Abe group would be well advised to be prudent, bearing in mind that the moves for a war state will only make it isolated and ruined. Ri Hyon Do

title: Overseas Koreans Delegations Leave
body: A delegation of headquarters chairmen of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) left Pyongyang on Tuesday after participating in the celebrations marking the 70th birthday of the DPRK. Leaving earlier were a delegation of Chongryon officials, a delegation of the United Confederation of Koreans in Kazakhstan and a delegation of the United Confederation of Koreans in Kamchatka, Russia. Rodong News Team

title: Nigerian President to Support Korean People's Efforts for Peace and Reunification
body: The DPRK ambassador presented his credentials to Muhammadu Buhari, president of the Federal Republic of Nigeria, on September 13. The president hoped that the DPRK would achieve peace, reunification and prosperity. He said he would continue to support the DPRK government and people in their efforts to realize them. Rodong News Team

title: Exhibitions of Kimilsungia and Kimjongilia Held in Various Countries
body: Kimilsungia exhibitions took place in Indonesia and Guinea and Kimjongilia exhibition in Mongolia during the period between Sept. 1 and 9 on the occasion of the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. On display at the venues of the exhibitions were portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and photos showing revolutionary activities of the great leaders and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Also displayed there were works of the peerlessly great men and books and pictures introducing the DPRK. The chairman of the Guinean national preparatory committee for celebrating the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK and the chairman of the Guinean Society for the Study of the Juche Literary Idea referred to the exploits performed by the great leaders in founding and developing the DPRK. They said that the DPRK is demonstrating its might as the invincible power under the guidance of Kim Jong Un. The chairman of the National Democratic Party of Mongolia said that the DPRK could make a leap forward while rejecting all sorts of challenges for a long period under the wise leadership of HE Kim Il Sung and HE Kim Jong Il and therefore, the whole world is highly praising them as the outstanding great men. The chairman of the Mongolian preparatory committee for celebrating the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK noted that the DPRK which covered the path of steady development under the leadership of President Kim Il Sung and HE Kim Jong Il is making a dynamic advance toward greater victory following HE Kim Jong Un, hoping the DPRK will further prosper along with the blooming Kimjongilia. Rodong News Team

title: SPA Delegation Leaves for Russia
body: A delegation of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK led by Vice-Chairwoman Ri Hye Jong who is president of the Academy of Social Sciences left Pyongyang on Monday to attend the 2nd Eurasia Women Forum due in Russia. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of Architects Union of Korea Leaves for China
body: A delegation of the Architects Union of Korea headed by Chairman of its Central Committee Sim Yong Hak left Pyongyang on Monday to take part in the 2018 Zhengzhou International Meeting for City Design to be held in China. Rodong News Team

title: 14th Pyongyang Autumn Int'l Trade Fair Opens
body: The 14th Pyongyang Autumn International Trade Fair opened at the Three-Revolution Exhibition House on Monday with due ceremony. Attending the ceremony were Ri Ryong Nam, vice-premier of the Cabinet; Kim Yong Jae, minister of External Economic Relations; Kim In Chol, vice-chairman of the Pyongyang City People's Committee; officials of economic and trade fields and delegations from different countries and regions and members of foreign diplomatic missions to Pyongyang. An opening address and a congratulatory speech were made at the ceremony. Speakers warmly welcomed the members of the delegations from different countries and regions who took part in the 14th Pyongyang Autumn International Trade Fair with the desire and wish to achieve common economic development and prosperity. They expressed the will to boost the external economic relations with various countries in the world on a new higher level on the principle of respect for sovereignty, equality and mutual benefit in the future, too. The fair will last till Sept. 21. Rodong News Team

title: Algeria-Korea Friendship Association Formed
body: An Algeria-Korea friendship association was formed with due ceremony on September 5. Meanwhile, the association opened a website to give publicity to the revolutionary activities of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and the proud reality of Juche Korea prospering day by day. Rodong News Team

title: Sexual Slavery Is Hideous Unethical Crime
body: The sexual slavery for the Imperial Japanese Army was the most hideous unethical crime as it was unparalleled in the cruelty and baseness. The Japanese imperialists abducted and forcibly drafted 200 000 Korean women to force them into sexual slavery during decades of their colonial rule over Korea. The past sexual slavery by Japan was the hideous unethical crime, which the military organized and perpetrated by itself through the government’s positive involvement in the crime, so Japan should take the blame for it. The international community demands that Japan take the responsibility for the crimes and begin to redeem them as early as possible. However, Japan did not sincerely reflect on the crimes and apologize for them, but it is impudent enough to justify the crimes. Going beyond the scope of covering up and playing down the past crimes, Japan is totally distorting and denying them. This shameless nonsense is an undisguised challenge and insult to justice, truth, international law and human ethics and morality. The history never changes although Japan denies it, and the crimes can never be covered up although Japan sticks to the unreasonable insistence. Japan’s past crimes are the ones against humanity to which no statute of limitations is applicable and which should be redeemed certainly. Japan should not deny the crimes and make poor excuse but sincerely admit and completely redeem them. This is the only way of Japan to raise its head before the international community. Ri Chol Hyok

title: 16th Pyongyang Int'l Film Festival Opens
body: The 16th Pyongyang International Film Festival opened with due ceremony at the Pyongyang International Cinema House on Wednesday. Present at the opening ceremony were Ri Ryong Nam, vice-premier of the Cabinet, Minister of Culture Pak Chun Nam who is chairman of the festival organizing committee, officials concerned, creators and artistes of the film sector, working people in Pyongyang, delegations and delegates from China, Germany, Switzerland, France, Britain, Australia and Italy and international juries from the DPRK, Russia, China, Canada and Poland. Invited there were foreign diplomatic envoys and representatives of international bodies, military attaches and staff members of foreign embassies here, foreign guests and overseas Koreans staying here. Introduced at the opening ceremony were movies exhibited at the festival, to begin with. Pak Chun Nam in an opening address expressed the belief that the festival would be successful in keeping with its noble ideal and the desire of the world progressive movie men before declaring the opening of the festival. Vladimir Menshov, chairperson of the International Jury Committee said in a congratulatory speech that the DPRK is attaching importance to the cultural and art development, sincerely wishing the festival bigger success in the future, too. Then, the festival prizes were introduced. At the end of the ceremony the participants watched a Chinese feature film. That day the organizing committee of the festival gave a reception at the Okryu Restaurant for the participants in the festival. Rodong News Team

title: Letter to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Koreans in China
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a letter from a congratulatory group and a delegation of the General Association of Koreans in China for celebrating the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK on September 15. The letter said that they were invited to the celebrations for the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK, which were held with splendor in the presence of Kim Jong Un, and came to bear in mind the unshakable faith of the people in the homeland, who are determined to accomplish the revolutionary cause of Juche under the banner of the great Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, and the images of those who are single-mindedly united around him. The Supreme Leader, with the same compatriotic love and warm heart as President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il had, took measures to ensure that they participated in the events receiving the best hospitality, and showed parental love for them not to feel any inconvenience, the letter said. They have received constant care of the benevolent father for decades thanks to the Supreme Leader who is identical to the President and the Chairman in ideology, leadership and virtue, the letter noted. They vowed in the letter that no matter how frequently the world changes, they will more firmly consolidate the General Association of Koreans in China into a dignified organization of overseas citizens of Juche Korea, which is faithful to the leadership of Kim Jong Un only and into a compatriots' organization strong in the Juche character and national character. Rodong News Team

title: World First Aid Day Marked in DPRK
body: A meeting for introducing first aid activities of young RC members took place at the Pyongyang City Park for Teaching Children Traffic Regulations on Wednesday to observe 2018 World First Aid Day. Present there were officials of the Red Cross Society of the DPRK, traffic security persons, school youth and children, members of a delegation of the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies and a delegation of the International Committee of the Red Cross working in the DPRK and staff members of foreign embassies and missions of international bodies here. There were an explanation about the traffic security regulations that the students and children should keep on the roadway and the spread of the knowledge of first-aid at the meeting held on the subject of "Traffic accident and measures for first-aid". The participants enjoyed an art performance given by young RC members. Rodong News Team

title: Credentials to Kim Yong Nam from Irish Ambassador
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, received credentials from Julian Clare, Irish ambassador to the DPRK, at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Wednesday. He had a talk with the ambassador after receiving the credentials. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Yong Nam Meets Congratulatory Group of Koreans in Japan
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, met and had a talk in a compatriotic atmosphere with a congratulatory group of Koreans in Japan for celebrating the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK led by Pu Yong Uk, chairman of the Osaka Prefectural Headquarters of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan, at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Wednesday. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Nepalese President
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, sent a message of greeting to Nepalese President Bidhya Devi Bhandari on Wednesday on the occasion of the national day of Nepal. Kim in the message expressed the belief that the traditional ties of friendship and cooperation between the two countries would grow stronger under the new situation and wished the president success in her work for the country's prosperity and the people's wellbeing. Rodong News Team

title: Photo Exhibition on Theme of Peace, Unification Opens in Seoul
body: A photo exhibition on the theme of "Peace, New Future-Praying for Peace on Korean Peninsula" opened in Seoul on September 17, according to news reports in south Korea. Displayed at the exhibition sponsored by Seoul City, the Foundation for Promotion of Media and the News Cameramen Association were photos showing the historic meaning and importance of the improvement of the north-south relations, peace and reunification of the Korean peninsula. Rodong News Team

title: Senegalese, Mongolian Personages Visit DPRK Embassies
body: A Senegalese party delegation and Mongolian personages paid congratulatory visits to the DPRK embassies on Sep. 8 and 9 to mark the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. The delegation of the Workers' Party for the Independence of Senegal and members of the Mongolian preparatory committee for celebrating the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK laid floral baskets, bouquets and flowers before the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and art pieces depicting their images and made a bow to them. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Yong Nam Meets Representatives of Political Parties from South Side
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, met with representatives of various political parties from the south side at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Wednesday. Kim Yong Nam met and had a talk with Lee Hae Chan, representative of the Minju Party, Jong Tong Yong, representative of the Party for Democracy and Peace, and Lee Jong Mi, representative of the Jongui Party who are special entourage of President Moon Jae In on a visit to Pyongyang for the historic north-south summit. Present there were An Tong Chun, vice-chairman of the Supreme People's Assembly, Ri Kum Chol, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Korean Social Democratic Party, and officials concerned. The talk took place in a compatriotic atmosphere. Rodong News Team

title: President Moon Jae In Plants Tree in Commemoration of Pyongyang Visit
body: President Moon Jae In on a visit to Pyongyang planted a tree at Paekhwawon on Wednesday. Planting the tree together with him was Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK. Present there were Jong Ui Yong, chief of the State Security Office of Chongwadae, Jo Myong Gyun, minister of Unification, Kang Kyong Hwa, minister of Foreign Affairs, Song Yong Mu, minister of Defense, To Jong Hwan, minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism, Kim Hyon Mi, minister of Land and Transport, Kim Yong Chun, minister of Oceans and Fisheries, So Hun, director of the Intelligence Service, Kim Jae Hyon, minister of the Korea Forest Service, and Kim Hyon Chol, adviser to the president for economic affairs. Also present there were Kim Nung O, chairman of the Pyongyang City Committee of the WPK, Ri Son Gwon, chairman of the Committee for the Peaceful Reunification of the Country, Jang Hyok, minister of Railways, Kim Kyong Jun, minister of Land and Environment Protection, Kang Yong Su, minister of Urban Management, Cha Hui Rim, chairman of the Pyongyang City People's Committee, working people and schoolchildren in the city. Prior to the planting, Moon Jae In told the circumstances of bringing a goldenrain tree. Then Moon Jae In planted the tree together with Choe Ryong Hae. Erected beside the tree was a monument with the letters "In commemoration of Pyongyang visit 2018.9.18-21 President of the Republic of Korea Moon Jae In". After the planting, the participants posed for a photo in front of the monument and the tree. Rodong News Team

title: President Moon Jae In and His Wife Visit Mansudae Art Studio
body: President Moon Jae In and his wife visited the Mansudae Art Studio on Wednesday. Visitors included Jong Ui Yong, chief of the State Security Office of Chongwadae, Jo Myong Gyun, minister of Unification, Kang Kyong Hwa, minister of Foreign Affairs, Song Yong Mu, minister of Defense, To Jong Hwan, minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism, Kim Hyon Mi, minister of Land and Transport, So Hun, director of the Intelligence Service, and other entourage. Officials and employees of the Studio greeted Moon Jae In and his wife with warm compatriotic feelings. The president and his wife were deeply impressed to see Korean paintings, large Koryo celadon and masterpieces to be valued as national treasures while looking round fine art piece exhibition hall. Moon Jae In made an entry in the visitor's book. That day Moon's wife and some entourage also visited hobby group rooms of the Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace and watched an art performance. Rodong News Team

title: Personages of S. Side Visit Pyongyang Teacher Training College and Tree Nursery No. 122
body: Personages of the south side visited Pyongyang Teacher Training College and Tree Nursery No. 122 on Wednesday. The special entourage of the south side who visited Pyongyang Teacher Training College looked round an educational science exhibition hall, a room for disseminating technology for developing intellectual faculty of children and other various places with keen interest, being briefed on the history of the development of the college. Meanwhile, some official entourage and the personages in the economic circle of the south side made round of sapling production processes of the tree nursery. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK's Founding Anniversary Observed in Various Countries
body: Seminars took place in Nepal, Bangladesh, Mongolia, DR Congo, Tanzania and Mexico from Sept. 1 to 7 on the occasion of the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. The general secretary of the Central Committee of the Nepal Communist Party (Marxist-Leninist) said: President Kim Il Sung is the great leader who built the socialist state of Juche where the popular masses become the master on the land of Korea. HE Kim Jong Il is the peerless hero who defended socialism from the undisguised moves of the imperialist allied forces for aggression by pursuing his original Songun politics. Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un who is carrying forward the cause of the preceding leaders has firmly guaranteed peace and security in the Korean Peninsula and the rest of the world by further firmly consolidating the country's military power. The secretary general of the Bangladesh Jatiya Party and the chief of the Bangladeshi Media Persons' Group for the Study of the Juche Idea wished the Korean people bigger success in building a powerful socialist country and accomplishing the cause of national reunification. The chairman of the National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of DR Congo said that the seven-decade long history of the glorious DPRK is associated with the exploits of the peerlessly great men who had devoted their all to the country and people. The chairman of the Tanzanian National Coordinating Committee of the Juche Idea Study Groups affirmed that the Korean people led by Kim Jong Un would certainly win the final victory. Adopted at the seminar held in Nepal was a congratulatory message to Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: New Stamps Issued
body: The State Stamp Bureau of the DPRK issued new stamps (one individual stamp and one sheetlet) depicting the Grand Mass Gymnastics and Artistic Performance "The Glorious Country" for celebrating the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. Seen in the individual stamp is an emblem symbolizing the grand mass gymnastics and artistic performance which newly and distinctively represents the desire and requirement of the Korean people. Contained in the sheetlet are individual stamps reflecting "Janggu Dance", "Dove Dance" and a gymnastic dance which remind people of scenes of the grand mass gymnastics and artistic performance giving fervent passion and mystery to the spectators with the harmony of peculiar music and dance, gymnastics and acrobatics, a large-scale background, modern lighting and stage setting. Rodong News Team

title: Int'l Scientific Conference of Kim Il Sung University to Be Held
body: The international scientific conference of Kim Il Sung University-2018 will be held under the subject of "Scientific Development and Human Wellbeing" on Sept. 26 and 27, Juche 107 (2018). The event will bring together scholars of universities and scientific research institutes of the DPRK, China, Russia, Indonesia, Sweden and other countries. It is to be held, divided into panels of social science, medicine, life science, forest one, the protection of ecological environment and agriculture. Rodong News Team

title: National Symposium on Potato Seed Production
body: A national symposium on potato seed production in the DPRK took place at the Pyongyang Vegetable Science Institute under the Institute of Agricultural Science on Wednesday and Thursday. Present there were officials and researchers of the Institute of Agricultural Science, ministries, national institutions and science research, educational and relevant fields. Attending it were also members of the mission of the European Union Programme Support to Pyongyang. Speakers at the symposium said that the demand on potato which is beneficial to good health and longevity of people and highly productive is rising day by day throughout the world and the researches into increasing potato seed production and technology for high-yielding cultivation are actively conducted in the DPRK. They noted the symposium will offer a good opportunity in sincerely discussing theoretical and practical issues arising in the field of potato seed production and vitalizing mutual cooperation and exchange. Then speeches were made under the titles of "Trend of virus-free potato seed production and measures for development", "Research into increasing potato progenitors in hydroponic greenhouse". Speakers gave a scientific and theoretical explanation about the issues arising in breeding new strain of potato and increasing seed production. Rodong News Team

title: Int'l Conference on 70th Founding Anniversary of Kim Chaek University of Technology Held
body: An international conference on the 70th founding anniversary of Kim Chaek University of Technology was held on Wednesday and Thursday. The conference on the theme of "Integration of education and scientific research and production" heard one hundred and dozens of scientific and technological papers conducive to developing science and education of the world. An opening ceremony was held at the Sci-Tech Complex on Wednesday. Present there were Kim Sung Du, chairman of the Education Commission, Hong So Hon, president of Kim Chaek University of Technology, officials, teachers and researchers of the university, Kirill S. Golokhvast, vice-president of the Far Eastern State University of Russia, Wang Xunlian, vice-president of China University of Geosciences, and other delegations and delegates from universities, scientific research institutions and organizations of various countries, overseas Korean scholars and a delegation of Korean University under the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan. The president of Kim Chaek University of Technology said in an opening address that the participants in the conference would exchange scientific and technological successes and experience conducive to developing science and education and deepen mutual ties. The chairman of the Education Commission in a congratulatory speech affirmed that the conference, a contributor to the scientific and technological development of various countries, would bear a good fruit by the efforts of the participants. The vice-president of China University of Geosciences in a congratulatory speech warmly congratulated the teachers and students of Kim Chaek University of Technology on its 70th founding anniversary. The conference was held at the e-library of Kim Chaek University of Technology, divided into panels of earth sciences and mining, metal and materials, machine and energy science, etc. The conference closed on Thursday. During the conference Kim Chaek University of Technology gave a reception for the participants. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from President of Council of State of Republic of Cuba
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Miguel Diaz-Canel Bermudez, president of the Council of State of the Republic of Cuba, on September 9. The president in his message extended sincere greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un on behalf of the government and people of Cuba on the national day of the DPRK. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Off Press in Germany
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us Step Up the Building of a Thriving Country by Applying Kim Jong Il's Patriotism" was brought out in booklet with due ceremony at the Azzawi Media Print Publishing House in Berlin on Sep. 7 to mark the 70th birthday of the DPRK. The work, published on July 26, Juche 101 (2012), deals with the essence of Chairman Kim Jong Il's patriotism and his noble life of love for the country and people. It also sets forth important issues arising in applying Kim Jong Il's patriotism. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Printed in Russia
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "The Cause of the Great Party of Comrades Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il Is Ever-Victorious" was brought out in booklet with due ceremony at the Radio Soft Publishing House of Russia on Sep. 7 ahead of the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. The work, published on Oct. 4, Juche 104 (2015), clarifies the idea that the 70-year-long history of the Workers' Party of Korea is a history of victory in which the validity and invincibility of the cause of the Party of Comrades Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il have been displayed and that the cause of the Party is invincible. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Birthday Marked Abroad
body: Celebrations were held abroad to mark the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. There were a meeting for adopting a congratulatory message in Zambia and a gathering, an exhibition of Korean books, photos and fine art pieces and a celebration concert in Mexico and Venezuela between Aug. 31 and Sep. 7. On display at the venues of the events were photos showing the exploits of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. There were also works of the peerlessly great men and books, photos and art pieces introducing the reality of the DPRK. The international secretary of the C.C., People's Socialist Party of Mexico praised the exploits of the great leaders and noted that the army and people of the DPRK are working miracles and innovations in socialist construction under the wise guidance of the Supreme Leader. The chairman of the Venezuelan preparatory committee for celebrating the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK stressed that the DPRK could emerge as an invincible socialist fortress thanks to the prominent leaders deeply revered by all people as the great men of the century. Rodong News Team

title: "September Pyongyang Joint Declaration" Hailed in S. Korea
body: According to the south Korean internet newspaper Tongil News, the Taejon headquarters of the South Side Committee for Implementing June 15 Joint Declaration expressed support for the historic "September Pyongyang Joint Declaration" on Thursday. At a press conference, the organization said that the south and the north are the driving force in opening up a new era of peaceful reunification of the Korean peninsula. In a press release, it stressed that the "September Pyongyang Joint Declaration" showed the strong will of the south and the north to realize the national reunification by implementing the April 27 Panmunjom Declaration and developing the bilateral relations onto a new high stage. Rodong News Team

title: National Sci-tech Presentation of Communications Held
body: A national sci-tech presentation of communications took place in Wonsan City of Kangwon Province from Sept. 19 to 21, under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea and the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications. Attending it were relevant officials, scientists, technicians, three-revolution team members, teachers, researchers and graduate students. More than 300 papers were presented. "System for reading sci-tech data of institutions and enterprises" and other papers won a high appreciation for their practical significance. During the presentation, its participants attended a lecture on 4G mobile network development and made the rounds of the new technologies and new goods exhibition, exchanging their successes and experience. Rodong News Team

title: National Symposium Held
body: A national symposium of different sectors took place at Kim Chaek University of Technology on Sept. 20 and 21 to mark the 70th anniversary of the university. Attending it were Choe Tong Myong, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), Kim Sung Du, chairman of the Education Commission, Thae Hyong Chol, president of Kim Il Sung University and concurrently minister of Higher Education, Hong So Hon, president of Kim Chaek University of Technology, officials concerned and others. The participants in the symposium, divided into 30 panels, heard more than 1 000 papers on social and natural sciences presented by 70-odd educational institutions and scientific institutes including Kim Il Sung University, Kim Chaek University of Technology, University of Sciences, Hamhung University of Chemical Engineering and geological mechanical engineering institutes of the State Academy of Sciences. At the symposiums of social science panels, speakers explained and proved the originality, validity and vitality of the ideas and theories of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and their revolutionary feats. Introduced at the symposiums of natural science panels were lots of papers solving the theoretical and practical problems arising in putting the national economy on a Juche, modern, IT and scientific basis. Rodong News Team

title: More Remains of Martyrs Buried at Cemetery
body: More remains of martyrs who devoted their lives to the accomplishment of the cause of building a powerful socialist nation were buried at the Patriotic Martyrs Cemetery in Sinmi-ri. Kim Yon Ju who was a general officer of the Korean People's Army (KPA) was loyal to the cause of the Party at the first-line post of defending the leader and the country till the last moment of his life. Pyon Chang Bok, twice labor hero, left a clear trace in the memory of the country and the people as she had thoroughly implemented the Party's agricultural policy in the van under the loving care of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. Ok Pong Rin who was a senior official at Kim Il Sung University of Politics fulfilled his duty in training competent political officials by devoting all his energy and wisdom. Ri Pyong Do who was an officer of the KPA contributed to developing the KPA into an elite revolutionary armed forces. The ceremony for burying remains of the martyrs took place at the cemetery on Friday. Speakers said at the ceremony that thanks to the love of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, who is taking care of the destinies of the revolutionary soldiers, the feats and lives of the martyrs are alive forever, The participants laid wreaths and bouquets at the graves of the martyrs and observed a moment's silence in memory of the martyrs. Rodong News Team

title: Wreaths Laid at Bust of Kim Jong Suk
body: Wreaths were placed before the bust of Kim Jong Suk, an anti-Japanese war heroine, at the Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery on Mt Taesong on Saturday, the 69th anniversary of her demise. Seen at the bust was a wreath sent by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Present at the wreath-laying ceremony were Party and government officials Pak Kwang Ho, Choe Pu Il, Choe Hwi and Kim Nung O, officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), power organs, working people's organizations, ministries, teachers and students of Mangyongdae Revolutionary School and officials of institutions and factories in the city of Pyongyang. Also, present were No Kwang Chol and other members of armed forces organs. Laid at the bust was a wreath in the joint name of the C.C., WPK, the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK and the DPRK Cabinet. And placed were wreaths in the names of the Ministry of the People's Armed Forces, working people's organizations, ministries, Mangyongdae Revolutionary School, Party and power organs and factories in Pyongyang. The participants paid a silent tribute to the memory of Kim Jong Suk, recalling her revolutionary career and feats. On the same day, floral baskets were laid at her statues in Hoeryong City, Kim Jong Suk County, Kim Jong Suk Naval University and other parts of the country. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Guinean President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, received a message of greeting from Alpha Conde, president of Guinea, on Sept. 11. The Guinean president in the message extended the warmest congratulations on behalf of the people and government of Guinea and on his own behalf to Kim Jong Un on the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. He reaffirmed the will to strengthen the historic relations of friendship and cooperation between the two countries. The message wished Kim Jong Un and the Korean people happiness and success. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Maldivian President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, received a message of greeting from Abdulla Yameen Abdul Gayoom, president of the Republic of Maldives, on Sept. 9. The Maldivian president in the message extended warm congratulations and heartfelt greetings on behalf of the government and people of the Maldives and on his own behalf to Kim Jong Un and the government and people of the DPRK on the auspicious founding anniversary of the DPRK. The message wished Kim Jong Un good health and happiness and the DPRK people greater progress and prosperity. Rodong News Team

title: Economic Circles of S. Korea Support "September Pyongyang Joint Declaration"
body: Economic circles of south Korea unanimously issued commentaries in support of the historic "September Pyongyang Joint Declaration" on Sept. 19, according to south Korean Yonhap News. The "National Federation of Businessmen" stressed that the the "September Pyongyang Joint Declaration" for peace and common prosperity of the Korean Peninsula would make a great contribution to the improvement of mutual benefit, exchange and cooperation between the south and the north of Korea. The Korea Chamber of Commerce and Industry commented that the publication of the Pyongyang joint declaration would be a turning point in opening the era of peace on the Korean Peninsula. The organization expressed the will to strive for the substantial progress in the economic cooperation between the south and the north. Other economic organizations, too, declared that they would do their best for successful implementation of the Pyongyang joint declaration and take the lead in the south-north economic exchange and development. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman of Chongryon Central Standing Committee Meets Secretary General of IIJI
body: Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), met and had a talk with Kenichi Ogami, secretary general of the International Institute of the Juche Idea (IIJI) who visited Pyongyang to mark the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK, at the Korean Hall in Tokyo on September 19. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Malian President
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a message of greeting to Ibrahim Boubacar Keita, president of the Republic of Mali, on Saturday on the occasion of the 58th anniversary of its proclamation. Kim Yong Nam in the message wished the Malian people bigger success in their struggle for the country's stability and social development under the correct guidance of the president, expressing belief that the friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries would develop on good terms in the future, too. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Sultan of Oman
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Qaboos Bin Said, sultan of the Sultanate of Oman, on September 6. The message said: We are pleased to extend sincere congratulations to Your Excellency on the national day of your country, founding anniversary of the DPRK. Taking ourselves of this opportunity, we wish you good health and happiness and your friendly people steady progress and prosperity. Rodong News Team

title: Joint Seminar of Political Parties, Organizations in European Region
body: A joint seminar on the struggle of the Workers' Party of Korea for building a socialist powerful nation was held by political parties and organizations of the European region in Rome of Italy on September 15 to mark the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. Attending it were representatives of the political parties and organizations in the European region including Italy, UK, Finland, Romania and Switzerland as well as popular masses. The chairman of the Supreme Council of the National Socialist Party of Romania praised the exploits of President Kim Il Sung who founded the Juche idea to provide a powerful guideline for national liberation, class liberation and socialist construction. The chairman of the Italian Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea said that President Kim Il Sung turned the DPRK into a socialist country independent in politics, self-supporting in the economy and self-reliant in defence and Chairman Kim Jong Il defended socialism by pursuing the original Songun politics. The general secretary of the Revolutionary Communist Party of Britain (Marxist-Leninist) said that socialist Korea, guided by the Juche idea, is a noble revolutionary legacy of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il and that the Korean people will successfully accomplish the cause of building a power in the near future under the guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. The chairperson of the Control Commission of the Communist Party of Switzerland expressed the will to intensify the work for giving publicity to the reality of the DPRK, saying the support for the DPRK is just that for the socialist cause. A letter to Kim Jong Un was adopted at the seminar. Rodong News Team

title: Letter to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Participants in Int'l Seminar
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a letter in the joint name of the Revolutionary Communist Party of Britain (Marxist-Leninist), the Finnish Communists' League, the Communist Party of Switzerland, the National Socialist Party of Romania, the Socialist Workers' Party of Croatia, the New Yugoslav Communist Party, the Communist Party of Italy, the Italian Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea, the Italian Committee for the Study of Songun Idea for Independence and Sovereignty and the Italian Branch of the Korean Friendship Association on September 15. The letter noted that a joint seminar on the struggle of the Workers' Party of Korea for building a socialist powerful nation was held in Rome of Italy by political parties and organizations of the European region on the occasion of the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. The seminar praised the revolutionary careers of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, who guided the building of a socialist state independent in politics, self-supporting in the economy and self-reliant in defence to victory, and the exploits of Kim Jong Un wisely leading the struggle to hit the higher goal of building a powerful nation and stressed the need to further strengthen solidarity with the WPK, it said. Under your leadership the DPRK is defending justice and peace and advancing the socialist cause, the letter said, adding: We will as ever fully support the struggle of the WPK for building a socialist powerful nation, achieving the reunification of the country and ensuring peace and security on the Korean peninsula. The letter sincerely wished Kim Jong Un, chairman of the WPK, new successes in his work for the victorious advance of the socialist cause. Rodong News Team

title: Wreaths Laid at Cemeteries
body: Wreaths were laid before the Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery on Mt. Taesong, the Patriotic Martyrs Cemetery in Sinmi-ri and the Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery on Monday, the Harvest Moon Day. Wreaths sent by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un were seen on the wreath-laying stands of the cemeteries. Present at the wreath-laying ceremonies were party and government officials Pak Kwang Ho, Thae Jong Su, Pak Thae Song and other officials, the chairperson of a friendly party, members of the Workers' Party of Korea Central Committee, officials of power organs, the cabinet, working people's organizations, commissions, ministries and national institutions, officials and working people of institutions and industrial establishments in the city and members of the armed forces organs including Ri Myong Su and Kim Su Gil. Wreaths in the joint name of the Central Committee of the WPK, the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK and the DPRK Cabinet were laid on the wreath-laying stands of the Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery on Mt. Taesong and the Patriotic Martyrs Cemetery in Sinmi-ri, and a wreath in the joint name of the Central Committee of the WPK, the Central Military Commission of the WPK and the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK on the wreath-laying stand of the Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery. Laid before the cemeteries were wreaths in the names of the Ministry of the People's Armed Forces, the Ministry of People's Security, working people's organizations, commissions, ministries and national institutions, units of the Korean People's Army and the Korean People's Internal Security Forces, institutions of science, education, public health and media, and Party and power organs, industrial establishments, universities and farms in the city. The participants paid silent tribute to the martyrs and looked round the cemeteries. On the same day wreaths were placed before the statues and cemeteries of the martyrs and memorial towers and graves of the fallen soldiers of the KPA across the country. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman of Hungarian Workers' Party Arrives
body: Gyula Thurmer, chairman of the Hungarian Workers' Party, and his party arrived in Pyongyang on Monday. Rodong News Team

title: SPA Delegation Back Home
body: A delegation of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK led by Vice-Chairwoman Ri Hye Jong who is president of the Academy of Social Sciences returned home Monday after attending the 2nd Eurasia Women Forum held in Russia. Rodong News Team

title: Congratulatory Letter to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from General Association of Koreans in China
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a congratulatory letter from the General Association of Koreans in China on September 19. The "September Pyongyang Joint Declaration" provided by the Supreme Leader is a new landmark for further accelerating the improvement of the north-south relations by honestly implementing the Panmunjom declaration in an all-round manner and for ushering in a new heyday of national reconciliation, unity, peace and prosperity and turning the Korean peninsula into the land of peace without nuclear weapons and free from nuclear threat, the letter said, and went on: The "September Pyongyang Joint Declaration" which gave all Koreans a new hope and dream and reflected the soul of the Koreans with a strong will to achieve national reunification will shine long in history as a great programme of the Korean nation for reunification along with the historic June 15 joint declaration, October 4 declaration and April 27 Panmunjom declaration.
