The letter lauded the Supreme Leader as the sun of the Korean nation and the bright lodestar of national reunification guiding all Koreans to independent reunification by dint of the great national unity, by thoroughly implementing the great leaders' instructions for national reunification. The letter stressed that the General Association of Koreans in China and all other Koreans in China would turn out as one in the struggle for paving a new avenue toward independent reunification, peace and prosperity in the spirit of By Our Nation Itself, bearing deep in mind the firm conviction that the cause of national reunification will be accomplished before long thanks to the Supreme Leader who represents the destiny and future of the Korean nation. Rodong News Team

title: Paper of Koreans in U.S. Backs "September Pyongyang Joint Declaration"
body: Minjok Thongsin, an online newspaper of Koreans in the U.S., carried an article titled "Let Us Take Precautions against Liberal Korea Party and Ultra-right and Ultra-left Forces" on Sept. 22. The article noted that the ultra-right and ultra-left forces of south Korea are condemned by compatriots at home and abroad as they are making desperate efforts to prevent the trend of peace, prosperity and reunification by rejecting the ratification of the Panmunjom declaration at the "National Assembly". The article blasted them for disregarding the historic significance of the Panmunjom declaration and the "September Pyongyang Joint Declaration" provided by the top leaders of the south and the north. It stressed that those declarations are the orientation to be taken by the Korean nation and an immediate task facing all the fellow countrymen. Whoever is Korean should welcome and positively back those declarations for the peace and prosperity of the Korean peninsula, the article said. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Delegation Leaves for 73rd Session of UN General Assembly
body: A delegation of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea led by Foreign Minister Ri Yong Ho left Pyongyang Monday to take part in the 73rd session of the UN General Assembly. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of DPRK Central Court Leaves for Russia
body: A delegation of the Central Court of the DPRK led by Vice-Director U Sang Chol left Pyongyang on Monday to take part in the International Jurist Forum to be held in Russia. Rodong News Team

title: Message of Sympathy to Iranian President
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, Sunday sent a message of sympathy to Iranian President Hassan Rouhani as regards the tragic terrorist incident in Iran which claimed heavy casualties. The message expressed deep sympathy and condolences to the Iranian president and, through him, to the victims and the bereaved families. Reaffirming the constant stand of the DPRK government that opposes all sorts of terrorist acts, the message wished the Iranian government success in its efforts for preventing terrorism and ensuring social stability. Rodong News Team

title: Swiss Bodies Hail Int'l Festival in Praise of Great Persons of Mt Paektu
body: Swiss bodies on Sept. 13 expressed their support for a press release issued at an enlarged meeting of the Organizing Committee of the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu. The Swiss Organizing Committee of the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu, the Switzerland-Korea Committee and the Swiss Group for the Study of the Juche Idea made public a joint statement. The statement said the above-said press release highlighted the need to step up preparations for the splendid arranging of the 6th International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu in Pyongyang and the area of Mt Paektu in 2022 marking the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il and the 10th anniversary of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's election at the top posts of the Workers' Party of Korea and the state, and to more briskly conduct solidarity movement with the Korean people. The statement went on: We will proactively make preparations to significantly organize the 6th International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu. We extend eternal glory to the peerlessly great persons! We support an independent and peaceful reunification of Korea! Rodong News Team

title: Premier Inspects Various Units
body: Premier Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, made a field survey of the venue of the 45th National Farm Machine Exhibition and the construction site for establishing the C1 chemical industry and the Samsong Cooperative Farm in Junghwa County. Looking round the venue of the exhibition, the premier acquainted himself in detail with the operation of the farm machines presented and called for increasing the rate of mechanization of agricultural labor and meticulously organizing the operation of the agricultural sci-tech learning space. Visiting the construction site where projects for establishing C1 chemical industry are underway, he urged the relevant units to dynamically conduct the campaign for increased production for supplying equipment and materials necessary for the projects in time. A consultative meeting held on the spot stressed the importance of the projects and called on officials to responsibly conduct organizing and control and guidance over the projects. At the Samsong Co-op Farm, he discussed measures arising in gaining a good harvest. Rodong News Team

title: German Embassy Hosts Reception
body: The German embassy here hosted a reception on Tuesday to mark the national day of Germany. Present there on invitation were Choe Hui Chol, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, Ri Kwang Gun, vice-minister of External Economic Relations, Mun Jae Chol, deputy general director of the General Bureau for Affairs with Diplomatic Corps, officials concerned and members of foreign embassies and missions of international bodies here. Pit Heltmann, German ambassador to the DPRK, and his embassy members were on hand. Speeches were made at the reception. Rodong News Team

title: National Software Contest of University Students
body: A national software contest of university students took place at Kim Chaek University of Technology from Sept. 21 to 25 on the occasion of its 70th founding anniversary. Taking part in the contest were more than 200 students, selected from 60-odd universities including Kim Il Sung University, Kim Chaek University of Technology and Kim Hyong Jik University of Education, divided into 68 groups. Presented in the contest were problems requiring multifarious and wide-ranging knowledge of mathematics, computer, etc. and the capacity of designing algorithm and programming. Highly appreciated were Kim Il Sung University, Kim Chaek University of Technology, the University of Sciences, Kim Hyong Jik University of Education, Huichon University of Technology, etc. Attending the closing ceremony held on Tuesday were Kim Sung Du, chairman of the Education Commission, Hong So Hon, president of Kim Chaek University of Technology, officials concerned, teachers and students. Rodong News Team

title: Koreans in Japan Pay Floral Tribute to Statues of Great Leaders
body: A home-visiting group of Koreans in Japan visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on Tuesday to pay floral tribute to them. Rodong News Team

title: Participants in Int'l Film Festival Visit Mangyongdae
body: The participants in the 16th Pyongyang International Film Festival visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. Being briefed on the revolutionary career of the President, they looked round the historical mementoes preserved at the old home in Mangyongdae - the sacred place of the Sun. The guests also toured the Tower of the Juche Idea, the Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace, the Natural History Museum, etc. Rodong News Team

title: 2018 Inter-provincial Mass Sports Contest to Be Held
body: The 2018 Inter-provincial Mass Sports Contest is due in Pyongyang. Taking part in the contest, to be held at Kim Il Sung Stadium, Pyongyang Indoor Stadium and other stadiums and gymnasiums here from early October, will be working people from all walks of life, housewives, school youth and children and sportspersons selected from Pyongyang and all provinces(municipality). Competitions will be made in four professional sports events including table-tennis and track and field, six mass sports events such as badminton, Taekwon-Do, Ssirum (traditional wrestling) and tug of war, and amusement games of two events. Rodong News Team

title: Home-visiting Group of Koreans in Japan Leaves
body: A home-visiting group of Koreans in Japan led by Ji Sung Chol left here on Tuesday. Rodong News Team

title: Irish President Hopes for Better Relations with DPRK
body: DPRK Ambassador Choe Il presented credentials to Micheal Higgins, president of the Republic of Ireland, on Sep. 20. The president hoped that the relations between the two countries would further develop, and expressed pleasure over the current climate of reconciliation and peace on the Korean peninsula. Rodong News Team

title: President of Equatorial Guinea Hails Inter-Korean Summit
body: DPRK Ambassador Tong Chol Ho met with President of Equatorial Guinea Obiang Nguema Mbasogo on Sep. 20. The president welcomed the meeting and talks for peace and prosperity of the Korean peninsula held in Pyongyang between Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and President Moon Jae In. He also supported the north and the south of Korea, the same nation, on their way to reconciliation, unity and cooperation and reaffirmed solidarity with the Workers' Party of Korea and the DPRK government. Rodong News Team

title: 70th Anniversary of Kim Chaek University of Technology Marked
body: Kim Chaek University of Technology marked its 70th founding anniversary. The university is the highest seat of science and technology education in the DPRK, founded and developed under the plan and care of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. It is a meritorious university which has made great contributions to putting the national economy on a Juche, modern, IT and scientific basis. President Kim Il Sung founded the county's first comprehensive university of technology on Sept. 27, Juche 37 (1948), while leading the cause of nation-building, and indicated the orientation and ways for its development in each period and every stage of the developing revolution. And he led the university to play the core role in solving the scientific and technological problems arising in socialist economic construction. Chairman Kim Jong Il paid deep attention to the work of the university and visited it several times. He encouraged the university to achieve successes in the training of persons talented in science and technology and scientific researches and put it forward as the pioneer of the IT industrial revolution. Over the past 70 years after its foundation, the university has made a positive contribution to the building of an economic giant and improving the people's standard of living while training a large number of competent backbones in science and technology. A meeting took place on Wednesday to mark the anniversary. It was attended by Pak Thae Song, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Ro Tu Chol, vice-premier of the Cabinet and chairman of the State Planning Commission, Kim Nung O, chairman of the Pyongyang City Committee of the WPK, officials of the field of education and science, officials concerned and teaching staff, students and graduates of the university. Rodong News Team

title: Russian Ambassador Arranges Friendly Gathering
body: Alexandr Matsegora, Russian ambassador to the DPRK, hosted a friendly gathering on Wednesday to mark the 70th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the DPRK and the Russian Federation. Present there on invitation were officials of the Foreign Ministry. Staff members of the Russian embassy were on hand. The participants expressed their will to further boost the friendly and cooperative relations in line with the interests of the peoples of the two countries and as required by the new era. They had colorful sports games. Rodong News Team

title: Wreaths Sent to Vietnamese Embassy
body: Power bodies, ministries and national institutions of the DPRK sent wreaths to the Vietnamese embassy here on Wednesday in memory of Tran Dai Quang, president of Vietnam. Laid before the portrait of the late were wreaths in the names of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, the Foreign Ministry, the Ministry of External Economic Relations, the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries and the General Bureau for Affairs with Diplomatic Corps. Present there were Kim Yong Dae, vice-president of the SPA Presidium, Choe Hui Chol, vice foreign minister, Ri Myong San, vice-minister of External Economic Relations, Pak Kyong Il, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries and chairman of the DPRK-Vietnam Friendship Association, Mun Jae Chol, vice-director general of the General Bureau for Affairs with Diplomatic Corps, and officials concerned. The participants observed a moment's silence in memory of the deceased and made entries in a condolence book. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman of Hungarian Workers' Party and His Party Visit Mangyongdae
body: Gyula Thurmer, chairman of the Hungarian Workers' Party, and his party visited Mangyongdae, birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. At the time-honored place of the Sun where Kim Il Sung was born and spent his childhood, the visitors looked round historic relics, being briefed on the immortal story associated with the historic home. They also toured the Tower of the Juche Idea, the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum, the Okryu Children's Hospital, etc. Rodong News Team

title: National Sci-tech Presentation in Construction Field
body: A national sci-tech presentation in the field of construction was held at the Sci-Tech Complex on Sept. 25-26. Attending the presentation, divided into two groups - building materials and urban management sectors - were officials, teachers, researchers, designers and graduate students from various units including Pyongyang University of Architecture and the Green Architecture Institute and the Building Materials Institute under the State Academy of Sciences. Presented to it were more than 70 valuable papers on achievements made in developing more various building materials with indigenous raw materials and in the researches for ensuring clean environment. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korea: Ruling Party Calls for Implementing Pyongyang Joint Declaration
body: According to news reports of south Korea, the parliamentary spokesperson for the ruling Minju Party of south Korea on September 20 called upon the opposition parties to actively come out to the ratification of the April 27 Panmunjom declaration at the "National Assembly" and the implementation of the "September Pyongyang Joint Declaration". The spokesperson said that the opposition parties should join the historic trend of peace of the Korean peninsula free from the political strife in the Cold War era. The spokesperson said that the "National Assembly" should work hard to make the Pyongyang summit talks bear fruits, noting that peace on the Korean peninsula could not be realized for 10 years and the south-north relations worsened under the former conservative "governments". Rodong News Team

title: "September Pyongyang Joint Declaration" Supported by Russian Party
body: The Political Executive Committee of the Party for Peace and Unity of Russia made public a statement in support of the historic "September Pyongyang Joint Declaration" on Sept. 21. Referring to the recent meeting between the top leaders of the north and the south of Korea in Pyongyang and the joint declaration adopted there, the statement said: This time the Korean nation made a decisive progress in the efforts for national security and unity on the peninsula. Today's dramatic event is a great fruition born by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's bold decision. The progressive mankind has been attracted by staunchness and noble traits of Kim Jong Un as a great person. We fully support the political will and decision and broadminded measures of the DPRK leadership. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Birthday Celebrated Abroad
body: Celebrations of the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK were held in Russia, Ukraine, Germany, Austria, Spain, Myanmar, India, Pakistan and Libya from Sept. 1 to 11. Speeches were made at the events. The first secretary of the C.C., Lenin Young Communist League of the Russian Federation said that the DPRK has vigorously advanced along the road of socialism, smashing every challenge of the hostile forces for the past decades since its foundation under the leadership of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. The chairperson of the Regional Social Organization of Russia "Borozino" said that today a climate of peace and stability has been created on the Korean peninsula thanks to the initiative and bold decision of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and that the international situation is under his control. A vice-chairman of the Yangon Regional Executive Committee of the Myanmar's National League for Democracy said that the celebrations would be helpful to getting a better understanding of the DPRK and deepening the friendship and bonds between the two countries. The secretary-general of the Karachi Branch of the Pakistan-Korea Friendship Association noted that President Kim Il Sung founded the DPRK 70 years ago and led the socialist construction to victory and that Chairman Kim Jong Il turned the DPRK into a socialist fortress under the unfurled banner of Songun. Congratulatory messages to Kim Jong Un were adopted at the events held by the Lenin Young Communist League of the Russian Federation, the German Group for the Study of Korean Culture, the German Branch of the Korean Friendship Association, the Society for the Promotion of the Relations between Austria and DPRK and the Karachi Branch of the Pakistan-Korea Friendship Association. Rodong News Team

title: Juche-based Iron-making Production Process Completed
body: At a significant time when the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK was celebrated as a grand festival of victors the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex has succeeded in establishing the Juche-oriented iron-making processes based on indigenous technology and locally available fuel and materials 100 per cent, thus instilling great joy and confidence into all the people of the country. The Workers' Party of Korea mapped out a gigantic plan for realizing the historic cause of establishing the system of Juche-based iron production true to the noble intention of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and set forth a militant task for completing the Juche-based project at the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex. The working class of the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex, the Chongjin Metal Construction Complex and the Equipment Assembly Complex and members of the February 17 Shock Brigade of Scientists and Technicians made energetic efforts to implement the idea of the Party and uphold the Party policies and thus victoriously finished the huge project in more than 500 days. The working class of the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex successfully built an oxygen heat blast furnace and a fluidized-bed gas generator, restored oxygen separators to their original state and put the operation of furnaces on a normal basis, thus producing a large amount of iron and steel. The working class of the Chongjin Metal Construction Complex and the Equipment Assembly Complex finished the project of installing an oxygen separator of 15 000㎥/h, the key to the Juche-based iron production, in a bold and big way, ahead of schedule and fulfilled difficult tasks and thus fully demonstrated the might of the main force which has displayed their reputation in metal construction and assembling of custom-built equipment. Thanks to the campaign of brains and the drive of breaking through the cutting edge by experts of Kim Chaek University of Technology, Chongjin University of Mining and Metallurgy, the State Academy of Sciences and other units, a new ground of iron-making method without use of cokes was hewed out and a solid technological guarantee for increased iron and steel production provided. An inaugural ceremony was held on Sept. 25. Present there were O Su Yong, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Kim Tok Hun, vice-premier of the Cabinet, officials of North Hamgyong Province, officials concerned, members of the February 17 Shock Brigade of Scientists and Technicians, officials and employees of the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex and officials of the relevant units. O Su Yong conveyed a letter of thanks from the WPK Central Committee to the workers, scientists, technicians and officials who performed feats in the Juche-based project at the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex. The WPK Central Committee in the letter stressed that the successful establishment of Juche-based iron-making process of our style at the leading huge metallurgical base made it possible to realize the lifelong desire of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and put the country's iron and steel industry on a upgrade track. It highly appreciated the workers, scientists, technicians and officials involved in the project for opening up a bright prospect to drastically develop the country's steel industry by displaying Kim Jong Il's patriotism and fortitude. Vice-Premier Kim Tok Hun made an inaugural address to be followed by speeches. At the end of the ceremony the participants went round the newly built objects. Rodong News Team

title: Chinese Ambassador Gives Reception to Mark Anniversary of PRC
body: Chinese Ambassador to the DPRK Li Jinjun hosted a reception at his embassy Thursday to mark the 69th founding anniversary of the People's Republic of China. Present there on invitation were Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, Pak Chun Nam, minister of Culture, officials concerned, diplomatic envoys of different countries and representatives of international bodies and military attaches here. Members of the Chinese embassy were on hand. The ambassador said in his speech that he was pleased that the Korean people are making great achievements in accomplishing the cause of socialist construction in single-minded unity under the leadership of the WPK headed by Chairman Kim Jong Un. He recalled that Li Zhanshu led the Chinese party and government delegation to attend the celebrations of the 70th birthday of the DPRK, as special envoy of Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and president of the People's Republic of China (PRC), thus demonstrating once again the invincibility of the China-DPRK friendship to the whole world. He affirmed that the Chinese party and government's firm stand to boost the China-DPRK relations, the Chinese people's friendly feelings toward the Korean people and China's support for socialist Korea would not change no matter how the international and regional situation may change. Choe Ryong Hae said the Chinese people are registering signal achievements in their efforts to realize the dream of China under the leadership of General Secretary Xi Jinping. He stressed that the three visits to China by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un this year offered important occasions for pushing the DPRK-China friendship onto a new high stage and making it advance with dynamics. We, together with the Chinese comrades, will usher in a new golden age of the DPRK-China friendship in the spirit of an agreement made by the top leaders of the two countries, he stressed. Earlier, the Chinese consul general in Chongjin hosted a reception. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Il Sung University International Symposium - 2018 Held
body: Kim Il Sung University International symposium - 2018 took place on Wednesday and Thursday. Presented at the symposium on the theme of "Development of Science and Improvement of Welfare of Mankind" were more than 140 papers of great academic value reflective of advanced sci-tech research achievements and experience. Its opening ceremony was held at Kim Il Sung University on Wednesday. Present there were Chairman of the Education Commission Kim Sung Du, President of Kim Il Sung University and Minister of Higher Education Thae Hyong Chol, teachers and researchers of the university and scholars from educational and scientific research institutes of China, Russia, Mongolia, Indonesia, Germany, France, Britain, Italy and other countries. In his opening address, Thae Hyong Chol said that the symposium would be greatly helpful to the promotion of welfare of mankind. Congratulatory speeches were made by Kim Sung Du and Managing Vice-President Gui Yonghao of China's Fudan University and President Ya Tumurbaatar of National University of Mongolia. The symposium was held, divided into such sections as social science, medicine and life science, forestry science and eco-environmental protection and agriculture. A letter to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was adopted at the closing ceremony on Thursday. Kim Il Sung University hosted a reception for the participants in the symposium. Rodong News Team

title: Letter to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Participants in Int'l Symposium
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un on Thursday received a letter from the participants in the Kim Il Sung University International Symposium - 2018. The letter said that the symposium, held on the theme "Development of Science and Improvement of Welfare of Mankind" amid the expectations and attention of universities and scientific research organs of various countries, helped its participants know better about the DPRK and offered an important occasion in further boosting the exchange and friendly and cooperative relations with famous Kim Il Sung University. It noted that during the symposium they were deeply impressed to see the educators and scientists of Kim Il Sung University devoting their wisdom and zeal to the work for achieving remarkable leaps forward in the sci-tech development of the country and training world-famous talents. It pointed out that they also became convinced that under the wise leadership of HE Kim Jong Un, the DPRK standing in the spotlight of the international arena will rank itself proudly among the science and education powers in the near future. All scholars from various countries who attended the symposium came to have a clear understanding that to briskly conduct the scientific exchange with Kim Il Sung University ranking itself among the world's best universities is very favorable to the sci-tech development of mankind and is urgently necessary, the letter said. It stressed that on the basis of the excellent successes they gained during the symposium, they would as ever strive to further expand and promote the multi-faceted exchange and cooperation with Kim Il Sung University. Rodong News Team

title: State Academic Degrees and Titles Conferred on Intellectuals in DPRK
body: State academic degrees and titles were conferred on the intellectuals who contributed to the development of the country's economy and the improvement of the people's living standard. The title of candidate academician was awarded to Kang Yong Ho, department head of Kim Il Sung University, and Kim Jong Gil, a researcher at the Institute of Koryo Medicine. Professorship went to a large number of teachers and researchers of various universities. Doctorate was conferred on Kim Chol Hyok and Kim Sung Chol, department heads of Kim Il Sung University, and others. The title of associate professor went to 199 persons and master's degree to 1 127. An awarding ceremony took place at the People's Palace of Culture on Thursday. Rodong News Team

title: Vice-Chairman of C.C., WPK Meets Hungarian Workers' Party Chairman
body: Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, on Thursday had a talk with Gyula Thurmer, chairman of the Hungarian Workers' Party, and his party. Rodong News Team

title: National Sci-Tech Presentation in Field of Coal Industry
body: A national scientific and technological presentation in the field of coal industry was held at the Supply Coal Mine of Jagang Province under the Kaechon Area Coal Mining Complex on Wednesday and Thursday under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea. Present there were officials, teachers, researchers and post-graduate students of the Ministry of Coal Industry, the State Academy of Sciences, Kim Chaek University of Technology, Phyongsong University of Coal Mining, the Kaechon Area Coal Mining Complex and other units. More than 170 papers were presented to it, divided into panels like prospecting, coal mining, pit construction and coal mining machine and equipment. Rodong News Team

title: National Symposium on Vegetable Seed Production
body: A national symposium on vegetable seed production and vegetable nutrition in the DPRK was held at the Pyongyang Vegetable Science Institute under the Academy of Agricultural Science on Wednesday and Thursday. Present there were officials and researchers of ministries, national institutions, scientific research institutes, educational units and relevant units including the Academy of Agricultural Science, and members of the European Union Programme Support in the DPRK. The speakers said that the symposium would offer an occasion for swapping achievements and experience gained in vegetable breeding and seed production and vegetable processing methods and invigorating mutual exchange and cooperation. There were speeches titled "Some ways for improving quality of vegetable seeds" and "Characteristics of newly bred tomato strains". The speakers gave scientific explanation about practical issues arising in the cultivation of new vegetable strains, seed production and cultivation and use. Rodong News Team

title: Foreigners Visit Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: Gyula Thurmer, chairman of the Hungarian Workers' Party, and his party and other foreign guests visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on Thursday to pay homage to President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. The visitors bowed before the statues of the great leaders at the palace. At the halls of immortality where the great leaders lie in state they paid homage to them. They went round the halls where the orders the great leaders received are on display and the halls that house cars, electric car, boat and train coaches used by them during their field guidance and foreign tours till the last moments of their lives. Rodong News Team

title: Gift to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Standing Committee
body: of Hungarian Workers' Party Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a gift from the Standing Committee of the Hungarian Workers' Party. The gift was handed over to Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, on Thursday by Chairman Gyula Thurmer of the Hungarian Workers' Party on a visit to the DPRK. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Visits Kim Chaek University of Technology
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un visited Kim Chaek University of Technology to congratulate its teachers and researchers on the 70th founding anniversary of the university and have a photo session with them. He was greeted by Hong So Hon, president of Kim Chaek University of Technology, and Kim Ryong Il, chairman of the university committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, at the university. Noting that the university has made great contributions to the country's scientific and technological education, independent development of the national economy and build-up of national defence capabilities, Kim Jong Un said he was pleased to personally meet and congratulate the teachers and researchers of the glorious university on its 70th birthday. He extended congratulations on behalf of the Party and government to all the teachers and researchers who have devoted themselves to the education and scientific research for the prosperity and future of the socialist country. Saying that the university's position and duty are very important in implementing the Party's strategic plan for building a sci-tech power, a talent power, he expressed expectations and belief that its teachers and researchers would become the leading chariot and locomotive powerfully propelling the development of the country's science and technology and its economic construction, holding higher the slogan "Let us make a leap forward by dint of science and guarantee the future by dint of education!", and had a photo session with them. Then he went to the revolutionary museum of the university, where he recalled with deep emotion that President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il founded the country's first comprehensive university of technology and clearly indicated directions and ways to be followed by it in each period and at each stage of the developing revolution and led it in every aspect of its work. The university is one of the universities the Party trusts, boasts and holds up most, he said, stressing that the building of an economic giant can be given impetus when efforts are concentrated on steadily developing the university's scientific education. He highlighted the need for the university to defend the Party and revolution with brilliant successes in scientific and technological research and talents training in the future, too, by reliably carrying forward the 70 year-long brilliant tradition. He set forth vital tasks for the university to train students into creation-oriented talents and scientists faithful to the Party and revolution with strong revolutionary spirit and high faculties of inquiry and application by steadily enhancing the quality of education as required by the new century. Saying it is the intention of the Party Central Committee and demand of the revolution to turn Kim Chaek University of Technology into the most prestigious university in the world, the Supreme Leader clarified the issues of improving the educational conditions and environment, content and method of the university, and bestowed great favors on the university. Accompanying him were Vice-Chairman Pak Thae Song and Department Director Choe Tong Myong of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea. Political News Team

title: Sincere Implementation of Panmunjom Declaration and
body: DPRK-US Joint Statement Urged The ministerial meeting of G77 was held at the UN Headquarters on Thursday. It was attended by delegations from more than 120 member states. The DPRK permanent representative at the UN and others of 60-odd countries made speeches at the meeting. Adopted at the meeting was a declaration to welcome the Panmunjom declaration made at the historic inter-Korean summit meetings and the DPRK-US Joint Statement declared at the historic DPRK-US Summit. The declaration stressed that implementation of the Panmunjom Declaration and the DPRK-US Joint Statement by relevant parties in good faith would contribute to building a lasting and durable peace regime on the Korean Peninsula. It supported that the positive developments towards peace on the Korean Peninsula is conducive to creating a peaceful environment which is instrumental in achieving the 2030 agenda, including its sustainable development goals and promoting economic prosperity in the Korean Peninsula and countries in the region. It also reaffirmed its rejection to the unilateral economic sanctions imposed on the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, which have a negative impact on the development and prosperity of the people of the DPRK, and in this regard called for an immediate lifting of those sanctions. Rodong News Team

title: Letter to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Film Festival Participants
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un on Friday received a letter from the participants in the 16th Pyongyang International Film Festival. The letter said that achievements and experience in the production of national films were swapped and friendship was deepened during the significant September festival. It also noted that during the stay being not long, the participants enjoyed the grand mass gymnastics and artistic performance "Glorious Country" and visited different places to see the stirring reality and bright looks of the DPRK. It said that thanks to the outstanding leadership of Kim Jong Un, a new history of peace and prosperity started in the Korean peninsula and dramatic changes took place in the international political structure, adding that the justice- and truth-loving world movie men are encouraged by the reality. It expressed the will to fulfill the mission and duty of movie men in the work to build an independent and just new world by devoting their energy and wisdom to the production of fresh, original and genuine national films as desired and required by the world progressives. Rodong News Team

title: Reception Given for Participants in Film Festival
body: The Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea arranged a reception for the participants in the 16th Pyongyang International Film Festival at the People's Palace of Culture on Friday as regards the successful festival. Invited to the reception were delegations and delegates of various countries which participated in the festival and the international jury. Ri Ryong Nam, vice-premier of the Cabinet, Pak Chun Nam, minister of Culture who is chairman of the festival organizing committee, Cha Hui Rim, chairman of the Pyongyang City People's Committee, and other officials concerned were on hand. A speech was made there. Rodong News Team

title: 16th Pyongyang Int'l Film Festival Closes
body: The 16th Pyongyang International Film Festival closed with due ceremony at the Pyongyang International Cinema House on Friday. Attending the event were Ri Ryong Nam, vice-premier of the Cabinet; Pak Chun Nam, minister of Culture who is chairman of the festival organizing committee; officials concerned, creators and artistes in the film sector, Pyongyangites, foreign delegations and delegates and the international jury. Present on invitation were diplomatic envoys of different countries and representatives of international bodies here, military attaches, foreign embassy officials and foreigners staying here. At the ceremony, the festival films were introduced to be followed by the announcement of jury results. Grand Prix was awarded to the Chinese feature film "The Woman behind the Man". Adopted there was the participants' letter to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Pak Chun Nam in his closing address said the festival contributed to the world film development, noting that the festival films gave a deep impression on the audience. He expressed the belief that the participants would produce more good films on the basis of the successes and experience gained in the festival, thus enriching the moral and cultural assets of mankind and contributing to further developing the festival into the world's famous one. Rodong News Team

title: Reception Given to Mark 69th Founding Anniversary of PRC
body: The Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries and the DPRK-China Friendship Association hosted a reception at the Okryu Restaurant on Friday to mark the 69th founding anniversary of the People's Republic of China (PRC). Present there on invitation were Chinese Ambassador to the DPRK Li Jinjun, staff members of the Chinese embassy and Chinese students and guests staying in the DPRK. Attending it were Yang Hyong Sop, vice-president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, Kim Il Guk, minister of Physical Culture and Sports, Ryu Myong Son, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Pak Myong Guk, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, Pak Chun Sik, vice-minister of Culture, Pak Kyong Il, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries and chairman of the DPRK-China Friendship Association, and officials concerned. Yang Hyong Sop said in his speech at the reception that the Chinese people have achieved great changes in different fields including politics, economy and culture, noting that the founding of the PRC was a historic event in which the first state of the people was built on the land of China. He expressed conviction that the DPRK-China friendship would grow stronger by the joint efforts of the two countries as it is being deepened as required by the new era, true to the idea discussed at the meetings and talks between the top leaders of the two countries. Li Jinjun said in a speech that the Chinese party and government sincerely hope that the Korean people will make bigger success in their efforts for their country's development under the leadership of Chairman Kim Jong Un. Saying it is the steadfast policy of the Chinese party and government to creditably protect and cement the China-DPRK cooperative relations, he expressed his will to proactively promote the development of the China-DPRK friendship under an agreement reached by the supreme leaders of the two countries. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman of Hungarian Workers' Party Leaves
body: Gyula Thurmer, chairman of the Hungarian Workers' Party, and his party left here for home on Friday. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Turkmenistan President
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, on Thursday sent a message of greeting to Gurbanguly Berdymuhamedov, president of Turkmenistan, on the occasion of its national day. Expressing belief that the friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries would grow stronger, Kim in the message wished the president good health and happiness and bigger success in his responsible work for the country's development and prosperity. Rodong News Team

title: Korean Schoolboys in Japan Pay Floral Tribute to Statues of Great Leaders
body: A basketball team of Korean schoolboys in Japan led by Kim Se Jong, vice-chairman of the Korean Sportsmen's Federation in Japan, on Friday visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill to pay floral tribute to them. Rodong News Team

title: Pyongyang Joint Declaration Paves Path to Reconciliation, Peace and Prosperity
body: The historic “September Pyongyang Joint Declaration” is a landmark for national reunification to further accelerate the development of the north-south relations and open up a new heyday of national reconciliation, unity, peace and prosperity by honestly and fully implementing the Panmunjom declaration in keeping with desire and demand of all Koreans. The spirit of national independence and unity indicative of the self-determination of the nation and the strong desire for peace and reunification run through every paragraph of the “September Pyongyang Joint Declaration.” The declaration also embodies the soul of all Koreans with their hearts burning with a new hope and strong will to achieve reunification. There were many turns and twists, trials and difficulties on the path towards national reunification, but nothing could ever undermine the strong faith of the Koreans, the people of a strong will for reunification. The Korean nation ardently hopes for the country’s reunification. It is because the reunification ensures the existence, development, dignity and prosperity of the homogeneous nation with a long history spanning 5 000 years. The declaration reflects the dream of the Koreans which will come true before long. Seeing the north and the south being pleased together with the auspicious national event and demonstrating the mettle of the nation by their concerted efforts, the Koreans once again and clearly realized that the Korean nation is just like an organism that can survive when reunified and cannot when bisected. Whether the north-south relations put on a new track of peace, reconciliation and cooperation are decisively developed or not totally hinges on the will and efforts of the north and the south. All Koreans in the north and the south and abroad should tangibly contribute to the development of the north-south relations and the accomplishment of the cause of independent reunification by holding aloft the “September Pyongyang Joint Declaration” as a banner for national reunification. Pak Chol Jun

title: Japanese Reactionaries Should Not Try to Spoil Peaceful Atmosphere of Korea
body: The maritime “Self-Defense Force” of Japan recently conducted a test-fire of the interceptor missile SM-3 Block 1B on an Aegis destroyer in waters off Hawaii of the U.S. It is reportedly the first time that the MSDF conducted an interceptor missile test-fire. Witnessing the will and aspiration of all Koreans to turn the Korean peninsula and its vicinity into a cradle of peace, the world community is now positively welcoming and supporting it, sincerely hoping that it would bear food fruit. However, only the reactionaries on the island country are crazy about military moves against the trend of the times. We cannot but take a serious view of their open claim that they conducted the first-fire as part of “muscle flexing” against the DPRK. Whenever there was an epochal event in the Korean peninsula, the ill-natured Japanese reactionaries talked rubbish to play down its significance, being displeased with it. The constitutional ill habit and mind of the descendants of the samurais seeking their interests in checking the peace trend on the Korean peninsula and creating tensions in the region never change. The present reactionary regime of Japan seeks to put the Asia-Pacific region under control by turning Japan into a country capable of going to war. No matter how desperately it moves, it can never dampen the aspirations of all Koreans and the international community for peace and stability of the Korean peninsula and the region. The politicians of Japan are well advised to face up to the present situation and improve their ability to behave themselves as it will be good for them. Ra Myong Song

title: Reactionary Ideological and Cultural Poisoning of Imperialists Should Be Checked
body: The imperialists’ ideological and cultural poisoning targeting independent countries has become craftier and more vicious. Failure to check the imperialists’ ideological and cultural poisoning would prevent a country from defending its sovereignty and dignity, let alone achieving the independent development and prosperity. There is constant danger of infiltration of bourgeois ideology and culture into other countries, given the escalated moves of the imperialists to stamp out the independent forces, and the complicated situation. The main target of the imperialists’ ideological and cultural poisoning campaign is young people. The destiny and future of each country and nation depend on the new generation who would shoulder upon the future. Failing to do proper education of young people would result in getting them affected by bourgeois ideology and culture to be hooligans seeking their own luxury only. The imperialists remain unchanged in the way of their aggression designed to disrupt and disintegrate the anti-imperialist and independent countries and attain their goal through the reactionary ideological poisoning. Countries aspiring after independent development and social progress should bear this in mind and thoroughly frustrate at the germinal stage the bourgeois ideological and cultural poisoning by the imperialists. Ri Hak Nam

title: Ri Yong Ho Calls for thoroughly Implementing DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement
body: Foreign Minister Ri Yong Ho, head of the delegation of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, delivered a speech at the plenary meeting of the 73rd session of the United Nations General Assembly on Saturday. He said that Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, conducted energetic summit-level diplomatic activities with a firm determination to turn the Korean peninsula into a cradle of peace without any nuclear weapons and nuclear threats; and made important breakthrough in improving the North-South relations and the DPRK-U.S. relations and in revitalizing the friendly and cooperative relations with neighboring countries and hence made a turning point for dramatic easing of tension in the Korean peninsula. He went on: The vital factor in consolidating the peace and security in the Korean peninsula is to thoroughly implement the DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement adopted in June at the historic DPRK-U.S. summit in Singapore. The primary task for effectively implementing the DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement should be bringing down the wall of mistrust between the two countries which has existed for several decades; and to do so the DPRK and the U.S. should direct their first efforts to building trust. It is our position that the denuclearization of the Korean peninsula should also be realized under the principle of building peace regime and simultaneous action, step by step, starting with what we can do first and giving priority to building of trust. However, we do not see any corresponding response from the U.S. The reason behind the current deadlock is because the U.S. clings to authoritarian methods which are lethal to trust-building method. The recent dramatic improvement of the North-South relations and the atmosphere of cooperation evidently show the decisive role of trust building. The political oppositions in the U.S. make it their daily business to slander the DPRK claiming that our Republic cannot be trusted with the sole purpose of attacking their political opponent and they are enforcing the administration to make unreasonable unilateral demand to our side aimed at impeding the smooth progress of the dialogue and negotiations. Creating mistrust towards the dialogue partner while only clinging to authoritarian methods is not helpful in building trust; on the contrary it only increases mistrust. One part of the spirit of the DPRK-U.S. summit in Singapore is getting rid of the stereo-typed way of thinking and finding a completely new way of solving the issues. At this critical juncture, the U.S. should make a foresighted judgment that faithful fulfillment of its commitment in Singapore is, in the end, for the best national interests of the U.S. and should seek new method for solving the DPRK-U.S. relations. Only then there will be positive prospects for the DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement. If the DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement falls victim to the domestic politics of the U.S., the greatest victim of the subsequent unpredictable consequences would be the U.S. itself. Solving the DPRK-U.S. relations and issues in the Korean peninsula should be the key topic in achieving theme of this session: "Making the United Nations relevant to all people: Global leadership and shared responsibilities for peaceful, equitable and sustainable societies". The implementation of the DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement is a common responsibility of the DPRK and the U.S.; at the same time the UN also has its role in implementing the statement. The UN Security Council that was once so eager to express "concern" to the tense situation in the Korean peninsula keeps silence even now about the precious momentum for peace in the Korean peninsula which has been achieved in this year; this is incomprehensible in any way. Worse still, the UNSC is taking very concerning stand by rejecting the proposal by some of its member states to issue presidential statement that welcomes the DPRK-U.S. summit and the Joint Statement. The UN should really apply the theme of this session to its actual activities and hence get rid of the stigma that "UNSC=U.S." as early as possible. Rodong News Team

title: National Sci-Tech Presentation on Potato Held
body: A national scientific and technological presentation in the field of potato research, production and processing was held at the Ryanggang Provincial Sci-Tech Exhibition from September 28 to 30 under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea and the Academy of Agricultural Science. Taking part in it were officials, teachers, researchers and graduate students from different units including Pyongyang Agricultural College of Kim Il Sung University, the Bioengineering Branch of the State Academy of Sciences, the Academy of Agricultural Science, the Ryanggang Provincial Institute of Agricultural Science, Hyesan University of Agriculture and Forestry and the Samjiyon Potato Farina Production Factory. Presented to it were scores of valuable papers which have been conducive to increasing the potato production and solving the sci-tech problems arising in potato production and processing. During the presentation, its participants had a lecture on the method of molecular diagnosing on potato germ and the temperature adjusting method for producing stock seed potato. And they swapped successes and experience with each other while looking round the venue of the exhibition at which processed potato products and vegetable insecticide were presented by several units. Rodong News Team

title: Floral Tribute to Great Leaders Paid
body: The participants in the 2018 Inter-provincial Mass Sports Contest visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on Sunday. They laid a floral basket and bouquets at the statues of the great leaders and bowed to them. Rodong News Team

title: 16th National Angling Contest
body: The 16th national angling contest took place in the waters off Kosong County of Kangwon Province on Saturday. It brought together 50-odd members of the anglers' association selected in Pyongyang and all provinces. The contest drew expectations and interest of the participants and spectators as it was held at the seashore for the first time. The rankings were decided according to the number and total weight of fishes caught within an appointed time. O Kum Song from Kangwon Province won the prize for the first place and Song Kyong Nam from North Hwanghae Province received a technical prize. Meanwhile, an exhibition of invented fishing tackles was held that day and Nampho City, Pyongyang City and Kangwon Province were highly appraised for their fishing tackles and quality bait by excellent ideas. Rodong News Team

title: FM of DPRK Meets UN Secretary-General
body: DPRK Foreign Minister Ri Yong Ho, who is attending the 73rd session of the UN General Assembly as head of the DPRK delegation, met and had a talk with UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres at the UN Headquarters on Sept. 28. Antonio Guterres highly appreciated the inter-Korean summits, DPRK-U.S. summit and other dialogues held so far this year, and hoped that all the issues would be tackled well through the efforts of all parties. Ri Yong Ho said that Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un brought about a new phase of dramatic détente of the situation in the Korean peninsula with his superb political ability and through energetic external activities. And he stressed that the UN has responsibility and duty to support and encourage the development of situation helpful to the international peace and security in keeping with its mission. Rodong News Team

title: Inter-Korean Summit Hailed Abroad
body: The Arabian Regional Committee for Friendship and Solidarity with the Korean People issued a statement on Sept. 23 to hail the historic inter-Korean summit. Expressing belief that peace and reunification would surely be realized in the Korean peninsula as early as possible under the guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, the statement said: We sincerely congratulate the successful north-south summit and hope that such meetings for peace of the Korean peninsula would be held continuously. The UN should help put an end to the danger of war in the Korean peninsula, withdraw the anti-DPRK sanctions and remove all the obstacles to Korea's reunification. We extend heartfelt congratulations to HE Kim Jong Un once again. We reaffirm the support and solidarity with the just cause of the Korean people. Rodong News Team

title: International Day of Older Persons Marked in DPRK
body: Aged people in the DPRK marked the International Day of Older Persons. Colorful art performances and special services and sports games were arranged for the aged in Pyongyang and every province, city and county. Former unconverted long-term prisoners and their spouses, war veterans, merited persons and other aged people watched a circus show given by the National Acrobatic Troupe at the Pyongyang Circus Theater. Put on the stage were numbers including physical and comic acrobatics. Sports and amusement games of the aged people took place at the Songyo Gymnasium and angling contest on the bank of the Taedong River. Leisure complexes such as Moran Hill and promenade beside the Taedong River were full of happy laughter of the aged people. Kind services at Okryu Restaurant, Chongryu Restaurant, Hyangmanru Restaurant and other public catering establishments also delighted the older people. Congratulations were offered to the aged people on the International Day of Older Persons. Officials of the Party and power organs visited the homes for the aged and offered them souvenirs and took warm care of their life. Meanwhile, a seminar was held at the Taedonggang Diplomatic Club under the participation of officials of the Central Committee of the Korea Federation for the Care of the Aged and officials concerned and diplomatic envoys of various countries and representatives of international bodies here on Monday, the International Day of Older Persons. Rodong News Team

title: Message of Sympathy to Indonesian President
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, on Monday sent a message of sympathy to Joko Widodo, president of the Republic of Indonesia, as regards a strong earthquake and tsunami that hit Central Sulawesi Province of Indonesia, claiming hundreds of lives. The message expressed deep condolences to the Indonesian president and, through him, to the victims and the bereaved families. It hoped that the Indonesian government would eradicate the aftermath of the quake as early as possible and make an achievement in the work to help the people in the affected area return to normal life. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK FM Meets His Foreign Counterparts, UN High-ranking Officials
body: Foreign Minister Ri Yong Ho, who is attending the 73rd session of the UN General Assembly as a head of a delegation of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, respectively had talks with foreign ministers of China, Russia, Switzerland, Kazakhstan, Azerbaijan, Sweden, Venezuela, Cote d'Ivoire, Algeria, Cuba, Burundi, Norway and Brazil, minister of Foreign Affairs and Cooperation of the Republic of Equatorial Guinea, minister of Foreign Affairs and Cooperation of the Islamic Republic of Mauritania, minister of Foreign Affairs and Trade of Mongolia, the minister responsible for Foreign Affairs of Oman, the UN under secretary-general for Political Affairs and the executive director of the UNICEF. Ri Yong Ho talked about the issues of developing the bilateral relations with those countries and strengthening cooperation on the arena of the UN in line with the trend of the development of the present situation on the Korean peninsula. Foreign ministers of different countries and high-ranking officials of the UN expressed views of strengthening bilateral relations and mutual cooperation on the UN arena and developing the cooperative relations between the UN and the DPRK, estimating dramatic events on the Korean peninsula being brought about by proactive measures of the DPRK this year. Rodong News Team

title: 19th National Educational Software Exhibition Opens
body: The 19th National Educational Software Exhibition opened with due ceremony at the Three Revolution Exhibition House on Monday. On display there are hundreds of programs for putting the education on an IT basis and more than 1 000 educational resources in use for teaching and out-of-school studies, which were developed by 70-odd units including Kim Il Sung University, Kim Chaek University of Technology, Kim Hyong Jik University of Education and Kim Chol Ju University of Education. Educational aid programs and resources appreciated at the exhibition will be disseminated to educational institutions across the country through a national computer network. The exhibition will last until October 5. Rodong News Team

title: National Exhibition of IT Achievements by University Students Opens
body: A national exhibition of IT achievements made by university students took place at the Sci-Tech Complex with due ceremony on Monday. On show there are over 1 950 valuable inventions and products of new technology made by university students from across the country. Attending the ceremony were Choe Hwi, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials concerned, officials of the youth league and university students. Rodong News Team

title: Members of AINDF Mission Visit Monument to Three Charters for National Reunification
body: Chief Pak Su Chol and members of the Pyongyang mission of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front (AINDF) visited the Monument to the Three Charters for National Reunification on Monday on the occasion of the 11th anniversary of the publication of the historic October 4 declaration. They looked round the tower and group of subsidiary theme sculptures, being briefed on the fact that the monument was built, reflecting the Koreans' will to convey to posterity the great leaders' feats for national reunification and usher in a new era of independent reunification under the banner of By Our Nation Itself. Rodong News Team

title: Inter-Provincial Mass Sports Contest - 2018 Opens
body: The Inter-Provincial Mass Sports Contest - 2018 opened with due ceremony at the Pyongyang Indoor Stadium on Monday. Present there were Choe Hwi, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the National Sports Guidance Committee, Vice-Premier Ri Ryong Nam, Minister of Physical Culture and Sports Kim Il Guk, officials concerned, active officials in the mass sports work, participants of the contest and cheering squads and Pyongyangites. There will be professional sports games, mass sports games and sports amusement games among working people of various circles, housewives, school youth and children and sportspersons selected in Pyongyang and each province (municipality) during the sports contest. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of DPRK Central Court Returns
body: A delegation of the Central Court of the DPRK led by Vice-President U Sang Chol came back home on Monday after taking part in the International Jurist Forum held in Russia. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of Ministry of Electric Power Industry Leaves for Russia
body: A delegation of the DPRK Ministry of Electric Power headed by Minister Kim Man Su left here on Monday to attend the 2nd "Russian week of electric power" event due in Russia. Rodong News Team

title: Syrian Delegation Feted
body: The Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK gave a reception for the visiting delegation of the People's Assembly of Syria on Tuesday. Present there on invitation were members of the delegation led by Vice-President Najdat Anzour and Syrian Ambassador to the DPRK Tammam Sulaiman. An Tong Chun, vice-chairman of the Supreme People's Assembly (SPA), Choe Jin Su, presidium member of the Central Committee of the Democratic Front for the Reunification of Korea who doubles as chairman of the DPRK-Syria Friendship Parliamentary Group, deputies to the SPA and officials concerned were on hand. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of People's Assembly of Syria Arrives
body: A delegation of the People's Assembly of Syria headed by Vice-President Najdat Anzour arrived here on Tuesday. Rodong News Team

title: Pak Pong Ju Inspects Units of South Hamgyong Province
body: Premier Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, inspected various units in South Hamgyong Province. Looking round the production processes of caustic soda at the February 8 Vinalon Complex, the premier highlighted the need to radically increase the production of basic chemical products by fully displaying the spirit of self-reliance and self-development based on science and technology. He visited the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex and the Ryongsong Machine Complex where he said that the relevant sectors should take thorough measures to supply materials to the Complex. Later he inspected the Hungnam Pharmaceutical Factory, Hamhung Disabled Soldier's Prosthesis Factory and others before going to the Ryongjon Fruit Farm in Pukchong County and the Pukchong Apple Research Institute. At field consultative meetings, measures were taken to solve in time the scientific and technological issues arising in putting production on a normal footing and officials were called upon to do well the work with scientists and technicians. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Wreath to Bier of Pak Jong Ju
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un on Tuesday sent a wreath to the bier of Movie Director of the Korean Film Studio Pak Jong Ju, winner of Kim Il Sung Prize, labor hero and people's artiste, to express deep condolences over his death. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Guinean President
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the DPRK Supreme People's Assembly, Tuesday sent a message of greeting to Alpha Conde, president of Guinea, on the occasion of the 60th anniversary of its independence. Expressing the belief that the friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries, with a history of 60 years along with the independence of Guinea, would grow stronger, the message wished the Guinean people bigger success in their efforts for building prosperous Guinea. Rodong News Team

title: Inter-Korean Summit Hailed in Various Countries
body: The historic inter-Korean summit has been welcomed by governments of different countries. Hailing the recent meeting and talks between Chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK Kim Jong Un and President Moon Jae In, the Mongolian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade said that the "September Pyongyang Joint Declaration", made public at the summit, is of great significance in activating exchange and cooperation between the north and the south of Korea and building a durable peace-keeping mechanism. The Foreign Ministry of Laos hoped that all the relevant countries would make joint efforts to keep a good atmosphere, expressing pleasure over the positive development of situation on the Korean peninsula. The Foreign Ministry of Turkey welcomed the "September Pyongyang Joint Declaration" signed by the top leaders of the north and the south and sincerely hoped that a permanent peace would settle in the Korean peninsula through such process. The Foreign Ministry of Indonesia stressed that the summit in Pyongyang marked an occasion of opening up a new era on the Korean peninsula. The Foreign Ministry of Colombia hoped that a durable peace on the Korean peninsula would be achieved in conformity with the wish of the Korean people and the unanimous will of the international community. The government of Nicaragua called upon the relevant countries to cooperate with each another for peace and stability of the Korean peninsula. Governments of many countries including Cambodia, Vietnam, India, Belarus, Germany, Brazil, Mexico, Uruguay, Ecuador and Costa Rica expressed expectations and conviction that the "September Pyongyang Joint Declaration" would be implemented to open up a new era of peace and prosperity in the Korean peninsula. Rodong News Team

title: Founding Anniversary of DPRK Marked Abroad
body: Media of different countries carried special write-ups and articles under such titles as "Comrade Kim Il Sung, the founder of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea" and "Great exploits of Comrade Kim Il Sung in state-building" to mark the 70th birthday of the DPRK. The Mozambican newspaper Noticias introduced in detail the nation-building feats and revolutionary career of President Kim Il Sung, carrying his smiling portrait. The German newspaper Rote Fahne said in an article illustrated with the portrait of smiling Kim Il Sung that the banner of socialism has invariably fluttered in Korea since the establishment of a socialist system as Korean-style socialism is one centred on the popular masses in which the Juche-oriented view and philosophy on the people are applied. The Belarusian newspaper Buperyod said in an article illustrated with photos of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un that the 70-year history of the DPRK is a proud history of struggle in which it has vigorously smashed the vicious moves of the imperialists under the leadership of the peerlessly great men. The website of the Kim Jong Il Library of Ecuador and a paper of Lebanon introduced the exploits of Kim Il Sung who set forth the idea and line for building an independent state and successfully implemented them. Online news of Jordan praised Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il for having founded and developed the DPRK and Kim Jong Un for steering the situation on the Korean peninsula with his prominent political ability. Rodong News Team

title: Works of Peerlessly Great Men Introduced in Russia
body: The Far East Regional Association for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism in Russia posted on its website President Kim Il Sung's work "Historical Experience of Building the Workers' Party of Korea", Chairman Kim Jong Il's work "The Workers' Party of Korea Organizes and Guides All the Victories of Our People" and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Concluding Speech at the March 2013 Plenary Meeting of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea" on September 28 on the occasion of the 73rd anniversary of the founding of the Workers' Party of Korea. The website carried photos of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: Japan’s Moves to Seize Tok Island
body: Recently, the Japanese government posted an inquiry report terming Tok Island a “part of the Japanese territory” on the website of the Cabinet Secretariat. This is just a manifestation of the sinister design of the Japanese ruling quarters hell-bent on the moves to seize the island. In January last a ceremony for opening an exhibition house for territorial sovereignty was given in the middle of Tokyo Metropolis to advertise Japan’s “dominium over Tok Island”. Paragraphs containing such claim were stipulated in such documents as a diplomatic blue book and a defense white paper. Not content with it, the Japanese regime posted such absurd and impudent words on its Cabinet Secretariat’s website. Tok Island is just a part of the inalienable territory of the Korean nation. Nevertheless, the Japanese reactionaries are insisting that the island is “a part of their territory”, touting “illegal occupation.” Their racket to seize others’ territory against historical truth and international principle has reached the height of wild greed and impudence. They are loudly talking about “dominium over Tok Island”, only to come under criticism by the international community. Lurking behind it is an ill-minded intention to justify their criminal moves for reinvasion, on which various countries are keeping their sharp eyes, by giving impression that there exists an “issue of territorial dispute” between the DPRK and Japan. The Japanese reactionaries’ distortion of history is just a prelude to their territorial expansion and overseas invasion. However, “dominium over Tok Island” touted by them is just a wild dream that can never come true. Japan’s desperate moves to grab the island will only harden the will of Korean nation to surely force the sworn enemy to pay dearly for the past crimes, out of towering hatred towards Japan. Ri Hyo Jin

title: DPRK Championships Open
body: The DPRK Championships opened with due ceremony at the Basketball Gymnasium in Chongchun Street on Wednesday. During the championships, competitions will be held in 470-odd categories of 37 events such as football, basketball, volleyball and judo, with attendance of more than 100 sports teams including the April 25 Sports Team, the Amnokgang Sports Team and the Pyongyang Sports Team. The championships will take place in ten cities and counties, including Pyongyang, Phyongsong and Sariwon, until Oct. 31. Present at the opening ceremony were Choe Hwi, vice-chairman of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the National Sports Guidance Committee, Ri Ryong Nam, vice-premier of the Cabinet, Kim Jang San, secretary general of the DPRK Football Association, officials concerned, sportspersons and Pyongyangites. At the end of the ceremony there was a men's basketball match between the April 25 Sports Team and the Amnokgang Sports Team. Rodong News Team

title: Foundation Day of Korea Marked
body: An event for celebrating the Foundation Day of Korea took place in front of the Mausoleum of King Tangun on Wednesday. Present there were Chairman of the Consultative Council for National Reconciliation Kim Yong Dae who is chairman of the C.C., Korean Social Democratic Party, Ri Kil Song and Kim Wan Su, presidium members of the Central Committee of the Democratic Front for the Reunification of Korea, officials concerned and working people in the city of Pyongyang and overseas compatriots. They performed an ancestral sacrifice for Tangun. Then Yun Jong Ho, vice-chairman of the Council for the Reunification of Tangun's Nation, in his commemorative report stressed that all the fellow countrymen should vigorously turn out in a nationwide advance for building a dignified and prosperous reunified powerful country, irrespective of difference in ideology, political view and religious belief. Rodong News Team

title: National Inter-Provincial Magic Contest
body: A national inter-provincial magic contest took place at the Anju Theatre amid great interests of magic experts and fans on Oct. 1. It brought together the South Phyongan Provincial Art Troupe, the South Hamgyong Provincial Art Troupe, the Ryanggang Provincial Art Squad, the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex and other units from across the country. Twenty-odd works of magic, appreciated at the preliminaries, were put on the stage. The contest, divided into the categories of expert and amateur, was held by way of estimating the styles of creation and technique of juggleries. The performers well represented the revolutionary spirit and optimistic life of the Korean people through unique forms and artistic tricks. Illusionary jugglery "Hot wind of sports", functional jugglery "Cards tricks", common jugglery "Lights of love" and others were highly appreciated. South Hamgyong Province took the first place. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK's Birthday Marked Abroad
body: Papers of different countries gave special write-ups and articles to the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. The Zimbabwean newspaper The Herald, the Zambian newspaper Top Rating and the South African newspaper Laudium Sun elaborated on the exploits of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il for the founding and development of the DPRK in articles under such titles as "On the occasion of the 70th founding anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea", illustrated with a photo of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. The Kuwaiti newspaper Times said in an article titled "People's country": Just as the name of the country implies, there are so many things that go by the name of "people" in the DPRK. This is the reflection of the firm stand of the DPRK to build socialist Korea into a genuine country for the people. The Bangladeshi paper The Daily Folk said in an article titled "70th founding anniversary of DPRK": The DPRK, the first people's democratic state in the East, was founded on Sept. 9, 1948. The DPRK has overcome continuous ordeals and difficulties for the last seven decades. Under the leadership of HE Kim Jong Un the DPRK will make a vigorous advance toward the brighter future. The Egyptian newspaper Al Ahrar told about the great leaders' exploits for national reunification and about the greatness of Kim Jong Un steering the situation on the Korean peninsula in articles under the title of "Defender of peace" and different subtitles. Rodong News Team

title: Bulletin Issued by Bulgarian Organization
body: The Bulgaria-Korea Friendship Association issued a bulletin as regards the historic north-south summit. The bulletin said: This year the three rounds of north-south summit took place on the Korean peninsula and a great progress has been made on the way toward the improvement of the north-south relations and reunification. All this is a shining fruition of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's bold decision and prominent political ability. Unimaginable successes have recently been achieved one after another thanks to the warm love for the nation and unshakable will for defending peace of Kim Jong Un who wants to build a prosperous reunified country with the concerted efforts of the whole nation and ensure peace and stability in the Korean peninsula and the region. The bulletin carried an account of the north-south summit in Pyongyang and the full text of the "September Pyongyang Joint Declaration" adopted at the summit. Rodong News Team

title: President Kim Il Sung's Work Introduced in Brazil
body: The Brazilian Center for the Study of Songun Politics posted on its website President Kim Il Sung's work "Let Us Further Strengthen the Socialist System of Our Country" on September 26. The work, made public on December 25, Juche 61 (1972), clarifies the struggle of the DPRK government for socialist revolution and socialist construction, the advantages of the Korean socialist system and the main contents of the Socialist Constitution of the DPRK and the tasks for steadily developing the socialist system. The website carried a photo of the President. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Foreign Ministry Delegation Leaves
body: A delegation of the DPRK Foreign Ministry led by Vice-Minister Choe Son Hui left here on Thursday to attend the DPRK-China negotiation in Beijing and the DPRK-Russia negotiation in Moscow as well as the DPRK-China-Russia negotiation. Rodong News Team

title: Overseas Compatriots Pay Tribute to Great Leaders
body: A delegation of the General Association of Koreans in China led by Vice-Chairman Cha Sang Bo and a delegation of the Japanese regional committee of the Overseas Side Committee for Implementing June 15 Joint Declaration headed by Chairman Son Hyong Gun visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill. Members of the delegations laid bouquets before the statues of the great leaders and bowed to them. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Delegation Returns from UNGA Session
