body: A delegation of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea led by Foreign Minister Ri Yong Ho came back home on Thursday after taking part in the 73rd session of the UN General Assembly. Rodong News Team

title: Symposium Exposes Massacre of Koreans by Japanese Imperialists
body: A symposium took place at the hall of Korean University under the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) on Sept. 22 on the lapse of 95 years since the Japanese imperialists brought death and suffering to innocent Koreans with the great earthquake in Kanto area as an occasion. Attending it sponsored by the Center for Korean Studies of the university were Korean residents and students in Japan and Japanese personages. First, a play was given to show the thrice-cursed atrocities committed by the Japanese imperialists against Koreans at the time of the great Kanto quake and suppression of Koreans in Japan that is still committed even after 95 years. A child of a compatriot who had witnessed the Japanese imperialists’ ruthless massacre of innocent Koreans at the time of the great Kanto quake made a speech. The speaker referred to the facts witnessed by his mother, saying that the Japanese government should acknowledge and apologize for the massacre of Koreans. The participants observed a moment's silence in memory of the victims. Speeches were made after reports titled "Probe into the truth behind the massacre of Koreans and theory of denying the massacre" and "Structure of the massacre and responsibility for a colonial rule". The reporters and speakers disclosed the massacre of Koreans committed by the Japanese imperialists at the time of the great Kanto quake and called for more thoroughly probing the truth behind the massacre. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Paralympic Committee Delegation Leaves
body: A delegation of the Paralympic Committee of the DPRK led by Kim Mun Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the Korean Federation for the Protection of the Disabled, left here on Thursday to attend the 3rd Asian Para Games due in Indonesia. Leaving earlier was a DPRK team of disabled players headed by Jong Hyon, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Korean Federation for the Protection of the Disabled. Rodong News Team

title: Foreigners Visit Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: A delegation of the People's Assembly of Syria headed by Vice-President Najdat Anzour and other foreigners visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on Thursday. They paid high tribute to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il at the palace. At the halls of immortality where the great leaders lie in state the visitors paid homage to them. They made rounds of the halls where the orders the great leaders received are on display and the halls that house cars, electric car, boat and train coaches used by them during their field guidance and foreign tours till the last moments of their lives. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korea: Conservative Forces Criticized
body: The south Korean online paper e-Daily on October 2 said that the conservative can not but ruin. Noting that the conservative forces have gone downhill to ruin from 2016, the paper said it is because they have been obsessed by power. Rodong News Team

title: AINDF Pyongyang Mission Chief Vows to Strive for
body: Implementation of Inter-Korean Declarations Pak Su Chol, chief of the Pyongyang Mission of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front (AINDF), issued a statement on Wednesday to mark the 11th anniversary of the historic October 4 declaration. The statement noted that Chairman Kim Jong Il provided a historic Pyongyang summit again in October 2007 to adopt and publish the October 4 declaration, an action programme for achieving peace of the country and prosperity common to the Korean nation by fully applying the June 15 joint declaration. It said that the great feats of Kim Jong Il, who opened up a bright prospect for realizing the cause of national independence and great unity, are being firmly defended and shedding brighter rays thanks to Chairman of the State Affairs Commission Kim Jong Un, who is ushering in a new era of the development of the south-north relations and national reunification. It pointed out that Kim Jong Un provided a sure guarantee for vigorously developing the south-north relations on a new high stage on the principle of national independence and self-determination, through the historic April and May Panmunjom summits and the September Pyongyang summit. The south-north summit and the announcement of the "September Pyongyang Joint Declaration", welcomed by the people at home and abroad and the whole world with emotion and excitement, are a precious fruition of Chairman Kim Jong Un's steadfast will for independent reunification, bold decision and ardent patriotism, it said. People from all walks of life in the south are now vigorously turning out in the struggle to implement the historic "September Pyongyang Joint Declaration", it noted. It stressed that the vanguard fighters of the AINDF and the patriotic people will put their heart and soul into the struggle to implement the April 27 Panmunjom Declaration and the "September Pyongyang Joint Declaration", programmes of independent reunification in the era of Kim Jong Un, with the confidence that the national reconciliation, prosperity and reunification will be brought earlier thanks to Kim Jong Un respected by all the fellow countrymen as a peerless patriot and great sage. Rodong News Team

title: Inter-Korean Summit Hailed in Sweden, Finland
body: Events took place in Sweden and Finland on Sept. 20 to welcome the historic inter-Korean summit. Speeches were made at the events attended by personages and masses of various strata. Giving impressions of the proud reality of the DPRK making a leap forward day by day under the direction of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un witnessed during his recent visit to it, the chief of the Swedish Group for the Study of the Juche Idea said: The talks between the leaders of the north and south of Korea held in Pyongyang are a historic occasion as they showed the world the will to achieve peace and prosperity of the Korean peninsula. We, together with the progressive peoples aspiring to the free and peaceful world, extend invariable support and solidarity to the Korean people in the struggle for reunifying their country by the united efforts of the nation. The chairman of the Finnish Communists' League and other speakers stressed that a bold decision made by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un resulted in a series of dramatic events on the Korean peninsula this year, expressing the belief that the Korean people would make greater success in the efforts for national reunification. Congratulatory messages to Kim Jong Un were adopted at the events. Rodong News Team

title: 13th Schoolchildren's Art Individual Contest
body: The 13th schoolchildren's art individual contest took place in the capital and local areas of the DPRK from August 25 to October 1. During the contest, schoolchildren selected at the schoolchildren's palaces and halls, primary schools, junior middle schools and senior middle schools in the field of general education across the country gave full play to their artistic abilities. Its closing ceremony took place at the Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace on Oct. 5. Rodong News Team

title: National Exhibition of IT Achievements by University Students Closes
body: The national exhibition of IT achievements made by university students closed with due ceremony at the Sci-Tech Complex on Friday. More than 830 inventions and IT products including "mobile combined thrasher" were highly appreciated at the exhibition. In the university standings Kim Chaek University of Technology took a special place, and Chongjin University of Mining and Metallurgy, O Jung Hup Chongjin University of Education No.1 and Kangson University of Industrial Technology took the first place. In provincial standings, Pyongyang City took a special place and North Hamgyong Province took the first place. Attending the closing ceremony were officials concerned and those of the youth league and university students. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Lao Party Leader
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), received a message of greeting from Bounnang Vorachith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party (LPRP), on Thursday. Extending the warm congratulations and wishes on behalf of the Central Committee and all the members of the LPRP and the Lao people to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, the Central Committee and all the members of the WPK and the fraternal people of the DPRK on the occasion of the 73rd founding anniversary of the WPK, the general secretary said in the message: We are very rejoiced over the fact that under the experienced and bold leadership of the WPK headed by President Kim Il Sung and Comrade Kim Jong Il, the great preceding leaders of the Korean people, and Comrade Kim Jong Un, successor to the revolutionary cause, the fraternal Korean people have achieved great successes in all fields and enjoyed a rich and happy life with the strengthened political stability, national defence and security work of the country and the steady development of the economy for the past 73 years. We are firmly convinced that the fraternal Korean people, under the tested and courageous guidance of the WPK, will continue to make great successes in national defence and all fields of building a powerful socialist country and realize the cause for peaceful reunification of the country with the tradition of the great army-people unity closely rallied around the Party Central Committee. The message wished Kim Jong Un good health and happiness and great successes in his noble cause, hoping that the traditional and comprehensive relations of friendship and cooperation between the two parties, governments and peoples of Laos and the DPRK would continue to strengthen. Rodong News Team

title: Congratulations to Kim Jong Un from Military Attaches Corps
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a floral basket and a congratulatory letter from the military attaches corps here ahead of the 73rd founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea. Alexei Bartusov, military attache of the Russian embassy who is doyen of the corps, handed over the floral basket and letter to Army General No Kwang Chol, minister of the People's Armed Forces, on Friday. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of South Side Arrives Here
body: A delegation of the south side arrived here on Thursday to take part in a meeting for national reunification marking the 11th anniversary of the publication of the October 4 Declaration, as the first step for implementing the historic "September Pyongyang Joint Declaration". The delegation is co-headed by Jo Myong Gyun, minister of Unification, Ri Hae Chan, chairman of the Minju Party who is managing director of the Roh Moo Hyun Foundation, Ri Chang Bok, permanent chairman of the South Side Committee for Implementing June 15 Joint Declaration, Won Hye Yong, a lawmaker, O Ko Don, mayor of Pusan City, and Ji Un Hui, former managing director of the Justice Solidarity for Settling the Issue of Sexual Slavery for the Imperial Japanese Army. That day an art performance was given at the Pyongyang Grand Theatre by artistes in Pyongyang City to welcome the delegations from the south and overseas visiting Pyongyang to take part in the national reunification meeting. After the performance, the Committee for the Peaceful Reunification of the Country hosted a reception for the delegations of the south and overseas sides at the People's Palace of Culture. Rodong News Team

title: "September Pyongyang Joint Declaration" Supported by Int'l Body
body: The Korean Friendship Association issued a statement on September 29 in support of the historic "September Pyongyang Joint Declaration", which said: The publication of the declaration is another progress made on the road to the reunification of the Korean Peninsula, and this gives great joy to the whole Korean nation as it shows the way for the joint development of the north and the south. It is natural that the Korean people work hard to realize peace and prosperity by their own efforts without any interference by outsiders. We are sure that the entire Korean nation in the north and the south will certainly build a reunified country by their concerted efforts. We will give wide publicity to the proposals advanced by President Kim Il Sung and HE Kim Jong Il for national reunification and the successes being made in the DPRK under the guidance of HE Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: 70th Birthday of DPRK Observed by Foreign Media
body: Foreign media gave special write-ups to the 70th founding anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. Pakistan's Daily Imroze carried an article illustrated with an art piece depicting President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il standing together and a photo of Kim Il Sung in praise of the exploits performed by the peerlessly great men in founding and developing the DPRK. The Myanmar newspaper The New Age and the Tanzanian newspaper Uhuru edited articles of such sub-titles as "Charisma of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un" and "The leader of the ever-changing situation in the Korean Peninsula" under headlines "Warm congratulations to the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK" and "The DPRK greeting its 70th founding anniversary". The papers carried photos of Kim Jong Un. The Uruguayan newspaper La Juventud conveyed in detail the greatness of Kim Jong Un who is steering the situation in the Korean Peninsula with his outstanding political ability. And it stressed that the DPRK possessed of powerful military muscle would certainly win the final victory while smashing all sorts of moves by the imperialists. The Guinean newspaper Horoya allocated one whole page to the sacred career of President Kim Il Sung who dedicated his all to the people, and the DR Congolese and Guinean TVs aired Korean films. Rodong News Team

title: President Kim Il Sung's Work Introduced in DR Congo
body: The National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of Democratic Congo posted on its website the full text of President Kim Il Sung's work "Let the North and the South Open the Way to Peace and the Reunification of the Country in a United Effort" on October 2 to mark the 11th anniversary of the October 4 Declaration. The work, published on Feb. 20, Juche 81 (1992), clarifies the idea that for the north and the south to achieve the peace and reunification of the country by their concerted efforts, it is important to adhere to the independent stand, take substantial steps for ensuring peace in the country and achieve the great national unity irrespective of difference in ideology and system. The website carried a photo of smiling Kim Il Sung. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korean Broadcasting Discloses Japan's Organized Sexual Slavery Crime
body: The south Korean CBS on October 2 disclosed data on the organized sexual slavery crime against the Korean women in Shanghai, China by the Imperial Japanese Army in the period of the Japanese imperialists. The broadcasting said the fact that the Imperial Japanese Army organizationally set up comfort stations with the police, businessmen and others in Shanghai and committed the sexual slavery crime in 1930s-1940s has recently been revealed in detail. It noted that the data on the crimes committed in the period are recently brought together by the experts. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of Syrian People's Assembly Visits Mangyongdae
body: The delegation of the People's Assembly of Syria led by Vice-President Najdat Anzour on Sunday visited Mangyongdae, birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. The visitors made rounds of historic relics, being briefed on the fact that Kim Il Sung was born in the patriotic family and grew up to be a revolutionary. They also toured the Tower of the Juche Idea, the Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace, the Munsu Rehabilitation Clinic, etc. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of South Side Leaves
body: A delegation of the south side left here on Saturday after taking part in a meeting for national reunification marking the 11th anniversary of the publication of the October 4 declaration held as the first step for implementing the historic "September Pyongyang Joint Declaration". The delegation was seen off at Pyongyang International Airport by Kim Yong Chol, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Ri Son Gwon, chairman of the Committee for the Peaceful Reunification of the Country, Pak Myong Chol, presidium member and director of the Secretariat of the Central Committee of the Democratic Front for the Reunification of Korea, Cha Hui Rim, chairman of the Pyongyang City People's Committee, An Tong Chun, vice-chairman of the Supreme People's Assembly, and officials concerned. Rodong News Team

title: Inter-Korean Summit Hailed by Foreign Political Parties, Organizations
body: Political parties and organizations of different countries issued statements in congratulation of the historic inter-Korean summit. Extending heartfelt congratulations to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un who made sure the inter-Korean summit was held again to reach a significant agreement for peace and prosperity on the Korean peninsula, the Lebanon Federation of Workers said: It is desire of the Korean nation and requirement of the world peace-loving peoples to terminate as early as possible the tragedy of the division that has lasted for more than 70 years. We wish the Workers' Party of Korea and the Korean people greater victory and prosperity. The Nigeria-Korea Friendship Association noted that the inter-Korean summit was held three times and the "September Pyongyang Joint Declaration" made public in the wake of the Panmunjom declaration this year. The events are a brilliant fruition borne by noble love for the nation, unshakable will for defending peace and broad magnanimity and great tolerance of HE Kim Jong Un who is determined to terminate the history of division and confrontation and open up a new era of peace and prosperity, the association said, expressing full support for the declaration. The Kuwait-DPRK Friendship Association said that the "September Pyongyang Joint Declaration" is an important milestone in comprehensively implementing the Panmunjom declaration in line with the unanimous desire and demand of the Korean nation to further accelerate the development of the north-south relations and usher in a new heyday of national reconciliation, unity, peace and prosperity. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Il's Exploits Praised by British Organizations
body: The British Association for the Study of Songun Policy, the British Group for the Study of the Juche Idea, the Korean Friendship Association UK and the British Solidarity Committee for Peace and Reunification of the Korean Peninsula issued a joint statement on October 1 ahead of the 21st anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's election as general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). The statement said that Kim Jong Il's election as general secretary of the WPK was a reflection of the unanimous will of the Korean people. It noted that he is a leader who enjoyed boundless trust and support from the people. It pointed out that he firmly defended socialism from the imperialists' maneuvers by pursuing the original Songun politics. It said rapid development was made in all fields and the Korean people enjoyed a happy life when he led the WPK. It noted that his great exploits were successfully carried forward by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and they became a solid foundation guaranteeing the future of Korea. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Meets U.S. Secretary of State
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Sunday received Mike Pompeo, secretary of State of the United States of America on a visit to the DPRK. Kim Jong Un, Supreme Leader of our party, state and army, warmly greeted Mike Pompeo and gladly exchanged greetings and had a photo taken with him at the Paekhwawon State Guesthouse. He warmly welcomed the U.S. secretary of State's visit to the DPRK and spoke highly of him, recalling how he worked energetically for the historic DPRK-U.S. summit and the development of relations between the two countries while visiting Pyongyang several times. Then he had a talk with the secretary of State. Kim Jong Un estimated that progress is being made in implementing the June 12 joint statement agreed upon at the first DPRK-U.S. summit talks. He expressed his gratitude to President Trump for making sincere effort to this end, asking Mike Pompeo to convey his regards to Trump. Together with Mike Pompeo, Kim Jong Un appreciated the positively developing situation on the Korean peninsula, explained in detail the proposals for solving the denuclearization issue and matters of concern of both sides and exchanged constructive opinions. There was an exchange of stands of the top leaderships of the two countries on the issues arising in holding the second DPRK-U.S. summit talks to be followed by an in-depth discussion of them. The Supreme Leader expressed his will and conviction that a great progress would surely be made in solving the issues of utmost concern of the world and in attaining the goal set forth at the last talks with the projected second DPRK-U.S. summit talks as an occasion. There was an agreement on the issue of holding the working negotiation for the second DPRK-U.S. summit talks as early as possible, and relevant procedure-related issues and ways were also discussed. Kim Jong Un expressed satisfaction over the productive and wonderful talks with Mike Pompeo at which mutual stands were fully understood and opinions exchanged. He hosted a luncheon at the Paekhwawon State Guesthouse where the U.S. delegation stays. Exchanged at the luncheon were views on issues of great interest such as further activating the communication and contact and visit between the two sides for the success of the DPRK-U.S. summit and the development of the DPRK-U.S. relations. Expressing the belief that the dialogue and negotiations between the DPRK and the U.S. based on the deep confidence between the top leaders of the two countries would continue to develop favorably in the future, too, and a good program for the 2nd DPRK-U.S. summit talks would be provided sooner or later, the Supreme Leader said good-bye to the U.S. secretary of State. Political News Team

title: DPRK-China Friendship Is Common Treasure of Two Peoples
body: It has been 69 years since the establishment of diplomatic ties at ambassadorial level between the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea and the People’s Republic of China. The establishment of diplomatic ties between the two countries served as an epochal occasion in developing the friendly relations between their peoples into a high level. Historically the Korean and Chinese peoples have deepened the feelings of friendship and strengthened ties in the course helping with each other in the struggle against the imperialist aggressors. President Kim Il Sung went through deadly crises together with Chinese revolutionaries in the days of the anti-Japanese war. The revolutionaries and peoples of the two countries further deepened the comradely obligation and friendship in a civil war in China after the defeat of the Japanese imperialists. The two armies and peoples of the DPRK and China fought in the same trench during the great Fatherland Liberation War. The DPRK-China friendship has developed down through generations without wavering in any trials and storms. The flower garden of DPRK-China friendship is now in full bloom under the deep care of the leaders of the two countries. The historic three visits to China by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in the year served as important occasions in dynamically promoting and advancing more vigorously the DPRK-China friendship, a strategic choice of the two parties and two countries. It is an unshakable stand of our Party and government to boost the traditional DPRK-China relations of friendship as required by the era. The Chinese party and government also attach importance to the friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries and have expressed their intention to make all efforts to creditably defend and develop them. The history of unbreakable DPRK-China friendship will as ever go on thanks to joint efforts of the two peoples. An Chol Gwon

title: DPRK-China Negotiation Held
body: Vice-Minister Choe Son Hui, who is heading a delegation of the DPRK Foreign Ministry on a visit to China, had a DPRK-China negotiation in Beijing on Oct. 5 with Kong Xuanyou, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs of China and concurrently special envoy of the Chinese government for the affairs of the Korean Peninsula. At the negotiation, both sides expressed the will to strive to develop the DPRK-China relations with long history and traditions into a higher stage, true to the intention of the top leaders of the two countries, and had an in-depth exchange of views on international issues of mutual concern including the present situation in the Korean peninsula which is positively developing thanks to the proactive efforts of the DPRK. Both sides agreed to further strengthen the communication and cooperation between the two countries. Rodong News Team

title: Stamp Exhibition Marks Anniversary of WPK
body: An intensive show of Korean stamps began at the Korean Stamp Exhibition House on Saturday in celebration of the 73rd anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). On display there are hundreds of kinds of stamps and bills under the subject of "Banner of Victory and Glory". They comprehensively show the history of the WPK which has advanced the revolution and construction for over seven decades since its foundation. Among them are "The Sun of the Nation", "Celebration of the 70th WPK Birthday" and other stamps depicting the revolutionary career and undying feats of President Kim Il Sung. They also include such stamps as "In Commemoration of the 50th Anniversary of the Great Leader Comrade Kim Jong Il's Start of Work at the Party Central Committee" reflecting the people's deep reverence for Chairman Kim Jong Il. "In Commemoration of 4th WPK Conference", "7th WPK Congress", and other stamps represent the personality of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un as a heaven-sent great man who is ushering in a new era of a great power on this land. Besides, there are stamps showing the heroic struggle of the Korean people. The show will last till Oct. 14. Rodong News Team

title: Officials of Int'l Bodies Pay Floral Tribute to Statues of Great Leaders
body: Staff members of UNICEF, UNFPA, FAO, WHO and WFP missions here visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on Monday on the occasion of the 73rd birthday of the Workers' Party of Korea. They laid floral baskets before the statues of the great leaders and made a bow to them. Rodong News Team

title: Dancing Party of Women Held
body: A dancing party of officials and members of the women's union took place in the plaza of the Monument to Party Founding on Monday in celebration of the 21st anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's election as general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and its 73rd founding anniversary. When the song "Glory to Our Great Party" was played, the women started dancing in humble reverence for Kim Jong Il. The playing of "Ongheya" and other songs revved up the festive mood of the event. The participants, with confidence in the rosy future of socialist Korea led by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, continued dancing, singing songs "I Will Live like a Star Following Party" and "Our Dear Marshal". Rodong News Team

title: Apple Show Held
body: An apple show took place at the Unjong Teahouse on Monday. Presented to the show, divided into two groups, were apples produced at the Taedonggang Combined Fruit Farm, the Kosan Combined Fruit Farm, fruit farms in Kwail and Pukchong counties, Onchon, Samchon and Myonggan fruit farms, Toksong Apple Farm and others fruit farms. At the show, sweet taste, sour taste, aroma and juice of apples of various kinds were appreciated at public examination. Rodong News Team

title: Congratulations to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Diplomatic Corps
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a floral basket and a congratulatory letter from the diplomatic corps here on the occasion of the 73rd founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea. The floral basket and letter were handed over to Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, on Monday by Ismail Ahmed Mohamed Hasan, Palestinian ambassador to the DPRK who is doyen of the corps. Rodong News Team

title: Floral Tribute to Statues of Great Leaders Paid
body: Servicepersons, working people, school youth and children laid floral baskets before the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on the 21st anniversary of Kim Jong Il's election as general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). Seen standing before the statues of the great leaders on Mansu Hill was a floral basket from Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Placed at the statues were floral baskets in the names of party, armed forces and power organs, social organizations, ministries, national institutions, units of the Korean People's Army and the Korean People's Internal Security Forces, and organs and industrial establishments at all levels in Pyongyang as well as bouquets and flowers. The visitors made a bow to the statues of the peerlessly great men. Floral baskets in the names of units of the KPA, organs and industrial establishments were laid before the statues of the great leaders in different parts of Pyongyang, including Kim Il Sung University, the Ministry of the People's Armed Forces, the Ministry of People's Security and the Mansudae Art Studio. Servicepersons, working people, school youth and children across the country paid respects to the statues of the great leaders and their smiling portraits in their residential quarters. Rodong News Team

title: Gift to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Syrian Figure
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a gift from Hammouda Sabbagh, president of the People's Assembly of Syria. The gift was conveyed to Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, on Monday by Najdat Anzour, vice-president of the People's Assembly of Syria who is heading its delegation on a visit to the DPRK. That day Kim Jong Un was presented with a gift by Najdat Anzour. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Yong Nam Meets Syrian Delegation
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, Monday met and had a talk with the delegation of the People's Assembly of Syria led by Vice-President Najdat Anzour that paid a courtesy call on him at the Mansudae Assembly Hall. Rodong News Team

title: Floral Basket to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Palestinian President
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a floral basket from Mahmoud Abbas, president of the State of Palestine, on the occasion of the 73rd founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea. The floral basket was conveyed to Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, by Ismail Ahmed Mohamed Hasan, Palestinian ambassador to the DPRK, on Monday. Rodong News Team

title: Shameless Sophism of Militaristic Maniacs
body: The Japanese reactionaries insisted on making a warship of the Japan Maritime “Self-Defense Force,” flying “the flag of rising sun shedding rays”, take part in the naval review on Jeju Island, which sparked off bitter condemnation and outrage at home and abroad. Japanese reactionaries including the Defense Minister Onodera clamored about “a symbol of sovereignty” and “a non-commonsensible and rude act” over the issue of opposing the flag-hoisting. And they claimed that they could not accept it. Such act of the Japanese reactionaries is an intolerable insult and mockery of the Korean nation and the international community. Lurking behind such act is an arrogant intention to demonstrate before the international community that Japan is a state which can go to war and that it never gives up the old dream of “the Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere”. The reality shows that it is a matter of time for the Japan “Self-defense Forces” to start a war for invasion of the Korean peninsula and other Asian nations in an attempt to realize the old dream under the flag. Whether Japan participates in the naval review or not, the black-hearted intention of the militaristic maniacs to reinvade the Korean peninsula and other Asian nations will remain unchangeable. Sim Chol Yong

title: Floral Basket to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Lao Party Leader
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a floral basket from Bounnang Vorachith, president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic who is general secretary of the C.C., Lao People's Revolutionary Party, ahead of the 73rd founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). The floral basket was handed over to Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the WPK, on Tuesday by Phonekham Inthaboualy, Lao ambassador to the DPRK. Rodong News Team

title: Vice-Chairman of C.C., WPK Meets Lao Ambassador
body: Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, had a talk with Phonekham Inthaboualy, Lao ambassador to the DPRK, who paid a farewell call on him on Tuesday. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Ugandan President
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the DPRK Supreme People's Assembly, on Tuesday sent a message of greeting to Yoweri Kaguta Museveni, president of the Republic of Uganda, on the occasion of the 56th anniversary of its independence. Kim in the message wished the Ugandan people success in the work for achieving the stability and socio-economic development of the country under the correct leadership of the president, expressing satisfaction over the steady development of the long-standing relations of friendship and cooperation between the two countries. Rodong News Team

title: Reception Given for Chinese Sports Delegation
body: The DPRK Ministry of Physical Culture and Sports on Monday hosted a reception in honor of a Chinese sports delegation on a goodwill visit to the DPRK. Invited to the reception were the Chinese sports delegation led by Gou Zhongwen, minister of the General Administration of Sports, Li Jinjun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK, and staff members of his embassy. Present there were Kim Il Guk, minister of Physical Culture and Sports, Ri Chang Gun, vice department director of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea, officials concerned and sportspersons. Speeches were made at the reception. Rodong News Team

title: Chinese Sports Delegation Here
body: A sports delegation of the People's Republic of China headed by Gou Zhongwen, minister of the General Administration of Sports, arrived here on Monday to pay a goodwill visit to the DPRK at the invitation of the DPRK Ministry of Physical Culture and Sports. The delegation consists of man and woman basketball teams headed by Yao Ming, president of the Chinese Basketball Association. It was greeted at Pyongyang International Airport by Kim Il Guk, minister of Physical Culture and Sports, Ri Chang Gun, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials concerned and Li Jinjun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK, and staff members of his embassy. DPRK sportspersons warmly welcomed the sports missions of the Chinese people, presenting bouquets to leading members of the delegation. The goodwill visit to the DPRK by the Chinese sports delegation at a time when the DPRK-China friendly relations are developing on a new high stage will contribute to strengthening exchange and cooperation in the sports field of the two countries and deepening fraternal friendship between the peoples of the DPRK and China. Rodong News Team

title: Important Anniversaries of DPRK Marked Abroad
body: Seminars took place in Russia, Belarus, DR Congo, Uganda and Nigeria from September 26 to October 1 to mark the 21st anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's election as general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), the 73rd birthday of the WPK and the 92nd formation anniversary of the Down-with-Imperialism Union (DIU). The first secretary of the C.C., Communist Party of the Soviet Union said that the WPK founded by President Kim Il Sung is a guiding force which has led the Korean people only to the road of glory. The first secretary went on: The history of the WPK is a history of shining victory in which it has reliably defended the dignity and sovereignty of the country and the nation despite manifold difficulties and trials. The WPK is vigorously speeding up the socialist construction despite the imperialists' continuous moves to isolate and stifle the DPRK. Its experience is a precious example to be followed by the world progressive political parties. The secretary of the C.C., All-Union Communist Party of Bolsheviks who is chairman of the Belarus Association for the Study of Juche Idea said that Kim Il Sung developed the WPK into an invincible revolutionary party. The deputy general secretary of the C.C., Communist Party of DR Congo stressed that the WPK would always emerge victorious as it has Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un as its chairman. Speakers at a seminar in Uganda said that the present development of the WPK would have been unthinkable without the energetic leadership of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. A congratulatory message to Kim Jong Un was adopted at the seminar in Belarus. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Praised in Switzerland
body: Leader Kim Jong Il will always be alive in the hearts of the Korean people. The Swiss Organizing Committee for the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu, Switzerland-Korea Committee and the Swiss Group for the Study of the Juche Idea stressed this in a joint statement on October 2 to mark the 21st anniversary of his election as general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). Chairman Kim Jong Il's election as general secretary of the WPK is a token of the Korean people's boundless trust in him, the statement said. He carried forward the idea and line of President Kim Il Sung in all fields of party and state activities without an inch of deflection, it noted. He formulated the Songun politics into the main political mode under socialism and steadily consolidated the DPRK as an invincible socialist fortress, it pointed out. He also provided two north-south summits and made sure that the June 15 North-South Joint Declaration and the October 4 declaration were adopted to open up a radical phase for Korea's reunification, it said. We extend everlasting glory to Kim Jong Il, the eternal head of the Workers' Party of Korea, it noted. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Work Introduced by German Organization
body: The Anti-Imperialist Forum of Germany posted on its website Chairman Kim Jong Il's work "Giving Priority to Ideological Work Is Essential for Accomplishing Socialism" on October 3 to mark the 21st anniversary of his election as general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and the 73rd birthday of the WPK. The work, published on June 19, Juche 84 (1995), elucidates the ideas that one should hold fast to the ideological work and give priority to it to successfully accomplish the socialist cause and that the main task to be carried out in the ideological work is to model the whole society on the socialist idea and the ideological work should be conducted on the principle and way suited to the intrinsic requirements of socialism. Rodong News Team

title: Dancing Parties of Youth and Students
body: Dancing parties of youth and students were held across the country on Wednesday, the 73rd founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea. Amid the playing of song "It Is October", dancing parties began in different parts of Pyongyang, including plazas of the Arch of Triumph and the Pyongyang Indoor Stadium. The venues of dancing parties were overflowing with deep reverence for President Kim Il Sung, who pioneered the building of a revolutionary party of Juche type and turned the WPK into a dignified and invincible party and a motherly party. The participants unrolled waves of dancing to the tune of such songs as "Our General Is the Best" and "Do Prosper, Era of the Workers' Party", paying the highest glory and deep thanks to Chairman Kim Jong Il, who glorified the WPK as a glorious party of Kim Il Sung and demonstrated to the whole world the dignity and prestige of socialist Korea. Heard there were also such songs as "Young People, Be Loyal to Our Party" and "Song of Socialist Advance" representing the revolutionary stamina and optimism of the Korean youths who are upholding the guidance of the WPK with loyalty. "Cheers of the People" and other songs reflecting the people's high pride of holding Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in high esteem loudly rang out. On the same day, cheerful dancing parties took place in all provincial seats, too. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Yong Nam Meets Lao Ambassador
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, had a talk with Phonekham Inthaboualy, outgoing Lao ambassador to the DPRK, at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Thursday. Rodong News Team

title: Russians Visit Mangyongdae
body: Representatives of the Russian Foreign Ministry to the Far Eastern Region, including Evgeny Volosastov, acting representative to Vladivostok, visited Mangyongdae, birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. Being briefed on the personality of Kim Il Sung as a great man and patriotic family members of Mangyongdae, they looked round historical relics at the old home. The guests also toured the Tower of the Juche Idea and Pyongyang Teacher Training College. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Ambassador to Cuba Appointed
body: Ma Chol Su was appointed as DPRK ambassador to Cuba, according to a decree of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK. Rodong News Team

title: SPA Delegation Leaves for Switzerland
body: A delegation of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK led by Deputy Ri Jong Hyok, director of the National Reunification Institute, left here on Thursday to take part in the 139th Conference of the Inter-Parliamentary Union to be held in Geneva, Switzerland. Rodong News Team

title: Foreigners Visit Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: A delegation of the Organization for the Study of the Juche Idea of Thailand led by Chairman Songchit Pullarp and other foreign guests visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on Thursday. They paid tribute to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il at the palace. At the halls of immortality where the great leaders lie in state the visitors paid homage to them. They made rounds of the halls where the orders the great leaders received are on display and the halls that house cars, electric car, boat and train coaches used by them during their field guidance and foreign tours till the last moments of their lives. Rodong News Team

title: Overseas Compatriots Delegations Leave
body: Overseas compatriots' delegations left here on Thursday after taking part in the meeting for national reunification marking the 11th anniversary of the publication of the October 4 declaration. They are a delegation of the Japanese regional committee of the Overseas Side Committee for Implementing June 15 Joint Declaration headed by Chairman Son Hyong Gun and a delegation of the Canadian regional committee of the Overseas Side Committee for Implementing June 15 Joint Declaration led by Chairman Jong Hak Phil. Leaving earlier were a delegation of the General Association of Koreans in China headed by Vice-Chairman Cha Sang Bo and a delegation of the European regional committee of the Overseas Side Committee for Implementing June 15 Joint Declaration led by Permanent Representative Son Kyong Sok. Rodong News Team

title: Theatre of Samjiyon Orchestra Opens to Public
body: Theatre of the Samjiyon Orchestra was opened to public on the occasion of the 73rd founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea. The magnificent theatre on the bank of the River Pothong is a world-class live sound theatre with all conditions for art creation and performance and view. Its inaugural ceremony took place on Wednesday. Present there were Pak Kwang Ho, member of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, Pak Chun Nam, minister of Culture, An Tong Chun, chairman of the C.C., General Federation of the Unions of Art and Literature of Korea (GFUALK), Ma Won Chun, department director of the State Affairs Commission, members of the Party Central Committee, executive members of the C.C., GFUALK, officials, creators and artistes of the Samjiyon Orchestra, employees of the theatre, and officers and men of the Korean People's Army unit which took part in the construction of the theatre, teachers and researchers of Pyongyang University of Architecture and creators and artistes in the field of arts. Pak Kwang Ho made an opening address to be followed by speeches. At the end of the ceremony the officials and artistes of the Samjiyon Orchestra and employees of the theatre entered the theatre. The participants made round of the theatre. They were briefed on the live sound theatre before listening to the rendition by the Samjiyon Orchestra. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK-China-Russia Negotiations Held
body: Choe Son Hui, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs of the DPRK visiting Russia at the head of the delegation of the DPRK Foreign Ministry, held three-party negotiations in Moscow on Tuesday with Kong Xuanyou, vice foreign minister of the People's Republic of China and special envoy of the Chinese government for the affairs of the Korean peninsula, and Igor Morgulov, vice foreign minister of the Russian Federation. They spoke highly of the efforts exerted by the DPRK for peace and stability on the Korean peninsula and reached a consensus of views on the importance of taking corresponding measures to ensure the continuance of the present positive trend concerning the situation on the Korean peninsula. They agreed to continue to strengthen communication and cooperation for a lasting and durable peace mechanism on the Korean peninsula and for the rational settlement of all issues of mutual concern. A joint press release was made public. Rodong News Team

title: Reception Given for Chinese Sports Delegation
body: The National Sports Guidance Committee of the DPRK arranged a reception on general-service ship Mujigae on Wednesday for the sports delegation of the People's Republic of China on a goodwill visit to the DPRK. Present there on invitation were the sports delegation of China led by Gou Zhongwen, minister of the General Administration of Sports, Li Jinjun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK, and his embassy officials. Present there were Choe Hwi, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the National Sports Guidance Committee, Kim Il Guk, minister of the Physical Culture and Sports, Ri Chang Gun and An Hong Chol, vice department directors of the Central Committee of the WPK, officials concerned, and sportspersons. Choe Hwi made a speech at the reception. The visit to the DPRK by the sports missions of China at a significant time when the Korean people are celebrating the 73rd anniversary of the WPK would contribute to further heightening the atmosphere of the DPRK-China relations and deepening the bonds of friendship and solidarity between the peoples of the two countries, he said. He hoped the fraternal Chinese people would certainly realize the dream of China called prosperity of China and Chinese sportspersons would make active contribute to it with the wonderful results of games under the guidance of the Communist Party of China with General Secretary Xi Jinping at the core. Gou Zhongwen made a speech next. He said that the party and people of the DPRK united in single mind around Chairman Kim Jong Un are vigorously advancing the cause of socialism, extending congratulations to the Korean people on the 73rd anniversary of the founding of the WPK. Korean sportspersons demonstrated the great mentality of the Korean people with great achievements at the recent international games, he said, stressing that strengthening of sports exchange and collaboration would contribute to spurring the development of bilateral friendly relations. Rodong News Team

title: Russian Ambassador to DPRK Hosts Reception
body: Alexandr Matsegora, Russian ambassador to the DPRK, gave a reception at the Taedonggang Diplomatic Club on Friday to mark the 70th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the DPRK and the Russian Federation. Present there on invitation were Ri Yong Ho, foreign minister; Han Man Hyok, vice department director of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea; Army Col. General Kim Hyong Ryong, vice-minister of the People's Armed Forces; Ri Kwang Gun, vice-minister of External Economic Relations; So Ho Won, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries and chairman of the DPRK-Russia Friendship Association; Mun Jae Chol, vice general director of the General Bureau for Affairs with Diplomatic Corps; and officials concerned. Staff members of the Russian embassy were on hand. Alexandr Matsegora said in his speech at the reception that important visits between the Russian Federation and the DPRK took place this year marking the 70th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic ties between the two countries and this demonstrated the invariable will to strengthen the bilateral relations and cooperation in the international arena. It is one of the most important policies of the Russian government to develop the friendly and cooperative relations with the DPRK, he noted. Ri Yong Ho in his speech said that he is pleased to commemorate meaningfully the 70th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic ties between the DPRK and the Russian Federation together with the Russian friends, and mentioned the immortal feats the great leaders performed for the development of the DPRK-Russia friendly relations. He expressed the belief that the friendly and cooperative ties between the DPRK and Russia would comprehensively develop in all fields including politics, economy and culture with the 70-year history as a foundation. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of Koreans in Japan Here
body: A delegation of the Association of Koreans in Japan for Peaceful Reunification led by Chairman Ri Tong Je arrived here on Friday. Rodong News Team

title: Russian Guests Leave
body: Representatives of the Russian Foreign Ministry to the Far Eastern Region, including Evgeny Volosastov, acting representative to Vladivostok, left here for home on Friday. Rodong News Team

title: Koreans in Japan Visit Statues of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: A delegation of the Association of Koreans in Japan for Peaceful Reunification paid a floral tribute to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on Friday. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Palestinian President
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a message of greeting from Mahmoud Abbas, president of the State of Palestine, on Oct. 10. Extending heartfelt and warm congratulations on behalf of the president, the State of Palestine and its people to Kim Jong Un and to the friendly Korean people and the struggling leadership and members of the Workers' Party of Korea on its founding anniversary, the message said: We take this opportunity to wish Your Excellency and your country and people greater progress and prosperity. We value the historic friendly ties between the two countries and peoples and appreciate your solidarity and support to our people's struggle for achieving fair peace by putting an end to the occupation and establishing an independent state with East Kuds, a city of reconciliation, co-existence and peace, as its capital. We wish Your Excellency good health, happiness and success. Rodong News Team

title: Thai Delegation's Sojourn in Pyongyang
body: A delegation of the Organization for the Study of the Juche Idea of Thailand led by Chairman Songchit Pullarp visited the Monument to Party Founding. It looked round the monument, being told about the history and revolutionary tradition of the Workers' Party of Korea. The delegation was also guided to Pyongyang Teacher Training College, the Ryuwon Footwear Factory, etc. Rodong News Team

title: Joint Game of Men Basketball Players of DPRK, PRC Held
body: There was a joint game of men basketball players of the sports delegation of China on a goodwill visit to the DPRK and men basketball players of the DPRK at the Ryugyong Jong Ju Yong Indoor Stadium on Thursday. Watching the game were Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the WPK Central Committee, Ri Su Yong, An Jong Su, Ri Yong Ho, Ro Tu Chol, Choe Hwi and other party and government officials and officials concerned. Also among the spectators were the sports delegation of the People's Republic of China led by Gou Zhongwen, minister of the General Administration of Sports, Li Jinjun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK, and his embassy officials and Chinese guests. The players of the two countries entered the playground. In their speeches, Minister of Physical Culture and Sports Kim Il Guk and Minister of the General Administration of Sports Gou Zhongwen expressed the expectation that the significant game would contribute to exchanging good techniques and experience between the sportspersons of the two countries and to demonstrating the bonds of DPRK-China friendship. Men basketball players of the two countries held a joint game, divided into Friendship Team and Solidarity Team. The game ended draw. Choe Ryong Hae and other party and government officials, leading members of the sports delegation of China and the Chinese ambassador met those players who performed well and congratulated them. The sportspersons of the two countries had a photo taken together in a joy of their exchanging diverse basketball technique and experience. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Russian President
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received greetings from Russian President V. Putin on Oct. 12. The message extended heartfelt greetings on the occasion of the 70th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic ties between the two countries. For the past decades the Russian Federation and the DPRK have accumulated lots of experience in the course of constructive cooperation in various fields, the message said. The message expressed the conviction that they would further strengthen all the reciprocal relations including the three-party program with the south Korean colleagues based on the achievements that have already been made. This, without doubt, complies with the interests of the peoples of the two countries and will contribute to strengthening security and stability on the Korean peninsula and overall Northeast Asia, the message noted. It wholeheartedly wished Kim Jong Un good health and success and all the citizens of the DPRK happiness and welfare. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Greetings to Russian President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a message of greeting to Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation, on Oct. 12. The message extended warm congratulations to the president and the friendly people of the Russian Federation on the occasion of the 70th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the DPRK and Russia. The message said that the DPRK-Russia friendly and cooperative relations provided by the preceding leaders have developed continuously on the principle of mutual respect, good neighborliness and mutual benefits, and this tradition has invariably been carried on in the new century. Expressing belief that the strategic and traditional DPRK-Russia friendly relations with 70-year-long history would continue to develop steadily and constructively in conformity with the requirements of the new era and the interests of the peoples of the two countries, the message sincerely wished the Russian president success in his responsible work for building powerful Russia and realizing international justice and the people of Russia well-being and prosperity. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korean Students Launch Anti-U.S. Campaign
body: University students of south Korea held a ceremony of forming an organization "Anti-U.S. fighters, university students, for the independence of this land" in Seoul on Oct. 10, according to the south Korean online paper Jaju Sibo. At the ceremony speakers denounced the U.S. for hurling a stream of anachronistic remarks at a time when the people all over the world are welcoming the peace climate prevailing in the Korean peninsula. They noted that they could not suppress their anger at the moves of the U.S. to keep the south and the north from solving the issue of the Korean peninsula and moving toward peace. At the end of the ceremony the students held a photo exhibition for citizens, through which they exposed the crimes of GIs in south Korea, and distributed pamphlets calling for the withdrawal of the U.S. forces from south Korea. Rodong News Team

title: Great Party Which Has Made Distinguished Contributions to Socialist Cause
body: The Workers’ Party of Korea has made a long drive along its orbit without any slightest mistake or deviation in implementing its line despite stern and complicated turns and twists of history for more than seven decades and led the human cause of independence, the socialist cause, to brilliant victory. The WPK saved the socialist movement from the crisis at the end of the last century when the world socialist movement underwent a serious setback, and has dynamically propelled its victorious advance. It provided many communist and workers’ parties and other progressive political parties with the guidelines for their joint struggle. Thus, it has inspiringly encouraged the revolutionary people in their struggle for rebuilding socialism. The WPK has demonstrated its dignity as a party which made a special contribution to the accomplishment of the socialist cause and as a party with absolute prestige, thanks to the outstanding guidance of the great leaders. The human cause of independence, the socialist cause, could overcome the crisis and dynamically advance along its orbit as President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il brightly illuminated the road ahead of the socialist movement and provided the world revolutionary parties with the guidance for their joint struggle. Today the WPK is displaying its might as the dignified party as it is guided by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, another peerlessly great man. Ri Hak Nam

title: Korean People Will Always Live Their Own Way
body: The slogan “Let us live our own way!” is a great strategic slogan which should be firmly held aloft until the accomplishment of the historic cause of modelling the whole society on Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism. The slogan reflects the resolute working spirit to carve out one’s destiny with recourse to one’s own strength, technology and resources. The Korean people, giving the fullest play to their mental power of national self-existence and single-minded unity under this slogan, opened up a heyday in the era of the Workers’ Party, turned the arduous march into the one for building a land of bliss and brought about a series of epochal events of great significance in the history of the nation. If they fail to have the spirit of self-reliance, the great Mallima era when everything changes rapidly and the dignity of the DPRK standing in the center of the world politics are unthinkable. In recent years the Korean people successfully concluded the 70-day campaign and 200-day campaign, which were followed by a continuous offensive. They thus gained the strongest national defence muscle and made a big stride in attaining the goals of the 5-year strategy for national economic development. All these world-startling victories and successes are ascribable to the Korean people’s patriotic devotion and revolutionary spirit of self-reliance. The Korean people will pave a broad avenue toward the country’s prosperity in the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance and fortitude under the uplifted slogan “Let us live our own way!” Kim Pyong Jin

title: Head of DPRK Government Delegation Meets President of Equatorial Guinea
body: Vice-Premier Ri Ryong Nam, head of the DPRK government delegation, on a visit to Equatorial Guinea to take part in the celebrations of the 50th anniversary of its independence met and had a talk with Obiang Nguema Mbasogo, president of the Republic of Equatorial Guinea, at the presidential palace on Thursday. The president warmly welcomed the visit of the DPRK government delegation to his country, saying that the visit serves as an important occasion in developing the friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries with a long historic tradition. Present there were members of the DPRK government delegation, Tong Chol Ho, DPRK ambassador to Equatorial Guinea, and Simeon Oyono Esono Angue, minister of Foreign Affairs and Cooperation of Equatorial Guinea. Rodong News Team

title: S. Koreans Urge Japan to Make Apology for Sexual Slavery
body: There took place a rally demanding a proper settlement of the issue of sexual slavery for the imperial Japanese army in Seoul of south Korea on Wednesday, according to Yonhap News of south Korea. Speakers there blamed the former regime for establishing the "reconciliation and recovery foundation" with a billion yen paid by Japan under the "agreement" on the issue of sexual slavery in 2015 against the will of its victims. They urged the present regime to return the fund at an early date and work hard to let Japan make an apology for sexual slavery. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Information Committee Delegation Leaves to Visit Foreign Countries
body: A delegation of the DPRK Information Committee led by Vice-Chairman Jo Yong Sam left Pyongyang on Saturday to visit Britain, France and Hong Kong of China. Rodong News Team

title: Chinese Sports Delegation Leaves
body: The sports delegation of China led by Gou Zhongwen, minister of the General Administration of Sports, left Pyongyang for home on Friday after paying a goodwill visit to the DPRK at the invitation of the DPRK Ministry of Physical Culture and Sports. Rodong News Team

title: Chinese Sports Delegation Visits Kim Il Sung University
body: The sports delegation of China led by Gou Zhongwen, minister of the General Administration of Sports, visited Kim Il Sung University on Friday. Teachers and students of the university warmly greeted the guests, presenting bouquets to them. Being told about the university which plays a key role in training national cadres and developing the country's science and technology, the visitors saw round its e-library and swimming pool. They also had a mixed basketball game with players of the university, deepening friendship. Earlier, the delegation toured the Basketball Gymnasium in Chongchun Street. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Yong Nam Meets Leading Members of Chinese Sports Delegation
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, met leading members of the Chinese sports delegation on a goodwill visit to the DPRK at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Friday. He had a friendly talk with Gou Zhongwen, minister of the General Administration of Sports of China, Wang Yajun, deputy head of the International Liaison Department of the C.C., Communist Party of China, Li Yingchuan, vice-minister of the General Administration of Sports, and Yao Ming, president of the Chinese Basketball Association, who paid a courtesy call on him. The visit of the Chinese sports delegation contributed to strengthening the exchange in sports and deepening the friendship between the peoples of the two countries, Kim Yong Nam said, stressing the need to expand the DPRK-China friendly and cooperative relations in the future. Gou Zhongwen said that the future of socialist Korea is bright and it will make great progress in sports thanks to the wise leadership of Chairman Kim Jong Un. And he expressed the will to strive for brisk promotion of exchange between the two countries in sports. Present there were Kim Il Guk, minister of the Physical Culture and Sports, Ri Chang Gun, vice department director of the Central Committee of the WPK, officials concerned, Li Jinjun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK, and members of the delegation. Rodong News Team

title: Socialism Is Far Superior to Capitalism
body: Socialism is the most progressive idea reflecting the intrinsic demands of man, and the socialist system is the most advanced one enabling the popular masses to enjoy an independent and creative life to the full. It is the capitalist system, not the socialist system, that suppresses the social development and the independence and creativity of the popular masses, and it is hard to provide the people with an independent and creative worthwhile life in capitalist society where the working masses are regarded as the slaves of capital. Such practice as the rich getting ever richer and the poor getting ever poorer is a malignant tumor of capitalist society, and capitalism is a reactionary society which degenerate people. Capitalist society, plagued by all sorts of social evils based on the jungle law, is a rotten and ailing society on the deathbed without future. The sound and lively society enlivened with creative life of people, society which promotes social development and steadily advances toward the future, is socialism. It is only under the socialist system that people can enjoy a sound material life, rich ideological and cultured life and independent political life. It was proven in history that socialism has great advantages incomparable over capitalism. Deliberately shunning this and distorting the truth and slandering socialism is no more than a foolish farce of those keen on reversing the flow of history. It is an immutable law of history development that things new are bound to win and things old are bound to ruin. However hard the imperialists may slander socialism, they can never stop humankind from advancing toward socialism. Ri Hak Nam

title: Head of DPRK Government Delegation Meets President of Cape Verde
body: Vice-Premier Ri Ryong Nam, who is attending the celebrations of the 50th anniversary of the independence of Equatorial Guinea as head of the DPRK government delegation, met with Jorge Carlos Fonseca, president of the Republic of Cape Verde, on Oct. 12. Rodong News Team

title: Ri Ryong Nam Meets PM of Republic of Equatorial Guinea
body: Vice-Premier Ri Ryong Nam, who is attending the celebrations of the 50th anniversary of the independence of Equatorial Guinea as head of the DPRK government delegation, met and had a talk with Francisco Pascual Obama Asue, prime minister of the Republic of Equatorial Guinea, on October 13. On hand were members of the DPRK government delegation, Tong Chol Ho, DPRK ambassador to Equatorial Guinea, and the adviser to the prime minister of Equatorial Guinea. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Foreign Ministry Hosts Reception
body: The DPRK Foreign Ministry hosted a reception on Monday to mark the 70th anniversary of establishment of diplomatic ties between the DPRK and Mongolia. Invited to the reception were Sukhbat Sodnomtsog, Mongolian charge d'affaires ad interim, and staff members of his embassy to Pyongyang. Present there were Vice-Foreign Minister Ri Kil Song and officials of the Foreign Ministry. Rodong News Team

title: Gift to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a gift from Obiang Nguema Mbasogo, president of the Republic of Equatorial Guinea. It was conveyed to Vice-Premier Ri Ryong Nam, who is attending the celebrations of the 50th anniversary of the independence of Equatorial Guinea as head of the DPRK government delegation, by an official of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Cooperation of Equatorial Guinea on October 13. Rodong News Team

title: Thai Guests Leave
body: A delegation of the Organization for the Study of the Juche Idea of Thailand led by Chairman Songchit Pullarp left Pyongyang for home on Monday. Rodong News Team

title: Koreans in Japan Visit Mangyongdae
body: A delegation of the Association of Koreans in Japan for Peaceful Reunification led by Chairman Ri Tong Je visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. Members of the delegation looked round the historical relics, being briefed on the revolutionary career of the President. The head of the delegation said he was so excited at the memory of the patriotic life of President Kim Il Sung, visiting Mangyongdae, the sacred place of revolution, and that they would hold Marshal Kim Jong Un in high esteem as the lodestar of reunification and fulfill their responsibility and role in achieving the country's reunification, the cherished desire of the nation. The delegation also toured Mirae Scientists Street, Panmunjom, etc. Rodong News Team

title: Polish Foreign Ministry Delegation Arrives
body: A delegation of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Poland led by Pawel Milewski, director of the Asia-Pacific Department, arrived in Pyongyang on Monday. Rodong News Team

title: Russian Delegation Arrives
body: A delegation of the Russian Foundation for Basic Research led by President Vladislav Panchenko arrived in Pyongyang on Monday. Rodong News Team

title: Historic Milestone for Prosperity Common to Nation
body: The “September Pyongyang Joint Declaration” is a historic milestone for prosperity common to the nation. The “September Pyongyang Joint Declaration” is a declaration of common prosperity for a balanced development of the national economy through more brisk exchange and cooperation between the north and the south based on the principles of reciprocity and common interests and prosperity. It is a realistic peace declaration to make this land a permanent and solid peace area by thoroughly terminating the danger of war and the hostile relations on the Korean peninsula. It is quite natural that not only the Koreans in the north, the south and abroad but also the international community are fervently supporting and welcoming the historic “September Pyongyang Joint Declaration”. No matter how desperately a handful of traitors work to stem the trend of times, they can never play down the significance of the Panmunjom declaration and the “September Pyongyang Joint Declaration” which are being supported and approved by the whole Korean nation and check the desire and will of the people from all walks of life in south Korea to thoroughly implement the declarations and open up a new era of independent reunification, peace and prosperity. The Panmunjom declaration and the “September Pyongyang Joint Declaration” are the milestones common to the nation reflecting the aspiration and wishes of all the compatriots to bring a bright future of the nation. The north and the south of Korea should be masters in implementing the Panmunjom declaration and the “September Pyongyang Joint Declaration” to write a new history of reconciliation and prosperity of the nation. Sim Chol Yong

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Off Press in Bulgaria
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "The Cause of the Great Party of Comrades Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il Is Ever-Victorious" was published in booklet with due ceremony at the Zaraba Publishing House of Bulgaria on Oct. 2 ahead of the 73rd founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea. The work, published on Oct. 4, Juche 104 (2015), clarifies the idea that the 70-year-long history of the Workers' Party of Korea is a history of victory in which the validity and invincibility of the cause of the Party of Comrades Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il have been displayed and that the cause of the Party is invincible. Rodong News Team

title: WPK's Birthday Observed by Foreigners
body: Personages of Lebanon and Malta made public statements to mark the 73rd founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). Samir Diyab, chief of the Lebanese Group for the Study of the Juche Idea, in a statement on Oct. 7 noted that for the past over 70 years since its foundation, the WPK has wisely led the Korean people's struggle for defending their country's sovereignty and nation's dignity and building a prosperous state. He pointed out that HE Kim Jong Il, the eternal head of the WPK, led the Party only to victory braving storm and stress of history. Today the prestige of the WPK with HE Kim Jong Un as its leader has been radically strengthened, he stressed. He sincerely wished the WPK progress and prosperity all the time. John Zammit, chairman of the Malta-Korea Friendship Association, in a statement on Oct. 4 extended congratulations to the Korean people on the 73rd founding anniversary of the WPK. He noted that on this occasion the Korean people are expressing boundless reverence for President Kim Il Sung, the founder the WPK. Rodong News Team

title: Inter-Korean High-Level Talks Held
body: Inter-Korean high-level talks for implementing the historic "September Pyongyang Joint Declaration" were held at the "House of Peace" in the south side portion of Panmunjom on Monday. Present there were a delegation of the north side led by Ri Son Gwon, chairman of the Committee for the Peaceful Reunification of the Country of the DPRK, and a delegation of the south side with Minister of Unification Jo Myong Gyun as chief delegate. At the talks the two sides deeply discussed the practical ways for thoroughly implementing the historic "September Pyongyang Joint Declaration" and developing the north-south relations into a fresh high level, and adopted a joint press release. It is specified in the press release that north-south general-level military talks will be held at an early date to discuss the technical issues referred to in the "military agreement to implement Panmunjom declaration." It also specified the time range of holding a ground-breaking ceremony for linking the railways and roads of the north and the south along the East and West Seas of Korea and for modernizing them. It detailed the dates, venues and agenda to be tabled at the talks of various panels. It also noted that the two sides would discuss and push ahead with the technical issues related to the performance to be given by an art troupe of the north side in a south side area. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK-Russia Cooperation
body: An agreement on cooperation between the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries and the Russian Foundation for Basic Research was signed in Pyongyang on Tuesday. Present at the signing ceremony from the DPRK side were Pak Kyong Il, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries, and officials concerned and from the Russian side were members of a delegation of the Russian Foundation for Basic Research led by President Vladislav Panchenko. Pak Kyong Il and Vladislav Panchenko inked the agreement. Rodong News Team

title: Premier Inspects Taean Heavy Machine Complex, Co-op Farms
body: Premier Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, inspected the Taean Heavy Machine Complex and co-op farms in South Hwanghae Province. Seeing round different parts of the complex, the premier instructed its officials to dynamically organize the economic work and carry out national economic plan for this year ahead of schedule by dint of self-reliance and self-development based on science and technology. At a field consultative meeting, measures were taken to prioritize the supply of materials, boost the ties between the processes and rev up the production by stepping up the technical updating. Visiting co-op farms in Paechon and Chongdan counties of South Hwanghae Province, the premier called for harvesting crops well and employing new farming methods. Rodong News Team

title: Gifts to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Organizations of Russia and Mongolia
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received gifts from the Russian Foundation for Basic Research and the Mongolian Agriculture, Food and Environment Workers' Trade Unions. The gifts were separately conveyed to officials concerned by Vladislav Panchenko, president of the Russian Foundation for Basic Research who is leading its delegation on a visit to the DPRK, and Gantuya Ochirjantsan, president of the Mongolian Food, Agriculture and Environment Workers' Trade Unions who is heading its visiting delegation, on Tuesday. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Government Delegation Back Home
body: The DPRK government delegation led by Vice-Premier Ri Ryong Nam returned home on Tuesday after attending the celebrations of the 50th anniversary of the independence of Equatorial Guinea. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman of Communist Party in Denmark Visits Various Places
body: Henrik Stamer Hedin, chairman of the Communist Party in Denmark, and his party visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. Being told about the revolutionary career of the President and his family members, the visitors looked round historical mementoes at his old home. They also toured the Korean Revolution Museum, the Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace, the Grand People's Study House, etc. Rodong News Team

title: Editorial
body: Let Us Wage Dynamic Struggle for Successfully Concluding This Year’s Campaign By attaining the goals for this year without fail in the spirit of the self-reliance and fortitude, all the officials, Party members and working people should fully display the indomitable spirit of Juche Korea which has nothing impossible and further accelerate the advance of the Korean revolution. This year has witnessed dramatic events strikingly demonstrating the dignity and might of Juche Korea under the leadership of the Workers’ Party of Korea and a new upswing was effected in overall economic construction to give full display to the tremendous might of the country.
