To successfully conclude this year’s campaign is a serious political struggle to fully display the tremendous national power of Juche Korea in the face of the difficulties of every description. It is also a crucial struggle to make a breakthrough without fail in attaining the goals of the five-year strategy for national economic development. Bearing in mind that the key to the leaping progress is the spirit of self-reliance and science and technology today when the tasks are gigantic and the country is faced with many difficulties and ordeals, all the people should perform miracles by their own efforts and technology. All people should wage a dynamic struggle for successfully concluding this year’s campaign and thus fully display the spirit and mettle of Juche Korea dashing towards the high eminence of a powerful socialist country.

title: Works of Great Men Introduced in Spain
body: The Communist Party of the People of Spain on October 9 posted on its website Chairman Kim Jong Il's work "The Workers' Party of Korea Organizes and Guides All the Victories of Our People" and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "The Cause of the Great Party of Comrades Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il Is Ever-Victorious" to mark the 21st anniversary of Kim Jong Il's election as general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and the 73rd founding anniversary of the WPK. The first work, published on October 3, Juche 79 (1990), deals with the idea that the leadership of the party is a decisive guarantee for the victory of the socialist cause and clarifies the matter of strengthening the WPK into a Juche-type revolutionary party and the basic way for performing the mission and duty of the party as a leadership political body. The second work, published on October 4, Juche 104 (2015), clarifies that the 70-year-long history of the WPK is a history of victory in which the validity and invincibility of the cause of the Party of Comrades Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il have been displayed and that the cause of the Party is invincible. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Embassy in Ulan Bator Hosts Reception
body: The DPRK embassy in Ulan Bator gave a reception on Oct. 12 to mark the 70th anniversary of establishment of diplomatic ties between the DPRK and Mongolia. Invited to the reception were the chairperson of the Mongolia-Korea Friendship Parliamentary Group, the advisor for Foreign Policy to the President and other figures. The DPRK ambassador and staff members of the embassy were on hand. Speeches were made there. Congratulating the 70th anniversary of establishment of DPRK-Mongolia diplomatic ties, the chairperson of the Mongolia-Korea Friendship Parliamentary Group said: The friendly relations, whose foundation was laid and developed by the preceding leaders of the two countries, are now steadily expanding. The mutual visits paid by President Kim Il Sung, the great leader of the Korean people, and the preceding leaders of Mongolia on several occasions have proactively promoted the bilateral relations. We hope that the traditional ties of friendship between Mongolia and the DPRK would be everlasting. The inter-Korean summits and the DPRK-U.S. summit held this year are a great event recorded on a page of history. We fully support the efforts of the DPRK for peace in the Korean peninsula and the region. The advisor for Foreign Policy to the President of Mongolia said that they would value the 70-year-old history of diplomatic ties between the two countries and proactively cooperate to further boost them. The roving ambassador of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade of Mongolia stressed the need for the younger generations to inherit the history of the traditional ties of friendship and cooperation. Rodong News Team

title: Ri Su Yong Meets Danish Party Leader
body: Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, had a talk with Henrik Stamer Hedin, chairman of the Communist Party in Denmark, and his companion on Wednesday. Rodong News Team

title: Gift to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Danish Party
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a gift from the Communist Party in Denmark. The gift was conveyed to Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, by Henrik Stamer Hedin, chairman of the Communist Party in Denmark, on a visit to the DPRK on Wednesday. Rodong News Team

title: Gift to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Nepalese Delegation
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a gift from the delegation of the Socialist Journalist Forum of Nepal for the Study of the Juche Idea. The gift was conveyed to an official concerned on Wednesday by Chairman of the Forum Deependra Rokaya, who is heading its delegation on a visit to the DPRK. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Yong Nam Receives Credentials from Vietnamese Ambassador
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, received credentials from Le Ba Binh, Vietnamese ambassador to the DPRK, at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Wednesday. After receiving the credentials, Kim had a talk with the ambassador. Rodong News Team

title: National Footwear Exhibition Opened
body: The 2018 National Footwear Exhibition opened with due ceremony at Pyongyang Department Store No. 1 on Wednesday. Presented to it, to be held in forms of product exhibition and sci-tech presentation, are more than 31 000 products of 940 kinds made by more than 60 units in the fields of shoe-making and science and education as well as more than 80 research findings. On display at the product exhibition are famous products representing units and various styles of footwear and shoe-making materials. Attending the ceremony were Vice-Premier Ri Ju O, Minister of Light Industry Choe Il Ryong, officials concerned and those of units taking part in the exhibition. During the exhibition there will be an introduction of sci-tech successes made in computerizing sketch and design, localizing raw and other materials and facilities and producing diverse, various and varicolored and light shoes and an exchange. The exhibition will last until Oct. 26. Rodong News Team

title: Mongolian Delegation Visits Mangyongdae
body: A delegation of the Mongolian Food, Agriculture and Environment Workers Trade Unions headed by President Gantuya Ochirjantsan visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. Being briefed on the fact that Kim Il Sung grew up to be a revolutionary and dedicated his all to the prosperity of the country and its people's happiness, the visitors looked round the historical relics. The delegation also toured the Korean Revolution Museum, the Rungna Dolphinarium, etc. Rodong News Team

title: Japanese Reactionaries’ Shameless Insult to Victims of Sexual Slavery
body: Shortly ago, a right-wing organization of Japan visited Taiwan of China, with intent to protest against the erection of the first statue of girl sexual slave there in August last and give so-called debate on the sexual slavery issue. What merits serious attention is that the head of the organization kicked the statue. This is a reckless act of insulting justice, truth, human ethics and conscience. The Japanese reactionaries’ denial of the sexual slavery crime and insult to the victims are an open challenge to justice, truth and human conscience and a revelation of their design to repeat the past crimes. Japan’s liquidation of its past is the demand of the international community. Japan is sadly mistaken if it thinks it can go against the demand. The more Japan denies its past crimes, the more statues of girl sexual slave will be erected. It is the legal obligation and moral responsibility to make an apology and reparation for the crimes. If Japan wants to appear upright before the international community, free from the burden, it should ponder why the statues of girl sexual slave have been erected. Japan’s denial of the sexual slavery crime and insult to the victims only show its moral vulgarity and shamelessness. Ri Chol Hyok

title: Anti-Popular Nature of Capitalism Can Never Be Concealed
body: Capitalist society is not for the working masses but for the exploiting classes, and it is the society where minority rules over majority and the former enjoys the material wealth produced by the latter. No matter how cunningly the imperialists and the bourgeois advocates of capitalism try to cover up the exploitation by capital and serious contradictions in capitalist society, they can never hide the vulnerability of doomed capitalism. The politics in capitalist society is anti-popular politics for the interests of monopoly tycoons and other exploiting classes. And it is also money-driven crafty oppression politics and dictatorship. The ruling classes control all mass media to spread the reactionary, anti-popular idea and culture and corrupt bourgeois life style so that they may numb the working masses’ consciousness of independence, make them obey to the exploiting system of capitalism and reduce them into slaves of money. It is capitalist society where the human relationship depends on money and a man’s worth and personality are also decided by money. In capitalist society, exploitation and plunder by capital are intensified with each passing day and people are never protected by the state. In such society one can never expect the equality in material life although the technology is developing and the material wealth is increasing. The reactionary political life, poor spiritual and cultural life and deformed material life lead to the ruin of capitalism. Son So Yon

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Works Introduced in Belarus
body: The Belarus National Association of Friends of Korean People Named after Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il posted the full texts of Chairman Kim Jong Il's works "The Historical Lesson in Building Socialism and the General Line of Our Party" and "Socialism Is a Science" on its website on Oct. 5 and 6 to mark the 73rd founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea. Rodong News Team

title: Commemorative Events Held Abroad
body: A Kimjongilia exhibition, seminar, book and photo exhibition, book-releasing ceremony, film show and reception were held in Mongolia on Oct. 12 and 15 to mark the 73rd founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea and the 70th establishment anniversary of DPRK-Mongolia diplomatic ties. On display at their venues were photos dealing with the exploits of President Kim Il Sung, who made contributions to the development of the DPRK-Mongolia friendly relations. There were also potted Kimjongilias in full bloom, works of the peerlessly great persons and books and photos showing the proud reality of Juche Korea. A documentary film on Kim Il Sung's historic visit to Mongolia was shown. Present at the events were personages of the Kimjongilia Association, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade, the Mt. Paektu Association for Independent Development and other units and popular masses of Mongolia, and the ambassador and staff members of the DPRK embassy in Ulan Bator. Meanwhile, an event took place in Poland on Oct. 2 to celebrate the 70th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations with the DPRK. Rodong News Team

title: "September Pyongyang Joint Declaration" Backed by Nepalese Bodies
body: Nepalese organizations made public statements in support of the historic "September Pyongyang Joint Declaration" on Oct. 7 and 11. The Nepal-Korea Friendship Association said in a statement that the inter-Korean summit and the "September Pyongyang Joint Declaration" are of weighty significance in achieving durable peace and prosperity on the Korean peninsula and that they have been warmly hailed by the world people loving justice and progress. Congratulating the successful inter-Korean summit, the Nepal Journalist Association said in its statement: The Nepalese people fully support the "September Pyongyang Joint Declaration". They sincerely hope that the declaration would be thoroughly implemented to bring a permanent peace to the Korean peninsula. Rodong News Team

title: Mongolian Guests Visit Mangyongdae
body: Badamdorj Ganchimeg, director general of the Mongolian News Agency Montsame, and her party visited Mangyongdae, birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. The visitors looked round the historical relics, being briefed on the careers of Kim Il Sung and his family members. They were guided to the Tower of the Juche Idea, the Arch of Triumph, the National Gifts Exhibition House, etc. Rodong News Team

title: Foreigners Visit Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: The chairman of the Communist Party in Denmark and his companion, the director general of the Mongolian News Agency Montsame and her party, the delegation of the Socialist Journalist Forum of Nepal for the Study of the Juche Idea and other foreign guests visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on Thursday. They paid tribute to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il at the palace. At the halls of immortality where the great leaders lie in state the visitors paid homage to them. They made the rounds of the halls where the orders the great leaders received are on display and the halls that house cars, electric car, boat and train coaches used by them during their field guidance and foreign tours till the last moments of their lives. Rodong News Team

title: Credentials of Thai Ambassador Accepted
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, received credentials from Piriya Khempon, Thai ambassador to the DPRK, at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Thursday. The president had a talk with the ambassador. Rodong News Team

title: Mongolian Trade Unions Delegation Leaves
body: The delegation of the Mongolian Food, Agriculture and Environment Workers Trade Unions led by President Gantuya Ochirjantsan left Pyongyang for home on Thursday. Rodong News Team

title: Photo of President Kim Il Sung Displayed at School in Mali
body: A photo of President Kim Il Sung was displayed at Kim Jong Il Class of Progres School in Mali with due ceremony on Oct. 6. Present at the event were the representative of the Ministry of Education of Mali, teaching staff and pupils of the school, the DPRK ambassador to Mali and staff members of his embassy. Rodong News Team

title: Kimjongilia Exhibition Held in China
body: A Kimjongilia exhibition took place in Jilin of China on Oct. 10 to mark the 21st anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's election as general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and the 73rd founding anniversary of the WPK. Present at its opening ceremony were personages of various circles and masses of China and members of the DPRK mission. Meanwhile, visits to the Kimilsungia Hothouse in Conakry of Guinea took place on Oct. 7-10. Rodong News Team

title: WPK Lauded by Foreign Media
body: Foreign media dedicated special write-ups to the 21st anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's election as general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and the 73rd founding anniversary of the WPK on Oct. 4-14. Xing San Daily of Thailand carried an article illustrated with a portrait of smiling Kim Jong Il. The article said Kim Jong Il developed the WPK into a party always emerging victorious in accomplishing the cause of socialism. The WPK, remarkably strengthened under his leadership, is now making world-startling successes for independence of the popular masses as befits a powerful general staff of the revolution, the article noted. His party-building exploits will go down to posterity, it added. The Kuwaiti paper Times carried an article illustrated with a photo of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. The article said that the WPK is the party guided by Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, the essence of which is the Juche idea, and it is the party which has achieved the steel-like unity and cohesion of the entire party and enjoyed absolute support and trust from the people. The paper Al-Anba introduced the exploits of the peerlessly great persons for the foundation and development of the WPK. The Iranian Ilna and the Indonesian internet paper RMOL said that Kim Jong Un has developed the WPK into steel-strong vanguard ranks advancing by dint of ideology and unity and into a party making selfless, devoted efforts for the good of the people under the unfurled banner of the people-first principle. The Nigerian paper Nigerian Observer cited facts to show the invincibility of the WPK that has emerged victorious in the storms of history over 70 years since its foundation. Rodong News Team

title: Floral Basket to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Japan Delegation
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a floral basket from the visiting delegation of Japan-Korea Friendship Linking with Juche. The basket was handed over to an official concerned by Masatake Shinzato, deputy director general of the Japanese Okinawa Liaison Council of Societies for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, who is heading the delegation, on Friday. Rodong News Team

title: National Sci-Tech Exhibition in Field of Finishing Building Materials Closes
body: A national exhibition of sci-tech successes in the field of finishing building materials closed with due ceremony at the Sci-Tech Complex on Friday. On display there were more than hundreds of sci-tech successes made in increasing the proportion of locally available finishing building materials and diversifying them and putting the architectural lightning on a Juche basis. Building parts and light decoration designs presented by the building materials research institute of the Paektusan Institute of Architecture, the Chollima Tile Factory, the Taedonggang Building-materials Factory, etc. drew attention of the visitors. Appreciated at the sci-tech presentation were eighteen papers which contributed to the development of the finishing building materials and the drive for putting production on a scientific basis. Present at the ceremony were Pak Thae Song, vice-chairman of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea, Jo Sok Ho, chairman of the Capital City Construction Commission, and officials, scientists and technicians of ministries, national institutions, relevant units, fields of science and education and industrial establishments in Pyongyang. Rodong News Team

title: Nepalese Juche Idea Followers Visit Mangyongdae
body: The delegation of the Socialist Journalist Forum of Nepal for the Study of the Juche Idea led by Chairman Deependra Rokaya visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. The guests looked round the historical relics, being briefed on the exploits of the President at his old home. They also toured the Tower of the Juche Idea, the Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace, Pyongyang Teacher Training College, etc. Rodong News Team

title: Danish Party Leader Leaves
body: Henrik Stamer Hedin, chairman of the Communist Party in Denmark, and his companion left Pyongyang for home on Friday. Rodong News Team

title: Danish Party Signs Pyongyang Declaration
body: The Communist Party in Denmark signed the Pyongyang Declaration "Let Us Defend and Advance the Cause of Socialism." Chairman of the party Henrik Stamer Hedin, who visited the DPRK, signed the declaration on behalf of the party on Thursday. Rodong News Team

title: National Exhibition of IT Successes-2018 Closes
body: The national exhibition of IT successes-2018 closed with due ceremony at the Three-Revolution Exhibition House in Pyongyang on Friday. A lot of successes gained in the drive for breaking through the cutting edge to put the national economy on a modern and IT basis were introduced at the exhibition. Present at the closing ceremony were Ro Tu Chol, vice-premier and concurrently chairman of the State Planning Commission, officials of commissions, ministries and national institutions, officials concerned and officials of those units which contributed to the exhibition and working people. The IT Institute of the Latest Science Institute of Kim Il Sung University, the Intelligent Information Institute of the State Academy of Sciences and other units were selected at the exhibition as ten IT model units and ten top IT enterprises and the school subject contest management system, the naval commanding system and others appreciated as ten top IT products. Rodong News Team

title: Natural Dyestuffs of Our Style Developed
body: The Sinuiju Cosmetics Factory has worked hard to acquire cutting-edge technologies, thereby succeeding in developing natural dyestuffs of our style with botanical Koryo drugstuffs richly available in Korea. This has afforded a material and technological guarantee for the mass-production of excellent functional hairdyes which have no negative effect on the human body. Always thinking how to promote the health of the people and provide them with civilized living conditions, Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un gave the cosmetic industry precious instructions to develop cosmetics for dyeing which do not irritate the skin and produce ill effects on it. True to the instructions, the factory strove strenuously to develop the natural dyestuffs for hairdyes. The factory picked out several botanical Koryo drugstuffs as the right raw materials for natural dyestuffs for developing purposes and focused on rationally determining the rate of their composition. Besides, it carried on researches into the properties of natural dyestuffs for them to be able to outdo their chemical counterparts in function. Consequently, the factory succeeded in developing natural dyestuffs with botanical Koryo drugstuffs abundant in Korea and made a solid breakthrough in the production of the hairdyes free from ill effects. Many clinical tests were conducted with the trial products of the natural hairdyes so as to prove that unlike their chemical counterparts, they do not produce ill effects on the head and yellow it despite their long application. In addition, the natural hairdyes lend natural beauty to the head, whereas their chemical counterparts cannot do so. The factory is now struggling vigorously to develop and produce quality cosmetics for dyeing with the natural dyestuffs. Kim Chung Song

title: Korean Children Win Great Admiration in Int'l Festival
body: The performance by the Oungum trio ensemble of Kyongsang Kindergarten of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea evoked a lively response from the 15th International Festival "Moscow Welcomes Friends" held in Russia. The festival has annually been held since 2004 with the aim of helping brush up the artistic talents of juveniles of various countries and boosting exchange and cooperation in the cultural and art fields. Participating in the recent festival were promising music prodigies from 21 countries including the DPRK, Russia, China, Belarus, Britain and Germany. The children of Kyongsang Kindergarten gave deep impressions to the audience through the excellent performance of the guitar quartet at the 9th international festival and other international stages. They decorated the recent festival with the Oungum trio ensemble. Sin Jong Hyon, Pak Ye Hwi and Jang Ye Jong were enthusiastically applauded by the audience as they gave peculiar representation of a Korean song. The Oungum trio ensemble fully displayed their high artistic skills at the closing performance given at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow on Oct. 12. Rodong News Team

title: Nepali Guests Leave
body: The delegation of the Socialist Journalist Forum of Nepal for the Study of the Juche Idea led by Chairman Deependra Rokaya left Pyongyang for home on Monday. Rodong News Team

title: Japanese Delegation Visits Mangyongdae
body: A delegation of Japan-DPRK Friendship Linking with Juche headed by Masatake Shinzato, deputy director general of the Japanese Okinawa Liaison Council of Societies for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. The delegation was guided to the Mangyongdae Revolutionary Museum where on display are historical data and relics dealing with the revolutionary activities of President Kim Il Sung and his family members. At his old home the visitors looked round the historical relics, being briefed on the sacred career of the President. They had a photo taken in commemoration of the visit to the old home in Mangyongdae and toured the revolutionary sites on Mangyong Hill. The delegation also visited the Korean Revolution Museum, Pyongyang Teacher Training College, etc. Rodong News Team

title: WPK Delegation Leaves for Russia
body: A delegation of the Workers' Party of Korea led by Ryu Myong Son, vice department director of the C.C., WPK, left Pyongyang on Monday to visit Russia. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Ambassador to Sweden Appointed
body: Ri Won Guk was appointed as DPRK ambassador to Sweden, according to a decree of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK. Rodong News Team

title: Russian Foreign Ministry Delegation Arrives
body: A delegation of the Department of International Organizations of the Russian Foreign Ministry led by Deputy Director Mikael Agasandian arrived in Pyongyang on Monday. Rodong News Team

title: Film Show Held
body: A film show took place at the Taedonggang Diplomatic Club on Monday to mark the 60th anniversary of the visit to the Thaekam Cooperative Farm by President Kim Il Sung together with Premier Zhou Enlai and the 60th anniversary of the formation of the friendship associations of the DPRK and China. It was attended by Kim Jong Suk, chairwoman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries, Pak Kyong Il, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries who is chairman of the DPRK-China Friendship Association, officials concerned, working people in the city, Li Jinjun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK, and staff members of his embassy and Chinese guests staying in the DPRK. Speeches were made there. Speakers noted that Kim Il Sung, together with Zhou Enlai, made strenuous efforts to strengthen the traditional DPRK-China friendship. The friendship associations of the two countries have contributed to deepening the feelings of fraternal friendship between the two peoples through diverse activities, they said. They stressed that all efforts would be made to expand the friendly ties between the two countries in the spirit of the agreement reached by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and General Secretary Xi Jinping. The participants watched a Korean documentary on the exploits of Kim Il Sung, who provided and boosted the excellent tradition of the DPRK-China friendship through his energetic external activities. That day, there was a reception co-sponsored by the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries and the DPRK-China Friendship Association. Rodong News Team

title: Self-Respect of Nation Is Foundation of Independent Development, Prosperity
body: The self-respect of the nation is self-confidence that one’s own nation is not inferior to others, the mind to value and defend the dignity of the nation and the determination and will to achieve the prosperity and development of the country and nation with one’s own effort. The strong self-respect of the nation is an important guarantee for creditably carving out the destiny of the nation and glorifying its dignity. The self-respect of the nation is the most powerful weapon for each country and nation. It is very instrumental in achieving national unity and displaying strength incomparable with anything. The Korean revolution clearly proves that the strong self-respect of the nation is very important in achieving the independent development and prosperity of the country and nation. The Korean people’s self-respect of the nation is based on the great pride and happiness that they have been led by the great leaders generation after generation and honor that they live under the socialist system centered on the popular masses best in the world. No force on the earth can break them. The self-respect of the nation is the life and soul of the nation and source of inexhaustible power. People with the strong self-respect of the nation can smash any challenge and achieve the independent development and prosperity of the country and nation. This is the truth of history. Son So Yon

title: Panmunjom Declaration and “September Pyongyang Joint Declaration”, Programmes Common to Korean Nation
body: It is the unanimous desire of all Koreans to vigorously advance the new era of independent reunification, peace and prosperity under the banner of the Panmunjom declaration and the “September Pyongyang Joint Declaration”. The declarations are the great programmes common to the nation as they clearly indicate the principle and way of opening a broad avenue to national reconciliation, unity, peace and independent reunification. The Panmunjom declaration is a historic one through which the north and the south of Korea declared to the whole world that they would make a new history of national harmony and usher in a new era of co-prosperity by pooling their will and efforts. The “September Pyongyang Joint Declaration” reflecting the general will of the nation is a milestone for the country’s reunification, which is designed to accelerate the development of the inter-Korean ties and usher in a new heyday of national reconciliation and unity, peace and prosperity by comprehensively and sincerely implementing the Panmunjom declaration. Those declarations mirror the interests of both the north and the south. The north and the south should move forward as indicated by the two declarations, without regard to any foreign interference and adversity. The attitude towards the declarations is a touchstone of whether or not one desires the development of the inter-Korean relations and peace on the Korean peninsula. No challenge and obstructions by the reactionaries of history will keep the Korean nation from advancing along the road indicated by the two declarations. Sim Chol Yong

title: Hostile Forces’ Campaign against DPRK
body: Japan and EU seek to cook up the “resolution on human rights in north Korea” again with a view to bringing it to the UN General Assembly. This is a product of the criminal plot to tarnish the image of the dignified DPRK and stifle its inviolable socialist system and a revelation of the deep-rooted evil practice of confrontation. The anti-DPRK smear campaign of Japan and EU is designed to intensify the sanctions and pressure on the DPRK and prevent the trend of dialogue and peace on the Korean peninsula under the pretext of “human rights issue”. Frankly speaking, there exists such human rights issue in Western countries plagued with widespread misanthropy and abnormal lifestyle. This being a hard reality, their pulling up the DPRK is absurd. It is an intolerable mockery and insult to justice and human rights that Japan, a brazen-faced human rights abuser, is recklessly taking the lead in the campaign against the DPRK, talking about someone’s non-existent “human rights issue”. Japan still refuses to apologize for the unspeakable crimes against the Korean nation and other Asian countries and brutally suppresses Korean residents in Japan. What should not be overlooked is that it is heard from south Korea that “it will positively participate in shaping the ‘resolution’” and “it will not abstain from voting”. If south Korea values the north-south relations and the climate for dialogue and peace prevailing in the Korean peninsula, it should stop playing to the tune of foreign forces but behave itself with its own views in conformity with the desire of the fellow countrymen for national reconciliation and unity, peace and reunification. Ho Yong Min

title: Works of Great Leaders of DPRK Posted on Italian Websites
body: Chairman Kim Jong Il's work "On Correctly Understanding the Originality of Kimilsungism" was carried on the website of the Italian Branch of the Korean Friendship Association. Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's works "The Cause of the Great Party of Comrades Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il Is Ever-Victorious" and "Let Us Brilliantly Accomplish the Revolutionary Cause of Juche, Holding the Great Comrade Kim Jong Il in High Esteem as the Eternal General Secretary of Our Party" were posted on the websites of the Group of Dialectical Materialists of Italy and the Italian Committee for the Study of Songun Idea for Independence and Sovereignty. The works were posted on Oct. 8 and 10 to mark the 73rd founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK's Holidays Marked Abroad
body: Celebrations were held in Romania, Germany, Bulgaria and Russia on Oct. 4-10 to mark the 21st anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's election as general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and the 73rd founding anniversary of the WPK. Personages of various strata and masses of the relevant countries were present at the events. Constantin Rotaru, chairman of the Socialist Party of Romania, and other speakers said that Kim Jong Il's election as general secretary of the WPK was of great significance in cementing the Party and building socialism and that the WPK guides all the people to victory under the direction of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, who glorifies the party-building idea and exploits of the preceding leaders. Vasile Lacatus, secretary general of the Romania-Korea Friendship Association, said that Oct. 8, 1997 when Kim Jong Il was elected as general secretary of the WPK has been recorded on a brilliant page in the history of the Korean people's struggle for accomplishing the revolutionary cause of the leader through generations. The chairman of the Anti-Imperialist Forum of Germany said that Kim Jong Il is the great leader who guided wisely the party to consolidate the DPRK into a socialist fortress and carried forward the idea and cause of President Kim Il Sung. He wished the WPK led by Kim Jong Un bigger success in further strengthening the socialist system and realizing the country's reunification as soon as possible. A message of greeting to Kim Jong Un was adopted at the event in Bulgaria. Rodong News Team

title: Birthday of WPK Marked in DR Congo
body: The National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of Democratic Congo posted on its website an article titled "The Workers' Party of Korea" illustrated with a portrait of smiling President Kim Il Sung to mark the 73rd founding anniversary of the WPK. The article said: The Workers' Party of Korea was founded on Oct. 10, 1945. President Kim Il Sung is the founder of the WPK and the illustrious guide and the eternal leader of the Korean people who led the revolution and construction to victory. HE Kim Jong Il is the great leader and eternal head of the WPK, who developed it into the party of President Kim Il Sung and dynamically advanced the Korean revolution with Songun politics. Chairman Kim Jong Un is the prominent leader of the WPK and the Korean people who is steadily carrying forward the idea and cause of President Kim Il Sung and HE Kim Jong Il. The article noted that the WPK is the revolutionary party of Juche type guided by Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism and the party struggling to accomplish the cause of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il, the revolutionary cause of Juche. Rodong News Team

title: Inter-Korean Talks for Cooperation in Forestry Held
body: Inter-Korean talks for cooperation in forestry took place at the north-south joint liaison office on Monday under the agreement at inter-Korean high-level talks for implementing the historic "September Pyongyang Joint Declaration". Present there were the north side's delegation led by Kim Song Jun, vice director-general of the General Bureau of Forest under the Ministry of Land and Environment Protection, and the south side's delegation with Pak Jong Ho, vice-director of the Forestry Administration, as chief delegate. At the talks both sides discussed the practical issues and step-by-step measures for promoting inter-Korean cooperation in forestry and adopted a joint press release. Rodong News Team

title: KNS Founding Anniversary Marked
body: A meeting for celebrating the 70th founding anniversary of the Korean News Service (KNS) took place at the Korean Hall in Tokyo of Japan on October 18. Present there were Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), Vice-Chairman and Director General of the General Affairs Department Pae Jin Gu, Director of the Department for Publicity and Culture Kim Song Hun, officials of the KNS, chairmen of Chongryon headquarters in Kanto area and leading officials of Chongryon organizations and businesses. Introduced was a congratulatory message from the Korean Central News Agency. Ho Jong Man in a congratulatory speech said that the KNS has creditably conducted news services and performed its mission as an overseas news service body of Juche Korea since its foundation. He expressed conviction that journalists, editors and officials of the KNS would dynamically conduct news services for the prosperity of the socialist homeland and peaceful reunification in the future, too. KNS Director General Choe Hong said in his report that the KNS could successfully conduct the news services for the last seven decades in an alien land thanks to the guidance and love of the peerlessly great men. He stressed the need to conduct more initiative and active news services for accelerating the patriotic advance to bring about a new heyday in the movement of Koreans in Japan, true to the congratulatory messages to Chongryon sent by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un on the occasions of the 24th Congress of Chongryon and the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK. A letter to Kim Jong Un was read out at the meeting. On the same day, there was a reception for celebrating the 70th anniversary of the KNS. Rodong News Team

title: Japanese Delegation Leaves
body: A delegation of Japan-DPRK Friendship Linking with Juche headed by Masatake Shinzato, deputy director general of the Japanese Okinawa Liaison Council of Societies for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, left Pyongyang for home on Tuesday. Rodong News Team

title: U.S. Interference Protested in S. Korea
body: According to the south Korean online newspaper Jaju Sibo, youth and students staged a rally against the U.S. unreasonable interference outside the U.S. embassy in Seoul on Oct. 19. The participants in the rally distributed copies of written protest in the name of the youths and students supporting the "September Pyongyang Joint Declaration". The protest said it is a clear infringement upon sovereignty and an act of blocking the road ahead of the Korean nation aspiring after peace and reunification that the U.S. asserted the cancellation of the "May 24 step" needs its approval. It urged the U.S. to immediately halt infringement upon sovereignty and interference and stop disturbing inter-Korean cooperation and exchange. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Works Introduced by Russian Organization
body: The Association for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism of Russia in the Far East Region posted on its website Chairman Kim Jong Il's works "Respecting the Forerunners of the Revolution Is a Noble Moral Obligation of Revolutionaries" and "The Workers' Party of Korea Is a Juche-Type Revolutionary Party Which Inherited the Glorious Tradition of the DIU" on October 9 to mark the 21st anniversary of his election as general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea. The work "Respecting the Forerunners of the Revolution Is a Noble Moral Obligation of Revolutionaries", published on December 25, Juche 84 (1995), deals with the idea that to respect the forerunners of the revolution is the requirement of the revolution. It also clarifies the principled problems arising in establishing the moral trait of respecting the revolutionary forerunners and developing the relationship based on the noble sense of moral obligation among people. The work "The Workers' Party of Korea Is a Juche-Type Revolutionary Party Which Inherited the Glorious Tradition of the DIU", published on Oct. 17, Juche 71 (1982), says that the Workers' Party of Korea is a revolutionary party of Juche type which paved a new path of its development and has conducted its revolutionary activities independently and creatively, guided by the Juche idea. It also deals with the position and role of the party in accomplishing the socialist cause. The website carried a photo of Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK's Holidays Marked Abroad
body: Round-table talks and lectures took place in Syria, Tanzania, Uganda, Guinea, Angola and Ethiopia on Oct. 1-6 ahead of the 21st anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's election as general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and the 73rd founding anniversary of the WPK. The general secretary of the Socialist Unionist Party of Syria noted that the WPK has firmly adhered to the principle of independence over more than 70 years since it was founded and led to victory the Korean people's struggle for defending the country's sovereignty and dignity and achieving the country's reunification. A vice-chairperson of the Tanzanian National Coordinating Committee of the Juche Idea Study Groups said that the WPK, guiding forces of Korea's society, could make a brilliant history of victory as it thoroughly and constantly maintained the principle of independence in politics, self-supporting in the economy and self-reliance in defence, guided by the Juche idea. Speakers said at a lecture in Uganda that the history of the WPK is the proud one of struggle in which it has always achieved victory and glory and that a new era of peace and prosperity has come to the Korean peninsula thanks to the outstanding political ability and bold decision of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, who carries forward the idea and cause of the preceding leaders without an inch of deflection. Rodong News Team

title: WPK Praised by Foreign Newspapers
body: Foreign newspapers gave special write-ups on Oct. 2-17 to mark the 21st anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's election as general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, the 73rd founding anniversary of the WPK and the 92nd anniversary of the formation of the Down-with-Imperialism Union (DIU). The Tanzanian newspaper Uhuru carried an article titled "The Workers' Party of Korea praised by the people" illustrated with a photo of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. The article said that the Korean people praise the WPK for having been responsible for their destiny and having served them. It is quite natural that the people sincerely follow and trust the party. As a deep-rooted tree weathers the raging wind, the WPK enjoying absolute trust from the people always emerges invincible. The Zambian newspaper Top Rating and the Zimbabwean newspaper Herald praised Kim Jong Il's party leadership history to be remembered forever. The Egyptian newspaper Al Akhbar Almassay carried articles praising his undying party-building exploits. In an article titled "The party strong in independence" it said it is thanks to the WPK that the DPRK has steadily implemented the line of independence in politics, self-supporting in the economy and self-reliance in national defence in the face of all storms of history. Rodong News Team

title: Youth League Delegation Leaves for Russia
body: A delegation of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League led by Jong Yong Won, secretary of its Central Committee, left Pyongyang on Wednesday to visit Russia. Rodong News Team

title: Anniversary of DPRK-Russia Diplomatic Relations Marked
body: A friendly meeting was held on Wednesday to mark the 70th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Russian Federation. Invited to it were Alexandr Matsegora, Russian ambassador to the DPRK, and staff members of his embassy. Present were So Ho Won, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries and chairman of the DPRK-Russia Friendship Association, and officials concerned. The participants in the meeting deepened the feeling of friendship, playing a volleyball game and talking to each other about further development of the bilateral cooperative relations. Earlier, there were sports and amusement games between students of DPRK-Russia friendship Moranbong Secondary School No. 1 and a school run by the Russian embassy. Meanwhile, the Russian consulate general in Chongjin hosted a reception to mark the anniversary. Rodong News Team

title: Seminar on Protection of Intangible Cultural Heritages
body: A seminar on the protection of intangible cultural heritages took place at the People's Palace of Culture on Wednesday to mark the publication anniversary of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "National Heritage Conservation Is a Patriotic Undertaking for Adding Brilliance to the History and Traditions of Our Nation". Attending it were officials in the fields of national heritage conservation, science and education, literature and arts and mass media, teachers and researchers and members of foreign embassies and missions of international bodies here and overseas compatriots staying here. At the seminar, held under the theme of "intangible cultural heritages--acceding to the convention and 10 year-long efforts", there was a show of video introducing the intangible cultural heritages of the DPRK and its successes made in the work to preserve them. Speeches were made under such titles as "Acceding to the international convention and the conservation of intangible cultural heritages in the DPRK", "Sustained development of intangible cultural heritages and the role of education", "Intangible cultural heritages and regional protection" and "Moxibustion that has developed along with the conservation of intangible cultural heritages". Certificates were conferred on the national and local intangible cultural heritages newly registered this year. Rodong News Team

title: Chinese Delegation Arrives
body: A delegation of Chinese youth cadres headed by Li Guiguang, vice-director of the Veteran Office, arrived in Pyongyang on Wednesday to mark the 68th anniversary of the entry of the Chinese People's Volunteers into the Korean front. Rodong News Team

title: Talks between Senior Officials of WPK and Russian Party
body: Talks were held on Tuesday between Ryu Myong Son, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea who is leading the WPK delegation on a visit to the Russian Federation, and Andrei Klimov, vice secretary of the General Council of the United Russia Party. Ryu Myong Son noted that the WPK and the Korean people are pushing ahead with a vigorous drive for making bigger success in building a powerful socialist nation in the spirit displayed in splendidly marking the 70th birthday of the DPRK under the guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. And he stressed the need to develop the relations between the two parties on a fresh high stage. Andrei Klimov said that the DPRK demonstrated the might of single-minded unity of the party and people rallied close around their leader and the invincible national power through the celebrations of its 70th birthday. Saying that a climate favorable for peace and security in the Korean Peninsula and the region is created thanks to the pro-active measure and wise guidance of Kim Jong Un, he fully supported the WPK's new strategic line on concentrating all efforts on the economic development. He expressed the invariable stand of his party to develop the relations with the WPK. Attending the talks from the WPK side were a member of the WPK delegation and the DPRK ambassador to Russia and from the opposite side a member of the Supreme Council of the United Russia Party and other party officials concerned. Rodong News Team

title: Congratulations to Vietnamese President
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, Wednesday sent a congratulatory message to Nguyen Phu Trong upon his election as president of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam at the 6th meeting of the 14th National Assembly of Vietnam. The message said that the election of Nguyen Phu Trong as president of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam showed the support and trust of the Vietnamese people for him. The message expressed the belief that the traditional ties of friendship and cooperation between the two countries, which were provided by President Kim Il Sung and President Ho Chi Minh, would grow stronger and sincerely wished the Vietnamese president success in his responsible work for the country's prosperity. Rodong News Team

title: Australia Should Behave with Discretion
body: Australia sent a frigate to the waters around the Korean peninsula, talking about support for the “implementation of sanctions”. A senior military official of the country announced this fact at a press conference. The official said that the said frigate would be aided by reconnaissance planes based in Japan and that it shows the efforts of Australia to put economic and diplomatic pressure on the DPRK. Australia is seeking to destroy the hard won peaceful atmosphere of the Korean peninsula and the region. It has become clear that Australia is displeased with the trend of peace in the Korean peninsula and the region. When many countries raise their voices at the United Nations that anti-DPRK sanctions should be relaxed or lifted, Australia is going against it. This fact shows that Australia has not abandoned its force of habit as a puppet. Australia should clearly know that the DPRK is a dignified socialist state advancing by dint of self-development and science and technology and that economic sanctions or diplomatic pressure can never work on it. If Australia is interested in the regional situation even a bit, it should behave itself, squarely seeing the trend of the times. In case the affirmative atmosphere created on the Korean peninsula is wrecked owing to the riffs-raffs such as Australia, they must be held wholly accountable for it. Ri Hak Nam

title: U.S. Interference Rejected
body: Minjok Thongsin, an internet newspaper of Koreans in the U.S., on October 20 posted an article denouncing the U.S. unreasonable interference. The article, contributed by Kim Jung San, a U.S.-resident Korean, rejected the U.S. recent assertion that south Korea can do nothing without its approval over the issue of lifting the "May 24 step". This is evidently an infringement upon the sovereignty of south Korea and an interference in internal affairs, the article said, demanding an apology from the U.S. Rodong News Team

title: Premier Inspects Mangyongdae Chicken Farm and Pyongyang Mushroom Farm
body: Premier Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, made a field survey of the Mangyongdae Chicken Farm and the Pyongyang Mushroom Farm. Seeing round different parts of the Mangyongdae Chicken Farm, he stressed the need to decisively lower the egg production cost by carrying on the organization and direction of production under a meticulous plan and to properly establish the feeding system. At the Pyongyang Mushroom Farm, he encouraged its officials and employees, and scientists and technicians from related unit in achieving successes in the mushroom production while accelerating the modernization of production process. At field consultative meetings, steps were taken to carry out the national economic plan for this year by concentrating all efforts on realizing the integration of science and technology and production and making the relevant units ensure the smooth supply of materials. Meanwhile, Pak Pong Ju looked round the venue of the National Footwear Exhibition. Rodong News Team

title: History of DPRK-China Friendship Will Go Down Forever
body: October 25 is the anniversary of the entry of the Chinese People’s Volunteers into the Korean front. The Chinese party and government organized volunteers and dispatched them to the Korean front on Oct. 25, 1950 when the DPRK was fighting against the imperialist allied forces. At the Korean front the CPV fighters fought bravely against the imperialist allied forces, hand in hand with the Korean People’s Army. Mirrored in every annuals of the history of DPRK-China friendship is the world of noble obligation shown by the leaders of the elder generation of the two countries, who supported and cooperated with each other for the common cause. Today, the DPRK-China friendship with long historic roots has entered a new stage of development as required by the new era. Valuing the historic tradition of the DPRK-China friendship and the revolutionary faith, Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un visited the People’s Republic of China three times this year, making an immortal contribution to the development of the DPRK-China friendly relations. The Korean people are now treasuring up the heroic self-sacrificing spirit displayed by the CPV fighters and always recollecting their merits. The DPRK-China friendly relations with a good tradition will grow stronger century after century and through generations in conformity with the desire of the peoples of the two countries. Ri Chol Hyok

title: Agricultural Sci-Tech Presentation
body: A national sci-tech presentation in the agricultural field took place at Wonsan University of Agriculture from October 23 to 25 under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea. Taking part in it were officials, teachers, researchers, graduate students and students from different units including Pyongyang Agricultural College of Kim Il Sung University, Kye Ung Sang Agricultural College of Kim Il Sung University and the Kangwon Provincial Institute of Agricultural Science. Presented to it, divided into several panels, were more than 170 papers conducive to solving the sci-tech problems arising in breeding new high-yielding strains, positively applying the advanced agricultural technology and methods and putting the rural economy on an integrated mechanized basis. During the presentation, its participants had lectures on the latest agricultural science and technology and toured the venue of the exhibition at which agro-scientific and technological achievements were displayed. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Ambassador to Thailand Appointed
body: Kim Je Bong was appointed as DPRK ambassador to Thailand, according to a decree of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly. Rodong News Team

title: Rason Old People's Home Built
body: There sprang up the Rason Old People's Home. The home, a two-storey Korean-style building, is equipped with all necessary facilities for old people's health and living such as fitness room, beauty room, bathrooms, clinic and entertainment hall. Its inaugural ceremony was held on Thursday with attendance of Sin Yong Chol, chairman of the Rason City Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Jo Jong Ho, chairman of the Rason City People's Committee, officials concerned, employees, inmates, builders and citizens. After the ceremony the participants saw round the home. Rodong News Team

title: Friendly Gathering with Mongolian Embassy Officials
body: A friendly gathering with staff members of the Mongolian embassy here was held at the Taedonggang Diplomatic Club on Thursday to mark the 30th anniversary of President Kim Il Sung's second visit to Mongolia and the 70th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic ties between the two countries. Present there were Vice-Chairman Jo Chol Ryong and officials of the DPRK-Mongolia Friendship Association and Charge d'Affaires ad Interim Sukhbat Sodnomtsog and staff members of the Mongolian embassy. Rodong News Team

title: The Correctness and Vitality of the Party’s Policy of Giving Importance to Science and Technology
body: True to the militant call of the Party, a grand march towards economic construction is dynamically stepped up in Korea to accelerate the advance of its revolution further. This coincides with the movement to qualify as a model technological innovation unit. Not long ago the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea qualified as model technological innovators those which achieved many successes in the energetic movement for mass technological innovation so as to enhance the independence and Juche character of the national economy and move it on to a modern, informational and scientific footing by dint of science and technology in the spirit of self-reliance in hearty response to the decisions of the historic April Plenary Meeting of the Party Central Committee. They comprise 15 thrice model technological innovation units, 22 twice model technological units and 30 model technological innovation units. Korea boasts 630 such units altogether across the country. The model technological innovation units have extensively introduced valuable technological innovation schemes into their production and management to consolidate their scientific and technologic foundations further, bring about a rapid progress in their production and contribute actively to the economic development of the country and the improvement of the people’s living standards. Kang Chol Ung

title: Nothing Can Check Advance of History
body: The history of development of human society is a history of the popular masses’ struggle for independence. Although turns and twists exist in the advance of history, a law of historical development does not change at all. The popular masses, once deprived of national independence and sovereignty, proudly appeared in history as master of the world. More developing countries have a voice in the settlement of international issues. They have grown to be a great driving force of human history and a mighty force in the struggle against imperialists. Those countries, which were once groaning under the colonial rule by the imperialists, proudly take their place on the stage of history and international balance of force has changed fundamentally. The unity based on independence is the source of invincibility and main guarantee for victory. When all the forces for independence around the world get united in a vigorous struggle against the imperialists, the imperialists’ moves would become impotent. The strength of the people aspiring after independence is inexhaustible and no force on earth can block their struggle. The desperate efforts of the imperialists cannot hold in check the advance of history. Ri Hyon Do

title: CPV Martyrs Cemetery Remodeled
body: Graves of the martyrs of the Chinese People's Volunteers located in Kangdong County and Sunan District of Pyongyang have been remodeled into the Martyrs Cemetery on the occasion of the 68th anniversary of the CPV's entry into the Korean front. A relevant ceremony took place at the remodeled cemetery in Kangdong County on Thursday. Present there were Choe Song Chol, vice-minister of Urban Management, officials concerned, working people in Kangdong County, Ambassador Li Jinjun and officials of the Chinese embassy to the DPRK, Chinese guests staying in the DPRK including the delegation of Chinese youth cadres, Chinese students studying in the DPRK, Chinese residents in the DPRK and Korean residents in China. Wreaths in the names of the Ministry of Urban Management, the Pyongyang City People's Committee, the Chinese embassy to the DPRK, the delegation of Chinese youth cadres and the General Association of Koreans in China were laid at the cemetery. The participants observed a moment's silence in memory of the CPV martyrs who bravely fought on the Korean front, displaying the matchless self-sacrificing spirit. Speeches were made at the ceremony. Ambassador Li Jinjun said the CPV beat back the imperialist aggression together with the Korean army and people under the banner of resisting America and aiding Korea, safeguarding the home and defending the motherland 68 years ago, and thus preserved peace and stability of the region and the world. He expressed the will to continue to strive to steadily carry forward and develop the bilateral friendship which has opened up a new chapter under the deep care of General Secretary Xi Jinping and Chairman Kim Jong Un. Vice-Minister Choe Song Chol said the ceremony reflects the fixed will of the top leaders of the two countries to more firmly carry forward and develop the traditions of the DPRK-China friendship. The exploits performed by the CPV martyrs on this land will shine as a symbol of the DPRK-China friendship in history along with the souls of the Korean revolutionaries on the vast land of China, he added. After the ceremony the participants saw round the cemetery. Rodong News Team

title: IPU President Promises Effort for Improved Inter-Korean Relations
body: Gabriela Cuevas Barron, president of the Inter-Parliamentary Union (IPU), said that she would strive for the improvement of inter-Korean relations. In a recent statement, she welcomed the affirmative events witnessed on the Korean peninsula in the wake of the historic inter-Korean summits and the Singapore DPRK-U.S. summit, and appreciated that the north and the south of Korea are promoting the reconciliation and understanding of each other. The IPU has directed a lot of efforts to the contacts between the north and the south and such effort will continue in the future, too, she said. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK's Holidays Marked Abroad
body: Celebrations were held in Myanmar, Pakistan and Mongolia on Oct. 7 and 9 to mark the 21st anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's election as general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and the 73rd founding anniversary of the WPK. Personages of various strata and masses of the relevant countries were present at the events. The chief editor of the organ of the League for National Democracy of Myanmar said: There are many political parties in the world, but none of them is on a par with the Workers' Party of Korea that has become a harmonious whole with the popular masses and glorified its more than 70 year-long history with victory, enjoying absolute trust of the people. President Kim Il Sung founded the WPK and cemented its foundations and HE Kim Jong Il developed it into a party of the leader, a mass party that has taken roots deep among the popular masses and the guiding force of Korea's society. The WPK led by HE Kim Jong Un is powerfully guiding all the people to socialist construction. The secretary-general of the Karachi Branch of the Pakistan-Korea Friendship Association and other speakers noted that under the wise guidance of the great leaders the WPK has advanced victoriously the people's cause of independence and the cause of socialism, holding high the banner of the Juche idea since its birth and that Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un develops the WPK into the party of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il. Meanwhile, such events as friendly meeting, book and photo exhibition and film show were held at the DPRK missions in Malaysia and Equatorial Guinea on Oct. 5 and 9 to mark the said anniversaries. Rodong News Team

title: Russian Guests Leave
body: The delegation of the Department of International Organizations of the Russian Foreign Ministry led by Deputy Director Mikael Agasandian left Pyongyang for home on Friday. During its visit, the delegation met Pak Myong Guk, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, and other relevant officials, exchanged views on the issues of mutual concern including cooperation in the international arena such as the UN and the development of bilateral relations and reached a consensus. Rodong News Team

title: Japanese Delegation Leaves
body: A delegation of Nippon Sport Science University led by Managing Director Kenshiro Matsunami left Pyongyang for home on Friday. Rodong News Team

title: Romanian Foreign Ministry Delegation Leaves
body: A delegation of the Romanian Foreign Ministry led by Mirela-Carmen Grecu, director of the Department of Culture, Science and Diplomacy, left Pyongyang for home on Friday. Rodong News Team

title: National Footwear Exhibition Closes
body: The 2018 National Footwear Exhibition closed with due ceremony at Pyongyang Department Store No. 1 on Friday. It was co-sponsored by the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea and the Management Bureau for the Shoe-making Industry under the Ministry of Light Industry. Presented to it were tens of thousands of products by 60-odd units from across the country as well as dozens of valuable sci-tech papers. More than 150 000 people visited the exhibition, where shoes presented by the Wonsan Shoes Factory, the Ryuwon Footwear Factory, etc. were in high consumer demand. Various papers were highly appraised at the presentation of sci-tech successes. Present at the closing ceremony were Vice-Premier Ri Ju O, Minister of Light Industry Choe Il Ryong, officials concerned, officials of the units which sent their goods to the exhibition, researchers, technicians, teachers, postgraduates, members of the Three Revolution Team and workers. Rodong News Team

title: Head of WPK Delegation Meets Russian Party Leader
body: Ryu Myong Son, vice department director of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea, met and had a talk with Boris Gryzlov, president of the Supreme Council of the United Russia Party, on Oct. 24. Ryu is attending the 10th general meeting of the international meeting of Asian political parties in Russia as head of the WPK delegation. Referring to the fact that an agreement on exchange and cooperation between the Workers' Party of Korea and the United Russia Party was signed, Boris Gryzlov expressed the belief that the relations between the two parties would further develop in depth. That day, the head of the WPK delegation met with the heads of delegations of the Indian People's Party, the Islamic Coalition Party of Iran, the Communist Party of the Russian Federation and the Japanese Communist Party and other foreign party delegations. Rodong News Team

title: Chinese Delegation Visits Mangyongdae
body: The delegation of Chinese youth cadres on a visit to the DPRK on the occasion of the 68th anniversary of the entry of the Chinese People's Volunteers into the Korean front visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung, on Sunday. At the old home of the President, the guests looked round the historical relics preserved, being briefed on the revolutionary career of the President. The delegation also toured the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum, the Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace, etc. Rodong News Team

title: Reckless Moves of LKP Denounced
body: A spokesperson for the Party for Democracy and Peace in south Korea condemned the reckless moves of the "Liberal Korea Party" (LKP) against peace in a commentary on October 24, according to the south Korean online paper e-Daily. The whole world hopes for peace on the Korean peninsula, the commentary said, adding that the LKP should do acts helpful to achieving peace on the peninsula. Rodong News Team

title: Foreigners Visit Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: Foreigners including the delegation of Chinese youth cadres headed by Li Guiguang, vice-director of the Veteran Office, visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on Sunday. They paid tribute to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. At the halls of immortality where the great leaders lie in state the visitors paid homage to them. They made the rounds of the halls where the orders the great leaders received are on display and the halls that house cars, electric car, boat and train coaches used by them during their field guidance and foreign tours till the last moments of their lives. Rodong News Team

title: 13th Int'l Seminar on Struggle against Neo-liberalism Held
body: The 13th international seminar on the struggle against neo-liberalism took place in Rio de Janeiro of Brazil. Attending it were figures of all social standings and citizens of Brazil. Present there on invitation were an official of the DPRK embassy in the country and other foreign diplomatic envoys. Speeches were made there. The general secretary of the Marxist-Leninist Communist Party of Brazil warmly welcomed the events for peace and prosperity on the Korean peninsula taking place one after another thanks to the energetic activities of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and extended support and solidarity to the Korean people in their struggle in the name of the participants in the seminar. The chairman of the Brazilian Center for the Study of Songun Politics, the Syrian ambassador to Brazil, the Cuban consul general and other personages expressed their admiration at the distinguished political ability of the Supreme Leader who leads the global peace. They said that the reality of the DPRK dynamically advancing in the van of the struggle for socialism and against the imperialism and neo-liberalism gives the faith of victory to the progressive people struggling for independent development of countries and global peace. Rodong News Team

title: Russian Media Praise Exploits of Peerlessly Great Men
body: Russian media dedicated special write-ups including articles titled "The Workers' Party of Korea Is Strong in Independence" and "The Leader of the Workers' Party of Korea" to the 21st anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's election as general secretary of the WPK and the 73rd founding anniversary of the WPK. The website Patrioti Moskva and the website of the Novosibirsk Regional Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation carried special write-ups illustrated with photos of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. The newspaper Komsomolskaya Pravda, in an article illustrated with a photo of smiling image of the President, praised him for leaving an indelible trace in the history of the world's diplomacy through independent diplomacy all his life. The newspaper Zolotoi Log and Zebri Deve, online paper of Khabarovsk Territory, carried articles illustrated with photos of Kim Jong Un. The articles noted that the Korean people are making a series of world-startling successes in the building of socialism. Other websites carried photos of Kim Jong Un. They said the historic inter-Korean summits and Singapore DPRK-U.S. summit showed the international community that he is the most prominent politician in the present century. The newspaper Serp I Molot and the website Irkutskblogspot. Ru introduced the immortal exploits of the peerlessly great men for founding and developing the WPK. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Foreign Ministry Delegation Leaves for Russia
body: A delegation of the Foreign Ministry of the DPRK led by Vice-Minister Sin Hong Chol left here on Saturday to attend the vice-minister-level negotiations between the DPRK and Russian foreign ministries and the celebrations of the 200th foundation anniversary of the Institute of Oriental Studies under the Russian Academy of Sciences. Rodong News Team

title: Congratulations to Ethiopian President
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, on Friday sent a congratulatory message to Sahlework Zewde upon her election as president of the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia. Expressing the belief that the good relations of friendship and cooperation between the two countries would continue to develop on good terms, the message sincerely wished the Ethiopian president big success in her responsible work for the country's peace, stability and development. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korea: LKP Blasted for Hindering Implementation of Panmunjom Declaration
body: Students, youth, civic and public organisations in south Korea held a news conference outside the building of the "Liberal Korea Party" (LKP) on Oct. 24 to condemn the LKP for hindering the implementation of the Panmunjom declaration, according to the south Korean online paper Tongil News. The speakers said that the south-north summit meetings and talks gave a hope that reconciliation between the south and the north would lead to removal of war crisis and peace on the Korean peninsula. They charged that the LKP has opposed the ratification by the "National Assembly" of the Panmunjom declaration supported by the majority of the population. Rodong News Team

title: Inter-Korean Military Talks Held
body: Inter-Korean general-level military talks were held at the Thongil House of Panmunjom on Friday under an agreement of the north-south high-level talks for implementing the historic "September Pyongyang Joint Declaration". Present there were a delegation of the north side headed by Army Lieutenant General of the Korean People's Army An Ik San and a delegation of the south side with Major General Kim To Gyun as chief delegate. At the talks, both sides reviewed in an overall way the first-phase implementation of the military agreement attached to the "September Pyongyang Joint Declaration". And they discussed the practical matters arising in the next-phase implementation and agreed to take necessary steps. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Inspects Samjiyon County
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and supreme commander of the Korean People's Army, inspected Samjiyon County. Supreme Leader of the Party, state and army Kim Jong Un learned about the construction of the township of Samjiyon County. Looking round dwelling houses, service facilities and public buildings newly built in the township area, he said with great appreciation that when he came there in August, framework construction was under way and in just a little more than two months most of them have entered the phase of completion. He was greatly pleased to see Samjiyon County that has taken its fabulous shape as a model cultured city in the mountainous area as wished by the Party. He dropped in at a completed dwelling house where he said that the construction has been done flawlessly while looking round living room, kitchen, bathroom and other parts of the house. All the commanding officers and soldier-builders and shock brigade members who took part in the construction of Samjiyon County have successfully carried out construction tasks for this year including the construction in areas around Lake Chon in Mt Paektu, public and industrial buildings, dwelling houses and road project in the township area, he said with high appreciation. He learned about the construction, provision of raw materials and labor and supply of materials that have been carried out up to now and heard a report about issues arising in the course of construction. Saying that the Cabinet and the Samjiyon County Construction Command plan to carry out all the project construction in the county in four phases by 2021, he said that this differs from the intention of the Party. He added that the Party plans and hopes that the construction would be divided into three phases and be finished within the period of five-year strategy for national economic development, advancing a militant task to work out the plan again to finish the overall construction plan of Samjiyon County ahead of schedule by October 2020 in which falls the 75th anniversary of the WPK, and to unconditionally carry it out. Next year is of a crucial year in completing Samjiyon County construction by 2020, he said, calling for perfectly completing the township construction by next year and setting up scientific and accurate goals for all processes, procedures, phases and years for stepping up other project construction, and for pushing forward it with all state efforts concentrated on it. He said that construction plan for next year, which is second-phase year of the Samjiyon County construction, should be clearly specified and all preparations should be made carefully ranging from assigning projects to construction units in a detailed way to timely providing raw materials, funds, labor and taking transport measures needed for the construction to push forward the construction next year just as it has been done this year. He said that as he stresses every time, emphasizing speed only being obsessed by impatience to unconditionally finish something by a certain time should be prevented, adding that just like other work if the construction is done to be gorgeous in appearance but poor in substance, it will be blamed by the people and future generations for long. He said that shoveling even one shovel of earth and plastering even one square meter should be done with conscience just as the real owner of the house would do, stressing the need to build all structures to be monumental edifices of lasting significance in the era of the Workers' Party by thoroughly ensuring quality on the highest level. He also set forth tasks of wonderfully building the Samjiyon County People's Hospital, the Samjiyon County Sci-tech Library and additional hotels and took measures to organize additional construction labor needed for them. He visited the construction site of the Samjiyon Blueberry Drink Factory which will produce various blueberry drinks and processed goods including blueberry sweet jelly, blueberry juice and blueberry wine. Saying that big progress has been made in a short span of time, he instructed to finish the factory by the end of this year. Kim Jong Un visited the Samjiyon Potato Farina Production Factory. Watching a mountain of potatoes that packed potato storehouses, the Supreme Leader was so glad and spoke highly of the Samjiyon County for reaping a high yield in potato farming despite unusually unfavorable climatic conditions this year. He said that corresponding with the massive production of potato powder, its advantages and effectiveness should be informed to the people and the methods of making various potato powder foods should be widely imparted to them so that they can actively introduce them to their diet. He sat unreservedly on a heap of potatoes with leading officials of the province and county and officials of the factory to have a photo taken. Accompanying him were Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, Jo Yong Won and Kim Yong Su, vice department directors of the C.C., WPK, Kim Chang Son, department director of the State Affairs Commission, and Ma Won Chun, director of the State Affairs Commission. Political News Team

title: Predatory Nature of Capitalism
body: The capitalist class noisily advertises for the development of science and technology as it increases production and makes a “contribution” to the “welfare for all people,” but it is nothing but a sophism to cover up their predatory nature. The growth of the production based on science and technology in the capitalist society does not give a big help to the working class and it drives the broad working people into misfortune and pain. In the capitalist society the monopolists regard the successes in developing science and technology as very good means to satisfy their unlimited cupidity. Today the capitalists get bigger profit than that in the past period by competitively introducing the scientific and technological successes.
