The monopolists have used the scientific and technological successes as means for harshly exploiting the working people. Today the capitalists’ exploitation of the working people is subdivided to the maximum. The capitalists increase their profits by reducing the number of workers at the maximum instead of introducing the scientific and technological successes. Now in the capitalist countries the number of workers reduces and more profits go to the capitalists as the up-to-date scientific and technological successes are introduced to ceaselessly increase the production and improve management activities. The overwhelming majority of working people cannot avoid from suffering damages owing to the exploiting and predatory nature of the capitalist society. The plight of the working people can never be improved in the capitalist society as long as the production means are controlled by a few monopolists. Rim Won

title: 70th Anniversary of DPRK-Romania Diplomatic Ties Marked
body: A photo exhibition opened with due ceremony at the Chollima Hall of Culture on Monday to mark the 70th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic ties between the DPRK and Romania. Attending it were So Ho Won, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries, Ryu Kyong Il, vice-chairman of the DPRK-Romania Friendship Association, officials concerned and Charge d'Affaires ad Interim George Amihaesei-Nicolescu and staff members of the Romanian embassy here. Present on invitation were members of foreign embassies and missions of international bodies here. Speeches were made at the opening ceremony. The participants looked round photos introducing inventors of Romania who produced worldwide inventions. On the same day a film show was given at the hall. Its participants watched a Romanian feature film. Rodong News Team

title: Chinese Delegation Leaves
body: The delegation of Chinese youth cadres headed by Li Guiguang, vice-director of the Veteran Office, left here for home on Monday after visiting the DPRK to mark the 68th anniversary of the entry of the Chinese People's Volunteers into the Korean front. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of Educational Officials Leaves for Russia
body: A delegation of educational officials of Kim Chaek University of Technology led by President Hong So Hon left here on Monday to visit Russia. Rodong News Team

title: EP Delegation Here
body: A delegation of the European Parliament Delegation for Relations with Korean Peninsula led by Chairman Nirj Deva arrived here on Monday. Rodong News Team

title: Russian Delegation Here
body: A delegation of former diplomats of Russia arrived here on Monday to mark the 70th anniversary of the establishment of DPRK-Russia diplomatic ties. Rodong News Team

title: 2018 World Day for Audiovisual Heritage Workshop Held
body: A workshop took place at the Grand People's Study House on Monday to mark 2018 World Day for Audiovisual Heritage. Attending it were officials of relevant units including the Grand People's Study House and members of the Beijing Office of UNESCO and the Asia and Pacific Regional Committee for World's Heritage. Speakers at the workshop said that world's heritage make people know about histories and cultures of countries and enrich people's life and promote the development of science and technology. They expressed expectation that the workshop will be a good occasion in raising social interest in heritage, improving the work for protection and use of audiovisual heritage and hastening the work to attain the sustainable development goals of the UN. The workshop heard several speeches underlining the need for protection and use of world's heritage and explaining about the successes and experience gained in this work and international activities. The participants watched a video on protection of world's heritage. Rodong News Team

title: Pyongyang Int'l Exhibition of Green Building Materials, Furniture Opens
body: The Pyongyang international exhibition of green building materials and furniture opened with due ceremony at the Three-Revolution Exhibition House on Monday. Presented to it are green building materials produced by companies of the DPRK, China and other countries through application of the latest sci-tech achievements as well as scientific and technological data and multi-purpose furniture. Present at the opening ceremony were Vice-Premier Ri Ryong Nam, Minister of External Economic Relations Kim Yong Jae, Chairman of the Central Committee of the Architects Union of Korea Sim Yong Hak, officials concerned and officials of the exhibiting units, and foreign diplomatic envoys here. Pak Ung Sik, president of the Korean International Exhibition Corporation, made an opening address before a congratulatory speech by Ri Chung Gil, chairman of the State Commission of Science and Technology. At the end of the ceremony the participants looked around the exhibition hall. The exhibition will last till November 1. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korean Youths Demand Withdrawal of U.S. Forces
body: Youths affiliated to the anti-U.S. expedition for removal of the evils of division and withdrawal of U.S. forces in south Korea reportedly launched a struggle demanding the pullout of the U.S. troops on October 26. That day they held a press conference outside the U.S. military base in Tongduchon to declare that they would conduct an action urging the withdrawal of the U.S. forces in Tongduchon, Phyongthaek and Seoul until Nov. 3. At the end of the press conference they scattered written protests denouncing the crimes of GIs in south Korea. The protest termed the U.S. troops a group of criminals. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of Chinese Artistes to Visit DPRK
body: A delegation of artistes of the People's Republic of China headed by Minister of Culture and Tourism Luo Shugang will pay a goodwill visit to the Democratic People's Republic of Korea from November 2 at the invitation of the DPRK Ministry of Culture. Rodong News Team

title: Parliamentary Talks between DPRK and EU
body: Talks were held between the DPRK-EU Friendship Parliamentary Group and a delegation of the European Parliament Delegation for Relations with Korean Peninsula at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Tuesday. Present there from the DPRK side were Chairman Ri Jong Hyok and members of the group and from the opposite side were members of the delegation led by Chairman Nirj Deva. At the talks both sides exchanged views on the issue of further developing the relations between the two parliaments and a series of issues of mutual concern. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Information Committee Delegation Returns
body: The delegation of the Information Committee of the DPRK led by Vice-Chairman Jo Yong Sam returned home on Tuesday after visiting Britain, France and Hong Kong of China. Rodong News Team

title: WPK Delegation Back Home
body: A delegation of the Workers' Party of Korea led by Ryu Myong Son, vice department director of its Central Committee, returned home on Tuesday after visiting the Russian Federation. Rodong News Team

title: Talks between Court Presidents of DPRK and Russia
body: Talks were held between Kang Yun Sok, president of the Central Court of the DPRK, and Vyacheslav Lebedev, president of the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation, at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Tuesday. Present at the talks from the DPRK side were officials concerned and from the Russian side were members of the delegation of the Supreme Court of Russia and the Russian ambassador to the DPRK. The talks discussed the issues of further developing the exchange and cooperation between judicial organs of the two countries. Rodong News Team

title: Russian Delegation Visits Liberation Tower
body: A delegation of the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation headed by its President Vyacheslav Lebedev laid a wreath at the Liberation Tower on Tuesday. Accompanying it were Choe Kun Yong, first vice-president of the Central Court of the DPRK, and Ambassador Alexandr Matsegora and staff members of the Russian embassy here. The wreath in the name of the president of the Supreme Court of Russia was placed at the tower. The visitors paid a silent tribute to the memory of fallen soldiers of the Soviet Army in battles for Korea's liberation before going round the tower. Rodong News Team

title: Russian Supreme Court Delegation Here
body: A delegation of the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation headed by President Vyacheslav Lebedev arrived here on Tuesday. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korea: LKP Accused of Checking Improvement of North-South Relations
body: The South Side Committee for Implementing June 15 Joint Declaration reportedly held a news conference outside the building of the "Liberal Korea Party" on Oct. 25 to criticize the LKP for trying to break peace of the Korean peninsula and check the improvement of the north-south relations. The LKP is opposing the ratification of the Pyongyang Joint Declaration and the military agreement at the "National Assembly", not content with groundlessly rejecting the NA ratification of the Panmunjom declaration, the organization charged in its press release. Noting that all Koreans and the international community are hailing the inter-Korean summit meetings and talks and negotiated development of the south-north relations in various fields, it pointed out that LKP does not want peace of the Korean peninsula and development of the south-north relations. LKP should stop its act of making the inter-Korean cooperation a topic of political strife, it held. Rodong News Team

title: "World Taekwon-Do" Visiting Group Arrives
body: A visiting group of the "World Taekwon-Do" led by President Jo Jong Won arrived in Pyongyang on Tuesday. On the same day the International Taekwon-Do Federation hosted a reception for the visiting group. Rodong News Team

title: Nepalese Figure Lauds DPRK
body: The Nepalese newspaper Gorkha Express carried an article on the Juche idea, contributed by its editor-in-chief, with a photo of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. The article said that although the territory of the DPRK is not large, it could fully display its might, adding the secret is that it has been led by the prominent leaders and guided by the great idea. The article went on to say: The Juche idea was founded by President Kim Il Sung, and today Marshal Kim Jong Un leads the work to thoroughly apply the requirements of the idea in all fields. The great vitality of the idea has been fully displayed in the DPRK. The DPRK, which embodied the Juche idea, is firmly adhering to the principles of independence in politics, self-support in the economy and self-reliance in national defense. The revolution and construction in this country are carried out in reliance on the people's strength. Without independence in politics, self-support in the economy and self-reliance in defense, is it impossible to build an independent state. Since it has developed on the basis of the Juche idea, the DPRK remains unfazed by any sanctions. The author appealed to the Nepalese revolutionaries to study the Juche idea and positively apply it to the reality of their country. Rodong News Team

title: Korean Book, Photo and Fine Art Exhibition Held in Russia
body: A Korean book, photo and fine art exhibition took place in Krasnoyarsk City of Russia on Oct. 25-28 to mark the 70th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the DPRK and Russia. On display there were photos showing the exploits performed by President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un for the development of the DPRK-Russia friendly ties. There were also books, photos and fine art works introducing the reality of Juche Korea advancing towards the final victory. Attending the opening ceremony were figures of all social standings and citizens in the city and DPRK officials concerned working in Russia. The exhibition is of greater significance as it goes with the 70th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the two countries as an occasion, the deputy director of the Krasnoyarsk City Administration said, adding: The DPRK is now making signal achievements in all fields under the wise guidance of respected HE Kim Jong Un. We hope that exchange and cooperation between the two countries would get brisker. Rodong News Team

title: Sci-Tech Presentation in Field of Construction
body: A national sci-tech presentation in the field of construction took place at the Sci-Tech Complex on Oct. 30-31. It brought together teachers, researchers, designers and postgraduates of Pyongyang University of Architecture and the Green Architecture Institute under the State Academy of Sciences and other units. More than 30 valuable papers were submitted to the presentation. Rodong News Team

title: Message of Sympathy to Indonesian President
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, on Tuesday sent a message of sympathy to Joko Widodo, president of the Republic of Indonesia, over the recent crash of an airliner in the country that claimed heavy casualties. The message expressed condolences to the president, the victims and the bereaved families, hoping that the Indonesian government and people would overcome the sorrow over the accident as soon as possible. Rodong News Team

title: Gift to Kim Jong Un from President of Russian Supreme Court
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a gift from Vyacheslav Lebedev, president of the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation. The gift was handed over to Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, on Wednesday by Vyacheslav Lebedev who is leading the visiting delegation of the Supreme Court of Russia. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Yong Nam Meets Russian Delegation
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, had a talk with the delegation of the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation headed by its President Vyacheslav Lebedev which paid a courtesy call on him at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Wednesday. Rodong News Team

title: Russian Supreme Court Delegation Visits Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: A delegation of the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation headed by its President Vyacheslav Lebedev visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on Wednesday. The members of the delegation paid tribute to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. At the halls of immortality where the great leaders lie in state the visitors paid homage to them. They made the rounds of the halls where the orders the great leaders received are on display and the halls that house cars, electric car, boat and train coaches used by them during their field guidance and foreign tours till the last moments of their lives. Rodong News Team

title: Negotiations between DPRK and Russian Foreign Ministries
body: Vice-Minister Sin Hong Chol who is visiting Russia as head of a DPRK Foreign Ministry delegation had negotiations with his Russian counterpart Igor Morgulov in Moscow on Tuesday. At the negotiations, both sides stressed that the strategic and traditional DPRK-Russia relations are further strengthening in conformity with the common interests and demand of the new era with the 70th anniversary of the establishment of bilateral diplomatic ties as a momentum. They agreed to further accelerate the development of the bilateral relations and boost mutual cooperation so as to positively contribute to peace and stability in the Korean peninsula and the region in next year marking the 70th anniversary of the DPRK-Russia agreement on economic and cultural cooperation. Earlier, the DPRK Foreign Ministry delegation attended the celebrations of the bicentenary of the Institute of Oriental Studies of the Russian Academy of Sciences. Rodong News Team

title: Removal of Evils Called for in S. Korea
body: A spokesperson of the Jongui Party of south Korea held a press conference on October 28 to call for uprooting deep-seated evils, according to News 1 of south Korea. Recalling that candlelight rallies took place two years after the citizens enraged by the Park Geun Hye "government's" scandal of "state affairs" turned out to candlelight demonstrations in demand of the impeachment, the spokesperson said that it was because evil forces and their remnants still remain in different sectors of the society. Removal of evils is a task of the times which brooks no further delay and an order of the people, he said. Rodong News Team

title: LKP's Denounced for Blocking NA Ratification of Panmunjom Declaration
body: A spokesperson for the Party for Democracy and Peace in south Korea in a commentary on October 28 condemned the "Liberal Korea Party" (LKP) for having blocked the ratification of the Panmunjom declaration at the "National Assembly", according to a news report from south Korea. The spokesperson said that what remains to be done by LKP is to cooperate in the NA ratification of the declaration as early as possible, adding that it is the intention of the people and demand of history. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of SWUK Leaves for Vietnam
body: A delegation of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea (SWUK) headed by Jang Chun Sil, chairwoman of its Central Committee, left here on Thursday to visit the Socialist Republic of Vietnam. Rodong News Team

title: European Parliament Delegation Visits Mangyongdae
body: A delegation of the European Parliament Delegation for Relations with Korean Peninsula led by Chairman Nirj Deva visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. The visitors saw round historical relics at the old home of the President, being told about the revolutionary history of the President and the patriotic lives of his family members. They also toured the Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace, the Munsu Rehabilitation Clinic and the European Union's aid projects in Anbyon County, Kangwon Province. Rodong News Team

title: Anniversary of Diplomatic Ties between DPRK and Mongolia Marked
body: A film show took place at the Taedonggang Diplomatic Club on Thursday to mark the 70th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic ties between the DPRK and Mongolia. Present there were Jo Chol Ryong, vice-chairman of the DPRK-Mongolia Friendship Association, officials concerned, youth and students and officials of the Mongolian embassy here. The participants watched a Mongolian documentary film. Rodong News Team

title: Pyongyang Int'l Exhibition of Green Building Materials, Furniture Closes
body: The Pyongyang international exhibition of green building materials and furniture which opened on Oct. 29 closed with due ceremony at the Three-Revolution Exhibition House on Thursday. The exhibition marked an important occasion in further strengthening the many-sided economic cooperation and scientific and technological exchange among countries in the field of green building materials and furniture industry. Present at the closing ceremony were Vice-Premier Ri Ryong Nam, Minister of External Economic Relations Kim Yong Jae, Chairman of the State Commission of Science and Technology Ri Chung Gil, officials concerned and officials of the exhibiting units, and foreign guests. Rodong News Team

title: President of Cuban Council of State to Visit DPRK
body: At the invitation of Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez, president of the Council of State and president of the Council of Ministers of the Republic of Cuba, will soon visit the DPRK. Rodong News Team

title: Russian Supreme Court Delegation Leaves
body: The delegation of the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation headed by President Vyacheslav Lebedev left here for home on Thursday. Rodong News Team

title: Implementation of Inter-Korean Declarations Is Key to Independent Reunification
body: It is the daily-growing aspiration and will of Koreans to achieve independent reunification, peace and prosperity under the unfurled banner of the Panmunjom Declaration and the “September Pyongyang Joint Declaration”. It is necessary to thoroughly implement the two declarations in accordance with the aspiration and demand of the compatriots for the improved north-south relations and national reunification so as to radically develop the inter-Korean relations and bring a durable peace to the Korean peninsula as soon as possible. It is the vital demand of the Korean nation and a crucial issue related to the destiny of the fellow countrymen to develop the inter-Korean relations, ease the military tension on the Korean peninsula and remove the danger of war. A permanent and durable peace-keeping mechanism should be established on the Korean peninsula which has been plagued with the most acute and tense situation on the earth. This constitutes a big contribution to providing peaceful and safe life to the fellow countrymen and securing peace and stability in Northeast Asia and the rest of the world. The Panmunjom Declaration and the “September Pyongyang Joint Declaration” serve as the programmes common to the nation, realistic and reasonable, for fully meeting the will and desire of the whole nation as well as the aspirations of the international community for peace and reunification of the Korean peninsula. The full implementation of the historic declarations guarantees the sustained development of inter-Korean relations, peace of the Korean peninsula and co-prosperity of the nation, independent reunification and a rosy future of the nation. Sim Chol Yong

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Introduced in DR Congo
body: The full text of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "National Heritage Conservation Is a Patriotic Undertaking for Adding Brilliance to the History and Traditions of Our Nation" was posted by the National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of Democratic Congo on its website on Oct. 29. The work, published on Oct. 24, Juche 103 (2014), deals with the fact that President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il made efforts for the national heritage conservation during their revolutionary leadership, with priority given to it, and added brilliance to the long history and splendid culture of the Korean nation before the world. The work also elucidates the tasks of thoroughly implementing the Workers' Party of Korea's policy for the national heritage conservation, firmly championing their undying feats and adding brilliance to the history and traditions of the Korean nation. A photo of the Supreme Leader was also posted on the website. Rodong News Team

title: Anti-reunification Act of "Liberal Korea Party" Protested
body: Not content with having obstructed the ratification of the Panmunjom Declaration at the "National Assembly", the "Liberal Korea Party" said it would make an "application of provisional disposition of halt to effect" as to the Pyongyang joint declaration and agreement in the military field under the pretext of the so-called "procedural issue", according to Yonhap News, the internet paper Jaju Sibo, etc. of south Korea. A spokesperson for the Party for Democracy and Peace said that the only LKP fails to abandon its conservative Cold War way of thinking at a time when the whole world anticipates peace of the Korean peninsula and stressed that the implementation of the declaration is the will of the people and demand of history. The South Side Committee for Implementing June 15 Joint Declaration pointed out that the LKP's act of slandering the "September Pyongyang Joint Declaration" betrayed that it has no desire for peace of the Korean peninsula and the development of inter-Korean relations. It urged the LKP to immediately scrap its policy of confrontation running counter to the era of the north-south reconciliation and cooperation. Other organizations warned that the conservative remnants would only face the judgment of history, unless it kicks its bad habit. Rodong News Team

title: European Parliament Delegation Leaves
body: A delegation of the European Parliament Delegation for Relations with Korean Peninsula led by Chairman Nirj Deva left here on Friday. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of Educationists of Kim Chaek University of Technology Back Home
body: A delegation of educationists of Kim Chaek University of Technology led by President Hong So Hon came back home on Friday after visiting Russia. Rodong News Team

title: Youth League Delegation Back Home
body: A delegation of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League led by Jong Yong Won, secretary of its Central Committee, came back home on Friday after visiting Russia. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Foreign Ministry Delegation Back Home
body: A delegation of the DPRK Foreign Ministry led by Vice-Minister Sin Hong Chol came back home on Friday after taking part in the vice-foreign ministerial negotiations of the DPRK and Russia and the celebrations of the 200th founding anniversary of the Institute of Oriental Studies of the Russian Academy of Sciences. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Players Return Home
body: DPRK players returned home on Friday after taking part in the 2018 Asian junior and 23 canoe championship held in Uzbekistan. The championship drew more than 180 men and women players from 19 countries and regions including the DPRK, China, Iran and Kazakhstan The Korean players won two gold medals and two silver medals. Jong Ye Song placed first at the junior women's canoeing single 200m and 500m games. Jong Ye Song and Cha Un Yong placed second at the junior women's canoeing double 200m and 500m games. Rodong News Team

title: Wife of President of Council of State of Cuba Visits Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace
body: Wife of the president of the Council of State and president of the Council of Ministers of the Republic of Cuba Lis Cuesta Perasa visited the Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace on Sunday. She was accompanied by Ri Sol Ju, wife of the chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK. Lis Cuesta Perasa and her party were warmly greeted by Choe Hwi, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and officials of the palace. Teachers of the palace and schoolchildren warmly welcomed the wife of the Cuban president, presenting a bouquet to her. She was guided to the rooms for the Korean dance and kayagum groups and a swimming pool, etc., being told that Korean schoolchildren are developing their talents and desires at the palace. Ri Sol Ju and Lis Cuesta Perasa saw a performance given by members of the art group of the palace. Political News Team

title: Congratulations to President of Ireland
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, sent a congratulatory message to Michael Higgins upon his reelection as president of the Republic of Ireland on Nov. 2. The message wished the president of Ireland greater success in his responsible work for the prosperity of the country and the people's wellbeing. Rodong News Team

title: Chinese Artistes Delegation Arrives
body: The delegation of artistes of the People's Republic of China arrived here on Nov. 2 to pay a goodwill visit to the DPRK at the invitation of the Ministry of Culture of the DPRK. The delegation headed by Luo Shugang, minister of Culture and Tourism, consists of famous singers, film and dance actors and actresses and other prestigious artistes of China. Rodong News Team

title: Samjiyon Orchestra Gives Performance to Welcome Chinese Artistes
body: A performance was given at the Theatre of the Samjiyon Orchestra on Friday to welcome the Chinese delegation of artistes on a goodwill visit to the DPRK. Present there on invitation were members of the Chinese delegation of artistes headed by Minister of Culture and Tourism Luo Shugang, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK Li Jinjun and his embassy officials. Among the audience were Pak Kwang Ho and Ri Su Yong, members of the Political Bureau and vice-chairmen of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Pak Chun Nam, minister of Culture, An Tong Chun, chairman of the Central Committee of the General Federation of the Unions of Art and Literature of Korea, officials, creators and artistes in the field of culture and art. Put on the stage, which started with a prelude Chinese song "Our New Era", represented with peculiar musical melodies the ideological emotion and friendship of the two countries. In female solos "Pyongyang Is Best", "Fly High, Our Party Flag" and orchestra "We'll Travel One Road Forever" the performers made an ideological and artistic representation of the dignity and pride of the Korean people. The female solo "Song of Changjiang" and female chorus "The Fluttering Red Flag" reflecting patriotism, national emotion and optimistic lives of the Chinese people delighted the Chinese guests. At the end of the performance the Chinese delegation of artistes and staff members of the Chinese embassy presented bouquets and floral baskets to the performers in congratulation of their successful performance. Rodong News Team

title: Reception Given to Welcome Chinese Delegation of Artistes
body: The Ministry of Culture of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea gave a reception at Pyongyang Koryo Hotel on Friday in honor of the delegation of artistes of the People's Republic of China on a goodwill visit to the DPRK. Present there on invitation were the Chinese delegation of artistes headed by Minister of Culture and Tourism Luo Shugang, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK Li Jinjun and his embassy officials. Pak Kwang Ho and Ri Su Yong, members of the Political Bureau and vice-chairmen of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Pak Chun Nam, minister of Culture, officials concerned and artistes were on hand. Pak Chun Nam in his speech at the reception warmly welcomed the Chinese artistes delegation which came here with the Chinese people's feelings of friendship. He said that the Korean people expect with great interest the performance of the famous artistes specially chosen and dispatched by the Chinese party and government. He noted that the current visit of Chinese artistes after the one in last April will offer an important occasion in further strengthening the DPRK-China friendship and vigorously accelerating the cultural and artistic exchange between the two countries. Luo Shugang said that the delegation's visit to the DPRK which is the practical embodiment of the important common understanding achieved by General Secretary Xi Jinping and Chairman Kim Jong Un at the historic summits would give an impetus to the development of the relations between the two parties and countries. Luo Shugang said that the current visit to the DPRK by a Chinese delegation of the artistes, a practice of the important joint understanding achieved by General Secretary Xi Jinping and Chairman Kim Jong Un at the historic meetings, will bring a new motive force to the development of the two parties and the two countries. It is the firm policy of the Chinese party and government to steadily consolidate and develop the China-DPRK friendship, he said, adding that the Chinese artistes would boost the traditional friendship and exchange with Korean comrades and thus positively promote the development of the relations between the two parties and the two countries. Rodong News Team

title: Inter-Korean Talks for Sports Held
body: Inter-Korean talks for sports took place at the north-south joint liaison office on Friday under the agreement at the inter-Korean high-level talks for implementing the historic "September Pyongyang Joint Declaration". Present there were the north side's delegation led by Won Kil U, vice-minister of Physical Culture and Sports, and the south side's delegation with Ro Thae Gang, vice-minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism, as chief delegate. At the talks both sides discussed the practical issues for activating cooperation and exchange in the field of sports to demonstrate the dignity of the nation and united appearance in the international games and adopted a joint press release. Rodong News Team

title: Joint Demonstration Given by Groups of ITF and WT
body: Demonstration groups of the International Taekwon-Do Federation and the "World Taekwon-Do" gave a joint demonstration at the Taekwon-Do Hall on Friday. Among the spectators were Choe Hwi, chairman of the National Sports Guidance Committee, Kim Kyong Ho, chairman of the Korean Taekwon-Do Committee, officials concerned and sportspersons. Major members of the ITF including President Ri Yong Son and members of the visiting group of the "World Taekwon-Do" led by President Jo Jong Won watched the demonstration. Prior to this, a demonstration was given by the demonstration group of the "World Taekwon-Do" at the Taekwon-Do Hall. The visiting group saw around the Taekwon-Do Holy House and toured the Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace, the Central Zoo, etc. Rodong News Team

title: GFTUK Delegation Leaves for Laos
body: A delegation of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea (GFTUK) led by Ju Yong Gil, chairman of its Central Committee, left Pyongyang on Saturday to visit the Lao People's Democratic Republic. Rodong News Team

title: SWUK Delegation Leaves for Cuba and El Salvador
body: A delegation of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea (SWUK) led by Chae Chun Hui, vice-chairwoman of its Central Committee, left here on Saturday to attend meetings of the Women's International Democratic Federation to be held in Cuba and El Salvador. Rodong News Team

title: Chinese Artistes Delegation Leaves
body: The delegation of artistes of the People's Republic of China headed by Luo Shugang, minister of Culture and Tourism, left here for home on Monday after successfully winding up its goodwill visit to the DPRK. Artistes of the DPRK gave the Chinese artistes a cordial send-off. Rodong News Team

title: Joint Performance Given by Artistes of DPRK and China
body: A joint performance of the artistes of the DPRK and China was given at the Mansudae Art Theatre on Monday. Among the audience were Choe Hwi, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK); Ri Ryong Nam, vice-premier of the Cabinet; An Tong Chun, chairman of the C.C., the General Federation of the Unions of Art and Literature of Korea; Pak Chun Sik, vice-minister of Culture, officials, creators, artistes and teachers and students in the field of culture and arts. Present there on invitation were leading members of the Chinese delegation of artistes including its head Luo Shugang, and Chinese Ambassador to the DPRK Li Jinjun and his embassy officials. Put on the stage were favorite songs of the peoples of the two countries such as female solo "Ardent Desire", male solo "The Fluttering Red Flag", mixed duet "New World", female duet "Song of Changjiang" and choruses "Blue Sky over My Country" and "I Love My Chinese Nation". The songs of the famous artistes of the two countries were acclaimed by the audience. The audience congratulated the performers on their successful performance, presenting bouquets to them. Rodong News Team

title: Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez Visits Mangyongdae Revolutionary School
body: Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez, president of the Council of State and president of the Council of Ministers of the Republic of Cuba, visited Mangyongdae Revolutionary School on Monday. He was greeted and accompanied by Army General Kim Su Gil, director of the General Political Bureau of the Korean People's Army. The friendly missions of the Cuban people were warmly welcomed by senior officials, teaching staff and students of the school and families of servicemen. There took place a ceremony of greeting by the guard of honor of the school. Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez together with Kim Su Gil reviewed the guard of honor of the school. A student of the school presented a bouquet to Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez. The guests watched a march-past and martial art training of the students of the school. Being briefed on the proud path of the development of the school and the fact that the students are growing up to be successors to firmly carry forward the revolution under the care of the Workers' Party of Korea, Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez saw round the revolutionary museum, several lecture rooms and gymnasium. Rodong News Team

title: Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez Visits Kim Il Sung University
body: Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez, president of the Council of State and president of the Council of Ministers of the Republic of Cuba, and his wife Lis Cuesta Perasa visited Kim Il Sung University on Monday. They were accompanied by Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and premier of the Cabinet, together with the members of the Cuban delegation and staff members of the Cuban embassy here. They were warmly greeted by Kim Sung Du, chairman of the Education Commission, and officials of the university. Students of the university presented bouquets to the Cuban president and his wife. Being briefed on the fact that the university has successfully performed a pivotal role in training national cadres and developing the country's science and technology, the Cuban guests looked round the revolutionary museum, e-library and swimming pool of the university. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Yong Nam Meets Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, met with Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez, president of the Council of State and president of the Council of Ministers of the Republic of Cuba, who paid a courtesy call on him, at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Monday. Present there were Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, and Kim Sung Du, chairman of the Education Commission who is chairman of the Korean Committee for Solidarity with Cuba. Present there were members of the delegation of the Republic of Cuba and Jesus De Los Angeles Aise Sotolongo, Cuban ambassador to the DPRK. Kim Yong Nam had a talk with Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez. Rodong News Team

title: Wife of President of Cuban Council of State Visits Kim Won Gyun University of Music
body: Lis Cuesta Perasa, wife of the president of the Council of State and president of the Council of Ministers of the Republic of Cuba, visited Kim Won Gyun University of Music on Monday. She was warmly greeted and accompanied by Ri Sol Ju, wife of the chairman of the DPRK State Affairs Commission, together with Pak Thae Song, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials concerned and those of the university. She was warmly welcomed by the students of the university with bunches of flowers. She was guided to various lecture rooms of the university, being briefed on the history of the university which has developed into a pedigree establishment for training the reliable music and art talents of the country. Ri Sol Ju and Lis Cuesta Perasa enjoyed a performance of the orchestra of the university at its concert hall. Rodong News Team

title: Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez Visits Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez, president of the Council of State and president of the Council of Ministers of the Republic of Cuba, visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on Monday. The members of the Cuban delegation were accompanied by Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the WPK Central Committee, Ri Yong Ho, member of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and foreign minister. A floral basket in the name of the Republic of Cuba was laid before the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez paid respects to the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il. At the halls of immortality where the great leaders lie in state, he paid homage to them. He and the members of the delegation were guided to the halls where the orders the great leaders received are on display and the halls that house cars, electric car, boat and train coaches used by them during their field guidance and foreign tours till the last moments of their lives. He made an entry in the visitor's book. Rodong News Team

title: Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez Visits Mansudae Art Studio
body: Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez, president of the Council of State and president of the Council of Ministers of the Republic of Cuba, and his wife Lis Cuesta Perasa visited the Mansudae Art Studio on Monday. Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, and his wife Ri Sol Ju accompanied Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez and his wife. Supreme Leader of the Party, state and army Kim Jong Un and his wife, Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez and his wife were warmly greeted by leading officials of the studio. The Cuban president and his wife looked round the exhibition hall of fine art works, being told that the studio has developed into a world-class art studio. The Cuban president and his wife were deeply impressed to see the fine art works as valuable as national treasures. Political News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sees Grand Gymnastics and Artistic Performance with Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, saw the grand gymnastics and artistic performance "The Glorious Country" together with Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez, president of the Council of State and president of the Council of Ministers of the Republic of Cuba, on Monday evening. Supreme Leader of the Party, state and army Kim Jong Un and his wife Ri Sol Ju came out to the platform seats of the May Day Stadium together with President Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez and his wife Lis Cuesta Perasa. Children presented bouquets to the supreme leader and the Cuban president and their wives. Among the audience were Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the WPK Central Committee, Premier Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, senior Party and government officials Ri Su Yong, Pak Thae Song, Ri Yong Ho and Kim Nung O, officials of the Cabinet, ministries and national institutions, and working people, youths and students of Pyongyang. Commanding officers of the Korean People's Army including Kim Su Gil, Ri Yong Gil and No Kwang Chol, and other KPA service personnel were also present to see the performance. The members of the Cuban delegation, the Cuban ambassador to the DPRK and his embassy officials were invited to see the performance. The grand gymnastics and artistic performance began, unfolding a sea of welcoming dancers at the stadium swept by warm friendly feelings toward the Cuban people. The performers gave grand epical descriptions of the history of the victorious and glorious socialist country which is prospering with self-reliance and demonstrating its dignity and might under the guidance of the great party, holding the peerlessly great men in high esteem. The atmosphere of the performance reached its climax with the chapter of DPRK-Cuba friendship reflecting the will of the peoples of the two countries to add eternal brilliance to the traditions of the fraternal and militant friendship and solidarity forged in the struggle for independence and socialism against imperialism. When the performance ended, fireworks were set off to gorgeously decorate the nocturnal sky of Pyongyang. The Supreme Leader and the Cuban president warmly waved back to the performers and the audience with their hands joined and upraised. The Supreme Leader, together with the Cuban president, congratulated the performers on their magnificent performance. Political News Team

title: Educational System of DPRK Introduced by Russian and Cambodian Media
body: Russian and Cambodian media introduced the educational system of the DPRK. The Russian newspaper Komsomolskaya Pravda said: The universal 12-year compulsory education, the highest level in the world, is being enforced in the DPRK. This educational system is the one in which the state bears all expenses needed for education. In particular, the DPRK has paid special attention to the education of gifted children and not spared investment for it. The Cambodian AKP aired: The national interest to improve the educational environment and conditions has risen higher at present and the traits of helping educational organs have been established in the DPRK. The universal 12-year compulsory education system now in force in this country serves as a sure guarantee for raising the general cultural and technical level of society and continuously developing society and economy, and a foundation for training the gifted persons. Over the fact that a child of the DPRK became a triple Olympic medalist of the International Math Olympiad, lots of educators in the world admire the DPRK as a country which has many talents and the one which is very high in its educational level. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of Young Chongryon Officials Pays Tribute to President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: A delegation of young officials of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on Tuesday. Members of the delegation laid a bouquet before the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il and bowed to them. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of Young Chongryon Officials Arrives
body: A delegation of young officials of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan led by Pak Ok Sam, vice-chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the Korean Youth League in Japan, arrived here on Tuesday. Rodong News Team

title: Indonesian Embassy Officials Do Friendship Labor
body: Staff members of the Indonesian embassy here did a friendship labor at the DPRK-Indonesia Friendship Yaksu Cooperative Farm in Kangso District on Tuesday. Being briefed on the leadership exploits of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il for the farm, they made rounds of the room dedicated to the history of the farm and others before helping farmers in farm work. At a break they had a talk with officials of the farm. They handed over aid materials to the farm. Rodong News Team

title: New Society Called for in S. Korea
body: The south Korean Confederation of Trade Unions held a rally in Youido of Seoul on October 30 to declare a struggle for building a new society, according to a news report from south Korea. The organization in a resolution said that two years have passed since a candlelight struggle was waged in demand of the impeachment of Park Geun Hye, but all sorts of evils that made a mockery of the "state affairs" and the people still remain, adding that it will wage an active struggle for the right to existence with the beginning of the struggle for a pension reform of the people as an occasion. At the end of the rally the participants waged a demonstration. Rodong News Team

title: Senegalese President Supports DPRK
body: Chae Hui Chol, DPRK ambassador to Senegal, presented his credentials to Senegalese President Macky Sall on November 2. The president hoped that the DPRK would continuously achieve good fruition in building a powerful country under the leadership of Chairman Kim Jong Un. Saying that the friendly relations between the two countries have favorably developed from several decades ago by former President Leopold Sedar Sengor and President Kim Il Sung, the Senegal president expressed his intention to develop the bilateral cooperative relations in various fields in the future. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sees Off Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez
body: Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez, president of the Council of State and president of the Council of Ministers of the Republic of Cuba, who paid a visit to the DPRK at the invitation of Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, left Pyongyang by his personal plane on Tuesday after winding up his successful visit. Supreme Leader of the Party, state and army Kim Jong Un came to the airport together with his wife Ri Sol Ju and warmly saw off Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez and his wife Lis Cuesta Perasa. Kim Jong Un and his wife waited for Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez and his wife to see them off at the airport. Present at the airport to see off the honored guests from fraternal Cuba were Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the WPK Central Committee, Premier Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, Ri Su Yong and Pak Thae Song, members of the Political Bureau and vice-chairmen of the WPK Central Committee, Ri Yong Ho, member of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and foreign minister, Kim Nung O, alternate member of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and chairman of the Pyongyang City Committee of the WPK, Ri Ryong Nam, vice-premier of the Cabinet, and Ma Chol Su, DPRK ambassador to Cuba. Army General Kim Su Gil, director of the General Political Bureau of the Korean People's Army, Army General Ri Yong Gil, chief of the KPA General Staff, Army General No Kwang Chol, minister of the People's Armed Forces, and other commanding officers of the KPA were also present there. After Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez and his wife got off a car, the Supreme Leader and his wife exchanged greetings and their inmost feelings, holding hands together. A ceremony took place to see off Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez, president of the Council of State and president of the Council of Ministers of the Republic of Cuba, at the airport. The leaders of the two countries and their wives respectively exchanged good-byes with the members of the delegation of the Republic of Cuba, and party, state and army officials of the DPRK side who came to see off. Feeling sorry to part with Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez with whom he forged warm and sincere feelings and became closer though the stay was only two nights and three days, Kim Jong Un said that he would look forward to meeting him again and wished him good health and happiness and continued success in his work. He added that no matter how the world may change, he and the party and the people of the DPRK will always stand by the Cuban people and Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez, wishing him safe journey. Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez said that he could never forget his Pyongyang visit during which he was accorded the best privilege and cordial hospitality, adding that he carries with him the warm fraternal fellowship and the feelings of friendship of Kim Jong Un and the Korean people who showed warm and heartfelt welcome with all sincerity. The leaders of the two countries had firm hand-shaking of farewell and warm hugs, promising to keep holding hands raised under the banner of socialism and keep advancing socialist construction in the two countries along the only road of victory. The Supreme Leader and his wife Ri Sol Ju waved their hands long toward the plane carrying Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez and his wife out of sincere and warm feelings toward the fraternal Cuban people. Political News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Work Introduced by Russian Organization
body: The Association for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism of Russia in the Far East Region posted on its website the full text of Chairman Kim Jong Il's work "Socialism Is a Science" on November 2 to mark the 24th anniversary of the publication of the work. The work, published on November 1, Juche 83 (1994), clarifies the idea that Korean-style socialism based on the socialist theory of Juche is the most scientific and vital one. And it expounds the principled matters arising in defending socialism. Rodong News Team

title: Japanese Authorities' Discrimination against Korean School Students in Japan Protested
body: A Friday action was launched outside the Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology of Japan in Tokyo on November 2 in demand of the application of tuition waiver program to Korean schools in Japan. It was attended by students of Korean University, Koreans in Japan, overseas compatriots and Japanese personages. Speakers said that the Tokyo High Court did not advance in a trial the reason why only Korean schools were excluded from the application of tuition waiver program. They declared that they would wage a solidarity struggle until the tuition free program issue is settled, saying that they cannot suppress their anger at the unjust decision. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Player Back Home
body: DPRK player Ri Se Gwang won a gold medal in the vault of men's individual apparatus final at the 48th FIG Artistic Gymnastics World Championships held in Doha of Qatar from October 25 to November 3. The championships brought together at least 580 men and women players from over 70 countries and regions including the DPRK, China, Russia, Uzbekistan and Kazakhstan. Ri Se Gwang returned home on Wednesday. He was greeted by Kim Il Guk, minister of Physical Culture and Sports, officials concerned and his family at Pyongyang Railway Station. Rodong News Team

title: 29th National Exhibition of IT Achievements Opens
body: The 29th national exhibition of IT achievements opened with due ceremony at the Sci-Tech Complex on Wednesday. The exhibition is divided into nine panels including a panel for operating system and information and communication networks, one for artificial intelligence and information processing and one for modernizing and automating production process. On display at its venue are more than 800 information science and technology achievements. Program contests such as computer-added designing, machine translation, face identification and speech recognition are to be held during the exhibition. Lectures on the global trend for the information science and technology development and the IT achievements gained in the DPRK will be given. Present at the opening ceremony were Ri Ryong Nam, vice-premier of the Cabinet, Choe Tong Myong, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Kim Sung Du, chairman of the Education Commission, Jang Chol, president of the State Academy of Sciences, officials concerned, officials of the presentation units, and workers, youths and students. Rodong News Team

title: Members of Russian Embassy Do Friendly Labor
body: Members of the Russian embassy here did a friendly labor at the DPRK-Russia Friendship Kochang Vegetable Co-op Farm in Chollima District on Wednesday. They helped the farmers in farming work. They handed over aid materials to the farm. Rodong News Team

title: Japanese Reactionaries’ Tactic to Cover up Unethical Crimes
body: Shortly ago, Japanese Prime Minister Abe appointed Suga, chief Cabinet secretary, as minister for Abduction Issue. Abe and Suga said in their recent joint news conference that they would do their best to put an end to the abduction issue. This is a reckless scheme to cover up the unethical crimes including sexual slavery for the Imperial Japanese Army. Japan is, indeed, the hideous abduction state recognized by the international community. Why is the Abe group persistently talking about the settlement of the abduction issue? Lurking behind this is its absurd calculation to defame the external prestige of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea by building a world public opinion on the abduction issue and to avoid its reparation for the past crimes, the biggest pending issue in mending the DPRK-Japan relations, by distorting the essence of the bilateral relations and to interfere in the issue of the Korean Peninsula. The more persistently the Japanese reactionaries seek their anachronistic hostile policy toward the DPRK while covering up their past crimes, the more denunciations and ridicules they meet at home and abroad. The international community urges Japan, the hideous abduction state, to assume the responsibility for its unethical crimes and liquidate the past crimes at an early date. The unethical crimes committed by Japan in the past can never be concealed and erased. Japan should liquidate the past crimes as soon as possible, not resorting to sleight of hand. Ri Hyon Do

title: Choe Hong Hui to Be Remembered
body: Taekwon-Doists and those related to martial arts of different countries including China, Germany, Russia, Malaysia, Sweden, UK, India, Cambodia and Canada and overseas Korean Taekwon-Doists arrived here on Thursday to take part in the event for commemorating the 100th birthday of Choe Hong Hui, former president of the International Taekwon-Do Federation. Rodong News Team

title: Polish Embassy Hosts Reception
body: The Polish embassy here gave a reception on Thursday to mark the centenary of the independence of Poland. Invited to the reception were Im Chon Il, vice foreign minister, officials concerned, and members of foreign embassies and missions of international bodies here. Present there were Krzysztof Ciebien, Polish ambassador to the DPRK, and staff members of the Polish embassy. Speeches were made there. Rodong News Team

title: National Sci-tech Presentation in Field of Sericulture Held
body: A national sci-tech presentation in the field of sericulture was held at the Grand People's Study House on Wednesday and Thursday under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea. It was attended by teachers, researchers, technicians and others from scores of units including Kim Il Sung University, Wonsan University of Agriculture, the Haeju Cocoon Production Office and the Hanggu Cocoon Production Office. It heard more than 70 valuable papers on sci-tech successes and experience gained by officials and workers in the field of sericulture in a mass technological innovation movement for increasing production of cocoon. A lecture on the trend of development of sericulture took place during the presentation. Rodong News Team

title: 8th Enlarged Plenary Meeting of 9th C.C., Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League
body: The 8th enlarged plenary meeting of the 9th Central Committee of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League took place here on Thursday. Attending the meeting were members and alternate members of the C.C., youth league and its officials. The meeting discussed the tasks of the league organizations for conducting education for youth and children more effectively. Speeches followed a report made by Pak Chol Min, first secretary of the C.C., youth league. The reporter and speakers referred to the successes and experience made in the ideological education for thoroughly implementing the important tasks set forth at Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us Usher in a Golden Age of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth Movement". They advanced the tasks and ways for energetically conducting the ideological education for the youth and children. They called upon all the youth league officials to fully display their honorable responsibility and mission in faithfully upholding the Supreme Leader's idea of valuing the youth and guidance. Rodong News Team

title: Members of Vietnamese Embassy Here Visit Migok Co-op Farm
body: Le Ba Binh, ambassador of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam to the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, and members of his embassy toured the Korea-Vietnam Friendship Migok Cooperative Farm in Sariwon City, North Hwanghae Province on Thursday. Being briefed on the farm associated with the guidance exploits of the peerlessly great men, they made rounds of modern dwelling houses and kindergarten remodeled there as the model of the socialist modern village. They handed over aid materials to the farm. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of Young Chongryon Officials Visits Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: The delegation of young officials of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan led by Pak Ok Sam, vice-chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the Korean Youth League in Japan, on Thursday visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun. The members of the delegation paid tribute to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in the palace. At the halls of immortality where the great leaders lie in state the visitors bowed to them. They made rounds of the halls where the orders the great leaders received are on display and the halls that house cars, electric car, boat and train coaches used by them during their field guidance and foreign tours till the last moments of their lives. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of SWUK Back Home
body: A delegation of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea (SWUK) headed by Jang Chun Sil, chairwoman of its Central Committee, came back home on Thursday after visiting the Socialist Republic of Vietnam. Rodong News Team

title: Punishment of Blacklist Maker Urged in S. Korea
body: The solidarity for culture and democracy, an organisation of men of culture and artistes of south Korea, held a rally outside the "National Assembly" on Nov. 3 to demand to punish the ringleader involved in making a blacklist and to take measures for probing into the truth behind it, south Korean MBC said. The organisation said that none of those who cooked up the blacklist of men of culture and artistes has been punished. It stressed that 131 persons involved in making the blacklist deserve investigation and punishment. Rodong News Team

title: Anti-U.S. Rally Held in S. Korea
body: An anti-U.S. rally for the declaration of sovereignty and independence was held at the park of Sejongro in Seoul on November 3 with the attendance of the people from all walks of life, according to south Korean internet paper Jaju Sibo. Speakers said that the struggle against the U.S. which stands in the way of peace, prosperity and reunification of the Korean peninsula is a patriotic movement for the transformation of the land based on the strength of the nation. It is necessary to put an end to unequal diplomatic history, they said, adding that the "government" should send the US and Japan a clear message of the public mindset which allows no longer the encroachment upon the interests of the people. A declaration was adopted at the rally. Rodong News Team

title: Wreaths Laid at Grave of Choe Hong Hui
body: Wreaths were laid at the grave of Choe Hong Hui, ex-president of the International Taekwon-Do Federation, at the Patriotic Martyrs Cemetery in Sinmi-ri on Friday to mark the centenary of his birth. Attending the wreath-laying ceremony were major members of the ITF including President Ri Yong Son, Taekwon-Doists and those related with martial arts from various countries, overseas Korean Taekwon-Doists, Kim Kyong Ho, chairman of the Korean Taekwon-Do Committee (KTC), officials concerned and bereaved families of Choe. Placed before the grave were wreaths in names of the ITF, KTC, the International Martial Arts Games Committee, the Committee for Aiding Overseas Compatriots of Korea and the Overseas Koreans' Affairs Administration and bouquets. The participants paid a silent tribute to the memory of Choe Hong Hui. Rodong News Team

title: LKP Blasted for Preventing Inter-Korean Cooperation
body: The south Korean Kyunghyang Daily News in an article on Nov. 7 denounced the "Liberal Korea Party" (LKP) for desperately preventing the inter-Korean cooperation. The paper said that LKP is crying out for "adjustment and cut" of the budget bill for 2019 submitted by the "government", branding it as a drain on resources for the north. The paper charged that the LKP is using the south-north relations for its political tactics. Rodong News Team

title: Sports Contest of Artistes Held
body: The 49th Sports Contest of Artistes took place at Kim Il Sung Stadium on Friday. The participants competed in various sports events including football, volleyball and ssirum (Korean wrestling), divided into the groups of cinematic art, stage art and fine arts. Among the spectators were Pak Chun Nam, minister of Culture, An Tong Chun, chairman of the Central Committee of the General Federation of the Unions of Art and Literature of Korea, officials concerned and officials in the field of culture and art. The mass rhythmic exercise and Taekwon-Do exercise for health revved up the atmosphere of the contest. The fine arts group beat the stage art group at the football match. The stage art group took the first place in total standings. Rodong News Team

title: War-thirsty Act of Japanese Militarist Fanatics
body: Japan has recently test-fired an interceptor missile, SM-3 Block 2A, in the waters off Hawaii together with the U.S., which was the test-launch in the wake of the failure of those in June last year and in January this year. Such test-fires are reportedly due. Justifying the recent test-launch, Japanese media said that it was carried out under the plan of introducing the ground interceptor missile system to cope with the “threat of ballistic missile” of the DPRK. Japan is going to develop such a missile till the last year of 2021 in a bid to deploy for action. The reckless military action is a serious military provocation which destroys peace and security in the region. The Japanese reactionaries’ ulterior intention is to put the “threat” from the DPRK into the limelight at any cost in an attempt to reverse the regional situation to the tensions and attain their ambition for reinvasion without fail. To make Japan a war-capable state is the final goal of the Abe group. Japanese reactionaries’ retrogressive revision of the constitution is nothing but the last-ditch effort of those going against public mindset. Japan’s road to reinvasion and war leads it to ruin. Abe and other militarist maniacs will come under fire by the whole world, and bring about self-destruction if they are going more reckless obsessed with the wild ambition for reinvasion, forgetting the history of defeat. Ra Myong Song

title: 2nd National Presentation of Forest Science and Technology Held
body: The second national presentation of forest science and technology took place at the Three-Revolution Exhibition House from Nov. 6 to 9. It was held under the co-sponsorship of the Ministry of Land and Environment Protection and the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea, divided into such panels as afforestation, forest conservancy, IT-based forestry and machine-based forestry. The venue had many exhibits and papers presented by scientists, technical personnel, teachers, three-revolution team members and others in the fields of science, education and forestry in the fields of education and science and forestry including Kim Il Sung University, Kim Chaek University of Technology, the Ministry of Land and Environment Protection, the State Academy of Sciences and the Ministry of Forestry. There were also a presentation and workshop during the exhibition. A closing ceremony took place on Friday. Attending it were O Su Yong, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Ri Ryong Nam, vice-premier of the Cabinet, and officials concerned. Rodong News Team

title: African Regional Seminar on Juche Idea
body: The African regional seminar on the Juche idea for "democracy, independence and development" took place in Conakry, Guinea on November 3. Displayed at its venue were works of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and books introducing the proud reality of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. Present there were the secretary general of the African Regional Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea, the chairman of the Nigerian National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism and the chairman of the Guinean National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism who are directors of the African regional committee, the acting general secretary of the Democratic Rally of Africa-Democratic Party of Guinea and other figures of various circles of different countries and the region. A congratulatory speech was made at the seminar. Andre Lohekele Kalonda, secretary general of the African Regional Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea, made a report to be followed by speeches. Speakers said that the immortal Juche idea founded by Kim Il Sung serves as the undying guideline as it brightly clarifies the road of the popular masses' struggle for realizing independence and building a new society. They noted that the DPRK has further demonstrated its might as an invincible power which no one dares to provoke thanks to the wise guidance of Kim Jong Un advancing invariably upholding the banner of Juche and the single-minded unity of all the people closely united around him. Saying that they deeply realized once again the validity and vitality of the Juche idea through the celebrations of the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK, they called upon all the participants to dynamically wage the struggle for realizing independence in the African region along the road guided by the Juche idea in the future, too. A letter to Kim Jong Un was adopted at the seminar. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Will Always Triumph in Reliance upon Self-Reliance
body: The revolutionary spirit of self-reliance and fortitude is the might of the great creation and change with which the Korean people built the socialist state, independent in politics, self-supporting in economy and self-reliant in national defense, on their land. The revolutionary spirit of self-reliance to solve all problems arising in the revolution and construction in a responsible manner and by their own efforts has made the Korean people those who have nothing impossible and the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea developed into the invincible socialist fortress in reliance upon the spirit and might. The Korean people are dynamically moving forward rallied close around the great Workers’ Party of Korea, holding aloft the banner of self-reliance. Self-reliance represents the tradition of victory won by the independent and dignified DPRK, the inexhaustible creative power of socialist Korea and indomitable mettle of the brave Korean people confident of the final victory of their cause. It is the way for independent people to glorify the dignity and honor. We will go along the road to the end and always be ever-victorious. This is the fixed will of the Korean people in the ongoing great drive for creation. No force on earth can hold in check the advance of the heroic people who make historical miracles by dint of self-reliance true to the guidance of the great Party. Ri Hyo Jin

title: Letter to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Participants in African Regional Seminar on Juche Idea
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a letter from the participants in the African regional seminar on the Juche idea for "democracy, independence and development" on November 3. The letter said that the Juche idea followers in Africa successfully held a seminar together with the progressive figures of Guinea in Conakry. It said the progressive people in Africa unanimously recognize that the gigantic change made in socialist Korea is valuable fruition of the Juche idea centred on man which President Kim Il Sung founded and Chairman Kim Jong Il developed in depth. It noted that the DPRK which has dynamically advanced along the road of Juche demonstrated the tremendous national power and position and has concentrated all its efforts on economic construction, ushering in a new era for peace and prosperity on the Korean Peninsula and region and independent reunification of the country. It stressed that the participants would push ahead with the study and dissemination of the immortal Juche idea in African countries, reaffirming the invariable support to the Korean people in their just struggle. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Cambodian King
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, sent a message of greeting to Cambodian King Norodom Sihamoni on Friday on the 65th anniversary of the independence of Cambodia. The message said that the Korean people were sincerely pleased with the big success made by the Cambodian friends in the efforts for achieving peace and stability of the country and building a powerful and prosperous state after gaining its independence. The message expressed the belief that the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation between the DPRK and Cambodia would steadily develop in the future, too, and wholeheartedly wished the king bigger success in his work for the country and its people. Rodong News Team

title: Ratification of Panmunjom Declaration Called for in S. Korea
body: A peace council of South Kyongsang Province of south Korea comprising civic and public organizations and political parties for peace and reunification held a press conference at the provincial office on November 8 to say that they will send questionnaire to lawmakers of the "National Assembly" requiring their yes or no over the NA ratification of the Panmunjom Declaration, according to the south Korean Yonhap News. The organization said that for NA to ratify and legalize the declaration, a national promise for peace, prosperity and reunification, is a requirement of the people. It stressed that it would stage a demonstration outside the offices of the lawmakers who oppose or refuse to respond to the ratification. Rodong News Team

title: GFTUK Delegation Back Home
body: A delegation of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea led by Ju Yong Gil, chairman of its Central Committee, returned home on Sunday after visiting the Lao People's Democratic Republic. Rodong News Team

title: Former Defense Security Command's Organised Surveillance Disclosed
body: The south Korean MBC on November 6 quoted an investigation result of the special investigation group as saying the former Defense Security Command (DSC) organizationally investigated the bereaved families of the ferry Sewol disaster and reported its result to Chongwadae. Right after the disaster in April 2014 the DSC made a secret organization for recovering the approval rate for Park Geun Hye and organizationally and illegally investigated the bereaved families of the victims. Rodong News Team

title: Autumn Table-Tennis Tournament for Disabled Persons and Amateurs Held
body: The 2018 Autumn Table-Tennis Tournament for Disabled Persons and Amateurs took place at the Gymnasium of Kim Chaek University of Technology from Nov. 5 to 11. Among the spectators were Kim Mun Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the Korean Federation for the Protection of the Disabled, officials concerned, disabled persons, table-tennis amateurs, working people, youth and students in Pyongyang, foreigners and overseas Koreans staying in the homeland. The players competed, divided into a group of disabled and old persons, groups of men amateurs of different ages and amateur men's singles and mixed doubles. Cups, medals and certificates were conferred upon the groups and players who proved successful at the tournament. Rodong News Team

title: Home-Visiting Group of Koreans in Japan Pays Tribute to President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: A home-visiting group of Koreans in Japan visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on Saturday. Members of the visiting group laid bouquets before their statues before making bows to them. Rodong News Team

title: Executive Board Meeting of IMAGC Held
body: The Executive Board Meeting of the International Martial Art Games Committee was held in Pyongyang on Saturday. Attending the meeting were Ri Yong Son, chairman of the IMAGC who is president of the International Taekwon-Do Federation, Leong Wai Meng, vice-president of the ITF, and Paul Hoglund, president of the World Jiu Jitsu Confederation who are vice-chairmen of the committee, and members of the executive board. Present there as observers were delegates of various international martial art organizations and national martial art games committees. The meeting discussed the issues of organizing celebrations of the 20th founding anniversary of the IMAGC and selecting the venue for the 8th International Martial Art Games. Rodong News Team

title: Pak Pong Ju Inspects Various Units
body: Premier Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, inspected various units. While visiting the Pyongyang Trolley Bus Factory and the Pyongyang Bag Factory whose workers have turned out in implementing the on-site instructions of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, he stressed the need to raise the accuracy of finishing outer surface of the bus body and improve the cultural refinement of rubber products and all fittings in the production of trolley buses of new type. He also stressed the need to increase the proportion of locally available raw and other materials and give precedence to the supply of them in producing schoolbags. After making a field survey of the Sunchon Phosphate Fertilizer Factory and the project for founding the C1 chemical industry under construction, he called for accelerating the construction. Making rounds of venues of the 29th National Exhibition of Consumer Goods and the Second National Exhibition of Forest Science and Technology, he discussed issues arising in turning out various and diverse consumer goods, increasing the rate of mechanization in producing saplings and actively introducing advanced science and technology. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korean University Students Call for NA's Ratification of Panmunjom Declaration
body: South Korean university students have waged a signature-collection campaign since September in demand of the ratification of the Panmunjom Declaration at the "National Assembly" (NA), according to south Korean Yonhap News.
