On Nov. 8 the "Fellow University Students" handed a document signed by over 2 000 students of 33 universities to a lawmaker from the Minju Party of south Korea belonging to diplomacy and unification committee of NA and held a news conference. Speakers said that they would work hard to make the bill on the ratification of the Panmunjom declaration pass through the NA as soon as possible. Rodong News Team

title: Fire in S. Korea
body: There broke out a fire at a building in Jongro District of Seoul on Nov. 9, according to KBS of south Korea. The fire left 7 persons dead and 11 others injured. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Introduced in DR Congo
body: The full text of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us Usher in a Great Golden Age of Construction by Thoroughly Applying the Party's Juche-Oriented Idea on Architecture" was posted by the National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of DR Congo on its website on Nov. 2. The work, published on December 8, Juche 102 (2013), clarifies that the DPRK's history of construction is a proud one in which miracles and epochal changes were brought about thanks to the outstanding idea on architecture of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and their wise leadership. It also sets forth the tasks facing the construction sector and ways to carry them out. The website carried a photo of Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il to Be Remembered in Russia
body: A committee for remembering Chairman Kim Jong Il was formed by the Russian Group for Solidarity with the DPRK on November 2. Revedev, chief of the Russian group, was elected chairman of the remembrance committee. The committee set a remembrance period between Nov. 2 and Dec. 17 and decided to hold political and cultural events praising the undying feats of Kim Jong Il during the period. Rodong News Team

title: Joint Friendship Gathering Held
body: A joint friendship gathering with the participants in the events for commemorating the 100th birth anniversary of Choe Hong Hui, ex-president of the International Taekwon-Do Federation, was held at the Taekwon-Do Hall on Monday. Present there were Kim Kyong Ho, chairman of the Korean Taekwon-Do Committee, officials concerned, Taekwon-Do players and coaches, Ri Yong Son, president of the International Taekwon-do Federation, and leading members of the federation, those related with martial arts, foreign and overseas Korean Taekwon-Doists. Colorful amusement games took place there. At the end of the games the participants deepened the feelings of friendship, dancing together. On the same day the DPRK Cabinet hosted a reception at Okryu Restaurant in honor of the participants in the events. Rodong News Team

title: Scientific and Technological Successes Achieved in Kim Il Sung University
body: Upholding the historic New Year Address of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, the research groups of Kim Il Sung University conducted brisk scientific research activities to develop its independent economy by dint of science and technology at an early date, thus crowing them with many successes. Comprised of the members of many colleges and faculties of the university, its research groups worked out solutions for more than 10 scientific and technological problems for the modernization of the Pyongyang Trolley Bus Factory, and splendidly carried out their research projects assigned to the university for the construction of the Koam-Tapchon railway. Many research groups of the university afforded a sure guarantee for settling admirably the scientific and technological problems of staging the grand mass gymnastics and art performance “The Glorious Country” for them to be a great masterpiece and upgrading the mobile communication technology of the country. In the Samchon Catfish Farm a research group of the university achieved great successes in establishing the system on which catfish of pedigree stock are kept for breeding purposes and moving water control on to a scientific footing. While striving to modernize the Pyongyang Catfish Farm another research group of the university superbly completed its integral production system by which catfish can be bred with economy of water and labor. The research groups of the university enlisted in the February 17 Shock Brigade of Scientists and Technicians were assigned to work in the Pukchang Thermal Power Complex, the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex, the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex, the Pyongyang Cosmetics Factory, the construction site of the Tanchon Power Station, etc. They contribute their large share of work towards fulfilling their scientific research projects to lay the power, metalworking, chemical and light industries of the nation on a Juche basis. In the Pyongyang Mushroom Farm the members of the shock brigade of the university energetically carried on their researches and thereby contributed greatly to preventing environmental pollution, sterilizing mushrooms and industrializing the production of agaric with fermented rice straw. This year the university published many essays on basic science and cutting-edge science in authoritative international scientific journals. Since they confirmed their determination to work harder than ever during their significant celebration of the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK the research groups of the university do their best to wind up their research projects for this year as soon as possible. Kong Ro Hyok

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Works Introduced in Brazil
body: Chairman Kim Jong Il's works "Women Are a Dynamic Force Pushing Ahead with the Revolution and Construction" and "Kim Chaek University of Technology Is a Powerful Base of Our Country for Training People Talented in Science and Technology" were posted by the Brazilian Center for the Study of Songun Politics on its website on Nov. 4 and 5. The website carried photos of Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: Burundian President Supports WPK, DPRK Government and People
body: Jong Tong Hak, DPRK ambassador to Burundi, presented his credentials to Pierre Nkurunziza, president of the Republic of Burundi, on Nov. 6. The president said he extended full support and solidarity to the Workers' Party of Korea and the government and people of the DPRK in their efforts for the country's reunification and economic construction. He recalled that the Korean people rendered unreserved aid to the struggle of the Burundian people for building a new society, expressing the will to proactively develop the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation between the two countries with a long history. Rodong News Team

title: Foreign and Overseas Korean Taekwon-Doists Leave
body: Taekwon-Doists and those related to martial arts of different countries and overseas Korean Taekwon-Doists left Pyongyang on Tuesday after taking part in the events for commemorating the 100th birthday of Choe Hong Hui, ex-president of the International Taekwon-Do Federation. Rodong News Team

title: Seminar of Social Scientists Held
body: A seminar of social scientists took place at the Grand People's Study House on Tuesday on the lapse of 100 years since Kim Hyong Jik, an indomitable revolutionary fighter, composed the song "Green Pine on Nam Hill". Present at the seminar were Ri Hye Jong, president of the Academy of Social Sciences, teachers, researchers, lecturers, journalists, editors and officials in the fields of science, education, literature and arts, media and preservation of revolutionary relics. The seminar heard papers explaining the revolutionary spirit, ardent patriotism, anti-Japanese idea and the far-reaching will for liberation of the country reflected on the song. Speakers said that the revolutionary essence of the idea and spirit of the song is the transparent idea of national independence that the destiny of the country and nation should be carved out by the strength of the Korean nation, not by the help of foreign forces. It also represents an indomitable revolutionary spirit calling for fighting against the enemy at any cost for freedom and liberation of the people and the idea of continuous revolution for bringing a bright world to the 3 000-ri land of Korea by waging struggle through generations, they said. They explained that the idea and spirit of the song served as an ideological and moral source that made President Kim Il Sung found the immortal Juche idea and put the Korean revolution on the orbit of independence. The speakers stressed the need to accomplish the revolutionary cause of Juche through generations, cherishing the idea and spirit of the song. Rodong News Team

title: Officials Compete in Table-Tennis Matches
body: Table-tennis matches of officials of the commissions, ministries and national institutions took place at the Handball Gymnasium in Chongchun Street from Nov. 6 to 13. More than 800 men and women players from at least 90 units, divided into four groups, competed on a knockout basis. The Central Bank, the Foreign Trade Bank of the DPRK, Taesong Bank and the Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House took first place respectively in each group. Rodong News Team

title: Arrest of Ryang Sung Thae Urged in S. Korea
body: Court officials of south Korea held a rally outside the Supreme Court in Seoul on Nov. 9 in demand of the arrest of Ryang Sung Thae, former president of the Supreme Court who is ringleader of judicial scandal, according to the south Korean MBC. They said that a special court bench is needed to a strict trial for those involved in the judicial scandal. Rodong News Team

title: Pyongyang Int'l Sci-Tech Exhibition: Health and Physical Culture to Be Held
body: The Pyongyang International Sci-Tech Exhibition: Health and Physical Culture will be held at the Sci-Tech Complex from November 22 to 26. It will bring together over 100 units of the DPRK and different countries and regions. It will exhibit functional health goods, medicines, medical instruments, sports apparatuses, software products and others conducive to the improvement of people's health and development of sports science and technology. During the period there will be a technical workshop, circulation of intellectual goods and exhibit sales. Rodong News Team

title: Agricultural Workers Plant Trees in Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: Officials of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea and agricultural workers across the country planted trees in the Arboretum of the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on Wednesday. More than 4 500 trees of fifteen species, flower shrubs and at least 10 tons of humus soil were provided by officials of the union and agricultural workers in Pyongyang City, South and North Phyongan and North Hwanghae provinces and Nampho City. They planted trees with great care. Rodong News Team

title: Japanese Enterprise Urged to Compensate Victims of Conscript Labor
body: The south Korean paper Hangyore said on Nov. 9 that Japanese legal circles urged a Japanese enterprise to make reparation to four victims of the conscript labor forced by Japanese imperialists. Over 100 Japanese lawyers in a statement said on Nov. 5 that the Japanese government perverted the essence of the issue on the reparation to victims of the conscript labor. Now that the decision on compensation was confirmed, the Japanese enterprise should pay reparations to victims and the Japanese government should take measures for it, said one of those lawyers at a press conference on Nov. 7. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il to Be Remembered in Ethiopia
body: An Ethiopian committee for remembering Chairman Kim Jong Il was formed in Addis Ababa on November 8. Nigatu Dagnachew, chairman of the Ethiopian National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism and chairman of the Ethiopia-Korea Friendship and Solidarity Committee, was elected chairman of the remembrance committee. The committee decided to organize political and cultural events praising Kim Jong Il's exploits between November 15 and December 20. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korean Paper Calls for Punishing Those Responsible for "Martial Law" Document
body: The south Korean online paper Voice of People carried an editorial on Nov. 8 in demand of the punishment of those responsible for drawing up a "martial law" document. Although it was confirmed that Chongwadae examined the "law" during the candlelight struggle in 2016, those masterminds have gone scot-free, the editorial said. Unless those who tried to suppress the candlelight struggle by force of arms are severely punished, the bloodbath like the May 18 Kwangju massacre would be repeated, the editorial said, calling for the punishment of the prime movers. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il to Be Remembered in Ukraine
body: A Ukrainian committee for remembering Chairman Kim Jong Il was formed in Kiev on November 6. Nikolai Polishk, chairman of the Ukrainian "Treasured Sword of Songun" Association for the Study of the Juche Idea, was elected chairman of the committee. The committee decided to organize political and cultural events praising Kim Jong Il's revolutionary career and exploits on the occasion of the anniversary of his demise. Rodong News Team

title: Ri Su Yong Meets New German Ambassador
body: Ri Su Yong, chairman of the Foreign Affairs Committee of the DPRK Supreme People's Assembly, Wednesday met and had a talk with Pit Cornelius Heltmann, new German ambassador to the DPRK who paid a courtesy call on him. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Greetings to Syrian President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on Wednesday sent a message of greeting to Bashar Al-Assad, president of the Syrian Arab Republic. Extending warm congratulations to the president and the friendly government and people of Syria on the occasion of the 48th anniversary of the corrective movement in Syria, the message said that the Syrian people have achieved great successes in the struggle for fighting against the Israeli invaders and building a new independent and prosperous society after the corrective movement. The message sincerely wished the government and people of Syria bigger successes in their just cause for frustrating hostile forces' moves and defending the sovereignty, security and territorial integrity of the country. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Gift from President Moon Jae In
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was presented with a significant gift by President of south Korea Moon Jae In. Moon Jae In presented to Kim Jong Un a large quantity of mandarins produced on Jeju Island with sincerity in expression of his thanks to Kim Jong Un for sending a lot of Songi mushrooms to him with the feelings of compatriotism during the historic Pyongyang summit meeting. Kim Jong Un expressed thanks to Moon Jae In for sending the gift associated with warm feelings of south Korean compatriots to him and instructed to convey the mandarins to school youth and children and Pyongyangites. Rodong News Team

title: Serious Human Rights Situation in Western Countries
body: Western countries cooked up and spread a human rights document of falsehoods and fabrications in a bid to internationalize and politicize the non-existent “human rights question” in the DPRK. A serious human rights question exists in the western countries. The U.S., which styles itself the “model” of capitalism, is swarming with unemployed and homeless people. Murder, robbery and other high-profile crimes are rampant there. Colored and minority races there have their rights wantonly violated in education, legal protection, election, etc. There is not much difference in Japan, which likes to brag itself as a “law-governed state” and “advanced state”, and in European countries which slander other countries, behaving as if they were the “model” in respecting human rights. Child maltreatment is rife and sexual abuses against children are on the steady increase in Japan. Women, children, persons of advanced age and those with disabilities who should be under the care of social protection are just forsaken by the society. This is the pitiful human rights situation in Japan. The same is the human rights situation in European countries. The U.S., Japan and Western countries had better cure their human rights illness, instead of criticizing others groundlessly. Ri Hak Nam

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il to Be Remembered in Russia
body: A committee for remembering Chairman Kim Jong Il was formed by the Moscow Group for the Study of the Juche Idea on November 6. Mikhail Vikulin Mikhailovich, chief of the group, was elected chairman of the committee. The committee decided to organize political and cultural events on the occasion of the 7th anniversary of his demise. Rodong News Team

title: Chongryon Publishes Book on Greatness of Peerlessly Great Man
body: The General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) published a book "Marshal Kim Jong Un, Sun of 21st Century." The book, which was written by the Central Standing Council of the Korean Social Scientists Association in Japan, deals with undying feats performed by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and his personality as a great man. The book is illustrated with a picture of the Supreme Leader atop Mt. Paektu and other ones of his personality as a great man. The book consists of the titles of "Outstanding Leader in New Era", "Ushering in a Great Golden Age of Juche Korea", "By Brilliantly Applying People-first Principle", "Lodestar of National Reunification, Praise of Mankind", "Genuine Voices" and "Tender-hearted Father of Compatriots in Japan and Defender of Their Destiny". The book says how Kim Jong Un is successfully leading the drive for accomplishing the socialist cause of Juche while bolstering up the might of the country in every way and translating the ideal and dream of the people into a brilliant reality. The book shows how he is making a new history of national reunification true to the lofty intention of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, and says that he is respected and lauded by mankind. The book notes that the Supreme Leader continues to make the history of warm feelings, the blood ties, established by the great leaders with Korean residents in Japan and that he is leading the struggle to usher in a new golden age in the movement of Koreans in Japan. It deals with what Korean people said after seeing his personality as a great man. Rodong News Team

title: Cabinet Decision Announced during the War
body: The fierce Fatherland Liberation War was at its height in November 1951. One day President Kim Il Sung summoned health workers to his presence and awakened them to defects in wartime health services. He pointed out that our country was short of doctors, pharmacists and nurses plus the low level of their technique and had not even plenty of medicines. The President said that it was important to widely disseminate knowledge of health to the people and arrange for them beforehand to prevent all diseases to protect their precious lives and promote their health. He shed light on the problem of rebuilding wrecked hospitals, clinics and all other medical institutions and prevention centers and setting them in good condition and other tasks facing the domain of public health. The President granted an official’s request for experienced pharmacists and adopted measures to discharge medical workers on active duty and send them to health establishments in the rear from the front although every soldier was needed for the war. Two months later, the President called a health worker to his supreme headquarters. He asked him in detail how much the people paid for their medical treatment. When he replied the President earnestly said that our people fought with patriotism and devotion at the cost of their lives both in the front and in the rear to win the war, that we should stint nothing for their benefit and that the free medical treatment system should be established for all of them. This was beyond the imagination of the official. He was deeply moved to the heart. The President added that nothing was more precious to us than the people and that when assigned to write compositions or speak at discussions during the anti-Japanese armed struggle, in most cases the guerrillas said in tears that their parents died of illness without so much as taking any medicine owing to their abject colonial poverty. Later on, the President always paid deep attention to the universal free medical treatment system for the people despite being so busy leading the war to victory. He meticulously ensured that funds and material conditions were secured for health services and took detailed steps to settle all the relevant problems. The President went the length of personally checking up the Cabinet decision on proclaiming the enforcement of the universal free medical treatment system for the people. Consequently, the decision was published on November 13, 1952 in the flames of the hard-fought war. Ko Chol Myong

title: LKP Has No Future: S. Korean Opposition Party Spokesman
body: A spokesman for the Party for Democracy and Peace of south Korea in a commentary said on Nov. 13 that the "Liberal Korea Party" (LKP) has no future as it goes against public sentiment, according to south Korean News 1. He said that LKP opposed each and every article of the budget bill for 2019 introduced by the "government". He warned the party that it would face a stern judgment by the people as it was hell-bent on grabbing power, so indifferent to the people's livelihood. Rodong News Team

body: Eva Margareta Wahlstrom, president of the Swedish Red Cross, and her party arrived in Pyongyang on Thursday. Rodong News Team

title: Cut in Expenses for Upkeep of U.S. Forces Urged in S. Korea
body: Civic and public organizations of south Korea launched a struggle in demand of a drastic cut in the expenses for the upkeep of the U.S. forces, according to the south Korean internet newspaper Tongil News. The Center for Peace and Disarmament of the Citizens Solidarity for Democratic Society in a commentary on Nov.13 claimed a sharp cut in the expenses for the upkeep of the U.S. forces. The organization denounced the U.S. for forcing south Korea to heavily expand its share before the negotiation for a special agreement on sharing the expenses for the upkeep of the U.S. forces. South Korea has so far born a large amount of expenses under various pretexts apart from the upkeep of the U.S. forces, the organization said. On the same day, the People for Achieving Peace and Reunification held a press conference as well as a rally at the Kwanghwamun Plaza of Seoul and slashed at the U.S. demand for increased expenses for the upkeep of the U.S. forces. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Weightlifters Back Home
body: DPRK weightlifters returned home on Nov. 15 after attending the 2018 World Weightlifting Championship of the International Weightlifting Federation. They bagged five gold medals, four silver medals and three bronze medals at the championship held in Turkmenistan from Nov. 1 to 10. Om Yun Chol won three gold medals in the men's 55kg category of the championship. Rim Jong Sim came first in the women's snatch of 76kg category, and Kim Un Ju in the women's jerk of 87kg category. Rim Jong Sim placed second in the women's jerk of 76kg category and total, and Kim Un Ju and Rim Un Sim in the total of women's 87kg and 64kg categories. Kim Un Ju and Kim Kuk Hyang took the third place in the women's snatch of 87kg and over 87kg categories, and Rim Un Sim in the women's jerk of 64kg category. Rodong News Team

title: Scientific and Technological Activities Briskly Conducted
body: This year festivals, forums and exhibitions, including the 33rd National Festival of Science and Technology, scientific and technological forums on metal, power, coal, chemistry, spinning and weaving, green structure and others, the National Exhibition of Scientific and Technological Successes in Energy and the 2018 National Exposition of Footwear, were held dozens of times under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea. Dynamic efforts were made throughout the society to widely spread new scientific and technological successes and experiences in time. Meanwhile, brisk activities were conducted as never before in various parts of the country for the dissemination and exchange of science and technology. In addition, the central committee promoted the cooperation between producers and scientific institutes, and sponsored forums, demonstrations and scientific and technological training courses to resolve the scientific and technological problems of normalizing the production of factories and enterprises. The central committee organized scientific and technological activities in depth so that they could substantially help toward thoroughly implementing the militant tasks set forth in the New Year Address of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un for 2018 and the decisions of the historic April Plenary Meeting of the Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea. Last March the first scientific forum was held to choose from among many a rational scheme for expanding the production capacity of Juche-based iron, followed by the second one in the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex in August. On this occasion the central committee innovatively arranged for all scientific associations and societies to bring about a radical switchover in their scientific and technological activities from a realistic standpoint, true to the intentions of the Party. Forums were held briskly in the process of this to contribute to carrying out the five-year strategy as soon as possible. They included the National Scientific Forum on Cosmetics, the 2018 Scientific and Technological Forum on Hothouse Vegetables, the scientific and technological prize contests and scientific forums for solving the scientific and technological problems of rolling stock production, etc. Technological training courses and demonstrations, too, had an important share in the scientific and technological activities conducted this year. Great strides were made once again in settling the scientific and technological problems of developing the science, technology and economy of the country and improving the living standards of the people. Kang Chol Ung

title: Japan’s Isolation Is Inevitable Outcome of Its Reckless Act
body: Japan is getting more and more isolated each day, which is the inevitable outcome of its reckless act. Many countries warmly welcomed positive changes for the reconciliation and détente in the Korean peninsula, but Japan cries out for “intensified sanctions on the DPRK” and persists in mendicancy, repeatedly clamoring about the “abduction”. Japan gets nothing but international isolation and passing Japan. Japan’s act remind people of a drunken brawler persisting in attending a wedding ceremony, absurdly speaking ill of the householder behind the fence. The impudent act makes even a close ally turn its face from Japan. Japan has not yet liquidated all the past unethical crimes including abduction, massacre, slave labor and sexual slavery. Japan creates a militarist climate for confrontation across the country, making the “threat” from the DPRK a fait accompli, and, at the same time, tries to turn itself into a war-capable country through the retrogressive revision of the constitution and arms build-up. It also claims the “dominium” over Tok Island and the territory of other country in violation of international law and principle. As a result, neighboring countries watch Japan with high vigilance. The political dwarf Japan styles itself “political power” in different parts of the world, only to be ridiculed. Japan would be well advised to behave itself well aware of its position. An Chol Gwon

title: Greetings to Palestinian President
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the DPRK Supreme People's Assembly, on Thursday sent a message of greeting to Mahmoud Abbas, president of the State of Palestine, on the 30th anniversary of the proclamation of the State of Palestine. The message wished the Palestinian president greater success in his responsible work, expressing firm belief that the Palestinian people would certainly emerge victorious in the just cause to regain the legitimate national rights including the right to self-determination, the right to return home and the right to build an independent state with East Kuds as its capital city. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il to Be Remembered in Algeria
body: An Algerian committee for remembering General Kim Jong Il was formed on November 8. The chairman of the Algeria-Korea Friendship Association was elected chairman of the remembrance committee. The committee decided to organize political and cultural events such as a remembrance meeting, seminar on exploits, lecture and film show in the period from Nov. 8 to Dec. 17. Rodong News Team

title: LKP Finding Itself in Quagmire of Factional Strife: S. Korean Paper
body: The Kyunghyang Daily News of south Korea on Nov. 15 carried an editorial denouncing the "Liberal Korea Party" under the title of "LKP finding itself in the quagmire of factional strife instead of renovation". It said that the "renovation" of LKP is running into a maze day by day. It deplored the strife between the pro-Park Geun Hye group and the rejoining group getting undisguised. Rodong News Team

title: Swedish Red Cross President Visits Mangyongdae
body: Eva Margareta Wahlstrom, president of the Swedish Red Cross, and her party visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. At the old home in Mangyongdae where the President was born and spent his childhood, nurturing his high ambition for the revolution, the guests looked round the historical relics, being briefed on the immortal story about the holy place of the sun. They also toured the Tower of the Juche Idea and the Arch of Triumph. Rodong News Team

title: Russian Delegation Visits Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: A delegation of the Federal Agency of Youth Affairs of Russia headed by Director Alexander Bugaev visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on Sunday. The members of the delegation paid tribute to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in the palace. At the halls of immortality where the great leaders lie in state the visitors bowed to them. They made rounds of the halls where the orders the great leaders received are on display and the halls that house cars, electric car, boat and train coaches used by them during their field guidance and foreign tours till the last moments of their lives. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Introduced in Russia
body: The full text of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us Further Intensify the Work of the Women's Union under the Banner of Modelling the Whole Society on Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism" was introduced by the Russian internet website Erofei－Deve on November 13. The website carried a photo of Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Delegation to Visit Some Latin American Countries
body: The delegation of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea led by President of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly Kim Yong Nam is to pay official visits to the Republic of Cuba and the Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela and a visit to the United Mexican States to take part in the presidential inaugural ceremony of the country. body: A British committee for remembering Chairman Kim Jong Il was formed in London on November 12. Dermot Hudson, chairman of the British Association for the Study of Songun Policy, was elected chairman of the committee. The committee set a remembrance period between Nov. 17 and Dec. 17 and decided to organize political and cultural events praising the revolutionary career and exploits of Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Inspects Taegwan Glass Factory
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the Korean People's Army, gave field guidance to the Taegwan Glass Factory. Making the rounds of the room for the education in the revolutionary history and the room dedicated to the history of the factory, the Supreme Leader acquainted himself with the ideological education of its employees. He highly appreciated that the factory built bases of ideological education to be of educational significance and is running regularly without fail and effectively conducting the educational work among its officials and employees to deeply implant the undying leadership exploits of the WPK in their hearts. Looking round valuable photos of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and relics related with their guidance, he said that the glass factory built on the personal initiative of the President has turned into the country's leading optical glass production base under the leadership of Kim Jong Il. Recalling that the workers of the factory have resolutely upheld the Party's policy while devotedly working to produce optical glassware urgently needed for the science, education and economic development of the country despite difficult situation of the state in the past, he spoke highly of the course covered by them. Calling at several production shops of the factory, the Supreme Leader learned about the production and watched glassware and optical apparatuses newly produced by the factory. Highly estimating the goods of the factory, he said with great pleasure that as he had said last time, the glassware and optical apparatuses produced by the Taegwan Glass Factory are flawless to all appearance. Pointing out that the world is rapidly changing and developing, he called for directing steady efforts to putting the factory's overall production process and process for checking goods on a modern basis and introducing update technology, not content with the present success, and thus producing better optical glass and measuring equipment. He expressed belief and conviction that the Party members and other workers of the factory would register bigger success in development and production of new goods, true to the Party's line of building an economic power. He was accompanied by Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, Jo Yong Won and Kim Yong Su, vice department directors of the C.C., WPK, and Kim Chang Son and Ma Won Chun, officials of the State Affairs Commission. Political News Team

title: DPRK Will Shine as Dignified Independent Country
body: The DPRK fully demonstrates its might as a dignified independent country and homeland of Juche. The complicated events in the international arena at present show how just it is that the Worker’s Party of Korea and the state adhere to the principle of independence. The DPRK has maintained the revolutionary principle, the principle of independence, in the activities of the Party and the state under the wise leadership of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. Our Republic has set forth and carried out all lines and policies in its own way and according to its faith as desired by the people with the transparent anti-imperialist and class stand and socialist principle in the face of the pressure, interference, threat and plot of the imperialists and big-power chauvinists. Under the guidance of the great leaders the DPRK has made a long drive in confrontation with the imperialists under the banner of independence. It is the fixed faith and will of the Korean people to defend the dignity and sovereignty of the country which they have regarded as their life and soul and maintained in the stern storms of revolution. Our Republic will remain long as a dignified independent country as it has Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un at the van of the Korean revolution. Ra Myong Song

title: Japan Running Headlong into 2nd Defeat
body: The present Japan’s constitution was enacted and promulgated on No. 3, 1946, and it was enforced after six months. The constitution consists of a preface of four paragraphs, ten chapters of a basic rule with 99 articles and the full text of a supplementary rule (Chapter 11) of four articles. Its keynote is Article 9 for peace against war. The Japanese ruling quarters and media have proudly advertised it as a “peace constitution”. In Japan the basic law of the state has become a mere scrap of paper due to the security legislation, etc. based on the interpretations of the constitution. Militarism has revived in all the fields of social life in Japan, the National Security Council was set up and the state structure was retrogressively established owing to the interpretations of the constitution by the Japanese ruling forces. Japan’s “Self-Defense Forces” use the waters of the Pacific and the Indian Ocean as their own ones and take part in joint military drills in other regions. Under such situation the Abe forces intend to replace the basic law of the state by the war constitution. If the war constitution is enforced, it would make Japan legalize its overseas aggression. Japan follows in the footsteps of the imperial era. It is running headlong into the second unimaginable defeat. Jang Chol

title: Friendship Joint Gathering with Russian Delegation Held
body: A friendship joint gathering with the delegation of the Federal Agency of Youth Affairs of Russia was held at the gymnasium of the Pyongyang Teacher Training College on Monday. Present there were Pak Chol Min, first secretary of the Central Committee of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League, officials of the youth league, the teaching staff and students of the college, the members of the delegation of the Federal Agency of Youth Affairs of Russia headed by Director Alexander Bugaev, and Russian Ambassador to the DPRK Alexandr Matsegora. Pak Chol Min said in a speech that the bonds of friendship between the youths of the two countries grew stronger this significant year marking the 70th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic ties between the DPRK and Russia. The delegation's visit would offer an occasion in promoting multi-faceted exchanges and cooperation between the youth organizations of the two countries, Pak said, hoping that young Russians would achieve successes in the work to build powerful Russia. Alexander Bugaev said that he was pleased to see the brisk cooperation and exchanges between the young peoples of the two countries. Noting that the excellent traditions of the Russia-DPRK friendly and cooperative relations would be carried forward by the rising generations, he stressed that the Russian youth will always remain reliable friends of the Korean youth. Alexandr Matsegora expressed the stand of the Russian government to develop the bilateral friendly and cooperative relations into a new higher level. There was a performance by the art squad of the Central Committee of the Youth League. Then, young people of the two countries held a dancing party, deepening the feelings of friendship. Rodong News Team

title: Reception Given for DPRK Players
body: The National Sports Guidance Committee gave a reception at the Okryu Restaurant on Monday in honor of the DPRK players who bagged gold medals in the 48th FIG Artistic Gymnastics World Championships and the 2018 World Weightlifting Championship of the International Weightlifting Federation. Present at the reception were Choe Hwi, vice-chairman of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the National Sports Guidance Committee, Ri Ryong Nam, vice-premier of the Cabinet, Kim Il Guk, minister of Physical Culture and Sports, officials concerned, players, coaches and families of the players. Choe Hwi, in a congratulatory speech, praised the players and coaches for having won the championships demonstrating the country's dignity and honor before the world. Players Ri Se Gwang and Om Yun Chol in their speeches extended thanks to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un for showing the great loving care for the sportspersons who did things they should do, representing the loyalty of all the participants. They vowed to fly the DPRK's flag higher in the future international games. Rodong News Team

title: Pak Pong Ju Inspects Various Units
body: Premier Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, inspected different units. While going round the site of the construction of the Unsan Prospecting Machine Factory, he underlined the importance of the construction of the factory in updating the prospecting equipment, and called for thoroughly meeting the requirements of the technical regulations and the method of the construction. Inspecting the Sunchon Heat Insulating Materials Factory, he appealed to the scientists and technical personnel to work hard to realize the local production of finishing building materials and improve the quality of products. At the consultative meetings held at the Chonsong Youth Coal Mine and the Pyongyang Electronic Medical Appliances Factory under construction, the premier took the measures to attain the goals for this year without fail and update the production processes. Rodong News Team

title: Congratulations to Egyptian President
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, on Monday sent a congratulatory message to Abdel Fattah al-Sisi, president of Egypt, on his birthday. Kim in the message sincerely wished the Egyptian president happiness in good health and the friendly Egyptian government and people greater success in the work for the stability and prosperity of the country under his correct leadership. title: DPRK Players Prove Successful at World Archery Championship
body: DPRK archers bagged one gold medal, two silver medals and one bronze medal at the 1st World Military Archery Championship held in Iran from Nov. 13 to 15. Kang Un Ju came first in the women's individual event and Pak Yong Won second in the men's individual event. title: Leading Progressive Mankind to the Avenue of Independence and Sovereignty
body: During his revolutionary life President Kim Il Sung set an example to others in the movement for the national liberation of colonial countries and led the progressive mankind of the world along the avenue of independence and sovereignty. From the outset of his revolutionary struggle he advanced all his lines and policies reflecting the demand and aspiration of our people and the actual conditions of Korea and organized and led the glorious anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle firmly relying on the Juche-oriented revolutionary forces. He always set forth all his revolutionary lines and policies on a firm independent footing and energetically waged the national liberation struggle in dependence on his own revolutionary forces. The result was that he finally liberated Korea from tens of years of Japanese colonial rule. He met the independence movement leaders and resistance fighters of many countries on a visit to Korea as well as heads of state and progressive personages who actively supported the struggle for anti-imperialist national liberation, informed them of the experiences he acquired in achieving the political independence of Korea on his own, and enlightened them about the key to victory, inspiring them with great confidence. He did his level best to instruct the revolutionary peoples of the world who struggled to end the colonial rule of imperialists and great power dominationists and achieve their political independence in his precious experiences in and lessons from winning national independence and sovereignty and inspire them with confidence and courage. A resistance fighter of Zimbabwe said: “The anti-Japanese guerrillas of Korea had neither regular army support nor state backing. Nobody supported and helped them except for the people. But they fought against the Japanese imperialists armed to the teeth in snowstorm for 15 years, digging up grass roots for eating purposes, and finally defeated them in the war. No snowstorm arises in our country and what is more, it is hot all the year round.Our Africa abounds in bananas, fruits of many kinds and other foods. Why should we not fight? We, too, should rise in a war against the imperialists, and can beat them in the war.” This clearly testified to the fact that the struggle for the national liberation of colonial countries the President set a shining example in and led to victory with his valuable experiences definitely entered a period of new upsurge worldwide and that the struggle for independence and sovereignty was the irresistible trend of the world. The movement for the national liberation of colonial countries was rapidly strengthened in many parts of the world. Till the end of the 1960s almost all the countries and nations of Asia won their independence and Algeria, Cuba and many other countries won their political independence for themselves in Africa and Latin America. Indeed, the President is the outstanding leader who is still extolled to the skies infinitely for his immortal services he rendered to the worldwide struggle for national liberation and the building of a new society. Pak Ye Gyong

title: More Silkworm Cocoons Produced than 2017
body: This year the management and employees of cocoon production companies under the control of the Sericultural and Silk Industry Bureau gained successes in the production of silkworm cocoons in many parts of the country. Taken altogether, the bureau produced tens of tons more silkworm cocoons than last year. The cocoon production companies of South Hwanghae Province increased the production of silkworm cocoons by 1.2 times as against last year. The Hanggu Cocoon Production Company of Nampho City conducted a dynamic high-yield movement and thereby turned out silkworm cocoons in large quantities. The Tongrim, Jongju and Thaechon Cocoon Production Companies and others of North Phyongan Province fed silkworms on additional food and protected them against damages from harmful insects in conformity with technological rules. The Mangyongdae, Sadong, Hyongjesan and Samsok Cocoon Production Companies, etc of Pyongyang won good successes in their cocoon production, working devotedly with patriotism. All the cocoon production companies of Korea energetically prepare for their cocoon production to crown it with great success in the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance by dint of science and technology in 2019, too. Hwang Chol Min

Speakers at the events in Bulgaria praised Kim Jong Il as a prominent leader who dedicated himself to the people, saying it was one of his greatest exploits that he firmly defended socialism in the period of ordeals unprecedented in history. Thanks to his Songun politics, the DPRK could demonstrate to the world its might as an invincible socialist fortress, they noted, adding his august name will always be remembered by not only the Korean people but also other progressive peoples in the world. A vice-general secretary of the Islamic Coalition Party of Iran said in the round-table talks that Kim Jong Il made great contributions to achieving the prosperity of the country and happiness of its people and to developing the friendly relations between the two countries and accomplishing the cause of global peace. The Iranian people are highly praising his noble career and undying exploits, the vice-general secretary stressed. Rodong News Team

title: Aim of Japanese Ruling Quarters to Revise Constitution
body: The Japanese ruling quarters reveal their ambition to revise the constitution. Abe, who finished an acute political schedule such as the election for the president of the Liberal Democratic Party of Japan, laid a foundation for power in such a way as revising the constitution. In order to get rid of criticism at home and abroad, he is describing the revision of the constitution as the “ideal of the state” with clamor about the “responsibility of a politician” to implant “pride” in the men of the “Self-Defence Forces”. Lurking behind Abe’s talks about “pride” is the ambition to turn Japan into a war state. The purpose for the revision of the constitution is to turn Japan “an ordinary state” capable of conducting a war. This is just the “ideal of the state” advertised by Abe. It is a more dangerous design, taking into consideration Japan which still refuses to make an apology and reparation for its past crimes. A criminal does not admit his crime because of an ill intention to repeat it. The international community does not allow Japan to become “an ordinary state” trying to provoke a war of aggression. The Japanese people set themselves against the moves of the ultra-right politicians for reinvasion which will lead to the second defeat of Japan. What remains to be done by Japan is not the revision of the constitution but a sincere apology and reparation for its past crimes. This is the way of turning Japan into a genuine normal state. Ri Hyo Jin

title: Books Praising DPRK Published in Venezuela
body: Books "History of Victor" and "I See a Paradise for Education" in praise of the immortal exploits of the peerlessly great men and the advantages of the socialist system of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea were published in Venezuela. title: The Infinitely Happy Family
body: Ordinary teachers, researchers and workers live happily in apartment blocks in Changjon Street, Mirae Scientists Street, Ryomyong Street and other modern ones. They can do so only under our people-centered socialist system led by our mother Party which deems it its duty to give top priority to the interests and welfare of the people and hold them supreme. A few years ago Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un visited a flat in Changjon Street. Its owner and his wife were workers. They had just moved to the flat. He chatted with them unceremoniously. He said that he brought a box of matches with him because it was customary with our people to carry it to movers into a new house on a visit, and presented them with the box, a color TV set, a set of bowls and vessels and books for children. The couple was moved by him to the heart and was quite thankful to him for favoring them despite their doing nothing special for the country. The Supreme Leader filled the couple’s cups with wine for toasting purposes. After a while he looked round the children’s room, washroom, kitchen, etc of the flat and affectionately asked the couple once and again with what they were dissatisfied. He turned over and checked up the pages of a drawing and handicraft book of the couple’s little boy like a true father and listened to their eldest son making up his mind to be a footballer. Prior to his departure, he had a souvenir photograph taken with them. This testifies that our people live in a large socialist family whose great father is the Supreme Leader. O Yong Sim

title: The Dynamic Movement to Qualify as a Sports Model
body: While the masses grew more enthusiastic for sports than before many units across the country were qualified as sports models this year. In early years President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il said that only when sports were widely disseminated to broad sections of the masses for them to conduct them as a part of their everyday life could our people as a whole promote their health and have a strong constitution and wholesome ideas. They threw a full light on the tasks and ways of putting sports on a mass basis. Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un said that it was an important policy of our Party to induce the people to conduct sports every day and make it a rule to do so, and ensured that all the country bubbled over with enthusiasm for sports. Under his wise leadership the movement to qualify as a sports model is going on very briskly in recent years. The Pyongyang Lighting Appliances Factory, the Haeju Tractor Parts Factory, the Sanitary Oxygen Factory and many others methodically arranged for all their employees to zealously rise as one in the movement. Under the sports policy of the Party many units aroused the interest of their employees in sports and fitted up sports facilities and apparatuses. Working people, students and schoolchildren are arranged for to passionately participate in sports activities. In addition, morning runs, health Taekwon-Do, mass rhythmic exercises and many other athletics are regularized. Colorful sports activities are conducted with an accent on national defense sports on holidays, rest days and sports days and at other specific times. Yut, chess and folk games, a tug of war, swinging, seesaws and other national athletics are played at the Ryanggang Provincial People’s Hospital and many other institutions. Basketball, volleyball, table tennis, tennis and badminton games and others are often played to the joy of everybody. In the course of this many people acquired a sports technique or more. Under the sports policy of our Party many units were qualified as sports models this year. Ju Ryong Bong

title: Sinister Nature of U.S. Human Rights" Campaign
body: The U.S. is making a slushy farce even now when its hostile policy toward the DPRK called the “human rights in north” results in failure. Recently the U.S. let the Human Rights Watch, a plot-breeding organization, make public a groundless “report” that sexual abuses against women are prevailing in the DPRK. At the same time the U.S. is inciting an atmosphere of hostility toward the DPRK, making reckless remarks that the UN and the UN Human Rights Council have repeatedly suggested the human rights issue in north Korea, but the latter denied it as well as other international obligation. And it urged the north Korean leadership to make a responsible probe into the human rights abuses. U.S. Congress, conservative media and experts cry out for ceaselessly putting up the sanctions and pressure and “human rights issue” as a policy toward the DPRK. Worse more, the U.S. and its vassal forces recently fabricated again the “resolution on human rights in north Korea” at the United Nations Human Rights Commission. This is, indeed, the height of shameless and coward acts. The “human rights issue in north Korea” much touted by the U.S. is unrealistic and groundless sophism. All of them are based on the rubbish of the human scum who ran away after committing unpardonable crimes before the country and people and turning their back upon their parents and children. It is abnormal to make the “testimony” cooked up by the human scum who do everything for a petty amount of money sound plausible. The U.S. groundless farce is aimed to tarnish the image of the DPRK, justify its sanctions and pressure upon the DPRK, secure concessions from it at the DPRK-U.S. negotiations and furthermore, realize the sinister scheme to bring down the DPRK’s social system. The U.S. should properly understand the strategic position of the DPRK and face up to the changed trend of the times and behave with decorum, not to take issue with others for no reason. This is the way out to escape gloomy future. Those countries and forces kowtowing to the U.S. would be well advised to live in their senses, not joining the anachronistic farce against the DPRK committed under the signboard of “human rights protection” if they have a shred of conscience or cool-headedness for justice. Ri Sung Gwon

title: The Orangchon Reservoir Well under Construction
body: North Hamgyong Province makes steady headway in the construction of the capacious Orangchon Reservoir. According to the amassed data, a water intake tunnel hundreds of kilometers long as well as an approach to it was finished successfully, and the foundations of the dam were laid with concrete by over 80%. Hundreds of thousands of cubic meters of earth was piled up around the reservoir in a little over two months to step up its building on schedule. The completion of the reservoir will enable the sufficient irrigation of thousands of hectares of fields in Orang and Myonggan Counties to raise the crops safely and yield them yet more copiously than before. In addition, it will alter the face of Orang County beautifully and serve as an integrated fish farm. Ri Un Nam

It was handed over to Kim Yong Dae, vice-president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, on Monday by Patriarch Illarion, chairman for foreign relations of the Russian Orthodox Church, who is heading a delegation of the Church on a visit to the DPRK. Rodong News Team

title: Pyongyang Int'l Sci-Tech Exhibition: Health and Physical Culture Closes
body: Pyongyang International Sci-Tech Exhibition: Health and Physical Culture closed with due ceremony at the Sci-Tech Complex on Monday. The products exhibited by Kim Il Sung University, the O-Il Health Drink Combined Factory, the Biomedicine Institute of the Academy of Medical Science and foreign companies were popular. Various technical seminars were held during the exhibition. The closing ceremony was attended by Choe Jong Ho, president of the Sci-Tech Complex, Kim Hyong Hun, vice-minister of Public Health, Won Kil U, vice-minister of Physical Culture and Sports, and officials, researchers and teachers at exhibiting units, foreign guests and members of foreign embassies here. Rodong News Team

title: Russian Orthodox Church Delegation Leaves
body: A delegation of the Russian Orthodox Church led by Patriarch Illarion, chairman for foreign relations, left Pyongyang for home on Monday. During its stay, the delegation visited the Tower of the Juche Idea, the Arch of Triumph, the Liberation Tower, etc. Rodong News Team

title: 8th National Exhibition of Liquor and Essential Foodstuff Held
body: The 8th National Exhibition of Liquor and Essential Foodstuff opened at the Pyongyang Railway Station Department Store on Monday. Exhibited there were more than 15 000 bottles of liquor and essential foodstuffs produced at 200-odd units across the country. Lectures on modernization of foodstuff factories and management system of hygiene and safety of foodstuff are to be held during the exhibition. The exhibition will last until Nov. 29. Rodong News Team

title: Successes Made by Pyongyang University of Architecture Exhibited
body: An exhibition of educational and scientific successes made by Pyongyang University of Architecture took place on November 25 and 26. The university exhibited tens of thousands of data of at least three hundreds of kinds made in the researches to raise the architectural science and technology of the country to the world standards. Displayed at the venue of the exhibition were architectural designs and layouts of more than 840 objects including Pyongyang Teacher Training College, the Mangyongdae Children's Camp, the Pyongyang Trolley Bus Factory and the Pyongyang Bag Factory. Rodong News Team

title: Wholesome Kimchi
body: From olden times our people have widely used kimchi in their dietary life. It has been celebrated as health food of longevity for its nutritive value. The nutritive value of kimchi is guaranteed by fermentation. Its nutriments are not destroyed because it is the product of the lactic fermentation of materials but they increase in kind and number during the fermentation. Red pepper, onion, garlic, ginger, pickles and other side materials complement the taste and nutrients of kimchi and are simultaneously synthesized by lactic bacteria into new nutriments in the course of their fermentation. In other words, vegetable and animal nutrients blend into one and then proceed to ferment so as to produce lactic acid, amino acid, vitamins, mineral matter and many other savors and nutrients. Kimchi is well preserved for long. But, unlike salted foods, it is lightly salted and contains plenty of many seasonings like red pepper powder. It is a low-calorie alkaline vegetable food of nutritive value although vegetables are poor in nutriments. When kimchi turns mellow, it abounds in sodium, calcium, phosphorus, iron and other basic mineral contents to satisfy the demand of the human body for them. When one eats kimchi regularly, one can easily take in necessary inorganic elements. When one eats 200～300g of kimchi a day, one can fully meet the demand of nutrition for inorganic elements. As mentioned above, kimchi is widely known not only as the traditional dish of the Korean nation but also as a world-class health food. Moreover, kimchi has been more popular than ever since scientists proved that it was highly preventive against SARS which burst out in Asia in 2003. Kim Chong Il

title: The Koryo Liquor
body: The Koryo liquor is popular in Korea. It is wholesome functional liquor. It is mainly made from the Koryo insam of Kaesong and the crust of overcooked glutinous rice. Developers used traditional alcoholic distilling methods and advanced technology in replacing a bitter taste of insam contained in previous insam liquors with a delicate savor and aroma of the crust of overcooked glutinous rice. Consequently, the Koryo liquor does full justice to the flavor and aroma of insam and exhibits a taste peculiar to the nation. The Koryo liquor is produced at the Taedonggang Foodstuff Factory situated in suburban Pyongyang. It was authenticated by the ISO-22000. It was analyzed from physiochemical and supersensible angles, and proved to hit the mark. According to experts, the Koryo liquor belongs to ideal functional liquors today. A thirsty soul of France said: “Maybe this liquor is the first of its kind in the world. Its taste will linger in my memory forever. I believe I’ll take to drinking the Koryo liquor instead of cognac in the future.” The officers of an authentication exchange office in China said that nobody could fully appreciate the Koryo liquor without tasting it in person and that they were dying to drink and drink it to the full. So Nam Il

body: Of late the Abe group calls for the improved DPRK-Japan relations, but plays the role of advance brigade of its master the U.S. that pursues the carrot-and-strike policy, reading its face. Japan’s clamor about the improved DPRK-Japan relations along with its persistent anachronistic and hostile act fully betrays its shamelessness and duplicity. Abe’s oft-repeated intensified sanctions and the already settled abduction issue in chorus with the U.S. clamor about sanctions and “human rights” makes it clear that his remarks represent an extension of Japan’s policy of kowtowing to the U.S. So the prospect for the DPRK-Japan relations for which Japan has longed will be further gloomed. Japan should be mindful that if it approaches the reality with American style mode of thinking, it can never get rid of the dishonor of being “dwarf Japan,” far from being treated as a “giant” of Asia it desires. Clear is the DPRK’s stand. The on-going moves of the Abe group will deprive Japan of a chance to visit Pyongyang forever and drive Japan into a poor position hard to have it. Thae Chol

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il to Be Remembered in Congo
body: A Congolese committee for remembering Generalissimo Kim Jong Il was formed in Brazzaville on November 20. Vital Balla, chairman of the Congolese Association for Friendship among Peoples, was elected chairman of the remembrance committee. The committee set a remembrance period from November 20 to December 17 and decided to hold political and cultural events to praise the revolutionary career and exploits of Chairman Kim Jong Il in the period. title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Birthday Spreads to Persons of Merit
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un sent birthday spreads to Labor Hero and Dr. Kang Yong Yong, a worker of the February 8 Vinalon Complex, and People's Teacher So Chun Yong, principal of Kusong Secondary School No. 1 on their 70th birthday. Born at a rural village of Hongwon County, Kang Yong Yong graduated from a university under the study-while-working educational system and contributed to realizing computer control system of production processes of the complex by continuously brushing up his technical knowledge and skills and learning modern science and technology. The great leaders made sure that he was awarded the title of Labor Hero and attended the eventful meetings as he took the lead in the implementation of the Party policies. So Chun Yong, who devoted herself to the education of the rising generation from her maidenhood, grew to be a genuine educator and a deputy to the Supreme People's Assembly under the loving care of the Party. She dedicated herself to the development of the country's education and training talents at school for decades and contributed to turning the school into the thrice Honored Red Flag school and the twice model physical training school by effectively conducting instruction and education and putting the education on a modern and IT basis. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il to Be Remembered in Kuwait
body: A Kuwaiti committee for remembering the great leader General Kim Jong Il was formed on November 17. Javid Ahmad, chairman of the Kuwait Asian Journalist Association, was elected chairman of the remembrance committee. title: Delegation of Young Chongryon Officials Meets Former Unconverted Long-term Prisoner
body: The delegation of young officials of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan led by Pak Ok Sam, vice-chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the Korean Youth League in Japan, met with Ri Kong Sun, pro-reunification patriotic fighter and former unconverted long-term prisoner, on Tuesday. Ri said that he could come back to the embrace of the motherland with dignity after suffering hardships as he kept in mind absolute trust in the great leaders and the firm confidence in the victory of revolution. He noted that former unconverted long-term prisoners enjoy an honorable life full of energy despite their advanced ages under the loving care of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. He asked the members of the delegation to hold the peerlessly great man in high esteem and work hard for the bright future of Kim Il Sung's nation. Pak Ok Sam said that they were greatly encouraged by the spirit of the pro-reunification patriotic fighters who maintained their revolutionary faith, adding that young officials of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan would carry forward the patriotic cause true to the leadership of Kim Jong Un. An art performance was given at the meeting. Rodong News Team

title: National Agro-Scientific Workshop and Exhibition Opens
body: A national agro-scientific workshop and exhibition of successes opened with due ceremony. Presented to the event, divided into five panels including scientific farming and veterinary science and animal husbandry, were more than 120 scientific and technological proposals and at least 700 exhibits of more than 250 kinds helpful to putting agricultural production on a scientific and modern basis and improving domestic animal breeding and cultivating technique and veterinary and anti-epizootic work. An agricultural scientific idea presentation reflecting valuable successes made in developing the country's agriculture will take place during the event. An opening ceremony was held at the Pyongyang Vegetable Science Institute under the Academy of Agricultural Science on Tuesday. Present at the ceremony were Pak Thae Dok, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Ko In Ho, vice-premier of the Cabinet and concurrently minister of Agriculture, Kim Sung Du, chairman of the Education Commission, officials, scientists, technicians, teachers and graduate students of the agricultural and scientific and educational organs. The event continues until Nov. 30. Rodong News Team

title: Gift to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Brazilian Organization
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a gift from the Brazil-DPRK Friendship Parliamentary Group. It was handed over to Ri Su Yong, chairman of the Foreign Affairs Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, on Tuesday by Vanessa Grazziotin, senator of Brazilian National Congress and chairwoman of the Brazil-DPRK Friendship Parliamentary Group who is leading a delegation of lawmakers from various political parties of Brazil on a visit to the DPRK. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Off Press in Russia
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work "Let Us Brilliantly Accomplish the Revolutionary Cause of Juche, Holding the Great Comrade Kim Jong Il in High Esteem as the Eternal General Secretary of Our Party" was brought out in booklet by the Forum Book Publishing House of Russia to mark the 7th anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's demise. The work, published on April 6, Juche 101 (2012), clarifies that it is the principled requirement for the victorious advance of the cause of the Korean revolution to hold Kim Jong Il in high esteem as the eternal general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea. It also deals with the tasks for steadily developing our party into the glorious party of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. A book-releasing ceremony took place on November 19. title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Highly Praised by Russian Media
body: A Russian website and newspaper carried special write-ups to commemorate the 7th anniversary of demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. An article titled "Figure of a great man" was posted on the website Grifon Prestizh, with a portrait of smiling Kim Jong Il on November 19. Saying that the world progressives recollect the valuable career of the great man Kim Jong Il with the approach of the anniversary of his demise, the article went on: Leader Kim Jong Il was a man who worked hard without rest. His work time was from dawn to dawn next day and his activity sphere was everywhere the people live. When he passed away, the world knew better about the sacred life of the great man who devoted his all to the people, seeing the Korean people bitterly grieved feeling guilty as they were unable to provide him with a rest. He was the man who devoted his all to the prosperity of the country and happiness of its people with his view of life and philosophy to devote himself to the future like pure and clean snow. The November 21st issue of the newspaper Nakhodkinski Rabochi carried an article tilted "Song in Praise of Great Man", together with his photos. It said that many foreign personages who were attracted by his rare wisdom, distinguished political ability and noble personality wrote books and created poems and songs for praising the great man with all their enthusiasm. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Mauritanian President
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, on Wednesday sent a message of greeting to Mohamed Ould Abdelaziz, president of the Islamic Republic of Mauritania, on the 58th anniversary of its independence. Kim in the message wished the president great success in his noble work for the stability and development of the country, expressing belief that a new progress would be made in the development of bilateral relations by implementing the agreements adopted in the meeting and talks between them in Pyongyang in September.
