title: Romanian Charge d'Affaires ad Interim Hosts Reception
body: George Amihaesei-Nicolescu, charge d'affaires ad interim of the Romanian embassy to the DPRK, hosted a reception at the Taedonggang Diplomatic Club on Wednesday to mark the national day of Romania. Invited to the reception were Im Chon Il, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, So Ho Won, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries, officials concerned, and members of foreign embassies and missions of international bodies to the DPRK. Officials of the Romanian embassy were on hand. Speeches were made. Rodong News Team

title: Suga's Anti-DPRK Rubbish
body: Chief Cabinet Secretary of Japan Suga, who had been appointed as minister for Abduction Issue following a recent government reshuffle, spouted a load of rubbish via the internet, causing consternation in the public. He said that he has engaged in the issue of north Korea since he became a member of the House of Representatives and that he took the lead in putting an embargo on the DPRK ship Mangyondbong-92 and withdrawing the measure for reducing the taxes for the fixed properties of the facilities under the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon). He also pointed out that he was the very man who inveigled the U.S. into the campaign against the DPRK and Chongryon and pledged to concentrate all efforts on the settlement of the “abduction issue” by intensifying sanctions and pressure upon the DPRK in cooperation with outside forces in the future, too. What Suga said is a loathsome remark by a political rogue and a clear revelation of Japan’s anti-DPRK and anti-Chongryon policies – a fatal disease of its politics. Suga became chief Cabinet secretary as he has been involved in persecuting officials of Chongryon and Koreans in Japan with hostility towards the DPRK. He is a prototype of the immorality and shamelessness of islanders. The misbehavior of the islanders is nothing but a poor wriggle of those who run counter to the trend of the times with the desperate efforts for turning Japan into a military giant and for overseas expansion only to find themselves isolated and face the daily-growing accusations of the international community. It’s ridiculous for Suga and other reactionaries of Japan to provoke the DPRK with inveterate bad habit, unaware of the present world situation. The guys who engage themselves in power-backed political terrorism stoking hostility towards the DPRK and Chongryon in a bid to realize their dirty political goal will not escape merciless punishment. Ho Yong Min

title: Many Buildings near Completion
body: Under the magnificent plan of our Party many construction projects are vigorously stepped up in the port city of Nampho. The two-story Nampho Rest Home, a kimchi factory, a spring water factory and a municipal tree nursery have entered the final stage of construction. The indoor stadium of Nampho University of Agriculture has already been finished while a stadium of Kangso District and an indoor stadium of the West Sea Barrage Station are well under construction. A fresh facelift is given to the port city day after day thanks to the patriotic devotion of its inhabitants. Yun Un Sim

title: The General Offensive for Annual Production
body: Factories under the control of the Ministry of Local Industry wage a general offensive to carry out their production assignments for this year. The Pyongyang Municipal Bureau for the Management of Local Industry, the South Hwanghae, Kangwon and South Hamgyong Provincial Bureaus for the Management of Local Industry, the Pyongyang Clothing Industry Management Bureau and the Tobacco Complex set themselves high monthly and quarterly production goals and went all out to achieve them, thereby fulfilling their yearly plan in terms of gross industrial output value late in October. Bearing deep in mind the instructions given by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un to provinces, cities and counties to develop their local economy distinctively in reliance on their sources of raw materials in the New Year Address for 2018, the officials of all the provincial bureaus for the management of local industry and the workers of factories and enterprises did their utmost to fulfill their production quotas from the outset of January, firmly resolved to attain unprecedented successes in their work. Factories controlled by the provincial bureaus for the management of local industry mapped out their scientific management strategy and dynamically vitalized their production with raw materials locally available. Furthermore, they took a good technological care of their machines to yield products a lot and develop many new ones to the people’s liking. The local industry factories of the provinces, cities and counties vigorously vied with each other to increase their production while the Kyongsong Pottery, the Ryongaksan Spring Water Factory, the Pyongyang Bag Factory and the Songdowon Foodstuff Complex overfulfilled their yearly national economic plan on all indices. Kim Yun Mi

title: Illuminating the Path of the World Socialist Movement
body: President Kim Il Sung is a peerlessly great man who led the cause of human independence and socialism to victory all his life. Many stories of great leaders of the country and the nation have so far gone down in human history. But history has ever known that none of them taught not only his nation but also the progressive people of the world how to hew out their destiny independently as the President did. Many countries returned to capitalism one after another towards the end of last century. In those days he inspired mankind with firm confidence in socialism and led it to march along the avenue of socialism without deviation. The President said that the setbacks suffered by some socialist countries in socialism were temporary phenomena manifested in accomplishing the cause of human independence and could not at all deny the validity of the cause of socialism and the reactionary nature of imperialism. He proved logically that socialism had a greater attraction for people than ever and emerged victorious definitely with the enhancement of their independence and creativity because it embodies the nature of a social being who wishes to eliminate the exploitation and oppression of man by man and live independently as one. When the General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Portugal visited our country in July 1991 and a delegation of the March 26 Movement of Uruguay followed suit a few years later the President met them in person and explained them the cause of the collapse of East European socialist countries. He pointed out that they were subservient and servile to the big power and were divorced from the masses of people, indulging in subjectivism and bureaucratism and that the cause of their failure in socialism lay herein. The President demonstrated how parties aspiring after socialism must vigorously conduct the movement for the reconstruction of socialism with a correct strategy and tactics. An illustrious political activist of India highly praised the President for contributing greatly to the cause of global independence, and said: “Comrade Kim Il Sung, the great leader of the 20th century, rendered undying services to the times and mankind. Mankind will always remember him as the leader of the people and a great revolutionary who dedicated his whole life to the freedom and happiness of the people and the cause of independence." Rim Won

title: The Ideal of Mankind Realized by the People’s Country
body: Our socialist system is a perfectly popular one under which all the people are the masters of national sovereignty and the means of production, legitimately exercise their rights in social, political, economic and cultural life and lead the most worthwhile lives. Witnessing the actualities of life in our country, the world public speaks highly of the people-centered socialism of our style as an ideal society of humanity and a paradise of humanity. The deputy chief of a group for the study and embodiment of the Juche idea in the Czech Republic said: “The unemployed, beggars and vagrants are to be found nowhere in Korea, whereas this is often the case with other countries. Now the state provides the working people with every living condition, all of them enjoy carefree happy lives to the full. A country of this sort can hardly exist on this planet except in Korea. The social system of Korea is a good example for all countries to follow, considering irregularities of all hues, crimes and corrupt culture prevail throughout the globe.” The mass media of many countries point out that Korea regards the people as its God, gives top priority to their demand and interests and absolutizes them, and report that capitalist countries cannot imitate socialist Korea in this. The Nigerian paper “The Nigerian Observer” wrote in an article titled “The People’s Country”: “The Democratic People’s Republic of Korea is a country of the people as its name indicates. It adopts popular policies of all kinds, including the free medical treatment system and the free education system.” Our socialism looked up to by progressive mankind as the beacon of hope will patently demonstrate its invincible dignity all over the world under Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un’s policy of love for the people. Kim Su Jin

title: National Kimchi Show Held
body: A national kimchi (pickled vegetables) show was given at the Food Festival House in Ryomyong Street on Wednesday and Thursday. A kimchi show and kimchi-making demonstrations were held, divided into the service sector under ministries and national institutions, public service sector, external service sector, public catering sector in Pyongyang, provincial (municipalities) public catering sector and the sector of Pyongyang city women's union. Kimchi wrapped in large cabbage leaves, kimchi made without red pepper presented by the Moran Guidance Bureau and Pyongyang Hotel and leaf-mustard kimchi and cabbage kimchi presented by North Hamgyong Province and the women's union committee of Rangnang District drew public favor. Cooks from Okryu Restaurant, Chongryu Restaurant, Kyonghung Guidance Bureau and the Myohyang Guidance Bureau demonstrated their good skills in making whole cabbage kimchi, watery raddish kimchi, Chonggak kimchi (pickled young radishes) and sliced radish kimchi. title: Greetings to Palestinian President
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, Thursday sent a message of greeting to Mahmoud Abbas, president of the State of Palestine and chairman of the Executive Committee of the Palestine Liberation Organization, on the occasion of the Day of World's Solidarity with the Palestine People. Kim in the message said that the expanding of the Jewish settlements, promulgation of the racist law, blockade of the Gaza Strip and suppression of the demonstrators being committed by the Israeli occupiers are posing a grave challenge to the struggle of the Palestinian people to retake the despoiled territory and build an independent state and are under world denunciation and rejection. title: The Puyong Pavilion
body: Haeju City boasts the Puyong Pavilion. It was built early in the 16th century under the Korean feudal dynasty. The pavilion stands in the middle of a lotus pond a thousand and several hundred meters square, supported by dozens of pillars driven into its bottom. Surrounded by pillars outside, it has a whole room in the center to give a feast and such like. The pavilion harmonizes with the surroundings well. It is a precious cultural legacy of Korea which testifies to the exceptional architecture of its ancestors. The pavilion was severely destroyed during the Fatherland Liberation War of 1950-53. It was admirably restored to the original state under the earnest instructions of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. The pavilion was used by the feudal rulers as an amusement center in the past. Today it serves the purpose of ensuring the cultural recreation of the working people and inspiring them with patriotism and national pride and confidence under the guidance of the Party. Kim Su Jong

title: The Vegetable Snake Driver
body: The doctor and vice-professor Hong Son Hui and other scientists of the Zoological Institute of the State Academy of Sciences developed a vegetable snake driver with raw materials abundantly available at home. During their researches they found out a substance which gives off a smell abominable to snakes and drives them away and established the method of making the relevant driver with it on their own. They then proceeded to ascertain how long the driver worked on snakes and confirmed that it was effective against them by over 95% regardless of environmental conditions, their physiological state and forms of its application. The driver acts on snakes about three times longer and 15% more efficaciously than previous expensive imports. Kim Yun Mi

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Provides Field Guidance to Fishery Stations in Eastern Coastal Area
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republicof Korea and supreme commander of the Korean People's Army (KPA), gave field guidance to the fishery stations in the eastern coastal area which are busy with winter intensive fishing campaign. The first leg of his guidance was the May 27 Fishery Station run by the KPA. Saying that he came to meet fishermen to encourage them with a great pleasure after receiving a report that they caught more than 60 000 tons of fish in a short span of time in the course of receiving every day a report on the fish catching of the fishery stations run by the People's Army in the eastern coastal area in a winter intensive fishing campaign, Supreme Leader of the Party, state and army Kim Jong Un personally got aboard the fishing vessel "Hwanggumhae-014" and congratulated its captain and fishermen who returned with a big fish haul. He noted that he is much pleased to see the unloading of fresh fish from the vessel and the fish which is poured out at an outdoor ground. Saying that let's have a photo taken against the background of this wonderful scenery, he summoned the fishermen and employees and had a significant photo session. Making rounds of a room dedicated to education in the revolutionary history, a freezing warehouse and a combined control room of the May 27 Fishery Station, he acquainted himself with the ideological education of the employees and production and management of the station. Seeing the fish blocks filled at the freezing warehouse, he expressed great pleasure, saying they look like a treasure mountain and gold bars and the warehouse is almost filled with fish in a few days of the intensive fishing campaign. He said that if the fish is caught as now, the warehouse will not be enough to store the caught fish and underscored the need to increase a quick freezing capability 2-3 times on an annual basis. He enjoyed an art performance given by the employees of the fishery station. He expressed expectations and belief that officials and employees of the fishery station will increase the successful fish catch to substantially contribute to the diet of the people and servicepersons and will take the lead in implementing the Party policy of bringing about a revolutionary change in fishery. The next leg of his guidance was the August 25 Fishery Station run by KPA. He gave congratulations and highly appreciated the fishery station for taking the lead in making a big fish haul as befits the native place of the history of "gold seas" and of "Tanphung" fishing vessels. He acquainted himself with performance and technical state of "Tanphung" fishing vessels of the fishery station and learned in detail how the Party policy is implemented, looking round various places of the station including the processing shop, freezing warehouse and combined production control room. He was told that a 3 000 ton capacity freezing warehouse was built by remolding a 1 500 ton capacity salting tank in a short period and a task of systematically increasing a daily quick freezing capacity was carried out, and highly appreciated it. He expressed great satisfaction at the freezing warehouses filled with thousands of tons of fish each. He expressed expectations and belief that the officials and employees of the August 25 Fishery Station would give a steady continuity to the history of big fish hauls in the future, too, as befit the pioneer and model which kindled a new torch in fishing, before having a picture taken with them. The next leg of his guidance was the January 8 Fishery Station run by the KPA. He boarded the vessel "Tanphung 18-01" in the middle of discharging, being welcomed by enthusiastic fishermen. He highly praised the fishery station for over-fulfilling the yearly quota of fish haul by ensuring that more than 1 000 tons of fish such as anchovy, gray mullet, mackerel, gizzard shad and hard-finned sandfish are caught by each vessel. He stressed the need to prevent fish from getting contaminated or degraded in the process of handling them and establish strict order for meeting the hygienic demand not only in the hold but also in all the processes of handling fish like discharge, grading, freezing, storing and supply. Notably, as the January 8 Fishery Station provides fish to baby homes, orphanages, primary and middle schools for orphans and old people's homes across the country, the level of scientific fish catch and automatic and updated carriage and processing should be higher than other fishery stations in terms of quality and only fresh fish should be supplied to the children and health seekers through intensified quality control, he said. Looking round the 1 000 ton freezing warehouse, he stressed the need to standardize the size of freezing drawer, saying that the weights of frozen fish blocks of the fishery stations are different from one another. The Supreme Leader said that the January 8 Fishery Station run by the KPA is the fishery station under the Supreme Command to which he attaches greatest importance, expressing the expectations and belief that the officials and fishermen of the station will take the lead in working a new miracle and innovation. He said that he felt refreshed, pleasant and very satisfied looking at the mountains of fish while touring the fishery stations in the eastern coastal area for the two consecutive days, adding that he used to feel like making time to sail out to the sea and fish with the fishermen whenever he heard the report of fishing results every day and every month. He said that the food problem of the people and the service personnel can be solved satisfactorily when the agricultural production, animal husbandry and fishing are developed as the three main thrusts, noting that the People's Army should continue to stay in the van of upholding and implementing the Party's fishery policy as the pioneers who created the history of "gold seas". He was accompanied by Hwang Pyong So, first vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea; Jo Yong Won, vice department director of the C.C., WPK; Kim Chang Son and Ma Won Chun, officials of the State Affairs Commission; and Army General So Hong Chan, first vice-minister of the People's Armed Forces. Political News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il to Be Remembered in Russia
body: A committee for remembering Chairman Kim Jong Il was formed by the Khabarovsk Territorial Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation on Nov. 23. Alexandr Gromov, first secretary of the Khabarovsk Territorial Committee of the Party, was elected chairman of the remembrance committee. The committee decided to hold political and cultural events in praise of Kim Jong Il's great revolutionary career and exploits on the 7th anniversary of his demise. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il to Be Remembered in Spain
body: The Spanish Committee for Remembering Comrade Kim Jong Il was formed on November 20. Victor Manuel Lucas, international secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the People of Spain, was elected chairman of the remembrance committee. The committee set a remembrance period from November 20 to December 20 and decided to hold political and cultural events praising the noble revolutionary career and exploits of Kim Jong Il in the period. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il to Be Remembered in Romania
body: The Romanian Committee for Remembering Leader Kim Jong Il was formed on November 20. Constantin Rotaru, chairman of the Socialist Party of Romania, was elected chairman of the remembrance committee. The committee set a remembrance period from November 20 to December 17 and decided to hold political and cultural events including a seminar and remembrance meeting praising the immortal exploits of Chairman Kim Jong Il in the period. title: Gift to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from President of Venezuela
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a gift from Nicolas Maduro Moros, president of the Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela. The gift was conveyed to Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, who is leading the delegation of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea on an official visit to the Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela, by President Nicolas Maduro Moros on November 27. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Yong Nam Meets President of National Constituent Assembly of Venezuela
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea who is leading the delegation of the DPRK on an official visit to the Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela, met President of the National Constituent Assembly of Venezuela Diosdado Cabello on Nov. 27. Present there were members of the DPRK delegation including Pak Thae Song, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and Ri Sung Gil, the DPRK ambassador to Venezuela, Tania Dias, first vice-president of the National Constituent Assembly of Venezuela, Gladys Requena, its second vice-president, and officials concerned. A talk proceeded in a friendly atmosphere. President Diosdado Cabello hosted a luncheon in honor of the DPRK delegation. That day the DPRK delegation placed a wreath before the National Martyrs Cemetery of Venezuela and visited the La Montana Barracks where the remains of Hugo Chavez Frias, former president of Venezuela, are buried, to pay respects. Meanwhile, a memorandum of understanding and an agreement between the foreign ministries of the DPRK and Venezuela were signed. Rodong News Team

title: Talks Held between Kim Yong Nam and Nicolas Maduro Moros
body: There were talks between Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, and Nicolas Maduro Moros, president of the Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela,on Tuesday afternoon at the Presidential Palace of Venezuela. Kim Yong Nam is heading a DPRK delegation on an official visit to Venezuela. Kim Yong Nam said that the relations between the DPRK and Venezuela are developing into the ones of true and close friends and firm comrades, adding that the struggle of the Venezuelan people for independence against imperialism, for peace against war and for socialism will dynamically advance. The Venezuelan president sincerely wished Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un good health, and hoped that he would victoriously guide the Korean people. He also expressed belief that the friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries would develop with stronger vitality in the future, too. Opinions on the issues of developing the bilateral friendly and cooperative relations and the non-aligned movement and other issues of mutual concern were exchanged at the talks. Present there from the DPRK side were Pak Thae Song, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and other members of the DPRK delegation, and DPRK Ambassador to Venezuela Ri Sung Gil, and from the Venezuelan side were Foreign Minister of People's Power Jorge Alberto Arreaza Montserrat, Tania Dias, vice-chairperson of the United Socialist Party of Venezuela and first vice-president of the National Constituent Assembly, and other officials concerned. Rodong News Team

title: International Meeting Supports Just Cause of Workers' Party and People of Korea
body: The 20th International Meeting of Communist Parties and Workers' Parties was held in Athens, Greece from November 23 to 25. Present there were delegations and delegates of communist and workers' parties from at least 70 countries, including the delegation of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). Speeches were made there. The head of the WPK delegation in his speech referred to the achievements of the WPK and the Korean people in building a powerful socialist nation and ensuring peace and security on the Korean peninsula under the guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. He also cited the justice of the new strategic line of the WPK. Delegates of parties of various countries including the Hungarian Workers' Party and the Brazilian Communist Party highly appreciated the positive efforts of the WPK, adding that the struggle of the WPK for building a powerful socialist nation makes a positive contribution to strengthening the international communist movement. A solidarity statement of communist parties and workers' parties was adopted at the meeting to support the just cause of the WPK and the Korean people for achieving the independent and peaceful reunification of Korea and ensuring peace and security on the Korean peninsula. The statement welcomed a new phase of peace and reconciliation on the Korean Peninsula recently created by the positive efforts of the WPK and the Korean people for improving the north-south relations, establishing permanent peace-keeping mechanism and putting an end to the U.S. hostile policy towards the DPRK. It stressed that the just cause of the Workers' Party and people of Korea for defending peace and security on the peninsula and building a powerful socialist nation serves as a positive contribution to the struggle of the communist and workers' parties for ensuring international justice and peace and victoriously advancing the cause of socialism on a world-wide scale. It resolutely rejected the moves of the imperialists who interfere in the internal affairs of the Korean nation and persist in the unjust sanctions and pressure upon the DPRK and strongly demanded the U.S. withdraw forever the hostile policy toward the DPRK and military threat against it. And an appeal on strengthening the joint action for expressing mutual support and solidarity among communist and workers' parties and progressive peoples was adopted. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Yong Nam Has Talks with President of Council of State and President of Council of Ministers of Cuba
body: There were talks between Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, heading the DPRK delegation on an official visit to the Republic of Cuba, and Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez, president of the Council of State and president of the Council of Ministers of the Republic of Cuba, at the office building of the Council of State on the afternoon of November 29. Kim Yong Nam said that he was pleased to visit Cuba at a time when an important turn has been provided in developing the friendly relations between the DPRK and the Republic of Cuba. He expressed the conviction that the bilateral relations based on revolutionary principle and comradely obligation would grow stronger amid the common struggle for socialism against imperialism. Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez said that he could not forget the excitement of visiting the DPRK and having an impressive meeting with respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. Saying that he would cherish as a valuable memory the warm hospitality shown by the Party, government and people of the DPRK, he sincerely hoped that respected Comrade Kim Jong Un would continue to victoriously lead the revolutionary struggle of the Korean people in good health. Exchanged at the talks were views on political dialogue and the relations of support and cooperation between the two countries, on developing the non-aligned movement and on issues of mutual concern. The talks proceeded in a comradely and friendly atmosphere. Present there from the DPRK side were Pak Thae Song, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and other members of the DPRK delegation and Ma Chol Su, DPRK ambassador to the DPRK, and from the opposite side were Bruno Rodriguez Parrilla, foreign minister of the Republic of Cuba, and officials concerned. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Yong Nam Meets Salvador Antonio Valdes Mesa
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, who is leading the delegation of the DPRK on an official visit to Cuba, met with Salvador Antonio Valdes Mesa, first vice-president of the Council of State and first vice-president of the Council of Ministers of Cuba, at the office building of the Council of State on Nov. 29. Present there were Pak Thae Song, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and other members of the DPRK delegation and Ma Chol Su, DPRK ambassador to Cuba, and Rogelio Sierra Diaz, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs of Cuba, and figures concerned. The talk proceeded in a warm atmosphere. Salvador Antonio Valdes Mesa hosted a reception to welcome the DPRK delegation. On the same day the DPRK delegation placed a wreath at the bust of Jose Marti at the Revolutionary Square in Havana and made rounds of the Jose Marti Memorial Hall. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Delegation Arrives in Havana
body: A delegation of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea led by Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, arrived in Havana on November 28 to pay an official visit to the Republic of Cuba. Arriving there together were Pak Thae Song, vice-chairman of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea, Ho Yong Bok, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, and other members of the delegation. They were greeted at the Jose Marti International Airport by Rogelio Sierra Diaz, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs of Cuba, officials concerned, Ma Chol Su, DPRK ambassador to Cuba, and his embassy officials. That day the DPRK delegation left Caracas after winding up its official visit to the Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Visits Wonsan Shoes Factory
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the Korean People's Army, inspected the Wonsan Shoes Factory. Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un said that he was so pleased to hear the report that the Wonsan Shoes Factory won the first place at a recent national shoes exhibition and that "Maebongsan"-brand shoes presented by the factory were very popular among the public. He added that a small local factory has become a shoes factory well known all over the country, an iconic shoes factory leading the shoe-making industry of the country. He looked round a room for education in revolutionary history and a room dedicated to the history of the factory and a sample display room newly arranged by the factory. Carefully looking at the historical relics displayed at the room for education in the revolutionary history, Kim Jong Un said that once old and shabby factory has undergone a complete change, noting that the factory, which Chairman Kim Jong Il had visited during the last period of his life and so much worried about, has now become a model and standard shoes factory of the country. He underlined the need to make the visit to the room for education in revolutionary history regular part of one's life to make sure that all the employees turn out in implementing the Party policy and bring into a reality the lifetime desire of Kim Jong Il with high production results, cherishing deep in their minds the history of the factory associated with the footprints of patriotic devotion left by Kim Jong Il and his leadership exploits. Touring the uppers-making shop, shoemaking shop and other production shops of the factory, he learned in detail about the implementation of the Party policy. Praising a young needle worker who just graduated from a school for successfully handling an auto-sewing machine operated by a control program at the uppers-making shop, he called for giving full play to creative wisdom of technicians and skilled workers and widely introducing computerization into the needlework. After familiarizing himself with the progress made so far in the research work for automating the shoe sole pasting process, he set forth tasks for perfecting the automation of all shoe-making processes. He stressed that in order to meet the daily increasing people's demand, it is necessary to keep pushing ahead with the work of ensuring world-level quality with an emphasis put on ensuring diverse patterns, decent colors and lightness and durability while meeting the aesthetic tastes of our people. A prerequisite to improving the quality of shoes lies in good designs, he repeatedly stressed, calling for deeply studying and actively introducing the world trend of the development of the shoes industry and shoe engineering and thus putting primary efforts on creating various new shoes designs favored by the people. Praising the factory for collecting feedback from the public after placing "feedback books" at outlets and introducing them into production, he said that the factory should lend an ear to the public comment, deeply consider what kinds of shoes people of different ages and jobs like in different seasons and thus produce more shoes favored and demanded by all men and women, young and old. He had a photo session with the employees of the factory at its shops. He was accompanied by Hwang Pyong So, first vice department director of the WPK Central Committee; Jo Yong Won, vice department director of the WPK Central Committee; and Kim Chang Son and Ma Won Chun, officials of the State Affairs Commission. Political News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Work Off Press in Russia
body: Chairman Kim Jong Il's work "Respecting the Forerunners of the Revolution Is a Noble Moral Obligation of Revolutionaries" was brought out in booklet by the Nakhodka Format Publishing House of Russia on November 25 to mark the 7th anniversary of his demise. The work, published on Dec. 25, Juche 84 (1995), deals with the idea that to respect the forerunners of the revolution is the requirement of the revolution. It also clarifies the principled problems arising in establishing the moral traits of respecting the revolutionary forerunners and developing the relationship based on the noble sense of moral obligation among people. Rodong News Team

title: Nepalese President Supports DPRK
body: Kim Yong Hak, DPRK ambassador to Nepal, paid a farewell call on Bidhya Devi Bhandari, president of the Federal Democratic Republic of Nepal, on November 28. The president said she was pleased that the Korean people are achieving surprising development and changes under the wise leadership of Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, and the peaceful environment is being created on the Korean peninsular after the inter-Korean summit talks took place thanks to his noble love for the nation. She noted that she and the Nepalese government and people will express full support for the just cause of the Korean government and people in the future, too. Rodong News Team

title: 70th Anniversary of Establishment of Diplomatic Relations between DPRK and Bulgaria Marked in Bulgaria
body: A seminar was held in Sofia on November 24 under the joint sponsorship of the Bulgarian Group for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism and the Bulgaria-Korea Friendship Association to mark the 70th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the DPRK and Bulgaria. Present there were figures of various political parties, organizations and institutions of Bulgaria. Speeches titled "70-year history of the relations between the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Republic of Bulgaria", "Self-supporting national economy" and "New proposal of the DPRK for peace" were made. Speakers gave congratulations to mark the 70th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the two countries and said that new generations should develop the good traditions of the friendship and cooperation provided amidst the support and solidarity of the peoples of the two countries. They said that the Korean people firmly defended socialism despite the worsening sanctions of the hostile forces to stifle the DPRK. They noted that the Korean people were convinced of the justice of their cause rather than giving in to imperialism and held higher the banner of independence. They praised the DPRK for having recently worked astonishing miracles in economic construction and improving the people's standard of living and achieved successes in inter-Korean relations as well as external relations. They noted that a country, small in territory and population, stands in the centre of the international arena as it holds in high esteem the great men such as President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. They expressed conviction that the Korean people rallied close around Kim Jong Un would surely win a brilliant victory in building socialism and accomplishing national reunification. A congratulatory message to Kim Jong Un was adopted at the seminar. A reception was given at the DPRK embassy in Sofia on November 28 on the same anniversary. Rodong News Team

title: Congolese President Supports DPRK
body: Kim Myong Sik, DPRK ambassador, presented his credentials to Congolese President Denis Sassou-Nguesso on November 27. The president recollected the meeting with President Kim Il Sung during his visit to the DPRK. He said that the relations of friendship and solidarity between our two countries have a long history. He noted that the spirit of friendship and solidarity is now being carried forward. He went on: I will strive to develop the good friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries. We support reconciliation and cooperation between the north and south of Korea, peace and reunification. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Greetings to Lao President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a message of greeting to Bounnang Vorachith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party and president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic (LPDR), on Sunday. The message extended warm congratulations to the president and, through him, to the friendly party, government and people of Laos on the occasion of the 43rd birthday of the LPDR. The message said that over the past 43 years the Lao government and people have achieved great successes in the work for defending socialist idea, consolidating the people's democratic system and achieving the independent development and prosperity of the country under the correct leadership of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party. The message wholeheartedly wished the president good health and happiness and bigger success in his responsible work, expressing belief that the traditional friendly and cooperative relations between the two parties and two governments created by the preceding leaders would invariably develop by the concerted efforts. Rodong News Team

title: Victim of "Yusin" Dictatorship Acquitted
body: A south Korean who was sentenced to jail by "yusin" dictatorial forces has been given a verdict of not guilty, according to the south Korean MBC on Nov. 29. The victim was sentenced to 2 years in prison for allegedly spreading false rumor during the October resistance for democracy. The Supreme Court gave him a verdict of not guilty, saying that the then "martial law" and "garrison decree" run counter to laws. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il to Be Remembered in Sweden
body: The Swedish Committee for Remembering Comrade Kim Jong Il was formed in Stockholm on November 23. Christer Lundgren, chairman of the Sweden-Korea Friendship Association, was elected chairman of the remembrance committee. The committee decided to hold political and cultural events praising the revolutionary career and exploits of Kim Jong Il from November 23 to December 17. Rodong News Team

title: The Implant Prosthesis Established
body: The Rason Municipal Dental Hospital newly established a high technology of making materials for implant dentures in our own way and acquired the highest level of implant prosthesis. This made it possible to make dental plates with our raw materials and technology and apply up-to-the-second implant prosthetics throughout the country. To this end the dentists of the hospital dedicated all their creative wisdom and ardor for several years to developing implant prosthesis of our style. They ultimately succeeded in coating the surface of metal with a good bioproductive material so as to enable it to be closely bound up with jawbones at the outset and continue clinging to them. The dentists cemented their creative cooperation with the scientists of Pyongyang Medical College at Kim Il Sung University, Kim Chaek University of Technology and many other institutions and carried on numerous experiments and analyses. In the process of this they found out how to minimize the force applied to jawbones during a functional load and prevent implant dentures and artificial crowns being disunited and invented convenient dental plates to be implanted the instant teeth are pulled out. Besides, they devised tools like an implant drill to suit our specific conditions. Implant prosthesis has been applied actively in practice to prove its great worth. Kim Chong Il

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il to Be Remembered in Sri Lanka
body: A Sri Lankan committee for remembering Chairman Kim Jong Il was formed in Colombo on Nov. 24 on the 7th anniversary of his demise. The chairman of the Sri Lanka-People's Korea Friendship Association was elected chairman of the remembrance committee. title: Implementation of Inter-Korean Joint Declarations Urged in S. Korea
body: The Solidarity of Movement for Independent Reunification, Peace and Prosperity in south Korea held a meeting of co-representatives in Seoul on Nov. 27 and discussed the issues of implementing the Panmunjom Declaration and the "September Pyongyang Joint Declaration" and the action orientation of the organization, according to the south Korean internet paper Jaju Sibo. A resolution titled "Let's thoroughly implement the Panmunjom Declaration and the September Pyongyang Joint Declaration" was adopted at the meeting. The resolution said that the Panmunjom Declaration is a new milestone for the independent reunification, peace and prosperity of the Korean nation and the world peace that inherits the historical June 15 joint declaration and the October 4 declaration, and the "September Pyongyang Joint Declaration" is its action programme. It urged the "government", "National Assembly", local self-governing bodies, all the political parties and social organizations to thoroughly implement the Panmunjom Declaration and the Pyongyang Joint Declaration with the concerted efforts on the principle of national independence and national self-determination. Rodong News Team

title: Fruit Trees of High-yield Species Reared
body: The Pomological Institute of the Academy of Agricultural Science achieves good successes in countrywide pomiculture. This year it grew many fruit trees of high-yielding varieties and provided their seedlings and grafts to related nurseries. They include peaches, apricots and plums whose fruits ripen not only in spring and summer but also in autumn. Peaches and apricots in particular can be harvested 10-odd days earlier than their predecessors, that is, at the beginning of June. Peaches which ripen in autumn contain a still higher percentage of sugar than their predecessors. As for the ones reaped in the first third of this October, they are much larger than the existing ones and their sugar content is high, only to be very pleasant to the palate. Apples and pears of some strains ripen early, and fruit trees of yet another varieties taste even better than their predecessors. Low pears and peaches of another species can be planted close, and yet be raised viably. They yield well and bear a plentiful harvest. Moreover, each of their fruits weighs heavy. The apples and pears are very fragrant and watery, and eat crisp. Peaches of some strains fruit in a year of their planting and give a harvest two years later. There are ones of hardy species. Many fruit sapling nurseries manure and tend fruit saplings of superior varieties along scientific and technological lines so as to raise their rooting rate. Kim Yun Mi

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il to Be Remembered in Russia
body: A committee for remembering Chairman Kim Jong Il was formed by the Party for Peace and Unity of Russia on Nov. 23. title: Japan Urged to Liquidate Its Past Crimes
body: Opposition parties and civic and public organizations of south Korea said that the sexual slavery for the Imperial Japanese Army should be liquidated, according to south Korean media. A spokesperson of the Jongui (justice) Party in a press conference at the "National Assembly" noted that the "foundation for reconciliation and recovery" was disorganized by the struggle of victims of the sexual slavery for the Imperial Japanese army and other peoples. The agreement on the issue of the sexual slavery for the Imperial Japanese Army was an outcome of political collusion of the Park Geun Hye "government" and the Abe government, the spokesperson said. A spokesman for the Party for Democracy and Peace said in a commentary that the "foundation for reconciliation and recovery" should not have been organized at the beginning and that it is too natural to dissolve the foundation. The Justice Solidarity for Settling the Issue of Sexual Slavery for the Imperial Japanese Army and other civic and public organizations held meetings and said that the Japanese government should recognize the fact that a great number of women in Asia-Pacific region experienced immeasurable sufferings owing to the sexual slavery, and make an apology for the crimes. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il to Be Remembered in Kyrgyzstan
body: A committee for remembering Chairman Kim Jong Il was formed in Bishkek of Kyrgyzstan on Nov. 23. A. Usupbayev, chairman of the Central Council of the People Unity-"Kyrgyz El" Republican Political Party and chief of the Group for the Study of the Juche Idea of Kyrgyzstan, was elected chairman of the remembrance committee. The remembrance committee decided to hold seminar on exploits and other political and cultural events on the occasion of the 7th anniversary of demise of Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: Repeal of SL Is Task of Times and Demand of S. Korea
body: Seventy years have elapsed since the fabrication of the “Security Law” in south Korea on Dec. 1, 1948. The SL, imitation of the “Public Order Act” dating back to the period of the Japanese imperialists’ rule, has steadily been revised in a retrogressive way for the maintenance and strengthening of the dictatorial system whenever there was the heightened desire of the people for independence, democracy and reunification and whenever “ruling” crisis worsened in south Korea. The SL is an unprecedented fascist law wantonly violating democracy and human rights and an anti-reunification law totally denying national reconciliation and unity with the north-south ties set as the ones of hostility. The repeal of the SL is the task of the times and the wish of the south Koreans. There is wide-spread view in south Korea calling for “discussing the future of SL” and “repealing SL dating back to the confrontation era” in reflection of the present situation in which the north-south ties have entered the path of improvement. However, the south Korean conservative forces including the “Liberal Korea Party” insist that “there can never be revision, to say nothing of repeal”, absurdly claiming that SL is not a “stumbling block” in the improvement of the north-south ties and it is the “security device at least”. Only when the SL, leftover of the fascist dark era, the confrontation era, is repealed, is it possible to ensure democracy and human rights and to open up a broad avenue to the improvement of the north-south ties. This is a lesson taught by history and reality. The repeal of SL is a requirement faced by the nation that can no longer be delayed and it is the strong desire of the south Koreans. Sim Chol Yong

title: DPRK Government Delegation Visits Vietnam
body: The government delegation of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea led by Foreign Minister Ri Yong Ho visited the Socialist Republic of Vietnam from Nov. 29 to Dec. 2. During the visit Ri Yong Ho paid a courtesy call on Nguyen Xuan Phuc, prime minister of Vietnam, had talks with Pham Binh Minh, deputy prime minister and foreign minister, and was invited to a welcome reception given by the deputy prime minister and foreign minister. During the courtesy call and talks both sides had an in-depth exchange of views and reached consensus on the issue of further developing the relations of friendship and cooperation between the two countries, provided and boosted by President Kim Il Sung together with President Ho Chi Minh, in various fields as required by the new era and other issues of mutual concern. During the sojourn the delegation laid a wreath before the grave of President Ho Chi Minh and toured the Academy of Agricultural Sciences, Halong Bay, etc. Rodong News Team

title: Pak Pong Ju Inspects Pyongyang Thermal Power Complex
body: Premier Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected the Pyongyang Thermal Power Complex. At various places of the complex, he encouraged the electric-power producers in a vigorous drive for increased production. At a field consultative meeting, measures were discussed to keep equipment in full operation and capacity and raise the efficiency of generators to the maximum and thus successfully conclude the campaign of the year. Earlier, he acquainted himself with the updating of the Moranbong Automation Appliances Factory and stressed the need to ensure the structural quality and for relevant units to supply materials for the project in time. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il to Be Remembered by Arab Committee
body: An Arab committee for remembering Chairman Kim Jong Il was formed in Cairo on Nov. 25. Yehia Zakaria Khairullah, co-chairman of the Arab Regional Committee for Friendship and Solidarity with the Korean People, was elected chairman of the remembrance committee. The committee decided to hold political and cultural activities in praise of the revolutionary career and exploits of Kim Jong Il in the remembrance period from November 25 to December 17. Rodong News Team

title: Abrogation of SL Demanded in S. Korea
body: The joint action of civic and social organizations of south Korea wishing for the abrogation of the "Security Law" held a press conference before the building of the "National Assembly" on December 1, according to the south Korean internet newspaper Tongil News. Speakers said that the SL was enforced under the pretext of "uprooting the left" 70 years ago, but, as a matter of fact, it was fabricated in accordance with the intention of foreign forces to divide the Korean Peninsula and dominate it. This evil law has been used in branding democratic forces as "spy" and "the left" and cracking down them for a long time, they noted. Saying that victims of the SL are the people, they urged the authorities to stop the investigation by the evil law and release all the prisoners of conscience. A press release was read out at the press conference. The press release said that the evil law against human rights and reunification should be abrogated in the peaceful era on the Korean peninsula, noting that there is no reason for SL to exist now when the south-north relations are developing. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Government Delegation Arrives in Damascus
body: The DPRK government delegation led by Foreign Minister Ri Yong Ho arrived in Damascus on Dec. 3 to visit the Syrian Arab Republic. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of Belarusian Foreign Ministry Leaves
body: A delegation of the Foreign Ministry of Belarus led by Victor Rybak, head of the Asia, Africa and Latin America Directorate, left Pyongyang for home on Tuesday. During the stay the delegation visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun to pay homage to President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. It also paid a courtesy call on Vice-Foreign Minister Im Chon Il and had negotiations with officials concerned. Exchanged at the talks were views over the issues of developing the relations between the two countries with the tradition of friendship and cooperation through various fields and strengthening mutual cooperation in the international arena. Meanwhile the delegation visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of Kim Il Sung, the Tower of the Juche Idea and other parts of Pyongyang City. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Centenarian Birthday Spread
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un sent a birthday spread to Kim Pyong Nyo, a centenarian, who lives in Sumun-dong, Sinuiju City, North Phyongan Province. She, who was born into a poor peasant's family in Unjon County before the liberation of the country, bitterly experienced the grief of being a member of the stateless nation, suffering every kind of humiliation and insult under the colonial rule of the Japanese imperialists. She, who has led a true life since President Kim Il Sung regained the country, devoted herself to the carrying out of her revolutionary tasks solely to repay the care of the Party. Rodong News Team

title: Abrogation of Security Law Urged
body: A preparatory committee for Pusan Joint Action for Scrapping "Security Law" held a rally in Pusan on Nov. 28, according to the south Korean newspaper Nodong and Segye. Speakers at the rally said the SL should have already been rolled back but it has been persistently sustained and used as a tool to crack down the people as of now for 70 years since it was cooked up. They called upon everyone to turn out in a campaign for repelling the SL, claiming that the SL should be scrapped without fail just to bring peace to the Korean peninsula. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Published in Booklet in Nepal
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us March Forward Dynamically towards Final Victory, Holding Higher the Banner of Songun" was published in booklet by the Five Star Publishing House of Nepal on November 23. The work is a speech the Supreme Leader delivered at the military parade in celebration of the centenary of birth of President Kim Il Sung on April 15, Juche 101 (2012). It says that the century-long history of Kim Il Sung's nation clearly proved the immutable truth that an outstanding leader guarantees the dignity and prosperity of the country and the nation. It also indicates the tasks for glorifying the dignity of Songun Korea for all ages and successfully accomplishing the cause of building a thriving socialist country. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Wreath to Bier of Kim Chol Man
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un sent a wreath to the bier of Kim Chol Man, a member of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and a deputy to the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on Tuesday, expressing deep condolences over his death. Rodong News Team

title: Breakup of "Liberal Korea Party" Urged
body: The south Korean online paper Minjok Ilbo carried an editorial titled "The 'Liberal Korea Party', an obstacle to people's living and welfare, should immediately disappear" on Nov. 30. The editorial said that the LKP is recklessly barring the pending issues for people's living from being solved. As long as the LKP remains in the "National Assembly" and blocks the policy for people's living with cunning tricks, south Koreans' welfare is impossible, said the editorial, adding that the people would surely break up the LKP and bring about the people's welfare. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Work Introduced in Bulgaria
body: The Bulgarian Group for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism posted on its website Chairman Kim Jong Il's work "Respecting the Forerunners of the Revolution Is a Noble Moral Obligation of Revolutionaries" on Nov. 30 ahead of the seventh anniversary of his demise. The work, published on Dec. 25, Juche 84 (1995), deals with the idea that respecting the forerunners of the revolution is a requirement of the revolution. It also clarifies the principled issues arising in establishing the moral traits of respecting the revolutionary forerunners and developing the relationship based on the noble sense of moral obligation among people. Rodong News Team

title: Party, Government, Military Officials Pay Condolences to Late Kim Chol Man
body: Officials of the Party, power and armed forces organs, ministries and national institutions paid a condolatory visit to the place housing the bier of Kim Chol Man, a member of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and a deputy to the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on Tuesday. Seen before the bier was a wreath from Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Placed there were wreaths in the names of the Central Committee of the WPK, the Presidium of the Supreme Peoples Assembly of the DPRK, the Cabinet of the DPRK, armed forces organs, ministries, national institutions and institutions at city and district levels. Mourners observed a moment's silence for the late Kim Chol Man amid the funeral music. They expressed deep condolences to the bereaved family members. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il to Be Remembered in Russia
body: A joint committee for remembering Chairman Kim Jong Il that comprised figures of the political parties and organizations under the Communist Party of the Soviet Union was formed on Nov. 26 on the occasion of the 7th anniversary of his demise. The remembrance committee, chaired by Mozgovoy, first secretary of the C.C., Communist Party of the Soviet Union and chairman of the International Social Federation "For the Union and Union's Communist Party", is made up of personages of such political parties and organizations as the Communist Party of Kyrgyzstan, the Communist Workers Party of Russia, the Communist Workers' Party of Belarus, the Communist Party of Azerbaijan and the Russian Association for Friendship and Cultural Cooperation with the DPRK. The committee decided to hold political and cultural events in praise of the revolutionary career and exploits of Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: Art Troupe of Korean Schoolchildren in Japan Visits Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: An art troupe of Korean schoolchildren in Japan led by Ri Sang Won, principal of Korean primary and middle school in Seibang, visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on Wednesday. They laid bouquets before their statues and paid tribute to them. Rodong News Team

title: Sci-Tech Presentation and Exhibition in Material Field
body: A national sci-tech presentation and exhibition in the material field took place at the Sci-Tech Complex on Tuesday and Wednesday. Present at the presentation and exhibition which opened under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea were teachers, researchers and graduate students of various units including Kim Il Sung University, Kim Chaek University of Technology, the State Academy of Sciences and the Ministry of Consumer Goods Industry. Presented to them, divided into metal, inorganic, organic, compound material panels, were more than 130 papers and 100-odd exhibits reflecting scientific and technical achievements and experience gained in the metal and chemical material fields. There took place lectures and a video show on the study of high-tech materials and their application and development prospect in the period. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il to Be Remembered in Russia
body: A committee for remembering Chairman Kim Jong Il was formed by the All-Russia Lenin Young Communist League on Nov. 26. Podzorov, first secretary of the Central Committee of the league, was elected chairman of the remembrance committee. The committee set a remembrance period from Nov. 26 to Dec. 18 and decided to organize political and cultural events including a seminar in praise of Kim Jong Il's revolutionary career and exploits in the period. Rodong News Team

title: State Funeral for Kim Chol Man Held
body: A state funeral for Kim Chol Man, a member of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and a deputy to the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, took place in Pyongyang on Wednesday. Present at the funeral were members of the state funeral committee, bereaved families of the deceased and officials of the Party and power organs and the Cabinet. The coffin was carried out. The hearse arrived at the Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery on Mt Taesong through streets of Pyongyang. Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the WPK Central Committee, Kim Phyong Hae, Thae Jong Su, Choe Pu Il, Choe Hwi, No Kwang Chol, Ri Pyong Chol and Kim Nung O, members of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, were waiting there. A ceremony of bidding the last farewell to the deceased took place there. Choe Ryong Hae in a eulogy said that Kim Chol Man grew to be a revolutionary and led a brilliant and worthwhile life under the deep trust and warm benevolence of the peerlessly great persons. Although Kim Chol Man passed away, his exploits will always be remembered, the speaker stressed. The remains of the deceased were buried. Members of the state funeral committee and bereaved family members spread earth on the remains. Placed before the grave were a wreath bearing the august name of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and wreaths in the names of the Central Committee of the WPK, the Presidium of the DPRK Supreme People's Assembly and the DPRK Cabinet. The participants observed a moment's silence in memory of the late Kim Chol Man. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il to Be Remembered in Cambodia
body: A Cambodian committee for remembering Chairman Kim Jong Il was formed on Dec. 1. Kong Sam Ol, deputy prime minister for Royal Palace, was elected chairman of the remembrance committee on the instructions of Cambodian King Norodom Sihamoni. The committee set a remembrance period from Dec. 1 to 20 and decided to give wide publicity to Kim Jong Il's revolutionary career and exploits through media and hold political and cultural events in the period. Rodong News Team

title: Self-reliance, Self-sufficiency Are WPK’s Consistent Struggle Strategy
body: Self-reliance and self-sufficiency are the most important struggle strategy that the Workers’ Party of Korea consistently holds up in the building of a thriving country. Whenever the Party is faced with enormous tasks it does not pin its hopes on any foreign support, but attaches great importance to setting in motion the revolutionary zeal of the people, the mental power of self-reliance. And the Party has performed miracles and changes in reliance upon it. Only when the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance and fortitude displayed in the history of the Republic is fully demonstrated, can a final victory of the revolution be won. The spirit is very instrumental in frustrating the sanctions of the hostile forces and turning a misfortune into a blessing. The sanctions of the hostile forces never work on the Korean people strong in class self-respect. The revolutionary spirit is the powerful driving force for the most rapid development of the country. Only when all the fields and units make a breakthrough in production revitalization based on local efforts, technology and resources, can the grandiose plan of the Party for the building of an economic giant come true with success. Kim Chol Ryong

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il to Be Remembered in Angola
body: A committee for remembering Chairman Kim Jong Il was formed in Angola on Nov. 30. Amalia Alexandr, international secretary of the Angolan Women's Organization, was elected chairwoman of the remembrance committee. The committee set a remembrance period from December 5 to 18 and decided to organize political and cultural events to praise the exploits performed by Kim Jong Il for the Korean revolution and the cause of global independence and to express support and solidarity with the Korean people who have gained consecutive successes in socialist construction in the period. Rodong News Team

title: The New Fireproof Paint Developed
body: The Ryujong Technological Exchange Agency worked hard for long to develop a new fireproof paint lately. The paint lowers the inflammability of paper, fiber, timber and other combustibles and prevents a fire from spreading rapidly. Both a sample coated with the paint and another one coated with a common paint were put in the flames of 800 ゜C by way of an experiment. The latter was reduced to ashes in five minutes, whereas the former remained intact, its surface carbonized 5mm in depth. The agency set itself a high goal of developing effective fireproof paints by their own efforts and with their technology. It strove energetically to determine the ideal rate of the composition of the chemical elements based on our raw materials and made new advances in producing fireproofing on a Juche footing. Resting on their laurels no longer, the officers and researchers of the agency endeavor actively to augment the quality of the new paint further, devise multi-purpose fireproof paints ceaselessly and widely apply them to many branches of the country. Jong Ryu Chol

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il to Be Remembered in Myanmar
body: A committee for remembering Chairman Kim Jong Il was formed in Myanmar on December 1. Tin Tun, director of the Myanmar Medical Research Institute, was elected chairman of the remembrance committee. The committee decided to organize political and cultural events including a remembrance meeting on the occasion of the 7th anniversary of demise of Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: The Machines of the PNMIF Assembled
body: The construction of the Pyongyang National Musical Instrument Factory is near completion to contribute a good deal to developing the national music of the country. The factory is under instructions from Chairman Kim Jong Il. It is an integrated national instrument producer which will turn out great numbers of string instruments like an oungum, an okryugum and a kayagum plus percussion and woodwind instruments such as a drum, an hourglass drum, a flute and a bamboo flute to meet the demand of the nation for them. The main buildings of the factory have been completed by the builders of the Munsubong Overseas Builders Training Center of the External Construction Guidance Bureau with the active moral and material aid of the Cabinet, ministries and central organs. Machines are assembled in the factory at full steam. The Ministry of Culture ensures that the builders are awakened to a great political and economic consciousness and motivated to work with devotion to finish the factory as soon as possible. The officials of the field headquarters supervise the construction of the factory on the spot and arrange for the builders to carry out their work assignments without fail every day. The scientists and technicians of the State Academy of Sciences, Kim Chaek University of Technology and many other institutions contribute their large share to fitting up machines in the factory. In the past most of musical instruments were made by hand. But our scientists and technicians made new machines which process the spare parts of musical instruments precisely. Efficient computer-aided machines were so made and installed as to numerically control the precise processing of the accessories of wooden musical instruments of diverse kinds. In addition, a casting machine in iron moulds and a dry kiln were designed, made and set up in our way. Dynamic efforts were made at the factory to actively utilize natural energy, so that it has been made quite possible to introduce the geothermal cooling and heating system into its buildings. Technology is imparted to the workers of the factory simultaneously with the assemblage of its machines. Yun Un Sim

title: Photo Exhibitions Held in Turkey
body: Photo exhibitions introducing the Democratic People's Republic of Korea took place in Istanbul and Ankara, Turkey, on Nov. 15 and 16. On display at its venues was a photo showing the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill. Also displayed there were photos showing the true picture of the DPRK advancing by dint of single-minded unity. Attending the opening ceremonies of the exhibitions were public figures and people of Turkey and the DPRK ambassador to the country and staff members of his embassy. Speakers at the ceremonies said the exhibition was opened successfully amid great interest of many people. The Korean people are friendly and diligent people, they said, adding that they could hardly repress their admiration for the appearance of the DPRK which has changed beyond imagination and the features of the Korean people who work with sincerity, full of optimism about tomorrow. Sending full support and solidarity to the Korean people in their struggle for firmly defending the sovereignty of the country through their dynamic struggle against imperialism, the personages of the Motherland Party of Turkey said they were rejoiced over the brilliant successes made by the Korean people under the leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea and that they would make positive efforts for developing the relations between the two countries. Rodong News Team

title: Japan Must Pay Dearly for All Its Crimes against Korean Nation
body: A research team at Seoul National University of south Korea recently opened to the public information of the crimes committed by the Japanese imperialists. A report in the U.S. National Archives deals with what Captain of the Navy Macmillan, former governor of Guam, experienced in captivity by the imperial Japanese army. According to it, on Jan. 3, 1942, over 70 women (sexual slaves for the Imperial Japanese Army) were in a row behind a Japanese army unit when its commander drew it up. And the women were soon taken to the barracks. Among the recently discovered documents were a report of the U.S. Command in Guam saying that seven comfort women were sent to a U.S. civilian hospital for the medical check and treatment, and a map of the “comfort stations” for the imperial Japanese army in an island. The recently discovered data are of great significance in proving the sexual slavery crime committed by the Japanese imperialists. Japan’s past crimes against the Korean people are the worst ones against humanity which cannot be seen in the world. No statute of limitations is applicable to the crimes against humanity, and the bloody history can never be hid and erased. Japan should no longer hatch a disgusting plot. It should pay dearly for all its hideous crimes against the Korean nation. An Chol Gwon

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Remembered in Different Countries
body: Events took place in various countries from Nov. 19 to 26 to commemorate the 7th anniversary of demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. They included seminars, remembrance meetings, lectures, book exhibitions and film shows in the Czech Republic, Ethiopia, Uganda and Thailand. Korean films "The Tower of the Juche Idea" and "My Country Has Emerged Victorious by Dint of Single-minded Unity" were shown. Jozef Servista, deputy general secretary of the Central Committee of the Czechoslovak Communist Party who doubles as chairman of the Paektusan Czech-Korean Friendship Association and chairman of the Czech Group for the Study and Materialization of the Juche Idea, said as follows: Great Comrade Kim Jong Il lives forever in the hearts of progressive mankind for his outstanding feats for the socialist construction in the DPRK and Korea's reunification and the cause of global independence. He developed and enriched the Juche idea founded by Comrade Kim Il Sung as required by the times and firmly defended Korean socialism by smashing with the unique Songun politics the moves of the imperialists to isolate and stifle the DPRK. Abdi Kedir, chairman of the Ethiopian Committee for the Study of the Independent Politics, said in a remembrance meeting that Kim Jong Il scientifically proved the validity of socialism and inevitability of its victory by publishing "Socialism Is a Science" and other works, and invariably maintained the principles of independence in politics, self-supporting in economy and self-reliance in defence. The participants in a lecture held in Uganda praised Kim Jong Il for making a great contribution to the development of the idea of mankind through his energetic ideological and theoretical activities. Songchit Pullarp, chairman of the Organization for the Study of the Juche Idea of Thailand, stressed that Kim Jong Il devoted all his life to the country's prosperity and people's happiness. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il to Be Remembered in Senegal
body: A Senegalese committee for remembering Chairman Kim Jong Il was formed on Nov. 27. Samba Sy, general secretary of the Workers' Party for the Independence of Senegal, was elected chairperson of the remembrance committee. The committee set a remembrance period from Dec. 3 to 17 and decided to hold political and cultural events including a reading session and film show in the period. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il to Be Remembered in Philippines
body: A Philippines committee for remembering Chairman Kim Jong Il was formed in Manila on Nov. 30. A member of the Philippines－DPRK Friendship Society was elected chairperson of the remembrance committee. The committee decided to organize political and cultural events on the occasion of the 7th anniversary of demise of Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il to Be Remembered in Libya
body: A Libyan committee for remembering Chairman Kim Jong Il was formed on December 2. Ahmad Muhammad Al Couleibi, chairman of the Libya－DPRK Friendship Association, was elected chairman of the remembrance committee. The committee decided to organize political and cultural events including a book and photo exhibition and film show to commemorate the 7th anniversary of Kim Jong Il's demise. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Praised by Organization of DR Congo
body: The National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of DR Congo released a bulletin on Nov. 14 on the occasion of the seventh anniversary of demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The bulletin in an article titled "DPRK, Snow in December" noted that Kim Jong Il lived a snow-like life. He devoted his all to the prosperity of the country and happiness of its people with his outlook on life as pure as snow to dedicate himself to the future, it said. It noted that he worked day and night to glorify the DPRK as a socialist country centered on the popular masses and reliably defend the security of the country and happiness of its people from the anti-socialist offensive by the imperialist allied forces. He, who was born at Mt Paektu and underwent all tempests of history, summed up his life at a train of journey for the people running in December of snowy storm, it pointed out. It said the Korean people miss him with tears on their faces when it snows. It noted that the Korean people have President Kim Il Sung, the founding father of socialist Korea, and Chairman Kim Jong Il in high esteem at the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun where they lie in state, full of the firm faith and will to remain true to their idea and cause to the end. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Yong Nam Meets Raul Castro Ruz
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, met and had a talk with Raul Castro Ruz, first secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba, in a friendly atmosphere at the office building of the Communist Party of Cuba on Dec. 4 when he made a stopover in Cuba on his return trip after taking part in the presidential inaugural ceremony in the United Mexican States. Kim Yong Nam referred to the DPRK visit by Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez, president of the Council of State and president of the Council of Ministers of the Republic of Cuba, expressing belief that the bilateral friendly relations would ceaselessly develop. Raul Castro Ruz wished Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un great success in his noble work of leading the struggle of the Korean people who turned out in the implementation of a new strategic line. Present there were Pak Thae Song, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and Ma Chol Su, DPRK ambassador to Cuba, and Bruno Rodriguez Parrilla, foreign minister of the Republic of Cuba. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK's Delegation Visits Mexico
body: A delegation of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea headed by Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, visited Mexico to take part in an inaugural ceremony of the president of the United Mexican States. During his visit Kim Yong Nam took part in the inaugural ceremony and met with Mexican President Andres Manuel Lopez Obrador at the presidential palace. He courteously conveyed the greeting and a gift from Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un to the president. Kim Yong Nam met with the heads of state of various countries who participated in the inaugural ceremony. He courteously conveyed the warm greetings from Kim Jong Un to Evo Morales Aima, president of the Plurinational State of Bolivia, and Danilo Medina Sanchez, president of the Dominican Republic. The presidents expressed deep thanks for it and asked Kim Yong Nam to convey their sincere greetings to Kim Jong Un. Kim Yong Nam met and had talks with Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez, president of the Council of State and president of the Council of Ministers of the Republic of Cuba, and Nicolas Maduro Moros, president of the Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela. He met with dignitaries of various countries including the vice-chairperson of the Standing Committee of the Chinese National People's Congress who is the chairperson of the All-China Women's Federation, and vice-presidents of Argentina, Uruguay and El Salvador.
