Rodong News Team

title: Ri Su Yong Meets Iranian Delegation
body: Ri Su Yong, chairman of the Foreign Affairs Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, met and had a talk with the delegation of the Iran-Korea Parliamentary Friendship Group led by Chairman Alaeddin Borujerdi who paid a courtesy call on him on Friday. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il to Be Remembered in Slovakia
body: A Slovak committee for remembering Chairman Kim Jong Il was formed in Bratislava on Dec. 1. Ivan Draxler, chairman of the Slovak Association for Supporting and Studying the Juche Idea and chairman of the Slovakia-Korea Friendship Association, was elected chairman of the remembrance committee. The committee decided to organize political and cultural events praising the revolutionary career and exploits of Kim Jong Il on the occasion of the 7th anniversary of his demise. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Work Published in Russia
body: Chairman Kim Jong Il's work "The Grand Mass Gymnastics and Artistic Performance Arirang Is a World-class Masterpiece Representative of the New Century" was brought out in booklet by the Radio Soft Publishing House of Russia on the occasion of the 7th anniversary of his demise. A book-releasing ceremony took place on Nov. 28. Rodong News Team

title: Iranian Delegation Leaves
body: The delegation of the Iran-Korea Parliamentary Friendship Group led by Chairman Alaeddin Borujerdi left here for home on Saturday. Rodong News Team

title: Meeting in Japan Voices Support for Korea's Reunification
body: The 36th meeting for the movement to support Korea's reunification took place in Tokyo on Nov. 24. It was attended by Fumihiro Himori, chairman of the Japan Committee for Supporting the Independent and Peaceful Reunification of Korea, and delegates and personages of solidarity organizations from Hokkaido, Nagano, Fukushima, Gunma, Kyoto and others. Also present there were Nam Sung U, vice-chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), So Chung On, director of its Department for International Affairs and Reunification, and Koreans in Japan. Hirokazu Kitakawa, deputy general secretary of the Japan Committee for Supporting the Independent and Peaceful Reunification of Korea, gave a keynote address, to be followed by speeches under the theme "Toward a new arena for peace and reunification". An appeal for more dynamically conducting a campaign for repairing the DPRK-Japan relations was adopted there. Rodong News Team

title: Congratulations to Swiss President-elect
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, sent a congratulatory message to Ueli Maurer, Swiss president-elect, on Friday. The message expressed the belief that the relations between the two countries would develop further in mutual interests, wishing the president-elect success in his responsible work for the prosperity of the country. Rodong News Team

title: Korean People’s Spirit of Self-Reliance
body: It is the fixed will of the Korean people to build a powerful socialist nation, to be envied by the world, without fail on this land. The DPRK’s history of building a prosperous country means the one of self-reliance. The Korean people have never thought of economic construction based on aids from others. They have settled everything by their own efforts on the principle of self-reliance and self-sufficiency, making only miracles. They won brilliant victory in two stages of arduous social revolution, two times of rehabilitation and construction and several stages of socialist construction, overcoming all trials and difficulties by their own efforts. They made a series of world-startling miracles in the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance and hard-working even in the days when socialism collapsed in some countries and imperialists went to extremes in their moves to isolate and stifle the DPRK. They are now striving to win the final victory while putting spurs on economic construction with the same spirit and mettle. The might of Juche Korea is, indeed, inexhaustible. No one can check the dynamic advance of the Korean people who are making signal development in socialist economic construction in the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance. Ri Hak Nam

title: DPRK Embassy in Vietnam Hosts Reception
body: The DPRK embassy in Vietnam gave a reception on December 3 to mark the 60th anniversary of President Kim Il Sung's visit to Vietnam. Invited to the reception were figures of political parties, government, ministries, organizations and institutions of Vietnam including the Communist Party, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Ministry of Defence, the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism, the Vietnam Union of Friendship Organizations, the Vietnam-DPRK Friendship Association, the Academy of Social Sciences, Ho Chi Minh Museum and Newspaper Nhan Dan. Attending it were the ambassador and officials of the DPRK embassy. Speeches were made there. Tran Thanh Man, secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam (CPV) and president of the C.C., Fatherland Front of Vietnam, said that the traditional relations of friendship between Vietnam and the DPRK was provided and cultivated with much effort by President Ho Chi Minh and President Kim Il Sung. He went on: Ho Chi Minh's visit to the DPRK and Kim Il Sung's visit to Vietnam served as a firm cornerstone for the development of bilateral relations. I was very pleased to take part in the celebrations for the 70th founding anniversary of the DPRK in September as the head of the party and state delegation of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam. I am convinced that the friendly and cooperative relations between the two parties and two countries will continue to grow stronger in conformity with the aspiration and interests of the peoples of the two countries and contribute to promoting regional peace, stability and development. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il to Be Remembered in Russia
body: A committee for remembering Chairman Kim Jong Il was formed by the branch of the Russian Association for the Study of the Juche Idea in the Republic of Altai on Dec. 2. Kadkina Daria, chairwoman of the Branch, was elected chairwoman of the remembrance committee. The committee decided to hold political and cultural events like remembrance meeting on the occasion of the 7th anniversary of the demise of Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il to Be Remembered in Zambia
body: A committee for remembering Chairman Kim Jong Il was formed in Zambia on Dec. 3. The rector of a middle school was elected chairman of the remembrance committee. The committee decided to organize political and cultural events like remembrance meeting and film show on the occasion of the 7th anniversary of the demise of Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: Gift to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from IIJI Secretary General
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was presented with a gift by the secretary general of the International Institute of the Juche Idea (IIJI). Kenichi Ogami, secretary general of the IIJI, conveyed the gift to an official concerned on Dec. 1. Rodong News Team

title: Head of DPRK Government Delegation Meets Chinese President
body: Foreign Minister of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea Ri Yong Ho on a visit to the People's Republic of China as head of the DPRK government delegation met with Xi Jinping, president of the PRC, at the Great Hall of the People on Dec.7. Xi Jinping said: Under the guidance of Comrade Kim Jong Un the Korean people are striving to implement a new strategic line set forth at the Third Plenary Meeting of the 7th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. He noted that China is attaching high importance to the China-DPRK relations, adding that it is the fixed policy of the Chinese party and government to develop the China-DPRK friendly relations. Ri Yong Ho said that the understanding shared by the top leaders of the two countries in their historic meetings serves as precious guidelines indicating the orientation in developing the DPRK-China friendly relations, as required by a new era. He wished the Chinese people bigger success in the struggle for achieving prosperity of the Chinese nation under the guidance of the Communist Party of China. Rodong News Team

title: Talks between Foreign Ministers of DPRK, PRC Held
body: Talks took place between Foreign Minister of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea Ri Yong Ho who is heading the DPRK government delegation on a visit to the People’s Republic of China, and Wang Yi, state councilor and foreign minister of the PRC, in Beijing on Friday. At the talks both sides recalled that a new heyday of the friendly relations between the DPRK and the PRC was ushered in and exchange and cooperation brisk in every field this year. They also exchanged views on further expanding and developing the traditional bilateral friendly relations next year marking the 70th anniversary of establishment of the diplomatic relations between the two countries and on the issues of mutual concern. Present there from the DPRK side were members of the government delegation and Ji Jae Ryong, ambassador to China, and from the Chinese side officials of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs including Vice-Minister Kong Xuanyou. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Government Delegation Arrives in Ulan Bator
body: The government delegation of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) led by Foreign Minister Ri Yong Ho arrived in Ulan Bator on Dec. 8 to visit Mongolia. Rodong News Team

title: Talks between Foreign Ministers of DPRK, Mongolia Held
body: Talks took place between Foreign Minister of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea Ri Yong Ho, who is heading the DPRK government delegation on a visit to Mongolia, and D. Tsogtbaatar, minister of Foreign Affairs and Trade of Mongolia, at the building of the FM on Dec. 8. At the talks, both sides appreciated that the DPRK and Mongolia have conducted brisk exchange and cooperation in various fields this year marking the 70th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic ties between the two countries, and exchanged views on the development of bilateral relations and international and regional issues. Present there from the DPRK side were members of the government delegation and the ambassador to Mongolia and from the Mongolian side the advisor for Foreign Policy to the prime minister, the ambassador to the DPRK and members of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il to Be Remembered in Russia
body: A committee for remembering Chairman Kim Jong Il was formed by the Amur Regional Branch Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation on December 4. L. A. Kobuizov, first secretary of the Amur Regional Branch Committee, was elected chairman of the remembrance committee. The committee decided to organize political and cultural events praising Kim Jong Il's noble career and immortal exploits on the occasion of the 7th anniversary of his demise. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il to Be Remembered in Germany
body: A committee for remembering Chairman Kim Jong Il was formed by the German Group for the Study of Korean Culture on December 4. Manfred Schneider, chief of the group, was elected chairman of the committee. The committee decided to hold political and cultural events in praise of immortal exploits of Kim Jong Il on the occasion of the 7th anniversary of his demise. Rodong News Team

title: State Commendations Conferred on Working People and Officials
body: State commendations were conferred on scientists, technicians, teachers and other working people and officials, who made labor achievements in this year's struggle, with due ceremony at the Mansudae Assembly Hall in the DPRK on Monday. Ryong Kun Chol was awarded Order of Kim Jong Il; Song Man Ho and Pak Ho Chol the title of Labor Hero, Gold Medal (Hammer and Sickle) and Order of National Flag First Class; Kang Chang Su and Song Un Sun watches bearing the august name of President Kim Il Sung; Rim Sun Hui and Hong Thae Sik watches bearing the august name of Chairman Kim Jong Il; Jong Pu Chan, Hong Kwang Il, Pak Yong Chol, Jon Yong Bom, Pak Jun Il, Ok Kwang Il and Kim Won Yong the citations of Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea; Hyon Chol Jin the citation of Kim Jong Un, Supreme Commander of the Korean People's Army; Jo Ryu Gyong, Kim Hyok and Kim Kwang Chol Kim Il Sung Youth Honor Prize and Cha Myong Nam Kim Jong Il Youth Honor Prize. The title of People's Scientist went to Kang Ung Gwon, the title of People's Teacher to Choe Jong Hwa and Ri Hyang and honorary titles were conferred on 24 people. 50 people including Kim Chang Gun and Ra Yong Chan were awarded Order of National Flag First Class. 83 were awarded Order of Labour and Order of National Flag Second Class. Labor achievements greatly conducive to the building of powerful socialist country this year were mentioned at the ceremony. Rodong News Team

title: Ri Yong Ho Meets Mongolian Deputy PM
body: DPRK Foreign Minister Ri Yong Ho who is on a visit to Mongolia as head of the DPRK government delegation met and had a talk with U. Enkhtuvshin, Mongolian deputy prime minister, on Dec. 9. Rodong News Team

title: Italian Figure Arrives
body: President Impagliazzo Marco of the Community of Santegidio, Italian organization for humanitarian cooperation, and his party arrived in Pyongyang on Monday. Rodong News Team

title: Japan, Barbarous State of 21st Century
body: Recently an international meeting was held for peace and prosperity of Asia and the Pacific. Often heard at the meeting were strong voices branding Japan as a barbarous state which behaves arrogantly and imprudently far from admitting its past crimes and making an apology for the hideous crimes against the Korean nation and Asian countries in the last century. Japan acts as if it has completely forgotten the thrice-cursed crimes committed in the wake of its illegal occupation of Korea in the last century. It is an instinctive movement of a brute to rush about unaware of what waits for himself. The Japanese reactionaries - a herd of beasts in rags of “the imperial Japanese Army” wielding a Japanese sword to call back the departed soul of “Yasukuni Shrine”- should be mindful that today’s Korea is not a weak country trampled because of a lack of national power to defend itself, but a country strong enough to bury the archipelago in the Pacific along with its indelible past crimes. Crime-ridden Japan, though belatedly, should honestly apologize for, reflect on and make reparation for its hideous past crimes to the Korean nation and the conscience of mankind and give up the daydream of reinvasion without reluctance, if it wants to get rid of its disgrace. Barbarous Japan should learn first what disgrace and conscience are instead of freaking out. To do so is the first step to be taken by Japan to undo shackles of crime and enter the bright world. Kim Yon I

title: Spring Water Factories Built in the Provinces
body: Modern spring water factories are under construction in all the provinces to contribute to improving the living levels of our people. According to the data of the Ministry of Local Industry, North Phyongan, Kangwon and South Hamgyong Provinces were the first to finish spring water factories respectively and operated them on a trial basis. The construction of spring water factories are near completion in North and South Hwanghae Provinces and many others, too. Kangwon Province erected buildings for the production of spring water in a short time by introducing rational methods of construction. It also made the relevant machines on its own and test-ran them with success. The officials of the North Phyongan Provincial Bureau for the Management of Local Industry cooperated with a related scientific research institute in designing spring water processors suited to its actual conditions and stepped up their production. Some time ago the Kusong Chongryongsan Spring Water Factory was operated on trial successfully. South Hamgyong Province tapped its internal reserves to the maximum and thereby made and test-ran spring water machines. It gears up preparations to put its spring water factory in commission. Jagang, South Phyongan and North and South Hwanghae Provinces and Nampho City, too, do all they can to finish building their spring water factories at an early date. Ri Chol Ok

title: Chanting the Praise of Socialism
body: On December 3 (the International Day of Persons with Disabilities) the members of the art circles of the Korean Society of Disability Artists performed at the Central Youth Hall. The hall was packed by spectators from at home and abroad to capacity. The performance began with the song and dance “Glory to General Kim Jong Un”. It was followed by the chorus “Ode to Motherland”, the female solo “The Party Is My Mother”, the piano solo “My Country Filled with Hope”, the folk dance “Ongheya” and various others. The disabled poet Ri Kuk Chol recited “My Dream”, a poem of his own composing, leaving deep impressions on the audience. Kim Myong Suk, a blind woman of 63, played a kayagum solo and beat a janggu dexterously to the audience’s delight. Pak Jin Ri formerly got an enthusiastic encore at every performance. This time, too, she was loudly applauded for singing the songs “Rays of Affection”, “We Love Party Flag”, “The Swift Horse Girl Rider” and some world-famous songs perfectly. The disabled artists are not unhappy at all under our socialist system because all our disabled people lead fruitful lives under the special care of the Party, the state and society. They join all normal others in attending school, conducting sports activities briskly and living worthily according to their taste and liking. Last year a group of the disabled of Pyongyang successfully gave performances in London and many other cities of Britain. Many of the British remarked that their performance was impressive beyond all imagination, that they could not be believed to be disabled, that their technical skill could not but be marveled at, that their performance keenly convinced them that Korea gave a good education to the disabled, too and that it was a sheer fabrication to accuse Korea of human rights. Yun Un Sim

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Exploits Praised in Different Countries
body: Events took place in different countries with the approach of the 7th anniversary of the demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. A remembrance meeting took place in Venezuela and seminars on Kim Jong Il's exploits in Russia and Uganda from November 29 to December 2. The chairman of the Yaracuy State Legislative Council of Venezuela said that socialism is victoriously advancing in the DPRK as Kim Jong Il firmly defended the banner of socialism and demonstrated its vitality and dignity all over the world. A vice chief of the Russian Group for Solidarity with the DPRK said that Kim Jong Il defended the destiny of the country and people by pursuing Songun politics and provided a sure guarantee for building a powerful socialist country in the most arduous days as to the Korean people, adding that as he loved the people before anything else, he was always on the road for the well-being of the people till the last moments of his life. Saying that Kim Jong Il made his unbounded devotion and efforts for the building of powerful Korea as it is, the participants in the seminar held in Uganda noted that his precious exploits for global independence will remain long. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il to Be Remembered in Switzerland
body: A Swiss committee for remembering the 7th anniversary of the demise of Generalissimo Kim Jong Il, the Swiss Organizing Committee for the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu, the Switzerland-Korea Committee and the Swiss Group for the Study of the Juche Idea issued a joint statement on December 2 with the approach of the 7th anniversary of the demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The statement said the world progressives praise Kim Jong Il as an outstanding state leader as he performed immortal feats for the reunification of Korea and global independence. It noted that Kim Jong Il's demise was the greatest loss to the Korean people and progressive mankind. It pointed out that Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un made sure that Kim Jong Il is held in high esteem as the eternal leader of the Korean people and his revolutionary career and exploits remain long. It said that Kim Jong Un is carrying forward Kim Jong Il's idea and line without an inch of deflection. It noted that he provided historic north-south summit meetings one after another this year to adopt the Panmunjom Declaration and the "September Pyongyang Joint Declaration" and thus performed great exploits in implementing Kim Jong Il's instructions for national reunification. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il to Be Remembered in Russia
body: A Russian committee for remembering Chairman Kim Jong Il was formed in Moscow on December 5. Victor Petrov, chairman of the Russian Association for Friendship and Cultural Cooperation with the DPRK and chairman of the Russian Committee to Praise the Great Persons of Mt Paektu, was elected chairman of the remembrance committee. The committee decided to organize political and cultural events including remembrance meeting on the occasion of the 7th anniversary of the demise of Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: Annual General Meeting of Bulgaria-Korea Friendship Association Held
body: The annual general meeting of the Bulgaria-Korea Friendship Association was held in Sofia on November 30. The general meeting reviewed the activities of the association and discussed its working plan. It elected the leadership of the association. Mincho Minchev was elected as chairman of the association and Milcho Gyuvrov, Lyudmil Kostadinov and Plamen Kamprov were elected as vice-chairmen. Rodong News Team

title: Ri Su Yong Meets Vietnamese New Ambassador
body: Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, met and had a talk with Le Ba Binh, new Vietnamese ambassador to the DPRK who paid a courtesy call on him on Tuesday. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Government Delegation Back Home
body: A government delegation of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea led by Foreign Minister Ri Yong Ho returned home on Tuesday after visiting the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, the Syrian Arab Republic, the People's Republic of China and Mongolia. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Marathon Runners Return Home
body: The DPRK players returned home on Tuesday after attending the 2018 Chinese Taipei International Marathon. Men and women aces from the DPRK, China, Ethiopia, Kenya and other countries and regions attended the marathon. Jo Un Ok of the DPRK took the first place in the women's marathon. Rodong News Team

title: U.S. Should Get Rid of Bad Habit of Confrontation and Hostility
body: The U.S. has recently made public a presidential resolution terming the DPRK “human trafficking country.” It is an unpardonable political provocation against the dignified DPRK and the most hostile act against the spirit of the Singapore DPRK-U.S. summit talks. Human trafficking is unthinkable in the DPRK where its system is based on giving priority to the people and loving them and the revolutionary comradeship and virtue constitute the spirit of the society thanks to the people-fist policy. The U.S. is the world’s worst graveyard of human rights. The recent provocation is designed to tarnish the image of the dignified DPRK at any cost and create an atmosphere for more sanctions and pressure. The U.S. persistent “human rights” campaign, a product of its extreme ignorance, prejudice and long-standing hostile policy against the DPRK, only betrays the inhumane nature of the U.S. The U.S. pledged to end the history of hostility and confrontation between the two countries, but still resorts to sanctions and pressure accompanied with vicious slander on the dignity and social system of the dialogue partner. Such double-dealing tactics deserves domestic and international denunciation. The U.S. would be well-advised to get rid of the stale habit of confrontation and hostility at an early date, mindful that the trite “human rights” racket against the DPRK will bring only disgrace upon the U.S. Ho Yong Min

title: The Dormitory As Good As Finished
body: Koryo Songgyungwan University, the pride and treasure of the Korean nation, boasts a history of more than 1,000 years. It is the oldest of its kind in the world. The construction of its modern dormitory neared completion. In early times President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il ensured that a building, a dormitory, an e-library, etc were newly set up around the university to add eternal luster to it. The new building was completed in September 2012. This year the construction of the dormitory entered its finishing stage on schedule. To this end the Cabinet and the central headquarters for the building of Koryo Songgyungwan University transported various kinds of daily commodities, building materials and many others to the construction site of the dormitory on their own responsibility. Under the noble plan of the Party to bring about a great revolution in education all the builders and the officials of related institutions work with revolutionary enthusiasm to finish the dormitory at the earliest date. Kim Yun Mi

title: S. Korean Military Hell-bent on Arms Build-up and War Drill
body: The south Korean military decided to introduce lots of foreign-made weapons and equipment at a recent meeting of the Committee for the Promotion of Defence. The military staged a combined drill for the combat preparedness of the Air Force, crying out for “security measure” to cope with drill vacuum. The large-scale arms build-up and war drill are a product of the attempt for showdown with the DPRK behind the curtain of dialogue. The misbehavior of the south Korean military is reminiscent of the reckless acts in the era of confrontation when the trigger-happy forces were trying to ignite a war with the clamor about the “theory that the north is a principal enemy” and “preemptive attack”. Under the past conservative regime the south Korean war mongers were hell-bent on military provocation against the fellow countrymen with the help of foreign forces. As a result, the distrust and confrontation between the north and south of Korea were escalated and the situation always remained tense. The military should learn a lesson from the reckless act of the former conservative regime which resorted to the foolish military confrontation with the north to drive the inter-Korean ties to the brink of war. Any military action against dialogue partner destroys confidence between the north and south and has side effect on the north-south relations and the situation in the Korean peninsula. The south Korean military would be well-advised to behave itself, well aware of the consequences to be entailed by the reckless arms build-up and war drill. Sim Chol Yong

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Introduced in Russia
body: The full text of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work "The Cause of the Great Party of Comrades Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il Is Ever-Victorious" was posted on the Russian website "DPRK Today" ahead of the 7th anniversary of the demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The work, published on Oct. 4, Juche 104 (2015), clarifies the idea that the 70-year-long history of the Workers' Party of Korea is a history of victory in which the validity and invincibility of the cause of the Party of Comrades Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il have been displayed and that the cause of the Party is invincible. Rodong News Team

title: Foreign Media Praise Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Special write-ups were carried by media of different countries on the occasion of the 7th anniversary of the demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. An internet website of the Brazilian Center for the Study of Songun Politics carried an article about the peerlessly great man's patriotic life together with immortal revolutionary hymn under the title of "'Song of General Kim Jong Il' resounding far and wide". The article was illustrated with a portrait of smiling Kim Jong Il. The Russian internet website Patrioti Moskva carried an article titled "Politician with great moral obligation" illustrated with a portrait of smiling Kim Jong Il and a photo of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. The article said Kim Jong Un made sure that Kim Jong Il is held as the eternal image after his demise and February 16 is instituted as Day of the Shining Star. The Bangladeshi newspaper The Daily Folk carried an article praising Kim Jong Un's noble moral obligation. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il to Be Remembered in Finland
body: A committee for remembering Chairman Kim Jong Il was formed in Helsinki of Finland on December 7. Pekka Kotkasaari, chairman of the Finland-Korea Society, was elected chairman of the committee. The committee decided to organize political and cultural events including a remembrance meeting, book and photo exhibition and film show on the occasion of the 7th anniversary of demise of Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: Book Releasing Ceremony Held in Russia
body: Books "Juche Idea for Interests of People" and "Toward the Sun" were published in Russia. A book releasing ceremony took place on November 23. Present there were figures of all social standings, members of organisations of friendship and solidarity with the Korean people and organizations for the study of the Juche idea, the DPRK ambassador to Russia and his embassy officials. Vladimir Sychev, director of the Forum Book Publishing House of Russia, said that in the wake of the publication of a book about the Juche idea which sees constant application in the DPRK in 2015, the serial of the book "Juche Idea for Interests of People" was off the press this time, adding that eye-opening successes achieved by the Korean people in the building of a powerful socialist country were the fruits of the outstanding political caliber and tested guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. The editor-in-chief of the publishing house said that in the course of the publication of the books she came to know better that under the wise guidance of Kim Jong Un the Korean people have registered remarkable successes in all fields in the spirit of self-reliance and self-development. She expressed the will to continue to publish books introducing the reality of the DPRK. A Russian writer said: The great Comrade Kim Il Sung, the founder of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, pursued politics for the people believing in them as in Heaven. The great Comrade Kim Jong Il is an outstanding leader who firmly defended the sovereignty and dignity of the country with his Songun politics. The Korean people who hold in high esteem the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un are constantly advancing along the road of socialism. The DPRK is vigorously advancing socialism with its own idea and faith, not reading other's face. This is an example to be followed by the world progressives. I will keep on writing articles in support of the just cause of the Korean people in the future, too. Rodong News Team

title: Pak Pong Ju Inspects Some Units in North Phyongan Province
body: Premier Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected various units in North Phyongan Province. During the tours of the Sinuiju Textile Mill, the Sinuiju Streptomycin Factory and the Sinuiju Chemical Fibre Mill, Pak underscored the need to spruce them up as they are the units associated with the leadership exploits of the Party, step up technical modernization of equipment on the basis of science and technology and steadily improve the quality of products. At the consultative meetings during his inspection of the Rakwon Machine Complex, the Sinuiju Cosmetics Factory and the Ponghwa Chemical Factory, Pak stressed the need to concentrate all efforts on the struggle for fulfilling this year's national economic plan and remodel the equipment and production processes into technology-intensive and labor-saving ones and called on relevant fields to take concrete measures to supply necessary raw and other materials to them. Rodong News Team

title: Swedish Embassy Gives Reception
body: The Swedish embassy to the DPRK hosted a reception on Wednesday to mark Lucia Day, a folk holiday of Sweden. Present there on invitation were Im Chon Il, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, So Ho Won, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries, officials concerned and members of foreign diplomatic and international bodies to the DPRK. On hand were Swedish Ambassador to the DPRK Jonas Michael Wendel and embassy officials. Rodong News Team

title: Many Visitors to Hall of Victory in Songun Revolution
body: A little over five years have passed since the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum was built anew into a great monumental structure and a comprehensive center of education. So far it has been visited by more than 2,300,000 people, including the officers and men of the Korean People’s Army. All the country yearns for Chairman Kim Jong Il infinitely and deeply admires him for dedicating his all to its wealth, strength and prosperity and the happiness of the people until he breathed his last. Visitors to the Hall of Victory in Songun Revolution increase in number this December alone as never before. The museum is an eternal treasure house dedicated to adding everlasting luster to the undying services rendered by President Kim Il Sung to victory in the Fatherland Liberation War and by the Chairman to the Songun revolution. It is also an edifice of victory which informs the whole world of the heroic fighting spirit and distinguished war services of our people. Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un ensured that the museum was built into a superb monumental structure symbolizing the eternal victory of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il’s Korea. He said that the Chairman consolidated the President’s victories in the war to the full, and arranged for the hall to be newly built in the museum to synthesize the immortal services done by the Chairman to the Songun revolution. Looking round the hall, visitors are warmly moved by the fact that the Chairman was at the front all his life to defend the sovereignty of the country and the nation and lay the eternal foundations for the prosperity of the coming generations. Foreign visitors to the hall, too, highly praised the Chairman for leading the cause of anti-imperialist independence to victory through the Songun revolution. Kim Yun Mi

title: The Peerless Great Contributor to the Cause of Global Independence
body: Chairman Kim Jong Il was a peerless great man who defended the destiny of socialism through his indefatigable ideological and theoretical activities and dynamic leadership. The socialist movement of the world underwent unexpected ordeals late in the 20th century. The red banner of socialism was pulled down in other countries. A great change was brought about in the political fabric of the world and the balance of its forces. When the cause of socialism was at a crossroads he determinedly shattered the anti-socialist sophistry of imperialists and renegades through his ideological and theoretical activities and extricated the socialist movement from a crisis with immortal devotion and outstanding guidance. In his immortal classic work “Abuses of Socialism Are Intolerable” he clearly demonstrated that although imperialists condemned socialism as “totalitarian”, “barracks-like” and “administrative and commanding”, their slanders and abuses of all hues were sheer fabrications and sophisms. He published the immortal classic work “Socialism Is A Science”, in which he logically proved the scientific accuracy and truth of socialism and the inevitability of its victory, thus fully exploding the sophisms of all shades concocted by the reactionaries of history to vilify socialism. He wisely led the progressive parties of the world to strengthen their unity and cooperation and thereby contribute to accomplishing the cause of socialism. He also announced the immortal classic work “On the Fundamentals of Revolutionary Party Building”. In the work he deeply analyzed the historical lessons from ruling party building in socialist countries and supplied clear-cut answers to the fundamentals of revolutionary party building required by the times and the socialist movement of the world. He energetically led many revolutionary and progressive parties to vigorously advance the socialist movement of the world under the banner of unity. In the process of this the historic Pyongyang Declaration “Let’s Defend and Advance the Cause of Socialism” was adopted and proclaimed in Korea. This declared that the socialist movement of the world started anew and advanced under the banner of the Juche idea and independence. He was the incarnation of benevolence that captivated the heart of everybody with noble moral duty and ardent love and set the world in motion. Even the politicians of hostile countries bowed to him of their own accord, admiring his infinite magnanimity and tolerance. He was an all-time great man of peerless charisma who not only defended the cause of socialism and human independence through his prominent ideological and theoretical activities and with his dynamic guidance but also swayed the world with noble virtues and personality. Ri Hyo Jin

title: Workers, Trade Union Members Meet
body: A resolve-making meeting of workers and members of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea (GFTUK) took place at the Central Hall of Workers on Thursday on the occasion of the seventh anniversary of the demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Present there were Vice-Chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea Choe Hwi and trade union officials, and workers and trade union members in Pyongyang. Ju Yong Gil, chairman of the Central Committee of the GFTUK, made a report which was followed by speeches. The reporter and speakers said the revolutionary life of Kim Jong Il was the great one of a peerless patriot who had defended the destiny of the country and the nation and devoted his all to the building of beautiful future for the people with a sense of obligation for the country and the revolution, iron will and outstanding leadership. They recalled that the foundation for building a socialist powerful nation was provided thanks to the great efforts of Kim Jong Il who had made high-intensity forced march for field guidance to every part of the country for the development of economy and improvement of people's living standard. They called for working hard to display the spirit of the heroic Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il working class and bring earlier the final victory in building the socialist powerful nation under the guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: Ryesonggang Youth Power Station No. 5 Inaugurated
body: The Ryesonggang Youth Power Station No. 5 was newly built. It will contribute to promoting economic development and people's living in North Hwanghae Province. An inaugural ceremony was held on Thursday. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Yong Nam Receives Credentials from Finnish Ambassador
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, received credentials from Suominen Eero Antero, Finnish ambassador to the DPRK, and had a talk with him at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Thursday. Rodong News Team

title: Italian Guests Visit Various Places in Pyongyang
body: President Impagliazzo Marco of the Community of Santegidio, Italian organization for humanitarian cooperation, and his party visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. Being told about the patriotic and revolutionary careers of the President and his family members, the Italian guests looked around the historical mementoes at the old home in Mangyongdae. They also visited Pyongyang University of Foreign Studies, Pyongyang Children's Foodstuff Factory, etc. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Works Posted on Russian Homepages
body: Full texts of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's works "Let Us Add Eternal Brilliance to Comrade Kim Jong Il's Great Idea and Achievements of the Songun Revolution" and "Let Us Brilliantly Accomplish the Revolutionary Cause of Juche, Holding the Great Comrade Kim Jong Il in High Esteem as the Eternal General Secretary of Our Party" were posted on Russia's internet news Erofei-Deve and homepage Amur Press on December 7 with the approach of the 7th anniversary of the demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. They also carried the photo of Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Remembered in Different Countries
body: Remembrance meetings took place in Myanmar, Iceland and Senegal on December 4 and 5 to commemorate the 7th anniversary of the demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Present there were figures of different social standings and masses in relevant countries. The secretary of the Yangon Regional Committee of the Union Solidarity and Development Party of Myanmar said: HE Kim Jong Il performed immortal exploits in fortifying the DPRK as an invincible socialist bulwark, achieving the reunification of the country and ensuring peace and security on the Korean peninsula. Thanks to his wise leadership the DPRK could display its dignity as a politico-ideological power and military power. The great exploits of HE Kim Jong Il have been further glorified by HE Kim Jong Un. The chairperson of the Iceland-DPRK Friendly and Cultural Society said that Kim Jong Il's demise left the pain of great loss in the hearts of the Korean people and the world progressives, adding that he was a great revolutionary who devoted all his life to the prosperity of socialist Korea. He, who performed immortal feats for the reunification of Korea and the global independence, is always alive as a peerless patriot and benevolent father in the minds of mankind, the chairperson said. Speakers including a spokesperson for the Workers' Party for the Independence of Senegal who is a member of its Political Bureau highly praised Kim Jong Il for making the journey of revolutionary leadership on behalf of the country and people day and night all his life. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il to Be Remembered in Belgium
body: A Belgian committee for remembering Chairman Kim Jong Il was formed in Brussels on December 6. The chairman of the Belgium-Korea Friendship Association was elected as chairman of the remembrance committee. The committee decided to organize political and cultural events praising Kim Jong Il's revolutionary career and exploits on the occasion of the 7th anniversary of his demise. Rodong News Team

title: Remembrance Concert Given by Members of Women's Union
body: Officials and members of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea (SWUK) gave a remembrance concert at the Hall of Women on Thursday ahead of the seventh anniversary of demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Put on the stage of the concert which started with poem and chorus "Ode to Comrade Kim Jong Il" were narration and chorus "O Korea, I Will Add Glory to Thee", an immortal classic, solo and pangchang (off-stage song) "Tell, O Road of Songun", instrument and a series of songs "Appearing in the East and in the West, It's the Anti-Japanese Guerilla Style" and so forth. The performers well represented the revolutionary career and exploits of Kim Jong Il, who devoted himself to the country's prosperity and people's happiness and laid the firm groundwork for the building of a powerful socialist nation. Among the audience were Ri Il Hwan, department director of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea, Jang Chun Sil, chairwoman of the C.C., SWUK, and its officials and members in Pyongyang. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of DPRK Olympic Committee Leaves for China
body: A delegation of the DPRK Olympic Committee led by Minister of Physical Culture and Sports Kim Il Guk, chairman of the Olympic Committee, left Pyongyang for China on Dec. 13 to attend the Guangzhou World Judo Masters 2018 as guest of honor. Rodong News Team

title: Cancer-like Entity Harassing Peace
body: Shortly ago, the Swiss newspaper Neue Zurich Zeitung carried a commentary dealing with the daily-increasing contradiction between the attempt of Japan at possession of aircraft carrier and its constitution. The commentary says that the Japanese conservative force claims Japan’s repossession of aircraft carrier which it gave up after the Second World War and Japan has two helicopter escort ships that can be rebuilt into aircraft carriers and keeps their rebuilding a secret. Japan’s possession of aircraft carrier, in its essence from A to Z, aims at launching a preemptive attack. The Japan “Self-Defence Forces” have all services and arms and have steadily bolstered their capability for preemptive strike. Japan’s attempt at possession of aircraft carrier is part of its moves for boosting its preemptive-attack capability. The operational sphere of the SDF was expanded to the Indian Ocean as well as the Pacific. It comes to be a fait accompli that Japanese aircraft carriers could be seen in the Pacific and the Indian Ocean. In case Japan possesses aircraft carriers, it may reproduce the Pearl Harbor incident. All its desperate efforts to revise the current constitution are destined for plunging the Asia-Pacific region into the tragic disaster of another world war. Japan emerged as a cancer-like entity harassing peace in the Asia-Pacific region and the rest of the world. Ri Hyon Do

title: Noble Traits of Korean People
body: It is the rational duty and noblest moral obligation of the Korean people to hold Chairman Kim Jong Il in high esteem for all ages and remain faithful to him down through generations, as they grew up under his warm care. The noble traits of our people sincerely upholding the leader have been fully displayed since the Korean nation suffered a great loss. The revolutionary traits of our people who devote themselves to implementing the cause of immortalizing the leader with ardent yearning for Kim Jong Il clearly showed the world people how revolutionaries have to uphold their leader. Upon the receipt of stirring news that Kim Jong Il would be laid in state for perpetuity at the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, all the people in the country have passionately devoted their sincerity to sprucing up the holy place of Juche. And they have showed their noble sense of obligation and sincerity in erecting his statues, mosaics depicting the portrait of him with smile and monuments to his on-the-spot instructions and field guidance. It comes to be an accepted way of life for officials and working people across the country to look up to his image whenever they are in joy or in difficulties. The history of blood ties between Kim Jong Il and the Korean people will go down forever thanks to the warm loyalty of the people who absolutely believe in and follow the leader. So Song Bom

title: Korean Film Shows Held in Russia
body: Film shows took place at the Maritime Territorial Regional Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation and the Maritime Territorial Branch Committee of the "A Just Russia" on December 7 and 8 to commemorate the 7th anniversary of the demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Russian figures said that they were moved to see films dealing with Kim Jong Il's noble trait and immortal exploits for the development of friendly relations between the DPRK and Russia. The first secretary of the Maritime Territorial Regional Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation who is chairman of the Association for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism in the Far East Region said that while seeing the film, he looked back upon the time when a tablet to honor Kim Jong Il was displayed at a hotel in Vladivostok City that he visited. The first secretary noted that tablets to honor Kim Jong Il displayed at different places of the city represent the Russian people's reverence for the peerlessly great man. An executive member of the Maritime Territorial Branch Committee of the "A Just Russia" said that many years have passed since Kim Jong Il visited Vladivostok City, but there is no change in the noble memory of him. The great man's exploits for the development of the friendly relations between the two countries will remain long in the hearts of the Russian people, he stressed. Meanwhile, Korean film shows also took place at different units of Mongolia and Nigeria from December 1 to 7. "Kimjongilia," "Sci-Tech Complex" and other Koreans films were shown there. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Remembered Abroad
body: Remembrance meetings took place in Myanmar and Switzerland and a film show in Bulgaria on November 29 and December 1 to commemorate the 7th anniversary of the demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Present at the events were figures of different social standings and people in those countries. Tin Tun, director of the Myanmar Medical Research Institute, said: HE Kim Jong Il is a veteran of the world politics who devoted his whole life to the bright future of Korea. The Democratic People's Republic of Korea demonstrates its dignity as a country strong in independence. The credit for it is the wise guidance of HE Kim Jong Il, who vigorously advanced the cause of socialism by pursuing invincible Songun politics true to the cause of President Kim Il Sung, and HE Kim Jong Un who is carrying forward Kim Jong Il's idea and line without an inch of deflection. Martin Lotscher, chairman of the Switzerland-Korea Committee, said that Kim Jong Il is a peerless patriot who led the struggle for defending socialism to a shining victory with his steel-strong pluck and iron will in the face of the imperialists' vicious moves to stifle the DPRK. Personages of political parties and organizations including the Bulgarian Communists Union and the Bulgarian Anti-Fascist Union saw a Korean film dealing with Kim Jong Il's exploits for the country, the people, the era and history and praised the exploits of world-historic significance performed by the peerlessly great man for setting an example in the building of a revolutionary party of Juche. A message to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was adopted at the remembrance meeting held in Switzerland. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Exploits Praised by Foreign Newspapers
body: Newspapers of DR Congo and Cambodia carried special write-ups on the occasion of the 7th anniversary of the demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Newspaper of DR Congo L'Avenir on December 3 in an article titled "Eternal leader of the Korean people", accompanied with the portrait of smiling Kim Jong Il, said: Leader Kim Jong Il is always alive as the eternal leader in the hearts of the Korean people. He had developed in depth the Juche idea founded by President Kim Il Sung, led the Korean people to firmly advance along the road of independence and the road of socialism, strengthened the DPRK into a politico-ideological power and military power and provided a firm foundation for building a power. The Cambodian newspaper Nokor Thom Daily on December 6 in an article titled "On the occasion of the 7th anniversary of the demise of the great H.E. Generalissimo Kim Jong Il" said: Leader Kim Jong Il had lived his life with a pure and clean conscience. He was always on the road for field guidance in an ordinary jumper, having short and uncomfortable sleep, to see to it that modern factories, new houses and leisure complexes had been built in different parts of the country for the improvement of people's living standard. Leader Kim Jong Il took warm care of people. The noble life of the peerlessly great man will always remain in the hearts of the Korean people and the world progressive mankind. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Yong Nam Meets Italian Guests
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Friday had a talk at the Mansudae Assembly Hall with President Impagliazzo Marco of the Community of Santegidio, an Italian organization for humanitarian cooperation, and his party, when they paid a courtesy call on him. Rodong News Team

title: Floral Baskets to Statues of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il from Japan
body: The family of Sin Kanemaru, former vice-prime minister of Japan, and Kiichi Tsunota, representative of the Gunma Prefectural Council for Japan-Korea Friendship and Solidarity, sent floral baskets to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on the occasion of the 7th anniversary of the demise of Kim Jong Il. The floral baskets were placed at the statues on Dec. 14. Rodong News Team

title: U.S. Urged to Implement June 12 Singapore Joint Statement
body: A joint statement signed by 71 organizations of overseas compatriots in the U.S. and Canada and Europe, Asia and Oceanic region, 59 prominent U.S. figures and 81 civic and public organizations for peace and civil rights was made public on Dec. 6, according to the south Korean internet paper Jaju Sibo. The statement fully supported the Panmunjom Declaration, "September Pyongyang Joint Declaration" and the June 12 Singapore Joint Statement. It said that the agreements made at the north-south summit meetings and DPRK-U.S. summit meeting serve as a foundation for preventing the danger of war and building a permanent and durable peace-keeping mechanism on the Korean Peninsula. It urged the U.S. to take such concrete actions for improved DPRK-U.S. relations as lifting sanctions against the north and deleting it from the list of "state sponsor of terrorism". Rodong News Team

title: Italian Guests Leave
body: President Impagliazzo Marco of the Community of Santegidio, an Italian organization for humanitarian cooperation, and his party, left Pyongyang for home on Friday. Rodong News Team

title: High-Yield Sericulturists Visit Pyongyang
body: High-yield sericulturists had a significant Pyongyang visit from Dec. 9 to 15. Those in various parts of the country, including Jagang Province, Nampho City, South Hwanghae Province and Kangwon Province, produced lots of cocoons this year. The first place of their visit was the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the sacred temple of Juche. At the immortality halls where President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il lie in state, they paid respects. Then they looked round the Mangyongdae Revolutionary Museum and the old home of the President in Mangyongdae. They visited the Korean Revolution Museum, Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Silk Mill, Sci-Tech Complex, etc. and enjoyed performances at the National Theatre and the Pyongyang Circus Theater. They also had a great time at the Munsu Water Park and the Central Zoo. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Ambassador to Nepal Appointed
body: Jo Yong Man was appointed as DPRK ambassador to Nepal, according to a decree of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly. Rodong News Team

title: Joint Meeting Held by Nepalese Organizations
body: A joint meeting was held by the Nepalese National Committee for Remembering President Kim Il Sung and Comrade Kim Jong Il, the Nepal-Korea Friendship Association, the Nepal Journalist Association for the Study of the Juche Idea and Songun Politics, the Socialist Journalist Forum of Nepal for the Study of the Juche Idea, the Nepali Literary Forum for the Study of Songun Politics and the Study Forum for Self-Reliance of Nepal on December 7. The meeting discussed issues on giving wide publicity to revolutionary careers and exploits of the peerlessly great men through media and organizing political and cultural events including remembrance meeting, seminar, film show and book and photo exhibition on the occasion of the 7th anniversary of the demise of Kim Jong Il, the 7th anniversary of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's assumption of the supreme commandership of the Korean People's Army and the 101st birth anniversary of the anti-Japanese war heroine Kim Jong Suk. Present there were figures of organizations of friendship and solidarity with the Korean people and organizations for the study of the Juche idea including the ex-minister of Land Reform and Management and the general secretary of the Central Committee of the Nepal Communist Party (Marxist-Leninist). Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il to Be Remembered in Hungary
body: A Hungarian committee for remembering Chairman Kim Jong Il was formed in Budapest on December 10. Gyula Thurmer, chairman of the Hungarian Workers' Party, was elected chairman of the committee. The committee decided to organize political and cultural events praising the peerlessly great man for making contributions to the socialist construction in the DPRK and the accomplishment of the cause of global independence, on the occasion of the 7th anniversary of his demise. Rodong News Team

title: Seminars on Chairman Kim Jong Il's Exploits Held Abroad
body: Seminars on Chairman Kim Jong Il's exploits took place in Romania, Ethiopia and Algeria between December 4 and 8 on the occasion of the 7th anniversary of his demise. Vasile Orleanu, chairman of the Romanian committee for remembering Chairman Kim Jong Il, said that Kim Jong Il developed the Juche idea founded by President Kim Il Sung by making energetic ideological and theoretical activities, and performed exploits for the Korean revolution and the cause of global independence. He noted that thanks to the great devotion of Kim Jong Il the DPRK could rank itself among military powers and achieve miraculous successes in the struggle for the economic construction and the improvement of the people's standard of living despite the imperialists' vicious moves. Nigatu Dagnachew, chairman of the Ethiopian National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, praised Kim Jong Il for performing feats for the country, the people, the era and the history, and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un for demonstrating to the world the might of the DPRK as a politico-ideological power and military power. The chairman of the Algeria-Korea Friendship Association said that Kim Jong Il was an extraordinary elder statesman recognized by the world, a leader of the people with boundless humble and popular traits and a peerless great man who braved all ordeals of history with his outstanding leadership and developed the DPRK into a genuine country of people. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Exploits Praised Abroad
body: Newspapers of different countries carried articles on the occasion of the 7th anniversary of the demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The Egyptian newspaper Al Akhbar Almassay on December 6 said in an article under the title of "A great master of independent politics": Leader Kim Jong Il was a great master of independent politics. He thoroughly applied the Juche idea to the Korean revolution and construction. As he adhered to the firm independent line, the DPRK could remain unmoved when socialism collapsed in different countries one after another at the end of the last century. The Songun politics pursued by him is an effective political mode to firmly maintain independence on the international arena. Mankind will hand down feats of Kim Jong Il who was a great master of independent politics forever. The Nigerian paper Nigerian Observer on December 7 said in an article titled "Kim Jong Il, leader of the people" that HE Kim Jong Il loved his people boundlessly. He regarded the people as the most precious being in the world and devotedly served them, the article said, and went on: He, who regarded the interest of the people as the starting point of all his thinking and activities, spared nothing for their happiness. HE Kim Jong Il possessed plain, humble, unreserved and popular traits. He turned the DPRK into a genuine socialist state centered on the popular masses with his outstanding leadership. The Bangladeshi newspaper The Daily Folk on December 9 carried an article titled "Last year of devotion" that highly praised Kim Jong Il who made the journey of love for the people till the last moments of his life. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Visits Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the Korean People's Army, visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on the occasion of the greatest national memorial day. He was accompanied by vice-chairmen, directors and leading officials of the departments of the C.C., WPK, and other cadres of the C.C., WPK. Supreme Leader of the Party, state and army Kim Jong Un entered the hall where the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il stand. Placed at the statues were a floral basket in the name of the Supreme Leader and a floral basket in the joint name of the C.C., WPK, the WPK Central Military Commission and the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK. The Supreme Leader paid homage to the statues. Then he entered the hall where Chairman Kim Jong Il lies in state. He paid highest tribute to Kim Jong Il who devoted his all to the prosperity of the country and the happiness of the people until the last moments of his revolutionary career. Looking back with deep emotion upon the sacred life of Kim Jong Il who performed very precious revolutionary feats for the country and the people, the Supreme Leader said that our Party has adhered to the idea and line of Kim Jong Il and his revolutionary principle and has resolutely struggled to carry out his last instructions for the last seven years like the Party made a pledge before the bier of Kim Jong Il this day seven years ago, and called on the entire Party to fulfill the obligation and duties as his revolutionary soldiers in the future, too, so as to dynamically struggle to implement his plan and desire to the last without an inch of deflection and any concession. Political News Team

title: Agricultural Workers and Union Members Meet
body: Agricultural workers and members of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea had a story-telling on the virtue of Chairman Kim Jong Il in Poman-ri, Sohung County, North Hwanghae Province on Sunday with the approach of the 7th anniversary of his demise. Speakers told with deep emotion the revolutionary exploits and noble virtue of Kim Jong Il who put forward the farmers as heroes of the times and performers of feats. The participants vowed to fulfill their duty as agricultural workers in the struggle for building a socialist rural community and improving the people's living standard, rallied close around Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, bearing in mind the behests of Kim Jong Il. Present there were officials concerned, officials of the union and agricultural workers in Sohung County. Rodong News Team

title: New DPRK Ambassador Presents Credentials to King of Sweden
body: DPRK Ambassador Ri Won Guk presented his credentials to Carl ⅩⅥ Gustaf, king of Sweden, on December 12. The king said he was pleased with the positive development of the situation in the Korean peninsula. He hoped that peace and prosperity would settle in the peninsula and everything would go well in the DPRK. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Praised by Russian Newspapers
body: Russian newspapers carried special write-ups illustrated with the portrait of smiling Chairman Kim Jong Il and his photo on the occasion of the 7th anniversary of his demise. The Russian newspaper Byvor and internet newspapers Edinaya Korea and Bremya Peremon introduced immortal revolutionary hymn "Song of General Kim Jong Il" under the title of "Great man immortal with hymn". The newspaper Tsumenskaya Pravda devoted one whole page to an article titled "Kim Jong Il, leader of the people". The article said: HE Kim Jong Il of the DPRK is a genuine leader of the people who believed in the people and led the country in reliance upon them. He ardently loved the people. His warm loving care for the people finds its manifestation in his ceaseless field guidance of great devotion for the people whom he had regarded as the most precious and powerful being in the world and his teacher. He regarded the interests of the people as the starting point of all his thinking and activities and devoted his all to translating their interests into reality. He was possessed of plain, humble, unreserved and popular traits. He braved all ordeals of history with his outstanding leadership to glorify the DPRK as a genuine socialist state centered on the popular masses and provide a firm foundation for building a powerful country. His noble image will be kept forever in the hearts of the Korean people and the world progressives. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Remembered Abroad
body: Remembrance events took place in different countries to commemorate the 7th anniversary of the demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. There took place a remembrance meeting in Libya, lecture meetings in Serbia and Brazil and round-table talks in Venezuela and Ethiopia from Nov. 30 to Dec. 8. The chairperson of the Libyan committee for remembering Kim Jong Il said that a lot of people of Libya are well aware of the exploits of Kim Jong Il and successes achieved by the Korean people under his leadership and are struck with them. The chairperson of the Serbian committee for remembering Kim Jong Il said that the world progressives recollect with deep emotion Kim Jong Il's revolutionary career with yearning and in humble reverence for him who made contributions to the happiness of the Korean people, the building of a powerful socialist country and the accomplishment of the cause of anti-imperialist independence. The exploits Kim Jong Il performed all his life will be kept forever in the hearts of mankind, the chairperson added. Figures of a hospital and the Oromia Designing Supervisory Office and other units in Ethiopia praised Kim Jong Il as the greatest man respected by the world as he devoted himself to the happiness of the people till the last moments of his life. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Introduced by Brazilian Organization
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us Usher in a Great Golden Age of Construction by Thoroughly Applying the Party's Juche-Oriented Idea on Architecture" was posted by the Brazilian Center for the Study of Songun Politics on its website on December 8 to mark the 5th anniversary of its publication. The work, published on December 8, Juche 102 (2013), clarifies that the DPRK's history of construction is a proud one in which miracles and epochal changes were brought about thanks to the outstanding idea on architecture of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and their wise leadership. It also sets forth the tasks facing the construction field and ways to carry them out. The website carried a photo of Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: Spring Water Factory Newly Built
body: The Rason Chonghak Spring Water Factory was newly built in the Sonbong area, Rason City. The factory comes to be a material foundation for supplying tasty spring water to the people in the city. It, divided into production and life zones, has a sci-tech learning space, combined control room and analytical laboratory. Rodong News Team

title: Impetus Given to Developing the Local Economy and Improving Provincials’ Living Standards
body: The provincial (municipal) committees of science and technology attain many successes in their tenacious endeavors to develop the local economy and improve the living levels of people with their strength, technology and resources. The Kangwon Provincial Committee of Science and Technology selected scores of research projects of importance in developing the economy of the province and bettering the living standards of its inhabitants and roused all its scientists and technicians into action to carry out the projects and introduce new technologies into production. In the course of this the process of producing sodium carbonate by the electrolytic method was perfected, and another self-supporting center was set up to turn out hundreds of tons of more than 10 kinds of basic chemicals like sodium carbonate, caustic soda and hydrochloric acid a year. The North Phyongan Provincial Committee of Science and Technology strove mightily to introduce the method of organic farming by mud snails into the agricultural producers of the province and enable dozens of valuable scientific and technological devices to be employed in practice, thereby contributing actively to developing the economy of the province and making its inhabitants better-off. In addition, the provincial (municipal) committees of science and technology did their utmost to apply the technology of electrical generation through coal and rice chaff gasification, the technology of the renewal of waste plastics and glasses and others into resources, the technology of economy of electricity by an AC contactor, the technology of the production and use of methane gas and other advanced technologies for the purpose of covering the shortage of electricity, securing materials, fuel and raw materials and developing the local economy in a distinctive way. The committees register successes also in reafforesting the country on a scientific and technological basis, normalizing the operation of the existing small and medium power stations and finding scientific and technological solutions for actual knotty problems. Kang Chol Ung

title: Railways Maintained Intensively
body: The Ministry of Railways successfully finished maintaining railways intensively for satisfactory winter transportation. In slightly over two months railway workers prevented 909 sections of railways being expanded from freezing for 14,115 meters, put to rights 4,036 sections of ditches alongside railways 1,002km in length and maintained 7,994 sets of switches. The result was that the technological conditions of railways were ameliorated and that it was made possible to run trains safely. Kim Yun Mi

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Remembered
body: All the people and service personnel of the DPRK honored the memory of Chairman Kim Jong Il with the most humble reverence on the seventh anniversary of his demise. On the greatest national memorial day, working people, youth, students and service personnel visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the sacred temple of Juche, to pay tribute to the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. Working people, service personnel, youth and students across the country paid tribute to the statues of the great leaders and portraits of smiling Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il in their residential areas. The National Symphony Orchestra gave a concert to remember Kim Jong Il at Moranbong Theatre in Pyongyang. The performers impressively depicted with solemn sound and emotional melody the profound respect for the peerless great man who had performed great feats in the history of building a thriving country and opened a bright future of Juche Korea with sacrificial devotion while making ceaseless high-intensity forced march. Similar concerts were given in North Phyongan, North Hwanghae, North Hamgyong, Kangwon, Ryanggang and other provinces and remembrance gathering "Song of Great Love" took place in South Hwanghae Province. Artistes of Jagang, South Phyongan and South Hamgyong provincial art troupes highly sang in praise of the loving care shown by Kim Jong Il for the people. Rodong News Team

title: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of Peerlessly Great Men
body: Working people, youth and schoolchildren and service personnel laid floral baskets and bouquets at the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and mosaics of their smiling images in different parts of the country to mark the seventh anniversary of Kim Jong Il's demise. Seen standing before the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill was a floral basket sent by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Floral baskets were laid in the name of Party, power and arms forces organs, social organizations, ministries, national institutions, institutions, industrial establishments and schools at all levels in Pyongyang City and units of the Korean People's Army and the Korean People's Internal Security Forces. A floral basket was placed in the name of the Pyongyang Mission of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front. Visitors made a bow to the statues. Floral baskets in the name of institutions, enterprises and units of the KPA and KPISF were laid at the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il and the mosaics in different parts of Pyongyang including Kim Il Sung University, the Mansudae Art Studio, the Ministry of the People's Armed Forces and the Ministry of People's Security. Working people, youth and schoolchildren and service personnel all over the country paid tribute to the statues of the great leaders and the mosaics in their residential areas. Rodong News Team

title: U.S. Attempt to Discuss DPRK's "Human Rights Issue" at UNSC Goes Amiss
body: The U.S. has discussed the DPRK's "human rights issue" at the UN Security Council early in December every year since 2014 by abusing its position, but its attempt went amiss this year. The U.S. proposal for consulting the "human rights issue" of the DPRK was refused by several member states of the UNSC. Many media in Asian, African and Western countries broadly report that the U.S., given to high-handed and arbitrary practices at the UNSC, was put to shame under the eyes of the world. Rodong News Team

title: Senior Party and Government Officials Visit Korean Revolution Museum
body: Senior Party and government officials, the chairperson of a friendly party and officials of ministries and national institutions visited the Korean Revolution Museum on Monday, the seventh anniversary of the demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Senior Party and government officials bowed to the colored statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in the general review room. They went round some rooms of the hall of period of turning-point for building a powerful socialist country, after being told that Kim Jong Il set forth the theory of building a socialist power and laid a strong political, military and economic foundation for the eternal prosperity of the nation while making ceaseless high-intensity forced march. Rodong News Team

title: “Security Law” Is Disgrace to Nation
body: Stronger voices in demand of the abrogation of the fascist “Security Law”, notorious law, are being heard in south Korea with the lapse of 70 years after its fabrication. It is quite natural that the tendency to repeal the SL is being reinforced in south Korea. The SL is an unprecedented evil law, a copy of the “Maintenance of the Public Order Act” cooked up by the Japanese imperialists to intensify their colonial rule over Korea and fascist crackdown on its people in the past. The successive south Korean conservative regimes grown out of pro-Japanese practices worked out the most notorious SL on the basis of the Japanese imperialists’ fascist law which had served for indiscriminately killing the Korean patriots, far from liquidating it. And they constantly revised the SL in their interest to use it as an all-purpose means to retain their power and crack down on the people. The history of the SL in south Korea is, indeed, the one of bloody crimes in which democracy has been mercilessly strangled by the fascist dictatorship, patriots judged by traitors and justice outraged by injustice. Nonetheless, such thrilling evil law still remains poisonous in south Korea though the conservative regime was toppled down and the times of national reconciliation, peace and prosperity ushered in. This is a mockery of the public sentiment of south Korea and disgrace to the Korean nation. Ra Sol Ha

title: Letter to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Chongryon Central Standing Committee
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a letter from the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) on Monday. The letter said that seven years have passed since the demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The letter praised Kim Jong Il as an outstanding leader and peerless patriot who firmly defended the Korean-style socialism and ushered in a new era of the country's prosperity to put the dignity and might of Juche Korea on the highest level in the history of the nation with unparalleled ideo-theoretical wisdom, brilliant leadership, unshakable faith, matchless pluck, warm loving care for the country and people and comradeship. The letter said Kim Jong Il is the benevolent father and an outstanding leader who turned Chongryon into invincible ranks that share the same destiny with the leader and the country and demonstrate the might of single-minded unity, and who put it forward as a model organization of the world movement of overseas compatriots. It noted that the history of Kim Jong Il's legendary loving care for the nation and compatriots still goes on thanks to the parental affection and meticulous loving care shown by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un for the development of Chongryon and happy life of the Koreans in Japan. The letter expressed the resolution to further develop Chongryon into a powerful Juche-oriented overseas compatriots' organization shining along with the august names of the peerlessly great men by strengthening its organizations and affiliates at all levels into the reliable fortress for the country and nation. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Is Peerless Politician
body: Chairman Kim Jong Il is a great politician and peerlessly elder statesman who led the human cause of independence, the cause of socialism along the road of victory with his unique idea and guidance, and outstanding politician who led to victory the struggle for ensuring the world peace. He is a prominent politician with the noblest virtue. The close of the 20th century witnessed a political upheaval ever known in history and the fiercest confrontation between progress and reaction, between socialism and imperialism. Then, Kim Jong Il, a peerlessly great man, dynamically steered mankind to the future of socialism, holding higher the banner of socialism. He made public immortal classical works including “Abuses of Socialism Are Intolerable” and “Socialism Is a Science” to show the eternal truth that socialism is sure to be revived and win the final victory for its scientific accuracy and truthfulness although it temporally went through twists and turns, thus dealing a crushing blow at the enemies slandering socialism. His rare charisma attracted all people, irrespective of their differences in nationality, national identity, religious belief and political view. His loving care for people based on eternal trust was vast and boundless and came to be his peculiar charisma charming all people. He is, indeed, the greatest man in thought and guidance, traits and benevolence and the paragon of politicians. Ri Hak Nam

title: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of Great Leaders
