body: Jong Il Sim, widow of DPRK Hero An Tong Su, on Monday laid a floral basket at the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on the 7th anniversary of the demise of Kim Jong Il. After laying the floral basket, she made a bow to the statues of the great leaders. Rodong News Team

title: Floral Basket to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il from Nigerian President
body: Nigerian President Muhammadu Buhari, commander-in-chief of the Armed Forces, sent a floral basket to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on the 7th anniversary of the demise of Kim Jong Il. The floral basket was laid before the statues of the great leaders on Monday. Rodong News Team

title: Bulgarian Organization Issues Information Bulletin
body: The Bulgaria-Korea Friendship Association issued an information bulletin "Seventh Anniversary of Demise of Great Comrade Kim Jong Il." The information bulletin said that Dec. 17, 2011 is the day when Chairman Kim Jong Il, the eternal leader of the Korean people and a prominent leader of the world revolution, passed away. It noted that the Korean people and the world progressives honor the memory of the peerlessly great man on the day every year. It pointed out that the Workers' Party of Korea has developed into a political organization working for the idea and cause of the leader since Kim Jong Il started the work at the Party Central Committee. It stated that the Korean people have registered signal successes in the socialist construction and realization of national reunification under the wise guidance of the WPK, a steel-strong and invincible party. It said it is the greatest feats of Kim Jong Il that he firmly defended Korean socialism under the uplifted banner of Songun in the face of the hardest difficulties. It added that his feats for the era and history will be immortal. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Remembered Abroad
body: Seminars on the feats of Chairman Kim Jong Il were held in Kyrgyzstan and Ukraine and a remembrance meeting was held in UK between Dec. 8 and 10 on the occasion of the seventh anniversary of his demise. Attending the events were figures of all social standings and people of those countries. The chief of the Group for the Study of the Juche Idea who is chairman of the Central Council of the People Unity-"Kyrgyz El" Republican Political Party said that Kim Jong Il is the great leader who performed great feats for the country and the people. He noted that Kim Jong Il developed the Workers' Party of Korea into a party working for the interests of the people. He pointed out that the future of Korea is brighter as it is led by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un who carries forward the cause of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. The chairman of the "Sun of Juche" Association of Journalists and Men of Culture for the Study of Kimjongilism in Ukraine said that by pursuing the Songun politics, Kim Jong Il frustrated the moves of the imperialist allied forces to stifle the DPRK, so as to firmly defend socialism and provide a firm foundation for the building of a powerful country. The people of the countries aspiring after independence and justice should learn from the DPRK, he added. A message to Kim Jong Un was adopted at the remembrance meeting held in UK. Roodng News Team

title: Senior Government Officials Visit Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: Senior government officials visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on Monday, the 7th anniversary of demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Present there were Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, and other senior government officials, the chairperson of a friendly party and officials of power organs, the Cabinet, working people's organizations, ministries and national institutions. Seen standing before the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il was a floral basket bearing the august name of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and a floral basket in the joint name of the Central Committee and the Central Military Commission of the WPK and the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK. Placed before the statues was a floral basket in the joint name of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly and the Cabinet of the DPRK. The senior government officials paid respects to the statues. At the hall where Kim Jong Il lies in state, they made bows to him. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Emir of Qatar
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, on Tuesday sent greetings to Tamim Bin Hamad Al-Thani, emir of Qatar, on the occasion of its independence day. The message sincerely wished the emir good health and happiness and the people of Qatar bigger progress, prosperity and wellbeing. Rodong News Team

title: Pak Pong Ju Inspects Various Units
body: Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission and premier of the Cabinet of the DPRK, inspected various units. Inspecting the Unha Breed-fish Station, he chaired a discussion of the issues of pushing ahead with the sustained introduction of advanced fish breeding methods to follow the current trend of pisciculture development and of laying a solid material and technical foundation for the breeding. After inspecting the Sunchon Cement Complex, the Sunchon Engine Factory and the construction site of the Sunchon Phosphate Fertilizer Factory, he chaired consultative meetings where he underlined the need for all officials and working people to give full play to the spirit of self-reliance and sci-tech power in order to put the production on normal track. He also called for finishing the construction at an early date by taking a thoroughgoing step for the supply of materials. Rodong News Team

title: Friendship Delegation Leaves for Mongolia
body: A friendship delegation led by Pak Kyong Il, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries and chairman of the Korea-Mongolia Friendship Association, left Pyongyang on Tuesday to visit Mongolia. Rodong News Team

title: S. Koreans Reject U.S. Demand for Increase of Upkeep for GIs
body: S. Korean people of different social strata rejected the U.S. demand for the increase of upkeep for the GIs in south Korea, according to the south Korean internet newspaper Jaju Sibo on Dec. 11. 10 odd organizations including the People for Achieving Peace and Reunification, the Solidarity for Social Progress and the Bar Association for Democratic Society held actions in protest against the U.S. unreasonable demand in various parts of Seoul. At a press conference outside the U.S. embassy, the speakers termed the demand an outrageous act of seeking egoistic interests. Noting the same is the U.S. demand that south Korea should bear the cost for the deployment of the U.S. strategic assets in south Korea, they charged that the U.S. is going to make south Korea pay for the deployment although it committed itself to halting the joint military drills and not deploying its strategic assets in the Korean peninsula. At the end of the press conference, the protestors headed for the Defense Institute, where they kicked off a protest action demanding the decrease of upkeep for GIs. Members of the People's Party of south Korea also held a press conference outside the U.S. embassy, where they called for a drastic cut of the upkeep, criticizing the U.S. for pressurizing south Korea to pay twice for the upkeep. Rodong News Team

title: Thaethan Spring Water
body: Sambong-ri, Thaethan County boasts the Thaethan spring water designated as a natural monument of Korea. It has long been widely known to the public for its marvelous efficacy. The spring water contains those elements which are infinitesimal in amount or are seldom or never to be found in its counterparts. It has a proper proportion of elements of more than ten kinds, including fluorine, bromine, selenium, zinc and copper. They are effective against diseases and good for health. The spring water satisfies the demand of the human body for fluorine. The spring water tastes fresh for long thanks to its fluorine. Kimchi and other dishes do not go bad easily when they are prepared with the spring water. The spring water is especially efficacious against digestive troubles, hypertension, cutaneous disease, etc. True to President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il’s lofty idea of love for the people, the county arranged for a rest center to be built in the forest of Sambong-ri so that its inhabitants and visitors from the whole country can benefit from the spring water. The county built a spring water factory and has since normalized its production to enable all the people to enjoy the wholesome spring water to their hearts’ contents. Kang Chol Ung

title: DPRK-China Protocol on Sports Exchange for 2019 Signed
body: A protocol on sports exchange for 2019 was signed in Beijing on Tuesday between the Ministry of Physical Culture and Sports of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the General Administration of Sports of the People's Republic of China. Present at the signing ceremony from the DPRK side were members of the delegation of the DPRK Ministry of Physical Culture and Sports led by Minister Kim Il Guk and a councilor of the DPRK embassy in Beijing and from the Chinese side were Gou Zhongwen, minister of the General Administration of Sports, and other officials concerned. Rodong News Team

title: Foreigners Visit Pyongyang Teacher Training College
body: Women of foreign embassies and missions of international organizations to the DPRK on Wednesday toured Pyongyang Teacher Training College on the occasion of the 101st birth anniversary of the anti-Japanese war heroine Kim Jong Suk. They looked round the educational and scientific exhibition, the primary school teaching method rehearsal room and other places of the college. Rodong News Team

title: Credentials to Kim Yong Nam from Lao Ambassador
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, received credentials from Lao Ambassador to the DPRK Sisavath Khamsaly at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Wednesday. The president had a talk with the ambassador. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Remembered Abroad
body: Remembrance meetings took place in DR Congo, Tanzania and Italy from Dec. 8 to 10 on the occasion of the seventh anniversary of the demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Attending the events were public figures of all social standings and citizens in those countries. Andre Lohekele Kalonda, chairman of the DR Congo committee for remembering Generalissimo Kim Jong Il, and Otete Gaston Mboyo, chairman of the DR Congo-Korea Friendship and Solidarity Association who is deputy general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the DR Congo, said that Kim Jong Il energetically worked for the happiness of the people and the accomplishment of the human cause of independence until the last moments of his life. They said that the world people will always remember the precious life of the great man and feats performed by him during his life. Maina, secretary general of the Tanzania-DPRK Friendship Association who is vice-chairperson of the Tanzanian National Coordinating Committee of the Juche Idea Study Groups, said the idea and line set forth by Kim Jong Il serve as the eternal banner indicating the way of the times and that Kim Jong Il is always alive in the mind of mankind as he made a distinguished contribution to the cause of global independence. Pasquale Felice, chief of the Firenze group under the Italian Committee for the Study of the Juche idea, and its members said that Kim Jong Il was a genuine leader of the people who gave ceaseless field guidance for the people during his life, praising him for strengthening the DPRK into an impregnable socialist fortress. Rodong News Team

title: Cambodian King and Great Queen Send Large Floral Baskets to DPRK Embassy
body: King Norodom Sihamoni and Great Queen Norodom Monineath Sihanouk of Cambodia sent large floral baskets to the DPRK embassy in Phnom Penh on Dec. 14 on the occasion of the seventh anniversary of the demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Upon the authorization by the king and the great queen, a delegation of the Cambodian Ministry of Royal Palace led by Kong Sam Ol, deputy prime minister for Royal Palace, laid the floral baskets before the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and paid tribute to them. Rodong News Team

title: Brief Biography of Chairman Kim Jong Il Reported by Russian Internet News
body: The brief biography of Chairman Kim Jong Il was reported by the Russian internet news Vesti. ru on Dec. 13 on the occasion of the seventh anniversary of his demise. The news carried his photo. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Introduced by Regional Body
body: The complete text of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us Brilliantly Accomplish the Revolutionary Cause of Juche, Holding the Great Comrade Kim Jong Il in High Esteem as the Eternal General Secretary of Our Party" was posted by the Asian Regional Institute of the Juche Idea on its website on Dec. 15 on the occasion of the seventh anniversary of the demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The work, published on April 6, Juche 101 (2012), says that to invariably hold Kim Jong Il in high esteem as the eternal general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea is a principled requirement for successfully advancing the cause of the Korean revolution, indicating the task of steadily strengthening the Party into the glorious party of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: Japanese Reactionaries Seeking Overseas Expansion
body: Days ago, Tokyo Shimbun carried an article denouncing the Abe regime for its reckless moves for turning Japan into a military giant. Noting that Japan’s increase of military expenditure and equipment with military hardware threatening other country are deviation from the principle of “exclusive defense”, the article urged the regime to exercise self-restraint. This is an expression of serious concern about Japan dashing towards militarism. The revision of the national defense guidelines and midterm defense capability buildup outline indicating the main orientation for beefing up military muscle has reached the final stage in Japan. Clear is Japan’s purpose, which is overseas expansion. The Japanese reactionaries still seek to realize the old dream of the “Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere”. For decades after its defeat, Japan has beefed up its military muscle bit by bit behind the deceptive screen of “defense”. As a result, Japan “Self-Defense Forces” have grown to be dangerous forces of aggression with three modern services capable of launching a preemptive attack. The principle of “exclusive defense” advocated by Japan is phony. Japan, a militarist viper that has been desperate for a wild ambition to launch overseas expansion, effuses venom towards the world, free from “restraint”. It revived militarism in all fabrics of social life. Its state structure has also been remolded as required by militarism. What remains to be done is the revision of the constitution. If the constitution is revised in a retrogressive manner, Japan will be a war-capable country in the true sense of the word. Japan’s reinvasion is a matter of time. An Chol Gwon

title: Successes Scored in Building Apartments and Public Establishments in Samjiyon County
body: A general offensive is carried on vigorously in Samjiyon County to crown its renovation with success this year and make good preparations for the next year’s construction. The soldier builders and shock workers worked with might and main to admirably transform the county into a good cultural mountain city under the far-sighted plan of the Workers’ Party of Korea. They completed the interior of a thousand and several hundred apartments in Samjiyon County Town as of Dec. 10. They are now finishing at the last stage the inside of the Paektusan General Museum, a junior middle school in the town, public establishments and service facilities linking apartment buildings with each other while successfully constructing many sectional roads in the town. The construction corps have taken drastic measures to prevent their buildings being frozen and keep them warm in a northern icy climate. They work hard day and night, obtaining success after success in completing the interior of their buildings. The town is face-lifted from day to day with the 3-D construction of many sectional roads. All the construction corps strive mightily and strenuously to finish their building projects in a short span of time while securing blocks, sand, gravel and timber with a view to their next year’s building works. Kim Yun Mi

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Work Introduced in Russia
body: The Russian internet homepage Patrioti Moskva carried the full text of Chairman Kim Jong Il's work "The Workers' Party of Korea Is the Party of the Great Leader Comrade Kim Il Sung" on December 14 to commemorate the 7th anniversary of his demise. The work, published on Oct. 2, Juche 84 (1995), is a great programme for the party building and activities as it reviewed with pride the glorious history of the Workers' Party of Korea which pioneered a new path of building a revolutionary party in the era of independence under the leadership of President Kim Il Sung and indicated the way for developing the WPK into his party forever. The homepage carried the portrait of smiling Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: Brief Biography of Chairman Kim Jong Il Reported by Czech Organizations
body: The Paektusan Czech-Korean Friendship Association and the Czech Group for the Study and Materialization of the Juche Idea posted on their internet homepages the brief biography of Chairman Kim Jong Il to commemorate the 7th anniversary of his demise. The websites carried photos of Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Introduced by Austrian Body
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us Brilliantly Accomplish the Revolutionary Cause of Juche, Holding the Great Comrade Kim Jong Il in High Esteem as the Eternal General Secretary of Our Party" was posted by the Austrian committee for remembering HE Kim Jong Il on the website of the Society for the Promotion of the Relations between Austria and DPRK on Dec. 14 ahead of the 7th anniversary of the demise of Kim Jong Il. The work, published on April 6, Juche 101 (2012), says that to invariably hold Kim Jong Il in high esteem as the eternal general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea is the principled requirement in successfully advancing the cause of the Korean revolution, indicating the tasks to be fulfilled in steadily developing the party into the glorious party of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Remembered in China
body: Families of Chinese related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle had a meeting to remember Chairman Kim Jong Il at the DPRK embassy in Beijing on Dec. 13 in commemoration of the seventh anniversary of his demise. The participants in the meeting laid a floral basket and bunches of flowers at the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and paid tribute to them. Speeches were made at the meeting. Zhou Wei, daughter of Zhou Baozhong, said: We are here today to remember with deep emotion the undying feats of the great General Kim Jong Il. I have still treasured the picture, which I had taken with President Kim Il Sung, General Kim Jong Il, his mother Kim Jong Suk and my parents when I was young, as a family heirloom. Yu Ming, son of Li Zade, said: General Kim Jong Il took great care of the comrades-in-arms of President Kim Il Sung and their children during his lifetime and I can never forget his benevolent image with a bright smile. Zhang Jinlu, daughter of Zhang Wei-hua, said: The respected Chairman Kim Jong Un is successfully carrying forward the idea and cause of President Kim Il Sung and General Kim Jong Il. I express thanks to him for showing unsparing love for the families of the people related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle. The son of Shang Yue said: I really admire the respected Chairman Kim Jong Un for his great political judgment and outstanding diplomatic resources. I hope that the Korean people will make greater achievements and the long-standing China-Korea friendship will further develop under his leadership. A similar meeting took place in Shenyang, China on Dec. 14. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Remembered in Foreign Countries
body: Seminars on the feats of Chairman Kim Jong Il took place in Russia and Nepal, and a lecture was given in Mexico on Dec. 10 and 11 in commemoration of the seventh anniversary of his demise. The chairperson of the Party for Peace and Unity of Russia and other speakers said that the whole world recognizes the greatness of Kim Jong Il as outstanding thinker and theoretician and peerless statesman, praising the noble revolutionary life of the peerlessly great man who devoted his all to the prosperity of the country and happiness of the people. Nepalese figures said that the Korean people and the world progressives are deeply respecting Kim Jong Il, always remembering him, and praised his feats for the times and history. The president of the Mexican Friend Association for Memory of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il said that Kim Jong Il firmly defended the sovereignty and dignity of the country and made a great contribution to the cause of national reunification by pursuing the Songun politics. A message to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was adopted at the seminar in Nepal. Rodong News Team

title: Letter to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Koreans in China
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a letter from the General Association of Koreans in China on Dec. 17. The letter said that there are many famous statesmen and great men in the world, but not a great revolutionary or a peerless patriot like General Kim Jong Il who was born into a guerrillas' family in the flames of the great bloody anti-Japanese war and performed undying feats on behalf of the times, history and nation to go down through all generations by devoting his all to the happiness of the people, building of a powerful socialist country, national reunification and human cause of independence till the moments he passed away on a running train. The precious revolutionary feats of the great Generalissimo Kim Jong Il who worked with warm love for the country and the nation and noble devotion during his life are always remembered by all the fellow countrymen and mankind and will be glorified for all ages along with the look of the prosperous socialist country, the letter stressed. It continued: Marshal Kim Jong Un, the supreme leader of our nation, saw to it that the great General is held in high esteem as the eternal leader of Kim Il Sung's nation with pure loyalty and noble revolutionary obligation and the sacred revolutionary career and undying feats of the General are always embroidered on the country. The letter expressed the will to further strengthen the General Association of Koreans in China, the patriotic legacy of the great Generalissimos, into the Juche-oriented organization of overseas citizens always remaining loyal to the leadership of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: Remembrance Meeting of Koreans Held in China
body: A remembrance meeting of the General Association of Koreans in China was held on December 17 in commemoration of the 7th anniversary of the demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Present there were Choe Su Bong, first vice chairperson of the General Association of Koreans in China, officials of the association and the Federation of Korean Economic Workers in China, and other Koreans in China. Before the meeting, the participants laid a floral basket before the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and paid tribute to them. Choe Su Bong in a speech said that Kim Jong Il, possessed of perfect personality and qualification of a great man, was an outstanding thinker and theoretician and a peerlessly elder statesman who led the revolution and construction to victory and a tender-hearted father who encouraged Koreans in China with warm love and trust to invariably follow the road of patriotism with the soul of the Korean nation. Choe stated that all DPRK citizens and other Koreans in China will remain loyal to the guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un who is making tangible contributions to the reunification of the country and global peace and stability, true to the behests of Kim Jong Il. A letter of pledge to Kim Jong Un was adopted at the meeting. At the end of the meeting, the participants watched a documentary film dealing with the revolutionary leadership exploits of Kim Jong Il. Similar meetings were held by the Federation of Korean Economic Workers in China, the Association of Young Korean Nationals in China and the Yanbian Regional Branch and the Zhongnan Regional Branch of the General Association of Koreans in China. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Yong Nam Meets Indonesian Ambassador
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, had a talk with Indonesian Ambassador to the DPRK Bambang Hiendrasto who paid a farewell call on him at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Thursday. Rodong News Team

title: Syrian Embassy Hosts Reception
body: The Syrian embassy to the DPRK hosted a reception on Thursday to mark the 27th anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's assumption of the supreme commandership of the Korean People's Army. Invited to the reception were Thae Hyong Chol, president of Kim Il Sung University and minister of Higher Education, and officials concerned. Syrian Ambassador to the DPRK Tammam Sulaiman were on hand. Speeches were made. Rodong News Team

title: Brief Biography of Chairman Kim Jong Il Carried by Russian Online Paper
body: A brief biography of Chairman Kim Jong Il was carried by the Russian online paper Lenta. ru on Dec. 14 on the occasion of the seventh anniversary of his demise. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Work Off Press in Algeria
body: Chairman Kim Jong Il's work "Respecting the Forerunners of the Revolution Is a Noble Moral Obligation of Revolutionaries" was brought out in booklet by the Tarzalt Publishing House in El-Djezair, Algeria on the occasion of the seventh anniversary of his demise. The work, published on Dec. 25, Juche 84 (1995), clarifies the idea that respecting the forerunners of the revolution is a requirement of the revolution, and the principled issues arising in imbuing people with moral traits of respecting the forerunners of the revolution and in developing the relationship of noble moral obligation among people. The work-releasing ceremony took place on Dec. 13. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Introduced by German Body
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us Brilliantly Accomplish the Revolutionary Cause of Juche, Holding the Great Comrade Kim Jong Il in High Esteem as the Eternal General Secretary of Our Party" was posted by the German Group for the Study of Korean Culture on its website on Dec. 16 ahead of the 7th anniversary of the demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The work, published on April 6, Juche 101 (2012), says that to invariably hold Kim Jong Il in high esteem as the eternal general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea is the principled requirement for successfully advancing the cause of the Korean revolution, indicating the tasks to be fulfilled in steadily developing the party into the glorious party of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. The website carried photos of Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Praised by Brazilian, Jordanian Figures
body: Brazilian and Jordanian figures issued statements on Dec. 10 and 14 on the seventh anniversary of the demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The chairperson of the Brazilian Committee for Remembering Leader Kim Jong Il highly praised the feats of Kim Jong Il, the great master of idea, theory and leadership and tender-hearted father of the people. He said that history has not known such a great man as Kim Jong Il who dedicated his whole life to the country and the people, adding that he is always remembered by the Korean people and the world progressives. Marwan Sudah, chairman of the Arab Committee for Solidarity with Korean People and Supporting the Reunification of Korea, said: I pay tribute to HE Kim Jong Il, the eternal leader of the Korean people. HE Kim Jong Il who carried forward the idea and cause of President Kim Il Sung firmly defended the sovereignty and dignity of the DPRK from the arbitrary practices of the imperialists. He put forward the slogan "We Serve the People!" and devoted his all to the people. Thanks to him, the DPRK could demonstrate its might as a power in terms of politics, ideology and military. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Remembered by Foreign Media
body: Media of various countries featured reports on Chairman Kim Jong Il together with the portraits of smiling Kim Jong Il and his photos in commemoration of the seventh anniversary of his demise. The Laotian paper Pasason on Dec. 14 carried an article titled "Great Revolutionary Life of Comrade Kim Jong Il." The paper said that Kim Jong Il strengthened the Workers' Party of Korea into an ever-victorious guiding force and the DPRK into a powerful socialist country and the Korean People's Army into an invincible army. The December issue of the German paper Rote Fahne in an article titled "Korea, White Snow in December" noted that the yearning of the Korean people for Kim Jong Il grows stronger as the days go by. The Iranian Ilna posted an article titled "Last Year of Great Devotion" on its website on Dec. 11. The article said that Kim Jong Il was a genuine leader of the people who dedicated his all to the prosperity of the country and the happiness of the people during his life, introducing the journey of devotion to the people that he had made in the last days of his life. The Nepalese paper Arpan on Dec. 14 in an article titled "Kim Jong Il, Leader of People" said that he led the revolution and construction, firmly trusting in the people and relying on them. The article said: He regarded himself as the son of the working people and shared the destiny with them. His noble image will be always remembered by the Korean people and the world progressives. The Zimbabwean newspaper Herald on Dec. 14 carried articles praising him for building the Workers' Party of Korea. Rodong News Team

title: Vietnamese Army Day Marked
body: Le Ba Binh, Vietnamese ambassador to the DPRK, and Nguyen Quoc Viet, military attaché of the embassy, hosted a reception at the Taedonggang Diplomatic Club on Friday to mark the Vietnamese Army Day. Invited to the reception were Army Col. General Kim Hyong Ryong, vice-minister of the People's Armed Forces, generals and officers of the Korean People's Army, officials concerned, diplomatic envoys of different countries here and military attaches of the embassies of various countries. Present there were staff members of the Vietnamese embassy. Speeches were made there. Rodong News Team

title: Landscape Painting and Handicraft Exhibition Opens
body: A landscape painting and handicraft exhibition opened on Friday at the Korean Art Gallery to mark the 101st birth anniversary of the anti-Japanese war heroine Kim Jong Suk. Displayed at the center of the exhibition hall is oil painting "The great leader Comrade Kim Il Sung and anti-Japanese war heroine Comrade Kim Jong Suk seeing the sunrise of Korea on the top of Jong Il Peak." Also displayed are acryl painting "Best wish of all people" depicting President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, Korean painting "By dedicating the whole life" and oil painting "By becoming a sentry" showing the noble traits of Kim Jong Suk who devoted her all to the accomplishment of the cause of Juche revolution. 110 odd Korean paintings, oil paintings, embroidery and craftworks are displayed. They deal with the exploits performed by the peerlessly great persons throughout the country. There are also metal and ceramic crafts showing wisdom and talents of the Korean people. The exhibition will last till Dec. 28. Rodong News Team

title: Importance of Science, Education and Public Health Service
body: Attaching importance to science, education and public health service and directing efforts to them are fundamental requirement for making a great leap forward in socialist construction. The ongoing grand march for economic construction is the march of self-reliance based on our own scientific and technological power. What we can rely on is our own efforts, the spirit of self-development. When we attach importance to scientific and technological development and give priority to it, we can rapidly increase our self-development capability and make a leap forward and innovation on all fronts of socialist construction. At present, the development of science and technology is guaranteed by education of training scientific and technological talents who are in direct charge of them. Only when education is prioritized, a lot of scientific and technological talents who will shoulder the building of a powerful socialist country can be trained and a locomotive of science and technology can dynamically dash forward. The same is true of the public health service. It is very important to protect the lives of people and promote their health in encouraging them to fully display their revolutionary enthusiasm and creative ability. This shows that when we put efforts into public health service, we can make bigger achievements in the grand march for economic construction. Hong Jin Hyok

title: The Utility Rice Sower Invented
body: The Chongsan Cooperative Farm in Kangso District pooled its efforts and wisdom to make a high-performance rice sower. The rice sower satisfies the demand of science and technology for rice seeding. When it inhales rice seeds and ceases to do so, only one of them falls into the right place of a fertile seedling plot. The rice sower helps save lots of seeds and labor. It has been proved in practice that it economizes on more seeds by 25～30% than a pair of hands so far as sowing is concerned. It dispenses with at least three people a day. In addition, the rice sower is so simple in structure and operation that a mechanized workteam or a repair sub-workteam can make and use it as it likes. Pak Yong Jin

title: Reply Message to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Lao President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a reply message from Bounnang Vorachith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party (LPRP) and president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic (LPDR), on December 21. The Lao president expressed his sincere gratitude to Kim Jong Un for sending encouraging and warm congratulations and best wishes to the Lao People's Revolutionary Party and the government and people of Laos and him on behalf of the Central Committee of the LPRP and government and people of the LPDR and for his part on the occasion of the 43rd birthday of the LPDR. He expressed his belief that the DPRK would continue to develop into a powerful and prosperous socialist state under the energetic leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea headed by Kim Jong Un. He was sure that good unity and traditional friendly and cooperative relations between the two parties and governments would further develop in the interests of the peoples of the LPDR and the DPRK and thus make contribution to peace, friendship and cooperation of the region and the world. He paid high respect to Kim Jong Un, wishing him good health and happiness and greater success in his noble work. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of Ministry of People's Security Leaves for Russia
body: A delegation of the Ministry of People's Security of the DPRK led by Ri Song Chol, councilor of the ministry, left here on Saturday to visit Russia. Rodong News Team

title: Participants in National Meeting of Activists Visit Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: The participants in the 4th National Meeting of Activists in Agricultural Field visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the sacred temple of Juche where President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il lie in state, on Saturday. The participants paid homage to the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il. At the halls of immortality where the great leaders lie in state, they bowed to them in humble reverence, looking back upon the revolutionary careers of the leaders. They made rounds of the halls where the orders the great leaders received are on display and the halls that house cars, electric car, boat and train coaches used by them during their field guidance and foreign tours till the last moments of their lives. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Feats Remembered by Foreign Figures
body: Meetings to remember Chairman Kim Jong Il took place in Nepal, Mongolia and Denmark on Dec. 11 and 12 to commemorate the seventh anniversary of his demise. Madav Kumar Nepal, former prime minister of Nepal, said that by pursuing Songun politics, Kim Jong Il converted the DPRK into a political, ideological and military power which no formidable imperialist enemy dares provoke. He noted that the DPRK is more fully demonstrating its dignity as a great country, as Kim Jong Il successfully settled the issue of succession to the leadership, though he passed away. C. P. Mainali, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Nepal Communist Party (Marxist-Leninist), praised the Songun revolutionary feats of Kim Jong Il who decisively frustrated the imperialists' moves to stifle the DPRK and defended the sovereignty of the country and the happiness of the people. J. Lomvo, chairman of the Mongolian Mt. Paektu Association for Independent Development, said President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il were the great leaders who dedicated their all to the development of friendly relations between Mongolia and the DPRK and the building of prosperous DPRK, adding that the friendly ties provided by the preceding leaders of the two countries have excellently developed for long. Anders Kristensen, chairman of the Denmark-DPRK Friendship Association, said that Kim Jong Il was a prominent thinker and theoretician who developed in depth the Juche idea into a guiding ideology in the era of independence and a defender of socialism and justice. Messages to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un were adopted at the meetings held in Nepal and Denmark. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Introduced in Russia
body: The full text of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us Brilliantly Accomplish the Revolutionary Cause of Juche, Holding the Great Comrade Kim Jong Il in High Esteem as the Eternal General Secretary of Our Party" was posted on the Russian internet website Irkutskblogspot. ru on Dec. 13 on the occasion of the 7th anniversary of the demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The work, published on April 6, Juche 101 (2012), says that to invariably hold Kim Jong Il in high esteem as the eternal general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea is the principled requirement for successfully advancing the cause of the Korean revolution, indicating the tasks to be fulfilled in steadily developing the Party into the glorious Party of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Work Published in Angola
body: Chairman Kim Jong Il's work "On Having a Correct Understanding of Nationalism" was brought out in booklet by the National Publishing House of Angola on the occasion of the 7th anniversary of his demise. The work, published in February, Juche 91 (2002), deals with the birth and essence of nationalism and the past view on it and important issues arising in achieving independent development of the nation. Its releasing ceremony was held on December 12. Rodong News Team

title: Peerlessly Great Men's Works Posted on Websites by Italian Bodies
body: Chairman Kim Jong Il's work "On Correctly Analyzing and Reviewing the History of Revolutionary Ideology of the Preceding Working Class" and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us Step Up the Building of a Thriving Country by Applying Kim Jong Il's Patriotism" were posted on websites by the Group of Dialectical Materialists of Italy and the Italian Committee for the Study of Songun Idea for Independence and Sovereignty on Dec. 15 to commemorate the seventh anniversary of the demise of Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Feats Praised
body: Kuwaiti and Algerian figures made public statements to commemorate the seventh anniversary of the demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Javid Ahmad, chairman of the Kuwait Asian Journalist Association who is chairman of the Kuwaiti committee for remembering the great leader General Kim Jong Il, in a statement on Dec. 15 said that by pursuing the original Songun politics, Kim Jong Il strengthened the DPRK into a political, ideological and military power which no formidable enemy dares to provoke and reliably guaranteed peace and security of the Korean peninsula and the rest of the world. The chairman of the Algeria-Korea Friendship Association in a statement on Dec. 13 said that Kim Jong Il was a peerless patriot who dedicated his all to the prosperity and development of socialist Korea and a genuine leader of the people who shared the destiny with them, possessed of boundlessly modest, simple and popular traits. He praised Kim Jong Il as an iron-willed commander who strengthened the DPRK into an impregnable socialist fortress and reliably defended the sovereignty and dignity of the country against the imperialists' vicious moves to stifle it with sanctions, adding that his noble image will always be kept in the hearts of mankind. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Remembered in Different Countries
body: Meetings to remember Chairman Kim Jong Il took place in India, Pakistan, Belarus and Bulgaria from Dec. 12 to 14 to commemorate the seventh anniversary of his demise. Attending the meetings were figures of all social standings and citizens in those countries. Atul Kumar Anjan, chairman of the All India Indo-Korean Friendship Association, and other speakers said that the whole life of Kim Jong Il was the one of a great revolutionary, a popular leader who dedicated his all to the people and to further glorifying the people-centered socialist Korea. Zabed Ansari, secretary general of the Karachi Branch of the Pakistan-Korea Friendship Association, said that Kim Jong Il had made dynamic efforts for the happiness of people and the building of socialism, the national reunification and the human cause of independence, adding that the yearning of the Korean people and the world progressives for Kim Jong Il grows stronger with the lapse of time. L. Shukolinikov, chairman of the Permanent Standing Committee of the Belarus National Association of Friends of Korean People Named after Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il who is chairman of the Belarusian committee for remembering Comrade Kim Jong Il, said that Kim Jong Il developed in depth the Juche idea, the Songun idea founded by President Kim Il Sung and the DPRK turned itself into an impregnable socialist fortress, thanks to Kim Jong Il. The participants in the remembrance meeting held in Bulgaria said it is thanks to the wise leadership of Kim Jong Il that socialism was defended in the DPRK and it could demonstrate its dignity as the people's country envied by the world people. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Off Press in Russia
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us Live and Work in the Revolutionary Spirit of Paektu, the Spirit of the Blizzards of Paektu" was brought out in booklet by Khabarovsk Territory Publishing House of Russia to commemorate the seventh anniversary of the demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The work, published on Oct. 27, Juche 103 (2014), says that it is necessary for everyone to know Mt Paektu in order to accomplish the revolutionary cause of Juche, indicating the tasks and other matters arising in living and working with the revolutionary spirit of Paektu, the spirit of the blizzards of Paektu. Its releasing ceremony took place on Dec. 14. Rodong News Team

title: Sinister Intention of Confrontation with Fellow Countrymen
body: Shortly ago, the “Liberal Korea Party” of south Korea issued a new “policy towards the north”, claiming that it replaced its old “policy towards the north” with the one including “denuclearization and peace”, “economic cooperation” and “co-prosperity” which it has never mentioned before. The LKP wrapped its new policy in a cloth of “peace” and “cooperation”, but it smacks of only confrontation and war. The new policy of the LKP is little short of “denuclearization, opening and 3 000 dollars” and “confidence-building process” advertised by former conservative regimes, as it actually aims at covering up its sinister intention of confrontation with the fellow countrymen, which is steeped to the marrow of its bone. The LKP put forward the “complete denuclearization of the north” as a prerequisite for realizing the new “policy towards the north” and forcibly linked the inter-Korean relations with the nuclear issue. This betrays the true look of the new policy. And the conservatives trumpeted about “denuclearization first and peace promotion next” and “economic cooperation in response to the progress in denuclearization”, while touting the new policy. Herein lies their cunning trick to whip up confrontation between the north and the south under the pretext of the nuclear issue. The group of traitors seeks to prolong their remaining days as politicians by winning popularity with sweet lies like “peace” and “cooperation”, while barring the progress of inter-Korean relations under the pretence of the nuclear issue. The LKP, a cancer-like entity standing in the way of achieving peace and reunification, should end itself, not resorting to wicked words to mislead the public sentiment. Sim Chol Yong

title: Young People Hold Dancing Parties
body: Youth and Students throughout the country had dancing parties on Dec. 24 in celebration of the 27th anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's assumption of the supreme commandership of the Korean People's Army and the 101st birth anniversary of the anti-Japanese war heroine Kim Jong Suk. Dancing parties took place amid the playing of the song "Fortune of Korea" in the plazas of the Monument to Party Founding, the Arch of Triumph and the Pyongyang Indoor Stadium and other venues here. The events showed the respect and glory to Kim Jong Il, who provided a powerful political and military guarantee of the DPRK. While dancing, the dancers renewed their determination to become human fortresses and shields of devotedly defending Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un just as was done by Kim Jong Suk who created the tradition of devotedly defending the leader. "Song of Youth", "Song of Socialist Advance" and other songs revved up the atmosphere. Similar dancing parties took place in other parts of the country. Rodong News Team

title: Participants in National Meeting of Activists Visit Mangyongdae
body: The participants in the 4th National Meeting of Activists in Agricultural Field visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. They looked round historic mementoes showing the greatness of the President and the outlook on life of his family members at the old home in Mangyongdae after visiting the Mangyongdae Revolutionary Museum. During their visit to the Korean Revolution Museum they paid tribute to the colored statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il at its general review room and saw round various rooms. They toured the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum and the Sci-Tech Complex. Rodong News Team

title: Men's Ice-Hockey Game Held
body: There took place a men's ice-hockey game between the Taesongsan Sports Team and the Pyongyang Railway Bureau Sports Team at the Ice Rink to mark the significant day December 24. Among spectators were Kim Il Guk, minister of Physical Culture and Sports, Ju Yong Gil, chairman of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea, officials concerned and others. The Taesongsan Sports Team defeated its rival 6:2. Rodong News Team

title: Visit Paid to Anti-Japanese War Heroine Kim Jong Suk's Birthplace in Hoeryong
body: Officials and members of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea from across the country visited the anti-Japanese war heroine Kim Jong Suk's birthplace in Hoeryong on Monday, her 101st birth anniversary. The visitors laid a floral basket and bouquets before her statue at the foot of Osan Hill and paid tribute to it. At her old home at the foot of Osan Hill, the visitors saw the historic mementoes preserved there, being told that Kim Jong Suk, born into a patriotic and revolutionary family when the Korean nation was suffering from hardships, grew up to be a revolutionary. At the Hoeryong Revolutionary Museum, they grasped the career of Kim Jong Suk who made a great contribution to building a new country and the revolutionary armed forces and developing the women's movement and provided the origin to carrying forward the revolutionary cause of Juche. That day they also toured Kim Ki Song Hoeryong Senior Middle School and the Hoeryong Schoolchildren's Palace visited by Chairman Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: Lao Foreign Ministry Delegation Here
body: A delegation of the Foreign Ministry of Laos led by Vice-Minister Khamphao Ernthavanh arrived here on Monday. Rodong News Team

title: Floral Baskets Laid at Statues of Anti-Japanese War Heroine Kim Jong Suk
body: Floral baskets were laid before statues of anti-Japanese war heroine Kim Jong Suk in Hoeryong City, Kim Jong Suk County, Kim Jong Suk Naval University and other places on Monday, her 101st birth anniversary. Present at the floral basket-laying ceremonies were officials of local party and power organs and working people's organizations, working people, youth and schoolchildren and service personnel. Laid before statues of Kim Jong Suk were floral baskets in the names of local party and power organs, working people's organizations, industrial establishments, farms, schools, units of the Korean People's Army and the Korean People's Internal Security Forces, etc. and flowers. The participants paid tribute to her. Rodong News Team

title: Floral Tributes to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Working people, youth and schoolchildren and service personnel across the country laid floral baskets at the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Dec. 24. Seen standing before the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill was a floral basket sent by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Floral baskets and bouquets were laid before the statues of the great leaders in the names of Party, power and arms forces organs, social organizations, ministries, national institutions, institutions, industrial establishments and schools at all levels in Pyongyang City and units of the Korean People's Army (KPA) and the Korean People's Internal Security Forces (KPISF). The masses made a bow to the statues of the great leaders. Floral baskets in the names of institutions, enterprises and units of the KPA and the KPISF were laid at the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il and the mosaics of their smiling images in different parts of Pyongyang, including the Ministry of the People's Armed Forces, the Ministry of People's Security and the Mansudae Art Studio. Working people, youth and schoolchildren and service personnel in other parts of the country paid tribute to the statues of the great leaders and mosaics of their smiling images in their residential areas. Rodong News Team

title: Wreath Sent to Bust of Kim Jong Suk
body: The family of So Sun Ok, a Korean anti-Japanese revolutionary martyr in China, sent a wreath to the bust of the anti-Japanese war heroine Kim Jong Suk at the Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery on Mt. Taesong in commemoration of her 101st birth anniversary. The wreath was laid at the bust on Dec. 24. Rodong News Team

title: Books Dealing with Greatness of Leaders Published in DPRK This Year
body: Over 120 varieties of books dealing with the exploits of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, peerlessly great men, were published in the DPRK this year. The Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House published books like Vol. 107 of memoirs "Among the People", Vol. 76 of memoirs "Glorifying the Era of Juche" and other books depicting their greatness. "History of Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth Movement" (Vols. 1-6) published by the Kumsong Youth Publishing House covers the exploits performed by Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il in leading the Korean youth movement and the greatness of Kim Jong Un who is ushering in the golden days of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist youth movement. Books including "Opening New Golden Days of Working People's Organizations" published by the Working People's Organizations Publishing House show the wise guidance of Kim Jong Un in further strengthening the union organizations into mass political organizations of the leader. The Science and Encyclopedia Publishing House produced books like "Spirit of Times Created in Accomplishing Cause of Juche Revolution". Books printed by the Art and Literature Publishing House include lengthy novels "One Family" and "Thunder-like Army Song" belonging to cycles of novels "Immortal History" and "Immortal Guidance" making an ideological and artistic depiction of the great personality of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il and those showing the loving care shown by Kim Jong Un for the people. Other publishing houses like the Social Science Book Publishing House, the Industrial Publishing House and the Agricultural Publishing House also published many books dealing with the greatness of the leaders, typically "Great Man Kim Jong Un, Testimony of Humankind". Rodong News Team

title: DPRK's Important Day Observed by Swiss Bodies
body: The Swiss Organizing Committee for the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu, the Switzerland-Korea Committee and the Swiss Group for the Study of the Juche Idea released a joint statement on December 8 on the occasion of the 27th anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's assumption of the supreme commandership of the Korean People's Army (KPA). Recalling that Kim Jong Il assumed the responsible supreme commandership of the KPA on December 24, 1991, the statement said: Generalissimo Kim Jong Il consolidated the DPRK to be an invincible socialist fortress by strengthening the KPA. When the DPRK faced the harshest ordeals, he smashed the hostile forces' moves to stifle the DPRK and laid a strong foundation for building a powerful nation by pursuing the Songun politics. Eternal glory to Generalissimo Kim Jong Il, the peerlessly brilliant commander of Songun! Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Remembered Abroad
body: Events took place in various countries to remember Chairman Kim Jong Il on the occasion of the 7th anniversary of his demise. They included remembrance meetings in Pakistan, Zimbabwe and Austria and a seminar in Sweden from December 13 to 17. The chairman of the Lahore Group for the Study of the Juche Idea of Pakistan said that the life of Chairman Kim Jong Il was the one of a great revolutionary and patriot who totally dedicated to the country and people, adding the noble career and exploits of the peerlessly great man who led the Korean revolution to victory under the uplifted banner of Songun will always be remembered by the Korean people and other progressive peoples in the world. The principal of Kuwazana Primary School No. 2 of Zimbabwe and other speakers recalled that Kim Jong Il turned the DPRK into an invincible political and military power and firmly defended global peace and security. The participants in the remembrance meeting in Austria said that Kim Jong Il performed undying exploits for peace, prosperity and reunification of the Korean peninsula. The chief of the Swedish Group for the Study of the Juche Idea pointed out the greatest exploit of Kim Jong Il is that he pursued the Songun politics when the DPRK was undergoing the hardest trials and thus defended the sovereignty of the country and happiness of its people and laid a solid foundation for building a powerful nation. Though Kim Jong Il passed away, he will always be remembered by humankind, he stressed. A message to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was adopted at the seminar in Sweden. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Praised by Foreigners
body: Remembrance meetings and book and photo exhibitions took place on December 13 and 15 in Bangladesh, Sweden, Norway and Finland on the occasion of the 7th anniversary of the demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Faizle Hossain Badsha, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Bangladesh, Mostafa Jamal Haider, secretary general of the Bangladesh Jatiya Party, Garib Newaz, president of the Bangladesh People's League, and Sheikh Rafiqul Islam Bablu, chairman of the Bangladesh Institute of the Juche Idea, said Kim Jong Il made contributions to the accomplishment of the cause of global independence. Christer Lundgren, chairman of the Sweden-Korea Friendship Association, praised Kim Jong Il as a prominent leader who illuminated the road ahead of the progressive people in the world. Thanks to his direction, the DPRK could turn into a politico-ideological power and military power, he added. Dag Norum, chairman of the Ostfold County Committee of the Communist Party of Norway, lauded Kim Jong Il as a great thinker and theoretician who developed and enriched the Juche idea founded by President Kim Il Sung, as required by the times. Pekka Kotkasaari, chairman of the Finland-Korea Society, praised the ideological, theoretical and Songun leadership exploits of Kim Jong Il for the times and history. Messages to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un were adopted at the events held in Norway and Finland. Rodong News Team

title: Sympathy to Indonesian President
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a message of sympathy to Joko Widodo, president of the Republic of Indonesia, on Monday as regards the huge human and material losses caused by tsunami in Sunda Strait, Indonesia. The message expressed deep condolences to the Indonesian president and, through him, to the victims and their bereaved families. It hoped that the Indonesian government and people would help the people in the affected area return to normal life and eradicate the aftermath of tsunami at an early date, overcoming their sorrow. Rodong News Team

title: Floral Basket to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Palestinian President
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a floral basket from Mahmoud Abbas, president of the State of Palestine, on the occasion of the New Year Juche 108 (2019). The floral basket was handed over to an official concerned by the Palestinian charge d' affaires ad interim here on Dec. 25. Rodong News Team

title: Syrian Embassy Hosts Reception
body: The Syrian embassy here gave a reception on Tuesday to mark the seventh anniversary of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's assumption of the supreme commandership of the Korean People's Army. Present there on invitation were Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Ho Yong Bok, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, Pang In Chol, vice-minister of Public Health, and officials concerned. Syrian Ambassador to the DPRK Tammam Sulaiman and his embassy officials were on hand. Speeches were made there. The Syrian ambassador in his speech said that Syria and the DPRK would defend the dignity and happiness of their peoples, steadily standing in the van of the independent countries of the world. Ri Su Yong said it is the fixed stand of the Workers’ Party of Korea and the government of the DPRK to ceaselessly boost the traditional friendly and cooperative ties between the DPRK and Syria. He expressed the belief that the Syrian people would achieve a final victory in their struggle for smashing invasion and interference of the hostile forces and rebuilding the country under the leadership of President Bashar Al-Assad. Rodong News Team

title: Choe Ryong Hae Inspects Construction Site of Onchon Tourist Area
body: Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the WPK Central Committee, visited the construction site of the Onchon tourist area in Yangdok County. Touring several places of the construction site, Choe Ryong Hae called for conducting in an effective way the organizational and political work for instilling into the hearts of the masses the noble intention of the Party to provide the people with more highly civilized life. He also underlined the need to further improve the logistic supply and to increase the building tempo through the introduction of rational construction methods to suit to the work flow for each phase. A field consultative meeting discussed the issue for the party organizations to actively help the units in charge of designing, construction and supervision to push forward the work for wonderfully sprucing up the Onchon area as the one of eternal value, and the issue for relevant units to timely ensure the supply of materials. Rodong News Team

title: Friendship Delegation Back Home
body: A friendship delegation led by Pak Kyong Il, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries and chairman of the Korea-Mongolia Friendship Association, returned home on Dec. 25 after visiting Mongolia. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Carried by Belarusian Paper
body: The whole text of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us Brilliantly Accomplish the Revolutionary Cause of Juche, Holding the Great Comrade Kim Jong Il in High Esteem as the Eternal General Secretary of Our Party" was carried on the 12th issue of the Belarusian paper Samostoyatelnosti. The work, published on April 6, Juche 101 (2012), says that to invariably hold Chairman Kim Jong Il in high esteem as the eternal general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea is the principled requirement for successfully advancing the cause of the Korean revolution. It also deals with the tasks to be fulfilled in steadily developing the Party into the glorious Party of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: Congratulations to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Diplomatic Corps Here
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a floral basket and a congratulatory letter from the diplomatic corps here on the occasion of the New Year Juche 108 (2019). The floral basket and congratulatory letter were handed over to DPRK Foreign Minister Ri Yong Ho on Wednesday by Syrian Ambassador to the DPRK Tammam Sulaiman on behalf of the diplomatic corps. Rodong News Team

title: Congratulations to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from
body: Economic and Commercial Councilors Corps Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was presented with a floral basket and congratulatory letter by the economic and commercial councilors corps here on the occasion of the 7th anniversary of his assumption of the supreme commandership of the Korean People's Army and the New Year Juche 108 (2019). The economic and commercial councilor of the Chinese embassy who is doyen of the corps conveyed them to an official concerned on Wednesday. Rodong News Team

title: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Members of UNDP, UNICEF, UNFPA, FAO, WFP and WHO missions here placed floral baskets before the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on Wednesday on the occasion of the New Year Juche 108 (2019). They paid tribute to the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: December 15 Quality Medals Awarded to Best Products
body: A meeting took place at the People's Palace of Culture here on Wednesday to award the December 15 Quality Medal to the best products made in the country in Juche 107 (2018). The Ryuwon Footwear Factory produced and presented sporting shoes for adults and children suited to the tastes of the people, youth and children according to their ages. The lotion (for men) which was produced by the Sinuiju Cosmetics Factory is popular among the people for its nutritious, protective and functional actions. The Thaechon Ryongop Factory developed industrial furfural going beyond the international standard quality level in reliance on indigenous technology and locally available resources and put its production on an industrial basis. A medal-awarding ceremony took place at the People's Palace of Culture on Wednesday. Medals and certificates were awarded to four products estimated as the home-made best goods. Rodong News Team

title: Workers and Trade Union Members Meet
body: Workers and members of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea (GFTUK) met at the Central Hall of Workers on Wednesday in celebration of the seventh anniversary of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's assumption of the supreme commandership of the Korean People's Army. Attending the meeting were Ri Il Hwan, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials of the GFTUK and workers and union members here. Ju Yong Gil, chairman of the Central Committee of the GFTUK, made a report followed by speeches. The reporter and speakers said that Kim Jong Un’s assumption of the supreme commandership is the greatest fortune for the country and the nation and a great revolutionary event of special significance in the history of building the army of Juche. They referred to the fact that the People's Army, waving the red flag of the Party of Juche as the first standard, has demonstrated its might as the revolutionary army of the Party and invincible army devotedly defending the Party, country and people under the leadership of Kim Jong Un. They called for getting firmly united behind the Party to make a dynamic struggle for the final victory in building a socialist power with the great national pride of holding Kim Jong Un in high esteem as the top leader of the Korean revolution. Rodong News Team

title: Congratulations to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Military Attaches Corps Here
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a floral basket and a congratulatory letter from the military attaches corps here ahead of the seventh anniversary of his assumption of the supreme commandership of the Korean People's Army. Alexei Bartusov, military attaché of the Russian embassy who is doyen of the corps, handed over the floral basket and congratulatory letter to Army General No Kwang Chol, minister of the People's Armed Forces, on Wednesday. Rodong News Team

title: Gift to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Head of Lao Foreign Ministry Delegation
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a gift from the head of the visiting delegation of the Foreign Ministry of Laos. The gift was conveyed to DPRK Foreign Minister Ri Yong Ho by head of the delegation Khamphao Ernthavanh, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs of Laos, on Wednesday. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Introduced by Spanish Political Party
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us Brilliantly Accomplish the Revolutionary Cause of Juche, Holding the Great Comrade Kim Jong Il in High Esteem as the Eternal General Secretary of Our Party" was posted by the Communist Party of the People of Spain on its internet homepage on December 17 to commemorate the 7th anniversary of the demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The work, published on April 6, Juche 101 (2012), says that to invariably hold Kim Jong Il in high esteem as the eternal general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea is the principled requirement for successfully advancing the cause of the Korean revolution. It also deals with the tasks to be fulfilled in steadily developing the WPK into the glorious Party of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Works Introduced by Serbian Body
body: The Serbian Committee for Remembering Comrade Kim Jong Il posted the full texts of Chairman Kim Jong Il's works "The Historical Lesson in Building Socialism and the General Line of Our Party" and "On Having a Correct Understanding of Nationalism" on the website of the New Yugoslav Communist Party on December 16 to commemorate the 7th anniversary of his demise. The website carried a portrait of smiling Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: Japan Should Not Deny Truth of History
body: Shortly ago, the 2018 state funeral for the victims of Nanjing Massacre took place in China. The Japanese imperialists, after provoking the Sino-Japanese War in July 1937, committed barbarous genocide in different parts of China they occupied. In mid-December the Japanese imperialist aggression army massacred hundreds of thousands of citizens in Nanjing. The massacre was a replica of the barbarous genocide committed by the Japanese imperialists against the Korean people. The Japanese imperialists killed innocent Koreans in the most brutal way beyond human imagination. Massacres committed by Japan in Asian countries, including Korea and China, in the past are the most heinous crimes against humanity with nothing can it cover up. It is the human ethnics and morality and the requirement and usage of international law to repent of and make apology for crimes. However, Japan is acting far from it. If a criminal does not admit his sins, it means he has the intent to repeat the past crime. The same is true of the Abe group that sets it as an ultimate goal to turn Japan into a war-capable state. If Japan persists in coward attempts to get rid of the responsibility for its past crimes, denying the truth of history, this will only add its crimes. Ri Hyon Do

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Remembered at DPRK Missions Abroad
body: Remembrance meetings, Kimjongilia exhibitions, book and photo exhibitions and a film show were held at the DPRK missions in China, Cambodia, Mongolia, Egypt, Equatorial Guinea and Romania on December 12-17 to commemorate the seventh anniversary of the demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. At the film show a Korean film dealing with the exploits performed by Kim Jong Il for the accomplishment of the human cause of independence was shown. Present at the events on invitation were personages of governments, political parties, institutions and organs and others in those countries and officials of the DPRK missions there. Kong Sam Ol, Cambodian deputy prime minister for Royal Palace, said: The great Generalissimo Kim Jong Il is a leader of the people and peerless statesman who devoted himself to the happiness of the Korean people and prosperity of the country till the last moments of his life. He consolidated the traditional and historic relations of friendship and cooperation between the two countries, which were provided by Great King Norodom Sihanouk and President Kim Il Sung, generation after generation and made a grandiose contribution to the accomplishment of the cause of global independence. The deputy director of the international department of the Democratic Party of Equatorial Guinea praised Kim Jong Il as the distinguished leader of the Korean people as he devoted his all to defending the sovereignty of the country and realizing national reunification. The chairman of the Supreme Council of the National Socialist Party of Romania who is chairman of the Romanian National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea and the chairman of the Socialist Party of Romania noted that the idea of Kim Jong Il brightly lightens the road ahead of the people aspiring after socialism, adding that the exploits he performed before the Korean and global revolution are immortal. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Remembered Abroad
body: Events to remember Chairman Kim Jong Il took place in different countries to commemorate the seventh anniversary of his demise. They included opening ceremonies of the Korean book, photo and fine art exhibitions in Russia and Venezuela, a book and photo exhibition in Indonesia and photo exhibitions and film shows in Germany, Mongolia, Algeria and Angola between December 9 and 19. On display at the venues of those events were photos dealing with the exploits of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. And displayed there were works of the peerlessly great men, books and photos introducing the DPRK and fine art works associated with the creative talents of the Korean people. Korean films including "My Country Has Emerged Victorious by Dint of Single-minded Unity" were shown at the film shows. Figures including a vice-minister of Foreign Affairs and the director of the institute of military science and technology of the Ministry of Defence of Venezuela were unanimous in saying that the DPRK is a strong country where the leader and the people get united as one and it demonstrates its might as an invincible military power. The general secretary of the National Guidance Council of the Pioneer Party of Indonesia noted that the DPRK under the leadership of Kim Jong Il invariably maintained the principle of independence in politics, self-supporting in economy and self-reliance in national defence. The secretary for Women's Development of the Angolan Women's Organization and other figures of various organizations and institutions stressed that Kim Jong Il developed the Workers' Party of Korea into an ever-victorious party and built up the single-minded unity of the Korean society as firm as a rock. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Work Serialized by Nepalese Paper
body: The full text of Chairman Kim Jong Il's work "Socialism Is the Lifeline of Our People" was serialized by the Nepalese newspaper Majodur on December 17 and 18 to commemorate the seventh anniversary of his demise. The work, published on November 14, Juche 81 (1992), indicates the necessity to defend the world socialist movement and cause of socialism and the tasks and ways for defending and advancing the cause of socialism. The paper carried a portrait of smiling Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Praised by Foreigners
body: Lucas Rubio, chairman of the Brazilian Center for the Study of Songun Politics, released a statement on December 17, the 7th anniversary of the demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Noting that Kim Jong Il never stepped back from the principle of independence during the period of his revolutionary leadership, the statement said: He defended the sovereignty and dignity of the country and nation by pursuing the Songun politics. Thanks to him, the DPRK put itself on the status of a full-fledged power. We deem it a great honor to know a great revolutionary like him and follow his idea. His exploits will be immortal. Earlier, Yousfe Al Amiri, chairman of the Kuwait-DPRK Friendship Association and president of the Kuwait House of Works, released a statement on Dec. 13 on the occasions of the 7th anniversary of the demise of Kim Jong Il and the 7th anniversary of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's assumption of the supreme commandership of the Korean People's Army. The statement highly praised the life of Kim Jong Il as the one of a peerless patriot, the noble one of devotion totally dedicated to national reconciliation, unity and reunification. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Remembered in Different Countries
body: Meetings to remember Chairman Kim Jong Il took place in the Czech Republic, Ukraine, Bulgaria, the Philippines and Chile on December 11 and 17 to commemorate the seventh anniversary of his demise. The chairman of the Paektusan Czech-Korean Friendship Association said that Kim Jong Il is the eternal leader of the Korean people as he faithfully carried forward the idea and cause of President Kim Il Sung to defend socialism and the gains of the revolution and lay a firm foundation for building a powerful country. He stressed that the exploits of Kim Jong Il, who devoted his life to the prosperity of the country, the happiness of the people, national reunification and the accomplishment of the cause of global independence, would be always remembered by the Korean people and the world progressives. The chairman of the Association for the Study of the Juche Idea in Lvov, Ukraine said: Comrade Kim Jong Il is a great revolutionary and patriot as he devoted his whole life to the prosperity of the country and the happiness of the people. I pay my highest tribute to him for successfully pushing forward the cause of global independence under the banner of the Juche idea. The chairman of the Philippines Committee for Remembering Chairman Kim Jong Il and the first secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Chile (Proletarian Action) highly praised the ideological and theoretical feats of Kim Jong Il and his leadership exploits to go down for all ages. A message to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was adopted at the remembrance meeting held in Bulgaria. Meanwhile, a similar meeting was held by the Communist Party of the Soviet Union on December 10. Rodong News Team

title: Indian National Seminar on Juche Idea Held
body: An Indian national seminar on the Juche idea "Juche philosophy and independence of nation" was held in New Delhi on December 22 to commemorate the seventh anniversary of the demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Seen at the venue were photos dealing with the careers and exploits of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and photos showing the revolutionary activities of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Displayed there were works of the peerlessly great men and books and photos introducing the reality of the DPRK. Present there were Kenichi Ogami, secretary general of the International Institute of the Juche Idea, Harish Gupta, director-general of the Asian Regional Institute of the Juche Idea, Mukesh Sharma, secretary general of the Asian regional institute, S. P. Pathak, chairman of the Indian Society for the Study of Works of Kim Jong Il, and chiefs and members of other organizations for the study of the Juche idea in India, figures of the University of Delhi and others.
