body: The Russian website Irkutskblogspot. ru carried the full text of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us March Forward Dynamically towards Final Victory, Holding Higher the Banner of Songun" on December 26 last year to mark the 7th anniversary of his assumption of the supreme commandership of the Korean People's Army. The work is a speech Kim Jong Un delivered at the military parade in celebration of the centenary of birth of President Kim Il Sung on April 15, Juche 101 (2012). It says that the century-long history of Kim Il Sung's nation clearly proved the immutable truth that an outstanding leader guarantees the dignity and prosperity of the country and the nation. It also indicates the tasks for glorifying the dignity of Songun Korea for all ages and successfully accomplishing the cause of building a thriving socialist country. Rodong News Team

title: Party and State Commendations Conferred on Successful Players and Coaches
body: Party and state commendations were awarded to the players who proved successful in the 18th Asian Games, world weightlifting and boxing championships and the 13th World Junior and the 8th World Veteran Taekwon-Do Championships, merited coaches and relevant persons with due ceremony at the Central Youth Hall on Monday. Kim Chun Hui, weightlifting coach of the Kigwancha Sports Team, was awarded the title of DPRK Labor Hero, Gold Medal (Hammer and Sickle) and Order of National Flag First Class and Om Yun Chol, weightlifter of the Amnokgang Sports Team, Rim Jong Sim, weightlifter of the Kigwancha Sports Team, Jang Song Man, researcher at the Academy of Sports Science, and Yun Yong Bok, vice department director of the Ministry of Physical Culture and Sports, the citation of Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers’ Party of Korea; and artistic gymnastics player Kim Su Jong and wrestling coach Kim Kuk Song of the Pyongyang Sports Team, Taekwon-Do players Yun Kwang and Pak Ji Hyang of the Taekwon-Do Team of the Korean Taekwon-Do Committee and Choe Son Yong, student at Kim Ju Hyok Senior Middle School in Mangyongdae District, the Kim Jong Il Youth Honor Prize. The title of People’s Sportsperson went to boxer Pang Chol Mi and boxing coach Pak Chol Jun of the Kumgangsan Sports Team and Kim Kwang Dok, secretary general of the Weightlifting Association, and the title of Merited Sportsperson to Kim Un Ju, weightlifter of the Kigwancha Sports Team, and Hyon Sik, secretary general of the Boxing Association. Order of National Flag First Class was conferred on wrestler Pak Yong Mi and artistic gymnastics coach Kim Un Ju of the Pyongyang Sports Team. Order of National Flag Second Class went to four persons, Order of National Flag Third Class to two persons and Medal of Merit to two persons. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from President of DR Congo
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Joseph Kabila Kabange, president of the Democratic Republic of Congo, on December 17 on the occasion of the New Year 2019. The president in his message extended the warmest congratulations and sincere greetings to Kim Jong Un on behalf of all the people of DR Congo and on his behalf on the occasion of the New Year 2019. He expressed his will to further boost the reciprocal and friendly cooperation for the well-being of the peoples of the two countries. He paid high tribute to Kim Jong Un, once again wishing him good health and big success in leading the DPRK. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Palestinian President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the Korean People's Army, received a message of greeting from Mahmoud Abbas, president of the State of Palestine, on December 24 on the occasion of the New Year 2019. Saying that he was pleased to extend the warmest greetings and blessing to Kim Jong Un on behalf of the state and people of Palestine and on his behalf on the occasion of the New Year 2019, the president sincerely wished him good health and happiness and the friendly DPRK and its people progress and prosperity. He hoped that in the new year, peace desired by all the people in his region would be realized and thus they could enjoy the safe and intimate life and the Palestinian people would attain their right and establish a sovereign state with east Kuds, the city of love, reconciliation and peace, as its capital. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Chairman of Liberal Democratic Party of Russia
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, received a message of greeting from V. V. Zhirinovsky, chairman of the Liberal Democratic Party of Russia, on December 22 on the occasion of the New Year 2019. The message extended congratulations to Kim Jong Un on the occasion of the New Year 2019. It said that for the working people of the DPRK, last year was the one of events decisive of their future destiny and the one of their steady struggle for consolidating the cohesion and unity between the party and the people and the security and independence of the country. It hoped that the Korean people would greet with pleasure the New Year 2019 promissory of creation and progress in all fields of their life, with firm belief in the validity of their struggle for better life. It wished Kim Jong Un good health, the Korean people happiness and prosperity, the Korean peninsula peace and security and the DPRK further success in socialist construction. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Chairman of C.C., Communist Party of Russian Federation
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, received a message of greeting from G. A. Zhuganov, chairman of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation, on December 24 on the occasion of the New Year 2019. The message extended sincere greetings to Kim Jong Un on behalf of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation with the approach of the New Year 2019. It wished Kim Jong Un and his family good health and happiness. It also wished the Korean people peace, happiness and fresh successes in the socialist construction in the new year. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Egyptian President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Abdel Fattah al-Sisi, president of the Arab Republic of Egypt, on December 24 on the occasion of the New Year 2019. Saying that he was very pleased to extend his best wishes and greetings to Kim Jong Un on the occasion of the New Year 2019, the president wholeheartedly wished him good health and happiness and the Korean people well-being and prosperity. The message hoped that all hopes and desires of Kim Jong Un would be materialized and he and the friendly Korean people would register greater achievements and successes in the blessed new year. The message also wished the peoples of the two friendly countries and all other peoples of the world well-being, peace and prosperity in the new year. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Iranian President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Hassan Rouhani, president of the Islamic Republic of Iran, on December 26 on the occasion of the New Year 2019. The message extended congratulations to Kim Jong Un and the Korean people on the occasion of the New Year 2019. It hoped that peace, justice and equality would be ensured in the world and violence eliminated in the new year. It wished Kim Jong Un good health and success in his work and the people of the DPRK happiness and prosperity, hoping that the new year would be the one full of blessing and happiness. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK's Holidays Marked in North Europe
body: A joint meeting of north European progressive political parties and friendship organizations, book and photo exhibition and film show took place in Sweden on Dec. 22 to mark the DPRK's meaningful days in December and the New Year 2019. Seen on the front wall of the venue was an art work depicting President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il standing together. Displayed were photos dealing with the revolutionary careers and exploits of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il and the revolutionary activities of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Also displayed were books and photos introducing the struggle of the Korean people. Screened at the film show was a Korean film showing the proud appearance of the DPRK. Present at the event were personages of progressive political parties, organisations for friendship and solidarity with the Korean people and organizations for the study of the Juche idea in north European countries including Sweden, Finland, Norway and Denmark and the DPRK ambassador to Sweden and staff members of his embassy. The participants laid bouquets and flowers at the art work before paying tributes. At the event Christer Lundgren, chairman of the Sweden-Korea Friendship Association, and Anders Kristensen, chairman of the Denmark-DPRK Friendship Association, made speeches. They said that this year was a proud year in which the Korean People made greater progress in the struggle for building socialism and national reunification under the wise leadership of Chairman Kim Jong Un. Welcoming this year's positive events on the Korean peninsula, they vowed to further vigorously conduct the solidarity activities in support of the just cause of the Korean people to safeguard the sovereignty of the country, build socialism and reunify the country. A congratulatory message to Kim Jong Un was adopted at the event. Rodong News Team

title: Editorial
body: Let Us Open New Road of Advance for Socialist Construction “Let us open a new road of advance for socialist construction under the uplifted banner of self-reliance!” - this is the slogan we should uphold this year. It is the single and ardent will of the Korean people to hasten the final victory in the building of a powerful socialist nation by having the Party’s line on self-reliance as their faith and fully displaying their indomitable mental and creative power. The New Year Address made by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un is run through with the unshakable will of the Workers’ Party of Korea to lead the victory already achieved to a greater victory in the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance and self-sufficiency and make remarkable promotion in the advance and leap forward of Juche-based socialism. The on-going general advance is a proud struggle to give full play to the country’s tremendous potentiality stored with its own ability. We should turn this year into the one of great creation and change witnessing abundant fruitions of self-reliance and self-development by continuously making innovations and progress, firmly believing in the validity of our cause and our own strength. We should strenuously push ahead with the work for further strengthening the might of self-supporting economy and building socialist civilization in our own way, the way of Juche. The successful advance of socialism and the bright future of the nation hinge on the Juche-based mode of revolution and our own way. The might of self-reliance is the might of the single-minded unity. All should become honorable victors in this year’s general advance with the historic New Year Address of the Supreme Leader as the guide of their life and work.

title: Fixed External Policy Stand of WPK and DPRK Government
body: Independence, peace and friendship, the idea of the external policy the Workers’ Party of Korea (WPK) and the government of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea (DPRK) have consistently preserved, reflect the aspiration and desire of not only the Korean people but also mankind. Global independence is the desire of mankind and is the aspiration and the goal of the struggle of the Korean people. Since its foundation, the DPRK has worked hard for global independence, mapping out its external policy independently in accordance with its own faith and determination out of its consistent stand of independence and firmly defending the sovereignty of the country. If the socialist countries support each other, intensify solidarity and boost cooperation and exchange in the struggle for shared goals and ideals, fast progress will be made in achieving global independence. It is the fixed external policy stand of the WPK and the DPRK government to develop relations with all countries that are friendly to the DPRK. The validity and vitality of the independent, peaceful and friendly external policy pursued by the WPK and the DPRK government have been clearly proved in practice. The WPK and the DPRK government will as ever fulfill their responsibility and role in defending global peace and security and powerfully accelerating global independence. An Chol Gwon

title: Inter-Korean Relations Can’t Be Appendage of DPRK-U.S. Relations
body: Greeting hope-filled New Year, the Korean people look back upon last year plagued with shock, cheers, joy, emotion, disappointment and irritation, and are aflame with the desire for more epochal progress in inter-Korean relations and reunification upon receiving the historic New Year Address of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Contrary to the high expectations and aspirations of the Korean nation, politicians of Washington claim that inter-Korean relations should not move forward faster than the DPRK-U.S. relations and inter-Korean relations should be promoted in parallel with the DPRK-U.S. denuclearization negotiations. The voices calling for speed adjustment cause deep concerns among all the fellow countrymen. Last year witnessed wonderful changes that had been unimaginable between the north and south of Korea as well as great movements in the Korean peninsula that changed the political topography of the relations between north and south and between the DPRK and the United States. But, in the final analysis, the inter-Korean relations were locked up in stagnation as they have neither contents in formation nor practice in high-sounding words. No doubt, the blame for it rests with the U.S., which voiced active support for the Panmunjom declaration and the moves for the improved inter-Korean relations whenever an opportunity presented itself, but dropped the check bar in the way of improving inter-Korean relations and put on the brakes in every way. Throughout the last year the U.S. called for speed control, claiming that the inter-Korean relations have gone far away. Out of the desire to make progress in the inter-Korean relations this year, we have something to say as regards the U.S. attitude. What does the U.S. seek behind the theory of speed control in the inter-Korean relations? The theory fully shows that the United States does not want to see the improvement and development of the inter-Korean relations. The assertion that the inter-Korean relations should not move forward faster than the DPRK-U.S. relations proves that the U.S. does nothing and keeps others from doing things. If the U.S. forces a marathon player who runs faster than his American rival to adjust his speed in an international game, it will invite a bitter denunciation. As seen above mentioned, the U.S. still keeps a burglary logic. Clear is the reason why the U.S. takes an unreasonable attitude. The reason is that the U.S. still remains unchanged in the policy hostile towards the DPRK. The reality shows that the U.S. responded to the DPRK-U.S. dialogue out of its strategic interests, but it has a sinister intention to deprive the DPRK of its nuclear weapons and bring it to its knees without a good will to build a new, good relationship with the DPRK. Lurking behind such a way of thinking are concern that the more closely the north and the south work for the improvement of the bilateral ties and reunification, the more the U.S. will be left out of the issue of the Korean peninsula, and a calculation that it can shake the basis of the U.S. strategy for the domination of Asia. It is not too much to say that the theory of adjusting the speed to prevent the north-south ties from going ahead of the DPRK-U.S. relations is a new hostile policy toward the DPRK adopted by the U.S., today when the north-south ties are undergoing drastic development. It is the Korean nation which will suffer from it. It is high time that the Korean nation advanced further for the improvement of the north-south ties, not hesitating or looking back while reading the faces of others. It is an experience and lesson drawn last year that when the north and the south dash forward hand in hand, the DPRK-U.S. relations can not but follow. What is important to note here is that time has come for the U.S. to change its stand and view on the north-south ties. We will never tolerate the intervention and interference of the U.S. that tries to check the Korean nation’s reconciliation, unity and reunification while trying to subordinate the north-south relations to its own tastes and interests. The U.S. has to drop its old way of thinking of approaching the north-south relations from the standpoint of sanctions and pressure on the DPRK. The U.S. must have keenly felt last year that the north-south ties do not hurt its strategic interests and instead they are helpful and can be essential for it. Which is more pressing and urgent for the United States, denuclearization or military hegemony over Asia? The U.S. has to make wise judgment and cool-headed thinking. It has to clearly understand the desire of the Korean nation for national reconciliation and reunification and what poisonous effect its stupid way of thinking to dampen the desire will bring. The U.S. is urged to do what it should do for the improvement of the DPRK-U.S. relations, not making useless admonition while meddling in the issue of the north-south relations, an internal issue of the Korean nation. The north-south relations belong to the north and the south while the DPRK-U.S. relations belong to the DPRK and the U.S. The north-south ties can never be put under the DPRK-U.S. relations. This is our warning in New Year. Sok Jong Yon

title: Cuban Embassy Officials Visit Pyongyang Maternity Hospital
body: Jesus De Los Angeles Aise Sotolongo, Cuban ambassador to the DPRK, and his embassy officials visited the Pyongyang Maternity Hospital on Jan. 4 on the occasion of the 60th anniversary of the victory in the Cuban revolution. They made rounds of various places such as a treatment ward and had a chat with patients who receive hospital treatment under the benefits of the socialist healthcare system. They presented a souvenir to the hospital. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Premier Inspects Various Units
body: Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, inspected various units including the February 8 Jikdong Youth Coal Mine and the Pyongyang Thermal Power Complex. In a pit of the coal mine, he gave a pep talk to coal miners doing the first-day work of the new year and underscored the need for officials to pay primary attention to the supply service for coal miners, and for relevant units to supply in time coal-mining equipment and accessories including compressors. At the Pyongyang Thermal Power Complex, he called on officials and workers to raise the efficiency of generating equipment to the maximum and observe technical rules and standard regulations to operate all equipment at full capacity, being conscious of standing in the leading sector of the national economy. Field consultative meetings discussed measures arising in waging a dynamic struggle for increased production to make a breakthrough in the revitalization of national economy. Earlier, he inspected the Pyongyang Children's Foodstuff Factory, the Pyongyang Building Materials Factory, etc. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Exhibition and Film Show Held in China
body: A DPRK cultural and art exhibition took place in Yangzhou City, Jiangsu Province of China and a Korean film show in Beijing from December 16 to 20 last year to mark the 7th anniversary of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's assumption of the supreme commandership of the Korean People's Army and the 101st birth anniversary of the anti-Japanese war heroine Kim Jong Suk. Displayed at the exhibition hall were photos documenting President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il meeting with leaders of the elder generations of China and photos documenting Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un visiting China and his field guidance to various sectors of the national economy. Also displayed there were works of the peerlessly great men, books and photos introducing the true picture of Juche Korea and art pieces showing wisdom and talents of the Korean people. Screened at the film show were the Korean films showing the appearance of the daily-prospering DPRK. Present at the events were personages of various strata and people in China. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Work Published in Russia
body: Chairman Kim Jong Il's work "Socialism Is the Lifeline of Our People" was brought out in booklet by the Arton Publishing House of Russia to mark the 7th anniversary of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's assumption of the supreme commandership of the Korean People's Army. The work, published on November 14, Juche 81(1992), indicates the necessity to defend the world socialist movement and cause of socialism and the tasks and ways for defending and advancing the cause of socialism. The book-releasing ceremony took place on December 28 last year. Rodong News Team

title: Act of Misleading Public in Period of S. Korean Former Regime Disclosed
body: According to the south Korean MBC on Dec. 28 last year, it was revealed that VIPs of the police of south Korea were involved with the red herring operations during the former regime. The former intelligence director of the Police Agency and others following the then Lee Myung Bak regime organized a department for the red herring operations to hatch plots of every description. They hushed up cases like the sinking of warship Cheonan and the spread of foot-and-mouth disease that adversely affected the then conservative regime, and things unfavorable for it. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Yong Nam Sends Greetings to President of Myanmar
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, sent a message of greeting to Win Myint, president of Myanmar, on Jan. 4 on the occasion of the 71st anniversary of its independence. The message wished the president of Myanmar greater success in his responsible work for peace, stability and prosperity of the country. Rodong News Team

title: Pyongyang Citizens Meet
body: There took place a Pyongyang mass rally at Kim Il Sung Square on Friday, where the participants pledged to thoroughly implement the important tasks set forth by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address. Seen at the platform were Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the DPRK Cabinet, senior officials of the Party and government O Su Yong, An Jong Su, Ro Tu Chol, Choe Hwi and Pak Thae Dok, vice-premiers of the Cabinet, officials of the Party and power organs, industrial establishments and co-op farms in Pyongyang and persons of labor feats. Kim Nung O, alternate member of the Political Bureau of C.C., WPK and chairman of the Pyongyang City Committee of the WPK, made a report. He said the New Year Address of the Supreme Leader serves as a militant banner indicating the path for bringing about a revolutionary upsurge on all fronts of socialist construction. He recalled that the Supreme Leader encouraged Pyongyang City to be a model and standard-bearer of the country in the grand revolutionary advance for attaining higher goals of building a thriving country and guided its work step by step. He called on officials, Party members and working people in the city to turn out in the drive for further increasing the might of the socialist self-supporting economy with self-reliance as a treasured sword for prosperity. He underlined the need to strive for the prosperity and development of the socialist homeland under the blueprint unfolded by the Supreme Leader in his New Year Address, rallied closer around the great Party. Then resolution speeches were made. They said that all the people turned out as one in the general advance for devotedly carrying out the important tasks advanced by the Supreme Leader in his New Year Address with greater confidence and ambition. The participants marched past the square in procession at the end of the rally. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Holidays Marked in Mexico
body: Meetings, book and photo exhibitions and film shows were held by the People's Socialist Party of Mexico and the Mexico-Korea Friendship Association, and a meeting and book, photo and craftwork exhibition and film show took place at a center in Mexico from December 13 to 30 last year to mark the 27th anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's assumption of the supreme commandership of the Korean People's Army (KPA) and the 7th anniversary of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's assumption of the KPA supreme commandership. On display at the venues were photos documenting the exploits of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and revolutionary activities of the Supreme Leader. Also on exhibition there were works of the peerlessly great men, books and photos showing successes achieved by the Korean people in building socialism and craftworks associated with wisdom and talents of the Korean nation. Screened at the film shows were the Korean films including "Fireworks of a Thriving Nation". The general secretary and international secretary of the Central Committee of the People's Socialist Party of Mexico said that Chairman Kim Jong Il strengthened the DPRK into a political and military power, which no formidable enemy dares to provoke, by holding higher the banner of Songun at the end of the last century, and added that the dignity of Juche Korea has reached the highest level thanks to the outstanding and tested guidance of the Supreme Leader. The chairman of the Mexico-Korea Friendship Association lauded the Songun leadership exploits of Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Published in Russia
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let the Entire Party, the Whole Army and All the People Conduct a Vigorous Forest Restoration Campaign to Cover the Mountains of the Country with Green Woods" was brought out in booklet by the Leto-Print Publishing House of Russia. The work, published on February 26, Juche 104(2015), indicates the tasks and ways of covering the mountains of the country with green woods by conducting a vigorous forest restoration campaign involving the entire party, the whole army and all the people. The book-releasing ceremony took place on December 31 last year. Rodong News Team

title: Atonement for Past Sins Is Essential for Japan
body: It was reported recently that the German government would pay reparations to the surviving Jews, who had evacuated to Britain after being persecuted by the then Nazi German government on the eve of the Second World War. The sincere efforts of Germany to take leave of past crimes command deep sympathy of the international community. Unlike Germany, Japanese ruling quarter takes much pain to justify the heinous crimes committed by Japan against humanity in the past. Every year Japanese rulers pay a group visit to Yasukuni Shrine where the remains of top-class war criminals including Hideki Tojo are interred, despite the international condemnation. They are also describing the death of the war criminals as “sacrifice for peace and prosperity of Asia”. They are insisting on the burglary logic that the judgment made at the Far Eastern Military Tribunal was the decision made by victor nations and therefore they could not be viewed as criminals in the light of the domestic law. Without sincere apology and reflection on the past crimes Japan can neither get rid of the international denunciation nor raise its head any time. Atonement for the sinful past is needed for the future of Japan. Ri Chol Hyok

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address Introduced in Guinea
body: The Guinean National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism carried the full text of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address in its bulletin on January 2. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Holidays Marked in Russia
body: An opening ceremony of a DRPK book, photo and craftwork exhibition took place in Artyom City, Maritime Territory of Russia and a book exhibition and film show in Sankt-Peterburg from December 20 to 28 last year to mark the 27th anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's assumption of the supreme commandership of the Korean People's Army (KPA) and the 7th anniversary of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's assumption of the KPA supreme commandership. Seen on the front wall of the exhibition venue were a portrait of smiling Kim Jong Il and photos documenting his field guidance over various sectors of the national economy and revolutionary activities of the Supreme Leader. Also displayed there were works of the peerlessly great men, books and photos introducing the development of the DPRK and art pieces showing wisdom and talents of the Korean nation. Screened at the film show was a Korean film "My Country Has Emerged Victorious by Dint of Single-minded Unity". Present at the events were personages of various strata and people of Russia. Rodong News Team

title: LKP Accused of Seeking to Cover up Truth behind Kwangju Massacre in S. Korea
body: The "Liberal Korea Party" of south Korea is working hard to disturb the probing of truth behind the May 18 Kwangju Massacre, according to media reports from south Korea on January 4. As already reported, the "National Assembly" of south Korea passed a special bill on the probing of truth behind the May 18 pro-democracy movement last February in order to probe the truth behind the massacre committed during the then Kwangju uprising. The relevant law was enacted on September 14 last year but the LKP has not yet submitted the list of its members for the fact-finding committee for probing the truth behind the massacre. So, the fact-finding committee has not yet been inaugurated. South Korean media comment that the awful behavior of the LKP is because of its true colors as an accomplice involved in the massacre. Rodong News Team

title: Provincial Mass Rallies Take Place
body: There took place mass rallies in North Phyongan, South Hwanghae, North Hamgyong, South Hamgyong and Ryanggang provinces on Sunday to implement the tasks set forth by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address. Attending the mass rallies were officials of local party and power organs, working people's organizations, factories, enterprises, farms, universities and others, working people and youth and students. Reports were made there to be followed by speeches. Reporters and speakers said that the New Year Address of the Supreme Leader provides all the officials, Party members and other working people with faith in sure victory and optimism. They called upon all the officials, Party members and other working people to make great innovations and leap forward in economic construction while regarding self-reliance as the treasured sword of prosperity. They called for making a dynamic advance along the road of developing Korean-style socialism full of faith in sure victory and optimism under the uplifted banner of self-reliance according to the bright blueprint unfolded by Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address. At the end of the mass rallies, there took place mass demonstrations. Rodong News Team

title: Let Us Make Korean Peninsula Lasting Peace Zone
body: It is the steadfast will of the DPRK to eradicate military hostility between north and south and make the Korean peninsula a durable and lasting peace zone. To make the peninsula a durable and lasting peace zone is not a goal for the authorities of the north and the south only. It is the historic task set for the whole Korean nation. There will be no discrimination between the north and the south and between individual class and stratum as far as the historic national struggle for completely removing the danger of war and achieving peace and prosperity on this land. All Koreans should unite as one to wage a dynamic struggle for checking and frustrating every act of wrecking peace and inciting military tension on this land, bearing in mind that they are chiefly responsible for peace on the Korean peninsula. All Koreans, wherever they live, should positively conduct various activities to disclose and denounce the moves of outsiders for aggression and demand lasting peace on the Korean peninsula. Any challenge and interference by the anti-reunification forces can never block the way of the Korean nation who is making a dynamic advance with confidence in the rosy future of the nation, closely united under the banner of patriotism and independent reunification. Sim Chol Yong

title: Japanese Reactionaries’ Arms Buildup
body: The Japanese authorities adopted a new defense guidelines program and a five-year Midterm Defense Capability Buildup Outline. In this regard, Japanese politicians insisted upon the need to possess “many-sided combined defense capability” against arms buildup of China and other neighboring countries. Specified in those defense plans are such arms-buildup items as organization of a professional space unit in the “Self-Defense Forces” and remodeling of the escort ship Izumo into an F-35B carrier. The Japanese ruling quarters allotted 5 trillion and 257.4 billion yens as military spending for the fiscal year 2019, the biggest ever. With this, the military spending of Japan has kept all-time records for several consecutive years. It is an open challenge to the international community opposing Japan’s lurch to the right and militarization and desiring peace. The reckless arms buildup of Japan, a war criminal state, proves that it is willing to repeat its past sins. Japan’s act is aimed at possessing preemptive offensive forces. Every arms buildup item, whatever it may be, is for the preemptive strike and aggression. As to the name of the escort ship Izumo, it reminds everyone of Japan’s ambition for reinvasion. Izumo was the name of a warship notorious for its role in Japan’s invasion of China early in the last century. Abe regime’s plan for remodeling of the escort ship into a carrier clearly shows its ambition to bring back the militarist past. The way Japan persistently follows is the way to the defeat it suffered in the past. The Japanese ruling quarter should bear in mind that it is an act of driving Japan into an abyss to remain hell-bent on turning Japan into a major military power and realizing its wild ambition for reinvasion at the cost of blood tax paid by its citizens. Ri Hyo Jin

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Leaves Pyongyang for China
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, is to visit China on Jan. 7-10, Juche 108 (2019) at the invitation of Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and president of the People's Republic of China. Supreme Leader of the Party, state and army Kim Jong Un left Pyongyang with his wife Ri Sol Ju on Monday afternoon to visit the PRC. He was accompanied by Kim Yong Chol, Ri Su Yong, Pak Thae Song, Ri Yong Ho, No Kwang Chol and other leading officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs. He was warmly seen off by leading officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs at the railway station. He said good-bye to the officials before boarding the private train. The officials warmly saw Kim Jong Un off, wholeheartedly wishing him good successes in his visit to China and a safe trip. Political News Team

title: Provincial Mass Rallies Held
body: There took place mass rallies in South Phyongan and North Hwanghae provinces and Nampho City on Monday to pledge to implement the tasks set forth by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address. Present at the rallies were officials of local party and power organs, working people's organizations, factories, enterprises, farms, universities and others, working people, youth and students. Reports and speeches were made there. Reporters and speakers said that the New Year Address made by the Supreme Leader encourages the Korean people who turned out in the struggle for bringing about a revolutionary upsurge on all fronts of socialist construction, taking hold of self-reliance as the treasured sword for prosperity. They called upon all the officials and working people to cherish the principle of our state first as an element of their faith and make tangible contributions to the prosperity and development of the socialist homeland with sincere devotion. They called for opening a new road of advance for socialist construction by adhering to the new strategic line of the Party and striving hard in the spirit of self-reliance with confidence in victory, firmly rallied around the Supreme Leader. At the end of the mass rallies, there took place mass demonstrations. Rodong News Team

title: Official of General Association of Koreans in China Pledges to Fulfill His Duty
body: Choe Su Bong, first vice chairperson of the General Association of Koreans in China, issued a statement under the title "Self-reliance is the Banner of Victory in the Building of a Powerful Socialist Country" on Jan. 3. Upon receiving the New Year Address for Juche 108 (2019) made by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, all the Koreans in China including officials of the General Association of Koreans in China are filled with pride and honor of being the members of the Korean nation, picturing in their minds the appearance of the homeland in 2019 which will witness great victories, the statement said. The slogan "Let us open a new road of advance for socialist construction under the uplifted banner of self-reliance!" set forth by the Supreme Leader in his New Year Address is the immortal banner of victory that comprehends the orientation and ways for bringing about a new upsurge and working miracles on all fronts of socialist construction this year, it stressed. Only victory is definitely in store for the homeland thanks to the experienced and seasoned guidance of the Supreme Leader and the indomitable will of the people in the motherland who single-mindedly turned out in the building of a socialist power under the uplifted banner of self-reliance, the treasured sword for victory, it noted. The first vice chairperson expressed his will to fulfill his duty and responsibility in the patriotic work for the prosperity of the country in step with the people in the motherland who turned out in carrying out the militant tasks set forth by the Supreme Leader in his New Year Address. Rodong News Team

title: Lifting of Sanctions against DPRK Demanded in S. Korea
body: A spokesperson for the People's Party of south Korea in a commentary on Jan. 2 said that the U.S. should lift sanctions against the north, according to south Korean internet paper Jaju Sibo. The commentary urged the U.S. to keep the spirit of the June 12 Singapore Joint Statement in order to solve the issue of the Korean peninsula. Accusing the U.S. of tightening sanctions against the north after the DPRK-U.S. summit talks, the commentary branded the U.S. unilateral demand for denuclearization as the denial of the spirit of the June 12 Singapore Joint Statement. If the U.S. truly wants the denuclearization of the Korean peninsula, there is no reason for the U.S. not to ease sanctions against the north, it said. The U.S. had better get rid of its daydream that sanctions can lead up to the denuclearization, it stressed. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address Supported in Serbia
body: The New Yugoslav Communist Party and the League of the Yugoslavian Communist Youth on Jan. 3 made public a joint statement in support of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address. The statement said: The respected Marshal Kim Jong Un set forth the slogan "Let us open a new road of advance for socialist construction under the uplifted banner of self-reliance!" in his New Year Address. This is the slogan that enables the DPRK to defeat the ceaseless sanctions and pressure by hostile forces and bring about a revolutionary upsurge on all fronts of socialist construction. We are convinced that the Korean people will achieve good successes in their efforts for implementing the tasks put forward by the respected Marshal Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address. The Workers' Party of Korea will continue to advance in the future, too. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Exploits Introduced in Russia
body: Special write-ups were posted on Russian internet magazine and website on Dec. 27 last year, the Socialist Constitution Day of the DPRK. Russia's online magazine Lemchich carried an artwork picturing President Kim Il Sung and introduced in detail the essence and main content of the Socialist Constitution of the DPRK. The Russian website "DPRK Today" carried an article on Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's noble outlook on the people together with his photo. The article said: Leader Kim Jong Un's politics of loving care for people draws the attention of the international community. An institute in the U.S., in an article commenting on his political mode, stressed that all documentaries on his field guidance show his popular and attentive personality and that his instructions are closely associated with special care for the people's living. What is most charming in his personality is boundlessly noble character and virtue. Thanks to his leadership for the wellbeing of people, a series of great successes have been made in the DPRK, being admired by the world people. All his thoughts and activities are directed towards the welfare of people. Rodong News Team

title: Self-Reliance Is Banner of Struggle of Juche Korea
body: A dramatic change was brought about in the situation of the Korean peninsula last year thanks to the independent line and strategic decision of the Workers’ Party of Korea. The international community hoped that the positive atmosphere that is never something which has been created with ease in the Korean peninsula would lead to better one, but the hostile forces going against the trend of the times intensified the sanctions against the DPRK. The Korean people fought against the challenge of injustice with the might of the self-supporting national economy and in the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance. The great Workers’ Party of Korea set forth a new strategic line of concentrating all efforts on socialist economic construction at the historic April Plenary Meeting of its Central Committee, which proceeds from the lawful demands of the era and the developing revolution. All the people and service personnel of the People’s Army turned out in force to implement the new strategic line. Their creative and working energies brought about world-startling miracles at factories, enterprises and construction sites and on fields. The anachronistic sanctions by the hostile forces persisted in the whole of last year, but socialist construction opened one page of proud victories and entered a new stage. The credit for it is the great revolutionary spirit of self-reliance of the Korean people full of ardent zeal to remove a mountain and fill the sea according to the Party Central Committee’s plan and decision. Ri Hyo Jin

title: Mass Rallies Held
body: There took place mass rallies in Jagang and Kangwon provinces and Rason City on Monday and Tuesday to pledge to thoroughly implement the tasks set forth by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address. Present at the rallies were officials of local Party and power organs, working people's organizations, factories, enterprises, farms, universities and others, working people, youth and students. Reports and speeches were made there. Reporters and speakers stressed that the New Year Address made by the Supreme Leader is the militant banner that encourages the grand revolutionary advance of all the people who are vigorously moving forward along the road of development of Korean-style socialism. They called upon all the officials and working people to perform new miracles and feats in the on-going grand advance of self-reliance by giving full play to their ardent loyalty and great patriotic zeal. The reporters and speakers vowed to make death-defying efforts for the prosperity and development of the genuine people's country, the socialist motherland, in response to the patriotic appeal made by Kim Jong Un. At the end of the mass rallies, there took place mass demonstrations. Rodong News Team

title: Reparations from Japanese War Criminal Business Demanded
body: Civic organizations and lawyers of south Korea and Japan said that they would launch into a solidarity campaign to secure reparations from Japanese war criminal businesses, according to KBS of south Korea on January 5. Last year the south Korean Supreme Court gave a verdict that Japanese war criminal businesses should indemnify the Korean victims of forced conscript labor. But the Japanese government and war criminal businesses including the Mitsubishi Heavy Industries, Ltd. are denying the south Korean Supreme Court's judgment, saying "the issue concerned was completely and finally settled by the 1965 'south Korea-Japan agreement'" and "every possible step will be taken against the judgment" and terming it "unreasonable judgment that upsets the legal foundation of the friendly and cooperative relations." Worse still, the right-wing "Active Conservative Movement" and conservative gangsters in Japan are kicking up a fuss in the middle of Tokyo, waving the flags of "rising sun shedding rays", terming the judgment a "violation of international law" and crying out for "shielding the Japanese businesses." Civic organizations and lawyers of south Korea and Japan held a meeting in Nagoya City, Aichi Prefecture of Japan and decided to launch into a solidarity campaign after forming an organization for securing reparations from the Japanese war criminal businesses. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address Posted on Websites
body: The full text or gist of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's historic New Year Address was posted on websites of the Association for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism of Russia in the Far East Region, the Communist Party "Russian Communists", the Indonesia-Korea Association for Friendship and Cultural Exchange, the National Socialist Party of Romania, the Romanian National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea, the Romanian Workers' Association, the Socialist Workers' Party of Croatia, the Bulgarian Group for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, the Portugal-Korea Friendship Association, the Paektusan Czech-Korean Friendship Association, the Czech Group for the Study and Materialization of the Juche Idea, the German Group for the Study of Korean Culture, Guinean Agency of Press, Agence Congolaise d'Information, the Algeria-Korea Friendship Association, the Kim Jong Il Library of Ecuador, the Brazilian Committee for Solidarity with the DPRK and the Brazilian Center for the Study of Songun Politics and other websites like "Juche-Nepal" run by the Nepal Journalist Association for the Study of the Juche Idea and Songun Politics and "News of Field Guidance" by the Anti-Imperialist Forum of Germany between Jan. 1 and 3. Also posted on the websites were photos of Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Holidays in Dec. Marked Abroad
body: Celebrations were held abroad to mark the 27th anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's assumption of the supreme commandership of the Korean People's Army (KPA) and the 7th anniversary of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's assumption of the KPA supreme commandership. A symposium on Kim Jong Il's work was held in Bulgaria and a photo show in China and lecture and film show took place in Algeria on Dec. 28 and 29 last year. A Korean film about the DPRK demonstrating its prestige as a power all over the world was screened at the film show. At the symposium on Kim Jong Il's work "Respecting the Forerunners of the Revolution Is a Noble Moral Obligation of Revolutionaries" held by the Bulgarian Group for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, speakers said that the work elaborated on the stance and stand of the revolutionaries on their leader. They noted that socialism collapsed in some countries which had been building socialism and they could not avoid miserable fate, because they failed to preserve the idea and exploits of their leaders. They stressed that under the leadership of Kim Jong Un, the Korean people are holding President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in high esteem as the eternal leaders, thus clearly showing the world the noble traits the revolutionaries should have. The chairperson of the Algeria-Korea Friendship Association said it would have been unthinkable without the leadership of Supreme Commander Kim Jong Un that the Korean People's Army is demonstrating its might as the invincible revolutionary army recognized by the world, praising him as an ever-victorious commander possessed of seasoned commanding art, rare military qualifications and iron pluck and gut. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Printed in Russia
body: "Let Us Usher in a Golden Age of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth Movement", the speech delivered by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un at the Ninth Congress of the Kim Il Sung Socialist Youth League, was published in booklet by the Khabarovsk Territory Publishing House of Russia on Jan. 3. The work, published on Aug. 28, Juche 105 (2016), clarifies the idea that the 70 years-long history of the youth league is the history of brilliant victory of the great leaders' idea of valuing the youth and their guidance and that the Korean youth movement is the glorious Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist youth movement which was pioneered and developed by the great idea and guidance of the great leaders. It indicates the tasks and ways for developing the youth league into an eternal one of the great leaders. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Visits China
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and chairman of the State Affairs Commission (SAC) of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), visited the People's Republic of China (PRC) from January 7 to 10, Juche 108 (2019) at the invitation of Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC) and president of the PRC. Supreme Leader of the Party, state and army Kim Jong Un was accompanied by his wife Ri Sol Ju. Among his entourage were Ri Su Yong, Kim Yong Chol, Pak Thae Song, members of the Political Bureau and vice-chairmen of the C.C., WPK, Ri Yong Ho, member of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK and minister of Foreign Affairs, and No Kwang Chol, alternate member of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK and minister of the People's Armed Forces, Kim Yo Jong, alternate member of the Political Bureau and first vice department director of the C.C., WPK, Ri Il Hwan and Choe Tong Myong, department directors of the C.C., WPK, and other leading officials of the C.C., WPK and the SAC of the DPRK. The train carrying the Supreme Leader arrived in Dandong, border city of China, at 9.30 p.m. Beijing time on Jan. 7. Seen at Dandong Railway Station to greet Kim Jong Un were Song Tao, head of the International Liaison Department of the C.C., CPC, Chen Qiufa, secretary of the Liaoning Provincial Party Committee, Lu Dongfu, general manager of the China Railway Corporation, Li Jinjun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK, and Ge Haiying, secretary of the Dandong City Party Committee. Kim Jong Un got off the train together with his wife Ri Sol Ju and exchanged warm greetings with the leading officials of the Chinese side. Song Tao offered the greeting of the heartfelt and warm welcome to Kim Jong Un upon authorization of General Secretary Xi Jinping and the Central Committee of the CPC. Kim Jong Un and Ri Sol Ju were presented with bunches of flowers by women. Kim Jong Un had an amicable talk with Song Tao on the train. He expressed thanks to Song Tao for coming all the way to the border town, warmly welcoming him and according hospitality with sincerity, while guiding him to Beijing every time. Saying that attaching great importance and significance to Kim Jong Un's current visit to China at the special and vital time, Xi Jinping and the party and government of China made exceptional instructions to render good reception, Song Tao added that he would do his best for the satisfactory success of the meeting between the top leaders of the two parties and the two countries. Kim Jong Un arrived in Beijing at 11 a.m. Beijing time on Jan. 8. He was greeted at Beijing Railway Station by Wang Huning, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau and the Secretariat of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, and Cai Qi, member of the Political Bureau of the C.C., CPC and secretary of the Beijing Municipal Party Committee. DPRK Ambassador to China Ji Jae Ryong was also there to greet him. As Kim Jong Un and Ri Sol Ju got off the train, children presented them with bunches of flowers. Kim Jong Un exchanged warm greetings with senior party and government officials of China and headed for the Diaoyutai State Guesthouse. He met Xi Jinping at the Great Hall of the People at 5 p.m. on Jan. 8. Upon arrival at the Great Hall of the People, Kim Jong Un and Ri Sol Ju were warmly greeted by Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan. Being so pleased to meet again at the beginning of the New Year, Kim Jong Un and Xi Jinping gladly shook their hands with each other and had a souvenir photo taken. Warmly welcoming Kim Jong Un who started his external activity in the New Year by visiting China, Xi Jinping said the current visit will offer a specially important occasion in successfully guiding the development of the China-DPRK relations. Kim Jong Un expressed thanks to Xi Jinping for sparing time to detail the itinerary and pay deep attention despite his tight schedule at the beginning of the New Year. Kim Jong Un and Ri Sol Ju had a souvenir photo taken with Xi Jinping and Peng Liyuan with the flags of the two countries for a background. A ceremony for welcoming Kim Jong Un's visit to China was held grandly at the Great Hall of the People. The welcome ceremony was followed by talks between Kim Jong Un and Xi Jinping at the Great Hall of the People. Present there from the DPRK side were Ri Su Yong and Kim Yong Chol, members of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK and vice-chairmen of the WPK Central Committee, and Ri Yong Ho, member of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and minister of Foreign Affairs. Present there from the Chinese side were Wang Huning, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the CPC and member of the CPC Central Committee Secretariat, Ding Xuexiang, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, member of the Secretariat and director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee, Yang Jiechi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and director of the Office of the Foreign Affairs Commission of the CPC Central Committee, Wang Yi, state councilor and minister of Foreign Affairs of the PRC, and Song Tao, head of the International Liaison Department of the CPC Central Committee. Exchanging greetings with each other again in a comradely, sincere and friendly atmosphere, the top leaders of the two parties and two countries had an in-depth and candid exchange of views over the issue of further boosting the friendship and unity, exchange and cooperation between the two parties and the two countries as required by the times and over the international and regional issues of mutual concern, the joint study and coordination of the management of the situation of the Korean peninsula and the denuclearization negotiations, in particular, and expressed mutual understanding, support and solidarity to the independent stands preserved by the parties and governments of the two countries in the external relations. Expressing thanks to Xi Jinping and the friendly comrades of the Chinese party and government for warmly inviting him at the beginning of the New Year despite their busy schedule and enthusiastically according cordial hospitality to him with all sincerity, Kim Jong Un conveyed the best wishes from the Party and the government of the DPRK and all its people to them. Saying that his current visit would play a very important role in putting the DPRK-China friendship on a firmer stage and promoting it to more developed relations also this year of weighty significance marking the 70th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations in the wake of last year which was recorded as a year that opened a brilliant page in the history of the DPRK-China friendship and unity, Kim Jong Un said that his visit would also offer an occasion in strikingly demonstrating to the world the invariability and invincibility of the DPRK-China friendship. The DPRK-China friendship was forged and developed by the leaders of the elder generations of the two countries and is now further brilliantly developing under the special situation, he said, stressing that the WPK and the DPRK government will as ever act in unity with the Chinese side and make fresh efforts to continuously develop the friendly relations by inheriting the tradition of close cooperation between the two parties and the two countries. Noting that he was encouraged by the confident Chinese people keeping to the path of socialism with the Chinese characteristics in the new era and the reality of China developing with each passing day under the seasoned leadership of the CPC, Kim Jong Un expressed the firm belief that the Chinese party and people will achieve new successes and great victory in the efforts for creating a new miracle of the Chinese nation. Xi Jinping once again warmly welcomed Kim Jong Un's China visit on behalf of the Chinese party, government and people, saying that the visit at the outset of New Year 2019 is of very special and important significance in terms of time and shows importance attached to China-DPRK friendship and deep confidence in the Chinese party and people. In-depth exchanges of views with Kim Jong Un, close comrade and friend of the Chinese people, helped promote active exchanges and cooperation in different fields including party and culture, and also helped the friendly relations between the two parties and two countries gain historic development and promotion, Xi Jinping said. He said that last year Kim Jong Un put forward the new strategic line of concentrating all efforts on socialist economic construction and took several important measures by making bold and wise decision, thus showing the international community the hope and expectation of the DPRK loving peace and aspiring after development. This has commanded increased international influence, and also great support, understanding and warm welcome from the whole world, he added. This proves that Kim Jong Un's strategic decision was correct and it was in line with the Korean people's interests and the trend of the times, Xi Jinping said, highly praising the Workers' Party of Korea and government of the DPRK for registering admirable successes at home and abroad. He said that, as a comrade and friend, he is convinced that the WPK would achieve greater and fresh successes in accomplishing the socialist cause under the leadership of WPK led by Kim Jong Un, and expressed his best wishes with sincerity. Both sides had in-depth exchanges of views on international and regional matters of mutual concern. Both sides highly appreciated that the top leaders of the two countries brought about and promoted beneficial development of the situation on the Korean peninsula through close communications, open-hearted exchanges of views and tuning, thereby defending mutual interests. They unanimously agreed on continuously preserving the stand for final and peaceful settlement of the nuclear issue on the Korean peninsula to meet the interests of the international community and all sides around the peninsula by properly managing the situation on the peninsula that has entered an important and vital time. Kim Jong Un said that the DPRK remains unchanged in its main stand to keep the goal of the denuclearization of the Korean peninsula, sincerely implement the joint statement adopted at the Singapore DPRK-U.S. summit talks and seek negotiated peaceful solution, referring to the difficulties and concern arising in the course of the improvement of the DPRK-U.S. relations and the negotiations for the denuclearization and the prospects of resolving them. Xi Jinping said that he fully agreed that the principled issues suggested by the DPRK side are deserved requirements and its reasonable points of concern should be resolved properly, adding it is a correct choice for the parties concerned to prioritize and reasonably tackle them. He said that the Chinese side would as ever play a positive and constructive role for the defence of the fundamental interests of both sides and the stability of the situation on the peninsula as the reliable rear, resolute comrades and friends of the Korean comrades. The top leaders of the two parties and the two countries agreed on the new plans to maintain, expand and develop the traditions of high-level visits in political, economic, military, cultural and other fields in the new year marking the 70th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the two countries. Kim Jong Un invited Xi Jinping to make an official visit to the DPRK at a convenient time and the latter accepted the invitation with pleasure and informed Kim Jong Un of the plan. The talks proceeded in a warm, comradely and friendly atmosphere from beginning to end. Xi Jinping gave a grand banquet at the Great Hall of the People on the evening of Jan. 8 in welcome of the China visit by Kim Jong Un. Present there at invitation were Ri Su Yong, Kim Yong Chol, Pak Thae Song, members of the Political Bureau and vice-chairmen of the WPK Central Committee, Ri Yong Ho, member of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and minister of Foreign Affairs, No Kwang Chol, alternate member of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and minister of the People's Armed Forces, Kim Yo Jong, alternate member of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and first vice department director of the WPK Central Committee, Ri Il Hwan and Choe Tong Myong, department directors of the WPK Central Committee, and other leading officials and retinue accompanying Kim Jong Un. Also invited there were Ji Jae Ryong, DPRK ambassador to China, and his embassy members. Seen at the banquet were Wang Huning, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau and member of the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee, Ding Xuexiang, member of the Political Bureau, member of the Secretariat and director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee, Yang Jiechi, member of the Political Bureau and director of the Office of the Foreign Affairs Commission of the CPC Central Committee, Guo Shengkun, member of the Political Bureau, member of the Secretariat and secretary of the Political and Legal Affairs Committee of the CPC Central Committee, Huang Kunming, member of the Political Bureau, member of the Secretariat and head of the Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee, Cai Qi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and secretary of the Beijing Municipal Party Committee, Wang Yi, state councilor and minister of Foreign Affairs of PRC, Song Tao, head of the International Liaison Department of the CPC Central Committee, Li Jinjun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK, and other Chinese party and government officials. Kim Jong Un and Ri Sol Ju entered the banquet hall, being guided by Xi Jinping and Peng Liyuan. Xi Jinping made a congratulatory speech at the banquet. Saying that Kim Jong Un and Ri Sol Ju visited China again with deep friendly feeling of the Party, government and people of the DPRK toward the party, government and people of China in the auspicious and fine period greeting the new year to open up a historic prelude to the development of China-DPRK relations for this year, Xi Jinping warmly welcomed their China visit. He said Kim Jong Un's three China visits within 100 days last year and his visit to China at the beginning of the new year fully showed that he values much the traditional China-DPRK friendship and cherishes friendly feeling toward the Chinese people. Xi Jinping stressed that he would make efforts together with Kim Jong Un to write a new history of visits between China and the DPRK. Saying that this year marks the 70th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between China and the DPRK, he proudly noted that for the past seven decades the two parties, two countries and two peoples have advanced while supporting and encouraging each other and achieving great successes in socialist construction of the two countries after forging the lips-and-teeth relations. The China-DPRK relations have already opened a page of new history and entered a new stage of development, and the party and government of China have attached high importance to the traditional relations between China and the DPRK, he said, clarifying once again that it is the consistent and steadfast stand of the Chinese party and government to defend, consolidate and develop the China-DPRK relations on good terms. Saying that he was pleased to witness remarkable successes achieved by the WPK and the people of the DPRK in the socialist revolution and construction, he expressed his conviction that they would surely carry out the new strategic line set forth at the Third Plenary Meeting of the Seventh Central Committee of the WPK under the leadership of the WPK headed by Kim Jong Un and thus achieve signal successes by powerfully accelerating the cause of socialist construction in the DPRK. Kim Jong Un made a reply speech. He said that he visited China as his first political schedule for the new year with the firm will to gain overall prosperity of the DPRK-China friendship, as required by a new great history and brilliant era of the DPRK-China relations, greeting the new year after seeing out the last year full of epochal events unprecedented in the history of the development of the relations between the two parties and two countries. He expressed his profound thanks for the warm hospitality and deep attention of the party and government of China on his visit made at the beginning of the new year and extended heartfelt New Year greetings to Xi Jinping, all the members of the Communist Party of China and the Chinese people on behalf of the members of the Workers' Party of Korea and the Korean people. Saying that last year the meetings between the top leaders of the two parties and the two countries served as a firm foundation and a powerful engine to develop the relations between the DPRK and China as required by a new era, he expressed his will to go on writing a beautiful epic of the DPRK-China friendship to be envied by the world and handed down generation after generation by joining hands with comrades of China and firmly defend peace and stability on the Korean peninsula and the region by the concerted efforts of the DPRK and China this year, too. He sincerely wished the fraternal Chinese people endless success in the long journey for attaining the "Two Century Goals" and realizing the dream of China, i.e. great prosperity of the Chinese nation, united close around the CPC with Xi Jinping as the core this year marking the 70th anniversary of the birth of new China. The banquet proceeded in a warm atmosphere overflowing with the feelings of friendship and fellowship. A special art performance was given by the Chinese artistes in honor of the historic visit of Kim Jong Un to China at the banquet. Kim Jong Un and Ri Sol Ju mounted the stage with Xi Jinping and Peng Liyuan to express their thanks to the performers and had a photo session with them. Kim Jong Un and Xi Jinping met again at Beijing Hotel on Wednesday. Xi Jinping and Peng Liyuan warmly greeted Kim Jong Un and Ri Sol Ju as they got to the hotel. Kim Jong Un had a candid conversation with Xi Jinping, further deepening special comradeship and close relations. Having a luncheon provided by Xi Jinping and Peng Liyuan, Kim Jong Un and Ri Sol Ju had a pleasant chat in an amicable and familiar atmosphere. Kim Jong Un expressed his deep thanks to Xi Jinping for sincerely hosting the luncheon once again at a special place in a special atmosphere. At the end of the luncheon Kim Jong Un shared farewell greeting with Xi Jinping. Kim Jong Un expressed satisfaction over making a fine and worthwhile visit without any inconvenience thanks to the special care and hospitality given by Xi Jinping, before thanking him. Kim Jong Un and Ri Sol Ju said goodbye to Xi Jinping and Peng Liyuan, promising to have another meeting. Kim Jong Un visited a branch pharmaceutical plant of the Beijing Tongrentang Co. Ltd. together with accompanying officials and entourage that morning. Accompanying him were Wang Huning, Cai Qi, Song Tao and Li Jinjun. He was warmly greeted by the board director of the Beijing Tongrentang Co. Ltd. who is also its party secretary, the general manager of the company who is also its vice-secretary and leading officials of the plant. Kim Jong Un watched the goods in production, while looking round the production processes at the plant. Touring the production site, he highly appreciated that the plant has undergone a good development by registering many achievements in production and technical upgrading through enterprising and determined efforts, and wished it bigger successes in its business management in the future. Kim Jong Un successfully finished his historic visit to China and left Beijing at 3:00 p.m. Beijing time on Wednesday. He received a good sendoff from Wang Huning, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and member of the CPC Central Committee Secretariat, and Cai Qi, member of the Political Bureau of the C.C., CPC and secretary of the Beijing Municipal Committee of the CPC, at Beijing Railway Station and Song Tao, head of the International Liaison Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, Lu Dongfu, general manager of the China Railway Corporation, and Li Jinjun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK, traveled together with him to Dandong Railway Station to see him off. Before leaving Dandong Railway Station, Kim Jong Un sent a personal letter of thanks to Xi Jinping for his splendid and warm welcome, sincere and good hospitality during the visit. Political News Team

title: Nepalese Figures Visit DPRK Embassy
body: Nepalese Lawmaker Sash Shrestha, Ex-Deputy Prime Minister C. P. Mainali who is general secretary of the Nepal Communist Party (Marxist-Leninist), Chairman of the Nepal Journalist Association for the Study of the Juche Idea and Songun Politics Manju Ratna Sakya and other personages of the government, political parties and organizations of Nepal paid congratulatory visits to the DPRK embassy in Nepal on Dec. 28 last year on the occasion of the seventh anniversary of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's assumption of the supreme commandership of the Korean People's Army and the New Year 2019. The visitors laid floral baskets and bouquets before the artworks picturing President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and paid respect. Sash Shrestha said that the Nepalese people were pleased to see the Korean people having won great victory and the strategic position of the DPRK radically promoted in the international arena under the wise guidance of Kim Jong Un. After upholding the great leaders, the Korean people have been able to make great successes, Sash Shrestha said, adding that the Nepalese people extend invariable support and solidarity to the just cause of the Korean people and will always side with them in the anti-imperialist struggle. C. P. Mainali appreciated that the relations between the north and south of Korea have been improved and global peace and security reliably guaranteed thanks to Kim Jong Un's noble love for the nation and his will to protect peace, and wished him good health in the new year and greater success in his noble work for peace of the Korean peninsula and the rest of the world. Rodong News Team

title: Japanese Reactionaries’ Moves for Overseas Expansion
body: Of late, the Japan Maritime “Self-Defense Force” conducted joint military drill with naval forces of the U.S. and the UK in the Pacific south of Honshu Island. At a Cabinet ministers meeting earlier, the Japanese reactionaries adopted a defense program and a midterm defense capability buildup outline to be executed for the five years to come and decided to lavish an astronomical amount of money on carrying them out. Such foolhardy move of the Japanese reactionaries is a revelation of their dirty design to realize their wild ambition for overseas expansion at any cost with the backing of their master. Japan is constitutionally banned from exercising the right of belligerency. Such a nation is now working hard to turn itself into a military giant after securing the military muscle strong enough to rank among big powers. This is aimed to turn the time back to the first half of the last century when the Japanese imperialists put the Asia-Pacific under their control. However, the wild ambition of the Japanese reactionaries to realize the old dream of the “Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere” can never come true. Ra Myong Song

title: Capitalist Society Has No Future
body: The imperialists and their mouthpieces advertise “economic prosperity”, “democracy” and “civilization” of the West, making a case for real prosperity and progress under capitalism. Capitalism seems to be prosperous outwardly, but is being rotten due to its daily-worsening intrinsic contradictions. In capitalist countries, “economic prosperity” does not rid people of worries about material life but the reverse is the truth. “Democracy” in the capitalist society is an anti-popular dictatorial politics for the rich and a tiny handful of the privileged circle. Politicians of capitalist countries describe the West’s multi-party system and parliamentary system as the most advanced and ideal democratic political mode. However, actual power over politics is seized by giga-monopolists. There can be no genuine democratic politics in the capitalist society where the giga-monopolists and their servants dominate everything. Lamentable is the civilization hyped by the West. The civilization of the West fails to bring up people to be independent human being, but makes them slaves of money. The capitalist society is mainly characterized by deformed material life, poor mental and cultural life and reactionary political life indicative of its anti-popular nature and corruption. The capitalist society is, indeed, the decadent and ailing one without future which is on the verge of ruin. Ri Hak Nam

title: Election of Deputies to SPA to Be Called in DPRK
body: The Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly (SPA) of the DPRK decided to call an election of deputies to the 14th SPA on March 10, Juche 108 (2019), according to Article 90 of the Socialist Constitution of the DPRK. The decision was made public on Tuesday. Rodong News Team

title: Winter Camping Begins at Songdowon Int'l Children's Camp
body: The first batch of winter campers began camping with due ceremony at the Songdowon International Children's Camp on Wednesday. The campers laid a floral basket and bouquets before the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il at the camp and paid tribute to them. Present at the ceremony were Pak Chol Min, first secretary of the Central Committee of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League, Sin Jong Nam, vice-chairman of the Kangwon Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials concerned, officials and teaching staff of the Camp and campers. The campers will enjoy skiing, skating, sleighing, etc. at the Masikryong Ski Resort. Rodong News Team

title: Schoolchildren's New Year Performance Continues
body: The New Year performance of schoolchildren "Blessed Snow Falls on New Year's Day" for Juche 108 (2019) continues at the Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace. Staged were female solo "Father's Way to Front", song and dance "Our Classmates", etc. The performers sonorously sang songs of the profound gratitude for President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il who used to find themselves among schoolchildren wishing them a rosy future and spared nothing for the younger generation. They vividly represented the sunny looks of schoolchildren who are preparing themselves to be pillars of socialist Korea under the loving care of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Working people, youth and students here enjoyed the performance. Rodong News Team

title: Young People Meet
body: A meeting of young people to vow to thoroughly carry out the tasks set forth by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address was held at the plaza of the Monument to Party Founding on Wednesday. Present there were Choe Hwi, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials concerned, officials of the youth league, youth and students. Pak Chol Min, first secretary of the Central Committee of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League, made a report to be followed by speeches. The reporter and speakers said that Kim Jong Un's New Year Address is an inspiring banner and goal of life and struggle as it gives tremendous strength and courage to 5 million young vanguard who turned out in the gigantic general advance this year. They noted that all the youth should become vanguard and shock-brigaders in the drive for opening up a new road of advance for socialist construction under the uplifted banner of self-reliance with the immutable faith that they would surely emerge victorious in their struggle as they are led by the Supreme Leader. They stressed they would become pioneers of new technology, creators of new culture and pathfinders for a great leap forward in the present stirring era and that they would make sure that the vigor and stamina of young people heartily responding to the call of the Party pervade wherever they work. Rodong News Team

title: Members of Working People's Organizations Meet
