body: The working people's organizations held meetings on Wednesday to pledge to thoroughly implement the tasks set forth by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address. Attending the meetings were Choe Hwi, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials concerned, officials of the trade union, agricultural workers' union and women's union, workers, members of the trade union, farmers and members of the agricultural workers' union and the women's union. Reports and speeches were made there. Reporters and speakers said that they are full of firm determination to make a hot emulation for a great innovation and leap in the general advance this year while regarding Kim Jong Un's New Year Address as the goal of their life and struggle. They expressed the will to wage a more vigorous struggle for increased production, so as to attain the goal of grain production this year by holding fast to self-reliance as a treasured sword for prosperity. They called upon all the people to throw in their lot with the Party, cherish the principle of our state first as an element of their faith and devoted themselves to the prosperity of the country no matter how the situation and circumstances may change. Rodong News Team

title: New Year Address Is Important Guidelines for Chongryon: Vice-Chairman of Its Central Standing Committee
body: Vice-Chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) Nam Sung U in a statement vowed to turn out in the drive for implementing the tasks for national reunification set forth by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in his historic New Year Address. All the Chongryon officials and Koreans in Japan are full of great excitement and confidence in the bright future of the nation, upon receiving the historic New Year Address which clarified the bright way for peace, prosperity and reunification, the statement said, and went on: The New Year Address full of noble patriotic intention, transparent idea of national independence and strong will for reunification serves as important guidelines to be held fast to not only by the people in the homeland but also by Chongryon in the nationwide struggle for reunification this year. It said that Chongryon and the Koreans in Japan would join all other Koreans in the gigantic advance for reunification under the slogan "Let us usher in a heyday of peace, prosperity and reunification of the Korean peninsula by thoroughly implementing the historic north-south declarations!" We will play a pioneer role in rallying the overseas forces for reunification with confidence that when all the Koreans pool intention and efforts, they can certainly open up a wide avenue to national prosperity and make tangible contribution to strengthening solidarity and unity among the Koreans in the north and the south and abroad and to boosting the atmosphere for reunification. Chongryon and Koreans in Japan who have devoted their all to the realization of national reunification, the cherished desire of the nation, true to the behests of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il will discharge the honorable mission and duty in the struggle for opening up the heyday of peace, prosperity and reunification under the guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: Holiday of Cuba Observed
body: A meeting took place at the Taedonggang Diplomatic Club on Thursday to mark the 60th anniversary of the victorious Cuban revolution. Present there at invitation were Jesus De Los Angeles Aise Sotolongo, Cuban ambassador to the DPRK, and staff members of his embassy. Present there also were Kim Sung Du, chairman of the Education Commission who is chairman of the Korean Committee for Solidarity with Cuba, So Ho Won, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries, and other members of the Korean Committee for Solidarity with Cuba and working people in Pyongyang. Kim Sung Du said in his speech at the meeting that it was the fixed stand of the Workers' Party of Korea and the government of the DPRK to boost the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation with the Cuban people, which have been consolidated down through centuries and generations, as required by the new era. He confirmed that the DPRK would always make all efforts for invariably carrying forward the baton of fraternal and friendly relations with the Cuban people, which were provided by the preceding leaders of the two countries. Jesus De Los Angeles Aise Sotolongo said that the unbreakable unity between the DPRK and Cuba have been consolidated invariably under the wise leadership of Raul Castro Ruz, first secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba, Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez, president of the Council of State and president of the Council of Ministers of the Republic of Cuba, and Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea. He expressed his stand to make a positive effort for boosting cooperation and exchange between the two countries in the common struggle for socialism. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Returns Home
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, returned home after successfully wrapping up his historic China visit. His train arrived at Pyongyang Railway Station at 3 pm Thursday when the whole country is pervaded with the humble reverence for Kim Jong Un who is remarkably raising the international position and dignity of Juche Korea through his energetic and brisk external activity from the beginning of the new year to defend peace and stability on the Korean peninsula and boost the traditional friendship and solidarity between the peoples of the DPRK and China as required by the new era. Kim Jong Un was greeted by leading officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs. The leading officials wholeheartedly extended the warmest congratulations to Kim Jong Un on having come back home in good health after achieving good successes in his historic visit to China, reflecting the unanimous desire of all the people. The Supreme Leader shook hands with the leading officials and extended warm greetings to all the beloved people of the country. Political News Team

title: Nepalese President Confirms Development of Friendly Relations with DPRK
body: DPRK ambassador to Nepal Jo Yong Man presented his credentials to Bidya Devi Bhandari, president of the Federal Democratic Republic of Nepal, on Monday. The president said that Nepal and the DPRK have maintained the long-standing friendly relations. Noting that invariable is the friendly feeling of the Nepalese people toward the Korean people, the president said the government of Nepal sincerely hopes that a durable peaceful climate will be created and prosperity provided in the Korean peninsula. He stressed that the Nepalese government would fully support the struggle of the government and people of the DPRK for ensuring peace and stability in the Korean peninsula in the international arenas. Confirming that he would make efforts to further develop the bilateral friendly relations, the president wholeheartedly wished Supreme Leader of the DPRK Kim Jong Un good health and happiness and great success in his noble work for leading the Korean people's struggle to achieve peace, stability and development on the Korean peninsula. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address Supported by Foreign Figure
body: Andre Lohekele Kalonda, secretary general of the African Regional Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea, issued a statement on Jan. 3 in support of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address. The statement said that the Supreme Leader in his New Year Address reviewed the proud successes registered by the Korean people last year and set forth the militant tasks for this year. It stated that thanks to Kim Jong Un's bold decision and energetic activities, remarkable events were witnessed in ensuring peace and stability in the Korean peninsula and the rest of the world and amazing progress was made in the Korean people's socialist construction last year. Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address called for further accelerating the nationwide advance for implementing the north-south declarations, and thus glorifying this year as a historic one when another radical change is brought about in the development of inter-Korean relations and implementation of the cause of national reunification, the statement stressed. It expressed full support to the New Year Address of Kim Jong Un illuminating the way of developing the inter-Korean relations and reunifying the country. It called on the international community to join with the Korean people in their peace-loving efforts. It extended firm solidarity to the Korean people in their struggle, expressing the belief that they would make bigger success in the economic construction and accomplishment of the cause of national reunification by their own efforts under the guidance of Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: Tideland Developed Briskly
body: In hearty response to the New Year Address of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un the managerial staff and developers of the North Phyongan Provincial General Tideland Reclamation Enterprise enthusiastically develop the tideland round the Honggon Island for the second stage from the beginning of 2019. They blew up mountains in the Sinmi Island and the Taesamgot Island respectively on January 6 despite the rigors of winter and produced 50,000 tons of earth and rock. They then proceed to shore up Bank 1 and build Bank 2 for the first stage. Thanks to their indomitable fortitude and untiring devotion, success after success is won in developing the tideland round the Honggon Island for the second stage. Song Chang Yun

title: DPRK Will Emerge Victorious By Dint of Self-reliance
body: Self-reliance is a powerful source that enables the Korean people to have advanced with a firm grip on their own destiny in the face of all sorts of storm and challenge of history. During the arduous anti-Japanese war, the Korean revolutionaries mowed down the enemies with Yanji bomb made with their own efforts and liberated the country by defeating the gangster-like Japanese imperialists through nationwide resistance. After the victorious three year-long Fatherland Liberation War, the Korean people turned out in the post-war rehabilitation and construction to heal war wounds and usher in the era of Chollima. They laid firm foundation for self-supporting national economy by working such miracles of history as completing socialist industrialization in a matter of 14 years. Even in the period of the Arduous March, forced march, they defended Korean-style socialism with their own faith and opened up a broad avenue to prosperity. Self-reliance serves as a great power that makes it possible to safeguard the country and save the nation under the present situation in which the imperialists are getting evermore undisguised in their moves for domination. No matter what happens in the world, the Korean people will advance and emerge honorably victorious in reliance upon self-reliance. Ri Chol Hyok

title: Meetings to Vow to Implement Tasks Set Forth in New Year Address Held
body: Meetings to vow to thoroughly carry out the tasks set forth by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address were held at units in the field of science and education and in major industrial sectors of the national economy. Reports and speeches were made at the meetings. Reporters and speakers said that Kim Jong Un's New Year Address is a militant banner helping to open up bright prospects for taking a step forward in socialist construction by expanding the capability of independent development of the country. They noted that the Supreme Leader proudly reviewed 2018 in which the Korean people turned out, believing in their own strength, to achieve greater development despite fierce economic blockade and sanctions and comprehensively indicated the tasks and ways for struggle to bring about a revolutionary upsurge on all fronts of socialist construction this year. They called upon all the officials, Party members and working people to successively attain the strategic goals for the development of national economy with an indefatigable spirit of self-reliance by adhering to the new strategic line of the Workers' Party of Korea. Rodong News Team

title: Reception Given for Art Troupe of Korean Schoolchildren in Japan
body: A reception was given at the People's Palace of Culture in honor of an art troupe of Korean schoolchildren in Japan on Friday under the care of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. The troupe took part in the New Year performance of schoolchildren for Juche 108 (2019). Present there on invitation was the art troupe of Korean schoolchildren in Japan headed by Ri Sang Won, principal of Korean primary and middle school in Seibang. Attending there were officials concerned including Kim Yong Chol, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Kim Yong Chol said in his speech at the reception that Kim Jong Un showed loving care for Korean schoolchildren in Japan, valuing them as reliable successors of the patriotic cause. He noted that through the New Year performance members of the art troupe impressively represented their resolution of loyalty to carry forward national education. He expressed belief that Korean schoolchildren in Japan would firmly believe in and follow Kim Jong Un only and grow to be true sons and daughters of Juche Korea, patriotic talents equipped with knowledge, a good moral character and good health. Head of the art troupe Ri Sang Won said that the personality of Kim Jong Un as the peerlessly great man and the stirring reality of the homeland they saw during the stay hardened the conviction that bright is the future of Kim Il Sung's and Kim Jong Il's Korea. He said that Korean schoolchildren in Japan would prepare themselves as reliable successors of the movement of Koreans in Japan and pillars of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan true to the noble intention of Kim Jong Un in any adversity. There was a joint performance given by schoolchildren in Pyongyang and the members of the art troupe of Korean schoolchildren in Japan at the reception. Rodong News Team

title: First Friday Labor of Officials Conducted in DPRK
body: Officials of ministries and national institutions did this year's first Friday labor at farms in Pyongyang on January 11. The ministries and national institutions sincerely prepared good-quality compost and lots of small farm implements and materials for farming. The officials left Kim Il Sung Square for the Mangyongdae Vegetable Farm and Wollo Vegetable Farm in Mangyongdae District and a feedstuff farm. The officials spread compost at the farms. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Visit to Russian Church Marked
body: A monument was erected at St. Bishop Innokenty of Irkutsk Church toured by Chairman Kim Jong Il during his visit to the Far Eastern region of the Russian Federation. An unveiling ceremony took place on December 30 last year. Present there on invitation were Russian figures of various circles, men of the press, citizens of Khabarovsk and staff members of the DPRK mission to Khabarovsk. The monument was unveiled with the tolling of a bell and bouquets were laid before it. Nikolai, bishop of the church, said in his congratulatory speech that he was much pleased to erect the monument in the church toured by Kim Jong Il. He added that Kim Jong Il is the leader of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea with excellent caliber, stressing that he will be remembered forever as he paid attention and respect to the culture and traditions of the Russian people. Rodong News Team

title: Gift to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Myanmar Figure
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a gift from the president of the Minglar Dragon Group of Myanmar on the occasion of the New Year Juche 108 (2019). The gift was conveyed by President Su Tin to the DPRK ambassador to Myanmar on Jan. 7. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Un's New Year Address Supported by Figure of Int'l Body
body: Kenichi Ogami, secretary general of the International Institute of the Juche Idea, made public a statement in support of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address. He said that Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address reviewed the successes made last year, set forth the tasks for socialist construction in the Democratic People's Republic of Korea this year and clearly indicated the ways for ensuring lasting and durable peace on the Korean peninsula and improving the DPRK-U.S. relations. Noting that he was deeply impressed by the firm faith of Kim Jong Un to accomplish the revolutionary cause of Juche without fail and his warm love for and trust in the people, he went on: Chairman Kim Jong Un advanced the slogan "Let us open a new road of advance for socialist construction under the uplifted banner of self-reliance!" and said that the DPRK should rely on its own technical forces and resources and the high creative spirit and revolutionary enthusiasm of all the people so as to succeed in attaining the strategic goals of national economic development and enter a new stage of growth. His New Year Address calling for greater strides in the struggle to boost inter-Korean relations, achieve peace and prosperity and reunify the country in the New Year 2019 reflects his will to make the Korean people, who have suffered from national division for a long period, reunify the country by their own efforts and lead a happy life. Chairman Kim Jong Un expressed the will to make positive efforts to usher in an era of peace and cooperation desired by the world. The future of Korea is rosy thanks to Chairman Kim Jong Un, who bravely overcomes any difficulties. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address Supported by Belarusian Figures
body: Belarusian figures supported Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address. L. Shukolinikov, chairman of the Permanent Standing Committee of the Belarus National Association of Friends of Korean People Named after Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il, Vassily Delikov, chairman of the Belarus Association for the Study of Juche Idea, and Drako, chairman of the Organizational Committee of the Communist Workers' Party of Belarus, said in their joint statement on Jan. 5 that they are pleased to see the Korean people confidently moving forward towards the country's prosperity and reunification and durable peace on the Korean peninsula. The joint statement noted the Korean people under the guidance of Kim Jong Un are registering big successes in the campaign for implementing the behests of the great leaders President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. It added that the DPRK's stance on foreign policy clarified by Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address instills fresh hope into the peace-loving progressives of the world, and expressed full support for his address. Rodong News Team

title: SPA Presidium Organizes Central Election Committee
body: The Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly (SPA) of the DPRK organized the central election committee for the election of deputies to the 14th SPA. The chairman of the committee is Yang Hyong Sop, vice-chairman is Kim Phyong Hae, and secretary general is Jong Yong Guk, and members are Choe Pu Il, Kim Yong Dae, Kim Yong Ho, Pak Chol Min, Ju Yong Gil, Kim Chang Yop, Jang Chun Sil, Ri Tu Song, Pak Myong Chol and Ryo Jong Son. The decision of the SPA Presidium on it was released on Jan. 11. Rodong News Team

title: Congratulations to President-elect of Madagascar
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, on Saturday sent a congratulatory message to Andry Nirina Rajoelina upon his election as president of the Republic of Madagascar. The message expressed the belief that the traditional relations of friendship between the two countries will be boosted, sincerely wishing him good health and success in his responsible work for the development and prosperity of the country and its people's wellbeing. Rodong News Team

title: Meetings Held to Vow to Implement Tasks Set Forth in New Year Address
body: Meetings to vow to carry through the tasks set forth by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address were held at units in the fields of agriculture, fishery, light industry, construction, land management, literature and art, public health and sports. Reports and speeches were made there. Reporters and speakers said that Kim Jong Un's historic New Year Address was an inspiring banner as it gives confidence in bright future of socialist Korea and the revolutionary self-confidence to all the people who turned out as one in the march in the new year. They called upon all the people to perform heroic feats in the grand revolutionary march for building a prosperous country, noting that last year's proud struggle hardened the conviction that the ideology, strength and way of the DPRK are the best and no force can check the sacred cause of the DPRK advancing to accomplish a far-reaching ideal and goal. They expressed their resolution to push ahead with the all-out drive for attaining the goals of the five-year strategy for national economic development, holding high the slogan "Let us open a new road of advance for socialist construction under the uplifted banner of self-reliance!" Rodong News Team

title: Epochal Turn in Accomplishing Cause of National Reunification Called for
body: Ri Tong Je, chairman of the Association of Koreans in Japan for Peaceful Reunification, issued on January 10 a statement in which he vowed to work hard to carry out the tasks for national reunification set forth by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in his historic New Year Address. The statement said that Kim Jong Un called upon the entire nation to hold high the slogan "Let us usher in a heyday of peace, prosperity and reunification of the Korean peninsula by thoroughly implementing the historic north-south declarations!", noting that greater strides should be made in the struggle for the development of north-south relations and peace, prosperity and national reunification in the New Year 2019. It said that only when the entire nation holds high the slogan set forth by Kim Jong Un, can they register signal successes in the campaign for the development of inter-Korean relations, peace, prosperity and national reunification. It called for positively conducting diverse political propaganda activities to ensure durable peace on the Korean peninsula. The statement expressed a resolution to take the lead with the attitude, stand and awareness of being responsible for glorifying this significant year as a year witnessing an epoch-making turn in the development of the north-south relations and the accomplishment of the cause of national reunification. Rodong News Team

title: Opening of Broad Avenue to Independent Reunification, Peace and Prosperity Called for
body: Cha Sang Bo, vice-chairman of the General Association of Koreans in China, issued a statement under the title of "We will make an active contribution to the development of the north-south relations and the accomplishment of the cause of national reunification true to the intention of the peerlessly great man" on January 3. The statement said upon receiving the New Year Address for 2019 reflecting Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's patriotic appeal and firm resolution for reunification, the General Association of Koreans in China and all Koreans in China are full of resolution to make a positive contribution to thoroughly implementing tasks set forth by Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address and ushering in a heyday of independent reunification. The statement noted that the tasks for Korea's reunification set forth by Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address serve as the most just and practical measures for thoroughly implementing the north-south declarations and providing a radical turn in the improvement of north-south relations and the accomplishment of the cause of national reunification this year. It said that though difficulties still lie in the way of national reunification, bright future is in store for the nation and the cause of reunification of the country is sure to be accomplished as it is led by Kim Jong Un, the destiny of the nation and the lodestar of national reunification. The statement called for opening up a broad avenue to independent reunification, peace and prosperity by dint of concerted effort of the nation on the basis of the firm stand of national independence under the banner of the historic Panmunjom Declaration and the September Pyongyang Joint Declaration, undeterred by any foreign interference and adversity. It said that officials of the association and all other Koreans in China would make an active contribution to glorifying this year as a historic one, in which one more radical turn is to be made in the development of the north-south relations and the accomplishment of the cause of national reunification, true to Kim Jong Un's patriotic appeal. Rodong News Team

title: Group Running of Government Employees in DPRK
body: A group running by officials of commissions, ministries and national institutions in the DPRK took place on Sunday, the first sports day of the new year. Kim Il Sung Square was crowded with government employees. After Ju Yong Gil, chairman of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea, made a speech, the officials began running, divided into two groups. Officials of the State Planning Commission, the Ministry of Electric Power Industry, the Ministry of Coal Industry, the Ministry of Metallurgical Industry, the Ministry of Chemical Industry, the Ministry of Machine-building Industry, the Ministry of Agriculture, the Ministry of Fisheries and the Ministry of Light Industry ran through the streets, with zeal to fulfill their responsibilities and duties as the leading personnel of the revolution. In the wake of group running, there were demonstrations of the Taekwon-Do exercise for health and mass rhythmic exercise. Meanwhile, diverse sports events such as basketball, volleyball and table-tennis were held at industrial establishments in Pyongyang, including Kim Jong Suk Pyongyang Textile Mill, the Pyongyang Thermal Power Complex and the Pyongyang Trolley Bus Factory. Mass sports activities including group running of officials, working people and youth and schoolchildren took place in every province, city and county to mark the day. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Congratulatory Letter from General Association of Koreans in China
body: The General Association of Koreans in China presented a congratulatory letter to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un on Jan. 10 upon hearing the news that he visited the People's Republic of China early in the New Year. The letter said that the officials of the Association and all the Koreans in China sincerely extended the warmest thanks and made a deep bow of gratitude to Kim Jong Un who made a historic visit to China early in the New Year to turn the situation on the Korean peninsula and the international political situation in favor of the Korean revolution and performed undying exploits for global independence, thus giving the Korean nationals in China and all the Koreans boundless national pride and honor. Kim Jong Un expressed his fixed will to firmly protect peace and stability in the Korean peninsula and the region with the concerted efforts of the DPRK and China during the visit to China, said the letter. The letter said that they would keep pace with the steps of patriotic devotion of Kim Jong Un who has put his heart and soul into the work for the people's happiness by making a foreign tour at the start of his revolutionary activities in 2019 and build the Association into the Juche-oriented overseas compatriots' organization with the strong Juche character and national identity and add eternal luster to the traditional DPRK-China relations of friendship boosted by him. The letter expressed the resolution to more dynamically do the patriotic work for the independent and peaceful reunification of the country and the building of a powerful socialist nation true to the patriotic call of Kim Jong Un, who called upon the whole nation to usher in a heyday of peace, prosperity and reunification on the Korean peninsula by thoroughly implementing the historic north-south declarations. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address Supported Abroad
body: Political parties and organizations of different countries issued statements in support of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address from Jan. 2 to 6. The Socialist Workers' Party of Croatia said that Kim Jong Un's New Year Address indicates tasks and ways for stepping up socialist construction and the stand of the Workers' Party of Korea and the DPRK government on the development of inter-Korean relations and international relations. It noted that his New Year Address is an immortal banner to be upheld for protecting the country's sovereignty and dignity, building a powerful socialist country and ensuring durable peace and security on the Korean peninsula. It expressed full support for the New Year Address made by Kim Jong Un. The Central Committee of the Lenin Young Communist League of the Russian Federation hoped that the Workers' Party of Korea and the Korean people will gain great success by bringing about a revolutionary upswing on all fronts of socialist construction this year. It went on: We are convinced that bigger strides would be made in the struggle of the Korean people for national reunification, the long-cherished desire of the nation. We will fully support the Korean people's struggle in the future, too. The Congolese Association for Friendship among Peoples noted that self-reliance has served as a banner of struggle and driving force for a leap forward in the course of development of socialist Korea and extended firm solidarity to the Korean people's struggle for demonstrating the country's dignity before the world by their own efforts. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address Studied in Romania, Switzerland
body: Seminars on Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address took place in Romania and Switzerland on Jan. 4 and 5. Personages of different social standings and masses of those countries attended the seminars. Vasile Orleanu, chairman of the Supreme Council of the National Socialist Party of Romania and chairman of the Romanian National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea, said that foreign media's broad reports on Kim Jong Un's New Year Address every day clearly prove his high prestige as the leader steering the international political situation. He noted the New Year Address reflects the steadfast will of the Workers' Party of Korea and the government of the DPRK to provide its people with more abundant and civilized life. He expressed full support for Kim Jong Un's New Year Address, referring to the tasks for improvement of the inter-Korean relations and accomplishment of the cause of national reunification and the stance of the WPK and the DPRK government on the DPRK-U.S. relations clarified by him in his New Year Address. A reporter and speakers including Martin Lotscher, chairman of the Switzerland-Korea Committee and chief of the Swiss Group for the Study of the Juche Idea, said that HE Kim Jong Un's New Year Address is an immortal programme indicating the way for bringing about a revolutionary upsurge in the socialist construction of the DPRK and a militant banner giving firm confidence in the victory of the socialist cause and optimism to the progressives. They expressed their will to wage more dynamic activities for solidarity with the just cause of the Korean people this year, too. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address Introduced in Bulgaria
body: The Bulgaria-Korea Friendship Association carried the detailed gist of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address for Juche 108 (2019) in its bulletin. Rodong News Team

title: Sinsollo, Super Dish of Korea
body: Sinsollo is a dish peculiar to the Korean nation. It belongs to the best dishes of the world. Originally, Sinsollo was the name of a pot in which a variety of food materials were cooked together. They tasted exceptionally delicious so the name itself finally turned to that of the dish. It has been so called since. More than 20 choice food materials are used in cooking Sinsollo. They include sea cucumbers, shrimps and other fresh seafood which abound in Korean seas. Pleasant to the palate and good to the eye, Sinsollo is distinguished as an excellent dish of Korea. Yun Un Sim

title: Benefit of Mineral Water Therapy
body: It is not long since mineral water therapy started at the mineral water bathroom of the Kangso Mineral Water Factory. The relevant pavilion has on its ground floor swell general bathrooms with wet and dry saunas, hot bathrooms and infirmaries with a holding capacity of more than 30 patients each. Prior to their mineral water therapy patients have their blood pressure and pulse taken. The temperature of mineral water and the length of therapy are accordingly prescribed for each of them. Patients warm up in the general bathrooms first and then proceed to take the baths each separately in the hot bathrooms as prescribed. They also use different bathtubs apiece in infirmaries for therapeutic purposes. Mineral water therapy is efficacious against dyspepsia, obesity, etc. Taking the baths and drinking the waters helps cure some diseases rather effectively. After undergoing mineral water therapy patients get their blood pressure and pulse taken again and are informed of what effect it has on them. The period of therapy is prescribed for them. All they should do is plan their ensuing therapy. The pavilion has an exercise room, superb bedrooms, etc on its first floor. Patients can use various sporting equipment at the exercise room to take necessary exercises. In case mineral water therapy takes them several days they can stay in the bedrooms. Permeated with the love of the peerlessly great men for the people, the Kangso mineral water will go very far toward protecting and promoting their health. Ji Hyok Chol

title: Korean Nation Should Implement Inter-Korean Declarations by Concerted Efforts
body: The Panmunjom Declaration and the September Pyongyang Joint Declaration are ones for national independence, unity, peace and reunification, through which the north and the south promised to pave the destiny of the Korean nation by pooling their intention and efforts. The declarations indicate in detail the practical measures and ways for the removal of the north-south hostility, multi-faceted cooperation and exchange and the turning of the Korean Peninsula into the true home of the nation, which is the most peaceful and will prosper forever. All the members of the Korean nation hoping the development of the inter-Korean relations and peace on the Korean Peninsula should turn out as one for the support and implementation of the Panmunjom Declaration and the September Pyongyang Joint Declaration irrespective of difference in ideology, idea, political view and system. The north and the south should firmly join hands and pave a broad avenue for the prosperity of the nation, frustrating all sorts of external obstacles by the concerted efforts of the fellow countrymen. The victory of the national reunification movement lies in the concerted efforts of the Korean nation. Everywhere the Korean fellow countrymen live, the strong sentiments should be shown to support and defend the Panmunjom Declaration and the September Pyongyang Joint Declaration and colorful activities in their forms should be briskly waged to demand the implementation of the declarations. All the fellow countrymen in north, south and overseas should struggle in high spirits holding high the slogan “Let us usher in a heyday of peace, prosperity and reunification of the Korean peninsula by thoroughly implementing the historic north-south declarations!” to bring about a radical change in carrying out the national reunification. Ra Sol Ha

title: Editorial
body: Victory and Glory for Worker-Peasant Red Guards Jan. 14 is the 60th anniversary of the founding of the Worker-Peasant Red Guards. Thanks to its foundation on Jan.14, Juche 48 (1959), all the people were armed; the whole country was fortified; the country’s military might has been bolstered up in every way and the successful advance in socialist construction firmly guaranteed. The 60-year history of the Worker-Peasant Red Guards is the praiseworthy course during which the people have reliably defended the socialist motherland and the gains of the revolution under the wise leadership of the Party. Thanks to the People’s Army, the most elite revolutionary strong army, and the mighty militia force, the security of the socialist homeland and the accomplishment of the revolutionary cause of Juche are firmly guaranteed. Our revolution is ever-victorious as there is the militia force, whose most important mission is to devotedly defend the leader, and it will defend the dignity of the supreme leadership in the country at any cost. The members of the Worker-Peasant Red Guards are putting spurs to the rounding off of the preparations for the combat to reliably defend their provinces, counties and birthplaces. Thanks to their devoted efforts, all the people are being armed and the whole country is being successfully fortified. The victorious advance of the country and its rapid development would be unthinkable without the members of the Worker-Peasant Red Guards with a rifle in one hand and a hammer, sickle or brush in the other. The Worker-Peasant Red Guards is a great pride and strength of our country as it is the only model of militia force in the world and matchless ranks with the boundless loyalty to the Party and the leader, a high revolutionary spirit, a strong sense of organization and discipline and the collective spirit.

title: Young University Students Work in Samjiyon County
body: Thousands of university students across the whole country voluntarily work hard in Samjiyon County, the birthplace of Chairman Kim Jong Il, during their winter holidays from a desire to actively help toward renovating it and erecting new buildings there and thus admirably transforming it into a model of modern mountainous city, an ideal socialist village. On arriving in the county they paid sincere homage to the statue of the Chairman which stands there and firmly vowed to splendidly develop their priceless socialist homeland by their own efforts before the eyes of the world under the far-reaching plan of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. It is associated with the leadership and undying exploits of President Kim Il Sung and the Chairman and has been defended generation after generation. A youth shock brigade of university students was organized for them to work on system, comers from the same province belonging to the same company. On the first day alone the young university students produced hundreds of cubic meters of broken gravel, plastered first-floor service facilities hundreds of meters square and carried large quantities of crushed pumice and sand. Every day they work hard by the sweat of their brow, learning the revolutionary spirit of Mt Paektu, the spirit of blizzards of Paektu, the fighting spirit of do-or-die fulfillment, self-reliant work attitude and the culture of heroic youth firsthand on the spot. Kim Yun Mi

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address Supported in Costa Rica
body: Jose Francisco Aguilar Bulgarelli, honorary chairman of the Latin American Institute of the Juche Idea, and Francisco Davila Bale, chairman of the Costa Rican Institute for the Study of the Juche Idea, released a joint statement on Jan. 2 in support of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address. The statement said that they received with deep emotion the New Year Address made by Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, that indicates the goals to be attained by the Korean people in 2019 and tasks for peace and reunification of the Korean Peninsula. It noted that they warmly welcome the broad avenue to peace and reunification on the peninsula opened by three north-south summit meetings and talks held last year. It positively supported the foreign policy stance of the Workers' Party of Korea and the government of the DPRK on ensuring world peace and security and developing the relations with all countries that are friendly to it. It stressed that the Singapore DPRK-U.S. summit meeting and talks are of special significance in liquidating long-standing hostility between the two countries and laying a foundation for complete denuclearization on the Korean Peninsula, adding that the Korean people will register big success in building a powerful socialist nation of Juche under the wise guidance of Kim Jong Un. It expressed their will to disseminate Kim Jong Un's New Year Address in Costa Rica and other countries in Latin America and further boost solidarity with the Korean people. Rodong News Team

title: Bodies of DR Congo to Boost Solidarity with Korean People
body: An annual general meeting of the National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of DR Congo and the DR Congo-Korea Friendship and Solidarity Association was held in Kinshasa on Jan. 5. It was attended by chairpersons and members of the National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of DR Congo and the DR Congo-Korea Friendship and Solidarity Association and chiefs of the Association for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, the Association for Implementing the Juche Philosophy of DR Congo, the Group for the Study of the Juche Idea in Kinshasa University and the Youth Group for the Study of the Juche Idea in DR Congo. Last year's successes were reviewed and experience exchanged at the annual general meeting. Discussed there were plans and ways for enlarging the ranks of the Juche idea followers, further activating the study and dissemination of the Juche idea and invariably boosting friendship and solidarity activities with the Korean people. Rodong News Team

title: U.S. Urged to Stop Sanctions, Interference
body: According to the south Korean online paper Jaju Sibo, south Korean civic and public organizations held a news conference before the U.S. embassy in Seoul on Jan. 10 to demand the U.S. stop the sanctions on the DPRK and the intervention in internal affairs. The organizations in the press release denounced the U.S. for preventing the development of the inter-Korean ties under the pretext of speed control. The press release condemned the U.S. for taking issue with every issue of the inter-Korean ties in a bid to stop the inter-Korean exchange and cooperation. It emphasized that the U.S. should stop at once the sanctions on the DPRK and the interference in internal affairs as they keep the inter-Korean relations from developing. Rodong News Team

title: LKP Hit for Disturbing Probe into Truth behind May 18 Massacre
body: A lawmaker from the Party for Democracy and Peace of south Korea denounced the "Liberal Korea Party" (LKP) for having tried to check the probe into the truth behind the May 18 Kwangju Massacre on January 11, according to the south Korean Newsis. He said that the LKP denies the special law which was passed at the "National Assembly" for the probe into the truth behind the May 18 movement for democracy and disturbs the probe into the truth behind it. Worse still, the LKP tries to nominate one of those who joined in the army mobilized for the suppression of the Kwangju uprising as a member of the committee for the probe into the truth, he disclosed. Rodong News Team

title: Chief of AINDF Pyongyang Mission on Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address
body: Pak Su Chol, chief of the Pyongyang mission of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front (AINDF), released a statement on Monday in support of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address. He said: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission, in his New Year Address said that greater strides should be made in the efforts to boost inter-Korean relations, achieve peace and prosperity and reunify the country in the new year 2019 on the basis of the priceless achievements made last year which was wonderfully adorned with unprecedented events, and set forth "Let us usher in a heyday of peace, prosperity and reunification of the Korean peninsula by thoroughly implementing the historic north-south declarations!" as a slogan that all the nation should hold high. This slogan reflects the fixed resolution of a peerlessly great man to continue to powerfully promote a new history of peace and prosperity started in Panmunjom on the basis of precious successes gained by the south and north by pooling intentions and hearts last year, and the unanimous desire and aspirations of all the fellow countrymen to further accelerate the nationwide advance for national reconciliation and independent reunification. The AINDF will do its best together with the people from all walks of life for realizing the New Year Address made by the respected Chairman of the State Affairs Commission, regarding it as signpost of the struggle and a militant banner for peace and prosperity of the nation and independent reunification this year. It will conduct the all-people movement to defend and implement the historic Panmunjom Declaration and the September Pyongyang Joint Declaration among the people of all walks of life and wage a dynamic struggle against the anti-reunification forces swimming against national reconciliation, unity and independent reunification. And it will further dynamically encourage all the people to activate the mass struggle for checking and frustrating all acts including joint military maneuvers with outsiders who prevent the stream of peace in this land and stir up military confrontation and tensions with transparent consciousness of national independence. It will fully discharge its mission before the times and history by helping the people from all walks of life turn out in the struggle for the implementation of the historic inter-Korean declarations, true to the New Year Address made by Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: Pak Pong Ju Inspects Various Units in Sunchon Area
body: Premier Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected different units in Sunchon area. Looking round the Sunchon Cement Complex, Pak gave a pep talk to its workers in the drive for increased production to supply more cement to the sites of the grand socialist construction in hearty response to the New Year Address of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. The consultative meeting discussed the issues of keeping the equipment in full-capacity operation and shortening the period of repairing revolving furnace by scrupulously managing equipment and improving technical control. At the consultative meetings held at the end of the inspection of the Sunchon Phosphate Fertilizer Factory under construction and the construction site of the project for the foundation of C1 chemical industry, Pak underlined the need to build the phosphate fertilizer factory as a model in the chemical industry, thoroughly carry out the phased tasks for the establishment of the C1 chemical industry by making the most effective use of the existing production foundations and take thorough measures to provide materials for the relevant units. Prior to the visits, he inspected the Songyo Knitwear Factory to take steps to produce more knit goods of high quality. Rodong News Team

title: New Stamps Issued in DPRK
body: A sheetlet was issued in the DPRK to commemorate the 60th anniversary of the Worker-Peasant Red Guards, Juche-oriented militia forces. Seen on the upper part of the sheetlet, in which rifle, hammer and sickle in hands are depicted, are letters reading “60th anniversary of Worker-Peasant Red Guards” and “Juche 48 (1959) – Juche 108 (2019)”. On its central part are two individual stamps carrying emblem of the Worker-Peasant Red Guards and letters “60th anniversary of Worker-Peasant Red Guards”. The stamps show man and woman members of the Worker-Peasant Red Guards with guns on their shoulders and a member of the Worker-Peasant Red Guards with rifle in one hand and hammer in the other respectively. The sheetlet portrays the brave spirit of the Worker-Peasant Red Guards prepared as the strong militant ranks to resolutely shatter any aggression move and defend the socialist system and lives and properties of the people. The Worker-Peasant Red Guards was founded on January 14, Juche 48 (1959) on the initiative of President Kim Il Sung and under his guidance. Rodong News Team

title: Choe Ryong Hae Inspects February 8 Vinalon Complex and Hungnam Fertilizer Complex
body: Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, inspected the February 8 Vinalon Complex and the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex. He gave a pep talk to the workers who are fully displaying the fighting spirit of self-reliance and fortitude at worksites associated with the leadership of the peerlessly great men and learned in detail about the management and operation and production of the complexes. At the field consultative meetings he stressed the need to conduct a sincere politico-ideological education through the revolutionary museums and at the same time boost production as early as possible at the February 8 Vinalon Complex and overfulfil a plan for fertilizer production by scrupulously managing equipment and improving technical control at all production processes and keeping them in full-capacity operation at the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex. He also stressed the need to supply raw and materials for putting production on normal track and improve the living conditions of the employees. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address Supported by Italian Figure
body: Roberto Gabriele, general secretary of the Movement for Peace and Socialism of Italy, issued a statement on January 7 in support of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address. He said that dramatic changes on the Korean peninsula last year served as a precious success for the Korean people, who are suffering from decades-long division due to foreign forces, and the progressive mankind struggling for world peace. The DPRK has dynamically waged the struggle for defending its sovereignty, he said, and went on: Leader Kim Jong Un said in his New Year Address that when the north and the south join hands firmly and rely on the united strength of the fellow countrymen, no external sanctions and pressure and challenges and trials will be able to hinder the Korean nation in the efforts to open a broad avenue to national prosperity. We are sure that the Korean people will achieve great successes in accomplishing the cause of reunification of the country and ensuring peace and security of the world. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address Supported by Foreign Organizations
body: Organizations of Bulgaria and Nigeria released statements on January 7 in support of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address. The Bulgaria-Korea Friendship Association said: Tasks set forth by Comrade Kim Jong Un, supreme leader of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, in his New Year Address show the bright prospect of the DPRK. We believe that the Korean people would register greater success in the socialist economic construction this year with diligent effort. We fully support Comrade Kim Jong Un's New Year Address. The Nigeria-Korea Friendship Association said: HE Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address reviewed last year's work, saying remarkable changes were brought about in the internal and external situations and the socialist construction entered a new stage thanks to the line of independence and strategic decision of the Workers' Party of Korea, and called for making greater strides in the struggle to boost the inter-Korean relations, achieve peace and prosperity and reunify the country. The entire Korean nation in the north, the south and abroad will glorify this year as a historic one when another radical change is brought about in the accomplishment of the cause of national reunification by further accelerating the nationwide advance for thoroughly implementing the north-south declarations by the concerted efforts. Rodong News Team

title: Seminars on Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address Held Abroad
body: Seminars on Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address took place in Russia, the Czech Republic and Romania on January 7 and 8. The director of the Russian Institute of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism said that Kim Jong Un's New Year Address serves as guidelines for bringing about a fresh turn in the building of a powerful socialist nation by the Korean people and in the development of the inter-Korean relations and external relations. The deputy general secretary of the Central Committee of the Czechoslovak Communist Party, who is also chairman of the Paektusan Czech-Korean Friendship Association and chairman of the Czech Group for the Study and Materialization of the Juche Idea, said that Kim Jong Un's New Year Address is an inspiring banner giving hope to the world people who love peace as it clearly indicated the orientation and way of making a leap forward on all fronts of the socialist construction under the banner of self-reliance and ensuring a durable peace on the Korean peninsula. The general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party-21 of the Czech Republic referred to the fact that the New Year Address serves as a precious document for not only the Korean people but also the progressive people, communist parties and workers' parties in the world. The secretary general of the Romania-Korea Friendship Association said that the Korean people, who are vigorously advancing, rallied close around Kim Jong Un, will continue to be on a winning streak in the confrontation with the hostile forces and thus demonstrate before the world the validity of the cause of socialism. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address Introduced in Mexico
body: The Mexican Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism carried the full text of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's historic New Year Address in its bulletin on January 9. Rodong News Team

title: No Force Can Reverse Advance of DPRK
body: It is the truth proved by history that any obstacle and challenge can never check the just cause of the Korean people. The whole course of the Korean revolution is a history of heroic struggle which has moved forward in the face of the worst-ever difficulty and challenge. The Korean people have dynamically advanced along the road of the Korean-style socialism without the slightest deviation. Last year was a proud year in which the history of glorious struggle and traditions of the Korean people who have been emerging victorious in any adversity has been proved once again in the world. The moves of the hostile forces to suffocate the DPRK went only to help the Korean people work with redoubled efforts in the spirit of self-reliance and fortitude. The state’s might of self-development has grown stronger and greater progress has been made in the building of a powerful socialist country. The Korean people have been convinced of the validity of their own cause and the invincible might of the DPRK. The determination of the Workers’ Party of Korea which regards the people-first principle as the cornerstone of its activities and the firm faith and will of the Korean people to devotedly implement it have been translated into a great reality. This is the immutable truth proved by the victorious advance of the DPRK last year. The history and reality eloquently show that no force on earth can reverse the will of the people and advance of the DPRK. Ri Hyo Jin

title: Filling Coal Miners with Youthful Stamina and Energy
body: A batch of performers to the Art Propaganda Troupe of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League perform at the Ryongdae Coal Mine to inspire its employees with youthful mettle and courage and enhance their fighting spirit. They have so far done the like since they started their art activities at many pits of the mine on February 23, 2018. They visited the members of the Kim Jin and Kim Hyok Shock Brigades at their pits respectively and expounded the contents of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un’s New Year Address, reminding them that he said that young people should be in the vanguard wherever the Party asks them to work the way they recently achieved new miracles in socialist construction in response to the militant call of the Party. They lustily sang them revolutionary militant songs like “Both the Country and Youth Will Shine”, “The Hymn of Praise to Youth”, “I Will Uphold My Honor as a Coal Miner”, “Blaze Up, Bonfire” and “The March of Young Socialist Builders” so as to encourage them to youthful ardor and vigor. Kim Yun Mi

title: Meeting of Chongryon Officials Held
body: Officials of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) had a meeting at the Korean Hall in Tokyo on January 12 to vow to implement the tasks set forth by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address and message of New Year greeting. Present at the meeting were Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of Chongryon, Vice-Chairman Nam Sung U, Vice-Chairman and Director General of the General Affairs Department Pae Jin Gu, Vice-Chairman and Director of the Organization Department Jo Il Yon, Vice-Chairman Pak Ku Ho, Vice-Chairwoman Kang Chu Ryon who is also chairwoman of the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Democratic Korean Women in Japan, Chairman of the Central Audit Committee of Chongryon Ri Myong Yu, advisors to the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, its department directors, the director of the Research Institute on History of Korean Residents in Japan, chairmen of Chongryon headquarters in Kanto area, senior officials of central leadership bodies and affiliates of Chongryon, officials under Chongryon headquarters in Kanto area, teachers of Korean schools at all levels and part-time activists. Ho Jong Man made a report. He said that Kim Jong Un's New Year Address made the Korean people full of confidence in victory and optimism for the bright future and serves as an inspiring banner indicating the way for bringing about the revolutionary upswing on all fronts of socialist construction. Kim Jong Un personally sent a message of New Year greeting to Chongryon and Koreans in Japan this year, too, he said, calling on all officials of Chongryon to thoroughly implement the tasks set forth by Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address and message of New Year greeting. Speeches were made at the meeting. A letter to Kim Jong Un was read out there. Rodong News Team

title: Youth Movement Museum Draws Many Visitors
body: The Youth Movement Museum has been visited by more than 400 000 people from above 5 800 units over the past 3 years since its opening. The museum was visited by the participants in the Seventh Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea and the Ninth Congress of the Kim Il Sung Socialist Youth League, working people from different social standings, youth and students, service personnel, overseas compatriots and foreigners. In the general review hall, the visitors laid bouquets before the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il among youth and students, and bowed to them. They went round an art work depicting Kim Il Sung founding the Young Communist League of Korea, a photo he had taken with delegates to the founding of the Democratic Youth League of North Korea and other photos, historic mementoes and different places of the museum. Looking at the photo of Kim Jong Il, who is handing down the torch of revolution to young vanguard in the evening gala and torchlight procession of youth and students in Pyongyang for celebrating the 50th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea, the young people vowed to take the one road following the Party forever. A photo of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, who is making his speech at the Ninth Congress of the Kim Il Sung Socialist Youth League and a photo of him who is seeing the flag of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League are associated with the history of his leadership for training young people as warriors for accomplishing the revolutionary cause of Juche. Through the visits working people of all social strata, youth and students and service personnel keenly realized that as there is the peerlessly great men the youth movement of Juche could pave its way of victory and young people of the DPRK could grow up to be proud masters of youth power without an equal in the world. After visiting the museum, overseas compatriots and foreign friends said that the future of the DPRK is very bright as it has iron-willed youth ranks. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Embassy in Havana Hosts Reception
body: The DPRK embassy in Havana gave a reception on January 10 to mark the 60th anniversary of the victory in the Cuban revolution. Present there on invitation were figures of the political party, government and organizations including the Communist Party of Cuba, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Ministry of Revolutionary Armed Forces, the Ministry of Higher Education, the Ministry of Trade and Foreign Investment and the Cuban Committee for Supporting Korea's Reunification and those of the Organization of Solidarity of the Peoples of Africa, Asia and Latin America and media persons. Present there were the DPRK ambassador to Cuba and his embassy officials. Speeches were made there. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address Supported by Romanian and Hungarian Political Figures
body: Romanian and Hungarian political figures supported Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address. Constantin Rotaru, chairman of the Socialist Party of Romania, posted a statement on a website on January 8. The statement said that Kim Jong Un reviewed proud successes registered by the Korean people last year and set forth tasks for dynamically accelerating socialist construction this year. It noted that in particular, Kim Jong Un called for bringing about another radical turn in developing inter-Korean relations and accomplishing the cause of national reunification. It expressed the conviction that the Korean people will achieve greater success in the struggle for building a powerful country and ensuring the peace and security on the Korean peninsula under the wise leadership of Kim Jong Un in the new year. Gyula Thurmer, chairman of the Hungarian Workers' Party, in his statement on Jan. 7 supported the stand of the Workers' Party of Korea and the DPRK government to achieve a durable peace on the Korean peninsula and its reunification and to strengthen the friendship with different countries, and expressed the will to make a positive contribution to continuing to develop the relations between the peoples of the DPRK and Hungary. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address Supported by Czech Organizations
body: The Paektusan Czech-Korean Friendship Association and the Czech Group for the Study and Materialization of the Juche Idea released a joint statement on January 8 in support of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address. The statement said: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address reviewed proud successes registered by the Korean people last year and advanced the slogan "Let us open a new road of advance for socialist construction under the uplifted banner of self-reliance!" to bring about a revolutionary upswing on all fronts of socialist construction. Last year a peaceful climate was created on the Korean peninsula and the international prestige of the DPRK was remarkably enhanced thanks to the proactive efforts of the DPRK. We are rejoiced at this. We express full support for the proposals for developing the north-south relations and ensuring peace on the Korean peninsula which were set forth by Comrade Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address. The DPRK which celebrated its 70th founding anniversary in splendor will carry forward the brilliant history of the revolutionary cause of Juche in the future, too. We hope that the Workers' Party of Korea and the Korean people will achieve creditable successes in the struggle for the socialist construction and the reunification of the country under the leadership of Comrade Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: Strong Support for the Coal-mining Industry
body: In response to the New Year Address of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un the ministries and national organs strongly support the coal-mining industry. From the beginning of the New Year dozens of the ministries and central organs supplied great numbers of equipment and materials to coal mines across the country and presented aid goods to the miners. The Ministry of External Economic Relations, the Ministry of Finance and the External Construction Guidance Bureau are also not outdone in backing up coal mines for patriotic purposes. The officials of the ministries and bureau called at the February 8 Jikdong, Sochang and Hoean Youth Coal Mines and the Jenam Coal Mine on the New Year’s Day. They provided the miners with plenty of materials like bearings for coal wagons and bar steel, thus arousing them to further production. The officials of the Ministry of Land and Maritime Transport, the Ministry of Electronics Industry and the Maritime Administration of the DPRK went to the Chonsong Youth Coal Mine and the Ryongdae, Tokchon and Joyang Coal Mines and handed over to the mines conveyor belts, air hoses, belts and other materials badly needed for coal production as well as lots of items for labor protection, so as to dynamically encourage the miners to mass-produce coal. The officials of the Ministry of Machine-building Industry, the Ministry of Urban Management, the State Planning Commission and the Ministry of Public Health carried their aid materials to many coal mines in the western region of the country and greatly inspired the militant spirit of the miners so that they could do well in their work from the outset of the New Year. Believing that they join the coal miners to be in the forefront of independent national development, many other ministries and national organs, too, tapped reserves to the full and provided an abundance of aid materials to coal mines in many areas of the country. Hong Song Jun

title: Art Squad of Youth League Gives Performance
body: The art squad of the Central Committee of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League gave a performance "Youth League of the Eternal Sun" at the Central Youth Hall on Thursday, the 73rd founding anniversary of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League. Among the audience were Choe Hwi, vice-chairman of the C.C., the Workers' Party of Korea, and officials of the youth league. The performance began with prelude "Dash toward Future" and "March of Self-reliance". The performers sang high praises of exploits of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il who led the Korean youth movement to the road of victory and glory. The hall resounded with male solo "We Will Follow Marshal to End" reflecting the faith of the youth vanguard who will share the idea and destiny with Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Put on the stage were also mixed trio and chorus "Our National Flag", male quartet "Along the Road of Socialism", etc. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Successful Visit to China Hailed by Swiss Organizations
body: The Swiss Organizing Committee for the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu, the Switzerland-Korea Committee and the Swiss Group for the Study of the Juche Idea released a joint statement on January 12 in congratulation of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's successful visit to China. The statement said: Chairman Kim Jong Un's recent visit to China has a special meaning as this year marks the 70th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the DPRK and China. As Chairman Kim Jong Un emphasized, his recent visit clearly demonstrated once again the immutability and invincibility of the DPRK-China friendship before the world. Chairman Kim Jong Un's visit to China made at the beginning of the new year serves as a historic occasion greatly conducive to boosting the DPRK-China friendship and ensuring peace and stability on the Korean peninsula. We warmly congratulate Chairman Kim Jong Un on his successful visit to China. Rodong News Team

title: Ecuadorian Organizations Support Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address
body: The Ecuadorian Committee for Remembering President Kim Il Sung, the Ecuadorian Committee for Remembering Generalissimo Kim Jong Il, the Ecuadorian Cultural Institute for the Study of the Juche Idea, the Canar Provincial Institute for the Friendship and Solidarity with DPRK of Ecuador, the Ecuadorian Committee for Supporting the Independent and Peaceful Reunification of Korea and the Guaranda Association for Friendship, Culture and Solidarity with the Korean People of Ecuador released a joint statement in support of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address. The statement said: Surprising changes which took place in inter-Korean relations last year convinced all Koreans that when they join minds and efforts, they can turn the Korean peninsula into the true home of the nation, which is the most peaceful and will prosper forever. The New Year Address calls for making greater strides in the efforts to boost inter-Korean relations, achieve peace and prosperity and reunify the country on the basis of the priceless achievements made last year which was wonderfully adorned with unprecedented events. The New Year Address called upon the Korean nation to hold high the slogan "Let us usher in a heyday of peace, prosperity and reunification of the Korean peninsula by thoroughly implementing the historic north-south declarations!" We fully support the respected HE Kim Jong Un's New Year Address. Rodong News Team

title: Japan’s Past Crime Should Be Liquidated
body: Japanese Prime Minister Abe in the New Year news conference said that he would do his best to resolve the abduction issue, talking about “the general summing up of postwar Japan’s diplomacy”. His reckless remarks are the revelation of the shamelessness peculiar to the island barbarian to cover up the hideous crimes against humanity committed by Japan in the past and evade their liquidation. The abduction issue on the lip-service of Abe had already been settled long ago. Japan still has an important and historic outstanding abduction issue. Having put Korea under its military occupation in the first half of the last century, Japan set in motion government power and military power to organizationally abduct Koreans. It fabricated even the “National Mobilization Law” to take more than 8.4 million young and middle-aged people to battle fields and slave labor sites and mercilessly kill more than one million Koreans and force 200 000 Korean women into sexual slavery for the Imperial Japanese Army. Japan’s abduction crime is the heinous war crime to which no statute of limitations is applicable. Japan vociferates the “contribution to the international community”, but it has not yet shaken off its disgrace of being a country that committed worst-ever war crimes, abductions and hideous crimes against humanity. Abe’s forces try to flee from the historic responsibility and obligation to liquidate the past under the pretext of abduction issue. Japan’s “general summing up of the postwar Japan’s diplomacy” should be subordinated to the thorough-going liquidation of the crimes it committed in Korea in the first half of the last century. Japan’s future lies in it. Ri Hyo Jin

title: Editorial
body: Let Us Increase Politico-Ideological Strength in Every Way It is important to increase the politico-ideological strength in every way so as to further accelerate the advance of the revolution by successfully carrying out the militant tasks set forth by the Workers’ Party of Korea this year. The politico-ideological might is the first and foremost strength of our state and the motive force for building a powerful socialist country. The great single-minded unity is a source of the heroic struggle of our motherland which has won only victory, overcoming ordeals of every description through the untrodden path for the accomplishment of the socialist cause of Juche. To increase the politico-ideological might guarantees the dignity, victory and eternal prosperity of the socialist state. Thanks to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, the peerlessly great man, the politico-ideological might of Juche Korea has been fully demonstrated. Socialist Korea is a country of single-minded unity which successfully achieved the ideological oneness. A state is invincible when it has an ideology and politics to win the sympathy of all people and unite them and has achieved firmly unity and cohesion. Our people never doubt the possibility of the long-term plan of the Party. The Party’s policy is a science and truth which must be unconditionally implemented in the face of every description of difficulties. This reflects all the people’s loyalty. Getting more dynamic each day is this year’s revolutionary march of Juche Korea advancing with the might of the single-minded unity based on the great idea and indomitable mental power. All people should work hard for the prosperity of the socialist country, the greatest people’s country, closely united around the Party.

title: Toothbrush Workshop Almost Completed
body: The construction of a toothbrush workshop of the Pyongyang Dental Hygiene Products Factory is nearing completion. It progressed apace from the beginning thanks to the expert operations and direction of the construction headquarters and the hardworking builders of the External Construction Guidance Bureau. The headquarters channeled its efforts into ensuring that the builders gave the fullest play to their spiritual strength and enhancing their creativity so as to actively contrive and introduce many rational methods of construction. It also strictly demanded that the builders exactly observe technical regulations and ensure the speed and quality of their building project on a high level. Consequently, the building project of the workshop has been carried out by 96%. The wallboards of the workshop’s distribution board room are painted at the last stage. Yun Un Sim

title: All-out to Modernize the PPF
body: The Pyongyang Pharmaceutical Factory is well under reconstruction and modernization. Since the start of their work the builders have so far worked hard without a break, thereby completing the skeleton framework of new buildings by 98%. The field headquarters strictly demanded that the builders work under methods of construction and gave integral directions to many building corps. The shock workers of the Ministry of Public Health admirably put up subsidiary buildings in the face of obstacles and difficulties. An economic propaganda squad did well in its art activities on the spot to egg the builders on to work hard in high spirits. The field headquarters carefully arranges to complete the skeleton framework of buildings in a short time, start fixing up their interior, secure necessary materials and provide for other requisites. Kim Yun Mi

title: All-out for Collective Innovations
body: In response to the historic New Year Address made by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, the managerial staff and animators of the Korean April 26 Animation Studio go all-out to produce masterworks. The result is that they finished the pictorial script for another new installment of the serial historical animated cartoon “Ko Ju Mong” in a short time. This year marks the 5th anniversary of Kim Jong Un’s visit to the studio for firsthand guidance. That day he said that the previous animated cartoon “The Boy General” enjoyed great popularity and that although it ended in its 50th part our children and people would be really delighted if it was extended to the 100th part to be produced and shown. The managerial staff and animators of the studio make redoubled efforts to carry out without fail Kim Jong Un’s instructions as to the animated cartoon and produce many others which will serve as the dear life and work companions of our children and people. Cha Su

title: Phalhyang Dam Well under Construction
body: North Hamgyong Province carries on a dynamic general offensive apace in the indomitable spirit of self-reliance despite the rigors of winter to build the Phalhyang Dam of the Orangchon Power Station and perform the militant task set by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address. The province placed tens of thousands of cubic meters of concrete for the dam for several months. As ever, it makes its possible effort day and night to complete the dam at an early date. The province ensures that an art propaganda squad performs and speaks in public like combatants at the construction site of the power station, thereby urging the builders to work hard. The ministries, the central organs and many units of the province extend active material and moral assistance to the building of the power station. Ri Un Nam

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address Supported by Foreign Figures
body: Bulgarian and Italian figures released statements on January 2 and 7 in support of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address. Atanas Ivanov, honorary chairman of the Bulgarian Communists Union, said that Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address indicates tasks to be fulfilled by the Korean people this year. He noted that the Supreme Leader in his New Year Address for 2019 reviewed proud successes registered last year and called for bringing about a revolutionary upswing on all fronts of socialist construction. He stressed that they fully support his New Year Address to be recorded as a significant document in history. Miriam Pelegrini Peri, president of the Group of Dialectical Materialists of Italy and chairwoman of the Italian Committee for the Study of Songun Idea for Independence and Sovereignty, said that she was convinced of the bright future of the DPRK through HE Kim Jong Un's New Year Address. She noted that the great victory won by the Korean people last year under his wise leadership instills hope into the peace-loving progressives. She wished the Korean people greater success under the banner of self-reliance. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address Hailed Abroad
body: An Ugandan figure and a Russian organization released statements on January 7 in support of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address.
