Adding that he respectfully sent New Year greetings to Kim Jong Un, the chairman of the Ugandan National Executive Committee of the Pan-African Movement said that last year was a significant year in which epoch-making events were made in the accomplishment of the cause of national reunification of the Korean people. He noted that the Singapore DPRK-U.S. summit meeting and talks and adoptions of the Panmunjom Declaration and the September Pyongyang Joint Declaration reflect the desire of the Korean people for national reconciliation, reunification and world peace. He extended support to the firm stand of the DPRK to improve north-south relations and DPRK-U.S. relations and ensure durable peace on the Korean peninsula and in the region. He hoped that the Korean people would mark the new year as a great one. The Central Committee of the All-Russia Lenin Young Communist League in its statement said it is rejoiced over the news that the Korean people achieved great successes last year and praises the firm stand of the DPRK to ensure peace and prosperity on the Korean peninsula. The statement noted that Kim Jong Un made initiative and sincere proposals for the development of north-south relations and the improvement of DPRK-U.S. relations in his New Year Address. It sincerely hoped that the Korean people will bring about a revolutionary upswing on all fronts of socialist construction in the new year. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Lines Supported
body: A political party and organizations of Mexico issued a joint statement on January 11 to support the New Year Address made by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. They are the People's Socialist Party of Mexico, the Mexican National Coordinating Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea, the Mexican Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, the Mexican Institute for the Study of the Juche Idea, the Mexican Friend Association for Memory of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, the Mexico-Korea Friendship Association and the Mexican Committee for Supporting the Peaceful Reunification of Korea. The statement warmly congratulated the Korean people on the last year's brilliant successes in the struggle for carrying out the new strategic line set forth at the Third Plenary Meeting of the Seventh Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea under the guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and on the celebrations for the 70th founding anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. The statement extended firm support and solidarity to the struggle of the Korean people for defending peace in the Korean peninsula and the rest of the world. It said that last year Kim Jong Un brought about a fresh turn in the development of north-south relations through three north-south summits and talks. It noted that in his New Year Address he set forth practical proposals for making the Korean peninsula a durable and lasting peace zone. Expressing the belief that all lines advanced by him are just, the statement hoped that the Korean people will achieve good successes in the struggle for improving the people's standard of living and ensuring peace and security on the Korean peninsula under the leadership of Kim Jong Un in 2019. Rodong News Team

title: Brisk Activities of Field Medical Teams
body: Field medical teams do their part well in all the major domains of socialist economic construction. They comprise hundreds of medical workers employed in dozens of medical and preventive institutions across Pyongyang and the provinces. From the beginning of the New Year they have offered their intensive medical services in major factories and enterprises and sites of gigantic construction. There are also field medical teams composed of a hundred and tens of doctors engaged in the Pyongyang Medical College Hospital of Kim Il Sung University, the Kim Man Yu Hospital, the Pyongyang Maternity Hospital, the Okryu Children’s Hospital, the Ryugyong Dental Hospital and other central hospitals. From the first days of 2019 they have given workers good medical care in the Pyongyang Thermal Power Complex, the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Silk Mill and other major factories and enterprises of various sectors of the national economy. The case is similar to the medical workers of the Ministry of Public Health Skin-disease Preventive Centre, the Ministry of Public Health General Dental Hospital and the Koryo Medical Institute. They accorded employees active medical treatment in the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill and many other production centers, thus encouraging them to be intent on their work. From the outset of the New Year the medical workers of metropolitan and other provincial medical and preventive institutions faithfully perform their medical duty in upward of 100 producers. The field medical teams, composed of the competent medical workers of many medical and preventive institutions in Pyongyang, sincerely examine the health of workers and give them medical treatment in coal mines, power stations and major factories and enterprises. In Kangwon Province its provincial medical and preventive institutions joined together to organize strong field medical teams, which tender their medical services to employees and children in the major factories and enterprises of the province, the Wonsan Baby Home, the Wonsan Orphanage, etc. on the spot. Besides, suit is followed by many medical and preventive institutions in North and South Phyongan and Hamgyong Provinces and other parts of the country. The masses of producers are medically treated by their field medical teams at their workplaces to fire their zeal for work further. Kim Song Min

title: Delegation of Ministry of Land and Environment Protection Leaves for Singapore
body: A delegation of the Ministry of Land and Environment Protection led by Minister Kim Kyong Jun left here on Saturday to take part in the 3rd Forum of Ministers of Environment of the Asia-Pacific Region to be held in Singapore. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Shining Star to Be Celebrated in Tanzania
body: A Tanzanian preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il (Day of the Shining Star) was formed in Dar es Salaam on January 12. Francis F. Lyimo, chairman of the Tanzanian National Coordinating Committee of the Juche Idea Study Groups, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The preparatory committee decided to organize colorful political and cultural events in praise of Kim Jong Il's revolutionary career and exploits between January 12 and February 16. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address Studied in Various Countries
body: Reading sessions on Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address were held by various organizations of Nepal, Mexico, DR Congo, Guinea, Nigeria and Ethiopia from Jan. 2 to 11. The general secretary of the Central Committee of the Nepal Communist Party (Marxist-Leninist) said that the New Year Address of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un lightens the way for boosting inter-Korean relations, achieving peace and prosperity and reunifying the country and that peace and stability of the Korean peninsula are closely related to the world peace and stability, adding that all the countries should put positive efforts on ensuring peace and stability of the Korean peninsula. The chairman of the DR Congo National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea, who is also national president of the Working Citizens' Association, said that thanks to the indefatigable guidance of HE Kim Jong Un, who is carrying forward without an inch of deflection the desires of the preceding leaders for building a powerful country, the Korean people have registered great success in the socialist construction and celebrated the 70th anniversary of the founding of the DPRK with splendor last year, thereby vividly demonstrating the country's dignity. He fully supported the tasks for national reunification set forth by Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address Supported by Foreign Figures
body: Personages of Syria, Guinea and Algeria released statements on Jan. 9 in support of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address. The chairman of the Syrian Arab-Korea Friendship Association said that he came to know well about the firm stand of the Party and the government of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea to accomplish the cause of national reunification through Kim Jong Un's New Year Address, wishing the friendly Workers' Party of Korea and the Korean people bigger success in 2019. The chairman of the Guinean Society for the Study of the Juche Literary Idea expressed the support for the tasks set forth by Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address for the development of the inter-Korean relations and peace and prosperity and national reunification, saying that the dramatic events which took place in the development of the north-south relations and the DPRK-U.S. relations last year were attributable to the initiative and bold steps taken by HE Kim Jong Un and his high political ability. The chairman of the Algeria-Korea Friendship Association stressed that Kim Jong Un's New Year Address indicates the orientation and ways for the prosperity, development and reunification of Korea. He hoped that the Korean people would make great progress on the road of reunifying the country this year, too. Rodong News Team

title: 23rd Kimjongilia Festival Will Take Place
body: The 23rd Kimjongilia Festival will take place in Pyongyang with splendor to celebrate the birthday of Chairman Kim Jong Il. During the festival, Kimjongilia exhibitions will take place and visits to the Kimilsungia-Kimjongilia greenhouses will be made in local areas. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Friendship Art Delegation to Visit China
body: The friendship art delegation of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea led by Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, will visit the People's Republic of China from Jan. 23 at the invitation of the International Liaison Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China. The DPRK friendship art delegation is composed of the State Merited Chorus of high repute and leading artistes in Pyongyang City. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Shining Star to Be Marked in China
body: A preparatory committee of the General Association of Koreans in China for significantly celebrating Chairman Kim Jong Il's birth anniversary was formed in Shenyang, China on Jan. 10. Choe Un Bok, chairwoman of the General Association, was elected chairwoman of the preparatory committee. The committee decided to organize a meeting, photo and book exhibition, art performance and other colorful events in praise of Kim Jong Il's revolutionary career and undying exploits in the run-up to the meaningful Day of the Shining Star (his birth anniversary). Meanwhile, the Zhongnan Regional Association, the Yanbian Regional Association and other organizations under the General Association also decided to hold various events. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Wreath to Bier of Ri Hui Chan
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un on Sunday sent a wreath to the bier of Ri Hui Chan, winner of Kim Il Sung Prize and writer of the Korean Scriptwriting Company, expressing deep condolences over his death. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Shining Star to Be Celebrated in Czech Republic
body: A preparatory committee of the Czech Republic for celebrating the Day of the Shining Star (birthday of Chairman Kim Jong Il) was formed in Prague on Jan. 8. Jozef Servista, chairman of the Paektusan Czech-Korea Friendship Association who is deputy general secretary of the Central Committee of the Czechoslovak Communist Party and chairman of the Czech Group for the Study and Materialization of the Juche Idea, was elected as chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee decided to organize colorful political and cultural events such as a seminar and film show to praise the revolutionary careers and exploits of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and the personality of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un as the heaven-sent great man on the occasion of the Day of the Shining Star. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address Supported in Nepal and Italy
body: Events took place in Nepal and Italy on Jan. 4 and 7 to support Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address. The general secretary of the Central Committee of the Nepal Communist Party (Marxist－Leninist) who is ex-vice prime minister of Nepal, said that the world is admiring the personality of Kim Jong Un as the great man who opened up a rosy future of national reunification, lifetime desire of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. He noted that Kim Jong Un wisely led the Korean people and thus defended Korean-style socialism and world peace and security. He said that the whole mankind received his New Year Address with deep emotion and extended full support to it. He stressed that the Korean people would make a dynamic advance towards the greater victory under the banner of self-reliance. The president of the Group of Dialectical Materialists of Italy who is chairwoman of the Italian Committee for the Study of Songun Idea for Independence and Sovereignty explained Kim Jong Un's New Year Address. She praised Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il for performing feats in the Korean revolution and the global cause of independence and Kim Jong Un for turning the DPRK into the invincible power. A congratulatory message to Kim Jong Un was adopted at the event held in Nepal. Rodong News Team

title: Editorial
body: Let Us Put Spurs to Hitting Goals of Five-Year Strategy for National Economic Development This year is an important year of decisive significance in attaining the goals of the five-year strategy for national economic development. Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address underscored the need to put spurs to carrying out the goals of the five-year strategy for national economic development and clearly indicated the tasks for its realization. Putting spurs to hitting the goals of the five-year strategy for national economic development is a worthwhile struggle for creation to demonstrate before the world the inexhaustible self-development capability and potentiality for development of the DPRK, which remains undaunted by any challenge, by bringing about a sharp upturn in the overall national economy. Last year the foundation of the self-supporting economy was further consolidated by the heroic struggle of all the people who turned out in the grand march for economic construction in hearty response to the decision of the historic April Plenary Meeting of the Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea. Self-reliance is a banner of struggle, driving force for a leap forward and a treasured sword for prosperity to be held fast to by all the people whatever the situation and circumstances. We have the power and foundation, our own strategy and way of creation to build a rosier future of socialism by our own efforts even in the face of all challenges of injustice and stern ordeals. All the sectors of the national economy should dynamically conduct the general offensive for attaining the goals of the five-year strategy for national economic development, thus fully demonstrating before the world the DPRK’s tremendous power and spirit of making a leap forward. Our advance towards a powerful socialist state will be further accelerated as there are the wise leadership of the ever-victorious Workers’ Party of Korea, the people with inexhaustible creative power, huge ranks of scientists and technicians trained by the Party and a firm foundation of mighty self-supporting economy.

title: Strong Support for Coal Mines
body: In hearty response to the militant tasks set in the New Year Address of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, the officials and working people of North Phyongan Province strongly supported the Kujang Area Coal-mining Complex. They secured prop timbers, bearings for coal wagons and lots of other materials and presented them to the Kujang Area Coal-mining Complex on January 11 so as to lift the morale of its labor and management. Believing that they are also responsible for coal production, the officials and working people of Sinuiju City and Sonchon County tapped latent reserves to the full to sincerely secure aid materials. They visited pits of coal mines in charge and provided the aid materials to mines to actively encourage them to produce coal. Suit was followed by Tongrim, Pakchon and Changsong Counties and the other counties of the province. This powerfully propelled the labor and management of the complex into coal production. Yun Un Sim

title: Prop Timber Production Plan for January Fulfilled Ahead of Set Time
body: The forestry personnel and workers strive energetically as one to produce prop timbers as Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un assigned them to do that in his New Year Address. As of January more than 15 twenty forestry stations and mine timber production stations under the Ministry of Forestry attained the goal of their prop timber production for January. From the outset of the New Year many forestry stations and mine timber production stations do well in their work to meet their daily production quotas more than double. The lumberjacks of the Kangye, Taehung, Phyonghwa and Chonnae Mine Timber Production Stations increase their production in felling sites. They fell and transport trees with all speed. Meantime, their trucks were repaired and maintained with good care, only to be put in full operation. Eventually the stations fulfilled their mine timber production plan for January in less than ten days. The Chonma and Yuson Forestry Stations, the Yonam, Huichon, Thongchon, Onsong, Kyonghung and Kyongsong Mine Timber Production Stations and many others concentrate all their efforts on producing mine timbers in winter and optimize their use of all reserves and potentials, thus augmenting their output considerably. Many forestry stations and mine timber production stations continue to work hard and achieve many more successes in their work the way they executed their production plan for January ahead of schedule. Jong Kyong Chol

title: Delegation of Int'l Gymnastic Federation Arrives
body: A delegation of the International Gymnastic Federation led by President Morinari Watanabe arrived here on Monday. Rodong News Team

title: Pak Pong Ju Inspects Various Units in South Hamgyong Province
body: Premier Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected various units in South Hamgyong Province. Inspecting the February 8 Vinalon Complex, Pak Pong Ju gave a pep talk to workers of the complex stepping up the production of caustic soda, vinyl chloride and carbide, called for fully displaying the advantages of the operation and management method of our own so as to rapidly increase the production, and underlined the need for the relevant units to supply materials and fuel to the complex in a responsible manner. At the Ryongsong Machine Complex, he also called for finishing the production of the custom-built equipment such as large toothed wheels and compressors for hydro-power stations and key factories and enterprises as early as possible and for improving the quality of products. Inspecting the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex, the Sinpho Fishery Station, etc., he discussed the issues arising in increasing the production of fertilizer badly needed in the agricultural field and in improving the field of fisheries. The consultative meetings on the spots took the measures to thoroughly prioritize science and technology and to reenergize the production by exploring and using all reserves and possibilities. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address Introduced in DR Congo

title: Editorial
body: Let Us Uphold Our-State-First Principle All the people should staunchly struggle for the DPRK’s prosperity with the principle of our state first as a powerful politico-ideological weapon in the great era of Kim Jong Un. The principle of our state first reflects the pride and self-confidence in the greatness of socialist country and a strong will to put its overall national power on the highest level. The principle also means a proud review of the long course of the DPRK and the leading thoughts and feelings of the times that all the people have cherished in their hearts. To uphold the principle at present is lawful requirement for the development of the DPRK making a leap forward towards a powerful socialist state. Since the idea on the principle reflects the requirement of the times and developing reality most correctly and meets the Korean people’s valiant revolutionary spirit and aspiration, it will display its tremendous might in building a powerful socialist nation. Steadfast are the determination and will of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un to glorify forever our Republic as Kim Il Sung’s and Kim Jong Il’s Korea and genuine people’s country without an equal in the world. All the people should cherish pride and confidence in the glorious history and the rosy future of the DPRK and step up the building of a powerful socialist state through the all-people patriotic struggle.

title: Ideological and Moral Basis of Our-State-First Principle
body: All the people should dynamically push forward the ongoing general advance for realizing the dream of prosperity on the principle of our state first. The ideological and moral basis of the principle of our state first is the immortal Juche idea and Kim Jong Il’s patriotism. The history of the DPRK is the one in which it has regarded the great Juche idea - the acme in the history of human thought - as a state political idea and undauntedly advanced along the road of independence. Korea, once a country torn with sycophancy and dogmatism and big powers’ theatre of fierce scramble for bringing it under their thumb, has towered at the center of the world political structure as a bulwark of independence and invincible socialist fortress. This is priceless fruit born by the great Juche idea and politics of independence. Patriotism full in the hearts of the Korean people today is Kim Jong Il’s patriotism through which noble outlooks on the country, its people and younger generation run. Kim Jong Il’s patriotism is precious ideological and moral pabulum for people who love the country and people and the ideological and moral source instilling courage and vigor into all the people who struggle for the country and people. All the officials, party members and other working people will have to step up the ongoing grand march for demonstrating the prestige and dignity of our state before the world by thoroughly applying the immortal Juche idea and Kim Jong Il’s patriotism. Kim Yong Il

title: National Brass Band Contest of University Students
body: Participants in the National Brass Band Contest of University Studentsrecently gave a performance at the construction site of the Wonsan-Kalma coastal tourist area under the far-reaching plan of the Party. An official of the Central Committee of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League remarked: “The National Brass Band Contest of University Students is taking place at the construction site of the Kalma coastal tourist area in Wonsan, the Sunchon Area Youth Coal-mining Complex and the February 8 Jikdong Youth Coal Mine during the winter vacation of university students. The contest was entered for by hundreds of university students from over 10 brass bands. They will be judged by the level of their stirring field performance. While the contest is going on for several days the wide construction site loudly resounds with the band music of university students.” The bandsmen of various universities played lively band music cheerfully at the construction site. The builders of the coastal tourist area are encouraged by the young university students to great activity. Kim Su Jong

title: Builders of Orangchon Power Station Greatly Encouraged
body: During their winter vacation the young university students of North Hamgyong Province inspired builders to greater feats by conducting dynamic socio-political activities at the Orangchon Power Station under construction. They visited the construction site of the Phalhyang Dam of the station and presented their hearty aid materials to the builders who bestirred themselves as one to implement the tasks set in the New Year Address of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and set to in 2019. They then performed and spoke to spur them on to further efforts. The girl students of O Jung Hup Chongjin University of Education No. 1 buckled down to their gravel and sand production. They crushed rocks with hammers and turned out large quantities of gravels even to men’s surprise. The students of Chongjin University of Agriculture overfulfilled their daily work assignments, doing themselves full justice in their youthful resource and gallantry. The students of Chongjin University of Mining and Metallurgy, Hambuk University of Technology and the Chongjin Art School lent a helping hand to builders at the construction site on one hand, and traveled about it and gave them art performances on the other. Consequently, they contributed to enabling gravels and sand to be mass-produced in a short time. As mentioned above, the young university students of the province inspired the builders of the Phalhyang Dam with great confidence and courage. Ri Un Nam

title: Schoolchildren's Sports Contest Opens
body: The 45th National Schoolchildren's Sports Contest for Jongilbong Prize opened with due ceremony at the Basketball Gymnasium in Chongchun Street on Tuesday. The sporting event will bring together more than 10 000 schoolchildren, who won the city, county and provincial preliminary matches. They are members of sports groups of schools throughout the country. They will compete in 18 events including basketball, Taekwon-Do, Ssirum and skiing. Attending the opening ceremony were Kim Sung Du, chairman of the Education Commission, Kim Il Guk, minister of Physical Culture and Sports, officials of the youth league and students. After the ceremony, there was a men's basketball match between Kang Pan Sok Senior Middle School and Kim Ju Hyok Senior Middle School in Mangyongdae District. Rodong News Team

title: Brazilian Figure Arrives
body: Gabriel Goncalves Martinez, chairman of the Brazilian Center for the Study of the Juche Idea, arrived here on Tuesday. Rodong News Team

title: Choe Ryong Hae Inspects Hadang Chicken Farm, Poultry Engineering Institute
body: Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, inspected the Hadang Chicken Farm and the Poultry Engineering Institute under the Academy of Agricultural Science. Looking round various places of the chicken farm, Choe Ryong Hae underlined the need to add glory to the honor of the farm as a unit associated with leadership exploits of the great leaders by settling the issue of breeding good species, making effective use of the sci-tech learning space, carrying out the breeding in a scientific way and putting production processes on automatic and assembly line. Inspecting the institute, he said that the institute should correctly set the goals of research as it plays an important role in developing the country's poultry farming and attain the goals step by step and settle sci-tech problems in time by giving full play to the creativity of researchers. The consultative meetings held on the spots discussed such issues as lowering the amount of feed consumption and putting the production of protein feed on an industrial way for increased meat and egg production, calling on their Party organizations to fulfill their responsibility and role in establishing a cultured way of production and life. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Shining Star to Be Marked in Nigeria
body: A Nigerian preparatory committee for celebrating Chairman Kim Jong Il's birth anniversary (the Day of the Shining Star) was formed in Abuja on Jan. 17. Ibrahim Mantu, member of the Credit Committee of the People's Democratic Party of Nigeria and chairman of the Nigeria-Korea Friendship Association, was elected as chairman of the preparatory committee. title: Seminars Held in Egypt, DR Congo
body: Seminars on the New Year Address of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un took place in Egypt and DR Congo on Jan. 14 and 16. Attending the events were personages of the Socialist Freedom Party of Egypt, Nasser Arab Democratic Party of Egypt, National Progressive Unionist Party of Egypt, Egypt-Korea Friendship Association, Communist Party of DR Congo, the National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of DR Congo, DR Congo-Korea Friendship and Solidarity Association and the Youth Group for the Study of the Juche Idea in DR Congo, and masses. Nzemba Yangana, chairman of the Youth Group for the Study of the Juche Idea in DR Congo, said that the Korean people, through the celebrations of the 70th birthday of the DPRK held last year, fully demonstrated the might of socialist Korea once again and showed their firm will to accelerate the building of a powerful country, rallied close around their leader. The positive events which took place in the Korean peninsula are the great fruits of the firm will of HE Kim Jong Un to reunify the country and his broadmindedness, he said. HE Kim Jong Un's New Year Address deals with the tasks and ways of speeding up socialist construction under the unfurled banner of self-reliance and the principled and just stand of the Workers' Party of Korea and the government of the DPRK for developing the inter-Korean relations and international relations, he noted. He said that the New Year Address serves as a priceless textbook for the Korean people and other world peace-loving progressives. He extended full support and solidarity to the struggle of the Korean people dynamically advancing under the wise guidance of HE Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Work Introduced in DR Congo
body: The full text of Chairman Kim Jong Il's work "On Preserving the Juche Character and National Character of the Revolution and Construction" was posted on the website of the National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of Democratic Congo on Jan. 16. The work, published on June 19, Juche 86 (1997), clarifies the idea that to preserve the Juche character and national character of the revolution and construction serves as a basic principle to be maintained in accomplishing socialist cause and the tasks and ways of preserving the Juche character and national character of the revolution and construction. The website carried Kim Jong Il's smiling image. Rodong News Team

title: Downfall of Capitalism Is Inevitable
body: The bourgeois reptile media claim that the capitalist society is the “rich society” and “welfare society” full of material wealth with developed economy, talking about its “eternity”. This is nothing but a sheer sophism to cover up the true color of the unpopular and depraved capitalist society. Capitalism is by no means a rich society good to live. Although it has an abundant material wealth, it does not serve people’s sound material life but spoils people both mentally and physically. A poor mental and cultural life shows another aspect of corruptness of capitalism. In the capitalist society the corrupt bourgeois life style is rampant so as to benumb sound spirit of people and lead them to ignorance and darkness. People are seized with uneasiness and horror in the capitalist society because way of life based on the jungle law becomes a social trend and all sorts of social evils including immortality and corruption, fraud and swindle and crimes of violence prevail. The corruption of capitalism can be clearly found in people’s political life. The capitalist class is clinging to the crafty moves to appease and win over the popular masses in a bid to keep its privileged position, strengthening its reactionary ruling machinery and suppressing the working people’s demand for independence and political freedom. This aggravates the split of society. Herein lies the inevitability of downfall of capitalism. Capitalism is not so civilized and eternal one just as the Western politicians and their advocators tout. The downfall of capitalism is inevitable as it has an incurable illness. Ri Hak Nam

title: Major Contents of Principle of Our State First
body: The miraculous successes made by the Democratic People’ Republic of Korea in building a prosperous country in the past are the major contents of the principle of our state first. The DPRK is the country of the dignified people, the country of single-minded unity in which the unity of thoughts is realized, the country of miracles which built the self-supporting national economy and military capability for self-defence and the promising country in which the succession is firm. The DPRK is, indeed, a genuine country of the people in which the position and role of the popular masses as the master of the state and society are being institutionally guaranteed and the idea of believing in the people as in Heaven and the most advantageous popular policies are being applied. It is the matchless and great country and invincible power in which everything of the state and society serves the people and the popular masses fulfill their responsibility and role as the master. There is no country but the DPRK the whole society of which has been imbued with the monolithic idea and the single-minded unity between the Party and people realized. The prospect of the development of the DPRK is very great as it has the powerful self-supporting national economy and military capability for self-defence, and the DPRK has huge influence on the international arena. The DPRK has given special priority to the issues of succession to the leadership and the revolutionary tradition and directed great efforts to building the youth power. Herein lies the essential secret of the DPRK which remains unfazed in any storms. It is the great pride and honor of Juche Korea that it perfectly settled the issue of succession, the knotty problem of other countries, theoretically and practically. Myong Ju Hyok

title: Making Bean Curds
body: Our country is the home of beans. Our people have developed a variety of bean dishes from olden times. Well-swollen beans are milled, the product is bagged up and its protein ingredients are squeezed. The ingredients are boiled and mixed with a small amount of brine or seawater to curdle them. As one likes, bean curds remain softly curdled or softly-curdled bean curds are poured into a frame and pressed down for hardening purposes. They are cut into cubes then. According to the true records of the feudal dynasty of Korea, the king of a foreign country said in the Court over and over that bean curds tasted most delicious of many dishes cooked by a Korean woman. There are scores of kinds of bean curds like coarse bean curds which are said to be too firm to crumble though bound with straw ropes, warm and fresh bean curds softly curdled, frozen bean curds, mellowed bean curds, bean curds fried in oil, medicinal bean curds containing loaches and bean curds hardened with hemp cloth and silk respectively. The old records show that our country boasted softly-curdled bean curd soup, bean curds prepared with greens and bean paste, loach and bean curd soup, bean curd casserole, steamed bean curds, roasted oyster and bean curds, steamed wax gourd and bean curds, etc. Bean curds are widely spread to other counties together with kimchi, red pepper bean paste, etc and various dishes of bean curds enjoy popularity there, too. Bean-curd making was inscribed in the list of the intangible cultural heritage of the nation. Rim Song I

title: DPRK Friendship Art Delegation Leaves for China
body: The friendship art delegation of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea led by Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, left here on Wednesday afternoon to visit the People's Republic of China at the invitation of the International Liaison Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China. It is composed of the State Merited Chorus and leading artistes in Pyongyang City. The delegation was seen off by senior officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea Kim Ki Nam, Kim Yo Jong, Kwon Hyok Bong and Ri Chang Gun and others. Li Jinjun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK, and his embassy official saw off the delegation. Rodong News Team

title: New Posters Produced in DPRK
body: New posters were produced in the DPRK to inspire the people to carry through the tasks set forth by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in his historic New Year Address. Posters "Let us open a new road of advance for socialist construction under the uplifted banner of self-reliance!" and "Let all of us turn out in implementing the tasks set forth in the New Year Address!" call on all the Party members and other working people to work hard in the indefatigable spirit on the principle of self-reliance by adhering to the Party's new strategic line and bring about a revolutionary upswing on all fronts of socialist construction. Another poster "Talented personnel, science and technology are our major strategic resources and weapons in socialist construction!" reflects the Party's policy of prioritizing science and technology and revolutionary policy for education. Posters "Let us give impetus to hitting the targets of the five-year strategy for national economic development!" and "Let us achieve a greater development in establishing the Juche orientation in the metallurgical and chemical industries!" call on all the sectors and units to successfully carry out the targets of this year's struggle by effecting a great revolutionary upsurge. Posters "Let us conduct a campaign for increased production on the agricultural front, the major point of attack!", "Let us open a new path for developing the fishing industry!" and "Let us produce and supply various kinds of consumer goods that are favoured by the people in the sector of light industry!" reflect the Party's intention to improve the people's standard of living radically. A poster "Let the young people become pioneers of new technology, creators of new culture and pathfinders for a great leap forward!" calls on the young people to glorify the honor of vanguard and shock brigade on all fronts of socialist construction. Rodong News Team

title: Modern Sports Centers under Construction
body: Up-to-date sports centers are being built apace in the Ryuldong area of Tongdaewon District east of Pyongyang. They comprise 14 buildings, including the Pyongyang Football School and its dormitory, a general building of a municipal air club, an agency for mass air sports techniques, an office building and terraces of the East Pyongyang Stadium, plus major and minor football pitches, volleyball and basketball courts and a running track. All the sports construction projects are completed in the main. 11 buildings are finished. Brisk arrangements are made to pave the ground of the pitches and courts with concrete and carpet it with artificial turfs and rubber slabs. Choe Su Bok

title: High-Performance Flow Meter of Our Style Devised
body: The scientists of the Automation Engineering Faculty of Kim Chaek University of Technology recently developed a high-performance conical flow meter on their own. Highly efficient flow meters were badly needed in many sectors of our country to put their productive processes on a modern and IT basis. The scientists of the faculty aimed at devising them for themselves and fully applied themselves to it. They pored over the literature on related technology and got firsthand knowledge of our specific field conditions. Meantime, they devoted themselves wholly day and night to developing a novel flow meter suited to our actualities. In the course of this, they hit upon an idea of a unique multi-advantaged conical flow meter. They worked hard on it and finally succeeded in inventing the flow meter on their own. The flow meter was inscribed in the list of hi-tech products last year. Ryo Myong Hui

title: Out for Increased Coal Production
body: A fierce general offensive is going on in the forefront of developing self-supporting economy to increase coal production. From the outset of the New Year the officials and miners of the coal-mining industry struggle hard in the spirit of self-reliance with indomitable fortitude to boost their coal output in all the mines of the country day by day. As a result, the Ministry of Coal Industry has so far overfulfilled its coal production plan by tens of thousands of tons. Myong Chun Gil

title: DPRK Sets National Memorial Days
body: The DPRK set July 8 and December 17, death anniversaries of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, as the national memorial days and decided to raise flags at half-mast on the days every year. A relevant decree of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK was made public on Thursday. Rodong News Team

title: Koreans in China Call for Reunification Movement
body: A spokesman for the General Association of Koreans in China on Jan. 21 made public a statement calling for actively turning out in the struggle for ironing out the military hostility between north and south of Korea and achieving peace, prosperity and reunification of the Korean peninsula. The statement pointed out that the peerlessly great man Kim Jong Un's patriotic appeal for eradicating military hostility between north and south and making the Korean peninsula a durable and lasting peace zone has evoked unanimous support and welcome from all the fellow countrymen. It went on: However, from the beginning of the year the south Korean military have put spurs to the introduction of military hardware from abroad and launched provocative war exercises against the requirements of the situation and the atmosphere of improved inter-Korean relations, stoking confrontation. The south Korean military have to learn a lesson from the doom of the predecessors who were given due punishment by the people for their criminal acts of destroying the north-south relations with confrontation and war moves at the outsiders' beck and call, and desist from committing acts of straining the situation on the Korean peninsula. All the Koreans who desire peace and reunification should never tolerate all the anti-reunification acts of blocking national reconciliation and unity and going against the development of inter-Korean relations and peace and prosperity. Today when all the fellow countrymen want peace and prosperity, the south Korean authorities should not read outsiders' face but thoroughly observe and implement the north-south agreements so as to join the powerful, patriotic stream of all the fellow countrymen towards peace and reunification of the Korean peninsula. All the fellow countrymen in north, south and abroad should staunchly oppose and reject the outsiders' moves for domination, interference and war of aggression and dangerous military conspiracies that follow in with them as they are contrary to the atmosphere of reconciliation between north and south. Rodong News Team

title: Joint Conference of DPRK Government, Political Parties and Organizations Held
body: A joint conference of the government, political parties and organizations of the DPRK took place at the People's Palace of Culture on Wednesday. Present there were Yang Hyong Sop, Kim Yong Chol and Ro Tu Chol, the chairman of a friendly party, officials of public organizations, members of the North Side Committee for Implementing June 15 Joint Declaration, the north headquarters of the Pan-National Alliance for Korea's Reunification and the Pan-National Alliance of Youth and Students for Korea's Reunification and the Consultative Council for National Reconciliation and representatives of the government, political parties and organizations of the DPRK. The conference discussed the tasks of the government, political parties and organizations of the DPRK for carrying through the tasks for national reunification set forth by respected Supreme Leader Comrade Kim Jong Un in his historic New Year Address. Yang Hyong Sop, vice-president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, made a report to be followed by speeches. The reporter and speakers stressed that the principled stand and proposal for developing the north-south relations and ensuring a lasting and durable peace of the Korean peninsula and the ways for realizing them set forth by Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address are the highly important guidelines which reflect most correctly the aspirations and desires of Koreans and the requirement of the times. They said that dramatic events unprecedented in the history of national division were brought about by Kim Jong Un's bold decision, calling for turning out as one in the struggle to carry through the north-south declarations with the last year's precious successes as a springboard and making a greater progress in accomplishing the cause of national reunification. They called on all the Koreans in the north, the south and abroad to respond to the patriotic appeal of Kim Jong Un with nationwide advance to thoroughly implement the north-south declarations and thus glorify this year as a historic one in which another epoch-making turn is brought about in the journey for the development of north-south relations and peace and prosperity. An appeal to all the Koreans was adopted at the joint conference. Rodong News Team

title: Appeal to Koreans Adopted at DPRK Joint Conference
body: An appeal to all Koreans was adopted at the joint conference of the government, political parties and organizations of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea held here on Wednesday. The appeal said that the historic New Year Address made by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un is a bright path and signpost of victory for making greater advance in developing the inter-Korean relations and achieving peace and prosperity and accomplishing the cause of national reunification this year by the concerted efforts of the Korean nation. The government, political parties and organizations of the DPRK called in the appeal, reflecting all Koreans' unanimous demand and will to continue to make the proud history for national reconciliation and unity, peace and prosperity as follows: 1. Let all the fellow countrymen hold high the slogan "Let us usher in a heyday of peace, prosperity and reunification of the Korean peninsula by thoroughly implementing the historic north-south declarations!" Let the north and the south value the historic declarations made by them before the nation and consistently accelerate their implementation! Let the Koreans at home and abroad turn out as one in the patriotic movement for reunification to implement the north-south declarations with one mind wherever they live! 2. Let us eradicate military hostility between the north and the south and make the Korean Peninsula a durable and lasting peace zone! Let the whole Korean nation uproot the source of the military hostility on the Korean Peninsula and turn the three thousand-ri land of Korea into the true home, which is the most peaceful in the world and will prosper forever, in firm unity under the banner of peace against war! 3. Let us comprehensively expand and develop cooperation and exchange between the north and the south! Let the north and the south further accelerate cooperation and exchange between the north and the south that started the first step, deepen understanding and trust with each other and in this course, positively propel national reconciliation and unity! Let us heighten vigilance against the cunning moves of outsiders to create mistrust and bad blood between the north and the south and resolutely smash the sinister attempt to subordinate inter-Korean relations to their tastes and interests! 4. Let us make a proposal for peaceful reunification based on a nationwide agreement and make sincere efforts to realize it! It is necessary to pool their wisdom and efforts to make a nationwide proposal for reunification in line with the will and demand of the nation on the basis of recognizing ideologies and systems existing in the north and the south and allowing them. Let all of us further accelerate the nationwide advance for implementing the north-south declarations with the conviction in certain victory and courage and thus glorify this year as a historic one when another radical change is brought about in the development of inter-Korean relations and accomplishment of the cause of national reunification! Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Successful Visit to China Hailed by Guinean Figure
body: Riyad Chaloub, chairman of the Guinean National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, released a statement congratulating Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un on his successful visit to China on Jan. 19. The statement said that Kim Jong Un made a visit to China early in the New Year, thus making a great contribution to boosting the DPRK-China relations of friendship. He paid the fourth visit to China in a little more than nine months, which was unprecedented in the history of the world's diplomacy, it said. The historic meetings between the supreme leaders of the two countries were sure signs of comradely relations based on sincere trust, it stressed. It went on: The DPRK-China friendship provided by the preceding leaders of the two countries has kept developing. HE Kim Jong Un's China visit early this year marking the 70th anniversary of the establishment of the DPRK-China diplomatic ties is of great significance in further consolidating the DPRK-China friendship. title: Reception Arranged by DPRK Foreign Ministry
body: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the DPRK hosted a reception in honor of the diplomatic corps here Thursday on the occasion of the New Year, Juche 108 (2019). Invited to the reception were members of foreign embassies and missions of international bodies. Attending there were Minister Ri Yong Ho and other officials of the ministry. He hoped that good fruits would be made in the development of the bilateral relations through close communication and cooperation this year, too. Alexandr Matsegora, Russian ambassador to the DPRK, spoke next. title: Koreans Should Bring About Radical Turn in National Reunification
body: Three north-south summit meetings and talks took place and the Panmunjom Declaration and the September Pyongyang Joint Declaration and the north-south agreement in the military field were adopted last year. All Koreans in the north, the south and abroad should bring about a radical turn in the movement for national reunification this year on a basis of such successes. Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address set forth the slogan “Let us usher in a heyday of peace, prosperity and reunification of the Korean peninsula by thoroughly implementing the historic north-south declarations!” The whole compatriots should turn out as one in the struggle for the development of the north-south relations, peace and prosperity and national reunification, holding high the slogan. It is necessary to eradicate military hostility between the north and the south and make the Korean Peninsula a durable and lasting peace zone. Inter-Korean cooperation and exchanges should be expanded and developed in an all-round way so that national reconciliation and unity can be consolidated and all the fellow countrymen can practically benefit from improved north-south relations. All the Koreans in the north, the south and abroad should join and unite on the principle of subordinating everything to national reunification, the cause common to the nation, beyond the differences among ideologies, systems, regions, ideals, classes and strata and accelerate the movement for reunification in a nationwide scale. Koreans should never tolerate interference and intervention of outside forces that stand in the way of national reconciliation, unity and reunification with the design to subordinate inter-Korean relations to their tastes and interests. All the fellow countrymen, bearing in mind that the dignity and prosperity of the nation depends on them, should conduct the dynamic movement for national reunification true to the patriotic appeal made by the peerlessly great man. Ho Yong Min

title: 9th Enlarged Plenary Meeting of 9th C.C., Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League
body: The 9th enlarged plenary meeting of the 9th Central Committee of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League took place in Pyongyang on Thursday. Attending the meeting were members and alternate members of the Central Committee of the youth league and its officials. The meeting discussed the tasks of the league organizations for thoroughly carrying out the important tasks set forth by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address and holding the principle of our state first. Speeches followed a report made by Pak Chol Min, first secretary of the C.C., youth league. The reporter and speakers said that Kim Jong Un's New Year Address is an inspiring banner as it gives tremendous strength and courage to the youth across the country who turned out in the general advance for bringing about a revolutionary upswing on all fronts of socialist construction by regarding self-reliance as a treasured sword for prosperity. They underscored the need to dynamically demonstrate once again strong revolutionary spirit and bravery of five million youth vanguard in the present general advance for building a powerful socialist country by strengthening the militant function and role of the youth league in every way true to the idea and leadership of Kim Jong Un. An appeal to the youth league organizations and youth across the country was read out there. The appeal called upon the youth league organizations and youth of the country to fully demonstrate the heroic spirit in the great era of Kim Jong Un as youth vanguard who are dashing forward and always marching straightly toward the Party by fully displaying the mental power of the Korean youth in the van of the general offensive campaign to open a new road of advance for socialist construction under the uplifted banner of self-reliance. title: Editorial
body: Let Us Step Up Construction of Highly Civilized Socialist Country Building a highly civilized socialist country is an important work for bringing up all the people to be those responsible for the socialist construction who are possessed of rich knowledge and high cultural attainments and for creating conditions and environment for them to lead an affluent and highly civilized life. Today when the DPRK has ranked itself with dignity among political and military powers, it presents itself as an urgent task for them to build a highly civilized country along with robust economic construction. A shortcut to building a powerful socialist country is to usher in an overall heyday in all the fields of the cultural construction, including education, public health, literature and art and sports. The DPRK is demonstrating its dignity as the only state in the world which has successfully fulfilled the fundamental and crucial tasks of building a prosperous and independent state. A powerful spur given to building a highly civilized socialist country will precisely lead to the advancement and development of the DPRK onto a higher stage and the hurrahs for socialism. Only when all the fields of building a highly civilized country are put on the level desired by the Party ranging from the mental and moral traits and costumes to culinary culture, will it be possible for the people living in the great motherland to cherish stronger pride and self-esteem and to further manifest the advantages and might of Korean-style socialism. We have valuable traditions and powerful potentials for spurring the building of a highly civilized socialist country at a fast pace. All people should dynamically step up the construction of a highly civilized socialist country so as to turn our country into a socialist paradise envied by the world.

title: Brush Plating Technology Applied
body: The scientists of the Mechanical Engineering Research Institute under the State Academy of Sciences carried on tireless scientific researches into brush plating technology. Meantime, they successfully solved many difficult and complicated scientific and technological problems of applying brush plating technology to our country and introduced it into numerous units. They updated the technology through ceaseless in-depth researches and continued to apply it to many more other fields. While applying brush plating technology in close cooperation with work leaders and field technicians, the scientists greatly helped toward ensuring that related units easily restored and used worn-out machine parts at a low cost and profited a lot from it. The MERI incessantly intensifies its scientific researches into brush plating technology for perfecting purposes, and on the other hand, makes active efforts to introduce it into many realms of the national economy. Ryo Myong Hui

title: Flexible Starter Devised for Coal Mines
body: The Tongrim Electric Appliance Factory makes furious efforts to implement the tasks set by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address. It developed a novel flexible starter for coal mines and made it on a trial basis in cooperation with the researchers of the Power-driven Machine Institute of the State Academy of Sciences. The starter is no longer faulty like the former flameproof electronic switch. Besides having many advantages, it can be made and used most conveniently. Unlike the former switch, the starter can be used safely everywhere in pit faces because it operates like a circuit-changing switch. Moreover, its starting current can be determined at one’s option to use the starter at will under various loads. Besides, the kind and number of its accessories are reduced sharply and its jig and fittings made simply, thus lightening the starter and cutting its production cost considerably. The managerial staff, technicians and workers of the TEAF make steady successful efforts to improve the efficiency of the starter for many of it to be introduced into coal mines. Sim Hak Chol

title: Cuban Ambassador Arranges Reception
body: Jesus De Los Angeles Aise Sotolongo, Cuban ambassador to the DPRK, hosted a reception at the general-service ship Mujigae on Monday on the occasion of the 60th anniversary of the victory of Cuban revolution. Invited to the reception were Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the C.C., WPK, Kim Sung Du, chairman of the Education Commission who is chairman of the Korean Committee for Solidarity with Cuba, Kim Yong Jae, minister of External Economic Relations, Kim Jong Suk, chairwoman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries, and officials concerned. Present there were members of the Cuban embassy here. Jesus De Los Angeles Aise Sotolongo made a speech. He recalled that the Cuban people overthrew the reactionary dictatorial regime under the guidance of Fidel Castro Ruz on Jan. 1, 1959 and established the socialist system, the first of its kind in the Western hemisphere. Saying that the Cuban people and the Korean people have supported with each other in the anti-imperialist struggle, he vowed to value and invariably develop the good comradely relations made by the preceding leaders of the two countries. Choe Ryong Hae in a speech said that after the victory of the revolution, the Cuban people have resolutely repelled the imperialists' moves and registered brilliant victory in the struggle for defending the socialist cause. Saying that the Korean people would invariably support the just cause of the Cuban people, he expressed the stand of the WPK and government of the DPRK to steadily boost the unity and cooperation with socialist countries in the idea of independence, peace and friendship. Rodong News Team

title: Choe Ryong Hae Inspects Namhung Youth Chemical Complex, Anju Duck Farm
body: Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, inspected the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex and the Anju Duck Farm. Looking round various places of the Chemical Complex, Choe Ryong Hae gave a pep talk to its officials and workers bringing about a great upsurge in production. The field consultative meeting said that its Party committee should encourage Party members and other working people to take the lead in establishing a cultured way of production and life and increase production by scrupulously managing equipment and improve technical control with a great honor of working at the glorious workplace associated with the leadership exploits of the peerlessly great persons. And measures were discussed for relevant units to supply electricity, coal and others on a regular basis for putting production on a normal track. Learning about the updating of the Anju Duck Farm, Choe Ryong Hae stressed the need to actively accelerate the project and produce more meat by adhering to the four key factors for the development of livestock farming. Rodong News Team

title: "Complete Collection of Kim Jong Il's Works" Vol. 24 off Press
body: Volume 24 of "Complete Collection of Kim Jong Il's Works", a library of undying Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism which comprehensively records the works of Chairman Kim Jong Il in a chronological and systematic order, was published by the Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House. The book contains 47 works including talks and speeches made public by Kim Jong Il in the period from Aug. to Dec. Juche 63 (1974). In his works such as "Let Us Expedite Modelling the Whole Society on Kimilsungism by Fundamentally Improving the Party Work", he gave a comprehensive indication of the theoretical and practical issues arising in strengthening the Party and enhancing its role. "On the Art of Opera" and some other works cover his energetic guidance to art and literature. The book has works on the ideas that the Party guidance to economic construction is a political guidance and that efforts should be made to keep making productive leap, without slackening the revolutionary spirit displayed at the 70-day campaign. Contained in it are works on the orientation and ways for deeply studying the scientific farming methods created by President Kim Il Sung and intensifying the political work among working people. It includes works that serve as invaluable guidelines for leading the socialist cause of Juche to victory. Rodong News Team

title: KPISF Commanding Officers Tour Revolutionary Battle Sites in Mt Paektu Area
body: Commanding officers of the Korean People's Internal Security Forces (KPISF) toured the revolutionary battle sites in Mt Paektu Area from Jan. 20 to 28. They departed Hyesan and reached Pochonbo, where they placed a floral basket and bouquets at the statue of President Kim Il Sung on the shore of Stream Karim and made a bow to him. They looked round the command post of the Battle of Pochonbo, the Police Sub-station, the subcounty office, and other places in Pochonbo Revolutionary Battle Site. At the Rimyongsu Revolutionary Site, the visitors remembered the intention of Chairman Kim Jong Il who started a journey for a study tour of the revolutionary battle sites in the area of Mt Paektu in order to add luster to the revolutionary traditions of Paektu, eternal cornerstone of the Workers' Party of Korea and revolution. After visiting Chongbong and Konchang bivouacs, they arrived at Kim Jong Il's birthplace in the Paektusan Secret Camp to look around the historical mementoes preserved there. They reached the Monument to the Victorious Battle of Musan Area through Mupho Bivouac; looked around groups of large subsidiary theme sculptures, and visited Paektusan Hero Youth Power Station. They had a meeting to pledge to be loyal to the guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un at the Samjiyon Grand Monument. During the study tour, they handed over farming materials to agricultural workers and went to the construction sites in the area of the township of Samjiyon. They held colorful political and cultural events such as a meeting to hear impressions of the reminiscences of anti-Japanese guerrillas, a poem recitation meeting and a contest of singing revolutionary songs in chorus during their tour. title: Party’s Leadership Is Decisive Guarantee for Applying Our-State-First Principle
body: With a view to successfully carrying out the sacred task of writing a great history of the country today, all the party members and other working people should be loyal to the Party’s leadership, being proud that our state is first. The Party’s leadership is a decisive guarantee for the accomplishment of the independent cause of the popular masses and the socialist cause. The cause of building a powerful socialist country, whose power is strong and which will always be prospering and where the people will lead the happiest life in the world to the full, can successfully be pioneered, advanced and accomplished by the Party’s leadership only. The praiseworthy history of our Republic is the proud course during which it set an example of the era in building an independent and prosperous state. During the days, epoch-making changes unprecedented in the 5 000-year-long history of the nation took place in the country. All the victories and successes achieved by our Republic are the precious fruits of the wise leadership of the Party. The wise leadership of the Party is a source of the invincible strength of our state which has further increased in the face of the trials. The leadership of the Party which continues bringing about a surge in all fields of revolution and construction to successfully push forward with the cause of building a powerful socialist country serves as a fundamental source for encouraging the people to rush forward towards the bright future like the wind, making a new history of great changes on this land. Jang Im Hyang

title: Hostile Forces Should Behave Themselves
body: The U.S., Japan and south Korean conservatives make reckless remarks, being displeased with the climate for peace prevalent on the Korean peninsula. Of late they say a hole is made in the cooperation for sanctions against the DPRK and that the south Korean authorities destroy the U.S.-Japan-south Korea cooperation as they are at loggerheads with Japan. As regards the moves of many countries to resume cooperation with the DPRK, they say that the sanctions resolutions against the DPRK can be scraped. Their claim is nothing but behaviors of political underwits without an elementary sense of judgment and the times. Those who assert that sanctions and pressure upon the DPRK should be kept until denuclearization is realized are just guys who do not want the improvement of the DPRK-U.S. relations and stable situation of the Korean peninsula. Sanctions do not work on the DPRK at all as it moves forward in the spirit of self-reliance and self-development. The DPRK can make a dynamic advance along the road of the development of Korean-style socialism in reliance upon the efforts of its people without any external assistance and somebody’s help. The hostile forces who press for sustained sanctions and pressure upon the DPRK would be well advised to lend their ears to the demand of the international community that an action should be taken to respond to the DPRK’s preemptive efforts, and behave themselves with reason. Ri Hak Nam

title: Successful Performances Given by DPRK Friendship Art Delegation in China
body: The friendship art delegation of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) is visiting the People's Republic of China (PRC) from January 23. The delegation has received a warm hospitality from the Chinese party, government and people since it arrived at Dandong Railway Station, border station of China. It arrived in Beijing on the morning of January 24. It was warmly greeted at Beijing Railway Station by Song Tao, head of the International Liaison Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC), and other cadres of the department and officials concerned. The DPRK friendship art delegation gave performances before full houses at the State Grand Theatre in Beijing from Jan. 26. Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and president of the People's Republic of China, and his wife Peng Liyuan met the DPRK friendship art delegation and enjoyed the performance at the theatre on Jan. 27. Prior to the performance Xi Jinping and Peng Liyuan met leading members of the delegation and had a talk with them. Xi Jinping said that the performance of the delegation is not only cultural exchange for the implementation of an important shared understanding between China and the DPRK but also an important activity for celebrating the 70th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between them, expressing his will to consolidate the traditional China-DPRK friendship. Noting that he was moved by the good performance prepared by the Korean comrades, he congratulated the DPRK friendship art delegation upon its great success. Saying that the cultural and art exchange is a very special and traditional major component of the China-DPRK relations, he hoped that the two sides would make joint efforts for positive contributions to the promotion of the building of socialist culture. Ri Su Yong, who is leading the delegation, said that every number of the program prepared by the delegation is associated with the noble intention of the chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, to carry forward the valuable tradition of the DPRK-China friendship as required by the new times and steadily develop the feelings of friendship between the two peoples and thus add a brilliant page to the history of the DPRK-China relations. Expressing thanks to Xi Jinping for prioritizing and paying attention to the performing tour of the delegation, he hoped that the current performance would be the New Year greetings to the Chinese comrades. Xi Jinping together with Peng Liyuan appreciated the performance given by the delegation. Among the audience were Wang Huning, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau and member of the Secretariat of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China; Ding Xuexiang, member of the Political Bureau and member of the Secretariat and director of the General Office of the C.C., CPC; Sun Chunlan, member of the Political Bureau of the C.C., CPC and vice-premier of the State Council; Yang Jiechi, member of the Political Bureau and director of the Office of the Foreign Affairs Commission of the C.C., CPC; Huang Kunming, member of the Political Bureau, member of the Secretariat and head of the Publicity Department of the C.C., CPC; Cai Qi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and secretary of the Beijing Municipal Committee of the CPC; Wang Yi, state councilor and minister of Foreign Affairs of the PRC; Song Tao, head of the International Liaison Department of the CPC Central Committee; and other officials of the Chinese party and government, artistes and citizens of Beijing. Put on the stage, which started with the prelude "Korea-China Friendship Will Be Ever-lasting", were colorful music and dance pieces including favorite songs of the two peoples dating back to the annuls of the heroic creation and struggle. Amid the playing of songs of friendship and unity rocking the mountains and rivers of the two countries, impressive pictures of the leaders of the elder generations of the two countries and the supreme leaders of the two parties, who have shared the intention and feelings in the great course of the DPRK-China friendship, meeting with each other were screened to win enthusiastic applauses. Put on the stage were colorful numbers such as female solo and male chorus "We Love You, Socialism" and song and dance "Dash toward Future" depicting dignity and rosy future of the DPRK advancing along the road of Korean-style socialism while demonstrating the might of the single-minded unity under the wise guidance of the Workers' Party of Korea. Also put on the stage were female duet and male chorus "Song of Changjiang" and other Chinese songs sung in the annals of prosperity of the Chinese nation as well as the proud 70-year long history of new China, which were performed by male choruses of the State Merited Chorus. The songs reflecting the time-honored history of China and the patriotic emotion and optimism of the Chinese people gripped the minds of the audience. The performance was loudly applauded as it made a vigorous and fresh representation of the aspirations and desire of the peoples of the DPRK and China to more beautifully write an epic of friendship and unity to be envied by the whole world. Xi Jinping and Peng Liyuan presented a floral basket to the performers and mounted the stage to congratulate them on their successful performance and had a photo taken with them. The performance continued until Jan. 28. The State Grand Theater, where the hot wind of enjoying the revolutionary opera "The Flower Girl" and the wonderfully adapted opera "A Dream of Red Mansions" was raised fiercely, was crowded every day with the audience who came to appreciate the performance of the Korean artistes. Among the audience were Li Zhanshu, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the C.C., CPC, and chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress of the People's Republic of China, and other senior officials of the Chinese party and government, artistes and citizens of Beijing. Three-day performances full of hot air of the DPRK-China friendship drew down a curtain, being loudly applauded. During the stay the delegation enjoyed welcome performances given by the Chinese National Ballet at the Tianqiao Theatre in Beijing and by the opera troupe of the Chinese National Opera Theatre and toured the Capital Museum, Lao She Teahouse and the Chinese Art Gallery. The Central Committee of the Communist Party of China gave a hearty welcome to the friendship art delegation of the DPRK during its China visit at the instruction and upon authorization of Xi Jinping. The art delegation achieved a rich success under the special care of the supreme leaders of the two parties and the two countries of the DPRK and China. Rodong News Team
