title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Work Introduced in Czech Republic
body: The Paektusan Czech-Korean Friendship Association and the Czech Group for the Study and Materialization of the Juche Idea posted on its website the full text of Chairman Kim Jong Il's work "The Democratic People's Republic of Korea Is a Juche-oriented Socialist State with Invincible Might" to mark the Day of the Shining Star, his birth anniversary, on Jan. 21. The work, published on September 5, Juche 97 (2008), says in detail that the invincible might of the DPRK lies in defending and adding eternal luster to the Juche-oriented nation-building idea and exploits of President Kim Il Sung. The website carried Kim Jong Il's photo. Rodong News Team

title: U.S. Blasted for Its Demand for Increased Upkeep of Its Forces
body: Civic and public organizations of south Korea struggle against the U.S. every day in protest of the U.S. demand for the increased upkeep of its forces, according to the south Korean internet newspaper OhmyNews. The Pusan Headquarters of the Movement for Uprooting Deep-seated Evils and Realizing Great Social Reforms held a press conference outside the building of the U.S. Consulate in Pusan on January 25 in which it said it was an anachronistic act going against the atmosphere for peace that the U.S. presses for increase in the upkeep of its forces at a time when the south and the north promised to take measures to ease military tensions and substantially remove the danger of a war on the Korean peninsula and have worked to implement it. If the U.S. does not retract its brigandish demand, it will face all-people protest, the organisation warned. The South Kyongsang Provincial Progressive Federation said that the U.S. demand for the increased upkeep of its forces was aimed to suck the blood and sweets of the people who work at the risk of their lives and infringe upon the sovereignty of south Korea under the pretext of alliance. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Has Photo Session with DPRK Friendship Art Delegation
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the Korean People's Army, on Thursday met the members of the friendship art delegation of the DPRK, who came back home after successfully winding up the visit to the People's Republic of China, at the office building of the Party Central Committee and had a photo session with them. All the members of the delegation broke into cheers, looking up to Supreme Leader of the Party, state and army Kim Jong Un who not only provided energetic guidance over all the preparations for the art performance so as to make the art performance in China a meaningful occasion in adding luster to the new era of the DPRK-China friendship but also warmly encouraged them far away from the country by sending several messages of thanks to them in congratulation on their successful performance so as to make sure that the song of friendship resounded higher and wider. Exchanging greetings with the members of the delegation, the Supreme Leader highly appreciated the art delegation for giving the wonderful and enthusiastic art performances reflecting the true intention and sincerity of the WPK and the Korean people for the Chinese party and people to significantly decorate the start of the cultural exchange between the DPRK and China this year and for putting into practice with rich and successful performance the intention of the Party Central Committee to develop the DPRK-China friendship as required by the new era. Expressing his satisfaction over the fact that the artistes fully displayed high artistic skill and talents and provided smooth performances in China to please the respected General Secretary Xi Jinping and his wife and the members of the Communist Party of China and the Chinese people, the Supreme Leader sent thanks to all the members of the art delegation who made active contributions to putting spurs to the emotion and cultural bonds between the two peoples of the DPRK and China and to further consolidating them. He expressed the great belief that the artistes who successfully provided the art performances in China would as ever more courageously conduct fresh performing activities reflecting the Party's ideology and will as active disseminators and mouthpieces of the Party's policies and thus powerfully encourage the Korean people in their struggle to defend the Party and socialism and to build the strong Korean-style socialist state and discharge their honorable mission and duty as core forces for developing Juche-oriented music and art, before having a significant photo session with them. Political News Team

title: Foot-and-Mouth Disease Spreads in S. Korea
body: According to the south Korean KBS, foot-and-mouth disease spreads in Kyonggi Province of south Korea, causing social concerns. It was confirmed that some cows of a peasant's family in Ansong, Kyonggi Province, took foot-and-mouth disease on Jan. 29. On Jan. 28 the same disease was confirmed at another peasant's family 11 kilometers away. Rodong News Team

title: Hwang Kyo An Should Have Already Gone to Doom: S. Korean Internet Paper
body: The south Korean internet paper Voice of People carried an editorial on January 30 under the title of "Hwang Kyo An who should have already gone to doom". The editorial said that Hwang Kyo An, former "prime minister", asserted that the "forces praising the north occupied the Kwanghwamun" at a ceremony for the run for the representative of the party. It said that Hwang proclaimed the coloring at the ceremony showing what he seeks in politics. It went on: Hwang Kyo An has no qualification to talk about the democracy as he took the lead in dictatorial rule based on the "Security Law" and the "law on assembly and demonstration". Hwang Kyo An is proud of the disorganization of the Unified Progressive Party, a hideous incident which is called a precedent of destroying democracy in the world. It is height of impudence. Rodong News Team

title: Setup of Memorial for Victims of Ferry Sewol Disaster Called for
body: The "people's emergency measure committee for the setup of Paengmok memorial", a civic organization of south Korea, held a press conference on January 28 in demand of the setup of the April 16 memorial for honoring victims of Ferry Sewol disaster at Paengmok Port of Jin Islet of South Jolla Province, the Seoul Economic Daily of south Korea said. Speakers said that the project plan for developing the port resumed last year has not any element related with the disaster. They called for arranging the memorial place at the port and erecting the monument to victims. Rodong News Team

title: Compensation for Environmental Pollution Damage by U.S. Military Base Demanded
body: According to the south Korean Yonhap News, the Seoul Central District Court on Jan. 27 made a decision that compensation should be made for environmental pollution damage by the U.S. military base in Ryongsan. The court said that pollutants flowed out of the U.S. military base for several years to contaminate areas of Seoul City and as a result a compensation suit has been filed without letup. It added that the base is responsible for the compensation. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Introduced in Brazil
body: The Brazilian Center for the Study of Songun Politics posted on its website Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us Step Up the Building of a Thriving Country by Applying Kim Jong Il's Patriotism" on Jan. 23. The work, published on July 26, Juche 101(2012), deals with the essence of Kim Jong Il's patriotism and his life constant in noble patriotism and loving care for the people. It also indicates the important matters arising in applying Kim Jong Il's patriotism. The website carried Kim Jong Un's photo. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Successful Visit to China Hailed by Austrian Organization
body: The Youth Group for Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism in Vienna, Austria released a statement on January 21 in congratulation of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's historic successful visit to China. The statement said that they heard the news of Kim Jong Un's visit to China with great excitement. Noting Xi Jinping's warm hospitality is an expression of the deepest respect for Kim Jong Un, it said his recent visit proved that the DPRK-China friendship and unity are the invincible ones with a long history and tradition. It added: We will as ever extend invariable support to the Korean people's just cause. Rodong News Team

title: New Stamps Issued in DPRK
body: Stamps (one sheet and seven individuals) reflecting the gist of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un’s New Year Address were issued in the DPRK. Printed on the upper part of the sheet is “Let us open a new road of advance for socialist construction under the uplifted banner of self-reliance!”, a slogan to be held up by the Korean people this year. The sheet carries a stamp depicting working people determined to bring about a revolutionary upswing on all fronts of socialist construction against the background of national flag and national tree-pine. Reflected in individual stamps carrying teachings of the Supreme Leader are the tasks advanced in the New Year Address to further strengthen the might of the independent socialist economy, consolidate the politico-ideological strength of our socialist state in every way, step up the construction of a highly-civilized socialist country and bolster up the national defence capabilities. And they represent the tasks facing the respective sectors to promote talent training and sci-tech development purposefully and improve the people’s standard of living radically. Displayed in a stamp depicting the Korean map and white pigeons against the background of the globe under the slogan “Let us usher in a heyday of peace, prosperity and reunification of the Korean peninsula by thoroughly implementing the historic north-south declarations!” are the task for the development of north-south relations and the national reunification and the foreign political stand of the DPRK set forth in the New Year Address. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Visit to China Hailed by Figure of DR Congo
body: Andre Lohekele Kalonda, chairman of the National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of DR Congo, released a statement on January 21 in congratulation of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's successful visit to China. He said that the Juche idea followers in Africa warmly congratulated Kim Jong Un on his visit to China. He noted that Kim Jong Un's recent visit to China early this year marking the 70th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic ties between the DPRK and China was the fourth visit in a little more than 9 months and it was unprecedented in the history of the world's diplomacy. It is of great significance in demonstrating before the world the immutability and invincibility of the deep-rooted DPRK-China friendship made by the leaders of the elder generation of the two countries and defending peace and stability in the Korean Peninsula and the region, he stated. The continuous visits to China to be specially recorded in the history of the DPRK-China friendship and unity is an expression of Kim Jong Un's steadfast will to carry forward and develop the friendly relations between the two countries through generations, he stressed. He added that the Korean people will achieve greater successes in socialist construction by dint of self-reliance under the wise leadership of Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: Appeal to Entire Korean Nation Backed
body: The European Regional Headquarters of the Pan-national Alliance for Korea's Reunification on Jan. 26 called upon overseas Koreans to proactively turn out in the patriotic movement for reunification in support of the appeal to the entire Korean nation adopted at the joint conference of the government, political parties and organizations of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. Overseas Koreans should positively support the historic appeal calling them a companion of the reunification movement out of patriotism, it said. It said that it is important to value the historic north-south declarations and consistently implement them as mentioned in the appeal. It went on: Overseas Koreans live in different places, but they should turn out as one in the patriotic movement for reunification to implement the north-south declarations with a single mind. The stand and attitude towards the declarations constitute a touchstone to distinguish between independence and sycophancy, between reunification and division and between patriotism and treachery. It is the Korean nation that wants peace of the Korean peninsula and has the strength to defend it. There is no need to read other's mind and get approval in doing inter-Korean cooperation as the Korean nation is responsible for it, it said, calling on overseas Koreans to make a tangible contribution to opening a broad avenue to national prosperity. Rodong News Team

title: School Youth and Children Start Study Tour of Chairman Kim Jong Il's Birthplace
body: School youth and children from across the country began the study tour of Chairman Kim Jong Il's birthplace in the secret camp in Mt Paektu on the occasion of his 77th birth anniversary. A kick-off ceremony took place before the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in Hyesan City, Ryanggang Province, on Friday. Present at the ceremony were Ri Sang Won, chairman of the Ryanggang Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials concerned, youth league officials and study tour group members. The participants laid floral baskets and bouquets at the statues of the great leaders. A reporter and speakers called on the study tour participants to deeply grasp the revolutionary history and feats of the peerlessly great persons associated with the revolutionary battle sites and revolutionary sites in the area of Mt Paektu and defend and add brilliance to the revolutionary traditions of Juche. They stressed that all study tour participants should fully demonstrate the appearance of reserves, advancing group and wing of the WPK true to the will of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. At the end of the ceremony the study tour participants marched for Pochonbo. Rodong News Team

title: Paektusan Prize Sports Games Open
body: The Paektusan Prize Sports Games were opened with due ceremony at the Basketball Gymnasium in Chongchun Street on Friday in celebration of the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The participants in the games will compete in football, basketball, volleyball, ice hockey and other events in Pyongyang, Sariwon, Samjiyon County, Pujon County and other places. Present at the ceremony were Choe Hwi, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the National Sports Guidance Committee, Jon Kwang Ho, vice-premier of the Cabinet, Kim Sung Du, chairman of the Education Commission, Kim Jang San, secretary general of the DPRK Football Association, officials concerned and others. Rodong News Team

title: Chongryon Officials Back Appeal of DPRK
body: Vice-Chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) Nam Sung U released a statement on January 31 in support of the appeal adopted at the joint conference of the government, political parties and organizations of the DPRK reflecting the unanimous desire and will of the entire Korean nation to keep writing a proud history of national reconciliation, unity, peace and prosperity. The statement said: A way for the existence of the nation and a bright future of Koreans in Japan lie in thoroughly adhering to and comprehensively implementing the historic Panmunjom Declaration and the September Pyongyang Joint Declaration as indicated by the appeal adopted at the joint conference. Chongryon and Koreans in Japan will accelerate the nation-wide march for reunification holding aloft the slogan "Let us usher in a heyday of peace, prosperity and reunification of the Korean peninsula by thoroughly implementing the historic north-south declarations!" Chongryon will strengthen the solidarity among the people in north and south and overseas, reject and oppose any challenge and obstruction for checking the implementation of the north-south declarations and make a tangible contribution to opening a broad avenue to north-south exchange and cooperation and co-prosperity of the nation. It will make sincere efforts to find out a proposal for peaceful reunification based on the agreement of the entire nation and to implement it and will encourage all the Koreans in Japan to join in a sacred struggle to bring a heyday of peace, prosperity and reunification irrespective of the differences in idea, political view, organisation and affiliation as a member of the nation. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends New Year Cards to Foreign Party and State Leaders
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un sent New Year's cards to party and state leaders and personages of different countries on the occasion of New Year Juche 108 (2019). They were sent to the president of the Russian Federation, the first secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba, the president of the Council of State and president of the Council of Ministers of the Republic of Cuba, the president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic who is general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party, the president of the Republic of Maldives, the president of the Republic of the Union of Myanmar, the president of Mongolia, the president of the People's Republic of Bangladesh, the president of the Syrian Arab Republic, the president of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the president of the State of Palestine, the president of the Republic of Tajikistan, the president of Turkmenistan, the president of the Republic of Azerbaijan, the president of the Republic of Indonesia, the president of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam who is general secretary of the C.C., Communist Party of Vietnam, the president of the Republic of Belarus, the captains regents of the Republic of San Marino, the president of the Republic of Rwanda, the president of the Republic of Equatorial Guinea, the president of the Republic of Togo, the president of the Republic of Tunisia, the president of the People's Democratic Republic of Algeria, the president of the Republic of Angola, the president of the Arab Republic of Egypt and the prime minister of the Kingdom of Thailand. They were also sent to the secretary general of the International Kim Il Sung Prize Council and the International Kim Jong Il Prize Council, the co-chairman of the Board of Directors of the Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation, the director-general and the secretary general of the International Institute of the Juche Idea and the UN secretary-general. Rodong News Team

title: Congratulations to Malaysian King
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on February 1 sent a congratulatory message to Al-Sultan Abdullah Riayatuddin Al-Mustafa Billah Shah lbni Sultan Haji Ahmad Shah Al-Mustain Billah upon his accession to the king of Malaysia. Expressing belief that the friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries with a long history and traditions would grow stronger, the message sincerely wished the king success in his work for the country's development and prosperity. Rodong News Team

title: Election Committees Start Work
body: According to the DPRK's Law on the Elections of Deputies to the People's Assemblies at All Levels, election committees were organized at the constituencies and sub-constituencies for the election of deputies to the 14th Supreme People's Assembly which were organized at the provinces (municipality), cities (district), counties and the armed forces field and they started their work. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Shining Star to Be Marked in Iceland
body: A preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il (Day of the Shining Star) was formed in Reykjavik, Iceland on January 21. Jon Arni Halldorsson, chairman of the Iceland-DPRK Friendly and Cultural Society, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The preparatory committee decided to organize political and cultural events in praise of the revolutionary career and exploits of Kim Jong Il on the occasion of the Day of the Shining Star. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Shining Star to Be Marked in Sweden
body: A Swedish preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il (Day of the Shining Star) was formed in Stockholm on January 23. Christer Lundgren, chairman of the Sweden-Korea Friendship Association, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The preparatory committee set a celebration period from January 24 to February 16 and decided to organize colorful political and cultural events in praise of the revolutionary career and exploits of Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: Foreign Organizations Support Appeal of DPRK
body: British and Swiss organizations released joint statements on January 24 in support of the appeal adopted at the joint conference of the government, political parties and organizations of the DPRK. The British Association for the Study of Songun Policy, the British Group for the Study of the Juche Idea, the Korean Friendship Association UK and the British Solidarity Committee for Peace and Reunification of the Korean Peninsula said the appeal adopted at the joint conference of the government, political parties and organizations of the DPRK stressed that the New Year Address made by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un is the bright path and signpost of victory for making greater advance in developing the inter-Korean relations and achieving peace and prosperity and accomplishing the cause of national reunification this year by the concerted efforts of the Korean nation. And it underscored the need to thoroughly implement the historic inter-Korean declarations, eradicating military hostility between the north and the south, comprehensively expand and develop cooperation and exchange and provide a proposal for peaceful reunification. They added that they support the efforts of the DPRK for making the Korean Peninsula a permanent and durable peace zone. The Swiss Organizing Committee for the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu, the Switzerland-Korea Committee and the Swiss Group for the Study of the Juche Idea also fully supported the above-said appeal, adding that more radical turn would be made in carrying out the cause of national reunification this year. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Sun and Day of Shining Star to Be Marked in Venezuela
body: A Venezuelan national preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversaries of President Kim Il Sung (the Day of the Sun) and the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il (the Day of the Shining Star) was formed on Jan. 25. Omar Lopez, chairman of the Venezuelan National Society for the Study of the Juche Idea, was elected as honorary chairman of the preparatory committee and Felix Jesus Velasquez Castillo, general coordinator of the Federal Political Secretariat of the United Left Party of Venezuela, as chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee decided to hold diverse political and cultural events in praise of the immortal exploits performed by the peerlessly great men for accomplishing the socialist cause and the global cause of independence on the occasions of the 107th birth anniversary of Kim Il Sung and the 77th birth anniversary of Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: Spokesperson for DPRK Foreign Ministry on Recent Developments in Venezuela
body: A spokesperson for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea gave the following answer to a question put by KCNA on February 3 as regards recent developments in Venezuela: An abnormal situation developed in Venezuela where the speaker of the parliament declared null and void the result of the presidential election held in last May and claimed himself as provisional president on January 23. The situation in Venezuela is developing into a complicated international issue, as evidenced, inter alia, by the convening on January 26 of the UN Security Council emergency meeting on Venezuelan issue. Any attempt by outside forces to remove a president legitimately elected according to the constitution of a sovereign state is an undisguised interference in internal affairs and a wanton violation of international law. It is our firm stand that Venezuelan issues should be resolved in a peaceful way in accordance with the independent will and decision of the government and people of Venezuela. Peoples of the whole world aspiring to justice and peace will ever stand by the government and people of Venezuela for safeguarding their sovereignty and stability. Rodong News Team

title: Pak Pong Ju Inspects Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex, Chollima Steel Complex
body: Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and premier of the Cabinet, made a field survey of the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex and the Chollima Steel Complex. Making rounds of various places of the complexes, he gave a pep talk to the workers who are bringing about a new revolutionary upswing in production. The field consultative meetings discussed measures for all the officials and workers to decisively increase production true to the traditions of struggle in which they have faithfully upheld the WPK with steel and for relevant units to sufficiently supply raw and other materials for putting the production on a normal basis. Pak also went to the Taean Heavy Machine Complex to call for putting spurs to the production of the custom-built equipment to be sent to various fields of national economy. Rodong News Team

title: Art Troupe of Koreans in Japan Visits Statues of
body: President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il An art troupe of Koreans in Japan for marking the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il (Day of the Shining Star) visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on Tuesday. Members of the art troupe placed a bouquet at the statues and made a bow to them. Rodong News Team

title: Korean Art Troupe in Japan Arrives
body: An art troupe of Koreans in Japan for marking the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il (Day of the Shining Star) led by Kim Jong Su, head of the Kumgang-san Opera Troupe of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan, arrived here on Tuesday. Rodong News Team

title: Floral Baskets Laid at Statues of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Working people, youth, students and service personnel throughout the country placed floral baskets before the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Lunar New Year's Day, Juche 108 (2019). Seen standing at the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill was the floral basket sent by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Laid at the statues were floral baskets in the names of the Party, power and armed forces organs and social organizations, ministries, national institutions, organs, industrial establishments and schools at all levels here, units of the Korean People's Army and the Korean People's Internal Security Forces, etc. as well as bouquets. The visitors made a bow to the statues. Floral baskets and bunches of flowers were laid at the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il at Kim Il Sung University, the Mansudae Art Studio, the Ministry of the People's Armed Forces, the Ministry of People's Security, etc. here in the names of organs, industrial establishments, units of the Korean People's Army and the Korean People's Internal Security Forces. Working people, students and service personnel across the country also paid tribute to the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il and their smiling portraits in their residential areas. Rodong News Team

title: Paektusan Prize Sports Contest among Officials of National Institutions Opens
body: The 24th Paektusan Prize Sports Contest among Officials of National Institutions was opened with due ceremony at the Basketball Gymnasium in Chongchun Street here on Monday to mark the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The contest is to be held on a knock-out basis being divided into four groups. The participants will compete in basketball, volleyball, badminton, Taekwon-do, tug of war, sporting and amusement games and other events at Kim Il Sung Stadium, the Pyongyang Indoor Stadium, the Basketball Gymnasium in Chongchun Street, the Taekwon-Do Hall, etc. Present at the opening ceremony were Choe Hwi, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea; Jon Kwang Ho, vice-premier of the Cabinet; Ju Yong Gil, chairman of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea; Kim Il Guk, minister of Physical Culture and Sports; officials concerned and officials and players of ministries and national institutions. Rodong News Team

title: Women's Union Members Meet
body: Officials and members of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea had a meeting at the Hall of Women on Monday ahead of the 71st anniversary of the founding of the Korean People's Army. Present there were Jang Chun Sil, chairwoman of the C.C., SWUK, and officials and members of the women's union. Speakers noted that President Kim Il Sung led the building of the regular armed forces after the country's liberation and developed the Korean People's Revolutionary Army into the regular revolutionary armed forces in a short period. They praised Chairman Kim Jong Il as the illustrious commander of Mt. Paektu, who further consolidated the KPA as the Party's revolutionary armed forces, remaining faithful to Kim Il Sung's army-building idea and exploits. They pointed out that the KPA is displaying its grandeur as militant ranks with politico-ideological features and perfect military and technical preparations as befits matchless army, creator of the people's happiness and shock brigade in building a powerful socialist nation under the guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. They called upon the officials and members of the women's union to add eternal luster to the peerlessly great men's army-building exploits and work in a way worthy of a woman revolutionary in the grand march for economic construction. Rodong News Team

title: Youth and Students Meet with DPRK Hero
body: Youth and students in Pyongyang met with a DPRK hero at the Central Youth Hall on Monday on the occasion of the 71st founding anniversary of the Korean People's Army. The attendees presented a bouquet to DPRK Hero Ji Yong Chun, a lecturer of the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum. At the meeting Ji talked about the exploits of the peerlessly great persons who always led the Juche-oriented army building to victory with outstanding army building idea and guidance. Ji said that after the country's liberation President Kim Il Sung founded the KPA to achieve a historic victory in the Fatherland Liberation War. Ji pointed out that thanks to the great commanders, the KPA could write a proud history of victory only and a great heyday of beefing up the revolutionary armed forces was opened up. Ji asked youth and students, the rising generations, to devotedly defend Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and fully demonstrate the spirit and mettle of the heroic youth in the struggle for the prosperity of the socialist country like the elder generations that remained true to the idea and intention of the great leaders. The youth and students vowed to learn the indomitable fighting spirit displayed by the victors of the great years and further glorify their honor of being the advancing group. Rodong News Team

title: Performance Given by Art Squad of C.C., Youth League
body: A performance was given by the art squad of the Central Committee of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League at the Central Youth Hall on Monday to celebrate the 71st founding anniversary of the Korean People's Army. The performance began with choruses "We Will Win Victory, Flying the Colours of the Supreme Commander" and "Song of the Korean People's Army". Put on the stage were colourful numbers such as female solo and chorus "Cantata to Marshal Kim Il Sung", guitar ensemble "To a Decisive Battle" and song and dance and national instrumental ensemble "Arirang of Army-People Unity". The performers sang of the revolutionary feats of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, who created an epoch-making example of building the revolutionary armed forces and provided the military guarantee of the prosperity of socialist Korea with their outstanding idea and leadership. There were also numbers such as poem and tale "Shine for All Ages, the Great Exploits for Army-Building" and percussion instrumental solo and chorus "Song of Coast Artillerymen". Among the audience were officials of the youth league and youth and students in Pyongyang. Rodong News Team

title: Chongryon Officials Support Appeal of DPRK
body: Officials of the central organizations of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) and chairpersons of the Chongryon headquarters and chapters across Japan made public statements on February 2 in support of the appeal to the entire Korean nation adopted at the joint conference of the government, political parties and organizations of the DPRK. Jo Myong Jin, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the Korean Youth League in Japan, said that the officials of the youth league and Korean youth in Japan fully supported the appeal which was adopted and released at the said conference reflecting the unanimous desire and will of the entire Korean nation to keep writing a proud history of national reconciliation, unity, peace and prosperity. Ri Yong Su, chairman of the Central Standing Council of the Korean Social Scientists Association in Japan, said that the appeal comprehensively reflected the unanimous demand and will of the Koreans in Japan and the rest of the Korean nationals to hold fast to the principle of national independence and self-determination as their lifeline. Nam Ju Hyon, vice-chairwoman of the Central Standing Committee of the Korean Democratic Women's Union in Japan, noted that all the officials of the union and Korean women in Japan ardently supported the appeal full of confidence and optimism about the future. Ko Tok U, chairman of the Tokyo Metropolitan Headquarters of Chongryon, vowed to make devoted efforts in the van of the great cause for providing a reunification plan common to the nation. Kim Chol, chairman of the Hyogo Prefectural Headquarters of Chongryon, stressed that he would arouse the compatriots to the patriotic movement for reunification for implementing the north-south declarations and thus fulfill his sacred mission in ushering in a golden age of peace, prosperity and reunification of the Korean peninsula. Rodong News Team

title: Floral Basket, Congratulatory Letter to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Military Attaches Corps
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a floral basket and congratulatory letter from the military attaches corps here on the occasion of the 71st anniversary of the founding of the Korean People's Army. Alexei Bartusov, military attache of the Russian embassy who is doyen of the corps, handed over the floral basket and congratulatory letter to Army General No Kwang Chol, minister of the People's Armed Forces, on Monday. Rodong News Team

title: Hwang Kyo An, Shadow of Park Guen Hye
body: Hwang Kyo An, a philistine who watched with his heart in his mouth the angry candlelight demonstrators, has plunged into south Korean political arena in a bid to take power. Hwang declared his run for the representative of the “Liberal Korea Party” on Jan. 29 in more than ten days since his admission to the party. He is merely a shadow of Park Geun Hye as he has neither his own face nor his own voice. He is a jackstraw as he is not worth a farthing and what is left to him is rags of a cabinet minister and prime minster appointed by Park Geun Hye and an acting president of south Korea. He reminds people of a rooster flapping its wings towards a perch called power. Just like Park Geun Hye who made a mess of the administration and lamented over her lot, saying that she became a president of south Korea only to disgraced, the day will soon come when he will say that he set foot in the political arena only to be disgraced, forsaken by the party and the public at home. Jo Nam Jin

body: A Congolese preparatory committee for celebrating the 77th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il was formed in Brazzaville on Jan. 29. Vital Balla, chairman of the Congolese Association for Friendship among Peoples, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. body: A British preparatory committee for celebrating Chairman Kim Jong Il's birth anniversary was formed in London on Jan. 26. title: U.S. Demand for Upkeep Rise Opposed in S. Korea
body: "The People for Achieving Peace and Reunification", an organization of south Korea, held a meeting in the plaza of Kwanghwamun in Seoul on Jan. 31 to oppose the U.S. demand for a hike in the upkeep of its forces stationed in south Korea, according to the south Korean online paper Tongil News. The speakers said that the U.S. should have shouldered the total upkeep, but the "government" has shouldered almost full upkeep. They blasted the U.S. for demanding even the upkeep of the deployment of their strategic assets and the maintenance of THAAD. Rodong News Team

title: Hwang Kyo An's Crimes Disclosed
body: The April 16 Solidarity of south Korea held a news conference before the building of the "Liberal Korea Party" (LKP) on Jan. 31 to denounce Hwang Kyo An for preventing the probe into the truth behind the ferry Sewol disaster. Speakers said that LKP grouping such criminals as Hwang should be dissolved. Rodong News Team

title: Korean People Mark Lunar New Year's Day
body: The Korean people enjoyed Lunar New Year's Day. People entered the plaza park of the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the sacred temple of Juche, where President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il lie in state, and made a bow to the portraits of smiling Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il. Working people, youth, students and service personnel visited the statues of the great leaders on Mansu Hill and their statues and smiling portraits in other parts of the country, and paid tribute to them. Colorful art performances were given in Pyongyang and in other areas. Maypole, kite-flying, top spinning, shuttlecock, rope-skipping and other colorful folk plays took place in various places of the capital city, Phyongsong, Sinuiju, Wonsan, Hamhung, Chongjin, etc. Working people had a good day, having national dishes such as Sinsollo at Okryu Restaurant, Chongryu Restaurant, etc. People had a good time at the Mangyongdae Amusement Park, Munsu Water Park and the Central Zoo. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Shining Star to Be Celebrated in Mongolia
body: A preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il (Day of the Shining Star) was formed in Mongolia on Jan. 29. J. Lomvo, chairman of the Mongolian Mt. Paektu Association for Independent Development, was elected as chairman of the preparatory committee. title: Many People Visit Korean Revolution Museum
body: Working people of many units, youths and students and servicepersons visit the hall of period of building a new country in the Korean Revolution Museum on the occasion of the 71st founding anniversary of the Korean People's Army (KPA). Exhibited at the room are historic relics and data showing the revolutionary exploits of President Kim Il Sung who developed the Korean People's Revolutionary Army into the KPA, the regular revolutionary armed forces. The visitors were deeply moved by the historic facts that Kim Il Sung organized the Central Security Officers Training School branched from the Pyongyang Institute, the Marine Security Officers Training School, the Security Officers Training Centre, the Korean Aviation Association, the Maritime Security Force and the Air Training Class and the Flying Corps of the Pyongyang Institute. They looked round the photo of Kim Il Sung on the tribune of honor of the first military parade of the KPA on February 8, Juche 37 (1948), photos of servicepersons marching along the square of military parade, the colors and uniforms of services and arms. Rodong News Team

title: Prizes Conferred on Scientists and Technicians
body: The 16th ceremony of awarding the February 16 Science and Technology Prize took place at the People's Palace of Culture on Thursday. Attending the ceremony were Pak Thae Song, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Im Chol Ung, vice-premier of the Cabinet, Ri Chung Gil, chairman of the State Commission of Science and Technology, Kim Sung Du, chairman of the Education Commission, Jang Chol, president of the State Academy of Sciences, and officials concerned. Korean scientists and technicians made achievements to contribute to promoting the development of the up-to-the-minute industry and revitalizing the national economy. Certificates and medals of February 16 Science and Technology Prize were conferred on more than 10 projects, and certificates of Scientific and Technological Innovation Prize on three projects. Certificates of those prizes went to over 200 scientists, technicians, teachers and officials at Kim Il Sung University, the State Academy of Sciences, the Ministry of Railways, the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex, etc. At the ceremony, Yun Won Nam, ex-director of a research institute of Pyongyang Medical College of Kim Il Sung University; Pak Ji Min, vice-rector of IT College of Kim Chaek University of Technology; Yu Chol Jun, head of a department of Kim Il Sung University; Kim Nam Chol, section chief of Kim Il Sung University, and Pak Jun Il, section chief of the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex; were chosen as the nation's best scientists and technicians in 2018. Rodong News Team

title: Meetings with DPRK Heroes Held
body: Working people's organizations held meetings with DPRK heroes on Thursday to mark the 71st founding anniversary of the heroic Korean People's Army (KPA). Workers and members of trade unions met with DPRK Hero Kim Sung Un, a lecturer of the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum, at the Central Hall of Workers. He said that President Kim Il Sung developed the Korean People's Revolutionary Army into the regular revolutionary armed forces under the independent line of army building after Korea's liberation. He recalled that the President initiated the aircraft-hunting team movement to frustrate the enemy's "air superiority" during the Fatherland Liberation War and taught KPA soldiers good methods of hunting enemy aircraft. He said he was honored with the title of DPRK Hero for shooting down five enemy aircraft in 20 odd days with small arms as instructed by the President. Agricultural workers met with DPRK Hero Pak In Ho, a lecturer of the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum. Pak told that the KPA reliably defended the country and the revolution with the matchless arms in the annals of the revolution under the guidance of the peerlessly great men. He stressed that the People's Army has fully demonstrated the might of the heroic KPA in the struggle for defending the country and on major fronts of building a powerful socialist nation as led by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. The heroes called upon the workers, trade union members and agricultural workers to become honorable victors in today's worthwhile struggle to consolidate in every way the might of socialist self-supporting economy, true to the leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea. Rodong News Team

title: Oath-taking Meeting of Schoolchildren Held
body: Schoolchildren had an oath-taking meeting in front of Chairman Kim Jong Il's statue in Samjiyon County on Thursday. Present at the meeting were officials concerned, youth league officials and the expedition members. They laid a floral basket and bouquets at the statue of Kim Jong Il and paid tribute to the statue. Led by Pak Chol Min, chairman of the Central Committee of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League, all the participants in the meeting vowed to perform vanguard role in the drive for hastening the final victory in the revolutionary cause of Juche under the guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: National Photo Exhibition Opens
body: A national photo exhibition "Continuing field guidance for loving care of the people" opened with due ceremony at the People's Palace of Culture on Thursday to mark the 77th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Seen in its venue are photos dealing with the history of his revolutionary activities. Photos "The great leader Comrade Kim Jong Il in the period of Kim Il Sung University" and "The great leader Comrade Kim Jong Il giving field guidance to the Komdok Mine" show the revolutionary life of the Chairman who made the journey of dedication for the prosperity of the country and people's happiness true to the pledge he made on Ryongnam Hill in his early years. Photos "The great leader Comrade Kim Jong Il making rounds of modern dwelling house in Wangjaesan-ri, Onsong County" reflect the noble personality of Kim Jong Il as the peerlessly great man who ceaselessly visited families of ordinary working people and took care of them with paternal affection. "The great leader Comrade Kim Jong Il making rounds of mountain-climbing route of Mt Myohyang Scenic Beauty Resort" and other photos show the noble view on the people of Kim Jong Il who made selfless and devoted efforts for the good of the people become a permanent climate of the Workers' Party of Korea. Photos of the Chairman giving field guidance to the e-library of Kim Il Sung University, the Chollima Steel Complex, the Ryongsong Machine Complex and the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex recollect the efforts of the peerlessly great man. There are also photos dealing with the personality of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un as the heaven-sent great man. On display there are photos showing happy looks of the Korean people. Rodong News Team

title: Koreans in Japan Visit Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: A congratulatory group of Koreans in Japan for celebrating the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il (Day of the Shining Star) visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on Thursday. The members of the group laid a bouquet at the statues of the great leaders before paying tribute to them. Rodong News Team

body: A congratulatory group of Koreans in Japan for celebrating Chairman Kim Jong Il's birth anniversary (the Day of the Shining Star) led by Ri Ju Hak, chairman of the Fukuoka Prefectural Headquarters of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan, arrived here on Thursday. Rodong News Team

title: Music and Dance Performance Given to Mark Lunar New Year's Day
body: A music and dance performance was given at the Pyongyang Indoor Stadium on Tuesday, Lunar New Year's Day, which delighted Pyongyangites. After hearing about the performance of the artistes of the famous art organizations including the Samjiyon Orchestra, the National Symphony Orchestra, the Wangjaesan Art Troupe and the Mansudae Art Troupe, Pyongyangites thronged to the stadium that day. When the solemn melody of overture "The Glorious Country" resounded, the audience keenly felt the pride of being citizens of the great country, looking back upon the glorious history of the DPRK which has always emerged victorious on the road of building a powerful socialist state while creating epoch-making miracles and changes. Numbers including female solo "Snowflakes Falling in the Night Sky", orchestra "Song Presented to the Mother Party" and orchestra and chorus "We Will Go along Road of Loyalty" were put on the stage to lead the audience to the world of deep emotion. Female chorus "We Love Our Country" and female solo "O My Motherland Full of Hope" reflecting the feelings of ardent love for the country which is the best in the world revved up the atmosphere of the performance. The performance, which showed the desire of the Korean people to create a happy and highly civilized life and the developing Juche-oriented art, ended with finale "Snow Is Falling on New Year's Day". Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Makes Congratulatory Visit to Ministry of People's Armed Forces
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, and supreme commander of the Korean People's Army, made a congratulatory visit to the Ministry of the People's Armed Forces on Friday, the 71st anniversary of the KPA. Supreme Leader of the Party, state and army Kim Jong Un had a significant photo taken with the KPA commanding officers before the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il at the Ministry of People's Armed Forces. At the conference hall of the ministry, Kim Jong Un sat together with generals and other officers of the ministry, and commanders of KPA large combined units and combined units and warmly congratulated them on the Day of Army Founding. He made a highly important speech. He extended warm congratulations to the beloved service personnel and their families of the entire army celebrating the significant Day of Army Founding at a stirring time when a new decisive phase has been opened in the development of our revolution and the drive for building a powerful socialist country has been pushed forward on a new stage of development. He said that meeting the commanders of all army corps, divisions and brigades of the KPA on the significant occasion, he felt like meeting all the service personnel of the army, asking them to convey to all other soldiers the feelings of the Supreme Commander of missing them and wanting to be with them though he is far away from them. Stressing the need for the People's Army to effect a great surge and innovations unprecedented in our Party's history of revolutionary struggle and the army building this year and thus fulfill their historic mission before the era and revolution, he set forth militant tasks for the People's Army. He said that it is a fundamental guarantee for modeling the entire army on Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, the general task of the army building, and the work of first and foremost importance related to the destiny of the country, the revolution and the people to more thoroughly establish the Party's monolithic command system in the entire army. He said that the party organizations and political institutions of the KPA should bear in mind that ideological and moral advantages are the absolute ones of the revolutionary army that cannot be bartered for anything and a guarantee for sure victory, conduct ideological work in an offensive, multi-lateral and three-dimensional way with main emphasis put on making the entire army politically, ideologically and morally stronger as the twin pillar and thus make the entire army an ideologically pure entity, a community united by the same blood, thought, intention and destiny with the party. Saying that the revolutionary traditions of our Party constitute the blood vessel linking yesterday with today and tomorrow of the Juche revolution and they serve as an immutable cornerstone, he called for directing particular attention to strengthening education on the revolutionary traditions among soldiers to make the revolutionary spirit of Mt. Paektu pervade the entire army. He also underlined the need to profoundly carry out the education on our state-first spirit with proper methodology and thus make sure that the soldier masses firmly defend with arms the bright future of the socialist country. He noted that the KPA should strengthen class education in the army as befits the vanguard ranks of the class struggle standing guard over the forefront of defending socialism by holding firm the arms of the revolution and thus mercilessly foil all moves of hostile forces aimed to undermine our ideology and our social system. He stressed that cooperation between military commanders and political officers should be realized on a higher stage as it is peculiar work-style of the revolutionary army so as to rally entire army around the Party as firm as a rock and thoroughly carry out the Party's military line and policies. Saying that turning the People's Army into elite forces is the consistent policy of our Party in building the revolutionary armed forces, he called for thoroughly implementing five-point policy on effecting a turn in training set forth by the Party Central Committee to make the army ever-victorious one which always win victories in any operations and battles. He underlined the need to further strengthen the People's Army politically and ideologically and in military technique in keeping with the requirement of the present times. He underscored the need to get rid of all old remnants like formalistic style and stereotyped patterns in training and steadily improve the contents and methods of training to suit to the specific natural and geographical, special characteristics of our country and to meet the demands and features of modern warfare. He also called on them to fully incite training zeal and competitive spirit among soldiers through mass movement including the movement for becoming crackshots in the entire army. A fundamental key to pushing forward the drive of turning the army into the elite revolutionary armed forces lies in ideological revolution, training revolution, modernization of arms and equipment and establishment of military discipline, he said. He said that all units and subunits of the entire army should raise three winds more fiercely to effect a new turn in improving logistic supply and soldiers' life. He said that the People's Army should keep holding high the slogan "Let Us Take Charge of Both Defence of Country and Socialist Construction!" and display the stamina of struggle and creation peculiar to the KPA in all fields of socialist construction called for by the Party and thus have a large share this year, a crucial year in carrying out the five-year strategy for national economic development. He specified the ways for successfully carrying out important tasks facing the KPA this year including further enhancing the role of party organizations and political institutions at all levels of the KPA and increasing the combat capabilities in every way by braving hardships and difficulties in the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance. So great is the trust of the Party in the commanding officers of the KPA, he said, voicing his expectation and conviction that they would hold full responsibility for their work before the party, revolution, country and the people and register greater successes in their work. Firm is the determination and will of the Party to shape a new roadmap toward building a powerful socialist country for realizing the wishes of the great leaders and no force can check the dynamic advance of our country, he said, appealing to the entire army to work hard for the accomplishment of the revolutionary cause of Juche in firm unity around the Party Central Committee. Political News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Enjoys Performance with Commanders of All Large Combined Units, Combined Units of KPA
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the Korean People's Army, enjoyed a performance given by the State Merited Chorus at an annex to the headquarters of the Party Central Committee together with all the commanders of the large combined units and combined units of the KPA on Feb. 8, the 71st founding anniversary of the KPA. Among the audience were KPA Vice Marshal Ri Myong Su, first vice commander of the KPA Supreme Command, KPA Army General Kim Su Gil, director of the KPA General Political Bureau, KPA Army General Ri Yong Gil, chief of the KPA General Staff, and KPA Army General No Kwang Chol, minister of the People's Armed Forces of the DPRK, and other commanding officers of the General Political Bureau and General Staff of the KPA and the People's Armed Forces together with the commanders of the army corps, divisions and brigades of the KPA. Appreciating the performance also were Choe Ryong Hae, Ri Su Yong, Kim Phyong Hae, Thae Jong Su, O Su Yong and Kim Yong Chol, vice-chairmen of the Central Committee of the WPK, other leading officials of the C.C., WPK and the State Affairs Commission. Supreme Leader of the Party, state and army Kim Jong Un and his wife Ri Sol Ju appeared in the auditorium. He warmly congratulated all the KPA service personnel who mark the Day of Army Founding, 71st founding anniversary of the KPA while encouraging them. Put on the stage that started with orchestral music "The Glorious Country" were colorful numbers including male chorus "We Wish Supreme Commander Good Health", male solo and chorus "Cantata to Marshal Kim Il Sung" and unaccompanied chorus "The Country I Am Defending". The performers sang high praises of the dignity and might of our country dynamically advancing along the road of victory of socialism under the wise guidance of the WPK and made an impressive artistic presentation of the firm faith and will of the army and people to firmly trust and follow the Party and the leader only and safeguard them politically and ideologically and at the cost of their lives while invariably and persistently succeeding to the lineage of arms of Mt Paektu, the lifeline of the Korean revolution. As Kim Jong Un requested the encore, female trio and male chorus "Our National Flag" was re-performed, being conducted by People's Artiste Jang Ryong Sik, vice department director of the WPK Central Committee, making the audience be gripped by the feelings of great excitement and leading the performance to its climax. Kim Jong Un expressed great satisfaction over the wonderful performance of high ideological value and artistry. He voiced the expectation and conviction that the artistes of the State Merited Chorus would as ever conduct more positive performing activities of revolutionary nature and thus creditably fulfill their honorable mission and duty as frontline soldiers in the field of literature and art. Political News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Attends Banquet Given to Celebrate Day of Army Founding
body: The Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea arranged a banquet on the occasion of the 71st founding anniversary of the Korean People's Army. Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and supreme commander of the KPA, attended the banquet. Present there were commanding officers of the General Political Bureau and the General Staff of the KPA and the Ministry of the People's Armed Forces and all commanders of the large combined units and combined units of the KPA. On hand there were also leading officials of the Central Committee of the WPK and the State Affairs Commission. At the banquet, Supreme Leader of the Party, state and army Kim Jong Un warmly congratulated all the service personnel of the KPA upon marking the Day of Army Founding once again. Upon authorization of Kim Jong Un, Choe Ryong Hae made a congratulatory speech addressed to the KPA on behalf of the Party Central Committee. Political News Team

title: S. Korean Military Running High Fever in Arms Buildup
body: Days ago, south Korean Defence Ministry made public “2019-2023 mid-term defense program” under the pretext of “coping with military threat and security change” expected at present and in the future. Under the program south Korean military is trying to spend military spending 13.6% more than the previous program. And it is seeking to launch into large-scale arms buildup after renaming “triad strike system”, “system of countering nuclear and weapons of mass destruction”. The south Korean military has already made public a plan to deploy Stealth F-35As for an actual war and introduce all kinds of foreign-made arms and equipment. The moves of the south Korean military are a challenge to the desire and aspirations of all Koreans for permanent and durable peace of the Korean Peninsula and undisguised provocation against the DPRK. The joint military exercises with foreign forces incessantly staged in south Korea in the past and large-scale arms buildup including the introduction of war hardware from other countries have been a source of tension on the Korean Peninsula. The entire Korean nation and the international community want to see practical measures to remove north-south military hostility on the whole of the Korean peninsula including the land, sky and seas. The public at home and abroad asserts that the south Korean military should sharply cut surplus arms and equipment under the present situation. The south Korean military’s redoubled efforts for arms buildup is a revelation of its intention to seek a showdown with the fellow countrymen. Ho Yong Min

title: Day of Shining Star to Be Celebrated in Italy
body: An Italian preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il (Day of the Shining Star) was formed in Rome on Jan. 31. Miriam Pelegrini Peri, chairwoman of the Italian Committee for the Study of Songun Idea for Independence and Sovereignty, was elected as chairwoman of the preparatory committee. The committee decided to hold colorful political and cultural events such as a celebration meeting, seminar, book and photo exhibition and film show on the occasion of the Day of the Shining Star. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Shining Star to Be Celebrated in Germany
body: The German Group for the Study of Korean Culture formed a preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il (Day of the Shining Star) on Jan. 30. Manfred Schneider, chief of the German Group for the Study of Korean Culture, was elected as chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee decided to hold political and cultural events including a seminar and film show to praise the exploits of Kim Jong Il on the occasion of the Day of the Shining Star. Rodong News Team

title: People's Delegations Visit KPA, KPISF Units
body: People's delegations visited units of the Korean People's Army and the Korean People's Internal Security Forces on the occasion of the 71st founding anniversary of the KPA. The members of the delegations warmly congratulated the servicepersons enthusiastic in training. They informed the service personnel of the struggle of the people and joined the officers and men of the units in colorful political and cultural events. They asked all the service personnel to always perform glorious military exploits in devotedly defending the Central Committee of the Party, bearing in mind the expectations and requests of the country and people. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Birth Anniversary to Be Celebrated in Brazil
body: A Brazilian preparatory committee for celebrating the 77th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il was formed on Jan. 31. Rosanita Campos, vice-president of the Party for Free Motherland of Brazil, was elected as chairwoman of the preparatory committee. The committee decided to organize colorful political and cultural events such as a celebration meeting and film show on the occasion of the birth anniversary of Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Servicepersons, working people, youth and students laid floral baskets before the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on the 71st founding anniversary of the Korean People's Army (KPA). Seen standing before the statues of the great leaders on Mansu Hill was a floral basket from Kim Jong Un, supreme leader of the Party, the state and the army of the DPRK. Placed at the statues were floral baskets in the names of Party, power and armed forces organs, social organizations, ministries, national institutions, units of the KPA and the Korean People's Internal Security Forces and institutions and industrial establishments and schools at all levels in Pyongyang as well as bouquets. The visitors made a bow to the statues of the great leaders. Floral baskets in the name of units of the KPA and the Korean People's Internal Security Forces, organs, enterprises, etc. were laid before the statues of the great leaders in different parts of Pyongyang including Kim Il Sung Military University, the Ministry of the People's Armed Forces, the Ministry of People's Security and the Mansudae Art Studio. Servicepersons, working people, youth and students paid respects to the statues of the great leaders and their smiling portraits across the country. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Introduced by Brazilian Organization
body: The Brazilian Center for the Study of Songun Politics posted on its website the full text of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us March Forward Dynamically towards Final Victory, Holding Higher the Banner of Songun" on Jan. 25. The work, published on April 15, Juche 101 (2012), says that the century-long history of Kim Il Sung's nation clearly proved the immutable truth that an outstanding leader guarantees the dignity and prosperity of the country and the nation. It also indicates the tasks for glorifying the dignity of Songun Korea for all ages and successfully accomplishing the cause of building a thriving socialist country. The website carried a photo of Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: KPA Lauded by Cambodian Press
body: The Korean People's Army (KPA) has reliably defended the safety of the country and people over the past more than seventy years after its founding. The Cambodian AKP said this in an article titled "The army of the people" posted on its website on Feb. 4 with the approach of the founding anniversary of the KPA. The article noted that every country regards the army as a consuming unit and its role is restricted to the defense of the territory and rescue operations but the KPA brings benefits to the people as it plays an important role in various fields such as economic construction, to say nothing of the defense of the territory. It stressed that the matchless merits displayed by the service personnel of the KPA in the past Fatherland Liberation War clearly proved that the KPA is the army of the people both in name and in reality. It said that the KPA makes great contributions to economic construction for the country's prosperity and people's happiness. In recent years the service personnel of the people's army built a lot of monumental edifices in major worksites for socialist construction, the article concluded. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Shining Star to Be Celebrated in Finland
body: A Finnish preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il (Day of the Shining Star) was formed in Helsinki on Jan. 29. Juha Kieksy, international secretary of the Finnish Communists' League, was elected to be chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee decided to hold colorful political and cultural events to praise the immortal exploits of Kim Jong Il with the approach of his birthday. Rodong News Team

title: Korean Books Donated to Russia
body: A Korean book-donating ceremony took place at the Sakhalin Regional Branch Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation on Jan. 28 on the threshold of the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il (Day of the Shining Star). Displayed at the venue of the ceremony were works of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and books introducing the history and culture of Korea and others. Present there were figures of the Central Committee and various branch committees of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation and masses. A secretary of the Central Committee of the party said that he was pleased to receive works of the great leaders of the Korean people with the approach of the Day of the Shining Star. He noted that Kim Jong Il is the staunch defender of socialism who made public works such as "Socialism Is a Science" and thus proved the scientific accuracy and truth of socialism and glorified the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. He said that the appearance of the Korean people who firmly keep to socialism despite the imperialist allied forces' vicious sanctions and pressure makes them have confidence in victory of socialism. The documents of the great persons of the DPRK are the precious textbooks to be deeply studied by all of them, he stressed. The first secretary of the Sakhalin Regional Branch Committee of the party said that he was deeply impressed by the ardent loyalty of the Korean people to their leader and patriotism. He stressed that the red flag of socialism still flutters in the DPRK and its people-oriented policies remind the Russian people of their happy days under the socialist system. The successes registered by the Korean people last year give them great might and courage, he added. Rodong News Team

title: School Youth and Children March towards Chairman Kim Jong Il's Birthplace
body: School youth and children from across the country marched to Chairman Kim Jong Il's birthplace in the secret camp in Mt Paektu from Feb. 1 to 9 on the occasion of his 77th birth anniversary. During the march, they placed floral baskets and bunches of flowers at the statues of President Kim Il Sung in Pochonbo Revolutionary Battle Site, Chongbong Bivouac and before the Samjiyon Grand Monument and the statue of Chairman Kim Jong Il in Samjiyon County and made bows to them. They left Hyesan and reached Pochonbo, where they looked round the command post of the Battle of Pochonbo, the Police Sub-station, the subcounty office, etc. They arrived at the Tableland of Junghung commanding a view of Mt Paektu through the Spring Site in Poso-ri, singing revolutionary songs in chorus. Then they reached the Rimyongsu Revolutionary Site, where they looked round various places there. At Chongbong and Konchang bivouacs, they looked round the site where the anti-Japanese war heroine Kim Jong Suk cooked rice and the trees bearing slogans and others. They visited Kim Jong Il's birthplace in the secret camp in Mt Paektu to look back upon his revolutionary career. They also visited the Samjiyon Grand Monument, toured the Paektusan Hero Youth Power Station, and visited the construction sites in the area of the township of Samjiyon to help the constructors. During the march, they had a meeting to hear impressions of the reminiscences of anti-Japanese guerrillas, a contest of singing revolutionary songs in chorus while marching in array and other political and cultural events. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Off Press in Russia
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work "The Cause of the Great Party of Comrades Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il Is Ever-Victorious" was published in booklet at the Nakhodka Format Publishing House of Russia on Jan. 24 ahead of the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The work, published on Oct. 4, Juche 104 (2015), says that the 70-year-long history of the Workers' Party of Korea is a history of victory in which the validity and invincibility of the cause of the Party of Comrades Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il have been displayed and that the cause of the Party is invincible. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Exploits Are Everlasting: Jordanian Figure
body: Marwan Sudah, chairman of the Arab Committee for Solidarity with Korean People and Supporting the Reunification of Korea, made public a statement on Jan. 22 ahead of Chairman Kim Jong Il's birth anniversary. He said that the world progressives would mark the 77th birth anniversary of Kim Jong Il before long. He said that Kim Jong Il, who carried forward President Kim Il Sung's idea and cause, dynamically advanced the revolutionary cause of Juche. He pointed out that Kim Jong Il consolidated the single-minded unity of the Korean society based on the Juche idea in every way and strengthened the capability for self-defence, thus laying a firm foundation for the country's prosperity. He said: Leader Kim Jong Il also turned the DPRK into the people's paradise. He set a world's example in the struggle against the imperialists' high-handed and arbitrary practices. He was a dear friend who extended support and solidarity to the peoples of the countries in their struggle for justice, truth, independence and sovereignty, and positively helped the cause of Arab people, in particular. His exploits will be immortal along with the century. Rodong News Team

title: Bulgarian Body Issues Bulletin to Mark Day of Shining Star
body: The Bulgaria-Korea Friendship Association issued a bulletin ahead of Chairman Kim Jong Il's birth anniversary (Day of the Shining Star). The bulletin in an article titled "77th birth anniversary of the great Comrade Kim Jong Il" said that he was born to be the son of the guerrillas in Mt Paektu, the holy mountain of the Korean revolution, on Feb. 16, 1942 and that he developed in depth the immortal Juche idea as required by the times. The bulletin recalled in detail that during his work at the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea he developed the Party into the ever-victorious guiding force and unfolded the original Songun politics to foil the imperialist allied forces' anti-DPRK moves and firmly defend socialism. Rodong News Team

title: Poster for 23rd Kimjongilia Festival Produced
body: A poster for the 23rd Kimjongilia Festival to be held on the occasion of the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il was produced. Depicted at the centre of the poster is the immortal flower Kimjongilia in full bloom against the background of Kim Jong Il's birthplace in the Paektusan Secret Camp, the holy place of revolution, and Jong Il Peak covered with snow. Seen on its upper part is the slogan "The great leader Comrade Kim Jong Il will always be with us" and on its lower part the letters "The 23rd Kimjongilia Festival" and festival venue and period. Rodong News Team

title: Editorial
body: KPA Will Add Eternal Luster to Its Ever-victorious History and Tradition As the KPA was founded, the Korean people’s centuries-old desire could be realized and the DPRK could advance along the road of independent development guaranteed by its own strong armed forces from the first day of its founding. The history of revolutionary leadership of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il remains a sacred one that set an example of the times in building revolutionary armed forces with outstanding wisdom and indefatigable leadership. President Kim Il Sung founded the KPA, Juche-type revolutionary regular army, in a matter of less than three years by setting forth the founding of a strong regular army as an indispensable requirement for the building of a sovereign and independent state after the liberation of Korea and pushing ahead with army building with his unique army-building idea and energetic leadership. The KPA won a brilliant victory in the Fatherland Liberation War and has grown to be the invincible ranks that can crush any formidable enemy at a single blow, smashing the adventurous provocations of the enemies at every step. The credit for it is the wise leadership of the President. The Songun revolutionary leadership of Chairman Kim Jong Il was the driving force of a radical change in the ideological and moral traits, combat preparedness and the appearance of the KPA as befitting a regular army. At the most rigorous and difficult time when the DPRK struggled against the allied forces of the world imperialists without any wing and aid, the heroic KPA performed brilliant feats in the first line of the revolution under the leadership of Kim Jong Il. The KPA led by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, the peerlessly illustrious commander, is further demonstrating its might as an invincible revolutionary army and performing world-startling heroic exploits in the building of a powerful socialist country.

title: Day of Sun, Day of Shining Star to Be Marked in Cambodia
body: A Cambodian preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversaries of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il (the Day of the Sun and the Day of the Shining Star) was formed on Feb. 6. Kong Sam Ol, deputy prime minister for Royal Palace, was elected as chairman of the preparatory committee upon the authorization of Cambodian King Norodom Sihamoni. The committee decided to give wide publicity to the revolutionary careers and exploits of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il and organize colorful political and cultural events on these anniversaries. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Shining Star to Be Marked in Belgium
body: A Belgian preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il (Day of the Shining Star) was formed in Brussels on Feb. 4. The chairperson of the Belgium-Korea Friendship Association was elected as chairperson of the preparatory committee. The committee decided to hold various political and cultural events in the run-up to the Day of the Shining Star. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Sun, Day of Shining Star to Be Marked in Slovakia
body: A Slovak preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversaries of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il (the Day of the Sun and the Day of the Shining Star) was formed in Bratislava on February 5. Ivan Draxler, chairman of the Slovakia-Korea Friendship Association and chairman of the Slovak Association for Supporting and Studying the Juche Idea, was elected as chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee decided to organize political and cultural events praising revolutionary careers and exploits of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il on these anniversaries. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Sun, Day of Shining Star to Be Marked in Angola
body: An Angolan preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversaries of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il was formed on Feb. 6. Amalia Alexandr, international secretary of the Angolan Women's Organization, was elected chairwoman of the preparatory committee. The committee set a celebration period from Feb. 7 to April 15 and decided to organize a seminar, reading session, film show and other political and cultural events in praise of the undying feats that Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il performed for the Korean revolution and global independence. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Iranian President
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, on Monday sent a message of greeting to Hassan Rouhani, president of the Islamic Republic of Iran, on the occasion of the 40th anniversary of the victory of the Islamic revolution of Iran.
