The message expressed belief that the good friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries would grow stronger, sincerely wishing the government and people of Iran greater success in their struggle for defending the gains of the Islamic revolution and building a powerful Iran. Rodong News Team

title: 26th Paektusan Prize Int'l Figure Skating Festival to Be Held
body: The 26th Paektusan Prize International Figure Skating Festival is to be held in Pyongyang to celebrate 77th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The festival will be held in the form of demonstration performance on Feb. 15-17. Rodong News Team

title: Week of Film Show Opens
body: A week of film show opened with due ceremony at the Pyongyang International Cinema House on Monday to mark the Day of the Shining Star, the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Such documentary films as "Shining Star of Paektu", "Shine, Jong Il Peak" and "Making Selfless, Devoted Efforts for the Good of the People" (1) dealing with the revolutionary career of Kim Jong Il will be shown at cinemas and halls of culture in Pyongyang and local areas. Also screened will be feature films showing the high ideological and moral qualities and noble view of life of the Korean people and their struggle. The week of film show opened in all provinces on the same day. Rodong News Team

title: 34th Sci-tech Festival of Kim Chaek University of Technology Opens
body: The 34th Festival of Science and Technology of Kim Chaek University of Technology opened with due ceremony on Monday. Exhibited at the festival are more than 230 scientific research findings conducive to ensuring the local production of raw and other materials and equipment. The festival, divided into 9 panels including machine, IT and basic science, involves a presentation and exhibition of scientific and technological achievements and an exchange of new techniques. Rodong News Team

title: Korean Stamps Museum Renovated
body: The Korean Stamps Museum has been renovated with due ceremony on Monday. Displayed in the museum are an album of stamps collected by Chairman Kim Jong Il in his schooldays and historical data, stamps and post cards showing the revolutionary careers of the peerless great persons and the development course of the DPRK and relics related to stamps. Also displayed there are historical data and relics showing the history of mail service in ancient and middle ages of Korea and establishment of modern postal system in the end of the feudal Joson dynasty. The museum has a stamp-stand, souvenir-stall, etc. Present at the ceremony were Jon Kwang Ho, vice-premier of the Cabinet; Kim Kwang Chol, minister of Posts and Telecommunications; officials concerned, employees of the museum, philatelists, foreign diplomatic envoys and officials in charge of cultural and friendly relations of foreign embassies here. At the end of the ceremony the participants looked round the stamps and relics. Meanwhile, the State Stamp Bureau of the DPRK presented a commemorative stamp as regards the renovation of the museum. Rodong News Team

title: Officials of Foreign Embassies, Missions of Int'l Bodies Visit Ryuwon Footwear Factory
body: Officials of foreign embassies and missions of international bodies here visited the Ryuwon Footwear Factory on Tuesday ahead of Chairman Kim Jong Il's birth anniversary. Being briefed on the fact that the factory has turned into a standard factory of the shoe-making industry, the visitors looked round the room dedicated to the history of the factory, integrated production control room, shoemaking workshop and other parts. Meanwhile, they toured the Pyongyang Cosmetics Factory on the same day. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of Vietnamese Foreign Ministry Here
body: A delegation of the Vietnamese Foreign Ministry led by Pham Binh Minh, deputy prime minister and foreign minister of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, arrived here on Tuesday. Rodong News Team

title: Foreign Embassy Officials Visit Pyongyang Teacher Training College
body: Officials in charge of cultural and friendly relations of foreign embassies here visited Pyongyang Teacher Training College on Tuesday ahead of Chairman Kim Jong Il's birth anniversary. The visitors looked round the educational and scientific exhibition, the primary school teaching method rehearsal room and other places of the college, being told that great achievements have been made in the work for putting the education of the children under school age and the primary schoolchildren on a new scientific footing. Rodong News Team

title: Military Attaches Corps Visits Kim Il Sung University
body: The military attaches corps here visited Kim Il Sung University on Tuesday ahead of Chairman Kim Jong Il's birth anniversary. The guests looked round the revolutionary museum, e-library and swimming pool of the university, being briefed on the fact that the university has developed into the highest seat of Juche-oriented science education under the wise guidance and meticulous care of the peerlessly great persons. Rodong News Team

title: 34th Sci-tech Festival of Pyongyang University of Mechanical Engineering Opens
body: The 34th Festival of Science and Technology of Pyongyang University of Mechanical Engineering opened with due ceremony on Tuesday. Officials, teachers, researchers, postgraduates and students of the university attended the festival. It is held in the forms of a presentation of scientific and technological achievements and an exhibition of high-tech goods, divided into panels such as machine, automation and information, and process and materials. Exhibited at the festival are more than 120 scientific and technological successes conducive to propelling the development of high-tech industry and energizing the national economy. The festival runs till Feb. 15. Rodong News Team

title: Pak Pong Ju Inspects Various Units
body: Premier Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, inspected various units. Looking round the Yongyu Mine, the Jungsan Mine and the Singye Apatite Mine, Pak stressed the need for officials to bring into full play the zeal of the masses and increase production capacity by upgrading dressing plants. The consultative meetings held on the spots discussed the issues arising in speeding up the technical remodeling of the production processes and in ensuring that the relevant units supplied materials regularly and in improving the supply services for the miners. Inspecting the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill, Pak called for thoroughly maintaining the principle of raising quality in production and furthering the work to establish a cultured way of production and life. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of DPRK Olympic Committee Leaves for Switzerland
body: A delegation of the DPRK Olympic Committee led by Minister of Physical Culture and Sports Kim Il Guk, chairman of the Olympic Committee, left here on Tuesday to visit Switzerland. Rodong News Team

title: Active Commanding Officers of WPRG Meet
body: A national meeting of active commanding officers of the Worker-Peasant Red Guards (WPRG) took place at the People's Palace of Culture on Monday. Attending the meeting were Premier Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Choe Pu Il, minister of People's Security, Ri Man Gon, first vice department director of the C.C., WPK, Kim Nung O, chairman of the Pyongyang City Committee of the WPK, commanding officers at all levels of the Worker-Peasant Red Guards and officials concerned. Present there were Army General Ri Yong Gil, chief of the General Staff of the Korean People's Army; and officials in the field of armed forces. At the meeting Ri Man Gon conveyed a letter from Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un to the participants in the national meeting of active commanding officers of the WPRG. Ri Yong Rae, department director of the Central Committee of the WPK, made a report. The reporter said that the WPRG which was founded and developed under the care of the peerlessly great persons is the revolutionary armed forces of the WPK which carries forward the revolutionary tradition of the anti-Japanese war. He said Kim Jong Un, who is adding luster to the immortal exploits President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il performed in the building of the Juche-based militia forces, indicated the way of strengthening the WPRG and ushered in a heyday in the building of militia forces with his energetic leadership. The Supreme Leader's loving care and trust in commanding officers and members of the WPRG serve as a fundamental source to make the WPRG demonstrate its might as a death-defying corps for defending revolution, native place and the country, the reporter stressed. He said that in the last five years after the meeting of active commanding officers of the WPRG commanding officers and members of the WPRG prepared themselves for fighters strong in ideology and faith and made innovations in increasing the fighting efficiency by making a vigorous struggle true to the Party's idea of building the Juche-based militia forces. He called for increasing the fighting efficiency of the WPRG in every way to firmly guarantee the victorious advance of socialism under the leadership of the Party. Speeches were made there. Speakers referred to successes and experience gained in the civilian defence field in the past under the leadership of the Party. The speeches analyzed and reviewed a series of tendencies and shortcomings revealed in the civilian defence work including shortcomings of some commanding officers who do not work in a revolutionary way as required by the developing revolution. The speakers expressed the firm resolution to bring uninterrupted innovations in the work of WPRG in the spirit of devotedly implementing the Party policies and the fighting spirit of self-reliance in hearty response to the historic letter of Kim Jong Un and thus repay with loyalty the expectations of the Party Central Committee. Rodong News Team

title: KPA Introduced by ACI
body: The Agence Congolaise d'Information (ACI) posted on its website on February 4 an article under the title of "Invincible Korean People's Army" on the occasion of the founding anniversary of the Korean People's Army (KPA). Noting that the KPA demonstrates its might as an invincible army, the article said that many military experts of the world analyzed the key to it. It went on: The KPA is a powerful army which carried forward the invincible spirit of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army. The absolute trust in the supreme commander and the devoted implementation of his order is the core of the staunch mental power of the servicepersons of the KPA. The KPA is equipped with ultra-modern military hardware as well as extraordinary strategy and tactics and war methods. As the KPA had outstanding brilliant commanders as its supreme commanders, it could demonstrate its might as a matchless revolutionary army. Rodong News Team

title: Lots of People Visit Chairman Kim Jong Il's Birthplace in Paektusan Secret Camp
body: An endless stream of people visits Chairman Kim Jong Il's birthplace in the Paektusan Secret Camp on the occasion of his birth anniversary. Among them are commanding officers of the Korean People's Internal Security Forces making a study tour of the revolutionary battle sites in the area of Mt Paektu, school youth and children from across the country making a study tour of Kim Jong Il's birthplace, students of Kim Il Sung University and employees of the Ministry of Forestry and other units making a study tour and working people. They laid floral baskets and bouquets at the mosaic mural depicting the three generals of Mt Paektu in the camp and paid tribute to them. Being told about the fact that Kim Jong Il was born as the Shining Star of Mt Paektu and grew up, hearing gun report of the anti-Japanese war as a lullaby, they looked round the historical mementoes. Looking up to Jong Il Peak, they recalled the revolutionary career of Kim Jong Il who performed undying feats for the era and history with extraordinary political caliber, outstanding leadership ability and noble traits. Rodong News Team

title: Gift to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Deputy PM and FM of Vietnam
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was presented with a gift by Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam Pham Binh Minh. The gift was conveyed to Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, on Wednesday by the deputy prime minister and foreign minister of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam who is leading a delegation of the Vietnamese Foreign Ministry on a visit to the DPRK. Rodong News Team

title: Talks Held between DPRK and Vietnamese FMs
body: Talks between the foreign minister of the DPRK and the deputy prime minister and foreign minister of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam were held at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Wednesday. DPRK Foreign Minister Ri Yong Ho and his Vietnamese counterpart Pham Binh Minh had an in-depth exchange of opinions of the issue of further expanding and developing the traditional friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries provided by President Kim Il Sung, the great leader of the Korean people, and President Ho Chi Minh, the respected leader of the Vietnamese people, and regional and international issues of mutual concern and reached a consensus of views. Rodong News Team

title: Reception Given for Vietnamese Delegation
body: The government of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea hosted a reception at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Wednesday in welcome of the visiting delegation of the Vietnamese Foreign Ministry. Invited to the reception were members of the delegation of the Vietnamese Foreign Ministry led by Pham Binh Minh, deputy prime minister and foreign minister of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam. Present there were Foreign Minister Ri Yong Ho and other officials of the Foreign Ministry. Rodong News Team

title: Chinese Guests and Koreans in China Arrive
body: Wang Wenri, CEO of the Dandong Shenpu Technology Co. Ltd., and his party, Wang Haifu, general manager of the China's Yanbian Yiqiao Commercial Co. Ltd., and his party, Choe Ryong Ho, vice-president for joint operation of Pyongyang University of Science and Technology, arrived in Pyongyang on Wednesday to take part in the 23rd Kimjongilia Festival. Earlier arrivals included Li Xiangjun, vice-president of the Azalea Branch of the China Flower Association, and his party. Rodong News Team

title: Russian Ambassador to DPRK Hosts Reception
body: Alexandr Matsegora, Russian ambassador to the DPRK, on Wednesday gave a reception at the Taedonggang Diplomatic Club on the occasion of the Russian Day of Diplomatic Officials. Invited to the reception were Im Chon Il, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, Mun Jae Chol, vice general director of the General Bureau for Affairs with Diplomatic Corps, officials concerned and foreign diplomatic envoys and representatives of international bodies to the DPRK. Present there were staff members of the Russian embassy. Speeches were made there. Rodong News Team

title: Vietnamese Delegation Visits Mangyongdae
body: A delegation of the Vietnamese Foreign Ministry led by Pham Binh Minh, deputy prime minister and foreign minister of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung, on Wednesday. The delegation laid a floral basket before the old home in Mangyongdae. Being briefed on the fact that Kim Il Sung devoted all his life to the popular masses' cause of independence and the cause of socialism, members of the delegation looked round the historic mementoes at the old home. Rodong News Team

title: Exhibition of Art Works to Mark Day of Shining Star Opens
body: An exhibition of art works "Korean National Tree-Pine" to mark the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il (Day of the Shining Star) opened at the Pyongyang International House of Culture on Wednesday. Seen on the front wall of the exhibition venue is an acryl painting "Best wish of all people" depicting President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. On display at the exhibition were more than 150 works based on pine tree created by painters and amateurs across the country. Korean paintings "Robust pine tree" and "Overcoming heavy frost", acryl painting "Green pine tree on Mt Ryongak" and others vividly depict pine tree that grows in thick verdure in all seasons despite any storm. The exhibition goes on till February 27. Rodong News Team

title: State Academic Degrees and Titles Conferred on Intellectuals
body: Meritorious intellectuals were awarded state academic degrees and titles with due ceremony in the DPRK on Wednesday on the occasion of the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The title of candidate academician went to Song Ye Ok, head of a department of Pyongyang Medical College of Kim Il Sung University, Kim Kyu Phil, teacher at Kim Chaek University of Technology, and Sok Jong Gun, section chief of Pyongyang University of Foreign Studies. The professorship was conferred on Kang Chol Su and Choe Kwang U, department heads of Kim Il Sung University, Jon Tae Yong, chief of a research institute of Pyongyang Medical College of Kim Il Sung University, Kim Chol Ryong, faculty head of Kim Chaek University of Technology, Jong Kang Ho, faculty head of Pyongyang University of Railways, Ha Kyong Chol, faculty head of Phyongsong University of Coal Mining, etc. The doctorate went to Ra Yong Il, ex-chief of a section of the State Academy of Sciences, Kim Kwang Sik, department head of Kim Il Sung University, and others and the associate professorship to 195 persons, and the master's degree to 951 persons. They made positive contributions to the building of a powerful socialist country and the improvement of the people's standard of living by achieving successes in scientific research and education. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Introduced by Austrian Organization
body: The full text of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us Brilliantly Accomplish the Revolutionary Cause of Juche, Holding the Great Comrade Kim Jong Il in High Esteem as the Eternal General Secretary of Our Party" was posted by the Society for the Promotion of the Relations between Austria and DPRK on its website on February 6 on the occasion of the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il (the Day of the Shining Star). The work, published on April 6, Juche 101 (2012), says that to invariably hold Kim Jong Il in high esteem as the eternal general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea is the principled requirement in successfully advancing the cause of Korean revolution, indicating the tasks to be fulfilled in steadily developing the Party into the glorious party of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Shining Star Marked Abroad
body: Celebration meetings, book and photo exhibitions and film shows took place in Myanmar, Bulgaria, Romania, UK and Mexico between January 24 and February 5 on the occasion of the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il (the Day of the Shining Star). Seen at the venues of the events were photos dealing with the exploits of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and photos showing the revolutionary activities of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Exhibited there were their works, and books and photos introducing proud successes achieved by the Korean people in socialist construction. Korean films were screened at the film shows. There were speeches at the events attended by personages of various circles and people in those countries. The vice-chairman of the Yangon Regional Executive Committee of the League for National Democracy of Myanmar said that Kim Jong Il was an outstanding leader who turned the DPRK into an invincible country. The general secretary of the Central Committee of the New Communist Party of Britain said that socialism is winning victories in the DPRK thanks to the great exploits Kim Jong Il performed for the country and its people. The chairperson of the Mexican National Preparatory Committee for Celebrating the Day of the Sun and the Day of the Shining Star said that the greatest exploits of Kim Jong Il is that he firmly defended the sovereignty and dignity of the country and socialism by pursuing the unique Songun politics. A letter to Kim Jong Un was adopted at the event held in UK. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Praised in Russia
body: Russian newspapers and internet websites gave special write-ups titled "Image of great man" and "Shining star of Korea" illustrated with the portrait of smiling Chairman Kim Jong Il and his photos on the occasion of his birth anniversary. The newspaper Nakhodkinski Rabochi on January 24 said in an article that immortal revolutionary hymn "Song of General Kim Jong Il" reflects the popular life of the great man. HE Kim Jong Il showed his warm love for the people, always finding himself among them, the article noted. Thanks to his ardent love, the DPRK could demonstrate its might as a country of the single-minded unity, an invincible political and ideological power and military power which remains unswayed by any trials and difficulties, it added. The website Grifon-Personal on January 26 said: The birth of HE Kim Jong Il was a great event of weighty significance in the destiny and development of not only the Korean people but also the world progressives. He made public one after another immortal works proving the scientific accuracy and truth of socialism and the inevitability of its victory to give strength and courage to the peoples of the countries aspiring after independence, justice and socialism. The February issue of the newspaper Serp I Molot introduced in detail the immortal exploits Kim Jong Il performed for the country and its people, era and history. The internet newspaper Edinaya Korea on February 5 said: Leader Kim Jong Il worked against time. His activities embraced all areas where the people live and he continued field guidance for them even on his birthday. Rodong News Team

title: C.C., AINDF Calls for Ostracizing LKP
body: The Central Committee of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front (AINDF) issued an "Appeal to all the people" on Feb. 13 through which it called for decisively ostracizing the "Liberal Korea Party" (LKP), a cesspit of deep-seated conservative evils. The appeal cited facts that LKP - the group of traitors - is challenging the people who turned out in the candlelight struggle to a fight, reviving like a poisonous mushroom in a dump though they got the impartial public punishment to rename the ugly "Saenuri Party" "Liberal Korea Party" and to be discouraged. The LKP reckless act enraging all the people constitutes an open challenge against the above-said people who decisively tried the conservative regime for the worst crimes in the name of the people and meted out punishment to Park Geun Hye and other chief criminals who held the monopoly of the administration, the appeal said. The appeal also said that it is the demand of the public and the intention of the times to prevent the conservatives from getting united again and frustrate the reckless acts of LKP. The situation urges the people of different social standings valuing justice and truth to turn out in the nation-wide struggle to eliminate LKP - a cesspool of injustice, deep-seated evils and traitorous acts, the appeal said. So long as the LKP remains existent, no one can expect peace in this land and the improvement of the south-north relations, the appeal said. It is our people who are in charge of uprooting deep-seated conservative evils and should play the main role in eliminating the LKP, it noted. The appeal called upon all the people to pool their efforts and wage a vigorous struggle so as to decisively ostracize LKP, greet the new society of justice and truth and make the history of national reconciliation, peace and prosperity. Rodong News Team

title: Congratulations to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Diplomatic Corps in Pyongyang
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a floral basket and a congratulatory letter from the diplomatic corps in Pyongyang on the occasion of Chairman Kim Jong Il's birth anniversary (Day of the Shining Star). The floral basket and letter were handed over to Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, on Thursday by Ismail Ahmed Mohamed Hasan, Palestinian ambassador to the DPRK who is doyen of the corps. Rodong News Team

title: Floral Baskets to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un on Thursday received floral baskets from foreign bodies and personages on the occasion of the Day of the Shining Star, the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. They are the Organizing Committee of the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu, Yuwen Middle School in Jilin, China, Beijing Chao Ya International Cultural and Exchange Center in China, the Asia-Pacific Regional Committee for Supporting Peaceful Reunification of Korea, the Japan-Korea Society for Scientific and Educational Interchange, the Japan Committee for the Independent and Peaceful Reunification of Korea, the Japanese Women's Society for Solidarity with the Korean Women, the Tokushima Prefectural People's Forum for Japan-Korea Friendship, the family of Chinese anti-Japanese revolutionary martyr Zhang Wei-hua, the family of Sin Kanemaru, former deputy prime minister of Japan, Kosima Weber Liu, executive director of the Environmental Education Media Project, Kiichi Tsunota, representative of the Gunma Prefectural Council for Japan-Korea Friendship and Solidarity, and Shunichi Narita, media person of Japan. Rodong News Team

title: Vietnamese Delegation Leaves
body: A delegation of the Vietnamese Foreign Ministry led by Pham Binh Minh, deputy prime minister and foreign minister of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, went back home on Thursday. Rodong News Team

title: Credentials to Kim Yong Nam from Bulgarian Ambassador
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, received credentials from Bulgarian Ambassador to the DPRK Grigor Porozhanov at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Thursday. The president had a talk with the ambassador. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Jong Il Youth Honor Prize, Kim Jong Il Children Honor Prize Awarded
body: Kim Jong Il Youth Honor Prize and Kim Jong Il Children Honor Prize were awarded to exemplary primary committees, officials and members of the youth league and members of the children's union on the occasion of the Day of the Shining Star (birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il). Kim Jong Il Youth Honor Prize went to 20 primary committees and 22 officials and members of the youth league that distinguished themselves in consolidating the youth league organizations into the rank of young vanguards and glorifying the name of the advancing group for national defense and building of a socialist power and in study and organizational life. Kim Jong Il Children Honor Prize was awarded to 101 members of the children's union who are exemplary in study, organizational life, social and political activities and do-good-thing movement. The awarding ceremony took place at the hall of the youth league on Thursday. Rodong News Team

title: National Meeting Marks Birth Anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: A national meeting took place at the Pyongyang Indoor Stadium on Friday to celebrate the 77th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. It was attended by members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, leading officials of the Party and the government, chairman of a friendly party, leading officials of the armed forces organs, officials of the Party, armed forces organs, ministries and national institutions, service personnel of the Korean People's Army and the Korean People's Internal Security Forces, teaching staff and students of Mangyongdae Revolutionary School and Kang Pan Sok Revolutionary School and others. Also present at the meeting were congratulatory groups of overseas Koreans, overseas compatriots and the chief of the Pyongyang mission of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front. Invited there were diplomatic envoys, representatives of the international bodies, military attaches and foreigners here. Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, made a report. He said that all the Party members and other people and service personnel are splendidly celebrating the 77th birth anniversary of Kim Jong Il. He noted that the history of Kim Jong Il's revolutionary leadership is the glorious one of the most prominent leader and great sage of revolution who led the Juche-oriented socialist cause only to the road of victory and thus performed immortal exploits before the country and on behalf of mankind. He lauded Kim Jong Il as the brilliant thinker and theoretician who provided the powerful ideological weapon for the victorious advance of the popular masses' cause of independence and socialism and the outstanding politician who made sure that revolution and construction were made by our own efforts and our own way and thus successfully put the ideal of Juche-oriented socialism into practice. He referred to the fact that Kim Jong Il developed Korean-style socialism into the powerful one independent in politics, self-supporting in economy and self-reliant in national defence. He stressed that Kim Jong Il is the eternal leader of the Workers' Party of Korea and people who perfectly settled the issue of succession to the revolutionary cause and thus opened up the bright prospect for Korean-style socialism. He said that Kim Jong Il advanced the patriotic line of national reunification and ushered in a turning phase for the country's independent reunification and made great contributions to the development of the global socialist movement and accomplishment of the human cause of independence with his superb diplomatic savvy and energetic external activities. He said that the revolutionary career and exploits of Kim Jong Il, who provided the eternal foundation for the prosperity of the socialist country while covering the unexplored path holding aloft the red flag of revolution all his life, would shine forever. He called for adding shine to the revolutionary exploits of Kim Jong Il forever and steadily and dynamically advancing Korean-style socialism which is put on a fresh high stage. He emphasized that the WPK and government of the DPRK would make all efforts to safeguard peace and stability on the Korean peninsula and strengthen solidarity and cooperation with the socialist countries and develop relations with all countries that are friendly to the DPRK under the ideals of independence, peace and friendship. On the same day, meetings also took place in all provinces, cities and counties and industrial complexes to celebrate the 77th birth anniversary of Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Visits Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the Korean People's Army, visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun to pay homage to Chairman Kim Jong Il on the occasion of the significant Day of the Shining Star, his birth anniversary. Kim Jong Un entered the hall where the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il stand. Placed at the statues were a floral basket in the name of the Supreme Leader and a floral basket in the name of the C.C., WPK. The Supreme Leader, together with the participants, paid a tribute to the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il. Then he entered the hall where Kim Jong Il lies in state. Kim Jong Un made a bow to Kim Jong Il, who dedicated his whole life for the prosperity of the country, happiness of people and accomplishment of the revolutionary cause of Juche, in token of his high respect and best wishes for the immortality of Kim Jong Il. He was accompanied by Choe Ryong Hae, Ri Man Gon, Kim Yo Jong, Ri Yong Sik and other officials of the Organizational Leadership Department and the Information and Publicity Department of the C.C., WPK. Political News Team

title: Paektusan Prize International Figure Skating Festival Opens
body: The 26th Paektusan Prize International Figure Skating Festival for Celebrating the Day of the Shining Star (the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il) opened with due ceremony at the Ice Rink on Friday. Present at the ceremony were Jon Kwang Ho, vice-premier of the Cabinet, Ri Il Hwan, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Ki Kwang Ho, minister of Finance and chairman of the Figure Skating Association, officials concerned and working people in Pyongyang. Also present there were diplomatic envoys of different countries and representatives of international bodies here, military attaches and staff members of foreign embassies here and other foreign guests and overseas Koreans and the chief of the Pyongyang Mission of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front. Figure skaters from the DPRK, China, Russia, Bulgaria, Belarus and Slovakia entered the venue of the ceremony. Kim Jong Su, first vice-minister of Physical Culture and Sports, made an opening address. There was a demonstration performance "Spring of February Is Forever" by the participants in the International Figure Skating Festival. DPRK figure skaters displayed graceful and strongly appealing rhythmic movements reflecting the honor of the nation blessed with the illustrious leaders in such numbers as "February Is Spring" and "The Sound of a Horse's Hooves in Mt Paektu". Foreign figure skaters who proved successful in international and national games showed well their figure skating technique in such numbers as ice dance "Tango", women's individual "Let Me Be Known" and "Hug". Rodong News Team

title: Floral Baskets to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Floral baskets were sent to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill from the family of Ya. T. Nobichenko, an internationalist soldier, Jong Il Sim, widow of DPRK Hero An Tong Su, the family of Kim Sun Ok who is related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, the Switzerland-Korea Committee and Jindallae Saphariny, president of the Jindallae Children's Foundation, on the occasion of the Day of the Shining Star, birth anniversary of Kim Jong Il. The floral baskets were laid at the statues on Friday. On the same day, Dermot Hudson, chairman of the Korean Friendship Association UK, laid a floral basket before the statues in the name of the association. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Floral Basket
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a floral basket from a director of the Board of Directors of the Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation on the occasion of Chairman Kim Jong Il's birth anniversary (Day of the Shining Star). The floral basket was conveyed to an official concerned by Director Jin Yuhua on Friday. Rodong News Team

title: LKP Slammed for Distorting Kwangju Uprising
body: The south Korean internet paper @ minplusnews carried an editorial titled "Monster group Liberal Korea Party should be liquidated" on Feb. 11. Lawmakers from the LKP held "May 18 all people hearing" and linked the Kwangju Uprising to the north and insulted the uprising as a riot and even showed its sordid intention to distort the fact, the editorial said. Citing a candidate running for its leadership post as pledging to "take the lead in ferreting out May 18 elements" with taxes collected from people, if he is elected, the editorial said his remarks are enough to betray the nature of the LKP. Saying that people wouldn't forgive those distorting the uprising to conceal the truth of the thrice-cursed massacre, the editorial stressed that it is the LKP's turn to be taken to the court following Park Geun Hye and Ryang Sung Thae as it is the hotbed of all evils. Rodong News Team

title: Agreement on Sharing Expenses for Upkeep of U.S. Forces Rejected in S. Korea
body: Organizations in Taegu of south Korea reportedly held a press conference on Feb. 11 to denounce the humiliating "special agreement on sharing the expenses for the upkeep of the U.S. forces". The organizations said that owing to the agreement concluded on Feb. 10, the expenses for the upkeep of the U.S. forces have increased more than those in the periods of Lee Myung Bak and Park Geun Hye regimes when the south-north relations hit the worst phase. They disclosed that the agreement is a humiliating one utterly serving the U.S. illegal and unreasonable demand for increased expenses and goes against the situation towards peace and reunification and the desire of the south Korean people. Rodong News Team

title: Floral Basket to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a floral basket from a delegation of the Secretariat of the Japanese National Liaison Council of Societies for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism on the occasion of the Day of the Shining Star, birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The floral basket was handed over to an official concerned on Friday by Yoshio Kobayashi, head of the delegation. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Published in DR Congo
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us Brilliantly Accomplish the Revolutionary Cause of Juche, Holding the Great Comrade Kim Jong Il in High Esteem as the Eternal General Secretary of Our Party" was brought out in booklet by the Cedi Publishing House of the Democratic Republic of Congo. The work, published on April 6, Juche 101 (2012), says it is the principled requirement for the victorious advance of the Korean revolution to hold Chairman Kim Jong Il in high esteem as the eternal general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea. It also indicates the tasks for steadily developing the WPK into the glorious party of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. A book-releasing ceremony took place on Feb. 7. Rodong News Team

title: Banquet Given to Celebrate Day of Shining Star
body: The Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea hosted a banquet on Saturday, the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. It was attended by members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, leading officials of the Party and the government, the chairperson of a friendly party, officials of ministries, national institutions, armed forces organs and city-level institutions and meritorious persons. Also present there were overseas compatriots, including the congratulatory groups of Koreans in Japan and the General Association of Koreans in China for celebrating the Day of the Shining Star and the art troupe of Koreans in Japan, and the chief of the Pyongyang mission of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front. Present there on invitation were diplomatic envoys, representatives of international bodies, military attaches and their spouses here and other foreigners. Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, made a speech. He said that Kim Jong Il is a peerless patriot, benevolent father of people and great sage of revolution who made immortal dedication to the victorious advance of the revolutionary cause of Juche, national reunification and cause of global independence with his rare wisdom and outstanding guidance. Under the guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, brilliant achievements have been made in the struggle for bringing into full bloom Kim Jong Il's plans and desires, and the dignity and prestige of the DPRK demonstrated all over the world, he pointed out. He stressed that the WPK and the people of the DPRK would hold Kim Jong Il in high esteem as the eternal sun of Juche, creditably carry forward and develop his idea and exploits and surely build the best country where the people lead a happy life with nothing to envy, as desired by him. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Shining Star Celebrated
body: The Day of the Shining Star, Chairman Kim Jong Il's birth anniversary, was significantly celebrated in the DPRK. People visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun where President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il lie in state. The visitors made a bow before the portraits of smiling Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il at the palace forecourt. Working people, youth and schoolchildren, servicepersons visited the statues of the great leaders on Mansu Hill and in other parts of the country to pay homage to them. A sea of flowers in praise of the great man was presented at the venues of the 23rd Kimjongilia Festival and similar provincial festivals. Colorful art performances were given at theatres here and across the country. Many pupils across the country had admission ceremonies to the Korean Children's Union. Art performances were given at industrial establishment and on farms. In Pyongyang sports games took place to rev up the festive mood. Pyongyangites enjoyed the holiday at the Mangyongdae Amusement Park, the Munsu Water Park, the Central Zoo and the Natural History Museum. Rodong News Team

title: Senior Government Officials Visit Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: Senior government officials visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on Saturday, the 77th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Present there were Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, and other senior government officials, the chairperson of a friendly party and officials of the power organs, the Cabinet, ministries and national institutions. Seen standing before the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il was a floral basket in the august name of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and floral baskets in the name of the Central Committee of the WPK and in the joint name of the Central Military Commission of the WPK and the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK. Placed before the statues was a floral basket in the joint name of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly and the Cabinet of the DPRK. The senior government officials paid respects to the statues. At the hall where Kim Jong Il lies in state, they made a bow to him in humblest reverence, looking back upon his immortal revolutionary career and exploits. Rodong News Team

title: Dancing Parties Mark Day of Shining Star
body: Dancing parties of youth and students took place across the DPRK on Saturday to celebrate the Day of the Shining Star, the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Dancing places in Pyongyang, including plazas of the Monument to Party Founding and the Arch of Triumph were crowded with youth and students celebrating the spring holiday in February. Amid the playing of song "Fortune of Korea", those places turned into a sea of dancers offering the highest glory to Kim Jong Il, who provided a solid foundation for the eternal prosperity of the nation and happiness of the people by making ceaseless journeys for the country and the people all his life. Songs like "Advancing Socialism", "Song of Youth" and "Dash toward Future" resounded throughout the dancing venues, reflective of the vigor and enthusiasm of young people creating heroic myth in all sites of socialist construction with Kim Jong Il's patriotism. On the same day, similar dancing parties took place across the country. Rodong News Team

title: Joint National Meeting of KCU Organizations Held
body: A joint national meeting of the Korean Children's Union organizations took place in Pyongyang on Saturday, the 77th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Attending it were delegates of the KCU from provinces and schoolchildren in Pyongyang and pupils joining the KCU. Present on invitation were Vice-Chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea Pak Thae Song, Chairman of the Education Commission Kim Sung Du, officials of relevant fields and the youth league, war veterans and persons of merit. Pak Chol Min, chairman of the Central Committee of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League, made a report. A ceremony for admission to the KCU was held at the meeting. Pupils joining the KCU made an oath, led by Pak Thae Song. Officials, war veterans and meritorious persons tied red ties around the necks of the pupils joining the KCU and attached KCU badges on their chests. Then Kim Hyong Bong, lecturer at the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum, Ro Chol Jun, section chief of the State Academy of Sciences, and Pak Mi Hyang, player at the Pyongyang City Taekwon-Do Players Team, delivered congratulatory speeches. The speakers congratulated the pupils on their admission and asked them to further glorify the glorious tradition of the KCU, the reliable heir of the lineage of Paektu, and to grow up to be stalwart future masters who will shoulder a powerful socialist country. Rodong News Team

title: First-term Winter Camping Starts
body: The first-term winter camping started in Jangjasan Children's Camp on the occasion of the Day of the Shining Star (birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il). Taking part in the camping were schoolchildren from across the country. A report and speeches were made at the starting ceremony held on Saturday. Present at the ceremony were Kim Jae Ryong, chairman of the Jagang Provincial Party Committee, Ri Hyong Gun, chairman of the Jagang Provincial People's Committee, officials concerned, officials and teaching staff of the camp and campers. Rodong News Team

title: Members of AINDF Pyongyang Mission Visit Venue of 23rd Kimjongilia Festival
body: Chief Pak Su Chol and members of the Pyongyang mission of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front visited the venue of the 23rd Kimjongilia Festival on Saturday, the Day of the Shining Star (the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il). They looked round the venue of the festival in praise of the great man. Rodong News Team

title: Floral Baskets Laid at Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Working people, youth and students and servicepersons visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in different parts of the country. Seen at the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill was a floral basket sent by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Placed before the statues were floral baskets in the names of the Party, power and armed forces organs, public organizations, ministries, national institutions and institutions, industrial establishments and schools at all levels in Pyongyang, units of the Korean People's Army (KPA) and the Korean People's Internal Security Forces (KPISF) and bouquets. Also laid at the statues was a floral basket in the name of the Pyongyang mission of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front. Visitors made a bow to the statues of the great leaders. Floral baskets in the names of Kim Il Sung University, the Ministry of the People's Armed Forces, the Ministry of People's Security, the Mansudae Art Studio and other institutions, enterprises and units of the KPA and the KPISF were laid at the statues of the great leaders in various parts of Pyongyang. Working people, youth and students and servicepersons visited the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il and mosaics of their smiling images in their residential areas to pay high tribute to them. Rodong News Team

title: Foreigners Pay Tribute to President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Foreigners and overseas compatriots including participants in the 23rd Kimjongilia Festival, congratulatory groups of Koreans in Japan and the General Association of Koreans in China visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on Saturday to pay tribute to Chairman Kim Jong Il on the occasion of the Day of the Shining Star, his birth anniversary. They paid deep respects to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. In the hall where Kim Jong Il lies in state, they made a bow to him. They went round the hall in which orders Kim Jong Il received are on display and halls which house the car, electric car, boat and train coach used by him during his field guidance and foreign tours till the last moments of his life. On the same day, the chief of the Pyongyang Mission of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front and members of the mission visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun to pay tribute to Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: Anachronistic Act of S. Korean Conservative Forces
body: The coteries of the “Liberal Korean Party” of south Korea, referring to the north-south agreement in the military field, are touting that “security foundation has broken down”, “sovereignty over national defence has been violated” and the agreement has to be “nullified”. They even went to areas near the Military Demarcation Line where they touted that the revision or nullification of the agreement in the military field is the way of “defending security”. The former minister of National Defence, the former chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, and other retirees from the military formed an ultra-right conservative organization and raised a disturbance, calling for scrapping the military agreement while trumpeting about “sham peace” and “general security crisis”. This clearly proves once again the despicable nature of the group of traitors to the nation finding their way-out in confrontation and escalated tensions, being displeased with the peace and stability settling on the Korean peninsula. The thoughtless act of the south Korean conservative forces keen on scrapping the military agreement is nothing but last-ditch efforts of those keen on saving their poor destiny doomed to ruin, as they are now lost to the means of existence maintained by dint of confrontation with the advent of the era of peace. Whether they are conservative opposition parties or retired military gangsters, whoever calls for abrogation of the military agreement are group of traitors that have to be eliminated at an early date for national reconciliation and unity and peace of the Korean peninsula. No matter how desperately the south Korean conservative forces may try to mislead the public opinion and prolong their remaining days, nothing will ever be effective. The group of traitors is fated to meet miserable fate, marginalized by the rapid current of the times. Pak Chol Jun

title: Editorial
body: Let Us Glorify Chairman Kim Jong Il's Exploits As Chairman Kim Jong Il was held in high esteem, the lifeline of the Juche revolution that was pioneered on Mt Paektu and the ever-victorious history have been invariably maintained and the grandiose new era of the country’s prosperity has opened up. Chairman Kim Jong Il is an outstanding leader and peerless patriot who warmly loved the country and its people and set a contemporary example in the building of a powerful socialist nation through his tireless guidance. Patriotism which Kim Jong Il was possessed of and personally applied to the reality is unprecedented in history in its depth, scale and intensity. He didn’t hesitate to inspect the forefronts within the sight of enemies and kept on giving field guidance while enduring manifold mental and physical fatigue with superhuman spirit in order to defend the country. Thanks to his untiring patriotic devotion, Korean-style socialism has been consolidated to be an invincible fortress and a dramatic change made in the country’s dignity and position. All the people will never forget his exploits for building a power and strong armed forces by burning himself out to glorify the DPRK before the world and laying firm groundwork for the building of a powerful socialist nation.

title: Art Troupe of Koreans in Japan Gives Performance for Guests of Honor
body: An art troupe of Koreans in Japan for celebrating the Day of the Shining Star (the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il) gave a music and dance performance "The General Association of Korean Residents in Japan Shines with Blessings of February" at the Pyongyang Grand Theatre on Sunday. Invited to it were Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, and other senior party and government officials; officials of ministries and national institutions and working people in Pyongyang. Among the audience were overseas Koreans and the chief of the Pyongyang mission of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front. The performance started with song and dance "The General Association of Korean Residents in Japan Shines with Blessings of February". Put on the stage were such numbers as female solo "Ode to Comrade Kim Jong Il", male solo "His Ideal" and dance "Flower I Love". The performance touched the heartstrings of the audience as it well represented the deep yearnings for Kim Jong Il who took deep care of the sons and daughters residing in an alien land just as one would do to one's own family members. The performance reached its climax with male solo "The Country Precisely Means the Marshal" and male solo and mixed chorus "Our National Flag" portraying their ardent love for socialist motherland led by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Some numbers reflected the firm will and indomitable spirit of Koreans in Japan to further develop the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan, the patriotic legacy left by Kim Jong Il, into the Juche-oriented overseas Koreans organization under the leadership of Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Yong Nam Meets Art Troupe of Koreans in Japan
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the DPRK Supreme People's Assembly, on Sunday met and had a talk in a compatriotic atmosphere with the art troupe of Koreans in Japan giving an art performance at Pyongyang Grand Theatre on the occasion of the Day of the Shining Star (the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il). Rodong News Team

title: Paektusan Prize International Figure Skating Festival Closes
body: The 26th Paektusan Prize International Figure Skating Festival for Celebrating the Day of the Shining Star, the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il, was closed with due ceremony at the Ice Rink on Sunday. Present at the ceremony were Jon Kwang Ho, vice-premier of the Cabinet, Ri Il Hwan, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Ki Kwang Ho, minister of Finance and chairman of the Figure Skating Association, officials concerned, and working people in Pyongyang City. Festival cups were awarded to players of the DPRK, China, Russia, Belarus and Slovakia who displayed refined representation and high techniques. A demonstration of figure skaters of the DPRK and other countries followed a closing address. Rodong News Team

title: Japanese Figures Visit 23rd Kimjongilia Festival Venue
body: A delegation of the Secretariat of the Japanese National Liaison Council of Societies for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism led by Yoshio Kobayashi visited the 23rd Kimjongilia Festival venue. They looked round the venue which presented spectacular scenery with immortal flowers in full bloom in profound reverence of all people for Chairman Kim Jong Il. They also visited the Korean Revolution Museum and the Korean Stamps Museum. Rodong News Team

title: South Korean Ruling Party Urges Official Apology of LKP
body: The Minju Party of south Korea reportedly demanded that the "Liberal Korea Party" make an official apology while urging punishment of those who distorted the Kwangju Uprising on Feb. 11. The members of the Minju Party held a meeting in the "National Assembly" and denounced the lawmakers of LKP for distorting the spirit of the May 18 Kwangju Uprising and insulting history. They criticized the LKP lawmakers for even describing the chief criminal of the Kwangju massacre Chun Doo Hwan as a "hero". Rodong News Team

title: Shameful Reckless Remarks of Japanese Authorities under Fire
body: Civic and public organizations of south Korea including the Justice Preserving Solidarity for Settling the Issue of Sexual Slavery of the Imperial Japanese Army released a statement on February 11 to condemn the shameful remarks of the Japanese authorities, according to the south Korean Yonhap News. The statement said that on the news of death of Kim Pok Dong, a victim of sexual slavery, the Japanese government made unreasonable sophism that it "made a sincere apology." It urged the Japanese government to stop at once the acts going against the humanity which also fall foul of the morals and international practices, admit its past crimes and make a legal responsibility for them. Rodong News Team

title: Japanese Delegation Visits Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: A delegation of the Secretariat of the Japanese National Liaison Council of Societies for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism led by Yoshio Kobayashi visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on Sunday. They paid noble tribute to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in the palace. At the halls of immortality where the great leaders lie in state the visitors paid homage to them. They made rounds of the halls where the orders the great leaders received are on display and the halls that house cars, electric car, boat and train coaches used by them during their field guidance and foreign tours till the last moments of their lives. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Work Posted on Russian Website
body: The complete text of Chairman Kim Jong Il's work "The Workers' Party of Korea Organizes and Guides All the Victories of Our People" was posted on the Russian website Irkutskblogspot. Ru on Feb. 7 to mark his 77th birth anniversary. The work, published on Oct. 3, Juche 79 (1990), puts forward the idea that the Party's leadership is a decisive guarantee for the accomplishment of socialist cause, the issues of strengthening and developing the Workers' Party of Korea into a Juche-type revolutionary party, the basic ways of fulfilling the mission and duty of the Party as a leading political organization, etc. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Shining Star Marked Abroad
body: Progressive political parties and friendship organizations in North Europe had a joint meeting and book and photo exhibition in Sweden on February 9 in celebration of the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il (Day of the Shining Star). Seen on the front wall of the venue were an art work of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. Also on exhibition were photos of precious careers and feats of the great leaders and ones of revolutionary activities of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. On show were works of the peerlessly great men and books and photos of praiseworthy successes of the Korean people in the socialist construction. Attending the event were personages of progressive political parties, organizations for the friendship and solidarity with the Korean people and Juche idea study organizations in nations of North Europe including Sweden, Finland and Norway and the DPRK ambassador to Sweden and his embassy officials and others. The participants in the event placed bouquets and flowers before the picture of the great leaders. Juha Kieksi, international secretary of the Finnish Communists' League; Dag Norum, chairman of the Ostfold County Committee of the Communist Party of Norway; and Christer Lundgren, chairman of the Sweden－Korea Friendship Association; praised Kim Jong Il for laying an everlasting foundation for the eternal prosperity of the country and nation. A message of greeting to Kim Jong Un was adopted there. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a message of greeting from the General Association of Koreans in China on February 16. The message paid the highest tribute and extended the eternal glory to Chairman Kim Jong Il reflecting the respect of the officials of the organization and all the Koreans in China for him on the occasion of his birth anniversary, the Day of the Shining Star, the most auspicious day in the history of the nation. It said that he performed great feats to be always remembered by the country and nation and the era and history by leading the revolutionary cause of Juche to the glorious ever-victorious road only with his great idea, outstanding leadership and noble moral influence. It stated that he reliably protected the country and socialism by dint of Songun in the grim period during which the imperialists got extremely frantic in the moves to stifle socialist Korea and thus laid an eternal foundation for the prosperity of the nation, the message said, adding that it is the greatest of his feats for the nation and the era. It stressed that the precious revolutionary feats of Kim Jong Il who worked with the warm love for the country and nation and noble dedication throughout his life will go down for all ages. It said that the revolutionary cause of Juche pioneered by President Kim Il Sung and successfully carried out by Kim Jong Il is dynamically advancing towards the ultimate victory thanks to another heaven-sent great man Kim Jong Un. The message underscored the need to usher in a new heyday of the patriotic movement of the Korean residents in China. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Birth Anniversary Marked in Japan
body: A meeting of Koreans in Japan took place at the Korean Hall of Culture in Tokyo, Japan on Feb. 15 in celebration of the 77th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Attending the meeting were Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon); Nam Sung U, vice-chairman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee; Pae Jin Gu, vice-chairman and concurrently director general of the General Affairs Department of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee; Jo Il Yon, vice-chairman and concurrently director of the Organization Department of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee; Pak Ku Ho, vice-chairman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee; Kang Chu Ryon, vice-chairwoman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee and concurrently chairwoman of the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Democratic Korean Women in Japan; Ri Myong Yu, chairman of the Central Audit Committee of Chongryon; advisers and department directors of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, the chief of the Research Institute on History of Korean Residents in Japan, the rector of Korean University, chairpersons of the Chongryon headquarters in Kanto, leading officials of the central leadership bodies and affiliates, Chongryon officials and teachers and students at Korean University. Ho Jong Man made a report. He paid high tribute to Kim Jong Il and made a bow to him, praying for his immortality on the occasion of the Day of the Shining Star. He said that Kim Jong Il, who was born into a son of the guerrillas in Mt Paektu, the holy mountain of revolution, and grew up in the stirring period of the construction of new Korea and during the Fatherland Liberation War, is a peerless statesman as he successfully led the overall work of the Party, state and army to usher in a great heyday of the Juche cause. He also said that Kim Jong Il would always be with us as the sun of Juche as he made ever-victorious history of the Korean revolution and fully demonstrated the dignity of the country and bolstered up its power and his undying feats for the prosperity of Juche Korea would be glorified for all ages. The reporter appealed to the officials of Chongryon and all the Koreans in Japan to be loyal to the leadership of Marshal Kim Jong Un and make an all-out effort to implement the decisions of the 24th Congress of Chongryon with a firm confidence in victory. Rodong News Team

title: Art Performance Marks Chairman Kim Jong Il's Birth Anniversary in Japan
body: Koreans in Japan gave an art performance at the Korean Hall of Culture in Tokyo, Japan on Feb. 15 in celebration of the 77th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Enjoying the performance were Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon); Nam Sung U, vice-chairman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee; Pae Jin Gu, vice-chairman and concurrently director general of the General Affairs Department of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee; Jo Il Yon, vice-chairman and concurrently director of the Organizational Department of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee; Pak Ku Ho, vice-chairman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee; Kang Chu Ryon, vice-chairwoman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee and concurrently chairwoman of the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Democratic Korean Women in Japan; Ri Myong Yu, chairman of the Central Audit Committee of Chongryon; advisers and department directors of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, the chief of the Research Institute on History of Korean Residents in Japan, leading officials of the central leadership bodies and affiliates, chairpersons of the Chongryon headquarters in Kanto, Chongryon officials, Koreans in Japan and teachers and students at Korean University. The performance was given by artistes of the Kumgang-san Opera Troupe of Chongryon, the Korean Song and Dance Ensemble in Tokyo, members of the Korean Youth League in Kanto, members of the song circle of the women's union and students of Korean University. The performance began with a chorus of students of Korean University "Song of General Kim Jong Il", an immortal revolutionary hymn. Put on the stage were colorful numbers such as a male solo "Ode to Comrade Kim Jong Il". The performers represented the ardent yearning of Chongryon officials and Koreans in Japan for Kim Jong Il who performed undying feats in accomplishing the Juche cause and carrying out the movement of Koreans in Japan. Also staged were a female vocal sextet "Ardent Desire" representing the ardent desire of the Korean people and the Koreans in Japan for wellbeing of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and a solo in bass and chorus "Our National Flag" exciting the audience with ardent patriotism. Rodong News Team

title: Chongryon Gives Lecture to Mark Birth Anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: The lecture of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) was given at the Korean Hall in Tokyo, Japan on Feb. 11 in celebration of the 77th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Attending the lecture were Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of Chongryon, and its vice-chairpersons, the chairman of the Central Audit Committee of Chongryon, officials of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee and central leadership bodies and affiliates and Chongryon officials in Kanto. Screened at the lecture was a video "Immortal Feats for National Reunification". The video is about the fact that Kim Jong Il energetically led the patriotic struggle of the fellow countrymen for reunification, regarding it as his lifelong mission to carry out the instructions of President Kim Il Sung for national reunification. It showed that thanks to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, the cause of national reunification, the supreme national desire, is sure to be accomplished, and called for thoroughly implementing the historic north-south declarations so as to make a positive contribution to ushering in a heyday of peace, prosperity and reunification of the Korean peninsula. Also screened at the lecture was a Korean documentary dealing with the feats of Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Birth Anniversary Marked by Koreans in China
body: The General Association of Koreans in China organized functions in celebration of the 77th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il (Day of the Shining Star). Attending the celebrations were Choe Su Bong, first vice-chairman of the association, and other officials and representatives of its affiliates, members of the Federation of Korean Economic Workers in China, Association of Young Korean Nationals in China and the Association of Korean Enterprisers in China, Korean nationals in Shenyang City, the DPRK consul general in Shenyang and officials of his consulate general. Present at the celebrations on invitation were compatriots from all walks of life and personages in Liaoning Province and Shenyang City. The association had a meeting in its conference room on Feb. 14 in celebration of the Day of the Shining Star. Choe Su Bong in his report said that Kim Jong Il pushed forward with the revolution and construction true to the idea and intention of President Kim Il Sung and performed undying great feats for the country and nation, the era and history. He said that Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un is leading the work to accomplish the revolutionary cause of Juche, adding that they would be loyal to his leadership as they trusted and followed the great leaders. A message of greeting to Kim Jong Un was adopted at the meeting. Then the participants watched a Korean documentary showing the efforts made by Kim Jong Un to turn Samjiyon County into the people's ideal land. Prior to the meeting, the participants looked round photos of revolutionary activities of the peerlessly great men and several other photos and books in the venue of the photo and book exhibition. An art performance was given in Shenyang, China to celebrate the Day of the Shining Star on Feb. 15. A reception was given that day in celebration of the Day of the Shining Star. Similar celebrations were held by the Zhongnan Regional Association of the General Association of Koreans in China and other affiliates. Rodong News Team

title: Photo Exhibition Marks Chairman Kim Jong Il's Birth Anniversary in Japan
body: The photo exhibition of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) was held at the Korean Hall of Culture in Tokyo, Japan on Feb. 15 to celebrate the 77th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. On display in the venue were photos of revolutionary careers of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and those of revolutionary activities of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of Chongryon, Nam Sung U, vice-chairman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, advisers and department directors of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, the chief of the Research Institute on History of Korean Residents in Japan, leading officials of central leadership bodies and affiliates, and chairpersons of the Chongryon headquarters in Kanto looked round the exhibition hall. Rodong News Team

title: Chinese Guests and Koreans in China Visit Mangyongdae
body: Chinese guests and Koreans in China taking parting in the 23rd Kimjongilia Festival visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. They laid bouquets at his old home in humble reverence for him. Being briefed on his revolutionary career, the visitors looked round the historical relics preserved. They also toured the Korean Revolution Museum, the Rungna Dolphinarium and other places. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Published in Bangladesh
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us Brilliantly Accomplish the Revolutionary Cause of Juche, Holding the Great Comrade Kim Jong Il in High Esteem as the Eternal General Secretary of Our Party" was brought out in booklet with due ceremony by a publishing house in Dhaka, Bangladesh on Feb. 9. The work, published on April 6, Juche 101 (2012), says it is the principled requirement for the victorious advance of the Korean revolution to hold Chairman Kim Jong Il in high esteem as the eternal general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea. It also indicates the tasks for steadily developing the WPK into the glorious party of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: Brief Biography of Chairman Kim Jong Il Posted on Website of Romanian Body
body: The Romanian Workers' Association posted on its website Romania Muncitoare the brief biography of Chairman Kim Jong Il on Feb. 13 on the occasion of the Day of the Shining Star, his birth anniversary. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Exploits Praised by Indonesian Figure
body: Ristiyanto, general secretary of the National Guidance Council of the Pioneer Party of Indonesia, issued a statement on Feb. 11 on the occasion of the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. He said that they are reverently looking back upon the exploits Kim Jong Il performed before the times and history on his 77th birth anniversary. He noted that Kim Jong Il was the benevolent father who devoted his all to the prosperity of the country and happiness of the people till the last moments of his life. He stated that Kim Jong Il made a great contribution to developing friendly relations between Indonesia and the DPRK and ensuring the world peace and security. He stressed that the reverence for Kim Jong Il will be always kept in the hearts of the Indonesian people. Rodong News Team

title: Japanese Figures Leave
body: A delegation of the Secretariat of the Japanese National Liaison Council of Societies for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism led by Yoshio Kobayashi left Pyongyang for home on Tuesday. Rodong News TEam

title: Korean Art Troupe in Japan Leaves
body: An art troupe of Koreans in Japan for celebrating the Day of the Shining Star led by Kim Jong Su, head of the Kumgang-san Opera Troupe of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan, left Pyongyang on Tuesday. Rodong News Team

title: Congratulatory Group of General Association of Koreans in China Leaves
body: A congratulatory group of the General Association of Koreans in China for celebrating the Day of the Shining Star led by Vice-Chairperson Ri Sun Nam left Pyongyang on Tuesday. Rodong News Team

title: Foreign Players Leave
body: Players of China, Bulgaria, Belarus and Slovakia left Pyongyang for home on Tuesday after participating in the 26th Paektusan Prize International Figure Skating Festival for Celebrating the Day of the Shining Star. Earlier leaving Pyongyang was a Russian player. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Birthday Spread to Centenarian
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un sent a birthday spread to Ri Ho Song, a centenarian living in Taedongmun-dong, Central District, Pyongyang. She, who was born into a poor peasant's family in Songchon County and suffered humiliation and insult before the liberation of the country, helped her husband, a member of the Association for the Restoration of the Fatherland, with his revolutionary work and made a contribution to the national liberation. After the liberation of the country, she became a member of the Workers' Party of Korea and official of the women's union under the care of President Kim Il Sung and aroused members of the women's union to the building of a new country. During the Fatherland Liberation War, she joined the army with a high sense of obligation for national defense and fully carried out her duty, proceeding from the mission to defend the country and in the periods of the post-war reconstruction and socialist construction she worked hard for the prosperity of the country. She is enjoying the rest of her life under the socialist system, being respected as a bereaved family member of an anti-Japanese patriotic martyr and a war veteran under the care of the Party. Rodong News Team

title: Director of Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation Leaves
body: Jin Yuhua, director of the Board of Directors of the Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation, and her party left Pyongyang on Tuesday. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Work Published in Germany
body: Chairman Kim Jong Il's work "Let Us Struggle Resolutely to Implement the Three Principles of National Reunification" was published in booklet by the Azzawi Media Print Publishing House in Berlin on the occasion of his birth anniversary (Day of the Shining Star). The work, published on July 14, Juche 61 (1972), underscores the need to make strenuous efforts to implement the three principles of national reunification and indicates tasks for their implementation. Rodong News Team

title: Congolese Body: Single-minded Unity Is Source of Invincible Strength of DPRK
body: A Congolese preparatory committee for celebrating the 77th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il issued an information bulletin on Feb. 11. The bulletin said in an article titled "On the Occasion of the 77th Birth Anniversary of the Great Leader Kim Jong Il of the Korean People, Single-minded Unity of Korea and Kim Jong Il": Leader Kim Jong Il set the single-minded unity as a revolutionary philosophy of the Workers' Party of Korea and thus provided a mighty ideological and theoretical weapon for the victory in the revolution. He put forward the idea of unity centered on the leader and with its might led the socialist construction to victory. The might of the single-minded unity has been fully demonstrated in the struggle to frustrate the imperialists' vicious and persistent moves for stifling the DPRK through sanctions and pave a broad avenue to the construction of a powerful nation. It is thanks to the single-minded unity, the strongest weapon, that Korea, though small in its territory, is making progress, performing epoch-making miracles despite severe trials and difficulties. The single-minded unity is, indeed, a source of the invincible strength of socialist Korea and a treasured sword of certain victory. Rodong News Team

title: Seminar Held in India
body: An Indian national seminar on the Juche idea "National Sovereignty and Global Peace" took place at University of Delhi on Feb. 13 ahead of the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il (Day of the Shining Star). At the seminar, Harish Gupta, director general of the Asian Regional Institute of the Juche Idea, made a keynote report which was followed by speeches. The reporter and speakers said that the Day of the Shining Star is a common holiday of mankind which is grandly celebrated by not only the Korean people but also the world progressive people. They highly praised President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, the eternal leaders of the Korean people, as the peerlessly great men who performed undying feats in achieving the prosperity of the country and accomplishing the cause of global peace.
