They stated Kim Jong Un, the Supreme Leader of the Korean people, is developing the DPRK into a more powerful country, holding higher the banner of the Juche idea, adding that the daily-changing look of the DPRK clearly shows his greatness and wise leadership. A letter to Kim Jong Un was adopted at the seminar. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Yong Nam Meets Congratulatory Group of Koreans in Japan
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, met and had a talk with the congratulatory group of Koreans in Japan for celebrating the Day of the Shining Star headed by Ri Ju Hak, chairman of the Fukuoka Prefectural Headquarters of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Wednesday. Rodong News Team

title: Congratulatory Group of Koreans in Japan Visits Different Places of Pyongyang
body: A congratulatory group of Koreans in Japan for celebrating the Day of the Shining Star headed by Ri Ju Hak, chairman of the Fukuoka Prefectural Headquarters of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan, visited Pyongyang Teacher Training College. Members of the group looked round the room dedicated to the history of the college, exhibition hall for educational science, education control room, etc. They also toured the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Silk Mill, the Ryuwon Footwear Factory, the Pyongyang Bag Factory and others. Rodong News Team

title: Film Show Marks Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's First China Visit
body: A film show was held at the Taedongmun Cinema on Wednesday in the joint name of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries, the DPRK-China Friendship Association, the Ministry of Culture and Tourism of China and the Chinese embassy here to mark the first anniversary of the historic first visit to China paid by Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. Present there were Kim Jong Suk, chairwoman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries, Ri Chang Gun, vice department director of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea, members of the DPRK-China Friendship Association, officials concerned and working people in Pyongyang. It was also attended by Li Jinjun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK, and his embassy members and the visiting culture and art delegation from Jilin Province, China and Chinese guests. Speeches were made there. The participants watched a Korean documentary dealing with the exploits of Kim Jong Un, who recorded a brilliant chapter in the chronicle of the great DPRK-China friendship through his first China visit. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK-China Friendship Spring Concert Given by Chinese Artistes
body: A DPRK-China friendship spring concert was given by the Chinese artistes at the Ponghwa Art Theatre on Wednesday in the joint name of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries, the DPRK-China Friendship Association, the Ministry of Culture and Tourism of China and the Chinese embassy here to mark the first anniversary of the historic first visit to China paid by Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. Among the audience were Jon Kwang Ho, vice-premier of the Cabinet, Pak Chun Nam, minister of Culture, Ri Chang Gun, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and others, members of the DPRK-China Friendship Association, officials concerned and working people in the city. Chinese Ambassador to the DPRK Li Jinjun and his embassy members, Chinese guests staying here and Chinese residents here watched the concert. Speeches were made before the concert. The artistes of a culture and art delegation from Jilin Province, China represented the aspiration to add beauty to the flower garden of DPRK-China friendship and steadily promote the friendly feelings between the two peoples through special and traditional cultural exchange this year that marks the 70th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic ties between the DPRK and China. They showed well ardent patriotism, national emotion and romantic life with peculiar singing method, rich voice and smart and elegant rhythm through colorful numbers. "Where Are You, Dear General?", an immortal masterpiece, and "Ardent Desire" sung by performers deeply moved the audience for vividly reflecting the ardent reverence of the Chinese people for Chairman Kim Jong Il and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un who made contributions to the history of DPRK-China friendship and solidarity. Rodong News Team

title: 34th Sci-Tech Festival of Kim Il Sung University Opens
body: The 34th Sci-Tech Festival of Kim Il Sung University was opened with due ceremony on Wednesday. Attending the festival under the theme of "The spirit of self-reliance and the might of science and technology" are teachers, researchers, graduate students and students of the university. The festival, divided into 12 panels including basic science, electronics and automation, IT, agriculture and bio-engineering, medical appliances and pharmacy is to be held in the forms of presentation and exhibition of sci-tech achievements and ideas, exhibition contest among different units and exchange of new technologies. Presented to the festival were more than 300 achievements made in their scientific researches and over 80 scientific ideas. Rodong News Team

title: Product of Pressure and Servility
body: Shortly ago, the south Korean authorities and the U.S. finished the negotiations for the conclusion of the 10th “special agreement on sharing the expenses for the upkeep of the U.S. forces” and initialed the agreement in Seoul. According to it, they agreed to increase the expenses by 8.2 percent over the last year. Its term of validity is one year as demanded by the U.S. The conclusion of the 10th “special agreement on sharing the expenses for the upkeep of the U.S. forces” is a product of U.S. pressure on south Korea and the latter’s submission to it. The U.S. forces in south Korea are using a great amount of tax under the pretext of the “expenses for the upkeep” every year and are not spending them all. The trend for peace is being created on the Korean peninsula thanks to the proactive efforts of the DPRK, and the measures are being taken to ease the military tensions between the north and south. Given the fact, how can we then understand a huge increase in the expenses for the upkeep of the U.S. forces in south Korea. It is not accidental that organizations and personages of all walks of life in south Korea urge the south Korean authorities to open negotiations again without delay while condemning the recent conclusion of the “special agreement on sharing the expenses for the upkeep of the U.S. forces” as an act going against peace era. No wonder the south Korean people turn out in the struggle for the repeal of the agreement while blasting it as the humiliating one and laying bare the U.S. move to take a large volume of tax under the pretext of “alliance”. Ra Sol Ha

title: Reckless Moves for Revival of Militarism
body: Abe at the recent full-dress session of the House of Representatives complained about the movement for criticizing or opposing the “Self-Defense Forces” with no reason, and also grumbled about uncooperative response to it. He stressed the need to specify the existence of the SDF in the constitution in order to end such a situation. He reiterated the same stand at the conference of the Liberal Democratic Party where he touted that the existence of the SDF has to be specified in Article 9 of the constitution. His senseless and persistent act for the retrogressive revision of the constitution from the outset of the year is a foolish trick to revise the constitution and realize at any cost the ambition for becoming a military giant and launching overseas expansion. Japan is ready for overseas aggression any moment and no one in the world will believe in Japan however loudly it may cry out for “peace”. The world people follow Japan with high vigilance, considering it as an entity threatening the world peace. The same is true for the Japanese mindset. More than 60 percent of all administrative units of Japan deny cooperation for the recruit for the SDF. Japan society has also become stronger in its demand for the step-down of the Abe Cabinet. The Japan ruling forces including Abe now find themselves driven into the tight corner. This notwithstanding, they keep seriously insulting its own people. The Abe group has better be reminded of what fate its predecessors met for their indulgence in overseas aggression and bloody wars. Ra Myong Song

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Work Reported by Indian Online News
body: The full text of Chairman Kim Jong Il's work "Socialism Is the Lifeline of Our People" was reported by the Indian online news Voice of Millions on Feb. 11 on the occasion of his birth anniversary (the Day of the Shining Star). The work, published on Nov. 14, Juche 81 (1992), indicates the necessity to defend the world socialist movement and the cause of socialism and the tasks and ways for defending and advancing the cause of socialism. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Lauded
body: Foreign media highly praised the revolutionary career of Chairman Kim Jong Il who performed undying feats for the era and history with his rare ideological and theoretical wisdom and outstanding leadership ability. Vishwanath, secretary general of the International Kim Il Sung Prize Council and the International Kim Jong Il Prize Council and director-general of the International Institute of the Juche Idea, was quoted in the Indian paper Indian and World Event as saying that HE Kim Jong Il was a man who was from heaven to serve mankind and such a great man is born only once in several centuries. The British Association for the Study of Songun Policy posted on its website the following article: Comrade Kim Jong Il is the great successor to the revolutionary cause of Juche pioneered by Comrade Kim Il Sung. Thanks to the Songun politics pursued by Kim Jong Il, the DPRK could step up the socialist construction vigorously, holding higher the red flag of the revolution. The Cambodian paper Nokor Thom Daily said that when many countries underwent political upheavals, HE Kim Jong Il published "Socialism Is a Science" and other immortal works to prove the scientific accuracy and truth of socialism and the inevitability of its victory. The Nigerian paper Nigerian Observer said that HE Kim Jong Il bolstered up the defense capacity of the country under the unfurled banner of Songun and thus frustrated the aggressive war moves of the imperialists. The Thai paper Xing San Daily said that leader Kim Jong Il devoted himself to the prosperity of socialist Korea true to the intention of President Kim Il Sung. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Embassador Presents Credentials to Togolese President
body: DPRK Ambassador to Togo Jon Tong Chol presented his credentials to Faure Essozimna Gnassingbe, president of the Republic of Togo, on Feb. 12. The president said the cornerstone of friendly relations between Togo and the DPRK was laid by President Kim Il Sung and former Togolese President Gnassingbe Eyadema and that the friendly relations are invariably developing on good terms. Noting that the DPRK had rendered lots of cooperation to Togo in the past, the president hoped the friendly relations between the two countries forged by the preceding leaders would develop more vigorously. He hoped this year for the DPRK would be better one than last year, stating that he is sharing the view with HE Kim Jong Un on his peace-loving policy and he will extend full support to it. He hailed the peaceful atmosphere created on the Korean Peninsula by the energetic activities of HE Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: Reception Arranged at DPRK Embassy to China on Lunar New Year's Day
body: The DPRK embassy in Beijing arranged a reception in celebration of the Lunar New Year, Juche 108 (2019). Present there on invitation were officials of the Chinese Foreign Ministry, the International Liaison Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, the Ministry of National Defense, the Ministry of Commerce, the Ministry of Public Security, the Ministry of Culture and Tourism, the Beijing Municipal People's Government and other units of China. Present there were the DPRK ambassador to China and his embassy officials. The participants looked round photos of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un making the New Year Address and making a visit to China as the first political program for this year. Speeches were made there. Ji Jae Ryong, DPRK ambassador to China, said that Kim Jong Un paid several historic visits to China to lay a firm foundation for invariably boosting the friendship and unity between the two countries, adding that his visit to China early in January was another event to be specially recorded in the history of DPRK-China friendship and unity. He affirmed that the DPRK would work hard to fully demonstrate the invariable and invincible DPRK-China friendship by boosting the friendship, unity, exchange and cooperation in various fields this meaningful year marking the 70th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the two countries. The assistant to the minister of Foreign Affairs of China said that the atmosphere of friendship between the two countries has got warm since the beginning of the year, adding that the performances given by the friendship art delegation of the DPRK in China were a cultural exchange to put the shared understanding of China and the DPRK sides into practice as well as an important activity conducted on the occasion of the 70th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic ties between the two countries. He said that the China-DPRK relations under the leadership of General Secretary Xi Jinping and Chairman Kim Jong Un have already entered a new historic stage, underscoring the need to make a positive contribution to furthering the friendly and cooperative ties with the concerted efforts as agreed on by the top leaders of the two countries. The DPRK missions in Shenyang, Dandong and Hong Kong of China also gave receptions. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK-China Friendship Spring Gathering Held
body: The 2019 DPRK-China friendship spring gathering took place at the Taedonggang Diplomatic Club on Thursday in the joint name of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries, the DPRK-China Friendship Association, the Ministry of Culture and Tourism of China and the Chinese embassy to the DPRK. Present at the gathering were Ri Kil Song, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, Pak Chun Sik, vice-minister of Culture, Pak Kyong Il, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries and chairman of the DPRK-China Friendship Association, members of the association, officials concerned, Li Jinjun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK, and his embassy members, a culture and art delegation from Jilin Province, China and Chinese guests. The participants looked round photos introducing showplaces of Jilin Province, China and customs of the people and had a better understanding of intangible heritages. They talked to each other about the need to make tangible contributions to boosting the relations between the two countries as required by the new era this year marking the 70th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the DPRK and China. Rodong News Team

title: Posters on Election of Deputies to 14th SPA Produced
body: Posters were produced with the approach of the election of deputies to the 14th Supreme People's Assembly (SPA) of the DPRK. Posters produced by the Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House bear letters "March 10" and "The day of election of deputies to SPA." Depicted on the poster "Let us further glorify socialism of our style on the strength of single-minded unity!" are a worker, a farmer and an intellectual full of pride and self-confidence of being the masters of the people's power, against the background of the fluttering flag of the DPRK. The national flag and the national emblem, the symbols of the DPRK, are reflected on the poster "Let us cement our revolutionary power as firm as rock!" Rodong News Team

title: 23rd Kimjongilia Festival Closes
body: The 23rd Kimjongilia Festival closed with due ceremony at the Kimilsungia-Kimjongilia Exhibition on Thursday. Present at the closing ceremony were Yang Hyong Sop, vice-president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, Pak Thae Song, vice-chairman of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea, Jon Kwang Ho, vice-premier of the Cabinet, officials of the festival organizing committee, ministries, national institutions and armed forces organs, working people, youth and schoolchildren, servicepersons, members of the associations for disseminating the immortal flower and overseas compatriots. The jury announced the results of the festival. Certificates of the festival prize bearing the portrait of smiling Chairman Kim Jong Il were awarded to many units, officials, cultivators and individuals, the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan and overseas compatriots. The participation certificates were also conferred on the working people and youth and schoolchildren who exhibited the immortal flowers at the festival. The chairman of the Korea Kimilsungia-Kimjongilia Committee made a closing address. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Birthday Spreads to Centenarians
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un sent birthday spreads to Kim In Hwa, a centenarian living in Ssanghak-ri, Ryongchon County and Yu Yong Ok, a centenarian living in the town of Kapsan County. Born into a poor peasant family before the liberation of the country, Kim In Hwa experienced the sorrow of a stateless nation. It was not until President Kim Il Sung liberated the country that she could lead a happy life. She took the lead in supporting the front during the Fatherland Liberation War and devoted herself to the implementation of the agricultural policy of the Workers' Party of Korea in the periods of post-war rehabilitation and construction and socialist construction. Yu Yong Ok worked hard to repay the benevolence of the Party which made her enjoy a worthy life. She brought up her children and made them stand guard over the country and work at difficult and labor-consuming posts of socialist construction. Rodong News Team

title: To Solve Actual Scientific and Technological Problems
body: The officials, teachers and researchers of Hamhung University of Chemical Engineering obtain successes in their work to solve the scientific and technological problems of establishing Juche orientation in the chemical industry. They made a device with their own efforts and technology to introduce it into a productive process of the February 8 Vinalon Complex. They went there and successfully operated it on trial in close liaison with its field workers and technicians. They made progress also in their work to lower the norm of power consumption per unit for carbide production and improve the conditions of production. Moreover, they enabled ammonium persulphate to be mass-produced even under adverse conditions. They advanced a rational method of regulating pH and proved its correctness, thus contributing to normalizing the production of acetylene and raising its quality. Staying at the Hungnam Pharmaceutical Factory the officials, teachers and researchers of the university finished arranging for basic experiments to be performed to prepare the raw materials and intermediates for essential medicines in our way. They continue to intensify their researches further. Besides, they innovated a fireproofing with raw materials abundantly available at home and enabled the life of furnaces to be prolonged. They introduced it into a cement factory and put its production on a normal basis. Pak Hyon

title: Getting 70,000 Tons of Earth and Rocks
body: The officials and working people of North Hamgyong Province successfully blew up a mountain on February 19 to produce 70,000 tons of earth and rocks and build the Phalhyang Dam of the Orangchon Power Station acceleratedly. They had already done that in January to secure 50,000 tons of the same. This demonstrated again their revolutionary zeal and preparedness to fulfill an oath of their devotion to the Party without fail under the banner of self-reliance. Builders proceed to push ahead vigorously with the production of gravel and sand and the concreting of the dam. Ri Un Nam

title: The Dharani Stone Pagoda of Haeju
body: Haeju of South Hwanghae Province boasts a unique elaborate granitic dharani pagoda. It was built in the years of Koryo(918-1392). It is 5-odd meters high. Beautiful petals are inscribed double on the base of the two-terraced round pedestal all along. A smoothly-faced hexagonal monolithic column stands on the pedestal. The whole surface of the column is engraved with a Sanskrit dharani sutra. ` The column is capped with three hexagonal stone roofs one upon another. Their corners all protrude to be shaped like the head of a turtle respectively at the end. The roofs diminish in size on the way upwards. They themselves, their ridges and the eaves are all slightly bent. In the final analysis, the pagoda looks slender yet solemn. The pagoda is the precious historical remains and treasure of the nation which testifies to the high masonry of our ancestors. Kim Chong Il

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Work Published in Russia
body: Chairman Kim Jong Il's work "On the Juche Idea" was brought out in booklet by a publishing house in Russia with due ceremony on Feb. 11. The work, published on March 31, Juche 71 (1982), deals with the immortal historic exploits of President Kim Il Sung who founded the Juche idea and their significance as well as the founding of the Juche idea and its philosophical, socio-historical and guiding principles and historical significance. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Introduced in Poland
body: The International Friendship Initiative "Explore DPRK" of Poland posted on its website Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us Step Up the Building of a Thriving Country by Applying Kim Jong Il's Patriotism" on Feb. 15 on the occasion of the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il (Day of the Shining Star). The work, published on July 26, Juche 101(2012), deals with the essence of Kim Jong Il's patriotism and his life constant in noble patriotism and loving care for the people. It also indicates the important matters arising in applying Kim Jong Il's patriotism. The website carried his photo. Rodong News Team

title: Seminars on Chairman Kim Jong Il's Feats Held Abroad
body: Seminars on feats of Chairman Kim Jong Il took place in Nepal, Kyrgyzstan, Uganda, DR Congo and Ethiopia from Jan. 29 to Feb. 8 to mark his birth anniversary (Day of the Shining Star). The general secretary of the Central Committee of the Nepal Communist Party (Marxist-Leninist) who is former deputy prime minister of the Nepalese government said that Kim Jong Il who was born in Mt Paektu led the Korean revolution pioneered by President Kim Il Sung to victory. He said that Kim Jong Il paved a firm road for carrying forward and accomplishing the revolutionary cause of Juche by developing in depth the revolutionary idea of the President. He noted that Kim Jong Il firmly defended the destiny of the country and nation and the world peace with the Songun treasured sword in the grim period when the imperialist allied forces were getting extremely frantic in the move to isolate and stifle the DPRK after the demise of the President. The chairman of the Central Council of the People Unity-"Kyrgyz El" Republican Political Party who is the chief of the Group for the Study of the Juche Idea in Kyrgyzstan praised Kim Jong Il for his ideological and theoretical feats and Songun leadership exploits for the country and people. Speakers at the seminar held in Uganda praised Kim Jong Il for developing the DPRK into an invincible powerful country and contributing to the accomplishment of the cause of global independence by leading the struggle of the Korean people under the banner of the Juche idea. The chairman of the Ethiopian National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism－Kimjongilism and other personages lauded the feats of Kim Jong Il. A message of greeting to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was adopted at the seminar held in Nepal. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Lauded
body: Foreign personages made public statements between Feb. 4 and 15 on the occasion of the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Samir Diyab, chief of the Lebanese Group for the Study of the Juche Idea, said that Kim Jong Il developed in depth the Juche idea and thus gave perfect answers to all the theoretical and practical issues arising in the revolution and construction. He is the eternal leader of the Workers' Party of Korea as he developed the Party into the guiding force of the Korean society, Samir Diyab said. He implanted firm consciousness of independence in the popular masses, bolstered up the single-minded unity of the whole society in every way and invariably held the socialist banner, Samir Diyab added. Saber Ballul, head of the Department of the Political Faculty of University of Damascus in Syria, said that Kim Jong Il was a peerlessly great man who led the Korean people to victory and the leader of the people with noble personality. The greatest of his feats is that he made the DPRK a world military power by pursuing the original Songun politics, Saber Ballul stated. It is thanks to his Songun politics that the DPRK could decisively frustrate the aggressive moves of the imperialists, Saber Ballul stressed. The official representative of the Greek Branch of the Korean Friendship Association lauded the Songun leadership feats of Kim Jong Il, expressing the determination to positively stage a solidarity movement to support the just cause of the Korean people. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Lauded in China
body: The Chinese Minzufuxingnet carried an editorial titled "Let us know well and study the great feats of Comrade Kim Jong Il" on Feb. 16. The editorial said that Kim Jong Il is an outstanding statesman, encourager and indomitable defender of socialist revolution, and distinguished thinker and theoretician of the present world. Noting that it is important to know well and study his great feats, the editorial added: In the closing years of the 20th century, the imperialists collapsed the Soviet Union with their strategy "peaceful transition" and some countries pulled down the flag of socialism. As a result, the world socialist movement suffered a great loss and broad strata of working people were plunged again into a despairing abyss of being exploited and oppressed. To cope with the changed situation, Comrade Kim Jong Il defended socialism in the spirit of a revolutionary and provided precious experience. He encouraged the Korean people to demonstrate the might of the self-supporting national economy and protect the sovereignty and dignity of the country and nation while overcoming all difficulties in the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance despite the sanctions and blockade by the imperialists, so as to develop the DPRK to be admired by the world and instill the conviction into the hearts of the oppressed people. He developed in depth the Juche philosophy. His feats are great and his exploits were performed for not only the DPRK but also the world socialist movement. He rejected dogma in socialist revolution and construction. This is what all revolutionaries should study and follow. The world people should bear in mind his great feats. Rodong News Team

title: UCKR Marks Chairman Kim Jong Il's Birth Anniversary
body: The United Confederation of Koreans in Russia (UCKR) held a celebration meeting on Feb. 15 ahead of Chairman Kim Jong Il's birth anniversary. At the meeting, speakers recalled that Kim Jong Il laid firm groundwork which enabled the DPRK to demonstrate its prestige as a powerful state. They pointed out that thanks to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, who remains true to Kim Jong Il's will, the dignity of the country and nation has been demonstrated throughout the world. They stressed that the members of the UCKR and all other Koreans in Russia would devote themselves to hastening the country's reunification, the long-cherished desire of the nation, in the future. Attending it were Chairman Kim Chil Song and members of the UCKR. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Work Off Press in Russia
body: Chairman Kim Jong Il's work "Let Us Make Our Country Richer and More Powerful, True to the Intention of the Great Leader" was brought out in booklet by the Arton Publishing House of Russia with due ceremony on Feb. 11. The work, published on December 31, Juche 83 (1994), indicates the tasks and ways to make the DPRK richer and more powerful. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Work Introduced in Serbia
body: The Serbian National Preparatory Committee for Celebrating the Day of the Shining Star posted the full text of Chairman Kim Jong Il's work "Socialism Is a Science" on the website of the New Yugoslav Communist Party on Feb. 15 in celebration of his birth anniversary, the Day of the Shining Star, and of the 45th anniversary of his proclamation of the programme of modeling the whole society on Kimilsungism. The work, published on November 1, Juche 83 (1994), clarifies the idea that Korean-style socialism based on the Juche-oriented theory of socialism is the most scientific and viable one. And it explains the principled issues arising in championing socialism. Rodong News Team

title: Seminar Held in Mexico
body: The Mexican National Seminar on the Juche Idea "Struggle for Global Independence and Peace" took place in Mexico City on Feb. 8 on the occasion of the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. On display at the venue of the seminar were works of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and books on their feats. Attending the event were personages of the Mexican organizations for the study of the Juche idea and lawmakers, the secretary general of the International Institute of the Juche Idea and members of the Japanese organizations for the study of the Juche idea. The chairman of the Mexican Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism who is director-general of the International Institute of the Juche Idea explained the philosophical and socio-historical principles of the Juche idea founded by Kim Il Sung and introduced the reality of the DPRK where the Juche idea was applied. He noted that Kim Jong Il with his original Songun politics frustrated the vicious moves of the imperialist allied forces to stifle the DPRK and thus successfully defended the sovereignty and dignity of the country and socialism and that the Korean people are performing miracles in all fields under the leadership of Kim Jong Un. The secretary general of the International Institute of the Juche Idea made a speech on realizing independence and achieving peace and prosperity in the Latin American region by extensively disseminating the Juche idea. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Shining Star Observed in Russia
body: Celebrations were held in Russia on the occasion of the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il (Day of the Shining Star). There took place seminars on his exploits by the Russian preparatory committee for the Day of the Sun (birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung) and the Day of the Shining Star and the Russian Group for Solidarity with the DPRK and film shows at the Sakhalin Regional Branch Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation and the Sakhalin Region Assembly from Jan. 28 to Feb. 8. Zhukova, first vice-chairwoman of the Russian Association for Friendship and Cultural Cooperation with the DPRK, lauded Kim Jong Il as the eternal leader of the Korean people who dedicated his all to the people all his life. She said that Kim Jong Il is a good friend of the Russian people who made a great contribution to the development of the Russia-DPRK friendly relations. Bavrin, chairman of the General People's Union Party of Russia, stressed that Kim Jong Il reliably defended the country's sovereignty and the global peace and security and his exploits would shine long along with the century. Lebedev, chief of the Russian Group for Solidarity with the DPRK, said that Kim Jong Il victoriously advanced the revolutionary cause of Juche pioneered by Kim Il Sung. Korniyenko, secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation, said he came to know better about the exploits performed by Kim Jong Il in developing the Russia-DPRK friendly relations through film show and that Kim Jong Il is a great man whom all the Russian people follow. A message of greeting to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was adopted at the seminar hosted by the Russian preparatory committee for celebrating the Day of the Sun and the Day of the Shining Star. A seminar on the exploits of Kim Jong Il was also held by the Communist Party of the Soviet Union on Feb. 11. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un to Pay Official Goodwill Visit to Vietnam
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, will soon pay an official goodwill visit to the Socialist Republic of Vietnam at the invitation of Nguyen Phu Trong, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam and president of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam. During his visit, the top leaders of the two countries will have a meeting and talks.

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Leaves Pyongyang
body: for Second DPRK-U.S. Summit Meeting and Talks Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, left here for the second DPRK-U.S. summit meeting and talks to be held in Hanoi, the Socialist Republic of Vietnam from Feb. 27 to 28, Juche 108 (2019). Supreme Leader of the Party, state and army Kim Jong Un is accompanied by Kim Yong Chol, Ri Su Yong, Kim Phyong Hae and O Su Yong, members of the Political Bureau and vice-chairmen of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), Ri Yong Ho, member of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and foreign minister, No Kwang Chol, alternate member of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and minister of the People's Armed Forces, Kim Yo Jong, alternate member of the Political Bureau and first vice department director of the WPK Central Committee, Choe Son Hui, vice minister of Foreign Affairs, and members of the WPK Central Committee and the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK. Kim Jong Un was seen off by Kim Yong Nam, Choe Ryong Hae and Pak Pong Ju, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, and other senior officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs. He exchanged greetings with the senior officials. The senior officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs sincerely wished Kim Jong Un good success in the second DPRK-U.S. summit meeting and talks and safe return. His train left Pyongyang Railway Station on Saturday afternoon. Political News Team

title: Foreigners Visit DPRK Missions
body: Delegations of political parties of Russia and Cambodia and personages of different countries visited the DPRK missions in their countries between Jan. 23 and Feb. 16 in celebration of the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The delegations and personages placed floral baskets and bouquets at the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and their picture and paid tribute to them. They include the delegations of the Maritime Territorial Branch of the United Russia Party and the Khmer Democratic Party of Cambodia, the head of the State Academy Beryozka Dancing Troupe of Russia Named after N. S. Nadezhdina, the first secretary of the Khabarovsk Territorial Committee of the Lenin Young Communist League of the Russian Federation, the vice-chairman of the Cuban Institute of Friendship with the Peoples, the first vice-chairman of the Cuban Committee for Supporting Korea's Reunification, the chairman of the Nepalese National Preparatory Committee for Marking the Day of the Sun and the Day of the Shining Star, the chairman of the Nepal Journalist Association for the Study of the Juche Idea and Songun Politics, the chairman of the Bangladeshi Preparatory Committee for Marking the Day of the Shining Star, the chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Bangladesh, the chairman of the Bangladesh Institute of the Juche Idea, personages of the Workers' Party of Mexico and the Mexican Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism and the secretary general of the Organization of Solidarity of the Peoples of Africa, Asia and Latin America. Rodong News Team

title: Korean Books Donated to China
body: A Korean book-donating ceremony took place at the Liaoning Provincial International Cultural and Economic Exchange Center on February 14. Seen at the venue of the ceremony were works of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and books introducing the Korean history and culture. Present there were officials of the center. The secretary of the center expressed pleasure to see the ceremony on the occasion of the Day of the Shining Star (birth anniversary of Kim Jong Il). The secretary pointed out the China visit paid by Kim Jong Un for four times prove that the China-DPRK friendship is developing on a new stage. Noting that the ceremony became an occasion to know better about the fact that the leaders of the DPRK authored a lot of works and the Korean people have made great successes on the basis of their ideas and theories, the secretary hoped that the exchange with the DPRK would be more brisk. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Exploits Lauded by Romanian Figure
body: Vasile Orleanu, chairman of the Supreme Council of the National Socialist Party of Romania and chairman of the Romanian National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea, posted an article on the website "Juche Idea" on Feb. 15 on the occasion of the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The article noted that Kim Jong Il had made a ceaseless journey for the country and people all his life. It went on: Thanks to his devotion, Korean socialism was defended and signal successes were made in economic construction and improvement of the people's standard of living. Comrade Kim Jong Il who carried forward the idea and cause of President Kim Il Sung resolutely frustrated the imperialists' moves for stifling the DPRK and led Korean socialism to victory. He formulated Songun politics as the main political mode of socialism and turned the DPRK into a military power which no formidable enemy dare provoke. His idea and line illuminate the road ahead of the world progressive peoples aspiring after socialism. Comrade Kim Jong Il's exploits for the Korean revolution and world revolution will shine forever. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Introduced in Russia
body: The full text of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work "The Cause of the Great Party of Comrades Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il Is Ever-Victorious" was reported by Russian internet news Erofei-Deve on Feb. 14 on the occasion of the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il (the Day of the Shining Star). The work, published on Oct. 4, Juche 104 (2015), clarifies the idea that the 70-year-long history of the Workers' Party of Korea is a history of victory in which the validity and invincibility of the cause of the Party of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il have been displayed, and that the cause of the Party is invincible. The internet news carried a photo of Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: Letter to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Congratulatory Group of Koreans in Japan
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a letter from the members of a congratulatory group of Koreans in Japan for celebrating the Day of the Shining Star (the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il) on Feb. 21. The letter said that celebrations for the Day of the Shining Star were a great festival of glory that instilled the pride and honor of the nation blessed with illustrious leaders generation after generation into the mind of all the members of the congratulatory group. They could keenly feel the personality of Marshal Kim Jong Un as the great man, and the inexhaustible potentiality of the DPRK through their visits to several units associated with his leadership exploits during their stay in the homeland, the letter noted. The letter praised Kim Jong Un as the peerless patriot and the great sun of the nation who successfully provides the eternal victory and prosperity of Kim Il Sung's and Kim Jong Il's Korea. The letter expressed the will to fulfill the responsibility and duty as leading members of the patriotic cause of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) in the struggle for laying a firm springboard for overall prosperity of the movement of Koreans in Japan with full confidence in sure victory and optimism braced through the visit to the motherland. The letter noted that they will firmly defend and add eternal luster to the Juche-based idea of overseas compatriots' movement set forth by the peerlessly great men of Mt Paektu and their feats and further develop Chongryon, the patriotic legacy of the great leaders, into the Juche-based overseas patriotic organization boundlessly faithful to Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: High Vigilance Should Be Kept on Deep Rooted Ambition of Japan
body: Voices for the revision of the constitution and increased military spending and nuclear weaponization are heard from the conservative camp in Japan. This indicates that the Abe group can go nuclear anytime after giving up “three non-nuclear principles” and consequently, peace in the Asia-Pacific region will be exposed to a great danger. Japan is a war criminal state that invaded Korea and other Asian countries and ignited the Pacific war with sudden attack on the Pearl Harbor in the last century, and the one and only country which has persistently denied its crime-woven history. Japan’s denial shows its will to repeat its past crimes. As a matter of fact, the Abe group is trying to turn Japan into a war-capable country and launch overseas aggression by revising the constitution that bans Japan from using armed forces and having the rights of belligerency and combat power. Japan’s desperate efforts for nuclear weaponization aim at taking revenge for its defeat, not for its security. In case Japan gets rid of the “three non-nuclear principles”, unimaginable will be the catastrophic consequences to be entailed on regional and global peace. All the countries that truly want global peace and security should keep close watch over Japan’s nuclear weaponization. Ri Hak Nam

title: Attaching Importance to Talents and Science and Education is Basic Method for Effecting Great Success in Socialist Construction
body: Talents and science and education should be given priority for the great leap forward and renovation on all fronts today when a dynamic struggle is under way for opening a new road of advance in socialist construction under the uplifted banner of self-reliance. Attaching importance to talents and science and education is the best way for bringing about a revolutionary upsurge on all fronts of socialist construction and the main guarantee for continuous leap forward in socialist construction. Talents training and sci-tech development are difficult as they require a long period and huge amount of investment. When importance is given to talents and priority to sci-tech development, the revolution and construction will get animated and the superiority and might of socialism will be more highly demonstrated. The building of a powerful socialist country will be accelerated in faster tempo when the atmosphere of giving importance to talents and science and education fully settles in the country. Officials, Party members and working people in all fields and units should thoroughly implement the Party’s policy of attaching importance to talents and science and education, so as to make tangible contributions to glorifying the DPRK as a country prospering by dint of talents and science and technology and outpacing the world. Kim Song Nam

title: White Paper Tolls Death-bell for LKP of S. Korea
body: The north side headquarters of the Pan-National Alliance for Korea's Reunification (Pomminryon) on Sunday issued a strongly-worded white paper against the "Liberal Korea Party" (LKP) of south Korea doomed to the wretchedness despite their desperate cry for "assembly" and "reconstruction". Describing the LKP as a group of rubbish with mean personality, low intelligence and double-sidedness in word and action, the white paper said: With party conference approaching, they have now become violent in their dog-fight with Park Geun Hye, who had already thrown into prison after stern punishment by candlelight demonstrators, on their back. Hwang Kyo An who recently entered the LKP eyeing "presidency" following the party hegemony openly defended Park, claiming that it was wrong to take all things done by Park Geun Hye regime as misadministration and evil and it was desirable not to debate impeachment any longer, heartened by Park's supporters flattering him as the "only person eligible for representing conservatism". The LKP members have now gone desperate even by embracing military fascist murder and traitor Chun Doo-hwan, not satisfied with Park. The LKP is made up of human rejects stained with corruption and irregularities. It is none other than this group of matchless traitors that have become intent on confrontational racket when the new era of national reconciliation, peace and prosperity has arrived to be the first in over 70-year history of division, utterly displeased with it. These guys faulted the historic Panmunjom Declaration after its adoption in April last year as "typical war and peace tactic", "discord in the south" and "strategy collapsing security" and the September Pyongyang joint declaration and the north-south agreement in military field as "agreement on disarming by the north" and "surrender document". The die-hard conservative elements faulted every clause of the agreement in the military field and ended up in crying out for overall modification and scrapping. They slandered the agreement on turning the West Sea hot-spot waters into peace waters as "renunciation of the northern limit line" and the measures for the prevention of accidental conflicts in areas along the Military Demarcation Line as "breakdown of security and disruption of south Korea-U.S. alliance". In reference to the October 15 north-south high-level talks held in last year, they have gone so mischievous as to call for "National Assembly ratification", grumbling that "railway and road re-connection cause heavy financial burden on the people". A broad spectrum of the south Koreans now reject the increase in defence cost sharing as the one going against the south-north declarations and north-U.S. joint statement, and demand its cut-down, not increase. And it is only the LKP group which reels off thoughtless words that the U.S. demand must be accepted, the issue of "defence cost sharing" is not just a financial matter but an issue of maintaining and strengthening alliance with the U.S. and one should not spare more fund. Branding the LKP as a group of rubbish accelerating their destruction through scramble, the white paper continued: Only garbage ground of history awaits the LKP, den of scarecrows absorbed in non-stop scrambles and meetings and partings only for power ambition, without any idea and ism, clean indifferent to the policy for the people and the nation. Now the conservative elements of the LKP speak loudly of making the upcoming party conference an opportunity to get rid of crisis, but rose can never be expected from a garbage ground. Rodong News Team

title: Seminar of Korean Social Scientists in Japan Marks Day of Shining Star
body: A seminar of Korean social scientists in Japan for celebrating the Day of Shining Star (the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il) was held at the Korean Hall in Tokyo on Feb. 22. Present there were Pae Jin Gu, vice-chairman and concurrently director general of the General Affairs Department of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), Ri Yong Su, chairman of the Korean Social Scientists Association in Japan, and members of the Association, leading officials of the central leadership bodies and affiliates of Chongryon and officials of Chongryon in Kanto area. Ri Yong Su in a report said that the revolutionary life of Chairman Kim Jong Il was the one of the greatest patriot who blazed a trail under the red flag of the revolution and burned himself out for the inheritance of the Juche cause to completion and prosperity of the country true to the intention of President Kim Il Sung. Entering the new century of Juche, the Korean people have registered signal events and achievements to be specially recorded in the nation's history spanning five thousands years by displaying the might of single-minded unity and self-reliance and self-development, rallied close around Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, thus thoroughly carrying out the behests of Kim Jong Il and demonstrating the dignity and spirit of Juche Korea dashing toward the final victory, he said. He stressed the need to deeply acquire the far-reaching plan of Kim Jong Un on writing a great history of the country under the uplifted banner of self-reliance and our state-first and his idea of ushering in the heyday of peace, prosperity and reunification on the Korean peninsula that were clarified in his New Year address. There were speeches. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Off Press in Algeria
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let the Entire Party, the Whole Army and All the People Conduct a Vigorous Forest Restoration Campaign to Cover the Mountains of the Country with Green Woods" was brought out in booklet by the Tarzalt Publishing House in El-Djezair, Algeria with due ceremony on Feb. 12 ahead of the 45th anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's proclamation of the programme of modeling the whole society on Kimilsungism and his birth anniversary, the Day of the Shining Star. The work, published on February 26, Juche 104(2015), indicates the tasks and ways of covering the mountains of the country with green woods by conducting a vigorous forest restoration campaign involving the entire party, the whole army and all the people. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Introduced in Russia
body: The full text of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us Add Eternal Brilliance to Comrade Kim Jong Il's Great Idea and Achievements of the Songun Revolution" was posted on the website of the Association for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism in the Far East Region of Russia on Feb. 16, the Day of the Shining Star, Chairman Kim Jong Il's birth anniversary. The work, published on August 25, Juche 102 (2013), deals with the Songun-based revolutionary leadership feats of Kim Jong Il and the essence and originality of his Songun revolutionary idea and clarifies the tasks for brilliantly accomplishing the revolutionary cause of Songun. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Shining Star Celebrated Abroad
body: Celebration meetings, seminars and book and photo exhibitions were held in Laos, Nepal, Pakistan, India and Switzerland on Feb. 9 and 11 ahead of Chairman Kim Jong Il's birth anniversary, the Day of the Shining Star. The secretary-general of the Karachi Branch of the Pakistan-Korea Friendship Association noted that the birth of Kim Jong Il was a great fortune for the Korean nation and a significant event which opened bright vistas to accomplishing the human cause of independence, pointing out that he firmly defended socialism with the treasured sword of Songun. The chairperson of the Juche Philosophy Study Committee of India and other speakers praised Kim Jong Il as the greatest man possessed of noble moral obligation and warm humanity, adding that he was the peerlessly great man who scored victory only despite all difficulties with his iron will and courage. The chairperson of the Switzerland-Korea Committee said: The Korean people and world progressives are looking back upon with emotion the undying exploits performed by Leader Kim Jong Il on the occasion of his birth anniversary. Leader Kim Jong Il remarkably strengthened the DPRK's international prestige with his energetic external activities. HE Kim Jong Un is adding eternal luster to the exploits of Leader Kim Jong Il. Thanks to him, Korean socialism is sure to win. Congratulatory messages to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un were adopted at the events held in Nepal, India and Switzerland. Rodong News Team

title: Korean Books Donated to Russia
body: Korean books were donated to the Far East State Science Library of Russia and the Khabarovsk Territorial Branch Committee of "A Just Russia" on Feb. 14. At the books-donating ceremonies attended by Russian personages of various strata and masses, works of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and books dealing with the true picture of the DPRK were conveyed. The president of the Far East State Science Library expressed pleasure at getting the works of the Korean people's great leaders on the occasion of the Day of the Shining Star, Kim Jong Il's birth anniversary. The president pointed out that the DPRK, though not big, is demonstrating its prestige in the international arena, firmly defending its sovereignty and dignity, to be admired by the world people, noting that they want to know the secret to it. The works of the Korean people's great leaders are textbooks giving the clear answer to the secret, the president added. The chief of the civil rights center at the Khabarovsk Territorial Branch Committee of "A Just Russia" said that the books are very precious treasures for them who support the just cause of the Korean people, adding: The Russian people always remember the exploits performed by President Kim Il Sung and HE Kim Jong Il for developing the relations between the two countries. We wish the Korean people bigger successes in socialist construction under the guidance of HE Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Kuwaiti Emir
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on Monday sent a message of greeting to Sabah Al-Ahmad Al-Jaber Al-Sabah, emir of Kuwait, on the occasion of the 58th anniversary of its independence and the 28th anniversary of its liberation. Kim in the message wished the emir good health and happiness and Kuwait prosperity, expressing belief that the friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries would grow stronger as required by the new situation. Rodong News Team

title: Meeting of DFRK Central Committee Held
body: A meeting of the Central Committee of the Democratic Front for the Reunification of Korea (DFRK) took place here on Monday. It was attended by Choe Hwi, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Kim Yong Dae, chairman of the Central Committee of the Korean Social Democratic Party, Ri Myong Chol, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Chondoist Chongu Party, members of the DFRK Central Committee and officials concerned. Pak Myong Chol, presidium member and director of the Secretariat of the DFRK Central Committee, made an opening address. He said the election of deputies to the 14th Supreme People's Assembly will serve as an important political occasion in successfully realizing the patriotic desires of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, the founder and builders of the DPRK, for building a powerful nation. The election will powerfully demonstrate the invincibility of the DPRK advancing toward a bright future while opening up a great heyday of its prosperity by firmly adhering to our state-first principle and by dint of the single-minded unity and self-reliance, he noted. Calling on the participants in the meeting to bear deep in mind the political significance and importance of the election and make tangible contribution to encouraging all the people to unanimously vote for the candidates during the election and thus adding glory to Korean-style socialism centered on the popular masses, in which all people are firmly united behind Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, he declared the meeting open. The meeting discussed the issue of adopting an appeal of the DFRK Central Committee to all Koreans ahead of the election of deputies to the 14th Supreme People's Assembly. The appeal was adopted there. Rodong News Team

title: Appeal to All Koreans Adopted at Meeting of C.C, DFRK
body: An appeal to all the Korean people was adopted at a meeting of the Central Committee of the Democratic Front for the Reunification of Korea (DFRK) held on Monday. The appeal said that the election of deputies to the 14th Supreme People's Assembly is a political event of great significance in glorifying the exploits of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il forever, further augmenting the people's power under the guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and bringing earlier the future of the socialist country, genuine one of the people. It noted that Kim Jong Un is the symbol of the mightiness of Juche Korea, banner of every victory and glory and peerless patriot who put the dignity and power of the Republic on the highest level. It stressed that it is necessary to cement the political and ideological might of the Korean-style socialist state centered on the popular masses in every way. It went on: Let us consolidate as firm as a rock the single-minded unity of our society in which all the people are united close around the Party by thoroughly applying the Juche-oriented view on the people and people-centered philosophy to state activities! It is necessary to regard as a treasured sword of prosperity the self-reliance, that has been the banner of struggle and motive power of a leap forward in the whole course of the independent development of the Republic, and conduct an all-people onward campaign for opening a new road of advance for socialist construction with redoubled patriotism and zeal for work and creation. It is the first and foremost task of our state, the genuine country of the people, to signally improve the people's standard of living. It is necessary to give fuller play to the advantages of our social system by accelerating socialist civilization. Thanks to the courageous will and determination of Marshal Kim Jong Un, three north-south summit meetings were held and the historic Panmunjom Declaration and September Pyongyang Joint Declaration and north-south agreement in the military field adopted and a new landmark for national reconciliation and unity, peace and prosperity and reunification provided. Let the north and the south value the declarations and agreements in which they made solemn commitments before the nation and thoroughly implement them! It is necessary to eradicate the military hostility between the north and the south and take practical measures for turning the Korean peninsula into the lasting and durable peace zone. Let us not allow joint military exercises with outsiders any longer and check and frustrate all acts escalating tension and destroying peace like the introduction of military hardware including strategic assets from outside. It is necessary to comprehensively expand and develop cooperation and exchange between the north and the south and thus consolidate national reconciliation and unity and make all the compatriots substantially benefit from the mended relations between the north and the south. Let us smash every sanction, pressure and challenge by outsiders by the concerted efforts of all the fellow countrymen and resolutely reject interference and intervention by outsiders to subordinate inter-Korean relations to their tastes and interests! Let us actively search for ways for peaceful reunification based on an all-Korean agreement and make sincere efforts to realize it! Let all the Koreans in the north, the south and abroad hold the respected Marshal Kim Jong Un in high esteem as the lodestar for the great national unity and reunification and dynamically accelerate the nation-wide advance for implementing the inter-Korean declarations in the redoubled courage under the banner of Korean nation-first and thus glorify this year as a historic one in which great advance will be made in the development of the north-south relations and accomplishment of the cause of the national reunification! Independence, peace and friendship are the consistent foreign policy tenet of our Republic. Let us continue to boost friendship, unity, cooperation and exchange with socialist countries and develop the relations with all the countries that are friendly to our country and thus make a positive contribution to world peace and security and prosperity common to mankind! The appeal called upon everyone to dynamically struggle for the development of the power of the Republic, victory in the building of a powerful socialist nation, independent reunification of the country and accomplishment of the revolutionary cause of Juche under the guidance of Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Wreath to Bier of Jin Pong Jun
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un sent a wreath to the bier of Jin Pong Jun, manager of Fishery Station No. 223 run by the Korean People's Army and recipient of Order of Kim Il Sung and Order of Kim Jong Il and twice labor hero, to express deep condolences over his death. Rodong News Team

title: LKP of S. Korea Accused of Disturbing Investigation into Kwangju Massacre
body: The ruling party and opposition parties of south Korea reportedly criticized the arrogant stand of the "Liberal Korea Party" (LKP) on the investigation into the Kwangju massacre on Feb. 17. As already reported, the "National Assembly" of south Korea passed a special bill on investigation into Kwangju massacre last year, which obliged LKP to appoint three persons to the investigation committee. The LKP had intentionally delayed the appointment but caved in to public protest and submitted a relevant list in January this year. However, all those appointed reportedly twisted the truth behind the Kwangju Uprising in the past. LKP's floor leader Ra Kyong Won, going against the public demand for "reappointment", is insisting that there is "no reason to reappoint". Commenting on this awful behavior, the ruling Minju Party, the Jongui Party and the Party for Democracy and Peace are scathingly criticizing the LKP. Rodong News Team

title: Highly Important Work That Reconfirms Significance of Ideological Work
body: February 25 is the 5th anniversary of the publication of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un’s work “Let Us Hasten the Final Victory through a Revolutionary Ideological Offensive”. The historic speech made by Kim Jong Un at the 8th conference of Ideological Workers of the Workers’ Party of Korea on February 25, Juche 103 (2014), is an immortal programme that indicates the path of accomplishing the revolutionary cause of Juche pioneered in Mt Paektu by dint of ideology. In the five years after the publication of the work, the WPK has brought about a great upsurge in ideological work so as to win brilliant victories and successes in all fields of socialist construction. The politico-military might of the DPRK has considerably increased and the dignity and spirit of Juche Korea to outpace the world and its inexhaustible potentiality have been fully displayed amid dynamic ideological offensive. This is a clear evidence of the validity and vitality of the idea and theory of the work calling for regarding ideology as the driving force of the revolution and bringing earlier the final victory through the revolutionary ideological offensive. It is the great intention and firm determination of the WPK to build a powerful and prosperous socialist nation on this land, holding fast to the Juche-oriented theory of ideology, a powerful weapon. The revolutionary cause of Juche and the cause of socialism are sure to triumph as there are the wise guidance of the Party leading the revolution and construction by dint of ideology and the people who remain faithful to the cause of the Party with indomitable mental power. Kim Song Nam

title: Editorial
body: Let Us Demonstrate Social Customs of Juche Korea Based on Single-hearted Unity of Leader and People It is the first and foremost social custom of Juche Korea that the leader trusts its people and boundlessly loves them while the latter repose an absolute trust in and remain faithful to the former. The DPRK is dynamically advancing the revolution and construction even in any storm and hardship of history as the leader and all the people have shared the idea, intention and destiny. The leader always gives top priority to the people and the people devotedly uphold the leader, which guarantees the invincibility and a bright future of the DPRK. The single-minded unity, the politico-ideological might of the DPRK, is the most powerful weapon that no force on earth can break and which makes it realize whatever it wants. The ardent yearning and blood ties between the leader and the people are just the blood vessel of our single-minded unity and source of inexhaustible power that can be seen nowhere in the world. All people should give full play to the might of the harmonious whole of the DPRK in which Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and the people are linked with blood ties and for effecting revolutionary upsurge on all fronts of socialist construction.

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Off Press in Indonesia
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us Brilliantly Accomplish the Revolutionary Cause of Juche, Holding the Great Comrade Kim Jong Il in High Esteem as the Eternal General Secretary of Our Party" was brought out in booklet with due ceremony by the Hekadaha Adicitra Publishing House of Indonesia on Feb. 12 ahead of the Day of the Shining Star, Chairman Kim Jong Il's birth anniversary. The work, published on April 6, Juche 101 (2012), says it is a principled requirement for the victorious advance of the Korean revolution to hold Kim Jong Il in high esteem as the eternal general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea. It also indicates the tasks for steadily developing the WPK into the glorious party of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Work Introduced in Iran
body: The full text of Chairman Kim Jong Il's work "Let Us Struggle Resolutely to Implement the Three Principles of National Reunification" was aired by the Iranian Ilna on Feb. 13 ahead of his birth anniversary (Day of the Shining Star). The work, published on July 14, Juche 61 (1972), underscores the need to make strenuous efforts to implement the three principles of national reunification and indicates tasks for their implementation. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Shining Star Marked in Russia
body: Events took place in Russia between Feb. 13 and 15 on the occasion of the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il, Day of the Shining Star. Celebration meetings were held by the Party for Peace and Unity of Russia, the Maritime Territorial Branch of the Liberal Democratic Party of Russia, the Lenin Young Communist League of the Russian Federation, the Korean War Veterans' Council of Russia, the Regional Social Organization of Russia "Borozino", the Maritime Territorial Association for Friendship with the DPRK and the 11th Middle School in Khabarovsk City. Seminars were held by the Communist Party "Russian Communists", the All-Russia Lenin Young Communist League and the Sakhalin Regional Branch Committee of the Lenin Young Communist League of the Russian Federation Russian people including public personages were present at the events. A vice-chairperson of the Party for Peace and Unity of Russia said that the Russian people enshrine in their hearts the greatness of Kim Jong Il possessed of unlimited devotion, warm love for the people, great yet humble traits and noble patriotism. The first secretary of the C.C., Lenin Young Communist League of the Russian Federation pointed out that Kim Jong Il firmly defended the country's sovereignty with his Songun-based revolutionary leadership and turned the DPRK into the world's military power at a time when the imperialists' move to strangle the DPRK reached an extreme in the closing years of the last century. The chairperson of the Regional Social Organization of Russia "Borozino" and other personages highly praised Kim Jong Il, remarking that he is an outstanding politician and thinker and theoretician recognized by the world and they came to more deeply understand the scientific accuracy and truth of socialism whenever they read his works. They lauded his exploits for the accomplishment of the revolutionary cause of Juche and human cause of independence. Messages of greeting to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un were adopted at the events held by the Lenin Young Communist League of the Russian Federation and the All-Russia Lenin Young Communist League. Meanwhile, a Korean book and photo exhibition opened with due ceremony in Sankt-Peterburg, Russia on Feb. 14. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Shining Star Marked in Venezuela
body: A Venezuelan national meeting for celebrating the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il (Day of the Shining Star) took place in Caracas on Feb. 13. Attending the meeting were delegates and members of different political parties and organizations of the country. Felix Jesus Velasquez Castillo, chairman of the Venezuelan National Preparatory Committee for Marking the Day of the Sun and the Day of the Shining Star, general coordinator of the Federal Political Secretariat of the United Left Party of Venezuela and chairman of the Venezuelan Solidarity Committee for Korea's Peace and Reunification, made a speech at the meeting. The speaker said that the world progressives admire Kim Jong Il so much as his exploits for the cause of human independence are great. He went on: When the world socialist movement faced a crisis due to the vicious moves of the imperialists, HE Kim Jong Il firmly defended Korean socialism, holding high the banner of the Juche idea, the Songun idea. Under his guidance, the DPRK could fully demonstrate its might as a politico-ideological and military power in the international arena. This was a historic event no one could imagine The experience of the DPRK gives the people a conviction that if a country achieves the single-minded unity of the leader and the people and has its own tremendous might, it can always emerge victorious in the struggle against any formidable enemy. Delegates of various political parties and organizations also said that Korean socialism led by HE Kim Jong Il, the eternal leader of the Korean people, is the people's paradise which is completely different from what Western countries said, and that the DPRK serves as the beacon of hope for the people struggling for justice. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Birth Anniversary Marked in Bangladesh
body: A joint seminar of Bangladeshi political parties and organizations was held in Dhaka on Feb. 11 ahead of Chairman Kim Jong Il's birth anniversary, the Day of the Shining Star. Present there were personages from the Workers' Party of Bangladesh, the Bangladesh Jatiya Party, the Bangladeshi Preparatory Committee for Celebrating the Day of the Shining Star, the Bangladesh-Korea Friendship and Solidarity Committee and the Bangladesh Institute of the Juche Idea and masses. Rashed Khan Menon, chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Bangladesh, Mostafa Jamal Haider, secretary general of the Bangladesh Jatiya Party, and Sheikh Rafiqul Islam Bablu, chairman of the Bangladesh Institute of the Juche Idea, made speeches. They said that the world progressives and Bangladeshi people significantly celebrated the birth anniversary of Kim Jong Il. They noted that Kim Jong Il is a peerless patriot, great thinker and theoretician and politician admired by the world, who crushed the imperialists' outrageous moves of isolating and stifling the DPRK under the uplifted banner of Songun and turned it into an invincible socialist fortress. Saying that the prestige of Juche Korea is being boosted day by day, they expressed the belief that the Workers' Party of Korea and the Korean people would register bigger successes in building a powerful socialist country and reunifying the country under the wise guidance of HE Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: 34th Sci-Tech Festival of Pyongyang University of Architecture Opens
body: The 34th Science and Technology Festival of Pyongyang University of Architecture opened with due ceremony on Tuesday. The festival will be held, divided into panels of architecture, city management, land and environment protection, construction engineering, construction management, building materials, construction mechanical engineering and IT. It was attended by teachers, researchers, graduate students and students of the university. Presented to it were more than 150 valuable scientific research successes. During the festival, the work for generalizing successes and experience gained in the development of architectural science and technology and positively transforming them into reality will be held in the form of presentation, exhibition and exchange of new technologies. The festival will continue till Feb. 28. Rodong News Team

title: Books Donated to Classroom Named after Fidel Castro Ruz at Pyongyang Foreign Languages School
body: The Cuban embassy to the DPRK donated books to the classroom named after Fidel Castro Ruz at Pyongyang Foreign Languages School under Pyongyang University of Foreign Studies on Tuesday. Ambassador Jesus De Los Angeles Aise Sotolongo and staff members of his embassy looked round different places of the school before donating the books. Rodong News Team

title: Japan Should Properly Liquidate Its Past
body: Inter-governmental negotiations are going on in the UN arena for the reform of the UN Security Council. Amid a hot debate on the key matters like the increase of permanent member states of the UNSC, Japan has engaged in a sly job to rank among those states. Japan’s behavior is utterly impudent. Japan is casting a covetous eye on the post of UNSC permanent member, unaware of where it is standing. Among the war criminal nations, only Japan has failed to properly atone for its crime-woven past. In the first half of the last century, Japan invaded Korea and other Asian countries and provoked the Pacific War. Then, the flames of the Second World War spilled over into the Asia-Pacific region. Japan, which has neither admitted nor atoned for its past crimes, is going so shameless as to seek the status of a permanent member state of the UNSC whose mission is to preserve global peace and security. This is just an open disregard for the UN Charter and an insult and challenge to human conscience. Though it is originally ineligible, Japan had gone so impudent as to have an eye on such high status, only to be derided by the world public. Japan left scars in the hearts of the Asian people by committing hideous inhumane crimes against them. Such wound is hard to be healed and will remain generation after generation. So, what Japan is obliged to do now is to acknowledge its state and legal responsibility for the crimes and make a sincere apology and reparation. Ri Kyong Su

title: Bird Flu Antigen Detected in S. Korea
body: According to the south Korean MBC on February 23, bird flu antigen was detected in Tangjin County, South Chungchong Province. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Ambassador Presents Credentials to President of Sao Tome and Principe
body: DPRK Ambassador Jo Pyong Chol presented his credentials to Evaristo Carvalho, president of the Democratic Republic of Sao Tome and Principe, on Feb. 20. The president said that the relations between the two countries were long-standing relations of friendship and cooperation which have been forged and developed since Sao Tome and Principe gained independence and that he has reverence for President Kim Il Sung of Korea and won't forget that the President actively helped Sao Tome and Principe in the building of a new society. He pointed out that his country is watching with admiration the successes made by the DPRK government and people in their struggle for peace and prosperity and will proactively support them in the future, too. He hoped that the relations between the two countries would grow stronger. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Lauded
body: The Swiss organizations and a Syrian personage issued statements ahead of the 45th anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's proclamation of the programme of modeling the whole society on Kimilsungism. The Swiss Organizing Committee for the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu, the Switzerland-Korea Committee and the Swiss Group for the Study of the Juche Idea released a joint statement on Feb. 20. The statement said: HE Kim Jong Il formulated the revolutionary idea of President Kim Il Sung as the integral system of ideology, theory and method of Juche and proclaimed the modeling of the whole society on Kimilsungism as the supreme programme of the Workers' Party of Korea. As a result, a steadfast guarantee was provided to model the whole society on the monolithic idea. He developed in depth Kimilsungism with immortal writing activities. Saber Ballul, head of the Department of the Political Faculty of University of Damascus in Syria, said in a statement on February 19 that Kim Jong Il's greatest exploit is that he enriched the Juche idea founded by Kim Il Sung. He noted that Kim Jong Il clearly proved the scientific accuracy and truth, validity and vitality of the Juche idea with his rare ideological and theoretical wisdom and energetic activities. He said that the Korean people are advancing with high spirit under the banner of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, holding HE Kim Jong Un in high esteem. Korean socialism is sure to win, he stressed. Rodong News Team

title: February 25 Prize Bowling Tournament Held
body: The Bowling Tournament for February 25 Prize took place at the Pyongyang Gold Lane on Feb. 26 and 27. Bowling fans took part in the tournament. They, divided into men's and women's individual and doubles and team (four men, one woman) events, competed on a knockout basis. Rodong News Team

title: National Seminar on Koryo Medicine Held
body: A national seminar on Koryo medicine took place at the Sci-Tech Complex on Wednesday to mark the 40th anniversary of the publication of President Kim Il Sung's work "On Developing Traditional Korean Medicine".
