The work, published on Feb. 27, Juche 68 (1979), elucidates the issues arising in developing Koryo medicine including the issue of combining Koryo medicine with western medicine. Officials concerned and teachers, researches and medial workers in the field of Koryo medicine attended the seminar. Kim Hyong Hun, chairman of the Central Committee of the Medical Association of Korea, made a speech. He referred to the achievements in putting Koryo medicine on a scientific basis. He called for putting the medical service with Koryo therapy on a high scientific and technological basis and developing and producing highly effective Koryo medicines for the improvement of people's health. Made public at the seminar were more than 10 valuable Koryo medical science achievements. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Yong Nam Receives Credentials from Czech Ambassador
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the DPRK Supreme People's Assembly, received credentials from Czech Ambassador to the DPRK Radim Pecl at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Wednesday. After receiving the credentials, Kim Yong Nam had a talk with the ambassador. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Has Chat and Dinner with President Donald J. Trump
body: Supreme Leader of the Party, state and army Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, had a meeting, one-on-one chat and dinner with Donald J. Trump, president of the United States of America. The historic second DPRK-U.S. summit and talks began in Hanoi, Vietnam thanks to the ardent wishes, active efforts and extraordinary determination of the top leaders of the DPRK and the USA to end the evil cycle of confrontation and antagonism and keep pace with the era of peace and prosperity that has newly arrived. The historic second meeting of the top leaders of the two countries began at 18:30, February 27, local time, followed by one-on-one chat and dinner. Kim Jong Un arrived at Metropole Hotel, the place of the meeting with the president of the USA, on his car, escorted by guard vehicles. The national flags of the DPRK and the USA were displayed side by side in La Veranda conference room of Metropole Hotel where the top leaders of the two countries were slated to meet. Kim Jong Un met Donald J. Trump in 8 months and exchanged firm handshakes with him. They had a photo taken against the national flags of the two countries. The top leaders of the two countries who deepened their friendly feelings through the Singapore summit last year and such occasions as subsequent exchanges of several personal letters exchanged warm greetings and made well-wishing remarks. Kim Jong Un said that mistrust, misunderstanding, hostility and old practices tried to stop our ways but we broke and overcame all of them and again walked towards each other to finally reach Hanoi in 260 days. He added that this period required lots of deep thinking, efforts and patience than ever before and that excellent results wished by all will be made in the talks and he would do his best to this end. President Trump said that he was honored and happy to meet Chairman Kim Jong Un again and that he was sure that the talks would be very successful, noting they had very nice relations with each other. Then they had one-on-one pleasant chat to have a candid and honest dialogue. At the end of the one-on-one chat, they had a social dinner. Present there from the DPRK side were Kim Yong Chol, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and Ri Yong Ho, foreign minister, and from the U.S. side were Mike Pompeo, secretary of State of the U.S., and Mick Mulvaney, acting White House chief of staff. The dinner was held in an amicable atmosphere with the top leaders of the DPRK and the U.S. and other figures of the two countries sat at a round table in a friendly way. At the dinner, considerable progress made in the bilateral relations after the Singapore summit were highly appreciated and sincere and deep opinions were exchanged with a view to making comprehensive and epoch-making results in the talks in order to meet the interest and expectation of the whole world for the successful Hanoi summit. Kim Jong Un said goodbye to Trump after the dinner. Kim Jong Un completed the first-day schedule of the historic second DPRK-U.S. summit talks and left for Melia Hotel. The top leaders of the two countries will continue their summit on Thursday. Political News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Work Introduced in DR Congo
body: The National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of DR Congo posted on its website the full text of Chairman Kim Jong Il's work "Let Us Highly Display the Korean-Nation-first Spirit" on Feb. 21. The work, published on December 28, Juche 78 (1989), comprehensively deals with the essence and content of the Korean-nation-first spirit and the tasks and ways of fully displaying it. The website carried a portrait of smiling Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: Paektusan Prize Sports Games Close
body: The Paektusan Prize Sports Games closed with due ceremony at the Basketball Gymnasium in Chongchun Street here on Thursday. At the ceremony, team standings were announced. The Taesongsan Sports Team took the first place in team standings. Men players of the April 25 Sports Team and women players of the Amnokgang Sports Team won gold medals in the basketball matches respectively. Men and women players of the April 25 Sports Team came first in the volleyball matches. Rotating trophy cups went to the Taesongsan Sports Team and the April 25 Sports Team. Rodong News Team

title: 24th Paektusan Prize Sports Contest among Officials of National Institutions Closes
body: The 24th Paektusan Prize Sports Contest among Officials of National Institutions, which began on Feb. 4, closed with due ceremony at the Basketball Gymnasium in Chongchun Street on Thursday. Teams of the Ministry of Railways, the State Commission of Science and Technology, the Taesong Bank and the Sci-Tech Complex came first in the tug of war. Teams of the Ministry of Electric Power Industry, the General Bureau of Public Catering Service, the Myohyang Guidance Bureau and the Academy of Medical Science took the first place in the men's basketball matches. Teams of the Ministry of Land and Maritime Transport, the General Bureau for Affairs with Diplomatic Corps, the Myohyang Guidance Bureau and the Academy of Medical Science won the first place in women's volleyball matches, teams of the Ministry of Railways, the General Bureau of Public Catering Service, the Taehung Guidance Bureau and the Foreign Languages Publishing House in Taekwon-Do matches and teams of the Ministry of Electric Power Industry, the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries, the Unha Guidance Bureau and the Foreign Languages Publishing House in shooting matches. Teams of the Ministry of Railways, the Foreign Trade Bank of the DPRK, the Taehung Guidance Bureau and the Sci-Tech Complex top the team standings in their groups. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Foreign Ministry Delegation Leaves for China
body: A delegation of the Foreign Ministry of the DPRK led by Vice-Minister Ri Kil Song left here Thursday to visit China. Rodong News Team

title: Seminars on Chairman Kim Jong Il's Exploits Held Abroad
body: Seminars on Chairman Kim Jong Il's exploits took place in Serbia, the Czech Republic, Italy and Germany between Feb. 9 and 12 on the occasion of his birth anniversary. The international secretary of the New Yugoslav Communist Party who is chairman of the Serbian national preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of the Day of the Shining Star said that Kim Jong Il is a distinguished thinker and theoretician, great statesman, outstanding Songun brilliant commander and benevolent father of the people who has made contributions to the accomplishment of the revolutionary cause of Juche and global independence. The deputy chairperson of the Paektusan Czech-Korean Friendship Association said that Kim Jong Il is always alive in the mind of not only the Korean people but also the world progressive people for his great feats performed before the era and history. The speakers including the chairperson of the Italian Preparatory Committee for celebrating the Day of the Shining Star praised Kim Jong Il for dedicating his all to the country and people, and the chief and members of the German Group for the Study of Korean Culture referred to the exploits the peerlessly great man performed for Korea's national reunification. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Shining Star Marked Abroad
body: Kimjongilia exhibitions were held in China and Mongolia, a ceremony for visiting the Kimilsungia Hothouse took place in Guinea and Korean book, photo and craftwork exhibitions were held in Russia and Laos between Jan. 28 and Feb. 20 on the occasion of the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il, Day of the Shining Star. Displayed at the venues of the events were photos showing the revolutionary activities of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. There were also their works, potted Kimilsungias and Kimjongilias in full bloom, the flowers of the sun, and books and photos introducing the DPRK and handicrafts associated with the creative talents of the Korean people. The chairperson of the Kimjongilia Association of Mongolia said that they would proactively contribute to developing the relations of friendship between the peoples of the DPRK and Mongolia by cultivating more Kimjongilias and widely organizing its exhibitions in different parts of Mongolia in the future. A vice-chairperson of the Kimilsungia-Kimjongilia Association of Guinea praised the revolutionary career of Kim Jong Il and explained how Kimjongilia, the flower of the sun, came into being. The secretary of the Khabarovsk Territorial Regional Political Council of the United Russia Party who is chairman of the legislative council of the territory, noted that Kim Jong Il devoted himself to the country and its people. The president of the Lao Federation of Trade Unions said the tradition of friendly relations between the two countries were provided and is being carried forward thanks to President Kaysone Phomvihane and President Kim Il Sung and that the current exhibition would be a good occasion in further developing the bilateral cooperative relations in various fields. Meanwhile, an online exhibition of Korean book, photo and craftwork was opened in Mexico on Feb. 15. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Exploits Praised by Syrian Media
body: Syrian media gave special write-ups titled "On the occasion of the 77th birth anniversary of Leader Kim Jong Il" from Feb. 13 to 16 to mark his birth anniversary. The Syria TV Channel said that Chairman Kim Jong Il carried forward President Kim Il Sung's idea and cause and firmly defended the sovereignty and dignity of the country despite all challenges and moves of the imperialist allied forces, screening a portrait of smiling Kim Jong Il and photos dealing with his revolutionary activities. The Radio Syria lauded Kim Jong Il for making great contributions to the country, people, era and history. The SANA carried a report together with a photo of Kim Jong Il that he developed in depth Kim Il Sung's revolutionary idea into the great guiding idea in the era of independence with his energetic ideo-theoretical activities. Papers Al Baath and Tishrin introduced in detail his ideological and theoretical feats and Songun leadership exploits together with his photo. The paper Al Thawrah elaborated on the exploits of Kim Jong Il who led the struggle for defending socialism to victory and his noble view of life. Rodong News Team

title: Symposium Marks Centenary of March First Popular Uprising
body: There took place a symposium in the field of social sciences at the People's Palace of Culture on Thursday to commemorate the centenary of the March First Popular Uprising. The March First Popular Uprising was the first nationwide anti-Japanese struggle waged by the entire Korean nation against the brutal colonial rule of the Japanese imperialists and a great patriotic event that propelled the anti-Japanese struggle for national liberation. The historic significance of the Uprising, lesson drawn from it and the patriotic spirit displayed by the Korean people were expounded at the symposium in which papers exposing the truth behind the Japanese imperialists' criminal policy of obliterating the Korean nation were made public. The speakers said that the Uprising which started in Pyongyang on March 1, Juche 8 (1919) swept the country and rapidly spread to all the regions where Koreans lived, including Northeast China and Maritime Province of Russia. People in Pyongyang played a vanguard role in the nationwide anti-Japanese uprising, performing proud feats to be recorded in the Korean history of anti-Japanese struggle for national liberation, they stressed. They noted that youth and students played the role of pioneer to start the March First Popular Uprising and kindle the flames of the uprising and the role of death-defying vanguard in expanding the anti-Japanese resistance to the whole of Korea. They cited detailed facts to disclose that the Japanese imperialists' suppression of the uprising was a state-sponsored crime committed by the Japanese government that regarded the obliteration of the Korean nation as its state policy. The speakers stressed that the Korean people always remember Japan's crime-woven history and will surely force Japan to pay dearly for its crimes. Present at the symposium were Ri Hye Jong, president of the Academy of Social Sciences, teachers, researchers, lecturers, journalists, editors and officials in relevant fields. Rodong News Team

title: Founding Anniversary of Kim Won Gyun University of Music Marked
body: Kim Won Gyun University of Music marked its 70th founding anniversary. President Kim Il Sung set up a national music school with university educational system on March 1, Juche 38 (1949) and visited the school several times to wisely lead it to thoroughly establish Juche in the musical education and improve instruction and edification in conformity with the developing socialist construction. Chairman Kim Jong Il provided the great programme for the Juche-oriented musical education including his work "On the Art of Music", saw to it that a modern new university building was erected on the bank of Taedong River and bestowed warm benevolence to the teaching staff and students of the university over again while sending high-quality musical instruments and teaching tools. Recorded in the seventy year-long history covered by the university are the brilliant contributions to ushering in a heyday of the Juche-oriented art by producing a number of excellent music and art talents true to the policy of the Workers' Party of Korea on art education. A meeting took place at the People's Palace of Culture on Thursday to mark the 70th founding anniversary of the university. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, President Trump Hold Second-day Talks
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, met again and had talks with Donald J. Trump, president of the United States of America, on Thursday. Supreme Leader of the Party, state and army Kim Jong Un met again with USA President Donald J. Trump at Metropole Hotel in Hanoi at 9:00 a.m. Hanoi Time and then had one-on-one talks before having extended talks with their aides attending. The top leaders of the two countries highly appreciated at the one-on-one talks and extended talks that a remarkable progress has been made in the historic course of implementing the Singapore joint statement. They had a constructive and candid exchange of their opinions over the practical issues arising in opening up a new era of the improvement of the DPRK-U.S. relations on the basis of the progress. At the talks they shared the common understanding that the efforts made by the two sides and proactive measures taken by them to defuse tensions and preserve peace on the Korean peninsula and completely denuclearize it were of great significance in building mutual trust and making a fundamental turn in the decades-long bilateral relations characterized by mistrust and antagonism. The top leaders listened to each other's views on the issues to be resolved without fail at the present phase in order to carry out the joint goals specified in the Singapore joint statement, and had an in-depth discussion of the ways to do so. They expressed the conviction that though a high barrier of antagonism and confrontation stands due to over 7 decades-long hostile relations and there exist inevitable hardships and difficulties on the road to writing a new history of the DPRK-U.S. relationship, they could create a significant advance in the DPRK-U.S. relations as desired by the peoples of the two countries if they firmly join hands to overcome hardships and difficulties with wisdom and patience. The top leaders of the two countries appreciated that the second meeting in Hanoi offered an important occasion for deepening mutual respect and trust and putting the relations between the two countries on a new stage. They agreed to keep in close touch with each other for the denuclearization of the Korean peninsula and the epochal development of the DPRK-U.S. relations in the future, too, and continue productive dialogues for settling the issues discussed at the Hanoi Summit. Kim Jong Un expressed his thanks to Trump for making positive efforts for the successful meeting and talks while making a long journey and said goodbye, promising the next meeting. Political News Team

title: Bulgarian Charge d'Affaires ad Interim Hosts Reception
body: Ivaylo Iordanov, charge d'affaires ad interim of the Bulgarian embassy here, hosted a reception on Friday to mark the national day of Bulgaria. Present there on invitation were Im Chon Il, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, officials concerned and representatives of foreign embassies and international bodies here. Staff members of the Bulgarian embassy attended the reception. Speeches were made there. Rodong News Team

title: Spring Tree-Planting Begins in DPRK
body: A spring tree-planting began in the DPRK to mark the tree-planting day. More than 2.8 million trees were planted on Friday. Premier Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, An Jong Su, Pak Thae Song, Ro Tu Chol, Choe Hwi, Pak Thae Dok and other senior party and government officials planted trees at different places of the city including the sports village in Chongchun Street, Munsu Hill, Moran Hill and the arboretum of the Central Botanical Garden together with working people and youth and students in Pyongyang. Officials of the Party and government organs and many citizens planted trees in different parts of the city on the same day. Officials, working people and youth and students in Kangwon, South Phyongan, South Hamgyong and South Hwanghae Provinces planted trees in a scientific and technological way on the principles of planting the right trees in the right soil and in the right season. Rodong News Team

title: Japan Urged to Pay for Its Crime-woven Past
body: The Korean Committee on Measures for the Sexual Slavery for Japanese Army and Drafting Victims released a statement on Friday, the 100th anniversary of the March First Popular Uprising. The statement read: On March 1, 1919 the Korean people's grudge and anger at the Japanese imperialists' outrageous colonial rule over Korea finally exploded into a nation-wide anti-Japanese resistance. Stunned by the anti-Japanese struggle of the Korean people, the Japanese imperialists hurled all their repressive forces including the army and policemen into indiscriminately massacring the demonstrators, killing more than 7 500, wounding over 15 900 and arresting and imprisoning at least 46 900 in a matter of three months. The murderers killed a 7 year-old boy by tearing his mouth with a dagger for the mere reason that he "hurrahed for independence of Korea." They even skinned the head of a 16 year-old girl and dismembered her to death for the reason that she stood in the van of the peaceful demonstration. The shuddering mass murder was just like madness of brutes and rampage of cannibals. The blood shed by the innocent Koreans permeated deep into this land and it seems that their grudge and angry shouts are still swirling around there. Not only that grudge but also the pain suffered by the Korean nation every day over 40 odd years due to the evil deeds committed by the Japanese imperialists in a bid to wipe Korea and the Korean nation off the face of the earth can neither be forgotten nor be healed easily, no matter that there was expiation for the sins. Nevertheless, Japan is still rubbing salt into the wound of the victims, twisting the justice of history and committing all sorts of evil deeds little short of the past crimes, far from honestly reflecting on the crime-woven past and paying for it. It is as clear as noonday that Japan is harboring a wild dream for reinvasion as it has not admitted its past crimes nor reflected on them and nor compensated for them. Unshakable is the stand and will of the DPRK over the issue of Japan's atonement for the crime-woven past. No matter how much water may flow under the bridge, Japan can never gloss over that issue if it fails to make a sincere apology and reparation for the damage and pain it inflicted upon the Korean nation in the past. The Korean nation will surely force Japan to atone for the century-old crimes recorded in history and to pay for the blood shed by the Koreans. Rodong News Team

title: WPK Delegation Leaves for Russia
body: A delegation of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) led by Han Man Hyok, vice department director of the Central Committee of the WPK, left here on Friday to visit Russia for participating in a photo exhibition to mark the 70th anniversaries of President Kim Il Sung's first official visit to the Soviet Union and the conclusion of the agreement on economic and cultural cooperation between the DPRK and Russia. Rodong News Team

title: Anniversary of March First Popular Uprising Marked Here
body: A Pyongyang City meeting took place at the People's Palace of Culture on Friday, the 100th anniversary of the March First Popular Uprising. Present at the meeting were Yang Hyong Sop, Ro Tu Chol and Choe Hwi who are senior officials of the Party and the government, Ri Son Gwon, chairman of the Committee for the Peaceful Reunification of the Country; Pak Myong Chol, presidium member and director of the Secretariat of the Central Committee of the Democratic Front for the Reunification of Korea; Cha Hui Rim, chairman of the Pyongyang City People's Committee, officials of social organizations and working people in the city. Kim Yong Dae, vice-president of the Presidium of the SPA, made a report. He stressed that the March First Popular Uprising which was vigorously staged one century ago, jolting the whole land of Korea, was the patriotic resistance to retake the sovereignty of the country and the nation usurped by the Japanese imperialists. He said that through the uprising, the Korean nation fully demonstrated its transparent and independent spirit, indomitable mettle and ardent patriotism and dealt a heavy blow at the colonial rule of the Japanese imperialists and greatly encouraged the world oppressed people in their struggle for national liberation. He pointed out that the uprising left a bitter lesson that the popular masses should consolidate their own forces under the guidance of the outstanding leader and revolutionary party and launch an organized struggle with correct strategy and tactics in order to win victory in their struggle for nation's sovereignty and country's independence, and that they stand against invaders armed to the teeth with arms. The reporter referred to the fact that the desire of the Korean people for the independence and sovereignty of the nation was successfully realized by President Kim Il Sung. He said that Chairman Kim Jong Il made patriotic devotion and efforts to vigorously carry forward the history of victory started in Mt. Paektu and further glorify the dignity and honor of Juche Korea. He emphasized that today the dignity of great Kim Il Sung's nation and Kim Jong Il's Korea is being demonstrated at the highest level as they are led by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. He called for resolutely smashing the hostile policy towards the DPRK and their moves for reinvasion by the Japanese reactionaries viciously disturbing peace on the Korean Peninsula and blocking reunification of Korea while persisting in realizing their old dream of the "Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere". He stressed that all the Koreans would never forget forever the crimes committed by the Japanese imperialists against the Korean nation but make them pay a dear price for the crimes. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Introduced in Russia
body: The full text of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us Brilliantly Accomplish the Revolutionary Cause of Juche, Holding the Great Comrade Kim Jong Il in High Esteem as the Eternal General Secretary of Our Party" was posted on the Russian internet homage Patrioti Moskva to mark Chairman Kim Jong Il's birth anniversary. The work, published on April 6, Juche 101 (2012), says it is a principled requirement for the victorious advance of the Korean revolution to hold Kim Jong Il in high esteem as the eternal general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea. It also indicates the tasks for steadily developing the WPK into the glorious party of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: Seminars on Chairman Kim Jong Il's Exploits Held Abroad
body: Seminars on Chairman Kim Jong Il's exploits took place in Pakistan, Mongolia, Kuwait, and Nigeria between Feb. 8 and 15. The reporters and speakers including the secretary-general of the Karachi Branch of the Pakistan-Korea Friendship Association said that Kim Jong Il is an outstanding revolutionary, ardent patriot and legendary hero who put the dignity and might of the DPRK on the highest level. They stated that Kim Jong Il made immortal contributions to the world peace and security and the accomplishment of the human cause of independence. The executive chairperson of the Mongolian Association for the Study of the Juche Idea-Songun Idea said: The great Comrade Kim Jong Il held higher the banner of Songun in the most arduous period. He defended the sovereignty of the country and the dignity of the people with his Songun politics and made the DPRK demonstrate its dignity as a political and ideological power and military power. The DPRK is now making a big contribution to firmly defending peace and security of the Korean Peninsula and the region. The chairman of the Nigerian Group for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism stressed that the greatest one of Kim Jong Il's feats is that he put the might of the DPRK on the highest level with his original Songun politics and developed the Workers' Party of Korea into an invincible guiding force and turned the DPRK into an impregnable fortress that no formidable enemy dares provoke. Rodong News Team

title: Nationwide Anti-Japanese Patriotic Resistance for National Independence
body: The March First Popular Uprising which startled the whole 3 000-ri land of Korea 100 years ago was a nationwide patriotic anti-Japanese resistance for retaking the country usurped by the Japanese imperialists and establishing the sovereignty of the nation. A century passed after the uprising and the mountains and rivers changed, but the spirit of the Popular Uprising still remains alive in the hearts of the fellow countrymen and encourages the entire nation to a just patriotic struggle for independence and reunification. The struggle of the Korean nation for complete independence and sovereignty of the country and the nation against the aggression and domination of outsiders has not yet been finished. Japan runs amuck to grab Tok Island, an inviolable territory of Korea, and swallow up the whole of Korea, persisting in the old dream of “the Greater Easter Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere” and hostile policy toward the DPRK. It is adding double and treble new crimes to its hideous crimes of the past. The Korean nation will never allow it. The Japanese authorities should have a good knowledge of the trend of the times in which a new climate of peace created in the Korean Peninsula gives a great impetus to the international political arena and balance of force rapidly changes in the region, and make an apology and reparation for the past hideous crimes against humanity for themselves as early as possible. Firm is the will of the Korean nation not to turn over historical responsibility for general settlement of the past crimes to the next generation. O Ryong Chol

title: Foolish Moves to Usurp Territory
body: A farce of the “Takeshima (Tok Island) Day” is staged in Japan on February 22, every year. On that day, not only high-ranking politicians but also right-wing conservative riff-raffs retired from political circle claim that Tok Island, an inviolable territory of the Korean nation, belongs to Japan and cry out for retaking it unconditionally. Shortly ago, the afore-said farce took place in Shimane Prefecture. The Japanese authorities sent high-ranking government officials to the venue to press for “dominium” over the island. The claim is a preposterous sophism just like setting the cart before the horse. Japan tries to gain world public recognition of the “Shimane Notice,” but the impudent and childish method does not work on anyone. The Japanese reactionaries’ ulterior motive is to turn Tok Island into a disputed territory and occupy it, when an opportunity presents itself. The Japanese reactionaries dream a pipedream. Angry voices that the daily worsening Japanese moves to usurp territory should not be allowed and that the pent-up grudge should be wreaked with arms are heard from among the Korean people. The Japanese politicians should lend an ear to this. They should think twice about what miserable consequences wait for Japan in case the Korean people burst into their anger. They would be well-advised to abandon their foolish ambition to usurp territory, which only invites disasters. Ri Hak Nam

title: Congratulations to Nigerian President
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, sent a congratulatory message to Muhammadu Buhari upon his reelection as president of the Federal Republic of Nigeria on Feb. 28. Kim in the message expressed the belief that the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation between the two countries would grow stronger in the future and wished the Nigerian president happiness in good health and bigger successes in his responsible work for the country's development and prosperity. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Shining Star Marked Abroad
body: Celebrations were held in different countries to mark Chairman Kim Jong Il's birth anniversary (Day of the Shining Star). The Swiss Group for the Study of the Juche Idea and the Ethiopian Committee for the Study of the Independent Politics had seminars and Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Class at a middle school in Zambia had a meeting for adopting a congratulatory message between Feb. 1 and 15. At the seminar on Chairman Kim Jong Il's work "On Having a Correct Viewpoint and Understanding of the Juche Philosophy", the reporters and speakers including the chief of the Swiss Group for the Study of the Juche Idea lauded Kim Jong Il as a brilliant thinker and theoretician who provided the ideological and theoretical assets for the prosperity of the DPRK with his rare wisdom and extraordinary inquiry. The Ethiopian Committee for the Study of the Independent Politics had a seminar on Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us Usher in a Golden Age of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth Movement". At the seminar, the chairperson of the committee explained the main content of the work and chiefs of its branches took the floor. They said that the Korean young people are playing an important role in socialist construction and stressed the need to learn after the youth movement of the DPRK. Meanwhile, a seminar on the Juche Idea took place on Feb. 16 with the attendance of personages and members of the Juche idea study organization and organizations of friendship and solidarity with the Korean people in Colombo, Sri Lanka. Rodong News Team

title: Congratulations to 2nd Congress of UPR
body: The Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea sent a congratulatory message to the Second Congress of the Union Party for the Republic (UPR) of Mauritania on March 2. Congratulating the congress, the message expressed the confidence that the congress would be an important occasion in consolidating the social unity and stability and in further strengthening and developing the party. Expressing the belief that the good friendly and cooperative ties between the two parties would continue to develop on good terms in the common interests of the two peoples in the future, the message wished the party great success in the congress. Rodong News Team

title: Concert Commemorates 100th Birth Anniversary of Composer Pak Han Gyu
body: A concert was given at the East Pyongyang Grand Theatre on March 2 to commemorate the 100th birth anniversary of composer Pak Han Gyu. He was a talented composer well known among the Korean people as he left a remarkable trace in the history of the development of Juche-oriented music. Staged at the concert were his famous works like "Song of the Proclamation of the People's Republic" representing the great excitement and joy of the Korean people who became the master of the genuine independent and sovereign state for the first time in history. Female solo and male pangchang "Nobody Knows", male small chorus "Song of Coast Artillerymen", male chorus "An Accordionist Has Come", etc. met with loud applause. The concert was enjoyed by creators and artistes in the army and society and teachers and students of art educational institutions and members of his bereaved family. Rodong News Team

title: Joint Statement Issued to Mark Centenary of March First Popular Uprising
body: The Swiss Organizing Committee for the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu, the Switzerland-Korea Committee and the Swiss Group for the Study of the Juche Idea released a joint statement on Feb. 23 ahead of the centenary of the March First Popular Uprising. The statement said that the Korean people turned out in the all-people anti-Japanese resistance in protest against the Japanese imperialists' brutal colonial rule on Mar. 1, 1919. It went on: The participants in the uprising staged intense demonstrations, shouting such slogans as "Long live the independence of Korea!" and "The Japanese and Japanese army, get out of the country!" The uprising left a lesson that victory cannot be won in the struggle when it is not led by an outstanding leader and the armed enemies should be countered with arms. The anti-Japanese armed struggle organized and led by Generalissimo Kim Il Sung ended in victory and as a result, Korea's independence, the desire of the participants in the uprising, could come true. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Shining Star Marked
body: Celebrations were held in the DPRK missions in many countries from Feb. 9 to 16 to mark Chairman Kim Jong Il's birth anniversary (Day of the Shining Star). Celebrations, book and photo exhibitions, round-table talks, film shows and receptions took place at the DPRK missions in Russia, Vietnam, Mongolia, Laos, Syria, Nepal, Myanmar, Cambodia, Iran, Indonesia, India, Thailand, Pakistan, Malaysia, Bangladesh, Belarus, Germany, Bulgaria, the Czech Republic, Switzerland, Romania, Italy, Spain, Guinea, DR Congo, Egypt, Ethiopia, Equatorial Guinea, Nigeria, Libya, Kuwait, South Africa, Senegal, Mexico, Brazil and Venezuela, the DPRK permanent mission to the UN Office and international organizations in Geneva and the DPRK permanent mission to the UN. Korean films including "Kimjongilia" and "My Country Has Emerged Victorious by Dint of Single-minded Unity" were screened at the film shows. Present at the events on invitation were personages of governments, political parties, organisations and institutions and masses in relevant countries and representatives of international and regional bodies and officials of the DPRK missions. The secretary of the Maritime Territorial Regional Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation said that Kim Jong Il who dedicated his all to the human cause of independence is the greatest man who recorded a brilliant chapter in the history of the world politics. The general secretary of the Central Committee of the Czechoslovak Communist Party said that Kim Jong Il is a great leader who made great contributions to the development of the Workers' Party of Korea and the accomplishment of the socialist cause through his energetic ideo-theoretical activities and rare leadership. The general secretary of the Central Committee of the People's Socialist Party of Mexico referred to the feats performed by Kim Jong Il for party building and his Songun leadership exploits. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Government Economic Delegation Leaves for Russia
body: A DPRK government economic delegation led by Minister of External Economic Relations Kim Yong Jae left here on Saturday to take part in the 9th meeting of the DPRK-Russia Intergovernmental Committee for Cooperation in Trade, Economy, Science and Technology due in Russia. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Lays Wreath at Monument to Heroic Martyrs
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, laid a wreath at the Monument to Heroic Martyrs on Saturday morning. Among the visitors were Kim Yong Chol, Ri Su Yong, Kim Phyong Hae and O Su Yong, members of the Political Bureau and vice-chairmen of the WPK Central Committee, Ri Yong Ho, member of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and foreign minister, No Kwang Chol, alternate member of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and minister of the People's Armed Forces, Kim Yo Jong, alternate member of the Political Bureau and first vice department director of the WPK Central Committee, Choe Son Hui, vice minister of Foreign Affairs, and other cadres. Present at the wreath-laying ceremony were Dao Viet Trung, director of the General Office of the Presidency of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, and Le Ba Binh, Vietnamese ambassador to the DPRK. Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un laid a wreath at the monument and paid a silent tribute. Political News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Lays Wreath before Mausoleum of President Ho Chi Minh
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, laid a wreath before the mausoleum of President Ho Chi Minh on Saturday morning. Among the visitors were Kim Yong Chol, Ri Su Yong, Kim Phyong Hae and O Su Yong, members of the Political Bureau and vice-chairmen of the WPK Central Committee, Ri Yong Ho, member of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and foreign minister, No Kwang Chol, alternate member of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and minister of the People's Armed Forces, Kim Yo Jong, alternate member of the Political Bureau and first vice department director of the WPK Central Committee, Choe Son Hui, vice minister of Foreign Affairs, and other cadres. Present at the wreath-laying ceremony were Dao Viet Trung, director of the General Office of the Presidency of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, and Le Ba Binh, Vietnamese ambassador to the DPRK. Supreme Leader of the Party, state and army Kim Jong Un laid a wreath before the mausoleum. He paid a silent tribute to the memory of Ho Chi Minh. Political News Team

title: Editorial
body: Let Us Turn Out in Spring Tree-Planting Campaign March 2 is the Tree-Planting Day. President Kim Il Sung, together with Chairman Kim Jong Il and anti-Japanese war heroine Kim Jong Suk, mounted Moran Hill on March 2, Juche 35 (1946), where he gave an important instruction to plant many trees and flowers. That day was recorded as the historical day when the tree-planting campaign started in the DPRK. When many trees are planted and the whole country is covered with thick verdure, can it be possible to develop the economy and improve the people’s living standard and turn the country into the people’s paradise good to live in. The Workers’ Party of Korea regards afforestation as an important work for the morrow of the prosperous country and happiness of the posterity. All Party members and other working people should devote themselves to planting trees, always remembering the great devotion of Kim Jong Il who had made tireless efforts for the country and the people till the last moments of his life with his heart burning with enthusiasm. All the people should turn out as one in the spring tree-planting, fully display their patriotic enthusiasm and thus turn the country into a beautiful paradise for the people and socialist fairyland.

title: DPRK Weightlifters Return Home
body: Weightlifters of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea returned home on Sunday after taking part in the 2019 IWF World Cup. The sporting event held in China from Feb. 22 to 27 brought together ace men and women weightlifters from many countries and regions including the DPRK, China, Russia, Italy and Mexico. DPRK players bagged six gold medals, 15 silver medals and six bronze medals. Pak Jong Ju and Kim Un Ju respectively came first in the jerk and total standings of men's 67kg category and women's 87kg category. Om Yun Chol and Choe Hyo Sim placed first in the jerk of men's 61kg category and the snatch of women's 59kg category and Ri Song Gum came second in the jerk, snatch and total standings of women's 49kg category. O Kang Chol, Pak Jong Ju, Kim Un Ju and Kim Hyo Sim respectively took the second places in the snatch of men's 73kg and 67kg categories and in the snatch of women's 87kg and 64kg categories. Choe Jon Wi, Rim Jong Sim, Rim Un Sim and Choe Hyo Sim won silver medals in the jerk of men's 81kg category and in the jerk and total standings of women's 76kg, 64kg and 59kg categories. O Kang Chol and Kim Hyo Sim came third in the jerk and total standings of men's 73kg category and in the jerk and total standings of women's 64kg category and Rim Jong Sim and Rim Un Sim in the snatch of women's 76kg and 64kg categories. Rodong News Team

title: Primary Information Workers Visit Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: The participants in the Second National Conference of Primary Information Workers of the Party on Sunday made bows to the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in the plaza of the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun where they lie in state. Rodong News Team

title: Greetings to Bulgarian President
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a message of greeting to Rumen Radev, president of the Republic of Bulgaria, on Sunday on the occasion of its national day. Expressing the belief that the friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries would be expanded and developed as desired by the peoples of the two countries, the message wished the Bulgarian people prosperity. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Shining Star Marked in Cambodia
body: Cambodian media aired special write-ups between Feb. 12 and 17 in the run-up to the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il, Day of the Shining Star. AKP reported the details given by an Indian prominent figure about the exploits performed by Kim Jong Il before the times and history. State Radio and Apsara Sound Broadcasting broadcast that Kim Jong Il tremendously strengthened the country's military capability under the unfurled banner of Songun, thus foiling the imperialists' moves of aggression and firmly defending peace and security on the Korean Peninsula and in the region and the rest of the world. F.M.105 Radio praised the noble virtue and traits of Kim Jong Il, who took warm care of all people with the warmest human love. Rodong News Team

title: Day of Shining Star Marked Abroad
body: Meetings took place in Pakistan, Belarus, Romania, Austria and Slovenia between Feb. 6 and 17 to celebrate Chairman Kim Jong Il's birth anniversary (Day of the Shining Star). The reporters and speakers including the chairman of the Lahore Group for the Study of the Juche Idea of Pakistan lauded Kim Jong Il as an outstanding statesman who achieved the immortal exploits in the history of the nation by leading the Korean revolution to victory. The chief of the Belarusian branch of the Russian Group for Solidarity with the DPRK stressed that Kim Jong Il lighted the way of the progressive mankind toward independence and peace by developing in depth the Juche idea. The editor-in-chief of the Belarusian magazine Social Education stated that Kim Jong Il, who is a distinguished revolutionary, thinker and theoretician and man of action, firmly defended Korean socialism with a treasured sword of Songun. The secretary general of the Romania-Korea Friendship Association praised Kim Jong Il's ideological and theoretical feats and Songun leadership exploits, adding that the DPRK has vigorously advanced along the road of socialism under the uplifted banner of independence against imperialism. The general secretary of the Society for the Promotion of the Relations between Austria and DPRK said that Kim Jong Il, the eternal head of the Workers' Party of Korea, is a peerless patriot who dedicated his all to prosperity of the country and happiness of the people. Rodong News Team

title: First Fulfiller of Her Yearly Textile Plan
body: Om Song Gyong fulfilled her yearly national economic plan ahead of set time on February 28. She is a weaver of Textile Shop 3 of the Combined Textile Shop of the Kim Jong Suk Pyongyang Textile Mill. At work on ten looms 2.5 times as many as her quota, she has followed her route among them and executed her daily work assignment by 700% as a token of her loyalty to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Consequently, she has been the first among weavers to carry out her annual plan. Emulating her at work, many other weavers of the mill register great successes in their daily output. More than 20 weavers have now fulfilled their national economic plan for the first half of 2019. O Un Byol

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Arrives at Home after Concluding Official Goodwill Visit to Vietnam
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, arrived at home on Tuesday after successfully wrapping up his official goodwill visit to the Socialist Republic of Vietnam. Seen to greet Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un at Pyongyang Railway Station were Kim Yong Nam, Choe Ryong Hae and Pak Pong Ju, Presidium members of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, and other senior officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs. Also seen there were staff members of the Vietnamese embassy here. At 3 o'clock in the early morning, his train entered the railway station yard. When he got off the train, he received a salute from the head of the guards of honor of the Korean People's Army. A ceremony for greeting him took place at the station. He was presented with bunches of flowers by a boy and girl. Senior officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs greeted him with their ardent congratulations. He exchanged greetings shaking hands with them. Acknowledging the enthusiastically cheering masses, he extended warm greetings to all the beloved people. Accompanying with him were Kim Yong Chol, Ri Su Yong, Kim Phyong Hae and O Su Yong, vice-chairmen of the WPK Central Committee, Ri Yong Ho, foreign minister, No Kwang Chol, minister of the People's Armed Forces, Kim Yo Jong, Ri Yong Sik and Kim Song Nam, first vice department directors of the WPK Central Committee, Choe Son Hui, vice minister of Foreign Affairs, Pak Jong Nam, chairman of the Kangwon Provincial Committee of the WPK, vice department directors of the WPK Central Committee and department directors and bureau directors of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK. Political News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address Off Press in Denmark
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address was brought out in booklet by the Denmark-DPRK Friendship Association on February 14. The booklet carried a photo of Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Exploits Lauded by Foreign Figures
body: Events were held in different countries between February 4 and 11 to mark the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. They included lectures in Uganda, Tanzania and Guinea, round-table talks in Ethiopia and a Taekwon-Do demonstration performance in India. Present there were personages of various units, including the Ugandan National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea, the Ugandan National Executive Committee of the Pan-African Movement, the Tanzanian National Coordinating Committee of the Juche Idea Study Groups, the Kim Il Sung Institute of Agricultural Science in Guinea, the Construction Design and Supervisory Complex of Ethiopia, the Water Projects Designing and Supervision Enterprise of Ethiopia and the Indian Association of Taekwon-Do, and masses in those countries. Speakers at the lectures in Uganda said that General Kim Jong Il of Korea is a great man who made a great contribution to global independence. They went on: His whole life is the one of a great revolutionary who devoted his all to the struggle for defending the sovereignty of the country in the face of all challenges by the imperialists. The world will always remember the benevolent image of the peerlessly great man who led the struggle for defending socialism to victory and made a ceaseless journey of patriotic devotion. The director general of the Kim Il Sung Institute of Agricultural Science in Guinea lauded Kim Jong Il's life as the sacred career during which he mapped out all things in a big way and put them into practice at the fastest tempo and devoted his all to the rosy future of the country and people. A congratulatory message to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was adopted at the lecture held at the Kim Il Sung Institute of Agricultural Science in Guinea. Rodong News Team

title: Korean Books Donated to Laos
body: A Korean book-donating ceremony took place at the Lao Federation of Trade Unions on February 20. Conveyed at the ceremony were famous works of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and other Korean books. Rodong News Team

title: 34th Sci-Tech Festival of Ministry of Railways Opens
body: The 34th Sci-Tech Festival of the Ministry of Railways opened with due ceremony on Monday. Attending the festival, divided into electricity, machine, IT operation, construction and electronics and automation sections, were scientists, technicians, three-revolution team members, teachers, researchers and field officials in the field of railway transport. Over 100 valuable achievements were presented to the festival. During the festival there will be a presentation and exhibition of sci-tech successes, exchange of new technologies, etc. to be helpful to solving sci-tech problems arising in railway transport and to increasing production. The festival will continue till Mar. 6. Rodong News Team

title: Jonsung Revolutionary Museum Marks 60th Founding Anniversary
body: The Jonsung Revolutionary Museum marked its 60th founding anniversary. The museum is associated with the exploits of President Kim Il Sung who led the Fatherland Liberation War to victory and unfolded the blueprint for postwar reconstruction in the flames of war. The President visited the museum on Mar. 9, Juche 76 (1987) and gave instructions on preserving and taking good care of the historical sites, while ascertaining historical data. Chairman Kim Jong Il visited it 13 times and saw to it that the historical tunnel was restored to its former glory and the records of revolutionary activities of the President were found out without omission, calling for arranging the visit to the museum well. The museum has fulfilled its mission to arm the Party members and working people with the revolutionary tradition of the Workers' Party of Korea in a responsible manner for the past 60 years since it was founded on Mar. 5 1959. A meeting marking its founding anniversary was held on Monday. Rodong News Team

title: Message of Condolence to President of Seychelles
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, sent a message of condolence to Danny Faure, president of the Republic of Seychelles, on Mar. 1, over the death of former President France Albert Rene. Kim in the message expressed deep condolences to the president and the bereaved family members of the deceased, noting that the former president actively strived to develop the relations of friendship and cooperation between the two countries. The message expressed the belief that the government and people of Seychelles would overcome the pain of the loss and make successes in the efforts for achieving social stability and progress. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Revolutionary Exploits Praised by Foreign Media
body: Foreign media gave special write-ups titled "Image of great man", "For ideal and peace of mankind", "The country of rosy future" illustrated with portraits of smiling Chairman Kim Jong Il and his photos on the occasion of his birth anniversary. The Congolese newspaper Le Patriot on Feb. 4 said that under the guidance of Kim Jong Il, the Workers' Party of Korea developed into the ever-victorious party, the Korean People's Army into the matchless army and the DPRK into the invincible socialist fortress. The Tanzanian paper Uhuru on Feb. 13 referred to the historic significance of Kim Jong Il's birth, noting that the Korean people celebrate with splendor his birth anniversary Feb. 16 as the greatest holiday of the nation every year. The organ of the Uganda National Resistance Movement Public Lens on Feb. 5 said that Kim Jong Il's life was the one of warm love for the people and the one of boundless devotion, adding that his noble image as the genuine people's leader would be kept in the hearts of the Korean people and the world progressives forever. The Feb. 16-28 issue of the Indian newspaper World's Mirror said that Kim Jong Il laid bare the reactionary nature of the abuses of socialism and proved the scientific accuracy and truth of socialism and inevitability of its triumph in his famous works including "Socialism Is a Science". The Feb. issue of the Bulgarian newspaper Iskra pointed out that Kim Jong Il performed exploits to be recorded for centuries in all fabrics of social life including politics, economy, military affairs and culture during the whole course of his revolutionary leadership. The South African newspaper Laudium Sun on Feb. 15 carried an article on the exploits performed by Kim Jong Il in developing the DPRK into an invincible military power. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Lauded Abroad
body: Celebrations and book and photo exhibitions were held in Norway, Denmark, Finland, Brazil and Mexico between Feb. 12 and 21 on the occasion of Chairman Kim Jong Il's birth anniversary. Personages of various strata and masses in those countries were present at the events. Dag Norum, chairman of the Ostfold County Committee of the Communist Party of Norway, said that Kim Jong Il wisely led the struggle for a rosier future of the DPRK on the basis of the Juche idea. Anders Kristensen, chairman of the Denmark-DPRK Friendship Association, praised Kim Jong Il as an outstanding revolutionary and elder statesman who performed undying exploits for prosperity of socialist Korea and global independence. Juha Kieksy, international secretary of the Finnish Communists' League who doubles as chairman of the Finnish Preparatory Committee for Celebrating the Day of the Shining Star, said in his speech that Kim Jong Il was a great thinker and theoretician who enriched the Juche idea founded by President Kim Il Sung as required by the times and that Kim Jong Il protected the country's dignity and sovereignty and happiness of the people under the uplifted banner of Songun and laid firm groundwork for building a powerful socialist country and improving the people's standard of living. Rosanita Campos, vice-president of the Party for Free Motherland of Brazil, and Benigno Gonzales Villasana, chairman of the Mexico-Korea Friendship Association, praised the revolutionary career and exploits of Kim Jong Il who devoted his whole life to the country and people. Congratulatory messages to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un were adopted at the events held in Norway, Denmark and Finland. Meanwhile, a political and cultural event was held in Venezuela to celebrate the 77th birth anniversary of Kim Jong Il. Rodong News Team

title: Annual Meeting of Korean Committee for Solidarity with Cuba Held
body: An annual meeting of the Korean Committee for Solidarity with Cuba was held in Pyongyang on Tuesday. Present there were Kim Sung Du, chairman of the Education Commission who is chairman the Korean Committee for Solidarity with Cuba, So Ho Won, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries, and other members of the solidarity committee and Cuban Ambassador to the DPRK Jesus De Los Angeles Aise Sotolongo and his embassy members. The meeting reviewed the work conducted by the solidarity committee last year to actively support the fraternal Cuban people in their struggle to defend the sovereignty of the country and the gains of socialism under the leadership of the Communist Party of Cuba. And it discussed this year's action program to develop the traditional DPRK-Cuba friendship as required by the new era. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Women's Volleyball Team Wins in Int'l Volleyball Tournament
body: Women volleyball players of the DPRK April 25 Sports Team won the International Women's Volleyball Tournament-LienVietPostBank Cup that took place in Vietnam from Feb. 22 to March 1. The games brought together eight teams from the DPRK, China, Vietnam and Kazakhstan. The players of the April 25 Sports Team beat the Fujian team of China 3:0 in the semifinals after overwhelming all its rivals 3:0 in the group B. The DPRK team defeated the Vietnamese LVPB team 3:0 in the final on March 1. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Foreign Ministry Delegation Back Home
body: A delegation of the Foreign Ministry of the DPRK led by Vice-Minister Ri Kil Song came back home on Tuesday after visiting China. Rodong News Team

title: Head of WPK Delegation Meets Chairman and Vice Secretary of Russian Political Parties
body: Han Man Hyok, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), met and had a talk with Vladimir Zhirinovsky, chairman of the Liberal Democratic Party of Russia, and Andrei Klimov, vice secretary of the General Council of the United Russia Party, respectively on Monday. Han Man Hyok is leading a delegation of the WPK on a visit to Russia. Vladimir Zhirinovsky said that the Korean people have achieved eye-opening successes, advancing along the road of development they chose and setting an example to the world in all the fields of state building and social life despite the harsh sanctions of the West for over seven decades. Noting that the dramatic turn in the situation of the Korean Peninsula and the region and the drastically enhanced prestige and role of the DPRK in the international arena are entirely attributable to the brilliant strategy and high political ability of Comrade Kim Jong Un, Supreme Leader of the Korean people, he said that heads of any countries will not match Kim Jong Un's leadership. He expressed the stand of the Liberal Democratic Party of Russia to invariably develop the relations with the WPK. Andrei Klimov said that the delegation's visit will offer an occasion to strengthen the favorably-developing relations between the United Russia Party and the WPK, expressing support to the WPK's line for achieving the country's reunification by the efforts of the Korean nation. Rodong News Team

title: Juche-based Fertilizer and Basic Chemicals Produced Briskly
body: Those engaged in the chemical industry do all they can to boost their production, infinitely yearning for Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. The　Namhung Youth Chemical Complex and the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex, the arsenals of the socialist agricultural front, increase their output at full swing in the face of obstacles. This year they have so far produced more Juche-based fertilizer than last year. The February 8 Vinalon Complex overfulfills its daily plan for the production of hydrochloric acid, caustic soda, carbide and other basic chemicals. Besides, it takes good care of its machines and equipment on technological lines and incessantly conducts a technological innovation movement with success. Sim Hak Chol

title: First Damming Project of Ansok Tideland Completed
body: The Tideland Reclamation Complex of South Phyongan Province finished building a sea dike for over 10,000 meters across the tideland extending from Ansok-ri, Onchon County, to Sokchi-ri and converting it into far more than 1,000 hectare of land on March 1. A million-odd cubic meters of earth was used to build the dike, which was coated with huge stones of 140, 000-odd square meters. Ri Chung Il

title: MOU Signed between DPRK and Russia
body: A MOU on cooperation in tourism was signed between the National Tourism Administration of the DPRK and the Bureau for Tourism of the Russian Federation in Moscow on Mar. 1. It was inked by the DPRK ambassador to Russia and the director of the Bureau for Tourism of the Russian Federation respectively. Rodong News Team

title: 34th Festival of Science and Technology of Academy of Agricultural Science Opens
body: The 34th Festival of Science and Technology of the Academy of Agricultural Science opened with due ceremony on Wednesday. The festival, divided into such panels as cereal crop breeding, agricultural information and crop cultivation, agricultural chemistry and plant protection and veterinary, is to be held in the forms of a presentation of sci-tech achievements and exhibition. More than 80 sci-tech achievements are exhibited at the festival attended by officials, researchers and postgraduates at the Academy of Agricultural Science. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Birth Anniversary Marked Abroad
body: Film shows and book and photo exhibitions took place at various units in Mongolia, Thailand, Singapore, Malaysia, Guinea, Algeria, Nigeria and Angola to mark the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Present at the events were personages of various strata and masses in those countries. Korean films "Kimjongilia" and "My Country Has Emerged Victorious by Dint of Single-minded Unity" were screened at film shows. The chairman of the Organization for the Study of the Juche Idea of Thailand said that he keenly realized the greatness of Kim Jong Il during his visit to the DPRK, adding that he devoted his all to the victorious advance of the revolutionary cause of Juche under the uplifted banner of Songun during the crucial period. The director of a Thai company noted that Kim Jong Il was born in Mt Paektu, holy mountain of Korea, adding that Jong Il Peak bearing the august name of the great man witnesses how much the Korean people revere him. Speakers at the film shows held in Nigeria praised Kim Jong Il for bringing up the Korean people to have a strong sense of independence. The director of an Angolan company said that he came to know better about the great personality of Kim Jong Il through the film, adding that he devoted his whole life to the prosperity of the country and happiness of the people. Rodong News Team

title: March 8 International Women's Day Marked
body: There took place sports and amusement games of officials and members of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea at the Taekwon-Do Hall on March 4-6 to mark the 109th anniversary of March 8 International Women's Day. More than 300 officials and members of the union selected from Pyongyang and each province competed in such games as volleyball and yut-games. There were the finals of all events on Wednesday. Pyongyang City took the first place in total points. Rodong News Team

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Praised in Russia
body: Russian media dedicated special write-ups to the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il under such titles as "Kim Jong Il, his birth and the world", "Memory of great man", "Great man and Mt Paektu" and "Charms". The media carried portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, pictures showing the revolutionary activities of Chairman Kim Jong Il and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and photos of the peerlessly great men standing together. The website of the Novosibirsk Regional Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation referred to Kim Jong Il's exploits performed for the cause of socialism and independence against imperialism, saying that his birth was the historic event of great significance in the destiny and development of the world progressives as well as the Korean people. The website Irkutskblogspot. Ru said that Kim Jong Il emerged as the guiding star who would hold responsibilities not only for the future of socialist Korea but also for the destiny and future of the cause of human independence by carrying forward the idea and cause of President Kim Il Sung, and stressed the historic significance of Kim Jong Il's birth. The newspaper Komsomolskaya Pravda said that Kim Jong Il lives forever in the hearts of the Korean people along with the hymns of yearnings for him and the flower named after him, and introduced in detail the immortal revolutionary hymn "Song of General Kim Jong Il" and Kimjongilia. The newspapers Nizhegorodskaya Pravda and Moskovskii Komsomolets and online magazine Lemchich carried articles in praise of the revolutionary career of Kim Jong Il who made ceaseless journey of loving care for the people and devotion and lived the whole life as pure as white snow with his noble view on the people. Rodong News Team

title: Socialist Korea Advancing by Dint of Science and Education
body: Today our country makes rapid strides in developing into a scientific and technological power and training all the people to be well versed in science and technology under the energetic leadership of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Therefore, the world public extols him to the skies. The DR Congo National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea spotlighted the science and technology of the DPRK in an article captioned “To Be a Power of Education and Talents”. It reads: “Today the DPRK develops into a power of education and talent under the wise leadership of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un who lays the firm foundations for national progress and prosperity. He ensured that the law on enforcing the universal 12-year compulsory education system was adopted at the 6th session of the 12th Supreme People’s Assembly of the DPRK and that its secondary general education and the relevant conditions and environment as well were improved rationally in accordance with the actualities of the country and the trend of development in the world. As a result, the universal 12-year compulsory education system has been put into effect in an all-round way in Korea. The higher educational system for training talents in large numbers and the online education system of major universities have been established on a higher level to enable all the people to master science and technology.” The Deve-Ross of Russia reportedly went:“Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un visits one scientific research institute after the other, attaching great importance to science and technology. Under his guidance the national strategy of scientific and technological development is carried out at a high speed and advanced technology is introduced actively into all the fields of the country. His politics encourages the Korean people to perform new miracles.” Jong Won Jun

title: UAWK Delegation Leaves for Nepal
body: A delegation of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea (UAWK) led by Kil Sang Bong, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the union, left Pyongyang on Thursday to take part in the International Conference on Food Sovereignty and Peasants' Rights to be held in Nepal. Rodong News Team

title: New Association Formed in Belarus
body: The Vitebsk Juche Pedagogy Association of Belarus was formed on February 21. The editor-in-chief of the magazine Social Education was elected chief of the association. The association decided to intensify the study of the Juche-oriented pedagogy to widely introduce the experience of the DPRK to the field of education and write books related to it. Rodong News Team

title: Photo Exhibition Opened in Russia
body: Photo exhibition "History of Friendship" opened with due ceremony at the building of the State Duma of Russia on March 5 to mark the 70th anniversaries of President Kim Il Sung's first official visit to the Soviet Union and the conclusion of the agreement on economic and cultural cooperation between the DPRK and Russia. Seen at its venue were photos dealing with the exploits of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. And displayed were photos showing the daily-changing appearance of the DPRK under the leadership of Kim Jong Un and the vitality of the Workers' Party of Korea's policy of attaching importance to the people. Present at its opening ceremony were deputies from various political parties including Melinikov, first vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation who doubles as first deputy speaker of the State Duma of Russia, and personages of the Foreign Ministry, the WPK delegation led by Han Man Hyok, vice department director of the Central Committee of the WPK, the DPRK ambassador to Russia and his embassy members. Speeches were made there. Melinikov said that the tradition of Russia-DPRK friendship provided and developed by the President and the Chairman is being successfully carried forward by the Supreme Leader. The vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation who doubles as first vice-chairman of the International Affairs Committee of the State Duma noted that the photo exhibition serves as a very important occasion clearly proving once again the friendly relations between Russia and the DPRK which have a long history and tradition. A member of the Supreme Council of the Liberal Democratic Party of Russia who doubles as member of the International Affairs Committee of the State Duma expressed support to the DPRK in its efforts to exercise influence in the international arena and ensure peace on the Korean Peninsula. The exhibition will go on till March 8. Rodong News Team

title: Centenarian Receives Birthday Spread
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un sent a birthday spread to So Sok Hwa, woman centenarian living in Jongsong-dong, Sariwon City. Born into a poor peasant family of Yontan County, North Hwanghae Province, she experienced the sorrow of a stateless nation, suffering every kind of humiliation and insult. It was not until President Kim Il Sung liberated the country that she could live a happy life. She dedicated herself to her revolutionary task to repay the benevolence of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il who built a new country in which the people became its master, and glorified it. After becoming a pensioner, she is enjoying her life, receiving social benefits and doing simple work. Rodong News Team

title: Joint Meeting with Aged Women Held
body: A joint meeting with aged women took place at the Pyongyang Old People's Home on Thursday ahead of the March 8 International Women's Day. Attending the meeting were Choe Il Hong, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Korea Federation for the Care of the Aged, and aged women here including health-seekers of the home. Present there on invitation were women of foreign embassies and missions of international bodies here. The aged women sang and danced with their joys of leading a happy life in the twilight years of their life and spent a sweet time with amusement. The attendees looked round the home and planted memorial trees there that day. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Women's Soccer Team Wins 2019 Cyprus Women's Cup
body: The DPRK women's soccer team took the first place in the 2019 Cyprus Women's Cup held in Cyprus from February 27 to March 6 (local time). The event brought together teams from different countries including the DPRK, Nigeria, Belgium and Mexico. The DPRK team beat the Czech team 4:2, South African team 4:1, Finnish team 1:0 in the group A and advanced to the final. The final match between the DPRK team and Italian team took place on March 6 (local time). The DPRK team beat the Italian rival 10:9 in the 11-meter kick after the match ended in draw 3:3. Rodong News Team

title: S. Korea and U.S. Start New Joint Military Drill
body: South Korea and the U.S. reportedly started a joint military drill under new codename Alliance from March 4. South Korea and the U.S. announced that the drill Alliance is the one replacing the former Key Resolve and it will continue until March 12. As for joint military drill Foal Eagle, they said they would stage it without codename round the year in the form of small-scale field mobile drill involving units smaller than battalion. They said that the on-going drill aims at examining wartime operation plan through computer-aided simulation of "the north's all-out invasion of the south" and increasing the capabilities to fight a war. The ill-boding moves of the south Korean military authorities and the U.S. are a wanton violation of the DPRK-U.S. joint statement and the north-south declarations in which the removal of hostility and tensions were committed to, and an open challenge to the aspiration and desire of all Koreans and the international community for peace and stability on the Korean Peninsula. Rodong News Team

title: Report of Central Election Committee in DPRK Issued
body: The work for nominating and registering candidates for deputies to the 14th Supreme People's Assembly (SPA) has been successfully conducted in the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. In this regard, the Central Election Committee issued a report on Mar. 7. The meetings of electors for nominating candidates and examining their qualifications nominated as candidates workers, peasants, intellectuals, service personnel of the People's Army and officials who have devotedly worked for the prosperity of the socialist country and happiness of its people, true to the idea and guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, the report said. The report noted that the election committees in all the constituencies across the country registered the nominees as candidates for deputies to the 14th SPA to be elected in their constituencies under the Law on the Elections of Deputies to the People's Assemblies at All Levels. The Central Election Committee reported that the candidates for deputies to the 14th SPA nominated at electors' meetings held in all the constituencies throughout the country were correctly registered as candidates for deputies to the SPA by the election committees of their relevant constituencies. Rodong News Team

title: Head of WPK Delegation Meets Chairman of "A Just Russia"
body: Han Man Hyok, vice department director of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea, on a visit to Russia as head of a WPK delegation, met and had a talk with Sergei Mironov, chairman of "A Just Russia", at the building of the State Duma on Wednesday. Sergei Mironov looked back with deep emotion upon the days when he visited the DPRK, noting that during the visit he was received by Chairman Kim Jong Il and was charmed with his warm human love and unassuming character. He said he fully supports the WPK's new strategic line and the decisive measures taken by it for ensuring peace and stability of the Korean peninsula. He wholeheartedly wished the Korean people bigger successes in building a powerful state under the wise guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, expressing the steadfast stand of "A Just Russia" on boosting the relations with the WPK. Meanwhile, the head of the WPK delegation met with Vladimir Kashin, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation. Vladimir Kashin said he was pleased to see the Korean people make big successes in socialist construction under the guidance of the supreme leadership of the DPRK. He affirmed that the Communist Party of the Russian Federation that always attaches importance to developing relations with the WPK would invariably support and encourage the Korean people in their efforts for building a powerful country. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address Published in Belarus
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's New Year Address was published in the city of Vitebsk, Belarus on Feb. 25. Present at the new year address releasing ceremony were personages at the editorial board of the Belarusian magazine Social Education and the Vitebsk National Veterinary Academy and masses. Sergei Zebyatikh, editor-in-chief of the Belarusian magazine Social Education, pointed out that the New Year Address delivered by Kim Jong Un is an important guideline that the Korean people should hold fast to this year. Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address instilled confidence in victory and optimism into the Korean people, he noted. The friends of Korea in Belarus are convinced that the just cause of the Korean people will surely emerge victorious, he added. Rodong News Team

title: Profiles of Candidates for SPA Deputies Displayed in DPRK
body: Sub-constituency election committees for the election of deputies to the 14th Supreme People's Assembly (SPA) displayed the profiles of candidates for deputies to the SPA who were registered at relevant constituencies, according to the Law on the Elections of Deputies to People's Assemblies at All Levels of the DPRK. Polling stations were arranged at all constituencies across the country. Rodong News Team

title: Statue of Drafted Worker Erected around Japanese Consulate General in S. Korea
body: According to a report, civic organizations of south Korea erected a statue depicting a Korean worker drafted by Japanese imperialists around the Japanese consulate general in Pusan on March 1, the centenary of the March First Popular Uprising.
