title: Rising from Obscurity to Distinction
body: The deputies to the DPRK Supreme People’s Assembly include teachers, too. Among them is Kil Kum Sun, People's Teacher and headmaster of the Thrice Red Flag Pyongyang Primary School No. 4. Her father was a worker of 13 before Korean liberation in 1945. From a child she wanted to be a teacher. As she wished she entered Pyongyang Teachers’ College and took up teaching at the Taedongmun Primary School (the present-day Kim Song Ju Primary School) in Pyongyang after graduation. She tried very hard to give good lessons to her schoolchildren. In her thirties she was appointed headmaster of the Pyongyang Primary School No. 4 attended by Chairman Kim Jong Il. The looks of her school have since been changed beyond recognition for slightly over 18 years. It can legitimately be said to lead all its counterparts in the country. This is the fruition of her conscience, devotion and strenuous efforts as a genuine educationalist of 30 years’ standing. She was elected by the people to the 13th SPA. They nominated her again as candidate for the 14th SPA considering she served them and their children faithfully for the past 5 years as befitting their representative. So Nam Il

title: Editorial
body: Let Us Make Whole Country Lively through Fresh and Vigorous Information and Motivation Work The 2nd National Conference of Primary Information Workers of the Party marked another milestone in cementing the revolutionary position and the class position, putting fresher spurs to socialist economic construction and successfully pushing forward the cause of modeling the whole society on Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism by fundamentally improving the Party information and motivation activities and methods as required by the developing reality. Its significance lies in that it provided a powerful treasured sword to instill confidence and courage into hundreds of thousands of primary information workers of the Party active at the outposts of the Party’s ideological front and bring about a fresh revolutionary upsurge in all fields of socialist construction. When primary information workers of the Party across the country fire a salvo of an ideological campaign and make it focused, steady and accurate through effective and enterprising information and motivation work, the country will advance more quickly and the dream and ideal of the people come true. Our Party is convinced that primary information workers of the Party across the country will turn their units into patriotic ones advancing in unity through their vigorous activities and make another leap forward in socialist economic construction through dynamic information and motivation offensive. All primary information workers of the Party should fulfill their duty as forerunners bringing the intention of the Party home to the masses and pioneers inspiring them to implementing the Party’s policies, mindful of their weighty mission and duty before the Party and the revolution, the era and the history.

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Successful Vietnam Visit Hailed by Swiss Organizations
body: The Swiss Organizing Committee for the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu, the Switzerland-Korea Committee and the Swiss Group for the Study of the Juche Idea released a joint statement on March 3 in congratulation of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's successful official goodwill visit to the Socialist Republic of Vietnam. The statement said that the relations between the DPRK and Vietnam became the one of friendship and solidarity thanks to President Kim Il Sung and President Ho Chi Minh. It noted that the Vietnam visit paid by Kim Jong Un offered an important occasion in developing the friendly relations forged by the preceding leaders of the two countries down through generations. The development of relations between the two countries is of great significance in ensuring peace and security of Asia, the statement stressed. Rodong News Team

title: Kim Yong Nam Sends Condolence to Ethiopian President
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a message of sympathy to Sahlework Zewde, president of the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia, on Monday over the airliner crash in Ethiopia that claimed loss of many lives. The message expressed deep sympathy and condolences to the president and, through him, to the victims and their bereaved families. Rodong News Team

title: Pak Pong Ju Inspects Different Units
body: Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, inspected different units. Making rounds of various places of the Pyongyang Pharmaceutical Factory, he learnt about the progress of the modernisation project, and stressed the need to enhance the responsibility and role of scientists and technicians for further perfecting the computer integrated manufacturing and to ensure hygienic safety. While inspecting the Pyongyang Dental Hygiene Products Factory, he called upon its officials and employees to make contributions to successfully materializing the intention of the Party for the wellbeing of the people by devoting their wisdom and passion to the production of various quality dentifrices, gargles and sanitary implements. The on-the-spot consultative meetings stresssed that officials should conduct the organizing and commanding work and guidance over building in a responsible manner, the relevant sectors should give precedence to taking measures to supply materials to the modernization project, the production plan for dental hygiene goods should be fulfilled by actively introducing new technical innovation proposals. He also inspected the Posan Iron Works, the Jangsan Mine and the Ramjong Mine. Rodong News Team

title: Report on Results of Election of Deputies to SPA Issued
body: The Central Election Committee on Tuesday released a report on the results of the election of the deputies to the 14th Supreme People's Assembly (SPA) of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea held on Mar. 10, Juche 108(2019). According to the report, the election was held in conformity with the Law on the Elections of Deputies to the People's Assemblies at All Levels. All the electors participated as one in the election to cement our people's power as firm as a rock, the report said, and continued: Electors abroad or working in oceans failed to take part in the election. According to the result of vote count, 99.99 percent of all the electors registered on the voter rolls across the country attended the election and 100 percent of them cast their ballots for the candidates for deputies to the SPA registered in relevant constituencies. The Central Election Committee made public the list of 687 persons elected to the SPA after examining the reports on the results of election submitted by election committees at all constituencies across the country. Rodong News Team

title: Shape Steel Production Base Erected
body: A modern shape steelworks with a large production capacity has been built in the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex situated in the northern part of Korea. Soon after the start of its building yet more than 100 tons of its steel structure was constructed and its concrete fabric put up with success. Shape-producing, bending, washing, plating and many other processes have been set up. Trial production was carried out in the steelworks some time ago and shape steel and circular arc trusses of various sizes were turned out. The firm material and technological foundations have been laid in our country for producing various kinds of shape steel for construction with our machines, materials and technology. The workers of the KCISC admirably built the shape steelworks with great fortitude in the spirit of self-reliance. The Songjin Steel Complex, the Ranam Coal-mining Machine Complex and other related factories provided the KCISC with materials and other spare parts in good time, thereby helping towards building the shape steelworks at an early date. Shape steel of all kinds has been enabled to be produced in our country for various spheres of the national economy. Ri Un Nam

title: Reprocessing Workshop for Ore Residues Newly Built
body: The Hyesan Youth Mine set up a lean ore reprocessing process anew. Consequently valuable components have been enabled to be recovered from ore dressing without being carried away. President Kim Il Sung had long given the HYM instructions to process the residues of dressed ore well. True to them, the officials, workers and technicians of the HYM had already built a settling pond and succeeded to some extent in preventing the environmental pollution by ore dressing. They did not rest content with this but buckled down to newly establishing a modern lean ore reprocessing process under the banner of self-reliance. They first put up a reprocessing shop in a short time and then proceeded to make relevant machines on their own with their technology and knowledge. They focus on reprocessing the residues of dressed ore which have long been deposited on the settling pond. Jon Chol Ju

title: Intent on Developing New Coalfields
body: The Sunchon Area Youth Coal-mining Complex exerts itself to develop new coalfields for an increase in its coal production. Under a long-term plan the Pukdang valley of the February 8 Jikdong Youth Coal Mine and the Jol valley of the Chonsong Youth Coal Mine have so far been tunneled into by over 70% at full swing to open up new coalfields with an annual capacity of hundreds of thousands of tons. On completion the coalfields will vitalize the national economy as a whole further. Fully conscious of their heavy responsibility for their large share in the coal output of the nation, the coal miners of the SAYCC achieve with great fortitude success after success in developing new coalfields. Myong Chun Gil

title: A Refractory Workshop Almost Completed
body: The Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex has mainly finished building a refractory workshop with a large productive capacity. All its working processes were test-run and the pressure on a network of its gas pipes tested with success. Preparations for full-scale refractory production are pushed forward vigorously. True to the intention of the Party to enhance the self-sustenance and Juche character of the metalworking industry further, the HISC decided to newly build a tunnel calcining furnace the technology of high-temperature air combustion is applied to and produce the refractory needed to increase its iron and steel output. The HISC nominated its competent officials for the leadership and stepped up the work of laying the foundations of the calcining furnace, building it and erecting its equipment simultaneously. The workers of the HISC strove hard as one to solidify the foundations for the production of Juche-oriented iron and steel. They registered successes in constructing the calcining furnace in the spirit of self-reliance despite their obstacles and hardship. This enabled it to turn out refractory on its own and boost its iron and steel output. O Mun Il

title: The Solvers of Firsthand Problems
body: The scientists of the Pyongyang Scientific and Technological Information Company under the State Commission of Science and Technology work devotedly to achieve greater successes in their scientific researches. Deeply conscious of being assigned the important task of advancing the national economy and the science and technology of the country, they have developed their information on science and technology to put the economy on a modern and informational footing and actively solved the problems which confronted them in actuality. They invented on their own an electromotor control frequency converter suited to our actual conditions. They briskly introduce it into actual operation. They have installed it in the Taedonggang General Fruit-Processing Plant. Of late, they study and analyze advanced machines complicated in structure and function, and on this basis, settle the problems of normalizing their operation. Moreover, they succeeded in developing the integrated accumulator maintenance system. Without resting content with their successes they work dynamically as ever to attain many more valuable successes in their researches. O Mun Il

title: Day of Shining Star Marked Abroad
body: The birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il (Day of the Shining Star) was marked abroad with splendor. National and regional preparatory committees chaired by political and public personages were organized in Pakistan, Nepal, Russia, Serbia, Romania, Mexico and Venezuela. Preparatory committees headed by party leadership members were formed in Iran, Indonesia, Kyrgyzstan, the Czech Republic, Germany, Hungary, Spain and Brazil. In Cambodia the deputy prime minister in charge of Royal Palace was elected as chairman of the preparatory committee upon authorization of the king. The International Alliance of Societies for the Study of the Juche Idea and Songun Policy in East European and Central Asian Regions formed an international preparatory committee with its general secretary as chairman. Preparatory committees sponsored diverse political and cultural events in praise of Kim Jong Il. On the occasion of the Day of the Shining Star, Swiss bodies issued a joint statement, and statements and articles were released by the general secretary of the National Guidance Council of the Pioneer Party of Indonesia, the chairman of the Supreme Council of the National Socialist Party of Romania, the official representative of the Greek branch of the Korean Friendship Association and the chairman of the Arab Committee for Solidarity with Korean People and Supporting the Reunification of Korea. The king and the great queen of Cambodia and the general chairperson of the Central Directive Council of the Indonesian Democratic Party of Struggle sent floral baskets to the DPRK embassies and delegations of foreign political parties and public personages visited DPRK missions in various countries. National symposiums on the Juche idea "National Sovereignty and Global Peace" and "Struggle for Global Independence and Peace" were hosted in India and Mexico. A national meeting took place in Venezuela and a joint celebration meeting of Nordic progressive political parties and friendship bodies in Sweden. Colorful political and cultural events including Kimjongilia Exhibition, ceremony for visiting the Kimilsungia Hothouse and book, photo and handcraft exhibition, internet exhibition and book-donating ceremony were significantly held in many countries. Foreign media gave wide publicity to the sacred career and exploits of Kim Jong Il before and after his birth anniversary. Rodong News Team

title: 34th Festival of Science and Technology Takes Place in Provinces
body: The 34th festival of science and technology took place in all the provinces. The Pyongyang City festival of science and technology was held from March 5 to 13 at the Pyongyang Railway Station Department Store. The participants were officials, teachers, researchers, workers and students of more than 190 units including science and research institutes, universities, factories and enterprises in Pyongyang. The festival, which was divided into several panels such as power, light industry, agriculture, machinery and electronics and automation, showed a collection of more than 300 scientific and technological achievements and inventions. Similar festivals were also significantly held in North Phyongan, South Hwanghae, South Phyongan and other provinces amid the expectations and interest of officials and working people in the fields of economy, science and education. Rodong News Team

title: President Kim Il Sung's Birth Anniversary to Be Marked in Russia
body: A preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (the Day of the Sun) was formed with due ceremony by the Moscow Group for the Study of the Juche Idea on March 10. Mikhail Vikulin Mikhailovich, chief of the group, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. At the ceremony, the committee discussed its action plan to organize various political and cultural events including a seminar on works of Kim Il Sung on the occasion of the Day of the Sun. Rodong News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Introduced in DR Congo
body: The full text of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "On Effecting a Drastic Turn in Land Management to Meet the Requirements for Building a Thriving Socialist Nation" was posted by the National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of DR Congo on its website on March 9. The work, published on April 27, Juche 101 (2012), deals with the exploits performed by President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in land management and indicates the general orientation and tasks for face-lifting the land of the country as befitting the appearance of a thriving socialist nation. The website carried a photo of Kim Jong Un. Rodong News Team

title: The Leader Is Great Leader of People, Tender-Hearted Father
body: Leader is the center of the life of the popular masses and the top intellect, not a being apart from them. The distinguished position and role of the leader lie in the fact that the leader personifies the interests of the popular masses to the maximum and organizes and guides their independent and creative struggle. The leader leads the people to victory and glory. The people should be united with one idea in one organization to be the independent driving force that carves out their destiny by themselves. Only the leader can accomplish the cause of arming the popular masses with independent revolutionary idea and rallying them around revolutionary organization. The leader makes the working masses the owner of the state power and the means of production and leads them to exercise all sovereign rights, take part in state management with the attitude of the master and reject and frustrate all pressure, arbitrary practices and moves of aggression by foreign forces at every step, thus letting them enjoy the dignified life as independent people. The leader is the great servant of the people who devotes his all to their happiness, sharing life and death with them all his life. The supreme models of the popular leader are President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il who remain long in the world history of socialist movement. Their lives are the sacred revolutionary histories of people’s leaders who devoted themselves to the country and people till the last moments of their lives as leaders, revolutionaries and human beings, going through unimaginable hardships and trials. Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un is creditably carrying forward the history of the ardent love of the great leaders for the people, the history of most fervent and sacrificial devotion for the people. Kim Yong Il

title: Editorial
body: Invincible Is DPRK Government Enjoying Absolute Support and Trust from Popular Masses 99.99 percent of all the electors took part in the election of deputies to the 14th Supreme People’s Assembly (SPA) of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea and 100 percent of them cast their ballots for the candidates for deputies to the SPA registered in relevant constituencies. This is the manifestation of the absolute support of all the people for and their trust in the DPRK power and the eruption of their ardent patriotism to glorify the socialist country of Juche all over the world. The election of deputies to the 14th SPA was a political event which fully displayed the dignity and might of the DPRK and gave fresh impetus to the struggle for building a powerful socialist country. The election is of titanic, historical significance for having demonstrated to the world the might of the DPRK where all the people have been united in one idea and one purpose and laid firm groundwork for realizing the people’s aspiration and demand. The election fully showed the true picture and rosy future of the DPRK that wins victory after victory under the leadership of the great Party as well as the people’s determination and will to dynamically make a breakthrough in socialist construction with sincere patriotic sweat and blood. All People should strive to strengthen the DPRK power and bring earlier the rosy future for the building of a powerful socialist country, rallied close around the Party.

title: Reply Message to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Syrian President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a reply message from Bashar Al-Assad, president of the Syrian Arab Republic, on March 12. The Syrian president in the message expressed deep thanks to Kim Jong Un for sending him kind congratulations on the occasion of the 56th anniversary of the March 8 Revolution in Syria. The reply message appreciated that Kim Jong Un is extending support and solidarity to the army and the people of Syria in their anti-terrorism struggle for defending the vital rights, stability and territorial integrity of the country. The message wished Kim Jong Un happiness in good health and the friendly Korean people bigger progress and prosperity. Rodong News Team

title: Demonstration to Punish Judicial Evil Forces Staged in S. Korea
body: The All-People Civic Solidarity for Uprooting Judicial Scandals in south Korea waged a foot march in Seoul on Mar. 9, calling for inflicting punishment upon close associates of Ryang Sung Thae, chief culprit of the judicial scandal, according to the south Korean internet paper Voice of Seoul. The participants in the march expressed their indignation at the fact that the close associates of Ryang Sung Thae still hold the positions of judges, which makes a mockery of the people. They vowed to continue the struggle to bring them to justice by dint of the people. Rodong News Team

title: Dissolution of LKP Demanded in S. Korea
body: According to the south Korean internet newspaper Jaju Sibo, the Youth Solidarity of south Korea released a commentary on Wednesday in demand of the dissolution of the "Liberal Korea Party", source of all evils. The commentary said that the ultra-rightist wrongs of LKP keen on distortion of the spirit of the Kwangju Uprising and confrontation with the fellow countrymen enrage the people with each passing day. It noted that the LKP's impudent act of making a mockery of and enraging the people almost every day, far from reflecting on its crimes, can never be pardoned. It stressed that only when the LKP, the hotbed of all evils, following outsiders in disregard of the people, is dissolved, it is possible to stabilize the people's livelihood and usher in a new era of peace, prosperity and reunification. Rodong News Team

title: Socialist Farms Backed Up
body: True to the militant call of the Party to the agricultural front, a main attack point of socialist economic construction, for an increase in grain production North Phyongan Province gives active assistance to rural farms. On March 5 provincial and county organs, factories and enterprises provided rural farms with 323,000-odd medium and small-sized farm implements of 35 kinds, vinyl sheets and lots of other farming materials, thereby vigorously encouraging agricultural officials and workers to their immediate farm work. A provincial exhibition of medium and small-sized farm implements was held in the Sinuiju Square on the same day amid the expectation and interest of people. Song Chang Yun

title: The Mass Technological Innovation Movement for Increased Coal Production
body: The Joyang Coal-prospecting Team of the Kaechon Area Coal-mining Complex conducts the mass technological innovation movement actively. The officials of the team reinforce its April 15 Technological Innovation Shock Brigade with able technicians and skilled workers and lead them to play a pivotal role in the mass technological innovation movement. They ensure that the team collectively discuss the urgent scientific and technological problems of putting its prospecting work on a modern and scientific footing and solve them creatively. As a result the team made a photosensitive corotation preventer and a no-load circuit breaker for delaying a welder for five seconds. In addition, it introduced more than 20 profitable technological innovations into its prospecting work. The team has attended provincial scientific and technological festivals actively and disseminated science and technology on normal lines. In the course of this the team has rapidly improved the technology and skill of its emplolyers who worked hard with high creative enthusiasm every day. O Mun Il

title: Japan's Shameless Act Censured by S. Korean Paper
body: The south Korean paper Hangyore on March 14 carried an editorial criticizing Japan's shameless act. The editorial said that the seizure of properties of war criminal businesses of Japan is in progress according to the south Korean Supreme Court's judgment. But Taro Aso, vice-prime minister of Japan, claims that economic retaliatory measures are examined against south Korea, it said. The editorial termed his mentioning about economic retaliation to get concession a foolish act. Rodong News Team

title: Reckless Act of Ultra-Right Conservative Forces Blasted
body: Members of civic organizations in Kwangju denounced ultra-right conservatives for threatening an elementary-school pupil, according to the south Korean Yonhap News on Mar. 14. The pupil was said to have chanted the slogans "Arrest Chun Doo Hwan" and "Get out of here, Chun Doo Hwan" to express the indignation at the traitor who led the "martial law soldiers" to slaughter the participants in the Kwangju Popular Uprising in cold blood. Taking issue with the act of the said pupil, the conservative elements phoned the school to protest against it and held a "news conference to denounce it" in front of the school. Civic organization members declared that they would never pardon the elements if they keep with the reckless act against pupils. Rodong News Team

title: Swiss Foreign Ministry Delegation Here
body: A delegation of the Swiss Foreign Ministry headed by Director for Asia-Pacific Raphael Naegeli arrived here on Saturday. Rodong News Team

title: Delegation of Russian Federal Assembly Arrives Here
body: A delegation of the Russian Federal Assembly led by Oleg Melnichenko, chairman of the Federal System, Regional Policy, Local Autonomous and Northern Affairs Committee of the assembly who is chairman of the Russia-DPRK Friendship Parliamentary Group, arrived here on Saturday to mark the 70th anniversaries of President Kim Il Sung's first official visit to the Soviet Union and the conclusion of the agreement on economic and cultural cooperation between the DPRK and Russia. Rodong News Team

title: DPRK Acrobats Win Gold Prize at Izhevsk Int'l Acrobatics Festival
body: The 12th Izhevsk International Acrobatics Festival was held in the city of Izhevsk, the Republic of Udmurtiya of Russia on Mar. 6-10. It was attended by 200-odd excellent acrobats from 15 countries including the DPRK, Russia, China, Poland, Spain and Mexico. The DPRK acrobats showed well the high development of the Juche-oriented acrobatics by performing aerial acrobatics full of bravery, courage, joy and optimism. Judges, participants in the festival and spectators gave a big clap to the DPRK acrobats whenever they flawlessly performed high stunts. At the awarding-ceremony the gold prize, the top prize of the festival, was conferred on the DPRK's physical acrobatics "Fliers". The DPRK acrobats returned home on Saturday. Rodong News Team

title: President Kim Il Sung's Birth Anniversary to Be Marked in Syria
body: A Syrian preparatory committee for celebrating the 107th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung was formed on Mar. 9. Mohammed Shaban Azzooz, chairman of the Syrian Arab-Korea Friendship Association, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee set a celebration period between Mar. 9 and April 16 and decided to hold diverse political and cultural events in praise of the President's exploits. Rodong Sinmun

title: Negotiations Held between DPRK and Russian Foreign Ministries
body: DPRK Vice-Foreign Minister Im Chon Il, on a visit to Russia as head of a delegation of the DPRK Foreign Ministry, had negotiations with Igor Morgulov, his counterpart of the Russian Foreign Ministry, in Moscow on Mar. 14. At the negotiations both sides agreed to boost high-level contact and exchange in the political field, actively promote cooperation in the fields of economy and humanitarianism, bolster up mutual support and collaboration in tackling the issue of the Korean peninsula and on the international arena and thus steadily develop the traditional and strategic DPRK-Russia relations this year marking the 70th anniversary of the conclusion of the DPRK-Russia agreement on economic and cultural cooperation, true to the intention of the top leaders of the two countries. A 2019-2020 plan of exchange between the two Foreign Ministries was signed following the negotiations. Im Chon Il also met with Sergei Vershinin, vice-foreign minister in charge of international organizations of Russia, on Saturday to exchange views to ensure peace and security of the Korean peninsula and boost cooperation between the two countries. Rodong Sinmun

title: Dissolution of LKP Urged in S. Korea
body: Civic and public organizations in the area of Taegu, south Korea held a news conference outside the building of the Taegu City Party of the "Liberal Korea Party" (LKP) on Mar. 14 to urge the party's dissolution, according to the south Korean internet paper Jaju Sibo. Speakers exposed the despicable acts of the LKP that distorted the spirit of the May 18 Kwangju Popular Resistance and denied the impeachment of Park Geun Hye. They said that they would make none of candidates affiliated to the LKP go into the "National Assembly" by judging them in the "National Assembly" elections. They vowed to dissolve the LKP by fighting to the last in the spirit of the candlelight demonstrations. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of Russian Federal Assembly Pays Tribute to
body: President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il A delegation of the Russian Federal Assembly led by Oleg Melnichenko, chairman of the Federal System, Regional Policy, Local Autonomous and Northern Affairs Committee of the assembly who is chairman of the Russia-DPRK Friendship Parliamentary Group, visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill. The visitors laid a bouquet at the statues of the great leaders and bowed down before them. Rodong Sinmun

title: UAWK Delegation Back Home
body: A delegation of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea (UAWK) headed by Kil Sang Bong, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the union, returned home on Sunday after attending the International Conference on Food Sovereignty and Peasants' Rights held in Nepal. Rodong Sinmun

title: The New Stem Cells Activator Developed
body: The scientists of the Bioengineering Branch under the State Academy of Sciences achieve good successes in their researches into the advanced technology of stem cells. They have recently developed the Stem Cells Activator 1 and related injection of our style which will contribute to promoting the health of the people and curing and preventing their diseases. They cooperated creatively with the medical workers of various health institutions like the Kim Man Yu Hospital and the Academy of Traditional Koryo Medicine in actively applying the activator to clinical therapeutics. In the process of this they proved the activator efficacious against spontaneous gangrene and ischemic cerebrovascular disease. The result was that a success was made of their devices. At present the Bioengineering Branch strives hard to build a workshop for the stem cells activators and relevant injections. Ryo Myong Hui

title: Day of Sun to Be Marked in Iran
body: A preparatory committee of the Islamic Coalition Party of Iran for celebrating President Kim Il Sung's birth anniversary, Day of the Sun, was formed on Mar. 11. A vice-general secretary of the party was elected as chairperson of the preparatory committee. The committee set a celebration period between Mar. 11 and April 16 and decided to hold diverse political and cultural events in praise of the President's revolutionary career and exploits. It also decided to give wide publicity to the achievements made by the Korean people in socialist construction under the guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Day of Sun to Be Marked in Britain
body: A preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, Day of the Sun, was formed in London on Mar. 8 in the joint name of the British Association for the Study of Songun Policy, the British Group for the Study of the Juche Idea and the Korean Friendship Association UK. Dermot Hudson, chairman of the British Association for the Study of Songun Policy, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee fixed a celebration period from Mar. 15 to April 15 and decided to organize diverse political and cultural events. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Ambassador Meets President of National Assembly
body: of People's Power of Cuba DPRK Ambassador Ma Chol Su paid a courtesy call on Esteban Lazo Hernandez, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba and president of the National Assembly of People's Power of Cuba, on Mar. 14. Esteban Lazo Hernandez expressed thanks to the party, government and people of the DPRK for always extending invariable support and solidarity to the Cuban party, government and people in their efforts for the country's development. Rodong Sinmun

title: Dissolution of LKP Urged in S. Korea
body: An editorial titled "Reckless remarks and acts of slayer Chun Doo Hwan enraging people" was posted on the south Korean internet newspaper Minjok Ilbo on March 15. The editorial denounced Chun for his shameless act of denying all charges again in a recent trial. It underscored the need to arrest Chun as early as possible, probe into his crimes and dissolve the "Liberal Korea Party", conspirator of Chun. Rodong Sinmun

title: South Korean Students Call for Dissolution of LKP
body: The Kangwon Progressive Federation of Students of south Korea launched a protest action on March 13 urging lawmaker Kim Jin Thae to resign from his post and calling for dissolution of the "Liberal Korea Party" (LKP) that is shielding Kim, according to the south Korean internet newspaper Jaju Sibo. Kim has reportedly come under public criticism for distorting the history and the spirit of the May 18 Kwangju Popular Uprising in south Korea. Members of the federation stormed Kim's office and handed him a questionnaire taking issue with his awful behavior of unhesitatingly insulting the May 18 pro-democracy movement for his dirty ambition for power. It urged him to resign from his post and pay for his wrong deed immediately. Then the organization released a statement, which said the treacherous moves of LKP which had to be dissolved along with the impeachment of Park Geun Hye two years ago, have gone beyond the red line. LKP can never go with impunity as it pursues ultra-right conservative politics, far from making a sincere apology for its crimes, the statement added. The organization declared that students will take the lead in the campaign for dissolving LKP and eradicating deep-rooted evils for the final victory of the candle-light resistance and peaceful reunification of the Korean peninsula. Rodong Sinmun

title: S. Korean Body Urges Japan to Make Apology and Reparation for Sexual Slavery
body: The Justice Preserving Solidarity for Settling the Issue of Sexual Slavery of the Imperial Japanese Army in south Korea made public a statement on Mar. 13 to urge the Japanese government to make a sincere apology and reparation for the sexual slavery for the Imperial Japanese Army, according to a south Korean news report. The statement said that the Japanese government is seeking to shirk the responsibility for the sexual slavery. It said that Japan can never cover up the crime by turning away its face from the suffering of victims and denying its war crimes. It demanded that the Japanese government make a sincere apology and reparation for the sexual slavery. Rodong Sinmun

title: Kim Yong Nam Receives Credentials from Swiss Ambassador to DPRK
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the DPRK Supreme People's Assembly, received credentials from Swiss Ambassador to the DPRK Bernardino Regazzoni at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Monday. After receiving the credentials, Kim Yong Nam had a talk with the ambassador. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Foreign Ministry Delegation Back Home
body: A delegation of the Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea led by Vice-Minister Im Chon Il returned home on Monday after taking part in the vice-ministerial negotiations between the DPRK and Russian foreign ministries and the celebrations of the 70th anniversary of the conclusion of the agreement on economic and cultural cooperation between the two countries. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairmen of Friendship Parliamentary Groups of DPRK and Russia Meet
body: Talks took place between Hong So Hon, chairman of the DPRK-Russia Friendship Parliamentary Group and president of Kim Chaek University of Technology, and Oleg Melnichenko, chairman of the Federal System, Regional Policy, Local Autonomous and Northern Affairs Committee of the Federation Council of Russia who is chairman of the Russia-DPRK Friendship Parliamentary Group, at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Monday. Present at the talks from the DPRK side were Kim Sok Nam, deputy to the Supreme People's Assembly, officials concerned and from the Russian side members of the delegation of the Federation Council of Russia and Alexandr Matsegora, Russian ambassador to the DPRK, and members of his embassy. At the talks both sides exchanged their views on further developing the relations between the parliamentary groups of the two countries and on the issues of mutual interests. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of Federation Council of Russia Visits Mangyongdae
body: A delegation of the Federation Council of Russia led by Oleg Melnichenko, chairman of the Federal System, Regional Policy, Local Autonomous and Northern Affairs Committee of the council who is chairman of the Russia-DPRK Friendship Parliamentary Group, visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. Being told about the revolutionary history of the President, the guests looked around the historical mementoes preserved at the native home in Mangyongdae. The delegation also toured the Tower of the Juche Idea, the Arch of Triumph, the Rungna Dolphinarium, Pyongyang University of Foreign Studies, etc. and laid a bouquet before the Liberation Tower. Rodong Sinmun

title: Film Show Marks Anniversary of DPRK-Russia Agreement
body: A film show took place at the Taedongmun Cinema on Tuesday to mark the 70th anniversary of the conclusion of the agreement on economic and cultural cooperation between the DPRK and the Russian Federation. Invited to the film show were Alexandr Matsegora, Russian ambassador to the DPRK, and his embassy members and the visiting delegation of the Federation Council of Russia led by Oleg Melnichenko, chairman of the Federal System, Regional Policy, Local Autonomous and Northern Affairs Committee of the council who is chairman of the Russia-DPRK Friendship Parliamentary Group. Present there were So Ho Won, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries who doubles as chairman of the DPRK-Russia Friendship Association, officials concerned and others. The participants watched a Korean documentary film "History of Eternal Friendship" showing the immortal exploits performed by President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il for the development of the DPRK-Russia friendly relations. Rodong Sinmun

title: Swiss Foreign Ministry Delegation Leaves
body: A delegation of the Swiss Foreign Ministry headed by Director for Asia-Pacific Raphael Naegeli left here for home on Tuesday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Campaign for Uprooting Deep-Seated Evils Declared in S. Korea
body: According to the south Korean Yonhap News, the Joint People's Action in south Korea held a meeting in Seoul on March 15 to declare a campaign for uprooting deep-seated evils. In a resolution, the organization denounced the "Liberal Korea Party" (LKP) for continuing its impudent and reckless acts while making a mockery of candlelight demonstrators. It asserted that the only way for realizing the will of demonstrators is to totally uproot the evils. It stressed that it would stoutly conduct the campaign against the LKP deceiving the people and distorting history. Rodong Sinmun

title: Dissolution of LKP Urged in S. Korea
body: The Taejon Headquarters of the Movement for Achieving People's Rights and Removing Evils in south Korea held a candlelight rally on March 15 outside the building of the Taejon City branch of the "Liberal Korea Party" (LKP), in which it urged the dissolution of the LKP, according to the south Korean internet newspaper Tongil News. Speakers said that the LKP coteries are the very ones who should be brought to justice as they cover the pro-Japanese force and disparage the patriotic force as "rioters". They called upon all people to unite and turn out in the struggle for dissolution of the LKP. Rodong Sinmun

title: Ri Su Yong Meets New Swiss Ambassador
body: Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, met and had a talk with Bernardino Regazzoni, new Swiss ambassador to the DPRK, who paid a courtesy call on him on Tuesday. Rodong Sinmun

title: S. Korean Bodies Demand Detention of Scandal-related Judges
body: The Solidarity of Justice for Correct History and other organizations in south Korea held a news conference outside the building of the Seoul Central District Prosecutor's Office on Mar. 15 in demand of the detention of judges implicated in judicial scandals, according to the south Korean internet paper Voice of Seoul. The organizations in a press release condemned Song Chang Ho, judge at the Seoul Central District Court, for betraying investigation secrets to cover up his colleague's scandal in 2016. The press release also denounced him for hiding most of briberies committed by Ku Un Su, former director of the Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency. Saying that such a guy should not be allowed to stay in the position, the press release demanded detention of and thorough investigations into evil judges. Rodong Sinmun

title: President Kim Il Sung Praised by Person of DR Congo
body: President Kim Il Sung is always alive in the hearts of not only the Korean people but also the progressives as the sun for his exploits. Andre Lohekele Kalonda, chairman of the National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of the DR Congo who is chairman of the DR Congo preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, said this at the inaugural ceremony of the preparatory committee on March 12. He said Kim Il Sung, who embarked upon the road of revolution in his teens, founded the Juche idea, the guiding idea in the era of independence, liberated the country from the Japanese imperialists' colonial rule and turned the DPRK into a socialist country. Today, the Korean people are waging a dynamic struggle to open up a new road of advance for socialist construction, holding high the banner of self-reliance under the leadership of the respected HE Kim Jong Un, he said. He said they will give wide publicity to the noble revolutionary career and immortal exploits of the President and the greatness of HE Kim Jong Un who is making great contribution to the world peace and the human cause of independence by steering international political trend with seasoned leadership, and wage the positive solidarity movement for supporting the Korean people's cause of justice. Rodong Sinmun

title: President Kim Il Sung Praised by Swiss Body
body: President Kim Il Sung is the great hero of the Korean nation and the iron-willed commander and outstanding strategist with an indomitable will. A Swiss preparatory committee for marking the 107th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung said this in a statement issued at its inaugural ceremony on Mar. 7. The statement said that the President devoted himself to the happiness of the people all his life, regarding it as his motto to believe in the people as in Heaven. He also energetically led the struggle for the building of socialism, reunification of Korea and the global independence until the last moments of his life, the statement noted, adding: The idea and cause of the President were successfully carried forward by HE Kim Jong Il, and are being given steady continuity by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Reception Given to Mark Anniversary of Conclusion of Agreement between DPRK and Russia
body: The Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries and the DPRK-Russia Friendship Association hosted a reception at the Okryu Restaurant on Wednesday to mark the 70th anniversary of the conclusion of the agreement on economic and cultural relations between the DPRK and the Russian Federation. Invited to the reception were Alexandr Matsegora, Russian ambassador to the DPRK, and members of his embassy and the delegation of the Federation Council of Russia led by Oleg Melnichenko, chairman of the Federal System, Regional Policy, Local Autonomous and Northern Affairs Committee of the council who is chairman of the Russia-DPRK Friendship Parliamentary Group. Present there were So Ho Won, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries who doubles as chairman of the DPRK-Russia Friendship Association, and officials concerned. Rodong Sinmun

title: Day of Sun to Be Marked in Czech Republic
body: A Czech preparatory committee for marking the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (Day of the Sun) was formed in Prague on Mar. 12. Jozef Servista, chairman of the Paektusan Czech-Korean Friendship Association who is deputy general secretary of the Central Committee of the Czechoslovak Communist Party and chairman of the Czech Group for the Study and Materialization of the Juche Idea, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. It decided to hold colorful political and cultural events such as seminar and film show in praise of the revolutionary careers and feats of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and the personality of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un as the great man on the occasion of the Day of the Sun. Rodong Sinmun

title: President Kim Il Sung's Birth Anniversary to Be Marked in Russia
body: The Juche idea study organizations in Russia jointly formed a preparatory committee for marking the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (Day of the Sun) on Mar. 13. The preparatory committee whose chairman is Dmitri Kostenko, chairman of the Russian Association for the Study of the Juche Idea, decided to organize colorful political and cultural events including a national seminar on the Juche idea and celebrations on the occasion of the Day of the Sun. Rodong Sinmun

title: Competition of Explanation Teams of Youth League Held
body: A competition of the explanation teams of the youth league related with the five-point education took place at the construction site of the Wonsan-Kalma coastal tourist area from March 15 to 20. Attending the competition were officials and primary information workers of more than ten units of the youth league selected in provincial competitions. The participants in the competition made positive use of the unique and various forms and methods of agitation for increased production acquired by them in the days when they had conducted activities of explanation teams for five-point education. They showed well the patriotic will and faith of the young vanguard in numbers such as motivation and song "Glory to General Kim Jong Un" and "Our National Flag", dialogic poem "Sun of Destiny" and female solo "Our Faith". Given at the competition were homophonic tale "Wonderful Person", motivation and song "Let Us Take Responsibility for the Safety of the Project and Guarantee Its Absolute Quality for All Eternity", comic story "Mind of Patriotism" and others. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Embassy in Moscow Hosts Reception
body: The DPRK embassy in Moscow hosted a reception on March 15 to mark the 70th anniversary of the conclusion of the agreement on economic and cultural cooperation between the DPRK and Russia. Present there on invitation were Sergei Tirtsev, first vice-minister of Development of the Far East and Arctic of Russia, Vice Foreign Minister Igor Morgulov and other figures of different units including the Foreign Ministry, the Ministry of Culture, the Ministry of Interior and the Russian Association for Friendship and Cultural Cooperation with the DPRK. Kim Hyong Jun, DPRK ambassador to Russia, and staff members of his embassy and a delegation of the DPRK Foreign Ministry led by Vice-Minister Im Chon Il were present. The participants laid a floral basket and bouquets before the picture depicting President Kim Il Sung standing together with Chairman Kim Jong Il and paid tribute to them. They looked round photos dealing with exploits performed by the great leaders and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in the development of friendly relations between the DPRK and Russia and their works, and books and photos introducing the reality of Juche Korea. Speeches were made at the reception. Meanwhile, the DPRK missions in Khabarovsk and Vladivostok arranged receptions on the same day. Rodong Sinmun

title: Pak Pong Ju Inspects Units in North Phyongan Province
body: Premier of the Cabinet Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected various units in North Phyongan Province. At the Combined Reed Farm, he stressed the need to repair and maintain a sluice, water pump, etc. in ensuring water supply for increased reed production and the need for relevant units to give help to the farm in a responsible manner. At the Sinuiju Chemical Fibre Mill, he highlighted the need to manage equipment well in pulp production and bleaching processes, thoroughly meet the requirements of standard regulations of operation and further enhance the responsibility of officials in hurrying the upgrading of the mill. Walking round the Sinuiju Textile Mill and the Thosong Cooperative Farm in Sinuiju City, the premier took the measures to further upgrade production processes, step up the construction of the mill's hostel and make effective preparations for each farming process. The field consultative meetings underlined the need to give fullest play to the might and potential of the self-supporting economy and attain the goal of grain production without fail by mobilizing all forces and concentrating means. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Footwear Exhibition Opened
body: The 2019 Spring National Footwear Exhibition opened with due ceremony at Pyongyang Yokjon Department Store on Wednesday. Presented to the exhibition going on in the forms of product exhibition and sci-tech presentation are more than 113 500 products of at least 1 110 kinds as well as valuable research findings by over 60 units including the Wonsan Leather Shoes Factory, the Ryuwon Footwear Factory and the Pyongyang Han Tok Su University of Light Industry. Also on display there are famous products symbolizing and representing those units and other diverse, various, varicolored and light leather and grass shoes and different materials for shoes. Attending the opening ceremony were Vice Premier Ri Ju O, Minister of Light Industry Choe Il Ryong, officials concerned and those of units taking part in the exhibition. The exhibition will last till March. 26. Rodong Sinmun

title: Kim Yong Nam Receives Credentials from Norwegian Ambassador
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, received credentials from Norwegian Ambassador to the DPRK Frode Solberg at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Wednesday. After receiving the credentials, Kim Yong Nam had a talk with the ambassador. Rodong Sinmun

title: Ri Su Yong Meets Delegation of Federation Council of Russia
body: Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, met and had a talk with the delegation of the Federation Council of Russia led by Oleg Melnichenko, chairman of the Federal System, Regional Policy, Local Autonomous and Northern Affairs Committee of the council and chairman of the Russia-DPRK Friendship Parliamentary Group, who paid a courtesy call on him on Wednesday. Rodong Sinmun

title: The Covering Materials for Maize Seeds Produced
body: The Phyongwon Agricultural Chemicals Factory produced in ten days the covering materials for maize seeds to be sown in more than 100,000 hectares of fields, thus topping its work assignments. They serve as an effective insecticide, germicide and stimulant to growth under the soil. They accelerate the sprouting of maize seeds. The officials, technicians and employees of the factory are now continuing to strive hard as ever to contribute to the grain production of the nation. Kang Kum Song

title: Delegation of Federation Council of Russia Leaves
body: A delegation of the Federation Council of Russia led by Oleg Melnichenko, chairman of the Federal System, Regional Policy, Local Autonomous and Northern Affairs Committee of the council who is chairman of the Russia-DPRK Friendship Parliamentary Group, left here for home on Thursday. It had visited the DPRK to mark the 70th anniversaries of President Kim Il Sung's first official visit to the Soviet Union and the conclusion of the agreement on economic and cultural cooperation between the DPRK and Russia. Rodong Sinmun

title: Day of Sun to Be Marked in Romania
body: A Romanian preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (Day of the Sun) was formed on Mar. 15. Vasile Orleanu, chairman of the Supreme Council of the National Socialist Party of Romania and chairman of the Romanian National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee set a celebration period from Mar. 15 to Apr. 15 and decided to hold political and cultural events in praise of the President's revolutionary career and exploits. Rodong Sinmun

title: Birth Anniversary of President Kim Il Sung to Be Marked in Jordan
body: A Jordanian preparatory committee for celebrating the 107th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung was formed on Mar. 12. Marwan Sudah, chairman of the Arab Committee for Solidarity with Korean People and Supporting the Reunification of Korea, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee set a celebration period between Mar. 12 and April 15 and decided to give media publicity to the President's exploits and hold diverse political and cultural events. Rodong Sinmun

title: 40th Meeting of Union of Korean Students in Japan Held
body: The 40th meeting of the Union of Korean Students in Japan (UKSJ) was held at the hall of the Osaka Prefectural Headquarters under the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) on Mar. 9. Present at the meeting were Jo Il Yon, vice-chairman and director of the organization department of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, Ri Hong Yun, chairman of the UKSJ Central Standing Committee, and other deputies. Ri Hong Yun made a report. He said that the UKSJ has more thoroughly established the ideological system and leadership system of Juche within the union and pushed ahead with the five-point education with the main emphasis on the education in the greatness of the great leaders. Since its 39th meeting, the UKSJ has made big successes in its work including scientific research, talent training and expansion of the union, he said. He referred to the tasks of the UKSJ in making contributions to the overall prosperity of the movement of Koreans in Japan till 2022 when the 25th Congress of Chongryon is due to be held. Following the speeches at the meeting, the results of the "2018 movement for creating new history of the Union of Korean Students in Japan" were announced and citations were awarded to the excellent branches of the union. Ri Hong Yun was re-elected as chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the UKSJ. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Greetings to Lao Party Leader
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, sent a message of greeting to Bounnang Vorachith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party (LPRP), on Thursday. The message extended warm congratulations to the general secretary and, through him, to the Central Committee of the LPRP and all its members on the occasion of the 64th founding anniversary of the party. The message said that for 64 years after the foundation the LPRP has achieved great successes in the struggle for consolidating the people's democratic system against the aggression and interference of outsiders and achieving the independent development and prosperity of the country. The message wholeheartedly wished the general secretary good health and the LPRP big success in its activities for carrying out the decision of its 10th Congress, expressing the belief that the traditional friendly and cooperative relations between the two parties and two peoples would develop onto a higher level as required by the new times. Rodong Sinmun

title: Day of Sun to Be Marked by Koreans in China
body: A preparatory committee of the General Association of Koreans in China for significantly celebrating the 107th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, the Day of the Sun which is the greatest national holiday, was formed in Shenyang, China on Mar. 16. Choe Un Bok, chairwoman of the association, was elected chairwoman of the preparatory committee and officials above directors of the headquarters of the association and officials of its affiliated organisations were elected vice-chairperson and members of the committee. The preparatory committee decided to lay floral baskets before President Kim Il Sung's statue at Yuwen Middle School in Jilin and organize various events including meeting, photo and book exhibition and art performance in praise of his revolutionary career and exploits on the occasion of the Day of the Sun. The Liaoning, Zhongnan and Yanbian regional associations under the general association decided to hold various celebrations. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to President of Namibia
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the DPRK Supreme People's Assembly, on Thursday sent a message of greeting to Hage Geingob, president of Namibia, on the 29th anniversary of its independence. Expressing the belief that the long-standing relations of friendship and cooperation between the two countries would invariably develop in mutual interests, the message sincerely wished the president big success in his responsible work for socio-economic prosperity and progress. Rodong Sinmun

title: S. Korean Bodies Demand LKP Dissolution
body: Civic and social organizations held a meeting in Seoul on Mar. 16 in demand of the dissolution of the "Liberal Korea Party" (LKP), according to the south Korean online paper Jaju Sibo. The speakers said that the LKP has distorted the spirit of the May 18 Kwangju Popular Resistance and resorted to unpopular deeds, enraging the people. In particular, they denounced Ra Kyong Won, LKP floor leader, for saying that war drills should continue so as to consolidate the alliance with the U.S. Speakers condemned this as a reckless remark to aggravate the prevailing situation and perpetuate the division. They expressed their will to struggle to have the LKP dissolved and to uproot the deep-seated evils. Rodong Sinmun

title: Message of Sympathy to Mozambican President
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, on Thursday sent a message of sympathy to Filipe Jacinto Nwussi, president of the Republic of Mozambique, over big human and material losses caused by the Cyclone Idai that recently hit Mozambique. The message expressed deep sympathy and condolences to the president and, through him, to the victims and their bereaved families. It wished the government and people of Mozambique success in their efforts to eradicate the aftermath of the disaster at an early date and bring the life of the people in the affected area to normal. Rodong Sinmun

title: President Kim Il Sung's Birth Anniversary to Be Marked in Benin
body: A Beninese preparatory committee for marking the 107th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung was formed on Mar. 14. Hessou Kohovi, chairman of the Benin-Korea Amicable Association "Long Live Kim Jong Il, Supreme Leader", was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee decided to hold a seminar and other political and cultural events from Mar. 15 to Apr. 15. Rodong Sinmun

title: Day of Sun to Be Marked in Pakistan
body: A Pakistani preparatory committee for marking the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (Day of the Sun) was formed in Karachi on Mar. 17. Amar Jit, former senator of Pakistan, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. It set a celebration period between Mar. 17 and Apr. 15 and decided to hold colorful political and cultural events in praise of the revolutionary career and feats of the President. Rodong Sinmun

title: Message of Sympathy to President of Malawi
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, on Thursday sent a message of sympathy to Arthur Peter Mutharika, president of the Republic of Malawi, over big human and material losses caused by the Cyclone Idai that hit Malawi. The messaged expressed deep sympathy and condolences to the president and, through him, to the government and people. It sincerely hoped that the government and people of Malawi would eradicate the aftermath of the disaster at an early date. Rodong Sinmun

title: Message of Sympathy to Zimbabwean President
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on Mar. 21 sent a message of sympathy to Emmerson Dambudzo Mnangagwa, president of the Republic of Zimbabwe, over heavy human and material losses caused by the Cyclone Idai that recently hit Zimbabwe. The message expressed deep sympathy and condolences to the Zimbabwean president and, through him, to the victims and their bereaved families. The message hoped that the Zimbabwean government would eradicate the aftermath at an early date and bring the life of the people in the affected area to normal. Rodong Sinmun

title: Congratulations to Kazakh President
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on Mar. 21 sent a congratulatory message to Kassym-Jomart Tokayev who took office as president of the Republic of Kazakhstan. The message expressed the expectation and belief that the bilateral friendly and cooperative ties between the two countries would steadily develop in conformity with the desire and common interests of the two peoples, sincerely wishing the president great success in his responsible work. Rodong Sinmun

title: Hearty Assistance to the Builders of Samjiyon County
body: The officials, Party members and working people of Ryanggang Province warmly assist the builders of Samjiyon County in converting it into an earthly paradise of the people without a peer in the world. It gains in intensity as the construction of the county progresses at full swing in its second stage. The people’s committee, the rural economy committee and the trading bureau of the province as well as lots of its other organs and institutions present the builders with materials, tools, consumer goods and many others as a token of their sincerity so that they can finish building the county at an early date. They supplied large quantities of coating materials to the 1st Regiment of the Brigade of Ministries and National Organs of Division 216 in particular. They go ahead with it with a high sense of patriotism. Suit is followed by the cities and counties of the province to inspire the builders to further efforts immeasurably. Jon Chol Ju

title: Newly Built Power Station Early Operated in Kujang County
body: The officials and working people of Kujang County built a medium power station with a large generation capacity for themselves in less than three years and put it in early commission. The demand of the county for electricity has consequently become able to be met more satisfactorily than before and another power station built apace. In retrospect, a field headquarters was formed with competent officials and over 100 people were singled out from county institutions, factories and enterprises as shock workers to build the power station. The county roused its inhabitants into action and built a cofferdam in three days. They excavated and concreted the riverbed in slightly over 4 months to lay the foundation of a dam, thus making a breakthrough in the construction of the power station. The shock workers dug out earth without letup in the rigors of winter, thereby laying the foundation of a generator shop and building a waterproof channel in three months. They proceeded in high spirits to gear up the concreting of a major dam, coat its right bank with huge stones and build a roundabout way along it. Moreover, they erected dwellings for tens of families. The technicians and workers of the county made and installed an iron pipe conduit and sluice gates, and admirably assembled two generators. Song Chang Yun

title: Introduction of Hot-Temperature Air-Combusion Stabilization Technology Pushed Ahead with
body: Vigorous efforts are made in the field of electric Power industry to introduce the technology of high-temperature air combustion stabilization into boilers of thermal power plants extensively. The technology makes it possible to save a huge quantity of heavy oil, raise the efficiency of generators and reduce cost of power production. The Ministry of Electric Power Industry deeply analyzed the successes and experiences gained in applying the technology in the past as well as lessons from it. It has aimed at introducing the technology into thermal power plants across the country in an all-round way this year. The ministry mapped out a detailed plan to apply the technology. It strengthens its liaison with scientific research institutions. Its officials in charge of thermal power plants fully apply themselves to rousing their employees to action on the spot to solve scientific and technological problems and conquer bottlenecks in introduction. All the thermal power plants go all-out to apply the technology as soon as possible and put the power industry on a perfect Juche footing. The Pukchang Thermal Power Complex correctly planned how to make and install relevant mammoth equipment. It substantially introduces the technology into its boilers. The case is similar to the Chongchongang and Sunchon Thermal Power Plants and the Pyongyang Thermal Power Complex. Ri Ho Song

title: President Kim Il Sung's Birth Anniversary to Be Marked in India
body: An Indian preparatory committee for marking the 107th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung was formed on Mar. 15. Atul Kumar Anjan, chairman of the All India Indo-Korean Friendship Association who is secretary of the National Council of the Communist Party of India, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. It fixed a celebration period between Mar. 15 and Apr. 15 and decided to hold colorful political and cultural events in praise of the feats performed by the President for the Korean revolution and the global independence. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to Pakistani President
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on Saturday sent a message of greeting to Arif Alvi, president of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, on the occasion of the Day of Pakistan. The message expressed the belief that the bilateral friendly and cooperative ties would grow stronger in conformity with the requirement of the new era and the interests of the two peoples, wishing the president good health and greater success in his work for the prosperity of the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Ambassador to Belarus Appointed
body: According to a decree of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, Ju Jong Bong was appointed as DPRK ambassador to Belarus. Rodong Sinmun

title: Day of Sun to Be Marked in Romania
body: A Romanian national preparatory committee for marking the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (Day of the Sun) was formed on Mar. 15. Constantin Rotaru, chairman of the Socialist Party of Romania, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. It set a celebration period between Mar. 15 and Apr. 15 and decided to hold colorful political and cultural events in praise of the revolutionary career and feats of the President. Rodong Sinmun

title: Enlarged Edition Vol. 5 of "Complete Collection of Kim Il Sung's Works" Published
body: The Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House published enlarged edition Vol. 5 of "Complete Collection of Kim Il Sung's Works" - the library of the immortal Juche idea which has his works systematically, comprehensively and in chronological order. The complete collection has 124 works including speech, talk and report made by President Kim Il Sung from December Juche 34 (1945) to March Juche 35 (1946). The works deal with the outstanding ideas and theories and original lines and strategic and tactical policies of the President who indicated the path of building an independent and sovereign state by scientifically penetrating into the complicated political situation at home and abroad and the requirement of the developing revolution after Korea's liberation. The book also elucidates the theoretical and practical issues arising in building a new country, including the issue of developing the mass media in a sound way, the issue of making the writers and artistes participate in the literature and art activities positively, the issue of rapidly developing the educational work and the issue of forming the democratic national united front. Rodong Sinmun

title: Pakistani Embassy Hosts Reception
body: The Pakistani embassy here gave a reception at the Taedonggang Diplomatic Club on Saturday to mark the Day of Pakistan. Present at the reception on invitation were Kim Yong Jae, minister of External Economic Relations, Sin Hong Chol, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, officials concerned, foreign diplomatic envoys, representatives of international bodies, military attaches and foreign embassy members here. Syed Sajjad Haider, Pakistani charge d' affaires ad interim, and members of the Pakistani embassy were present. Speeches were made there. Rodong Sinmun

title: Arab Preparatory Committee Formed in Egypt
body: An Arab preparatory committee for marking the 107th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung was formed in Cairo, Egypt on Mar. 17. Yehia Zakaria Khairullah, co-chairman of the Arab Regional Committee for Friendship and Solidarity with the Korean People who is vice-chairman of the Socialist Freedom Party of Egypt, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. It fixed a celebration period from Mar. 17 to Apr. 16 and decided to hold a seminar, photo exhibition, film show and other political and cultural events. Rodong Sinmun

title: Day of Sun to Be Marked in Ethiopia
body: An Ethiopian preparatory committee for marking the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (Day of the Sun) was formed in Addis Ababa on Mar. 19. Nigatu Dagnachew, chairman of the Ethiopian National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. It set a celebration period between Mar. 21 and Apr. 18 and decided to hold political and cultural events in praise of the feats of the President for the global independence. Rodong Sinmun

title: Day of Sun to Be Marked in Nigeria
body: A Nigerian national preparatory committee for marking the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (Day of the Sun) was formed in Abuja on Mar. 18. Ibrahim Mantu, chairman of the Nigeria-Korea Friendship Association who is member of the Credit Committee of the People's Democratic Party of Nigeria, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. It decided to give publicity to the President's revolutionary career and feats and the achievements made by the Korean people in socialist construction under the guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and to hold colorful political and cultural events on the occasion of the 107th birth anniversary of the President. Rodong Sinmun

title: New Technology Introduced
body: The Phyongsong Branch of the Pyongyang Automation Appliances Factory devised an inverter to afford a technological guarantee for using natural energy more effectively than ever. Installed in many units on trial, the inverters do themselves justice in performance to gain public favor. They are much lower in production cost than imports but far higher in performance than them. The branch is now gearing up the production of the inverters dynamically. Myong Chun Gil

title: Message of Sympathy to Leaders of China
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, and Pak Pong Ju, premier of the DPRK Cabinet, on March 22 sent a message of sympathy to Li Keqiang, premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, and Li Zhanshu, chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress of the PRC, over many casualties caused by an explosion at a chemical factory in Jiangsu Province, China. Expressing deep sympathy to the government and people of the PRC, the message sincerely hoped that the aftermath of the accident will be eradicated at an early date and the people's life in the afflicted area brought to normal under the guidance of the Communist Party and government of China with Xi Jinping as the core. Rodong Sinmun

title: World Tuberculosis Day Marked
body: An event to mark the World Tuberculosis Day took place at the People's Palace of Culture on Monday. Attending it were healthcare workers, relevant officials, the WHO representative and members of missions of other international bodies here. Speeches were made at the event. Speakers informed the participants of the subject of the event and underscored the importance of the positive cooperation between medical institutions and relevant units aimed at stamping out TB. They also emphasized that efforts should be made to direct public heed to the importance and significance of TB treatment, and called for strengthening the prevention and cure of TB. The achievements made in the treatment of TB-related diseases were introduced and future program was made public. There was a quiz on the TB prevention. Then the participants enjoyed a performance given by the hygienic information team of students. On the same day, there took place intensive hygienic information activities in all provinces on the occasion. Rodong Sinmun
