title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Guides 5th Meeting of Company Leaders and Political Instructors of KPA
body: The 5th meeting of company leaders and political instructors of the Korean People's Army (KPA) took place here on March 25 and 26. The meeting analyzed and reviewed successes and experience gained in the course of embodying the spirit of the 4th meeting of company leaders and political instructors of the KPA and discussed tasks and ways for further enhancing the responsibility and role of company leaders and political instructors as required by the work for modeling the entire army on Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism. Attending the meeting were company leaders and political instructors, commanding and political officers of units at all levels and military schools who have devoted themselves to turning their companies into elite militant ranks and true homes of soldiers. Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the Korean People's Army, appeared in the platform to guide the meeting. Seen in the platform were leading officials of the armed forces organs including Ri Myong Su, Kim Su Gil, Ri Yong Gil and No Kwang Chol, KPA commanding officers, exemplary company leaders and political instructors. Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un made an opening address. He said that over the past five years, measures were taken and deep guidance provided to thoroughly apply the main idea of the 4th meeting of company leaders and political instructors of the KPA to the army-building and military affairs and thus signal successes were made in strengthening all the companies and a springboard for developing the people's army into an invincible elite army was laid. Saying with pleasure that sitting together with company leaders and political instructors, he seems to meet all the beloved soldiers whom he always missed even during his visit to foreign countries, he expressed deep respect for all the company leaders and political instructors of the army who are devoting themselves to increasing military capabilities while undergoing hardships and worrying a lot about their soldiers. Expressing the belief that the meeting would serve as a significant occasion to provide a new landmark for strengthening companies by thoroughly embodying the Party's idea and policy of attaching importance to companies as required by the developing revolution, he declared the meeting open. Army General Kim Su Gil, director of the General Political Bureau of the KPA, made a report. He said in his report that the period after the fourth meeting of company leaders and political instructors of the KPA were the days of honor when they keenly felt the wise guidance of the Supreme Leader and those of pride when all the companies have developed into matchless combat ranks which formed a harmonious whole with him. The reporter referred to the tasks for increasing the combat capabilities of companies, the cells and main combat units of the KPA, in every way. He called for smartly kindling the fresh flames of strengthening the companies and further consolidating the invincible might of the heroic KPA under the ever-victorious guidance of the Supreme Leader. Speeches were made at the meeting. Speeches made at the first-day and second-day meetings referred to the achievements and experience gained during the past five years in the work for training soldiers to be one-match-for-a-hundred stalwart fighters and making companies true home of soldiers by firmly keeping the building of politico-ideologically strong army and morally strong army as two mainstays. Speeches were also made on the issue of drawing lessons from the faults made by some company leaders and company political instructors, who failed to take good care of soldiers' living and conduct substantial training, and the ways of thoroughly rectifying them. Listening carefully to those commanding officers who made good speeches about achievements and experience gained in the work for strengthening the companies, the Supreme Leader encouraged them and highly appreciated their distinguished deeds and dedicated efforts. Pointing out one by one the achievements, experience, lessons and deviations mentioned in the speeches, he earnestly called on all the participants in the meeting to actively learn from the excellent achievements made by those units which are taking the lead. A decree of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK on conferring the title of Labor Hero on exemplary company leaders and political instructors was read out by Kim Su Gil. Kim Jong Un conferred the certificates and Gold Medal (Hammer and Sickle), Order of National Flag First Class on KPA officers Nam Chol Man, Choe Song Min, Choe Un Hui, Pak Hong Gwan and Ri Man Bok, who made great contributions to strengthening companies, and had a photo taken with them on the platform. He made a speech. Saying that he was very pleased to see again through the meeting the real picture of good men among company commanding officers of the entire army, he highly appreciated their devotion to the Party and the revolution. Underlining the need for the participants to be well aware of the Party's intention of organizing the meeting, deeply study and actively generalize good experience and thus make sure that substantial surge is brought about in strengthening the companies, he set forth militant tasks for company leaders and political instructors of the entire army. He also set forth in detail the tasks of steadily deepening the essential five-point education, vigorously conducting the education in the revolutionary tradition, positively putting forward the examples to make soldiers adorn every moment of their military service with loyalty and feats, etc. for developing the revolutionary armed forces into an ideologically-prepared elite force. Noting that the Korean revolution would make a vigorous advance forever, he ardently called for dynamically fighting for the victory of the Korean sacred revolution. A written oath to Kim Jong Un was adopted at the meeting. Kim Jong Un made a closing speech. He said that all the company leaders and political instructors of the KPA sat together to analyze and review successes, experience and lessons gained in the struggle for strengthening the companies and discuss practical measures, and expressed great satisfaction over the successful meeting held amid their elated political enthusiasm. He again underlined the need for the participants to fulfill their honorable mission and duty in the struggle for strengthening the companies into elite combat ranks devotedly defending the Party Central Committee and making the companies true homes of soldiers, always keeping in mind that the decisive guarantee for rounding off combat preparedness lies in strengthening the companies. Expressing the belief and expectation that the participants in the meeting would devote their all to strengthening the companies as intended by the Party, he declared the closing of the meeting. Political News Team

title: Spring National Footwear Exhibition Closes
body: The 2019 Spring National Footwear Exhibition closed with due ceremony at the Pyongyang Yokjon Department Store on Tuesday. On display at the exhibition were footwear produced by over 60 units across the country, drawing tens of thousands of visitors every day. Visitors were very satisfied to see home-made footwear with the trademarks of "Maebongsan", "Samcholli", "Nalgae" and "Cholli" which are diverse, various, varicolored and light. Footwear made by the Ryuwon Footwear Factory, Pyongyang Leather Shoes Factory, Wonsan Leather Shoes Factory, Sinuiju Footwear Factory, Anju Footwear Factory, Sochon Haedong Factory, Rason Samryong Footwear Factory, etc. were well received. At the presentation of sci-tech successes, the establishment of the power production system based on anthracite gasification was highly appreciated for making it possible to put the footwear production on a normal basis while making much profit. Rodong Sinmun

title: Scientific Research Prize Awarded to Excellent University Students
body: University student scientific research prize was awarded to students, who distinguished themselves in study and scientific researches, with due ceremony at the hall of the youth league on Tuesday. The students across the country are making valuable inventions and contriving new technical innovations while conducting the campaign of brains and technology in major sectors of the socialist economic construction. Present at the ceremony were Pak Chol Min, chairman of the Central Committee of the youth league, officials of the youth league and students. Certificates and medals went to the students including those from Kim Il Sung University and Kim Chaek University of Technology. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to Bangladeshi President
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, on Tuesday sent a message of greeting to MD. Abdul Hamid, president of Bangladesh, on its independence day. The message wished the president success in his work for the prosperity of the country, expressing the belief that the friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries would grow stronger as required by the new era. title: New Novel "Korean Youth" Published
body: The April 15 Literary Production Company brought out a new novel "Korean Youth" (author: Kim Jong), a part of the cycle of novels "Immortal History." The novel tells about the exploits President Kim Il Sung performed by setting forth the line of forming the Democratic Youth League and wisely leading the struggle for it to rally young people around a mass youth organization soon after the country's liberation from the Japanese colonial rule. Rodong Sinmun

body: A delegation of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) led by Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the WPK Central Committee, left here on Tuesday to visit the Lao People's Democratic Republic. Rodong Sinmun

title: World Water Day Observed in DPRK
body: A workshop took place at the Grand People's Study House here on Wednesday to observe World Water Day 2019. Present there were officials of relevant units including the State Commission of Science and Technology, the Ministry of Urban Management and the Ministry of Land and Environment Protection and members of missions of international bodies here including UNICEF. Speeches were made there. Speakers referred to the fact that many people in the world are suffering from big damage inflicted by polluted water and impure hygienic conditions. Saying that it is one of the important works for ensuring the existence of mankind and the socio-economic development to solve the serious water problem, they stressed the need to take positive measures for securing and making an effective use of water source and protecting the natural ecological environment. Speeches were made under the titles "World Water Crisis and Its Solutions", "Some Measures for the Supply of Clean Drinking Water" and "Introduction to the WASH Activities of UNICEF in DPRK". Rodong Sinmun

title: Spokesperson for DPRK Foreign Ministry on Golan Heights in Syria
body: A spokesperson for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea gave the following answer to a question put by KCNA on March 27 as regards the issue of the Golan Heights in Syria: It is a global recognition that the Golan Heights is an inalienable sacred territory of Syria, and the relevant resolutions were also adopted at the United Nations Security Council and the United Nations General Assembly. The denial of Syria's dominion over the Golan Heights is an infringement upon the sovereignty of Syria, and this could lead to further aggravating the unstable regional situation. We extend full support and solidarity to the struggle of the Syrian government and people for taking back the occupied Golan Heights, safeguarding the country's sovereignty and achieving territorial integrity. Rodong Sinmun

title: Reckless Act of Japan Adding Crimes to Its Past Crimes
body: Japan is busy renewing its own sanctions on the DPRK. It is a pitiable effort of those sidelined in the trend of regional situation. Japan tries to camouflage its deplorable position of getting showed out of the trend of the situation in the Korean peninsula and the region and throw its weight around at any cost. Such disgraceful behavior only drives Japan into a more piteous plight. The Japanese reactionaries seek to find any comfort or mental consolation in their contradictory deeds, but it is a mere foolish idea to be cherished only by them who are ignorant politically and dull in the sense of the times. Japan should know that its despicable anti-DPRK moves will only harden the determination of the Korean people to settle an account with it. Japan had better make an apology and reparation for its hideous past crimes against the Korean people, not resorting to futile sanctions. Ri Hyo Jin

title: Special Dishes for the Third Day of the Third Lunar Month
body: In olden times Koreans had a picnic and enjoyed the following on the third day of the third lunar month out in the fields every year. Ground rice was kneaded into pancakes. They then were stuffed with petals of azalea blossoms for them to be good to the eye and give a feel of spring. They were finally fried in an iron pot. Tasting good and smelling fragrant they were by no means inferior to anything when it came to ceremonial occasions and banquet tables. Meantime, azalea blossoms were put in ground mung beans which were kneaded into thin flat dough. It was chopped in long narrow strips and cooked in the boiling water flavored with soy sauce. It was put into juice from the fruit of Schizanadra chinensis or honeyed water to be served. The dishes, too, were indispensable to spring picnickers on the third day of the third lunar month. Ground mung beans were kneaded into pancakes for frying purposes. Well-done, they were chopped in long narrow strips, spread with honey and stuffed with pine nuts. They, too, went together on the day. O Mun Il

title: 250,000 Tons of Earth Blown Up
body: The North Phyongan Provincial General Tideland Reclamation Enterprise steadily reclaims the tideland off the Honggon Island in its second stage. The complex has almost finished covering the outside of the first dike with huge stones and built the second primary dike by more than 50%. Moreover, it has successfully blown up 250,000 tons of earth and rocks on March 25 and made a breakthrough in acceleratedly reclaiming the tideland in its second stage. The labor and management of the enterprise go ahead with their work without resting contented with their successes. Song Chang Yun

title: Young Red Cross Volunteers Plant Trees
body: Young Red Cross volunteers of Unsan County, South Phyongan Province planted trees in the area of the township on Thursday on the occasion of the spring period of the general mobilization for land administration. They planted pine trees in the area. They also gave an art performance there. The spring tree-planting campaign by young Red Cross volunteers will continue across the country till April. Rodong Sinmun

title: General Meeting of DPRK Olympic Committee Held
body: The Juche 108 (2019) general meeting of the DPRK Olympic Committee took place at the People's Palace of Culture on Thursday. Attending the meeting were Vice-Premier Jon Kwang Ho, members of the committee and officials in the sports field. The meeting reviewed the work of the committee for Juche 107 (2018) and discussed the orientation of its work for Juche 108 (2019). Kim Il Guk, minister of Physical Culture and Sports who is chairman of the committee, made a report followed by speeches. The reporter and speakers said that last year witnessed successes at international games, meaningful mass sports events stimulating enthusiasm for sports across the country and more positive cooperation with the international sports bodies. They called upon players and coaches to continue creating Korean-style tactics and game methods in order to see the flag of the DPRK raised at more international games. The meeting discussed practical issues arising in developing professional sports technique of the country and effecting a turn in the field of sports science researches this year. Rodong Sinmun

title: Foreign Guests Visit Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: A delegation of the Syria Baath Children Organization led by Chairman Muhamad Ezat Arabi Katbi and foreign guests visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on Thursday. They paid tribute to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. They also paid homage to the great leaders in the halls where they lie in state. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Published in Russia
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "The Great Comrade Kim Il Sung Is the Eternal Leader of Our Party and Our People" was brought out in booklet by the Forum Book Publishing House of Russia to mark the Day of the Sun. The work, published on April 20, Juche 101 (2012), deals with the revolutionary exploits performed by President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in their lifetime. It also indicates the tasks for staunchly defending and adding eternal luster to the ideology and feats of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il. A book-releasing ceremony took place on March 22. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Praised by Swiss Organizations
body: The Swiss Preparatory Committee for Celebrating the 107th Birth Anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, the Swiss Organizing Committee for the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu, the Switzerland-Korea Committee and the Swiss Group for the Study of the Juche Idea made public a joint statement on March 21, the 45th anniversary of the abolishment of the tax system in the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. The statement said: The Law on Abolishing the Tax System was promulgated at the 3rd Session of the 5th Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK on March 21, 1974. This is the expression of the love of President Kim Il Sung for the people, who regarded it as his lifetime motto to believe in the people as in Heaven. The complete abolishment of the tax system in socialist Korea was supported and admired by the progressive people. The people in capitalist countries who have been distressed by tax would never think of such a wonderful policy. The complete abolishment of the tax system served as an event clearly proving that the DPRK is, indeed, the genuine country of the people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Improving Life Environment In Conformity with Requirement of Times
body: Pyongyang strives energetically to change its appearance to meet the demand of the times for culture. Parks and streets like Ryomyong Street and Mirae Scientists Street are now being tidied up in Pyongyang. Its districts and counties are clearly rid of the traces of wintering and renovated further so that they can look characteristic of socialism. In Pyongyang Central and Phyongchon Districts repaired buildings and roads and painted fences in a short time. Factories and enterprises, too, are trimmed in a hygienic and cultural way in Pyongyang. True to the lofty intention of the Party to convert it into a park thick with trees and pranked with flowers of every kind its horticultural stations fantastically decorate its streets with beautiful flowers. The citizens of Pyongyang are very zealous to develop it into a fairyland. O Mun Il

title: National Agricultural Workers' Basketball Contest Held
body: The 13th national agricultural workers' basketball contest was held in Pyongyang on Mar. 26-29. The contest was held at the Basketball Gymnasium in Chongchun Street and other places. Men and women players of 21 units selected from Pyongyang City and every province played group league matches before knock-out games. title: 70th Anniversary of Conclusion of DPRK-Russia Agreement Marked in Russia
body: A Korean book, photo, stamp and handicraft exhibition and film show took place at the Diplomatic Academy under the Russian Foreign Ministry on March 21 to mark the 70th anniversary of the conclusion of the agreement on economic and cultural cooperation between the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Russian Federation. Displayed at the exhibition venue were works of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, books, photos and stamps introducing the DPRK and handicrafts showing the creative wisdom and talents of the Korean people. title: Russian National Seminar on Juche Idea Held
body: A Russian national seminar on the Juche idea "Patriotism and Self-Reliance" took place in Sankt-Peterburg on March 20 on the occasion of the 107th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Seen in the venue of the seminar were photos dealing with the revolutionary exploits of the peerlessly great men. On display there were works of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and books and photos introducing the successes made by the Korean people in socialist construction. The general secretary of the International Alliance of Societies for the Study of the Juche Idea and Songun Policy in East European and Central Asian Regions said in his keynote report that Kim Il Sung, who waged an arduous anti-Japanese armed struggle to liberate Korea, is the peerlessly great man who made a great contribution to accomplishing the cause of global independence. He said that Kim Jong Un formulated the patriotic idea and exploits of Kim Jong Il as Kim Jong Il's patriotism. Speakers including the chairwoman of the Kim Jong Suk Women's Union of Russia and the chairman of the Russian Association for the Study of the Juche Idea noted that Kim Il Sung turned the DPRK into a socialist country independent in politics, self-supporting in economy and self-reliant in national defense in a brief span of time. They lauded Kim Jong Il for his Songun leadership exploits and stressed that he is always alive in the hearts of the Korean people as the brilliant model of genuine patriotism. They said that the DPRK under the tested guidance of Kim Jong Un is firmly adhering to its own development principle provided by the preceding leaders and fully demonstrating the might of self-reliance. A letter to Kim Jong Un was adopted at the seminar. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Letter from Participants in
body: Russian Seminar on Juche Idea Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a letter from the participants in the Russian national seminar on the Juche idea "Patriotism and Self-Reliance" on March 20. The letter said that the seminar helped the participants know better about the exploits of President Kim Il Sung, who founded the Juche idea and led the Korean revolution to the victory by applying it to the revolution and construction. It noted that they deeply grasped the undying feats of Chairman Kim Jong Il who formulated the Juche idea, the revolutionary idea of the leader, as Kimilsungism and defended the people-centered socialism in the harshest period when socialism collapsed in East European countries. It lauded Kim Jong Un for formulating the Juche idea founded by Kim Il Sung and developed and enriched by Kim Jong Il as Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism and thus glorified it as the eternal guiding idea in the era of independence. It stressed that the world admires Kim Jong Un for leading the DPRK with his outstanding political stratagem to further demonstrate its might as an invincible power by dint of patriotism and self-reliance in the face of the imperialists' moves to stifle the country. It said that all the participants in the seminar have keenly felt the great vitality of Kim Jong Il's patriotism and self-reliance again and would fully support the Korean people in their struggle for defending the country's sovereignty and socialist system together with the followers of the Juche idea across the world. Rodong Sinmun

title: Typical Spring Dishes
body: Thangphyongchae belongs to delicious spring dishes in Korea. It is composed of mung-bean jellies chopped in strips, pork, parsley, laver, etc and seasoned with a mixture of vinegar, sesame, pine-nut meal and so forth. Suran is an appetizing poached egg dish. Eggs are put in simmering water and half-done. It is served, spiced with a blend of vinegar, sesame, pine-nut meal, etc. In addition, sanjaddok is also a special traditional March dish. Conical cakes are made of ground rice and stuffed with red-bean jam. They are classified into five divisions, each of which is tinted in different color. Five conical cakes of separate colors are spitted together. Kim Chong Il

title: Effective Use of Greenhouse
body: Kanggye University of Physical Education directs its great efforts to the production of vegetables in its greenhouse. Since the greenhouse covers a limited area of land the KUPE has selected the right varieties of vegetables, determined the right time for sowing them and grown them along scientific lines in an attempt to maximize their output. The result was that it attained successes in its vegetable production last year. This year, too, the KUPE makes great efforts to produce vegetables of various varieties in plenty and enable its teachers and students to profit from the greenhouse a good deal. O Mun Il

title: Ri Su Yong Meets Lao PM
body: Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) who is on a visit to the Lao People's Democratic Republic as head of a delegation of the WPK, met and had a talk with Thongloun Sisoulith, prime minister of the LPDR, on Mar. 29. The Lao prime minister wished Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un good health and bigger successes in his noble work for leading the struggle of the Korean people to defend the sovereignty of the country and achieve its prosperity. He stressed he would as ever give full support to the just cause of the party and people of the DPRK in regional and international arenas, noting that the recent successes in ensuring peace and stability of the Korean peninsula were entirely attributable to the seasoned and energetic external activities of Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Day of Sun to Be Marked in Russia
body: A preparatory committee for celebrating President Kim Il Sung's birth anniversary, the Day of the Sun, was formed by the Communist Party "Russian Communists" on Mar. 22. M. A. Suraikin, chairman of the C.C. of the party, was elected as chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee decided to give publicity to the President's revolutionary career and exploits through media and hold political and cultural events including seminar on the occasion of his 107th birth anniversary. Rodong Sinmun

title: Talks Held between WPK and LPRP
body: Talks were held between Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) who is on a visit to the Lao People's Democratic Republic as head of a delegation of the WPK, and Lao Vice-President Phankham Viphavanh, member of the Political Bureau and permanent secretary of the Secretariat of the C.C., the Lao People's Revolutionary Party (LPRP), on Mar. 28. At the talks, both sides informed each other of the activities of their parties and exchanged opinions on boosting the relations between the two parties. Present at the talks from the DPRK side were members of the WPK delegation and the DPRK ambassador to Laos and from the Laos side the chairman of the Committee for External Affairs of the LPRP who is member of the C.C., LPRP and other officials concerned. At the end of the talks, an agreement on exchange and cooperation between the two parties was signed. That day, the WPK delegation was invited to the welcome reception given by the C.C., LPRP. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League Leaves for Cuba, Venezuela
body: A delegation of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League headed by Kim Song Il, vice-chairman of the C.C. of the league, left here on Mar. 30 to visit Cuba and attend the meeting of the General Council of the World Federation of Democratic Youth due in Venezuela. Rodong Sinmun

title: Day of Sun to Be Marked in Hungary
body: A Hungarian preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (Day of the Sun) was formed in Budapest on March 26. Gyula Thurmer, chairman of the Hungarian Workers' Party, was elected as chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee decided to give wide publicity to the revolutionary careers and exploits of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and the successes registered by the Korean people in building a powerful socialist country under the guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un through media and hold colorful political and cultural events on the occasion of the Day of the Sun. Rodong Sinmun

title: Day of Sun to Be Marked in Mongolia
body: A preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, the Day of the Sun, was formed in Mongolia on Mar. 21. J. Lomvo, chairman of the Mongolian Mt. Paektu Association for Independent Development, was elected as chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee decided to hold such colorful political and cultural events as seminar and film show to mark the Day of the Sun. Rodong Sinmun

title: President Kim Il Sung's Work Published in Russia
body: The Radio Soft Publishing House of Russia brought out in booklet President Kim Il Sung's work "Enhancing the Role of the Popular Masses Is the Guarantee for Victory in the Cause of Independence". The work, published on April 15, Juche 81 (1992), says that the President's life spanning 80 years is the one of struggle in which he devoted himself to the people as their son. It also clarifies that the Workers' Party of Korea has firmly maintained the Juche-based stand and principle, always regarding the Juche idea as its guideline in the whole course of the revolution and construction and that the common task facing the Korean people and the world people is to build an independent new world. A book-releasing ceremony took place on Mar. 21. Rodong Sinmun

title: Ri Su Yong Meets General Secretary of C.C., LPRP
body: Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) who is on a visit to the Lao People's Democratic Republic as head of a delegation of the WPK, met and had a talk with Bounnang Vorachith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party (LPRP), on March 28. Ri Su Yong referred to the stand of the WPK to further develop the friendly and cooperative relations between the DPRK and Laos provided by the preceding leaders of the two countries as required by the new times. Bounnang Vorachith expressed full support for the efforts made by the WPK and the government of the DPRK for the building of a powerful socialist country and peace and security in the Korean peninsula and the rest of the world, saying that the relations between the two parties and two countries are the comradely ties with a long history and tradition. Present there were members of the WPK delegation, the DPRK ambassador to Laos, the chairman of the Committee for External Affairs of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party who is a member of the C.C., LPRP, and officials concerned. Rodong Sinmun

title: Gift to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Lao President
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was presented with a gift by Bounnang Vorachith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party (LPRP) and president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic. The gift was handed over to Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) who is on a visit to Laos as head of a delegation of the WPK, by Lao Vice-President Phankham Viphavanh, member of the Political Bureau and permanent secretary of the Secretariat of the C.C., the LPRP, on March 28. Rodong Sinmun

title: Editorial
body: Let Us Accelerate Construction of Samjiyon County Upholding Party’s Intention Sprucing up Samjiyon County is a noble work to uphold Chairman Kim Jong Il as the sun of Juche for all ages. It is the fixed will of the Workers’ Party of Korea to spruce up Samjiyon County, housing the native home of Chairman Kim Jong Il and glorify his revolutionary history and exploits for long. The victory in the reconstruction of Samjiyon County will be a demonstration of the might of the country and its economic potential. It is a very huge project covering all fields of politics, economy and culture. The acceleration of the reconstruction of Samjiyon County will steadily provide new models and it will further expedite the advance speed of the Korean revolution. We should give further spurs to the Samjiyon County project as planned by the party and thus make the hurrah for the Workers’ Party and socialism reverberate far and wide from the land of Mt Paektu.

title: Sixth April Spring People's Art Festival Is to Open
body: The 6th April Spring People's Art Festival is due to be held in Pyongyang on the occasion of the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. The festival is an all-people art festival provided by Chairman Kim Jong Il in reflection of the desire of the Korean people to hold Kim Il Sung in high esteem as the sun of Juche. The festival will bring together members of art troupes and squads and itinerant art groups and members of art groups in Pyongyang and provinces. It will take place at theatres and cultural houses in Pyongyang from April 10 to 17, divided into categories of art troupe, art squad, itinerant art group and art group. The art festival will also include a magic festival. Rodong Sinmun

title: Day of Sun to Be Marked in Guinea
body: A Guinean preparatory committee for celebrating President Kim Il Sung's birth anniversary, the Day of the Sun, was formed in Conakry on Mar. 20. Riyad Chaloub, chairman of the Guinean National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, was elected as chairman of the preparatory committee at its inaugural meeting. The meeting discussed the action program of the preparatory committee to set a celebration period between Mar. 20 and Apr. 20 and organize such diverse political and cultural events as Kimilsungia exhibition during the period. Rodong Sinmun

title: Day of Sun to Be Marked in Russia
body: A preparatory committee for celebrating President Kim Il Sung's birth anniversary, the Day of the Sun, was formed by the Amur Regional Branch Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation on Mar. 23. L. A. Kobuizov, first secretary of the Amur Regional Branch Committee, was elected as chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee decided to give publicity to the revolutionary career and undying exploits of President Kim Il Sung, the great personality of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and the successes made by the Korean people in socialist construction through media and organize diverse political and cultural events like seminar between Mar. 23 and Apr. 25. Rodong Sinmun

title: President Kim Il Sung's 107th Birth Anniversary to Be Marked in Brazil
body: A Brazilian preparatory committee for celebrating the 107th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung was formed on Mar. 25. Rosanita Campos, vice-president of the Party for Free Motherland of Brazil, was elected as chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee set a celebration period between Mar. 26 and Apr. 20 and decided to organize colorful political and cultural events in praise of Kim Il Sung's revolutionary career and exploits during the period. Rodong Sinmun

title: Russian Minister of Interior Here
body: Vladimir Kolokoltev, minister of Interior of the Russian Federation, and his party arrived here on Monday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Pyongyangites Bid Farewell to Participants in 5th Meeting of Company Leaders and Political Instructors
body: The participants in the 5th meeting of company leaders and political instructors of the Korean People's Army (KPA) left for the defense line posts of the country, being warmly congratulated by Pyongyangites. Officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and officers of the armed forces organs gave a send-off to them at April 25 Hotel, Pyongyang Railway Station, etc. Vehicles carrying the company commanding officers passed the streets of Pyongyang amid the warm send-off by citizens. In Taehak Street, Tongdaewon Street, Chongnyon Street, Sungri Street, Pipha Street, Hasin Street and other parts of the capital city, officials of the ministries and national institutions, employees of industrial establishments, and teachers and students of universities sent warm congratulations and militant encouragement to the participants. Rodong Sinmun

title: New School Year Begins in DPRK
body: A new school year for Juche 108(2019) began with due ceremony across the country amid the interests of all the parents of students and working people. At the ceremonies held across the country, officials of the party and power organs, teaching staff, students and parents congratulated new students and pupils on their entrance into universities and schools. Speeches were made at the ceremonies. At the end of the ceremonies, the first lesson of the new school year began. Rodong Sinmun

title: Nepalese Politicians Here
body: A delegation of the Provincial Committee of the Nepal Communist Party headed by Malla Tilak Bahadur, member of the Karnali Provincial Committee, arrived here on Monday. Rodong Sinmun

title: WPK Delegation Back Home
body: The delegation of the Workers' Party of Korea headed by Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the WPK, returned home on Monday after visiting the Lao People's Democratic Republic. Rodong Sinmun

title: Mangyongdae Prize Sports Games Open
body: The Mangyongdae Prize Sports Games opened with due ceremony at the Basketball Gymnasium in Chongchun Street on April 1 to celebrate the Day of the Sun, the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. During the sports games, competitions in 460-odd categories of 37 events, including football, basketball, volleyball, weightlifting and judo, will take place in Pyongyang, Phyongsong and Wonsan cities, Kwaksan County, etc. Rodong Sinmun

title: New School Year Begins at Korean Rehabilitation Centre for Children with Disability
body: A new school year began at the Korean Rehabilitation Centre for Children with Disability with due ceremony on Monday. Present at the ceremony were officials of the C.C., the Korean Federation for the Protection of the Disabled and children, nurses, teachers and doctors of the centre and parents of the children. The attendees laid a floral basket and made a bow before an art work depicting President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. The director of the center made an address to be followed by speeches. Then the attendees looked round the rooms for physical therapy and work therapy and other places of the centre. Rodong Sinmun

title: Day of Sun to Be Marked in Ecuador

Milton Burbano Bohorquez, chairman of the Ecuadorian Cultural Institute for the Study of the Juche Idea, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. It decided to hold colorful political and cultural events in the capital and other parts of the country to mark the Day of the Sun. Rodong Sinmun

title: Day of Sun to Be Marked in Germany
body: A preparatory committee for celebrating President Kim Il Sung's birth anniversary, the Day of the Sun, was formed by the German Group for the Study of Korean Culture on Mar. 24. Manfred Schneider, chief of the group, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The preparatory committee decided to give wide publicity to the immortal exploits of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and the DPRK's proud reality through media and organize such political and cultural events as photo show and film show in the run-up to the Day of the Sun. Rodong Sinmun

title: To Stamp Out Noxious Insects Effectively
body: The scientists of the Institute for the Science of Botanical Protection attain good successes in their researches into exterminating by new methods insects of various kinds which damage the crops. Working hard with ingenuity the nematologists of the institute established the new seed examination method of exterminating most nematodes in rice seeds and developed an effective seed disinfectant. This year, too, they do their level best to mass-produce seed disinfectants efficacious against nematodes in rice for many cooperative farms throughout the country. The observers and predictors of the institute make it a rule to observe the fields beforehand and give scientific information on the breeding of noxious insects. They fully apply themselves to enabling cooperative farms to take real-time precautions against harmful insects in practice. The entomologists of the institute produced breeding Trichogramma ostriniae and Trichogramma japonica to kill corn borers and Asiatic rice borers, and supplied them to many botanical prevention centers across the country, thus enabling them to be mass-produced and set free into tens of thousands of hectares of rice paddies and dry fields. Those engaged in the different sections of the institute work with might and main to develop and produce the agrochemicals good at extirpating the lush weeds of the regions stretching along the West Sea of Korea and eradicating many diseases of fruit trees. O Mun Il

title: Tribute Paid to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Home-visiting groups of students of Korean University under the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on Tuesday. The members of the groups laid bouquets at the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il and paid tribute to them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Talks Held between DPRK Minister of People's Security and Russian Minister of Interior
body: Talks were held between Choe Pu Il, minister of People's Security of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, and Vladimir Kolokoltev, minister of Interior of the Russian Federation, at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Tuesday. At the talks, both sides exchanged views on the issue of developing the friendly relations between the ministries of the two countries and on the issues of mutual concern. That day, the Ministry of People's Security gave a reception in honor of the minister of Interior of the Russian Federation and his party. Rodong Sinmun

title: Pak Pong Ju Inspects Co-op Farms in Ongjin County
body: Premier Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected co-op farms in Ongjin County of South Hwanghae Province. At the Jangsong and Raengjong Co-op Farms, he stressed the need to fundamentally improve the work style and manner of officials and attain the goal of grain production for this year without fail by raising the rate of mechanization in the farm work. The field consultative meetings discussed issues of widely introducing the advanced farming methods and technologies suited to the climatic conditions of relevant areas, accurately enforcing a field-responsibility-system within the framework of the subworkteam management system to enhance the zeal of farmers for production and accelerating the repair and readjustment of pumping equipment for smooth farming. The premier also inspected the Pyongyang Thermal Power Complex and the Pyongyang Tannery. Rodong Sinmun

title: Kim Yong Nam Meets Russian Minister of Interior
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on Tuesday met and had a talk with Vladimir Kolokoltev, minister of Interior of the Russian Federation, and his party who paid a courtesy call on him at the Mansudae Assembly Hall. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Gift from Russian Minister of Interior
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a gift from the Russian minister of Interior. The gift was conveyed to Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, by Vladimir Kolokoltev, minister of Interior of the Russian Federation who is on a visit to the DPRK, on Tuesday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Russian Minister of Interior Visits Statues of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Vladimir Kolokoltev, minister of Interior of the Russian Federation, and his party visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on Tuesday.
