title: Day of Sun to Be Marked in Kyrgyzstan
body: A preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (Day of the Sun) was formed in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan on Mar. 27. A. Usupbayev, chief of the Group for the Study of the Juche Idea who is chairman of the Central Council of the People Unity-"Kyrgyz El" Republican Political Party of Kyrgyzstan, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The preparatory committee decided to hold colorful political and cultural events on the occasion of the Day of the Sun. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Inspects Samjiyon County
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the Korean People's Army, gave field guidance to Samjiyon County. Supreme Leader of the Party, state and army Kim Jong Un walked round the township of Samjiyon County under construction to learn about how the construction is now underway. The builders have made much progress in the project despite the cold weather in winter in the northern part of the country, he said, adding that the appearance of the township has changed so much in several months. He said in full conviction that if the construction is vigorously pushed forward at the current speed, the project could be finished by the appointed time as scheduled by the Party and that its prospect is clearly looking up. He underlined the need to accurately set the monthly targets for each process and wage a dynamic struggle for completing the second-stage construction projects as planned without fail by inspiring all the builders, calling for responsible direction and supervision of the construction. He visited the family of triplet sisters Jang Un Hye, Jang Chung Sil and Jang Po Dap who moved to a new house built in the township. Being told about the fact that the triplet sisters left their native Pyongyang for Mt Paektu area to participate in the construction of Paektusan Hero Youth Power Station and settled down in Samjiyon County with a pure determination to spruce up Chairman Kim Jong Il's native county, he said that they are admirable, and praised their deed as excellent virtue and model of the young people produced by the times. Asking them to write a letter to him when they marry good men, he highly appreciated them for making an excellent decision to live a worthy life in their youthful days and gave them a pep talk. He looked round the Samjiyon Blueberry Drink Factory and Samjiyon County Junior Middle School nearing completion. He said that the construction of the factory and school as well as the dwelling house he just visited were perfect. He gave field guidance to the Samjiyon Potato Farina Production Factory again. He acquainted himself with the operation of the factory, including the installation of potato-processing facilities and the production of potato farina, making rounds of several workshops. The Party has paid much effort to building the factory, so it is important to properly run it to be beneficial to not only the people in the county but also other people across the country, he said, and indicated the ways to improve the management and operation of the factory and its operation strategy. Watching a large pile of potato farina amounting to thousands of tons with a broad smile on his face, he said with great satisfaction that potatoes heaped up in storehouse last year were turned into a mountain of potato farina that looked great. He said to leading officials of the headquarters of the construction of Samjiyon County and the provincial and county party committees and other officials accompanying him that the construction of Samjiyon County is a fierce class and political struggle against the hostile forces seeking to check the advance of the DPRK and that the victory in the construction would be a demonstration of its might and economic potentials. He underlined the need to inspire the entire Party and the whole country as well as builders to perfect the construction of Samjiyon County till the 75th founding anniversary of the Party, so as to turn the county, the yard of the old home for the revolution, into a highly-civilized mountainous city, a typical county which no one can imitate and the richest county in the country. He was accompanied by Jo Yong Won, vice department director of the WPK Central Committee. Political News Team

title: Officials and Members of GFTUK Meet to Praise Virtues of Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: A presentation on the virtues of Chairman Kim Jong Il was held by officials and members of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea (GFTUK) at the Central Hall of Workers on Wednesday to mark the 26th anniversary of his election as chairman of the National Defence Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. At the presentation, speakers told about leadership exploits of Kim Jong Il who developed the country into a dignified politico-ideological power and matchless military power. They said that Kim Jong Il set a brilliant practical example of the equipment management at the Pyongyang Textile Machine Factory when he was conducting revolutionary activities at Kim Il Sung University. They recalled that Kim Jong Il showed his loving care for and trust in workers of Kangson so that they could kindle the flames of a new great revolutionary upswing in the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance and fortitude and thus firmly ensure the steel industry of the country. They said that he put forward scientists as precious treasures of the country and frontline soldiers for the sci-tech development and the defence of socialism. They vowed to fully demonstrate the intrepid spirit of the heroic Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il working class in the ongoing march for the prosperity of the country, bearing in mind the immutable faith that the powerful country and bright future would have been unthinkable without Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un who is identical to Kim Jong Il in the idea, leadership and traits. Present there were Ju Yong Gil, chairman of the Central Committee of the GFTUK, officials and members of trade unions and workers. Rodong Sinmun

title: State Academic Degrees and Titles Conferred on Intellectuals
body: Intellectuals were awarded state academic degrees and titles on the occasion of the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. They made tangible contributions to developing the national economy, improving the people's standard of living and educating new generations by achieving valuable scientific research successes. An awarding ceremony took place at the People's Palace of Culture on Wednesday. The title of candidate academician went to Choe Jong Sik, department head of Kim Il Sung University, Ri Won Chol, vice-president of Kim Chaek University of Technology, and Mun Jong Won, room chief of the Academy of Agricultural Science. The professorship was conferred on 14 persons including Ri Kwang Hui, department head of Kim Il Sung University, Jong Mun Il, vice-president of Pyongyang University of Architecture. The doctorate went to Ri Myong Gi, vice department head of Pyongyang Medical College of Kim Il Sung University, Jang Sang Yong, teacher of University of National Economy, and others and the associate professorship to 163 persons and the master's degree to 1 161 persons. Rodong Sinmun

title: Minister of Interior of Russian Federation Visits Mangyongdae
body: Vladimir Kolokoltev, minister of Interior of the Russian Federation and his party visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. Being briefed on the old home at Mangyongdae where Kim Il Sung was born and spent childhood while nurturing his great intention to make revolution, the guests looked round the historical mementoes. They also toured Kim Jong Il People's Security University, the Tower of the Juche Idea, the Jongbaek Church, etc. and placed a wreath before the Liberation Tower. Rodong Sinmun

title: Congratulations to Slovak President-elect
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on Wednesday sent a congratulatory message to Zuzana Captova upon her election as president of the Slovak Republic. The message wished the president-elect success in her responsible work for the country's prosperity and the people's well-being, expressing belief that the friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries would grow stronger in conformity with the common interests and desire of the peoples of the two countries. Rodong Sinmun

title: Minister of Interior of Russian Federation Leaves
body: Vladimir Kolokoltev, minister of Interior of the Russian Federation, and his party left here for home on Wednesday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Posters for 6th April Spring People's Art Festival Produced
body: Posters were produced for the 6th April Spring People's Art Festival to be held on the occasion of the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Printed on them were letters "The 6th April Spring People's Art Festival" and the logo and period of the festival. The posters describe the immortal flower Kimilsungia, the fluttering national flag and national flower Magnolia of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and indicate categories of the festival, vividly reflecting the atmosphere of the festival in Pyongyang. The poster for art troupe category depicts artistes who fulfill their revolutionary duty to add luster to the revolutionary career and exploits of the President for all ages and show the development and advantage of Juche-oriented art. The posters include those for art squad, itinerant art squad, art group and magic categories. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to Senegalese President
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a message of greeting to Macky Sall, president of the Republic of Senegal, on Wednesday on the occasion of the 59th anniversary of the independence of Senegal. Expressing belief that the friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries would grow stronger in the future, Kim sincerely wished the Senegalese people a fresh success in their work for the country's development and prosperity. Rodong Sinmun

title: Kim Yong Nam Meets Delegation of Syria Baath Children Organization
body: Kim Yong Nam, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, met and had a talk with a delegation of the Syria Baath Children Organization led by Chairman Muhamad Ezat Arabi Katbi who paid a courtesy call on him at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Wednesday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Foreign Marathoners Arrive
body: Marathoners of China, Morocco, Kenya and Ethiopia arrived here on Thursday to participate in the 30th Mangyongdae Prize International Marathon to be held on the occasion of the Day of the Sun, the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of Syria Baath Children Organization Visits Mangyongdae
body: The delegation of the Syria Baath Children Organization led by Chairman Muhamad Ezat Arabi Katbi visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. Being briefed on Kim Il Sung's revolutionary history and the patriotic life of his family members, the visitors looked round the historical relics there. The delegation also toured the Tower of the Juche Idea, the Arch of Triumph, the Youth Movement Museum, Pyongyang Primary School for Orphans, etc. Rodong Sinmun

title: Day of Sun to Be Marked in Libya
body: A Libyan preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (Day of the Sun) was formed at the Sunbula International Friendship Club on March 29. The chairman of the Libya-DPRK Friendship Association was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The preparatory committee decided to organize political and cultural events like photo exhibition and film show on the occasion of the Day of the Sun. Rodong Sinmun

title: President Kim Il Sung Praised by Russian Media
body: Russian media carried special write-ups illustrated with the photo of smiling President Kim Il Sung, his photos, a photo and picture showing President Kim Il Sung standing together with Chairman Kim Jong Il between March 20 and 29 on the occasion of the birth anniversary of the President. The newspaper Nakhodkinski Rabochi said in an article titled "The great man's history goes on" that Kim Il Sung accomplished the cause of national liberation by waging the arduous anti-Japanese war and turned the DPRK into a true country of the people and a country strong in independence. It said that the President was a world's elder statesman who rendered material and moral assistance to developing countries in their building a new society and made a contribution to the development of the non-aligned movement. Russia's online magazine Lemchich in an article said that the DPRK is a country based on the people-first principle. It said that the Korean people call the train used by Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il a "go-to-the-people train". The newspaper Byvor in an article under the title of "President Kim Il Sung and the DPRK-China friendship" introduced the feats he performed for the development of the DPRK-China friendship. A Russian website said in an article titled "The estimation of history" that Kim Il Sung was a great man admired by all people, irrespective of ideology, social system, political view and religious belief. It elaborated on what prominent figures of different countries in the world said in praise of him. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Work Introduced by Austrian Organization
body: The Society for the Promotion of the Relations between Austria and the DPRK posted on its website Chairman Kim Jong Il's work "Let Us Hold the Great Leader Comrade Kim Il Sung in High Esteem as Eternal President of Our Republic" on March 29 on the occasion of the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, the Day of the Sun. The work, published in July Juche 83 (1994), underlines the need to hold Kim Il Sung in high esteem for all ages and sets forth the tasks for defending and successfully carrying forward his idea and undying exploits. Rodong Sinmun

title: Russian Government Donates Wheat to DPRK
body: The wheat that the government of the Russian Federation donated to the DPRK through the WFP arrived at Hungnam Port on April 2. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Photo Exhibition Opens
body: A national photo exhibition "Great devotion to the country and people" opened with due ceremony at the People's Palace of Culture Thursday to celebrate the 7th anniversary of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's assumption of the top posts of the Workers' Party of Korea and the State. Seen in its venue are photos of Kim Jong Un. Photos including the photo "The Respected Supreme Leader Comrade Kim Jong Un giving on-the-spot guidance to Samjiyon County under construction" remind the visitors of the days of his revolutionary leadership. "The Respected Supreme Leader Comrade Kim Jong Un making a congratulatory speech at the military parade held in celebration of the 70th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Army" and "The Respected Supreme Leader Comrade Kim Jong Un meeting participants in the 5th National Conference of War Veterans" and other photos show his personality as a great man. Displayed are photos dealing with the spirit of the Korean people and the DPRK making a leap forward. Present at the ceremony were Ri Yong Sik, first vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Pak Chun Nam, minister of Culture, officials concerned and others. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Inspects Hot-spring Tourist Area under Construction
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the Korean People's Army, gave field guidance to the construction site of the hot-spring tourist area in Yangdok County, South Phyongan Province. Supreme Leader of the Party, state and army Kim Jong Un noted that people would be pleased to play skiing in the day time and take a rest while taking baths in hot-spring in the evening by building a ski ground around the hot-spring tourist area under construction in Yangdok County. And he repeatedly learned about the winter climate condition and geographical features of the area and gave the relevant field the detailed tasks and ways for building a ski ground. He looked round every nook and corner of the construction site after learning about the construction project while watching the newly made master plan for the Yangdok hot-spring tourist area. Expressing great satisfaction over the fact that a bright outlook for the project is seen as the ground excavation and concrete tamping and substructure project of all the construction objects such as recuperation district, rest district, general service district and hotel district charged by the KPA have been carried out as scheduled, he highly praised the soldier-builders for their high spirits. He said that making a field survey of the construction sites today once again, he could know Yangdok area has a favorable natural and geographical condition for building a ski ground as it has high mountains and much snow along with low temperature in winter. Noting that the yield of hot-spring water has not changed and its temperature is very high in the area though it is under construction, he was very pleased to say that the general sporting and cultural rest center and the health treatment service center for hot-spring bath and skiing would be built in the fameless and quiet mountainous area. He said that the construction speed should be hastened and the operation unit should make meticulous service preparations one by one from now so as to operate the hot-spring ground and ski ground from winter this year. He pointed out that deep studies and good management strategy should be made for perfect operation and service of the Yangdok ski ground in a higher level on the basis of experience gained in operating the Masikryong Ski Resort. He noted that the soldiers of the People's Army who always reply "Yes" to the Party's call come across his mind before anyone whenever the Party determines to carry out such large construction projects demanding high technical and qualitative level as the Wonsan-Kalma coastal tourist area and Yangdok hot-spring tourist area. He said the People's Army should fully demonstrate the might as creator of people's happiness and pioneer of high civilization by devotedly implementing the Party's plan and determination. He was accompanied by Choe Ryong Hae, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the WPK, and Jo Yong Won and Pak Chang Ho, vice department directors of the C.C., WPK. Political News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Inspects Wonsan-Kalma Coastal Tourist Area under Construction
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the Korean People's Army, gave field guidance to the construction site of the Wonsan-Kalma coastal tourist area. Supreme Leader of the Party, state and army Kim Jong Un inspected several places of the construction site to acquaint himself in detail with the construction results and situation. He highly praised the builders for nearly finishing framework construction of all the buildings and plastering of their interiors and exteriors, constructing additional buildings at the high speed and pushing forward afforestation and greening in three dimensions by pressing ahead with the project while creating construction anecdotes without an equal in the world even in winter, thus changing the appearance of the construction site beyond recognition. He said that the shortcomings that the artistic reciprocity, compatibility and connectivity among the buildings are not flexible, and high and low buildings are not combined in a harmonious way, which he pointed out while inspecting the area at the end of last year, were made up. He expressed his great satisfaction, saying that the whole of the street formation looks elegant artistically and fairly good and that the area is very spectacular. He said that large-scale construction work like the tourist area should never be carried out in a slipshod manner, stressing the speed only. He stressed that as the Party directs with mind enormous funds and labor to the construction of the tourist area for the people, it is necessary to ensure the quality of every building at the highest level so that it should be perfect 50 or 100 years later, too. He gave precious instructions to spruce up the area including the issue of designing all the buildings on the principle of optimization to make them useful and convenient, the issue of economizing the building materials and constructing the buildings suited to the modern aesthetic sense, the issue of building promenade, tramlines and bicycle roads well suited to users' convenience, the issue of producing many storage battery cars, the issue of making floating piers for the panel lodgings built on stilts over the water to make people use boats, the issue of setting up outdoor clocks on buildings and other places for people bathing in the sea, the issue of decorating buildings with lamplights and putting up signboards in a highly civilized and peculiar way. He pointed out that the relevant field should correctly set operation units to begin service just after the completion of the buildings, and structural measures for perfect service preparation should be made. The builders should not push forward the construction of the Wonsan-Kalma coastal tourist area in a hurried way to finish till the Party founding anniversary this year after the sea-bathing season, but postpone the construction period until the Day of the Sun next year to perfectly finish it so that our people would fully enjoy themselves in the impeccable tourist area from the sea-bathing season next year, he said, calling upon all to create new feats in the worthwhile struggle to build a people's cultural resting place, coastal park of the people envied by the world, in high spirits. He was accompanied by Jo Yong Won and Kim Ung Bok, vice department directors of the Central Committee of the WPK. Political News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Reply Message from Lao Party Leader
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), received a reply message from Bounnhang Vorachith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party (LPRP), on March 26. In the message Bounnhang Vorachith expressed sincere thanks to Kim Jong Un on behalf of the C.C., LPRP and on his own behalf for sending the warm congratulations and wishes along with a beautiful floral basket on the occasion of the 64th founding anniversary of the LPRP. He expressed the belief that the Democratic People's Republic of Korea will keep achieving bigger and fresh successes in national defence and in the building of a socialist powerful country under the bold and tested leadership of the WPK headed by Kim Jong Un. He wished Kim Jong Un success in his noble work in good health, hoping that the friendly and cooperative relations between the two parties, two states and two peoples of Laos and the DPRK with a long tradition will grow stronger. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chinese Embassy Members Visit Friendship Tower
body: Staff members of the Chinese embassy here laid a wreath before the Friendship Tower ahead of Tomb-sweeping Day. Present at the wreath-laying ceremony were Ambassador Li Jinjun, staff members of his embassy, Chinese guests staying here and students studying here, Chinese residents in the DPRK and Choe Song Chol, vice-minister of Urban Management, Pak Kyong Il, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries who doubles as chairman of the DPRK-China Friendship Association, and officials concerned. Wreaths were laid at the tower in the names of the Chinese embassy and a Chinese delegation. Wreaths were also laid in the names of the Ministry of Urban Management, the Pyongyang City People's Committee, the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries and the DPRK-China Friendship Association. Participants paid a silent tribute to fallen fighters of the Chinese People's Volunteers before looking round the tower. Floral baskets and wreaths were laid at the cemetery of martyrs of the Chinese People's Volunteers in Hoechang County, South Phyongan Province in the names of the Chinese embassy, the Hoechang County People's Committee, etc. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of Syria Baath Children Organization Leaves
body: A delegation of the Syria Baath Children Organization led by Chairman Muhamad Ezat Arabi Katbi left here for home on April 5. Rodong Sinmun

title: Poster for 21st Kimilsungia Festival Produced
body: A poster was produced for the 21st Kimilsungia Festival to be held here on the occasion of the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Depicted in the poster is the immortal flower Kimilsungia in full bloom against the background of Pyongyang including the superb landscape of Mangyong Hill and the River Taedong in balmy spring of April. Written there are the slogan "The great leader Comrade Kim Il Sung will always be with us" and letters "The Day of the Sun", "Celebration" and "The 21st Kimilsungia Festival". Also seen are the logo of the festival and its venue and period. Rodong Sinmun

title: Day of Sun to Be Marked in Germany
body: A preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (Day of the Sun) was formed by the Communist Party of Germany on March 31. Torsten Schoevitz, chairman of the Communist Party of Germany, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee decided to hold colorful political and cultural events including a seminar on the occasion of the Day of the Sun. Rodong Sinmun

title: Day of Sun to Be Marked in Senegal
body: A Senegalese preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (Day of the Sun) was formed on March 30. Samba Sy, general secretary of the Workers' Party for the Independence of Senegal, was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee set a celebration period from March 30 to April 20 and decided to organize political and cultural events including a photo exhibition and film show. Rodong Sinmun

title: Day of Sun to Be Marked by Russian Organizations
body: A preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (Day of the Sun) was formed by the Regional Social Organization of Russia "Borozino" and the Korean War Veterans' Council of Russia on March 25. Salinikov, chairman of the Regional Social Organization of Russia "Borozino", and C. M. Kramarenko, chairman of the Korean War Veterans' Council of Russia, were elected co-chairmen of the preparatory committee. The committee set a celebration period from March 25 to April 16 and decided to hold colorful political and cultural events in praise of the revolutionary career and exploits of Kim Il Sung. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to Baath Arab Socialist Party
body: The Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea sent a message of greeting to the Central Leadership of the Baath Arab Socialist Party on Saturday on its 72nd founding anniversary. The message said that today the BASP and Syrian people are working hard to rehabilitate and stabilize economy and people's living while smashing the hostile forces' vicious and persistent sanctions and pressure and resolutely defending the country's sovereignty and territorial integrity under the guidance of President Bashar Al-Assad. Reiterating firm support and solidarity with the BASP and Syrian people in their just cause, the message sincerely wished the BASP members greater victory and success in their struggle for strengthening the party and defending the country's dignity and stability. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: The participants in the 6th April Spring People's Art Festival visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on Saturday. They laid a floral basket and bouquets at the statues of the great leaders and made a bow to them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Day of Sun to Be Marked in Germany
body: A preparatory committee for celebrating President Kim Il Sung's birth anniversary (Day of the Sun) was formed by the Anti-Imperialist Forum of Germany in Berlin on March 31. The chairman of the Anti-Imperialist Forum of Germany was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. The committee decided to give wide publicity to the immortal exploits of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un through media and hold colorful political and cultural events including seminar and online photo exhibition on the occasion of the Day of the Sun. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Published in DR Congo
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "The Great Comrade Kim Il Sung Is the Eternal Leader of Our Party and Our People" was brought out in booklet by the Cedi Publishing House of DR Congo to mark the Day of the Sun, birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. The work, published on April 20, Juche 101 (2012), deals with the revolutionary exploits performed by President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in their lifetime. It also indicates the tasks for staunchly defending and adding eternal luster to the ideology and feats of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il. A book-releasing ceremony took place on March 29. Rodong Sinmun

title: Day of Sun to Be Marked in Russia
body: A preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (Day of the Sun) was formed by the Nakhodka City Branch Committee of the Maritime Territory of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation on Mar. 29. The first secretary of the branch committee was elected chairman of the preparatory committee. It decided to hold colorful political and cultural events such as seminar and film show in praise of undying feats of the President on the occasion of the Day of the Sun. Rodong Sinmun

title: All-out to Qualify as Sports Models
body: The people show great zeal for mass sports activities to carry out the relevant task set by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address and fill the whole country with vigor and optimism. As a result, many of its units qualified as sports models. The Pyongyang Mechanical Pencil Factory and many others put up billboards to give wide common knowledge of sports to their employees and encouraged them to actively go in for sports activities. The Kophung Forestry Station and many other units built sports facilities and got all necessary sports equipment. They ensured that their employees, young people and schoolchildren joined in mass sports activities passionately. In addition, they made it a rule for them to run in the morning, play health Taekwon-Do and take various other exercises. They also arranged for them to conduct physical training for national defense and play other colorful sports games not only on holidays and sports days but also at the hours set aside to suit their convenience. The Hamhung City Power Distribution Station and many others often organize a tug of war, national sports matches and basketball, volleyball and other games to make their employees happy and optimistic. In the course of this many more of them came to acquire upwards of a sports technique. While dynamic efforts are made to qualify as sports models all the country is filled with opulent emotion and revolutionary optimism and the people are greatly encouraged to accelerate the building of a powerful socialist country. Ju Ryong Bong

title: Congratulations to President of Malta
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, on Friday sent a congratulatory message to George William Vella upon his election as president of the Republic of Malta. Kim in the message wished the president success in his responsible work for prosperity of the country and welfare of the people, expressing the belief that the friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries would grow stronger in common interests and desire of their peoples. Rodong Sinmun

title: Presentation on Chairman Kim Jong Il's Virtues Held
body: Agricultural workers and members of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea (UAWK) held a presentation on Chairman Kim Jong Il's virtues at the Samjigang Co-op Farm in Jaeryong County, South Hwanghae Province on Sunday to mark the 26th anniversary of his election as chairman of the DPRK National Defence Commission. At the event, speakers recalled with emotion the leadership exploits of Kim Jong Il who worked heart and soul to resolve the issue of the people's food while always finding himself on the road of field guidance to farms till the last moments of his life. They vowed to add eternal luster to the revolutionary exploits Kim Jong Il performed in developing the country's agriculture and faithfully support Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's cause of building a powerful socialist country with bumper crop. Rodong Sinmun

title: 30th Mangyongdae Prize Int'l Marathon Held
body: The 30th Mangyongdae Prize International Marathon was held here to mark the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, Day of the Sun. Marathoners from the DPRK, China, Morocco, Kenya and Ethiopia and foreign amateurs competed in marathon, half marathon, 10 km and 5 km races. Its opening ceremony took place at the Kim Il Sung Stadium on Sunday. Present there were Choe Hwi, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the National Sports Guidance Committee, Vice-Premier Jon Kwang Ho, officials concerned, Pyongyang citizens, youth and students and foreign guests. Minister of Physical Culture and Sports Kim Il Guk made an opening address, to be followed by the marathon races. When the signal pistol was fired, marathoners and amateurs left the stadium and run the course, cheered by working people, youth and schoolchildren. DPRK marathoners Ri Kang Bom (man) and Ri Kwang Ok (woman) came first, Ethiopian marathoner Dabi Tadesse Yae (man) and DPRK marathoner Jo Un Ok (woman) second and DPRK marathoners Han Il Ryong (man) and Kim Ji Hyang (woman) third in the marathon and DPRK players won gold, silver and bronze medals in the half marathon. A Russian male marathoner and a Swiss female marathoner took the first place, a Portuguese male and an Austrian female the second and an Irish male and an Austrian female the third in the amateur marathon. At the end of the races, a closing ceremony took place. Cups, medals, diplomas and certificates were awarded to the successful marathoners and amateurs at the closing ceremony. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Visits Taesong Department Store Ready to Open
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the Korean People's Army, provided field guidance to Taesong Department Store just before its opening. Looking round counters on each floor, Supreme Leader of the Party, state and army Kim Jong Un was given details of the renovation and enlargement of the department store, and goods exhibition and service readiness. Now that the modern department store has been completed, it has become possible to provide citizens of the capital with different varieties of more quality foodstuffs, clothing, footwear, household articles, sundry goods for daily use, school things and goods for cultural use, he said. It was easily noticeable that the goods are exhibited in diverse and attractive ways and styles, and the environment and scope of service and quality and diversity of goods are on the high level, he said, before emphasizing that quality daily necessities and mass consumption goods should be procured and sold in abundance for the convenience of the people so as to satisfy their daily growing desire and wish. He clarified specific tasks for improving the management and operation of the department store and its commercial service as required by the Party's commercial policy. He was accompanied by Vice-Chairmen of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea Choe Ryong Hae and An Jong Su, vice department directors of the WPK Central Committee, officials of the State Affairs Commission and other officials concerned. Political News Team

title: Congratulations to President of Comoros
body: Kim Yong Nam, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on April 6 sent a congratulatory message to Azali Assoumani upon his re-election as president of the Union of the Comoros. Kim in the message expressed the belief that the friendly relations between the two countries would grow stronger, and wholeheartedly wished the president good health and success in his work for consolidating the country's political stability and national unity and achieving its economic prosperity. Rodong Sinmun

title: Young People Turn out in Construction of Samjiyon County
body: The young people in the DPRK are devoting themselves to sprucing up the area of Mt Paektu, the holy place of the sun. This year alone, they rendered material aid and moral support to the construction of Samjiyon County and over 6 000 young people volunteered in sprucing up Samjiyon County. The youth league organizations throughout the country properly carry out the work for encouraging young people to create new legendary tales about heroic youth in the campaign for face-lifting Samjiyon County, while pushing ahead with the work to popularize the examples shown by exemplary units and young people. Young people in Pyongyang City sent large volumes of aid materials to the construction site. Those in Ryanggang Province provided building materials and over 1 000 utensils and tools of 70 kinds to the construction site. The youth league organizations in South Hamgyong and Jagang provinces sent various condiments and over 8 500 pieces of living necessities. The same is true of the youth league organizations in South Hwanghae and North Hamgyong provinces. Many young people in Pyongyang City and other parts of the country have volunteered in sprucing up Samjiyon County. Rodong Sinmun

title: Nepalese Party Delegation Visits Mangyongdae
body: A delegation of the Provincial Committee of the Nepal Communist Party headed by Malla Tilak Bahadur, member of the Karnali Provincial Committee, visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. The delegation looked round historical relics, being briefed on the President's old home at Mangyongdae. It also visited the Tower of the Juche Idea, the Korean Revolution Museum, the Monument to Party Founding, etc. Rodong Sinmun

title: Bulletin Issued in DR Congo
body: A preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (Day of the Sun) issued a bulletin on March 27. The bulletin carried an article titled "The man praised by the world" under the headline "On the occasion of the 107th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung". President Kim Il Sung, the eternal leader of the Korean people, is an outstanding great man recognized by the world and it is well evidenced by the fact that streets, institutions and organizations in many countries were named after the great man, the article said. Prominent political and public figures in the world have expressed their highest reverence for Kim Il Sung, a revelation of his prestige, the article said, adding that he is always alive in the hearts of mankind. Rodong Sinmun

title: Day of Sun Celebrated in Different Countries
body: A meeting and a book and photo exhibition took place in Mexico and seminars in Russia and the Czech Republic between March 12 and 23 on the occasion of the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (Day of the Sun). The events were attended by personages of various political parties and organizations and peoples in those countries. Jesus Antonio Carlos Hernandez, general secretary of the Central Committee of the People's Socialist Party of Mexico, praised Kim Il Sung for founding the Juche idea to indicate the way to be followed by the world progressives and making immortal contribution to the building of a regular army. L. A. Kobuizov, first secretary of the Amur Regional Branch Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation, said that Kim Il Sung laid the firm foundation for defending the sovereignty of the DPRK and achieving its prosperity. Noting that Chairman Kim Jong Il firmly defended socialist Korea founded by the President and led it to victory, he said that thanks to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, the DPRK fully demonstrates its might as an invincible power which no one dares provoke. Jozef Servista, chairman of the Paektusan Czech-Korean Friendship Association who is deputy general secretary of the Central Committee of the Czechoslovak Communist Party and chairman of the Czech Group for the Study and Materialization of the Juche Idea, said that Kim Il Sung is the eternal leader of the Korean people who built and developed the Party, state and army in the DPRK on the basis of the immortal Juche idea. The socialist cause of Korea pioneered by Kim Il Sung and advanced by Kim Jong Il is being successfully carried forward by Kim Jong Un, he said. He said that the Korean people will achieve greater successes in building a powerful socialist country under the leadership of Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Fumigation, Intangible Cultural Heritage of Nation
body: From Olden Times our people have actively applied fumigation to promoting their health and treating their diseases. As for the fumigation, the fumes of a boiling or burning Koryo medicine are puffed into a certain region of the body or its decoction is applied to the region. This is expatiated on in “Tonguibogam”, “Uibangryuchi”, “Hyangyakjipsongbang” and other old books of traditional Koryo medicine. According to circumstances the body, its region or its limited part is fumigated with fumes of heat, burning fumes or tiny fumes. The fumigation produces no ill effects on a patient and gives him or her no pain, welding thermotherapy, the ensuing diaphoretic effect and the pharmacological effect of medical fumes organically. The fumigation is very widely applied to therapy. It proves very effective in treating insomnia, fibular aseptic necrosis, synovitis of a joint of a knee and others which are beyond the limits of modern medicine. The Koryo Medicine Hospital of South Phyongan Province and many other medical and preventive institutions successfully benefit from the fumigation. Rim Song I

title: Day of Sun to Be Marked in Algeria
body: An Algerian preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, Day of the Sun, was formed on April 2. The chairman of the Algeria-Korea Friendship Association was elected as chairman of the preparatory committee. The preparatory committee decided to hold diverse political and cultural events including seminar, lecture and film show in praise of Kim Il Sung's revolutionary career and exploits on April 2-15. Rodong Sinmun

title: Day of Sun to Be Marked in South Africa
body: A South African preparatory committee for celebrating the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, Day of the Sun, was formed on April 1. Ambrose Mnisi, chairman of the South African National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, was elected as chairman of the preparatory committee. The preparatory committee decided to give wide publicity to the President's revolutionary exploits through media and hold colorful political and cultural events throughout April. Rodong Sinmun

title: Vietnamese Vice-President Supports Peace on Korean Peninsula
body: DPRK Ambassador Kim Myong Gil paid a farewell call on Dang Thi Ngoc Thinh, vice-president of Vietnam, on April 5. The vice-president said that the relations of friendship and cooperation between the two countries provided by President Ho Chi Minh and President Kim Il Sung are soon to turn 70 years. He said that Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's recent official goodwill visit to Vietnam was a historic event which helped lift the traditional relations of friendship between the two countries to a higher level in various fields. Congratulating the DPRK's government and people on their remarkable achievements in socialist construction, he said he was convinced that the Korean people would win bigger victories under the guidance of the Workers' Party of Korea headed by Kim Jong Un. He affirmed that the Communist Party and government of Vietnam would as ever prioritize the friendly relations with the Workers' Party of Korea and the DPRK government and maintain the constant stand of supporting peace and stability of the Korean peninsula. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Introduced in Brazil
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us Usher in a New Golden Age in Building a Sports Power in the Revolutionary Spirit of Paektu" was posted by the Brazilian Center for the Study of Songun Politics on its website on Mar. 25, the 4th anniversary of the publication of the work. The work, published on Mar. 25, Juche 104 (2015), says it is a determination and firm will of the Workers' Party of Korea to put the DPRK on the position of a dignified sports power, and sets forth tasks and ways for ushering in a new heyday in the building of a sports power in the revolutionary spirit of Paektu. Rodong Sinmun

title: Russian Politicians Here
body: A joint delegation of political parties of the Legislative Assembly of the Amur Region, Russia, headed by Chairman Vyacheslav Loginov, arrived here on Monday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Russian Guests Visit Statues of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: A joint delegation of political parties of the Legislative Assembly of the Amur Region, Russia, visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on Monday. Members of the delegation laid bouquets at the statues of the great leaders and made a bow to them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Choe Ryong Hae Inspects Various Units of North Hwanghae Province
body: Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, made a field survey of various units in North Hwanghae Province. Making rounds of various places of the Migok Cooperative Farm in Sariwon City, he underlined the need for the farm to positively introduce the advanced farming technologies and methods, increase the operating ratio of farm machines, do all the farm work in a sincere manner and thus always take the lead in glorifying the Party's leadership exploits. At the Hwangju County Farm Machine Station, he said the station should properly ensure farm machine serving and production of accessories and invent and introduce new farming facilities through a good operation of its sci-tech learning space and that the Party's organizations should conduct a brisk mass movement for arousing the working people to the implementation of the Party policy. He also inspected the Sariwon Chicken Farm, the Sariwon Duck Farm and the Jangchon Cooperative Farm in Hwangju County. The field consultative meetings took measures for the Party officials to conduct a frontline-style political work among the producers and farmers in a unique manner in order to positively excite their revolutionary zeal and for relevant fields to supply farming materials in time. Earlier, he visited the Pyongyang Ostrich Farm. Rodong Sinmun

title: Foreigners Visit Korean Revolution Museum
body: Staff members of foreign embassies and missions of international bodies here visited the Korean Revolution Museum on Monday on the occasion of the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (Day of the Sun). Being told about the revolutionary careers and feats of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, they looked round the historical mementoes and data. After the visit, they made entries in the visitor's book. Rodong Sinmun

title: World Health Day Marked
body: A seminar took place at the Grand People's Study House on Monday to mark the World Health Day. Present at the seminar were officials in the fields of public health and media and members of missions of international bodies here including the acting representative of the WHO and the UN resident coordinator here. At the seminar on the theme of "Universal Health Coverage", speakers noted that the cost of minimum initial service package goes up day by day and the number of people out of primary health care is on a steady increase due to political, social and economic conditions, natural disaster and so forth. They stressed the need for all the countries to ensure enough materials and personal force for establishing health service system for all the people for attaining sustained development goal and developing health service and to raise the qualification of health workers. Then, speeches were made there. At the end of the seminar the attendees looked round posters and photos dealing with universal health service. On the same day the intensive hygienic information service took place in every province. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of DPRK-China Friendship Association Leaves
body: A delegation of the DPRK-China Friendship Association led by Chairman Pak Kyong Il, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries, left here on Tuesday to take part in a Korean photo, book and art exhibition to be held in China to mark the first anniversary of the historic first visit to China by Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, and the 70th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the DPRK and China. Rodong Sinmun

title: S. Korean Military Authorities Plan Military Exercises
body: It was reported that the south Korean military authorities plan to wage provocative single-handed military exercises. Crying out for "keeping up perfect military posture" and "improving the operational capacity in contingency", the south Korean military authorities have announced that they will single-handedly stage the south Korea-U.S. joint military exercises slated for April and May "intensively" and "qualitatively". Accordingly, they are going to more intensively wage in April the Ssangryong drill which has been staged every year as part of Foal Eagle exercise, a joint field maneuver with the U.S. They are also examining a plan to "qualitatively" stage the joint air combat drill Max Thunder based on the combined drill for combat readiness posture carried out by the south Korean air force single-handedly in December last year. It is a mockery of the fellow countrymen desirous of durable peace in the Korean Peninsula, and a reckless act to deny the north-south declarations confirmed under the eyes of the nation and the world. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Birthday Spread to Pro-reunification Patriotic Fighter
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un on Tuesday sent a birthday spread to Hong Myong Gi, a pro-reunification patriotic fighter, on his 90th birthday. Hong Myong Gi, born into a tenant's family in Puyo, South Chungchong Province, was subject to a miserable life, feeling the sorrow of a stateless nation. He had yearned after the northern half of the Republic, a new world for the people, in humble reverence for President Kim Il Sung who liberated the country from the Japanese imperialist colonial rule. During the Fatherland Liberation War, he joined the People's Army advancing southward and performed feats in a number of battles. Later, he was arrested by the enemy while bravely fighting for national reunification. He lived up to the revolutionary faith and principle as a member of the Workers' Party of Korea despite 38 year-long imprisonment. Chairman Kim Jong Il highly appreciated his feats and saw to it that he was conferred a watch bearing the august name of the President, the title of hero of the Republic, the National Reunification Prize and other state commendations and could lead a happy life. Kim Jong Un invited him as delegate to various events including the celebrations of the centenary of the birth of Kim Il Sung, the Fourth National Conference of War Veterans and the Seventh Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea, thereby adding more luster to the noble life of the revolutionary fighter. Rodong Sinmun

title: Finnish President Wishes DPRK Success
body: DPRK Ambassador Ri Won Guk presented credentials to Finnish President Sauli Niinisto on April 4. The president said he sincerely hoped that the DPRK would make achievements in economy and all other fields. Rodong Sinmun

title: President Kim Il Sung's Feats Praised by Political Party of Senegal
body: The Workers' Party for the Independence of Senegal issued a statement on March 30 on the occasion of the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. The statement praised Kim Il Sung as a great state leader with matchless courage and wisdom, and said: He won glorious victories in the acute confrontation with the imperialists and dedicated himself to the happiness of people, possessed of immeasurably noble traits. He also made a great contribution to strengthening friendship and solidarity among the progressive peoples and ensuring the world peace and security. We will never forget how positively Comrade Kim Il Sung supported and encouraged the national liberation struggle of the peoples of Senegal and other African countries. Rodong Sinmun

title: Editorial
body: Exploits of Chairman Kim Jong Il in State Building Are Cornerstone of Victory and Prosperity of Our Republic April 9 marks the 26th anniversary of Kim Jong Il’s election as chairman of the National Defence Commission of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea. Kim Jong Il was elected chairman of the DPRK National Defence Commission on April 9, Juche 82(1993). As there was the historic day, the DPRK could emerge as an invincible politico-ideological power and military power of world standard and the Korean people could actively overcome unprecedented difficulties and add eternal luster to the immortal patriotic exploits of President Kim Il Sung. Kim Jong Il was a peerlessly brilliant Songun commander and patriot who laid an eternal foundation for defending the country and building a powerful country with his extraordinary wisdom, distinguished political caliber and wise leadership and a peerless politician who made the DPRK demonstrate its dignity as an independent fortress with a high international prestige and influence. He is a tender-hearted father who made the DPRK shed its brilliant rays as a dignified country of the people and a peerless patriot who developed the DPRK into a promising country with a powerful independent national economy and defence capability for self-defence. Today the eye-opening successes in the building of a powerful socialist country would have been unthinkable without the powerful military and economic foundation laid by Kim Jong Il. The matchless military muscle and inexhaustible potentials of the self-supporting economy reliably guarantee the durable security and rapid and sustained development of the DPRK.

title: Anniversary of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's First China Visit Marked in China
body: An on-line photo show was held in China to mark the first anniversary of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's historic first visit to China. Huan Qui network on Mar. 25 posted an article illustrated with photos showing Kim Jong Un's China visit. The article said: Chairman Kim Jong Un of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea visited China in March 2018. It was his first foreign trip. Chairman Kim Jong Un's first visit to China is of great significance in maintaining the tradition of China-DPRK friendship and developing the relations between the two countries. A number of impressive deeds and beautiful stories were recorded in the history of relationship between the two countries in the course of which the two peoples became true friends. The tradition of China-DPRK friendship was provided by President Kim Il Sung and HE Kim Jong Il together with the leaders of the elder generation of China. Chairman Kim Jong Un further develops China-DPRK friendship true to the will of the preceding leaders. His China visit laid firm groundwork for continuing the tradition of friendship between China and the DPRK through generations. Rodong Sinmun

title: Report on 4th Plenary Meeting of 7th Central Committee of WPK
body: The 4th Plenary Meeting of the 7th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) took place at the headquarters building of the C.C., WPK on Wednesday. Kim Jong Un, chairman of the WPK, guided the plenary meeting. Attending the meeting were members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, members and alternate members of the Political Bureau, members and alternate members of the WPK Central Committee and members of the Central Auditing Commission of the WPK. Vice directors of some departments of WPK Central Committee and other members were on hand as observers. Kim Jong Un chaired the meeting upon authorization of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee. The plenary meeting discussed agendas as follows: 1.On holding higher the banner of self-reliance in the socialist construction 2.On the plan of formation of state leadership bodies to be presented to the First Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly 3.Organizational affairs There was discussion on the first agenda at the plenary meeting. Kim Jong Un made a report on the first agenda. He in his report made a scientific analysis of the changed international landscape and the peculiarities of the present situation becoming daily acute and clarified the main tenor of the recent DPRK-U.S. summit talks and the Party's stand towards it. He underscored the need to more vigorously advance socialist construction by dint of self-supporting national economy suited to the specific local conditions of our country based on our efforts, technology and resources under the uplifted banner of self-reliance, so as to deal a telling blow to the hostile forces who go with bloodshot eyes miscalculating that sanctions can bring the DPRK to its knees. He reviewed and analyzed the successes and faults in the struggle for speeding up the socialist construction under the uplifted banner of self-reliance after the 7th Congress of the WPK, and set forth immediate objectives and tasks to be carried out without fail in further demonstrating the might of the self-supporting economy. He referred to the great achievements for socialist construction made in all the fields and regions and by units through the indomitable offensive under the banner of self-reliance and self-sufficiency in recent years. He noted that a great progress was registered in the struggle to make the national economy Juche-based and self-supporting and the reserved strength of the DPRK and tremendous potential of its independent economy were vividly demonstrated at home and abroad, adding that through the remarkable successes achieved in socialist construction he could keenly feel that our line was right over and over again. Self-reliance and self-supporting national economy are the bedrock of the existence of our own style socialism, the motive power of its advance and development and the eternal lifeline essential to the destiny of our revolution, he stressed. Noting that the first and foremost issue arising in accelerating socialist construction under the uplifted banner of self-reliance is to secure a sure guarantee for putting the national economy on a new phase of growth by expanding and reinforcing the foundation of self-supporting economy, he clarified in detail the immediate tasks for sectors of the national economy. Officials in all the fields and units should do their best for the development of science and education, bearing in mind that the success of relevant fields and units as well as the present and future of socialist construction depend on the thorough implementation of the Party's policy of attaching importance to science and education and talents, he said. He put special stress on decisively enhancing the role of the Party organizations in the struggle to vigorously speed up the socialist construction under the uplifted banner of self-reliance. Speeches were made on the first agenda. Speakers extended unanimous and full support to the historic report of Kim Jong Un that clarified the immortal guidelines to be adhered to as the lifeline in the struggle for building the powerful socialist country. The meeting discussed the second agenda. Kim Jong Un presented for discussion a proposal for the formation of the state leadership bodies, including the State Affairs Commission, the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly and the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea to be submitted to the First Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly. The plenary meeting decided with unanimous approval to submit the proposal to the First Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly. The plenary meeting discussed the organizational affairs, the third agenda. It recalled and by-elected members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee and members and alternate members of the Political Bureau. Kim Jae Ryong, Ri Man Gon, Choe Hwi, Pak Thae Dok, Kim Su Gil, Thae Hyong Chol and Jong Kyong Thaek were by-elected as members of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee. Jo Yong Won, Kim Tok Hun, Ri Ryong Nam, Pak Jong Nam, Ri Hi Yong and Jo Chun Ryong were by-elected as alternate members of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee. The plenary meeting recalled and by-elected members and alternate members of the Party Central Committee and member of the Party Central Auditing Commission. It disestablished and elected vice-chairmen of the Party Central Committee. Pak Pong Ju and Ri Man Gon were elected as vice-chairmen of the Party Central Committee. The plenary meeting recalled and by-elected members of the Party Central Military Commission. Kim Jae Ryong, Ri Man Gon, Thae Jong Su and Kim Jo Guk were by-elected as members of the Party Central Military Commission. It disestablished and appointed directors of some departments of the Party Central Committee. Ri Man Gon, Jang Kum Chol and Kim Tong Il were appointed as department directors of the Party Central Committee. First vice department directors of the Party Central Committee were appointed. Jo Yong Won, Kim Jo Guk and Kim Yong Su were appointed as first vice department directors of the Party Central Committee. The meeting disestablished and appointed chairmen of the Provincial Party Committees. Kang Pong Hun was appointed as chairman of the Jagang Provincial Party Committee, Pak Chang Ho as chairman of the North Hwanghae Provincial Party Committee, Ri Chol Man as chairman of the South Hwanghae Provincial Party Committee and Kim Chol Sam as chairman of the Nampho City Party Committee. Kim Jong Un made a historic conclusion at the plenary meeting. He emphasized some issues arising in applying the revolutionary stand and the principle of self-reliance. First of all, he underlined the need to make a clear understanding of the intention of the Party Central Committee which raised the issue of holding higher the banner of self-reliance as the main agenda of the current plenary meeting. He stressed that the basic spirit of the Fourth Plenary Meeting of the Seventh Party Central Committee is that the entire party, the whole country and all the people should courageously wage an all-out death-defying campaign to bring about a great surge in socialist construction by taking self-reliance as a treasured sword of prosperity today when the building of an economic power is raised as the main political task. He underlined the need to vigorously wage a grand advance for attaining the goals of economic construction set forth by the plenary meeting of the Party Central Committee to give full play to the offensive stamina of the country and confidently switch over to a new stage of growth. He also emphasized the importance of duty and role of the officials in properly drawing up the strategy of self-reliance and organizing all work on a scientific basis. He stressed the need for the party organizations and working people's organizations to dynamically wage the political work for powerfully arousing all the party members and other working people to the grand march of self-reliance and thus make the whole country seethe with a new revolutionary atmosphere. To thoroughly establish the socialist lifestyle is an important work for maintaining the Juche character and national identity and preserving the true nature of socialism and giving full play to its advantages in the field of cultural life, he said. He advanced the tasks facing the party organizations and officials in the struggle to do so. He expressed the expectation and conviction that all the officials, party members and other working people would vigorously wage the grand march of self-reliance to successfully attain the goals of struggle set forth by the Fourth Plenary Meeting of the Seventh Party Central Committee and thus achieve a new development in socialist construction and powerfully demonstrate once again the might of the country winning victory after victory with the might of self-development. Political News Team

title: Oratorical Contest of Trade Union Officials and Members Marks Day of Sun
body: A national oratorical contest of trade union officials and members was held at the Central Hall of Workers on Wednesday to mark the 107th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Present there were officials of the trade union and workers and trade unionists in Pyongyang. Those who took the floor spoke highly of the undying exploits of the President who embarked on the road of the revolution in his teens, defeated the gangster-like Japanese imperialists through the fierce anti-Japanese war and accomplished the historic cause of national liberation. They told impressive stories about the noble popular traits of the President who made a long journey of patriotism and dedication for the prosperity of the country and happiness of people, referring to the Korean people's pride of being blessed with illustrious leaders generation after generation. The 3rd Conference of the WPK in September Juche 99 (2010) marked an occasion of historic significance in the succession of the revolutionary cause of Juche, they said, stressing that the great Kim Il Sung's and Kim Jong Il's Korea will be blessed by the sun forever as there is Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. They voiced their pledge to fully display the spirit and stamina of the heroic working class of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il in building a powerful socialist country, upholding the banner of our state-first spirit under the leadership of Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Syrian President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Bashar Al-Assad, president of the Syrian Arab Republic, on Tuesday with the approach of the 107th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. The message extended the warmest congratulations to Kim Jong Un in the names of the president and people of Syria on the occasion of the 107th birth anniversary of Kim Il Sung who is always alive in the hearts of people, the Day of the Sun, wishing Kim Jong Un happiness in good health and the friendly Korean people bigger progress and prosperity. The message said that Kim Il Sung achieved great prosperity in all fields despite the harsh and inhumane blockade imposed by the dominationist and imperialist forces against the friendly DPRK. It expressed belief that Kim Jong Un would defend the great legacy and continue to firmly lead the DPRK to new developments and successes. Rodong Sinmun
