title: Agricultural Workers and Members of UAWK Meet
body: Agricultural workers and members of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea (UAWK) held a meeting on Wednesday in celebration of the seventh anniversary of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's assumption of the top posts of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and the state. Attending it were officials concerned, officials of the union, agricultural workers and members of the union in Pyongyang. At the meeting a reporter and speakers said Kim Jong Un's assumption of the top posts of the WPK and the state is the auspicious national event of historic significance in carrying forward and accomplishing the cause of Juche. The past seven years were remarkable days during which the national power of the DPRK has been put on the highest level under the leadership of the Supreme Leader, they stressed. They expressed the will to bring about a revolutionary turn in the agricultural production under the uplifted banner of self-reliance, true to the leadership of the Party, cherishing the glory of holding him on the top posts of the Party and the state. They called for displaying patriotism with pure conscience to bring about rich harvest on every field of the socialist country, true to his idea and intention. Rodong Sinmun

title: SPA Session Discusses State Budget
body: At the First Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly (SPA) of the DPRK, Deputy Ki Kwang Ho made a report on summing up of the fulfillment of the state budget of the DPRK for Juche 107 (2018) and its state budget for Juche 108 (2019) that had been put under full deliberation at the SPA Budget Committee. According to the report, the plan of state budgetary revenue for last year was successfully fulfilled at 101.4 percent, 4.6 percent increase over the previous year. The plan for local budgetary revenue was fulfilled at 100.5 percent. The plan for state budgetary expenditure last year was carried out at 99.9 percent. 47.6 percent of the total expenditure was spent for the development of the national economy, contributing to developing the capacity of power generation, expanding the success made in putting the metallurgical industry and chemical industry on a Juche basis, increasing the coal and grain production and improving the quality of various kinds of vehicles and light industrial products. State investment in key projects of the country was increased by 4.9 percent over last year to financially support such main projects of the country as sprucing up Samjiyon County, building the Wonsan-Kalma coastal tourist area and the Orangchon and Tanchon power stations and setting up modern tree nurseries in provinces. Investment in the sci-tech field was increased by 7.4 percent over last year, contributing to producing research findings propelling the sci-tech development and activating national economy. 36.4 percent of the total expenditure was earmarked for comprehensively developing the socialist culture, contributing to improving the condition and environment of education and developing public health, sports and literature and arts. 15.8 percent of the total expenditure went for firmly increasing the country's defense capabilities, contributing to boosting the combat capabilities of the revolutionary army and modernizing the Juche-oriented production structure and process of the munitions industry. The reporter said that this year we face an important task of providing in a responsible way the funds necessary for opening up a firm prospect for a step forward in socialist construction by expanding and strengthening the national independent development capacity true to the Party's militant appeal "Let us open a new road of advance for socialist construction under the uplifted banner of self-reliance!". According to the report, the state budgetary revenue and expenditure for this year was shaped in such a way as to financially support the Korean people in their struggle for further strengthening the might of the self-supporting socialist economy, attaining socialist civilization and firmly increasing the national defence capabilities by adjusting and reinforcing the overall national economy and focusing investment on the training of talents and development of science and technology. The state budgetary revenue for this year is expected to grow 3.7 percent over last year. Among them transaction tax, key item of budgetary revenue, is expected to swell 4.1 percent, and the profits from state-run enterprises 4.3 percent, to account for 85.7 percent of total budgetary revenue. The benefits from cooperative units are envisioned to grow 1.1 percent, real estate rental fee 0.3 percent, social insurance fee 0.2 percent, income from property sale and price fluctuation 0 percent, income from other sources 0.5 percent and that from economic trade zone 1.6 percent respectively. The central budgetary revenue will account for 73.9 percent of the state budgetary revenue. Here, the revenue from state-run economy will hold an absolute proportion, and provinces, cities and counties are supposed to cover expenditure with their own revenue and to contribute lots of funds to the central budget. The state budgetary expenditure for this year will grow 5.3 percent over last year. The funds for economic construction were increased 5.4 percent over last year, which amount for 47.8 percent of the total budgetary expenditure. The investment in the sci-tech field will increase by 8.7 percent to spur training of talents and sci-tech development and expenditure for the national economy including power, coal, metal, chemical industries, railway transport, agriculture, fishery and light industry by 5.7 percent. The state budgetary expenditure for important construction projects and second-stage forestation campaign will increase by 6.6 percent, which include the reconstruction of the "Hall of Great Leaders and Comrades-in-Arms" in the Korean Revolution Museum, sprucing up of Samjiyon County as an iconic mountainous city of modern civilization and socialist utopia and construction of the Wonsan-Kalma coastal tourist area, Sunchon Phosphate Fertilizer Factory, hot-spring tourist area in Yangdok County, Onpho Greenhouse Farm, Orangchon Power Station, Tanchon Power Station and second-stage construction of the South Hwanghae Province Waterway. Expenditure for people-oriented policies will increase 5.5 percent for education and 5.8 percent for public health and expenditure for social and cultural work 4.1 percent for literature and arts and 4.5 percent for sports over last year. 15.8 percent of the total budgetary expenditure will go to national defence. A lot of educational aid fund and stipends will be sent for Korean children in Japan this year, too, to keep propelling the development of democratic national education of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan. The reporter stressed that successful implementation of the state budget for this year for a step forward in socialist construction will offer financial support for the work for the prosperity and development of the socialist country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Elected as Chairman of DPRK State Affairs Commission
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was elected as chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea at the First Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly (SPA). Reflecting the general will of all the Korean people, the SPA solemnly declared at home and abroad that Kim Jong Un who is making a new history of modeling the whole society on Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism with his outstanding ideological and theoretical wisdom and experienced and seasoned leadership and demonstrating the politico-ideological might and tremendous power of socialist Korea on the highest level with the people-first and our state-first principles was elected as chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK. The election of the Supreme Leader as chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK is the great political event of crucial historical significance in further consolidating and developing the DPRK into Kim Il Sung's and Kim Jong Il's state forever and accomplishing the revolutionary cause of Juche generation after generation and an auspicious revolutionary event that guarantees the eternal future and prosperity of Kim Il Sung's Korea for all ages. Holding Kim Jong Un invariably in high esteem as the top leader of the DPRK is the reflection of the deep reverence and trust of all the party members, people and servicepersons of the People's Army in him who has opened up a bright future of all generations to come by leading the Workers' Party of Korea and the DPRK to only victory with his rare political abilities and sweeping revolutionary practices. Rodong Sinmun

title: First Session of 14th SPA Held
body: The First Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea took place at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Thursday. Newly-elected deputies to the SPA were present there. Officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, the Presidium of the SPA, the Cabinet, armed forces organs, ministries and national institutions, chairpersons of the party committees and people's committees of cities and counties and officials of the central and provincial organs were present there as observers. The participants observed a moment's silence in reverence for President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. Deputy Yang Hyong Sop made an opening address. The session elected Deputy Pak Thae Song as chairman of the SPA and Deputies Pak Chol Min and Pak Kum Hui as its vice-chairpersons. It also held an election for the Deputy Credentials Committee of the 14th SPA. The session discussed the following agenda items: 1. Election of chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK 2.Election of state leadership bodies of the DPRK 3. On Modifying and Supplementing the Socialist Constitution of the DPRK 4. On summing up the execution of the state budget of the DPRK for Juche 107 (2018) and the state budget for Juche 108 (2019) When Deputy Choe Ryong Hae courteously proposed the SPA to elect Kim Jong Un as chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, the post of the supreme representative of all the Korean people and the supreme leader of the Republic, in the discussion of the first agenda item, all the participants expressed absolute support and approval for it. The session declared that Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, was elected as chairman of the State Affairs Commission (SAC) of the DPRK. It discussed the second agenda item. It elected Choe Ryong Hae as first vice-chairman of the SAC of the DPRK, Pak Pong Ju as its vice-chairman and Kim Jae Ryong, Ri Man Gon, Ri Su Yong, Kim Yong Chol, Thae Jong Su, Ri Yong Ho, Kim Su Gil, No Kwang Chol, Jong Kyong Thaek, Choe Pu Il and Choe Son Hui as its members. It also elected Choe Ryong Hae as president of the Presidium of the SPA of the DPRK, Thae Hyong Chol and Kim Yong Dae as its vice-presidents, Jong Yong Guk as its secretary general and Kim Yong Chol, Kim Nung O, Kang Ji Yong, Ju Yong Gil, Kim Chang Yop, Jang Chun Sil, Pak Myong Chol, Ri Myong Chol, Kang Su Rin, Kang Myong Chol, and Ri Chol as its members. It elected Deputy Kim Jae Ryong as premier of the DPRK Cabinet. The members of the Cabinet proposed by the premier of the Cabinet were appointed with unanimous approbation. Ro Tu Chol was appointed as vice-premier and concurrently chairman of the State Planning Commission, Im Chol Ung, Kim Tok Hun, Ri Ju O, Ri Ryong Nam, Jon Kwang Ho and Tong Jong Ho as vice-premiers, Ko secretary general of the Cabinet. It appointed Kim Myong Gil as director of the Central Public Prosecutors Office and elected Kang Yun Sok as president of the Central Court. It also held elections for the Legislation Committee, the Budget Committee and the Foreign Affairs Committee, which are panel committees of the SPA. Choe Pu Il was elected as chairman of the Legislation Committee, and Kim Myong Gil, Kang Yun Sok, Pak Jong Nam, Kim Yong Bae, Jong Kyong Il and Ho Kwang Il were elected as its members. O Su Yong was elected as chairman of the Budget Committee and Ri Hi Yong, Hong So Hon, Kim Kwang Uk, Choe Yong Il, Pak Hyong Ryol and Ri Kum Ok were elected as its members. Ri Su Yong was elected as chairman of the Foreign Affairs Committee and Ri Ryong Nam, Ri Son Gwon, Kim Jong Suk, Choe Son Hui, Kim Song Il and Kim Tong Son were elected as its members. The premier of the Cabinet made an oath on behalf of the members of the Cabinet. Deputy Kim Phyong Hae, chairman of the Deputy Credentials Committee, made a report of the committee of the 14th SPA and a decision approving it was adopted. According to the report, the Deputy Credentials Committee confirmed that all the members elected to be deputies to the 14th SPA assume qualifications to be deputies. Among them are anti-Japanese revolutionary fighters and war veterans who heroically fought for the country and the people, holding arms during the anti-Japanese armed struggle and the Fatherland Liberation War and who have continuously devoted themselves to the completion of the revolutionary cause of Juche. Factory and enterprise workers registering considerable labor achievements in the van of the general advance for building a powerful socialist country account for 16.2 percent, cooperative farmers 9.6 percent and soldiers performing feats for the defence of the country and at sites for socialist construction 17.2 percent. The deputies include officials of party and power organs, administrative and economic bodies, working people's organizations, and those of various fields including the fields of science, education, public health, sports, literature and art, press and media, and also officials of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan and organizations under it. Out of them, winners of Order of Kim Il Sung, Order of Kim Jong Il, Kim Il Sung Prize, Kim Jong Il Prize hold 20.7 percent, winners of the titles of DPRK Hero and Labor hero 13.5 percent, holders of academic degrees and titles like professors and doctors and holders of technical and expert qualifications 92 percent. 94.8 percent of the deputies have knowledge of university graduates. 4.8 percent of them are under age 39, 63.9 percent are between age 40 to 59 and 31.3 percent are above age 60 and women make up 17.6 percent. The session discussed the third agenda item. It adopted an ordinance of the SPA on modifying and supplementing the Socialist Constitution of the DPRK. Deputy Ki Kwang Ho made a speech on the fourth agenda item. The speakers referred to their delight of having elected Kim Jong Un to the top post of the Republic. They expressed full support and approbation, acknowledging that last year's work was correctly summed up in the state budgetary report presented to the SPA for discussion, and that this year's state budget was properly shaped to be able to focus all efforts on economic construction. Adopted at the session were a decision of the SPA of the DPRK "On approving the summing up of the execution of the state budget for Juche 107 (2018)" and an ordinance of the SPA of the DPRK "On state budget of the DPRK for Juche 108 (2019)". The session will continue. Rodong Sinmun

title: Vietnamese State Art Troupe Here
body: A Vietnamese state art troupe arrived here on Thursday to visit the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. The troupe is headed by Vo Van Phuong, member of the Communist Party of Vietnam Central Committee (CPVCC) and permanent vice-chairman of the CPVCC's Commission for Education and Information. It consists of famous Vietnamese artistes. It is accompanied by officials of the Commission for Education and Information and External Affairs Commission of the CPVCC and the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam. Rodong Sinmun

title: Art Performances Given Here
body: The participants in the Sixth April Spring People's Art Festival gave their first performances at theatres and halls here on Thursday to mark the Day of the Sun, the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Artistes of art troupes, art squad members, itinerant art squad members and art circle members from every province enthusiastically showed the Korean people's yearning and reverence for Kim Il Sung through their high ideological value and artistry and good musical representation. Artistes of art troupes of North Hamgyong Province, North Phyongan Province, Nampho City, South Phyongan Province and Ryanggang Province gave their performances at the Pyongyang Grand Theatre and artistes of the art troupes of North and South Hwanghae, South Hamgyong, Kangwon and Jagang provinces at the Ponghwa Art Theatre. Performances were given by artistes of the art squad of the Central Committee of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League, the workers' art squad of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea and art squads of North Phyongan and South Hamgyong provinces and Nampho City at the Central Youth Hall. Itinerant art squad members gave performances at the Chollima Hall of Culture and the National Theatre. Members of the working people's art groups from across the country gave their performances at the People's Palace of Culture and the Cultural Hall of the Ministry of Railways. The Magic Theatre of the National Acrobatic Troupe witnessed a performance of jugglers of different art troupes, art squads and magic fans. Enjoying the performances were members of the festival organizing committee and officials, working people, students and other young people here. Rodong Sinmun

title: Juche Idea Followers Here
body: Juche idea followers arrived here on Thursday ahead of the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, the Day of the Sun. Among them are a delegation of the Study Forum for Self-Reliance of Nepal headed by Chairman Subash Kaji Shrestha, a delegation of the Nepali Literary Forum for the Study of Songun Politics headed by Chairman Sonkori Baroti, a delegation of the Ethiopian Committee for the Study of the Independent Politics headed by Chairman Abdi Kedir, a delegation of the British Group for the Study of the Juche Idea headed by Chairman Dermot Hudson, a delegation of the Czech Group for the Study and Materialization of the Juche Idea headed by First Vice-Chairman Lukas Vrobel, a delegation of the Sri Lanka Society for Self-Reliance Studies headed by Vice-Chairman Pradif Viseratna Sekara, a delegation of the Bangladesh Institute of the Juche Idea headed by Adviser MD. Harun-Ar-Rashid, a delegation of the Mongolian Organization for the Study of the Juche Idea headed by J. Lomvo, Takao Kamakura, director of the International Institute of the Juche Idea, and his party, Alhassan Mamman Muhammad, chairman of the Nigerian National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, Volodymyr Polishchuk, chairman of the Ukrainian Youth and Students' Association for the Study of the Juche Idea, Abdoulaye Diallo, chairman of the Guinean Society for the Study of the Juche Literary Idea, Thomas Losh, chief of the Group for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism in Vienna, Austria and Daniel Rugarama, vice-chairman of the Ugandan National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea. Rodong Sinmun

title: Many Korean Stamps Displayed to Mark Day of Sun
body: Many Korean stamps were put on display under the subject of "Eternal Sun of Mankind" at the Korean Stamp Exhibition House on Thursday ahead of the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (Day of the Sun). On display are upwards of 420 stamps of over 220 kinds dealing with the revolutionary careers of the peerlessly great persons at the house where photos of stamps carrying the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il are seen. The event will continue till April 20. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Symposium on Medical Science Held
body: A national symposium on medical science was held at the Sci-Tech Complex on Wednesday and Thursday to mark the 45th anniversary of the publication of Chairman Kim Jong Il's work "On Further Improving the Public Health Service". The work, published on April 9, Juche 63 (1974), comprehensively indicates the tasks and ways for thoroughly implementing the policy of preventive medicine set forth by the Workers' Party of Korea, improving health care and developing medical science and technology. Kim Hyong Hun, chairman of the Central Committee of the Medical Association of Korea, said in his speech at the seminar that Kim Jong Il's work serves as important guidelines for putting health service onto a new high stage and a classical document which gives comprehensive answers to all theoretical and practical problems arising in settling the issue of the public health from the Juche-based viewpoint. The leadership of Kim Jong Il gave fuller play to the advantage of the socialist public health system constantly serving for the lives and health of the people, he said. He called upon public health workers to thoroughly implement the tasks set forth in Kim Jong Il's work and the Party's policy of public health and thus ensure the lives and health of the people with medical sci-tech successes by modernizing the pharmaceutical factories and medical appliances factories and decisively improving medical service. The symposium, divided into panels of surgery, internal medicine, hygiene and anti-epidemics, basic medicine, pharmacy and Koryo medicine, heard more than 340 valuable papers on medical science. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of DPRK-China Friendship Association Meets Chinese Dignitary
body: A delegation of the DPRK-China Friendship Association headed by Chairman Pak Kyong Il, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries, met with Yang Chuantang, vice-chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, in Beijing on April 10. Pak Kyong Il said that thanks to the four rounds of meetings between the supreme leaders of the two countries the bilateral relations have undergone unprecedented development. He expressed the will to jointly strive for the overall prosperity of the bilateral relations of friendship this year marking the 70th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the two countries. Yang Chuantang said that the two countries have a long-standing tradition of friendship, adding: Invariable is the unwavering stand of the Chinese party and government on boosting bilateral relations no matter how the international and regional situations may change. He hoped that the Korean people would achieve bigger successes in implementing the new strategic line of the Workers' Party of Korea under the guidance of Chairman Kim Jong Un. Present at the meeting were the DPRK charge d'affaires ad interim to China, a vice-chairperson of the Chinese People's Association for Friendship with Foreign Countries and other officials concerned. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Makes Policy Speech at First Session of 14th SPA
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un made a policy speech "On Socialist Construction and the Internal and External Policies of the Government of the Republic at the Present Stage" at the First Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea on Friday. Kim Jong Un extended heartfelt thanks to all the deputies for expressing great trust in him on behalf of all the people to lead the overall work of the DPRK, the glorious country, once again as chairman of the DPRK State Affairs Commission and solemnly pledged to dedicate himself to the development and prosperity of the DPRK and the happiness of the people. He said that it is the important historic task of the government of the Republic to accomplish the cause of socialism under the uplifted banner of modeling the whole society on Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism. Modeling the whole society on Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism is the supreme programme of the Party and the government of the Republic and the general orientation and goal in building the socialist country, he stressed. He noted that the main task for us in modeling the whole society on Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism is to accomplish the cause of building a powerful socialist country. He said that the idea of building the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist state comprehensively deals with the state building idea and feats of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il who strengthened and developed the DPRK into the most dignified and powerful socialist country in history, adding it also clearly indicates the orientation and ways for accomplishing the socialist cause with the state power as a political weapon. Independence is the political philosophy of the DPRK and the core in the idea of building the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist state, he noted. It is the invariable and firm stand of the DPRK to adhere to the revolutionary line of independence in the state building and activities, he stressed. Noting that it is necessary to thoroughly preserve the people-first principle in state activities and in all fabrics of social life, he underlined the need to ensure the Party's leadership over the overall work of the state in every way. He said that the party's leadership is the intrinsic requirement of building the socialist country and the lifeline of state activities. He said that the major task facing the DPRK in the struggle of the present stage for building a powerful socialist country is to firmly consolidate the material foundation of socialism by concentrating all the efforts of the country on the economic construction. The trend of present political situation demands that the DPRK hold higher the banner of self-supporting and self-reliance, he said, adding: In fear of the security of its own land in the face of the rapid development of the nuclear armed forces of the DPRK, the U.S. floated the idea of improved relations and peace at the negotiations and on the other hand, made desperate efforts to create the conditions for forcing the DPRK to drop arms and toppling its social system after making it run off its way through persistent application of economic sanctions. Now that the U.S. describes its demands running counter to the fundamental interests of our country as conditions for the lift of sanctions, the stand-off with the U.S. will naturally assume the protracted nature and sanctions by the hostile forces will also continue. Sanctions come to be a last resort for those forces finding it hard to bring down the DPRK by force, but constitute an intolerable challenge to the DPRK that can never be overlooked but must be weathered and foiled. As the protracted nuclear threats were done away with nuclear weapons, it is necessary to sweep away the whirlwind of sanctions by the hostile forces with the hot wind of self-supporting and self-reliance. The strategic policy maintained by our party and the DPRK government in socialist economic construction is to put the national economy on a Juche, modern, IT and scientific basis. The independent and Juche characters of the national economy have to be augmented in every way. We have to definitely turn the country's economy into knowledge-based economy through an active drive for putting it on a modern and IT basis. It is required to develop local economy and activate external economic affairs. The economy of the country has to be carried out under the unified control, strategic operation and command of the state. Talents and science and technology serve as key engines for the development of self-supporting economy. The political and military might of the country has to be further increased. The DPRK government should train all the members of society to be genuine Kimilsungists-Kimjongilists and further consolidate the politico-ideological unity and cohesion of the country by giving definite precedence to the political and ideological work as required by the intrinsic nature of the socialist society. It has to perfect the legal system of the country and strengthen the role of laws in the state activities and social life. Self-reliant national defence capabilities constitute a powerful treasured sword for defending the sovereignty of the country. The climate of peace that began settling in the Korean peninsula is not durable and the hostile forces' attempt at invasion of the DPRK has not gone. We have to always keep in mind that peace can be ensured only by powerful military capabilities, and firmly maintain the principle of self-defence and keep increasing the defence capabilities of the country. We have to bring into full bloom and develop socialist culture our own way. The trait of giving top national priority to education should be established and the level of education of developed countries has to be outpaced by stepping up our-style revolution in education. It is needed for the DPRK government to put particular efforts on the socialist health care. The field of culture and art has to create more masterpieces reflecting the needs of the times and desire of the people, and the film field, in particular, has to raise a revolution in film-making in the new century and thus play a pace-setter role in opening up the new heyday of the development of socialist culture. Physical culture and sports play a very important role in increasing the might of the country and demonstrating the resourcefulness and dignity of the nation. Establishing socialist lifestyle and morality is a serious political struggle and an acute class struggle to defend and glorify our idea and social system. It is imperative to enhance the function and role of the people's power bodies in order to successfully carry out the huge revolutionary tasks facing the DPRK government, the Supreme Leader said. Noting that our historic struggle for the reunification of the country, the long-cherished desire of the nation, has now entered a new phase, he continued: The three historic north-south summit meetings and talks and the adoption of north-south declarations last year meant a great event of exceptionally huge significance that turned back the serious situation from inching close to a war and declared the start of a new journey toward national reunification. Now the entire nation ardently hopes that the historic Panmunjom Declaration and the September Pyongyang Joint Declaration would be thoroughly implemented to lead to the continued peaceful atmosphere on the Korean peninsula and the steady improvement of the north-south ties. However, the conservative forces of south Korea are responding to the desire of the nation and the unanimous expectation of the international community with untrustworthy words and acts and making desperate struggle to turn the north-south ties back to those in the period before the publication of the Panmunjom Declaration. The U.S. is openly forcing the south Korean authorities to "control speed" and moving in every way to subordinate the implementation of the north-south agreement to its policy of sanctions and pressure on the DPRK. Because of this, we now face a serious situation of whether to defuse tension and keep maintaining the atmosphere of improving the north-south ties or to go back to the past when the ties plunged into a catastrophe with the danger of a war increasing. I make it clear once again that it is my unwavering determination, as clarified before, to turn the north-south ties into those of durable and lasting reconciliation and cooperation by holding hands with the south Korean authorities and to write a new history of the nation, peaceful and co-prosperous, as wished by all the fellow countrymen. In order to give further momentum to the good atmosphere of improved relations which the north and the south provided with much efforts after putting inglorious situation under control and to lead them to the meaningful result of peace and reunification, we have to put an end to the nature of sycophancy tarnishing the spirit of independence and the policy of relying on outsiders damaging the interests common to the nation, and subordinate everything to the improvement of the north-south ties. I think that the south Korean authorities should come back to their stand at the time of the Panmunjom meeting and the September Pyongyang meeting and fulfill their responsibility before the nation through the sincere implementation of the north-south declarations if they truly wish for the improved north-south ties and peace and reunification. The south Korean authorities should not act an officious "mediator" and "booster" that adopt a vacillating stand depending on the trend and engage themselves in an array of visits, but be a party advocating the interests of the nation with its own spirit and voice, being part of the nation. It is our consistent stand that in order to give further momentum to the atmosphere of improving the north-south ties, it is prerequisite to foil the moves of hostile forces against reunification and peace at home and abroad. It is important to understand before it becomes too late that it will be hard to expect any progress in the north-south ties and any result of peace and prosperity as long as the war-like south Korean military forces are left intact in their disguised persistent hostile acts including the resumption of the joint military exercises with the U.S. in other codenames, though they were agreed to be stopped, and unless a fundamental liquidation is put to the anachronistic arrogance and hostile policy of the U.S. which creates a deliberate hurdle in the improvement of ties while coming forward with unilateral gangster-like demands. All the Koreans in the north and the south and abroad have to resolutely foil the moves of the U.S. and the south Korean conservative forces challenging the historical trend toward the improvement of the north-south ties and peace and reunification, for the sake of the destiny and future of the nation. If the south Korean authorities have a true intent to head for the improvement of the north-south ties and peace and reunification, they have to sympathize with our stand and will and keep pace with them and take a bold decision proving their sincerity in practical acts, not in words. The Singapore DPRK-U.S. summit and talks that were held in June last year for the first time in history in the limelight of the world served as an eventful occasion that instilled the hope of settlement of peace on the Korean peninsula where the exchanges of fire had been observed, and the June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement commanded full support and approval by the international community desirous of peace as it marked a historic declaration that communicated to the world that the two countries DPRK and U.S. would write a new history of relations. The DPRK took the first step of confidence-building, a key to defusing the hostile relations between the DPRK and the U.S. through crucial and meaningful measures like a moratorium on the nuclear test and test-fire of ICBM, and demonstrated its will to sincerely follow through on the June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement, a landmark in establishing the new DPRK-U.S. relations through such a bold measure of facilitating the repatriation of the remains of GIs as requested by the U.S. president. But the second DPRK-U.S. summit in Hanoi in February became an occasion which aroused a strong question if we were right in taking the steps with strategic decision and bold resolution, and evoked vigilance as to the U.S. true willingness to improve its relations with the DPRK. At the second DPRK-U.S. summit, we expressed our decision to take more prudent and trustworthy measures after setting stages and courses indispensable for the implementation of the June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement and expected a response from the U.S. to it. But the U.S. came to the talks, only racking its brains to find ways that are absolutely impracticable. In a word, the U.S. did not ready itself to sit face to face with us and settle the problem nor had a clear direction and methodology. If it keeps thinking that way, it will never be able to move the DPRK even a knuckle nor gain any interests no matter how many times it may sit for talks with the DPRK. There are now open hostile moves running counter to the June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement, as exemplified by the U.S. recent test simulating the interception of ICBM from the DPRK and the resumption of the military exercises whose suspension was directly committed to by the U.S. president. These seriously rattle us. As wind is bound to bring waves, the U.S. open hostile policy toward the DPRK will naturally bring our corresponding acts. Now the U.S. is strongly suggesting its thinking of holding the 3rd DPRK-U.S. summit talks and the settlement of the issue through dialogue. Yet, it is still shunning the withdrawal of its hostile policy, the fundamental way of establishing the new DPRK-U.S. relations, and miscalculating that it can bring us to our knees if it puts maximum pressure on us. Of course we also attach importance to the settlement of the issue through dialogue and negotiations, but American-style way of dialogue to impose its unilateral demand upon the dialogue partner does not suit our constitution and we have no interest in it. The U.S. is further escalating the hostility to us with each passing day despite its suggestion for settling the issue through dialogue. It is as foolish and dangerous an act as trying to put out fire with oil. Given the existence of deep-rooted hostility between the DPRK and the U.S., in order to implement the June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement it is necessary for both sides not to table their unilateral demands but find out a constructive solution to meeting each other's interests. To this end, it is essential for the U.S. to quit its current calculation method and approach us with new one. The U.S. is now talking a lot about the 3rd DPRK-U.S. summit meeting, but the resumption of such summit as the Hanoi summit is not inviting to us nor we have an intent. But as President Trump keeps saying, the personal ties between me and him are not hostile like the relations between the two countries and we still maintain good relations, as to be able to exchange letters asking about health anytime if we want. If the U.S. adopts a correct posture and comes forward for the third DPRK-U.S. summit with a certain methodology that can be shared with us, we can think of holding one more talks. However, what I feel now is if there will be any need to keep an attachment to the summit with the U.S. just because of the issue of sanctions relief. Anyway, we will wait for a bold decision from the U.S. with patience till the end of this year but I think it will definitely be difficult to get such a good opportunity as the previous summit. Only when there provided written content favorable for the interests of both sides and acceptable to each other, I will sign the agreement without reserve and this depends on in what position and with what calculation method the U.S. would come forward. What is clear is that if the U.S. persists in its present political calculation method, the prospect of settling the issues will be gloomy and very dangerous. I anticipate that the U.S. would make a wise decision at the crucial moment today and hope that the second hand of the confrontation between the DPRK and the U.S. brought to a stop with much effort will not run again forever, he said. He emphasized that the DPRK government would develop friendly and cooperative relations with all the countries that respect the DPRK's sovereignty and are friendly to it and join hands with the world peace-loving forces in order to establish a lasting and durable peace mechanism on the Korean peninsula. He called for making a general advance to successfully accomplish the cause of building a powerful socialist country in close unity around the Party and the government of the Republic under the uplifted banner of great Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism.

title: SPA Deputies Enjoy Art Performance "Our National Flag"
body: Art performance "Our National Flag" was given at the East Pyongyang Grand Theatre on Friday in honor of deputies to the 14th Supreme People's Assembly (SPA) of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. Among the audience were Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea (WPK), first vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea and president of the Presidium of the SPA, Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, vice-chairman of the DPRK State Affairs Commission and vice-chairman of the WPK Central Committee, Kim Jae Ryong, member of the DPRK State Affairs Commission and premier of the Cabinet, and deputies to the 14th SPA. Artistes of leading art troupes successfully put on the stage masterpieces of the times. Patriotic feelings pervaded the hall as it resounded with prelude "Our National Flag" led by children. The performers made a solemn and beautiful, musical epical depiction of the glorious history of the DPRK that has won victory after victory upholding the banner of self-reliance under the leadership of the great Party in such numbers as orchestral music and male chorus "We Started from Scratch" and female duet and male chorus "Are We Living like in Those Days?" and "We Wish Comrade Supreme Commander Good Health". Serial songs "The Dear Name Called by People", female solo and male chorus "We Will Follow Marshal to End" reminded the audience of the glorious days when they led a worthwhile life as revolutionary fighters. The performance was acclaimed by the audience. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Has Photo Session with Members of SPA Presidium and Cabinet and Deputies to 14th SPA
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, had a photo session with the members of the newly-formed Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly (SPA) and the Cabinet and deputies to the 14th SPA before the Mansudae Assembly Hall on April 12. The moment Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un appeared in the photographing venue, all the deputies to SPA broke into cheers of "hurrah!" looking up to him. After expressing the expectation and belief that the deputies would successfully fulfill the revolutionary duty as faithful servants of the people and the first standard-bearers in implementing the Party policies, always bearing in mind the deep trust and expectation of the Party and people, he had a photo session with the members of the newly-formed SPA Presidium and Cabinet and then with all the deputies to the 14th SPA. Political News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Has Photo Session with Newly-elected Members of Party and State Leadership Bodies
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, met the newly-elected members of the leadership bodies of the Party and state at the headquarters building of the Party Central Committee on April 12 and had a photo session with them. The moment Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un appeared, all the participants broke into cheers of "hurrah!" looking up to him. He congratulated them, warmly responding to their cheers. After expressing the expectation and belief that they would successfully fulfill the responsibility and duty as leading members of the revolution in the sacred struggle to pave the road to the prosperity by their own efforts and bring earlier the great victory of a powerful socialist country, always well aware of the sacred mission assigned to them by the Party and people, he had a photo session with them. Then he met with the Presidium members and members of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee to warmly share the feelings of revolutionary comradeship, and left scenes to go down in the history of the Party and had a photo session with the members of the State Affairs Commission. Political News Team

title: First Session of 14th SPA of DPRK Finishes
body: The First Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea continued at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Friday. It was presided over by Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and chairman of the State Affairs Commission (SAC) of the DPRK. Seen on the platform were newly-elected state leading officials: Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, first vice-chairman of the SAC of the DPRK and president of the Presidium of the SPA, Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, vice-chairman of the SAC of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the WPK Central Committee, and Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, member of the SAC of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet. Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un made a policy speech. Kim Jong Un in his speech stressed that modeling the whole society on Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism is the supreme programme of our Party and the government of the Republic and the general orientation and goal in socialist state-building. He clearly specified the main tasks in modeling the whole society on Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism and the major tasks of the government of the Republic and ways for the struggle of building a powerful socialist country at the present stage, analyzed the prevailing situation and declared the foreign policy stand of our Party and government. All the deputies expressed full support for the historic policy speech with loud applauses, unanimously admitting that it clearly indicates the orientation of the development of the power of the Republic and the path of building a powerful socialist country reflecting the will and requirement of the people. Choe Ryong Hae made a closing address. Expressing belief that all the deputies and participants would work hard in one mind for the prosperity of the socialist motherland, the genuine people's country, upholding the vital tasks set forth by the Supreme Leader in his historic policy speech, Choe Ryong Hae declared the session closed. Political News Team

title: Art Group Members of Women's Union Give Performance
body: Art group members of the women's union gave a performance at the Hall of Women on Friday in celebration of the 107th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. The performance began with poem and song "Let's Sing of the Day of the Sun". The performers sang in praise of the feats of the President who devoted his life to the prosperity of the country and happiness of the people and created a new history of the Korean women's movement. Oungum ensemble "Nostalgia", an immortal classic masterpiece, dialogic poem "Leader's Promise" and other numbers aroused the yearning of audience for the President who is immortal as the Sun of Juche. Put on the stage were kayagum ensemble "Our General's Motto", janggu ensemble "My Prospering Country", etc. Enjoying the performance were officials concerned, officials of the women's union and its members here. Rodong Sinmun

title: Home-visiting Group of Koreans in Japan Arrives
body: A home-visiting group of Koreans in Japan headed by Pak Hae Chol, vice department director of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan, arrived here on Friday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Overseas Koreans Visit Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Overseas Koreans visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on Friday to lay bouquets and pay tributes to them. They included a congratulatory group of Koreans in Japan for celebrating the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (Day of the Sun), congratulatory group of the General Association of Koreans in China for celebrating the Day of the Sun, delegation of the International United Confederation of Koreans, delegation of the United Confederation of Koreans in the Far Eastern Region of Russia and home-visiting group of Koreans in Japan. Rodong Sinmun

title: Overseas Koreans' Delegations Here
body: Delegations of overseas Koreans arrived here on Friday, ahead of the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (Day of the Sun). They include a delegation of the International United Confederation of Koreans led by First Vice-Chairman Kim Chil Song and a delegation of the United Confederation of Koreans in the Far Eastern Region of Russia headed by Chairman Ri Ku Yul. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Mass Rally Held
body: A national mass rally took place at Kim Il Sung Square on Saturday in celebration of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's election as chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. Attending the event were leading officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs, officials of the Party Central Committee, officials of ministries, national institutions, officials of institutions and industrial establishments here and working people, students and other young people, service personnel and overseas Koreans. A celebratory report was made by Choe Ryong Hae. The reporter said that Kim Jong Un's election as the top leader of the Republic at the historic First Session of the 14th SPA and his historic policy speech made there are a great auspicious event of Juche Korea and the political event as they have redoubled the confidence in victory and fighting spirit of all the people opening a new road of advance for the socialist construction. Holding in high esteem the Supreme Leader at the top post of the state representing all the Korean people and leading the overall work of the country makes it possible to further strengthen the power of the Republic as a mighty political weapon for the building of a powerful country and to successfully realize the dream and ideal of the people by accelerating the accomplishment of the socialist cause of Juche, said the reporter. The reporter extended the greatest glory and the warmest congratulations to Kim Jong Un in reflection of the unreserved trust and ardent loyalty of all the party members, people and service personnel. He called upon all the people and service personnel to glorify socialist Korea of Juche to the whole world, true to the idea and guidance of the Supreme Leader. Celebratory speeches were made there by the delegates of the working class, agricultural workers, service personnel, intellectuals and students and other young people. Speakers said that today's auspicious event is a clear manifestation of the invincibility of the Republic dynamically advancing along the road of Juche under the guidance of him who devotes himself to bringing earlier the future of a powerful socialist country while demonstrating the dignity and might of the country over the world. They made pledges to perform feats and miracles in the sacred and worthwhile struggle for the building of a powerful socialist country, true to the idea and leadership of Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Third-day Performances of Sixth April Spring People's Art Festival Given
body: The third-day performances of the Sixth April Spring People's Art Festival were given here on Saturday. The performers represented well all the people's pledges to sing in praise of the sun forever in the socialist country where the lifelong wish of President Kim Il Sung comes true with the glory and pride of holding again in high esteem Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un as chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. The art troupes from all the provinces gave performances at the Pyongyang Grand Theatre and the Ponghwa Art Theatre and art squads at the Central Youth Hall. The Magic Theatre of the National Acrobatic Troupe witnessed diverse numbers showing the praiseworthy appearance of the country. Itinerant art squad members gave performances at the National Theatre and the Chollima Hall of Culture. Art group members from across the country also gave performances at the People's Palace of Culture and the Cultural Hall of the Ministry of Railways. Enjoying the performances were officials, working people, students and other young people here. The performances will continue. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Floral baskets were sent to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill from the family of Ya. T. Nobichenko, an internationalist soldier, Jong Il Sim, widow of DPRK Hero An Tong Su, the family of Kim Sun Ok who is related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, on the occasion of the Day of the Sun, birth anniversary of Kim Il Sung. The floral baskets were placed at the statues on April 13. On the same day the floral baskets from the Switzerland-Korea Committee and Jindallae Saphariny, president of the Jindallae Children's Foundation, were laid at the statues. Rodong Sinmun

title: Overseas Koreans Here
body: A delegation of the Federation of Koreans in Australia led by Chairman Pak Yong Ha, Chairman Kim Su Hae of the Federation of Koreans in Canada and Secretary General Kim Min Jong of the Council of Koreans in New Zealand arrived here on April 13 ahead of the Day of the Sun, President Kim Il Sung's birth anniversary. Rodong Sinmun

title: Congratulatory Message to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Russian President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a congratulatory message from Russian President V. Putin on April 12. The message extended heartfelt congratulations to Kim Jong Un on his reelection as chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK. The message expressed belief that the work of Kim Jong Un at the top post of the state would contribute to developing the friendly and good neighbourly relations between the two countries and the two peoples and strengthening the peace and security of the Korean Peninsula in the future, too. Putin in the message confirmed his willingness to work together with Kim Jong Un as regards the urgent bilateral and regional problems. The message sincerely wished Kim Jong Un new successes and good health and happiness. Rodong Sinmun

title: Congratulations to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from General Secretary of C.C., Communist Party of Vietnam
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a congratulatory message from Nguyen Phu Trong, general secretary of the Communist Party of Vietnam Central Committee and president of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, on April 12. The Vietnamese president in the message extended warm congratulations to Kim Jong Un upon his election as chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea at the First Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly. The message sincerely wished the DPRK's government and people bigger successes in their cause of building the DPRK into a prosperous and happy country under the guidance of the WPK with Kim Jong Un as its chairman. It expressed the belief that the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation between the two countries would steadily develop in conformity with the interests of the two peoples and peace, stability, cooperation and development of the region and the world, on the basis of the joint understanding obtained by the two parties and the heads of two countries during Kim Jong Un's recent official goodwill visit to Vietnam. The message wished Kim Jong Un good health and many continuous successes in his noble work. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of DPRK-China Friendship Association Returns Home
body: A delegation of the DPRK-China Friendship Association led by Chairman Pak Kyong Il, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries, came back home on Saturday after taking part in the opening ceremony of a Korean photo, book and art exhibition held in China to mark the first anniversary of the historic first visit to China by Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, and the 70th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the DPRK and China. Rodong Sinmun

title: Choe Ryong Hae Meets Joint Delegation of Political Parties of State Duma of Russia
body: Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, had a talk with a joint delegation of political parties of the State Duma of Russia led by Deputy Speaker Sergei Neberov which paid a courtesy call on him at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Saturday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Congratulatory Group of Koreans in China Visits Mangyongdae
body: A congratulatory group of the General Association of Koreans in China for celebrating the Day of the Sun headed by Vice-Chairwoman Kim Yong Nyo visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung, on Saturday. At the President's old home, the visitors looked round the historical relics, being told about the holy place of the sun associated with the sacred career of Kim Il Sung. Rodong Sinmun

title: Joint Delegation of Political Parties of State Duma of Russia Leaves
body: A joint delegation of political parties of the State Duma of Russia led by Deputy Speaker Sergei Neberov left here for home on Sunday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Russian Delegation Visits Mangyongdae
body: A joint delegation of political parties of the State Duma of Russia led by Deputy Speaker Sergei Neberov visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. At the President's old home, the visitors looked round the historical relics, being told about the life of the President dedicated to the country and the people. They also toured the Korean Revolution Museum, the Ryugyong General Ophthalmic Hospital, the Pyongyang Cosmetics Factory, the Liberation Tower, etc. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of Korean Nationality in China Here
body: A delegation of the Association for Economic and Cultural Exchange of Korean Nationality in Dandong City, China headed by Chairman Sim Chong Song arrived here on Sunday ahead of the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Baskets to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Floral baskets from the Anti-Imperialist Forum of Germany and Chairperson of the Marine Transport Council of DR Congo Mienze Kiaku were placed before the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on Sunday on the occasion of the birth anniversary of the President, the day of the Sun. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Order and Medal Awarded to Followers of Juche Idea
body: Adherents to the Juche idea were awarded the DPRK order and medal with due ceremony held at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Sunday. Order of DPRK Friendship 2nd Class went to Anatoli Dolgachev, chairman of the Association for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism in the Far East Region of Russia, O. Mashbat, executive chairman of the Mongolian Association for the Study of the Juche Idea-Songun Idea, Thomas Losh, chief of the Group for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism in Vienna, Austria, and Yasko Takizawa, member of the Secretariat of the International Institute of the Juche Idea, and the Friendship Medal to three adherents to the Juche idea. They have made positive contributions to accomplishing the human cause of independence through energetic activities for the study and dissemination of the Juche idea. Rodong Sinmun

title: Reception Given for Delegations and Delegates of Organizations for Study of Juche Idea
body: The government of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea hosted a reception in honor of delegations and delegates of organizations for the study of the Juche idea at Pyongyang Koryo Hotel on Sunday. Present there on invitation were delegations and delegates of organizations for the study of the Juche idea on a visit to the DPRK. Attending it were Kim Ki Nam, advisor to the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Ri Hye Jong, first vice-chairwoman of the Korean Association of Social Scientists and president of the Academy of Social Sciences, and officials concerned. Speeches were made. Rodong Sinmun

title: Russian Delegation Visits Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: A joint delegation of political parties of the State Duma of Russia led by Deputy Speaker Sergei Neberov visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on Sunday. The members of the delegation paid homage to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. They also paid tribute to the great leaders in the halls where they lie in state. They made rounds of the halls where the orders the great leaders received are on display and the halls that house cars, electric car, boat and train coaches used by them during their field guidance and foreign tour till the last moments of their lives. Rodong Sinmun

title: Taesong Department Store Remodeled
body: Taesong Department Store has been remodeled ahead of the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (Day of the Sun). Exhibited in diverse ways and styles at the department store were various foodstuffs, household goods, school things, goods for cultural use, etc. As the store has been remodeled into a comprehensive and all-purpose service center, modern department store that will provide commercial, public and catering services according to people's demand, taste and favor, it came to be conducive to ensuring the convenience of customers to the maximum and enhancing the material and cultural life of people. An inauguration ceremony took place on Sunday. Attending the ceremony were An Jong Su, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and officials and employees of the Kyonghung Guidance Bureau and the department store. The store will start service from April 15, Day of the Sun. Rodong Sinmun

title: Maebongsan Spring Water Factory Inaugurated
body: The Maebongsan Spring Water Factory was newly built in Wonsan, the city of port and culture. The factory is a part of material foundation for the more civilized life of the people. Its inaugural ceremony was held on Sunday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Gift to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Vietnamese State Art Troupe
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a gift from the Vietnamese state art troupe on the occasion of President Kim Il Sung's birth anniversary (Day of the Sun). The gift was handed over to Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, by Vo Van Phuong, member of the Communist Party of Vietnam Central Committee (CPVCC) and permanent vice-chairman of the CPVCC's Commission for Education and Information, who is head of the Vietnamese state art troupe on a visit to the DPRK on Monday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Performances Given to Mark Day of Sun
body: Performances were given by the participants in the 6th April Spring People's Art Festival at the Pyongyang Grand Theatre, Ponghwa Art Theatre, National Theatre, People's Palace of Culture, Central Youth Hall, Chollima Hall of Culture, Cultural Hall of the Ministry of Railways and the Magic Theatre of the National Acrobatic Troupe on Monday, the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (Day of the Sun). Among the audience were working people and youth and students in Pyongyang. Artistes from provincial art troupes and art squad, itinerant art squad and art group members put on the stage colorful numbers including vocal, dance and instrumental music, reflecting the firm will of all the people to hold in high esteem President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il as the eternal sun of Juche forever. They sang high of the people's absolute trust in Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un who is successfully carrying forward the cause of the great leaders and demonstrating the dignity and might of the DPRK before the world. Put on the stages were numbers depicting the Korean people who are making a new leap forward in the great advance for economic construction by dint of the spirit of self-reliance and science and technology. Performed at the Magic Theatre of the National Acrobatic Troupe were colorful numbers such as illusionary jugglery "Skill of Juggler" and "Wonderful Robert" and functional jugglery "Dove Feats". Rodong Sinmun

title: Day of Sun Celebrated Here
body: The Korean people significantly celebrated the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, the Day of the Sun. A lot of people visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the sacred temple of Juche where President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il lie in state. They paid tributes to the portraits of the smiling great leaders at the plaza of the palace. Working people, youth and students and service personnel of the People's Army visited the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill and their statues and mosaics depicting their smiling images in other parts of the country to pay tribute to them. Many people visited the venue of the 21st Kimilsungia Festival and venues of Kimilsungia exhibitions going on in every provincial site. Colorful performances could be seen at theatres and outdoor places across the country. A concert was given by the Samjiyon Orchestra at its theatre to celebrate the Day of the Sun. Artistes of the National Symphony Orchestra gave a concert at the Moranbong Theatre. Outdoor performances were arranged by artistes of the Phibada Opera Troupe and the National Folk Art Troupe in front of the Pyongyang Grand Theatre and the Three-Revolution Exhibition House. A combined circus show by the acrobats of the National Acrobatic Troupe at the Pyongyang Circus Theater delighted working people, youth and students. Celebration performances were also given across the country. Many schoolchildren joined the Korean Children's Union. And sports games took place in Pyongyang, adding festive mood to the Day of the Sun. Rodong Sinmun

title: Senior Party and Government Officials Visit Mangyongdae
body: Senior party and government officials, the chairperson of a friendly party and officials of ministries and national institutions visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung, on April 15, his birth anniversary (the Day of the Sun). They toured the Mangyongdae Revolutionary Museum and looked round historic data and relics. At the old home of the President in Mangyongdae, they looked round the historical relics. They had photos taken before the President's old home. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Congratulatory Letter from C.C., AINDF
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un on Monday received a congratulatory letter from the Central Committee of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front on his re-election as chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea at the First Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK. The letter said that Kim Jong Un's re-election is a great auspicious event of the nation which reflects the unanimous desire of the south Korean people who follow and uphold him as the great leader of the nation with all their hearts. It lauded that he is a peerlessly great man who creditably materializes the desire of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il for building a powerful country, demonstrates the might and dignity of Juche homeland and opens a bright future of the nation and a peerless patriot whom all the fellow countrymen follow. It noted that thanks to his patriotic bold decision and enormous tolerance, a grave situation on the verge of war reversed to adopt the historic joint declarations and bring about a dramatic turn in the inter-Korean relations, and a new era of independent reunification, peace and prosperity came to this land. He, a great master of independent diplomacy, considerably raises the sovereignty and influence of Juche homeland and international prestige with his superb strategy of clairvoyance and energetic external activities and is making great contributions to safeguarding global peace and stability and building a new independent society, it added. It stressed the pledge to regard Juche homeland shining with the august names of the peerlessly great men as the symbol of the dignity and pride of the nation and further activate the movement of independence, democracy and reunification, looking up to the north that is making a long drive under the guidance of the outstanding leader as a beacon of hope. Rodong Sinmun

title: Joint National Meeting of KCU Organizations Held
body: A joint national meeting of the Korean Children's Union (KCU) organizations took place at Mangyongdae Revolutionary School on April 15, the 107th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Attending the meeting were the delegates of KCU organizations from all provinces, students of Mangyongdae Revolutionary School and Kang Pan Sok Revolutionary School and schoolchildren in Pyongyang together with pupils who would join the KCU. Present there on invitation were Choe Hwi, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Kim Nung O, chairman of the Pyongyang City Party Committee, officials of the youth league, war veterans and persons of merits. The participants placed a floral basket and bunches of flowers at the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in Mangyongdae Revolutionary School and made a bow to them. Pak Chol Min, chairman of the Central Committee of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League, in his report, referred to the feats of President Kim Il Sung who wisely led the KCU to successfully fulfill its mission and duty. The parental loving care shown by the great Generalissimos to younger generations in the whole periods of their revolutionary leadership is being brought into fuller bloom thanks to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, the reporter said. He called upon all the KCU members to prepare themselves to be true sons and daughters and young revolutionaries loyal to the socialist motherland. A ceremony for admission to the KCU was held at the meeting. Led by Choe Hwi, the pupils joining KCU made an oath. Officials, war veterans and meritorious persons tied red ties around the necks of the pupils and attached KCU badges on their chests. Congratulatory speeches were made by Kim Song Bong, rector of Mangyongdae Revolutionary School, Pae Ji Song, student of Kim Il Sung University, Jong Kum Hwa, player of the Ministry of Commerce Sports Team. Rodong Sinmun

title: First-term Camping Starts in DPRK
body: The first-term camping started in schoolchildren's camps across the country on the occasion of the Day of the Sun, the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Taking part in the camping are the schoolchildren who have distinguished themselves in study, organizational life, socio-political activities and do-good-thing movement. A camping starting ceremony was held at the Songdowon International Children's Camp on Monday. Prior to the ceremony the campers laid a floral basket and bouquets at the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and made a bow to them. Camping starting ceremonies were held at the Mangyongdae Children's Camp, the Sokam Children's Camp and other camps across the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Young People Hold Dancing Parties
body: Students and other young people held dancing parties throughout the country on April 15 in celebration of the Day of the Sun, the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Young people here started dancing amidst the playing of song "Let's Sing of the Day of the Sun" in the plazas of the Arch of Triumph, Monument to Party Founding and other venues, paying the highest homage and glory to President Kim Il Sung. They enthusiastically danced to the tunes of songs "We Sing of Our Country Holding the Leader in High Esteem", "Mine Is Always the Country of Kim Il Sung", etc. They further revved up the atmosphere of the event, singing in chorus song "Let Us Display the Might of the Most Powerful Country in the World" with the confidence that only victory and glory are in store for the country as they held again in high esteem Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un carrying forward the idea and cause of the great leaders at the top post of the DPRK. On the same day, similar dancing parties took place throughout the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Baskets Placed at Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Working people, youth and students, and service personnel paid tribute to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il throughout the country to mark the Day of the Sun. Many people went to Mansu Hill missing the great leaders. Seen at the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il was a floral basket sent by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Floral baskets and bunches of flowers were laid at their statues in the names of the Party, power and armed forces organs, social organizations, ministries, national institutions, institutions at different levels here, industrial establishments, schools and units of the Korean People's Army and the Korean People's Internal Security Forces, etc. A floral basket was placed at the statues in the name of the Pyongyang Mission of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front. The visitors made a bow before the statues. Floral baskets and bunches of flowers were also laid at the statues in Kim Il Sung University, the Ministry of the People's Armed Forces, the Ministry of People's Security, the Mansudae Art Studio, etc. here in the names of institutions, enterprises and units of the Korean People's Army and the Korean People's Internal Security Forces, etc. Working people, youth and students and service personnel also paid homage to the statues and the portraits of smiling Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il in all parts of the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Guides Flight Drill of Unit 1017 of KPA Air and Anti-Aircraft Force
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the Armed Forces of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Tuesday guided the flight drill of the combat pilots of Unit 1017 of the Air and Anti-aircraft Force of the Korean People's Army. Noting that while passing by the unit he abruptly dropped in at the unit in order to learn about the flight drill of a pursuit assault plane group, Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un said it is important to make a sudden inspection of the regular readiness of unit as a fight of the air and anti-aircraft field is waged without previous notice. He issued an order for pilots of the pursuit assault planes on duty for combat to take off and perform difficult and complicated air combat actions. Seeing the practiced aviation of the pilots making all the skilled and experienced flights including takeoff, air combat actions and landing, he expressed great satisfaction over the excellent readiness to carry out any combat task irrespective of conditions and environment. He said he feels ease to see the pilots creditably carrying out anti-aircraft task to defend the capital city. Highly praising the unit as a noteworthy unit which is perfectly and correctly carrying out the Party's policy of training revolution and military and political task, he asked for conveying his regards to all the pilots and ground crew for the jets of the unit and their families. He said that all the pilots should firmly prepare themselves to be indomitable pilots who creditably carry out combat tasks, bearing in mind expectations of the country and people. He was accompanied by Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, Kim Phyong Hae, O Su Yong, Jo Yong Won and other leading officials of the C.C., WPK. Political News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Inspects Sinchang Fish Farm
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the Armed Forces of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, together with his wife Ri Sol Ju Tuesday inspected the Sinchang Fish Farm. Looking round a newly built room for education in revolutionary history, Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un said it is necessary to make a profound education in greatness through the leadership history of Chairman Kim Jong Il associated with the fish farm to add eternal luster to the exploits of him who laid a firm foundation for fish farming and opened its bright future. He was told by officials of the fish farm about the implementation of the on-the-spot guidance task and toured fish ponds, fish spawn hatching place and others to learn in detail about the management and operation of the fish farm. Noting that the People's Army did a lot of work for putting the fishing science and technology of the country on a high level, he said the whole country should follow the example of the People's Army in carrying through the Party's policy of fish farming and certainly materialize the desire of Kim Jong Il who worked heart and soul to provide the people and servicepersons of the People's Army with abundance of tasty and nutritious fish. He asked the officials and employees of the fish farm to set a higher goal and make a radical development in fish production so as to supply more fish to the public catering in the capital city and servicepersons true to Kim Jong Il's behests. He said that the Sinchang Fish Farm should live up to the Party's trust and expectation to continue to take the lead in putting fish farming on a Juche, scientific, modern, industrial and intensive basis and perform the mission and role as a standard fish farm showing the development of the fish farming technology of the country, a model and an education unit in developing the fish farming of the country. He pinpointed the problems to be overcome in the overall fish farming of the country and gave important instructions to bring about a revolutionary turn in the fish farming field. He was accompanied by Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, Kim Phyong Hae, O Su Yong, Jo Yong Won and other leading officials of the C.C., WPK. Political News Team

title: Joint Friendship Meeting with Delegations and Delegates of Organizations for Study of Juche Idea Held
body: There was a joint friendship meeting with delegations and delegates of organizations for the study of the Juche idea on Tuesday.
