Present there were Vice-Chairman of the Korean Association of Social Scientists Ri Kil Song, officials concerned and delegations and delegates of the organizations for the study of the Juche idea visiting the DPRK. The participants held colorful amusement games like running with balls in arms, tug-of-war, divided into Friendship Team and Solidarity Team. They deepened friendship, singing and dancing. Rodong Sinmun

title: Birthday Spread Sent to Centenarian
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un sent a birthday spread to Choe Nam Sun, a centenarian residing in Myonggan County, North Hamgyong Province. Born as a daughter of poor peasants before the liberation of the country, Choe keenly felt the sorrow of the statelessness, being subject to all kinds of maltreatment and humiliation. It was only after the liberation of the country by President Kim Il Sung that she could lead a worthwhile life as a human being. Out of single intention to repay the solicitude, she tried to fulfill her duty as an agricultural worker. Even after she got retired, she kept herself busy, doing household chores and other work. She is now enjoying the remaining days of her life and keeps asking her offspring to work hard for the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegations and Delegates of Juche Idea Study Organizations Visit Mangyongdae
body: Delegations and delegates of Juche idea study organizations on a visit to the DPRK visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung to mark the Day of the Sun, his birth anniversary. The guests visited the Mangyongdae Revolutionary Museum where the historical data and relics are displayed showing the revolutionary activities of the President and his family members in Mangyongdae. At the native home of the President they looked round the relics, being briefed on his revolutionary career. They visited the venue of the 21st Kimilsungia Festival, the Korean Revolution Museum, the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum, the Pyongyang Cosmetics Factory and others. Rodong Sinmun

title: Participants in 6th April Spring People's Art Festival Visit Mangyongdae
body: Participants in the 6th April Spring People's Art Festival visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. They visited the holy land of the sun in reverence for Kim Il Sung. They put bouquets at the graves of Kim Po Hyon and Ri Po Ik, and graves of Kim Hyong Jik and Kang Pan Sok and observed a moment's silence. After visiting the Mangyongdae Revolutionary Museum, they went to the native home of the President where they looked round relics in good preservation, recalling the revolutionary careers of the President and his family members in Mangyongdae. They also visited Korean Revolution Museum. They made a bow to the color sculpture of Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in the general review room. They were briefed on the exploits of the peerlessly great men, when they looked round relics and data on display in several rooms. They visited the National Gifts Exhibition House and the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum. Rodong Sinmun

title: Vietnamese State Art Troupe Leaves
body: The Vietnamese state art troupe led by Vo Van Phuong, member of the Communist Party of Vietnam Central Committee (CPVCC) and permanent vice-chairman of the CPVCC's Commission for Education and Information, left here for home on Tuesday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Members of SPA Presidium and Cabinet Visit Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: Members of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly (SPA) and the Cabinet of the DPRK visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on April 15, the 107th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. A floral basket in the joint name of the SPA Presidium and the Cabinet of the DPRK was laid at the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. The members of the SPA Presidium and the Cabinet made a bow before the statues. They paid tribute to the great leaders in the halls where they lie in state. Rodong Sinmun

title: 6th April Spring People's Art Festival Closes
body: The 6th April Spring People's Art Festival, opened here to mark the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, closed with due ceremony at the Ponghwa Art Theatre on Wednesday. Special prize went to the art troupe of North Hamgyong Province, art squad of the Central Committee of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League, itinerant art squads of the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill and the Tobacco Complex, art groups of Changsong County, Jangchon Vegetable Cooperative Farm in Sadong District and the February 8 Vinalon Complex. The group prize was awarded to 17 units, ensemble prize to 19 art pieces and 11 units, creation prize to 67 persons and prize for best acting to 53 persons. Best prize and high-grade prize were awarded to 4 jugglers who proved successful at the magic festival. Diplomas and cups relevant to festival prizes were also awarded. Then a closing performance was given. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Greetings to Syrian President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a message of greeting to Bashar Al-Assad, president of the Syrian Arab Republic, on Wednesday. The message congratulated the president and the friendly government and people of Syria on the 73rd anniversary of its independence. It wished the Syrian government and people successes in the struggle for defending the sovereignty and security of the country and achieving the stability and development under the leadership of the president, expressing belief that the historic friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries would grow stronger. Rodong Sinmun

title: Foreign Guests Visit Venue of 21st Kimilsungia Festival
body: Foreign guests, including diplomatic envoys and representatives of international bodies' missions and their wives and economic and commercial councilors corps here, visited the venue of the 21st Kimilsungia Festival on Wednesday on the occasion of the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (the Day of the Sun). They looked round the venue representing a sea of potted Kimilsungias which were brought into full bloom thanks to the sincere efforts of the Korean people, foreigners and overseas compatriots. Rodong Sinmun

title: Choe Ryong Hae Meets Overseas Koreans
body: Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, had a talk with overseas Koreans at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Wednesday. They included a congratulatory group of the General Association of Koreans in China for celebrating the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (Day of the Sun) headed by its Vice-Chairwoman Kim Yong Nyo, Kim Chil Song, first vice-chairman of the International United Confederation of Koreans and Ri Ku Yul, chairman of the United Confederation of Koreans in the Far Eastern Region of Russia. Rodong Sinmun

title: Day of Sun Celebrated in Japan
body: A Japan-DPRK friendship meeting took place in Tokyo on April 6 to mark the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, Day of the Sun. Present there were Fumihiro Himori, chairman of the Japan Committee for Supporting the Independent and Peaceful Reunification of Korea, Shingo Kanemaru, adviser to the Tokyo-Pyongyang Rainbow Bridge, and other personages of various strata. Present there on invitation were Nam Sung U, vice-chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), So Chung On, director of the Department for International Affairs and Reunification, and officials of Chongryon. Speeches were made there. Fumihiro Himori warmly congratulated the Day of the Sun, and stressed the need to conduct diverse activities aimed at making the Japanese support the reunification of the Korean peninsula and have a correct understanding of the DPRK. The adviser to the Tokyo-Pyongyang Rainbow Bridge expressed the will to strive to improve the relations between the two countries in the future, too, recalling with deep emotion the days when he was received by Kim Il Sung. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Work Off Press in Russia
body: Chairman Kim Jong Il's work "The Great Leader Comrade Kim Il Sung Will Always Be with Our People" was published in booklet by the Arton Publishing House of Russia with due ceremony on April 8. The work, published on February 11, Juche 85 (1996), clarifies the idea that setting July 8, the day when President Kim Il Sung passed away, as the greatest national memorial day is the noblest moral obligation and firm will of all the Korean people and progressive mankind to hold him in high esteem forever as the great leader of the revolutionary cause of Juche and the father of all people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Guides Test-Fire of New-Type Tactical Guided Weapon
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the Armed Forces of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, supervised and guided a test-fire of a new-type tactical guided weapon conducted by the Academy of Defence Science on Wednesday. Looking round the new-type tactical guided weapon, Kim Jong Un was told by officials concerned of the Academy of Defence Science about the formation of the weapon system and its operation mode. Saying that the completion of the development of the weapon system serves as an event of very weighty significance in increasing the combat power of the People's Army, he noted that it is a very good thing that the field of national defence science has waged a dynamic struggle for attaining core research goals set forth by the Party at the 8th Conference of Munitions Industry and thus conducted brisk activities for developing our own style weapon system which embodies four elements. He mounted an observation post to learn about a plan of the test-fire of the new-type tactical guided weapon and guided the test-fire. The design indexes of the tactical guided weapon whose advantages are appreciated for the peculiar mode of guiding flight and the load of a powerful warhead were perfectly verified at the test-fire conducted in various modes of firing at different targets. After watching the power of the new-type tactical guided weapon, he pointed out that our national defence scientists and workers in the field of the munitions industry performed another great work in increasing the country's defence capabilities, saying with pride that he had always been struck with admiration at them in the period of developing strategic weapon and our scientists, technicians and workers are, indeed, great and there is no weapon impossible to make when they are determined to do. He set the phased and strategic goals for keeping munitions production going on and putting national defence science and technology on cutting edge level and indicated detailed tasks and ways to attain them. He was accompanied by Kim Phyong Hae, O Su Yong, Jo Yong Won, Ri Pyong Chol, Kim Jong Sik and other senior officials of the Party Central Committee and commanding officers of the Korean People's Army including Kim Su Gil, Ri Yong Gil, No Kwang Chol, Pak Jong Chon and Pak Kwang Ju. Political News Team

title: Editorial
body: Let Us Make General Advance towards Fresh Victory Upholding Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un’s Policy Speech Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un made a policy speech “On Socialist Construction and the Internal and External Policies of the Government of the Republic at the Present Stage” at the First Session of the 14th Supreme People’s Assembly of the DPRK. The speech deals with all the principled issues to be adhered to in the State building and activities, including the issue of sticking to the independent revolutionary line, the issue of thoroughly applying the people-first principle and the issue of ensuring the leadership of the Party in every way. His policy speech is a powerful weapon to successfully accomplish the cause of building a powerful socialist country by applying the state-building idea and principle indicated by Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism. The policy speech serves as a militant banner as it clarifies all the tasks and ways for further accelerating socialist construction at the present stage. The policy speech also serves as a beacon illuminating the way to continuously develop the north-south relations and ensure peace on the Korean peninsula by frustrating the moves of hostile forces going against historic trend. To thoroughly apply the spirit and requirements of the historic policy speech is the best way for bringing earlier the day of national reunification and ensuring global peace and security. Let us make a general advance towards the victory in the cause of Juche-oriented socialism, closely rallied around the Workers’ Party of Korea and the DPRK Government.

title: Oath-taking Meeting Takes Place in Kangwon Province
body: An oath-taking meeting of Kangwon Province took place in Haean Plaza of Wonsan on Thursday to bring about a great upsurge on work sites of socialist construction under the uplifted banner of self-reliance, the treasured sword for prosperity. Attending the meeting were officials of Party and power organs, working people's organizations, institutions, industrial establishments, cooperative farms and universities and labor innovators in the province. Pak Jong Nam, alternate members of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the Kangwon Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, read a letter to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Then oath-taking speeches were made. Speakers said that self-reliance is a transparent revolutionary stand with which to make revolution of one's own country to the last in a responsible manner no matter how long and arduous the revolution is and a traditional spirit of struggle of the Korean people whose validity and might have been proved in socialist construction. Saying that they will resolutely smash the challenge of the hostile forces by dint of self-reliance staking the honor of the Korean people, they expressed the will to turn Kangwon Province into the first self-supporting province of high civilization. They proposed to send the appeal for bringing a great upswing in work sites of socialist construction by taking self-reliance as the treasured sword for prosperity to the working people across the country and all the participants in the meeting fully supported the proposal. The meeting adopted the appeal. The appeal stressed that as Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un said in the historic policy speech, we will move towards a high goal of building a powerful socialist country by dint of self-reliance whether the hostile forces lift sanctions or not, and translate our dream and desire into reality by our own efforts. The appeal in the name of the creators of the spirit of Kangwon Province called upon all the working people across the country as follows: Let us take self-reliance as the treasured sword for prosperity and wage all-people death-defying campaign for a great upswing in socialist construction. Let all the people ranging from officials in charge of the important missions of the country to ordinary producers become masters of self-reliance and self-development who do all work by their own efforts in the spirit of self-reliance. Let all the units regard talents and science and technology, not money and materials, as the most precious resources so that scientists, technicians and skilled workers give full play to their passion and ability. Let us direct top priority effort to improving the contents and methods of education and give face-lifting to educational conditions and environment with the viewpoint that without attaching importance to education it is impossible to have our own talents and sci-tech forces and live with our own efforts even after an elapse of decades. Let the workers across the country rise up as one for a vigorous struggle for increased production and creation as well as a dynamic production drive to devotedly safeguard the spirit of the Fourth Plenary Meeting of the Seventh Central Committee of the Party. Let the masters of farming not to put the blame on soil, fertilizer and atmospheric conditions, but believe in their own strength and scientific farming methods and make soil fertile so as to increase the number of high-yielding farms, workteams, sub-workteams and farmers. Let us keeps our feet firmly planted on our land and look out over the world, add luster to the socialist homeland and create more remarkable intellectual assets for the early building of a powerful country with the intelligent and clear head of Koreans armed with the spirit of self-reliance. Let us keep in mind the trust of the Party that put us forward as the masters of our dignified country and fully demonstrate the spirit and courage of the Korean young men and women in the present general death-defying drive. Let us the strong mettle and resourcefulness of the Korean women in a worthwhile struggle for bringing earlier a brighter future of socialism. Let us grasp the mass work method of our Party, set a good example in all work and become true servants of the people who devotedly work for their sake. Let us devotedly defend the Supreme Leader with edifices of self-reliance built in the strong and brave spirit of the heroic people and bring earlier the happy future. Let us hand the spirit of self-reliance down to posterity as eternal social customs of Juche Korea. The appeal stressed that the people of Kangwon Province ardently appealed to bring about a great upswing in socialist construction through the struggle for creating the all-people Mallima speed movement, firmly believing that all the working people across the country will turn out as one in the grand march of self-reliance true to the calls of the Party. Then followed a public procession. The participants in the public procession passed through the plaza to the tune of wind music with placards and hand-slogan boards bearing revolutionary and militant slogans and letters. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Reply Message to Vietnamese President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a reply message to Nguyen Phu Trong, general secretary of the Communist Party of Vietnam Central Committee and president of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, on April 17. The message said: I express deep thanks for your warm congratulations and best wishes to me on my re-election as chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK. Your congratulations are powerful support and encouragement to the struggle of our Party, state and people for building a powerful socialist country. The recent meaningful meeting with you became a solid foundation to put on a new high level the DPRK-Vietnam friendship which was forged and consolidated by the preceding leaders of the two countries. I am grateful to you for having sent an art troupe of high repute to give a distinguished and excellent art performance and deeply impress our people true to your promise, and renew the mind to actively propel the friendly and cooperative relations between the DPRK and Vietnam desired by the peoples of the two countries. Availing myself of this opportunity, I express the belief that traditional friendly and cooperative relations between our two parties, two countries and two peoples grow stronger in accomplishing the common cause for socialism in the future, too. I sincerely wish you good health and bigger success in your responsible work for the development of the party and prosperity of the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Reply Message to President Xi Jinping
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a reply message to Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and president of the People's Republic of China, on April 17. The message said: Respected general secretary was the first to send sincere and warm congratulations to me on my re-election as chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. This is a manifestation of your deepest trust in and friendship with me and, at the same time, firm support and encouragement to the socialist cause of our Party, government and people. I am sincerely grateful for this and express heartfelt thanks to you. As you said, we jointly opened a new chapter of the DPRK-China relations through four rounds of meetings and talks in a little over a year and demonstrated at home and abroad the particularity and vitality of the DPRK-China relations helping each other like a family. In this course I and you shared confidence and established the most genuine comradely relations which served as the cornerstone for the DPRK-China relations in a new era and a powerful driving force propelling the growth and strengthening of the DPRK-China friendship. This year is a significant year in which the two countries mark the 70th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations and the 70th founding anniversary of the People's Republic of China. It is an important mission for us to further value and steadily advance the friendly and cooperative relations between the DPRK and China at a time when the socialist cause of the DPRK and China and the situation prevailing in the Korean peninsula entered a very crucial period. I will remain always loyal to comradely obligation with you and make all efforts to surely put the friendly and cooperative relations between the two parties and two countries on a new high level. I believe that fraternal Chinese people will achieve greater success in the grand march for bringing earlier a new era of prosperity of China and of rich country and wealthy people under the wise leadership of the Communist Party of China with you as the core. I sincerely wish you good health and happiness. I send warm and comradely regards to you. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Seminar Held
body: A national seminar was held at the People's Palace of Culture on Thursday to deeply grasp the idea advanced in Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's historic letter "Let Us Double the Motive Force of Our Revolution through Fresh Information and Motivation Work" and thoroughly apply it to the Party's ideological work. Attending the seminar were officials of central and city party and administrative organs, working people's organizations, those in the fields of science, education, literature and art and media and those of party cadres training institutions and those in the field of revolutionary relics preservation. The seminar heard papers profoundly explaining and proving the originality, scientific accuracy and truth of the idea clarified in the historic letter sent by Kim Jong Un to the participants in the Second National Conference of Primary Information Workers of the Party. At the seminar, speakers said that the letter serves as an immortal programme as it comprehensively expounds the important tasks facing the Party's ideological work at the present time and clearly indicates the tasks for decisively enhancing the role of the primary information workers of the Party and ways to do so. In the letter, Kim Jong Un set it as an important task to hold fast to the struggle for concentrating all efforts on firmly consolidating the revolutionary position and class position, directing all efforts of information and motivation on accelerating socialist economic construction and overcoming formalism as a party-wide work, the most urgent task for cementing the ideological front, they noted. As the letter newly defined the position and role of the primary information workers of the Party and detailed even the ways for decisively enhancing their role, it comes to be an immortal banner to spirit up the ideological front of the Party with stirring and enterprising temper and encourage the whole revolutionary ranks to make a dynamic advance, they stressed. Rodong Sinmun

title: Ri Su Yong Meets Mongolian Delegation
body: Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, met and had a talk with the delegation of the Mongolian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade headed by Secretary of State D. Davaasuren, which paid a courtesy call on him on Thursday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Gift from Mongolian President
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a gift from Khaltmaa Battulga, president of Mongolia. The gift was handed over to Foreign Minister Ri Yong Ho on Thursday by Secretary of State D. Davaasuren who is leading a delegation of the Mongolian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade on a visit to the DPRK. Rodong Sinmun

title: Reception Hosted by Vietnamese Embassy Here
body: The Vietnamese embassy here hosted a reception on Thursday to mark the 69th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic ties between the DPRK and Vietnam. Invited to it were Sin Hong Chol, vice-minister of Foreign Minister, Pak Kyong Il, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries who is chairman of the DPRK-Vietnam Friendship Association, Jo Song Dok, vice-general director of the General Bureau for Affairs with Diplomatic Corps, and officials concerned. Present there were Le Ba Binh, Vietnamese ambassador to the DPRK, and staff members of his embassy. Speeches were made there. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of Mongolian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade Here
body: A delegation of the Mongolian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade headed by Secretary of State D. Davaasuren arrived here on Thursday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Mangyongdae Prize National Martial Art Championship Closes
body: The Mangyongdae Prize National Martial Art Championship to mark the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, Day of the Sun, closed with due ceremony at the Taekwon-Do Hall on Thursday. The Pyongyang City Taekwon-Do team finished first in total standings. Present at the ceremony were Choe Hwi, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the National Sports Guidance Committee, Kim Yong Ho, secretary general of the Cabinet, Kim Chun Sik, secretary general of the National Sports Guidance Committee, officials concerned, sportspersons and citizens in Pyongyang. Rodong Sinmun

title: Art Performance Given by Koreans in China
body: An art performance was given by Korean singers in China at the Ponghwa Art Theatre on Thursday and Friday to celebrate the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, the Day of the Sun. Among the audience were Pak Chun Nam, minister of Culture, Kim Ung Sop, director of the Overseas Koreans' Affairs Administration, officials concerned, creators and artistes in the field of culture and art, overseas compatriots staying here and the chief of the Pyongyang mission of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front. Famous singers Choe Kyong Ho and Han Son Nyo put on the stage immortal classic "Nostalgia", "We Will Live for All Ages, Holding the Leader in High Esteem", "His Eternal Smile" and other songs. They sang high of the honor and pride of Kim Il Sung's nation blessed with the illustrious leaders generation after generation with admiration and reverence for the peerlessly great men. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Reply Message to Russian President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a reply message to Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation, on April 18. The message said: I express deep thanks for your warm congratulations to me on my re-election as chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK. It fully conforms with the common interests of the peoples of the two countries to invariably strengthen and develop the long-standing friendly relations between the DPRK and Russia established by the preceding leaders. I am ready to closely cooperate with you in order to steadily and constructively develop the traditional friendly relations between the DPRK and Russia as required by the new era and defend peace and security of the Korean peninsula and the rest of the world. Availing myself of this opportunity I wish you good health and greater success in your responsible work for building a powerful Russia and the intimate Russian people wellbeing and prosperity. Rodong Sinmun

title: Oath-taking Meetings Held in Cities, Provinces
body: Oath-taking meetings of Pyongyang City, North Phyongan, South and North Hwanghae and Jagang provinces and Nampho City took place on Friday to respond to the appeal of the working people in Kangwon Province. Present there were officials, working people, youth and students of party and power organs, working people's organizations, institutions, industrial establishments, farms and universities in the cities and provinces. The appeal was read out at the meetings to be followed by speeches. Speakers said that all the officials and working people have turned out as one in the all-people death-defying campaign true to the independent revolutionary line and the strategy of self-reliance set forth at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 7th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and the First Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. They said that scientists and technicians should make contributions to reenergizing the overall economy and developing the hi-tech industries by creatively introducing everything advanced, true to the Party's intention of keeping their feet firmly planted on their land and looking out over the world. They noted that all the activities of the people's power organs should be thoroughly directed and subordinated to safeguarding and realizing the people's demands and interests and faithfully serving them, as intended by the Party to thoroughly applying the people-first principle in all aspects of state activities and social life. They called upon officials, party members and other working people to make a new development in socialist construction and thus fully demonstrate once again the might of our state which has won only victories by its own efforts, bearing in mind the faith that they will surely emerge victorious as they are led by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Then there took place mass demonstrations. The demonstrators marched through plazas and streets, chanting revolutionary and militant slogans. Rodong Sinmun

title: Juche Idea Followers Leave
body: Followers of the Juche idea left here on Friday after visiting the DPRK on the occasion of the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, Day of the Sun. They included a delegation of the Association for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism in the Far East Region of Russia, a delegation of the Bulgarian Group for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, a delegation of the Bangladesh Institute of the Juche Idea, a delegation of the Organization for the Study of the Juche Idea of Thailand and the director general of the Asian Regional Institute of the Juche Idea and his party, the chairman of the Nigerian National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, the chief of the Group for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism in Vienna, Austria and the vice-chairman of the Ugandan National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of Mongolian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade Leaves
body: A delegation of the Mongolian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade headed by Secretary of State D. Davaasuren left here for home on Friday. Rodong Sinmun

title: 21st Kimilsungia Festival Closes
body: The 21st Kimilsungia Festival closed on Friday with due ceremony at the Kimilsungia-Kimjongilia Exhibition. Present at the closing ceremony were Pak Thae Song, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Jon Kwang Ho, vice-premier of the Cabinet, officials of the festival organizing committee, ministries, national institutions and armed forces organs and festival participants. Attending it were members of the Society for Disseminating and Supporting Kimilsungia-Kimjongilia, a congratulatory group of Koreans in Japan for celebrating the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, the Day of the Sun, and overseas compatriots and foreigners. Diploma of the Kimilsungia Festival Prize was awarded to a number of units and exemplary participants, including cultivators and lecturers, highly appraised at the festival. The diploma was also conferred on the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan, the Indonesian embassy in Pyongyang and foreigners. Rodong Sinmun

title: Congratulatory Message to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Mongolian President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a congratulatory message from Mongolian President Khaltmaa Battulga on April 15. The Mongolian president in the message extended sincere congratulations to Kim Jong Un upon his re-election as chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK on behalf of the Mongolian people and on his own behalf. He expressed his will to cooperate with Kim Jong Un to steadily develop the long-standing traditional friendly relations between Mongolia and the DPRK provided and nurtured by the proceeding leaders of the two countries in the interests of the peoples of the two countries. He said Mongolia hails the fact that dialogue is being revitalized and positive climate created on the Korean peninsula by the tireless efforts of the DPRK. He said that Mongolia is ready to cooperate with the DPRK in the future, too, to peacefully settle the issue of the Korean peninsula through dialogue, establish peace and security and develop cooperation in Northeast Asia. He sincerely wished Kim Jong Un success in his important work for achieving the country's economic development, improvement of people's living and harmony and common prosperity on the Korean peninsula. He also wished Kim Jong Un happiness in good health and the friendly Korean people progress and prosperity. Rodong Sinmun

title: Mongolian Delegation Visits Tower of Juche Idea
body: A delegation of the Mongolian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade headed by Secretary of State D. Davaasuren visited the Tower of the Juche Idea on Friday. Being briefed on the grand monument telling about the ideological and theoretical exploits of President Kim Il Sung, they made rounds of the body of the tower and groups of sculptures. They went up to the observation deck of the tower to have a bird's eye view of Pyongyang City. The head of the delegation made an entry in the visitor's book. Rodong Sinmun

title: Overseas Koreans Leave
body: A delegation of the International United Confederation of Koreans led by First Vice-Chairman Kim Chil Song and a delegation of the United Confederation of Koreans in the Far Eastern Region of Russia headed by Chairman Ri Ku Yul left here on Friday after visiting the motherland on the occasion of the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, Day of the Sun. Rodong Sinmun

title: Performances Given by CPLA Literary Art Delegation
body: Performances were given by a literary art delegation of the Chinese People's Liberation Army on a visit to the Democratic People's Republic of Korea at the Pyongyang Grand Theatre on Friday and Saturday. Among the audience were generals and officers of the Korean People's Army including Ri Du Song and Kim Hyong Ryong, officials concerned, creators and artistes of art troupes and art education institutions. Seeing the performance were Li Jinjun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK, and members of his embassy, Chinese guests staying here and members of the military attaches corps here. The delegation which consists of a talented conductor and instrumentalists of the military band of the Chinese People's Liberation Army depicted in military music the desire and will of the Chinese army and people to put the DPRK-China friendly relations on a fresh high stage this year marking the 70th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the DPRK and China. Put on the stage beginning with the playing of national anthems of the DPRK and China were the army songs of the two countries and masterpieces of the two countries and the world accompanied on brass band. Band music "Song of General Kim Il Sung" and "Song of General Kim Jong Il", immortal revolutionary hymns, and "We Cannot Live without You" touched the heartstrings of the audience. Band music "Ode to the Motherland" jointly performed by the military bands of the Korean People's Army and the Chinese People's Liberation Army marked the climax of the performances. Floral baskets were conveyed to the performers and the audience presented bouquets to them in congratulation of their successful performance. Rodong Sinmun

title: Commander of KPA Navy Leaves for China
body: Admiral Kim Myong Sik, commander of the Navy of the Korean People's Army, and his party left here on Saturday to attend the celebrations for the 70th anniversary of the founding of the Navy of the Chinese People's Liberation Army. Rodong Sinmun

title: Overseas Compatriots Leave
body: A delegation of the Federation of Koreans in Australia led by Chairman Pak Yong Ha and a delegation of the Association for Economic and Cultural Exchange of Korean Nationality in Dandong City, China headed by Chairman Sim Chong Song left here on Saturday after visiting the homeland on the occasion of the Day of the Sun, the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Leaving on the same day was a home-visiting group of Koreans in Japan headed by Pak Hae Chol, vice department director of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan. Rodong Sinmun

title: Message of Sympathy to President of DR Congo
body: Choe Ryong Hae, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on April 19 sent a message of sympathy to Felix Antoine Tshilombo Tshisekedi, president of the Democratic Republic of Congo, over a capsize that caused huge casualties in DR Congo. Expressing deep sympathy and condolences to the president and victims and their bereaved families, the message wished the government and people of DR Congo success in their work of eradicating the aftermath of the accident as early as possible. Rodong Sinmun

title: Day of Sun Marked Abroad
body: Opening ceremonies of Korean book, photo and craftwork exhibitions took place in Russia, Bulgaria, Sweden and Senegal from March 30 to April 11 on the occasion of the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (Day of the Sun). Speeches were made at the ceremonies attended by the personages of various strata and masses of those countries. The vice-governor of Sovietskaya Gavan District Administration in Khabarovsk Territory, Russia said that the Korean people and the world progressives splendidly mark the Day of the Sun every year. The first vice president of Sckolkovo Fund noted that the exhibition is of more weighty significance as it is to be held to mark the birthday of President Kim Il Sung, a founding father of socialist Korea, and the Russian people bear in their hearts his exploits for the development of the friendly relations between Russia and DPRK. Speakers at the event held in Sweden said that they were struck with admiration at the resourcefulness and talents of the diligent Korean people, hoping that the exhibition would serve as an important chance to introduce the reality of the DPRK to the Nordic people. A spokesperson for the Workers' Party for the Independence of Senegal who is a member of its Political Bureau stressed that Kim Il Sung is a great leader who led the cause of independence against imperialism to victory and a benefactor who gave active assistance to the peoples of the African countries in their struggle for national liberation and building of a new society and the Senegalese people will always remember him. Rodong Sinmun

title: Seminars on President Kim Il Sung's Exploits Held in Different Countries
body: Seminars on exploits of President Kim Il Sung took place in Cambodia, Mongolia, Egypt, DR Congo and Uganda between April 1 and 7 on the occasion of his birth anniversary (the Day of the Sun). Present at the seminars were personages of various strata and masses in those countries. Speakers, including J. Lomvo, chairman of the Mongolian preparatory committee for celebrating the Day of the Sun, and the chairperson of the Mongolia-Democratic Korea Friendship Bridge Association praised exploits Kim Il Sung performed in the development of friendly relationships between Mongolia and the DPRK and his great personality. Yehia Zakaria Khairullah, vice-chairman of the Socialist Freedom Party of Egypt, referred to the fact that the President made great contributions to the country, people, era and history. Andre Lohekele Kalonda, chairman of the National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of DR Congo, said that the President's exploits will be cherished in minds of the Korean people and the world progressives, noting that he is the greatest man who devoted his all to the development of socialist Korea. Speakers said at the seminar held in Kampala of Uganda said that through the seminar they came to have better knowledge of the reality of the DPRK in which the Juche idea is embodied, noting that the President is a great man who performed immortal exploits for the liberation, prosperity and development of Korea and the accomplishment of the human cause of independence. A congratulatory message to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was adopted at the seminar held in Mongolia. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Policy Speech Introduced in DR Congo
body: The National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of DR Congo on April 16 in a bulletin carried the parts on Korea's reunification and external relations of the policy speech "On Socialist Construction and the Internal and External Policies of the Government of the Republic at the Present Stage" made by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un at the First Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Work Published in Russia
body: Chairman Kim Jong Il's work "Let Us Hold the Great Leader in High Esteem Forever and Accomplish His Cause" was brought out in booklet by the Knizhnii Mir Publishing House of Russia on the occasion of the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (Day of the Sun) with due ceremony on April 9. The work, published on October 16, Juche 83 (1994), indicates the tasks and ways for defending and accomplishing the revolutionary cause of President Kim Il Sung, including the issue of building up the Party and strengthening the single-minded unity of the leader, Party and masses, the issue of carrying through the Party's revolutionary economic strategy, the issue of strengthening the People's Army and establishing the social trait of attaching importance to military affairs. Rodong Sinmun

title: Youth League Delegation Back Home
body: A delegation of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League headed by Kim Song Il, vice-chairman of its Central Committee, returned home on Sunday after visiting Cuba and attending the meeting of the General Council of the World Federation of Democratic Youth held in Venezuela. Rodong Sinmun

title: Oath-taking Meetings Held
body: Oath-taking meetings of South Phyongan, North and South Hamgyong and Ryanggang provinces and Rason City took place on Sunday to respond to the appeal of the working people in Kangwon Province for bringing about a great surge at all work sites of the socialist construction under the uplifted banner of self-reliance, the treasured sword for prosperity. Attending those meetings were officials of party and power organs, working people's organizations, institutions, industrial establishments, farms and universities and working people, youth and students in relevant areas. The appeal was read out at the meetings to be followed by speeches. Speakers expressed full support to the appeal made by the working people in Kangwon Province who are taking the lead in implementing the great leaders' instructions and upholding the Party's policies, adding they ardently respond to the appeal. They said that all the officials and working people have turned out as one in the all-people death-defying campaign true to the historic policy speech made by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un at the First Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly and the spirit of the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 7th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. They called for bringing about new miraculous victories one after another at all work sites of socialist construction under the uplifted banner of self-reliance, the treasured sword for prosperity, firmly united around the Supreme Leader. Then there took place mass demonstrations. Rodong Sinmun

title: Leading Members of CPLA Literary Art Delegation Visit Mangyongdae
body: Leading members of the literary art delegation of the Chinese People's Liberation Army visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. Being briefed on the fact that the President nurtured a great intention of liberating the country under the patriotic and revolutionary influence of his parents, the guests went round historic mementoes at his old home in Mangyongdae. They toured the revolutionary sites on Mangyong Hill. They also visited the Tower of the Juche Idea, the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum, the Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace, etc. Meanwhile, the delegation enjoyed a performance given by the Samjiyon Orchestra at its theatre and laid a wreath before the Friendship Tower. Rodong Sinmun

title: CPLA Literary Art Delegation Visits Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: A literary art delegation of the Chinese People's Liberation Army visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on April 21. The members of the delegation paid tribute to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. They made a bow to Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il in the halls where they lie in state. They made rounds of the halls where orders the great leaders received are on display and the halls that house cars, electric car, boat and train coaches used by them during their field guidance and foreign tour till the last moments of their lives. Rodong Sinmun

title: 23rd Seminar of World Political Parties Held in Mexico
body: The 23rd seminar of political parties of the world on building a new society took place in Mexico from April 4 to 6. Present there were members of the Leadership of the Workers' Party of Mexico including its National Leader Alberto Anaya Gutierrez and delegates of its affiliated organizations. Attending it were delegations and delegates of more than 140 political parties and organizations from over 40 countries including the DPRK, Cuba, Vietnam and Venezuela. Present there on invitation were leaders of progressive political parties and lawmakers of Mexico and diplomatic envoys of different countries including the DPRK charge d' affaires ad interim in Mexico. A congratulatory message from the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) was read out to be followed by speeches. The head of the delegation of Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) said that the Korean people are creating miracles and innovations in the economic construction with the might of self-reliance under the guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in despite of the hostile forces' persistent sanctions and pressures. He affirmed that the WPK would in the future, too, invariably hold fast to the socialist principles in all fields of the revolution and construction and successfully accomplish the cause of building a powerful country by its own efforts under the banner of independence against imperialism. Delegates of political parties of different countries blasted the imperialists for interfering in the internal affairs of sovereign states advancing along the road of independence and called upon all the progressive political parties and organizations of the world to consolidate the unity and solidarity to cope with them. Adopted at the seminar was a "solidarity statement for supporting the Workers' Party of Korea defending peace and security on the Korean peninsula and the region and the just cause of the Korean people". The statement highly appreciated the successes made by the WPK and the Korean people in socialist construction under the leadership of Kim Jong Un, the peace-loving will of the DPRK government and its proactive efforts. The struggle of the WPK and the Korean people for defending peace and security on the Korean peninsula and the region and accelerating the building of a powerful country encourages the peoples of the countries in their struggle for securing international justice and peace and building a new society, said the statement. Firmly rejecting the hostile forces' sanctions and pressures upon the DPRK and strongly demanding the withdrawal of them, the statement called upon all communist parties, workers' parties and progressive organizations of the world to further intensify the international support and the solidarity activities for the just cause of the WPK and the Korean people for easing the tension on the Korean peninsula and improving the north-south relations. Rodong Sinmun

title: Revolutionary Career and Feats of President Kim Il Sung Lauded by Foreign Media
body: Foreign media carried special write-ups to mark the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, Day of the Sun. The Laotian paper Pasason on April 5 carried an article titled "The Great nation-building feats performed by President Kim Il Sung" together with the portrait of his smiling image. The article said that the Korean people are holding Kim Il Sung in high esteem as the eternal President of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea as his nation-building feats are so great. The President set forth the original idea and theory of building the country centered on the popular masses to provide the firm guiding principle for nation-building, it noted. It detailed that the President founded the DPRK and developed it into the invincible country with firm political, economic and military foundation. An Egyptian paper in an article titled "On the occasion of the 107th birth anniversary of HE President Kim Il Sung, the great leader of the Korean people, Socialist Korea and President Kim Il Sung" on April 7 said that the DPRK has steered the cause of global independence and made tangible contributions to glorifying the 20th century as the era of independence under the leadership of the President, and stressed that he is, indeed, the eternal leader of socialist Korea. The paper on April 8 in an article titled "The life of great man illustrious with independence" highly praised him for successfully leading the Korean revolution for decades under the unfurled banner of independence. The Bangladeshi newspaper Daily Nauroz on April 6 carried an article titled "Reverence for great man" dealing with the fact that the President, who is boundlessly revered by the world progressives, had received gifts from many countries. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Policy Speech Supported by Swiss Organizations
body: The Swiss Organizing Committee for the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu, the Switzerland-Korea Committee and the Swiss Group for the Study of the Juche Idea released a joint statement on April 13 in support of the policy speech made by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un at the First Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. The statement said: Chairman Kim Jong Un stressed in his policy speech "On Socialist Construction and the Internal and External Policies of the Government of the Republic at the Present Stage" at the First Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK that modeling the whole society on Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism is the highest programme of the Workers' Party of Korea and the government of the Republic. He said that the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist ideas of State building contain in a concentrated way the ideas of, and exploits in, State building of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, who developed the Republic into the most prestigious and strong socialist State in its history. Noting that Kim Jong Un indicated the issues arising in improving the north-south relations and the DPRK-U.S. relations, the statement expressed support to his policy speech and highly praised his noble peace-loving will. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Published in Italy
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "The Great Comrade Kim Il Sung Is the Eternal Leader of Our Party and Our People" was brought out in booklet by the Italian Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea at the Roma Carlo Kelini Printing House on April 11 on the occasion of President Kim Il Sung's birth anniversary (Day of the Sun). The work, published on April 20, Juche 101 (2012), deals with the revolutionary exploits performed by President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in their lifetime. It also indicates the tasks for firmly defending and adding eternal luster to the ideology and feats of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Work Published in Russia
body: Chairman Kim Jong Il's work "Holding the Great Comrade Kim Il Sung in High Esteem Is the Noblest Moral Obligation of Our Party and People" was brought out in booklet by the Forum Book Publishing House of Russia on the occasion of the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (Day of the Sun) with due ceremony on April 11. The work was published on October 27, Juche 88(1999). Rodong Sinmun

title: Literary Art Delegation of CPLA Leaves
body: A literary art delegation of the Chinese People's Liberation Army left here for home on Monday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Congratulatory Group of Koreans in Japan Visits Mangyongdae
body: A congratulatory group of Koreans in Japan for celebrating the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (Day of the Sun) led by Kwon Sun Hwi, adviser to the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of the President. Members of the congratulatory group visited the Mangyongdae Revolutionary Museum where the historical data and relics showing the revolutionary activities of the President and his family members are on display. At the old home in Mangyongdae where the President was born, spent his childhood and nurtured great intention for the revolution, they looked round historic mementoes, being briefed on the story associated with the historic home. After the visit, the head of the congratulatory group said that visiting Mangyongdae, the native place dear to the heart of the Korean nation, the yearning for the President grew stronger. Kwon went on: The President defeated the Japanese imperialists, liberated the country, founded the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and led the Fatherland Liberation War to victory. He formed Chongryon and put forward the Koreans in Japan as dignified overseas citizens of the independent and sovereign state and remitted educational aid funds and stipend for children of Korean residents in Japan. Kwon said that he could not forget forever the benevolent image of the President who showed his great favor while saying he felt very pleased at a time when he met with officials of Chongryon and Koreans in Japan. Kwon noted that they would make a dynamic advance of patriotism for the prosperity of the country and the overall development of the movement of Koreans in Japan true to noble intention of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. The congratulatory group also toured the Korean Revolution Museum, Pyongyang Teacher Training College, the Pyongyang Cosmetics Factory, the Ryuwon Footwear Factory, etc. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of Ministry of People's Armed Forces of DPRK Leaves for Russia
body: A delegation of the Ministry of the People's Armed Forces of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea led by Army General No Kwang Chol, minister of the People's Armed Forces, left here on Monday to take part in the 8th Moscow seminar on international security. Rodong Sinmun

title: Congolese Body Issues Bulletin to Mark Day of Sun
body: The Congolese preparatory committee for celebrating the 107th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (the Day of the Sun) issued a bulletin on April 12. The bulletin carried detailed facts in an article titled "Birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung" conveying noble traits of the President who made a ceaseless journey of devotion for the country and people even on his birth anniversary. Rodong Sinmun

title: Ugandan Organizations Express Solidarity for Korean People's Struggle
body: The Ugandan National Executive Committee of the Pan-African Movement and the Ugandan National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea released a joint statement on April 16 in support of the policy speech made by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un at the First Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. The statement extended warm congratulations to HE Kim Jong Un, the Supreme Leader of the DPRK, upon the successful First Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK. It noted that last year the DPRK initiatively took important and significant measures to bring sustainable peace to the Korean Peninsula and the region. It stated that they hope that the Panmunjom Declaration and the September Pyongyang Joint Declaration would be thoroughly implemented to keep the peaceful atmosphere on the peninsula and steadily improve the inter-Korean relations. The U.S. should respect the June 12 DPRK-U.S. joint statement and prudently think about the practical measures for withdrawing its hostile policy towards the DPRK, before it is too late, it stressed. It extended firm support and solidarity to the government and people of the DPRK in their efforts for building socialism. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Introduced in Spain
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Making Selfless, Devoted Efforts for the Good of the People Is the Mode of Existence and Source of Invincible Might of the Workers' Party of Korea" was posted by the Communist Party of the People of Spain on its website on April 14 on the occasion of the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, the Day of the Sun. The work was published on October 10, Juche 104 (2015). Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Work Printed in Russia
body: Chairman Kim Jong Il's work "Let Us Hold the Great Leader Comrade Kim Il Sung in High Esteem as the Eternal President of Our Republic" was brought out in booklet by the Leto-Print Publishing House of Russia with due ceremony on April 12 on the occasion of the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, the Day of the Sun. The work, published in July, Juche 83 (1994), underlines the need to hold Kim Il Sung in high esteem for all ages just as the Korean people did during his lifetime and sets forth the tasks for defending and successfully carrying forward his idea and undying exploits. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un to Visit Russian Federation
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, will soon pay a visit to the Russian Federation at the invitation of Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation. They will have talks during the visit.

title: Many DPRK Records Set Up
body: Male and female adult weightlifting matches were played respectively in the Weightlifting Gymnasium of Chongchun Street between April 7 and 13 during the Mangyongdae Prize Sports Games to celeberate the Day of the Sun. More than 140 men and women weightlifters were singled out from over 20 sports teams to enter for matches according to body weight. One DPRK record after another was set anew at the matches. Good skills were displayed especially at heavy-weight matches. New DPRK records were established at a male 96-kg match and other sub-divided events. Ji Hyok Chol

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Leaves for Russian Federation
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, left here by a private train at dawn on Wednesday to visit the Russian Federation. Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was accompanied by Kim Phyong Hae and O Su Yong, members of the Political Bureau and vice-chairmen of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), Ri Yong Ho, member of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK and foreign minister, Army General Ri Yong Gil, alternate member of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK and chief of the General Staff of the Korean People's Army, Choe Son Hui, member of the State Affairs Commission (SAC) of the DPRK and first vice foreign minister, and members of the C.C., WPK and the SAC. He was seen off by Choe Ryong Hae and Pak Pong Ju, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK, and other leading officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs. He exchanged farewells with the leading officials. The leading officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs wholeheartedly wished Kim Jong Un a safe foreign trip. The private train departed amid the warm send-off by the leading officials of the Party, government and armed organs and the people. Political News Team

title: DPRK Government Delegation Leaves for China
body: A delegation of the government of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea led by Kim Yong Jae, minister of External Economic Relations, left here on Tuesday to take part in the second Belt and Road Forum for International Cooperation to be held in China. Rodong Sinmun

title: Condolences to Sri Lankan President
body: Choe Ryong Hae, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a consolatory message to Maithripala Sirisena, president of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, on Monday over many casualties caused by terrorist attacks in Colombo, Sri Lanka. Offering deep sympathy and condolences to the president and victims and their bereaved families, the message said it is the consistent principled stand of the government of the DPRK to oppose all forms of terrorism. It hoped the president and government of Sri Lanka would do away with the aftermath of the incident as early as possible and maintain social stability. Rodong Sinmun

body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "The Great Comrade Kim Il Sung Is the Eternal Leader of Our Party and Our People" was brought out in booklet by the Khabarovsk Territory Publishing House of Russia with due ceremony on April 11 on the occasion of President Kim Il Sung's birth anniversary (Day of the Sun). The work, published on April 20, Juche 101 (2012), deals with the revolutionary exploits performed by President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in their lifetime. It also indicates the tasks for firmly defending the ideology and feats of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il and adding eternal luster to them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Policy Speech Supported in Russia
body: A Russian political party and personage issued statements on April 17 in support of the policy speech made by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un at the First Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. The Political Executive Committee of the Party for Peace and Unity of Russia said that Kim Jong Un in his policy speech at the First Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK set forth tasks arising in accomplishing the cause of socialism and modeling the whole society on Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, hoping that all tasks set forth by him would be thoroughly carried out and the DPRK would more fully display its dignity and might in the international arena. V. M. Smirnov, chairman of the National Salvation Front of Russia, expressed support to Kim Jong Un's policy speech that clarifies the programme for building a socialist power, extending firm solidarity to the Korean people in their struggle for completing the great historic tasks. Rodong Sinmun

title: Day of Sun Observed in Different Countries
body: Meetings for celebrating the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, the Day of the Sun, took place in Cuba, Venezuela, Ecuador and Nepal from April 10 to 12. The first vice-chairman of the Cuban Committee for Supporting Korea's Reunification said that Kim Il Sung, who embarked upon the road of the revolutionary struggle in his teens, liberated Korea by waging the arduous anti-Japanese war and won a brilliant victory in the three year-long Fatherland Liberation War. He said that Kim Il Sung built a socialist state and devoted his all to defending the sovereignty of the country and accomplishing the cause of reunification, adding that the President will always be alive in the hearts of the Korean and Cuban peoples. The general coordinator of the Federal Political Secretariat of the United Left Party of Venezuela noted that the history of socialist Korea would have been unthinkable without the sacred life of Kim Il Sung who is being praised by the world people. He said that the Korean people are dynamically accelerating the cause of building a powerful nation under the guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un who has carried forward the cause of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. The chairman of the Ecuadorian Cultural Institute for the Study of the Juche Idea stressed that the exploits of the President would be conveyed down through generations as he glorified the DPRK, which had once eclipsed in the international arena, as a socialist state independent in politics, self-supporting in economy and self-reliant in national defence. The general secretary of the Central Committee of the Nepal Communist Party (Marxist-Leninist) stated that the great President is a world-known elder statesman who founded the Juche idea. He highly lauded the President for his special contribution to the reunification of Korea and global peace and security. A congratulatory message to Kim Jong Un was adopted at the meeting held in Nepal. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Carried by Lao Newspaper
body: The full text of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "The Paektusan Hero Youth Power Station Is a Proud and Grand Monument to Our Youth and a Symbol of Youth Power" was carried by the Lao newspaper Vientiane Times on April 11. The work, a speech delivered by Kim Jong Un at the inauguration ceremony of the power station on October 3, Juche 104 (2015), says that the power station which represents the love of Chairman Kim Jong Il for the youth and future is a proud creation powerfully demonstrating the might of the politics of the Workers' Party of Korea that prioritizes the youth. It also says that the charging spirit and culture of the youth in the Songun era, the precious treasure of the Korean youth movement, were created during the construction of the power station. The newspaper carried a photo of Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Effective Feed Additive “Chukyon”
body: The scientists of the Zootechnical Institute of the Academy of Agriculture developed the feed additives “Chukyon”. They are acknowledged as green additives. They secured the raw materials for the additives by 97% at home. First of all, they added enzymes and vitamins to the feed by mingling, culturing or fermenting microbes, and applied the technology of complex compounds to it to optimize their use of microelements and rare-earth elements. The feed additives are composed of sweeteners, seasonings and depressants. They are made from home plants which are also used as raw materials for traditional Korean drugs. The researchers of the institute tested the additives at the Sariwon Pig Farm for many years as compared with their counterparts made from imported raw materials. It was consequently proved that the domestic additive for parent pigs excelled its foreign counterpart in effect and that the home additives for weaned and unweaned piglets and pigs for fattening up little differed from their alien rivals in effect. Kang Myong Chon

title: Songbul Temple, National Treasure of Korea
body: The Songbul Temple was built in 898 in Mt Jongbang, North Hwanghae Province and was rebuilt in the years of Koryo (a feudal state of Korea between 918 and 1392). Later on, it was repaired and added to many times. The temple consists of the Hall of Paradise, the Ungjin Hall, the Hall of the King of Hell, the Tower of Fresh Wind, the Pavilion of Clouds and Glow, the Pavilion of Mountain God, a five-storied stone pagoda, a monument to supernatural mystery, etc. The Hall of Paradise is the main building of the temple. It was rebuilt after the Korean War (June 25, 1950-July 27, 1953) as it was. It stands on a relatively high stylobate whose front is 12m long and whose side is 6.3m wide. The Ungjin Hall belongs to wooden buildings, the oldest of its kind in our country. It boasts pot-bellied pillars, chapiters laid one upon another, timber props whose tops were hollowed out round to dovetail crossbeams, arms stretching out from the right and left of sets of manifold boards and posts, etc. The pagoda stands in the court of the Hall of Paradise, looking modest yet soft and refined. The Pavilion of Clouds and Glow looks like a 2-storied house without, and like a board-floored room within. The inscription on the monument said that the temple formerly had more than 20 buildings, upwards of 10 hermitages and 15 stone pagodas. The temple carried forward the architecture of Koguryo (the first feudal state of Korea between 277 BC and 668). It also bears good testimony to the characteristics of Koryo’s architecture such as a concise yet solid structure, red and blue paintings and decorative sculptures of a deep green tint. Song Rim

title: Editorial
body: Let Us Go All-out for Grand Advance of Self-Reliance An appeal was sent to the working people across the country by the working people in Kangwon Province who held a meeting to pledge to fulfill the important tasks set forth in the policy speech made by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 7th Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea (WPK). The people in Kangwon Province pledged in their appeal to turn their province into the leading province in attaining self-sufficiency under the uplifted banner of self-reliance, the most civilized and richest province. The appeal reflecting the faith of the people in Kangwon Province is an eruption of their ardent loyalty to devotedly defend the idea, line and determination of the Party Central Committee with the great victory of self-reliance and self-development and a manifestation of their high class dignity and patriotism to show the mettle of the Korean people to the hostile forces keen on blocking the advance of the DPRK. The militant appeal of the people in Kangwon Province makes the whole country seethe like a furnace. We should hold fast to self-reliance as a treasured sword for prosperity to wage a dynamic all-people death-defying campaign and thus write a great history of the country to be prosperous with self-reliance. The Fourth Plenary Meeting of the 7th Central Committee of the WPK and the First Session of the 14th Supreme People’s Assembly of the DPRK reaffirmed it as the steadfast political line to build a powerful socialist nation with a grip on the revolutionary line of independence and strategy of self-reliance. It is the firm determination of the WPK to usher in a heyday of building socialism with our own efforts while solving all problems on the principle of self-reliance and self-development without allowing any slightest concession in matters for the fundamental interests of our state and people whatever difficulties. Self-reliance is the invariable path of Juche Korea and its eternal social customs.

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Arrives at Vladivostok, Russian Federation
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, arrived at Vladivostok, the Russian Federation on Wednesday. At 18:00 local time, a private train with Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un aboard pulled in at the railway station. He was greeted at the railway station by Minister of Development of the Far East and Arctic of Russia Alexandr Kozlov, Vice Foreign Minister Igor Morgulov, Governor of Maritime Territory Oleg Kozhemyako and Russian Ambassador to the DPRK Alexandr Matsegora. There was a ceremony for welcoming the visit to the Russian Federation by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. When he came forward to the square of the railway station, the chief of the guard of honor of the three services of the armed forces of the Russian Federation made a welcome report. The national anthems of the DPRK and the Russian Federation were solemnly played. The Supreme Leader reviewed the guard of honor of the three services of the armed forces of the Russian Federation. Then there took place a march-past of the guard of honor of the three services. The Supreme Leader exchanged greetings with senior officials of the capital and local areas and headed for the lodging place. He passed Russia's border railway station in Khasan on Wednesday morning on his way to the Russian Federation. He was kindly greeted at Khasan Railway Station by Alexandr Kozlov, minister of Development of the Far East and Arctic of Russia, and other senior officials who came to the railway station from the capital and local areas to greet him. He was also greeted at the railway station by Kim Hyong Jun, DPRK ambassador to the Russian Federation, and Jo Sok Chol, DPRK consul general in Vladivostok. After getting off the train, he exchanged greetings with the senior officials of the capital and local areas who came to greet him. He was presented with a bread and salt and then floral greetings by Russian women according to a Russian custom. Then, he was guided into the VIP room at the railway station. The senior officials warmly welcomed Kim Jong Un's visit to the Russian Federation, saying that President Putin dispatched them to the border railway station with particular attention given to his current visit. Kim Jong Un expressed thanks for it and had an amicable talk with them. Political News Team

title: Oath-taking Meetings Held in Various Units
body: Oath-taking meetings were held in the leading sectors and major industrial sectors of national economy in response to the appeal of the working people in Kangwon Province. At the meetings the appeal was read out to be followed by speeches. Speakers vowed to fully display the indomitable spirit and mettle of the heroic working class of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il by resolutely waging an all-out death-defying drive under the unfurled banner of self-reliance, expressing full support to and approval at the appeal. They called for demonstrating to the world the spirit of socialist Korea by making ceaseless innovations and progress true to the revolutionary line of independence and the strategy of self-reliance unfolded by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in his historic policy speech at the First Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK and the Fourth Plenary Meeting of the Seventh Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Players Back Home
body: Judokas of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea returned home on Wednesday after taking part in the 2019 Judo Asian-Pacific Championships. The Asian-Pacific Championships, held in the United Arab Emirates, brought together more than 270 male and female ace judokas from 40 countries and regions including the DPRK, China and Kazakhstan. In the women's 57 kg category Kim Jin A defeated her Jordanian rival in preliminary, another from Chinese Taipei in quarterfinals and Chinese rival in the semi-finals before beating her Japanese rival in the finals. Meanwhile Rim Song Sim won a bronze medal in the women's 52 kg category. Rodong Sinmun

title: Palestinian Ambassador Gives Reception
body: Ismail Ahmed Mohamed Hasan, Palestinian ambassador to the DPRK, hosted a reception at his embassy on Wednesday to mark the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (the Day of the Sun). Present there on invitation were Ju Yong Gil, chairman of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea who is chairman of the DPRK-Palestine Friendship and Solidarity Committee, Ryu Myong Son, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Pak Myong Guk, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, So Ho Won, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries, and officials concerned. A member of the Palestinian embassy was on hand. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Reply Message from Syrian President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a reply message from Bashar Al-Assad, president of the Syrian Arab Republic, on April 20. The Syrian president in the message extended thanks to Kim Jong Un for expressing sincere emotion in the message of greeting he sent on the independence day of Syria, and wished him happiness and the friendly DPRK permanent security and stability. He expressed his will to make steady efforts to further consolidate the friendly ties in the interests of the peoples of the two friendly countries and expand bilateral cooperation to fresh spheres in the future, too. Rodong Sinmun

title: Letter of Thanks to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un
body: from Central Standing Committee of Chongryon Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a letter of thanks from the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) on April 14. The letter said that they received with great emotion and joy 224 million yen worth of educational aid fund and stipends sent by Kim Jong Un on the occasion of the 107th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. It noted that the education aid fund and stipends sent by Kim Jong Un serve as the source of power greatly encouraging the Chongryon officials and Koreans in Japan who firmly turned out in implementing the decisions of the 24th Congress of Chongryon to provide a solid springboard for boosting the overall movement of Koreans in Japan and are the invaluable lifeblood for developing the national education of Chongryon.
