It said that they would resolutely defend and adhere to the Juche-oriented idea of education for overseas compatriots clarified by the great Generalissimos and their immortal leadership exploits for the development of national education and further glorify the great era of Kim Jong Un. It stressed that they would more positively conduct the activities for contributing to accomplishing the cause of building a powerful socialist state in the motherland, vigorously organize and conduct the movement for national reunification true to Kim Jong Un's instructions calling for ushering in a heyday of peace, prosperity and reunification on the Korean peninsula and thus make tangible contributions to building the reunified and prosperous power on the 3 000-ri land of the motherland. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Congratulatory Message from Iranian President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a congratulatory message from Hassan Rouhani, president of the Islamic Republic of Iran, on Tuesday. The Iranian president in the message extended warm congratulations to Kim Jong Un upon his re-election as chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, the supreme representative of all the Koreans. He hoped that the bilateral relations would grow stronger in all fields under the leadership of Kim Jong Un and by the political will of the leaderships of the two countries on the basis of present potentials. He wished Kim Jong Un good health and success in his work and the people of the DPRK prosperity. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Letter from Koreans in China
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a congratulatory letter from the General Association of Koreans in China on April 14. The letter said upon hearing the news that Kim Jong Un was re-elected as chairman of the State Affairs Commission (SAC) of the DPRK, the officials of the General Association of Koreans in China and Koreans in China are filled with great joy and excitement. Marshal Kim Jong Un's re-election as chairman of the SAC of the DPRK ensures that the motherland will shine more brilliantly as the eternal country of Generalissimos Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il, and that the revolutionary cause of Juche, the cause of building a powerful socialist state pioneered and led by the great Generalissimos will dynamically advance along the road of victory and glory, the letter pointed out. The letter said the officials of the General Association of Koreans in China would firmly follow the road of patriotism with reverence for Kim Jong Un only, bearing in mind the iron faith that the great Generalissimos' patriotic desire for a powerful country will surely come true as they are led by him. The letter stressed that they would cherish the great honor and pride of being overseas citizens of the dignified DPRK and absolute confidence in the rosy future of the country and thus work heart and soul to realize Kim Jong Un's plan for building a powerful socialist country by displaying patriotism and loyalty. Rodong Sinmun

title: President Kim Il Sung's Work Published in Russia
body: President Kim Il Sung's work "Let Us Firmly Guarantee the Fulfillment of the Revolutionary Cause of Juche by Force of Arms" was brought out in booklet by the Arton Publishing House of Russia with due ceremony on April 13 on the occasion of his birth anniversary, the Day of the Sun. The work, published on April 25, Juche 71 (1982), deals with the course and feats of the revolutionary armed forces of the DPRK and indicates the tasks for further strengthening them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Day of Sun Celebrated in Russia
body: Events took place in Russia on April 12 and 13 on the occasion of the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, Day of the Sun. They included a seminar on exploits by the Party for Peace and Unity of Russia and celebration meetings by the Lenin Young Communist League of the Russian Federation, the Regional Social Organization of Russia "Borozino" and the Korean War Veterans' Council of Russia. Attending the events were figures of the relevant units and masses. Speakers including the chairwoman of the Party for Peace and Unity of Russia highly praised Kim Il Sung for performing the exploits in founding and developing the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. The first secretary of the Central Committee of the Lenin Young Communist League of the Russian Federation said that Kim Il Sung is the father of socialist Korea and founder of the Workers' Party of Korea and the DPRK, adding that he led the two revolutionary wars to brilliant victories. The chairman of the Regional Social Organization of Russia "Borozino" emphasized that Kim Il Sung is the outstanding leader who made a tangible contribution to accomplishing the cause of global independence and he is alive in the minds of the progressive mankind for his exploits. A congratulatory message to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was adopted at the meeting held by the Lenin Young Communist League of the Russian Federation. Rodong Sinmun

title: CPRC Spokesman Warns S. Korean Authorities against Acts of Perfidy
body: The south Korean military kicked off a provocative combined aerial drill with the U.S. forces against its dialogue partner DPRK on April 22, with the involvement of a number of warplanes like F-15K, KF-16, F-16. A spokesman for the Committee for the Peaceful Reunification of the Country (CPRC) of the DPRK in a strongly-worded statement Thursday blasted the drill as an outright challenge to the historic April 27 Panmunjom Declaration and the September Pyongyang Joint Declaration reflecting the unanimous will of the entire nation for peace and prosperity of the Korean peninsula, and an open violation of the agreement on the military field in which the north and the south committed to make joint efforts for the ease of military tension and removal of hostility. The statement continued: The acts of perfidy on the part of the south Korean authorities have greatly disappointed us, as they, far from trying to keep to preserve the valuable spark of peace, reconciliation and cooperation, have gone against the trend toward the reconciliation on the peninsula which the north and the south nurtured by their joint efforts for the past one year. While staging the large-scale combined aerial drill, the south Korean authorities claim that Max Thunder was thrown into the history and they reduced the scope of the drill by taking into consideration the situation on the Korean peninsula. They are seriously mistaken if they think they can give relief to us and stay clear of the public criticism at home and abroad with such trite nonsense. In March also, the south Korean authorities held a joint military drill under the codename of Alliance that replaced Key Resolve which was agreed to be suspended, and now it mulls going ahead with it in the future, too. They can never conceal the aggressive, offensive and confrontational nature of their hostile acts no matter how hard they may try to give impression about "reduction in scope" by replacing the codename. Wind naturally brings wave. Now that the south Korean authorities get undisguised in their military provocation against the DPRK together with the U.S., there will be corresponding response to it from our army. Whatever steps we take, the south Korean authorities can never make any complaint, and if they cavil at, that will render the issue and the situation further complicated to let it go out of control. The south Korean authorities have to behave with discretion, mindful that their open perfidy to the DPRK at the crucial moment of whether to preserve the atmosphere of the improvement of the north-south ties may put the overall bilateral ties at risk. Rodong Sinmun

title: Congratulatory Group of Koreans in Japan Leaves
body: A congratulatory group of Koreans in Japan for celebrating the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (Day of the Sun) headed by Kwon Sun Hwi, adviser to the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan, left here on Thursday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Performance Given by State Merited Chorus to Mark Founding Anniversary of KPRA
body: A performance was given by the State Merited Chorus at the April 25 House of Culture on April 25, the founding anniversary of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army. Among the audience were Army General Kim Su Kil, director of the General Political Bureau of the Korean People's Army, and other senior officials of the armed forces organs, service personnel and teaching staff and pupils of Mangyongdae Revolutionary School and Kang Pan Sok Revolutionary School. Put on the stage of the performance that started with prelude "Our National Flag" were male chorus "We Wish Comrade Supreme Commander Good Health", orchestra and male chorus "The Snow Is Falling", unaccompanied chorus "The Country I Am Defending", mixed duet "Loving Care for My Destiny", etc. The performers sang high praises of the immortal exploits of the peerlessly great men who founded the revolutionary army and thus pioneered the revolutionary cause of Juche advancing by dint of the might of the arms and ushered in a heyday of building the revolutionary armed forces. The performance climaxed with female solo and male chorus "We Will Follow Marshal to End" and orchestral music and male chorus "We Will Go along Road of Loyalty" that showed the will of the KPA servicepersons to follow the road of revolution indicated by the Party to the last, holding aloft the flag of the Workers' Party of Korea as the first colors. Rodong Sinmun

title: Week of Syrian Film Show Opens
body: A week of Syrian film show opened with due ceremony at the Pyongyang International Cinema House on Thursday to mark the national day of Syria. Attending the opening ceremony were Jong Yong Nam, director-general of the National Administration of Motion Picture Industry, officials concerned, creators and artistes of the film sector, working people in the capital city, Syrian Ambassador to the DPRK Tammam Sulaiman and members of his embassy. Present there on invitation were diplomatic envoys and representatives of international bodies' missions here. Speeches were made there. The participants watched a Syrian feature film "Fate Changed". Rodong Sinmun

title: Cuban Ambassador Gives Reception
body: Jesus De Los Angeles Aise Sotolongo, Cuban ambassador to the DPRK, hosted a reception at his embassy on Thursday on the occasion of the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (the Day of the Sun). Present there on invitation were Kim Sung Du, chairman of the Education Commission who is chairman of the Korean Committee for Solidarity with Cuba, and other members of the committee. Staff members of the Cuban embassy were on hand. Speeches were made there. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Policy Speech Supported
body: by Political Parties of Syria and Hungary Political parties of Syria and Hungary issued statements on April 18 and 19 in support of the policy speech made by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un at the First Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. The Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Syrian Arab Socialist Union Party said that Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, in his policy speech made at the First Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK called for concentrating all efforts on economic construction under the uplifted banner of self-supporting and self-reliance to meet the sanctions moves of the hostile forces. It noted that the policy speech clearly clarified the principled stand of the WPK and the government of the Republic for the steady development of the north-south relations, ensuring of peace on the Korean Peninsula, improvement of the DPRK-U.S. relations and friendship and cooperation with all the countries in the world. It extended warm congratulations to Kim Jong Un who is leading the struggle of the Korean people for building a prosperous and powerful socialist country by smashing high-handed and arbitrary practices of the imperialists. It noted that bright is the future of the Korean people vigorously advancing under the leadership of Kim Jong Un. The Hungarian Workers' Party supported the policy speech made by Kim Jong Un, welcomed the stand of the DPRK government to defend peace of the Korean Peninsula and the world and extended firm solidarity to the Korean people's struggle for accomplishing the cause of socialism. Rodong Sinmun

title: President Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin Hosts Banquet
body: in Welcome of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation, hosted a grand banquet on Thursday in welcome of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Present there on invitation were Kim Phyong Hae and O Su Yong, vice-chairmen of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Ri Yong Ho, foreign minister, Army General Ri Yong Gil, chief of the General Staff of the Korean People's Army, Choe Son Hui, first vice foreign minister, and other officials accompanying Kim Jong Un and suite members. Also present there on invitation were Kim Hyong Jun, DPRK ambassador to the Russian Federation, and Jo Sok Chol, DPRK consul general in Vladivostok, and members of the consulate general. Present there from the Russian side were Sergei Lavrov, foreign minister, Yuri Trutnev, deputy prime minister and presidential envoy to the Far East Federal Region, Dmitri Peskov, deputy head of the Presidential Administration and president's press secretary, Yuri Ushakov, assistant to the president's foreign policy, Yevgeny Dietrich, minister of Transport, Alexandr Kozlov, minister of Development of the Far East and Arctic, Anatoli Yanovski, vice-minister of Energy, Oleg Belozerov, president of the Russian Railways Company, and Alexandr Matsegora, Russian ambassador to the DPRK, and officials concerned. President Putin made a congratulatory speech. Warmly welcoming Kim Jong Un and all other Korean friends visiting the Russian Federation once again, he remembered with deep emotion the history of friendship between the two countries and meaningful meetings between the preceding leaders. Putin said that the situation around the Korean peninsula is becoming stable at the initiative of Kim Jong Un, and Russia supports the efforts of the DPRK leadership for the DPRK-U.S. dialogue and the improvement of the north-south relations. Voicing Russia's willingness to continue mutual cooperation to defuse tension on the Korean peninsula and strengthen security in Northeast Asia as a whole, Putin expressed his conviction that the goal of ensuring lasting peace and stability and achieving prosperity on the peninsula and in the region will certainly be attained by the active involvement of the international community and all the countries concerned. Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un made a reply speech. He expressed heartfelt gratitude to Putin for kindly inviting him and according cordial hospitality in all sincerity. Noting that the peoples of the two countries were firmly linked together with the feelings of comrades-in-arms in the joint struggle for the great anti-Japanese war in the last century, and the officers and men of the Red Army devoted their warm blood to the liberation of Korea, he said the Korean people do not forget the noble internationalist exploits of the sons and daughters of the Russian people who unsparingly laid down their precious lives for the sacred cause of the liberation of Korea and will always remember them in the future, too. Noting that he had a frank and meaningful conversation with Putin on the issues of developing the DPRK-Russia friendly relations and ensuring peace and security on the Korean peninsula and in the region and international issues of mutual concern, he said it is the fixed stand and strategic policy of the government of the DPRK to steadily develop the DPRK-Russia friendship on a new high as required by the new century. The Supreme Leader sincerely wished that Russia would certainly prosper as a powerful and dignified great country under the leadership of President Putin. The banquet proceeded in an amicable atmosphere overflowing with the feelings of friendship. There was an art performance prepared by Russian artistes in sincerity in welcome of the historic visit to Russia by Kim Jong Un. Kim Jong Un and Putin presented a floral basket to the performers and expressed thanks. Expressing deep gratitude to the Russian friends for their enthusiastic and warm hospitality once again, Kim Jong Un exchanged cordial farewell with Putin, promising a new meeting. Political News Team

title: Congratulations to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from President of Council of State of Republic of Cuba
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a congratulatory message from Miguel Diaz-Canel Bermudez, president of the Council of State of the Republic of Cuba, on April 16. Miguel Diaz-Canel Bermudez in the message said that he is pleased to send the sincerest congratulations to Kim Jong Un upon his re-election as chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK. He reaffirmed his will to develop the relationship between the two countries and the admiration and love for the DPRK people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Oath-taking Meetings Held across Country
body: Oath-taking meetings were held at institutions, industrial establishments, farms and universities across the country in response to the appeal of the working people in Kangwon Province. At the meetings, the appeal was read out before speeches. Speakers said that all the people are full of revolutionary zeal to make a great turning point of effecting a leap forward in socialist construction with self-reliance by single-mindedly rallying around Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. They stressed the need to cherish the unshakable faith to pave their own way by themselves with confidence in their own strength so as to step up modernization of production lines and bring about a turn in diversification and quality improvement of people's consumer goods by investing efforts in developing new products. They noted that they would glorify the era prospering with self-reliance by thoroughly implementing the important tasks set forth by Kim Jong Un in the historic policy speech made at the First Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and at the Fourth Plenary Meeting of the Seventh Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. They called for making tangible contribution to the economic development of the country and the improvement of people's standard of living by making proud successes in the drive for breaking through the cutting edge, mindful that the on-going grand march of self-reliance is just the struggle for devotedly supporting the Party Central Committee and defending socialism. They called for more vigorously stepping up the grand march for creating the new Mallima speed, keeping pace with the steps of patriotic devotion taken by Kim Jong Un who is on a foreign trip for the prosperity of socialist Korea and happiness of the people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Commander of KPA Navy Back Home
body: Admiral Kim Myong Sik, commander of the Navy of the Korean People's Army, and his party returned home on Friday after attending the celebrations for the 70th founding anniversary of the Navy of the Chinese People's Liberation Army. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of Ministry of People's Armed Forces of DPRK Back Home
body: A delegation of the Ministry of the People's Armed Forces of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea led by Army General No Kwang Chol, minister of the People's Armed Forces, returned home on Friday after taking part in the eighth Moscow Conference on International Security. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to South African President
body: Choe Ryong Hae, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Friday sent a message of greeting to Cyril Ramaphosa, president of the Republic of South Africa, on the Day of Freedom, its national day. The message said that South Africa achieved great success in the work for the stability and economic development of the country for the past 25 years. Expressing the belief that the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation between the two countries would continue to grow strong to meet the common interests and desires of their peoples, it sincerely wished friendly South Africa steady development and prosperity. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Published in Spain
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "The Great Comrade Kim Il Sung Is the Eternal Leader of Our Party and Our People" was brought out in booklet by the Anfer Publishing House of Spain on April 12 on the occasion of President Kim Il Sung's birth anniversary (Day of the Sun). The work, published on April 20, Juche 101 (2012), deals with the revolutionary exploits performed by President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in their lifetime. It also indicates the tasks for firmly defending the ideology and feats of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il and adding eternal luster to them. Rodong Sinmun

title: President Kim Il Sung's Work Printed in Russia
body: President Kim Il Sung's work "On the Occasion of Founding the Anti-Japanese People's Guerrilla Army" was published in booklet by the Forum Book Publishing House of Russia with due ceremony on April 17 on the occasion of his birth anniversary (Day of the Sun) and the founding anniversary of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army. The work, published on April 25, Juche 21 (1932), deals with the motive and significance of the founding of the Anti-Japanese People's Guerrilla Army and its goal and mission. It also indicates the tasks and ways for strengthening it. Rodong Sinmun

title: Day of Sun Marked Abroad
body: A celebration and seminar were held in India and Pakistan from April 9 to 14 ahead of President Kim Il Sung's birth anniversary (the Day of the Sun). Present at the events were personages of various strata and masses of the relevant countries. The director general of the Asian Regional Institute of the Juche Idea, the chairman of the Indian Group for the Study of the Songun Politics and other speakers said that the Juche idea founded by Kim Il Sung is the popular masses-centered ideology and the great ideology that leads humankind to the path of peace, progress and prosperity. The chairperson of the Juche Philosophy Study Committee of India stressed that Kim Il Sung's life was the great one in which he performed undying feats for the country, people, times and history with his outstanding and seasoned leadership under the uplifted red flag of the revolution. The secretary general of the All India Indo-Korean Friendship Association praised Kim Il Sung as the outstanding thinker and theoretician who brightly lighted the way ahead of humankind, the invincible and iron-willed commander who defeated two imperialist invaders in one generation, and a genius of creation and construction and the benevolent father of the people who built a powerful socialist state. The secretary general of the Karachi Branch of the Pakistan-Korea Friendship Association and the chairman of the Lahore Group for the Study of the Juche Idea said that Kim Il Sung is the great leader who enjoyed boundless reverence from the world progressives and that he is alive in the hearts of humankind as he dedicated all his life to the people. Meanwhile, an event was held under the sponsorship of the preparatory committee for celebrating the Day of the Sun in Austria on April 10 to praise the President's revolutionary career and exploits. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Returns Home after Concluding Visit to Russian Federation
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, returned home by the private train at dawn on Saturday after successfully concluding his visit to the Russian Federation. After getting off the train amid the enthusiastic cheering of the masses, Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a greeting report from the head of the guard of honor of the Korean People's Army. A ceremony of saluting Kim Jong Un took place. He was presented with fragrant bouquets by a boy and a girl. Leading officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs greeted Kim Jong Un, who returned home safe after performing the immortal exploits in his external activities for peace and stability of the Korean peninsula and the region and independent life and happy future of the Korean people, with warm congratulations reflecting the unanimous mind of all the people of the country. Kim Jong Un gladly exchanged greetings with the senior officials. Acknowledging the enthusiastically cheering masses, he extended warm greetings to all the beloved people. Political News Team

title: Chief of Pyongyang Mission of AINDF Vows to Struggle for Independent Reunification, Peace and Prosperity
body: Pak Su Chol, chief of the Pyongyang mission of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front (AINDF), issued a statement on Saturday on the occasion of the first anniversary of publication of the historic Panmunjom Declaration. The statement said that the last year's Panmunjom summit meeting and the publication of the April 27 Declaration were a great event worth a special record in the history of the nation as they declared the start of a new journey for national reunification. The south Korean people eagerly want to see the atmosphere of reconciliation, unity and peace going on in this land and the south-north relations getting improved continuously through the thorough implementation of the historic south-north declarations, it noted. But the south-north relations are not making progress as desired by the nation and unanimously expected by the international community, and the atmosphere of reconciliation, unity and peace can be chilled by the frost of confrontation and war again, it said. The reality raises an urgent need to remove the spawn of the anachronistic arrogance and hostile policy of the U.S. which is making unilateral brigandish demand to throw artificial obstacles in the way of the improvement of inter-Korean relations, and to resolutely frustrate the reckless act of the conservative forces and military warmongers of south Korea, it stressed. In the historic policy speech at the First Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly, Chairman of the State Affairs Commission Kim Jong Un clarified the principled stand to put the south-north relations and the struggle for national reunification on a higher level, it said. It stressed that the AINDF will turn out as one together with the patriotic people of all strata into the struggle to invariably preserve and thoroughly implement the south-north declarations reflecting the general will of the nation, bearing in mind the firm belief that the dawn of independent reunification of the nation will surely come under the leadership of Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Message of Sympathy to South African President
body: Choe Ryong Hae, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Saturday sent a message of sympathy to Cyril Ramaphosa, president of the Republic of South Africa, over human and material losses due to flood caused by torrential rain that recently hit South Africa. The message expressed deep condolence and sympathy to the president and, through him, to the victims and their bereaved families, and hoped that South Africa would make success in eradicating the aftermath of damage and bringing the life of people in the stricken area to normal as soon as possible. Rodong Sinmun

title: Home-visiting Group of Koreans in Japan Arrives
body: A home-visiting group of Koreans in Japan led by Im Jong Hyo, vice-chairman of the Osaka Prefectural Headquarters of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan, arrived here on Saturday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of Korean Medical Persons in U.S. Arrives
body: A delegation of Korean medical persons in the U.S. led by Park Kee Bum arrived here on Saturday to take part in the 21st Pyongyang Symposium on Medical Science of Compatriots at Home and Abroad. Rodong Sinmun

title: Home-visiting Group of Koreans in Japan Visits Statues of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: A home-visiting group of Koreans in Japan visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on Saturday. The visitors laid bouquets and made a bow before the statues. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Baskets to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a floral basket from the Asia-Pacific Regional Committee for Supporting Peaceful Reunification of Korea on the occasion of the 1st anniversary of the publication of the historic Panmunjom Declaration. Meanwhile, he was presented with a floral basket by the Choson Exchange Association in Singapore. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of DPRK Ministry of Foreign Affairs Leaves for NAM Member States
body: A delegation of the DPRK Ministry of Foreign Affairs headed by Vice-Minister Pak Myong Guk left here on Saturday to visit Syria, Iran, Azerbaijan and Mongolia which are member states of the Non-Aligned Movement. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Congratulatory Message from Senegalese President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a congratulatory message from Macky Sall, president of the Republic of Senegal, on April 19. The message extended warm congratulations to Kim Jong Un upon his re-election as chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea at the First Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK. It wished him good health and success in his work. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Reply Message to Syrian President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a reply message to Bashar Al-Assad, president of the Syrian Arab Republic, on April 24. The message expressed deep thanks to the Syrian president for sending his warm congratulations on the occasion of the 107th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. It wished the Syrian government and people bigger success in the struggle for safeguarding the sovereignty of the country and achieving territorial integrity under the guidance of the president, expressing the belief that the historic relations of friendship and cooperation between the two countries would grow stronger. Rodong Sinmun

title: Spring Amateur Riders Competition Held
body: A spring amateur riders competition took place at the Mirim Riding Club on April 21 and 28 under the sponsorship of the Korean Equestrian Association. Members of the association and amateur riders participated in the competition which was held divided into steeplechase, horse-riding amusements and amateurs' horse race games. There was a lottery on the riders of the club during the competition. Rodong Sinmun

title: Day of Sun Marked by Syrian Media
body: Syrian media gave special write-ups to the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (Day of the Sun) on April 11 and 15. SANA reported with a photo of Kim Il Sung that he led the Korean revolution for several decades, invariably holding fast to the principle of independence. TV Channel aired the President's exploits together with his photos and pictures showing the achievements made by the Korean people in the building of a powerful socialist country under the guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. The Syria central radio gave a special report praising the revolutionary career of the peerlessly great man. The newspaper Al Baath introduced in detail the undying exploits of the President for the reunification of Korea with his photo. The newspaper Al Thawrah in an article said that the President built socialism centered on the popular masses for the first time in the history of the Korean nation and wisely led it. At the end of the last century socialism collapsed in different countries, but Korean-style socialism could be steadily advanced thanks to the steadfast line of independence indicated by him, the newspaper added. The newspaper Tishrin said that the President put forward the correct strategies and tactics in each period and at each stage of the revolution and construction to vigorously advance socialism. Rodong Sinmun

title: Foreigners Visit DPRK Missions
body: Delegations of political parties and organizations and personages of various circles in different countries visited the DPRK missions in their countries from April 7 to 15 on the occasion of the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (Day of the Sun). They laid floral baskets and bouquets and paid tributes before the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and art works depicting the peerlessly great men. They include the delegations of the People's Socialist Party of Mexico, the Mexican Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, the Mexican Institute for the Study of the Juche Idea and the Mexico-Korea Friendship Association, the head of the State Academy Beryozka Dancing Troupe of Russia Named after N. S. Nadezhdina and her party, the first secretary of the Khabarovsk Territorial Committee of the Lenin Young Communist League of the Russian Federation and his party, the commander of the Air and Anti-Aircraft Defense Forces of the Revolutionary Armed Forces of Cuba and his party, the first vice-chairman of the Cuban Committee for Supporting Korea's Reunification, a vice-general secretary of the Islamic Coalition Party of Iran and his party, the chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Bangladesh and its general secretary, the secretary general of the Bangladesh Jatiya Party, the president of the Bangladesh People's League, the chairman of the Bangladesh Institute of the Juche Idea, the chairman of the Bangladesh Group for the Study of the Songun Policy, the executive secretary-general of the Bangladeshi Organization for Afro-Asian People's Solidarity, the former secretary general of the Commission for Foreign Affairs of the Senate of Italy, the chairman of the Kuwaiti Committee for Supporting Korea's Reunification who doubles as chairman of the Kuwaiti Preparatory Committee for Celebrating the Day of the Sun, the chairman of the Mexican Committee for Supporting Peaceful Reunification of Korea. Meanwhile, an Italian figure sent a large floral basket to the DPRK mission on April 9. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Re-election to Top Post of DPRK Hailed by British Body
body: The British Association for the Study of Songun Policy issued a statement on April 21 to congratulate Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un upon his re-election as chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. The statement said that Kim Jong Un's re-election reflects the Korean people's boundless reverence for and trust in him. His re-election is another demonstration of the might of the single-minded unity of the Korean society centred on the leader, it stated. Noting that Kim Jong Un, possessed of talented diplomatic resources, is steering the situation on the Korean peninsula with his energetic external activities, it expressed the belief that the Korean people would as ever continue to win victories under his wise leadership. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Policy Speech Supported by Foreign Organizations
body: Nigerian and Indian organizations issued statements on April 18 and 19 in support of the historic policy speech made by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. The Nigeria-Korea Friendship Association said that Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, in his policy speech "On Socialist Construction and the Internal and External Policies of the Government of the Republic at the Present Stage" made at the First Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, indicated the tasks facing the Korean people at the present time and ways for their fulfillment and issues of inter-Korean relations and DPRK-U.S. relations. Extending support to the policy speech consistent with independence, it expressed the belief that the Korean people would open a new phase of prosperity and achieve the ideal and goal of building a powerful country by their own efforts, holding aloft the banner of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism under the wise leadership of Kim Jong Un. The All India Indo-Korean Friendship Association noted that Kim Jong Un in his policy speech stressed that modeling the whole society on Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism is the highest programme of the Workers' Party of Korea and the government of the Republic and the general direction and general goal of the construction of a socialist state. The grandiose programmes declared by him will be implemented and therefore the DPRK will further demonstrate its might as an independent powerful state that no one can dare provoke and as a country in which the people's dream and ideal become materialized, the association added. Rodong Sinmun

title: Establishing Party Leadership System Is Vital to Victorious Advance of Korean Revolution
body: April 28 marks the 40th anniversary of publication of Chairman Kim Jong Il's work "On Thoroughly Establishing the System of Party Leadership". The work, published on April 28, Juche 68 (1979), serves as important guidelines to be held fast to in speeding up the victorious advance of the cause of socialism by enhancing the leadership and fighting efficiency of the Party in every way. The work clarifies theoretical and practical issues arising in establishing the Party leadership system, including the issue of unconditionally implementing the Party's decision and instructions to the last, the issue of establishing iron discipline within the Party, enhancing the militant function and role of Party organizations and the issue of ensuring that officials should learn from the art of leadership of President Kim Il Sung. Establishing the Party's leadership system is the basic principle for building a revolutionary party and the issue of key importance in successfully pushing ahead with the revolutionary struggle and construction work. Only when the Party's leadership system is thoroughly established, can the Party fulfill its mission as the staff of the revolution and powerfully push forward the revolution and construction by mobilizing broad segments of people. After the publication of the work, great efforts have been directed to thoroughly establishing the Party's leadership system and firmly guaranteeing the Party's guidance over the revolution and construction. We should further intensify the work for the establishment of the Party's leadership system as required by the developing revolution, upholding the Party's plan and determination with one mind, thus making fresh leaps forward and innovations in building a powerful socialist country. Jang Im Hyang

title: Founding Anniversary of Central Zoo Marked
body: The Central Zoo marked its 60th founding anniversary. The Central Zoo is a base of national treasure for cultural and leisure activities built thanks to the great efforts made by President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il for the people, and an important centre conducive to the education of school youth and children and zoology researches. Kim Il Sung drafted a plan to build a zoo of world standard at the foot of Mt Taesong. He visited the construction site of the zoo on April 30, Juche 48 (1959) to indicate important tasks and ways and turned the Central Zoo into a cultural and leisure site frequented by the people. Kim Jong Il visited the Central Zoo several times to give detailed guidance and sent a lot of rare animals, vehicles and equipments for the pleasure of the people. Over the past 60 years the Central Zoo has developed into a peculiar and popular base of cultural and leisure activities, educational base for working people, youth and students. A meeting was held on Monday to mark its founding anniversary. Present at the meeting were An Jong Su, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and officials and employees of the Central Zoo. Rodong Sinmun

title: 15th National Machine Design Festival Opens
body: The 15th National Machine Design Festival opened with due ceremony at the Sci-Tech Complex on Monday. Attending the festival are designers, teachers, researchers, postgraduates, technicians and three-revolution team members of over 110 units, including professional design institutions, educational and scientific research institutions. Exhibited at the festival are more than 650 research achievements like designs of machinery and equipment for various sectors of the national economy and designs of equipment for the use of natural energy. The festival includes the exhibition of machine designs, designing contest, prize contest, presentation of advanced designing technology and dissemination of latest technologies to put designing on a more scientific and IT basis. Present at the opening ceremony were Im Chol Ung, vice premier of the Cabinet, Yang Sung Ho, minister of Machine-building Industry, officials concerned and the participants in the festival. Rodong Sinmun

title: Iranian Embassy Hosts Reception
body: The Iranian embassy here hosted a reception on Monday to mark the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (Day of the Sun). Invited to the reception were Yun Kang Ho, minister of Labor who is chairman of the DPRK-Iran Friendship Association, Ryu Myong Son, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Sin Hong Chol, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, Pak Kyong Il, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries, and officials concerned. Present there were Seyed Mohsen Emadi, Iranian ambassador the DPRK, and members of his embassy. Speeches were made there. Rodong Sinmun

title: Congratulations to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from President of Equatorial Guinea
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a congratulatory message from Obiang Nguema Mbasogo, president of the Republic of Equatorial Guinea, on April 25. The president in the message extended the sincerest and warmest congratulations to Kim Jong Un on his re-election as chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK in the name of the government and people of Equatorial Guinea and for his part. He wished Kim Jong Un success in his noble work of leading the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, expressing the firm will to further develop the good friendly and cooperative relations between the peoples of the two countries. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegations of Chongryon Visit Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: A delegation of officials of the Korean Youth League in Japan and a home-visiting group of Koreans in Japan visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on Monday. The delegations laid bouquets and made a bow before the statues. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of Korean Youth League in Japan Here
body: A delegation of officials of the Korean Youth League in Japan led by Ri Kwang Il, vice-chairman of its Central Standing Committee, arrived here on Monday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Vietnamese Delegation Here
body: A delegation of the Vietnam Academy of Social Sciences led by Nguyen Thanh Ha, director general of the Department of International Cooperation, arrived here on Monday. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Premier Inspects Different Units
body: Premier Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and member of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected different units of national economy, including the Sunchon Cement Complex and the Kumsong Tractor Factory Making rounds of the complex, the premier urged officials to properly organize operation for increasing the capabilities of building-materials production and give correct guidance over it, calling upon all the producers to strictly observe the technical rules and standard regulations in managing equipment in a responsible manner At the Kumsong Tractor Factory, he underlined the need to speed up the technical modernization for enhanced performance of rolling stocks, build up its own sci-tech forces through regular operation of sci-tech learning space, realize the integration of science and technology into production and thus add glory to the honor of being the unit associated with leadership exploits. The field consultative meetings underscored the importance of missions charged by those units in preferentially supplying cement and machines to the projects to which the Party attaches importance, discussed measures to turn production processes into labor-saving and technology-intensive ones and called on the relevant sectors to give definite precedence to supplying materials. Kim Jae Ryong also inspected the Sunchon Phosphate Fertilizer Factory now under construction, the construction site of the project for developing C1 chemical industry and the Ferrous Metal Research Institute under the State Academy of Sciences. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to King of Netherlands
body: Choe Ryong Hae, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a message of greeting to Willem Alexander, king of Netherlands, on April 27 on its national day. The message sincerely hoped that the relations between the two countries would develop in conformity with the desire and demand of the peoples of the two countries. Rodong Sinmun

title: 19th May 21 Architectural Festival, 14th Symposium on Architectural Aesthetics to Be Held
body: The 19th May 21 Architectural Festival will be held here from May 7 to 10. The festival under the theme "Let's make all buildings at the world level by our own strength and technology" is to be held, divided into architecture designing exhibition, construction gears and tools exhibition and designing information exhibition. During the festival there will be the 14th Symposium on Architectural Aesthetics. The symposium will deal with model architectures which embody the Juche character and national identity and are peculiar to formative art built under the guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un as well as issues arising in further developing Juche architecture. Rodong Sinmun

title: Day of Sun Marked by Foreign Newspapers
body: Newspapers of various countries gave special write-ups and articles to the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (Day of the Sun). The Angolan paper O Pais on April 12 dedicated one whole page to an article under the title of "President Kim Il Sung, leader of people" illustrated with a portrait of the smiling President. The paper said that history has never seen such a great man as President Kim Il Sung, the founder of socialist Korea, who has been boundlessly admired by the world people century after century, praising him as a pioneer and leader of independent era, an outstanding elder statesman of world politics and a peerless sage. The Kuwaiti newspaper Times on April 14 gave a special write-up carrying a photo of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il standing together and photos dealing with revolutionary activities of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. It introduced the idea of loving the people and the transparent independent spirit which ran through Kim Il Sung's career. The Kuwaiti paper Al-Rai on April 9 carried an article praising the historic feats of world significance performed by Kim Il Sung in founding the Juche idea and making immortal contributions to the Korean revolution and the cause of independence against imperialism. A Mongolian paper on April 15 carried an article under the title of "Sun is immortal" illustrated with photos of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Un. The paper dealt with the sacred career and feats of Kim Il Sung who illuminated the way ahead of mankind, enforced benevolent politics and fascinated the world people with his immeasurably noble traits. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Published in Mexico
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "The Great Comrade Kim Il Sung Is the Eternal Leader of Our Party and Our People" was brought out in booklet by the Publishing House of the Workers' Party of Mexico on April 23 on the occasion of President Kim Il Sung's birth anniversary (Day of the Sun). The work, published on April 20, Juche 101 (2012), deals with the revolutionary exploits performed by President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in their lifetime. It also indicates the tasks for firmly defending and adding eternal lustre to the ideology and feats of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il. Rodong Sinmun

title: Mangyongdae Prize Sports Games Close
body: The Mangyongdae Prize Sports Games for celebrating the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (the Day of the Sun) closed with due ceremony at the Basketball Gymnasium in Chongchun Street on Tuesday. Men and women players of the April 25 Sports Team, the Amnokgang Sports Team, the Pyongyang Sports Team, the Kigwancha Sports Team, the sports team of the February 8 Vinalon Complex, the Defense Sports Team of the Korean People's Army and the Amnokgang Defence Sports Team set new records of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea in such events as weightlifting, shooting, swimming and track-and-field. Men players of the Kigwancha Sports Team and women players of the April 25 Sports Team separately took the first place in the football event. Present at the closing ceremony were Choe Hwi, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the National Sports Guidance Committee, Jon Kwang Ho, vice-premier of the Cabinet, Kim Sung Du, chairman of the Education Commission, officials concerned, sportspersons and Pyongyangites. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Boxers Prove Successful at ASBC Elite Boxing Championships
body: Boxers of the DPRK returned home on Tuesday after taking part in the ASBC Elite Men and Women Boxing Championships 2019. More than 300 elite boxers from 36 countries and regions including the DPRK, China and Kazakhstan took part in the championships held in Thailand. DPRK woman boxer Pang Chol Mi defeated her Vietnamese rival 4:1 at the final of the women's 51kg category to take the first place. Kim Hyang Mi bagged a silver medal in the women's 48 kg category and Pak Un Sim won a bronze in the women's 75 kg category. Rodong Sinmun

title: Italian Personage Visits Statues of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: The president of the International World Group of Italy Tuesday visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill. He laid a floral basket at the statues and made a bow to them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Home-visiting Group of Koreans in Japan Visits Statues of
body: President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il A home-visiting group of Koreans in Japan visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on Tuesday. The visitors laid bouquets and made a bow before the statues. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Government Delegation Back Home
body: A delegation of the government of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea led by Kim Yong Jae, minister of External Economic Relations, returned home on Tuesday after participating in the second Belt and Road Forum for International Cooperation held in China. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of Korean Health Workers Association in Japan Here
body: A delegation of the Korean Health Workers Association in Japan headed by Chairperson Nam Yang I arrived here on Tuesday to attend the 21st Pyongyang Medical Science Symposium of Koreans at Home and Abroad. Rodong Sinmun

title: Condolences to Ethiopian President
body: Choe Ryong Hae, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, sent a message of condolence to Sahlework Zewde, president of the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia, on Tuesday over the death of Negasso Gidada, former president of Ethiopia. The message expressed deep sympathy and consolation to the president and the bereaved family. Rodong Sinmun

title: Condolences to Vietnamese President
body: Choe Ryong Hae, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, sent a message of condolence to Nguyen Phu Trong, president of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, on Wednesday over the death of Le Duc Anh, former president of Vietnam. The message expressed deep condolences to the president and the people of Vietnam and the bereaved family, saying that Le Duc Anh was a state political activist who devoted himself to building rich and prosperous Vietnam. It noted that though Le Duc Anh passed away, the feats he performed for the prosperity of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam and the happiness of its people will remain long in the mind of the Vietnamese people. Rodong Sinmun

title: May Day Marked across Country
body: The Korean people significantly marked May Day, international holiday of the working people all over the world. Celebrations took place in the capital and local areas. Performances were given by the national art troupes at theatres, in pleasure grounds and other places in the capital city. A music and dance performance of the Mansudae Art Troupe for celebrating May Day was given at the East Pyongyang Grand Theatre. The dance suite "Ours is the greatest strength" was given by the National Folk Art Troupe at the Ponghwa Art Theatre. The revolutionary drama "Celebrations" was performed at the National Theatre. Colorful acrobatic and jugglery pieces were staged by the artistes of the National Acrobatic Troupe at the Mangyongdae Amusement Park, the Pyongyang Circus Theater and the Magic Theatre of the National Acrobatic Troupe. The artistes of the Phibada Opera Troupe also gave a performance conspicuous for the melodies, tunes and dances peculiar to the Korean nation at the plaza of the Arch of Triumph. Colorful events including meetings for congratulating innovators and performances took place at industrial establishments. Agricultural workers in farms across the country felt worth of leading a genuine labor life and enjoying a high socialist civilization, playing colorful sports and amusement games including football, basketball, volleyball, tug-of-war and yut-game. Rodong Sinmun

title: Ri Su Yong Meets Italian Guest
body: Ri Su Yong, chairman of the Foreign Affairs Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, met and had a talk with Giancarlo Elia Valori, president of the International World Group of Italy, on Wednesday. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Players Back Home
body: DPRK players returned home on Wednesday after taking part in the 2019 Asian Wrestling Championship held in China from April 23 to 28. The championship brought together at least 340 men and women wrestlers from 29 countries and regions including the DPRK, China, India, Kazakhstan and Mongolia. DPRK players won one gold medal, three silvers and two bronzes. Pak Yong Mi bagged a gold medal in women's wrestling 53kg category. Kang Kum Song, Ri Se Ung and Jong Myong Suk placed second in men's freestyle wrestling 57kg category, men's Greco-roman wrestling 60kg category and women's wrestling 57kg category and Kim Han Song and Hwang Yong Ok third in men's freestyle 65kg category and women's wrestling 50kg category respectively. Rodong Sinmun

title: Senior Party and Government Officials Enjoy May Day together with Working People
body: Senior Party and government officials significantly marked the May Day, the international holiday of the working people of the world, together with working people across the country on Wednesday. Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), first vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission (SAC) of the DPRK and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, vice-chairman of the SAC of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the WPK Central Committee, and Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, member of the SAC of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, went to the Chollima Steel Complex, the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex and the Pyongyang Thermal Power Complex to congratulate workers on their holiday. Other senior officials of the Party and the government, officials of the Cabinet and officials of Party and power organs at all levels significantly celebrated the May Day together with workers, agricultural workers and intellectuals at institutions, industrial establishments, construction sites and farms. They laid floral baskets and bouquets and made a bow before the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, portraits of the smiling peerlessly great men and their mosaics. They made rounds of the revolutionary museums and rooms dedicated to the history of relevant units and other places. They met with labor innovators and gave a pep-talk to them. They joined the working people in colorful sports and amusement games including tug-of-war. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Meeting Marks 129th May Day
body: A national meeting took place at the People's Palace of Culture on Wednesday to mark the 129th May Day, the international holiday of the working people in the world. Present there were members of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea Choe Hwi, vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, Thae Hyong Chol, vice-president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, and Kim Nung O, alternate member of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK and chairman of the Pyongyang City Committee of the WPK, officials of working people's organizations, ministries and national institutions, officials and working people of institutions and industrial establishments in the city and overseas compatriots. Present there on invitation were members of foreign embassies and international bodies and military attaches here. Choe Hwi made a report. He said that President Kim Il Sung clarified for the first time in the history the unique revolutionary principle that popular masses are the master of revolution and they have the strength to push it forward and firmly adhered to the principle of revolutionary leadership with which he had solved all the issues arising in the revolution and construction by dint of inexhaustible creative wisdom and might of the popular masses. Thanks to the wise leadership of the President who brought up the working people into those responsible for building a prosperous country and set in motion their infinite mental power, finding himself among the people all his life, the Korean people could grow up to be the revolutionary people strong in the independent spirit and creativity, he noted. Chairman Kim Jong Il firmly united broad segments of working people including the working class around the Party with his benevolent politics for the people and vigorously advanced the socialist cause of Juche with the might of single-minded unity, adding eternal luster to the immortal leadership feats of the President, he stressed. The wise leadership of Kim Jong Il served as the motive force for the working people of Juche Korea to demonstrate their dignity as independent life-guardsmen and open up the broad way of prosperity with their own efforts, technology and resources, he said. The history of the sacred revolutionary leadership of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il is being vigorously carried forward by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, he noted. He called for bringing about a great upsurge in socialist construction through an all-people death-defying drive under the wise leadership of Kim Jong Un, holding aloft the banner of self-reliance. He stressed that the DPRK will as ever boost solidarity with the working people in the world aspiring after independence in the idea of independence, peace and friendship and positively encourage the righteous struggle of working people of all the countries for their dignity and rights and the global peace and security. Rodong Sinmun

title: 7th Sports Contest among Public Health Workers Closes
body: The 7th sports contest among public health workers closed with due ceremony at the Pyongyang Indoor Stadium on Wednesday. The Pyongyang Maternity Hospital and the Dental Hospital under the Ministry of Public Health took the first place in standings of the contest which was held, divided into two groups, in such events as basketball, volleyball, table tennis and tug of war. Present at the closing ceremony were Pak Thae Song, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Jon Kwang Ho, vice-premier of the Cabinet, officials concerned, officials and players in the fields of public health and students of Pyongyang Medical College of Kim Il Sung University. Rodong Sinmun

title: Italian Guest Visits Mangyongdae
body: Giancarlo Elia Valori, president of the International World Group of Italy, visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung, on Wednesday. He laid a floral basket before the old home of the President at Mangyongdae. Being briefed on the fact that Kim Il Sung was born and spent childhood while nurturing his great intention of patriotism, he looked round the historical mementoes preserved at the old home. Rodong Sinmun

title: Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace Marks 30th Anniversary
body: The Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace marks its 30th founding anniversary. President Kim Il Sung proposed the building of another magnificent palace for children best in the world and after the completion of the Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace, personally cut the tape at its inaugural ceremony and sent gifts and significant autograph. Chairman Kim Jong Il, who set the Kallimgil area in Mangyongdae, birth place of the President, as the site for the palace, gave detailed guidance to perfect it. Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un saw to it that the palace was splendidly remodeled into a children's palace without an equal in the world and a monumental edifice in the era of the Workers' Party to be proud of over the world. Under the warm care of the peerlessly great men, the Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace has successfully fulfilled its mission and duty as popular extracurricular education centre for schoolchildren and produced a number of reserve scientists, artistes and sportspersons who could shoulder the future of the country. At least 8.2 million schoolchildren have cultivated their talents and desires through extracurricular activities at the palace. Schoolchildren of the groups of the palace have won over 6 500 medals in international and domestic fine art and calligraphy contests and in national sports games. Through over 340 rounds of performances on 20-odd occasions in at least 10 foreign countries and regions and in international contests like concours and children's fine art contests, they have fully displayed the advantages of the socialist educational system all over the world. The palace has produced famous actors and actresses and sports aces and over 40 awardees of honorary titles and academic degrees like the titles of Labor Hero and People's Teacher and doctorate and hundreds of holders of the title of the October 8 Model Professor, new teaching method certificate and inventions certificate. Over 2 700 art performances including New Year performances were given at the palace and members of its art groups have conducted more than 800 rounds of agitation activities for increased production. The palace was awarded the Order of National Flag First Class and many teachers at the palace were honored with high official commendations. Rodong Sinmun

title: Policy Speech of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Supported in Guinea
body: A Guinean organization and personage released statements in support of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's policy speech on April 22. The Guinea-Korea Friendship and Solidarity Association noted in a statement: We fully support the principled stand clarified by H.E. Kim Jong Un, the Supreme Leader of the Korean people, in his historic policy speech as regards the inter-Korean relations and the DPRK-U.S. relations. The south Korean authorities should drop their habit of kowtowing to big countries that goes against the spirit of independence, end their policy of depending on outsiders, which violates the common interests of the nation and subordinate everything to the improvement of the north-south relations. The U.S. should contribute to the building of a peace-keeping mechanism on the Korean peninsula by honestly implementing the June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement. We invariably encourage the Korean people in their struggle for a durable peace of the Korean peninsula and the independent and peaceful reunification. Riyad Chaloub, chairman of the Guinean National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, said the policy speech made by the Supreme Leader serves as important guidelines that help the Korean people more dynamically advance socialist construction under the uplifted banner of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, adding that no force on earth can ever check the advance of the Korean people who are stepping up the building of a powerful socialist country under the experienced leadership of the Supreme Leader. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Published in Brazil
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us Step up the Building of a Thriving Country by Applying Kim Jong Il's Patriotism" was brought out in pamphlet by the Brazilia Alphagraphics Printing Office in Brazil on April 24. The work, published on July 26, Juche 101(2012), deals with the essence of Chairman Kim Jong Il's patriotism and his life constant in noble patriotism and loving care for the people. It also indicates important matters arising in applying Kim Jong Il's patriotism. Rodong Sinmun

title: Editorial
body: Let Us Demonstrate Mettle of Heroic Workers of Juche Korea May Day is the international holiday of the workers in the world. The DPRK’s heroic struggle characterized by great victory and epochal changes and the strong spirit of today’s socialist Korea advancing with pride toward a bright future in the face of all tempests of history are associated with the patriotic devotion made by the Korean workers. The workers of Juche Korea are ardent patriots strong in ideology and faith and fighters of self-reliance who invariably take the path of independence and socialism, always following the Party in the ordinary and stormy days. Self-reliance is just the traditional fighting spirit of the workers and an ever-victorious treasured sword for building a powerful socialist nation. The events of great significance in the history of the nation and the eye-opening successes in all sectors of socialist construction like economy and culture witnessed in the course of foiling the moves of the hostile forces to stamp out the DPRK’s rights to sovereignty, existence and development clearly proved how strong the Korean workers’ spirit of self-reliance and self-development is. Self-reliance is just the mettle and working manner peculiar to the workers of Juche Korea. Unshakable is the will of the workers to strenuously advance along the road of the Juche revolution under the guidance of the Party, holding higher the banner of independence, though they have to take a long and thorny path of revolution.

title: Choe Ryong Hae Inspects Hot-spring Tourist Area under Construction in Yangdok County
body: Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, inspected the hot-spring tourist area under construction in Yangdok County. Walking round the road under construction in the hot-spring tourist area, Choe underscored the need for officials to properly map out plans and provide correct guidance for perfecting the construction projects and satisfactorily push forward afforestation and greening along the road and construction of modern houses in rural area. At the construction site of hot-spring sanatorium area, he stressed the need to improve river conditions in accordance with the geographical characteristics and give precedence to the project for supplying enough water for drinking and housework. The field consultative meeting discussed the issues of making sure that the relevant units timely supply materials in step with construction timetable, raising the proportion of locally available finishing building materials and improving the quality of buildings. Rodong Sinmun

title: Officials and Members of GFTUK Hold Seminar
body: There took place a seminar of officials and members of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea (GFTUK) at the Central Hall of Workers on Thursday to mark the 35th anniversary of publication of Chairman Kim Jong Il's work "On Further Improving the Work of the Trade Unions". Present there were officials concerned and officials of the trade unions, workers and trade union members. Presented at the seminar were papers explaining and proving the validity and vitality of the idea and theory contained in the letter sent by Kim Jong Il to the participants in the national training course for trade union officials on May 3, Juche 73 (1984). The speakers said the idea and theory set forth in his work serve as valuable guidelines to be invariably held fast to by the GFTUK in carrying out the revolutionary cause of Juche, the cause of socialism. The idea that the trade union organizations should dynamically conduct the three revolutions serves as the fundamental guarantee to firmly train workers and trade union members to be genuine Kimilsungists-Kimjongilists and vigorously accelerate socialist construction by giving the fullest play to their mental power, they noted. They said that the trade union organizations can firmly unite workers and trade union members around the Party and fully enlist them in the revolutionary struggle and construction only when they increase their militant function and role as required by modeling the whole society on Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism. They underscored the need to fully demonstrate the valiant spirit of the heroic working class of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il in the present all-people death-defying drive for bringing about a great upsurge in socialist construction under the guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, holding aloft the banner of self-reliance. Rodong Sinmun

title: Vietnamese Delegation Visits Mangyongdae
body: A delegation of the Vietnam Academy of Social Sciences led by Nguyen Thanh Ha, director general of the Department of International Cooperation, visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung, on Thursday. Being briefed on the old home where the President was born and spent childhood, the guests looked round historical mementoes. They toured the revolutionary sites on Mangyong Hill. The delegation also toured the Tower of the Juche Idea, the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum and others. Rodong Sinmun

title: Choe Ryong Hae Meets Italian Guest
body: Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, met and had a talk with Giancarlo Elia Valori, president of the International World Group of Italy, who paid a courtesy call on him at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Thursday. Rodong Sinmun

title: New School Year for Disabled Persons Begins
body: The 8th-term school year of the vocational school under the Central Committee of the Korean Federation for the Protection of the Disabled began with due ceremony on Thursday. Present there were officials concerned, new students, teachers, students and parents. Speeches were made at the ceremony. At the end of the ceremony, the participants watched sports and amusement games of students. Rodong Sinmun

title: Polish Embassy Hosts Reception
body: The Polish embassy here gave a reception on May 3 to mark the national day of the Republic of Poland. Present there on invitation were officials concerned and foreign diplomatic envoys and representatives of international bodies here. On hand were Damian Mikolajczyk, Polish charge d' affaires ad interim, and Polish embassy members. Speeches were made there. Rodong Sinmun

title: Symposium on Medical Science Held
body: The 21st Pyongyang Symposium on Medical Science of Compatriots at Home and Abroad took place at the People's Palace of Culture on May 2 and 3. A lecture was given under the title of "On the advantages of the socialist healthcare system of our country to which the respected Supreme Leader Comrade Kim Jong Un adds luster," and papers on theoretical and practical issues arising in the development of medical science and technology and the public health service were made public. The symposium took place, divided into panels of hepatopathy, dentistry, pharmaceutics and psychiatry. The participants exchanged their research achievements and experience in prevention and treatment of diseases and had in-depth discussions about the issues arising in applying them to clinical practice. Attending the symposium were officials, scientists and teachers of public health sector including the Central Committee of the Medical Association of Korea, and members of a delegation of the Korean Health Workers Association in Japan headed by Chairperson Nam Yang I and a delegation of Korean medical persons in the U.S. led by Park Kee Bum. Rodong Sinmun

title: 34th National Festival of Science and Technology Closes
body: The 34th National Festival of Science and Technology closed with due ceremony at the Three-Revolution Exhibition House on Friday. At the festival opened on April 23 was an exchange of valuable scientific and technological successes and experience gained by scientists, technicians and officials across the country who contributed to ensuring home production of raw and other materials and equipment, putting production process on a modern basis and perfecting the self-supporting economic structure true to the Party's intention. Present at the closing ceremony were Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, member of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, Pak Thae Song, vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, Kim Sung Du, chairman of the Education Commission, Jang Chol, president of the State Academy of Sciences, officials concerned and working people. The results of examination were announced at the ceremony. The special place of the festival was taken by the Central Mining Research Institute of the State Academy of Sciences, the dressing plant No.3 of the Komdok Mining Complex, the Chollima Steel Complex, Ponghwa Chemical Factory and six other units and the first place by over 70 units. Rodong Sinmun

title: Vietnamese Delegation Leaves
body: A delegation of the Vietnam Academy of Social Sciences led by Nguyen Thanh Ha, director general of the Department of International Cooperation, left for home on May 3. Rodong Sinmun

title: Sports Contest of Disabled Persons and Amateurs Opens
body: The sports contest of disabled persons and amateurs opened with due ceremony on Friday at the Changgwang Health Complex. Present at its opening ceremony were officials of the organs concerned including the Central Committee of the Korean Federation for the Protection of the Disabled and players. Jong Hyon, vice-chairman of the C.C., Korean Federation for the Protection of the Disabled, delivered an opening address before speeches. There took place a swimming contest after the ceremony. The contest will last till May 19, divided into groups of disabled persons and amateurs in the events of swimming, table tennis and tennis. Rodong Sinmun

title: Home-visiting Group of Koreans in Japan Leaves
body: A home-visiting group of Koreans in Japan led by Im Jong Hyo, vice-chairman of the Osaka Prefectural Headquarters of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan, left here on May 3. Rodong Sinmun

title: Condolatory Visit to Vietnamese Embassy
body: Ri Kil Song, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, Han Song U, vice-minister of External Economic Relations, Pak Kyong Il, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries who is chairman of the DPRK-Vietnam Friendship Association, Mun Jae Chol, vice general director of the General Bureau for Affairs with Diplomatic Corps, and officials concerned paid a condolatory visit to the Vietnamese embassy here on Friday over the death of Le Duc Anh, former president of Vietnam. Laid before the photo of the deceased were wreaths in the names of the Foreign Ministry, the Ministry of External Economic Relations, the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries and the General Bureau for Affairs with Diplomatic Corps. The participants paid a silent tribute to the memory of the deceased and made entries in a condolence book. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of Int'l Diabetes Federation Here
body: A delegation of the International Diabetes Federation led by President Nam Han Cho arrived here on May 3. Rodong Sinmun

title: Congratulations to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, received congratulatory messages from foreign party and state leaders upon his reelection as chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK at the First Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly. They were the president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic, the president of the Syrian Arab Republic, the president of the State of Palestine who is chairman of the Executive Committee of the Palestine Liberation Organization, the president of DR Congo, the president of the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia and the Mongolian prime minister who is chairman of the People's Party of Mongolia. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Gives Field Guidance to Kumyagang Power Station No. 2
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, gave field guidance to Kumyagang Power Station No. 2 on Saturday. After being briefed on the circumstances of the construction of the power station and its situation, Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un looked round several parts of the power station including the dam and a generating room, learning in detail about the construction, technical equipment and power generation.
