It is admirable that Kumya County is set to build power stations by its own efforts and put the power production on a normal footing in hearty response to the Party's policy on building minor hydraulic power stations suited to the specific local conditions and settling the power problem, he said, speaking highly of the praiseworthy feats performed by the people in the county who created the treasure of national value in the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance and fortitude. He said that there are not a few examples in which cities and counties fall short of getting benefits from minor power stations due to water shortage that led to failure to ensure capacity generation of electricity even though they were built at the cost of massive building materials because the construction was not based on accurate survey of hydraulic resources in the specific areas and on scientific calculation of the amount of electricity generation. If Kumyagang Power Station No. 2 installs thousands of kW power generator as planned and produces electricity at full capacity, it will please the people as it can fully supply power to residential areas, to say nothing of the industrial factories and co-op farms in the county, he said, repeatedly praising the indomitable fighting spirit displayed by the officials and working people of Kumya County in which they provided an important boon for the wealthy economic life of the county with strenuous efforts. Noting that he would feel relieved only when he does something to help the people in Kumya County who did a big thing without being known to others, he promised to send generator and transformers without fail, which have not yet been installed at Kumyagang Power Station No. 2, on his own responsibility. He gave warm encouragement, hoping that Kumya County would ensure the good operation of the power station, a great treasure, to make the people substantially benefit from it and to contribute to the development of county industry and improvement of the people's living and thus prosper as a beautiful county good to live in and develop with vitality. He was accompanied by officials of the Party Central Committee including Kim Phyong Hae, O Su Yong, Jo Yong Won, Kim Yong Su and Ri Yong Sik. Political News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Guides Strike Drill of Defence Units in Frontline Area and on Eastern Front
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, guided the strike drill of defence units in the forefront area and on the eastern front which took place in the East Sea of Korea on Saturday. The purpose of the drill was to estimate and inspect the operating ability and the accuracy of striking duty performance of large-caliber long-range multiple rocket launchers and tactical guided weapons by defence units in the frontline area and on the eastern front and the combat performance of arms and equipment and to more powerfully arouse the entire army to the movement for becoming crackshots with the drill as an occasion and thus put it at combat readiness posture all the time. At the observation post Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un learned about the strike plan of the striking means of different calibers and inspected the fire readiness including the advance to and deployment of large-caliber long-range multiple rocket launchers and tactical guided weapons in fire positions. After setting the sequences and methods of strike, the Supreme Leader gave an order of firing. Praising the People's Army for its excellent operation of modern large-caliber long-range multiple rocket launchers and tactical guided weapons, he said that all the service members are master gunners and they are capable of carrying out duty to promptly tackle any situation as a result of full knowledge of modern weapon system and intensive training. He spoke highly of the successful striking drill though it was organized without an advance notice. Expressing great satisfaction with the rapid response ability of those defence units in the frontline area and on the eastern front to keep them fully ready to go into combat action immediately upon the issuance of order any moment, he gave important instructions for improving and strengthening the operation and combat drill of the People's Army. He stressed the need for all the service members to keep high alert posture and more dynamically wage the drive to increase the combat ability so as to defend the political sovereignty and economic self-sustenance of the country and the gains of revolution and the security of the people from the threats and invasion by any forces, bearing in mind the iron truth that genuine peace and security are ensured and guaranteed only by powerful strength. Watching the drill together with him were cadres of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea including Kim Phyong Hae, O Su Yong, Ri Pyong Chol and Jo Yong Won. Political News Team

title: Floral Basket to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a floral basket from the party of Kenichi Ogami, secretary general of the International Institute of the Juche Idea (IIJI). The floral basket was conveyed to an official concerned on Saturday by Kenichi Ogami on a visit to the DPRK. Rodong Sinmun

title: Secretary General of IIJI Here
body: Kenichi Ogami, secretary general of the International Institute of the Juche Idea (IIJI), and his party arrived here on Saturday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Overseas Koreans Leave
body: A delegation of the Korean Health Workers Association in Japan headed by Chairperson Nam Yang I and a delegation of Korean medical persons in the U.S. led by Park Kee Bum left here on Saturday after attending the 21st Pyongyang Symposium on Medical Science of Compatriots at Home and Abroad. Rodong Sinmun

title: Italian Figure Leaves
body: Giancarlo Elia Valori, president of the International World Group of Italy, left here for home on Saturday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of Central Court Leaves for Laos, Vietnam
body: A delegation of the Central Court headed by President Kang Yun Sok left here on Saturday to visit Laos and Vietnam. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to Union Party for Republic of Mauritania
body: The Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea sent a message of greeting to the National Council of the Union Party for the Republic of Mauritania on Saturday on the 10th founding anniversary of the Union Party for the Republic of Mauritania. The message said that the union party has achieved great successes by working hard to consolidate national unity and social stability and achieve economic development and prosperity in the past ten years since its founding. It said that the union party increases cooperation and unity with progressive forces, maintaining the stand of national independence. Expressing the belief that the friendly relations between the WPK and the union party would grow stronger in the future, the message wished the union party greater success in the struggle for its development and social progress. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Birthday Spread to Anti-Japanese Revolutionary Fighter
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un sent a birthday spread to anti-Japanese revolutionary fighter Hwang Sun Hui, curator of the Korean Revolution Museum, on her centenarian birthday. She was born in an alien land on May 3, Juche 8 (1919), was deprived of her family by the Japanese imperialists in her early years and wandered to seek a way for living. She led a genuine life and grew up to be a revolutionary under the care of President Kim Il Sung. She worked as a branch chief of the Children’s Corps in her early years under the guidance of the anti-Japanese war heroine Kim Jong Suk before joining the Korean People's Revolutionary Army and taking part in many battles including the Battle of Jiansanfeng and devoting her all to accomplishing the historic cause of national liberation. President Kim Il Sung took benevolent steps, paying special attention to her health and life after the liberation of the country, and made sure that she conducted the Party work at the Korean Revolution Museum. Chairman Kim Jong Il took care of her work and life and saw to it that photo and data of Hwang Sun Hui were displayed at the room "The Great Leaders and Comrades-in-Arms" of the Korean Revolution Museum. Working as a leading official of the museum under the care of the President and the Chairman, she remained single-mindedly loyal to the guidance of the Party. Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un paid deep attention to her health and sent his autograph representing his paternal love so that she would live full of energy despite her advanced age. She devotedly worked for the Party and revolution, the country and people as a member of the leadership organ of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and deputy to the Supreme People's Assembly and was awarded the Party and state commendations like Order of Kim Il Sung, Order of Kim Jong Il, the title of Hero of the Republic twice and the title of Labor Hero. The birthday spread sent by Kim Jong Un was conveyed to her on Friday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Youth League Delegation Back Home
body: A delegation of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League headed by Pak Chol Min, chairman of its Central Committee, returned home on Sunday after visiting Russia. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Expresses Invariable Support and Solidarity to Venezuelan People
body: A spokesperson for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) gave the following answer to a question put by KCNA on May 5 as regards the coup d'état attempt by anti-government forces in Venezuela: An abnormal incident broke out recently in Venezuela, where internal anti-government forces attempted a coup d'état to remove the legitimately elected president. The latest coup d'état attempt is an extremely dangerous act of violence that pushes the Venezuelan situation to an utmost instability, having a highly negative impact on the overall situation in the region. The situation in Venezuela is being aggravated day by day, because the internal anti-government forces are launching, with the support of the outside forces, a campaign against the president from January and the hostile forces are making undisguised attempt to deprive Venezuela of its representation in the United Nations. At the same time, the United States, acting like a "single superpower", is making such reckless remarks that a military action is possible with regard to the Venezuelan situation and the U.S. will carry out that action if so necessary. These remarks are evoking great concern of the international community. We condemn all of the attempts for removing the legitimately elected president of Venezuela and interfering in its internal affairs as a challenge to international justice and a flagrant violation of international law. We call for a peaceful solution to the Venezuelan issue in accordance with the independent will and decision of the government and people of that country and extend invariable support and solidarity to the Venezuelan people in their struggle for defending sovereignty. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Reply Messages to Foreign Party and State Leaders
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un sent messages to foreign party and state leaders in reply to their congratulatory messages upon his re-election as chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea at the First Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly. They were the president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic who is general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party, the Mongolian president, the president of the Syrian Arab Republic, the president of the State of Palestine who is chairman of the Executive Committee of the Palestine Liberation Organization, the president of the Islamic Republic of Iran, the president of the Republic of Senegal, the president of the Republic of Equatorial Guinea, the president of the Democratic Republic of Congo and the president of the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia. Kim Jong Un in his reply messages expressed deep thanks to them for sending him warm congratulations and sincere wishes. Expressing the belief that the friendly and cooperative relations between the DPRK and the relevant countries would grow stronger, he wished them bigger successes in their responsible work. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Gift from IIJI Secretary General
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a gift from Kenichi Ogami, secretary general of the International Institute of the Juche Idea (IIJI). The gift was conveyed to an official concerned by Kenichi Ogami on a visit to the DPRK. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of Int'l Diabetes Federation Tours Pyongyang
body: A delegation of the International Diabetes Federation led by President Nam Han Cho visited the Ryugyong General Ophthalmic Hospital. Members of the delegation made rounds of treatment rooms and wards, being briefed on the fact that the hospital contributes to promoting the people's health. The delegation also toured the Tower of the Juche Idea, the Arch of Triumph and the Okryu Children's Hospital. Rodong Sinmun

title: IIJI Secretary General Visits Statues of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: The secretary general of the International Institute of the Juche Idea (IIJI) and his party visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on Sunday. They laid a floral basket and made a bow before the statues. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Policy Speech Supported in Austria, Syria
body: An Austrian body and a Syrian figure made public statements on April 20 and 21 in support of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's historic policy speech. The Youth Group for Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism formed in Austria said in a statement that the policy speech made by Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, at the First Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly is an important guideline leading socialist Korea along the road of independence and victory. In his policy speech, he underscored the need to advance the revolution and construction by dint of self-reliance, the statement said. The Korean people will make a more vigorous advance under the uplifted banner of socialism thanks to his seasoned leadership, which will instill great confidence and courage into the world progressives, the statement pointed out. Saber Ballul, head of the Department of the Political Faculty of University of Damascus in Syria, said HE Kim Jong Un in his policy speech clarified the way ahead of the Korean people and that his far-reaching plan for the people's wellbeing will surely come true. Rodong Sinmun

title: Day of Sun Marked Abroad
body: A seminar was held in Algeria, a Korean book, photo and craftwork exhibition in Russia and an opening ceremony of the week of DPRK film show in Syria to mark President Kim Il Sung's birth anniversary, the Day of the Sun. Present at the events were personages of various strata and masses of the relevant countries. The chairman of the Algeria-Korea Friendship Association said President Kim Il Sung was an outstanding man who illuminated the way ahead of mankind and performed noble exploits to be recorded in history and that the world progressives highly praise him while looking back upon his life with emotion on the occasion of the Day of the Sun, a holiday common to mankind. The acting minister of Culture of the Samara Region Administration of Russia said that all the people in the world pay high tribute to the President, lauding him as a great statesman and leader boundlessly revered by the whole of mankind including Russians. Another Russian personage said that the Russia-DPRK friendship has a long history and both countries have promoted active exchange and cooperation in various fields such as politics, economy and culture, wishing the Korean people bigger successes in socialist construction under the wise guidance of HE Kim Jong Un. Meanwhile, an internet photo show was held in Nepal to celebrate the Day of the Sun. Rodong Sinmun

title: Seminar Held
body: Media persons held a seminar at the Central Youth Hall on Monday to mark the 45th anniversary of the publication of Chairman Kim Jong Il's work "Our Party's Media Is a Powerful Ideological Weapon Which Contributes to Modeling the Whole of Society on Kimilsungism". The work, published on May 7, Juche 63 (1974), is an immortal encyclopedia giving comprehensive and scientific answers to the theoretical and practical issues arising in developing the Party's mass media into the most revolutionary and militant ideological weapon for the materialization of the idea and cause of the leader. Speakers at the seminar explained that the idea and theory of publications and reports clarified by Kim Jong Il in his work serve as an ideological weapon to be always held fast to by media persons. The validity and vitality of the Juche-oriented idea of mass media have been fully displayed after the publication of the work, so that the revolution and construction have been dynamically propelled, they said. They also stressed that Kim Jong Il's idea and theory of mass media have been further developed and enriched under the wise guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. They said the idea and theory advanced by the Supreme Leader are an immortal banner to be always held fast to in defending and adding eternal luster to the undying feats of Kim Jong Il and in bringing about another revolution in mass media as required by the reality. They called upon all the media persons to firmly adhere to the Juche-oriented idea of mass media set forth by Kim Jong Il and Kim Jong Un as a lifeline, thoroughly materialize it and thus fulfill their mission and duty as ideological standard-bearers in the ongoing all-out death-defying campaign to open up a period of a great upsurge in the socialist construction under the banner of self-reliance. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Tribute to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: A delegation of the Vietnam Women's Union visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on Monday. Members of the delegation laid a floral basket before the statues and paid tribute to them. Rodong Sinmun

body: A delegation of officials of the Korean Youth League in Japan led by Ri Kwang Il, vice-chairman of its Central Standing Committee, left here on Monday. Rodong Sinmun

title: 15th National Machine Design Festival Closes
body: The 15th National Machine Design Festival closed with due ceremony at the Sci-Tech Complex on Monday. Exchanged at the festival that opened from April 29 were research achievements and experience which are of importance in further developing the nation's designing technology for machine by completing designs of machinery and equipment for various sectors of the national economy on high level. Present at the closing ceremony were Im Chol Ung, vice premier of the Cabinet, Ri Chung Gil, chairman of the State Commission of Science and Technology, officials concerned and participants in the festival. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Policy Speech Supported by Bulgarian Body
body: The Bulgarian Group for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism made public a statement on April 29 in support of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's policy speech. In his policy speech Kim Jong Un called for frustrating the hostile forces' sanctions on the strength of self-sufficiency and self-reliance, the statement said. The statement expressed support for the just measures taken by the DPRK to foil the imperialists' sanctions and develop its self-supporting economy. It said that the achievements made by the Korean people serve as an example to be followed by world progressives, and the peoples of the countries aspiring after independence extend firm solidarity to the struggle of the Korean people. The statement expressed full support for the efforts of the DPRK for peace of the Korean peninsula and slammed the policy hostile toward the DPRK pursued by the imperialists, the chief peace wrecker. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of Int'l Diabetes Federation Leaves
body: A delegation of the International Diabetes Federation led by President Nam Han Cho left here on May 7. Rodong Sinmun

title: Pyongyang Medical Science Symposium on Diabetes Held
body: The Pyongyang medical science symposium on diabetes was held on May 6 and 7. It was attended by members of the Diabetes Committee of the Korean Hospital Association and other medical experts and members of the delegation of the International Diabetes Federation led by President Nam Han Cho. Sin Pong Chol, chairman of the Diabetes Committee of the Korean Hospital Association, made an opening address to be followed by congratulatory speeches. Sin Pong Chol said that the current symposium would become a good occasion in exchanging the achievements and experience gained in preventing, curing and researching diabetes, a global issue. Speakers expressed expectation that the participants in the symposium would obtain techniques for curing diabetes and that the ties between the International Diabetes Federation and the Diabetes Committee of the Korean Hospital Association would grow stronger. Then speeches were made. Rodong Sinmun

title: Birthday Spread Sent to Centenarian
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un sent a birthday spread to Kim Ae Gi, a centenarian residing in Sohung-dong, Sinam District, Chongjin City, North Hamgyong Province. Born as a daughter of poor peasants before the liberation of the country, she lived in privation and sorrow. It was only after the liberation of the country by President Kim Il Sung that she could lead a genuine life. She devotedly worked in the fishing sector and kept herself busy even after becoming a pensioner. She is enjoying her life having a balanced diet. Rodong Sinmun

title: Lao Delegation Here
body: A delegation of the Lao Veterans Federation led by President Keomixay Somphon arrived here on Tuesday. Rodong Sinmun

title: May 21 Architectural Festival Opens
body: The 19th May 21 Architectural Festival opened with due ceremony at the Sci-Tech Complex on Tuesday. The festival on the theme of "Let's build up all structures on the world level by dint of our strength and technology" will showcase more than 420 architectural designs, 50-odd construction gears and tools, above 30 IT-based design programs selected in provincial (municipal) festivals. Attending the opening ceremony were Vice-Premier Tong Jong Ho, officials, architects, designers, teachers and researchers in the fields of architectural design, construction, building materials, supervision, science research and education. Rodong Sinmun

title: Appeal for World Peace-Loving People Supported by DR Congolese Organizations
body: DR Congolese organizations extended support to an appeal sent by the Latin American and Caribbean Regional Committee to Support the Reunification of Korea to the world peace-loving people on the occasion of the first anniversary of the adoption of the historic Panmunjom Declaration and the June 12 DPRK-U.S. joint statement. The National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of DR Congo and its affiliated organizations, the DR Congo-Korea Friendship and Solidarity Association and the Working Citizens' Association of DR Congo made public a statement at a meeting cosponsored by them on April 26. The statement said that they fully supported the appeal made by the Latin American and Caribbean Regional Committee to Support the Reunification of Korea which suggested setting the "international action period for peace, prosperity and reunification on the Korean peninsula" from April 27 to June 12 which mark the first anniversary of the adoption of the Panmunjom Declaration and the June 12 DPRK-U.S. joint statement thanks to the bold decision and will of HE Kim Jong Un for defending peace. It noted that the adoption of the Panmunjom Declaration and the June 12 DPRK-U.S. joint statement is an event of radical significance in achieving the improvement of the inter-Korean relations, reunification on the Korean peninsula and peace and security in Northeast Asia and the rest of the world. It stressed that the south Korean authorities should sincerely implement the declaration without reading someone's face in line with the trend of the present times. It added that the U.S. should make efforts to improve the DPRK-U.S. relations and build a durable and solid peace-keeping mechanism on the Korean peninsula as specified in the June 12 DPRK-U.S. joint statement. It concluded that they clarify once again that they would conduct more dynamic solidarity activities to support the Korean people's just cause, being convinced that the tragedy of the Korean national division which has lasted century after century would be removed at an early date thanks to HE Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK-Russia Summit Talks Hailed
body: Atul Kumar Anjan, chairman of the All India Indo-Korean Friendship Association, and Suneet Chopra, secretary general of the association, made public a joint statement on April 26 as regards the visit of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un to Russia. The statement warmly hailed the DPRK-Russia summit talks held in Russia. It said they were convinced that the measures taken by the DPRK would accelerate the reunification of the Korean peninsula and certainly put an end to the hostile forces' sanctions and pressure to check regional progress and prosperity. It extended firm solidarity to the Korean people in their struggle for realizing the country's reunification, the long-cherished desire of the nation, as soon as possible. Rodong Sinmun

title: President Kim Il Sung's Exploits Lauded by Russian Media
body: Russian media gave special write-ups together with portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and his photos, art pieces depicting him and photos of him standing together with Chairman Kim Jong Il to mark the birth anniversary of Kim Il Sung (Day of the Sun). The paper Komsomolskaya Pravda carried articles titled "Comrade Kim Il Sung, great man's history goes on", "Political idea of President Kim Il Sung" and "Eternal sun of Juche". It said that President Kim Il Sung passed away, but his history still continues and elaborated on his immortal exploits. A Russian newspaper in an article titled "On the road of revolution" lauded his revolutionary career and said that songs revering him reverberate worldwide century after century. Papers Zavtra, Glasnosti, Nizhegorodskaya Pravda, Tsumenskaya Pravda and Rio Panorama carried articles praising him. Internet magazine Lemchich carried articles titled "The Sun of Juche rose up in Mangyongdae", "Life of devotion to the people", "For the people's happiness", "Eternal smile of the great man", "Noble image never to be forgotten", "Reverence of the people", "Politics of loving care for the people" and "The great master of independent diplomacy". Another Russian newspaper carried an article praising the life of the President for the people and Zebri Deve, internet paper of Khabarovsk Territory, gave a special write-up titled "Kim Il Sung-founder of the tradition of self-reliance and self-development". Rodong Sinmun

title: Manifestation of Sinister Plot of Japan for Realizing Its Ill-intentioned Ambition
body: Japan is planning to import interceptor missiles from the U.S. under the pretext of “missile threat” from someone. Japan wants to purchase 56 SM-3 Block 1B interceptor missiles which can be mounted on an Aegis ship. It is pushing forward the introduction of the new type SM-3 Block 2A interceptor missile which it developed together with the U.S. Japan’s move is an act of deliberately wrecking the peaceful atmosphere that settled on the Korean peninsula and the region. A peaceful climate has been created on the peninsula thanks to the DPRK’s active steps and patient efforts, but only Japan has an axe to grind, taking umbrage at the present situation. That explains why Japan tries to buy interceptor missiles costing an arm and a leg under the pretext of the non-existent “missile threat” from someone. Japan’s intention is as clear as noonday. It tries to fish in troubled waters by complicating the situation of the peninsula. In a word, the Japanese reactionaries’ move is designed to mess up the peaceful atmosphere of the peninsula and, by taking advantage of that, realize their ambition for a military power. Turning itself into a military power is never beneficial to Japan. If Japan keeps doing reckless acts unaware of the change in the strategic structure on the peninsula and the region, it will face ruin only. Jo Thaek Bom

title: DPRK Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Criticizes Some Forces for Making Issue of Its Routine and Self-Defensive Military Drill
body: A spokesperson for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) gave the following answer to a question put by KCNA on May 8 with regard to the fact that some forces are making an issue of the DPRK's recent military drill. As has already been reported, a strike drill was conducted in the East Sea of Korea on May 4, the purpose of which was to check the operating ability of large-caliber long-range multiple rocket launchers and tactical guided weapons, the accuracy in mission fulfilment and the combat performance of military equipment of the defense units in the frontline area and on the eastern front and, on this occasion, to further galvanize the entire army into the movement for becoming crack shots and make thorough preparations for combat mobilization at all times. The drill once again confirmed the rapid reaction capability of those defense units in the frontline area and on the eastern front that are fully prepared to go immediately into combat under any orders and at any moment. Some forces, however, are making spiteful remarks on this routine and self-defensive military drill conducted by the DPRK. There are some countries that have become totally mute so far on the proactive measures of crucial and strategically decisive nature taken by the DPRK for peace and stability of the Korean Peninsula and on the maximum patience demonstrated by the DPRK concerning the impasse created in the course of implementing the June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement because of the absence of due corresponding response to the said measures. These countries are now impertinently making spiteful remarks on our recent military drill of regular and self-defensive character. The recent drill conducted by our army is nothing more than part of the regular military training, and it has neither targeted anyone nor led to an aggravation of situation in the region. Any country carries on military drills for national defense and this kind of very normal drill is obviously different from the war exercises waged by some countries against other sovereign states. In last March and April alone, the U.S.-south Korea joint military exercise "Dong Maeng (Alliance) 19-1" and joint aerial military drill were conducted in south Korea, and war drill plans aiming at us continue to be worked out even at this very moment. For unknown reasons, however, there is only dead silence on these provocative military drills and war exercises. Only our regular and self-defensive military drill is branded as provocative, and this is an undisguised manifestation of the attempt to press the gradual disarmament of our state and finally invade us. We think this is very much unpleasant and regrettable, and we sound a note of warning. Those forces would be well-advised that if they attempt to deny our sovereignty and self-defensive right by making baseless allegations against us at anyone's instigation, it might produce a result of driving us to the direction which neither we nor they want to see at all. We will watch the future words and deeds of those forces. Rodong Sinmun

title: 14th Symposium on Architectural Aesthetics Held
body: The 14th Symposium on Architectural Aesthetics took place at the Central Youth Hall on Wednesday. Attending the event were Kwon Song Ho, minister of State Construction Control, Kim Kyong Jun, minister of Land and Environment Protection, Kang Yong Su, minister of Urban Management, officials concerned and officials and students in the fields of construction, designing, control, science and education here and the participants in the 19th May 21 Architectural Festival. Jo Jong Mun, general director of the State General Bureau of Design, and other speakers referred to the fact that there have been built model edifices peculiar in formative art embodying the Juche character and national character under the guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, and explained the theoretical and practical issues arising in further developing the Juche-oriented architecture. They stressed that the Supreme Leader has energetically led grand construction for the prosperity of the country and happiness of the people to be carried out in a big way. Speakers said that all the officials and workers in the field of construction would hold fast to the Juche-oriented idea of the Workers' Party of Korea on architectural aesthetics as the guidelines to accelerate the grand march of self-reliance and sci-tech development and thus make a positive contribution to materializing the far-reaching construction plan of Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Talks Held between Veterans' Organizations of DPRK and Laos
body: Talks were held on Wednesday between members of the Korean Committee of Veterans against Imperialism and the delegation of the Lao Veterans Federation. Present there from the DPRK side were Army General Pak Jae Gyong, chairman of the Korean Committee of Veterans against Imperialism, and members of the committee and from the Lao side members of the delegation of the Lao Veterans Federation led by President Keomixay Somphon and Sisavath Khamsaly, Lao ambassador to the DPRK. At the talks both veterans' organizations informed each other of their activities and had an exchange of views over boosting exchange and cooperation between them. That day the Korean Committee of Veterans against Imperialism gave a reception in welcome of the delegation of the Lao Veterans Federation. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of Vietnam Women's Union Visits Mangyongdae
body: A delegation of the Vietnam Women's Union led by President Nguyen Thi Thu Ha visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. Members of the delegation looked round the historical relics, being briefed on the fact that Kim Il Sung nurtured the great intention to liberate the country, receiving patriotic education from his parents. They toured the Okryu Children's Hospital, the Kyongsang Kindergarten, the Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace, etc. Rodong Sinmun

title: Lao Guests Visit Statues of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: A delegation of the Lao Veterans Federation led by President Keomixay Somphon visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on Wednesday. Members of the delegation laid bouquets at the statues of the great leaders and made a bow to them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Panmunjom Declaration Supported by Thai, Myanmar Figures
body: Figures of Thailand and Myanmar issued statements on April 27 on the occasion of the 1st anniversary of the adoption of the Panmunjom Declaration. Songchit Pullarp, chairman of the Organization for the Study of the Juche Idea of Thailand, said that President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il made immortal contributions to accomplishing the cause of Korea's reunification. He noted that Kim Il Sung advanced the Three Principles of National Reunification and the 10-Point Programme of the Great Unity of the Whole Nation and put his heart and soul into the country's reunification till the last moment of his life. He said that the June 15 North-South Joint Declaration and the October 4 Declaration were published thanks to Kim Jong Il so that the Korean people could dynamically advance the cause of national reunification, united closer in the idea of By Our Nation Itself. He added that Korea's reunification would be certainly realized thanks to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, who is successfully carrying forward the great leaders' idea and cause of national reunification. Tin Tun, director of the Myanmar Medical Research Institute, said that the Panmunjom Declaration commanded strong support and deep sympathy of the whole world, expressing the expectation that the international community would extend invariable support to the Korean people's struggle for implementing the declaration. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK-Russia Summit Meeting and Talks Hailed
body: The Paektusan Czech-Korean Friendship Association released a statement on April 27 as regards Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's visit to Russia. The statement warmly congratulated the successful summit meeting and talks between Kim Jong Un, Supreme Leader of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation. It said that Kim Jong Un's visit to Russia displayed the daily rising status of socialist Korea in the international arena. His visit served as a great contribution to ensuring peace in the Korean peninsula and the region, it noted. The traditional friendly relations between the DPRK and Russia with long history grew stronger through the meeting of the supreme leaders of the two countries, it stressed. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Published in Denmark
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "The Cause of the Great Party of Comrades Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il Is Ever-Victorious" was published in booklet by the Denmark-DPRK Friendship Association on April 30. The work, published on Oct. 4, Juche 104 (2015), says that the 70 year-long history of the Workers' Party of Korea is the one of victory in which the validity and invincibility of the cause of the Party of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il have been displayed and that the cause of the Party is ever-victorious. Rodong Sinmun

title: Expanding Action Scope of Japanese SDF Intended to Attain Purpose of Reinvasion
body: Last year witnessed joint military exercises between Japan Maritime “Self-Defense Force” and the British Navy and between the Japan Ground “Self-Defense Force” and the British Ground Force. Japan is now going to sign an agreement on the status of visiting unit between SDF and the British army. Crying out for peace, Japan dispatches its forces to other regions. Such hurried move of SDF deserves the caution of other countries including Asian nations. It is as clear as noonday that such activities are a link in the whole chain of the moves for overseas expansion getting more undisguised. They are also aimed at the realization of the old dream of the “Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere” which did not come true. The Japanese reactionaries seek to achieve its ambition of reinvasion, controlling the neighboring countries by dint of the superiority in the military strength. Most of Japanese reactionaries think that Japan was defeated because it was weak. Japan’s reinvasion is a matter of time. Ri Hak Nam

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Guides Strike Drill of Defence Units in Forefront Area and on Western Front
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, guided the strike drill of defence units of the Korean People's Army (KPA) in the forefront area and on the western front on Thursday. At the command post Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un learned about a plan of the strike drill of various long-range strike means and gave an order of start of the drill. The drill for mobility and assault strike designed to inspect the rapid response of the defence units in the forefront area and on the western front successfully showed the might of the units which were fully prepared to proficiently carry out any operation and combat in the flames of the practical actual maneuvers kindled by the Party. Expressing satisfaction with the mobility, deployment and assault strike, Kim Jong Un said that some days ago, the defence units on the eastern front perfectly carried out their strike mission and today's drill showed the full preparations of the defence units on the western front and the excellent ability of the units in the forefront area to carry out the task of strike, in particular. He stressed the need to further increase the capability of the defence units in the forefront area and on the western front to carry out combat tasks and keep full combat posture to cope with any emergency as required by the prevailing situation and in keeping with the Party's strategic intention. Noting that the genuine peace and security of the country are guaranteed only by the strong physical force capable of defending its sovereignty, he stressed that the People's Army should reliably defend the socialist country and the people's heroic struggle for creation by force of arms of revolution in the future, too. He set forth important tasks for further increasing the strike ability of the defence units of the KPA in the forefront area and on the western front. Watching the drill together with him were leading officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea including Kim Phyong Hae, O Su Yong and Jo Yong Won. Political News Team

title: Delegation of Central Court of DPRK Meets Lao President
body: A delegation of the Central Court of the DPRK headed by President Kang Yun Sok on a visit to Laos met and had a talk with Bounnang Vorachith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party and president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic, at the presidential building on May 7. Bounnang Vorachith expressed the conviction that the bilateral relations would grow stronger, saying that the traditional friendly and cooperative relations between the two parties, two states and two peoples continue to develop on good terms under the deep care of Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. He wished Kim Jong Un, Supreme Leader of the DPRK, great success in his noble work for leading the building of a powerful socialist country. Present there were the DPRK ambassador to Laos, the president of the People's Supreme Court of Laos and officials concerned. Rodong Sinmun

title: U.S. Military Drill Aims at Ratcheting Up Situation on Korean Peninsula
body: A recent revelation has it that the U.S. forces in south Korea staged THAAD deployment drill in Phyongthaek Base in Kyonggi Province. Commenting on this, south Korean media and experts say that toward the end of last year THAAD was revealed to have been under drill after being relocated to Songju Base in North Kyongsang Province but it is the first time that the drill in Phyongthaek Base was revealed, adding that the recent drill sends a pressure message to the north. The deployment drill is apparently an extension of the U.S. policy of sanctions to stifle the DPRK, a military provocation to chill the hard-won atmosphere of peace on the Korean peninsula created with much effort and an open threat and blackmail against the DPRK. In the face of a flurry of censure from a broad spectrum of people against the drill, the U.S. is making lame excuses but it is just a thinly-veiled trick to spare denunciation as the harasser of peace by all the Koreans and the world peace-loving people. If the U.S. truly wishes for peace on the peninsula, it should not resort to the moves of stifling the DPRK by dint of strength but stop all acts of hostility against the DPRK as the former committed itself to abolish the relations of animosity and write a new history. The U.S. has to clearly understand that the use of force will bring it nothing, let alone browbeat the DPRK. Rodong Sinmun

title: Gift to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Vietnam Women's Union
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a gift from the Vietnam Women's Union. The gift was conveyed to Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, by President of the Vietnam Women's Union Nguyen Thi Thu Ha who is head of the delegation of the union on a visit to the DPRK on Thursday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Russian Embassy Officials Visit Liberation Tower
body: Staff members of the Russian embassy here on Thursday laid a wreath at the Liberation Tower on the occasion of the 74th anniversary of Russia's victory in the great Patriotic War. Present at the wreath-laying ceremony were Ambassador Alexandr Matsegora and members of the Russian embassy and diplomatic envoys and military attaches of foreign embassies here. A wreath in the name of the Russian embassy was laid at the tower. The participants paid a silent tribute to fallen fighters of the Soviet Army and looked round the tower. Staff members of the Russian embassy also placed a wreath and bouquets at the cemetery of fallen fighters of the Soviet Army in Sadong District, Pyongyang on the same day. Earlier, they visited liberation towers, statues of Soviet soldiers, cemeteries and monuments to the fallen Soviet soldiers in local areas. Meanwhile, staff members of the Russian consulate general in Chongjin placed bouquets at the Liberation Tower and the cemetery of fallen soldiers of the Soviet Army in Chongjin City of North Hamgyong Province. And a reception was hosted by the consulate general. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chinese Guests Visit Mangyongdae
body: A friendship delegation of Yuwen Middle School in Jilin of China headed by Principal Jiang Guofu visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. Members of the delegation laid a bouquet before the old home of the President in Mangyongdae. Being briefed on the revolutionary history of the President and the noble patriotic spirit of his family members of Mangyongdae, they looked round the historical mementoes. The delegation also visited the Tower of the Juche Idea, Changdok School, Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace and other places and laid bouquets before the Friendship Tower. Rodong Sinmun

title: Ri Su Yong Meets Vietnamese Delegation
body: Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, had a talk with a delegation of the Vietnam Women's Union led by President Nguyen Thi Thu Ha, which paid a courtesy call on him on Thursday. Rodong Sinmun

title: No Kwang Chol Meets Delegation of Lao Veterans Federation
body: Army General No Kwang Chol, minister of the People's Armed Forces, had a talk with a delegation of the Lao Veterans Federation led by President Keomixay Somphon that paid a courtesy call on him on Thursday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of State Emergency Disaster Committee Leaves for Switzerland
body: A delegation of the State Emergency Disaster Committee led by Chairman Kang Il Sop left here on Thursday to attend the 6th world forum for prevention of danger of disaster to be held in Switzerland. Rodong Sinmun

title: Appeal of Latin American and Caribbean Regional Committee to Support Reunification of Korea Supported
body: The Arab Regional Committee for Friendship and Solidarity with the Korean People released a statement on April 25 in support of an appeal of the Latin American and Caribbean Regional Committee to Support the Reunification of Korea. The statement expressed full support for a proposal made by the Latin American and Caribbean Regional Committee to Support the Reunification of Korea to set a period from April 27 to June 12 as the "international action period for peace, prosperity and reunification on the Korean peninsula" on the occasion of the 1st anniversary of the adoption of the Panmunjom Declaration and the June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement. It stressed the need to take positive international action for peace and stability on the Korean peninsula and support the Korean people in their struggle for national prosperity with concerted efforts. Rodong Sinmun

title: Korean People's Struggle Supported by Swiss Organizations
body: Swiss organizations released a joint statement in support of the appeal of the Latin American and Caribbean Regional Committee to Support the Reunification of Korea. The joint statement of the Swiss Organizing Committee for the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu, the Switzerland-Korea Committee and the Swiss Group for the Study of the Juche Idea expressed full support for the appeal sent by the Latin American and Caribbean Regional Committee to Support the Reunification of Korea to the world peace-loving people on the occasion of the first anniversary of the adoption of the Panmunjom Declaration and the June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement. It stressed the historic significance of the north-south and the DPRK-U.S. summit meetings held last year thanks to the bold decision and will of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. It paid respects to the noble will of Chairman Kim Jong Un for defending peace. It hoped Korea's reunification will be achieved as soon as possible under the banner of the Panmunjom Declaration. It supported the Korean people in their struggle for establishing a durable peace-keeping mechanism on the Korean peninsula. Rodong Sinmun

title: President Kim Il Sung's Work Introduced in Nepal
body: The Nepalese newspaper Arpan carried the full text of President Kim Il Sung's work "Answers to Questions Raised by the Chairman of the Nepal Journalist Association" on May 3. The work, published on Nov. 29, Juche 79 (1990), deals with the essence of the Juche idea, invincibility of Korean socialism, ways for realizing Korea's reunification and the stand of the DPRK government to develop the friendly and cooperative relations between the DPRK and Nepal. The newspaper carried a portrait of smiling Kim Il Sung and his photo. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of Lao Veterans Federation Visits Mangyongdae
body: A delegation of the Lao Veterans Federation led by President Keomixay Somphon visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. Members of the delegation looked round the historic mementoes, being briefed on the fact that Kim Il Sung nurtured a great intention to liberate the country and embarked on the road of revolution in his early years. They also toured the Tower of the Juche Idea, the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum, the Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace, etc. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chinese Guests Leave
body: A friendship delegation of Yuwen Middle School in Jilin of China headed by Principal Jiang Guofu left for home on Friday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Vietnamese Delegation Leaves
body: A delegation of the Vietnam Women's Union led by President Nguyen Thi Thu Ha left for home on Friday. Rodong Sinmun

title: May 21 Architectural Festival Closes
body: The 19th May 21 Architectural Festival closed with due ceremony at the Sci-Tech Complex on Friday. During the festival the participants exchanged their successes and experience gained in the course of waging a dynamic campaign for research and creation to promote dry-process fabrication and put the construction science and technology like zero-energy, zero-carbon and intelligent architectural techniques on a high level. Highly appreciated at the festival were architectural layouts, construction equipment, tools and CAD programs. Attending at the closing ceremony were Vice-Premier Tong Jong Ho, officials, architects, designers, teachers and researchers in the fields of architectural designing, construction, building materials, supervision, science research and education. Rodong Sinmun

title: Koryo Songgyungwan University
body: Koryo Songgyungwan University was founded in 992. The feudal state of Koryo (918-1392) instituted its highest institution of education in Kaesong, its capital. It was called Kukjagam in those days. Afterwards, it was named Songgyungam, Songgyungwan, Kukjagam, etc. It was finally called Songgyungwan from 1362 onwards. At the beginning, it gave lessons in Confucianism, the West, arithmetic and so forth. It had 200 students or so. It precedes historied Oxford and Paris Universities in birth. It is believed to count among the oldest universities of the world. The building of Songgyungwan erected in the years of Koryo was reduced to ashes by the Japanese invaders during the Imjin Patriotic War of 1592-98. The existing building was put up again between 1602 and 1610. Kang Myong Chon

title: National Training Course in Welfare Service
body: The national training course in welfare service was given at the Changgwang Health Complex (CHC) between April 24 and 30. It takes place every year to spread and popularize nationwide the experiences acquired and applied by the CHC in haircut, beauty art, facial culture and massage. This year over 200 welfare service workers singled out from all provinces learned successes and experiences from the excellent barbers, beauty artists, beauty doctors and massagers of the CHC. They gave lessons to their learners, imparted their techniques to them and judged their technical level. The techniques of the learners were judged on the last day of the training course to place North Hamgyong Province first, Pyongyang second and Kangwon Province third. Ri Sin Hyang

title: DPRK Photo Exhibition Held in China
body: A DPRK photo exhibition took place at Bangchuidao Guesthouse from April 26 to 28 on the occasion of the 1st anniversary of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's visit to Dalian City, China. Displayed at the venue were photos dealing with the Supreme Leader's visit to Dalian City. Present at the opening ceremony were personages of various units including the People's Association for Friendship and the People's Government in Dalian City, the DPRK consul general in Shenyang, staff members of the consulate general and others. Congratulatory speeches were made there. Then the participants in the ceremony looked round the photos on display. Meanwhile, a Korean fine art exhibition was opened in Beijing on May 4. Rodong Sinmun

title: Thai King Hopes for Development of Relations with DPRK
body: DPRK Ambassador Kim Je Bong presented his credentials to Maha Vajiralongkorn Bodindradebayavarangkun, king of Thailand, on May 7. The king said that he attached great importance to the development of the Thailand-DPRK relations and would pay special attention to it. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of Lao Veterans Federation Leaves
body: A delegation of the Lao Veterans Federation led by President Keomixay Somphon left here for home on Saturday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of Central Court of DPRK Meets Vice-President of Vietnam
body: A delegation of the Central Court of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea headed by President Kang Yun Sok on a visit to Vietnam met and had a talk with Dang Thi Ngoc Thinh, vice-president of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, at the presidential building on May 10. The vice-president said that brisk exchange has been made in various sectors after the establishment of diplomatic relations between the two countries, noting that the firm foundation for the development of bilateral relations was provided by President Ho Chi Minh and President Kim Il Sung. He wished the DPRK greater success in improving the people's standard of living under the guidance of Chairman Kim Jong Un. That day, the delegation met with the minister of Justice of Vietnam. Rodong Sinmun

title: Congratulatory Messages to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Adopted in Russia
body: A meeting for adopting a message to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was held by the Sankt-Peterburg City Committee of the Lenin Young Communist League of the Russian Federation on April 27 to congratulate his successful visit to Russia. Present at the meeting were personages and members of the central committee and the city committee of the league. The congratulatory message to Kim Jong Un was adopted there. On April 30, the National Council of the Russian Association of Youth and Children held a meeting for delivering a congratulatory message to be sent to Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: President Kim Il Sung's Works Introduced in Brazil
body: The Brazilian Center for the Study of Songun Politics posted President Kim Il Sung's works "The Inaugural Declaration of the Association for the Restoration of the Fatherland" and "The Ten-Point Programme of the Association for the Restoration of the Fatherland" on its website on May 5. The first work, published on May 5, Juche 25(1936), deals with the reason why the Korean people had failed to attain the goal in their past struggle for national independence and liberation and indicates the tasks for all Koreans to wage a struggle on the basis of the Ten-Point Programme of the Association for the Restoration of the Fatherland. The second work, published on the same day, indicates the political, economic, cultural and military tasks to be fulfilled in the phase of the anti-imperialist, anti-feudal democratic revolution. The website carried an art work depicting the President. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Government's Effort Supported by Afro-Asian People's Solidarity Organization
body: The Afro-Asian People's Solidarity Organization released a statement on April 27 in support of an appeal of the Latin American and Caribbean Regional Committee to Support the Reunification of Korea. The statement said last year was a year when dramatic change was made in the situation of the Korean peninsula by the peace-loving efforts of the DPRK government and the Korean people. It noted that the north-south and DPRK-U.S. summit meetings and talks were provided thanks to HE Kim Jong Un's will for defending peace and his bold decision. It went on: We extend full support to the DPRK government in its efforts to achieve the reunification of the Korean peninsula and co-prosperity of the nation. We will more vigorously conduct a solidarity movement with the Korean people. We appeal to the world peace-loving people to actively turn out in the struggle for putting an end to the division of Korea and the imperialist forces' moves to stifle the DPRK. Rodong Sinmun

title: Editorial
body: Let All Sectors and Units Make Greater Strides on Basis of Scientific Development Strategy The present situation urges all sectors and units to advance and make a leap forward in reliance on scientific strategy for development. Mapping out scientific strategy for development is a primary work for every sector and unit to register steady successes in the revolution and construction. Every sector and unit can advance faster and leap higher only when they draw up the forward-looking and scientific strategy for development in keeping with their actual conditions and trend of global development and on the principle of making the maximum use of internal reserves, possibility and potentiality and stoutly carry out the strategy. State guidance and assistance are important for every unit to develop its work, but what is more important is that every unit should fulfill its duties. The Workers’ Party of Korea wants all the sectors and units to properly map out their own strategies for development and make a higher leap while looking out over the world. Let all the sectors and units draw up scientific strategy for development aiming at turning themselves into those of world standard and thus successfully open up a new road of advance for socialist construction.

title: Congratulations to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Indian President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a congratulatory message from Ram Nath Kovind, president of the Republic of India, on May 9. The Indian president in the message said that he was pleased to extend warm greetings and congratulations to Kim Jong Un upon his reelection as chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK. The message said that the India-DPRK ties have been traditionally maintained by friendship and sincerity. The message hoped that the traditional friendly ties would continue to grow strong. To this end the Indian president in the message hoped to closely cooperate with Kim Jong Un in the work for mutual benefits of the two peoples. Paying high tribute to Kim Jong Un, the message most sincerely wished him happiness and the friendly people of the DPRK prosperity. Rodong Sinmun

title: Joint Meeting of Working People's Organizations Held
body: A joint meeting of working people's organizations took place at the People's Palace of Culture on Monday to thoroughly implement the important tasks set forth by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in his policy speech at the First Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly and at the Fourth Plenary Meeting of the Seventh Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Present there were Choe Hwi, vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, and officials of the working people's organizations in the capital and local areas. At the meeting, a reporter and speakers said that Kim Jong Un's policy speech at the First Session of the 14th SPA and his report at the plenary meeting are guidelines to be held fast to in faithfully upholding the state-building ideology and exploits of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and the inspiring banner to step up the socialist construction at the highest speed with their own efforts and in their own way. After referring to the achievements made by working people's organizations in the past, they analyzed and reviewed faults and lessons in the work of working people's organizations tailored to ideological education. They stressed that the working people's organizations should give full play to their militant might in bringing about a great upsurge in socialist construction in hearty response to the tasks put forth by Kim Jong Un. The joint meeting adopted a joint resolution of the central committees of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League, the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea, the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea and the Socialist Women's Union of Korea. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Sci-Tech Exhibition in Field of Finishing Building Materials Opened
body: The National Exhibition of Sci-Tech Successes in the Field of Finishing Building Materials-2019 was opened with due ceremony at the Sci-Tech Complex on Monday. Displayed at the venue of the exhibition under the theme of diversified, varied and multicolored finishing building materials are 250-odd research achievements and products in the form of sample and chart by institutes and producers of furniture and finishing building materials under commissions, ministries, national institutions and every provincial people's committee. The exhibition also includes the introduction of sci-tech achievements, made in the research into and production of finishing building materials, and exchange of technologies. Present at the opening ceremony were Pak Thae Song, vice-chairman of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea, Jon Kwang Ho, vice-premier of the Cabinet, Jo Sok Ho, chairman of the Capital City Construction Commission, officials concerned and officials, scientists and technicians of ministries, national institutions, scientific and educational institutions and industrial establishments in Pyongyang. The exhibition will last till May 20. Rodong Sinmun

body: A delegation of the Central Court of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea headed by President Kang Yun Sok returned home on Monday after visiting the Lao People's Democratic Republic and the Socialist Republic of Vietnam. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Lauded by Foreign Bodies
body: Foreign organizations issued statements on April 27 and May 8 to congratulate Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un on his successful Russia visit. The Nepal-Korea Friendship Association in a statement said that the summit and talks between HE Kim Jong Un and President Putin are of great significance in further developing the long-standing DPRK-Russia friendly relations, and they came to be an occasion to further intensify the strategic cooperation for ensuring peace and security in the Korean Peninsula and the rest of the world. The Bangladesh-Korea Friendship and Solidarity Committee, the Bangladesh Institute of the Juche Idea, the Bangladesh Group for the Study of the Songun Policy and the Bangladeshi Media Persons' Group for the Study of the Juche Idea said in a joint statement that Kim Jong Un, through his Russia visit, made a great contribution to developing the relations between the two countries and ensuring peace and security in the Korean Peninsula and the rest of the world. The joint statement hoped that the Korean people would achieve greater success in the struggle for the socialist construction and national reunification, the long-cherished desire of the nation, under his wise leadership. The joint statement of the Swiss Organizing Committee for the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu, the Switzerland-Korea Committee and the Swiss Group for the Study of the Juche Idea also said that Kim Jong Un had talks with Putin in a friendly atmosphere, and congratulated his successful Russia visit. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Policy Speech Run by Indian Paper
body: The Indian paper Ocean News Point on May 9 carried the detailed gist of the policy speech "On Socialist Construction and the Internal and External Policies of the Government of the Republic at the Present Stage" delivered by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un at the First Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK. The paper was illustrated with his photo. Rodong Sinmun

title: Noted Hot Springs in Yangdok County
body: Yangdok County boasts celebrated hot springs. An enormous quantity of water with great medicinal and curative properties gushes from the Sokthang Hot Spring or crevices on stones. Therefore, in olden times our ancestors prefixed it with the Korean “tolthang” first and with “sokthang” then. “Tolthang” is similar in meaning to “sokthang”. An English equivalent for both is crevices on stones. According to records, it has been used for hundreds of years. The hot spring is good for skin soothing and softening, stimulation of myocardial constriction and blood circulation, promotion of antiphlogosis and tissue regeneration, desensitivization, stimulation of enterocinetic motion, etc. The Yangdok Hot Spring is a hot spa. It counts among our typical sulfuric spa whose water contains simple silica, sulfur and fluorine-low alkali. It, too, is efficacious for skin soothing and softening, stimulation of myocardial constriction and blood circulation, promotion of antiphlogosis and tissue regeneration, stimulation of enterocinetic motion, etc. The analysis of the water of the hot springs in Yangdok County shows that they are effective against chronic eczema, psoriasis, lichen, various kinds of arthritis, aftereffects of external wounds and operations, neuralgia, neuritis, chronic gastritis, gout, obesity, diabetes, etc. A hot-spring tourist area is well under construction in the county under the lofty plan of the mother Party which does its utmost to provide our people with more civilized life. Kim Ok Byol

title: Gift to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from President of Council of State of Cuba
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a gift from Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez, president of the Council of State and president of the Council of Ministers of the Republic of Cuba. The gift was conveyed to Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, by Jesus De Los Angeles Aise Sotolongo, Cuban ambassador to the DPRK. Rodong Sinmun

title: Sci-Tech Presentation and Exhibition in Field of Welding Held
body: A national sci-tech presentation and exhibition in the field of welding took place at the Nampho Taejin Welding Rod Factory on Monday and Tuesday under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea. Present there were scientists, technicians, teachers, researchers, graduate students and field officials from various units including the Welding Institute of the State Academy of Sciences, Kim Chaek University of Technology, Pyongyang University of Architecture, Pyongyang University of Mechanical Engineering and the Munchon Kumgang Smeltery. The participants presented more than 70 papers and exhibits conducive to the research and development of the new welding method and welding equipment and to putting the welding materials on a Juche basis There took place a lecture on new technologies and a show during the presentation and exhibition. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of DPRK Ministry of Foreign Affairs Back Home
body: A delegation of the DPRK Ministry of Foreign Affairs headed by Vice-Minister Pak Myong Guk returned home on Tuesday after visiting Syria, Iran, Azerbaijan and Mongolia which are member states of the Non-Aligned Movement. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Premier Inspects Wonsan-Kalma Coastal Tourist Area under Construction
body: Premier Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and member of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, inspected Wonsan-Kalma coastal tourist area under construction and the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex. Inspecting various places of the area under construction, he stressed the need for all the construction units to ensure structure quality at the best level from the stand of taking responsibility for the safety of the projects and guaranteeing their absolute quality for eternity. He also underlined the need for officials to meticulously organize the work with main emphasis put on meeting the requirements in design and construction and for the relevant units to preferentially supply equipment and materials. He also referred to the issue of boosting the survival rate of trees. At the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex he stressed the need for the officials to properly conduct operation and command to put the production on normal track and took steps for further rounding off the Korean-style Juche-based iron-and steel-making processes with recourse to advanced science and technology. Inspecting various production processes of the complex, he called for dynamically conducting the mass technological innovation movement and the drive for increased production and thus fully supplying iron and steel to various sectors of the national economy. At the field consultative meetings detailed issues were discussed to enhance the responsibility and role of the units for the construction of the tourist area and materials-supply units and to fully supply raw materials and fuel to keep the steel and iron production going at a high rate at the complex. Rodong Sinmun

title: Choe Ryong Hae Sends Reply Messages to Foreign Party and State Leaders
body: Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, sent reply messages to party and state leaders of different countries. They were the president of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam who is general secretary of the C.C., Communist Party of Vietnam, the president of Mongolia, the chairman of the Executive Committee of the Palestine Liberation Organization who is president of the State of Palestine and the president of Bulgaria. Choe Ryong Hae in his reply messages extended thanks to them for sending congratulations to him upon his election as president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly. He expressed the expectation and conviction that the relations between the DPRK and those countries would grow stronger in common interests in the future, too. He also sent a reply message to the chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress of the People's Republic of China. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of DPRK Red Cross Society Leaves for China
body: A delegation of the DPRK Red Cross Society led by Paek Yong Ho, executive vice-chairman of its Central Committee, left here on Tuesday to visit China. Rodong Sinmun

title: Bulgarian Figure Supports Korean People's Struggle
body: Atanas Ivanov, honorary chairman of the Bulgarian Communists Union, made public a statement on April 27 in support of the appeal issued by the Latin American and Caribbean Regional Committee to Support the Reunification of Korea. The statement said that the Latin American and Caribbean Regional Committee to Support the Reunification of Korea set the period of international action for peace, prosperity and reunification of the Korean peninsula from April 27 to June 12 ahead of the first anniversaries of the historic Panmunjom Declaration and the June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement and appealed to the world peace-loving people to proactively wage solidarity activities in support of the just cause of the Korean people. Expressing full support to the appeal, it extended, together with the Bulgarian progressives, firm solidarity to the Korean people's struggle for establishing a permanent peace mechanism on the Korean peninsula. It said that the Korean people would surely achieve the cause of national reunification under the guidance of HE Kim Jong Un, holding aloft the banner of national independence. Rodong Sinmun

title: Indian Bodies Support Korean People's Struggle
body: Indian organizations made public statements on May 2 in support of the appeal issued by the Latin American and Caribbean Regional Committee to Support the Reunification of Korea to mark the first anniversaries of the Panmunjom Declaration and the June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement. The All-India Peace and Solidarity Organization expressed full support to the appeal to the world peace-loving people for proactively conducting solidarity activities with the Korean people, extending solidarity to the Korean people's struggle for achieving peace, prosperity and reunification of the Korean peninsula. The All India Indo-Korean Friendship Association called upon all Indian progressive organizations to send support and solidarity to the Korean people in their efforts for establishing a permanent peace mechanism on the Korean peninsula by making good use of a peaceful climate on the peninsula and for achieving national reunification in the spirit of national independence. Rodong Sinmun

title: The Pass-On-Technology Conference Held
body: Some time ago the national pass-on-technology conference of agricultural workers was held at the Suwon Farm in Paechon County as regards the scientific and technologic problems of transplanting rice seedlings and fertilizing and tending field crops qualitatively in the right time to meet the demand of the Juche farming method. The conference was attended by far more than 100 officials, including those of the Cabinet and the Ministry of Agriculture and the chairmen of the Rural Economy Committees of all provinces. First of all, light was shed at the conference with the help of comprehensive visual aids on bedding out rice seedlings and manuring and cultivating field crops qualitatively in the right time as required by the Juche farming method. In the next place it was said at the conference that rice seedlings must be fertilized and tended scientifically and technologically after their transplantation. It was stressed at the conference that beans must be sown qualitatively in due season and earlier crops like potato, wheat and barley fertilized and grown well in the fields. The rice seedling planters of the Suwon Farm made for its paddy fields with ceremony. Other rice seedling planters and ridge plows of various shapes as well as many farm machines and implements caught the eye, exhibited in the conference ground. In the fields the participants in the conference were finally informed firsthand how to transplant big seedlings, humus-pot-grown seedlings, cold-bed humus-grown seedlings and many other humus-pot-grown seedlings, sow and raise rice direct in the fields and manure and tend maize and bean. Pak Yong Jin

title: Our Will to Settle Accounts with Japan Will Be Doubled
body: Japan noted again in its 2019 diplomatic blue book that Tok Island is part of its “territory”. It is a vivid manifestation of the Japanese reactionaries’ inveterate wild ambition for reinvasion and territorial expansion. The Japanese reactionaries are insisting on its ‘dominium” over Tok Island, which is meant to invent a pretext for reinvading Korea. The more undisguised moves of the Japanese reactionaries for reinvasion will only harden the will of the Korean people to surely force Japan to pay for its crimes. Such moves of the Japanese reactionaries, seized with the futile old dream of “Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere,” will only lead them to self-destruction. It is will of the Korean people never to tolerate the risky moves of Japan. The Japanese reactionaries should not act rashly, aware of what consequences they would face when the Korean people give vent to their pent-up indignation. Jo Thaek Bom

title: Editorial
body: Let Us Bring About Great Upsurge in Building A Powerful Socialist Nation through Powerful Movement to Create Mallima Speed The Workers’ Party of Korea designated the struggle for creating the Mallima speed as the Mallima speed movement in reflection of the mature requirement of the developing revolution and called on all the people to turn out as one in the movement. The Mallima speed movement is a new mass movement of the present era to make an earlier accomplishment of the cause of building a socialist power by remarkably speeding up the advance of the Korean revolution in the spirit of Mallima (horse that runs 4 000 miles a day). The movement is aimed at making every sector and unit hold fast to self-reliance and science and technology, bring about tangible progress and effect steady innovations in economic construction with the indomitable and offensive revolutionary spirit and thus attain ahead of schedule the high goals for building a powerful socialist country. The Mallima speed movement is characterized by the fact that it is a movement for grand march to hit at the fastest tempo and in the shortest span of time the high goals for the building of an economic power and improvement of the people’s living standard set forth by the Party, overtake the world by taking firm hold of self-reliance and science and technology as a treasured sword and giving the fullest play to the potentiality of socialism and thus win a greater victory through successive offense. Let us dynamically advance in the spirit of Mallima to bring earlier the accomplishment of the cause of building the socialist power, rallied close around the Party.

title: Russian Figure Leaves
body: Anton Khlopkov, director of the Center for Energy and Security Studies of Russia, left here for home on Wednesday.
