During his visit he met with officials concerned of the Foreign Ministry and exchanged views on the issues of mutual concern including the relations between the DPRK and Russia and the situation on the Korean peninsula. Rodong Sinmun

title: AFC Grassroots Football Day Marked
body: An event was held at Pyongyang International Football School to mark AFC Grassroots Football Day on May 15. Present there were Jo Chol, vice-chairman of the Education Commission, officials of the DPRK Football Association and in the field of education and sports teachers and pupils of junior middle schools and primary schools here. Kim Sang Hyop, vice-secretary general of the DPRK Football Association, said in a speech that youth and students of the DPRK are conducting brisk grassroots sports activities at splendid stadiums, sports parks and playgrounds. He stressed that all the attendees should make a positive contribution to promoting the development of the country's football techniques and making the whole society enthusiastic over sports and football. Pupils of Pyongyang International Football School and other schools did the football rhythmic exercise to be followed by a seminar of sports teachers. Speakers explained the trend in the training of football reserves, important issues arising in basic technical education, and achievements and experience they gained in running football groups at the schools. At the end of the seminar there were small-scale football matches of the pupils of primary and junior middle schools. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Industrial Art Exhibition Closes
body: The national industrial art exhibition for celebrating the Day of the Sun, the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, closed with due ceremony at the National Industrial Art Exhibition House on May 15. During the exhibition, the attendees had an exchange of successes and experience they gained in waging a brisk campaign of study and creation for making an organic combination of beauty and practicality in industrial art. Present at the closing ceremony were Ri Ju O, vice-premier of the Cabinet, Kim Sung Du, chairman of the Education Commission, Choe Il Ryong, minister of Light Industry, Jo Yong Chol, minister of Local Industry, officials concerned, creators, teachers, researchers and students. Rodong Sinmun

title: Ethiopian Bodies Support Just Cause of Korean People
body: The Ethiopian National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, the Ethiopian Committee for the Study of the Independent Politics and the Ethiopia-Korea Friendship and Solidarity Committee made public a joint statement on May 3 in support of the appeal issued by the Latin American and Caribbean Regional Committee to Support the Reunification of Korea. The statement said Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un saw to it that the historic Panmunjom Declaration and the June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement were adopted and made public with his courageous will and bold decision, thus making a great contribution to ensuring peace and security of the Korean peninsula and the world. Nevertheless, some forces not desirous of peace lay hurdles in the way of Korea's reunification, it noted, adding: To achieve peace, prosperity and reunification of the Korean peninsula is an urgent task which brooks no further delay for the times and a wish of world progressives. The present situation requires all peace-loving people of the world to resolutely turn out in a joint action for peace of the peninsula in unity. We will regard it as a contribution to defending global peace to support the just cause of the Korean people and further the solidarity activities together with world progressive organizations. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Policy Speech Supported by Indian Figure
body: The general secretary of the All India Agricultural Workers' Union made public a statement on May 8 in support of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's policy speech. Expressing full support at the policy speech, the statement said that Kim Jong Un in his policy speech indicated the highest programme of the Workers' Party of Korea and the government of the DPRK and the general direction and general goal of the construction of a socialist state. The grand tasks set forth by him would be successfully carried out, so that the DPRK would turn into a genuine people's country where their ideal is translated into a reality, and into a dignified and invincible power of independence, the statement pointed out. It stressed that if the south Korean authorities sincerely want to see improved inter-Korean relations and reunification, they have to honestly carry out the Panmunjom Declaration. It urged the U.S. to give up the current old way of political calculation and show sincerity for improving the DPRK-U.S. relations. It wished the Korean people new successes in their efforts for building a powerful socialist country and achieving the independent and peaceful reunification of the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Dam of the Lake Pongchon Completed
body: Great advances are made in building the waterways across South Hwanghae Province in their second stage. The officials and shock brigade members completed the dam of the Lake Pongchon by disposing of 1,798,000-odd cubic meters of soil and coating it with stones in the section of more than 105,000 square meters. This afforded a solid guarantee for finishing the waterways across the province in their second stage at an early date. The central waterway construction headquarters set itself a high step-by-step work target. It concentrated all its shock bridgade members and machines on constructing the dam and effectively arranged for it to be built with all speed. The officials and members of the Pyongyang Brigade, a battalion of a waterway mechanization station and the Nampho City Brigade worked with the sweat of their brow as one to build the dam. The way they successfully finished the dam of the lake, the officials and shock brigade members strive strenuously without letup to complete the waterways in their second stage as soon as possible. Pak Chol

title: Our Quality Medicines Developed
body: A pharmic institute of the Academy of Medical Science gears up its scientific researches into efficacious medicines to mass-produce them from our domestic raw materials and promote the health of the people. In the process of this it developed a medicine badly needed for clinical purposes. The institute worked hard to develop for itself a tetrahydropalmatine injection known as a powerful anodyne and sedative. It succeeded in synthesizing palmatine which performs a strong physiological function in the body. It hydrogenated it and ultimately devised the tetrahydropalmatine injection. It was proved positively by clinical application that the injection notably excelled its counterparts in effect. It was accordingly patented last year and highly appreciated at the 16th National Exhibition of Inventions and the National Exhibition of Scientific and Technological Achievements in Public Health. The institute invented a liquid insam essence, too, to customers’ liking. Insam raises the immunity of the human body and is very preventive and effective against diabetes and other endocrinal and metabolic diseases. The liquid essence maximizes the pharmacological activity of insam and improves the decline of immune function in the body resulting from cancerous diseases, post-surgery and post-illness debility, hemorrhage and many others. Kim Song Min

title: What Does Japan Pursue Backed Up By Its Master U.S.
body: Recently, Japan’s Ministry of Defence announced that the large assault landing ship America of the U.S. navy would be deployed at the Sasebo base of Nagasaki Prefecture. Meanwhile, the large amphibious craft New Orleans of about 25 000 ton displacement would also be deployed at the Sasebo base. What matters is that the large amphibious craft is carrying F-35 B and MV-22 Osprey. The real intention of the Japanese reactionaries vociferating about introducing such equipment and strengthening their operational ability is to realize their sordid ambition for becoming a major military power and launching overseas expansion with the backing of their master. The intolerable serious problem is that Japan which is banned from the right to belligerency and possession of combat power by the “Pacifist Constitution” is trying to get access to aircraft carrier. Now, in order to eliminate the legal obstacle which prohibits Japan from possessing an aircraft carrier and to justify its ambition for becoming a major military power, the Abe forces are distorting the public opinion by talking nonsense that the standard justifying the possession of an aircraft carrier depends on whether it is for attack or not. Japan is equipping itself with large-size marine military hardware with longer distance, while increasing its actual war capacity by pulling up other countries. The Japanese reactionaries are rushing headlong into a military power in defiance of criticism from the international community. Japan’s painstaking efforts for overseas expansion with the backing of its master will lead to the repetition of its ruin. Ri Hyo Jin

title: Home-visiting Group of Koreans in Japan Visits Statues of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: A home-visiting group of Koreans in Japan on Thursday visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill. The visitors laid bouquets and made a bow before the statues. Rodong Sinmun

title: S. Koreans Launch Actions Demanding Dissolution of LKP
body: People of various circles reportedly launched actions in demand of dissolution of the "Liberal Korea Party" (LKP) across south Korea on May 11. More than 3 000 citizens including members of the April 16 Solidarity, bereaved families of the ferry Sewol disaster and students gathered at the Kwanghwamun Plaza in Seoul to stage a rally. They demanded dissolution of LKP and punishment of its representative Hwang Kyo An and floor leader Ra Kyong Won. Speakers there criticized LKP for disturbing the efforts for probing truth behind the ferry disaster and punishing those responsible for it. Recalling that more than 1.8 million people petitioned for dissolving LKP, they said it represents the public mindset. Then, a professor of Wonkwang University informed the participants of the result of the judgment made earlier by the "civic constitutional court for dissolving LKP." A rally demanding the dissolution of LKP was also reportedly held in Pusan. Speakers said that LKP should be dissolved as it is denying history, distorting history and going against the times. Rodong Sinmun

title: Probe into Truth behind Kwangju Massacre Demanded in South Korea
body: The Peace and Justice Committee of the Kwangju Catholic Archdiocese in south Korea held a memorial mass in Kwangju on May 13 demanding a probe into the truth behind the May 18 Kwangju massacre and punishment of arch murderers, according to Newsis of south Korea. Chun Doo Hwan, who is to blame for the massacre, is distorting the spirit of the Kwangju uprising and denying historical facts, speakers there charged. They also accused the "Liberal Korea Party" of terming the uprisers "group of monsters." Calling for properly probing into the truth behind the Kwangju massacre, they urged LKP to punish those who used abusive language against the uprising and its participants. Then, the participants staged a candlelight procession in demand of the institution of a "law on punishment of those distorting the history of the May 18 popular uprising." Rodong Sinmun

title: Chinese Figure Vows to Develop China-DPRK Friendship
body: Principal Jiang Guofu, head of the friendship delegation of Yuwen Middle School in Jilin of China, said that he was pleased to visit the DPRK in the meaningful year marking the 70th anniversary of the opening of China-DPRK diplomatic relations. He went on: During the visit to Pyongyang, we enjoyed a warm welcome from the Korean people wherever we made visits, keenly feeling the friendship between China and the DPRK. Yuwen Middle School in Jilin of China is the meaningful place associated with President Kim Il Sung's revolutionary activities in his early years so that it is very familiar to the peoples of both countries. The school associated with the President's great revolutionary activities was honored to be visited by Chairman Kim Jong Il. All the teaching staff and students of the school are eager to meet the respected Chairman Kim Jong Un at their school. The head of the delegation pointed out that Yuwen Middle School in Jilin and Changdok School have developed mutual friendly relations so far, adding: Now the friendly relations between the two schools bloom thanks to the top leaders of both countries. The top leaders provided four rounds of summits and talks from last year, thus putting the friendly relations between both countries onto a new high level. We will further intensify the exchange with Changdok School as required by the new era in the future, thus making a positive contribution to developing the long-standing traditional China-DPRK friendly relations. The two schools will be forever kept in the hearts of the two people as a symbol of China-DPRK friendship. Rodong Sinmun

title: African Regional Body Supports Korean People's Righteous Struggle
body: The African Regional Committee for Friendship and Solidarity with the Korean People headquartered in Nigeria expressed support for the appeal issued by the Latin American and Caribbean Regional Committee to Support the Reunification of Korea. The African Regional Committee, in an appeal issued on May 5, highly praised Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un for making a great contribution to ensuring peace and security of the Korean peninsula and the world with his noble love for the nation, will for national reunification and bold decision to defend peace. It went on: The Korean people are struggling for peace, prosperity and reunification of the peninsula. We will fully support their righteous struggle and conduct brisk solidarity activities with them. We pay high tribute to the respected HE Kim Jong Un, who is conducting energetic external activities for the sake of peace and security of the Korean peninsula and the world. Rodong Sinmun

title: Briefing on Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Policy Speech Given in Mongolia
body: A briefing on Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's policy speech at the First Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK was given in Mongolia on May 2. Present at the briefing were personages of the Mongolian Mt. Paektu Association for Independent Development, the Mongolian Association for the Study of the Juche Idea-Songun Idea, the Mongolian Centre for the Study of Juche, the Mongolia-Democratic Korea Friendship Bridge Association and other organizations for the study of the Juche idea and organizations for friendship and solidarity with the Korean people, the DPRK ambassador to Mongolia and members of his embassy. After the DPRK ambassador referred to the gist of the policy speech, the chairman of the Mongolian Mt. Paektu Association for Independent Development said that Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, in his policy speech gave concrete answers to the issues as to state building and activities in the DPRK, and inter-Korean relations and DPRK-U.S. relations. The chairman of the association pointed out that the ideology and lines set forth by Kim Jong Un are of great significance as they indicate the path ahead of the DPRK, wishing the Korean people bigger successes in their efforts for socialist construction and national reunification under his guidance. Rodong Sinmun

title: Hundreds of Early Fulfillers of Their Production Plan for the Five-year Strategy
body: The textile industry produced hitters of their production targets for the five-year strategy for national economic development. Those engaged in the industry have worked with might and main and fulfilled their national economic plan threefold or fivefold since they set out to implement the strategy. Consequently, 273 workers achieved their production goals for the strategy till the first quarter of 2019. The Kim Jong Suk Pyongyang Textile Mill, a leading cloth producer of the country, was the first to increase its output competitively. 101 of its workers executed their national economic plan for five years, a decade or fifteen years within three years. 49 workers carried out their production plan for the strategy at the Sinuiju Textile Mill, too. The Kusong Textile Mill produced 46 fulfillers of their production plan for the strategy, and the Sariwon Textile Mill 29. 26 workers hit their production targets for the strategy at the Hamhung Woolen Textile Mill, and 22 at the September Textile Mill. Ri Chol Ok

title: A New Workshop Set Up and Test-run
body: The Samjiyon Potato Farina Production Factory set up a new workshop for processed potato foods and test-ran it successfully. The factory has so far produced only potato farina but has now been fitted up with modern machines for producing riced nutriments, noodles, vermicelli, twists and others with our homegrown potatoes. This has fully enabled delicious and highly nutritious potato foods to be mass-produced to serve our people as Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un wishes. Firmly resolved to process plenty of quality potato foods for all the people, the workers and technicians of the factory are now exerting great efforts to master their equipment and improve their technical knowledge and skills. Jon Chol Ju

title: Foreign Delegations Arrive
body: Delegations of China, Russia, Pakistan, and Poland came here on Friday to take part in the 22nd Pyongyang Spring International Trade Fair. Rodong Sinmun

title: President Kim Il Sung's Birth Anniversary Marked Worldwide
body: The 107th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (the Day of the Sun) was celebrated by all peoples of the world. Preparatory committees for celebrating the birth anniversary were formed in different parts of the five continents in the wake of the formation of a national preparatory committee in Mexico in January. The preparatory committees with prominent political and public figures involved held colorful political and cultural events in praise of the noble career and feats of the President, the tender-hearted father of all people, indomitable revolutionary and great politician. Amid the daily-growing atmosphere of celebrating the Day of the Sun, Russian figures including the founder of the Gelion Construction Company sent gifts to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. The Workers' Party for the Independence of Senegal, Swiss organizations, the chief of the Lebanese Group for the Study of the Juche Idea, the chairman of the Arab Committee for Solidarity with Korean People and Supporting the Reunification of Korea and the head of Department of the Political Faculty of University of Damascus, Syria in their statements praised the President as the great teacher and great sage who illuminated the road ahead of the era of independence with the torch of Juche and defended justice with his iron will and wise leadership. On the occasion of the Day of the Sun, foreign political parties, organizations, delegations and figures from all walks of life made congratulatory visits to the DPRK missions in their countries, and the Cambodian king and great queen and the president of the International Group of Italy sent large floral baskets. A floral basket was laid at the portrait of the smiling President with due ceremony at the building of the Organization of Solidarity of the Peoples of Africa, Asia and Latin America, and there took place all over the world hundreds of colorful events such as joint celebration meeting of Nordic progressive political parties and friendship organizations, American regional internet seminar, the Russian national seminar on the Juche idea "Patriotism and Self-Reliance", Korean book, photo and handicraft exhibition, book-donating ceremony and internet photo exhibition. Foreign media reported the sacred history of the great sun before and after April 15. Rodong Sinmun

title: Congolese, Nigerian Bodies Support Korean People's Struggle
body: Congolese and Nigerian organizations made public statements on May 7 and 10 in support of the appeal issued by the Latin American and Caribbean Regional Committee to Support the Reunification of Korea. The Congolese Association for Friendship among Peoples in a statement expressed full support for the historic Panmunjom Declaration which reflects the steadfast stand of national independence to solve all the issues as to inter-Korean relations in conformity with the demands and interests of the Korean nation and the firm will to achieve the historic cause of national reunification by the concerted efforts. It said that the Panmunjom Declaration is the programme for reunification that indicates the most correct way to peace, prosperity and independent reunification desired by the Korean nation. It pointed out that the adoption of the June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement was a historic event which instilled hope into all peace-loving people, extending firm solidarity to the Korean people in their efforts for peace and stability of the Korean peninsula. The Nigeria-Korea Friendship Association said in a statement that it will join the international actions demanding that the current peaceful atmosphere on the Korean peninsula lead to the establishment of a permanent peace mechanism, stressing that it would actively conduct solidarity activities in support of the Korean people's struggle for the country's reunification under the uplifted banner of national independence. Rodong Sinmun

title: Korean Book and Photo Show Held in Russia and Lecture Given in Guinea
body: A Korean book and photo show was held in Sankt-Peterburg of Russia on May 6-8 to mark the third anniversary of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's election as chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea. Speeches were made at its opening-ceremony attended by personages of Russian political and public circles and masses. The chairperson of the All-Russian Society for the Study and Dissemination of Kimilsungism said he was pleased to see the opening of the book and photo show in celebration of the significant day when Kim Jong Un was elected as chairman of the WPK. The chairperson pointed out that Kim Jong Un sees to it that all the people perform a series of miracles in socialist construction under the uplifted banner of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, noting that the Russian people always remember the exploits performed by President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il for boosting Russia-DPRK friendship and sincerely welcomed and warmly congratulated Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's historic visit to Russia. The chairperson hoped that the Korean people would emerge ever-victorious in the struggle against the imperialists and achieve bigger successes in the building of a powerful socialist country under the wise leadership of Kim Jong Un. Meanwhile, a lecture titled "The features of Kim Jong Un's politics" was given in Conakry, Guinea. Rodong Sinmun

title: Exhibition of Successes in the Development of New Products
body: The Exhibition of Successes in the Development of New Products was held at the Pyongyang Automation Appliances Factory to accelerate the economic development of the nation and the betterment of the people’s living standard. It was attended by 23 units under the Ministry of Electronics Industry. More than 170 automatic machines, electronic elements and consumer goods of 115 kinds were submitted to the exhibition. They were all invented and made by our efforts and with our technology. New headlights for motor vehicles, an electric motor for a washer and other small electric motors of various kinds were highly spoken of. Electronic automation devices and sensors of scores of kinds highly necessary for power industry, agriculture and many other domains of the national economy were also displayed at the exhibition to excite the admiration of visitors. They included power factor compensators, controllers of exciters for small and medium power stations and PLCs of our style. Visitors were greatly interested in new-type fan blades for wind-driven generators, inverted converters and other novel products of great practical value in actively developing and applying diverse energy resources. The exhibition marked an important occasion for increasing the production of electronic automation apparatus and elements and other consumer goods badly needed to put the national economy on a modern and IT basis and improve the living level of the people. Choe Yong Jo

title: More and More Maize Fields Weeded
body: Those farms which finished weeding their maize fields once grow in number throughout the country. Over 70% of the farms nationwide devotedly weeded their maize fields once as of May 16. South Hwanghae Province, a player of a great role in national output of cereals, had already weeded its maize fields once assiduously. It keeps on weeding them twice without delay. The farms of North Hwanghae Province, too, do well in their weeding. The agricultural workers of the province, including Hwangju, Rinsan, Sohung and Yonsan Counties, have worked from the sweat of their brow, with the result that the province has almost finished weeding its maize fields once. The agricultural workers of South Phyongan Province, Nampho City and other parts of the country assert that weeding a field once is tantamount to fertilizing it once. They qualitatively weed as many of their maize fields as possible once. Ri Yong Hak

title: Hundreds of Hectares of Land Realigned
body: Hundreds of hectares of land has been realigned vigorously into large standard mechanized fields within about two months in Sindo County situated in the northwestern part of Korea. In addition, dozens of hectares of new land has been acquired, too. Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un inspected the county last June. He said that it was instituted anew and developed under the far-reaching plan of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and gave instructions to furbish it better than ever into a model of the whole country to glorify their guidance to it through all ages. Officials and shock brigade members in the county continually exert every effort to newly realign and acquire a wider area of land in spring. Jong Yong Chol

title: Taesongsan Spring Water Factory Inaugurated
body: A spring water factory for Pyongyangites has been newly built in the area of Mt Taesong. The newly-built spring water factory would mass-produce bottled tasty spring water and supply it to the people for the improvement of their health. Its inaugural ceremony was held on Saturday. Present there were Kim Nung O, chairman of the Pyongyang City Party Committee, officials concerned, officials and employees of the factory and builders. Rodong Sinmun

title: Foreigners Visit Mangyongdae
body: Foreigners to take part in the 22nd Pyongyang Spring International Trade Fair visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung, on Saturday. They laid bouquets before the old home of the President in Mangyongdae in boundless reverence for him. Being briefed on the glorious revolutionary history of the President associated with his low-roofed thatched home and the patriotic careers of his family members, they looked round historical relics. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of DPRK Red Cross Society Back Home
body: A delegation of the DPRK Red Cross Society led by Paek Yong Ho, executive vice-chairman of its Central Committee, came back home on Saturday after visiting China. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Tributes Paid to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Foreign guests to participate in the 22nd Pyongyang Spring International Trade Fair visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on Saturday. They laid a floral basket and bouquets before the statues before paying tributes. Rodong Sinmun

title: C.C., AINDF Calls for Unity to Eliminate Evil-doing Conservative Forces
body: The Central Committee of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front (AINDF) made public an appeal on May 17, on the occasion of the 39th anniversary of the Kwangju Popular Uprising, according to the website Kuguk Jonson. The appeal said that the May 18 Kwangju resistance was an eruption of the resistance and will of the south Korean people never to pardon the barbarous suppression by the pro-U.S. military dictatorship of traitor Chun Doo Hwan and an explosion of their aspiration and ardent desire to root up all sorts of injustice and deep-seated evils and live in a new world governed by justice and truth. The appeal went on: The indomitable spirit of the resistance fighters and their call for justice 39 years ago are still encouraging the south Korean people as an initial explosive of struggle, and their noble intention and desire, still remaining as a pending task, are calling on the people to wage a new struggle. Two years ago, our people waged a great candle-light resistance. This impeached Park Geun Hye, a descendant of the military fascist dictatorship, and meted out stern punishment to the conservative ruling forces, shaking the whole world. It was a great deed done in the unyielding struggle for realizing the intention of the Kwangju Popular Uprising. However, the "Liberal Korea Party" (LKP), which was ostracized in the trend of history, is making desperate efforts to bring back the past dark era, making a mockery of the souls of participants in the Kwangju uprising. The reckless act of the evil-doing conservative forces is nothing but a revelation of their black-hearted intention to turn this land into a tundra of democracy, civil rights and public welfare and a theatre of confrontation between fellow countrymen through a bloody revenge by realizing the wild ambition for retaking power at any cost. History and reality eloquently prove that unless the descendents of the military fascist slaughterers and the evil-doing conservative forces are eliminated, the noble desire of participants in the Kwangju uprising will never come true and the south Korean people will be deprived of their gains in the candle-light resistance, which would be led to the second Kwangju massacre. The prevailing situation is urgently calling on all the people to turn out in the all-out struggle to eliminate the evil-doing conservative forces. Let us all turn out in the struggle for eliminating LKP, the enemy of democratization stamping out democracy and civil rights, in the spirit of the May resistance and the candle-light resistance! Let the people from all walks of life mete out severe punishment to LKP, the party of traitors, seeing through the deceptive nature of the LKP's crafty farce for "a long march for people's livelihood". The appeal called upon each party and each faction and people from all walks of life to intensify the solidarity and unity in the struggle for eliminating LKP and make a joint effort to do so, transcending differences in political view, religious belief and ism. The appeal called for never pardoning but decisively smashing the anti-national moves of LKP clamoring for sanctions and pressure on the fellow countrymen and resumption of military drills with foreign forces. It called on all the people to get united in order to eliminate the evil-doing conservative forces and realize the desire of the resistance fighters for independence, democracy and reunification without fail. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Off Press in Switzerland
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us March Forward Dynamically towards Final Victory, Holding Higher the Banner of Songun" was published in booklet by a publishing house in Basel City of Switzerland. The work, published on April 15, Juche 101 (2012), says that the century-long history of Kim Il Sung's nation clearly proved the immutable truth that an outstanding leader guarantees the dignity and prosperity of the country and the nation. It also indicates the tasks for glorifying the dignity of Songun Korea for all ages and successfully accomplishing the cause of building a thriving socialist country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Joint Statement Issued in Latin America
body: Organizations of Latin American countries made public a joint statement to mark the first anniversary of the June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement. The organizations are the Ecuadorian Committee for Remembering President Kim Il Sung, the Ecuadorian Committee for Remembering Generalissimo Kim Jong Il, the Ecuadorian Cultural Institute for the Study of the Juche Idea, the Canar Provincial Institute for the Friendship and Solidarity with DPRK of Ecuador, the Ecuadorian Committee for Supporting Korea's Independent and Peaceful Reunification, the Guaranda Association for Friendship, Culture and Solidarity with the Korean People of Ecuador, the General Kim Jong Il Peruvian Amicable Institute, the Kim Jong Suk Library of Peru, the Peruvian－Korean Institute of Culture and Friendship and the Colombia－Korea Friendship Association. The joint statement referred to the historic significance of the Singapore DPRK-U.S. summit and talks and opposed all sorts of sanctions on the DPRK. Expressing the belief that the joint statement adopted at the Singapore DPRK-U.S. Summit Talks would be thoroughly implemented, it appealed to all the peace-loving people of the world to actively support the Korean people in their struggle for the reunification of the Korean Peninsula and the building of a powerful socialist country. Rodong Sinmun

title: 60th Anniversary of Foreign Trade Bank Marked
body: The Foreign Trade Bank of the DPRK marked its 60th founding anniversary President Kim Il Sung, who had established a people-oriented independent external financial system after the liberation of the country, saw through the actual demand in the development of the external economy of the country in the post-war period and made sure that the foreign trade bank in charge of state's external settlements and financial work was founded on May 20, Juche 48 (1959). He also led the bank to fulfill its mission and duty. With his extraordinary wisdom and leadership, Chairman Kim Jong Il developed and enriched the President's unique idea and theory on finance, clearly indicated the path to be followed by the external financial work in every period and at each stage of the revolution and construction. For the past 60 years since its foundation, the bank has developed into a state bank and an external financial organ of the DPRK, fully demonstrating the validity and vitality of the Party's external financial policy. A meeting for marking the anniversary was held on Sunday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Sports Contest of Disabled Persons and Amateurs Closes
body: The sports contest of disabled persons and amateurs which opened on May 3 closed with due ceremony at the gymnasium of Kim Il Sung University on Sunday. The contest vividly showed disabled persons attaining their desires and nurturing talent under the care of the socialist system. Amateurs also demonstrated their diverse techniques and tactics, giving full play to their individual skills in each game. Rodong Sinmun

title: Session of Management Board of Association of Koreans in Japan
body: for Peaceful Reunification Held The 2nd Session of the 10th Management Board of the Association of Koreans in Japan for Peaceful Reunification took place in Tokyo on May 15. Present there were Nam Sung U, vice-chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), So Chung On, director of its Department for International Affairs and Reunification, Chairman Ri Tong Je and vice-chairmen of the Association of Koreans in Japan for Peaceful Reunification, members of management board of each local council, advisors, and officials of the central leadership bodies and affiliates. A report was made by Ri Tong Je to be followed by speeches. The reporter and speakers recalled the political information activities conducted by the Association of Koreans in Japan for Peaceful Reunification to explain and give publicity to the high intention and outstanding guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and help the Koreans in Japan turn out in implementing the north-south declarations. They noted that the association would as ever effectively conduct the political information activities to open up a heyday for peace, prosperity and reunification of the Korean peninsula, foiling the challenges by the internal and external anti-reunification forces, and contribute to revving up the atmosphere of solidarity and unity by boosting cooperation and exchange among Koreans in the north, the south and abroad. Nam Sung U stressed that members of the management board of the association should positively conduct the movement for national reunification full of conviction and optimism, remaining vigilant against the south Korean anti-reunification conservative forces' moves to check the improvement of the north-south relations. Rodong Sinmun

title: Parliamentary Delegation of Czech Republic Here
body: A parliamentary delegation of the Czech Republic led by Lubomir Zaoralek, chairman of the Foreign Affairs Committee of the Chamber of Deputies, arrived here Monday. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Party and Government Delegation Leaves for Cuba
body: A party and government delegation of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea led by Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, left here on Monday to visit the Republic of Cuba. Rodong Sinmun

title: International Organizations Support Panmunjom Declaration
body: The International League of People's Struggle issued a statement on April 26 to mark the first anniversary of the historic Panmunjom Declaration. The statement said that the Panmunjom Declaration which reflected the unanimous desire of the whole Korean nation solemnly clarified that there opened a new peace era without war on the Korean peninsula. It supported efforts of the Korean people to put an end to division and confrontation and open an era of national reconciliation and prosperity. It went on: The adoption of the declaration serves as a remarkable event showing the world the fact that the Korean nation is one and peace and prosperity can be achieved by the Korean nation itself. An end should be put to the protracted division, outside interference and the imperialists' moves for a war. We will join the world people in their struggle for establishing durable peace mechanism on the Korean peninsula. We always extend firm solidarity to the struggle of the Korean people for the reunification of the country on the principle of national independence. The Confederation of Lawyers of Asia and Pacific released an appeal supporting the just cause of the Korean people on May 3 to mark the first anniversaries of the Panmunjom Declaration and the June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement. Rodong Sinmun

title: Indian Body Supports Korean People's Struggle
body: The All India Students Federation made public a statement on May 8 in support of the appeal issued by the Latin American and Caribbean Regional Committee to Support the Reunification of Korea. The statement said that the Latin American and Caribbean Regional Committee to Support the Reunification of Korea, in the appeal, fixed the period from April 27 to June 12 as the "international action period for peace, prosperity and reunification on the Korean Peninsula" and suggested proactively conducting solidarity activities in support of the just cause of the Korean people. It went on: We express full support for it. We will conduct vigorous activities calling for leading the current peaceful atmosphere on the Korean peninsula to the establishment of a permanent peace mechanism. And we extend firm solidarity to the just cause of the Korean people, youth and students for the reunification of the country and prosperity of the nation under the banner of independence. Rodong Sinmun

title: Independent Line of WPK Is Great Banner of Victory and Prosperity
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un re-formulated it as the steadfast political line of our Party and state to build a powerful socialist country by sticking to the revolutionary line of independence and the strategy of self-reliance at the Fourth Plenary Meeting of the 7th Central Committee of the Worker’s Party of Korea and the First Session of the 14th Supreme People’s Assembly. This is a noteworthy event in which Kim Jong Un declared at home and abroad the iron will of the WPK and the people to achieve the great cause of the building of a powerful country by giving fuller play to the spirit of national independence and national self-respect which has been fully displayed since the early period of the Korean revolution. Independence is the only way to realize our great aspiration to build the most powerful country, the people’s ideal society. Independence gave birth to modern Korea and it is the bloodline and lifeline that has dynamically advanced it along the road of prosperity. President Kim Il Sung’s and Chairman Kim Jong Il’s history of leading the building of a prosperous country is, in essence, the one of national independence and national self-respect. The validity and vitality of the independent line have been more clearly proved in the grand march of the new century of Juche. Our Party has vigorously pushed ahead with socialist construction from the firm standpoint that revolution is the struggle for realizing the independence of the popular masses, and carrying forward the revolutionary cause of Juche is, in essence, the inheritance of independent faith, independent politics. The days when Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un has led our revolution are the brilliant period in which a model of independent politics for the times has been created. The WPK’s absolute authority, socialist Korea’s prestige and our people’s dignity fully demonstrated before the world are the brilliant fruitions of Kim Jong Un’s experienced and seasoned politics of independence. A new chapter of the era of the Worker’s Party in which development and prosperity are achieved with our own efforts has been opened up, and this constitutes the undying patriotic exploits of Kim Jong Un. It is the unanimous will of our people to win earlier the victory in building a powerful socialist country by thoroughly implementing the independent line of the WPK. A series of eye-opening events and victories which can be hardly estimated with existing political conception and economic figures are in store for Juche Korea, the country of strong independence.

title: The Pyongyang Grand Theatre
body: The Pyongyang Grand Theatre was built in August 1960 on the picturesque Taedong River in Pyongyang in a year and a half to fully demonstrate the excellent architecture of our nation. The theatre is a masterwork of the age of the Workers’ Party of Korea, national in form and socialist in content. It is a center for the cultural and emotional lives of our people and Juche-oriented performing arts. During the Fatherland Liberation War (June 25, 1950-July 27, 1953) President Kim Il Sung had already believed that our country would win it and shaped its future. He personally unfolded a blueprint for the postwar rehabilitation and construction on an operational plan-designing table at his supreme headquarters and inspected it. Meantime, he mapped out a far-seeing plan for building a superb theatre of Korean style in the center of Pyongyang. After the war he personally chose its site and gave detailed advices on its plan and construction. He visited the construction site of the theatre for firsthand leadership many times and said that it should be built well into a monumental edifice of the era of the WPK to meet the demand of the people and suit their convenience. He went the length of naming it the Pyongyang Grand Theatre. The Pyongyang Grand Theatre was consequently built into a great center of the flourishing Juche art and an excellent center for the cultural and emotional lives of our people. True to Kim Il Sung’s idea of the Juche art Chairman Kim Jong Il did all he could to develop the theater further into a swell monumental edifice in the 21st century, too. It has now been rebuilt splendidly to contribute actively to the cultural and emotional lives of our people. O Mun Il

title: Summer National Dishes
body: In April of the lunar calendar our people enjoyed fish dishes, especially broiled gizzard shad, sea bream soup, gray mullet soup, hard-boiled golden carp, etc. From olden times gizzard shad has smelled so delicious when broiled so it was said proverbially in Korea that the smell of broiling gizzard shad brought back daughter-in-law who was running away. The inhabitants of Phyongan, Hwanghae and Jolla Provinces enjoyed sea bream soup. When caught in April of the lunar calendar red sea-breams are at their best. Made with them, its soup is delicious and appetizing. It has been considered very efficacious for the infirm in particular. From of old gray mullet soup has been famous as a dish native to Phyongan Province. Above all, the soup prepared with the gray mullet of the Taedong River joined the Pyongyang iced noodle, the Pyongyang hot rice and meat soup, the Pyongyang fish porridge, etc in its specialties. From ancient times hard-boiled golden fish has been widely used by hepatic patients as an efficacious dish. Kim Chong Il

title: More Truth about Kwangju Massacre Revealed
body: A document showing that traitor Chun Doo Hwan commanded the final bloody suppression operation codenamed "loyalty operation" in those days of the Kwangju Popular Uprising was disclosed, according to a news report. According to the "military instructions and measures during the loyalty operation in Kwangju" which were mapped out by the then 2nd Corps Command in 1980, the commander of 2nd Corps reported to Chun Doo Hwan on the "loyalty operation" plan on May 23 and Chun approved it. A witness testified that two copters had fired at the protesters in Kwangju. According to him, the copters fired about 500 bullets at the protesters. Rodong Sinmun

title: Child Health Day Marked
body: An event was held at the Taedongmun Kindergarten in Central District of Pyongyang on Tuesday to mark the Child Health Day. Present there were officials of the Ministry of Public Health and relevant units, the Swedish and British ambassadors to the DPRK, the representative of the United Nations Children's Fund here and staff members of diplomatic missions and international bodies' missions here. At the event, speakers called upon all the attendees to share their common sense and experience and acquire knowledge of child health so as to make a positive contribution to bringing up younger generations in good health. Then a seminar on child health was held. Speakers elaborated on the problems arising in child health care including prevention and treatment of diseases. After looking round the photos of happy Korean children and those showing the aid activities of the missions of international bodies here, the participants enjoyed an art performance given by the children at the Taedongmun Kindergarten and their sporting and amusement games. Rodong Sinmun

title: Kim Jae Ryong Inspects Various Units of National Economy
body: Premier Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and member of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, inspected the Sunchon Thermal Power Plant, the Chollima Steel Complex, the Posan Iron Works and Pongchon and Paechon counties of South Hwanghae Province. Walking round several places of the Sunchon Thermal Power Plant, Kim Jae Ryong said that as the integrated power production system has been set up, the officials and technicians should scrupulously improve the technical control of the equipment and actively invent and introduce new technical innovation schemes in order to raise the efficiency of the generating equipment. At the Chollima Steel Complex and the Posan Iron Works, he stressed that the officials should properly conduct operation and command to make the maximum use of the existing production capacity and take due measures to ensure supply of electricity so as to send more iron and steel to major construction sites. The field consultative meetings discussed issues to adopt thorough measures for normal operation and repair of the generating equipment, calling upon relevant fields to supply in time materials needed for production of iron and steel. He also made a field survey of the farming in the Sindap Cooperative Farm of Pongchon County and in Paechon County of South Hwanghae Province. Rodong Sinmun

title: LKP Blasted in S. Korea
body: The Taejon Headquarters of Movement for Achieving People's Rights and Removing Evils and the Taejon and Chungchong Committee for Commemorating the 39th Anniversary of May 18 Popular Resistance in south Korea held a "candle-light rally of Taejon citizens to inherit the spirit of the May 18 Popular Resistance" at the plaza of Taejon Railway Station on May 17, according to the south Korean internet paper Tongil News. Speakers of the rally said that the "Liberal Korea Party" (LKP) of south Korea nominated a person, who insulted the spirit of the Kwangju Uprising, as a member of the Investigation Committee for the Probe into the Truth behind the Kwangju Massacre and accepted the allegations made by Ji Man Won as historical facts and committed other reckless acts, all of which invoke public denunciation. Noting LKP, roots of pro-Japan and military dictatorship, spawns injustice, they demanded the party of traitors stop denying history and democracy at once. The participants in the rally marched up to the Taejon building of LKP, chanting slogans "Let us inherit May spirit!" and "Dissolve LKP!" They held a funeral ceremony for LKP outside the building after sentencing to death the LKP that goes against the public sentiment and defends the distortion of May 18 history and the lawmaker perverting the historical facts. Rodong Sinmun

title: Korean People's Struggle Supported by International Organization
body: The Asia-Pacific Regional Committee for Supporting Peaceful Reunification of Korea issued a statement on April 22 in support of the appeal issued by the Latin American and Caribbean Regional Committee to Support the Reunification of Korea. The statement said that the Latin American and Caribbean Regional Committee to Support the Reunification of Korea suggested setting the period from April 27 to June 12, the first anniversaries of the adoption of the historic Panmunjom Declaration and the June 12 DPRK-U.S. joint statement, as the "period of the international action for peace, prosperity and reunification of the Korean peninsula" and expressed support for it. The statement called upon all member organizations under the Asia-Pacific Regional Committee for Supporting Peaceful Reunification of Korea to conduct positive activities for solidarity with the Korean people, saying that the development of the situation on the Korean peninsula after the adoption of the Panmunjom Declaration was warmly welcomed by all peace-loving peoples in the world. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Policy Speech Supported by Indian Figure
body: Hannan Mollah, general secretary of the All-India Peasants' Union, issued a statement on May 13 in support of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's policy speech. He said that the policy speech made by Kim Jong Un at the First Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea is an important guideline that indicated the way of building a powerful socialist country and achieving peace, prosperity and reunification of the Korean Peninsula. The DPRK will become an independent power which no force dares to provoke and the great country where the ideal of the people is comprehensively realized and which is outpacing the world by brilliantly implementing the tasks set forth by Kim Jong Un, he noted. He extended active support to the righteous cause of the Korean people, expressing the belief that the heroic Korean people would open a new phase of prosperity with their own efforts, attain the ideal and goal for a powerful country and realize the independent and peaceful reunification of the country without fail. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Meeting Marks 80th Anniversary of Victorious Battles in Musan Area
body: A national meeting was held at the forecourt of the Monument to the Victorious Battle of Musan Area on Wednesday to mark the 80th anniversary of the victorious battles in the Musan area led by President Kim Il Sung. Present there were Choe Hwi, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Jon Kwang Ho, vice-premier of the Cabinet, Ro Kwang Sop, director of the Party History Institute of the Central Committee of the WPK, Ri Sang Won, chairman of the Ryanggang Provincial Party Committee, Ri Song Guk, chairman of the Ryanggang Provincial People's Committee, officials of working people's organizations, and officials and working people in Ryanggang Province. It was also attended by Army General No Kwang Chol, minister of the People's Armed Forces, members of the armed forces organs and service personnel of the Korean People's Army. Choe Hwi made a report. He said that the battles in the Musan area led by the President were a historic event of great significance - a radical turn - in carrying out the Juche-oriented line of the Korean revolution and bringing about an upsurge in the Korean people's anti-Japanese national liberation movement centering on the armed struggle. The victory in the battles in the Musan area was the brilliant fruit of Kim Il Sung's steadfast idea and faith of independence and outstanding leadership, the reporter said. He pointed out that the battle of Pochonbo demonstrated that Korea was not dead but alive, and the battle of Musan area was a historic battle which actually showed that the Korean People's Revolutionary Army (KPRA) was thriving and dealing telling blows to the Japanese imperialists after growing to be more powerful forces, no matter how desperately the enemy spread false information about destruction of KPRA. The reporter went on: The battles in the Musan area were a heavy blow to the Japanese imperialists hell-bent on continental aggression and thus rendered a direct help to the revolutionary struggle in neighboring countries and greatly inspired the national liberation movement of the world oppressed people against the imperialists' invasion and subjugation. The reporter stressed that only victory and glory are in store for the Korean people who are adding eternal luster to the revolutionary tradition of Paektu and carving out the destiny of their country and nation in an independent and creative way. Rodong Sinmun

title: Palestinian Delegation Here
body: A delegation of the Palestine National Liberation Movement led by Vice-Chairman Mahmoud O.R. Al Aloul arrived here Wednesday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Commemorative Stamps Issued in DPRK
body: The State Stamp Bureau of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea issued new stamps (one sheet and one individual stamp) in commemoration of the 80th anniversary of the victorious battles in the Musan area commanded by President Kim Il Sung during the anti-Japanese armed struggle. Seen on the upper part of the stamps are letters "80th anniversary of the victorious battles in the Musan area". The individual stamp carries a picture of the Monument to the Victorious Battle of Musan Area with the statue of Kim Il Sung, legendary hero of the great anti-Japanese war who led the offensive in the Musan area to a brilliant victory. A sheet carries pictures of a group of large subsidiary theme sculptures showing guerrillas who displayed unparalleled bravery in the battles of the Musan area, the sketch of the battles in the Musan area and others. Rodong Sinmun

title: Palestinian Delegation Feted
body: The Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea gave a reception in honor of the visiting delegation of the Palestine National Liberation Movement on Wednesday. Present there on invitation were members of the delegation of the Palestine National Liberation Movement led by Vice-Chairman Mahmoud O.R. Al Aloul and Ismail Ahmed Mohamed Hasan, Palestinian ambassador to the DPRK. Attending it were Pak Thae Song, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and officials concerned. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Seminar Held
body: A national seminar was held at the People's Palace of Culture on Wednesday to have a good grasp of the historic policy speech made by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un at the First Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly and the idea and line set forth by him at the Fourth Plenary Meeting of the 7th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and carry them through. Attending the seminar were officials of central and city party and administrative organs, working people's organizations, those in the fields of science, education, literature and art and media and those of party cadres training institutions and those in the field of revolutionary relics preservation. The seminar heard papers explaining the idea and theory set forth in Kim Jong Un's policy speech "On Socialist Construction and the Internal and External Policies of the Government of the Republic at the Present Stage" and proving the theoretical and practical issues arising in the struggle to implement the decision made at the Fourth Plenary Meeting of the 7th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Speakers said that the policy speech of Kim Jong Un serves as guidelines which indicated the way for successfully accomplishing the cause of building a powerful socialist country by embodying the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist ideas of State building. President Kim Il Sung's and Chairman Kim Jong Il's ideas of State building gives perfect answers to all the theoretical and practical matters arising in the struggle of all the people with transparent spirit of independence, faith and will to accomplish the cause of building a powerful state, they noted. The DPRK's history of building socialism is the one of proud struggle in which it has laid a material foundation for self-supporting economy, defended the dignity of the country and destiny of the people and steadily increased the political and military might by dint of it under the leadership of the peerlessly great men, they said. Firm is the stand of the Workers' Party of Korea and the government of the DPRK to dynamically advance along the road of independence and build a powerful socialist country with the revolutionary line of independence and revolutionary mode of self-reliance as its eternal lifeline and cornerstone of state-building, they stressed. They vowed to fulfill their duty as leading officials of revolution in accomplishing the cause of building a powerful socialist country of Juche by remaining loyal to the leadership of Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Choe Ryong Hae Inspects Several Units in Jungsan County
body: Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, inspected Jungsan County, South Phyongan Province to acquaint himself with its forest management. In Mubon-ri, Choe Ryong Hae learned in detail about how it has preserved soil and solved the issue of firewood by planting fast-growing poplars. Looking round the mother tree nursery of the forestry management station of the county, he gave a pep talk to its employees who are making great contributions to the forest restoration campaign by growing many saplings, and called for putting the production of saplings on a higher scientific, industrialized and intensive basis. He gave field officials the instructions on such issues as letting every ri properly build its own tree nurseries, boosting the rate of rooting by fertilizing and tending them in a responsible manner and designing the cyclic felling in firewood forest in a scientific way as required by the Party policy. Rodong Sinmun

title: Kuwaiti Organization Extends Solidarity to Korean People's Struggle
body: The Kuwait-DPRK Friendship Association released a statement on May 15 in support of the appeal issued by the Latin American and Caribbean Regional Committee to Support the Reunification of Korea. The statement said that the appeal of the Latin American and Caribbean Regional Committee to Support the Reunification of Korea was issued at a time when the positive atmosphere toward peace and reunification on the Korean Peninsula should be valued and active efforts directed to more favorably develop the current situation, irrespective of ideology, political view and religious belief. It extended full support to the initiative made by the Latin American and Caribbean Regional Committee to Support the Reunification of Korea, and went on: The Panmunjom Declaration and the September Pyongyang Joint Declaration are of great significance as they reflect the firm resolution and will to open the era of peace without war in the Korean peninsula. As was indicated in the June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement, it is the steadfast stand of the Workers' Party of Korea and the DPRK government to establish new relations between the two countries as required by the new century and build a lasting and durable peace-keeping mechanism on the Korean Peninsula. We will join the international activities calling for checking every move to escalate military tension on the Korean Peninsula and for leading the peaceful atmosphere to the establishment of a permanent peace-keeping mechanism. We extend firm solidarity to the Korean people in the struggle for achieving the reunification of the country in the spirit of national independence. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Published in Ethiopia
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let KCU Members Become True Sons and Daughters, Young Revolutionaries, of the Socialist Country" was brought out in booklet by the Penguin Publishing House of Ethiopia with due ceremony on May 13. In his speech on June 6, Juche 106 (2017), Kim Jong Un clarified that the basic task facing the organizations of the Korean Children's Union (KCU) at present is to develop forever the KCU into Kim Il Sung's and Kim Jong Il's union and the union of the Workers' Party of Korea and prepare all the KCU members to be true sons and daughters, young revolutionaries of the socialist country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Talks Held between Vice-Chairman of C.C., WPK and Vice-President of Council of State of Cuba
body: Talks between Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, who is on a visit to the Republic of Cuba as head of a party and government delegation of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and Roberto Morales, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba, vice-president of the Council of State and vice-president of the Council of Ministers of the Republic of Cuba, were held at the building of the Council of State on May 22. Roberto Morales said that the current visit of the party and government delegation of the DPRK is a vivid manifestation of the Korean people's sincere support and solidarity to the Cuban revolution. Noting that the peoples of the two countries are overcoming shoulder to shoulder ordeals and difficulties, he said it is the firm stand of the Cuban party and government to invariably develop the friendly and cooperative relations with the DPRK. Present at the talks from the DPRK side were members of the delegation and the DPRK ambassador to Cuba and from the Cuban side the deputy head of the International Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba, a vice foreign minister and officials concerned. Meanwhile, a reception was given for the party and government delegation of the DPRK. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Players Back Home
body: DPRK players came back home on Thursday after taking part in the FINA diving World Series 2019. They bagged two gold medals, five silvers and two bronzes in the World Series held in Canada, Russia and Britain. Kim Mi Rae and Jo Jin Mi took the first place in the women's 10 meter platform synchronized event held in Canada and Kim Mi Rae in the women's 10 meter platform event held in Russia. Hyon Il Myong and Jo Jin Mi bagged silver medals in the mixed 10 meter platform synchronized event held in Canada, Russia and Britain, Kim Mi Rae and Jo Jin Mi silver medals in the women's 10 meter platform synchronized event held in Russia and Britain and Kim Mi Rae bronze medals in the women's 10 meter platform event held in Canada and Britain. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of State Emergency Disaster Committee Back Home
body: A delegation of the State Emergency Disaster Committee led by Chairman Kang Il Sop came back home on Thursday after taking part in the 6th world forum for prevention of danger of disaster held in Switzerland. Rodong Sinmun

title: Skilled Workers' Contest Opens
body: The contest of skilled workers with different jobs in various sectors of the national economy-2019 opened in the DPRK. The contest will be held divided into such categories as plastering, carpentry, welding, pipe-making and lathe. More than 200 skilled workers selected in the earlier contests held in the field of the armed forces and by ministries, national institutions and provincial people's committees will take part in the contest. Its opening ceremony took place at the Kangwon Provincial Art Theatre on Thursday. Present there were Jon Kwang Ho, vice-premier of the Cabinet, officials of ministries and national institutions and officials and working people of institutions and enterprises in Wonsan. Rodong Sinmun

title: 6th National Children's Football Tournament Opens
body: The 6th national children's football tournament opened with due ceremony at the Sariwon Youth Stadium on Thursday on the occasion of the 73rd anniversary of the foundation of the Korean Children's Union. The football players (boys and girls) who proved successful in city and county games will play league matches during the tournament. Present at the ceremony were officials of the youth league and schoolchildren. Rodong Sinmun

title: Parliamentary Delegation of Czech Republic Tours Pyongyang
body: A parliamentary delegation of the Czech Republic led by Lubomir Zaoralek, chairman of the Foreign Affairs Committee of the Chamber of Deputies, visited the Pyongyang Cosmetics Factory on Thursday. The members of the delegation looked round various production processes at the factory. They also visited the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum, Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace, Ryugyong General Ophthalmic Hospital, etc. Rodong Sinmun

title: Pak Thae Song Meets Delegation of Palestine National Liberation Movement
body: Pak Thae Song, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, on Thursday met and had a talk with the delegation of the Palestine National Liberation Movement led by Vice-Chairman Mahmoud O.R. Al Aloul that paid a courtesy call on him. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of Institute of International Studies of DPRK Leaves for China
body: A delegation of the Institute of International Studies of the DPRK headed by President O Yong Ran left here on Thursday to visit China. Rodong Sinmun

title: UK, Swiss Bodies Issue Joint Statements
body: British and Swiss organizations released joint statements on May 13 and 15 on the occasion of the 39th anniversary of the Kwangju Popular Uprising in south Korea. The British Association for the Study of Songun Policy, the British Group for the Study of the Juche Idea, the Korean Friendship Association UK and the British Solidarity Committee for Peace and Reunification of the Korean Peninsula in their joint statement said that citizens in Kwangju turned out in the struggle against the dictatorship of the Chun Doo Hwan military fascist clique in May, 1980. The joint statement said that the Kwangju Popular Uprising was recorded as a new chapter in the history of the south Korean people's struggle against the U.S. and fascism. The south Korean military fascist clique, instigated by the U.S. imperialists, brutally suppressed the uprising, it said, adding that the blood shed by the participants in the uprising will not be in vain. The Switzerland-Korea Committee and the Swiss Group for the Study of the Juche Idea stressed that the Kwangju Popular Uprising was a mass armed uprising for independence, democracy and reunification. Rodong Sinmun

title: Ri Su Yong Meets President of National Assembly of People's Power of Cuba
body: Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, who is on a visit to the Republic of Cuba as head of a party and government delegation of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Thursday met and had a talk with Esteban Lazo Hernandez, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba and president of the National Assembly of People's Power of Cuba, at the building of the National Assembly of People's Power of Cuba. Esteban Lazo Hernandez thanked the Korean people in the name of the party, government and people of Cuba for extending full support and solidarity to the righteous struggle of the Cuban people, and expressed the belief that the visit of the party and government delegation of the DPRK would serve as an occasion for accelerating the development of the friendly relations between the two countries. Meanwhile, Ri Su Yong met Marcelino Medina Gonzalez, first vice-minister of Foreign Affairs of Cuba, on the same day. Rodong Sinmun

title: Parliamentary Delegation of Czech Republic Leaves
body: The parliamentary delegation of the Czech Republic led by Lubomir Zaoralek, chairman of the Foreign Affairs Committee of the Chamber of Deputies, left here for home on Friday. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Players Prove Successful at World Challenge Cup
body: DPRK player Kim Hyok came first in the vault of men's individual apparatus finals of the 2019 FIG Artistics Gymnastics World Challenge Cup. Ri Yong Min bagged a bronze medal in the parallel bars of men's individual apparatus finals. The competition which took place in China from May 19 to 21 brought together over 40 men and women players from 11 countries and regions including the DPRK. The DPRK players returned home on Friday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: A home-visiting group of students of Korean high schools in Japan headed by Jo Kyong Hwan, principal of Aichi Korean Middle and High School, visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on Friday. They laid a bouquet and made a bow before the statues of the great leaders. Rodong Sinmun

title: Congratulations to South African President
body: Choe Ryong Hae, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Thursday sent a congratulatory message to Cyril Ramaphosa on his reelection as president of the Republic of South Africa. The message sincerely wished the president happiness in good health and bigger success in his responsible work for the country's development and prosperity, expressing the belief that the friendly relations between the two countries would grow strong in the future, too. Rodong Sinmun

title: Choe Ryong Hae Meets Delegation of Palestine National Liberation Movement
body: Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, met and had a talk with the delegation of the Palestine National Liberation Movement led by Vice-Chairman Mahmoud O.R. Al Aloul that paid a courtesy call on him at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Friday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Palestinian Delegation Visits Mangyongdae
body: A delegation of the Palestine National Liberation Movement led by Vice-Chairman Mahmoud O.R. Al Aloul visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. Members of the delegation laid a bouquet at the native home of Kim Il Sung in Mangyongdae in reverence for him. Being told that he nurtured the great intention to liberate the country while receiving education in patriotism from his parents in his early years, they looked round historical relics. They walked round revolutionary sites on Mangyong Hill. The delegation also toured the Tower of the Juche Idea, the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum, the Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace, etc. Rodong Sinmun

title: Personal Letter and Gift to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Palestinian President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, was presented with a personal letter and gift by Mahmoud Abbas, president of the State of Palestine and chairman of the Palestine National Liberation Movement. They were conveyed to Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, first vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, on Friday by Mahmoud O.R. Al Aloul, vice-chairman of the Palestine National Liberation Movement who is leading its delegation on a visit to the DPRK. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to President of Eritrea
body: Choe Ryong Hae, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on Friday sent a message of greeting to Issaias Afewerki, president of the State of Eritrea, on its independence day. The message sincerely wished the president and people of Eritrea greater success in their work for development and prosperity of the country, expressing belief that the friendly relations between the two countries would grow stronger. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to Chairman of AU Commission
body: Choe Ryong Hae, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, Saturday sent a message of greeting to Moussa Faki Mahamat, chairman of the Commission of the African Union, on the occasion of the Day of Africa. Choe in the message said that the DPRK government and people extend invariable support and solidarity to the African people in their just struggle to reject all sorts of domination and interference of outsiders and achieve peace and stability and sustained development and prosperity of the continent with concerted efforts. Expressing the belief that the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation between the DPRK and the AU member states would grow stronger in the future, it wished the AU great success in its work for raising the continent's position and carrying more weight in the international arena. Rodong Sinmun

title: Celebrations Held in Czech Republic and Russia
body: A seminar on exploits of Chairman Kim Jong Il was held in Prague, the Czech Republic on May 15 to mark the 55th anniversary of Kim Jong Il's start of work at the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). Present there were political and public personages and masses in the Czech Republic. The chairman of the Czech Group for the Study and Materialization of the Juche Idea who is deputy general secretary of the Central Committee of the Czechoslovak Communist Party said that since Kim Jong Il started his work at the Central Committee of the WPK, it has further demonstrated its dignity as a powerful revolutionary party that materializes the idea and cause of President Kim Il Sung, firmly defends socialism and leads it to victory. He said that Kim Jong Il consolidated the single-minded unity of the Korean society by rallying all the people around the Party. Not only the Korean people but also the progressive peoples deeply cherish in their minds the exploits Kim Jong Il performed in developing the WPK, achieving people's happiness and global peace and accomplishing the cause of socialism, he noted. A Korean book, photo and handicraft exhibition opened in Russia on May 16 to mark the 3rd anniversary of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's election as chairman of the WPK. Rodong Sinmun

title: Foreign Guests Leave
body: Delegations of China, Russia and Poland left here for home on Friday and Saturday after taking part in the 22nd Pyongyang Spring International Trade Fair. Rodong Sinmun

title: Palestinian Delegation Leaves
body: A delegation of the Palestine National Liberation Movement led by Vice-Chairman Mahmoud O.R. Al Aloul left here for home on Saturday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Birthday Spreads Sent to Educationalists
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un sent birthday spreads to Candidate Academician, Prof. and Dr Ko Pyong Jun, researcher at Kim Chaek University of Technology, on his 80th birthday, and Merited Scientist, Candidate Academician, Prof. and Dr Kim Haeng Son, teacher at the same university, on his 70th birthday. Ko Pyong Jun and Kim Haeng Son have dedicated their wisdom and enthusiasm to education of the rising generation and scientific research after graduating the university. Ko Pyong Jun has written more than 40 kinds of textbooks, reference books and papers and trained dozens of holders of academic degree who make contributions to development of the country's science and technology, while serving as a teacher, chief of department, dean of faculty and researcher for decades. He was awarded a watch bearing the august name of President Kim Il Sung and citation of Chairman Kim Jong Il and participated in the National Meeting of Intellectuals and other meetings. Kim Haeng Son has explored many subjects and written twenty-odd kinds of textbooks and references to make a positive contribution to the sci-tech development. He was awarded a watch bearing the august name of Kim Il Sung and high official commendations and took part in the 13th National Meeting of Educationists and others. Rodong Sinmun

title: Russian Government Donates Wheat to DPRK
body: Wheat donated by the Russian government to the DPRK through the WFP arrived here on Saturday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Gift to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from President of Council of State of Cuba
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was presented with a gift by Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez, president of the Council of State and president of the Council of Ministers of the Republic of Cuba. The gift was conveyed to Ryu Myong Son, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, who is on a visit to Cuba as a member of a party and government delegation of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea by an official of the Cuban Foreign Ministry on May 24. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Gift from First Secretary of Central Committee of Communist Party of Cuba
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was presented with a gift by Raul Castro Ruz, first secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba.
