The gift was conveyed to Ryu Myong Son, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, who is on a visit to Cuba as a member of a party and government delegation of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea by an official of the Cuban Foreign Ministry on May 24. Rodong Sinmun

title: Ri Su Yong Meets Raul Castro Ruz
body: Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), who is visiting the Republic of Cuba as head of a party and government delegation of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, met Raul Castro Ruz, first secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba, at the building of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba on May 23. Raul Castro Ruz said that Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un is the wise leader successfully carrying forward the cause of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. He expressed his will to develop the fraternal and comradely relations of friendship and cooperation between the two countries with a long history and tradition. Rodong Sinmun

title: Party and Government Delegation of DPRK Tours Las Terrazas in Cuba
body: A Party and government delegation of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea led by Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, toured Las Terrazas, a famous tourist attraction and model eco-zone in Artemisa Province, during its sojourn in Cuba. Rodong Sinmun

title: Proud Course Covered by Chongryon Following the Bright Sun
body: May 25 marks the 64th anniversary of the formation of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) which has demonstrated its honor of being the pioneer of patriotic struggle, the model of patriotism and loyalty and the model of overseas compatriots’ organizations in the world. Chongryon is an organization of faith and loyalty that has steadily covered the sacred road for the country and nation under the uplifted banner of Juche and patriotism. There are many organizations of overseas compatriots in the world but it is only Chongryon which is patriotic and powerful in view of loyalty for the country and nation and size, sphere of activity, unity and working efficiency. The history of Chongryon is the one of the great victory for the Juche-oriented idea of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un on the overseas compatriots’ movement and their outstanding guidance and the one adorned with their noblest compatriotism and loving care for the nation. Officials of Chongryon and Koreans in Japan have strengthened Chongryon, a creation of Juche, into a patriotic organization that shares life and death with the socialist country in any storm and stress, and resolutely defended the DPRK from all sorts of denunciation and censure by the hostile forces, true to the peerlessly great persons’ outstanding idea on the overseas compatriots’ movement. Chongryon has worked hard for the democratic and national rights of Koreans and promotion of their wellbeing as the genuine mouthpiece and resolute defender of their rights and interests and the one kindly serving them. Chongryon’s proud and true feature can be found in the fact that it is giving steady continuity to patriotism as an organization organizationally and ideologically united on the basis of the great Juche idea and deeply rooted in broad masses of compatriots. Ho Yong Min

title: Talents, Science and Technology Are Engine for Developing Self-supporting Economy
body: Only when a country attaches importance to talents and prioritizes sci-tech development, it can ceaselessly increase the sci-tech power and thus develop economy in an all-round and comprehensive way. Even a small country can rank itself among powers and undergo a remarkable development if it has a wealth of talent. On the contrary, if a country, though it is big, lacks talents, its vast territory and rich resources will become worthless and its prospects for prosperity are dim. Knowledge competition constitutes the main current in the contest of national power among countries, which can be said, in its essence, the brain and knowledge contest of talents. The socio-economic development depends on how to quickly produce more talents and give fuller play to their ability than others. This hard reality proves that talents serve as main strategic resources of a country and a nation and as powerful forces responsible for hastening social progress and prosperity. Only when we depend on our sci-tech talents, we can give full play to our self-supporting economic foundation and potentials, make an inveterate habit of self-reliance and bring the tremendous strength of all people with their hearts burning with patriotic and creative zeal to substantial successes in the economic construction. The socialist economic construction has become a serious political matter and fierce confrontation with the enemy, not merely an economic technical issue. So, only when we give top priority to science and technology, we can frustrate the enemy’s sanctions and accelerate the development of our self-supporting economy on the strength of self-sufficiency and self-reliance. Hong Jin Hyok

title: Editorial
body: Let Us Thoroughly Establish Beautiful and Lofty Moral Traits throughout Whole Society Imbuing the whole society with the revolutionary moral traits ensures the victory of socialism. We should wipe out all hues of mixed ideas and evil spirits on the strength of revolutionary moral traits to further strengthen the moral foundation of our style socialism. It is necessary for us to show the warmest loving care for comrades based on the noble view of life and morality of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and to make sure that the revolutionary morality runs through the work system and discipline and that good virtue and tender sentiment pervade our society and the collective. What is imperative here is for the rising generations to carry forward the tradition of the revolutionary morality. We have to put great efforts into the education of the rising generations in good morality to make them value and further glorify the great harmonious socialist family cultivated by the preceding generations.

title: Thorough Application of People-First Principle Is
body: Fundamental Principle of State Building, Activities Today the Workers’ Party of Korea (WKP) set it as the main principle of state building and activities to thoroughly apply the people-first principle from an urgent demand of the developing revolution. To thoroughly apply the people-first principle is the fundamental requirement for uniting the Party, State and people more closely as one community sharing the destiny and it is the inevitable demand for accelerating the socialist construction by giving fullest rein to people’s revolutionary enthusiasm and creative strength. It is also an important demand for decisively rooting out all kinds of dishonest practices encroaching on the people’s interests among officials. For our Party and State, it comes to be the revolutionary climate prevailing throughout the Party and the social customs to make selfless, devoted efforts for the good of the people. It is the mode of activity of our Party and State to lavish billions of money on removing pain of people. The Party and the State make selfless, devoted efforts for the good of the people and the people entrust their destiny and future to the Party and the State and devotedly uphold them. This is the real picture of socialist Korea in which the people-first principle is embodied. Thanks to the heroic struggle of the entire people who remove a mountain and fill the sea if it is planned and determined by the Party, Juche Korea will dash ahead like the wind in Mallima speed, a new advance speed. Kim Chol Ryong

title: Deep-rooted Sinister Plot of Japanese Reactionaries to Stamp out Chongryon
body: Shortly ago, the Japanese authorities gave a written answer in the name of the Cabinet to questions raised by a Diet member against the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea and the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan(Chongryon). The keynote of the answer is that Chongryon may commit “violent acts of sabotage if the situation presents itself” as it is in “close contact with north Korea” and accordingly, they regard Chongryon as a rebel organization. The Japanese reactionaries in the written answer labeled Chongryon as a target of investigation under the Act for the Prevention of Sabotage while bring 14 kinds of false charges against Chongryon like “abduction” and “illegal export”. All their moves show that the Japanese authorities remain unchanged in their hostile policy towards the DPRK and Chongryon despite the changed situation and peaceful climate on the Korean peninsula which draw the attention of the international community. In recent days, they often talk about dialogue. However, their deeds go against their words. Still, Japan is a country which has the cross on its breast and the devil in its heart and commits wicked deeds against its words, and a despicable and impudent violent state and a real target to be checked for the prevention of sabotage. Explicitly speaking, mean slander and crackdown upon Chongryon are just a hostile act and serious politically-motivated provocation against the DPRK. Ho Yong Min

title: Japan Should Drop Evil Habit of Accusing Others
body: A “specific missing man” was found in Japan recently, according to an announcement by the police of Japan. Japan has claimed that it cannot rule out the “possibility of abduction by north Korea” from the case of his missing. The “specific missing man” reportedly left his home in Yokohama City of Kanagawa Prefecture in May 1992 when he was 26. Then, he went missing. In April this year the Japan police confirmed that he is alive and once served as an “officer of the Ground Self-Defense Force.” The Japanese reactionaries talk about “abduction by north Korea” whenever they cannot find missing persons. The above-said fact clearly proves that their story is just sophism and fabrication. Like in the past, a “specific missing person” was found in Japan again and Japan has come under public derision as it always passed the buck to others when they could not find such missing persons. Missing persons are on the steady increase in Japan and its root cause lies in its unpopular and reactionary social system. Nevertheless, the Japanese reactionaries went so shameless as to deliberately link all the missing cases caused by the social evils rampant in Japan to the DPRK and go crazy in their anti-DPRK campaign like the “rally of families of abduction victims.” Japan is a country which committed heinous abductions unprecedented in history. Far from making efforts to cleanse itself of the crime-woven past, Japan is intentionally linking the missing cases occurring in it to the DPRK. It is just the height of tricky propaganda against the DPRK. Japan is well advised to break with the evil habit of finding faults with others and honestly atone for its past crimes. It should make an apology for trying to impair the dignity of the DPRK. Ri Kyong Su

title: S. Korean Authorities Launch Provocative Military Drill
body: According to media reports, south Korean authorities launched Ulji Thaeguk drill throughout south Korea on May 27. The Ulji Thaeguk drill is a combination of Ulji drill, a part of Ulji Freedom Guardian, and Thaeguk drill, which the south Korean military has performed alone. The south Korean military authorities announced that the current drill will run till May 30 with the involvement of the units assigned to the Defence Ministry. Even more than 480 000 civilians from over 4 000 administrative bodies and public institutions of cities, counties and districts of south Korea will reportedly take part in the drill. The south Korean authorities decided to conduct a drill of reorganizing all work on a war footing to cope with the "provocation of a local war" by someone, including the issuing of mobilization order and emergency call of public officials, on the sidelines of the drill. It is said that the "prime minister" summoned the heads of central administrative bodies, mayors, provincial governors and commanding officers of the army to the building of the "government" in Seoul on May 14 to discuss the current drill. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Judoists Win Two Gold Medals
body: DPRK judoists Kim Jin A and Jon Yu Sun won gold medals in the women's 57kg and 48kg categories of the 2019 International Judo Federation Hohhot Grand Prix held in China. The Hohhot grand prix brought together over 300 men and women judo aces from more than 40 countries and regions, including the DPRK, China and Russia. The DPRK players returned home on Monday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Kim Jae Ryong Inspects Various Units
body: Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, member of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, inspected the Pukchang Thermal Power Complex, East Pyongyang Thermal Power Plant, Sungri Motor Complex, etc. Looking round the thermal power complex and plant, Kim Jae Ryong instructed their officials to properly organize and manage the production, actively introduce the valuable technical innovation schemes, maintain equipment on a regular basis and thus increase the generating capacity to the maximum. At the Sungri Motor Complex, he called upon the complex, which is associated with the leadership feats of the Party, to always take the lead in production, step up the update of production processes, and ensure the accurate processing of accessories on a high level. The field consultative meetings discussed such issues as further improving the present generating capacity of thermal power plants, making allied domains take proper measures to provide thermal power plants with raw and other materials and converting the auto industry into the development-and-creation-oriented one. Touring Pyongyang City to learn about its management, he underscored the need to intensify the direction and supervision over the capacity-expansion project for the sewage treatment plant in the centre of the city and thoroughly observe the principle of building infrastructure first. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of Ministry of Railways Leaves for Uzbekistan
body: A delegation of the Ministry of Railways of the DPRK led by Minister Jang Hyok left here on Monday to attend the 47th ministerial meeting of the Organization of Railways Cooperation due in Tashkent, Uzbekistan. Rodong Sinmun

title: WPK Pyongyang City Committee Delegation Leaves for Russia
body: A delegation of the Pyongyang City Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) led by Chairman Kim Nung O left here on Monday to visit Russia. Rodong Sinmun

title: Appeal Issued by Latin American and Caribbean Regional Committee
body: to Support Reunification of Korea Supported The general director of Sunbula International Friendship Club who is chairman of the Libya-DPRK Friendship Association made public a statement on May 19 in support of the appeal issued by the Latin American and Caribbean Regional Committee to Support the Reunification of Korea on the occasion of the first anniversaries of the historic Panmunjom Declaration and the June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement. He voiced firm solidarity with the Korean people in their struggle for the rejection of outsiders' interference and the independent reunification of the country. He expressed his will to conduct positive activities for supporting the Korean people's just cause, noting that sanctions on the DPRK should be immediately lifted. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Party and Government Delegation Returns from Cuba
body: A party and government delegation of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea led by Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, returned home on Tuesday after visiting the Republic of Cuba. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Players Prove Successful in Int'l Tournament
body: DPRK players proved successful in the Chinese Taipei Athletics Open 2019 held on May 25 and 26. The tournament brought together 440-odd men and women players from 15 countries and regions, including the DPRK, Singapore, South Africa and Canada. Kim Kuk Hyang took the first place in women's 1 500m race. Jong Chol Guk won a silver medal in men's 3 000m hurdle race and Kim Ran Yon in women's 3 000m hurdle race. The DPRK players returned home on Tuesday. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Children Show High Artistic Abilities at Int'l Piano Contest
body: The 27th International Juvenile Chopin Piano Contest took place in Poland from May 16 to 19. The contest was held divided into three age groups and brought together over 50 admirable pianists from 18 countries including the DPRK, China, Russia, Poland, Bulgaria and Italy. The jury and experts were deeply moved by the wonderful playing of world famous music by Yu Jin A and Ri Kwon Yun of Kyongsang Kindergarten and Kim Ye Song, student of Pyongyang Music School No.1 of Kim Won Gyun University of Music, who made their debuts in international contest. Yu Jin A was awarded a special prize in the Group A contest and participated in the demonstration concert of winners. Ri Kwon Yun and Kim Ye Song also won special prizes in the groups A and C contests. Rodong Sinmun

title: Over 5 000 People Hold Candlelight Meeting in Seoul to Demand Dissolution of LKP
body: More than 5 000 people of different social standings from Pusan, Ulsan, Taegu, Taejon, etc. in south Korea had a candlelight meeting at the plaza of Kwanghwamun in Seoul on May 25 in demand of the dissolution of the "Liberal Korea Party" (LKP), according to the south Korean online paper Jaju Sibo. They participated in the meeting holding boards bearing such slogans as "Dissolute LKP!" and "Punish Hwang Kyo An and Ra Kyong Won!" Speakers at the meeting said that the people are denouncing LKP as it has prevented the chief criminal responsible for the ferry Sewol disaster from punishment and disturbed probing the truth behind the disaster. They denounced that the group of traitors, the descendants of dictatorship and murderous regimes and the group most corrupt with irregularities and corruption, are crying out for "defense of constitution", "democracy" and "people's livelihood". After the meeting, the participants marched past with candles in their hands. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to Ethiopian President
body: Choe Ryong Hae, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on Tuesday sent a message of greeting to Sahlework Zewde, president of the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia, on the occasion of its national day. The message expressed belief that the friendly relations between the DPRK and Ethiopia would grow stronger, wishing the president and the people of Ethiopia greater success in their work for the prosperity and development of their country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of General Administration of Civil Aviation of DPRK Leaves for China
body: A delegation of the General Administration of Civil Aviation of the DPRK led by General Director Rim Kwang Ung left here on Tuesday to visit China. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: A home-visiting group of students of Korean high schools in Japan headed by Jon Jin Song, principal of Kyushu Korean Middle and High School, visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on Tuesday. They laid a bouquet and made a bow before the statues of the great leaders. Rodong Sinmun

title: Austrian Body Calls for Standing against Anti-DPRK Sanctions
body: The Youth Group for Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism in Austria on May 22 made public a statement in support of the appeal issued by the Latin American and Caribbean Regional Committee to Support the Reunification of Korea. The statement said it is a sacred duty of progressives to extend support and solidarity to the Korean people in their efforts for reunifying the country. It called for boosting the international solidarity with the DPRK and opposing all sorts of anti-DPRK sanctions for the sake of the victorious advance of socialism. It expressed the belief that the Korean people would achieve bigger successes in socialist construction under the guidance of the Workers' Party of Korea. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Introduced in Russia
body: The full text of "Let Us Usher in a New Golden Age of the Movement of Koreans in Japan True to the Intention of the Great Comrade Kim Jong Il", the letter sent by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un to the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) and the Koreans in Japan on the occasion of the 60th formation anniversary of Chongryon, was posted on the Russian website Irkutskblogspot. Ru on May 23. The work, published on May 25, Juche 104 (2015), deals with the 60 year-long history of Chongryon under the leadership and loving care of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. It also indicates the tasks and ways for bringing about a new heyday in the movement of Koreans in Japan true to Kim Jong Il's intention. Rodong Sinmun

title: Japan’s Ambition to Seize Tok Island Can Never Be Realized
body: Japan Decided to enlarge a territorial sovereignty exhibition house that houses distorted data describing Tok Island as “inalienable territory of Japan.” Japan is to expand the house seven times the current area. It means that Japan will wage a more frantic campaign to distort history by replenishing the exhibition house with false data which can deceive the public within and without, insisting that Tok Island belongs to Japan. It has been only almost a year and a half since Japan held a ceremony for opening the exhibition house in the heart of Tokyo Metropolis, but Japan declared that it would expand the exhibition house even seven times the current area, which was a revelation of the undisguised wicked intention to seize the island. Tok Island is an inalienable territory of the Korean nation both historically and legally and both in name and reality. The Japanese reactionaries are most greedy and shameless as they are persisting in enlarging the exhibition house through the distortion of historical facts and violation of all of universally-recognized legal principles as a part of the campaign to seize the island. Japan is brazen-faced and impudent enough to claim that the island belongs to its territory, talking about “illegal occupation”. In the past, the Japanese imperialists invented the story of “Mimana Miyake” meaning “Japan’s government agency of Imna”, the absurd pseudo theory, so as to invent the pretext of invading Korea, and now their descendants are going to repeat the impudent history of aggression. However, Japan’s ambition to seize the island is a pipedream. Tok Island will exist forever as territory of the Korean nation. Ri Hyo Jin

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Work Published in Russia
body: The Khabarovsk Territory Publishing House of Russia brought out in booklet Chairman Kim Jong Il's work "Officials Should Become Devoted Servants of the People" on the occasion of the 55th anniversary of his start of work at the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. The work, published on October 28, Juche 92 (2003), indicates the tasks and ways for making all the officials work as devoted servants of the people. A book-releasing ceremony took place on May 24. Rodong Sinmun

title: Break-up of "Liberal Korea Party" Urged in S. Korea
body: Citizens in Pusan of south Korea held a candlelight gathering in demand of the break-up of the "Liberal Korea Party" (LKP) on May 22, according to south Korean internet paper Jaju Sibo. Speakers said that recent fresh evidence is clarifying that Chun Doo Hwan is the chief criminal of the May 18 massacre. However, the LKP repeatedly talks rubbish about the May 18 massacre because it is a descendant of Chun Doo Hwan and the "Democratic Justice Party", they charged. They called upon people from all walks of life to wage a candlelight demo in demand of the dismissal of the LKP. The participants poured scorn on the LKP, throwing trash at the photos of Ra Kyong Won, Chun Doo Hwan and Hwang Kyo An. Rodong Sinmun

title: Home-Made Goods Popular among Visitors
body: Locally made products and commodities gained great popularities among visitors at the recent Pyongyang Spring International Trade Fair. In particular, an increasing number of people visited the wing of the Ryongaksan Soap Factory in which scores of goods including shampoo, rinse, body washer and detergents were exhibited. According to Jang Un Il, an official of the factory, the factory newly developed various kinds of functional goods with natural plants. For an example, facial cleanser made with silverberry oil was highly estimated by visitors for its distinguished cleansing, whitening and moisturizing effects produced by physiological active material based on ultra-modern technology. Other products including glass washing agent and clothes abstergent were also very popular. Cosmetics of the Pyongyang Cosmetics Factory, the Sinuiju Cosmetics Factory and the Kumgangsan Joint-venture Company also attracted eyes of visitors. Kim Chong Il

title: Delegation of Institute of Int'l Studies Back Home
body: A delegation of the Institute of International Studies headed by President O Yong Ran came back home on Thursday after visiting China. Rodong Sinmun

title: Home-visiting Group of Students of Korean High Schools in Japan Arrives
body: A home-visiting group of students of Korean high schools in Japan headed by Kim Chan Uk, principal of Kanagawa Korean Middle and High School, arrived here Thursday. Rodong Sinmun

title: 2019 Sports Contest of Students at Revolutionary Schools Held
body: The 2019 sports contest of students at revolutionary schools took place on May 28-30 to mark the 73rd anniversary of the founding of the Korean Children's Union in the DPRK. The contest brought together players selected from Mangyongdae Revolutionary School, Kang Pan Sok Revolutionary School and Nampho Revolutionary School. Watching the contest were Army General No Kwang Chol, minister of the People's Armed Forces, members of the armed forces organs, and officials, teaching staff and students of the revolutionary schools. Prior to the contest, the participants laid a floral basket and bouquets before the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il at Mangyongdae Revolutionary School and made a bow to them. The contest included 18 events such as shooting, football, basketball, volleyball, table-tennis, swimming, hurdle-overcoming and relay race. Mangyongdae Revolutionary School took the first place in schoolboys' category and Kang Pan Sok Revolutionary School the first place in schoolgirls' category. Rodong Sinmun

title: Traitor Hwang Kyo An Gets Cold Reception
body: Traitor Hwang Kyo An, representative of the "Liberal Korea Party" (LKP), when begging for support in Kosong County of Kangwon Province of south Korea, was treated with chilly disdain by the inhabitants on May 23, according to a report. On that day, the traitor held a meeting with victims of forest fire where he uttered sheer sophism that the disaster was attributable to the "government", instead of referring to recovery from damage. The enraged inhabitants strongly protested, faulting him for talking nonsense and telling him to do the propaganda for the LKP at the "National Assembly". As a result, the meeting originally meant to denounce the "government" and elicit support was led to a meeting of criticizing the LKP and the support begging fizzled out. Rodong Sinmun

title: Overseas Koreans Call for Setting Up Special Team for Inquiry into Sewol Disaster
body: The Ferry Sewol Overseas Solidarity made public a statement on May 24 to demand the setting up of a special team for investigation into the ferry Sewol disaster, according to a news report. The statement said that the grief-stricken bereaved families of the Sewol victims have expected in vain that the truth about the disaster will be probed and that the person responsible for it will be punished. The statement condemned the Defense Security Command and the Intelligence Service for investigating bereaved families and citizens and examining "martial law" so as to cover up the truth in an organized way. After mentioning that over 240 000 people are petitioning for the complete reinvestigation of the disaster, it demanded that the said special team be set up to probe the truth. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK's Citizens' Favorite Songs Introduced by S. Korean Newspaper
body: The south Korean online newspaper Jaju Sibo carried an article titled "North Korean society seen through songs loved by its citizens in 2019" on May 16. The article said that the leaders of north Korea have given importance to the might of music and art. It went on: In particular, Chairman of the National Defence Commission Kim Jong Il's philosophy of music is that the revolution advances and wins victory with songs. It means that the socialist revolution and construction are a solemn symphony of history and source of songs and that sonorous singing certainly helps the revolution emerge victorious. Chairman of the State Affairs Commission Kim Jong Un attaches importance to the might of music and art. In recent days, every art performance is started with song "Our National Flag" and the song is heard everywhere, including farms, enterprises, streets, etc. To get a proper understanding of north Korean music is one of the ways to get more knowledge of its society. Then, what are the north Korean residents' favorite songs in 2019? They are "Our National Flag", "We Will Go to Mt Paektu", "We Call You Father" and others, according to the personages who recently visited north Korea. The songs show their will to believe in and follow only the Supreme Leader and turn their country into a prosperous one. They also represent their confidence that they will certainly overcome any difficulty and trial, bearing in mind the holy land of revolution and their origin. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Policy Speech Supported by Indian Body
body: The All India Students Federation made public a statement on May 23 in support of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's policy speech. The statement extended full support to the policy speech made by Kim Jong Un at the First Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. It expressed conviction that the DPRK will further demonstrate its dignity as a country strong in independence and people's country by successfully implementing the tasks set forth by Kim Jong Un in his policy speech. It said that Kim Jong Un is making all efforts for national reunification, a cherished desire of the Korean people, and peace and stability of the Korean peninsula and the rest of the world. The statement continued: If the south Korean authorities really want to see improved inter-Korean relations and reunification, they have to honestly implement the Panmunjom Declaration. The U.S. should quit its current calculation method and work for improving the DPRK-U.S. relations. We wish the Korean people big successes in their struggle for surely realizing the ideal and goal of building a powerful country and achieving the independent and peaceful reunification of the country. We extend firm solidarity to the just cause of the Korean people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Tens of Millions of Trees Planted in Cyclic Timber Felling Areas across the Country
body: Officials and Workers in the domain of the forestry planted tens of millions of trees in areas of more than 20,000 hectares this year. In hearty response to the behest of President Kim Il Sung on keeping the principlr of planting ten trees after felling one and the appeal of the Workers' Party of Korea on dynamically waging the forest restoration campaign, the Ministry of Forestry is scrupulously organizing the work of planting trees in the areas where trees are cut down and in treeless places. Provincial forestry management bureaus of the country made workers observe the technical regulations in tree planting. They are now manuring and tending the newly-planted trees in a responsible way to raise the rate of their rooting. Jong Kyong Chol

title: Mandarin Fish Breeding Base Newly Built
body: A mandarin fish breeding base was newly built in Thaechon County, North Phyongan Province. The base,covering an area of over 10 000 square meters, is annually capable of producing tens of thousands of young mandarin fishes and other fries as their preys and release them in rivers and lakes. Installed with solar panels,the open-air fish ponds have full ecological environments and conditions suited to features of mandarin fish including piles of stones built in them. There are also a fodder fish pond and loach pond as well as a microbe producing ground which can make an effective use of excrements of domestic animals from stables. The fishing ponds are arranged in tiers and gravity-fed drainage system is introduced. So clean water can always flow into the ponds without the help of electric power. The county is now making scrupulous preparations for breeding mandarin fries as it has already secured breed mother mandarin fishes. Jang Jong Chol

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Guides Master Plans for Kanggye and Manpho Cities
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, examined and guided the master plans for Kanggye and Manpho cities together with leading officials of the Party, administrative and designing bodies in Jagang Province. Present there were Jo Yong Won, first vice department director of the Central Committee of the WPK, Kang Pong Hun, chairman of the Jagang Provincial Committee of the WPK, Ri Hyong Gun, chairman of the Jagang Provincial People's Committee, and Party and administrative officials in the province and cities and officials of the relevant fields including the Jagang Provincial Designing Institute. The Supreme Leader of the Party, the State and the armed forces, looking at the blueprints for Kanggye and Manpho cities and a model board showing their panoramic views, was briefed on the plans for the layout of cities before putting forth the tasks and ways for successfully sprucing up the cities as required by the era. He pointed out that as the city construction has been carried out in such a haphazard way as to fill vacant lots without any careful consideration, most of the buildings sprawled to make the cities look like architecture history museums. He said that the layout plan should specify a district of ideological education, industrial district, cultural district, etc. and maps showing the bird's eye view of the districts should be worked out and the construction carried out under an annual plan. It is very important to preserve local characters in city layout, he said, adding that the architectural layouts should be made in a scientific way to preserve local characters and structures peculiarly built in various forms to renew the appearance of the cities by learning from the experience gained in remodeling Samjiyon County into a model of modern mountainous city. Pointing to the poor afforestation of Kanggye City, the Supreme Leader said the afforestation and greening constitute an important work for providing the people with civilized living condition and environment. He stressed the need to plant various species of trees and create more green belts to harmonize with the mountainous region. What is most important in city construction is to thoroughly embody the principle of ensuring people’s convenience, he said, calling for overhauling minor power stations run by the province and cities to increase electricity production, and for making a good combination of electricity and geothermal energy and other natural energies to solve the issue of heating buildings, and for remarkably raising the water production capacity of reservoirs to ensure the daily water supply to each citizen on a high level. Good sewage disposal is vital to preventing the environmental pollution when building cities, he said, stressing the need to build sewerage scientifically, regularly operate sewage treatment facilities and thus strictly purify and treat industrial waste water and sewage. It is important to rapidly develop finishing materials in order to push forward the construction, the Supreme Leader said, calling on every province to set up well building-materials production bases in the province including cement factory, roofing tile factory and tile factory and vitalize production so as to ensure self production and provision of finishing building materials needed for the construction. In order to effect a drastic turn in the construction of local cities, it is important to strengthen the provincial designing forces, he pointed out, underlining the need to build in an integrated way the machinery of provincial designing institutions on the basis of deep study, fully provide good working and living conditions to them and push forward the work for training talented designers through cooperation between Pyongyang and provinces. He stressed the need for provincial, city and county party committees to wage the competitive campaign for giving a fundamental facelift to the provincial and county seats and cities to be suited to their specific characters in keeping with the present stirring reality where world-level monumental edifices mushroom across the country. Political News Team

title: Delegation of WPK Pyongyang City Committee Meets Russian Figure
body: The Russia-visiting delegation of the Pyongyang City Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) led by Kim Nung O, alternate member of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and chairman of the city committee, met and had a talk with Ivan Melinikov, first vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation and first deputy speaker of the State Duma, at the building of the State Duma on May 30. On the same day, the delegation met the first secretary of the Moscow City Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation. Rodong Sinmun

title: Vietnamese Delegation Here
body: A delegation of the Central Theory Council of the Communist Party of Vietnam headed by Vice-Chairman Ta Ngoc Tan arrived here on Friday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Posters Reflecting Revolutionary Spirit of Self-Reliance Published in DPRK
body: The Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House brought out posters arousing officials, Party members and other working people to the grand march of self-reliance. The poster "Eternal lifeline of our revolution!" reflects the truth that self-reliance is just the bedrock of the existence of Korean-style socialism, the motive power of its advance and development and the eternal lifeline essential to the destiny of the Korean revolution. The poster "Great upsurge in every worksite of socialist construction with self-reliance as treasured sword for prosperity!" represents the struggle of the working people who have turned out in an all-out death-defying campaign to effect world-startling miracles and make a greater leap. The poster "Let us all turn out in implementation of decision made at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 7th Party Central Committee!" ardently appeals to everyone to turn out in the grand march for creating the new Mallima speed, bearing deep in mind the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance. Rodong Sinmun

title: Congratulations to President-elect of Latvia
body: Choe Ryong Hae, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on May 30 sent a congratulatory message to Egils Levits, president-elect of the Republic of Latvia. The message wished the president-elect success in his responsible work for the country's prosperity and its people's wellbeing. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: A home-visiting group of students of Korean high schools in Japan headed by Kim Chan Uk, principal of Kanagawa Korean Middle and High School, visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill Friday. They laid bouquets and made a bow before the statues of the great leaders. Rodong Sinmun

title: South Korean Students' Group for
body: Studying Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un to Publish Study Results The south Korean internet newspaper Jaju Sibo reported on May 17 that reverence for Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un is getting more fervent in south Korea after the publication of the historic Panmunjom Declaration and the September Pyongyang Joint Declaration. According to the newspaper, the Progressive Federation of Students of south Korea inaugurated a group for studying Chairman of the State Affairs Commission Kim Jong Un and has made a deep study since early this year. The group in its announcement said that it would host the first meeting for publishing the results of the study in Seoul on June 8. Noting that the path toward independent reunification has been paved with the publication of the April 27 Panmunjom Declaration in 2018 as an occasion, the announcement said the reunification can be hastened only when south Koreans have good knowledge of the north, and that to this end, it is necessary to know well about Chairman Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Visits 250-Mile Journey for Learning Schoolchildren's Palace
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, provided field guidance to the 250-mile Journey for Learning Schoolchildren's Palace. True to the teachings and instructions given by the Supreme Leader on several occasions, Jagang Province built the five-storey main building housing more than 30 hobby group rooms and the multi-functional gym for holding art performance and an annex building in place of the old building that had been more than 50 years old. Since its inaugural ceremony in September 2016, the palace has been put on a normal operation. The Supreme Leader was reported about the accommodation of hobby group rooms of the palace and their operation from an official of the palace. Looking round several places of the palace including the gym and rooms for dancing group, table-tennis group, accordion group, Taekwon-do group, IT group and electronic musical instrument group, he learned about the renovation and operation of the palace. He said that technical designing of the gym and several hobby group rooms does not meet the mission and usage of the rooms. Noting that the palace has not been built in a charming way to meet the mission and usage as extracurricular educational facilities even though it was built with the use of great amounts of materials in place of the old building, he said that formalism, expediency and slipshod manner remain strong in the designing field despite lots of call for embodying the principle of "conveniences first". It does not mean that we have become richer than 10 and 20 years ago that our Party has given priority to the construction and renovation of schoolchildren's palaces, schoolchildren's halls, children's camps and schoolbag factories, the production of textbooks and notebooks and betterment of education conditions and environment while giving importance to the work for the future generations, he said, noting that our Party is set to do whatever it can do for the children at the highest level even though it is pressed hard for everything because how to bring up the future generations is a vital issue deciding the future destiny of our revolution. Saying that the construction and renovation of schoolchildren's palaces are now under way in other provinces, he said that it is necessary to set things right to prevent the similar inclination from happening in order to give real satisfaction to schoolchildren. He stressed that along with the construction of schoolchildren's palaces as all-purpose extracurricular education bases equipped with high level of all education conditions and environment, it is important to steadily improve the methods and forms of the operation of hobby groups, raise the responsibility and qualifications of teachers and conduct the campaign for swapping experience, overtaking and learning from others among schoolchildren's palaces in Pyongyang and in provinces so as to give broad knowledge of science and technology and art education relative to the grades and ages of children, and thus drastically improve the education level. He watched children of hobby group rooms of the palace, full of dream to grow up to be dependable pillars who would shoulder upon the future of the country, bringing into full bloom their creative talents through their hobby group activities, and had significant photos taken with them, blessing them bright future. He was accompanied by leading officials of the WPK Central Committee including Jo Yong Won, Yu Jin, Kim Yong Su and Hyon Song Wol and leading officials of the State Affairs Commission including Kim Chang Son and Ma Won Chun. Political News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Visits February 8 General Machine Factory
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, gave field guidance to February 8 General Machine Factory. The Supreme Leader of the Party, the State and the armed forces looked round the revolutionary museum. Recollecting with deep emotion October 28, 2011 when he visited the factory together with Chairman Kim Jong Il, he said that the employees of the factory should cherish the great devotion made by Kim Jong Il for the strengthening of the factory till the last period of his life, and take the lead in the nationwide drive by carrying forward the tradition of the factory which has upheld the Party with high production achievements out of loyalty. Being reported about the technological updating of the factory and the implementation of the production plan, he looked round production shops. Going along the streamlined production processes, the Supreme Leader stressed the need to introduce such processes a lot and ensure substantial control of labor and thus put the production going at a high level. He underlined the need to conduct ideological education of the employees of the factory in a substantive way with a main emphasis on the accomplishment of the revolutionary task, and to provide good working and living conditions. Even though the factory has made remarkable progress as against the past, we should not be contented with this, he said, calling for mapping out higher modernization plan to reflect the needs of the ever-changing times and steadily carrying it out on an annual basis. Saying that all the elements of the factory ranging from the production processes and sci-tech dissemination center to cultural hall should meet the modernity and requirement under the Party policies, the Supreme Leader called on the factory to set an example and generalize it across the country so that everyone can turn out with clear understanding of what the modernization intended by the Party is. Watching modern machine goods produced by the factory, he learned in detail about the performance and stressed the need to enhance the scientific level of the testing and measuring devices and put into force strict test system. Watching varieties of daily necessity goods produced by the workers of the factory, he spoke highly of producing various useful goods through effective use of idle and available materials in the local area. It is to his liking that the factory is alive with the drive for establishing cultured practice in production and living, he said, adding that the factories across the country should learn from the traits of this factory. Noting that he was greatly satisfied to look round the factory, he earnestly asked the factory officials to convey his regards to all the employees of the factory. He was accompanied by officials of the WPK Central Committee and the State Affairs Commission including Jo Yong Won, Yu Jin, Kim Yong Su, Hyon Song Wol, Kim Chang Son and Ma Won Chun. Political News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Gives Field Guidance to Phyongnam General Machine Plant
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, gave field guidance to the Phyongnam General Machine Plant. After looking round the room for the education in the revolutionary history, the Supreme Leader of the Party, the State and the armed forces made rounds of the general assembling workshop, combined processing workshop, sheet metal processing and pressing workshop and other places of the plant to learn in details about the first-phase updating and production. He said that it is necessary to enhance the speed of processing and assembling of the products and mass-produce machines by putting all the production processes on an automated and streamlined basis. He noted that the updating of the plant should lead to the improvement of quality of products. Now that the equipment of the processing workshops has been updated it is necessary to work hard to raise the level of skilled workers so as to considerably improve the quality of the processed goods, he pointed out. Noting that the Phyongnam General Machine Plant holds a very important place in the development of the national economy, he stressed again that the production processes should be updated on a higher level to meet the requirements of the Party policy to build a Juche-based and self-supporting plant which can turn out all sorts of machines and equipment at will so as to turn it into a model plant of machine-building industry in the new century. It is important to set right the problems that arose in the first-phase updating and, at the same time, put spurs to the second-phase updating to increase production capacity and turn out more machines to satisfy the needs of the country, he said. He said it is an important undertaking for giving full play to the zeal of the masses for production to take good care of the livelihood of the employees, adding that it is essential to manage and operate well the stock-breeding base, vegetable greenhouse and fishing base provided by the Party and thus supply meat, vegetables and fish to the employees on a regular basis so that they can keenly feel the loving care of the Party and work heart and soul for carrying out their revolutionary task. He was accompanied by Jo Yong Won, Hong Yong Chil, Yu Jin, Kim Yong Su, Hyon Song Wol, Kim Chang Son, Ma Won Chun and other leading officials of the Party Central Committee and the State Affairs Commission. Political News Team

title: Delegation of General Administration of Civil Aviation of DPRK Back Home
body: A delegation of the General Administration of Civil Aviation of the DPRK led by General Director Rim Kwang Ung returned home on Saturday after visiting China. Rodong Sinmun

title: Disabled Children Mark International Children's Day
body: A gathering of disabled children took place at the Taedonggang District Gymnasium in Pyongyang on Saturday, the International Children's Day. Present there were Jong Hyon, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Korean Federation for the Protection of the Disabled, officials concerned, disabled children, kindergarteners of Tongmun Kindergarten 2 in Taedonggang District and their teachers and parents, members of the European Union Programme Support here and foreign guests. A speech was made by Song Hyang Chun, director of the Korean Rehabilitation Centre for Children with Disability, before an art performance and sports and amusement games by disabled children and kindergarteners. Rodong Sinmun

title: New Stamps Issued
body: The State Stamp Bureau of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea recently issued new stamps (two sheets) dealing with the historic policy speech made by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Seen in the stamps centered on a red flag are letters reading "On Socialist Construction and the Internal and External Policies of the Government of the Republic at the Present Stage", the title of the policy speech, and "The First Session of the Fourteenth Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea April 12, Juche 108 (2019)". Rodong Sinmun

title: Joint Friendship Gathering Marks Int'l Children's Day
body: A joint friendship gathering took place at the Taesongsan Amusement Park on Saturday, the 69th anniversary of the International Children's Day. Attending it were Choe Hwi, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Thae Hyong Chol, vice-president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, Jon Kwang Ho, vice-premier of the Cabinet, Kim Sung Du, chairman of the Education Commission, Cha Hui Rim, chairman of the Pyongyang City People's Committee, and officials concerned, kindergarteners, kindergarten teachers and women here. Present there were diplomatic envoys, representatives of international bodies' missions and staff members of foreign embassies here, foreign children and women and other foreign guests and overseas compatriots staying in the homeland. Jang Chun Sil, chairwoman of the Central Committee of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea, in her address made at the gathering congratulated the Korean children and young foreign participants upon the June 1 International Children's Day. Amid the playing of the song "Flower Buds' Holiday", the children danced and did a rhythmic exercise to show their happiness and bright and cheerful appearances. Then sports and amusement games were held. After the games, the children had a pleasant time, having a circle dance and enjoying amusement facilities. Meanwhile, International Children's Day was marked in each province. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Players Prove Successful in Int'l Handball Game
body: DPRK players proved successful in the junior women's game and the juvenile women's game of the 2019 IHF Trophy Tournament East and Southeast Asia held in Taipei of China on May 26-30. The tournament brought together players from different countries and regions, including the DPRK, Vietnam and Hong Kong of China. In the junior and juvenile women's games, the DPRK players defeated all their rivals and overwhelmed the players of Taipei of China in the finals, bagging gold medals. They returned home on June 1. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to President of Azerbaijan
body: Choe Ryong Hae, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on May 28 sent a message of greeting to Ilham Aliyev, president of the Azerbaijan Republic on the occasion of its national day. Expressing the belief that the long-standing relations of friendship and cooperation between the two countries would grow stronger in conformity with the aspirations and desires of the two peoples, the message wished the Azerbaijani president bigger successes in his responsible work for the Azerbaijani people's prosperity and wellbeing. Rodong Sinmun

title: Congratulations to President of Malawi
body: Choe Ryong Hae, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on May 31 sent a congratulatory message to Arthur Peter Mutharika upon his re-election as president of the Republic of Malawi. The message wished the Malawian president happiness in good health and success in his responsible work for the country's stability and prosperity. Rodong Sinmun

title: Building Skill Contest Held in Samjiyon
body: A national contest of young skilful builders took place at the construction site to spruce Samjiyon County from May 5 to 30. During the contest, the young skilful builders selected from every provincial youth league organization plastered more than 20 000 sq meters of the inside and outside of buildings, did welding at over 7 000 spots, and installed formworks with the total length of at least 32 000 meters. The participants in the plastering contest from Pyongyang City, South Hamgyong Province, etc. plastered thousands of sq meters of the inside and outside of buildings on the first day. Welders from North Hwanghae, Jagang and other provinces qualitatively welded the roof of the Samjiyon County Conference Hall and dozens of steel structures. Woodworkers also shortened the time of formwork installation at the construction site of the Samjiyon Children's Camp, thus making contribution to overfulfilling daily plan. Young skilful builders invented and introduced valuable technical innovations and effective utensils and tools. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Enjoys Art Performance Given by KPA Officers' Wives
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, Sunday watched a performance given by amateur art groups of the wives of officers of units of the Korean People's Army (KPA) selected in the seventh round of the second-term contest of art groups of KPA officers' wives. The Supreme Leader of the Party, the State and the armed forces appeared in the auditorium together with his wife Ri Sol Ju. Among the audience were Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, first vice-chairman of the SAC of the DPRK and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, leading officials of the WPK Central Committee including Ri Man Gon, Pak Kwang Ho, Ri Su Yong, Kim Phyong Hae, Choe Hwi, An Jong Su, Pak Thae Dok, Pak Thae Song, Kim Yong Chol, Kim Su Gil and Kim Ki Nam, commanding officers of the KPA and creators and artistes of major art troupes. The performance was given by members of the amateur art groups of wives of the officers of the Fourth Corps and the Air and Anti-Aircraft Force of the KPA. The performers impressively represented the ideological and mental features of KPA officers' wives, who make every moment of their life honorable with ardent yearning for the leader and boundless loyalty to him, in such numbers as solo and pangchang "Yearning", chorus "Our Leader Loved by People", accordion ensemble and chorus "Our National Flag", chorus "Ardent Desire", instrumental trio ensemble "Beautiful Vapour Trail" and national instrumental ensemble "Our Socialism Is the Best in the World". The performance was highly acclaimed by the audience for successfully showing that the defence line of the country is impregnable as long as there is a large unit of women revolutionaries who bear in mind the great trust and expectation of the Party Central Committee and add dynamism to the revolution with love and devotion. At the end of the performance, Kim Jong Un called near to him the son of a pilot who sacrificed himself for combat duty and the child whom he named at a conference, and embraced them and wished them a happy future. He expressed great satisfaction over the fact that the members of amateur art groups of officers' wives gave an excellent performance of great ideological and artistic influence finely reflecting the Party policies on the basis of the Party's leadership exploits associated with the units and their real life. Stressing the importance of the performance of amateur art groups of officers' wives, which is strong in motive and appealing power, in the ideological and cultural construction of the Party, he praised their revolutionary and noble mental world and cultural attainments as the motive power of the revolution, model for the whole society and said that all the members of the society should live and work regarding officers' wives as a model. He expressed expectation that the wives of officers would bring the revolutionary and beautiful life put on the stage into fuller bloom at their posts as good elucidators and disseminators of the Party policies. Political News Team

title: Sports Contest for Pochonbo Torch Prize Opens
body: The Sports Contest for Pochonbo Torch Prize opened with due ceremony at the Hyesan Gymnasium on Sunday. The players will compete in over 30 events including football, basketball, volleyball, table-tennis and swimming, divided into junior and senior categories. Games will take place in Pyongyang, Phyongsong, Hamhung, Sariwon and Nampho from June 2 to 28. Present at the opening ceremony were officials of Ryanggang Province including Ri Sang Won, chairman of the Ryanggang Provincial Party Committee, sportspersons, working people, youth and students of the province. Rodong Sinmun

title: Body of DR Congo Introduces President Kim Il Sung's Love for Children
body: The National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of DR Congo posted on its website an article titled "The great man and children" illustrated with a portrait of smiling President Kim Il Sung on May 27 to mark the International Children's Day, June 1. The article said that the President loved children very much, telling stories about the President's noble outlook on the younger generation in the period of the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle and the post-national liberation years. It pointed out that the President called children the king of the country and found his joy in hearing their happy laughter. It went on: Saying that the best things should be given to children, the President saw to it that schoolchildren's palaces and children's camps were built in every good place and scenic spot of the country. Noting that the birth of triplets is a sign of the country's prosperity, he ensured that they were brought up under the care of the country. His loving care for them has been observed in his making time to see children's New Year performances despite his heavy schedule. Numerous are stories about the President's loving care for them. The President's profound love for the rising generations has been carried forward by Leader Kim Jong Il and by HE Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Work Introduced in Russia
body: The Russian paper Komsomolskaya Pravda on May 28 carried the full text of Chairman Kim Jong Il's work "Let Us Make Our Country, Our Motherland, Ever More Prosperous, True to the Great Leader Comrade Kim Il Sung's Intention" to mark the 55th anniversary of his start of work at the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. The work, published on December 31, Juche 83 (1994), indicates the tasks and ways to make the country, the motherland, ever more prosperous. Rodong Sinmun

title: Mallima Speed Movement Is Great Motive Force for Building Economic Power
body: In order to attain the goals set forth by the Party at an early date in the face of all sorts of hardships, we should push forward with the Mallima Speed Movement on all the fronts. The Mallima Speed Movement serves as an engine with which we can outpace the world in economic development by our own effort and our own technology, and all the fields and all the units can increase the offensive speed remarkably. The movement makes the whole country seethe with a struggle for new standards, records and miracles and helps develop the overall economic construction amid exchange of successes and experience and keen competition to outpace an advanced unit. The Party called for the movement. It seeks in this to quickly accelerate economic construction as well as to make everything of world-standard, which will be a model of the times and from which the people get benefits. We have a firm foundation and potentials to surely push ahead with the building of an economic giant. The grand Mallima march for building an economic giant is sure to win as there is the ever-victorious Workers’ Party of Korea that sets forth scientific lines and policies reflecting the requirement of the era and the developing revolution and leads socialist construction with veteran and experienced leadership. Yun Chol Hui, Kim Yong Il

title: World No Tobacco Day Observed
body: A seminar took place at the Grand People's Study House on Monday to mark World No Tobacco Day. Attending it were health workers, officials of relevant units, the UN resident coordinator in the DPRK, WHO acting representative, members of missions of international bodies and members of foreign embassies here. Speeches were made at the seminar. Speakers in the speeches titled "On nonsmoking campaign in our country" and "Tobacco and lung health" said that tobacco has a decisive impact on the outbreak of non-infectious diseases, and called for positive public awareness of nonsmoking campaign. They referred to the harmful effects of smoking on human health and socio-economic life, the importance of tobacco control and hygienic information service and other issues. The participants watched a video on the harm of tobacco before visiting the Non-smoking Research Center. On the same day, no-smoking information service was given at the hygienic information halls and preventive and curative medical care institutions in Pyongyang and provinces. Rodong Sinmun

title: WPK Pyongyang City Committee Delegation Back Home
body: A delegation of the Pyongyang City Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) led by Chairman Kim Nung O came back home on Monday after visiting Russia. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegates to Celebrations of Founding Anniversary of KCU Here
body: Participants in the celebrations of the 73rd founding anniversary of the Korean Children's Union (KCU) arrived here on Monday. When the trains with the participants from Kangwon, South Phyongan, South Hwanghae, Ryanggang, Jagang, North Hamgyong and other provinces arrived at Pyongyang Railway Station, Pak Chi Ung, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and officials of the Central Committee of the youth league greeted them. Schoolchildren and working people waved their hands to the buses carrying them towards their lodging quarters. Rodong Sinmun

title: Kim Jae Ryong Inspects Several Units
body: Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, member of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, inspected several units of the national economy including the Taean Heavy Machine Complex and the Woldang Co-op Farm in Sinwon County. Touring the complex, he stressed the need to make scrupulous economic organisation and command, steadily improve the techniques and skills of the workers and process parts of the generating equipment in a responsible manner. The consultative meeting discussed the issues of keeping equipment in full-capacity operation to unconditionally produce the ordered equipment in the period and on the level set by the Party. On the co-op farm, Kim Jae Ryong underlined the need to give correct assignments to the farmers as required by a field-responsibility-system within the framework of the subworkteam management system, make a scrupulous estimation of the fulfillment and do all the farm work in a scientific and technological way. He also inspected the Hasong Wheel Factory and the National IT Administration. Rodong Sinmun

title: President Kim Il Sung to Be Remembered in Switzerland
body: A Swiss remembrance committee for the 25th anniversary of demise of President Kim Il Sung was formed in Basel on May 25. Martin Lotscher, chairman of the Switzerland-Korea Committee, was elected as chairman of the remembrance committee. The committee-forming ceremony set a remembrance period from June 1 to July 9, and discussed and decided an action plan of the committee for giving wide publicity to the exploits of the President and organizing political and cultural events including a remembrance meeting and film show. Rodong Sinmun

title: Mongolian Bodies Support Korean People's Struggle
body: The Mongolia-Democratic Korea Friendship Bridge Association and the Mongolian Committee for Supporting the June 15 North-South Joint Declaration on May 27 made public a joint statement in support of the appeal issued by the Latin American and Caribbean Regional Committee to Support the Reunification of Korea. The statement said that thanks to the bold decision and will of Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, the Panmunjom Declaration and the June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement were adopted last year. This was a turning point of great significance in improving inter-Korean relations, achieving reunification of the Korean peninsula and ensuring global peace and security, the statement noted. It stressed that the Mongolian bodies will conduct brisk solidarity activities to support the Korean people in their efforts for establishing a permanent peace mechanism by making good use of a peaceful atmosphere prevailing over the Korean peninsula and for achieving reunification and prosperity under the uplifted banner of national independence. Rodong Sinmun

title: Grand Mass Gymnastics and Artistic Performance Opens
body: The grand gymnastics and artistic performance "The Land of the People" was held with due ceremony at the May Day Stadium on Monday. Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, enjoyed the grand gymnastics and artistic performance. The Supreme Leader of the Party, the State and the armed forces appeared at the auditorium together with his wife Ri Sol Ju. The Supreme Leader waved back to the enthusiastically cheering masses for a long time. Enjoying the performance were Ri Man Gon, Pak Kwang Ho, Ri Su Yong, Kim Phyong Hae, Choe Hwi, An Jong Su, Pak Thae Song, Kim Yong Chol, Jo Yong Won, Kim Yo Jong, Ri Yong Sik, Hyon Song Wol, Kwon Hyok Bong, Jang Ryong Sik, Pak Chun Nam and other leading officials of the Party and government and Pyongyang citizens. Also enjoying it were overseas compatriots and foreign guests staying here. Pak Chun Nam, minister of Culture, made an opening address. The performance began with the title of "The Land of the People" shining in the nocturnal sky above the capital city. The performers showed beautiful and graceful rhythmic movements, high-spirited gymnastics, interesting national emotion and rich artistic depiction and large kaleidoscopic background stand. At the end of the performance all the performers and the audience broke into cheers of "hurrah!" again, looking up to the Supreme Leader, and fireworks were displayed in the nocturnal sky above the capital city. The Supreme Leader extended his warm greetings to the performers, expressing thanks for their performance. After the performance he called creators of the performance and seriously criticized them for their wrong spirit of creation and irresponsible work attitude, pointing to the contents and forms of the performance. Noting that the creators and artistes in the literature and art sector have a very important duty in socialist cultural construction, he set forth important tasks for correctly implementing the revolutionary policy of our Party on literature and art. Political News Team

title: Pottery Kiln Site Unearthed in Rason City
body: True to the Party’s intention of enriching the treasure house of the heritage of the national culture, in recent years our archeologists have striven energetically to excavate historic relics. Meanwhile, the scientists of the Archeological Institute of the Academy of Social Sciences, together with the researchers of the Rason City Agency for Preserving the National Heritage, dug out a pottery kiln site in the Rajin area of Rason City, or on the southern slope of the right peak of the Sagi Valley 10km northwest of Muchang-dong. At present nothing but a kiln and a chimney remains at the pottery kiln site. The site contained pieces of pottery, props and bricks. The investigation shows that the site belonged to the rule of the feudal Joson dynasty. The site eloquently testifies to the creative ability of our sagacious and intelligent ancestors. Jang Chol Man, Doctor of Archeological Institute of the Academy of Social Sciences

title: Delegation of Central Public Prosecutors Office Leaves for China
body: A delegation of the Central Public Prosecutors Office led by Director Kim Myong Gil left here on Tuesday to visit China. Rodong Sinmun

title: WPK Central Committee Officials Visit Schoolchildren's Lodging Quarters
body: Officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) visited the lodging quarters of delegates to the celebrations of the 73rd founding anniversary of the Korean Children's Union (KCU) on Tuesday evening. Department Director Ri Il Hwan and other officials of the WPK Central Committee and youth league officials congratulated the delegates participating in the celebrations. Learning about the conditions of the accommodations of the delegates, they requested the delegates to bear deep in mind the trust and expectation of the Party and the country and become pillars of prosperous Korea who are knowledgeable, virtuous and healthy. Rodong Sinmun

title: Foreign Bodies Support Korean People's Struggle
body: British and Ethiopian organizations released statements on May 22 and 27 to mark the first anniversary of the adoption of the historic June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement. The British Association for the Study of Songun Policy, the British Group for the Study of the Juche Idea, the Korean Friendship Association UK and the British Solidarity Committee for Peace and Reunification of the Korean Peninsula in their joint statement said that the adoption of the June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement gave hope and expectation for peace to the world people. The DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement clarified that the two countries would commit themselves to establish new bilateral relations as desired by their peoples and make joint efforts to build a durable and solid peace mechanism on the Korean Peninsula, they noted. They urged the U.S. to withdraw its hostile policy towards the DPRK and make efforts to build a new peace mechanism on the Korean peninsula. The Confederation of Taekwon-do of Ethiopia in its statement said that the sincere implementation of the June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement is the only way of ensuring peace and security in the Korean peninsula and the rest of the world. It noted that the U.S. should honestly take practical measures suited to the sincere and positive efforts of the DPRK to implement the joint statement. We will more dynamically conduct the solidarity movement for supporting the Korean people together with the world's progressives, it added. Rodong Sinmun

title: Home-visiting Group of Koreans in Japan Arrives
body: A home-visiting group of Koreans in Japan led by Kang Chol Sik, chairman of the Fukuoka Prefectural Commercial Association of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan, arrived here on Tuesday. Rodong Sinmun
