body: Delegates to the celebrations of the 73rd founding anniversary of the Korean Children's Union laid a floral basket and bouquets and made a bow before the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on Tuesday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Just Cause of Korean People Supported Abroad
body: The Romania-Korea Friendship Association released a statement on May 24 on the occasion of the "period of the international action for peace, prosperity and reunification of the Korean peninsula". The statement said that the adoption of the April 27 Panmunjom Declaration was warmly welcomed by all the Koreans and other peace-loving people of the world. It noted that the Panmunjom Declaration heralded a new start of the north-south relations and opened a new era of peace and prosperity. A genuine peace on the Korean peninsula can be realized only when the historic inter-Korean declarations are thoroughly implemented, it said. It stated that the south Korean authorities should honestly implement the inter-Korean declarations in response to the sincere appeal of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea for national independence and self-determination and great unity of the nation. It expressed the belief that the Korean people will defend peace and security on the Korean peninsula and surely achieve the cause of national reunification under the seasoned leadership of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. The Guinea-Korea Friendship and Solidarity Association released a statement on May 27 in support of the appeal issued by the Latin American and Caribbean Regional Committee to Support the Reunification of Korea. It expressed the support for the historic April 27 Panmunjom Declaration reflecting the firm stand of national independence. The Panmunjom Declaration is, indeed, the reunification programme as it indicates the path of peace, prosperity and independent reunification aspired by the Korean nation, it stated, adding: The adoption of the June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement was a historic event as it gave the hope to all the peace-loving people in the world. We extend a firm solidarity to the Korean people in their struggle for peace and security on the Korean peninsula. Rodong Sinmun

title: Many People Visit Pochonbo
body: Chairman Kim Jong Il led a squad of the first visitors to the revolutionary battle sites around Mt Paektu and arrived in Pochonbo in June 1956. He looked round its revolutionary battle site of capital importance in the history of our Party and gave earnest instructions to build it into a monumental place. Throughout the Korean revolution our people, servicepersons, young people, college and university students and middle schoolchildren have incessantly joined him generation after generation to visit the revolutionary battle site in Pochonbo. They have so far totaled up to more than 21,660,000 for 6-odd decades, enrolled in over 480,000 different organizations. They have so far followed the route of the march made by the main force of the Korean People’s Revolutionary Army and toured a post used by President Kim Il Sung to command the force’s fierce battle against the Japanese invaders in Pochonbo and its relevant fields as well, enshrining his outstanding command art and the historic importance of the battle deeply in their hearts. In addition, they have held meetings on various themes in Pochonbo to learn the revolutionary spirit of Mt Paektu and its blizzards from the KPRA soldiers. Meanwhile, large numbers of overseas Koreans and foreigners, too, have visited the revolutionary battle site in Pochonbo. O Mun Il

title: Press Statement of Spokesperson for Ministry of Foreign Affairs of DPRK
body: A spokesman for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea released the following press statement on Tuesday: The DPRK-U.S. summit meeting and talks held in Singapore in June last year for the first time in history was a momentous occasion of great significance in promoting peace and stability on the Korean peninsula and in the region and advancing the historic trend of reconciliation and cooperation. The June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement adopted at the DPRK-U.S. summit meeting and talks enjoyed full support and approval of all countries and peoples across the world, as it proved in practice that even the countries with the most hostile relations could lay out an avenue for establishing new relations once they make politically decisive steps to defend peace and stability, giving these issues a top priority. As is acknowledged by the international society at large, the government of the DPRK has exerted ceaseless efforts over the past year to establish new DPRK-U.S. relations, build a lasting and stable peace regime on the Korean peninsula and achieve denuclearization of the Korean peninsula, as has been stipulated in the June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement, and also made every possible endeavor such as taking practical initiatives that require strategically decisive measures. However, it is regrettable to see that the United States has become ever more undisguised during the past year in its scheme to annihilate us by force while deliberately turning its face away from the implementation of the DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement and only insisting on our unilateral surrender of nuclear weapons. At the second DPRK-U.S. summit talks held in Hanoi amid the great interest and expectation of the entire world, the United States made the biggest mistake of having missed a lifetime opportunity by insisting on "dismantlement of the nuke first." This overshadows the future of the DPRK-U.S. talks. Had the United States done anything of a little help in addressing the issues on the basis of serious position and sincere attitude for implementing the DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement, the issue of denuclearization of the Korean peninsula might also have seen much progress. In his historic policy speech, Comrade Chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea said that given the persistence of deep-rooted hostility between the DPRK and the U.S., it is necessary for implementation of the June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement that both sides give up their unilateral demands and find a constructive solution which would meet each other's interest. And he said that to this end, it is requisite for the U.S. to fold its current method of calculation and approach us with a new one. The June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement is the commitment which the two countries have pledged to the world and the humankind, and it is the task both sides should be jointly accountable for. The DPRK remains unchanged in its stand and will to cherish and implement in good faith the June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement personally signed by the supreme leaders of the DPRK and the U.S. at the first-ever DPRK-U.S. summit talks. However, if the U.S., a dialogue partner, fails to carry out its obligation and keeps resorting to anti-DPRK hostile policy, the fate of the June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement will not be promising. Whether the June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement will remain effective or turn out to be a mere blank sheet of paper will now be determined by how the U.S. would respond to our fair and reasonable stand. Nearly one year now since the declaration of the historic June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement, the U.S. should duly look back on the past one year and cogitate about which will be a correct strategic choice before it is too late. The U.S. would be well-advised to change its current method of calculation and respond to our request as soon as possible. There is a limit to our patience. Rodong Sinmun

title: Gift to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Central Theory Council of CPV
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a gift from the Central Theory Council of the Communist Party of Vietnam (CPV). The gift was conveyed to Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, by Ta Ngoc Tan, vice-chairman of the council, who is on a visit to the DPRK as the head of the delegation of the council, on Wednesday. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Players Prove Successful in International Games
body: DPRK players proved successful in the Women's Canoe Cup of ICF held in Hungary on May 18 and 19. The game brought together at least 60 players from 16 countries including the DPRK, China, Indonesia and Germany and regions. DPRK player Ko Haeng Bok finished first at the senior women's canoeing single-seater 200m game. She, together with O Su Rim, placed second and third at the senior women's canoeing double 500m and 200m games respectively. The DPRK players returned home on Wednesday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegates to Celebrations of KCU Anniversary Visit Mangyongdae
body: The delegates to the celebrations of the 73rd founding anniversary of the Korean Children's Union (KCU) toured Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. They visited the Mangyongdae Revolutionary Museum and looked round the historical mementoes preserved at the old home of the President. They climbed Mangyong Hill to go round study and wrestling sites, etc. where the President cherished a lofty idea of revolution and trained his will. They also visited the Youth Movement Museum. They entered the general review hall to place bouquets at the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il who are among young people and to bow to them. They saw the photos and historical data and mementoes of the undying feats of Kim Il Sung, Kim Jong Il and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. The other legs of their tour were the Sci-Tech Complex, the National Exhibition of Children's Science Fictions and Models, Central Class Education House, etc. and they had a good time at the Rungna Dolphinarium. Rodong Sinmun

title: 6th National Children's Football Tournament Closes
body: The 6th National Children's Football Tournament closed with due ceremony. Men's and women's finals were held in the playground of the Songdowon International Children's Camp on Wednesday. The Kangwon provincial men's team and the South Phyongan provincial women's team finished the first in the tournament. The finals were followed by a closing ceremony. It was attended by Pak Jong Nam, chairman of the Kangwon Provincial Party Committee, the youth league officials, players and campers. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Reunification Institute Issues Detailed Report on Struggle to Dissolve LKP
body: The National Reunification Institute made public on Wednesday a detailed report on the daily-escalated struggle of broad popular masses throughout south Korea for the dissolution of the "Liberal Korea Party" (LKP) of south Korea. The detailed report said that LKP has been cursed, denounced and rejected by the south Korean people for its treacherous and unpopular nature, fascist disposition and unpardonable crimes against the history and nation since its ancestor "Liberal Party". The report continued: Remnants of the fascist dictatorial party and its descendants renamed the party the "Democratic Republican Party", "Democratic Justice Party", "Democratic Liberal Party", "New Korea Party", "Grand National Party", etc. in succession in order to escape the stern trial by the people and prolong their remaining days, and they dampened the desire of the people for independence, democracy and reunification and tried to make south Korea a land where sycophancy, treachery, fascism and anti-reunification acts stalk, but they could not spare themselves the resistance and punishment. This year, the climate to reject LKP has gained further momentum among south Koreans from all walks of life. In particular, the people's anger erupted occasioned by the reckless remarks about May 18 uprising made by the traitors of the LKP in February. In March the struggle swept across south Korea including not only Kwangju and Seoul but also Taejon, Kyonggi Province, Kangwon Province of south Korea and Jeju Island. Candlelight rallies and citizens' rallies demanding the disbandment of the LKP were held even in Pusan and Taegu areas called the origin of the party, throwing the conservative group into confusion. The campaign for the dissolution of the LKP has been given a shot in the arm on the occasion of the fifth anniversary of the ferry Sewol disaster to become widespread, assuming popular nature with each passing day. It is joined by whoever loves justice and hates injustice ranging from primary school students, workers, students, housewives to the elderly in their 70s, to say nothing of organizations of a broad spectrum of people like the Solidarity for People's Sovereignty, May 18 Memorial Foundation, April 16 Solidarity, Confederation of Trade Unions, South Side Committee for Implementing June 15 Joint Declaration, Citizens' Solidarity to Denounce "Liberal Korea Party", People's Joint Action and People's Action for Peace against War. Candlelight gatherings and demonstrations take place in front of the headquarters of the "National Assembly" and the "Liberal Korea Party" and the building of the Supreme Court and at Chonggye Square and Kwanghwamun Plaza in Seoul and in other places. And there are a series of press conferences, free speech forums, presentations of writings and art performances to lay bare the crimes committed by the LKP and arouse people to an all-out resistance for the dissolution of the LKP. And the struggle for the dissolution of the LKP has taken up more colorful forms and methods day by day including raid on the building of the party, wreath-sending, pouring water and pelting with rubbish. The struggle for the disbandment of the LKP has now become the second candlelight demonstration to strangle the last windpipe of the LKP, the report said, stressing that it is the inevitability of history that the LKP is destined to be ruined, severely punished by the people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Ri Su Yong Meets Vietnamese Delegation
body: Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, met and had a talk with a delegation of the Central Theory Council of the Communist Party of Vietnam headed by Vice-Chairman Ta Ngoc Tan that paid a courtesy call on him on Wednesday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Still Other Fulfillers of Their Plan for the Five-Year Strategy
body: Still other workteams of the Komdok Mining Complex carried out their production assignments for the five-year strategy for national economic development ahead of schedule. They are the Hero Pak Thae Son Workteam of the Yonggwang Pit of its Kumgol Mine and the Choe Yong Chol Tunneling Workteam of Pit 2 of its pit construction enterprise. The Hero Pak Thae Son Workteam aimed at fulfilling its annual work plan twofold every year. When other workteams were reluctant to work in a pit owing to its adverse mining conditions the workteam volunteered to do do and met its daily production quotas by over 200% every day, applying novel rational drilling methods. As a consequence, it produced yet more ore than before monthly. This finally led to its topping its production plan for the five-year strategy on the occasion of the Day of the Shining Star (February 16, 1942). The Choe Yong Chol Tunneling Workteam, too, executed its tunneling plan for the five-year plan late last April ahead of set time. This manifestly demonstrates with what great loyalty and fortitude the heroic Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist workers and Mallima (a legendary horse of Korea which gallops 4,000km a day) vanguards of Korea have worked hard, invariably true to the plan and intention of the WPK. Ri Chol Ok

title: An Indoor Stadium Newly Built
body: Under the Party’s policy of making sports mass-based and part of people’s daily life Onsong County newly built an indoor stadium, a popular sporting complex, in less than a year. The indoor stadium covers an area of more than 1,500㎡ in total. It is well-furnished enough to enable basketball, volleyball, tennis, ping-pong and small-sized football to be played and physical training to be taken. Working people, youth, students and children in the county fully enjoy various sports activities in the indoor stadium, making themselves healty in body and mind. Ri Un Nam

title: The Fruit of Self-reliance
body: The abdominal surgeons of the North Hwanghae Provincial People’s Hospital contrived and made LED DC celioscopic equipment anew for themselves. It proves very effective in medical treatment. It was highly appreciated at the National Exhibition of Sci-Tech Achievements in Public Health-2018. Sin Kyong Sop

title: Birthday Party Held for Delegates to Celebrations of KCU Founding Anniversary
body: Birthday spreads were sent to delegates to the celebrations of the 73rd founding anniversary of the Korean Children's Union (KCU). Present at the meeting for congratulating delegates on their birthdays were more than 70 KCU members including Choe Su Hyang, pupil at Nampho Revolutionary School, and Pak Se Gwang, pupil at Pukchong Junior Middle School in Pukchong County. Pak Chol Min, chairman of the Central Committee of the youth league, made an address at the meeting held at April 25 Hotel on Thursday evening. He extended warm congratulation to the delegates who received birthday spreads under the care of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un on behalf of parents in their native places, school teachers and close comrades. He said that the birthday spreads the delegates received are associated with profound loving care of Kim Jong Un who spares nothing for the KCU members. He called upon the KCU members to grow to be competent revolutionary talents of the future who are knowledgeable, virtuous and healthy and push ahead with socio-political activities and do-good-thing movement. Rodong Sinmun

title: Art Performance Given to Celebrate KCU Founding Anniversary
body: An art performance "Three Million Members of KCU Grow under DPRK's Flag" was given at the Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace on Thursday, the 73rd founding anniversary of the Korean Children's Union (KCU). Among the audience were Choe Hwi, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Pak Chol Min, chairman of the youth league Central Committee, officials concerned, officials of the youth league, delegates to the celebrations of the KCU founding anniversary, students of Mangyongdae Revolutionary School. The performance began with prologue "Our Holiday of KCU Glorified by Marshal". Put on the stage were male solo and chorus "He Wears Necktie of KCU", dance and story "KCU Badge Shines Today" and other numbers. The performers gave an impressive depiction of boundless thanks to Generalissimos Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il who laid a firm foundation of the Juche-oriented juvenile movement and devoted their all to the bright future of the rising generation. Female chorus "Our Generous Sun", real-story telling "We Have Father" and other numbers showed the fatherly love of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un who puts forward the KCU members who envy nothing in the world. The performers put on the stage the numbers showing bright and merry schoolchildren who study to their heart's content and bring their talents into fuller bloom under the advantageous socialist education system. Rodong Sinmun

title: KCU Members Celebrate Its Founding Anniversary
body: The members of the Korean Children's Union (KCU) across the country significantly celebrated its 73rd founding anniversary. They laid floral baskets and bouquets before the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in various parts of the country and paid tribute to them. Provincial, city and county joint meetings of KCU organizations took place on the occasion of its 73rd founding anniversary. KCU members vowed to be true sons and daughters of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and ardent young revolutionaries, who are knowledgeable, virtuous and healthy and always ready for the socialist country. The National Symphony Orchestra gave a concert at the Moranbong Theatre in Pyongyang. Art performances were given by schoolchildren in various places of the country including Hamhung Square, Kaesong Schoolchildren's Palace and Songdowon Youth Open-Air Theatre. Sports and amusement games of KCU members took place at schools for orphans, junior middle schools and primary schools of the country including Pyongyang Primary School for Orphans, Pyongyang Middle School for Orphans, Songyo Junior Middle School in Songyo District and Chongryu Primary School in Taedonggang District. Laughter of joy and optimism of schoolchildren broke out at the Central Zoo, Kaeson Youth Park and other recreation grounds that day. Rodong Sinmun

title: Joint National Meeting of KCU Organizations Held
body: There was a joint national meeting of the organizations of the Korean Children's Union (KCU) at the plaza of the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on Thursday, the 73rd founding anniversary of the KCU Attending the meeting were delegates to the celebrations of the 73rd founding anniversary of the KCU, students of Mangyongdae Revolutionary School and Kang Pan Sok Revolutionary School and schoolchildren in Pyongyang. Present there on invitation were Choe Hwi, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Kim Nung O, chairman of the Pyongyang City Party Committee, Jon Kwang Ho, vice-premier of the Cabinet, Kim Sung Du, chairman of the Education Commission, officials concerned and officials of the youth league. The participants made a bow to the portraits of smiling Generalissimos Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il. Pak Chol Min, chairman of the Central Committee of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League, in his report, said that the road covered by the KCU is associated with the deep loving care of the great Generalissimos who set forth the slogan of the KCU as required by the era and revolution and trained the KCU members as masters of the future. All the KCU members grow to be reliable pillars of socialist Korea thanks to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. The reporter called upon all the KCU members to hold in high esteem the great Generalissimos as the Sun of Juche with loyalty and prepare themselves to be young revolutionaries who firmly believe in and follow only Kim Jong Un always and anywhere. Then speeches were made. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of Central Theory Council of CPV Visits Mangyongdae
body: A delegation of the Central Theory Council of the Communist Party of Vietnam headed by Vice-Chairman Ta Ngoc Tan visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. The visitors made rounds of historical mementoes preserved at the old home of the President, being briefed on the fact that he was born in the patriotic and revolutionary family and nurtured the great intention to liberate the country. They toured the Tower of the Juche Idea, the Monument to Party Founding, the Korean Revolution Museum, the Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace, Pyongyang Teacher Training College, etc. Rodong Sinmun

title: Foreign Organizations and Figure Support Korean People's Struggle
body: Ugandan organizations and a Kuwaiti personage on May 29 expressed support for the appeal issued by the Latin American and Caribbean Regional Committee to Support the Reunification of Korea. The Ugandan National Executive Committee of the Pan-African Movement and the Ugandan National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea said in a joint statement that the adoption of the Panmunjom Declaration and the June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement gave great hope to the global progressive mankind desirous of peace and prosperity. The joint statement expressed the will to further intensify the solidarity movement for supporting the struggle of the Korean people for peace, prosperity and reunification. Javid Ahmad, chairman of the Kuwaiti Committee for Supporting Korea's Reunification, noted in a statement that after the adoption of the Panmunjom Declaration and the June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement by the bold decision and will of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un for defending peace, a peace-oriented current was created on the Korean peninsula which was the biggest hot spot, and a new era of national reconciliation, peace and prosperity opened. I fully support the efforts of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea to make the Korean peninsula durable and solid peace zone, he said, adding: If the south Korean authorities really hope the improvement of the north-south relations, they should honestly implement the Panmunjom Declaration. The June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement adopted at the DPRK-U.S. summit meeting and talks is a historic one and the U.S. should drastically change its policy towards the DPRK to implement the statement. I extend firm solidarity to the Korean people advancing despite the hostile forces' moves against the DPRK under the banner of independence. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Published in Russia
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us Brilliantly Accomplish the Revolutionary Cause of Juche, Holding the Great Comrade Kim Jong Il in High Esteem as the Eternal General Secretary of Our Party" was brought out in booklet by the Nakhodka Format Publishing House on May 30 on the occasion of the 55th anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's start of work at the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. The work, published on April 6, Juche 101 (2012), says it is a principled requirement for the victorious advance of the Korean revolution to hold Kim Jong Il in high esteem as the eternal general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea. It also indicates the tasks for steadily developing the WPK into the glorious party of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Exploits in Party Building Introduced in Russia
body: Russian newspapers dedicated special write-ups to the 55th anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's start of work at the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea on May 28 and 30. They carried such articles as the one titled "Kim Jong Il, his undying exploits in party building" illustrated with his smiling image. The Komsomolskaya Pravda said in an article that Kim Jong Il started his work at the Central Committee of the WPK on June 19, 1964. Through the period of leading the WPK, he set it as the most important task to build the party into the leader's party and creditably carried it out, the article noted. It stated that he put forward the Juche idea founded by President Kim Il Sung as the only guiding ideology of the WPK, and declared it as the party's highest programme to model the whole society on Kimilsungism. Under his wise leadership, the WPK consolidated the single-hearted unity of the leader, party and masses as firm as a rock and fully displayed its might as befits the invincible party guiding the cause of socialism to victory, it said. It stressed that his undying exploits in party building will be resplendent for ever along with socialist Korea that makes ceaseless progress. The Nakhodkinski Rabochi said in an article that Kim Jong Il had a clear view on how to build a socialist ruling party, and developed the WPK into the genuine motherly party that fulfills responsibility for the destiny of the people. It is too natural that the Korean people call the party as the motherly party boundlessly trusting in and following it, the article stressed. Rodong Sinmun

title: Meeting Held at Korean University
body: A meeting to mark the 60th anniversary of the ribbon-cutting ceremony of a new building of Korean University took place at the hall of the university in Tokyo on June 1. Attending the meeting were Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon); Pak Ku Ho, its vice-chairman; Kang Chu Ryon, its vice-chairwoman and concurrently chairwoman of the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Democratic Korean Women in Japan; Han Tong Song, rector of the university, and deans of the university faculties; Hong Nam Gi, chairman of the board of directors of the university; officials of the central organizations and its affiliates, and students and teachers of the university. Introduced there were congratulatory messages from the Education Commission of the DPRK and universities of the homeland including Kim Il Sung University. Ho Jong Man made a congratulatory speech. Recalling that a modern building of the university was built in June 1959, the speaker said that the university has won fame with the development into supreme faculty of national education and seat of science under the meticulous guidance and loving care of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. He stressed that Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un leads Korean University to a dignified university of the DPRK as required by the times. Han Tong Son made a report. A letter to Marshal Kim Jong Un was read out there. On the same day an art performance was given by students and teachers of the university and a congratulatory reception was given. Rodong Sinmun

title: Talks Held between Ministers of DPRK and Russia
body: Talks were held between Kim Yong Jae, minister of External Economic Relations who is chairman of the DPRK side to the DPRK-Russia Intergovernmental Committee for Cooperation in Trade, Economy, Science and Technology, and Alexandr Kozlov, minister of Development of the Far East and Arctic of the Russian Federation who is chairman of the Russian side to the committee at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Friday. Present at the talks from the DPRK side were Ri Kwang Gun, vice-minister of External Economic Relations, and officials concerned and from the opposite side were the party of the minister of Development of the Far East and Arctic of the Russian Federation, Alexandr Matsegora, Russian ambassador to the DPRK, and members of his embassy. The talks discussed matters of further revitalizing the work of the DPRK-Russia Intergovernmental Committee for Cooperation in Trade, Economy, Science and Technology and putting the equally-beneficial economic and trade relations between the two countries on a higher stage. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Gift from Russian Figure
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a gift from Alexandr Kozlov, minister of Development of the Far East and Arctic of the Russian Federation. The gift was conveyed to Kim Yong Jae, minister of External Economic Relations, on Friday by Alexandr Kozlov on a visit to the DPRK. Rodong Sinmun

title: Pak Pong Ju Meets Russian Figures
body: Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, met with Minister of Development of the Far East and Arctic of the Russian Federation Alexandr Kozlov and his party who paid a courtesy call on him on Friday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Kim Jae Ryong Meets Russian Figures
body: Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, member of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and premier of the Cabinet, had a talk with Minister of Development of the Far East and Arctic of the Russian Federation Alexandr Kozlov and his party who paid a courtesy call on him at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Friday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Vietnamese Delegation Leaves
body: A delegation of the Central Theory Council of the Communist Party of Vietnam headed by Vice-Chairman Ta Ngoc Tan left here for home on Friday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Fictions and Models - 2019 Held
body: The National Exhibition of Children's Science Fictions and Models - 2019 took place at the Sci-Tech Complex from June 3 to 7 to mark the 73rd anniversary of the foundation of the Korean Children's Union. Presented to it are more than 400 works such as science fictions and models created by schoolchildren. Over 100 exhibits including science fiction "Invisible bullet-proof wall" and scientific fictitious model "Hub of natural energy" were highly appreciated. Pyongyang city came first in the team standings. A closing ceremony took place on Friday. Rodong Sinmun

title: KCU Delegates Visit Various Places of Pyongyang
body: The delegates to the celebrations of the 73rd founding anniversary of the Korean Children's Union (KCU) spent their time in Pyongyang. They visited the Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery on Mt Taesong and the Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace. They also toured the Natural History Museum and the Central Zoo. They enjoyed the grand gymnastics and artistic performance "The Land of the People" at the May Day Stadium and had a pleasant time at the Kaeson Youth Park, the Rungna People's Pleasure Park and the Munsu Water Park. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Congratulatory Messages
body: and Letters from Foreign Countries Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received congratulatory messages and letters from different countries on the occasion of the third anniversary of his election as chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). The congratulatory messages and letters came from the chairman of the Socialist Party of Romania, the chairman of the Supreme Council of the National Socialist Party of Romania, the chairwoman of the Party for Peace and Unity of Russia, the general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party-21 of the Czech, the general secretary and the international secretary of the Central Committee of the New Yugoslav Communist Party, the chairman of the Ugandan National Executive Committee of the Pan-African Movement, the Central Committee of the Democratic Workers' Party of Spain, the director of the International Department of the Socialist Workers' Party of Croatia, the international secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the People of Spain and other senior personages of political and public circles and representatives of organizations for the study of the Juche idea and organizations for friendship in Russia, Germany, Belarus, Switzerland, Spain, Uganda and Ecuador. Rodong Sinmun

title: Russian Figures Leave
body: Minister of Development of the Far East and Arctic of the Russian Federation Alexandr Kozlov and his party left here for home on Saturday. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Government Delegation Leaves for Nigeria
body: A delegation of the government of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea headed by Ri Ryong Nam, vice-premier of the Cabinet, left here on Saturday to take part in the celebrations of the "Day of Democracy" of the Federal Republic of Nigeria. Rodong Sinmun

title: Nepalese Organizations Issue Joint Statement
body: Nepalese organizations released a joint statement on May 30 on the occasion of the "period of the international action for peace, prosperity and reunification of the Korean peninsula". They included the Nepal-Korea Friendship Association, the Nepal Journalist Association, the Afro-Asian People's Solidarity Committee of Nepal, the Nepalese Committee for Promotion of Reunification of Korea, the Nepalese Association for Supporting the Songun Politics, the Study Forum for Self-Reliance of Nepal, the Nepali Literary Forum for the Study of Songun Politics, the National Press Club of Nepal and the Socialist Journalist Forum of Nepal for the Study of the Juche Idea. The statement underscored the historic significance of the April 27 Panmunjom Declaration and the June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement adopted thanks to the outstanding political ability and bold decision of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, and said that the authorities of south Korea and the U.S. should honestly implement them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Work Introduced in DR Congo
body: The National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of DR Congo posted the full text of Chairman Kim Jong Il's work "Let Us Reunify the Country Independently and Peacefully through the Great Unity of the Entire Nation" on its website on June 4. The work, published on April 18, Juche 87 (1998), clarifies the five-point policy for great national unity which serves as important guidelines for achieving the great unity of the entire nation. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Work Published in Russia
body: Chairman Kim Jong Il's work "The Workers' Party of Korea Is the Party of the Great Leader Comrade Kim Il Sung" was brought out in pamphlet by the Leto-Print Publishing House of Russia with due ceremony on June 3. The work, published on October 2, Juche 84 (1995), is a great programme for the party building and activities as it reviews with pride the glorious history of the Workers' Party of Korea which hewed out a new path of building a revolutionary party in the era of independence under the leadership of President Kim Il Sung and indicates the road of developing the party into his party forever. Rodong Sinmun

title: S. Korean Newspaper Sneers at LKP
body: The Kyunghyang Daily News of south Korea on June 5 carried an article saying the "Liberal Korea Party" (LKP) was stigmatized as "foul language political party". It said that the LKP surely turned into "foul language political party" in 100 days of Hwang Kyo An's seizure of the seat of the representative of the LKP. The slander of the May 18 Kwangju Popular Uprising and the remarks belittling the ferry Sewol disaster were the foreshower and the party top-ranking officials including the floor leader and the secretary general made one reckless remark after another, it added. It noted that it is Hwang who turned LKP into "foul language political party". Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairpersons of Chongryon Headquarters Meet
body: There took place a meeting of chairpersons of the headquarters of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) at the Korean Hall in Tokyo on May 29 and 30. Present at the meeting were Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of Chongryon; Nam Sung U, its vice-chairman; Pae Jin Gu, its vice-chairman and concurrently director of the General Affairs Department; Jo Il Yon, its vice-chairman and concurrently director of the Organization Department; Pak Ku Ho, its vice-chairman; Kang Chu Ryon, its vice-chairwoman and concurrently chairwoman of the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Democratic Korean Women in Japan; Ri Myong Yu, chairman of the Central Audit Committee of Chongryon; department directors of the Central Standing Committee of Chongryon and chairpersons of the headquarters of Chongryon. The meeting discussed the tasks and ways for consolidating Chongryon as a cornerstone of patriotism and opening up a brilliant efflorescence of national education. Speeches were followed by a report made by Ho Jong Man. Underscoring the need to strengthen Chongryon, the reporter said that all the full-time officials should give definite precedence to the ideological work, wage a dynamic innovation movement and find themselves among the masses with the spirit of making selfless and devoted efforts for the compatriots. He noted that the headquarters chairpersons should build up organizations and groups at all levels and perform their duties in a responsible manner and thus bring about a decisive advance in the work for building up the branches of Chongryon. He stressed the need to further develop the national education in the face of the moves of the Japanese authorities for erasing Chongryon. Speakers vowed to push ahead with innovation movement to turn branches into cornerstones of patriotism and, at the same time, conduct national education, lifeline of the movement of Koreans in Japan, with the main emphasis put on organization building and patriotic activities as commanding officials in charge of regional guiding units. Rodong Sinmun

title: Despicable Nature of Hwang Kyo An
body: Hwang Kyo An, representative of the “Liberal Korea Party” (LKP), is a despicable human scum with a veneer of politician in south Korea. Hwang has killed a lot of innocent people for decades to earn an ill fame as a fascist “public security prosecutor”. Hwang Kyo An is a heinous murderer who deserves bitter denunciation of the entire nation as he attempted to turn a sea of candle lights into a sea of blood with the same fascist temper as that of traitors Park Chung-Hee and Chun Doo Hwan, the worst dictators and murderers. Hwang leaves no stone unturned to bury in oblivion all his crimes of the past, claiming that he made a stabilized performance of state affairs during his term of office as an “acting president”, but he can never cover up the true colors of murderer in human skin. Hwang behaves himself as a politician, crying out for democracy and livelihood of the people after seizing the seat of the representative of LKP. It is the height of impudence. He set himself against the hard-won climate of peace on the Korean peninsula to enrage all the Koreans. He has prolonged his remaining days in the era of confrontation and is running amuck with blood to turn the north-south relations back to those before the adoption of the Panmunjom Declaration. Traitor Hwang will clearly know before long that his foolish act of swimming against the trend of the times and public mindset leads to a miserable end. Choe So Il

title: Japan Will Be Made to Pay for Past Crimes
body: 93 years have passed since the June 10th Independence Movement. The barbarous suppression of Koreans by the Japanese imperialists led to an anti-Japanese popular demonstration on June 10, 1926. The June 10th Independence Movement waged across Korea was an eruption of the pent-up grudge of the Korean nation against the severe colonial rule by the Japanese imperialists and a popular patriotic anti-Japanese struggle to retake the country and establish the sovereignty of the nation. Upset by the indomitable will and patriotic spirit of Koreans, Japanese army and police made desperate efforts to suppress the escalating demonstration. The cruel massacres of Koreans by the Japanese imperialists stained the country with the blood of the innocent people. During their occupation of Korea, the Japanese imperialists made no scruple of slaughtering Koreans in a bid to exterminate the entire Korean nation. As a result, a great many Koreans lost their lives. Notwithstanding, the Japanese reactionaries are craftily trying to evade the responsibility for the settlement of the past crimes, denying them. No matter how much water may flow under the bridge, Japan’s past crimes will never be put in oblivion. Its desperate efforts can never swim against the truth of history and justice. Rim Won

title: Local Elections to Be Held in DPRK
body: Elections for deputies to provincial (municipality), city (district) and county people's assemblies will take place in the Democratic People's Republic of Korea on July 21, Juche 108 (2019) in accordance with Article 138 of the Socialist Constitution and decisions of the local people's committees. The Presidium of the DPRK Supreme People's Assembly announced a report on the elections on Monday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Swedish Ambassador Hosts Reception
body: Jonas Michael Wendel, Swedish ambassador to the DPRK, hosted a reception at his embassy on Monday to mark the national day of Sweden. Present there on invitation were Im Chon Il, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, officials concerned, foreign diplomatic envoys and representatives of international bodies here. Present there were staff members of the embassy. Rodong Sinmun

title: Anniversary of Meeting between President Kim Il Sung and H.E. Seyed Ali Khamenei Observed
body: A meeting to mark the 30th anniversary of the meeting between President Kim Il Sung and Seyed Ali Khamenei, leader of the Islamic Revolution of Iran, was held at the Taedonggang Diplomatic Club on Monday on the occasion of the DPRK-Iran friendship week. Present there on invitation were Seyed Mohsen Emadi, Iranian ambassador to the DPRK, and his embassy officials. On hand were Pak Kyong Il, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries, officials concerned and working people in Pyongyang. Pak Kyong Il and Seyed Mohsen Emadi made speeches there. The speakers said that the meeting and talks between Kim Il Sung and Seyed Ali Khamenei served as a historic event as they laid the foundation for wide-ranging bilateral relations in various fields including politics, economy and culture. The speakers vowed to make positive efforts to expand and strengthen the friendly and cooperative relations on a new high level as desired by the two peoples to make independent development without interference of foreign forces. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Baskets to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Foreign Organizations
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received floral baskets from the Choson Exchange Association in Singapore and the Australia-DPRK Association for Friendship and Culture on Monday ahead of the first anniversary of the June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Work Introduced by DR Congo Organization
body: The full text of Chairman Kim Jong Il's work "The Workers' Party of Korea Is the Party of the Great Leader Comrade Kim Il Sung" was posted by the National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of Democratic Congo on its internet homepage on June 5 on the occasion of the 55th anniversary of Kim Jong Il's start of work at the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. The work, dated October 2, Juche 84 (1995), serves as the great programme for the Party building and activities as it indicated the way for developing the Workers' Party of Korea into the eternal Party of President Kim Il Sung based on the proud review of its glorious history in which it blazed a trail in building the revolutionary party in the era of independence under his leadership. Rodong Sinmun

title: The Sohyon Private School
body: The historical Sohyon Private School is situated in Pyoksong County, or in one of its picturesque nine valleys with a stone pond lying along the West Sea of Korea. It was founded during the rule of the last feudal dynasty of Korea to train the gentle and wise. In those years the private school was a local private institution of education. Originally, it was used by Ri I, a scholar of the feudal state, to give lessons to his disciples and write books. Later on, it was rebuilt for educational purposes. It was divided in an ancestral shrine and a lecture-hall in the mass. It consisted of the Chonggye Hall, the Yogum Pavilion and others. The private school is important in testifying to the looks and architecture of the then institution. Part of the private school was destroyed during the Fatherland Liberation War. Afterwards, it was restored to its original state under the Party’s policy of protecting the national heritage. Kim Su Jong

title: Yearly Plan for Salt Production Fulfilled
body: The Kwangmyongsong Saltworks fulfilled its yearly plan for salt production on May 31 amid the dynamic Mallima speed movement. All its workshops and workteams competed with each other along socialist and collectivist lines to produce hundreds of tons of salt a day. The saltworks still goes all-out not to fail to turn out this year more salt than in the peak year. Kim Kyong Chol

title: Fulfilling Their Production Plan for the Five-year Strategy
body: Fulfillers of their production plan for the five-year strategy for national economic development grow in number at the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill. They numbered 101 till the first quarter of 2019. Another 27 joined them slightly more than two months after, hence the fulfillers total up to 128. Pak Hyon Jong, Kim Sol Gyong, Ryu Myong Sun, Pyon Kyong Hui, Choe Kun Bok, Jo Hyang Mi enabled spindles of their spinning machines to rotate more rapidly than ever and produced over 1.5 times as much cotton yarn as before every day. Six weavers of the textile mill tended many looms respectively and worked with might and main to execute their production plan for the five-year strategy in no time. The case was similar to its waste silk spinners. Consequently, 9 of weavers, fixers, throwsters, warpers and yarn winders carried out their work assignments for the five-year strategy. The two workers of the chemical fiber spinning combined workshop and the four ones of the Mangyongdae Textile Branch met their production quotas for the five-year strategy. The textile mill is now increasing the speed of its Mallima further so many of its weavers topped their annual production plan ahead of time and go all-out to hit their output target for the five-year strategy the way they did. Ri Chol Ok

title: Plate Glass Production Boosted
body: As of mid-June the Taean Friendship Glass Factory provided hundreds of thousands of square meters of plate glass to Samjiyon County, the Wonsan-Kalma coastal tourist area, the hot-spring tourist area in Yangdok County and other major places under construction. The factory ensures that raw materials are supplied to its workshops on a priority basis and that they organize their production down to the minutest detail to yield lots of products. Its raw materials workshop adopted the method of iron dust removal by permanent magnet to crush raw materials, thereby improving the quality of its glass products on all indices. In the control room of the factory’s plate glass workshop controllers observe standard procedures in operating a blast furnace, an agglomerating furnace and an annealing furnace, fully informed of their actual conditions, and help toward producing high-quality glass plates. Glass plates are transported to the major construction sites the instant they are turned out. Hong Song Jun

title: Russian Ambassador Hosts Reception
body: Alexandr Matsegora, Russian ambassador to the DPRK, gave a reception at the Taedonggang Diplomatic Club on Tuesday on the occasion of the national day of Russia. Present there on invitation were Kim Yong Jae, minister of External Economic Relations, Han Man Hyok, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Army Col. General Kim Hyong Ryong, vice-minister of the People's Armed Forces, Im Chon Il, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, Kim Ik Song, general director of the General Bureau for Affairs with Diplomatic Corps, So Ho Won, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries who is chairman of the DPRK-Russia Friendship Association, officials concerned, foreign diplomatic envoys and representatives of international bodies and foreign military attaches here. Staff members of the Russian embassy were on hand. Speeches were made there. Alexandr Matsegora said that the historic Russia visit made by Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, was an important event. Noting that the top leaders of the two countries agreed to closely cooperate with each other in the work for ensuring the development of the versatile bilateral cooperation and regional peace and safety, he emphasized that what can never be otherwise is the friendly relations between Russia and the DPRK with a reliable foundation and tradition. Kim Yong Jae said that the first historic meeting between the top leaders of the DPRK and Russia last in April served as an epoch-making occasion to promote the development of the friendly ties of the two countries. He said that the DPRK is delighted at the achievements made by the Russian people in firmly safeguarding the sovereignty and security of the country and the national interests, achieving sustained development of the economy and improving the people's living under the leadership of President Putin. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of Ministry of Railways Returns Home
body: A delegation of the Ministry of Railways headed by Minister Jang Hyok returned home Tuesday after taking part in the 47th ministerial meeting of the Organization of Railways Cooperation held in Tashkent, Uzbekistan. Rodong Sinmun

title: Symposium on Greenhouse Vegetable Farming Opens
body: The sci-tech symposium on greenhouse vegetable farming-2019 opened with due ceremony at the Pyongyang Vegetable Science Institute under the Academy of Agricultural Science on Tuesday. The symposium under the theme "Breeding and introduction of functional vegetable species and putting the production of greenhouse vegetable on an intensive and modern basis" is focused on the wide dissemination and generalization of the scientific research successes and experience achieved in the greenhouse vegetable production and cultivation technology development. The symposium includes a presentation of scientific research successes and technical experience and sci-tech and practical lectures. Present at the opening ceremony were Pak Thae Dok, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials concerned and officials, researchers and cultivators of greenhouse vegetable production field. The symposium will last till June 26. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Premier Inspects Several Units
body: Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, member of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, inspected the Pyongyang Thermal Power Complex and the Chongchongang Thermal Power Plant and acquainted himself with the farm work in Pyoksong, Kangryong and Ongjin counties. Making rounds of production processes of the Pyongyang Thermal Power Complex and the Chongchongang Thermal Power Plant, Kim Jae Ryong stressed the need to give priority to the scientific calculation in the management and control for maximum profitability and intensify the socialist system of responsible business operation and the system of reviewing daily production and finance. On the Okjong Coop Farm in Pyoksong County, the Naedong Coop Farm in Kangryong County and the Sonphung Coop Farm in Ongjin County he gave a pep-talk to the farmers and helpers in the campaign for overcoming the drought damage with all forces and means and finishing the transplantation of rice seedlings at the right time. He called upon officials to fulfill their responsibility and role in consolidating the material and technical foundation of rural economy and increasing agricultural production. The field consultative meetings discussed measures for making the working people in the fields of electrical power industry and agriculture give full play to their zeal for production and for efficiently introducing advanced science and technology. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Central Public Prosecutors Office Delegation Returns from China
body: A delegation of the DPRK Central Public Prosecutors Office led by Director Kim Myong Gil returned home on Tuesday after visiting China. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Greetings to President of Russian Federation
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Wednesday sent a message of greeting to Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation. Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in his message extended warm congratulations and greetings to the president, government and people of the friendly Russian Federation on the occasion of its national day in the name of the government and people of the DPRK. Today the strong and diligent Russian people are achieving big successes in the struggle to build powerful and prosperous Russia while bravely overcoming all the challenges and difficulties under your energetic leadership and we are sincerely pleased over them, the message said, and went on: The first meeting between me and you in Vladivostok, the beautiful port city of the Russian Federation, in April served as a significant and important occasion that made a sincere and good close relationship between ourselves and opened a new history of the DPRK-Russia friendship as required by the changing international situation and the times. I am much pleased with this. It is our common responsibility before the times and history to put the precious centuries-old tradition of friendship on a higher stage. I express firm belief that the common understanding and agreements made at our first significant meeting will bear rich fruits and, as a result, the strategic and traditional DPRK-Russia relations of friendship provided by the preceding leaders will further develop. The message sincerely wished the Russian president good health, happiness and greater successes in his responsible work for building prosperous Russia. Rodong Sinmun

title: Absurd Outcries Aiming at Realizing Their Ambition for Reinvasion
body: At a recent press conference Japanese Foreign Minister Kono termed the rocket launch of the DPRK an “explicit violation of the resolution” of the UN Security Council. The Japanese minister of Defense echoed his rubbish at an international conference on the issue of Asia-Pacific security recently held in Singapore. Japan has neither qualification nor face to take issue with the DPRK over its drills for defense. Lurking behind its absurd charge is its risky design to put spurs to its moves for becoming a military giant and launching reinvasion, which it has long pushed forward. Now the ruling forces of Japan are desperately working to revise the present Constitution that puts brake on realization of their wild dream for overseas expansion. It means they want to turn Japan into a war state. No wonder, they are trying to specify the “Self-Defense Forces” as army in the Article 9 of the Constitution. What the Japanese reactionaries sharpening the sword for reinvasion will do after turning Japan into a military giant is as plain as a pikestaff. They seek to repeat the period when they lorded it over Asian people under the signboard of “Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere”. Their frequent accusations against the DPRK are to justify their scheme for turning Japan into a military giant and realizing the wild dream for reinvasion. Kim Su Jin

title: Saplings Produced Twice a Year
body: The Kangwon Provincial Tree Nursery has begun to produce saplings twice a year in its greenhouses covered with light plastic sheets. While visiting the nursery in July 2018 Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un gave precious instructions to raise the scientific level of sapling production further, turn out saplings twice a year and mass-produce goods kinds of the trees of high economic and decorative value suited to the climate and soil of the province so that it can profit from effective afforestation in actuality. The nursery resorts to science and technology definitely to mass-produce saplings and substantially arranges for its labor and management to improve their technical knowledge and skills. This year the nursery has established the system of the real-time examination of water quality and adopted drastic measures to overcome the damages from drought. It continues striving hard as ever to lay the firm material and technical foundations for sapling production. The employees of the nursery successfully finished planting young trees in their light plastic sheet greenhouses. They are now tending them to meet the demand of science and technology for their production. Hong Song Chol

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Condolatory Message to Bereaved Families of Ri Hui Ho
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, sent a condolatory message to the bereaved families of Ri Hui Ho, on Wednesday. In the message Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un expressed deep condolences and consolation to the bereaved families upon the sad news that Ri Hui Ho, wife of ex-President Kim Dae Jung, passed away. The dedication and efforts made by Ri Hui Ho for the reconciliation and unity of the nation and the peace and reunification of the country while going through all trials and hardships together with ex-President Kim Dae Jung serve as a valuable foundation for the present trend of the north-south relations toward the independent reunification, peace and prosperity, and all the fellow countrymen will always cherish it, the message said. Rodong Sinmun

title: Iranian Embassy Staff Members Visit International Friendship Exhibition House
body: Staff members of the Iranian embassy here visited the International Friendship Exhibition House on Wednesday on the occasion of the DPRK-Iran friendship week marking the 30th anniversary of the historic meeting between President Kim Il Sung and Seyed Ali Khamenei, leader of the Islamic Revolution of Iran. The guests paid tribute to the wax replicas of the peerlessly great men. They walked round the gifts presented by party, state and government leaders and prominent personages of many countries to President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in token of their reverence. Rodong Sinmun

title: Fans and Our Folk Custom
body: Koreans have used various kinds of beautiful and convenient fans from ancient times. Fans woven out of barks of willows and other trees, cattails and other grasses, plus round fans made of feathers and down, were widely used before the existence of Koryo (a feudal state of 918-1392 in Korea). King Kyon Hwon of Later Paekje (a feudal state of 900-936 in Korea)presented Wang Kon with a round fan made with the tail feathers of a peacock to congratulate him on his accession to the throne of Koryo. Thereafter fans were made with cloth, paper, bamboo, laver and other different materials during the rule of the feudal dynasties of Koryo and Korea. Fans were largely classified into round ones and folding ones. In the years of Koryo our fans became widely known to other countries for their artistic value and elaborate handicraft. In the past our people made fans early in May of the lunar calendar when hot weather sets in and used to exchange them with their villagers and friends. Fans were used not only for cooling purposes but also for ceremonial and decorative purposes. At his wedding ceremony a bridegroom often covered his face with a fan which contained excellent pictures or verses. Later on, it was kept as a household decoration. Rim Song I

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Condolatory Message and Wreath to Bereaved Families of Ri Hui Ho, Wife of S. Korean Ex-President Kim Dae Jung
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, sent a condolatory message and a wreath to the bereaved families of Ri Hui Ho, wife of ex-president of south Korea Kim Dae Jung. Upon authorization Kim Yo Jong conveyed the message and wreath to the south side in Panmunjom on Wednesday afternoon. Present there from the south side were Jong Ui Yong, chief of the State Security Office of Chongwadae, So Ho, vice-minister of Unification, Pak Ji Won, deputy director of the Kim Dae Jung Peace Center, and others. The condolatory message and words of deep consolation from Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un to the bereaved families of Ri Hui Ho were courteously conveyed by Kim Yo Jong. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK FM Spokesperson's Statement Distributed as Document of UNGA, UNSC
body: The statement issued by a spokesperson for the Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, which clarified the DPRK's stand and will on the occasion of the first anniversary of the June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement, was distributed as an official document A/73/894-S/2019/466 of the UN General Assembly and the UN Security Council on June 11. Rodong Sinmun

title: The Songdowon International Children's Camp
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un saw to it that the Songdowon International Children’s Camp was rebuilt with splendor into a children’s palace. He personally presented himself at the unveiling ceremony of the new statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il erected at the camp and its inaugural ceremony as well in May 2014 and spent the whole day with its children. Since then more than 75, 000 children at home and abroad have so far enjoyed themselves happily there. They came from the Mangyongdae Revolutionary School, the Kang Pan Sok Revolutionary School, middle schools for orphans, schools in the northern extremity of the country, regions along the Military Demarcation Line and the East Sea and West Sea of Korea, its urban and rural areas and all its other parts, and even little branches of mountain villages. During the winter camping season children fully enjoyed skiing, skating, sleighing at the Masikryong Ski Resort. In 2016 the schoolchildren from flood-ridden northern tip of North Hamgyong Province enjoyed themselves at the camp amid the great interest of the whole country. Besides, children from different countries, including China, Russia and Vietnam, and other foreign friends had a happy time at the camp with our schoolchildren, deepening their friendly feeling toward each other. Kang Hyo Sim

title: Russian Embassy Staff Members Pay Floral Tribute to Liberation Tower
body: Russian Ambassador to the DPRK Alexandr Matsegora and his embassy staff members laid a wreath before the Liberation Tower on June 12, the national day of the Russian Federation. A wreath in the name of the embassy was laid. The participants paid silent tribute to the memory of the fallen Soviet soldiers before going round the tower. Earlier, staff members of the consulate general of the Russian Federation in Chongjin City laid bouquets before the Liberation Tower and graves of fallen Soviet soldiers in the city. Rodong Sinmun

title: Congratulations to President of Kazakhstan
body: Choe Ryong Hae, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, Tuesday sent a congratulatory message to Kassym-Jomart Tokayev upon his election as president of the Republic of Kazakhstan. Expressing the belief that the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation between the two countries would grow strong, the message wished the president of Kazakhstan good health and happiness and great success in his responsible work. Rodong Sinmun

title: The Inphung Pavilion
body: The Inphung Pavilion was a general’s wartime command post northwest of the walls of Kanggye County Town, Jagang Province. It was built in 1472 and rebuilt in 1680. Unique in architecture, it blends so well with its surroundings that it has been called one of the eight scenic spots in North and South Phyongan Provinces and Jagang Province, Korea from olden times. Topped by a gabled roof, the pavilion is 7.15m long in the east, 8.94m long in the west and 5.36m wide in the north and south respectively. It is minus a pillar in the east, so that the eastern pillars stand asymmetric with the western ones and are distanced from them irregularly. The pavilion is well preserved to bear good testimony to the creative wisdom and architectural talent of our nation. Yun Un Sim

title: DPRK Will Win Victory Only Under Uplifted Banner of Independence
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un said in his historic policy speech that the great Comrades Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il raised independence as the life of the Korean revolution and the fundamental cornerstone for State building and advanced the revolution and construction in our own way while categorically rejecting worship for big countries, dogmatism and the high-handedness and pressure by outside forces, and under their wise leadership our Republic has been built and developed to be a socialist State, independent in politics, self-supporting in the economy and self-reliant in national defence, and it is still demonstrating to the world its prestige and might as a powerful independent country. President Kim Il Sung laid the solid foundation of the self-supporting national economy on this land, thoroughly maintaining the independent attitude in the State building and activities. Chairman Kim Jong Il safeguarded the sovereignty of the country and the prestige of the nation, never allowing any deviation from the revolutionary line of independence; and he aroused the people to the struggle for more fully displaying the might of the self-supporting national economy, thus frustrating the moves of the imperialists to isolate and stifle the country. Our people are fully demonstrating the might of the self-supporting national economy, performing labor feats in every site of the building of a powerful socialist country under the wise leadership of Kim Jong Un with the spirit of self-reliance as treasured sword for the prosperity. No force on earth can keep the Korean people from dynamically advancing with him in the van of the revolution in the face of all sorts of challenges of the reactionaries of history. Jo Thaek Bom

title: The Great Comrade Kim Jong Un Is Peerless Patriot Who Demonstrates Dignity and Might of Our Country All over the World
body: There is no statesman for all ages and in all places like Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un who brought about a radical change in the destiny and position of the country and ushered in a new era of eternal peace and prosperity in the worst adversity in such a short brief of time. That is why he is deeply respected and praised by all people as a peerless patriot and the greatest of great men. It is an undying patriotic feat that he put the dignity of the country and national power on the highest level ever known in the 5 000-year-old history of the nation. His undying patriotic feats are that he turned the DPRK into a country that no other country dare provoke and a country which is free from war forever and put the DPRK into a powerful country recognized by the world and a country which achieves prosperity and takes a bold leap forward by its own efforts. He is a peerlessly great man who is demonstrating to the whole world the prestige of the DPRK and national power by the offensive way of revolution. His spirit of offensive combined with innovative discernment and forward-looking mode of creation is vividly observed in his tireless efforts and self-sacrificing devotion. Defending and adding luster to the undying feats performed by him for the development of the DPRK guarantees our prestige and future. We should safeguard his State-building ideas and feats like the apple of our eyes and add brilliance to them as eternal treasure of Juche Korea. No matter how the situation may change and whatever wind may blow, we should remain hot-blooded loyalists who advance along the road indicated by him and genuine comrades and comrades-in-arms who share the idea and intention with him and keep step with him to the last. It is essential to go out for the implementation of the important tasks laid down in his historic policy speech and at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 7th Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea. Everyone should become a performer of labor feats and hero of the era in the on-going grand Mallima march for displaying to the whole world the prestige of the DPRK and national power, keeping in mind the great honor and pride of making revolution under the leadership of the peerlessly great man, peerless patriot.

title: It Is the Demand of the Times to Implement the Inter-Korean Declarations
body: Some time ago the reunification movement organizations of south Korea held a press interview, in which they pointed out that the authorities did not optimize the opportunity to improve the inter-Korean relations, waiting for the US to give them its “okay” and strongly demanded that they should respect the inter-Korean declarations and independently adopt measures for the durable peace of the Korean peninsula. This truthfully reflects the desire of south Koreans to thoroughly implement the historic Panmunjom Declaration and the Pyongyang September Joint Declaration under the banner of national independence, steadily carry on with the relaxation of the tensions of the peninsula and the atmosphere of its peace and improve the inter-Korean relations without cease. Various circles of the south Korean society maintain that measures for the enduring peace of the peninsula must be adopted on independent lines, demanding the execution of the inter-Korean declarations. This is quite natural. If they wish for the betterment of the inter-Korean relations, the peace of the peninsula and the co-prosperity of the nation all Koreans should assume a correct posture on the relations and evince in practice their will to execute them. Our nation is the master of the inter-Korean relations in every respect, and has the wisdom and power to ameliorate them. Therefore, it should be firmly confident of adhering to the principle of its independence and thoroughly putting it into practice to better the relations. The inter-Korean relations can be improved only through national cooperation. Nobody can criticize Koreans themselves for settling the problem of their bilateral relations by their joint united efforts. The whole nation will definitely denounce anyone for attempting to invite foreign forces to interfere in its internal affairs. So long as the north and the south have confirmed the principle of their national independence there is no need for them to study others’ pleasure and still worse, receive approval from foreign forces. It is of capital importance to put an end to subservience to big powers, the ensuing loss of the spirit of independence and the policy of depending on foreign forces to invade the common interests of the nation for the purpose of saving the grave situation prevailing on the Korean peninsula and carrying on with the stream of its detente and peace. It is the demand of the situation to repudiate foreign forces, give top priority to the fundamental interests and demand of the nation and subordinate everything to them. The north and the south have nothing to fear and fail to do when they are definitely disposed to hold fast to and thoroughly fulfill their declarations by the united efforts of the nation in any storm and stress. Pak Chol Jun

title: Head of DPRK Government Delegation Meets Presidents of Nigeria, Congo, Namibia and Chad
body: Ri Ryong Nam, vice-premier of the Cabinet who participated in the celebrations of the Day of Democracy of the Federal Republic of Nigeria as head of the delegation of the government of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, separately met with presidents of the Federal Republic of Nigeria, the Republic of Congo, the Republic of Namibia and the Republic of Chad on June 11 and 12. The Nigerian president said that he was deeply impressed with the fact that Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un dispatched a delegation of the government of the DPRK to the celebrations, stressing that he would make all efforts to further develop the traditional friendly and cooperative relations with the DPRK. The presidents of Congo, Namibia and Chad warmly congratulated HE Kim Jong Un upon his election as chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK. They wished the Korean people success in their work for building a power and achieving peace and safety on the Korean peninsula. Ri Ryong Nam also met Yemi Osinbajo, vice-president of the Federal Republic of Nigeria. Rodong Sinmun

title: Vietnam Donates Food to DPRK
body: Food donated by the government of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam to the Democratic People's Republic of Korea arrived in Nampho Port on Thursday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Home-visiting Group of Koreans in Japan Visits Statues of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: A home-visiting group of Koreans in Japan Thursday visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill. The visitors laid bouquets and made a bow before the statues. Rodong Sinmun

title: Piano Concert Held by Students of Kim Won Gyun University of Music
body: A piano concert of students of Kim Won Gyun University of Music took place at the Music Hall of the university on Thursday to mark the national day of the Russian Federation. Among the audience were Pak Chun Sik, vice-minister of Culture, officials concerned, teachers and students of the university, Alexandr Matsegora, Russian ambassador to the DPRK, and his embassy members, diplomatic envoys of different countries and representatives of international bodies here. The concert was given by Pak Ye Un, U Song Ryon, Kim Ji Won, Choe Jang Hung and Pae Yon Ju. They proved successful in the Second and Third Moscow Krainev International Piano Concours. Put on the stage were famous tunes of the DPRK and the world including piano solo "Ode to Comrade Kim Jong Il", "Let's Keep the Revolutionary Faith to the Death" and "We Are Mallima Riders". The performers wonderfully depicted works requiring high skills by fully displaying their artistic talents which have been developed to their heart's content under the socialist educational system. Officials of the Russian embassy presented a floral basket to the performers who showed their excellent rendition. Rodong Sinmun

title: Iranian Embassy Staff Members Help Korean Farmers
body: Staff members of the Iranian embassy here did friendship labor on the DPRK-Iran Friendship Ripsok Co-op Farm in Mundok County of South Phyongan Province Thursday on the occasion of the DPRK-Iran friendship week. They were briefed on the leadership feats performed by President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in developing the farm before helping farmers. They handed over aid materials to the farm. Rodong Sinmun

title: Members of UNICEF Mission Help Korean Farmers
body: MyoZin Nyunt, representative and members of the UNICEF mission here did assistance work Thursday on the Taesong Vegetable Cooperative Farm in Sariwon City, North Hwanghae Province. They helped the farmers weeding. They handed over aid materials to the farm. Rodong Sinmun

title: Members of Art Squads of Women's Union Tour Revolutionary Battle Sites in Mt Paektu Area
body: Members of the art squads of the women's union from across the country toured the revolutionary battle sites in the area of Mt Paektu from June 5 to 14. They departed Hyesan and reached Pochonbo, where they laid bouquets and made a bow before the statue of President Kim Il Sung. Being briefed on the personality of the President as a great man, they looked round the command post of the Battle of Pochonbo, the police sub-station, etc. They headed for the Rimyongsu Revolutionary Site and Chongbong and Konchang Bivouacs. They visited Chairman Kim Jong Il's birthplace in the Paektusan Secret Camp. At the Samjiyon Grand Monument they went round the shore of Lake Samji, groups of subsidiary theme sculptures, etc. They also toured the Monument to the Victorious Battle of Musan Area and the Sinpha Revolutionary Site. They handed aid materials to shock brigade members in the township of Samjiyon County now under remodeling and helped them in their work while conducting a contest of agitation for speeding up the remodeling. They visited the Paektusan Hero Youth Power Station and held colorful political and cultural events like a meeting to hear impressions of the reminiscences of anti-Japanese guerrillas and recital of poems. Rodong Sinmun

title: Head of DPRK Government Delegation Meets VP of Venezuela
body: Ri Ryong Nam, vice-premier of the Cabinet who participated in the celebrations of the Day of Democracy of the Federal Republic of Nigeria as head of a delegation of the government of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, met and had a talk with Aristobulo Isturiz, vice-president of the Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela, on June 12.
