The Venezuelan vice-president wished the government and people of the DPRK, strong in independence, greater success in their struggle for socialism against imperialism, stressing that the Venezuelan government and people would value and develop the friendly and cooperative relations with the DPRK. Rodong Sinmun

title: Home-visiting Groups of Korean Students in Japan Visit Statues of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: The home-visiting groups of Korean high school students in Japan led by Jo Myong Ho, principal of the Kyoto Korean Middle and High School, and Kim Yong Ung, principal of the Hiroshima Korean Primary, Middle and High School, visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill Friday. The members of the groups laid bouquets and made a bow before the statues. Rodong Sinmun

title: Central Election Guidance Committee Formed in DPRK
body: The Central Election Guidance Committee for the election of deputies to provincial (municipality), city (district) and county people's assemblies was organized in the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. The Central Election Guidance Committee is made up of Chairman Thae Hyong Chol, Vice-Chairman Kim Phyong Hae, Secretary General Jong Yong Guk, members Choe Pu Il, Kim Yong Ho, Pak Chol Min, Ju Yong Gil, Kim Chang Yop and Jang Chun Sil, according to a decision of the Presidium of the DPRK Supreme People's Assembly announced on Thursday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Czech Figure Calls for Understanding DPRK Properly
body: Lubomir Zaoralek, chairman of the Foreign Affairs Committee of the Chamber of Deputies who visited the DPRK as head of a parliamentary delegation of the Czech Republic, gave his impression of the visit on June 3. He referred to the necessity for developing the friendly relations between the two countries on the basis of mutual respect and trust. He supported the DPRK's exercise of its right to defending sovereignty and appreciated its steady diplomatic efforts for peace, expressing his stand to oppose all forms of sanctions against it. He stressed the need to understand the true reality in the DPRK through more contacts with Koreans. He said that he regards it essential and positive to develop the historic friendly relations with the DPRK. Rodong Sinmun

title: President Kim Il Sung to Be Remembered in Congo
body: A Congolese committee for remembering President Kim Il Sung was formed on June 6. Vital Balla, chairman of the Congolese Association for Friendship among Peoples, was elected chairman of the remembrance committee. The committee set the remembrance period from June 8 to July 9 and decided to give wide publicity to the career and exploits of the President through media and hold political and cultural events in the period. Rodong Sinmun

title: True Loyalty of Revolutionary to the Leader
body: Loyalty to the leader is the most basic character which revolutionaries who embark upon the road of revolution should have. The revolution is pioneered and advanced by the leader, and a revolutionary should have infinite loyalty to the leader in order to fulfill his duty. For revolutionary fighters who grew up under the care of the leader, invariably remaining faithful to the leader all their lives is their duty and obligation. Loyalty to the leader is neither displayed nor verified in a special period and critical circumstances only. The true loyalty of revolutionary fighter to the leader is fully displayed in the day-to-day work and life. Officials, party members and other working people should remain loyal to the idea and guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un with the great pride of living and making the revolution, holding in high esteem the peerlessly great man as the top leader, and thus make a positive contribution to the accomplishment of the cause of the building of a powerful socialist country. Kim Ki Chol

title: The East Sea of Korea Stocked with Flatfish Fry
body: The Yanghwa Fishery Station makes great efforts to raise young non-migratory fishes like flatfish. On June 1 it released million-odd flatfish fries into the East Sea of Korea . The consistent policy of our Party is to protect and propagate flatfish and other kinds of non-migratory fishes and thus increase the marine resources of the country. The station sought to secure breeding flatfish before everything else. On the other hand it strove mightily to establish an advanced water examination system and put spawn collection, fry raising and all other processes on a scientific basis. The station did all it could to rear flatfish fry in a fishpond artificially, breaking bottlenecks in the temperature of its water and its quality in good time. It fed them amply especially in their early days so as to raise their survival rate. This led to breeding more than a million flatfish fry in good health. Kim Kuk Chol

title: The Riparian Works of the Hapjang River Completed
body: The inhabitants of Pyongyang completed their riparian works of the Hapjang River successfully in five days as befit the creators of the spirit and speed of Pyongyang, thus admirably carrying out without fail the task set by the Party, improving the surroundings of the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun as the supreme sanctuary of Juche further and face-lifting the city. The river is flanked with two embankments of huge stones and copes for thousands of meters from the Hapjang Bridge to the Juamsan Bridge. Good repairs were made on them. The lawn was laid out along the river in apple-pie order and its surroundings were realigned tidily to pedestrians’ delight. On this occasion the metropolitans once again demonstrated their spirit cogently through their riparian works of the river. Choe Su Bok

title: Chief of Pyongyang Mission of AINDF Vows to Thoroughly Implement June 15 Joint Declaration
body: Pak Su Chol, chief of the Pyongyang mission of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front (AINDF), issued a statement on Saturday, the 19th anniversary of publication of the June 15 joint declaration. The statement said that the historic Pyongyang summit meeting and publication of the June 15 joint declaration provided by Chairman Kim Jong Il 19 years ago were a great event which made a breakthrough in the national division that has lasted for decades and thus ushered in a rosy future of independent reunification. It noted that true to the sacred intentions of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il of the National Defence Commission who made great devotion and efforts to present a reunified country to the fellow countrymen, Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission, is wisely leading the struggle of the fellow countrymen to bring about a radical turn in accomplishing the cause of national reunification. It said however, the south Korean conservative forces are resorting to all sorts of moves to bring back the past confrontation era, abusing the inter-Korean declarations as "humiliating documents" and "documents benefiting the enemy", opposed to the nation's aspiration and the unanimous expectation of the international community. It pointed out that the popular masses in the south will all turn out in the campaign for ushering in a new era of peace and co-prosperity, true to Kim Jong Un's idea and line of independent reunification, being convinced that the behests of Kim Jong Il for national reunification will surely be translated into reality by Kim Jong Un. AINDF, together with all the south Korean people of various circles, will all turn out in the struggle for implementing the historic south-north joint declarations shining with the undying exploits of the peerlessly great men and reflecting the general will of all Koreans and thus surely bring peace, prosperity and independent reunification to this land, the statement stressed. Rodong Sinmun

title: Juche Idea Study Group of Scotland, UK Formed
body: The Juche Idea Study Group of Scotland, UK was formed in Glasgow on June 1. The statement issued at the inaugural ceremony said that the study group is aimed to study the Juche idea, further its promotion and apply it to the reality of Scotland. Mitchell Wells was elected chief of the group. Rodong Sinmun

title: President Kim Il Sung to Be Remembered in Lebanon
body: A Lebanese committee for remembering President Kim Il Sung was formed on June 6. Zaher al Khatib, secretary general of the Lebanon Federation of Workers and chairman of the Lebanese Committee for Support to the Reunification of Korea, was elected chairman of the remembrance committee. The remembrance committee decided to give wide publicity to the revolutionary career and exploits of Kim Il Sung. Rodong Sinmun

title: WPK's Stand to Defend Int'l Justice and World Peace Supported by Syrian Figure
body: Mohammed Shaban Azzooz, member of the Regional Leadership of the Baath Arab Socialist Party and chairman of the Syrian Arab-Korea Friendship Association, made public a statement on June 12, the first anniversary of the adoption of the historic June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement. He in his statement said that thanks to the bold decision made by Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, the DPRK-U.S. summit meeting and talks were held in Singapore in June last year for the first time in history and the June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement was adopted. He expressed full support for the WPK's stand to defend international justice and world peace. He stated that he would closely cooperate with the WPK in the struggle for building a new world being aspired by mankind and achieving development and prosperity of all peoples around the world. He paid the noblest tribute to Kim Jong Un, wishing the WPK bigger success in its work for national prosperity. Rodong Sinmun

title: President Kim Il Sung to Be Remembered in Belarus
body: A committee for remembering President Kim Il Sung was formed by the Vitebsk Juche Pedagogy Association of Belarus on June 8. Sergei Zebyatikh, chief of the association and editor-in-chief of the Belarusian magazine Social Education, was elected chairman of the remembrance committee. The remembrance committee decided to give wide publicity to the revolutionary exploits of President Kim Il Sung through media and hold political and cultural events including remembrance meeting. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Exploits in Party Building Praised by Swiss Organizations
body: The Swiss Organizing Committee for the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu, the Switzerland-Korea Committee and the Swiss Group for the Study of the Juche Idea issued a joint statement on June 7 on the occasion of the 55th anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's start of work at the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). The statement said that Kim Jong Il developed the WPK into President Kim Il Sung's party and established the ideological system of the leader in the Party while working at the Central Committee of the WPK. It went on: His start of work at the Central Committee of the WPK serves as a significant event in the history of the WPK. Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un put forward Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism as the eternal guiding ideology of the WPK to glorify Kim Jong Il's immortal revolutionary exploits for all ages. Rodong Sinmun

title: Leadership of the Party Is Lifeline of Socialist State Building and Activities
body: To realize the Party guidance over state building and activities is a fundamental requirement for the accomplishment of the cause of socialism, and it presents itself as a more important issue as the revolution develops in depth and the construction goes ahead. The Party leadership serves as a decisive guarantee ensuring that a socialist state fulfills its mission with credit as a servant of the people. The socialist power cannot fulfill its mission with credit as a servant of the people without Party leadership. It can be illustrated by the tragic revival of capitalism in some countries that had built socialism. Party leadership constitutes a lifeline to make a socialist state properly organize and undertake the unified guidance over the society and the struggle for the overall socialist construction. To ensure the unified guidance over the society is the basic function of the socialist state. To successfully ensure the unified guidance of the state over the society, it is necessary to remain faithful to the leadership of the party. It is because the unified guidance function of the socialist state, the inclusive function to control all the realms of social life and all the regions of a country and organize and control their development, can be realized only under the leadership of a party. Our Republic has set examples of the era in the socialist construction under the wise leadership of the Party for more than seven decades. Thanks to the seasoned leadership of the great Party leading the Juche-oriented revolution with a firm grip on the switch of history, our Republic will further develop into the independent powerful country no one dares provoke, the people’s country where all their ideals come true and the great country which outpaces the world, tapping the infinite potentiality. Han Un Il

title: Kim Jae Ryong Inspects Tokchon Area Coal-Mining Complex
body: Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, member of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, inspected the Tokchon Area Coal-Mining Complex. He gave a pep talk to coal miners tunneling in the face 7 of the Jenam Coal Mine and called for ensuring a full capacity operation of rock-drills, compressors and other equipment and proactively introducing the effective technical innovations for the timely mucking. There took place a consultative meeting on the spot. The meeting discussed the issues of further improving the planning as required by the developing situation, building its own reliable repair and maintenance base and making the relevant units take thorough measures to provide materials necessary for the coal production. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of DPRK Government Back Home
body: A delegation of the government of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea headed by Vice-Premier of the Cabinet Ri Ryong Nam returned home on Monday after attending the celebrations of the Day of Democracy of the Federal Republic of Nigeria. Rodong Sinmun

title: Pyongyang International Sci-Tech Exhibition of Health and Medical Appliances Opens
body: The Pyongyang International Sci-Tech Exhibition of Health and Medical Appliances opened with due ceremony at the Sci-Tech Complex on Monday. On display there are functional health goods, medicines, appliances for diagnosis, treatment and prevention, and diverse sanitary goods presented by more than 100 units of the DPRK, China, Russia and other countries. During the exhibition a symposium on medical technology will be held, intellectual products distributed and exhibits sold. Present at the opening-ceremony were Choe Jong Ho, president of the Sci-Tech Complex, Kim Jong Su, vice-chairman of the State Commission of Science and Technology, Kim Hyong Hun, vice-minister of Public Health, officials concerned, foreign delegations, diplomatic envoys and members of foreign missions here. The exhibition will last till June 21. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Publishes Many Works on Single-minded Unity during His Leadership over WPK
body: Chairman Kim Jong Il published many works serving as the important guidelines in closely uniting the broad masses of people behind the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) during his guidance over the Party for more than half a century. He published works "On the Firm Establishment of the Party's Monolithic Ideological System among Writers and Artists", etc. in the 1960s and provided the important guidelines for holding President Kim Il Sung in high esteem and creditably realizing the idea and leadership of the President. "On Some Immediate Tasks of Party Ideological Work for Modeling the Whole Society on Kimilsungism", published on February 19, Juche 63 (1974), served as the important banner illuminating the road for achieving the single-minded unity of the whole society on the basis of the revolutionary idea of the leader. "The Workers' Party of Korea Organizes and Guides All the Victories of Our People", "Let Us Further Strengthen Our Single-hearted Unity and Give Full Play to the Korean-Nation-First Spirit" and other works specify the tasks and ways for defending the tradition of the unity and cohesion centered on the leader and steadily strengthening the driving force of the revolution. "On Making a Decisive Advance in the Building of a Great, Prosperous and Powerful Socialist Country" and "The Songun-Based Revolutionary Line Is a Great Revolutionary Line of Our Era and an Ever-Victorious Banner of Our Revolution" and other works clarify that the single-minded unity, which defended the red flag of socialism despite the moves of the imperialist allied forces to isolate and stifle the DPRK and the economic difficulties, serves as the lifeline of Korean-style socialism and invincible treasured sword. In the last period of his great life Kim Jong Il published "The Workers' Party of Korea Is a Great Party that Carries forward and Implements Victoriously the Revolutionary Cause of Comrade Kim Il Sung" and "We Must Carry forward and Implement down through Generations the Revolutionary Cause of Juche Pioneered on Paektu" and other works , in which he requested the whole party, the entire army and all the people to remain loyal to the idea and guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and carry forward the single-minded unity generation after generation. Rodong Sinmun

title: Xi Jinping to Visit DPRK
body: At the invitation of Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and president of the People's Republic of China, will pay a state visit to the DPRK from June 20 to 21. Rodong Sinmun

title: Science and Technology and Education Are Engine of General Advance of Self-reliance
body: Giving priority to science, technology and education is the best way to perfectly solve the problems arising in economic construction by the Koreans’ own efforts and to raise the overall national economy onto a higher level. It is also a fundamental guarantee that a state can achieve uninterrupted prosperity. Self-reliance is neither a requirement of the situation nor a tactical countermeasure against a temporary setback but a strategic line that the DPRK should maintain constantly. We, who were raised learning the history of self-reliance under the care of the Party, have no other choice but to stick to the principle of self-reliance. Giving priority to science, technology and education is a guarantee that our Republic can make steady progress. We should bear in mind why the Party considers science, technology and education a propeller of the grand march of self-reliance, and give top priority to them, so as to push ahead with socialist construction. Kim Song Nam

title: President Kim Il Sung to Be Remembered in Pakistan
body: A Pakistani national committee for remembering President Kim Il Sung was formed in Karachi on June 12 to observe the 25th anniversary of his demise. S. M. Altaf, chairman of the Central Committee of the Worker-Peasant Party of Pakistan, was elected chairman of the remembrance committee. The committee set days from June 20 to July 8 as a remembrance period and decided to give wide publicity to the revolutionary career and feats of the President through media and hold political and cultural events in the period. Rodong Sinmun

title: A River Improved 10-odd Kilometers
body: Rason City carried out a river improvement project with success. From a patriotic desire to prevent flood damages beforehand and add beauty to the landscape of Rason City its citizens dug up the bed of a river in tens of days, removed tens of thousands of cubic meters of deposits, embanked it with stones in a section of hundreds of square meters and built a road along its shore for several kilometers. As a consequence, the river was improved for more than 10 kilometers and its surroundings were afforested. Ri Un Nam

title: Energetically Assisting in the Construction of the Tanchon Power Station
body: The Tanchon Power Station under construction is dynamically backed up throughout the country. Last May Pyongyang, Kangwon and other provinces, the Ministry of Forestry and other ministries and national organs provided the TPS under construction with rock-drills, mine wagons and lots of other equipment, materials and spare parts as well as plenty of supplies. Last May Pyongyang presented the TPS under construction with over 1,500 machines and materials of 10-odd kinds and more than 19,000 items of supplies to heighten the morale of its builders. Kangwon Province handed hundreds of pieces of equipment, materials and welfare supplies of dozens of kinds, including mine wagons, electromotors and cables, over to the TPS under construction. Along with Nampho and Rason Cities, North Hwanghae, Jagang and South Phyongan Provinces donated lots of machines, materials and supplies to the construction site of the TPS. Various ministries and national organs like the Central Committee of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League, the Ministry of Forestry, the Ministry of Land and Maritime Transport, the Central Court and the Central Bank sincerely assisted in constructing the TPS and encouraged its builders to work hard day and night to carry out the far-reaching plan of the Party as soon as possible. O Mun Il

title: National Art Exhibition Opens
body: A national art exhibition opened with due ceremony at the Korean Art Gallery on Tuesday to mark the 55th anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's start of work at the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Seen at the venue of the exhibition is a picture of Kim Jong Il, a great man. Displayed there are art pieces dealing with the spirit of the brave Korean people. Acryl paintings "Dawn of our Party's history" and "The great leader Comrade Kim Jong Il declaring the modeling of the whole society on Kimilsungism" and other art pieces deal with the party-building exploits of Kim Jong Il who developed the WPK into the genuine Party of the leader and revolutionary Party of Juche. The devoted service of Kim Jong Il who always found himself among the people with the loving care for them is witnessed in art pieces such as Korean paintings "Being exposed to untimely rain", "Among the developers of Ryonha machines" and "The great leader Comrade Kim Jong Il in coal mine working face". Art pieces such as oil paintings "Hometown of Mallima", "Morning of golden seas" and "New appearance of Sokjon Bay" vividly represent the reality of the country that has been spruced up under the guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un as the days go by. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of Koreans in Japan Pay Tribute to Statues of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: A delegation of the Korean Commercial Association in Chiba Prefecture under the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on Tuesday. Members of the delegation laid bouquets and made a bow to the statues. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Seminar Held
body: A national seminar was held at the Central Youth Hall on Tuesday to have a good grasp of the ideology and theory advanced in Chairman Kim Jong Il's work "Let Us Further Raise the Flames of a Revolutionary Great Upsurge on All Fronts of the Building of a Thriving Country with the Great Spiritual Strength of Kim Il Sung's Nation" and bring about a revolutionary upswing in the grand march of self-reliance this year. The work, published on June 25, Juche 98(2009), indicates the tasks and ways for bringing about a revolutionary upswing on all fronts of socialist construction by giving the fullest play to the mental power of national self-respect and self-reliance. At the seminar speakers said that the work of Kim Jong Il serves as important guidelines clarifying the way for training the Korean people into those strong in the ideological and mental power with the Juche-oriented theory of giving importance to ideology as a powerful weapon in the revolution and construction. It is the immutable truth running through the work that giving full play to the popular masses' mental power is the key to the creation of miracles and guarantees great innovations and leaps forward and the mental power of the Korean people equipped with the revolutionary idea is the most important asset for building a prosperous country, they noted, adding that this is the law which has been proven in practices in the advance of the new century of Juche. Speakers vowed to deeply study and grasp the profound idea of the work and fulfill their mission and duty as leading officials of the revolution in the van of the march for fresh revolutionary upsurge under the uplifted banner of self-reliance, true to the guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Attending the seminar were officials of central and city party and administrative organs, working people's organizations, those in the fields of science, education, literature and art and media and those of party cadres training institutions and in field of preservation of revolutionary relics. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to Seychellois President
body: Choe Ryong Hae, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a message of greeting to Danny Faure, president of the Republic of Seychelles, on Tuesday on the occasion of its national day. The message expressed the belief that the traditional friendly relations between the two countries would grow stronger, and wished the government and people of Seychelles success in their work for the social stability and economic development of the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: President Kim Il Sung to Be Remembered in Kuwait
body: A committee for remembering President Kim Il Sung was formed in Kuwait on June 10. Javid Ahmad, director of the Administrative Department of the Kuwait Times who doubles as chairman of the Kuwait Asian Journalist Association, was elected chairman of the remembrance committee. The committee decided to hold political and cultural events including seminar and film show to praise Kim Il Sung's revolutionary career and feats from June 11 to July 9. Rodong Sinmun

title: President Kim Il Sung to Be Remembered in Syria
body: A committee of the Socialist Unionist Party of Syria for remembering President Kim Il Sung was formed on June 9. Adnan Ismail, general secretary of the party, was elected chairman of the remembrance committee. The committee decided to conduct information activities for praising the President's exploits. Rodong Sinmun

title: Venezuelan City's Highest Order Awarded to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un
body: Naguanagua City, Carabobo State, Venezuela awarded the "Naguanagua City Order", the highest order of the city, to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un on the occasion of the "period of the international action for peace, prosperity and reunification of the Korean peninsula" and the first anniversary of the adoption of the historic June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement. A meeting for conveying the order took place on June 11. Present there were figures of the Carabobo State Government, the city office, the city council and political parties and organizations of Venezuela, the DPRK ambassador to Venezuela and his embassy member and others. A decision on awarding the highest order to the Supreme Leader and the certificate of the order were read out there. Conveying the order, the certificate and the written decision to the DPRK ambassador, the mayor of the city said that Kim Jong Un is a great model of the revolutionary people of the world including the Venezuelan people as he has led the socialist cause of the DPRK and the cause of national reunification to victory. He stressed that it is the highest happiness and pride of them, moved by his greatness, to award the highest order of the city to Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Various Functional Products Developed
body: Last year Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un visited the Sinuiju Cosmetics Factory. Meanwhile, he assigned it to develop and produce numbers of cosmetics of various kinds much to the people’s liking and shed full light on the ways of doing that. While deeply analyzing the trend of the development of the cosmetic industry at home and abroad, the technicians of the SCF cudgel their brains hard to ideally unite various components in functional cosmetics and enable them to have the best effect on the skin. In the process of this they developed handy, efficacious and pleasant-smelling perming cream on an experimental basis and have since striven to enhance its function further. Besides, they develop a liquid eyelash grower, a beauty film effective against acne and anti-mosquito cream in their final stage. The technicians of the SCF work hard to mass-produce functional cosmetics which always keep the skin fresh and springy. They have almost finished developing nano-hyaluronic acid bioactive liquid essence which is very effective against the aging of one’s facial skin. The officials and technicians of the SCF do not rest satisfied with their successes but keep on trying steadily as ever to expand the varieties of their functional cosmetics. Yun Un Sim

title: Fields Are Actively Weeded Twice or Thrice
body: Agricultural officials and workers across the country are vigorously weeding their fields the way they transplanted rice seedlings there. They are now weeding their rice paddies for the second time, and their maize fields for the third time. The districts and counties of Pyongyang, including Sadong and Ryokpho Districts, successfully finished weeding their maize fields thrice, and are now weeding their paddies full steam for the second time. North Hwanghae Province and other ones, plus Nampho City are also concentrating their efforts on weeding their rice and maize fields. Ri Yong Hak

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Lauded Abroad
body: Seminars on exploits of Chairman Kim Jong Il were held in Mongolia, Uganda and DR Congo from June 4 to 12 to mark the 55th anniversary of his start of work at the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. The chairman of the Mongolian Mt Paektu Association for Independent Development said that Kim Jong Il had pushed forward the revolution and construction on the basis of the Juche idea founded by President Kim Il Sung. Kim Jong Il had built the WPK into the leader's Party and mother Party serving the people, he stressed. Participants in the seminar held under the co-sponsorship of the Ugandan National Executive Committee of the Pan-African Movement and the Ugandan National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea said that Kim Jong Il developed in depth the Juche idea, an ideological basis to defend and develop the sovereignty of the DPRK, further enriching the treasure house of the history of human thought. The chairman of the National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of DR Congo and other speakers said that it is the greatest exploit of Kim Jong Il to prove the inevitability of victory of socialism with his outstanding ideo-theoretical activities and defend socialism by dint of Songun politics. They added that his exploits for the development of the WPK, the cause of socialism, the reunification of Korea and the cause of global independence will go down. Rodong Sinmun

title: Solidarity with Korean People Called for
body: The Workers' Party for the Independence of Senegal made public a statement on June 12, the first anniversary of the adoption of the historic June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement. The statement said: A joint statement reflecting the will to put an end to the hostile relations between the DPRK and the U.S. and make efforts for peace was adopted at the summit meeting and talks between Chairman Kim Jong Un and the U.S. president in Singapore. The Workers' Party for the Independence of Senegal was glad to see the adoption of the DPRK-U.S. joint statement warmly welcomed by the progressives. We extend solidarity to the Korean people advancing in the face of all sorts of sanctions and call on all the justice-loving people to turn out in the struggle for peace. Rodong Sinmun

title: Annual General Meeting of Paektusan Czech-Korean Friendship Association Held
body: The annual general meeting of the Paektusan Czech-Korean Friendship Association was held on June 8. Present there were the chairman and members of the association and personages of various circles. The chairman said that the association has worked hard to give wide publicity to the DPRK's reality and strengthen exchange and solidarity between the two countries. The idea and cause of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il are invariably carried forward in the DPRK under the guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, he stressed. A solidarity statement adopted at the general meeting underlined that thanks to the energetic leadership of Kim Jong Un, only victory and glory are in store for the Korean people and the 21st century will shine as the century of independence. The statement noted that the association will work hard for the development of the friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of Journalists Union of Korea Leaves for China
body: A delegation of the Journalists Union of Korea headed by Chairman of its Central Committee Cha Sung Su left here Wednesday to visit China. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Baskets Laid at Statues of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Working people, youth and students and servicepersons visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on the occasion of the 55th anniversary of Kim Jong Il's start of work at the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Seen at the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill was a floral basket sent by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Placed before the statues were floral baskets in the names of the Party, power and armed forces organs, public organizations, ministries, national institutions and institutions, factories, enterprises, schools at all levels in Pyongyang, units of the Korean People's Army (KPA) and the Korean People's Internal Security Forces (KPISF) and bouquets. Visitors made a bow to the statues of the great leaders. Floral baskets in the names of institutions, enterprises and units of the KPA and the KPISF and bouquets were laid at the statues of the great leaders at Kim Il Sung University, the Ministry of the People's Armed Forces, the Ministry of People's Security, the Mansudae Art Studio and other parts of Pyongyang. Working people, youth and students and servicepersons visited the statues of the great leaders and portraits of their smiling images across the country to pay homage to them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Ideological Work Is the Core Problem in Implementing the Socialist Cause
body: Chairman Kim Jong Il published the work “Giving Priority to Ideological Work is Essential for Accomplishing Socialism” on June 19, Juche 84 (1995). His work serves as the undying banner which provided an invincible treasured sword for creditably accomplishing socialism to the party and people making revolution. Giving priority to ideological work and developing it in depth are essential for opening a new road of advance for the socialist construction by dint of self-reliance. Self-reliance constitutes an immutable mode of advance of Juche Korea, treasured sword for prosperity and driving force for a leap forward, and our people have achieved praiseworthy victories in the whole course of socialist construction by giving full play to the revolutionary spirit and working spirit of self-reliance. The ideological work is an important work to imbue the masses with the idea that they should carry on a revolution in their country by themselves with responsibility, and to bring their revolutionary and creative zeal into full play. Only when the popular masses are equipped with the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance, can they carve out their own destiny in an independent and creative manner and successfully accomplish socialism. It is only when the political and ideological work is pushed ahead with that the strong national dignity to live not depending on others and the steadfast spirit to independently and thoroughly solve all the issues arising in the revolution and construction can be displayed. Myong Ju Hyok

title: Editorial
body: Let Us Forever Glorify Exploits of the Great Leader Comrade Kim Jong Il in Leading the Cause of Juche-oriented Party Building June 19 marks the 55th anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il’s start of work at the Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea (WPK). June 19, Juche 53 (1964) is the day that marked the steady continuation of the sacred history and traditions of the WPK that began on Mt Paektu, and an occasion that had an epoch-making effect on accomplishing the revolutionary cause of Juche. Kim Jong Il’s guidance over the party shines with the history of succession run through with his intense loyalty and devotion to the revolutionary cause of the leader, with the miraculous history characterized by landmark changes in all fields of the revolution and construction and with the glorious history which laid the eternal foundation for the final completion of the revolutionary cause of Juche. To look back on history, a series of complicated situation developed due to the aggression and counterrevolutionary moves of the imperialists and the neo-revisionists on the international arena in the 1960s. Kim Jong Il who started his work at the Central Committee of the WPK at this time set it as the issue of utmost importance for the accomplishment of the cause of socialism to strengthen the party organizationally and ideologically, and provided wise guidance for its materialization. It was attributable to his outstanding leadership that our party could demonstrate its invincible might and lead the country and the people with full responsibility for their destiny despite the massive political upheaval of successive collapse of ruling political parties in socialist countries. Invincible and ever-lasting will be the exploits of Kim Jong Il who blazed a trail of building the revolutionary party to develop the WPK into the organizer and guide of all victories of our people and thus provided a sure guarantee for the advance of the socialist cause and the eternal future of the country.

title: Undying Traces Recorded in Annals of Development of DPRK-China Friendly Relations
body: DPRK-China friendship is a valuable legacy bequeathed by the leaders of the old generation of the two countries. The world of particular comradeship and revolutionary obligation established by President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il with the leaders of the old generation of China is vividly implied in the history of the DPRK-China friendly relations that have been carried forward and developed generation after generation. Kim Il Sung, who paid deep attention to the development of the DPRK-China relations in the whole period of his revolutionary life, forged comradely trust and deep friendly relations with the leaders of the old generation of China including Comrades Mao Zedong, Zhou Enlai and Deng Xiaoping and provided precious tradition of DPRK-China friendship. In 1949, Kim Il Sung visited China to take part in events of celebrating the founding of the People’s Republic of China and had first meaningful meetings with Mao Zedong and Zhou Enlai. Since then had the leaders of the two countries made it a tradition to visit each other like members of a family, transcending diplomatic customs and formalities, and worked heart and soul to consolidate and develop the friendly relations between the two countries. During his China visits made on many occasions including October, 1954 and April, 1975, Kim Il Sung deepened comradely ties with the leaders of the old generation of China and further consolidated the foundation of the development of the friendly relations between the two brotherly countries. Meetings and talks held between the former leaders of the two countries discussed matters of mutual concern always on the basis of deep faith, revolutionary obligation and comradeship and agreed on the orientation of developing their relations from a strategic point of view and on its ways. Whenever Kim Il Sung visited the People’s Republic of China, the leaders of the old generation of China warmly welcomed him as the closest friend of the Chinese people and showed every possible sincerity for him. Zhou Enlai and other leaders of the old generation of China who visited the DPRK on several occasions including April, 1970 had directed deep concern to the development of the DPRK-China friendly relations, saying that the militant friendship of sharing interests and joys and sorrows with each other united the peoples of the two countries into one. Upon receiving the sad news that Zhou Enlai died of a long illness, Kim Il Sung could not repress his sorrow at his death and sent a consolatory message to Mao Zedong. And the joint decision of the Workers’ Party of Korea and the DPRK government on setting the day before the funeral of Zhou Enlai and the funeral day as mourning days and hoisting flags at half-mast at all organs, factories, enterprises, schools, residential quarters and rural areas was adopted. In his own name he sent wreaths to the bier of Zhou Enlai and the Chinese Embassy in Pyongyang. Afterward, he saw to it that the statue of Zhou Enlai and his monument were erected at the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex associated with his footprints. And he, together with Deng Yiangchao, personally attended the unveiling ceremony. Underlying the deep trust expressed by the leaders of the old generation of China in Kim Il Sung whenever opportunities presented themselves was their ardent sympathy with his noble sense of revolutionary obligation and comradeship. Kim Il Sung usually highly estimated that things were going well in all realms including politics, economy and foreign relations in China, a close neighbor of our country, under the guidance of the Communist Party of China. And he used to stress the importance of developing traditional friendly relations between the peoples of the two countries forged in blood through a protracted revolutionary struggle generation after generation. The undying footprints made by Kim Il Sung on the road of developing the DPRK-China friendly relations were fully carried forward by Chairman Kim Jong Il. For nearly 15 days from June 1, 1983, Kim Jong Il made the first historical visit to China by train. During his China visit, he met with senior officials of the Party and government of China including Comrades Deng Xiaoping, Hu Yaobang and Xi Zhongxun and revolutionaries of the old generation, deepening friendly relations with them. In those historical days, he conducted energetic activities to lay a solid foundation for constantly inheriting and developing the history of DPRK-China friendship provided by Kim Il Sung with the leaders of the old generation of China through generations and centuries. Entering the 21st Century, he made mutual visits with Comrades Jiang Zemin and Hu Jintao on several occasions and recorded a shining chapter in the annals of DPRK-China friendship. On June 18, 2008, he made a meaningful meeting with Xi Jinping who came to our country and conversed with him in a warm atmosphere overflowing with feelings of fraternal friendship. The immortal traces of Kim Jong Il who visited China on two occasions in May and August, 2011, the last year of his noble revolutionary life, are clearly marked in the annals of DPRK-China friendship. There is no end to talk about all the stories that Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il, together with the leaders of the old generation of China, provided the deep and strong roots of DPRK-China friendship and invariably carried forward the feelings of friendship sealed in blood. This unfolded the history of friendship and bonds that closely combined the peoples of the two countries. As it is deeply rooted in minds of the two peoples in a long period of bloody struggle thanks to the leaders of the old generation of the two countries, DPRK-China friendship has been consolidated and developed through generations and centuries, surmounting all trials of history. At present, excellent tradition of DPRK-China friendship provided by the preceding leaders is being invariably inherited under the particular concern and energetic guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and Comrade Xi Jinping. In order to develop traditional DPRK-China friendship established by the leaders of the old generation of the two countries onto a new height, Kim Jong Un visited China on three occasions last year and revisited China as the first political agenda item for this year and made a meaningful meeting with Xi Jinping. Xi Jinping and leading officials of the Chinese party and government who hope for valuing and constantly carrying forward and developing the friendly relations between the two countries, paid particular attention to the China visit of Kim Jong Un and accorded him cordial hospitality with utmost sincerity. In those days when signal milestone was provided for developing bilateral relations in accordance with the requirements of the new era, the invincibility and solidity of DPRK-China friendship were fully demonstrated at home and abroad and the steadfast will of the two parties and governments to develop bilateral friendly relations forged by the leaders of the old generation of the two countries onto a higher stage, regarding them as a common heritage and valuable treasure. Our people are rejoiced as over their own over the achievements made by the fraternal Chinese people in the struggle to realize the dream of China for great rehabilitation of the Chinese nation under the leadership of the Communist Party of China with Xi Jinping as a core. The traditional DPRK-China friendship forged by the leaders of the old generation of the two countries through the bloody struggle and developed through ages and centuries will be further consolidated in conformity with the requirements of the times developing under the deep concern of the top leaders of the two parties and two countries and with the common desires of the two peoples. Ri Hyo Jin

title: Their Researches Prove Successful in Actuality
body: A thermal engineering institute of the heat engineering faculty of Kim Chaek University of Technology developed and applied the technology of drying with hot air from an electric heater the papers whose two sides are printed in four colors at a high speed. Originally, a printing plant dried the papers with expensive propane. The scientists of the institute researched into the use of hot air from an electric heater instead of from burning propane. While cooperating creatively with the field engineers of the plant, they scientifically elucidated how both sides of papers were printed fast and dried simultaneously with hot air from an electric heater and how much various factors had to do with the quality and output of the papers and power consumption while they were dried. This confirmed that propane could be substituted with an electric heater. The scientists of the institute newly designed a heat exchanger to effectively use the heat of the waste air with a temperature of over 110℃ resulting from the drying. They overcame their scientific and technological difficulties in making the exchanger and thus enabled the heat of the waste air to be recycled and used rationally. The result was that it was made possible for the plant to economize in a great measure on the energy it used to dry the papers. Finally, the system of the operation of the electric heater has been established in the plant and the indices to the drying of the papers have been complied. The plant has become able to dry its papers with the electric heater without using propane at all. O Mun Il

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and President Xi Jinping Have Photo Session
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, met Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC) and president of the People's Republic of China, at the headquarters building of the WPK Central Committee on the afternoon of June 20. Supreme Leader of the Party, state and armed forces Kim Jong Un, together with Xi Jinping, had a meaningful photo session with members of Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee. Kim Jong Un and his wife Ri Sol Ju greeted with delight Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan in front of the headquarters building of the Party Central Committee. Kim Jong Un welcomed Xi Jinping, general secretary of the CPC Central Committee who paid a cordial visit to the headquarters of the WPK Central Committee, with a firm handshake of comradely friendship. Department directors of the C.C., WPK presented bouquets to Xi Jinping and Peng Liyuan. Being introduced to members of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK by Kim Jong Un, Xi Jinping exchanged greetings with them one by one to deepen the bonds of comradely trust between the two parties. Kim Jong Un and Ri Sol Ju and Xi Jinping and Peng Liyuan had a meaningful photo taken with members of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK against the background of the building of the Party Central Committee, which would abide long in the histories of the two parties. Political News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and President Xi Jinping Enjoy Grand Mass Gymnastics and Artistic Performance
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), together with Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC) and president of the People's Republic of China (PRC), enjoyed the grand mass gymnastics and artistic performance "Invincible Socialism" on Thursday evening. When the Supreme Leader of the Party, state and armed forces of the DPRK and his wife Ri Sol Ju, together with President Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan, appeared on the platform of honor in the May Day Stadium, all the performers and audience warmly welcomed the top leaders of the two countries. Kim Jong Un and Xi Jinping warmly waved back to the enthusiastically cheering masses. Children presented bouquets to Kim Jong Un and Ri Sol Ju, Xi Jinping and Peng Liyuan. Among the audience were Choe Ryong Hae, Pak Pong Ju and Kim Jae Ryong, leading officials of the Party and the government, officials of the armed forces organs, ministries and national institutions and citizens in Pyongyang. Ding Xuexiang, Yang Jiechi, Wang Yi, He Lifeng, Song Tao and other entourage members of the Chinese side, members of the Chinese embassy here, Chinese guests and students here also enjoyed the performance. Amid the playing of the song "DPRK-China Friendship Will Be Immortal", the national flags of the two countries were hoisted. The performers artistically represented the glorious development course and history of the heroic struggle of the DPRK which has emerged as a socialist state independent in politics, self-supporting in economy and self-reliant in defence, winning great victories and bringing about epoch-making changes under the leadership of the WPK with the peerlessly great men held in high esteem. Prestigious art troupes put on the stage such Chinese songs as "No New China without Communist Party", "We Sing of Motherland", "I Love Thee, China", "New World", "The Fluttering Red Flag", which impressively represented the thoughts and feelings of the Chinese people who are achieving the prosperity of the Chinese nation under the guidance of the CPC. Displayed by the background stand were pictures of historic significance showing deep comradely trust and friendship which was forged by the leaders of the elder generations of the two countries and is being steadily carried forward by the top leaders of the parties of the two countries. Friendly feeling swept the stadium amid the peculiar display of Chinese folk dances and welcome dances and letters "Long Live the Invincible Friendship and Unity between the Peoples of the DPRK and China!" Fireworks were displayed at the end of the performance. Kim Jong Un, together with Xi Jinping, warmly waved back to the performers and audience. Floral baskets were presented to the performers. Kim Jong Un and Ri Sol Ju, together with Xi Jinping and Peng Liyuan, went down to the stage to congratulate the performers on their successful performance. Political News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Hosts Banquet for President Xi Jinping
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, and his wife Ri Sol Ju hosted a grand banquet on Thursday evening in welcome of the DPRK visit by Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and president of the People's Republic of China, and his wife Peng Liyuan. Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and his wife gladly greeted President Xi Jinping and his wife at the venue of the banquet. Present there were Choe Ryong Hae, Pak Pong Ju, Kim Jae Ryong and other senior officials of the Party and the government, and commanding officers of the Korean People's Army. Invited to the banquet were the entourage of the Chinese side including Ding Xuexiang, Yang Jiechi, Wang Yi, He Lifeng and Song Tao, and members of the Chinese embassy here. The Supreme Leader made a speech welcoming the Chinese president's visit to the DPRK. The Supreme Leader warmly welcomed the Chinese president and his wife who came with warm friendly feelings of the Chinese people on behalf of the WPK Central Committee, the DPRK government and all the Party members and other people of the DPRK and for his own part. The Pyongyang citizens' enthusiastic cheers in every street of Pyongyang today reflect the deep and friendly feelings of the Party and people of the DPRK toward the Chinese party and people and come to be a strong demonstration of the great DPRK-China friendship, the Supreme Leader said. He recalled that the revolutionaries and peoples of the two countries had their destinies united into one in the flames of the sacred struggle for realizing the common socialist idea in the early days of their struggle and created valuable traditions of genuine comradely friendship, unity, support and cooperation. He said the past four rounds of meetings and talks with the general secretary confirmed again the truth that socialism is the unchangeable core of the DPRK-China friendship and the peculiarity and invincibility of the DPRK-China friendship lie in defending and glorifying socialism by pooling efforts, adding that the general secretary's visit serves as great political support and encouragement to the party members and people of the DPRK out in the accomplishment of the cause of socialism. Expressing the belief that the two countries would as ever give full play to their unity and solidarity and surely achieve brilliant victories in the struggle for achieving progress in the cause of socialism, the Supreme Leader expressed the firm belief that the Communist Party of China and the Chinese people would register greater successes in the struggle for effecting a fresh miracle of the Chinese nation under the guidance of the general secretary. General Secretary Xi Jinping made a reply speech. He extended the sincerest greeting and heartfelt thanks to Chairman Kim Jong Un and his wife Ri Sol Ju, the party, government and people of the DPRK on behalf of the Chinese party, government and people for the grand and warm welcome accorded by the leading officials of the Party, government and army of the DPRK and hundreds of thousands of Korean people. Pointing out that the Korean party and people have tackled a variety of ordeals and difficulties and performed prominent exploits through a resolute struggle by dint of the single-minded unity under the direction of President Kim Il Sung, General Secretary Kim Jong Il and Chairman Kim Jong Un, Xi Jinping said that today the party and the people of the DPRK are effecting a new leap forward in the socialist construction in one mind under the strenuous leadership of Chairman Kim Jong Un. He expressed the belief that the socialist cause of the DPRK would steadily register new and bigger successes and advance toward a more beautiful future under the guidance of the Workers' Party of Korea headed by Chairman Kim Jong Un. He noted that the party, government and people of China firmly support Chairman Kim Jong Un leading the Korean party, government and people to preserve socialism, enforce the new strategic line and accelerate the course of the political settlement of the peninsula issue and thus create a good environment for self-development. He expressed his will to jointly carve out a beautiful future of the China-DPRK relations and a beautiful future of durable peace and co-prosperity in the region by inheriting history, hewing out future and achieving unity and cooperation together with the DPRK side. The banquet proceeded in a warm and amicable atmosphere. Political News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Has Talks with President Xi Jinping
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, had talks with Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and president of the People's Republic of China (PRC), on Thursday afternoon. The Supreme Leader of the Party, state and armed forces Kim Jong Un and his wife Ri Sol Ju visited the Kumsusan State Guest House. They exchanged warm greetings and had a pleasant chat with Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan in a family atmosphere before having a photo taken against the background of the national flags of the two countries. Then, the talks were held between the top leaders of the two countries. Present at the talks from the DPRK side were Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK, member of the SAC of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, Ri Yong Ho, member of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK, member of the SAC of the DPRK and foreign minister, Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK, member of the SAC of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, and Kim Su Kil, member of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK, member of the SAC of the DPRK and director of the General Political Bureau of the Korean People's Army. Present there from the Chinese side were Ding Xuexiang, member of the Political Bureau, member of the Secretariat and director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee, Yang Jiechi, member of the Political Bureau and director of the Office of the Foreign Affairs Commission of the CPC Central Committee, Wang Yi, state councilor and foreign minister of the People's Republic of China, He Lifeng, vice-chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference and head of the National Development and Reform Committee, Song Tao, head of the International Liaison Department of the CPC Central Committee, Zhong Shan, minister of Commerce of the PRC, and Miao Hua, director of the political affairs department of the Central Military Commission of the PRC. Warmly welcoming Xi Jinping's visit to the DPRK this year that marks the 70th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the DPRK and China, Kim Jong Un highly appreciated that his visit comes to be a decisive occasion to demonstrate the immutability and invincibility of the DPRK-China friendship before the world and is of great significance in further consolidating the friendly relations between the two countries that greeted a new age of vitality. Xi Jinping said that he was very pleased to meet Kim Jong Un again, and expressed his thanks to the leading officials of the Party and the government of the DPRK and leading officials of the armed forces organs and citizens in Pyongyang for warmly greeting and welcoming him. Kim Jong Un and Xi Jinping informed each other of the situations of their countries and successes gained by the two parties and peoples of the two countries in their struggle for advancing the cause of socialist construction, and extended their full support and solidarity to them. Stressing that it is the consistent stand of the parties and the governments of the two countries to steadily and energetically develop the traditional DPRK-China friendly and cooperative relations as required by the times and it fully conforms with the aspiration, desire and basic interests of the peoples of the two countries, they proposed brilliant plans for greeting the 70th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the DPRK and China with more significance and exchanged their views on them. Both sides agreed on making positive joint efforts to promote close strategic communication between the two parties and the two countries, deepen mutual understanding and trust, maintain the tradition of high-level visit and strengthen exchange and cooperation in every field. The top leaders of the two countries exchanged extensive views on important international and regional matters including the situation of the Korean peninsula, and appreciated that to further develop in depth the relations between the two parties and the two countries conforms with the common interests of the two countries and favors the regional peace, stability and development now that serious and complicated changes are happening in international and regional situations. The talks proceeded in a comradely, sincere and candid atmosphere and brought about common understanding of discussed issues. Political News Team

title: Xi Jinping Arrives in Pyongyang
body: At the invitation of Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC) and president of the People's Republic of China (PRC), arrived in Pyongyang by his personal plane Thursday to pay a state visit to the DPRK. Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un greeted him at Pyongyang International Airport. Kim Jong Un and his wife Ri Sol Ju came out to the airport. Present there were Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the WPK Central Committee, and Ri Man Gon, Ri Su Yong, Choe Hwi, Kim Yong Chol, Ri Yong Ho and Kim Yo Jong, senior Party and government officials, and Ji Jae Ryong, DPRK ambassador to China. Kim Su Gil, Ri Yong Gil, No Kwang Chol and other commanding officers of the Korean People's Army (KPA) were on hand. Ambassador Li Jinjun and staff members of the Chinese embassy here were seen at the airport. At 12:00, Kim Jong Un had an emotional meeting with Xi Jinping. Kim Jong Un warmly took hands of Xi Jinping and exchanged friendly greetings with him. Giving his impression of the long-desired visit to Pyongyang, Xi Jinping expressed heartfelt thanks to the Korean people for the grand welcome. Arriving together with him were Ding Xuexiang, member of the Political Bureau, member of the Secretariat and director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee, Yang Jiechi, member of the Political Bureau and director of the Office of the Foreign Affairs Commission of the CPC Central Committee, Wang Yi, state councilor and foreign minister of the PRC, He Lifeng, vice-chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference and head of the National Development and Reform Committee, Song Tao, head of the International Liaison Department of the CPC Central Committee, Zhong Shan, minister of Commerce of PRC, Miao Hua, director of the Political Affairs Department of the Central Military Commission of the PRC, and other entourage. Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan were presented with bouquets by children. Kim Jong Un introduced to Xi Jinping the leading officials of the Party and the government and the commanding officers of the KPA who came to greet him. Kim Jong Un exchanged greetings with Chinese side's suite members. A welcoming ceremony took place. Xi Jinping, guided by Kim Jong Un, reviewed the guard of honor of the KPA. Kim Jong Un and Xi Jinping mounted the stand to see the march-past of the guard of honor of the KPA. Xi Jinping, together with Kim Jong Un, waved back to the enthusiastically cheering children, schoolchildren and masses. The car carrying Xi Jinping headed for the Kumsusan State Guest House, lodging quarters, escorted by motorcycles. Pyongyangites warmly welcomed Xi Jinping along the route of various places including Sunan District, Ryonmot-dong, Ryonghung Crossroads and the plaza of the April 25 House of Culture. Kim Jong Un, together with Xi Jinping, transferred into an open limousine at Ryonghung Crossroads. Kim Jong Un and Xi Jinping warmly waved back to the citizens. The open limousine carrying the top leaders of the DPRK and China arrived at the plaza of the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun through Ryomyong Street crowded with the welcoming citizens. Xi Jinping was greeted by Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, first vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, member of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, and other senior Party and government officials and leading officials of the Party and power organs of the capital city. Women artistes presented bouquets to Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan. Kim Jong Un introduced to Xi Jinping the cadres of the Party and government. There were seas of graceful dances of the masses amid the nimble rhythmic rendition of the women's brass band at the plaza. The car carrying the top leaders of the two countries left the plaza of the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun to arrive at the Kumsusan State Guest House amid the warm welcome by the citizens with the flags of the two countries and bunches of flowers in their hands. The employees of the Kumsusan State Guest House presented bouquets to Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan. Kim Jong Un, together with his wife Ri Sol Ju, personally guided Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan to the lodging quarters and had a pleasant chat. Political News Team

title: Egyptian Charge D' Affaires Ad Interim Hosts Reception
body: Haitham Safey Eldin, Egyptian charge d' affaires ad interim here, gave a reception at the Taedonggang Diplomatic Club on Thursday to mark the Day of Africa. Present there on invitation were Pak Myong Guk, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, officials concerned and foreign diplomatic envoys and representatives of international bodies here. The staff members of the Egyptian embassy were on hand. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of DPRK Olympic Committee Leaves for Switzerland
body: A delegation of the DPRK Olympic Committee led by Chairman Kim Il Guk, minister of Physical Culture and Sports, left here on Thursday to visit Switzerland. Rodong Sinmun

title: Implementation of June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement Called for
body: The June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement should surely be implemented for peace in the Korean peninsula and the rest of the world. The Pioneer Party of Indonesia and the Indonesia-Korea Association for Friendship and Cultural Exchange said this in their joint statement on June 11 to mark the first anniversary of the adoption of the June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement. The statement noted that June 12 this year is the first anniversary of the first DPRK-U.S. summit meeting and talks held in Singapore and the adoption of the DPRK-U.S. joint statement. It demanded that the U.S. thoroughly implement the joint statement and do not throw a wet blanket over the atmosphere of peace on the Korean peninsula. It went on: The U.S. should work hard to build confidence with the DPRK with a new way of calculation. We fully support the Korean people in their struggle for peace and reunification of the Korean peninsula. Rodong Sinmun

title: Preserving Juche Character and National Identity Is Fundamental Principle for Independent Development of State
body: June 19 marks the 22nd anniversary of the publication of Chairman Kim Jong Il’s work “On Preserving the Juche Character and National Character of the Revolution and Construction”. The work, published on June 19, Juche 86 (1997), indicates the correct ways for all countries to make development as a full-fledged independent and sovereign state while smashing the moves of the imperialist and dominationist forces. The work serves as important guidelines as it clarifies that preserving the Juche character and national character is fundamental to ensuring the independent development of a state and herein lies its great significance. The Juche character and national character are the life of a country and nation that guarantees their prosperity and the victorious advance of the revolution and construction. The historical experience and lesson show that preserving the Juche character and national character is the key issue decisive of victory or failure in the revolution and construction, and the one vital to the destiny of the country and nation. Preserving the Juche character and national character provides a firm guarantee for the country and nation to defend and glorify their independent dignity and make steady progress with true quality as befits a state. Kim Yong Il

title: Xi Jinping Places Floral Basket at Friendship Tower
body: Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC) and president of the People's Republic of China (PRC) who is on a state visit to the DPRK, laid a floral basket at the Friendship Tower on Friday. Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, and his wife Ri Sol Ju greeted Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan at the Friendship Tower. Present at the floral basket-laying ceremony were Ding Xuexiang, Yang Jiechi, Wang Yi, He Lifeng, Song Tao and other entourages of the Chinese side. Also attending it were Choe Ryong Hae, Pak Pong Ju and other senior officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs and officials concerned. The guard of honor of the Korean People's Army (KPA) lined up at the Friendship Tower. The national anthems of the two countries were played. A floral basket was placed at the tower in the name of Xi Jinping. Written on the ribbon were letters saying "The Martyrs of the Chinese People's Volunteers Will Be Immortal". Kim Jong Un and Xi Jinping, together with the participants, paid silent tribute to the memory of the martyrs of the Chinese People's Volunteers. Then there was a march-past of the guard of honor of the KPA. Being told about the Friendship Tower, Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan looked round the tower symbolic of the DPRK-China friendship sealed in blood. Xi Jinping wrote in the visitor's book: "Friendship will be handed down through generations with longing for the martyrs. Xi Jinping June 21, 2019" Political News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Hosts Luncheon for President Xi Jinping and His Wife Peng Liyuan
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), visited the lodging quarters of Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and president of the People's Republic of China, and hosted a luncheon for Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan. The top leaders of the two countries and their wives exchanged warm greetings and walked together in the garden of the lodging quarters to deepen their friendship in a harmonious atmosphere. The top leaders respectively referred to major internal and external policies of their countries and had a profound conversation, exchanging constructive views on domestic and international issues of mutual concern. The top leaders of the two countries continued discussions about a series of plans for strengthening collaboration to more significantly decorate this year marking the 70th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic ties between the DPRK and China and to get greater satisfaction in the friendly relations between the DPRK and China, and about positive promotion of the situation of the Korean peninsula. Then Supreme Leader of the Party, state and armed forces of the DPRK Kim Jong Un and his wife Ri Sol Ju conducted Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan to a specially-arranged luncheon site at the rosarium of the Kumsusan State Guest House and unreservedly sat together with them in a cordial atmosphere like the same family members. Kim Jong Un and Xi Jinping referred to the fact that through the five rounds of meetings in a little more than a year they had profound communications as well as excellent and beneficial talks to have deep understanding of each other, reached a consensus on important issues, deepened the comradely trust and forged special relations of friendship, and expressed their will to creditably carry forward and glorify the friendly relations between the two parties and the two countries in the future, too, whatever the international situation. Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan expressed their thanks to Kim Jong Un and his wife Ri Sol Ju for sincere hospitality and enthusiastic and special reception and protocol events during their visit to Pyongyang. The luncheon proceeded in a harmonious atmosphere overflowing with the feelings of friendship. Political News Team

title: President Xi Jinping Leaves Here
body: Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and president of the People's Republic of China (PRC), who paid a state visit to the DPRK at the invitation of Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, left Pyongyang on Friday afternoon by his personal plane after winding up his successful visit. Supreme Leader of the Party, state and armed forces Kim Jong Un together with his wife Ri Sol Ju saw off President Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan at Pyongyang International Airport. Kim Jong Un and his wife came out to the airport to see off Xi Jinping and his wife. Present at the airport were Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the WPK Central Committee, Party and government officials Ri Man Gon, Ri Su Yong, Choe Hwi, Kim Yong Chol, Ri Yong Ho, Kim Nung O and Kim Yo Jong, and Ji Jae Ryong, DPRK ambassador to China. Seen there were Kim Su Gil, Ri Yong Gil, No Kwang Chol and other commanding officers of the Korean People's Army. Li Jinjun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK, and members of his embassy here were also seen. Cars carrying close Chinese friends arrived at the airport amid the warm send-off by the citizens. Kim Jong Un and Ri Sol Ju warmly took hands of Xi Jinping and Peng Liyuan who got off a car, and exchanged greetings with them. A ceremony took place to see off Xi Jinping. Kim Jong Un, together with Xi Jinping, reviewed the guard of honor of the KPA. Xi Jinping and Peng Liyuan were presented with bouquets by pretty children. The top leaders of the two countries respectively exchanged farewell with the officials of each other's side. Kim Jong Un and Xi Jinping exchanged firm handshake of farewell, promising to steadily bring about efflorescence and development of the DPRK-China friendship of the great new era in line with the wishes of the two parties and two peoples. Xi Jinping and Peng Liyuan boarded the plane, bidding warm farewell to the citizens. The plane left the airport at 15:30. Kim Jong Un together with Ri Sol Ju waved their hands long toward the plane carrying the friendly mission of the Chinese people. Political News Team

title: Constituencies, Sub-constituencies for Elections of Deputies Organized in DPRK
body: Constituencies and sub-constituencies for the elections of deputies to the provincial (municipal), city (district) and county people's assemblies have been organized till Friday, according to the DPRK Law on the Elections of Deputies to the People's Assemblies at All Levels. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK-China Friendship Further Consolidated through Upheavals of History
body: DPRK-China relationship is an invincible friendly one which is closely bound by militant friendship and trust. During the protracted revolutionary struggle, revolutionaries of the DPRK and China fought shoulder to shoulder for the common cause. In those days their sense of fidelity as close revolutionary comrades-in-arms was deepened and comradely trust solidified. The leaders of the old generation of the two countries provided the historical root of DPRK-China friendship and grew it strongly. President Kim Il Sung established solid comradely relations with Chinese revolutionaries at a time when he was organizing and commanding the great anti-Japanese war for liberating Korea in vast areas of the homeland and Northeast China with Mt. Paektu as its axis. Vividly engraved in every battle zone of anti-Japanese war is the world of noble devotion and internationalist fidelity of Kim Il Sung who provided the precious tradition of DPRK-China friendship, defying death hand in hand with revolutionaries of China. Feats performed by a number of martyrs who self-sacrificingly fought for victory of the revolution and common ideal of the two countries during the great anti-Japanese war became a valuable foundation for growing a large tree of DPRK-China friendship. When a civil war broke out in China after the defeat of Japanese imperialism, revolutionaries and peoples of the two countries fought shoulder to shoulder and further deepened the feelings of friendship forged in the days of the bloody anti-Japanese war.
