A large number of sons and daughters of Korea unhesitatingly sacrificed their precious lives and blood for the birth of a new China in fierce battles in the China proper and in the course of advancing a long distance as far as Hainan Dao, to say nothing of operations to liberate Changchun, Jilin and Shenyang that brought about a decisive turn in the war for liberating Northeast China. Even when our country was placed under the very difficult condition right after its liberation, Kim Il Sung assisted the Chinese revolution both materially and morally including sending huge amounts of military munitions such as weapons, ammunitions, explosives, medicines, etc on many occasions. And he even went to Dandong of China in person and took strategic and tactical measures to make a fundamental change in the front situation. A Chinese publication said: Led by President Kim Il Sung, the Workers’ Party of Korea, the DPRK government, the Korean People’s Army and broad segments of Korean people selflessly aided wars of liberating northeast areas and the whole of China though they were under the difficult conditions in which everything had to be rehabilitated immediately after the liberation of Korea. Comrade Mao Zedong said that the five-star red flag of the People’s Republic of China is permeated with the blood shed by Korean martyrs. The might of the blood-sealed ties and friendship between the peoples of the DPRK and China forged and consolidated in the flames of fierce war against the Japanese imperialists and the domestic revolution of China was fully demonstrated in days of the fatherland liberation war of the Korean people. On October 25, 1950, the Chinese Party and government, regarding the trials of the Korean people as their own, dispatched the volunteers composed of fine sons and daughters of the Chinese people to the Korean front under the banner of “Resisting America and Aiding Korea, Safeguarding the Home and Defending the Motherland”. A lot of Chinese volunteers sacrificed their precious youth in the Korean War. Among them are Mao Anying, the son of Mao Zedong, and Hero Huang Jiguang who covered the firing muzzle of the enemy machinegun with his body for the victory of his unit in a battle on Sanggam Pass. The entry of the Chinese People’s Volunteers into the Korean War even under so difficult conditions after the People’s Republic of China was just founded is a manifestation of the revolutionary obligation made in the course of the common struggle against imperialism and a living example of proletarian internationalism. Even now the Korean people do not forget soldiers of the Chinese People’s Volunteers who shed their blood over mountains and fields of Korea during the extremely hard-fought war and hand down their feats generation after generation. The tradition of blood bonds and friendly relations between the two countries that have surmounted all trials, sharing bitters and sweets with each other, has been steadily strengthened and developed on the basis of the comradely trust and revolutionary obligation between the leaders of the two countries. Chairman Kim Jong Il visited China for the first time in the 80s of the last century and deepened comradeship and friendship with the leaders of China, thus making the DPRK-China friendship incessantly consolidated and developed generation after generation and century after century. Entering the new century, too, he visited China on several occasions, adorning the annals of the DPRK-China friendship with immortal exploits. In those days, peoples of the two countries struggled for socialism hand in hand, supporting and cooperating with each other. There is a saying that a deep-rooted tree never sways in the wind and the spring from deep underground does not dry up. Even when anti-socialist moves of the imperialists got more frantic and radical change took place in relations among countries after the end of the cold war, deep-rooted DPRK-China friendship never shook. The DPRK-China friendship which has been proved and consolidated through all kinds of trials and upheavals of history has entered a new stage of development today. Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and Comrade Xi Jinping deepened particular comradeship and friendly relations through several meetings and expressed their will to usher in full upsurge in the DPRK-China friendship as required by the new era. The DPRK-China friendship is valuable legacy bequeathed by the revolutionaries of the elder generation of the two countries and the precious treasure common to the two peoples. The long history of development of the DPRK-China friendly relations proved that any challenge could be met and enormous strength be demonstrated only when the two countries struggle hand in hand. It is the unchangeable will of the parties and peoples of the DPRK and China to steadfastly uphold and glorify forever the great tradition of DPRK-China friendship forged and consolidated by the elder generations, sharing the life and death and intention and feelings with each other. Ri Chol Hyok

title: Spring Silkworms Briskly Raised in Jagang Province
body: Spring silkworms are raised well in Jagang Prpvince. Under the Party policy of converting the province into a silk one its sericulturists raise their silkworms in good health with the copious mulberry leaves they harvested despite an adverse climate. The province built and repaired more than 800 buildings for young silkworms and over 14,000 buildings for adult silkworms which are each coupled with storerooms and processing rooms for mulberry leaves and put its sericulture on a firmer scientific and intensive footing. It produced fertilizer, disinfectants, food additives, etc for its sericultural farms in good time. A cocoon farm of Manpho City, the Songha Cocoon Cooperative Farm of Songgang County and a cooperative farm of Janggang County Town, which were visited by President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il for on-site guidance, settle the problems of feeding, disinfecting and growing silkworms scientifically and technologically to produce healthy ones. The sericultural farms of Huichon City and Chosan and Jasong Counties contrived and applied various innovative technological devices to produce silkworm eggs in the right season and hatch 1.2 times as many of them as before. The sericulturalists of Kanggye City and Sijung and Songwon Counties actively introduce advanced methods into their silk raising and successfully produce many more silkworms without letup. O Mun Il

title: Valuable Technical Devices Invented and Applied
body: Assigned to work in North Phyongan Province, this year alone three-revolution teams contrived and applied more than 100 technical devices and contributed to developing its economy and improving the living standard of its people. At the Tongrim Foodstuff Factory and the Amnokgang General Foodstuff Factory the members of the three-revolution teams made a roller-pressed biscuit former and a water magnetizer on their own and made it possible to augment the quality of their products a great deal. At the Sinuiju Food Administration Station the members of the three-revolution team developed a DC micro motor and an electromagnetic multivariate automatic weigher in cooperation with technicians, thereby increasing the speed of its production by 1.2 times. The members of the three-revolution team of the Thaechon Mushroom Farm applied technical devices to reuse substrates for mushrooms and disinfect and decontaminate them with activated chlorine water, providing a sure guarantee for its increased mushroom output. The members of the three-revolution team of the Sinuiju Dockyard invented and adopted a new technology to better the quality of its castings and economize on a lot of its labor and materials. Yun Un Sim

title: President Kim Il Sung to Be Remembered in Venezuela
body: A Venezuelan committee for remembering President Kim Il Sung was formed on June 11. Oscar Figuera, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Venezuela, was elected chairman of the remembrance committee. The committee decided to organize a remembrance meeting and other political and cultural events on the occasion of the 25th anniversary of demise of the President. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications of DPRK Leaves for Singapore
body: A delegation of the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications headed by Minister Kim Kwang Chol left here Saturday to attend the Asia-Pacific ICT Ministerial Meeting and the Smart Nation Innovations Week to be held in Singapore. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Foreign Ministry Delegation Leaves for Russia
body: A delegation of the Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea led by Vice-Minister Im Chon Il left here Saturday to attend the vice minister-level negotiations between the DPRK and Russian foreign ministries due to be held in Moscow. Rodong Sinmun

title: Art Performance Given by Art Group Members of Korean Art Association of Disabled
body: An art performance is being given by art group members of the Korean Art Association of the Disabled in Phyongsong City, South Phyongan Province from June 18 to mark the Day of Persons with Disabilities. Put on the stage are song and dance "Glory to General Kim Jong Un", mixed chorus "Our National Flag", folk dance "Ongheya" and jugglery "Mystery inside Box" and other colorful numbers. Through the performance, the performers showed their happiness of being trained to be competent soloists, dancers and singers while enjoying the cultural and emotional life to their heart's content. Watching the performance were officials and working people from all walks of life, youth and students, persons with disabilities and their families in the province. The performance goes on. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Personal Letter from U.S. President Donald Trump
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, received a personal letter from President of the United States of America Donald Trump. After reading the letter, the Supreme Leader of the Party, the state and the armed forces said with satisfaction that the letter is of excellent content. Appreciating the political judging faculty and extraordinary courage of President Trump, Kim Jong Un said that he would seriously contemplate the interesting content. Political News Team

title: Collection of Memoirs "Among the People" Vol. 108 Published
body: Vol. 108 of "Among the People", a collection of memoirs, was brought out by the Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House. It contains 16 memoirs telling about the immortal feats and popular personality of President Kim Il Sung who devoted all his life to the prosperity of the country, happiness of the people and realization of the cause of global independence. Among them are "World Admiration for the Great Man's Independent Politics", "Meaningful Recollection at the Wangjaesan Revolutionary Site", "Sacred Trace Left at Ungsang Station", "Love Shown at a Sentry Post Clouded with Powder Smoke" and "Embrace of Mother Who Helped Me Lead a Brilliant Life". Rodong Sinmun

title: Korean People's Struggle for Peace, Prosperity and Reunification Supported by Foreign Figures
body: Saber Ballul, head of the Department of the Political Faculty of University of Damascus in Syria, released a statement on June 12 to mark the first anniversary of the adoption of the June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement. He said that on June 12 last year, a summit meeting and talks were held between Supreme Leader of the DPRK Kim Jong Un and U.S. President Trump for the first time in history and the DPRK-U.S. joint statement was made public. He went on: Mankind expected that the DPRK and the U.S. which has been most hostile to each other on the earth would write a new history. The DPRK answered the international community's demand for peace and prosperity with putting important and strategic decisions into practice. But the U.S. does not implement the DPRK-U.S. joint statement and insists on the demand unacceptable to the DPRK. The U.S. attitude will never work on the DPRK. Songchit Pullarp, chairman of the Organization for the Study of the Juche Idea of Thailand, released a statement on June 12 in support of the Korean people in their struggle for peace, prosperity and reunification of the Korean peninsula. He referred to the significance of the April 27 Panmunjom Declaration and the June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement, and noted that the declaration and joint statement should be implemented for peace and prosperity on the peninsula. Rodong Sinmun

title: Events Held Abroad
body: Events were held in different countries on the occasion of the "period of the international action for peace, prosperity and reunification of the Korean peninsula" and the first anniversary of the June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement. A meeting, round-table talks and seminar were held in Venezuela, Romania and Japan, film shows in Syria, Guinea and Angola and internet photo show in Senegal from June 7 to 12. A video dealing with the first DPRK-U.S. summit meeting and talks was shown at the film shows. Speeches were made at the events. The mayor of Naguanagua City in Carabobo State of Venezuela said that last year was the year when Supreme Leader of the Korean people Kim Jong Un demonstrated his high degree of political calibre and the guarantee of Korea's reunification and global peace was provided under his guidance. The chairman of the Venezuelan National Society for the Study of the Juche Idea said that the joint statement was adopted at the first DPRK-U.S. summit meeting and talks, praising the adoption as a brilliant fruit of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's outstanding diplomatic stratagem, bold decision and will to defend peace. The chairman of the Socialist Party of Romania stressed that Korea, which was a theatre of big powers' fierce scramble for bringing it under their thumb, is now firmly defending its sovereignty and dignity as it has been led by the distinguished leaders possessed of iron pluck and boldness. The chairman of the Romania-Korea Friendship Association demanded that the U.S. stop anti-DPRK sanctions and pressure and come out to implement the joint statement. The chairman of the Japan-Korea Society for Scientific and Educational Interchange and other personages from various circles expressed the will to smash the moves of the forces, which leave no stone unturned to block peace, prosperity and reunification of the Korean peninsula, and to conduct brisk activities in support of the implementation of the joint statement. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Culture Exhibition Held in China
body: The DPRK culture exhibition took place in Beijing, China from June 14 to 20 on the occasion of the first anniversary of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's visit to China. Seen at the exhibition venue were photos of the Supreme Leader's visit to China. Also on display were works of the peerlessly great man, album documenting his energetic external activities, Korean stamps and art pieces associated with the creative talent of the Korean nation. Present at the opening ceremony of the exhibition were the chairman of the China World Peace Foundation and other figures of various circles, masses and staff members of the DPRK embassy in Beijing. Speeches were made at the ceremony. The chairman of the China World Peace Foundation said that the DPRK is an independent country and the Korean people are diligent and good-natured people. The China-DPRK relations of friendship were sealed in blood and the prosperity of the DPRK is beneficial to the peaceful development of China, he said. The secretary general of an organization in Beijing said that this year marks the 70th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic ties between China and the DPRK, expressing the will to further activate exchanges between the two countries and thus make contributions to the development of the traditional China-DPRK friendship down through generations. Rodong Sinmun

title: Talks Held between DPRK Foreign Minister and Syrian Deputy Prime Minister
body: Talks were held at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Monday between the DPRK foreign minister and the Syrian deputy prime minister who doubles as minister of Foreign Affairs and Expatriates. Present there from the DPRK side were Vice Foreign Minister Pak Myong Guk and officials of the Foreign Ministry and from the Syrian side were members of the Syrian government delegation and Syrian ambassador to the DPRK Tammam Sulaiman. At the talks, DPRK Foreign Minister Ri Yong Ho and Syrian Deputy Prime Minister Walid Al-Muallem underscored the need to further develop the historic and traditional relations of friendship and cooperation between the two countries provided by the preceding leaders. They exchanged deepened views on regional and international matters and reached a consensus of them, reaffirming their commitments to boosting mutual support and solidarity. At the end of the talks a MOU on political negotiations between the DPRK Foreign Ministry and the Syrian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Expatriates was signed. Rodong Sinmun

title: British Ambassador to DPRK Hosts Reception
body: British Ambassador to the DPRK Colin James Crooks gave a reception on Monday on the occasion of the national day of Britain. Present there on invitation were officials concerned and foreign diplomatic envoys and representatives of international bodies here. Staff members of the British embassy were on hand. Rodong Sinmun

title: Reception Given for Syrian Government Delegation
body: The government of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea hosted a reception at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Monday in honor of the visiting delegation of the government of the Syrian Arab Republic. Present there on invitation were members of the delegation of the government of the Syrian Arab Republic headed by Deputy Prime Minister Walid Al-Muallem, who is also minister of Foreign Affairs and Expatriates, and Syrian Ambassador to the DPRK Tammam Sulaiman. DPRK Foreign Minister Ri Yong Ho and other officials of the Foreign Ministry were on hand. Rodong Sinmun

title: Lao Guests Visit Statues of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: A delegation of the Lao Federation of Trade Unions Monday visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill. The guests laid bouquets and made a bow before the statues of the great leaders. Rodong Sinmun

title: Lao Delegation Here
body: A delegation of the Lao Federation of Trade Unions headed by Vice-President Aly Vongnorbountham arrived here on Monday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of National Tourism Administration Leaves for Cuba
body: A delegation of the National Tourism Administration of the DPRK headed by General Director Jo Song Gol left here on Monday to visit Cuba. Rodong Sinmun

title: Members of Lao Embassy Visit Chongryu Junior Middle School
body: Sisavath Khamsaly, Lao ambassador to the DPRK, and his embassy members visited DPRK-Laos Friendship Chongryu Junior Middle School in Taedonggang District on Monday on the occasion of the 45th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Lao People's Democratic Republic. They looked round different places of the school and enjoyed an art performance given by the schoolchildren. They donated education equipment to the school. Earlier, they toured the International Friendship Exhibition House, Pyongyang Teacher Training College and the Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace. Rodong Sinmun

title: Union of Korean Writers and Artists in Japan Marks Its 60th Birthday
body: A meeting was held at the Central Hall of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) in Tokyo on June 8 to mark the 60th founding anniversary of the Union of Korean Writers and Artists in Japan (UKWAJ). Present there were Pae Jin Gu, vice-chairman and concurrently director general of the General Affairs Department of the Central Standing Committee of Chongryon, Kim Song Hun, director of the Department for Publicity and Culture, Yun Chung Sin, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the UKWAJ, and other leading officials of organizations and affiliates of Chongryon, and Korean artistes and creators. A congratulatory message from the Central Committee of the General Federation of the Unions of Art and Literature of Korea was read out at the meeting. Pae Jin Gu made a congratulatory speech. He underscored the need to live up to the trust and expectations of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un by opening up a new heyday of the literature and art of Chongryon true to his policy speech. He called for adopting a more unique approach towards the production of literary and art works dealing with the great personality of the Supreme Leader, the dynamic look of the homeland and the beautiful mental world of the compatriots. Yun Chung Sin in a report underscored the need to usher in a new heyday of the literature and art of Chongryon so as to firmly preserve the national character of the Korean community in Japan and make a positive contribution to inspiring the compatriots to a patriotic campaign. A letter to Kim Jong Un was read out at the meeting. That day there were a film show, photo exhibition and reception in celebration of the anniversary. Rodong Sinmun

title: Mirae Sci-Tech Center Inaugurated at Kim Chaek University of Technology
body: The Mirae Sci-Tech Center has been built at Kim Chaek University of Technology, a pedigree establishment for training sci-tech talents of the country. It has development rooms and labs with modern equipment for developing, producing and testing products of up-to-date technology, international symposium hall, conference room, interview room, etc. An inaugural ceremony was held on Monday in the presence of Kim Nung O, chairman of the Pyongyang City Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), Vice-Premier Jon Kwang Ho, Department Director of the WPK Central Committee Choe Tong Myong, Chairman of the Education Commission Kim Sung Du, officials concerned, and officials, teaching staff and students of the university. Rodong Sinmun

title: Many Stamps Displayed
body: Many Korean stamps were on display at the Korean Stamp Exhibition House to mark the third anniversary of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's election as chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. Stamps carrying photos of the peerlessly great men have been exhibited there, divided into two groups titled "The great succession" and "The age of change". The stamps represent the great personality of the Supreme Leader who has creditably accomplished the cause of immortalizing the great leaders out of the noblest moral obligation. They also deal with the patriotic devotion made by the Supreme Leader to build a powerful socialist country, and with the revolutionary exploits he performed by bringing about a turning point in the Korean revolution and steering the global politics with his far-sighted wisdom, warm love for the nation and outstanding diplomacy. The stamp exhibition is going to be held from June 25 to July 4. Rodong Sinmun

title: Laotian Embassy Hosts Reception
body: The Laotian embassy here hosted a reception at the Taedonggang Diplomatic Club on Tuesday to mark the 45th anniversary of diplomatic relations between the DPRK and Laos. Present there on invitation were Foreign Minister Ri Yong Ho, Cha Hui Rim, chairman of the Pyongyang City People's Committee who is chairman of the DPRK-Laos Friendship Association, Ryu Myong Son, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and other officials concerned. Lao Ambassador Sisavath Khamsaly and his embassy members and a delegation of the Lao Federation of Trade Unions on a visit to the DPRK were on hand. Speeches were made. The Lao ambassador said that the meeting between President Kaysone Phomvihane, the respected leader of the Lao people, and President Kim Il Sung, the great leader of the Korean people, was a historic occasion of great significance in developing the bilateral relations. Pointing out that Laos always supports the just line and policies of the DPRK for reunification and peace of the Korean peninsula, he expressed the belief that the Korean people would register new successes in the building of a powerful socialist nation and accomplishment of the cause of national reunification under the guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Ri Yong Ho recalled that the friendly and cooperative relations between the DPRK and Laos have invariably developed for the past 45 years, witnessing mutual comradely support and cooperation for the accomplishment of the cause of socialism, despite the complicated international situation. It is the consistent stand of the DPRK government to develop the bilateral friendly and cooperative relations on to a higher stage as required by the new era, he stressed. Rodong Sinmun

title: Sports Officials Leave for China
body: A friendly delegation of sports officials led by Kim Jong Su, first vice minister of Physical Culture and Sports, left here on Tuesday to visit China. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Gift from Head of Syrian Government Delegation
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a gift from the head of a Syrian government delegation on a visit to the DPRK. It was handed over to Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, by Walid Al-Muallem, deputy prime minister and minister of Foreign Affairs and Expatriates of Syria who is leading the Syrian government delegation, on Tuesday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Choe Ryong Hae Meets Syrian Government Delegation
body: Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, met and had a friendly talk with a Syrian government delegation led by Walid Al-Muallem, deputy prime minister and minister of Foreign Affairs and Expatriates, at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Tuesday when the delegation paid a courtesy call on him. Rodong Sinmun

title: Ri Su Yong Meets Syrian Government Delegation
body: Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, met and had a friendly talk with a Syrian government delegation led by Walid Al-Muallem, deputy prime minister and minister of Foreign Affairs and Expatriates, on Tuesday when the delegation paid a courtesy call on him. Rodong Sinmun

title: Syrian Government Delegation Visits Mangyongdae
body: A Syrian government delegation led by Walid Al-Muallem, deputy prime minister and minister of Foreign Affairs and Expatriates, visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. The guests laid bouquets at the old home of the President before looking round the historic relics, being briefed on the revolutionary history of the President and his patriotic family. The head of the delegation made an entry in the visitor's book. The delegation also visited the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum, the Museum of Weapons and Equipment of the Korean People's Army, etc. Rodong Sinmun

title: Foreign Bodies Release Statements
body: Foreign organizations made public statements between June 5 and 15 on the occasion of the 19th anniversary of the adoption of the June 15 North-South Joint Declaration. The Swiss Organizing Committee for the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu, the Switzerland-Korea Committee and the Swiss Group for the Study of the Juche Idea said in a joint statement that the June 15 North-South Joint Declaration was provided by the noble patriotic will of leader Kim Jong Il. Thanks to the energetic leadership of Chairman Kim Jong Un for national reconciliation and unity, a new era of peace and prosperity was ushered in on the Korean Peninsula, the joint statement noted, adding: It is illustrated by the three rounds of inter-Korean summits last year and the adoption and publication of the Panmunjom Declaration and the September Pyongyang Joint Declaration. The joint statement stressed that Kim Jong Un performed great feats of world-historic significance in carrying out President Kim Il Sung's and leader Kim Jong Il's instructions for national reunification. The British Association for the Study of Songun Policy, the British Group for the Study of the Juche Idea, the Korean Friendship Association UK and the British Solidarity Committee for Peace and Reunification of the Korean Peninsula said in a joint statement that the June 15 North-South Joint Declaration based on the idea of By Our Nation Itself calls for resolving the issue of the reunification of the country by the concerted efforts of the Korean nation. The adoption of the declaration was the noble fruit of the great devotion of Kim Jong Il who dedicated his all to Korea's reunification, the statement said. It expressed the full support for the Korean people in their struggle to reunify the country without fail. The France-Korea Friendship Association in its statement referred to the historic significance of the adoption of the above-said declaration. Rodong Sinmun

title: German Bodies Back June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement
body: The Anti-Imperialist Forum of Germany and the Berlin Juche Idea Study Group of Germany released a joint statement on June 12 on the occasion of the first anniversary of the adoption of the June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement. The statement expressed the full support for the DPRK-U.S. joint statement adopted in Singapore in June last year, saying that it is the fruit of the great bold decision of the respected H.E. Kim Jong Un to improve the hostile relationship between the DPRK and the U.S. and bring a lasting peace to the Korean Peninsula. The peace-loving policy of socialist Korea coincides with the wish of the world progressives, the statement said, expressing the support for the just cause of the Korean people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Symposium on Greenhouse Vegetable Farming Closes
body: The sci-tech symposium on greenhouse vegetable farming-2019, which opened on June 11, closed with due ceremony at the Pyongyang Vegetable Science Institute under the Academy of Agricultural Science on Wednesday. During the symposium, scientific research successes and technical experience have been presented and sci-tech and practical lectures given with the main emphasis on breeding and introducing new functional vegetable species and putting the production of vegetable on an intensive and modern basis as required by the trend of the world development. "The Experience of the introduction of ring-shaped rotation production system in solar greenhouse" and other papers were highly appreciated at the Scientific Research Successes and Technical Experience Presentation. The lecture "On Functional Vegetable", etc. attracted attention in the participants. Present at the closing ceremony were Pak Thae Dok, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Kim Kwang Uk, president of the Academy of Agricultural Science, officials concerned and officials, researchers and cultivators in the field of greenhouse vegetable production. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to Mozambican President
body: Choe Ryong Hae, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Wednesday sent a message of greeting to Filipe Jacinto Nwussi, president of the Republic of Mozambique, on the occasion of its national day. Expressing the belief that the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation between the two countries would steadily develop, the message sincerely wished the Mozambican president happiness in good health and the Mozambican people bigger successes in their efforts for socio-economic development under his leadership. Rodong Sinmun

title: Syrian Government Delegation Leaves
body: A delegation of the government of the Syrian Arab Republic headed by Deputy Prime Minister Walid Al-Muallem, who is also minister of Foreign Affairs and Expatriates, left here for home on Wednesday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Negotiations Held between Vice Foreign Ministers of DPRK and Russia
body: Negotiations between Vice Foreign Minister Im Chon Il, who is visiting Russia as head of a DPRK Foreign Ministry delegation, and Vice Foreign Minister of Russia Igor Morgulov were held in Moscow on June 24. At the negotiations both sides discussed the issues of further developing the traditional DPRK-Russia friendly relations by boosting exchanges and contacts in various fields, including high-level visit and intensifying economic and cultural cooperation as agreed at the historic DPRK-Russia summit meeting and talks. They also exchanged views on the regional and international issues of mutual concern. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of DFRK Central Committee Leaves for China
body: A delegation of the Central Committee of the Democratic Front for the Reunification of Korea (DFRK) led by Kim Wan Su, presidium member of the Central Committee of the DFRK, left here on Wednesday to visit China. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Reply Message
body: from First Secretary Raul Castro Ruz Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, received a reply message from Raul Castro Ruz, first secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba, on June 13. In the message, Raul Castro Ruz expressed his gratitude to Kim Jong Un for sending warm congratulations on his birthday. He confirmed his willingness to continue to strengthen the ties of historic friendship between the two parties and the governments and peoples of the two countries. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: A home-visiting group of students of Korean high schools in Japan headed by Yun Song Jin, principal of Osaka Korean High School, visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill Wednesday. The members of the home-visiting group laid a bouquet and made a bow before the statues of the great leaders. Rodong Sinmun

title: Tablet to Honor Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Unveiled in Russia
body: A tablet to honor Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un has been displayed at Lesnaya Zaimka Restaurant in Vladivostok, Russia. The employees of the restaurant displayed a tablet to honor Chairman Kim Jong Il, who made an undying contribution to the development of the DPRK-Russia friendly relations, at their restaurant in August 2015. They decided to display another tablet to hand down through generations their honor of having Kim Jong Un at their restaurant. Engraved on the tablet were letters "Comrade Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, visited Lesnaya Zaimka Restaurant on April 26, 2019" in Korean and Russian. The unveiling ceremony of the tablet took place on the spot on June 19. Attending the ceremony were personages of the Maritime Territory Administration, the mission of the Russian Foreign Ministry in Vladivostok and other units, citizens, the DPRK consul general and staff members of the DPRK consulate general in Vladivostok. The participants placed a floral basket and bouquets before the tablets. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Feats Lauded by Personages of Jordan and Lebanon
body: Jordanian and Lebanese personages made public statements on June 18 to mark the 55th anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's start of work at the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Marwan Sudah, chairman of the Arab Committee for Solidarity with Korean People and Supporting the Reunification of Korea, said that leader Kim Jong Il firmly defended the sovereignty and dignity of the DPRK with his rare ideological and theoretical wisdom and outstanding political caliber and performed great feats for the prosperity of the country and happiness of the people. He gave ceaseless field guidance all his life by go-to-the-people train, Marwan Sudah said, adding: He shared the destiny with the people, always finding himself among them, and valued the people's support and trust above all things. Samir Diyab, chief of the Lebanese Group for the Study of the Juche Idea, said that leader Kim Jong Il turned the DPRK into a powerful country under the unfurled banner of socialism, hoping that the Korean people advancing along the road indicated by him would achieve brilliant victories in the struggle for the socialist cause and reunification of the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Olympic Committee Delegation Back Home
body: A delegation of the DPRK Olympic Committee led by Chairman Kim Il Guk, who is minister of Physical Culture and Sports, returned home Thursday after visiting Switzerland. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Foreign Ministry Delegation Back Home
body: A delegation of the Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea led by Vice-Minister Im Chon Il returned home on Thursday after attending the vice minister-level negotiations between the DPRK and Russian foreign ministries held in Moscow. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Children's Paduk Contest and National Amateur Paduk Contest Held
body: A national children's paduk contest and a national amateur paduk contest were held at the Taekwon-Do Hall from June 20 to 27. The contests were held, divided into three groups according to the ages, in the form of men's and women's individuals, mixed doubles and group matches, with more than 270 children and over 90 amateurs selected at provincial try-outs involved. Pyongyang City came first in total standings at the national children's paduk contest and the national amateur paduk contest respectively. Rodong Sinmun

title: Lao Delegation Visits Mangyongdae
body: A delegation of the Lao Federation of Trade Unions headed by Aly Vongnorbountham, vice-president of the Central Committee of the federation, visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. The guests visited the Mangyongdae Revolutionary Museum and looked round the historical mementoes preserved at the old home, being briefed on the patriotic careers of the President and his family members. The delegation also toured the Tower of the Juche Idea, the Monument to Party Founding, the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum, Okryu Children's Hospital and other places and enjoyed the grand gymnastics and artistic performance "The Land of the People". Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of DPRK University Sports Association Leaves for Italy
body: A delegation of the DPRK University Sports Association led by Chairman Jo Chol, vice-chairman of the Education Commission, left here Thursday to take part in the 30th World University Summer Games to be held in Italy. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Basket to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Family of Chinese Anti-Japanese Revolutionary Martyr
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a floral basket from the family of Zhang Wei-hua, a Chinese anti-Japanese revolutionary martyr, Thursday ahead of the third anniversary of his election as chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. Rodong Sinmun

title: Seminars on Chairman Kim Jong Il's Exploits Held Abroad
body: Seminars on Chairman Kim Jong Il's exploits were held in Germany, Pakistan, Syria and Egypt between June 15 and 18 to mark the 55th anniversary of his start of work at the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). The representative of the German Branch of the Korean Friendship Association said that leader Kim Jong Il developed the Party, State and army on the basis of the Juche idea and laid the firm foundation for the building of a powerful socialist nation. The chairman of the Anti-Imperialist Forum of Germany stressed that under the leadership of H.E. Kim Jong Il, the WPK has consolidated the single-hearted unity of the whole society as firm as a rock and fully demonstrated its might as an invincible party guiding the cause of socialism to victory, praising the exploits he performed for party building. The secretary general of the Karachi Branch of the Pakistan-Korea Friendship Association pointed out that leader Kim Jong Il's start of work at the Central Committee of the WPK was an epoch-making event in the history of the WPK, adding that he, possessed of rare wisdom and outstanding caliber, was a prominent man who enjoyed absolute support and trust of the Korean people. The director of the Higher Education Department of the Regional Leadership of the Syria's Baath Arab Socialist Party lauded H.E. Kim Jong Il as the great leader who imbued the WPK with the revolutionary idea of President Kim Il Sung and consolidated the unity and cohesion of the party in every way. Rodong Sinmun

title: Anniversary of Diplomatic Relations between DPRK and Laos Marked in Laos
body: A lecture was hosted by the Laotian Foreign Ministry in Vientiane on June 20 to mark the 45th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the DPRK and Laos. Attending the event were personages of the Laotian Foreign Ministry, the Committee for External Affairs of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party and other units and the DPRK ambassador to Laos and staff members of his embassy. Prior to the lecture, the chief of the diplomatic institute of the Laotian Foreign Ministry in a speech said that the exchange and cooperation between the two countries have proceeded in high gear for several decades since the establishment of diplomatic relations despite the complicated international situation, expressing the expectation that the relations would further expand in the future. Rodong Sinmun

title: President Kim Il Sung to Be Remembered in Austria
body: An Austrian committee for remembering President Kim Il Sung was formed in Vienna on June 17. Eduard Knapp, chairman of the Society for the Promotion of the Relations between Austria and DPRK, was elected chairman of the remembrance committee. The committee set the remembrance period from June 18 to July 8 and decided to organize political and cultural events in praise of the career and feats of the President in the period. Rodong Sinmun

title: Revelation of Japan’s Unchangeable Ambition for Reinvasion
body: Shortly ago, Japan allowed the deployment of another RC-135S of the U.S. air force in Kaneda U.S. air force base under the groundless pretext of bolstering surveillance to cope with the DPRK’s “threat”, and thereby the U.S. air force base came to have two RC-135Ss. Japan is also trying to independently possess an early warning satellite. Such moves are the manifestation of the Japanese reactionaries’ persistent and vicious ambition for reinvasion that remains unchanged even today as they were originated in an ill-boding scheme for an active information warfare against the DPRK. Japan’s information warfare is the prelude to reinvasion and Japan’s addiction to reinforcing the information warfare hints that it works hard to bring earlier the moment of reinvasion. The successive Japanese reactionary ruling quarters have run amuck for a military giant and reinvasion, talking about “threat from north Korea”. They have revived the militarism in Japan to encroach on the whole society and turned the “Self-Defense Forces” (SDF) into the best offensive forces of the capitalist countries, repeating stereo-typed gibberish about “threat from north Korea”. They conducted a joint military exercise in the East Sea of Korea with SDF and foreign naval forces involved under the allegation of “threat” from the DPRK. Now they are trying to have an aircraft carrier and the SDF advances into the Indian Ocean. They are building up public opinion about Japan’s “dominium” over Tok Island in a bid to create a pretext for landing the SDF in the Korean peninsula. The present reality proves once again that the Japanese militarist aggressive nature still remains unchanged and will never change in the future, too. Ri Kyong Su

title: Lao Delegation Leaves
body: A delegation of the Lao Federation of Trade Unions headed by Aly Vongnorbountham, vice-president of the Central Committee of the federation, left here for home on Friday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of Journalists Union of Korea Back Home
body: A delegation of the Journalists Union of Korea headed by Chairman of its Central Committee Cha Sung Su returned home Friday after visiting China. Rodong Sinmun

title: Sports Contest for Pochonbo Torch Prize Closes
body: The Sports Contest for Pochonbo Torch Prize closed with due ceremony at the Nampho Gymnasium on Friday. The contest was held in Pyongyang, Phyongsong, Hamhung, Sariwon, Nampho and other areas, divided into adult and youth groups in dozens of events including football, basketball, volleyball and table-tennis. Present at the closing ceremony were officials concerned, sportspersons and citizens in Nampho. The April 25 Sports Team came first in total standings to win the rotating trophy cup. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of Educationalists Leaves for China
body: A delegation of the educationalists at Kim Chaek University of Technology led by Hong So Hon, president of the university, left here on Friday to visit China. Rodong Sinmun

title: SPA Delegation Leaves for Russia
body: A delegation of the Supreme People's Assembly (SPA) of the DPRK headed by Vice-Chairwoman Pak Kum Hui left here on Friday to attend the second international forum on the development of parliamentary system to be held in Russia. Rodong Sinmun

title: Committee for Remembering President Kim Il Sung Formed by Koreans in China
body: A committee for remembering President Kim Il Sung was formed by the General Association of Koreans in China ahead of the 25th anniversary of his demise. Choe Un Bok, chairwoman of the association, was elected as chairwoman of the remembrance committee. The committee decided to hold various political events in praise of the President's revolutionary career and exploits at the headquarters and branches of the association on the occasion. Rodong Sinmun

title: Events Held Abroad
body: Events were held in different countries to mark the 55th anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's start of work at the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). Seminars on his exploits, book-releasing ceremonies, book and photo exhibitions and lectures were held in Nepal, Ethiopia and Nigeria from May 28 to June 12. The chairman of the Karnali Provincial Committee of the Nepal Communist Party said that the whole world is praising the exploits of H.E. Kim Jong Il, who further developed and enriched the Juche idea founded by President Kim Il Sung and made the DPRK resplendent as the Juche-oriented socialist country. The chairman of the Ethiopian National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism pointed out that H.E. Kim Jong Il built the WPK into the mother party that takes good care of the people's destiny with high responsibility. The chairman of the Ethiopian Committee for the Study of the Independent Politics said that H.E. Kim Jong Il published "Socialism Is a Science" and other works at a time when the global socialist movement underwent the twists and turns, and that he firmly strengthened the DPRK into the socialist fortress centered on the masses, thus instilling confidence in sure victory of socialism into the progressives of the world. Rodong Sinmun

title: President Kim Il Sung to Be Remembered in India
body: An Indian committee for remembering President Kim Il Sung was formed in New Delhi on June 17. Atul Kumar Anjan, chairman of the All India Indo-Korean Friendship Association who is secretary of the National Council of the Communist Party of India, was elected chairman of the remembrance committee. The committee set a remembrance period from June 17 to July 10 and decided to give wide publicity to the revolutionary career of the President and feats he performed for the Korean revolution and the cause of global independence and to hold political and cultural events such as remembrance meeting, seminar, lecture and photo exhibition. Rodong Sinmun

title: Celebration Performances Given
body: There took place art performances in Pyongyang and provinces to celebrate the 3rd anniversary of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's election as chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. Artistes of the national art troupes gave colorful performances at theatres and outdoor stages in Pyongyang. Artistes of the Phibada Opera Troupe and the National Folk Art Troupe gave performances outside the Pyongyang Grand Theatre and the Three-Revolution Exhibition House. Performers sang of the emotion and joy of all the people who elected the Supreme Leader to the top post of the DPRK in such numbers as a female quartet "Our Leader Loved by People". A drama "The Red Snow Is Falling" was given at the National Theatre. Circus and magic performances were given by artistes of the National Acrobatic Troupe at the Pyongyang Circus Theater and the jugglery theatre of the National Acrobatic Troupe. Similar performances were also given in South Phyongan, North and South Hwanghae, Jagang and Ryanggang provinces and other areas. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Authors Works Indicating Way for Economic Construction
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un advanced scientific and revolutionary line and policies for augmenting the might of the self-supporting economy under socialism during his leadership of the revolution and construction in the new era of the Juche revolution. Indicating the goals and tasks for new year to be fulfilled by the Workers' Party of Korea, the state and people in his new year addresses every year, he provided important guidelines for effecting a turn in the economic work of the country. In Juche 101(2012), the first year of the new century of Juche, he authored works like "On Some Tasks for Effecting a Turn in Economic Work", "We Must Put the Production and Construction on Scientific Footing by Applying the Idea of Attaching Importance to Science and Technology" and "On Eliminating the Inclination to Imports". Enshrined in the works are the idea of improving economic work, settling the issue of people's living and providing them with an affluent and highly civilized life, true to the noble intention of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. He also specified tasks for different sectors of the national economy and ways for carrying them out in the works like "Let Us Open Up a Road of Charge in the Building of an Economic Giant by Solving the Problem of Electricity", "Let Us Bring About Innovations in Agricultural Production under the Unfurled Banner of the Socialist Rural Theses", "Let Us Expedite the Construction of the Livestock Farming Base in the Sepho Area and Bring About a Fresh Turn in Developing Animal Husbandry" and "Let's Boost the Fishing Sector and Effect a New Turn in the Development of Fisheries". He also published works like "The Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill Is an Enterprise Associated with the Great Leader's and the General's Life Devoted to Loving the People" and "Let Us Usher in a Great Golden Age of Construction by Thoroughly Applying the Party's Juche-oriented Idea on Architecture", illuminating the direction, tasks and ways of bringing about a surge and renovation in light industry and open up the heyday of construction. At the third plenary meeting of the 7th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea in April, 2018, the Supreme Leader advanced the new strategic line for the entire party and the whole country to channel all-out efforts into the socialist economic construction and aroused all the people to the general revolutionary offensive and the grand advance for economic construction. In his policy speech "On Socialist Construction and the Internal and External Policies of the Government of the Republic at the Present Stage" and in his report and concluding speech at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 7th Central Committee of the WPK, he specified self-reliance as the political line of our party. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of DPRK Red Cross Society Leaves for Mongolia
body: A delegation of the DPRK Red Cross Society headed by Paek Yong Ho, executive vice-chairman of its Central Committee, left here on Saturday to take part in a meeting of leading officials of Red Cross organizations in East Asia region and the celebration of the 80th founding anniversary of the Mongolian Red Cross to be held in Mongolia. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications of DPRK Back Home
body: A delegation of the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications headed by Minister Kim Kwang Chol returned home on Saturday after attending the Asia-Pacific ICT Ministerial Meeting and the Smart Nation Innovations Week held in Singapore. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Meeting Held
body: A national meeting took place at the People's Palace of Culture on Friday to mark the 3rd anniversary of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's election as chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. It was attended by Choe Ryong Hae, Pak Pong Ju, Kim Jae Ryong and senior officials of the Party and the government, officials of the Party Central Committee and leading officials of armed forces organs and officials of the Cabinet, working people's organizations, ministries and national institutions, servicepersons of the Korean People's Army and the Korean People's Internal Security Forces, officials and persons of distinguished services of institutions, factories and enterprises in Pyongyang. Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, made a report. Kim Jong Un's election as chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK at the 4th Session of the 13th Supreme People's Assembly on June 29, Juche 105 (2016) was a political event of great historical significance in the building of the socialist state of Juche, the reporter pointed out. The past three years were the days in which the world has witnessed the outstanding leadership and the great personality of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, who won a series of miraculous victories with his extraordinary wisdom and experienced and seasoned politics, the reporter noted, and went on: The Supreme Leader has put the national power and position of the country on the highest level with his boundless loyalty to the revolution, unshakable faith and strong executive faculty despite the tempest of history. The rare commanding art of the Supreme Leader added momentum to the implementation of the line of making the People's Army politically, ideologically and morally stronger and turned the People's Army into the Party's revolutionary army boundlessly loyal to the leadership of the Party and the matchless army with ever-victorious strategy and tactics and perfect capability for fighting an actual war. And the country's defense industry has developed into the development-and-creation-oriented self-supporting and modern industry of the revolution, which can manufacture any cutting-edge arms and equipment. The Supreme Leader provided the strongest war deterrent amid the death-defying confrontation with imperialism. This is the greatest feat of the Supreme Leader for the country and the people, and this brilliant victory enabled the Korean people to lead a dignified and happy life under the ever-blue sky. Inexhaustible is the national power of Juche Korea regarding self-reliance as the foundation of its existence and motive power of its development and no force on earth can either change the path of the DPRK or stifle it. His firm faith of independence, strategic decision and proactive external activities brought about the great June 12 event and re-establish the relations between the DPRK and big powers, which leads to a visualization of a new horizon for defending global peace and security and building a righteous international society. The DPRK government will accomplish the historical cause of national reunification without fail and work hard to develop the ties of friendship and cooperation with all the countries that respect the DPRK's sovereignty and are friendly to it. The reporter stressed that only victory and glory are in store for Juche Korea as it has Kim Jong Un at the top post of the DPRK, and the 21st century will shine as the century of overall victory of the great Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism. Rodong Sinmun

title: President Kim Il Sung to Be Remembered in Uganda
body: A Ugandan national committee for remembering President Kim Il Sung was formed on June 22 under the co-sponsorship of the Ugandan National Executive Committee of the Pan－African Movement and the Ugandan National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea. Mayambala Lawrence, chairman of the Ugandan National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea, was elected chairman of the remembrance committee. body: A Hungarian committee for remembering President Kim Il Sung was inaugurated in Budapest on June 19. Gyula Thurmer, chairman of the Hungarian Workers' Party, was elected chairman of the committee. It decided to hold political and cultural events praising the feats of the President on the occasion of the 25th anniversary of his demise. Rodong Sinmun

title: Modern Rest Houses in the Majon Recreation Ground
body: Rest houses were built in the Majon Recreation Ground of South Hamgyong Province-a beauty spot on the East Sea of Korea. The Party Committee of South Hamgyong Province dynamically arranged for its officials and workers to bear in mind the intentions of the Party and devote themselves to the building of rest houses. Under the guidance of its Party committee the province supplied rest houses under construction with plenty of materials and effectively used builders to finish them before the sea bathing season this year. They have a holding capacity of 80 and 120 people each. The field construction headquarters worked out its construction program in keeping with actual conditions and saw to it that builders actively applied various advanced building methods and raised the speed and quality of their construction simultaneously. The province adopted far-sighted measures to provide the builders with a large quantity of structural steel, cement, wood, block and others so that the rest houses could be built on schedule and paid close attention to the supply of their fittings and furniture. On completion the rest houses make flawless preparations for their service to please visitors to the recreation ground and consult their convenience. Kim Kyong Chol

title: Principal and Divisional Roads Built in Samjiyon County
body: As of June 24 the leading officials, soldier builders and shock workers of the February 16 Division removed more than 500,000 cubic meters of soil and formed road beds for over 30 kilometers in the township of Samjiyon County and many other districts. They curbed roads for 7,000-odd meters and completed many bridges. Principal and divisional roads must be built in a circular way and paved with asphalt and concrete around a square in the township. Cycling and walking tracks must be laid, and street lamps, traffic signals and signposts, too, set up. This is important in converting the county into an excellent model of the era of the Workers’ Party of Korea. While speeding up the construction of dwellings, public establishments and industrial buildings, under the guidance of its political affairs department the field headquarters of the division maps out a detailed plan of its road building and makes good arrangements for securing building materials and producing in advance what are needed for its construction. The field headquarters ensures by way of demonstration that road builders play a good role in their work, that construction corps build road beds and curb roads to fully meet the demand of technological regulations and building methods and that the experiences of model construction corps are arranged for to be learned after when their daily work assignments are reviewed. The looks of the county are changed day after day beyond recognition amid the revolutionary enthusiasm of the division. O Mun Il

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Has Historic Meeting with U.S. President Donald Trump at Panmunjom
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, had a historic meeting with President of the United States of America Donald Trump at Panmunjom on Sunday afternoon at the suggestion of Trump. The Supreme Leader of the Party, the state and the armed forces of the DPRK accepted the opinion of President Trump that he would like to meet Chairman of the State Affairs Commission Kim Jong Un in the Demilitarized Zone during his June 29-30 visit to south Korea and went to the south side portion of Panmunjom to have a surprise meeting with him. Kim Jong Un stepped out of the Phanmun Pavilion on Sunday afternoon and had a historic meeting with Donald Trump just before the demarcation line at Panmunjom amid the worldwide attention. In 66 years since the Armistice Agreement in 1953 there happened such an amazing event of the top leaders of the DPRK and the U.S. exchanging historic handshakes at Panmunjom, place that had been known as the symbol of division. Kim Jong Un exchanged compliments with Trump about meeting him after about 120 days and guided him toward the north side portion of Panmunjom. The two leaders stepped toward just before the Phanmun Pavilion in the north side portion of Panmunjom where they held their hands again, leaving the historic moment of the sitting U.S. President setting his foot on the soil of the DPRK across the Military Demarcation Line for the first time in history. They headed for the "House of Freedom" in the south side portion of Panmunjom, the venue of the talks, exchanging a pleasant chat. President Moon Jae In greeted Kim Jong Un outside the House. Kim Jong Un exchanged warm greetings with Moon Jae In. Then there were a one-on-one chat and talks between the top leaders of the DPRK and the U.S. They explained issues of easing tensions on the Korean peninsula, ending the inglorious relations between the two countries and making a dramatic turn and also issues of mutual concern and interest which become a stumbling block in solving those issues, and voiced full understanding and sympathy. The top leaders of the two countries agreed to keep in close touch in the future, too, and resume and push forward productive dialogues for making a new breakthrough in the denuclearization of the Korean peninsula and in the bilateral relations. Kim Jong Un said that it was the good personal relations with President Trump that made such a dramatic meeting possible at just a one day's notice, noting that the relations would continue to produce good results unpredictable by others and work as a mysterious force overcoming manifold difficulties and obstacles in the future, too. Present at the talks from the DPRK side was Ri Yong Ho, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, member of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and foreign minister, and from the opposite side U.S. State Secretary Mike Pompeo. The top leaders of the two countries expressed great satisfaction over the results of the talks. After the talks Kim Jong Un exchanged parting words with Trump. Trump and Moon Jae In saw Kim Jong Un off up to the demarcation line at Panmunjom. Political News Team

title: Greetings to President of DR Congo
body: Choe Ryong Hae, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Sunday sent a message of greeting to Felix Antoine Tshilombo Tshisekedi, president of the Democratic Republic of Congo, on the occasion of the 59th anniversary of its independence. Expressing belief that the traditional friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries would grow stronger, the message sincerely wished the president happiness in good health and bigger success in his responsible work for the country's peace, stability and prosperity. Rodong Sinmun

title: Wang Yang Expresses Readiness to Promote China-DPRK Relations
body: The delegation of the Central Committee of the Democratic Front for the Reunification of Korea headed by Presidium Member Kim Wan Su, which is on a visit to China, met with Wang Yang, chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, in Beijing on June 28. Wang Yang said that the China-DPRK friendship is a common asset of both sides which the leaders of the elder generation of the two countries provided and developed, expressing the readiness to creditably put into practice the important common understanding of the top leaders of the two countries and to promote the development of the bilateral relations. He sincerely wished the Korean people greater success in carrying out the new strategic line of the Workers' Party of Korea under the wise leadership of Chairman Kim Jong Un. Present there were Ji Jae Ryong, DPRK ambassador to China; Xia Baolong, vice-chairman and concurrently secretary general of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, and other officials concerned. Earlier, there took place talks between Kim Wan Su, presidium member of the C.C., the Democratic Front for the Reunification of Korea, and Yang Chuantang, vice-chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference. Rodong Sinmun

title: The Communist Party of China That Has Covered Proud Road
body: The Chinese people greeted a historic moment in the struggle for hewing out their destiny on July 1, 98 years ago. That Day the Communist Party of China (CPC) was founded. The foundation of the CPC was a great event as it brought about an epochal turn in the development of the Chinese revolution. Thanks to the leadership of the CPC the Chinese people could wage an organizational and stubborn struggle against foreign forces of aggression and won a victory in the fierce struggle with domestic reactionary forces to greet the birth of a new China. As a result, a new era of prosperity opened on the vast tract of land of China. The CPC has put forward lines and policies reflecting Chinese actual conditions and the interests of the people in each period of the developing revolution and overcame difficulties in reliance upon all the people. It directed big efforts to the work for maintaining social stability and achieving sustainable development of the economy and face-lifted the appearance of the country by achieving great development and changes in politics, economy and culture and all fabrics of social life. By developing science and technology it put the overall national power on the world level of advance and increased weight and influence in the international arena. Today the Chinese people, all out in the struggle for attaining “Two Centenary Goals” in accordance with the strategic assignments set forth at the 19th Party Congress under the seasoned guidance of the CPC with Xi Jinping as the core, are striving to bring about a new prosperity. The Korean people are rejoiced as over their own over the achievements the Chinese people are gaining in the struggle for building socialism with the Chinese characteristics in a new era in the face of difficulties and challenges under the guidance of the CPC, and sincerely congratulate the Chinese people on the 98th founding anniversary of the CPC. Jo Thaek Bom

title: Floral Basket to C.C., Communist Party of China
body: The Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea sent a floral basket to the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC) to mark the 98th founding anniversary of the CPC. Ji Jae Ryong, DPRK ambassador to China, handed the floral basket to Wang Yajun, deputy head of the International Liaison Department of the C.C., the CPC, on June 28. On the same day, a floral basket in the name of the DPRK embassy in Beijing was conveyed to the C.C., the CPC. Rodong Sinmun

body: A friendly delegation of sports officials led by Kim Jong Su, first vice minister of Physical Culture and Sports, came back home on Monday after visiting China. Rodong Sinmun

body: Kent Rolf Magnus Harstedt, special envoy of the Swedish government, and his party arrived here on Monday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Founding Anniversary of Chongryon Hagu Bookshop Marked in Tokyo
body: A meeting for celebrating the 70th founding anniversary of the Hagu Bookshop of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) was held at the Korean Hall in Tokyo on June 21. Present at the meeting were Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of Chongryon; Pak Ku Ho, its vice-chairman, Song Kun Hak, director of its Education Department; Han Tong Song, rector of Korean University; chairpersons of Chongryon headquarters in Kanto; chairpersons of Chongryon branches; leading officials of organizations and affiliates; principals of schools at all levels; students of the Education Faculty of Korean University; Kang Chang Hun, president of the Hagu Bookshop and its employees. Introduced there were a congratulatory message from the Committee for Aiding Overseas Compatriots of Korea and a silk banner from the Joguk Company. Ho Jong Man said in his congratulatory speech that the Hagu Bookshop has overcome manifold hardships and steadily improved the contents and methods of book publishing work to meet the requirements of the developing situation, true to the Juche-oriented idea of education for overseas compatriots clarified by Generalissimos Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il and Marshal Kim Jong Un, adding that the bookshop has made contribution to developing the national education and training the new generations to be talents who love the nation and the country and genuine patriots. He expressed the firm belief that the bookshop would repay great loving care shown by Kim Jong Un with great success in its work. Kang Chang Hun said in a commemorative report that he would make positive efforts to improve the contents and methods of education in keeping with the trend of modern education by carrying forward the tradition of patriotism. A letter to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was read out at the meeting. There was a reception after the meeting. Rodong Sinmun

title: Pak Pong Ju Inspects North Phyongan Province
body: Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the WPK Central Committee, inspected various units in North Phyongan Province. Inspecting the Combined Reed Farm in Sindo County and the Sinuiju Chemical Fibre Mill whose remodeling and updating projects are underway, he discussed the measures to be taken to finish the remodeling and updating projects in the time fixed by the Party and at the level demanded by it. During his inspection of the Taegyedo reclaimed tideland, the Kwaksan reclaimed tideland, the Honggondo reclaimed tideland under second-phase construction and others, he acquainted himself with the real state of supply of manpower, equipment and materials needed for the building of setups of the reclaimed tidelands, and underscored the need to ensure the economic value by increasing the utility rate of the reclaimed tidelands and dynamically wage the campaign for the cultivation of new land and increase the area under cultivation. Rodong Sinmun

title: A Cancer Destroying Peace in Northeast Asia
body: Japanese Minister of Defense Iwaya recently said that Japan would go ahead with a plan for deploying Aegis Ashore, defying the strong protest of the local residents. Aegis Ashore capable of loading SM-3 Block 2A is known as a weapon system to intercept a ballistic missile in outer space. It is a part of the Japanese reactionaries’ desperate moves for a military giant. Aegis Ashore to be deployed in Japan aims at China and Russia, to say nothing of the Korean peninsula. The final aim of Japan for a military giant is overseas aggression. Invasion just means preemptive attack. In the past all wars of aggression began with preemptive attack. Japan, far from drawing a lesson from its defeat in the past, works harder for a military giant, persistently denying its past crimes. It is an outright assertion that Japan will repeat the past. Japan hell bent on the moves for a military giant and reinvasion is a malignant cancer harmful to peace and stability in Northeast Asia. The moves can never be looked with folded arms. Jo Thaek Bom

title: Delegation of Ministry of Defense of Russia Feted
body: The Ministry of the People's Armed Forces Tuesday hosted a reception in honor of the visiting delegation of the Ministry of Defense of Russia. Invited to the reception were the delegation headed by Vice-Minister Alexandr Fomin and staff members of the office of the military attaché of the Russian embassy here. Present there were Army General Kim Hyong Ryong, vice-minister of the People's Armed Forces, and other generals and officers of the Korean People's Army. Speeches were made there. Rodong Sinmun

body: A delegation of the Central Committee of the Democratic Front for the Reunification of Korea (DFRK) led by Kim Wan Su, presidium member of its Central Committee, returned home on Tuesday after visiting China. Rodong Sinmun

title: Juvenile Taekwon-Do Championship for Jongilbong Prize Opens
body: The National Juvenile Taekwon-Do Championship for Jongilbong Prize opened with due ceremony at the Taekwon-Do Hall on Tuesday. The championship brings together Taekwon-Do teams at all levels and players of Korea University of Physical Education, Central Sports School and other organisations. Taekwon-do and Paduk competitions will take place. Present at the opening ceremony were Choe Hwi, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials concerned, players and coaches, youth and students. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Tribute to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: A delegation of the Defense Ministry of Russia visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on Tuesday. The guests laid a floral basket in the name of the Defense Ministry of the Russian Federation and made a bow before the statues. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Premier Inspects Various Units
body: Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, member of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, inspected various units including the February 8 Jikdong Youth Coal Mine and the Kumpho Mine. Making rounds of the work site of Pit No. 9 of the Youth Coal Mine, Kim Jae Ryong stressed the need to positively introduce new technical innovation schemes and build up its repair and maintenance base as an integrated production system has been set up and IT-based production and management have been put on a high level. At the Kumpho Mine he called upon its officials and workers to bear in mind an importance of the mine's duty in putting the metal industry on a Juche basis and put repair of equipment at stope and dressing plants on a regular basis and for relevant units to take thorough-going measures for production conditions including electric power. The field consultative meetings discussed issues arising in taking measures for optimizing the economic work on the basis of scientific calculation and in realizing the integration of science and technology into production so as to give full play to the existing production capacity. The premier also inspected the State Academy of Sciences, the Sunchon Coal-mining Machine Factory and learned about the preparations for building a major power station in Haeju Bay. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of Ministry of Defense of Russia Here
body: A delegation of the Ministry of Defense of Russia led by Vice-Minister Alexandr Fomin arrived here on Tuesday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Introduced by Belarusian Organization

The work, published on April 20, Juche 101 (2012), deals with the revolutionary exploits performed by President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in their lifetime. It also indicates the tasks for staunchly defending and adding eternal luster to the ideology and feats of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il. Rodong Sinmun
