The committee set a remembrance period from June 23 to July 10 and decided to give wide publicity to Kim Il Sung's career and exploits through media and hold political and cultural events in the period. Rodong Sinmun

title: President Kim Il Sung to Be Remembered in Kyrgyzstan
body: A committee for remembering President Kim Il Sung was formed in Bishkek of Kyrgyzstan on June 25. A. Usupbayev, chairman of the Central Council of the People Unity-"Kyrgys El" Republican Political Party of Kyrgyzstan, was elected chairman of the remembrance committee. The committee decided to organize political and cultural events in praise of Kim Il Sung's exploits on the occasion of the anniversary of his demise. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: A home-visiting group of students of Korean high schools in Japan headed by Ho Kyong, principal of Kobe Korean High School, visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill Wednesday. The members of the home-visiting group laid a bouquet and made a bow before the statues. Rodong Sinmun

title: Skilled Workers' Contest Closes
body: The contest of skilled workers with different jobs in various sectors of the national economy-2019 closed. The contest was held, divided into occupational categories of plaster, carpenter, welder, pipe-maker and lathe operator, at major construction sites and factories from May 23. A closing ceremony of the contest of lathe operators took place at the Kusong City Hall of Culture on Wednesday. Earlier, the contests of plasters and carpenters closed in Wonsan City and those of welders and pipe-makers in Sunchon City with due ceremonies. At the closing ceremonies, the standings were made public and prizes were awarded to successful skilled workers. Rodong Sinmun

title: Remembrance Concert Given
body: Workers and members of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea (GFTUK) gave a remembrance concert "Our Leader and Workers" at the Central Hall of Workers on Wednesday ahead of the 25th anniversary of demise of President Kim Il Sung. Put on the stage were narration "Our Leader", male solo "Red Snow Falls in Iron Producing Town", female duet "Leader Visits Our Factory", etc. Performers impressively represented immortal exploits and noble leadership traits of the President who trained the workers to be creators of epochal miracles, always finding himself among them, and brought about a fresh heyday of revolution by relying on the popular masses. There were also numbers singing of the greatest pride and honor of Korean workers and other people who are making revolution under the guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un who is translating the patriotic desire of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il for a powerful country into reality. Among the audience were Choe Hwi, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials concerned, trade union officials and working people in Pyongyang. Rodong Sinmun

title: Talks Held between Members of Ministry of People's Armed Forces and Delegation of Ministry of Defense of Russia
body: Talks were held here between members of the Ministry of the People's Armed Forces and a delegation of the Ministry of Defense of Russia on Wednesday. Present at the talks from the DPRK side were Army Colonel General Kim Hyong Ryong, vice-minister of the People's Armed Forces, and other generals and officers of the Korean People's Army and from the Russian side the delegation of the Ministry of Defense of Russia led by Vice-Minister Alexandr Fomin and members of the office of the military attache of the Russian embassy here. At the talks both sides discussed the issues of putting friendly and cooperative relations between the armies of the two countries on a higher stage. Rodong Sinmun

title: Ri Su Yong Meets Special Envoy of Swedish Government
body: Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, met and had a talk with Kent Rolf Magnus Harstedt, special envoy of the Swedish government, and his party who paid a courtesy call on him, on Wednesday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Editorial
body: Let Us Further Deepen Education in Self-reliance in Keeping with the Requirements of the Developing Situation Only when we firmly believe in ourselves and steadily build up our own strength, can we more fully demonstrate to the whole world the prestige and might of the DPRK and push ahead with the building of a powerful socialist country according to the timetable set by the Party. We, with transparent class consciousness and strong national dignity, should fully display the reserved strength of Juche Korea and its spirit of certain victory by bringing about a new upsurge in all the sectors of socialist construction in our own way and by our own efforts and wisdom. It is only when we fully display the might of the self-supporting economy under the uplifted banner of self-reliance that we will further develop and grow stronger, and successfully attain the goal of building a powerful socialist country. Self-reliance constitutes the foundation of the existence of Korean-style socialism and the motive force of its progress and the eternal lifeline to the Korean revolution. Whatever path others may follow and whatever others may choose for their development, we have no option but to be self-reliant. The sacred revolutionary cause to make all the people live a happy life in a dignified and powerful country can never take a step forward without the efforts and spirit of its own. The dreams and ideals of the people will come true only by national independence and self-respect, and the key to achieving the great ambition to build a powerful country the world will envy is also self-support and its own efforts.

title: Japan Should Not Dream about the Future without Liquidating Its Past
body: There will be no bright future ahead of Japan if it refuses to sincerely atone for the past crimes it committed by colonizing Korea and inflicting misfortune and pain upon many Asian people. The Japanese reactionaries get more desperate in distorting and denying history and Japan is going so shameless in its attitude towards the past. History itself means truth and living evidence. Japan is making desperate efforts to destroy living evidence of its past crimes at any cost. It is aimed to turn the clock of history back to the imperial era when Japan was steeped in aggression and war. It is evidenced by the hoisting of “flag of rising sun shedding rays”, a symbol of the war criminal state, in the heart of Tokyo, the bulwark of Japanese militarism and at the mast of warship, and the adoption of security legislation which allows the “Self-Defense Forces” to extend the scope of their military operation to any parts of the world. However, the vaulting ambition of the Japanese reactionaries for reinvasion is just a daydream. What Japan is obliged to do is unconditional atonement for the crime-woven past and this guarantees the future of Japan. Pak Song Yong

title: Remembrance Meeting Held by Agricultural Workers, Members of UAWK
body: A remembrance meeting "Great Leader will always be with us on the fields of socialist countryside visited by rich harvest" was held by agricultural workers and members of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea (UAWK) at the Chongsan Co-op Farm in Kangso District on Thursday ahead of the 25th anniversary of demise of President Kim Il Sung. Present at the meeting were Kim Chang Yop, chairman of the Central Committee of the UAWK, officials concerned, officials of the union and agricultural workers in Nampho City. The meeting began with chorus "We Are Yearning for Your Sunny Smile". The performers sang of revolutionary exploits of Kim Il Sung who dedicated devotion and tireless efforts to happiness and affluent life of the people through a long journey for field guidance to farms across the country. They expressed their will to bring a rich harvest to every field through a hot wind of scientific farming and high-yield based on the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance, holding fast to the behests of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il as lifeline. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Home-visiting groups of students of Korean University under the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on Thursday. The members of the groups laid bouquets at the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il and paid tribute to them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Families of Those Related to Anti-Japanese Revolutionary Struggle Arrive
body: Families of those related to anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle arrived here on Thursday on the occasion of the 25th anniversary of demise of President Kim Il Sung. Among them were families of Fan Delin and Jiang Zihua, Chinese related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, and the family of Ri Min, China-resident Korean related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle. Rodong Sinmun

title: Russian Delegation Leaves
body: A delegation of the Russian Ministry of Defense led by Vice-Minister Alexandr Fomin left here for home on Thursday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of Russian Defense Ministry Visits Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum
body: A delegation of the Russian Ministry of Defense led by Vice-Minister Alexandr Fomin visited the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum on Thursday. The guests looked round the museum, being told that the service personnel of the Korean People's Army and the people of the DPRK honorably defended the sovereignty of their country and the dignity of their nation in the Fatherland Liberation War under the leadership of President Kim Il Sung. The delegation also visited the KPA Museum of Weapons and Equipment, laid a wreath in the name of the Russian Defense Ministry before the Liberation Tower and saw the grand gymnastics and artistic performance "The Land of the People". Rodong Sinmun

title: Gift to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Delegation of Russian Ministry of Defense
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a gift from a delegation of the Russian Ministry of Defense. The gift was handed to Army General No Kwang Chol, minister of the People's Armed Forces of the DPRK, by Vice-Minister Alexandr Fomin who is leading the delegation of the Russian Ministry of Defense on a visit to the DPRK on Thursday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Minister of People's Armed Forces Meets Delegation of Russian Defense Ministry
body: Army General No Kwang Chol, minister of the People's Armed Forces of the DPRK, met and had a talk with a delegation of the Ministry of Defense of Russia led by Vice-Minister Alexandr Fomin when it paid a courtesy call on him on Thursday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Baskets Laid at Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Staff members of the UN resident coordinator's office and missions of UNDP, UNICEF, UNFPA, FAO, WFP and WHO here Thursday visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill with the approach of the 25th anniversary of demise of the President. They laid floral baskets and made a bow before the statues. Rodong Sinmun

title: Families of Those Related to Anti-Japanese Revolutionary Struggle Arrive
body: Families of those related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle arrived here on Friday on the occasion of the 25th anniversary of demise of President Kim Il Sung. Among them were the families of Zhang Wei-hua, a Chinese anti-Japanese revolutionary martyr, the family of Li Zade, a Korean anti-Japanese revolutionary fighter in China and families of So Sun Ok and Kim Sun Ok, China-resident Koreans related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle. Meanwhile, Families of Shang Yue, Zhou Baozhong, Chai Shiying and Wang Xiaoming, Chinese related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, arrived here on the same day. Rodong Sinmun

title: Oath-taking Meeting Held by Young People
body: Young people of the DPRK held an oath-taking meeting before the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on Friday ahead of the 25th anniversary of demise of the President. Present at the meeting were Choe Hwi, vice-chairman of the C.C., the Workers' Party of Korea, officials of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League, and youth and students in Pyongyang City. Led by Pak Chol Min, chairman of the C.C., the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League, the participants made an oath reflecting the iron faith and will of the Korean young vanguard to build without fail a prosperous and powerful socialist nation on their land resplendent with the august names of the peerlessly great men, firmly united around Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: President Kim Il Sung's Great Personality Lauded by Members of Women's Union
body: A remembrance meeting was held by officials and members of the women's union at the Hall of Women on Friday with the approach of the 25th anniversary of demise of President Kim Il Sung. Attending the meeting were Ri Il Hwan, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Jang Chun Sil, chairwoman of the Central Committee of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea, officials concerned, officials of the union and union members in Pyongyang City. At the meeting speakers lauded Kim Il Sung for his noblest character and virtue. They recollected with deep emotion the great personality of the President who glorified the worthy life of revolutionary fighters with loving care for them. They said that the President is not only the leader of a country but also their father as he kindly took care of all sons and daughters of the country and brought them up to be successors to the revolution and reliable pillars of the country. They stressed that the legendary tales of loving care will as ever continue on this land as Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un carries forward the lofty intention of the great leaders as the father of the socialist great family. Rodong Sinmun

title: Message of Sympathy to Russian President
body: Choe Ryong Hae, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent on July 4 a message of sympathy to Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation, as regards the fact that floods hit some areas in Irkutsk Region, claming casualties and material losses. The message offered deep sympathy and condolence to the Russian president, the victims and bereaved families. It hoped that the Russian government would eradicate the aftereffects of the flood damage at an early date and gain success in its efforts for stabilizing the living of the afflicted people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Families of Those Related to Anti-Japanese Revolutionary Struggle Visit Mangyongdae
body: Families of Fan Delin and Jiang Zihua, Chinese related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, and the family of Ri Min, a China-resident Korean related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. They looked round historic relics, being told that Kim Il Sung was born into the revolutionary and patriotic family and nurtured the great intention to liberate the country. They toured the revolutionary sites on Mangyong Hill. Rodong Sinmun

title: Posters Produced
body: The Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House produced posters on the election for the deputies to provincial (municipal), city (district) and county people's assemblies. The poster "Let Us Brighten the Socialist System of Our Country!" depicts a worker, peasant and intellectual, who are seeing in the day of the election with a high degree of political zeal and labor achievements, against the background of the fluttering DPRK flag and monumental edifices. The poster "Let Us Consolidate the People's Power Rock-solid!" depicts the will of the Korean people to fully display once again the invincible might of the DPRK, a country of the single-minded unity, by voting out of patriotism for the candidates with the pride and honor of being masters of the genuine people's power. Rodong Sinmun

title: Trees Planted and the Lawn Laid Out
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un gave precious instructions to attach as great importance to landscaping and forestation as to construction during his field guidance to the construction site of the Wonsan-Kalma coastal tourist area. True to the instructions, soldier builders and other shock brigade members from ministries, national organs and provinces vigorously pushed ahead with their construction projects as well as with their afforestation, thereby planting more than 350,000 trees and other flowering shrubs of good strains and laying out the lawn hundreds of thousands of square meters in slightly over a year. Our trustworthy soldier builders planted thousands of ornamental pines of various kinds and dozens of good species of flowering shrubs with ardent patriotism to add unique beauty to the maritime city of Wonsan. Last April they formed quick hedges thousands of meters long in a fortnight and planted various kinds of trees, flowering shrubs and flowers to landscape the shore of the East Sea of Korea further. The shock workers, too, afforested the tourist area and laid out the lawn there with the attitude of masters. They provided the young trees with sufficient growing conditions and tended them with all care to raise the rate of their rooting. The Ministry of Urban Management, other ministries, the Pleasure Park General Bureau, other national organs, the People’s Committees of Pyogyang and Kangwon, North Hamgyong and North Phyongan Provinces and those of other provinces supplied the tourist area with trees of superior species, tools and humus soil. Sim Hak Chol

title: The “Cycle”1.0 Disseminated
body: The company for the technology of cyclic dissemination under the Workers’ Party of Korea Publishing House developed “Cycle” 1.0, a system for the study of the works and great charisma of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. It is an encyclopedic e-book reading program which fully comprehends their immortal classic works as well as reminiscences and books on their great and noble charisma and virtues. In the past the WPKPH synthetically analyzed and studied the reading programs developed by many other units to study the works and great charisma of the peerlessly great men of Mt Paektu, and on this basis, did its utmost to establish the advanced integral system for the study of their works and great charisma. The “Cycle” 1.0 contains “Complete Works of Kim Il Sung” (vol. 1-100), “Complete Works of Kim Il Sung” (an enlarged edition vol. 1-4), “Selected Works of Kim Jong Il” (an enlarged edition vol. 1-25), “Complete Works of Kim Jong Il” (vol.1-23), “For the Building of the Strong Socialist Country of Juche” (vol. 1-3) and many other works. It also comprehends the reminiscences “Among the People” (vol. 1-107) and “Adding Luster to the Era of Juche” (vol. 1-76) dealing with the lofty charisma and exceptional virtues of the peerlessly great men as well as “ The Reminiscences of the Anti-Japanese Guerrillas” (vol.1-20) and “The Reminiscences of the Participants in the Fatherland Liberation War”. “The Chronicles of Kim Il Sung’s Victories” (vol. 1-5) and “The Life of A Great Personality” (A Son of a Guerrilla, I’ll Luster You, Korea, Under the Banner of the Party and The Symphony of the Korean Revolution) and other books on their greatness were added to the “Cycle” 1.0. In addition, the “Cycle” 1.0 includes “Time and Justice”, “Kim Il Sung, Great Master of Independent Diplomacy”, “General Kim Jong Il, the Sun of Songun”(an enlarged edition vol. 1-5), “I’ll Love like Comrade Kim Jong Il”, “The Last Farewell and Immortality”, “The Marshal and the Dream of the People”, “Comrade Kim Jong Un, the Great Son of the People” and other fine books which excel all their predecessors in content, width and depth. “The Cycle” 1.0 can perform its function as a searcher for the titles, contents and dates of relevant books. The “Cycle” 1.0 is divided into reading programs for panel computers, network servers, windows and the “Pulgunbyol” operating system to enable users to study the great charisma of the peerlessly great men in real time anywhere and anytime. The company works hard to widely spread the “Cycle” 1.0 through many IT services and state networks while actively stepping up the development of “Cycle” 2.0 which can perform other diverse functions such as vocal reading. Jong Ryu Chol

title: Delegation of Joined Int'l Youth Organizations Here
body: A delegation of Joined International Youth Organizations led by Grigory Petushkov, chairman of the National Council of the Russian Association of Youth and Children, arrived here on Saturday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of Educationalists Returns
body: A delegation of the educationalists at Kim Chaek University of Technology led by Hong So Hon, president of the university, returned home on Saturday after visiting China. Rodong Sinmun

title: Anniversary of Korean Youth Publication Marked in Japan
body: A meeting took place at the Korean Hall in Tokyo on June 29 to mark the 60th anniversary of the founding of the Korean Youth Publication of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon). Attending the event were Jo Il Yon, vice-chairman and director of the Organization Department of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee; Kim Song Hun, director of the Department for Publicity and Culture of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee; Ko Tok U, chairman of the Tokyo Metropolitan Headquarters of Chongryon; Kim Ik Sun, chairperson of the Nishi Tokyo Headquarters of Chongryon; leading officials of organizations and affiliates; Jo Myong Jin, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the Korean Youth League in Japan; and other officials of its headquarters in different parts of Japan, Pak Ok Sam, vice-chairman and director of the Department for Publicity and Culture of the Central Standing Committee of the Korean Youth League in Japan and concurrently chief of the Korean Youth Publication, and incumbent and former officials. A message of greetings from Chongnyon Jonwi Office in the homeland was read out at the meeting. Jo Il Yon made a congratulatory speech. He underlined the need for the Korean Youth Publication to bring about a new turn in editing and disseminating the publications keeping step with the youth in the motherland in the vigorous struggle in the future, too and to make the publications popular among the Korean youth in Japan as desired by them so as to make the publications more influential. He expressed the conviction that officials of the Korean Youth League in Japan and the Korean Youth Publication will take the lead in ushering in a new heyday of Chongryon and the movement of Koreans in Japan. Then Pak Ok Sam made a report. A letter to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was read out at the meeting. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Embassy Hosts Reception
body: The DPRK embassy in Laos hosted a reception on July 3 to mark the 45th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Lao People's Democratic Republic. Present at the reception on invitation were the Lao foreign minister, the chairman of the Committee for External Affairs of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party (LPRP) and the president of the Lao Federation of Trade Unions who doubles as chairman of the Laos-Korea Friendship Association, members of the Central Committee of the LPRP, and figures of various strata. It was attended by the DPRK ambassador to Laos and staff members of his embassy. Speeches were made there. The Lao foreign minister said that the tradition of the bilateral friendship provided by President Kaysone Phomvihane and President Kim Il Sung is carried forward by President Bounnang Vorachith and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Noting that for the past 45 years the two parties and two countries have steadily developed exchange and cooperation, he expressed gratitude to the Party, government and people of the DPRK for extending invariable support and solidarity to the struggle of the Lao people. Rodong Sinmun

title: President Kim Il Sung to Be Remembered in Russia
body: A committee for remembering President Kim Il Sung was formed by the Maritime Territorial Regional Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation on July 3. Dolgachev, first secretary of the Maritime Territorial Regional Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation, was elected chairman of the remembrance committee. The committee decided to give wide publicity to the revolutionary career and exploits of the President through media and to organize political and cultural events including a seminar on the occasion of the 25th anniversary of his demise. Rodong Sinmun

title: President Kim Il Sung to Be Remembered in Slovakia
body: A Slovak committee for remembering President Kim Il Sung was formed in Bratislava on July 1. Ivan Draxler, chairman of the Slovak Association for Supporting and Studying the Juche Idea and chairman of the Slovakia-Korea Friendship Association, was elected chairman of the remembrance committee. The committee decided to organize political and cultural events such as a remembrance meeting and a film show praising the career and exploits of Kim Il Sung. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Tribute to Statues of Great Leaders Paid by Foreigners and Overseas Koreans
body: Families of persons related to the revolutionary activities of President Kim Il Sung from abroad paid a floral tribute to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill here on Sunday ahead of the 25th anniversary of the demise of the President. They are the family of Zhang Wei-hua, a Chinese anti-Japanese revolutionary martyr, the family of Zhou Baozhong, a Chinese related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, Jong Il Sim, widow of DPRK Hero An Tong Su, and families of So Sun Ok and Kim Sun Ok, China-resident Koreans related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle. They placed floral baskets at the statues and bowed to them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Statement Issued by Chief of AINDF Pyongyang Mission
body: Pak Su Chol, chief of the Pyongyang Mission of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front (AINDF), made public a statement on Sunday, 25 years after President Kim Il Sung left his last autograph on a document related to Korea's reunification. The statement noted that the President pioneered the cause of national reunification and had led it to victory with his outstanding leadership and noble moral influence, taking to heart more than anyone else the tragedy of the territorial and national division by foreign forces. He regarded it as his noble mission and as the biggest present for the fellow countrymen to reunify the country and, accordingly, signed a document related to the national reunification at the last moments of his great life, sitting up all night, it said, adding: His historic autograph "Kim Il Sung 1994. 7. 7." vividly shows the great revolutionary career and patriotic intention of the President who devoted his all to the reunification and prosperity of the nation. So, the great General Kim Jong Il saw to it that a monument to the President's autograph for national reunification was erected in Panmunjom to hand down his feats through generations. Today, Kim Jong Un, respected chairman of the State Affairs Commission, brings about a new historic turn by wisely guiding the cause of national reunification associated with the lifetime of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il. It is the faith and conviction of all the people in the south that the dawn of national reunification will surely break and the broad avenue to peace and prosperity will be paved as Kim Jong Un leads the Korean nation. Our people's just struggle for bringing earlier the day of the independent reunification under the leadership of the peerlessly great man is sure to win. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Tribute to Great Leaders of DPRK Paid by Foreigners
body: Organizations and personages of different countries sent floral baskets to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill here on the occasion of the 25th anniversary of the demise of the President. They are the Organizing Committee of the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu, Yuwen Middle School in Jilin of China, the Switzerland-Korea Committee, the Beijing Chao Ya International Cultural Exchange Center in China, the Japan-DPRK Friendship Kyoto Net for the Promotion of Cultural, Scientific and Civilian Exchange, the family of former Japanese Deputy Prime Minister Sin Kanemaru, and Kiichi Tsunota, representative of the Gunma Prefectural Council for Japan-Korea Friendship and Solidarity. The floral baskets were placed at the statues on Sunday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Feats Praised in Syria
body: Syrian media dedicated special write-ups to the third anniversary of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's election as chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea on June 26 and 29. SANA and the newspaper Al Baath carried photos of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and praised him as the world leader winning official recognition and trust from the international community and as the man of great eminence steering the world political situation with his extraordinary decision and bold negotiation ability. They introduced in detail the exploits of the Supreme Leader who ushered in a new era of peace and prosperity on the Korean Peninsula. The newspaper Tishrin praised Kim Jong Un as the leader with noble moral obligation, stressing that he is turning the whole society into one large and harmonious family full of moral obligation. The newspaper Al Thawrah said that he is possessed of skilled organizing ability of uniting the strength of the people with the confidence that the power of the popular masses is unlimited and there is no difficulty insurmountable when it is motivated. Rodong Sinmun

title: President Kim Il Sung to Be Remembered in Germany
body: A committee for remembering President Kim Il Sung was formed by the Communist Party of Germany on July 2. Torsten Schoevitz, chairman of the Communist Party of Germany, was elected chairman of the remembrance committee. The committee decided to give wide publicity to Kim Il Sung's career and exploits through media and hold political and cultural events including a seminar. Rodong Sinmun

title: President Kim Il Sung to Be Remembered in Russia
body: The Rostov Association for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism of Russia formed a committee for remembering President Kim Il Sung on July 1. Dmitri Remizov, chairman of the association, was elected chairman of the remembrance committee. The committee decided to organize political and cultural events in praise of the revolutionary career and exploits of Kim Il Sung. Rodong Sinmun

title: Voter Rolls Displayed at Constituencies, Sub-Constituencies for Election of Deputies
body: Voter rolls were displayed at constituencies and sub-constituencies for the election of deputies to the provincial (municipal), city (district) and county people's assemblies. The voter rolls were worked out, pursuant to the Law on the Elections of Deputies to the People's Assemblies at All Levels of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. Registered there are all citizens with suffrage residing in the relevant areas. Voters are confirming whether they are correctly registered. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Memorial Service Held on 25th Anniversary of President Kim Il Sung's Demise
body: There was a national memorial service at the Pyongyang Indoor Stadium on July 8, the 25th anniversary of the demise of President Kim Il Sung. Supreme Leader of our Party, state and armed forces Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, took the platform of honor. Present at the service were Choe Ryong Hae, Pak Pong Ju, Kim Jae Ryong and other senior officials of the Party and the government, the chairperson of a friendly party, officials of the Cabinet, working people's organizations, ministries and national institutions, leading officials of the armed forces organs, officials of the Party Central Committee, service personnel of the Korean People's Army and the Korean People's Internal Security Forces, the teaching staff and students of revolutionary schools, officials of institutions and industrial establishments in Pyongyang, persons of merits, bereaved families of revolutionary martyrs, overseas compatriots, those who are related to the revolutionary activities of the President, the chief of the Pyongyang Mission of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front, diplomatic envoys, representatives of the missions of international bodies and military attaches here and foreign guests. All the participants observed a moment's silence in memory of President Kim Il Sung. Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, first vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, made a memorial address. Recalling that 25 years have lapsed since the demise of President Kim Il Sung, Choe Ryong Hae said: The past 25 years were the sacred days in which the greatness of the revolutionary exploits the President performed for the country and the people, the times and mankind and their significance in world history were highlighted more brightly and the days of noble inheritance and moral sense of obligation during which our Party and people successfully realized the cause of immortalizing the great leaders for the first time in history and registered proud victories and great changes in the socialist construction true to the behests of the great leaders. The President is a peerlessly great man the Korean people greeted and held in high esteem for the first time in the history of the nation spanning thousands of years and the sun of Juche who is always alive in the hearts of all peoples century after century. The speaker praised the President as the founder of socialist Korea who provided precious assets and firm foundations for the victory of the revolutionary cause of Juche and eternal prosperity, and as the eternal leader of the WPK and the people. He said it is one of the President's great undying feats for the country and the people, the times and mankind that he provided guidelines for the revolution and construction by founding the Juche idea. He went on: The President regained the country and firmly defended the destiny of the country and people from the aggression by the imperialists, a feat worth going down in the national history. The President built the Party, state and armed forces of Juche type, realized the unity and cohesion of the whole society and thus performed the undying feats of providing a powerful political force for the victory of the socialist cause. It is the greatest exploit performed by him that he built the socialism centered on the popular masses to provide the foundation for happiness and prosperity of the posterity. It is the most brilliant exploit performed by the President for the future of the country and nation that he perfectly settled the issue of succession to the revolutionary cause. Setting it as the supreme patriotic task of the nation to reunify the country, the President advanced the three charters for national reunification and energetically led the nation-wide struggle for implementing it and put his heart and soul into national reunification till the last moments of his life. The speaker stressed that the revolutionary career and exploits of the President would last forever along with the eternal prosperity of socialist Korea and victorious advance of the popular masses' cause of independence, and that the President will always live in the hearts of the Korean people and minds of mankind as the sun of Juche. There took place memorial services in all provinces, cities, counties and industrial complexes on the same day. Political News Team

title: Foreigners and Overseas Compatriots Visit Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: Families of those related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle and overseas compatriots who are staying here visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on Monday, the 25th anniversary of the demise of President Kim Il Sung. The families included those of Zhang Wei-hua, a Chinese anti-Japanese revolutionary martyr, Zhou Baozhong, a Chinese related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, and Kim Sun Ok, China-resident Korean related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, and Jong Il Sim, widow of DPRK Hero An Tong Su. The visitors paid respects to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. They also paid homage to the great leaders in the halls where they lie in state. They made rounds of the halls where the orders the great leaders received are on display and the halls that house cars, electric car, boat and train coaches used by them during their field guidance and foreign tour till the last moments of their lives. On the same day, the representative and members of the Pyongyang Mission of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun to pay respects to Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il. Rodong Sinmun

title: China-DPRK Friendship Will Last Forever: Granddaughter of Zhou Baozhong
body: Zhou Haiqiao, a daughter of Zhou Baozhong's daughter, was interviewed by KCNA on Monday. She, whose grandfather Zhou Baozhong was a Chinese related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, is visiting the DPRK on the occasion of the 25th anniversary of President Kim Il Sung's demise. Noting that every July she pictures the benevolent image of the great President Kim Il Sung who used to embrace her family members with a broad smile on his face, she said: I visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun where the President lies in state, which reminded me of the great exploits left by the President in the history of the China-DPRK friendship. Every anti-Japanese battle site in northeast China is associated with the long journey of bloody combats undergone by the revolutionaries of elder generations of the two countries, going hungry and sleeping outdoors together. The President was a paragon of internationalism who sincerely helped the Chinese revolution despite hardship right after the liberation of Korea. The President never forgot but frequently recalled my grandfather who was his close revolutionary comrade-in-arms. The President showed warm love for our family just as he did to my grandfather. When meeting our family, Chairman Kim Jong Il recollected every paragraph of the letter sent by my grandfather to the President during the past Korean war, terming the relations between the DPRK and China a paragon of relations among all countries over the world and the ties with the family of my grandfather a model. The China-DPRK friendship nurtured by the preceding leaders of the two countries is growing stronger. The recent DPRK visit by General Secretary Xi Jinping and the four China visits by the respected Marshal Kim Jong Un helped confirm once again the durability of the China-DPRK relations provided and developed by the elder generations of the two countries while sharing their intention, friendly feelings and destiny. The traditional China-DPRK friendship forged in blood through the sacred struggle for the common cause will be immortal. Rodong Sinmun

title: SPA Delegation Back Home
body: A delegation of the Supreme People's Assembly (SPA) of the DPRK headed by Vice-Chairwoman Pak Kum Hui returned home on Monday after attending the second international forum on the development of parliamentary system held in Russia. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of National Tourism Administration Back Home
body: A delegation of the National Tourism Administration of the DPRK headed by General Director Jo Song Gol returned home on Monday after visiting Cuba. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Basket to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il from Italian Personage
body: Giancarlo Elia Valori, president of the International World Group of Italy, sent a floral basket to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on the occasion of the 25th anniversary of the demise of Kim Il Sung. The floral basket was laid before the statues on Monday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Tribute to Statues of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Working people, youth and students and servicepersons across the country visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il to pay tribute to them on the occasion of the 25th anniversary of the demise of the President. Seen before the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill was a floral basket sent by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Placed before the statues were bouquets and floral baskets in the names of the Party, power and armed forces organs, public organizations, ministries, national institutions and institutions, factories, enterprises and schools at all levels in Pyongyang and units of the Korean People's Army (KPA) and the Korean People's Internal Security Forces (KPISF). A floral basket was placed before the statues in the name of the Pyongyang Mission of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front. Visitors made a bow to the statues of the great leaders. Floral baskets in the names of different institutions, enterprises and units of the KPA and the KPISF and bouquets were laid before the statues of the great leaders in Kim Il Sung University, the Ministry of the People's Armed Forces, the Ministry of People's Security, the Mansudae Art Studio and other places of Pyongyang. Working people, youth and students and servicepersons across the country visited the statues of the great leaders and mosaics of the smiling leaders in their residential quarters to pay homage to them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Three Minutes' Silence Observed for President Kim Il Sung at Noon
body: The whole country is being wrapped in the strong longings and deep reverence for President Kim Il Sung, the great sage representing the 20th century, and the kind-hearted father of the nation, on Monday, the 25th anniversary of his demise. The feelings of strong longings for the President pervaded the whole country on the greatest memorial day of the nation. Flags are seen at half-mast in all units including institutions, enterprises and factories at all levels and farms, fishing villages and schools in Pyongyang and in provinces, ranging from Phungso-ri, Onsong County at the northern tip of the country to Phyonghwa-ri, a village near the Demarcation Line in Kaesong and from Pidan Islet in the West Sea to Lighthouse Village on Al Islet in the East Sea. An endless stream of people and servicepersons visit the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill and the statues of the leaders, mosaics of the smiling leaders, towers to the immortality of the leaders, revolutionary battle sites, revolutionary historic sites and monuments to the field guidance by the leaders across the country. Sirens blared all at once across the country at 12 sharp. Sirens reverberated far and wide in cities, villages, worksites and in all units and also by trucks and locomotives that had been running. All the people and service personnel offered three-minute silent tribute for Kim Il Sung, founder of socialist Korea and eternal president of the DPRK, in the deepest reverence. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: A home-visiting group of students of Korean high schools in Japan headed by Sin Kil Ung, principal of Korean Middle and High School in Tokyo, visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on July 8, the 25th anniversary of the demise of the President. The members of the home-visiting group laid bouquets and made a bow before the statues. Rodong Sinmun

title: Foreign Newspapers Observe Demise Anniversary of President Kim Il Sung
body: Foreign newspapers featured articles to observe the 25th anniversary of demise of President Kim Il Sung from June 22 to July 4. The Indian newspaper Ocean News Point carried articles under such titles as "Kim Il Sung, Strong Spirit of Independence" and "President's Hobby", illustrated with photos of Kim Il Sung. The Nigerian newspaper Nigerian Observer in an article titled "Kim Il Sung, Together with People All His Life" said that the field guidance provided by Kim Il Sung was a journey of dedication he covered by overcoming ordeals and difficulties while sharing his destiny with the people. The Bangladeshi newspaper Daily Folk in an article "The Man who Believed in People as in Heaven" illustrated with a photo of the President said President Kim Il Sung, the founder of socialist Korea, believed in the people as in Heaven. The Guinean newspaper Horoya in an article titled "President Kim Il Sung and Children" illustrated with a photo of the President noted that the President always found himself among children and showed warm love for them. A Senegalese newspaper in an article titled "President Kim Il Sung Revered by World" said President Kim Il Sung, eternal leader of the Korean people, is a prominent great man recognized by the international community, recalling that units going by his august name made their appearances across the world. The 7th issue of the Belarusian paper Samostoyatelnosti carried articles under various titles including "The President Always Alive in the Hearts of People." Rodong Sinmun

title: Friendly Delegation of Ministry of People's Security Leaves for China
body: A friendly delegation of the Ministry of People's Security headed by Councilor Ri Song Chol left here on Tuesday to visit China. Rodong Sinmun

title: Vice-Chairman of C.C., WPK Meets Delegation of Joined Int'l Youth Organizations
body: Choe Hwi, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, met and had a talk with a delegation of Joined International Youth Organizations led by Grigory Petushkov, chairman of the National Council of the Russian Association of Youth and Children, at the People's Palace of Culture, when it paid a courtesy call on him on Tuesday. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Premier Inspects Several Units
body: Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, member of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, inspected several units of the national economy. At the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill, the premier looked rounds the silk-spinning combined shop and other places and stressed the need to properly organize management and production by meticulously calculating the realistic condition and possibility and took measures to reconstruct the production building of the chemical fiber spinning combined shop and modernize its facilities. Walking round the Sunchon Chemical Complex, he discussed and took measures for realizing the integration of science and technology and production and reallocating some production processes in the viewpoint of optimization. He acquainted himself with farming at the township co-op farm in Songchon County and discussed the issues of demonstrating the advantage of a field-responsibility-system within the framework of the sub-workteam management system and unconditionally fulfilling the plan for the state cereals production set by the Party. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of Joined Int'l Youth Organizations Visits Mangyongdae
body: A delegation of Joined International Youth Organizations led by Grigory Petushkov, chairman of the National Council of the Russian Association of Youth and Children, visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. At the old home of the President, they looked round historical relics, being told that the President was born into a patriotic and revolutionary family and grew up while nurturing ardent patriotism and great intention for the revolution. They also toured the Tower of the Juche Idea, the Youth Movement Museum, Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace, etc. They saw the grand gymnastics and artistic performance "The Land of the People". Rodong Sinmun

title: Gift to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Delegation of Int'l Youth Organizations
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a gift from the delegation of Joined International Youth Organizations on a visit to the DPRK. The gift was handed to Choe Hwi, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, on Tuesday by Grigory Petushkov, chairman of the National Council of the Russian Association of Youth and Children, who is leading the delegation. Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un also received gifts from the delegates of youth organizations of Romania, North Macedonia and Portugal who are members of the delegation. A gift sent by a high school of economics of the National Research University of the Russian Federation to the Supreme Leader was conveyed that day. Rodong Sinmun

title: Tribute Paid to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: A delegation of officials of the Commercial Association of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan Tuesday visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill. The members of the delegation laid a bouquet and made a bow before the statues. Rodong Sinmun

title: People Going to Mansu Hill
body: The people of the whole country earnestly yearned for Comrade Kim Il Sung, founder of a socialist Korea and perpetual President of our Republic, on the occasion of the national memorial day. The officials of ministries and national organs, the men and soldiers of the Korean People’s Army, officials and workers of institutions and enterprises in Pyongyang, young and old people and university students incessantly thronged to Mansu Hill where the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il stand, and vowed to remain loyal to them. They included scores of old people in Pyongyang including Ri Yong Hui who dwells in Ponghak-dong, Phyongchon District, Pyongyang and has looked after the surroundings of the statues every day from July 1994 up to the present and An Sun Sil who resides in Kyongsang-dong, Central District, Pyongyang; youth and students and their parents who donated materials as a token of their sincerity on many occasions to take better care of the statues; old people of different districts in Pyongyang who have taken good care of the sacred native home of Kim Il Sung in Mangyongdae for a long time and often brought the water of a small spring in front of the home to Mansu Hill with them to pour it on flowering trees and plants; and working people from all social strata who have invariably made it a rule to look after the surroundings of the statues in the morning and evening of every day. Overseas nationals and many foreign friends, too, ascended Manu Hill and laid their bouquets before the statues, doing sublime homage to Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il who rendered undying services to the cause of national reunification and global independence. On the occasion of the national memorial day hundreds of thousands of working people in all walks of life, the men and officers of the KPA, young people, students, overseas compatriots and foreign friends climbed up Mansu Hill, paid warm tribute to Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il and placed by far more than 1,000 floral baskets before the statues. O Mun Il

title: On the DPRK’s New History of Iron
body: Having recreated the opera “The Story of Iron” the Art Troupe of North Hamgyong Province successfully stages it day after day in Chongjin City. President Kim Il Sung watched it on June 19, 1979. After the opera he said that the Art Troupe of North Hamgyong Province did a good job of it and highly praised its actors and actresses for singing and dancing well. “Every scene of the opera has been enacted with graphic splendor on the basis of historical facts. The scene of a sleeping car was a historical fact. When I was out in the provinces for my firsthand guidance in those days, I had no place to sleep in except for my train. The wife of Pong Il acted her part well in visiting her husband who returned from the war and joins in the reoperation of a furnace. She informs the fellow workers of her husband of the news of their home villages and says that peasants do not do farming to their hearts’ contents for lack of farm implements. This truthfully reflects the then farming conditions and the heart of the then peasants. After the restoration of the furnace its crew leader addresses a letter to the wife of Pong Il. On receipt she removes to the ironworks from Musan. This scene is very similar to reality. A dreamy scene, too, is rich in content and is presented beautifully. The last scene of molten iron production in particular is very good….” The Art Troupe of North Hamgyong Province fully applied itself to recreating the opera on a high level and raised the curtain on June 19 this year which marks the 40th anniversary of Kim Il Sung’s enjoyment. From the outset of its performance the rehash has captivated the hearts of the provincials. Kim Song Min

title: Japanese Reactionaries Are Well Advised to Behave Themselves,Properly Knowing How Their Image Is
body: Japanese Prime Minister Abe tried to reach out to leaders of some countries, who attended the G20 summit, to seek support for the implementation of the “sanctions resolutions” against the DPRK. Besides, he called for taking tough measures against the evasion of the sanctions, crying out for “verifiable and irreversible dismantlement.” Abe’s such nonsense is a ludicrous one of a political dwarf who has no ability to properly grasp the reality. Now the climate of reconciliation and peace has mounted unprecedentedly on the Korean peninsula and in the region, and the demand for dropping the anachronistic anti-DPRK sanctions becomes increasingly vocal in the international arena. But on the contrary, the Japanese politicians went round imploring other countries to implement the “sanctions resolution” against the DPRK, part begging and part forcing. This is another reminder of their dull political sense and their poor ability to size up the situation. Now Japan’s position in the international arena is miserable as it remains in the periphery over the regional situation. Left alone, yet it attempts to meddle in the Korean peninsula issue again, a thing unbecoming for its current plight. No matter how hard Japan may try to react to an avalanche of ridicule and accusations from the international community, it only falls on deaf ears. It is the height of foolishness for Japan to think of getting somewhere by means of such cheap conducts. The Japanese politicians had better know where they stand and behave themselves. Ri Hak Nam

title: Koreans in China Observe 25th Anniversary of President Kim Il Sung's Demise
body: The General Association of Koreans in China and its affiliated organizations held events on July 8, the 25th anniversary of President Kim Il Sung's demise. An event took place to lay floral baskets at the statue of the President at Yuwen Middle School in Jilin. Present there were Choe Un Bok, chairwoman and other officials of the General Association, officials of its branches, Koreans in China, officials of the DPRK consulate general in Shenyang, DPRK citizens working in Changchun and Jilin cities, a vice-director of the Foreign Affairs Office of the Jilin City People's Government, the head of Yuwen Middle School and other Chinese figures. After laying the floral baskets, the participants paid tribute to the President. The members of the Federation of Korean Economic Workers in China laid floral baskets before the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il at the Dandong Branch of the DPRK consulate general in Shenyang and paid tribute to them. A remembrance meeting of the General Association took place. Present there were officials and part-time officials of the General Association and members of its Shenyang City Branch. An article on the President's greatness was read out at the meeting. And the Korean documentary film "Our Leader" was shown. Earlier, the Zhongnan Regional Association and the Yanbian Regional Association of the General Association held a remembrance meeting and a film study. Rodong Sinmun

title: Congolese Government Delegation Arrives
body: A government delegation of the Republic of Congo led by Hugues Ngouelondele, minister of Sports and Education of Physique, arrived here on Wednesday. The government of the DPRK hosted a reception in honor of the delegation that day. Rodong Sinmun

title: WPK International Department Delegation Leaves for China
body: A delegation of the International Department of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) led by First Vice Department Director Kim Song Nam left here on Wednesday to visit China. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of Information Department of Chinese Foreign Ministry Arrives
body: A delegation of the Information Department of the Chinese Foreign Ministry led by Director Lu Kang arrived here on Wednesday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of Joined Int'l Youth Organizations Leaves
body: A delegation of Joined International Youth Organizations led by Grigory Petushkov, chairman of the National Council of the Russian Association of Youth and Children, left here on Wednesday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Vice-Chairman of WPK Central Committee Meets Delegation of WPM
body: Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), met and had a talk with a delegation of the Workers' Party of Mexico (WPM) led by Renata Libertad Avila Valadez, member of its National Executive Commission, when it paid a courtesy call on him on Wednesday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Gift to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Mexican Party Leader
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a gift from Alberto Anaya Gutierrez, national leader of the Workers' Party of Mexico (WPM). The gift was conveyed to Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, by Renata Libertad Avila Valadez, member of the National Executive Commission of the WPM, who is visiting the DPRK as head of the delegation of the WPM, on July 10. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Tributes Paid to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: A delegation of the Korean youth and students in Japan led by Pak Ok Sam, vice-chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the Korean Youth League in Japan, visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on Wednesday to pay tributes to them. Members of the delegation laid bouquets before the statues and paid tribute to them. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK-China Friendship Developing Day by Day
body: July 11 marks the 58th anniversary of the conclusion of the DPRK-China Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance. The treaty personally signed by the leaders of the elder generation of the two countries on July 11, 1961 laid a firm legal foundation for permanently consolidating and developing the friendly and cooperative relations nurtured in the bloody struggle for independence and socialism against imperialism. The treaty has made a great contribution to developing the DPRK-China friendly and cooperative relations, advancing the socialist cause of the two countries and defending peace and security in Asia and the rest of the world century after century. The rapport between the leaders of the elder generations of the two countries formed the fundamental foundation of the development of the DPRK-China friendly relations and has served as a nutritive element that makes the bilateral friendship further blossom as required by the new times. Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un visited the People’s Republic of China four times up to now since last year and thus ushered in a new heyday of the development of the friendly relations between the DPRK and China. The current international environment requires the peoples of the two countries to carry forward the DPRK-China relations in conformity with the trend of the times. This is a duty common to the peoples of the two countries. Much water has flowed under the bridge and a lot of things have changed. But the truth that the peoples of the DPRK and China have inseparable relations remains unchanged. Kim Sung Gol

title: New Products Developed
body: The Pyongyang Cosmetics Factory has recently developed new products of over 20 kinds. Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un visited it on many occasions and gave precious instructions to devise and mass-produce cosmetics which will help toward not only beautifying, sublimating and civilizing the lives of our women and other working people but also promoting their health. The technologists of the Pyongyang Cosmetics Factory worked with might and main to use natural materials richly available in our country as basic raw materials for its cosmetics.While conducting many clinical examinations, they positively proved the dermal security and effectiveness of medical cosmetics, including a new prickly heat powder they invented. They went all-out to develop natural, functional and effective medical cosmetics which meet the diverse tastes and demand of customers, thus successively devising and producing an anti-mosquito perfume, an anti-mosquito cream and many others whose hygienic security is guaranteed and which are badly needed for one’s outdoor life. They include a natural beauty pack which makes the skin elastic, glossy and fair and unwrinkles it as well as an antioxidant and other different beauty membranes which make the skin light gray and vitaminize it. The workers and technologists of the Pyongyang Cosmetics Factory applied themselves to diversifying its toilet sets and dressing bags further and made more than 50 ones of 10-odd kinds. O Mun Il

title: Delegation of Workers' Party of Mexico Visits Mangyongdae
body: A delegation of the Workers' Party of Mexico led by Renata Libertad Avila Valadez, member of its National Executive Commission, visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. Being briefed on the revolutionary history of the President and careers of his family members, the delegation members looked round historic relics at the old home in Mangyongdae. The delegation also toured Kim Il Sung University, the Monument to Party Founding, Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace, Kyongsang Kindergarten and other places and enjoyed the grand gymnastics and artistic performance "The Land of the People". Rodong Sinmun

title: Chinese Embassy Hosts Reception
body: The Chinese embassy here hosted a reception on Thursday on the occasion of the 58th anniversary of the conclusion of the DPRK-China Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance. Invited to the reception were Thae Hyong Chol, vice-president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, Ri Chang Gun, vice-department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Ri Kil Song, vice-minister of foreign affairs, Pak Kyong Il, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries who is chairman of the DPRK-China Friendship Association, and other officials concerned. Present there were Charge d'Affaires ad Interim Zhang Chenggang and members of the Chinese embassy and the visiting delegation of the Information Department of the Chinese Foreign Ministry. Zhang Chenggang made a speech. He said that it is an unshakable strategic policy of the Chinese party and government to consolidate and develop China-DPRK relations, adding that the Chinese people are rejoiced over the fact that the Korean people are achieving new successes in the building of socialist economy under the leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea headed by Chairman Kim Jong Un. Noting that this year marking the 70th anniversary of establishment of China-DPRK diplomatic relations is a year of weighty significance in the development of the relations between the two countries, he expressed the conviction that China-DPRK friendship provided by the leaders of elder generation would grow stronger as the days go by. Thae Hyong Chol made a speech. He stressed that President Kim Il Sung, together with Premier Zhou Enlai, signed the DPRK-China Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance, and thus provided a solid foundation to develop the DPRK-China friendship on a legal basis. Noting that it is the fixed stand of the WPK and the government of the DPRK to steadily develop the traditional DPRK-China friendship, he hoped that the fraternal Chinese people would realize the Chinese nation's great dream of national rejuvenation under the direction of the Communist Party of China with Comrade Xi Jinping at the core. The Chinese consul general in Chongjin also hosted a reception that day on the same occasion. Rodong Sinmun

title: Head of Delegation of International Department of WPK Central Committee Has Talks with Head of International Liaison Department of CPC Central Committee
body: There were talks between Kim Song Nam, first vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, visiting China at the head of the delegation of the International Department of the WPK Central Committee and Song Tao, head of the International Liaison Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, in Beijing Thursday. Song Tao warmly welcomed China visit by the delegation. The China-DPRK Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance which marks the 58th anniversary of its conclusion serves as the cornerstone and symbol of China-DPRK relations, he said, voicing his stand to propel the development of China-DPRK relations in the new era true to the noble intention of the top leaders of the two parties. Present there from the DPRK side were members of the delegation and the DPRK ambassador to China and from the Chinese side officials of the International Liaison Department of the CPC Central Committee. There was a reception in honor of the delegation of the International Department of the WPK Central Committee at the Diaoyutai State Guesthouse Wednesday. Rodong Sinmun

title: World Population Day Observed
body: A seminar was held at the Taedonggang Diplomatic Club on Thursday to observe World Population Day. It was attended by officials of public health and relevant organs, representatives of the UNFPA and WFP missions and members of missions of other international bodies here, foreign diplomatic envoys and officials of foreign embassies here. Successes and experience gained by the DPRK in population field were shared and the orientation of future activities was discussed at the seminar. The Population Centre of the DPRK released a special issue of "Population Newsletter" that day. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Tribute to President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il by Koreans in China
body: Organizations under the General Association of Koreans in China held a ceremony of laying floral baskets on July 8, the 25th anniversary of demise of President Kim Il Sung. The Zhongnan Regional Association under the General Association of Koreans in China laid a floral basket before the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il at the DPRK embassy in Beijing. The participants paid their respects to the President and the Chairman, recollecting warm benevolence shown by the President who advanced the Juche-oriented idea of overseas compatriots' movement and showed warm fatherly love for the overseas compatriots. Members of the Dandong Branch of the General Association of Koreans in China laid a floral basket and bouquets before the portraits of smiling President and Chairman at the Dandong Branch of the DPRK Consulate General in Shenyang and made a bow to them. Rodong Sinmun

title: 2019-2022 DPRK-Bulgaria Plan for Cooperation in Education and Culture Signed
body: The 2019-2022 inter-governmental plan for cooperation in the field of education and culture between the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Republic of Bulgaria was signed in Pyongyang on Thursday. Present at the signing-ceremony from the DPRK side were Pak Kyong Il, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries, and officials concerned, and from the other side Ivaylo Iordanov, Bulgarian charge d’affaires ad interim to the DPRK, and a staff member of the Bulgarian embassy. The plan was inked by Pak Kyong Il and Ivaylo Iordanov. Rodong Sinmun

title: Asian Regional Juche Idea Seminar Held
body: An Asian regional seminar on the Juche idea on the theme "Self-reliance is the guarantee for sovereignty and global peace" took place in Ulan Bator on June 29. On display at the venue of the event were works of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and books showing the developing DPRK. Present there were the director general, secretary general and directors of the Asian Regional Institute of the Juche Idea, guests of honor, personages of various circles and Juche idea study organisation members in Mongolia and others. Harish Gupta, director general of the Asian Regional Institute of the Juche Idea, made a report to be followed by speeches. The reporter and speakers said President Kim Il Sung, a prominent great man of the 20th century, founded the Juche idea, applied it to the revolution and construction and wisely led the Korean people to push ahead with socialist construction in the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance. Thanks to the unique Songun politics pursued by H.E. Kim Jong Il, the DPRK could demonstrate its dignity as a world-famous political and military power, they said, adding the Songun politics, which helped bolster its own military muscle despite stern ordeals, is closely associated with self-reliance from the viewpoint of global peace. H.E. Kim Jong Un clarified once again at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 7th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea that it is the unshakable political line of the WPK to build a powerful socialist nation under the uplifted banner of self-reliance, they noted, pointing out that the DPRK under his guidance is fully demonstrating its might. A letter to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was adopted at the seminar. Rodong Sinmun

title: WPK Delegation Meets with Member of Secretariat of CPC Central Committee
body: A delegation of the International Department of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) headed by First Vice Department Director of its Central Committee Kim Song Nam met with Wang Huning, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau and member of the Secretariat of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC), at the Great Hall of the People on Friday. Wang Huning said that China and the DPRK are the friendly neighboring countries linked by the same mountain and rivers and the relations between the two parties and two countries are the deep-rooted traditional relations. He noted that the top leaders of the two parties reached important agreements on the development of China-DPRK relations, the situation on the Korean peninsula and issues on international relations at the five rounds of meetings in a little more than a year. He stated that the special and revolutionary relations between the top leaders serve as the most important guarantee for the development of the relations between the two parties and two countries. In particular, the state visit to the DPRK by President Xi Jinping boosted the friendly feelings of the peoples of the two countries and through this the Chinese people came to know well the successes achieved by the Korean people in socialist construction under the leadership of Chairman Kim Jong Un, he said. Present there were Ji Jae Ryong, DPRK ambassador to China, Song Tao, head of the International Liaison Department of the C.C., CPC, and other officials of the C.C., CPC. Rodong Sinmun

title: Early Peaches Supplied to Pyongyang Citizens
body: Early peaches produced in Kwail County arrived in Pyongyang on Friday. A convoy of vehicles full of peaches was greeted by officials and working people in Pyongyang City at Munsu parking lot on the bank of the Taedong River. body: Family members of Shang Yue, Zhou Baozhong and Jiang Zihua, Chinese related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, and family members of Li Zade, a Korean anti-Japanese revolutionary fighter in China, and of Kim Sun Ok, a China-resident Korean related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, left here on Friday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Congolese Government Delegation Visits Mangyongdae
body: A government delegation of the Republic of Congo led by Hugues Ngouelondele, minister of Sports and Education of Physique, visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. Being told that the President grew up to be a revolutionary, the members of the delegation looked round the historical relics preserved at his old home. The guests also toured some stadiums in the sports village of Chongchun Street, Pyongyang Sports Goods Factory, Taekwon-Do Holy House, Rungna Dolphinarium, etc. Rodong Sinmun
