body: Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, met a government delegation of the Republic of Congo led by Hugues Ngouelondele, minister of Sports and Education of Physique, at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Friday when the delegation paid a courtesy call on him. Rodong Sinmun

title: President Kim Il Sung Remembered in India
body: Several organisations and institutions of India held a remembrance meeting, book and photo exhibition and film show from July 2 to 6 on the threshold of the 25th anniversary of demise of President Kim Il Sung. Attending the events were personages of political and social circles and masses of India. The secretary of the National Council of the Communist Party of India who is chairman of the All India Indo-Korean Friendship Association, a member of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of India (Marxist) and the secretary of the Central Committee of the All-India Forward Bloc said that the whole life of Kim Il Sung is the one of a great revolutionary and outstanding leader who made great contributions to the people's happiness, the country's independent and peaceful reunification and global independence. The chairman of the Indian Society for the Study of Works of Kim Jong Il and other speakers lauded Kim Il Sung as the outstanding elder statesman who led global independence under the uplifted banner of independence against imperialism and peerless sage who moved the world with his warm human love and noble virtues. The secretary general of the Indian Youth Group for the Study of Works of Comrade Kim Il Sung said that the history of the President invariably continues in the DPRK as he was possessed of the noblest personality. The chairman of the Juche Philosophy Study Committee of India stressed that the President is still alive in the hearts of the Korean people as his idea is very great. Messages to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un were adopted at the events. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Posted on Website of Russia
body: The full text of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "The Great Comrade Kim Il Sung Is the Eternal Leader of Our Party and Our People" was posted on the website of the news agency of the Zabaikal Territory of Russia on July 6 ahead of the 25th anniversary of demise of President Kim Il Sung. The website carried a photo of the President. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Published in India
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "The Great Comrade Kim Il Sung Is the Eternal Leader of Our Party and Our People" was brought out in booklet by the Indian newspaper Indian And World Event on the occasion of the 25th anniversary of demise of President Kim Il Sung. The work, published on April 20, Juche 101 (2012), deals with the revolutionary exploits performed by President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in their lifetime. It also indicates the tasks for staunchly defending and adding eternal luster to the ideology and feats of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il. A book-releasing ceremony took place on July 2. Rodong Sinmun

title: Bright Laughter of Children Makes the Whole Country Cheerful
body: Some time ago we visited the December 6 Children’s Camp in Munchon City, Kangwon Province. We entered the central hall of its Building 1 and saw on its front wall a painting in which Chairman Kim Jong Il stands at his field car on his way to his first-line posts and affectionately sees schoolchildren go camping. According to an official of the camp, on December 6 three years ago Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un visited it and watched the painting for a long time. He continued: “Kim Jong Un warmly said that a song composed during the last arduous march and forced march went in part to the effect that Kim Jong Il goes to the front while schoolchildren go camping and that in those difficult days, too, he took care that their faces were not clouded with anxiety in the slightest. He proposed that we should always defend their merry laughter and songs as he did.” “Kim Jong Un said that schoolchildren should be arranged for not only to see with their eyes during their camping what they learned in class and experience them in person but also to enshrine them deeply in their memories and that only then could their camping actively contribute to definitely training them as the excellent knowledgeable, virtuous and healthy pillars of the country. He gave instruction s to organize and conduct the camping of schoolchildren laying the main emphasis on giving them more knowledge to satisfy the demand of pedagogy and high civilized level in the new century.” Kim Chun Mi, chief of the camp, informed us of the kind-hearted love of Kim Jong Un for schoolchildren. She said: “When he dropped in at the second floor of Building 1 Kim Jong Un saw round chairs and arranged for them to be installed again for campers to be able to enjoy television in comfort. He shook the balustrade of the staircase and said that it must be strong enough for schoolchildren. “Many officials remained indifferent to the balustrade although they inspected my camp.” We were more interested in the afternoon program of campers than others. In an e-recreation room they enjoyed themselves losing count of time. In another room they had a happy time singing happily. They were playing a basketball game full steam in a gymnasium. When we met a schoolboy at a roller-skating rink he said: “I’m very happy at the camp every day. I’ll study hard and participate in my organizational activities well, always bearing Kim Jong Un’s love for us in my mind.” According to a guidance teacher, Kim Jong Un looked round the gymnasium, a shower room in a bathing resort and a wide playground and learned that all their equipment and even artificial turfs were produced by Kangwon Province for itself. He highly praised it for doing that and was very much pleased that campers could play to their hearts’ content and strengthen their heart and physique. The teacher led us to a pine forest. She said: “Kim Jong Un said that the camp looked quite picturesque in a pine forest. He gave instructions to plant and grow trees of superior species and fruit trees of various kinds in great numbers in and round the camp for landscaping and beautifying purposes and convert the camp grounds into a teaching forest to give lessons to campers. I feel as if his words were still ringing in my ears. “That day Kim Jong Un said that he firmly believed that the officials of our camp would creditably carry out our honorable assignments, always keeping in our mind the fact that when children laughed brightly the whole country was filled with optimism.” Indeed, the whole of the camp was impregnated with the warm love of Kim Jong Un for children. Bidding farewell to the camp, we said to ourselves: “Children, laugh more happily to brighten our country further and please Kim Jong Un.” Kim Song Hun

title: WPK International Department Delegation Back Home
body: A delegation of the International Department of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) led by First Vice Department Director of its Central Committee Kim Song Nam came back home on Saturday after visiting China. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Women Footballers Finish First at 30th World University Summer Games
body: DPRK women footballers finished first at the 30th World University Summer Games being held in Italy. The women's football games held from July 2 to 12 (local time) brought together teams from 12 countries including the DPRK, China, Russia, Brazil and Mexico and the regions. The DPRK women's footballers trounced its Canadian and South African rivals in the group league matches, defeated its Italian rival 4:1 in the quarterfinals and a team from Ireland 5:0 in the semifinals. In the finals held on July 12 (local time) the DPRK team defeated its Japanese rival 2:1. Rodong Sinmun

body: A delegation of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea (GFTUK) led by Kim Tong Son, vice-chairman of its Central Committee, left here Saturday to visit Mongolia. Rodong Sinmun

Being briefed on the revolutionary history of Kim Il Sung and his patriotic family, the guests looked round the historic mementoes at the old home in Mangyongdae. The delegation also toured the International Friendship Exhibition House and Panmunjom, enjoyed the grand gymnastics and artistic performance "The Land of the People" and laid bouquets at the Friendship Tower and the cemetery of martyrs of the Chinese People's Volunteers in Kaesong City. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to President of Montenegro
body: Choe Ryong Hae, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Saturday sent a message of greeting to Milo Djukanovic, president of Montenegro, on its national day. Expressing the belief that the friendly relations between the two countries would develop in line with the aspiration and desire of their peoples, the message wished the people of Montenegro prosperity. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of Workers' Party of Mexico Leaves
body: A delegation of the Workers' Party of Mexico led by Renata Libertad Avila Valadez, member of its National Executive Commission, left here for home on Saturday. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Premier Inspects Units in Agricultural Sector
body: Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, member of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, learned about the agricultural work in South and North Hwanghae Provinces and Nampho City. Visiting the Unhye Co-op Farm in Unchon County, he stressed the need to push ahead with the work to prevent the drought damage of crops including the issues of creating many wells, tube-wells and water holes in every work-team and sub-workteam and securing the source of water by building auxiliary dams at every valley of mountains. While learning about the water control of Lake Thaesong, he stressed the need to establish the system for supplying water to farms of Nampho City on the basis of science and economize water, and took practical measures arising in preventing damage of crops by salt in areas contiguous to the sea including the Porim Co-op Farm of Onchon County. He also visited the Wonphyong Co-op Farm in Unryul County and the Sokjong Co-op Farm in Hwangju County. Rodong Sinmun

title: European Regional Solidarity Meeting Held
body: A European regional solidarity meeting for peace, prosperity and reunification of the Korean peninsula took place in Helsinki, Finland on June 29. Present there were chiefs and delegates of organizations of friendship and solidarity with the Korean people in Europe. The chairman of the Finland-Korea Society made a keynote report. The reporter referred to brisk solidarity activities of organisations for friendship and solidarity with the Korean people in support of their just cause. He stressed the need to bring home to broad segments of people the reality of socialist Korea and urgency of ensuring peace on the Korean peninsula and push ahead with the activities for demanding the implementation of the north-south declarations and the June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement and denouncing all hostile acts of deteriorating the situation on the Korean peninsula. The chairman of the Sweden-Korea Friendship Association, the chairman of the Denmark-DPRK Friendship Association, the chairman of the Korean Friendship Association UK, the chairman of the Belgium-Korea Friendship Association, the chairman of the Slovenia-Korea Friendship Association and the secretary general of the France-Korea Friendship Association and other personages took the floor. They expressed the conviction that the Korean people who advance holding aloft the banner of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism under the wise guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un would surely win a brilliant victory in socialist construction and national reunification. A letter to Kim Jong Un was adopted at the meeting. Rodong Sinmun

title: President Kim Il Sung Lauded by Indian Personages
body: A joint statement was released by Atul Kumar Anjan, chairman of the All India Indo-Korean Friendship Association who is secretary of the National Council of the Communist Party of India, a member of the national committee of minorities of India, Harising Khang, member of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of India (Marxist), G. Debarajan, secretary of the Central Committee of the All-India Forward Bloc, and Suneet Chopra, joint secretary of the All India Agricultural Workers' Union who doubles as secretary general of the All India Indo-Korean Friendship Association, on July 7 on the occasion of the 25th death anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. The statement said that they recollect with deep emotion the exploits performed by Kim Il Sung for the happiness of the Korean people, socialism and global independence. It noted that they know well the great efforts made by him for the reunification of Korea. His exploits will be immortal, it pointed out. It paid respects to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un who made a great contribution to the reunification of the country and peace of the Korean peninsula through his energetic external activities. It expressed firm support and solidarity with the Korean people in their struggle for achieving the development and prosperity of the country while frustrating the sanctions of the hostile forces to stifle the DPRK under the banner of self-reliance. We will always stand by the Korean people, it added. Rodong Sinmun

title: Letter to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Participants in European Meeting
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a letter from the participants in a European regional solidarity meeting for peace, prosperity and reunification of the Korean peninsula on June 29. The letter said that the solidarity meeting took place in Helsinki, Finland in token of friendship and solidarity with the Korean people. It noted that the meeting strongly denounced the negative moves harmful to the implementation of the north-south declarations and the June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement and peace on the peninsula and maneuvers of the hostile forces to stifle the DPRK. It said that friendly and solidarity organizations in Europe discussed practical issues to conduct proactive activities for supporting the Korean people in the building of a powerful socialist country and the reunification of the country. It reiterated full support for the principled stands declared by Kim Jong Un in his policy speech at the First Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK. It noted that they will push ahead with colorful activities for supporting the struggle of the Korean people and making a contribution to peace, prosperity and reunification of the peninsula. Rodong Sinmun

title: President Kim Il Sung's Work Off Press in Russia
body: President Kim Il Sung's work "Strengthening the Party and Enhancing Its Role Is the Basic Guarantee for the Victory of Revolution" was brought out in booklet by the Forum Book Publishing House of Russia on the occasion of the 25th death anniversary of the President. The work, published on October 10, Juche 79 (1990), clarifies the idea that in order to successfully carry out the revolutionary tasks, it is important to build up the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and steadily enhance its role. It also stresses the need to develop the WPK into a revolutionary party of Juche, closely united organizationally and ideologically and possessed of the invincible fighting efficiency, by thoroughly observing the party-building principle of Juche. A book-releasing ceremony took place on July 8. Rodong Sinmun

title: Self-reliance Is Eternal Lifeline of Korean Revolution
body: Self-reliance serves as a revolutionary mode and the principle of struggle of the Korean people who regard independence and self-respect as their life. All victories and glory the Workers’ Party of Korea (WPK) and the Korean people have won through severe trials and difficulties for the last decades are the noble fruition of self-reliance. Self-reliance is not just a tactical countermeasure for meeting a requirement of the changed situation and overcoming a temporary obstacle standing in the way of advance, but the invariable political line the WPK and the Korean people have confirmed and consistently maintained as a fundamental orientation and the mode of development in building socialism. The banner for independence with one’s own efforts the first generation of the Korean revolution upheld in the thick forests of Mt Paektu in the severe period when the nation’s destiny stood at the crossroads of life and death has been more firmly inherited as the banner of independence and self-support in the whole course of solidifying the foundation of democracy and building socialism from scratch with one’s own efforts. Today, the political line of self-reliance clarified again by the Party serves as a treasured sword of building up a rich country with a strong army for defending the gains of socialism which cannot be bartered for anything else in the world and accomplishing the cause of building a powerful country by fully displaying the potential for the development of the DPRK. Self-reliance serves as the eternal lifeline of the Korean revolution which can never be abandoned as long as the DPRK and its people exist. Thanks to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, who makes total dedication with the lifelong will to build the great Kim Il Sung’s nation and Kim Jong Il’s Korea into an independent power to be admired by the world, Juche Korea is making a vigorous advance along the road of self-reliance. The way of self-reliance in which the Korean people share joy and sorrow with Kim Jong Un under his leadership represented the days when they have been united around him with the same intention and feelings with keen realization of the greatness of the leader. The Korean people have entered a new stage of socialist construction with more confidence than any period in history. The history will certainly witness how glorious today’s era was when the road of advance for building a powerful socialist country was paved by self-sustenance and self-support despite the worst challenge and blockade and what great feats the Party and the people achieved when opening up the era. All people should make a vigorous advance towards the bright future of Juche Korea, holding aloft the banner of self-reliance under the leadership of the great Party. Rodong Sinmun and Kulloja

body: A delegation of the Central Court led by President Kang Yun Sok left here on Monday to visit the People's Republic of China. Rodong Sinmun

title: Pak Pong Ju Inspects Various Places in South Hwanghae Province
body: Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the WPK Central Committee, inspected South Hwanghae Province to learn about farming and tideland reclamation. He acquainted himself with farming in Paechon, Yonan and other counties of the province and stressed the need to actively introduce scientific conservation agriculture, make a good choice of the right soil for intercropping cultivation and reduce drought damage by thoroughly establishing the irrigation system. Making rounds of the reclamation site of the Ryongmaedo Tideland, he gave a pep-talk to the builders who turned out in the revetment of anti-tidal dike, and stressed the need to further improve supply service and push ahead with the project of building setups. After learning about several tideland reclamation projects in the province, he discussed the way for winding up them in a brief period and the issue of concentrating efforts on farming by taking due measures to supply water to reclaimed tidelands. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Embassy in Beijing Hosts Reception
body: The DPRK embassy in Beijing hosted a reception on July 11 on the occasion of the 58th anniversary of conclusion of the DPRK-China Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance. Invited to the reception were Hu Chunhua, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and vice-premier of the State Council, and officials of the State Council, the Foreign Ministry, the International Liaison Department of the C.C., CPC, the Ministry of Commerce, the Ministry of National Defense, the Chinese People's Association for Friendship with Foreign Countries, the People's Daily, the Xinhua News Agency and other relevant organs. Present there were DPRK Ambassador to China Ji Jae Ryong and his embassy officials. The DPRK ambassador, in his speech at the reception, recalled that President Kim Il Sung, together with Premier Zhou Enlai, inked the DPRK-China Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance and thus provided a legal foundation for boosting the traditional DPRK-China friendship in various sectors. Thanks to the deep trust and personal relations forged between Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and President Xi Jinping, the DPRK-China friendship is invariably developing despite the complicated international situation, the ambassador said, terming the five meetings between the top leaders of the two countries events of great significance that markedly demonstrated at home and abroad the immutability of the DPRK-China friendship. The vice-premier of the State Council of China said the traditional China-DPRK friendship provided by the leaders of elder generations of the two countries serve as common precious wealth, recalling that the two sides have dynamically accelerated the socialist construction and developed the bilateral relations steadily while supporting and closely cooperating each other on the principle of and in the spirit of the treaty. Noting that it is the consistent and fixed policy of the party and the government of China to preserve, consolidate and develop the China-DPRK relations on good terms, the vice-premier said this year marks the 70th anniversary of establishment of the diplomatic relations between the two countries. The vice-premier expressed conviction that the bilateral relations would greet a rosier future thanks to the joint efforts of the two sides. The DPRK General Consulate in Shenyang and its branch in Dandong also hosted receptions on the same occasion. Rodong Sinmun

title: President Kim Il Sung Remembered in DR Congo
body: The DR Congo Committee for Remembering President Kim Il Sung issued a bulletin "On the occasion of the 25th anniversary of demise of President Kim Il Sung" on July 8. The bulletin carried articles subtitled "Rehe expedition and principle of independence" and "Spurned offer of CMEA admission" under the title of "Kim Il Sung, Strong Spirit of Independence", illustrated with a portrait of smiling Kim Il Sung. It gave detailed accounts of the fact that Kim Il Sung rejected the Left adventurists' line of the Rehe expedition and preserved the stand of Juche and line of independence in the Korean revolution. Citing a detailed fact that the peerlessly great man made sure that the principle of independence in politics, self-sufficiency in economy and self-reliance in defence was invariably applied to the revolution and construction and thus foiled the moves of the big-power chauvinists and provided a strong foundation for self-supporting national economy, it stressed that all successes achieved by the Korean people in the socialist construction are the brilliant fruition of the line of independence preserved by the President. Rodong Sinmun

title: Editorial
body: Let Us Further Accelerate Advance of Our Revolution with the Might of Great Army-people Unity The unity is the proud tradition of the Korean revolution. We accomplished the historic cause of national liberation by dint of the unity, and our army and people won a legendary victory in the Fatherland Liberation War with one mind and will. The spirit of Chollima and the spirit of speed campaign were displayed, a radical turn was brought about in the building of a powerful country and a great victory of national historic significance achieved amid the vigorous struggle in which the army and people braved all sorts of difficulties and trials, sharing the destiny in the same trench of the revolution. In recent years, we created a legendary tale about the construction of Ryomyong Street, won a miraculous victory in the rehabilitation of flood-ravaged northern part of North Hamgyong Province, ushered in a great golden era of construction and made a new history of gold mountains, gold fields and gold seas on the strength of the unity under the wise leadership of the Party. We keenly grasped again the immutable truth that when the army and people get united firmly with one mind and will in the gigantic struggle of a great innovation and great leap forward, there is no difficulty they cannot overcome and no fortress they cannot conquer. The mettle and spirit of Juche Korea should be fully displayed, making a leap forward towards a powerful socialist country by dint of the great army-people unity under the leadership of the great Party.

title: Banner of Self-Support and Self-Reliance, a Powerful Propellant
body: for the Advance and Development of Our State Self-sustenance and self-support serve as a foundation of existence and development of a state and its motive power. One is seriously mistaken if one seeks other’s help in today’s world in which national egoism is rampant and the cupidity of big powers has reached the extremes. Only self-sustenance and self-support guarantee the sovereignty of the country and nation and their rights to existence and development. Holding aloft the banner of self-sustenance and self-support is a bed-rock principle to be consistently maintained and thoroughly applied in the whole process of building a state, not a temporary countermeasure for breaking the present deadlock. It is an important requirement for demonstrating before the world the dignity and might of Juche Korea to hold aloft the banner of self-sustenance and self-support. To hold aloft the banner of self-sustenance and self-support guarantee the dignity of the nation and prosperity of the state. The people strong in self-respect pave the way for self-reliance and self-sufficiency without the slightest vacillation. It is an urgent requirement for speeding up the socialist economic construction to hold aloft the banner of self-sustenance and self-support. If one is strong in self-sustenance and self-support, one can do anything and conquer any fortress. There are not a few things that are in short supply for the Korean people at present. But as there are the patriotic people who build up socialism by their own efforts with self-support, the DPRK can successfully make amazing development which is beyond imagination. The fever of the spirit of self-reliance represents the speed of economic construction. The Korean people will create the world-startling myth of economic construction by relying on their peculiar method of development and strong efforts. Jong Ung

title: President Kim Il Sung Lauded by Foreign Personages
body: Foreign figures made public statements on July 8, the 25th anniversary of demise of President Kim Il Sung. Andre Lohekele Kalonda, chairman of the National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of the DR Congo, said that the great President Kim Il Sung is the outstanding leader of the 20th century who made great contributions to the prosperity of socialist Korea, people's happiness, national reunification and global independence. He noted that the President is always alive in the hearts of the progressives as the sun of Juche as he, regarding it as his motto to believe in the people as in heaven, wisely led the popular masses' struggle for realizing independence and dedicated his all to the country and the people. Samir Diyab, chief of the Lebanese Group for the Study of the Juche Idea, said that the idea and cause of President Kim Il Sung had been successfully carried forward by leader Kim Jong Il and now has been creditably inherited by H.E. Kim Jong Un, adding that the Korean people are waging a dynamic struggle for accomplishing the revolutionary cause of Juche under the tested guidance of H.E. Kim Jong Un. Marwan Sudah, chairman of the Arab Committee for Solidarity with Korean People and Supporting the Reunification of Korea, praised Kim Il Sung for making an undying contribution to the accomplishment of the human cause of independence through his outstanding ideo-theoretical activities and energetic guidance. Rodong Sinmun

title: More Martyrs' Remains Buried in Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery
body: Remains of martyrs Yang Phan Gi and Jon Ki Bong, heroes of the Republic, were buried in the Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery with the approach of the 66th anniversary of the victory in the Fatherland Liberation War. After joining the volunteer corps, Yang Phan Gi distinguished himself in an assault in April, Juche 40 (1951). On June 29, 1951, President Kim Il Sung summoned heroes of the Republic and model combatants to the Supreme Command and gave a submachine gun to Yang Phan Gi to appreciate his military merit. Yang Phan Gi had served as a lecturer at the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum under the loving care and trust of the peerlessly great men. Jon Ki Bong, who was brought up as a commanding officer of the People's Army under the care of Kim Il Sung, led over 130 rounds of combats to victory during the Fatherland Liberation War. The ceremonies of burying remains took place on Tuesday. Remains of Yang Phan Gi and Jon Ki Bong were buried together with their wives'. And remains of wives of martyrs Ko Tae Sok, Kim Rak Hong, Kim Sung Nam, Kim Il Bu (Kim Sam Son), Kim Won Thae, Ri Jae Chol, Ri Won Hup, Pak Ung Phal, Song Hae Son, Yun Yong Uk, Jo Chan Gil, Cha Sun Hae, Choe Song Nam, Han Kye Chon and Hwang Sok In were buried together with their husbands'. The participants laid bunches of flowers at the graves of martyrs and observed a moment's silence in memory of them. Rodong Sinmun
