title: DPRK Wrestlers Prove Successful at 2019 Asia Junior Wrestling Championship
body: DPRK wrestlers proved successful in the 2019 Asia Junior Wrestling Championship. The championship, held in Thailand from July 9 to 14, brought together more than 350 men and women wrestlers from 18 countries and region, including the DPRK, China and India. Yun Hyon Ju came first in the female 55kg category. Won Myong Gyong and Kim Song Ok finished third in the female 50kg and 53kg categories respectively. They returned home on Tuesday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Converted into a Farm Town
body: One day Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un visited the Jangchon Vegetable Cooperative Farm in Sadong District, Pyongyang. It had been visited by President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il for firsthand guidance. It was transformed into a model of the building of socialist rural culture by carrying out the instructions given by Kim Jong Un during his visit a year ago to develop it into a model of the production of vegetables in greenhouses and a model farm of the whole country. The officials of the farm were hugely delighted to meet him again on the spot. That day Kim Jong Un made the rounds of a room for education in revolutionary activities and a room for the history of the farm which were refurbished well and warmly said that Jangchon-ri owed its present prosperity to Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il. Looking round every nook and corner of the farm Kim Jong Un said with satisfaction that all its buildings and facilities were built on the highest level to meet the demand of the new century, that the living standard of the farmers were improved and that they could lead civilized lives. Kim Jong Un climbed up the observation platform of the farm and said that a panorama of the farm was really a fine spectacle and that the JVCF was a farm town. He repeatedly praised the persons concerned for laying it out in good harmony. Kim Chong Il

title: To Meet the Desire of the Peasants
body: One day in October 1953 President Kim Il Sung visited the then war-torn Hungnam Fertilizer Factory. Its labor and management were infinitely delighted to see him again but wondered why he did so because he came to them four days ago, looked round it within and without and taught them in detail how to restore it. This was because while he toured the farm villages of the province their peasants anxiously asked for fertilizer everywhere to give him a heartache. When he visited a village of Hamju County a woman told him that she could not increase her crop yield so he remained wakeful all night that day. Early in the morning of the next day he went out to the paddy fields of another village and noticed that its peasants, too, eagerly waited for fertilizer. He advised them not to try to depend on chemical fertilizer alone but to amply compost their fields because of the wreckage of the HFF. He said that our fertilizer would be turned out two years later and promised them to provide them with large quantities of it that time. That promise of his brought him back again to the HFF. Fully informing the workers of the HFF of the peasants’ desire Kim Il Sung said that because he believed that they would not fail to carry out the decision of the 6th Plenary Meeting of the Party Central Committee he told the peasants that they would be supplied with fertilizer two years after. He looked at the workers trustfully. He sincerely continued: You had better know well how fervently the peasants wish for fertilizer. It is said that the peasants of the Hamhung Plain cried bitterly when the HFF was bombed. You should not remain indifferent to this. The peasants value fertilizer so much. Who else will meet this earnest desire of the peasants but for us? The speech of Kim Il Sung played upon the heartstrings of the workers. They were firmly determined to ensure that Kim Il Sung kept his promise he gave to the peasants believing in them. They dynamically roused themselves into action. They rehabilitated their factory in a short time in the spirit of self-reliance and arduous efforts and stepped their production, thus providing our farms with copious fertilizer. Rim Jong Ho

title: Delegation of DPRK Central Court Meets Secretary of Political and Legal Affairs Committee of CPC Central Committee
body: A delegation of the DPRK Central Court led by President Kang Yun Sok met and had a talk with Guo Shengkun, member of the Political Bureau, member of the Secretariat and secretary of the Political and Legal Affairs Committee of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC), on July 16. The delegation is on a visit to China. Secretary Guo Shengkun said that the Chinese party and government are attaching much importance to the China-DPRK friendly and cooperative relations personally provided and nurtured by the revolutionaries of the elder generations of the two countries. He recalled the successful Pyongyang visit paid recently by General Secretary Xi Jinping at the invitation of Chairman Kim Jong Un. Being pleased over the eye-opening successes achieved by the DPRK in the economic development and improvement of people's living standard under the leadership of Chairman Kim Jong Un, the secretary expressed belief that the friendly and cooperative relations between the judicial organs of the two countries would grow stronger as required by the new era this year marking the 70th anniversary of establishment of the diplomatic relations between the two countries. Present there were the DPRK ambassador to China, the president of the Supreme People's Court of China and officials concerned. That day the delegation met the Chinese minister of Justice. Rodong Sinmun

title: Venezuelan Delegation Here
body: A delegation of the National Leadership of the Youth of the United Socialist Party of Venezuela headed by its Secretary General Rodbexa Poleo arrived here on Wednesday. On the same day, the Central Committee of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League hosted a reception in honor of the delegation. Rodong Sinmun

title: 2nd Meeting of 30th Central Committee of UDKWJ Held
body: The 2nd Meeting of the 30th Central Committee of the Union of Democratic Korean Women in Japan (UDKWJ) was held at the Korean Hall in Tokyo on July 9. Present there were Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), Kang Chu Ryon, vice-chairwoman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee and concurrently chairwoman of the Central Standing Committee of the UDKWJ, and members of its Central Committee, etc. Ho Jong Man made a speech of greeting at the meeting. He called upon the union to make epoch-making progress in ushering in a fresh heyday in the movement of the Korean women in Japan on the basis of the loyalty to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and in the spirit of making selfless, devoted efforts for the interests of the compatriots with the meeting as a momentum. Kang Chu Ryon made a report at the meeting. She referred to the fact that the union has concentrated all its efforts on strengthening itself organizationally and ideologically and on the education of children and national education for ushering in a brilliant era of the national education as required by the era of Kim Jong Un. She called for consolidating the branches of the union as reliable patriotic organizations, putting the education of children and national education in the center of all patriotic activities and making selfless, devoted efforts for the interests of the compatriots under the slogan of the compatriots first. Speeches were made at the meeting. A letter to Kim Jong Un was read out at the meeting. Rodong Sinmun

title: Sci-Tech Presentation in Field of Construction Held
body: A national sci-tech presentation in the field of construction took place at the Sci-Tech Complex on July 16-17 under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of the Architects Union of Korea. It brought together officials, teachers, researchers, designers and postgraduates at several units including Pyongyang University of Architecture, Pyongyang University of Transport, the Green Architecture Institute under the State Academy of Sciences and the Hydraulic Engineering Research Institute. Made public at the presentation, which was held divided into structure and execution panels, were more than 110 valuable papers to be conducive to ensuring the formative art and structural safety of buildings and increasing the quality and speed in construction. Rodong Sinmun

title: President Kim Il Sung's Exploits Praised by Syrian Media
body: Syrian media dedicated special write-ups to the 25th anniversary of demise of President Kim Il Sung from July 4 to 8. Syrian TV Channel, telecasting photos of the President, reported that the President turned the DPRK into a socialist state independent in politics, self-supporting in economy and self-reliant in defence and actively supported peoples of many countries in their struggle for national liberation and building of new society out of his noble internationalist obligation. It also telecasted scenes showing the proud successes achieved by the Korean people in various fields under the guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. The newspaper Al Baath carried the following article under the title of "On the occasion of 25th anniversary of demise of President Kim Il Sung, the eternal sun" illustrated with a photo of the peerlessly great man: President Kim Il Sung is the founder of the DPRK, iron-willed brilliant commander who defeated two imperialisms in one generation and the eternal sun of the Korean people. The Juche idea founded by him casts scientific light on the path ahead of the popular masses for carrying out the cause of independence. The newspaper Tishrin in an article titled "Optimism of President Kim Il Sung" said that the life of the President was the one in which he overcame stern trials and difficulties with laugh and songs and achieved a brilliant victory. The newspaper Al Thawrah carried an article entitled "Great man and children" which praised the President's noble outlook on the rising generations. SANA and Central Radio Broadcasting Service reported in detail that boundless reverence for the President is sweeping many countries, praising him performing the undying exploits for the Korean revolution and the cause of global independence. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Floral Basket from Family of Zhang Wei-hua
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a floral basket from the family of Zhang Wei-hua, a Chinese anti-Japanese revolutionary martyr, on the occasion of the 7th anniversary of the conferment of the title of the DPRK Marshal on him. The floral basket was conveyed to an official concerned by Zhang Jin-quan, son of Zhang Weihua, on Wednesday. Rodong Sinmun

title: The Marshal’s Uniform and Plainclothes
body: Although he is the Marshal of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un wears common plainclothes. Our people have not seen him put on a marshal’s uniform since he was the Marshal. We feel like seeing Kim Jong Un work for the people with a benevolent smile on his face, dressed in plainclothes. He has always worn plainclothes not only on visits to the frontline units of the KPA, factories and farms but also on official occasions and foreign trips. Looking up to him in tears with deep emotion our people feel as if they rehear him saying that day that he did not need the title of a hero or decorations except for their confidence in him. The world has nobody but Kim Jong Un who, wearing plainclothes, loves the people and works hard with all devotion for their happiness and rosy future. Ko Chol Myong

title: Support for the Armed Forces Is the Ways of Our Nation
body: At the beginning of last April the citizens of Pyongyang showed deep affection towards the participants in the 5th Meeting of the Commanders and Political Instructors of the Companies of the Korean People’s Army. The participants reunited with their families and relatives in the streets, residential quarters and homes of the city. The officials of the Party and government bodies, ministries, national organs, factories and enterprises visited them at their lodging and presented them with goods as a token of their sincerity. They were joined in by working people. The citizens enthusiastically sent off the participants when they returned to their companies. The latter keenly realized that the country and the people believed them firmly and expected very much from them. The above was the epitome of the great unity between the KPA and the people in socialist Korea. Throughout the whole period of our revolution the servicemen and the people shared life and death with each other and performed immortal heroic feats with one mind and one purpose. Before Korean liberation from Japanese colonial rule numerous patriots supported the anti-Japanese guerillas morally and materially falling in the snowstorm. They knew full well that they might be killed by the enemy in the course of their support but did not hesitate at all to back up the guerrillas for the liberation of Korea. During the Fatherland Liberation War the people pounded rice in mortars to provide it to our soldiers and officers fighting with the enemy on the front, carried ammunition boxes to them and shared bad times and good with them in the same trenches reposing firm faith in victory in the Fatherland Liberation War. Consequently, our country could win it with honor. Support for the armed forces, which originated in the flames of the anti-Japanese war, was constantly carried forward year after year even in the days of the grim class struggle and the fierce confrontation with imperialists.It is still the greatest patriotic work of the people. O Mun Il

title: The Steps of the Supreme Commander
body: While looking at the sacred Flag of the Supreme Commander fluttering in the air we are warmly reminded that Kim Jong Un, Supreme Commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, has strengthened our revolutionary armed forces into indestructible militant ranks further and maximized the military strength of the country. We cannot forget his historic arduous march toward Mt Osong. He climbed it up passing by a precipitous cliff of giddy height and driving along a steep mountain path dotted with 152 turns to visit a frontline unit. He then proceeded to make for an outpost on the Kkachil Peak. The officials and soldiers barred his passage in tears and repeatedly implored him to give up. But he said in a cavernous voice: “I go to the outpost to encourage its soldiers and pose with them for a photo session….” The soldiers of the outpost were very much surprised and pleased that Kim Jong Un visited them too unexpectedly, and wept to see him. He did them a kindness and said that at their back they had roads leading to their home towns and villages jnhabited by their dear parents, brothers and sisters and that he was always with them. They got firmly determined to grip their revolutionary rifles and sacrifice their blood to defend the Party, the leader, the country and the people. Not only the Kkachil Peak but also the Jangjae and Mu Islands lying in waters along the southwest front and the Cho Island like an indestructible battleship on the West Sea of Korea bear good witness to the history of the strengthening of our revolutionary forces and the acquisition of our military power. While inspecting frontline units he inspires the men and officers of the KPA with wisdom and courage and the people with confidence in victory. While he takes thunderous steps forward toward the front our revolutionary armed forces have been able to have close ties of kinship with him, be imbued with Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism and immutable faith and reliably defend and support the revolutionary cause of the Party. Kang Won Nam

title: Gift to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Cuban Figure
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was presented with a gift by the president of the Cuban Institute of Friendship with the Peoples who is on a visit to the DPRK. President Fernando Gonzalez Llort handed the gift to an official concerned on Thursday. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Wrestlers Back Home
body: DPRK players returned home on Thursday after attending the 2019 Asian Cadet Wrestling Championship. The championship, held in Kazakhstan, brought together more than 280 men and women players from 10-odd countries and regions, including the DPRK, China and Uzbekistan. The DPRK players bagged two gold medals and one bronze. Jang Jin Hyang and Kim Ji Hyang won gold medals in the female 43kg and 49kg categories and Kim Jin A a bronze medal in the female 40kg category. Rodong Sinmun

title: Struggle of Venezuelan People and Youth Backed
body: There took place at the Central Youth Hall on Thursday a solidarity meeting of the Korean youth and students to support the struggle of the Venezuelan people and youth for defending the sovereignty of the country. Present there were Pak Chol Min, chairman of the Central Committee of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League, and officials of the C.C., the youth league, youth and students here and the members of a delegation of the National Leadership of the Youth of the United Socialist Party of Venezuela headed by Secretary General Rodbexa Poleo. Speeches were made at the meeting and then a solidarity statement was read out there. The statement condemned the imperialists' interference in the internal affairs of Venezuela, which is aimed at overthrowing the legitimate government of Venezuela advancing along the road of independence against imperialism, as a challenge to international law and justice. It extended full support to the Venezuelan people and youth who are advancing for the victory in the Bolivarian revolution, while frustrating the hostile forces' escalated sanctions and pressure. It said that to struggle for the building of an independent new world is a common task of the youth of all countries, adding that the just cause of the Venezuelan people and youth for protecting the sovereignty and ensuring peace and security is sure to win. After the meeting, the participants enjoyed a performance given by the art squad of the Central Committee of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of DPRK University Sports Association Returns Home
body: A delegation of the DPRK University Sports Association led by Chairman Jo Chol, vice-chairman of the Education Commission, returned home on Thursday after taking part in the 30th Summer Universiad held in Italy. DPRK players took part in women's football and men's judo games. Women football players took the first place after defeating its Japanese rival 2:1 and Kim Chol Gwang came third in 73kg category of men's Judo. Rodong Sinmun

title: Cubans Here
body: Fernando Gonzalez Llort, president of the Cuban Institute of Friendship with the Peoples, and his party arrived here on Thursday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Gift to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Danish Organization
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a gift from the Denmark-DPRK Friendship Association. The gift was conveyed to an official concerned by Anders Kristensen, chairman of the association who is on a visit to the DPRK. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of Korean Youth and Students in Japan Visits Mangyongdae
body: A delegation of the Korean youth and students in Japan led by Pak Ok Sam, vice-chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the Korean Youth League in Japan, visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. After visiting the Mangyongdae Revolutionary Museum, the delegation made rounds of the historical mementoes at the old home of the President in Mangyongdae, being briefed on the fact that he nurtured the great intention to liberate the country while receiving patriotic education from his parents. It also toured the revolutionary sites on Mangyong Hill. At the end of the visit, the head of the delegation said: We deeply grasped the immortal revolutionary exploits performed by the great Generalissimo Kim Il Sung, who liberated the country through the bloody anti-Japanese war, and the patriotic spirit of his family members. We will train the Korean youth and students in Japan to be reliable successors to the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) who will steadily carry forward the patriotic movement true to the behests of the great Generalissimo. The delegation also visited the Korean Revolution Museum, the Youth Movement Museum and other places and enjoyed the grand gymnastics and artistic performance "The Land of the People". Rodong Sinmun

title: Foreign Guests Visit Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: Foreign guests, including members of a delegation of the Swiss Communist Youth and a delegation of the National Leadership of the Youth of the United Socialist Party of Venezuela, visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on Thursday. They paid tribute to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. They also paid homage to Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il in the halls where they lie in state. They made rounds of the halls where the orders the great leaders received are on display and the halls that house cars, electric car, boat and train coaches used by them during their field guidance and foreign tour till the last moments of their lives. Rodong Sinmun

title: Kim Jae Ryong Inspects Several Units in North Hamgyong Province
body: Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, member of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and premier of the Cabinet, inspected several units in North Hamgyong Province. Making rounds of the oxygen heat blast furnace shop, the hot-rolling shop and others of the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex, he stressed the need to scrupulously manage equipment, improve the technical administration, operate the Juche-based production processes on a normal basis and thus increase iron and steel production. At the Orangchon Power Station under construction, he called for speeding up the construction of Phalhyang dam and Changpho dam of the Power Station No. 4, expanse and concrete covering of waterway tunnel, construction of generator-room, assembling of generating equipment and others in the spirit of self-reliance. At the Chongjin Steel Plant, he learnt in detail about the production of Juche iron and discussed the measures for improving administrative management and making relevant sectors fully ensure the transport of raw materials and fuel and electricity. He also acquainted himself with the production of concentrated iron ore at the Musan Mining Complex and farming at the Ripsok Cooperative Farm in Myonggan County. Rodong Sinmun

title: Cuban Guests Visit Mangyongdae
body: Fernando Gonzalez Llort, president of the Cuban Institute of Friendship with the Peoples, and his companion visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung on Friday. They laid bouquets at the old home of the President in Mangyongdae in reverence for him. And they made rounds of historical mementoes, being briefed on the President and his family members who gave steady continuity to the patriotic and revolutionary family tradition generation after generation. They also toured the Tower of the Juche Idea, the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum and the classroom named after Fidel Castro Ruz at Pyongyang Foreign Languages School under Pyongyang University of Foreign Studies and enjoyed the grand mass gymnastics and artistic performance "The Land of the People". Rodong Sinmun

title: Agreement on Friendship and Solidarity between DPRK and Cuba Signed
body: An agreement on friendship and solidarity between the DPRK Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries, the Korean Committee for Solidarity with Cuba and the Cuban Institute of Friendship with the Peoples and the Cuban Committee for Supporting Korea's Reunification was signed in Pyongyang on Friday. Present at the signing ceremony from the DPRK side were So Ho Won, vice-chairman of the DPRK Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries and vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Solidarity with Cuba, and officials concerned and from the Cuban side were Fernando Gonzalez Llort, president of the Cuban Institute of Friendship with the Peoples, and his companion and Boris Perez Abin, councilor at the Cuban embassy here. So Ho Won and Fernando Gonzalez Llort inked the agreement. Rodong Sinmun

title: Korean Youth and Students from Japan Meet Former Unconverted Long-term Prisoner
body: A delegation of the Korean youth and students in Japan led by Pak Ok Sam, vice-chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the Korean Youth League in Japan, met with Hong Myong Gi, pro-reunification patriotic fighter and former unconverted long-term prisoner, on Friday. Hong Myong Gi said as he engraved in his mind the faith that victory is sure to be won under the leadership of the great leaders, he could have fought indomitably to preserve the revolutionary integrity for decades despite all sorts of evildoings of the enemies who were forcing conversion upon him. He noted that former unconverted long-term prisoners lead a praiseworthy life full of energy despite their advanced ages. He asked the members of the delegation to give steady continuity to the patriotic cause of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan with the loyalty to the peerlessly great men. Pak Ok Sam said that he was greatly encouraged by the fighting spirit of the pro-reunification patriotic fighters who held to their revolutionary sense of obligation, adding that he would invariably take the road of patriotism. An art performance was given at the meeting. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chinese Children Enjoy Camping in DPRK
body: A camping group of Chinese children headed by Chen Wenping enjoyed camping in the DPRK on July 15-19. Members of the camping group laid a floral basket before the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill. They made a round of historical relics at the old home of President Kim Il Sung in Mangyongdae, being told that he was born at a low thatched house and received patriotic and revolutionary education from his parents. They visited the Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace and had a joint performance with members of the art groups of the palace. They also toured the International Friendship Exhibition House, the Friendship Tower and others, saw the grand mass gymnastics and artistic performance "The Land of the People" and had a good time at the Central Zoo and the Rungna People's Pleasure Park. Rodong Sinmun

title: Meeting of Korean Youth League in Japan Held
body: The 2nd Meeting of the 24th Central Committee of the Korean Youth League in Japan was held at the Korean Hall in Tokyo on July 11. Among those present were Jo Il Yon, vice-chairman and director of the Organization Department of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), Jo Myong Jin, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the Korean Youth League in Japan, and members of the Central Committee of the youth league. Jo Myong Jin said in his report at the meeting that the Korean Youth League in Japan has vigorously turned out in the struggle to bring earlier a new heyday of the movement of Koreans in Japan to implement the decision made at the 24th Congress of Chongryon, cherishing the sense of mission to reliably carry forward the patriotic cause of Chongryon. He called on the youth league to play a vanguard role in the struggle for bringing earlier the new heyday of the movement of Koreans in Japan in the era of Kim Jong Un. Then speeches were made. Jo Il Yon said at the meeting. He underscored the need for the youth league to decisively bring about a radical turn in its work as required by the new era, bearing in mind the special solicitude and political trust shown by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. A letter to Kim Jong Un was read out at the meeting. Rodong Sinmun

title: Choe Ryong Hae Meets Cuban Figures
body: Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, met and had a talk with Fernando Gonzalez Llort, president of the Cuban Institute of Friendship with the Peoples, and his companion who paid a courtesy call on him at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Friday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Updated Flotation Process Inaugurated in Komdok Mining Complex
body: The flotation process has been updated at Dressing Plant No. 3 of the Komdok Mining Complex. The Korean-style pneumatic flotation process of the plant has been remodeled into the power- and manpower-saving one to serve as a foundation for increased production of nonferrous metal. An inauguration ceremony was held on Thursday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Candidates for Deputies to Local People's Assemblies Nominated in DPRK
body: Nomination of candidates for deputies to provincial (municipal), city (district) and county people's assemblies of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea ended till July 17. At the meetings of voters for nominating candidates and examining their qualifications held across the country, workers, farmers, intellectuals and officials were nominated as candidates and registered in relevant constituencies. The constituent and sub-constituent election committees posted public announcements of nominees at constituencies and sub-constituencies and are stepping up the preparations for successful election such as equipping polling booths at the final stage. Rodong Sinmun

title: Officials of Korean Youth League in Japan Visit
body: Statues of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il A delegation of officials of the Korean Youth League in Japan visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on Saturday. Members of the delegation laid a bouquet and made a bow before the statues. Rodong Sinmun

title: Officials of Korean Youth League in Japan Arrive
body: A delegation of officials of the Korean Youth League in Japan headed by Jo Myong Jin, chairman of its Central Standing Committee, arrived here on Saturday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Officials and Primary Information Workers of Union of Agricultural Workers
body: Make Study Tour of Mt Paektu Area Officials and primary information workers of the Union of Agricultural Workers from across the country made a study tour of the revolutionary battle sites in the area of Mt Paektu from July 11 to 20. They left Hyesan for Pochonbo, where they placed a floral basket and bunches of flowers and made a bow before the statue of President Kim Il Sung on the bank of Karim Stream. Being briefed on the great personality of the President, they went round the command post of the Battle of Pochonbo, the Police Sub-station and others. They fully realized that the purity of the revolutionary tradition of Mt Paektu is being firmly defended thanks to the guidance of Chairman Kim Jong Il, touring the Spring Site in Poso-ri, the monument to the teachings given by the President in the Tableland of Junghung and the Rimyongsu Revolutionary Site. They made rounds of Chongbong and Konchang bivouacs, the Samjiyon Revolutionary Battle Site, the Sinsadong Revolutionary Battle Site and the Monument to the Victorious Battle of Musan Area. They warmly looked back upon the revolutionary career of Kim Jong Il, who had glorified the protracted course of the Korean revolution with victory, at his birthplace in the Paektusan Secret Camp. They had a meeting to vow loyalty in the plaza before the statue of Kim Jong Il in Samjiyon County. Making rounds of the Kwangson Photographic Studio and Sokjon Tailor's at the Sinpha Revolutionary Site, they cherished once again the revolutionary exploits performed by anti-Japanese War Heroine Kim Jong Suk who dedicated her all to national liberation. During the study tour, the officials and primary information workers of the union gave a helping hand to the construction of the town of Samjiyon County and had a contest of chorusing revolutionary songs, meeting to give their impressions of the reminiscences of anti-Japanese guerrillas and other political and cultural activities. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of Central Court Back Home
body: A delegation of the Central Court headed by President Kang Yun Sok returned home on Saturday after visiting China. Rodong Sinmun

title: Venezuelan Delegation Visits Mangyongdae
body: A delegation of the National Leadership of the Youth of the United Socialist Party of Venezuela headed by its Secretary General Rodbexa Poleo visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. Being briefed on the old home of the President in Mangyongdae where he was born and spent his childhood while nurturing the great intention to make revolution, members of the delegation made rounds of the historical relics preserved there. The delegation also toured the Tower of the Juche Idea, the Youth Movement Museum, the Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace and others and appreciated the grand mass gymnastics and art performance "The Land of the People". Rodong Sinmun

title: Cubans Leave
body: Fernando Gonzalez Llort, president of the Cuban Institute of Friendship with the Peoples, and his companion left here on Saturday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Labor Innovators in Field of Textile Industry Tour Pyongyang
body: Labor innovators in the field of textile industry of the DPRK attained the goal of the five-year strategy for national economic development ahead of schedule. Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un highly praised their feats of labor and saw to it that they have a good time in Pyongyang. The innovators arrived here with great excitement and joy on July 14. They visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the sacred temple of Juche, in humble reverence for President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. They bowed to the peerlessly great men in the halls, where they lie in state, with boundless respect for them. They visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. After making a round of the Mangyongdae Revolutionary Museum, they deeply grasped the revolutionary career of the President and the noble outlook of his family members on life at his old home in Mangyongdae. At the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill, they shared successes and experience gained in the course of working miracles and innovation in production with the workers of the mill. They also toured the Ryuwon Footwear Factory, the Pyongyang Cosmetics Factory, the Sci-Tech Complex and others and enjoyed the grand mass gymnastics and artistic performance "The Land of the People". During the tour of Pyongyang, they had a good time at the Rungna People's Pleasure Park and the Munsu Water Park. The labor innovators left here on Saturday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Takes Part in Election of Deputies to Provincial, City and County People's Assemblies
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, visited the polling station of Sub-constituency No. 94 of Constituency No. 201 of South Hamgyong Province Sunday to take part in the election of deputies to the provincial, city and county people's assemblies. Supreme Leader of the Party, state and armed forces Kim Jong Un received ballots from the chairperson of the sub-constituency committee and voted for Ju Song Ho and Jong Song Sik who are candidates for deputies. He met the candidates and warmly encouraged them to become the faithful servants of the people by fulfilling their duties so as to live up to the anticipation of the people, being aware of being the representatives of the people. He was accompanied by Jo Yong Won, Kim Yong Su, Ri Yong Sik, Hyon Song Wol and other senior officials of the Party Central Committee. Political News Team

title: Election Finishes in DPRK
body: The election of deputies to provincial (municipal), city (district) and county people's assemblies of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea was successfully held on Sunday. According to data available at the Central Election Guidance Committee, 99.98 percent of electors participated in voting, except those on foreign tour or working in oceans. Those voters troubled with aging or illness cast their ballots into mobile ballot boxes. The count of votes for the candidates for deputies to provincial (municipal), city (district) and county people's assemblies registered in relevant constituencies is being carried out by the election committees at constituencies across the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Senior Party and Government Officials Go to Polls
body: Senior Party and government officials went to the polls in different parts of the country on Sunday to join electors in the election of deputies to provincial (municipal), city (district) and county people's assemblies. Choe Ryong Hae, Pak Pong Ju, Kim Jae Ryong and other senior officials of the Party and government voted for candidates registered at relevant constituencies. They met and gave a pep talk to candidates and voters who have made patriotic efforts for glorifying the Korean-style people-centered socialism, and asked them to accelerate the general march of self-reliance for bringing about a great upsurge of socialist construction with the loyalty to the Party and the spirit of making selfless, devoted efforts for the good of the people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Genuine Welfare Policy Can Never Be Effected in Capitalist Society
body: It is an out-and-out deception and daydream to build a "welfare society" in capitalist countries where the gap between the rich and the poor is extremely widening and all sorts of social evils are rampant. The building of "welfare society" much touted by politicians in capitalist countries is nothing but an advertisement for covering up the inequality and anti-popular nature of the capitalist society. A tiny handful of capitalists suppress and dominate the popular masses in the capitalist society. The state power is seized by monopoly capitalists and reactionary ruling quarters serving them. There is no representative of workers and peasants in parliaments of capitalist countries. The same is true of governmental organs. Politicians in capitalist countries are all mouthpiece for the interests of business giants and their servants. They make all sorts of pledges during presidential and parliamentary election campaigns to curry favor with electors, but deny all of them after taking power. Class antagonism and conflict reach an extreme in the capitalist society. It is self-evident that capitalists can never have mercy on the working masses as the former remains hostile to the latter. Therefore, the enforcement of genuine welfare policy for the people is impossible in the capitalist society. Ri Kyong Su

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Inspects Newly Built Submarine
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, inspected a newly built submarine. The submarine built under the meticulous guidance and special attention of Supreme Leader of the Party, state and armed forces Kim Jong Un will perform its duty in the operational waters of the East Sea of Korea and its operational deployment is near at hand. Making a round of the submarine, the Supreme Leader learned in detail about its operational and tactical data and combat weapon systems. He expressed great satisfaction over the fact that the submarine was designed and built to be capable of fully implementing the military strategic intention of the Party under various circumstances. Saying that the operational capacity of a submarine is an important component in national defence of our country bounded on its east and west by sea, he stressed the need to steadily and reliably increase the national defence capability by directing big efforts to the development of the naval weapons and equipment such as submarine. Explaining the Party's strategic plan for the use of submarine and underwater operation, he elaborated on the immediate duty and strategic tasks facing the field of national defence science and submarine industry to carry out the plan. He said with pride that the successful building of the Korean-style powerful submarine is the fruition of the noble patriotism and loyalty of officials, scientists, technicians and workers in the field of national defence science and munitions factories who have worked hard to boost national defence capability, true to the Party's policy on attaching importance to defence science and technology, and another great demonstration of the might of our defence industry making a leap forward. He was accompanied by Jo Yong Won, Hong Yong Chil, Yu Jin, Kim Jong Sik, Ri Jong Sik, Choe Myong Chol, Jang Chang Ha and other senior officials of the Party Central Committee and the field of national defence science. Political News Team

title: GFTUK Delegation Back Home
body: A delegation of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea (GFTUK) led by Kim Tong Son, vice-chairman of its Central Committee, returned home Monday after visiting Mongolia. Rodong Sinmun

title: African Democratic Revolutionary Union Delegation Here
body: A delegation of the African Democratic Revolutionary Union headed by Oumar Mariko, chairman of the Party: African Solidarity for Democracy and Independence of Mali, arrived here on Monday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Secretary General of International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies Arrives
body: Sy El Hadji Amadou Gueye, secretary general of the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies, and his party arrived here Monday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chinese Delegation Here
body: A delegation of Chinese youth cadres headed by Li Xiangdong, director of the Veteran Office, arrived here on Monday. On the same day, the DPRK-China Friendship Association hosted a reception in honor of the delegation. Rodong Sinmun

title: Venezuelan Delegation Leaves
body: A delegation of the National Leadership of the Youth of the United Socialist Party of Venezuela headed by Secretary General Rodbexa Poleo left here for home on Monday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Choe Hwi Meets Venezuelan Delegation
body: Choe Hwi, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, met and had a talk with a delegation of the National Leadership of the Youth of the United Socialist Party of Venezuela headed by Secretary General Rodbexa Poleo that paid a courtesy call on him at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Monday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Gift to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Venezuelan President
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a gift from Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro Moros. The gift was conveyed to Choe Hwi, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, by Rodbexa Poleo, secretary general of the National Leadership of the Youth of the United Socialist Party of Venezuela, on a visit to the DPRK as head of a delegation of the national leadership on Monday. On the same day, a gift to Kim Jong Un in the joint name of the United Socialist Party of Venezuela and the Youth of the United Socialist Party of Venezuela was conveyed. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Outstanding Diplomacy Introduced by DR Congolese Organization
body: The National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of DR Congo posted on its website an article titled "Study of the DPRK's diplomacy" illustrated with a photo of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un on July 15. The article elaborated on the historic DPRK-U.S. summit meetings and talks and said that they were good opportunities showing the independent diplomacy of the DPRK which does not sacrifice its dignity and will. It went on: In case of talking about the DPRK's diplomacy, a special mention of the diplomacy of Chairman Kim Jong Un should be made. Outstanding diplomacy of Chairman Kim Jong Un characterized by bold decision, profound analysis and extensive knowledge, exceptional and candid view, confident pluck, wits, sense of humor and unassuming character draws the attention of all people. The international community is unanimous in commenting that the world-startling successes registered by the DPRK in external relations are the fruits of Chairman Kim Jong Un's outstanding diplomacy. It is not accidental that the world people admire the DPRK's diplomacy as "Kim Jong Un-style diplomacy". Rodong Sinmun

title: History Indicts Japan for the Greatest Crime Ever
body: It has been 125 years since the Japanese imperialists’ criminal assault on the Korean royal palace. On July 23, 1894, Japanese invaders surrounded the palace with many troops. After carrying the palace and taking Emperor Kojong into custody, the Japanese invaders banned even ministers of the Korean feudal government from entering the palace without approval and plundered treasures, cultural assets preserved at the palace for hundreds of years and different sorts of weapons. And they conquered the telegraphy office to completely hold up communication and seized the barracks of the Korean army in city to disarm soldiers. It is just a part of huge crimes Japan committed against the Korean nation. Far from reflecting on their past crimes, the Japanese reactionaries have cunningly tried to evade the apology and reparation for the past crimes, persistently denying them. The reality shows that the Japanese reactionaries are now seeking to reinvade Korea as they did 125 years ago. If the Japanese reactionaries opt to repeat the past history of aggression, it will result in digging up their graves. Kim Sung Gol

title: Chinese Delegation Visits Friendship Tower
body: A delegation of Chinese youth cadres headed by Li Xiangdong, director of the Veteran Office, visited the Friendship Tower Tuesday. Floral baskets in the name of the delegation and others were placed before the tower. The members of the delegation paid silent tribute to the martyrs of the Chinese People's Volunteers who unhesitatingly dedicated their lives to the struggle against the imperialists' invasion on the Korean front under the banner of resisting America and aiding Korea, safeguarding the home and defending the motherland. Then they made a round of the tower. Rodong Sinmun

title: Egyptian Charge D'Affaires Ad Interim Gives Reception
body: Haitham Safey Eldin, Egyptian charge d'affaires ad interim here, gave a reception at the Taedonggang Diplomatic Club on Tuesday, the 67th anniversary of the July 23 revolution in Egypt. Present there on invitation were Ho Yong Bok, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, Ri Myong San, vice-minister of External Economic Relations, and officials concerned. Members of the Egyptian embassy were on hand. Rodong Sinmun

title: Gift to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Chinese Delegation
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a gift from a delegation of Chinese youth cadres. The gift was conveyed to Thae Hyong Chol, vice-president of the Presidium of the DPRK Supreme People's Assembly, on Tuesday by Li Xiangdong, director of the Veteran Office, on a visit to the DPRK as head of the delegation. Rodong Sinmun

title: Kim Jae Ryong Inspects Yangdok County Hot Spring Resort under Construction
body: Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, member of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, inspected the Yangdok County Hot Spring Resort under construction. Kim Jae Ryong walked around the township of Yangdok County, Onjong-ri, construction site of roadbed, etc., where he called for carrying out the construction plans without fail, properly carrying on operation and control to push ahead with the projects in a comprehensive way and taking full measures for the supply of materials. He underscored the need to ensure the quality of buildings in constructing the world-level hot spring resort and make an environmental face-lift. He took measures to provide the builders with good living conditions in a responsible manner. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Taekwon-Do All-Star Tournament for Jonsung Cup Opens
body: The National Taekwon-Do All-Star Tournament for Jonsung Cup opened with due ceremony in Sariwon on Tuesday. In the tournament, players from over 10 organizations including the Taekwon-Do Team of the Korean Taekwon-Do Committee will compete in Taekwon-Do and Paduk events. Attending the opening ceremony were officials concerned, sportspersons and youth and students in Sariwon city. Kim Kyong Ho, chairman of the Korean Taekwon-Do Committee, made an opening address. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Gift from Swiss Organization
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a gift from the Swiss Communist Youth. The gift was conveyed to an official concerned on Tuesday by Iembo Samuel, general secretary of the Swiss Communist Youth, on a visit to the DPRK as head of a delegation of the Swiss Communist Youth. Rodong Sinmun

title: Swiss Guest Visits Mangyongdae
body: Claude Rene Begle, member of the Federal Assembly of the Swiss Confederation, visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. Being briefed on the revolutionary history of the President and patriotic career of his family members, Claude Rene Begle looked round the historical relics preserved at the old home. He toured the revolutionary sites on Mangyong Hill. He also visited the Korean Revolution Museum, the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Silk Mill and the Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace and other places and enjoyed the grand mass gymnastics and art performance "The Land of the People". Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of Korean Committee for Solidarity with Cuba Leaves for Nepal
body: A delegation of the Korean Committee for Solidarity with Cuba headed by So Ho Won, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries and vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Solidarity with Cuba, Tuesday left here to attend the ninth Asia-Pacific Conference on Solidarity to Cuba due in Nepal. Rodong Sinmun

title: Founding Anniversary of International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies Marked
body: A briefing on Red Cross activities was held at the Taedonggang Diplomatic Club on Wednesday in the name of the DPRK Red Cross Society to mark the 100th founding anniversary of the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies. Present there were Kang Ji Yong, chairman of the Central Committee of the DPRK Red Cross Society, and officials concerned. Present there on invitation were Secretary General of International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies Sy El Hadji Amadou Gueye and his party, members of the delegation of International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies and the delegation of International Committee of the Red Cross working in the DPRK, foreign diplomatic envoys and representatives of missions of international bodies here. Congratulatory speeches were made. The speakers said that the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies has actively facilitated diverse humanitarian activities to prevent and allay misfortune and pain of people since its foundation. Secretary General Sy El Hadji told the audience about the background of the foundation of the international federation and the successes made in the activities of the DPRK Red Cross Society. The participants saw a video showing the activities of the federation in the DPRK and other countries and regions, enjoyed an art performance given by members of the art group of Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace and young RC volunteers and made a round of photos on display. Rodong Sinmun

title: IT Presentation Held
body: There took place at the Sci-Tech Complex a national sci-tech presentation in the IT field on July 23 and 24. Attending the event were teachers, researchers, graduate students, etc. at 17 units including Kim Il Sung University, the State Academy of Sciences and the Sci-Tech Complex. Over 110 valuable papers were presented to the event, which was held divided into IT, computer-technology and educational-information panels. The participants in the event introduced the sci-tech achievements and experience contributing to the research into and development of the Korean-style ultra-modern information technologies and the development of the country's IT education. There were a presentation of papers and question-and-answer session via national computer network. There took place a closing ceremony on Wednesday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Swiss Delegation Visits Mangyongdae
body: A delegation of the Swiss Communist Youth headed by General Secretary Iembo Samuel visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. Being told that Kim Il Sung fostered the great will to liberate the country, receiving patriotic and revolutionary education from his parents, the visitors saw the historical relics there. They also toured the Tower of the Juche Idea, the Arch of Triumph, the Youth Movement Museum, Okryu Children's Hospital, etc. and saw the grand mass gymnastics and artistic performance "The Land of the People." Rodong Sinmun

title: Secretary General of International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies Tours Tower of Juche Idea
body: Sy El Hadji Amadou Gueye, secretary general of the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies, and his party toured the Tower of the Juche Idea on Wednesday. Being told about the grand monument built to bequeath the undying ideological and theoretical exploits of President Kim Il Sung, the guests saw round the tower and groups of sculptures. They enjoyed a bird's eye view of Pyongyang at the observation deck of the tower. They also visited the Korean Stamps Museum and the Pyongyang Metro and saw the grand mass gymnastics and artistic performance "The Land of the People." Rodong Sinmun

title: Choe Ryong Hae Meets Secretary General of International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies
body: Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, met and had a talk with Sy El Hadji Amadou Gueye, secretary general of International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies, and his party at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Wednesday. Rodong Sinmun

title: International Table-tennis Tournament Begins in Pyongyang
body: Seamaster 2019 ITTF Challenge Plus Pyongyang Open started at the Table-Tennis Gymnasium of Chongchun Street in Pyongyang on July 24. Players from different countries, including the DPRK, China, Norway, Thailand, Iran, India and Chinese Taipei, and region are taking part in the tournament, divided into senior men's and women's singles and doubles and mixed doubles and U-21 men's and women's singles. Men's and women's preliminary singles were held on the same day. The tournament will go on till July 28. Rodong Sinmun

title: Ri Su Yong Meets Swiss Lawmaker
body: Ri Su Yong, chairman of the Foreign Affairs Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, met and had a talk with Claude Rene Begle, member of the Federal Assembly of the Swiss Confederation, who paid a courtesy call on him on Wednesday. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Delegation Head Makes Speech at Ministerial Meeting of Coordinating Bureau of NAM
body: The head of the delegation of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea made a speech at the Ministerial Meeting of the Coordinating Bureau of the Non-Aligned Movement (NAM) held in Caracas, Venezuela on July 20 and 21. He said that despite continued efforts of the NAM countries, the imperialists are becoming more undisguised than ever before in arbitrarily trampling over the sovereignty of other countries with complete disregard of the UN Charter and international law in the international arena. He went on: In many countries, humanitarian disasters are occurring one after another accompanied by serious political crisis, military conflicts, aggravated disputes and refugee influx, and the main victims of these disasters are none other than many of the NAM countries. The prevailing reality demands that the NAM decisively enhance its position and role as a political force representing developing countries. When the member states that occupy overwhelming majority of the UN membership further intensify collective action, the leading role of the NAM can be enhanced in safeguarding peace and security of the world. In order to defend the collective interests of the member states and implement the principles of impartiality and equality at the UN, it is important for the NAM member states which are the non-permanent members of the UN Security Council to further enhance their role. If those member states actively engage themselves in representing the interests of the NAM, they can prevail over all sorts of maneuvers of the West committed against developing countries and thereby make contributions to enabling the UN to fulfill its mission of preserving world peace and security in good faith. The DPRK as a member state of the NAM has been making consistent efforts to develop and strengthen the NAM in conformity with its founding purposes and the principles of activities. Despite the continuing challenges of the hostile forces attempting to block the road ahead of us, the DPRK government remains firm and unshakable in its will to establish a lasting and durable peace mechanism on the Korean peninsula, open up a new phase of prosperity by its own efforts and realize the ideal and objectives for a powerful country. The DPRK government will actively support and encourage the NAM member states in their efforts to hold fast to the ideal of independence against imperialism and peace against war and to defend sovereignty. The DPRK government will in the future, too, make every possible effort for the strengthening and development of the NAM in accordance with its foreign policy ideals of independence, peace and friendship. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Guides Power Demonstration Fire of New-Type Tactical Guided Weapon
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, guided the power demonstration fire of a new-type tactical guided weapon Thursday. Supreme Leader of the Party, state and armed forces Kim Jong Un personally organized and guided the fire of the new-type tactical guided weapon as part of the power demonstration to send a solemn warning to the south Korean military warmongers who are running high fever in their moves to introduce the ultramodern offensive weapons into south Korea and hold military exercise in defiance of the repeated warnings from the DPRK. Watching the preparatory processes for launch at the fire position together with leading officials in the field of the national defence science, he learned in detail about the operating mode of the guided weapon system to be newly deployed for operation. Then he mounted the observation post and guided the power demonstration fire. The power demonstration fire gave satisfactory verification once again to the efficiency indicators of the system. And it must have given uneasiness and agony to some targeted forces enough as it intended. Carefully watching the overall process of the fire, he said that today we could understand better the superiority and perfection of the new-type tactical guided weapon system. Saying that he was gratified by the direct confirmation and conviction of the rapid anti-firepower capability of the tactical guided weapon system and the specific features of the low-altitude gliding and leaping flight orbit of the tactical guided missile, which would be hard to intercept, and its combat power, he noted that the fact about the development and possession of such state-of-the-art weaponry system is of huge eventful significance in developing our armed forces and guaranteeing the security of the country by military force. Explaining the accompanying officials and the leading officials in the field of the national defence science the annoying situation in the south of the Korean peninsula, he said that the ultra-modern weapons and equipment which the bellicose forces of the south Korean military are introducing with desperate efforts are definitely offensive weapons and their purpose is absolutely clear. He stressed it is a work of top priority and a must activity for the security of the country to steadily develop powerful physical means and conduct the tests for their deployment for neutralizing those weapons posing undeniable threats to the security of the country immediately and turning them to scrap iron at an early stage when it is considered necessary. He said that the south Korean authorities show such strange double-dealing behavior as acting a "handshake of peace" and fingering joint declaration and agreement and the like before the world people and, behind the scene, shipping ultra-modern offensive weapons and holding joint military exercises. He emphasized that we can not but develop nonstop super powerful weapon systems to remove the potential and direct threats to the security of our country that exist in the south. Giving the leading officials in the field of the munitions industry and national defence science the direction of researches into important strategic and tactical weapon systems for continued development, he set forth methodological issues for further consolidating the nation's capabilities for self-defence. He said that his advice to the south Korean chief executive to understand in time the danger the developments will possibly bring, stop such suicidal act as the introduction of ultra-modern weapons and military exercises and come back to the proper stand as in April and September last year is addressed to the south together with the news of the power demonstration fire. The south Korean chief executive should not make a mistake of ignoring the warning from Pyongyang, however offending it may be. The power demonstration fire was watched by officials of the Party Central Committee including Jo Yong Won, Ri Pyong Chol, Hong Yong Chil, Yu Jin, Kim Jong Sik and Ri Yong Sik. Political News Team

title: All-out Anti-Japanese, Anti-Conservative Struggle Called for
body: The Central Committee of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front (AINDF) on Thursday made public an appeal calling on the south Korean people from all walks of life to stage an anti-Japanese and anti-conservative struggle, according to the website Kuguk Jonson. The appeal says that the denunciation of Japan's impudent and gangster-like economic invasion of south Korea has become increasingly vocal, adding that the anti-Japanese protest is an eruption of curse and anger, hatred and denunciation against Japan drawing a sword of aggression on the economy and people of south Korea again to realize its wild ambition for reinvasion. It goes on: What is more intolerable is the fact that the Japanese reactionaries adopted all the Koreans as a target of recent gangster-like retaliatory measures, groundlessly linking the measures with the north and calling the south Korean people "mean ones" and "ill-bred kids." At a time when the south Korean people, enraged at the arrogant Japanese reactionaries, turn out in the struggle against them, the "Liberal Korea Party" (LKP) and other pro-Japanese traitorous forces infuriate all the south Korean people by resorting to the pro-Japanese traitorous act of throwing a wet blanket over the struggle. The present situation proves that unless the reckless acts of the Japanese political gangsters and south Korean conservative traitors against the nation and the people are frustrated, the history of national ruin in 1905 will repeat itself on this land together with another miserable plight of "wailing all day after the nation's fall". The appeal calls for turning out in the anti-Japanese struggle to defend the dignity of the nation, rescue the people and fully demonstrate the spirit of the people aspiring after independence and justice. Rodong Sinmun

title: African Democratic Revolutionary Union Delegation Feted
body: The Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea hosted a reception on Thursday in honor of the visiting delegation of the African Democratic Revolutionary Union headed by Oumar Mariko, chairman of the Party: African Solidarity for Democracy and Independence of Mali. Members of the delegation were invited to the reception. Present there were Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the WPK, and officials of the WPK Central Committee. Speeches were made. Rodong Sinmun

title: Performances Given by Art Squads of Working People's Organizations
body: The Art Squad of the Central Committee of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League, the Workers' Art Group of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea and the Art Squad of the Central Committee of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea gave performances Thursday in celebration of the 66th anniversary of the victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War. Put on the stages were choruses "Long Live Generalissimo Kim Il Sung", poem and chorus "July 27, Our Victory Day" and other colorful numbers. The performers praised the war victory exploits performed by President Kim Il Sung by making military miracles to be specially recorded in the world history of wars and firmly defending the dignity and sovereignty of the country with his rare military wisdom and outstanding commanding art. They admired the patriotic devotion made by Chairman Kim Jong Il who won one victory after another in the unprecedented struggle for the defence of socialism under the uplifted banner of Songun and convinced the audiences of the iron truth that July 27 of victory will shine long under the guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Among the audience were Ri Il Hwan, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Pak Chol Min, chairman of the C.C., the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League, Ju Yong Gil, chairman of the C.C., the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea, Kim Chang Yop, chairman of the C.C., the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea, and officials concerned and officials of the working organizations, youth and students and working people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Meetings with War Veterans Held
body: Youth and students and officials and members of the women's union in Pyongyang met war veterans on July 25 ahead of the 66th anniversary of the victorious Fatherland Liberation War. DPRK Hero Ri Yong Je, a war veteran, made a speech at the meeting with youth and students held at the Central Youth Hall. He recalled that President Kim Il Sung initiated the movement of aircraft-hunting teams to foil the enemy's "air superiority" and taught soldiers brilliant stratagem for hunting enemy aircrafts. Noting that the traditions of the July 27 victory will shine more brightly generation after generation thanks to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, he asked youth and students to demonstrate their resourcefulness and pluck of the youth in defending the country and building a powerful socialist country. War veteran Ju Jae Hyon, a participant in the attack on Height 351, made a speech at the meeting with officials and members of the women's union. He told the audience that soldiers of the People's Army occupied in only 15 minutes Height 351, which was boasted by the enemies to be the "line of no retreat", by employing our style combat method and made a report on victory to Kim Il Sung. He called for fully discharging the revolutionary mission of the Korean women in the on-going grand march of self-reliance with ardent loyalty to Kim Jong Un as the first and second generations of the revolution did. Rodong Sinmun

title: Cuban Embassy Members Visit Kim Hyong Jik University of Education
body: Members of the Cuban embassy here visited Kim Hyong Jik University of Education on Thursday on the occasion of the month of solidarity with the Cuban people. The guests made rounds of several places of the university, being briefed about the fact that it has been turned into a pedigree establishment for training promising teachers. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairpersons of Chongryon Branches Meet in Tokyo
body: A meeting of the chairpersons of branches of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) took place in Tokyo on July 20 to mark the 7th anniversary of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's congratulatory message sent to the participants in the congress of officials of Chongryon branches. Present there were Chairman Ho Jong Man and members of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, the director of the Research Institute on History of Korean Residents in Japan, leading officials of major organizations and affiliates under Chongryon, chairpersons of Chongryon headquarters and chairpersons of Chongryon branches in different parts of Japan. The meeting discussed the issues of concentrating all efforts on cementing Chongryon branches to be reliable patriotic ones, hastening a fresh heyday of the movement of Koreans in Japan and providing a springboard for overall prosperity, true to the high intention of Kim Jong Un. Ho Jong Man made a report. The reporter underscored the need to make decisive progress in strengthening as firm as a rock the branches, main units of compatriots' living and patriotic work, into regional bases of the movement of Koreans in Japan and terminal guiding units of Chongryon in step with the ever-victorious stratagem and strategic idea of Kim Jong Un. He called on all the officials to consolidate the Chongryon as firm as a rock to be powerful overseas compatriots' organization forming a harmonious whole with compatriots as desired by Kim Jong Un. And speeches were made there. A letter to Kim Jong Un was read out at the meeting. Rodong Sinmun

title: Secretary General of International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies Leaves
body: Sy El Hadji Amadou Gueye, secretary general of the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies, and his party left here on Thursday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Swiss VIP Leaves
body: Claude Rene Begle, member of the Federal Assembly of the Swiss Confederation, leaves here for home on Thursday. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Meeting Held to Observe Day of War Victory
body: A national meeting was held at the April 25 House of Culture on Friday to observe the 66th anniversary of the victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War. Present there were Choe Ryong Hae, Pak Pong Ju, Kim Jae Ryong and other senior officials of the Party and the government, officials of the armed forces organs, officials of the Party Central Committee, war veterans, officials of ministries and national institutions, service personnel of the Korean People's Army and the Korean People's Internal Security Forces, teaching staff and students of revolutionary schools, officials of institutions and industrial establishments, labor innovators, youth and students in Pyongyang and overseas compatriots. Present there on invitation were foreign diplomatic envoys, representatives of the missions of international organizations and military attaches of foreign embassies here. Army General Kim Su Gil, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, member of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, and director of the KPA General Political Bureau, made a report. The reporter said that the brilliant victory in the Fatherland Liberation War on July 27, Juche 42 (1953) was a historic event which fully demonstrated the invincibility of Juche Korea to the whole world and opened up a broad avenue for vigorous advance and accomplishment of the revolution. He went on: The victory in the Fatherland Liberation War was a brilliant one brought about by the Juche-oriented military idea, war methods and outstanding leadership of President Kim Il Sung and the proud one by ardent patriotism and indomitable fighting spirit of the service personnel of the People's Army and people of Korea. The President set forth the slogan "Everything for Victory in the War!", encouraged the entire Party, the whole state and all the people to turn out in the struggle for defending the country and wisely led the struggle to destroy the numerical and technical superiority of the enemies by dint of political, moral, strategic and tactical advantages. Having a deep insight into the prevailing situation, the balance of forces between the enemy and the People's Army and the weak points of the enemy with his rare military wisdom in each stage of the war, he opened the turning phase for the war victory, dealing telling blows at the invaders by employing the Korean-style strategy, tactics and war methods. The brave People's Army fighters opened up a road of charge by dedicating their lives to destroying the enemy pillboxes, and did not hesitate to sacrifice themselves for the defence of an inch of the country's land, shouting "Long live General Kim Il Sung!" in battlefields. During the war, the Chinese party, government and people sent the Chinese People's Volunteers composed of their excellent sons and daughters to support the struggle of the Korean people at the cost of their blood under the uplifted banner of resisting America and aiding Korea, safeguarding the home and defending the motherland, and thus boosted the DPRK-China friendship forged in the flames of the anti-Japanese war and strikingly demonstrated its invincibility and vitality. The war victory exploits performed by the President who rescued twice the destiny of the country and the nation by leading the Fatherland Liberation War to victory and created the ever-victorious history and traditions of Juche Korea will be immortal generation after generation. The proud tradition of the July 27 victory has been steadily carried forward century after century by the great brilliant commanders. Our socialist country greeted the golden age of bolstering up the national power under the outstanding guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. The reporter called for working harder to fully demonstrate the strong spirit of heroic Korea and win the brilliant victory in building a powerful socialist country of Juche, rallied close around the Supreme Leader. Rodong Sinmun

title: Widow of An Tong Su Pays Floral Tribute to Statues of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Jong Il Sim, widow of DPRK Hero An Tong Su, Friday paid a floral tribute to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on the occasion of the 66th anniversary of the victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War. She laid a floral basket and made a bow before the statues. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Basket to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Bereaved Family of DPRK Hero
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a floral basket from the bereaved family of DPRK Hero An Tong Su on the occasion of the 66th anniversary of the victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War. The floral basket was handed to an official concerned by Jong Il Sim, widow of DPRK Hero An Tong Su, on Friday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of Officials of Korean Youth League in Japan Visits Mangyongdae
body: A delegation of officials of the Korean Youth League in Japan headed by Jo Myong Jin, chairman of its Central Standing Committee, visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. After visiting the Mangyongdae Revolutionary Museum, the visitors looked round the historical relics preserved at the old home of the President in Mangyongdae, being briefed about the immortal story associated with the historic home where the President was born and spent his childhood while nurturing the great intention to make revolution. At the end of the visit, the head of the delegation said that Generalissimo Kim Il Sung devoted his all to the country and the people, and that the exploits he performed for the era and history would shine long. The delegation also visited the Korean Revolution Museum, the Youth Movement Museum, Pyongyang Teacher Training College and other places. Rodong Sinmun

body: A delegation of the Swiss Communist Youth headed by General Secretary Samuel Iembo left here for home on Friday. Rodong Sinmun

body: There was the 8th National Exhibition of 206 Kinds of Goods for Daily Use at the Pyongyang Yokjon Department Store on July 23-26. Exchanged during the exhibition were successes and experience gained in the production of goods for daily use during the course of the struggle to produce various and diversified consumer goods and improve their quality. On exhibition were over 42 000 goods of at least 400 kinds, including kitchen utensils, electrical and electronic goods and school things produced by over 300 units under commissions, ministries, national institutions and industrial management bureaus of all the provinces.
