title: Greetings to Maldivian President
body: Choe Ryong Hae, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Friday sent a message of greeting to Ibrahim Mohamed Solih, president of the Republic of Maldives, on the occasion of its independence. Expressing the belief that the friendly relations between the two countries would develop in a fresh way in conformity with common interests of the two peoples, the message wished the Maldivian president bigger successes in his responsible work for the country's progress and prosperity. Rodong Sinmun

title: People-oriented Policies Enforced during Fatherland Liberation War
body: Thanks to the boundless warm love of President Kim Il Sung for the people, the future of the country to emerge victorious was designed and people-oriented policies, unprecedented in human history of war, were enforced in succession despite the grave situation of the war. Cabinet decision No. 203 on enforcing free medical care system for the people was promulgated on November 13, Juche 41 (1952), and thereby the universal free medical care was carried into effect from January 1953. People-oriented policies were enforced in succession, including the Cabinet decision on regular state aid adopted on August 19, 1950, the Cabinet decision on increasing the amount of food supply for families of workers, technicians and office workers on September 30, 1952 and the Cabinet decision on measures for improving economic situation of poor peasants and impoverished fishermen on February 18, 1953. Kim Il Sung saw to it that the Cabinet decision on the establishment of schools for bereaved children was adopted on January 13, 1951 and the Cabinet decision on pensioning at state expense on August 30, 1951 as part of the efforts to take well care of the living of the bereaved families of patriotic martyrs and fallen soldiers. In the flames of the war, the number of sanatoriums and rest centers was doubled as of 1951, as compared with the period before the war and even front-line rest homes were set up. The President ensured that policies for guaranteeing the democratic freedom and rights and happy life of the people was also enforced in the liberated regions of south Korea. A decree of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly on enforcing the agrarian reform in all the liberated areas of the southern half of Korea was promulgated on July 4, 1950. Among the people-oriented policies were an order of the Military Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea on supplying food grain to the poor in Seoul and liberated areas issued on August 2, 1950, the Cabinet decision on enforcing the labour law adopted on August 19 and the Law on Sex Equality. All those people-oriented policies and a number of measures could be enforced during the life-and-death war, only thanks to the President, the great father of the people who had the dispositions of noble humanity and warm love for and trust in people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Appreciates Concert
body: Given by National Symphony Orchestra Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, appreciated a concert given by the National Symphony Orchestra to celebrate July 27, the day of war victory. When Supreme Leader of the Party, state and armed forces Kim Jong Un appeared in the auditorium, all the audience shouted "hurrah!" extending the greatest glory to him. He warmly waved back to the enthusiastically cheering audience. Put on the stage of the concert which started with orchestra "July 27 March" were symphonic poem "Eternal Ode to Victory", female solo "Peace Is Guaranteed by Our Arms" and female trio "Our National Flag". Listening to the symphonic poem comprised of wartime songs and contemporary famous songs, the audience recollected the rigorous days of the hard-fought Fatherland Liberation War. Among the audience were Ri Man Gon, Pak Kwang Ho, Ri Su Yong, Kim Yong Chol, Jo Yong Won, Kim Yo Jong and Choe Son Hui who are senior officials of the Party and the government, Yang Hyong Sop, Ri Myong Su, Choe Yong Rim and other war veterans, senior officials of the Party Central Committee, persons of merits, creators and artistes of major art organizations and youth and students. Political News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Visits Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, visited the Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery on the morning of July 27, the 66th anniversary of the victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War. Supreme Leader of the Party, state and armed forces Kim Jong Un put a flower before the cemetery. He said the undying feats of the war martyrs who saved the country from the crisis of a life or death in the tragic annals under the leadership of President Kim Il Sung will shine long in the history of the country. He offered a humble tribute to the memory of the martyrs of the People's Army who dedicated their precious lives to the sacred war for safeguarding the freedom and independence of the country and the happiness of the people, praying for the immortality of their great souls on the platform of eternal glory. Political News Team

title: Day of War Victory Celebrated in DPRK
body: The 66th anniversary of the victory in the Fatherland Liberation War was celebrated across the DPRK Citizens visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the sacred temple of Juche where President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il lie in state, and paid tribute to the portraits of smiling Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il. Working people, youth and students and servicepersons visited the statues and cemeteries of martyrs, monuments to the fallen soldiers of the Korean People's Army, and graves of martyrs in different parts of the country to pay tribute to the country's defenders of the great years. Circus and magic performances were given at the Pyongyang Circus Theater and the jugglery theatre of the National Acrobatic Troupe to please the working people and youth and students celebrating the day of war victory. An acrobatic gymnastics competition between the men's and women's players of Korea University of Physical Education and the sports team under the Ministry of Commerce took place at the Athletics Gymnasium in Chongchun Street. A wartime song performance was given by war veterans in Haeju City. There took place in different places the meetings of war veterans, trade union members, youth and students. Rodong Sinmun

body: George Yong-Boon Yeo, former foreign minister of Singapore, and his party arrived here on Saturday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Leading Party and Government Officials Visit Fatherland Liberation War Historic Site
body: Leading officials of the Party and the government, the chairperson of a friendly party, officials of ministries and national institutions visited the Fatherland Liberation War Historic Site on July 27, the 66th anniversary of the victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War. Being told that President Kim Il Sung located the supreme command there from January, Juche 40 (1951) to July, Juche 42 (1953) and defeated the imperialist aggressor forces to defend the destiny of the country and the nation by leading the war to victory, the visitors walked round the site. They also saw the historic relics associated with Chairman Kim Jong Il who grasped the military idea, war methods and commanding art of the President beside a table for mapping out operations at the supreme command during the war. At the command post of the supreme command, they recalled with deep emotion the records of revolutionary activities of the President who advanced the orientations and ways of post-war reconstruction, sure of the victory in the do-or-die war. Making rounds of the tunnel used by the President and the site where he had a talk with DPRK heroes and model soldiers, etc., they grasped again the popular traits of the President who always found himself among the service personnel and the people and showed warm loving care for them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Dancing Parties Held
body: Youth and students of the DPRK held dancing parties in different places of the country on July 27, the 66th anniversary of the victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War. Amid the playing of the song "Holiday of Great War Victory" at the venues of dancing parties in Pyongyang, including the plazas of the Monument to Party Founding and the Pyongyang Indoor Stadium, youth and students represented a sea of dance in token of humblest reverence for and eternal glory to President Kim Il Sung who firmly defended the dignity and sovereignty of the country. They enthusiastically danced to the tunes of such wartime songs as "Advance" and "We Have Won" and the songs like "Who Ever Taught Me?" and "Victory Will Be Won Generation after Generation" reflecting their pledge to add eternal luster to socialist Korea's proud tradition of victory. The playing of songs "His Embrace Is the Best" and "Song of Youth" reflecting the pride of young vanguards, who are demonstrating their honor as reliable reserves, an advancing group and a wing of the Party, revved up the festive atmosphere. Dancing parties of youth and students were also held in other parts of the country. Rodong Sinmun

body: Wreaths were laid at the Martyrs Cemetery of the Chinese People's Volunteers (CPV) in Hoechang County on Saturday, the 66th anniversary of the victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War. body: Wreaths were laid at the Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery on Mt Taesong, the Patriotic Martyrs Cemetery in Sinmi-ri and the Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery on Saturday, the 66th anniversary of the victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War. Also laid there were wreaths in the names of the Ministry of the People's Armed Forces, the Ministry of People's Security, working people's organizations, ministries, national institutions, units of the Korean People's Army and the Korean People's Internal Security Forces, institutions of science, education, public health and media and Party and power organs, enterprises, farms, etc. in Pyongyang. The visitors paid a silent tribute to the martyrs and saw round the cemeteries. title: Performances Given to Celebrate Victory in Great Fatherland Liberation War
body: Performances were given by the State Merited Chorus and the Mansudae Art Troupe on Saturday, the 66th anniversary of the victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War. Senior officials of the Party and the government including Choe Ryong Hae and Pak Pong Ju and officials of the armed forces organs and Pyongyangites enjoyed the performance. The performers sang in high praise of the exploits of President Kim Il Sung for the war victory, who set a world example in the history of struggle against imperialism by leading the Fatherland Liberation War to victory. "Advance" and "Off We Go, Brindled Ox" and other wartime songs reminded the audience of the feats of those who emerged victorious in the war. A performance was given by the Mansudae Art Troupe at the East Pyongyang Grand Theatre. Put on the stage were chorus "Long Live Generalissimo Kim Il Sung", serial orchestra "Song of National Defence" and other colorful numbers. Performers in their songs and dances ardently praised the exploits of President Kim Il Sung who defeated the imperialist allied forces and tactics and created the brilliant legendary tales of heroic Korea about the war victory with his outstanding military idea, Juche-oriented war methods and superb strategies. Put on the stage were immortal classic masterpiece "Song of Best Wishes" and "For My Only Motherland", "Fifteen Minutes on That Day", etc. Mixed quartet and chorus "Respects to Victors of Great Years" and finale "Holiday of Great War Victory" were appreciated by the audience as they made them brace themselves with the will and spirit to strenuously carry forward the tradition of victory in the on-going campaign for defending socialism under the guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. title: Katsura-Taft Agreement, Shameless Fake Treaty
body: Japanese Prime Minister Taro Katsura and U.S. Secretary of the Army Taft fabricated the illegal and brigandish “Katsura-Taft agreement” on July 29, 1905. Japan and the U.S. asserted that the “agreement” was for “peace” and “security” in Asia, but it was sophism. The “agreement” was just a product of conspiracy between the U.S. and Japan, which reduced Korea into a bargaining chip for the division of their sphere of influence in Asia and legalized their colonial rule over other countries. It became a root cause of new aggression and war, far from helping ensure peace and security. Under that “agreement”, Japan and the U.S. paved each other’s path for increasing their aggressor forces across Asia by offering each other Philippines and Korea as advanced bases. In a nutshell, the “agreement” provided a decisive premise for the Japanese imperialists’ occupation of Korea and served as its guarantee. The “agreement” was an utterly illicit and brigandish fabrication, as evidenced by the fact that it had been kept in top secrecy before being found in the archives of the U.S. State Department and made public and nothing about it has been found in Japan. The undisguised moves of the Japanese reactionaries totally denying the past crimes only harden the will of the Korean people to surely force Japan to pay dearly for the crimes committed by the Japanese imperialists. Pak Song Yong

title: Manifestation of High-handed and Outrageous Ambition of Reinvasion
body: The Japanese reactionaries have persistently refused to admit the past crimes, far from making an apology and reparation for them, but they are brandishing a sword of economic retaliation, export restrictions, at south Korea, describing the issue of the reparation to the victims of the conscript labor forced by the Japanese imperialists as “damage to the confidence-based relations” and “violation of international law.” The export restrictions measure is, in essence, a sinister act of aggression to annex south Korea economically and make it its new colony. By hitting the south Korean economy, dependent on Japan, on its tender spot through the recent export restrictions to deal a telling blow to south Korea, the Abe’s group is cunningly seeking to make south Korea more and more dependent on Japan economically and politically. Clear is the black-hearted intention of the Abe’s group, militarist descendants, who grew up while hearing as lullaby the story about the notorious guys advocating the “theory of the conquest of Korea.” It is intolerable that Japan is desperately trying to achieve its ambition to reinvade Korea as it occupied the Korean Peninsula by force of arms and inflicted misfortunes and suffering, for which it cannot make up for all ages, on the Korean people. All the fellow countrymen in the north, the south and abroad should turn out as one in the struggle to frustrate the gangster-like and reckless arbitrariness of Japan so as to decisively crush the moves of the Japanese reactionaries, obsessed with reinvading Korea. title: Remains of Latter Term of Old Stone Age Unearthed in DPRK
body: Teachers and researchers at the Faculty of History of Kim Il Sung University discovered remains of the Old Stone Age in a natural cave in the River Ryesong basin and registered the cave as a site for preservation. It is the first time that remains of the Old Stone Age were discovered at the River Ryesong basin, one of the central parts of Korea lying between the Ahobiryong and Myolak mountains. The cave was found in Sajong-ri, Singye County, North Hwanghae Province, where the teachers and researchers unearthed lots of remains dating back to the Old Stone Age, including five stone tools of three kinds, three bone tools and 732 fossil bones of 17 species of mammals, through comprehensive excavation. Through an archeological study of a stone tool and palaeontological analysis of extinct species, they proved that the remains in the natural cave date back to the latter term of the Old Stone Age. The fossil bones of mammals, including weasel, water-deer, bear and lynx, in the site go to prove that the basin was a forest area with hilly, grassy and swampy lands and was subject to temperate climate like the present. The stone tools and bone tools, estimated to be used for hunting animals and collecting plants, and fossil bones of mammals give a vivid description of the then human life. It was clearly proved through the discovery of the remains in the natural cave that the Korean ancestors had lived in the vast area covering the Taedong River and the Ryesong River basins in the Old Stone Age, creating human culture. Rodong Sinmun
