title: Procuring the Happiness of the People
body: Late at Night Late at night in February a new-type trolley bus was running along a road in Pyongyang. It bore Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Very busy as he was he found time to get on the trolley bus and check it up for fear lest it would discomfort the people even a little, saying that he would rest reassured when it proved perfect. As seen above, he loves the people warmly and works for their welfare to the utmost of his power. A Great Man of His Word Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un visited the construction site of Yangdok County Hot Spring Resort in South Phyongan Province for firsthand guidance last Autumn. For a long time he taught officials how and what to do to build the hot spring resort into a world-class one. He emphasized that it should be completed till October 10, 2019 on the highest level possible to keep his word he gave the people. That moment they keenly realized once again that he loved the people infinitely. A Mountain of Treasures Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un visited a fishing station of the Korean People’s Army. He got aboard a fishing ship named “Hwanggumhae-014” in the rigors of midwinter and congratulated its captain and fishermen on sailing back with a capacity load of fish. Presently he entered a cold storage of the ship and saw it packed with frozen blocks of fish. He described them as a mountain of treasures and was hugely delighted to say that the cold storage was almost filled with fish within several days of their intensive fishing. So much concerned about the food lives of our people and service personnel he heartily rejoiced to see frozen blocks of fish and regard them as priceless treasures. Ri Hong Chol

title: The Great History of a Victory in the Fatherland Liberation War Will Shine Forever
body: The Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum is a center of education in the tradition of victory in the Fatherland Liberation War and a great treasure of the nation which bequeaths the immortal exploits of President Kim Il Sung for it to posterity for all ages. Lots of new historical relics and wartime remains and photos were exhibited in the VFLWM for the last six years. Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un visited the VFLWM in July 2012. He said that it was an excellent center of education which arms the officers and soldiers of the Korean People’s Army, working people, youth and students with the Juche idea and anti-imperialist revolutionary ideas of Kim Il Sung, his outstanding command art and his military strategies, tactics and methods. He also gave instructions to work in depth to find out the historical relics and remains of the FLW. True to the instructions, the officials and researchers of the VFLWM and the bereaved families of participants in the FLW went all-out to find out the wartime remains. In the process of this they unearthed the historical fact that Kim Il Sung went so far as Kwangju, south Korea, in August 1950 and gave instructions to strengthen the defenses of the southwest coast, promptly restore and realign the Party and government organs in the liberated regions of south Korea and enforce the agrarian reform and other democratic reforms. More than 70 historical relics were newly found out and displayed at the VFLWM. They included the fact that Kim Il Sung met the then commander of the 105th Guard Seoul Tank Division in Rohyon-ri, Puksinhyon Subcounty, Nyongbyon County (at that time) in October 1950 and assigned him the task of defending the area on and around the Chongchon River. Those remains carried by the KPA men and officers with them during the FLW and kept by their children as their household treasures for dozens of years after the FLW were newly on display at the VFLWM. The bereaved family of An Tong Su, who was a vice-commander in charge of cultural affairs of the then 105th Seoul Tank Division, sent his medal and certificate of a DPRK Hero to the VFLWM. An exhibition hall for a guard unit which set an example to others in carrying out the military and strategic ideas of Kim Il Sung during the FLW was set up anew. Data on 14 men were newly displayed to view at a heroes’ hall of the VFLWM. Ri Kyong Il

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Guides Test-Fire of New-type Large-caliber Multiple Launch Guided Rocket System
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, guided a test-fire of newly-developed large-caliber multiple launch guided rocket system on July 31. He was accompanied by Jo Yong Won, Ri Pyong Chol, Yu Jin, Kim Jong Sik and Pak Jong Chon. He was greeted on the spot by Jang Chang Ha, Jon Il Ho and other senior officials in the field of national defense science. The officials, scientists and technicians were filled with great pride and excitement for having developed and making the first test-fire of the new-type guided ordnance rocket, which will play a main role in ground military operations, in a short span of time according to the strategic policy of artillery modernization for the building of armed forces set forth at the Seventh Congress of the WPK. Being briefed on the system, Kim Jong Un, Supreme Leader of the Party, state and armed forces of the DPRK, learnt in detail about its development. The test-fire took place in his presence. The test-fire scientifically confirmed that the tactical data and technical characteristics of the new-type large-caliber guided ordnance rocket reached the numerical values of its design, and verified the combat effectiveness of the overall system. After learning about the result of the test-fire, he said that it is very great and it would be an inescapable distress to the forces becoming a fat target of the weapon. He repeatedly expressed satisfaction over the result of the test-fire and highly appreciated the feats of the working class in the fields of national defense science and munitions industry who has made another wonderful Korean-style multiple launch rocket system of great strategic significance conducive to considerably boosting the combat capability of the People's Army. Political News Team

title: State Academic Degrees and Titles Conferred on Intellectuals
body: State academic degrees and titles were awarded to intellectuals, who made contributions to the development of self-supporting economy and improvement of the people's living standard, in the DPRK. The title of academician went to Ri Sin Ung, researcher at Kim Chaek University of Technology, and Jong Sun Gi, researcher at the Academy of Social Sciences, and the title of candidate academician to Jon Ji Hyon, head of a faculty at Kim Chaek University of Technology, and Yu Pong Suk, head of a department at Pyongyang Han Tok Su University of Light Industry. Professorship was conferred on Pak Hak Song, researcher at Kim Il Sung University, Jin Tu Ha, teacher at Kim Chaek University of Technology, Han Kum Sil, teacher at Pyongyang Han Tok Su University of Light Industry, Ri Pong Son, head of department at Phyongsong University of Coal Mining, Choe Son Yong, rector of Wonsan Jong Jun Thaek University of Economics, and others. Doctorate went to Pak Chol and Hong Hye Myong, department heads at Kim Il Sung University, Choe Hak, department head at Kim Hyong Jik University of Education, Ri Kyong Do, department head at Kim Chol Ju University of Education, Kim Song Sim, teacher at Kim Chol Ju University of Education, Kang In Song, Jin Myong Chol and Ri Il Song, department heads at Kim Chaek University of Technology, Kim Hak Song and Jong Myong Guk, teachers at Kim Chaek University of Technology, and others, associate professorship to 171 persons, and master's degree to 1 158 persons. The awarding ceremony took place at the People's Palace of Culture on Wednesday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Camping Starts at Songdowon International Children's Camp
body: The 34th camping began at the Songdowon International Children's Camp in the DPRK with due ceremony on Wednesday. Present there were Kim Song Il, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League, Chae Il Ryong, vice-chairman of the Kangwon Provincial People's Committee, officials concerned, camping groups of children from the DPRK, China, Russia, Vietnam, Laos, India and Germany and a camping group of overseas Korean children. The participants laid a floral basket and bouquets and made a bow before the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il at the camp. A congratulatory address and speech were made at the ceremony. During the camping, the children will conduct multifarious activities including maritime sports, amusement games and meetings for national days. Rodong Sinmun

title: Singaporean Figures Visit Mangyongdae
body: George Yong-Boon Yeo, former foreign minister of Singapore, and his party visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. The guests looked round the historic relics at the old home of the President at Mangyongdae, being briefed about his revolutionary career. They also toured the e-library at Kim Il Sung University, the Arch of Triumph, the Okryu Children's Hospital, etc. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: A delegation of the Union of Korean Teachers in Japan led by Ri Chang Hung, vice-chairman of its Central Standing Committee, visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill Wednesday. Members of the delegation laid a bouquet and made a bow before the statues. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to Swiss President
body: Choe Ryong Hae, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Wednesday sent a message of greeting to Ueli Maurer, president of the Swiss Confederation, on the occasion of its national day. The message wished the Swiss people prosperity, expressing the belief that the long-standing friendly and cooperative relations between the DPRK and the Swiss Confederation will continue to develop in conformity with the aspiration and demand of the peoples of the two countries. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Players Win Gold Medals in Int'l Game
body: DPRK players won medals in the ITTF Asian Para Championships 2019. The championship, held in Chinese Taipei from July 23 to 27, brought together more than 260 men and women players from 16 countries and regions including the DPRK, China, Indonesia, India and Iran. In team events (TT6-TT7), DPRK players Jon Ju Hyon and Kim Yong Rok defeated their south Korean rivals in the quarterfinals and their Thai rivals in the semifinals. In the finals on July 27 they defeated their Chinese rivals and won gold medals. And Jon Ju Hyon came third in individual event (TT6). Rodong Sinmun

title: Souvenir Photo Taken on the Auspicious Day
body: Chairman Kim Jong Il visited the then Pyongyang Textile Mill in parching midsummer heat on July 30, 2009. He dropped in at a workshop and examined its modernization. He expressed his satisfaction at the fact that it increased its productive capacity several times more than before and praised it for doing so. He took a seat in a retiring place and talked with officials. He said that the workshop was refurbished very splendidly and that its surroundings, too, were neat and trim. He continued to say that he felt like being in a park. Pointing out that the PTM boasted great numbers of women he warmly proposed for the labor heroines and innovators of the new generation he had just met to pose with him for a photo session because that day marked the promulgating anniversary of the Law on Sex Equality, and had a souvenir photograph taken with them. This fully evinced how Kim Jong Il assigned our women to legitimately turn one of the wheels of the revolution in the eyes of the world. O Mun Il

title: Promulgation of Law on Sex Equality
body: The Law on Sex Equality was promulgated in our country on July 30, 1946. This was worth special mention in the history of human development and another event which put an end to the history of contempt for women and their tears of blood. After Korean liberation from Japanese colonial rule President Kim Il Sung set forward the liberation of women from social fetters as an important problem of democratic revolution and wisely led the efforts to achieve the equality of the sexes. He ensured that a women’s league was formed first of all and that broad sections of women were enrolled in it to educate and temper them. When the agrarian reform was enforced he also ensured that land was distributed equally not only to men but also to women. When the Labor Law was put in effect he made sure that women had the same equal right with men in work. Having laid foundations for settling the problem of women Kim Il Sung personally worked out and published the Law on Sex Equality in North Korea. This could be done by law by nobody but Kim Il Sung who warmly loved human beings and respected and valued women. Chairman Kim Jong Il published immortal classic works like “Women Are a Powerful Force for Stepping Up the Revolution and Construction,” in which he shed full light on the road of the Korean women’s movement and ensured that the whole society of our country was filled with the spirit of treasuring up and highly esteeming women. Today the Juche-oriented women’s movement is at the zenith of its development under the leadership of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Kim Jong Un enacted the Day of Mothers and posed with the participants in the 4th National Meeting of Mothers for a photo session. He saw that good performances were given and presents presented to them to congratulate women on the March 8 International Day of Women. Under the well-advised leadership and meticulous loving care of Kim Jong Un our women live worthily as female revolutionaries and the flowers of their families and society making fruitful efforts to build theirs into a socialist strong power. Kim Song Nam

title: Swimming Contest of Public Officials Held
body: A swimming contest of officials of commissions, ministries and national institutions was held in the DPRK on July 24-31 on the occasion of the months for maritime physical culture, July and August. In the team event held divided into four groups, officials of the Ministry of Land and Marine Transport, the Foreign Trade Bank, Tin Ming Alan Commercial Center and the Academy of Medical Science took the first place. In the individual event held divided into three categories, officials of the Central Committee of the Journalists Union of Korea, the General Bureau for Affairs with Diplomatic Corps and the Foreign Trade Bank came first. Rodong Sinmun

title: Cuban Embassy Members Visit Jonsung Revolutionary Museum
body: Staff members of the Cuban embassy here Thursday visited the Jonsung Revolutionary Museum on the occasion of the month of solidarity with the Cuban people. The visitors looked round the historical data and relics on display, being briefed on the feats of President Kim Il Sung, who led the Fatherland Liberation War to a brilliant victory and unfolded a grand blueprint for the post-war rehabilitation and construction in the flames of war. Rodong Sinmun

title: Youth and Students Begin Study Tour
body: Youth and students from across the country started the study tour of revolutionary battle sites in the area of Mt Paektu. A ceremony for departure took place in front of the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in Hyesan City on Thursday. Present there were officials concerned, officials of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League, and the participants in the study tour. Pak Myong Jin, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the youth league, made a report at the ceremony, which was followed by speeches. The reporter and speakers called upon the participants in the study tour to bear in mind and add luster to the revolutionary history and exploits of the peerlessly great persons associated with the revolutionary battle sites and revolutionary sites in the area of Mt Paektu. At the end of the ceremony, the participants left for the Pochonbo Revolutionary Battle Site. Rodong Sinmun

title: Former Singaporean FM Leaves
body: George Yong-Boon Yeo, former foreign minister of Singapore, and his party left here on Thursday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Guides Again Test-Fire of New-type Large-caliber Multiple Launch Guided Rocket System
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, guided again the test-fire of newly-developed large-caliber multiple launch guided rocket system early in the Friday morning. The test-fire was aimed to examine the altitude control flight performance, track control capability and rate of hits of the large-caliber multiple launch guided ordnance rocket. Together with Supreme Leader of the Party, state and armed forces of the DPRK Kim Jong Un, senior officials of the Party Central Committee including Ri Pyong Chol, Yu Jin, Kim Jong Sik and leading officials of the field of national defence science including Jang Chang Ha and Jon Il Ho guided the test-fire. At the fire position Kim Jong Un measured the time of combat deployment of gun carriage and learned in detail about the operation mode of the large-caliber multiple launch guided rocket system before guiding the test-fire at the observation post. The test-fire satisfactorily confirmed the altitude control level flight performance, track changing capability, accuracy of hitting a target and warhead explosion power of the guided ordnance rocket. The Supreme Leader expressed great satisfaction over the result of the test-fire, saying that another Juche-oriented weapon planned and so desired by the Party has been made. He highly appreciated the efforts of leading officials, scientists, technicians and workers in the field of national defense science. Political News Team

title: Period of Anti-Japanese, Anti-LKP Struggle Declared in S. Korea
body: According to the south Korean internet newspaper Jaju Sibo, the People's Solidarity for Sovereignty and other organizations of south Korea held a press conference outside the Japanese embassy in Seoul on July 29 and declared the period of intensive struggle against Japan and the "Liberal Korea Party". The speakers exposed that the economic retaliation of Japan is due to the judgment of the Supreme Court forcing the Japanese war criminal enterprise to make compensation to the victims of forced labor. The sordid behavior of Japan became the target of global criticism and lots of south Koreans have turned out to boycott Japan's goods, they said. They denounced the LKP for taking part with Japan. They stressed that they would conduct intensive struggle until August 15 to force Japan to make an apology and reparation and disband the LKP. Rodong Sinmun

title: All-people Candlelight Action Denouncing Japan Staged in S. Korea
body: A candlelight rally took place near the Kwanghwamun Plaza in Seoul on July 27 under the sponsorship of the "Citizens' Action to Denounce Abe for Distorting History, Invading Economy and Threatening Peace", according to the south Korean online paper Tongil News. Present there were thousands of masses from across south Korea. Speakers said that they would struggle to the end against Japan's improper acts of not admitting its unethical crimes. They stressed that they would show anger of the people at Japan's impropriety with candlelight actions in all parts of south Korea on August 15. And the participants marched to the Japanese embassy in Seoul, chanting such slogans as "Compensate the drafted workers!" and "Let's liquidate the pro-Japanese evils!" On the same day, candlelight rallies were also held to condemn Japan's economic provocation in Pusan and South Kyongsang Province. Rodong Sinmun

title: On Our Own and In Our Style
body: One May day a few years ago Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un looked round an exhibition of machines and equipment, which were made to congratulate the mother Party on its congress. He looked at them with a broad smile and said with satisfaction that they were excellent. He added in an excited tone that all the people and soldiers launched a general offensive to make the country rich and strong under the slogan of self-reliance-first principle and that the exhibition was of cardinal importance in inspiring them with confidence and optimism. He said that President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il advanced the idea that one was the master of one’s destiny and should carve it out on one’s own alone, that they trained our people with the spirit of their self-reliance to be too strong in spirit to succumb to impossibility and converted ours into an indestructible strong power nobody can ignore and that our present march was quite fraught with meaning now that we were once again firmly convinced that self-reliance was foremost. That day Kim Jong Un stressed that the machines and equipment were all made by our scientists, technologists and workers on a high level and said that they were especially to his liking because many of them were not modeled after foreign ones but made in our style. Looking up to Kim Jong Un the officials keenly realized once again that the source of great creation lay in an ardent patriotic will to love and value one’s own things and develop them infinitely. Ko Chol Myong

title: DPRK Players Prove Successful in Int'l Judo Game
body: DPRK players won two gold medals, one silver and two bronzes in the Asian-Oceanian Cadets and Junior Judo Championships 2019. Players Kim Hyon A and Ri Chong Mi bagged gold medals in the juvenile women's 52kg category and 57kg category respectively. Mun Song Hui took the second place in the juvenile women's 57kg category and Kwon Kum Chong the third in the junior men's 50kg category. Ri Kum Song won a bronze medal in the junior men's 66kg category. The championships held in Taipei, China brought together 310-odd ace men and women players from 26 countries and region including the DPRK, Mongolia and India. DPRK players returned home on Saturday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Koreans in Japan Visit Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: A home-visiting group of Koreans in Japan visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill Saturday. The visitors laid a bouquet and made a bow before the statues. Rodong Sinmun

title: Italian Delegation Here
body: A delegation of lawmakers from various political parties of Italy headed by Osvaldo Napoli, chairman of the Italia-Korea Parliamentary Group, arrived here on Saturday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Lao Delegation Here
body: A delegation of the Lao Academy of Social Sciences headed by Khamphaeng Thipmountaly, director of the institute of sociology, arrived here on Friday. Rodong Sinmun

title: S. Korean Students Protest against Japan's Impudence
body: The Progressive Federation of Students of south Korea held a press conference in Seoul on July 30 to protest against Japan's impudent behavior, according to the south Korean internet newspaper Jaju Sibo. Speakers there said Japan's behavior of having not yet sincerely reflected on the past crimes of colonizing Korea and inflicting untold damage on it is greatly infuriating all south Koreans. Noting that the supreme court's judgment that war criminal businesses of Japan should indemnify the victims of forced labor was not enough for the victims to settle the old scores, they charged that Japan, on the contrary, engaged in economic retaliation against south Korea. They said the Mitsubishi company should leave south Korea immediately as it is a war criminal business. The participants burnt the flag symbolic of war criminal Japan, tearing photos of the lawmakers from the "Liberal Korea Party" siding with Japan. Rodong Sinmun

title: S. Koreans Urge Japan to Atone for Past Crimes
body: Citizens of Pusan, south Korea held a rally outside the Japanese Consulate General in the city on July 31, according to the south Korean internet newspaper minplusnews. The participants mourned those who were killed after being drafted for forced labor and sexual slavery for the imperial Japanese army. Speakers there said that the growing anti-Japanese sentiments in south Korea are an expression of anger at Japan which has revealed its wild ambition for invasion, far from reflecting on its untold war crimes. Recalling that south Koreans voluntarily join the anti-Japanese campaign like boycott against goods from Japan, they urged the Japanese businesses involved in war crimes to accept the verdict of the supreme court that found them guilty of unprecedented human rights abuses and acts against humanity. Then the participants encircled the consulate general and urged Japan to make an apology and reparation for the past crimes. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Exhibition of August 3 Consumer Goods Opens
body: A national exhibition of August 3 consumer goods opened with due ceremony on Sunday at Pyongyang Department Store No. 1. On display in the exhibition are more than 385 700 consumer goods of over 25 000 kinds produced by factories, enterprises, home workers teams and reutilization production work-teams across the country with locally available materials and resources. The exhibition will last until August 8. Rodong Sinmun

title: Foreigners and Overseas Koreans Visit Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: A delegation of the Lao Academy of Social Sciences, a delegation of the Union of Korean Teachers in Japan and other foreign guests and overseas Koreans visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on Sunday. The visitors paid tribute to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il at the palace. They paid homage to the great leaders at the halls of immortality where they lie in state. They saw round the halls where orders the great leaders received are on display and the halls that house cars, electric car, boat and train coaches used by them during their field guidance and foreign tour till the last moments of their lives. Rodong Sinmun

title: S. Koreans Blame U.S. for Demanding Increase of Upkeep for GIs in S. Korea
body: It was reported by Yonhap News of south Korea that the People for Achieving Peace and Reunification, an organization of south Korea, held a press conference in Seoul on July 31 and censured the U.S. for urging south Korea to pay much more for the GIs stationed in south Korea. Speakers there said that south Korea has already been paying a huge amount of money as upkeep for the GIs in south Korea, holding that south Koreans are saying no to the increase of upkeep. They pointed out that the U.S. groundless demand is aimed to realize its ambition for supremacy by meddling in the south-north relations and introducing U.S.-made weapons into south Korea. Noting that drastic increase of upkeep for the GIs will become a factor of greatly increasing the defense spending of south Korea, they said large-scale arms buildup will inevitably irritate the north and disturb the efforts for preserving peace of the Korean peninsula. They urged the U.S. to retract such demand. Rodong Sinmun

title: Anti-Japanese Sentiments Grow among Self-governing Bodies in South Korea
body: Anti-Japanese sentiments are growing among local self-governing bodies of south Korea in the wake of the unjust economic retaliation launched by Japan, according to KBS of south Korea on August 2. A Japanese flag was removed in Kangnam District of Seoul under the eyes of citizens. Japanese flags in other places also disappeared. "Assemblies" of Seoul City and Kyonggi Province proposed regulations restricting purchase of goods from the Japanese war criminal businesses, and other local "assemblies" are also taking similar steps. More than 120 local self-governing bodies have joined the anti-Japanese campaign. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Is Peerlessly Great Man
body: Who Leads the Revolution with Lofty Love for People If they wish to know the invincibility and great strength of Juche Korea, which remains unfazed by the challenges and ordeals unprecedented in history, they should know Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un’s noble love for the people and if they wish to talk about the rosy future of the DPRK, they should feel the pulsation of his heart for the love for and devotion to the people. The motto “Believe in the people as in heaven” runs right through the idea, leadership and personality of Kim Jong Un, and herein lies the peculiarity of his politics and the great might of change. He is the paramount incarnation of the love for the people ever known in history. The virtues are the main personality a socialist state leader should have. A leader’s noble love for the people is vital to the destiny of socialism when alternation of leadership generation takes place. If the leader is short of the ability, he will delay the development of socialist society. If he has no virtues, he will betray the people to make mess of socialism. The qualitative difference between the Juche-oriented revolution in the DPRK and the revolution in other countries depends on whether it is led by the popular leader possessed of love for the people as disposition or not. Kim Jong Un’s love for the people is the deep-seated ardent thoughts and feelings formed through his experiences. His love for the people sprouted and grew stronger and turned into an unshakable view of life and revolutionary philosophy when he was sharing joys and sorrows with the great leader and the great people and making a revolution with them. The energetic leadership of Kim Jong Un, the paramount incarnation of the love for the people, constitutes a basic source that puts the Korean revolution onto a new high stage and boosts the advance of socialism. Thanks to his veteran and experienced leadership and the great people boundlessly loyal to the cause of the Party, the DPRK will be the first ideal society in the world where the dreams and ideals of the people will come true.

title: Spokesperson for Ministry of Foreign Affairs of DPRK Issues Press Statement
body: A spokesperson of the Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea made public the following press statement on Tuesday: Despite our repeated warnings, the United States and south Korean authorities have finally started the joint military exercise targeting the DPRK. This is an undisguised denial and a flagrant violation of June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement, Panmunjom Declaration and September Pyongyang Joint Declaration, all of which are agreements to establish new DPRK-U.S. relations and build a lasting and stable peace regime on the Korean peninsula. Although the U.S. and south Korean authorities are playing all sorts of tricks to justify the joint military exercise, its aggressive nature can neither be covered up nor whitewashed in any manner. The first joint military exercise "Focus Lens" was conducted in south Korea in 1954, the year after the conclusion of the Armistice Agreement. All the U.S.-south Korea joint military exercises which have been annually conducted during the past 65 years since then were unexceptionally aggressive war exercises simulating the surprise and preemptive attack on the DPRK. What is more serious is that the U.S. increases hostile military tension against us by deploying a large amount of latest offensive military equipment in south Korea, in disregard of its commitment to suspend joint military exercises made at summit level on such occasions as the Singapore DPRK-U.S. summit and the Panmunjom DPRK-U.S. summit. Even after the Singapore DPRK-U.S. summit, the U.S. and south Korean authorities continuously staged all kinds of aggressive war exercises targeting us, such as Marine Corps Joint Exercise, "Alliance 19-1", Joint Aerial Drill, "Proliferation Security Initiative", and the U.S. did not hesitate to conduct the missile interception test simulating an interception of our ICBMs and the test-fire of ICBM "Minuteman-3" and SLBM "Trident 2 D-5." The U.S. also made clear, in "its nuclear deterrence policy report," its policy position to oppose the ban on nuclear first use against our country and it dared to expose the repugnance towards us by branding our country as a "rogue state" and a "proliferator" of nuclear technology, chemical weapons and ballistic missiles. Recently, "F-35A" stealth fighters were brought into south Korea and the U.S. nuclear strategic submarine "Oklahoma City" came into port of Pusan. In the meantime, the U.S. is pushing forward the move to introduce even high-altitude reconnaissance drone "Global Hawk" into south Korea. All these put us on our guard. All the above facts prove that the U.S. and south Korean authorities do not have political will at all to implement the joint statements whereby they committed to improve the DPRK-U.S. relations and the inter-Korean relations, and that they remain unchanged in their position to continue to face us as an enemy. Since the hostile military moves of the U.S. and south Korean authorities have reached the danger line, the spokesperson for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea makes clear the following principled position, strongly condemning and denouncing the above moves. First, the U.S. and south Korean authorities will, under no circumstances, evade from their responsibilities for compelling the DPRK to take countermeasures for eliminating the potential and direct threats to its state security. The U.S. and south Korean authorities know too well that the joint military exercise will cause a backlash from us. Then what is its ulterior motive to conduct it at any cost which only provokes and threatens us? We have already warned several times that the joint military exercises would block progress in the DPRK-U.S. relations and the inter-Korean relations and bring us into reconsideration of our earlier major steps. There is no such a law that one side might be allowed to walk away from its commitment and our side only should be bound by the commitment. As the U.S. and south Korean authorities take every possible occasion to claim that the joint military exercises are "defensive" in nature, an "essential element" for combat preparedness, etc, so we are compelled to develop, test and deploy the powerful physical means essential for national defence. The U.S. and south Korean authorities cannot counter this even though they have ten mouths. If south Korea finds itself so distressed by "security threat," it would be much more expedient for it not to commit such an act that will only make a rod for itself. Second, we remain unchanged in our stand to resolve the issues through dialogue. But the dynamics of dialogue will be more invisible as long as the hostile military moves continue. The prevailing situation is dramatically dampening down our desire for implementing the DPRK-U.S. agreements and the inter-Korean agreements, which also affects the prospect of future dialogue. It is too axiomatic that a constructive dialogue cannot be expected at a time when a simulated war practice targeted at the dialogue partner is being conducted, and there is no need to have a fruitless and exhausting dialogue with those who do not have a sense of communication. The U.S. and south Korean authorities remain outwardly talkative about dialogue. But when they sit back, they sharpen a sword to do us harm. If this is what they call "creative approach" and "imaginative power beyond common sense", we will be compelled to seek a new road as we have already indicated. If the U.S and south Korean authorities trust to luck, disregarding our repeated warnings, we will make them pay heavy price which will in turn make them very much difficult. Rodong Sinmun

title: Downfall of Traitors Is Inevitability of History
body: Public actions for punishing the conservative coteries are gaining momentum in south Korea to coincide with the ever-mounting anti-Japanese sentiments. South Korean people’s fierce actions against the “Liberal Korea Party” represents their condemnation against the group of traitors hell-bent on committing acts of treachery against the will and demands of the people. LKP is a horde of traitors steeped in pro-Japanese spirit to the marrow of their bones, bereft of blood and soul of the Korean nation. It is just an inescapable obligation of Japan to make a sincere apology and reparation for the untold crimes it committed against the Korean nation in the past. It is also as unanimous demand of all the Koreans. However, the conservative group of south Korea has served the island barbarians and prolonged its life by flattering Japs. Japan’s restrictions on export to south Korea are not just an expression of its discontent at the south Korean court’s judgment obliging Japanese businesses to indemnify the victims of the forced labor. Lurking behind them is the sinister design of the Abe group to realize the old dream for the “Great East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere” by creating a political environment favorable for reviving militarism. The conservative group is committing pro-Japanese acts of treachery at a time when the militaristic tendency of the Abe cult has reached its height. It is quite natural that the treachery will facilitate the arbitrariness of the Japanese reactionaries and adding fuel to their burning ambition for reinvasion. That’s why the south Korean people have turned out in the actions as they cannot escape the disgrace to the nation and give vent to their pent-up grudge against the Japanese imperialists and they will suffer war disaster if the group of traitors is allowed to go scot-free. The ruin of the group of traitors is the inevitability of history as it is keen on acts of treachery against public mindset. Sim Chol Yong

title: Enlarged Edition Vol. 6 of "Complete Collection of Kim Il Sung's Works" Published
body: The Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House brought out enlarged edition Vol. 6 of "Complete Collection of Kim Il Sung's Works"-the library of the immortal Juche idea which has his works systematically, comprehensively and in chronological order. The book has 103 works including speeches, talks, reports and concluding speeches made by President Kim Il Sung from April Juche 35 (1946) to July Juche 35 (1946). The works deal with the tasks and ways for safeguarding the revolutionary character of the Workers' Party of Korea by rejecting factionalism and local separatism and firmly uniting the broad masses. The book elucidates the issue of bringing up lots of capable cadres to make them play a vanguard role in building a new country and stresses the need for officials to acquire the popular method and style of work. It also clarifies the idea of putting forward workers, peasants and other working masses as the master of politics, economy and culture by enforcing all democratic reforms to completely eradicate the residue of outdated ideas which had blocked social development of the country for centuries. It also elucidates the policy and militant tasks to found the genuine people's army carrying forward the revolutionary tradition of the anti-Japanese guerrillas and train the military officers in all services and arms by one's own efforts and conducting the military education in the Korean style from A to Z, and the mission and duty of the Party media. It also deals with the theoretical and practical issues arising in building a new country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Italian Delegation Leaves
body: A delegation of lawmakers from various political parties of Italy headed by Osvaldo Napoli, chairman of the Italia-Korea Parliamentary Group, left here for home on Tuesday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Japan's Economic Sanctions Protested in S. Korea
body: According to media reports, actions were launched across south Korea on Aug. 2 in protest against Japan's decision to remove south Korea from a "white list" of countries with preferential trade status after intensifying restrictions on export to south Korea. More than 40 organizations in the area of Pusan called an emergency press conference outside the Japanese consulate general and condemned Japan's move as provocative and aggressive one. The Ulsan Citizens Action for Denouncing Abe composed of civic and social organizations in Ulsan held a news conference outside the city office and slammed Japan for intensifying its economic retaliation, far from reflecting on its history of aggression and war crimes. Rodong Sinmun

title: Sportspersons' Lodging Quarters in Chongchun Street Open
body: The Sportspersons' Lodging Quarters in Chongchun Street opened with due ceremony on Tuesday. The 15-storeyed building with a total floor space of 11 860 sq meters houses an e-library, entertainment room and all other conditions for rest and cultural and leisure life of sportspersons. Present at its opening ceremony were officials concerned, sportspersons, builders and employees of the lodging quarters. That day, sportspersons entered the lodging quarters, being warmly welcomed by its officials and employees. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Players Prove Successful in Int'l Judo Game
body: DPRK players Ri Un Ju and Kim Ye Yong won gold medals in the women's 57kg and 78kg categories of the Asian Judo Open Men and Women Taipei 2019. Meanwhile, Ri Pok Hyang and Kim Jin Gang bagged bronze medals in the women's 63kg and 70kg categories respectively. The games brought together more than 160 men and women players from 17 countries including the DPRK, Vietnam, Mongolia and India. DPRK players returned home on Aug. 6. Rodong Sinmun

title: Light Industry Sci-tech Presentation Opens
body: A national light industry sci-tech presentation and exhibition was opened. An opening ceremony took place at the Sci-Tech Complex on Aug. 6. Attending the presentation and exhibition were teachers, researchers, field officials and three-revolution team members from 30-odd units, including the Ministry of Local Industry, the State Academy of Sciences, Pyongyang Han Tok Su University of Light Industry, Hamhung University of Chemical Engineering, etc. And over 400 papers and at least 1 500 exhibits were presented there. During the exhibition, a lecture and video show will be arranged. The presentation and exhibition will go on till Aug. 9. Rodong Sinmun

title: Joint Friendship Gathering Held by Campers
body: The participants in the 34th Songdowon International Children's Camping had a joint friendship gathering at the Songdowon International Children's Camp on Tuesday. Present at the gathering were the camping groups of children from the DPRK, China, Russia, Vietnam, Laos, India and Germany, overseas Korean children's camping group and officials concerned. Korean and foreign campers gave an art performance. The participants danced all together with delight in enjoying a happy and cheery camping. Rodong Sinmun

title: Photo Exhibition Shows China's Achievements in Socialist Construction
body: A photo exhibition was opened at the People's Palace of Culture on Tuesday to show the achievements gained in building socialism with the Chinese characteristics. Present at the opening ceremony were Kim Yong Jae, minister of External Economic Relations, Pak Kyong Il, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries and chairman of the DPRK-China Friendship Association, officials concerned and Li Jinjun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK, members of his embassy, Chinese guests staying in the DPRK. Speeches were made. Speakers said that the exhibition would help further deepening the friendship and understanding between the peoples of the two countries. They expressed the belief that the exhibition, an event to mark the 70th anniversaries of the establishment of diplomatic ties between the DPRK and China and the foundation of the People's Republic of China, would serve as a significant occasion to promote the development of the long-standing friendship between the two countries. Then the participants saw round the photos. The exhibition will continue till Aug. 8. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Watches Demonstration Fire of
body: New-Type Tactical Guided Missiles Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, watched the demonstration fire of new-type tactical guided missiles at daybreak Tuesday. After receiving the report on the plan for demonstration fire of new-type tactical guided missiles at the observation post together with the accompanying officials, Supreme Leader of the Party, state and armed forces Kim Jong Un saw the fire. Two tactical guided missiles launched at the operational airfield in the western area of the country flied across the sky over the capital area and the central inland region of the country to precisely hit the targeted islet in the East Sea of Korea. The demonstration fire clearly verified the reliability, security and actual war capacity of the new-type tactical guided weapon system. Highly appreciating that the demonstration fire was carried out satisfactorily as intended, Kim Jong Un noted that the said military action would be an occasion to send an adequate warning to the joint military drill now underway by the U.S. and south Korean authorities. The Supreme Leader met the leading officials and scientists in the field of national defence science and workers in the field of munitions industry who successfully conducted the demonstration fire, and had a photo taken with them. Accompanying him were Vice-Chairmen of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea Pak Pong Ju, Ri Man Gon, Pak Kwang Ho, Ri Su Yong, Kim Phyong Hae, O Su Yong, An Jong Su, Pak Thae Dok and Pak Thae Song and First Vice Department Directors of the C.C. WPK Jo Yong Won and Ri Pyong Chol and vice department directors of the C.C., WPK. Present there were Army General Ri Yong Gil, chief of the General Staff of the Korean People's Army, and Army General Pak Jong Chon, director of the Artillery Bureau of the KPA. Political News Team

title: National Symposium Held
body: A national symposium on science took place to mark the 60th anniversary of the founding of Pyongyang University of Mechanical Engineering on Tuesday and Wednesday. Attending the symposium were teachers, researchers and graduate students from more than 40 universities including Kim Il Sung University and Pyongyang University of Mechanical Engineering. Over valuable 600 papers were presented to the symposium which was held divided into 10 panels. Research successes achieved by teachers, researchers and graduate students were made public and experience was exchanged. Rodong Sinmun

title: Nepalese Delegation Here
body: A delegation of the Nepal Communist Party (Marxist-Leninist) headed by Surendra Dhakal, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee, arrived here on Wednesday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Many People Visit Mangyongdae Revolutionary Site for Six Decades
body: It has been 60 years since the Mangyongdae Revolutionary Museum was inaugurated on Aug. 7, Juche 48 (1959). During the past six decades, over 139 million people including working people, service personnel, youth and students, overseas compatriots and foreigners have visited Mangyongdae. The visitors to the museum looked round with deep attention rooms for the historical data showing that President Kim Il Sung was born into a patriotic and revolutionary family and spent his childhood, nurturing a high ambition for revolution. They visited the President's old home in Mangyongdae in humble reverence for him who devoted his life to the country and people. Seeing around the historical mementoes preserved in the straw-thatched old home and various historical places like Swing Site, Sliding Rock, Warship Rock, etc., the visitors keenly felt that the President was a peerlessly great man and peerless patriot who harbored the lofty intention of loving the country, nation and people. Over 231 000 overseas compatriots and south Koreans and 1.21 million foreigners also visited Mangyongdae to grasp the sacred revolutionary career and history of the President. Rodong Sinmun

title: Campers Have Whale of Time
body: The 34th Songdowon International Children's Camping took place from July 31 to Aug. 7. Korean schoolchildren and foreign campers spent a joyful time at the Songdowon International Children's Camp. The campers enjoyed themselves at seashore, indoor pool and outdoor playground and electronic recreation hall, 4D simulation cinema, aquarium, aviary and labyrinthine-like mirror house. During the camping, campers from different countries promoted their ties, singing songs of friendship, irrespective of differences in language, national identity and customs. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Premier Inspects Several Units in Tanchon and Komdok Areas
body: Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, member of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, inspected factories, enterprises and mines in Tanchon and Komdok areas. He learnt in detail about the situation of several units such as the Tanchon Magnesia Factory, the Tanchon Smeltery, the Tanchon Mining Machine Factory, the Ryongyang Mine, etc. and stressed the need to revitalize the production by turning production processes into power-saving ones by dint of the spirit of self-reliance and the might of science and technology. Walking round the Kumgol Mine and Dressing Plant No. 3 of the Komdok Mining Complex, he encouraged its workers including members of the Ko Kyong Chan-led Hero Workteam and called for decisively increasing the extraction rate in concentration and the quality of concentrated ore. The field consultative meeting called on officials to properly map out management and business strategy and meticulously organize and lead economic affairs to ensure profitability, and discussed measures to let relevant units positively support factories, enterprises and mines in Tanchon and Komdok areas. On the other hand, he learnt about the construction of the Tanchon Power Station, discussed the issues of increasing the level of mechanization in the construction and fully supplying materials and satisfying transport requirements and took measures for them. He also made a field survey of the farming at the Suui Cooperative Farm in Hochon County. Rodong Sinmun

title: Film Show Held
body: A film show was held at the Chollima Hall of Culture on Thursday to mark the month of solidarity with the Cuban people. Present there on invitation were Councilor Boris Perez Abin and other staff members of the Cuban embassy here. It was attended by So Ho Won, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Solidarity with Cuba and vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries, officials concerned and working people in Pyongyang. The participants watched a Cuban feature film. Rodong Sinmun

title: Foreign Guests Visit Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: Foreign guests including a delegation of the Nepal Communist Party (Marxist-Leninist) headed by Dhakal Surendra, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of its Central Committee, visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on Thursday. They paid tribute to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. They also paid homage to the great leaders in the halls where they lie in state. They made rounds of the halls where the orders the great leaders received are on display and the halls that house cars, electric car, boat and train coaches used by them during their field guidance and foreign tour till the last moments of their lives. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Premier Inspects Samjiyon County
body: Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, member of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, inspected Samjiyon County. Going round the Paektusan Museum, the Samjiyon County Hall of Culture, the Samjiyon County People's Hospital, hotels and others under construction, he gave a pep talk to builders who are making positive efforts to complete the construction projects prioritized by the Party within the period set by the Party. The consultative meeting called on relevant units to preferentially supply materials necessary for the remodeling of Samjiyon County and minutely organize and command the transport. Earlier, he learned about the preservation of historic relics at Chairman Kim Jong Il's birthplace in the Paektusan Secret Camp and its management, and acquainted himself with the potato farming at the Junghung Farm and stressed the need to take measures for supplying farm machines and overhauling them. Rodong Sinmun

title: CPRC Reunification and Agitation Department Blames
body: South Korea-U.S. Joint Military Exercises The Reunification and Agitation Department of the Committee for the Peaceful Reunification of the Country (CPRC) of the DPRK Thursday made public an open letter revealing who is the arch criminal harassing peace and stability on the Korean peninsula as regards the fact that the south Korean authorities and the U.S. have conducted an aggressive joint military exercise since Aug. 5. According to the open letter, the joint military exercises which have been conducted by the south Korean authorities with outsiders century after century are the root cause escalating tension on the Korean peninsula and blocking the development of the inter-Korean relations. The south Korean authorities continue to conduct joint military exercises against the fellow countrymen together with outsiders while asserting that "they should adopt perfect military posture" after shaking hands with us for "reconciliation and peace" at the venue of dialogue. They had conducted the "2018 Max Thunder", the very adventurous allied air combat drill aimed at making a preemptive air strike at the DPRK and commanding the air with the U.S., in the whole area of south Korea since May 11, last year even before the ink of the historic April 27 Panmunjom Declaration which excited the whole Korean nation and international community got dry. This is the typical example. The south Korean authorities responded to the repeated warnings of the DPRK against the joint military drills with outsiders by launching at last the north-targeted war drills whose original codename Ulji Freedom Guardian was changed, but form and contents never differ from it at all. Citing a series of hidden hostile acts for invading the DPRK in south Korea, the open letter went on: The north and the south, in their agreement in the military field for implementing the Panmunjom declaration, agreed each other to completely halt all hostile acts of becoming the root cause of military tensions and conflicts on the ground and in the air and the sea and all other spaces. But the south Korean authorities are staging north-targeted attack drills in camera in league with outsiders, saying "there is a method not to make public the drills" and "joint drills will not be exceedingly publicized for the sake of strategic communication." The war-like forces of the south Korean military mobilized marine corps and special operation units to secretly stage joint special operation drills against the DPRK together with the U.S. marines in March. They have been staging in camera flying drills of F-35A stealth fighters since April. They also staged a joint naval drill Pacific Vanguard together with the U.S. in the waters off Guam in May and secretly a joint infiltration exercise targeting the nuclear facilities of the DPRK together with south Korea-present U.S. forces at a U.S. military base in Uijongbu city, Kyonggi Province in June. They took part in the U.S.-led multinational naval intercepting drill targeting the DPRK on the pretext of "preventing WMD proliferation" in the waters off Pusan in July in the wake of last year's, and waged a joint sub drill Silent Shark targeting the DPRK together with warships of the U.S. Seventh Fleet in the waters off Guam. The drill involved subs and sea patrol planes. Condemning the south Korean authorities for their frantic arms build-up against the fellow countrymen in the north, the open letter continued: At the seminar "national defense reform" on May 11 last year, less than two weeks after he signed the historic Panmunjom declaration, the south Korean chief executive said that powerful defense capabilities are necessary to cope with unspecified and diverse threats in the case of the improved inter-Korean ties and ordered his men to concentrate all efforts on the arms build-up. Accordingly, days later the south Korean bellicose military forces launched with due ceremony a large-sized transport ship for a landing operation in the area of the DPRK side in case of emergency, claiming that the military's mission will never change though the security situation may change and that they will further tighten the military posture. The south Korean authorities have purchased F-35A stealth fighters one after another from the U.S. since March this year in a bid to mount a "preemptive attack" on the DPRK, according to the "defense ministry's program for 2019" and the "2019-2023 mid-term defense program." Under the pretext of coping with "the existing threat from the north," they increased the military budget for 2019 by 8.2%, as compared to the one for 2018 which was at the record level. Not content with this, they submitted to the "National Assembly" the draft military budget for 2020, 8% up from the one for 2019. The open letter warned that the south Korean authorities, who have been disloyal to the fellow countrymen and abetted the U.S. in the moves for stifling the DPRK, can never escape from the responsibility of compelling the DPRK to take countermeasures for eliminating potential and direct threats to its security, and will pay dearly for it. Rodong Sinmun

title: Do Not Covet Another’s Territory
body: The Tokyo Olympic Organizing Committee openly posted on its website a map on which Tok Island is marked as Japan’s “territory” and the East Sea of Korea as the “Sea of Japan” with the 2020 Olympics to be hosted in Japan approaching. What merits an attention is the fact that Chief Cabinet Secretary Suga said at a press conference that Japan’s dominium over “Takeshima” and its status in relation to the “Sea of Japan” have been put into consideration. This goes to prove that Japanese government is set to use even the holy international sports festival as a plaything of politics. So persistent, indeed, is the Japanese reactionaries’ ambition for seizing territory. The Olympics will draw lots of sportspersons from different countries of the world, to say nothing of tourists. The Japanese reactionaries have gone crafty enough to avail themselves of the opportunity to make the world people believe that Tok Island and the East Sea of Korea both belong to Japan. Their intention is to paint Japan as a “victim” by making the international community think the island and the sea as “usurped land and sea”. That’s why they are making a far-fetched assertion that not only Tok Island, part of an inviolable territory of Korea, but also the East Sea of Korea are theirs in a foolish bid to turn the region into a dispute-torn area, internationalize the issue and secure a legal pretext for the reinvasion of Korea. The crafty sleight of hand employed by the islanders can never work. Ra Myong Song

title: SPA Session Due in DPRK
body: The Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly (SPA) of the DPRK on Aug. 8 released a decision to convene the Second Session of the 14th SPA in Pyongyang on Aug. 29, Juche 108 (2019). Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to Singaporean President
body: Choe Ryong Hae, president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, Friday sent a message of greeting to Halimah Yacob, president of the Republic of Singapore, on the occasion of the 54th anniversary of its national day. Expressing belief that the friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries with a long history and tradition would grow stronger in various fields, the message wished the Singaporean president big success in her responsible work for the prosperity and development of the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of Union of Korean Teachers in Japan Visits Mangyongdae
body: A delegation of the Union of Korean Teachers in Japan led by Ri Chang Hung, vice-chairman of its Central Standing Committee, visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. Being told about the revolutionary history of the President at his old home in Mangyongdae, the visitors looked round the historical relics. They also toured different places of Pyongyang Teacher Training College. The delegation also visited the Tower of the Juche Idea, the Korean Revolution Museum, the Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace, etc. Rodong Sinmun

title: Remodeled Pyongyang Ostrich Farm Inaugurated
body: The remodeled Pyongyang Ostrich Farm was inaugurated with due ceremony on Friday. Several production buildings for raising ostrich on a scientific and technical basis, at least 110 pens, sci-tech learning space, gymnasium and others were newly built there. And more than 10 structures including meat-processing factory and hatchery took on a new look. Present at the inaugural ceremony were Ri Man Gon, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials concerned, officials of various units, which helped the remodeling of the farm, officials and employees of the farm. Rodong Sinmun

title: Kim Jae Ryong Inspects Various Units in Hamhung City
body: Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, member of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, inspected various units in Hamhung City. Inspecting workshops of the February 8 Vinalon Complex, the premier underscored the need to organize and guide production on the principle of ensuring maximum economic benefits. At the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex and the Ryongsong Machine Complex, he underscored the need to push ahead with the work for recycling waste from production and to intensify one's own sci-tech power. The field consultative meetings discussed measures for the relevant units to fully supply raw and other materials and equipment needed for putting production on normal track and measures for actively developing and introducing new power-saving technologies. The premier also inspected the Hamhung Branch of the State Academy of Sciences and the Hungnam Pharmaceutical Factory. Rodong Sinmun

title: Indian Body Demands Halt to Military Drills Targeting DPRK
body: The All India Indo-Korean Friendship Association on Aug. 7 made public a statement in support of the press statement issued by a spokesperson of the Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea to condemn the U.S. and south Korean authorities' hostile military acts. The statement said that the U.S. and south Korean authorities launched the joint military exercises posing a big threat to the efforts for peace on the Korean peninsula, branding them as an undisguised denial and a flagrant violation of the June 12 DPRK-U.S. Joint Statement, Panmunjom Declaration and September Pyongyang Joint Declaration. It went on: The U.S. has escalated military tension with hostility toward the DPRK by massively deploying latest offensive military equipment in south Korea. This proves that the U.S. and the south Korean authorities do not have any political will to implement the joint statements in which they committed to improve the DPRK-U.S. relations and the inter-Korean relations, and that they would remain hostile toward the DPRK. The U.S. and south Korean authorities will not be able to evade their responsibilities for compelling the DPRK to take countermeasures to remove potential and direct threats to its security. The statement strongly demanded an immediate halt to the joint military exercises for the sake of peace and security of the Korean peninsula. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegation of Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League Leaves for Russia, Laos
body: A delegation of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League led by Kim Song Il, vice-chairman of its Central Committee, left here on Saturday to take part in the International Youth Forum to be held in Russia and visit Laos. Rodong Sinmun

title: Swedish Delegation Arrives
body: A delegation of the Swedish Institute for Security and Development Policy led by Director Niklas Swanstrom arrived here on Saturday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Guides Test-Fire of New Weapon
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, guided the test-fire of a new weapon on August 10. The scientists in the field of national defence science and workers in the field of the munitions industry perfected another new weapon system the orientation of research and development of which was indicated by the Party recently, and made a proud report to the Party Central Committee. After receiving a report on the development of the new weapon, Supreme Leader of the Party, state and armed forces Kim Jong Un gave an instruction to test it immediately. The Supreme Leader looked round the new weapon at the launching site. He said that the new weapon which was developed to suit the terrain condition of our country and as required by the Juche-oriented war methods has advantageous tactical character different to the existing weapon systems, and explained the strategic and tactical attempt of the Party Central Committee which indicated the task to develop the weapon system to the field of national defence science. He mounted the observation post and guided the test-fire. When he gave the order of fire, powerful Juche projectiles spewed dazzling flashes as if they heralded their birth. The detailed analysis of the test-fire result proved that the new weapon system's advantageous and powerful demand of the design was perfectly met. After seeing the test-fire result of the new weapon transmitted to the display at the observation post, the Supreme Leader expressed great satisfaction, being very pleased that another new weapon intended by the Party came into being. Noting that our scientists in the field of national defence science and workers in the field of munitions industry do everything when the Party gives an orientation only, he said that they correctly see through the strategic idea and intention of the Party Central Committee and carry out them before anyone. He added that they are very grateful comrades who always relieve him of heavy burden, difficulties and hardships. He appreciated that the heroic and patriotic feats of the scientists in the field of national defence science and workers in the field of munitions industry will be recorded forever along with the history of the struggle of our Party as they are steadily consolidating the defence capability of the country, true to the Party's strategy for developing the defence industry, with boundless loyalty to the Party and the revolution and the noblest patriotism. Political News Team

title: Editorial
body: Let Us Turn out as One in Environmental Protection with Noble Civic Consciousness All the officials, Party members and other working people should turn out in environmental protection, being mindful that it is a patriotic work of lasting significance for the prosperity of the country and nation and for posterity, to say nothing of the current generation.Environmental protection is an important and responsible work to add beauty to the country, promote the people’s health and provide them with highly civilized living conditions.At present, it comes to be an urgent demand to intensify environmental protection.To attach importance to the environmental protection is a global trend. The rapid environmental destruction causes frequent abnormal climatic phenomena that endanger the existence of mankind, producing knotty problems. Global warming, desertification and air, river and sea pollution have severely destroyed forest, land and wildlife resources and the amount of loss reaches astronomical figures. That’s why the environmental protection emerges as a matter of international concern and many countries have channeled great efforts into it.Patriotism means devotion to the country and people. All the DPRK citizens should actively turn out with burning patriotism in the environmental protection to turn the country into a beautiful socialist land of bliss in the era of the Workers’ Party. title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Orders to Promote Military Ranks of National Defense Research Scientists
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Central Military Commission of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), on Aug. 12 issued Order No. 008 to promote the military ranks of scientists in the field of national defense science research who have made great contributions to bolstering up the military capabilities for self-defence. He said in the order that in hearty response to the decision made at the historic Seventh Congress of the WPK and the spirit of the 8th Conference of Munitions Industry, our reliable scientists in the field of national defence science research, who are firmly equipped with the WPK's revolutionary idea, performed feats to be specially recorded by developing and completing new powerful weapon systems one after another which are of key importance in defending the Party, the revolution, the country and the people and guaranteeing the victorious advance of the revolutionary cause of Juche with matchless military strength. He, in the name of the Party and government, highly praised the scientists in the field of national defence science research for providing an epoch-making turning point in bolstering up the country's military capabilities for self-defense and successfully implementing the strategic plan and intention of the Party by settling highly difficult technological problems of the ultra-modern national defense science with indomitable spiritual strength and remarkable creative power and by researching and developing new weapon systems with our own efforts, wisdom and technology. He issued the order to award a higher military rank to 103 scientists.

title: Editorial
body: Let Us Thoroughly Implement the Tasks Set in the New Year Address of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un with the Strength of Self-reliance Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in his New Year Address for this year set forth the task to expand the country’s capability of self-supporting development to open up bright prospects for taking a step forward towards socialist construction. The slogan “Let us open a new road of advance for socialist construction under the uplifted banner of self-reliance!” reflects the firm will of the Workers’ Party of Korea to bring earlier the rosier future of socialism on the basis of our own efforts and foundation and the Korean-style stratagem for struggle and mode of creation. Self-reliance is the only way to survive and to be followed by us. The last seven month-long struggle proved once again that the high dignity and genuine prosperity of the DPRK and the advance and development of Juche revolution lie in believing in our own efforts and paving the way by dint of self-reliance. The reality shows that it is the best to live our own way whatever the situation and if we wage an indomitable struggle based on the firm belief in our own strength, we can surely attain the goals of struggle for this year. Let us thoroughly carry out the militant task set forth by the Supreme Leader in his New Year Address, so as to bring earlier the prosperity of our great state and the rosy future of our people.

title: 9th Rason Int'l Trade Exhibition Opens
body: The 9th Rason International Trade Exhibition opened with due ceremony on Monday. Exhibited there are building materials, light industrial goods, food, daily necessities, medicines, etc. presented by 110 units from several countries including the DPRK, China, Russia and Germany. Attending the ceremony were officials concerned, working people in Rason City, exhibitors, consul generals of China and Russia in Chongjin, Chinese figures concerned and foreign businessmen active in the Rason economic and trade zone. Speeches were made there. Rodong Sinmun

title: Japan's Apology and Reparation Urged in S. Korea
body: A citizens' meeting for denouncing Japan took place in Jonju City, North Jolla Province of south Korea on August 8, according to the south Korean internet newspaper Tongil News. At the meeting, a letter to the chief executive of Japan was read out. The letter said the Japanese government should stop at once the economic retaliation and make an apology and reparation to the victims and expressed the will to fight it out. The participants in the meeting launched a signature campaign for settling the issue of conscript labor forced by the Japanese imperialists upon Koreans after looking round propaganda literatures showing the testimony of victims of the forced labor and Japan's denial of past crimes. Rodong Sinmun

title: Kim Jae Ryong Inspects Chollima Steel Complex and Taean Friendship Glass Factory
body: Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, member of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, inspected the Chollima Steel Complex and the Taean Friendship Glass Factory. Looking round several workshops at the Chollima Steel Complex, Kim Jae Ryong underscored the need to properly work out the management strategy and conduct business activities in an active and creative way as required by the socialist system of responsible business operation, so as to contribute to putting the metal industry on a Juche and modern basis and further improve the supply service for workers. At the Taean Friendship Glass Factory, he called for introducing sci-tech successes into production to lower the production cost to the minimum and recycling wastes in an active manner. The field consultative meetings called on relevant units to supply raw materials and fuel necessary for iron and steel production in good time and discussed the issues of making products diverse. Rodong Sinmun

title: The Leader of Cuban Revolution Enjoys Immortality with Socialist Cause
body: August 13 is the 93rd birth anniversary of Fidel Castro Ruz, leader of the Cuban revolution.Fidel Castro Ruz was an ardent revolutionary fighter who established the socialist system for the first time in the western hemisphere of the earth and devoted his all to the prosperity of the country.Under his leadership, the Cuban people built a socialist country and pushed forward the revolution and construction despite the imperialists’ vicious moves of aggression, interference and blockade.Cuba has become one of advanced Latin American countries in the fields of education and public health.The victory in the revolution and proud changes in Cuba would have been unthinkable without his guidance.Even today, his spirit is alive in the hearts of the Cuban people and propels the cause of socialism in Cuba.His exploits are shining along with the advance of the socialist cause in Cuba.The Korean people have respected him as an outstanding leader of the Cuban people, prominent title: Centenarian Receives Birthday Spread
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un sent a birthday spread to Ri Kyong Ui, a woman residing in Namsan-ri, Kusong City of North Phyongan Province, on the occasion of her 100th birthday.She was born into a poor peasant's family and had suffered all sorts of humiliation and insult before the country's liberation. title: Delegation of Rodong Sinmun Offices Meets Head of Publicity Department of C.C., CPC
body: A delegation of the Rodong Sinmun Offices of the DPRK headed by Deputy Editor-in-Chief Kim Jin Su on a visit to China met and had a talk with Huang Kunming, member of the Political Bureau, member of the Secretariat and head of the Publicity Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC), at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing on August 23.Huang Kunming said that the friendly relations between China and the DPRK, common precious wealth provided by the leaders of the elder generation of the two countries, open a new historic chapter thanks to the five meetings between General Secretary Xi Jinping and Chairman Kim Jong Un.He hoped that the Korean people would achieve excellent successes in the struggle for implementing the five-year strategy for national economic development under the wise leadership of Kim Jong Un.He expressed his expectation that the party papers of the two countries would boost the exchange and cooperation to promote the development of the traditional friendship between China and the DPRK.Attending there were the DPRK ambassador to China and officials of the Chinese People's Daily.Rodong Sinmun A delegation of the title: Sports Games Mark Day of Songun

Chongchun Street between men players of the sports team of Pyongyang Medical College of Kim Il Sung University and the Amnokgang Sports Team.The Amnokgang Sports Team beat its rival 3:1.Rodong Sinmun title: Day of Songun Marked in DPRK
body: Art performances were given at theatres in Pyongyang and other parts of the country on Sunday to mark the Day of Songun.An art performance was given by the State Merited Chorus at the People's Theatre.The performance began with prelude "General Is Great Defender" and "General of Korea".Put on the stage were numbers including male quartet "Snow Falls on Road to Front", mixed duet "Tell, O Road of Songun", orchestra and male chorus "Thinking of General", male solo and male chorus "Peace Is Guaranteed by Our Arms".The performers sang highly of Chairman Kim Jong Il's revolutionary career and exploits.The National Symphony Orchestra gave a concert at the Moranbong Theatre and artistes of the Phibada Opera Troupe presented a collection of famous songs and scenes at the Pyongyang Grand Theatre.The drama "Blood Vessel" was given at the National Theatre.Circus and magic performances were given at the Pyongyang Circus Theater and the jugglery theatre of the National Acrobatic Troupe.Performances were given at theatres and squares of North Phyongan, North Hwanghae, Jagang and other provinces of the country. title: Pak Pong Ju Visits Construction Site of Wonsan Kalma Coastal Tourist Area
body: Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the WPK, learned about the construction of the Wonsan Kalma coastal tourist area in field.Visiting various places of the construction site, he encouraged the builders working miracles and innovations to build Korean-style coastal city in Myongsasipri, a scenic spot on the east coast.He emphasized the issue of ensuring the highest quality of all the buildings and stressed the need for relevant fields to fully tap production potentials to timely provide equipment and materials needed and do greening well.
