title: Dancing Parties Held
body: Dancing parties of youth and students were held in different parts of the country Sunday, the 59th anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's start of the Songun revolutionary leadership.Amid the playing of the song "Long Live Great Illustrious Commander of Songun" at the venues of dancing parties in Pyongyang, including the plazas of the Monument to Party Founding and the Pyongyang Indoor Stadium, youth and students represented the sea of dancers in token of the humblest reverence for Kim Jong Il.The participants danced to the tunes of such songs as "Our General Is the Best", "This Is Thanks to the Songun Politics of General", "Cheers of the People", "Song of Youth" and "Dash toward Future".There were similar dancing parties in provincial seats, cities and counties on the same day. title: We Support Measures Taken by Chinese Party and Government to Maintain the Line of “One Country and Two Systems”
body: The situation is getting serious in Hong Kong, China as demonstrations against the revision of the law there have assumed the tendency of opposing the social system and the government.What matters is that the interference by the outside world is making the Hong Kong crisis more and more complicated.Extremists, encouraged by this, are openly asserting the intervention in the crisis by the U.S. and other Western forces, chanting “Let’s liberate Hong Kong” and other slogans.It is the steadfast determination and will of the Chinese party and government to maintain the line of “one country and two systems” and defend the sovereignty, security and interests of the country.The Chinese Party and government are holding fast to the principle of settling the crisis by way of maintaining prosperity and stability of Hong Kong, ensuring rights and freedom of inhabitants according to the basic law and handling hooligans through legal actions.As the issue of Hong Kong pertains to China’s internal affairs, no one has the right to interfere in it.The issue should be settled according to the decision of the Chinese people themselves.The DPRK supports the measures taken by the Chinese party and government to solve the problem by way of executing the law with the power of self-control and hopes that their measures would yield desired fruits as early as possible.Jo Thaek Bom title: Seminar on Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's Work Held
body: A seminar was held at the Central Youth Hall on Monday to mark the third anniversary of the publication of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us Usher in a Golden Age of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth Movement".The seminar heard papers explaining and proving the validity and vitality of the idea and theory set forth by Kim Jong Un in the work dated Aug. 28, Juche 105 (2016) and those on tasks and ways for preparing all the young people to be genuine Kimilsungists-Kimjongilists.Speakers stressed that the work serves as an immortal programme as it contains in a comprehensive way the idea and theory for ushering in a golden age of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist youth movement.His idea that the youth league should hold fast to ideological education of young people as its main task and fully prepare all of them to be genuine Kimilsungists-Kimjongilists is an important guideline to be adhered to by all the youth league organizations, as it is a revolutionary one that scientifically indicates the fundamental way of modeling the youth league on Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, they said.They vowed to fulfill their mission and duty in the van of the struggle for modeling the youth league on Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism in hearty response to the tasks laid down in the work.Present there were youth league officials, officials concerned and youth and title: Kim Jae Ryong Inspects Several Units
body: Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, member of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, inspected several units in the field of the national economy, including the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex and the Pyongyang Bus Plant.Learning in detail about the process of ammonia production, maintenance of equipment and production at the complex, he underscored the need to step up the updating of production processes and obtain optimum results in the management.At the Pyongyang Bus Plant and the Pyongyang Trolley Bus Factory he saw a new-type bus, battery car and others made by their own efforts and technology, encouraged the officials and workers to register more successes and stressed the need to positively introduce advanced technologies in assembly processes.The field consultative meetings discussed the measures for supplying electricity, further perfecting the machinery system, putting production processes on an automated and robotized basis and making relevant units properly produce and supply products under contract. title: Japanese Politicians Visit Shrine in Groups Reviving Militarist Specter
body: The Japanese chief executive made an offering to the Yasukuni Shrine and nearly fifty lawmakers paid a visit to the shrine to revive the departed souls of militarists on the day of the Japanese imperialists’ defeat.The group visit to the shrine by the Japanese politicians reveals that they have no idea for reflection on and apology for the past wars of aggression, but only seek overseas aggression following in their predecessors’ footsteps.The Japanese ruling quarters turned the day of the defeat as a lever for reviving the departed souls of militarists and fostering public atmosphere for overseas aggression. title: Sports Contest among Officials of Ministries and National Institutions-2019 Opens
body: The sports contest among officials of ministries and national institutions-2019 was opened with due ceremony on Tuesday at the Basketball Gymnasium in Chongchun Street to mark the founding anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.The participants will compete in men's basketball, women's volleyball, table-tennis, Taekwon-do, tug of war and colorful sports and amusement games on a knock-out basis at the Pyongyang Indoor Stadium, gymnasiums in Chongchun Street, the Taekwon-Do Hall, etc.Attending the opening ceremony were Ro Tu Chol, vice-premier of the Cabinet and chairman of the State Planning Commission who doubles as vice-chairman of the National Sports Guidance Committee, Jon Kwang Ho, vice-premier of the Cabinet, and officials and players of ministries and national institutions.At the end of the ceremony there took place a demonstration of players of the Taekwon-Do Team of the Korean Taekwon-Do Committee and other events. title: Kim Jae Ryong Inspects Several Units in South Hwanghae Province
body: Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, member of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, inspected several agricultural units in South Hwanghae Province.While going round the single-stage water pumping station of the West Sea Barrage-Sinchon-Kangryong, Ongjin Waterway and the township co-op farm and the Sogok Co-op Farm in Unryul County, he stressed the need to put the water control on a scientific basis, build more profitable underground water facilities like drop well and secure water source in a far-sighted way. He also emphasized putting effort on developing natural energy to suit the topographical characteristics.The field consultative meetings discussed the practical measures to fully supply electricity needed for agricultural production and the issues to ensure the supply of equipment and materials in a planned way.Earlier, he went round the Sunchon Co-op Farm in Hwangju County, North Hwanghae Province to learn about the supply of irrigation water. title: International High-Tech Product Trade Fair Opens
body: The international high-tech product trade fair opened with due ceremony at the Pyongyang International Cinema House in Pyongyang on Monday.On display at the trade fair are artificial intelligence products, electronic goods, building materials, light industrial products, household goods and others.Present at the opening ceremony were Ri Chung Gil, chairman of the State Commission of Science and Technology, officials concerned, Chinese guests participating in the trade fair and foreign diplomatic envoys here.Ri Myong Hwan, vice-minister of Construction and Building-Materials Industry, made an opening address to be followed by congratulatory speeches.Speakers said the trade fair opened in the significant year marking the 70th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the DPRK and China would offer an occasion for promoting the friendship and cooperation, strengthening the economic cooperation and exchange and expediting trade activities between the two countries.They voiced the will to continue to develop the external economic relations between the two countries on a new high stage.The trade fair will last until September 6. title: Intensive Show of Stamps Marks 71st Founding Anniversary of DPRK
body: An intensive show of stamps began at the Korean Stamp Exhibition House on Wednesday in celebration of the 71st founding anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.A photo of the stamp carrying the image of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un making his first New Year Address is seen at the venue of the exhibition.Stamps and bills are displayed under the title of "My Great Country." Among them are stamps showing the feats of President Kim Il Sung who laid a firm foundation for building an independent and sovereign state after the liberation of Korea, and others dealing with the history of revolutionary activities of Chairman Kim Jong Il who developed the DPRK into an invincible politico-ideological power and a military power.Stamps dealing with the spirit of the DPRK advancing under the guidance of the Supreme Leader are on display.Also exhibited there are stamps showing the heroic struggle of the Korean people recorded in the victorious annals of the Republic.The show will last till Sep. 14. title: Participants in 14th National Conference of Teachers Tour Pyongyang
body: The participants in the 14th National Conference of Teachers toured different places in Pyongyang.They visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung.They went to the Mangyongdae Revolutionary Museum and looked round historic mementoes preserved at the old home of the President in Mangyongdae.At the Korean Revolution Museum, they paid tribute to the colored statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in the general review room and made rounds of various halls.They also visited Kim Il Sung University, Kim Chaek University of Technology, Pyongyang University of Education, Mangyongdae Revolutionary School, Pyongyang Primary School No. 4, Pyongyang Primary School for Orphans, Pyongyang Middle School for Orphans, the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum, the Central Class Education House and others.They looked round equipment and apparatuses for experiment and practical training and teaching aids made by educational institutions and industrial establishments at all levels at the venues of the national educational experimental apparatus and teaching aids exhibition and the education aid exhibition, and exchanged successes and experience.They watched the grand mass gymnastics and artistic performance "The Land of the People" and an art performance given by kindergarteners from across the country. title: Agricultural Workers and Members of UAWK Meet
body: Agricultural workers and members of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea (UAWK) held a meeting on Thursday in celebration of the 71st founding anniversary of the DPRK.At the meeting a reporter and speakers stressed that the founding of the DPRK on September 9 Juche 37 (1948) was a historical event that witnessed the materialization of the long-cherished desire of the Korean people for genuine state power of the working masses.They said that President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il set an example of the century in socialist state building.The leadership of the President and the Chairman who pushed forward the building of a powerful country of Juche on the people-first principle is the main factor which guaranteed the steady development of the Republic, they stressed.The guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un ushers in the heyday of the building of a powerful socialist country, they noted.They called for becoming true rural revolutionaries supporting socialism with increased rice production under the uplifted banner of our state-first spirit true to the leadership of Kim Jong Un. title: Poem-reciting and Concert Given by Workers and Members of GFTUK
body: A poem-reciting and concert "My Great Country" was given by workers and members of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea (GFTUK) at the Central Hall of Workers on Thursday in celebration of the 71st founding anniversary of the DPRK.The event began with chorus "Ode to the Motherland".In female trio "The Country of the Leader", narration and male solo "Red Chol Pass", lyric poem "My Motherland" and other numbers, performers praised the revolutionary careers and exploits of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il who established the genuine people's power for the first time in history and opened a broad avenue for building a prosperous country.Put on the stage were poem "We Love Socialism" and female chorus "Cheers of the People" reflecting the people's thoughts and feelings about the country advancing to attain the high goal of building a powerful socialist country under the guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un.Also put on the stage were numbers reflecting the will of the working people who turn out in the grand march to create Mallima speed while leading a glorious life under the care of the Workers' Party of Korea.Attending there were Ju Yong Gil, chairman of the GFTUK Central Committee, trade union officials and working people in Pyongyang.Rodong Sinmun A poem-reciting and concert "My Great Country" was given by workers and members title: National Cooking Contest Held among Restaurants and Hotels
body: A national cooking contest among restaurants and hotels took place at Sinhung Restaurant in South Hamgyong Province from September 3 to 5 under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of the Korean Association of Cooks.The contest brought together nearly 40 units in Pyongyang and local areas.There was an appreciation of the materials composition, processing, taste and artistry and other indices at the contest which involved a demonstration performance with the main emphasis put on technical contest and contest of reception and service.At the contest held among restaurants famous dishes were presented by Okryu Restaurant, Sinhung Restaurant of South Hamgyong Province, Chongryu Restaurant, Phyongchon Restaurant in the preset time.Pyongyang Koryo Hotel, Yanggakdo International Hotel, Sosan Hotel, Sinhungsan Hotel and Jangsusan Hotel were appreciated at the contest held among hotels for peculiar dishes and kind service.At the demonstration performance the cookers and waiters and waitresses from several units showed their delicate and seasoned cooking skills and service.Rodong Sinmun A national cooking contest among restaurants and hotels took place at Sinhung Restaurant title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Bangladeshi President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), received a message of greeting from MD. Abdul Hamid, president of the People's Republic of Bangladesh, on Monday.MD. Abdul Hamid in the message extended the warmest greetings and congratulations to the Supreme Leader on the 71st founding anniversary of the DPRK.The message hoped that the relations between the two countries would grow stronger in the future.It wished the Supreme Leader and the people of the DPRK peace, happiness and prosperity on the occasion of this joyful day.Rodong Sinmun Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), received a message of greeting from MD. title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Birthday Spreads to Workers
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un sent birthday spreads to Kim Song Nyo, leader of the Kubongryong family platoon under the Songgan County road repair and management corps, and Ha Sun Man, a worker at the Jungsan mining area of the Unryul Mine, on their 80th birthdays.Kim Song Nyo was born into a day laborer's family before the liberation of Korea from Japan's colonial rule. She has worked as a road cleaner, leading a worthy life in the country liberated by President Kim Il Sung.Chairman Kim Jong Il met her on Kubong Pass during his field guidance to Jagang Province in August Juche 89 (2000), put her forward as a model of the era and her family as the one of patriots and showed loving care on several occasions.Ha Sun Man who was born into a poor family in Unryul County has dedicated his whole life to the prosperity of the country after the liberation of Korea.He over-fulfilled the plan for iron ore production for over fifty years to be honored with the title of Labor Hero.Rodong Sinmun Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un sent birthday spreads to Kim Song Nyo, leader of the Kubongryong family platoon under the Songgan County road repair and management corps, and Ha Sun Man, a worker at the Jungsan mining area of the Unryul Mine, on their 80th birthdays.Kim Song Nyo was born into a day laborer's family before the liberation of Korea from Japan's colonial rule. title: Floral Baskets and Congratulatory Letters to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was presented with floral baskets and congratulatory letters by the diplomatic corps and the military attaches corps here on the occasion of the 71st founding anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.Ismail Ahmed Mohamed Hasan, Palestinian ambassador to the DPRK who is doyen of the diplomatic corps, handed them to Ri Yong Ho, DPRK foreign minister, and Alexei Bartusov, military attache of the Russian embassy who is doyen of the military attaches corps, to Army General No Kwang Chol, minister of the People's Armed Forces, on Thursday.Rodong Sinmun Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was presented with floral baskets and congratulatory letters by the diplomatic corps and the military attaches corps here on the occasion of the 71st founding anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.Ismail Ahmed Mohamed Hasan, Palestinian ambassador to the DPRK who is doyen of the diplomatic corps, handed them to Ri Yong Ho, DPRK foreign minister, and Alexei Bartusov, military attache of the Russian embassy who is doyen of the military attaches corps, to Army General No Kwang Chol, minister of the People's Armed Forces, on Thursday.Rodong Sinmun Ismail Ahmed Mohamed Hasan, Palestinian ambassador to the DPRK who is doyen of the diplomatic corps, handed them to Ri Yong Ho, DPRK foreign minister, and Alexei Bartusov, military attache of the Russian embassy who is doyen of the military attaches corps, to Army General No Kwang Chol, minister of the People's Armed Forces, on Thursday.Rodong Sinmun Rodong Sinmun

title: Head of DPRK Government Delegation Meets Russian Deputy PM
body: Ri Ryong Nam, vice-premier of the Cabinet who took part in the 5th Oriental Economic Forum held in Vladivostok of Russia as head of a delegation of the government of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) Thursday met and had a talk with Yuri Trutnev, deputy prime minister of the Russian Federation who is presidential envoy to the Far East Federal Region.Yuri Trutnev said that the Russian government attaches importance to the friendly relations with the DPRK and affirmed that he would make all efforts for the development of the economic cooperation between the two countries in the future, too.Present there were members of the DPRK government delegation, the DPRK consul general in Vladivostok and the minister of Development of the Far East and Arctic and a vice foreign minister of the Russian Federation.During his stay, Ri Ryong Nam respectively met with Alexandr Kozlov, minister of Development of the Far East and Arctic of the Russian Federation, and Oleg title: Education-related Exhibitions Close
body: The national educational experimental apparatus and teaching aids exhibition and the education aid exhibition closed with due ceremony at the Sci-Tech Complex on Friday.Highly appreciated were title: National Sci-Tech Presentation in Field of Biology Held

title: Pak Pong Ju Inspects Co-op Farms in South Hwanghae Province
body: Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the WPK, made field survey of several co-op farms in South Hwanghae Province.Making rounds of co-op farms in Ongjin, Kangryong and Yonan counties of the province, he learned about the damage of crops and arable lands and encouraged officials and working people in their struggle to eradicate the damage caused by the typhoon.He held a field consultative meeting to do away with damage.The consultative meeting discussed the measures to get rid of the damage as soon as possible. title: "Day of Korea" Event Held in China
body: An event "Day of Korea" took place on Sept. 9 on the sidelines of the 2019 Beijing world horticultural expo.Present at the event were officials of the China Council for the Promotion of International Trade (CCPIT), the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and other relevant fields, the DPRK ambassador to China and his embassy members and others.Ambassador Ji Jae Ryong and a vice-chairman of the CCPIT made speeches.Speakers said that the "Day of Korea" event is significantly underway to mark the 71st founding anniversary of the DPRK on the sidelines of the Beijing world horticultural expo.They stressed that the DPRK-China friendship associated with the great heart and soul of the leaders of the elder generation of the two countries is invariably consolidating and developing on the basis of the deep trust and personal relations between Chairman Kim Jong Un and President Xi Jinping under the complicated international situation.They said that the DPRK and China are the friendly neighbors and expressed the will to add beauty to the flower garden of the traditional DPRK-China friendship by boosting exchange and cooperation in various fields this year marking the 70th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the DPRK and China.The participants watched a video introducing the DPRK and a congratulatory performance and visited the Korean garden title: IMAGC Marks Its 20th Founding Anniversary
body: A meeting took place at the Sci-Tech Complex on Tuesday to mark the 20th founding anniversary of the International Martial Arts Games Committee (IMAGC).Attending there were Im Chol Ung, vice-premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), Ri Yong Son, chairman of the IMAGC and president of the International Taekwon-Do Federation, members of the Executive Board Meeting of the IMAGC and other members and martial art delegates from different countries.Im Chol Ung made a congratulatory speech.He congratulated persons of martial arts on the 20th founding anniversary of the IMAGC on behalf of the government of the DPRK and said that since its foundation the IMAGC has made a proud history of the world martial arts for the building of a new peaceful world in the idea of friendship, cooperation and development.Then Chairman Ri Yong Son, Vice-Chairman Leong Wai Meng, Rajendran Balan, president of the Indian National Martial Art Games Federation, and Jonathan Makiling, president of the International Jendo Federation, made speeches.Speakers referred to the founding of the IMAGC, successes in the efforts for consolidating its organizational foundation and international martial arts games held as world games for 20 years.At the meeting certifications were conferred on representatives from martial art organizations of Greece and UK newly acceded as national martial art organizations of the IMAGC. title: Pak Pong Ju Inspects Co-op Farms in Pyongyang City
body: Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the WPK, made field survey of co-op farms in Pyongyang City.Officials and agricultural workers of the Namsa Co-op Farm of Rangnang District and the Songsin Vegetable Cooperative Farm in Sadong District are securing a guarantee for rich harvest even under the unfavorable weather conditions by boosting the introduction of scientific farming method.Learning about the harvest prospect in the fields to which the rice-enriching method was introduced, Pak Pong Ju stressed the need for officials to bear in mind that scientific farming is the key to increased grain production and successfully conclude this year's farm work by positively introducing advanced farming method.He took technical steps for thoroughly establishing an irrigation and drainage system, continually raising the level of the farming technique and increasing the area under cultivation on a large scale as the advantages of the rice-enriching method have been proved in reality. title: Pak Pong Ju Inspects Units in Field of Food Industry
body: Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the WPK, inspected units in the field of food industry in Pyongyang.In the Pyongyang Wheat Flour Processing Factory and the Pyongyang Cornstarch Factory, he learned in detail about the operation of the equipment and the production and stressed the need to decisively increase the quality of the foodstuff to meet demands of the people and to cater for their tastes.The field consultative meetings discussed the issues of building up technical forces of the factories and bringing about the improvement in raising the quality of products by properly mapping out management and business strategy as intended by the Party to further improve the people's standard of living.He also stressed the need to do well the work for generalizing experience gained in ensuring the quality of the products during his visits to the Sonhung Foodstuff Factory, the Kyonghung Unhasu Foodstuff Factory and the Mangyongdae Kyonghung Foodstuff Factory. title: Women's Union Officials and Members Visit Hoeryong Revolutionary Site
body: Women's union officials and members from across the country visited the Hoeryong Revolutionary Site on Sept. 19 on the occasion of the 70th demise anniversary of the anti-Japanese war heroine Kim Jong Suk.They made a bow to the statue of Kim Jong Suk at the foot of Osan Hill after laying a floral basket and bouquets before the statue.Then they saw historic relics in the low-roofed old home of Kim Jong Suk, where she was born into a patriotic and revolutionary family and spent her childhood.At the Hoeryong Revolutionary Museum the visitors looked back upon the brilliant career and revolutionary feats of the woman commander of Mt Paektu who became a bodyguard faithfully upholding the idea and leadership of President Kim Il Sung and dedicated herself to the liberation and prosperity of the country.At the plaza before her statue they held an oath-taking meeting on Sept. 20.They pledged to remain faithful to the idea and leadership of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un by following the strong spirit shown by Kim Jong Suk to devotedly defend the leader.Rodong Sinmun Women's union officials and members from across the country visited the Hoeryong Revolutionary Site on title: "Complete Collection of Kim Jong Il's Works" Vol. 27 Off Press
body: Volume 27 of "Complete Collection of Kim Jong Il's Works", a library of immortal Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, was brought out by the Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House. The book systematically and comprehensively contains the works of Chairman Kim Jong Il in a chronological order.The book contains 65 works including talks and speeches made by Kim Jong Il from November Juche 64 (1975) to May Juche 65 (1976).The works deal with the ideology and theory of Kim Jong Il who indicated the way of struggle for more thoroughly establishing the Party's monolithic ideological system and firmly consolidating the Juche-oriented revolutionary forces and dynamically accelerating the socialist construction as required by the developing revolution.The book contains works giving perfect answers to the theoretical and practical issues arising in the revolutionary struggle including the issues of turning Komdok and Tanchon areas into major bases for producing nonferrous metals and doing work well with scientists and technicians, developing medical science in the field of public health and improving hospital management and the issue for diplomatic officials to keep holding higher the banner of independence in foreign affairs.Rodong Sinmun Volume 27 of "Complete Collection of Kim Jong Il's Works", a library of immortal Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, was brought out by the Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House. title: Pak Pong Ju Inspects Units in South Hamgyong Province
body: Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the WPK, made field survey of several units in South Hamgyong Province.Pak Pong Ju learned in detail about the typhoon damage in Yonggwang and Jangjin counties and gave a pep-talk to the working people and service personnel of the People's Army in building dwelling houses and rehabilitating roads and discussed measures to complete the rehabilitation as soon as possible.At the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex and the February 8 Vinalon Complex, he underscored the need to unconditionally carry out the quotas for fertilizer production by giving free rein to the creative initiative and spiritual strength of the workers and technicians and to pep up production by ensuring profitability to the maximum.At the Ryongsong Machine Complex, the Hamhung Woolen Mill, the Hamhung Catfish Farm and others he stressed the need to make a tangible contribution to economic construction and the improvement of the people's standard of living by keeping production at a high rate with scientific management and business strategy. title: 15th Pyongyang Autumn International Trade Fair Opens
body: The 15th Pyongyang Autumn International Trade Fair opened with due ceremony at Pyongyang Indoor Stadium on Monday.Electrical and electronic goods, building materials, machines and light industrial products are on display at the fair involving more than 350 companies from the DPRK, China, Vietnam, Mongolia, Indonesia, Italy and other countries.Attending the ceremony were Ri Ryong Nam, vice-premier of the Cabinet, Kim Yong Jae, minister of External Economic Relations, delegations from different countries and members of foreign diplomatic missions here.Pak Ung Sik, director of the Korean International Exhibition Corporation, made an opening address to be followed by a congratulatory speech by O Ryong Chol, vice-minister of External Economic Relations.At the end of the ceremony the participants toured the fair venue.The fair will last till Sept. 27. title: 50th Anniversary of Mansudae Art Troupe Marked
body: A meeting took place at the East Pyongyang Grand Theatre on Friday to mark the 50th birth anniversary of the Mansudae Art Troupe.Chairman Kim Jong Il organized the art troupe on Sept. 27, Juche 58 (1969) to usher in the heyday for the development of Juche-oriented music.The 50 year-old history of the art troupe was the proud course during which it has developed into a model art institution under the wise leadership of the peerlessly great men.Kim Jong Il visited the scene of creation even at midnight and dawn to make a new history in composing songs of praising the leader. He energetically led the art troupe to take the lead in defending, carrying forward and developing the tradition of the anti-Japanese revolutionary literature and art, showing great loving care for and putting trust in its creators and artistes.Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un praised the art troupe as a famous one organized and developed into a model of Juche-based art by Kim Jong Il, and led it to advance under the banner of the Mansudae spirit.Under the leadership of the Party, the art troupe was honored with Order of Kim Il Sung and has produced a number of recipients of the Party and state commendations, honorary title holders and winners of the February 16 Art Prize and international concours.Rodong Sinmun A meeting took place at the East Pyongyang Grand Theatre on Friday to mark the 50th birth anniversary of the Mansudae Art Troupe.Chairman Kim Jong Il organized the art troupe on Sept. 27, Juche 58 (1969) to usher in the heyday for the development of Juche-oriented music.The 50 year-old history of the art troupe was the proud course during which it has developed into a model art institution under the wise leadership of the peerlessly great men.Kim Jong Il visited the scene of creation even at midnight and dawn to make a new history in composing songs of praising the leader. title: Pak Pong Ju Inspects Units in South Phyongan Province
body: Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the WPK, made field survey of several units in South Phyongan Province.Making a round of the Phyongsong Irrigation Machine Factory, Pak Pong Ju encouraged its workers effecting innovation in pump production for irrigation by strengthening the existing production foundation, and underscored the need to raise the modernization level of production processes and expand their capability.After learning about the production of the Phyongsong Artificial Leather Factory including raw materials supply, he underlined the need to produce much more quality artificial leather goods by increasing the proportion of locally available raw and other materials, and called upon the relevant units to meticulously organize the provision of electric power and supply of materials.After inspecting the construction site of the Sunchon Phosphate Fertilizer Factory and the construction site for the project of building C1 chemical industry, he discussed the measures for ensuring the construction speed and the quality of structures at the best level and managing the overall production processes in a utilitarian way. title: DPRK Academy of Defence Science Succeeds in Test-firing of New-type SLBM
body: The Academy of Defence Science of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea succeeded in test-firing the new-type SLBM Pukguksong-3 in the waters off Wonsan Bay of the East Sea of Korea on Wednesday morning.The new-type ballistic missile was fired in vertical mode.The test-firing scientifically and technically confirmed the key tactical and technical indexes of the newly-designed ballistic missile and had no adverse impact on the security of neighboring countries.The leading officials of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and in the field of the national defence scientific research who guided the test-firing on the spot informed the WPK Central Committee of the result of the successful test-firing.Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un sent warm congratulations on behalf of the Central Committee of the WPK to the national defence scientific research units involved in the test-firing.The successful new-type SLBM test-firing comes to be of great significance as it ushered in a new phase in containing the outside forces' threat to the DPRK and further bolstering its military muscle for self-defence. title: Foundation Day of Korea Marked
body: A celebration for the Foundation Day of Korea took place in front of the Mausoleum of King Tangun on Thursday.Attending the event were Pak Yong Il, chairman of the Central Committee of the Korean Social Democratic Party, Kim Wan Su and Ri Jong Hyok, presidium members of the Central Committee of the Democratic Front for the Reunification of Korea, officials concerned, Pyongyangites and overseas compatriots.They performed an ancestral sacrifice for Tangun.Ri Myong Chol, vice-chairman of the Council for the Reunification of Tangun's Nation, made a report.He said that Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un has demonstrated to the whole world the dignity and honor of the country and nation with the transparent idea of independence, rare political caliber and patriotic devotion true to the noble intention of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il.He noted that the national reunification is the supreme national task which brooks no further delay, and called upon all the fellow countrymen to open up a broad avenue to independent reunification by fully displaying the great strength of the Tangun's nation and will for reunification.He stressed that the cause of national reunification is certain to be accomplished thanks to Kim Jong Un, the peerlessly great man. title: Stamps Displayed to Mark 74th Birthday of WPK
body: A number of Korean stamps were displayed at the Korean Stamp Exhibition House on Sunday to mark the 74th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK).The stamps are on display under the theme "The great party of guidance". They represent in a comprehensive way the glorious history of the WPK, which has developed into the party of the great leaders and the invincible revolutionary party and perfectly fulfilled its role as the organizer and guide of all victories of the Korean people for over 70 years since its birth.100-odd of them, illustrated with photos of President Kim Il Sung, deal with the immortal exploits performed by him in founding the WPK and leading it to victory only.Some stamps show that thanks to the wise leadership of Chairman Kim Jong Il, the WPK developed into the leader's party and revolutionary party of Juche in which the oneness and continuity of the idea and leadership of the leader were firmly established and a heyday was ushered in all fields including politics, military, economy and culture in the era of the Workers' Party.Some stamps carry photos of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, who is possessed of outstanding and seasoned political ability and leadership and demonstrates to the world the dignity and might of the party of Comrades Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il.The stamp show will go on till Oct. 16. title: Meeting of Korean Mothers in Japan Calls for Bringing Bright Future to Children
body: The 11th meeting of mothers of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) took place in Tokyo, Japan, on Sept. 21.Present there were Kang Chu Ryon, vice-chairwoman of the Central Standing Committee of Chongryon who is also chairwoman of the Central Standing Committee of the Korean Democratic Women's Union in Japan, officials of the women's union organizations who are in charge of work with children. Also seen there were activists in the field of the work with children, members of the mothers' societies of Korean schools at all levels, and representatives from different parts of Japan.Kang Chu Ryon, in her speech, called for bringing a rosy future to the children with warm maternal love.There was a video show under the theme of "For rosy future of beloved children".Held there were workshop, experience-swapping, lecture and quiz appropriate to the features of children of different ages and to mothers' interests.There was adopted an appeal addressed to the Koreans in Japan, and a request to the Japanese authorities for the application of tuition waiver program for Korean high schools and the "program for free education and upbringing of children" to Koreans.Rodong Sinmun The 11th meeting of mothers of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) took place in Tokyo, Japan, on Sept. 21.Present there were Kang Chu Ryon, vice-chairwoman of the Central Standing Committee of Chongryon who is also chairwoman of the Central Standing Committee of the Korean Democratic Women's Union in Japan, officials of the women's union organizations who are in charge of work with children. title: Dancing Parties of Youth and Students Held
body: Dancing parties of youth and students were held across the country on Tuesday in celebration of the 22nd anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's election as general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK).Dancing parties began amid the playing of song "Please Accept Best Wishes of People" in different parts of Pyongyang including plazas of the Monument to Party Founding, the Arch of Triumph and the Pyongyang Indoor Stadium.The participants danced in token of reverence for Kim Jong Il who developed the WPK into the glorious party of President Kim Il Sung and led the revolutionary cause of Juche to victory.Youth and students passionately danced, chorusing songs "His Embrace Is the Best" and "Cheers of the People" with deep emotion that the victorious history of the Korean youth movement is being carried forward as it is led by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un.The atmosphere of dancing parties was revved up with the playing of "Song of Youth" and other musical numbers.Similar dancing parties took place in provincial seats, cities and counties on the same day. title: Kim Jae Ryong Inspects Electric Power and Coal Industrial Establishments
body: Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, member of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, inspected several electric power and coal industrial establishments.Making rounds of the Huichon Power Station No. 10 and the Sunchon Thermal Power Plant, he called for thoroughly keeping a balance between power production and its supply and consumption, increasing the efficiency of produced electricity without waste of electric power and dynamically conducting scientific research for increased power production.At the Kaechon Coal Mine, the Kaechon Coal-mining Machine Factory and the Chonsong Youth Coal Mine, he acquainted himself with the repair and maintenance bases and underscored the need to ensure stable production accessories necessary for coal production by making the maximum and effective use of the present capability.The field consultative meetings discussed the issues of increasing the production of electric power, improving the planning of coal production and supply on the principle of giving top priority to coal supply to thermal power stations and making the relevant units ensure smooth supply of equipment and materials.Visiting the Munchon Valve Factory, he stressed the importance of active introduction of advanced technologies for the modernization of production process. title: Party and Government Leading Officials Visit Korean Revolution Museum
body: Leading officials of the Party and government, officials of ministries and national institutions visited the Korean Revolution Museum on Tuesday on the occasion of the 22nd anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's election as general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK).They paid tribute to the colored statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in the general review room.Being briefed on the fact that Kim Jong Il strengthened the WPK into the powerful guiding force of the revolution and led the socialist construction to victory with his iron will and superhuman efforts despite manifold grave hardships, the visitors looked around several rooms in the hall for the period of the arduous march, forced march.They also made a round of historic data showing that Kim Jong Il was elected as the WPK general secretary by the unanimous will and desire of all the Party members and other people of the country.They also looked round photos of Kim Jong Il and historic data showing that he aroused the Korean people seized with bitter grief over the loss of the President and firmly defended socialism of Juche with his unique Songun revolutionary leadership. title: S. Korean Students Protest U.S. Intervention
body: Students affiliated to the Progressive Federation of Students of south Korea staged a demonstration in Kwanghwamun Plaza of Seoul on Oct. 4 in protest against the U.S. intervention in south Korea's drill for defending Tok Island, according to the Seoul Economic Daily of south Korea.The U.S. Department of State reportedly expressed discontent at the drill conducted by south Korea for title: Dancing Parties Celebrate WPK's Birthday
body: There were dancing parties of the youth and students in different parts of the country Thursday to celebrate the 74th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK).Dancing venues in Pyongyang included the plaza of the Monument to Party Founding and the plaza of the Pyongyang Indoor Stadium, where dancing parties started with the song "Mother's Birthday".Fully reflected in the dancing venues were deep reverence for President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, founding father and eternal leader of the WPK.The participants danced to the tunes of such songs as "Our Comrade Kim Jong Un" and "Glory to Our Great Party" in praise of the undying feats of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un displaying the dignity and mightiness of Juche Korea all over the world by leading the WPK along the road of victories.Songs "Do Prosper, Era of the Workers' Party" and "March of Self-reliance" reflective of the revolutionary spirit and optimism of youths creating new heroic youth myth in the on-going grand advance of self-reliance revved up the atmosphere of the dancing parties.Similar dancing parties were held in provincial seats, cities and counties on the same day. title: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Floral baskets were laid before the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il to mark the 74th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK).Seen at the statues of the great leaders on Mansu Hill was a floral basket from Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un.Placed at the statues were floral baskets in the names of the Party, armed forces and power organs, social organizations, ministries, national institutions, units of the Korean People's Army (KPA) and the Korean People's Internal Security Forces and institutions, industrial establishments and universities at all levels in Pyongyang as well as bouquets and flowers.Also laid was a floral basket in the name of the Pyongyang mission of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front.The visitors made a bow to the statues of the peerlessly great men.Floral baskets, bouquets and flowers were laid before the statues of the great leaders at Kim Il Sung University, the Ministry of the People's Armed Forces, the Ministry of People's Security, the Mansudae Art Studio and other parts of Pyongyang.Working people, servicepersons and youth and students across the country visited the statues of the great leaders and the portraits of the smiling great leaders. title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Palestinian President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Mahmoud Abbas, president of the State of Palestine and chairman of the Executive Committee of the Palestine Liberation Organization, on Thursday.The president in his message said that he was pleased to extend the sincere and warmest congratulations to Kim Jong Un on behalf of the State of Palestine and its people and on his own behalf on the founding anniversary of the friendly WPK.He wished Kim Jong Un, the DPRK and its people, the leadership of the powerful WPK and its members bigger progress and prosperity.He highly appreciated the WPK for having maintained historic and militant relations with the Palestinian people and supported the struggle of the world people for liberation and independence and especially the legitimate struggle of the Palestinian people to terminate the occupation by Israel and found an independent state with East Kuds as its capital.He expressed the affirmation to continue to make joint efforts and cooperation to boost the friendly relations between the peoples of the two countries and hew out the future in conformity with the shared goal.He wished Kim Jong Un good health and happiness and the WPK and the friendly Korean people eternal prosperity.Rodong Sinmun Kim title: Application of "Program for Free Education and Upbringing of Children" to Korean Kindergartens Demanded
body: The delegates of the branches of the Liaison Society for Protecting Korean Kindergartens in 18 regions of Japan, where Korean kindergartens are located, reportedly carried out activities demanding the Cabinet Office, the Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology, the Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare of Japan to apply the "program for free education and upbringing of children" to Korean kindergartens on Sep. 26.They read out a request to the Japanese authorities for application of tuition waiver program also for Korean high schools and "program for free education and upbringing of children" to Korean kindergartens adopted on Sep. 21 at the 11th meeting of mothers of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon).The request demanded that the Japanese authorities and local self-governing bodies recognize Korean kindergartens at Korean schools as an object of application of the program and take a measure to render financial support for upbringing all the Korean kindergarteners.The request was conveyed to those authorities concerned.Meanwhile the participants in the request activities held a press conference to title: Kim Jae Ryong Inspects Various Units
body: Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, member of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and premier of the Cabinet, inspected various units.At the East Pyongyang Thermal Power Plant and the Chongchongang Thermal Power Plant, he underlined the need to take a strict heat-conserving measure and maximize the output of generators by fully observing standard control method and technical regulations in operating generating equipment.Learning about the production at the Joyang Coal Mine, he underscored the need to decisively increase the coal production through forest creation for the production of pit props under far-reaching program and the stepped-up development of new coal field with precedence given to the supply of equipment, materials and parts.The field consultative meetings called on officials to meticulously conduct the guidance over the economic work and urged the coal mines responsible for supplying coal to thermal power plants to keep coal production going at a high rate by concentrating manpower, equipment and materials and the relevant units to supply products under contract to power stations on a priority basis and discussed measures for fully meeting the increasing demand for electricity. title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Ascends Mt Paektu on Horseback
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, rode a white horse to the top of Mt Paektu in the first snow.He was accompanied by senior officials of the WPK Central Committee.His horseback march in Mt Paektu is a great event of weighty importance in the history of the Korean revolution.He, atop Mt Paektu on the horseback, recollected with deep emotion the road of arduous struggle he covered for the great cause of building the most powerful country with faith and will as firm as Mt Paektu and days of fast-paced changes and took a bird's-eye view of mountains that looked like the high steep mountains of the revolution he has to pass in high spirits.Reflected in the dignified mien of Kim Jong Un atop majestic Mt Paektu was the majesty of the illustrious commander looking far into the road of advance of a powerful socialist country that will achieve prosperity with its own efforts, meeting all headwinds with the storm of Mt Paektu.All the officials who accompanied him to the top of the mountain felt overflowing emotion and joy title: National Footwear Exhibition Opens
body: The 2019 Autumn National Footwear Exhibition opened with due ceremony at the Pyongyang Yokjon Department Store on Friday.The exhibition will be waged in the forms of product exhibition and sci-tech presentation.Presented to it are more than 182 500 products of at least 1 300 kinds from over 50 units including the Wonsan Leather Shoes Factory, the Ryuwon Footwear Factory, the shoe-making institute of the Management Bureau for the Shoe-making Industry and Pyongyang Han Tok Su University of Light Industry, and scores of researching findings made in the field of footwear industry.Attending the ceremony were Vice-Premier Im Chol Ung, Minister of Light Industry Choe Il Ryong, officials concerned, officials of the exhibiting units, researchers, technicians, postgraduate students, three-revolution team members and workers.The exhibition will last until October 24. title: Art Troupe of Disabled Persons Gives Performance
body: A performance was given at the Central Youth Hall on Friday by an art troupe of disabled persons, which returned home after visiting China.The members of the art troupe showed on the stages in China their talents bloomed under the DPRK's socialist system policy for protecting the disabled. Their performances were acclaimed by the audience.Working people, youth and students in Pyongyang enjoyed the performance.The performance began with prelude "Our National Flag". Put on the stage were numbers including poem reciting "My Dream", female vocal solo "My Home Village", instrumental ensemble "Pyongyang Is Best" and sign-language dance "We Are the Happiest in the World".In numbers such as female solo "Yearning" and "The Party Is My Mother" the performers impressively showed their thanks for the great care which brought up them to be talented soloists, dancers and singers.Also put on the stage were numbers of instrumental music and dance full of national flavor and magic to add to the atmosphere of the performance.Finale "My Great Country" marked the climax of the performance.Rodong Sinmun A performance was given at the Central Youth Hall on Friday by an art troupe of disabled persons, which returned home after visiting China.The members of the art troupe showed on the stages in China their talents bloomed under the DPRK's socialist system policy for protecting the disabled. title: DPRK Embassy in Moscow Hosts Reception
body: The DPRK embassy in Moscow gave a reception on Oct. 15 to mark the 71st anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic ties between the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Russian title: Founding Anniversary of Overseas Koreans' Affairs Administration Marked
body: A meeting for marking the 60th founding anniversary of the Overseas Koreans' Affairs Administration took place on Monday.President Kim Il Sung, considerate of the desire of the Koreans in Japan who wanted to return home, saw to it that the Committee for Receiving Korean Nationals in Japan was founded on Oct. 21, Juche 48 (1959), clearly indicated the path to be covered by it, and developed it into an organ in charge of the affairs concerning the overseas compatriots visiting the homeland.True to the noble intention of the President, Chairman Kim Jong Il established a regular system for successfully conducting the work with overseas compatriots and showed warm love for the officials and employees of the administration, reposing trust in them.The administration has covered the path of proud development for the past 60 years under the wise guidance of the peerlessly great men.Present at the meeting were Kim Yong Chol, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of title: Japanese Authorities' Impudent Chauvinistic Act under Fire
body: The Committee for Aiding Overseas Compatriots of the DPRK issued a statement on Monday denouncing the Japanese authorities for excluding the kindergartens of the Korean schools from the "program for free education and upbringing of children".The statement said that Abe regime's arrogant exclusion of the kindergartens of the Korean schools from the program fully reveals the chronic national chauvinism of the island country and shows again that the Japanese reactionaries' hostile policy towards the DPRK and the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) and their inveterate repugnancy and ill-intended discrimination against the Korean nation never change.It went on:The Japanese reactionaries, not content with putting down Chongryon and Koreans in Japan, are trying to use education and upbringing for preschool children of the Koreans in Japan as a bargaining chip for negotiations. Their mean act fully lays bare the true colors of Abe regime which talks about the "dialogue without any condition".The Japanese authorities' discrimination against the Korean children in Japan adds to the frozen DPRK-Japan relations.They would be well advised to behave themselves, though belatedly, bearing in mind that if they commit crimes against the trend of the times, they would be left alone out of the world political current, to say nothing of visit to the DPRK.Rodong Sinmun The Committee for Aiding Overseas Compatriots of the DPRK issued a statement on Monday denouncing the Japanese authorities for excluding the kindergartens of the Korean schools from the "program for free education and upbringing of children".The statement said that Abe regime's arrogant exclusion of the kindergartens of the Korean schools from the program fully reveals the chronic national chauvinism of the island country and shows again that the Japanese reactionaries' hostile policy towards the DPRK and the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) and their inveterate repugnancy and ill-intended discrimination against the Korean nation never change.It went on:The Japanese reactionaries, not content with putting down Chongryon and Koreans in Japan, are trying to use education and upbringing for preschool children of the Koreans in Japan as a bargaining chip for negotiations. title: DPRK Delegation Leaves to Take Part in NAM Summit
body: A delegation of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) led by Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, left here on Tuesday to take part in the 18th NAM Summit to be held in Baku, Azerbaijan.The guard of honor of the Korean People's Army (KPA) lined up at a terminal of Pyongyang International Airport.Choe Ryong Hae reviewed the guard of honor of the KPA after receiving a salute from its first vice-chief.The DPRK delegation was seen off by Thae Hyong Chol, vice-president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, and Kim Son Gyong, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs. title: Chairman of DPRK SPA Meets Speaker of State Duma of Russian Federation
body: Pak Thae Song, chairman of the Supreme People's Assembly (SPA) of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) who is leading the SPA delegation on a visit to Russia, met and had a talk with Byacheslav Wolodin, speaker of the State Duma of the Russian Federation, at the building of the State Duma on Tuesday.Present there were members of the delegation and the charge d'affaires a.i. of the DPRK embassy in Moscow, the first deputy speaker of the State Duma and others concerned.The speaker said that the historic DPRK-Russia summit meeting and talks injected great vitality into the title: 2019 Global Handwashing Day Marked in DPRK
body: An event was held in Myonggan County, North Hamgyong Province on Wednesday to mark the 2019 Global Handwashing Day.Present there were officials of the Ministry of Urban Management, the Grand People's Study House and Myonggan County, working people and schoolchildren of the county, the chief and members of the mission of UNICEF here and foreign guests.Speeches were made at the event on the theme of "Clean hands of all of us."The attendants shared experience in handwashing and enjoyed an art performance given by schoolchildren.Meanwhile, an inaugural ceremony of the gravity-fed water title: Cuban Ambassador Hosts Reception
body: Jesus De Los Angeles Aise Sotolongo, Cuban ambassador to the DPRK, hosted a reception at his embassy Wednesday to mark the 74th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK).Present there on invitation were Ri Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau and vice-chairman of the WPK Central Committee, and officials of the International Department of the WPK Central Committee.Staff members of the Cuban embassy were on hand.The Cuban ambassador in his speech hoped that the Korean people would achieve bigger successes in implementing the new strategic line of the WPK on calling for directing all efforts to the economic construction under the wise guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un.Noting that the Korean people extend full support and solidarity to the just struggle of the Cuban people, Ri Su Yong expressed the stand of the WPK and the government of the DPRK to boost the relations of friendship and cooperation in conformity with the spirit agreed by the top leaders title: Project for Remodeling and Mending Graves of CPV Martyrs Starts
body: There took place a ground-breaking ceremony for remodeling and mending the graves of the martyrs of the Chinese People's Volunteers (CPV) located in Hyongjesan District, Pyongyang City on Friday.Attending the ceremony were Choe Song Chol, vice-minister of Urban Management, officials concerned, working people in the district, Zhang Chenggang, charge d' affaires ad interim, and staff members of the Chinese embassy here, Chinese guests, students and residents in the DPRK.Placed before the graves were wreaths in the names of the Ministry of Urban Management, the Hyongjesan District People's Committee of Pyongyang City, the Chinese embassy, etc.The participants observed a moment's silence in memory of the martyrs of the CPV.Speeches were made there.Speakers said that the brave fighters of the CPV devoted their youth and lives to the sacred war for repelling the imperialists' armed invasion with the Korean people.They said that the project would make a contribution to handing down the militant friendship sealed in blood between the peoples of the two countries and the feats of the martyrs.The participants broke ground first to signal the start of the project.Rodong title: Wreaths Laid before Friendship Tower
body: Wreaths were laid before the Friendship Tower on Friday, the 69th anniversary of the entry of the Chinese People's Volunteers (CPV) into the Korean Front.Present at the wreath-laying ceremony were Thae Hyong Chol, vice-president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly (SPA), Ri Chang Gun, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), Ri Kil Song, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, officials concerned and working people in the city.Zhang Chenggang, charge d' affaires ad interim, and staff members of the Chinese embassy here, Chinese guests, students and residents in the DPRK were on hand.Placed at the tower was a wreath in the joint name of the WPK Central Committee, the SPA Presidium and the Cabinet of the DPRK.Also laid were wreaths in the names of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Ministry of People's Security, the Ministry of External Economic Relations, the Ministry of Culture, the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries, the DPRK-China Friendship Association, the Pyongyang City Committee of the WPK, the Pyongyang City People's Committee, the Chinese embassy here, etc.On the same day, wreaths were laid at the cemeteries and graves of the CPV martyrs in Kaesong City, Hoechang County and Anju City of South Phyongan Province, etc. Rodong Sinmun Wreaths were laid before the Friendship title: DPRK Players Prove Successful in 7th Military World Games
body: DPRK players have proved successful in the 7th Military World Games.DPRK players took the first place in the men's 500m hurdles relay.Pak Un Sim defeated all her rivals to come first in the 75kg event of women's boxing.Kim Jin Son and Pang Chol Mi won the second place in the 69kg and 51kg events of women's boxing and DPRK players finished the second in the women's team event of the 25m title: 18th NAM Summit Held
body: The 18th NAM Summit was held in Baku, Azerbaijan on October 25 and 26.Attending it was a delegation of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) led by Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly.Present there were 3 000 persons including heads of states and governments of 120 member states of NAM, high-level delegations and delegates and representatives of several international organizations.At the summit Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro Moros who worked as the chairman of the 17th NAM Summit made a report on the 2016-2019 NAM work.Azerbaijani President Ilham Aliyev who was elected the chairman of the 18th NAM Summit made an opening address.He in his address underscored the need to strengthen the role of NAM on the basis of the principle of respecting the sovereignty, territorial integrity and non-interference in other's internal affairs.After congratulatory speeches the issues on peace and security, disarmament, human rights and Middle East situation were discussed.Choe Ryong Hae made a speech there.And speeches were made by delegates of 97 countries and international organizations.A final document of the 18th NAM Summit, the "Baku Declaration" and others were adopted there. title: National Sci-Tech Presentation in Fields of Electronics and Automation Held
body: A national sci-tech presentation in the fields of electronics and automation was held at the State Academy of Sciences from Monday to Wednesday under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea.The presentation was held, divided into the panels of electronic materials and elements, electronic measurement and device and automation. title: Kim Jae Ryong Inspects Different Units of Agricultural Field
body: Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, member of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and premier of the Cabinet, inspected several units of the agricultural field of North and South Hwanghae Provinces, South Phyongan Province and Nampho City.At the Obong Cooperative Farm in Paechon County, Phungchon Cooperative Farm in Yonan County, Migok Cooperative Farm in Sariwon City, Jasan Cooperative Farm in Phyongsong City and Sokchi Cooperative Farm in Onchon County, he gave a pep-talk to the agricultural workers busy in the farm work and stressed the need to responsibly organize all processes including to keep thresher in full-capacity operation and to store grains so as to successfully conclude this year's farming.He also emphasized the need to make full preparations for next year's farming, increase underground water resources, push ahead with a correct field-responsibility-system within the framework of the subworkteam management system and increase the proportion of the mechanization in the farm work on the basis of the experience gained in increasing agricultural output this year.At the second-stage waterway under construction in South Hwanghae Province, he learned in detail about the supply of building materials including cement and the promotion of overall construction. title: National Exhibition of IT Successes 2019 Opens
body: The National Exhibition of IT Successes 2019 opened with due ceremony at the Pyongyang Indoor Stadium on Friday.On display at the exhibition are more than 1 600 IT successes and products from the commissions, ministries, national institutions, scientific research and educational institutions, institutions, enterprises, IT model units and IT industrial units.The exhibition under the theme of "digit economy and IT hot wind" includes diverse forms of shows, artificial intelligence programming contest, presentation of new products and technologies, football match of robots and IT exchange.Displayed at the exhibition are ultra-modern IT successes, IT products, educational information systems and educational aid programs conducive to putting the education IT basis.The exhibition is set to examine sci-tech problems solved through IT application and economic efficiency and select distinguished ministries, national institutions and provincial IT administrations, ten IT model units, ten best IT enterprises and ten best IT products.Present at the opening ceremony were Pak Thae Song, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials concerned, officials of the exhibiting units and working people.The exhibition goes on till Nov. 7. title: Choe Ryong Hae Inspects Yangdok County Hot Spring Resort
body: Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, inspected the Yangdok County Hot Spring Resort under construction.Making round of the complex for spa medical treatment and sports, culture and recreation ground, he underscored the need to concentrate efforts on ensuring the quality of the finishing work.He acquainted himself with the construction of railways including Onjong Railway Station and called on officials to complete the construction earlier through meticulous organization and plant lots of good species of trees around the railway station building and railways.After inspecting the hot spring service facilities in the township of Yangdok County, he took the measures for furnishing them perfectly to fully meet the convenience of the people and making effective preparation for operation.The field consultative meeting discussed the issues for unconditionally completing the construction in the time set by the Party. title: Korean Book, Photo and Art Exhibition Takes Place in Romania
body: There took place a Korean book, photo and art exhibition in Bucharest on October 29 on the occasion of the 71st anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the DPRK and Romania.On display at the venue of the exhibition were photos showing the revolutionary career and exploits of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and the revolutionary activities of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un.Also displayed there were works of the peerlessly great men and other Korean books and art pieces showing the resourcefulness and talent of the Korean nation.Personages of title: Symposium on History and Culture of Palhae Held
body: A symposium on the history and culture of Palhae was held at the Sci-Tech Complex on Thursday.Attending the symposium were researchers, teachers, journalists and editors in the sectors of science, education, media and national heritage preservation.Speakers explained and proved the history and culture of Palhae which had played a big role in the development of Korean history that exalted its name as a thriving country in the East at that time, true to the Party's policy of national heritage preservation.Palhae, one of the feudal states in Korea, was a thriving country in the East which developed the politics, economy and military for over 200 years and held its position as a country that inherited Koguryo, they said.In the light of the size of the earthen castle in Songsang-ri and its building method recently discovered in the area of Kim Chaek City, the structure pattern of the group graves in Thapha-ri and remains there, mural tombs in Kumsong-ri, Hwadae County and others, it was proved that the area of Kim Chaek City was a provincial administrative unit in Palhae, they noted.They expressed their resolutions to intensify scientific research work and fulfill their responsibilities and duties for unearthing much more excellent national and cultural heritages created by the Korean people and developing them.Rodong Sinmun A symposium on the history title: Friendly Meeting Takes Place in Bulgaria
body: A friendly meeting took place in Vratsa City, Bulgaria on Nov. 1 to mark the 71st anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the DPRK and Bulgaria.Attending the meeting title: National Cosmetics Show Opens
body: The national cosmetics show opened with due ceremony at the Pyongyang Yokjon Department Store on Monday under the co-sponsorship of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea and the Ministry of Consumer Goods Industry.Presented to the show are more than 137 000 beauty products of at least 930 kinds and essential oils of more than 80 kinds by dozens of units, including the Pyongyang Cosmetics Factory, the Sinuiju Cosmetics Factory, the Pyongyang Essential Oil Factory and the Ryongaksan Soap Factory and over 60 research findings made in the field of the cosmetics industry.The show will be held in the way of presenting cosmetics and essential oil products, symbolic and typical of their units, to be estimated by the people through sci-tech exchanges and sale.There will be a lecture and video show on the development trend and direction of the cosmetics industry, the concept of ultraviolet rays-proof cosmetics and their development trend and others.Attending the opening ceremony were officials concerned and officials, teachers, researchers, technicians, field officials and workers of the units that presented products to the show.The show will continue until Nov. 18. title: Symposium on Space Science and Technology-2019 Opens
body: The symposium on space science and technology-2019 opened with due ceremony at the Sci-Tech Complex on Tuesday.Attending the symposium sponsored by the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea were dozens of units including Kim Il Sung University, Kim Chaek University of Technology, the State Academy of Sciences and the Academy of Agricultural Science.The symposium under the theme of "Building of space power and drive for breaking through the cutting edge" is held, divided into panels of artificial satellite, space materials and elements, space observation and basic science and applied technology.More than 180 papers on successes and experience gained in conquering the outer space will be introduced at the symposium.Lectures and video watch will take place on the sidelines of the symposium.Present at the opening ceremony were officials concerned, scientists, technicians, teachers, researchers and graduate students.The symposium will last until November 15. title: South Koreans Stage Anti-U.S. Demonstration
body: Members of the Pusan Popular Masses Solidarity, a public organization of south Korea, held a surprise demonstration in Pusan City on Nov. 11 in protest against the U.S. which is forcing south Korea to pay more for the upkeep of the U.S. forces in south Korea and renew the general security of military intelligence agreement (GSOMIA) with Japan, according to minplusnews, a south Korean internet newspaper.Upon hearing the news that officials concerned from America would take part in an "international event" to be held in a park of Pusan City, they gathered near the park and launched a protest, shouting that the U.S. should stop its unjust pressure on south Korea.At a press conference they said they launched a protest to condemn the U.S. for conducting a biochemical weapon test at title: Chief Culprit of Kwangju Massacre Should Be Held in Detention
body: The bereaved families of the victims of the May 18 Kwangju massacre and Kwangju citizens of south Korea launched an action in Seoul on Nov. 12 in demand of detention of traitor Chun Doo Hwan, title: U.S. Army Urged to Pull Out of S. Korea
body: The south Korean internet paper minplusnews carried an editorial captioned "U.S. army, Get Out of south Korea" on Nov. 12.The editorial denounced the U.S. for pressuring south Korea to offer 6 trillion won for the upkeep of GIs present in south Korea.It disclosed that the U.S pressure for more upkeep of GIs is aimed at turning south Korea into a stronger logistics base for the strategy for global hegemony.Rodong Sinmun The south Korean internet paper minplusnews carried an editorial captioned "U.S. army, Get Out of south Korea" on Nov. 12.The editorial denounced the U.S. for pressuring south Korea to offer 6 trillion won for the upkeep of GIs present in south Korea.It disclosed that the U.S pressure for more upkeep of GIs is aimed at turning south Korea into a stronger logistics base for the strategy for global hegemony.Rodong Sinmun The editorial denounced the U.S. for pressuring south Korea to offer 6 trillion won for the upkeep of GIs present in south Korea.It disclosed that the U.S pressure for more upkeep of GIs is aimed at turning south Korea into a stronger logistics base for the strategy for global hegemony.Rodong Sinmun It disclosed that the U.S pressure for more upkeep of GIs is aimed at turning south Korea into a stronger logistics base for the strategy for global hegemony.Rodong Sinmun Rodong Sinmun
