title: By Taking Top-class Anti-epidemic Measures in a More Strict and Thoroughgoing Way
body: The enlarged meeting of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea debated issues of taking and strictly enforcing top-class anti-epidemic measures to prevent the viral epidemic spreading rapidly throughout the world.All domains and units should approach the COVID-19 with maximum vigilance and keep themselves fully ready against it.The campaign to prevent the COVID-19 should be conducted as a party-wide, country-wide and all-people one.In order to check the inroad route of the viral disease tightly, the officials of all anti-epidemic institutions and relevant units should find, isolate and medically observe all the people who returned home from abroad and contacted with them and those who show abnormal symptoms.The medical domain should enhance the responsibility of doctors in charge of families to deepen the work of grasping and curing the people who have fever or respiratory diseases every day.All inhabitants should regularly wear masks title: Transparent Anti-imperialist Class Consciousness
body: Anti-Japanese revolutionary literature and art is consistent with the most steadfast anti-imperialist class consciousness depicted in a profound way. So it still serves as the most valuable ideological and artistic treasure for our people.The immortal classic works created by President Kim Il Sung during the rigorous anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle such as “Song of Korea”, “Korean People’s Revolutionary Army”, “Song of Anti-Japanese War”, “Song of the Sea of Blood” and “Song of the Ten-Point Programme of the Association for the Restoration of Fatherland” are exemplary and typical works of anti-Japanese revolutionary literature which inspired new-generation youth communists, anti-Japanese fighters and people to turn out as one in the revolutionary struggle to drive out the gangster-like Japanese imperialists and to build a new society in the liberated country.It is the faith of our people and their firm class standpoint to advance along the only road of self-prosperity, decisively frustrating the imperialists’ moves of threat, appeasement and deception.U Kwang Yong Anti-Japanese revolutionary literature and art is consistent with the most steadfast anti-imperialist class consciousness depicted in a profound way. title: Workers’ Party of Korea’s Mode of Existence
body: It is the iron will of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un to firmly defend the true nature of the Workers’ Party of Korea that is totally responsible for people’s destiny and to thoroughly apply the people-first principle in activities of the Party and the state.He made a historic speech at the military parade and public procession of Pyongyang citizens marking the 70th founding anniversary of the WPK on Oct. 10, Juche 104 (2015).He said in the speech that our Party has been able to propel the revolution over the past 70 years without flinching whatever storms, achieving only victory and glory. title: What’s Important in Forest Restoration Work This Year
body: Officials of the General Bureau of Forest under the Ministry of Land and Environmental Conservation said to Rodong Sinmun as follows:The important issue of afforestation this year is to transform useless forests into useful ones in cities and counties which finished the tree planting in the main.Special concern should be paid to securing the rate of rooting in conformity with this year’s climate when thawing season comes 8 to 10 days earlier in lowlands and 10 to 15 days earlier in highlands than last year.It is also important not to fall short of sapling production quota by taking thoroughgoing measures for sapling production.In addition, over 90% of rooting rate should be secured by introducing an advanced tree planting method.Kim Song Il Officials of the General Bureau title: Editorial
body: Let Us Turn All Mountains of the Country into Golden Ones and Treasured Ones Today is a meaningful day when President Kim Il Sung kindled the first torch of tree planting movement.All people across the country are hardening their will to convert all mountains into golden ones and treasured ones by devoting themselves to realizing the noble patriotic desire of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il.“Let us turn all mountains into useful golden ones!”, this is the slogan of struggle and practice to be held fast to by us in afforestation work at present.We should take part in afforestation with Kim Jong Il’s patriotism deeply cherished in mind.Priority should be given to the work of planting trees of good breeds.Afforestation should be conducted in a scientific way.All people should be masters in the protection of forest.The role of the Party organizations should be heightened during the period of spring tree planting.The headquarters of forest restoration campaign should work out a tree planting plan on the basis of the scientific assessment of the present situation of forests and topographic features and realistic condition before carrying it out without fail.We should turn out as one in the forest restoration campaign, the noble patriotic work, and turn the country into a people’s paradise. title: High-yielding Chestnut Sapling Bred in DPRK
body: Scientists and technicians in the forestry field of the DPRK succeeded in breeding a high-yielding chestnut sapling.They bred a new sapling in the method of grafting scion on sprout of chestnut and provided a technical guarantee for putting the production of this chestnut tree sapling on an intensive and industrial basis.The new method helps reduce the cultivation area of saplings sharply and shorten their production period by 2-3 years. The fully grown chestnut tree is 3 meters high, so cultivation and fruit harvest can be done easily and productivity per hectare can be raised thrice.The newly-bred chestnut tree can bear fruits 3-5 years after the planting of its sapling.In autumn last year alone, more than 500,000 chestnut trees were planted in different parts of the country, including Pyongyang City and Kumya County of South Hamgyong Province, and the rate of their rooting was ensured at more than 90 percent.Meanwhile, they completed a technology of creating the dense planting pine-nut forest to move up the fruit harvest period by 8-10 years, thus making it possible to raise the productivity 1.5 times as against that of ordinary pine-nut tree.Rodong Sinmun Scientists and technicians in the forestry field of the DPRK succeeded in breeding a high-yielding chestnut sapling.They bred a new sapling in the method of grafting scion on sprout of chestnut and provided a technical guarantee for putting the production of this chestnut tree sapling on an intensive and industrial basis.The new method helps reduce the cultivation area of saplings sharply and shorten their production period by 2-3 years. title: There Can Be No Condition and Excuse in Electricity Saving
body: The Kyongsong Ceramic Factory and many other units ensure the qualitative level of products with less electricity by effectively economizing electricity.They are successful in their endeavors to organize the alternative production and lower power consumption per goods as much as possible.Eliminating the wastage of electricity is also as important as its production.Electricity-saving work should be more intensively carried out although more bottlenecks and difficulties may arise.Carefully staggering production can bring greater successes in the socialist construction with the electricity being generated at present.All the Party members and other working people should display their patriotism in the electricity-saving activities with a high sense of civic consciousness. title: Color Artificial Stone Plate for Purpose of Decoration
body: Shock brigade members of the Company of the State Science and Technology Commission under the Brigade of Ministries and National Institutions of the 216 Division, true to the Party’s intention to raise the rate of the localization of final building materials, put efforts into a research to produce color artificial stone plates with materials abundant in Samjiyon City.A lot of technical problems should be solved in the serial production of the stone plates.However, they, taking a firm hold of science and technology, surmounted all difficulties and deadlocks on their own efforts. body: The North Hwanghae Provincial Regiment under 618 Brigade is a mighty unit which built over 10 multistoried dwelling houses in Samjiyon City under its second-stage construction.This year it is title: Greetings to Bulgarian President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Tuesday sent a message of greetings to Rumen Radev, president of the Republic of Bulgaria.Extending warm congratulations in the name of the government of the DPRK and its people on the occasion of the national day of the Republic of Bulgaria, Kim Jong Un in the message wished the president and the people of Bulgaria successes in their work for the development and prosperity of the country.The message expressed the belief that the relations of friendship between the DPRK and Bulgaria would grow stronger in line with the needs of the new era.Rodong Sinmun Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Tuesday sent a message of greetings to Rumen Radev, president of the Republic of Bulgaria.Extending warm congratulations in the name of the government of the DPRK and its people on the occasion of the national day of the Republic of Bulgaria, Kim Jong Un in the message wished the president and the people of Bulgaria successes in their work for the development and prosperity of the country.The message expressed the belief that the relations of friendship between the DPRK and Bulgaria would grow stronger in line with the needs of the new era.Rodong Sinmun Extending warm congratulations in the name of the government of the DPRK and its people on the occasion of the national day of the Republic of Bulgaria, Kim Jong Un in the message wished the president and the people of Bulgaria successes in their work for the development and prosperity of the country.The message expressed the belief that the relations of friendship between the DPRK and Bulgaria would grow stronger in line with the needs of the new era.Rodong Sinmun The message expressed the belief that the relations of friendship between the DPRK and Bulgaria would grow stronger in line with the needs of the new era.Rodong Sinmun Rodong Sinmun

title: Conducting Hygienic and Anti-epidemic Work with Maximum Vigilance
body: Sinuiju City, in accordance with its regional characteristics of a border city of the country with a port, makes continuous efforts to check COVID-19 from coming into our country.The public health organs of the city dispatch their members to many places to incinerate and remove all pathogenic wastes as laid down in regulations.The hygienic and anti-epidemic center of the city produces hundreds of liters of disinfectant a day by itself for the anti-epidemic work.Meanwhile, it normalizes the examination of drinking water every day.Its officials conduct brisk hygienic information services among the inhabitants of dongs and neighborhood units.The officials and teachers of the Sariwon Baby Home and Orphanage are taking an active part in the anti-epidemic work while carefully examining if there is slightest negligence in the work to curb COVID-19.The Sariwon Baby Home rouses its workers to conduct the anti-epidemic work with top vigilance, bearing in mind the significance of the prevention of COVID-19.The air is frequently ventilated and kitchen utensils are thoroughly disinfected.Children wash their hands in line with the hygienic requirement and frequently used furnishings and installations are sterilized several times a day.The officials of the Sariwon Orphanage daily inform their employees of the danger of COVID-19 and let them rise up as one in the work title: Farms of Our Country Associated with the Undying Exploits of Great Leaders
body: President Kim Il Sung proclaimed the “Law on Agrarian Reform in North Korea” on March 5, 1946.The proclamation of the law was a gigantic event that made the peasants eternal masters of the land, totally liquidated landlords and uprooted the feudal landownership, the source of exploitation and oppression.Indeed, Kim Il Sung was the sun of people who brought the spring of happiness to this land.Chairman Kim Jong Il added glory to the exploits of the President who provided eternal foundation for people’s happy life.Kim Jong Il mapped out a mammoth nature-remaking project for the everlasting prosperity of the country and led the leveling and rezoning of fields through daring and large-scale operations, thus bringing tremendous changes to our country.Thanks to the wise leadership and endless devotion of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un who is building into a socialist paradise this country liberated and defended by the great leaders, our country is daily turning into the title: Editorial
body: Let Us Firmly Adhere to the Revolutionary Nature of the Workers’ Party of Korea Devotedly Serving for People The enlarged meeting of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea took place in the vital period when the whole Party, the entire country and all the people are bringing about remarkable changes in the offensive for making a head-on breakthrough in carrying out the decisions of the Fifth Plenary Meeting of the Seventh Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea (WPK).The enlarged meeting constitutes a significant event which powerfully demonstrated again our Party’s spirit of devotedly serving people, giving top priority to their lives and safety and subordinating everything to it.From the outset of the COVID-19, our Party, foreseeing possible circumstances and aftereffects, has made sure that firm and reliable preventive measures have been taken in the country.All the Party organizations and officials should keep deep in their minds the noble intention of the Party Central Committee which again laid stress to thoroughly apply the people-first principle at the first enlarged meeting of the Political Bureau after the historic Fifth Plenary Meeting.All the officials should actively learn and apply Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un’s idea, leadership traits and method of work.They should thoroughly carry out the tasks set forth at the enlarged meeting. title: Reservation for Useful Animals to Be Newly Built
body: Nampho is building a reserve for useful animals in a bold way.A reserve is to be arranged in the Satgatbong Area of Ryonggang County. Occupying an area of tens of hectares, it will have a ring-shaped road of about 4km. Tens of thousands of trees of good breeds will be planted in the reserve which will be enclosed with a new wire fence.It put main efforts on providing a habitat condition for animals, making a waterway of various branches and installing the wire fence in a three-dimensional way.After securing hundreds of deer, its districts and counties are breeding them well while channeling big efforts into tree planting.It also buckled down to the work of expanding the area of the reserve by stages in line with the progress of the project and securing new suitable land in other areas.Ju Chang Son Nampho is building a reserve for useful animals in a bold way.A reserve is to be arranged in the Satgatbong Area of Ryonggang County. title: North Phyongan Province Concentrating All Efforts on Preparations for Farming
body: North Phyongan Province is making successes in preparations for this year’s farming with the resolution to bring about a high yield.It attached foremost importance to securing the high-yielding seed.The provincial rural economy committee, on the basis of making a detailed analysis of the farming in the last period, channeled big efforts into collecting various high-yielding seeds.The province pushed ahead with the production of organic composite fertilizer, too.All organs, factories, enterprises, dongs and neighborhood units as well as cities and counties were busy securing materials of organic composite fertilizer.Sinuiju was the first to hit the goal of ensuring about 10,000 tons of fertilizer, followed by Tongrim, Sonchon and Sakju Counties.Organic composite fertilizer factories of the cities and counties are aflame with enthusiasm for increased production day and night. title: Touching Stories about Our Socialist Society
body: One January day, a woman came out of the hospital of Tukjang Area Coal Mining Complex amid a hearty farewell of medical workers.She was Kim Song Mi, a worker of the Tukjang Youth Mine.When she was taken to the hospital, she was at the crossroads of life and death. But only a week later, she could be released after returning to her perfect health. Thinking of the warm love of the socialist public health system, she could not repress her tears.It was far after the closing hour a few days ago that she was carried to the hospital for her unexpected illness.The hospital held an urgent consultation for her treatment.The operation came to a successful end in two hours, but the medical workers could not make themselves at ease.They attended her alternately for two days.Thanks to their sincerity and devotion, she could leave the hospital in good health.That day, she firmly resolved to work more things for our socialist country.Yun Un Sim One January day, a woman came out of the hospital of Tukjang Area Coal Mining Complex amid a hearty farewell of medical workers.She was Kim Song Mi, a worker of the Tukjang Youth Mine.When she was taken to the hospital, she was at the crossroads of life and death. title: What "Pulgungi" No. 1 Teaches Us
body: There is the electric locomotive “Pulgungi” No. 1 at the Tanchon Youth Engine Service Brigade of the Tanchon Railway Branch.It was awarded the titles of Labor Hero, the Thrice Three-revolution Flag and the Twice “Lathe No. 26”Model Machine Prize for its contributions to the railway transport of the country.President Kim Il Sung gave an instruction to make an electric locomotive to the then West Pyongyang Railway Factory at the end of August, Juche 48 (1959).Making such electric locomotive under the condition at that time was precisely creating something out of nothing.Its workers made many parts and fittings of the locomotive one by one by their own efforts and technology.Finally, the trial run of the first electric locomotive was made in August, Juche 50 (1961).The President personally came out to the field and saw the first-made electric locomotive on Aug. 30, (1961).On that day, he said that our self-reliance was the best and gave it an honorable name “Pulgungi”. title: Hamhung Youth Power Station No. 1 Built
body: Chairman Kim Jong Il, during his on-the-spot guidance to South Hamgyong Province, gave an instruction to additionally build Hamhung Youth Power Station Nos.1 and 2 on the Kumjin River.True to his behests, its provincial Party Committee channeled efforts into the construction of Hamhung Youth Power Station No.1.Shock brigade members in charge of the damming, simultaneously carried out the cofferdam construction and the excavation of the dam bedrock by daringly introducing rational construction methods.Scientists and technicians of the province actively invented and introduced practical technological innovation schemes and rendered services to ensuring the quality of the construction.Continuous successes were also recorded in waterway tunneling.Shock brigade members markedly raised the blasting efficiency by introducing an advanced blasting method. Therefore, the waterway tunnel was cut through in three months and its expanding and covering work was successfully concluded. title: Great Efforts Constantly Focused on Hygienic and Anti-epidemic Work
body: Pyongyang City continues to channel all efforts into the anti-epidemic work to curb the inflow and spread of Covid-19 true to the Party’s intention to take the national top-class anti-epidemic measures and strictly enforce them.It strongly demands its citizens are duty-bound to wear masks in the crowded streets, public places and residential areas.The vacation of students is prolonged thanks to the national measures not to allow any weak points that may spread the epidemic. In compliance with them, dongs, neighborhood units and families get the students not to move unnecessarily.The city is also launching brisk hygienic information service so that all families always keep the insides and outsides of their houses clean and the residents strictly observe the rules of health.Anju City is zealous in taking preemptive and scientific measures to curb thespread of Covid-19.It deploys loudspeaker vans and posts visual aids, explanations and other kinds of means of propaganda and agitation everywhere in the city and conducts vigorous information services to raise people’s vigilance over the infection.Various units of the city intensify the anti-epidemic work to thoroughly prevent the influx and spread of the pestilence.The hygienic and anti-epidemic center of the city produces a lot of antiseptic solution on their own and supplies it to schools and families in the city. title: Foundations for Producing Building Materials Strengthened
body: All the provinces in the DPRK have strengthened the foundations for producing building materials to spruce up the appearance of localities.Kangwon Province built processes for producing synthetic grass and heat ray reflection glass and other building materials production bases.North Hwanghae Province remodeled the cement production base in Sariwon City and established a process for producing bricks, while the Kyongam Building Materials Fatory began to produce a new foam lagging.South Hwanghae Province introduced a computer integrated manufacturing into the Sinwon Cement Factory and developed building parts based on shells.North Hamgyong Province put the production at the Komusan Cement Factory and other building materials units on a normal basis.And it is pushing ahead with the work to produce various kinds of building fixtures in coating materials bases.On the basis of establishing a colored roof tile production process at the paint factory, Kanggye City in Jagang province has turned out thousands of colored roof tiles every day.The building materials factory in South Hamgyong Province began to produce tiles by developing a heat-resistant roller important in title: Sportswomen Displaying Honor of DPRK with Gold Medals
body: In the DPRK, women are leading a worthwhile life as a powerful force pushing one of the two wheels of the revolutionary chariot and the flower of the times.Among them are sportswomen who have displayed the honor of the country with gold medals.Twice world table-tennis championship holder Pak Yong Sun, world marathon queen Jong Song Ok, four times world Judo championship holder Kye Sun Hui, twice world boxing championship holders Ri Jong Hyang and Yun Kum Ju and twice Olympic medalist Rim Jong Sim showed the indomitable fighting spirit and high sportsmanship at international games to strike the world with wonder.Ri Kum Suk, Hong Myong Gum, Ra Un Sim, Ho Un Byol, Ri Hyang Sim, Wi Jong Sim and other footballers won victories three times at the Asian Women’s Football Championships and the women’s football events of the Asian Games respectively and obtained U-20 women’s world cup twice.An Kim Ae, Hong Un Jong, Ri Song Hui, Kim Jong, Kim Kum Ok and many other sportswomen, too, proved successful at the Olympic Games and world and Asian championships.In praise of their feats, the DPRK government awarded the titles of DPRK Hero and Labor Hero and the titles of People’s Athlete title: New Stainless Steel for Making Hydraulic Turbine Blade Developed in DPRK
body: Scientists of the DPRK developed a new stainless steel for making hydraulic turbine blade.In recent years, several hydro-power stations in the country including the Thaechon Power Station have increased the electric-power production by using the hydraulic turbine blade made of this stainless steel.The durability of this turbine blade is more than 10 times that of the previous one.The new stainless steel is suitable for making hydraulic turbine blade as it is highly resistant to cavitation erosion and abrasion and good for weldability.Last year alone, the Kumya Hydraulic Generating title: Without Any Slightest Negligence in Inspection and Quarantine

body: A Japan-DPRK friendship new spring meeting took place in Japan to celebrate the Day of the Shining Star (birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il).Present at the meeting were Japanese title: Past Crimes Done by Japan against Korean Nation
body: During their colonial rule over Korea, the Japanese imperialists even divested the Koreans of their hereditary lands.Such plunder policy was carried into practice by the Oriental Development Company, which was formed in December 1908 when the Japanese imperialists hastened the “annexation of Korea by Japan”.The company was backed by big figure in politics of Japan and its head was the lieutenant general in active service.The Japanese imperialists stationed the headquarters of the company in Seoul and established its branches in various parts of Korea.The company had taken at least 210,000 hectares of lands away from Koreans before Japan’s defeat, under such pretexts as “state land” and by all sorts of means. title: Kophung County Prospering by Dint of Self-reliance
body: Kophung County completed the construction of the Phyongdang Power Station in a short period of two years with the fund secured by developing sericulture. Its construction had been waged for 18 years.It went on to cut through the waterway tunnel of Kophung Power Station No. 3 with the length of hundreds of meters, the project which is four times more than that of the Phyongdang Power Station.After securing mechanized means like large lorries, it is pushing forward construction projects on a full scale.When Kophung Power Station No. 3 is completed, the county will be able to fully resolve the shortage of electricity on its own with the additional production of the mini-generators of its many farmhouses.The Kophung County Cement Factory, called a factory in a park, has put its production lines on a modern footing by its own efforts and technology and is turning out quality cement necessary for the construction in large quantities.The township food supply center is regularly supplying foodstuffs at low costs.In addition, the county people’s hospital is equipped with modern treatment facilities. title: Reconstruction and Updating of Local Industrial Factories Underway in North Phyongan Province
body: North Phyongan Province is unremitting in its efforts to remodel its local industrial factories.Sonchon County set a high aim to turn the county foodstuff factory into the exemplary one of the province and stubbornly pushed it forward. title: Intensified Anti-epidemic Work Continued
body: The ministries and national institutions channel all their efforts into the work of preventing the spread of COVID-19.The Ministry of External Economic Relations demands that fittings frequently used by people are sterilized more than three times a day.It also makes it a rule to take temperatures of its staff at least twice a day.What’s more, medical observation is intensified upon those who have been abroad or who contacted with them and immediate precautions are taken to cope with any slightest abnormalities.The Ministry of Commerce makes welfare service establishments like shops, restaurants and hotels put up posters about common knowledge on anti-epidemic work and ensures that all service units, with utmost vigilance, rigidly observe service rules and discipline required by the state emergency and anti-epidemic system.At the Publication Guidance Bureau, the work is underway in a responsible way to receive fresh data concerning COVID-19 in time and promptly inform people of them through publications in close contact with relevant units.Besides, vehicles for daily publication delivery are inspected and disinfected in a thoroughgoing way. title: Work to Increase Sanctuaries Brisk in DPRK
body: Big efforts have been paid to increasing sanctuaries for useful animals in each province of the DPRK.North Hwanghae Province chose sanctuaries in Yonthan and Unpha counties and planted there more than 60 000 trees like pine and maple while speeding up the construction of road and animal sheds.Nampho City set an area of tens of hectares in Hanggu District as a sanctuary and is pushing ahead with the work to build a ring road, plant tens of thousands of good species of trees and install a wire-net fence.Similar works are witnessed in North and South Phyongan and Hamgyong, Kangwon and other provinces.Earlier, a 2019-2020 survey of sanctuaries was carried out with the participation of officials and researchers from the Zoology Research Institute and the Biodiversity Institute under the State Academy of Sciences and the General Bureau of Forest under the Ministry of Land and Environment Protection as well as designers and rangers in forestry field from each province.Through the survey, they confirmed main protective animal species and resources in relevant areas.Meanwhile, such works as making pools, feed shelves, nests and artificial caves in the areas unfavorable for animals’ feeding and breeding activities are conducted from March to July every year, the period of protecting useful animals.Rodong Sinmun Big efforts have been paid to increasing sanctuaries for title: Japan-DPRK Seminar on Education Held
body: The 21st Japan-DPRK seminar on education took place at the Korean Junior and Middle School in Gunma Prefecture.Present there were personages and members of the Japan-Korea Society for Scientific and Educational Interchange and the Japan Teachers Union, officials of the Union of Korean Teachers in Japan and teachers of Korean schools and Koreans in Japan.The seminar began with the keynote report which was followed by speeches.Speakers mentioned a series of important problems such as ensuring the rights to learning at Korean schools and support for them.An appeal was adopted at the seminar.The appeal called for carrying out further activities of defending the rights of Koreans in Japan to national education in various parts of Japan including the one million-signature campaign for applying the tuition-free program for senior high schools to Korean schools and the "program for free education and upbringing of children" to kindergartens of Korean schools.The general assembly body: Ju Ok Hwa, a teacher at Kwangmyongsong Higher Technical Middle School of Samjiyon City, is a genuine educator who has rendered her pure conscience to the education of the rising generation for 30 years.She was blessed by President Kim Il Sung, who visited the Samjiyon Schoolchildren’s Palace in July, Juche 71 (1982).Cherishing the glory of that day, she has dedicated all her wits and enthusiasm to the education of children.She was awarded several certificates of new instructional methods and invention certificates of experimental equipment and teaching aids.She also won several times in the instruction competitions of teachers of mother tongue and literature held in Ryanggang Province.Besides, she boasts of the collection of writings “We Sing of Three Generals of Mt Peaktu” which she, along with other teachers and members of the students’ literature group, presented to Chairman Kim Jong Il.Last July, Ju Ok, a teacher of the literature class of Kang Pan Sok Senior Middle title: Great Men’s Devotion to Salt Production from Underground Ultra-saline Water
body: Nowadays, the salt production from underground ultra-saline water is increasing at various salterns on the west coast of the DPRK.“Undok Salt” produced there tells about the devoted efforts made by the peerlessly great men for the development of the country’s salt industry.In April Juche 99 (2010), Chairman Kim Jong Il visited the education science exhibition at Kim Il Sung University. There he examined an illustration for developing underground ultra-saline water resources and expressed his great satisfaction, saying that it is a good idea for realizing his plan.Later, he took a step to confirm the deposits of underground ultra-saline water and its positions on the west coast and other parts of the country.Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un acquainted himself with the development of underground ultra-saline water on several occasions and gave precious instructions.In 2013, the Supreme Leader dispatched a powerful sci-tech group to speed up the development work and provided an example in establishing the method of salt production based on underground ultra-saline water.In May 2016, he went round the salt production site and expressed his great pleasure over the heaps of salt produced from underground ultra-saline water, saying he felt as if they were a mountain of white gold. And he added that it would be good to call it “Undok Salt” in the meaning of the Chairman’s benefit.Rodong Sinmun Nowadays, the salt production from underground ultra-saline water is increasing at various salterns on the west coast of the DPRK.“Undok Salt” produced there tells about the devoted efforts made by the peerlessly great men for the development of the country’s salt industry.In April Juche 99 (2010), Chairman Kim Jong Il visited the education science exhibition at Kim Il Sung University. title: S. Korean Organization Calls for Punishing Conservative Forces
body: The People's Sovereignty Solidarity in south Korea released an appeal to blast the "United Future Party" (UFP) on March 9, according to the south Korean internet newspaper Saram Ilbo.The appeal said it is none other than the UFP that has conducted innumerable evil doings to turn this land into a veritable hell called "Hell Korea".The upcoming general election should be an occasion to punish the evil political forces, liquidate the pro-Japanese elements and chastise the UFP dreaming of Park Geun Hye's return to power, it stressed.Rodong Sinmun The People's Sovereignty Solidarity in south Korea released an appeal to blast the "United Future Party" (UFP) on March 9, according to the south Korean internet newspaper Saram Ilbo.The appeal said it is none other than the UFP that has conducted innumerable evil doings to turn this land into a veritable hell called "Hell Korea".The upcoming general election should be an occasion to punish the evil political forces, liquidate the pro-Japanese elements and chastise the UFP dreaming of Park Geun Hye's return to power, it stressed.Rodong Sinmun The appeal said it is none other than the UFP that has conducted innumerable evil doings to turn this land into a veritable hell called "Hell Korea".The upcoming general election should be an occasion to punish the evil political forces, liquidate the pro-Japanese elements and chastise the UFP dreaming of Park Geun Hye's return to power, it stressed.Rodong Sinmun The upcoming general election should be an occasion to punish the evil political forces, liquidate the pro-Japanese elements and chastise the UFP dreaming of Park Geun Hye's return to power, it stressed.Rodong Sinmun Rodong Sinmun

title: Arming Oneself with Revolutionary Spirit and Practical Experience
body: The flame of study tour of revolutionary battle sites in the area of Mt Paektu is flaring up all over the county.In the first month alone since the offensive for making a head-on breakthrough began, the number of people who visited them is 10 times as against the same period of last year.An official of the Revolutionary Relics Bureau gave impressions of the expedition to the revolutionary battle sites in the area of Mt Paektu:The blizzards of Paektu were cutting. Particles of ice carried by the strong wind stroke us on our cheeks. Our gloves could not keep our hands from being frozen. So, we rubbed each other’s hands with snow.The march through snowy lands was also exhausting.On the footpath covered with snow with a mere depth of 15 cm, the front rank barely managed to make its way for 1,000 meters.Carrying on the arduous march, we were unanimous to say:Now we are so exhausted. We can imagine how the anti-Japanese revolutionary fighters, not fully eating nor being clad properly, had ploughed their way through the waist-deep virgin snow with the enemies chasing after them.To make them learn from the revolutionary spirit of the anti-Japanese guerillas through such actual experiences, Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un saw to it that all the people visit the revolutionary battle sites of Mt Paektu.Kim Sun Yong The flame of study tour of revolutionary battle sites in the area of Mt Paektu is flaring up all over the county.In the first month alone since the offensive for making a head-on breakthrough began, the number of people who visited them is 10 times as against the same period of last year.An official of the Revolutionary Relics Bureau gave impressions of the expedition to the revolutionary battle sites in the area of Mt Paektu:The blizzards of Paektu were cutting. title: Jagang Provincial E-Business Institute Seethes with Enthusiasm for Creation

title: Stimulant to Rooting Draws Attention
body: A new stimulant to plant rooting draws the attention.Developed by Economic Forest Research Center of the Forest Management Institute, this stimulant is made by mixing additives with hormone of a plant accelerating the elongation of cells as its primary components in proper amounts.It helps trees take roots quickly and multiply their number and thus stimulates their growth.Kim Song Il A new stimulant to plant rooting draws the attention.Developed by Economic Forest Research Center of the Forest Management Institute, this stimulant is made by mixing additives with hormone of a plant accelerating the elongation of cells as its primary components in proper amounts.It helps trees take roots quickly and multiply their number and thus stimulates their growth.Kim Song Il Developed by Economic Forest Research Center of the Forest Management Institute, this stimulant is made by mixing additives with hormone of a plant accelerating the elongation of cells as its primary components in proper amounts.It helps trees take roots quickly and multiply their number and thus stimulates their growth.Kim Song Il It helps trees take roots quickly and multiply their number and thus stimulates their growth.Kim Song Il Kim Song Il

title: Highly Efficient Biological Pesticide Actively Applied

biological pesticide into preventing damage from soil insects which have been considered hard to kill and thus increase the sapling output markedly.This biological pesticide developed by the Kangwon Provincial Institute of Forest Science proved very advantageous.First of all, it is easy to handle and harmless to people and ecological environment.Besides, it is of high extermination efficiency and a certain period later, it biodegrades to work as an effective soil conditioner.The application of this pesticide enables the management station to thoroughly check damage from soil insects and title: Success in Construction Expanded in Spirit of Blizzards of Paektu
body: According to data available, the 216 Division arranged an area of over 705,000 ㎡ and excavated earth of nearly 33,000 ㎥ for the foundations of dwelling houses and establishments by February.They also laid down a roadbed in a section of more than 50,000 meters.In several districts including Sinmusong, Rimyongsu and Pothae dongs, infrastructural project and groundwork for dwelling houses progress apace in line with the plans for the third-stage construction of Samjiyon City.All construction units under the division produced and secured not a few materials needed for this year’s construction based on rich experiences gained last year.Thus, further achievements are made in the third-stage construction thanks to the pure loyalty and devoted efforts of all the officers, soldier builders and shock brigade members of the 216 Division to facelift Samjiyon City as befits a sacred place of revolution. title: Ryongaksan Soap Factory
body: in Mangyongdae District of Pyongyang is well-known to citizens of the DPRK for its “Ryongaksan”-trademarked products like soft soap, washing agent and washing powder. The factory, whose production processes are put on an automatic and unmanned basis with the computer integrated manufacturing established, was built under the energetic and detailed guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un.The Supreme Leader selected a site for the factory at the foot of the scenic Mt Ryongak and guided its miniature on several occasions and dispatched a powerful building force.He visited the factory under construction in June Juche 105 (2016) and named it the “Ryongaksan Soap Factory”. And he set forth an important task for building it in a splendid way, saying that the party is waiting for its completion as it is urgently required by the people.Thanks to his warm love and energetic guidance, the factory was completed in a little more than one year.When visiting the factory in October 2016, the Supreme Leader said with great satisfaction that one more large-scale modern factory was built splendidly to contribute to the improvement of the people’s livelihood.After its operation, the factory has channeled big efforts into raising the proportion of locally available raw materials, thus increasing the varieties of products and lowering their production cost markedly.Rodong Sinmun in Mangyongdae District of Pyongyang is well-known to citizens of the DPRK for its “Ryongaksan”-trademarked products like soft soap, washing agent and washing powder. title: Anti-Epidemic Work Intensified with Constant Vigilance
body: The DPRK is intensifying a nationwide and all-people work to thoroughly prevent the COVID-19.The hygienic and anti-epidemic center of Hamhung City, South Hamgyong Province, concentrates efforts on sterilizing public places, passenger transport means, stations and other crowded places and regulates the sterilization work every day.North Hamgyong Province tightens the anti-epidemic work so that any slightest deviation may not happen in the work to curb its spread.It gives priority to the work of sterilizing hotels, passenger transport means of Chongjin and the ships entering Chongjin Port while conducting medical examination on those under medical observation. At the same time, it provides materials to them in a responsible manner.Kangwon Province ceaselessly raises people’s law-abiding spirit and totally cuts off and blocks every routine and space through which the epidemic may infiltrate into our country.North and South Phyongan Provinces, North Hwanghae Province and all other provinces conduct political work and hygienic information services in various forms and methods and take necessary measures in a foresighted manner so that any slightest vacancy may not appear in their medical examination, test and quarantine. title: Forest Management Station of Kumya County Broadens Large Chestnuts Forest with Patriotism
body: The Ryongrim Valley of Kumya County is covered with large chestnut trees.20-odd years ago, there grew a lot of chestnut trees of local breed in the mountains of the county.It could not gain profit from the chestnut trees of local breed as they were often plagued with insects and their output was less. So, its officials and employees decided to replace them with large chestnut trees after several debates.They set a high goal of transplanting over 10,000 saplings of the breed a year and worked in an assiduous manner with pure and true patriotism.The area of large chestnut trees has been systematically expanded from a few years ago.Their strenuous efforts spread out a thousand and hundreds of hectares of large chestnut forests in various areas.Now, the county forest management station gathers a large number of chestnuts every year and sends them to nurseries and kindergartens in the county.Kim Kyong Chol The Ryongrim Valley of Kumya County is covered with large chestnut trees.20-odd years ago, there grew a lot of chestnut trees of local breed in the mountains of the county.It could not gain profit from the chestnut trees of local breed as they were often plagued with insects and their output was less. title: DPRK Premier Inspects Various Sectors of National Economy
body: Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, member of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, inspected various sectors of the national economy.Learning in detail about the state of Unryul and Jaeryong mines, he underscored the need to tap all their production potentials and properly organize their operation in a creative manner.At the Ryongnam Dockyard, he took measures for letting relevant units give precedence to providing products under contract and supplying electricity and materials in time and positively introducing and generalizing advanced scientific and technical achievements.Walking round the Pyongyang Coal-mining Machine Factory and the Sunchon Engine Factory, he stressed the need to meticulously carry out their operation and management, boost up the production of new items of products and put spurs to the development of products urgently needed in different sectors of the national economy.The field consultative meetings discussed such issues as applying proper methods of business administration suitable for practical conditions, revitalizing the production, improving the quality of products and encouraging cooperation among economic sectors. title: Being Well Aware That They Are Responsible for Life and Health of People
body: In Myongchon County, explanation and education are intensified so that its inhabitants can never slacken their vigilance as COVID-19 has not entered our country yet.Its public health workers are intensifying medical examination of the inhabitants while explaining preventive measures to them in an efficient way.The county has laid an antiseptic solution base with a capacity of thousands of liters to supply its products to factories, enterprises and neighborhood units and thus ensures disinfection on a regular basis.Officials of the Ryokpho District Hygienic and Anti-epidemic Center are frequenting factories, enterprises, farms and residential areas.There, they are conducting effective explanation and information services to make sure that all people take an active part in the hygienic and anti-epidemic work, wearing masks, washing their hands frequently and drinking boiled water.Along with this, water supply and drainage system of the district is disinfected in a responsible way and prompt measures are taken against any slightest abnormal practices. body: Officials of South Hwanghae Province went out to counties, factories, enterprises and mines to grasp their actual conditions in detail. title: New Orchard Created in DPRK
body: More than 3 000 hectares of orchard were newly created in Pukchong County of South Hamgyong Province, a famous fruit producing center of the DPRK.Every year the county has planted high-yielding fruit trees on several hundred hectares of area, set up concrete props and established an irrigation system to significantly greet the 75th anniversary of the Workers’ Party of Korea. It also increased the fertility of orchard by applying tens of thousands of tons of organic fertilizer annually.And it has produced hundreds of thousands of fruit saplings every year at the newly arranged tree nursery covering one hundred hectares as well as at tree nurseries of its fruit farms.President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il visited the county on several occasions and indicated the way for developing the fruit farming of the country.The county, with natural and geographical conditions favorable for fruit farming, firm material and technical foundations and rich experiences and tradition, is turning into a leading modern and large-scale fruit producing center of the country under the plan of the WPK.Rodong Sinmun More than 3 000 hectares of orchard were newly created in Pukchong County of South Hamgyong Province, a famous fruit producing center of the DPRK.Every year the county has planted high-yielding fruit trees on several hundred hectares of area, set up concrete props and established an irrigation system to significantly greet the 75th anniversary of the Workers’ Party of Korea. title: A Must Place
body: In May several years ago Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un visited People’s Open-Air Ice Rink under construction for firsthand guidance.While doing the rounds of the ice rink he suddenly asked the officials in the mass if it would have a place for sharpening the blades of skates.They did not reply readily. Although they were proud to build a superb ice rink they had not so much as thought of sharpening the blades of skates.Reading their hearts he emphasized with a generous smile that a skate-renting stand must be set up well and not fail to go with a place for sharpening the blades of skates because the open-air ice rink was to be used by the masses of people.He ultimately implied that what was needed to meet the convenience of the people should not be overlooked but founded by all means despite its triviality.O Yong Sim In May several years ago Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un visited People’s Open-Air Ice Rink under construction for firsthand guidance.While doing the rounds of the ice rink he suddenly asked the officials in the mass if it would have a place for sharpening the blades of skates.They did not reply readily. title: Families Can Also Build Mini Hydropower Stations
body: The family of Kil Pyong Ho, a caretaker of the Woljong Temple under the Anak County National Heritage Protection and Management Station, has gained profits from a mini hydropower station built on a stream more than 10 years ago.Its facilities include a water wheel with a diameter of 1.5 meters, a generator and others. What is impressive is that the waterway is made with woods abundant in the region.There is a cozy cottage in the small village at the foot of Ryongsong Hill. Belonging to the 10th neighborhood unit of Samgok-ri, Samsu County, it is far away from the township of the county. Its villagers call the cottage “Power Station Home.”The family thought of producing electricity with the water of a stream running in front of their home and built the mini hydropower station by themselves.They made a water wheel after canalizing the waterway of tens of meters.In summer they dug the bottom of the waterway to check the sand from piling up. In winter they crushed ice in an effort to normalize the operation of the station.The output of electricity is not so much. But it is enough for TVs and lights for nearly 20 families in the mountain village.Pak Chol The family of Kil Pyong Ho, a caretaker of the Woljong Temple under the Anak County National Heritage Protection and Management Station, has gained profits from a mini hydropower station built on a stream more than 10 years ago.Its facilities include a water wheel with a diameter of 1.5 meters, a generator and others. title: Mini Hydropower Stations Built Everywhere Water Flows in Jagang Province
body: Many units in Jagang Province built mini hydropower stations wherever water flows so as to produce electricity.Kophung County erected some of them along the river.The Ryongdae Co-op Farm, setting the target to build it two years ago, dammed a stream which is flowing not far from its township before laying a waterway of tens of meters and setting up a generator-room.The farm supplies the produced electricity to schools, offices and homes. With this electricity, it operates a foodstuff processing base on a normal basis, thus rendering services to the dietary life of farmers.Officials and technicians of the Kanggye Knitting Mill produce electricity for compound illumination at a hydropower station built after straightening a stream flowing through its compound.Not only institutions and enterprises in the province but also households installed mini hydropower generators on their own.Eight years ago, a resident living in Huksu-ri, Hwaphyong County set up a mini hydropower station suited to the geographical character around his house.He made the waterway with wooden boards to prevent the water from being frozen in mid-winter of northern areas. It is said that the electricity produced there is used by his home and others. title: A New Irrigation Network Is Being Laid in Unryul County
body: A project of setting up a new irrigation network to pump the water of the River Taedong into the reservoir for this year’s farming is in full swing in Unryul County.Having turned out as one in laying the foundation for agricultural production free from any crop failure, its officials and working people installed several pumping stations after removing tens of thousands of cubic meters of earth and digging a waterway of kilometers along a mountain foot in a short span of time.They also finished projects of laying an underground ditch and other structures and are speeding up the assemblage of iron pipes.Drivers focused on ensuring the full operation of excavators and trucks, thereby contributing a large share to finishing the major waterway in a month.Officials and working people of the Unryul Mine actively supported the irrigation work. They volunteered to manufacture iron pipes needed for this project in a short period.Besides, they pushed vigorously ahead with the assemblage of those pipes, with their attention focused on ensuring quality.When a new irrigation network is established with the completion of the irrigation project, many farms of the county can be sufficiently provided with irrigation water.In addition, the length of the waterway will be much shortened, loss of water through leakage be prevented and, as a result, the reservoir will be filled with much water within a short time.Jong Yong Chol A project of setting up a new irrigation network to pump the water of the River Taedong into the reservoir for this year’s farming is in full swing in Unryul County.Having turned out as one in laying the foundation for agricultural production free from any crop failure, its officials and working people installed several pumping stations after removing tens of thousands of cubic meters of earth and digging a waterway of kilometers along a mountain foot in a short span of time.They also finished projects of laying an underground ditch and other structures and are speeding up the assemblage of iron pipes.Drivers focused on ensuring the full operation of excavators and trucks, thereby contributing a large share to finishing the major waterway in a month.Officials and working people of the Unryul Mine actively supported the irrigation work. title: Top Priority Given to Solving Water Problem
body: Officials and working people of Hyongjesan District achieved not a few successes by waging the work of securing enough water for this year’s farming in a bold way.They undertook a project of expanding a reservoir and increased the water storage capacity more than 5 times so that sufficient water could be supplied to some fields of the Sinmi area with an unfavorable water condition.In addition, they completed as planned a project of laying a waterway to irrigate tens of hectares of paddy fields in the Hyongsan area and thus provided a firm guarantee for bringing a greater harvest in grain production.Pak Yong Jin Officials and working people of Hyongjesan District achieved not a few successes by waging the work of securing enough water for this year’s farming in a bold way.They undertook a project of expanding a reservoir and increased the water storage capacity more than 5 times so that sufficient water could be supplied to some fields of the Sinmi area with an unfavorable water condition.In addition, they completed as planned a project of laying a waterway to irrigate tens of hectares of paddy fields in the Hyongsan area and thus provided a firm guarantee for bringing a greater harvest in grain production.Pak Yong Jin They undertook a project of expanding a reservoir and increased the water storage capacity more than 5 times so that sufficient water could be supplied to some fields of the Sinmi area with an unfavorable water condition.In addition, they completed as planned a project of laying a waterway to irrigate tens of hectares of paddy fields in the Hyongsan area and thus provided a firm guarantee for bringing a greater harvest in grain production.Pak Yong Jin In addition, they completed as planned a project of laying a waterway to irrigate tens of hectares of paddy fields in the Hyongsan area and thus provided a firm guarantee for bringing a greater harvest in grain production.Pak Yong Jin Pak Yong Jin

title: Superior Alloy Steel Production Base Plays a Big Part
body: The superior alloy steel production base of the Ferrous Metal Research Institute under the State Academy of Sciences is a research and development and production center of alloy steel where science and technology is integrated with production. It makes various kinds of quality alloy steel and supplies them to various domains of the national economy.Its builders are officials, scientists and employees of the institute. Though it is small in scale, it is a treasured one that plays an important role in developing the country’s metallurgical industry true to the Party’s intention.It developed and produced with its own efforts various kinds of major alloy steel that had been dependent on imports in the past.It is now forging ahead on a full scale with the work of supplying them to main factories and enterprises so as to meet the increasing demand of the national economy for small amounts of varied alloy steel.Kim Yun Mi The superior alloy steel production base of the Ferrous Metal Research Institute under the State Academy of Sciences is a research and development and production center of alloy steel where science and technology is integrated with production. title: Works Which Should Be Done Before Anything Else
body: Main efforts should be given to the following works during spring clean-up months.Firstly, the filth from isolated places should be removed cleanly and their surroundings be sterilized thoroughly. Secondly, laystalls and WCs should be reconstructed or repaired or constructed in accordance with the requirements of state standard designs.Besides, water supply and drainage networks should be investigated, repaired and improved and manholes and sewage ditches be dug and sterilized in a responsible manner. body: Let Us Vigorously Turn Out in Work of Spring Clean-up Months The work of this year’s spring clean-up months highlights its importance and significance as it is conducted at a time when the whole country is waging an emergency anti-epidemic campaign with top vigilance and preparedness.A strong discipline of absolutely obeying the unified command of the Non-Permanent Central Public Health Guidance Committee should be established.Special attention and close observation should be focused on rigid hygienic work and disinfection of the quarantine areas.Sustained steps should be taken to strictly dispose of the wastewater from the trade ships quarantined in territorial waters of our country and the basin of the River Taedong in compliance with the rules.Big efforts should be channeled into clearing off the traces of winter.Proper measures should be taken to readjust and repair water supply and drainage systems and wastewater be thoroughly disinfected at sewage treatment plants.Major efforts should be directed to thoroughly removing sources of diseases and creating a cleaner and healthier environment. title: How They Endeavored to Raise the Quality of Products
body: Various kinds of plastic products made at the Kumya Disabled Solders’ Daily-necessities Factory enjoy high demands.One of the issues it attached importance to in raising the quality of the products was to help workers undertake the technical innovation.It organized a group with technicians and young workers with strong initiative spirit whose mission was to make an automatic temperature controller and actively helped them to obtain successes in a short span of time.Thus, three automatic temperature controllers were made last year to install in production processes of the ejection, extruding and roller workteams. title: By Disseminating Agricultural Science and Technology with an Appropriate Methodology
body: The Pukjiri Party Committee of Jaeryong County disseminates agricultural science and technology in a methodological way.First of all, its management board classified the agricultural scientific and technological data and the up-to-date farming methods and synthesized them.On this basis, the chief engineer made a question-and-answer book containing various scientific and technological problems and their explanation, the book to be read by all cold-bed tenders, paddy irrigation controllers and other farmers in each farming process.Next, the agitators, with this book, conducted a vigorous dissemination of science and technology as well as an explanation on Party policies among the farmers to raise the enthusiasm for studying in a question-and-answer way.The study of agricultural science and technology deepened through the book helped farmers be well aware of the problems arising in carrying out their assignments without meetings of workteams and sub-workteams.As said above, the Pukjiri Party Committee found the new method in conformity with circumstances and kindled the flame for study. title: Bean Curd Widely Used in Korean People’s Diet
body: From long ago, the Korean people have used bean curd for their diet, preparing soup, casserole and other delicious dishes with it. Korea is the home of soybean.In the DPRK, bean curd cookery has got more diversified under the warm care of the peerlessly great men for the people.At the early dawn of one day in January Juche 51 (1962), President Kim Il Sung visited a bean curd factory in Pyongyang City. He personally tasted the bean curd and acquainted himself with the supply of it to the citizens.Chairman Kim Jong Il set forth a policy on soybean farming during his Songun revolutionary leadership. And he said on several occasions that bean curd and other diverse soybean dishes should be widely used in the dietary life of citizens and servicepersons.True to the noble intention of the President and the Chairman, Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un took a step to inform them of how to cook various broiled dishes with bean curd.Rodong Sinmun From long ago, the Korean people have used bean curd for their diet, preparing soup, casserole and other delicious dishes with it. title: Ambitious Goal, Persevering Practice
body: Officials and builders of the North Phyongan Provincial General Tideland Reclamation Enterprise are displaying the indomitable offensive spirit and strong executive ability in the reclamation of the Woldo tideland and in the second-stage project of reclaiming the Honggondo tideland.Thus, dykes are stretching out through wild sea.The sound of blasting is loudly ringing out in the Jopdo area of Sonchon County and the Ansan area of Tongrim County where the work of building Dyke No. 1 for the 2nd-stage project of the Honggondo tideland is being vigorously accelerated. In the Cholsan area, too, the project of building the first dam of the second area of the Woldo tideland is being stepped up.The enterprise set a high goal to finish the project of building the first dam of the second area of the Woldo Tideland in the first half year and complete the 2nd-stage project of the Honggondo Tideland of 5,500 hectares in the second half of the year and is endeavoring to implement it.The construction is progressing apace thanks to indefatigable offensive spirit and devoted efforts of officials and constructors who are dedicating their patriotic zeal to the tideland reclamation to carry out the Party’s gigantic plan for remaking the nature. title: DPRK Teacher Active as Editor of International Scientific Journal
body: Kim Chol Hyon, a teacher of Kim Chaek University of Technology in the DPRK, is working as an editor of the international scientific journal “Non-Metallic Material Science”.Kim completed the postgraduate course of the university and started his career as a teacher at the Laser Engineering Department of the Physics Engineering Faculty in Juche 98 (2009).He presented his first treatise to an international scientific journal “IEEE Access” in 2018 and, since then, has come to the notice of editorial departments of various scientific journals.His treatise “Effect of Linewidth Enhancement Factor on Fringe in a Self-mixing Signal and Improved Estimation of Feedback Factor in Laser Diode” was firstly carried in the “IEEE Access” published in March 2019. With this as an occasion, the “Non-Metallic Material Science” and the “International Journal of Information and Communication Sciences” invited him to work as an editor at their editorial departments.So, he became the editor of the “Non-Metallic Material Science” in May 2019. And he evaluated an e-mail treatise sent by the “Applied Optics”, a SCI international scientific journal, in November 2019 and its editorial department requested him to work as an evaluator in December that year.International scientific journals, “Optics Communication” of Netherlands and “Measurement Science and Technology” of Britain, too, carried his treatises this year.Rodong Sinmun Kim Chol Hyon, a teacher of Kim Chaek University of Technology in the DPRK, is working as an editor of the international scientific journal “Non-Metallic Material Science”.Kim completed the postgraduate course of the university and started his career as a teacher at the Laser Engineering Department of the Physics Engineering Faculty in Juche 98 (2009).He presented his first treatise to an international scientific journal “IEEE Access” in 2018 and, since then, has come to the notice of editorial departments of various scientific journals.His treatise “Effect of Linewidth Enhancement Factor on Fringe in a Self-mixing Signal and Improved Estimation of Feedback Factor in Laser Diode” was firstly carried in the “IEEE Access” published in March 2019. title: Unreasonable Retrogressive Revision of Labor Law Slammed
body: Labor, civic and public organizations in south Korea including the Confederation of Trade Unions, the People's Joint Action, the Bar Association for Democratic Society and the Citizens Solidarity for Democratic Society held a press conference in Seoul on Mar. 30 in denunciation of unreasonable retrogressive revision of the labor law, according to the south Korean paper Nodong and Segye.Speakers said that part-time workers and specially-employed workers failed to get even the minimum wage for their livelihood owing to the suspension of businesses by plutocrats.They called for dissolving the general association of employers which is keen on the revision of the labor law.Rodong Sinmun Labor, civic and public organizations in south Korea including the Confederation of Trade Unions, the People's Joint Action, the Bar Association for Democratic Society and the Citizens Solidarity for Democratic Society held a press conference in Seoul on Mar. 30 in denunciation of unreasonable retrogressive revision of the labor law, according to the south Korean paper Nodong and Segye.Speakers said that part-time workers and specially-employed workers failed to get even the minimum wage for their livelihood owing to the suspension of businesses by plutocrats.They called for dissolving the general association of employers which is keen on the revision of the labor law.Rodong Sinmun Speakers said that part-time workers and specially-employed workers failed to get even the minimum wage for their livelihood owing to the suspension of businesses by plutocrats.They called for dissolving the general association of employers which is keen on the revision of the labor law.Rodong Sinmun They called for dissolving the general association of employers which is keen on the revision of the labor law.Rodong Sinmun Rodong Sinmun

title: Do Everything in Our Style
body: In May several years ago Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un inspected a long marine railway bridge completed between Koam-ri and Tapchon-ri across the Sokjon Bay.Taking an extensive view of the railway bridge he said with joy that it was really excellent, that he felt like enjoying an art object, that a project the Party was interested in was carried out and that he was very much satisfied.Looking up to him the officials present on the occasion smiled a happy smile because a new project without precedent in the history of our railway construction was carried out by our own efforts with our technology.After a while Kim Jong Un expressed his satisfaction time and again, saying that the railway bridge was well designed and qualitatively built, that the more he looked at it, the more pleasant and prouder he felt and that another precious bridge was built on the East Sea of Korea.That day he said that nothing was impossible to our people who advanced vigorously by their strenuous efforts in the spirit of self-reliance with science and technology and that they could do whatever they were determined to. Agreement" held on Mar. 31 a press conference at the Kwanghwamun Plaza in Seoul to blame the U.S. for putting pressure upon south Korea to increase its share of defence cost.The organizations said in a press release that the U.S. is trying to impose layoff on the south Korean workers at the U.S. military bases as part of its pressure on south Korea to steeply increase its share of defence cost, adding that the presence of the U.S. forces in south Korea is for the security of the U.S. and its world hegemony.Therefore, there is no reason for south Korea to increase the expense for the upkeep of the U.S. forces, but the U.S. should pay south Korea for the presence of its troops, the press release stressed.Rodong Sinmun Civic organizations of south Korea including the "People for Achieving title: Story of Mullet Soup Cooked with Cold Water
body: Most people are familiar with words “Mullet Soup,” but a few persons may hear of words Sungoraengsuthang (Mullet Soup Cooked with Cold Water).In fact, the mullet soup cooked with cold water is one of famous specialties of Pyongyang.This soup is made in such a way as boiling chopped mullet with a few pepper corn wrapped in a sheet of gauze.The point is that it must be boiled in cold water, not in hot water. That’s why the soup is called Sungoraengsuthang.It’s none other than President Kim Il Sung who taught the recipe of this soup which even the cooking experts were ignorant of.Indeed, he is the father of the people who paid solicitude even to a single dish for people.Ko Chol Myong Most people are familiar with words “Mullet Soup,” but a few persons may hear of words Sungoraengsuthang (Mullet Soup Cooked with Cold Water).In fact, the mullet soup cooked with cold water is one of famous specialties of Pyongyang.This soup is made in such a way as boiling chopped mullet with a few pepper corn wrapped in a sheet of gauze.The point is that it must be boiled in cold water, not in hot water. title: New Production Process of Steel Established
body: The Chongjin Steel Factory is obtaining successes in its work to rationally renovate its production processes.Officials, workers and technicians of the factory built big induction furnaces with a large capacity and improved the electricity supply system in the spirit of self-reliance and by dint of science and technology. title: Scientific Research Successes Conducive to Forestation and Forest Conservation

a scientific and intensive footing.It also bred and introduced new species of fast-growing trees with high productivity and much medicinal value, while ensuring their rate of rooting at over 90 percent.Nutritive activator and other accelerants developed by them are well received.The researchers at the Forest Science Information Institute developed "Friends of Forest", a data browser for dissemination of forest science and technology which makes it possible to get rapid access to domestic and foreign scientific and technological information, multimedia, etc. by use of domain and integrated search functions.The Thremmatology Institute, the Forest Machine Institute and other units have made positive efforts to create seed-gathering forests and introduce machines for forest title: Ryugyong Kimchi Factory
body: Kimchi, one of the world’s five health foods, is an important subsidiary food indispensable to the Korean people’s diet. The number of factories producing kimchi in an industrial way is now on the increase in the DPRK. Among them is the Ryugyong Kimchi Factory located on the outskirts of Pyongyang. It has put the production of kimchi on a highly industrial and scientific basis. Its products like the whole cabbage kimchi, white kimchi, sliced radish kimchi and nutritive kimchi for children are very popular among the consumers.The factory has recently further improved the quality of products through a technical innovation drive. On the basis of properly constituting the mixing proportion of lactobacilli, it newly cultivated 10 kinds of lactobacilli in an industrial way and completely removed various germs. And it improved the taste and aroma of kimchi by completing a pickling method in low temperature and less salt to keep the freshness and nutritive substances of vegetables and radishes. Now the factory is conducting a research for making kimchi with mallow, chives and other nutritive vegetables. body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a message of greeting to Macky Sall, president of the Republic of Senegal, on countries would invariably develop as required by the new era and desired by the peoples of the two countries, it sincerely wished the president and people of Senegal greater success in their work for title: A Passionate Woman Educator Who Contributed to Education for Intellectual Development
body: O Chun Gyong, director of the Educational Science Institute under Pyongyang Teacher Training College, is an educator in her thirties who contributed to the education for intellectual development of children.She is a rare enthusiast who created a lot of efficient and advantageous new teaching methods conducive to developing intellectual faculties of children and raising their inquiring capability and wrote valuable textbooks and references.Besides, she contributed a big deal to making university education practical and integrated and putting it on modern and IT basis including establishing the estimating system of children’s intellectual ability by educative robots.She frequented the Grand People’s Study House and the Sci-tech Complex to devise and introduce in our way the technology for developing children’s intellectual faculties and introducing robotized education, the trend of the development of the modern education.In those days, she came to create the methods of developing children’s intelligence with abacus game and robotized extracurricular education of children in compliance with the principle of socialist pedagogy and mental qualities of their ages. title: Strict Anti-epizootic Measures Taken
body: The Soju Rabbit Breeding Stock Farm of Jongju City established a strict anti-epizootic system and prevents rabbits from diseases with self-produced veterinary medicines.Informing breeders in detail of issues propping up in the rabbit breeding, officials of the stock farm rooted out sources of various diseases in time through scientific breeding.This brought about the improvement in anti-epizootic work, markedly reduced the death rate and largely raised the number of leverets.The Jongmun Higher Middle School of Sinuiju City takes thorough anti-epizootic measures for breeding rabbits.It built a rabbit corral with an open-air rabbit pen, a breeding rabbit pen, an epizootic prevention center, etc. and focused efforts on securing breeding rabbits.Thus, they laid the foundation for producing many leverets by securing 100-odd breeding rabbits in a short span of time.It also frequently sterilized rabbit pens and, in a close combination with related units, it vaccinated the rabbits 2-3 times a year. title: Ko Kyong Chan-led Hero Workteam Fulfills the Yearly Quotas for National Economic Plan
body: The Ko Kyong Chan-led Hero Workteam of the April 5 Pit of the Kumgol Mine of the Komdok Mining Complex, that has grown as a hero workteam well-known to our people under the loving care of the Workers’ Party of Korea, carried out the yearly quotas of the national economic plan on March 30.They, setting a goal to finish their yearly quotas in the first quarter of the year, found the way of increasing production in technological innovation and constantly thinking of and introducing advanced working methods.Chief of the workteam Ko Kyong Chan frequented the Youth Tunneling Workteam formed with ex-soldiers to teach them rational drilling and blasting methods and knacks. title: Not a Moment’s Delay Must Be Brooked
body: In the autumn of 1962 President Kim Il Sung joined an official to pass through a street fronting toward the Pyongyang Railway Station.He did not take his eyes off a building which had not a signboard and whose windows were covered with cloth.He said to himself that a store was run there and asked the official why it existed no longer.The official failed to reply readily. Kim Il Sung gave instructions to operate the store again.A few days after Kim Il Sung called the official to his office and said that he had just passed by the front of the building and noticed that its windows were still covered with cloth to convince him that the store was not reopened. He asked the latter what was the matter with it.The official informed Kim Il Sung that an institution closed up the store to use it as its office and delayed its removal one day after another because it did not yet find another office right now.Kim Il Sung said that an office could be moved anywhere and that nothing went amiss although it was postponed for a day or two. He earnestly stressed that the reopening of the store must brook not a moment’s delay.The official was warmly touched to the heart by the great concern of Kim Il Sung about the welfare of the people.O Mun Il In the autumn of 1962 President Kim Il Sung joined an official to pass through a street fronting toward the Pyongyang Railway Station.He did not take his eyes off a building which had not a signboard and whose windows were covered with cloth.He said to himself that a store was run there and asked the official why it existed no longer.The official failed to reply readily.
