title: Pyongyang Children’s Department Store
body: Recently, a stand for baby goods was arranged at the Pyongyang Children’s Department Store of the DPRK. The department store, situated in the heart of the capital city, is a commercial service center professionally dealing in goods for children.At its every floor there is playing space for children.It is associated with the peerlessly great men’s warm love for the rising generation.President Kim Il Sung initiated the construction of a children’s department store in April Juche 48 (1959) and selected its site in February next year.He visited the completed department store in November 1961 to acquaint himself with the preparation of its operation. And he gave instructions to produce and supply many more quality goods to the department store, noting that the department store should become an educational place for the children.Chairman Kim Jong Il, too, visited the department store on several occasions and gave detailed instructions to fulfill its mission.The department store was remodeled as a modern commercial service and educational center for the children some years ago, thanks to the loving care of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un who personified the noble outlook of the President and the Chairman on posterity.Rodong Sinmun Recently, a stand for baby goods was arranged at the Pyongyang Children’s Department Store of the DPRK. title: A Model Apartment Building Rejected
body: Chollima Street was well under construction scores of years ago.One day President Kim Il Sung visited it despite having not yet taken his lunch.An official of the construction site guided Kim Il Sung to a completed model apartment building. Meanwhile, he thought that the latter would be satisfied with it.Kim Il Sung looked round the interior of an apartment and entered its washroom. title: Salt Output from Underground Ultra-saline Water Increases by 2.5 Times
body: In the first quarter of this year, the Salt Production General Enterprise increased the salt production from the underground ultra-saline water by 2.5 times as against the same period of last year.In May four years ago, Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un visited the Kwisong Salt Works during which he acquainted himself with the state of salt production from the underground ultra-saline water in the Korean People’s Army and gave precious instructions to widely generalize their successes and experiences.The enterprise set a goal to increase the salt production from the underground ultra-saline water of great economic benefit this year, the first year of the frontal offensive for making a breakthrough, and scrupulously organized the economic work to carry it out.Especially, it paid deep attention to making full preparations for salt production including overhauling equipment at salterns in order to start the salt production ten days earlier than last year.They devised and produced lightened boring machines and actively introduced different technical innovation schemes. title: Manbokhwa
body: It has been eight years since Manbokhwa, a new species of cymbidium, came into being.A research group of the Pyongyang Floriculture Institute has spread Manbokhwa across the country after mass-breeding it on an advanced bioengineering method. This flower is associated with the deep care of the great leaders.When visiting the newly-built Pyongyang Floriculture Institute in March Juche 100(2011), Chairman Kim Jong Il was told about the newly-bred species of cymbidium. He gave an instruction that newly-bred flowers should be named after coming into bloom. title: Construction of Pyongyang General Hospital in Full Swing
body: Soldier-builders of the Guards Hero Brigade and the builders of the Eighth Construction Bureau are waging a vigorous struggle to realize the noble will of the Workers’ Party of Korea on building the Pyongyang General Hospital for the people on a modern basis at an early date.The building units made open caissons and drew water out of them with pumps while pushing ahead with the drilling work without letup. In addition, they massed heavy machines on the spot and removed earth in a three-dimensional and blitz war way, creating a surprising speed in it.Thus, earth of hundreds of thousands of cubic meters was excavated in a little more than 20 days.Not content with this, they are making continuous successes in the foundation concrete tamping every day.Geared like cogwheels in time are all working processes including steel and frame work and transportation of concrete mixture. Especially, foremost importance is given to ensuring quality on the principle of taking responsibility for the safety of the projects and guaranteeing their absolute quality for eternity. title: Working as a Pump Worker for Nearly 30 Years

title: Pak Pong Ju Inspects Different Units

title: Highly Appreciated Fatigue Alarm for Drivers
body: Recently, a technical group of the Myohyang Advanced Technology Institute developed a fatigue alarm for drivers in our style.This device is based on an advanced technology of estimating the drivers’ fatigue.Immediately drivers’ concentration power is lowered or they feel very tired when running cars, it detects it and gives a warning to them.Ri Pong Sun, director of the institute, researcher Kim Kwang Jin and other technicians, setting a goal to devise the fatigue alarm in cooperation with scientists of the State Academy of Sciences in line with the world trend and detailed actuality of our country, made strenuous efforts to put it into practice.They applied alarms in vehicles of various units of Pyongyang and local areas on a trial basis. title: The First and Foremost Index
body: Political independence is the first and foremost index of an independent sovereign state.When the building of a new society began in Korea after its liberation President Kim Il Sung chose the original line of defending and realizing the basic interests of our people and the sovereignty of our country and nation.On August 20, 1945 he told the military and political cadres of the Korean People's Army that we should continue to advance the Korean revolution on the basis of successes in our victory and build an independent rich and strong sovereign state by the efforts of the Korean people themselves. title: His Iron Faith
body: The SEV (the Council for Mutual Economic Assistance) was founded in the mid-20th century with many former socialist countries. They demanded that our country, too, join it.President Kim Il Sung evinced his attitude toward the SEV. It ran: First, the SEV coordinates the economic assignments of its member countries under a unified plan. The European countries can take charge of a sphere because their industries are developed. But ours is not yet on a par with them. Second, our machine-building industry has not been developed. Therefore, our country will have to supply the member nations of the SEV with raw materials alone if it participates in international division of labor. If so nothing but empty tunnels will eventually remain with us. Third, in that case we’ll have nothing to do but beg something from other countries. This will be a burden on the (then) Soviet Union, too. As mentioned above Kim Il Sung countered the admission of his country to the SEV with the upbuilding of its independent national economy.O Mun Il The SEV (the Council for Mutual Economic Assistance) was founded in the mid-20th century with many former socialist countries. title: An Answer to the Question of History
body: Our country and people were confronted with a grave situation in the 1960s right after the Caribbean Crisis.President Kim Il Sung made up his mind to convene the 5th Plenary Meeting of the 4th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and advance the line of building up our economy and national defense simultaneously. Prior to this, he repeatedly discussed the line.Officials fully agreed on the line as one and assured Kim Il Sung that it must be carried out without fail because it alone afforded a guarantee for national defense and prosperity.Kim Il Sung knew better than anybody else that defense spendings would place difficulties in the way of the people’s livelihood. But he firmly decided to adopt the line because the right to live and sovereignty of the nation were valuable above all. Consequently, the line was put forward at the 5th Plenary Meeting of the 4th Party Central Committee held in December 1962 and the ensuing militant slogan “A rifle in one hand and a sickle and a hammer in the other!” was brought into being.O Mun Il Our country and people were confronted with a grave situation in the 1960s right after the Caribbean Crisis.President Kim Il Sung made up his mind to convene the 5th Plenary Meeting of the 4th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and advance the line of building up our economy and national defense simultaneously. title: Moran Hill, Beauty Spot of Pyongyang
body: Moran Hill has long been known as a scenic spot of Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, as it is thickly covered with various flowers and trees and has many historical relics.In the hill, there are historical relics like Ulmil and Chongryu pavilions and the Hyonmu Gate, cascades, ponds and walkways.There are also Kim Il Sung Stadium, volleyball ground, basketball ground, Korean-wrestling site, folklore games areas, Moranbong Theatre, botanical exhibition, small-sized zoo and other cultural establishments.In fact, the hill could turn into an excellent park of Korean style and a cultural resort for citizens thanks to the devoted efforts of President Kim Il Sung.He climbed Moran Hill one day in the first spring after Korea’s liberation from Japan’s colonial yoke (August 15, 1945). Going round the damaged hill with a heartrending mind, he said that it should be turned into a fine cultural recreation center for the Pyongyang citizens.In February 1974, he again climbed the hill with leading officials of Pyongyang City in the teeth of cold wind. He gave precious instructions to spruce up the hill into a Korean-style park, saying that it is just like a garden of Pyongyang.The President had toured the hill more than 30 times till the last moments of his life.Rodong Sinmun Moran Hill has long been known as a scenic spot of Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, as it is thickly covered with various flowers and trees and has many historical relics.In the hill, there are historical relics like Ulmil and Chongryu pavilions and the Hyonmu Gate, cascades, ponds and walkways.There are also Kim Il Sung Stadium, volleyball ground, basketball ground, Korean-wrestling site, folklore games areas, Moranbong Theatre, botanical exhibition, small-sized zoo and other cultural establishments.In fact, the hill could turn into an excellent park of Korean style and a cultural resort for citizens thanks to the devoted efforts of President Kim Il Sung.He climbed Moran Hill one day in the first spring after Korea’s liberation from Japan’s colonial yoke (August 15, 1945). title: President Kim Il Sung’s Great Devotion for People
body: The Korean people have celebrated April 15, birthday of President Kim Il Sung, as the Day of the Sun.April 15 is one of the greatest national holidays to the people. But it was a “working day” for the President who had devoted his all to the people’s happiness.At early dawn of April 15, Juche 43 (1954), his first birthday after the Fatherland Liberation War, the President visited an agricultural cooperative in Junghwa County, which was included in South Phyongan Province at that time. He sat together with officials and members of the cooperative at the edge of a field to discuss farm work and indicated the orientation and ways for the cooperative to follow.That day, he went round the then Junghwa Farm and the Pyongyang Farm Machine Hire Station till sunset. And he said that he enjoyed his birthday with pleasure and felt good when the state affairs went well.On his 65th birthday, too, he gave field guidance to coal mines in Kaechon and Anju areas, saying that when coal is produced in a large quantity, it is just a rest for him.Like this, the President regarded working for the people even on his birthday as his great pleasure and rest.Rodong Sinmun The Korean people have celebrated April 15, birthday of President Kim Il Sung, as the Day of the Sun.April 15 is one of the greatest national holidays to the people. title: An Effective Use of Grass Feed Alone Can Activate the Household Stockbreeding
body: Kim Myong Hun’s family of the Songha Industrial Crops Co-op Farm of the Jagang Provincial Rural Economy Committee in Manpho City is known for gaining benefits from growing a lot of domestic animals.11 breeding pigs are raised at the two-storied pigsty of plastic sheet greenhouse type.This year, his family has already produced 58 piglings. It plans to produce over 120 piglings till the end of this year.It also raises a lot of goats - 30 breeding goats, 4 medium-sized goats and 28 tattoos.It plans to increase the number of goats to 100 this year.There is a sheep in pup. title: Kim Jae Ryong Inspects Various Units
body: Premier Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and member of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, inspected the Sunchon Phosphatic Fertilizer Factory nearing completion and the Nampho Medical Appliances Factory.The officials, workers and builders of the Sunchon Phosphatic Fertilizer Factory are putting spurs to making preparations for production in the spirit with which they finished the construction of the Korean-style modern phosphatic fertilizer factory in a brief span of time in hearty response to the tasks given by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un during his field guidance.Looking round some production lines, Kim Jae Ryong learned about detailed problems arising in test operation in each sector and process and underscored the need for leading economic officials to accurately estimate costs and ensure the quality of materials in operation of the factory.At the Nampho Medical Appliances Factory, Kim Jae Ryong discussed measures to drastically increase the production of quality medical appliances conducive to promoting the people's health true to the Party's intention.He stressed the need to develop more indices for medical appliances needed for treatment and further promote the efficiency of production facilities.He also inspected the Yongyu Mine. title: Traditional Costume Encouraged in DPRK
body: The traditional costume of the Korean nation is well known to the world for its beauty and decentness.Korean clothes, peculiar in shape and bright and soft in color, are a precious heritage and pride of the nation.Such custom of national dressing, involving the traditional clothes-making technique and method and attire developed from the ancient times, was registered as a national intangible cultural heritage and has been encouraged in the DPRK.In general, Korean dresses are characterized with two parts-upper and lower garments-harmonious combination of straight and curbed lines, neck-band and breast-tie.The Korean people would like to put on the national costume regularly, not only in such significant occasions of life as holidays and wedding ceremony.The Korean costume has body: The Provincial Medical Oxygen Factory was inaugurated in North Hamgyong Province.The factory is fully equipped with the necessary conditions for the production of medical oxygen such as oxygen separator ground and oxygen filling ground.The Provincial Medical Oxygen Factory made it possible to mass-produce medical oxygen and send them to hospitals.Officials and employees of the factory are conducting an effective work to normalize the production through proper technical management of equipment. title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Syrian President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Bashar Al-Assad, president of the Syrian Arab Republic, on April 11.The president extended the wholehearted and warmest congratulations to Kim Jong Un and, through him, to the friendly Korean people on the occasion of the Day of the Sun, the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung.The message said that Kim Il Sung built the DPRK into a powerful country facing up to the foreign forces' moves to stifle the sovereignty, independence and right of the DPRK to self-determination.It noted that the exploits of Kim Il Sung who made a contribution to the movement of national liberation around the world and supported the cause of Arab opposing Zionism will be immortal in the hearts of not only the Korean people but also the world people aspiring after freedom.It hoped that the Korean people would achieve progress and prosperity while continuously title: His Lifelong Creed
body: Pak In Jin, who headed believers in the Religion of Chondogyo (the Heavenly Way) in an area, visited a secret camp of President Kim Il Sung in the early winter of 1936.When he met Pak In Jin one day Kim Il Sung remembered that it was high time for believers in the religion to offer clear water to its founder in prayer and told his orderly to bring a bowl of clear water. He then advised the latter to observe the rite.That day Pak In Jin admired at the unequalled personality and magnanimity of Kim Il Sung. He told the latter that believers in the religion worshipped God and unexpectedly asked him if he, too, had an object of worship and what it was if any.He replied: “Of course, I, too, have an object of worship. It is none but the people. I have regarded them as God and served them. They are precisely my God. Nobody is so omniscient, omnipotent and almighty as them in the world. Therefore, I have formulated it as my lifelong motto to deem them God….”Kim Il Sung regarded the people as God and respected them as such throughout his life.O Mun Il Pak In Jin, who headed believers in the Religion of Chondogyo (the Heavenly Way) in an area, visited a secret camp of President Kim Il Sung in the early winter of 1936.When he met Pak In Jin one day Kim Il Sung remembered that it was high time for believers in the religion to offer clear water to its founder in prayer and told his orderly to bring a bowl of clear water. title: Decisions Not Fulfilled
body: The people of the whole country hoped that President Kim Il Sung would take even a short rest because he was absorbed in his work without a day’s rest. Consequently, the Political Committee of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea adopted decisions on his rest time and again. But they were not at all implemented on every occasion.In September 1973, too, the Political Committee of the Party Central Committee adopted a decision on his rest of a month.But he provided his firsthand leadership in a cooperative farm from the first day of his rest.When an official earnestly entreated Kim Il Sung to take a rest the latter said that he could not do so feeling at ease while he had much work to do and asked him to understand it as if he begged his consideration.On the 8th day of his rest, too, Kim Il Sung had his hand full from morning to night and returned to his lodgings late in the evening. He said that he would stop resting and urged officials to join him to go back to Pyongyang. He warmly said that a rest was nothing special and that it was his rest to mix and talk with workers and farmers and rid them of their obstacles to please them.Although a rest was given to him with much effort Kim Il Sung was always busy with his work instead.Choe Yong Il The people of the whole country hoped that President Kim Il Sung would take even a short rest because he was absorbed in his work without a day’s rest. title: His Determination Confirmed among Workers
body: President Kim Il Sung called on the workers of the Kangson Steelworks on August 3, 1953 a week after our victory in the Fatherland Liberation War.He said that he prepared for a meeting prior to this trip and came to see them and discuss the rehabilitation and construction of the country with them. He expatiated on his plan to preferentially develop the heavy industry of the nation.The workers of the KS felt grateful to him for reposing confidence in them and discussing an important affair of the nation with them. They warmly assured him that they absolutely upheld his line.Kim Il Sung got great courage from them and repeatedly confirmed that the general orientation of the rehabilitation and construction was entirely correct.Two days after his return from the KS he held the 6th Plenary Meeting of the Party Central Committee and put forward the main line of socialist economic construction which prescribed the preferential development of heavy industry and the simultaneous development of light industry and agriculture in the country.O Mun Il President Kim Il Sung called on the workers of the Kangson Steelworks on August 3, 1953 a week after our victory in the Fatherland Liberation War.He said that he prepared for a meeting prior to this trip and came to see them and discuss the rehabilitation and construction of the country with them. title: Orangchon Reservoir Completed, the First Irrigational Water Supplied
body: When the fierce flames of the frontal offensive for making a breakthrough are raging throughout the country, North Hamgyong Province completed the Orangchon Reservoir on April 17 and supplied the first irrigational water.Officials, members of the Workers’ Party of Korea and other working people of the province finished the reservoir project envisaging the filling of earth of nearly one million㎥ for a dam in little over one year by displaying the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance.Many units and residents of Orang County actively supported the construction both mentally and materially.The completion of this reservoir provides a guarantee for increasing grain output on farmlands in Orang and Myonggan counties and makes it possible to utilize all the water at the Phalhyang Reservoir for electric-power production and to sufficiently supply the inhabitants with water for living. title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Greetings to Syrian President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a message of greeting to Bashar Al-Assad, president of the Syrian Arab Republic, on April 17.The message extended warm congratulations to the president, government and people of Syria on behalf of the DPRK government and people on the occasion of the 74th anniversary of its independence, a significant national holiday of the Syrian people.The message said that the people of the DPRK are sincerely pleased to see the friendly Syrian people making great progress in accomplishing the cause of justice for defending the country's sovereignty and territorial integrity, peace and security under the correct leadership of the president, and wholeheartedly wish them bigger success in their future work for the country's reconstruction and independent development.It expressed the belief that the good friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries with long history and title: Premier Calls for Increased Production at Power Plant and Coal Mine
body: Premier of the Cabinet Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and member of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, visited the East Pyongyang Thermal Power Plant and the February 8 Jikdong Youth Coal Mine to learn about production.Touring several places of the power plant, he called for properly carrying on business management and technical control, lowering the consumption of raw materials as much as possible and directing efforts to saving.There was a consultation on practical problems for making a breakthrough in the increased production and providing raw and other materials in a responsible manner by giving definite precedence to science and technology.At the February 8 Jikdong Youth Coal Mine, he underscored the need to provide materials for increasing the capacity of coal transport, build dwelling houses for coal miners and ensure supply service under more scrupulous plan. title: The Fighters Tasted the Mullet Soups
body: One day following the liberation of Korea from Japanese colonial rule an anti-Japanese revolutionary fighter reminded President Kim Il Sung that one year the latter talked by a bonfire in a secret camp about a soup prepared with the gray mullets of the Taedong River and asked him unreservedly when he could eat it.Such being the case, Kim Il Sung decided to take lunch with his anti-Japanese revolutionary fighters at a restaurant noted for the excellence of its mullet soup.But he was in a very awkward position because he could not pay for the fighters there for lack of money.At that juncture one of them carefully took money from his pocket. It was wrapped in paper.Truth to tell, the other day he called at Mangyongdae, the birthplace of Kim Il Sung, by stealth to acquire information concerning the latter’s grandparents and other relatives who lived there. When he returned the latter’s grandmother Ri Po Ik put the money in the former’s hand.Looking toward his faraway birthplace Kim Il Sung warmly said that the fighter uttered his will to pay for the mullet soups with the money he was given by Ri Po Ik there yesterday, that it was a good thing for him to do so and that it would also please her.Consequently, the anti-Japanese revolutionary fighters tasted the mullet soups for the first time after liberation.Jang Jong Chol One day following the liberation of Korea from Japanese colonial rule an anti-Japanese revolutionary fighter reminded President Kim Il Sung that one year the latter talked by a bonfire in a secret camp about a soup prepared with the gray mullets of the Taedong River and asked him unreservedly when he could eat it.Such being the case, Kim Il Sung decided to take lunch with his anti-Japanese revolutionary fighters at a restaurant noted for the excellence of its mullet soup.But he was in a very awkward position because he could not pay for the fighters there for lack of money.At that juncture one of them carefully took money from his pocket. title: The Steadfast Rules of His Life
body: One evening in October 1945 President Kim Il Sung returned home from his firsthand leadership and entered his reception room. He found new pieces of furniture put there.He lost no time in calling an official and saying that he was not justified in furnishing the room. He strictly reproved him for doing that although he knew that the people were badly off.That day he said that we should always have the same food, clothing and housing as the people did. He earnestly suggested to the latter that when they used furniture of this sort we, too, should follow suit.As stated above it was the steadfast rules of Kim Il Sung’s life to live just like the people all the time.Kim Chong Il One evening in October 1945 President Kim Il Sung returned home from his firsthand leadership and entered his reception room. title: Starting from the Viewpoint of a Producer, Not a Consumer
body: From long ago, our unit has directed great efforts to development and introduction of solar generating technique in order to help relieve the shortage of electricity in the country.In the course of this, we have made not a small findings in our research and established a well-arranged production process of filmy and polycrystal solar cells with a yearly production capacity of tens of thousands of kilowatts.In particular, the filmy solar cells can be used for the purposes of decorating building walls or as roofing materials. Thus they can play the aesthetic mission as finishing building materials.For example, our unit installed 7,000-odd filmy solar cells on the building walls of thousands of square meters in a monolithic way and more than 1,000 polycrystal solar cells on the roof as well. body: The Kanggye University of Agriculture and Forestry has made several findings in the research into production method of Terracottem and its application effectiveness.Based on this achievement, it title: Efficient Vegetable Insecticide Developed
body: Scientists at the Forest Vegetation Engineering Research Center of the Forest Management Institute have strived to develop a vegetable insecticide effective for exterminating harmful forest insects.Thus, they succeeded in developing a vegetable insecticide with at least one third of chemical insecticides in the production cost. When mixing with a bit of auxiliary agent, it works effectively on pine caterpillar, hairy caterpillar and other major harmful forest insects.Five kilograms of dried perennial plants are needed for making one kilogram of this vegetable insecticide. title: Book “Korean Commodities” Published in DPRK
body: The Committee for the Promotion of International Trade of the DPRK (CPIT) recently published the book “Korean Commodities” (revised edition).The first edition of the book was published in Juche 107 (2018) and attained a wide circulation at home and abroad to give much helping hands to the audience.The CPIT brought out its revised edition to introduce homemade articles much more and further promote the exchange and cooperation with foreign businesses which wish to trade with the DPRK.The new book shows 48 enterprises famous in the country and their special products as well as different kinds of commodities like foodstuffs, health foods, light-industry goods, electronic goods, finishing building materials and metallic materials. title: An Educator Leading the Creation of New Teaching Methods
body: Kim Song Hui, a teacher of Clinical Medicine Faculty No.1 of Pyongyang University of Medicine, is an educator of ability and passion distinguishing herself in medical education sector in creating new teaching methods for training talents with practical ability.Last year, she gave two lectures to more than 10,000 educators from tens of universities, who were unanimous in saying that hers was a new medical teaching method of our style that suits the developing world trend of education and a valuable and superior teaching method that can be generalized in universities and colleges across the country.Her new teaching method, freed from the traditional one centering on the lecturer’s explanation, can make students active learners and researchers by enabling them to conceive, design and create anything freely according to the lecturer’s control and guidance.She pays great concern to students’ view and opinion of her lecture, regarding it as a very important factor in title: Slag Processing Factory Newly Built

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Reply Message to Syrian President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on April 22 sent a reply message to Bashar Al-Assad, president of the Syrian Arab Republic.Kim Jong Un, in his message, expressed his deep thanks to the president of the Syrian Arab Republic for sending his heartfelt message of greeting reflecting the warm respect for President Kim Il Sung, who is always alive in the hearts of the Korean people and the world progressives, on the occasion of his 108th birth anniversary.Expressing the belief that the DPRK-Syria friendly and cooperative ties title: 60-odd Days Dedicated to Life of a Young Patient
body: North Hamgyong Provincial Infant Hospital has recently revived an 8-year-old child who had been unexpectedly placed on the verge of death.Many medical workers unhesitatingly devoted their blood and skin to the patient for several skin grafts and blood transfusions.They treated the patient capable of neither sitting nor standing with all their sincerity and prepared nutritious foods for the patient’s nourishment.Such high sense of responsibility and boundless devotion of the medical workers gave rebirth to the once-dying child.Kim Chong Il North Hamgyong Provincial Infant Hospital has recently revived an 8-year-old child who had been unexpectedly placed on the verge of death.Many medical workers unhesitatingly devoted their blood and skin to the patient for several skin grafts and blood transfusions.They treated the patient capable of neither sitting nor standing with all their sincerity and prepared nutritious foods for the patient’s nourishment.Such high sense of responsibility and boundless devotion of the medical workers gave rebirth to the once-dying child.Kim Chong Il Many medical workers unhesitatingly devoted their blood and skin to the patient for several skin grafts and blood transfusions.They treated the patient capable of neither sitting nor standing with all their sincerity and prepared nutritious foods for the patient’s nourishment.Such high sense of responsibility and boundless devotion of the medical workers gave rebirth to the once-dying child.Kim Chong Il They treated the patient capable of neither sitting nor standing with all their sincerity and prepared nutritious foods for the patient’s nourishment.Such high sense of responsibility and boundless devotion of the medical workers gave rebirth to the once-dying child.Kim Chong Il Such high sense of responsibility and boundless devotion of the medical workers gave rebirth to the once-dying child.Kim Chong Il Kim Chong Il

title: More Than 900 Tons of Tangle Harvested Every Day
body: Offshore farms in the Korean West Sea have recently harvested more than 900 tons of tangles every day.Under the direction of the Ministry of Fisheries, they laid solid foundations of increased tangle production by expanding the area under aquiculture and focusing on transplantation of tangles and their manuring and cultivation.As a result, they brought about rich tangle yields this year and are focusing efforts on tangle harvest at the moment.The Pupho Offshore Farm is making innovations in the van of others.The Ongjin Offshore Farm is also trying to increase tangle output. title: Those Who Actively Support the Army
body: It has been over 20 years since Jang Yong Ae, chief inspector at the Kosong County Land and Environmental Conservation Station, started helping the army together with her husband.Remembering her father’s precept that one can neither imagine one’s family’s happiness nor children’s future without one’s country, she became a soldier after her graduation from a middle school. title: Stockbreeding Suited to Local Features of Mountainous Area Can Pay Off

title: Belt Conveyer Proves Effective at Sochang Youth Coal Mine
body: The belt conveyer newly laid at the Sochang Youth Coal Mine of the Tokchon Area Coal Mining Complex proves effective in coal production.Since it went into operation late in January, it has so far conveyed tens of thousands of tons of coal.It takes coal from prolific Pits Nos. 3, 5 and 8 to the coal depot and its total length is over 2,700 meters.Thus, the conveyance capacity of the coal mine increased more than 1.3 times.The operation of the newly laid belt conveyer provided another guarantee for normalizing coal production for thermal power stations.Sim Hak Chol The belt conveyer title: Broad-spectrum Sterilant Widely Used in DPRK
body: In the DPRK, stable solution of chlorine peroxide manufactured by its scientists has been widely used in the anti-epidemic work.This solution is a broad-spectrum sterilant that can destroy all sorts of pathogens including virus, bacterium and true fungus, and it is applicable to any objects.It is higher in concentration and thrice longer in storage than the existing chlorine peroxide.Many units across the country have used it in the anti-epidemic work after the state emergency anti-epidemic measure was taken to prevent COVID-19.The demand for this broad-spectrum sterilant is now growing higher in such various sectors as hygienic and anti-epidemic and medical service, foodstuff processing, public catering, stockbreeding and fish farming.Rodong Sinmun In the DPRK, stable title: Haeju Fowl-Breeding Farm Newly Built
body: The high-capacity Haeju Fowl-breeding Farm was completed in South Hwanghae Province.It is a comprehensive fowl-breeding base with computer-aided production and management systems.The province set its construction as an important issue for the development of the poultry industry and improvement of the livelihood of people in the province, and carried out a campaign for its qualitative completion in the shortest span of time.In cooperation with scientists from the State Academy of Sciences, the breeding equipment was manufactured at home and the control of temperature, humidity and gas in incubation chamber and breeding blocks put on computer-aided basis.The farm is also equipped with the solar-powered system.The province has secured hundreds of highly productive seed fowls with strong viability, thus laying a foundation for its immediate operation after completion.With the completion of the fowl-breeding farm, the province came to fully supply seed chicks and eggs to poultry units in the province, while preserving and extensively reproducing highly productive purebred fowls.Rodong Sinmun The high-capacity Haeju Fowl-breeding Farm was completed in South Hwanghae title: Socialism Vigorously Advances Only When Importance Is Attached to Morality
body: Today we should thoroughly establish a revolutionary and sound moral trait throughout the society in order to set an example in building a civilized country.Just as a socialist society rapidly develops by dint of self-consciousness of popular masses, so priority should be given to morality before the law. Prioritizing morality constitutes a prerequisite for defending the nature of socialism and fully displaying its superiority. It is also an important guarantee for hastening the construction of a powerful socialist country more forcefully. The motive force of the socialist construction is the high spiritual strength of people who are willing to advance ahead of others. Their spiritual strength ceaselessly rises when they regard it as their moral duty to devote their all to the Party and revolution, the state and society. There are some points that should not be neglected in the understanding that importance should be given to morality. Prioritizing the morality does not mean disregarding the law. Ours is the genuine country for people in which the law defends the people and the latter observes the former voluntarily. The laws of the DPRK constitute a powerful weapon defending the state and social system and independent lives of the people and propelling the revolution and construction. title: Russian Organization on Development of Relations with DPRK
body: The Russian Association for Friendship and Cultural Cooperation with the DPRK published a statement on April 20 on the occasion of the first anniversary of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's visit to the Russian Federation.The statement said that Kim Jong Un met and had talks with President Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin at Far Eastern Federal University on Russky Island in the city of Vladivostok on April 25, 2019.It pointed out that this was a historical event of weighty importance for a new golden age of development of Russia-DPRK relations as well as durable peace and security of the Korean Peninsula.Saying that the friendly relations between Russia and the DPRK have a long tradition, the statement continued as follows:We are convinced that Russia and the DPRK will make every possible effort to realise the precious agreements made at the summit talks.We will work hard for the development of the friendly and cooperative relations between Russia and the DPRK.We sincerely wish the Korean people greater success in the struggle for implementing the decision of the Fifth Plenary Meeting of the Seventh Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea.Rodong Sinmun The Russian title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Chairman of C.C.,
body: Communist Party of Russian Federation Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, on April 24 received a message of greeting from G. A. Zhuganov, chairman of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation.The message said that the great peoples of Russia and Korea have now greeted great and shining events in the history of the two countries.The significant Russia-Korea summit held in Vladivostok on April 25, 2019 marked the symbol of mutual trust and understanding between the two countries, the message said, and went on:At the summit an agreement was reached on issues of expanding and developing the bilateral cooperation onto the higher stage in various fields.After the summit, Russia-Korea relations have entered the phase of multifaceted cooperation.Today the friendship between the Communist Party of the Russian Federation and the Workers' Party of Korea has been strengthened.We support the WPK enforcing the policy of independence and friendship in external relations, defending peace on the Korean peninsula and in Asia and developing cooperative relations with other countries.The message extended greetings to Kim Jong Un and wished him good health and happiness and the Korean people prosperity.Rodong Sinmun Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, on April 24 received a message of greeting from G. title: A Village Full of Fragrance of Blossom
body: There are many fruit trees at villages of the Kisan Farm in Unpha County. In spring, they are fragrant with the smell of blossoms. In summer and autumn, the fruit trees are laden with various kinds of fruits, adding beauty to them.Some families have 20-25 fruit trees in gardens.Growing there are various kinds of fruit trees including peach, apricot, plum, cherry, grape, and persimmon.So its farmers can eat various fruits and rest under fruit trees after working at fields in hot summer. The fruits they gather in every year are conducive a great deal to improving their living standard.Pak Yong Jin There are many fruit trees at villages of the Kisan Farm in Unpha County. title: Let Us Listen to People
body: The Mountain Lavishing Us with Sweet Fruits Residents of our county actively engaged themselves in turning all the mountains into useful golden ones and made not a few achievements. Last year alone, the county harvested a considerable amount of acorns. Our foodstuff factory is producing various kinds of tasty foodstuffs with those acorns. The county is also supplying nurseries, kindergartens, hospitals, hotels and public catering facilities with tens of tons of wild fruit. This adds much to people’s happiness. Pak Kwang Won, Worker at Usi County Foodstuff Factory Straight Roads, Fresh Air We enjoy convenience from the refreshing water of high quality supplied to every household. Now that roads have been put into good shape and air is finer, our pleasure is growing bigger day by day. In this year’s general mobilization period for spring land administration, a peculiar flower park has been laid to add beauty to the streets of the town. The work of renovating public establishments in keeping with the characteristics of our county and in a modern way is at the final stage. We are all out for land administration with patriotism, picturing the day when our county will become a better place to live in. title: Over 85 Percent of Yearly Timber Production Plan Carried out
body: Officials and workers in the sector of forestry fulfilled the yearly timber production quotas by more than 85% as of mid-April by waging a fierce production drive to greet the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers’ Party of Korea with significant labor feats.At the moment, other forestry stations and timber production stations across the country are occupied in the timber production with their efforts concentrated on taking logs piled up in lumber yards to several sectors of the national economy in time.Jong Kyong Chol Officials and workers in the sector of forestry fulfilled the yearly timber production quotas by more than 85% as of mid-April by waging a fierce production drive to greet the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers’ Party of Korea with significant labor feats.At the moment, other forestry stations and timber production stations across the country are occupied in the timber production with their efforts concentrated on taking logs piled up in lumber yards to several sectors of the national economy in time.Jong Kyong Chol At the moment, other forestry stations and timber production stations across the country are occupied in the timber production with their efforts concentrated on taking logs piled up in lumber yards to several sectors of the national economy in time.Jong Kyong Chol Jong Kyong Chol

title: Abnormal Weather Phenomena Witnessed in DPRK
body: Recently, abnormal weather phenomena were witnessed in the DPRK. It rained in certain areas and the temperature was so changeable.In the beginning and the middle of March, the country saw frequent rainfall and snow in northern inland regions. So, the monthly precipitation in the regions was higher than the average, whereas that in areas south of the central part, including Nampho City and South Hwanghae Province, was lower.In the end of March and the beginning of April, it rained very little in the country as a whole. And arid climate persisted in most parts of the west coast, with frequent strong wind.In the period, the temperature went up as compared with the average.But from April 20, it went down suddenly. The maximum temperature on April 21 and 22 was less than 10 degrees centigrade in the eastern and western coastal areas and less than 4 degrees centigrade in the northern inland areas, 7-10 degrees lower than the average.In particular, slight snowfall accompanied by strong wind was witnessed in some areas of the west coast on April 21. According to experts, such phenomenon can be seen early in winter or early in spring.Rodong Sinmun Recently, abnormal weather phenomena were witnessed in the DPRK. title: Japan's Apology and Compensation for Past Crimes Urged
body: The south Korean newspaper Hangyore on April 23 carried an article demanding Japan's apology and compensation for its past crimes.Japan has strangled law suits instituted by south Korean victims of forcible drafting enforced during the period of the Japanese imperialists' colonial rule over Korea, raising a "theory on exempt state" that calls for not accepting decisions of foreign and regional courts, the article said.The article urged the south Korean court to work to meet the demands of victims.Rodong Sinmun The south Korean newspaper Hangyore on April 23 carried an article demanding Japan's apology and compensation for its past crimes.Japan has strangled law suits instituted by south Korean victims of forcible drafting enforced during the period of the Japanese imperialists' colonial rule over Korea, raising a "theory on exempt state" that calls for not accepting decisions of foreign and regional courts, the article said.The article urged the south Korean court to work to meet the demands of victims.Rodong Sinmun Japan has strangled law suits instituted by south Korean victims of forcible drafting enforced during the period of the Japanese imperialists' colonial rule over Korea, raising a "theory on exempt state" that calls for not accepting decisions of foreign and regional courts, the article said.The article urged the south Korean court to work to meet the demands of victims.Rodong Sinmun The article urged the south Korean court to work to meet the demands of victims.Rodong Sinmun Rodong Sinmun

title: Swiss Bodies Issue Joint Statement to Mark KPRA Founding Anniversary
body: The Swiss Organizing Committee for the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu, the Switzerland-Korea Committee and the Swiss Group for the Study of the Juche Idea issued a joint statement on April 19 on the occasion of the founding anniversary of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army (KPRA).The joint statement said that President Kim Il Sung founded the Korean People's Revolutionary Army (KPRA), the first revolutionary armed force of Juche type in Korea, on April 25, 1932.It said that the KPRA defeated the Japanese imperialists under the leadership of legendary hero Kim Il Sung to liberate the country on August 15, 1945, a long cherished desire of the Korean people.It said that he had exerted himself for the building of the regular armed forces after the liberation of the country, thus founding the Korean People's Army (KPA) on Feb. 8, 1948.The KPA defeated the U.S. imperialists in the three year-long Fatherland Liberation War to creditably defend the freedom and sovereignty of the country, it said.It stressed that the KPA is strengthening and developing into invincible revolutionary armed forces under the wise guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un.Rodong Sinmun The Swiss Organizing Committee for the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu, the Switzerland-Korea Committee and the Swiss Group for the Study body: The officials of South Hamgyong Province are forging ahead with the construction of Kumya County nature-driven waterway with the determination to greet the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers’ Party of Party with high yields.The length of the waterway is over 40 kilometers.When the construction is finished, the county can supply water to thousands of hectares of fields without using tens of large water pumps installed in over 20 places. title: Pak Pong Ju Inspects Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill and Public Commercial Centers in Pyongyang
body: Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the WPK, inspected the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill and public commercial centers in Pyongyang.Making rounds of several places of the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill like the general dyeing shop and the general weaving shop, Pak Pong Ju stressed the need to produce more cloth of different colors liked by the people, and took practical measures to update sewage disposal facilities for environmental protection.At Pyongyang Department Store No. 1 and Kwangbok Area Supermarket, he called upon officials and employees to meticulously ensure the supply of commodities and improve service so as to fulfill their responsibilities and duties as true servants of the people. title: Long Stride Made through Difficulties
body: It happened in February when the Pyongyang City Regiment of 922 Brigade started the ground-making project of dwelling houses including blocks Nos.1, 7 and 10 in Pothae-dong.The cold was biting and cutting winds were raging.However, the constructors did not stand back even a single step. body: The waterway builders have completed the 2nd-stage project of South Hwanghae Provincial waterway and successfully passed the water through it on a trial basis. title: Coal Combustion Additive Made of Local Raw Materials
body: The Kangwon Provincial Fuel Supply Center is striving to save precious coal while affording convenience in people’s everyday life and protecting the forest resources of the country.It devised a coal combustion additive on its own to suit the actual conditions of its locality. The additive, devised and applied by the concerted efforts of the officials of the supply center and members of the three-revolution teams in the province, can spare a lot of coal by lowering the ignition temperature and raising the combustion efficiency.At the National Exhibition of Sci-Tech Achievements in Field of Fuel for Inhabitants held last year, this additive was appraised as an excellent sci-tech success.This is a precious fruition of the ardent patriotism of those persons who are anxious to help the country’s economic life and improvement of people’s living standard by saving even one gram of coal.Kim Kwang Guk The Kangwon Provincial Fuel Supply Center is striving to save precious coal while affording convenience in people’s everyday life and protecting the forest resources of the country.It devised a coal combustion additive on its own to suit the actual conditions of its locality. title: “Our Postman”
body: Myong Ryong Chan, residing in the township of Jungsan County, had worked faithfully at the county post office for over 30 years and became a pensioner three years ago.However, he carries on his work as a postman.Although he deserves an easy life in his remaining years, he could not rest at home for he was fully aware of how important the postman’s duty was.His sincerity of thinking of the society and the collective before his own comfort touched heartstrings of officials of the post office and he could go on working as a postman.He always visits inhabitants with a bright smile on his face. title: Tree Nursery Newly Built in Nampho City
body: Officials, Party members and other working people of Nampho City have built a modern tree nursery true to the Party’s grand intention of land development.The main building, sapling display hall, light substrate production workshop, dormitory and welfare facilities were built in harmonious shape in an area of nearly 200,000㎡. In addition, four round cutting grounds, greenhouses and open-air cultivation grounds were laid out and the entrance road and the compound paved neatly.It is a modern tree nursery whose sapling production has been put on a scientific, industrial and intensive level. title: Campaign for Probe into Truth behind Kwangju Massacre Vowed in South Korea
body: Yonhap News of south Korea reported on May 3 that various public organizations are taking more active part in the struggle to disclose the truth behind the Kwangju massacre and deal a penalty on distorting the history with the lapse of 40 years after the Kwangju Popular Uprising.Referring to the fact that the May 18 Kwangju Popular Uprising is registered in history as a mass struggle for independence, democracy and reunification against the dictatorship, it said various circles of south Korea have steadily continued the struggle for carrying on the history and spirit of the Kwangju resistance.It said that many people from all walks of life have turned out in the struggle for enacting the law on punishing the distortion of the May 18 history and some of them call for putting an end to the distortion of the history.It said that an investigation committee would be organized for investigating the detailed truth behind the Kwangju massacre.Meanwhile, organizations related with the May 18 Kwangju Popular Uprising and other organizations decided to launch, on a larger scale, activities for probe into the truth of the May 18 massacre in Kwangju and other parts of south title: Founding Anniversary of ARF Marked by Swiss Organizations
body: The Swiss Organizing Committee of the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu, the Switzerland-Korea Committee and the Swiss Group for the Study of the Juche Idea made public a joint statement on May 2 on the occasion of the 84th founding anniversary of the Association for the Restoration of the Fatherland (ARF).The statement said:President Kim Il Sung founded the ARF on May 5, 1936 to rally the broad masses under the banner of the anti-Japanese struggle.The "Ten-Point Programme of the Association for the Restoration of the Fatherland" formulated by the President comprehensively deals with tasks for accomplishing the historic cause of Korea's liberation and building a prosperous, independent, sovereign and democratic state, including the one for establishing the genuine government of the Korean people after overthrowing the ruling system of the Japanese imperialists.The ARF, the first anti-Japanese national united front of Korea, had struggled for realizing the country's independence and sovereignty on the basis of the might of the Korean people while regarding the Juche idea founded by the President as its guideline.Rodong Sinmun title: Pride of a Merited Machine-building Worker
body: Kim Kwang Su of Sunan District received the title of Merited Machine-building Worker at the Conference for Reviewing Work in Agricultural Field in 2019.He has devotedly worked at the District title: Construction of Organic Compound Fertilizer Factory at Final Stage
body: Kim Hyong Gwon County, Ryanggang Province is stepping up the construction of an organic composite fertilizer factory at the final stage.The county set a goal to build the organic composite fertilizer factory with a yearly production capacity of thousands of tons and is making strenuous efforts for its realization.Now that the construction has reached its final stage, the county is securing liquid manure, peat and humus needed for the production of the organic composite fertilizer in a foresighted manner.Jon Chol Ju Kim Hyong Gwon County, Ryanggang Province is stepping up the construction of an organic composite fertilizer factory at the final stage.The county set a goal to build the organic composite fertilizer factory with a yearly production capacity of thousands of tons and is making strenuous efforts for its realization.Now that the construction has reached its final stage, the county is securing liquid manure, peat and humus needed for the production of the organic composite fertilizer in a foresighted manner.Jon Chol Ju The county set a goal to build the organic composite fertilizer factory with a yearly production capacity of thousands of tons and is making strenuous efforts for its realization.Now that the construction has reached its final stage, the county is securing liquid manure, peat and humus needed for the production of the organic composite fertilizer in a foresighted manner.Jon Chol Ju Now that the construction has reached its final stage, the county is securing liquid manure, peat and humus needed for the production of the organic composite fertilizer in a foresighted manner.Jon Chol Ju Jon Chol Ju

title: Like Their True Father
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un visited the newly-built Kyongsang Kindergarten in May 2012.He was pleased that it was distinctive. He then had a prudent complexion.After a while he told officials that the whole front yard of the KK, even the playing space of its children included, was paved with pitch but that it was not good for them.However, everyone else turned a blind eye to this defect.He continued to point out in an anxious tone of voice that if any of them might fall from a swing while on it he or she would get injured.Soon afterward he kindly advised the playing space to be carpeted with sand or turf.The hearts of the officials were deeply touched by his great fatherly love for the kindergarteners.O Mun Il Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un visited the newly-built Kyongsang Kindergarten in May 2012.He was pleased that it was distinctive. body: On January 1, 2015 Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un visited the Pyongyang Baby Home and the Pyongyang Orphanage for the first on-site guidance of the year.He affectionately said that he wished the title: Cutters of the Tapes Designated
body: In June several years ago Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un visited the Wonsan Baby Home before its completion. He smiled all along hugely delighted that the orphans were given a good home and could grow happily.He saw the whole of the baby home for a time. Presently he looked about officials and suddenly said that when the Wonsan Baby Home and the Wonsan Orphanage were finished with due ceremony the orphans should be arranged for to cut the tapes apiece to signal their completion and that when they moved there and cut the tapes with their hands they would remember it forever even after reaching adulthood.The officials were surprised at this because Kim Jong Un did all he could to ensure that the Wonsan Baby Home was designed and built and they believed that nobody but he was accordingly entitled to cut the tape to signal its completion.They keenly realized that he always intended to prepare the orphans as the future super pillars of the nation.O Mun Il In June several years ago Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un visited the Wonsan Baby Home before its completion. title: Verbal Message to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from President Xi Jinping
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a verbal message from Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and president of the People's Republic of China, in reply to his verbal message to the latter over the achievements made by the party and people of China in their efforts to fight the pandemic.Xi Jinping in his message said that he received with pleasure the warm and friendly verbal message from the chairman of the WPK, stressing that it fully showed the deep feelings of Chairman Kim Jong Un, and the Party, government and people of the DPRK toward himself, and the party, government and people of China, and greatly displayed the solid foundation of the traditional China-DPRK friendship and its tremendous vitality.Xi Jinping said that he has intent to propel the steady advance and development of China-DPRK relations in the new era and to actively contribute to the regional peace, development and prosperity by thoroughly carrying out important agreements, strengthening strategic communications and intensifying exchange and cooperation between the two parties and the two countries. title: Kim Jae Ryong Inspects Ansok Tideland under Reclamation and Kwisong Salt Works
body: Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, member of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, inspected the Ansok tideland under reclamation and the Kwisong Salt Works.Walking along the dyke at the tideland, he gave a pep-talk to builders and stressed the importance of measures for pushing ahead with the building of networks of facilities, applying advanced construction methods and new technologies and lowering the cost of the construction to the minimum.At the Kwisong Salk Works, he called for taking measures to actively harness natural energies and scrupulously doing such works for strengthening the internal motive force as training more talents.The field consultative meetings discussed the issues for taking the advantage of economic levers and took measures for the supply of raw and other materials and equipment. title: First Rice-transplanting Begins in Wonhwa-ri of Phyongwon County
body: President Kim Il Sung sowed seeds in the fields of Wonhwa-ri, Phyongwon County on May 10, 1952 in the midst of war.Officials and members of the farm, whose fields still bear vivid traces of the President, began transplanting rice seedlings on May 10 with a firm determination to glorify this meaningful year marking the 75th founding anniversary of the Party with great successes in grain production.Now, the farm’s rice-transplanting machines are operated at full capacity and its fields are going greener as time goes by. title: Chairman Kim Jong Il’s Feat for Automating Hwanghae Iron Works
body: A project for extending the iron and steel production capacity is now progressing apace at the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex, a leading ferrous metallurgical base in the DPRK.The complex has been well-known in the country as a model of putting all its production processes on an automated basis.In May Juche 55(1966), Chairman Kim Jong Il visited the complex (the then Hwanghae Iron Works) in company with President Kim Il Sung and took a measure to put its production processes on a mechanized and automated basis for freeing the workers from heat-affected, harmful and onerous labor.Going round different parts of the iron works, the Chairman gave an instruction to free workers form heat-affected and onerous labor by introducing advanced sci-tech successes. He also watched a new blast furnace erected by its workers and stressed that smelters should not be allowed to work under the heat-affected and dusty conditions, indicating the solution in detail.Later, he dispatched powerful technical forces and provided on a preferential basis such major equipment as closed-circuit televisions to turn the iron works into a fine model of all-round automation.Following it, a number of industrial establishments realized the overall automation and comprehensive mechanization by introducing closed-circuit televisions, tele-control system, etc.Rodong Sinmun A project for extending the iron and steel production capacity is now progressing apace at the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex, a leading ferrous metallurgical base in the DPRK.The complex has been well-known in the country as a model of putting all its production processes on an automated basis.In May Juche 55(1966), Chairman Kim Jong Il visited the complex (the then Hwanghae Iron Works) in company with President Kim Il Sung and took a measure to put its production processes on a mechanized and automated basis for freeing the workers from heat-affected, harmful and onerous labor.Going round different parts of the iron works, the Chairman gave an instruction to free workers form heat-affected and onerous labor by introducing advanced sci-tech successes. title: New Kinds of Flowers Registered as Garden Plant Species
body: Ten kinds of ornamental flowers newly bred by the Pyongyang Floriculture Institute in the DPRK were registered as the state garden plant species recently.Those flower species are strong in cold resistance and grow well even in high temperature. And their blooming periods and breeding coefficients are long and high.Among them are Chrysanthemum morifolium “Bunga”, Tulipa gesneriana “Strong Gold”, Rosa Hybrida “Black Lady”, Helichrythum bracteatum “Rose Beauty”, Lilium hybridium “Algarve”, Gladiolus hybridus “Priscilla” and Calceolaria herbeohybrida “Naine Daintt”.The institute will breed many more beautiful flowers of good species which are easy to cultivate and grow well, thus contributing to decorating the whole country with flowers.Rodong Sinmun Ten kinds of ornamental flowers newly bred by the Pyongyang Floriculture Institute in the DPRK were registered as the state garden plant species recently.Those flower species are strong in cold resistance and grow well even in high temperature. title: Construction of Hydraulic Power Stations Brisk in DPRK
body: The construction of minor hydraulic power stations is progressing apace in the DPRK.Each province, city and county set it as a goal to produce by their own efforts the electricity needed for developing the local economy.On the basis of correct survey of hydraulic resources in their areas and scientific calculation of electricity output, they have hastened the construction of power stations in a profitable way.Kangwon Province has sped up the construction of six hydraulic power stations simultaneously. This year, the province concluded the construction of Ichon Army-People Power Station and opened a prospect to complete the construction of Munchon Army-People Power Station in the near future by driving through thousands of meters of waterway tunnel. It is also stepping up the construction of Phyonggang, Kosong, Hoeyang and Sepho army-people power stations by introducing advanced building methods.Jagang Province has pushed ahead with the construction of Hungju youth power stations Nos. 4 and 5 by applying a rational building method that makes it possible to save much material, fund and labor.North Phyongan Province, too, is building minor hydraulic power stations like Kujang Youth Power Station No. 2 and Phihyon Power Station No.2.Rodong Sinmun The construction of minor hydraulic power stations is progressing apace in the DPRK.Each province, city and county set it as a goal to produce by their own efforts the electricity needed for developing the local economy.On the basis of correct survey of hydraulic resources in their areas and scientific calculation of electricity output, they have hastened the construction of power stations in a profitable way.Kangwon Province has sped up the construction of six hydraulic power stations simultaneously. title: U.S. Arrogant Attitude Blamed by S. Korean Newspaper
body: The south Korean internet newspaper Voice of People in an editorial on May 8 branded the U.S. attitude to the negotiation for share of defense cost as a height of arrogance.The editorial said that the U.S. is demanding an unconditional increase while refusing south Korea's proposal for an increase of 13 percent in the latter's share.It claimed that the U.S. took even the south Korean workers at the U.S. military bases as hostages for the negotiation.It stressed that the U.S. arrogant attitude sparks off the public anger.Rodong Sinmun The south Korean internet newspaper Voice of People in an editorial on May 8 branded the U.S. attitude to the negotiation for share of defense cost as a height of arrogance.The editorial said that the U.S. is demanding an unconditional increase while refusing south Korea's proposal for an increase of 13 percent in the latter's share.It claimed that the U.S. took even the south Korean workers at the U.S. military bases as hostages for the negotiation.It stressed that the U.S. arrogant attitude sparks off the public anger.Rodong Sinmun The editorial said that the U.S. is demanding an unconditional increase while refusing south Korea's proposal for an increase of 13 percent in the latter's share.It claimed that the U.S. took even the south Korean workers at the U.S. military bases as hostages for the negotiation.It stressed that the U.S. arrogant attitude sparks off the public anger.Rodong Sinmun It claimed that the U.S. took even the south Korean workers at the U.S. military bases as hostages for the negotiation.It stressed that the U.S. arrogant attitude sparks off the public anger.Rodong Sinmun It stressed that the U.S. arrogant attitude sparks off the public anger.Rodong Sinmun Rodong Sinmun

title: His Teachings in Chongsan-ri
body: Chairman Kim Jong Il visited Chongsan-ri in May 1971.Its officials greeted him politely. He was glad to see them and kindly said that we were here to help their village.He asked them if the artists who stayed here to help it in its farm work performed their duty well.One of the officials replied that they not only transplanted rice seedlings well but also helped his farmers from the bottom of their hearts, getting them water from wells for their lodgings, sweeping their yards with brooms and furbishing up the information halls of his workteams.Smiling at this he told his accompanying officials that helpers of rural areas were not simple manpower supporters but the revolutionary soldiers of the Party who aided in splendidly carrying out the tasks of the ideological, technological and cultural revolutions there.They seriously realized that mistaken with a correct view on helpers of rural areas they regarded them as simple manpower supporters.O Mun Il Chairman Kim Jong Il visited Chongsan-ri in May 1971.Its officials greeted him politely. title: His Benevolence
body: President Kim Il Sung passed through a farm on the evening of May 1974.When the headlights of his car flashed across its paddy he saw farmers bedding out rice seedlings there with a transplanter although the evening deepened.He appreciated their patriotism and told his driver to turn his car to the paddy and throw a light on it.When their paddy was bright with light the farmers stepped up their work in high spirits.After a while they came to know that they owed this fortune to Kim Il Sung. Deeply touched, they tried to stop their rice seedling transplanter and finish the day’s work.He dissuaded them from doing so and tenderly told them to drive their rice seedling transplanter to the opposite side of the paddy and back once more. He then watched that being done.Despite the passage of time this memory is still enshrined in the hearts of all our agricultural workers.O Mun Il President Kim Il Sung passed through a farm on the evening of May 1974.When the headlights of his car flashed across its paddy he saw farmers bedding out rice seedlings there with a transplanter although the evening deepened.He appreciated their patriotism and told his driver to turn his car to the paddy and throw a light on it.When their paddy was bright with light the farmers stepped up their work in high spirits.After a while they came to know that they owed this fortune to Kim Il Sung. title: His Trusting Letter
body: The 8th Congress of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea was held in December 2016 in the capital city of Pyongyang.Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un addressed a historic letter entitled “On Improving the Role of the UAWK in Accomplishing the Juche-Oriented Socialist Cause” to those who attended the meeting.He wrote in his letter that the agricultural front was an outpost for the defense of socialism and that when farm work was done well enough to settle the food problem of the people satisfactorily the socialism of our style could be defended and a strong socialist country built successfully. Moreover, he stressed that masters of agriculture were farmers, that the key to an increase in agricultural production lay in rousing the enthusiasm of agricultural workers for production and that it should be ensured that conscious of being responsible for the supply of cereals to the nation agricultural workers farmed the land assiduously along scientific lines to meet the demand of Juche-based farming method.The letter still stirs the hearts of all our agricultural workers who defend the main theater of a frontal breakthrough and vigorously stimulates them to work hard to increase their cereal output.Kim Kwang Guk The 8th Congress of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea was held in December 2016 in the capital city of Pyongyang.Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un addressed a historic letter entitled “On Improving the Role of the UAWK in Accomplishing the Juche-Oriented Socialist Cause” to those who attended the meeting.He wrote in his letter that the agricultural front was an outpost for the defense of socialism and that when farm work was done well enough to settle the food problem of the people satisfactorily the socialism of our style could be defended and a strong socialist country built successfully. title: Fifty-four Kinds of Trees to Be Planted This Year
body: Citizens of the DPRK have turned out in the second-stage forest restoration campaign under the slogan “Let’s turn all the mountains into golden mountains!”24 kinds of fruit trees, 19 kinds of wood plants and 11 kinds of ornamental trees, high in economic value and favorable for ecological environment, are to be planted throughout the country to suit the geographical and biological characters.Mixed forests will be created with those kinds of trees amounting to 90 percent of the forestation this year to accelerate the growth of trees and raise their capacity of absorbing carbon dioxide and storing water.Fruit trees include pine-nut tree, Evodia daniellii, black walnut, Korean pepper bush, chestnut tree, wild pear tree, wild vine, tara vine, Aronia melanocarpa and vitamin tree.Poplar, larch, birch and black pine-Maengsan are included in wood plants.Meanwhile, national-tree pine, “Kumya Black Pine”, magnolia, Pyongyang maple tree and clammy locust are comprised in the title: Newly-built Modern Tree Nurseries
body: In the DPRK, provincial, city and county tree nurseries have been built or reconstructed on a modern basis in recent two years.Those land- and manpower-saving nurseries produce saplings twice in a year.The Mundok County Forestry Management Station in South Phyongan Province built a sapling greenhouse with plastic sheets, where the sapling production is put on a scientific, industrial and intensive basis of higher level.The Tanchon City Forestry Management Station in South Hamgyong Province has sharply increased the sapling production in its modern tree nursery.The Kangdong County Forestry Management Station in Pyongyang City, too, newly built a mother tree nursery with a plan to turn all the mountains in the county into gold and treasure ones in the near future.Growing at this nursery are millions of saplings with high economic value like “Kumya Black Pine”, Larix lepolepis, Pinus rigida, Pinus strobes, chestnut tree, tara vine and wild pear tree.In order to raise the rate title: Fabrication of Death Cause during May 18 Kwangju Uprising Revealed
body: The south Korean Kyunghyang Daily News on May 11 disclosed that the military authorities fabricated those, who were dead when taking part in the operation for quelling the May 18 Kwangju Uprising, as "the fallen killed by Kwangju citizens."The daily said that a military training corps of the infantry school under the branch command for education of combatants misjudged an airborne brigade moving to the Kwangju Airport as a civilian army unit and made an assault on it in the afternoon of May 24, 1980, killing 10 soldiers.It said that many documents recorded the case as a mistaken shooting or conflict between forces under Martial Law, but "the notice of death" represented the dead as "the fallen killed by mobs (Kwangju citizens)".Noting on other several fabricated death records, the daily stressed that it would be quite possible such fabrication were carried out with Chun Doo Hwan's connivance.Rodong Sinmun The south Korean Kyunghyang Daily News on May 11 title: Condolatory Visit to Lao Embassy
body: Ri Kil Song, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, Pak Kyong Il, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries who is vice-chairman of the DPRK-Laos Friendship Association, and officials concerned paid a visit to the Lao embassy here on Thursday to express condolence over the demise of Sisavath Keobounphanh, former prime minister of Laos.Placed before the photo of the deceased were wreaths in the names of the Foreign Ministry, the Ministry of External Economic Relations, the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries and the Bureau for Affairs with Diplomatic Corps.The visitors paid a silent tribute to the memory of the deceased and made entries in a condolence book.Rodong Sinmun Ri Kil Song, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, Pak Kyong Il, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries who is vice-chairman of the DPRK-Laos Friendship Association, and officials concerned paid a visit to the Lao embassy here on Thursday to express condolence over the demise of Sisavath Keobounphanh, former prime minister of Laos.Placed before the photo of the deceased were wreaths in the names of the Foreign Ministry, the Ministry of External Economic Relations, the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries and the Bureau for Affairs with Diplomatic Corps.The visitors paid a silent tribute to the memory of the deceased and made entries in a condolence book.Rodong Sinmun Placed before the photo of the deceased were wreaths in the names of the Foreign Ministry, the Ministry of External Economic Relations, the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries and the Bureau for Affairs with Diplomatic Corps.The visitors paid a silent tribute to the memory of the deceased and made entries in a condolence book.Rodong Sinmun The visitors paid a silent tribute to the memory of the deceased and made entries in a condolence book.Rodong Sinmun Rodong Sinmun

body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un visited a disabled soldiers’ plastic daily necessities factory in May 2017. He looked round its room for education through revolutionary relics.
