title: Winter, Too, Designated for Camping
body: Early in December 2016 Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un visited the December 6 Children’s Camp newly rebuilt in Kangwon Province.He did the rounds of it and told officials about winter camping. title: An Earnest Request
body: In November several years ago Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un visited the Ryugyong Health Complex before its forthcoming completion and did the rounds of it with great satisfaction.Informed by an official that the RHC would go into service right after its completion he looked around at its interior. title: Trustworthy High-yielding Farmers
body: Three years ago, Jin Jong Hui, a farmer of Work-team No.3 of the Yonpho Co-op Farm in Kim Hyong Jik County, volunteered to take charge of an infertile field.She found a way of increasing grain output in constantly improving the soil fertility. Since then, she has produced a lot of compost every year to increase the fertility of the field.This year, she has participated in the Conference for Reviewing Work in Agricultural Field in 2019 and received a commendation of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un.Keeping the pride in mind, she carefully tends her fields by the sweat of her brow.There is a girl farmer who is well-known as an innovator at the Ryonsong Co-op Farm in Chosan County. title: Traditional Habit of Tea-drinking Actively Encouraged
body: Koreans have been drinking tea from long ago. In our country, tea tree planting began in the period of the Three States and then people started drinking tea.At first, they only processed tea leaves to drink but later on they also infused or brewed different fruits, leaves or roots for drinking purposes.Teahouses and restaurants across the country including the Unjong tea service facilities in Pyongyang are serving the customers with teas made with the famous Korean ginseng, fruit of Schizandra chinensis and others as well as green and black teas.They are also being face-lifted anew to provide better service.Meanwhile, the Mansudae Art Studio and other units are producing various colorful teacups that suit the tastes and national emotions of our people.Ri Jong Hyok Koreans have been drinking tea from long ago. title: Co-op Farm Seething with Enthusiasm for High Yields
body: The Unjong Co-op Farm in Sonchon County is transplanting rice seedlings in a minute manner as required by the Juche farming method. It has already adopted advanced farming methods like rice-enriching method and big rice seedling cultivation method.Taking into account the condition of the farm which is in lack of water as it is located at the lowest part of the waterway, it introduced the rice-enriching method in a larger area this year.The substantial technical guidance of officials and elevated enthusiasm of farmers are leading to further successes in rice-transplantation in every field. title: Kangwon Province Benefits from Brisk Production of Building Materials
body: Kangwon Province gets profits from vitalized building material production bases.The province produces various kinds of building materials on its own including cement, brick, tiles, synthetic grass, heat ray reflection glass and distemper paint and uses them for its construction.Recent years have witnessed successive appearances of buildings conducive to the development of local economy and the improvement of the living standard of its people. title: Order of Chairman of WPK Central Military Commission Issued
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Central Military Commission (CMC) of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), signed an order on promoting the military ranks of commanding officers. The order issued on May 23 is as follows: It is the fixed faith and unshakable will of our party to firmly defend the sovereignty and dignity of the country, break through head-on the grim unprecedented hardships and win new victory in building a powerful socialist country in reliance on the strong militant spirit and the invincible might of the revolutionary armed forces. Today the armed forces of the DPRK face a heavy historic task to further arm themselves with the revolutionary idea, line and policies of the WPK as required by the prevailing situation, to reliably defend the party, the revolution, the country, people and socialism by bolstering the invincible military force in every way and to fully display the might as the pioneer of the times and the performers of miracles in the grand advance for achieving prosperity by dint of self-defence. All the commanding officers of the armed forces of the DPRK must open the breakthrough of advance in the van of the gigantic struggle to significantly celebrate the 75th founding anniversary of the glorious WPK by holding fast to the party's leadership as lifeline and work unprecedented innovative successes in carrying out the cause of building a powerful army and the cause of socialist construction as a whole so as to glorify the noble honor as members of the great party's army, the great people's army. I order to promote the military ranks of the major commanding officers as follows, firmly believing that all the commanding officers, key backbones of the armed forces of the DPRK, would honor their noble mission and duties in the sacred struggle to defend the party, the revolution, the country and the people. title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Guides Enlarged Meeting of WPK Central Military Commission
body: The Fourth Enlarged Meeting of the Seventh Central Military Commission of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) took place at a stirring time when the entire Party and the whole society are pushing ahead with the great revolutionary advance for glorifying this year marking the 75th founding anniversary of the WPK as a year of opening up an epoch-making phase in the path of the development of the Korean-style socialism, true to the line and policy for achieving prosperity by self-reliance set forth by the great Party. The meeting was guided by Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the Central Military Commission (CMC) of the WPK. Attending the meeting were members of the WPK Central Military Commission, members of the Executive Committee of the Korean People's Army Committee of the WPK, commanders and commissars of the services and corps of the Korean People's Army, commanding officers of the Ministry of State Security, the Ministry of People's Security, the Guard Headquarters and other armed forces organs at all levels and vice directors of major departments of the WPK Central Committee. The meeting discussed important military steps and organizational and political measures to further bolster up the overall armed forces of the DPRK politically and ideologically and in military technique to be able to firmly defend the political stability and sovereignty of the country and reliably contain the persistent big or small military threats from the hostile forces in view of the essential requirements to bring about further progress in developing the national defence capabilities and war deterrent under the internal and external situation created in the vital period in the development of our revolution, and dealt with an organizational matter. The meeting reviewed and analyzed a series of drawbacks in the military and political activities of the overall armed forces of the DPRK including the People's Army, and discussed methodological issues for overcoming them and bringing about drastic improvement. Also discussed at the meeting were the issue of examining and setting right the unreasonable machinery and compositional defects and the core issues for further increasing the capabilities for militarily deterring the threatening foreign forces by rapidly increasing the self-reliant defence capabilities and organizing new units. The meeting stressed once again the tasks facing the different sectors to thoroughly carry out the revolutionary military line and policies of the party. Set forth at the meeting were new policies for further increasing the nuclear war deterrence of the country and putting the strategic armed forces on a high alert operation in line with the general requirements for the building and development of the armed forces of the country. Taken at the meeting were crucial measures for considerably increasing the firepower strike ability of the artillery pieces of the Korean People's Army. The meeting elected a vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission of the DPRK and recalled or by-elected some of its members. Ri Pyong Chol was elected as vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission of the WPK. The organizational matter was tabled at the meeting on dismissing or transferring or newly appointing commanding officers in major posts of the armed forces institutions. The CMC of the WPK decided to promote the military ranks of major commanding officers of the People's Army in high recognition of their devotion and efforts to glorify this year marking the significant 75th anniversary of the glorious WPK as the first year of great victory in the frontal breakthrough. The respected Supreme Leader put main emphasis on thoroughly realizing the party's monolithic leadership over the People's Army by consolidating the party organizations and political institutions at all levels within the People's Army and enhancing their function and roles, and on providing party leadership to conducting military, political, logistic and defence and all other affairs in line with the ideology and intention of the party under whatever circumstances. He specified key issues to be constantly maintained in the military and political performance of the armed forces of the DPRK, and tasks and ways. He signed seven orders including the orders on new military measures discussed and decided at the Party CMC, an order on draft reorganization of machinery for enhancing the responsibility and roles of the major military educational institutions, the order on reorganizing the military commanding system to meet the mission and duty of the security institutions, and the order on promoting the military ranks of commanding officers. The Fourth Enlarged Meeting of the Seventh Central Military Commission of the WPK organized and led by Kim Jong Un served as a historic turning point of great significance in increasing the capabilities of the revolutionary armed forces in every way and laying a solid foundation for further powerfully propelling the victorious advance of the revolutionary cause of Juche by dint of the invincible military force under the outstanding army-building idea and strategic plan of the WPK. title: Founding Day of KPRA Set as National Holiday
body: The founding day of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army (KPRA) has been instituted as a national holiday in the DPRK. April 25, Juche 21 (1932) was the day when President Kim Il Sung founded the KPRA, the first revolutionary armed forces of Juche in the country. With the foundation of the KPRA, the Korean people came to have the genuine revolutionary army led by an outstanding leader for the first time in history and this marked the start of the glorious history of the Korean revolution in which the imperialist aggression forces were repelled and the sovereignty and dignity of the nation staunchly championed. In order to meaningfully celebrate the founding day of the KPRA, April 25 every year has been instituted as a national holiday. A decree of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK on it was promulgated on May 20. Rodong Sinmun

title: Kim Jae Ryong Inspects Various Units
body: Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, member of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and premier of the Cabinet, inspected different units of the national economy. Touring several places of Nampho Port, Kim Jae Ryong stressed the need to further round off the inspection and quarantine system without a single moment's relaxation under the situation in which the anti-epidemic work assumes protracted nature. A field consultative meeting discussed issues of thoroughly carrying on disinfection on a scientific ground and organizing well the supply of disinfectant to ensure effective anti-epidemic work. At Chongsan Co-op Farm in Kangso District he encouraged the agricultural workers in their labor efforts and stressed the need for officials to make sure that active drive for high yields should be waged based on scientific farming methods so as to celebrate the 75th founding anniversary of the Party with increased grain production. Kim also learned about the operation of the Pyongyang Metro, development of new product at the Kim Jong Thae Electric Locomotive Complex and remodeling of the Kumsong General Tractor Factory. title: Repeal of "Security Law" and Release of Prisoners of Conscience Demanded in S. Korea
body: The Association for Supporting Prisoners of Conscience for Justice, Peace and Human Rights reportedly held a regular general meeting in Seoul on May 16 to announce that it would struggle for the world free from the "Security Law", the world without the prisoners of conscience. The meeting reviewed its work carried out for decades and decided to organize various activities in demand of the repeal of the SL and release of the prisoners of conscience. The association denounced the conservative media for its false reports on the Justice Preserving Solidarity for Settling the Issue of Sexual Slavery for the Imperial Japanese Army, and released a statement with the Family Movement for Realizing Democracy in south Korea in support of the solidarity. Rodong Sinmun

title: Japan Blasted for Its Shameless Acts
body: The south Korean paper Hangyore on May 21 editorially denounced Japan, a war criminal state, for being shameless in dealing with the issue of sexual slavery. The editorial condemned the ultra-right media of Japan for finding fault with the work of the south Korean Justice Preserving Solidarity for Settling the Issue of Sexual Slavery for the Imperial Japanese Army on May 20. The media was blasted for demanding the removal of the statue of a girl sexual slave and a stop to the rallies for the settlement of the sexual slavery issue, the editorial said. It denounced the media for urging the south Korean authorities to clarify their stand towards the solidarity, an act of interfering in the internal affairs. Terming it the profound confusing of the right and the wrong, the editorial said that the issue of sexual slavery is an issue related to the war crimes. It stressed that Japan, the war criminal state, should stop all the provocations aimed at tarnishing the movement for the settlement of the sexual slavery issue. Rodong Sinmun

title: Advantages and Might of People-oriented Socialism of Our Style
body: On May 24, 1990, President Kim Il Sung made a policy speech “Let Us Bring the Advantages of Socialism in Our Country into Full Bloom” at the First Session of the 9th Supreme People’s Assembly. This work clearly indicates the essence and main features of our-style socialism and tasks and ways for fully displaying its advantages. The advantages and might of our-style socialism find their expression in the fact that the Workers’ Party of Korea and the state bear full responsibility for people’s future and take good care of it. They are also fully displayed in dynamically advancing along the invariable course of achieving prosperity by dint of self-reliance. The harmonious whole of the Party and the masses constitutes another manifestation of the advantages and might of our socialism. The single-hearted unity is the symbol and invincible might of our-style socialism. We will complete the socialist cause of Juche by dint of single-hearted unity. Kim Yong Il

title: Pak Pong Ju Inspects Different Sectors in South Hwanghae Province
body: Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, inspected different units in South Hwanghae Province.Walking round the waterway in South Hwanghae Province, Pak Pong Ju stressed the need to properly manage the waterway to fully supply water to farming and encouraged officials and agricultural workers of the Sindap Co-op Farm in Pongchon County where wheat is under good cultivation.At the Haeju Tractor Accessory Parts Factory, he calls for constantly raising the quality of products and producing and supplying enough accessories by giving full play to its existing production capacity.He stressed the need to increase the proportion of locally available materials in the production of farm machines, after learning about the remodeling of the Haeju Farm Machine Factory.The field consultative meetings discussed the measures for issues arising in increasing grain production, including cultivation of new land and supply of irrigation water and farm machines.Earlier, he inspected the production process newly established at the Ryugyong Necessities Factory. title: Important Issue Arising in Youth Education
body: To educate the younger generation in a revolutionary way is an undertaking of great importance directly linked to the victorious advance of Juche revolution. title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Birthday Spread to Woman Centenarian
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un sent a birthday spread to Hyon Ok Son, a woman centenarian residing in the township of Sindo County of North Phyongan Province.She, who was born into a poor peasant's family before the liberation of Korea, had faithfully worked to increase grain production for decades with a single mind to repay the benevolence of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il who built a genuine people's country and enforced the politics of loving care for the people.She brought up four sons and daughters to be pillars of the rural outposts of socialism. title: Rallies Demanding Settlement of Issue of Sexual Slavery Held in S. Korea
body: Rallies took place in Seoul, Taegu and Pusan simultaneously on May 27 in demand of the settlement of the issue of sexual slavery for the Imperial Japanese Army, according to news reports.The Pusan Women's Action for Solution of the Issue of Sexual Slavery for the Imperial Japanese Army sponsored a rally before the girl statue for peace in Pusan, where speakers condemned Japan for denying the sexual slavery in the past, refusing to make apology and compensation and seeking to erase the history of war crimes together with pro-Japanese forces in south Korea.There was a similar rally before the girl statue in Taegue.The participants in the rally called on all the citizens to make efforts for the settlement of the issue of sexual slavery.They urged the Japanese government to make an official apology and reparation for the sexual slavery.The participants in a rally held before the statue of a girl sexual slave near the Japanese embassy in Seoul denounced the conservative forces title: Kim Jae Ryong Makes Inspection of Agricultural Field in North Hwanghae Province
body: Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, member of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, made an inspection of the Miru Plain Waterway and rice-transplantation in Koksan and Singye counties of North Hwanghae Province.Walking round the waterway, Kim Jae Ryong underscored the need to take measures for timely supplying materials necessary for its management and preserving it by planting good species of trees along it.After learning about the rice-transplantation in Songrim Co-op Farm in Koksan County and Sinhung Co-op Farm in Singye County, the premier called for introducing varieties of rice with short growing period, properly effecting the field-responsibility-system within the framework of the sub-work team management system and awakening peasants' zeal for grain production.He discussed the issues arising in planting crops suitable for agrological features of the Miru plain. title: Hwangjugindung Waterway Project Begins
body: Hwangjugindung waterway is being built in North Hwanghae Province.Officials and shock-brigade members have buckled down to the construction of the Hwangjugindung waterway after concluding the waterway project of South Hwanghae Province.On June 2, they started the construction project by blowing up 100,000 tons of earth on the spot.When the waterway is completed, a new irrigation system will be established to sufficiently feed the Hwangjugindung Plain and vast farmland in Yonthan County with water from Lake Yonthan. title: Kamapho Fishery Station Benefits from Vitalized Aquiculture

title: DPRK Foreign Minister Ri Son Gwon Meets Chinese Ambassador
body: Foreign Minister Ri Son Gwon met Li Jinjun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK, at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Thursday.Ri Son Gwon expressed the support of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and the government of the DPRK to the measures taken by the Chinese party and government over the issue of Hong Kong.Saying that as the issue of Hong Kong is an internal affair of the People's Republic of China (PRC), the foreign forces' interference in it is a wanton violation of the sovereignty of China and international law, he stressed that the DPRK will as always positively support the stand of the Chinese party and government to safeguard the sovereignty and security of the state and its territorial integrity.Li Jinjun thanked for the support of the Party and government of the DPRK, and said that the Chinese side would strive to promote the construction and development of socialism in the two countries and realize the common ideal and goal by strengthening the cooperation with the DPRK side.He wished the WPK and the Korean people great successes in all fields of the socialist construction under the wise leadership of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un this year that will mark the 75th title: Chosun Ilbo Branded as Pro-Japanese Media
body: The south Korean Internet newspaper Tongil News decided to brand "Chosun Ilbo" as pro-Japanese media from June 1.The newspaper said that "Chosun Ilbo," styling itself as legitimate conservative media, should be taken as a pro-Japanese paper from its attitude to the Japanese imperialists' colonial rule over Korea, to the December 2015 agreement on the issue of sexual slavery for the Imperial Japanese Army and to the Justice Preserving Solidarity for Settling the Issue of Sexual Slavery of the Imperial Japanese Army.It continued that "Chosun Ilbo" must unconditionally be described as "pro-Japanese inclination media".Rodong Sinmun The south Korean Internet newspaper Tongil News decided to brand "Chosun Ilbo" as pro-Japanese media from June 1.The newspaper said that "Chosun Ilbo," styling itself as legitimate conservative media, should be taken as a pro-Japanese paper from its attitude to the Japanese imperialists' colonial rule over Korea, to the December 2015 agreement on the issue of sexual slavery for the Imperial Japanese Army and to the Justice Preserving Solidarity for Settling the Issue of Sexual Slavery of the Imperial Japanese Army.It continued that "Chosun Ilbo" must unconditionally be described as "pro-Japanese inclination media".Rodong Sinmun The newspaper said that "Chosun Ilbo," styling itself as legitimate conservative media, should be taken as a pro-Japanese paper from its attitude to the Japanese imperialists' colonial rule over Korea, to the December 2015 agreement on the issue of sexual slavery for the Imperial Japanese Army and to the Justice Preserving Solidarity for Settling the Issue of Sexual Slavery of the Imperial Japanese Army.It continued that "Chosun Ilbo" must unconditionally be described as "pro-Japanese inclination media".Rodong Sinmun It continued that "Chosun Ilbo" must unconditionally be described as "pro-Japanese inclination media".Rodong Sinmun Rodong Sinmun

title: Probe into Truth behind Ferry Sewol Disaster and Punishment of Chief Culprit Demanded in S. Korea
body: The April 16 Consultative Council of Families of Victims and the "People's Solidarity for Promise Made on April 16" took an intensive action on June 2 in demand of the probe into the truth behind the ferry Sewol disaster and punishment of the principal culprit of the disaster, according to the south Korean online newspaper Voice of People.Speakers held a press conference before the building of the Seoul Central District Prosecutor's Office, and complained that the prosecution organized a special investigation team for the ferry Sewol disaster and started the probe into the truth behind it last year with a pledge that it would make a thorough investigation into every doubt and prove it with a result, but it failed even in approaching the core forces.They stressed that it is necessary to make a thorough investigation into the criminal suspects related with the disaster, including Park Geun Hye, Kim Ki Chun, the then Chongwadae, Intelligence Service and the Defense Security Command and punish them severely in order to probe into the truth behind the disaster.Saying that what the special investigation team has done up to now is a little short of a show, they title: Anti-DPRK Acts of S. Korean Authorities and "Defectors from North" Accused by Youth
body: Youth and students held a meeting at the Youth Park Open-Air Theatre in Pyongyang City on June 6 in protest against the anti-DPRK act of the south Korean authorities and the "defectors from the north". Attending the meeting were officials of the youth league including Pak Chol Min, chairman of the Central Committee of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League, and youth and students. title: Kim Jae Ryong Inspects Different Units of National Economy
body: Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), member of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, inspected different units of the national economy, including the Chongchongang-Phyongnam irrigation waterway under construction, Namhung Youth Chemical Complex and Anju Pump Factory.Walking round the waterway under construction, he called on officials to meticulously organize and guide the work and conduct a vigorous campaign for tapping internal reserves, and took practical measures for supplying necessary equipment and materials in a responsible manner.Inspecting the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex, he underscored the need to put the fertilizer production on a normal basis, speed up the expansion of production capacity and repair of equipment and thus provide a firm foundation for fully supplying fertilizer to the agricultural field.Looking round the Anju Pump Factory, Taean Heavy Machine Complex, etc. he discussed the measures to scrupulously organize the production, take thoroughgoing measures for material supply and thus send equipment in time to the projects to be completed on the occasion of the 75th founding anniversary of the WPK. title: Rainbow-trout Farming in Sea Starts
body: Officials and employees of the Jikha Atlantic Salmon Pedigree Farm have adapted rainbow trout, a freshwater fish, to seawater and succeeded in breeding it in cage-net fish farm in the sea.Large numbers of rainbow trout are growing in the cage-net fish farm with high water-quality.The pedigree farm is devotedly working to attain a higher aim of growing other kinds of freshwater fishes in the sea. title: Stone Chair Telling about Popular Traits of Great Man
body: At the Yonphung Scientists Holiday Camp on the picturesque shore of Lake Yonphung in the DPRK, there is a stone chair telling about the popular traits of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un.In October Juche 103(2014), the Supreme Leader visited the completed holiday camp and came to see an elegant stone chair at its vineyard resting place.After being told that soldier-builders made this special chair of granite weighing hundreds of kilograms, with wish that he would relieve his fatigue even a little at the camp, the Supreme Leader sternly reproved the officials, asking if it is a throne for whom. And he added that he hates such things.As seen above, the Supreme Leader has never allowed any privilege and preferential treatment for him.The said stone chair is now used by ordinary vacationers of the camp.Rodong Sinmun At the Yonphung Scientists Holiday Camp on the picturesque shore of Lake Yonphung in the DPRK, there is a stone chair telling about the popular traits of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un.In October Juche 103(2014), the Supreme Leader visited the completed holiday camp and came to see an elegant stone chair at its vineyard resting place.After being told that soldier-builders made this special chair of granite weighing hundreds of kilograms, with wish that he would relieve his fatigue even a little at the camp, the Supreme Leader sternly reproved the officials, asking if it is a throne for whom. title: 1st Round of Tree Sapling Production Finished After Inauguration
body: The North Hamgyong Provincial Tree Nursery built in the Jungphyong area has finished first-round sapling production in the sapling greenhouse.Over two million saplings of various species like Kumya Black Pine and Larix lepolepis are being moved to its outdoor adaptation site at present.The nursery has opened up a prospect for producing 20 million saplings a year. title: Waging Cultivation of Oil-bearing Plants on an All-people Scale

title: Tree Nursery Newly Built in North Hwanghae Province
body: A modern base for producing saplings has been newly built in North Hwanghae Province. title: Pak Pong Ju Inspects Several Units
body: Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, inspected several units.Walking round several projects now under brisk construction for establishing the C1 chemical industry, Pak Pong Ju gave a pep talk to builders who are devoting themselves to the struggle for putting the chemical industry on a Juche and modern basis.The field consultative meeting discussed in detail such issues as speeding up the construction and the manufacture of equipment and installations, pushing ahead with the building of different production processes in a comprehensive way and enhancing the sense of responsibility and role of designing and construction units.During his inspection of the steel shop at the Chollima Steel Complex, he called for ensuring the normal operation of UHP electric arc furnace and paying due attention to supply service for workers and their labor safety.At the Songyong Paint Factory, he took measures to fully produce and supply paints necessary for different sectors of the national economy. title: Research Intensified for Putting Cultivation of Grass on Scientific Basis
body: Scientists and officials of the Pyongyang Turf Institute are actively engaging themselves in researches to put turf cultivation on a scientific basis.Scientists intensified researches into acclimatizing turfs of superior species so as to perfect “Namsan” No. 1 of Poa pratensis breed.They also selected new turf species with strong resistance to drought.Based on the experience gained when title: WPK, Motherly Party for Korean People
body: The people in the DPRK heartily trust in and follow the Workers’ Party of Korea (WPK), calling it the motherly party.This call would have been unthinkable without the immortal feats of Chairman Kim Jong Il who built the WPK into a genuine motherly party winning the unreserved support and trust of the popular masses.At every opportunity, the Chairman, who devoted all his life to the people would ask the officials to always pay heed to the voice of people and become a servant faithful to the people meeting their demands and relieving their anxieties and sufferings in time.Visiting the Samsu Power Station under construction in March Juche 95(2006), he told that the people’s interests should be always placed at the center of officials’ thinking and action. And he showed deep care for the living conditions of inhabitants to be evacuated from its vicinity, saying that people’s livelihood is more urgent than electricity output and better and modern houses for the inhabitants should be built before their evacuation.When leaving the construction site, he earnestly instructed officials to hasten the construction of power station and dwelling houses for inhabitants simultaneously.After all, modern houses for to-be-excavated thousands of families were successfully built along with the construction of power station.That’s why the Korean people have followed the WPK with deep trust all the time.Rodong Sinmun The people in the DPRK heartily trust in and follow the Workers’ Party of Korea (WPK), calling it the motherly party.This call would have been unthinkable without the immortal feats of Chairman Kim Jong Il who built the WPK into a genuine motherly party winning the unreserved support and trust of the popular masses.At every opportunity, the Chairman, who devoted all his life to the people would ask the officials to always pay heed to the voice of people and become a servant faithful to the people meeting their demands and relieving their anxieties and sufferings in time.Visiting the Samsu Power Station under construction in March Juche 95(2006), he told that the people’s interests should be always placed at the center of officials’ thinking and action. title: New Koryo Therapies Applied in Treating Diseases
body: In recent years, medical institutions in different parts of the DPRK have applied new Koryo therapies, making successes in treating patients.A carbon light therapy device is effective in treating women’s diseases like mastopathy. The treatment by carbon light gives no mental or physical burden to patients.The newly-made ointment shortens the date in treating burn and trauma.A combination of medicamental acupuncture therapy and manual technique therapy is efficacious for lumbar slipped disk.A method of checking the state of stomach acidity secretion by saliva, too, is valued for its high accuracy in treating digestive troubles.Rodong Sinmun In recent years, medical institutions in different parts of the DPRK have applied new Koryo therapies, making successes in treating patients.A carbon light therapy device is effective in treating women’s diseases like mastopathy. title: There Is No Statute of Limitations to Heinous Crimes
body: Pak Hui Chol, department head of the Law Faculty of Kim Il Sung University, said that the crime of the human scum who faulted our supreme leadership and those who connived at it is the most serious crime which should be condemned and mercilessly punished. title: New Species of Goldfish Bred
body: Scientists in the field of fish farming of the DPRK succeeded in breeding a new species of goldfish.This goldfish crossbred with carp is called “Namgang-1”. It weighs over 30 grams in the year of its hatching and 100-200 grams in the next year. Its growth speed is 1.3 times faster than native goldfish and survival ratio is twice higher than carp.It can be raised with other species of fishes and its productivity per hectare is three times that of native goldfish. It has less fine bones.Kim Tong Hak, head of a department of the Fish Farming Management Bureau under the Ministry of Fisheries, told that the new species of goldfish is now reared at breed-fish station, fish farm and other units.Rodong Sinmun Scientists in the field of fish farming of the DPRK succeeded in breeding a new species of goldfish.This goldfish crossbred with carp is called “Namgang-1”. title: Taedonggang Beer Factory
body: Taedonggang beer is one of the famous products popular among citizens of the DPRK. The beer is mass-produced at the Taedonggang Beer Factory, which brews seven flavors of beer with domestic raw materials suited to the demands of consumers. A computer integrated manufacturing was established at the factory with an annual production capacity of tens of thousands of tons. Chairman Kim Jong Il visited the factory in June Juche 91(2002), stressing the need to steadily work on researches so as to produce best Korean-style beer with unique taste. The factory has all the necessary conditions for acquiring the advanced internal and external sci-tech data, and its employees have taken an active part in inventing new technologies. Nearly 1 500 technical innovations were applied to the production in the last 10-odd years and more than 200 employees won certificates of inventions last year alone. Thanks to the sustained efforts of its employees, the factory’s products obtained the Dec. 15 Quality Medal which is awarded to the best domestic products. Foreigners from various countries including China, Russia, Germany, Switzerland and the United Kingdom expressed their admiration at Taedonggang beer. title: Mirim Barrage, First of Its Kind in DPRK
body: In the DPRK, the Mirim Barrage is the first comprehensive hydraulic structure built across the Taedong River. It has played a big role in providing water for farming, allowing boats and cars to travel, producing electricity, protecting Pyongyang City from flood, etc. over the last 40 years. The Mirim Barrage Office is now ensuring the water control on a higher IT and scientific level based on the real-time data transfer system and automatic control system for floodgate via computer network. It raised vessel traffic capacity by realizing the automatic control of lock chamber operation. The Mirim Barrage was built in a matter of one year and a half from October Juche 67(1978), under the wise guidance of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. The President set a site for its construction on the spot and gave important instructions on such project-related matters as designing, organization of construction force and supply of building materials. Later, he frequented the barrage under construction to settle knotty problems. The Chairman energetically guided the barrage construction to complete it wonderfully. In the wake of the Mirim Barrage, such modern barrages appeared along the Taedong River one after another as the world-leading West Sea Barrage and Ponghwa, Songchon and Sunchon barrages. title: S. Korean Bodies Urge Authorities to Stop Hostile Acts
body: According to the south Korean Yonhap News, the People for Achieving Peace and Reunification held a press conference outside Chongwadae to demand that the authorities put an end to hostile acts against the DPRK. title: South Korean Authorities Urged to Take Responsibility for Destroying Inter-Korean Relations
body: Civic organizations of south Korea reportedly released statements on June 17 denouncing the south Korean authorities for having plunged the inter-Korean relations into a catastrophe. No matter how good an agreement is, there would be neither confidence-building nor fruition without its implementation, a civic organization in South Kyongsang Province noted in a statement. The agreement between the south and the north is not for propaganda of the "government" but is the commitment it made to the era and the nation and it is its due responsibility to implement it, it held. It urged the "government" to keenly reflect on its evasion of responsibility. A civic organization of Changwon in a statement accused the "government" of having engrossed in hostile acts against the north, far from implementing its agreement with the north. The organization called for putting an end to the U.S. interference in south Korea's internal affairs and determining the destiny of the nation by dint of the candlelight action, stressing that the destiny of the nation can not be left to the current impotent and weak-willed "government". title: Preliminary Meeting for 5th Meeting of 7th WPK Central Military Commission Held
body: A preliminary meeting for the fifth meeting of the Seventh Central Military Commission of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) took place through video conferencing on June 23. Kim Jong Un, chairman of the WPK and chairman of the WPK Central Military Commission, presided over the meeting. Attending the preliminary meeting were Ri Pyong Chol, vice-chairman of the WPK Central Military Commission, and some members of the commission. The meeting examined agenda items of major military policy to be laid before the fifth meeting of the Seventh WPK Central Military Commission, and made a study of a report and decisions, which will be submitted to the fifth meeting, and some documents carrying the state measures for further bolstering the war deterrent of the country. At the preliminary meeting, the WPK Central Military Commission took stock of the prevailing situation and suspended the military action plans against the south brought for the fifth meeting of the Seventh Central Military Commission by the General Staff of the Korean People's Army. title: Dissolution of Conservative Party Called for in South Korea
body: The Progressive Federation of Students of south Korea, the People's Sovereignty Solidarity and a political party of south Korea held a press conference in front of the building of the "United Future Party" (UFP) denouncing the conservative opposition party for going against the public mindset. The speakers said that the UFP supports the reckless anti-DPRK leaflet scattering by "defectors from the north" and is clamoring for strengthening alliance with the U.S. to push the Korean peninsula into a maelstrom of war. They also said that the UFP is making desperate efforts to hold the position of permanent chairman of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee of the "National Assembly" while spreading the suspicion about fraudulent election and disturbing the establishment of the office for investigation into corruption of public officials. Stressing that only the dissolution of the UFP will prevent the repetition of the history characterized by its acts against the public mindset, they published a statement saying that the UFP must be thrown overboard. title: S. Korean Authorities Accused of Reneging on North-South Agreement in S. Korea
body: Civic and public organizations launched a struggle in protest against south Korean authorities who have reneged on the north-south agreement, according to the south Korean Internet newspaper Tongil News. The Seoul committee for the promotion of the August 15 meeting for national independence held a press conference outside Chongwadae on June 20, where it expressed its will to wage a struggle until the "government" rejects the foreign forces and takes practical measures for mending the south-north relations. A press release signed by 172 organizations of south Korea was read out. It urged the "government" to take the responsibility for failing to implement the south-north agreement. It stressed that the "government" should quit the south Korea-U.S. working group, put an eternal end to the south Korea-U.S. joint military exercises and punish the organization of "defectors from the north" which scattered anti-DPRK leaflets and its conspirators. The participants held a press conference again outside the U.S. embassy in Seoul, urging the U.S. to dissolve the working group and stop its interference in the south-north relations. title: Kim Jae Ryong Inspects Chemical Industrial Units in South Hamgyong Province
body: Premier of the Cabinet Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and member of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, inspected the chemical industrial sectors and relevant units in South Hamgyong Province. Visiting the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex and the February 8 Vinalon Complex, Kim Jae Ryong learned in detail about the project for enlarging the production capacity, the construction of new production lines and the production of chemical goods like carbide and caustic soda and vinalon. At the Hamhung Branch of the State Academy of Sciences, he underscored the need to further raise the sci-tech guarantee and economic effectiveness of C1 chemical industry by constantly furthering research work. Looking round the Ryongsong Machine Complex and the Kumya Youth Coal Mine, he called on the relevant units to fulfill their responsibility and duties in producing custom-built equipment needed for fertilizer production and coal. The field consultative meetings discussed the measures to further accelerate the research for developing the chemical industry, which is the foundation of industry and the major thrust front in the national economy, and to provide equipment and materials needed for the gigantic chemical industrial bases and ensure transport. title: Foreigners Pay Congratulatory Visits to DPRK Missions
body: Delegations of political parties and personages of various circles in different countries visited the DPRK missions in their countries in the period between June 10 and 18 on the occasion of the 56th anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's start of work at the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. They laid floral baskets and bouquets before the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. Among them were the delegation of the Funcinpec Party of Cambodia, the director of the Central Secretariat of the Pakistan People's Party, a Nepalese lawmaker, the chairman of the Nepal Journalist Association for the Study of the Juche Idea and Songun Politics, the chairman of the Study Forum for Self-Reliance of Nepal, the chairman of the Nepalese Association for Supporting the Songun Politics and the chairman of the Nepali Literary Forum for the Study of Songun Politics. title: U.S. Forces in S. Korea Blamed for Preparing Germ Warfare on Korean Peninsula
body: The South Kyongsang Provincial Headquarters of the south Korean Confederation of Trade Unions held a rally outside a U.S. naval base in Jinhae Port of Changwon City, South Kyongsang Province of south Korea on June 20 to denounce the U.S. military for preparing germ warfare on the Korean peninsula, according to the south Korean internet newspaper Tongil News. The speakers blamed the U.S. military for scheming to deploy germ warfare units in Seoul, Pusan, Taegu, Waegwan, Changwon and other places of south Korea. Disclosing the danger of germ warfare projected by the U.S. military, they called on the public to campaign against it. Accusing the U.S. of pressurizing south Korea into paying more money for the upkeep of GIs in south Korea and interfering in its internal affairs, they called for the withdrawal of U.S. forces from south Korea. title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Birthday Spread to Pro-reunification Patriotic Fighter
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Wednesday sent a birthday spread to Ri Kyong Gu, a pro-reunification patriotic fighter, on his 90th birthday. Ri, born into a peasant's family in Kongju of South Chungchong Province, underwent the sorrow of statelessness. He boundlessly revered President Kim Il Sung who liberated Korea. During the Fatherland Liberation War, he joined the volunteers' corps and performed meritorious services. He was arrested by the enemies but undauntedly fought against them in the face of all sorts of torture for 37 years. Chairman Kim Jong Il saw to it that he was repatriated to the Republic and awarded the title of hero of the Republic, the National Reunification Prize and other state commendations. Thanks to Kim Jong Il he was treated as a man strong in faith and will. Kim Jong Un invited him as delegate to the celebrations of the 100th birth anniversary of the President, the 4th National Conference of War Veterans, the Seventh Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea and other events, and has taken care of him, so that he can enjoy a worthy life full of energy despite his advanced age. title: Korean People Pay Homage to War Martyrs
body: The immortal exploits President Kim Il Sung performed by leading the Fatherland Liberation War to victory and the great feats of the martyrs in the war are shining along with the great victory in the 1950s. title: Pak Pong Ju Inspects Several Units of National Economy
body: Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, inspected several units of national economy.Walking round several production processes of the Sunchon Cement Complex, Pak Pong Ju called for dynamically conducting the technological innovation movement, enforcing the socialist system of responsible business operation in a realistic way and thus obtaining more successes in production.At the field consultative meeting, he discussed measures for directing steady efforts to the revitalization of production and completing the ongoing project for expansion of production capacity as early as possible.Learning about the remodeling of the Kumsong Tractor Factory and the Sunchon Heat Insulating Materials Factory, he underscored the need to ensure both speed and quality in construction, and called on relevant units to supply building materials in a responsible way.Meanwhile, Pak Pong Ju learned about the cultivation of wheat in the Samjigang Co-op Farm of Jaeryong County and the Paeksok Co-op Farm of Sinchon County, and stressed that the manuring and cultivating of crops should be meticulously carried out for increased yield. title: Okryu Mineral Water in Pyongyang
body: Okryu mineral water gushing out from under the Taedong River bank all the year round is in great demand among citizens in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK. This mineral water containing chlorine, calcium bicarbonate, sodium, iron, etc. is efficacious for chronic gastritis, chronic enteritis and colitis, chronic bronchitis, diabetes and hypertensive disease. It is associated with the loving care of Chairman Kim Jong Il. In May Juche 76 (1987), the Chairman was very glad to hear about the discovery of the mineral water and said that it should be used for the improvement of the people's health. And he personally named it "Okryu Mineral Water” and saw to it that a spring resort was built in good harmony with scenery of the Taedong River for the people’s convenience. title: Jangchon Vegetable Cooperative Farm
body: The Jangchon Vegetable Cooperative Farm in Sadong District, Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, plays a big role in improving the citizens' diet. The farm consisting of 100-odd blocks of semi-vaulted and vaulted greenhouses has produced hundreds of tons of vegetables per hectare annually through 4-6 cropping. It also produces 100-odd more tons of vegetables by installing plastic baskets and column tubes in spaces of the greenhouses. Among the cultivated vegetables are new species of nutritive vegetables like mallow, tanbaekcho and chive. The modernization of the farm would have been unthinkable without the devoted efforts of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. In June Juche 103 (2014), the Supreme Leader went round various places of the farm to learn in detail about vegetable farming. The farm is associated with the traces of President Kim II Sung and Chairman Kim Jong II who had always worked heart and soul to provide the citizens with fresh vegetables. He gave detailed instructions on developing the vegetable cultivation technology, providing vegetable seeds and raising the productivity by putting the greenhouse vegetable cultivation on a scientific and intensive basis of higher level. And he took a revolutionary step to turn the farm into a better socialist cultural village. The farm is now taking the lead in the country's greenhouse vegetable production. title: Pyongyang International Football School
body: It has been seven years since Pyongyang International Football School, situated on the scenic Rungna Islet in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, began its operation. Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un visited the school in June Juche 102 (2013) and gave an instruction on applying the scientific methods and means into teaching as it is a specialized sports school training reserve football players. And he showed loving care for its students’ learning and living conditions. At the school, boy and girl students aged between 7 and 17, selected from across the country, are getting general and practical educations. Over the past years, they bagged nine gold medals and trophies and eight silver medals at international games, including the AFC U-14 Girls’ Regional Championship 2016 for East Zone. And 20-odd students won the prizes of best player, top scorer and best goalkeeper. From 2017，more than 100 students (40 percent of them girls) graduated from the school through four terms. Most of the graduates are now active at April 25 Sports Team, Kigwancha Sports Team, Amnokgang Sports Team, Pyongyang Sports Team and other sports teams of the country. They have drawn the attention of football experts and fans for their good performance at domestic and international games. title: Kim Jae Ryong Inspects Posan Iron Works and Pyongyang Construction Machine Plant
body: Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, member of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and premier of the Cabinet, made a field survey of the Posan Iron Works and the Pyongyang Construction Machine Plant.Making a round of the revolving furnace shop of the iron works, he called for managing equipment and improving technical control as required by the technical rules. He also underscored the need to save as many materials as possible with a viewpoint that economy leads to increased production, urging party organizations to inspire the masses to revitalizing production.At the machine plant, he called for raising the proportion of domestically-produced accessories in the production of machinery and equipment and making a positive introduction of advanced science and technology in the production by meticulously operating sci-tech learning space.The consultative meetings held on the spots discussed the practical matters arising in decisively raising the level of putting the production processes on a scientific basis and fully supplying the machinery and equipment necessary for the building of dwelling houses in Pyongyang City. title: Large Number of White Birches Planted in Samjiyon City

title: A Hero Medal of an Ordinary Woman
body: On June 17, Kim Chun Hwa, a managerial staff member of the Hoean Youth Coal Mine of the Pukchang Area Youth Coal-mining Complex, was awarded the title of DPRK Labor Heroine.For 30-odd years she has taken devoted care of her husband, a blind, armless and one-legged special-class disabled soldier. She brought up her two sons well so that they can be the officers of the Korean People's Army. She is a trustworthy supply service worker of her coal mine. She has actively helped the KPA and is respected by numbers of its soldiers as their mother.A model for all the people of our times, she motivates them to reflect on their view on life plus their history. title: Kim Jae Ryong Inspects Construction Sites in Pyongyang City
body: Premier of the Cabinet Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and member of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, inspected various construction sites in Pyongyang City.Looking round the construction sites in the area of Tongsan-dong in Rangnang District, he underscored the need to ensure the structural quality and the building speed at the highest level by enhancing the responsibility of the units in charge of construction and leading officials and by taking measures to supply materials.He also urged the officials to pay deep attention to the living of the people who moved to the newly built apartment houses and solve their problems in time so that they would not feel any slightest discomfort.Acquainting himself with the construction of a new building of Ryongmun Primary School in Ryongsong District, he took a measure for tackling the problems arising in finishing the project by the fixed date. title: Historical Relics in Mt Taesong
body: Around Mt Taesong in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, there are lots of historical relics showing the might and culture of Koguryo Kingdom (B.C. 277-A.D. 668).Among the relics are Taesongsan Fort, the ruins of Anhak Palace and Kwangbop Temple, together with mural paintings registered as a world cultural heritage.They have been preserved with deep care as national treasures under the policy of the Workers’ Party of Korea and the government for protecting the national heritages.The historical relics in Mt Taesong are associated with the devoted efforts made by the peerlessly great men to glorify the national heritages.Kwangbop Temple is a Buddhist temple erected by Kwanggaetho, the 24th king of Koguryo, in 392. This temple was completely destroyed due to the enemy’s indiscriminate bombing in the last Fatherland Liberation War (1950-1953).In Juche 78 (1989), President Kim Il Sung gave an instruction on restoring the temple to its original state. title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Birthday Spread to Centenarian
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un sent a birthday spread to Ra Pan Wol, a centenarian residing in neighborhood unit No. 43, Unbyol-dong, Sariwon City.She, born into a poor peasant's family, had keenly felt the sorrow of statelessness, being subjected to all kinds of maltreatment and contempt, before the liberation of the country.It was only after President Kim Il Sung liberated the country that she came to lead a worthwhile life as a human being. She had long worked as an agricultural worker honestly with a single mind to repay the great loving care shown by President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il with increased grain production.After becoming a pensioner, she did not stop working to assist the People's Army, and gave a sincere help to the road improvement project in the city.She specially likes soy-based foods and vegetable and has enjoyed a life in good health, while cultivating kitchen garden.Rodong Sinmun Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un sent a birthday spread to Ra Pan Wol, a centenarian residing in neighborhood unit No. 43, Unbyol-dong, Sariwon City.She, born into a poor peasant's family, had keenly felt the sorrow of statelessness, being subjected to all kinds of maltreatment and contempt, before the liberation of the country.It was only after President Kim Il Sung liberated the country that she came to lead a worthwhile life as a human being. title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Greetings to President of Cape Verde
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), Sunday sent a message of greeting to Jorge Carlos Fonseca, president of the Republic of Cape Verde.Kim Jong Un in the message extended warm congratulations and friendly greetings to the president, the government and people of Cape Verde on behalf of the government and people of the DPRK on the occasion of the 45th anniversary of its independence and the proclamation of the republic.The message said that the people of the DPRK are pleased with huge progress and development made by the people of Cape Verde in building an independent new society in the past period, and sincerely wished them greater success in their future work for the prosperity of the country.The message expressed title: Waterway Tunnel and Dam Construction Actively Stepped Up at High Speed
body: Officials and builders of Kangwon Province are pushing forward construction of major projects as befits the creators of the new spirit of the times.After having finished the construction of high-capacity Ichon Army-People Power Station they went on to push forward the construction of Kosong, Phyonggang, Sepho, Hoeyang and Munchon army-people power stations.In the last one month alone, they cut through thousands of meters of waterway tunnels and coated them with concrete, piled up over a hundred thousand cubic meters of earth for dams and covered hundreds of square meters of them with stones at the construction sites.Meanwhile the construction of the dams is actively assisted on a provincial scale. title: Potato Sorter of High Efficiency Produced
body: Recently the Management Bureau of Farm Machine Industry under the Ministry of Agriculture manufactured a high-performance potato sorter.The sorter can sort or select large amounts of potatoes per hour.Officials of the management bureau had set an aim to send an effective potato sorter to Samjiyon City before the 2nd anniversary of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un’s visit to the Junghung Farm in the city and scrupulously organized the work.Together with researchers of the Farm Machine Institute and workers and technicians of the Haeju Farm Machine Factory, they also decided to manufacture a potato-seed sorter and a potato loader by themselves and carried out the work in a bold way.Thanks to their collective efforts, the high-performance machines were finally completed.These machines were highly appreciated by officials and agricultural workers of Samjiyon City in their test-run on the spot. title: DPRK Premier Inspects Several Fields of National Economy
body: Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, member of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, made a field survey of various fields of national economy.Making rounds of different places of the Chonsong Youth Coal Mine including mechanic shop and coal miners' dwelling houses under construction, he stressed the need to meticulously organize the management of the coal mine on the basis of a correct economic calculation, make maximum use of internal reserves and pay deep attention to the living of coal miners.The field consultative meeting urged the relevant units to provide the coal mine with equipment and materials in time and discussed in detail the practical issues of increasing the existing production capacity of the coal mine as early as possible.Learning about the Pyongyang Pharmaceutical Factory under remodeling construction, he called upon officials and builders to put production processes on a germ-free and dust-free basis, ensure the best quality in construction and complete the project before the set time, being aware of the importance of the project in implementing the Party's policy of public health.Meanwhile, he also inspected the Haeju Tractor Accessory Parts Factory and the Hungsan Mine. title: President Kim Il Sung Praised by Foreign Body, Figures
body: A British organization and Russian figures made public statements in the period between July 1 and 3 on the occasion of the 26th anniversary of the demise of President Kim Il Sung.The British Association for the Study of Songun Policy in its statement said that Kim Il Sung was a great leader of the international socialist movement and a renowned elder statesman.The statement said that he liberated Korea, once eclipsed in the world map, and built an independent and strong socialist state, adding that he made a great contribution to the accomplishment of the cause of independence title: Our-Style Creative Spirit Demonstrated in Struggle to Implement the Instructions of the Leader
body: Dressing Plant No. 3 of the Komdok Mining Complex has been renovated into an energy-, labor- and land-saving one equipped with a process of concentrating lead and zinc ores with our-style pneumatic floatation machine.The technical renovation of its concentrating process has made it possible to bring great profits to the country every year by raising the actual concentration rate by over 2% while reducing the usage of installation area, electricity and labor by half as against the previous days and markedly lowering reagent consumption norms.At the 17th presentation of the February 16 Science and Technology Prize held in June, this project of the Central Mining Institute of the State Academy of Sciences and the Komdok Mining Complex was awarded the top sci-tech prize of the country.Better still, scientists of the Central Mining Institute and a technical worker of the Tanchon Mining Machine Factory who played a pivotal role in fulfilling this project received the February 16 Science and Technology Prize. title: Pak Pong Ju Inspects Pyongyang General Hospital under Construction
body: Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, inspected the construction site of the Pyongyang General Hospital.Making rounds of different places of the construction site, he called on officials to meet the requirements of designs and building operations in the whole course of construction by enhancing their responsibility and role without resting on their laurels.While learning about the introduction of advanced construction methods, he stressed the need to maximize the work efficiency by deploying manpower rationally and ensuring timely supply of materials, as required by the project being pushed forward in a comprehensive way.The field consultative meeting urged the construction coordination commission and the units in charge of construction to map out detailed plans for every process and properly tap manpower, equipment and materials in order to step up the construction of the hospital.Meanwhile, he inspected the Songyo Knitwear Factory and the Pyongyang Hosiery Factory. title: President Kim Il Sung’s Great Life Devoted to People
body: The revolutionary life of President Kim Il Sung is woven with his ardent love and devoted efforts for the country and the people.It was November 9, Juche 57(1968).Early in the morning, the President left Pyongyang to visit a local chicken farm. He appreciated the farm for having over-fulfilled its annual meat and egg production plan and gave an instruction to increase the meat and egg production by building more chicken coops.The next leg of his field guidance was a dairy cattle farm. At this farm, he organized a consultative meeting of officials concerned to indicate the tasks and ways for improving the people’s livelihood.Without a short rest, he continued his field guidance and had to take his late lunch on the running car.Arriving in Pyongyang, he examined the winter clothes and shoes for schoolchildren and kindergarteners at the building of the Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea and told officials to make well-fitting uniforms.Then he went round various parts of Pyongyang City to learn about the situation of the city’s heating system and gave important instructions in regard to the citizens’ living conditions.When the night was far advanced, he came back to his office and began his writing on the transport and labor administration.As seen above, his whole life was a continuation of such days for the country and the people.Rodong Sinmun The revolutionary life of President Kim Il Sung is woven with his ardent love and devoted efforts for the country and the people.It was November 9, Juche 57(1968).Early in the morning, the President left Pyongyang to visit a local chicken farm. title: Opening Avenue of Unit’s Development by Consolidating the Foundation for Prosperity with Stockbreeding
body: Haean Restaurant in Rason City is famous for its noodle and stockbreeding.Its stockbreeding base, located several kilometers away from the city, breeds large numbers of domestic animals of various kinds including chicken, turkey, sheep, pig, goat, goose and duck.It solved the feed problem with thorough establishment of a ring-shaped rotation production system.As it persistently carried out stockbreeding, it made it possible to maintain regular supply of meat and eggs for its employees.Besides, it rebuilt service facilities for the employees like the bathhouse and improved its service condition and environment.Better still, it meets its own requirement for raw and other materials for cooking on the principle of self-reliance and self-support.Reality of Haean Restaurant is a vivid proof of the correctness and vitality of our Party’s policy on "grass for meat". title: By Introducing Advanced Method into Exterminating Noxious Insects

title: Great Life Devoted to People
body: President Kim II Sung had always regarded himself as the son of the people and their servant.His pleasure was to provide the people with affluent and cultured life.On a summer day of Juche 61 (1972) marking his 60th birthday, the President went to Sinpho Port after hearing that a cold-storage factory was built there. And he learned in detail about its refrigerating capacity and equipment, staying at a quick-freezing space for a long time.When officials worried about the health of the President in summer attire, he said that one should not hesitate to go through fire and water for the sake of the people.In his lifetime the President made a ceaseless journey of the countryside, taking much pains to develop the country's farm work. On one day of August 1993 alone, he visited five farms in South Hwanghae Province to give instructions on farming.At a consultative meeting of senior officials in the economic sector held in the last days of his great life, he heard from an official a report on the completion of supply of new clothes to kindergarteners and schoolchildren across the country. He was so happy that he repeatedly expressed thanks to the official.Indeed, President Kim II Sung is the tender-hearted father of the people as he devoted his all to them, finding his pleasure in their happiness.Rodong Sinmun President Kim II Sung had always regarded himself as the son of the people and their servant.His pleasure was to provide the people with affluent and cultured life.On a summer day of Juche 61 (1972) marking his 60th birthday, the President went to Sinpho Port after hearing that a cold-storage factory was built there. title: President Kim Il Sung Commemorated across Country
body: All the people and service personnel of the People's Army across the country have commemorated President Kim Il Sung on July 8, the greatest national memorial day.The national flag was hoisted at half-mast in different parts of the country on the occasion.Working people, service personnel and youth and students visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun where President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il lie in state, and made a bow in the humblest reverence before the portraits of the smiling great leaders.People and service personnel paid floral tribute to the statues of the President and the Chairman on Mansu Hill and their statues and the portraits of their smiling images in other parts of the country.Documentary films dealing with the great personality of the President, the founder of socialist Korea and the father of the Korean nation, and his undying revolutionary feats were aired.Watching such documentary films as "Our Leader" and "Finding Himself among the People All His Life", officials, Party members, working people and service personnel recollected with deep emotion the great exploits that the President had performed by dedicating himself to the people's body: The Thaechon Breed-fish Station has succeeded in breeding young mandarin fish.Its mandarin-fish-workteam has discharged over 15, 000 young mandarin fishes into Lake Thaechon in late June.Last year Thaechon County built a modern mandarin fish breeding base with an indoor spawning pond and ten fishponds in an area of more than 10,000 square meters.Therefore it produced over 30, 000 young mandarin fishes till the beginning of June this year. title: Free Education and Upbringing of Korean Children Urged in Japan

"program for free education and upbringing of children" to the kindergartens of Korean schools in Japan.Since the kindergartens of Korean schools in Japan were excluded from the "program" application title: Koreans in China Mark 26th Anniversary of Demise of President Kim Il Sung
body: The General Association of Koreans in China and its affiliated organizations held events on Wednesday, the 26th anniversary of demise of President Kim Il Sung.A ceremony took place to lay a floral basket before the statue of the President at Yuwen Middle School in Jilin. title: Preparatory Work for Sea Urchin Farming Brisk in DPRK
body: Preparatory work for sea urchin farming is brisk in fishery stations on the east coast of the DPRK.The North Hamgyong Provincial Fishery Management Bureau has made a survey of mineral resources to secure the waters favorable to sea urchin farming. It has also overhauled the existing breeding grounds to lay material and technical foundations for sea urchin farming.Officials and technicians of the fishery stations in Kim Chaek and Ryonjin have developed effective cultivating methods suiting the biological features of sea urchin.Fishery stations under the South Hamgyong Provincial Fishery Management Bureau are also active in sea urchin farming.Fishery stations in Rakwon, Soho and Hongwon, the Kyongpho Cultivation Fishery Station and other fishery stations have created an environment for breeding sea urchin and laid a firm foundation for the farming.Several fishermen's cooperatives in South and North Hamgyong Provinces have also remodeled their culture grounds to ensure combined farming of sea urchin and trepang.Rodong Sinmun Preparatory work for sea urchin farming is brisk in fishery stations on the east coast of the DPRK.The North Hamgyong Provincial Fishery Management Bureau has made a survey of mineral resources to secure the waters favorable to sea urchin farming. title: DPRK Premier Inspects Chollima Steel Complex
body: Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, member of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, inspected the Chollima Steel Complex.Making a round of the steel shop, he gave a pep-talk to smelters waging a drive for increased production and stressed the need to thoroughly meet the technical requirements in normal operation of the electric furnace and production.At the 6 000-ton press shop, he stressed the need to direct primary efforts to ensure the quality of iron and steel and took measures to enhance the responsibility and role of officials and technicians and thus manage all production processes, as required by technical regulations.He also inspected the Biomedicine Institute under the Academy of Medical Science and the Bioengineering Branch of the State Academy of Sciences. title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Birthday Spread
body: to Pro-Reunification Patriotic Fighter Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un sent a birthday spread to Kim Un Hwan, a pro-reunification patriotic fighter, on his 90th birthday.Kim Un Hwan keenly experienced the grief at statelessness in his early years. After the liberation of Korea, he worked as a day laborer in Seoul and greatly admired the northern half of the Republic where a new life was blooming.During the Fatherland Liberation War, he was a brave fighter in the volunteer army. In the post-war period he was arrested by enemy while struggling for national reunification. title: Pak Pong Ju Inspects Construction Site of Project for Establishing C1 Chemical Industry
body: Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, inspected the construction site of the project for establishing the C1 chemical industry.Walking round the construction site, he discussed with officials such issues as dynamically conducting the on-site political work to give full play to the revolutionary enthusiasm of builders and making detailed plans for the construction and providing meticulous guidance to it.He called upon scientists and technicians to rationally arrange production processes on the basis of scientific calculations, and upon construction directors to enhance their sense of responsibility and role for high quality of construction.Meanwhile, he inspected the Sunchon Phosphatic Fertilizer Factory and the Aeguk Compound Microorganisms Fertilizer Factory in Sunchon City. title: Rest Days of Great Man Devoted to People’s Wellbeing
body: President Kim Il Sung of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea devoted all his life to the people’s wellbeing.In December Juche 52(1963), the President had to stay in North Hwanghae Province to take a rest for 10-odd days, under a decision of the Political Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea Central Committee.But he went round Rinsan and other counties of the province to acquaint himself in detail with the living conditions of peasants and came back to Pyongyang. Some days later, he saw to it that a Cabinet decision was adopted to supply all the children and students across the country with padded clothes and caps free of charge.In September 1973, too, the Political Committee of the C.C., WPK adopted a special decision that the President should rest for one month.But he visited a co-op farm on the first day of his “vacation” and spent several days guiding the work of a dockyard and having discussion on the affairs of North Phyongan Province with its leading officials. Then he stopped his rest and returned to Pyongyang.The President told officials that it is rest for him to talk with workers and peasants and take care of their livelihood and see their happy looks.Indeed, his revolutionary career was run through with warm love and devoted service for the people.Rodong Sinmun President Kim Il Sung of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea devoted all his life to the people’s wellbeing.In December Juche 52(1963), the President had to stay in North Hwanghae Province to take a rest for 10-odd days, under a decision of the Political Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea Central Committee.But he went round Rinsan and other counties of the province to acquaint himself in detail with the living conditions of peasants and came back to Pyongyang. body: The officials and builders of the North Phyongan Provincial Tideland Reclamation General Enterprise successfully carried out the blasting of 200,000 cubic meter earth at the second-stage construction site for reclaiming Honggondo tideland.Through the successful blasting, a huge amount of earth and stone was secured for speeding up the final works at the section 2 in the second-stage construction site.Rodong Sinmun The officials and builders of the North Phyongan Provincial Tideland Reclamation General Enterprise successfully carried out the blasting of 200,000 cubic meter earth at the second-stage construction site for reclaiming Honggondo tideland.Through the successful blasting, a huge amount of earth and stone was secured for speeding up the final works at the section 2 in the second-stage construction site.Rodong Sinmun Through the successful blasting, a huge amount of earth and stone was secured for speeding up the final works at the section 2 in the second-stage construction site.Rodong Sinmun Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Baskets to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un
