body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received floral baskets from Jin Xian, director of the Board of Directors ofthe Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation, and Zhan Xueyan, member of the foundation, on July 14 on the occasion of the 8th anniversary of the conferment of the title of the DPRK Marshal on him.Rodong Sinmun Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received floral baskets from Jin Xian, director of the Board of Directors ofthe Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation, and Zhan Xueyan, member of the foundation, on July 14 on the occasion of the 8th anniversary of the conferment of the title of the DPRK Marshal on him.Rodong Sinmun the Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation, and Zhan Xueyan, member of the foundation, on July 14 on the occasion of the 8th anniversary of the conferment of the title of the DPRK Marshal on him.Rodong Sinmun Rodong Sinmun

title: When Persistently Pushing Ahead with Stockbreeding by Rousing Masses
body: The Kimhwa Taehung Mine is known as a unit which has overfulfilled its national economic plans annually. One of its secrets is that it improved supply service for its employees by making success in stockbreeding. The mine raises hundreds of livestock including pigs and goats every year. Last year, it contributed to improving living conditions of employees by producing a lot of meat and goat milk. Now the mine is pushing forward the construction of a sheep stock farm. Hong Song Chol

title: Continuous Aid to Countryside
body: Ministries and national institutions are inspiring farmers by frequently acquainting themselves with problems arising in work of farms across the country and solving them in time. They sent living necessities as well as fuel, fertilizer, tractor wheels and other small farm implements to the countryside, helping hasten immediate farm work. They also sent a lot of supplies and building materials to face-lift farms and improve the living condition of farmers. Choe Yong Jo

title: Exterminating Noxious Insects in Biological Way
body: Officials and farmers in Onsong County are taking thorough measures to exterminate noxious insects in order to minimize the damage in this year’s farming and make further achievements. In particular, they are putting efforts into exterminating noxious insects with the help of Trichogramma. In this work they preferentially set the right time to discharge Trichogramma. They let the preliminary surveyors heighten their responsibility and role in observing nits on maize leaves. O Un Byol

title: After Working Out a Foresighted Plan in Detail
body: Officials and agricultural workers in Ryongchon County are concentrating efforts on taking thoroughgoing measures to cope with the rainy season in conformity with its regional characteristics. Not a few farms are situated on the River Amnok. Agricultural workers are striving to provide a guarantee for adequately supplying rice paddies with good growth conditions and increasing crop yields by properly managing rice-paddy irrigation despite unfavorable conditions of the rainy season. Rodong Sinmun

title: Photos and Art Pieces Depicting President Kim Il Sung Newly Displayed
body: Several photos and art pieces bearing the image of President Kim Il Sung have newly been displayed at the Fatherland Liberation War historic site to convey to posterity his undying exploits of leading the war to victory. It is the site of the Supreme Headquarters of the Korean People’s Army in the war days which bears immortal feats of the President who defended the destiny of the country and sovereignty of the nation. Myong Ju Hyok

title: Editorial
body: Officials Should Set Their Ideals and Ambitions in Keeping with Party’s Plan Our Party requires that officials set ideals and ambitions in keeping with the Party’s plans and fully perform their duties as standard-bearers and the vanguard in implementing the Party policy. All officials should become faithful servants of people who set ideals and ambitions in keeping with the Party’s plans. They should become competent organizers and stubborn practicians who make persistent efforts to carry out every undertaking of their sectors and units perfectly at the standard demanded by the Party. They should fully display devotion and self-sacrificing spirit in the struggle to implement the Party’s plans. They should steadily improve their practical abilities and widen their horizon. It is important to enhance the role of party organizations to the maximum. Officials should invariably walk along the road of making selfless, devoted efforts for the people to the end, regarding it as a pride of life and moral obligation to become foundations for the happiness of people.

title: Reply Message to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from President of Mongolia
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), received a reply message from Khaltmaa Battulga, president of Mongolia, on July 12. The Mongolian president in the message expressed his sincere thanks to the Supreme Leader for sending warm congratulations on the occasion of the 99th anniversary of the victory of the Mongolian people's revolution, a national holiday. The message said that the historic and traditional relations of friendship and cooperation between Mongolia and the DPRK have grown strong under the care of the preceding leaders of the two countries. Expressing the will to steadily develop the relations in steady cooperation with the respected Supreme Leader in the interests of the peoples of the two countries, the message wished the respected Supreme Leader good health and happiness and the friendly Korean people prosperity. Rodong Sinmun

title: Trustworthy Intellectuals at Hamhung University of Chemical Engineering
body: and Hungnam Fertilizer Complex Prof. and Dr. Pak Kon Sik and Ju Hyon Su, teachers of the Hamhung University of Chemical Engineering, and Kye Chun Guk, a senior engineer of the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex, have recently received the February 16 Science and Technology Prize, the top sci-tech prize of the country. They have successfully devised a method of effectively treating waste gas using raw materials abundant in our country and introduced it into the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex. Thanks to their painstaking studies and devoted efforts, another scientific and technological guarantee has been provided for preventing pollution and protecting people’s health. Kang Chol Ung

title: Improving Teachers’ Qualifications and Training Reserve Athletes
body: In recent years the Mangyongdae District Juvenile Sports School has made achievements in training reserve athletes. It tried to develop scientific training equipment and programs and introduce new training methods in order to heighten the qualifications of teachers. Last year many students of this school clinched tens of gold medals in a national game and were picked out for various sports teams. Ju Ryong Bong

title: How They Converted Useless Ore Residue into Treasure
body: In recent years, mines in various areas have recycled particle tailings which were piled in concentration plants. A tungsten mine gets a lot of economic benefits from producing tungsten ore from piles of tailings. The success comes from the rotating disk mechanical picker introduced by scientists of the Ferrous Metal Mining Research Institute. They are true patriots who convert everything on this land into treasures. Ryo Myong Hui

title: Technical Remodeling and Overhauling of Major Production Process Progress Apace
body: The Chollima Steel Complex is briskly hastening the technical reconstruction and overhauling of important production lines. Technical reconstruction of the refractory production process is in full swing. According to data available, around 95% of the foundation work for installing refractory production facilities has been completed. The complex is boldly braving difficulties and hardship arising in the technical reconstruction and overhauling. Jo Kwang Song

title: Feats of Heroes Will Shine Forever with Great History of
body: Victorious Fatherland Liberation War In the last Fatherland Liberation War, more than 600 heroes were produced among our people and fighters of the Korean People’s Army. Among them are 5 Twice Heroes of the Republic and 13 Heroines of the Republic. Also included are 18 Labor Heroes and 2 Labor Heroines. The wartime heroes include scores of teenagers including Hero Ri Su Bok who opened a way for the unit’s charge by blocking the enemy's gun muzzle with his breast. Over 420 of the heroes were in their twenties while the number of heroes in their thirties and forties totals to more than 100. Thanks to President Kim Il Sung who trained all the service personnel and people as heroes, they could defeat the imperialist aggressors by means of superior political idea, strategy and tactics in the Fatherland Liberation War and wrote a heroic epic of proud victory in the history of the country. Myong Ju Hyok

title: By Applying High-efficiency Plant Activation Accelerant
body: The Kumsong Coop Farm in Onchon County has made success in wheat farming. The key lies in conducting wheat farming on a scientific and technological basis including introducing a plant activation accelerant. The farm applied manure and exterminated noxious insects on a scientific basis and thus further increased the wheat production per hectare. A workteam of the farm produced quadruple the production of wheat per hectare as against the last period. And the farm produced many high-yield farmers. Yun Yong Ho

title: Full Preparation for Initial Manure Proves Effective
body: The Sangsan Coop Farm in Kowon County overfulfilled the wheat production plan per hectare. Its officials put efforts into preparing initial manure as well as choosing proper soil in consideration of biological characteristics of wheat. On this basis, wheat was planted in a scientific way. Kim Song Chol

title: Efforts Concentrated on Improving Fertility of Soil
body: Workteam No.5 of the Janggyo Coop Farm in Kangnam County cropped a bumper harvest in wheat farming as an earlier crop this year. It is because large amounts of quality organic fertilizer were applied. After finding a rational method to provide an organic fertilizer source, they concentrated labor and transport means on it and organized the work in a scrupulous way in conformity with its reality and thus markedly increased the organic fertilizer production. O Un Byol

title: Mosaics Depicting Images of Peerlessly Great Persons Erected
body: in Various Units in Kaesong City “Bumper Crop”, a mosaic depicting the images of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il has been erected at the Phyonghwa Co-op Farm in Phanmun District and Uipho Co-op Farm in Kaephung District of Kaesong City. Also erected in the Haeson Vegetable Co-op Farm of Kaesong City is a mosaic depicting the tender images of the great leaders who had carried on their journey for field guidance on people-bound trains for the prosperity of the country till the last moments of their lives. So Nam Il

title: Progressive Working Attitude Seen through Technical Innovation Competition
body: In recent years the Sunchon Thermal Power Station has made a lot of technological innovations conducive to its management and operation and increased production of electric power. What draws attention all the more is the fact that workers assume a big proportion of those innovators. One of its secrets is a technical innovation competition organized by the power station. The Sunchon Thermal Power Station vigorously pushes forward the work to normalize the production and strengthen its own talents force by converting the technical innovation competition into the work of workers themselves. An Song Hyok

title: Project for Establishing a Geothermal Cooling and Heating System Progresses Apace
body: A project for establishing a geothermal cooling and heating system is being accelerated on a full scale at the construction site of the Pyongyang General Hospital. According to news from the spot, excavation for open caisson No. 1 has been concluded and that of other places is also progressing apace. Meanwhile, laying geothermal water pipes has been completed. On July 12, the pipeline system was tested successfully. Sim Hak Chol

title: Genuine Patriotism Reflected in His Hydraulic Turbine Design
body: Over 4 decades ago Han Il Sok was assigned to the Taean Heavy Machine Designing Institute under the Taean Heavy Machine Complex after his graduation from a college. Since then has he designed a lot of small and large hydraulic turbines. His biggest happiness is to hear the news that hydraulic turbines designed by him run well in large and minor power stations across the country. It is admirable that one has long worked in an occupation. What is all the more important is how one works for the Party and revolution, country and people. This is eloquently illustrated by Han Il Sok’s 40-year-long career as a designer. Kim Jin Uk

title: Trustworthy Mechanization Worker
body: Ryu Ki Yong is a rural mechanization worker of the mechanized sub-workteam of the Pukpho Coop Farm in Thosan County. He is a pride of the farm, Since he volunteered to work as a tractor driver 30 years ago with an ambition to turn his village into a socialist fairyland, he has devoted his efforts and enthusiasm to his job. He always carries out his undertaking in a responsible way with a view to cropping bumper harvest. Rodong Sinmun

title: Genuine Feature of Our Society Overflowing
body: with Excellent Morality and Tender Feelings It is our Party’s plan and determination to suffuse the whole society with excellent morality and tender feelings and build it into a people’s paradise and a harmonious socialist society of our style. In our society, the whole country has formed a large family united around the leader and people are all like real brothers and relatives. The fact that our socialist society is replete with beautiful and noble deeds of helping and caring for one another and is firmly united with good morality and tender feelings constitutes the absolute superiority and vitality of our-style socialism which no other country can imitate. True features of our society harmonious with moral excellence and tender feelings find their expression in the fact that all the people regard it as a revolutionary obligation to repay the leader’s love and trust with loyalty. They are also expressed in the fact that everyone is overcoming ordeals and difficulties with revolutionary comradeship and moral obligation. Today, the revolutionary comradeship and moral obligation of our people are being displayed on a lofty level. Indeed, the mightiness of our ever-prospering country is thanks to the great army of laudable persons who devote sincerity to those with troubles, those left behind others and those with worries without seeking any compensation or reward. So Song Bom

title: Many Textile Mill Workers Finish Yearly Economic Plan in DPRK
body: Many textile mill workers have finished their yearly economic plan in the DPRK. According to statistics, a hundred and dozens of workers have carried out their yearly economic plans ahead of schedule by early July. More than 30 workers of the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill have finished their yearly economic plans. With increased textile machines and amid a hot wind of collective emulation, 18 workers of the September Textile Mill have implemented their yearly economic plans. And the number of such workers is on the increase. 21 workers of the Sinuiju Textile Mill, 43 of the Sariwon Textile Mill, 28 of the Kusong Textile Mill and 20 of the Hamhung Woolen Mill have carried out their yearly economic plans. Getting stronger is enthusiasm of the workers in the field of textile industry to glorify the 75th anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea with proud successes. Rodong Sinmun

title: Important Historical Milestone for Development of DPRK-Russia Friendly Relations
body: Today marks the 20th anniversary of the publication of the historic DPRK-Russia joint declaration. On the invitation of Chairman Kim Jong Il, Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation, visited the DPRK in July, 2000, which was the first visit of a state leader of Russia to our country. In this period, significant meetings and summits were held between Chairman Kim Jong Il and President Putin and the DPRK-Russia joint declaration was made public. The joint declaration reflects the demand and will of the governments and peoples of the two countries to incessantly augment and develop the DPRK-Russia friendly and cooperative relations. It provided an important milestone for developing in depth the traditional DPRK-Russia friendship as required by the new era. Since the publication of this historic document, the friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries have ceaselessly developed. Chairman Kim Jong Il paid deep attention to developing the friendly relations between the two countries based on the joint declaration and visited Russia several times. Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un paid great attention to invariably carrying forward the DPRK-Russia friendly relationship provided by the great leaders and developing it continuously and constructively to a new higher level. Thanks to the energetic external activities of the Supreme Leader, the friendly and cooperative relations between the peoples of the two countries, which have been handed down through centuries and generations, are getting closer day by day. The deep-seated DPRK-Russia friendly relations will further develop in the future, too, in accordance with the interests of the two peoples. Jong Won Jun

title: Editorial
body: Let Us Take Thorough Measures to Prevent Damage from Flood, Heavy Rain and Storm To take thoroughgoing measures to prevent damage from flood, heavy rain and storm is an important work for protecting the life, property and safety of people and defending the national resources and successes of socialist economic construction. All officials and working people should organize and carry out this work in a responsible way mindful that it is not a simple practical undertaking but an important political affair to uphold the people-first politics of our Party and defend the gains of the revolution. The entire party, the whole country and all people should wage a dynamic campaign to prevent the damage from occurring in the rainy season. Agricultural field should run in the van of this work. The irrigation field should not only put big efforts into repairing the reservoir dams and facilities but also manage the sluices in a responsible way taking into consideration the rainfall and reservoir capacity. All fields and units of the national economy should prevent flood damage and thus normalize the production. The construction sites of major objects including the Pyongyang General Hospital should take measures to prevent materials and facilities from being damaged. The provinces, cities and counties should conduct the work to protect the land as a mass movement. The hydro-meteorological field should observe the weather well and ensure the scientific character, exactness and quickness of weather forecast. All fields and units should always pay deep concern to weather forecasts and organize the necessary work in time.

title: Campaign for Application of Aid Program to Korean Schools Goes On in Japan
body: Koreans in Japan are waging campaigns across Japan to demand the application of "program for free education and upbringing of children" to the kindergartens of Korean schools in Japan. In Ibaraki, Fukushima and other places, those concerned of Korean schools and Japanese citizens submitted during their campaign a letter of request signed by 34 520 people affiliated to the organizations supporting the Korean schools and the mothers' groups of those schools to the Cabinet Office and the Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology of Japan and the Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare of Japan on July 14. Urging the application of the support program to Korean schools, the members of a request group at a press conference condemned the Japanese authorities for excluding the students of the Korean University even from the subsidy program related to COVID-19. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Guides Enlarged Meeting of
body: WPK Central Military Commission The Fifth Enlarged Meeting of the Seventh Central Military Commission of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) took place at the office building of the Central Committee of the WPK on Saturday. The meeting was guided by Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the Central Military Commission (CMC) of the WPK. Present there were Ri Pyong Chol, vice chairman of the CMC of the WPK, and members of the WPK Central Military Commission. Attending it were commanders and commissars of the services and corps of the Korean People's Army, commanding officers of the General Political Bureau, the General Staff and the Ministry of the People's Armed Forces, commanding officers of the armed forces organs at all levels and vice directors of major departments of the WPK Central Committee. The enlarged meeting discussed issues of intensifying the party's education and guidance of commanders and political officials of the people's army in line with the Party's idea and requirements after exposing a series of issues arising in political and ideological life of the commanding officers of the KPA and military affairs. The meeting stressed the need to thoroughly arm the young commanding officers of the KPA with the revolutionary idea of the WPK and indicated a concrete orientation and ways for it. An organizational matter was tabled at the meeting on dismissing or appointing commanding officers of major posts of the armed forces institutions. Then there was a closed meeting of the Central Military Commission of the Party to examine the strategic mission of the major units for coping with the military situation in the vicinity of the Korean Peninsula and the potential military threat and the alert posture and to discuss the key issues of further bolstering a war deterrent of the country. The meeting discussed and approved major key munitions production plan indices. The Supreme Leader signed the orders for carrying out key tasks that had been discussed and decided. The important measures taken by the Central Military Commission of the Workers' Party of Korea are a historic decision which makes it possible to more reliably guarantee the future of the Juche revolution with the reliable military muscle. Political News Team

title: Remains of Martyrs Buried in Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery
body: Remains of Heroes of the Republic Ryu Yon Gi, Pak Jong Sik, Kim Song Sop, Cha Ung Son, Chu Kyo Rak, Kim Yo Hong, Ri Thae Hwan and An Yong Sung were buried in the Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery with due ceremony on July 18 on the occasion of the 67th anniversary of the victory in the Fatherland Liberation War. Ryu Yon Gi and Kim Song Sop took an active part in the aircraft-hunting group movement in hearty response to the order of President Kim Il Sung. In May and June, Juche 40 (1951), they shot down over 10 enemy planes that had been engaged in bombing the areas along the front and in the rear. Pak Jong Sik, commander of a wing of night bombers, personally bombed enemy territory more than 30 times to destroy enemy combat and technical facilities and wipe out enemy manpower. The then scout Kim Yo Hong captured over 80 enemy soldiers by displaying boldness. They worked at the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum as lecturers under the loving care of the peerlessly great men. Cha Ung Son, Chu Kyo Rak and Ri Thae Hwan also performed brilliant feats in many battles and An Yong Sung made a great contribution to the victory in the war by carrying out the orders of the President to the last in the enemy rear. The remains of Kim Song Sop, Cha Ung Son, Ri Thae Hwan and An Yong Sung were buried in the cemetery and the remains of the wives of Hyon Su Yong, Pae Pyong Uk, Jo Su Hwan, Kwon Hyok Chang, Ro Sung Man, Kim Sang Hun, Jang Ryong In, Jong Man Yong, Pak Kwan Yong, Kim Ung Gi, Kim Yun Hyop, Jin Tae Song, Pak Hung Sin, Ri Su Jin and Kang Sung Hyon who had been buried in the cemetery were buried with their husbands. The participants in the ceremony placed bunches of flowers on the graves and paid a silent tribute to them. Rodong Sinmun

title: With Parental Affection
body: Officials and employees of the Rason Youth Hostel take care of the boarders with parental love. They provided ceremonial dress materials for wedding ceremonies of boarders. They also sincerely nursed them when they were ill. Besides, there are many other touching stories about their beautiful traits. Their laudable deeds convince us again that our society forms a harmonious family under the care of the motherly Party. Jon Hyok Chol

title: Normalization of Production Ensured with Securing Raw Materials
body: and Heightening Quality of Goods The Phyongchon Koryo Medicine Pharmaceutical Factory, which won the Twice Three-Revolution Red Flag, is an exemplary unit leading others across the country not only in its production but also in ensuring quality of the goods. It constantly stores enough raw materials for Koryo medicines even though it annually consumes scores of tons of materials of hundreds of species. This is unthinkable without foresighted planning and organizational work of its officials. What also draws attention in its development strategy is the development of new goods and the improvement of their quality. It has produced new Koryo medicines efficacious for liver protection and treatment with medicinal herbs. Brisk scientific research is being conducted in the factory by its own technical force to produce more Koryo medicines and health foods with new raw materials and steadily improve their qualities. Kim Song Min

title: In Order to Provide Fresh Occasion
body: for Improving Practical Qualifications of Lecturers Recently Cha Kwang Su Sinuiju University of Education No. 1 organizes in detail the work for improving qualifications of its instructors. It makes particular efforts for improving teaching and practical qualifications of the instructors on many occasions. Last year alone the university created over a hundred teaching methods and instruments based on modern educational technology and tens of its instructors received academic degrees or titles. The university students ranked high in recent national contests. This directly bears upon the improved abilities of its instructors. Rodong Sinmun

title: Top Priority Given to Ensuring Profitability
body: True to the Party’s intention of turning ours into a country of mushrooms, the Jangjagang Mushroom Farm is striving to increase production. It has made persevering efforts to solve the problem of substrate whose sources are limited. At the moment, it is turning out different kinds of mushrooms using sawdust. Furthermore, it produces a disinfectant by itself and applies it to mushroom production. Jon Myong Il

title: Proper Viewpoint Changes Manner of Work
body: Party members and other working people across the country as well as steel producers have turned out in response to the Party’s appeal for the metallurgical industry to rise up in today’s frontal offensive for making a breakthrough. Mindful that they are in the same trench with steel makers, Party members and other working people in provinces, cities and counties are channeling great efforts into collecting a lot of scrap iron and sending it to metallurgical factories. Experience of officials in several provinces who distinguished themselves in the first half-year assistance to the metallurgical factories indicates that only when one buckles down with a proper standpoint, can full play be given to one’s creativity and a turn be effected in one’s work attitude. Ri Chol Ok

title: Producing Quality Accessories with By-products
body: The Sinuiju Textile Mill is recycling not a small amount of packing plastic bands and packing films to produce different textile accessories. Its officials have buckled themselves to recycling every waste from the factory. A technical innovation team for establishing a recycled raw material production process was formed with technicians and was given a powerful boost. Therefore, the factory is producing plastic bobbins and other various accessories with waste materials to earn actual economic profits. Rodong Sinmun

title: Foundation for Leap Laid by Making Effective Use of Mountains and Streams
body: The Tanchon Goat Farm is achieving prosperity by its own efforts. It gains profits from making an effective use of mountains and streams. A newly-built milk processing shop has started production of various processed milk goods including yoghurt. Besides, it has built four small power stations which supply electricity to a tunnel-storehouse. Kim Song Chol

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Gives Field Guidance to
body: Pyongyang General Hospital under Construction Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, gave field guidance to the Pyongyang General Hospital under construction. He was greeted on the spot by Pak Pong Ju, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the WPK, Pak Thae Song, Kim Jae Ryong, premier of the Cabinet, and officials of the construction coordination commission. Touring the construction site, he highly appreciated the builders for their labor feats, saying that lots of things have been done so far and the construction has made exceptionally rapid progress despite difficult situation. After hearing a detailed report on the overall situation of the construction from the construction coordination commission on the spot, he pointed out serious problems in economic organization for the construction. He said that the construction coordination commission is organizing economy in a careless manner with no budget for the construction properly set up, yet. Noting that it is making a serious digression from the Party's policy in supplying equipment and materials to go against the intention of the Party which initiated the construction for the people and mapped out its operation, he severely rebuked it for burdening the people by encouraging all kinds of "assistance". Saying that the construction coordination commission failed to solve all the problems in conformity with the Party's policy line, he said in the strong terms that if such situation is left to go on, the noble plan and intention of the Party which initiated the glorious and worthwhile construction for the good of the people could be distorted and the image of the Party be tarnished. He instructed the relevant departments of the Party Central Committee to investigate the performance of the construction coordination commission as a whole and replace all the officials responsible and make strict referral of them. Pointing out that though the construction work of the hospital was being pushed ahead thanks to the patriotic zeal and devoted efforts of the builders and the working people in charge of equipment and materials, it was just at the beginning and there still were a lot of things to do, he stressed the need for the construction coordination commission to keep pace with the Party Central Committee and properly conduct detailed organization and operation for carrying out the decisions made at the 14th Enlarged Meeting of the Political Bureau of the 7th Central Committee of the WPK. Political News Team

title: 6th National Conference of War Veterans to Be Held in DPRK
body: The 6th National Conference of War Veterans is to be held here on the occasion of the 67th anniversary of the Korean people's victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War. Thanks to the noble intention and benevolent measure of the Workers' Party of Korea that has valued and put forward war veterans as the dedicated defenders of the country and revolutionary forerunners, the conference is to be held to congratulate all the war veterans across the country. The conference will serve as a significant occasion in glorifying the life of the war veterans and in carrying forward the history and tradition of war victory by arming the Korean people and the rising generations with the spirit of defending the country and the spirit of defending the revolution which were displayed in the 1950s. Rodong Sinmun

title: We Should Incessantly Aspire after and Create New Things
body: To always aspire to, study and create the new with an innovative insight is a shortcut to cementing our own independent and internal motive forces and accelerating the socialist construction. The present era calls upon us to compete with and outpace the world. If a new thing ends merely as an academic issue or in a sketch and fails to make a tangible contribution to improving the people’s living standard and building a powerful socialist country, it is no more than an empty talk. If something is, though not big, good for the people and conducive to the prosperity of the country, it is just the one that is necessary for us and valuable as a new thing. Our Party urges us to always consider whether it is good for the people and the country, when doing anything, and to create many valuable things conducive to the people’s wellbeing and the prosperity and development of the country. When all sectors and units aspire to the new and conduct a fierce research and creation campaign, always placing the issues of people’s living and state’s benefits above all, bigger strides will be made in improving the people’s standard of living and building a powerful socialist country. Ri Kang Ho

title: 506th Triplets Born at Pyongyang Maternity Hospital
body: The 506th triplets were born at the Pyongyang Maternity Hospital of the DPRK on July 17. The triplets’ birthrate of this year is higher as compared with the same period of last year. The births of ten-odd triplets have been witnessed until now. All mothers pregnant with triplets of the country get special treatment at the Pyongyang Maternity Hospital. In the DPRK, women with triplets or more are to receive preferential treatment under such laws as the Public Health Law, the Law on Protection of Women’s Rights and the Law on the Nursing and Upbringing of Children. Triplets and quadruplets are supplied with nutritive foodstuffs and clothes free of charge for a given period by the State. Under the state measures, a subsidy is offered to those children until they reach school age and certain medical workers are put in charge of the health of the children and their mothers. Rodong Sinmun

title: President Kim Il Sung’s Warm Love for Servicepersons Shown in Wartime
body: The great victory in the Fatherland Liberation War (1950-1953) would have been unthinkable without President Kim Il Sung’s trust and love for the servicepersons and civilians. During the war, the President had always shown deep care for the soldiers’ living conditions, regarding them as precious treasures. In one day of September Juche 40 (1951) when the fierce battles were going on to defend Height 1 211 on the east front, he called the commander of a Korean People’s Army corps active there on the phone and earnestly instructed him to take good care of the servicepersons’ life, providing them with hot meals and comfortable bed. And he sent to the front a large amount of beans and mackerels and taught in detail how to keep and cook them. In May 1951, he took a step to run frontline rest homes for servicepersons. In November that year, he issued an order of dispatching a KPA regiment to the enemy rear to rescue an 18 year-old soldier’s family and indicated detailed ways for the successful rescue operation. This news had been the limelight of world media at that time. Such paternal love of the President was the source of matchless bravery and heroism displayed by the KPA men and officers during the war. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Gives Field Guidance to
body: Kwangchon Chicken Farm under Construction Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, gave field guidance to the Kwangchon Chicken Farm under construction. He was accompanied by Vice-Marshal of the Korean People's Army Pak Jong Chon who is chief of the KPA General Staff, Army General Kim Su Gil who is director of the General Political Bureau of the KPA, and Jo Yong Won, Kim Yo Jong, Hyon Song Wol and Ma Won Chun who are officials of the Central Committee of the WPK. He was greeted by officials of the Kwangchon Chicken Farm construction headquarters on the spot. The Kwangchon Chicken Farm now under construction in Kwangchon-ri, Hwangju County, North Hwanghae Province according to the far-reaching plan of our Party is a modern chicken farm which will produce thousands of tons of delicious and quality meat and tens of millions of tasty and quality eggs every year. The respected Supreme Leader who is making painstaking efforts and devotion, always shouldering full loads for the prosperity of the country and the happiness of the people, personally initiated the construction of the modern chicken farm which would make a great contribution to significantly developing the poultry of the country. Saying that chicken farms in our country which are said to have been modernized are now backward as they are more than 20 years old, he made a decision for the Party to take direct charge of the construction of an icon farm which would be a model in modernizing all the chicken farms across the country, and then dispatched powerful force of builders affiliated to the Party and soldier builders. The builders turned out in hearty response to the people-first policy of our Party which prioritizes people and makes devoted service for them, thus making the achievements of almost finishing the construction work. Touring the construction site, the Supreme Leader learned in detail about the progress made in the construction. He expressed satisfaction over the fact that the huge project was successfully pushed forward and lots of work done in a short period, highly appreciating the labor achievements of the builders. The Kwangchon Chicken Farm being built to be a model in the poultry field should be standard in terms of its structure, to say nothing of equipment, he said, calling for building it at the maximum level to meet the scientific and technological needs. Saying that the Party is going to send a full set of the most advanced poultry equipment with the highest level of modernity, automation and intensification to the Kwangchon Chicken Farm, he repeatedly stressed the need to thoroughly ensure the quality of the construction to suit to the modern equipment. He instructed the officials to dynamically conduct political and economic organization to finish the project as scheduled. The construction of the chicken farm is what the Party had planned and has put lots of efforts to from a long time ago, and as it is a farm which the Party expects to make significant contributions to the dietary life of our people, the Party has paid deep attention to it, he said. He stressed that all the builders should be encouraged to fully display their loyalty and talents in the construction true to the noble intention of our Party. He also urged the need to make a three-dimensional push to turn the farms providing chicken feed to the Kwangchon Chicken Farm into icon units of the rural culture, and also to help the farming of those farms so as to make them advanced ones. He pointed out that operational units should staff the modern chicken farm with capable officials and scientists and technicians in the stock-breeding field and that the training of technicians should be carried out from now in a far-sighted way for them to satisfactorily operate the advanced equipment. He voiced his expectation and conviction that the builders would turn out in the worthwhile construction for turning into a reality the ideal of our Party to supply our children and people with much more delicious and nutritious meat and eggs and build the Kwangchon Chicken Farm as a wonderful farm. All the builders were greatly heartened by the Supreme Leader who put deep profound trust in them by visiting the construction site despite the mid-summer heat and by giving valuable teachings for pushing forward the project and by taking all necessary measures. They made a firm pledge to certainly make a report of completion of the project within the time set. Political News Team

title: Floral Baskets to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a floral basket from Cui Tongwen, honorary director of the Board of Directors of the Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation, on Thursday on the occasion of the 67th anniversary of the victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War. He received a floral basket from Osaka of the Citizens Solidarity Demanding Earlier Normalization of the Relations between Japan and the DPRK on the same day. Rodong Sinmun

title: Taegyedo Reclaimed Tideland
body: The Taegyedo Reclaimed Tideland on the shore of the West Sea of Korea is one of the DPRK's monumental edifices. In the tideland of 8 800 hectares there are rice fields, saltern, fish farm and reservoirs. This fascinating scene would have been unthinkable without the wise guidance of Chairman Kim Jong II. President Kim II Sung set a grand target on reclaiming hundreds of thousands of hectares of tideland on the west coastal area, saying that there are many tidelands in the area. True to his intention, the Chairman visited the construction site for reclaiming the Taegyedo tideland on several occasions to encourage its builders. The Chairman praised those builders as brave conquerors of sea and indomitable fighters with a single mind to implement the behest of the President to the end, and as performers of feats to be always remembered by the country and the people. In July Juche 99 (2010), he went round the reclaimed tideland and said that the work to enlarge the land, an eternal wealth of the country, is an important work for the welfare of all generations to come and prosperity of the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Heroic Feats Recorded in History of War Victory
body: Recorded in the first page of the DPRK’s history of the great Fatherland Liberation War (1950-1953) are the feats performed by soldiers of the security forces, who were reliably guarding the 38th parallel at that time. At dawn of June 25, 1950, the enemies launched a surprise armed attack on the DPRK all along the 38th parallel under their already worked-out war scenario. The soldiers of the DPRK security forces contained the attack of the enemies, superior in numbers, at all positions and posts and went over to a counteroffensive in cooperation with the units of the Korean People’s Army (KPA) in all directions. A captured enemy officer confessed as follows over the then combat situation: Soon after launching an attack, we met a strong counterblow from the DPRK security forces. The encounter on the 38th parallel at that time was the fiercest ever in the past ones. Their counterattack was so strong that all of us, officers and men, could hardly know what to do in that case, only stupefied with fear. As seen above, the DPRK security forces frustrated the enemies’ armed invasion at its beginning by displaying the popular heroism and matchless self-sacrificing spirit. Their heroic struggle played a decisive part in making an instant counterattack and in liberating Seoul, the stronghold of the aggressors, in three days after the start of the war. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Convenes Emergency Enlarged Meeting
body: of Political Bureau of WPK Central Committee Amid the intensified anti-epidemic campaign for thoroughly checking the inroads of the world's threatening pandemic, an emergency event happened in Kaesong City where a runaway who went to the south three years ago, a person who is suspected to have been infected with the vicious virus, returned on July 19 after illegally crossing the demarcation line. The anti-epidemic organization said that as an uncertain result was made from several medical check-ups of the secretion of that person's upper respiratory organ and blood, the person was put under strict quarantine as a primary step and all the persons in Kaesong City who contacted that person and those who have been to the city in the last five days are being thoroughly investigated, given medical examination and put under quarantine. The Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea convened an emergency enlarged meeting in the office building of the Central Committee of the WPK on July 25 as regards the dangerous situation in Kaesong City that may lead to a deadly and destructive disaster. Kim Jong Un, chairman of the WPK, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, was present at the meeting. Attending the meeting also were members and alternate members of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK. Present there as observers were members of the Central Emergency Anti-epidemic Headquarters. Party and administrative leading officials of the Cabinet, ministries and national institutions, members of the executive committees of provincial Party committees and senior officials of the leading institutions at provincial level were present in the video conferencing rooms as observers. Upon authorization of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK, Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un presided over the meeting. Despite the intense preventive anti-epidemic measures taken in all fields throughout the country and tight closure of all the channels for the last six months, there happened a critical situation in which the vicious virus could be said to have entered the country, the Supreme Leader said, adding that he took the preemptive measure of totally blocking Kaesong City and isolating each district and region from the other within July 24 afternoon just after receiving the report on it. To tackle the present situation, he declared a state of emergency in the relevant area and clarified the determination of the Party Central Committee to shift from the state emergency anti-epidemic system to the maximum emergency system and issue a top-class alert. He specified tasks for each sector to be immediately implemented by Party and working people's organizations, power organs, public security and state security institutions, anti-epidemic and public health institutions. The meeting unanimously adopted a decision of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK on shifting from the state emergency anti-epidemic system to the maximum emergency system. He instructed all the participants to immediately conduct follow-up organizational work to carry out the decision of the Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee in their fields and units, and party organizations at all levels and every field to ensure and guarantee the most correct implementation of the directions and assignments of the Party Central Committee with a sense of boundless responsibility, loyalty and devotion. He underscored the need to thoroughly maintain tough organizational discipline and ensure the unity in action and thinking throughout the Party and society, to keep order by which everyone absolutely obeys and moves as one under the baton of the Emergency Anti-epidemic Headquarters and the need for party organizations at all levels to perfectly perform their role and duty. Saying that everyone needs to face up to the reality of emergency, he appealed to all to overcome the present epidemic crisis by not losing the focus of thinking and action, practicing responsibility and devotion to be faithful and true to the leadership of the Party Central Committee, being rallied closer behind it so as to defend the welfare of the people and security of the country without fail. The meeting sternly took up the issue of the loose guard performance in the frontline area in the relevant area where the runaway to the south occurred, and decided that the Central Military Commission of the WPK would get a report on the results of an intensive investigation of the military unit responsible for the runway case, administer a severe punishment and take necessary measures. Political News Team

title: Cadres and Senior Officials Visit Lodging Quarters of
body: Participants in 6th National Conference of War Veterans Cadres of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and senior officials of armed forces organs visited the lodging quarters of the participants in the 6th National Conference of War Veterans on July 25. Among the visitors were Vice-Chairmen of the C.C., WPK Ri Il Hwan, Choe Hwi and Pak Thae Song, Department Director of the C.C., WPK Choe Pu Il and vice-department directors. They also included Army General Kim Jong Gwan, minister of the People's Armed Forces, and other senior officials of armed forces organs. The visitors conferred participation certificates on the war veterans and congratulated them who are leading a happy life full of energy despite their advanced ages under the care of the mother party. They explained in excitement that it became possible to hold the conference thanks to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, who put forward war veterans as excellent revolutionary forerunners, showing warm love for them. Learning whether there wasn't any inconvenience for the aged war veterans during a long journey by plane, train and bus, the visitors had a talk with them in a warm atmosphere. The participants in the conference could hardly repress their emotional feelings before special loving care lavished by the Supreme Leader upon them, and earnestly asked to hold Kim Jong Un in higher esteem for the sake of the eternal prosperity of socialist Korea and happiness of posterity. Rodong Sinmun

title: Participants in 6th National Conference of War Veterans Arrive Here
body: War veterans arrived here on Saturday to participate in the 6th National Conference of War Veterans to be held on the occasion of the 67th anniversary of the Korean people's victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War. They left for Pyongyang by plane, train and bus being sent off by officials of the Party and power organs and working people. Before leaving, they laid floral baskets and bouquets at the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and mosaics picturing their smiling images in their residential places and paid tribute to them. People across the country warmly congratulated the war veterans who were leaving for the conference of honor with orders and medals reflective of immortal exploits pinned on their clothes. The participants in the conference, upon arrival, were warmly greeted by senior officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Citizens in the streets waved their hands to the war veterans with respect for them. They arrived at the April 25 Hotel, their lodging place, where they were kindly welcomed by its officials and staff members. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Confers "Paektusan" Commemorative Pistols on Leading Commanding Officers of DPRK Armed Forces
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme Commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, conferred "Paektusan" commemorative pistols on leading commanding officers of the armed forces of the DPRK on the occasion of the 67th anniversary of the Korean people's victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War. A grand conferring ceremony took place at the building of the headquarters of the Party Central Committee on Sunday afternoon. The Supreme Leader came to the venue of the ceremony. All the participants made a salute of best wishes to the Supreme Leader who is opening up the great heyday of building the revolutionary army of the Party with his gifted military wisdom, outstanding military idea, superb strategy and refined commanding art. Present at the ceremony were KPA Vice Marshal Pak Jong Chon, who is chief of the KPA General Staff, commanding officers of the services and corps levels units of the KPA, director of the Defence Department of the KPA, minister of State Security, minister of Public Security, chief of the Guard Command, director of the Guard Department, chief of the Guard Section, director of the Guard Department of the State Affairs Commission and other leading commanding officers of the armed forces at all levels and members of the executive committee of the KPA Committee of the WPK. Cadres of the WPK Central Committee were also present there. At the ceremony, the Supreme Leader said that he would confer the "Paektusan" pistol, newly developed and produced by the workers of the munitions field of the country, on the leading commanding officers of the armed forces of the DPRK in commemoration of the great V-day. He continued that this is an expression of the great trust and expectation of the Party in the commanding officers of the new generation who would carry to completion the revolutionary cause of Juche by firmly holding the weapons of the revolution. He stressed the need for the commanding officers of the armed forces of the DPRK to prepare themselves to be genuine army revolutionaries with intense and truthful loyalty to the glorious Party and the state, to be those strong in ideology and faith armed with the monolithic ideology of our Party and the transparent revolutionary spirit and to be competent military activists proficient in the military ideology, theory and tactics of Juche. He directly conferred on the leading officers the significant commemorative pistols bearing his august name in token of his trust, convincing that they would remain intensely loyal to their missions before the Party, the revolution, the country and the people and keep to the path of the arduous revolution following the Party for the final victory of the revolutionary cause of Juche. The commanding officers who were honored to receive the commemorative pistols directly from the Supreme Leader chanted in unison their pledge of loyalty to Kim Jong Un and the WPK Central Committee, holding close to them the weapons of the revolution with which they would share their destiny in the stern road of decisive battles. They made solemn pledges, looking up to the Party flag, to hold close to their hearts the commemorative pistols conferred upon them by the Supreme Leader until their death and trust and follow the Marshal only and fulfill their sacred missions of defending the leader, the country and the people despite whatever changes in the world just as those fighters who went through the great anti-Japanese war and anti-U.S. war with the weapons of the revolution conferred on them by President Kim Il Sung and the commanding officers in the Songun era who stood firm guard over the forefront of defending socialism by holding the pistols conferred upon them by Chairman Kim Jong Il as the pillars of their faith and will. The Supreme Leader had a significant commemorative photo taken with the commanding officers who received the commemorative pistols. The participants held high the pistols and made firm pledges to fight for Kim Jong Un at the cost of their lives. They made a solemn oath to cherish the Party's trust and expectation all the time, direct all their efforts into turning the entire army into the elite forces and uphold the great cause of our Party with full military preparedness. Political News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Visits Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, visited the Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery to pay noble tributes to the fallen fighters of the People's Army on the occasion of the 67th anniversary of the Korean people's victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War. Supreme Leader of our Party, state and armed forces Kim Jong Un was accompanied by Vice Marshal Pak Jong Chon, chief of the General Staff of the Korean People's Army, and other commanding officers of the KPA. He laid a flower before the cemetery. He paid humble tributes to the heroes of the great years who defended the fatherland with costly sacrifice and laid a foundation of our powerful state. Saying that the undying feats of the defenders of the fatherland in the 1950s, who provided the valuable mental heritage of the revolution amid the flames of the hard-fought war, would shine long in history, he expressed belief that the heroic fighting spirit of the fallen fighters would be carried forward as the eternal soul of socialist Korea. Political News Team

title: Ethics of Our Society
body: The beauty of a social system lies in mental and moral traits of people in the society concerned. The beauty of our society finds its expression in the fact that all people are displaying the world of true ethics with a noble moral obligation towards the former generation of revolution. It is the ethics and national customs of our country to respect the former generation of revolution and devote themselves to them. There are countless people who become sons and daughters of war veterans and take good care of them. As there is a moral obligation toward the revolutionary forerunners our country has been able to enjoy victory and glory for a long historical period and our country is getting stronger generation after generation. Ri Chol Hyok

title: Precious Truth Taught by Historic Victory in Fatherland Liberation War
body: The victory won by our people in the Fatherland Liberation War still distinguishes itself as a military miracle unprecedented in the world war history. The historic war victory clearly proved the truth that the country and people led by the great leader are ever-victorious. President Kim Il Sung strengthened the Party organizationally and ideologically, firmly united all the people and service personnel around the Party to form a single political force and roused them to the struggle for defending the sovereignty of the country and nation. His matchless attacking spirit and iron courage, extraordinary military ideas and adroit strategies and tactics and original art of war served as a treasured sword for sure victory. Holding the ever-victorious iron-willed commander in high esteem, our Republic was destined for triumph. The historic war victory also verified that no force can match the people cherishing trust in and love for their own things. For our people, trust in their own things was precisely trust in the validity of their cause, the revolutionary cause led by their leader. They were possessed of an unshakable faith that they were sure to emerge victorious as long as they had the great President. Great dedication and matchless self-sacrificing spirit of all the people full of trust in and love for their own things reduced the aggressors to the miserable plight of forlorn wandering spirits. Today, Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, another peerlessly great man and ever-victorious iron-willed brilliant commander, is leading our revolution. Our people will reliably safeguard their precious socialist country and creditably accomplish the historic cause of building a powerful country in the fighting spirit of the victors of the great years, firmly rallied behind the Supreme Leader. Kim Yong Il

title: 6th National Conference of War Veterans Held
body: The 6th National Conference of War Veterans was held splendidly in Pyongyang at the April 25 House of Culture on Monday. Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, was present at the conference. War veterans and persons of wartime merits who displayed unrivaled bravery and self-sacrificing spirit out of boundless loyalty to the leader attended the conference. Present there were chairmen of provincial Party committees, officials of ministries, national institutions and armed forces organs, faculty members and students of revolutionary schools, and youth and students of Pyongyang. Amid the playing of the welcome music, Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un appeared at the platform of the conference with war veterans. All the participants raised stormy cheers of "hurrah!" in great reverence and trust in Kim Jong Un who represents the might and dignity of Juche Korea and the symbol of invincibility. Kim Jong Un warmly acknowledged the war veterans, genuine patriots who made an immortal contribution in the country's history of victory in the war. Seated at the platform were Choe Yong Rim, Yang Hyong Sop, Thae Jong Su, Ri Myong Su, Ri Yong Mu, O Kuk Ryol, Kim Si Hak and other war veterans who served as cadres of the Party and the state and senior officials of the armed forces organs for a long period. Also ascending the platform were Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, first vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, and Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the WPK Central Committee. Officials of the Party and state Ri Pyong Chol, Ri Il Hwan, Choe Hwi, Choe Pu Il, Ri Man Gon, O Su Yong, Jo Yong Won, Kim Yo Jong, Kim Yong Hwan, Pak Jong Nam, Ri Hi Yong, Kim Jong Ho and officials of working people's organizations took the platform. Together with them were Pak Jong Chon, Kim Jong Gwan and other leading officials of the armed forces organs. Kim Jong Un made a significant congratulatory speech at the conference. He extended warm congratulations to the war veterans who participated in the conference, all the participants in the Fatherland Liberation War and persons of wartime merits on the occasion of the 67th anniversary of the Korean people's victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War. He also paid noble tributes to the well-known and unsung revolutionary martyrs who dedicated their valuable lives to the sacred war for the country's reunification and independence and people's freedom and happiness and the fallen fighters of the Chinese People's Volunteers who set a genuine example of militant friendship while helping the Korean people in their revolutionary war at the cost of blood, and war veterans. Highly appreciating the heroic life of the generation who performed the undying feats and created the noble fighting spirit in the hard-fought Fatherland Liberation War true to the guidance of President Kim Il Sung, he expressed great belief that the war veterans would successfully hand down the spirit of the 1950s to the rising generation as the bloodline of faith. The participants in the conference were greatly excited by the congratulatory speech full of high appreciation, respect, noble comradely loving care and noble revolutionary obligation for the participants in the great Fatherland Liberation War. As soon as Kim Jong Un finished his speech, loud cheers of "hurrah!" resounded around the venue of the conference once again. All the participants extended the greatest glory and the warmest thanks to Kim Jong Un who holds up the war veterans as the honorable master who made the great history and laid a foundation of the independent power and bestows all sorts of benevolence on them. Kim Sung Un, hero of the Republic who is a lecturer of the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum, made a speech addressed to the rising generation. Saying that Kim Il Sung who is the national liberator and illustrious leader of new Korea meant the country and the pillar of faith for the Korean people and fighters of the People's Army during the days of the war, he stressed that the war veterans brought about July 27 of victory by fighting in the indomitable faith that they could never be deprived of the land and the thankful country liberated by Kim Il Sung and with a unique thought that they have to kill the enemy even though they might die one hundred times. Saying that the war veterans take pride in handing down the spirit of defending the country to the rising generation as a heritage, he expressed the absolute conviction that the DPRK would certainly win victories thanks to Kim Jong Un, the iron-willed commander. He stressed that our country would certainly win victory, asking the rising generation to uphold well Kim Jong Un who devotes himself for the people's dignity and happiness and believing, holding and following only our Party despite any trial, bearing in mind the spirit of defending the country and spirit of defending the revolution displayed in the 1950s as their faith. Then, Jo Chun Hyok, student of Kim Il Sung University, made a resolution speech on behalf of youths and Ji Yong Min, officer of the Korean People's Army on behalf of the service personnel. Speakers extended warm congratulations and militant salute to the war veterans who participated in the 6th National Conference of War Veterans, reflecting the mind of the youth and service personnel across the country. They said that the war veterans who honorably defended the dignity and sovereignty of the country from the imperialists' gangster-like invasion and handed down the indomitable spirit of defending the country as their valuable heritage are clearly kept in their minds as the model of true soldier. They stressed that they would become the youth heroes, who dedicate their lives for the sake of the Party, revolution and country by carrying forward the spirit and soul in the great era of winning victory in the war, and invariably and single-mindedly believe in and follow only our Party in any storm and stress. They made a firm resolution to devotedly defend the Central Committee of the Party headed by Kim Jong Un and implement the Party's policies in the van, bearing in mind that the history of winning victory in the war and victory of socialism are guaranteed only by the spirit of devotedly defending the leader. Kim Jong Un extended warm greetings to the war veterans across the country, warmly congratulating them once again upon performing the immortal exploits which would shine long in the history of the country. The 6th National Conference of War Veterans fully demonstrated the firm faith and will of our people and service personnel to add shine to the proud history and tradition, created and continued under the guidance of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, generation after generation under the leadership of Kim Jong Un and accomplish the cause of building a powerful socialist nation without fail. Political News Team

title: Fireworks Display Marks V-Day
body: Fireworks were displayed in Pyongyang on Monday, the 67th anniversary of the Korean people's victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War. Lots of people gathered in different parts of the capital city near the Tower of the Juche Idea, including Okryu Bridge and Taedonggang Bridge, to watch the fireworks. At 21:00 fireworks were shot off to form a five-pointed star as token of tribute of people to the victors of the great years in the sky above the Tower of the Juche Idea amid the playing of "Song of National Defence". The display of gorgeous multicolor fireworks seemed to represent the deep reverence of the people for President Kim Il Sung, an invincible and iron-willed commander who provided the history and tradition of eternal victory of heroic Korea by wisely leading the hard-fought Fatherland Liberation War. Fireworks of various shapes and colors were displayed in the nocturnal sky. Fireworks were set off in succession to the tune of the songs "Holiday of Great War Victory" and "We Will Defend General Kim Jong Un with Our Lives", revving up the festive mood. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Officials, working people and service personnel of the People's Army visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in different parts of the country on the occasion of the 67th anniversary of the Korean people's victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War. A floral basket sent by Kim Jong Un, supreme leader of the Party, state and armed forces of the DPRK, was seen before the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill. Placed before them were bouquets and floral baskets in the names of the Party, power and armed forces organs, social organizations, ministries, national institutions, units of the Korean People's Army (KPA) and the Public Security Forces (PSF) and institutions and industrial establishments at all levels and universities in Pyongyang. The visitors made a bow before the statues. Floral baskets in the names of institutions, enterprises and units of the KPA and the PSF were laid at the statues of the great leaders and mosaics of their smiling images in different parts of Pyongyang including Kim Il Sung University, Kim Il Sung Military University, the Ministry of the People's Armed Forces, the Ministry of Public Security and the Mansudae Art Studio. Officials, working people and servicepersons in other parts of the country visited the statues and mosaics of the smiling great leaders in their residential quarters to pay homage. Rodong Sinmun

title: Wreaths Laid at Statues and Cemeteries of Martyrs on V-Day
body: Wreaths were laid at the statues and cemeteries of martyrs, the memorial towers for fallen soldiers of the Korean People's Army and graves of martyrs across the country on Monday, the 67th anniversary of the Korean people's victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War. Taking part in the wreath-laying ceremonies were officials of local Party and power organs, working people's organizations, industrial establishments and farms, working people and service personnel of the Korean People's Army. Placed there were bouquets and wreaths in the names of local Party and power organs, etc. The participants paid a silent tribute in memory of the martyrs. Rodong Sinmun

title: All People Congratulate War Veterans on V-Day in DPRK
body: All the people in the DPRK celebrating the V-Day are extending their warmest congratulations to the victors of the great years. The war veterans across the country received foodstuffs and basic necessities reflecting the warm loving care of the Workers' Party of Korea. Officials of ministries and national institutions and officials in all provinces, cities and counties and working people visited the families of war veterans and persons of wartime merits to present flowers, health foodstuffs and tonics to them. They listened to the war veterans' stories of struggle, sang songs for them and congratulated them who are leading happy lives, full of energy despite their advanced ages, under the loving care of the motherly Party. Officials and employees of Pyongyang Glasses Shop visited the lodging quarters of the participants in the 6th National Conference of War Veterans to provide them with thousands of pairs of glasses. On this day, public catering facilities across the country served war veterans, persons of wartime merits and disabled soldiers with various national foods and dishes. Rodong Sinmun

title: Wreaths Laid before War Martyrs Cemetery on V-Day
body: The participants in the 6th National Conference of War Veterans laid wreaths before the Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery on Monday, the 67th anniversary of the Korean people's victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War. Present at the wreath-laying ceremony were Ri Il Hwan, Choe Pu Il, Thae Hyong Chol and Kim Il Chol, leading officials of the Party and the government, chairpersons of the provincial Party committees, students of the revolutionary schools and youth and students in Pyongyang. Also present were officials of the armed forces' organs including Kim Jong Gwan and service personnel of the People's Army. Placed at the cemetery were wreaths in the names of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK and the Cabinet of the DPRK. The participants observed a silent tribute in memory of the martyrs of the People's Army who dedicated their youth and life to the sacred war against the gangster-like armed invasion of the imperialists, true to the order of President Kim Il Sung. After laying flowers before the gravestones of martyrs, the war veterans recalled with deep emotion the worthwhile life of their comrades-in-arms who are enjoying immortality under the care of the Party. Sharing their inner thoughts with fallen fighters, they renewed their will to keep the flower of revolution in bloom as they did during the war and fulfill their duty as educators adding patriotic enthusiasm to the ranks of successors. All the participants confirmed their revolutionary determination to add glory to the history and traditions of ever-victorious Juche Korea in the transparent spirit of devotedly defending the country and the revolution shown by the victors of the great years, true to the guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Reception Given for Participants in 6th National Conference of War Veterans
body: The Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea hosted a reception Monday in honor of the participants in the 6th National Conference of War Veterans. Present at the reception on invitation were the participants in the conference including those war veterans who had worked at important posts of the Party, the state and the armed forces for a long time. The war veterans were greeted by officials and employees of the People's Palace of Culture, Okryu Restaurant, Chongryu Restaurant, Pyongyang Noodle House, general-service ship Mujigae and Pyongyang Koryo Hotel at the venues of the reception. Present there were Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, and Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK, vice-chairman of the SAC of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK. Joining them were leading officials of the Party and the government including Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK, member of the SAC of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, chairmen of the provincial Party committees and leading officials of the armed forces organs. At the reception speakers warmly congratulated the war veterans on their participation in the 6th National Conference of War Veterans. They said that Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un made a heartfelt speech in the conference and that the journey to Pyongyang from their residential areas in different parts of the country and conference schedule are associated with the noble moral obligation and warm care shown by the Supreme Leader for war veterans as he made sure that best measures were taken for their health and conveniences. There are a great number of war veterans across the world but it is only those of Juche Korea who have been respected as victors of the great years by the leaders and people all over the country generation after generation, they said. They asked the war veterans to take good care of their health to live long and help the new generations cherish the spirit of defending the country and the revolution displayed in the 1950s. They proposed a toast for good health of war veterans and happiness of their families. Rodong Sinmun

title: Participants in 6th National Conference of War Veterans Leave
body: War veterans who participated in the 6th National Conference of War Veterans held with splendor on the occasion of the 67th anniversary of the Korean people's victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War left here on Tuesday. Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un who values and treats war veterans as dear forerunners of the revolution personally attended the conference and made a congratulatory speech with high appreciation and respect for war veterans and also made sure that the congratulatory message of the Central Committee of the Party was sent to the war veterans greeting the V-Day so as to add luster to the feats performed by the participants in the Fatherland Liberation War in the history of the country. The war veterans on their way home with deep emotion and great joy of receiving warm loving care and trust by our Party were warmly sent off by employees of the lodging quarter. In the streets of the capital where the buses with the war veterans aboard passed, Pyongyangites waved their hands to the elder generations of the revolution who are enjoying the greatest honor and happiness under the benevolence of the mother party. Senior officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea warmly saw the war veterans off at Pyongyang International Airport and Pyongyang Railway Station. The participants in the 6th National Conference of War Veterans expressed their determination to fulfill their educators' role in handing down the spirit of defending the country and the revolution in the 1950s to the rising generation as the bloodline of faith, bearing in mind the deep intention of our Party hoping that they would serve as the eternal source of our strength and spiritual mainstay. Rodong Sinmun

title: Choe Ryong Hae Inspects Kwangchon Chicken Farm under Construction
body: Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, inspected the Kwangchon Chicken Farm under construction. Looking round the construction site, Choe Ryong Hae stressed the need for construction directors and builders to do the construction of structures in a responsible manner and scrupulously map out a plan and guide the work for finishing the project as scheduled. He referred to the detailed issues arising in the establishment of the drainage system in the rainy season, afforestation and greening and the pavement of roads. At the field consultative meeting, he called on all the officials and builders to ensure the quality of the construction at the maximum level to meet the scientific and technological needs, bearing in their minds the noble intention of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, and the relevant units to supply materials in time and conduct the preparations for operation in a far-sighted way. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives
body: Congratulatory Messages and Letters from Foreign Personages Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received congratulatory messages and letters from foreign personages on the occasion of the fourth anniversary of his election as chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
