body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a floral basket from Mahmoud Abbas, president of the State of Palestine, on the occasion of the 75th anniversary of the liberation of Korea. The floral basket was handed over to Foreign Minister Ri Son Gwon on Friday by Ismail Ahmed Mohamed Hasan, Palestinian ambassador to the DPRK. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Baskets Laid at Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Floral baskets were sent to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill by the family of Kim Sun Ok who is related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, Giancarlo Elia Valori, president of the International Group of Italy, and Luis Emilio Veintimilla Ortega, secretary general of the Ecuadorian Committee for Supporting the Independent and Peaceful Reunification of Korea, on the occasion of the 75th anniversary of Korea's liberation. They were laid before the statues on Friday. On the same day, Svetlana Odintzova, member of the Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation, sent a floral basket to the statues. Rodong Sinmun

title: Blasting of 300 000 Cubic Meter Earth Successful at Woldo Tideland
body: Workers of the North Phyongan Provincial Tideland Reclamation General Enterprise successfully carried out the blasting of 300 000 cubic meter earth in Woldo area. The successful blasting made a breakthrough in pushing ahead with the first-stage damming project in the District No. 1 of Woldo Tideland as planned. The officials and builders of the enterprise are working hard to register more successes, not resting on their laurels. Rodong Sinmun

title: Congratulatory Letter to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un
body: from Chongryon Central Standing Committee Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a congratulatory letter from the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) on Aug. 15, the 75th anniversary of Korea's liberation. The letter said that President Kim Il Sung is the hero of the Korean nation and the founder of socialist Korea who saved Korea, which had been deprived of its own colour on the world map, and built a full-fledged independent and sovereign state and a country whose people became its masters, adding that he has always been remembered by the world progressives as the most prominent leader in the 20th century and the sun of Juche for his undying feats for the Korean revolution and the cause of global independence. It said that Chairman Kim Jong Il regarded it as his lifetime mission to carry forward and accomplish the cause of Juche pioneered by President Kim Il Sung and turned the country into an invincible political and ideological power and a military power. As he took warm care of Koreans in Japan with paternal affection and reliably defended them with the treasured sword of Songun, Chongryon could demonstrate to the whole world its honor as a patriotic pioneer and a model of patriotism and loyalty and overseas compatriots organizations, it added. It said that Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un is adding luster and giving steady continuity to the proud history and traditions of the country liberated and glorified by the great leaders. The letter expressed the will to intensify the patriotic movement by putting spurs to the five-month intensive campaign for greeting "Chongryon Chapter Representative Conference-2020" (the third conference for a new heyday) with high zeal and achievements in work, keeping pace with the dynamic general advance of the people in the homeland who are all out in the offensive for making a breakthrough head-on to greet the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea with brilliant labor feats. The Chongryon Central Standing Committee in the letter sincerely wished the respected Supreme Leader good health, reflecting the intense loyalty and reverence of all the Chongryon officials and other Koreans in Japan for him. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Letter from C.C., AINDF
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a letter from the Central Committee of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front (AINDF) on Saturday on the occasion of the 75th anniversary of the liberation of Korea. The letter said that the national liberation achieved by President Kim Il Sung under the banner of independence, holding the bayonet of justice, was a noteworthy event which put an end to the dark history of occupation by the Japanese imperialists and brought about a radical turn in carving out the destiny of the country and the nation and in the history of the weak nations' struggle for liberation from colonial rule. The President, always finding himself among the people, turned the DPRK into the one and only ideal land centered on popular masses, and the dignified socialist power independent in politics, self-supporting in economy and self-reliant in defence, boundlessly admired and praised by the world people, with his outstanding leadership, the letter noted. The President advanced great programs, including the Three Principles of National Reunification, the proposal for founding the Democratic Federal Republic of Koryo and the ten-point programme of the great unity of the whole nation, to illuminate the path for independent reunification and lay a firm foundation for it, it pointed out. The President's precious feats and idea of patriotism were reliably carried forward and glorified by Kim Jong Il, chairman of the National Defence Commission who was born in Mt Paektu, and are now being translated into glorious reality by the guidance of Chairman of the State Affairs Commission Kim Jong Un, another peerlessly great man of Mt Paektu, it said. The letter expressed the will to more firmly consolidate the AINDF, which has adored and upheld Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il, to be an integral whole of loyalty that single-mindedly reveres Kim Jong Un only as the Supreme Leader of the nation. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Letter
body: from General Association of Koreans in China Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a letter from the General Association of Koreans in China on Saturday, the 75th anniversary of national liberation. The letter said: The great leader Generalissimo Kim Il Sung held aloft the arms for independence and the banner of national liberation on Mt Paektu, led the great war against the brutal Japanese imperialists to a victory and liberated the country from their colonial rule, thus bringing a new morning of national resurrection. He defeated a huge army of one million of the Japanese imperialists styling themselves the "leader" of Asia and set an example in the struggle for national liberation in colonies to be specially recorded in the world history by making public immortal classic works, advancing the Juche-oriented lines and inspiring all Koreans to a sacred war for national liberation. Vividly recorded in the 75 year-long history of our country is the sacred revolutionary career of the great Generalissimo Kim Jong Il who led socialist Korea to be ever-victorious by successfully carrying forward the idea and cause of the great Generalissimo Kim Il Sung. Today, our country is vigorously advancing toward the eminence of a powerful socialist nation under the experienced and sagacious guidance of the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un who is possessed of courage and pluck of Paektu as his gifts. The letter said that the General Association of Koreans in China would believe in and follow only Kim Jong Un and turn out in the dynamic patriotic movement for the country and the movement for national reunification in the face of any trials and difficulties, always remembering the warm loving care shown by the Supreme Leader for the general association. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Medical Supplies to Flood-hit Area
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un sent medical supplies to the people in Taechong-ri, Unpha County, North Hwanghae Province. A meeting took place in the county seat on Aug. 15, with the attendance of county officials, employees of the county people's hospital and inhabitants of Taechong-ri. Kung Hye Yong, chairperson of the Unpha County Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), made a conveying address. Referring to the fact that the Supreme Leader took the consecutive steps of love for the residents in the flood-stricken area and sent lots of medicines again, the chairperson ardently called for turning out as one in the recovery work and sprucing up the county wonderfully, and thus greeting the 75th birthday of the WPK with proud achievements. Then followed speeches. The speakers were determined to trust and follow only the Supreme Leader under any circumstances and become the patriotic peasants in the era of the Workers' Party who defend the revolution and socialism with increased production of rice. Rodong Sinmun

title: Plenary Meeting of WPK Central Committee to Be Convened
body: The Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea decided to convene the 6th Plenary Meeting of the 7th Central Committee of the WPK on August 19 in order to discuss and decide on an issue of crucial significance in developing the Korean revolution and increasing the fighting efficiency of the Party. A relevant decision of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee was announced on Monday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Greetings to General Secretary of C.C., LPRP
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a message of greeting to Bounnhang Vorachith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party (LPRP) and president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic (LPDR), on August 15. The message sent warm congratulations and comradely greeting to the general secretary on his 83rd birth anniversary. The message expressed belief that the fraternal Lao people would defend gains of revolution and victoriously advance the cause of socialism under the leadership of the LPRP headed by the general secretary. It sincerely wished the general secretary good health and greater successes in his responsible work for consolidating the party and achieving prosperity of the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Songdowon International Children's Camp
body: It has been 60 years since the establishment of the Songdowon International Children's Camp. After the fist camping of Children's Union members took place in August Juche 49 (1960), at least 470 000 schoolchildren from across the country and foreign countries have enjoyed themselves there. Foreign campers and visitors said it is so marvelous that there is a camp for children in such a scenic place, out of envy of the schoolchildren in the DPRK who have led happy life under the warm care of the peerlessly great men. Rodong Sinmun

title: Kim Tok Hun Inspects North Hwanghae Province
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the DPRK, inspected different counties of North Hwanghae Province to learn about their flood damage and reconstruction. Touring Taechong-ri in Unpha County, he urged officials to carry out the reconstruction on the principle of putting the interests of the people above all, true to the idea and intention of the Party Central Committee and put primary efforts into providing the flood-stricken people with a better living condition. He stressed the need for all the service personnel and builders involved in the reconstruction project to strictly abide by the anti-epidemic rules, calling for stepping up the reinforcement of embankment and floodgates on Unpha Stream and properly fixing the locations of the new dwelling houses. He also urged the relevant units to ensure timely supply of materials needed for reconstruction. Acquainting himself with the rehabilitation project in Sohung and Pongsan Counties, he urged the designing organs to design the structures in a responsible way. He took necessary measures after discussing the issues of rehabilitating the drain pumping stations immediately, improving all the waterways as planned, and putting cultivation of crops on a scientific and technical basis. Rodong Sinmun

title: Pak Pong Ju Inspects Flood-Hit Areas in Kangwon Province
body: Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, inspected Kimhwa, Cholwon and Phyonggang Counties in Kangwon Province hit by flood. Learning about the situation of the flood-hit areas and their reconstruction plans, he urged officials of the Party and power organs to bear deep in mind the idea of the 16th meeting of the Political Bureau of the 7th Central Committee of the WPK, fulfill their responsibilities and duties in providing the people with a stable life and giving a complete facelift to the residential areas as desired by the people. Meeting with people in the township of Kimhwa County, he acquainted himself with their living and took necessary measures after discussing the issues arising in fixing the locations of new residential districts, supplying potable water and pushing ahead with the anti-land-sliding project. At the Paekrosan Co-operative Farm in Cholwon County, he underscored the need to put efforts into stabilizing the living of farmers and ensuring healthy growth of flood-afflicted crops. At Phyonggang County, he called for reexamining the technical condition of railway stations and fully ensuring the transport of materials needed for reconstruction. Rodong Sinmun

title: Enlarged Edition of "Complete Collection of Kim Il Sung's Works" Published
body: The Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House has brought out the enlarged edition Vol. 10 of "Complete Collection of Kim Il Sung's Works", a library of the immortal Juche idea dealing with President Kim Il Sung's works systematically and comprehensively and in chronological order. The book contains 95 works including speeches, talks, reports and concluding speeches made by the President from August to December, Juche 36 (1947). The works deal with the ideology and theory and strategic and tactical policies illuminating the path for building a prosperous independent and sovereign state including the ones for strengthening the Party and the people's government and achieving independent development of the national economy after the national liberation. In the works, the President called for developing the Party into a powerful one, firmly rallying the broad masses around the people's government, further strengthening the democratic national united front and vigorously carrying on the general ideological mobilization movement for nation building. He also indicated the tasks and ways for laying firm material foundations for building a democratic and independent sovereign state, founding a strong regular army as early as possible and establishing an all-people national defence system. He clarified the ideas of decisively intensifying the Party's guidance over social organizations, bringing about a fundamental turn in the work of social organizations, improving the education of younger generation and training of national cadres and making the teachers fully prepared politically and ideologically. There are also the works giving perfect answers to the theoretical and practical problems arising in building a democratic and independent sovereign state such as the issue of bringing up the children of the revolutionary martyrs to be good revolutionaries as desired by their parents, the issue of developing literature and art and vigorously conducting the mass cultural work and the issue of exerting greater efforts on the development of physical culture and sports of the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Anti-Epidemic Work Further Intensified in DPRK
body: A brisk anti-epidemic campaign is underway in the DPRK to cope with the worldwide pandemic, true to the idea of the 16th meeting of the Political Bureau of the 7th Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea. All the emergency anti-epidemic workers in Pyongyang and provinces are actively conducting the organizational and political work to correctly implement the directions and assignments given by the Party Central Committee, with high vigilance and readiness, as required by the protracted emergency anti-epidemic work. New anti-epidemic measures have been taken to more strictly maintain the nationwide emergency anti-epidemic system and thoroughly check any inroads of malignant virus under the present anti-epidemic situation. The inspection and quarantine officials have been urged to fully discharge their responsibility and role for a flawless anti-epidemic work now that anti-epidemic measures are constantly supplemented and strictly observed to shut tighter the border, coastal and frontline areas. As the lock-down of the frontline area has been lifted, Kaesong City is intensifying the anti-epidemic work, strictly abiding by the anti-epidemic rules in lifting the isolation of those in quarantine. Relevant units across the country have established additional anti-epidemic watch posts to get rid of and block the source and channels of infection in the rainy season, strengthened real-time monitoring and sterilized drinking water and removed garbage in accordance with the anti-epidemic rules to prevent virus infection. Officials in the flood-stricken areas have taken timely measures to make sure that there would be no violation of anti-epidemic rules among their inhabitants and those involved in the rehabilitation project. Medical tests of citizens have been intensified across the country and all units and sectors are working hard to ensure promptness and accuracy of the anti-epidemic work with recourse to the nationwide emergency anti-epidemic information system while steadily putting big efforts into sterilization. Officials and working people across the country are strictly observing the anti-epidemic rules including mask wearing, temperature taking and hand sterilization, keeping in their minds that any slightest indolence and relaxation and chronic attitude might bring about an incontrollable serious disaster. Rodong Sinmun

title: Participants in Plenary Meeting of WPK Central Committee
body: Visit Kumsusan Palace of Sun The participants in the 6th Plenary Meeting of the 7th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on Wednesday evening to pay homage to President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. Members of the leadership body of the Party Central Committee who visited the sacred temple of Juche where Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il lie in state were full of the humblest reverence for the peerlessly great men. They laid a floral basket in the name of the Central Committee of the WPK before the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il and paid high tribute to them. At the halls where Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il lie in state they paid high tribute to the great leaders, making a solemn pledge to remain faithful to the revolution to the last, defending socialism of Juche, the patriotic legacy bequeathed by the great leaders. The participants in the 6th Plenary Meeting of the 7th C.C., WPK hardened their iron will to single-mindedly and faithfully uphold the guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un who newly illuminates the road ahead of the development of the Great Party of Comrades Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il and revolutionary struggle and fulfill their duty as the commanding staff of the revolution in accelerating the victorious advance for putting the building of a powerful socialist nation on higher stage with confidence. Rodong Sinmun

title: Decision of 6th Plenary Meeting of the 7th Central
body: Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea Juche 109(2020) August 19 On Convening 8th Congress of WPK Our Party and people are carrying out the historical task set forth at the Seventh Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea while breaking through head-on all the barriers to our advance by organizing and launching an arduous revolutionary struggle. Through this indomitable struggle for implementing the decision made at the Seventh Congress of the WPK the dignity and position of our state has been remarkably raised, the single-minded unity of the Party and the people further consolidated and a great revolutionary turn made in the building of the Party and its overall activities. On the other hand, economy was not improved in the face of the sustaining severe internal and external situations and unexpected manifold challenges, thereby planned attainment of the goals for improving the national economy has been seriously delayed and the people's living standard not been improved remarkably. The plenary meeting, after analyzing and reviewing the experience and lessons from the work of the past five years for building a powerful socialist country, decided to convene the Eighth Congress of the WPK as follows to set forth a correct line of struggle and strategic and tactical policies on the basis of the new requirements of our developing revolution and the prevailing situation: 1. The Eighth Congress of the WPK will be convened in January, Juche 110(2021). 2. The agendas of the Eighth Congress of the WPK are as follows: 1) Review of the work of the Central Committee of the WPK 2) Review of the work of the Central Auditing Commission of the WPK 3) On revising the rules of the WPK 4) Election of the leadership organ of the WPK Central Committee 3. One delegate with the right to vote to the Congress will be appointed among every 1 300 Party members and one delegate with the right to speak among every 1 300 candidate Party members. Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea

title: Political Decision to Be Recorded as Another Special Event in Militant Course of Glorious WPK
body: On Convening 8th Congress of WPK 6th Plenary Meeting of 7th Central Committee of WPK Held The 6th Plenary Meeting of the 7th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea was held at the office building of the Central Committee of the Party, the supreme general staff of the Korean revolution, on Aug. 19, Juche 109 (2020). Supreme Leader of the Party, the state and the armed forces of the DPRK Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, guided the plenary meeting. Attending the meeting were members and alternate members of the WPK Central Committee and members of the Party Central Auditing Commission. Officials of departments of the Party Central Committee were present as observers. The meeting discussed as the major agenda the issue of convening the 8th Congress of the WPK to set forth a new line of struggle and strategic and tactical policies on the basis of the requirements of our developing revolution and the changed situation, and to further strengthen the Party organizationally and ideologically. Upon authorization of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, the respected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un presided over the meeting and made a historic speech. In the speech he analyzed the subjective and objective environments this year in which we faced unexpected and inevitable challenges in various aspects and the situation in the region surrounding the Korean peninsula, and assessed achievements and shortcomings that have been seen in the Party and the state affairs for the past four years since the historic 7th Party Congress. He made a detailed report on the accomplishment of goals of various sectors of the national economy for this year, the last year of attaining the goals of the five-year strategy for national economic development set forth in the 7th Congress of the Party, in particular, and analyzed the results. He said that the Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee suggested convening the 8th Congress of the WPK to analyze and review in a comprehensive, three-dimensional and anatomical way the deviations and shortcomings in the work for the implementation of the decisions made at the 7th Congress of the Party and to discuss and decide on the strategic tasks for the Party and the government in the new phase of struggle in the crucial period of our revolution. Calling for regularly convening the congresses of the Party, the supreme guidance organ of the Party, in order to confirm the line, strategic and tactical measures for steering the development of the times and the revolution and adjust and reinforce the leadership body for guaranteeing their execution, he advanced the important guidelines for the operation of the congress. He said that the 8th Congress would review this year's work and the work of the Central Committee of the Party in the period under review and set forth a new 5-year plan for national economic development including next year's orientation of work. Noting that the 8th Congress should become the congress of struggle, the working congress and the congress that will comprehensively review the Party work, he detailed the agenda items to be discussed at the congress and the issues arising in the preparations for it. The Supreme Leader stressed the need for all the sectors and units including the Party organizations at all levels, power organs and organs of the armed forces to regularly in time sum up the results of the work so as not to deviate from the implementation of the Party's basic lines, policies and decisions. He also said that they should encourage and develop good successes, overcome shortcomings and take rectification measures at the double and thus achieve new progress in advancing the revolution and construction and in strengthening the Party. The Supreme Leader called on all the participants to greet the 8th Congress of the WPK with high political zeal and shining feats of labor by pushing forward the work of developing the internal potentiality and the motive force as required by the offensive for making a breakthrough head-on along with the major tasks set forth at this year's meetings of the Political Bureau of the Party. The Supreme Leader read out a draft decision of the plenary meeting on convening the 8th Congress of the WPK. After he read out the draft decision on convening the Congress which will be recorded as another special event in the path of our glorious Party, all the participants fully supported and approved the agenda that had been taken up in the meeting with thunderous cheers and applauses. The plenary meeting decided to convene the 8th Congress of the WPK in January, Juche 110(2021). The historic decision is an indication of the self-confidence of our Party leading the overall activities of the Party and the state to the new higher phase as required by the developing revolution, and an expression of the strong will and solemn pledge of our Party to live up to the great trust and expectation of our people by fulfilling its duty while shouldering upon itself the future of the country. Political News Team

title: Anti-epidemic Activities Get Brisk in DPRK
body: Commercial and catering facilities across the DPRK are actively conducting the anti-epidemic activities to tackle the worldwide pandemic. Officials and workers in service facilities are strictly observing the anti-epidemic rules in their activities while taking due measures after finding out flaws in their anti-epidemic work. Officials and employees of the Kwangbok Area Supermarket conduct medical examination of the public service workers in a responsible manner, making sure that they strictly observe the sanitary rules during their activities. They strictly disinfect the frequently-touched things such as shopping carts, baskets, escalators and goods, informing the customers of the code of conduct they have to observe while buying goods and hygiene information over loudspeaker. Service facilities in various parts of the country frequently disinfect the floor and goods, keeping the high-rate operation of ventilation equipment. Anti-epidemic rules are strictly observed in catering facilities across the country. In the Pyongyang Noodle House kitchen utensils are disinfected in accordance with the anti-epidemic regulations and foodstuffs and dishes are inspected strictly to ensure that there would be no abnormal phenomenon in service activities. Service workers of Sinhung Restaurant in Hamhung and Kyongam Restaurant in Sariwon take temperature of visitors and let them sterilize their hands as required by anti-epidemic regulations, making sure that they keep social distancing in dining halls. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Russian Political Party Leader
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, received a message of greeting from S. M. Mironov, chairman of the "A Just Russia", on August 13. Mironov in his message extended congratulations to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un on behalf of his party and on his own behalf on the occasion of the day of Korea's liberation, a national holiday of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK). The message said the Korean people, who bravely fought for the freedom and independence of their country, are highly proud of the heroes of the country. It noted that the massive and nationwide resistance of the broad sections of patriotic forces hastened the aggressors' defeat. It appreciated the fact that the soldiers of the Red Army, who laid down their lives while fighting shoulder to shoulder with the Korean patriots, are remembered and revered in the DPRK. It expressed the belief that the cooperation between the two political parties would successfully develop in line with the development of relations between Russia and the DPRK and the boosting friendship between the peoples of the two countries, and wished Kim Jong Un and all the people of the DPRK good health, success and well-being. Rodong Sinmun

title: Anniversary of Korea's Liberation Celebrated by Koreans in China
body: The General Association of Koreans in China and its affiliated organizations held celebrations on Aug. 15, the 75th anniversary of the liberation of Korea. A meeting of the General Association of Koreans in China took place in Shenyang, China. Present there were officials of the association, Korean nationals of Shenyang and family members of martyrs of the Chinese People's Volunteers. Choe Su Bong, first vice chairman of the association, said in a speech that President Kim Il Sung led the 20 year-long hard-fought anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle to victory in the darkest period when the Korean nation stood at the crossroads of life and death, and thus achieved the historic cause of Korea's liberation. He noted that the 75th anniversary of Korea's liberation is of greater significance as it is celebrated when the dignity and might of the DPRK dynamically advancing under the uplifted banner of independence and self-reliance are fully demonstrated. It is thanks to the guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un that the DPRK is renowned in the international arena as a country strong in its independent stand that no one dares provoke, he noted. The General Association of Koreans in China and all Koreans in China, keeping pace with the great advance of the people in the homeland, will firmly unite a broad spectrum of compatriots around the organization and more strenuously conduct the patriotic movement for national reunification with indomitable will and fortitude, true to the wise leadership of the Supreme Leader, he stressed. A letter to the Supreme Leader was adopted at the meeting. Then there were round-table talks and a film show. A meeting of officials of the Yanbian Regional Association of the General Association of Koreans in China and its branches took place in Yanji City, Jilin Province of China on the same occasion. The Federation of Korean Economic Workers in China held a ceremony of laying a floral basket before the portraits of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and a remembrance meeting in Dandong City, Liaoning Province of China. Rodong Sinmun

title: Reconstruction of Flood-Hit Roads and Bridges Brisk in DPRK
body: Reconstruction of the flood-hit roads and bridges is brisk in the DPRK. Kangwon Province hastens the reconstruction of the flood-hit roads and bridges in various parts of the province including Kimhwa, Changdo and Hoeyang counties by giving precedence to designing and supply of materials. The province also speeds up the reconstruction by waging the joint operation of service personnel and people and concentrating all efforts and means on the projects. Kumchon and Sohung counties in North Hwanghae Province direct primary efforts to quickly repairing the roads damaged by flood. South Hwanghae, North Phyongan, South Phyongan, South Hamgyong and other provinces push ahead with the reconstruction of the flood-afflicted roads and bridges, while taking measures to cope with continuous wet weather. Rodong Sinmun

title: Anti-Epidemic Measures Toughened in Coastal Areas of DPRK
body: Anti-epidemic measures have been toughened in the DPRK to thoroughly check the maritime inroads of the malignant virus. Emergency anti-epidemic organs in coastal areas are scrupulously organizing the work for further strengthening the anti-epidemic inspection along the seashore and its vicinity. They also keep themselves alert and work hard to perfect their material and technical foundation to cope with any emergency circumstances. They have established an all-citizens information system for tackling abnormal phenomenon, strengthened the anti-epidemic forces and reinforced the coastal observation post. They also strictly observe the anti-epidemic rules in incinerating and burying the beach-drifting rubbishes. They tighten the control to make sure that relevant regulations and order are strictly observed in the entry into the sea, taking immediate measures against imperfections in their anti-epidemic work. Rodong Sinmun

title: Japan Urged to Acknowledge Mass Killings of Koreans
body: A spokesman for the Association of Korean Victims of Forcible Drafting and Their Bereaved Families made public a statement on Monday on the lapse of 75 years since Ukishima-maru, a transport vessel of the Japanese imperialist aggressor army, was sunken by explosion. Thousands of Koreans who boarded the ship to return to their homeland looking forward to the time when they would meet their beloved families after liberation of Korea were forced to death for no reason, the statement said, and went on: Nevertheless, the Japanese authorities have so far resorted to all sorts of sleight of hand to cover up the crime, shamelessly describing the incident as an accident. We denounce the Japanese authorities and reactionaries in the name of the victims and their bereaved families for drowning thousands of people in revenge for their defeat not content with abducting and drafting lots of Koreans and driving them into hard labor wielding the bayonet in the past and now persistently dodging their responsibility for it. The Japanese authorities' desperate efforts to deny the thrice-cursed mass killings of Koreans and cover up the truth behind them only bring to light their vileness and harden the will of the Korean people to surely exact Japan's atonement for the past crimes. The Japanese authorities should clarify the truth behind the case of Ukishima-maru and make due apology and reparation to the victims and their bereaved families, aware that Japan's blood-stained past can neither be justified nor be written off. Rodong Sinmun

title: Pak Pong Ju and Kim Tok Hun Inspect Construction Site of Project for Establishing C1 Chemical Industry
body: Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, and Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK and premier of the Cabinet of the DPRK, inspected the construction site of the project for establishing the C1 chemical industry. Walking round the construction site, they stressed the need to thoroughly embody the Party's idea and intention of turning the chemical industry into energy-, labor-saving one in establishing the Korean-style chemical industry. They called upon officials, technicians and workers to map out a correct construction plan and thoroughly carry it out, complete the architecture designing on the principle of convenience and architectural beauty first and observe technical regulations in the construction and the equipment assembling. The field consultative meeting reviewed the progress in the project and discussed the issues of setting up a proper system for direction of overall construction, timely supplying materials and equipment in close touch with relevant units and simultaneously pushing ahead with afforestation and greening. Earlier, Kim Tok Hun inspected Pyongyang General Hospital under construction. Rodong Sinmun

title: 17th Enlarged Meeting of Political Bureau and
body: 5th Meeting of Executive Policy Council of 7th Central Committee of WPK Held The 17th enlarged meeting of the Political Bureau of the 7th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and the 5th Meeting of the Executive Policy Council of the 7th Central Committee of the WPK took place at the office building of the Central Committee of the WPK on August 25. Kim Jong Un, chairman of the WPK, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, was present at the meetings. Attending the meetings were members and alternate members of the Political Bureau including members of the Executive Policy Council of the Central Committee of the WPK. Present there as observers were leading officials of departments of the WPK Central Committee and members of relevant fields. Supreme Leader of the Party, the state and the armed forces Kim Jong Un presided over the 17th enlarged meeting of the Political Bureau of the 7th Central Committee of the WPK. The meeting discussed in depth the relevant issues of examining the state emergency anti-epidemic posture to cope with the world public health crisis and further intensifying the anti-epidemic work. The meeting seriously assessed some defects in the state emergency anti-epidemic work for checking the inroads of the malignant virus, and studied measures to overcome the defects urgently. The meeting stressed the need to imbue officials of the Party, public security and defense organs at all levels once again with the idea of the Party Central Committee on taking intense anti-epidemic measures and to thoroughly maintain perfect anti-epidemic posture. Citing facts about some shortcomings in state emergency anti-epidemic work, the Supreme Leader underlined the need to take active measures involving the entire Party and society for completing and maintaining the anti-epidemic posture and eliminating some defects. The Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK made relevant decisions on agenda items brought up for discussion. The meeting put an emphasis on the discussion of the issues of taking thorough state emergency measures on preventing the damage with strong typhoon expected to affect the overall area of the DPRK including South Hwanghae, South Phyongan and North Phyongan Provinces between August 26 and 27. Kim Jong Un set forth tasks for the Party organizations, people's power organs and public security organs at all levels, saying that to thoroughly prevent the casualties by typhoon and minimize the damage to the crops is an important work which can never be neglected even a moment for our Party bearing the responsibility for the destiny of the people and also a crucial one deciding whether we would successfully wrap up this year's farming or not. He stressed the need to conduct information activities among officials, Party members and other working people in an intensive way to awaken them to the importance of the work for preventing the damage by typhoon and the method for countering crisis, and called upon all the fields of national economy to take instant measures to prevent the damage from the typhoon. The meeting decided to map out and issue the written directive of the Central Committee of the Party on thoroughly implementing the instructions given by Kim Jong Un. There took place a meeting of the Executive Policy Council following the enlarged meeting of the Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee. The meeting studied and discussed practical issues arising in implementing the decision of the 6th Plenary Meeting of the 7th Central Committee of the WPK on convening the 8th Congress of the WPK. The meeting organized the preparatory committee for the successful 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea and decided on the work system and the assignment of work for the panels and groups. The relevant decision of the Executive Policy Council of the Party Central Committee was adopted with full approval. Political News Team

title: Floral Baskets Laid before Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Officials, service personnel and working people of the DPRK placed floral baskets before the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il to mark the 60th anniversary of Kim Jong Il's start of his guidance over the revolutionary armed forces. The officials, service personnel and working people paid tribute to the statues of the President and the Chairman on Mansu Hill. Laid at the statues were floral baskets in the names of the Party, power and armed forces organs, social organizations, ministries, national institutions and units of the Korean People's Army and the Public Security Forces, the organs at all levels, industrial establishments, universities, etc. here and bunches of flowers. The visitors paid tribute to the statues of the peerlessly great men. Floral baskets in the names of units of the Korean People's Army and the Public Security Forces and industrial establishments, etc. and bunches of flowers were placed before their statues and the portraits of smiling Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il in different places of the capital city, including Kim Il Sung University, the Ministry of the People's Armed Forces and the Mansudae Art Studio. Officials, service personnel and working people in all parts of the country paid tribute to the statues and the portraits of smiling Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il in their places. Rodong Sinmun

title: Vigorous Campaign to Eradicate Flood Damage Aftermath
body: Achievements have been recorded in the campaign to eradicate the aftermath of the flood damage and provide stable living conditions to the people in the flood-stricken areas as soon as possible. The service personnel who are taking part in the rehabilitation of flood-stricken Taechong-ri, Unpha County, North Hwanghae Province made millions of blocks and thus opened up vistas for finishing the construction of dwellings. People of Ichon County, Kangwon Province in joint operation with service personnel reconnected the county's communication line to the provincial one and joined the communication lines between the county and the villages as of Aug. 21. Cement-production, iron-and-steel-production and timber-production units throughout the country are pushing forward with the work to supply enough cement, iron and steel and timber to the flood-ravaged areas. The Sunchon Cement Complex provided over 10 000 tons of cement to the reconstruction sites in a short span of time. The light industrial sector sent lots of underwear and socks to people of flood-hit areas, including Kimhwa and Changdo counties of Kangwon Province, and is arranging the work to timely supply daily necessities for the next season under a meticulous plan. The railway transport sector is giving priority to the transport of emergency materials, keeping in close touch with the recovery sites. Rodong Sinmun

title: Exploits of Chairman Kim Jong Il Who Built Revolutionary Army of the Party Are Eternal Treasure Guaranteeing Victorious Advance of Juche Revolution
body: It has been 60 years since Chairman Kim Jong Il's start of his guidance on the revolutionary armed forces. He inspected the Seoul Ryu Kyong Su Guards 105th Tank Division of the Korean People's Army on Aug. 25, Juche 49 (1960), which was a historic event of an important milestone in strengthening the revolutionary armed forces. He also built the People's Army into the genuine army of the leader and the Party, which is the greatest of his exploits for building the most elite invincible revolutionary army. He is a peerless brilliant commander, who advanced the Juche-based idea of building the army, successfully accomplished the cause of building the revolutionary army of the Party for the first time in history and built our revolutionary armed forces into the army strong in faith which is true to the idea and cause of the Party. He built the elite forces that thoroughly established within themselves the revolutionary military climate of unconditionally and thoroughly carrying out the orders and instructions of the Party whatever happens, and he also built the strong army whose members, united with a single heart, share weal and woe with the Party to the last out of comradeship and revolutionary obligation. The feats performed by him for building the revolutionary army of the Party are being successfully carried forward and developed thanks to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Chae Chol Ryong, Pak Yon

title: Campaign for Minimizing Damage from Typhoon Launched in DPRK
body: A typhoon warning was issued in most areas in the DPRK with Typhoon No. 8 arriving in the country between coming Wednesday and Thursday. The whole nation is now engrossed in the campaign for minimizing the damage from the typhoon. In the fields of coal and extractive industries steps are being taken to increase the number of pumping machines and piping to drain water from heavy rain out of pits in time. Thermo-power and hydro-power stations are taking urgent measures to protect generating equipment and hydraulic structures from thunderbolt, heavy rain and storm. The railway transport field is putting greater efforts to the inclined railroad sections and places prone to landslide, and people have taken up an emergency posture to be able to immediately cope with any circumstances. In the fishery and offshore farms on the west coast of the DPRK fishing boats have been taken to safe zones and measures are being taken to prevent the production buildings, discharging equipment and culture farms from damage. The land and environmental field is making all efforts to prevent the damage by the typhoon after making a list of the dangerous places with poor conditions. Strong measures for protecting crops from the typhoon are also being taken on farms across the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Songs in Praise of Chairman Kim Jong Il Resound in DPRK
body: Many songs in praise of Songun exploits of Chairman Kim Jong Il have become popular among the Korean people and service personnel of the Korean People's Army. The song "We Will Never Forget" is a famous song of the era reminding one of the history of the grim Korean revolution associated with the devotion of Kim Jong Il during the arduous march. Many songs reflect the reverence for Kim Jong Il who firmly guaranteed the dignity of the country and the wellbeing of the people with the arms of the revolution. The song "Thinking of Journeys for Songun Leadership" and other songs tell lots of tearful events experienced by the peerlessly great man on the road of Songun. Such songs as "This Is Thanks to the Songun Politics of General" show the true picture of the DPRK in the era of Songun witnessing a series of eye-opening events. There are so many famous songs about the emotion-charged era when great changes took place in accomplishing the cause of socialism with the might of Songun. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Birthday Spread to Centenarian
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un sent a birthday spread to Yun Nae Bong, a woman centenarian residing in Unsong-ri, Hwangju County in North Hwanghae Province. She, born into a poor peasant's family, was subjected to all sorts of maltreatment and humiliation. After the liberation of the country, she worked faithfully as a master of the country and an agricultural worker for scores of years. Enjoying regular medical service, she is doing simple housework in good health. When talking to villagers she says she could bring up her children without paying even a penny and lead a long life in good health with her sons and daughters, grandchildren and great-grandchildren thanks to the people-oriented policies of the Workers' Party of Korea and the state. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Inspects Typhoon-Stricken Area
body: in South Hwanghae Province Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, inspected typhoon-stricken area in South Hwanghae Province and learned about damage. Kim Jong Un summoned Ri Chol Man, chairman of the South Hwanghae Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, to receive a report on the situation of damage in the province. He said that the damage by Typhoon No. 8 is smaller than expected, adding that he had worried a lot but he feels it is fortunate to have damage that much. Saying that as all the Party organizations and officials took foresighted security measures immediately after receiving the instructions made by the Party Central Committee to have the proper consciousness of countering crisis and thoroughly prevent the damage from the typhoon, they could reduce casualties and minimize the damage in every sector, he positively appraised national crisis control system against natural disasters taking up proper shape and the ability to counter the crisis making remarkable improvement. Referring to the need to do well the work of removing the damage by typhoon by focusing all efforts, he pointed out that it is necessary to direct efforts to minimizing the damage in the agricultural field in particular and reduction in the harvest by making a correct examination of the damage to crops and taking measures for improving their growth in touch with the institutions of agricultural science. Saying that it is one of top-priority tasks to be surely carried out by our Party to go among the people and encourage and sincerely help them when they are in trouble and feel difficult and that the Central Committee of the Party should always be with them both when they are in weal and woe, he instructed every department of the Central Committee of the Party to get engaged in the work of rehabilitating from the damage to farming lands and crops in South Hwanghae Province. He ardently appealed to everyone to wage an all-out campaign for finishing the recovery from damage as soon as possible with confidence in victory and thus greet the 75th founding anniversary of the Party most significantly and splendidly with proud labor achievements. Political News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Reply Message from Lao Political Party Leader
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), received a reply message from Bounnang Vorachith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party and president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic, on Aug. 26. Bounnang Vorachith in the message expressed his sincere gratitude to Kim Jong Un for sending a beautiful floral basket and a message of greeting on the occasion of his 83rd birthday. The message expressed the belief that the fraternal people of the DPRK would make new greater achievements in defending the country, building a powerful socialist country and accomplishing the cause of the peaceful reunification of the country under the seasoned leadership of the WPK led by Kim Jong Un. It wished him happiness in good health and success in his noble and honorable work. It hoped that the long-standing relations of friendship and cooperation between the two parties, between the two states and between the two peoples would grow stronger. Rodong Sinmun

title: "Complete Collection of Kim Jong Il's Works" Vol. 31 Published
body: The Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House brought out "Complete Collection of Kim Jong Il's Works" vol. 31, the library of the immortal Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism carrying Chairman Kim Jong Il's works in chronological order and in systematic and comprehensive way. Carried in it are 68 works including talks, speeches and letters released by Kim Jong Il in the period from January to December Juche 68 (1979). Kim Jong Il in the work "Our Leader Is a Peerlessly Great Man Who Values the Revolutionary Obligation" and other works underlined the need to erect the statue of President Kim Il Sung at the highest level and attach top priority to giving wide publicity to the greatness of the President. Clarified in the work "On Strengthening the Political and Ideological Unity and Cohesion of the Party" and other works are the idea of firmly ensuring the leadership of the Party by establishing the steel-like discipline of thoroughly and unconditionally implementing the Party's decisions and directions and enhancing the militant capabilities and role of the Party organizations. The work "Let Us Thoroughly Implement the Party's Strategic Policy on Living Our Own Way" and other works deal with the ideas of firmly adhering to the revolutionary principle of solving all problems arising in revolution and construction in our own way under the uplifted banner of the Juche idea, fully ensuring the Party leadership to economic activities and bringing about new upsurge in the socialist economic construction by giving full play to the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance and fortitude. The collection also carries such works as those that indicate the tasks and ways for establishing the system of the Party leadership in the People's Army, further sharpening the revolutionary vigilance as required by the prevailing situation and intensifying combat drills and preparations. Contained in it are works in which Kim Jong Il underscored the need to create literary pieces depicting the leader on the basis of historical facts and further develop our literary and arts, including film, music and acrobatics, by diversifying programs and styles of theatrical art performances and applying the Juche-oriented methods of creation. The collection carries works giving perfect answers to theoretical and practical problems arising in the socialist construction. Rodong Sinmun

title: Outdoor Performance "Youth, Let's Uphold Our Party" Celebrates Youth Day
body: There was outdoor performance "Youth, Let's Uphold Our Party" for celebrating the Youth Day in the plaza of the April 25 House of Culture in Pyongyang on Friday. The art squad of the Central Committee of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League, artistes of art troupes in Pyongyang and local areas and teachers and students in the field of art education in the city adorned the night on the Youth Day with colorful pieces. Put on the brightly decorated stage were songs and dances "Glory to General Kim Jong Un" and "Song of Youth". The performers sang high praises of the immense pride of youths preparing themselves to be main players of the drive for building a powerful socialist country under the care of our Party. Put on the stage were female solo and female pangchang "Gold Cushion", "Our Dear Marshal", "Your Embrace Is the Best" and conspicuous numbers showing the enthusiasm and optimism of patriotic youths. There were also sporting rhythmic and song "Youth and Courage" presenting a fantastic view with peculiar lighting effects, harmonica quartet and a series of youth songs. After outdoor performance there was a dancing party of youths and students. They were full of trust in the Party and one mind to repay the Party which always puts deep trust in the youth and puts them forward in advance. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Cuban Leaders
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, received a message of greeting from Raul Castro Ruz, first secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba, and Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez, president of the Republic of Cuba, Saturday. The message sent the most heartfelt congratulations to Kim Jong Un in the names of the Communist Party, government and people of Cuba on the occasion of the 60th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the DPRK and the Republic of Cuba. The Cuban leaders in their message said that availing themselves of the opportunity, they confirm once again that Cuba attaches top priority to the bonds of friendship and cooperation between the two countries based on the special ties between preceding leaders Comrade Fidel Castro Ruz and Comrade Kim Il Sung. Rodong Sinmun

title: ﻿Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Greetings to Cuban Leaders
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Saturday sent a message of greeting to Raul Castro Ruz, first secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba, and Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez, president of the Republic of Cuba. The message extended warm and comradely greetings to the first secretary and the president of Cuba, the friendly Cuban party, government and people on the occasion of the 60th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic ties between the DPRK and the Republic of Cuba. The message said that for the past 60 years the peoples of the two countries have invariably preserved and developed the precious tradition of friendship, unity and cooperation created by the great leaders of the revolution of the two countries despite the complicated international situation and all sorts of challenges by the hostile forces. It expressed the belief that the strategic and comradely relations of friendship and cooperation between the two countries would grow stronger in the future in the joint struggle for independence and socialism against imperialism. It sincerely wished the Cuban leaders greater success in their responsible work, extending full support to the Cuban people in their just struggle to firmly defend gains of revolution and victoriously advance the cause of socialism. Rodong Sinmun

title: Officials of WPK Central Committee Engage in Recovery of
body: Typhoon-Damaged Farmland and Crops Officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea engaged in the campaign with agricultural workers to recover from damage done to cropland and crops in the typhoon-stricken areas in South Hwanghae Province. The officials of the Central Committee of the WPK immediately went to the sites for recovery from damage, true to the noble intention of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un who said that it is one of top-priority tasks to be surely carried out by our Party to go among the people and encourage and sincerely help them when they are in trouble and feel difficult. In Ongjin, Kangryong and Pyoksong counties they are working hard to lessen the reduction in the crop yield with the farmers in the most severely stricken fields. They encouraged the farmers to successfully conclude this significant year's farming while doing farming work such as picking up corns and digging ditches and repairing dwelling houses just as members of the workteams and sub-workteams would do. Visiting the families of farmers with aiding materials prepared by them with sincerity, they learned about their living conditions as their real parents would do and encouraged them to firmly defend the socialist cooperative fields. People in the damaged areas were deeply impressed with the appearance of officials of the WPK Central Committee who had meals from the same pot as the farmers and shared common weal and woe with them after launching the campaign for recovering from damage from early dawn till late at night. People in the damaged areas said in excitement that officials of the WPK Central Committee helped them relieved of their worries after they were hit by typhoon, and that they remain unperturbed by any storm and stress as there is the care of Marshal Kim Jong Un and the mother party. The devoted and people-oriented traits displayed by the officials of the Central Committee of the WPK in the sites for recovery from damage harden the revolutionary will of the agricultural workers who buckled down to the campaign to remove the aftermath of disaster as early as possible and greet the 75th founding anniversary of the WPK with shining labor achievements. Rodong Sinmun

title: Kim Tok Hun Inspects Recovery from Typhoon Damage in South Hwanghae Province
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the DPRK, inspected South Hwanghae Province where the work for recovery from typhoon damage is underway. Making rounds of the Obong Co-op Farm in Kangryong County, the Janghyon Co-op Farm in Pyoksong County and other different places in Ongjin, Kwail and Jaeryong counties, he discussed on practical issues arising in recovering from the damage. He underscored the need to manure and cultivate crops at the typhoon-stricken fields with correct methods and, at the same time, gather corns without any waste. He learned about the railway recovery in Unryul County, held a consultative meeting at the Kumpho Mine and stressed the need to take warm care of the families of the employees who suffered damage and for relevant sectors to timely supply materials necessary for building dwelling houses. Rodong Sinmun

title: Pak Pong Ju Inspects Recovery from Typhoon Damage in South Hwanghae Province
body: Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, made field survey of the recovery from typhoon damage in South Hwanghae Province. True to the on-spot instructions given by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, the officials and working people in the province have turned out as one in the drive for finishing the recovery from damage as soon as possible and minimizing crops damage. Pak Pong Ju learned in detail about the damage at the Township Cooperative Farm and the Raengjong Cooperative Farm in Ongjin County, the Township Cooperative Farm in Kangryong County and the Ohyon Cooperative Farm in Yonan County. He referred to the need for the farms to take timely measures for improving the crops growth in touch with the institutions of agricultural science, and scrupulously conduct the organizational and political work to mobilize all means and forces for recovering from damage. He met with agricultural scientists dispatched to typhoon-affected areas and requested them to actively introduce feasible methods for maximizing grain output so as to provide a scientific and technological guarantee for an increase of grain. Rodong Sinmun

title: The Art Exchange Association of Korea Observes Its 40th Founding Anniversary
body: August 30, Juche 109 (2020) marks the 40th founding anniversary of the Art Exchange Association of Korea(AEAK). The AEAK contributes to the April Spring Friendship Art Festival, the art impartment for overseas Koreans and other external art exchange and cooperation. It has set up a department for running the Pyongyang International Music School. It also invites the professional vocalists, instrumentalists and conductors of many countries to our country and arranges them to impart their art knowledge and techniques to the artistes of the National Symphony Orchestra and other art troupes as well as to the teachers and students of institutions of art education like the Pyongyang Kim Won Gyun Conservatory. The AEAK opened its home page “Korean Art” on the Internet last September. It informs netizens of the Juche-oriented art of Korea. Om Su Ryon

title: Hamhung Branch of State Academy of Sciences Marks Its 60th Founding Anniversary
body: The Hamhung Branch of the State Academy of Sciences marked its 60th founding anniversary. A congratulatory message sent by the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea was conveyed to scientists, technicians and employees of the branch greeting its 60th founding anniversary on August 30. The branch is a prestigious scientific research institute which plays an important role in scientifically guaranteeing and propelling the work for putting the chemical industry on a Juche and modern basis. President Kim Il Sung founded the branch on Aug. 30, Juche 49 (1960) and visited it several times to detail its job and showed warm loving care for its researchers and employees. Chairman Kim Jong Il inspected the branch several times and clearly set forth the orientation and ways for research and made sure that it was provided with adequate experimental equipment and electricity and dwelling houses were built for its researchers and employees. Its 60 year-long history records the brilliant creations and feats it has made by faithfully upholding the Party's idea of attaching importance to science and technology. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings and Congratulatory Letters to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from
body: Foreign Personages and Organizations Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received messages of greeting and congratulatory letters from foreign personages and organizations on the occasion of the 75th anniversary of Korea's liberation. They included the general chairman and the secretary general of the National Guidance Council of the Pioneer Party of Indonesia, the general chairwoman and the secretary general of the Central Directive Council of the Indonesian Democratic Party of Struggle, the chairman of the Socialist Party of Romania, the chairman of the Supreme Council of the National Socialist Party of Romania, the chairman of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation, the chairwoman of the Party for Peace and Unity of Russia, the chairman of the National Salvation Front of Russia, the chairman of the Central Committee of the Communist Party (Russian Communists), the chairman of the Hungarian Workers' Party, and the general secretary and the international secretary of the Central Committee of the New Yugoslav Communist Party. Among them are also the international secretary of the Serbian Communist Party, the president of the International Group of Italy, the chairman of the Afro-Asian People's Solidarity Organization, the vice-director general of the International Institute of the Juche Idea, the head of the Orchestra of the 21st Century of Russia and other high-ranking personages of political, public and economic circles and representatives of organizations for the study of the Juche idea, organizations supporting Korea's reunification and friendship organizations in China, Russia, Nepal, Cambodia, Philippine, Turkey, India, Japan, Germany, Romania, Bulgaria, Belarus, Switzerland, Sweden, Slovenia, the Czech Republic, Poland, UK, Austria, Spain, South Africa, Ethiopia, Brazil, Venezuela, Peru, Ecuador, New Zealand and Australia. Meanwhile, the general secretary and the international secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Venezuela sent messages of greeting to the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Rodong Sinmun

title: Ri Pyong Chol Guides Recovery from Typhoon Damage in Jangyon County
body: Ri Pyong Chol, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the WPK and vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission of the WPK, guided the work for eradicating the aftermath of typhoon in Nulsan, Changpha and Hakrim co-op farms in Jangyon County, South Hwanghae Province. He learned in detail about the damage on those farms and underscored the need for the officials and agricultural workers to push forward the work to eradicate the aftermath of typhoon as soon as possible in hearty response to the idea and intention of the Party. He acquainted himself with farmers' living and encouraged them to successfully wrap up this year's farming with confidence and courage that as our Party leads us, there is nothing to fear whatever typhoons. He underlined the need for the officials of elementary Party organizations and Party members to further enhance their responsibility and roles to successfully lead and help the farmers fully display their mission as masters responsible for the granary of the country. He also discussed the measures for manuring and cultivating well the crops in the typhoon-stricken fields and for harvesting every crop. Rodong Sinmun

title: Pak Pong Ju Guides Work for Eradicating Aftermath of Typhoon in Jangyon County
body: Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the WPK, guided the work for eradicating the aftermath of typhoon on different farms in Jangyon County of South Hwanghae Province. He met with officials and agricultural workers of the Sokjang, Chuhwa and Rakyon Co-op Farms to learn in detail about the damage on those co-op farms. Saying that the Party shares bitters and sweets with the people all the time, he called for firmly defending the agricultural front, the major thrust area in defending socialism, rallied close around the Party in single mind, bearing in mind that the rosy future is guaranteed only when they believe in and follow the Party only. He underlined the need to pay deep attention to the living of farmers who suffered from typhoon damage, to make more achievements in the campaign for eradicating the aftermath of typhoon by making the farmers give full play to their mental power and to enhance the role of the Party organizations in minimizing the damage to the crops. He called on officials of the farms to eradicate the aftermath of typhoon as soon as possible, introduce scientific farming methods positively and increase the proportion of mechanization in farming. Rodong Sinmun

title: Vice-Chairmen of WPK Central Committee Inspect Recovery from Damage
body: in Various Farms of South Hwanghae Province Kim Jae Ryong, Ri Il Hwan, Choe Hwi, Pak Thae Dok, Kim Yong Chol and Kim Hyong Jun, vice-chairmen of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), made field survey of the sites for the recovery from heavy damage by typhoon in various farms of Jangyon and Thaetan counties, South Hwanghae Province. The campaign for recovery from damage by typhoon is being dynamically waged with full efforts exerted by the Party and the state, true to the calls of the Central Committee of the WPK. A full-dress campaign to minimize damage to crops by Typhoon No. 8 is underway in South Hwanghae Province against this backdrop. The vice-chairmen of the Party Central Committee went to the relevant farms on Aug. 30 and 31 to learn in detail about the recovery from damage. They sprayed nutrition liquid, applied fertilizer and picked up corns together with agricultural workers and encouraged them to turn out as one in the campaign for recovery from damage, being fully aware of their mission as the masters responsible for the granary of the country. They told them Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was very much worried about the people in the typhoon-affected areas, and called upon them to overcome on-going trials and greet the 75th founding anniversary of the Party with proud labor achievements. The frontline-style political work conducted by the vice-chairmen of the Party Central Committee greatly inspired the agricultural workers. They sat knee to knee with the officials and farmers of relevant farms to discuss the practical measures for minimizing the drop in the harvest and gave convincing explanation about the Party's policy of scientific farming. Their field guidance greatly enlivened the recovery sites. Officials and agricultural workers of various farms in South Hwanghae Province, much encouraged by the field guidance, are full of faith and optimism to remove the damage at an early date and greet the 8th Congress of the WPK most significantly by raising good crops. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Wreath to Bier of Late Pak Kyong Suk
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un sent a wreath to the bier of the late anti-Japanese revolutionary fighter Pak Kyong Suk on Aug. 31 to express his deep condolences over her death. Pak Kyong Suk bravely fought for Korea's liberation as the first generation of our revolution and remained true to the leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea till the last moments of her life. Rodong Sinmun

title: The Whole Province Has Turned Out
body: South Hwanghae Province exerts all its efforts to minimize a decrease in its grain yield caused by the typhoon damage. Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un said that it is one of top-priority tasks to be surely carried out by our Party to go among the people and encourage and sincerely help them when they are in trouble and feel difficult. True to this, its officials lead the people to work hard setting personal examples to them. All the officials and agricultural workers of the province devotedly do their utmost to repair the typhoon damage at an early date, achieving one success after the other in their work. Jong Yong Chol

title: Beet Processing Line Laid at Kujang County Foodstuff Factory
body: The Kujang County Foodstuff Factory has established a beet-processing workshop anew and become able to produce raw materials for sugar on its own. The line comprises a well-equipped building for production and other auxiliary building. It has a floor space of thousands of square meters. Raw materials for sugar were produced successfully for trial at the line. Kim Myong Hun

title: Power Transmission and Supply System Restored
body: Ichon County, Kangwon Province has finished restoring its power transmission and supply system. The officials of the Ichon County Power Distribution Station courageously tried to restore its power system in close connection with the provincial Power Distribution Station to ensure that the flood damage of the county was repaired with success and relieve its people of hardships in their lives as soon as possible. The soldiers of the Korean People’s Army, too, joined them in making up for the damage. Consequently, many power substations of the county restored their power supply systems within 48 hours after the outset of their work. Rodong Sinmun

title: Work for Protecting Bank of River Jangja Progresses Apace
body: The officials and working people of Jagang Province vigorously push ahead with the embankment of the Jangja River. They finished leveling the ground along the shores of the river for more than 10 kilometers in a short time and started to coat them with large stones. Besides, they widen and straighten roads along them at the same time. The officials and working people of Manpho City in particular display high spirits at a difficult section of the riverside. They disposed of a huge amount of its soil and laid the foundation of its embankment within a few days. They are now successfully coating its bank with large stones. Jon Myong Il

title: All Efforts and Means Enlisted to Prevent Typhoon Damage
body: Now that a warning has been issued against the advent of Typhoon No. 9 active countermeasures are adopted in the regions of Korea lying along its East Sea to ward off the damage from it. Kangwon Province ensures that the Wonsan Youth Power Station and its other hydroelectric power plants control the water level of their dams in a far-sighted way and examine the safety of their generation equipment and hydraulic structures lest they are damaged by the typhoon. South Hamgyong Province held an emergency video conference on the problem of protecting the lives and properties of its people and minimizing the damage from Typhoon No. 9. North Hamgyong Province pays deep attention to preventing flood and landslide damage and the inundation of farmland in its mountain regions and finding out and removing the dangerous spots of its riverbanks. Rodong Sinmun

title: Based on Cooperation with Agricultural Science Research Institutions
body: The officials and agricultural workers of Yonan County, South Hwanghae Province, strive to recover their typhoon damage as soon as possible and minimize a decrease in their grain yield. Closely joining hands with agricultural science institutes they correctly judge what damage the typhoon caused to their cooperative farms and their workteams and sub-workteams plus their fields and plots respectively and lose no time in adopting relevant agro-technological measures. They are now pooling their wisdom with agricultural scientists to repair their typhoon damage and successfully hit their grain output target this year and doing all they can to improve the growing conditions of their crops. Pak Yong Jin

title: Urgent Measures Taken in DPRK to Minimize Typhoon Damage
body: Urgent measures are being taken for minimizing the damage in the situation that heavy rain and strong wind are expected to hit various areas of the DPRK, due to the effect of Typhoon No. 9. Officials of the Party and power organs at all levels are conducting intensive information campaign among people to let them deeply understand the importance of work for preventing typhoon damage and methods of coping with its crisis. And they are taking immediate and thoroughgoing measures after making detailed survey of dangerous spots while frequently examining the conditions of buildings, roads, croplands, railways, railway tunnels and others in their areas. The units in charge of city management have repaired roofs and fixed trees and road lamps in a responsible way, as part of the efforts to minimize the typhoon damage, and removed sediments from sewerages and put water pumps in good condition for smooth drainage. The power distribution stations in each province, city and county have taken scrupulous measures for protecting electrical equipment and power transmission towers, while checking them for stable power supply. Units in charge of dams and floodgates are directing big efforts to comprehensively analyzing hydro-meteorological data, checking water level in real time and properly regulating it. Fishery and offshore farms on the east coast, which are put on special-class alert for strong wind and high wave, let their ships move to safe areas and take measures to protect landing equipment and culture grounds. Officials and working people in the field of national heritage preservation also made a survey of all the objects, which might be damaged by typhoon, and are taking full security measures like readjustment of waterways and revetment. Rodong Sinmun

title: New Mural Tombs and Relics Dating Back to Koguryo Kingdom Unearthed
