body: Two more mural tombs and relics dating back to Koguryo Kingdom were recently unearthed in the DPRK. The Archaeological Institute under the Academy of Social Sciences excavated those tombs and nine gold ornaments in Wolji-ri, Anak County of South Hwanghae Province and checked their historical references. The Archaeology Society of the DPRK verified that the mural tombs were constructed in the first half of the sixth century and appraised their archaeological importance. Judging from historical documents saying that only high-ranking officials could be buried in mural tombs during the period of Koguryo Kingdom, it affords clear proof that the area was one of important administrative hubs of the kingdom. Rodong Sinmun

title: Anniversary of Songdowon International Children's Camp Marked
body: The Songdowon International Children's Camp marked its 60th founding anniversary. The camp is a palace for children without an equal in the world and a comprehensive extra-curricular educational base for them built under the great loving care and benevolence of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. The President chose the best place in Songdowon, scenic spot on the east coast of the DPRK, as the site for the camp and saw to it that the foundation of the camp was known to the world on Aug. 17, Juche 49 (1960). He visited the camp several times, taking deep care of schoolchildren, hope of the country, so that they would grow up vigorously in the cradle of happiness. Chairman Kim Jong Il made sure that the larger and wonderful camp was built so as to host even foreign children and solved all the issues arising in the management and operation of the camp. He left the history of legendary loving care for children, personally visiting the camp on his journey to frontline units and making sure that all measures were taken for children to spend pleasant days without any slightest inconveniences. For the past six decades since its founding the camp has made great achievements and fully discharged its duties for the organization and operation of the camp, true to the intention of the Party which puts forward children as the king of the country. A meeting was held on Wednesday to convey a congratulatory message from the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) to the teaching staff of the camp on the occasion. Present there were Choe Hwi, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the WPK, and teaching staff of the camp. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Egyptian President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Abdel Fattah al-Sisi, president of the Arab Republic of Egypt, on Tuesday. The president said in his message that he was very pleased to extend warm greeting and the sincerest wishes to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and the people of the DPRK on the occasion of the founding anniversary of the friendly DPRK. Confirming that Egypt attaches great importance to the good bilateral friendly relations, he hoped that those relations would as ever develop in conformity with the common interests. He sincerely wished Kim Jong Un happiness and the Korean people welfare and development. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Greetings to Vietnamese Political Party Leader
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), Wednesday sent a message of greeting to Nguyen Phu Trong, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam and president of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam. The message extended warm congratulations to the general secretary and the friendly party, government and people of Vietnam on the occasion of the 75th founding anniversary of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam. It said that the Socialist Republic of Vietnam repelled outside forces' aggression and interference and won a great victory in the struggle for national liberation, the country's reunification and socialist construction for the past 75 years after its foundation. Kim Jong Un said in the message that he was very pleased that the Vietnamese people have made many achievements in the struggle for building a prosperous and civilized socialist state under the leadership of the Communist Party of Vietnam led by the general secretary. Expressing the belief that the long-standing relations of friendship and cooperation between the two parties and between the two countries would further develop onto a new high stage in the spirit of the agreement made with the general secretary in March last year, the message sincerely wished him greater success in his responsible work to lead the party and state. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Tribute to President Kim Il Sung by Koreans in China
body: Koreans in China held a ceremony of laying floral baskets before the statue of President Kim Il Sung at Yuwen Middle School in Jilin on August 26 to commemorate the 10th anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's visit to the school. Laid before the statue were floral baskets in the names of the General Association of Koreans in China, the family of Ri Min, a China-resident Korean related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, and Yuwen Middle School in Jilin. The participants made a bow after laying the floral baskets before the statue. Rodong Sinmun

title: Blueberry Picking Concluded in Samjiyon City
body: Situated at the foot of Mt Paektu, Samjiyon City finished picking blueberries. The Samjiyon Blueberry Drinks Factory operated its machines at full capacity, thereby preserving large quantities of blueberries to meet technological demand for them. The city makes efforts to ensure that various kinds of blueberry drinks and processed blueberries are the favorite foodstuffs of all the people in the country. Jon Chol Ju

title: Foundation Work Completed, Walling Started
body: Motor vehicles were provided, hundreds of thousands of concrete blocks produced and formworks for concrete floors made in a foresighted way in the construction sites of dwellings in the flood-torn area of Kaesong City. Consequently, a breakthrough has been made in finishing their construction at an early date. The officials and working people of the city finished their groundwork for dwellings for more than 100 families in a short time and then proceeded to build their walls. The field headquarters meticulously guides the working people in their building operations with the quick construction of the dwellings and arranges for their surroundings to be put in order beforehand. Thanks to the assiduous efforts of the city, success after success is gained in building the dwellings despite its difficulties and converting it into a paradise. Jong Ryu Chol

title: Great Results Attained in Their Construction
body: The officials and builders of the Capital City Construction Commission(CCCC) register great results in repairing the flood damage of Ichon County. The builders produced hundreds of thousands of concrete blocks for dwellings and excavated the ground for them for thousands of cubic meters in a short time till August 30. They did this with ardor at the same time. On the basis of their successes the officials and constructors of many construction companies under the control of the CCCC deposit concrete on the sites of dwellings for their foundation and build their frameworks at a high speed. Rodong Sinmun

title: 60% of Dwelling-house Frame Works Completed
body: The servicemen of the Korean People’s Army achieve successes in recovering the flood damage in Taechong-ri, Unpha County. They started to build dwellings there on August 24. They leveled the ground for them and finished depositing tens of thousands of cubic meters of concrete there. They have built their frameworks by 60% as of September 3. They ceaselessly push ahead with their building operations according to their schedule to conclude their dwellings with speed. Rodong Sinmun

title: Bettering Content of Education as Required by the Times
body: Institutions of education across the country try harder as ever to intensify their scientific and technological education further during a drastic revolution in education. Universities continue to propel forward the innovation of their teaching programs and the practical utilization, synthesization and modernization of relevant lesson plans to compile the contents of their education scientifically under their talent-training plan and improve them without interruption. The spheres of higher education and common education ensure that a proportion of practice, experiments, practical training and functional training is raised in education considerably. Kong Ro Hyok

title: Strengthening Ranks of Teachers and Improving Tele-education
body: Many universities of education and teacher-training colleges strive energetically to bring up future teachers. To this end they direct big efforts to raising the qualifications of teachers in schools and kindergartens of all levels. Wonsan University of Education has developed a tele-lecture program. Consequently, the teachers of rural or mountain regions, too, have become able to be given tele-lectures anywhere, anytime and anyhow. Ri Kye Sun Sariwon University of Education, Kanggye Teachers Training College, Haeju Kim Jong Thae University of Education and other universities, too, make endeavors to establish their remote education system anew and improve its level, thereby acquiring excellent experiences in their education. Rodong Sinmun

title: Walling of 130-odd Dwelling Houses Finished
body: KPA Soldiers finished building the walls of over 130 dwelling houses in the flood-ravaged area of Taechong-ri, Unpha County. Giving priority to the quality of their dwelling houses they are now trying hard to make the best job of them. They come up with one rational working method after the other to help toward ensuring the speed and quality of their building operations. They are now devotedly building the floors of their dwelling houses with aggregate and successively pushing forward other construction projects, too, without cease. Rodong Sinmun

title: Dwelling-house Foundation Work Concluded, Frame Works Make Headway
body: Soldiers of the Korean People’s Army bring about daily innovations in restoring the flood-hit area of Cholwon County. They excavated the ground for the foundations of dwellings in their charge and removed far more than 1 000 cubic meters of soil within two days. They also deposited concrete there in a day. This was done at a village in the county till August 31. They are now building the frameworks of their dwellings with all speed. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Syrian President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Bashar Al-Assad, president of the Syrian Arab Republic, on September 2. The Syrian president extended the warmest and heart-felt congratulations to Kim Jong Un and the friendly people of the DPRK on the occasion of the 72nd founding anniversary of the DPRK. The message said that under the wise guidance of the great preceding leaders and Kim Jong Un, the DPRK has covered the path of progress and prosperity since its foundation and it would develop as an indefatigable independent and sovereign state standing for truth and peace against war in the future, too. It wished Kim Jong Un good health and happiness all the time and the DPRK greater progress and prosperity. Rodong Sinmun

title: New Novel Published in DPRK
body: The April 15 Literary Production Company in the DPRK recently brought out the full-length novel "Red Glow All over the Land" (authored by Kim Chang Hun), part of the serial "Immortal Guidance". The setting of the novel is the period between the autumn of Juche 59 (1970), when the Fifth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) was at hand, and February, 1974 when the modeling of the whole society on Kimilsungism was declared. It vividly depicts the historical fact that Chairman Kim Jong Il formulated the revolutionary idea of President Kim Il Sung as Kimilsungism with his rare wisdom and energetic ideological and theoretical activities and declared the modeling of the whole society on Kimilsungism as the supreme programme of the WPK. Rodong Sinmun

title: Memorial Service Held for Korean Victims of Massacre after Great Kanto Quake
body: A memorial service took place in a park of Tokyo Metropolis on Sept. 1 on the lapse of 97 years since the heinous massacre of Koreans committed by the Japanese imperialists in the wake of the great Kanto quake. It was hosted by the Japan-Korea Association. The participants mourned the Koreans killed by the Japanese imperialists. A speaker at the service recalled that Japan spread a false rumor in the wake of the great quake and mobilized army, police and even ultra-right conservative bodies to brutally massacre innocent Koreans. Misconduct to cover up and deny the indelible historical fact is getting pronounced in the Japanese society, the speaker charged. The speaker stressed that the fact will always be remembered and Japan is obliged to pay for it. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Floral Baskets
body: from Members of Board of Directors of Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received floral baskets from Sai Tiejen, honorary vice-chairman of the Board of Directors of the Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation, Jin Xian, director of the Board of Directors of the foundation, Cui Tongwen, honorary director of the Board of Directors of the foundation, and members of the foundation Lin Gennan, Zhu Jinghao, Zhan Xueyan and Zhao Bin on Friday on the occasion of the 72nd founding anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. Meanwhile, he was presented with a floral basket by Tang Yiming, member of the China Dandong branch of the foundation, on the same day. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sent Open Letter to All Party Members in Pyongyang
body: The following is the full text of an open letter sent by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un to all the Party members in the capital city of Pyongyang during his inspection of a typhoon-afflicted area in South Hamgyong Province: To All the Comrade Party Members in the Capital City of Pyongyang Dear all the comrade Party members in the capital city of Pyongyang, I extend my greetings to you who are working harder than anybody else in the intensive struggle for making preparations for the grand events to be held soon in celebration of the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea and for its historic Eighth Congress. In hearty response to the major decisions the WPK Central Committee adopted in the face of manifold threats to the security of the state and lives of the people, you are working with devotion for their implementation; thanks to the pivotal role you have played, Pyongyang, the capital city of our revolution, is maintaining its security in the main. But, as you all have learned through newspaper and radio, various parts of the country suffered severe damage simultaneously from floods and a typhoon that hit them in succession recently, and an intensive struggle is going on to remove the aftereffects. To make matters worse, typhoon No. 9 followed them, inflicting damage on Kangwon Province and North and South Hamgyong provinces on the east coast. In particular, dwelling houses and public buildings were submerged or damaged in about ten cities and counties in South Hamgyong Province, including Tanchon, Sinpho and Hongwon, leaving many people homeless. To take houses alone as an example, more than 1 000 of them collapsed. I have been reported that North Hamgyong Province suffered no less damage. Although we had taken all the conceivable preventive measures closely monitoring the typhoon since it was coming up north hundreds of kilometres away, it brought unexpectedly heavy rains and high winds, resulting in great damage. In this critical situation which admits not a moment of delay and, what is more, when many of the major civilian construction forces and Korean People's Army units have already been deployed in the damaged areas in Kangwon and North and South Hwanghae provinces, the WPK Central Committee has decided to unburden itself of the problem of strongly supporting the reconstruction project sites in North and South Hamgyong provinces to none other than you, Party members in the capital city. Needless to say, there are also many Party members and organizations and major forces of the working class in these provinces, and it is of my belief that they, too, will fully understand the intention of the WPK Central Committee and do a good job of the reconstruction projects. However, it is the view of the WPK Central Committee that it would be more meaningful when the core Party members in the capital city, bodyguards who are defending it nearer to it than anybody else, hold aloft a banner and march to the reconstruction project sites. It is a national trait that all the parts of the country always defend the capital, its heart, in every possible way, but it can also be called our proud national trait that the citizens of the capital city give sincere support and encouragement to the provincial people when they are in difficulties. Party members in the capital city are the core force that our Party places its greatest trust in. If they go and work in the damaged areas true to the call of the Party, we will gain great strength which cannot be compared to the economic losses incurred as a result of the destructive natural disaster. Their arrival at the damaged areas after a forced march from Pyongyang will immediately instil a great encouragement into the Party members and other people there, and the unity of the whole Party will be further consolidated with intention and intimate feelings in the course of their struggle to weather and break through the trials and hardships together. This year we have experienced special difficulties owing to the continuing worldwide healthcare crisis concurring with the natural disasters, but we are overcoming all these difficulties bravely on the strength of the unity of the Party and the people. This is never a year of calamity and disaster but a year of struggle, advance and unity, in which we are achieving firmer solidarity through a super-intense, arduous struggle. Over the past 75 years, our Party flag has fluttered on the victorious hills, never with the wind of those times, but thanks to the ardent feelings of loyalty and patriotism of our Party members, who have turned out whatever the tasks as one to reply to the calls of the WPK Central Committee with outstanding feats. At this decisive and responsible moment, when a turning point has to be created for achieving another meaningful victory noteworthy in the history of our Party and the revolutionary struggle, the Party members in the capital city should be standard-bearers and a shock-brigade. The WPK Central Committee requests our Party members in the capital city to turn out and volunteer in high spirits for the reconstruction projects in the damaged areas in North and South Hamgyong provinces in order to resolutely defend the 75th founding anniversary of the WPK and its Eighth Congress. October 10 is approaching nearer, and even though we are under difficult conditions and time is not enough, we can never leave the many new disaster victims in North and South Hamgyong provinces to greet the holiday outdoors. The WPK Central Committee calls upon the Party members in the capital city, with the warm care and solicitude of the Party and deep affection of Pyongyang, to wholeheartedly console the people in the damaged areas, help them and work with devotion so that they can get rid of the aftereffects as soon as possible. Dear comrade Party members in the capital city of Pyongyang, Now the front where the reconstruction campaign is being conducted to relieve the disaster victims of their inconveniences and sufferings is the forefront to which our Party must direct all its efforts. That is why the WPK Central Committee has decided to organize elite divisions, involving 12 000 hardcore Party members in the capital city, to be dispatched immediately to North and South Hamgyong provinces, respectively. Any officials and other Party members of the Pyongyang municipal committee and district committees of the WPK, city-level and district-level institutions, factories and other enterprises can volunteer to join these first-ever combat units, and receive recommendations from their respective WPK committees. If the divisions, before leaving, hold a rally and harden their resolve in the square in front of the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, where Comrades Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il are preserved in their lifetime appearance, and march to the reconstruction project sites, the great leaders will be very pleased. Your major task at the reconstruction sites is to be the point men and sparks in implementing the Party's policy in the vanguard of the working youth and soldiers who have turned out to restore the damaged areas. As befitting core Party members from the capital city, you should be a model for others by displaying burning stamina and performing well-ordered action in all respects of restoration struggle and living during the whole period, from going to the reconstruction sites to withdrawing from them. Explaining to the people in the afflicted areas the genuine desire of the WPK Central Committee to turn the misfortune into blessings and get them to live in better houses and in a better environment, you should sincerely help them to carry out the reconstruction projects with confidence and optimism. You should never impose a burden on the local people nor put on airs abusing your assistance, but be modest and behave faithfully; and while learning from the unyielding way of life and temperament of the local people who are braving the difficulties out, you should open-heartedly teach them the good experiences and advanced technical skills created in the capital city. As the elite divisions of the Party members of the capital city, who are going to be dispatched, are to build mainly houses and public facilities, units under the direct control of the divisions should be organized involving those who served in the army units specializing in construction and therefore are highly skilled in construction. These units should complete their projects wonderfully, raise the quality of all the reconstruction projects and teach all the advanced construction skills they possess to the local builders not only with advanced construction methods and skills but also with the attitude of an educator who does all their work with a sense of responsibility and assiduousness. Party members at ministries and central institutions should provide promptly and in good time the materials, equipment and goods necessary for the reconstruction projects with an attitude of being combatants in the restoration areas, so as to fulfil their duties becoming Party members in the capital city. I am going to dispatch the divisions, formed of excellent Party members in the capital city, to help the people in North and South Hamgyong provinces, but what worries me most is their health. Even though these Party members have been trained much and tested at the production sites and through practical struggle, they may feel difficult and tired as they have to wage a 24-7 campaign in the autumn winds in the damaged areas. The commanding officers and political workers who are in charge of the divisions of Party members should show meticulous concern on the health and life of all their members and take care of them with a tender heart, so that they all can finish the projects and come back to the capital city of Pyongyang and their dear houses in good health. I firmly believe that the elite divisions of our Party members in the capital city organized and dispatched to North and South Hamgyong provinces under the direction of the WPK Central Committee, as a special detachment for staunchly defending the celebrations of the 75th anniversary of the WPK and its Eighth Congress, would perform with credit their honourable mission and combat tasks and achieve a great victory. For our great people, For our great single-hearted unity, For our great state, And for our great October holiday, Let us launch a brave, sacred struggle! Forward, comrade Party members in the capital city! In a typhoon-afflicted area in South Hamgyong Province Kim Jong Un September 5, 2020

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Lao President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), received a message of greeting from Bounnang Vorachith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party (LPRP) and president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic (LPDR), on September 4. The Lao president in the message extended best wishes to Kim Jong Un, and through him, to the WPK Central Committee, the fraternal government and all the people of the DPRK on behalf of the LPRP Central Committee, the government and the National Assembly and people of the LPDR and for his part on the occasion of the 72nd founding anniversary of the DPRK. The message said: I am very pleased that the Korean people have achieved comprehensive and great successes for the past 72 years since the foundation of the DPRK and for the past 75 years since the foundation of the WPK in firmly preserving the political stability of the country, steadily developing the economy, strengthening the national defence and security and improving the people's livelihood under the experienced and determined guidance of the WPK. I am also very glad about the ever-promoting status and role of the DPRK in the regional and international arenas. I take great pride in the traditional and favorable relations of friendship and cooperation between the two countries, which have steadily developed to provide the peoples of the two countries with substantial benefits and made tangible contributions to regional and global peace, stability cooperation and development since they were provided by the preceding leaders of the two countries. I am firmly convinced that the DPRK will achieve ceaseless development and progress in attaining its goal of building a powerful socialist country and achieve peaceful reunification of the country free from outsiders' interference under the determined leadership of the WPK headed by you. The Lao president, availing himself of that auspicious opportunity, sincerely wished Kim Jong Un good health and happiness and fresh bigger success in his noble and honorable work for turning the state into a powerful one. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Convenes Enlarged Meeting of Executive Policy Council of C. C., WPK in Typhoon-hit Area before Inspection
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, convened and guided the enlarged meeting of the Executive Policy Council of the Central Committee of the WPK for organizing the campaign for recovery from natural disasters in areas in South and North Hamgyong provinces hit by Typhoon No.9. Attending the meeting were members of the Executive Policy Council of the Party Central Committee and leading officials of the Organizational Leadership Department, the Information and Publicity Department and other major departments of the Party Central Committee. Also present at the meeting were Vice Marshal of the Korean People's Army (KPA) Pak Jong Chon, chief of the KPA General Staff, and other KPA commanding officers. A vigorous campaign to eradicate the aftermath of the floods and typhoon which recently hit several areas of the DPRK has been underway. Against this backdrop South and North Hamgyong provinces were hit by Typhoon No. 9 that did damage to some areas of the two provinces on Sept. 3. Heavy rain and strong wind by Typhoon No. 9 caused damage to some areas of the two provinces. So Supreme Leader of the Party, state and army Kim Jong Un immediately dispatched vice-chairmen of the Party Central Committee to the typhoon-hit areas so that they could learn in detail about the damage to each field. On Sept. 5, he arrived in the typhoon-hit areas in South Hamgyong Province and received a detailed report on the typhoon damage from vice-chairmen of the Party Central Committee. Heavy rain and strong wind by Typhoon No. 9 destroyed over 1 000 dwellings along the coastline areas of the two provinces each and not a few public buildings and farmlands were inundated. The meeting had an in-depth discussion about the issue of the recovery from damage in the typhoon-hit areas of the two provinces and studied and decided on the detailed measures such as organization of building force to be urgently dispatched to the areas, designs and material transport. The Supreme Leader underscored the need to make the recovery campaign from damage an important political work and an occasion of consolidating the single-mined unity, not just an economic and business work for eradicating the aftermath of natural disasters, and said that it would be good to make the Capital City positively aid the provinces so as to make the noble spiritual and moral virtues of taking preferential care of those living a difficult life and overcoming difficulties while sharing joy and sorrow with them all the time in the whole society a socialist custom. He also said that for the party members, especially those in the capital to take the lead in aiding the provinces when the country undergoes difficulties and hardships would make a great contribution to the strengthening of the single-minded unity of our society. And he said that the Party Central Committee will appeal to the core party members in Pyongyang City to turn out after organizing capital party member divisions. He expressed belief that party members of the capital would play a vanguard role in the recovery campaign in the disaster-stricken areas true to the intention of the Central Committee of the Party and fully demonstrate the single-minded unity of our society, sharing weal and woe with party members and workers in local areas and that they would do a large share of work in the holy campaign ahead of the 75th founding anniversary and the 8th Congress of the Party. Saying that it is necessary to issue a general mobilization order to the transport field this time as during the campaign for recovery from the damage in the northern part of the country a few years ago and push ahead with the transport organization and control to ensure the sufficient supply of materials necessary for rehabilitation, he took measures one by one after estimating the amount of major materials needed for rehabilitation. Expressing belief that the People's Army would faithfully fulfill its mission and duty as defender of the country and creator of the people's happiness, he issued an order of the Central Military Commission of the WPK of calling for conducting a campaign for recovery of South Hamgyong Province and North Hamgyong Province from damage. At the enlarged meeting of the Executive Policy Council, Kim Song Il, chairman of the South Hamgyong Provincial Committee of the WPK, was dismissed and a vice-director of the Organizational Leadership Department of the C.C., WPK was newly appointed as chairman of the provincial party committee. After concluding the meeting, the Supreme Leader inspected the typhoon-hit areas in South Hamgyong Province. He was accompanied by vice-chairmen of the Central Committee of the Party, commanding officers of the People's Army and leading officials of the major departments of the Central Committee of the Party. Pointing out that as it was shown by the damage by the recent tidal wave, the conditions of the overall coastline of our country is poor and sea dikes were not properly built, he stressed that this issue is also one of the work to be quickly tackled by us as an important political task. He noted that given the potential exposure to the wildness of nature in the future, it is necessary to make a plan for moving residential districts near the sea to safe zone in the future while thoroughly examining and considering their safety. He said that in order to build permanent quality coastline structures for protecting residential districts and farmlands from the effect of tidal wave and typhoon, it is necessary to make good study and plan for building sea dike and harbor breakwater according to the standard method of construction, with the involvement of science research units of the marine and hydraulic engineering field and designing institutes specializing in the design of harbor and wharf breakwater, and build them under yearly plan by mobilizing state force. Learning about the growth of the crops damaged by typhoon, he called for taking positive agricultural and technological measures for minimizing the reduction of the yield. He expressed the conviction that our Party and people would certainly make an advance while winning great and fresh victory single-mindedly, and our state would certainly be more prosperous however wild the nature may be and how many difficulties we may face. Political News Team

title: Faunal and Floral Exhibition House Newly Built
body: Situated in the Rangnim Mountains Mt Oga is a nature reserve, a national treasure of our country. It boasts a pass crossed by President Kim Il Sung when he travelled quite a distance to study in Korea and did that again a few years after to liberate it from Japanese colonial rule. The officials and employees of the Ogasan Nature Reserve Management Station newly built a faunal and floral exhibition hall with a total floor space of 300-odd square meters to take better care of their nature reserve and show the natural scenery of the mountain throughout the year. Stuffed bears, badgers, pheasants, heath cocks and other animals as well as more than 800 specimens of plants like a wild insam, an Amur cock, a barrenwort and a rhododendron are displayed at the exhibition hall. There are also a pavilion and a resting place round the exhibition hall, where visitors can relax and enjoy the natural scenery of Mt Oga. Jon Myong Il

title: Construction of 80-odd Schools Pushed Ahead with Actively
body: True to the lofty plan of the Party to provide the rising generation with better learning conditions, North Phyongan Province vigorously pushes ahead with the construction of its 80-odd schools. It started to build the schools at the beginning of this year. Its construction projects have now reached 80%. The frameworks of most of the schools are completed, whereas those of the rest of them are built at their final stage. Teaching tools, too, are procured beforehand. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floor Building of Dwellings Concluded
body: Soldiers build dwellings at a high speed in the flood-torn area of Taechong-ri, Unpha County. Although they could not use heavy machines in their work they rapidly deposited concrete on the floors of dwellings in their charge in the area of Workteam 7 of the Taechong Cooperative Farm in a staunch attacking spirit, thus finishing it as of September 5. Rodong Sinmun

title: "General Kim Jong Il, the Sun of Songun" Awarded Kim Jong Il Prize
body: Kim Jong Il Prize was awarded to "General Kim Jong Il, the Sun of Songun", a collection of revolutionary anecdotes, by the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly (SPA) of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK). The collection is a monumental national treasure which made a great contribution to encouraging the grand revolutionary advance of the DPRK people who are waging a dynamic struggle for glorifying the precious revolutionary career and undying revolutionary feats of Chairman Kim Jong Il for all ages, building a powerful socialist country and accomplishing the revolutionary cause of Juche under the guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. A relevant decree of the SPA Presidium was adopted on Aug. 22. Rodong Sinmun

title: Party Members in Pyongyang Volunteer to Join in Damage Recovery Projects
body: in South and North Hamgyong Provinces All the officials and Party members in Pyongyang are turning out in the reconstruction campaign in response to the call of the Central Committee of the Party after receiving the historic open letter of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un with emotion. On Sunday alone, more than 300 000 Party members volunteered to join the reconstruction campaign in South and North Hamgyong provinces out of the passion to carry out the plan of the Party Central Committee, and other working people are following the Party members, the numbers of volunteers increasing. Further rising is the surging spirit of the Party members in Pyongyang to certainly finish the recovery from damage in the period set by the Party and at the level desired by the Party and make a report of victory and glory to the Party Central Committee. Rodong Sinmun

title: Blasting of 260 000 Cubic Meter Earth Successful at Sunchon Limestone Mine
body: Workers at the Sunchon Limestone Mine successfully carried out the blasting of 260 000 cubic meter earth on Sunday. The blasting of earth provided a firm guarantee for mining in bulk and made it possible to supply raw materials to the leading cement production base without letup. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from President of Montenegro
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Milo Djukanovic, president of Montenegro, on September 2. The president in the message extended sincere congratulations to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un on behalf of the people of Montenegro and on his own behalf on the occasion of September 9, the national holiday of the DPRK, wholeheartedly wishing the DPRK and its people greater progress and prosperity. The message affirmed that Montenegro would further develop the overall cooperation with the DPRK for guaranteeing prosperity of the two countries and ensuring international peace and stability. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from King of Bahrain
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Hamad Bin Isa al-Khalifa, king of the Kingdom of Bahrain, on September 1. The king in the message said that he was pleased to extend warm congratulations and best wishes to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un on behalf of the government and people of the Kingdom of Bahrain and on his own behalf on the occasion of the national holiday of the friendly DPRK. The message sincerely wished Kim Jong Un happiness in good health all the time and the people of the DPRK steady progress and prosperity under his wise leadership. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from President of Myanmar
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Win Myint, president of the Republic of the Union of Myanmar, on Sept. 2. The president in the message said that the president and people of the Republic of the Union of Myanmar extended greetings and congratulations to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and the people of the DPRK upon the 72nd founding anniversary of the DPRK. The message most sincerely wished Kim Jong Un good health and happiness and the DPRK steady progress and prosperity. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from President of DR Congo
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Felix Antoine Tshilombo Tshisekedi, president of the Democratic Republic of Congo, on Aug. 27. The president in his message extended warm congratulations to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un on behalf of all the people of DR Congo and on his own behalf on the occasion of the 72nd founding anniversary of the DPRK. He reaffirmed his firm will to further boost the bilateral friendly and cooperative relations. He wholeheartedly wished Kim Jong Un good health and big success in his work. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Gabonese President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Ali Bongo Ondimba, president of the Gabonese Republic, on August 18. The president in his message extended warm congratulations to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un on behalf of the government and people of the Gabonese Republic and on his own behalf on the occasion of September 9, the founding anniversary of the DPRK. He sincerely wished Kim Jong Un happiness in good health and the fraternal people of the DPRK steady success. He expressed his will to boost and develop the friendly relations between the two countries in line with mutual interests. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Tajik President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Emomali Rahmon, president of the Republic of Tajikistan, on September 4. The president in his message extended his sincere congratulations and best wishes to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un on the occasion of the founding anniversary of the DPRK, its national holiday. He wholeheartedly wished Kim Jong Un good health and success in his state activities and the friendly Korean people peace and prosperity. He expressed belief that the friendly and cooperative relations between Tajikistan and the DPRK would steadily develop in conformity with the interests of the peoples of the two countries. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Ugandan President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Yoweri Kaguta Museveni, president of the Republic of Uganda, on Aug. 20. The president in his message extended his warm greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un on behalf of the government and people of the Republic of Uganda and on his own behalf on the occasion of the 72nd founding anniversary of the DPRK. Saying that he values the historic and friendly relations between the two countries very much, he hoped that he would continue to do work with Kim Jong Un and the government of the DPRK in order to further develop the bilateral relations. He wished Kim Jong Un good health and the fraternal people of the DPRK peace and prosperity. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Baskets to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Foreign Organizations and Figure
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received floral baskets on Monday from the family of Zhang Weihua, a Chinese anti-Japanese revolutionary martyr, the Japan Committee for the Independent and Peaceful Reunification of Korea, the Tokyo-Pyongyang Rainbow Bridge, Osaka of the Citizens Solidarity Demanding Earlier Normalization of the Relations between Japan and the DPRK, Jindallae Saphariny, president of the Jindallae Children's Foundation, and Professor Emeritus Kazuyoshi Hishiki at Hiroshima Shudo University of Japan, on the occasion of the 72nd founding anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Captains Regent of San Marino
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Alessandro Mancini and Grazia Zafferani, captains regent of the Republic of San Marino, on September 2. The message said: On the occasion of the Founding of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, we would like to express on behalf of the people of San Marino and in our own name our best wishes to Your Excellency and to the friendly people of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. Please accept, Your Excellency, the assurances of our highest consideration and sincere good wishes for Your personal well-being and for the welfare, progress and prosperity of the people of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Basket to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Lao President
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a floral basket from Bounnang Vorachith, president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic who is general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party, on the occasion of the 72nd founding anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. The floral basket was handed over to an official concerned by the Lao ambassador to the DPRK, on Tuesday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Oath-taking Meeting of Party Members in Pyongyang Held
body: A Pyongyang meeting was held in the plaza of the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on Tuesday to pledge to fully demonstrate the might of the special detachment in the campaign for recovery from typhoon damage in hearty response to the appeal of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. 12 000 people recommended by their Party organizations to be members of the elite divisions of the Party members of the capital city, and officials of institutions and industrial establishments in the city lined up in the plaza. Seen at the platform were Kim Jae Ryong, Ri Il Hwan and Choe Hwi, members of the Political Bureau and vice-chairmen of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), Kim Yong Hwan, chairman of the Pyongyang City Committee of the WPK, Choe Hui Thae, chairman of the Pyongyang City People's Committee and commanding officials of the divisions of Party members in the capital city. Prior to the meeting, all the participants bowed to the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. Ri Il Hwan in a report said the Party members in the capital city were granted the greatest privilege and honor by Chairman of the WPK Kim Jong Un to be the standard bearers and shock brigade for the restoration campaign at a decisive and responsible time when another crucial turning point of victory has to be brought about to be specially recorded in the history of our Party and the revolutionary struggle. He referred to the great love for people of the Supreme Leader who devotes his all for the good of the people while traveling a long and arduous way to the damaged sites with the ardent love for people and taking to his heart the pain of the people. The reporter called upon all the combatants to work hard to bring earlier the moment of honor when they would bow to Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il in the plaza of the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun and make a report of proud victory to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un after creating new world-startling heroic and legendary stories. Oath-taking speeches were made at the meeting. Speakers vowed to make a report of loyalty and glory to Kim Jong Un after perfectly carrying out the tasks assigned by the Party at the highest level and at the earliest date. A letter of pledge to Kim Jong Un was adopted at the meeting. Upon authorization of Kim Jong Un, Kim Jae Ryong presented the flag of Division No. 1 of the Party members of the capital city to its commanding officials and Ri Il Hwan the flag of Division No. 2 to its commanding officials. The meeting was followed by a procession of the divisions. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Basket and Congratulatory Letter to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Diplomatic Corps
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a floral basket and a congratulatory letter from the diplomatic corps here on the occasion of the 72nd anniversary of the founding of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK). Palestinian Ambassador to the DPRK Ismail Ahmed Mohamed Hasan, doyen of the diplomatic corps, handed over the floral basket and the congratulatory letter to DPRK Foreign Minister Ri Son Gwon on Tuesday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Divisions of Party Members in Capital City Leave for
body: Reconstruction Campaign Site amid Warm Send-Off Party members in the capital city who pledged loyalty at the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the sacred temple of Juche, left for the reconstruction campaign sites for defending the people on Tuesday. That day working people in the city warmly sent the combatants of the divisions of the party members in the capital city off in the streets. Lots of working people in several parts of the city warmly waved their hands to the line of buses carrying the Party members who are leaving for the sites that will require selfless, devoted efforts for the good of the people, encouraging them. They were seen off at Pyongyang Railway Station, Taedonggang Railway Station and Sopho Youth Railway Station by Kim Jae Ryong and Ri Il Hwan, vice-chairmen of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Kim Yong Hwan, chairman of the Pyongyang City Party Committee, Choe Hui Thae, chairman of the Pyongyang City People's Committee, officials of the Party Central Committee, officials of the party and power organs and working people in the city. Trains boarded with them left Pyongyang. Trucks loaded with construction tools and equipment, materials and goods for supply service left for the sites for the reconstruction campaign on the same day. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Basket to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Nigerian President
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a floral basket from Muhammadu Buhari, president of the Federal Republic of Nigeria and commander-in-chief of the Armed Forces, on the occasion of the 72nd anniversary of the founding of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. The floral basket was conveyed to an official concerned by the Nigerian charge d'affaires here on Tuesday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Basket to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Palestinian President
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a floral basket from Mahmoud Abbas, president of the State of Palestine, on the occasion of the 72nd founding anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK). The floral basket was handed over to DPRK Foreign Minister Ri Son Gwon on Tuesday by Ismail Ahmed Mohamed Hasan, Palestinian ambassador to the DPRK. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Vietnamese President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), Wednesday received a message of greeting from Nguyen Phu Trong, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam and president of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam. The Vietnamese president in the message extended, on behalf of the Party, state and people of Vietnam, warm congratulations to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, and through him, to the Party, state and people of the DPRK on the occasion of the 72nd founding anniversary of the DPRK (Sept. 9, 1948-Sept. 9, 2020). It said that the fraternal Korean people have achieved a lot of great successes in the cause of building and developing the country and improving the people's living standard for the past 72 years under the leadership of the WPK headed by President Kim Il Sung, General Secretary Kim Jong Il and Chairman Kim Jong Un. It expressed belief that the fraternal Party, state and people of the DPRK would achieve bigger successes in the future under the leadership of Chairman Kim Jong Un. It expressed pleasure over great important progress made in the cooperative relations between the two parties and countries after Chairman Kim Jong Un's official friendly visit to Vietnam in March, 2019. Noting that the relevant institutions of the two parties and countries have positively implemented the issues agreed by him and Chairman Kim Jong Un, the Vietnamese president said in the message that Vietnam always attaches importance to the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation between the two parties and countries and wishes to further develop the relations in the interests of the peoples of the two countries and for the peace, stability, cooperation and development in the region and the rest of the world. The message also wished the WPK the successful holding of its 8th Congress in January 2021. It wished Kim Jong Un good health and more successes in fulfilling his noble duties. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Staff members of UN resident coordinator office and missions of UNDP, UNICEF, United Nations Population Fund, FAO, WFP and WHO here visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on Tuesday on the occasion of the 72nd founding anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. They laid floral baskets before the statues of the great leaders and paid tribute to them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from President of Cuba
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez, president of the Republic of Cuba, on Wednesday, the founding anniversary of the DPRK. The president in the message extended the sincerest congratulations to Kim Jong Un on the 72nd founding anniversary of the DPRK, reaffirming his will to continue to develop the relations of historic friendship and solidarity between the two countries. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Baskets Laid before Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Officials, working people and service personnel of the People's Army placed floral baskets before the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il Wednesday, the 72nd founding anniversary of the DPRK. Laid before the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill were bouquets and floral baskets in the names of Party and power organs, armed forces organs, social organizations, ministries, national institutions, units of the Korean People's Army (KPA) and the Public Security Forces (PSF), and institutions, industrial establishments and universities at different levels in Pyongyang. Also placed there was a floral basket in the name of the Pyongyang mission of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front. The visitors bowed to the statues of the great leaders. Bouquets and floral baskets in the names of KPA and PSF units, institutions and enterprises were laid before the statues of the great leaders in various parts of Pyongyang including Kim Il Sung University, the Ministry of the People's Armed Forces and the Mansudae Art Studio. Officials, working people and service personnel visited the statues of the great leaders and mosaics depicting their smiling images in other parts of the country to pay homage. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Chongryon Organizations
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received messages of greeting from organizations under the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) on the occasion of the 72nd founding anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. They are the Standing Council of the Korean Federation of Workers in Commerce in Japan, the Central Standing Committee of the Korean Youth League in Japan, the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Democratic Korean Women in Japan, the Central Standing Management Board of the Korean Youth Commercial Association in Japan, the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Korean Teachers in Japan, the Central Standing Council of the Union of Korean Educational Association in Japan, the Central Standing Council of the Korean Scientists and Technologists Association in Japan, the Central Standing Council of the Korean Social Scientists Association in Japan, the Standing Council of the Korean Sportsmen's Federation in Japan, the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Korean Writers and Artists in Japan, the Central Standing Council of the Korean Health Workers Association in Japan, the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Korean Students in Japan, the Association of Koreans in Japan for Peaceful Reunification, the Central Standing Council of the Korean Human Rights Association in Japan and other Chongryon central organizations and their affiliated bodies. Among them are also the Choson Sinbo Company, the Korean News Service, the Hagu Bookshop, the Kumgang-san Opera Troupe, Kumgang Insurance Company, the Committee for Promoting Korea-Japan Economic Exchange, and other enterprises, and prefectural headquarters of Chongryon, Korean University and Korean schools in Japan. Rodong Sinmun

title: Wreaths Laid at Cemeteries of Martyrs
body: Wreaths were laid at cemeteries of martyrs, the Memorial Towers for the Fallen Soldiers of the Korean People's Army and the cemeteries of fallen fighters of the KPA across the country on Wednesday, the 72nd founding anniversary of the DPRK. Present at the wreath-laying events were officials of local Party and power organs and working people's organizations and working people. Placed at the cemeteries of martyrs and the memorial towers and the cemeteries of fallen fighters of the KPA were wreaths in the names of the local party and power organs and bouquets and flowers. The participants paid a silent tribute to the memory of the martyrs. Rodong Sinmun

title: Wreaths Laid at Martyrs Cemeteries
body: Wreaths were laid at the Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery on Mt. Taesong, the Patriotic Martyrs Cemetery in Sinmi-ri and the Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery on Wednesday, the 72nd founding anniversary of the DPRK. Present at the wreath-laying events were leading officials of the Party and the government Kim Jae Ryong, Ri Il Hwan, Kim Yong Chol, Thae Hyong Chol, Kim Il Chol, Im Chol Ung, Ri Ryong Nam and Kim Yong Hwan, and Pak Yong Il, chairman of the Central Committee of the Korean Social Democratic Party, and officials of ministries and national institutions. Kim Su Gil and Kim Jong Gwan, leading officials of armed forces organs, were present. Wreaths in the joint names of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK and the DPRK Cabinet were laid on the wreath-laying stands of the cemeteries. The participants paid a silent tribute to the memory of the martyrs. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Baskets Laid before Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: The family of Kim Sun Ok who is related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, the Anti-Imperialist Front of Germany, Giancarlo Elia Valori, chairman of the Italian General Investment Group, Rufino Ndong Esono Nuchama, minister of Culture, Tourism, Promotion of Handicrafts of Ecuatorial Guinea, Yehia Zakaria Khairullah, co-chairman of the Arab Regional Committee for Friendship and Solidarity with the Korean People, and Mpongo Ne Kongo, national chairman of the Federation of Students and Pupils of the DR Congo sent floral baskets to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on the occasion of the 72nd founding anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. The floral baskets were laid before the statues on Sept. 8 and 9. Rodong Sinmun

title: Vietnamese Embassy Members Pay Floral Tribute to Statues of
body: President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il Le Ba Binh, Vietnamese ambassador to the DPRK, and his embassy members visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on Wednesday, the 72nd founding anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. They laid a floral basket and made a bow before the statues of the great leaders. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from President of Turkmenistan
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, Wednesday received a message of greeting from Gurbanguly Berdymuhamedov, president of Turkmenistan. The president in the message extended sincere congratulations and best wishes on behalf of the people and government of Turkmenistan and on his own behalf to Kim Jong Un and all the Korean people on the occasion of the founding anniversary of the DPRK. The message sincerely wished Kim Jong Un good health and happiness and the friendly Korean people peace, wellbeing and prosperity. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Palestinian President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, Wednesday received a message of greeting from Mahmoud Abbas, president of the State of Palestine. The president in the message extended sincere and warm congratulations on behalf of the State of Palestine and the Palestinian people and on his own behalf to Kim Jong Un, and through him, to the friendly government and people of the DPRK on the occasion of the founding anniversary of the DPRK. He expressed thanks to the Korean people on the occasion of the auspicious holiday for extending support and solidarity to the Palestinian people in their just cause to gain legitimate rights including freedom, independence and sovereignty in the territory of Palestine with east Kuds as its capital. The message sincerely wished Kim Jong Un good health and happiness and success in his work and hoped that the durable friendship and mutual respect between the peoples of the two countries would grow stronger. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Mongolian President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, Wednesday received a message of greeting from Khaltmaa Battulga, president of Mongolia. The president in the message extended sincere congratulations to Kim Jong Un, and through him, to the diligent Korean people on behalf of the people of Mongolia and on his own behalf on the occasion of the 72nd founding anniversary of the DPRK. The president in the message said that he would steadily develop the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation, the firm foundation of which was provided by the preceding leaders of the two countries, for the common interests of the peoples of the two countries and regional peace and prosperity. The message sincerely wished Kim Jong Un happiness and success in his work and the Korean people prosperity and development. Rodong Sinmun

title: Fruit Picked in New Groves of Vitamin Trees
body: Ryanggang Province manured and cultivated new vitamin tree groves well, thus collecting fruits again from them this year. The province aimed at growing vitamin trees in a wide area of their mountains and channeled its great efforts into this work. Demonstration lectures were given on the production and cultivation of young vitamin trees and researchers were actively helped in their work on the spot and inspired to further efforts. Drawing on the successes and experiences gained in the culture of its vitamin trees the province pushes forward the work to extensively raise them in Samjiyon City and many other districts of the country. Jon Chol Ju

title: Construction of Liquid Nutrient Fertilizer Factory Completed
body: A liquid nutrient fertilizer factory has been built anew and gone into production at the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex. The fertilizer is badly needed at hydroponic greenhouses to increase the nutritive value and productivity of their vegetables. As from last August the liquid nutrient fertilizer has been produced for trial at the factory. Consequently, all its technological processes as well as their standard operation methods have been improved and perfected to maximize its production capacity. Rodong Sinmun

title: Division No.1 of Party Members of Capital City Makes Innovation in Flood-hit Areas from the Outset
body: The officers and men of the Division No.1 of Party members of the capital city have worked for their housing construction in high spirits from the very beginning since they travelled as far as South Hamgyong Province and arrived in its flood-hit area. The men of many battalions of the division worked hard day and night from the outset to build dwellings in Unpho Workers’ District, Hongwon County. They transported hundreds of tons of cement to the construction site of the dwellings from a railway station in a short time. The men of the division succeeded in temporarily repairing damaged roads with lightning speed to build dwellings in Haksadae-ri, Riwon County. They are now hurrying to put the relevant ground to rights for their housing construction. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Birthday Spread to Centenarian
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un sent a birthday spread to war veteran Ri Tong Gyu residing in Ryonggok-ri, Kangnam County, Pyongyang on his 100th birthday. He, who was taken to Japan in labor conscription during Japan's colonial rule over Korea, could lead a worthwhile life after he returned to the homeland liberated by President Kim Il Sung. During the Fatherland Liberation War, he volunteered to join the People's Army and performed distinguished feats. In the periods of the postwar reconstruction and the socialist construction, he devoted himself to agricultural production. And he has done the work conducive to the economic life of the country after retirement. He is still doing housework in good health, always telling his descendants and neighbors to do more works for the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Founding Anniversary of Pyongyang College of Technology Marked
body: It has been 60 years since Pyongyang College of Technology was founded. The college is a competent factory college training working people of the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill and several industrial establishments in Pyongyang to be talents of practical technologies, and a model unit taking the lead in implementing the Party's policy that calls for fully displaying the superiority of the study-while-working educational system. President Kim Il Sung set forth the idea to found study-while-working technical colleges at major industrial establishments, saw to it that Pyongyang College of Technology was founded on September 1, Juche 49 (1960), and solved all the problems arising in managing and operating the college. Chairman Kim Jong Il indicated the directions and ways for improving the education at factory colleges including Pyongyang College of Technology and led the work to make innovations in instruction and education and scientific research. For the past six decades since its founding, the college has fulfilled its duties true to the Party's policy of attaching importance to education and talents. A meeting was held on Thursday to convey a congratulatory message from the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea to the teaching staff and students of the college. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings and Congratulatory Letters to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un
body: from Foreign Personages and Organizations Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received messages of greeting and congratulatory letters from foreign personages and organizations on the occasion of the 60th anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's start of guidance on the revolutionary armed forces. They included the chairman of the Supreme Council of the National Socialist Party of Romania, the chairman of the Hungarian Workers' Party, the general secretary and the international secretary of the Central Committee of the New Yugoslav Communist Party, and the acting general secretary of the Democratic Rally of Africa-Democratic Party of Guinea. Among them are also the director of the International Department of the Socialist Workers' Party of Croatia, the international secretary of the Serbian Communist Party, the international secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the People of Spain, and other high-ranking personages of political, public and economic circles in Russia, Nepal, the Philippines, Turkey, Germany, Romania, Switzerland, Ireland, Spain, Colombia and Ecuador, and representatives of organizations for the study of the Juche idea, organizations for supporting Korea's reunification and friendship organizations. Rodong Sinmun

title: Division No. 1 of Party Members of Capital City Begins Recovery Campaign
body: Members of the Division No. 1 of the Party members of the capital city arrived at the typhoon-stricken area in South Hamgyong Province on Sept. 9. They were warmly greeted by local officials and residents. After learning about the situation on the spot, the commanding officers of the division properly determined the order of priority in recovery project before mapping out detailed plans and giving meticulous directions for labor organization, supply of materials, etc. They are conducting frontline-style political campaign for raising the public enthusiasm, always finding themselves among the Party members of the division, while creating excited atmosphere by displaying militant slogans and mottos of the Party in different places of reconstruction sites. Every member of the division began arranging the sites for dwelling houses, directly after their arrival. Rodong Sinmun

title: Division No. 2 of Party Members of Capital City Begins Recovery Campaign
body: The officers and men of the Division No. 2 of the Party members of the capital city arrived at Kim Chaek City, North Hamgyong Province from Pyongyang one after another by rail, water and land, whole-heartedly determined to accomplish at all costs the vital tasks set forth by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in his trusting open letter to the Party members of Pyongyang. They lose no time in setting about working in the flood-torn area of the city. They are now working hard night and day to convert the area into a paradise of its citizens. Rodong Sinmun

title: Division No. 1 of Party Members of Capital City Makes Achievements
body: in Recovery Campaign The Party members of Pyongyang register success after success courageously in recovering the flood damage of Unpho Workers’ District, Hongwon County, South Hamgyong Province. The men of many battalions of the Division No. 1 of the Party members of the capital city worked tenaciously there and finished readjusting the ground for their housing construction. This patently demonstrates that the officers and men of the division work resolutely with great enthusiasm, revolutionary spirit and loyalty to carry out their work assignments unconditionally and successfully on schedule and report it to the great Party Central Committee with pride. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Inspects Reconstruction Site of Flood-Hit Area in Taechong-ri, Unpha County, North Hwanghae Province
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, inspected the reconstruction site of flood-hit Taechong-ri area of Unpha County, North Hwanghae Province. He was accompanied by Vice Marshal of the Korean People's Army (KPA) Pak Jong Chon, chief of the KPA General Staff, leading officials of the Central Committee of the WPK Ri Il Hwan, Jo Yong Won, Kim Yong Su and Hyon Song Wol and Pak Chang Ho, chairman of the North Hwanghae Provincial Committee of the WPK. The Supreme Leader was greeted by commanding officers of the units of the People's Army taking part in the reconstruction of flood-hit Unpha County and officials. True to the idea of the 16th meeting of the Political Bureau of the 7th WPK Central Committee and the joint order of the WPK Central Committee, the Party Central Military Commission and the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, combatants and commanding officers of the KPA units taking part in the reconstruction are vigorously accelerating the reconstruction with the do-or-die struggle of loyalty out of strong desire to provide the people in the flood-hit area with better place to live and realize the noble intention of the Party at an earliest date possible. Making round of the reconstruction site, the Supreme Leader acquainted himself with the progress and plan of the reconstruction. Appreciating the frontline-style agitation which is stirring the whole construction site to fit the battle-style one, he underlined the need to conduct the ideological offensive without rigid formality and pattern and in a militant manner to arouse all the combatants taking part in the reconstruction to the implementation of the idea of the Party and upholding its policies. Enjoying the view of the workteam villages of the flood-hit farm which has neatly taken shape as befitting the icon of modern houses of rural area free from all the backwardness of the times and the traces of flood damage, he said that he was right to give the order to build one-household dwelling houses and approve the design without considering the amount of building materials needed or land-saving aspect as demanded by the farmers he met during his last visit, adding that the newly built houses with much efforts would be worth more only when they meet the requirements of the farmers and are liked by them. He expressed his happiness, saying that such a village that has taken its shape as a fairyland within a short period of merely over 30 days is a miracle which can be created by only the service personnel of the Korean People's Army (KPA) who have the loyalty to the Party and the ardent love for the people, adding the world will be startled to see the capability of the KPA. He said that everywhere in the construction site is full of sincerity of the service personnel, noting that they, the excellent sons and daughters of the people, are devoting themselves to the rehabilitation with the mind of building their own native homes and villages. This fact alone clearly shows the KPA's ideological and moral traits, he added. Watching with satisfaction the combatants of the KPA working at the construction site, he said that it is the greatest pride of our Party to have such a powerful army which is always loyal to the Party, and that our Party is tiding over all difficulties of the revolution with courage as there is the KPA, the politico-ideologically strong army and morally strong army and the genuine army of the people, which is regarding it as its own noble obligation to help the Party and the people get rid of all troubles with its sincere patriotism and loyalty. As there is the KPA which is faithfully loyal to our Party and the revolutionary cause of our Party, no natural disaster can ever deprive the people of happiness and laughter and no one in the world can break the faith and will of the Workers' Party of Korea struggling for the people, he said. He repeatedly told commanding officers of the units of the KPA which were mobilized in the construction to be aware of the intention of the Party that called upon the KPA to turn out in eradicating the aftermath of the natural disaster and the importance of the rehabilitation. He called upon the Party organizations and political organs at all levels to further intensify among all the service personnel the work of making them clearly cognizant of the intention of the Party Central Committee that mobilized the KPA to the great campaign for creating the happiness of the people, and push ahead with the rehabilitation with the mind of strengthening the single-minded unity. He stressed that this year he mobilized a lot of units of the People's Army to the campaign for recovering from the flood and typhoon damage and that the People's Army should regard the campaign for recovering from the damage by the natural disaster as a political work for maintaining the blood ties between the Party and the people and further boosting them and the most important work for living up to the trust of the people, who have only believed and followed our Party single-mindedly irrespective of any difficulty and trial, in the Party and defending the Party's absolute prestige, and display the boundless devotion and popular heroism. Saying that our people might pin their hope only on our Party and wait for a measure to be taken by the Party in difficult days as now and we should neither discourage them nor make them feel inconvenience in their living even a moment owing to the natural disaster, he emphasized that for our Party which regards it as its noble motto to believe in the people as in Heaven and keeps them as its root, it is the most important work to repay their trust and therefore, our Party started an unprecedented great reconstruction campaign by mobilizing all the state potentiality in the work for defending the people's happiness and put forward the revolutionary army of the Party as the main force on every front for recovering the damage by the natural disaster across the country. He expressed his great trust in the People's Army, saying that they should kindle high the flame of creating heroic legendary stories and making miracles on every reconstruction front, bearing in mind the noble intention of our Party and thus devotedly ensure the successful celebrations of the 75th founding anniversary of the Party and convention of its 8th Congress with honor. He stressed that commanding officers of the People's Army should strengthen the command and technical guidance over the construction with high awareness that it is totally up to them whether the reconstruction campaign proves to be a success or failure, push ahead with the construction by launching a three-dimensional and intense speed campaign and scrupulously take a practical measure for thoroughly ensuring the quality of the construction by strictly meeting the requirements of design and technical method. Learning in detail about the condition of the crops in the paddy fields that had been under water, he worried that various diseases had broken out and the condition of the growth of rice was not good in much of those fields. Saying that though there are some losses, it is necessary to improve the condition of growth at any cost by taking decisive agricultural and technological measures, not abandoning the crops cultivated by farmers with sincerity throughout the spring and summer, he repeatedly asked officials and workers in the agricultural field to make redoubled efforts to minimize the damage to the crops and increase the yield in a consistent and responsible way. Our Party has faced trouble and distress at the great damage caused by the recent series of heavy rain and typhoons but it will readily face the trouble and will take every possible measure for the sake of the great people and repay their great trust without fail, he said, expressing his determination to dynamically overcome the current trial together with the People's Army. Immensely encouraged by the field guidance of the Supreme Leader to the reconstruction site, all the service personnel vowed once again to become a fortress and shield devotedly defending the Party Central Committee to finish the reconstruction at the highest level by the founding anniversary of the WPK and make a report of victory and thus clearly demonstrate to the world how the service personnel and people brought up by the Party uphold and devotedly defend their leader, their Supreme Commander.
