The pace of energetic leadership by the Supreme Leader who is making endless journey of patriotic devotion for the country and people will be the stride of the vigorous advance of the country and the motive force of miracles that make the people and army honorable victors in today's campaign for recovery from natural disaster, and hurrah for the socialism would resound far and wide across the country celebrating the October holiday. Political News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Greetings to Syrian President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, Friday sent a message of greeting to Bashar Al-Assad, president of the Syrian Arab Republic. Kim Jong Un in the message extended warm congratulations to the president of Syria on his 55th birthday. He said in the message that the Korean people are pleased to see the friendly government and people of Syria have firmly defended the sovereignty and dignity of the country under the correct leadership of their president. The message sincerely wished the Syrian president good health and greater success in his responsible work, expressing the belief that the long-standing friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries would grow stronger in the future. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from President of Pakistan
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), received a message of greeting from Arif Alvi, president of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, on Thursday. The Pakistani president in the message said that he was delighted to convey sincere felicitations on behalf of the people and the government of Pakistan on the occasion of the 72nd founding anniversary of the DPRK. Noting that Pakistan and the DPRK enjoy cordial ties based on mutual goodwill, the message expressed belief that the relationship continue to grow in the years ahead. The Pakistani president in the message said that he avails this opportunity to convey his best wishes for Kim Jong Un's good health and happiness and for the progress and prosperity of the DPRK. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Founding Anniversary Marked by British and Swiss Organizations
body: British and Swiss organizations issued joint statements on Sept. 1 to mark the 72nd founding anniversary of the DPRK. The British Association for the Study of Songun Policy, the British Group for the Study of the Juche Idea and the Korean Friendship Association UK said in their joint statement that Sept. 9, 1948 was an important day when the first people's democratic state was founded in the East. Under the leadership of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, the DPRK demonstrated its dignity as a country strong in its independent stand on the international arena, strictly maintaining Juche in ideology, independence in politics, self-sufficiency in economy and self-reliance in defence, the statement noted. It said that the DPRK, wisely led by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, is pushing forward the socialist construction, smashing all sorts of provocation by the imperialists under the uplifted banner of the Juche idea. The DPRK will shine forever as the powerful country of Juche, it stressed. The Swiss Organizing Committee of the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu, the Switzerland-Korea Committee and the Group for the Study of the Juche Idea of Switzerland said in their joint statement that Kim Il Sung founded the DPRK and thus set an example in the building of an independent and sovereign state. For more than 70 years since its foundation, the DPRK has accelerated the building of Korean-style socialism, firmly consolidating the foundation of its self-supporting national economy, the statement added. The socialist cause of Juche led by Leader Kim Jong Il has been successfully carried forward by Chairman Kim Jong Un, it noted. Thanks to the outstanding and tested leadership of Kim Jong Un, the DPRK will dynamically advance toward a new victory and bring earlier its bright future, it stressed. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK's Founding Anniversary Marked by Koreans in China
body: Koreans in China held celebrations on the occasion of the 72nd founding anniversary of the DPRK. Choe Su Bong, first vice chairman of the General Association of Koreans in China, and other officials of the association laid a floral basket and paid tribute before an art work depicting President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il at the DPRK Consulate General in Shenyang on September 9. Members of the Jilin Regional Association of the General Association of Koreans in China placed a floral basket and made a bow before the statue of Kim Il Sung at Yuwen Middle School in Jilin. Members of the Federation of Korean Economic Workers in China and the Association of Young Korean Nationals in China laid a floral basket before the portraits of smiling Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il in the DPRK mission in Dandong. The General Association held a celebration in Shenyang, China to mark the founding anniversary of the DPRK. A letter of the General Association to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was adopted there. The Yanbian Regional Association and the Zhongnan Regional Association of the General Association held colorful events such as meetings for adopting letters to the Supreme Leader, celebrations, film shows and round-table talks. Rodong Sinmun

title: Construction of Pyongyang General Hospital Progresses Apace
body: The builders of the Pyongyang General Hospital vigorously wage a general offensive to celebrate the 75th birthday of the Workers’ Party of Korea and its forthcoming 8th Congress with laudable successes in their work. They continue to do their utmost to conclude the PGH at an early date. Great results have been achieved in a short time in tiling the outer walls of inpatients’ and outpatients’ wards after its commencement. The tile-setting is now nearing completion. Many outside establishments of the PGH, too, are built full steam. Rodong Sinmun

title: Division No.1 Starts Ground Concrete Tamping
body: True to the lofty intention of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, the officers and men of the Division No. 1 of the Party members of the capital city work hard day and night in South Hamgyong Province. Those of many battalions of the division excavated the ground for their housing construction in Haksadae-ri, Riwon County of the province and removed large quantities of soil in a twinkling. They then proceeded to concrete the ground. Infinitely encouraged by them the flood sufferers of the province are going all-out for the restoration of their dwelling places with great confidence. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Chairman of
body: Liberal Democratic Party of Russia Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, received a message of greeting from V. V. Zhirinovsky, chairman of the Liberal Democratic Party of Russia, on September 8. The chairman in the message extended sincere congratulations to Kim Jong Un on the occasion of the 72nd founding anniversary of the DPRK, an important day in the life of the DPRK people. The message said that the Liberal Democratic Party of Russia highly appreciated successes achieved by the DPRK in economic field and international relations under the leadership of Kim Jong Un in recent years. It noted that to develop bilateral relations between Russia and the DPRK and between the Liberal Democratic Party of Russia and the Workers' Party of Korea is an invariable stand of the Liberal Democratic Party of Russia. It wished Kim Jong Un good health and success in his work for the development of the national economy of the country and the improvement of the well-being of the DPRK people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Azerbaijani President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Ilham Aliyev, president of the Republic of Azerbaijan, on Sept. 7. The message said: Your Excellency, It is on the occasion of the Day of the Foundation of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, I convey my sincere congratulations to you and your people on my own behalf and on behalf of the people of Azerbaijan. I believe that the development of friendly and cooperative relations between our countries will continue to serve the interests of our peoples. On this pleasant day, I express my best wishes of peace and prosperity to you and your people. Sincerely. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from President of Zimbabwe
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Emmerson Dambudzo Mnangagwa, president of the Republic of Zimbabwe on September 1. The message said: Your Excellency, On behalf of the government and the people of Zimbabwe, and on my own behalf, allow me to extend to you, and through you, to the Government and people of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), our warm felicitations on the occasion of the 72nd anniversary of the founding of your great country. As we join you in celebrating this momentous occasion, Your Excellency, I wish to reaffirm my Government's commitment to strengthen bilateral relations between our two countries for the mutual benefit of both countries and peoples. May I take this opportunity to wish you, Your Excellency, personal good health, and peace and prosperity for the people of Democratic People's Republic of Korea. Please accept, Your Excellency, the assurances of my highest consideration. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from President of Equatorial Guinea
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Obiang Nguema Mbasogo, president of the Republic of Equatorial Guinea, on Sep. 4. The president in the message extended the warmest congratulations to Kim Jong Un on behalf of the government and people of the Republic of Equatorial Guinea and on his own behalf on the occasion of the 72nd founding anniversary of the DPRK, September 9, 2020, a day of important significance for the DPRK government and people. The message sincerely wished Kim Jong Un happiness and the DPRK people prosperity, and affirmed that the government of the Republic of Equatorial Guinea will make continuous efforts to develop the reciprocal relations between the two countries. It highly appreciated that Kim Jong Un exerts huge effort to achieve lasting peace and stability of the Korean Peninsula and socio-economic welfare of the DPRK people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Namibian President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Hage Geingob, president of the Republic of Namibia, on August 28. The message said: Your Excellency, On behalf of the Government and people of the Republic of Namibia, I would like to extend to Your Excellency, the government and the fraternal people of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, our profound congratulations on the occasion of your national day on September 9, 2020. We are pleased to note that it has been thirty years since the establishment of diplomatic relations in the spirit of mutual respect, solidarity and friendship between our two countries. I am confident that through joint efforts, we will continue to strengthen the longstanding cooperation between Namibia and the DPRK to the benefit of our peoples. I take this opportunity, Your Excellency, to wish you continued personal good health, strength and wisdom. Please accept, Your Excellency, the assurances of my highest esteem. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Kenyan President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Uhuru Kenyatta, president of the Republic of Kenya, on August 30. The president in the message extended the sincerest congratulations and best wishes to Kim Jong Un, and through him, to the government of the DPRK and the great Korean people on behalf of the government and people of the Republic of Kenya and on his own behalf on the auspicious occasion of the 72nd founding anniversary of the DPRK. The president availed the significant holiday to highly appreciate that the Republic of Kenya and the DPRK have a long-standing relations of friendship and cooperation. He extended thanks to Kim Jong Un for sincere support and cooperation of the DPRK for recent Kenya's election as UNSC non-permanent member. As regards the start of Kenya's UNSC non-permanent membership from January, 2021, he expressed belief that two countries would respect international law and norms in the peaceful settlement of disputes and closely cooperate with each other to create the atmosphere of one accord, transparency and trust in settling current important matters, including global peace and security, terrorism and climate change, and in providing all the peace-loving peoples with rosier future. He hoped that he, together with Kim Jong Un and the government of the DPRK, would make joint efforts to further boost the bilateral relations in the common interests of the two countries and peoples. He wished Kim Jong Un happiness in good health and the people of the DPRK continued prosperity. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Thai King
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Maha Vajiralongkorn, king of Thailand, on September 8. The message said: On the occasion of the anniversary of the foundation of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, I take this opportunity to extend to Your Excellency my sincere felicitations and best wishes for your good health and happiness as well as for the progress and prosperity of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and her people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Malaysian King
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Al－Sultan Abdullah Riayatuddin Al－Mustafa Billah Shah lbni Al－Marhum Sultan Haji Ahmad Shah Al－Mustain Billah, king of Malaysia, on September 9. The message said: The Raja Permaisuri Agong joins us in extending our sincere felicitations and warmest wishes to Your Excellency as well as to the Government and the citizens of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea on the auspicious occasion of the 72nd anniversary of the Founding of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. Malaysia and the Democratic People's Republic of Korea share a longstanding relation and cooperation in various fields. It is our sincere hope that the ties between our two countries will continue to be consolidated based on the principles of mutual trust, openness and rule of law. On this happy occasion, we would like to extend our best wishes for Your Excellency's good health, as well as for the continued peace, progress and prosperity of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Cambodian King
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Norodom Sihamoni, king of Cambodia, on September 6. The king said in the message that he was very pleased to extend to Kim Jong Un warm congratulations and wishes for his happiness and success on the occasion of the 72nd founding anniversary of the DPRK. The message also wished the Korean people peace and lasting prosperity. It noted that the steady efforts made by the DPRK under the leadership of Kim Jong Un have consolidated and propelled the course for achieving the well-being and development of the people of the DPRK. It said that the good relations of friendship and cooperation between the Kingdom of Cambodia and the DPRK would be developed into more excellent ones in the interests of the peoples of the two countries. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Inspects Rebuilt Kangbuk-ri, Kumchon County,
body: North Hwanghae Province Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, inspected Kangbuk-ri, Kumchon County, North Hwanghae Province that has been rebuilt from the damage by heavy rain and strong wind. He was accompanied by Choe Ryong Hae, Pak Pong Ju, Kim Jae Ryong, Pak Jong Chon, Ri Il Hwan, Jo Yong Won, Kim Yong Su, Pak Thae Song and Hyon Song Wol. The Supreme Leader of the Party, the State and the armed forces was greeted on the spot by Pak Chang Ho, chairman of the North Hwanghae Provincial Committee of the WPK, and commanding officers of the units of the People's Army mobilized for the reconstruction from the damage. Kangbuk-ri, Kumchon County, North Hwanghae Province was greatly damaged when heavy rain and strong wind swept away the whole areas of the DPRK this year. But it removed all the traces of great natural disaster and was successfully built as a socialist fairyland, model village of socialist rural communities thanks to the wise guidance of Kim Jong Un and the ardent patriotism, loyalty and heroic struggle of service personnel of the People's Army. Learning that Kangbuk-ri had been greatly damaged by the recent heavy rain and strong wind and that some dwelling houses and public buildings had been in critical conditions due to exposure to natural disaster every year on top of lack of repairing, Kim Jong Un immediately issued a militant order to the units of the People's Army to remove all the buildings in the ri seat and build them new so as to facelift the ri. The service personnel who rushed to the damaged area in response to the order of trust given by Kim Jong Un achieved proud success of making the first report of victory to the Party Central Committee in the campaigns for recovery from disaster by newly constructing the seat of Kangbuk-ri, Kumchon County through a fierce campaign of loyalty, bearing in mind the noble viewpoint on the people, the idea of the people-first principle of our Party. Kim Jong Un, looking over the picturesque village that turned into a fine example of socialist farm village, wondered if the village which looked so pitiful for its backwardness plus damage by natural disaster could shake them off in such a short period, adding he felt as if facing a different world. He noted with great satisfaction that another success was made in which our Party's grand plan for building rural areas and policy for building local areas have been carried out most correctly thanks to the patriotic devotion and struggle of our soldiers. He said that upon hearing all most every day the news about heroic struggle waged by soldiers as main players on all the fronts for the recovery from the disasters in several areas of the country, he keenly felt the tremendous mental power, ardent patriotism and intense loyalty toward the Party and people possessed by all the officers and men of the People's Army. He added that he was deeply moved by their devotion and painstaking efforts. The People's Army is made up of creators of all miracles on this land, he praised, adding that the genuine might of the People's Army lies not in the number of troops and the might of ammunitions but in their ardent love for their country and people and their mental power based on love for and trust in their Party and the revolutionary cause. He stressed in great excitement that it is the greatest pride of our Party and the state and the biggest blessing for himself that we have such powerful revolutionary army loyal to the country, the people, the Party and the revolutionary cause. Looking round dwelling houses and public buildings in the ri, he appreciated that they were built cozy and to be impeccable both exterior and interior. He discussed with the senior Party and government officials who accompanied him the orientation to be constantly maintained by our Party in rural construction. Saying that it is imperative to set up the long-term goal of construction in provinces, rural construction in particular, in a more realistic and planned way, he emphasized the need to bolster up remarkably the state assistance to the responsible and important work for sprucing up rural areas by accelerating the development of high civilization of the rural areas and for turning our rural areas into rich and cultured socialist rural areas backed by modern technology. What is urgent is to make in-depth study of an immediate task at present and long-term goal of our Party for accomplishing at an early date the far-reaching programmes for socialist rural construction advanced by President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, and measures for carrying them out, he said, noting that the upcoming Party congress will be able to give correct answers to this crucial issue. He repeatedly asked if the inhabitants, the farmers were pleased with the new living environment in Kangbuk-ri that had been rebuilt after damage due to rainstorm and strong wind. Noting that he was pleased to hear that they were feeling happy, he said that our Party certainly had done good things and he extended thanks to the soldiers of the People's Army who put into practice one more wish of our Party. He told the chairman of the Provincial Party Committee that it would be good to let the inhabitants move to new houses earlier, adding that he couldn't wait to see them moving to new houses. He said that it has been long since he felt so relieved, and noted that he was very happy to feel relieved of worries. He hoped that the people in the area would settle down in the new villages and new houses to lead a happy life and that the area would always be visited by fortune. Farmers and inhabitants in Kangbuk-ri, Kumchon County who are to move to new houses in the model socialist rural village which was built thanks to the ardent love of the Supreme Leader for the people and in which the desire of our Party has been realized, are sure to live up to his great solicitude with loyalty by making dedication to the construction of a powerful country while bearing deep in mind the loving care and solicitude bestowed by the mother party to clear them of their misfortune. As there are the Supreme Leader and our great Party, happy cradles for the better living of people will mushroom before long in different parts of the country which had been hit hard by the wildness of nature. Political News Team

title: People in South Hamgyong Province Vow to Turn out in Campaign for
body: Recovery from Typhoon Damage Different units of South Hamgyong Province held meetings to vow to turn out in the campaign for recovery from typhoon damage in hearty response to the call of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Reports were made to be followed by oath-taking speeches. Reporters and speakers recalled the revolutionary measures taken by the Supreme Leader during his repeated visits to the typhoon-hit areas in South and North Hwanghae Provinces and inspection of the situation in typhoon-hit South Hamgyong Province. They said that horrible natural rampage destroyed many valuable things, causing great economic loss, but they have nothing to fear as they are under the care of Kim Jong Un and the Workers' Party of Korea and they would achieve a miraculous victory in the rehabilitation campaign. At the meetings held by the Provincial Committee of the WPK and the Provincial People's Committee, the speakers stressed the need to meticulously organize and direct the campaign for eradicating the typhoon damage as soon as possible and responsibly ensure the transportation of equipment and materials for rehabilitation, true to the noble intention of the Party Central Committee. At the meeting held by the provincial youth league committee, the speakers expressed their will to fully demonstrate the strong spirit of the reliable advancing group of the Party in the forefront for defending the people and to finish the construction of the dwelling houses they are tasked with at the highest level before any others. The employees of the Hamhung City Cement Factory in their oath-taking meeting expressed their resolution to increase the production of cement for rehabilitation projects. At the meetings of employees in the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex and the Songchongang Electric Appliances Factory, the speakers vowed to give priority to production of equipment needed for rehabilitation and effect innovations in the construction of dwelling houses. Speakers at the meeting held in the Sapho Vegetable Farm of Hamhung City represented great enthusiasm of agricultural workers to strive to minimize the damage to crops and boost yield in the same spirit as being displayed in the working sites for recovery from typhoon damage. At the meeting of the teaching staff of Hamhung University of Agriculture, the speakers called for finishing the construction of dwelling houses in the flood-hit area before any others by dedicating themselves to it. Rodong Sinmun

title: People in North Hamgyong Province Vow to Be Active in Campaign
body: for Recovery from Typhoon Damage Various units in North Hamgyong Province held meetings to vow to turn out in the campaign for recovery from typhoon damage in response to the appeal made by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. At the meetings reports and speeches were made. Reporters and speakers recalled the open letter sent by the Supreme Leader to all the Party members in the capital city of Pyongyang during his inspection of the typhoon-afflicted area in South Hamgyong Province. They expressed their will to dedicate themselves to living up to the great trust and expectation of Kim Jong Un who said that there are many Party members and organizations and major forces of the working class in South and North Hamgyong provinces, and they, too, will fully understand the intention of the Party Central Committee and do a good job of the reconstruction projects. Speakers at the meetings held by the Provincial Party Committee and the Provincial People's Committee said that they would become brave standard-bearers and vanguard fighters who boldly organize and direct the construction in the revolutionary working manner of devotedly carrying out the tasks given by the Party and open a road of advance in the campaign. At the meeting held by the employees of the Chongjin Steel Plant the speakers represented the strong will of its workers to overhaul and reinforce the typhoon-afflicted production processes and produce more Juche-based iron by stepping up technical updating and taking measures for full provision of raw materials and fuel. Agricultural workers in Rimmyong Co-op Farm of Kim Chaek City and Ryongyon Co-op Farm of Kyonghung County in their meetings expressed their will to attain this year's goals of grain production and greet the Eighth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea with brilliant labor achievements. Speakers at the meeting of the teaching staff of Chongjin University of Mining and Metallurgy said that they would find themselves in the worksites for providing the flood-stricken people with stable living condition as early as possible and successfully build their dwelling houses by waging a vigorous campaign. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Ambassador Presents His Credentials to Danish Queen
body: The DPRK ambassador presented his credentials to the queen of the Kingdom of Denmark on September 9. DPRK Ambassador Ri Won Guk courteously conveyed warm greetings sent by Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, to Queen Margrethe II. The queen expressed her gratitude for it and asked him to convey warm and sincere greetings to Kim Jong Un. The queen said that she hopes everything would go well in the DPRK. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Congratulatory Letter
body: from General Association of Koreans in China Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a congratulatory letter from the General Association of Koreans in China on Sept. 9, the 72nd anniversary of the founding of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK). The letter said that the 72nd anniversary of the founding of the DPRK is being celebrated as an auspicious holiday at a time when the grand revolutionary advance is being dynamically waged to greet the 75th anniversary of the founding of the Workers' Party of Korea and its Eighth Congress with great political enthusiasm and brilliant labor achievements. As President Kim Il Sung founded the DPRK, the DPRK people became masters of the country and power for the first time in the national history of five thousand years and have carved out their own destinies independently and the building of a powerful socialist country of Juche began, it said. It noted that Chairman Kim Jong Il turned the DPRK into a world-class military power and provided a reliable springboard for the building of an economic giant with his original Songun politics when the Korean revolution faced the most severe ordeals. The socialist homeland, a patriotic legacy left by the great leaders, is demonstrating to the whole world its dignity and might as it is holding in high esteem Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un as the top leader of the Korean revolution, it stressed. Praising Kim Jong Un for making a new great history of the love for the people and turning the socialist country into a powerful country of Juche admired by the world, the letter expressed the will of the Koreans in China to lead a worthwhile life as the faithful ones who support and follow him only, entrusting their fate and future totally to him. Rodong Sinmun

title: Continuous Successes Recorded in Dwelling Construction
body: The officials and builders of the Capital City Construction Commission finished framing dwellings in their charge on the whole in the flood-hit areas of Ichon County. At present they exert all their powers to plaster their interior and exterior with mortar and realign their surroundings. They succeeded in framing their dwellings in Haan-ri and Murung-ri before any rivals else. They procured large quantities of materials beforehand to build dwellings in the township. As a result, they push ahead with their building operations without a hitch as scheduled. The officials of the Capital City Construction Commission detailedly guide its builders in their work ensuring that they guarantee the quality of the dwelling satisfactorily to thoroughly meet the demand of methods of construction. Rodong Sinmun

title: Efforts Focused on Stabilizing People’s Living
body: North Hwanghae Province works substantially true to the intention of the Party to concentrate all our powers on recovering the flood damage of the people and stabilize their lives as soon as possible. It successfully finished repairing houses for more than 700 families under its jurisdiction in a short time. Unpha County repaired the dwellings for its 190-odd families which were partially damaged by a heavy rain and a violent wind and enabled them to live there again as usual. While consolidating their successes the officials and working people of the province cooperate with the servicemen of the KPA in doing all they can to conclude dwellings for its flood victims unconditionally in its flood-ridden areas till the 75th birthday of the Workers’ Party of Korea. Rodong Sinmun

title: In Order to Perform New Feats
body: Boundlessly inspired by the field guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un the officers and men of the Korean People’s Army increase the speed of their housing construction in Taechong-ri, Unpha County, North Hwanghae Province to provide its flood sufferers with new dwellings at an early date. They worked as one without a break to produce large numbers of concrete blocks. Consequently, a breakthrough has been made in being able to accelerate the construction of the ri’s public establishments. Furthermore, they successfully finished roofing dwellings in their charge with tiles by the sweat of their brows. Rodong Sinmun

title: By Overcoming Unfavorable Conditions in a Persistent Manner
body: The men of the Division No. 2 of the Party members of the capital city work hard in many flood-stricken areas of North Hamgyong Province despite their trials and hardships. They repaired a road for four kilometers and more as of September 14 and enabled their division to transport materials. By dint of hard all-night work they finished readjusting the flood-hit sections of Chundong-ri and Sokho-ri in a day on the whole. They do so in Unho-ri, too, full steam as of September 14. Rodong Sinmun

title: With Importance Attached to Updating Mother Tree Nursery
body: Thaechon County modernizes its mother tree nursery under the Party policy of producing saplings along scientific, industrial and intensive lines. It reinforces the foundations of its forestry station for sapling production and actively plants trees on a mass scale every year. It has successfully carried out huge tasks such as the amelioration of a field sapling farm and sapling fields. The result is that great numbers of saplings have become able to be raised in safety and health. Kim Myong Hun

title: Recovery of Power Transmission and Supply Network Progresses Apace
body: Power transmission and supply systems are restored vigorously in the typhoon- and flood-ridden areas of North and South Hamgyong Provinces. Dispatched to the areas the officials of the Ministry of Electric Power Industry and power distribution workers started to restore the damaged power distribution stations and power transmission cables of the provinces. Thanks to their devotion, the power transmission and supply systems of the areas are being restored and power supply bettered there. Ri Ho Song

title: Communications Being Recovered in Three-dimensional Way
body: The officials and workers employed in the sector of posts and telecommunications strive hard to restore destroyed telecommunication facilities without delay. The Posts and Telecommunications Management Bureau of South Hamgyong Province restored the mobile and fixed telecommunication apparatus of the Komdok area and enabled the direction of the recovery of its flood damage shortly after it began to restore its telecommunication route. It has now finished repairing its telecommunication equipment in the flood-stricken areas of the province. The Posts and Telecommunications Management Bureau of North Hamgyong Province, too, simultaneously pushed forward the recovery of telecommunication facilities in 15 cities and counties. It finished restoring the telecommunication route between Pyongyang and the province and between the province and counties. In conclusion, it is now doing its possible to restore the communication route between counties and ris. Ri Chol Ok

title: Makeshift Road Construction in Komdok Area Started
body: True to the order of the Central Military Commission of the Workers’ Party of Korea on recovering the typhoon damage of the Komdok area of South Hamgyong Province the servicemen of many units of the Korean People’s Army marched quite a distance toward it and arrived there. No sooner had they taken off knapsacks in their tents they began to build makeshift roads to loyally repay their respected Supreme Commander Kim Jong Un for implicitly trusting them and assigning them to restore the area. While on the march they did laudable deeds for the people. They repaired many sections of roads and built makeshift roads by dint of devoted work. Rodong Sinmun

title: Performing Feats Day after Day
body: The officers and men of the divisions of the Party members of the capital city work courageously without a break in the flood-hit areas of North and South Hamgyong Provinces and set new records in their restoration every hour and every day. The men of many battalions of the Division No. 1 walled dwellings in their charge in a day in the Unpho and Kyongpho Workers’ Districts of Hongwon County. They then proceeded to set up formworks for the floors of the dwellings and piece together reinforced iron bars over them. Furthermore, they successfully finished concreting the floors in a short time. The officers and men of the Division No. 2 determinedly push ahead with their restoration projects despite their adversities. They started and finished realigning the ground in Unho-ri on September 14 on the whole to build dwellings allocated to them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Pak Pong Ju Inspects Newly Completed Ansok Tideland
body: Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the WPK, inspected the newly completed Ansok Tideland on Tuesday. He was accompanied by Ko In Ho, vice-premier and minister of Agriculture, Kang Hyong Bong, chairman of the South Phyongan Provincial People's Committee, officials concerned and officials of the South Phyongan Provincial Tideland Reclamation General Enterprise. He appreciated the efforts devoted by the officials and workers of the enterprise to build an edifice of eternal value by bringing nature under control in indomitable spirit of self-reliance in their all-out drive to implement the decision made at the Fifth Plenary Meeting of the 7th Central Committee of the WPK. He ordered to inform the relevant units of the completion. He referred to the need to hasten the building of the network of facilities of the reclaimed tideland by giving precedence to supplying materials such as cement, take measures for supplying water for irrigation and make large and stable yield by making further study of salt resistant rice species. He called on the officials and builders of the enterprise to make fresh innovation by giving foremost importance to science and technology and actively introducing peculiar construction method of our own style in reclaiming of new tidelands on the basis of success and experience which they have already achieved, thus contributing to realizing the large-scale projects of our Party for the remaking of nature. Rodong Sinmun

title: Kim Tok Hun Inspects Reconstruction Sites in Eastern Part of Country
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the DPRK Cabinet, inspected reconstruction project sites in the eastern part of the country. In the reconstruction sites in South and North Hamgyong Provinces he called on all the officials to fulfill their responsibility and role as leading officials in upholding the intention of the Party Central Committee in practice, always bearing in mind that Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un is always concerned about the living of the people in the disaster-stricken areas. He stressed the need to timely provide the cement and structural steel for the reconstruction project sites, to take emergency measures to transport materials to Komdok area and other damaged ones and to concentrate on repairing the railway lines and roads. In Thongchon County, Munchon City, Changdo County and Kumgang County of Kangwon Province, he underlined the need to rebuild breakwaters, etc. according to the accepted method of construction so that they can withstand any tidal wave and typhoon. He also underscored the need for hydraulic engineering research institutes to make a good job of design in line with the requirements of the natural and geographical conditions and the changed global ecological environment. The field consultative meetings discussed the measures to produce and supply materials and equipment for the reconstruction projects unconditionally and timely by tapping all internal reserves of several sectors of the national economy and by waging production increase campaigns and to let the railway transport sector organize and guide the transportation dynamically from the viewpoint of ensuring the wartime transport. Rodong Sinmun

title: Matriculation Ceremony of Korean University of Chongryon Held
body: A matriculation ceremony of Korean University of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) for the academic year Juche 109 (2020) took place at the university hall in Tokyo on Sept. 13. Attending the ceremony were Pak Ku Ho, first vice-chairman of the Central Standing Committee of Chongryon, Song Kun Hak, its vice-chairman and concurrently director of its Education Department, Kang Chu Ryon, its vice-chairwoman and concurrently chairwoman of the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Democratic Korean Women in Japan, Han Tong Song, rector of the university, Hong Nam Gi, director of the board of trustees of the university, and its teaching staff and freshmen. Congratulatory messages from the Education Commission of the DPRK, Kim Il Sung University and other universities of the DPRK were read out at the ceremony. Pak Ku Ho made a congratulatory speech. He said the university is the dignified overseas university of the DPRK, which is associated with the immortal leadership feats of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and warm loving care of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, adding that it is also associated with the selfless devotion of the patriotic elder generations to the destiny of the movement of Koreans in Japan and the future of the younger generations, and with their lofty spirit. He expressed belief that the freshmen of the university would prepare themselves to be new type cadres of the nation full of vigor and high intellect, who will successfully carry forward the patriotic movement during their study at the university, by setting high goals and studying hard and thus acquiring special knowledge about cutting-edge science and other fields. A report was made by Han Tong Song, rector of the university, to be followed by oath-taking speeches. Rodong Sinmun

title: Enlarged Meeting of Third Session of 24th Central Committee of Chongryon Held
body: An enlarged meeting of the Third Session of the 24th Central Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) took place at the Korean Hall of Culture in Tokyo on September 6. Among those present there were Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of Chongryon, Nam Sung U, its vice-chairman, Pae Jin Gu, its vice-chairman and concurrently director general of its General Affairs Department, Pak Ku Ho, its vice-chairman and director of its Organization Department, and others. Discussed at the meeting were the first agenda item "On weathering severe difficulties unprecedented in the history of Chongryon and bringing earlier a new heyday of the movement of Koreans in Japan through an offensive for making a breakthrough head-on", the second agenda item "On organizational matter" and the third agenda item "On partial amendments and supplements to the rules of Chongryon". Ho Jong Man made a report on the first agenda item. He said that the enlarged meeting was held in the historic period when Chongryon is putting spurs to its five-month intensive campaign for greeting the "Chongryon Chapter Representative Conference-2020", keeping pace with the people in the homeland all out to greet the 75th founding anniversary of the glorious Workers' Party of Korea and its Eighth Congress with high political enthusiasm and brilliant labor feats under the outstanding guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. He noted that the present meeting aimed to discuss and decide on the policy of Chongryon for hastening a new heyday in the movement of Koreans in Japan at any cost in the face of the grave difficulties caused by widespread COVID-19. He called for ushering in a new heyday in the movement of Koreans in Japan at any cost with strong faith and by dint of the single-minded unity under any serious situation in the future. Then, speakers took the floor. Pak Ku Ho was elected first vice-chairman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee and Song Kun Hak its vice-chairman. The rules of Chongryon were partially modified and supplemented. A letter to Kim Jong Un was adopted at the meeting. Rodong Sinmun

title: Agro-technological Measures Taken Rapidly to Accelerate the Growth of Crops
body: Hugely delighted to be informed that Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un visited Kangbuk-ri, Kumchon County, North Hwanghae Province the agricultural officials, scientists and workers of the province strive mightily as never before to fertilize and tend their farm produce. They got detailed firsthand knowledge of the growth of the crops in their flood-ridden fields. On this basis they strenuously manure and cultivate them focusing on enabling their rice and corn to raise their photosynthetic ability and disease resistance so that their ears can ripen soon and gain in 1,000-grain weight. Moreover, they make great efforts to procure the photosynthetic intensifiers and growth promoters badly needed for better crops and extensively top-dress their leaves with them. Kim Song Chol

title: Construction of Makeshift Road between Tonsan-dong and Muhak-dong
body: Finished in the Main Encouraged by the drastic measures adopted by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un to recover the typhoon and flood damage of the Komdok area the officials and workers of many mines, factories and enterprises affiliated with the General Bureau of the Tanchon Area Mining Industry have risen as one in a campaign against the damage. They worked courageously by day and by night for several days to build the makeshift road between Tonsan-dong and Muhak-dong for dozens of kilometers by and large. Consequently, the traffic problem of the Komdok area has become able to be solved at an early date. Rodong Sinmun

title: The Dikes for the Unpha Stream Repaired
body: The officials and workers of Unpha County finished making repairs on the flood-ravaged dykes for the Unpha Stream for still more than dozens of meters hand in hand with the servicemen of the Korean People’s Army who are assigned to make good the flood damage of Taechong-ri. As a result, another singular success has been achieved in extricating the ri from the flood damage. Rodong Sinmun

title: Officials of WPK Central Committee and Their Families
body: Aid People in North and South Hamgyong Provinces Departments of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and families of their officials sincerely aided the residents in the typhoon-hit areas in North and South Hamgyong provinces. True to the noble intention of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un who dedicates himself to pleasure and happiness of the families across the country, always paying attention to taking care of the people, officials of the Party Central Committee and their families prepared lots of materials necessary for stabilizing the living of the inhabitants in the typhoon-hit areas and stepping up reconstruction there. Trains and trucks loaded with necessities, foodstuff and building materials prepared by the departments of the Party Central Committee and families of their officials arrived at Hongwon County and Tanchon City of South Hamgyong Province and Kim Chaek City of North Hamgyong Province. Choe Pu Il, Ho Chol Man, Pak Myong Sun, O Il Jong and other senior officials of the Party Central Committee handed over the aid materials to officials of the local Party and power organs. The officials of the Party Central Committee told the local officials that the Supreme Leader has taken unprecedented measures of loving care to rid of misfortune suffered by the people in the typhoon-hit areas as early as possible, feeling sick at his heart about their pain. They also urged the local officials to do their best to stabilize the life of the people and stand in the van of the recovery campaign, being well aware of the sincerity of the Party Central Committee. The officials of the Party Central Committee learned in detail about the damage in the Komdok area and living conditions of the residents. They called upon officials and people there to please the Supreme Leader by successfully tiding over the present hardships and difficulties and achieving a victory in the forefront which the Party concentrates all efforts on. The people in the typhoon-hit areas said that they received various kinds of necessities and foodstuff reflecting sincerity of the officials of the departments of the Party Central Committee, who upholds the high intention of the Supreme Leader nearest to him, and their families, and keenly felt they are always under the care of the Party Central Committee though they live far from the capital. Noting that they are not fearful of any natural disaster as they are led by the motherly Party taking warm care of them when they face difficulties, the people in the typhoon-hit areas expressed their patriotic will to turn their villages into socialist fairyland admired by the world by working miracles of turning adversity into favorable situation. Rodong Sinmun

title: Okryu Restaurant Marks Its 60th Founding Anniversary
body: Okryu Restaurant marked its 60th founding anniversary. The restaurant is a legacy left by President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il for the people and a beloved home at which they feel thankful for the socialist system while being served with Pyongyang cold noodle and delicacies. Kim Il Sung initiated the plan for building a peculiar public catering establishment on the picturesque bank of River Taedong and named it Okryu Restaurant. He visited the restaurant, which was built in a magnificent style on August 13, Juche 49(1960), and specified the orientation and way of its service activities after declaring its inauguration. Chairman Kim Jong Il saw to it that a delicacy house was built after the construction of Moran Restaurant, House No. 1 and House No. 2 of Okryu Restaurant and sent modern kitchen equipment, utensils and fittings. He made sure that the restaurant is favored by the people for its delicious noodle and delicacies. For the past 60 years, the restaurant has been renowned as a restaurant favored by people of the DPRK, compatriots in the south and abroad, and as a public catering establishment in which the people enjoy the benefits of socialism. The Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea sent a congratulatory message to the employees and officials of the restaurant greeting its 60th founding anniversary. A ceremony for conveying the congratulatory message took place on Sept. 16. Rodong Sinmun

title: Cuban President Sends Floral Basket and Bouquet to DPRK Embassy
body: Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez, president of the Republic of Cuba, sent a floral basket and bouquet to the DPRK embassy in Havana on the occasion of the 72nd founding anniversary of the DPRK. Rodong Sinmun

title: Priority Given to Securing Necessary Materials
body: The officials of Kyongsong County have bestirred themselves further to hit their grain production target for this year without fail. They have made detailed arrangements to improve the growth of their crops. They got concrete firsthand knowledge of them and held the ensuing virtual meeting in which the problem of draining the inundated fields on a priority basis, top-dressing the leaves of the crops, spraying the crops with germicide, etc, plus various related methods were discussed mainly and detailed work assignments were given to individual farms. At the meeting the special emphasis was placed on ensuring that physical conditions must be afforded to promote the growth of the crops and that satisfactory efforts must be made to the last to increase the output of the crops to the maximum. Consequently, the county hurried to secure liquid nutrients and germicide for its farms so that they could be top-dressed to the leaves of their crops. In the final analysis, the growth of the crops is improved remarkably in the farms of the county. Kim Chol Nam

title: Through Innovative Planning and Stubborn Practice
body: The officials and farmers of Sinchon County fully exert themselves to manure and cultivate their crops. All its cooperative farms adopt thorough agro-technological measures to minimize the damages of their crops and increase their crop yield. Techniques were passed on to them to suit their actual conditions and the natural features of the relevant areas. This marked an important occasion for overcoming deviations in their water control. The farmers of the county are now continuing to tenaciously and responsibly fertilize and tend their crops all the time, fully prepared to attain their grain goal without fail this year. Ri Chung Il

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Reply Message to Lao President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), on September 14 sent a reply message to Bounnang Vorachith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party (LPRP) and president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic (LPDR). Kim Jong Un in the message expressed his deep thanks to the general secretary for sending warm congratulations on the occasion of the 72nd founding anniversary of the DPRK and extending firm support and solidarity to the WPK and the DPRK people in their struggle for building a powerful socialist country and achieving the national reunification. The message said that it is the consistent stand of the WPK and the government of the DPRK to invariably develop the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation between the two parties and two countries, which were provided in the joint struggle for accomplishing the cause of socialism. It sincerely wished the general secretary greater success in his responsible work for leading the party and the state. Rodong Sinmun

title: People of Kangbuk-ri, Kumchon County of North Hwanghae Province
body: Move to New Houses The people of Kangbuk-ri in Kumchon County, North Hwanghae Province hit by natural disaster moved to new houses built as the socialist fairyland and a model socialist farm village by the struggle of service personnel of the People's Army true to the noble intention of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. A ceremony of moving to newly built houses in the seat of Kangbuk-ri was held on Sept. 17. Attending it were Pak Chang Ho, chairman of the North Hwanghae Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Im Hun, chairman of the North Hwanghae Provincial People's Committee, officials concerned, residents of the seat and solider builders. Pak Chang Ho made a congratulatory speech. He said that though Kim Jong Un was very busy with state affairs, he ordered the KPA to urgently dispatch service personnel to the area to facelift the village and settled all the problems arising in the construction, right after receiving a report about the situation in Kangbuk-ri. The soldier builders who rushed to the damaged area on the order given by Kim Jong Un reconstructed the seat of Kangbuk-ri by waging a fierce struggle and achieved the proud success of making the first report of victory on the front for the recovery from natural disaster to the Central Committee of the WPK, he said. He noted that the Supreme Leader personally visited Kangbuk-ri, Kumchon County whose looks have undergone a radical change, hoped the residents in the place would settle down in the new village and new dwelling houses to lead a happy life and that the area would always be visited by fortune, and took a benevolent measure of letting the inhabitants move to new houses earlier. He stressed that all the officials and agricultural workers should bear in mind the boundless loving care and benevolence of the mother Party which would be handed down forever, trust in and follow only our Party to the end with a single mind and defend socialism and our revolution with rice. House licenses were conferred on the residents in the damaged area at the ceremony. Resolution speeches were made there. Speakers said that they would bear in mind the present deep gratitude and happiness forever and thoroughly carry out the Party's agricultural policy for glorifying the 75th founding anniversary of the WPK and its Eighth Congress with the proud success of high-yield. And the residents entered new dwelling houses amid the congratulations from officials, working people and soldier builders. The officials of the province and commanding officers of the unit which participated in the construction visited families that moved to new dwelling houses. They congratulated the residents who were excited to move to modern houses with all wonderful living conditions and shared pleasure with them, giving daily necessities. The gratitude of the people filled each dwelling house in the socialist fairyland village that was built by removing all traces of great disaster. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Reply Message to General Secretary of C.C.,
body: Communist Party of Vietnam Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), on Sept. 14 sent a reply message to Nguyen Phu Trong, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam and president of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam. Kim Jong Un in the message expressed deep thanks to the general secretary for sending warm congratulations on the occasion of the 72nd founding anniversary of the DPRK and for greatly encouraging the Korean people in their struggle for building a powerful socialist country. Kim Jong Un in the message expressed expectation and belief that the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation between the two parties and the two countries would grow stronger in the future in accordance with the spirit of the agreement at the significant meeting with the general secretary last year. The message sincerely wished the general secretary greater success in his responsible work for the development of the party and the country's prosperity. Rodong Sinmun

title: Ansok Tideland Completed
body: Ansok Tideland was inaugurated in the DPRK. It took about three years for officials and workers of South Phyongan Provincial Tideland Reclamation General Enterprise to reclaim the tideland. The successful reclamation of the tideland, fruition of the devoted efforts of the tideland builders, laid foundations for the country's agricultural development. The builders reclaimed the tideland by building a dozens of kilometers-long bank in the West Sea of Korea. They are brave conquerors of sea upholding the grandiose nature-remaking plan of the Party by working miracles of creating a thing out of nothing. The reclaimed tideland comes to be their gift to the motherly Party. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Reply Message to Cuban President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), sent a reply message to Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez, president of the Republic of Cuba, on September 14. Kim Jong Un in the message expressed deep thanks to the Cuban president for sending his heartfelt congratulations on the occasion of the 72nd founding anniversary of the DPRK. Kim Jong Un expressed his conviction that the traditional friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries would steadily develop in the spirit of the agreement reached at the historic meeting and talks with the president in November, 2018. He sincerely wished the Cuban president greater successes in his responsible work for firmly defending the gains of revolution and building a prosperous socialist state. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Reply Message to First Secretary of C.C.,
body: Communist Party of Cuba Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, sent a reply message to Raul Castro Ruz, first secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba (CPC), on Sept. 14. Kim Jong Un in the message expressed deep thanks to the first secretary for sending warm congratulations on the occasion of the 72nd founding anniversary of the DPRK. Saying that he is always pleased to see the Party and people of Cuba have steadily advanced the cause of socialism, overcoming all sorts of hardships and difficulties under the correct leadership of the first secretary, Kim Jong Un in the message extended firm support and solidarity to the Cuban party and people. He sincerely wished the first secretary good health and greater success in his noble work for leading the Cuban revolution. Rodong Sinmun

title: Telecommunications Line Restored in South Hamgyong Province
body: The officials and employees of the Posts and Telecommunications Bureau of South Hamgyong Province restored the telecommunications of its flood-hit areas in close liaison with the Ministry of Post and Telecommunications. They satisfactorily enabled officials to direct the restoration of the flood-stricken areas with recourse to telecommunications. They are now focusing their great efforts on restoring their dangerous telecommunication spots to their original state. Kim Kyong Chol

title: Cement for Reconstruction Arrives at Chongjin Port, Concentrated Transport Arranged
body: A cargo ship left the Hungnam Port laden with cement to rebuild the flood-ridden areas of North Hamgyong Province with and arrived at the Chongjin Port. The province is now arranging the KPA servicemen and the people to discharge the cement from the cargo ship without any waste hand in hand and transport it to its flood-torn areas. The officials and employees of the Chongjin Port have risen as one to unload the cement as soon as possible. The province concentratedly sends the cement to the most damaged areas of all its typhoon victims. Rodong Sinmun

title: Four Days and Three Nights of Fierce Struggle
body: The servicemen of the Korean People’s Army and the workers of the Ryongyang Mine finished building a makeshift road in Tonsan-dong, Tanchon City within four days and three nights although it was believed to take them full 15 days. This manifestly demonstrates that the great unity of the army men and the people can convert adversity into prosperity under whatever worst conditions. The construction of the makeshift road has enabled the rest of the road to be repaired promptly. Rodong Sinmun

title: Meeting of Korean Federation of Workers in Commerce in Japan Held
body: The 34th general meeting of the Korean Federation of Workers in Commerce in Japan took place in Tokyo on September 12. Attending it were Jo Il Yon, vice-chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), and officials of the federation and deputies. The meeting reviewed the federation's past work for ushering in a new heyday of the movement of Koreans in Japan in the face of today's difficulties and discussed and decided on the orientation of its work and main tasks to be carried out for the coming two years. O Min Hak, managing director of the Standing Council of the federation, in a report said that the federation has developed into a capable economic organization and an organization which contributes to the patriotic cause for the last two years under the wise leadership and care of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. He noted that the federation has fulfilled its responsibility and duty in tiding over the difficulties caused by widespread COVID-19, preserving the rights and interests of Korean traders and industrialists in Japan and contributing to the patriotic work of Chongryon. Stressing the need to further develop the federation into a competent economic organization with innovative management system and a powerful organization waging a vigorous patriotic movement, he referred to its four main tasks. Speeches were made by officials of commercial organizations at all levels. Pak Chung U was reelected chairman of the federation and O Min Hak managing director of its Standing Council. Jo Il Yon made a speech. Then, there was an enlarged meeting of the First Session of the 34th Standing Council of the Korean Federation of Workers in Commerce in Japan. Rodong Sinmun

title: New Novel Published in DPRK
body: The April 15 Literary Production Company in the DPRK recently brought out the full-length novel "Regeneration" (authored by Paek Nam Ryong), the first one of the cycle of novels "Immortal Milestones", which comprehensively deals with the greatness and immortal revolutionary feats of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. "Immortal Milestones", together with the cycle of novels "Immortal History" and the cycle of novels "Immortal Guidance", makes grand epic representation of the sacred revolutionary history of the leader and his personality as a great man. It comes to be one of our nation's eternally valuable assets. The setting of the novel is the historical period when the Supreme Leader was paving the road toward the eminence of a talent power where all the people are well versed in science and technology after pioneering the radical improvement in education in the new century. Paek Song Gun

title: Agitation Activities Encourage Campaign for Recovery from Damage
body: Central art troupes are waging frontline-style agitation activities in the areas for recovery from damage, true to the militant appeal of the Party Central Committee. Artistes from the National Folk Art Troupe are encouraging the people through frontline-style agitation in the campaign sites for rehabilitation in North Hwanghae Province including Taechong-ri, Unpha County. Creators and artistes from several central art troupes including the National Theatrical Troupe and the National Circus instill revolutionary optimism into the members of the divisions of Party members of the capital city through peculiar performance activities. Artistes from the Phibada Opera Troupe have been engaged in impressive performing activities at the construction sites in Kangwon Province. Members of the artistes' squad for agitation for increased production of the central art troupes also continue the campaign for inspiring faith and spirit of struggle in each rehabilitation campaign area. Rodong Sinmun

title: Foreigners Pay Congratulatory Visits to DPRK Missions
body: Personages from all walks of life in different countries visited DPRK missions in their countries in the period between September 7 and 9 on the occasion of the 72nd founding anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. They laid floral baskets and bunches of flowers before the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and art works depicting Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il standing together and paid tribute to them. Among the visitors were the general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Bangladesh (Marxist-Leninist), the president of the Bangladesh People's League, the chairman of the Bangladesh-Korea Friendship and Solidarity Committee, the chairman of the Bangladesh Group for the Study of the Songun Policy, the chairman of the Nepal Journalist Association for the Study of the Juche Idea and Songun Politics, the chairman of the Study Forum for Self-Reliance of Nepal, the chairman of the Study and Research Forum of Songun Politics of the National Press Club of Nepal, the chairman of the Nepali Literary Forum for the Study of Songun Politics, the chairman of the International Committee for the Study of Songun Politics for Peaceful Reunification of Korea in Nepal, the chairman of the Nepalese Association for Supporting the Songun Politics, the secretary general of the Nepal-Korea Friendship Association, the chairman of the Mongolia-Korea Friendship Society, the chairman of the Mongolian Mt Paektu Association for Independent Development, the chairman and the executive chairman of the Mongolian Association for the Study of the Juche Idea-Songun Idea, the president of the J. Sambuu Herders Development Fund of Mongolia, a secretary of the Central Council of the Communist Parties-the Communist Party of the Soviet Union, the chief of the Belarusian Group for Solidarity with the DPRK, the vice-director of the International Department of the Democratic Party of Equatorial Guinea, the chairman of the Ethiopian National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism and the chairman of the Ethiopian Committee for the Study of the Independent Politics. And the Committee for External Affairs of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party and the Central Committee of the Lao Federation of Trade Unions sent floral baskets to the DPRK mission in Laos. Rodong Sinmun

title: Channeling Its Primary Efforts on Repairing Roads
body: Makeshift roads were built over rivers and the passes and roads destroyed by landslides were restored in many areas of North Hamgyong Province. Consequently, materials and goods have been enabled to be transported to its flood-hit areas by sea and land. Kim Chaek City and Myonggan County repaired their bridges and restored their roads to their original state to enable the transportation of their materials and goods. In cooperation with the KPA servicemen other districts, too, built bypasses and makeshift roads and bridges in a short time. While consolidating its already won successes the province goes on repairing its northbound roads and finally opening up one blocked transport route after the other. Rodong Sinmun

title: Setting Harvest Time Properly and Exerting All Efforts
body: Having fixed their harvest season correctly the cooperative farms of South Hwanghae Province concentrate all their labor on harvesting corn. The officials and workers of factories and enterprises in the province actively give helping hands to harvesting. A corn harvest is reaped full steam in North Hwanghae Province, too. The officials and agricultural workers of North Phyongan Province do themselves full justice in their corn harvest, resolved to defend our socialism and revolution with cereals. The agricultural officials and workers of Pyongyang, Nampho City, South Phyongan Province and other districts, too, examine whether or not corn has ripened and harvest it with success. Rodong Sinmun

title: Cement Production Increased by Thousands of Tons
body: The workers and management of cement factories across the country successfully produced thousands of tons more cement. The officials and workers of the Sangwon Cement Complex do their level best every moment to supply the flood-hit areas of the country with as much cement as possible and help toward their restoration. The Sunchon Cement Complex, too, does its part creditably. The workers of the Chonnaeri Cement Factory and its nationwide counterparts, too, are now going all-out to turn out cement for the restoration of the flood-torn areas under way. Rodong Sinmun

title: Encouraged by the Fighting Spirit of Division of Party Members of Capital City
body: The officials and workers of South Hamgyong Province register success after success in restoring its flood-ridden areas in step with the men of the Division No. 1 of the Party Members of the capital city. They finished making concrete blocks for their housing construction and excavated and concreted the ground for the foundations of their dwellings in a short time. They are now building their walls with concrete blocks at the last stage while at the same time processing reinforcing bars and realigning the surroundings of their dwellings under construction. The labor and management of the factories and enterprises of the province, too, strive mightily to produce cement and structural steel as assigned to do so. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Premier Kim Tok Hun Inspects Industrial Establishments
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the DPRK, inspected various industrial establishments. At the Chollima Steel Complex, Kim Tok Hun gave pep talk to its furnacemen all out in the drive for increasing production, true to the noble intention of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un to provide the people in the typhoon-hit areas with happy life as early as possible. He called on them to fully display their spirit and mettle as the working class of Kangson in the recovery campaign on which the Party concentrates efforts. In the steel workshop and others, he took measures for tackling the problems arising in keeping electric furnaces going at a high rate and improving the technical control of strand-casting machine. At the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex, he underscored the need to accelerate the installment of the large oxygen separator and conduct a mass technological innovation movement for increasing iron and steel production by introducing rational melting methods and decreasing the steelmaking time. During his inspection of the Pyongyang Electric Fitments Factory, he called upon its officials to produce more electric fitments with locally available raw and other materials by giving full play to revolutionary enthusiasm and creative ingenuity of its workers. The field consultative meetings urged relevant units to fully supply electricity, raw and materials in order to increase iron and steel production urgently needed for reconstruction projects, and took practical measures to introduce efficient methods into fitment production. Earlier, he inspected the Sunchon Cement Complex and the Posan Iron Works. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Wreath to Bier of Late Jon Hui Jong
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un on Monday sent a wreath to the bier of Jon Hui Jong, former vice-minister of Foreign Affairs who is honoree of Order of Kim Il Sung and Order of Kim Jong Il, expressing deep condolences over his death. Jon Hui Jong, who grew up into a competent official in charge of foreign affairs under the care of the peerlessly great men, made great contributions to realizing the foreign policy of our Party and the DPRK government with immense loyalty and devotion to the Party and the revolution, the country and the people. The wreath sent by the Supreme Leader was placed before the bier of the deceased. Rodong Sinmun

title: New Posters Produced
body: The Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House brought out new posters for celebrating the 75th founding anniversary of the glorious WPK. A poster carries the Party Founding Museum, the red Party flag and a bunch of flowers along with letters "The Celebration of the 75th Founding Anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea", which makes every viewer look back upon the development of the WPK and the history of its struggle. Another poster "The Highest Glory to our Great Party!" depicts a worker, peasant and intellectual holding high a hammer, sickle and writing brush against a display of fireworks in nocturnal sky and torchlight parades. It shows well the respect of all the people for our great Party and their faith and will. Rodong Sinmun

title: Many Poems and Songs Created in Reconstruction Campaign Sites
body: Poets are conducting vigorous creative activities in reconstruction campaign sites, the front line for defending the people. Poems like "Party members of the capital city, Forward!" and "I am a Party Member in the Capital City of Pyongyang" and lyrics "March of Division of Party members of the Capital City" and "We are Lifeguards of the Party Central Committee" are running through with the revolutionary fighting spirit of the Party members in the capital city who volunteered to work in the reconstruction campaign sites of South and North Hamgyong provinces, true to the appeal made by the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Lyrics in praise of the loving care shown by the motherly Party for the people in disaster-hit areas have been created. Those poems like " We Devote Our Sincerity", "Together with You", "Party Members, Forward!" and "24 Hours They Had" show well the struggle of the Party members who are waging a 24-7 reconstruction campaign to provide the people in the disaster-stricken areas with better dwelling houses and living condition. Poets also encouraged the builders with their impromptu poems to work miracles in the reconstruction campaign sites of North Hwanghae and Kangwon provinces. Rodong Sinmun

title: Putting forward Strenuously with Priority
body: The officers of the division No. 1 of the Party members of the capital city make detailed arrangements to establish an emergency anti-epidemic network in the flood-hit areas of South Hamgyong Province under restoration. Stationed in Hongwon County the battalions of the division No. 1 finished their waterworks within two days of their arrival. Consequently, their members drink thoroughly sanitary water. Settled in Riwon County the members of other battalions are made to thoroughly sterilize and boil water for drinking purposes to meet the demand of the on-the-spot conditions. Besides, the system of normal water examination has been set up lest even the slightest deviation may be committed. Rodong Sinmun

title: Turning Out as One to Increase Iron and Steel Production
body: The steelworkers of the country have stoutly turned out in the production of steel manufactures for the recovery of the flood damage of its areas. The officials and employees of the Steel Works of South Hamgyong Province are no exception to it. They finished producing the steel manufactures needed to repair the flood damage of Kangwon Province. They then proceeded to do that for the flood-torn areas of their province. Their efforts meet with success. The mill workers of the steel works devotedly churn out more rolled steel plates day after day for the flood-torn areas of the country under restoration. Rodong Sinmun

title: Plenty of Materials and Goods Aided with Sincerity
body: The officials and workers of South Phyongan Province(SPP) provided the flood-hit areas of the country with an abundance of materials and goods for their restoration. The cities and counties of SPP maximized the role of their skilled workers and the utility rate of their machines and thus produced various kinds of furnishings. The officials and workers of Kaechon City and Sukchon County in particular take the lead in the provision of furnishings with a high sense of responsibility and great devotion. SPP sent more than 100,000 pieces of materials and goods of tens of kinds to the flood-hit areas of Kangwon Province under restoration on many occasions. Rodong Sinmun

title: Machines and Spare Parts Produced Preferentially
body: In the sphere of the machine-building industry its officials and workers have risen as one to produce the machines and spare parts needed to recover the flood damage of some areas of the country. New successes are gained at the Anju Pump Factory. The Kyongsong Insulator Factory carries out its work assignments exemplarily. Through a fierce socialist emulation among their workshops and workteams the Taean Electric Appliances Factory and many other plants and enterprises bring about an upswing in producing machines and spare parts for the flood-ridden areas of the country under restoration on a top-priority footing. Rodong Sinmun

title: Sincere Aid to Areas under Reconstruction
