body: In Pyongyang the officials and members of the Socialist Women’s Union of Korea support the flood-wrecked areas of the country with utmost sincerity in their restoration. The officials of the Taedonggang District, Hyongjesan District and Kangnam County Committees of the SWUK donated building utensils and tools to the flood-stricken areas. The Mangyongdae, Tongdaewon, Rangnang and Sosong District Committees of the SWUK secured many goods at home with their whole heart and contributed them to the flood victims. The SWUK’s organizations of Ryongsong and Ryokpho Districts heartily procured clothes and various kinds of other daily necessities and supplies. The members of the SWUK’s organizations of Central and Sunan Districts, too, did all they could to support the flood sufferers. A few days ago hundreds of members of the SWUK’s organizations of Moranbong, Songyo and Samsok Districts procured plenty of supplies and building materials and donated them to the flood-ridden areas under restoration. The members of the SWUK’s organizations of Phyongchon and Taesong Districts and Kangdong County secured relief goods from the bottom of their hearts and contributed them to the areas. Rodong Sinmun

title: Active Support Rendered to Reconstruction Sites
body: The Party members and working people of North Phyongan Province wholeheartedly support the KPA servicemen and civilians in repairing the flood damage of many areas of the country. On September 11 they fed hundreds of tons of scrap iron to metalworking plants so that steel manufactures could be turned out with them to accelerate the restoration of many flood-torn areas. Moreover, they sent furnishings and other materials to the areas on many occasions. They continue to do that enthusiastically still now. They gathered hundreds of tons of iron scraps, which were transported by rail to metalworking plants on September 22. This greatly encourages the workers of metalworking plants to work harder than ever to produce more steel manufactures to renovate the areas. Rodong Sinmun

title: Important Materials Transported Timely
body: The officials and workers of the railway sector are all-out to transport materials to the flood-hit areas of the country under restoration. They have so far carried large quantities of cement, timber, etc to them. The officials and workers of the Pyongyang, Hamhung and Chongjin Railway Bureaus work with devotion to send relief materials for restoration to their destinations in good time. The workers and management of many factories and enterprises affiliated with the Ministry of Railways and the railway bureaus also contribute positively to materials transport by courageously overcoming their trials and bottlenecks and dynamically producing spare parts. Rodong Sinmun

title: Wreath Laid before Bust of Anti-Japanese War Heroine Kim Jong Suk
body: A wreath was placed before the bust of the anti-Japanese war heroine Kim Jong Suk in the Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery on Mt Taesong on Sept. 22, the 71st anniversary of her demise. Attending the wreath-laying ceremony were Ri Il Hwan, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and officials of the Party Central Committee. A wreath in the name of the Party Central Committee was laid before the bust of Kim Jong Suk. The participants observed a moment's silence in memory of the noble life and revolutionary exploits of Kim Jong Suk. Meanwhile, Chief Pak Su Chol and members of the Pyongyang Mission of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front also visited the cemetery and laid bouquets before her bust. That day officials of local Party and power organs and service personnel laid bouquets before her statues in Hoeryong City, Kim Jong Suk County, Kim Jong Suk Naval University, etc. before making a bow. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Basket to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Indonesian President
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a floral basket from Joko Widodo, president of the Republic of Indonesia, on the occasion of the 72nd founding anniversary of the DPRK. The floral basket was handed over to an official concerned by the Indonesian ambassador to the DPRK on Tuesday. Rodong Sinmun

title: When Everyone Buckles Down to Afforestation
body: The rain teemed down in Kujang County, too, this year but it did not fall prey to so much damage mainly because it planted, protected and raised trees well in its land and mountains. The successes it has so far scored in its reafforestation lay a springboard for its greater future victories. Having set itself a goal of winning the title of a model county in afforestation without fail within the period of the second stage of its reafforestation the county is now achieving one success after another in garbing itself in green. Rodong Sinmun

title: Pumps Produced and Supplied as Planned
body: The workers and management of the Anju Pump Factory step up the production of pumps of various kinds for the flood-hit areas of South Hamgyong Province under restoration. They double the output of their pumps every day as never before through a brisk socialist emulation conducted among their workshops and workteams and individuals. Rodong Sinmun

title: Railways in Komdok Area Repaired on Full Scale
body: In the railway sector its officials and workers energetically accelerate the restoration of railway in the Komdok area. The Tanchon Railway Branch of the Hamhung Railway Bureau preferentially procures the materials needed to restore destroyed railways and electric car cables and actively apply rational working methods. It qualitatively replaces its ruined ties with new ones, repairs its relevant structures and hardens its railway beds with speed. The officials and workers of the Pyongyang and Kaechon Railway Bureaus and many other units raise the speed of their construction notably through an active socialist emulation positively applying rational working methods. Rodong Sinmun

title: Cement Transported by Ship Successively
body: Laden with the cement needed to restore the flood-wrecked areas of North Hamgyong Province many cargo ships leave the Hungnam and Wonsan Ports for them one after another. The officials and workers of the Chongjin Port and many other units have carefully examined and maintained their harbor cranes and adopted meticulous measures to mobilize all their unloaders of diverse kinds. Consequently, instantly cargo ships enter the Chongjin Port cement is transloaded onto freight cars and giant motor trucks. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Amir of Qatar
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Tamim Bin Hamad Al-Thani, amir of the State of Qatar, on September 9. The message said: I have the pleasure, on the anniversary of your country's founding day, to extend to you and your people, on behalf of the people of the State of Qatar and my own behalf, our cordial greetings and felicitations, coupled with our best wishes for Your Excellency's good health and well-being and continued development and progress for your friendly people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Mauritanian President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Mohamed Ould Cheikh El Ghazouani, president of the Islamic Republic of Mauritania, on Sept. 8. The president in the message said that on the occasion of the celebration by the Democratic People's Republic of Korea of its national day, he was glad to express to Kim Jong Un his warmest congratulations as well as his best wishes of progress and prosperity for the friendly DPRK people. He added that he also renewed to Kim Jong Un their common desire and keenness to continue their efforts to strengthen and develop the cooperation relations between the two countries in order to serve the interests of the two peoples. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Indonesian President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Joko Widodo, president of the Republic of Indonesia, on Sept. 2. The message said: Please allow me to convey to Your Excellency and the people of Democratic People's Republic of Korea, my sincere congratulations on the occasion of the 72nd anniversary of the founding day of the DPRK on 9 September 2020. I believe the spirit of the founding day will strengthen efforts of the government and people of DPRK to overcome the challenges caused by the COVID-19 pandemic. I would also like to take this opportunity to reiterate my commitment in strengthening the cooperation between Indonesia and DPR Korea for mutual benefit of our two nations, as well as for the peace and progress in the region and beyond. Please accept, Excellency, the renewed assurances of my highest consideration and my best wishes for Your Excellency's good health and continued success in Your Excellency's noble tasks. Rodong Sinmun

title: Anti-Japanese War Heroine Kim Jong Suk Praised by Arab-Korean Cooperation Council
body: The Arab-Korean Cooperation Council posted on its website an article titled "The Anti-Japanese War Heroine Kim Jong Suk" on September 19. The website in the article illustrated with photos of President Kim Il Sung and the anti-Japanese war heroine Kim Jong Suk said that history knows many prominent women renowned for their dedications to the progress and prosperity of their countries and nations, but no outstanding woman political activist except for Kim Jong Suk who devoted her all to the freedom and happiness of people. The article said that she joined the Korean People's Revolutionary Army led by the President in 1935 and waged long bloody battles with arms in hands for the liberation of the country, thus winning fame as an anti-Japanese war woman commander and competent political activist during those days. She had displayed matchless bravery, outstanding strategies and astonishing marksmanship in many battles, it noted, adding it is her greatest exploit that she had resolutely defended the President. It noted that after the liberation of Korea, she had faithfully assisted the President who was working hard to build a new country. She was loved and revered by the people for having performed immortal feats on behalf of the country and nation, but passed away at her early age on September 22, 1949, it said. It stressed that the noble life of Kim Jong Suk, which remains as an indelible trace in the modern history of Korea, will shine long along with the prosperous DPRK. Rodong Sinmun

title: Taking Care of Crop Nutrition to the Last
body: The officials and members of the Posok Cooperative Farm in Unjon County have striven tenaciously to the last to minimize the damage of their crops and boost their yield. The farmers spray their paddy rice with liquid nutrients and apply germicide to it according to the demand of technology. Meanwhile, they ceaselessly do their utmost to accelerate the growth of the paddy rice. Rodong Sinmun

title: Flood-stricken Areas under Reconstruction Given Material Aid and Moral Support
body: The officials and working people of North Phyongan Province heartily donated large quantities of relief goods to the flood-ravaged areas of Kangwon Province under restoration feeling as if the misfortune befell them. The cities and counties of North Phyongan Province actively found out and tapped out their internal reserves and raised the utilization of their machines, thereby producing various kinds of furnishings on a high qualitative level. The relief goods were transported to the areas by rail on many occasions. Rodong Sinmun

title: Displaying the Might of Revolutionary Army
body: The servicemen of the units of the Korean People’s Army attain daily successes in building dwellings in Kimhwa County. They are now covering the interior and exterior of the dwellings with plaster, coating them with related materials, tiling their toilet rooms and others, planting trees for landscaping purposes, realigning their surroundings and doing other final works with great speed. Taking the lead in doing difficult and labor-consuming jobs the officers of the units inspire their soldiers to further efforts. Rodong Sinmun

title: Dwelling Construction Begins in Komdok Area, Foundation Excavation Concluded
body: Housing construction progresses apace in the Komdok area. As of September 24 the servicemen of the Korean People’s Army finished excavating the ground for the foundations of dwellings in their charge and started concreting it. The soldiers of a KPA unit fully demonstrated their fighting strength in excavating the ground for the foundations of flats of several stories in the Ryongyang Mine area for building purposes. The soldiers of another KPA unit, too, achieved great results day after day in excavating the ground for the foundations of their dwellings in the area of the Komdok Mining Complex and the Taehung Youth Hero Mine. The ground was excavated successfully for the foundations of dwellings by and large through a sharp competition among the KPA units. The servicemen of the units began concreting the ground for the foundations of their dwellings the instant they finished excavating it. Many of them have already finished their ground concrete tamping and started walling their dwellings with concrete blocks. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Reply Message to Cuban President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a reply message to Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez, president of the Republic of Cuba, on September 22. Kim Jong Un in the message expressed deep thanks to the Cuban president for sending heartfelt condolence over the damage caused by a series of typhoons that hit the DPRK. The message sincerely wished the Cuban president greater success in his responsible work. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from President of Cape Verde
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), received a message of greeting from Jorge Carlos Fonseca, president of the Republic of Cape Verde, on Sept. 9. In the message, the president extended warm congratulations to Kim Jong Un on behalf of the people of the Republic of Cape Verde and on his own behalf on the national day of the DPRK, and wished the DPRK and its people steady progress. The message also wished Kim Jong Un and his family good health. Rodong Sinmun

title: Species of Fruit Trees Adapted to Northern Highlands Grow in Number
body: In recent years apples, plums and many other fruit trees of various tasty species are acclimated and widely raised in Ryanggang Province. The researchers of the provincial commission of science and technology pooled their wisdom and efforts to breed and cultivate fruit trees of delicious and fragrant varieties. This finally met with success. It is remarkable that apple trees have struck root and begun to bear fruit in Samjiyon although it is high above the sea. Lying in a northern highlands region Ryanggang Province works to popularize the successes and experiences acquired in the cultivation of fruit trees and expand and grow high-yielding ones which are acclimated in its soil. Rodong Sinmun

title: Final-stage Project Progresses Apace
body: The construction of dwellings nears completion in the flood-wrecked areas of North Hwanghae Province under restoration. Officials, workers and the KPA soldiers go all-out to finish them in concert as soon as possible. Taechong-ri, Unpha County is being transfigured admirably. New villages show their pretty figures respectively in the flood-ridden areas of North Hwanghae Province as a result of the indefatigable round-the-clock work of officials, builders and the KPA servicemen. Rodong Sinmun

title: Railways Repaired in the Main in Komdok Area, Transportation by Train Begins
body: By dint of devoted work the officials and workers of the railway sector and the servicemen of the units of the Korean People’s Army mainly restored railways in the Komdok area and opened them to traffic. The materials for the recovery of the damage of the area were transported by rail as far as the Kumgol Youth Railway Station on September 24 for the first time. The workers and servicemen register success after success in their restoration projects by their united efforts. Rodong Sinmun

title: Pak Pong Ju Inspects Industrial Establishments
body: Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the WPK, inspected different units of the national economy. At the Sunchon Cement Complex, he learned about the overhaul of a kiln and production. He gave pep talks to the workers waging a campaign in the spirit of self-reliance and fortitude for increasing the production of cement needed for the recovery from damage by natural disasters, on which the Party concentrates primary efforts, and called on them to increase output by giving full play to the existing production capacity. The field consultative meeting called for giving priority to the political work to inspire workers, and took measures for decisively strengthening the material and technical foundations of the complex, which plays an important role in implementing the Party's economic policy, and ensuring its strategic and rational management. Earlier, he visited the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex to acquaint himself with production and care of equipment. He chaired a consultative meeting of officials concerned to complete the project for establishing the C1 chemical industry as early as possible. Meanwhile, he went round flood-hit Taechong-ri, Unpha County of North Hwanghae Province, where construction of dwelling houses is underway, and underscored the need to finish the construction at the level desired by the Party. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Birthday Spread to Woman Centenarian
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un sent a birthday spread to Kim Song Ok, a centenarian living in the township of Jaeryong County, South Hwanghae Province. She, born into a poor peasant's family, keenly experienced the grief of being a stateless woman before the liberation of the country, being subject to humiliation and insult. She could lead a worthwhile life as a master of the country after President Kim Il Sung liberated the country. Granted farmland she had ardently desired, she worked hard to live up to the solicitude of the country. During the Fatherland Liberation War, she was active in supporting service personnel of the People's Army. She also positively took part in postwar agricultural cooperativization. She dedicated herself to increasing agricultural production for decades with a sense of responsibility for the granary of the country. Leading a worthwhile life as a member of the family of a patriotic martyr, she requests her descendants to do more work for the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Blasting of 160 000 Cubic Meter Earth Successful at Sunchon Limestone Mine
body: The blasting of 160 000 cubic meter earth was successfully carried out at the Sunchon Limestone Mine on Friday. The blasting of earth provided a firm guarantee for producing cement necessary for the recovery from damage by natural disasters. The officials and workers of the mine are making collective innovations, not resting on their laurels. Rodong Sinmun

title: Offensive Agitprop Rousing People to Perform Feats
body: An agitprop offensive is vigorously going on in Ichon and Cholwon counties and many other flood-hit areas of Kangwon Province under reconstruction to inspire the builders to great efforts. The members of the art propaganda squads and itinerant art squads of many construction corps which build dwellings in the areas conduct vigorous agitprop activities in a novel and militant way where the dwellings are under construction. Rodong Sinmun

title: Saplings of Good Breeds Produced
body: The central tree nurseries of the Ministries of Land and Environment Protection and Urban Management register success after success in producing the saplings to be planted in the autumn. The officials and employees of the Central Tree Nursery of the Ministry of Land and Environment Protection improved the production conditions of their tree nursery as a whole and increased the output of saplings per unit area. The officials and employees of the Central Tree Nursery of the Ministry of Urban Management strove mightily to solidify their material and technological foundations. They achieve successes in the production of their saplings by working with devotion to afforest and landscape the whole country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Ryanggang Provincial Old People's Home Newly Built
body: Ryanggang Provincial Old People's Home was newly built at the shore of picturesque Lake Samsu. The home is a two-storeyed Korean-style building with crane-shaped roof. It has exercise room, amusement hall, bathroom, therapy room, movie room and outdoor resting place. Rodong Sinmun

title: The Reclaimed Tideland Realigned Well
body: Networks of facilities are built full steam in the tidelands reclaimed by building dykes from the shores of the West Sea of Korea to the Ryongmae, Honggon and Chongsu Islands and back. The officials and members of a shock brigade for land realignment realigned thousands of hectares of the reclaimed tideland by dint of hard work. They go on with it successfully. Rodong Sinmun

title: The Way They Fulfilled the Quotas of Yearly National Economic Plan
body: The Samchong Mine of the Sangwon Cement Complex carried out its yearly national economic plan by mid-September ahead of schedule. The workers of the Samchong Mine expand successes in increasing their production elatedly as ever. Rodong Sinmun

title: To Send More Cement to Reconstruction Sites
body: The officials and workers of the Manpho August 2 Cement Factory increase the production of cement to help toward rebuilding the flood-torn areas of the country. They continue to bring about an upswing in their production through a brisk mass technological innovation drive. Rodong Sinmun

title: Production of Household Electric Appliances Stepped Up
body: The Kyongsong Insulator Factory turned out thousands of household electric appliances in a short time and supplied them to the flood-hit areas of North and South Hwanghae provinces under reconstruction. The workers and management of the Kyongsong Insulator Factory work uninterruptedly in high spirits to successfully produce home electric appliances for the flood-hit areas of North and South Hamgyong provinces now under reconstruction. Rodong Sinmun

title: Innovations Made in Production of Various Paints
body: The Anju Insulating Material Factory produced tens of tons of paints of diverse sorts and provided them to the flood-wrecked areas of North and South Hwanghae Provinces, Kangwon Province and Kaesong City. The officials and employees of the Anju Insulating Material Factory are now being all-out to bring about an upswing in their production, fully prepared to contribute actively to stabilizing the livelihood of the flood victims as soon as possible. Rodong Sinmun

title: "Complete Collection of Kim Jong Il's Works" Vol. 32 Published
body: The Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House brought out "Complete Collection of Kim Jong Il's Works" vol. 32 carrying Chairman Kim Jong Il's works in chronological order and in systematic and comprehensive way. Carried in it are 82 works including talks, speeches and letters released by Kim Jong Il in the period from January to December Juche 69 (1980). Those works comprehensively deal with the ideas and theories indicating the path of the struggle for further strengthening the Party in conformity with a new requirement of the developing revolution, effecting a great upsurge in the revolution and construction and greeting the 6th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea with laudable labor feats. "Supporting the Great Leader Well Is Our Noble Duty", "Let Us Learn from the Faithfulness Cherished by the Anti-Japanese Revolutionary Forerunners" and other works deal with the ideas of modeling after the anti-Japanese revolutionary fighters to bear in mind the loyalty to President Kim Il Sung as the revolutionary faith and obligation, so as to hold the President in high esteem and protect and secure the President's authority in every way. "The People's Army Should Vigorously and Continuously Push Ahead with the Work of Establishing the Party's Leadership System" and other works clarify the tasks for strengthening the People's Army into an invincible rank that is boundlessly loyal to the leadership of the Party and fight for the President at the risk of their lives. The collection also carries the works giving perfect answers to theoretical and practical issues arising in the socialist construction, including the issue of intensifying the scientific and educational work as required by the developing reality, the issue of further improving the people's standard of living, the issue of improving the social and cultural life and the issue of imbuing the Party members and working people with great national pride and revolutionary self-confidence. Rodong Sinmun

title: Founding Anniversary of Sariwon University of Geology Marked
body: Sariwon University of Geology greets its 50th founding anniversary. The university is a trustworthy base for producing geological prospecting technicians, and the one that has made scientific and technical contributions to the implementation of the Party's policy on resource development and the building of an economic power. President Kim Il Sung saw to it that the university was founded on September 28, Juche 59 (1970) and the well-organized educational system, including postgraduate course, was set up at it. And he energetically led the work for making good educational conditions at the university and laying material and technical foundation for it. Along with the progress in the socialist construction, Chairman Kim Jong Il wisely guided the university to steadily improve the education and scientific research and sent modern apparatuses for experiments and practical training and cultural equipment, while bestowing great favors on its teaching staff and students. The history of the university is marked with devoted efforts of its teaching staff and students who have dedicated themselves with clear conscience and enthusiasm for quest to education and edification, scientific research and studies, bearing in mind the trust of Kim Il Sung, Kim Jong Il and the Party in them. A meeting took place on September 27 for conveying a congratulatory message sent by the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea to the teaching staff and students of the university greeting its 50th founding anniversary. Rodong Sinmun

title: Kim Tok Hun Inspects Farms in South Hwanghae Province
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the DPRK, inspected farms in Anak, Sinchon and Jaeryong counties in South Hwanghae Province. Going round fields of the Oguk Co-op Farm in Anak County, Saegil Co-op Farm in Sinchon County and others, he stressed the need for junior officials and agricultural workers of the farms to successfully finish the farming this year marking the 75th founding anniversary of the Party with the pride of working on the farms associated with the leadership exploits of the Party. He called for overhauling rice harvesters and threshers in time to increase the proportion of mechanization in harvesting, urging the Haeju Tractor Accessory Parts Factory to produce and supply efficient farm machines and accessories. On Samjigang Co-op Farm and Kanggyo Co-op Farm in Jaeryong County, he underlined the need to thoroughly implement the Party's policy of double cropping. He urged the farms to encourage their farmers by rationally introducing a field-responsibility-system within the framework of the sub-work team management system and to increase per-hectare yield by positively applying scientific methods to farming. He also visited the dwelling house construction sites in Tokam-dong and the seat of Rimhan-ri, Panmun District in Kaesong City. He underscored the need to intensify the anti-epidemic activities with high vigilance, given that the areas are near the Military Demarcation Line, and to guide the construction of dwelling houses, which is underway at the final stage, in a responsible manner. He also discussed the issue to let relevant units supply raw materials in time and took due measures. Rodong Sinmun

title: Rice Harvest at Its Height in Taechong-ri, Unpha County
body: Rice fields are harvested full tilt and a good rice crop is reaped in Taechong-ri, Unpha County, North Hwanghae Province. This was beyond anticipation when the fields fell victim to the flood damage. The cooperative farm tries its hardest to finish its rice harvest opportunely at one go-off without wasting even a grain of rice. Rodong Sinmun

title: To Achieve Triumph as Soon as Possible
body: Thanks to its reconstruction, the flood-wrecked area of Hongwon County has changed beyond recognition. Much time has not passed since the men of the Division No. 1 of the Party Members of the Capital City set to there, but dwellings in their charge stand up fast. Their surroundings are now being realigned and other final works propelled forward. Consequently, remarkable changes are effected in the area day after day. Surprised at this the dwellers there speak highly of the division. Rodong Sinmun

title: 18th Meeting of Political Bureau of 7th Central Committee of WPK Held
body: The 18th meeting of the Political Bureau of the 7th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) took place at the office building of the Central Committee of the WPK on Sept. 29. Kim Jong Un, chairman of the WPK, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, was present at the meeting. Attending the meeting were members of the Presidium and members and alternate members of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee. Present there as observers were directors of departments of the WPK Central Committee, members of the state anti-epidemic field and others concerned. Upon authorization of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK, Chairman of the WPK Kim Jong Un presided over the meeting. The meeting pointed out some faults found in preventing the inroads of the malignant virus and had an in-depth study and discussion about the issues on further intensifying the state emergency anti-epidemic work. A report on worldwide damage by COVID-19 was made at the meeting. The meeting stressed the need to strictly guard against self-complacency, carelessness, irresponsibility and slackness in the anti-epidemic field and employ home-grown style and wisdom to further toughen anti-epidemic measures. It also called for successfully maintaining a steel-strong anti-epidemic system and order by revving up the mass-based anti-epidemic atmosphere and intensifying the all-people unity of voluntary action. The Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee examined the Party and state works, which have been conducted on the occasion of the 75th founding anniversary of the Party, and the progress made in the campaign for recovery from natural disasters, before proposing, discussing and determining due organizational steps for ensuring their successful implementation. The meeting also dealt with organizational matters. The meeting, chaired by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, marked an important occasion in devotedly protecting the security of the country and the people and stabilizing and improving their living standard as it took practical measures to celebrate the 75th founding anniversary of the Party as a genuine and auspicious holiday of the people and successfully conclude the campaign this year, the last year of the 5-year strategy for national economic development, despite the unprecedented crisis and natural disasters. Political News Team

title: Meeting of Osaka Headquarters of Chongryon
body: The 3rd Meeting of the 24th Executive Committee of the Osaka Prefectural Headquarters of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) took place at the Korean Hall in Osaka on Sept. 19. The meeting was to implement the decision made at the enlarged meeting of the 3rd Session of the 24th Central Committee of Chongryon Attending it were Pu Yong Uk, chairman of the headquarters, and other members of its executive committee. Pu Yong Uk made a report. He said that the headquarters have achieved many successes in the campaign for effecting innovations in the building of its basic organizations, information activities and education. He urged the organizations at all levels under the headquarters to step up the building of the basic organizations and do their bit in the work for tiding over the crisis in national education. At the meeting speakers stressed their will to take the lead in paving an avenue of a new heyday of the movement of Koreans in Japan, overcoming the prevailing difficulties. A letter to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was read out at the meeting. Rodong Sinmun

title: 3rd Meeting of 30th Central Committee of UDKWJ Held
body: The 3rd Meeting of the 30th Central Committee of the Union of Democratic Korean Women in Japan (UDKWJ) was held at the Korean Hall in Tokyo. Present there were Pak Ku Ho, first vice-chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), Kang Chu Ryon, its vice-chairwoman and concurrently chairwoman of the Central Standing Committee of the UDKWJ, Nam Ju Hyon, its vice-chairperson and organizational department director, Kwon Kyong Ae, its vice-chairwoman, and other members of its Central Committee. The meeting was held to discuss and decide on the measures for implementing the decision made at the enlarged meeting of the 3rd Session of the 24th Central Committee of Chongryon without fail. Pak Ku Ho delivered a speech. He said that the people in the homeland are waging an all-out drive to successfully greet the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea and its Eighth Congress. The main spirit of the enlarged meeting is to successfully carry forward the patriotic traditions, boldly overcoming the present difficulties unprecedented in the history of Chongryon, and to radically improve the movement of Koreans in Japan in the great era of Kim Jong Un, he said. Then, Kang Chu Ryon made a report. She stressed the need to actively cope with the manifold difficulties and changing circumstances and conditions, further consolidate the UDKWJ organizationally and ideologically in order to implement the decision of the enlarged meeting of the 3rd Session of the 24th Central Committee of Chongryon, effect decisive innovations in the working methods of the union as required by the patriotic movement. She also called for establishing a strict crisis control system for combating COVID-19. Speeches were followed and a letter to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was read out at the meeting. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Greetings to President Xi Jinping
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), sent a message of greeting to Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC) and president the People's Republic of China (PRC), on October 1. Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in the message extended warm felicitations and greeting on behalf of the WPK, the government of the DPRK and the Korean people to the general secretary, and through him, to the CPC, the government of the PRC and the fraternal Chinese people on the occasion of the 71st founding anniversary of the PRC. The message said the Chinese people have registered eye-opening successes in the socialist construction under the sagacious guidance of the CPC for the past 71 years after the birth of new China. Leading the party, the government and the people of China, the general secretary has brought about a decisive progress in the struggle for building a comprehensively well-off society and completely totally eradicating poverty, and creditably defended the sovereignty and territorial integrity of the country in the face of stern challenges at home and abroad, the message pointed out. The message said that the hostile forces' ever-escalating smears and pressure racket can not bring to collapse the Chinese people's trust in the general secretary and the CPC, deny the successes achieved by socialist China and block the advance of the Chinese people along the road chosen by them. The message expressed belief that the Chinese people would surely attain the great goals of building a powerful and modern socialist country, united closely around the CPC with the general secretary as its core. The Supreme Leader also stressed in the message that he and the party and the people of the DPRK will invariably stand by the general secretary, the CPC and the Chinese people in the struggle for accomplishing the joint cause of defending and glorifying socialism gained at the cost of blood. The Supreme Leader in the message expressed his will to strive, together with the general secretary, to ceaselessly consolidate and develop the invincible DPRK-China friendship which has entered a new historical period. The message sincerely hoped that the general secretary would achieve bigger successes in his work in good health, expressing best wishes for the prosperity of the PRC and happiness and wellbeing of the Chinese people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Meeting of Tokyo Metropolitan Headquarters of Chongryon Held
body: The Third Meeting of the 24th Executive Committee of the Tokyo Metropolitan Headquarters of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) took place in Tokyo, Japan on Sept. 18. The meeting, attended by Ko Tok U, chairman of the headquarters, and other members of the executive committee, was held to carry out the decision made at the enlarged meeting of the 3rd Session of the 24th Central Committee of Chongryon. Ko Tok U said in a report that the headquarters has made a big stride in the movement for bringing about a leap forward in the patriotic movement. Calling for concentrating efforts on consolidating basic organizations in the face of the changed situation and setting it as a primary work to turn all the affairs into the ones for the good of the compatriots, he detailed the tasks and ways to do so. Then followed speeches. A letter to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was read out at the meeting. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Ambassador Presents Credentials to Algerian President
body: Song Chang Sik, DPRK ambassador to Algeria, presented his credentials to Abdelmadjid Tebboune, president of the People's Democratic Republic of Algeria, on Sunday. Saying that he is pleased with all the successes achieved in the DPRK, the president hoped that the friendly relations between the two countries would steadily develop in the future, too. Rodong Sinmun

title: Rich Apple Harvest at a Thriving Orchard
body: The officials and agricultural workers of the Ryongjon Fruit Farm of Pukchong County have worked hard from the beginning of 2020 to reap an abundant apple harvest this year. This has met with success. It teemed down irregularly at the rainy season of this year to adversely affect this farm, too. All the members of the farm were out to defend theirs against natural damages. Even in a torrential downpour they drained their orchards without a break. Consequently, their apples are heavily laden with fruits. Rodong Sinmun

title: Further Achievements Made in Transportation of Materials
body: The Ministry of Land and Maritime Transport continues to transport materials dynamically with speed to the flood-hit areas of the country under reconstruction. The navigation time of cargo ships and that of their entry into ports are well coordinated and detailed arrangements are made to load materials onto them and unload them. Consequently, many ports keep expanding successes in helping toward maritime cargo transport. Since cargo ships enter it in succession the Chongjin Port puts its loaders and unloaders of all kinds in full operation to transload their materials onto freight cars and giant motor-trucks in a short time and send them making for the flood-ridden areas of North Hamgyong Province under reconstruction. Rodong Sinmun

title: Timber Production Concluded
body: The officials and workers of the Forestry Management Bureau of South Hamgyong Province finished fulfilling their timber production plan satisfactorily for the flood-wrecked areas of the country under reconstruction and sent the timber to them. They did that felling trees, carrying them from a short distance to another and repairing transportation roads in the spirit of collectivism despite their manifold difficulties. Rodong Sinmun

title: Iron and Steel for Reconstruction Produced
body: The officials and workers of the Chollima Steel Complex and the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex worked with might and main to stabilize the living of the flood victims as soon as possible, thereby carrying out their iron and steel production assignments. The officials, Party members and workers of Pyongyang, Nampho City and many other localities gathered large quantities of iron scraps and sent them to the Chollima Steel Complex so as to contribute actively to boosting the production of iron and steel. The workers and management of the Kumpho Mine and its limestone branch, too, strove mightily to opportunely turn out the concentrates and limestone needed to produce iron and steel. Rodong Sinmun

title: Pak Pong Ju Inspects Chongchongang-Phyongnam Irrigation
body: Waterway Construction Site Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, inspected the Chongchongang-Phyongnam irrigation waterway construction site. Shock brigade members in charge of the construction of dam are fulfilling their daily plans while actively introducing advanced construction methods, true to the Party's grand nature-remaking plan and its policy on agricultural irrigation. Looking round a dam under construction, he learned about the construction of the floodgate of intake dam and the condition of roadbed for gantry crane, and called upon officials and builders to do every work in a responsible manner on the principle of taking responsibility for the safety of the projects and guaranteeing their absolute quality for eternity. At the field consultative meeting, he discussed issues to make exact demands on relevant units for manufacturing equipment qualitatively in conformity with standard designs, and to let the railway transport field convey equipment and materials necessary for the project in time by meticulously organizing transport services. Rodong Sinmun

title: Kosan Fruit Processing Plant Completed
body: A fruit processing plant was built on the Kosan Combined Fruit Farm. The construction of the fruit processing base capable of mass-producing processed fruit goods in the combined large-scale fruit production base helped the Kosan Combined Fruit Farm perfect its appearance as a standardized combined fruit farm of our country, it being a precious wealth that will contribute to the improvement of the people's living standard. The completion ceremony for the Kosan Fruit Processing Plant was held on Wednesday. Present there were Ri Il Hwan, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials concerned and officials and employees of the Kosan Fruit Processing Plant under the Kosan Combined Fruit Farm. Ri Il Hwan made a report. He said that the Plant is a precious creation produced under the energetic leadership of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un who is materializing into brilliant reality the behests of Chairman Kim Jong Il. He said that Kosan has turned into a vast thriving orchard, a large-scale fruit producing and processing base comprising modern pig farm, sci-tech dissemination room and fruit processing plant, and a good place to live with thousands of houses and cultural and welfare facilities. The officials and employees of the Plant should take care of precious equipment and buildings provided under the solicitude of the Party and produce more famous products loved by the people and thus make active contribution to improving the standard of people's living, he stressed. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Inspects Sites of Reconstruction in Kimhwa County
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, inspected the site of reconstruction from damage in Kimhwa County. He was accompanied by Pak Jong Chon, Ri Il Hwan, Kim Yong Su, Jo Yong Won, Kim Yo Jong, Pak Thae Song and Hyon Song Wol. He was greeted by commanding officers including the chairman of the Kimhwa county Party committee and the vice-minister of the People's Armed Forces who are working at the reconstruction site in the eastern area. The soldier builders who turned out in the campaign for recovering from damage by natural disaster in the eastern area true to the idea and spirit of the 16th meeting of the Political Bureau of the 7th WPK Central Committee made patriotic dedication and worked the miracle of bringing about the brilliant creation in the era of the Workers' Party in the area swept by natural disasters in a short period spanning 40 odd days. Looking round the site under reconstruction, Kim Jong Un learned in detail about damage to dwelling houses, to farming lands, to transport system, land and environment, city management, power field, and telecommunications in the area and about the progress in the recovery. Vividly recalling the day in the mid-August when a helicopter was used to learn about the situation of the disaster after over 900 mm disastrous downpour cut off even the roads and when he was shocked to hear the horrifying report that more than 1 000 dwelling houses were destroyed, he said that they all seem to have happened just yesterday. Hearing the report that about 88 percent of the total construction project has now been done for nearly 1 000 families ― several-storey dwelling houses in township area and single-storey dwelling houses in the ri of the county, he said with great satisfaction that the People's Army is making world-startling achievements under the energetic leadership and meticulous guidance of our Party. He said he was greatly impressed by the patriotic deeds and revolutionary fighting stamina of the soldiers of the People's Army who brought about another miraculous event in the wake of the recovery of Kangbuk-ri, Kumchon County, adding that such results brought about by the People's Army is the spiritual wealth most valued by our Party, before just simple material creation. He continued to say that the noble mental and moral traits of the People's Army by which it displays indefatigable mental power with firm resolution to go through thick and thin without any slightest vacillation and hesitation despite whatever disasters and hardships if they are for the sake of our Party, the people and the prosperity of the country, and creates a thing out of nothing and turns a misfortune into a blessing are the key secret to the creation of all miracles on this land. He repeatedly asked the chairman of the county Party committee if the people of the county were pleased and, upon hearing that they were all happy with it, he said he has nothing more to wish. He continued in real earnest that nothing will be pleasing and more worthwhile struggle if people take back their happy life in modern dwelling houses suited to the ideal and highly civilized society planned by the Party, after shaking off backwardness. He was told by the chairman of the county Party committee and the commanding officers of the construction units that watching the wonderful dwelling houses being built in a lightning speed despite difficulties and hardships, under the measures taken by the Party, the people in the area said that houses are built faster than meals being cooked and they were so happy to have strong houses enough to stand whatever disasters. Hearing this he said he was encouraged by the frank and unreserved feedback of the people and added that the houses should be evaluated by the people. He stressed that the whole process of the reconstruction ranging from designing and construction should be carried out from the viewpoint and on the principle of putting the people above all and respecting the people. One thing he felt regretful while watching the houses built in the areas that had been hit by disasters, he said, is that designs of all the houses were monotonous. He noted that he wishes they had been given peculiarity on the principle of meeting the advantageous cultural and regional characteristics of the areas and meeting the people's conveniences and demand, and artistic harmony with the surrounding environment and diversity had been appropriately combined. He then mentioned some things that should be guarded against and be overcome in the construction field and gave detailed teachings about the key idea of the construction policy of our Party. He said that though designing is important, the present situation in which the construction is making rapid progress in Pyongyang and provinces, requires, as he stressed last time, for the building materials industrial field to keep pace with the speed of the rapidly developing construction of the country. He emphasized that it becomes urgent policy tasks to actively develop and produce modern and efficient construction equipment and tools and implements, significantly raise the level of mechanization in the construction field in the provinces as well as in Pyongyang and to provide the diversity of the building materials in the provinces. He made particular mention of the issue to plant more trees in the township and mountains around it and to plant more land-creeping plants in the residential areas so as to further improve the natural and ecological environment in the areas. To suit to the change of Kimhwa County, local industrial factories should be modernized on a yearly basis and production be vitalized to improve the economic life of the county and steadily increase the standard of material living of the people, he stressed. He repeatedly highly praised the People's Army for making tremendous contribution to the socialist local construction which has embodied the demand and hope of the working masses, adding that the solider builders should bear deep in mind that architecture is an epitome of the height of ideology and culture in which the height of the ideology and civilization in the times is intuitively reflected. He asked them to display staunch fighting spirit and stamina with immense loyalty and filial devotion for the Party and the people and present great pleasure to the people by wonderfully and quickly building standard and modern dwelling houses preserving the local peculiarity of high civilization desired by our Party and the state with the same sincerity with which they would make when they build their own houses. Kim Jong Un, on his way to and from Kimhwa County, stopped in field plots affected by disasters in several areas and learned about farming. He said that good crops are expected unlike the time when the fields were damaged by flood, adding that clear traces of having overcome flood can be seen in all plots. He said that thanks to the devotion and patriotic sweats and efforts made by farmers for each plant, such a result could be possible despite unprecedented damage, before highly appreciating the agricultural workers for their efforts to preserve valuable crops to the last. Even though wildness of nature swept away a lot of things in a moment, the damaged areas have been face-lifted with the construction of new wonderful houses and damage to crops has been minimized to have promising crop yield not less than that in the year of the highest yield, he said, stressing with confidence that this year has been the one of unprecedented hardships but it will be a year of great victory with particularly great worth of struggle. The present hardships have never discouraged us but made us get stronger and make further progress and let us know how loyal, patriotic and strong our people are, he said, noting that he is greatly emboldened by such loyal people and he keenly feels again that there is no difficulties insurmountable. All the builders were greatly moved by the great dedication made by Kim Jong Un to provide the people in the afflicted areas with cradle of happiness at an early date, and hardened the firm pledge to share the intention and keep pace with the Party Central Committee and make final rush for the completion of the houses in the spirit of devotedly carrying out the Party's instructions. Political News Team

title: International Day of Older Persons Marked in DPRK
body: The International Day of Older Persons was marked in the DPRK where the aged are respected as revolutionary forerunners and as elders of society and families under the care of the Korean-style socialist system. Officials of the Party and power organs in the capital city of Pyongyang visited the Pyongyang Old People's Home to give souvenirs and foodstuffs to its inmates, who devoted themselves to building a thriving country, and take warm care of them. Peculiar services for the old people were offered at Okryu Restaurant, Chongryu Restaurant, Hyangmanru Restaurant and other public catering establishments in the city. Special services were also given at welfare service faculties. Meanwhile, there were colorful works for the elderly in different parts of the country. The elderly spent a pleasant time that day, leading a cultural and emotional life of diverse forms. Rodong Sinmun

title: Coins to be Minted in Commemoration of 75th WPK Birthday
body: Commemorative coins will be minted in the DPRK to mark the 75th birthday of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). The Presidium of the DPRK Supreme People's Assembly promulgated a decree in this regard on Thursday. Commemorative coins "75th Founding Anniversary of the WPK" are to be minted in gold and silver. Carved on the central front of gold and silver coins are the images of the Party Founding Museum and the mark of the WPK. On the upper part of the front are letters reading "Foundation of the WPK" and on its lower part are letters "75th Anniversary" with letters "1945" and "2020" in both sides. On the central back of the coins is the national emblem of the DPRK. Seen in the upper part of the back are letters "The Central Bank of the DPRK" and in its lower part are degree of purity, weight and minting year, with magnolia decoration in its frame The size of the pure gold coin is 35 mm in diameter and 2 mm in thickness, and that of pure silver coin 40 mm in diameter and 3 mm in thickness. Commemorative coin "75th Founding Anniversary of the WPK" (gold coin) Commemorative coin "75th Founding Anniversary of the WPK" (silver coin) Rodong Sinmun

title: Rich Wild Fruit Harvest in Changsong County
body: Changsong County has an unusually bumper year for wild fruits. They are almost twice as much as those which were yielded in any previous year. The county gathers acorns, pine nuts and other wild fruits, too, to afford a sure guarantee for the normal production of its local industry factory. Rodong Sinmun

title: New Books Published in DPRK
body: Books of scores of varieties have been brought out by publishing houses on the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). They deal with the ideological and theoretical exploits performed by President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and their great personalities, and with the histories of revolutionary activities of the peerlessly great men who made patriotic devotion to the prosperity of the country and the happiness of the people. The Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House brought out the enlarged edition Vol. 10 of "Complete Collection of Kim Il Sung's Works" and Vol. 32 of "Complete Collection of Kim Jong Il's Works", the encyclopedias of the great Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism. It also published Vol. 1 of "With the Nation", the collection of real-life revolutionary stories impressively telling about the noble revolutionary life and exploits of Kim Il Sung, as a masterpiece of national treasure. Among newly published books are those on the greatness of the peerlessly great men, such as the reminiscences "Great Life" (Builder of Youth Power) which deal with the history of guidance over the youth movement provided by Kim Jong Il who had brought up our young people to be the successors to the revolution and the reliable reserves of the WPK. The Science and Encyclopedia Publishing House put out the books "Ideology and Theory on Three-Revolution Red Flag Movement Developed in Depth by the Respected Supreme Leader Comrade Kim Jong Un" and "The History of Korean Revolution Is the One of Establishing Juche". The Kumsong Youth Publishing House, the Working People's Organizations Publishing House and the Industrial Publishing House brought out such books as "Peerlessly Great Man", "Leader of Ability", "Great man and World" (2), all of which vividly shows the great personality of Kim Jong Un. The Art and Literature Publishing House published books like the collection of poems "To the Utmost Ends of the Sky and the Earth", after releasing "Regeneration", the first full-length novel of the cycle of novels "Immortal Milestones" which crystallizes the greatness and immortal revolutionary exploits of Kim Jong Un. The Agricultural Publishing House, the Social Science Book Publishing House and other publishing houses put out books showing the great devotion and efforts made by the peerlessly great men who dedicated their whole lives to providing our people with sufficient and civilized life. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Will Strive to Safeguard World Peace and Security: Its Representative to UN
body: The DPRK permanent representative to the United Nations made a speech at the general debate of the 75th Session of the United Nations General Assembly on Sept. 29. He said that anti-epidemic situation in the DPRK is now under safe and stable control thanks to the far-sighted leadership of the government of the DPRK now that COVID-19 is ever more becoming serious as days go by. Noting that building a peaceful world without war is the consistent goal of the DPRK government, he said that the DPRK has done everything possible to safeguard peace and security on the Korean peninsula and in the region during the past several decades. He stressed that the DPRK has drawn the conclusion that peace never comes of itself by mere wish of one side and it is not granted by someone else either, adding genuine peace can only be achieved when one possesses the absolute strength to prevent war itself in the present world, where high-handedness based on strength is rampant. Saying that the DPRK has suffered considerable losses due to unexpected natural disasters this year, but it is vigorously striving to remove the flood and typhoon damages by itself and stabilize the people's life in a short period of time, he continued: It has been 75 years since the UN took its first step. The main theme of this General Debate; "The future we want, the United Nations we need: reaffirming our collective commitment to multilateralism" reflects the demand of the absolute majority member states of the UN for building a peaceful and prosperous world on the basis of multilateralism. The future wanted by the humankind is an independent world, free from domination, subordination, aggression and interference, and the sovereignty and equality of all countries and nations are ensured. The United Nations is needed for achieving this purpose. He clarified the stand of the DPRK to develop good-neighborly and fraternal relations with all countries across the world that respect its sovereignty and are friendly to it, and to make determined efforts to safeguard peace and security of the region and the world at large. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Ambassador Presents Credentials to Mexican President
body: DPRK Ambassador Song Sun Ryong presented his credentials to Andres Manuel Lopez Obrador, president of the United Mexican States, on Sept. 29. Expressing belief that the friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries would develop, the Mexican president hoped the government and people of the DPRK would register great successes in the economic development and the improvement of people's living. Rodong Sinmun

title: State Academic Degrees and Titles Conferred on Intellectuals
body: Meritorious intellectuals were awarded state academic degrees and titles on the occasion of the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea. The intellectuals achieved research successes conducive to the economic development of the country and improvement of the standard of the people's living through their dynamic drive of breaking through the cutting edge and made tangible contributions to the education of the rising generation. Professorship was conferred on Pak Song Yon, researcher of Kim Il Sung University, Kim Sun Hui, head of a department of Kim Chaek University of Technology, Choe Tong Son, teacher of Pyongyang University of Mechanical Engineering, Han Myong Sik, vice-rector of Sariwon University of Geology, and others. Doctorate went to Jang Song Chol, head of a faculty of Kim Il Sung University, Ho Yong Nam, chief of office of Kim Hyong Jik University of Education, Cha Ryong Un and Jo Song Hyok, teachers of Kim Chol Ju University of Education, Kim Myong Sok, teacher of Kim Jong Suk University of Education, Rim Hyon Ok, principal of East Pyongyang Secondary School No. 1, Han Yong Ho, director of the Jagang Provincial Forestry Management Bureau, Kim Song Su, manager of the Haeju Kumgang Youth Smeltery and other 89 persons. 246 persons received associate professorship, and master's degree went to 999 persons. Rodong Sinmun

title: "Hall of Great Leaders and Their Comrades-in-Arms" Opens in Korean Revolution Museum
body: "Hall of the Great Leaders and Their Comrades-in-Arms" newly opened in the Korean Revolution Museum with due ceremony on Friday ahead of the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). Each room of the Hall exhibits memorial photos and fine art pieces showing the noble great personalities of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un who brought up the revolutionary soldiers to be comrades who would share fate with the leaders with ardent love and trust, and more data on their revolutionary activities and revolutionary relics. Also displayed there are data showing the worthwhile life of the revolutionary soldiers who shared their fate with the Party rainy or snowy, learning what the revolution is and why one has to live not for today but for tomorrow under the warm care of the great leaders. Present at the opening ceremony was Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, first vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission (SAC) of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly. Also present there were Ri Il Hwan, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the WPK, Kim Yong Hwan, chairman of the Pyongyang City Party Committee, Ro Kwang Sop, director of the Party History Institute of the Central Committee of the WPK, officials of the Party Central Committee, officials of ministries, national institutions, city- and district-level institutions, units which participated in the construction, distinguished persons, and officials and staff members of the Korean Revolution Museum. Also seen there were Army General Kim Su Gil, director of the General Political Bureau of the Korean People's Army, and other officials of armed forces organs. Before the opening ceremony, all the participants offered respects toward the color sculptures of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in the general review room. Choe Ryong Hae made an opening speech. He said that the "Hall of the Great Leaders and Their Comrades-in-Arms" in the Korean Revolution Museum is the great national treasure of Juche Korea which is an epitome of the history of noble comradeship of the peerlessly great men, and a grand seat of education in loyalty that teaches the iron truth of the revolution that glory and eternal life are in upholding the leaders and following them to the last. He stressed the need to further uphold the banner of the great unity and the revolutionary comradeship and win fresh victories in building a powerful socialist country and in accomplishing the revolutionary cause of Juche under the outstanding and seasoned leadership of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. The participants looked round rooms after being briefed on the Hall. Rodong Sinmun

title: Noodle-making Contest Held in Pyongyang
body: A noodle-making contest of ace cooks from Okryu Restaurant, Chongryu Restaurant and the Pyongyang Noodle House took place at Okryu Restaurant on Friday. During the contest, the contestants fully displayed their culinary skills in making Pyongyang cold noodle, noodle in flat vessel with meat and meat stock. Jury members appraised their skills by tasting the foods on the spot. The jury members include culinary specialists who are officials and researchers of the Central Committee of the Korean Association of Cooks and Pyongyang Jang Chol Gu University of Commerce, and those who were selected from the Guidance Bureau of Public Catering Service and public catering establishments under the Pyongyang City People's Committee. Rodong Sinmun

title: Protein Feed Ground Newly Built
body: North Hwanghae Province newly built a protein feed ground at the Poman Fish Farm. It is a profitable natural feed producer which will contribute to propagating protein insects in bulk and using them for boosting fish production. The protein feed ground consists of an eclosion ground, a nurturing ground, a drying ground, a feed storehouse, etc. The Poman Fish Farm has consequently laid the foundations for increasing its fish output. The Poman Fish Farm is now stepping up the production of its protein-rich natural feed. Rodong Sinmun

title: A Lot of Furnishings Sent to Komdok Area
body: The officials, Party members and workers of Jagang Province procured tens of thousands of furnishings of 20-odd kinds, including door and window frames, in a short time and sent them to the flood-wrecked area of Komdok under reconstruction. The workers and management of the Kanggye Timber-Processing Factory and many other producers mass-produced furnishings in a short time by dint of hard work. The officials and workers of the railway sector transported them to their destination by rail without delay. Rodong Sinmun

title: Samjiyon Potato Farina Production Factory Runs at Full Capacity
body: The labor and management of the Samjiyon Potato Farina Production Factory achieve greater results in their production than last year. The SPFPF channels its efforts to store its potato powder in good conditions and ensure its quality thoroughly. Rodong Sinmun

title: Tiles Needed for Housing Construction in Komdok Area Produced
body: The workers and management of the factories and enterprises under the control of the General Bureau of the Tanchon Area Mining Industry produced a million and hundreds of thousands of tiles for dwellings to be built in the Komdok area. They are now working hard as usual in high spirits to turn out tiles for public establishments under construction. Rodong Sinmun

title: Dwelling Construction Makes Headway through Fierce Emulation
body: The builders of the Tanchon Power Station register new successes every day in recovering the flood damage of Hochon County by dint of hard work. They are forced to build dwellings in widely scattered areas of the county, and what is worse, the transport routes to many of them are blocked. Accordingly, the field headquarters determines the order of priority in housing construction properly, keeps materials supply ahead of it, rationally organizes labor and suitably gives the builders work assignments. The builders bring about innovations hour after hour and day after day in their housing construction through a fierce socialist emulation among their separate areas and workteams. Rodong Sinmun

title: Myohyangsan Medical Appliances Factory Remodeled
body: The Myohyangsan Medical Appliances Factory was successfully remodeled and updated. The factory furnished with equipment produced by our workers, scientists and technicians has all its processes automated and streamlined and puts its production and management on a scientific and IT basis at a high level in order to produce modern medical appliances. The inauguration ceremony took place on October 4. Attending the ceremony were Choe Sang Gon, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, O Chun Bok, minister of Public Health, officials and persons of distinguished service who contributed to the construction of the factory, working people in Hyangsan County and officials and employees of the factory. Kang Pong Hun, chairman of the Jagang Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, made a speech. He said that the factory was remodeled as one taking the lead in rapidly developing the national medical appliance industry thanks to the wise and energetic guidance of our Party. He noted that Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un visited the factory repeatedly with his plan to bring about a turn in the national medical appliance industry and public health by making the factory an example, and set a high aim of updating it and took the revolutionary measures for realizing it. He stressed that officials of the field of public health should renovate every public health institution on the basis of the success and experience gained in the course of updating the factory and further cement the national foundation for anti-epidemic work and thoroughly protect and promote the life and health of our people from malignant infectious disease and all other diseases. At the end of the ceremony, the participants made a round of the factory. Rodong Sinmun

title: Meeting of Korean Youth League in Japan Held
body: The 3rd Meeting of the 24th Central Committee of the Korean Youth League in Japan was held at the Korean Hall in Tokyo on Sept. 25. Among those present were Pak Ku Ho, first vice-chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), Jo Myong Jin, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the Korean Youth League in Japan, Ri Kwang Il, its vice-chairperson and organizational department director, Pak Ok Sam, its vice-chairman and director of the Department for Publicity and Culture, department directors of its Central Standing Committee and members of the Central Committee of the youth league. The meeting was held to review the work of the youth league after the 2nd Meeting of the 24th Central Committee of the Korean Youth League in Japan and make discussions and decisions on tasks and ways for carrying out the resolution adopted at the enlarged meeting of the 3rd Meeting of the 24th Central Committee of Chongryon. Jo Myong Jin made a report. Then speeches were made by Ryang Sang Thae, chairman of the Tokyo Metropolitan Headquarters of the Korean Youth League in Japan, Kim Song Rang, chairman of the Osaka Prefectural Headquarters of the youth league, Yun Son Gi, chairman of the Hiroshima Prefectural Headquarters of the youth league, etc. Pak Ku Ho made a concluding address. A letter to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was adopted at the meeting. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairman of WPK Central Military Commission Kim Jong Un Issues Order
body: to Promote Military Ranks of Senior Officials Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Central Military Commission of the Workers' Party of Korea, issued an order on Monday to promote the military ranks of senior officials on the occasion of the 75th founding anniversary of the glorious WPK. According to the order, Pang Tu Sop and Rim Kwang Il were promoted to general and Kim Jong Sik and Pak Kwang Ju to colonel general.

title: Title of KPA Marshal Conferred in DPRK
body: The title of the Marshal of the Korean People's Army (KPA) was conferred on Ri Pyong Chol, vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the WPK, and Pak Jong Chon, chief of the General Staff of the KPA. A joint decision of the Central Committee and the Central Military Commission of the WPK and the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea on it was announced on Monday.

title: 19th Meeting of Political Bureau of 7th Central Committee of WPK Held
body: The 19th meeting of the Political Bureau of the 7th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) took place at the office building of the Central Committee of the WPK on Monday. Kim Jong Un, chairman of the WPK, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, was present at the meeting. Attending the meeting were members of the Presidium and members and alternate members of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee. Present there as observers were directors and first vice-directors of departments of the WPK Central Committee. Upon authorization of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK, Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un presided over the meeting. The meeting discussed, as its first agenda item, the issue of successfully greeting the Eighth Congress of the Party by waging a dynamic 80-Day Campaign of the entire Party, the whole country and all the people. A report on the first agenda item was made. The report referred to the subjective and objective requirements for launching a fresh offensive under the current situation. Today all the Party members and working people are dynamically waging the final all-out campaign to celebrate the 75th founding anniversary of the Party as a great festival of victors. Now we are faced with a heavy and responsible task to grandly hold the celebrations for the 75th founding anniversary of the Party we have prepared with much effort and greet the Eighth Congress of the Party to be convened at the outset of the new year with proud labor successes. We have only 80 odd days until the Eighth Congress of the Party to be etched as an important political event of epochal significance in the development of our Party and revolution. We have performed historical feats with our costly efforts, boldly overcoming unprecedentedly grave trials and difficulties this year, but we should not rest on our laurels. We still face the challenges that cannot be overlooked and there are many goals we have to attain within this year. It is our Party's consistent mode of struggle to bring about greater successes and miracles one after another through a determined successive offensive and usher in a new heyday of the revolution and it is our people's proud tradition of struggle to write a history of great change and work eye-opening miracles by waging an all-out campaign for the great socialist construction ahead of Party Congress. The meeting stressed that the remaining days till the Eighth Congress of the Party is the period of year-end struggle and also the last phase of carrying out the five-year strategy for national economic development put forth at the Seventh Congress of the Party, so that the entire Party and the whole country should wage another all-out campaign. The Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee made a responsible and crucial decision to wage a 80-day Campaign of the entire Party and the whole country so as to glorify the 75th founding anniversary of the Party as a great festival of victory and progress, proudly conclude this year's struggle in elated spirit and greet the Eighth Congress of the Party with high political enthusiasm and labor feats. The meeting clarified the main purpose of the campaign and the key principle to be preserved and the goals to be attained by every sector during the campaign before studying in depth the detailed orientation and ways to thoroughly implement them. The Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee decided to advance a militant slogan and send a letter of the Party Central Committee to all Party organizations and members to encourage the entire Party, the whole country and all the people to turn out in the 80-Day Campaign. The meeting, as its second agenda item, made a decision on conferring high military titles on leading officials of the Party and the army on the occasion of the 75th founding anniversary of the WPK. According to the joint decision of the Central Committee and the Central Military Commission of the WPK and the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, the title of the Marshal of the Korean People's Army (KPA) was conferred on Ri Pyong Chol, vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission of the WPK and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the WPK, and Pak Jong Chon, chief of the General Staff of the KPA. After informing the participants of the joint decision, the Supreme Leader congratulated the recipients, requesting them to live up to the deep trust and expectations of the Party and the people with great successes in their jobs. The revolutionary steps discussed at the meeting marked an important turning point in accelerating the revolution and construction at a higher stage of development, as required by the prevailing situation. Political News Team

title: Senior Officials of C.C., WPK Visit Delegates to Celebrations for Party Founding Anniversary
body: Senior officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) visited the lodging quarters of the delegates to the celebrations for the 75th founding anniversary of the WPK on Monday. They warmly congratulated the delegates on their honor of taking part in the celebrations for the 75th Party founding anniversary, thanks to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's great loving care and deep trust in them. The visitors told them that the Supreme Leader called many ordinary working people to the celebrations. They also gave pep talks to the delegates who have made a series of miracles in their working places. They asked the delegates to make fresh innovations in every working site for socialist construction, cherishing the honor of taking part in the celebrations. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegates to Celebrations for Party Founding Anniversary Here
