body: Delegates to celebrations for the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) arrived here on Monday. They were warmly greeted by Ri Il Hwan, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the WPK, and other senior officials of the Party Central Committee and officials of the armed forces organs. Pyongyangites extended warm greeting to them. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Art Exhibition Opens
body: A national art exhibition opened to celebrate the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). National art treasures depicting the images of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il who performed immortal exploits for the founding of the WPK and its development are displayed in the exhibition hall. Also on display are hundreds of excellent art pieces like Korean painting, oil painting and sculpture created by artists of the Mansudae Art Studio, the Central Fine Arts Studio and other art studios and by amateur painters in Pyongyang and provinces. An opening ceremony took place at the Okryu Exhibition Hall on October 5. Present there were Kim In Bom, chairman of the Central Committee of the General Federation of the Unions of Art and Literature of Korea, officials and artists of fine art studios, and citizens in Pyongyang. Jon Myong Sik, minister of Culture, stressed in his opening address that the exhibition would contribute to celebrating the 75th founding anniversary of the Party as a great revolutionary event and a significant festival, and encourage the people to step up the revolutionary march toward the 8th Congress of the Party. The exhibition will continue till November 3. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Industrial Art Exhibition Opens
body: A national industrial art exhibition opened in celebration of the 75th anniversary of the founding of the Workers' Party of Korea. On display in the venue are photos of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un leading the country's industrial art to contribute to the economic construction and the improvement of the people's standard of living. Also on show are more than 980 designs examined by the Supreme Leader in the period between April, Juche 101 (2012) and July, Juche 109 (2020) and over 580 designs, models, etc. highly appreciated in the past exhibitions. Vice-premier of the Cabinet Ri Ju O, leading officials of commissions, ministries and national institutions, officials and creators in the field of industrial art looked round the venue on Monday. The exhibition will continue until first half of November. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Floral Baskets from
body: Members of Board of Directors of Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received floral baskets from Johnny Hon, co-chairman of the Board of Directors of the Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation, Sai Tiejen, honorary vice-chairman of the Board of Directors of the foundation, Jin Xian, director of the Board of Directors of the foundation, and Cui Tongwen and Qiu Jianliang, honorary directors of the Board of Directors of the foundation, on Monday on the occasion of the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea. On the same day, the Supreme Leader was presented with floral baskets by the China Dandong branch of the Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation, and its members Lin Gennan, Liang Zhengxiong and his wife, Fang Hua, Cui Tongjun and his wife, Zhan Xueyan, Zhao Bin, Li Ailan, Li Zhengyuan, Tang Yiming, Cui Tongzhu, Piao Mingde, Pei Jinqian and Andrei Morkel. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Floral Baskets
body: from Foreign Political Party and Figure Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received floral baskets from the Central Committee of the Zimbabwe African National Union-Patriotic Front and from Joseph Kabila Kabange, ex-President of DR Congo who is the national chairman of the People's Party for the Reconstruction and the Democracy of DR Congo, on Monday on the occasion of the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea. Rodong Sinmun

title: Production Line for Plastic Conveyor Rollers Established
body: The Ministry of Coal Industry invented plastic rollers for belt conveyors and built a workshop in a factory to produce them. The rollers consume electricity a little thanks to their lightness, and what is better, can be recycled. They have now been applied to the new-built and renewed belt conveyors of many coal mines, including the February 8 Jikdong Youth Coal Mine and the Chonsong Youth Coal Mine of the Sunchon Area Youth Coal Mining Complex and the Tokchon Coal Mine of the Tokchon Area Coal Mining Complex. Rodong Sinmun

title: A Workers’ Hostel Newly Renovated
body: An old workers’ hostel of the Kanggye Knitting Mill was renovated anew beyond recognition. Some time ago its inmates moved there. The officials and employees of the Kanggye Knitting Mill are now bringing about a fresh upswing in their production to repay the mother Party for its love. Rodong Sinmun

title: Pak Pong Ju Inspects Reconstruction Sites in North Hamgyong Province
body: Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and vice-chairman of the C.C., WPK, made a field survey of the progress in the projects for recovering from damage in Chongjin and Kim Chaek cities and Orang County in North Hamgyong Province. Pak Pong Ju gave pep talks to members of the Division No. 2 of the Party members of the capital city, members of the 216 Division and soldier builders who have waged a drive of loyalty, a fierce 24-7 struggle and a resolute lightning campaign. On the spots he urged officials to set examples in the van of the masses, ensure the quality of structures at a high level by pushing ahead with the building of dwelling houses on the principle of prioritizing the interests and conveniences of the people and holding them absolute and correctly calculate the necessary amount of materials including cement and steel and economize on them to the maximum. He stressed the need for officials of Party and power organs to take warm care of the people, true to the noble intention of the Party Central Committee, and constantly conduct effective forest and water conservation such as river improvement and anti-land-sliding project. The field consultative meetings discussed the measures to ensure scrupulous operation and command to successfully propel the reconstruction campaign, supply raw materials in time and minimize the natural disaster in the future on the basis of a scientific analysis of the cause of flood damage. Meanwhile, Pak Pong Ju learned in detail about the production at the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex and the Chongjin Steel Plant. Rodong Sinmun

title: Lighting Festival "Wonders of Light-2020" Begins
body: A lighting festival "Wonders of Light-2020" opened here on Tuesday. Watching the festival were delegates to celebrations for the 75th founding anniversary of the Party and viewers. The places around Pyongyang Department Store No. 1 and at the foot of Jangdae Hill were crowded with people who were about to watch the fantastic art of light. At the festival large images were presented on the building wall of the department store with the help of our own 3D multi-media and the multi-channel and multiplex projective technique, leading viewers to ecstasy. Displayed at the avenue of the festival were numbers "2020", "10.10" and "75" which are reflecting the proud history of the Party and the title of "Wonders of Light-2020". Pictures were presented in succession with the marvelous light of various colors and the contrast between light and shade, typically the three-person group sculpture of the Tower of the Juche Idea, the proud visages of the socialist country and the happy life of the Korean people. An ecstasy resulted by light, dimensional and tactile, has revved up the atmosphere of the festival. The art of light moved the viewers as it vividly displayed the pictures of places full of socialist civilization and the monumental edifices as masterpieces with the precision representation of dots and lines with the use of optical characteristic of the wall of the building. Then displayed was the image of fireworks for marking the end of the festival in which light music and the world of marvelous light have formed perfect artistry. The festival will last until October 8. Rodong Sinmun

title: Art Performance Given by Workers' Art Group
body: The Workers' Art Group of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea (GFTUK) gave a performance at the Central Hall of Workers on Tuesday to mark the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). Through the performance which began with narration "Glory to Our Great Party", the performers highly praised the immortal exploits performed by President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il who had founded the Juche-oriented revolutionary party and devoted their whole lives to developing the Party. The repertoire including Oungum ensemble "Lights from the Party Central Committee" eulogized the absolute trust in and admiration for the motherly Party which provided the working masses with genuine life and happiness by its extraordinary idea, energetic leadership and devoted efforts for the sake of the people. Enjoying the performance were Ju Yong Gil, chairman of the GFTUK Central Committee, officials and members of the GFTUK and workers in Pyongyang. Rodong Sinmun

title: Stamp Exhibition Opens to Mark Founding Anniversary of WPK
body: A Korean stamp exhibition opened with due ceremony at the Korean Stamp Exhibition House on Tuesday in celebration of the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). On display there are more than a thousand stamps showing the glorious 75-year-long history of the WPK, and many stamps presented by stamp collectors in Pyongyang. Attending the ceremony were Ri Il Hwan, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the WPK, officials concerned, and philatelists in the city. A speech was made. The exhibition will last till Oct. 16. Rodong Sinmun

title: Art Squad of C.C., UAWK Gives Performance
body: The art squad of the Central Committee of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea (UAWK) gave a performance at the Unhung Co-op Farm in Thaechon County, North Phyongan Province on Oct. 6 in celebration of the 75th anniversary of the founding of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). Put on the stage were a prologue and songs "Long Live the Workers' Party of Korea", "It Is October", and "Mother's Birthday", a female chorus "We Have Planted Apple Trees on Mountains", a narrative poem and serial song "When We Walk along the Road between Fields", a female duet "Glory of Our Life", etc. Performers sang high praises of the revolutionary feats of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il who founded and built the WPK and indicated the path of the solution of the socialist rural question, thus laying an eternal foundation for the country's agricultural development. The repertoire included mixed chorus "We'll Travel One Road Forever" and "We Will Go along Road of Loyalty", etc. Among the audience were Kim Chang Yop, chairman of the UAWK Central Committee, Sin Tong Chol, vice-chairman of the North Phyongan Provincial Committee of the WPK, officials concerned, UAWK officials and agricultural workers in Thaechon County. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegates to Celebrations for 75th Founding Anniversary of WPK
body: Visit Kumsusan Palace of Sun Delegates to celebrations for the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on Tuesday. They paid a tribute to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in the palace. At the halls where Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il lie in state, the delegates paid homage to the peerlessly great men. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Baskets and Congratulatory Letters to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Diplomatic Corps and Military Attaches Corps
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received floral baskets and congratulatory letters from the diplomatic corps and the military attaches corps here on the occasion of the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea. The floral baskets and congratulatory letters were conveyed to officials concerned by the Palestinian ambassador to the DPRK who is doyen of the diplomatic corps and the military attache of the Vietnamese embassy who is doyen of the military attaches corps respectively on Tuesday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Basket to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from General Secretary of C.C., LPRP
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a floral basket from Bounnang Vorachith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party (LPRP) and president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic, on the occasion of the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea. The Lao ambassador to the DPRK handed the floral basket over to an official concerned on Wednesday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Syrian President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), received a message of greeting from Bashar Al-Assad, president of the Syrian Arab Republic, on September 23. The Syrian president in the message extended the warmest and heart-felt congratulations to Kim Jong Un, the government and the friendly people of the DPRK on the occasion of the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). The message wished the WPK big success in the work for leading the great DPRK to a bigger progress, development and prosperity under the leadership of Kim Jong Un. It said that the glorious course covered by the WPK is full of victories and successes achieved by the DPRK people in their struggle for consolidating the country's independence and possessing the muscle to defend the country against the hostile states. Noting that the relations between the WPK and Syria's Baath Arab Socialist Party are intimate and solid, the Syrian president in the message affirmed his will to make joint efforts for further intensifying the cooperation between the two parties in conformity with the interests of members of the parties. The message extended the warmest greeting to Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Baskets to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Foreign Organizations and Figures
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received floral baskets on Wednesday from the Organizing Committee of the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu, the Japan Committee for the Independent and Peaceful Reunification of Korea, the Japan Nagano Prefectural People's Council for Supporting the Independent and Peaceful Reunification of Korea, the Tokyo-Pyongyang Rainbow Bridge, the Sweden-DPRK Cultural Exchange Association, the family of Zhang Weihua, a Chinese anti-Japanese revolutionary martyr, the family of former Japanese Deputy Prime Minister Sin Kanemaru, Jindallae Saphariny, president of the Jindallae Children's Foundation, Damian Ogbonna, national chairman of the People's Progressive Party of Nigeria and chairman of the African Regional Committee for Friendship and Solidarity with the Korean People, Julio Ballesteros Espin, chairman of the Ecuador-Guaranda Institute for Friendship and Cultural Solidarity with the Korean People, Kiichi Tsunota, representative of the Gunma Prefectural Council for Japan-Korea Friendship and Solidarity, and Professor Emeritus Kazuyoshi Hishiki at Hiroshima Shudo University of Japan on the occasion of the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea. On the same day, Kim Jong Un was also presented with a floral basket by Jin Chengwu, a member of the Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Party Leadership Exploits Praised
body: by British Political Party and Organizations The New Communist Party of Britain, the British Association for the Study of Songun Policy, the British Group for the Study of the Juche Idea, the Korean Friendship Association UK and the British Solidarity Committee for Peace and Reunification of the Korean Peninsula issued a joint statement on October 2 on the occasion of the 23rd anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's election as general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea. The statement said that Kim Jong Il's election as general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea was a reflection of the unanimous desire of all the Party members and other people. It said that it is also an expression of absolute support for and trust in the peerlessly great man who led the WPK to victory and glory for scores of years. It noted that throughout the period of leading the WPK, Kim Jong Il, who carried forward the revolutionary cause of President Kim Il Sung, united the masses of the people around the Party while always finding himself among the people. Thanks to his leadership, the WPK has resolutely smashed the imperialists' moves of stifling the DPRK, marshaled the people for the struggle to achieve the economic development and improve the people's standard of living and achieved great successes in it, the statement said. It stressed that the exploits Kim Jong Il performed in leading the Party will be remembered forever. Rodong Sinmun

title: Jang Ryong Sik Awarded Title of DPRK Labor Hero
body: Jang Ryong Sik, vice-department director of the Information and Publicity Department of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, was awarded the title of Labor Hero of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. He has performed distinguished feats in developing Juche-oriented music and art with absolute loyalty to the Party while working in the field of arts for a long period. The Presidium of the DPRK Supreme People's Assembly promulgated a decree on it on Tuesday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Delegates to Celebrations for 75th Founding Anniversary of WPK
body: Visit Mangyongdae and Korean Revolution Museum Delegates to the celebrations for the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. The first leg of their visit was the Mangyongdae Revolutionary Museum where they recalled the feats performed by the President. Then, they looked round the historical mementoes at the old home of the President in Mangyongdae. They also visited the Korean Revolution Museum. They paid tribute to the colored statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in the general review room. At the "Hall of the Great Leaders and Their Comrades-in-Arms", they were briefed on the photos of the peerlessly great men, revolutionary relics and worthwhile lives of revolutionary soldiers. Meanwhile, labor innovators and persons of merits who came to Pyongyang from across the country to see the celebrations for the 75th founding anniversary of the WPK visited the National Gifts Exhibition House, Pyongyang Teachers Training College, the Ryuwon Footwear Factory and other places. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Book Exhibition Opens
body: A national book exhibition opened with due ceremony at the Grand People's Study House on Oct. 7 in celebration of the 75th anniversary of the founding of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). Present at the ceremony were Ri Il Hwan, vice-chairman of the WPK Central Committee, officials, journalists and editors in the field of press. On display in the venue of the exhibition are works of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and over 20 000 publications of 10 000 varieties, brought out in the DPRK and other countries. The exhibits also include books on the revolutionary traditions and the five-point education, on the Party policies and on the great personalities of the peerlessly great men, along with scientific, technological and literary books. Ri Il Hwan in his speech made at the opening ceremony referred to the ideological and theoretical feats of the President and the Chairman who founded and continuously developed in depth the immortal Juche idea to lead the revolutionary cause of Juche, pioneered in Mt Paektu, to brilliant victory. Thanks to the energetic guidance of the Supreme Leader, the socialist cause of Juche is dynamically advancing towards a new higher stage, he said. He called for more deeply cherishing the idea and feats of the peerlessly great men, fully equipping with the Party policies, and acquiring profound knowledge and broad common sense. Rodong Sinmun

title: Performance Given by Schoolchildren
body: Schoolchildren's performance was given at the Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace on Wednesday in celebration of the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). Put on the stage of the performance which began with the celebration chapter were female solo "Marshal Kim Jong Un Is Our Father", serial song "I Gave Answer to My Sister's Question" and other numbers. Performers impressively represented the appearance of all the schoolchildren in the country who are happily growing up under the loving care of the greatest father in the world. They showed their pleasure and pride of celebrating the birthday of the mother Party with beautiful songs and dances. The performance ended with epilogue "We Will Go to Mt Paektu" and other numbers, all of which reflect the oath of the schoolchildren to stoutly prepare themselves to be the genuine sons and daughters of the socialist homeland. Among the audience were officials of the Central Committee of the youth league and the field of the extracurricular education for youth and schoolchildren and youth and schoolchildren in Pyongyang. Rodong Sinmun

title: People of Flood-hit Areas Given Sincere Aid
body: South Hamgyong and North Phyongan Provinces support the flood victims with all sincerity. The workers and management of the Hamhung Disabled Soldiers’ Essential Plastic Goods Factory produced vinyl wallpapers tens of thousands of meters square and provided them to the victims. The labor and management of the Hamhung Calcium Silicate Brick Works and the Hamhung Timber Mill scored good successes in their production. Those of the Puraesan Cement Factory and the Steelworks of South Hamgyong Province effected innovations in the production of cement, iron and steel. Meanwhile, North Phyongan Province procured tens of thousands of pieces of relief goods for the flood sufferers of North Hamgyong Province. On October 5 loaded motortrucks left Jongju City for them in proud array. Rodong Sinmun

title: Members of Missions of Int'l Bodies Pay Floral Tribute to
body: Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il Staff members of the UN resident coordinator office and missions of UNDP, UNICEF, United Nations Population Fund, FAO, WFP and WHO here visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on Wednesday on the occasion of the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea. They laid floral baskets before the statues of the great leaders and paid a tribute to them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Baskets to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Svetlana Odintzova, member of the Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation, the Costa Rican Committee for Supporting Korea's Reunification and Jose Francisco Aguilar Bulgarelli, coordinator of the Costa Rica-Korea Institute of Friendship and Culture, sent floral baskets to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on the occasion of the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea. The floral baskets were laid before the statues on Oct. 6 and 7. Rodong Sinmun

title: New Posters Inspire People to General Advance towards 8th Congress of Party
body: Recently, the Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House, the Mansudae Art Studio and the Korean Central Fine Arts Studio produced posters inspiring all the people to greet the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea with high political enthusiasm and brilliant labor success and to turn out in the campaign for recovery from damage by natural disasters. Posters "Let us fully display the might of the single-minded unity!", "Let us greet the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea with high political enthusiasm and brilliant labor success!" and "Towards the 8th Congress of the Party!" vividly show the revolutionary mettle of the Korean people to go all out towards the 8th Congress of the Party. Poster "Let us loudly sound the gun-report of victory in the campaign for recovery from natural disaster!" reflects the firm will of the Korean people to proudly build homes of happiness and typical cultured socialist villages in the natural disaster-stricken areas. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Basket to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Nigerian President
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a floral basket from Muhammadu Buhari, president and commander-in-chief of the Armed Forces of the Federal Republic of Nigeria, on the occasion of the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea. The floral basket was conveyed to an official concerned by the Nigerian charge d' affaires ad interim in the DPRK on October 8. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Basket to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from C.C., CPC
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a floral basket from the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba on the occasion of the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea. The floral basket was conveyed to an official concerned by the Cuban ambassador to the DPRK on October 8. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Baskets Laid before Statues
body: of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il The family of Kim Sun Ok who is related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, families of Chai Shiying and Wang Xiaoming, Chinese related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, the Anti-Imperialist Forum of Germany and Giancarlo Elia Valori, president of the International Group of Italy, sent floral baskets to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on the occasion of the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea. The Communist Party of the Russian Federation and the Communist Parties-the Communist Party of the Soviet Union also sent to the statues a floral basket in their joint name. The floral baskets were laid before the statues on October 8. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Officials, working people and service personnel of the People's Army visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in different parts of the country on the occasion of the 23rd anniversary of Kim Jong Il's election as general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea. Placed before the statues of the great leaders on Mansu Hill were bouquets and floral baskets in the names of the Party, power and armed forces organs, social organizations, ministries, national institutions, units of the Korean People's Army (KPA) and the Public Security Forces (PSF) and institutions and industrial establishments at all levels and universities in Pyongyang. The visitors made a bow before the statues. Floral baskets in the names of units of the KPA and the PSF, institutions and enterprises and bouquets were laid at the statues of the great leaders in different parts of Pyongyang including Kim Il Sung University and the Mansudae Art Studio. Officials, working people and servicepersons in other parts of the country visited the statues of the great leaders and mosaics of their beaming images in their residential quarters to pay homage to them. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Photo Exhibition Opens
body: A national photo exhibition opened at the People's Palace of Culture on Thursday with due ceremony to mark the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). Displayed in the venue of the exhibition are photos showing the revolutionary careers of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, founder and builder of the WPK and eternal leaders, and photos of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un developing the Party into an invincible one steering the revolutionary cause of Juche. Also on display are photos dealing with the proud reality of the DPRK where the new era of prosperity is being ushered in and those showing the appearance of the Korean people enjoying the independent and creative life to their hearts' content. Present at the ceremony were Ri Il Hwan, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials, journalists, editors of the Korean Central Photograph Publicity Agency and working people in the city. Ri Il Hwan said in his opening speech that the photos of Kim Il Sung, Kim Jong Il and Kim Jong Un displayed in the venue of the exhibition serve as valuable treasure reflecting the revolutionary histories of the peerlessly great men who devoted themselves to the founding of the Party and its development. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Lao President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), received a message of greeting from Bounnang Vorachith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party (LPRP) and president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic (LPDR), on Thursday. The Lao president in the message extended warm congratulations and best wishes on behalf of the LPRP Central Committee, all the party members and the people of the LPDR and on his own behalf to Kim Jong Un, the WPK Central Committee, all the Party members and the fraternal people of the DPRK on the occasion of the 75th founding anniversary of the WPK (Oct. 10 1945 - Oct. 10 2020). In the message, he said that he was very pleased to see the fraternal Korean people achieving great successes in all fields including political stability, national defense, social security, economy and the people's livelihood by smashing all challenges of the hostile forces and waging a struggle for steadfastly defending the gains of the revolution, and steadily raising the status and role of the DPRK in the regional and international arenas by expanding and developing its external relations under the 75 year-long wise and resolute leadership of the Korean people's great leaders President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, and the WPK headed by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, the great successor to the revolutionary cause. The president expressed firm conviction that the WPK would continue to triumphantly lead the Korean people's struggle for defending the country, achieving its prosperity, realizing the cause of building a powerful socialist country and accomplishing the peaceful reunification of the country by implementing the decision of the 7th Congress of the WPK under the banner of the Juche idea and Songun. Availing himself of that significant opportunity, he wished Kim Jong Un good health and happiness and bigger success in his noble work. The Lao president expressed his desire for the continuous development of the traditional friendly and cooperative relations between the two parties and the two countries in conformity with the interests of the two peoples and the idea of world peace, friendship and cooperation. Rodong Sinmun

title: ﻿People of Kaesong City, North and South Hwanghae Provinces Move to New Houses
body: The people of the natural disaster-stricken areas of Kaesong City and North and South Hwanghae provinces moved to new houses. The residents in the damaged area of Kaesong City moved to new houses built as cultured socialist farm villages. After receiving with great pleasure the report on granting new houses to the residents in the natural disaster-hit area of Kaesong City on the eve of the founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un asked officials to convey his hand-written regards to the residents moving to new houses, wishing them happiness. A ceremony for moving to newly-built houses was held on October 9. Attending it were Jang Yong Rok, chairman of the Kaesong City Committee of the WPK, and other officials in the city, the residents in the damaged area and builders. A congratulatory speech was made at the ceremony. A speaker said that Kim Jong Un, who is considerate of the people in the city near the demarcation line before others all the time, acquainted himself with the situation in the city several times and took all measures for pushing ahead with the construction of dwelling houses to be proud of in the world. The speaker noted that no one in the world is as happy as the Korean people as they have the Supreme Leader, who, so pleased with the completion of dwelling houses, sends his wishes for the happiness of those moving to new houses ahead of others, as their father. House licenses were conferred on the residents in the damaged area at the ceremony. Meanwhile, the people in the damaged areas of Unpha, Singye, Phyongsan, Jangphung, Jaeryong and other damaged counties of North and South Hwanghae provinces moved to newly-built houses on the same day. Rodong Sinmun

title: ﻿Congratulatory Letter to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from AINDF
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a congratulatory letter from the Central Committee of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front (AINDF) on Saturday. The letter said that under the wise guidance of the great President Kim Il Sung and the great Chairman Kim Jong Il, the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) has created the legendary history of turning Juche Korea into a utopia centered on the popular masses and a powerful socialist country - independent, self-supporting and self-reliant - admired by all people. The WPK which has thoroughly embodied the President's and the Chairman's idea of independent reunification and their line of the great national unity has clarified the most correct reunification policies all the time and aroused all the fellow countrymen to the struggle for their realization and thus powerfully propelled the movement for national independence and reunification, the letter said, and continued: The WPK has greeted the most shining heyday as it is led by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, master of the outstanding leadership. The vanguard fighters of the south and the patriotic people of all social strata, who are convinced of the bright future of the completion of the cause of national independence and the building of a powerful reunified country in the glorified look of the WPK blessed by the sun, are renewing their firm pledge to go along the path of Juche, upholding the Supreme Leader. The letter stressed that the red flag of the WPK will flutter forever and the greater fortune and glory will be ahead of the nation as the sunny images of the President and the Chairman will be eternal and the great personality of the Supreme Leader is shining brightly. Rodong Sinmun

title: ﻿Congratulatory Letter to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from General Association of Koreans in China
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a congratulatory letter from the General Association of Koreans in China on Oct. 10 on the occasion of the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). The letter said that on this auspicious day, officials of the association and other Koreans in China pay the humblest tribute to President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and extend the highest glory and warm felicitations to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un who is leading the cause of the WPK along the road of victory and glory. It noted that the WPK is demonstrating its leadership and fighting efficiency all over the world as it is led by Kim Jong Un who is identical to the great leaders in ideology, guidance, personality and virtue. It said that Kim Jong Un, with his extraordinary wisdom, perfect political caliber and strong will, has ushered in a glorious era of great changes to be recorded in the history of the WPK. Noting that the officials of the association and other Koreans in China are fully determined to always remain faithful with their destiny and future entrusted to Kim Jong Un while picturing the rosy future of the great homeland, the letter stressed that the association would dynamically conduct the activities for the homeland and reunification to achieve the prosperity of the country, keeping pace with the people of the homeland, in high spirits of greeting the 75th founding anniversary of the WPK as the holiday of victors under the leadership of Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: ﻿Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Congratulatory Message from Xi Jinping
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), received a congratulatory message from Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, on October 10. The message said: I extend warm congratulations and the best wishes to Comrade Chairman and through you to the Central Committee of the WPK and all members of the WPK and the Korean people on behalf of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and on my own behalf on the occasion of the 75th founding anniversary of the WPK. The WPK with glorious and time-honored revolutionary traditions rallied and led the Korean people, fought bravely and made progress with renewed efforts in its brilliant course of 75 years, thereby realizing the independence of the country and the liberation of the people and making great achievements in accomplishing the socialist cause. In recent years under the reliable leadership of the Central Committee of the WPK headed by Comrade Chairman the Party and people of Korea have put efforts on strengthening the Party building and the economic work, have coped with all sorts of hardships and challenges in single-minded unity and conducted active exchange and cooperation with foreign countries to make a series of important achievements, while making steady advance along the path of socialism. We, as comrades and friends, are greatly pleased over this. I believe that under the reliable leadership of the Central Committee of the WPK led by Comrade Chairman, the Party and people of Korea would continue the courageous and unflinching struggle so as to steadily advance the socialist cause of Korea and greet the 8th Congress of the WPK with victory. The two countries of China and Korea are friendly neighbors which are linked by the same mountain and river and we are both socialist countries led by the communist parties. The traditional China-Korea friendship personally provided and cultivated with much care by the leaders of the elder generations of the two parties and the two countries has taken deep roots and become further stronger and immensely valuable as the days go by. In recent years I had several meetings with Comrade Chairman and reached a series of important common understanding over the consolidation and improvement of the relations between the two parties and the two countries, and opened up the new historic page of the China-Korea relations. Today, there has been a great change unprecedented in 100 years worldwide and the international and regional situations have become complicated and serious amid the spread of COVID-19. We have an intent to successfully defend, consolidate and develop the China-Korea relations together with Korean comrades and propel the long-lasting and stable development of the socialist cause of the two countries and thus provide the two countries and the two peoples with greater happiness and make new and active contributions to realizing the regional peace, stability, development and prosperity. I wish Comrade Chairman good health and success in your work. I hope that the WPK would make ceaseless development and the socialist cause of Korea would prosper. Rodong Sinmun

title: ﻿Floral Basket to WPK Central Committee from CPC Central Committee
body: The Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) received a floral basket from the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC) on Friday on the occasion of the 75th founding anniversary of the WPK. On the same day, a floral basket in the name of the Chinese embassy here was conveyed to the WPK Central Committee. Rodong Sinmun

title: ﻿Delegates to Celebrations for 75th Founding Anniversary of WPK Tour Pyongyang
body: Delegates to celebrations for the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and other visitors continue touring different places in Pyongyang. They visited the Party Founding Museum that shows the exploits of President Kim Il Sung. They saw the photos and art works depicting Kim Il Sung displayed in several rooms of the building of the Central Organizing Committee of the Communist Party of North Korea located at the foot of Haebang Hill in Pyongyang, being briefed on the fact that the President successfully accomplished the cause of founding the Party. And they visited the KPA Museum of Weapons and Equipment. In the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Silk Mill, they looked round the room dedicated to the history of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, several production processes, hostel and others, inspiring the workers of the mill who have brought about a surge in production. They also visited the venues of the national art, book and photo exhibitions, all of which were opened in celebration of the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea and enjoyed the lighting festival "Wonders of Light-2020" and the fun stage "My home full of laughs". Rodong Sinmun

title: ﻿Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Cuban Political Party Leader
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, received a message of greeting from Raul Castro Ruz, first secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba (CPC), on Oct. 9. Raul Castro Ruz in the message extended his sincere felicitations to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un on behalf of the CPC on the occasion of the 75th founding anniversary of the WPK. The message said the two countries are marking the 60th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations this year. It said that the good friendly and cooperative ties, which have been invariably maintained over the past 60 years, are a clear manifestation of deep trust and fraternal obligation between the two parties and the two peoples. Rodong Sinmun

title: ﻿Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from General Secretary of CPV Central Committee
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), Friday received a message of greeting from Nguyen Phu Trong, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam (CPV) and president of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam. The Vietnamese president in the message extended, on behalf of the party, state and people of Vietnam, the warmest congratulations to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, and through him, to the WPK Central Committee and the people of the DPRK on the occasion of the 75th founding anniversary of the WPK (October 10, 1945-October 10, 2020). The message said that the WPK, leading the state and the people, has achieved important successes in the work for building and defending socialism, developing the economy and improving the people's standard of living step by step for the past 75 years. It expressed belief that the WPK would achieve bigger successes in the future under the guidance of Kim Jong Un, leading the country and the people. It expressed pleasure over the fact that the cooperative relations between the two parties have ceaselessly become strong, in particular, since Chairman Kim Jong Un's official friendly visit to Vietnam in March, 2019. It expressed conviction that the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation between the CPV and the WPK would continue to successfully develop in the interests of the peoples of the two countries and contribute to regional and global peace, stability and cooperation. It wished Kim Jong Un happiness in good health and greater success in fulfilling his noble duty. Rodong Sinmun

title: ﻿New Stamps Issued
body: The State Stamp Bureau of the DPRK issued new stamps on the occasion of the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). Seen on the upper part of the stamps are letters "Celebrating the 75th Founding Anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea". A stamp carrying the fluttering flag of the WPK shows well the history and exploits of our Party which has achieved only victories and glory for 75 years. The stamp with letters "The People-first Principle" reflects the political ideology of our Party which has made selfless, devoted efforts for the good of the people and materialized their dream and ideal. Rodong Sinmun

title: Principled Stand of DPRK Government on Terrorism Clarified
body: The DPRK representative clarified the principled stand of the DPRK government on terrorism when discussing the agenda on measures for removal of international terrorism at the 6th Committee of the 75th session of the UN General Assembly on October 6. Now, terrorism, which destroys global peace and security and threatens the sovereignty of countries, comes to be one of the biggest challenges facing the world, he said. He noted that the reality demands more urgently than ever before that all the countries take a proper view of the source of terrorism and sincerely grope for the effective measures against it. Underscoring the need to pay primary attention to eradicating the state-sponsored terrorism aimed at toppling regimes of sovereign states, ahead of others, in the international anti-terrorism war, he said that the state-sponsored terrorism aimed at regime change in sovereign states is the most serious terrorist act and amounts to a wanton violation of the UN Charter and international law that formulate the principles of respect for sovereignty and non-interference in other's internal affairs. However, some specified countries are branding sovereign states as "terrorism-sponsors" of their own accord to meet their interests, putting sanctions and pressure upon them and resorting to the moves for toppling regimes, while giving aids to dissident terrorist groups, he noted. No one should allow the abuses of anti-terrorism war to be used as leverage for the political purpose of specified countries or forces, he said. The comprehensive international anti-terrorism convention now under discussion should contain clear provisions that take issue with and eradicate the state-sponsored terrorist acts by specified countries violently infringing upon the sovereignty of independent countries with high-handed and arbitrary practices, he said. Calling for paying reasonable attention to eradicating the source of terrorism, he said that the efforts of the international community to stop terrorism can attain the desired goal and then lead to completely terminating terrorism on earth only when priority is attached to the issue of rooting out the source of terrorism. It is the invariable stand of the DPRK government to oppose all forms of terrorism and any support to it, he stressed. The DPRK will as ever fulfill its responsibility and role in fundamentally terminating all forms of terrorism and defending peace and stability in the Korean Peninsula and the rest of the region. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Russian Political Party Leader
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), received a message of greeting from G. A. Zhuganov, chairman of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation, on October. 10. The message extended sincere congratulations to Kim Jong Un, all the members of the WPK and all other people of the DPRK on the occasion of the 75th founding anniversary of the WPK. The WPK founded by President Kim Il Sung, the great leader of the Korean people, has become organized guiding force of the nation and has united people and led them to the struggle for achieving independence and social progress, the message said. It noted that the WPK purposively conducts the work for the ideological and spiritual development of the Korean people and makes every effort for improving their welfare. It said that the DPRK has made eye-opening achievements in the fields of science, industry and culture, and put the nation's defence capability on a new stage under the guidance of the WPK. The working people of the DPRK who remain faithful to the Party's line and leaders' behests are invariably advancing along the road of building prosperous socialist society, it pointed out. It wished the Korean people greater success. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Officials, working people and service personnel of the People's Army visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in different parts of the country on the occasion of the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). Laid before the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill were bouquets and floral baskets in the names of Party, power and armed forces organs, social organizations, ministries, national institutions, units of the Korean People's Army (KPA) and the Public Security Forces (PSF), and institutions, industrial establishments and universities at different levels in Pyongyang. Also placed there was a floral basket in the name of the Pyongyang mission of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front. The visitors bowed to the statues of the great leaders. Pyongyangites visited the statues of the great leaders and mosaics depicting their smiling images in various parts of Pyongyang including Kim Il Sung University and the Mansudae Art Studio. Officials, working people and service personnel visited the statues of the great leaders and mosaics depicting their smiling images in other parts of the country to pay homage. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Palestinian President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), received a message of greeting from Mahmoud Abbas, president of the State of Palestine and chairman of the Executive Committee of the Palestine Liberation Organization, on Saturday. The Palestinian president in the message extended the warmest congratulations from the bottom of his heart to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un on behalf of the state and the people of Palestine and on his own behalf on the occasion of the founding anniversary of the friendly WPK, wishing the DPRK, the Korean people, the leadership, officials and members of the stout-hearted WPK constant progress and success. The president said they, availing themselves of the glorious opportunity, highly appreciated the historical role of the WPK extending firm support and solidarity to the peoples struggling for freedom and independence, and to the Palestinian people fighting in the van of them for freedom, independence and sovereignty of the Palestinian territory with east Kuds as its capital. He added they believed that the WPK would continuously support the Palestinian people's struggle for realizing the noble object. He, wishing Kim Jong Un good health and happiness, hoped that the historical friendly relations between the two countries and peoples would further be strengthened and the WPK achieve greater prosperity. Rodong Sinmun

title: Public Procession Celebrates Founding Anniversary of WPK
body: A public procession took place at Kim Il Sung Square on Oct. 10, the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). Attending the procession were labor innovators and persons of merits from every province. Seen at the tribune of honor were Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, first vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission (SAC) of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, Ri Pyong Chol, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission of the WPK and vice-chairman of the WPK Central Committee, Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and premier of the DPRK Cabinet, and Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, vice-chairman of the SAC of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the WPK Central Committee. Standing at the tribune were also members of the leadership body of the WPK Central Committee including Kim Jae Ryong, Ri Il Hwan, Choe Hwi, Pak Thae Dok, Kim Yong Chol, Choe Pu Il, Thae Hyong Chol, O Su Yong, Kim Hyong Jun, Ho Chol Man, Pak Myong Sun, Jong Kyong Thaek, Kim Il Chol, Im Chol Ung, Ri Ryong Nam, Kim Yong Hwan and Pak Jong Nam. Pak Jong Chon, Kim Su Gil, Kim Jong Gwan and other commanding officers appeared at the tribune. Those, who had worked long as Party and government officials and commanding officers, including Kim Yong Nam, Choe Yong Rim, Yang Hyong Sop, Kim Ki Nam and Choe Thae Bok were seen standing at reserved seats for guests. The reserved seats for guests were also taken by delegates to the celebrations for the 75th founding anniversary of the WPK and working people in Pyongyang. After the declaration of the start of the public procession, the procession began amid the playing of the song "Glory to Our Great Party". At the time when a column carrying the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il appeared in the square, fireworks were shot off and many balloons let loose and a sea of waving flowers was unfolded. Columns portraying large flags of the DPRK, the symbol of our great state, and the WPK, the ever-victorious banner, entered the square. Working people, youth and students from various parts of the country were full of reverence for the WPK which translated the long-cherished desire of the Korean people into reality. Columns of cheering people from every province with a float bearing the letters "The guide through our destiny, the banner of invincibility" marched past the square, representing the course covered by the WPK shinning as a history of the people. The square echoed with the song "Our Home is the Embrace of the Party" which can be heard in all parts of the country from its northern tip to the city near the demarcation line, amid hurrah for the WPK raised by the participants. Columns carrying Party flags and national flags walked past the square with a float bearing letters "Forward along the road of socialism under the guidance of the great party!", reflecting the strong spirit of the Korean people to successfully carry out the Juche-oriented cause of socialism under the direction of the Party Central Committee. With the playing of the revolutionary hymn "Ode to General Kim Jong Un", the square again turned into a sea of flowers. Rodong Sinmun

title: Meeting Held to Celebrate Founding Anniversary of WPK
body: A meeting for celebrating the 75th anniversary of the founding of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) was held at Kim Il Sung Square here on Saturday. Taking the tribune were Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, first vice-chairman of the Sate Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, Ri Pyong Chol, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission of the WPK and vice-chairman of the WPK Central Committee, Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and premier of the Cabinet of the DPRK, and Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, vice-chairman of the Sate Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the WPK Central Committee. Present there were also Kim Jae Ryong, Ri Il Hwan, Choe Hwi, Pak Thae Dok, Kim Yong Chol, Choe Pu Il, Thae Hyong Chol, O Su Yong, Kim Hyong Jun, Ho Chol Man, Pak Myong Sun, Jong Kyong Thaek, Kim Il Chol, Im Chol Ung, Ri Ryong Nam, Kim Yong Hwan, Pak Jong Nam and other members of the leadership body of the Party Central Committee. Pak Jong Chon, Kim Su Gil, Kim Jong Gwan and other commanding officers of armed forces organs were also present at the tribune. Present at reserved seats for guests were Kim Yong Nam, Choe Yong Rim, Yang Hyong Sop, Kim Ki Nam, Choe Thae Bok and other veteran officials who had worked for a long time in the Party, the government and the military. Present at the reserved seats were also delegates to the celebrations for the 75th founding anniversary of the WPK and working people in Pyongyang. The meeting was declared open. Adopted at the meeting was a congratulatory message to Kim Jong Un, Supreme Leader of the Party, state and armed forces of the DPRK, on the 75th founding anniversary of the DPRK. Ri Il Hwan, vice-chairman of the WPK Central Committee, read the congratulatory message which is in the joint name of the Central Committee of the WPK, the WPK Central Military Commission, the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly and the Cabinet of the DPRK. The congratulatory message extended the greatest glory and the warmest congratulations reflective of the deep reverence and the ardent loyalty of all the people for Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, the glorious and invincible revolutionary party, the outstanding leader of the Juche revolution and the great symbol and representative of the dignified state and people of the DPRK. It highly praised the undying feats etched in the history of the nation the Supreme Leader performed by turning our Party into the powerful political staff and into the great mother Party and building a great flower garden prioritizing the people and an eternal powerful country with the greatest might. It stressed that the ode to the WPK and hurrahs for the Workers' Party that resound across the country in October with immense excitement and enthusiasm is a strong eruption of the gratitude of all the people of this country to the Supreme Leader, the sun of the destiny taking care of their life and ensuring their happiness. Adopted was the joint congratulatory message reflecting the unshakable faith and will of the people to single-mindedly trust and follow the Supreme Leader. Then there was a report of celebration by Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, first vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly. He said that the founding anniversary of the WPK which all the people are celebrating with immense joy, excitement and the feelings of solemnity and reverence is the revolutionary holiday of pleasure and fortune, on which they cherish once again the happiness and pride that they have the kindest and greatest Party. He continued that the WPK, which has carried on the journey of the revolution upholding the programme for sacred struggle for accomplishing the great cause for the independence of the popular masses and the building of a prosperous and powerful country, has brought about great victory and change unprecedented in the nation's history spanning 5 000 years by leading the state and the people to the most correct path. Under the leadership of Kim Jong Un with far-reaching wisdom and unusual and gifted temperament, our Party has developed into the militant and invincible general staff making advance with confidence in the van of the era of independence while holding high the modeling of the whole society on Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism as the supreme programme and into the promising revolutionary Party in the struggle for materializing the dream and ideal of the people. The reporter called for devotedly safeguarding the party-building idea and feats of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and for making confident advance for our state and people and for the victory of the sacred revolutionary cause of Juche. Rodong Sinmun

title: Torchlight Procession of Young Vanguard Held
body: The torchlight procession of the young vanguard for celebrating the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea took place at Kim Il Sung Square on Saturday evening. Taking the tribune of honor were Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, first vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission (SAC) of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, Ri Pyong Chol, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission of the WPK and vice-chairman of the WPK Central Committee, Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and premier of the DPRK Cabinet, and Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, vice-chairman of the SAC of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the WPK Central Committee. Also present at the tribune were Kim Jae Ryong, Ri Il Hwan, Choe Hwi, Pak Thae Dok, Kim Yong Chol, Choe Pu Il, Thae Hyong Chol, O Su Yong, Kim Hyong Jun, Ho Chol Man, Pak Myong Sun, Jong Kyong Thaek, Kim Il Chol, Im Chol Ung, Ri Ryong Nam, Kim Yong Hwan, Pak Jong Nam and other members of the leadership body of the Party Central Committee. Kim Su Gil, Kim Jong Gwan and other military commanding officers were also present at the tribune. The reserved seats for guests were taken by Kim Yong Nam, Choe Yong Rim, Yang Hyong Sop, Kim Ki Nam, Choe Thae Bok and other veteran officials who had worked for a long time in the Party, the government and the military. Taking the reserved seats were delegates to the celebrations for the 75th founding anniversary of the WPK. As the start of the procession was declared, letters of celebration appeared one after another and a pattern of fire portraying the emblem of the WPK, symbol of victory, brightened the sky above the square. Open cars carrying the red flags bearing the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il entered the square, escorted by young vanguard. Seen in the square were the august names of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Ranks of revolutionary schools, youth and students and working youth started their solemn march. Ranks of youths forming letters reading "Peerless Hero" entered the square, shouting slogan "Long Live Peerless Patriot General Kim Jong Un!" Torchlight holders forming letters "Great Party", "Strongest Military Power" and "Independence", making loud shouts to express the immense trust and reverence for our Party, filled the square. They make formation changes to depict letters reading "Revolutionary Traditions", "Single-minded Unity", "Socialism" and "Self-reliance" one after another to the tune of the song "Advancing Socialism". The far-reaching ideal and ambition of young builders were reflected in letters "Devoted Service", "Golden Mountain", "Golden Field" and "Golden Sea". Letters reading "Scout Party" and "Heroic Youth" showed the bravery and valiant courage of youth in the great era of Kim Jong Un. The ranks of students entered the square. The pledge of youths resounded throughout the square against the background letters reading "Toward 8th Congress of Party" mirroring the iron will to certainly build a powerful socialist country on this land under the guidance of the WPK. The ranks forming letters "First Lifeline" marched past the platform as there presented in the square letters "Devoted Defence" and "Devoted Implementation" to the tune of song of faith "We Know Nobody but You". The song "Youth, Forward Following Party" sung in chorus resounded, a reflection of the powerful might of a large contingent of the heroic youth. Rodong Sinmun

title: Fireworks Displayed for WPK Anniversary
body: There was fireworks celebration in Pyongyang on Saturday on the occasion of the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea. The event started as firecrackers of various colors were shot off in the entire area between Okryu Bridge and the Taedonggang Bridge with the Tower of the Juche Idea in the middle. People presented the sea of dancers at Kim Il Sung Square under the sky beautifully lit with fascinating fireworks. Colorful fireworks and myriads of firecrackers that were let off nonstop decorated the sky beautifully. Song "Mother's Birthday" reverberated far and wide and fireworks depicting number reading "75" appeared in the sky above Taedong River. The enthusiastic dancing revved up the atmosphere. Firecrackers fell in torrents to the tune of songs like "Appearance of Korea" and "Do Prosper, Era of the Workers' Party" to present a spectacular view. Firecrackers were shot off one after another to depict galaxy, flowers and frostwork, portraying the happy laughter of people in the villages turned into socialist fairyland. The emblem of our Party and letters reading "Long Live the Workers' Party of Korea" were depicted with the firecrackers amid the song "Long Live the Workers' Party of Korea". Rodong Sinmun

title: Modern Sports Bases Newly Arranged in Pyongyang
body: Pyongyang newly built a municipal football school and a municipal air club and admirably renovated the East Pyongyang Stadium. Roads in the grounds of the school and club were asphalted and trees planted round them splendidly for landscaping purposes. They were also fitted up amply and supplied with excellent sports equipment. Consequently, athletes and sports amateurs can take exercises and play games in good conditions in the sports center. Rodong Sinmun

title: 400,000 Cubic Meter Earth Successfully Blown Up
body: On October 11 the workers and management of the Musan Mining Complex blasted a mountain by 400,000 tons. This has led to its good mining conditions. The Musan Mining Complex has become able to make good advances in its work from the very beginning of its 80-day campaign. Rodong Sinmun

title: Banquets Mark 75th Founding Anniversary of WPK
body: Banquets were given at the Mokran House, the People's Palace of Culture, Okryu Restaurant, Chongryu Restaurant, Pyongyang Taedonggang Seafood Restaurant, etc. on October 11 on the occasion of the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). Present there were Choe Ryong Hae, Ri Pyong Chol, Kim Tok Hun, and Pak Pong Ju, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, officials of the Party, the government and the military and delegates to the celebrations for the 75th founding anniversary of the WPK. Speeches were made there. Speakers said that all the people across the country are celebrating the 75th founding anniversary of the WPK, being blessed with the party generation after generation thanks to the great Party. The people's cheers in the square for celebration of the October holiday were the expression of the firm pledge and strong will to trust, follow and uphold with loyalty the party in single mind, they said, stressing that the celebration of the Party founding anniversary as the genuine holiday for the people is a scene peculiar to Juche Korea. They said that our party that has recorded the proud history of 75 years has ahead of it the 8th Congress which would become a new watershed in its development. They noted that it is the noble obligation and bounden duty of the revolutionary soldiers to greet with unusual political enthusiasm and shining labor achievements the 8th Party Congress which will become a landmark of a turn even in the destiny and position of our state and people. They called on all the people to cherish in depth the single mind of loyalty to the Party and become passionate loyalists, faithful servants of the people and patriots who defy death in implementing the Party's idea of launching an offensive for making a breakthrough head-on and its decisions and instructions in posts and working places. Rodong Sinmun

title: Grand Mass Gymnastics and Artistic Performance Marks WPK Founding Anniversary
body: The grand mass gymnastics and artistic performance "Great Guidance" took place at the May Day Stadium on Oct. 11 in celebration of the 75th anniversary of the founding of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, appreciated it. The moment the Supreme Leader of the Party, state and armed forces appeared on the grandstand, all the performers and the audience broke into stormy cheers of hurrah. He waved to his beloved people. He was presented with bouquets by children. Amid the song "Our National Flag", the national flag of the DPRK and the flag of the WPK were hoisted. The performers gave such numbers as "The Workers' Party Is Our Guide", "Along the Road of Socialism" and "We Have the Great Party". Among the audience were Choe Ryong Hae, Ri Pyong Chol, Kim Tok Hun and Pak Pong Ju, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, senior officials of the Party, government and military, the delegates to the celebrations of the 75th anniversary of the founding of the WPK, the participants in the military parade, viewers and Pyongyang citizens. Political News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Has Photo Session with Participants in Military Parade
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, had a photo session with the participants in the military parade for celebrating the 75th anniversary of the founding of the WPK on Oct. 11. Present there was Marshal of the Korean People's Army (KPA) Ri Pyong Chol, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission of the WPK and vice-chairman of the WPK Central Committee. Also present at the photo session were KPA Marshal Pak Jong Chon, Army General Kim Su Gil and Army General Kim Jong Gwan, commanding officers of the military. The Supreme Leader of the Party, state and armed forces appeared in the venue of the photo session. All the participants broke into stormy cheers of hurrah in reverence for Kim Jong Un. He warmly waved to the participants who demonstrated the majestic appearance and tremendous might of the revolutionary army of the Party, the elite army boundlessly faithful to the Party's leadership through the military parade. After expressing the expectation and belief that the stalwart and reliable officers and men of our revolutionary armed forces would remain boundlessly true to the country and people and to their missions and duties as befits a motive force for national defense, creators of the people's happiness and pioneers of new civilization, he posed for a picture with them. Political News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Has Photo Session with Delegates to Celebrations of WPK Founding Anniversary
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, had a photo session with the delegates to the celebrations of the 75th anniversary of the founding of the WPK on Oct. 11. Attending it were Choe Ryong Hae, Ri Pyong Chol, Kim Tok Hun and Pak Pong Ju, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, and Kim Jae Ryong, Ri Il Hwan, Choe Hwi, Pak Thae Dok, Kim Yong Chol, Pak Jong Chon, Choe Pu Il, Kim Su Gil, Thae Hyong Chol and O Su Yong, members of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK. The moment the Supreme Leader of the Party, state and armed forces arrived at the venue of the photo session, all the participants raised stormy cheers of hurrah in reverence for him. He acknowledged enthusiastically cheering crowds. He highly appreciated the delegates to the celebrations for significantly decorating the 75th anniversary of the founding of the Party as a grand political festival to shine long in the history by performing feats in the van of the general onward march towards the significant October, and thus greatly contributing to fully demonstrating the tremendous might of our Party and people defending the prestige of the Party Central Committee and advancing towards the victory of socialism with confidence. Expressing the expectation and belief that they would reliably guarantee the victorious advance of the cause of the great Party of Comrades Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il, the revolutionary cause of Juche in the future, too, as pillars and cornerstones supporting our Party, he posed for a picture with them. Political News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from General Secretary of Sandinist National Liberation Front of Nicaragua and His Wife
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), received a message of greeting from Daniel Ortega Saavedra, general secretary of the Sandinist National Liberation Front of Nicaragua, and Rosario Murillo, his wife, on September 30. The message extended fraternal greetings of immortal spirit and solidarity to Chairman Kim Jong Un, our friend and comrade, and the Korean people greeting the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) with the pride of the revolutionary and diligent people who are advancing victoriously. It expressed the conviction that the viable and brave DPRK will invariably write the victorious history of the great people under the energetic guidance of Kim Jong Un and the WPK. The Sandinist National Liberation Front is honored to extended greetings to Kim Jong Un, firmly believing that the future belongs to the people who wage a vigorous struggle for peace and just development, joy of the family and right to the happiness, the message noted. The message wished Kim Jong Un good health and the WPK and the Korean people big achievements. Rodong Sinmun

title: African Union Leader on Developing Relations with DPRK
body: Sim Tong Guk, permanent representative of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) to the African Union, presented his credentials to Moussa Faki Mahamat, chairman of the Commission of the African Union, on Oct. 8. Saying that the relations between the DPRK and the African Union have long historical tradition, the chairman expressed his gratitude to the DPRK for having rendered material and moral support to African countries in their struggle for national liberation in the past. Evincing his will to make efforts to develop the relations with the DPRK, the chairman extended warm felicitations to the Korean people celebrating the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea. He sincerely wished the DPRK government and people bigger successes in the struggle for eradicating the aftermath of natural disasters as early as possible. Rodong Sinmun

title: Gift to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from General Secretary of
body: Communist Party of DR Congo Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a gift from Boswa Isekombe Sylvere, general secretary of the Communist Party of the DR Congo, on October 7 on the occasion of the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea. The gift was conveyed to an official of the DPRK mission in the DR Congo. Rodong Sinmun

title: Seminars Held Abroad to Mark 75th Founding Anniversary of WPK
body: A joint seminar of Bangladeshi political parties and social organizations was held on Oct. 5 to mark the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea. The chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Bangladesh, the chairman of the Bangladesh Jatiya Party and the chairman of the Bangladesh Institute of the Juche Idea made speeches at the joint seminar attended by figures of various political parties and social bodies. Speakers praised the exploits performed by President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il for the founding and development of the WPK, saying that Bangladeshi people significantly celebrated the 75th founding anniversary of the WPK with the Korean people. They praised Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un for developing the WPK into the party of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il, a genuine people's party making selfless, devoted efforts for the good of the people and a steel-strong party with invincible might, expressing the belief that the Korean party and people would celebrate the 8th Congress of the WPK as a grand festival of victors. Seminars were held in Nepal, Pakistan, DR Congo on Oct. 2 and 3 ahead of October 10, the founding anniversary of the WPK. Participants in the seminar in Nepal said the WPK has made brilliant achievements in the efforts for building and glorifying Korean-style socialism centred on the masses. The chairman of the Central Committee of the Worker-Peasant Party of Pakistan and the secretary general of the Pakistan Association for Self-Reliance Studies stressed that the WPK gives continuity to its proud course under the invariable banner of the Juche idea, adding this is a precious outcome of Kim Jong Un's outstanding political ability. The chairperson of the National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of DR Congo said that the WPK led by Kim Jong Un strives to creditably accomplish the cause of the Juche revolution started on Mt Paektu, while regarding it as its supreme programme to model the whole society on Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism. Rodong Sinmun

title: Army-People Meeting Held in Pyongyang
body: A Pyongyang city army-people rally took place at Kim Il Sung Square Monday to vow to greet the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea with proud victory by going all out in the 80-day Campaign true to the appeal of the great Party. Taking the tribune were Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and premier of the Cabinet of the DPRK, and Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, vice-chairman of the Sate Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the WPK Central Committee. Also taking the tribune were Kim Jae Ryong, Ri Il Hwan, Choe Hwi, Pak Thae Dok, Kim Il Chol, Im Chol Ung, Kim Yong Hwan, Ri Yong Gil, Ko In Ho and other leading officials of the Party and the government, senior officials of the commissions, ministries, national agencies and the Party and administrative organs and labor innovators in Pyongyang City. Kim Jong Gwan and other commanding officers of the armed forces organs were also present at the tribune.
