Attending the rally were Pyongyangites including officials of the commissions, ministries, national institutions, and officials and working people of city-and district-level organs, factories, enterprises and cooperative farms and officers and men of the Korean People's Army (KPA) and the Public Security Forces. Pak Pong Ju made a report. He emphasized the importance, mission and historic significance of the 80-day Campaign in successfully concluding the year-end drive this significant year and greeting the 8th Congress of the Party with significance by furthering the revolutionary fighting spirit that has become remarkably high with the 75th anniversary of the founding of the Party as an occasion. He said that 80-day Campaign, the first of its kind in the history of our Party, has begun ahead of the Party, for the safety of people's lives and the stability of their living true to the noble intention of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. He ardently appealed to all to make dynamic advancement to greet the 8th Congress of the Party with proud victory by holding high the flame of the 80-day Campaign, in hearty response to the appeal of the great Party. Pledge speeches were made. Kim Yong Hwan, chairman of the Pyongyang City Committee of the WPK, stressed that 80 days left are the most essential and crucial period in which it will be decided whether we make greater stride forward in the general advance or make a retreat. He stressed that all the officials, Party members and other people of the capital should rise up before others in the 80-day Campaign, clearly show to the world what the Pyongyang people spared and put forward by the Supreme leader are and devotedly safeguard the 8th Congress of the Party. Im Chol Ung, vice-premier of the Cabinet, called for putting priority efforts on protecting the lives of the people and the security of the country from the vicious contagious disease so that no pore would be made in the anti-epidemic wall built with much effort by our Party. He stressed the need for the officials of the Cabinet, commissions, ministries and national institutions to enter the hall for the 8th Congress of the Party with dignity by unconditionally carrying out the fighting goals set forth for their own fields and units. Pak Chol Min, chairman of the Central Committee of the youth league, confirmed his pledge to strikingly manifest the honor of being the reserves of the WPK by preparing gifts of loyalty going by the name of "Youth" for the great Party and the great country in the 80-day Campaign toward the 8th Congress of the Party. Kang Sun Nam, general of the KPA, stressed that he would devotedly safeguard the 8th Congress of the Party by writing proud feats and admirable military exploits in the 80-day Campaign Record and fully demonstrating the militant stamina and bravery as the army of the revolutionary Party. Adopted at the rally was an oath to Supreme Leader of the Party, state and armed forces Kim Jong Un. Then there was mass demonstration. Rodong Sinmun

title: Exerting Every Effort to Harvest and Thresh Cereals
body: The officials and agricultural workers of South Hwanghae Province and Nampho City channel all their efforts to harvest and thresh cereals. Paechon, Anak, Yonan, Sinchon, Jaeryong, Ongjin and Kangryong counties and many others in South Hwanghae Province are all-out for rice harvesting and threshing. The cooperative farms of Nampho City, too, are very busy harvesting their cereal crops. The officials and farmers of the Chongsan Cooperative Harm of Kangso District, the Okto Cooperative Farm of Ryonggang County and the Unha and Kumsong cooperative farms of Onchon County to the city also attain good results in their harvesting and threshing. Rodong Sinmun

title: By Motivating Masses’ Spiritual Strength
body: The officials and agricultural workers of Sunchon City score successes in harvesting and threshing cereals. On the basis of experiences in their previous farm work they carefully repaired and maintained their combines and tractors beforehand. This has led to their harvesting cereals a lot. They repaired lanes through their fields qualitatively. Consequently, they have been able to consume less fuel oil and yet transport sheaves of rice promptly. After all, cereals are harvested and threshed on schedule. Rodong Sinmun

title: Running Transport Trains in a Responsible Manner
body: The officials and employees of the Sunchon Service Brigade of Passenger and Freight Cars have risen as one in the 80-day campaign and done full justice to themselves in their work assignments. Since many trains go by rail and their railway for car maintenance is limited the officials rationally allocate their labor and take the lead of their fitters in responsibly maintaining their cars. The officials and employees are now doing their possible to ensure that freight cars do not fail to transport cement on schedule to the flood-wrecked areas of the country under reconstruction. Rodong Sinmun

title: Tongsin Power Station No. 3 Built Anew
body: Tongsin County newly built the Tongsin Power Station No. 3 across the Myongmun Stream. It will contribute greatly to developing the local industry of the county and improving the living standard of its inhabitants. Some time ago the TPS No. 3 successfully operated its generation equipment on trial and proceeded to produce electricity. Rodong Sinmun

title: Making Breakthrough in the Van of Fierce 24-7 Campaign
body: Millions of the members of the Workers’ Party of Korea have turned out vigorously in the 80-day campaign in hearty response to its militant appeal for it. The Party members of the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex lead in working hard day and night. The Party members of the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex, the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex, the February 8 Vinalon Complex and other chemical industry factories, too, stand in the van of the 80-day campaign playing their pivotal role in it. The Party members of the Sunchon Area Youth Coal Mining Complex go all-out to boost their coal output to honor the forthcoming 8th Congress of the WPK with successes in their work. The Sangwon Cement Complex registers successes day by day in producing more cement than ever to provide it to the flood-hit areas of the country under reconstruction and its other major sites of construction. Firmly determined to defend the 8th Congress of the WPK with rice the Party members of Migok-ri in Sariwon City, Samjigang-ri in Jaeryong County and other agricultural districts strive energetically as one to conclude their farm work for this year. Rodong Sinmun

title: Strong Aid to Metallurgical Industry
body: North Hwanghae Province procured large quantities of scrap iron and donated it to the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex on October 13. After all, it owed this not only to the officials and workers of Sariwon and Songrim Cities, Hwangju, Junghwa and Pongsan counties and other counties under its jurisdiction but also to those of their institutions and enterprises. The authorities concerned of NHP arranged for the scrap iron to be transported to the HISC in good time. Rodong Sinmun

title: To Hit without Fail Electric-power Production Target
body: The officials and workers of the sphere of electric-power industry have risen as one to increase their power production. First of all, they focus their efforts on putting their power stations in good order, reinforcing them and operating them at full capacity. The Ministry of Electric Power Industry makes detailed arrangements to speed up the technological reconstruction of its power distribution stations and reduce the leakage loss of power as best it can. It also bends every effort to create the generating capacity of the nation anew hand in hand with its working people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Determined to Bring About Rapid Development in Chemical Industry
body: The officials and workers of the domain of the chemical industry have made great strides in their work in step with the 80-day campaign. The workers of the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex and the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex set themselves a definite daily work goal and accelerate their fertilizer production. The workers and management of the February 8 Vinalon Complex have also bestirred themselves. The Myonggan Chemical Factory and the Chongjin and Sinuiju Chemical Fiber mills, too, strive mightily to hit the targets they have set themselves for the 80-day campaign. Rodong Sinmun

title: Harvesting and Threshing in Full Swing
body: The agricultural officials and workers of the country have risen stoutly in response to the appeal of the Party for the 80-day campaign. Those of Pyongyang lead the country in farm work. Those of South Hwanghae Province determine the order of their farm work in the fields and rationally allocate their labor and travelling threshers to fields in hand so as to finish their work as soon as possible. Those of North Phyongan Province register successes in their farm work from the outset of the 80-day campaign. Those of South Phyongan, North Hwanghae and South Hamgyong Provinces and others, too, work with great devotion to bring their farm work for this year to a successful conclusion. Rodong Sinmun

title: Masses Actively Inspired to 80-Day Campaign
body: The Ryanggang Provincial Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea energetically encourages the Party members and workers of the province to carry on the 80-day campaign. Now that the officials of the province conduct their political work dynamically at its major production places the way the like is done at the front, the Paektusan Spring Water Factory, a provincial medical oxygen factory and a synthetic stockbreeding center are built full steam at the last stage of their completion. The medium and small power stations of the province actively repair their generating machines and hydraulic structures. Meanwhile, its forestry stations make good arrangements for their winter timber production in real earnest. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Inspects Rehabilitation Site
body: in Komdok Area of South Hamgyong Province Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, inspected the rehabilitation site in the Komdok area of South Hamgyong Province. Accompanying the Supreme Leader of the Party, state and armed forces were Pak Jong Chon, Ri Il Hwan, Kim Yong Su, Jo Yong Won, Hyon Song Wol and Kim Myong Sik. He, who arrived there by dangerous gorge railway restored temporarily, was greeted by excited commanding officers of the Korean People's Army (KPA). He convened the 6th Enlarged Meeting of the 7th Central Military Commission of the WPK just one month ago to issue an order of the Party Central Military Commission to involve KPA units in the rehabilitation campaign in the Komdok area which suffered severe damage from typhoon and whose conditions were the worst. And he ardently called on the service personnel to make devoted efforts for our great people, for our great Party, and for our great state. In hearty response to his noble intention the soldier-builders turned out as one in the restoration campaign. They waged a 24-7 campaign in the spirit of carrying out the Party's instructions unto death and of At a Go to fulfill over 60 percent of the total project of building more than 2 300 new dwellings in the Komdok area. He said he could see the damage done to the area was more severe than he thought. He highly appreciated the labor feats of the service personnel who completely removed the serious aftereffects and are pushing forward with the reconstruction project. He was greatly satisfied with the service personnel's high spirit and the effective field political work that was conducted across the reconstruction site. Looking round the reconstruction site, he highly praised service personnel for building dwellings to be of high quality and doing all parts of the construction with all sincerity. Saying that the conscience and unassuming efforts of the service personnel devoted to the building of the dwelling houses will be appreciated and estimated by the householders, he stressed the need for the service personnel remaining boundlessly true to the Party and the people to put sincerity to every dwelling. He also spoke highly of the KPA units and sub-units involved in the recovery campaign in Komdok area as they are building firm retaining concrete walls by road stretches and railway sections exposed to potential danger of landslides, and doing qualitative river improvement so that there would not be damage by future natural disasters. He said that the service personnel were dispatched to the reconstruction sites in different parts of the country to carry out the holy missions given by the Party Central Committee and are performing miracles like legendary stories about heroes, adding that thanks to them the 75th anniversary of the founding of the glorious WPK could be celebrated successfully and the square of the celebrations could also be glorified more. And he expressed his thanks to all the soldier-builders for displaying gallantry in the reconstruction campaign. He underlined the need for the whole party and for the whole society to establish the trait of encouraging the struggle of the service personnel taking the lead in the restoration campaign, to send letters inspiring them and to render political and ideological aid to them so as to keep the high spirit. He learned about the supply of winter clothes for the service personnel and other supply service and underscored the need to take good care of them as it is getting cold, to provide living environments of meeting the anti-epidemic requirements and to create the conditions for timely curing the cases, if any. He said he was so pleased to hear that the calamity-afflicted people could move into new houses by the end of this month, and stressed the need to take measures to supply food and daily necessities to those disaster-hit people and to take good care of them as they are living a hard life in public buildings and other people's houses. He was so unhappy to see the single-storied houses squeezed in a haphazard way at the foot of a mountain slope on his way to the reconstruction site. He said that there are still houses built more than half a century ago and that we did not know properly the life of the people living in so piteous environments and dwellings, although we thought of reconstructing houses for the disaster-stricken people. He continued that he feels not relieved as we can not build new houses for them this time. He said that we have to seriously self-reproach ourselves for making the workers in Komdok live in such a backward living environment because we failed to pay due attention to the living of the people there, though we claimed that the workers of Komdok are like the elder brother of the country and that the Komdok area is the major artery of the national economy. He continued that if we shun such living conditions of the people in the local areas, our Party's popular policies will be just an empty talk and be just like taking credit to oneself, adding that he would feel remorseful if only thousands of houses that had been affected by flood are rebuilt. He said that now new houses are built only when old ones are brought down by natural disasters, adding that local construction should not be done this way and, as he had said shortly ago, that the goal for the local construction should be set in a planned way and be carried out in a long-term way. He unfolded a far-reaching plan and master plan to turn the Komdok area, the country's leading large-scale mineral production base, into the country's model mountainous city and a mining city next to Samjiyon City by doing away with the centuries-old backwardness in Taehung, Komdok and Ryongyang and by building modern dwelling houses suited to the requirement of the new century. He said that the current construction for recovery from damage should be set as the first-stage project which must be completed during the 80-day campaign with all-out efforts, stressing his pledge to build 25 000 new dwelling houses in Komdok Mining Complex, Taehung Youth Hero Mine and Ryongyang Mine during the five-year plan which will be set forth in the 8th Congress of the Party as the second-stage project. He gave detailed instructions regarding the direction of the construction in the Komdok area, pledging to take charge of the project himself and build, together with the People's Army, mine villages in the Komdok area into the world's best mining city, the world's No 1 mountainous gorge city to be envied by all the people. He said that the People's Army would take full charge of building materials such as cement, steel and oil and build 5 000 dwelling houses each year from next year on an yearly basis, not reaching out for help to the national planning institutions which become very calculating, reel off complaints being caught in defeatism and make a great fuss when the target worthy of the political attention of the country is set. He advanced the task for the designing field to work out the master plan for the construction of the Komdok area during the 80-day campaign period. He stressed the need to conduct field survey before the designing, to set the site properly so that there would be free from natural disasters and wouldn't be inconvenience in living, and to design the exterior and interior of the dwelling houses strictly based on the requirements of the people. He suggested making harmonious combination of one-storey houses and several-storey, multi-storey and high-rise apartment buildings in the Komdok area, calling for breaking the old style of building clusters of single-storey houses in local counties and mountainous counties and for face-lifting the area so as to create another example, a revolution, in the local construction. He stressed the need to do the good work of dredging beds of rivers and streams and embankment and put importance on forest and water conservation so that the area would not be affected by any floods and typhoons in the future. He again made a decision to conduct huge task believing in the People's Army, he said, adding the grandiose ambition and ideal of our Party will instill fresh confidence and hope to the people all over the country and become a spark of the 80-day campaign for opening up the period of new surge and great turn in our revolution. He said that the second hand of the clock of our revolution turns keeping pace with the footsteps of the People's Army and the speed of the latter is precisely the speed of the advance of our revolution, calling on the People's Army to dash forward keeping step with the attack speed of our Party which doesn't feel content in the work for the people and thus bring earlier the future of our country with nothing to desire more. All the builders were full of strong will to creditably carry out the task for the construction for the recovery of the Komdok area and turn the area into the example of mining city which will bring about a great change in the era of the Workers' Party, and into the place of unprecedented and mythical miracle, in response to the do-or-die attack spirit of Kim Jong Un working heart and soul for the miraculous civilization which will soar from manifold disasters, the spirit which is tantamount to a bold pluck and decision that can be made and put into practice by our Marshal only. The Supreme Leader ardently appealed to the units of the People's Army to make dedicated efforts for our great people, our great Party and our great state. Political News Team

title: Army-People Meetings Held in North Phyongan and Jagang Provinces
body: Army-people meetings were held in North Phyongan Province and Jagang Province on Tuesday. The participants in the meetings vowed to greet the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea with proud victories by going all out in the 80-day Campaign. Attending the meetings were officials of local Party and power organs, working people's organizations, factories, enterprises and cooperative farms and working people. Also present at the meetings were officers and men of the Korean People's Army and the Public Security Forces. Reports and Speeches were made at the meetings. Reporters and speakers called for turning out as one in the 80-day campaign and bringing about greater victories and miracles in hearty response to the patriotic appeal made by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un who has unfolded far-sighted plans for the rosy future of the country and the people. They called upon all fields and units to simultaneously turn out in the implementation of the goals for the five-year strategy for national economic development from 2016 to 2020 and successfully conclude this year by finding out the practical way for self-reliance, holding high the slogan of "Let us advance vigorously towards the Eighth Party Congress by making the flames of the 80-day campaign flare up!". They said that though they face gigantic tasks and many difficulties and ordeals during the campaign, they have confidence and capability for carrying out any revolutionary tasks. They called on all Party members and all other working people to further consolidate the anti-epidemic barrier, as required by regional situations, and turn out as one in carrying out the Party's economic policy, regarding the anti-epidemic campaign and the economic work as combats. Then there took place processions of citizens. Rodong Sinmun

title: Cause of WPK Is Ever-victorious: Foreign Political Personages
body: Political personages of different countries released statements and articles on the occasion of the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). Atanas Ivanov, honorary chairman of the Bulgarian Communists Union, said in a statement that the history of the WPK spanning 75 years is a glorious one, in which the WPK has safeguarded the sovereignty of the country and turned it into a fortress of world socialism and the beacon of hope of the progressive mankind. Vasile Orleanu, chairman of the Supreme Council of the National Socialist Party of Romania, noted in his article that the WPK has fulfilled its mission and role as the general staff of the revolution under the outstanding leadership of the great leaders. The WPK is winning victory after victory under the guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, he said, expressing his will to further strengthen solidarity with the WPK and actively support the struggle of the Korean people. Yehia Zakaria Khairullah, vice-chairman of the Socialist Freedom Party of Egypt, in his article carried on the Egyptian newspaper Al Ahrar, praised the feats performed by President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in founding and developing the WPK and gave a detailed account of the victorious advance of Korean-style socialism under the wise leadership of the peerlessly great men. The article said that Kim Jong Un, who carries forward the revolutionary cause of the great leaders, continues his tireless field guidance for the people and thereby a series of eye-opening miracles and innovations are made in the DPRK. Rodong Sinmun

title: To Repay His Great Trust by Performing Miraculous Feats
body: Infinitely encouraged by the firsthand guidance offered by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un to the Komdok area the servicemen of the Korean People’s Army units and the workers and inhabitants of the area are firmly resolved to repay him for his great confidence in them by dint of mysterious heroism. The servicemen of the KPA try their hardest to build houses of several storeys for miners around the Ryongyang Mine most qualitatively. All the soldiers of the KPA units work in sky-high spirits to build dwellings in the flood-ridden area of the Taehung Youth Hero Mine. The officials and workers of the Komdok Mining Complex, the Taehung Youth Hero Mine and the Ryongyang Mine work hard to increase their mineral production while doing all they can to finish their construction projects by the appointed time. Since the inhabitants of the Komdok area and the servicemen of the KPA units work energetically as one to loyally repay Kim Jong Un for his great trust in and love for them, its flood damage will be recovered as soon as possible. Rodong Sinmun

title: Hungju Youth Power Station No. 5 Built Full Steam
body: The Hungju Youth Power Station No.5 finished concreting more than 10 spillway columns before the 75th birthday of the Workers’ Party of Korea. They are now concentrating all their energies on concreting the substructure of its generator room. They put their excavators, delivery machines and mixers in full operation and actively apply rational working methods, thereby achieving great results in their construction project. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Inspects Reconstruction Sites
body: in South Hamgyong Province Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, provided guidance inspecting reconstruction sites in the eastern area including Sinpho City and Hongwon County in South Hamgyong Province. Accompanying the Supreme Leader of the Party, state and armed forces were Pak Jong Chon, Jo Yong Won, Kim Yong Su, Hyon Song Wol and Kim Myong Sik. He was greeted on the spot by Commander of the Division No.1 of Party Members of the Capital City Choe Hwi, vice-chairman of the WPK Central Committee; Commissar Ri Yong Sik, first vice director of the Information and Publicity Department of the WPK Central Committee; Chief of Staff Sim In Song, vice-chairman in charge of organizational affairs of the Pyongyang City Committee of the WPK; and commanding officers of the Korean People's Army's units at different levels. He exchanged greetings with leading officials of the division. He said that the division members and service personnel involved in the reconstruction campaign were always in his heart during the celebrations marking the founding anniversary of the glorious Party, and added that he missed them and he visited them to give encouragement to them. The Supreme Leader called on the Party members from the capital city of Pyongyang, the core force our Party puts its greatest trust in, to immediately go to calamity-afflicted areas in North and South Hamgyong provinces and to help them remove the aftereffects as soon as possible. In hearty response to his ardent call, the members of division 1 arrived in the disaster-stricken areas repairing the section of road extending scores of kilometers and built 147 modern dwelling houses in Unpho and Kyongpho workers' districts in Hongwon County and Haksadae-ri, Riwon County of South Hamgyong Province in 12-29 Sept. period, within 18 days since the start of the reconstruction project. Thus they carried out their duties before the October holiday. Then they went to the most severely devastated areas, the areas which are left behind in the reconstruction, and are pushing forward with the all-out reconstruction campaign to achieve greater successes. He said that the Party members of the capital city and service personnel are undergoing many difficulties far away from their homes, looking round for a long time the new houses to which they put their efforts. He said that they built the houses flawlessly as well as professional builders, noting with great satisfaction that those houses are a crystal of the loyalty of Party members from the capital city to the Party, and the work capacity of the elite division of the Party members of the capital city was fully displayed in practice. He said that the Party spirit, the spirit of serving the people and the revolutionary spirit of the core Party members from the capital city were verified this time, adding that their intense loyalty and struggle zeal are prevailing all over the reconstruction sites and encouraging all the builders to perform new feats and innovations, and serve as a driving force for the acceleration of the reconstruction project. He said that by involving the core Party members of the capital city in the reconstruction of the local areas, we could give proper understanding as to what the Party members should do and what the duty and role of a Party member should be when the country is in difficulties, adding that this contributed to establishing a good socialist national trait of the whole country sharing and overcoming ordeals together. He said that although the project was great and the conditions were unfavorable, proud successes were achieved thanks to their devoted efforts, adding that the proud achievements showed that if Party members turn out with firm faith, they can display the tremendous strength and no ordeal would be insurmountable in the world. The Supreme Leader said that it is good to see collectivism being fully displayed, a beautiful trait of helping and leading one another forward and learning with an open mind amid the fierce hot wind of the socialist emulation during the construction, adding a hot wind of competition including the campaigns in which one overtakes and learns from others and swaps building experiences with them should be raised fiercely in all the campaign sites for recovery from natural disasters to let all units make innovations. He stressed the need to provide the Party member fighters with clothes for winter, necessities, materials and supplies in a responsible manner and take good measures for treatment and prevention, now that the weather is getting cold. He appreciated that service personnel of the People's Army have raised fierce flames of performing the feats in the campaign sites for recovery from disasters in South Hamgyong province to build new dwelling houses embodying the plan of our Party and desire and requirement of the people like mushrooms after rain, and made miraculous successes. He said that it is a miracle that can be worked by only our army, creator of the people's happiness and pioneer of a new civilization, that the service personnel have registered a series of brilliant successes in finishing the building of dwelling houses qualitatively in time while making unsparing devotion with the same sincerity with which they would make when they build their own houses and villages, after correctly understanding that architecture is like a visual aid material of ideology and culture in which the height of the ideology and civilization in the times is intuitively reflected as noted by the Party. Calling for steadily setting new example and model in the direction of preserving the characteristics of specific zones in the local construction in the future, too, the Supreme Leader emphasized that the designing agencies assume very important mission in materializing our Party's grandiose plan for local construction. He particularly stressed that it is one of important issues that should be prioritized to enhance the responsibility and role of the field of construction supervision. According to a recent report, there occurred wicked and shameless violation of law of construction in which construction is done in a random way in a easy-going way in violation of the requirements of the designing and construction method by some units in Kangwon Province, and North and South Hamgyong Provinces, he said, adding that this issue will be strictly dealt with. He instructed officials to study and introduce the way of paving roads in the residential districts with earth hardening agent. He stressed the need to plant lots of fruit trees around every dwelling house and carry out the work of creating forests in the surrounding mountains on a long-term basis. Out of dwelling houses he looked around today, the ones built by the division of Party members from the capital city were the best, he said, adding that as the chairman of the WPK, the houses built by the Party members from the capital were most valuable to him and he felt proud of them. He stressed that the houses built by the division of the Party members from the capital city are a model which all the units should reach and follow in the construction for rehabilitation from damage. Calling on the divisions of the Party members from the capital city to conduct a new creation drive with high awareness and enthusiasm in the areas to which they had been moved with the tasks given by the Party, he extended militant greetings to all the members of the division of Party members from the capital city once again. He said that watching the construction of the dwelling houses, the people in the afflicted areas waiting day by day with great expectation and hope would be really pleased, ardently appealing to all to make redoubled and strenuous efforts to bring earlier the day of completion when new cradle of happy life would be provided to our people. Political News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Russian Party Leader
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), received a message of greeting from S. M. Mironov, chairman of "A Just Russia", on October 6. The chairman in the message extended congratulations to Kim Jong Un on behalf of "A Just Russia" and on his own behalf on the occasion of the 75th founding anniversary of the WPK. The message said that the WPK has organized and aroused the Korean people for the struggle to frustrate challenges at home and abroad, attain important socio-economic and socio-political tasks and strengthen the sovereignty and defence capability of the country for decades. It expressed the belief that friendly working-level contacts between the two parties would propel the development of good-neighbourly and close ties between Russia and the Democratic People's Republic of Korea in the future, too. It wished Kim Jong Un, the WPK and all the Korean people success and prosperity. Rodong Sinmun

title: New Novel Published in DPRK
body: The full-length novel "From Spring to Spring" (authored by Ri Yu Chol), part of the serial "Immortal Guidance", was published. The novel depicts the exploits Chairman Kim Jong Il performed by further developing the People's Army into invincible combat ranks remaining loyal to the leadership of the Party with pure revolutionary outlook on the leader. The novel recalls that the Chairman climbed Mt Paektu in summer of Juche 57 (1968) and made a decisive decision to root out anti-party warlord-bureaucratism from the People's Army and strictly maintain the traditions and the revolutionary character of the revolutionary armed forces peculiar to the army of the leader and the Party. The novel also deals with the feats he performed by wisely leading the work for strengthening the Party's guidance on the People's Army in every way, so as to establish the revolutionary command system and military discipline throughout the army. The novel notes that President Kim Il Sung, together with Chairman Kim Jong Il, meets the anti-Japanese revolutionary fighters and the commanding officers of the younger generation at Mangyongdae in April 1972 and has a photo session with them, expressing the expectation and conviction that the People's Army would firmly preserve its true nature, remaining true to the cause of the Party. It depicts Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un recollecting the glorious course of development of our revolutionary armed forces strengthened under the leadership of the President and the Chairman, seeing the steel-strong ranks marching past the square of the military parade marking the centenary of the birth of the President in April 2012. The novel represents the idea that the People's Army, which has carried forward the brilliant traditions created during the anti-Japanese armed struggle, greeted the new spring for its development into the revolutionary army of the Party under the leadership of the Chairman, and that it will always greet the spring of victory as it is led by the Supreme Leader. Rodong Sinmun

title: Head of DPRK Delegation Speaks at Ministerial Meeting of NAM
body: The head of a DPRK delegation made a speech at the Ministerial Meeting of the Non-Aligned Movement (NAM) on the sideline of the High-Level Segment of the 75th Session of the UN General Assembly on October 9. He said that the existence of humankind is at serious risk from the worldwide rapid spread of COVID-19. Wiping out the malignant virus off the planet and saving humanity is the most pressing issue which brooks no further delay, and effectively responding to this global pandemic is a matter of utmost urgency now faced by the Movement, he noted, and went on: Success in the fight against the worldwide malignant virus can be ensured only when all countries assume responsibility for the life and safety of their own people and take thoroughgoing anti-epidemic measures. Thanks to the far-sighted measures of the government of the DPRK taking the people-first policy as its political philosophy and idea, a stable anti-epidemic situation is maintained in our country until now. The government of the DPRK will firmly defend the safety of our people by building upon the state emergency anti-epidemic measures without allowing the slightest complacency and laxity until the danger of inflow of the pandemic is completely gone away. We have suffered extensive damages this year caused by successive natural disasters, but we are doing everything we can on our own efforts to recover from the damages of typhoons and floods and bring our people back to a stable life. Today, in the international arena, high-handedness and arbitrariness by certain forces become ever more reckless and the power politics grow rampant, thereby complicating the international relations as days go by. In particular, the sovereignty of the non-aligned countries is encroached, and interference, threats and aggression against these countries continue unabated. The prevailing situation calls upon all member states to firmly adhere to the UN Charter and the principles of the NAM, which require respect for sovereignty, non-interference in internal affairs of other countries and peaceful settlement of disputes. It is an invariable goal of the government of the DPRK to struggle to build a peaceful world free of war. When the progressive humankind that love independence, justice and peace unite firmly and fight vigorously, it will be possible to build an independent and peaceful world, free of high-handedness, arbitrariness, and war maneuvers of the imperialist forces. He stressed that the DPRK will continue to actively develop friendly and cooperative relations with the NAM countries under the ideas of independence, peace and friendship and make vigorous efforts to strengthen and develop the Movement and to ensure its joint action and safeguard peace and security of the region and the world at large. Rodong Sinmun

title: Founding Anniversary of WPK Commemorated in Various Countries
body: Meetings took place in Pakistan, Russia, Norway, Denmark, Kazakhstan, and Belarus from Sept. 24 to Oct. 7 to commemorate the 75th anniversary of the founding of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). At a meeting held in Pakistan, a reporter and speakers said that the WPK is a great and dignified party which has advanced along the ever-victorious road since its foundation, holding aloft the banner of the Juche idea and weathering stern trials of its revolutionary struggle. The first secretary of the Khabarovsk Territorial Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation said that the WPK, founded by President Kim Il Sung and strengthened by Chairman Kim Jong Il, is a popular party, which solves every problem by relying on the people, adding that it is the faith of the WPK that there is nothing impossible to do if it believes in the people and relies on them. The chairman of the Ostfold County Committee of the Communist Party of Norway said that the Juche idea, the guiding idea of the WPK, serves as the best cornerstone for developing socialism in the DPRK. The chairman of the Denmark-DPRK Friendship Association said that the WPK is enjoying absolute support and trust by the revolutionary parties and progressives in the world as well as all the Korean people. The chairman of the Kazakh Kim Jong Il Association for the Study and Dissemination of the Juche Idea said that although the DPRK was recently battered by natural disasters, the Korean people have pushed forward with the campaign to remove their aftereffects under the leadership of the great Party. The chief of the Belarusian Group for Solidarity with the DPRK hoped that the Korean people would accomplish the cause of building a powerful socialist country without fail under the guidance of the WPK. Messages of greeting and congratulatory letters to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un were adopted at the meetings held in Norway and Denmark. Rodong Sinmun

title: Eager to Contribute to Improving People’s Living Standard
body: Those engaged in the sphere of the sericulture and silk industry have stirred up in hearty response to the appeal of the Party to the entire Party, the whole country and all the people for the 80-day campaign. The workers and management of cocoon producers, filatures and silk mills across the country make great strides in their production. Those of the Nyongbyon and Pakchon Silk Mills and many other ones, too, exert themselves to fulfill their daily production plan without fail. Rodong Sinmun

title: Strong Support to Chollima Steel Complex
body: On October 14 Pyongyang used more than a hundred motortrucks to transport scrap iron to the Chollima Steel Complex which is in full operation. Its Mangyongdae, Moranbong and Sosong districts led in this. The Party members and workers of its Taedonggang, Rangnang and Tongdaewon districts worked hard as one to gather and carry iron scraps, too. This naturally met with success. Rodong Sinmun

title: The Whole City Has Turned Out
body: The officials of Sinuiju City and the agricultural workers of all its cooperative farms have bestirred themselves vigorously to harvest cereals in the fields. Not only the employees of factories and enterprises in the city but also the housewives of its residential units affiliated with the Socialist Women’s Union of Korea actively help its farms in their work. Fresh successes are registered in their cereal harvest day after day. Rodong Sinmun

title: Going All-out to Harvest Soonest
body: All the officials and agricultural workers of Sukchon County are all-out to finish their cereal harvest at the earliest possible date. The Chaeryong, Yakjon and Kumphung Cooperative Farms are very zealous for this. The case is similar to the Yoltusamchon, Hungo and Ryonhwa Cooperative Farms. Rodong Sinmun

title: Innovations Made Competitively Day by Day
body: From the first day of the 80-day campaign novel successes are scored in repairing the flood damage of Hochon County, South Hamgyong Province, walling and roofing dwellings for hundreds of families there, plastering them with mortar and doing other final works. The soldiers of the Korean People’s Army units outdo all civilian rivals in housing construction. The Jagang Provincial Brigade registered successes in their first-stage housing construction and on this basis, speedily builds dwellings in a new district at the last phase of their completion. The Pyongyang Municipal Brigade for the Construction of the Chongchongang-Phyongnam Irrigation Waterway keeps on making innovations in covering the interior and exterior of dwellings in their charge and carrying on other final works. The members of the 6th Brigade of the High-Speed Youth Shock Force, the Brigade of the Kumgang Trade Guidance Bureau, North Phyongan Province, Kangwon Province, the South Hamgyong Provincial Brigade for the Construction of the Chongchongang-Phyongnam Irrigation Waterway and other units also strive energetically to complete their dwellings as soon as possible. Rodong Sinmun

title: Samjiyon City People's Hospital Opens
body: A new modern hospital was built in Samjiyon City that has wonderfully turned into the example of modern mountainous city in the era of the Workers' Party. The Samjiyon City People's Hospital which has perfectly embodied the healthcare and medical requirements and the Juche-based idea on architectural beauty has full provision of ultra-modern medical equipment and apparatuses in all sections, efficient tele-medical service system and IT-based medical service for rapid and accurate diagnosis and treatment of patients. An opening ceremony took place Thursday. Present there were Ri Il Hwan, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), Choe Sang Gon, department director of the WPK Central Committee, O Chun Bok, minister of Public Health, Ri Thae Il, chairman of Ryanggang Provincial Committee of the WPK, Ri Song Guk, chairman of the provincial people's committee, officials concerned, staff members of the hospital and working people in the City. Ri Il Hwan in the opening speech said that the hospital is a gift provided by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in order to make the people in Samjiyon City who are living and working in the home village of Chairman Kim Jong Il lead a highly civilized life in good health with access to the most advanced medical care. The Samjiyon City People's Hospital is the icon of local people's hospitals which has embodied the healthcare and medical requirements and the Juche-based idea on architectural beauty, he said, calling for effecting a fundamental change in the work of all treatment and prevention agencies and anti-epidemic units to give fuller play to the advantages of the socialist healthcare system in our country. He called for winning a proud victory in the 80-day campaign toward the 8th Congress of the WPK by making devoted service for our great Party and state which build the best paradise for the people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Meetings for 80-day Campaign Held
body: Meetings were held at commissions, ministries, national institutions, and other institutions, industrial establishments, cooperative farms and universities to vow to greet the Eighth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea with proud victory by going all out in the 80-day campaign true to the appeal of the great Party. Reports and speeches were made there. Reporters and speakers said that it is a good tradition of our Party members and people that has been handed over generation after generation to provide the present of loyalty by displaying high spirit and strong ability of exertion whenever the Party congress is convened. They expressed their resolution to resolutely conduct the 80-day campaign of loyalty and merits with faith in sure victory that no difficulties and trials can ever check their advance as they are led by the great Party and greet the Eighth Congress of the Party successfully. Rodong Sinmun

title: KCNA Releases a Detailed Report on Grand Celebration of
body: 75th Anniversary of WPK as Auspicious All-People Event The Korean Central News Agency released a detailed report on Thursday on the successful celebration of the 75th anniversary of the founding of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) by all the people across the country. The report said that the work has dynamically been pushed forward from the outset of the year to greet the 75th anniversary of the WPK as a genuine holiday for the people and as the revolutionary holiday for cementing the single-minded unity and as a great festival peculiar to socialist Korea from every aspect under the leadership of the Party Central Committee. The 5th Plenary Meeting of the 7th Central Committee of the WPK advanced the great immortal programme for breaking through head-on unprecedented grim difficulties and for opening up the broad avenue toward the victory of the revolutionary cause of Juche, and adopted a decision on celebrating the 75th anniversary of the Party with splendor. Upon the decision of the Plenary Meeting of the WPK Central Committee, all the people and the service personnel of the People's Army turned out toward the October of glory. The all-people general advance was a continuation of courageous head-on breakthrough in which they had to overcome manifold challenges and difficulties from the beginning. The malignant contagious disease that swept the world as a great disaster from the outset of the year has seriously threatened the security of our state and the lives of our people, and a series of harsh natural disasters held us back from making advance. The whole world accepted 2020 as a year of unavoidable disasters and calamities but the Party Central Committee turned the emergency anti-epidemic work and the campaign for recovery from natural disasters into the drive for defending the people, thereby glorifying this year as a year of great struggle and a year of advance and unity for winning miraculous victories by turning adversity into favorable conditions. Since the very beginning of the worldwide contagious disease, we have built high the anti-epidemic wall with preemptive and offensive super-class measures. The might of the great army-people unity has been fully displayed in the sites for rehabilitation from damage hit hard by natural disasters including South and North Hwanghae provinces, Kangwon Province, South and North Hamgyong provinces and Kaesong City. 12 000 Party members from the capital city organized elite divisions and have performed feats in the disaster-stricken areas in South and North Hamgyong provinces, in hearty response to the call of the Party Central Committee. A perfect anti-epidemic system has been maintained and strengthened nationwide and socialist fairyland villages have appeared one after another in the areas that had been hit hard by natural disasters, further highlighting the image of our style socialism. The first gun-report of victory in the head-on breakthrough was made in the construction of the Sunchon Phosphatic Fertilizer Factory which was followed by the heated-up drive of self-reliance and self-prosperity in all fields including the construction sites for the Pyongyang General Hospital, water-way project in South Hwanghae Province and power stations and tideland reclamation sites. Under the outstanding leadership of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, the 75th anniversary of the WPK has been celebrated as a grand festival for all the people and a great auspicious event marked by victory and advance, the report said, and continued: "Hall of Great Leaders and Their Comrades-in-Arms" was wonderfully arranged at the Korean Revolution Museum, making it possible to further advance the glorious history of the Korean revolution and the traditions of single-minded unity. Commemoration coins were issued on the occasion. Volume 10 of the enlarged version of "Complete Collection of Kim Il Sung's Works", and Volume 32 of "Complete Collection of Kim Jong Il", a library of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, and "With the Nation," volume 1 of the collection of real-life revolutionary stories, reminiscences "Great Life" (builder of youth power), first lengthy novel "Prosperity" from library "Immortal Milestones" and other books dealing with the personality of the great leaders were published and disseminated. Performances of the Workers' Art Group of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea and the joint performance of schoolchildren added to the festive atmosphere. Lots of meritorious workers from across the country took part in the celebrations in Pyongyang as delegates to the celebrations and as viewers. National political and cultural festivals for celebrating the October holiday were held almost every day, giving pleasure to the people. There took place a successful military parade for celebrating the 75th founding anniversary of the WPK in the presence of Kim Jong Un at Kim Il Sung Square in Pyongyang at 00:00 on October 10. The historic speech made by Kim Jong Un on the platform of victory and glory the last sentence of which was Long Live our great People greatly impressed the whole country and the whole world. The military parade demonstrated to the world the proud path of the development of our army which has developed into the invincible army possessed of the weaponry system of the WPK style and the ultra-modern type huge nuclear war armed forces though it was so young as to let carts with machine guns on form a column of mechanized units during the first days after the army building. There was a grand meeting for celebrating the anniversary, also. The meeting adopted a congratulatory message to Kim Jong Un who led our Party along the path of only victories and performed undying feats before the country, the revolution, the times and history. Fully demonstrated at the mass demonstration for celebrating the 75th anniversary of the WPK was people's joy of having glorified our Party's birthday with great glory and pride. There was torchlight procession of youth and students for celebrating the WPK founding anniversary "Dynamically Forward, Straight along the Party!" The fireworks display for celebrating the anniversary brilliantly decorated the nocturnal sky of October. The grand mass gymnastic and artistic performance "Great Guidance" took place at the May Day Stadium on Rungna Islet in the presence of the Supreme Leader in celebration of the 75th anniversary of the founding of the WPK. He had a photo session with the delegates to the celebrations marking the Party founding anniversary and the participants in the military parade to bestow favors on them. All civilians and service personnel of the country including those involved in the reconstruction campaign watched the October celebrations on TV, feeling as if they took part in the grand festival. The celebrations hardened the confidence of all the people that when they are true to the idea and guidance of the Supreme Leader, the cause of our Party will surely emerge ever-victorious and a powerful socialist country will be built without fail, the detailed report concluded. Rodong Sinmun

title: WPK Is Invincible: Foreign Political Parties
body: Political parties in different countries made public statements on Oct. 8 and 9 on the occasion of 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). The Central Committee of the Czechoslovak Communist Party said in a statement that President Kim Il Sung founded the WPK on October 10, 1945 and set an example in the building of a revolutionary party of the working class. Under the leadership of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il the WPK successfully advanced the cause of socialism in the face of persistent challenges and obstructive moves of the imperialist allied forces, and developed the DPRK into a strong country, independent and self-reliant in all fields including politics, economy and military. The National Guidance Council of the Pioneer Party of Indonesia said in a statement that since its foundation, the WPK has made its policies to realize the independence of the people and improve their standard of living. By pursuing such policies, the WPK has become a party that enjoys the people's trust and established the single-minded unity of the society centered on the leader, it added. It stressed that by dint of the unity, the DPRK has foiled the invasion by imperialism and emerged as a powerful socialist country displaying its might as an independent and sovereign state. As long as there are people who firmly believe in and follow the WPK, it will always be invincible, it added. The People's Progressive Party of Nigeria in its statement said that the DPRK has exalted its dignity, defended the destiny of the people and opened up a golden age of prosperity in the face of severe adversities of history as it has great leaders and established a harmonious whole of the Party and the masses that can never be found in other countries. Saying that the DPRK neither follows nor kowtows to any big power or foreign forces, it noted that the DPRK is recognized in the international arena as "a strong-willed country" and "a country with self-respect" which says what it wants and manages state building and activities independently. The statement hoped that the WPK with a sacred history of 75 years would achieve greater successes under the leadership of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Efforts Channeled into Developing New Product
body: The machines of various kinds recently invented and produced at the field of the machine-building industry attract public attention in our country. They are of importance in settling the electricity problem of the country. They are highly efficient at once and low in production cost. The Sunchon Engine Factory devised engines of three kinds. It has already completed two kinds of them. It is now trying out the last one finally. Rodong Sinmun

title: Terrapin Farming Base Built in Sunchon Catfish Farm
body: The Sunchon Catfish Farm in South Phyongan Province has newly built a soft-shelled turtle farm. It comprises main production buildings like a hatchery, a young soft-shelled turtles house, a fattening house and a soft-shelled mother turtles house, plus a heating place, a compressor house and other secondary houses. Above all, the warm waste water from the electricity production of the Sunchon Thermal Power Station is used for raising soft-shelled turtles. Rodong Sinmun

title: Division No. 1 of Party Members of Capital City Speeds Up Construction
body: The officers and men of the Division No. 1 of the Party Members of the capital city are all-out to create a new speed of construction. On the one hand the division gives priority to its survey and on the other, definitely pushes its roads repairs and rezoning ahead of its materials transport to amend the very bad traffic conditions. The Battalions of Ryongsong and Pothonggang districts set a great example to others in the work. The officers and men of many battalions, including the battalions of Songyo, Central and Moranbong districts and Kangnam County, fiercely compete with each other in work and thereby sharply increase its speed. Rodong Sinmun

title: Flood-hit People in Taechong-ri of Unpha County,
body: North Hwanghae Province Move to New Houses A model rural village under socialism was wonderfully built in Taechong-ri, Unpha County, North Hwanghae Province and people moved to new houses. The men and officers of the People's Army, bearing in mind noble view on the people of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and true to his noble intention to make devoted service for the people, turned out in the recovery campaign and wonderfully completed more than 820 dwelling houses in a little more than two months. A meeting for moving to new houses was held on the spot on Thursday. Present there were Pak Chang Ho, chairman of the North Hwanghae Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Im Hun, chairman of the provincial people's committee, officials concerned, residents in Taechong-ri, Unpha County, and soldier-builders. Pak Chang Ho made a congratulatory speech. He said that the soldiers of the KPA who always positively respond to the order of the Supreme Leader in the spirit of devotedly carrying out the instructions of the leader performed the miracle of building the wonderful rural village in a short span of time through the fierce three-dimensional speed campaign by way of finishing one at a time. He extended the warmest thanks to Kim Jong Un, reflecting the loyalty of the inhabitants in Taechong-ri and all the people across the country and service personnel. He stressed that all the officials and the agricultural workers should convey long the great loving care and solicitude bestowed on them by the great mother Party, defend socialism with rice and build our country as the paradise for the people. Licenses for use of houses were delivered. Pledge speeches were made. The speakers voiced their pledge to make the hot wind of scientific farming run high, thoroughly carry out the Party's policy on bringing about a radical turn in farming and become genuine patriotic farmers defending our Party and the revolution, always bearing deep in mind the loving care and benevolence of the Party Central Committee. The people moved to new houses amid warm congratulations by officials, working people and solider-builders. The village was full of happy laughter and songs and dances, as a line of trucks with household goods arrived. Officials of the province and officers of the units which took part in the construction visited families moving to new houses to congratulate them, give living necessities and share joy. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Reply Message to Syrian President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a reply message to Bashar Al-Assad, president of the Syrian Arab Republic, on Oct. 15. Kim Jong Un in the message expressed deep thanks to the president for sending warm felicitations and best wishes on the occasion of the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea. The message expressed the belief that the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation between the two parties and the peoples of the two countries would steadily grow stronger in the future, too. It wished the Syrian people greater success in their just struggle for defending the sovereignty of the country and territorial integrity under the leadership of the president and Syria's Baath Arab Socialist Party. Rodong Sinmun

title: Young People in DPRK Vow to Be Active in 80-Day Campaign
body: Young vanguard held a meeting at the Kim Il Sung Stadium on Friday. At the meeting they pledged to greet the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea with proud victory by dynamically waging the 80-day campaign in hearty response to the call of the great Party. Present there were officials of the Central Committee of the Youth League, officials concerned, youth and students in Pyongyang. Pak Chol Min, chairman of the Central Committee of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League, said in his report that it is the unanimous will of the young people to add glory to their honor as members of the advancing group and death-defying corps in every upswing site, holding aloft the slogan of loyalty "Let us advance vigorously towards the Eighth Party Congress by making the flames of the 80-day campaign flare up!" He stressed the need for all officials of the youth league and young people to give full play to their immense youthful enthusiasm as sons and daughters of the Workers' Party and successors to the revolution, just like their fathers and mothers who adorned their youthful days with worthy exploits, and thus defend the 8th Congress of the Party with remarkable successes. He called on all young people to perform eye-opening miracles and feats every day during the 80-day campaign with confidence in victory and greet the 8th Congress of the Party with the greatest labor achievements of the Korean youth. Speeches were made. The speakers ardently called upon all young people across the country to perform a series of new miracles and innovations through a vigorous drive for increased production and creation with a single mind of loyalty and out of patriotism in every worksite and post. Then, there took place a procession of young vanguard. Rodong Sinmun

title: Workers and Trade Union Members Vow to Turn out in 80-Day Campaign
body: Workers and members of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea (GFTUK) had a meeting at the Sangwon Cement Complex on Friday to vow to greet the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea with proud victory by dynamically waging the 80-day campaign in hearty response to the appeal of the great Party. Attending the meeting were trade union officials in Pyongyang and local areas, officials of the Sangwon Cement Complex, workers and trade union members. Ju Yong Gil, chairman of the Central Committee of the GFTUK, made a report to be followed by speeches. The reporter and speakers said that the 80-day campaign is an all-people offensive for successfully concluding the year-end struggle and significantly greeting the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea and an all-out drive accelerated by the enterprising spirit and assiduity of the workers and trade union members for bringing about greater victories. They called for consolidating the national emergency anti-epidemic barrier by strictly observing the anti-epidemic rules in any situation, bearing in mind that conceit, slackness, carelessness and indifference are the principal enemy to the emergency anti-epidemic work. They stressed the need to make tangible contributions to stabilizing the life of the inhabitants in the areas hit by natural disasters as early as possible by building all the dwelling houses and villages in those areas to be happy homes and paradise villages under socialism invulnerable to any calamity, and by waging a brisk drive for increased production and innovation in transport. They called upon all workers and trade union members across the country to greet the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea with high political enthusiasm and brilliant labor successes by fully demonstrating to the world once again the mettle of the heroic Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il working class in the 80-day campaign. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Reply Message to Vietnamese President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), sent a reply message to Nguyen Phu Trong, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam (CPV) and president of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, on Oct. 15. Kim Jong Un in the message expressed deep thanks to the general secretary for sending warm felicitations to the Party and the people of the DPRK on the occasion of the 75th founding anniversary of the WPK. The message expressed the belief that the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation between the two parties and the two countries would as ever develop ceaselessly in the spirit of the agreement made with the general secretary last year. It sincerely hoped that the Vietnamese people would make new progress in the struggle for defending the socialist cause under the leadership of the CPV led by the general secretary. It also sincerely wished the general secretary good health and greater success in his responsible work. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Seminar Held in Mongolia to Mark WPK Founding Anniversary
body: A national seminar took place in Ulan Bator, Mongolia on Oct. 7 on the occasion of the 75th anniversary of the founding of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). Attending it were political and public personages, members of organizations for friendship and solidarity with the DPRK's people and adherents of the Juche idea in Mongolia. The chairperson of the Mongolian-Korean Parliamentary Group of the State Great Hural of Mongolia made a congratulatory speech and then speeches on various subjects were made. The chairperson and the executive chairperson of the Mongolian Association for the Study of the Juche Idea-Songun Idea said that the 75 year-long history of the WPK is about the feats of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. They also referred to the guiding idea, revolutionary nature and invincibility of the WPK. The chairperson of the Mongolian Centre for the Study of Juche said that the WPK has made great progress in all fields, including politics, economy, military and culture, since its foundation by consistently adhering to the Juche-based attitude and revolutionary principle. They added that the world progressive political parties should learn from the precious historical experience of the WPK displaying the invincible might. The chairperson of the Mongolian Mt Paektu Association for Independent Development said that the preceding leaders of the two countries established and strengthened the friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries, adding that the ties are developing on good terms thanks to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. The chairperson hoped that the people of the DPRK would make great achievements in the building of a powerful socialist country under the leadership of the WPK. A message of greeting to the Supreme Leader was adopted at the seminar. Rodong Sinmun

title: Intensive Campaign Goes on to Successfully Conclude This Year’s Farming
body: Officials and agricultural workers work with might and main in the Ryongchon Plain to conclude their farming for this year during the 80-day campaign. The agricultural workers of Ryongchon and Yomju Counties and Sinuiju City adopt active measures to overcome their difficulties beforehand and vigorously push forward their immediate farm work in hand. Above all, they make responsible endeavors to operate their combined rice threshers at full capacity. Besides, they work tenaciously to thresh rice quite qualitatively before everything else. They are now achieving great results in their rice threshing day by day. Rodong Sinmun

title: Corn Harvested Full Steam
body: The flames of the 80-day campaign are kindled in Singye County, too. It organized a socialist emulation among the workteams and sub-workteams of all its cooperative farms and ensured that they made and posted the relevant large graphs respectively to show their corn harvest results in public. It reviewed the results of the farms judging from those of their individual workteams and sub-workteams. This led to stimulating their members to further efforts. Consequently, the county finished its corn harvest ahead of schedule. It is now threshing the corn. Rodong Sinmun

title: Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill Strives to Be Active in 80-Day Campaign
body: The labor and management of the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill have courageously risen in the 80-day campaign. Many weavers of the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill step up their work while steadily contriving rational itinerant and working methods. The employees of its preliminary workshop, too, work hard all the time. Suit is followed by the workers of its general spinning workshop and chemical fiber spinning combined workshop. Rodong Sinmun

title: 20-odd Thousand Tons of Materials Transported
body: The officials and workers employed in land and maritime transport have so far transported large quantities of important relief materials by water quite successfully to the flood-wrecked areas of the country from the Hungnam and Wonsan Ports for reconstruction purposes within five days since they launched the 80-day campaign. They totaled to twenty thousand and thousands of tons. The workers and management of many ports have dedicated all their wisdom and enthusiasm to loading and unloading cargo ships as soon as possible. Rodong Sinmun

title: Dwelling Frame Works Reaches Final Stage
body: The officials and men of the Division No. 2 of the Party Members of the capital city hasten to frame dwellings for the flood victims in a new area at the last stage to enable them to live happily there. They formerly reached the area from afar by rail and land and realigned it at one go-off. They have already procured the sand, gravel and rubbles needed to build dwellings. The officers and men of a municipal regiment of the division had already built dwellings before anybody else in an area of Kim Chaek City most badly damaged by flood. They have buckled down to their work again day and night in the new area. The transporters of the division, too, contribute actively to raising the speed of its construction. Its officers and men are now keeping on accelerating their housing construction dynamically hour by hour every day. Rodong Sinmun

title: Lots of Letters of Support Sent to Soldiers in Recovery Sites
body: Officers and men of the People's Army are working hard to defend the people in the recovery campaign in the areas hit by natural disasters to carry out the tasks given by the Party Central Committee. Officials, working people, youths and students across the country are sending letters to them. Soldier-builders who are waging a vigorous reconstruction campaign in the calamity-stricken areas in South Hamgyong Province and Kangwon Province including the Komdok area and Kimhwa County and in North Hamgyong Province were pleased to receive the letters of encouragement from the people. Senior Party officials of provinces in the eastern part of the country personally visited the reconstruction sites to covey the letters to the soldiers and gave pep talks to them. The soldier-builders came to realize again their mission and pride as the army of the people, reading the letters mirroring the thankful feelings of the people. The letters represented the gratitude of the people in the calamity-stricken areas toward the solder-builders who are building their dwelling houses, and respect and thankfulness of schoolchildren for the soldier-builders who are building schools and providing new school things. The letters full of the paternal and fraternal feelings added to revolutionary enthusiasm and morale of the soldier-builders. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Premier Inspects Industrial Establishments
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected the Jenam Coal Mine, the Namdok Youth Coal Mine and the construction site of dwelling houses for the employees of the feed supply farm under the Kwangchon Chicken Farm. The colliers of the Jenam Coal Mine and the Namdok Youth Coal Mine are further flaring up the flames of increased production in hearty response to the militant call of the Party upon the whole Party, the whole country and the entire people to vigorously conduct the 80-day campaign and brilliantly greeting the Eighth Congress of the Party. Inspecting various production processes of the coal mines, Kim Tok Hun urged the officials to raise the carriage capacity as required by increased coal production, technically manage equipment as specified in relevant rules and put efforts into the supply work for bettering the livelihood of colliers. Going round the construction site of dwelling houses, he urged the units involved in the project to ensure quality in the building of every structure, as required by designs and construction methods. He also underlined the need to step up land readjustment, road pavement and river improvement. The field consultative meetings urged officials to find themselves among the workers to solve their problems in time. They stressed the need for the coal mines to speed up capital tunneling and preparatory tunneling in order to secure reserve cutting face. They also discussed practical matters for completing the construction of dwelling houses as early as possible. The premier also went round the Pukchang Thermal Power Complex and the February 8 Jikdong Youth Coal Mine. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Birthday Spread to Centenarian
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un sent a birthday spread to Ha Ryong Nam living in the township of Onsong County, North Hamgyong Province on his 100th birthday. He, born into a poor slash-and-burn peasant's family before the liberation of the country, keenly experienced how miserable a stateless nation's destiny is, being subject to all sorts of humiliation and insult. Only after President Kim Il Sung liberated the country, he was granted land, his long-cherished desire. He then devoted himself to farming. He bravely fought in the People's Army during the Fatherland Liberation War. In the post-war period he worked hard as a stockbreeder for decades. During those days he was honored to receive citation of the President. Saying that our socialist system is the best in the world as it gave birth to a large harmonious family where everyone helps each other, he requests his children to do more jobs for the good of the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Reply Message to Raul Castro Ruz
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), sent a reply message to Raul Castro Ruz, first secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba, on Oct. 15. Kim Jong Un in the message expressed deep thanks to the first secretary for sending warm felicitations on the occasion of the 75th founding anniversary of the WPK. The message expressed the belief that the comradely and fraternal relations of friendship and cooperation between the two parties would steadily develop in the common struggle for accomplishing the socialist cause in the future, too. It sincerely wished the first secretary good health and greater success in his noble work for leading the Communist Party of Cuba and its people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Construction Projects Accelerated
body: The officers and men of the 3rd Regiment of the Brigade of Ministries and National Institutions of Division 216 energetically build dwellings in their charge by various methods. The companies of the Bureau for Affairs with Diplomatic Corps, the Unha Trade Bureau, the Public Service Management Bureau and the General Bureau for Pleasure Parks and many other ones originate and apply novel building methods so as to carry out their work assignments to excess. Rodong Sinmun

title: Success Registered in Dwelling Frame Works
body: Assigned to build another houses of several stories the officers and men of the Division No. 1 of the Party Members of the capital city finished rezoning their sites and their surroundings as well and concreting the ground for their foundations. They proceed to frame them at present. Although they have difficulty in transporting materials and building dwellings those of the battalions of Sunan and Taesong districts actively apply rational working methods to their projects and speed up their construction. Those of the battalions of Sadong and Rangnang districts overtake and learn from others and exchange experiences with them. They ensure the quality and speed of the construction of their dwellings simultaneously on the principle of taking the responsibility for the safety of the projects and guaranteeing their absolute quality for eternity. Those of the battalions of Phyongchon and Taedonggang districts work only according to the program for the order and processes of their building operations. Those of the battalions of Mangyongdae and Ryokpho districts, too, work with all their might to build good dwellings for the flood sufferers as soon as possible. Rodong Sinmun

title: Project Assignments Overfulfilled Day after Day
body: The servicemen of the Korean People’s Army units have roused themselves to carry out at all costs the highly important tasks set forth by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un during his firsthand guidance in the flood-wrecked Komdok area under reconstruction. They overfulfill their daily work plan. They finished placing windows in the walls of multi-storied dwellings in Sao-dong, Tanchon City. They proceed to plaster their interior with mortar with speed. Furthermore, they cover the interior of dwellings with plaster, install a heating system there and realign their surroundings in Sonkwang-dong, Tanchon City at a final phase. The soldiers of a KPA unit finished plastering the exterior of more than ten houses of several stories and building insulation walls close by their inside walls around the Ryongyang Mine within a few days.
