They cover their interior with plaster, build waterworks for them and install a heating system there, thus overfulfilling their daily work assignments. The servicemen of another KPA units work hard like new mysteries. Firmly determined to honor the forthcoming 8th Congress of the Workers’ Party of Korea with the fruits of their loyalty the soldiers of the KPA units do their utmost to recover the flood damage of the Komdok area. Rodong Sinmun

title: People Move to New Houses in Hongwon County, South Hamgyong Province
body: People in Unpho and Kyongpho workers' districts in Hongwon County, South Hamgyong Province on the eastern coast of the country moved to dwelling houses built thanks to the struggle of members of the division of the elite Party members from the capital city. The core Party members from the capital built new houses in damaged areas in Hongwon County in a short period of time. A ceremony for moving to new houses took place in Unpho workers' district on Sunday. Present there were Commander of the Division No.1 of Party Members of the Capital City Choe Hwi, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK); Commissar Ri Yong Sik, first vice director of the Information and Publicity Department of the WPK Central Committee; Ri Jong Nam, chairman of the South Hamgyong Provincial Committee of the WPK, officials concerned, commanding officials and members of the Division No. 1 of Party members of the Capital City, officials and working people in Hongwon County, and people in damaged areas. Ri Jong Nam delivered a congratulatory speech at the ceremony. He warmly congratulated the people in the damaged areas on having moved to new houses under the care of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. He said that no people in the world are as happy as the Korean people who are holding the Supreme Leader as the father. Licenses for the use of the houses were conveyed amid the applauses and cheers of the participants. Then people moved to new houses. The new villages were lively with the people as they moved to new houses amid congratulations from the officials and builders and as they danced full of happiness in great excitement with gratitude for the Workers' Party of Korea. The commanding officials of the division of the Party members from the capital city and officials of the province visited the new houses and shared joy with owners of modern houses with full provision of living conditions. Rodong Sinmun

title: Gathering Held by Agricultural Workers
body: Agricultural workers and members of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea (UAWK) held an oath-taking gathering in Kangbuk-ri of Kumchon County, North Hwanghae Province on Sunday where they vowed to greet the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea with proud victory by going all out in the 80-day campaign in response to the call of the great Party. Kim Chang Yop, chairman of the Central Committee of the UAWK, made a report to be followed by speeches. The reporter and speakers stressed that the ongoing 80-day campaign is an all-people offensive aimed at successfully concluding this significant year-end struggle and greeting the 8th Congress of the WPK more significantly by steadily raising the revolutionary fighting spirit which has become unusually high with the 75th founding anniversary of the WPK as an occasion. They referred to the fact that Kangbuk-ri hit by floods has turned into a paradise and more wonderful houses for the people are being built at present thanks to the wise leadership of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. They called on all agricultural workers and union members to follow the Party to the end of the earth. They stressed the need to further raise the massive anti-epidemic atmosphere and the all-people voluntary unity with maximum awareness and thus consolidate the anti-epidemic situation. They underscored the need to harvest all crops without any waste and devotedly defend the 8th Congress of the WPK by responsibly wrapping up this year's farming including threshing. They ardently appealed to all the agricultural workers and union members across the country to wrap up farming and to raise fierce flames of a socialist emulation for making preparations for the next year's farming in the spirit displayed for the splendid celebration of the 75th founding anniversary of the glorious WPK. Rodong Sinmun

title: Korean Women Vow to Turn out in 80-Day Campaign
body: Officials and members of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea (SWUK) met at the plaza of the Arch of Triumph on Sunday to vow to greet the Eighth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) with proud victory by dynamically waging the 80-day Campaign in hearty response to the appeal of the great Party. At the meeting Jang Chun Sil, chairwoman of the SWUK Central Committee, made a report to be followed by speeches. The reporter and speakers said the 80-day Campaign unprecedented in history is being conducted for safety of the people and the stability of their life by the noble intention of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. They noted that now is the time for the Korean women who dynamically push one of the two wheels of the revolutionary chariot to fully display their indomitable mental power in the gigantic 80-day campaign unfolded by the WPK to bring about new victory and miracle with a resolute continuous offensive. They stressed that all the members of the women's union should fulfill their responsibility and duties in the on-going 80-day campaign for glorifying the Eight Congress of the Party as the one of victory and honor. They stressed the need to thoroughly implement all anti-epidemic measures taken by the state and stand at the front for preventing the inroads of COVID-19. They underlined the need to dynamically conduct activities of women's union shock brigade for contributing to build new houses of fairyland by regarding the rehabilitation work as a responsible militant task. They stressed the need to demonstrate the strong spirit and might of the Korean women in the 80-day campaign true to the Party's call and devotedly defend the Eighth Congress of the WPK. At the end of the meeting members of the women's union in the City of Pyongyang conducted revolutionary and militant agitation activities to rev up the atmosphere of the city. Rodong Sinmun

title: International Online Seminar Hosted in Indonesia
body: An international online seminar was co-sponsored in Jakarta, Indonesia in the period between September 25 and October 5 by the Organizing Committee of the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu and the Indonesia-Korea Association for Friendship and Cultural Exchange on the occasion of the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). Video clips showing the revolutionary activities of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un were posted on the website opened for the successful seminar. Also posted on it were works of the peerlessly great men, photos, video clips and books dealing with the successes achieved by the Korean people in socialist construction. It carried over 110 written speeches, poems and songs sent by public personages of at least 60 countries to revere the peerlessly great men. Speakers in the seminar lauded the glorious WPK for leading the Korean people to advance along the road of independence and socialism without deflection under the uplifted banner of the Juche idea. A letter to Kim Jong Un was adopted at the seminar. Rodong Sinmun

title: Farms in Ryanggang Province Finish Potato Harvest
body: Farms in Ryanggang Province have finished potato harvest. Agricultural officials and workers in the province made a bumper potato harvest despite unfavorable climatic conditions. Organizational and political activities were brisk in the province to make officials and agricultural workers turn out as one in the urgent farm works. The Junghung Farm and others in Samjiyon City waged a socialist emulation among its workteams and sub-workteams and reviewed it in a substantial manner so that farmers fulfilled their daily quotas for potato harvest without fail. Farms in Taehongdan and Paekam counties minimized the decrease of yield by finishing harvest on the typhoon-hit fields first through rational manpower allocation. The province has set a transport timetable to send potatoes quickly to the Samjiyon Potato Farina Production Factory and the Taehongdan County Potato-processing Factory. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Letter from Participants in Internet Seminar
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a letter in the joint name of the co-chairmen of the Organizing Committee of the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu on Oct. 5 on behalf of the participants in the international online seminar. The co-chairmen are Peter Woods, co-chairman of the Asia-Pacific Regional Committee for Supporting Peaceful Reunification of Korea, Rachmawati Soekarnoputri, chairwoman of the Founding Committee of the Soekarno Foundation for Education in Indonesia, Damian Ogbonna, chairman of the African Regional Committee for Friendship and Solidarity with the Korean People, Yehia Zakaria Khairullah, co-chairman of the Arab Regional Committee for Friendship and Solidarity with the Korean People, Jesus Antonio Carlos Hernandez, first vice-chairman of the Latin American and Caribbean Regional Committee to Support the Reunification of Korea, Victor Petrov, chairman of the Russian Association for Friendship and Cultural Cooperation with the DPRK, Anders Kristensen, chairman of the Denmark-DPRK Friendship Association, and Fumihiro Himori, chairman of the Japan Committee for Supporting the Independent and Peaceful Reunification of Korea. The letter said that Korean-style socialism is victoriously advancing along the road of independence under the guidance of Kim Jong Un, adding that it gives great encouragement to the people of the countries struggling to build a new society. It said that the world people were deeply moved by Kim Jong Un inspecting reconstruction sites repeatedly to guide recovery campaigns for ridding the calamity-stricken people of their misfortune and sufferings as soon as possible. It said that the world progressives are immensely revering and highly praising Kim Jong Un for his adoration of the people, unique independent politics and matchless diplomatic caliber. In the letter the participants evinced their will to positively support the struggle of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) for independent development of the country and global peace and prosperity in the future, too. It also expressed conviction that the forthcoming Eighth Congress of the WPK would be a historic one for hastening the victory in the building of a powerful socialist country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Youth Open-air Theatre Built Anew in South Phyongan Province
body: A youth open-air theater with a seating capacity of 5,000 people was built admirably in South Phyongan Province. It consists of a 3-storied building, a stage, an auditorium, etc. The building has rooms of various kinds like an accordionists room, a guitarists room, dancers room and table-tennis players room. They will help toward raising the artistic skills and sports techniques of young people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Rice Threshing Progresses Full Steam
body: The Wollyong Cooperative Farm in Yonthan County fulfills its rice threshing plan 1.2 times. It ensures that its threshers and transporters of various kinds are operated to the maximum and that all its rice is carried in sheaves and threshed. Rodong Sinmun

title: Determined to Hit Grain Production Target without Fail
body: The cooperative farms of North Phyongan Province vigorously push ahead with their cereal threshing. NPP maximizes the operation rate of its travelling threshers. It also ensures that sheaves of rice are carried to threshing grounds in plenty on a priority basis and that rice is threshed ceaselessly without so much as losing even a grain of it. Rodong Sinmun

title: With the Mind of Building Their Own Native Homes
body: The officers and men of many KPA units accelerate the construction of dwellings around the Muhak Branch of the Taehung Youth Hero Mine in the flood-wrecked Komdok area. They are near completion. They devote their whole hearts to the dwellings so that they can be super. Thanks to them, the dwellings are transformed into smart ones hour by hour. Rodong Sinmun

title: Dwelling Construction Sped up in Tanchon City
body: The servicemen of many KPA units plastered the exterior of multi-storied dwellings with cement mortar in Sao-dong, Tanchon City, installed window frames in them, paved roads with concrete for hundreds of meters, flanked them with lawn on both sides, set up a storm sewerage system and made fences. They are now making preparations for blanketing thousands of square meters of sidewalks with paving blocks. Rodong Sinmun

title: Successes in Dwelling Construction on Steady Increase
body: The soldiers of the KPA units are all-out to promptly build dwellings for hundreds of families at the last stage in the flood-stricken areas of Orang County, North Hamgyong Province. Preferentially transporting building materials to their construction sites with their motor vehicles they steadily speed up their building projects. Rodong Sinmun

title: Letters of Support Sent to KPA Soldiers at Reconstruction Sites
body: Today all the people of the country are greatly interested in and inspired with infinite strength by the news from its flood-ridden areas under reconstruction. Some time ago Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un reportedly visited the flood-wrecked Komdok area and the flood-hit areas of South Hamgyong Province under reconstruction and expressed his great satisfaction at the successes registered by the servicemen of the Korean People’s Army units in their building operations. The people have addressed letters to them from all parts of the country to congratulate them on the successes and inspire them to further efforts. According to an official of the Central Committee of the Socialist Women’s Union of Korea, the day they were informed that Kim Jong Un visited the above areas for firsthand guidance the citizens of Pyongyang had already written more than 50,000 letters to the KPA soldiers who rebuild them and other flood-torn areas of the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Those Who Fulfilled Three-, Two- or One-year Production Plans Increase in Number
body: Fulfillers of their work plans grow in number at the producers affiliated with the Textile Industry Department of the Ministry of Light Industry. Till October 16, 5 workers of the textile mills across the country fulfilled their work plans for three years, over 80 ones of them their work plans for two years and nearly 1,000 ones of them their yearly work plans. Rodong Sinmun

title: Daily Power Generation Plan Overfulfilled
body: The officials, workers and technicians of the Pyongyang Thermal Power Complex fulfill the plan for their electricity production more than 1.3 times every day. The officials of its 1st and 2nd Workshops for Thermal Production direct their production in detail respectively. In the meantime, they actively apply valuable successes in their technological innovations to the normal operation of their boilers so as to increase the output of their steam. The workers of the Turbine and Electricity workshops of the PTPC carefully check up their machines and cure defects in them opportunely, thus operating them at full capacity. Dynamos and other equipment, too, are splendidly examined and maintained at the PTPC. Its Coal-conveying, Self-reliance and Engineering workshops and many other units contribute to producing electricity at their complex by turning out in good time the accessories and materials needed to operate its generation equipment on a normal footing. Rodong Sinmun

title: Socialist Emulation Brisk in Farms across the Country
body: The Central Committee of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea organizes and conducts a socialist emulation for the 80-day campaign substantially. The Pyongyang Municipal Committee of the UAWK, the Committee of North Phyongan Province of the UAWK, the Kwaksan Committee of the UAWK and many other provincial and county committees of the UAWK widely generalize the models set by and experiences acquired by exemplary agricultural workers in harvesting and threshing rice. Besides, they work briskly to ensure that agricultural workers overtake and outstrip each other, learn from each other and exchange experiences with each other. The Committee of South Hwanghae Province of the UAWK organizes a socialist emulation in detail in order to put all its tractors and threshers in operation for them to harvest and thresh cereals with and for other farm work to be done under a well-knit system. The organizations of the UAWK of North Hwanghae Province and other provinces, too, cogently review the interim results of the socialist emulation for harvesting and threshing cereals and thereby heighten an atmosphere of the emulation. Rodong Sinmun

title: Reservoir Construction Nears Completion
body: Thanks to the officials and workers of North Phyongan Province the construction of the Tongraegang Reservoir nears completion. The completion of the reservoir will afford a guarantee for safely raising rice plants in thousands of hectares of reclaimed tideland. A few days ago the main dike for the reservoir was successfully covered with earth. Dykes 12,000 square meters wide are coated with large stones, the breast walls of drainage canals built and other building operation done according to the plan on and off the reservoir. In addition, energetic arrangements are also made for the construction of waterway far more than 10,000 meters in length. Rodong Sinmun

title: Reconstruction Makes Headway in Komdok Area
body: The servicemen of the Korean People’s Amy units set new standards and records of housing construction day by day in the flood-wrecked Komdok area under reconstruction. They finished building dwellings in their charge in the area. They then proceed to erect other buildings and overfulfill their work assignments considerably every day. The soldiers of the KPA units build dwellings superbly around the Taehung Young Hero Mine and in Sao-dong, Tanchon City at the last stage. The servicemen of many KPA units, too, work hard with all speed to build roads and bridges and improve river conditions in the Komdok area. Rodong Sinmun

title: Further Achievements Made in Dwelling Construction
body: The officers and men of the Division No. 1 of the Party Members of the capital city finished concreting the ground for the foundations of dwellings of several stories in a short time. They are now working hard to frame them. They channel their energies into road administration first thing and transport materials satisfactorily despite their adversities. The officers and men of the Division No. 2 of the Party Members of the capital city, too, vigorously speed up the construction of dwellings in their charge in flood-hit areas helping and leading each other forward to build them well at the earliest date possible. They thoroughly meet the demand of plans and building methods for their dwellings in all their construction projects. Rodong Sinmun

title: Daily Assignments of 80-Day Campaign Overfulfilled
body: The workers and management of the Pukchang Area Youth Coal Mining Complex strive energetically to increase their coal production. Since the outset of the 80-day campaign the PAYCMC has increased its daily coal output without cease. On October 16 it hit its high daily coal production target by 122%. The Namdok Youth Coal Mine has a large share in the coal production of the PAYCMC. Its miners stand in the van of the PAYCMC. The officials and miners of the Inpho, Hoean, Songnam and Phunggok Youth Coal Mines try their hardest to produce more coal than usual despite their bad working conditions and overlapping difficulties while going all-out to overtake and outstrip others, learn from them and exchange experiences with each other. Rodong Sinmun

title: 80-Day Campaign Active in Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex
body: The workers of the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex have bestirred themselves to attain greater successes than before in their work the way they did their utmost to honor the 75th birthday of the Workers’ Party of Korea with their products. The officials and smelters of the HISC produce molten iron and steel in succession through tight connections between processes and mutual assistance between shifts. The officials of the HISC join its workers to turn out heavy rails and install a gigantic air separator on the spot. They also lead them in unraveling knotty problems then and there whenever they crop up in the course of their work and thus making a breakthrough in their production. Rodong Sinmun

title: Time Flows amid Loyal Offensive
body: The men of the Divisions of the Party Members of the capital city do themselves full justice before anybody else in rebuilding the flood-wrecked areas of North and South Hamgyong provinces, thus adding a brilliant page to the 80-day campaign. The party members of the February 8 Vinalon Complex, the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex and the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex lead others in moving the structure of their chemical industry on to a Juche and modern footing and rebuilding themselves apiece into an economizer in energy and labor, a protector of the environment, a technology-intensive entity and a developer-creator. The Party members of many realms of the national economy, including the electric-power, coal-mining and machine-building industries, also work with all their might courageously to score remarkable successes in the 80-day campaign. The Party members of the agricultural sector of the nation, including the Chongsan Cooperative Farm of Kangso District and the Sinam Cooperative Farm of Ryongchon County, set to in the fields at dawn harvesting cereal crops without so much as wasting them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Reply Message to Xi Jinping
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), sent a reply message to Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC), on October 19. Kim Jong Un in his message extended heartfelt thanks to the general secretary on behalf of the WPK and all the Korean people and on his own behalf for sending warm congratulations and best wishes on the occasion of the 75th founding anniversary of the WPK. He said that the hearty congratulations from the general secretary and the party and people of China added to the joy of the members of the WPK and the Korean people who greeted the significant Party founding day, and are positively encouraging them to the struggle towards the 8th Congress of the Party. He noted that the lives and safety of the peoples are being reliably defended and the socialist construction being vigorously pushed ahead with in the DPRK and China despite the complicated international situation and serious world public health crisis thanks to the firm guidance of the WPK and the CPC which regard the people as the dearest. He said that he would make positive efforts together with the general secretary to further consolidate and develop the traditional DPRK-China friendly relations, which have entered a fresh and vigorous stage as required by the era, and dynamically advance socialism, the core of the DPRK-China friendship,. He expressed the conviction that the Chinese people would win a fresh victory in their struggle for comprehensively building a modernized socialist state under the leadership of the CPC with the general secretary as its core. He sincerely wished the general secretary good health and bigger success in his responsible work. Rodong Sinmun

title: Apple and Pear Show Held
body: An apple and pear show took place here on Oct. 20. Displayed in the show were apples and pears of good species produced in fruit farms in Kwail and Pukchong counties, the Kosan Combined Fruit Farm, the Taedonggang Combined Fruit Farm and others in the country. Officials and working people of the farms made a good harvest this year despite unfavorable climatic conditions by taking scientific and technological care of fruit trees. The jury consisted of ordinary people. They tasted apples and pears on display and appreciated their sweetness, sourness, wetness, aroma and solidness. Rodong Sinmun

title: Foreign Figures Visit DPRK Missions
body: Foreign figures paid a congratulatory visit to the DPRK missions in their countries from Oct. 8 to 11 on the occasion of the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). They laid floral baskets and bouquets before the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and art works depicting the peerlessly great men standing together and bowed to them. They include the chairman of the National Democratic Party of Mongolia, the chairman of the Mongolia-Korea Friendship Society, the chairman of the Mongolian Mt Paektu Association for Independent Development, the chairman and the executive chairman of the Mongolian Association for the Study of the Juche Idea-Songun Idea, the chairman of the Mongolian Centre for the Study of Juche, the president of the J. Sambuu Herders Development Fund of Mongolia, the general secretary of the Socialist Unionist Party of Syria, the president and vice-chairman of the Syrian Trade Unions Federation, the director of the Central Secretariat of the Pakistan People's Party, the chairman of the Nigeria-Korea Friendship Association who doubles as the member of the Credit Committee of the People's Democratic Party of Nigeria, the chairman of the Nigerian National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, the chairman of the Anti-Imperialist Forum of Germany and other foreign personages. Meanwhile the chairwoman of the Union of Democratic Women in Senegal who doubles as the vice-chairwoman of the Parliament, and the vice-chairman of the Socialist Freedom Party of Egypt, also visited the DPRK missions in their countries. The co-chairman of the Board of Directors of the Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation, the director general of the International Institute of the Juche Idea, the national leader of the Workers' Party of Mexico, the general secretary of the Central Committee of the People's Socialist Party of Mexico and the minister of communication and technology of Syria sent floral baskets to the DPRK missions in their countries. Rodong Sinmun

title: Application of Program for Free Education and
body: Upbringing of Children Demanded in Japan Street agitation activities demanding the application of program for free education and upbringing of children to the kindergartens of Korean schools were carried out in Hokkaido, Japan on Oct. 3 under the sponsorship of the Hokkaido Prefectural Headquarters under the Korean Youth League in Japan. Participated in the activities were youth league members under the headquarters, parents of students, and Japanese personages belonging to the society for supporting Korean schools in Hokkaido. The participants disclosed the injustice of the Japanese authorities' discrimination against Korean schools, holding literatures calling for the application of program for free education and upbringing of children to the kindergartens of Korean schools. They said that they would continue to stage the struggle for the just right to national education to condemn Japan's undisguised discrimination against Korean schools. From last year, youth league members and Koreans in Hokkaido have waged various dynamic struggles for defending the right to national education against the Japanese government's unreasonable exclusion of Korean kindergartners at Korean schools from the application of program. Rodong Sinmun

title: Kim Jong Un Visits Cemetery of CPV Martyrs
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, visited the cemetery of the martyrs of the Chinese People's Volunteers (CPV) in Hoechang County, South Phyongan Province, and paid a high tribute to them on the occasion of the 70th anniversary of the entry of the Chinese People's Volunteers into the Korean front. Present there were Choe Ryong Hae, Ri Pyong Chol and Kim Tok Hun, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, and Pak Jong Chon, Kim Jae Ryong, Ri Il Hwan and Kim Hyong Jun who are the members of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK. Also present there were Foreign Minister Ri Son Gwon, Admiral Kim Myong Sik and Air Force General Kim Kwang Hyok, Ri Yong Chol, chairman of the Hoechang County Party committee, and Kim In Chol, chairman of the Hoechang County People's Committee. The guard of honor of the Korean People's Army (KPA) lined up at the Cemetery of the Martyrs of the Chinese People's Volunteers. As Kim Jong Un arrived before the monument to the CPV martyrs with the officials of the Party, the government and the military, the national anthems of the two countries were solemnly played. Amid the playing of the wreath-laying music, a floral basket in the name of the Supreme Leader of our Party, state and armed forces and floral baskets in the names of the Central Committee of the WPK, the Central Military Commission of the WPK, the DPRK State Affairs Commission, the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, the Cabinet of the DPRK and the Korean People's Army were laid at the monument to the CPV martyrs. Written on the ribbons of the floral baskets were letters "Martyrs of the Chinese People's Volunteers will Be Immortal". Kim Jong Un paid a silent tribute in memory of the CPV martyrs. Then, he visited the grave of Mao Anying in the cemetery. A floral basket in the name of Kim Jong Un was placed before the grave of Mao Anying. Written on the ribbon of the floral basket were letters "To Martyr Mao Anying!" He paid a tribute to Mao Anying. He made a round of the cemetery together with leading officials of the Party, state and armed forces. He said with deep emotion that even though 70 years have passed since the excellent sons and daughters of the fraternal Chinese people made an entry into the sacred Fatherland Liberation War fought by the Korean people, the immortal exploits and heroic feats made by the CPV by sacrificially supporting us under the banner of resisting America and aiding Korea, safeguarding the home and defending the motherland despite the very difficult situation remain vividly in the memory of our people. Saying that the entry of the CPV into the Korean front was a historic contribution to the great victory in the Fatherland Liberation War, he noted that the great victory won by the armies and peoples of the DPRK and China while linking their destiny as one and sharing weal and woe with each other is, indeed, of great significance no matter how much water flows under the bridge. Saying that every part of our country is closely associated with the red blood shed by the service personnel of the Chinese People's Volunteers who bravely fought in the sacred war against the imperialist aggressors, not being afraid of death, and dedicating their invaluable youth and lives to it, he stressed that our Party, government and people would never forget their noble soul and lofty self-sacrificing spirit forever. Political News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Floral Basket to Friendship Tower
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, sent a floral basket to the Friendship Tower on Oct. 21, on the occasion of the 70th anniversary of the entry of the Chinese People's Volunteers (CPV) into the Korean front. The guard of honor of the Korean People's Army (KPA) lined up at the tower. The national anthems of the People's Republic of China and the DPRK were played. A floral basket bearing the august name of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was laid at the tower. Written on the ribbon of the floral basket were letters "The Martyrs of the Chinese People's Volunteers Will Be Immortal". Placed at the tower were floral baskets in the names of the WPK Central Committee, the WPK Central Military Commission, the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, the Cabinet of the DPRK and the KPA. Present at the ceremony was Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the WPK Central Committee. Kim Su Gil, Thae Hyong Chol, Ri Ryong Nam and Kim Yong Hwan, members of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, Ri Chang Gun, vice department director of the WPK Central Committee, Pak Myong Ho, vice minister of Foreign Affairs, and Pak Kyong Il, vice-chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries who doubles as the chairman of the DPRK-China Friendship Association, were on hand. The participants paid a silent tribute to the martyrs of the Chinese People's Volunteers, who became true role models in displaying noble internationalism and fraternal friendship by dedicating their invaluable lives, and looked round the tower. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Baskets from PRC to Cemetery of CPV Martyrs
body: The People's Republic of China (PRC) sent floral baskets to the cemetery of the martyrs of the Chinese People's Volunteers (CPV) in Hoechang County, South Phyongan Province on the occasion of the 70th anniversary of the entry of the CPV into the Korean front. A ceremony for laying the floral baskets took place on Oct. 21. It was attended by Li Jinjun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK, his embassy members, Chinese guests staying here and Chinese residents in the DPRK. The guard of honor of the Korean People's Army lined up at the cemetery. The national anthems of the PRC and the DPRK were played. A floral basket sent by Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC), president of the People's Republic of China (PRC) and chairman of the Central Military Commission of the PRC, was placed at the monument to the martyrs of the CPV. Written on the ribbon of the floral basket were letters "The Martyrs of the Chinese People's Volunteers Will Be Immortal". Placed before the monument were floral baskets in the names of the CPC Central Committee, the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress of the PRC, the State Council of the PRC and the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, a floral basket in the joint name of the Central Military Commission of the CPC and the Central Military Commission of the PRC, and a floral basket in the names of bereaved families of the martyrs of the volunteer army for resisting America and aiding Korea, veterans and elder comrades and Chinese people from all walks of life. The participants paid silent tribute in memory of the martyrs of the CPV who dedicated their lives to the sacred war against the imperialists' armed invasion under the banner of resisting America and aiding Korea, safeguarding the home and defending the motherland, and laid flowers and made a bow before the grave of Mao Anying. Then, they looked round the cemetery. Rodong Sinmun

title: PRC Sends Floral Baskets to Friendship Tower
body: The People's Republic of China (PRC) sent floral baskets to the Friendship Tower on the occasion of the 70th anniversary of the entry of the Chinese People's Volunteers into the Korean front. A ceremony for laying floral baskets took place on Oct. 21. It was attended by Li Jinjun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK, his embassy officials, Chinese guests staying here and Chinese residents in the DPRK. The guard of honor of the KPA lined up at the tower. The national anthems of the PRC and the DPRK were played. A floral basket sent by Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC), president of the PRC and chairman of the Central Military Commission of the PRC, was laid at the tower. Written on the ribbon of the floral basket were letters "The Martyrs of the Chinese People's Volunteers Will Be Immortal". Placed before the tower were floral baskets in the names of the Central Committee of the CPC, the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress of the PRC, the State Council of the PRC and the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, a floral basket in the joint name of the Central Military Commission of the CPC and the Central Military Commission of the PRC, and a floral basket in the names of bereaved families of the martyrs of the volunteer army for resisting American and aiding Korea, veterans and elder comrades and people from all walks of life. The participants paid silent tribute to the martyrs of the Chinese People's Volunteers, and looked round the tower. Rodong Sinmun

title: The Way They Finished Framework of Multistory Dwellings
body: The soldiers of a KPA unit register successes in building multi-storied houses in the flood-ridden township of Hochon County, South Hamgyong Province. They finished framing the houses in a short time after they launched their 80-day campaign. They are now all-out to roof them and cover their interior and exterior with plaster swiftly. Rodong Sinmun

title: Dwelling Construction Nears Completion
body: For recent three days the servicemen of a Korean People’s Army unit finished installing electric wires in the 15 dwellings of several stories they built around the Ryongyang Mine and providing them with underfloor heating. They then proceeded to focus their efforts on plastering their interior and exterior with cement mortar. Consequently, they have become fully able to complete them till the end of this month. By dint of their devoted work the servicemen will finish the dwellings successfully in no time. Rodong Sinmun

title: Fertilizer Production Makes Progress
body: Within ten days of their 80-day campaign the labor and management of the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex topped their relevant fertilizer production plan by 150%. The HFC is now going all-out to turn out much more fertilizer than ever. Rodong Sinmun

title: Successive Innovations Made in Major Materials Transport Day after Day
body: The officials and workers of our railway sector topped their cargo transport assignments by 102% on a daily average. They transported even more major freight than before to the flood-wrecked areas of the country under reconstruction within ten days of their 80-day campaign. In addition, they transported great quantities of materials to metalworking factories in excess of their plan. They proceed to carry lots of freight to many domains of the national economy day after day. Rodong Sinmun

title: Coal Industrial Field Activated
body: Within ten days of its 80-day campaign the Ministry of Coal Industry hit its relevant coal production target by 102%. The coal-mining complexes and coal mines across the nation give definite priority to their tunneling, strive hard to procure lots of coalfields and concentrate all their efforts on pit faces with ample deposits and favorable mining conditions. This finally leads to an increase in their coal output. Rodong Sinmun

title: Electric-power Production Increases
body: Within ten days of their 80-day campaign the workers and management of thermal power stations topped their relevant electricity production plans by 110%. The Pukchang and Pyongyang Thermal Power Complexes and the Sunchon, Chongchongang and East Pyongyang Thermal Power Stations do all they can to produce electricity. Many hydropower stations, too, operate all their machines at full capacity. Hydropower stations like the Hochongang, Suphung, Jangjingang, Pujongang and Huichon Power Stations control their water and run their machines along scientific lines and check up and maintain them on a normal basis so as to bring about an upswing in their production. Rodong Sinmun

title: Pig Iron and Steel Production Goals Attained
body: The ironworks and steelworks across the country have topped their production targets for pig and steel every day from the outset of its 80-day campaign. The workers of the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex, Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex and the Chollima Steel Complex have achieved tangible results in their production by dint of hard work. The related producers throughout the country do their parts creditably to help toward the production of the complexes. The officials and workers of the Hungnam Terminal Factory have made a breakthrough in boosting the output of its terminals with science and technology. They fully exert themselves to turn them out. The Unryul and Jaeryong mines and other ore mines carry out their daily production assignments without fail in spite of their difficulties. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Floral Baskets to Cemetery of Martyrs and Monument to Resisting America and Aiding Korea
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, sent floral baskets to the cemetery of the martyrs fallen in resisting America and aiding Korea in Shenyang City, Liaoning Province, China and the monument to resisting America and aiding Korea in Dandong City on the occasion of the 70th anniversary of the entry of the Chinese People's Volunteers into the Korean front. Ceremonies for laying floral baskets took place on Oct. 22. The guard of honor of the Chinese People's Liberation Army lined up at the cemetery and the monument. The national anthems of the DPRK and the People's Republic of China were played. Floral baskets bearing the august name of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un were laid at the monument of the cemetery and the monument. Written on the ribbons of the floral baskets were letters "Martyrs of the Chinese People's Volunteers Will Be Immortal". Present there were the DPRK ambassador to China and staff members of the DPRK missions, officials of the DPRK working in China and officials concerned of the International Liaison Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, Liaoning Province, Shenyang and Dandong cities. The participants paid silent tribute to the martyrs of the Chinese People's Volunteers, and looked round the cemetery and the monument. Rodong Sinmun

title: 45-ton Crane for Container Newly Manufactured in DPRK
body: Officials, technicians and workers of the Ministry of Land and Maritime Transport and the Nampho Port newly manufactured and installed a 45-ton crane for container in our own way and successfully made its trial run. The home-made gantry crane increased the port's container-lifting capacity 1.2 times more than before and made stevedoring easier. This valuable success conducive to the development of marine transportation of the country is a proud fruition of the patriotic devotion made by the Korean working class with the spirit of self-development, who are breaking through head-on all difficulties and bottlenecks, regarding implementation of the Party policy as a lifeline. Rodong Sinmun

title: One and the Same Request Reflected in Various Stories
body: The officers and men of the divisions of the most seasoned Party members of the capital city received thousands of letters from Pyongyang. The letters vary from each other in content, but all their addressers have earnestly appealed to their addressees in them to recover the flood damages of the areas in their charge at the earliest date possible true to the intentions of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and reunite in Pyongyang honorably. Rodong Sinmun

title: The Dwellings of Several Stories Framed, Etc
body: The officers and men of the Division No. 1 of the Party Members of the capital city finished framing all dwellings of several stories in their charge till October 21. All the battalions of the Division No. 1 are now roofing the dwellings and plastering their interior and exterior with cement mortar at the same time. Rodong Sinmun

title: Irrigation Structures Built in Tideland
body: The April 22 Land Realignment Shock Brigade and the General Tideland Reclamation Enterprise of South Hwanghae Province swiftly build irrigation structures in the tideland dyked from a seashore to the Ryongmae Island and back. The officials and men of the shock brigade realigned more than 130 hectares of land for ten days after the 80-day campaign began. In step with this the officials and workers of the General Tideland Reclamation Enterprise of South Hwanghae Province make great daily successes in building field lanes and irrigation structures and realigning ridges between rice paddies. Rodong Sinmun

title: Commemorating Meeting Held in China
body: Commemorating meetings were held in China on the occasion of the 70th anniversary of the entry of the Chinese People's Volunteers into the Korean front. A meeting marking the 70th anniversary of the Chinese People's Volunteers (CPV) entering the Democratic People's Republic of Korea to fight in the War to Resist U.S. Aggression and Aid Korea was held Friday at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing. Attending the meeting were Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC), president of the People's Republic of China (PRC) and chairman of the Central Military Commission of the PRC, leading officials of CPC and the state, veterans of CPV, bereaved families of the martyrs of CPV and others. The participants paid silent tribute to the martyrs of CPV. Xi Jinping made a speech at the meeting. He noted that the Chinese People's Volunteers fought bloody battles with the Korean people upholding the just banner of defending peace and rejecting aggression and achieved a victory 70 years ago. He said that the Party, government and people of Korea valued CPV and supported them and the armies and peoples of the two countries forged the militant ties of friendship in blood sharing weal and woe with each other. He continued to say that the victory achieved by China and Korea has great significance in the national-liberation struggle of the oppressed people of the world and in changing the world strategic structure. He called for making continuous advance for implementing the Chinese dream of national rejuvenation, united close around the party central committee and for displaying the spirit of resisting U.S. aggression and aiding Korea. Meanwhile, there were events of laying floral baskets to the cemetery of the martyrs who fell in resisting U.S. aggression and aiding Korea in Shenyang City, Liaoning Province, China and the monument to resisting U.S. aggression and aiding Korea in Dandong City. Rodong Sinmun

title: Letters of Support Encourage Soldiers at Reconstruction Sites
body: A few days ago inspiring letters from all parts of the country reached the servicemen of the Korean People’s Army units who rebuild the flood-swept Komdok area. In the letters they were requested earnestly to complete their dwellings as soon as possible and report it to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un triumphantly. They are inspired to register greater successes in their work. Rodong Sinmun

title: Women’s Shock Brigades Animate Builders to Greater Efforts
body: The organizations of all levels to the Committee of North Hamgyong Province of the Socialist Women’s Union of Korea as well as tens of thousands of their officials and members actively go to its flood-wrecked areas and work hard there to make concrete blocks, procure gravels and sand and build dwellings. The Committees of Hoeryong and Chongjin cities and Myonggan, Orang and Kyongwon counties of the SWUK and its other organizations of NHP have set their women’s shock brigades in good motion to greatly help toward accelerating the reconstruction of its flood-torn areas day after day. Rodong Sinmun

title: Daily Work Plans Overfulfilled
body: The February 8 Jikdong Youth Coal Mine tunneled along into coalfields 1.2 times longer on a daily average than before the outset of their 80-day campaign. The officials and miners of Pit No. 1 lead their mine in coal production. All the officials and workers of the mine, including the miners of its belt-aided pit and the workers of its repair and maintenance workshop, strive hard to increase their coal output. Rodong Sinmun

title: Transformers of Various Kinds Made
body: The workers and management of the Taean Electric Appliances Factory have so far finished producing an excitation transformer and a current transformer for the Orangchon Power Station No. 3 since the 80-day campaign began. They step up the assemblage of high-power transformers at their last stage according to a plan. They are now carrying on a general offensive for the forthcoming 8th Congress of the Workers’ Party of Korea with success. Rodong Sinmun

title: People Move to New Houses Built in Disaster-stricken Areas in Kangwon Province
body: Areas in Kangwon Province that had been hit by natural disasters have now turned into fairyland villages under socialism. In the disaster-stricken areas such as Cholwon, Phyonggang, Changdo, Ichon, Hoeyang, Phangyo and Kumgang counties over 810 blocks of low-storey and single-storey houses for more than 1 670 families have been newly built and people have moved into them. Meetings for moving to new houses were held on Friday. Present there were Pak Jong Nam, chairman of the Kangwon Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Chae Il Ryong, chairman of the provincial people's committee, officials of the province, citizens in the areas and builders. Congratulatory speeches were made. The speakers warmly congratulated the people on moving into new houses in the fairyland and model rural villages under socialism under the warm loving care of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un who wished those who moved to new houses in new villages happiness only. They said in excitement that Kim Jong Un, taking it as immense honor to go through hardship for the country and the people, made continued journey for the people and bestowed immense solicitude on the people in Kangwon Province, worrying about them after they were hit by flood. The soldiers of the People's Army and builders built new houses in the areas that had been ravaged by flood in Kangwon Province in a short period through 24/7 fierce and courageous campaign of loyalty, they stressed. Licenses for the use of the houses were conveyed amid applauses. Then there were pledge speeches. People danced as householders moved to new houses amid warm congratulations by officials and working people. Officials of the province who visited the new houses congratulated the owners, gave them necessities of life and shared joy as they were greatly excited to be given modern dwellings with all conditions necessary for living provided. Rodong Sinmun

title: Choe Ryong Hae Inspects Various Ris in South, North Hwanghae Provinces
body: Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, inspected several rural ris in South and North Hwanghae Provinces. He went round Taechong-ri of Unpha County which was wonderfully built as an example village of the socialist countryside. He congratulated the owners of the new dwelling houses and asked the householders grateful for the great loving care shown by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un to uphold our Party and defend socialism with increased rice production. He stressed the need for the officials of the Party committee and people's committee of the county to always go deep among the people, share weal and woe with them, turn the villages into places good to live in and glorify the Party's leadership feats. Visiting dwelling houses newly built in Samjigang-ri, Jaeryong County, Choe Ryong Hae called for planting lots of fruit trees and land-creeping plants around the houses and in the village true to the requirements of the Party policies to facelift the farm and to brilliantly realize the Party's grand plan for rural construction. Learning about the farming in Migok-ri, Sariwon City, he asked the farm officials and workers to carry out thrashing as planned by increasing the operating ratio of farm machines including thrashers and thus successfully conclude this year's farming. Rodong Sinmun

title: Newly Found Wells Registered on Cultural Heritage List in DPRK
body: Two wells excavated in Taesong District of Pyongyang City have been registered as cultural heritage of the Korean nation. The wells date back to the Koguryo Kingdom. Many red roofing tiles and pieces of earthenware bowls dating back to the Koguryo Kingdom were found in the wells which are partly in original state after excavation. This helped archeologists scientifically clarify the kinds and structure of the wells dating back to the Koguryo Kingdom. Those newly found wells were named Rimhungdong Koguryo Wells No.1 and No. 2. Meanwhile, Pothonggang Mineral Spring in Pyongyang good for health has been newly registered as a natural monument The mineral water is slightly alkaline, full of various minerals needed for human body. The spring's daily gushing amount is 72㎥ and the temperature is 12 to 14℃ in all seasons. The spring is said to prove effective for curing chronic gastritis and skin diseases. The Bureau for the Protection of Cultural Heritage, on the basis of a detailed examination and appraisal in close contact with relevant units, registered the wells as cultural heritage and the spring as a natural monument. Those on cultural heritage list of the DPRK show the developed culture of the Korean nation, its originality and superiority. Rodong Sinmun

title: Seminar on Juche Idea, Independence and Peace Held in Japan
body: A seminar on the Juche idea, independence and peace was held in Tokyo, Japan, on October 10, the day of the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). Attending the seminar held under the co-sponsorship of the International Institute of the Juche Idea, the Japan Committee for Supporting the Independent and Peaceful Reunification of Korea and the Japanese National Liaison Council of Societies for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism were personages of the Juche idea study organizations and the Japan-Korea friendship bodies. Present there on invitation were officials of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan. The participants watched congratulatory video clips sent by the Juche idea study organizations in different countries and regions and personages including Ramon Jimenez Lopez, director-general of the International Institute of the Juche Idea, Jose Francisco Aguilar Bulgarelli, honorary director-general of the Latin American Institute of the Juche Idea, Harish Gupta, director general of the Asian Regional Institute of the Juche Idea, Juha Kieksi, deputy director-general of the European Society for the Study of the Juche Idea, and Andre Lohekele Kalonda, secretary general of the African Regional Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea. Introduced there were congratulatory messages from the Korean Association of Social Scientists, Director-General Edmond Jouve and Secretary General Matteo Carbonelli of the European Society for the Study of the Juche Idea and Japanese personages. Speeches were made there. Adopted at the seminar was a letter to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: By Striving to Attain Their Ambitious Goals
body: The officials and workers of Sinphyong County conserve their rivers and forests well. The county coated more than 8,000㎡ of its riverbanks with large stones and built a strong dyke where the current is swift. In addition, it repaired its roads for thousands of meters and built retaining walls in dangerous spots. It continues to channel its great endeavors into its afforestation and water control to register greater successes in its current 80-day campaign. Rodong Sinmun

title: Autumn Land Rezoning Started
body: The officials and men of the North Hwanghae Provincial Brigade of the Shock Force for Land Realignment have gone into autumnal land realignment in Hwangju and Yonthan Counties. The NHPB decided on methods by which to rezone its fields and mapped out a detailed plan to do so by plots. On this basis, it correctly set each of its bulldozers and shifts day work assignments and allocated plots to each battalion. The NHPB ensured that its battalions held spare parts and mechanical equipment shows separately and then proceeded to start its land realignment with due ceremony. It has formed a squad with skilled drivers for it to level the ground. It also makes sure that land is realigned qualitatively under technological supervisors. Rodong Sinmun

title: Dash toward the Goal
body: The cooperative farms lying along the West Sea of Korea are all-out to thresh their cereals. The officials and agricultural workers of North and South Phyongan and North Hwanghae provinces achieve great results in their threshing. The agricultural officials and workers of South Hwanghae Province and Pyongyang follow suit, fully realizing that it is of importance to finish threshing cereals at the earliest possible date. Rodong Sinmun

title: Dwelling Construction Nearly Finished in Jungsan-ri Area of Tanchon City
body: The building of dwellings for dozens of families is near completion in Jungsan-ri, Tanchon City as in the flood-wrecked Komdok area well under reconstruction. They have already been wallpapered, their floors carpeted with vinyl plates and fruit trees planted round them. At present efforts are made to complete the dwellings in Jungsan-ri as soon as possible and procure ample fuel for their future owners and their families at the same time so that they can pass the winter in comfort. Rodong Sinmun

title: Plans for Important Indices Overfulfilled Day after Day
body: Workers overfulfill their daily plan on important indices in many spheres of the national economy. The officials and workers of thermal power stations produce electricity every day over and above their plan while those of the metalworking industry score innovative successes in the production of iron and steel. For several recent days alone those engaged in the coal industry have topped their daily coal production assignments by 103%, and great successes are registered in cement producers, too. The officials and workers of the ministries of Railways and Forestry and other fields of the national economy also work hard without cease and perform great feats in their work assignments to honor the forthcoming 8th Congress of the WPK with successes in their work. Rodong Sinmun

title: Powerful Ideological Offensive Rousing Masses
body: The organizations of the Workers’ Party of Korea at all levels dynamically conduct an organizational and political work to galvanize all officials, its members and workers into a nationwide offensive toward its forthcoming 8th Congress. The WPK organizations of the Pukchang, Pyongyang thermal power complexes and the Sunchon Thermal Power Station, the Hochongang and Suphung power stations encourage their workers to do their best to produce electricity. The WPK organizations of the Ryongsong Machine Complex, the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex, the Kaechon Area Coal Mining Complex, the February 8 Jikdong Youth Coal Mine and others across the nation ideologically stir their officials, its members and workers to put through its ideas and defend its policies the way combatants are inspired to victory at the front. Rodong Sinmun

title: Online Exhibitions of Books, Photos and Stamps Held in Various Countries
body: Many countries and regional organizations held online exhibitions of books, photos and stamps on the occasion of the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea. Those countries are China, Russia, Myanmar, Syria, India, Cambodia, Pakistan, Germany, Romania, Bulgaria, Sweden, Italy, the Czech Republic, Poland, Serbia, Libya, Senegal, Mexico and Brazil. Mass media, political parties, organizations, institutions and regional bodies in many countries posted on their websites photos and works of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, and photos, video clips, books and stamps showing achievements made by the Korean people in socialist construction. They include Ren-TV Broadcasting, Red Star TV, and the online magazine Lemchich of Russia, Syrian Arab News Agency, AKP of Cambodia, the Maritime Territorial Regional Committee and the Vladivostok City Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation, the Pakistan Association for Self-Reliance Studies, the Anti-Imperialist Forum of Germany, the Romanian Workers' Association, the Group for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism of Bulgaria, the Group of Dialectical Materialists of Italy, the Italian Committee for the Study of Songun Idea for Independence and Sovereignty, the Libya-Korea Friendship Association, the Brazilian Center for the Study of Songun Politics, and the Asian Regional Institute of the Juche Idea. Rodong Sinmun

title: Yearly Potato Production Plan Overfulfilled in Samjiyon City
body: Samjiyon City overfulfilled its potato production plan for this year. The 1st Workteam of its Junghung Farm harvested more than 45 tons of potatoes per hectare. 18 workteams of its farms and hundreds of their members qualified as high yielders, so that they topped their potato production plans honorably. The Hunggyesu Farm sprouted its potato seeds faithfully. Besides, it increased the proportion of its farm work done by machines. Consequently, it enabled its employees to work with ease and yet yield large quantities of potatoes this year. The Paeksam and Thongsin Farms and many others judiciously arranged for all their labor and machines to be mobilized to reap in good time abundance of the potatoes they raised with all care in spring and summer and transport them all to their storehouses. They finally proved themselves good potato yielders. Rodong Sinmun

title: 20-odd Tunneling and Coal-mining Units Fulfill Their Yearly Plans Ahead of Schedule
body: More than 20 squads of heading workers and coal hewers of the Sunchon Area Youth Coal Mining Complex fulfilled their yearly plans ahead of set time. The heading workers and coal hewers of the February 8 Jikdong Youth Coal Mine outdid their fellows in work. Those of the Chonsong and Ryongdae youth coal mines actively applied advanced tunneling methods to their work. The result was that they secured enough coalfields and raised the rate of the operation of their machines in their faces, thereby attaining laudable successes in their production. Rodong Sinmun

title: Production Targets Hit by More Than 130% Every Day
body: The workers and management of the Chonnaeri Cement Factory top their cement production assignments by 130% on a daily average. The workers of its Raw Materials and Baking Workshops take good care of their machines and actively devise and adopt various rational working methods. This leads to helping toward the increased production of their cement. The technicians of the CCF dedicate all their wisdom and enthusiasm to reducing its production cost and increasing the productive capacity of their own refractory. The workers of the CCF are now continuing to do their possible to produce more cement for the flood-hit areas of the country under reconstruction. Rodong Sinmun

title: Cement Production Plan Fulfilled by Over 1.1 Times
body: The Sangwon Cement Complex tops its cement production plan 1.1 times and more every day. The officials and workers of its limekiln and cement workshops strive mightily day after day to turn out large quantities of cement. The workers of the SCC’s repair and maintenance workshop briskly tap out their internal reserves and enthusiastically process every day in large numbers the spare parts of all kinds needed to produce cement. The officials, workers and technicians of the Sangwon Limestone Mine and the Samchong Mine put their machines in full operation and speed up their production. The officials and workers of the Hwachon Coal Mine, too, increase their coal production by means of successive drillings and explosions. Rodong Sinmun

title: Pukchang Thermal Power Complex Increases Electric-power Output
body: The Pukchang Thermal Power Complex has so far successfully executed its daily electricity production plan by over 110% since the outset of its 80-day campaign. The workers of its furnace operation shops and coal conveyance shops do their parts responsibly. The workers of its repair and maintenance shop are also in high spirits. The officials, workers and technicians of the PTPC continue to register innovative successes in their electricity production with wholehearted patriotism. Rodong Sinmun

title: The Hitters of Their 5-Year Strategic Targets Produced
body: In the railway sector over 180 locomotive workteams and 460-odd engineers have hit their 5-year strategic targets. They include more than 70 locomotive workteams and 170 engineers and over in the Pyongyang Railway Bureau and upward of 20 locomotive workteams in the Hamhung Railway Bureau. Many locomotive workteams and engineers of the Kaechon, Chongjin and Rason Railway Bureaus, too, have successfully attained their 5-year strategic goals. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Congratulatory Messages and Letters
body: from Different Countries Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received congratulatory messages and letters from different countries on the occasion of the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea. They are the president of the Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela, the chairman of the Central Committee of the Nepal Communist Party (United), the general secretary of the Central Committee of the Nepal title: Solidarity to Korean People All out for 80-Day Campaign
body: from Russian Organizations and Personage Russian organizations and personage expressed solidarity to the Korean people who are waging the 80-day campaign of loyalty on October 19 and 22. The Russian Association for Friendship and Cultural Cooperation with the DPRK said in a statement that the Korean people are waging an all-out 80-day campaign for greeting the Eighth Party Congress with high political enthusiasm and labor feats true to the idea and spirit of the 19th meeting of the Political Bureau of the Seventh Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. It expressed the belief that the Korean people who are overcoming the harsh ordeals and hardships such as the spread of the malignant virus and natural disasters firmly united around the WPK led by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un would greet the WPK Congress with proud achievements. It noted that they will always be with the Korean people who are vigorously accelerating the construction of a powerful socialist country. Vadim Kudimin, director of the Russian Institute of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, expressed the belief that the Korean people would successfully conclude the 80-day campaign and vigorously demonstrate once again the dignity and might of Kim Il Sung's and Kim Jong Il's Korea. The Sevastopol City Committee of the Lenin Young Communist League of the Russian Federation said that the Korean youth who have always been in the van of socialist construction would fully display their bravery and devotion breaking through ordeals and difficulties in the 80-day campaign, too. Rodong Sinmun

title: 750-odd Workers in Textile Industry Sector Fulfill
body: Their Production Assignments for 5-year Strategy In the textile industry more than 750 weavers have hit their production targets during the 5-year strategy for national economic development. The workers of the textile industry strove energetically to attain the goals of the 5-year strategy from its first year and topped their national economic plans more than twice and thrice every year. Above all, many of them overfulfilled their plans for a decade, 15 years and 18 ones at most. Ri Un Jong, throwster of a cop-winding workshop of the General Chemical Fiber Spinning Workshop of the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill, successfully executed her plan for 18 years during the 5-year strategy. Upward of 80 workers of the Sariwon Textile Mill hit their 5-year strategic targets and 91 weavers followed suit at the Sinuiju Textile Mill. The case is similar to 48 workers at the Hamhung Woolen Mill. The weavers have owed successes in their work for the 5-year strategy to the hardworking repairers of their textile mills. Rodong Sinmun

title: Sunchon Cement Complex Increases Production by Thousands of Tons
body: The Sunchon Cement Complex has so far turned out thousands of tons of cement over and above its plan and supplied it to the flood-stricken areas of the country under reconstruction and other major construction sites since the outset of its 80-day campaign. The workers of its limekiln workshop operate all their machines at full capacity and overfulfill their daily plans. The workers and technicians of its cement workshop use their recesses to regularly check up their machines or go round them to check them up and correct their defects in advance. Consequently, they carry out their work assignments every day by 120%. The steel casting, forging and raw materials workshops of the SCC actively contribute to boosting the output of its cement by dint of their hard work. Rodong Sinmun

title: Nearly 1,000 Dwellings Completed
body: The servicemen of the Korean People’s Army units have so far completed dwellings for nearly 1,000 families in the flood-wrecked Komdok area in an attacking spirit. The area is transformed hour by hour thanks to a socialist emulation among their units. Rodong Sinmun

title: Propaganda through Visual Aids Revs Up Reconstruction
body: Some time ago many KPA units competed with each other in news flashes in a flood-torn area under reconstruction round the Taehung Youth Hero Mine. This was aimed at promptly publicizing and generalizing the successes gained by the soldiers of the KPA units every hour and every day in the whole Komdok area, goading them into working hard competitively with revolutionary zeal and thus ensuring that they carry out their reconstruction assignments in the shortest time. The competition was participated in by excellent servicemen in charge of visual aids singled out of each of the units. There they each had to write a piece of news on the spot under every given theme at set time. They were then reviewed in terms of ideological content, visual impact and cultural level and appropriately placed at the competition. Rodong Sinmun

title: Scenic View of Pyongyang in Autumn
body: Streets, promenades along the banks of the Taedong River, the Central Botanical Gardens, parks, places of relaxation, etc are tinged with autumnal tins in Pyongyang. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Reply Message from President Xi Jinping
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a reply message from Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and president of the People's Republic of China (PRC), on October 24. Xi Jinping in the message expressed his heartfelt thanks to Kim Jong Un for sending a sincere and passionate message of greeting on the occasion of the 71st founding anniversary of the PRC. The message said that the Communist Party of China has united and led the peoples of all the ethnic groups in the country and made strenuous efforts in one mind and with one will for 71 years since the foundation of new China and thus registered great successes attracting the attention of the world. The message noted that they have achieved important strategic successes in a nationwide anti-epidemic struggle, adhering to the principle of attaching importance to the people and their life in the wake of the sudden outbreak of COVID-19 this year. China and the DPRK are the friendly neighbors linked by the same mountain and rivers, and the traditional friendship between the two countries is being further consolidated with the lapse of time, the message said. It said: I and Comrade Chairman have got the relations between the two parties and between the two countries to enter a new historic period through close and deep communication in recent years. The message noted that the world is witnessing the great rapid change unprecedented in 100 years. The message said that they are willing to develop the traditional China-DPRK friendship together with the Korean comrades generation after generation, to provide the two countries and the two peoples with better welfare and to propel the regional peace, stability and development. Recently, the Korean people celebrated the 75th founding anniversary of the WPK with splendor, the message said, adding that the WPK has achieved great successes in the cause of socialist construction by rallying the people and leading them for 75 years. The message expressed the belief that the Korean people would implement a new strategic line and achieve rich successes without fail in the development and construction of the state under the firm leadership of the Central Committee of the WPK led by Kim Jong Un and thus greet the Eighth Congress of the WPK with victory. It wished Kim Jong Un good health, hoping that everything would go well. It also wished the DPRK prosperity and the Korean people happiness and welfare. Rodong Sinmun

title: DIU Anniversary Marked Abroad
body: Russian newspapers and a regional body dedicated articles to the 94th anniversary of the formation of the Down-with-Imperialism Union (DIU). The articles were illustrated with photos of President Kim Il Sung. The Russian paper Komsomolskaya Pravda said in an article, "DIU and Workers' Party of Korea", that President Kim Il Sung realized that the independence of Korea could not be gained through the early communist movement and nationalist movement characterized by power struggles, factional strife, sycophancy and dogmatism; and that he groped for a new path of the struggle and formed the DIU consisting of young revolutionaries with the same idea and will. The DIU formation was a historic declaration of the new start of the Korean revolution and an epoch-making event marking a radical turning point in the Korean people's carving out of their destiny, the article added. The Workers' Party of Korea built socialism and it has developed socialism, according to the great ideal and goal put forward by the DIU, the article said. Only victory and glory are in store for the WPK advancing along the road of independence and socialism, chosen by the DIU, the article stressed. Similar articles were posted on the online paper Edinaya Korea and the website Patrioti Moskva of Russia. The Arab-Korean Cooperation Council posted on its website an article, "DIU and President Kim Il Sung", which was about the formation of the DIU by the President on Oct. 17, 1926. The article stressed that the human history recorded many great persons but has not known such a great man as the President who formed a revolutionary organization in his teens. Rodong Sinmun

title: Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex Makes Continued Innovations in Production
body: The workers and management of the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex register innovative successes day after day in producing pig iron and steel. The workers of an oxygen blast furnace workshop lead the KCISC in production executing their pig production plan by 123% on a daily average. Those of raw materials and fuel workshops examine and maintain their machines well and thoroughly meet the demand of standard operation methods for them so as to contribute actively to the iron production of the KCISC. The officials, workers and technicians of Steel Workshop 2 make efforts to boost their steel production by the reduction of their setup time for melting. Rodong Sinmun

title: Autumn Plowing Pushed Forward
body: The cooperative farms of South Hwanghae Province, North Phyongan Province and Nampho City have begun their fall plowing. The cooperative farms of SHP concentrate their machines on plowing their fields, only to carry out their daily plan without fail. Those of North Phyongan Province and Nampho City adopt preliminary measures to repair and maintain their tractors, secure necessary accessories for them and expand successes in their plowing. Rodong Sinmun

title: New Achievement Made by Kim Jong Thae Electric Locomotive Complex
body: The Kim Jong Thae Electric Locomotive Complex newly invented and produced a man car. It can be hoisted along rails by wire rope as far as Lake Chon atop Mt Paektu. It finished producing the car in a short time and then proceeded to install it so that it can ascend the lake and descend from it. It was successfully operated on trial. Rodong Sinmun

title: New-type Trolley Bus Produced
body: The Pyongyang Trolley Bus Factory produced trolley buses of a new type. They have gone into operation along major routes in Pyongyang to its citizens’ delight. Rodong Sinmun

title: Thousands of Tons of Wild Fruits Picked
body: The cities and counties of North Phyongan Province gathered thousands of tons of wild fruits this year. They are now used effectively for putting their local industry factories in full operation. In NPP Pyoktong, Sakju and Unsan counties and many other counties harvested large quantities of wild fruits. The result is that their local industry factories have become able to produce as much food and drink as possible. Rodong Sinmun

title: Active Shock-brigade Movement under Way
body: The officials and members of the countrywide organizations of the Socialist Women’s Union of Korea have honorably participated in the 80-day campaign and fully demonstrated their great revolutionary spirit and stamina as Korean women. The officials and members of the SWUK’s organizations in Pyongyang energetically conduct their activities in a women’s shock force. The SWUK’s organizations of all levels in North Hamgyong Province attain great results every day in the production of cement blocks and tiles in close liaison with the field headquarters for rebuilding its flood-wrecked areas. The members of the SWUK’s organizations in many cities and counties of South Hamgyong Province responsibly wallpaper the new-built dwellings in their flood-ruined areas and apply coating materials to them of their own choice, thereby doing their share in accelerating their construction. The members of the SWUK’s organizations in North and South Phyongan provinces and Nampho City also work in their production places by the sweat of their brows. The members of the SWUK’s shock force of North Hwanghae Province and the housewives of Kanggye City and Jonchon County, Jagang Province undertake difficult work assignments, demonstrating their collective unity. In addition, the members of the SWUK’s organizations in South Hwanghae Province and Kaesong and Rason cities actively help their cooperative farms in their present work. Rodong Sinmun

title: Project for Increasing Transport Capacity Finished in the Main
