body: The February 8 Jiktong Youth Coal Mine and Chonsong Youth Coal Mine of the Sunchon Area Youth Coal Mining Complex and the Tokchon and Jenam coal mines of the Tokchon Area Coal Mining Complex under the control of the Ministry of Coal Industry have mainly finished newly building and rebuilding belt conveyors and thereby increasing their coal-carrying capacities. The officials, technicians and workers of the Sunchon and Tokchon coal-mining machine factories, the Unsan Plant for the Accessories of Coal-mining Equipment and many other producers of belt conveyor accessories actively helped toward the belt conveyor projects. Rodong Sinmun

title: Strong Support to Iron and Steel Producers
body: In many parts of the country officials and workers collected a good deal of scrap iron and sent it to metalworking plants in October. Organs, enterprises and working people’s organizations of various levels in North Phyongan Province and Jagang Province gathered scrap iron over and above their quotas. The officials and workers of Pyongyang, Nampho City and North and South Hwanghae provinces tried their hardest to secure even a kilogram more of scrap iron and lost no time in sending their relevant collection to metalworking plants by motor vehicle. Ministries and national organs without exception join together to vigorously support the steelworks of the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Production of Consumer Goods Hastened
body: The workers and management of the light industry factories in Kangwon Province overfulfill their production plan every day. Those of the Wonsan Shoes Factory bring about a great upswing in their production. Those of the Kalma Foodstuff Factory, too, speed up their production bending every effort to devise new products, raise their quality and reduce their production cost. Those of the Wonsan Hosiery Factory, the Songdowon General Foodstuff Factory, the Wonsan Disabled Soldiers’ Essential Plastic Goods Factory and many other units do their utmost to turn out consumer goods while at the same time overtaking and outstripping others, learning from them and exchanging experiences with them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Completion Ceremony for Kumyagang Power Station No. 2 Held
body: Kumyagang Power Station No. 2 was wonderfully built as an icon of minor power stations in our country. It was commissioned with due ceremony on the spot on October 30. The completion of the power station has brought about advancement in the afforestation and water conservation in the county and provided another firm foundation for making contribution to the economic development and improvement of people's living in the county. Present at the ceremony were Ri Jong Nam, chairman of the South Hamgyong Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Kim Pong Yong, chairman of the Provincial People's Committee, officials concerned, officials and working people of Kumya County and employees of the power station. Conveyed in the ceremony was a congratulatory message of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea addressed to the officials and working people of the county who contributed to the construction of the power station and those who rendered help to it. The Central Committee of the WPK in the congratulatory message stressed that President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il made the new history of the change of the Kumya River and gave valuable teachings to build cascade power stations to put the river into various uses. The WPK Central Committee made high appreciation of the endeavors made by the officials and working people of the county and supporters who made an exemplary achievement in the implementation of the Party's policy of nature remaking by successfully building the power station and created valuable gift of significantly decorating the 75th anniversary of the founding of the Party. A report was made in the ceremony to be followed by speeches. Rodong Sinmun

title: Kumyagang Power Station No. 2 Completed
body: Kumyagang Power Station No. 2 was completed and went into operation amid the high flame of the 80-day campaign of loyalty. The power station was built in an appropriate place for the use of advantageous natural and geographical conditions in Kumya County, South Hamgyong Province. The minor power station with enormous potential of making profits would generate electricity nonstop even in the dry season with the help of rich water resources. In hearty response to the intention of the Party to effectively tap to the maximum the hydraulic resources, the officials and working people of the county completed the wonderful power station in the fighting spirit of self-reliance and thus created another reliable asset for the development of the county. The completion of the power station would ensure the increased production in local industrial factories and more affluent life of the people in the county. It would also make it possible to ensure the satisfactory supply of irrigational water to several farms in the county including Kumya Plain to promote the agricultural development of the county. Cage-net fish farming in the reservoir of the power station would also bring great profits. Cozy dwelling houses form a good harmony with young orchard and they present a picturesque view with the new pavement of the entrance to the power station. Rodong Sinmun

title: Premier Kim Tok Hun Inspects Several Sectors of National Economy
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected several sectors of the national economy. Touring co-op farms in Paechon, Yonan and Chongdan counties of South Hwanghae Province seething with the 80-day campaign, Kim Tok Hun encouraged the agricultural workers who are making patriotic devotion to successfully harvest grain cultivated by them despite natural disasters. Learning in detail about threshing at farms, he stressed the need to keep threshing machines in full-capacity operation to finish the threshing in time, secure more source of manure and plow the fields at the right time and in a qualitative way. The field consultative meetings discussed the issues arising in improving the living standard of farmers and enhancing the proportion of mechanization of the farming work while successfully concluding this year's farming and making steady preparations for next year's farming. Making a field survey of the production at the Chollima Steel Complex, the premier called on officials and technicians to introduce rational working methods which would enable to reduce the time of a heat in UHP electric arc furnace and increase the production of molten iron per charge so as to propel the campaign for increased production. Meanwhile, he went round the Yonbaek Salt Works and acquainted himself with the production at the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill and the updating of the Kumsong Tractor Factory. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Congratulatory Message to Participants in Conference of Representatives of Branches of Chongryon-2020 (Third Conference of a New Heyday)
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a congratulatory message to the participants in the Conference of Representatives of Branches of Chongryon-2020 (Third Conference of a New Heyday) on November 1. The full text of the congratulatory message is as follows: To Participants in the Conference of Representatives of Branches of Chongryon-2020 (Third Conference of a New Heyday) I warmly congratulate the Conference of Representatives of Branches of Chongryon (General Association of Korean Residents in Japan) which is being held amid the great interest and expectation at home and abroad in the meaningful period when the strength and invincibility of our Republic is being demonstrated worldwide. I extend warm compatriotic greetings to the participants in the conference and other officials of Chongryon and compatriots resident in Japan. This is a conference with a proud history and tradition, which has aroused the patriotic enthusiasm of the masses of compatriots from all walks of life in every historic period of the development of the movement of Koreans in Japan; it has thus expanded and consolidated the mass basis of Chongryon and produced remarkable successes in implementing the patriotic tasks. There are many organizations of overseas compatriots of other countries in the world, but there is no other organization than our Chongryon which has its lowest-echelon units in all parts where the Korean compatriots live and the leaders of whose lowest-echelon units get together on a regular basis to hold a large-scale conference. In the past leaders and other officials of the branches of Chongryon have performed many feats, indeed, for achieving national reunification and the prosperity of their homeland and strengthening and developing the movement of Koreans in Japan, regarding the great Comrades Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il as the fathers of their nation and saviours of their lives. The harsh conditions and circumstances in the alien land, where suppression and discrimination that infringe upon and threaten the dignity, interests and lives of our compatriots exist constantly, have never brought peace and stability to the Korean community in Japan; however, as there have been many ardent patriots like the officials of branches of Chongryon, who are thoroughgoing in their spirit of national independence and value things of their own, there is today's Chongryon that shines as a model organization of overseas compatriots and its patriotic work is so vigorous. I offer high tribute to the branch leaders of the first generation and other branch officials of the elder generations who have played the role of firm cornerstones of their socialist homeland and Chongryon with sweat and sincere devotion throughout the whole period, from the first days of the patriotic cause up to now. They have built up the branches, the basic organizations of Chongryon, and undertaken all the burdens, large and small, for the patriotic cause as they would do their own family affairs. I would like to take this occasion to extend my greetings of gratitude, together with the hearty encouragement from the people of their homeland, to all other officials of basic organizations of Chongryon and other patriotic compatriots who have always deeply sympathized with their homeland and Chongryon for their hardships, and invariably devoted their all for the development of the community of the Koreans in Japan and for the all-round rejuvenation of the movement of the Koreans in Japan, no matter whether they are recognized or not and whether they are rewarded or not. The heavy yet important tasks Chongryon has assumed at present and the tenacious challenges that hover over the community of Korean compatriots require that the branches, the basic units of Korean compatriots for living and direct undertakers of the patriotic tasks, enhance their functions and role in every way possible than ever before. Chongryon should consistently hold fast to the instructions of Comrades Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il on consolidating its branches and give stronger impetus to the struggle for making all its basic organizations reliable cornerstones for the patriotic cause. It should build all its branches up into powerful patriotic collectives, which are imbued with the great Kim Jong Il's patriotism and advance, closely united in single mind and will. Branch officials should find out every suitable method which the compatriots would favour, accept and respond to, and conduct information and cultural activities in an aggressive manner, thus training them all to be ardent patriots who have cherished the Juche-oriented faith and the spirit of love for their homeland and nation. They should remarkably spruce up their branches into those in whose work the masses of compatriots have become masters and take an active part, so that the businesspeople and compatriots of all other strata would enhance their sense of responsibility and perform their duties as masters in the campaign for setting an example of patriotism. By giving top priority to thoroughly implementing the mass line, leaders and other officials of the branches should rally more compatriots into the ranks of patriots, so as to expand and strengthen the mass foundation of Chongryon without interruption. They should develop all the branches of Chongryon into friendly neighbourhoods overflowing with the beautiful traits of mutual assistance and firmly rallied through virtue and affection. They should orient the activities of their branches to strengthening the blood-sealed ties with the compatriots, and all their officials should strive to relieve them of the worries and agony they experience in their family businesses and lives and defend and promote their rights and interests, thus ensuring that the climate of making selfless, devoted efforts for their good prevails in their organizations. In particular, they should make the perfect preparations more perfect and devote themselves lest a single family of the compatriots would suffer from the heart-breaking pain due to the malignant infectious disease sweeping the world. They should build all the branches into durable bases for maintaining the national identity. Regarding national education as the great foundation of the movement of the Koreans in Japan, branch officials should not spare time and efforts to bring up the children of the Korean compatriots into pillars, who will carry forward the baton of Chongryon and patriotism, and should briskly conduct various national cultural and sporting activities with Koreans' schools as centres. They should launch a vigorous struggle for encouraging the compatriots to enjoy using our language, both written and spoken, and preserving the excellent folk customs and traditions of the Korean nation, so as to lead all of them to live with dignity as genuine Koreans who are possessed of the soul of Korea and the spirit of their nation. They should develop all the branches into the bulwarks of patriotism, which can make characteristic contributions to the efforts for achieving independent national reunification and building their homeland into a powerful socialist country. As in the past, so in the future too, branch officials and other compatriots should always breathe the same breath as and keep pace with the people of their homeland and build higher the monument to patriotic devotion on the sacred road for the prosperity of their homeland. All the branches should make an active contribution to implementing the historic cause of national reunification by paying due attention to achieving the national unity with the compatriots living outside the organizations; they should also create an external environment favourable for the existence and development of the community of the Koreans resident in Japan by taking the initiative in conducting activities for friendship with the Japanese people. Organizations, affiliates and other organs at all levels including the Central Standing Committee of Chongryon should direct all their energies to paying special attention to and strengthening the branches, remembering that now the decisive link in the whole chain of efforts for strengthening Chongryon and the shortcut to bringing earlier the new heyday of the movement of the Koreans in Japan lie in strengthening the basic organizations. All the organizations and affiliates of Chongryon should set up their work system more progressively to help the lowest-echelon units, build up the ranks of branch officials and regularly help the leaders of branches so that they can properly play their roles. Chongryon officials should make strenuous efforts to put its backward branches on a normal track, so as to turn all its basic organizations into lively, working entities that shine their brilliance of patriotism in the work for their homeland and nation. Whenever I think of the basic organizations of Chongryon that remain stout in various parts of the alien land, I always recollect the unassuming, devoted efforts made by its branch officials, and I will render unstinting support and sincerity for the community of the Koreans resident in Japan that brims over with the Juche character and national identity and for the better welfare and brighter future of our compatriots. Believing that this conference will prove significant in intensifying the work of the branches and developing it onto a new, higher stage and set up a milestone in ushering in an upsurge of the campaign for setting an example of patriotism, I sincerely wish great success in its work. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Birthday Spreads to Centenarians
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un sent birthday spreads to centenarians Kim Kum Ryon residing in Soam-dong, Sinam District of Chongjin City, Choe Sun Nyo in Haeun-dong of Haeju City and Kim Sun Nyo in the township of Sangwon County. The centenarians, born into poor families, had keenly felt the sorrow of statelessness, being subject to all kinds of maltreatment and contempt, during the Japanese imperialists' colonial rule over Korea. It was only after President Kim Il Sung liberated the country that they came to lead a worthwhile and happy life. After receiving without any cost farmland they had ardently desired, they worked hard to live up to the solicitude of the country. During the Fatherland Liberation War, they were active in supporting the People's Army and they took the lead in the postwar reconstruction. And they had dedicated themselves to the prosperity of the country for decades. They have volunteered to do works conducive to the economic life of the country after becoming pensioners. Thanks to the socialist public health system, they are enjoying optimistic life in good health, doing housework and cultivating kitchen gardens. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Wreath to Bier of Late Ra Myong Hui
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un on Saturday sent a wreath to the bier of Ra Myong Hui, a heroine of the Republic and a war veteran, to express deep condolences over her death. In February, Juche 47 (1958), the period of the harshest trial in the history of our Party, Ra Myong Hui, serving in the Korean People's Army, made a contribution to exposing and frustrating the plot hatched by the anti-Party and anti-revolutionary factional elements against the supreme interests of our revolution, and thus performed great feats in devotedly defending the leader. The wreath was placed before the bier of the deceased. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greeting Congresses of Party with Labor Success Is Korean People's Tradition
body: It is the proud tradition of our people that they have glorified historic congresses of the Party by ushering in periods of ideological and spiritual surge and new surge of the revolution and firmly defended congresses of the Party with successes in their campaign of loyalty. The Workers' Party of Korea convened its congresses in every important period of the developing revolution and clearly set forth tasks for fresh stage, and the Korean people have made labor achievements for the congresses of the Party by launching campaigns of loyalty. The Korean people greeted the 5th Congress of the Party with pride of successfully carrying out the first seven-year national economic plan and historic tasks for socialist industrialization. They also made gifts of ensuring economic growth to be specially recorded in national history for the 6th Congress of the Party. The tradition of our people who greeted congresses of the Party with revolutionary great surge was displayed in the 70-day campaign for the 7th Congress of the Party. In the 70-day campaign, they made valuable creations of self-reliance and self-development in the brave spirit of uninterrupted innovations and progress and successive offensives. The Korean people are now making an all-out effort for greeting the 8th Congress of the Party with great success in the on-going 80-day campaign. Rodong Sinmun

title: WPK Founding Anniversary Marked Abroad
body: The world progressive mankind significantly celebrated the 75th anniversary of the founding of the glorious Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a gift from the general secretary of the Communist Party of the DR Congo and floral baskets from the general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party, the president of the State of Palestine, the president of the Federal Republic of Nigeria and political parties and organizations of different countries including Cuba, DR Congo, Zimbabwe, Sweden and Japan, international bodies and foreign personages on the occasion of the 75th founding anniversary of the WPK. Placed at the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill were floral baskets sent by the Nepal Communist Party (Marxist-Leninist), the Communist Party of the Russian Federation, the Communist Parties-the Communist Party of the Soviet Union, the Nigerian National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, the Switzerland-Korea Committee, the Finland-Korea Society, the Anti-Imperialist Forum of Germany, families of Chinese related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, the president of the International Group of Italy and others. The co-chairman of the Board of Directors of the Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation, the director general of the International Institute of the Juche Idea, the national leader of the Workers' Party of Mexico, the general secretary of the Central Committee of the People's Socialist Party of Mexico and the minister of communication and technology of Syria sent floral baskets to the DPRK missions in their countries. Personages of different countries paid congratulatory visit to the DPRK missions in their countries, laid floral baskets and bouquets before the portraits of smiling Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il and art works depicting the peerlessly great men standing together and bowed to them. Kim Jong Un received congratulatory messages and letters from party leaders, heads of state and senior personages of political and public circles of different countries including China, Russia, Cuba, Nepal, Mongolia, Laos, Syria, Vietnam, Demark, UK, Italy, Nigeria, Mali, Equatorial Guinea, Uganda, Venezuela, Mexico, Uruguay, Chile and Brazil on the occasion of the holiday of October. Statements and articles were issued by political parties, organizations and personages of different countries including the Political Executive Committee of the Party for Peace and Unity of Russia, the National Guidance Council of the Pioneer Party of Indonesia, the People's Progressive Party of Nigeria, the chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Bangladesh, the chairman of the Supreme Council of the National Socialist Party (Romania), the vice-chairman of the Socialist Freedom Party of Egypt and the chairman of the Congolese Association for Friendship among Peoples. Celebrations took place in different countries to mark the anniversary. In Jakarta, Indonesia, an internet website was opened for the successful holding of international online seminar on the DPRK winning victories with the spirit of independence and over 110 speeches, poems and songs sent by personages of different public circles in over 60 countries were posted on it. Colorful political and cultural functions took place worldwide, including national and joint seminars in Mongolia, Bangladesh, Uganda, DR Congo and Brazil and a seminar on the Juche idea, independence and peace in Japan. A number of foreign mass media carried special write-ups illustrated with the portraits of smiling Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il and photos of Kim Il Sung, Kim Jong Il and Kim Jong Un before or after October 10. Rodong Sinmun

title: Thriving Livestock Farming Base in the Sepho Area
body: The livestock farming base in the Sepho area is quite a picture. This year it boosted its meat output over 4.5 times and produced thousands of tons of milk as against 2016. Moreover, it has established a scientific breeding stock production system to rear good breeds of domestic animals in greater numbers. It has also applied embryo transfer technology, artificial fertilization technology, etc. Consequently, oxen, sheep, goats and other domestic animals have multiplied into hundreds of thousands. Rodong Sinmun

title: Dwellings Built for Scientists
body: Some time ago the scientists of the Agricultural Science Institute of Jagang Province removed to the new dwellings of several stories built at its picturesque Hungju. Their living rooms and kitchens are all heated by electricity and well-appointed. Rodong Sinmun

title: Transport Ships Loaded with Cement Leave for Reconstruction Sites One After Another
body: The workers of the Hungnam Port under the Ministry of Land and Maritime Transport as well as the working citizens of Hamhung City strive mightily to send large quantities of cement to the flood-stricken areas in course of reconstruction. They have so far sent tens of thousands of tons of cement. The women of the affiliates of the Socialist Women’s Union of Korea in Hungnam, Hungdok and Haean districts, Hamhung City devotedly embark the cement for the housing construction in ships to stabilize flood victims’ living at the earliest date possible. In close liaison with the Hungnam Port the Hamhung Railway Bureau helps toward transporting cement to the flood-stricken areas of the country under construction without delay and cease by sea. Rodong Sinmun

title: Various Fixtures Produced at Full Steam
body: North Hamgyong Province speeds up the production of furnishings for dwellings under construction in its flood-ruined areas. Kim Chaek and Hoeryong cities, Hwadae, Kyongwon and Kyonghung counties and many other counties have now finished turning out the furnishings they are assigned to do. Other units, too, dynamically accelerate the production of doors, window, etc. Counting themselves as the field builders of dwellings in their flood-hit areas the officials and workers of other cities and counties also do their utmost to produce furnishings. NHP has so far turned out tens of thousands of furnishings of various kinds and sent them to dwellings under construction in its flood-ridden areas. Rodong Sinmun

title: Road Construction Progresses Apace
body: The officers and men of the division No. 2 of the Party members of the capital city energetically step up the construction of roads in residential areas while at the same time building dwellings there. Although they have to finish their housing construction as soon as possible they are all-out to build roads creditably. As a result, it incessantly meets with success after success. Rodong Sinmun

title: Further Successes Made in Komdok Area under Reconstruction
body: The servicemen of the Korean People’s Army units finished many building projects in the flood-wrecked Komdok area. They keep on scoring success after success in carrying out another ones. Those of a KPA unit completed the Kumgol Bridge 1 in 12 days. Those of another KPA unit, too, finished building a park in Sao-dong, Tanchon City in two days and then proceeded to swiftly realign its surroundings, blanket its sidewalks with cement blocks, create lawns there and afforest its area. Those of still another KPA unit improved river conditions in Kumgol-dong No.1, Tanchon City in five days. Rodong Sinmun

title: KCNA Report on Achievements Made in First Month of 80-day Campaign
body: The Korean Central News Agency released a report on Monday on the achievements made by all the regions, fields and units of the country in the efforts to accomplish the targets for the first month of the 80-day campaign. According to the report, all the people across the country came out in the general revolutionary campaign for the fresh progress and prosperity. The headquarters at all levels from Pyongyang to the lowest unit set targets to be attained during the campaign and pressed for measures for their execution and meticulously organized operations and commanding. The Party organizations at all levels let all the Party members and other working people properly know about the idea of the letter of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and waged powerful organizational and political work to arouse their mental power and creative enthusiasm to the maximum. The emergency anti-epidemic work has been further intensified to defend the security of the country and the people and to devotedly safeguard the 8th Congress of the Party from the worldwide health crisis which is getting serious as the days go by. Notices and instructions from the central emergency anti-epidemic field were updated and delivered and anti-epidemic measures were enforced on a high level. All the fields and units thoroughly carried out emergency anti-epidemic measures taken by the Party and the state, firmly maintained steel-like anti-epidemic system and order and maintained and consolidated the stable and perfect anti-epidemic situation. Scientific research institutions established our own disinfection system and have pushed forward in real earnest the work to guarantee the emergency anti-epidemic campaign in a scientific and technological way. The great army-people unity and the might of coordinated operations were demonstrated in the campaign for recovery from damage. Service personnel of the People's Army and members of the division of Party members from the capital city performed miracles and feats in the van of the campaign for the recovery from the damage and in the 80-day campaign, and officials, working people, youth and students across the country sent lots of encouraging letters to them. In the first month of the campaign more than 2 000 modern dwelling houses were newly built across the country. Thanks to the struggle waged by the members of the division of the Party members from the capital city and soldier-builders, villages of new dwelling houses appeared one after another in Hongwon and Riwon counties in South Hamgyong Province, Kim Chaek City in North Hamgyong Province, and Cholwon, Phyonggang, Changdo, Ichon, Hoeyang, Phangyo, Kumgang and Kimhwa counties in Kangwon Province. People moved to new houses in Taechong-ri, Unpha County, North Hwanghae Province which has turned into model village in socialist farm. Keeping step with the achievements made in the construction of dwelling houses in the areas for recovery from damage, the projects for rehabilitating railways, iron bridges and facilities have been successfully pushed ahead. In the fields of forestry, agriculture, city management and land and environmental conservation, the rehabilitation of more than 30 bridges, improvement of rivers in more than 70 places, projects of over 10 reservoirs, more than 50 waterway projects and structure rehabilitation projects were concluded. The agricultural front is all alive for the successful conclusion of the farming for this year and preparations for farming for next year. Thanks to the efforts exerted by agricultural workers across the country harvesting of rice and corn was completed across the country and thrashing has reached 74 percent. The officials and working people in the agricultural field are stepping up the autumn ploughing and production of self-sufficing manure for the preparations for farming for next year. The fighting spirit of the people runs high in all sites for the economic construction. Kumyagang Power Station No. 2 was built and commissioned as a model of minor power stations of the country and the Munphyong Smeltery has had its lead refining system updated as labor-intensive, energy-efficient, cost-saving and land-saving one. The project for updating and modernizing the Kumsong Tractor Factory and the construction of low-temperature drying distiller of the Myonggan Chemical Factory and rayon pulp production process of the Chongjin Chemical Fibre Mill are being pushed forward on a full scale. The workers of the large-scale industrial bases including the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex and the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex are pressing for the projects for the expansion of production capacity to consolidate the pillar of the self-supporting economy. Modern production processes conducive to the promotion of people's health and improvement of people's living standard have been built in the Unjong Tea Drink Factory and the Sinuiju Textile Mill and they are nearing their completion. The targets for the first month of the 80-day campaign have been accomplished on such major indices as electricity, iron ore, steel, coal and cement in the industrial field including metal, chemical, power, coal and machine industries and railway transport. The report stressed that the achievements made in the first month of the 80-day campaign clearly prove the iron truth that the all-people offensive is sure to triumph as long as there are the leadership of the Party Central Committee and the ranks of the single-minded unity which has embodied the staunch attack spirit. Rodong Sinmun

title: Benefiting from Greenhouses
body: Waudo District, Nampho City directs its efforts into its greenhouse vegetable production. The greenhouse vegetable workteam alone under the immediate control of the Waudo District Cooperative Farm Management Committee has produced hundreds of tons of greenhouse vegetables of various kinds every year for recent years on end and supplied them to the inhabitants of the district and many other units. The Taedae Vegetable Cooperative Farm and other farms have also registered considerable successes in their greenhouse vegetable production. Rodong Sinmun

title: Daily Power Generation Targets Topped
body: Kangwon Province overfulfills its electricity production plan every day. The officials, workers and technicians of the Wonsan Youth Power Station, the Wonsan Army-People Power Station, the Anbyon Youth Power Station No. 2 and the Ichon Army-People Power Station have thoroughly set up the system for the checkup and maintenance of their machines and put them in operation to meet the demand of technological rules and standard operation methods, thus increasing their production. Rodong Sinmun

title: Hundreds of Dwellings Built at Final Stage
body: The construction corps which are assigned to build the Wonsan-Kalma Coastal Tourist Resort finished framing dwellings for hundreds of families in the flood-wrecked areas of North Hamgyong Province. They register success after success in their final works day by day. The officers and men of the Brigade of the Ministry of Public Security have mainly finished building dwellings. The brigades of Pyongyang, North Phyongan Province and the Ministry of Land and Maritime Transport and many other construction corps do their best to build dwellings in their charge in spite of their difficulties. Rodong Sinmun

title: Keeping Pace with KPA Soldiers
body: The workers and management of the Komdok Mining Complex accelerate the construction of dwellings for tens of families in the thick of a socialist emulation among units while building relevant structures around them and ameliorating their adjacent river conditions. The dwellings are now near completion. Coating materials were applied to them and furnishings installed there. The relevant structures are now well under construction. The river, too, was well improved so that it can withstand any flood or typhoon. Some time ago a river which flows by the front of the Kumgol Mine was bettered for hundreds of meters. The Jungsanchon sedimentation reservoir is restored to its original state for the normalization of the KMC’s production. Rodong Sinmun

title: To Attain 80-Day Campaign Goals
body: More than 20 days have passed since the beginning of the 80-day campaign of loyalty for the 8th Congress of the Workers’ Party of Korea. Those officials and workers engaged in many domains of the national economy hit one production target after another on important indices to honor the 8th WPK Congress with great political enthusiasm and shining successes in their work. The officials and workers of the mining industry bring about innovations in attaining their production quotas. The Phungnyon, Jungsan and Yongyu mines and many other mines, plus the December 5 Youth Mine which has fulfilled its yearly national economic plan ahead of schedule, achieve great results in their production day after day, The Ryongsong Machine Complex, the Tongrim Mining Machine Factory, the Anju Pump Factory, the Pyongyang General Electric Cable Factory 326 and other machine-building plants do quite well in production. The light industrial sector goes all-out for its production despite its adverse conditions. The officials and workers of the lumber industry make great incessant advances in their lumber production. Rodong Sinmun

title: 11th Plenary Meeting of 14th Presidium of DPRK SPA Held
body: The 11th Plenary Meeting of the 14th Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly (SPA) of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) took place at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Nov. 4. Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and president of the SPA Presidium, presided over the meeting. It was attended by Thae Hyong Chol and Pak Yong Il, vice-presidents of the SPA Presidium, Ko Kil Son, secretary general of the SPA Presidium, and members of the SPA Presidium. Brought up for discussion at the meeting were agendas "On Adopting Tobacco-Prohibition Law of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea" and "On Revising and Supplementing the Law on Enterprises of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea". The gist of the two agendas, discussed at the Legislation Committee of the SPA, was introduced. The tobacco-prohibition law with 31 provisions stipulates the rules which all the institutions, organizations and citizens must follow in protecting the lives and health of the people and providing more cultured and hygienic living environments by tightening the legal and social controls on the production and sale of cigarettes and on smoking as required by the state tobacco-prohibition policy. The law specifies places and units in which smoking is forbidden, such as places for political and ideological education, public places including theaters and cinemas, and the institutions for nursing and upbringing children, education ones, medical and public health facilities, commercial and public catering ones, public transport means. It also indicates penalties for violating smoking rules and others. The revision and supplements to the enterprise law newly stipulate contents of making enterprises labor-, energy-, cost-, and land-saving ones and of making the employees patriotic working people who regard the spirit of economy as part of their mental qualities. The enterprise law refers to issues which all the units must observe when organizing new enterprises or when their affiliations change. It also stipulates that the production and business management must be done under the unified guidance and strategic control of the state and on socialist principles. The meeting deeply considered those agendas and had an exchange of views on them. Decrees of the SPA Presidium "On Adopting Tobacco-Prohibition Law of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea" and "On Revising and Supplementing the Law on Enterprises of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea" were adopted with unanimous approval at the plenary meeting. Rodong Sinmun

title: Lumber Production at Final Stage
body: The officials and workers of the Forestry Management Bureau of Kangwon Province turned out large quantities of lumber for dwellings under construction in many flood-hit areas of the country. They still proceed to score successes in their production. The forestry stations and mine lumber producers under the FMBKP increase their lumber production day after day in a fierce socialist emulation among its units. The Phangyo Forestry Station gives priority to its lumber felling and puts its transporters in full operation to mass-produce lumber every day. The Sepho Timber Production Station and other producers, too, step up their lumber production tapping out and enlisting their reserves and potentials to the maximum. Rodong Sinmun

title: Further Successes Made in Dwelling Construction
body: Despite its hugeness in area the ground was excavated and concreted for the foundations of dwellings in the flood-wrecked areas of South Hamgyong Province. They were also framed. Their interior is fixed up at the last stage. The Division No. 1 of the Party Members of the capital city, the servicemen of the Korean People’s Army units and the officers and workers of South Hamgyong Province joined force with each other to recover the flood damage of its flood-ridden areas. The officials and workers of SHP actively introduced rational building methods into their construction of dwellings in the flood-torn areas of Tanchon City and Riwon County and completed them in a short time. They gain new successes day after day in going on with their housing construction in another flood-stricken areas. Rodong Sinmun

title: Silk Thread Production Plan Overfulfilled by 200% Day after Day
body: The labor and management of the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Silk Mill fulfill their production plan by over 200% on average for the last several days. They, without exception, register honorable successes in their work while a socialist emulation for the 80-day campaign of loyalty is vigorously conducted among their workshops, workteams and individuals to thoroughly observe the principle of giving precedence to quality over quantity in all their production processes and bring about great results in their production. Keeping step with this the officials of the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Silk Mill prearrange the timely procurement of materials and raw materials. Rodong Sinmun

title: New Local Villages Being Built round Kwangchon Chicken Farm
body: The officials, Party members and workers of North Hwanghae Province speed up their housing construction for the members of a feed farm to the Kwangchon Chicken Farm. The builders of the battalions of Songrim and Sariwon cities and Sungho County lead others in this. The builders employed in provincial organs, factories and enterprises work very hard to complete the dwellings ahead of set time. As a result, they mushroom up day by day. Rodong Sinmun

title: Efforts Focused on Preparations for Next Year’s Farming
body: The officials and agricultural workers of South Hwanghae Province attain great results every day in the tillage of their paddies and dry fields. Those of Anak County plow their fields a lot in high spirits. Those of Jaeryong, Unryul and Pongchon counties and other counties, too, go all-out to till their paddies and dry fields successfully in preparation of their farm work for the next year. Rodong Sinmun

title: Highest Production Results Recorded
body: The workers and management of the Sungho Concrete Sleeper Factory registered the greatest success ever in its production after it was commissioned on November 1. The workers of the SCSF’s quarrying shop and reinforcing bars and transport workteams make collective innovations in their work. Those of the SCSF’s heat control, loading and unloading, repair and maintenance and electricity workteams explore and tap out their internal reserves as much as possible and do their parts responsibly so as to register one success after the other in their tie production without cease. Rodong Sinmun

title: Letter to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Participants in Conference of Representatives of Branches of Chongryon-2020
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a letter from the participants in the Conference of Representatives of Branches of Chongryon-2020 (Third Conference of a New Heyday) on November 1. The letter said that the conference was held at a stirring time when the people of the homeland are all out in the 80-day campaign of loyalty toward the Eighth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea to usher in a new period of a great upsurge and change of the revolution. Thanks to the meticulous leadership and warm love of Kim Jong Un, the conference has become a significant one for developing the work of the branches of Chongryon (the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan) onto a new, higher stage by enhancing the functions and role of the branches, the basic units of Korean compatriots for living and direct undertakers of the patriotic tasks, in every way, the letter said. The conference also serves as a turning point for bringing about an upsurge in the campaign for setting an example of patriotism in the new heyday, it added. It also represented the will of Chongryon and Koreans in Japan to develop the work of the branches as required by the glorious era of Kim Jong Un by thoroughly implementing the tasks specified in his congratulatory message. It also expressed their determination to always breathe the same as and keep pace with the people of the homeland and make tangible contributions to the prosperity of the homeland by carrying forward the tradition of patriotism. Evincing the will to uphold Kim Jong Un's congratulatory message as an eternal great programme for the work of the branches, the letter expressed their pledge to live up to his trust and love by turning all basic organizations of the branches into lively entities that will shine in patriotism and bringing earlier a new heyday of the movement of Koreans in Japan. Rodong Sinmun

title: Conference of Representatives of Branches of Chongryon-2020 Held
body: The Conference of Representatives of Branches of Chongryon-2020 (Third Conference of a New Heyday) took place in Tokyo on November 1. Present there were Pak Ku Ho, first vice-chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), Nam Sung U, its vice-chairman, and other officials, representatives of branches of Chongryon and women's union throughout Japan from Hokkaido to Kyushu, full-time and part-time officials of the headquarters and branches of Chongryon. The conference was held through video conferencing. Pak Ku Ho read out the congratulatory message sent by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un to the participants in the Conference of Representatives of Branches of Chongryon-2020 (Third Conference of a New Heyday). Vice-Chairman Pae Jin Gu made a report. He stressed that Kim Jong Un sent a congratulatory message that serves as important guidelines to the participants in the conference to add glory to the conference and put its historical status on the highest level although he was so busy with his guidance over the 80-day campaign for greeting the 8th Congress of the Party after the celebrations of the 75th founding anniversary of the glorious Workers' Party of Korea as the grand festival of victors. He called on the participants to resolutely overcome all the difficulties by dint of the single-minded unity with a rock-firm faith that Chongryon and Koreans in Japan are sure to win as they are led by the Supreme Leader, the symbol of the cause of Juche and the benevolent father of Chongryon and Koreans in Japan, thus ushering in a new heyday of the movement of Koreans in Japan. A congratulatory video sent by the homeland was shown there. Speeches were followed. Citations of model patriotic branches and citations of model branches of different sectors and model branch flags of a new heyday were conferred on exemplary branches of Chongryon and special prizes on their exemplary affiliates. A letter to Kim Jong Un was read out at the conference. Rodong Sinmun

title: One Family
body: The family of an old woman named Kim Sun Ok has a happy time with her visitors. She is a war veteran who dwells in Neighborhood Unit 79 of Mirae-dong, Phyongchon District, Pyongyang. Respecting her as a revolutionary forerunner they pay a high tribute to her and treat her cordially. This is the ways of the nation and the pride of our society. Rodong Sinmun

title: Tea Flowers in Autumn Catching People’s Eyes
body: Tea plants are in full bloom like spring plants in Kangryong County in the autumn sending forth fragrance. Associated with the noble love of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un for the people, the tea garden of the county bears witness to the happy lives of our people and their future generations. Rodong Sinmun

title: Promenades Rebuilt along the Shores of the Pothong River
body: The looks of the Pothong River have recently been changed to add beauty to the landscape of Pyongyang. The officials, Party members and workers of Pyongyang have bestirred themselves to rebuild promenades along the shores of the Pothong River during the 80-day campaign and worked hard to that end. Consequently, they have mainly finished doing that in a bit more than 20 days. They get through with their rebuilding operations with devotion. Consequently, the shores of the river are being face-lifted admirably. Rodong Sinmun

title: Many Electrodes Produced for the National Economy
body: All-out for their 80-day campaign the officials, workers and technicians of the Hungnam Electrode Factory tap out all their reserves and potentials and briskly conduct a mass technological innovation drive, thereby achieving great results in their production. Last month they turned out lots of electrodes and sent them to the major units of the national economy. They aimed at executing their electrode production plan for November about 10 days ahead of schedule and have since done their utmost to this end this month. Firmly determined to add glory to their HEF they register success after success in their electrode production. Rodong Sinmun

title: Sunchon Thermal Power Station Fulfills Its Production Target by Over 110% Every Day
body: The officials, workers and technicians of the Sunchon Thermal Power Station perform great labor exploits day after day in their 80-day campaign. They overfulfilled their electricity production plan for October. They produce electricity by 110% every day in November, too, by dint of their hard work. Successes in their electricity production gain in scope day by day now that they exert all their energies on their work assignments in response to the appeal of the Workers’ Party of Korea for the 80-day campaign of loyalty. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chollima Steel Complex Continues to Boost Production
body: The labor and management of the Chollima Steel Complex hit their iron and steel production target in October in 20 days after they went into their 80-day campaign. Without so much as resting on their laurels they proceed to work harder than before in November, too, to be entitled to legitimately aver that they carry out their work assignments every day. The workers of the Posan Ironworks fulfill their production plan without fail putting their rotary furnaces in full operation. The smelters of its steel workshop have established a rational production system and vigorously carried on a socialist emulation for their 80-day campaign of loyalty among their shifts and workteams helping and leading each other forward in their collective innovations. The workers of the PI’s rolling workshop operate their heating furnaces and rolling mills at the fullest capacity and speed up the production of their rolled steel to thoroughly meet the demand of technological regulations for them. The workers and technicians of its auxiliary branches actively contribute to increasing the output of its iron and steel. Rodong Sinmun

title: Wonderful Dwelling Houses Built in Damaged Areas of Kimchaek City and Riwon County
body: New dwelling houses have been built in the damaged areas of Chundong-ri, Unho-ri and Sokho-ri in Kimchaek City of North Hamgyong Province and Haksadae-ri in Riwon County of South Hamgyong Province, and the villagers moved into the houses. Ceremonies for moving to new houses were held on the spot. Congratulatory speeches were made there. Speakers warmly congratulated inhabitants who move into new houses thanks to the great loving care and solicitude of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un when the people of the whole country are vigorously advancing towards the Eighth Congress of the Party. They said that Kim Jong Un, taking to heart the fact that dwelling houses collapsed and the villagers were suffering hardships of life owing to natural disasters in the South and North Hamgyong provinces, personally visited the spot to inspect the damage, took a special measure of urgently dispatching the divisions of the elite Party members of the capital city and led to victory the building of dwelling houses. They stressed that all the working people should wage fierce emergency anti-epidemic work and rehabilitation campaign with higher flame of the 80-day campaign and successfully conclude this year's farming and thus make tangible contributions to the prosperity of a socialist homeland. Licenses for the use of houses were conveyed to the citizens in the damaged areas. There were pledge speeches. The speakers evinced their pledges to victoriously conclude the rehabilitation campaign, bring about a surge in the production and construction and greet the Eighth Congress of the Party with labor achievements, not forgetting the benevolence of the Party even a moment. The sea of dancers was presented to the tune of peasants' music and people moved to new houses amid warm congratulations by officials, builders and shock-brigade members. Commanding officers and members of the divisions of Party members of the capital city and officials of the provinces visited new houses to share happiness with the new owners. Rodong Sinmun

title: Pak Pong Ju Inspects Kumsong Tractor Factory and Phyongchon Prefab Factory
body: Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the WPK, inspected the Kumsong Tractor Factory and the Phyongchon Prefab Factory. Their officials, workers and technicians who are dynamically conducting the 80-day campaign of loyalty for devotedly defending the historic Eighth Congress of the Party are working innovations in carrying out the tasks assigned to them by fully displaying the spirit of self-reliance and fortitude. At the Kumsong Tractor Factory, he acquainted himself with the progress made in its updating project. He underscored the need to increase the proportion of locally available materials in construction, ensure speed and quality in the project and push ahead with afforestation and greening at the same time. At the Phyongchon Prefab Factory, he urged its officials, workers and technicians to take technical measures for operating equipment at full capacity and ensure the quality of products, being well aware of the importance of their duty in putting the construction in an industrial and modern basis. The field consultative meetings discussed measures to step up technical updating for increasing the performance of tractors, perfect the production process and boost the production of building parts and elements. Rodong Sinmun

title: Munchon Army-People Power Station Completed
body: The Munchon Army-People Power Station was built in Kangwon Province as a result of self-development and self-sufficiency. The completion of the power station laid a foundation for improving the local economy and the people's living standard and fully supplying water for drinking, irrigation and industrial use in the city. An inauguration ceremony was held on spot on Friday. Attending it were Pak Jong Nam, chairman of the Kangwon Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Chae Il Ryong, chairman of the Provincial People's Committee, officials concerned, officials and working people in Munchon City and builders and employees of the power station. Rodong Sinmun

title: Credentials to President of Belarus
body: The DPRK ambassador presented credentials to the Belarusian president on Nov. 3. DPRK Ambassador Ju Jong Bong politely conveyed to Aleksandr Lukashenko, president of Belarus, warm greetings from Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK. The president expressed deep thanks and asked the ambassador to convey his warm greetings to Kim Jong Un. The president expressed his will to strive to develop the bilateral relations. Rodong Sinmun

title: Ferroalloy Production Plan Overfulfilled Day after Day
body: The officials, workers and technicians of the Puryong Ferroalloy Plant work hard in response to the appeal of the WPK for the 80-day campaign and overfulfill their production plan every day. They introduce many technological innovations and findings into their plant to raise its productivity and operate its machines at fuller capacity, thus contributing actively to strengthening its material and technological foundations. This vigorously encourages the workers of our metal industry to their 80-day campaign. Rodong Sinmun

title: Tunneling Prioritized to Guarantee Increase in Coal Output
body: Since the beginning of their 80-day campaign the labor and management of the Tokchon Area Coal Mining Complex which has a large share in the coal output of the country have made incessant advances in their speedy tunneling and the ensuing production increase to celebrate the forthcoming 8th Congress of the Workers’ Party of Korea by turning out large quantities of coal. They have so far tunneled into coalfields dozens of meters longer than they planned to do and reserved more than 60 coal pits for future extraction. The heading workteams of the Hyongbong Coal Mine won successes in their work. The members of the high-speed heading workteams of its Taesong and Solgol Pits actively applied rational blasting and tunneling methods to their work and performed successive drillings and blasts, thus fulfilling their daily work assignments by 120% and more. The members of the Kim Hyok and Cha Kwang Su Youth Shock Brigades of the Jenam Coal Mine as well as those of a high-speed heading workteam of its 7th Pit have taken good care of their machines like masters, optimized the use of their compressors and other heading machines and intensified cooperation between their shifts, thereby setting new standards and records every day during their 80-day campaign of loyalty. Fully convinced that their increased coal production depends on the securement of their coalfields the members of many heading workteams of the Tokchon and Wolbong Coal Mines and the Sochang Youth Coal Mine drill rocks in smaller numbers and yet blow them up efficiently by new innovative methods. They then proceed to promptly dispose of dead rocks. As a consequence they attain high results in their tunneling every day. Rodong Sinmun

title: Kim Tok Hun Inspects Various Units of National Economy
body: DPRK Premier Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, inspected the Sunchon Thermal Power Plant, the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex and the Chongchongang-Phyongnam irrigation waterway construction site. He looked round the turbine shop and integrated power production control room in the thermal power plant, where the workers are increasing production every day in the spirit of overfulfilling the October plan of electricity production in order to brilliantly greet the 8th Congress of the Party. There he discussed the ways to increase power production and urged officials to meticulously organize the management on the socialist economic management principle and the socialist system of responsible business operation. At the gas producer and compressor shop of the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex he called for meticulously organizing the management of equipment to meet the technical rules and standard regulations, and correctly ensuring periodic equipment repairing for fully producing and providing fertilizer. At the waterway construction site he underscored the need to give precedence to supplying materials so as to step up the final-stage task of waterway tunnels and to finish at an early date the setting up of the sluice gate of dam, being well aware of the importance of the waterway construction in carrying out the Party's policy for irrigation in rural areas. The consultative meetings in field called on the officials, scientists and technicians in the fields of power and chemical industries to take scientific and technological measures for putting the production on a normal basis through the introduction and recycling of locally available equipment, raw and other materials, and discussed the issue of qualitatively completing the waterway project. Rodong Sinmun

title: Sangwon Cement Complex Fulfills Yearly Production Quota
body: A good news arrived from the Sangwon Cement Complex, a leading cement producer of the country. From early January 2020 on end it has done all it can to produce as much cement as possible and finally fulfilled its cement production plan for this year till November 4. Without so much as resting on its laurels it still tries its hardest to turn out more cement this year than in its peak production year for cement and goes on with its construction projects to increase its cement production capacity. Rodong Sinmun

title: Primary Attention Paid to Forest Conservancy
body: Forest conservation is as important as forestation. The prevention of a forest fire in particular is a matter of primary attention. Therefore, during their dynamic 80-day campaign the cities and counties of North Phyongan Province adopt drastic measures against the outbreak of a forest fire. Forest conservancy can be said to protect land, ecoenvironment and the economy. Bearing this in mind the the officials and workers of the cities and counties register one success after another in their forest conservation. Rodong Sinmun

title: Great Exploits of Developing WPK into Invincible Revolutionary One
body: The advance in the new century of Juche is continuity of the revolutionary advance pioneered on Mt Paektu. It is important to develop our Party into an invincible guiding force in order to invariably carry forward the history and traditions of our ever-victorious revolution pioneered by President Kim Il Sung and led by Chairman Kim Jong Il. The crucial tasks facing the era and the revolution have been successfully performed by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un possessed of outstanding political caliber. It is the greatest feat performed by the Supreme Leader for the country and the revolution that he has consolidated the Party organizationally and ideologically and brought about a new turn in the Party building and activities and its overall work with his unexcelled ideological and theoretical wisdom, outstanding guidance and firm faith. He has developed our Party into a body, ideologically pure and organizationally integrated, and this is his immortal Party-building feat. He has also strengthened our Party into the one which achieved the unity of action and laid its rock-solid mass foundation. Today our revolution vigorously advances in the face of the persistent challenges by the hostile forces and severe difficulties. But it is the iron-willed faith of our people that they can overcome any ordeals under the seasoned and tested leadership of the ever-victorious Workers' Party of Korea. Invincible is the cause of the Workers' Party of Korea led by Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Yearly Cocoon Production Plan Overfulfilled
body: The sericultural officials and agricultural workers of Jagang Province overfulfilled their cocoon production plan for 2020 despite long spells of unfavorable weather. The sericulturists of the province manured and tended their mulberry fields and raised their silkworms with all care although bad weather lasted for a long time. Consequently, they brought about unprecedented innovations in producing mulberry leaves and cocoons per hectare. They scientifically and technologically controlled the temperature and humidity of their sericultural rooms, sterilized them and fed mulberry leaves to silkworms according to their growing conditions, thus achieving high results in their cocoon production. In the course of this the employees of the Songha Cocoon Cooperative Farm in Songgan County successfully turned out more than 500kg of cocoons in their mulberry fields per hectare. Rodong Sinmun

title: Hitting Ambitious Daily Targets without Fail
body: The members of the 8th Workteam of the Sinhung Cooperative Farm in Singye County work hard and fast by shifts as one and score great successes every day in threshing cereals under their plan. Rodong Sinmun

title: Construction of Kalma Offshore Aquiculture Station at Final Stage
body: In hearty response to the appeal of the Workers’ Party of Korea for the 80-day campaign Kangwon Province accelerates the completion of the Kalma Offshore Aquiculture Station. True to the principle of being liable for their structures for a thousand years and guaranteeing them for ten thousand years the officials and shock workers of the provincial fishery management bureau and the Wonsan Port successfully stepped up the construction of the KOAS pooling their collective wisdom with each other. Consequently, they laid huge cubic meters of earth on the ground, concreted it for the foundations of many buildings, walled them, plastered their interior and exterior with cement mortar and roofed them one after another. The workers and management of machine producers made the related machines with all speed in the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance. Rodong Sinmun

title: Cement Producers Keep Increasing Output
body: Cement factories under the control of the Ministry of Construction and Building-materials Industry focus their greater efforts on their increased cement production than ever after they hit their production target for the first month of their 80-day campaign. The officials, workers and technicians of their limekiln, mixed raw materials and other important workshops take scientific care of their machines, dovetail their processes with each other further and amplify cooperation between their shifts. In connection with the units concerned cement workshops repaired and maintained their important machines in a short time so as to boost their production further. The Chonnaeri Cement Factory does its possible for its production. The workers and management of its limestone branch mine register high results in their limestone production day after day. Those of its limestone conveyance and raw materials workshops put their limekiln in full operation to strictly meet the demand of technological rules and standard operation methods. The officials and workers of its limekiln and cement workshops, too, overfulfill their production plan taking good technological care of their machines. Rodong Sinmun

title: New Residential Quarter Nears Completion
body: The officers and men of the Division No. 2 of Party members of the capital city accelerate the completion of dwellings in another flood-wrecked area. They have mainly finished many dwellings, erected fences round them and built roads where necessary. They are now all-out to build open caissons, dig ditches, set up roadside boundary stone signals in the area, readjust and afforest the surroundings of the dwellings and install electrical appliances there. As the front agitprop work is done briskly in the area to spiritually inspire the officers and men of the division to further efforts, the paddies and dry fields round the dwellings are admirably realigned with the rational help of shovelers and other heavy machines. Rodong Sinmun

title: Great Army-People Unity Fully Displayed in Socialist Construction
body: The song "Arirang of Army-People Unity" can be heard in cities, farm villages, factories, coal mines, forestry workers' villages, seaside villages and socialist construction sites across the DPRK. The song depicts the people and the service personnel in the DPRK who are sharing their idea and intention in upholding the Party's leadership. This moment, too, people and service personnel of the DPRK are performing miracles and feats on the strength of their unity, singing this song. The soldiers, who are involved in the reconstruction projects in Komdok area, North and South Hamgyong provinces, Kangwon province, etc., have waged a 24-7 campaign to build new villages and houses under the slogan "Let Us Help the People!" And the people have sincerely helped the soldiers. During those days they fully displayed such noble traits of devotion as respecting, caring for, helping and steering each other. One can hear service personnel saying "our people are the best!" and people saying "our army is the best!" in any places they work together. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greeting Cards Issued for Mother's Day
body: Special greeting cards have been newly issued ahead of the Mother's Day. The Mansudae Art Studio, the Korean Central Fine Arts Studio, Pyongyang University of Fine Arts and the Art and Literature Publishing House issued lots of greeting cards of 16 kinds. Letters reading "Happy Mother's Day", "Congratulations" are written on the cards in different fonts, decorated by beautiful flowers and bouquets. The greeting cards on which the song "Thought of Mother", and the letters "Congratulations 11.16" are depicted with beautiful roses fully represent the respect for mothers who devote themselves to the future of the country. Images of a mother with her beloved baby on her back and children greeting the Mother's Day with the pride of acquiring knowledge, a good moral character and good health are also depicted on the greeting cards. Rodong Sinmun

title: Founding Anniversary of Changgwang Health Complex Marked
body: The Changgwang Health Complex greeted its 40th founding anniversary. The complex is a popular welfare service center. During his visit to the complex on March 21, Juche 69 (1980) ahead of its opening, President Kim Il Sung expressed satisfaction over the best welfare facility. Chairman Kim Jong Il fixed the site for the complex on a picturesque bank of the Pothong River. He visited the complex after its completion and gave instructions to properly conduct management and service. The complex has glorified its honor as a model welfare service facility for the past 40 years. A meeting took place on Tuesday for conveying a congratulatory message sent by the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) to the employees and officials of the complex greeting its 40th founding anniversary. It was attended by Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the WPK. Rodong Sinmun

title: Spirit of Times Encourage Koreans to Work Fresh Miracles
body: The Korean people are making fresh successes in the 80-day campaign towards the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea by waging successive offensive with their inexhaustible spiritual strength. Recorded in the course of the development of the Korean revolution is the great spirit of the times powerfully encouraging all the service personnel and people to perform miracles. During the period of the revolutionary struggle against the Japanese imperialists, the Korean People's Revolutionary Army accomplished the historic cause of national liberation by defeating the Japanese imperialist aggressors in the revolutionary spirit of Paektu. The Korean people, who carried forward the tradition of the anti-Japanese war, demonstrated to the world the dignity and mettle of heroic Korea in the indomitable spirit of defending the country. They completed industrialization, done by other countries for centuries, in only 14 years in the spirit of Chollima. In the 1990s, the period of the arduous march and forced march, the people and service personnel of the DPRK safeguarded the dignity of their socialist country and provided a springboard for building a powerful country in the revolutionary soldier spirit and the spirit of Kanggye. In the new century of Juche, Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un made sure that the people and the service personnel cherish the revolutionary spirit of Paektu, the spirit of the blizzards of Paektu, as the pillar of their faith in their grand advance. Kim Jong Un set the spirit of the Paektusan hero youth and the spirit of Kangwon Province as the model spirit of the times in the advance for socialist construction. World-startling miracles and feats are being made in the DPRK under his guidance for creating the new spirit of the times and making it sweep the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Bags of Various Kinds and Shapes Produced
body: The Kanggye Bag Factory mass-produces multifarious quality bags. The employees of its technological preparation room bring about innovations in their work by dint of collectivism leading and helping each other forward. The members of the KBF’s cutting workteam actively apply rational methods into their work and cut materials for bags over ten days ahead of schedule. Those of its palette printing workteam work hard without shifts to overfulfill their work plan. The needle workers of the KBF, too, register collective successes in their work helping and leading each other forward. Rodong Sinmun

title: Devoted Assistance to Metallurgical Industrial Field
body: The officials, Party members and workers of Pyongyang sent hundreds of tons of iron scraps to the Chollima Steel Complex on November 6 as it had done so in October. Songyo, Central and Taesong districts set an example to their counterparts in this. Rodong Sinmun

title: Concentrates Transport Pipelines Repaired
body: The Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex finished restoring a pipeline for the transport of concentrates. Meanwhile, it promptly cleaned out a waterway for hundreds of meters and thus made it quite easy to test-operate the pipeline and run it on a normal footing. It started to test-operate it from the end of October. The workers of the KCISC are now accelerating the production of their iron and steel rectifying all the mistakes which crop up in pipelining concentrates. Rodong Sinmun

title: Tiles Produced for Reconstruction
body: The Chollima Tile Factory finished producing tiles for inner walls to send them to dwellings under construction in the flood-wrecked areas of the country. Last August it turned out tens of thousands of square meters of tiles for inside walls and donated them to dwellings under construction in Taechong-ri which fell victim to flood damages. It then proceeded to produce hundreds of thousands of square meters of tiles for interior walls in September and October and provide them to those dwellings which were built in the flood-stricken areas of Kangwon and North and South Hwanghae Provinces, Kaechon City and North and South Hamgyong Provinces. Rodong Sinmun

title: Endeavors Made to Increase Fertilizer Output
body: Having overhauled their machines the workers of the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex increase their fertilizer output during their 80-day campaign. The officials, workers and technicians of the Raw Materials, Gas Purification, Urea, Ammonium Nitrate and Water Electrolysis Shops of the HFC as well as its Nitrogen and Composition Shops 1 and 2 have taken good technological care of their machines with a high sense of responsibility and topped their plans by shifts. The technicians of the HFC introduce valuable technological innovations to its fertilizer production so as to actively speed it up. The officials, workers and technicians of the HFC’s auxiliary shops, too, satisfactorily supply its above important shops with spare parts, materials, etc., thereby contributing to increasing its fertilizer production. Rodong Sinmun

title: Fulfillers of Their Yearly Assignments Produced in Coal Industrial Field
body: Affiliated with the Ministry of Coal Industry more than 150 heading squads and mining brigades of the Sunchon Area Youth Coal Mining Complex, the Pukchang Area Youth Coal Mining Complex, the Tokchon Area Coal Mining Complex, the Anju Area Coal Mining Complex and many other complexes fulfilled their national economic plans for 2020 ahead of set time. Rodong Sinmun

title: High Results Achieved despite Their Difficulties
body: The officials and workers of the machine-building industry register success after success in producing machines to order. The Ryongsong Machine Complex and the Taean Heavy Machine Complex hit their production targets ahead of schedule. The Jonchon Rock Drill Factory, the Kusong and Mangyongdae Machine Tool Factories, the Pyongyang Electric Cable General Factory 326, the Kyongsong Insulator Factory, the Songchongang and Jangsan Electric Appliances Factories and many other factories topped their production assignments in 30 days of their 80-day campaign. Rodong Sinmun

title: Defending the Lifeline of the National Economy
body: Those officials and workers engaged in the electric power industry overfulfilled their power production plans for the last 30 days. Having topped their power production assignments over and above their norms in 20 days of their 80-day campaign the workers and management of thermal power plants still go all-out to do that every day. Conscious that an important task of power production is assigned to them the officials and workers of hydropower stations have all done their best to bring about an upswing in their production. The labor and management employed in the coal industry have overfulfilled their coal production assignments for the last 30 days. Rodong Sinmun

title: Farmers Work by the Sweat of Their Brow
body: Thanks to the devotion of agricultural officials and workers the cooperative farms of cities and counties finish threshing their cereals one after another. They proceed to successfully till their fields, produce organic manure and make other arrangements for their farm work for the next year. The agricultural officials and workers of Pyongyang work hard in high spirits. The case is similar to those of North Phyongan and South Hamgyong provinces. Those of Kaesong and Nampho cities, South Phyongan Province and other regions also continue to make advances in their agriculture. Rodong Sinmun

title: People Move to New Houses in Kimhwa County
body: Kimhwa County, Kangwon Province, has been visited by an auspicious event to be envied by all people. New dwelling houses were built in the township and several ris in the county, that had been hit hard by natural disaster, thanks to the courageous day and night campaign waged by soldiers of the People's Army. The houses were wonderfully built under the meticulous guidance and solicitude by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un to form socialist fairyland villages. Ceremonies for moving to the houses were held on Wednesday. Present there were Pak Jong Nam, alternate member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the Kangwon Provincial Committee of the WPK, Ri Yong Rae, department director of the Central Committee of the WPK, Chae Il Ryong, chairman of the Kangwon Provincial People's Committee, officials concerned and working people of the county and soldier-builders. There were congratulatory speeches.
