The speakers said that in October Kim Jong Un personally visited the sites for recovery from disaster in the county and gave his leadership of tireless efforts and devotion to provide the people with happy cradle at an early date. The spectacular fairyland villages are the presents of love given by the mother Party, they said, extending the greatest glory and the warmest thanks to Kim Jong Un. The speakers said that all the officials, working people and residents have to firmly trust and follow Kim Jong Un only with one mind and become creators of feats in the 80-day campaign, always keeping in mind the great solicitude bestowed by the Party Central Committee. Licenses for the use of houses were conveyed to the new house owners. Pledge speeches were made. People moved to new houses in 17 ris and workers' districts including township, Choso-ri and Yonsong-ri in the county on the same day. The officials and the commanding officers of the units that took part in the construction visited the new houses and shared happiness with the new householders, who were beside themselves with joy for receiving the houses with all conditions for living. There was dancing in the villages and laughter of happiness could be heard from every house. Rodong Sinmun

title: Pak Pong Ju Inspects Units in North Phyongan Province
body: Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the WPK, inspected various units in North Phyongan Province. He looked round newly-built production and public buildings and various processes in the Sinuiju Chemical Fibre Mill and stressed the need to put equipment on a more modern basis and satisfactorily settle the issues arising in the processing and transport of raw materials. The field consultative meeting took thoroughgoing measures for providing materials and equipment needed for the project for remodeling and upgrading the mill, and organized the work for actively propelling the science research. He learned about the recycling at the Sinuiju Textile Mill and stressed the need to ensure the living conveniences of the workers. He visited a gymnasium under construction. At the second-stage construction site of the Honggondo tideland which is underway under the grand nature-remaking plan of the Party, he stressed the need to bring earlier the day of completion by stepping up the drainage project which is in the final stage. He also acquainted himself with the Tongraegang reservoir project and this year's farming in Kwaksan County. Rodong Sinmun

title: Strict Measures Taken to Maintain Perfect Anti-epidemic State in DPRK
body: The anti-epidemic work is being intensified across the country to maintain the perfect anti-epidemic state and protect the security of the state and the lives of the people from COVID-19. The central emergency anti-epidemic units have further revved up the public anti-epidemic atmosphere for finding out infection channels and thoroughly preventing any possible inroads of COVID-19. The emergency anti-epidemic units in the coastal areas urge the members of the anti-epidemic posts to enhance their responsibilities and roles to thoroughly carry out disinfection of the crew and ships, as specified in the anti-epidemic protocols, while tightening the rules of entry into sea. In the areas along borders measures are being timely taken to eliminate defects in consolidating the anti-epidemic wall and maintain lockdown. The units handling imports make sure that the relevant officials and members do their bit with awareness that they stand in the frontline for defending the country and people. Workers in public transport, who fully prepared disinfectants and sterilizers, frequently disinfect the passengers and public transport vehicles and take passengers' temperatures properly. Rodong Sinmun

title: More Measures for Prevention of Forest Fire Taken in DPRK
body: In the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, the work for forest conservation and prevention of forest fire has turned into the all-people patriotic one. Prevention of forest fire is the most important work in the revolutionary battle sites, revolutionary sites and regions with trees bearing slogans. All the provinces, cities and counties are making sure that everyone takes an active part in the prevention of forest fire with a sense of civic duty and law observance, bearing in mind that forest conservation preciously means the protection of the land, the ecological environment and the economy. They ensure that all the people voluntarily participate in fire watch and notification in reliance on the system of mobilizing the people and they make material and technical preparations to rapidly cope with a sudden situation. They reviewed the details of every unit's possession of fire-fighting equipment and newly displayed watchwords related with the prevention of forest fire and built fire belts and took full possession of fire-fighting equipment. Forest rangers, forest patrollers and fire guards are boosting inspection of mountains under their charge and intensifying supervision and control over persons who climb mountains under various pretexts in autumn. A guarantee for conserving valuable forest better has been made by the efforts of all the people with consciousness that forest conservation means forest creation. Rodong Sinmun

title: All-people Movement Brings about Great Innovations in DPRK
body: The might of the all-people movement is being fully displayed in the on-going 80-day campaign toward the Eighth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea. The history of our revolution shines with the annals in which the Korean people brought about advance and victories through their all-out movement. The great anti-Japanese revolutionary war started with the people's struggle for gaining arms. The building of a new country began with the general ideological mobilization movement for nation building. This led to the emulation for increased production, the campaign against illiteracy, the patriotic movement of donating grains and the movement for donating funds for weaponry. During the Fatherland Liberation War, the vengeance-taking movement, the campaign for donating relief grains to the front and other movements were widely waged. Movements such as the Chollima workteam movement and the let-one-machine-tool-make-another movement dynamically propelled the drive for building the groundwork of socialism and the overall socialist construction. In the 1970s, the three-revolution red flag movement was brisk across the country and the movement for following the examples of heroes of the era was underway. Later, different public movements such as the movement for creating the speed of the 1980s and the movement for creating the speed of the 1990s were brisk across the country. In the new century for accomplishing the revolutionary cause of Juche, a hot collective emulation is going on amid the campaigns in which one overtakes and learns from others while swapping experience. The all-people movement added luster to the annals of the revolution and construction with proud victories. Rodong Sinmun

title: Stories about Tender-hearted Persons in Our Socialist Country
body: A Diary of Special Service A middle-aged man entered a hotel in Tokchon City on the late night of last October. He had just arrived there by train from elsewhere on business. He went through formalities at a receptionist room of the hotel. He checked in at its room for the night. On the morning of the next day a janitress came to him and kindly asked him whether or not he was comfortable in his bed. She informed him that his breakfast was ready at a dining-room of the hotel and guided him there. He followed her there. He was astonished that the manager of the hotel named Kim In Suk and its employees wished him a happy birthday and took him to a dining table quite unexpectedly. Marveling at this he did not readily take breakfast. A man who ate his meal at the table opposite him told him that the case was similar to him a few days ago on his birthday and that the hotel kept a diary of special service for lodgers and honored them with a good spread on their birthdays from the bottom of their hearts while they observed them at the hotel on official business. The man concerned remembered that the receptionist carefully looked at his citizenship card. He felt a lump in his throat. Shock Workers and "the Mother of Sinuiju" Some time ago Ryom Jong Suk received a letter from the shock workers who restore the flood-wrecked areas of the country. She is a vice-director of an external agency for developing the technology of medicines. It belongs to the People’s Hospital of North Phyongan Province. The letter began with the phrase "the beloved mother of Sinuiju". The word "mother" is explained below. On each occasion she was hugely delighted to hear that innovations were made at the flood-hit areas under reconstruction. Although she did not know the flood victims by name and by face they all belong to the one and the same large socialist family. She thought time and again of helping even a little toward building dwellings at the areas as soon as possible. She hit upon a good idea with joy. She was determined to prepare medicinal spray with garlic good for one’s health and started to do that. Some time afterwards she made thousands of bottles of medicinal spray and travelled quite a distance to the areas with them. This greatly played upon the heartstrings of the shock workers. Simple as it is the medicinal spray reflects the beautiful social traits of our people who love and benefit each other sharing bitters and sweets with each other. Rodong Sinmun

title: Doing All He Can to Bolster Science and Technology
body: Nothing Should Be Stinted One September day in 2013 Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un looked round new-built Unha Scientists Street. Doing the rounds of many dwellings he said that now that they were well-appointed and that everything was kept ready for their housekeeping scientists could remove there without a farthing and yet be well-off there. He added that delighted with this he carried on a revolution. That day he convincingly emphasized that there was nothing to stint for the scientists and technicians who contributed to increasing the national strength of Korea, building the economy and improving the living standard of the people and that when the revolution was carried out with a correct viewpoint of and attitude toward scientists and the talented the country prospered. The officials looked at the shiny street again. Meanwhile, the words of Kim Jong Un deeply touched their hearts. The Key to Growth of Production Kwail County, South Hwanghae Province reaped bumper fruit harvests despite its natural calamities in September 2017. This was quite a miracle. Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un visited the county. He shook hands with its officials one by one and spoke highly of them. He remarked that the officials and workers of the county really took much trouble to produce plenty of fruits in spite of its dire natural disasters and thus demonstrated the great accuracy of the Workers’ Party of Korea’s policy in practice by dint of hard work and enthusiasm in the first year when they set about executing the decisions of the 7th Congress of the WPK. That day he highly praised them for harvesting abundant fruits by recourse to science and technology. He said that this was the age of science and technology, that the days when fruits were raised in reliance on weather had already passed, that advanced methods and technology of fruit production must be applied actively and that the key to fruit production lay in moving it on to a surer scientific, modern and intensive footing than ever. Chewing his words over the officials realized more keenly than before that they had nothing but science and technology to rely on today and that therein lay the key to securing their future happiness as soon as possible. The Ways of Our Society Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un visited the Farm No. 1116 in October 2019. As always he stressed that we had no alternative but to rely on science and technology, that all the spheres and units of the country must firmly keep up the spirit of attaching importance to science and technology and that it should be ensured that it was the ways of the nation for them to carry out their tasks for themselves by recourse to science and technology. No doubt he aimed at giving priority to science and technology and bringing about incessant upswings in building ours into a great socialist powerhouse. Rodong Sinmun

title: Devotion of Medical Workers to Recover a Girl’s Eyesight
body: Not long ago the ophthalmic section of the People’s Hospital of North Phyongan Province cured an inhabitant of Nyongbyon County of her diseased eyes and ensured that she regained her eyesight. She is named Ryu Hyang Gum. The doctors and nurses of the section worked hard day and night to treat her for diseased eyes. They even cooked nourishing dishes for her like her real parents, brothers and sisters to promote her health. They also donated clothes to her according to the season with their whole hearts. Consultative meetings were held very often for Ryu Hyang Gum, followed by the ensuing treatment of her eyes and operations on them. It finally met with success. She began to improve in her eyes. The result of her eyesight test proved astonishingly excellent when it was made some time after. She was given a hearty send-off by the doctors and nurses of the hospital when she left it for home. Rodong Sinmun

title: Building Materials for Reconstruction Produced on Top Priority Basis
body: The officials and workers of North Hamgyong Province enthusiastically carry on their 80-day campaign to produce the finishing building materials they are assigned to do for the dwellings under construction in its flood-stricken areas. Dictated to, the labor and management of the Chongjin Plastic Pipe Factory speedily manufacture their plastic products of various kinds at the final stage. Those engaged in the sector of city management produced dozens of tons of coating materials for housing construction in a short time. The officials and workers of other units, too, overfulfilled their plans for the production of covering materials in over ten days. The Kyongsong Ceramic Complex had already finished turning out sanitary ware for housing construction in the flood-hit areas. Rodong Sinmun

title: Their Coal Production Boosted
body: As of November 10 the workers and management of the Pukchang Area Youth Coal Mining Complex produced more than 4,000 tons more of coal in excess of their plan. The coal mines belonging to the PAYCMC turn out large quantities of coal day by day striving mightily to boost their coal output per shift through an emulation for increased production and make a breakthrough in an increase in their coal production through a brisk high-speed heading drive. Rodong Sinmun

title: Agitprop Activities Effectively Motivate the Masses
body: Agitprop is conducted in real earnest in the domain of the coal industry by its Party organizations to heighten the zeal of its masses for work further. The Party organizations of the Sunchon Area Youth Coal Mining Complex, the Tukjang Area Coal Mining Complex and the Kyongwon Area Coal Mining Complex conduct their ideological work intensively by traveling method with all their agitprop workers and means. In addition, the coal mines of Anju and Tokchon Cities, Pukchang, Kangdong, Onsong and Chonnae Counties and South Hamgyong Province animate their Party members and miners to increased production by means of frontline agitation. Rodong Sinmun

title: Determined to Come Up to the Great Trust of Party Central Committee
body: A month has passed since Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un traveled quite a distance to the flood-wrecked Komdok area on a very precarious railway which was temporarily restored along ravines. The servicemen of the Korean People’s Army units have worked with might and main day and night in the area to live up to the great confidence of Kim Jong Un in them and thus registered one great success after another in their housing construction to everyone’s astonishment. They found out a source of clear quality spring water and built a water tank to enable residents to get it from the taps and use it to their hearts’ contents in their future dwellings. They went the length of laying service pipes as far as all of them in a short time and ensured that they could benefit from water. True to the demand and interest of residents they floored their dwellings with stone slabs underlaid by horizontal smoke passages and thereby set up their good underfloor heating system. They also built smart kitchen ranges to their great admiration. Dwellings are near completion by and large in the flood-wrecked Komdok area. In the meantime roads are paved full steam with soil mixed with hardeners between groups of dwellings. Rodong Sinmun

title: Thousands of Dwelling Houses Built in Samjiyon City
body: Samjiyon City in Paektu area has seen another auspicious event. New modern dwelling houses for thousands of families were built in more than 10 dongs and ris in Samjiyon City by the endeavors of all the commanding officers and shock brigade members of Division 216 and soldier-builders. Meetings for moving to new houses were held in Paektusanmilyong-dong, Sinmusong-dong, Rimyongsu-dong, Phothae-dong, Ohomuldong-dong, Junghung-ri, Hunggyesu-ri, Sobaeksan-ri, Paeksam-ri, Poso-ri and Thongsin-ri. Present there were Tong Jong Ho, vice-premier of the Cabinet, Pak Hun, minister of Construction and Building-Materials Industry, Pak Song Chol, vice department director of the Central Committee of the WPK, officials and working people in Samjiyon City, commanding officers and shock brigade members of Division 216 and soldier-builders. There were congratulatory speeches. The speakers said that socialist fairyland villages appeared in Paektu area under the warm solicitude shown by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. They sent greetings of gratitude in reflection of the unanimous mind of the people in Samjiyon City and all over the country to Kim Jong Un who is bringing all blessings in the world to the people, taking all of them to his arms. They stressed the need for the officials and working people of the city to further spruce up and take good care of the sacred land of the revolution as the utopian land of socialism and remain loyal to our Party with pure conscience and obligation. Licenses for the use of the houses were conveyed at the meetings. There were pledge speeches. Amid laughter and singing and dancing, people began to move to new houses. Officials visited new houses and congratulated their owners, sharing the joy. Rodong Sinmun

title: Choe Ryong Hae Inspects Jungsan County
body: Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, acquainted himself with the farming and afforestation and water-conservancy in Jungsan County. Agricultural workers in Chongsan-ri and Phungjong-ri of Jungsan County brought about a bumper harvest by working hard throughout this year despite unfavorable climate in order to uphold the policy of the Party, which set the agricultural front as a major thrust of the offensive for making a breakthrough head-on, with increased grain production. He acquainted himself with the farming in ris and stressed the need to finish threshing in a responsible way at the earliest date and thus greet the 8th Congress of the Party with a bumper harvest. He referred to the ways to thoroughly implement the Party's policy of afforestation and water-conservancy in the county by creating shelter belts with rapidly-growing trees like Sangwon poplar in conformity with natural and topographical features of seaside region and conducting river improvement and dredging of rivers under a detailed plan. He, going round the mother tree nursery of the county forestry management station, took measures to put sapling cultivation on a higher scientific, industrial and intensive basis. Rodong Sinmun

title: Rising Up with Trust in Their Own Strength
body: The officials, Party members and workers of North Hwanghae Province built a new energy- and labor-saving cement branch with a production capacity of dozens of thousands of tons on a small piece of land in the Kyongam Cement Factory with their technology for themselves. The result is that another guarantee has been afforded for the economic development of the country and the improvement of the living standard of the people. The officials, workers and technicians of the KCF are now trying hard to put the producer on a surer automatic footing while at the same time rapidly making dynamic preparations to operate it on a full scale. Rodong Sinmun

title: Remodeling of Pig Farm Reaches Final Stage
body: North Phyongan Province strives energetically to rebuild the Army-People Ryongchon Pig Farm on modern lines during its 80-day campaign of loyalty. The pork production capacity of the APRPF will be augmented further than before by newly building or rebuilding a production process for the fodders fermented by additives, a pork processing room, etc. The APRPF has already built a protein fodder house. It is now working hard to construct a production process for the fodder fermented by additives, a corn fermentation shop and a protein insect habitat. It also directs its efforts to procure what are needed to modernize its production processes and improve the technological knowledge and skills of its employees. The APRPF makes active endeavors to install the machines of tens of kinds made by the workers of its province in the production process for the fodders fermented by additives and the corn fermentation shop as soon as possible. The APRPF has been moved on to a modern footing by far more than 90%. Rodong Sinmun

title: Pothonggang Mineral Spring Registered as Natural Monument
body: The waters from a mineral spring on the Pothong River have been inscribed as a natural monument of Korea anew. The spring is situated round the Pothonggang Revolutionary Site, haunted by many people. According to an old dweller in Mangyongdae District, the mineral waters help toward one’s good digestion and whet one’s appetite. Another old resident in Sosong District remarked that his blood pressure had become stable and that he had grown vigorous since he began to drink the mineral waters. A middle-aged woman of Moranbong District said that she cured her hands and feet of their skin disease with the mineral waters and that they certainly gave longevity to people. According to the waitresses for the mineral spring, its waters are very highly efficacious pharmaceutically because they are subalkaline, spring up from the rocks lying deep underground, abound in chlorine, baking soda, sodium ion and other potassium, calcium, magnesium, etc badly needed for the human body and include rare metals. Therefore, the mineral waters prove effective in preventing and curing chronic gastroenteritis, chronic enteritis, chronic colitis, stomach ulcer, duodenal ulcer, diabetes, hypertension and many other diseases. They are also good for cutaneous diseases. Rodong Sinmun

title: A Happy Palace of Workers
body: Many years have passed since the workers’ hostel of the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill was newly built and occupied by inmates. After their shifts the women weavers of the textile mill come back to their hostel and have a happy time there. Some of them get telelectures at an e-book room of their hostel while others assiduously improve their culinary techniques at its cookroom. The hostel is really a palace of workers which bears clear testimony to the great solicitude of our Party and socialist system for them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Efforts Directed to Devising New Products
body: The Jangjasan Foodstuff General Factory invents and produces popular goods of dozens of sorts with raw materials available in its locality. It enhances the role of its technicians and skilled workers and increases the utilization of its local raw materials under its plan to devise new products. The JFGF ensured that its employees amplified their knowledge in its science and technology learning space and at many other courses and exchanged their technology and experiences with others actively. The JFGF is now all-out to achieve its realistic goal of developing new products during its 80-day campaign of loyalty. Rodong Sinmun

title: Fruition of Dynamic Socialist Emulation
body: For recent several months the quality of more than 70 manufacturing processes and products of over ten kinds was authenticated in nearly 50 units. Besides, products of about 60 sorts of 10-odd units were inscribed as the February 2 Product. The quality control system for manufacturing processes was authenticated in the units of construction and building materials industry, light industry, the electronic industry and many other units. The foodstuff safety control system for tens of manufacturing processes was also authenticated in many foodstuff producers which have carefully controlled the quality and sanitary safety of their products. The factories and enterprises throughout the country went out to produce their goods like the excellent February 2 Product. Rodong Sinmun

title: Preparations for Next Year's Farming Stepped Up
body: The agricultural workers of North Phyongan Province register good successes in finishing their farm work for this year and making all-out preparations for their next year's agriculture. The Rural Economy Committee of NPP scrupulously arranges for the plan for the preparations for the next year's farm work to be carried out unconditionally that day on each occasion. For the purpose of tilling paddies and dry fields, applying lots of manure to them and making them fertile during the 80-day campaign the province adopts tough measures to ensure that the Jongju Tractor Parts Factory and other farm machine stations of its cities and counties satisfactorily produce farm machine accessories on indices. In addition, it strengthens the material and technological foundations of the existing producers of nutrients, germicides, insecticides and slaked lime of all kinds so that they can prove effective. The province also makes steady preparations for growing high-yielding drought-resistant crops in its areas short of water and introducing advanced farming methods into its low-yielding areas. Rodong Sinmun

title: Women Devote Themselves to Reconstruction in DPRK
body: The 80-day campaign of loyalty for glorifying the Eighth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea has witnessed the noble spiritual world of the women devoting themselves to the country and the people, the society and the collective. Among them are women party members who volunteered to take part in reconstruction after sending their young children to their parents' houses, a woman who volunteered to work in reconstruction sites in place of her husband who was hospitalized, and a woman, who has devotedly worked on behalf of her husband who sacrificed his life during a combat training, out of the intense loyalty to repay the great trust of the Party that posted the People's Army to the fore of reconstruction. Women's union's art squad members of Pyongyang City have also worked hard in the reconstruction sites while giving performances encouraging the builders. Women's union members of South and North Hamgyong provinces, Kangwon Province, Kaesong City made positive contributions to finishing the reconstruction projects ahead of schedule by voluntarily preparing the needed materials and carrying out other tasks. Their patriotic devotion has led to a big stride in the reconstruction project. Women's union members in Komdok area have dedicated themselves to reconstruction as early birds in the sites. They are encouraging the soldier-builders by becoming barbers for them and repairing their shoes. Women of the capital city went to the sites with lots of supplies they prepared at home. They dedicated their vacation to reconstruction. All these facts show the Korean women's intense loyalty to the Party and their ardent patriotism. Rodong Sinmun

title: 20th Enlarged Meeting of Political Bureau of 7th Central Committee of WPK Held
body: The 20th Enlarged Meeting of the Political Bureau of the 7th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) was held at the office building of the Central Committee of the WPK on Sunday at a time when the 80-day campaign of loyalty is vigorously underway toward the new victory by tiding over manifold challenges and difficulties in our advance toward the 8th Congress of the WPK under the leadership of the great Central Committee of the WPK. Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, was present at the meeting. Attending the meeting were members of the Presidium and members and alternate members of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee. Present there as observers in the video conference system were officials of relevant departments of the WPK Central Committee, chairpersons of the provincial Party committees, minister of Public Security, the director of the Central Public Prosecutors Office and the members of the state emergency anti-epidemic sector. Upon authorization of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK, Supreme Leader of the Party, state and armed forces Kim Jong Un presided over the meeting. The meeting discussed in depth the issue of further tightening the state emergency anti-epidemic system in the face of the ever-worsening worldwide health crisis. The Supreme Leader analyzed and assessed the serious worldwide spread of COVID-19 and the state anti-epidemic situation and clarified the tasks for the Party, military and economic fields to further tighten the emergency anti-epidemic front, the major front of the 80-day campaign, and ways for doing so. He also stressed the need to keep a high alert, build a tight blocking wall and further intensify the anti-epidemic work, being aware of the important responsibility for the security of the state and the well-being of the people. The meeting reported the analysis of non-socialist practices in educational organizations and in society as a whole, and seriously discussed the issues to decisively root them out. Sharply criticized at the meeting were the Party committee of Pyongyang University of Medicine which committed a serious crime, and the irresponsibility and extreme dereliction of duty of relevant departments of the Central Committee of the WPK, judicial and procuratorial organs and security organizations which shielded, connived and fostered the crime by failing to tighten the Party guidance over the university and by failing to strengthen the system of handling complaints, legal monitoring and control. The enlarged meeting of the Political Bureau emphasized the need to awaken the Party organizations at all levels once again and wage a fierce Party-wide struggle to root out practices against the Party, the people and socialism and the need for the law enforcement organs, in particular, to upgrade the law enforcement so as to make sure that beautiful socialist traits are maintained in the overall socio-political, economic and moral life. The Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee made deep study and discussion of agenda items referred to it and set forth important tasks and adopted relevant decisions with unanimous approval. Political News Team

title: Korean People Cherish Spirit of War Victors in 1950s
body: A brisk campaign for greeting the Eighth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea with great successes is underway in the DPRK swept by a resolute fighting spirit. The inexhaustible strength propelling the current grand advance is a proud fighting spirit displayed by the victors of the war in the 1950s under the guidance of President Kim Il Sung. The fighting spirit in the 1950s is the spirit of devotedly defending the leader and the country and the spirit of creation and innovation displayed by the Korean people and soldiers of the People's Army in the stern period when the destiny of the country was at the crossroads of survival or ruin. The Korean people and service personnel were revolutionary optimists strong in faith, who waged a death-defying struggle with an unshakable faith that they were sure to win in the war as they were led by the President, when huge formidable enemy forces launched an offensive and the situation turned unfavorable. The fighting spirit displayed by the war victors in the 1950s also helped the Korean people bring about great leaps forward in the era of Chollima after the war by tightening their belts. They also carried out socialist transformation and laid solid foundations for self-supporting economy. The spirit also led them to a heyday in the era of the Workers' Party, when the spirit of the speed campaign swept the country. By dint of the fighting sprit, the Korean people could successfully conclude the arduous march, the forced march in the 1990s and laid everlasting foundations for building a powerful country. The heroic fighting spirit displayed in the 1950s was a motive power that enabled the Korean people to further consolidate the single-minded unity on the basis of their absolute loyalty to the great leaders and perform uninterrupted miracles generation after generation. Today, they are making unprecedented innovations and successes in every worksite of the 80-day campaign in a heroic, indomitable fighting spirit under the leadership of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, like the war victors in the 1950s. Rodong Sinmun

title: Kim Tok Hun Inspects Taean Heavy Machine Complex and Mindulle Notebook Factory
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected the Taean Heavy Machine Complex and the Mindulle Notebook Factory. At the Taean Heavy Machine Complex, he gave pep-talks to its workers working hard to produce custom-built equipment ahead of schedule amid the intensive 80-day campaign. Making rounds of its several workshops, he stressed the need to positively introduce efficient jigs and equipment and new technical innovations to production so as to process and assemble the products in a responsible way. Underscoring the need to normalize the production at the Mindulle Notebook Factory associated with the loving care of the Party for future generations, he discussed the ways to find and use materials lying idle by directing primary efforts to recycling. The field consultative meetings took measures to finish the production of custom-built equipment as early as possible with a proper business and management strategy, and fully supply raw materials necessary for the production of good-quality notebooks. Rodong Sinmun

title: Mother's Day Marked in DPRK
body: The Korean people marked the Mother's Day. They visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the sacred temple of Juche where President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il lie in state, and paid high tribute to them. They also visited the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill and in various parts of the country and portraits of the smiling leaders. They laid floral baskets, bouquets and flowers at the statues and portraits of the smiling leaders before making a bow. The mothers across the country were warmly congratulated. Soldiers of the People's Army and sons and daughters dedicating their enthusiasm to socialist construction in every worksite for the on-going intensive 80-day campaign sent greeting cards to their mothers. Children of women of the divisions of Party members of the capital city sent congratulatory messages to their mothers, livening up the atmosphere of the worksites for reconstruction campaign. Youth in various parts of the country visited flower shops to prepare bouquets for their mothers. Performances were given to mark the Mother's Day. Public catering establishments across the country sincerely served mothers. Rodong Sinmun

title: Art Performances Mark Mother's Day
body: Major art troupes gave performances in theaters of the capital city to greet the Mother's Day. The Samjiyon Orchestra gave a performance at the Samjiyon Theater and the National Symphony Orchestra at the Moranbong Theater. A performance was given by the Mansudae Art Troupe at the East Pyongyang Grand Theatre. The performers warmly congratulated the mothers across the country who are giving continuity to the lineage of the Juche revolution with patriotism and loyalty and noble devotion and leading a worthy life. Reflecting on the numbers were the grateful greetings all the sons and daughters are offering to the mothers raising the fruits of happiness while devoting themselves to their children. Performances given at the National Theatre, Pyongyang Circus Theater and Ponghwa Art Theatre delighted the people greeting the Mother's Day. Rodong Sinmun

title: On the Morning of a Meaningful Day
body: On the morning of the Mother’s Day mothers in the DPRK respectfully thank the great Workers’ Party of Korea for its love for them. Pae Kwang Hui, doctor and associate professor of the Korean Language Faculty of Kim Il Sung University, has greeted the MD in warm retrospect. Born and bred in a common family she graduated from Kim Il Sung University and has since taught there for dozens of years. In those days she won the Kim Il Sung Youth Honor Prize, qualified as doctor and associate professor, announced treatises at international academic fora and functioned as a judge or president of the board of examiners for a time. The WPK admirably trained not only her but also all the members of her family, bestowed a modern apartment at the Ryonghung Crossing upon her. It has also ensured that she is an educator of authority and a member of an international organization. This is quite unthinkable without the favors of the WPK. Therefore, in the morning she acknowledged her infinite thanks to the WPK on this MD. The case is similar to Kim Chun Hui, weightlifting coach of the Kigwancha Sports Team, and Ri Yong Hui, workshop head of the Pyongyang Children’s Foodstuff Factory. Those mothers who happily live in new superb houses thanks to the favors of the WPK as in a dream, the mothers of the servicemen of the Korean People’s Army units who enjoyed themselves under the loving care of the WPK at the Yangdok Hot Spring Resort built by the latter and large numbers of other mothers who are distinguished as patriots, merited women and innovators whole-heartedly bow to the WPK as a token of their boundless gratitude to it. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greenhouse Vegetables Produced in Larger Amount
body: The Jongju City Vegetable Greenhouse mass-produces vegetables. It continues to direct its great efforts into boosting its vegetable production with advanced culture technology. Above all, it channels its primary efforts into learning advanced technologies of raising vegetables of new strains in close connection with the scientific institutes concerned. The primary cadres and employees of the JCVG have made great efforts to fertilize their indoor fields. They are now continuing to do their utmost to produce vegetables of new species and many others in greater quantities than ever in their greenhouse. Rodong Sinmun

title: Art Theater Built at Final Stage in Jagang Province
body: In Jagang Province a provincial art theatre is near completion on the shore of the picturesque Jangja River. It has a seating capacity of over 1,500, an elevator-style stage, a movable stage, a central hall, etc. It also boasts training rooms for vocalists, instrumentalists and dancers, a makeup room and so on. They will actively help toward the satisfactory creative activities of its artistes. The shock workers register initiative successes in their construction of the theatre firmly determined to honor the forthcoming 8th WPK Congress with them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Reservoir Expansion Project Completed in Short Period
body: Pyongyang successfully completed a large reservoir in slightly over ten days. The Pyongyang Municipal Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea made detailed organizational and political arrangements for finishing the reservoir expansion project in a short time during the 80-day campaign. This would make a breakthrough in settling the drinking water problem of the citizens decisively. The officials, the WPK members and workers of Pyongyang buckled down to the reservoir expansion project from last mid-October. The headquarters for the project ensured that all was done to excavate the ground for the expansion of the reservoir, cover its shores with large stones and realign its surroundings and that all this was carried out faster than ever day by day. By dint of hard work the officials, WPK members and workers of Pyongyang excavated the ground, removed tens of thousands of cubic meters of soil, coated the wide banks of the reservoir with large stones and embanked in about ten days. The finished reservoir expansion project has made sure that the citizens of Pyongyang can be provided with good-quality water more satisfactorily than before without being adversely affected by the season. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supply Service Is Precisely Political Work
body: President Kim Il Sung joined company with officials in Tokchon in March Juche 66(1977) to discuss how to give their better supply service to its workers for their welfare. He said that supply service was precisely political work and that unless it did not go with good supply welfare service agitation alone did not enable the people to give full play to their revolutionary enthusiasm and creative initiative and dynamically speed up their socialist economic construction. He then proceeded to say with a look of sentimental reminiscence that although his unit was in great difficulty during the anti-Japanese armed struggle he always paid special attention to the supply welfare service for his soldiers and that they were therefore in very high combat morale and won every battle. Counting the order of priority on his fingers he stressed that if good supply service was not given to workers for their welfare in Tokchon not only coal but also others could not be produced and that everything could not go on smoothly. The officials seriously reproached themselves for not remaining true to his lofty intentions. Looking round them he told them to bear deep in mind that supply welfare service was one of important political affairs and give priority in their work all the time to improving and intensifying the supply service for the welfare of workers. Besides, he adopted the related measures one by one. He fully convinced the officials that whether or not good supply service was given to working people for their welfare entirely depended on their attitude toward them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Networks of Facilities Built in Reclaimed Tideland
body: Field lanes and irrigation structures are built and ridges between rice paddies realigned full steam in the reclaimed tideland dyked from the seashore to the Honggon, Ryongmae and Chongsu Islands and back. The Brigade of North Phyongan Province of the Land Realignment Shock Force and the April 22 Land Realignment Shock Force carry out extensive work projects during their 80-day campaign to build field lanes and irrigation structures and realign ridges between paddies in full swing and thereby increase arable land in area. Rodong Sinmun

title: Frontline-style Agitprop Revs Up the Country in Its General Advance
body: The art bodies and art propaganda squads of national institutions are now briskly conducting frontline economic agitation in all parts of the country to vigorously goad all the members of the Workers’ Party of Korea, workers and the rest of people into carrying on the 80-day campaign. To be exact, this is done at the major work places of the national economy and many other job sites or while they are on their way to work. Consequently, a great upswing is brought about in our nationwide production. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Greetings to Syrian President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a message of greeting to Bashar Al-Assad, president of the Syrian Arab Republic, on Nov. 16. Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in the message extended warm congratulations and greeting on behalf of the government and people of the DPRK to the president, government and people of the Syrian Arab Republic on the occasion of the 50th anniversary of the corrective movement in Syria. The message said that the Syrian people have made great progress in accomplishing the cause of building a new independent and prosperous society under the correct leadership of HE Hafez Al-Assad and the president for the past 50 years since the corrective movement. Extending invariable support and solidarity to the president and the people of Syria in their just struggle for firmly defending the sovereignty and security of the country in the face of all kinds of difficulties and trials, the message expressed belief that the historical relations of friendship and cooperation between the two countries would grow stronger. Rodong Sinmun

title: Active Preparation for Supply of Irrigation Water
body: Officials and agricultural workers across the country make great efforts to recover their flood and typhoon damage as soon as possible and enable their irrigation system to do a world of good to their next year’s farm work. Vigorous endeavors are made to restore and refit the dikes of medium and small streams, irrigation canals and structures, the spillways and discharge gates of reservoirs, pumping machines, etc till the end of this year. The officials of the Ministry of Agriculture and all the provinces, cities and counties of the country detailedly arrange for irrigation setups to be refitted to perfection, settle the relevant knotty problems in good time and adopt drastic measures to procure materials necessary for the project so that it can be carried out quickly. Throughout the country the dikes of medium and small streams are restored full steam and all is also done to satisfactorily irrigate farmland in 2021. Rodong Sinmun

title: Irrigation Structure Repaired by Their Own Effort
body: The officials and agricultural workers of Jungsan County finished repairing 14 irrigation structures in a short time, thereby affording an important guarantee for fully irrigating farmland in 2021. The senior officials of the county fully applied themselves to securing the materials needed for the irrigation projects. They took charge of each of the projects and set a personal example to the agricultural workers on the spot giving them advices on their repairs. Consequently, the officials and agricultural workers of the Mubon, Chongsan and Raksaeng Cooperative Farms and other farms of the county disposed of huge cubic meters of soil and concreted hundreds of square meters of irrigation canals at one go-off. Rodong Sinmun

title: Emergency Anti-epidemic Activities Intensified in DPRK
body: Emergency anti-epidemic units at all levels are taking measures for further tightening the state emergency anti-epidemic system in order to implement the tasks set forth at the 20th Enlarged Meeting of the Political Bureau of the 7th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. The central emergency anti-epidemic unit is tightening control and guidance over all its officials to make sure that they fulfill their duty as leading personnel of the revolution. The emergency anti-epidemic units across the country urge the members of the anti-epidemic posts to strictly disinfect passers-by and vehicles as specified in the anti-epidemic protocols, making sure that the citizens voluntarily observe such anti-epidemic protocols as disinfection of hands and mask wearing. The emergency anti-epidemic units in the areas along borders and the demarcation line and coastal areas make sure that citizens handle any trifling abnormal phenomena from the anti-epidemic viewpoint after rapidly informing the relevant organs of them. Every unit is conducting hygienic information service through visual aids in working sites and thoroughly disinfecting offices, working sites, and equipment, raw and other materials, while taking measures after finding those with such doubtful symptoms as fever and cough. Public catering facilities and public transport agencies thoroughly check the inroads of the malignant virus by improving their sanitary condition and fully preparing disinfectants, sprayers and other necessary tools and materials. Rodong Sinmun

title: Earnest Request Reflected in Commemorative Photo
body: The officials and workers of the Pyongyang Cornstarch Factory always cherish a souvenir photograph they had taken with Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un there when he visited it in June 2016 in a pouring rain. On that occasion he dropped in at the general analytical laboratory of the PCF. He said that the laboratory fully convinced him that the PCF was a national frontline unit. Adding that he was informed that during its reconstruction the PCF mostly fitted out its analytic laboratory with homemade analytic equipment he spoke highly of it. He affirmed with great joy that it was a very good thing for the PCF to make for itself the analytical equipment which had formerly been imported. He stressed that he demanded that not only production facilities but also all other machines like analytical equipment should be made at home as at the PCF and that this was the idea and plan of our Party. He continued to say that the PCF was a model factory which advanced under the banner of Juche orientation, a factory which could be a standard of self-reliance and self-development and a textbook on the way of modernization. That day he said that he would pose with the employees of the PCF for a photo session and made for a related ground in spite of a heavy rain. Much time passed till they all gathered at the ground. But he suggested waiting for them for some time to have a photograph taken with the employees of the PCF and waited for them for long in a downpour. When they were photographed with him the officials and workers of the PCF confirmed their determination to work hard energetically all the time despite all trials and ordeals under the banner of self-reliance and self-development as he earnestly wished. Rodong Sinmun

title: Dissemination of New Technologies Brisk in DPRK
body: Proactive dissemination of updated information by the Central Information Agency for Science and Technology helps broaden the vision of scientists, technologists, officials and working people all out in the on-going 80-day campaign in the DPRK. It has transferred necessary data to sci-tech learning spaces of many units across the country, propelling the growth in production and economic revitalization at those units. It has also contributed to cementing the anti-epidemic wall by comprehensively analyzing and systemizing the data about disinfection for preventing the inroads of COVID-19. Drawing attention of relevant officials and workers is its dissemination of new technologies helpful to putting electric power, coal, metal, chemical and machine industries on a modern and IT basis and mapping out scientific management and business strategies. Rodong Sinmun

title: Women’s Union Members Encourage People on Their Way to Work in Pyongyang
body: Every day the female members of the organizations of the Socialist Women’s Union of Korea conduct energetic agitation activities in the morning in many parts of Pyongyang to inspire its working citizens with courage and confidence so that they can report for work in a hurry. Being the housewives of large families they have to bring up their children and attend on their parents-in-law in the meantime. Truth to tell, it is therefore no easy job for them to finish their kitchen work, quietly leave home and carry on art activities in the street early in the morning to encourage the citizens of the city who are on their way to work. They include the wives of disabled soldiers. Rodong Sinmun

title: Efforts Channeled into Developing New Product
body: The labor and management of the Pyongyang Spices Factory invented new products of over ten kinds this year. They are now scoring one success after another in their production. The researchers of the PSF’s spice institute select aromatic plants, extract natural perfumes from them and purify them to strictly meet the demand of technological rules and standard operation methods in all processes. Meanwhile, they push ahead with the development of other natural perfumes They have worked hard to extract natural perfumes from fruits of tara vines, jujubes and others and make perfumes with the by-products of various kinds of meat and seafoods. Consequently, they have developed plenty of natural perfumes this year alone. The PSF has devised and produced edible perfumes of over ten kinds, which are used and favorably commented on by many foodstuff producers. Rodong Sinmun

title: Afforestation Pushed Forward in a Foresighted Way
body: Afforestation is stepped up in a far-sighted way throughout the country. Above all, the General Bureau of Forest under the Ministry of Land and Environmental Protection ensures that trees are planted on the principle of the right number on the right soil. Active efforts are made to plant trees of diverse kinds of great economic value together in the mountains of the country and convert them into thick forests. Trees of good kinds are planted a lot in many areas of South Phyongan and North Hwanghae provinces. The officials and workers of the country also exert themselves to form windbreaks. Rodong Sinmun

title: Thousands of Meters of Belt Conveyor Being Built
body: The Ryongdae Youth Coal Mine tried hard to install a new belt conveyor from its pit face to its coal depot for thousands of meters to increase its coal conveyance capacity and completed it by over 70% in a bit more than a month. The RYCM tunnels into its coalfield to install its belt conveyor and extends and fortifies the relevant tunnel in full swing. Its miners speedily build a surface structure to install the belt conveyor from an approach to a main pit to the coal depot for 1,000-odd meters. The workers and technicians of the repair and maintenance shop of the RYCM find out and tap out their internal reserves to the maximum and turn out for themselves lots of the accessories needed to install the belt conveyor. The result is that they contribute greatly to the project. The officials of the Ministry of Coal Industry and the Sunchon Area Youth Coal Mining Complex visit the RYCM for its belt conveyor on occasion to acquire firsthand knowledge of its installation, resolve its knotty problems in hand opportunely and actively help toward it. Rodong Sinmun

title: Extension of Large-scale Oxygen Separator at Final Stage
body: at Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex The workers and management of the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex erect a building for another gigantic oxygen separator at full steam while at the same time exerting its efforts on its production. The building is completed by and large and the oxygen separator assembled at its final stage. Frontline agitation is given actively on the spot and success after success is hourly registered in the completion and assemblage on the other hand. Attaching great importance to science and technology the HISC successfully produces on its own the apparatus needed to install the oxygen separator. Rodong Sinmun

title: Sariwon Youth Open-air Theatre Newly Built
body: The Sariwon Youth Open-air Theater has been built admirably at the picturesque foot of Mt Sangmae in Sariwon City. It will contribute actively to educating the working and young people of North Hwanghae Province and benefiting their cultural and emotional lives. Rodong Sinmun

title: Cooperative Fields Seethe with Preparation for Next Year’s Farming
body: The cooperative farms of North Phyongan Province go all-out to make arrangements for their agricultural production in 2021. The agricultural officials and workers of Sinuiju City have already finished tilling their fields. They are now going ahead with another work in high spirits. Those of other cities and counties of the province fully apply themselves to digging out the beds of their streams and repairing their banks and their irrigation structures. They also secure water for future use. Rodong Sinmun

title: Cement Production Boosted Day after Day
body: The workers and management of the Puraesan Cement Factory have tried their hardest day and night to turn out more cement than ever since they vowed to the Party that they would hit their cement production target ahead of schedule. They score success after success in this. The workers of its mining shop blast lime fields efficiently and put their excavators in full operation, thus executing their limestone production plan without fail. The drivers of its transport squad make daily successes in transporting materials and raw materials. The workers of the PCF’s auxiliary shop preferentially turn out the spare parts needed to operate its machines at full capacity and firmly ensure successes in the increased production of its cement. Rodong Sinmun

title: Phosphatic Manure Production Process Built at Final Stage
body: Kangwon Province is all-out to complete a phosphatic fertilizer shop. Thanks to it, the province will be able to turn out phosphatic and potassic fertilizer for its agricultural production for itself with its technology and raw materials. The officials, workers and technicians of the province are now striving mightily to change its looks completely. Rodong Sinmun

title: Musan Mining Complex Increases Production during 80-Day Campaign
body: The workers of the Musan Mining Complex top their daily production assignments courageously despite their difficulties. The workers of the MMC’s open branch mine have reliably done their part as the leading sector of its production since they blew up a mountain by 400,000 cubic meters earth at the outset of their 80-day campaign. The drivers of its ore transport station register singular successes in transporting ores. The workers of its ore-dressing shop raise their technological knowledge and skills further and try hard to increase their output by recourses to science and technology. Rodong Sinmun

title: Demonstrating Fighting Spirit of Never Knowing Impossibility
body: Officials and workers successfully build the Hungju Youth Power Station No. 5 nearly twice as fast as they did. Consequently, a solid guarantee has been afforded for completing it ahead of set time. They changed the course of the Jangja River in more than 40 days and finished a cofferdam in ten days although this was considered to take them upward of a month. Rodong Sinmun

title: Members of Divisions of Elite Party Members from Capital City Arrive Here
body: Members of the divisions of the elite Party members from the capital city returned home on Friday after creating heroic and legendary stories and achieving victory in the most difficult reconstruction campaign sites in South and North Hamgyong provinces. They were warmly seen off by officials of the Party and power organs and working people in South and North Hamgyong provinces as they were leaving for Pyongyang with a report of loyalty and proud victory to the great Party Central Committee. The trains arrived at Pyongyang Railway Station carrying the members of the divisions of the Party members of the capital city, patriots and core members of the Party, who returned home in triumph. The divisions of the elite Party members of the capital city were warmly greeted by Pak Thae Dok and Kim Yong Chol, vice-chairmen of the WPK Central Committee, Kim Yong Hwan, chairman of the Pyongyang City Committee of the WPK, cadres of the Party Central Committee and officials of the city. Giving bouquets and flowers, the Party and administrative officials of the relevant units congratulated the trustworthy and proud combatants who set new epoch-making examples of implementing the ideas of the Party and upholding its policies. They received a hero's welcome from their families and relatives who had asked them to come back home as honorable victors at the reconstruction campaign. Upon the news of the arrival of the divisions from loudspeaker vans, a lot of citizens warmly welcomed the vanguard fighters. The atmosphere of welcoming them revved up as the buses with them entered Ryomyong Street near the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the sacred temple of Juche. Voices congratulating the members of the divisions who created an excellent example in the reconstruction campaign and in all aspects of their life as befit members of the Party from the capital city and recorded praiseworthy feats in the record book of 80-day campaign of loyalty could be heard along the streets and from windows of flats. Rodong Sinmun

title: Meeting of Members of Divisions of Party Members from Capital City Held
body: A meeting of the members of the divisions of the Party members from the capital city was held at the plaza of the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the sacred temple of Juche, on Friday to make a report of loyalty to President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. The heroes and heroines of the divisions who fully displayed their honor as lifeguards and special detachment of the Party Central Committee by successfully performing the combat duty given by the Party proudly entered the plaza with the report of proud victory and glory. Taking the platform were Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the WPK, Kim Yong Hwan, chairman of the Pyongyang City Committee of the WPK, commanding officials and exemplary members of the divisions of Party members in the capital city and leading officials of the Party and administrative organs in Pyongyang City. All the participants bowed to the portraits of smiling Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il. Commander of the Division No.1 of Party Members of the Capital City Choe Hwi, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK and vice-chairman of the Party Central Committee, made a report of loyalty to Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il. The reporter presented the report of victory and loyalty to Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il, eternal leaders of our Party and people and sun of Juche, that the Party members from the capital city successfully carried out the militant duty given by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. He said that despite harsh conditions and environment, all the members of the divisions waged all-out charge of loyalty and fierce day and night campaign in a blitz war formula to build single-story houses and low-story apartments for hundreds of families and rehabilitate roads and rivers strong enough to stand any floods, out of pledge of faith to realize the noble plan of the Party Central Committee even at the cost of their lives. He continued that the members of the divisions of the Party members from the capital city could fully display their might as the special detachment of the Party Central Committee as there were the great trust and loving care shown by Kim Jong Un as he visited the distant and dangerous disaster-hit areas before others, sent an open letter, sent militant encouragement and thanks to them from the high podium in the military parade for celebrating the 75th anniversary of the WPK and looked after the members of the divisions all the time. Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the WPK Central Committee, made a congratulatory speech. Upon authorization of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, Pak Pong Ju, in the name of the Party Central Committee, warmly congratulated all the members of the divisions who displayed honor of the divisions of elite Party members from the capital city and made the report of victory and loyalty to Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il in the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun. The members of the divisions are vanguard fighters and heroes who recorded a proud page in the glorious history of our Party and showed in practice how our Party members have to devotedly defend the Party Central Committee, he stressed. He called on all of them to strikingly demonstrate the spirit of continued innovation and advance at their revolutionary posts and thus further glorify their honor as the party members of the capital city most trusted by the Party Central Committee in the revolutionary advance toward the 8th Congress of the WPK. A letter of pledge to Kim Jong Un was adopted at the meeting. Rodong Sinmun

title: Their Heroic Feats Will Be Ever-lasting
body: Rodong Sinmun

title: "Famers Like It"
body: Pointing to a conspicuous two-storied sanatorium which stands on a knoll at the seat of his ri an official of the Yakjon Farm of Sukchon County said that its members were really fond of it. It is a good match for a superb sanatorium and what is better, its interior is neat and tidy. In the past the YF laid good foundations for its supply service for the welfare of the sanatorium, face-lifted its interior and exterior and did many other things to run it on a normal footing. Researches were carried on into finishing building materials at the YF with the help of scientists and technicians to produce them with raw materials richly available at its locality. Consequently, it has become able to turn out diverse kinds of quality building materials as much as possible. The roofing tiles, paints and tiles produced at the farm are now winning general popularity in terms of form, color and many others. In addition, the officials of the YF present its labor innovators and frontline workteams and subworkteams with abundance of commodities of diverse sorts and farming materials according to the results of a socialist emulation for each of its farming processes whenever it is summed up. They also push forward their stockbreeding and fish culture in their farm’s rice paddies to provide its employees with better rich dietary lives. Thanks to the selfless devotion of its officials, the YF is distinguished as an excellent lucrative producer which is really to its members’ liking. Rodong Sinmun

title: Officials in Sonchon County Make Devoted Efforts
body: Almost every day the officials of Sonchon County look round its township early in the morning ascertaining what they have missed out in its construction and the livelihood of its inhabitants and what work they have to do and discussing in detail what they will do to rectify the related shortcomings. Throughout the daylong construction and reconstruction of the county the senior official of its Party committee and all its other officials have been ordinary workers, builders and materials suppliers. They have always taken charge of the most difficult building operations, travelled a distance without hesitation to fill up the shortage of materials if any and incessantly studied what should be done to erect all their buildings to perfection. All this was done with difficulty for the people under the banner of self-reliance. It ultimately bore fine fruit. Dozens of modern multi-storied apartment blocks and one-story dwellings were built and a briquette factory was commissioned in a year. The production processes of a foodstuff factory were automated for its products to come off the flow line, sterilized and freed from dust. A super pottery was rebuilt to produce various kinds of chinaware and sanitary ceramic ware. This year many dwellers in the county removed to new houses. Moreover, although their lives expired the storage batteries for street lamps were all recycled to illuminate the streets brightly at night. Firmly believing that they cannot at all rest contented with what they have done for the people the officials of the county still do the rounds of its township at dawn as always. Rodong Sinmun

title: Recycling While Protecting Environment
body: Situated on the sea, till several years ago the seat of Sinpho City transported elsewhere lots of filth which resulted from one’s living and buried it there. But heaps of dirt have turned into treasures since the building of the Sinpho City Filth Disposal Works. The labor and management of the works remodeled their machines on their own and produced quality blocks with filth, thus freeing the city of environmental pollution, contributing actively to its construction and face-lifting it. The blocks are said to be as good as those blocks made with aggregate. The case is similar to the Sinpho City Organic Compound Fertilizer Factory which stands side by side with the SCFDW. The SCOCFF pulverizes shells rich in the city and turns out good-quality fertilizer. It also speedily builds a process for the production of vinyl sheets with waste vinyl at its final stage. On completion it will greatly help toward environmental protection further. Rodong Sinmun

title: Performing Feats in Flame of Bold Successive Offensive in Every Worksite
body: The officials and workers of many domains of the national economy have bestirred themselves to celebrate the forthcoming 8th Congress of the Workers’ Party of Korea by achieving brilliant successes in their work with great political enthusiasm. They successfully hit their production targets on important indices every day. In the sector of power industry thermal power stations across the country raise the efficiency of their generation equipment with recourse to science and technology and extensively apply advanced technology. They operate their generation equipment and repair and maintain it in good time to meet the demand of technological rules and standard operation methods, thereby boosting the output of their generators. The officials and workers of hydroelectric power stations throughout the country concentrate their efforts on settling the technological problems of increasing the efficiency of their hydraulic turbines and optimize their effective use of water so as to augment the output of electricity. The sphere of the coal industry directs its main efforts to feed coal to the thermal power stations of the country and makes detailed arrangements for supplying many fields of the national economy with more coal. The area of the metal-working industry has so far attained its goals of pig iron, steel and rolled steel production and satisfactorily fulfilled its plan for the production of iron ores, electrodes and many others. Many mines and factories, too, use their existing production equipment and facilities to the maximum and actively introduce rational production methods into their work. The workers of the machine-building industry strive energetically and courageously day and night to carry out their production assignments for their 80-day campaign. Above all, the Anju Pump Factory, the Wonsan Ventilator Factory, the Pyongyang Electric Motor Factory and the Ryangchaek Bearing Factory successfully step up the production of pumps, ventilators, electromotors and bearings of all sorts. The extractive industry also continues to win success after success in its 80-day campaign. The workers of the Munphyong Smeltery have successfully topped their zinc production quotas for the 80-day campaign ahead of schedule. The officials and workers of the railway sector register uninterrupted successes in transporting more freight than ever. Under the control of the Ministry of Forestry the officials and workers of forestry stations and mine lumber production stations across the country produce lumber every day in excess of their quotas. Great efforts are made in the domain of light industry to increase the production of goods. The agricultural officials and workers of the country finished tilling their fields and threshing their cereals nationwide by dint of hard work. Rodong Sinmun

title: Heroic Myth Created in Rehabilitation Campaign in North and South Hamgyong Provinces
body: The core Party members of the capital city, in hearty response to the great appeal of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, courageously rushed to the foremost front for defending the people to eradicate the great natural disaster that had hit North and South Hamgyong Provinces and perfectly carried out without an inch of deviation the noble intention of the Party Central Committee. Thanks to the over 70-day dedicated struggle waged by the divisions of Party members from the capital city, a heroic myth was created in which gorgeous model villages have appeared and huge rehabilitation projects such as road project and river improvement have been wonderfully concluded in the shortest period in the areas that had been hit by natural disaster in Hongwon County, Riwon County and Hochon County in South Hamgyong Province and Kim Chaek City and Orang County of North Hamgyong Province,. As soon as they arrived in the disaster-ravaged areas, they all got down to building houses, before arranging their lodging quarters, and opened up the road of advance for rehabilitation although road, bridges and railways were severely destroyed. The members of Division No. 1 of Party members from the capital city finished spreading more than 6 300 cubic meters of sand-stone mixture, cutting over 10 000 cubic meters of ground and rearraning the area in just one day in the disaster-stricken areas in Hongwon and Riwon counties. They then pushed forward the construction by carrying out different processes like foundation concrete depositing and brick-laying in a three-dimensional way. Thanks to their devoted efforts, more than 140 modern dwelling houses were built in Unpho Workers' District and Kyongpho Workers' District in Hongwon County and in Haksadae-ri, Riwon County in just 18 days since the ground breaking. The members of Division No. 2 of the Party members from the capital city arrived in the disaster-hit area in Kim Chaek City by making hundreds of kilometers of day and night forced march. They first opened up the transport road and took measures for the provision of building materials and braved manifold difficulties to staunchly push forward the projects. As a result of their all-out offensive, happy fairyland villages took their shape in Chundong-ri, Unho-ri and Sokho-ri in Kim Chaek City in a short period. They wonderfully completed quality dwelling houses with the sincerity of building their own native villages and houses and thus brilliantly accomplished their duty before the October holiday. The divisions of Party members from the capital city who defended the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea with proud labor achievements again rushed to areas which had had the worst damage and which were left behind in the rehabilitation project. Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un in the significant military parade for celebrating the 75th founding anniversary of the WPK spoke highly of the members of the divisions of Party members from the capital city as patriots as they headed for other rehabilitation areas, not for Pyongyang where their beloved homes are, even though they had carried out the reconstruction duty entrusted to them. He extended militant encouragement and thanks to them. Those of Division No.1 of Party members from the capital city moved to the disaster-ravaged area in Hochon County and rebuilt the damaged roads extending 8 kilometers in three days and finished building low-story dwelling houses for tens of families in a little over half a month and grappled with river improvement and bridge construction. Those of Division No. 2 of Party members from the capital city not only completed the construction of dwelling houses but the road pavement extending thousands of meters in the rehabilitation campaign in Orang County. They then planted more than 900 fruit trees, and over 400 trees along the roads and turfed the area. During the 24-7 campaign days of creating miracles and performing feats, splendid single-story and low-story dwelling houses for hundreds of families mushroomed in the disaster-ravaged areas in Hongwon County, Riwon County, Hochon County, Kim Chaek City and Orang County and roads and rivers and streams were recovered to their former state. True to the high intention of the Party Central Committee to share weal and woe with the people by mixing with them and getting close to them in difficulty and hardships, the Party members from the capital city comforted those disaster-affected people and helped them both materially and morally. Despite tight project schedule, they repaired dwelling houses and public buildings in the neighboring villages. The proud achievements made by the elite divisions of Party members from the capital city have contributed to further glorifying this significant year as the year of struggle, advance and unity. Rodong Sinmun

title: People Move to New Dwelling Houses in Orang and Hochon Counties
body: The divisions of the elite Party members from the capital city went to Ryongphyong-ri, Orang County in North Hamgyong Province and Sinhong Workers' District in Hochon County, South Hamgyong Province which had been damaged most severely after carrying out their tasks. They built modern dwelling houses there. Meetings for moving to new houses were held in the new villages. Present at the meetings were officials of North Hamgyong Province and South Hamgyong Province and inhabitants in the disaster-hit areas. The speakers warmly congratulated the inhabitants moving to new houses. They said that Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un left his footprints of dedication on the windy eastern coast right after the typhoon, and took all measures to build dwelling houses for the inhabitants in the disaster-hit areas. Saying that there are no such happy people in the world as the Korean people as they are holding the great father in high esteem, they extended the greatest glory and the warmest gratitude to Kim Jong Un, reflecting the loyalty of all the inhabitants in the areas and people of the provinces. Then licenses for the use of houses were conveyed amid the applauses and pledge speeches were made. The speakers said that they could not live even a moment away from Kim Jong Un who bestows unfathomable favors on them. Moving to new houses took place amid laughter, singing and dancing. Officials of the provinces visited new houses and congratulated the owners, sharing joy with them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Science and Technology Regarded as Treasured Sword
body: North Phyongan Province dynamically steps up the reconstruction of its Phyongbuk Pig Factory Farm to lower the fodder unit of its pigs and modernize its production processes on a high level. On completion the productive capacity of the PPFF will be increased considerably as never before. Pooling its strength and wisdom with scientists the PPFF built a shop for the production of an integrated fodder rich in mineral matter, vitamin and others and a general analytical laboratory for fodders.
