It has also put its fermented fodder producer and protein insect habitat on a good modern footing. Meanwhile, it boosts its protein insect output at the habitat. Moreover, the PPFF adopts practical measures to improve its anti-epizootic work. Rodong Sinmun

title: Power Generation Quota Overfulfilled Day after Day
body: The workers and management of the East Pyongyang Thermal Power Station has so far proceeded to top their electricity production quotas after overfulfilling their electricity production plan for October. The heat production shop of the EPTPS does its possible to produce more electricity than ever. The workers of its turbine and electricity shops work hard day and night putting their generation equipment in full operation. The workers and technicians of its repair and maintenance shops for steam generators and turbines also fully exert themselves to do their parts in electricity production. Rodong Sinmun

title: 200,000 Cubic Meter Earth Blown Up
body: The Sunchon Limestone Mine successfully blasted a mountain by 200,000 cubic meters on November 22. As a result, another guarantee has been afforded for the increased production of cement for many spheres of the national economy. The labor and management of the SLM are now going all-out to transport limestone to help toward the increased production of cement with it. Rodong Sinmun

title: Outcome of Collective Innovation
body: The workers and management of the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Silk Mill overfulfilled their silk thread and pressed cotton production plan for their 80-day campaign by November 20. The Party committee of the silk mill has conducted concentrated ideological work for its employees without cease to ensure that they score honorable successes in their devoted work for the forthcoming 8th Congress of the Workers’ Party of Korea. The employees of the silk mill adopted rational work methods to increase their output per unit hour and ensure the quality of their products on a high level and thereby topped their production assignments day by day. The employees of the silk mill’s auxiliary shops also made tangible successes in their work every day and contributed actively to crowning their 80-day campaign with them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Brisk Preparation for Farming in 2021
body: The cooperative farms of South Phyongan Province make preparations for their agriculture in 2021 in high spirits plowing a large area of their fields. The officials and agricultural workers of Phyongsong City speed up the tillage of their fields by applying rational methods to it. Those of Tokchon City work with devotion to plow their paddies and dry fields as much as possible. Those of Chongnam County and other cities and counties, too, register successes in tilling their farmland bearing in mind that therein lies the future rich harvest of their high-yielding crops. Besides, they overtake and outstrip each other, learn from each other and briskly exchange experiences with each other. Rodong Sinmun

title: To Kindle the Flames of Science and Technology
body: A few years ago Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un visited a factory and warmly shook hands with its officials. He kindly suggested inspecting its new-built science and technology learning space. He entered a central hall of the space and was hugely delighted to remark that the factory planned it well on its own. When he visited the factory a year ago he asked officials if a system under which the factory was provided with the data on the production of machines was established. One of them replied that a unit related to the factory issued some data to it. Kim Jong Un walked along lost in thought for a while. He said that he would present the factory with the data on all the machines it produced and that machine producers must know the trend of the development of world-class machines. That time an official told him that he would ensure that the data on the production of machines would be read at the existing e-library of the factory. Kim Jong Un said that it was a cultural service center used by many people. He affirmed that another new building must therefore be erected and used as a database at the factory and that it must be named a science and technology learning space. That day he emphasized that after the space was built splendidly a demonstration lecture must be organized and that the importance of the management of the space must be explained to the participants in the lecture well so that the lecture could mark an important occasion for training working people as talented scientists and technicians. It was not until then that the officials of the factory realized that Kim Jong Un aimed at popularizing their science and technology learning space throughout the whole country and training our workers to be well versed in science and technology. Rodong Sinmun

title: Successes Made in Autumn Land Management
body: An all-out campaign for autumn land management has been brisk in the DPRK. During the campaign, roads of hundreds of kilometers have been paved or remodeled, dredging of riverbeds of more than 2 millions of cubic meters completed and bank-protecting forests of tens of hectares newly created across the country. Officials of the Ministry of Land and Environment Protection and those in each province, city and county have responsibly directed the work after mapping out detailed plans to be fulfilled during the campaign. The work for sprucing up Pyongyang City as the grand and picturesque capital of the revolution has been brisk. Pavement and remodeling of roads have been vigorously conducted in Jagang and North Phyongan provinces and Nampho City. Officials and working people in various parts of the country have directed efforts into afforestation and water-conservancy, thus achieving many successes in creation of forests and bank-protecting forests, river improvement, construction of small- and medium-sized power stations, etc. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Reply Message from Syrian President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a reply message from Bashar Al-Assad, president of the Syrian Arab Republic, on November 22. The message expressed thanks to Kim Jong Un for sending congratulations on the occasion of the 50th anniversary of the corrective movement in Syria. It expressed the belief that a fresh chapter of the development of the bilateral cooperative relations would be ushered in through closer mutual cooperation in various fields in the interests of the peoples of the two friendly countries. The president wished Kim Jong Un good health. Rodong Sinmun

title: When One Buckles Down
body: The 3rd Workteam of the Unhak Cooperative Farm in Anju City raises 100-odd pigs and hundreds of chickens, ducks, geese, rabbits, etc and supplies its members with meat and eggs on a normal basis. The workteam demolished its old pens and coops determinedly and newly built them again into profitable two-storied ones. It also built a large greenhouse for stockbreeding purposes. Consequently, it has been able to keep its pens and coops warm in the winter without firewood and turn out livestock products at all seasons. It has considerably raised the proportion of non-cereal food for its livestock benefitting from the Chongchon River which flows a short walk away. With the fodder problem being settled its livestock has annually increased in number and high-quality organic manure has been produced in large quantities to carpet its fields with it. It has led to boosting the production of its cereals. It has not only produced plenty of meat and eggs and regularly provided them to its members but also registered successes in its farm work despite bad weather conditions. It has patently demonstrated the accuracy and vitality of the Party policy of establishing the system for the circulatory chain production of agriculture and livestock. Rodong Sinmun

title: Taehongdan Plain Seethes with Preparation for Next Year’s Farming
body: Great preparations are made for the next year’s farming in the Taehongdan Plain. The officials of the rural economy management committee ensured that a demonstration lecture was given to prepare for the next year’s farming and that good experiences were popularized. The Nongsadong, Hongam, Sindok and Sodu Farms lead in preparing for their farming for 2021. Rodong Sinmun

title: KPA Soldiers Make Successes One after Another
body: Dwellings of several or many storeys were built for more than 800 families round the Komdok Mining Complex, the Taehung Youth Hero Mine and the Ryongyang Mine. 10-odd nice houses of several stories have risen up round the RM to blend with high and low adjacent mountains. Modern 5-storied dwellings have been built for hundreds of families round the TYHM to visitors’ admiration. Having mainly finished dwellings in the flood-stricken Komdok area the units of the Korean People’s Army set about improving its river conditions and building roads all at once. The soldiers of the KPA units concreted the ground for the foundations of embankments with hundreds of cubic meters of aggregate along the shores of rivers every day and coated them with large stones to thoroughly meet the demand of the relevant plans. Meanwhile, they simultaneously widen roads, build retaining walls, drive thousands of guard piles and install guard rails. The strong embankments, broad and straight roads, concrete bridges and thousands of trees planted along the banks of the river add beauty to the Komdok area. The building for the Kumgol Youth Railway Station has been completed at Sao-dong, Tanchon City. It has a waiting hall for travelers and a waiting room for mothers with their babies. Besides, various services are also ready for travelers for their convenience. Furthermore, an escalator is to be installed for the disabled. Rodong Sinmun

title: Method Taught by Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Notwithstanding the sweltering heat of July tens of years ago Chairman Kim Jong Il looked round many places of a mountain county and was informed by its senior official of its farm work the while. While the official went on to tell him that the stony fields of his county were a headache to its inhabitants from olden times and what was worse, were annually visited by flood he remained silent but gradually looked very prudent. He said that the rivers and forests of the county must be conserved well to prevent its farmland from flood damages and that President Kim Il Sung pointed out that it was important for our country with a small area of arable land to acquire new land but that its good river improvement and its good afforestation for erosion control excelled others in importance. Presently he reached a place. For a while he looked at a river flowing in torrents and asked the official if it continued to flow when want of rain was suffered from. He answered that because his county boasted many mountains and deep valleys the river always abounded in water and ran over its banks at a rainy season every year to seriously damage the crops grown along them. Kim Jong Il told the official that a power station could be built across the river because it flew in rapids and had plenty of water. Soon afterward he carefully looked at high and low adjacent mountains and valleys. He said that the numerous mountains of the county would be rich in wild fruits and herbs and that they must be gathered in large quantities, used in producing delicious foodstuffs at its local industry factories and supplied to its inhabitants to their great liking. He got to another place and spoke highly of a terraced orchard and mulberry fields lying on broken mountain slopes. When he left he emphasized that the county had the natural and geographical advantages for the development of its diversified agriculture. Having seen him off the official viewed his county from new angles regarding its disadvantages as new advantages instead. Later on, in actual reality the county coated the banks of the river with stones of many sizes for far more than 40 kilometers to prevent its land from any flood, converted the riverside into hundreds of hectares of paddies full of ripe golden rice ears, built medium- and small-size power stations across the river to make its people happy and turned its mountains into producers of abundant wild fruits treasured by them. It operates its local industry factories at full capacity. This has fully convinced the people of the county that their river improvement and application as well as the conservation of their mountains are the key to turning adversity into prosperity. Rodong Sinmun

title: New Hostel Built in Sinuiju Textile Mill
body: A wonderful hostel was built at the Sinuiju Textile Mill. The cradle of happiness was built on the initiative of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and under his guidance, who was considerate to provide workers with better living conditions, always saying that our society is the one for workers. The hostel housing cozy rooms, dining hall, library, youth's hall and cultural hall and the Pangjik health complex housing swimming pool, gym, hairdresser's and other welfare facilities would help the hostellers lead a highly civilized life. A completion ceremony took place on Tuesday. Present there were Mun Kyong Dok, chairman of the North Phyongan Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and officials and employees of the mill. Mun Kyong Dok made a completion address. The speaker recalled that Kim Jong Un visited the mill in June, Juche 107 (2018) and bestowed the benevolence of building the hostel. Saying that he heard the hostellers of the mill were so envious of the hostels of the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill and the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Silk Mill provided by the Party, Kim Jong Un promised them to build a wonderful hostel as good as those in Pyongyang, and set the site for the hostel, organized powerful building force and solved all the problems arising in the project, the speaker said. He continued that the soldier builders waged strenuous day and night campaign from the first day of the project, with a single wish to put into a reality the noble intention of Kim Jong Un. He stressed the need for all the officials and employees to bring about a steady production surge in the grand advance of self-reliance toward the 8th Party Congress and thus make active contribution to developing the country's light industry and to improving the people's living standard so as to pay back the Party's benevolence with loyalty. Officials of the province and officials and employees of the mill congratulated those moving to the new hostel. Rodong Sinmun

title: Continuous Successes Made in Reconstruction Site
body: Many construction corps accelerate the construction of dwellings in the flood-wrecked areas of North Hamgyong Province further by dint of hard work so that their dwellers could thank their WPK and socialist system for their great solicitude for them from the bottom of their hearts. Many construction corps have already finished dwellings in their charge by and large. They are now scoring success after success every day in building and repairing roads and improving river conditions. The officers and men of the Brigade of the Ministry of Public Security work hard before anyone else. Rodong Sinmun

title: His Decision Based on His Great Trust
body: Ushering in the New Year 1980 our people were greatly excited at the thought that the forthcoming 6th Congress of the WPK would be going on this year to be recorded in their national history as a great festival of victors. At this juncture Chairman Kim Jong Il called officials to his side. Looking round them with ardent eyes he said that true to the militant slogan advanced by President Kim Il Sung in his New Year Address, we should add the most brilliant chapter to our history this year when the 6th Congress of the WPK would be held and that down through history our WPK had always brought about new upswings in its production and construction on every occasion before the convocation of its forthcoming congresses. He stressed that the national economic plan for 1980 must be fulfilled more than two and a half months ahead of schedule before the 6th Congress of the WPK although its execution quotas were higher than those of the plan for the previous year and that this was the determination of the WPK. This infinitely encouraged the officials and animated them to great efforts. In mid-June that year Kim Jong Il asked an official by telephone how the national economic plan for the year was being executed and said that it was the intention of Kim Il Sung and his resolve to carry it out before the 6th Congress of the WPK. He uttered his will to conduct the 100-day campaign for the congress. A few days later he called the official to his side again. He said with deep emotion that our workers overfulfilled their plan for the first half of the year and spoke highly of their loyalty and fighting spirit. He affirmed confidently that the 100-day campaign must be mapped out in detail and carried on in a big way trusting their great loyalty. It was not until then that the official realized in what the courageous decision and will of our WPK struck root. The implicit trust of our people in the WPK, Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il and their ardent loyalty to them really constitute a source of the unfathomable strength of the WPK. Rodong Sinmun

title: Concrete Ties Produced with Success
body: The output of concrete ties has now increased 2.6 times as against last November in the Ministry of Railways and its goals for the 80-day campaign have been achieved by more than 90%. The officials and tie producers of the Sunchon Railway Branch outdo others in work setting new standards and records. The case is similar to those of the Pukchang, Haeju and Sinuiju Railway Branches. The tie production bases of the Pyongyang and Chongjin Railway Bureaus, the Jongju Railway Branch and many other railway bureaus and branches, plus the Sungho and Rahung Concrete Tie Factories, also registered great successes in their production. Rodong Sinmun

title: Proud Achievement Gained by Self-reliant and Indomitable Spirit
body: The Sangwon Cement Complex fulfilled its cement production plan for 2020 ahead of schedule and proceeded to successfully hit by November 21 its 5-year strategic target for national economic development set forth at the 7th Congress of the Workers’ Party of Korea. For the last five years the workers and management of the SCC worked hard to this end. The SCC made great efforts to rebuild and modernize its production processes bearing in mind that it was important in hitting its 5-year strategic target. In addition, it mapped out its detailed economic operations and efficiently directed and accelerated its production according to its plan. The Sangwon Limestone Mine, the Samchong Mine and the Hwachon Coal Mine did their utmost to supply the SCC with raw materials and fuel for its cement production. The successes of the SCC give great strength and courage to the working people of the whole country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Socialist Fairyland Villages Appeared in Komdok Area of South Hamgyong Province
body: Socialist fairyland villages have appeared in Komdok area of South Hamgyong Province, promising the bright future of the mining city. Komdok area was under muddy water and stones due to the natural disaster, and the aftermath of the disaster was so severe that houses there couldn't be recognized even by their owners. Now, modern houses are everywhere to present spectacular scenery. Single-, low- and multi-storeyed dwelling houses for 2 300 households, public buildings and parks have been successfully built to turn misfortune into blessings in the area. The big change in the area is the bright fruition brought about by the passionate loving care and dedication made by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un for our workers, the eldest son of the country, and valuable achievements produced by the fighting spirit and stamina of the People's Army clearing the worries of our Party and pain of our people with loyal and patriotic devotion. After the meetings for moving to new houses in the mining villages, people began to move to new houses which have been beautifully built in the damaged area. Choe Hwi, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), Kim Pong Yong, chairman of the South Hamgyong Provincial People's Committee, Kim Yong Hak, vice-chairman of the South Hamgyong Provincial Committee of the WPK, officials concerned and commanding officers of the units which participated in the construction visited the families that moved to the new houses to congratulate them. The working people who became the owners of the new fairyland village thanked Kim Jong Un in tears for his love deeper than the ocean. They vowed to glorify the 80-day campaign with increased extraction of minerals and greet the Eighth Congress of the WPK with pride, cherishing in their minds the benevolence of the mother Party that provided them with places for happy living. Rodong Sinmun

title: Nyongbyon County Opens Avenue for Development by Its Own Efforts
body: Nyongbyon County has set itself definite goals of developing its local economy and improving the living standard of the people and striven mightily to achieve them. It built a nice granite production base for its local construction in several months and procured all the machines for building stones in close connection with the enterprises concerned. On this basis the county has gathered and transported the stones scattered over its riversides and streams and mass-produced building stones of all sizes with them. It has used them for face-lifting those units honored with the firsthand leadership of the Workers’ Party of Korea and splendidly building a schoolchildren’s hall, an indoor stadium, etc. Furthermore, the county processed and used scraps of its building stone products and greatly profited from them. It also succeeded in producing acrylic paints. It changed the looks of its seat by applying them to its county people’s hospital and the interior and exterior of the schoolchildren’s hall and the indoor stadium. It has now got tanning machines ready for use and successfully turned out tanned leathers on an experimental basis. It vigorously steps up the construction of a tannery to complete it during the 80-day campaign of loyalty. Besides, it finished a quarry to increase the output of its granite and secured a cutter of large building stones. Rodong Sinmun

title: Successes Achieved in Development of Traditional Medicine in DPRK
body: Researchers and medical workers of Koryo Medicine General Hospital have achieved dozens of medical sci-tech successes through researches for developing traditional medicine of the Korean nation. Among the successes is the method of diagnosing the function of internal organs on the basis of the color-change of aural spot for acupuncture. Those successes were submitted as treatises to be appreciated. Such successes as the Koryo medicine-based system for grouping physical constitutions were registered as state sci-tech successes. Medical workers at the hospital have also made progress in the research for new Koryo medical treatment of incurable diseases. And they have standardized several Koryo medicines. Rodong Sinmun

title: Issue Given Priority to Over Production
body: The Kangryong County Disabled Soldiers’ Foodstuff Factory purifies its waste industrial water well and drains it into a stream. Prior to this, it directed its efforts into the technological construction of its filter tank. It designed it rationally in liaison with an institute concerned. Its officials made a breakthrough in building the tank actively tapping out and mobilizing their reserves and preferentially securing the cement, bricks and other materials necessary for it. It finally made its good filter tank and devices in a bit more than 20 days for purification purposes. Rodong Sinmun

title: Roads Rebuilt Technologically
body: Sonchon County obstinately carries out a correct plan it drew up to improve its roads technologically according to its features. It straightened up all the curved parts of its roads and widened them for far more than ten kilometers. Moreover, it acquired new land. It also improved its roads in terms of technology lest they might be damaged by rain at a wet season. It is now continuing to speed up the technological amelioration of its roads laying the main accent on ensuring its traffic security and rapidity more satisfactorily than ever during the 80-day campaign. Rodong Sinmun

title: Firm Viewpoint and Innovative Work Attitude
body: Suan County improves its streams in full swing. Most of it is mountainous and streamy. It arranged for its streams to be ameliorated full steam under a detailed plan. Consequently, the beds of its streams were excavated, they were embanked with stones qualitatively and their sides were sodded for upward of 20 kilometers. Without so much as resting on their laurels the officials and workers of the county fully exert themselves to better the conditions of their another streams for several kilometers during the 80-day campaign. Rodong Sinmun

title: Brisk Development of New Products
body: The footwear factories under the control of the Management Bureau for the Shoe-making Industry under the Ministry of Light Industry developed new products of hundreds of kinds. Above all, they have so far invented ones of a hundred and several ten kinds since the beginning of the 80-day campaign. The Wonsan and Pyongyang Shoes Factories and the Ryuwon Footwear Factory are all-out to devise their new products. The Pyongyang, Pothonggang and Wonsan Footwear Factories, the Mangyongdae Shoes Factory and many other factories under the bureau also do all they can to invent their new products. Rodong Sinmun

title: Putting Emphasis on Strengthening Production Foundation
body: The Osoksan Granite Mine has readjusted its settling pond, removed its overburden and extended its mining fields by 75% by November 24 according to its plan for its 80-day campaign. A vigorous frontline agitation is conducted on the spot to encourage the employees of the KIF to redouble their efforts to achieve their goals for the campaign ahead of schedule. The workers of the KIF are now striving energetically to celebrate the forthcoming 8th Congress of the WPK by carrying out their production assignments for the campaign as soon as possible. Rodong Sinmun

title: Continuous Success Made in Kyongsong Insulator Factory
body: The labor and management of the Kyongsong Insulator Factory have so far overfulfilled their production quotas by over 130% on a daily average since they started their 80-day campaign. The workers of its Insulator Shop No.2 not only overfulfill the production plans of their respective workteams but also help each other pooling their affection and strength. The workers of the KIF’s casting shop more than doubled the daily output of their molten iron. Those of its baking shop reduced the duration of their furnace heating more by half than before and baked over 90% of their charges on each occasion. The labor and management of the KIF go on working hard to overfulfill their plan for the production of insulators and electrical equipment of diverse sorts for many spheres of the national economy. Rodong Sinmun

title: With Enthusiasm to Promote Coal Production
body: Resolved to honor the forthcoming 8th Congress of the WPK with successes in their 80-day campaign of loyalty the officials and workers of many coal mining machine factories channel their efforts into the production of their trams and thus afford a solid guarantee for increasing the output of coal. The workers and management of the Pukchang Coal Mining Machine Factory of the Pukchang Area Youth Coal Mining Complex manufactured far more than 100 trams in a short time. The Tukjang Coal Mining Machine Factory of the Tukjang Area Coal Mining Complex and the coal mining machine factory of the South Hamgyong Provincial Area Coal Mining Complex procured lots of materials on their own and thereby achieved tangible results in producing their trams and spare parts. Rodong Sinmun

title: Sinphyong Power Station Construction Vigorously Pushed forward
body: North Hwanghae Province dynamically pushes forward the construction of a canal tunnel for the Sinphyong Power Station. Long ago President Kim Il Sung gave precious instructions to build a dam in Sinphyong and construct a power station. Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un shed light on the importance of the construction of the SPS and assigned the province to build it quickly at the 5th Plenary Meeting of the 7th Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea. The North Hwanghae Provincial Committee of the WPK made detailed arrangements for the construction of the SPS to speedily build a canal tunnel for it and make a breakthrough in its construction during the 80-day campaign. The officials and shock workers of the Battalions of Suan and Koksan counties work in high spirits to carry out their work assignments. The Battalions of Yonsan and Singye counties are all-out to build the canal tunnel with success. Rodong Sinmun

title: Directing Main Efforts to Nutrition Management
body: It is the demand of the agricultural policy of our Party to carefully raise and harvest two good cereal crops a year. Bearing this in mind the officials and agricultural workers of Unsan County in South Phyongan Province afford a guarantee for a high yield of the next year’s preceding crop. Its cooperative farms, workteams and subworkteams have made it a rule to sow wheat and barley in their respective fields and regularly examine their growth and tended them with care feeding various kinds of liquid nutrients to them. The officials and agricultural workers of the county have raised their earlier wheat and barley with devotion so that they can pass the winter safely and crop abundantly without fail. Rodong Sinmun

title: Efforts Focused on Preparation for Next Year’s Farming
body: South Hamgyong Province makes good arrangements for its farming for 2021 through its fierce 80-day campaign. The agricultural workers of Hamhung City do all they can to procure raw materials for the production of their organic manure. Sinhung, Yonggwang and Riwon counties and other cities and counties of the province also turn out organic manure and spare parts of farming machines, secure materials for rice seedbeds and make thorough preparations for other farm work. Rodong Sinmun

title: Putting Big Efforts into Devising New Products
body: The officials and workers in the field of the machine-building industry go all-out to devise the machinery and equipment necessary for many domains of the national economy. The officials, workers and technicians of the Rakwon Machine-building General Enterprise successfully invented many kinds of efficient concrete mixtures delivery machines. The Taean Electric Appliances Factory developed a new-type dynamo and highly insulated electromotors of diverse sorts. The workers of the Kusong Machine Tool Factory manufactured new-type machine-tools. The Munchon Valve Factory, the Ryangchaek Bearing Factory and the Kyongsong Insulator Factory newly produced on their own with their technology high pressure valves, bearings for rolling-stock and other valves, bearings and high pressure switchboards of various sorts needed for many sectors of the national economy. Besides, many other factories, too, scored valuable successes in developing modern machines by dint of hard study. Rodong Sinmun

title: People of DPRK Create Beautiful Life with Collectivism
body: The word "collectivism" is familiar to the Korean people in their work and life. They have brought about shining victory with the might of collectivism throughout the historical path of making the revolution and conducting construction. It is with this ism that they fully displayed the spirit of Chollima on the ruins after the Fatherland Liberation War and carried out the task of industrialization, that took others several centuries, in just fourteen years. They have flied a red flag of socialism and are vigorously advancing under this flag, today, too, despite the challenges and stifling moves of the hostile forces. Everywhere including factories, co-op farms, underground cutting faces and centers for scientific research one can experience collectivism practiced efficiently and its vitality. Masses come up with original ideas with collective wisdom that is hard to be expected from one or two technicians and successes have been achieved through gigantic work which is formidable by a few people. Everything from monumental edifices built everywhere of the country to well-arranged relaxation places is all associated with the strength and wisdom of the masses. There is the pervading trend of devotion for one and love for all in the DPRK in which collectivism has become part of life of the people. All the people across the country are creating a beautiful life and helping and leading each other, firmly united as one. Herein lies the advantage of the Korean-style socialist system. With the word "collectivism" the Korean people are getting stronger and their life is getting more beautiful with warm love, trust and faithfulness. Rodong Sinmun

title: Cocoon Production Hits All-time High in DPRK
body: Cocoon production hit an all-time high in the DPRK. Officials and working people in the field of sericulture have worked hard to increase the production of cocoons since the outset of this year. Thanks to their efforts, this year's production has increased by some 350 tons and 200 tons, as compared to the last year's and the peak year's. This led to the emergence of scores of high-yielding farms and over 800 bumper sericulturists. Officials of the Sericulture and Silk Industrial Bureau secured mulberry saplings of high-yield variety and supplied vinyl sheets, knapsack-style sprayers, agricultural chemicals and fertilizers in time to relevant farms. 20 odd farms in North Phyongan Province have brought about bumper cocoon yields amid the hot campaign for increased production. The number of bumper sericulturists has increased by 170 percent this year, as compared to the last year. Rodong Sinmun

title: Preparations for Next Year's Fruit Farming Finished in DPRK
body: Fruit farms across the country have directed their efforts into preparations for next year's farming. Within the recent 20 odd days, they completed preparations for fruit trees to pass the winter. Officials and working people of the fruit farms have waged a campaign, in which one overtakes and learns from others, swapping experience with each other, to protect the fruit trees from the cold. On the basis of detailed study of the conditions of fruit trees, they have taken steps for protecting them, as specified in technical regulations. They are digging pits to fertilize soil for fruit trees. Rodong Sinmun

title: Brisk Dissemination of Tea Culture
body: The Unjong Teahouse in Changjon Street actively spreads tea culture. Long ago Chairman Kim Jong Il said that in Pyongyang teahouses must serve customers with not only the Unjong tea and green and black teas but also barley, buckwheat, cornsilk and many other teas and disseminate tea culture. The waitresses of the UT strive actively to widely inform the people that the WPK arranged for the Unjong tea to be produced for them and amplify their common knowledge of teas of various kinds and their technology of tea making. The teahouses set up in the provinces actively spread tea culture of our style. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greenhouse Vegetable Manured and Cultivated on Scientific Basis
body: The officials and employees of the Migok Cooperative Farm in Sariwon City make active endeavors to boost the production of their greenhouse vegetables. What is noticeable here is to fix the time for the cultivation of vegetables scientifically according to their traits and get actual profits from them. The MCF has actively used liquid nutrients of various kinds for safely ensuring the growth of its greenhouse vegetables and increased their yield per unit area. The farmers assigned to take care of the greenhouse weeded its fields, applied additional fertilizer to its vegetables and did all other farm works very carefully. Consequently, it could produce lots of vegetables. Rodong Sinmun

title: Electric Power Production Plan Overfulfilled Every Day
body: The workers and management of the Sodusu Power Station overfulfilled their electricity production plan every day. The SPS has paid close attention to operating generation equipment at full capacity and controlling their water on a scientific footing. Consequently, it considerably tops its daily electricity production quotas despite its difficulties. Of late, it has solved for itself the scientific and technological problems of remodeling the hydraulic turbines of its dynamos and the blades of the pumping machines of the Mubong Pumping Station and afforded a guarantee for producing more electricity than before. It has also installed a real-time monitor for the water level of its river so as to put its water control on a scientific basis. Rodong Sinmun

title: Tens of Projects Completed in North Phyongan Province
body: North Phyongan Province newly built, rebuilt and modernized scores of targets. It built the Tongraegang Reservoir, the Sinuiju Youth Open-air Theater, the Thaechon Terrapin Factory Farm, the Hyangsan County Outdoor Ice Rink, a sheep range and others, and proceeded to modernize the Yomju Youth Fish Farm, the Thaechon Youth Breed Rabbit Farm, the Sinuiju Chicken Factory Farm, etc., thereby opening a broad avenue to its regional development. In addition, it newly built and rebuilt a provincial tree nursery, the Phihyon Power Station No. 2 and dozens of others. Moreover, the province rebuilt the Ryongmun Cave, the Sakju County Foodstuff Factory, the Ryongchon Duck Factory Farm and many others with success. Rodong Sinmun

title: Unity of Idea and Fighting Spirit
body: In February 1998 Chairman Kim Jong Il joined company with the commanding officers of the Korean People’s Army and told them to strengthen the unity of the KPA and the people. In those days the KPA units helped the people actively as never before. The servicemen of our KPA units performed difficult jobs in the fields of our socialist cooperative farms from at dawn till late at night. Learning that the people of its stationing place had a hard time for several days because of their delay in building a head of water one of the units went all-out to finish it. The public were also zealous to support the KPA in return. Everybody believed that this led to the unity of the KPA and the people and that it was brought about well. That day Kim Jong Il said that some civilians thought that the unity of the KPA and the people was perfectly achieved when the latter supplied the former with relief materials well but that in our opinion the unity was not such a technical one. After a while he looked round the officials and said: “It is important in achieving the unity of the KPA and the people for the former to help the people and for the latter to support the former whole-heartedly but that what is of primary importance is to bring about the ideological unity of the KPA and the people and that of their fighting spirit.” This could be defined by Kim Jong Il alone anew in an original way. Rodong Sinmun

title: Enlarged Meeting of 21st Political Bureau of 7th Central Committee of WPK Held
body: The enlarged meeting of the 21st Political Bureau of the 7th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) was held at the office building of the Party Central Committee on November 29. Kim Jong Un, chairman of the WPK, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, was present at the meeting. Present there were members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, and members and alternate members of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee. Present there as observers were leading officials of major departments of the Party Central Committee, members of the Party Congress preparatory committee and other relevant personnel. Supreme Leader of the Party, state and armed forces Kim Jong Un presided over the meeting upon authorization of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee. The meeting discussed and studied as key agenda items the issue of hearing a report on the preparations for the 8th Congress of the WPK and taking corresponding measures, the issue of reorganizing a relevant department mechanism of the Party Central Committee to strengthen the field of the Party ideological work, to more thoroughly establish the Party's leadership system in relevant institutions and to intensify policy guidance and Party guidance over them and important issues of improving the Party guidance over economic work and carrying out immediate economic tasks. Then decisions were made on them. The Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK heard a report from the Party Congress preparatory committee on the preparations for the 8th Congress of the WPK including the summing up of the work of guidance institutions of Party organizations at all levels and elections, convention of Party meetings to elect delegates to the Party Congress, preparations of documents for the Party Congress, and preparations for political and cultural celebrations before and after the Party Congress. The Political Bureau referred to a series of deviations and major duties of the Congress preparatory committee and indicated the orientation for the issues brought up by the Congress preparatory committee. The Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK examined relevant issues for improving and strengthening the field of the Party ideological work as required by the developing revolution and approved on the organization mechanism issue. The Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK harshly criticized the economic guidance organs for failing to provide scientific guidance to fields under their charge under the subjective and objective environment and the prevailing conditions, and for failing to overcome subjectivism and formalism in their work. It stressed the need to put the operation and command for carrying out the Party's economic policies on a scientific basis and display great dedication and responsibility. The Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK discussed measures for important issues of carrying out immediate economic tasks for this year and adopted key decisions with unanimous approval. Political News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Birthday Spread to
body: Pro-Reunification Patriotic Fighter Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un sent a birthday spread to Jang Ho, an indomitable pro-reunification patriotic fighter, on his 100th birthday. Jang Ho, born into a poor family in Mapho District, Seoul City, keenly experienced the grief at statelessness, being subjected to maltreatment and contempt in a foreign country. He could lead a worthwhile life only after President Kim Il Sung liberated the country and built a genuine country of the people. He dedicated himself to the building of a new country out of his pledge to live up to the President's benevolence. He, as a journalist, contributed to encouraging the people to win victory in the Fatherland Liberation War and to turn out in the postwar reconstruction. He was arrested by enemy while bravely struggling for national reunification. He fought for over 30 years in jail to preserve his revolutionary faith and obligation with firm belief in our Party. Chairman Kim Jong Il made sure that he and other unconverted long-term prisoners, who had invariably taken the road of patriotism and reunification, were repatriated to the socialist homeland and awarded the Title of DPRK Hero, National Reunification Prize and other state commendations. Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, taking warm care of him, saw to it that he took part as delegate in major national events such as the celebrations for the 100th birthday of President Kim Il Sung, the 4th National Conference of War Veterans and the Seventh Congress of the Workers' Party Korea. The former unconverted long-term prisoner thanked the Party for remembering his birthday and bestowing benevolence on him. Rodong Sinmun

title: Project for Remodeling Promenade along Pothong River Completed in Pyongyang City
body: The Pothong River has been given a face-lift. The project for remodeling the promenade along the Pothong River was a large-scale land management. However, officials and working people in the city finished the project within just one month, out of the will to spruce up the city as the center of socialist culture. All the officials and working people in the city are vigorously advancing toward the Eighth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea and a new victory with intense loyalty to the Party and in the sky-high spirit of having their another exploit listed in the 80-day campaign register. Rodong Sinmun

title: Stricter State Emergency Anti-epidemic Measures Enforced in DPRK
body: Emergency anti-epidemic system is in full force in the country with endeavors increasing to take cautions against possible porosity and take preemptive measures. The central emergency anti-epidemic units are making sure that officials heighten their vigilance against unwary practices while sharply following the ever-worsening world health crisis. They have set up visual aids calling for preventing the inroads of COVID-19 in different places and are inciting the anti-epidemic atmosphere through mass media, education networks and loudspeakers. The emergency anti-epidemic units across the country have established more anti-epidemic checkpoints with the arrival of the winter season and enhanced the responsibilities and roles of the staff. They are also taking strong measures for getting rid of uncultured and unhygienic practices that may lead to the spread of the epidemic. In the areas along borders and the demarcation line, officials, working people and citizens are strongly urged to maintain firm anti-epidemic wall and obey the anti-epidemic protocols and rules of conduct and to take care of any abnormal phenomena in time. The emergency anti-epidemic units in the coastal areas further tighten the rules of entry into sea and incinerate seaborne rubbish in time. The units handling imports are working hard to observe the anti-epidemic rules in sterilizing goods in accordance with varieties, qualities and packing and make sure that their members go through regular check-up. Rodong Sinmun

title: His Great Trust Placed in Agricultural Workers
body: The historic National Conference of Activists in Farm Work was held at the Pyongyang Moranbong Underground Theater in the presence of President Kim Il Sung in January 1953, the last year of the fierce Fatherland Liberation War. That day he called many delegates of reapers of bumper harvest to a resting room of the PMUT during a recess. He gladly welcomed them there. He told a woman from the Orori Plain that he saw her exhibit, that she raised her crops well and that she bestirred herself to avenge many members of her family upon their enemy murderers. He warmly praised her for harvesting abundant crops as never before. This played on the heartstrings of the woman. She told Kim Il Sung that she, too, was anxious to join the army and fight against the enemy. Kim Il Sung laughed a hearty laugh. He said that beating the enemy, arms in hands, was not the only way to fight against them. He continued: While the war front is strong, the home front must not be the reverse, and vice versa. Only then can the war be won. The home front is also the war front. Man can fight when he eats meals. Your front is of cardinal importance. When the home front is strong the war front gets strong. You are army people at the home front. The delegates bore this in mind. Reposing great confidence in the peasants of the nation Kim Il Sung ranked them with the servicemen of the Korean People’s Army fighting at the war front. After all, he earnestly requested the former to firmly defend their agricultural front and do their responsible duty in winning the war at the earliest date possible. Rodong Sinmun

title: Practical Arrangements for Fertility Improvement
body: The officials and farmers of the Tokmun Cooperative Farm of Suan County concentrate their efforts on preparing for their farm work for 2021. They drew up a realistic plan for the fertilization of their farmland in the first place and are now carrying it out. The TCF determined where to heap up the fermented compost they produced, mapped out the relevant plan and roused all its members to action. Firmly resolved to discharge their responsibility for producing their food grains for the nation they do not fail to execute their production plan with great devotion. Rodong Sinmun

title: People Move to New Houses in South and North Hamgyong Provinces and Rason City
body: New socialist villages appeared in northeastern coastal areas of the country that had been battered by terrible natural disasters. New houses for thousands of families have been built in the disaster-stricken areas such as Sinpho and Tanchon cities, Riwon, Toksong and Pukchong counties in South Hamgyong Province, Chongjin and Kim Chaek cities, Orang and Kilju counties in North Hamgyong Province and Sonbong District in Rason City. Ceremonies for moving to the new houses were held. Speakers at the ceremonies warmly congratulated the residents on moving to new houses. They stressed that the newly built cozy houses are associated with the great patriotic devotion made by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un through his ceaseless journey for field guidance to bring happiness and welfare to the people. Licenses for house were conveyed to the new house owners. Some of them made speeches to represent their pledge to live up to the Supreme Leader's benevolence. Then they began to move to the new houses. They danced to cheerful music, being greatly excited to have new houses. Officials visited the families that moved to the new houses and congratulated them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Many Trees Planted in Rural Areas
body: A campaign of planting trees near dwelling houses and villages is being brisk in the rural areas of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. In North Phyongan Province, the agricultural workers planted more than 120 000 trees in the autumn tree-planting period alone. Tens of thousands of fruit trees were planted in several cities and counties of South Hamgyong Province this year as the province directed efforts to growing good species of fruit tree saplings for families in rural areas. Families of other rural areas also planted a number of fruit trees and useful trees. Rodong Sinmun

title: Rason Brewery Inaugurated
body: Rason Brewery has been inaugurated with due ceremony on Sunday. The brewery is located at a scenic place in Sonbong District of Rason City. All its production processes ranging from bottle washing to packaging are put on an automated and streamlined basis. It has also a hostel for workers. The brewery with a combined brewing system will produce high-quality "Tumangang Beer" for citizens. Rodong Sinmun

title: Symposium on Space Science and Technology-2020 Held
body: The symposium on space science and technology-2020 took place in the DPRK. The symposium was sponsored by the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea. The symposium has been held every year to give wide publicity to the scientific and technological successes in the work for carrying out the policy of the Party and the government on aerospace development for peaceful purposes and accelerate the development of space science and technology. Attending it were scientists, technicians, teachers, postgraduate students and officials of scientific and educational organs, ministries and national institutions including Kim Il Sung University, Kim Chaek University of Technology, the State Academy of Sciences and the Ministry of Agriculture. The symposium, divided into the panels of artificial satellite, space observation and basic science, space materials and elements and applied technology, was held in the way of announcing standings after examining some 170 treatises presented by relevant units. Attracting the attention of experts were the achievements helping increase the lifetime of a satellite and its parts and promote its stability and operation accuracy. Highly appreciated at the symposium were the treatises on combination of information from satellites and meteorological observatories as they are conducive to developing agriculture, land and environment protection and other sectors of the national economy. Rodong Sinmun

title: Enlarged Edition Vol. 11 of "Complete Collection of Kim Il Sung's Works" Published
body: The Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House has brought out the enlarged edition Vol. 11 of "Complete Collection of Kim Il Sung's Works", a library of the immortal Juche idea dealing with President Kim Il Sung's famous works systematically and comprehensively in chronological order. It contains 78 classical works such as historical speeches, statements, reports and conclusions made by the President from January to March, Juche 37 (1948). The works comprehensively deal with the outstanding ideas, theories and strategic and tactical policies which gave profound and unique solutions to the theoretical and practical issues arising in further consolidating the Party and the people's power, hastening prosperity and development of the national economy and building a full-fledged independent sovereign state as early as possible by the own efforts of the Korean people after the liberation of the country. Specified in works are also theoretical and practical issues arising in the revolution and construction, such as taking paternal care of the sons and daughters of the revolutionary martyrs and bringing them up to be reliable pillars for building a new country, developing the mass media for giving full play to the patriotic enthusiasm and creativity of the people. There are also works calling on all patriotic and democratic forces to get united more firmly in the struggle for national reunification and independence. Rodong Sinmun

title: New Pride of the Farm
body: The Chonghae Farm is situated far more than ten kilometers off the township of Pukchong County. It has many prides. A stockbreeding center of its own building produces tens of tons of meat and tens of thousands of eggs every year and actively contributes to the dietary lives of its agricultural workers. It does much good work for society and the collective. It does not concede the first place in any work. The CF built cultural and welfare facilities on its own this year. The facilities consist of a bathroom, a sauna, a wading pool, a barbershop, a beauty parlor, etc. After their day’s work the members of the CF have their hair cut, receive beauty treatment and take a bath and a steam bath at the facilities. Rodong Sinmun

title: By Dint of Science and Technology
body: The workers and management of the Kusong Machine Tool Factory have done their utmost to finish their production assignments for their 80-day campaign ahead of schedule since they fulfilled their yearly plan in October. The workers of the KMTF aimed at producing over 1.5 times as many machine tools as before for the 80-day campaign. Under the guidance of its Party organization its officials went among its employees and conducted frontline political work to touch their hearts and rouse them all to activity. All the KMTF went all-out to explore its internal reserves a good deal. It hit its daily production target by more than 110% solving its knotty problems in hand one by one. The workers of the KMTF accelerate their production by recourse to science and technology without so much as resting on their laurels. Rodong Sinmun

title: Efforts Focused on Paddy and Field Tillage
body: The officials and agricultural workers of North Hwanghae Province are all out to prepare for their farming for 2021. The province made great efforts to adopt thorough measures for the provision of fuel to raise the proportion of the tillage done by machines while ensuring that the farm machine stations of its cities and counties augment their role. The officials and agricultural workers of Sariwon City plow its fields on a large scale. The officials and agricultural workers of Yonthan, Sohung and Phyongsan Counties focus their efforts on tilling their paddies and dry fields and carry out their relevant plans without fail. Rodong Sinmun

title: Coal-mining Industry Tops Its Production Plan by Tens of Thousands of Tons
body: Coal mines across the country produced tens of thousands of tons more of coal over and above their plans by November 29 and sent it to its thermal power stations and many other sectors of the national economy. The miners of the Pukchang Area Youth Coal Mining Complex and the Tokchon Area Coal Mining Complex work hard in high spirits. Suit is followed by those of the Sunchon Area Youth Coal Mining Complex, the Kaechon and Tukjang Area Coal Mining Complexes and many other coal mining complexes. Rodong Sinmun

title: Successive Innovations Made amid Drive for Increased Electricity Production
body: The Ministry of Electric Power Industry produced tens of millions more of kilowatt hours of electric power in November. The workers of the Pukchang Thermal Power Complex actively introduced various valuable plans for technological innovations to raise the efficiency of their dynamos and achieved high results in their production. The officials, workers and technicians of the Pyongyang Thermal Power Complex raise the operating rate of their boilers, increase their steam output and take good technological care of their equipment, thus meeting their daily production quotas in excess. The labor and management of the Sunchon, Chongchongang and East Pyongyang Thermal Power Stations mobilize their reserves and potentials to the maximum and actively apply technological innovations into their work to operate their generation equipment on a normal basis, thereby boosting their electrical production. The hydraulic power stations of the country, too, do their best to increase their power production. The workers and technicians of the Pujongang, Taedonggang and Thaechon Power Stations and the Kanggye Youth Power Station register high results in their electric production every day operating and maintaining their generation equipment to meet the demand of technological regulations and standard operation methods. Rodong Sinmun

title: Firm Foundations Laid for Its Regional Development
body: South Phyongan Province completed a medical oxygen factory, a tree nursery, the Phyongsong Indoor Stadium, the Youth Open-air Theater and many other buildings to perfection on the occasion of the birthday of the Party. The Sunchon Metal Rolling Mill is now near completion. The Kaechon Junhyok Power Station is built forcefully in the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance. On completion it will produce thousands of kilowatts of electricity to help toward developing the economy of the province and improving the living standard of its inhabitants. The province is also all-out to erect an air club building with all its might. In addition, the province dynamically builds, rebuilds and modernizes scores of structures, including the Phyongsong Teachers Training College, an anti-epizootic and medicine-producing center, the Sunchon Steel Works, the Anju Sanitary Chinaware Factory, the Kaechon Tile Factory with might and main, plus dwellings for thousands of families. Rodong Sinmun

title: Hydraulic Power Plants in Kangwon Province Pay Off
body: Kangwon Province builds hydroelectric power stations across its rivers and streams true to the plan of the Party for actively developing and harnessing water resources. This year, too, its officials and workers creditably built the Ichon and Munchon Army-People Power Stations. The province builds many other army-people power stations dynamically without cease, thereby making it quite possible to satisfy its demand for electricity on its own. Rodong Sinmun

title: Modern Medical Service Center Built at the Foot of Mt Paektu
body: Some time ago the Samjiyon City People’s Hospital has admirably been built into a standard regional people’s hospital at the foot of Mt Paektu. The SCPH is fitted out with a complete set of ultramodern medical appliances like air sterilizers and ultraviolet disinfectors and apparatus thanks to the great solicitude of the Party for the welfare of the people. A photograph showing Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un offering his firsthand guidance as to the SCPH under construction is courteously exhibited in the room for its history. The case is similar to various other data on the looks of the SCPH. The SCPH has a modern X-ray test room and a tele-medicare room, plus a dental branch. Hundreds of citizens, including old-age pensioners in particular, have already had false teeth put in their gums. Rodong Sinmun

title: Lots of Farming Materials Secured by Recycling
body: The officials and agricultural workers of Sinhung County exert themselves to recycle their wastes and thus produce vinyl foils necessary for their farming. First of all, the officials of the county mapped out a plan to turn out many sizes of vinyl foil and tried hard to secure idle materials and produce vinyl foils. The committee for the management of the cooperative farms of the county preferentially procured the materials needed to refashion machines. Consequently, the county has already become able to secure thousands of square meters of vinyl foil necessary for farming in 2021. It keeps on boosting the output of its vinyl foils. Rodong Sinmun

title: Field Political Work Inspiring Coal Miners to Increasing Production
body: The Party Committee of the Tukjang Area Coal Mining Complex spiritually rouses all its employees to great activity through a vigorous economic agitation. The committee conducts good organizational and political work to ensure that the coal mines of the TACMC mass-produce coal by recourse to science and technology despite their manifold difficulties. It also makes sure that a socialist emulation is widely carried on among the mines and that their employees overtake and outstrip each other, learn from each other and exchange experiences with each other. Meanwhile, it pays close attention to relieving them of difficulties in their living. Rodong Sinmun

title: Their Production Assignments for November Fulfilled
body: In many spheres and units of the national economy officials and workers go ahead with their work the way they hit their production target for November. In the domain of the metalworking industry they vigorously push forward their iron and steel production as befitting the eldest son of the country. In the sector of the electric power industry they do their possible to boost their electric production, thereby inspiring all the people to further efforts. In the domains of the coal industry and the machine-building industry they brought about collective innovations in their work and topped their production goals for November. In the railway sector they strive mightily to transport more freight than ever. In the areas of the lumber industry and light industry they do all they can to hit their production targets. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Greetings to Laotian President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a message of greeting to Bounnang Vorachith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party (LPRP) and president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic (LPDR), on Wednesday. The Supreme Leader in the message extended the warmest congratulations to the general secretary and the fraternal party, government and people of Laos on the 45th founding anniversary of the LPDR. The message noted that over the past 45 years after its foundation, the LPDR has registered great successes in the struggle to firmly preserve the socialist idea, consolidate the people's democratic system and improve the people's livelihood under the wise guidance of the LPRP despite all sorts of challenges at home and abroad and manifold difficulties. Being always rejoiced over this, we firmly believe that the LPDR would achieve steady prosperity in the future, too, it said. The message expressed conviction that the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation between the two parties and the two countries, forged and invariably developed in the joint struggle for socialism, would grow stronger. It sincerely wished the general secretary good health and bigger success in his responsible work for leading the party and the state. Rodong Sinmun

title: To Spruce Up Mt Paektu Area as Befits Base for Education in Revolutionary Traditions
body: The officials and employees of the Revolutionary Site Guidance Bureau and the Revolutionary Battle Site Management Bureau of Ryanggang Province made endeavors to furbish the revolutionary sites and battle sites in and around Mt Paektu honored with the revolutionary exploits of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il into an excellent center for the education through the revolutionary traditions and registered many successes in this. In close liaison with the institutions concerned they have respectfully kept in the best condition the statues of Kim Il Sung built on Lake Samji and the Chongbong Bivouac respectively and the statue of Kim Jong Il built in Samjiyon City with undivided loyalty to Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il. In addition, the revolutionary relics of the anti-Japanese forerunners have been displayed anew in the Chongbong and Konchang Bivouacs and other revolutionary battle sites. Moreover, great efforts are made to thoroughly protect the historic buildings and relics of the revolutionary sites and battle sites against every manner of damages. Rodong Sinmun

title: Iron Will to Creditably Carry on Revolutionary Tradition of Paektu
body: More than 84,000 civilians, Korean People’s Army officers and men, students and youngsters of over 1,900 organizations nationwide had toured the revolutionary battle sites in and around Mt Paektu from December 2019 till November 2020. In the course of this they fully mastered the revolutionary traditions of our Party and fortified themselves with the anti-Japanese forerunners’ thorough spirit of defending the leader at all costs, ardent patriotism, unyielding faith in victory, iron will and revolutionary optimism further. Rodong Sinmun

title: Six Successive Victories Won at This Year’s Codechef
body: The young students of Kim Il Sung University, the highest seat of Juche-based science and education, honorably won the Codechef Contest again in November. They had entered the rounds of the contest from June on end and so far won each of them for six times one after another. Rodong Sinmun

title: Major Ordered Equipment and Spare Parts Produced
body: In many units of the machine-building industry their officials and workers finished producing their important equipment and other accessories for their 80-day campaign. In the Pyongyang General Electric Cable Factory 326 and the Pyongyang Electric Motor Factory their officials, workers and technicians finished turning out their electric motors for an important factory. The Kumjingang Machine Plant of the Ryongsong Machine Complex applied valuable technological innovations and work methods and thereby finished their production assignments for the reducing gears necessary for important machines. The workers and management of the Songchongang Electrical Appliances Factory, the Wonsan Draft Fan Factory, the Pyongyang Coal-mining Machine Factory and the Pyongyang Bearing Factory finished their production quotas with all their internal potentials they mobilized. Besides, lots of other units turn out equipment of various sorts for many spheres of the national economy at its final stage. Rodong Sinmun

title: Its Yearly Production Assignments Topped
body: The Sunchon Cement Complex overfulfilled its yearly national economic plan by the end of November. Its officials afforded a material and technological guarantee for increasing the capacity of their refractory producer and mass-producing refractories without being adversely affected by seasonal conditions and finally augmented their clinker production capacity by consistent effort. The Sunchon Limestone Mine successfully blasted mountains on an extensive scale many times and put their mining equipment and rolling-stock in full operation, thus devotedly boosting the output of limestone for the production of cement. Rodong Sinmun

title: Kim Je Won Haeju University of Agriculture Marks Its Birthday
body: Kim Je Won Haeju University of Agriculture marked its 60th founding anniversary. The name of the university was Haeju University of Agriculture when it was founded on Dec. 1, Juche 49 (1960). At that time the university had only a few faculties. Under the wise leadership and warm care of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il the university turned into a powerful base for training people talented in agricultural science and technology with several faculties, a postgraduate school, institutes, education woodlands, modern labs and a practice farm. It has developed valuable programs for simulation experiment and practice and multimedia programs, pioneered new subjects, studied effective methods of education and directed its efforts into making the contents of education practical, comprehensive and up-to-date. It has produced many winners of professorship, doctorate and other academic degrees. Thanks to the deep trust and warm care of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, the university in South Hwanghae Province is developing into a reliable base for training people well-versed in agricultural science and technology and a scientific research base with good education and research conditions and environment. Rodong Sinmun

title: Japanese Regime Accused of Discrimination against Korean Schools
body: There took place a rally in Tokyo, Japan, on Nov. 21 to protest against the Japanese authorities' discrimination against the Korean schools in Japan. Present there were teachers of Korean schools and parents of their students and members of Japanese civic organizations including the liaison council for opposing the exclusion of Korean schools from tuition-free program for senior high schools and Japanese citizens. Speakers at the rally accused the authorities of excluding the Korean schools from the subsidy program for students, not content with having excluded them from the tuition-free program for senior high schools and the "program for free education and upbringing of children." They said that brisk judicial actions are underway across Japan to disclose the injustice of the Japanese authorities' discriminative moves and settle the issue. They expressed their will to form organizations for supporting the Korean schools in different parts of Japan and disclose the Japanese authorities' discrimination in solidarity with Japanese citizens. Rodong Sinmun

title: Remains of Martyrs Buried in Patriotic Martyrs Cemetery in Sinmi-ri
body: Remains of martyrs were newly buried in the Patriotic Martyrs Cemetery in Sinmi-ri with due ceremonies on Dec. 3 and 4. Among them are Sin Un Ho, ex-officer of the Korean People's Army (KPA), and Kang Jong Ho, former director of the Art Studio of the KPA. Among the martyrs are also Jon Hui Jong, former vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, and Hong Si Hak, former councilor of the General Bureau of the Tanchon Area Mining Industry, who supported the leadership of the Party with loyalty. Kim Chang Sop, former general of the KPA, dedicated himself to the sacred struggle for defending the leader, the social system and the people. DPRK Hero Ra Myong Hui contributed to exposing and foiling in time the plots of the anti-party, counter-revolutionary factional elements. Son Chang Gu, former section-chief of the Korea General Red Cross Hospital, and Pyon Ung Hui, former architectural engineering researcher of the State Academy of Sciences, made contributions to the development of medical science and architectural engineering of the country. Jong Myong Hak and Pak Yun Gwan contributed to the development of the Party. The participants in the ceremonies laid bouquets and flowers at their graves and observed a moment's silence in memory of them. Rodong Sinmun

title: 12th Plenary Meeting of 14th Presidium of DPRK Supreme People's Assembly Held
body: The 12th Plenary Meeting of the 14th Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly (SPA) of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) took place at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on December 4. Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and president of the SPA Presidium, presided over the meeting. It was attended by Vice-Presidents Thae Hyong Chol and Pak Yong Il, Secretary General Ko Kil Son and other members of the SPA Presidium. Officials concerned of the Presidium of the SPA and the Cabinet were on hand as observers. Brought up at the meeting were agenda items "On convening a session of the SPA of the DPRK", "On adopting the DPRK law on rejecting reactionary ideology and culture", "On adopting the DPRK law on introduction of sci-tech achievements", "On adopting the DPRK law on forestry", "On adopting the DPRK law on mobile telecommunications" and "On recalling and electing judges of the Central Court of the DPRK". First, a decision of the Presidium of the SPA on convening the 4th session of the 14th SPA of the DPRK, which was put on the agenda of the meeting, was adopted with the unanimous approval of its participants. Then, there was an explanation about the gist of relevant laws deliberated at the Legislation Committee of the SPA. The law on rejecting the reactionary ideology and culture specifies the principles to be certainly observed by all the institutions, enterprises, organizations and citizens in further cementing our ideological, revolutionary and class positions by thoroughly preventing the inroads and spread of the anti-socialist ideology and culture and firmly maintaining our idea, spirit and culture. The law on introduction of sci-tech achievements details the issue of tightening discipline in mapping out, notifying, grasping, controlling and reviewing the plans of introduction of sci-tech achievements, the issue of ensuring scientific accuracy, objectivity and correctness in deliberating, examining, estimating and confirming the introduction of sci-tech achievements. The law on forestry specifies the issue of putting the production of timber on a normal basis while steadily increasing the forest resource of the country by establishing a modern forestry bases with state investment and applying cyclic felling method properly and waging an all-people campaign for planting and nurturing trees, and the issue of thoroughly observing the system and order established in the supply, sale and use of timber. The law on mobile telecommunications deals with the principled issues arising in the mobile telecommunications including the set-up, management and operation of mobile telecommunications facilities, modern perfection of mobile telecommunications network, diversification of mobile telecommunications, service and use of mobile telecommunications and registration of mobile telecommunications equipment. On the basis of in-depth study and discussion of the agenda items, the meeting adopted the decrees of the Presidium of the SPA on the adoption of the above-said laws with the unanimous approval of its participants. Judges of the Central Court of the DPRK were recalled and elected at the meeting. Rodong Sinmun

title: Achievers of Their Production Goals Increase in Number
body: Many factories and enterprises of Kangwon Province have worked with might and main and thereby hit their production targets for their 80-day campaign ahead of set time one after another. The Anbyon Youth Power Station No.2 and the Wonsan Disabled Soldiers’ Plastic Daily Necessities Factory splendidly topped their production plan for their 80-day campaign. Many other units follow suit. The officials and workers of the Ryongdam Cement Factory and many other factories and enterprises worked hard for their increased production and brought about collective innovations in it. The province ensures that its factories and enterprises sum up their 80-day campaign substantially every day, secure and use materials and raw materials at home, develop new products and modernize their production processes. Rodong Sinmun

title: Through Agitprop Offensive
body: Organizations of all levels of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea conduct vigorous propaganda and agitation to enhance the role of their junior cadres and junior propagandists and encourage the members of the GFTUK to their 80-day campaign of loyalty. The Committee of Pyongyang of the GFTUK organized seven intensive economic agitation squads with its travelling lecturers of the city and dispatched them to the boiler-overhauling shop of the Pyongyang Thermal Power Complex, the promenades on the Pothong River under reconstruction, the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill, the dwellings of the Mangyongdae Vegetable Farm of Mangyongdae District under modernization and other working places. The Committee of South Phyongan Province of the GFTUK consistently ensures that its senior officials conduct political propaganda among miners at the Ryongdae Youth Coal Mine by explaining to them about their duty and carry on effective frontline political work among workers and the members of the GFTUK at the major units and work sites of the national economy to dynamically arouse them to activity for their 80-day campaign. In addition, at the organizations of South Hamgyong Province, the Capital City Construction Commission and many other units of the GFTUK thousands of their officials and travelling lecturers have so far launched a general offensive for energetic economic agitation at factories, farms and many other units hundreds of times since the outset of their 80-day campaign. This finally leads to contributing greatly to inspiring workers and the members of the GFTUK countrywide with revolutionary confidence, fighting spirit and patriotism for their 80-day campaign. Rodong Sinmun

title: 70-odd Units Awarded Title of Socialist Patriotic Forest
body: Many units plant and tend trees well in areas in their charge and qualify as a creator of a socialist patriotic forest one after another. This year more than 70 units afforested and landscaped areas in their charge and qualified as creators of socialist patriotic forests in its third quarter. Many units in Sunchon City of South Phyongan Province, Kanggye and Huichon Cities of Jagang Province and Riwon County of South Hamgyong Province registered successes in planting socialist patriotic forests.
