Fully aware that it was important to create socialist patriotic forests the officials and workers of many units in great numbers of other regions worked devotedly by the sweat of their brows to afforest and landscape areas in their charge. Besides, the personnel and pupils of over 10 schools devoted their all to planting and tending trees in areas in their charge from a patriotic desire to build their precious mother country to which Chairman Kim Jong Il dedicated his whole life and for which forerunners worked body and soul into a nice thickly wooded paradise of the people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Lodging Houses Admirably Refurbished
body: Jagang Province successfully renovates and rebuilds lodging houses for tourists for the study of the revolutionary history of Korea. Last year Kanggye City face-lifted a lodging house for study tourists anew and successfully rebuilt the Muphyong Enroute Restaurant of the Jonchon Lodging House for Study Tourists, the Riman Enroute Restaurant of the Koin Lodging House for Study Tourists and the Puji Enroute Restaurant of the Songgan Lodging House for Study Tourists. This year Jagang Province rebuilt the Huichon, Chongun, Jonchon, Songgan, etc Lodging Houses for Study Tourists and completely changed the looks of the Songjang and Songwon Enroute Restaurants and others to fully suit the convenience of study tourists. The province is now striving energetically to rebuild as soon as possible lodging houses for study tourists in Hwaphyong County where the statue of President Kim Il Sung stands to represent him journeying home for 400 kilometers for learning purposes. Lodging houses are now being refurbished anew at full steam in many other provinces of the country, too, for the study tourists of revolutionary sites and battle sites to meet the demand of the developing times. Rodong Sinmun

title: 4th Session of 14th SPA to Be Convened
body: The 4th Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly (SPA) of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea will be convened in Pyongyang late in January, Juche 110 (2021), according to a decision of the Presidium of the SPA made on December 4. Rodong Sinmun

title: Main Pit Concreting Brisk at Tokchon Area Coal-mining Complex
body: The Tokchon Area Coal Mining Complex concreted its main gallery despite its great construction quotas ahead of schedule. Particular mention is made of the fact that it did so in December tens of meters longer over and above its plan. The labor and management of the Tokchon Coal Mine successfully concrete the driftway for a belt conveyor. The Jenam Coal Mine, too, tops its coal production goal without fail every day and does its best to concrete its main gallery. The Hyongbong and Sochang Youth Coal Mines do their utmost to concrete their galleries in no time. The Wolbong, Namyang and Toksong Coal Mines register tangible daily results in their concreting projects organizing their labor rationally and securing materials well. The workers and management of their building parts and elements factories pool their creative wisdom and strength to increase the output of their cement and blocks and thus actively help toward concreting their main galleries according to their plans. Rodong Sinmun

title: To Send More Cement to Major Construction Sites
body: The officials and workers of many cement factories ceaselessly score one success after another in their 80-day campaign of loyalty. Those of the Sangwon Cement Complex have gone ahead with their work in high spirit since they hit their target for the 5-year strategy for national economic development by November 21. Those of the Sunchon Cement Complex are also in sky-high spirits. Those of the Chonnaeri Cement Factory, too, successfully boost their production as never before. Rodong Sinmun

title: Enlarged Edition Vol. 12 of "Complete Collection of Kim Il Sung's Works" Published
body: The Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House has brought out the enlarged edition Vol. 12 of "Complete Collection of Kim Il Sung's Works", a library of the immortal Juche idea dealing with President Kim Il Sung's works systematically and comprehensively in a chronological order. It contains 97 works such as speeches, statements, reports and concluding speeches made by the President from April to August, Juche 37 (1948). Some works deal with the tasks and ways for further consolidating the Party organizationally and ideologically and developing it into a powerful united one, and the idea that anyone who loves the country and prioritizes the destiny of the nation should turn out in the efforts for establishing a unified democratic and independent sovereign state, irrespective of their idea, political view and religious belief. Specified in other works is the idea of formally adopting and enforcing the constitution of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), as intended and demanded by all the people, and of naming the country the DPRK. There are also works dealing with the tasks for resolutely defending the country and the people's lives and properties by developing the people's army into powerful armed forces. Clarified in some works are the policy urging the working class to take the lead in over-fulfilling the national economic plan and building a thriving, independent and sovereign state and the idea of hastening the development and prosperity of the national economy by improving education, training more excellent technicians and experts and giving priority to science and technology. Other works give perfect solutions to the theoretical and practical issues arising in building a thriving democratic and independent sovereign state. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Ambassador Presents Credentials to Slovak President
body: DPRK Ambassador Ju Won Chol presented his credentials to the president of the Slovak Republic on December 2. The DPRK ambassador courteously conveyed the greetings sent by Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, to President Zuzana Captova. The president expressed thanks for it and asked the ambassador to convey her greetings to Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Taedong Mineral Spring Tells a Touching Story
body: According to an official of a natural treatment institute of the Ministry of Public Health there are more than 110 mineral springs throughout the country and dozens of the related sanatoria have been built by the state hard by them. They include the Taedong Mineral Water Sanatorium erected for the health of the people. It stands hard by a mineral spring in a thickly-wooded remote mountain village of Tongchang County. It wells up in cracks in rocks. In antiquity a peasant of the county saw his ox suddenly grow fat and strong despite having almost died of a fever. He closely watched it and ultimately found that it resorted to a spring after its day’s work and drank its water and that it tastes unique and was of high medicinal value. It has since been known as a mineral spring. The water of the mineral spring abounds in ions of bicarbonate, sodium, calcium, magnesium, iron and other elements. The Fatherland Liberation War was at its height on October 23, 1950. President Kim Il Sung visited the mineral spring by jeep. He tasted its water and remarked that it was excellent and apparently rich in carbonic acid and iron. He affirmed that it was especially good for dyspepsia and gave instructions to build a sanatorium and a rest center for the working people at this picturesque place after the war ended and enable them to regularly resort here for their medical treatment and relaxation. He also told officials to set up beehives in adjacent mountains, produce much honey and supply it to the inmates of the sanatorium and holidayers. True to his instructions the sanatorium turns out honey and regularly provides its inmates with it to their great liking. The farmers noted for their bumper harvests, old war veterans, disabled soldiers and teachers in the county periodically recuperate at the sanatorium. Many working people of the country, too, have a good time here for remedial and recreational purposes. Rodong Sinmun

title: Autumn Tillage of Paddies and Fields Concluded
body: All the fields of the country have been plowed. The cooperative farms of North Phyongan Province tilled their paddies and dry fields by over 130% on a daily average as against last year. Fully aware that the reserves for the increased production of their cereals lie in their qualitative tillage the agricultural workers of Pyongyang, North Hwanghae Province, South Phyongan Province, Nampho City and other areas plow their fields qualitatively and speedily overtaking and outstripping each other, learning from each other and exchanging experiences with each other. Rodong Sinmun

title: Their Youthful Gallantry Displayed to the Full
body: The organizations of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League nationwide encourage their members to give full play to their wisdom and valor so that they can make a breakthrough in the economic development of the country. In the Sangwon Cement Complex, the Pukchang Thermal Power Complex, the Chollima Steel Complex and the Kujang Area Coal Mining Complex and many other major units of the national economy their Youth League organizations have formed shock forces with their members and set them in motion so that they can carry out difficult work assignments on their responsibility and contribute actively to registering innovative successes in the economic activities of their employers. At the youth subworkteam of the Songsin Vegetable Coop Farm and the youth workteam of the Jangchon Vegetable Coop Farm in Sadong District and the youth workteams and subworkteams of many other farms the members of their Youth League organizations also do themselves full justice in their 80-day campaign. Rodong Sinmun

title: Achievers of Their 80-Day Campaign Goals Increase
body: The seven factories of the Pyongyang Municipal Building Materials Management Bureau have hit their production targets for their 80-day campaign. Of all its factories, the Pyongyang Chemical Building Materials Factory and the Pyongyang Plastic Building Materials Factory were the very first to do so. The Kangwon Provincial Forestry Management Bureau fulfilled its lumber production plan for its 80-day campaign. A steelworks of South Hamgyong Province executed its yearly plan on October 20 and attained its production goal for its 80-day campaign by 107.5% by the end of November. The officials and workers of the Jonchon Rock Drill Factory hit their production target for their 80-day campaign by the end of November. Rodong Sinmun

title: Sapling Production Increases
body: The workers and officials of the forest management sector of North Hwanghae Province have energetically rebuilt their tree nurseries and successfully produced their saplings on a firmer scientific, industrial and intensive footing. Those of NHP’s modern tree nursery did their utmost to produce young trees with a high sense of responsibility. The Forest Management Station of Koksan County actively applied the advanced sapling-nursing methods suited to the features of its area. It top-dressed, weeded and tended its young trees well. The result is that it overfulfilled its sapling production plan. The officials and workers of Singye and Sohung Counties strove mightily to recover the damages of their typhoon-ridden tree nurseries. Moreover, they rooted most of their young trees and nourished and tended them responsibly. This met with good success. Rodong Sinmun

title: Plan for Materials Transportation Topped
body: The labor and management of the Pyongyang Railway Bureau have so far transported over 100,000 tons more freight in excess since the beginning of their 80-day campaign. Those of the West Pyongyang Service Brigade of Engine procure on their own the equipment and jigs needed to repair their locomotives and qualitatively repair them in time by recourse to advanced technology. They also make traveling repairs on locomotives so as to increase the rate of their operation. The Passenger and Freight Car Corps of the Pyongyang Marshaling Yard and lots of its counterparts have highly aimed at putting their freight cars in good operation and made efforts to raise the rate of their utilization, thereby contributing to transporting freight as much as possible. Rodong Sinmun

title: River Taedong Dredged along Its Route
body: The workers and management of the Mirim Barrage Office of the Ministry of Land and Maritime Transport topped its dredging assignments for its 80-day campaign by November 30 ahead of schedule. Consequently, the MLMT finished dredging a fairway in the Taedong River under its plan for its quotas for the 5-year strategy for national economic development. Freighters have now become able to ply between Sunchon and Nampho and satisfactorily transport cargo. Rodong Sinmun

title: Sinuiju Youth Open-Air Theatre Newly Built
body: Sinuiju Youth Open-Air Theatre has been newly built. The theatre with 5 000-seat stand will serve as a base for ideological and cultural education of youth and students and working people in North Phyongan Province. Present at an inaugural ceremony held on Sunday were Mun Kyong Dok, chairman of the North Phyongan Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials of the province, employees of the theatre and builders. Rodong Sinmun

title: Phyongbuk Pig Farm Remodeled
body: The Phyongbuk Pig Farm in North Phyongan Province was remodeled. Processes were newly arranged to put production and management activities on an IT basis and industrialize feed production. So another firm material and technical foundation was laid for increasing meat production. Present at its inaugural ceremony held on December 6 were Mun Kyong Dok, chairman of the North Phyongan Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials concerned, employees of the farm and builders. Mun Kyong Dok made a speech on the inauguration of the farm. Rodong Sinmun

title: Emergency Anti-epidemic Work Intensified across DPRK in Winter
body: All the sectors and units of the DPRK are intensifying the work for strictly observing the top-class anti-epidemic guidelines in winter. The central emergency anti-epidemic units are taking measures to remove porosities inclinable to the inroads of malignant virus, while directing efforts into proactively coping with any circumstances. Those, who were sent to major areas for guidance over anti-epidemic work, are taking timely measures with regard to the drop in temperature, while keeping themselves highly tensed with clear awareness of their heavy responsibility. Ideological education and hygienic information activities through mass media, education networks and speaker posts are being carried out in an offensive way. Scientific research institutes and educational institutions are pushing ahead with the work to develop and introduce the methods of disinfection applicable at low temperature. And the control and guidance are being intensified for thorough-going examination of rivers and lakes against the inroads of malignant virus in the areas with reserves and habitats, in regard to the migration of wild animals. Institutions and industrial establishments are making detailed arrangements for and strict analyses of emergency anti-epidemic activities like measuring of body temperature, disinfection and ventilation. The hygienic and anti-epidemic institutions and disease prevention and medical treatment organs are paying big attention to encouraging residents to care for health against respiratory diseases. Rodong Sinmun

title: People Move to New Houses in North Hamgyong Province
body: Happy laughter of the people resounded in the northern part of the DPRK. The shock brigade members of Division 216 and soldier-builders of the Brigade of the Ministry of Public Security successfully built new houses for at least a thousand families in the areas of Hoeryong City, Musan, Onsong, Kyonghung and Kyongwon counties of North Hamgyong Province that had been stricken by natural disaster despite severe conditions of the northern area. Houses for nearly 1 000 families were built in a short span of time by the devoted efforts of the members of the division. The solider-builders of the Bridge of the Ministry of Public Security devoted the same sincerity with which they would build their own houses to the building of the dwelling houses and planted thousands of fruit trees including apple, pear and plum trees in new villages. The miraculous reality in which new modern dwelling houses under socialism built in the land swept by wildness of nature from areas along the demarcation line, Onsong in the northern tip of the country, farm villages on the western coast and fishing villages on the eastern coast to the gorge in Komdok are a precious fruition brought about by the idea of devoted service for the people of the Party Central Committee that willingly accepts whatever difficulties as immense honor and is determined to move even the sky and the land for the sake of the people, and its leadership. Meetings were held there before moving to the houses. Pak Man Ho, chairman of the North Hamgyong Provincial People's Committee, Kim Kwang Chol and Kim Pong Gil, vice-chairmen of the North Hamgyong Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, commanding officials of Division 216 and the Brigade of the Ministry of Public Security and officials concerned congratulated the inhabitants in the areas on moving to new houses and shared joy with them. The greatly excited new house owners expressed their deep gratitude to Marshal Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Premier Inspects Industrial Establishments
body: DPRK Premier Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), inspected the Sunchon Pharmaceutical Factory, the Unsan Prospecting Machine Factory and Pyongyang Department Store No. 1. Going round the production processes of the pharmaceutical factory, he underlined the need to add glory to the exploits performed by the WPK for the development of the Juche-based pharmaceutical industry and decisively increase medicines. He underlined the need to put the pharmaceutical industry on a self-supporting and modern basis, paying efforts to producing basic and reserve medicines with locally available raw and other materials. He also took steps for updating the production processes. At the prospecting machine factory he urged its officials, technicians and workers to register more successes in the 80-day campaign and develop movable prospecting equipment suitable for the geographical condition of the country. The field consultative meetings discussed the issues to raise the production of medicines on a higher stage and produce more efficient prospecting equipment. Learning about the operation of Pyongyang Department Store No. 1, Kim Tok Hun called upon its officials and employees to improve their service and scrupulously organizing the supply of goods with the spirit of devotedly serving the people. Rodong Sinmun

title: 300 000 Cubic Meters of Earth Successfully Blasted at Woldo Tideland
body: The North Phyongan Provincial Tideland Reclamation General Enterprise has succeeded in blasting of 300 000 cubic meters of earth in Woldo area. With the successful blasting, a breakthrough was made in pushing forward the project as planned. The enterprise made a scrupulous transport plan and is successfully carrying it out. Rodong Sinmun

title: Model School Construction in Rason City
body: Rason City admirably rebuilt the Huchang Higher Middle School in its Rajin District to meet the demand of the developing times. The school was a one-story building, but the relevant builders rebuilt it into a 2-story one and erected many auxiliary buildings on a high qualitative level. Above all, they built a waterway for more than 100 meters and extended the playground of the school for various sports items with thousands of square meters of the soil which was carried there. The HHMS boasts a biochemical laboratory, a physical laboratory, a foreign languages study room, an information technology study room, a nature room and others. They are fully supplied with various kinds of the experimental apparatus, information appliances and specimens of animals and plants needed to the intellect development and education of the children of the HHMS. It also has an excellent teaching forest and superb open-air study sites. Rodong Sinmun

title: Samsu County Conveys Touching Story of Love for People
body: In March 2006 Chairman Kim Jong Il traveled quite a distance and visited the Samsu Power Station under construction. He listened to the progress of its building in front of a board on which the whole of it was painted. He looked round its construction site and got detailed firsthand knowledge of its building operations under way. He told officials that the SPS was situated well and also planned well on the thorough principle of profitability. He expressed his great satisfaction at the building of another valuable national wealth. He pointed at the dwellings built at a valley which extends forward from the inside of the SPS’ dam under construction and asked the officials if they would all be inundated with the completion of the dam and how many families would lose and quit their houses. An official replied that they would number several thousands. Kim Jong Il asked a senior official of the province repeatedly how he intended to look after the dishoused families. He answered that he intended to arrange them to live together in others’ houses first thing. Kim Jong Il said that he visited the construction site of the SPS today not only to inspect with his own eyes how much the dam was built but also to acquaint himself with the housing construction for the dwellers to be dishoused because of the dam. He stressed that a problem of primary importance in building the SPS was to provide the dwellers with living conditions. The officials seriously reproached themselves because they were intent only on completing the SPS as soon as possible and did not pay close attention to the inconveniences it would cause to the dishoused dwellers in their living. Looking round at the officials Kim Jong Il said earnestly that we should keep in mind that the living of the dwellers to be dishoused was more important than tens of thousands of kilowatts of electricity and settle the problem of their livelihood not by word of mouth but in practice and that it was the policy and mass line of the Workers’ Party of Korea for it and the nation to look after the lives of the people. That day he said that in other words the SPS and the houses of the dwellers to be dishoused must be built simultaneously but that the main thing of the two was the housing construction for the dwellers. He emphasized that while priority was given to the housing construction the SPS must be finished and followed by the production of its electricity. Consequently, the dishoused dwellers removed to the new well-appointed houses fitted out with domestic goods and utensils. Rodong Sinmun

title: Achievers of 80-Day Campaign Goal Increase in Number
body: The workers and management of the Jaeryong Mine hit their target for the 80-day campaign by 120% by November 26. They proceed to fulfill their production plan more than 1.5 times every day this month. The Ranam Coal Mining Machine Complex topped its assignments for its 80-day campaign by the end of November. The Mangyongdae Aeguk Aluminum Sash Factory carried out its quotas for its 80-day campaign by 119% by November 15. Rodong Sinmun

title: Benefits Gained from Power Station of Their Own Construction
body: Many people visit the Girin Cooperative Farm in Sinhung County to learn how it built its cozy power station. The GCF was seldom known to others several years ago. Two dynamos are in full operation at the power station. Before the construction of its power station the GCF ranked last in the county in setting its tractors and farm machines in motion because it did not process their spare parts satisfactorily for lack of electricity. The labor and management of the GCF decided to build a power station across the upper reaches of a river. It built a waterway for hundreds of meters and erected a building for the power station. It also cut bye-channels, discharge channels, etc. They built an intake tower and others, too, full steam on their own. But the power station failed to produce much electricity at the start. While rectifying the shortcomings of the dynamos one by one they came to firmly believe that they could turn out more electricity than ever when their turbines were remodeled and that the loss of power could be reduced in transmission when the electrical transmission system was set up rationally. They did all they could to improve their power production and transmission. As a result, the power station became able to turn out far more electricity than before and minimize the transmission loss of its electricity. Thanks to the power station, the farm machine repair shop of the GCF is operated at full capacity and the houses of its employees are brightly illuminated. Rodong Sinmun

title: After Buckling Down with Bold Determination
body: The Haeju Kumgang Youth Smeltery recycles its industrial waste materials, thus contributing to bettering the living level of the people. It set up a workshop for sodium bicarbonate. It is now vigorously stepping up its production there. Its officials and technicians are firmly convinced that nothing is impossible to them when they courageously surmount their manifold difficulties with their technology for themselves. Rodong Sinmun

title: Sewage Works Built
body: A sewage disposal plant has been newly built on a plot of land in Hyesan City. It is based on advanced technology and highly efficient biological clarification methods. It is composed of a settling tank, a filter tank, a pumping plant and other modern devices and equipment. They are suited to the features of the city. The domestic sewage of the city’s populated areas and the industrial waste water of its factories and enterprises have consequently become able to be clarified to protect its eco-environment better than before. The sewage disposal plant is now operated full steam on trial. The city works hard to execute its plan to produce organic manure, methane, etc there in the future. Rodong Sinmun

title: More Achievements Witnessed During 80-Day Campaign
body: The eight heading squads of the Tokchon Area Coal Mining Complex hit their targets for their 80-day campaign ahead of set time. They go ahead with their work without so much as resting on their laurels. The five factories of the Pyongyang Municipal Construction Management Bureau topped their goals for their 80-day campaign. The officials and workers of the Pyongyang Municipal Garment Industry Management Bureau achieved their goal for their 80-day campaign and have since made advances in their work without cease. Rodong Sinmun

title: River Embankment Project Progresses on Full Scale
body: All the officials and workers of Hoeryong City go all out to embank its 10-odd medium and small streams and better their conditions. Those of a unit hurriedly embank at its final stage the Parul Stream they are assigned to. Other units, too, qualitatively build the banks of the Segok Stream thoroughly according to the demand of building methods to prevent it from any flood. Other streams, too, are embanked well by the devoted officials and workers of the city. The medium and small streams of the city have now been embanked for tens of thousands of meters. Accordingly, their looks are changed completely day after day. Rodong Sinmun

title: Enlisting Masses’ Creativity and High Productive Performance
body: The Anak Ponghwa Garment Factory recycles its industrial waste materials of various kinds, thereby producing clothes of over ten kinds including padded garment, working uniforms, quilts and many other goods. They are popular with customers for their diverse types and good quality. The officials of the APGF ensured that recycling was the concern of all its employees. They carefully arranged the latter to study what goods could be made with craps of cloth and put forward a contrivance and more. The result was that capital ideas were advanced to manufacture good products with scraps of cloth. Rodong Sinmun

title: Spurs Put to Manure Production
body: The Kumgye Cooperative Farm in Mundok County locates its compost yards near sources of water so as to water its manure amply and ensure its quality. In the past its members brought water from afar. This took them much time. Therefore, the KCF paid special attention to situating its compost yards well. Through a socialist emulation among its workteams and subworkteams lots of its members work by the sweat of their brows to heap up their manure in their compost yards. Rodong Sinmun

title: Scientific Planning and Stubborn Practice
body: In North Phyongan Province its cooperative farms go all out to make preparations for their farming in 2021. NPP swiftly secures the raw materials needed to produce its organic compound manure and vigorously steps up its irrigation projects. It also registers successes in repairing and maintaining its farm machines. Its agricultural officials and workers incessantly score one success after another in preparing for their farming in 2021 by dint of unselfish work. Rodong Sinmun

title: Zeal for Socialist Emulation Further Elevated
body: The organizations of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea countrywide contribute greatly to hitting the targets of their employers for their 80-day campaign by effectively organizing and conducting their socialist emulations under their actual conditions. Consequently, workers and the members of the GFTUK get so enthusiastic for their work as to perform new miracles and innovations in it without cease. Rodong Sinmun

title: Number of Achievers of 80-Day Campaign Goal Increases Steadily
body: The labor and management of the Unryul Mine carry out their daily work assignments in excess of their quotas the way they hit their target for their 80-day campaign ahead of schedule. Those of the Wonsan Shoes Factory fulfilled their yearly national economic plan first and then proceeded to execute their shoes production plan for their 80-day campaign by the end of November. They are now all out to bring about technological innovations in turning out their high and low shoes with materials and raw materials available at home. Many factories of the Knitting Industry Management Bureau of the Ministry of Light Industry achieved their goals for their 80-day campaign. Rodong Sinmun

title: Sinpho Canned Fish Factory Remodeled
body: The Sinpho Canned Fish Factory was remodeled. The factory, where an integrated production system is established, has a fish processing plant, brining plant, sci-tech learning space and cultural and welfare establishments. The Sinpho Distant-Sea Fishery Complex remodeled or built at least 10 buildings for production, welfare service, etc. It also newly built a hostel, canteen, nursery and kindergarten. Rodong Sinmun

title: Huichon Hospital Bed Factory Inaugurated
body: The Huichon Hospital Bed Factory was built in Jagang Province. The completion of a large-capacity medical equipment producer comes to be another success in consolidating the material and technical foundations for the field of public health. Its inaugural ceremony took place on Thursday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Many Units of Sericulture Over-fulfill Plans for This Year
body: 100-odd units of sericulture have over-fulfilled their national economic plans for this year. Pyongyang City and several provinces have brought about good prospects for increasing cocoon production by putting manuring on a scientific basis after making detailed analysis of soil on mulberry fields. Amid a hot contest for increased production, many units and workers have become high-yielding units and bumper sericulturists. The Thaechon Cocoon Production Office has produced at least 10 tons of cocoons. Workers of several units became bumper sericulturists by producing over one ton of cocoons this year. The number of those who yielded over 500 kg of cocoons per hectare has increased across the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Innovations Witnessed in Machine Industry of DPRK
body: Factories and enterprises in the field of machine industry have implemented their important custom-built equipment and parts production plans, set as goals for the 80-day campaign, ahead of schedule. The Pyongyang General Electric Cable Factory 326 has brought about high results in production of various kinds of electric wires and electromotors. The Kumjingang Machine Factory under the Ryongsong Machine Complex has kept equipment in full-capacity operation, thus over-fulfilling its production plan by more than 300 percent. The Ranam Coal-mining Machine Complex, the Jonchon Rock-drill Factory, the Pyongyang Bearing Factory and the Kumsong Tractor Factory have also carried out their production plans. The Mangyongdae Machine Tool Factory has over-fulfilled its production plan by 150 percent. Rodong Sinmun

title: Pooling Creative Wisdom
body: The Food Technology Faculty of Pyongyang Han Tok Su University of Light Industry speeds up its researches into the homemade enzymes badly needed to improve the living standard of the people. Trying their hardest to research into the enzymes the teachers of the faculty keenly realized that nothing was impossible to them when they were convinced of their strength. Rodong Sinmun

title: Land Development Pushed Forward
body: The Kumdong Unjong Tea Cultivation Station strives energetically to reclaim wild land and augment the area of its tea fields. The Ministry of Agriculture aimed at breaking non-cultivating land and increasing the area of tea fields. It dispatched its officials to the KUTCS and ensured that they exercised control over the selection of the right soil for tea, its reclamation and the provision of farming materials and briskly settled the problems that cropped up in the course of this. The officials of the KUTCS make detailed economic arrangements for the unconditional clearance of their wild land. The officials of Kangryong County sent many bulldozers and tractors to the land under reclamation and heightened the morale of the officials of the KUTCS. The KUTCS channels its efforts into the realignment of its new fields and works to use its cut shrubs as its necessary farming materials. Rodong Sinmun

title: Great Person's Noble View on People
body: In April 2001 Chairman Kim Jong Il guided South Hwanghae Province in its land realignment on the spot. He looked at its smartly realigned land with a broad smile. He highly praised its officials and workers with great satisfaction time and again for their good work. Officials unreservedly informed him that shock workers devoted themselves like heroes to realigning the land of SHP and performed various good deeds for each other in the meantime. He listened to them attentively lost deep in thought, the while warm tears stood in his eyes. He earnestly said in a hoarse voice that our people were really good and that although they said that they were blessed with the illustrious leaders we were blessed with the good people instead. He continued to say that we would never waver in the road of the revolution or step back from it so long as we had the good people. He added that the enemy was now wondering why our socialism did not budge an inch despite its great difficulties and finally emphasized that this was because they were mistaken about our good people. The officials were greatly impressed by this. Rodong Sinmun

title: Number of Achievers of 80-Day Campaign Goal Increases Steadily
body: The workers and management of the Ragwon Machine-building General Enterprise hit their target for their 80-day campaign. Those of the Ragwon Air Separator Plant pooled their creative wisdom to produce a dredger they were assigned to and finished doing that in a bit more than a month although it had formerly taken many months to complete. They went all out to turn out a hydraulic excavator with a bucket capacity of a cubic meter, too. They are now working with might and main every day to achieve greater results than ever in their 80-day campaign. Those of many local industry factories in South Phyongan Province also achieved their goals for their 80-day campaign. Rodong Sinmun

title: Power Generation Plan Topped Day after Day
body: The officials, workers and technicians of thermal power stations nationwide overfulfilled their electricity production plans for October and November. This month, too, they turn out more electricity than ever every day in excess of their quotas by dint of hard work. The labor and management of the Pukchang Thermal Power Complex work courageously to increase their electricity production. The workers of the Pyongyang Thermal Power Complex and the Sunchon, East Pyongyang and Chongchongang Thermal Power Stations boost their electricity production by mobilizing their reserves and potentials to the maximum and actively applying valuable technological innovations. Rodong Sinmun

title: Production of Saplings for Spring Tree Planting Next Year Finished in DPRK
body: Production of saplings is in full swing across the country amid the on-going dynamic 80-day campaign for greeting the Eighth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea as the one of victors. Officials and workers in the field of forestry have devoted themselves to making preparations for spring tree planting next year, producing over one billion saplings of good species. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Ambassador Presents Credentials to Lebanese President
body: The DPRK ambassador presented his credentials to the president of the Republic of Lebanon on Dec. 9. DPRK Ambassador Mun Jong Nam courteously conveyed the greetings from Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, to President Michel Aoun. The president expressed deep thanks for it and asked the ambassador to convey his best wishes and warm greetings to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un. The president sincerely hoped that the Korean people would achieve bigger progress and prosperity under the guidance of His Excellency Kim Jong Un, expressing his will to strive to steadily develop the bilateral relations of friendship in the interests of the peoples of the two countries in the future, too. Rodong Sinmun

title: Electricity Production Increased
body: The Ryongsan and Taegak Youth Power Stations and other medium- and small-size power stations of South Phyongan Province are put in full operation. Their officials and workers register innovative successes in their electricity production day after day to luster their 80-day campaign. Rodong Sinmun

title: Anniversary of Establishment of Diplomatic Ties between DPRK and Cuba Marked
body: A central meeting was held at the palace of the revolution in Havana, capital of Cuba, on Dec. 11 to mark the 60th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Republic of Cuba. Present there were Raul Castro Ruz, first secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba, Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez, president of the Republic of Cuba, Salvador Antonio Valdes Mesa, vice-president of Cuba, Esteban Lazo Hernandez, president of the National Assembly of People's Power of Cuba, Manuel Marrero Cruz, president of the Council of Ministers, and other senior party and government officials, Ma Chol Su, DPRK ambassador to Cuba, and staff members of his embassy. Prior to the meeting, Ma Chol Su courteously conveyed the warm greetings from Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un to First Secretary Raul Castro Ruz and President Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez. Raul Castro Ruz expressed deep thanks for it and asked the ambassador to convey his greetings to Kim Jong Un. Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez expressed his gratitude for it and asked the ambassador to convey his best regards to Kim Jong Un. Ma Chol Su and Salvador Antonio Valdes Mesa made speeches at the meeting which began with the playing of the national anthems of the two countries. Speakers stressed that the two countries have consolidated friendship by repelling all challenges and ordeals of history and supporting and cooperating with each other for the past 60 years, referring to the historic significance of the establishment of diplomatic ties between the two countries. Saying that the relations of friendship and cooperation provided by the preceding leaders of the two countries are now developing onto a new high stage amid the deep interest of Kim Jong Un and Raul Castro Ruz and Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez, they expressed the will to further boost solidarity in a joint struggle for independence and socialism against imperialism. Cuban artistes gave a performance at the meeting. Rodong Sinmun

title: Emergency Anti-epidemic Work Further Intensified in DPRK
body: All sectors and units are further intensifying the emergency anti-epidemic work, keeping the utmost vigilance. Given the protracted emergency anti-epidemic work and cold weather, officials in the central emergency anti-epidemic field have taken strict measures to ensure that there would be no abnormal happenings dampening the anti-epidemic atmosphere. They are making the people take an active part in the anti-epidemic campaign through ideological education. New anti-epidemic measures have been taken across the country to thoroughly check the inroads of the malignant virus in winter. The anti-epidemic units in the border areas make sure that all workers strictly observe the anti-epidemic rules when using machines or going to repair the embankments, railroads, etc. The anti-epidemic workers in the seaside provinces, cities and counties are strictly carrying out medical examination and disinfection of the workers and vessels involved in rehabilitation of costal structures and tideland reclamation. They also timely collect, disinfect and dispose of the things drifting around. Institutions and industrial establishments have taken measures for keeping the disinfecting instruments warm in order to successfully ensure the anti-epidemic work. Public health organs are paying deep attention to the health of old persons and children, while urging the medical workers in charge of households to fulfill their responsibilities so that the residents would not catch cold or other respiratory diseases. Rodong Sinmun

title: Kim Tok Hun Inspects Various Units
body: DPRK Premier Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), inspected the construction site of the project for establishing the C1 chemical industry. Kim Tok Hun called upon officials to speed up the construction in quality, being aware of the significance and importance of the work for establishing the new chemical industry relying on domestic raw materials and resources. He stressed the need for officials to properly set up the project plan and fulfill it without fail under the winter conditions and conduct realistic operation and command for unraveling the knotty problems in time. The field consultative meeting discussed taking measures for science research institutes and relevant units to push forward the development of catalysts and ensure timely provision of equipment and materials needed for the construction project. At the East Pyongyang Thermal Power Plant, he encouraged the working people in their efforts for increased power production to greet the forthcoming Eighth Congress of the WPK with proud labor achievements, and stressed the need to increase the operating rate and efficiency of generating equipment by waging a brisk mass technological innovation movement. Rodong Sinmun

title: Tasado Barrage Rebuilt
body: The officials and workers of Yomju County successfully rebuilt and repaired their Tasado Barrage. Consequently, they have become able to raise their crops safely with the water from the TB at the farming season and minimize flood damages at the rainy season. Rodong Sinmun

title: Fully Enlisting the Inner Potentiality
body: The light industrial factories of South Hamgyong Province are in full operation at the height of their 80-day campaign. The workers of the Hamhung Disabled Soldiers’ Essential Plastic Goods Factory do all they can to increase their production. The Hamhung Knitting Mill and the Hungnam Leather Shoes Factory step up their production. The officials, workers and technicians of the Hamhung Silk Mill, the Hamhung Adhesive Factory, the Pukchong Footwear Factory and other light industry factories of SHP score one success after another in their production to luster their 80-day campaign. Rodong Sinmun

title: Hitters of Their 5-Year Strategic Targets Produced
body: In the sphere of the coal industry its 60-odd youth shock brigades successfully hit their targets for the 5-year strategy for national economic development. The young vanguards of the Pukchang Area Youth Coal Mining Complex brought about innovations in their work before anyone else. Many youth shock brigades of the Sunchon Area Youth Coal Mining Complex led others in boosting its output. At the Tokchon Area Coal Mining Complex, too, its 10-odd units achieved their goals for the 5-year strategy for national economic development. At the Hamnam, Chonnae, Kangdong and Onsong Area Coal Mining Complexes their youth shock brigades carried out their objectives for the 5-year strategy. Rodong Sinmun

title: Number of Achievers of 80-Day Campaign Goal Increases Steadily
body: The workers and management of the Sangnong Mine topped their goals for their 80-day campaign after they repaired their typhoon damage and went into production. The Hamhung Youth Electric Appliances Factory and the Taesong Ceramic Factory went all out for their production and hit their targets for their 80-day campaign. The labor and management of the Anju Insulating Material Factory successfully achieved their goal for their 80-day campaign by early December. Rodong Sinmun

title: Pyongyang under the Snow
body: The first snow fell in Pyongyang this winter. The deep green gable roofs of the Pyongyang Grand Theater and the Grand People’s Study House and the tops of apartment blocks are all blanketed with white snow to be refreshing to the eye. The banks of the Taedong River are also a picture. The Sci-Tech Complex, the Ryugyong Health Complex, the People’s Open-Air Ice Rink, the May Day Stadium, the Rungna People’s Pleasure Park and the floating restaurant “Taedonggang” bearing the sentence “My Country Is the Best” blend well with white snow, too. Rodong Sinmun

title: Millions of Kilowatt Hours More Electricity Produced Every Day
body: The workers of hydroelectric power stations nationwide turn out millions of kilowatt hours more electricity every day this month the way they overfulfilled their electricity production plan for October and November. The workers of the Suphung and Jangjingang Power Stations strive mightily to boost their electricity production on their own by recourse to science and technology. The workers of the Sodusu Power Station and the Kanggye Youth Power Station examine their generation equipment in detail, repair and maintain it effectively and operate it to thoroughly meet the demand of technological regulations and standard operation methods. The workers and technicians of the Thaechon, Wiwon and Huichon Power Stations and many other hydroelectric power stations operate their generation equipment on their responsibility, thereby registering very high results in their electricity production every day. Rodong Sinmun

title: Fresh Organizational and Political Work Inspires Mental Strength of Masses
body: The Party organizations countrywide are now carrying on a strong ideological offensive to rouse officials, the Party members and working people to great action. The Party organizations of all levels in North Hamgyong Province stir up the people by means of intensive ideological education. Those of South Phyongan Province, too, conduct effective frontline political work. Those of South Hwanghae Province exert their great efforts to enhance the role of their junior Party propagandists and ensure that they bring about innovations in making preparations for the farm work for 2021. Those of Jagang Province ensure that agitators, extraofficial lecturers and propagandists in charge of five households enhance their role and ceaselessly arouse the revolutionary enthusiasm of the people where their 80-day campaign is conducted. In addition, the Party organizations of Kangwon, South Hamgyong, North Phyongan and North Hwanghae Provinces and other provinces give intensive ideological education to the people by diverse methods so as to instill great fighting spirit in them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Number of Hitters of 80-day Campaign Targets Increases Continuously in Metallurgical Industrial Field
body: The workers of the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex hit their steel production target. Those of the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex, too, achieved their pig iron production goal ahead of schedule by December 8. The Ongjin Kumpho Mine, too, hit its target for its 80-day campaign ahead of set time. In addition, the Ramjong and Saenggiryong Mines and many other units also achieved high results in their production every day and carried out their objectives for their 80-day campaign ahead of schedule. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Exploits Praised Abroad
body: The media of various countries and regions carried special write-ups on the occasion of the ninth anniversary of the demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. La Prosperite, the paper of DR Congo, on Dec. 7 dedicated one whole page to an article titled "Outstanding thinker and theoretician" and others under the headline "On the occasion of the ninth anniversary of demise of the great leader Comrade Kim Jong Il" together with a photo of the smiling Chairman. The paper said that Kim Jong Il had authored many works to illuminate the way for the Korean people and other world progressives and made great contributions to accomplishing the cause of socialism and the cause of independence against imperialism. A website of the Arab-Korean Cooperation Council and the Nepalese internet magazine Nepal Today on Dec. 5 and 8 carried photos of Kim Jong Il and articles titled "During the last moments of life" and "The memory of a great man". An Egyptian newspaper on Dec. 4 carried an article titled "Exploits performed on behalf of the cause of global peace" illustrated with the photo of the Chairman. The article stressed that the exploits the Chairman performed on behalf of the cause of global peace would be recorded in human history. The British Association for the Study of Songun Policy, the British Group for the Study of the Juche Idea, the Korean Friendship Association UK and the British Solidarity Committee for Peace and Reunification of the Korean Peninsula on Dec. 2 posted on a website a joint article dealing with the ideological and theoretical exploits of the Chairman and his Songun leadership exploits. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Remembered Abroad
body: There took place seminars on exploits of Chairman Kim Jong Il and meetings for remembering him in Russia, Belarus and DR Congo from Nov. 28 to Dec. 5 on the occasion of the 9th anniversary of his demise. Present at the events were figures of political parties and organizations and citizens in those countries. The first secretary of the Amur Regional Branch Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation said that the greatest exploit performed by Chairman Kim Jong Il is that he firmly defended the Korean-style socialism. He also published works proving the scientific accuracy and truth of socialism and inevitability of its victory, thus providing the progressive mankind with the firm faith in victory of socialism, the first secretary added. The chairwoman of the Party for Peace and Unity of Russia praised the exploits Kim Jong Il performed by dedicating himself to the country and its people through his ceaseless journey for field guidance across the country. The red flag of the revolution, which President Kim Il Sung held aloft and Chairman Kim Jong Il added glory to, is flying high in the DPRK, the chairwoman said, terming the successes, which the Korean people recently achieved by waging a struggle for eradicating the aftermath of natural disasters in hearty response to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's appeal, the ones that can be witnessed only in socialist Korea. Noting that the military parade for marking the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea evoked admiration, the chairwoman said the future of the DPRK led by Kim Jong Un is immensely rosy. The chief of the Belarusian Group for Solidarity with the DPRK said that Kim Jong Il's whole life was the most revolutionary one dedicated to the people, adding the works authored by him serve as valuable guidelines for the people aspiring after independence and socialism. The first secretary of the Khabarovsk Territorial Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation stressed that although Kim Jong Il passed away, he will always be remembered by mankind. Personages of organizations for the study of the Juche idea of DR Congo praised Kim Jong Il's ideological and theoretical exploits. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Remembered in Different Countries
body: Meetings for remembering Chairman Kim Jong Il took place in Russia, Romania, Ukraine, Nepal and Myanmar from December 7 to 10 on the occasion of the 9th anniversary of his demise. Speeches were made at the meetings attended by figures of political parties, organizations and institutions and citizens in those countries. The chairman of the Russian Association for Friendship and Cultural Cooperation with the DPRK said that Kim Jong Il was a great statesman who applied the Juche idea founded by President Kim Il Sung to all fields of the revolution and construction, adding that his exploits will be everlasting century after century. The chief director of the Moscow Peace Fund noted that Kim Jong Il's greatest exploit was that he successfully settled the issue of succession to the revolutionary cause, adding that he will always be alive in the hearts of the peoples of the two countries for his contributions to the development of the Russia-DPRK friendly relations. The chief of the Group for International Solidarity with the DPRK paid homage to Kim Jong Il, praising him as a peerless statesman who devoted himself to the cause of socialist construction. The chairman of the Supreme Council of the National Socialist Party (Romania) and the chairman of the Ukrainian "Treasured Sword of Songun" Association for the Study of the Juche Idea highly praised Kim Jong Il as an outstanding thinker and theoretician who developed the Juche idea as required by the times, and as a peerless brilliant commander who led the struggle for defending socialism to victory. A former deputy prime minister of the Nepalese government lauded Kim Jong Il as a peerlessly great man who declared the modeling of the whole society on Kimilsungism as the supreme programme of the Workers' Party of Korea and energetically led the work for carrying it out. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Baskets Laid before Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Staff members of the UN resident coordinator office and missions of UNDP, UNICEF, United Nations Population Fund, FAO, WFP and WHO here visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on Tuesday on the 9th anniversary of the demise of Kim Jong Il. They laid floral baskets before the statues and paid a tribute to them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Baskets Laid before Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Floral baskets from foreigners were laid before the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on Tuesday on the occasion of the 9th anniversary of the demise of Kim Jong Il. They were sent by Co-Chairman Johnny Hon, Honorary Vice-Chairman Sai Tiejen and Honorary Directors Cui Tongwen and Qiu Jianliang of the Board of Directors of the Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation. Floral baskets also came from the members of the foundation; Liang Zhengxiong and his wife, Lin Gennan, Li Ailan, Zhu Jinghao, Jin Chengwu, Dong Fangyi, Zhan Xueyan, Zhao Bin, Fang Hua, Liu Chunxi, Liu Yongxi, Jin Chenyu and Tang Yiming. On the same day floral baskets sent by the China Dandong Branch of the foundation and an association for praying for immortality of the Palace of the Sun were placed before the statues. Rodong Sinmun

title: To Resuscitate A Child
body: One October day an emergency case was carried to the Sepho County People’s Hospital by car. She was a girl of 3 who had a second- to third-degree burn on her belly, chest and whole arms. She lay senseless. The Committee of Sepho County of the Workers’ Party of Korea helped the doctors of the SCPH to cure her of burns concerned about her. They intensively treated her to bring her back to life and ultimately brought her round a few days later. Grafting skin on the girl was not an easy job because she was widely and badly burnt in the body. It was impossible to transplant new skin over it satisfactorily only with the skins donated by the doctors and nurses of the SCPH. Its officials were quite at a loss what to do. Informed of this, many officials and workers of the county came to the SCPH to donate their skin without hesitation. They included the officials of the CSCWPK and the Sepho County People’s Committee, the officials of the institutions of education and health in the county, the officials and employees of lots of its factories and the members of the organizations of its young people and women respectively. They totaled up to more than 300. Skin was grafted on the girl four times successfully. Consequently, she began to recuperate. This graphically demonstrates that in our society the people of the whole country live harmoniously like full brothers and sisters. Rodong Sinmun

title: Absolute Standard of All Affairs
body: In October 2015 which closely approached the 70th birthday (October 10, 1945) of the Workers’ Party of Korea Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un visited the then Paekhak-dong in Sonbong District, Rason City. It had fallen victim to great flood damage but the soldiers of the units of the Korean People’s Army repaired it completely and admirably converted it into a nice socialist village entirely different from its old looks. That day he was pleased to look round the village for long. His eyes remained glued to the dwellings for the people for a good while. He told his accompanying officials that the finishing work for their interior must be arranged for to be done qualitatively. He continued to say that the people who would use public establishments should be left to judge whether they were built qualitatively or not and that the new-built dwellings, too, were really good when the people okayed them while living there. He emphasized that we should listen to the voice of the people whatever we did anywhere anytime and regard it as a criterion. He firmly convinced the officials that however superb a structure was it was of no value when the people used it and spoke ill of it and that what was liked by them and suited their convenience should be a criterion for our judgment. They keenly realized that an absolute criterion for all their work was precisely the demand, desire, interests and convenience of the people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Many Units Attain Their 80-day Campaign Goals
body: In the domain of the lumber industry more than 40 lumber stations and lumber production stations hit their targets for their 80-day campaign ahead of schedule. The Wonsan Disabled Soldiers’ Bag Factory and dozens of other units of Kangwon Province also carried out their production plans for their 80-day campaign. Tens of factories and enterprises in North Hamgyong Province register innovative successes in their production. Their officials and employees worked hard in the fighting spirit of self-reliance and indefatigable fortitude despite their difficulties and finally achieved their goals for their 80-day campaign ahead of set time. Moreover, many factories controlled by the Management Bureau for the Shoe-making Industry of the Ministry of Light Industry hit their targets for their 80-day campaign. The Sunchon Engine Factory executed its production plan for its 80-day campaign by late November. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Visits Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: All the Party members, working people and service personnel across the country all out in the grand advance of loyalty toward the historic 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea, are full of strong yearnings for Chairman Kim Jong Il, peerless great man and patriot, on the occasion of the 9th anniversary of his demise. Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), chairman of the State Affairs Commission (SAC) of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on the occasion of the greatest national memorial day. The Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the sacred temple of Juche, was wrapped in the sublime atmosphere by the deep reverence of the people for Kim Jong Il, great sage of the revolution. Accompanying the Supreme Leader were Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, first vice-chairman of the SAC of the DPRK and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly (SPA), Ri Pyong Chol, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission of the WPK and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the WPK, Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and premier of the Cabinet of the DPRK, Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, vice-chairman of the SAC of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the WPK Central Committee, and other party and government officials and senior officials of the armed forces organs. A floral basket in the name of the Supreme Leader was laid before the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. Laid before the statues were floral baskets in the names of the WPK Central Committee, the SAC of the DPRK, the Presidium of the SPA of the DPRK and the Cabinet of the DPRK. The Supreme Leader, together with other visitors, paid high tribute to the statues. At the hall where Kim Jong Il lies in state, the Supreme Leader made a deep bow in deep reverence for him who dedicated his whole life to the country and people with warm love and devotion till the last moments of his revolutionary life and glorified the dignified, great and ever-victorious Party and the country of single-minded unity all over the world. The Party and government officials and senior officials of the armed forces organs solemnly vowed to firmly defend and add luster to the idea and feats of Kim Jong Il and fulfill their heavy duty in the sacred struggle for a fresh victory of the socialist cause under the leadership of the Supreme Leader. Political News Team

title: Floral Baskets to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: from Abroad Floral baskets were sent to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill by foreign personages and bodies on the occasion of the 9th anniversary of the demise of Kim Jong Il. They include the family of Zhang Weihua, a Chinese anti-Japanese revolutionary martyr, the family of Kim Sun Ok who is related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, the families of Zhou Baozhong and Chai Shiying, Chinese related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, the family of Ya. T. Nobichenko who was an internationalist soldier, the Switzerland-Korea Committee, the Beijing Chao Ya International Cultural Exchange Center in China, the Beijing international cultural development center for China-DPRK friendship, Trotsky Serano, chairman of the Ecuadorian Committee for Remembering Generalissimo Kim Jong Il, Giancarlo Elia Valori, president of the International Group of Italy,, Jindallae Saphariny, president of the Jindallae Children's Foundation, and Kosima Weber Liu, executive director of the Environmental Education Media Project. The floral baskets were laid before the statues on Dec. 16. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Basket to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: from Nigerian President Muhammadu Buhari, president of the Federal Republic of Nigeria and commander-in-chief of the Armed Forces, sent a floral basket to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on the occasion of the 9th anniversary of the demise of Kim Jong Il. The floral basket was laid before the statues on Dec. 16. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Exploits for Building Thriving Nation
body: Chairman Kim Jong Il is a peerless patriot who laid a firm foundation for the building of a thriving nation. It is an immortal exploit Kim Jong Il performed for the cause of building a thriving nation that he provided the precious ideological and theoretical wealth and strengthened our political and military might in every way. He has laid a firm foundation for the self-supporting economy and brought up a large contingent of talents who would shoulder the future destiny of socialist Korea. The theory of rallying around the leader, the ideological theory of Juche, the idea of waging a speed campaign, the policy of living in our own way, the theory of building a socialist power and all other ideas and theories indicated by the Chairman are shining as a powerful ideological weapon of the revolution and construction for their originality, scientific accuracy and feasibility. It is his greatest exploits for the eternal prosperity of our country, nation and all generations that he has built up the tremendous military power with his energetic Songun revolutionary leadership. He had visited different parts of the country through ceaseless anti-Japanese guerilla-style forced march of field guidance to encourage officials and workers to make a leap forward, and to kindle the flames of a fresh great revolutionary upsurge. Thanks to the dedication made by the Chairman who had visited the campaign sites for the great upsurge one after another though he was in bad health, the firm foundation for building the self-supporting economy could be laid. Under his warm care, innumerous revolutionary talents loyal to the Party and the people have been trained. His exploits in bringing up a large contingent of talents for the rosy future of our country will be immortal along with the history of building a powerful socialist country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Many Books on Greatness of Chairman Kim Jong Il Published in DPRK
body: Lots of books on the greatness of Chairman Kim Jong Il have been brought out in the new century of Juche. The book "Comrade Kim Jong Il, Legendary Great Man"(five volumes) was published on the occasion of his 70th birth anniversary. Its 4th volume "Genius of Creation" and 5th volume "Peerless Patriot" deal with the great exploits of the peerlessly great man who ushered in a new era of prosperity to be etched in the history of the nation by directing the revolution for a long time. Vol. 4 of the serial "The Son of Mt Paektu", books "The Great Leader Comrade Kim Jong Il Will Be Immortal" and "The General and the Flames at Hamnam" and others help readers keenly realize that there is no such a peerlessly great sage, the legendary revolutionary and the tender-hearted father of the people as Kim Jong Il. Works giving perfect solutions to the theoretical and practical problems arising in all fields of the revolution and construction including politics, military, economy and culture were brought out as national treasure. Sequels to the reminiscences "Great Life" dealing with the history of the Chairman's patriotic devotion were published in succession. Serials of the memoirs "Glorifying the Era of Juche" and other books on his greatness have been brought out. Many literary works including full-length novel on the history of high-intensity forced march of Kim Jong Il have also been published. Rodong Sinmun

title: To Record High Transport Result
body: Having overfulfilled their freight transport plan in October and November the workers and management of the Hamhung Railway Bureau transport more freight over and above their plan in December, too. Before everything else they made detailed arrangements for preferentially transporting the materials needed to rebuild the flood-wrecked areas of the country. The HRB successfully transported materials to the February 8 Vinalon Complex, the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex and many other units with might and main. The Tanchon Youth Service Brigade of Engine, the Kowon Service Brigade of Engine and many other service brigades of engine procured necessary jigs and equipment on their own and repaired their locomotives with rational work methods, thereby putting as many ones as needed in full operation. The labor and management of the Hamhung Passenger and Freight Car Corps and many other passenger and freight car corps also executed their locomotive and freight car repairing plan for their 80-day campaign ahead of set time. The employees of the HRB ceaselessly bestir themselves to hit their targets for their 80-day campaign with success. Rodong Sinmun

title: Anju City Remodels Its Chilsong Park
body: The Chilsong Park lies extensively in the middle of a lake in downtown Anju City. It has been transfigured admirably into a pleasure resort of the people. It is thick with trees. It boasts many islets, pavilions, fantastic stones, waterfalls, etc. Bridges are built in the form of the Great Bear between the islets. The CP has good promenades, too. It resembles a floating ship in shape. Rodong Sinmun

title: Number of Hitters of 80-day Campaign Target Increases
body: The officials, workers and technicians of the Munphyong Refinery fulfilled their zinc production plan for their 80-day campaign first and then proceeded to top their lead production plan with success. The workers of the Riwon Mine executed their mineral production plan for their 80-day campaign. Exploring and mobilizing their internal reserves to the maximum the workers and management of the Pyongyang Construction Machine Plant carried out their lift production plan for their 80-day campaign. Those of the Sungho Concrete Tie Factory made primary efforts to secure materials for ties on the one hand and put their machines in normal operation on the other, thus topping their target for their 80-day campaign ahead of schedule. Rodong Sinmun

title: Making Scrupulous Preparation for Next Year’s Farming
body: The officials and agricultural workers of North Hamgyong Province make substantial preparations for their farming in 2021 as fast as possible. The Committee of NHP of the Workers’ Party of Korea impresses on its agricultural workers by various educational methods that they removed to new dwellings under the loving care of the WPK and that success after success is registered day by day in rebuilding its flood-affected areas and ensures that they make meticulous preparations for their farming in 2021 so as to repay the WPK for its solicitude for them. Irrigation setups are restored full steam throughout NHP. In addition, various other works are also done substantially beforehand to raise farm crops in 2021. Rodong Sinmun

title: Units Associated with Leadership Exploits of Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Take Lead in 80-day Campaign The units associated with the leadership exploits of Chairman Kim Jong Il are taking the lead in the 80-day campaign. The Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Silk Mill has thoroughly ensured the quality of products, true to the last instructions of Kim Jong Il on producing more good-quality silks. The Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill, the Pyongyang Cornstarch Factory and other units in Pyongyang City have made a great stride in the struggle for carrying out the last instructions of Kim Jong Il by correctly finding the essential factor in all their works and allocating manpower in a reasonable way. The Ryesonggang Power Station has registered proud successes in the on-going general advance by giving full play to the mental power of its workers. The Oguk Cooperative Farm in Anak County, the Samjigang Cooperative Farm in Jaeryong County and other cooperative farms in South Hwanghae Province have inspired the agricultural workers to the preparations for the next year's farming. Other units associated with the leadership exploits of Kim Jong Il across the country including industrial establishments, steel plants, power stations and cooperative farms also have achieved great successes in the 80-day campaign. Rodong Sinmun

title: Concert Given by National Symphony Orchestra
body: A concert was given by the National Symphony Orchestra at the Moranbong Theatre on Thursday, the greatest national memorial day. Put on the stage of the concert, which began with orchestral prelude "Ode to Comrade Kim Jong Il", were such numbers as orchestral music "The Sound of a Horse's Hooves in Mt. Paektu" and "The General Is the Destiny of Korea." The performers represented high praise of the revolutionary career of the Chairman who continued his forced march for field guidance day and night to the end of his life, regarding it as his maxim to believe in the people as in Heaven. The repertoire also included the numbers lauding the Chairman who dedicated himself to the happiness of his beloved people and the rising generations through his ceaseless journey for the Songun leadership, and those reflecting the will of the people to realize his patriotic desire for building a powerful nation. Citizens in Pyongyang watched the concert. Rodong Sinmun

title: Vietnamese Embassy Members Pay Floral Tribute
body: to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il Le Ba Binh, Vietnamese ambassador to the DPRK, and his embassy members visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on Thursday, the 9th anniversary of the demise of Kim Jong Il. They laid a floral basket and made a bow before the statues of the great leaders. Rodong Sinmun

title: Emergency Anti-Epidemic Work Further Intensified in DPRK
body: Officials and working people across the country are further intensifying the all-people anti-epidemic campaign to cope with the worldwide spread of COVID-19 while strictly observing the measures taken by the state. The central emergency anti-epidemic units are taking measures for promptly coping with possible situations while correcting the deviations that result from the prolonged emergency anti-epidemic work through regular meetings. They are conducting ideological education effectively in various forms and by various methods among all the people to make them strictly abide by the state emergency anti-epidemic measures with the awareness that they are masters of the anti-epidemic work, and to further boost the anti-epidemic atmosphere on a mass basis. Inspection and quarantine units are setting high demands to make all the people strictly observe the disinfection system and methods. They are promoting the work for establishing perfect anti-epidemic wall at the edges of border bridges and ports by setting up specialized disinfection facilities of several kinds and studying and introducing efficient disinfectants and disinfecting methods. The units in the field of public health are taking scrupulous measures for responsible medical examination. Institutions and industrial establishments are disinfecting the offices and work sites and taking the temperatures of the employees as required by the anti-epidemic rules, while regularly reviewing the daily work and keeping the emergency anti-epidemic work above all. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Officials, working people and service personnel visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and mosaics of their smiling images in different parts of the country to pay floral tribute to them on the occasion of the 9th anniversary of the demise of the Chairman. Placed before the statues on Mansu Hill were floral baskets in the names of the Party, power and armed forces organs, public organizations, ministries, national institutions, units of the Korean People's Army (KPA) and the Public Security Forces (PSF), and institutions, industrial establishments and universities at different levels in Pyongyang. A floral basket in the name of the Pyongyang mission of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front was laid there. Placed at the statues of the President and the Chairman and mosaics of their smiling images in various places of Pyongyang including Kim Il Sung University, the Ministry of Public Security and the Mansudae Art Studio were floral baskets in the names of units of the KPA and the PSF, institutions and enterprises. Officials, working people and service personnel of the KPA across the country visited the statues of the President and the Chairman and mosaics of their smiling images in their residential areas to pay homage to the great leaders. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Reply Message from Lao President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, received a reply message from Bounnang Vorachith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party (LPRP) and president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic (LPDR), on Dec. 14. The Lao president in the message expressed his heartfelt thanks on behalf of the Central Committee of the LPRP and the government and people of Laos and on his own behalf to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un for sending encouraging warm felicitations and best wishes to the LPRP, the government and people of Laos and to him on the occasion of the 45th founding anniversary of the LPDR. The president expressed the belief that the DPRK would as ever achieve new greater successes in the defence of the country, the cause of building a powerful socialist country and improvement of the people's living standard under the leadership of Kim Jong Un. He said that he rejoices at the traditional and good relations of friendship and cooperation between the LPDR and the DPRK which have brought substantial benefits to the peoples of the two countries and grown stronger in conformity with regional and global peace and stability, cooperation and development. The message wished Kim Jong Un happiness in good health and greater success in his noble work. Rodong Sinmun

title: Pak Pong Ju Inspects Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex
body: Pak Pong Ju, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the WPK, inspected the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex.
