The working people of the complex, who are waging a vigorous campaign to greet the Eighth Congress of the WPK with proud labor successes, are over-fulfilling daily plans for the 80-day campaign. Looking round various parts of the complex including a furnace shop, oxygen separating shop No 2 and crude steel shop, Pak Pong Ju learned about the production of iron and steel and heavy rails before holding a field consultative meeting. At the meeting, measures were taken to strictly abide by technical rules and standard working method in the furnace operation, to lower production cost through meticulous equipment and technical control, and to further increase the production of Juche iron. Meanwhile, Pak Pong Ju visited the Sunchon Steel Works where he discussed technical problems and took measures for perfecting the iron production process in reliance on locally available raw materials and fuel as required by the Party policies. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Receives Many Gifts from Progressive Mankind
body: Chairman Kim Jong Il has been presented with over 40 000 gifts from party and state leaders, organizations, political and public figures and other personages of different social standings in 170 countries and international bodies. Every gift is closely associated with their ardent respect for and trust in Kim Jong Il. Among the gifts is crystal craftwork showing the Tower of the Juche Idea, the one presented by the International Institute of the Juche Idea (IIJI) in February, Juche 80 (1991) to praise the feats of Kim Jong Il who illuminated the way for the era of independence. The president of the Party for Free Motherland of Brazil presented to Kim Jong Il with deep reverence the gem-cutting craftwork "Humming Bird" in October 2010. The reverence for Kim Jong Il is given continuity by the peoples of the world, even after the Korean people suffered a great loss of the nation. It can be witnessed by the fact that the number of gifts presented to the Chairman by the world progressives reaches over 110 pieces since his demise. Vishwanath, former director-general of the IIJI, personally designed an exquisite gold necklace and asked a famous Indian craftsman to make it, which took several months for completion. And he presented the necklace to Kim Jong Il in April 2012. A personage in Kuwait presented the craftwork "Steering Wheel" to Kim Jong Il on the occasion of his 70th birthday. The craftwork represents humble reverence praising the exploits of the Chairman who had steered the world politics by firmly taking the helm of the history. The national chairman of the Better Nigeria Progressive Party sent the crystal craftwork "The Shining Star of Mt Paektu on Jong Il Peak" on the occasion of the 75th birthday of the Chairman. The progressive mankind's boundless reverence and ardent yearning for Kim Jong Il grow stronger as the days go by. Rodong Sinmun

title: Homage Paid to Chairman Kim Jong Il across DPRK
body: The people in the DPRK looked back upon the memory of Chairman Kim Jong Il with reverence on the occasion of the 9th anniversary of his demise, the greatest national memorial day. On the occasion, people and service personnel visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the sacred temple of Juche, where President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il lie in state, and paid tribute to them. Working people from all walks of life and service personnel placed floral baskets, bouquets and flowers before the statues of the President and the Chairman and mosaics of their smiling images in different parts of the country. Aired across the country were documentaries on the long journey of patriotic devotion made by the Chairman and his revolutionary exploits. Seeing "Cherishing the Desire of President Kim Il Sung" and other documentary films, officials, Party members, working people and service personnel looked back with deep emotion on the revolutionary career of the Chairman who performed great feats for the times and history. All the families and worksites were pervaded with the will to hold the Chairman in high esteem forever and implement his instructions. Rodong Sinmun

title: Cambodian King, Great Queen Send Large Floral Baskets to DPRK Embassy
body: Cambodian King Norodom Sihamoni and Great Queen Norodom Monineath Sihanouk sent large floral baskets to the DPRK embassy in Phnom Penh on Dec. 15 on the occasion of the 9th anniversary of the demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Upon the authorization by the king and the great queen, a delegation of the Cambodian Ministry of the Royal Palace led by Kong Sam Ol, deputy prime minister for the Royal Palace, laid the floral baskets and made a bow before the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il at the embassy. Rodong Sinmun

title: To Produce More Consumer Goods of High Quality
body: The officials, workers and technicians of the Hamhung Disabled Soldiers’ Essential Plastic Goods Factory register successes in vigorously carrying on their 80-day campaign to honor the forthcoming 8th Congress of the Workers’ Party of Korea with high results in their production. They topped their plan for the production of plastic flooring and other plastic daily necessities of many kinds and made advances in the invention of new products, too. The result is that they developed multifarious and multicolored bags for middle-aged women, rucksacks and other new goods one after another. The HDSEPGF also renewed its e-library during its 80-day campaign. Rodong Sinmun

title: Number of Hitters of 80-day Campaign Target Increases
body: Many units of the Pukchang Area Youth Coal Mining Complex hit their targets for their 80-day campaign by December 15 one after another. They were four pits, over ten coal mining workteams and dozens of heading squads. The Automobile Transport Department of the Ministry of Land and Maritime Transport fulfilled its freight transport plan for its 80-day campaign. The Kusong Machine Tool Factory and the Tongrim Electric Appliances Factory executed their respective machine tool and electromotor production plans for their 80-day campaign. The Ryongsong Bearing Factory and the Phyongsong Artificial Leather Factory achieved their goals for the 80-day campaign. Rodong Sinmun

title: Kim Tok Hun Learns about Development of Mt Kumgang Tourist Area
body: DPRK Premier Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, visited Mt Kumgang tourist area to learn about its development. Looking round Kosong Port coastal tourist area, Haegumgang coastal park area, sports and cultural area, etc. he discussed technical matters arising in correctly reflecting the Party's idea of developing scenic spots and meeting the people's cultural needs on the highest level in the master plan for the development of Mt Kumgang tourist area, and carrying them out. He called for pushing ahead with the development project of turning Mt Kumgang area into modern and all-inclusive international tourist and cultural area under yearly and phased plans and thoroughly maintaining the principle of conveniences and architectural beauty first in the construction so that people can fully enjoy natural beauty. He stressed the need to build the tourist area our own way in which national character and modernity are combined while in good harmony with the natural scenery of the diamond mountain so as to turn the famous mountain of the nation into the one well-known for serving the people and a cultural resort envied by the whole world. The field consultative meeting discussed measures to properly set priorities in the development project consistent with the master plan and fully apply the Juche-oriented idea of architecture and policy concerning construction to the design and construction of a world-level hotel, golf course, skiing ground, etc. Rodong Sinmun

title: Many Power Stations Newly Built in Jagang Province
body: Jagang Province built the Hungju Youth Power Station 4, the Tongsin Power Station 3, the Kophung Power Station 3 and many other medium- and small-size power stations this year. Consequently, a production capacity of over 10,000 kilowatts of electricity has been obtained newly, thus affording a guarantee for successfully satisfying the demand of electricity for its economic development and the lives of its people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Tens of Construction or Modernization Projects Pushed Ahead with
body: North Hwanghae Province successfully speeds up the construction or modernization of tens of its structures which will greatly contribute to developing its economy and improving the living level of its people. It admirably built a provincial tree nursery and the Rinsan Ryongsok Power Station on the occasion of the 75th birthday of the Workers’ Party of Korea. It then proceeded to build the Sariwon Youth Open-Air Theater and the Taekwon-Do Training Gymnasium and increase the production capacity of the Kyongam Cement Factory. Its officials and workers are now bestirring themselves further to celebrate the forthcoming 8th Congress of the WPK by registering laudable successes in their work. Rodong Sinmun

title: Reed Harvest in Full Swing in Sindo County
body: The officials and workers of Sindo County reaped rich reed crops in thousands of hectares of its fields this year and produced more than 10,000 tons more of reed than last year. Before any others else, the Reed Branch Farm 1 produced over 15 tons of reeds per hectare. In addition, it realigned hundreds of hectares of its fields, planted reeds there and grew them satisfactorily. It also lost no time in repairing its banks wrecked by storm waves. SC is now making good arrangements for finishing cutting reeds and binding them into sheaves during its 80-day campaign. Rodong Sinmun

title: Significant Sci-tech Success Made in DPRK
body: The scientists of the State Academy of Sciences contrived a sophisticated scanning tunnel microscope. It is an up-to-the-minute nano-measuring device. It is composed of a measuring head, a vibration isolator, a control device and a control computer. It excels all its homemade predecessors in technological index. Rodong Sinmun

title: Active Prospecting for Hot Spring in DPRK
body: Hot springs are briskly explored for across the country. Hot springs have been prospected for at the township of Samchon County, South Hwanghae Province, Munyang-ri, Koksan County, North Hwanghae Province, Onhyang-ri, Kumya County, South Hamgyong Province, Hwangjin-ri, Myongchon County, North Hamgyong Province and Kwanmo-ri, Kyongsong County, North Hamgyong Province to increase the volume of their water. Hot springs have also been explored for newly or are expanded further at Unsan County, North Phyongan Province, Tongsin County, Jagang Province, Pochon County, Ryanggang Province, Poptong County, Kangwon Province, Onchon County of Nampho City and many other regions. Successes are registered in prospecting for hot springs in many parts of Pyongyang and in and around Mt Paektu. Rodong Sinmun

title: Attainers of 80-day Campaign Goal Increase in Number
body: The workers and management of the Rahung Concrete Tie Factory fulfilled their tie production plan for their 80-day campaign. The Sunchon Limestone Mine carried out its production assignments for its 80-day campaign. The case is similar to the Pyongyang Daily Necessities Factory, the Pyongyang Spices Factory, the Jonchon Match Factory, the Tobacco Complex, the Pyongyang Mechanical Pencil Factory, the Pyongyang Eyeglass Factory and many other light industry factories. The Hamhung Catfish Farm is also no exception to them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Feats Praised by Foreign Personages
body: Personages of different countries issued statements and articles on the occasion of the 9th anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's demise. Mostafa Jamal Haider, chairman of the Bangladesh Jatiya Party, said in a statement that Kim Jong Il devoted himself to the prosperity of the country and happiness of the people with his lofty view of life, continuing his long and arduous journey for the people. Manju Ratna Sakya, chairman of the Nepal Journalist Association, said in a statement that Kim Jong Il developed the Juche idea founded by President Kim Il Sung and set it as the monolithic guiding ideology of the DPRK. Kim Jong Il ensured peace and stability of the Korean peninsula and the region by enforcing the Songun politics when the world socialist movement underwent serious turns and twists and the imperialist allied forces were escalating their threats to the DPRK, the statement noted. Phanindra Raj Pant, secretary general of the Nepal-Korea Friendship Association, said in an article that the DPRK vigorously advanced along the road of independence and socialism under the guidance of Kim Jong Il, adding the Korean people highly praise him as the father of the great socialist family. The secretary general of the Romanian Workers' Association noted in an article that the Korean People's Army, which developed into the army strong in ideology and faith under the leadership of Kim Jong Il, demonstrated its might as the main force not only for defending the country but also for the socialist construction. Korean socialism was safeguarded, thanks to Kim Jong Il, the article stressed. Rodong Sinmun

title: Pyongyang National Musical Instrument Factory Inaugurated
body: The Pyongyang National Musical Instrument Factory has been newly built and inaugurated. As the factory was built as a comprehensive national musical instrument producer capable of making dozens of kinds of national string, woodwind and percussion instruments with home-made equipment, a foundation was laid to further develop the national musical instruments. Chairman Kim Jong Il gave instructions on building a factory specializing in the production of national musical instruments on August 3, Juche 100 (2011), the last year of his life. Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un acquainted himself with the construction of the factory and took measures to solve the problems arising in its construction. Its workshops are equipped with home-made modern CNC machines. Ri Yong Sik, first vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and officials concerned looked round the factory on Sunday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Foreign Personages Visit DPRK Missions
body: Foreign personages visited the DPRK missions in their countries from December 8 to 17 on the occasion of the 9th anniversary of the demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. They laid floral baskets, bouquets and flowers before the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and art works depicting them standing together and bowed to them. They included the general secretary of the Central Committee of the Nepal Communist Party (Marxist-Leninist) who is ex-deputy prime minister of Nepal and other Nepalese personages, the chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Bangladesh and Bangladeshi personages, the chairman of the Mongolia-Korea Friendship Society and Mongolian personages, the acting general secretary and members of the Democratic Rally of Africa-Democratic Party of Guinea, the vice-director of the International Department of the Democratic Party of Equatorial Guinea and his party, the chairman of the Egypt-Korea Friendship Association, and the chairman of the Permanent Standing Committee of the Belarus National Association of Friends of Korean People Named after Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il. Meanwhile, the director of the Central Secretariat of the Pakistan People's Party sent a bouquet to the DPRK mission in Pakistan on Dec. 15 on the same occasion. Rodong Sinmun

title: Scores of Construction or Modernization Projects under Way
body: South Hamgyong Province dynamically builds and rebuilds dozens of its structures which will contribute to developing its economy and improving the living standard of its people. It rebuilt its provincial people’s hospital and the Sinpho Canned Fish Factory in a short time. It also built the Hamhung Youth Power Station 1, the Hamhung Kimchi Factory, the chemical experiment hall of Hamhung University of Chemical Industry and the indoor stadium of Hamhung University of Medicine. Moreover, it completed a liquid nourishing fertilizer factory of the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex, the Hamhung Folklore Park and many other structures. It actively steps up the construction of its provincial tree nursery, too. It almost finishes the Pukchong Pig Farm to help toward bettering the dietary lives of its people. It carries out the capacity extension project of its provincial building materials factory. It goes all out to build dwellings at Hoeyang-dong and the Hamhung Youth Open-air Theater. Rodong Sinmun

title: Livestock Production Foundation Consolidated
body: This year South Hwanghae Province built the Haeju Breeding Poultry Farm, the Ongjin Breeding Rabbit Farm, the Jaeryong Breeding Stock Farm, the Sinwon Stock Farm, the Thaethan Breeding Sheep Farm, etc. Besides, it was all out to rebuild the Yonan Duck Farm and many other stockbreeding farms. Consequently, domestic seed animals have been enabled to be tended and produced on scientific and technological lines. Last year anti-epizootic stations were newly built at the cities and counties of SHP. A provincial anti-epizootic station was set up there this year to afford a reliable guarantee for its increased livestock production. Consolidating already-won successes in their work the officials and workers of SHP are now working hard to secure domestic animals of good breeds and augment their livestock products. Rodong Sinmun

title: Work Attitude of Taking Everything into Detailed Account before Execution
body: Yonggwang County repaired many sections of its waterways and riverbanks in good time, thus affording a number of guarantees for raising its crops safely in 2021. Its officials joined the technicians concerned to explore their waterways and riverbanks for a week and discover their damaged sections. They drafted and adopted a scientific plan to repair them and meet the great shortage of water for their next year’s crops. They also calculated in detail the materials, labor and time needed for the repairs. They paid deep attention to correctly determining when the damages of the waterways and riverbanks must be recovered. Consequently, the repair projects were carried out qualitatively with good speed from the outset. This shows that officials can achieve good results in their work when they carefully examine it, perform it under a scientific plan and set personal examples to the masses. Rodong Sinmun

title: For Increased Production of Fermented Fertilizer
body: The labor and management of the Changhyo Cooperative Farm in Hoeryong City make good preparations for their farm work for 2021. Before everything else, they concentrate their efforts on producing the fermented compost “Sinyang 2” and other good-quality organic manures in large quantities. The members of the CCF piled up their fermented composts in rational sizes and covered them with vinyl sheets to provide against a low temperature and heat them as much as necessary. Besides, they took steps to water them amply. The employees of the CCF incessantly increase the output of their fermented composts by dint of selfless work. In addition, they actively procure liquid manure, excrements of domestic animals and other quality manures, plus raw materials for huminite and afford a guarantee for enriching their fields. Rodong Sinmun

title: Validity of Idea of Prioritizing Young People Demonstrated to the Full
body: True to the Party’s idea of attaching importance to young people the Party organizations countrywide conduct a vigorous drive to be models and paragons of their Party leadership in the work of the youth league’s organizations. Some time ago a hundred and tens of basic Party organizations qualified as such ones. The models and paragons increase in number day by day and young people enhance their role in carrying out the Party policies. This patently demonstrates the correctness and vitality of our Party’s idea of setting store by young people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Exploits Praised Abroad
body: There took place seminars on the exploits of Chairman Kim Jong Il in Russia, Mongolia, Bangladesh, Pakistan, Bulgaria and Brazil from December 9 to 16 on the occasion of the 9th anniversary of his demise. Present there were political and social personages and citizens in those countries. The first secretary of the Sakhalin Regional Branch Committee of the Lenin Young Communist League of the Russian Federation praised Kim Jong Il as a prominent leader of the world revolution who devoted himself to the victorious advance of socialist Korea and the accomplishment of the cause of human independence. The chairman of the Mongolian Mt Paektu Association for Independent Development, the chairman of the Mongolian Association for the Study of the Juche Idea-Songun Idea and other personages praised Kim Jong Il as a general possessed of superb military stratagem and pluck, an outstanding diplomat who steered the trend of the international political situation, a benevolent father of the Korean people and the greatest man with noble traits and warm love. The chairman of the Bangladesh Group for the Study of the Songun Policy lauded Kim Jong Il's ideological and theoretical exploits and Songun leadership exploits. The chairman of the Central Committee of the Worker-Peasant Party of Pakistan and the secretary general of the Society for the Study of Self-Reliance of Pakistan highly praised Kim Jong Il as a peerless revolutionary who made a great contribution to the accomplishment of the cause of independence against imperialism. The chief of the Bulgarian Group for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism spoke highly of Kim Jong Il for his exploits in guiding the Workers' Party of Korea. The chairman of the Brazilian Center for the Study of Songun Politics recalled that Kim Jong Il led the struggle for defending socialism to victory under the uplifted banner of Songun. Rodong Sinmun

title: Top-class Emergency Anti-epidemic State Maintained in DPRK
body: All sectors and units are waging an intensive drive to firmly consolidate the anti-epidemic walls. The central anti-epidemic sector is paying primary attention to making sure that all citizens maintain the highest vigilance and unity of action to cope with the global health crisis. Emergency anti-epidemic units in all provinces, cities and counties urge the members of anti-epidemic posts to enhance their responsibility and tightened their control over those handling supplies through intensified education, so that state anti-epidemic measures are strictly observed. Hygienic and anti-epidemic and epizootic prevention organs at all levels tighten their surveillance over seasonal birds and inspection of their habitats so as to thoroughly check the inroads of COVID-19. Public health organs urge the medical workers in charge of households to enhance their responsibilities in regularly carrying out medical checkups for the elderly, children and patients with chronic diseases, find in time residents with fever and respiratory diseases and take immediate steps for curing them after pinpointing their causes. Education institutions and scientific research institutes are putting efforts on the study and introduction of effective disinfectants and sterilization methods indispensable for cementing the anti-epidemic walls. All citizens are urged to regard wearing of masks and sterilization of their hands as part of their life and voluntarily observe the anti-epidemic protocols in their work places and houses. Rodong Sinmun

title: Earth Blown Up Successively by 300,000 Cubic Meters Each Time
body: The General Tideland Reclamation Enterprise of North Phyongan Province blew up a mountain by 300,000 tons in succession, thereby affording a guarantee for dynamically accelerating its tideland reclamation. Last November storm waves swept the Woldo tideland under reclamation and threw hindrances in its way. Firmly determined to complete their tideland ahead of set time the workers and management of the complex went all out to blow up a mountain by 300,000 tons. The employees of the Posan Tideland Reclamation Branch Company and the Ri Su Bok Youth Shock Force finally blasted a mountain by 300,000 tons in Posan in December. The Sokhwa and Jangsong Tideland Reclamation Branch Companies, too, finished tunneling a mountain in the Wol Island and blasted it so as to procure 300,000 tons of rubble stone and soil. Rodong Sinmun

title: Fulfillers of 80-Day Campaign Assignments Increase in Coal-mining Industry
body: More than 10 mining teams, 20-odd heading squads and 6 mining pits of the Sunchon Area Youth Coal Mining Complex fulfilled their production plans for their 80-day campaign. The labor and management of the February 8 Jikdong Youth Coal Mine worked hard to hit their target for their 80-day campaign in the face of their difficulties. Many units of the Chonsong and Ryongdae Youth Coal Mines carried out their mining and heading goals. The 20-odd mining teams and 10-odd heading squads of the Kujang Area Coal Mining Complex topped their work assignments by December 20. Tens of the heading squads and 10-odd mining squads of the Anju Area Coal Mining Complex, including the first heading team of the first Mining Pit of its Ryongrim Coal Mine, executed their tunneling and mining plans for their 80-day campaign. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Officials, working people and service personnel of the People's Army visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il across the country on December 24. Placed before the statues of the President and the Chairman on Mansu Hill were floral baskets and bouquets. The visitors made a bow before the statues. Floral baskets and bouquets were laid at the statues of the great leaders and mosaics of their smiling images in different parts of Pyongyang including Kim Il Sung University, the Ministry of Public Security and the Mansudae Art Studio. Officials, working people and servicepersons in other parts of the country visited the statues of the great leaders and mosaics of their smiling images in their residential quarters to pay homage. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of Anti-Japanese War Heroine Kim Jong Suk
body: Bouquets and flowers were laid before the statues of anti-Japanese war heroine Kim Jong Suk on Thursday, her 103rd birth anniversary. Officials, working people and service personnel of the People's Army in the capital city visited the bust of Kim Jong Suk at the Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery on Mt Taesong and paid tributes to her bust. The visitors observed a moment's silence in memory of her noble life. On the same day, local officials, working people and service personnel laid bouquets and flowers before the statues of Kim Jong Suk in Hoeryong City, Kim Jong Suk County and Kim Jong Suk Naval University and other places of the country, and made bows to her. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Remembered Abroad
body: Meetings for remembering Chairman Kim Jong Il took place in Bangladesh, Belarus, Sweden, Hungary, Norway, Denmark, Finland, Iceland, Slovenia, Guinea and Libya from Dec. 10 to 17 on the occasion of the 9th anniversary of his demise. Speeches were made at the meetings attended by personages of various political parties, organizations and institutions and citizens in those countries. Speakers praised the noble career of the Chairman who performed gigantic exploits for the Korean revolution and the cause of global independence and worked heart and soul for the country's prosperity and the people's happiness. Meanwhile, a remembrance meeting was held by the Communist Party of the Soviet Union on Dec. 15. Rodong Sinmun

title: Ranking of Socialist Emulation in Pomicultural Field Rated
body: Fruit growers countrywide could produce more fruits this year than last year by dint of devoted work. In liaison with the units concerned the Central Committee of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea analyzed and synthesized the successes and defects of fruit producers in their culture and on this basis, ranked them in the 2020 fruiters’ socialist emulation in terms of their per-hectare fruit yield and its quality and taste. In the emulation large-scale fruit producers called the Kwail and Pukchang Counties and the Kosan and Taedonggang Combined Fruit Farms were classified into the first category and more than 30 fruit farms under the control of the Fruit Culture Department of the Ministry of Agriculture into the second category. The TCFF placed first, KC second and PC third in the first category. The Onchon Fruit Farm placed first, the Toksong Apple Farm second, the Sukchon Youth Fruit Farm third, the Jungsan Youth Fruit Farm fourth and the Kwaksan Fruit Farm fifth in the second category. The rest were ranked to the 32nd place according to their merit. Rodong Sinmun

title: Magnesia Clinker Production Plan Fulfilled
body: The General Bureau of the Tanchon Area Mining Industry executed its magnesia clinker production plan for its 80-day campaign. Having finished repairing their flood damages in a short time and gone into production the workers and management of the Ryongyang and Paekbawi Mines, the Tanchon Magnesia Factory and the Songjin Fireproof Materials Factory did their utmost to boost their output as much as possible. Rodong Sinmun

title: In Order for Study-while-working System to Prove More Effective
body: Factory colleges in all parts of the country have registered considerable successes in ensuring that the study-while-working system proves more fruitful than ever. Pyongyang College of Technology produced quite a lot of persons with academic degrees and titles and renewed thousands of their lesson plans this year so that they could contribute to normalizing and modernizing the production of the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill. Moreover, it successfully devised many good teaching methods which could be applied in all factory colleges nationwide. Sinuiju College of Technology, too, has put the contents of its education in many study courses and synthesized and modernized them. It also formulated more than 110 model teaching programs. Chongjin, Phyongchon, Sosong, Munphyong, Hungnam and Kangson Colleges of Technology and Nampho College of Marine Transport have registered tangible results in innovating their teaching contents and methods in close liaison with the field technicians of factories and enterprises in their districts. Rodong Sinmun

title: Electricity Production Plan Overfulfilled
body: In the sector of the electricity industry its officials and workers produce millions of kilowatt hours more electricity every day over and above their plans during their 80-day campaign. Thermal power stations nationwide ceaselessly work hard to increase the production of their electricity. The case is similar to hydroelectric power stations countrywide. Rodong Sinmun

title: Demonstrating Vitality of Mass Technological Innovation Drive
body: Models of technological innovations increase in number throughout the country one after another. A mass technological innovation drive was conducted vigorously in many units of the country. Consequently, 85 units were qualified as models of technological innovations some time ago. More than 230 units were honored as such this year. Of them all, 9 units were qualified as thrice models of technological innovations and 35 ones as twice models of technological innovations during their 80-day campaign. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chongryon Joint Meeting Held in Japan
body: A joint meeting of chairmen of the Headquarters of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) and chairpersons of its branches took place at the Korean Hall of Culture in Tokyo on December 12. Attending the meeting were Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of Chongryon, Pak Ku Ho, its first vice-chairman, and others. Ho Jong Man made a report. He said that Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un sent a congratulatory message to the Conference of Representatives of Branches of Chongryon. He put emphasis on the important issues arising in embodying the idea of Kim Jong Un's congratulatory message in the work of Chongryon by holding fast to it as an invincible treasured sword and making the whole of Chongryon, all its officials and hard-core masses immediately turn out with resolve in implementing the tasks set forth in the congratulatory message for consolidating the branches of Chongryon. He called for setting the year 2021 as "the one for consolidating the branches of Chongryon" and making the year the first year of the struggle in which the whole association will turn out in fully implementing Kim Jong Un's idea of attaching importance to the branches. Speakers at the meeting vowed to unite as one and develop the branches of Chongryon into patriotic ones, bearing in mind the idea and intention carried in the congratulatory message sent by Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Material and Technological Foundations Consolidated at Local Industrial Factories
body: Phyongsong City registered good results in rebuilding its local industrial factories on modern lines with might and main this year. To this end it organized its labor skillfully and secured materials on a priority basis. In addition, it pushed ahead with the projects on the principle of producing and installing as many homemade machines as possible and thoroughly relying on the sources of its local raw materials. Its officials and workers try their hardest to carry on their 80-day campaign building up the successes they made in their work. Rodong Sinmun

title: Fulfillers of Their 80-day Campaign Assignments Produced in Succession
body: The Komdok Mining Complex fulfilled its mineral production plan for its 80-day campaign ahead of schedule despite its unparalleled difficulties. The Jangsan Electric Appliances Factory and the Ryangchaek Bearing Factory carried out their assignments for the production of electric cars, electromotors and various kinds of other bearings. The Tongrim Mining Machine Factory hit its target for the production of electric cars, reducers, loaders and other ordered equipment during its 80-day campaign. The Sinuiju Mining Machine Factory achieved its hutch production goal for its 80-day campaign. Dozens of units controlled by the Pyongyang Municipal Local Industry Management Bureau carried out their goals for their 80-day campaign. Rodong Sinmun

title: Foreign Personages Visit DPRK Missions
body: Personages of various circles in different countries visited the DPRK missions in their countries on December 16 and 17 on the occasion of the 9th anniversary of the demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. They laid floral baskets, bouquets and flowers before the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and art works depicting the peerlessly great men standing together and bowed to them. Among them were the chairwoman of the Party for Peace and Unity of Russia, the vice-director of the International Affairs Department of the Liberal Democratic Party of Russia, the chairman and the first vice-chairman of the Czech Group for the Study and Materialization of the Juche Idea, the Political Bureau of the Workers' Party for the Independence of Senegal, members of the Guinean Rainbow People's Assembly, the chairman of the Ethiopian Committee for the Study of the Independent Politics, the national president of the Working Citizens' Association of DR Congo and the chairman of the Youth Group for the Study of the Juche Idea in DR Congo. Meanwhile, the secretary general of the Karachi Branch of the Pakistan-Korea Friendship Association and the deputy headmaster of Metropolitan Academy in Karachi, Pakistan sent bouquets to the DPRK mission in Pakistan on Dec. 16 on the same occasion. Rodong Sinmun

title: Project for Apatite Concentrates Production Concluded
body: In west Korea apatite mines finished their projects for creating the productive capacity of their apatite concentrates. The workers and management of the Phungnyon, Yongyu and Jungsan Mines pushed them forward despite their overlapping difficulties and set up the integrated production system for their scientific production and management the while. While focusing their efforts on their production the mines simultaneously tunneled along to prospect for apatite and prepare for its mining and removed their overburden. Consequently, they overfulfilled their plans for the production of apatite concentrates, tunneling for prospecting and preliminary purposes and the disposal of overburden true to their 80-day campaign and laid the foundations for executing their plans to turn out apatite concentrates in 2021. Rodong Sinmun

title: Well over 10,000 Tons of Vegetables Produced
body: at Jungphyong Vegetable Greenhouse Farm The Jungphyong Vegetable Greenhouse Farm produced ten thousand and thousands of tons of fresh vegetables of diverse kinds, including cucumber, tomato, celery cabbage and radish, in a bit more than a year and supplied them to the people of the province after its inauguration. In the JVGF scientists and researchers pooled their creative wisdom with its technicians and devoted themselves entirely to breeding young vegetables of good strains. The result was that the JVGF provided the baby home, kindergarten, primary school and secondary school for orphans, the old people’s home, the home for the disabled and many cities and counties of the province with the vegetables it produced in huge quantities. Rodong Sinmun

title: People Move to New Houses in Feed Supply Farms under Kwangchon Chicken Farm
body: Dwelling houses for a thousand and hundreds of households have been successfully built in the area of Kwangchon in North Hwanghae Province. In the feed supply farms under the Kwangchon Chicken Farm which are being built as the model in the field of poultry, low- and single-storied dwelling houses of various styles with perfect living conditions and environment have been beautifully built with the introduction of formative art to architecture on the principle of convenience and architectural beauty first. Fruit trees such as apricot and persimmon trees, and trees of good species have taken roots around the dwelling houses of the new villages that appeared in Kwangchon-ri, Jangsa-ri and Hukgyo-ri of Hwangju County. Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un initiated the construction of the modern chicken farm conducive to the development of the country's poultry and took measures for pushing ahead with the construction of the farm in parallel with the development of the feed supply farms into the model units of rural culture. Servicepersons of the Korean People's Army (KPA), and officials and other working people of North Hwanghae Province built wonderful dwelling houses fully embodying the needs of the new era and the desire of the people in a short period. Meetings for moving to new houses took place in the farm villages in Kwangchon-ri, Jangsa-ri and Hukgyo-ri on Sunday. Licenses for the use of the houses were handed over to the inhabitants following speeches there. KPA soldiers and builders congratulated the new owners of the houses in the new modern villages. Rodong Sinmun

title: Vegetables Produced in Midwinter
body: The Mangyongdae District Agricultural Management Committee has a vegetable producer with more than 10 greenhouses. Various kinds of leaf and fruit vegetables are produced there even in the dead of winter. Tomatoes thrive in its 5th greenhouse. They can be reaped in January 2021. Cabbages and celery cabbages, too, are grown well there as catch crops. Consequently, the greenhouse is used effectively. Celery cabbages are harvested in the 9th greenhouse of the producer, too. Rodong Sinmun

title: Pupho Duck Farm Remodeled
body: The Pupho Duck Farm was rebuilt on modern lines in Rason City. It covers an area of tens of thousands of square meters. It has an education space, welfare service facilities and a production center. All the processes of the PDF are put on an automatic footing and its products come off the flow line. It produces plenty of duck and eggs every year. Rodong Sinmun

title: Striving to Secure Solid Guarantee of Ceaseless Advance
body: The officials, workers and technicians of the Sunchon Thermal Power Station actively step up the repair, maintenance and technological reconstruction of their generation equipment to continuously increase their electricity production. Lots of valuable technological innovations have so far been contrived and applied for tens of days through a vigorous mass technological innovation drive. The workers of the STPS are now working indefatigably and efficiently to rebuild their feed pump vanes and many other machines along technological lines at their final stage. Rodong Sinmun

title: Their 80-day Campaign Targets Hit in Succession
body: Hitters of the targets for their 80-day campaign grow in number ceaselessly with the approach of its end. In South Hamgyong Province factories and enterprises score success after success in their 80-day campaign by striving mightily to honor the forthcoming 8th Congress of the Workers’ Party of Korea with it. The Songyo Knitwear Factory, the Sinuiju Disabled Soldiers’ Knitwear Factory, the Pyongyang and Wonsan Hosiery Factories, the Kaesong Textile Mill and many other light industrial factories achieved the production goals for their 80-day campaign. Young vanguards, too, register laudable results in the important work places of their 80-day campaign for the 8th Congress of the WPK. Rodong Sinmun

title: New Year's Cards Brought out
body: The Mansudae Art Studio, the Korean Central Fine Arts Studio and the Art and Literature Publishing House have brought out over ten kinds of greeting cards for the New Year Juche 110 (2021). Those cards reflect the joy to greet the New Year on the road of worthwhile advance for building a socialist power with great pride of glorifying this year, unprecedentedly arduous year, as a year of struggle, advance and unity under the leadership of the Party, and with national spirit and sentiment. They also show the will of our people who are determined to achieve proud victories in the New Year, too. Rodong Sinmun

title: Their 80-Day Campaign Goals Achieved Successively
body: Thermal power stations countrywide continue to hit the targets for their 80-day campaign one after another. The workers and management of the Pukchang Thermal Power Complex successfully achieved the goal for their 80-day campaign. The Pyongyang Thermal Power Complex boosted its electricity production. Working hard round the clock the employees of the East Pyongyang Thermal Power Station put their generation equipment in full operation and carried out the goal for their 80-day campaign. Besides, the 30-odd heading teams and 10-odd mining teams of the Tukjang Area Coal Mining Complex fulfilled their respective plans for their 80-day campaign. The February 8 Vinalon Complex, the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex, the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex, the Sinuiju Chemical Fiber Mill and other chemical industry factories executed their plans for their 80-day campaign on many indices. The Tanchon Smeltery fulfilled its plan for the production of electrolytic zinc, sulfuric acid, zinc flower and leading others true to its 80-day campaign. The Jangsan Mine hit the target for its 80-day campaign. Rodong Sinmun

title: Tideland Realigned and Improved
body: The April 22 Land Realignment Shock Brigade and the General Tideland Reclamation Enterprise of South Hwanghae Province successfully finished realigning and ameliorating more than 2,000 hectares of the Ryongmaedo tideland according to the plan for their 80-day campaign. The former disposed of millions of cubic meters of soil. The latter made field lanes and cut irrigation channels and drainage channels for hundreds of kilometers and built more than 500 structures in the tideland. Rodong Sinmun

title: Registering Continuous Successes Full of Confidence in Sure Victory
body: Achievers of the goals for their 80-day campaign continue to increase in number in the sector of railway transport. Hundreds of units under the Ministry of Railways finished the goals for their 80-day campaign. Hitters of the targets for their 80-day campaign grow in number ceaselessly in the sphere of water power generation, too. They are the Kanggye Youth, Wiwon, Jangjagang, Thongchon, Namgang, Suphung, Jangjingang, Taedonggang, Pujongang, Thaechon and Huichon Power Stations, the Kumyagang Army-People Power Station and the Paektusan Hero Youth Power Station. The Musan Mining Complex and the Huichon Precision Machine Plant fulfilled their production plans for their 80-day campaign. Rodong Sinmun

title: Accurately Targeted Political Work Enhancing Zeal for Revolution and Struggle
body: Party organizations nationwide vigorously encourage officials, Party members and working people to build up the successes they scored in their 80-day campaign and defend the forthcoming 8th Party Congress at all costs. The Party organizations of Pyongyang conduct intensive political work to rouse the masses to activity for uninterrupted and devoted work. Those of South Phyongan Province, too, carry on intensive frontline political work. Having drawn up an innovative plan for its next year’s farming those of South Hwanghae Province firmly ensure that it is carried out. The Jagang Provincial Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea energetically inspires the masses to implement its plan to complete the Hungju Youth Power Station 5 in a short time. In addition, the Party organizations of the Pukchang Thermal Power Complex and the Tongbong Cooperative Farm in Hamju County and other Party organizations throughout the country continuously animate the masses to great efforts. Rodong Sinmun

title: 22nd Meeting of Political Bureau of 7th Central Committee of WPK Held
body: The 22nd meeting of the Political Bureau of the 7th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) was held at the office building of the Party Central Committee on December 29. Kim Jong Un, chairman of the WPK, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, was present at the meeting. Present there were members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK and members and alternate members of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee. Under the guidance of Supreme Leader of the Party, state and armed forces Kim Jong Un, Kim Jae Ryong, vice-chairman of the WPK Central Committee, presided over the meeting. The meeting studied the preparations for the 8th Congress of the WPK. The meeting examined and made confirmation as for the qualifications of the delegates who had been elected at the conferences of the WPK organizations at all levels, discussed and confirmed the proposals for forming the presidium, members of platform and secretariat of the 8th Congress of the Party and schedules according to the agendas of the Party Congress and deliberated on the documents to be presented to the Party Congress. The Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK made exhaustive discussion on the above issues and approved agendas. The Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK adopted a decision on holding the 8th Congress of the WPK early in January, 2021. The meeting appreciated that innovative achievements and progress were made in all fields during the 80-day campaign thanks to the exceptional political enthusiasm of the entire Party and all the people, providing excellent conditions for the 8th Congress of the Party, and all the preparations for the Party Congress are going off smoothly. It emphasized that the success of the Party Congress should be thoroughly guaranteed by keeping on the effective preparations. The Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee also made in-depth study and discussion on a series of important issues to be referred to the Party Congress and made relevant decisions. Political News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Floral Baskets from Foreign Organizations and Figures
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received floral baskets from foreign organizations and figures on Tuesday on the occasion of the 9th anniversary of his assumption of the supreme commandership of the armed forces of the DPRK. The foreign organizations are the Asia-Pacific Regional Committee for Supporting Peaceful Reunification of Korea, the Beijing Chao Ya International Cultural Exchange Center in China, the Beijing international cultural development center for China-DPRK friendship, and the Japan Committee for Supporting the Independent and Peaceful Reunification of Korea. The foreign personages are the family of the former Japanese Deputy Prime Minister Sin Kanemaru and Ibrahim Mantu, chairman of the Nigeria-Korea Friendship Association. Meanwhile, the Supreme Leader received a floral basket from the family of Zhang Weihua, a Chinese anti-Japanese revolutionary martyr, on the same day on the occasion of the 9th anniversary of his assumption of the supreme commandership of the armed forces of the DPRK and the New Year, Juche 110(2021). Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Baskets to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Members of Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received floral baskets from Co-Chairman Johnny Hon, Honorary Vice-Chairman Sai Tiejen and Honorary Directors Qiu Jianliang and Cui Tongwen of the Board of Directors of the Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation and Lin Gennan, Li Ailan, Zhan Xueyan, Jin Chenyu and Tang Yiming, members of the foundation, on Tuesday on the occasion of the New Year, Juche 110 (2021). On the same day, the Supreme Leader received a floral basket from the China Dandong branch of the Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation. Rodong Sinmun

title: Members of Missions of International Bodies Pay Floral Tribute to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Members of the UN resident coordinator office and missions of UNDP, UNICEF, United Nations Population Fund, FAO, WFP and WHO here visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on Dec. 29 on the occasion of the New Year Juche 110 (2021). They laid floral baskets before the statues and paid tribute to them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Successes Made in Metallurgical Industry
body: Plants in the metallurgical industry have attained the goals for the 80-day campaign on major indices. The Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex has over-fulfilled its goals in production of pig iron, steel and rolled steel. The Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex carried out its pig iron production plan ahead of schedule by organizing an emulation campaign among its workers to reduce the smelting time of the UHP electric arc furnace and increase the output of molten iron. It has also successfully achieved the goals for steel and rolled steel production. The Posan Iron Works has increased the production of Juche iron by keeping its revolving furnaces in full-capacity operation. The Chollima Steel Complex has fulfilled its goals for the campaign by raising the operation rate of furnaces and rolling machines. Similar successes have been achieved in other industrial establishments including the Musan Mining Complex, the Unryul Mine and the Hungnam Electrode Factory. Rodong Sinmun

title: Intensified Emergency Anti-epidemic Work Goes on in DPRK
body: Stricter measures have been taken in the DPRK to thoroughly check the inroads of COVID-19 with the approach of the New Year's Day. The central emergency anti-epidemic units have taken measures to conduct medical examination of citizens more strictly in public places, intensify the work for cleaning and disinfecting open-air places and reinforce the anti-epidemic checkpoints in keeping with the situation to make sure that all citizens wear masks and thoroughly observe other anti-epidemic protocols. Public health workers are urged to enhance their roles and carry out medical checkups for inhabitants in a responsible way. Workers in the field of public transport thoroughly sterilize tramcars, buses and other vehicles and make sure that passengers strictly observe the anti-epidemic rules. Service facilities have intensified the medical examination of their workers and urged them to observe the sanitary rules and properly disinfect the service places and kitchen utensils as specified in the rules. Officials and workers of the emergency anti-epidemic units across the country have further intensified the ideological education to make all citizens maintain the unity of action in the emergency anti-epidemic campaign during the holidays. They examine in detail water of rivers and streams and conduct information activities to make sure that citizens would not touch wild animals. Institutions, industrial establishments and people's neighborhood units have taken measures to keep their working places, villages, office rooms and homes tidy and clean in terms of sanitation and cultured practice and to heat up the public anti-epidemic atmosphere of helping and steering each other. Rodong Sinmun

title: ﻿Certificates Awarded to Delegates to 8th Congress of WPK
body: A ceremony for awarding certificates to delegates to the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) took place on Wednesday. Seen at the venue of the ceremony were sacred red flags of the WPK. First, certificates were courteously awarded to President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, founder and builder of our glorious Party, at the ceremony, reflecting the unanimous will and ardent desire of millions of members of the entire Party and all other Korean people. When it was declared that certificates were awarded to the President and the Chairman, all the participants in the ceremony passionately applauded in token of support. They were gripped by great emotion that they are to greet the Party Congress, invariably upholding the President and the Chairman as great delegates to our Party Congress as in their lifetime. Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK and vice-chairman of the Party Central Committee who is the chairman of the preparatory committee for the 8th Congress of the WPK, said in excitement that the hearts of all the participants were full of ardent yearning for the President and the Chairman, peerlessly great men and patriots, great sages of revolution and the sun of Juche, at the time of glory when they were awarded the certificates. It is the requirement of our Party and revolution and the unanimous aspiration and will and right obligation of all the Party members and other people to uphold the President and the Chairman, who are always alive in our hearts as spiritual mainstay and instilling the indomitable faith and the will to struggle into us, as the great delegates to the Party Congress as in their lifetime to adopt the line and strategy for a new victory in the revolution, he stressed. He said that the 8th Congress of the WPK comes to be an important political event which will make another milestone for a fresh turn in the history of the glorious Party as it will set forth the line of struggle and strategic and tactical policies to surely put the cause of building a socialist power onto the next stage of victory. He stressed that the certificates to delegates to the 8th Congress of the WPK are the reflection of deep political trust and expectation of the Party Central Committee that expects them to display boundless devotion and self-sacrificing spirit in implementing the Party's policies, being conscious of important responsibilities before the Party and revolution with the great honor and pride. He called upon all the delegates to make positive contribution to glorifying the Congress as a historic one for fully demonstrating the dignity and prestige of the WPK before the world and for laying a firm springboard for a new victory of the revolution. Awarded to the participants were the certificates that carry the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il along with our sacred Party emblem, symbol of all victories and glory. All the participants were fully determined to take an active part in the Party Congress amid high political enthusiasm, bearing deep in mind the great trust of the great Party Central Committee which put them forward as delegates to the Party Congress, the supreme guidance organ of the WPK, and the expectation of all the Party members. Rodong Sinmun

title: Brisk Preparations for 8th Congress of WPK
body: Millions of party members, other people and service personnel of the People's Army are looking forward to the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) to be held in Pyongyang as an important event of special record in the sacred path of the revolutionary cause of Juche which is vigorously advancing under the uplifted banner of the great Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism. Since they heard the historic decision on holding the 8th Congress of the WPK, all the people have been out for ushering in a new period of a great surge and turn in the revolution by inheriting the tradition of loyalty characterized by great revolutionary upswings that glorified the Party congresses. Amid the elated spirit of all the people to greet the 8th Congress of the Party with high political zeal and brilliant labor feats, preparations for the Party Congress have made headway. Conferences of the WPK organizations at all levels took place in December. The conferences comprehensively reviewed the work done by relevant Party organizations in the period under review, based on the idea and spirit of the 6th Plenary Meeting of the 7th Central Committee of the WPK and elected new leadership organs. Provincial Party conferences and conferences of party organizations that assume the same function as the provincial Party committee, including the Party committees of the Korean People's Army, the Cabinet, the Ministry of Public Security, the Ministry of Railways, the Ministry of Culture and the Capital City Construction Commission elected the Party members who would play the core, leading role in the struggle for implementing the decision to be made at the 8th Party Congress as delegates to the Party Congress, and nominated observers. Delegates to the 8th Party Congress arrived in Pyongyang late in December amid the warm welcome by citizens. The delegates started the technical preparations for the Congress with a high sense of responsibility and great honor of attending the Party Congress, the supreme guidance organ of the WPK, on behalf of their party organizations. During the period of preparations, the delegates watched the documentary films such as "Five Years of Great Leadership that Brought about Victory and Change" which helps recollect the glorious and worthwhile days of creating a new history of great change under the energetic leadership of the Party Central Committee. A national photo, book and art exhibition opened at the Korean Art Gallery to mark the 8th Party Congress impressively shows the immortal history of revolutionary activities of our Party and the history of the struggle of the heroic people who have followed the Party. The preparations for the 8th Party Congress are successfully underway amid the profound interest and expectations of the whole country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Basket to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il from Korean Friendship Association
body: The Korean Friendship Association sent a floral basket to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on the occasion of the New Year Juche 110 (2021). The floral basket was placed before the statues on Dec. 30. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Basket and Congratulatory Letter to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Diplomatic Corps
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a floral basket and congratulatory letter from the diplomatic corps here on the occasion of the New Year Juche 110 (2021). The floral basket and congratulatory letter were handed to an official concerned by the Palestinian ambassador to the DPRK, who is doyen of the corps, on Wednesday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Floral Basket from Palestinian President
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a floral basket from Mahmoud Abbas, president of the State of Palestine, on the occasion of the New Year Juche 110 (2021). The floral basket was conveyed to an official concerned by the Palestinian ambassador here on Wednesday. Rodong Sinmun

title: 7,000-odd Dwellings Built
body: South Phyongan Province built high-rise, low-rise and single-story dwellings for more than 7,000 families this year. Consolidating this success it is now striving to build another dwellings in larger numbers. Its officials, Party members and working people score one success after another in improving the living standard of the people by dint of hard work. Rodong Sinmun

title: To Greet the 8th Congress of WPK with Proud Labor Achievements
body: In all parts of the country officials and working people continue to go ahead with their work the way they finished their goals for their 80-day campaign from a desire to honor the forthcoming 8th Congress of the Workers’ Party of Korea with laudable successes in their work. The Pukchang Area Youth Coal Mining Complex, the Kujang, Kangdong and Chonnae Area Coal Mining Complexes and other coal industry complexes carried out the goals for their 80-day campaign. The Unryul Mine fulfilled the production plan for its 80-day campaign by more than 200%, and a potato-processing factory of Taehongdan County topped the plan for the production of its processed potatoes. Rodong Sinmun

title: Vitality of Three-revolution Team Movement Displayed
body: The members of the three-revolution teams have brought about more than 9,600 technological innovations in many sectors of the national economy this year. Their exceptional researching spirit and creative ardor have patently been demonstrated especially in the national contest of the three-revolution teams for technological innovations held on the occasion of the 75th birthday of the Workers’ Party of Korea. The members of the three-revolution teams gave full play to their creative enthusiasm during their 80-day campaign. They set themselves high research targets and successfully carried on their technological innovations with courage. This bears clear testimony to the vitality of the three-revolution team movement. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Visits Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: Another year of victory has been recorded in the history of our country which vigorously advances for the realization of the ideal for a powerful country with the might of the single-hearted unity under the leadership of the great Party. All the people of the country, who are greeting the significant New Year Juche 110 (2021) when the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) will be held, are extending the best wishes of immortality to President Kim Il Sung, founding father of socialist Korea, and Chairman Kim Jong Il, who are the great leaders of our Party and people and the great sages of the revolution. Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun at 00:00, January 1, 2021 together with the delegates to the 8th Congress of the Party. The Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, sacred temple of Juche where Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il lie in state, was wrapped in a solemn atmosphere. He was accompanied by Choe Ryong Hae, Ri Pyong Chol, Kim Tok Hun and Pak Pong Ju, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, and other members of the Party Central Committee leadership body and the delegates to the 8th Congress of the Party. A floral basket in the name of Supreme Leader of the Party, state and armed forces Kim Jong Un was placed before the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il. Also laid were floral baskets in the names of the WPK Central Committee, the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK and the Cabinet of the DPRK. The Supreme Leader together with the visitors paid high tribute to the statues. At the halls where the President and the Chairman lie in state, the Supreme Leader offered them his New Year's greetings in the deepest reverence. The members of the Party Central Committee leadership body and the delegates to the Party Congress hardened their firm pledge to glorify the 8th Congress of the Party as the watershed in the development of the Party and the revolution and fulfill their responsibility and duty in the advance in the New Year to accelerate the fresh victory of the socialist cause. Political News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Letter to All People on New Year
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, Chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, Chairman of the State Affairs Commission and Supreme Commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, sent a letter to all the people, greeting the hope-filled new year, Juche 110 (2021). The following is the full text of the letter: Happy New Year. As we greet the new year, I extend my heartfelt greetings to all the people. I sincerely wish all the families across the country greater happiness and beloved people, good health. In the new year, too, I will work hard to bring earlier the new era in which the ideals and desires of our people will come true. I offer thanks to the people for having invariably trusted and supported our Party even in the difficult times. Pledging once again that I will always remain faithful to the great people. Kim Jong Un January 1, 2021

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Greetings to Cuban Leaders
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Thursday sent a message of greeting to Raul Castro Ruz, first secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba (CPC), and Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez, president of the Republic of Cuba. The message extended warm felicitations and comradely greeting to the first secretary and the president of Cuba, the Cuban party, government and people on the occasion of the 62nd anniversary of the victory of the Cuban revolution. Expressing pleasure over the fact that the fraternal Cuban people have firmly defended the sovereignty and dignity of the country and the priceless gains of the revolution under the leadership of the CPC despite all sorts of challenges by the hostile forces and their moves to stifle Cuba, the message expressed full support and solidarity with the Cuban party, government and people in their struggle. Expressing the belief that the relations of friendship, unity and cooperation between the two parties and two countries forged in the common struggle for accomplishing the cause of socialism will grow stronger in the spirit of the agreement reached at the significant Pyongyang meeting in November, 2018, the message sincerely wished the first secretary and the president of Cuba good health and greater successes in their noble work for leading the Cuban revolution. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Greetings to Chairman
body: of Chongryon Central Standing Committee Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Friday sent greetings to Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), on the occasion of the New Year Juche 110 (2021). The Supreme Leader said in the message that the New Year 2021 is greeted amid the sacred struggle for realizing the desire for building a great powerful nation. He extended his warm felicitations and compatriotic greetings to the members of the Central Leadership and all the officials of Chongryon and other Koreans in Japan on the occasion of the hopeful New Year. The message recalled that last year Chongryon won great victories in its every patriotic front through its more resolute struggle for ushering in a new heyday of the movement of Koreans in Japan despite severe trials threatening the life and interests of Koreans in Japan. It said that the successful Conference of Representatives of Branches of Chongryon, the first of its kind in the history of the movement of the overseas compatriots, and the eye-opening successes in implementation of overall patriotic tasks can be called great prides but the greatest and the most precious success is that Chongryon has firmly protected the compatriots' lives despite the global public health crisis. The Supreme Leader expressed thanks to the officials of the organizations, bodies and enterprises of Chongryon at all levels for doing their best to make sure that our dear compatriots and their families greet the morning of the New Year's Day with happy laughter. He also paid high tribute to Koreans in Japan for displaying intense loyalty and patriotism in the last year's proud struggle for their country, overcoming severe trials in an alien land by getting firmly united around Chongryon organizations. The message noted that the New Year 2021 is the one of a great turn and a grandiose struggle in which an advance toward fresh development and prosperity for realizing the people's dreams and ideals starts, under the strategy and goals dedicated to attaining prosperity in self-reliance to be set forth at the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea. The message called on Chongryon to concentrate on the anti-epidemic campaign for protecting the compatriots' life and safety and strive hard to build a harmonious and wealthy community of Koreans in Japan pure in Juche character and national identity and to achieve national reunification and prosperity by dint of idea and the single-hearted unity. The Supreme Leader added that he will take warmer care of the officials of Chongryon and other Koreans in Japan as our great people living in an alien country and show special affection for them as ever. He sincerely wished the trustworthy officials of Chongryon including the chairman of its Central Standing Committee and all other dear compatriots in Japan good health, and hoped that all their families would be filled with love, hope and happiness in the new year, too. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Floral Basket to Cuban Leaders
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a floral basket to Raul Castro Ruz, first secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba, and Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez, president of the Republic of Cuba, on the occasion of the 62nd anniversary of the victory of the Cuban revolution. The DPRK ambassador to Cuba courteously handed over the floral basket bearing the august name of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un to an official concerned of the Cuban Foreign Ministry on December 28, Juche 109(2020). Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Palestinian President
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, received a message of greeting from Mahmoud Abbas, president of the State of Palestine and chairman of the Executive Committee of the Palestine Liberation Organization, on Dec. 22. The Palestinian president in the message said that he was pleased to extend the warmest congratulations to Kim Jong Un, and through him, to the friendly government and people of the DPRK on behalf of the state and the people of Palestine and on his own behalf, hoping that the Korean people and other peoples in the world would be happy and prosperous in the New Year 2021. In the message he sincerely wished the Supreme Leader good health, happiness and success in his work. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Kuwaiti Emir
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, received a message of greeting from Nawaf Al-Ahmad Al-Jaber Al-Sabah, emir of the State of Kuwait, on Dec. 20. The Kuwaiti emir said in the message that he was pleased to extend his warm felicitations and best wishes to Kim Jong Un on the occasion of the New Year 2021. Sharing his joy with the Chairman on that occasion, the emir hoped that the New Year would be a good year bringing peace and stability to the whole world and wellbeing and prosperity to all peoples. The message wished the Chairman good health, expressing belief that the friendly relations between the two countries and peoples would grow stronger. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Congratulatory Letter from C.C., AINDF
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a congratulatory letter from the Central Committee of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front (AINDF) on Friday on the occasion of the New Year 2021. Last year 2020 was a year of great victory and glory in which the prestige of the ever-victorious Workers' Party of Korea was demonstrated all over the world and the independent dignity of Juche Korea and its tremendous might and powerful spirit were displayed at the highest level under the outstanding and seasoned leadership of Kim Jong Un, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, the letter said, and went on: The proud victory and fruition achieved in the Republic last year serve as noble outcome of the Supreme Leader's outstanding idea, seasoned leadership and tireless devotion and efforts, and the great and immortal epoch-making feats would be brilliantly recorded in the history of Juche Korea and be handed down forever. The eye-opening reality of the Republic recording only victory resolutely countering all sorts of challenges and stern trials of the history as it holds the Supreme Leader in high esteem, deepens the yearning for the homeland of Juche and the conviction in bright future of the nation among the vanguard fighters and the patriotic people of all social strata of the south, and makes them renew their firm pledge to achieve national reunification and cause of national independence under the guidance of the Supreme Leader. The letter vowed to faithfully uphold the guidance of the Supreme Leader while holding great President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il as the eternal sun of Juche and Kim Jong Un as the top leader of the nation this year, too. The letter expressed a resolution to consolidate the organization as the ranks of vanguard fighters of Juche who advance along the path of independence indicated by the chairman of the State Affairs Commission and take the lead in the movement of change on this land with the great immortal Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism as the only guiding idea. The letter sincerely wished good health to Kim Jong Un, symbol of the national dignity and glory and banner of victory. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Gift from Russian Political Party Leader
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a gift from the chairwoman of the Party for Peace and Unity of Russia on the occasion of the New Year Juche 110(2021). The gift was conveyed to the DPRK ambassador to Russia by Chairwoman Sazhi Umalatova on December 30, 2020. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Tribute to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Officials, working people and service personnel paid tribute to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and the mosaics of their smiling images across the country in the morning of the hopeful New Year's Day. Floral baskets were laid before the statues on Mansu Hill in the names of the Party, power and armed forces organs, social organizations, ministries, national institutions, units of the Korean People's Army (KPA) and the Public Security Forces (PSF) and institutions, industrial establishments and universities at all levels here. Members of the Pyongyang mission of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front placed a bouquet before the statues. The visitors bowed to the statues. Floral baskets in the names of KPA and PSF units, institutions and enterprises, and bunches of flowers were laid before the statues of the great leaders and mosaics of their smiling images in different parts of Pyongyang, including Kim Il Sung University, the Ministry of Public Security and the Mansudae Art Studio. Officials, working people and service personnel across the country also paid homage to the statues of the great leaders and mosaics of their smiling images in their residential areas. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Chongryon Organizations and Affiliates
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received messages of greeting from the organizations and affiliates of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) on the occasion of the New Year Juche 110 (2021). Among them are the central organizations of Chongryon, including the Standing Council of the Korean Federation of Workers in Commerce in Japan, the Central Standing Committee of the Korean Youth League in Japan, the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Democratic Korean Women in Japan, the Central Standing Management Board of the Korean Youth Commercial Association in Japan, the Central Standing Council of the Union of Korean Educational Association in Japan, the Central Standing Council of the Korean Scientists and Technologists Association in Japan, the Central Standing Council of the Korean Social Scientists Association in Japan, the Standing Council of the Korean Sportsmen's Federation in Japan, the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Korean Writers and Artists in Japan, the Central Standing Council of the Korean Health Workers Association in Japan, the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Korean Students in Japan, the Association of Koreans in Japan for Peaceful Reunification and the Central Standing Council of the Korean Human Rights Association in Japan, and branch organizations. The Chongryon affiliates are the Choson Sinbo Company, the Korean News Service, the Hagu Bookshop, the Kumgang-san Opera Troupe, the Kumgang Insurance Company, the Committee for Promoting Korea-Japan Economic Exchange, the Center for Consulting Marriage of Korean Youth in Japan, etc. Kim Jong Un also received messages of greeting from local headquarters of Chongryon, Korean University and Korean schools at all levels in Japan. Rodong Sinmun

title: New Year Performance Given by Schoolchildren
body: A performance of schoolchildren "We Are the Happiest in the World" for greeting the New Year Juche 110 (2021) was given at the Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace on December 31.
