They referred to the need to faithfully support the unified leadership system of the Party Central Committee without an inch of deflection to make a positive contribution to the implementation of the Party's line and policies and the tangible development of the Party work, and make devoted efforts for the good of the people with full responsibility for the work of their sectors and units before the Party. The workshop helped the participants keenly feel the importance of scrupulously conducting the organizational and political work, bearing in mind that the destiny of our revolution, our people and themselves depend on the implementation of the decision made at the Party Congress―organizational will of the entire Party and guidelines for thinking and action of officials and Party members. They underlined the need for all the participants in the congress to firmly instill the idea and spirit of the Party Congress into the officials, Party members and other working people and further inspire the masses with the enthusiasm through offensive political work while working out the scientific and feasible plans for implementing the decision made at the Party Congress and closely assigning their duties to make a breakthrough in the advance in the van of the masses. The workshop referred to the issues important for the participants in the congress in making the process of implementing the decision made at the Party Congress an important occasion in strengthening our own force with the firm viewpoint of self-reliance and self-sufficiency, thoroughly observing the principle of giving priority to the state interests and holding fast to talents and science and technology as the main strategic assets. The speakers stressed the need for all the participants in the congress to more vigorously open up an era of fresh development, an era of our state-first principle by thoroughly implementing the decision made at the Party Congress through indefatigable and devoted efforts in the van of the advancing masses, deeply cherishing the trust, expectations and ardent wish of all the Party members and other people of the country. The workshop helped the participants deeply understand once again the intention of the Party Central Committee to open an era of new surge, an era of drastic change in our revolution, with the noble ideals of "The people are God", "single-hearted unity" and "self-reliance" and provide the people with better and stable living conditions and environment as soon as possible. All the participants in the workshop were full of revolutionary zeal to win a great new victory in socialist construction by remaining boundlessly loyal to the people-first principle of our Party true to the leadership of the general secretary and thoroughly implementing the programmes for struggle set forth at the 8th Congress of the Party. Rodong Sinmun

title: WPK Central Committee Sends Congratulatory Message to 11th Congress of LPRP
body: The Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) sent a congratulatory message to the 11th Congress of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party (LPRP) on Jan. 13. The WPK Central Committee in its message warmly congratulated the LPRP upon its 11th Congress and, through the congress, extended warm comradely greetings to all its members. It noted that the LPRP has made a big success in national defence and state building by wisely organizing and leading the struggle of all its members and other Lao people for implementing the decision made at its 10th Congress for the past five years. It expressed firm belief that the 11th Congress of the LPRP would serve as a turning point of marking a new milestone in the struggle for further strengthening the leadership role of the party and achieving the prosperity of the country. It sincerely wished the congress big success in its work, expressing conviction that the traditional friendly and cooperative relations between the two parties and two countries put on a higher stage under the deep care of the top leaders of the two countries would grow stronger in the common struggle for accomplishing the cause of socialism. Rodong Sinmun

title: Turning Out as One in High Spirits
body: The officials and agricultural workers of Taegwan County make uninterrupted innovations in preparing for their farm work for this year with redoubled courage. All its cooperative farms conduct a vigorous frontline agitprop to encourage their employees to work hard. Bearing in mind that piles of compost led to heaps of cereals the agricultural officials and workers of the Taean and Hapsu Cooperative Farms went all out to enrich their fields. In the county other cooperative farms, too, rivaled them in farming. They made earnest arrangements for it item by item. All its cooperative farms make incessant good preparations for their farm work by working with devotion to fimly defend the Party with cereals in all sincerity. Rodong Sinmun

title: Ever-soaring Enthusiasm for Emulation
body: Yontan County works in a big way under arrangements to produce more compost than last year and carpet its fields with it. Before everything else it makes substantial efforts to transport the sludge of a sewage treatment plant and homemade manure to the fields of its cooperative farms by motortruck. The Wollyong Cooperative Farm and other cooperative farms of the county are busy carrying their already-produced manure to their fields. With the passage of time their members vie with each other in their farm work more zealously than ever. The result is that copious manure is spread over their fields. Rodong Sinmun

title: Preparations for Farm Work Gather Momentum
body: The officials and agricultural workers of South Hwanghae Province make vigorous preparations for their farming this year. Those of Jaeryong County take the lead in this. The officials of Anak County ensured that its cooperative farms optimized their use of tractors and other vehicles to transport their manure to their fields. Consequently, the cooperative farms carried their manure to their fields in excess of their quotas despite their adversities. The officials and agricultural workers of Yonan County are all out to extract peat. Unchon County bends every effort to produce activated bio-compost of good quality. Sinchon County and other counties, too, make high results in producing and transporting their manure. Rodong Sinmun

title: For Increased Production and Creation
body: The workers of power stations nationwide have so far produced tens of millions of kilowatt hours more electricity over and above their plan this year. The workers of thermal power stations turn out their electricity on a high normal level. The workers and management of the Pukchang and Pyongyang Thermal Power Complexes make endeavors to produce as much electricity as possible. The workers of the Sunchon, Chongchongang and East Pyongyang Thermal Power Stations register high results in their production, maintaining their equipment technologically with good care. The case is similar to hydroelectric power stations across the country. Thousands of tons of more coal has been produced in excess in the sector of the coal industry since the 8th Congress of the Workers’ Party of Korea began. The labor and management of the Pukchang Area Youth Coal Mining Complex lead their counterparts in the increased production of coal. Many coal mines of the Kujang Area Coal Mining Complex concentrate all their energies on faces with rich coal deposits and favorable mining conditions to augment their output. The workers of the Sunchon Area Youth Coal Mining Complex and the Kaechon Area Coal Mining Complex choose and work out new pit faces on their own initiative and thereby boost their coal production. The officials and workers of the Tokchon and Sunchon Coal Mining Machine Plants and other auxiliary factories turn out spare parts of coal-mining equipment and small tools a lot, filling up the shortage of materials on their own. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Has Photo Session with Delegates to 8th Congress of WPK
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, had a photo session with the delegates to the 8th Congress of the WPK on Thursday. Present there were Choe Ryong Hae, Jo Yong Won, Ri Pyong Chol and Kim Tok Hun, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, and members and alternate members of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK. The delegates were greatly excited and delighted as they had the honor of having a photo taken in presence of the respected General Secretary against the venue of glory where the 8th Congress took place. They recollected with high pride the days of the congress when they elected Kim Jong Un, the symbol of all victories and glory of the Korean people and the outstanding leader of the Juche revolution, as general secretary of the WPK, and received a practical programme for making a radical advance in the development of the Party and the socialist construction. When the General Secretary appeared at the venue of the photo session amid the welcome music, all the delegates broke into stormy cheers of "Hurrah!", extending the highest glory to the General Secretary who glorified the 8th Congress of the WPK as a congress of struggle and progress for improving the leadership and fighting efficiency of our great Party in every way and hastening a new victory of revolution with confidence. He warmly waved back to the delegates filled with fervent enthusiasm and will to remain boundlessly faithful to the Party and the revolution, the country and the people. He posed for a picture with the delegates, expressing belief that they would break through all challenges and obstacles in the advance with the revolutionary spirit of Paektu, the spirit of self-reliance and fully discharge their revolutionary duty in the struggle for implementing the decision made at the 8th Congress of the WPK as the core of the Party and the pioneers of the era, under the uplifted red flag of the Juche-type Party. All the delegates vowed to make a breakthrough in the struggle for the overall development of Korean-style socialism under the blueprint unfolded by the 8th Party Congress, closely rallied around the respected General Secretary. Political News Team

title: Military Parade Commemorates 8th Congress of WPK
body: There took place a splendid military parade at Kim Il Sung Square here in the evening on January 14 to commemorate the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). The band of the State Affairs Commission (SAC) and the central military band of the Ministry of Defence took the peculiarly-decorated bandstand to play parade music. Parade columns entered the square with the pride and honor. Columns of mechanized units which would demonstrate the inexhaustible might of the armed forces of the Republic were on standby on the avenues leading to the square. Air squadrons for the parade were waiting for order of sorties. Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the WPK, chairman of the SAC of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, appeared at the tribune of the square. Cheers of "Hurrah!" for Kim Jong Un and chanting shouts of "Kim Jong Un" and "Devoted Defence" rocked the heaven and earth and fireworks brightly decorated the nocturnal sky. He warmly waved back to the enthusiastically cheering paraders and masses. Children presented fragrant flowers to him and leading officials of the Party, the government and the military. Taking the tribune were Choe Ryong Hae, Jo Yong Won, Ri Pyong Chol, and Kim Tok Hun. Members of the 8th Party central leadership body and commanding officials of the military appeared at the tribune. Invited to the tribune were Kim Yong Nam, Choe Yong Rim, Yang Hyong Sop, Kim Ki Nam, Choe Thae Bok, Kim Kyong Ok, Ri Yong Mu and Pak Pong Ju who had worked for a long time in the Party, the government and the military. Present at the reserved seats for guests were the participants in the 8th Congress of the WPK and special guests. Amid the playing of the song "The Glorious Country", a salute of 21 guns boomed. Kim Jong Gwan, minister of Defence of the DPRK, made an address. Then, there was a ceremony of hoisting the national flag. All the participants paid high respect to the national flag. KPA Marshal Pak Jong Chon, chief of the General Staff of the Korean People's Army (KPA), made a report to KPA Marshal Ri Pyong Chol, vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission of the WPK, that parade units lined up to be reviewed for the parade commemorating the 8th Congress of the WPK. Ri Pyong Chol reviewed the parade units. He courteously reported to the general secretary of the WPK that the military parade for commemorating the 8th Congress of the WPK was ready to start. The parade began led by the command car with Marshal Pak Jong Chon on, amid the play of dynamic march music. The column of the honor cavalrymen ran past the square with the firm will of the service personnel of the People's Army to make a dynamic advance of loyalty and march of faith for implementing the decision made at the Party's congress in the spirit shown by the great brilliant commander when looking round the Mt Paektu area on horseback. Entering the square following it were the fine arrays of columns of loyal lifeguards, showing that the mission of paramount importance for our revolutionary armed forces is to devotedly defend the Party Central Committee. The columns of the first and the second corps marched past with dignity, demonstrating their pride as the eldest corps and the unit where the a-match-for-a-hundred spirit was born. They were followed by the columns of the fourth corps standing guard over the gate to the southwestern part of the country and the fifth corps, backbone corps of the People's Army, flying colors with proud military merits. Making powerful strides toward the square were columns of the navy and the air and anti-air force. The masses warmly applauded the column of the strategic force. The columns of ground, sea and air snipers and lightly-armed infantrymen demonstrated the spirit of invincibility of the revolutionary armed forces of a-match-for-a-hundred that have nurtured their wisdom and courage of annihilating the enemies under the care of the great brilliant commander. The columns of corps of anti-aircraft artillerymen, 91st corps and 3rd corps standing guard over the capital city of Pyongyang and the columns of the corps defending the coasts and border gateway of the country as firm as an iron wall marched past in fine arrays. The columns of tank units and columns of mechanized infantry divisions rolled past the square, displaying the might of the revolutionary armed forces that have grown to be invincible elite forces. They were followed by columns of mountain warfare infantrymen and reconnoiters and such professional arms as electronic harassment unit and then the column of armed mobile unit for public security which marched past demonstrating heroic spirit. The Supreme Leader warmly acknowledged the marchers. Then there was flight, paying respect to the great Party Central Committee. Following the formation of guard planes, the red hawks of the Party, in the pattern of the Party emblem, flew past the sky above the square letting off the fireworks to brighten the sky. The column of planes depicted number "8" with fireworks in the nocturnal sky, reflecting the happiness and emotion of glorifying the 8th Congress of the Party as another political event of special record in the militant path of our Party. The columns of mechanized units began their procession led by the column of armored vehicles. The column of prototype tanks roared past the square, which was followed by those of ultra-modern tactical rockets. This was followed by the procession of the ultra-modern self-propelled artillery pieces, grandly showing off the might of our artillery force. The columns of rockets possessed of powerful striking capability for thoroughly annihilating enemies in a preemptive way outside the territory, roared past. Other proud-worthy Juche-type weapons rolled past the square one after another, demonstrating to the world how our defence industry built up tremendous might since it started its first step with the production of sub-machine gun after the liberation of the country, while covering the untrodden path of army-building. The world's most powerful weapon, submarine-launch ballistic missile, entered the square one after another, powerfully demonstrating the might of the revolutionary armed forces. The people raised cheers as it demonstrated the tremendous might of our Party which accomplished the great cause of building a wealthy country with a powerful army, the 5000 years-old desire of the nation, in such a short period of five years of fierce struggle between the 7th Congress of the Party and the 8th Congress of the Party. At the end of the military parade, fireworks were shot off again. The Supreme Leader warmly waved back to the enthusiastically cheering crowds. The square was full of high revolutionary enthusiasm of all the participants determined to always follow the path of our-style socialism, full of confidence and optimism about the bright future with great national pride and honor of making the revolution under the leadership of Kim Jong Un. Political News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Congratulatory Letter from Chongryon Central Standing Committee
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a congratulatory letter from the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) on January 11. The letter said that all the officials of Chongryon and Koreans in Japan can not repress their deep emotion of great joy and happiness after receiving the delightful news that Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un was elected as the head and general secretary of the WPK at the 8th Congress of the WPK. It stressed that it is the eruption of the absolute support, trust and unanimous loyalty of all the Korean people and a great noteworthy revolutionary event which provided a sure guarantee for the victory of our own-style socialism and promised its rosy future that Kim Jong Un has invariably been held in high esteem as the head and general secretary of the WPK. It noted that the Central Standing Committee of Chongryon offers the highest glory and warmest congratulations to the Supreme Leader upon his election as general secretary of the WPK. It praised the Supreme Leader as the prominent leader who has developed the WPK into a powerful political general staff and elite iron-willed ranks of vanguard fighters both in name and reality by readjusting the leadership and fighting efficiency of the Party and consolidating the organizational and ideological foundation of the Party in every way as required by the idea of building Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Party and the developing reality. It expressed the will to more thoroughly establish the Supreme Leader's unified leadership system throughout the association by applying the main spirit of the 8th Congress of the WPK to the work of Chongryon, a flank of the Korean revolution, strengthen the single-minded unity, boldly overcome any difficulties by dint of ideological power and the single-minded unity and thus usher in a fresh heyday of the movement of Koreans in Japan. The Chongryon Central Standing Committee sincerely wished the Supreme Leader good health in reflection of the ardent loyalty and boundless reverence of all the officials of Chongryon and Koreans in Japan for him. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Congratulatory Letter from C. C., AINDF
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a congratulatory letter from the Central Committee of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front (AINDF) on Jan. 11. The letter said that amid the international attention to the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), the fellow countrymen in the south are filled with emotion and ecstasy upon receiving the news about his election as the general secretary of the WPK. The letter said it is a manifestation of absolute support and trust of all the WPK members and other people of the north in the peerlessly great man that Kim Jong Un was invariably held in high esteem as the head of the great WPK, and at the same time, a great special event to firmly guarantee the final accomplishment of the cause of the Juche revolution pioneered on Mt Paektu and the rosy future of all generations to come. The letter extended the highest glory and warmest congratulation to Kim Jong Un, the top representative of the WPK, with ardent reverence for him cherished by vanguard fighters and patriotic people of all walks of life in the south on the occasion of the national-historic auspicious event. It said that it is the inevitability of history and great fortune of the Korean nation to hold Kim Jong Un in high esteem as the general secretary of the WPK who performed great exploits unprecedented in history with his outstanding idea, superb leadership and noble virtues. The letter noted that with the pride and self-esteem of holding Kim Jong Un, who is demonstrating the national dignity and mightiness by leading the WPK, at the top leading post, the AINDF would consolidate itself into the ranks of Juche-type loyalists believing and following only the Supreme Leader. The letter stressed that as Kim Jong Un, the brilliant sun of Juche and prominent hero of the nation, illumines the way for the times, the day of national reunification, a desire of the whole countrymen, will surely come. Rodong Sinmun

title: Congratulatory Letter to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from General Association of Koreans in China
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received a congratulatory letter from the General Association of Koreans in China on Jan. 11. The letter said that the officials of the general association and other Koreans in China extended the highest glory and warmest congratulations to the Supreme Leader, the tender-hearted father of the nation, with the deepest reverence for him, upon hearing the exciting news that he was elected as general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). It noted that it is the greatest fortune of the WPK and the Korean nation to hold the Supreme Leader respected and revered by all peoples as the most prominent political leader in the present era in high esteem as the head of the WPK again, adding that it is a great political event promising the rosy future of the socialist homeland. It praised the Supreme Leader for having achieved a great exploit to be etched in the history of the nation by developing the WPK into the most dignified, capable and powerful general political staff of the revolution and the genuine mother party absolutely supported and trusted by the people, and thus putting the overall power and status of the Republic on the highest level. Recalling that the Supreme Leader offered warm greetings to the overseas compatriots on the first day of the 8th Congress of the WPK and made sure that protection and guarantee of the democratic national rights and interests of the overseas compatriots are specified in the newly revised rules of the WPK, it lauded the Supreme Leader as the tender-hearted father with boundless love for the overseas compatriots and warm patriotism that no other state leader can ever show. It expressed the will to further develop the general association into the reliable organization of overseas compatriots of Juche Korea by dynamically waging the patriotic activities for contributing to the building of a powerful nation, the cause of national reunification and the development of the DPRK-China friendly relations with socialism as its core, holding fast to the outstanding line and policies for struggle newly set forth at the 8th Congress of the WPK as guidelines. It sincerely wished the Supreme Leader good health for the eternal prosperity of the powerful country of Juche, accomplishment of the cause of national reunification and development of the patriotic movement of Koreans in China. Rodong Sinmun

title: KPA Will Ensure Party's New Historic Advance with Strongest Military Power: DPRK Minister of Defence
body: Kim Jong Gwan, minister of Defence of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, made a speech at the military parade for commemorating the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) on Thursday. The speaker said that the military parade would serve as a historic occasion in demonstrating at home and abroad once again the militant spirit and tremendous power of our heroic armed forces that defend and uphold in the van the revolutionary cause of the WPK led by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un and vigorously encouraging the whole Party, all the people and the entire army to the struggle in the new era ushered in by the 8th Congress of the Party. The majestic elite units and invincible iron-clad ranks of the Republic which will proudly pass Kim Il Sung Square represent our absolute power, he said, and went on: The path we are following is the most sacred and worthwhile one that leads our socialist Korea to the future when it will be more powerful and prosperous and our strongest power lies in the harmonious whole and the single-minded unity in which the whole Party, all the people and the entire army are firmly united as one around the Supreme Leader. The armed forces of the Republic will always remain faithful to the order and instructions of the Supreme Leader only and successfully fulfill their duty and mission at the forefront of the revolution entrusted by the Party. The armed forces of the Republic will strictly contain any military threats in the region of the Korean peninsula and preemptively use the strongest offensive power to thoroughly smash the hostile forces if they jeopardize the security of our state even a bit, and firmly defend the security of the country and the people and our socialist system. Our army will ensure the new historic advance of the Workers' Party of Korea with the strongest military power. We will surely win a victory as we are led by respected Comrade Kim Jong Un.

title: Fireworks Displayed in Celebration of 8th Congress of WPK
body: A fireworks display followed the military parade celebrating the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea on Thursday evening. Fantastic fireworks were set off around the Tower of the Juche Idea and songs "Glory to General Kim Jong Un" and "Cheers of the People" resounded forth. Citizens who gathered at Kim Il Sung Square and on the banks of the River Taedong raised shouts of joy, feasting their eyes on the fireworks. Those presented a sea of dance at the square. Fireworks were shot off one after another to the tune of such songs as "Glory to Our Great Party" and "Our Leader Loved by People", representing the profound reverence for the Party Central Committee putting the dignity and might of the country and the people on the highest level by dint of the great idea and unity in the face of the stern trials of history. Colorful fireworks in different shapes were displayed in the nocturnal sky, exciting the dancing citizens in the square. Watching the gorgeous fireworks, the participants in the congress and citizens renewed their will to remain true to the leadership of the great Party Central Committee and bring earlier the prospering morrow by advancing along the road of victory indicated by the congress. Rodong Sinmun

title: Congratulatory Message to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Syrian President
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), received a congratulatory message from Bashar Al-Assad, president of the Syrian Arab Republic, on January 12. The Syrian president noted in the message that he was pleased to offer the heartfelt warmest congratulations on his own behalf and on behalf of the Syrian Arab people to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un upon the convention of the 8th Congress of the WPK and his election as general secretary of the WPK. The message recalled that the WPK has achieved victories and successes in the protracted historic course and played the guiding role in the advance and development of the DPRK, adding it serves as a solid foundation for achieving a greater victory in the future struggle. It stressed that the Supreme Leader's election as general secretary of the WPK is a manifestation of the absolute support by all the Korean people who are faithful to the great idea and principle of the Party. Expressing warm felicitations again to the Supreme Leader, it hoped that he and the WPK would always register successes in the work for the well-being of the friendly people of the DPRK. Rodong Sinmun

title: Congratulatory Messages and Letters to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un
body: from Different Countries Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received congratulatory messages and letters from different countries on the occasion of the Eighth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). They include the secretary general of the Lebanon Federation of Workers, the senior leader of the Indian People's Party, the chairman of the Supreme Council of the National Socialist Party (Romania), the general secretary of the Guinean Rainbow People's Assembly, the national chairman of the People's Progressive Party of Nigeria and the national leader of the Communist Party of Canada (Marxist-Leninist). Also among them are the deputy general secretary of the National Democratic Congress of Ghana, the secretary general of the International Kim Il Sung Prize Council and the International Kim Jong Il Prize Council, the vice-director general of the International Institute of the Juche Idea, the director of the Asian Regional Institute of the Juche Idea and other personages of political, public and economic circles in China, Russia, Iran, Japan, Germany, Romania, Belarus, France, Austria, Spain, Nigeria, Tanzania and DR Congo, and representatives of organizations for the study of the Juche idea, organizations for supporting Korea's reunification and friendship organizations. Meanwhile, the Central Committee of the WPK received congratulatory messages from the general secretary of the Mongolian People's Party, the general secretary of the National Council of the Communist Party of India, the international secretary of the Serbian Communist Party, the secretary for International Relations of the Central Committee of the Spanish Communist Party, the chairman of the African Party for the Solidarity and Justice of Mali, the chairperson of the Coalition for Mali, the vice-chairman of the Popular Liberation Movement of Angola, the general secretary and the secretary for International Relations of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Venezuela and the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Venezuela. The secretary of the Central Council of the Communist Parties-the Communist Party of the Soviet Union, the international secretary of the Awami League of Bangladesh, the acting chairman of the Communist Party of Germany, the international secretary of the Central Committee of the Bulgarian Communists' Party, the general secretary of the Revolutionary Communist Party of France, the national chairman of the New Communist Party of Britain, the chairman of the Communist Party of Great Britain (Marxist-Leninist) and the Central Committee of the Mozambique Liberation Front Party sent congratulatory messages to the Eighth Congress of the WPK. And the first secretary of the Central Committee of the Bulgarian Communist Party sent congratulatory messages to the Central Committee of the WPK and the Eighth Congress of the WPK. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Floral Baskets from Foreign Organizations
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Friday received floral baskets sent by the Korean War Veterans' Council of Russia and the Sweden-DPRK Cultural Exchange Association in congratulation of his election as general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea. Rodong Sinmun

title: In Order for Units Associated with Leadership Exploits of Peerlessly Great Persons to Advance in the Van
body: Light industry factories in Samjiyon City try their hardest to carry out the highly important tasks set forth at the 8th Congress of the Workers’ Party of Korea. Visited by Chairman Kim Jong Il for firsthand guidance the Samjiyon Soybean Paste and Sauce Factory overfulfilled its plan for January ahead of schedule, but goes on with its production uninterruptedly without so much as resting on its laurels. The officials, workers and technicians of the Samjiyon Potato Farina Production Factory also produce more than twice as much potato powder as they did when it was commissioned. The Samjiyon Blueberry Drinks Factory boosts the production of its drinks and processed foodstuffs of various kinds with blueberries. Rodong Sinmun

title: So as to Implement the Party’s Policies at Any Cost
body: The workers and management of the Unryul Mine top its iron ore production plan by 1.3 times every day. They step up their work in the Chongnyon and Jungsan Mining Lots and others uttering their reluctance to quit work before carrying out their daily production assignments in excess of their quotas. Deeply conscious of the importance of their duty the operators and drivers of the UM work hard to put their equipment and rolling-stock in full operation. Rodong Sinmun

title: Efforts Focused on Adjustment and Reinforcement of Irrigation System
body: The officials and agricultural workers of Pyoktong County do their utmost to make it easier and more satisfactory than ever to irrigate their farmland. During their last year’s 80-day campaign they achieved considerable successes in cleaning out their water canals, repairing and maintaining their power equipment for pumping machines and renovating their irrigation structures. The township’s cooperative farm leads its counterparts in improving its conditions for water supply. The Songsa and Kwonchang Cooperative Farms and other cooperative farms in the county effectively ameliorate the conditions of their relevant streams and water channels. The officials, technicians and workers of the county’s irrigation management station repair and maintain their power equipment for pumping machines as soon as possible awakened to the importance of their duty in satisfactorily providing water to farmland. The officials and workers of organs, enterprises and factories in the county produce manure and improve its streams to actively help its socialist cooperative farms with their work and join them in defending the agricultural front of the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Brisk Preparations for Farming to Increase Grain Production on Low-yield Fields
body: Agricultural officials and workers throughout the country exert themselves to increase the output of cereals in their fields which give a low yield of them, thereby carrying out the highly important tasks put forward at the 8th Congress of the Workers’ Party of Korea. Earnest efforts are made to ameliorate acid fields. South Phyongan Province tries its hardest to procure large quantities of slaked lime and dolomite on its own and use them for bettering its acid fields. South Hwanghae Province carries slaked lime and quality organic manure to the fields of its cooperative farms by vehicle at the same time. North Phyongan Province substantially arranges for the production of slaked lime to be boosted and supplied to its cities and counties. This meets with one success after another. Cooperative farms across the country are all out to carpet their fields with humus soil. Many counties of North and South Hwanghae, North Phyongan and Kangwon Provinces carpet their fields with humus soil laying the main accent on improving them and simultaneously supplementing them with nutrients of various kinds. Cooperative farms nationwide prevent some of their fields from damages from cold and wet weather with a view to their improvement. Rodong Sinmun

title: Determined to Reliably Defend Outpost for Development of Self-supporting Economy
body: In response to the highly important tasks set forth at the historic 8th Congress of the Workers’ Party of Korea the workers and management of coal mines countrywide do their best with unusually great enthusiasm and confidence to increase their coal production. Those of the Munchon Coal Mine have stirred themselves as one to implement the decisions of the congress. Pooling their strength and wisdom they stubbornly overcome the difficulties which crop up from time to time. The technicians of the MCM work to the best of their ability to hit their new technological targets this year, too, the way they contrived and applied valuable technological innovations last year to actively step up its coal production. The labor and management of the Hukryong and Ryongsan Coal Mines also go all out for their production with extraordinary consciousness. Rodong Sinmun

title: Further Rousing Masses’ Enthusiasm for Study
body: The Workers’ Party of Korea’s organizations of North Phyongan Province ensure that its officials and workers study the ideas and spirit of the 8th Congress of the WPK hard, thus bringing them home to them. The provincial party committee makes detailed organizational arrangements for fortifying all the inhabitants with the ideas of the WPK. First of all, it motivates them to study hard and fully master the report made at its 8th Congress. The provincial people’s committee, the provincial rural economy committee and the WPK’s organizations at all levels like the Sinuiju City, Cholsan County and Pyoktong County Committees of the WPK ensure that all their officials fully convince the WPK members and working people of the ideas and essence of the 8th WPK Congress and rouse all of them to the struggle for a new victory. The officials of the Ragwon Machine-building General Enterprise, the Kujang Area Coal Mining Complex, the Kusong Machine Tool Factory, the Suphung and Thaechon Power Stations, the Pakchon Silk Mill and other factories and enterprises in the province arrange their WPK members and workers in detail to study the documents of the WPK’s Congress deeply and adopt them as their firm creed. Rodong Sinmun

title: Congratulations to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Chairman of Central Committee of CPRF
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), received a congratulatory message from G. A. Zhuganov, chairman of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation (CPRF), on January 12. The message extended sincere congratulations to Kim Jong Un upon his election as general secretary of the WPK on behalf of the Central Committee of the CPRF and on his own behalf. The message said that the CPRF knows very well about his efforts for strengthening the influence of the WPK, the vanguard unit of the working people of the DPRK, expressing satisfaction over the increasing role of the WPK in the DPRK and in the international communist movement. Highly appreciating the friendly and cooperative relations between the CPRF and the WPK, the message expressed belief that they would grow stronger favorably in the future, too. The message wished Kim Jong Un and the WPK success in the Party building for the happiness and prosperity of the country and people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Congratulations to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Raul Castro Ruz
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), received a congratulatory message from Raul Castro Ruz, first secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba, on Jan. 11. In the message Raul Castro Ruz, on behalf of the Communist Party of Cuba and the Cuban people and on his own behalf, extended his most sincere congratulations to Kim Jong Un upon his election as general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea. Expressing the belief that the Korean people would advance the socialist cause under the leadership of Kim Jong Un true to the instructions of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, the message hoped that achievements would be made in the implementation of the decision of the 8th WPK Congress. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Has Photo Session with Guard, Security and Defence Personnel
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, called the guard, security and defence personnel who contributed to the successful Eighth Congress of the WPK to the office building of the Central Committee of the WPK, the supreme general staff of the Korean revolution, and had a photo session with them on Saturday. All the participants were full of boundless reverence for Kim Jong Un who entrusted them with a heavy responsibility of safeguarding the historic 8th Congress of the WPK, appreciated their efforts as brilliant military service to be glorified in the history of our Party and bestowed benevolence to them, which will be conveyed generation after generation. When Kim Jong Un appeared at the venue of the photo session, all the participants burst into stormy cheers of "hurrah!" in token of their deepest respect for the General Secretary, the top representative of our dignity and the whole of our destiny and future. He extended a warm militant salute to them, highly appreciating them for ensuring the successful 8th Congress of the Party with transparent revolutionary faith and pure loyalty. He had a significant photo taken with them, expressing belief that they would live up to the Party's trust and expectations by establishing steel-like discipline and increasing the combat efficiency in every way to fulfill their important mission of defending the revolution. They had their hearts burning with a firm pledge to devotedly defend the Party Central Committee headed by the General Secretary, who is symbol of the mightiness of the country and banner of all victories and glory, cherishing the great loving care and trust shown by him throughout their lives. Political News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Has Photo Session with Participants in Military Parade
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, had a photo session with the participants in the military parade for commemorating the 8th Congress of the WPK on Jan. 16. Present there were Ri Pyong Chol, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK and vice-chairman of the WPK Central Military Commission, and leading officials of armed forces organs Pak Jong Chon, Kwon Yong Jin, Kim Jong Gwan and Ri Yong Gil. The participants were filled with great excitement as they were honored to have a photo taken with the Supreme Leader at Kim Il Sung Square where the military parade for celebrating the 8th Party Congress was splendidly held in the presence of the Supreme Leader. When the Supreme Leader arrived at the venue of the photo session, all the participants broke into thunderous cheers of "Hurrah!", extending the highest glory to him who helped them bear deeper in their minds the historic mission of the revolutionary army of the Party by making sure that a historic advance toward a new victory of our-style socialism is begun after significant celebration of the Party congress with a grand parade of the revolutionary armed forces. The Supreme Leader warmly waved back to the members of the military parade who demonstrated through the military parade to the whole world the might of the army of the WPK remaining boundlessly loyal to the Party and people and the most powerful elite army surpassing the world level in its military technology, and expressed full support for the strategic line of our Party with their strong will to take the lead in making a breakthrough for implementation of the decision made at the 8th Party Congress. Expressing belief that our revolutionary armed forces would fulfill their mission and duty as the driving force of national defence and the genuine people's army firmly safeguarding the country and people, he posed for a picture with the participants in the military parade. At the end of the photo session, all the participants again broke into stormy cheers of "hurrah!" and continuous shouts of "Kim Jong Un" and "devoted defence". They took an oath of loyalty to devotedly defend the Party Central Committee headed by the Supreme Leader with invincible arms and fully demonstrate the mightiness of the powerful revolutionary army in the forefront of the all-people offensive for implementing the struggle programme set forth at the 8th Party congress. Political News Team

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Has Photo Session with Observers to Eighth WPK Congress
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, had a photo taken with the observers to the 8th WPK Congress with its venue for a background on Saturday. Present at the photo session were Jo Yong Won and Ri Pyong Chol, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK and secretaries of the Party Central Committee, and Pak Thae Song, Jong Sang Hak, Ri Il Hwan, Kim Tu Il and Choe Sang Gon, members of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK and secretaries of the Party Central Committee. The observers to the congress were full of excitement and joy as they were honored to have a photo taken with the General Secretary they had always longed for. They felt their hearts leaping in profound reverence for the General Secretary who personally called them to the venue of the historic Party congress etched in the history of our Party and the country and wished them successes in their future struggle with his warm love and trust. When he appeared at the venue of the photo session amid the playing of the welcome music, all the participants broke into stormy cheers of "hurrah!" in token of their deepest respect for the General Secretary who indicated the correct orientation of advance for our Party and revolution with his outstanding ideological and theoretical wisdom and superb leadership and opened up a wide avenue toward prosperity and development of our dignified state and happiness of the people. He warmly waved back to the participants who were filled with fervent enthusiasm to make signal successes in their future practical struggle by dint of their revolutionary faith and indomitable spirit renewed with the congress as an occasion. He posed for a picture with them, expressing his expectation that the observers to the congress, together with delegates, would kindle the flames of revolution and become standard-bearers and pioneers of progress in every campaign site for implementing the decision made at the 8th Party Congress. All the participants vowed to make a positive contribution to ushering in an era of fresh development and an era of our state-first principle by making indefatigable and devoted efforts, deeply cherishing the main idea and the main spirit of the 8th Party Congress. Political News Team

title: Grand Art Performance "We Sing of Party" for Celebrating 8th Congress of WPK Continues
body: The grand art performance "We Sing of the Party" that opened at the Pyongyang Indoor Stadium in celebration of the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) continues. Special guests invited to the celebrations of the 8th Party Congress, the observers in the congress and participants in the military parade enjoyed the performance on Jan. 15. The reserved seats were taken by veteran cadres including Kim Yong Nam, Choe Yong Rim, Yang Hyong Sop, Kim Ki Nam, Choe Thae Bok, Kim Kyong Ok and Ri Yong Mu who had worked in the Party, the government and the military for a long time. The performance touched the heartstrings of the audience as it instilled greater enthusiasm for struggle into the people who reelected Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un as the head of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and turned out in the new onward march for the prosperity of socialism of our own style. The audience deeply cherished the iron truth that all victory, glory and bright future of socialism are in store for them when they remain faithful to the general secretary of the WPK, being determined to dedicate all their wisdom and zeal to the struggle for devotedly implementing the decision made at the Party Congress. Rodong Sinmun

title: Pyongyang City Army-People Rally Held
body: There was Pyongyang city army-people rally at Kim Il Sung Square on Jan. 15 to extend the greatest glory to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un on his election as general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and to vow to thoroughly carry out the decision made at the 8th Congress of the WPK. Choe Ryong Hae, Ri Pyong Chol and Kim Tok Hun took the platform. Also taking the platform were leading officials of the Party and the government and leading officials of commissions, ministries, national institutions and Party and administrative organs in Pyongyang, workers of meritorious services and officials of armed forces organs. Present at the rally were officials of commissions, ministries and national institutions, officials and workers of institutions and industrial establishments and cooperative farms in Pyongyang and officers and men of the Korean People's Army and the Public Security Forces. Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, first vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly, made a speech. He said that it was an eruption of the absolute trust and deep loyalty of all the Party members and all other Korean people and a great auspicious revolutionary event that provided a sure guarantee for the victory of our style socialism and promised its bright future that Kim Jong Un was elected as the head of the WPK again at its historic 8th Congress. He extended the greatest glory and the warmest congratulations to Kim Jong Un, the great leader of our Party and people, in reflection of the ardent loyalty of all the Party members, people and officers and men of the KPA. He stressed that the officials, Party members, working people and officers and men of the KPA should thoroughly arm themselves with the main idea and main spirit of the 8th Congress of the WPK and bring about substantial success and progress in the socialist construction with redoubled revolutionary enthusiasm. He strongly appealed to all to turn out in implementing the decision made at the 8th Congress of the WPK, rallied close around the Party Central Committee in single mind and intention, in order to win greater victory in the socialist cause and to bring earlier the new era when the people's ideal and desire will be brought into full bloom. Taking the floor were Vice-Premier Yang Sung Ho, alternate member of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, Kim Yong Hwan, alternate member of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and chief secretary of the Pyongyang City Committee of the WPK, and KPA General Kim Kwang Hyok. The speakers spoke about the immense pride and happiness of our people of invariably holding peerlessly great man Kim Jong Un in high esteem at the top post representing and leading the WPK again. The most important revolutionary task in implementing the decision made at the Party Congress is to shore up the country's economy as early as possible and bring about substantial improvement in people's living, they said, expressing their pledge to meticulously organize economic operation and command and achieve renovation, development and substantial change that can be felt by the people, in line with the intention of the Party which set forth self-reliance and self-sufficiency as the main seed and theme of the new five-year plan for national economic development. They called on Party members in the capital to become core and vanguard fighters and create the new Pyongyang spirit, Pyongyang speed in the struggle for opening up the new period of great surge and gigantic change of our revolution and to channel the force of the Party work into stabilizing and improving the people's standard of living. They said that the People's Army will fulfill its sacred mission and duty before the Party and the revolution as the revolutionary armed forces of the WPK and main force for defending the country and driving force of the revolution and thus uphold the leadership of the Party Central Committee with loyalty. They said that all the Party members in the capital city, other people and service personnel of the KPA would uphold Kim Jong Un with loyalty and make devoted efforts to implement the decision made at the Party Congress in the noble idea of believing in people as in heaven and by dint of single-minded unity and self-reliance and surely bring about new period of prosperity of Pyongyang heralding the prosperity of the socialist country. Then there was mass demonstration. Rodong Sinmun

title: Report Made on Fulfillment of State Budget for Last Year and on State Budget for This Year
body: There was a report by Deputy Ko Jong Bom, minister of Finance, on the results of the fulfillment of the state budget of the DPRK for Juche 109(2020) and on state budget for Juche 110(2021) at the 4th session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly held on Sunday. According to the report, the state budget for Juche 109(2020) was successfully implemented. Last year the state budgetary revenue was over-fulfilled 0.1 percent, a 4.3 percent growth from the previous year. Local budgetary revenue was over-fulfilled 0.1 percent. The state budgetary expenditure was implemented at 99.9 percent last year. 45.3 percent of the total expenditure was allocated for the development of the national economy. The fund needed for stabilizing key fields of the national economy and the standard of people's living was expended at 105.7 percent as against the previous year and this contributed to further strengthening the independence and Juche character of metal and chemical industries, shoring up the fields of electricity, coal, machine, building materials industries and railway transport and developing agricultural and light industrial fields. 9.5 percent more investment was spent in the field of science and technology than the previous year. 19.1 percent of the total expenditure went to the construction field while 36.5 percent of the total expenditure to embodying the popular policies of the Party and the state including public health and education and bringing about the overall development of socialist culture. 15.9 percent of total expenditure was directed to the national defence building. The report clarified mistakes observed in the implementation of the state budget last year and specified state budget for this year. The state budgetary revenue is expected to grow 0.9 percent more than that of the previous year out of which the transaction tax and the revenue from the profits of state enterprises, which are main sources of the budgetary revenue, will hold 100.8 percent and 101.1 percent each to account for 83.4 percent of the total revenue. The revenue from the profits of cooperative enterprises is expected to grow 0.4 percent, depreciation 0.1 percent, revenue from real estate rent 0.0 percent, that from social insurance 0.3 percent, that from sales of assets and price differences 0.1 percent, that from other sources 0.6 percent and that from the special economic zones 0.2 percent. The central budgetary revenue is to hold 74.2 percent in the state budgetary revenue and as a result the revenue from central economy is to account overwhelming proportion, and provinces, towns and counties are to cover the expenditure with their own revenue and contribute lots of funds to the national budget. The state budgetary expenditure is to increase 1.1 percent as against the previous year. 0.6 percent more investment has been planned to be made for economic construction as against the previous year. There will be focused investment in the metal industry and chemical industry and 0.9 percent more funds are to be spent for propping up the production in key industrial fields, agriculture and light industrial fields of the national economy as compared with the previous year. It is expected that 1.6 percent more investment will be spent in the field of science and technology and the funds necessary for pressing for key projects such as third-stage project of sprucing up Samjiyon City, the construction of oxygen heat blast furnaces in the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex and the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex, foundation of C-1 chemical industry, construction of the Tanchon Power Station, construction of dwelling houses for 50 000 families in Pyongyang and the construction of 25 000 dwelling houses in Komdok area are to be financed as planned. 15.9 percent of total expenditure is earmarked for the sustained development of the state defence capabilities. 33.9 percent of total expenditure is to be spent for enforcing the popular policies of the Party and the state so as to increase the one for educational field at 103.5 percent and that for public health at 102.5 percent. The fund for social and cultural work has also increased as against the previous year i.e. 102.7 percent for the field of literature and art and 101.6 percent for sports field. This year, too, lots of educational aid fund and stipends are to be sent to children of Koreans in Japan so as to keep developing the democratic national education of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan. The report said that the correct implementation of the state budget for this year is a responsible and important task facing the officials in providing the financial guarantee for the revolutionary advance of our people for opening up the breakthrough in carrying out the new five-year plan and for effecting a drastic turn in socialist construction. The report stressed the need to successfully carry out the state budget for this year, true to the important tasks set forth in the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea so as to provide financial support for the all-people struggle for surely opening up the broad avenue to prosperity in the spirit of self-reliance. Rodong Sinmun

title: Kim Tok Hun Calls for Implementing Five-year Plan for National Economic Development Set forth at Eighth Congress of WPK
body: Deputy Kim Tok Hun, premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), made a report at the 4th Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK held on Sunday in which he called for thoroughly carrying out the five-year plan for national economic development set forth at the Eighth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). According to the report, all the people and service personnel of the People's Army who turned out in carrying out the five-year strategy for national economic development true to the decision of the Seventh Congress of the WPK had waged devoted struggle to provide precious assets for continuing the economic development by their own efforts in the past five years, he said, and went on: The building of power stations was positively propelled for creating new generating capacity, the Juche-based system of producing iron established and other new construction and remodeling projects in different sectors were dynamically pushed forward. So the independence and Juche character of the national economy were further augmented. Samjiyon City was radically transformed into a model mountain cultural town, monumental edifices were successfully built everywhere as epitomes of modern civilization including Ryomyong Street, the Yangdok Hot Spring Resort and the Central Zoo and a drive for recovering from consecutive natural disasters and providing the people in the afflicted areas with cradle of happiness was dynamically conducted. This helped the people feel grateful for the socialist system of our country in reality. We defended the security of the state and the life and safety of the people from the epidemic sweeping across the world, maintained stable anti-epidemic state, and the regular working system and foundation were established in the hygienic and anti-epidemic sector. During the 80-day campaign of loyalty a surge in production was made in the leading sectors, and several major construction projects were successfully concluded. So the work of strongly consolidating the foundation of the self-supporting economy was positively propelled. These precious successes are a valuable fruition brought about by the guidance of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un who made patriotic devotion making ceaseless high-intensity forced march for the country and great people. The report referred to the serious mistakes observed in the work of the Cabinet during the period of carrying out the five-year strategy for national economic development, and also causes of those mistakes. The report said that we face heavy tasks to unconditionally carry out the five-year plan for national economic development set forth at the Eighth Congress of the Party. He stressed that the Cabinet will definitely put our economy on a normal track that makes sustained development, unaffected by any outside influence while maintaining a firm hold on the adjustment strategy and reinforcement strategy together with self-reliance and self-sufficiency which were set forth by the Party during the new five-year plan as economic strategy and as main seed and theme. He stressed that they would put priority efforts into the development of key industries including metal industry and chemical industry, which constitute twin pillars of the national economy, and open up a breakthrough to carrying out the five-year plan in order to keep the overall economy afloat. He continued: We will drastically increase the production of electricity, key power of independent economy, and reliably guarantee the stable development of the national economy and the material and cultural life of the people. In the field of electric power industry, we will conduct the drive for increased production for meeting the immediate demand for power and adjust and reinforce its overall production foundation and expand it on a long-term basis. We will increase investment in the coal industrial field, the outpost for developing self-supporting economy, and thus satisfactorily meet the demand for coal in the key industrial fields of the national economy. We will wage in a bold way and powerfully promote the work for nationwide provision of equipment, materials, labor and funds to the field of coal industry and thus further consolidate the material and technical foundation and drastically increase the proportion of the mechanization in the mining pits. We will turn the machine industry into the one with reliable foundation and into development-and-creation type industry and actively develop and produce modern and efficient machine products and thus make sure that the machine industry takes the lead and steer the overall economic fields. In the field of extractive industry, the force for geological prospecting will be strengthened and the work for the unified and effective development and exploitation of the underground natural resources of the country will be propelled in a realistic way and thus reinforce and expand the production foundation of mines, refineries and factories and basically meet the demand for nonferrous metals and nonmetal minerals for national economy. In the field of railway transport and land and marine transport, the modernization of railways will be actively pushed forward and the transport will be improved in a revolutionary way to satisfactorily meet the demand for railway transport. We will ensure that more large-tonnage cargo ships meeting the world trend for ship-building technical development and new shape underground trains, trolley-buses, tramcars and passenger buses are produced. In the construction field, professional construction force will be built up and the level of mechanization for construction will be raised. Yearly plan for massively carrying out capital construction will be worked out including the construction of dwelling houses for 50 000 families in Pyongyang and dwelling houses for 25 000 families in Komdok area and construction operation and guidance will be meticulously organized for their implementation and provide people with higher civilized living conditions and give a face-lift to the appearance of the country. The Cabinet will ensure the unified management of products and put the focus of the improvement of the economic management on lowering cost and improving quality on the principle of enhancing the organizational function of the national economy and making sure that the results of the economic work are directed to the promotion of the people's welfare. He continued that they would surely attain the goal of crop production set forth by the Party in the agricultural field, the major thrust area of the socialist economic construction, and further consolidate the material and technical foundation for the sustained development of agriculture. More efforts will be directed to the development of light industry to increase the production of consumer goods and their quality so that people would enjoy our own products. We will systematically increase the production of seafood in the fisheries field. We will make sure that the cities and counties would set up realistic development strategy and long-term goals suited to the local characteristics and put them into practice and thus turn all cities and counties into strategic strongholds of highly civilized and prosperous socialist state and the developed region with its peculiar characteristics. We will actively solve scientific and technical problems urgent in carrying out the new five-year plan for national economic development and propel the development of core and advanced ultra-modern technology. The Cabinet will bring about a definite turn in the overall economic work in the direction of promoting fresh innovation, bold creation and steady progress and press for measures for removing old work system and irrational and ineffective work methods that prevent our advance and thus make a stride forward in the economic construction and in the improvement of people's standard of living. The report stressed that all the officials in charge of economic guidance would cherish deep in their minds the heavy responsibilities they have assumed before the Party, the revolution, the country and the people, and creditably fulfill their revolutionary duties in the struggle for implementing the decision made at the Eighth Congress of the WPK. Rodong Sinmun
