title: 4th Session of 14th SPA of DPRK Held
body: The 4th Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly (SPA) of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) took place at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Jan. 17. Present there were the deputies to the SPA. Attending it as observers were officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), the SPA Presidium, the Cabinet, the armed forces organs, ministries and national institutions, and chief secretaries of the city and county committees of the WPK, chairpersons of the people's committees, chairpersons of the cooperative farm management committees and officials of major industrial establishments. The platform was taken by Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, first vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission (SAC) of the DPRK and president of the Presidium of the SPA, Ri Pyong Chol, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission of the WPK and secretary of the WPK Central Committee, and Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK and premier of the DPRK Cabinet. Among those on the platform were Pak Thae Song, Ri Il Hwan, Kim Tu Il, Choe Sang Gon, Kim Yong Chol, O Su Yong, Kwon Yong Jin, Kim Jong Gwan, Jong Kyong Thaek, Ri Yong Gil, Pak Thae Dok, Ho Chol Man, Kim Hyong Sik, Pak Myong Sun, Ri Chol Man, Thae Hyong Chol, Kim Yong Hwan, Pak Jong Gun, Yang Sung Ho, Jon Hyon Chol and Ri Son Gwon, and members of the SAC of the DPRK, vice-presidents, secretary general and members of the SPA Presidium and vice-chairpersons of the SPA. Choe Ryong Hae, president of the SPA Presidium, made an opening address. The session decided on its agenda items; an organizational matter, on thorough implementation of the five-year plan for national economic development set forth at the 8th WPK Congress and on review of fulfillment of the state budget for Juche 109 (2020) and the state budget for Juche 110 (2021) of the DPRK. The session discussed the first agenda item. Cabinet members suggested by Deputy Kim Tok Hun, premier of the Cabinet, upon authorization by the WPK Central Committee, were appointed with the unanimous approval. The director of the Central Public Prosecutors Office was dismissed and appointed. Deputy Kim Tok Hun, premier of the Cabinet, took an oath on behalf of the members of the Cabinet. Deputy Kim Tok Hun made a report on the second agenda item and Deputy Ko Jong Bom, minister of Finance, on the third agenda item. Speeches were made on the basis of a study of the reports. The speakers said that the execution of the state budget for last year was correctly reviewed and the state budget for this year was properly drawn up, they voiced full support and approval. They seriously analyzed and reviewed shortcomings, causes and experience in the efforts for making remarkable progress in the development of the country's economy and improvement of the people's standard of living in the past. They also suggested realistic and dynamic measures for implementing the new 5-year plan. Adopted at the session with the unanimous approval were the ordinance of the SPA of the DPRK "On thoroughly implementing the five-year plan for national economic development set forth at the Eighth Congress of the WPK", the decision of the SPA of the DPRK "On approving the execution of the state budget of the DPRK for Juche 109 (2020) " and the ordinance of the SPA of the DPRK "On state budget of the DPRK for Juche 110 (2021)". President of the SPA Presidium Choe Ryong Hae made a closing address. Rodong Sinmun

title: Deputies to SPA Visit Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Deputies who will participate in the Fourth Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly laid a floral basket at the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on Saturday. Present at the floral basket-laying ceremony was Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and president of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly. They made a bow before the statues of the great leaders after laying the floral basket and flowers. They pledged to fulfill their responsibility and duty in the struggle for firmly consolidating our people's power and carrying out the decision made at the Eighth Congress of the Party under the leadership of Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, guided by the state-building idea of great Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism. Rodong Sinmun

title: Congratulatory Message to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Chairman of Liberal Democratic Party of Russia
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, received a congratulatory message from V. V. Zhirinovsky, chairman of the Liberal Democratic Party of Russia, on January 11. The chairman in the message extended congratulations to Kim Jong Un upon his election as general secretary of the WPK on behalf of the Liberal Democratic Party of Russia and on his own behalf. The message said that his election by the delegates to its 8th Congress with unanimous approval is a reflection of the fervent aspiration of all the working people of the DPRK who are convinced of the Party leadership of the young and energetic statesman personifying the wisdom of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, the preceding leaders of the DPRK, and the spirit of the builders of today's socialist Korea. It noted that the 8th Congress of the WPK will be recorded in the history of the DPRK as an important milestone in the course of the development of the DPRK for building socialism peculiar to it on the basis of the Juche idea and the principle of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism. It stressed that the Juche idea definitely proved its creative might in the whole historic course of the DPRK which has developed into an advanced country in the Asia-Pacific region. Wishing Kim Jong Un good health, it hoped that he would consolidate the unity of the Party ranks centered on the general line of the WPK and successfully implement the decision made at the 8th Congress of the WPK. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Has Photo Session with Those Who Contributed to Successful Eighth WPK Congress
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, called the working people of publishing and printing field who contributed to the successful Eighth Congress of the WPK to the yard of the office building of the Party Central Committee and had a significant photo session with them on January 18. The participants were full of dreamlike happiness and delight of meeting the Marshal whom they have wanted to meet awake and asleep in the yard of the Party Central Committee dear to their hearts and having a souvenir photo of honor taken with him. Seeing him, all the participants broke into cheers of "hurrah!" in tears for the Supreme Leader who repeatedly thanked them and bestows great solicitude to convey down to the generations while valuing humble efforts made by the ordinary working people for the preparation of the Party Congress. He spoke highly of them, noting that the congress of our Party could be successful as there were devoted efforts of the working people who showed all the sincerity to carry out the task given to them by the Party at the highest level with pure loyalty. He posed for a souvenir photo of loving care, expressing his expectation and conviction that they would make greater successes in their work by displaying boundless devotion and responsibility with their noble mission of taking charge of important post in the Party ideological front in the future, too. All the participants pledged to bear deep in mind the iron truth that the worthwhile life and happiness lie in the road of following the benevolent father in a single mind with their destiny and future entrusted to him, and to dedicate all patriotic enthusiasm to the sacred struggle for carrying out the decision of the Eighth Party Congress. Political News Team

title: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un Has Photo Session with Newly-appointed Members of Cabinet
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, met and had a photo session with the members of the Cabinet newly-appointed at the Fourth Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly (SPA) on Jan. 18. Kim Jong Un summoned the members of the Cabinet to shake hands with each of them and warmly congratulate them. Saying that what is important in the efforts to carry out the new five-year plan for national economic development set forth at the 8th Party Congress is devotion and bravery of leading officials, the General Secretary called upon the Cabinet members to bring about substantial changes and successes in carrying out the revolutionary tasks assigned to their sectors by calculating all undertakings in a scientific way and doing them in a bold way to follow through on their implementation, while trusting the Party. Once again stressing that the work of the Cabinet precisely means the work of the Party Central Committee and the implementation of the decision of the Eighth Congress of the WPK constitutes the work of the Cabinet, he indicated once again every principle and way to be maintained in the work of the Cabinet, ranging from the issue of giving priority to science and technology and prioritizing talented persons to the issue of ensuring that the overall economic work aspires to and encourages new innovations, bold creations and constant progress. Expressing the belief that the newly-appointed members of the Cabinet will make redoubled efforts to make remarkable successes in the country's economic work, always cherishing the expectations and trust of the Party and the people as well as patriotism and loyalty and the idea that the people are God, the Supreme Leader had a meaningful photo session with them. All the participants in the photo session raised cheers for the General Secretary who entrusted them with full responsibility for the country's economic work and placed great trust upon them again. They took a loyal oath to make a big stride forward in the economic construction and the improvement of the people's standard of living by throwing themselves into the implementation of the tasks set forth at the 8th Party Congress. Political News Team

title: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un Has Photo Session with Members of 8th Party Central Leadership Body
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, met and had a meaningful photo session with the newly-elected members of the 8th Party central leadership body at the venue of the Party Congress on Monday. The venue was full of warm reverence and loyalty of all the participants for the respected General Secretary who posted them to heavy, honorable and important positions of the Party central leadership body at a crucial moment in the course of the development of the Party and socialist construction of our own style and summoned them to the historic venue of the Party Congress to bestow great loving care and comradely trust on them. When Kim Jong Un appeared at the venue, all the participants broke into enthusiastic cheers of "hurrah!", looking up to him who has developed the Party into an invincible party leading the revolutionary cause of Juche with his outstanding ideas and theories and seasoned and experienced guidance and opened up a new era of the great powerful country by victoriously advancing the construction of our own style socialism. Warmly waving back to the cheering participants, the General Secretary once again warmly congratulated them on their election as members of the 8th leadership body of the dignified WPK as a token of deep trust and expectations of all the Party members and other people. He said that the members of the Party central leadership body, the core of the WPK, should display high sense of responsibility and devotion in the struggle to implement the tasks set forth at the 8th Party Congress, always remembering the gigantic trust of all the Party members expecting them to make more responsible efforts for the firm unity of the Party and its dignified leading authority and the brilliant implementation and victory of the fighting programme. Expressing the belief and expectations that they will deeply cherish the noble idea that the people are God and the idea of dedicating to the people, remain boundlessly faithful to the people-first principle and fulfill with success their responsibility and duty as leading officials of the revolution in the sacred struggle for new victory in the building of our own style socialism, he had a photo session with them. The newly-elected members of the Party central leadership body took a firm oath to bring about prosperity and development of our own style socialism, by faithfully upholding the great leadership of the General Secretary in a single mind with the great honor and trust put on them by him. Political News Team

title: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un Sends Floral Basket to General Secretary of C.C., LPRP
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), sent a floral basket to Thongloun Sisoulith in congratulation of his election as general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party (LPRP) at the 11th Congress of the LPRP. The DPRK ambassador to Laos handed over the floral basket whose ribbon bore the august name of WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un to an official of the Committee for the External Affairs of the LPRP Central Committee on Monday. Rodong Sinmun

title: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un Sends Congratulatory Message to General Secretary of C.C., LPRP
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), sent a congratulatory message to Thongloun Sisoulith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party (LPRP), on Jan. 16. In the message Kim Jong Un extended warm congratulations and comradely greetings to Thongloun Sisoulith on the successful holding of the 11th Congress of the LPRP and on his election as general secretary of the Central Committee of the LPRP. Your assumption of the heavy responsibility as the head of the LPRP is an expression of high trust and expectation of all members of your Party and the Lao people for you who have devoted yourself to the party, state and people for a long period, the message said. It is the firm will of our Party to steadily strengthen the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation between the DPRK and Laos provided by the preceding leaders of the two countries and developed in the common struggle for socialism, it noted. The Supreme Leader in the message hoped that the fraternal Lao people would make a new advance in the struggle for implementing the decision of the 11th Party Congress under the leadership of the general secretary. He in the message sincerely wished the Lao general secretary good health and great success in his responsible work for further enhancing the leadership role of the party and building a prosperous socialist state. Rodong Sinmun

title: To Readjust and Reinforce Its Production Foundations While Waging Increased Production Drive
body: The workers and management of the Pukchang Thermal Power Complex are all out to fufill their new 5-year plan for national economic development. The workers and technicians of its equipment operation shop are firmly determined as never before to fully meet the current demand of the country for electricity. The officials, workers and technicians of its steam generator maintenance shop, turbine maintenance shop and other service stations buckled down to maintaining their fifth generator. The labor and management of the PTPC are firmly resolved to carry out at all costs the highly important tasks set forth at the 8th Congress of the Workers’ Party of Korea by working hard with invincible fortitude in the fighting spirit of self-reliance. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Reply Message to General Secretary Nguyen Phu Trong
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), sent a reply message to Nguyen Phu Trong, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam, on Jan. 18. The message expressed deep thanks to Nguyen Phu Trong for sending his warm congratulations to Kim Jong Un upon his assumption of the post of general secretary of the WPK at its Eighth Congress. The wholehearted warm congratulations and best wishes of Nguyen Phu Trong greatly inspired the WPK and DPRK people who turned out in the efforts for implementing the decision of the 8th Party Congress, the message said. The message expressed the belief that the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation between the two parties and peoples of the two countries which had entered a new high stage would steadily develop in a joint struggle for accomplishing the cause of socialism in the future, too, in conformity with the spirit of the agreement reached with Nguyen Phu Trong in March 2019. It sincerely wished Nguyen Phu Trong good health and big success in his responsible work of leading the party and state. Rodong Sinmun

title: New Posters Produced
body: The Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House, the Mansudae Art Studio and the Korean Central Fine Arts Studio have recently produced posters encouraging all the people to the implementation of the important tasks set forth at the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea. Reflected in the poster "All out for the Implementation of the Decisions by the 8th Party Congress!" carrying mottos "The People Are God", "Single-minded Unity" and "Self-Reliance" is the revolutionary will and firm pledge of all the people across the country who have turned out in hearty response to the fighting programme set forth by the Party. The poster "Let Us Concentrate All Our Efforts on Implementing the Five-year Plan for National Economic Development!" calls for laying solid foundations for revitalizing the overall economy and improving the people's standard of living by devotedly implementing the Party policies and achieving substantial successes in carrying out the new five-year plan for national economic development. The poster "Advance Vigorously towards a New Victory!" is run through with the idea to register a great, new victory by radically augmenting the Juche-oriented force, internal motive force of socialist construction. Rodong Sinmun

title: Finding Innovative Method by Analyzing Experiences and Lessons
body: Agricultural officials nationwide are whole-heartedly prepared to fully discharge their duty to implement the decisions of the 8th Congress of the Workers’ Party of Korea. Conscious of being assigned to attain self-sufficiency in cereals for the people and accelerate socialist construction while the new five-year plan for national economic development is carried out the officials of the Ministry of Agriculture and the agricultural guidance organs of provinces, cities and counties fully exert themselves to thoroughly arm themselves with the ideas and spirit of the 8th Congress. The agricultural officials of North Phyongan Province take great strides in their work with confidence and courage. Those of South Phyongan and North and South Hwanghae Provinces and other provinces study the document of the 8th Congress in depth. In the course of this they analyze the merits and demerits of their work, enthusiastically contrive, find and discuss the realistic methods of executing their tasks and strive to adopt active measures to apply to their work. Rodong Sinmun

title: Winter Timber Production Pushed Forward on Full Scale
body: The workers and management of many forestry stations of the Jagang Provincial Forestry Management Bureau bring about fierce collective innovations in producing lumber in winter. Those of the Huichon Mine Lumber Station actively introduce rational methods into their work and operate their machines effectively so as to mass-produce lumber. Pooling their creative wisdom and strength those of the Kanggye, Songwon and Samnak Mine Lumber Stations, the Hwaphyong Forestry Station and other stations work hard voluntarily to produce lots of lumber. Rodong Sinmun

title: ﻿New Year Cards to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Foreign State and Political Party Leaders
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received New Year cards from foreign state and political party leaders and personages of different social strata on the occasion of the New Year Juche 110(2021). They included the president of the Republic of Maldives and his wife, the presidents of the People's Republic of Bangladesh, the Republic of Cyprus, the Republic of Indonesia, the Republic of Belarus, the Republic of Serbia and the Republic of Zimbabwe and the captains regent of the Republic of San Marino. Also among them were the prime ministers of the People's Republic of Bangladesh and the Republic of India, the general chairwoman and the secretary general of the Central Directive Council of the Indonesian Democratic Party of Struggle, the general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of India (Marxist), the general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Portugal, the general secretary of the Socialist Party of Senegal, the co-chairman of the Board of Directors of the Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation and the director of the Regional Office for Southeast Asia of the WHO. Rodong Sinmun

title: Army-People Rallies Held in Different Provinces
body: There took place army-people rallies in North Phyongan, North Hwanghae, Jagang and South Hamgyong provinces on Tuesday to extend the greatest glory to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un upon his election as general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), and to vow to thoroughly implement the decisions made at the 8th Congress of the WPK. Attending the rallies were officials of local Party and power organs, working people's organizations, factories, enterprises and cooperative farms and working people and officers and men of the Korean People's Army (KPA) and the Public Security Forces. The chief secretaries of the provincial party committees and the chairman of a provincial people's committee made addresses, which were followed by speeches. Speakers extended the greatest glory and the warmest congratulations to Kim Jong Un as a token of the ardent loyalty of all the Party members, service personnel and other people. They called upon officials to make thorough preparations from the start, fully determined to prove their loyalty to the Party, revolution and people with practical working ability and results, and to fulfill their responsibility and duty in the van of the advancing ranks. They stressed the need to wage a vigorous ideological campaign for equipping officials, Party members and working people with the idea and spirit of the Party congress and to make every working site seethe with the implementation of the decisions made at the Party congress. They also underscored the need for cities and counties to set the realistic development strategies and long-term goals accordant to their regional characteristics, translate them into reality without fail and thus turn the cities and counties into developed regions with their own specific features. They said that light industry factories should hold fast to the home production of raw materials and recycling as lifeline and the main orientation, increase the production of quality consumer goods and rural communities accelerate the three revolutions―ideological, technological and cultural― and thoroughly materialize the socialist rural theses. They called upon service personnel to be the first death-defying corps, the first shock brigade making a breakthrough for advance in the van of the struggle for implementing the decisions made at the Party Congress in the spirit of devotedly defending the Party Central Committee. They called for devoting themselves to bringing about the prosperity of our socialist state under the uplifted banner of self-reliance. Letters of pledge to Kim Jong Un were adopted at the rallies. Then there were mass demonstrations. Rodong Sinmun

title: Scientific and Technological Front Seethes with Ardent Loyalty
body: Our scientists, technicians and officials have risen with great confidence in the endeavors to register fresh victories in their work under a bright blueprint unfolded at the 8th Congress of the Workers’ Party of Korea. The officials and public servants of the State Commission of Science and Technology have buckled down to their work with new determination. The SCST focuses all its efforts on dynamically fulfilling the new 5-year plan for national economic development. It goes out to responsibly select and formulate the projects of great national importance in making a breakthrough in moving the science and technology of the nation as a whole on to an ultramodern footing. In addition, it discusses in real earnest measures to improve its general administrative work for science and technology to ensure that successes in scientific researches can prove actually effective in production and practice. The scientists and officials of the State Academy of Sciences have bestirred themselves as never before to discharge their great duty to the country in developing its economy, science and technology. The officials of the SAS have examined in detail what of the highly important tasks set forth by Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un it should carry out. They visit many research institutes and branch academies and definitely set them future and present research projects. The scientists and officials of not only the Academy of Agricultural Science and the agricultural science institutes of all the provinces but also the scientific institutes for the sectors of coal, railway, forestry and many others apply themselves to their work with exceptional revolutionary zeal. Rodong Sinmun

title: All Out to Actively Develop Educational Science
body: Deeply conscious of its duty the officials and researchers of the Pedagogical Institute are all firmly determined to contribute actively to developing our educational science. First of all, the PI energetically maps out the 5-year plan for the development of the educational science of the nation at its last stage. Separate detailed plans for the general goal are also drawn up. The officials and researchers of the PI give fuller play than ever to their burning loyalty and patriotism with the passage of time. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Reply Message to Syrian President
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), sent a reply message to Bashar Al-Assad, president of the Syrian Arab Republic, on January 20. Kim Jong Un in his message extended deep thanks to the president for sending warm congratulations to him on his assumption of duty as the general secretary of the WPK at its 8th Congress. He said that the sincere feelings of friendship and fraternity expressed by the president encourage the Party and the people of the DPRK to make epochal progress in the socialist construction by implementing the decision made at the 8th Congress of the WPK. Expressing belief that the historic friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries would continue to grow strong in conformity with the common interests and desire of the people, the message wished the president and the Syrian people bigger success in their struggle for defending the country's sovereignty. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends New Year Cards to Foreign Party and State Leaders
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, sent New Year cards to foreign party and state leaders on the occasion of the New Year Juche 110 (2021). Among them are the president of the People's Republic of China who is the general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, the president of the Russian Federation, the first secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba, the president of the Republic of Cuba, the president of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam who is the general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam, the president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic who is the general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party and the president of the Syrian Arab Republic who is the general secretary of the Syria's Baath Arab Socialist Party. Rodong Sinmun

title: Army-People Rallies Held in Provinces and Cities
body: There took place army-people rallies in South Phyongan, South Hwanghae and Kangwon provinces and Nampho and Kaesong cities on Wednesday to extend the greatest glory to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un upon his election as general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and to vow to thoroughly implement the decision made at the 8th Congress of the WPK. Attending the rallies were officials of local Party and power organs, working people's organizations, industrial establishments and cooperative farms and working people and officers and men of the Korean People's Army and the Public Security Forces. Addresses were followed by speeches there. Speakers said that Kim Jong Un's election as general secretary of the WPK is an eruption of our people's boundless reverence for the great father and a great national event which provided a decisive guarantee for the victory of revolution and promised its bright future. They noted that all the Party members and other working people are full of a single intention to devotedly implement the decision made at the 8th Party Congress by thoroughly arming themselves with the main idea and main spirit of the congress and by displaying redoubled revolutionary enthusiasm. They underlined the need to wage a courageous offensive under the banner of self-reliance and surely attain the goals specified in the new five-year plan so as to bring about substantial improvement in the economic development and betterment of people's standard of living. They stressed the need to further develop agriculture, light industry and fishing industry, work out development strategy and long-term goals to suit to the specific conditions of cities and counties and carry them out in a planned way and on an annual basis in order to make self-reliant and multi-lateral progress. They stressed the need for officers and men of the People's Army to be aware of their sacred and important mission as the basic force for national defence and driving force of the revolution and thus fully guarantee the implementation of the decision made at the Party Congress with the armed forces and create more wealth of socialism for people's happiness. Letters of pledge to Kim Jong Un were adopted at the rallies. Then there were mass demonstrations. Rodong Sinmun

title: In Order to Turn Low-yielding Field into Fertile One
body: The 8th Congress of the Workers’ Party of Korea stressed the important need to produce more cereals than ever in fields which give a low yield of them and thus boost agricultural output. In recent years Tokchon City has achieved a number of experiences in improving its farm work in its fields with a low yield of cereals. For example, the Hyongbong Cooperative Farm removed stones from its fields with a low yield of cereals, carpeted them with humus soil and intensively grew corns in their rich spots so as to augment their output more than three times than before. Above all, a member of the Unhung Cooperative Farm raised cereals with good care in his fields notorious for a low yield and turned out more than 10 tons of them per hectare. As a result, he proved in practice that no land was good or bad to a real farmer. Now that they have studied the main ideas and spirit of the 8th congress hard officials bring about a fundamental change in their fighting spirit and work attitude. They make primary efforts to map out and carry out a detailed plan to double the output of their organic compound manure as against last year for the present, extensively ameliorate their fields which suffer damages from cold and wet weather and blanket them with humus soil in a big way. The officials of TC have bestirred themselves to implement the decisions of the 8th congress by all means. Through in-depth thoughts and discussions they adopt meticulous practical measures to reap bumper harvests in all their fields, including the rest of them which give a low yield of cereals. Rodong Sinmun

title: Reserves for New Land Can Be Found Everywhere
body: It is one of the important tasks put forward at the 8th Congress of the WPK to increase arable land by all means. Changdo County actively explored for its reserves and increased its farmland in area last year and scored a number of successes in its other agricultural work. Its officials formulated their detailed plan by phases to acquire new arable land all the time. They decided to improve its rivers anew and acquire new land. They also discussed realigning ridges between fields and removing piles of stones and puddles to convert them into arable land. Furthermore, they conducted good organizational and political work among their working people. True to the decisions of the 8th congress, the officials and working people of the city work hard to acquire new land. Rodong Sinmun

title: Metal Industry Powerfully Supported
body: The officials, Party members and workers of Pyongyang support the sector of the metalworking industry more enthusiastically than ever. The capital sent lots of scrap iron to the Chollima Steel Complex by motortruck to help it in its production. Songyo, Central, Moranbong, Taedonggang and Taesong Districts led the capital in gathering scrap iron. Conscious that the collection of scrap iron led to the production of steel the officials of Mangyongdae, Sosong, Phyongchon, Tongdaewon and Pothonggang Districts set personal examples to the masses and goaded them into supporting steelworks with zeal. All the officials, Party members and workers of factories and enterprises in the capital collected large quantities of scrap iron in a short time by dint of hard work. When heavily laden with scrap iron motortrucks entered the CSC on January 20 its workers warmly welcomed them there. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Reply Message to Laotian President
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a reply message to Bounnang Vorachith, president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic, on January 18. Kim Jong Un in his message extended deep thanks to the president for sending warm and encouraging congratulations and a floral basket with sincerity on his assumption of duty as general secretary of the WPK at its 8th Congress. He expressed belief that the tradition of the good friendly and cooperative relations between the two parties and peoples of the two countries would be firmly carried forward and developed generation after generation. He sincerely wished the president good health, happiness and big success in his responsible work for the country's prosperity. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Reply Message to Raul Castro Ruz
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, on Jan. 18 sent a reply message to Raul Castro Ruz, first secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba. In the message Kim Jong Un expressed his deep thanks to the first secretary for extending sincere congratulations to him upon his assumption of duty as the general secretary of the WPK at its 8th Congress. The first secretary's warm and comradely congratulations are the great support and encouragement to the struggle of our Party and people for achieving a new victory of socialist cause, the message said. Expressing once again the steadfast will to value and steadily boost the tradition of militant unity and cooperation with the Cuban Party and people, the message wished the first secretary good health and greater success in his noble work of leading the Cuban revolution. Rodong Sinmun

title: Army-People Rallies Held in Provinces and City
body: There took place army-people rallies in North Hamgyong and Ryanggang provinces and Rason City on Thursday to extend the greatest glory to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un upon his election as general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and to vow to thoroughly implement the decision made at the 8th Congress of the WPK. Attending the rallies were officials of local Party and power organs, working people's organizations, industrial establishments and cooperative farms, working people and officers and men of the Korean People's Army and the Public Security Forces. Speakers said that it was an eruption of the absolute trust and intense loyalty of all the Party members and other Korean people that the Supreme Leader was elected again as the head of the great WPK at its 8th Congress. They called upon all officials, Party members and working people to thoroughly arm themselves with the main idea and main spirit of the 8th Party Congress and make substantial successes and progress in the socialist construction by giving full play to their revolutionary enthusiasm. They stressed the need for all sectors and units to map out proper stage and annual plans for implementing the new five-year plan and for officials to calculate all undertakings in a scientific way and carry out them in a big way. They called for dynamically conducting the three revolutions-ideological, technological and cultural- in rural communities and increasing the production of quality consumer goods popular among the people by fully supplying raw and other materials to the light industry factories. They called upon the service personnel to fulfill their duties before the Party and the revolution as the main force for national defence and the driving force of the revolution and thus become honorable victors in the sacred struggle for implementing the decision made at the 8th Party Congress. They called for achieving prosperity and development of our own style socialism by going all out for the implementation of the important tasks advanced at the Party congress. Letters of pledge to the Supreme Leader were adopted at the rallies. Then there were processions of the participants. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Reply Message to Syrian President
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), sent a reply message to Bashar Al-Assad, president of the Syrian Arab Republic, on January 20. Kim Jong Un in his message extended deep thanks to the president for sending warm congratulations to him on his assumption of duty as the general secretary of the WPK at its 8th Congress. He said that the sincere feelings of friendship and fraternity expressed by the president encourage the Party and the people of the DPRK to make epochal progress in the socialist construction by implementing the decision made at the 8th Congress of the WPK. Expressing belief that the historic friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries would continue to grow strong in conformity with the common interests and desire of the people, the message wished the president and the Syrian people bigger success in their struggle for defending the country's sovereignty. Rodong Sinmun

title: Recycling Regarded as Its Development Strategy
body: The officials, workers and technicians of factories and enterprises in Kangwon Province energetically recycle their wastes. The Kangwon Provincial Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea conducts good organizational and political work in all its sectors and units to ensure that they recycle their industrial wastes and domestic garbage to the maximum. Before everything else it arranges its light industry spheres to take the lead in this. The Wonsan Shoes Factory doesall it can to recycle its wastes, thus briskly going on with its production. The workers and management of the Wonsan Disabled Soldiers’ Plastic Daily Necessities Factory develop their production by recycling paper scraps. The Kalma Foodstuff Factory, too, dynamically recycles its leftovers with the help of its technicians. The other factories and enterprises of the province register good results in recycling its industrial wastes. The province pays due attention to purchasing all sorts of wastes from its inhabitants because they are greatly interested in recycling them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Conscious of Their Heavy Responsibility
body: The scientists and technicians of South Hamgyong Province actively settle the problems of the normalization of production in its leading chemical industry centers. The scientists, technicians, teachers and researchers of the Hamhung Branch of the State Academy of Sciences, Hamhung University of Chemical Engineering, Hamhung University of Hydraulic Engineering and many other units make great strides forward with great confidence, optimism and vigor. The scientists and technicians of the province present themselves at the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex and the February 8 Vinalon Complex and bestir themselves time and again to resolve scientific and technological problems there. Rodong Sinmun

title: All Out for the Increased Production of Electricity
body: The workers of the Yonsan Army-People Power Station operate all their generation equipment at full capacity. The officials, workers and technicians of the YAPPS fully acquaint themselves with the water level and inflow of the river and on this basis, distribute its output scientifically so as to operate their generators very efficiently at high water level. The workers of its generators workteam set their equipment in motion to meet the demand of technological regulations and standard operation methods and thereby produce plenty of electricity. The workers of the YAPPS’ repair and maintenance workteam devote their creative wisdom and zeal to turning out necessary accessories on their own with their technology. Those assigned to take care of the dam and hydraulic structure of the YAPPS also do their part responsibly contributing greatly to augmenting the output of its electricity. Rodong Sinmun

title: Active Aid to Socialist Countryside
body: In Pyongyang officials and workers support their cooperative farms in a big way. They are now going all out to transport lots of cinder to the cooperative farms of their adjacent districts and blanket their vegetable fields with it in an endeavor to enrich them by all means. The units of Pyongyangvie with each other to procure plenty of cinder in a short time and carry it to the farms of its surrounding districts by vehicle at the one go-off. Thousands of tons of cinder was transported to the farms of Sadong District with hundreds of motortrucks on January 21. The senior Party officials of Taedonggang, Taesong, Central, Phyongchon, Songyo and Pothonggang Districts and other districts of Pyongyang went to the farms and conducted dynamic political work among their employees actively encouraging them to make good preparations for their farming. Rodong Sinmun

title: Pyongyang Electronic Medical Appliances Factory Upgraded
body: The remodeled Pyongyang Electronic Medical Appliances Factory has been inaugurated. The factory covering a total floor space of more than 13 200 square meters has several workshops, integrated control room, room for technological development, sci-tech learning space, etc. As the factory was successfully upgraded, foundations have been laid for further developing the country's medical instrument industry. The factory has all sorts of equipment for streamlining the production and assembly of different electric and electronic medical appliances. It has also spaces for IT service, welfare service and technical apprentice. Choe Sang Gon, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Vice-premier of the Cabinet Ri Song Hak, Minister of Public Health Choe Kyong Chol, Ri Il Bae, chief secretary of the Mangyongdae District Party Committee, and officials concerned looked round the factory on Jan. 22. Rodong Sinmun

title: Mass Rallies Held in Cities, Counties
body: There took place mass rallies in Kim Chaek, Songrim, Sunchon, Sinpho and Samjiyon cities, Ryongsong District and Pongsan, Ryongchon, Anak, Janggang and Anbyon counties to extend the greatest glory to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un upon his election as general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and to vow to thoroughly implement the decisions made at the 8th Congress of the WPK. Attending the rallies were officials of local Party, power and economic organs, working people's organizations, industrial establishments and cooperative farms, and working people. Speakers at the rallies spoke about the immense pride and happiness of our people invariably holding Kim Jong Un in high esteem at the top post representing and leading the WPK. They expressed their pledge to confidently advance towards a new victory, fully supporting the decisions made at the 8th Party Congress which indicated clear struggle tasks and ways for advancing the socialist cause to the next stage of victory. Saying that on-going struggle for implementing the decisions made at the Party Congress is an all-people general advance for bringing about another upsurge in our revolution and achieving a new victory of our own-style socialism, they called upon officials and working people to grope for innovative way for thoroughly implementing the five-year plan for national economic development. At the rallies speakers vowed to direct all efforts to making an epoch-making progress in the socialist construction by remaining faithful to Kim Jong Un and by throwing themselves into implementing the decisions made at the Party Congress, guided by the noble ideals of "The people are God", single-minded unity and self-reliance. Rodong Sinmun

title: Congratulatory Messages and Letters to Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un from Different Countries
body: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un received congratulatory messages and letters from different countries upon his election as general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). They include the general secretary of the Union Solidarity and Development Party of Myanmar, the chairman of the Mongolian People's Party, the chairman of the Central Executive Committee of the Bangladesh National Socialist Party, the general secretary of the Central Committee of the Syrian Communist Party, the general secretary of the Al Ahd al Watani Party of Syria, the general secretary of the Palestinian Popular Struggle Front, the chairman of the Motherland Party of Turkey, the acting first secretary of the Central Committee of the Armenian Communist Party, the chairman of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Azerbaijan, the chairman and the deputy secretary general of the National Leading Council of the Diversity Party of Indonesia, the senior leader of the Indian People's Party, the general secretary of the Central Committee of the All-India Forward Bloc, the acting chairman of the Communist Party of Germany, the chairman of the Socialist Party of Romania, the general secretary of the Communist Party of Switzerland, the chairman of the Communist Party in Sweden, the general secretary of the Guinean Rainbow People's Assembly, the secretary general of the Mozambique Liberation Front Party, the general secretary of the Socialist Party of Senegal, the general secretary of the Congolese Party of Labour, the general secretary and the secretary for International Relations of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Venezuela, the first secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Chile (Proletarian Action), the general secretary of the Revolutionary Communist Party of Uruguay, the Central Committee of the Marxist-Leninist Communist Party of Brazil and the National Leadership of the March 26 Movement of Uruguay. Also among them are the secretary of the Central Council of the Communist Parties-the Communist Party of the Soviet Union, the international secretary of the Serbian Communist Party, the international secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the People of Spain, a councilor of the European Society for the Study of the Juche Idea, the secretary general of the International Liaison Committee for Reunification and Peace in Korea and other high-ranking officials of political, public and economic circles and the military of China, Russia, Nepal, Myanmar, Mongolia, Singapore, Cambodia, Turkey, India, Japan, Germany, Bulgaria, Belarus, Sweden, France, Italy, Spain, South Africa, Libya, Senegal, Zambia, Zimbabwe, DR Congo, Ethiopia, Brazil, Peru, Argentina and Australia, and representatives of organizations for the study of the Juche idea, organizations for supporting Korea's reunification and friendship organizations. Meanwhile, the Central Committee of the WPK received a congratulatory message from the general secretary of the Revolutionary Communist Party of France. Rodong Sinmun

title: Blasting of 200 000 Cubic Metre Earth Successful at Woldo Tideland under Reclamation
body: Workers of the North Phyongan Provincial Tideland Reclamation General Enterprise, who turned out in the efforts to implement the decisions of the Eighth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea, have successfully carried out the blasting of 200 000 cubic meters of earth in the area of Woldo tideland. Thanks to the successful blasting, foundations have been laid for pushing ahead with the project of the anti-tidal dike No. 3 in District 2 of the Woldo tideland. Not resting on the laurels, the workers are waging an all-out campaign to glorify this year with proud labor successes. Rodong Sinmun

title: Blasting of 50 000 Cubic Metre Earth Successfully Carried out by Kyongam Cement Factory
body: Workers of the Kyongam Cement Factory successfully carried out the blasting of 50 000 cubic meters of earth. Through the successful blasting, they made a breakthrough in their efforts for increased production. They are now waging an intensive campaign for increased production and creation to implement the tasks set forth at the Eighth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea. Rodong Sinmun

title: Grand Art Performance "We Sing of Party" Celebrates 8th Congress of WPK
body: The grand art performance "We Sing of the Party" drew a full house at the Pyongyang Indoor Stadium. It was given from Jan. 13 to 24 to celebrate the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea. Working people in the city enjoyed the performance. The performers, who represented a sublime music world with hymns of the times heartily sung by our people for centuries in reverence for the great Party, put on the stage special numbers to impressively depict the immortal feats of the invincible WPK that has led the cause of socialism to a shining victory. Watching the performance, the audience keenly realized that the prosperity and development of the country came to be achieved, thanks to the wise leadership of the Party regarding the people-first principle as its basic idea and guiding idea. The performance boosted the morale of our people who turned out in the revolutionary struggle for the overall development of our own-style socialism, true to the ideals of "The people are God", single-minded unity and self-reliance. Rodong Sinmun

title: WPK Central Committee Sends Reply Messages to Leaderships of Foreign Political Parties
body: The Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) sent messages to the leaderships of foreign political parties in reply to the congratulatory messages and letters sent by them on the occasion of the 8th Congress of the WPK. They are the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam, the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party, the Central Leadership of the Syria's Baath Arab Socialist Party, the Central Committee of the People's Party of Cambodia, the Central Committee of the South African Communist Party, the Central Committee of the Mozambique Liberation Front Party and the National Executive Committee of the Workers' Party of Mexico. The WPK Central Committee in the messages extended thanks to them for sending warm congratulations to the 8th Congress of the WPK, an important political event for the development of the WPK and the Korean revolution. The messages noted that their comradely and fraternal felicitations give great strength and encouragement to the Party and people of the DPRK in their struggle for fulfilling the fighting programme set forth at the 8th Congress of the WPK. Affirming its will to steadily develop the friendly and cooperative relations with those parties, the WPK Central Committee in the messages wished them bigger successes in their activities for the independent development and prosperity of their countries. Rodong Sinmun

title: Voices of Standard-bearers in the Front line
body: Ri Sun Chol, the chief of the Corn Institute of the Academy of Agricultural Science, said that his institute was not geared toward carrying out its scientific research projects in the past to breed a variety of corn suited to our climate, soil and region. He affirmed that in the future his institute would pursue its scientific researches with the appraisal of the people as a yardstick. Jon Jun Ho, a sectional chief of the Foodstuff Institute of the Academy of Light Industrial Science, said that he would carry on his scientific researches to produce homemade additives indispensable to improving the quality of soft drinks, acquire sugar with domestic raw materials, secure materials and raw materials at home and recycle their leftovers. Jon Myong Hyok, a researcher of the Institute for the Science and Technology of Aquatic Life of the Academy of Aquatic Science, said that he would exert all his energies to artificially propagating and rearing walleye pollacks and croakers, raising aquatic animal and plant life together and resolving other scientific and technological problems of aquatic products so as to contribute actively to bringing about an actual change in the diet of the people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Firmly Resolved to Support Party with Increased Steel Production
body: The historic 8th Congress of the Workers’ Party of Korea set the sector of the metalworking industry an important task of perfecting its Juche-based iron production system technologically, increasing its capacity and boosting its iron and steel output by all means. The workers and management of the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex ceaselessly carry out their immediate assignments needed to refashion their existing production processes with advanced technology and increase their iron and steel production while at the same time trying hard to augment their pig iron production. The officials, technicians and workers of the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex have courageously buckled down to their production with new determination. The labor and management of the Chollima Steel Complex take great strides forward with a full resolve to lead their counterparts in bolstering up the metalworking industry of the country. The officials, technicians and workers of the Musan Mining Complex, the Jaeryong, Unryul and Hungsan Mines, the Hungnam Electrode Factory and many other producers work in real earnest to solidify the foundations for their long-range production and boost their present output. Rodong Sinmun

title: By Revving Up Atmosphere of Study
body: The WPK’s organizations of North Hwanghae Province ensure that officials and workers study the documents and decisions of its 8th Congress hard. The provincial Party committee detailedly arranges all officials to study the documents of the congress in depth and above all, find the practical methods of bringing about fresh changes in the work of their spheres and units. The Party organizations of the provincial people’s committee, the provincial rural economic committee and other provincial organs ensure that the employees study the documents of the congress examining their work in close relation to actual circumstances. City and county Party committees and other Party organizations at all levels make sure that while studying the documents of the congress all the employees are ideologically prepared to correctly execute the Party policies on their units, plan their work and undertake assignments. Rodong Sinmun

title: Realizing Noble Intention of Party
body: Although blanketed with snow the foot of Mt Paektu is exposed to a temperature of tens of degrees below zero for many months dozens of greenhouses of the Samjiyon City Vegetable Greenhouse Farm boast bumper vegetable crops. The SCVGF reaps celery cabbages, spinaches, cucumbers, tomatoes and other fresh vegetables stage by stage. Last year it harvested hundreds of tons of vegetables and sent them to the inhabitants of Samjiyon City, the tourists of revolutionary battle sites and the shock workers of Division 216. Celery cabbage is now being seeded in the fields of the greenhouses at full steam to reap vegetables step by step. Rodong Sinmun

title: Feats Performed by Workers of Samsu Forestry Station
body: The workers and management of the Samsu Forestry Station have worked with all their might to carry out the decisions of the 8th Congress of the WPK, thus fulfilling their yearly plan for the production of lumber in the mountains by 90%. This winter it snowed a little and what was worse, a biting cold weather lasted as against last winter. Consequently, the production and transport of lumber was affected very adversely. The Chongsu Forestry Sub-station found it most difficult of all its counterparts in the SFS because it had to transport its lumber to a main road from its felling place along dangerous slopes and iced lanes. Consequently, it took much time to transport lumber by motortruck. But the employees of the CFS were firmly prepared to defend the dignity of the WPK and promote the progress of the country by helping toward carrying out the new 5-year plan for the national economic development. They were the very first in the SFS to top its yearly lumber production plan by dint of devotion. The other forestry sub-stations of the SFS also made collective innovations in their production. The workers of the Jungphyong Youth Forestry Sub-station set up a mobile repair shop in the mountain and repaired their motor vehicles on their own so as tobring about innovations in their production. Meanwhile, those of the Kwandong Forestry Sub-station applied efficient methods to their work, thereby saving lots of labor and fuel oil and yet registering high results in their felling day by day. The result is that the labor and management of the SFS perform great exploits in their production in the Paektu mountain range. Rodong Sinmun

title: New Novel Published in DPRK
body: The full-length novel "Our Dear Native Home" (authored by Kwak Song Ho), part of the serial "Immortal Guidance", was published. The novel deals with the immortal exploits Chairman Kim Jong Il performed by putting efforts into the strengthening of the companies of the People's Army, the basic requirement for developing it into the pillar of the revolution and the main force for accomplishing the revolutionary cause of Juche, and by turning them into dear native homes for soldiers. The novel notes that a revolution was witnessed in transforming all the companies of the army into the cradle of worthwhile life where soldiers cultivate their bravery and perform feats, and into their dear native homes under the care of the Supreme Command, thanks to the guidance of the Chairman who took warm loving care of soldiers. Rodong Sinmun

title: Information Activities of Central Emergency Anti-epidemic Units Get Brisk
body: The central emergency anti-epidemic units are dynamically conducting anti-epidemic information activities to prevent the inroads of the worldwide epidemic. Their officials, on the basis of their experience gained in the last year's work, have buckled down to information activities and health education to intensify the anti-epidemic campaign. Since the outset of this year, many explanatory statements, video clips and recordings have been produced by the central emergency anti-epidemic units to help maintain constant vigilance in the emergency anti-epidemic work. They have also conducted the information work for consolidating the anti-virus walls against the new coronavirus variant rapidly spreading across the world. Information and reference books are widely disseminated to help all working people take part in the anti-epidemic work voluntarily. Rodong Sinmun

title: WPK Central Committee Sends Congratulatory Message to 13th Congress of CPV
body: The Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) sent a congratulatory message to the 13th Congress of the Communist Party of Vietnam (CPV) on Jan. 25. The WPK Central Committee in the message warmly congratulated the CPV on its 13th congress, and through the congress, extended warm comradely greetings to all the members of the CPV. The message expressed belief that the 13th congress would become an important occasion for marking a new milestone in the struggle for consolidating the party and building thriving socialist Vietnam. Expressing the conviction that the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation between the two parties and two countries, forged in the joint struggle for accomplishing the cause of socialism, would grow stronger in the spirit of the agreement made by the top leaders of the two parties in March 2019, the message sincerely wished the congress big success in its work. Rodong Sinmun

title: In Ministry of Chemical Industry
body: The officials of the Ministry of Chemical Industry explore ways and measures to scientifically map out the plan for its current production and the strategy for its step-by-step development and carry them out. They adopt the detailed ways of effectively pushing ahead with their construction schemes now under way. They realistically draw up a long-term plan to found the Juche-based chemical industry relying on our raw materials and determine the proper order of priority for work on the basis of a scientific calculation. They also arrange all chemical factories in detail to intensify their cooperative researches in close liaison with the scientific institutes concerned and vitalize their production. In the past the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex, the February 8 Vinalon Complex and the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex achieved successes in readjusting their technologically-backward production processes. The officials of the MCI are now paying close attention to widely introducing and generalizing the complexes’ technologies of value. Rodong Sinmun

title: Gaining Experience in Achievements and Lesson from Mistakes
body: The officials of Hochon County deeply analyze the successes and experiences in their old work and map out detailed operations to develop their local economy this year, the first year for the new 5-year plan. Above all, they plan to actively popularize the experiences they gained in discovering every inch of waste ground and using it for improving the living level of the people. The county directs its efforts into energizing its local industries. The officials derive experiences from their successes, find ways of overcoming their shortcomings, set themselves great targets and adopt practical measures to hit them. Much is expected from their future work. Rodong Sinmun

title: Converting Local Economy into One Thoroughly Based on Its Own Raw Materials
body: While analyzing how matters stood at its local industrial factories the officials of Jonchon County paid attention to the experiences gained by their county cement factory in annually producing thousands of tons of cement with limestone and inferior coal available at the county. Analyzing the experiences in detail the county studies hard how its local industry factories must normalize their production in reliance on their raw materials. It also tries to develop its sericulture, effectively use its herb resources and opportunely provide raw materials to its local industrial factories directly linked with the living of its inhabitants. Rodong Sinmun

title: To Increase Production of Various Building Materials
body: The Phyongsong Gravels and Sand Production Station takes great technological care of its equipment to increase its output even in winter, thus fulfilling its daily production plan without fail. Its workers and management turn out thousands of tiles and paving blocks every day by mixing sand and gravels with cement in exact proportion and curding them thoroughly for a certain time. In addition, they pay deep attention to consolidating the material and technological foundations of their station. The PGSPS bends every great effort to strengthen the foundations of its repair and maintenance shop and brings about technological innovations methodologically. Rodong Sinmun

title: By Putting Big Efforts to Production of Organic Composite Fertilizer
body: The officials and agricultural workers of South Hamgyong Province blanket its fields with plenty of organic compound manure. Sinhung County built an organic compound manure factory and has since enlivened its production. Yonggwang County lays the firm foundations for producing as much organic compound manure as it wishes, procures raw materials for it and takes good care of its equipment, thereby augmenting its output. The officials and agricultural workers of Tanchon City do their utmost to turn out its organic compound manure. The case is similar to those of Hamhung City, Pukchong and Kowon Counties and many other cities and counties. Rodong Sinmun

title: Hundreds of Thousands of Tons of Homemade Compost Produced
body: Of late, the farm villages of North Hwanghae Province turned out hundreds of thousands of tons of farmyard manure. The provincial rural economy committee strives mightily to satisfactorily supply cooperative farms with the spores and slaked lime needed to produce their fermented compost. The officials and agricultural workers of Hwangju County aim at producing more manure than before and conduct a vigorous socialist emulation among farms, workteams and subworkteams, thereby stacking manure heaps on heaps. The cooperative farms of Junghwa County analyzed the soil of their fields and plots in detail and on this basis, have since done their best to turn out their farmyard manure. The agricultural workers of Yonthan and Singye Counties try hard to produce their good farmyard manure in both quality and quantity. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Reply Message from General Secretary of C.C., LPRP
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), received a reply message from Thongloun Sisoulith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party (LPRP), on Jan. 26. Thongloun Sisoulith in the message expressed heartfelt gratitude to Kim Jong Un for extending warm congratulation and best wish to him upon his election as general secretary of the Central Committee of the LPRP at its 11th Congress. He said the warm congratulation and best wish are an expression of fraternal and comradely support, firm solidarity and unswerving trust based on common idea and serve as a great encouragement to him leading the work for defending the country and the cause of building a socialist state. The message wished Kim Jong Un happiness in good health and success in his noble work. It hoped that the long-standing friendly relations between the two parties and peoples of the Lao People's Democratic Republic and the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and between the two countries would grow stronger in conformity with the substantial interests of the peoples of the two countries and regional and global peace, friendship and cooperation. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Sends Birthday Spread to Centenarian
body: Under the care of our Party that attaches greatest importance to promoting the people's health and welfare, the number of centenarians is increasing in the DPRK. Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un sent a birthday spread to Thak Jae Dan living in Munchon-dong, Munchon City, Kangwon Province on her 100th birthday. Deeply moved by the birthday spread, she expressed gratitude to the Supreme Leader. She, born into a fisherman's family before the liberation of the country, keenly experienced how miserable a stateless nation's destiny is, being subject to all sorts of humiliation and contempt. She fulfilled her duties in the field of food administration for a long time to repay the benevolence of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il who liberated the country and provided her with worthwhile life. She keeps her diet balanced and her life optimistic, requesting her children to do more jobs for the good of our social system, the best one in the world. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un Receives Gift from Nepalese Party Leader
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), received a gift from the chairman of the Central Committee of the Nepal Worker-Peasant Party on the occasion of the 8th Congress of the WPK. The gift was conveyed to the DPRK ambassador to Nepal by Chairman Narayan Man Bijukchhe on January 22. Rodong Sinmun

title: Energetic Campaign for Increased Production Goes on in Coal Mining Industry
body: The workers and management of coal mines countrywide produced tens of thousands of tons more coal by January 26 over and above their plans approved by the Ministry of Coal Industry. The employees of the February 8 Jikdong, Chonsong and Ryongdae Youth Coal Mines of the Sunchon Area Youth Coal Mining Complex try hard to carry out their new 5-year plan before anyone else. Those of the Kaechon and Joyang Coal Mines of the Kaechon Area Coal Mining Complex as well as many of its other coal mines work hard in high spirits to boost their coal output. The workers of the Tokchon, Pukchang, Tukjang, Kujang and Kangdong Area Coal Mining Complexes and many other coal mines across the country give priority to their tunneling and actively introduce advanced mining methods into their work, thus registering high results in their production day after day. The workers of the Sunchon, Tokchon, Pukchang, Kaechon and Tukjang Coal Mining Machine Plants and many other units step up the production of the equipment, materials and accessories needed for machines to be used in high proportion in coalfaces for mining purposes. Rodong Sinmun

title: Enthusiasm to Produce More Electricity
body: The labor and management of the Pukchang Thermal Power Complex work hard with courage to readjust and reinforce the foundations for their production exploring and mobilizing their internal reserves as much as possible and actively conducting a mass technological innovation drive. The Pyongyang Thermal Power Complex strives energetically to augment the production of its electricity by recourse to science and technology. While increasing its strength continuously the Sodusu Power Station actively explores the realistic ways of boosting the output of its electricity to help toward settling the problem of electricity for the nation. Rodong Sinmun

title: Setting High Targets and Executing Them One by One
body: The officials of North Phyongan Province pay close attention to establishing a circulatory production cycle system to procure cereal fodder, protein fodder and fodder additives. Besides, it adopts tough measures to increase its herbivores in number sharply. Meanwhile, its city and county anti-epizootic stations ensure that the areas concerned improve their anti-epizootic work to suit their actual conditions. Rodong Sinmun

title: To Raise More Grass-eating Domestic Animals
body: The officials of the Sepho Area Stockbreeding Management Committee bear in mind again that it is prerequisite to developing the livestock industry to solve the seed problem and adopt detailed scientific and technological measures to maximize the number of their herbivores of superior breeds on a priority basis. They also pay deep attention to planting properly the fodder crops suited to the natural and geographical features of the Sepho area and perfecting the methods of manuring and tending them on scientific lines so as to increase their output. Furthermore, they make efforts to lay the material and technological foundations for raising their domestic animals on a scientific footing and carrying on their anti-epizootic work on a higher level. Rodong Sinmun

title: By Intensifying Mass Discussion
body: The officials of Jangjin and Pujon Counties adopt effective measures to raise their sheep. Those of Jangjin County try hard to fully listen to the voices of the masses, synthesize them, correctly incorporate them in their plan and translate them into reality. Those of Pujon County, too, build their sheepcotes newly at rational places, give importance to raising great numbers of their prolific Maengsan sheep which grow rapidly and gain much flesh and exert themselves to do that. Moreover, they pay due attention to securing the seeds of nourishing forage grasses which thrive lushly in an alpine zone, increasing their grassy places in area and using them effectively. Rodong Sinmun

title: To Produce More Tasty Processed Potato Foods
body: The labor and management of the Taehongdan County Potato Processing Factory increase their output with success. It overfulfilled its plan for the first month of this year by January 24. The officials and workers of the TCPPF are now stirring themselves to produce delicious processed potatoes in larger quantities than before. Rodong Sinmun

title: Disabled Female Soldier Receives University Diploma
body: Ryom Hye Ryon successfully finished Pyongyang Jang Chol Gu University of Commerce through telelectures on January 3 this year while the whole city jubilated over the New Year. She resides at the 13th Neighborhood Unit, Wasan-dong 1, Sosong District, Pyongyang. She was worst disabled during her military service five years ago and returned home. Later on, she considerably recuperated from her disability thanks to many benefactors and benefactresses and has since been able to walk anyway. She went the length of matriculating in the teleeducation faculty of the university. Very busy as they were Ri Un Sun, Kim Un Chol and other teachers devoted their time and energy unhesitatingly to help her in her study. Han Kum Ju and Ri Ok Ju became her real sisters rather than her educators to take good care of her. She studied hard for four years and finally finished all her university lessons with good scholastic marks. Rodong Sinmun

title: By Putting Efforts to Increasing Electricity Production
body: The hydraulic power stations of South Hamgyong Province are operated at full capacity to boost the output of their electricity. The Hochongang Power Station is all out to produce electricity, preferentially repairing and maintaining its generation equipment. The officials, workers and technicians of the Jangjingang and Pujongang Power Stations work to the best of their ability to produce as much electricity as possible and contribute to socialist construction. Rodong Sinmun

title: Building Materials Production Base Pays Off
body: North Phyongan Province profits from a building materials combined factory with great production capacity. Last year it built the combined factory true to the intention of the Party to produce building materials at home. The combined factory turns out colored cement tiles, cement blocks, plastic pipes, fixtures, etc with the raw materials available in NPP. Consequently, the province has laid the firm material and technological foundations for dynamically accelerating the erection, refashioning and modernization of the buildings needed to develop its economy and improve the living standard of its people. The combined factory is now speeding up the production of its building materials for important construction projects. Rodong Sinmun

title: Machine-building Industry Makes Successes
body: In the sector of the machine-building industry officials and workers have bestirred themselves to carry out their new 5-year plan. The workers and management of the Ryongsong Machine Complex, the Ragwon Machine-building General Enterprise, the Taean Heavy Machine Complex and other major machine-building plants have risen as one in their work with a firm determination to bring about a fresh change in developing the machine-building industry of the nation. Those of the Kusong Machine Tool Factory, the Sungri Motortruck General Enterprise, the Kumsong Tractor Factory and other machine-building plants, too, take vigorous strides in their progress. Rodong Sinmun

title: Intensive Broadcasting Activities Go On
body: The Party organizations of North Hamgyong Province vigorously spur the masses to implement the decisions of the 8th Party Congress. Some time ago the provincial Party committee arranged sound trucks to be sent to factories and complexes. Settling at the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex Party information workers and announcers lose no time in informing its employees on the spot of the innovative successes registered by its separate factories in producing their Juche-based iron and steel. Publicity activities are conducted dynamically by speaker at the Chongjin Chemical Fiber Factory, the Ranam Coal Mining Machine Complex and the Chongjin Theater and other major institutions under construction in the province. Publicity is also given by speaker at the fields of cooperative farms to the good preparations made by their members for their farming. Rodong Sinmun

title: Big Efforts Put to Reinforcing Rails
body: Many railway bureaus exert themselves to make substantial advances in building up the strength of their rails during the period of their new 5-year plan. The officials, technicians and workers of the Pyongyang Railway Bureau devote all their wisdom and enthusiasm to heightening the strength of their rails keenly realizing once again that it is of importance in raising the traffic capacity of their railways and ensuring their security. The Chongjin Railway Bureau adopts scientific and technological measures to build up the strength of its rails.
