The officials, technicians and workers of the Kaechon, Hamhung and Rason Railway Bureaus work hard to heighten the strength of their rails superbly by dint of science and technology under their detailed plans. Rodong Sinmun

title: Enthusiasm to Guarantee Seed Production with Science and Technology
body: The scientists of the Rice Plant Institute of the Academy of Agricultural Science have formulated their step-by-step research projects to breed high-yielding varieties of paddy rice and strenuously accelerate them. The scientists are arranged in detail to actively spread knowledge of advanced agricultural science and technology among agricultural workers directly responsible for the production of crops while engaged in scientific pursuits in the fields. They also study hard how the output of cereals can be increased in those areas damaged by salt a great deal. In addition, they rack their brains to improve the method of growing and planting young rice plants and killing noxious insects and establish the methods of scientifically raising their new-bred varieties of paddy rice. Rodong Sinmun

title: To Produce More "Taesongsan" Products of Better Quality
body: The labor and management of the Pyongyang Sports Goods Factory detailedly plan to set up the production processes of equipment and materials for winter athletic items and raise their quality to manufacture their superb “Taesongsan”-trademarked products in great numbers. On the other hand they give importance to producing them with their technology and raw and other materials available at home for themselves and recycling their wastes and do their utmost to do so. Rodong Sinmun

title: Superior Is Our Socialist Public Health System
body: President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il said that preventive medicine was fundamental to socialist medicine and ensured that the system of a doctor’s charge of families without precedent in the world was established for him or her to visit patients instead. This never slips the memory of our people despite the passage of time. True to their ideas, the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un said at the 8th Congress of the WPK that the general purpose of public health was to ensure that all the people could substantially benefit from the socialist health system and live in good health. Although they live in a remote mountain village or an out-of-the-way coast hamlet in our country everybody are cured by their doctors in charge even of their petty disease. In addition, doctors in charge take care of the health of working people at our mines, coal mines, factories and all other work places, too. Doctors make it a rule to visit common workers at their places of work, examine their health and adopt measures to give them medical treatment. Rodong Sinmun

title: Enthusiasm to Guarantee Production with Science and Technology
body: The officials, scientists and technicians of the Academy of Coal Science of the Ministry of Coal Industry are all out to dynamically step up the production of coal with their science and technology. The ACS makes good preparations for speedily introducing advanced science and technology into coal production in concert with the scientific institutes concerned. It also sets itself the goals of technological development which are important in giving priority to prospecting and tunneling, readjusting and reinforcing processes of coal cleaning and augmenting the output of gas flame coal. It actively encourages its scientists and technicians to rack their brains to achieve the goals. Besides, it studies hard how the speed of tunneling and the quality of coal can be raised. Rodong Sinmun

title: Source of Miracle
body: A few years ago the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un visited the Pyongyang Condiments Factory. While doing the rounds of it he was hugely delighted to be informed that its employees spruced up their workshops on their own. That day he remarked that it was of primary importance to inflame the spirit of the producer masses. He continued to say with great satisfaction that it was important for the PCF to have modernized its production processes and established cultured practices in its production and life but that it was more valuable than anything for it to have awakened the spirit of its producer masses and modernized itself on its own and that this was more powerful than a nuclear weapon. He is implicitly convinced that the more deeply our officials stir the hearts of the masses, the more greatly their spirit is inflamed and that the more firmly they are prepared for their work, the more rapidly the revolution is moved forward. Our officials can remarkably develop their sectors and units when they deeply implant the ideas and spirit of the 8th Congress of the WPK in the masses and inspire them to further great efforts by setting practical examples to them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Various Sectors of National Economy Fulfill Plan of January
body: In the sector of the metalworking industry officials and workers fulfilled their production plan on all indices in an endeavor to implement the decisions of the 8th Congress of the Workers’ Party of Korea. Above all, the Kim Chaek and Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complexes produced lots of pig iron over and above their plans. The Posan Iron Works and the Chongjin Steel Plant overfulfilled their production plans. The Chollima Steel Complex and the HISC tried their hardest to produce steel. The Hungnam Electrode Factory, the Jangsan and Hungsan Mines, the Puryong Ferroalloy Plant and many other units fulfilled their daily plans for the production of electrodes, fire bricks, graphite and ferrosilicon without fail and contributed actively to producing iron and steel. The workers and management of the Pyongyang General Electric Cable Factory 326, the Ryongsong Machine-building Complex, the Anju Pump Factory, the Mangyongdae and Kusong Machine Tool Factories and many other machine plants topped their production quotas for January. Those of the Sunchon Cement Complex and the Chonnaeri Cement Factory also worked selflessly to execute their cement production plans. The Kyongsong Ceramic Factory, too, carried out its national economic plan for January ahead of schedule. Rodong Sinmun

title: Congratulatory Messages and Letters to Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un from Different Countries
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received congratulatory messages and letters from different countries on the occasion of the Eighth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). They include the chairman of the Central Committee of the Nepal Worker-Peasant Party, the general secretary of the Patriotic Front of Zambia, the international secretary of the Brazilian Workers' Party, the first vice-chairman of the United Socialist Party of Venezuela, the director of the Asian Regional Institute of the Juche Idea, the co-chairman of the Asia-Pacific Regional Committee for Supporting Peaceful Reunification of Korea and other personages of political, public and economic circles in China, Nepal, Mongolia, Pakistan, the Philippines, Japan, Belarus, the UK, Zambia, Equatorial Guinea, Tunisia, Brazil, New Zealand and Australia, and representatives of organizations for the study of the Juche idea, organizations for supporting Korea's reunification and friendship organizations. Meanwhile, the Central Committee of the WPK received congratulatory messages from the general secretary of the Central Committee of the All-India Forward Bloc and the vice-chairman in charge of the international issue of the United Socialist Party of Venezuela, and the general secretary of the Socialist Party of Senegal sent a congratulatory message to the Eighth Congress of the WPK. Rodong Sinmun

title: New Posters Produced to Accelerate Socialist Construction
body: The Mansudae Art Studio, the Korean Central Fine Arts Studio, Pyongyang University of Fine Arts and the Art Studio of the Ministry of Railways have recently produced posters accelerating the all-people drive for implementing the decisions made at the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea. Reflected in the posters are the idea of laying firm guarantee for reenergizing the overall economy and improving the people's living standard by developing the metal and chemical industry, the twin pillars of self-supporting economy, and the need to invigorate key industries including electricity, coal and machine industries in order to further strengthen the economic potentials and might and accelerate the overall economic construction. There are posters calling for making a radical improvement in transport and waging a mass movement for afforestation and water-conservation. Posters also represent the Party's people-first principle and call for developing science and technology and bringing about a radical improvement in education in the new century. The posters will add to the zeal of all the people for the revolution and struggle for hastening a fresh victory of Korean-style socialism by fulfilling without fail the five-year plan for national economic development put forth at the Party Congress. Rodong Sinmun

title: New Year Cards and Greetings to Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un from Different Countries
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received New Year cards and greetings from heads of states, leaders of political parties and personages of different countries on the occasion of the New Year Juche 110 (2021). Kim Jong Un received New Year cards from the first secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba, the president of the Republic of the Union of Myanmar, the president of the Republic of India and the president of the Republic of Guinea and his wife. He also received a New Year card from the state counselor of the Republic of the Union of Myanmar and greetings from the director-general of FAO. Meanwhile, the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea received a congratulatory message from the chairman and the secretary general of the Central Board of the Party of the Functional Groups of Indonesia. Rodong Sinmun

title: Major Economic Sectors Complete Their January Assignments
body: Those workers and management engaged in the field of the chemical industry carried out their production assignments for January. Those of the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex patently formulated the targets for the growth of their fertilizer production for the period of the new 5-year plan, made preparations for the technological refashioning of many processes and vigorously sped up their current production. The result is that they hit their production target for January without fail. The Namhung Youth Chemical Complex, the February 8 Vinalon Complex and many other chemical plants did their utmost for their production and met their quotas for January. The officials, workers and technicians of thermal power stations across the country went all out to boost their electricity production and admirably achieved the goals for the production of their electricity for January. The labor and management of the Pukchang Thermal Power Complex tried their hardest to operate their equipment thoroughly according to the method of standard operation, thus responsibly carrying out their daily production assignments. The officials, workers and technicians of the Pyongyang Thermal Power Complex devoted themselves entirely to increasing the output of their steam and satisfactorily ensuring the efficiency of their generation equipment. The workers of the Sunchon, Chongchongang and Pyongyang Thermal Power Stations mobilized their reserves and potentials to the maximum and actively applied valuable technological innovations to their production, thereby operating all their machines at full capacity. In the railway sector workers and management overfulfilled their transport quotas for January. The Pyongyang Railway Bureau adroitly coupled its locomotives and freight cars and directed their running so as to satisfactorily transport goods and materials. Meanwhile, it consolidated the material and technological foundations for its transportation. The Hamhung Railway Bureau also did all it could to transport as much freight as possible. The Kaechon, Chongjin and Rason Railway Bureaus increased their rail transport considerably despite their manifold difficulties fully convinced that their materials transport led to the production of the nation. Rodong Sinmun

title: Many People Visit Venue of National Photo, Book and Art Exhibition
body: There took place a national photo, book and art exhibition for celebrating the Eighth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) at the Korean Art Gallery from December 23 last year to January 31. Officials and working people of many units visited the venue of the exhibition. Exhibited at the venue of the exhibition were photos and art works dealing with the history of revolutionary activities of the peerlessly great men who brought about great victories and gigantic changes with their extraordinary wisdom and outstanding leadership, and works dealing with their immortal ideological and theoretical feats. Also exhibited there were photos, books and art pieces showing the heroic spirit of the Korean people who are advancing with confidence to realize the ideal for building a powerful country, firmly united behind the Party, and the history of Juche Korea characterized by creation and innovations. Photos of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un guiding the fifth and sixth plenary meetings of the 7th Central Committee of the WPK helped the visitors recollect with deep emotion his great devotion and efforts. Also on display to highlight the significance of the exhibition were more than 10 000 books and magazines of 6 000 kinds including the classical works dealing with the ideological and theoretical exploits of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. Through the visits, officials and working people renewed their pledge to thoroughly implement the important tasks set forth at the historic Eighth Congress of the Party, true to the guidance of the great Party Central Committee leading Korean-style socialism to a new victory. Rodong Sinmun

title: Different Sectors of National Economy Complete Their January Assignments
body: The coal mines of the Sunchon and Pukchang Area Youth Coal Mining Complexes carried out their production goals for January ahead of schedule by concentrating their efforts on tunneling on the one hand and mobilizing their existing production potentials to the maximum on the other. The Ministry of Light Industry achieved its production goal for January on dozens of indices. The Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill and the Sinuiju, Sariwon, Kusong and September Textile Mills fulfilled their daily production plans, considerably topped the goals for the production of their spun yarn and general cloth by January 30 through a dynamic socialist emulation for increased production. The Bureau of Sericulture and Silk Industry effectively mobilized and enlisted its production potentials, thus boosting the production of its general cloth and silk yarn. The sectors of the knitting industry and the footwear industry explored and enlisted their internal reserves and potentials to the full and went all out for their products, thereby carrying out their production goals for January. In the fields of the daily necessities industry and the foodstuff industry factories won the goals for the production of their knitwear, hosiery, footwear, toothbrushes, toilet soap, cosmetics, etc for January on tens of indices. Those workers and management engaged in the sphere of the lumber industry felled great numbers of trees and thus admirably topped their lumber production plan for January. The labor and management of mines, factories and enterprises in the Tanchon area scored their production goals for January on important indices. Rodong Sinmun

title: Great Efforts Made to Produce Quality Accessories
body: The workers and management of tractor parts factories nationwide are all out to supply cooperative farms with high-quality accessories for tractors. Those of the Haeju Tractor Parts Factory make great efforts to solidify its material and technological foundations further exploring and enlisting their reserves and potentials. Those of the Sariwon Tractor Parts Factory, too, almost finish making preferential technological preparations for producing their accessories which have grown in kind. Those of the Jongju Tractor Parts Factory and its other counterparts also do their shares responsibly. Rodong Sinmun

title: To Solidify Foundations of Higher Technical Middle Schools
body: Kowon County fully exerts itself to strengthen the material and technological foundations of its higher technical middle schools and raise the quality of their education. Drawing on experiences in and lessons of its last year’s work it maps out an extensive detailed plan to bring about a fresh change in the education of its higher technical middle schools this year and puts it in execution. The schools lay the main emphasis on raising the educative level of their majors for their children and consistently try to improve the qualifications of their teachers. Rodong Sinmun

title: Painstaking Efforts to Improve Their Qualifications
body: In Phyongchon District the officials and counselors of a refresher training center for teachers ensure that their in-service trainees from schools at all levels master subjects on their curricula. This enables them to guard against the protracted emergency anti-epidemic work and yet give effective lessons to their charges while visiting with them at home. Rodong Sinmun

title: Central Measuring Science Institute Marks Its 70th Birthday
body: The Central Measuring Science Institute marked its 70th founding anniversary. President Kim Il Sung opened up a new history of scientific measuring in our country by founding the Central Measuring Science Institute. He made sure that it was provided with huge funds needed for equipping itself with measuring tools of international standards during the grim Fatherland Liberation War and in the post-war period. He clearly indicated the way to be followed by the institute in every period of socialist construction. Chairman Kim Jong Il sent modern measuring tools and equipment to the institute and wisely led it to develop Korean-style measuring tools by its own efforts. The Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) tasked the field of measuring science and research with making a tangible contribution to raising the quality of products and structures by studying and developing ultra-modern measuring tools and updating inspection methods, as required by the building of a powerful socialist country. For the past 70 years, the institute has fully discharged its duty, writing a proud history of creation and innovation under the guidance of the WPK. A meeting took place on Monday to convey a congratulatory message from the WPK Central Committee to the scientists, technicians and employees of the institute. It was attended by Choe Sang Gon, secretary of the WPK Central Committee, Ri Chung Gil, chairman of the State Commission of Science and Technology, and officials and employees of the institute. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Floral Basket from Lao Embassy
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a floral basket from the Lao embassy here upon his election as general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and on the occasion of the New Year Juche 110 (2021) and the Lunar New Year's Day. The floral basket was conveyed to an official concerned by the Lao ambassador on February 3. A congratulatory letter to Kim Jong Un from the Lao ambassador was also handed over on the same day. Rodong Sinmun

title: 12th Plenary Meeting of 9th Central Committee of Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League Held
body: There took place the 12th Plenary Meeting of the 9th Central Committee of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League here on Wednesday. Present there were members and alternate members of the central committee of the youth league. Put on the agenda were the issue of thoroughly implementing the decisions made at the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea, the issue of convening the 10th Congress of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League, etc. Proposed at the meeting was a draft resolution on the first agenda item. The participants studied in depth the draft resolution with the zeal to further develop the youth league, a relay and reserve for the Party, into invincible ranks strong in organizing ability, united force and fighting efficiency and into vanguard ranks remaining unfailingly faithful to the cause of the Party, as indicated by the historic Party Congress. Discussion comprehensively analyzed and reviewed the faults latent in the work of the youth league and their causes and lessons. It suggested innovative opinions for conducting all activities in a fresh and spirited way, as required by the duty and characteristics of the youth league as an ideological and educational organization and by the developing times. Speakers stressed the need to energetically wage an ideological offensive for equipping all officials and members of the youth league with the line and policies set forth by the Party Congress and continuously improve the contents, forms and methods of the five-point education with education in the greatness of the peerlessly great men as its keynote. They called for further inspiring the enthusiastic youth through vigorous mass movements and achieving great successes by planning and conducting all the work in a big and bold way. Hearing the speeches, the participants recollected the work of their units according to the idea and spirit of the Party Congress and exchanged their opinions for the development. A relevant resolution was adopted with unanimous approval based on a full study on the first agenda item and the positive discussion by the participants. The plenary meeting discussed the second agenda item and decided on the convening of the 10th Congress of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League early in April, Juche 110(2021). Rodong Sinmun

title: 10th Congress of Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League to Be Held
body: The 12th Plenary Meeting of the 9th Central Committee of the youth league decided to convene the 10th Congress of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League to firmly prepare the youths to be successors to and reserves of the Party and further strengthen the organizations of the youth league into the powerful forces of the socialist construction. According to a decision, the 10th Congress of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League is to be held in Pyongyang early in April, Juche 110 (2021). The coming congress will serve as a significant occasion for the youth league to demonstrate more highly its fighting efficiency as the advancing group, wing and contingent of warriors of the Party in the advance for successfully carrying out the struggle goal and tasks set forth at the historic 8th Congress of the Party and to provide a new landmark in the development of the Juche-oriented youth movement. Rodong Sinmun

title: 10th Plenary Meeting of Sixth Central Committee of
body: Socialist Women's Union of Korea Held The 10th Plenary Meeting of the Sixth Central Committee of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea (SWUK) was held here on Wednesday. Present there were members and alternate members of the SWUK Central Committee. Put on the agenda were the fundamental issues facing the women's union, an outer organization of the Party, to thoroughly implement the important tasks set forth by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un in his report on the work of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) at the Eighth Congress of the WPK. The plenary meeting firstly suggested a draft resolution for thoroughly implementing the decisions made at the Eighth Congress of the WPK, and deeply studied and discussed it. On the basis of their deep understanding of the struggle tasks and ways set forth at the Party Congress, all the participants studied the draft resolution with the main stress put on taking substantial measures for strengthening the organizations of the women's union at all levels into the powerful force for the socialist construction. A relevant resolution was adopted on the basis of the in-depth study and discussion and the detailed and correct methodology worked out in a realistic way for making a fundamental turn in the work. The plenary meeting discussed and decided on convening of the Seventh Congress of the SWUK. Rodong Sinmun

title: To Take Thorough Measures for Water Supply
body: The officials and agricultural workers of Kangwon Province strive mightily to readjust and reinforce their irrigation system. Anbyon and Cholwon Counties have set about repairing their reservoirs and damming their rivers to convert them into reservoirs. Thongchon County and other cities and counties, too, make detailed preparations for repairing their irrigation setups. The soldiers of the Korean People’s Army energetically help the people in their repairs. They make a breakthrough in repairs on reservoirs and their reinforcement rationally using various kinds of their motor vehicles and undertaking difficult work assignments. Thongchon and Phangyo Counties and other districts also do their possible to secure materials under their detailed plans to readjust and reinforce their irrigation systems and facilities. Rodong Sinmun

title: New Records Set in the Waterway Construction Site
body: The construction of the Hwangjugindung Waterway enables its Hwangjugindung Plain and the farmland of Yonthan County to be satisfactorily irrigated with ample water from Lake Yonthan using none of power equipment and pumping machines and yet economizing on electricity. The officials of the Central Headquarters for the construction of the waterway are out to boldly introduce advanced building methods into the laying of the waterway. The central headquarters exerted itself to devise and make efficient construction equipment. The brigades of South Phyongan, Jagang and South Hamgyong Provinces and Pyongyang plus all other units make great strides in their building operations. Rodong Sinmun

title: Making Successive Innovations the Way They Completed Their January Assignments
body: In the realm of the extractive industry labor and management go all out to implement the decisions of the 8th Congress of the Workers’ Party of Korea. Consequently, they admirably hit their production target for January. The workers and management of the December 5 Youth Mine topped their production assignments for January in excess of their quotas. To this end they boosted their mineral output by actively applying rational methods to their work and responsibly putting their ore conveyors in normal operation. Those of the Phungnyon, Jungsan, Yongyu, Sijung, Ssangryong and Riwon Mines and many other mines also gave themselves body and soul to achieving their daily mineral production goals. Those of the Munphyong Smeltery scored their daily and weekly production goals without fail operating their rotary furnace and other machines at full capacity. In addition, the officials, workers and technicians of the Taedonggang Storage Battery Factory and many other units worked unselfishly by the sweat of their brows to win their production target for January. The officials and workers of the Sangwon Cement Complex achieved their cement production goal for January. The officials, workers and technicians of the Sunghori Cement Factory took good technological care of their machines and put them in great operation so as to register successes in their cement production. The workers of the Onchon Granite Mine put their machines in normal operation with the utmost enthusiasm. The Pyongyang Cast Iron Pipe Factory made great efforts to rationally allocate its manpower and transport its raw materials with speed, thereby topping the production of its building parts to excess every day. The Pyongyang Metal Building Materials Factory, the Pyongyang Chemical Building Materials Factory and the Pyongyang Plastic Building Materials Factory secured plenty of spare parts and stepped up their production at full steam. Other units, too, carried out their production goals for January overcoming their trials and hardships tenaciously. The workers and management of the Forestry Complex 121 dynamically buckled down to their work from the beginning of this year and ultimately hit its lumber production target for January. Rodong Sinmun

title: Top Priority Given to Consolidating Foundations of Agricultural Production
body: The agricultural officials of North Hwanghae Province aimed at face-lifting the agricultural science and technology learning spaces of its cooperative farms in an endeavor to spread advanced farming technology and kindle the fierce flames of scientific farm work among agricultural workers. They strive mightily to ensure that its production centers for organic compound manure and recycled vinyl sheets prove their great worth. Moreover, they produce high-yielding varieties of crops for a far wider area of their fields than before and process and treat their seeds qualitatively so as to supply the cities and counties of their province with them. In addition, they procure various kinds of liquid nutrients, growth promoters and germicides amply with a view to the future. Rodong Sinmun

title: 11th Plenary Meeting of 8th C.C., UAWK Held
body: The 11th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea (UAWK) was held in Pyongyang on Feb. 4. Attending the plenary meeting were members of the UAWK Central Committee. As the first agenda item, the meeting discussed the thorough implementation of the decisions made at the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). After a serious study of the draft resolution on the first agenda item, the participants had discussions on the practical ways to bring about a fundamental turn in the UAWK's work. During the discussions, the shortcomings, lessons and causes drawn in the work of UAWK in the past were analyzed and constructive opinions for improving its work as required by the times and the developing revolution were raised. Speakers expressed their will to wage an intensive information and publicity campaign for firmly arming all the UAWK officials and members with the main idea and main spirit of the Party Congress and thus make the whole union pulsate with the struggle for implementing the decisions made at the Party Congress. They underscored the need for the union organizations to give impetus to the agricultural production in the period of the new five-year plan for national economic development by setting it as a main task to bring about a radical turn in seed selection, do farming in a scientific way, increase the yield in the low-yielding fields and cultivate new land, and by powerfully conducting a dynamic mass movement awakening the revolutionary zeal of agricultural workers. The meeting adopted the resolution on the first agenda item with unanimous approval. The plenary meeting discussed and decided on convening the 9th UAWK Congress as the second agenda item. Before the discussion on the agenda items, the plenary meeting recalled Kim Chang Yop in consideration of his age and elected Han Jong Hyok as chairman of the UAWK Central Committee. Rodong Sinmun

title: 10th Plenary Meeting of 7th Central Committee of GFTUK Held
body: The 10th plenary meeting of the 7th Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea (GFTUK) took place in Pyongyang on February 4. Present there were members of the GFTUK Central Committee. The plenary meeting discussed ways of fully displaying the might of GFTUK in the struggle for implementing the important tasks set forth at the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). The draft resolution for implementing the decisions of the Party Congress was distributed and speeches were made after a deep study of and discussion on it. Speakers comprehensively and deeply analyzed and reviewed the achievements, shortcomings and lessons drawn in the past five year's GFTUK work on the basis of the main idea and main spirit of the 8th Party Congress. They expressed their will to conduct in a dynamic way the work for imbuing the whole GFTUK with the revolutionary idea of the Party and to fulfil the responsibility and duty of its organizations in the efforts for carrying out the new five-year plan for the national economic development. Discussed at the plenary meeting were the ways for GFTUK organizations to vigorously wage various mass movements, including the socialist emulation drive, and thus kindle the flame of collective innovation and raise the hot wind of creating new standards and hitting new records among all sectors and units of the national economy. After the deep study and discussion at the meeting, the resolution on thoroughly implementing the important tasks set forth at the Party Congress was adopted with unanimous approval. The plenary meeting also discussed and decided on the convening of the 8th Congress of the GFTUK. Before discussing agenda items, the plenary meeting recalled Ju Yong Gil in consideration of his age and elected Pak In Chol as chairman of the GFTUK Central Committee. Rodong Sinmun

title: 100,000 Cubic Meter Earth Blown Up
body: The General Tideland Reclamation Enterprise of North Phyongan Province blasted a mountain by 200,000 tons last January and then proceeded to blow up another mountain by 100,000 tons in Osong on February 1, thereby becoming able to accelerate the reclamation of the Woldo tideland in full swing. It is now exerting itself to put all its motor vehicles in full motion. Rodong Sinmun

title: To Raise Efficiency of Generating Equipment
body: The Ministry of Electric Power Industry maintains and reinforces the defective production processes and equipment of its power stations qualitatively and steps up their technological reconstruction. The Pukchang Thermal Power Complex maintains its fifth boiler on schedule. The Pyongyang Thermal Power Complex and many other thermal power stations make full-scale preparations for enhancing the efficiency of their power generation assembly. The sector of hydroelectric power generation intensively contemplates and discusses raising the efficiency of hydropower stations definitely by modernizing control apparatus for generators and including all hydropower stations in an integrated power management system. Rodong Sinmun

title: Happiness the Blessed System Brought to Her
body: Pak Yong Hui gave birth to a son at the Pyongyang MaternityHospital at the end of last January. She is a disabled female soldier whodwells in Mangyongdae-dong, Mangyongdae District, Pyongyang. She did not at all believe that she could be a mother because sheis paralyzed in the lower half of her body. All the doctors of the maternity hospital took very warm care ofher and devoted themselves wholly to enabling her to have an easy delivery. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Wreath to Bier of Late Ri Jae Il
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un sent a wreath to the bier of Ri Jae Il, ex-advisor to the Information and Publicity Department of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and recipient of Order of Kim Il Sung and Order of Kim Jong Il and title of Labor Hero, to express deep condolences over his death. While working at the Party Central Committee for a long period, Ri Jae Il, who grew into a strong-willed and competent political activist under the care of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, performed distinguished feats in the field of the Party ideological work, true to the idea and cause of the leaders. The wreath sent by Kim Jong Un was placed at the bier of the deceased on Friday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Wreath to Bier of Late Choe Ki Hyok
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un sent a wreath to the bier of the late People's Artiste Choe Ki Hyok, music master of the National Symphony Orchestra, expressing deep condolences over his death. Choe Ki Hyok, who grew up to be a violinist of a prestigious art group under the care of our Party, contributed to developing the Juche symphony for over 50 years by performing and creating lots of famous pieces of music of the times including symphonic series "Song to the Party". The wreath was placed before the bier of the deceased on Feb. 4. Rodong Sinmun

title: Finding the Resources and Methods on Their Own
body: The light industry factories of South Phyongan Province make extensive endeavors to enliven their production. The Phyongsong Artificial Leather Factory exerted itself to bring about technological innovations in reducing the power consumption of their equipment and finally registered good successes in it. In addition, it does its best to introduce new technologies into the production of its goods with domestic raw materials and finds out more reserves for its recycling. The workers and management of the Sunchon Leather Shoes Factory adopted the methods of economizing on their crude rubber, vinyl chloride and plasticizers. But, without resting contented with this they make great efforts to use waste rubber for their production. Those of the Paeksong Combined Foodstuff Factory effectively use their local raw materials and dynamically refashion and modernize their equipment with the help of their technicians, thereby boosting the production of their foodstuffs. The cities and counties of SPP compete with each other to energize the production of their light industrial factories. Rodong Sinmun

title: Believing That Nothing Is a Waste
body: The labor and management of the Haeju Tractor Parts Factory turned out more than 6,000 accessories of tens of kinds last January. The HTPF made efforts to recycle the chips and scraps from the production of its accessories. Besides, it awakened its employees to the fact that their economy led to their production and convinced them to maximize their increased production and economy. The result was that the HTPF obtained fresh results in producing its spare parts. Rodong Sinmun

title: In Pursuit of Sustained Progress
body: The workers and management of the Hungsan Mine topped their graphite production goal for January in excess of their quotas and have since continued to score high results in their production this month, too. The HM refashioned its pneumatic machine-aided flotation flowsheets so that their air passage can go past the exterior of a flotation machine. This has lowered the attrition rate of their accessories and yet raised the output of their graphite. Consequently, the HM hit its graphite production target for January. Furthermore, it reduced the production cost of its graphite and increased both its output and tenor thanks to the prolonged life of the accessories of its flotation flowsheets. Rodong Sinmun

title: Endeavors for Timber Production
body: The workers of the Hoeryong Timber Production Station achieved their production goal for January to excess despite their adversities. Its transport workteam made much use of its motor vehicles, thus transporting its lumber in greater numbers every day than before. All the employees of forestry stations countrywide conduct an energetic socialist emulation to fulfill their yearly lumber production plans in mountains and thereby register innovative successes in their production. Rodong Sinmun

title: By Dint of Technical Innovation
body: The labor and management of the Rahung Railway Factory bring about great technological innovations in their work and strengthen the foundations for their production. The technicians and skilled workers of the RRF stand in the van of its employees. The RRF effects dynamic technological innovations in setting up a process for the production of its high-quality welding rods and makes advances in solidifying the foundations for its production. Rodong Sinmun

title: Go-ahead Innovators Out to Augment Their Electricity Output
body: The workers and management of the Sunchon Thermal Power Station try hard to apply technological innovations of great realistic importance in putting their boilers in optimal operation, find out the reserves for their increased production and operate their power generation assembly at great capacity. They have just begun to boost the output of their electricity and have much work to do to this end. But they tenaciously push ahead with their production scheme. Rodong Sinmun

title: 2nd Plenary Meeting of 8th C.C., WPK to Be Held
body: The Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) decided to convene the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Party within the first ten days of February to examine and decide the 2021 working plans of all fields for thoroughly carrying out the strategic tasks set forth at the 8th Congress of the WPK. A relevant resolution of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK was issued on Saturday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Funeral for Late Ri Jae Il Held
body: There was a funeral for Ri Jae Il, ex-advisor to the Information and Publicity Department of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and recipient of Order of Kim Il Sung and Order of Kim Jong Il and the title of Labor Hero, at the Sojang Club on Saturday. The funeral was attended by officials of the Central Committee of the WPK, officials concerned and bereaved family members of the deceased. The participants and the bereaved family members offered a moment's silence for the deceased before the coffin left. A motor vehicle with the coffin left for the Patriotic Martyrs Cemetery in Sinmi-ri where the funeral service was held. Kwon Hyok Bong, vice department director of the WPK Central Committee, made a funeral speech. He said that Ri Jae Il, who was raised to be a competent Party official and a political activist under the deep trust and loving care shown by the peerlessly great men, rendered devoted services to defending the undying feats performed by Chairman Kim Jong Il for the Party ideological work and to thoroughly establishing the monolithic leadership system of the Party Central Committee in the whole Party and society at an important historic time of carrying out the revolutionary cause of Juche. He went on: Upon the news of his death, Marshal Kim Jong Un, feeling pain in the chest more than anyone, taught one issue after another in holding the funeral ceremony and made sure that his remains were buried in the Patriotic Martyrs Ceremony. Ri Jae Il who worked with total dedication to the strengthening of the Party and to the victory of the socialist cause will always be remembered. The remains of the deceased were buried. A wreath from the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un was placed before the grave. Wreaths in the names of departments of the WPK Central Committee, the Ministry of Culture and other institutions were placed. The participants observed a moment's silence for the deceased. Rodong Sinmun

title: Concentrating Efforts on the Main Link
body: The officials and agricultural workers of North Hamgyong Province make substantial preparations for their farm work for this year focusing their main efforts on it. Its provincial rural economic committee got detailed firsthand knowledge of the actual conditions of its cooperative farms. On this basis it demands strictly that they carry out their daily work goals without fail. It also adopts measures to ensure that they channel their primary efforts on enriching their fields which were damaged by typhoon last year. The cooperative farms of NHP make energetic endeavors to implement the decisions of the 8th Congress of the Workers’ Party of Korea. Their members and management carry to their fields by vehicle the quality barnyard manure they mass-produced. Besides, they use their tractors and other vehicles as effectively as possible for transporting lots of their compost to their fields and stacking it there heaps on heaps. NHP is all out to produce many pumping machines and cultivators for its cooperative farms. Rodong Sinmun

title: The Way They Fulfilled Their January Assignments
body: In South Phyongan Province medium- and small-sized power stations hit their electricity production targets for January and have since gone on with their work without cease. The Ryongsan Youth Power Station registers high results in the production of its electricity by responsibly managing its equipment and preferentially examining and repairing its waterpower structures to harness much water from the upper reaches of the Taedong River. The Sunchon Barrage Power Station actively adopts rational working methods and effectively maintains its equipment, thereby stepping up the production of its electricity on a normal footing. The Taegak Youth Power Station, too, does all it can to produce more electricity than usual despite no change in its circumstances. Rodong Sinmun

title: Encouraging Letters Sent to Service Personnel
body: On the occasion of the 73rd anniversary of the founding of the heroic Korean People's Army (KPA), all the Korean people are extending their warm congratulations and inspiring greetings to the service personnel who are defending the security of the country. The young people in the capital city extended their sincere thanks to the service personnel for fully discharging their sacred mission and duty of defending the country, people and revolution, remaining true to the leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. The young people in all other parts of the country, in their letters, pledged to demonstrate their might as the vanguard and shock brigade in the building of a powerful socialist country with the mind that they are standing in the same trench with the service personnel devotedly implementing the plans of the Party Central Committee. The women, too, in their letters wished the service personnel, who are glorifying the precious youth with arms, good health and success in military service. The women across the country asked the service personnel to reliably defend their posts while conveying the news of the rear where they are glorifying the days of loyalty and feats. Reading the letters, the service personnel kept in mind again their mission as the defender of the country and the creator of the people's happiness, and vowed to take the lead in upholding the Party's people-first politics. Rodong Sinmun

title: State Academic Degrees and Titles Conferred on Intellectuals
body: State academic degrees and titles were conferred on meritorious intellectuals on the occasion of the Day of the Shining Star. The intellectuals achieved research successes conducive to the economic development of the country and improvement of the standard of the people's living and made tangible contributions to the education of the rising generation. According to a decision of the State Commission for Conferment of Academic Degrees and Titles, professorship was conferred on Jo Myong Bong, department head of Kim Il Sung University, Kim Kil Nam, department director of Kim Chaek University of Technology, Choe Nam Sun, department head of Kim Hyong Jik University of Education, and others. Doctorate went to 45 persons including Kim Kwang Min, vice dean of a faculty of Kim Il Sung University, Kim Myong Chan, department head of Kim Chaek University of Technology, So Hak Chol, department head of Kim Hyong Jik University of Education, Ro Chol Yon, department head of Kim Chol Ju University of Education, and Jong Chol Song, vice department head of University of National Economy. 188 persons received associate professorship, and 1 011 master's degree. Rodong Sinmun

title: 2nd Plenary Meeting of 8th WPK Central Committee Held
body: First-day Sitting Held All the Party members and other people across the country, much encouraged by the practical programme for struggle and advance set forth at the historic 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), are full of confidence and enthusiasm to dynamically advance towards a fresh victory in the socialist construction by tiding over current challenges and difficulties by dint of single-minded unity and self-reliance under the leadership of the great Party. According to the decision of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the WPK was convened to consider and decide on the Juche 110 (2021) plan of sectors at all levels for thoroughly implementing the strategic tasks set forth at the 8th Party Congress. The 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th WPK Central Committee to indicate the road of the great struggle was held on February 8 amid expectation and concern of all the Party members. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, guided the plenary meeting. Attending the meeting were members and alternate members of the WPK Central Committee. Present as observers were vice directors of the relevant departments of the Party Central Committee, leading Party and administrative officials of commissions, ministries and national institutions, senior officials of the leading institutions at provincial level, chief secretaries of the city and county Party committees and leading Party and administrative officials of major industrial establishments. The General Secretary appeared at the platform of the meeting with members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee to guide the plenary meeting. All the participants raised stormy cheers of "hurrah!" for the General Secretary who set a new goal for significant advance of the socialist construction with his outstanding idea and seasoned leadership art and wisely leads the historic advance of our people along the road of victory. At the meeting the General Secretary referred to the main purport of convening the plenary meeting of the Party Central Committee, appreciating that the readiness and fighting spirit of officials, Party members and other people have remarkably grown and our revolution has firmly moved to the fresh stage of development with the 8th Party Congress as an occasion. The General Secretary analyzed that positive and clear changes are being made among the Party members in their political consciousness and way of thinking in the course of the Party-wide acceptance and intensive study of the documents of the Party Congress. He added that the correct dissemination of the idea and spirit of the 8th Congress of the Party throughout the Party, through which the new fighting programme won the sympathy of the Party's rank and file, means the provision of the most valuable asset for a new victory of the socialist construction. Saying that the Party Central Committee should powerfully lead the masses to the implementation of the decisions made at the Party Congress by valuing their elated spirit and giving further momentum to their enthusiasm, he stressed the need to provide the Party organizations and members with practical means for innovation which would help bring about practical change and substantial progress from the first year of the five-year plan. He said that as the decisions made at the Party Congress are mid-and long-term tasks to be fulfilled by all sectors during the coming five years, it is necessary to examine this year's plans down to details at the plenary meeting and fix and issue them as the decisions of the Party Central Committee. He evinced the determination and will of the Party Central Committee to take important measures to push forward the economic construction and provide the people with more stable and improved living conditions despite the persistent emergency anti-epidemic situation. He proposed agenda items to be discussed at the plenary meeting, underscoring the need to make a serious study of a series of issues arising in thoroughly overcoming negative elements obstructing the socialist construction at present, further consolidating the Party organizationally and ideologically and enhancing the militant function and role of the Party organizations. The plenary meeting passed the agenda items with unanimous approval. Kim Jong Un began an important report on thoroughly implementing the first year's tasks of the five-year plan set forth by the 8th Party Congress. The report sharply criticized the passive and self-protecting tendencies revealed by the state economic guidance organs in the course of setting this year's goals, and stressed the principled matters for overcoming the tendencies and organizing the economic work in an innovative and meticulous way. Setting forth the tasks of different fields of the national economy, the report detailed the need to push forward with the production of iron and steel and chemical fertilizer by concentrating investment on the metal and chemical industries which were set as the main link in the chain of national economy, and to stoutly accelerate the work of expanding the production capacity on the basis of a scientific guarantee. It also indicated important goals to be achieved this year by key industrial fields including electric power and coal industries and by the fields of railway transport, construction and building materials, light industry and commerce, and practical ways to attain them. Listening to the report made by the General Secretary, the participants reproached themselves for failing to apply the idea and spirit of the Party Congress to the first year's operation for implementing the new five-year plan and not living up to the high expectation of the Party and the people. All the participants are carefully listening to the report by the General Secretary, keenly feeling how they should think and exert their efforts to discharge their important responsibilities as leading officials of the revolution in the present crucial period aspiring after fresh innovation, courageous creation and steady progress. The plenary meeting goes on. Political News Team

title: Floral Tribute to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Service personnel of the Korean People's Army (KPA) and working people laid floral baskets and bouquets at the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in different parts of the country on the occasion of the Day of Army Founding. Placed before the statues on Mansu Hill were bouquets and floral baskets in the names of the Party, power and armed forces organs, public organizations, ministries, national institutions, units of the KPA and the Public Security Forces (PSF), and institutions, industrial establishments and universities at all levels in Pyongyang. The visitors made a deep bow to the statues. Floral baskets in the names of KPA and PSF units, institutions, enterprises, etc. and bouquets were also laid at the statues of the great leaders and the mosaics of their smiling images in different parts of Pyongyang, including Kim Il Sung Military University, the Ministry of National Defence, the Ministry of Public Security and the Mansudae Art Studio. Servicepersons and working people in other parts of the country visited the statues of the great leaders and the mosaics of their smiling images in their residential quarters to pay homage. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Reply Message from General Secretary of C.C., CPV
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), received a reply message from Nguyen Phu Trong, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam (CPV) and president of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, on February 2. In the message, Nguyen Phu Trong on behalf of the party, state and people of Vietnam and on his own behalf expressed sincere thanks to Kim Jong Un and, through him, to the Party, leadership and people of the DPRK as regards the congratulatory message sent to the 13th Congress of the CPV by the WPK Central Committee and splendid congratulations sent to him by Kim Jong Un upon his reelection as general secretary of the Central Committee of the CPV. The message said that the excellent congratulations serve as a great courage to them wishing to build a developed country following the direction of socialism as soon as possible by advancing ceaselessly and vigorously along the road of making renovation and building and safeguarding a powerful country. It hoped that the two parties and two countries would continue to cooperate further closely and develop creditably the friendly and cooperative relations of the long-standing tradition between Vietnam and the DPRK in the interests of the peoples of the two countries and for regional and global peace, stability and prosperity. It wished the General Secretary happiness in good health and the DPRK bigger successes in accomplishing the cause of building a prosperous powerful country and providing people with happiness under the leadership of the WPK headed by the General Secretary. Rodong Sinmun

title: Second-day Sitting of 2nd Plenary Meeting of 8th WPK Central Committee Held
body: The 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) for discussing the crucial issues of key importance in implementing the decisions of the 8th Congress of the WPK continued on February 9. The second-day sitting of the plenary meeting was held amid a high sense of Party responsibility and unusual awareness of all the participants to surely bring about a remarkable improvement in this year's economic work and people's standard of living, bearing in mind once again the urgent requirements of the Party and the revolution. Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, continued his report on the first agenda item. The report set forth this year's tasks for different sectors including economy and culture, and importantly referred to the issue of enhancing the role of the state organs for economic guidance to carry them out. It put forward the tasks for the fishing sector to put the fishing and aquatic farming on a regular basis so as to provide people with more marine products. Referring to the works to be implemented this year in the fields of communications, land and environment and city management to provide convenient and civilized living condition to people, it stressed the need for the external economic sector to carry out innovative and reasonable plans from the stand of protecting the country's economy and consolidating its independence. Attentively listening to the General Secretary's enthusiastic report indicating the audacious plans and lucid ways for courageously overcoming manifold hardships and bringing about a revolutionary turn in the economic construction and improvement of the people's living, the participants in the meeting were convinced of successes in the work for this year and engaged themselves in listening to his report with main focus put on the plans of their sectors. Saying that propping up agriculture is an important state affair that must be successful at any cost to solve the food problem for the people and successfully push ahead with the socialist construction, the General Secretary analyzed the achievements and experience gained in the agricultural field for the recent several years and set forth tasks of stably and steadily developing the agricultural production based on them. Emphasized in the report were the issues of taking prompt state measures for supplying farming materials on which success or failure of farming for this year hinges for the present, pushing ahead with the work of providing a material and technical foundation for the agricultural production in a planned way and bringing about a decisive improvement in the Party work in the rural areas. Reconfirming the importance of raising the role of science and technology as a traction engine, the report called for directing special efforts to solving scientific and technological problems demanding an urgent solution in consolidating the existent economic foundation and improving the standard of people's living, actively developing core and strategic latest technologies and building up the scientific research force, scientific and technical talents. It clarified detailed instructions calling for bringing about evident improvement and innovation in the field of cultural construction including education, public health, literature and art, media and sports, further displaying the advantages of our own-style socialism and making sure that the revolutionary and optimistic fighting spirit prevails in the whole society. The General Secretary in the report evinced the militant tasks to be carried out by the People's Army and the munitions industry this year for implementing the decisions set forth by the 8th Party Congress, and the direction of future action to be taken by the sector in charge of affairs with south Korea and the sector in charge of external affairs, before underscoring the need to thoroughly carry them out without fail. The report noted that the success or failure in this year's economic work depends on the capability and role of the state economic guidance organs in the main, and made clear the issue that the Cabinet and state economic guidance organs should restore the function peculiar to them as economic organizer and their controlling function to improve the guidance and management over the whole economy, the one of improving the role of non-permanent economic development committee and other important practical issues for consolidating the Cabinet-centered system, Cabinet-responsibility system. The report stressed the need for the Cabinet and state economic guidance organs to make everything dovetailed from their planning, pay attention to organic contact and cooperation among economic sectors, thoroughly establish the plan discipline, sharply sum up the results of production and correct the rule-of-thumb way of work in planning and guiding the economic work. The report also advanced the direction oriented towards the adoption of essential and vital practical measures by furthering the study of methods of economic management and their translation into practice. Noting that the Party will support the bold renovation in the economic work to the end, the General Secretary stressed over again the need for economic guidance officials to decisively enhance their responsibility and role in planning and guiding this year's economic work. The report, which comprehensively analyzed and appreciated the planning and attitude taken by different sectors for implementing the decisions of the Party Congress and clearly set forth rectification measures, drew a great support and enthusiastic approval from the participants in the plenary meeting, as it reflects firm determination and bold practical measures to bring about without fail substantial results desired and welcomed by the people this year. The report will continue at the third-day sitting of the plenary meeting. Political News Team

title: Priority Given to Supply Service for Welfare of Miners over Their Production
body: The Namdok Youth Coal Mine is all out to implement the decisions of the 8th Congress of the Workers’ Party of Korea. Consequently, it registers high results in its coal production. Under the guidance of its Party organization its officials did their utmost despite their difficulties to provide their miners with good living conditions. Pleased with this all the latter devoted themselves entirely to their work and gradually increased the output of their coal. This shows that catering to the needs of workers for their livelihood eventually leads to great successes in their production. Rodong Sinmun

title: To Produce Various Medical Appliances of High Performance in Greater Numbers
body: At the up-to-the-minute Myohyangsan Medical Appliances Factory built under the care of the WPK its workers and management vigorously step up the production of their medical instruments of various kinds to execute the decisions of its 8th Congress. Innovations are effected in the MMAF while a socialist emulation is carried on dynamically among its workshops, workteams and individual workers on the principle of thoroughly ensuring the quality of their products. The MMAF makes endeavors to ensure that its workers improve their technological knowledge and skills as befits operators of modern CNC machines. The result is that they produce various sorts of accessories of medical apparatus qualitatively. Rodong Sinmun

title: Raw Materials Secured Preferentially
body: The organic compound manure of an organic compound manure factory in Onsong County was quite popular with agricultural workers for its good quality. But its output was small. The officials of the factory aimed at producing almost double as much organic compound manure this year as against last year. The factory has already increased the capacity for the production of its organic compound manure with much effort. The point was to procure raw materials for it. Its employees responsibly secured the raw materials by all means. They also transported them to their factory by vehicle. In the course of this the factory gave wide publicity to the good deeds of its model employees to laud them and animate others to further efforts. As a result, the factory finished procuring its raw materials as it wished and has since been able to turn out its organic compound manure on schedule. Rodong Sinmun

title: Consultative Meeting of Construction Panel Held
body: Jong Sang Hak, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and secretary of the Party Central Committee, Pak Hun, vice-premier of the Cabinet, and So Jong Jin, minister of Construction and Building-Materials Industry, guided the consultative meeting of the construction panel. The participants at the consultative meeting focused their enthusiastic discussion on the issue of attaining without fail the goal of building 10 000 dwelling houses in Pyongyang this year, on which Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the WPK, put stress at the plenary meeting. The meeting brought together scientific and innovative proposals for making the designing of dwelling houses to be built in Pyongyang concur with the aspiration of the people and the level of civilization of the times, thoroughly guaranteeing the quality of construction and fully supplying building materials like cement and finishing building materials. It also discussed practical issues to build dwelling houses in large scale in different local areas and thoroughly implement the Party's policy of centralization in the industrial construction. Rodong Sinmun

title: Light Industrial Panel Meeting Held
body: Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, Pak Thae Song, member of the Political Bureau and secretary of the WPK Central Committee, Pak Myong Sun, alternate member of the Political Bureau and department director of the WPK Central Committee, and Ri Song Hak, vice-premier of the Cabinet, guided the consultative meeting of light industrial panel. The meeting had a serious discussion on measures for decisively increasing the proportion of domestically available raw materials and other materials, true to the noble intention of Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the WPK, who called on the light industrial field, which takes a big share in resolving the problems of food, clothing and housing, to make a fresh start with redoubled efforts. Discussed in detail at the meeting were plans on all indices for restoring the original performance of equipment, creating new production capacity, boosting the local industry and thus producing and supplying in a responsible manner consumer goods urgently needed for the people's living in the fields of light industry, including textile, knitting and shoe-making, and ways to carry them out. Rodong Sinmun

title: Agricultural Panel Meeting Held
body: Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and department director of the WPK Central Committee, Ri Chol Man, alternate member of the Political Bureau and department director of the WPK Central Committee, and Ju Chol Gyu, vice-premier of the Cabinet and concurrently minister of Agriculture, guided the consultative meeting of agricultural panel. In the meeting, the participants discussed in depth the detailed issues of working out farming operation in a foresighted way and unconditionally attaining the goal of the grain production for this year, cherishing deep in mind the idea and intention of Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the WPK, on laying the foundation for stable and sustained development for increased grain output. The meeting made a discussion on important methodological issues of improving the people's diet by taking scientific and technical measures for ensuring safe agricultural production despite any disastrous climatic conditions, by increasing the areas under crop cultivation and by directing efforts into the fields of stock-breeding, vegetable growing, fruit farming and industrial crop cultivation. Rodong Sinmun

title: Industrial Panel Meeting Held
body: Jo Yong Won, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and secretary of the Party Central Committee, and Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK and premier of the Cabinet, guided the consultative meeting of the industrial panel. The meeting brought up for discussion the targets to be hit in the different sectors of the industrial field this year based on the deep study of the programmatic report made by Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the WPK, at the plenary meeting, and intensified the discussion of them. Constructive suggestions were made for achieving definite growth of production by concentrating efforts on creating new productive capacity while putting the current iron production on a normal footing in the metallurgical industry, by enhancing the independent nature and technological potential of the chemical industry and by strengthening the mutual cooperation and organic coordination among the sectors of key industries, including electric, coal, machine and mining, and railway transport. Rodong Sinmun

title: ﻿Centenarian Receives Birthday Spread in DPRK
body: Amid the increasing number of centenarians in the DPRK, an auspicious event happened in the family of grandmother Ri Jong Nyo living in Johung-ri of Jongphyong County in South Hamgyong Province. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un sent a birthday spread to Ri Jong Nyo on her 100th birthday. She said tears come into her eyes when she thinks of her parents and brothers and sisters who died in their early years, being treated as a hangdog without being properly fed and dressed in the dark period of the Japanese imperialists' rule over Korea. She added it became possible for her to lead a happy life in a large family with her grandsons and granddaughters in good health in the era of the Workers' Party. She extended her gratitude to the respected Marshal Kim Jong Un for seeing to it that the birthday spread was sent to her, an ordinary old woman enjoying preferential treatment as a centenarian without any worries under the care of the Party and the state. She requested her children to work hard for the country, saying the socialist system of our country is the best in the world. Rodong Sinmun

title: Jo Yong Won, Secretary of C.C., WPK, Makes Speech at Plenary Meeting
body: Jo Yong Won, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), at the plenary meeting made a brief on the activities of Party organizations at all levels for inspiring officials, Party members and working people greatly encouraged by the idea and spirit of the 8th Party Congress to the implementation of the decisions made at the congress and referred to the serious mistakes being witnessed among some officials. Pointing out the issue that the light industrial field, in particular, lowered the whole plan for the production of consumer goods, complaining of conditions, the one that the construction field dared to bring down the goal of building 10 000 dwelling houses this year, which the Party Central Committee promised to citizens in Pyongyang, the one that the field of electric power industry artificially lowered the plan of electric power production with indifference to the urgent demand from the economic construction and people's living, the one that the field of fishing industry does not prepare itself for supplying fishes to the people through positive fishing activities, etc., he sharply criticized senior officials of the Party Central Committee and the government who are responsible for shamefully setting the indices of major plans. He made a strong reprehension that the above-said mistakes show they are unhesitatingly abandoning even the decisions of the Party congress and pledge taken before the people, seized with extreme passivism and self-protectionism, and such deeds should be considered as absolutely intolerable anti-Party, anti-popular act against the idea and intention of Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the WPK. He said that the Party organizations will never remain indifferent to the officials, who neglect their duties and hinder the progress and renovation, untrue to the leadership idea of the General Secretary while only taking care of their positions, but severely censure them. He said that the Party organizations will make correct appraisal of everyone with the loyalty to the revolution as the main criterion, decisively improve the work with leading functionaries, Party members and other masses and, in particular, be strict with officials, who take an important share in the implementation of the decisions of the Party congress and this year's work, to make them attain actual results. He noted that he would make all the Party organizations efficiently carry out the organizational and political work for implementing the Party's decisions, positively support the work of administrative and economic officials and further elate the spirit of masses with fresh methods of working with the masses. He took a pledge before the plenary meeting that he would steadily intensify the party guidance to make every unit work and seethe with revolutionary enthusiasm as required by the present stirring era and devote his all to making everything planned and intended by the General Secretary be carried out most correctly and perfectly.

title: Speech of Director of Central Public Prosecutors Office
body: U Sang Chol, director of the Central Public Prosecutors Office, made a speech at the plenary meeting. He expressed his determination to direct all his efforts to firmly guaranteeing the fulfillment of a new five-year plan by law true to the important tasks set forth by Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, at the 8th Congress of the Party. Saying he would ensure that legal measures are taken to make every field and enterprise thoroughly implement the Party's economic policy, he said that he would thoroughly restrain and control all acts of curbing the Cabinet from playing the leading role, find out and take powerful measures against every factor becoming an obstacle in readjusting and reinforcing the metallurgical, chemical, electric power, coal and other major industrial sectors and tighten the legal control in order to make it unbearable for relevant units to go without producing goods under contract in a responsible way. He stressed that he would offensively and continuously keep legal watch over units which wantonly violate the socialist economic management order within their own enclosure on the strength of "special organs" while being away from control by law, intensify the education on the law among the economic officials to make them observe the socialist principle conscientiously and uphold the Party's economic policy sincerely, and thus prevent in advance illegal factors infringing upon the state economic management system and order. He said he would make sure that there won't be such phenomena as conniving at and fostering illegal acts, bearing in mind that if the law enforcement is not conducted on the Party's and class principles, the Party's economic policy can not be thoroughly carried out and all sorts of unsound practices will be rampant and that the success or failure in carrying out the Party's economic policy depends on how public prosecutors ensure law enforcement. He pledged to thoroughly reject phenomena that judicial officials fall in or make compromise and concession to acts of defaulting on the Party's economic policy, being soaked in defeatism, and to upgrade the struggle as a resolute and strict defender of the Party's economic policy. He said that every official of the prosecutorial institutions would accept the militant tasks set forth by the General Secretary as the supreme order, conduct dynamic legal struggle for successfully carry out the five-year plan for the national economic development and for reliably defending the socialist economic system and thus fulfill their holy mission and duty before the Party and the revolution, the country and the people.

title: Speech of Minister of Chemical Industry
body: Ma Jong Son, minister of Chemical Industry, made a speech at the plenary meeting. He said that Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, in his report made at the historic 8th Party Congress put an emphasis on transforming the structure of the chemical industry of the country into that of the Juche industry relying on our own technical force and our own raw materials, pledging to make this year a year of a decisive turn in consolidating the self-supporting foundation of the chemical industry under the uplifted banner of self-reliance. He said he would make sure that the operational plans for carrying out the militant goal for this year are worked out on scientific calculation and officials become doer-type and field officer-type officials who devotedly carry out tasks entrusted to them and steadily learn things new and create things in a bold way, always bearing in mind that whether the Party policies are carried out or not entirely depends on officials. He stressed that he would build reliable technical force and bring up promising talents to provide a firm guarantee for ensuring sustained development of the chemical industry as a whole including C-1 chemical industry on a high scientific and technological foundation, bearing deep in mind that neither the success of the fighting tasks for this year nor the future prospect can be expected without relying on the advanced science and technology and talents. He pledged to map out realistic plans for remodeling and modernization of factories and enterprises in the field of chemical industry and make sure that people benefit from every project and open up the future of the chemical industry on the principle of looking 50, 100 years ahead, with it set as an important task to push ahead with the work of rounding off the structure of the chemical industry on a long-term basis. He evinced to push forward the project of expanding the nitrogen fertilizer production capacity and the updating of sodium carbonate production process to unconditionally finish them within this year as pledged before the Party Central Committee.
