He also vowed to meticulously organize economic work for carrying out the quotas for national economy so that fertilizer factories would implement the planned supply of nitrogen fertilizer for farming within the set period and sufficiently produce principal chemical products. He made a firm pledge to fulfill his heavy duty before the Party and the people in a responsible manner, bearing deep in mind the earnest teachings of the General Secretary that the chemical industry is a key link in the economic development and the lifeline for the improvement of people's living, and thus make our people benefit from the chemical industry without fail.

title: Speech Made by Premier of Cabinet
body: Fully supporting and approving the programmatic report by General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea Kim Jong Un, Kim Tok Hun, premier of the Cabinet, expressed the responsible determination of the Cabinet to find out correct scientific methods for implementing the decisions made at the Party Congress and make substantial renovation in the economic work. Seriously looking back on how the Cabinet failed to set this year's goal to meet the Party's intention but submitted the plan figures devoid of purposefulness of development, dynamism, perseverance and scientific accuracy, he said the Cabinet would strive to live up to the expectation of the people, while readily shouldering a heavy burden as the General Secretary stressed again and again. He said that the Cabinet would work out innovative economic plan for this year with a main emphasis put on the strategy for readjustment and reinforcement and self-reliance set forth by the Party as the key point of the economic work and positively and bravely solve main problems arising in improving the methods of economic management. He pledged to perfect feasible methodology for making the working people practical master of economic management by correctly enforcing the socialist system of responsible business operation while readjusting and rearranging system and order of economic work and practicing the unified guidance and strategic management of the state over economic work. He emphasized that the Cabinet would make sure all the sectors and units of the national economy actively push forward domestic production of equipment and materials in line with the requirements of the principle of nationwide, planned and scientific self-reliance set forth by the 8th Party Congress and concentrate efforts on the fields of metallurgical and chemical industries to lay a foundation for producing and supplying sufficient amount of iron and steel and chemical products. He noted that the Cabinet would push ahead with the work of readjusting and reinforcing the current production processes in different sectors of the national economy from this year and direct efforts into the projects in which ten achievements can be made from one success, so as to create one asset after another for sustainable production growth. Saying that the way to carry out this year's high goal depends on radical renovation in ideological viewpoint and work attitude of officials, he called on the members of the Cabinet to firmly switch economic work to the one of aspiring after and encouraging fresh innovation, bold creation and ceaseless advance with unusual readiness and a sense of responsibility. He made a solemn determination to make redoubled efforts to implement without fail this year's economic plan with persevering practice, bearing deep in mind the General Secretary's teachings that the work of the Cabinet precisely means the work of the Party Central Committee and the implementation of the decisions of the 8th Party Congress constitutes the work of the Cabinet and his instructions to conduct a bold work.

title: Press Release of 2nd Plenary Meeting of 8th Central Committee of WPK Issued
body: Members and alternate members of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) who were by-elected and secretary of the Party Central Committee who was elected at the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th WPK Central Committee are as follows: Member of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK Ri Son Gwon Alternate member of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK Kim Song Nam Secretary of the Party Central Committee and director of its Department of Economic Affairs O Su Yong

title: Let Us Adorn First Year's Advance for Implementing Decisions Made at Party Congress with Proud Innovation and Progress
body: Report on 2nd Plenary Meeting of 8th Central Committee of WPK Amid the great expectations and interest of all the Party members and the people who have turned out in the new revolutionary advance upholding the programme for struggle set forth at the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the WPK was held from February 8 to 11, Juche 110 (2021). The 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the WPK was convened in the period when the guidance and the fighting efficiency of the WPK, which leads our own style socialism to new victories with the great idea and the art of leadership, have been remarkably demonstrated and the spirit of all the Party members and the people for struggle who are boundlessly loyal to the Party's cause has been elated. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the WPK, guided the plenary meeting. As the General Secretary took the platform with members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee, all the participants raised stormy cheers of the greatest respect for the General Secretary who wisely leads our Party and the people to only victory and glory out of the noble responsibility for the country, revolution and people. Attending the meeting were members and alternate members of the WPK Central Committee. Present as observers were vice directors of the relevant departments of the Party Central Committee, leading Party and administrative officials of commissions, ministries and national institutions, senior officials of the leading institutions at provincial level, chief secretaries of the city and county Party committees and leading Party and administrative officials of major industrial establishments. They listened in the tele-conference system. Kim Jong Un presided over the meeting upon authorization of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK. Before discussing the agenda items, the General Secretary referred to the main purport of convening the plenary meeting of the WPK Central Committee. Saying that the Party Central Committee should powerfully lead the masses to the implementation of the decisions made at the 8th Party Congress by giving further momentum to the enthusiasm of the masses who are responding to the idea and spirit of the Party Congress, he stressed the need to provide the Party organizations and members with practical means for innovation which would help bring about practical change and substantial progress from the first year of the five-year plan. He said that as the decisions made at the Party Congress are mid-and long-term tasks to be fulfilled by all sectors during the coming five years, it is necessary to examine this year's plans down to details at the plenary meeting and fix and issue them as the decisions of the Party Central Committee. He evinced the determination and will of the Party Central Committee to take important measures to push forward the economic construction and provide the people with more stable and improved living conditions despite the persistent emergency anti-epidemic situation, in particular. He proposed agenda items to be discussed at the plenary meeting, underscoring the need to make a serious study of a series of issues arising in thoroughly overcoming negative elements obstructing the socialist construction at present, and in further consolidating the Party organizationally and ideologically and enhancing the militant function and role of the Party organizations. The plenary meeting passed the agenda items with unanimous approval. 1. On thoroughly implementing the first year's tasks of the five-year plan set forth at the 8th Party Congress 2. On waging further intensive struggle against anti-socialist and non-socialist practices throughout society 3. On modifying the collection of the slogans of the Party Central Committee 4. On the examination of "Description of Rules of Workers' Party of Korea" 5. An organizational matter The first agenda was discussed at the meeting. The General Secretary made an important report "On thoroughly implementing the first year's tasks of the five-year plan set forth at the 8th Party Congress" on the first agenda item. First, in the report he underlined the need to properly organize the economic work of the first year for implementing the new five-year plan for the national economic development. Saying that the first-year work is very important in attaining the new prospective goal decided by the 8th Congress of the WPK, he noted that the five-year plan can be finally accomplished with confidence only when the first-year plan is properly set up and fully implemented. The new five-year plan requires a new start apart from all those old and out of date and all the people in the country are now watching how the work for implementing the decisions made at the Party Congress starts and what kind of change is being made, the report stressed. In order to successfully do this year's work decisive of the result of the implementation of the decisions made at the 8th Congress of the Party, the plan which is its operational map and a blueprint should be set up in an innovative and effective way and the entire Party, the whole country and all the people should wage a vigorous struggle for its implementation. However, there are no big changes in this year's quotas for national economy drafted by the Cabinet, analyzed the report, noting that the idea and policy of the Party Congress are not properly reflected in the proposed plan for economic work for this year and innovative viewpoint and clear tactics can't be found although the Party Congress has just made decisions and intensive studies on the document of the Party Congress and discussions for its orientation have been made. The Cabinet failed to play a leading role in mapping out plans of key economic fields and almost mechanically brought together the numbers drafted by the ministries. And as a result, the plan of one field has been raised subjectively even there is no actual possibility and the plans of other fields have been lowered under the signboard of readjusting and reinforcing even there are tasks that can certainly be accomplished or must be fulfilled. The report sharply criticized the work of several fields that markedly showed such tendencies. In the field of agriculture, the goal for grain production has been set high subjectively from the first year of the five-year plan irrespective of present situation where farming condition is unfavorable and the state is unable to supply enough farming materials, thereby making it hard to avoid bureaucracy and bragging from the planning stage just as before. In contrast with this, the fields of electric power industry, construction and light industry have brought down the production plans for major indices to the level where they would not be blamed in the year-end. Now major industrial establishments in the fields of metal, chemical and machine industries, local-industry factories across the country and the agricultural field raise the demand for even a bit more electricity, coal and other mines can not but stop production due to electricity and the people feel inconvenience in their living. This being a fact, the Cabinet, the State Planning Commission and the Ministry of Electric Power Industry mapped out this year's plan for producing electricity lower than the present level under the pretext of adjusting to the present demand on electricity of major industrial establishments and directing efforts to restoring original efficiency of electric generators. The construction field also lowered the plan for building dwelling houses in the Pyongyang City than the goal decided by the Party Congress under the excuses of the supply of materials and labor. These are seeds of self-protection and defeatism of officials in the field of economy who are trying to find a breather and make pretense of doing work under the pretext of condition and environment. Noting that the building of dwelling houses is an important work to provide the people with stable and highly cultured life and a political issue to defend the prestige of the Party Congress, the report said that the Party Central Committee was determined to build 10 000 dwelling houses in Pyongyang this year without fail. The light industry sector was also seriously censured for mapping out an absurdly low plan for this year's shoes production under the excuse of materials provision and giving priority to quality over quantity. The report stressed the need for other sectors to suggest goals, which can make tangible contribution to economic construction and people's living, with purposefulness of development, dynamism, perseverance and scientific accuracy, far from setting plan low so as to get appraisal of over-fulfilling task at the year-end. The General Secretary in the report referred to the issue of conducting substantial operation for expanding production capacity and foundation when organizing economic work for this year. All sectors of the national economy should build new production bases for production growth in the future, upgrade the backward and outdated production processes and reinforce necessary processes so as to push forward the work of expanding production capacity in parallel with the current production. As suggested in the main task of the five-year plan, we should press ahead with the nationwide work of focusing investment on the metallurgical and chemical industries, regarding them as key links in the whole chain of the national economy, and consolidating the material and technological foundation of the agricultural sector in a planned way from this year. We also need a method by which we can concentrate efforts in accurately-targeted way on projects which is urgent to us and in which ten achievements can be made from one success. Stressing that the nationwide, planned and scientific self-reliance should be given special priority and applied innovatively in economic work, the report said that this year's plan mentions about preferentially providing materials demanded in the major sectors of the national economy but only a few have national measures taken for their provision. Just to tell them to buy and use as much as they can even those goods which don't certainly have to be imported and which are domestically produced, is the most typical expression of dereliction found in the organs for economic guidance characterized by shifting their responsibilities on to the lower units by abusing the slogan "self-reliance." The continuity of such status would result in gradual disappearance of the economic authority and control power of the state and in pushing state-run enterprises to illegal moneymaking. Noting that the Cabinet and the State Planning Commission should take centralized and unified control of products from all sectors of the national economy and businesses, and make quick switchover to the work system of fully meeting the demand by establishing production-consumption relations, the report underscored the need to intensively provide labor, equipment, materials and funds to businesses of key industry sectors and the only-son factories, take nationwide encouraging and preferential steps and take detailed measures to ensure import indices with domestic production. The General Secretary in the report called for giving importance to talents in organizing economic work for this year and paying special attention to bringing up talented scientific and technical personnel and management personnel and Party functionaries in every sector. The knottiest problem in propping up the national economy now is the shortage of talents and it is an urgent task to bring up new-type talents at present when we are set to make a bold innovation in all work. Changes should be made in the work of bringing up talents first to make substantial changes in the Party, state and economic work and people's living, The report said that all sectors and units should regard it as an important task of the five-year plan to bring up able scientific and technical personnel, administrative personnel and Party functionaries who can shoulder each sector of the country in the future and push forward it in a planned way. For this all sectors of the national economy should meticulously organize work on the principle of bringing up talents necessary for their spheres themselves and leading economic officials should hold fast to it as an important methodology to find talents before relying on them in keeping abreast of their own sectors and groping for improvement measures. It should be the working attitude and traits common to all officials to boldly appoint talents, bring them up in practice and put them forward before the Party and state with a viewpoint that no work can be carried out, to say nothing of the decisions of the Party Congress, without having talents in hand and bringing them up, the report added. It stressed the need to bring up Party functionaries who are capable of finding out and intentionally bringing up talented management personnel excellent in conceiving ideas and in organizing and conducting and controlling power, and are proficient in work with people. The General Secretary in the report put important emphasis on waging intensified struggle for putting an end to unit specialization and self-centeredness as the one involving the whole Party, state and society when conducting the first year's work for implementing the decisions of the Party Congress. The report said that misuse of power, bureaucratism and irregularities and corruption are anti-Party and anti-people acts committed by individuals, whereas unit specialization and self-centeredness are graver anti-Party, anti-state and anti-people acts perpetrated under the veil of unit and organization, stressing these are the biggest obstacle in applying our Party's people-first politics and consolidating our own strength, our internal driving force. It specially evinced that the practices of unit specialization and self-centeredness which infringe on the interests of the state and people and neglect the implementation of the decisions and instructions of the Party must not be allowed to go at large any longer but be stamped out resolutely by mobilizing the Party authority, legal right and military prerogative. It expressed the determination of the Party Central Committee to regard unit specialization and self-centeredness as the enemy to the revolution and state tantamount to the misuse of power, bureaucratism and irregularities and corruption and to wage an all-out war against it with the plenary meeting as an occasion, and dealt with the issue for all Party organizations, political and state organs and all the people to be the main force in the war for wiping out unit specialization and self-centeredness. In the report the General Secretary stressed to organize economic work for this year in the direction of displaying the potential of self-supporting economy and stabilizing the people's living to the maximum while strictly maintaining the state emergency anti-epidemic discipline. He then suggested the tasks facing the sectors of the national economy for this year. The report suggested key tasks to be carried out this year by main industrial fields such as metal, chemical, electric power, coal, development and exploitation of natural resources, machine industry and forestry in reinforcing the production foundation while conducting on-going production, and specified detailed ways for their materialization. Importantly stressed was the issue of pushing forward the work of improving the railway situation with the focus of this year's work put on adjusting and reinforcing the railways in the field of railway transport. The report suggested the tasks of conducting on an extensive scale the construction of major projects including the unconditional construction of dwelling houses for 10 000 families in Pyongyang and finishing of infra-network project as planned as well as local construction and of accelerating the work to expand the cement production capacity and meeting the demand for various building materials with responsibility in the field of construction and building materials industry. In the report the General Secretary underlined the need for the light industrial field holding a big share in solving food, clothing and housing for the people to fully tap all potential and to increase to the maximum the production of people's consumer goods and light industrial goods. He set it as the central part of the work for this year to ensure home provision of raw materials, recycling, recovery of original performance of equipment, creation of new production capacity, and invigoration of local industry and the General Bureau of the Tanchon Area Mining Industry. The report stressed that it was decided to spruce up local industrial factories in Kimhwa County, Kangwon Province this year to implement the line of strengthening city and county set forth at the 8th Congress of the Party and to set a new standard of local industrial factory. The report proposed the tasks for taking measures for this to the Cabinet, the State Planning Commission and the Ministry of Light Industry. Along with this it was mentioned to put emphasis on strengthening the material and technical foundation in the fisheries field and to actively carry out fishing, aquatic farming to bring substantial benefits to the people this year. The report also detailed the major tasks to be carried out this year by the fields of commerce, communications, land and environment, city management, external economic relations and tourism. The General Secretary in the report stressed the need to unconditionally carry out the plan for agricultural production for this year. The report called upon the institutions of agricultural guidance including the Ministry of Agriculture to map out a foresighted plan for farming and, in particular, to take measures for coping with the disastrous climate in a scientific and realistic way, stressing the need for the agricultural sector to steadily lay the foundation for stable and sustained development for increased grain output by thoroughly fulfilling this year's plans for cereals production and procurement. It suggested tasks for breeding high yielding varieties and expanding the area for cultivating them to raise the per-hectare yield, decisively increasing the fertility of soil, ensuring the scientific cultivation method for each farming process in line with the features of each breed and mapping out and pushing ahead with a detailed plan for making the low-yielding fields fertile before farming season. It called for promoting in a planned way the work for laying material and technological foundation of units producing tractor and farm machines, pushing forward the restoration of irrigation systems and facilities and the expansion of the irrigated areas, accelerating the reclamation of tideland, cultivation of new land and land realignment and increasing the production of livestock products, vegetables, fruit and industrial crops. It dealt with issues of supplying farming materials on which hinge success or failure of this year's farming in a responsible way on a nationwide scale, stamping out the practices of talking big in the agricultural sector, and bringing about a decisive improvement in the rural ri-Party committees' work. The General Secretary in the report referred to the tasks to be fulfilled by sectors of science and culture. The report clarified issues to call upon the field of science and technology to smoothly solve the technological problems arising in consolidating the existing economic foundation of this year and putting the production on a normal basis, and to identify all scientific and technological talents in different sectors, regions and units and to take practical steps for and improving qualification of scientists and technicians. It said that the secondary educational sector should establish the rational educational system for bringing up the reserve scientific and technological talents in a planned way and that universities train more scientific and technological talents including experts on IT, biological engineering, chemistry and material. Suggested were important tasks to be fulfilled to bring about a clear improvement by the sector of public health this year. The public health sector should direct primary efforts into decisively eradicating different kinds of contagious diseases, and should promote as scheduled the construction of new public health facilities and that of pharmaceutical factory, medical appliances factory and medical supplies factory now under progress. The report roundly exposed the real state of literature and art still in stagnation and hibernation and called for bringing about a real progress in creation activities as required by reality that has entered a new period of turn. Tasks were suggested for the mass media to wage a vigorous media campaign aimed at inspiring the masses to the implementation of the decisions of the Party Congress, and for the field of physical culture and sports to organize colorful sports events and conduct brisk mass sports activities. The report stressed the importance for the People's Army and the munitions industry, the sector in charge of affairs with south Korea and the sector in charge of external affairs to thoroughly carry out the fighting goal and plans of this year for implementing the decisions set forth by the 8th Party Congress without an inch of deflection. The General Secretary in the report made particular reference to the tasks for improving the economic work in an innovative way by decisively enhancing the function and role of the state economic guidance organs. What should be settled immediately at present is to improve the guidance and management of the Cabinet and state economic guidance organs over the whole economy by restoring the function peculiar to them as economic organizer and their controlling function. State economic guidance organs should emerge from old-fashioned force of habit by which they used to put the blame on bad condition, complaining lack of authority, and take a hands-off approach towards the national economy and actively wage a campaign for overcoming economical difficulties and obstacles. It is important to remove obstacles laying in the economic development and make sure the economy of the country is smoothly managed by improving the role of non-permanent economic development committee. The report called for overcoming obstacles and difficulties by making everything dovetailed from the planning, paying attention to organic contact and cooperation among economic sectors, thoroughly rejecting the evasion of responsibility and self-centeredness existing among state economic guidance organs and actively supporting and supplying each other purposefully, consciously and actively. It is important to establish strict discipline in the fulfillment of plans and do thorough-going summing up for the substantial organization and command of economic work. It is necessary for the Cabinet and state organs for economic guidance to raise high demand while providing necessary condition for every production unit to unconditionally carry out their plan for production and supply of materials, and conduct an intensive struggle against such phenomena as bargaining, defaulting and observing discipline in the fulfillment of plans for mere form's sake. The report also set forth tasks for the Cabinet and state organs for economic guidance to boldly wage the work for improving the economic management method. It is necessary to prioritize the state-wide seeking and applying of methods for grasping all products and incoming materials in their numbers in a unified way and circulating them in improving the economic management method. It is necessary to properly combine the political method with economic and technological method and administrative and organizational method to settle the economic management our own way in line with our own situation. The General Secretary in his report repeatedly emphasized the need for officials of the economic field to decisively enhance a sense of responsibility and role. Saying that the expectation of the Party and people of economic guidance officials is very big at the present starting point for the five-year plan, and the reality calls upon every official to work with redoubled efforts beyond the limitation of his or her level, ability and potentiality, the report called upon our officials to display mental power and fighting spirit to make a staunch dash toward the future and terminal of the five-year plan while always looking far into the future. The General Secretary in his report set forth the tasks for guaranteeing the fulfillment of the national economic plan by law. Saying that nobody has a right to bargain with the national economic plan and they have only a duty to unconditionally carry it out as it is the order of the Party and law of the state, he stressed the need for the law field to set it as the core task to legally, powerfully and closely guarantee the national economic plan for this year and thoroughly carry it out. He importantly called for concentrating efforts of the Party work on the fulfillment of the tasks for this year. The report noted that the serious mistakes made in attaining the goals of the five-year strategy for national economic development set forth at the 7th Party Congress were caused by the misguidance by the Party committees at all levels over the economic work and the failure of the Party officials in fulfilling their responsibility and role as the organizer and standard-bearer in implementing the Party's policies. Mentioned in the report were the principled matters to be maintained in intensifying the guidance of the Party organizations for the economic work for this year. Party organizations should thoroughly overcome formalism in shaping and adopting Party decisions for implementing the line and policies of the Party. They should decisively part from the old way of running Party meetings and discuss and adopt the decisions of the Party for carrying out the tasks set forth in the present plenary meeting in line with the intention of the Party Central Committee, will of the masses and realistic condition of their units and to be able to exactly question about the guarantee of their execution and limit of responsibilities. It is necessary to make wider use of strong points and successes and correct faults and deviations while grasping and reviewing the implementation of the Party's decision on a regular basis after its adoption. The report called upon the Party organizations to play their role as the helm in substantially providing their political guidance for the successful implementation of the economic tasks for this year. The role of the Party organizations in carrying out the national economic plan is, in essence, the work of most correctly illuminating the way for ensuring satisfactory economic work as required by the Party's policy and properly leading them not to derail from it. Party organizations should find out correct methods and map out detailed plans for perfectly carrying out the national economic plan for their units, positively push ahead with the work to make sure that administrative and economic work is done as required by the Party's policy and timely correct the mistakes and deviations. The Party committees should intensify brainstorming and help their members enhance the responsibility and role to skillfully overcome obstacles and difficulties in carrying out the national economic plan and in particular, leading officials of the Party organizations should do away with subjective and arbitrary practices but fulfill their duty as the political educator and standard-bearer who arouse the masses to implementing the Party's policy. The Party organizations should regard a monthly production review as a Party meeting of summing up the fulfillment of the Party's decisions, not just a business-like review of the fulfillment of the national economic plan, and hold it to be of political significance and make it a good opportunity in awakening officials and producers, arousing their emulation and generalizing advanced experience. The report said that it is very important to heighten the role of the Party organizations of the Cabinet, ministries and national institutions in successfully carrying out the economic tasks for this year and set forth relevant tasks. Party organizations of ministries and national institutions should effectively conduct the organizational and political work for implementing the Party's policies upon their indication and positively back administrative and economic officials with a stand of taking full responsibility for the results of execution. They should steadily awaken officials by conducting intensive educational and ideological campaign for overcoming such negative phenomena as the one of not devoting themselves to implementing the Party's policy and of failing to boldly do the work while complaining about poor conditions, being seized by defeatism and self-protectionism. Concluding his three-day report, the General Secretary said that the plenary meeting was convened in an appropriate and necessary period in the sense that it helped rectify mistakes from the stage of planning this year's work and newly decided on the great work for our people and also helped find out and correct the ideological maladies including passivism and self-protectionism latent in officials. Expressing the expectation that every member of the Party central leadership organ would correctly confirm the work plan for this year through consultative meetings of panels, he called for making the plenary meeting a significant occasion of giving greater confidence and courage to all members of the Party and other people who turned out in implementing the decisions made at the 8th Congress of the Party. After he finished his report on the first agenda item, all the participants in the meeting raised enthusiastic cheers to pay the greatest tribute to the General Secretary who provided the commanding officials of the revolution, all Party members and other people with the powerful weapon of advance and innovation by unfolding a clear plan for the first year's march for implementing the decisions made at the 8th Congress of the Party with his rare insight and deep thought and by energetically guiding the meeting for days. His important report full of his absolute confidence in the justice of the socialist cause, spirit of boundlessly serving the people and strong will to win a fresh victory of the revolution serves as a great militant banner for bringing about a new upsurge and change in the socialist construction. Kim Tok Hun, premier of the Cabinet, Ma Jong Son, minister of Chemical Industry, U Sang Chol, director of the Central Public Prosecutors Office, and Jo Yong Won, secretary of the Central Committee of the Party, made speeches on the first agenda item at the plenary meeting. Referring to the fact that the General Secretary in his important report comprehensively set forth the struggle tasks for the entire Party and all the people for this year, the speakers deeply analyzed and pointed out mistakes of not properly applying the idea and spirit of the Party Congress from the stage of mapping out the plan. They expressed their firm determination to set the militant goal for the first year in an innovative and scientific way by bringing about a fundamental innovation in their ideological view and work style in order to repay the great expectation of the Party and people and staunchly put it into practice and thus fulfill their responsibility in the struggle for implementing the decisions made at the Party Congress. The speakers pledged to conduct a dynamic legal struggle for carrying out the five-year plan and defending the socialist economic system and powerfully propel the implementation of the decisions made at the Party Congress and this year's tasks as a Party and political work by turning the whole Party into an integral whole of loyalists upholding the leadership idea of the Party Central Committee with sincerity and devotion. Consultative meetings of different panels for drawing up a draft resolution for the first agenda item were held at the plenary meeting. The consultative meetings, divided into the industrial, agricultural, light industrial and construction panels, deeply studied the contents of the report made by the General Secretary and discussed in depth how to work out plans of different sectors for this year guided by the report. New reserves and possibilities were actively explored and creative and constructive suggestions were made for innovating work of different sectors amid earnest speculation and efforts, and primary targets submitted to the plenary meeting were upgraded as a whole. At the plenary meeting, there was a comprehensive report about supplementary suggestions made during the process of drawing up a draft resolution at the consultative meetings of different panels. The draft resolution drawn up through the consultative meetings was acknowledged to correctly reflect the strategic tasks and policies of the Party Congress and fully carry scientific accuracy, feasibility and dynamism of this year's work direction and targets for different sectors. "On thoroughly implementing the first year's tasks of the five-year plan set forth at the 8th Party Congress", resolution on the first agenda item, was adopted with unanimous approval at the plenary meeting. When the important resolution which would bring about an evident change and practical achievements in the struggle and life of our people for implementing the tasks set at the Party Congress was adopted, all the participants manifested their strong support for the resolution of the plenary meeting and absolute will to carry it out with loud applauses. The second agenda item "On waging further intensive struggle against anti-socialist and non-socialist practices throughout society" was discussed at the plenary meeting. Kim Jong Un made a report on the second agenda item. Stressing that our revolution, which has entered the new development stage, strongly calls for more intensified struggle against the anti-socialist and non-socialist practices than ever before, the General Secretary in his report clarified his revolutionary will and determination to definitely remove vicious cancer that threatens our ideology and social system and hinders single-minded unity. Also suggested in his report was the task of powerfully waging the struggle against anti-socialist and non-socialist practices in the Party organizations, working people's organizations, government organs and law enforcement institutions. The report noted that powerful combined headquarters should be organized ranging from Pyongyang to provinces, cities and counties so that they could grasp the actual conditions of the struggle against anti-socialist and non-socialist practices in a unified way on one and the same principle and powerfully carry it out in an intensive and diverse way. It specially stressed the need for the Party organizations to intensively carry out the operation for overcoming abuse of power, bureaucratic behavior and irregularities and corruption among the officials as well as definitely remove those who connive at and fostering anti-socialist and non-socialist acts from the ranks of officials. It is necessary to set it as the most important task for defending the socialist character of our state and for rooting out the anti-socialist and non-socialist practices to urgently solve economic management problem, and solve them one after another in a strict and resolute manner. The General Secretary in his report said that all officials should clearly bear in mind that low-keyed struggle done only in words will never end anti-socialist and non-socialist practices and that if so they and our people will be made to pay a dear price. He stressed the need for the officials to fulfill their responsibilities and duties in the struggle for mercilessly curbing and stamping out anti-socialist and non-socialist acts found in their own sectors and units for the destiny of the country, people and younger generation, and consolidating Korean-style socialism. Listening to the report of the General Secretary, the participants once again inscribed the necessity and urgency of the intensified struggle against anti-socialist and non-socialist acts and received powerful methodology and solutions to them and hardened their pledge to firmly defend Korean-style socialism and add luster to it. "On waging further intensive struggle against anti-socialist and non-socialist practices throughout society", resolution on the second agenda item, was adopted with unanimous approval at the plenary meeting. The third agenda item "On modifying the collection of the slogans of the Party Central Committee" was discussed at the plenary meeting. The collection of the slogans of the Party Central Committee is a political document holding the Party's strategic and policy slogans, and therefore it plays an important role in firmly uniting all the Party members and other people around the Party and in encouraging them to the accomplishment of the revolutionary cause of Juche. The reality, in which the Party's prestige and leadership are being remarkably strengthened and the socialist construction goes ahead in depth, urges to ensure the political character and refinement of the collection of the slogans set forth by the Party Central Committee in every way. A report on the modification of the collection was made. The plenary meeting recognized that as the collection of the slogans set forth by the Party Central Committee was modified with political slogans intensively reflecting the line, strategy and tactics, political doctrine which would always be held fast to by our Party, it would fulfill its mission as an ideological weapon for defending the idea, immortal revolutionary exploits and absolute prestige of the leader, safeguarding the revolutionary character of our Party and victoriously advancing the socialist cause, and adopted a decision on making the modified collection the one of the slogans of the Party Central Committee. The plenary meeting discussed the fourth agenda item "On the examination of 'Description of Rules of the Workers' Party of Korea'". The General Secretary referred to the purport of examining "Description of Rules of Workers' Party of Korea" at the plenary meeting. Noting that the 8th Party Congress modified and supplemented some contents of the Party rules as required by the developing revolution, he said that to compile the handbook on the Party rules is of great significance in consolidating the Party organizationally and ideologically, strengthening the militant function and role of the Party organizations and intensifying the Party life of Party members. He said that the handbook on the Party rules must be decided at the plenary meeting of the Party Central Committee, which organizes and guides all Party works, at an interval between the Party congresses, stressing that after the handbook was examined and distributed, the Party organizations and members should deeply study it and do every Party work and lead Party life as demanded by the norms of the Party rules. The plenary meeting, based on the full pre-study by the members of the Party central leadership organ, adopted a decision on having the draft handbook as the one on the rules of the WPK. It deliberated the fifth agenda item "An Organizational Matter". Members and alternate members of the Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee were recalled or by-elected. Ri Son Gwon was by-elected member of the Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee. Kim Song Nam was by-elected alternate member of the Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee. A secretary of the Party Central Committee was elected. O Su Yong was elected secretary and economic department director of the Party Central Committee. Members and alternate members of the Party Central Committee were recalled or by-elected. Kim Tong Il, Kim Yong Nam and Kim Chol Su, alternate members of the Party Central Committee, were by-elected its members. Hong Hyok Chol, Ri Kyong Ho, Choe Yong Jin, Ryong Kun Chol and Jong So Chol were by-elected alternate members of the Party Central Committee. The General Secretary concluded the plenary meeting. Saying that the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee successfully finished the discussion on all agenda items presented, he expressed thanks to the members of leadership body for sincerely attending the discussion on the Party and state work, always keeping themselves tense and prepared for the past four days. He noted that it is a revelation and expression of their will to fulfill their heavy duty entrusted by the times and the revolution by solemnly and thoroughly implementing their pledge made before the people. He said that every agenda item discussed at the plenary meeting is of special significance in developing the revolutionary work and the Party and clear recognition of important and urgent immediate tasks facing us was shared and definite directions were confirmed at the plenary meeting. He pointed out that the plenary meeting provided a strong policy weapon to prevail against and eradicate the internal negative factors hindering the existence and development of the socialist system, and a political means to equip and rouse the whole Party. He said that through the plenary meeting, our Party Central Committee came to further refine its leadership art, with which it has found a correct way out in solving problems and submitted and directed everything to it, and gain precious experience. He also appreciated that the plenary meeting showed to our people, who are valuing the 8th Party Congress, the firm will of the 8th Party Central Committee to translate the epoch-making tasks decided at the Party congress into reality without fail by mapping out detailed and practical plans. He said that as we have gone through another requisite and excellent course of development, the Party Central Committee should advance the revolutionary work with correct guidance over and thorough-going execution of the decided tasks, thus making the people feel the renovated reality. Stressing that officials of every field and unit should bear in mind that to ensure perfection in emergency anti-epidemic work tops important tasks for this year, remain strict and consistent in the anti-epidemic work and rapidly cope with all the circumstances, the General Secretary took new measures to make the state emergency anti-epidemic headquarters keep the highest tenseness and vigilance and to establish strong anti-epidemic discipline throughout the country. Noting that the Party Central Committee has made preparations in a farsighted way from long ago to provide our people with more bountiful and happy life and give impetus to readjusting, reinforcing and independent development of the state economy, he expressed his expectation that with the plenary meeting as an occasion, substantial changes will be witnessed in the working attitude and way of economic guidance officials, and took decisive measures which will guarantee the implementation of the new five-year plan. Calling on all the members of the Party central leadership body to value the decisions of the plenary meeting as their life and make every effort to make them be carried out unconditionally and thoroughly, he said that it is time to bring our loyalty under the consideration of our loving people. He earnestly asked all the comrades to turn out as one in the revolution for materializing the grand fighting programme of our Party by making redoubled efforts. All the participants broke into cheers of &&Hurrah!&& with stormy applauds in token of their pledge to remain always loyal to the revolution and the people by devotedly upholding the leadership of Kim Jong Un, passionately revering the General Secretary who opened up an avenue toward new progress and victory for our Party and people with his brilliant wisdom and outstanding ideology and theory and provided another epochal milestone to be recorded in the history of the socialist construction. The 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee guided by Kim Jong Un will be brilliantly recorded in the history of our Party and the Juche revolution as a historic meeting which showed more clearly the revolutionary image of the WPK, which is constantly struggling and making renovations, and gave a strong impetus to the all-people grand march for implementing the decisions of the Party congress. Political News Team

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Watches Lunar New Year Performance with Members of Party Central Leadership Organ
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, watched a Lunar New Year performance on Feb. 11 together with members of the Party central leadership organ. The participants were greatly excited to see the significant performance celebrating the Lunar New Year with the General Secretary after taking part in the 2nd plenary meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea to be brilliantly recorded in the history of our Party and Juche-oriented revolution and being given the powerful weapon for practice and innovation for implementing the decisions made at the 8th Congress of the Party. As he entered the auditorium of the theater amid the welcome music, all the participants burst into enthusiastic cheers of "hurrah!" extending the greatest respects to the General Secretary who indicates the broad avenue to fresh advance and victory for the Party and the people with his far-sighted wisdom and extraordinary leadership art and strengthens our Party into the mother party that fights, advances and unconditionally serves the people both in name and reality. The performance given by artistes of the State Merited Chorus and major art troupes included monumental songs reflecting the people's boundless trust in the WPK which has led the country and the people and glorified the annals of the revolution with gigantic changes and victories. The performers sang highly of the greatness of our Party which has confidently led our revolution along the straight path of victory defying unprecedented grim hardships and challenge and demonstrated the might of the country and the people. Resounding through the hall were famous pieces of the era of the Workers' Party showing deep reverence for Kim Jong Un who is opening up the new history of a dignified powerful country with the people-first politics full of warm loving care and devotion to the people, and reflecting the loyalty and single-minded unity of people determined to greet all victories and glory in the road of trusting and following our Party only. Seeing the solemn and noble music world with hymns for the great Party, the audience keenly felt once again the truth that our country and people have immensely bright future despite whatever hardship and difficulties in the road of advance as long as the general secretary leads the Party and the revolution with total dedication to realizing the dream and ideal of people in the spirit of Devoted Service for the People's Wellbeing and the noble idea of single-minded unity and self-reliance. The performance gave rich artistic depiction of the profound loyalty and firm faith of the people to follow the long journey of the revolution demonstrating the might of our-style socialism while holding the red flag of Mt Paektu and the Party flag of guidance as the banner of victory. It reached the climax with orchestra and male chorus "We Will Go along Road of Loyalty" and "We'll Travel One Road Forever". At the end of the performance, the general secretary mounted the stage and thanked the performers for warmly congratulating the success of the plenary meeting of the Party Central Committee while showing absolute support for the revolutionary line and idea of the Party with excellent performance, and had a significant photo taken with them. Acknowledging the enthusiastically cheering audience, the general secretary expressed the conviction that the members of the Party central leadership organ would creditably fulfill their heavy yet honorable responsibility and duty before the revolution in the van of the grand march for implementing the decisions made at the Party Congress, not forgetting even a moment the expectation of all the Party members and people across the country, and encouraged all the participants. Political News Team

title: Members of Missions of International Bodies Pay Floral Tribute to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Members of the UN resident coordinator office and missions of UNDP, UNICEF, United Nations Population Fund, FAO, WFP and WHO here visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill Thursday on the occasion of the Day of the Shining Star (birth anniversary of Kim Jong Il). They made a bow after laying floral baskets at the statues. Rodong Sinmun

title: Manuring and Tending Fruit Trees Brisk in DPRK
body: Fruit farms across the country are directing their efforts into manuring and tending fruit trees. Officials and working people, deeply aware of the importance of manuring and tending fruit trees in the period of seasonal change, have taken substantial measures to put fruit farming on a scientific basis after mapping out detailed plans for doing so. Fruit farms across the country are cutting branches off trees, focusing on increasing their fruit-bearing rate. They are working hard to put management of orchards on a sci-tech basis while increasing the production of quality organic fertilizer. Rodong Sinmun

title: Determined to Bring About Practical Improvement
body: The officials of the Ministry of Machine-building Industry go all out for their work with new determination. The MMI is now mapping out a detailed realistic plan to manufacture modern extractive machines for mines and coal mines. It concentrates its efforts on providing a material and technological guarantee for building the existing production processes of the Ranam Coal Mining Machine Complex, the Tongrim Mining Machine Factory and many other plants along technological lines and manufacturing efficient mining machines. The Anju Insulating Material Factory has regarded it as the main key to the normalization of its production to secure raw and other materials at home and use them for its products as much as possible and accordingly drawn up a detailed step-by-step plan for it. It settles its scientific and technological problems in hand by bringing the creative initiative of its employees into full play. Rodong Sinmun

title: New Sewage Purification Process of Our Style Invented and Applied
body: Pyongyang University of Architecture has recently devised a new separating plate of our style and introduced it into sewage treatment facilities. It has considerably increased their treatment efficiency instead of the former multi-separating plate. Suited to our actual conditions the new plate helps economize on our equipment, materials, ground and electricity a great deal. Applied to the building of Samjiyon City the new plate has already been proved efficient. In Rangnang and Phyongchon Districts it is now being introduced into their sewage treatment plants under reconstruction and expansion. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Tribute to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Working people and service personnel laid floral baskets and bouquets at the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on the occasion of the Lunar New Year's Day, Juche 110 (2021). Floral baskets in the names of the Party, power and armed forces organs, social organizations, ministries, national institutions, units of the Korean People's Army (KPA) and the Public Security Forces (PSF), institutions and industrial establishments and universities at all levels in Pyongyang and bouquets were laid before the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill. The masses made a bow before the statues. Placed at the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il and mosaics of their smiling images in various places of Pyongyang, including Kim Il Sung University, the Ministry of National Defence, the Ministry of Public Security and the Mansudae Art Studio, were floral baskets in the names of units of the KPA and the PSF, institutions and enterprises. Working people and service personnel across the country paid tribute to the statues of the great leaders and mosaics of their smiling images in their residential areas. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Floral Baskets and Congratulatory Letters
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a floral basket and a congratulatory letter from the diplomatic corps here on the occasion of the Day of the Shining Star (birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il). The floral basket and congratulatory letter were conveyed to an official concerned by the Palestinian ambassador to the DPRK, who is doyen of the corps, on Feb. 11. On the same day, Kim Jong Un received floral baskets and congratulatory letters from the Vietnamese and Indian ambassadors to the DPRK. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Floral Basket from General Secretary of C.C., LPRP and Lao President
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a floral basket in the joint name of Thongloun Sisoulith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party (LPRP), and Bounnang Vorachith, president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic, on the occasion of the Day of the Shining Star, the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The floral basket was handed to an official concerned by the Lao ambassador to the DPRK on Feb. 11. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Floral Basket from Palestinian President
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a floral basket from Mahmoud Abbas, president of the State of Palestine, on the occasion of the Day of the Shining Star, the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The floral basket was handed to an official concerned by the Palestinian ambassador to the DPRK on Feb. 11. Rodong Sinmun

title: Lunar New Year's Day Enjoyed in DPRK
body: All the people of the DPRK enjoyed the Lunar New Year's Day, Juche 110 (2021). An endless stream of people visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the sacred temple of Juche, carrying the best wishes for President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. The visitors looked back with deep emotion on the revolutionary careers and feats of the President and the Chairman. People and service personnel of the People's Army visited the statues of the President and the Chairman and mosaics of their smiling images on Mansu Hill and in other parts of the country. They laid floral baskets and bouquets and made a bow before the statues and mosaics. Happy laughter could be heard in every family celebrating the Lunar New Year's Day. Greetings, encouragement, inspiration and best wishes shared by people showed the true appearance of a large socialist family holding the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un in high esteem as their father. The dwelling houses, villages and streets newly built across the country were full of happy laughter. Public catering establishments across the country delighted the visitors with kind holiday service. People spent a pleasant time, tasting national dishes and local dishes at Okryu Restaurant and Chongryu Restaurant in Pyongyang, Kyongam Restaurant in Sariwon City and other public catering establishments. Outdoor stalls in different parts of the capital city were crowded with citizens enjoying the holiday. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Photo Exhibition Opens to Celebrate Birth Anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: A national photo exhibition "The great guidance steering the campaign for defending socialism to victory" opened to celebrate the 79th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Displayed at the exhibition hall are photos showing the immortal feats of Chairman Kim Jong Il who firmly defended the dignity and sovereignty of the country and the nation and provided the firm foundation for the building of a powerful socialist nation and the personality of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un as a great man. Also displayed there are photos showing the proud reality of the country, where a new era of prosperity is being ushered in under the wise guidance of the Workers' Party of Korea, and the appearance of the people who are fully enjoying their independent and creative life. An opening ceremony took place at the People's Palace of Culture on Feb. 12. Present there were Pak Thae Song, secretary of the C.C., the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), Choe Hui Thae, chairman of the Pyongyang City People's Committee, Kim Pong Sok, secretary of the Pyongyang City Committee of the WPK, officials concerned and working people in the city. Rodong Sinmun

title: Kim Jong Un Sends Gifts to Employees of Sangwon Cement Complex
body: The scene of love and trust shown by the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) was unfolded at the Sangwon Cement Complex, the leading cement production base where the spirit of new innovation and advance runs high to implement the decisions made at the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the WPK. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un has always shown deep concern for the workers of the complex by putting forward them as the frontline soldiers realizing the WPK's plan for grand building and by sending a congratulatory message to them when they achieved unprecedented successes in cement production. He showed the fatherly love of sending benevolent gifts again to them all out in the new charge for increased production. The gifts sent by General Secretary of the WPK Kim Jong Un carry his deep trust and expectation that the workers of the complex, who have responded to the Party's call in practice at all times, would glorify the advance of the first year for implementing the decisions made at the 8th Party Congress with greater increased production of cement by giving further momentum to the elated spirit. A meeting for conveying the gifts sent by the General Secretary took place on the spot on Sunday. Attending the meeting were officials and employees of the complex. Kim Tong Il, first vice department director of the Central Committee of the WPK, made an address for conveying the gifts. He said in excitement that the General Secretary took benevolent measures of sending rare marine products to the workers of the complex together with even cuisine. Noting that the workers of the Sangwon Cement Complex are the blessed people who are living under the trust and love of the Party Central Committee, he said that the General Secretary is always trusting in the working class of the complex in the grand construction campaign. He stressed that the working class of the complex should take the lead of the country in implementing the decisions made at the Party Congress by unconditionally carrying out the cement production task for this year for implementing the decisions made at the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the WPK and winning victory in the struggle for expanding production capacity. There were pledge speeches at the meeting. The speakers said in excitement that the moving reality at the complex is reflective of the love that can be shown only by Marshal Kim Jong Un who set "The people are God" as the noble idea of the WPK, and extended gratitude to him. They expressed their firm will to carry out without fail any task entrusted by the Party with the great pride of being taken closest by the General Secretary. Then the gifts sent by Kim Jong Un were conveyed to the employees of the complex. Rodong Sinmun

title: Inspiring Posters Produced
body: The Mansudae Art Studio, the Central Fine Arts Studio and Pyongyang University of Fine Arts in the DPRK produced posters encouraging the people to implement the decisions made at the Second Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). The poster "All out for the implementation of the decisions made at the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea!" appeals to all the Party members and other working people to turn out as one in a new revolutionary march with their intense loyalty to the Party's cause. Posters "Let us carry through the first year's tasks of the five-year plan set forth at the Eighth Party Congress!" and "Let us carry out the national economic plan for this year without fail!" are penetrated with the idea on unconditionally hitting the first year's targets for implementing the new five-year plan by courageously overcoming the existing challenges and difficulties by dint of self-reliance and science and technology. There is also a poster showing a smelter throwing the letters "passivity" and "self-protection" into a furnace full of red molten iron, which calls for categorically removing the ideological maladies obstructive to the progress and making redoubled efforts to fulfill the five-year plan through fresh innovation, bold creation and uninterrupted advance. Another poster "Let us bring about substantial change and advance in the first year of carrying out the five-year plan!" clearly shows the WPK's firm resolution and will to push forward the economic construction and provide the people with more stable and better living conditions despite the protracted emergency anti-epidemic situation. Rodong Sinmun

title: Day of Shining Star Celebrated Abroad
body: There took place meetings, seminars and lectures in Russia, Ukraine, Austria and Algeria from February 1 to 6 on the occasion of the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il (the Day of the Shining Star). The first secretary of the Khabarovsk Territorial Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation at a meeting praised Kim Jong Il as a true revolutionary who made great contributions to not only the Korean revolution but also the accomplishment of the cause of global independence. The first secretary of the Amur Regional Branch Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation said at a lecture that the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) had invariably advanced under the leadership of Kim Jong Il, holding high the banner of socialism, and fully demonstrated its might as a political, ideological and military power. The chairman of the Ukrainian "Treasured Sword of Songun" Association for the Study of the Juche Idea at a meeting of organizations for the study of the Juche idea of Ukraine noted that Kim Jong Il saved the destiny of socialism by pursuing the original Songun politics at a time when socialism collapsed one after another in east European countries and the imperialists openly resorted to the moves for stifling the DPRK. The chief of the Group for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism in Vienna and the chairman of the Algeria-Korea Friendship Association at seminars praised Kim Jong Il as a genuine popular leader. Meanwhile, an internet photo exhibition for celebrating the Day of the Shining Star opened in Russia on Feb. 6 and 8. Photos of Kim Jong Il were posted on Patrioti Moskva and other internet homepages. Also posted on the homepages were photos showing orders, medals, titles of honor and gifts presented to the peerlessly great man by many countries. Rodong Sinmun

title: Seminars on Chairman Kim Jong Il's Exploits Held Abroad
body: Seminars on the exploits of Chairman Kim Jong Il took place in Nepal, Bangladesh, Romania and Uganda between Feb. 3 and 7 in the run-up to the Day of the Shining Star, his birth anniversary. Speeches were made there. The general secretary of the Central Committee of the Nepal Communist Party (Marxist-Leninist) who is ex-deputy prime minister of Nepal noted that Chairman Kim Jong Il enriched the Juche idea founded by President Kim Il Sung to formulate it as the guiding ideology of the Workers' Party of Korea and consolidated the single-hearted unity of the whole society as firm as a rock. The chairman of the Socialist Party of Romania said that the DPRK could shine as the beacon of hope for the progressive humankind and an invincible socialist fortress thanks to Kim Jong Il's energetic ideo-theoretical activities and distinguished guidance. The chairman of the Romania-Korea Friendship Association stressed that Kim Jong Il, possessed of passionate love for the country and the people as his inborn disposition, dedicated all his life to the prosperity of socialist Korea. Personages of the Ugandan National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea, the Ugandan National Executive Committee of the Pan-African Movement and the Uganda-DPRK Friendship Association praised Kim Jong Il for defending the country's sovereignty and people's wellbeing while winning a series of victories in the acute showdown with the imperialists under the unfurled banner of Songun during the harshest-ever period. At a seminar co-sponsored by the National Socialist Party, the Workers' Party, the Jatiya Party, the People's League and the Institute of the Juche Idea of Bangladesh, speakers lauded the undying feats performed by Kim Jong Il before the country and the people, the times and history. Congratulatory messages to the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un were adopted at the seminars held in Nepal. Rodong Sinmun

title: At Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex
body: The workers and management of the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex strive tenaciously to accelerate the substantial manufacture of its iron and steel products from the beginning of this year which marks the first year of the five-year plan for the national economic development. Those of its furnace shop make efforts to improve the method of the operation of their furnace by oxygen blast further and thus boost the production of their iron and steel. Rodong Sinmun

title: A Medium-and Small-sized Farm Implements Show Helped toward Accelerating Farm Work
body: Some time ago a medium- and small-sized farm implements show was held at Mangyongdae District for two days. Its farms had so far submitted their medium- and small-sized farm implements into a place for exhibition and judgment purposes. But the show was held the way judges went round their workteams and subworkteams and inspected and evaluated their medium- and small-sized farm implements. The agricultural officials and workers of the district repaired and maintained their farm implements qualitatively and paid attention to making new rational ones for themselves on the other hand. Consequently, they invented and made handy efficient ones of many kinds anew and remodeled their existing ones profitably. The show marked an important occasion for vigorously stepping up the agricultural production of agricultural officials and workers. Rodong Sinmun

title: Working People's Organizations Give Performances
body: Performances of the art squads of the Central Committee of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League and the C.C. of the Union of Agricultural Workers took place on Sunday on the occasion of the Day of the Shining Star, the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The art performance "We will carry on the march started from Mt Paektu" was given by the art squad of the Central Committee of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League at the Central Youth Hall. Put on the stage of the performance that started with prelude "General Star" were chorus "Song of General Kim Jong Il", immortal revolutionary hymn, dialogic poem "Whole Life of Our General", male chorus "Thunder over Jong Il Peak", narration and song "Snow Falls on Road to Front" and other colorful programs. Also put on the stage of the performance were programs reflecting boundless honor of the Korean youth leading worthwhile life under the leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un and showing the revolutionary enthusiasm of our youth who will demonstrate the brave spirit and fighting efficiency in the struggle for implementing the decisions made at the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. An art performance "Heaven of destiny to be believed in forever" was given by the art squad of the Central Committee of the Union of Agricultural Workers at the Jangchon Vegetable Cooperative Farm, Sadong District of Pyongyang. Put on the stage were narration and chorus "We Celebrate", dialogic poem "General and Snowstorm", female trio "General's Way to Front" and other programs. Other programs, showing the world of noble love of Kim Jong Un making ceaseless journey of dedication to people and the new appearance of modern socialist farm villages and new history of change, were put on the stage. Watching the performances were Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, Hong Chol Jin, secretary of the Pyongyang City Committee of the WPK, officials of the Youth League and the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea, teachers and students of revolutionary schools and youth and agricultural workers in the city. Rodong Sinmun

title: Conference for Reviewing Work of Forest Restoration Campaign and General Mobilization for Land Administration Held
body: A video conference for reviewing the work of forest restoration campaign and general mobilization for land administration was held at the People's Palace of Culture on Sunday. Present at the conference were Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, O Su Yong, secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, and other leading officials of the Party and government, officials of the Cabinet, commissions, ministries and national institutions, educational institutions and provincial, city and county Party and power organs and officials in the field of forest restoration and land and environment protection. Also present there were Kim Jong Gwan, minister of National Defence of the DPRK, and officials of the armed forces organs. At the conference successes and lessons gained in the forest restoration campaign and the general mobilization for land administration last year were analyzed and reviewed, and measures for innovatively mapping out plan for making practical change and substantial advance from the first year of the implementation of the new five-year plan and for bringing about a decisive turn in management of the land and protection of ecological environment were discussed. A video clip on the forest restoration campaign and general mobilization for land administration last year was shown at the conference. The conference touched upon deviations in last year's forest restoration and general mobilization for land administration. The conference called upon all the officials to take the lead in the struggle for transforming the whole country into a socialist fairyland, a beautiful land as befitting the era of the Workers' Party with conviction that we can build a powerful socialist nation with our own efforts, technology and natural resources. Rodong Sinmun

title: Streets of Pyongyang Bedecked with Flowers
body: Streets of the capital city of the DPRK are bedecked with flowers on the occasion of the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Determined to turn the streets into a sea of beautiful flowers on the meaningful holiday in February, the officials in charge of horticulture under the Pyongyang City People's Committee and the employees of floricultural stations in all districts have cultivated tens of thousands of potted flowers with great care despite winter weather to decorate scores of planters in a spectacular fashion. Rodong Sinmun

title: Congratulatory Letter to Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un from Chongryon Central Standing Committee
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a congratulatory letter from the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) on Feb.16, the 79th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The letter said that the revolutionary career of Kim Jong Il was a great life in which he devoted his all to the prosperity of the country and happiness of the people true to the noble intention of President Kim Il Sung. The letter noted that Kim Jong Il is a great teacher of Chongryon and Koreans in Japan and defender of their destiny who had always led Chongryon to be the pioneer of patriotism, model of patriotism and loyalty and model organization of overseas compatriots' movement in the world, true to the high intention of the President. The history of ardent affection and kindred relation made between Kim Jong Il and Koreans in Japan is given steady continuity thanks to the parental love and tender care of Kim Jong Un, the letter said. It stressed that all the officials of Chongryon and Koreans in Japan, who celebrate the significant Day of the Shining Star at a historic time when the cause of Juche enters a new period of great upsurge and turn, are fully determined with loyalty to uphold the noble ideals of "The people are God", single-minded unity and self-reliance indicated by Kim Jong Un and usher in a new golden age of the movement of Koreans in Japan, keeping their hearts pulsating to the same beat as the speed of the general march of the people in the homeland and their pace with it. The letter sincerely wished Kim Jong Un good health for the victorious advance and bright future of the cause of Juche and the patriotic cause of Chongryon in reflection of the intense loyalty of all the Chongryon officials and other Koreans in Japan and their boundless reverence for him. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Congratulatory Message from AINDF
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a congratulatory message from the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front (AINDF) on Feb. 16 on the occasion of the 79th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The message paid the highest tribute to Kim Jong Il, the eternal sun of Juche, and also extended the highest glory to and warm congratulations to President of the State Affairs Kim Jong Un leading the revolutionary cause of Juche, pioneered on Mt Paektu, to victory only. It said that Feb. 16, 1942, when Kim Jong Il was born as the Shining Star of Mt Paektu amid the ardent desire of the nation at the anti-Japanese war when the gunfire sounded, was the day of great fortune when the Korean people were blessed with another illustrious leader and brilliant commander and the great auspicious day that promised the eternal victory and glory for the nation.
