It noted that his sacred revolutionary career is shining as the holy career of the illustrious leader of the people who dedicated his all to the country and nation and as the history of illustrious commander characterized by ceaseless victories in the annals of the revolutionary cause of Juche. It said that the revolutionary cause of Juche adorned with the ever-victorious glorious course thanks to Kim Jong Il has greeted a period of new transformation and a great upsurge unprecedented in history thanks to Kim Jong Un, the peerlessly great man and illustrious leader. It said that vanguard fighters and patriotic people from all walks of life of the south keenly feeling the great national fortune and honor of being led by peerlessly great men and patriots generation after generation are full of firm pledge to work hard for national reunification and for national cause of independence, upholding the great President of the State Affairs Kim Jong Un in single mind. Reflecting the unanimous mind of reformists and other patriotic people from all walks of life in the south, the AINDF in the message sincerely wished Kim Jong Un good health. Rodong Sinmun

title: Congratulatory Letter to Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un from General Association of Koreans in China
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a congratulatory letter from the General Association of Koreans in China on February 16, the 79th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The general association in its congratulatory letter extended the noblest respect and ever-lasting glory to Kim Jong Il and congratulations to Kim Jong Un who is translating into practice the patriotic desire of Kim Jong Il for building a powerful country. The letter said that the whole life of Kim Jong Il was the noble one of the peerless patriot and great revolutionary who performed immortal exploits for the country and nation, for the times and history by leading only to victory the revolutionary cause of Juche pioneered by President Kim Il Sung. It stressed that the noble revolutionary career and immortal exploits of Kim Jong Il who devoted his whole life to turning the country into a great powerful socialist country and paradise for the people would shine long along with the history of the prosperous country. The revolutionary cause of Juche pioneered and led to victory by the great leaders has now greeted a new period of a great upsurge and turn as we hold in high esteem Kim Jong Un, another heaven-sent great man of Paektu, it noted. It said that the energetic guidance provided by Kim Jong Un by glorifying the 8th Congress of the dignified Workers' Party of Korea as the one of honor and victory has boosted pride and self-confidence of Koreans in China as being overseas citizens of the Republic, inspired them with the confidence in the rosy future of the country and encouraged them and made the whole planet seethe with deep reverence for him. It expressed the determination to make a tangible contribution to the patriotic work of building a prosperous country, keeping pace with the people of the country who are making dynamic advance and positively contribute to the development of the DPRK-China friendly relations with socialism as the core. The letter stressed that the general association wholeheartedly wishes Kim Jong Un, who represents the great power of our country and the brilliant glory to it and is the benevolent father of all the Koreans in China, good health. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Tribute to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Service personnel of the Korean People's Army (KPA) and working people laid floral baskets and bouquets at the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in different parts of the country on the occasion of the Day of the Shining Star, the Chairman's birth anniversary. Placed before the statues on Mansu Hill were bouquets and floral baskets in the names of the Party, power and armed forces organs, public organizations, ministries, national institutions, units of the KPA and the Public Security Forces (PSF) and institutions, industrial establishments and universities at all levels in Pyongyang. The chief and members of the Pyongyang mission of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front laid bouquet before the statues. Floral baskets in the names of KPA and PSF units, institutions and enterprises were also laid at the statues of the great leaders and mosaics of their smiling images in different parts of Pyongyang, including Kim Il Sung University, the Ministry of National Defence and the Mansudae Art Studio. The masses made a deep bow to the statues and mosaics. Working people and servicepersons visited the statues of the great leaders and mosaics of their smiling images in provinces, cities and counties to pay homage to them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Congratulatory Message from Syrian President
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, received a congratulatory message from Bashar Al-Assad, president of the Syrian Arab Republic, on February 11. The message sent the sincere and warmest congratulations to Kim Jong Un and through him, to the friendly people of his country on the occasion of the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The message also wished the DPRK greater progress, prosperity and development all the time as desired by President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, the great leaders. It affirmed aspiration and will to develop in depth in all fields the historic relations and mutual cooperation between the two countries in the interest of their friendly peoples. It extended warm greeting to Kim Jong Un, wishing him good health and happiness always. Rodong Sinmun

title: Unjong Pig Farm Completed
body: The Unjong Pig Farm of the State Academy of Sciences was successfully inaugurated. The completion of the farm has laid a material and technical foundation for putting all problems arising in meat production on an optimal and modern basis and for introducing the successes into the whole country. The farm, of which all production lines are labour-, energy- and land-saving, is equipped with home-made facilities to be a model pig farm. Choe Sang Gon, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Kim Sung Jin, president of the State Academy of Sciences, Ri Chol Yong, chief secretary of Party committee of the State Academy of Sciences, and officials concerned looked around the newly-built pig farm on Monday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Art Performances Given by Art Squads of Central Committees of GFTUK and SWUK
body: Art performances were given by the working people's organizations on Monday on the occasion of the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Watching the performances were Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), Pak In Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea (GFTUK), Jang Chun Sil, chairwoman of the Central Committee of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea (SWUK), Hong Chol Jin, secretary of the Pyongyang City Committee of the WPK, officials and members of the GFTUK and SWUK and other working people. The Workers' Art Group of the Central Committee of the GFTUK gave a performance at the Central Hall of Workers. The hall was full of yearning and reverence for Kim Jong Il and put on the stage were numbers including chorus "Glory to General" and male solo "Red Chol Pass". The Art Squad of the Central Committee of the SWUK gave a performance at the Hall of Women. Put on the stage were colorful numbers including narration and chorus "Greeting Spring on Jong Il Peak" and instrumental ensemble "The Sound of a Horse's Hooves in Mt. Paektu". The performances showed well the firm faith of all the workers and women across the country to add eternal luster to the immortal feats performed by Kim Jong Il for the country, revolution, the times and the history and vigorously turn out in the struggle for implementing the important tasks put forward by the 8th Party Congress, true to the leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Kim Jong Il Youth Honor Prize, Kim Jong Il Children Honor Prize Awarded
body: Kim Jong Il Youth Honor Prize and Kim Jong Il Children Honor Prize were awarded to exemplary primary committees, officials and members of the youth league and members of the children's union on the occasion of the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. According to a decree of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, Kim Jong Il Youth Honor Prize went to 27 primary committees and 23 officials and members of the youth league. Kim Jong Il Children Honor Prize was awarded to 108 members of the children's union. Rodong Sinmun

title: Kim Jong Il Prize Awarded to Sin Kyun
body: Kim Jong Il Prize was awarded to Sin Kyun on the occasion of the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. He has made a great contribution to adding shine to the immortal exploits performed by Kim Jong Il for the country and revolution, for the times and history and to educating the Party members and working people in the greatness of our Party with his literary activities while working in the field of the Party ideological work for long. A relevant decree of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea was issued on February 14. Rodong Sinmun

title: Order of Kim Jong Il Conferred on Meritorious Officials
body: Order of Kim Jong Il was conferred on Song Yong Gyu, Hwang In Song and Cha Yong Chol on the occasion of the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. They have organized and aroused the popular masses to the struggle to implement the Party's idea and safeguard the Party policies through excellent political work in the fighting spirit of devotedly implementing them with the boundless loyalty to the Party and the spirit of making selfless, devoted efforts for the good of the people, thus making great contributions to the socialist construction. A relevant decree of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK was made public on Feb. 14. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Floral Basket from Nigerian President
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a floral basket from Muhammadu Buhari, president and commander-in-chief of the Armed Forces of the Federal Republic of Nigeria, on the occasion of the Day of the Shining Star, the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The floral basket was conveyed to an official concerned by the charge d'affaires ad interim of the Nigerian embassy here on Feb. 15. A congratulatory letter to Kim Jong Un from the Nigerian charge d'affaires ad interim was also conveyed. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Baskets to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il from Abroad
body: Floral baskets were sent to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill by the family of Kim Sun Ok who is related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, the family of Chai Shiying, Chinese related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, the family of Ya. T. Nobichenko who was an internationalist soldier, the Anti-Imperialist Forum of Germany, the Switzerland-Korea Committee, Giancarlo Elia Valori, president of the International Group of Italy, Rufino Ndong Esono Nuchama, minister of Culture, Tourism, Promotion of Handicrafts of Equatorial Guinea, and Svetlana Odintzova, member of the Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation, on the occasion of the Day of the Shining Star, the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The floral baskets were laid before the statues of the great leaders on Feb. 15. On the same day, a floral basket sent by Sim Chong Song, chairman of the association of Korean nationality in Dandong City of China, was laid before the statues. Rodong Sinmun

title: Youth Pledge to Implement First Year's Task of New Five-year Plan
body: A meeting of the young vanguard was held at the Pyongyang City Youth Park Open-Air Theatre on Thursday to vow to thoroughly implement the first year's task of the new five-year plan put forward at the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). Attending the meeting were Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, officials of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League, officials concerned and youth and students in Pyongyang. Pak Chol Min, chairman of the Central Committee of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League, said in his speech that young vanguard across the country were full of enthusiasm to implement the first year's task of the new five-year plan without fail upon receiving the news of the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee at which the noble love of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un for the people was vividly shown. He said when the whole country is imbued with the enthusiasm of the young people for the revolution, struggle and patriotism, our Party's intention to bring about a practical change and substantial progress from the first year's advance for implementing the decisions of the 8th Party Congress would brilliantly be realized. He called upon all the young people to perform miracles and feats in the all-out charge this year with confidence in new victory as befitting sons and daughters of the Workers' Party and youth of Juche Korea who were raised under the care of the Party. He ardently called on the youth across the country to work hard to glorify the advance of the first year for implementing the decisions of the 8th Party Congress with proud innovation and advancement by demonstrating the high spirit of young vanguard in the great era of Kim Jong Un. Pledge speeches were made. The speakers expressed their will to glorify days and months of the advance of the first year for implementing the decisions of the 8th Party Congress with courageous practical actions, not in words. A letter of pledge to Kim Jong Un was adopted at the meeting. Then there was a procession of young vanguard. Citizens waved their hands, encouraging the dependable and lively youth sharing the same thought, breath and footstep with the Party amid revolutionary songs reverberating through the streets. Rodong Sinmun

title: Agricultural Workers Vow to Reap Bumper Crop
body: Agricultural workers and members of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea (UAWK) met at the plaza before the statue of President Kim Il Sung in Chongsan-ri, Kangso District, on Thursday to pledge to thoroughly implement the first year's task of the new 5-year plan set forth at the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). Present at the meeting were Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, Choe Yong, secretary of the Nampho City Committee of the WPK, officials concerned, officials of the UAWK and agricultural workers and members of the UAWK in Kangso District. Han Jong Hyok, chairman of the UAWK Central Committee, made a speech at the meeting. He said that organizations and officials of the UAWK should concentrate focus of their work on attaining the goal of the grain production for this year without fail with high sense of responsibility and extraordinary ideological readiness. He called for developing the agricultural production, stockbreeding and fruit farming, with efforts put on seed selection, scientific farming, increased grain production on low-yielding fields, and on cultivating new land and reclaiming tideland, and for holding fast to the irrigation and mechanization of the rural economy as a major strategic task. He stressed need to bring about a radical turn in its work by turning the units associated with the leadership feats of the Party into model ones, generalizing them and conducting dynamic campaigns in which one overtakes and learns from others and swaps experience with each other. He said that officials should come up with new ideas and display innovative work style, putting an end to passiveness, self-protection, formalism and old-fashioned manner of work, and should become standard-bearers in actively arousing the popular masses with their frontline-style political campaign, skilled commands and practical deeds. At the meeting the speakers pledged to uphold our Party and defend socialism with increased grain production, bearing in mind the plan and intention of the Party Central Committee to bring about a practical turn and substantial advance from the first year of the new 5-year plan. A letter of pledge to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un was adopted at the meeting. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Reply Message to Syrian President
body: Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a reply message to Bashar Al-Assad, president of the Syrian Arab Republic, on Feb. 17. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un in his message expressed deep thanks to the Syrian president for sending warm congratulations and the best wishes to him on the 79th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il who lives alive in the hearts of the Korean people and the world progressives. Expressing belief that the historic relations of friendship and cooperation between the two countries provided by the preceding leaders would invariably grow stronger, Kim Jong Un wished the Syrian president good health and the Syrian people bigger success in their just struggle. Rodong Sinmun

title: More Electricity Produced
body: The workers and management of the Sodusu Power Stations 1, 2 and 3 have produced 100,000-odd kilowatt hours more of electricity on a daily average in February, too, since last January they began carrying out their assignments under the five-year plan set forth at the 8th Congress of the WPK. They boost the production of their electricity with the same quantity of water as ever. Those of the 3rd power station in particular augment the output of their electricity by introducing new-type hydraulic turbines into their generators in liaison with many units. The workers of the Anbyon Youth Power Station 2, too, take thorough technological care of their machines, thereby registering high results in the output of their electricity. Rodong Sinmun

title: An Obliging Country Where Everybody Is in Charge of Their Doctor
body: The district medical care system symbolizes the superiority of the socialist healthcare system. Under the system the health of all our people is benefitted and protected by doctors in charge of them all their life. The system was inaugurated toward the end of the 1940s in our country. Active efforts had been made since 1961 to enforce it there in an all-round way. The system was developed into the present system of doctors’ medical care for families further late in the 1980s. All clinics countrywide retain data on the health and diseases of all individual residents in their charge. Rodong Sinmun

title: Pines Planted Anew in Pyongyang
body: Great numbers of pines, the national tree of Korea, have recently been planted round the Pothong Gate and in many other parts of downtown Pyongyang to catch the eye. The officials and workers of Sosong, Central, Songyo, Moranbong and Rangnang Districts showed great patriotic enthusiasm for the tree-planting project. The pines add great beauty to the scenes of downtown Pyongyang. Rodong Sinmun

title: Novel Distinctive Industrial Art Designs Produced
body: The artists of the Korean Industrial Art Studio draw excellent utility and aesthetic designs to conform to the ever-growing level of the civilization of our people. They include designs for the trademarks of goods, clothes and others plus lots of their current designs. The KIAS focuses its efforts on ensuring that all its artists practice themselves in designing a great deal so as to improve their techniques. Besides, it arranges for their designs under creation to be reviewed and evaluated jointly so that they can be masterpieces. In the final analysis, the artists produce singular industrial art designs by dint of hard work. Rodong Sinmun

title: After Finding out Practical Method to Increase Production
body: Factories and enterprises in South Hamgyong Province work tenaciously to map out realistic scientific plans for their technological development and carry them out. Above all they define their cost reduction and quality enhancement as an important way to boost their production and vigorously carry on their technological innovation drive. Rodong Sinmun

title: In Ryanggang Province
body: Ryanggang Province strives to move its potato farming on to a better scientific footing and increases its agricultural production securely despite its adverse weather conditions. It analyzed its last year’s farming in depth and formulated a realistic scientific scheme for effecting innovations in its potato farming this year which marks the start of the execution of another five-year plan. Before everything else it regards the Party’s policy of accomplishing a green revolution as its lifeline and pays close attention to securing seeds of high-yielding fine varieties in plenty. While preparing for its potato farming it makes great efforts to turn out mineral fertilizer with raw materials available in its land. Besides, dynamic technological innovations are brought about in invigorating the production of organic compound fertilizer in the province. RP actively steps up the production of vegetable agricultural chemicals of various kinds which serve as good insecticide and germicide. Rodong Sinmun

title: Efforts Made for Securing Seed-bed Materials
body: The labor and management of the Kosan Cooperative Farm in Jaeryong County channel their efforts on securing materials for their seedbeds. The officials of the KCF called at its workteams and subworkteams and arranged for them in detail to get materials for their seedbeds ready to meet the demand of technology for them. Consequently, the materials are procured with speed and success. Rodong Sinmun

title: Eager to Contribute to Grain Production
body: The workers and management of a farm machine station in Jungsan County repair tractors and produce their accessories at full steam. They are all very zealous to do that by recourse to science and technology overtaking and outstripping each other, learning from each other and exchanging experiences with each other. Rodong Sinmun

title: Intensive Lecture and Propaganda Brisk in North Phyongan Province
body: The Party organizations of North Phyongan Province ensure that their propaganda squads give intensive lectures on Party policies at factories and farms to inspire audiences to further efforts. The Committee of Cholsan County of the Workers’ Party of Korea sets an example to others in this. The Committees of Yomju, Kwaksan and Sonchon Counties of the WPK, too, do good work with the members of their propaganda squads and make sure that they give energetic frontline lectures at local industry factories, cooperative farms and other major construction sites and encourage the masses to work hard. Rodong Sinmun

title: Continuous Aids to Cooperative Farms
body: North Phyongan Province dynamically supports its cooperative farms. A few days ago motortrucks left the Sinuiju Square for the fields of cooperative farms laden with urban manure. The officials and working people of North Hamgyong Province continue bending every effort to support its cooperative farms. Rodong Sinmun

title: Efforts Focused on Prospect and Tunneling
body: In the domain of the coal industry the officials do their best to give priority to prospecting and tunneling and thus procure coalfields in great numbers. Active endeavors are made to give impetus to prospecting by all means. The Ministry of Coal Industry focuses on ensuring that the production processes of a factory for the accessories of prospecting machines which belongs to the Kaechon Area Coal Mining Complex are speedily readjusted and reinforced to opportunely produce prospecting machines of various kinds and their spare parts. In addition, it concentrates its prospecting teams on its coal mines of importance in boosting the coal production of the country and its other large-scale prospective coalfields which can be opened up without difficulty. Rodong Sinmun

title: Metal Industrial Sector Seethes with Enthusiasm to Increase Production of Iron and Steel
body: In the sector of the metalworking industry workers and management began executing another five-year plan last January and have therefore stirred themselves to effect innovations in the manufacture of their iron and steel products this year. The labor and management of the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex do their utmost to boost the production of their iron and steel in February, too, as in January. Those of the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex and the Chollima Steel Complex, too, strive hard to increase the production of their iron and steel concentrating their energies on readjusting and strengthening the foundations for their production. Those of the Musan Mining Complex, the Unryul and Jaeryong Mines, the Hungnam Terminal Factory and other related units also do all they can to thoroughly carry out the decisions of the 2nd plenary meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the WPK. The sphere of the coal industry adopts detailed technical measures to preferentially provide metalworking plants with coal. Those officials engaged in the field of transport exert their efforts on composing freight cars and directing their running to satisfactorily transport raw materials and fuel to metallurgical plants in good time. Rodong Sinmun

title: Day of Shining Star Marked in India
body: Personages of the Communist Party of India, the Communist Party of India (Marxist), the national committee of minorities of India, the Nationalist Congress Party of India, the Indian People's Party and the All-India Forward Bloc made public a joint statement on Feb. 11 ahead of the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il, the Day of the Shining Star. The joint statement said that the Chairman's whole life was indeed a noble life during which he dedicated his everything to the people always finding himself among them. His leadership clearly proved that to consistently hold fast to the principle of independence in all fields would ensure that a country, nation and socialism are defended from the aggressive moves by the imperialists and the people are provided with a happy life, the statement pointed out. It stressed that the gigantic feats performed by the Chairman for the development of the DPRK are shining more brilliantly thanks to the seasoned guidance provided by the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) at present. It expressed pleasure at the recent achievements made by the Korean people and the single-hearted unity of Korean society that has been more firmly cemented. It expressed belief that the WPK which has just wrapped up its Eighth Congress with success would continue to lead the people to victory in the future, too. Rodong Sinmun

title: Koreans in China Celebrate Day of Shining Star
body: Koreans in China held events on Feb. 16, the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il (Day of the Shining Star). The General Association of Koreans in China and the family of a vice-chairperson of the Jilin Province Regional Association of the general association laid floral baskets before the statue of President Kim Il Sung at Yuwen Middle School in Jilin. Officials of the general association laid a floral basket and made a bow before an art work depicting President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il at the DPRK Consulate General in Shenyang. The Federation of Korean Economic Workers in China and the Association of Young Korean Nationals in China placed a floral basket and made a bow before the portraits of smiling Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il at the DPRK mission in Dandong. A congratulatory letter of the general association to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un was adopted with due ceremony in Shenyang, China. Present there were officials of the general association and members of the Shenyang City Branch of the Liaoning Regional Association. At the end of the ceremony, the participants heard the audio clip "By waging a hot campaign for embodying Kim Jong Il's patriotism" and watched the video clip "Report on the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea". The participants vowed to turn out as one in the pro-reunification patriotic movement for achieving the prosperity of the country and ushering in a new era of independent reunification, keeping pace with the dynamic advance of the people in the homeland who are breaking through head-on all difficulties with the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance in their all-out campaign for bringing about a new victory in the socialist construction. Meanwhile, members of the Federation of Korean Economic Workers in China and the Association of Young Korean Nationals in China celebrated the Day of the Shining Star, singing the song "February Is Spring". Rodong Sinmun

title: Day of Shining Star Marked in Russia
body: The United Confederation of Koreans in Russia held an event at its building on February 12 to mark the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il (Day of the Shining Star). Attending the event were members of the confederation, Koreans in Russia and members of the Russian Association for Friendship and Cultural Cooperation with the DPRK. Kim Chil Song, chairman of the United Confederation of Koreans in Russia, made a congratulatory speech to be followed by others. Speakers highly praised Kim Jong Il as the great teacher who enriched the Juche idea with his energetic ideological and theoretical activities and provided a powerful ideological and theoretical weapon to the progressives aspiring after a new world free from aggression and war. They said that socialist Korea is now demonstrating its might as an invincible power thanks to the leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un who is carrying forward the idea and cause of Kim Jong Il. Sok Song, first vice-chairman of the confederation, cordially notified that Kim Jong Un was elected as general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), according to the unanimous will of all the members of the Party. The participants extended the highest glory and warmest congratulations to Kim Jong Un upon his election as general secretary of the WPK. Sok Song talked in detail about the 8th Congress of the WPK and the tasks set forth at the Congress. A performance was given by Korean artistes in Russia. Put on the stage were colorful numbers including the immortal revolutionary hymn "Song of General Kim Jong Il", the immortal classic "Jindallae" (Azalea) and dance "Puchaechum" (dance with fans). Rodong Sinmun

title: To Produce Peculiar Foodstuffs with Locally Available Raw Materials
body: The labor and management of the Jangjasan General Foodstuff Factory strive hard to mass-produce foodstuffs of various kinds indigenous to Jagang Province. Through in-depth popular discussions the JGFF seeks a solution to producing cakes with the rye abundantly available in the province. In addition, it studies how to better the quality of its corn syrup and okdang sugar and settle the problems of many other foodstuffs. Rodong Sinmun

title: Fertilizer Production Target Hit Day after Day
body: The workers of the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex and the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex vigorously speed up the production of fertilizer for the socialist cooperative farms in an endeavor to carry out the decisions of the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea. The workers and management of the NYCC are now operating their two separate processes of fertilizer production simultaneously and registering high results in their daily output. The HFC, too, tries its hardest to turn out fertilizer. While a socialist emulation for its increased production is conducted vigorously among all its workshops their workers, without exception, are all out to turn out fertilizer to strictly meet the demand of the methods of standard operation and technological regulations. Rodong Sinmun

title: So as to Set This Year’s Target with Purposefulness of Development
body: Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Ambassador Presents Credentials to Sultan of Oman
body: The DPRK ambassador presented his credentials to the sultan of Oman on Feb. 15. DPRK Ambassador Ma Tong Hui courteously conveyed the greetings from Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, to Sultan Haitham Bin Tariq Al Said. The sultan expressed deep thanks for it and asked the ambassador to convey his warm greetings to His Excellency Kim Jong Un. The sultan said he sincerely hoped everything would go well in the DPRK, expressing his expectation that the friendly relations between the two countries would steadily develop in the future, too. Rodong Sinmun

title: Artistes of Wangjaesan Art Troupe on Tour Gives First Performance
body: at Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex The song of march of self-reliance resounds far and wide, instilling confidence in victory and courage into the minds of the Korean people all out in the first year's struggle for carrying the new five-year plan to implement the decisions made at the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea. The artistes of the Wangjaesan Art Troupe, who started their performance tour, gave the first music and dance performance in Songrim on Feb. 20. The house of culture at the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex, the venue of the performance, was overflowing with delight and excitement of the workers of the complex to see the performance by the artistes of the Wangjaesan Art Troupe, at their worksite. Put on the stage of the performance that started with music "Song of Socialist Advance" were female chorus "Glory to General Kim Jong Un", dance "Fly, Our Tri-color National Flag", female trio "Our Marshal" and others. Performers, through their excellent skills, gave a rich artistic description of the greatness of the leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. Dance "Smelters" impressively depicted the history and tradition of the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex which has taken the lead in devotedly upholding the cause of our Party with increased iron and steel production, greatly exciting the audience. The audience hardened their iron will to firmly cement the steel pillar of the country by successfully carrying forward the traditions of patriotism and loyalty of the preceding generations. Put on the stage, full of self-confidence and pride of the Korean people, were colorful numbers including male solo "Ballad of Gold Mountains", mixed septet "My Prospering Country" and national dance "Janggochum", delighting the audience. Mixed chorus "Along the Road of Socialism" and other songs were applauded by the audience as they added to patriotic enthusiasm of the workers, scientists and technicians of the complex for the revolution. The performance reached its climax when song and dance "Cheers of the People" was put on the stage to reflect fervent enthusiasm and optimism of the people. After the performance, the audience congratulated the performers on their successful performance, presenting bouquets to them. The performance continues. Rodong Sinmun

title: Workers of Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex Vow to Carry out First-Year Tasks of Five-year Plan
body: There took place a meeting of the workers of the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex on February 22 on the spot to vow to certainly carry out the first-year tasks of the five-year plan true to the spirit of the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Party. Attending the meeting were O Su Yong, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Kim Chung Gol, minister of Metallurgical Industry, Pak Chang Ho, chief secretary of the North Hwanghae Provincial Committee of the WPK, Im Hun, chairman of the provincial people's committee, and officials in the province and officials and employees of the complex. Ri Song Chol, chief secretary of the party committee of the complex, made a report. The speaker said that the workers of the complex are full of firm determination to repay the great trust of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, who put forward them in the van of the struggle for implementing the decisions made at the 8th Congress of the Party, with increased steel production. He referred to the fact that Kim Jong Un at the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Party indicated the clear orientation of the general advance of this year for firmly defending the dignity of the Party congress and bringing about practical results awaited and welcomed by the people at any cost by making a great stride forward from the first year of implementing the five-year plan. He called upon the officials and workers of the complex to become a core and death-defying corps of the Party in carrying out the militant tasks set forth at the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Party. He called for setting an innovative and detailed goal strictly based on the main idea and spirit of the plenary meeting and establishing revolutionary traits of implementing the monthly and quarterly plans without fail. He stressed the need to give full play to the vitality of planned and scientific self-reliance by holding fast to science and technology as the key to the implementation of the Party policy and thus speeding up the technical remodeling and modernization of production processes and encouraging active recycling. The reporter called for making a breakthrough in implementing the new five-year plan by surely attaining the goal of iron and steel production for this year advanced at the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee. Speeches were made at the meeting. Speakers called on the working people across the country to accomplish at any cost the first-year tasks of the five-year plan true to the decisions of the Party congress, expressing their determination to keep in mind the trust and expectation of Kim Jong Un to kindle fiercer flames of producing more iron and steel and thus fully demonstrate the spirit and mettle of the heroic Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il working class. An appeal to the working people across the country was adopted at the meeting. Then a mass demonstration took place. The participants in the demonstration marched in fine array, responding to such slogans as "Let us thoroughly implement the first-year tasks of the five-year plan set forth by the 8th Party Congress!" and "Let us turn out in implementing the Party policy with the do-or-die spirit!" Rodong Sinmun

title: Workers of Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex Call for Going All Out for Implementation of First-Year Tasks of Five-year Plan
body: An appeal to all the working people across the country was adopted at the meeting of the workers of the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex on Monday to vow to carry out the first-year tasks of the five-year plan without fail in hearty response to the spirit of the Second Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. The appeal stressed that the great fighting programme set forth at the historic 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Party has stirred up the complex, adding the goals that seemed to be far from attainment got nearer and confidence and courage became stronger through the deep study of the idea and spirit of the plenary meeting. The appeal said that the report made by the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un at the said plenary meeting expounds not only campaign goals but also policies and good methods for overcoming the manifold hardships most quickly and successfully making a turning-point in economic revitalization. Saying that everything will go well as long as they are done as instructed by the respected General Secretary, the appeal evinced the steel-strong pledge of the working people of the complex. It said that the production of iron and steel has to be doubled this year in comparison with last year, but the complex will attain this year's goal without fail by carrying forward the patriotism and loyalty displayed by the preceding generation while pushing forward with huge projects for expanding its production capacity. In the appeal, the workers of the complex called on all the working people across the country to take an active part in the all-people and all-out onward campaign, death-defying campaign for defending the authority of the Party and glorifying the era of our state-first principle all over the world. The time has come for us to give full play to the great might and abounding zeal for the sake of our Party, revolution and socialist country, the appeal said, calling for going all out for the implementation of the first-year tasks of the five-year plan advanced by the 8th Party Congress with great revolutionary enthusiasm and patriotism. It called on the workers in the metal industry to ride the legendary Chollima once again with the heart of loyalty for the respected General Secretary, and on the workers in the chemical industry to redouble their efforts, bearing in mind that the people are waiting for home-produced fertilizer and chemical goods. It appealed to the workers in the electrical power industry to generate a lot of electricity so as to make all the working sites of the country put production on normal track and increase the production nonstop, and to all the coal miners to increase the coal production with the zeal of loyalty and pure patriotic conscience in order to inject vitality into the advance of the country. The workers of the railway transport field are appealed to responsibly ensure freight transport for different fields of the national economy just as how it was done despite hails of bullets and shells during the wartime. The appeal called on the field of machine industry to put greater spurs to the drive of breaking through the cutting edge so as to churn out our machines to be proud of in the world. The workers in the field of building-materials industry are called upon to create another myth of the DPRK in construction to startle the world people in all construction sites across the country including the construction sites for building 10 000 dwellings in Pyongyang. The agricultural workers are appealed to become genuine loyalists and patriotic farmers safeguarding the Party and the revolution and defending socialism with increased rice production. The appeal called on the workers of the light industry to make this year a year of substantial achievements in the home-production of goods and recycling and a year of a great turn to show the new appearance of our light industry after decisively eliminating the inclination to import. It called on scientists and technicians to powerfully haul the general advance for a new victory by dint of self-reliance with intelligent brains and patriotism and loyalty. The workers of the munitions industry are called upon to unconditionally attain the goals for the development of the national defence industry set forth at the 8th Congress of the Party with the same spirit, resourcefulness and stamina as those which have been displayed in putting the dignity and prestige of the country on the highest level in the nation's history spanning 5 000 years. The appeal stressed the need for workers across the country to make a report of victory to the Party Central Committee by thoroughly carrying out the first-year tasks of the five-year plan advanced at the 8th Congress of the Party with full confidence and redoubled efforts, and to demonstrate all over the world the spirit and stamina of the heroic Korean working people who are symbolized as a hammer, sickle and writing brush on our Party flag. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Greetings to Chairman of Central Standing Committee of Chongryon
body: Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a congratulatory message to Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), on Feb. 22. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un in his message extended warm felicitations and comradely greeting to the chairman on his 86th birthday. The message said that the chairman is a true model overseas revolutionary, who assumed the heavy responsibility for the movement of Koreans in Japan when the homeland underwent the biggest hardship, and has resolutely defended and proudly glorified Chongryon, the patriotic legacy bequeathed by President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. The message noted that the Workers' Party of Korea highly appreciates and always remembers the distinguished exploits of the chairman etched in the development course of Chongryon and the movement of Koreans in Japan. The message hoped that the chairman would work harder for dear Chongryon and beloved compatriots in Japan with the vigor he had displayed when setting out on the 625-mile journey across the eastern mountainous area of the homeland 24 years ago to follow the undying course covered by Chairman Kim Jong Il with a death-defying spirit. Expressing thanks again to the chairman for his noble fidelity and sincerity, the message wished him good health and his wife and other family members happiness. Rodong Sinmun

title: In Order to Raise Scientific Level of Animal Raising
body: True to the vital tasks set forth at the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea, the labor and management of the Unjong Stockbreeding Cooperative Farm in North Hwanghae Province try their hardest to increase their livestock products. They believe that whether the Party policy of obtaining meat from grass proves its worth or not depends entirely on their role. They exert themselves fully to study the technology of stockbreeding hard and learn from the experiences of advanced units. Rodong Sinmun

title: By Scrupulously Organizing and Guiding Production
body: The workers and management of the Sariwon Bag Factory bring about a great upswing in their production. Its employees conduct a brisk emulation for their increased production among its workteams and machines and kindle the fierce flames of their collective innovation helping and leading each other forward. The SBF makes great efforts to mass-produce shapely quality schoolbags on the principle of giving priority to quality over quantity. Rodong Sinmun

title: Plans Are Carried Out as Scheduled in Coal-mining Industry
body: The workers and management of the Kujang, Tukjang and Anju Area Coal Mining Complexes, the Pukchang and Sunchon Area Youth Coal Mining Complexes and other coal mines carry out their production plans by dint of hard work without fail. The workers of the Sunchon and Tokchon Coal Mining Machine Factories, the Unsan Plant for the Accessories of Coal-mining Equipment and many such others do their possible with wisdom and ardor to produce all the spare parts of coal mining equipment and other small tools in good quality. Rodong Sinmun

title: Waterway Tunnel and Its Various Structures Built Apace
body: The Hwangjugindung Waterway is quite well under construction. Tens of thousands of cubic meters of soil and bedrock have so far been disposed of this year. The members of all the shock brigades register great results in their building assignments in high spirits despite their overlapping difficulties. Rodong Sinmun

title: Exerting Themselves to Put Salt Production
body: on Intensive, Mechanized and Modern Basis The labor and management of many units of the Salt Production General Enterprise are all out to execute another five-year plan. The SPGE made a scientific analysis of the actual conditions of many of its saltworks and on this basis, has now focused on intensifying, mechanizing and modernizing their salt production. It works hard to that end. The workers and management of the Kwangryangman and Kumsong Saltworks have almost finished their energetic preparations for producing salt earlier than usual. The case is similar to the Namyang and Namsi Saltworks and many other units. Rodong Sinmun

title: Seminar of Korean Social Scientists in Japan Held
body: A seminar of Korean social scientists in Japan on the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) was held at Korean University of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) in Tokyo, Japan, on Feb. 11. Present there were Ri Yong Su, chairman of the Korean Social Scientists Association in Japan, and other members of the association. The seminar was held to deeply study and grasp the essence, main contents and historic significance of the 8th Congress of the Party which serves as a great turning point and historic watershed in the development of the Korean revolution. Speeches were made on the basis of study of the main idea of the report on the work of the 7th Party Central Committee made by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un at the 8th Congress of the Party, review on the work in the field of economic construction and the tasks facing it, the tasks for strengthening the national defense capabilities, the issue of national reunification, the external policy, etc. Ri Pyong Hwi, professor at the Center for Korean Studies of Korean University, explained the historic background and the purpose of the 8th Congress of the Party and successes achieved during the period under review. Referring to the purpose and significance of the congress, he said that its convocation is not only a manifestation of the firm confidence of the WPK to lead the Korean revolution to a next-stage victory but also the strong will and solemn pledge to live up to the people's absolute trust and expectations by fulfilling the responsibility and duties for the future of the country. Saying that the key to breaking through the existing manifold difficulties with utmost certainty and speed lies in consolidating our own strength, our internal force in all aspects, he added that it is the main idea and main spirit of the Party Congress to achieve a great fresh victory in all fields by remarkably increasing our own strength, our internal force, in socialist construction. Then Kang Il Chon, vice-chairman of the Korean Social Scientists Association in Japan, gave explanations about the strategy for socialist economic construction set forth at the 8th Congress of the Party, Choe Yong Hae, dean of Political Economy Faculty of Korean University, about the issue of national reunification and the external policy, and Ryom Mun Song, associate professor of Foreign Language Faculty of the university, about steadily strengthening the national defense capabilities. Rodong Sinmun

title: Centenarians Receive Birthday Spreads in DPRK
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un sent birthday spreads to Ryu Hae Dok living in Suphung Workers' District of Sakju County in North Phyongan Province and Ko Kum Nyo living in the township of Kwaksan County on their 100th birthdays. The centenarians, born as daughters of day laborers, suffered from the grief of statelessness, being subject to all kinds of maltreatment and contempt, when the Korean nation was deprived of its sovereignty. They worked sincerely for decades in the agricultural field with a single mind to live up to the benevolence of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, who liberated the country and provided them with a worthwhile life and dignity, with increased grain production. They voluntarily did jobs conducive to the prosperity of the country even after retirement. They are still doing housework in good health under the care of medical workers, thanks to the socialist public health system. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Floral Basket from Vietnamese Ambassador
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a floral basket from Le Ba Binh, Vietnamese ambassador to the DPRK, on the occasion of the 2nd anniversary of Kim Jong Un's official goodwill visit to the Socialist Republic of Vietnam. The floral basket was conveyed to an official concerned on Tuesday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Foreign Figures Visit DPRK Missions
body: Foreign figures of various circles paid congratulatory visits to the DPRK missions in their countries from February 9 to 16 on the occasion of the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il, (Day of the Shining Star). They laid floral baskets and bouquets before the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and the art works depicting the peerlessly great men standing together and bowed to them. They include the general secretary of the Central Committee of the Nepal Communist Party (Marxist-Leninist) who is ex-deputy prime minister of Nepal, the chairman of the Nepal Journalist Association for the Study of the Juche Idea and Songun Politics, the chairman of the Study Forum for Self-Reliance of Nepal, the vice-chairperson of the Socialist Journalist Forum of Nepal for the Study of the Juche Idea, the chairman of the Nepal Institute for the Juche Studies, the chairman of the Central Executive Committee of the Bangladesh National Socialist Party, the chairperson of the Bangladesh Jatiya Party, the chairman of the Bangladesh-Korea Friendship and Solidarity Committee, the chairman of the Bangladesh Group for the Study of the Songun Policy, the general secretary of the Arab Democratic Union Party of Syria, the general secretary of the Socialist Unionist Party of Syria and members of its Political Bureau, the secretary general of the Laos-Korea Friendship Association, the chairman of the Anti-Imperialist Forum of Germany, the chief of the Berlin Juche Idea Study Group of Germany, the general secretary of the Society for the Promotion of the Relations between Austria and DPRK, the federal secretary of the Left Bloc of the Austrian Trade Union Federation, the general secretary of the Central Committee of the Czechoslovak Communist Party, the chairman of the Paektusan Czech-Korean Friendship Association, the first vice-chairman of the Czech Group for the Study and Materialization of the Juche Idea, the chairman of the Ethiopian Committee for the Study of the Independent Politics, members of the Political Bureau of the Workers' Party for the Independence of Senegal, the vice-director of the International Department of the Democratic Party of Equatorial Guinea and his party, the chairman of the Youth Group for the Study of the Juche Idea in DR Congo and the director of the Senegalese newspaper Courrier Africain. Meanwhile, the Finnish Communists' League, the Finland-Korea Society and the Finnish National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea sent a floral basket in their joint name to the DPRK mission in Finland, and the Khabarovsk Territorial Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation, the Denmark-DPRK Friendship Association and the director of the Central Secretariat of the Pakistan People's Party sent bouquets to the DPRK missions in their countries on the occasion of the Day of the Shining Star. Rodong Sinmun

title: 8th Congress of General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea to Be Convened
body: The 8th Congress of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea will take place in the capital city of Pyongyang late in May, Juche 110 (2021). The congress will comprehensively analyze and review the work of the federation during the period under review, and discuss the tasks and ways for fulfilling the mission and duty of the federation as the transmission belt and peripheral organization of the Party and bringing about a fundamental turn in the work of the federation in the struggle to implement the decisions of the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea. Rodong Sinmun

title: Intensive Ideological Work Goes On
body: The Party organizations of South Hamgyong Province at all levels try hard to ideologically encourage its officials and working people to carry out the tasks for the first year of new five-year plan at all costs. Tens of ideological workers’ squads for agitation for increased production have been organized in the province to conduct all manner of aggressive frontline political work at its important factories, enterprises, coal mines and farms. The Party organizations of the province at all levels actively conduct traveling art propaganda and sound truck-aided propaganda activities, thereby ensuring that everybody goes all out for their work where they are employed. Rodong Sinmun

title: Substantial and Dynamic Measures Taken
body: The officials of the Rural Economy Committee of Kangwon Province organize and direct its farm work for this year in depth to effect an actual change in it and make substantial headway with it. In the first place the RECKP adopts measures to do all farming scientifically and technologically. The province demands strictly that a model be set for scientific farming, that good experiences be generalized, that multimedia be used and that agricultural science and technology be disseminated according to actual conditions. In the next place the RECKP arranges for varieties of crops to be distributed properly to reap bumper harvests in low-yielding fields above all and for innovative measures to be taken to fertilize and tend the crops according to the process of farming. In the province reservoirs are restored and pumping machines repaired and maintained in full swing. Besides, water channels are cleaned out and irrigation setups repaired with all its strength and means. In addition, the efficacy of fertilizer and the proportion of the farm work done by machines are increased and other new progress is also made in agricultural production in actual reality. Rodong Sinmun

title: Advanced Cultivation Method Adopted
body: The employees of a vegetable greenhouse in Pyoksong County fertilize and tend their vegetables along scientific and technological lines. They apply their already-adopted methods of growth to others on an expansive scale to suit their actual conditions while developing them in detail. Meanwhile, they strive energetically to enrich the fields of their greenhouse. Rodong Sinmun

title: First Enlarged Meeting of Eighth Central Military Commission of WPK Held
body: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Guides Enlarged Meeting The First Enlarged Meeting of the 8th Central Military Commission of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) took place at the office building of the Central Committee of the WPK on Feb. 24. Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the WPK and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, guided the enlarged meeting. Attending the meeting were Ri Pyong Chol, vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission of the WPK, and its members. Also present at the meeting were commanding officers of the services and corps-level units of the Korean People's Army (KPA), executive members of the KPA Committee of the WPK, commanding officers of some armed forces organs and vice-directors of the relevant departments of the C.C., WPK. The meeting referred to a series of shortcomings revealed in the military and political activities and moral life of KPA commanding officers, and mainly discussed the issue of thoroughly establishing the revolutionary moral discipline within the KPA. To establish the revolutionary moral discipline within the KPA is not just a technical issue, but a fatal issue related to the existence of the KPA and success or failure in the army building and military activities, the respected General Secretary said, and added that in order to settle the important issue, it is necessary above all to intensify the education and control aimed at ensuring that the KPA commanding officers of the new generation have the proper political consciousness and moral point of view. The meeting stressed the need for all Party organizations and political institutions of the KPA to regard the establishment of the revolutionary discipline and moral traits as a major task of the present time for thoroughly establishing the command system of the Party Central Committee, enhancing combat capability and giving full play to the noble spiritual and moral superiority of the revolutionary army, and underlined the need to carry out the task in an intensive way. Then the meeting discussed an organizational matter on dismissing or appointing major commanding officers of the armed forces organs. The Central Military Commission of the WPK appointed Kim Song Gil as commander of the Navy of the KPA and conferred the title of Vice Admiral on him. Kim Chung Il was appointed as commander of the KPA Air and Anti-Aircraft Force and the title of Lieutenant General was conferred on him. A decision to promote the military ranks of major commanding officers was also adopted at the meeting. According to the decision of the Central Military Commission of the WPK, the title of KPA Vice Marshal was conferred on Kim Jong Gwan, minister of National Defence of the DPRK, and Kwon Yong Jin, director of the KPA General Political Bureau. Political News Team

title: Chairman of WPK Central Military Commission Kim Jong Un Gives Order to Promote Military Ranks of Commanding Officers
body: Kim Jong Un, chairman of the Central Military Commission of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), on Feb. 24 gave an order to promote the military ranks of major commanding officers. According to the order, Ju Tong Chol, Ko Won Nam, Kim Yong Mun, Kim Chung Song and Jang Sun Mo were promoted to lieutenant general and Ri Myong Ho, Kim Chol Ju, Jong Pong Chan, Sin Jong Nam, Choe Tae Un, Ri Tu Il, Jon Ung Chol, Kang Chol Ryong, Kang Kyong Ho, Pak Jae Yong, Han Jong Sik, Jong Yong Chol, Hwang Song Chol, Song Yong Se, Sin Jae Yong, O Yong Su, Kim Jin Uk, Jon Myong Hak, Ju Chol Jin, Ri Myong Ho, Ri In Su, Pak Thae I, So Chang Ho, Choe In Chol, Rim Hak, Kim Myong Il and Han Jong Chol to major general.

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from General Secretary of Democratic Party of Equatorial Guinea
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Jeronimo Osa Osa Ecoro, general secretary of the Democratic Party of Equatorial Guinea, on Feb. 11. The message said that all the members and supporters of the Democratic Party of Equatorial Guinea, as they had done on the past occasions, extended sincere and warm felicitations to Kim Jong Un, and through him, to the Workers' Party of Korea and all the Korean people, on behalf of Obiang Nguema Mbasogo, founder-chairman of the Democratic Party of Equatorial Guinea, on the occasion of the 79th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. It hoped that the significant day, the birth anniversary of the great leader who wisely led the Korean people, would be celebrated with splendor. Rodong Sinmun

title: With Daring Plan and Tenacity
body: The agricultural officials and workers of South Phyongan Province do all they can to produce manure and transport it to its cooperative farms. The officials and agricultural workers of Tokchon City achieve high results in the production of their manure. Songchon County makes principal efforts to turn out manure and transport it to its low-yielding fields to boost their crop output there. Firmly determined as never before to enrich their low-yielding fields before the farming season all the officials and agricultural workers of Sunchon City, Pukchang County and other cities and counties work hard by the sweat of their brows to carry manure there and blanket them with it. Those of Kangwon Province, too, fully apply themselves to ameliorating a wide area of their cold wet fields and guaranteeing an increase in their cereal production. Ryanggang Province also strives energetically to execute its innovative plan to harvest more crops in its low-yielding fields before the farming season. Rodong Sinmun

title: Resolved to Make Breakthrough with All Burdens on Their Shoulders
body: The officials of the Ministry of Metal Industry go all out to effect a real change and headway in their work from the first year of another five-year plan conscious of their heavy responsibility to the national economic development. The MMI channels its primary efforts into refashioning the existing production processes of its major ironworks and steelworks with advanced technology, building new ironmaking furnaces economical of their energy and hitting the immediate targets for the production of its steel. Moreover, it adopts active measures to normalize the production of its iron mines and expand their production capacity. Meanwhile, it takes steps to briskly train talented technicians in its subsidiary units purposefully according to accurate methods. Rodong Sinmun

title: Metal Industry Makes Headway
body: Firmly determined to promote the development of the independent economy by boosting the production of their iron and steel and solidifying the material and technological foundations for it the workers of the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex strive mightily to readjust and maintain the pipelines for the transport of their concentrates. The workers of the Chollima Steel Complex, too, do their utmost to carry out their tasks for the first year of another five-year plan without fail. Above all, the workers and management of the Posan Ironworks register remarkable results in their production repairing their furnace qualitatively and operating it to thoroughly meet the demand of technological regulations. The officials, technicians and workers of the Musan Mining Complex, the Unryul, Jaeryong, Hungsan, Ramjong and Jangsan Mines, the Hungnam Electrode Factory and other producers of iron ores, refractory and electrodes stir themselves for their production further. Rodong Sinmun

title: Hydro-power Generators Produced Full Steam
body: The workers and management of the Taean Heavy Machine Complex are all out to produce generation equipment for the water power stations under construction in Kangwon Province. The THMC has mapped out its production plan in detail. Accordingly, it strictly demands that joint production between its processes be stepped up further and that its employees carry out their daily work assignments unconditionally. Besides, it pays due attention to putting its equipment in full operation and reducing its process time. It recycles its industrial wastes effectively to meet the demand of the Party policy. The workers of the 1st Workshop for the Processing of Generation Equipment introduce valuable technological innovations into their production to process their components more speedily than usual and raise their quality, thus fulfilling their daily production plans without fail. The workers of many other units of the THMC, too, do their best to take good technological care of their equipment, dovetail their production processes well with each other and top their production plans. Rodong Sinmun

title: Immortal Party Building Exploits Which Will Shine with Human Cause of Independence
body: A revolutionary party which has been strengthened and developed into the party of the leader and thoroughly carries his ideas and guidance into effect can perform its mission and role creditably in any storm and stress. This precious truth has been clearly proved by the proud course of the Workers’ Party of Korea, which fully demonstrates its dignity and might to the whole world. Our Party has powerfully been able to forward the cause of socialism, the cause of human independence, enjoying high prestige and demonstrating its invincible might. This is unthinkable without the outstanding leadership of Chairman Kim Jong Il who has developed the WPK into the one and only powerful party of the world. In the mid-20th century modern revisionism was rearing its head in some socialist countries and seriously damaging the activities of their working-class parties and their social life as a whole. Worse still, modern revisionists undisguisedly repudiated the leadership of the party, the General Staff of the revolution, openly slandering the authority and prestige of the leader and his achievements as well and ignoring his position and role in the carrying out of the revolutionary cause of the working class. Imperialists wildly applauded the modern revisionists for this hell-bent on malignant propaganda against socialism. Under this complex international situation Kim Jong Il started his work at the Central Committee of the WPK. He solemnly declared that our Party was unimaginable without the august name of President Kim Il Sung and should invariably be strengthened and developed into his glorious Party forever not only in the past and in the present but also in the future. He then proceeded to devote all his energies to strengthening and developing our Party into the revolutionary Party of Juche type firmly determined to do so. Nobody had so far built a revolutionary party into a party of the leader. No solution could be found to the numerous relevant theoretical and practical problems either in any classics or in the actualities of any country. Kim Jong Il is a peerlessly great man who perfectly solved all the problems of strengthening and developing our Party into the Party of Kim Il Sung’s. Kim Jong Il safeguarded the purity of Kim Il Sung’s revolutionary ideas and developed and enriched them with prodigious ideological and theoretical activities, thus providing a firm guarantee for imbuing our Party and revolutionary ranks with one ideology. He declared that it was the highest program of the Party to imbue the whole society with Kimilsungism and set it forth as the strategic line of party building to imbue the whole Party with Kimilsungism. This effected a turn in ensuring that our Party was that of Kim Il Sung forever. The work of establishing the monolithic ideological system of the Party and its monolithic leadership system has been conducted endlessly in depth. Consequently, the whole Party, ranging from its central committee to its basic organizations and members, has been strengthened into an pure ideological entity whose thought and action are based on the ideas and purpose of the leader alone and an integral organizational whole which is faithful to his guidance alone. It is none other than Kim Jong Il who ensured that the guiding ideology of the Party was newly prescribed in the Party rules. He met an official of the Party Central Committee one September day in 1970. He said that he had long thought of newly formulating the guiding ideology of our Party in its rules and that he was going to do that at the upcoming 5th Congress of the WPK when it would amend and supplement the rules. The official could not but be surprised at this because neither political parties which existed in the history of mankind nor the parties of the socialist countries had so far laid down their guiding ideology clearly in their rules. In those days the parties of the socialist countries regarded the preceding theories as the absolute truth of revolution and construction. Therefore, nobody could dare think of specifying our Party’s guiding ideology anew in its rules. That day, Kim Jong Il told the official with confidence that the guiding ideology of our Party which would be adopted and laid down in its rules at its congress was the immortal Juche Idea founded by Kim Il Sung. Consequently, our Party solemnly declared its revolutionary nature at its historic 5th Congress and started its dynamic advance forward although all the other working-class parties in the world adhered to the preceding theories as the absolute truth of revolution and construction and their guiding ideal. In his answers to the questions raised by the General Director of the Cuban newspaper “Granma” in October 1989 Kim Jong Il said that it was fundamental to strengthening the Party to firmly achieve its ideological and volitional unity and cohesion round the leader and that the unity and cohesion of the Party based on a single revolutionary ideology was its lifeline. He added that the Party could attain its unbreakable unity and cohesion and satisfactorily fulfill its mission only when its monolithic ideology and leadership was surely ensured. This has served as important guidelines on the building of revolutionary parties. Despite the epoch-making collapse of socialism in many countries late in the 20th century the WPK has since distinguished itself dignifiedly as the Party of Kim Il Sung and firmly defended the socialism of our style. This testifies the immortal exploits performed by Kim Jong Il in the history of revolutionary party building and the world socialist movement. Kim Jong Il published large numbers of immortal classical works to strengthen and develop our Party and further the cause of socialism and human independence. They include “The Historical Lesson in Building Socialism and the General Line of Our Party”, “On the Fundamentals of Revolutionary Party Building”, “Abuses of Socialism Are Intolerable”, “Socialism Is a Science”, etc. They are the precious fruition of his extraordinary ideological and theoretical sagacity, endless devotion and colossal efforts. On reading the works the communist parties, workers’ parties and other progressive political parties of different countries highly spoke of them as “textbooks for building a Juche-oriented party” and “invaluable guidelines on the construction and activities of a revolutionary party” and conducted movements to learn from the DPRK, the fortress and bulwark of socialism. They competitively visited our country and held bilateral and multilateral WPK-led talks there. They also strengthened their revolutionary international unity and solidarity in every way under the banner of Pyongyang Declaration on defending and advancing the cause of socialism. The undying services rendered by Kim Jong Il to the cause of socialism and human independence will shine forever in the hearts of our people and the progressive peoples of the world. Rodong Sinmun

title: Joint Meetings of Working People's Organizations Held in DPRK
body: Joint meetings of the working people's organizations took place in Pyongyang and all provinces of the DPRK to pledge to thoroughly implement the first year's tasks of the 5-year plan set forth at the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). Speakers at the joint meetings of the working people's organizations called upon officials and members of working people's organizations to implement the decisions made at the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the WPK most brilliantly and most perfectly by glorifying the first year's march of carrying out the decisions made at the Party Congress with proud innovations and progress in the indomitable revolutionary spirit and through the death-defying struggle. They expressed their will to make a breakthrough for victory in this year's struggle through new innovations, bold creations and constant advance under the banner of self-reliance and self-sufficiency, bearing deep in mind the main idea and spirit of the plenary meeting. They stressed the need to strictly observe the anti-epidemic rules and consolidate anti-epidemic positions as firm as a rock, keeping firmly in mind that to ensure the flawlessness of the anti-epidemic work is the primary one of the important tasks for this year. They called upon the young people to work miracles and perform feats in this year's general offensive with confidence in new victory as befitting the sons and daughters of the Workers' Party and the youths of Juche Korea who have grown up under the care of the Party. The workers and members of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea should put production on a normal and active track in all fields of the economic construction, they said, and went on: The members of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea should attain without fail this year's goal of grain production which is of weighty significance in implementing the decisions made at the Party Congress by fulfilling their mission as the masters responsible for the granary of the country. The members of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea should turn the country into a socialist flower garden full of moral excellence and tender feelings by giving priority to state affairs before family affairs and giving full play to the virtue and traits of devoting themselves to the organizations, masses and comrades. Speakers stressed the need to struggle against anti-socialism and non-socialism more strongly with full confidence in socialism and with a firm viewpoint that our ideology, culture and morality are the best. Letters of pledge to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un were adopted at the joint meetings. Then followed demonstrations of the participants in the joint meetings. Rodong Sinmun

title: Enlarged Plenary Meeting of Cabinet Held
body: There took place an enlarged plenary meeting of the Cabinet on February 25 via tele-conference system to thoroughly carry out the important tasks set forth at the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea and the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Party. Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK and premier of the Cabinet, presided over the meeting. Attending the meeting were members of the Cabinet including Vice-premiers Pak Jong Gun and Jon Hyon Chol. Present there as observers were officials of organs under direct control of the Cabinet, officials of ministries, chairpersons of the provincial, city and county people's committees and officials of organs for agricultural guidance, major factories and enterprises. Discussed at the enlarged plenary meeting was the agenda "On thoroughly implementing the decisions made at the 8th Congress of the WPK and the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Party". Pak Jong Gun, vice-premier of the Cabinet who doubles as chairman of the State Planning Commission, made a report. The report analyzed and reviewed the reasons why the Cabinet and state economic guidance organs revealed again passive and self-protective tendency in drawing up this year's national economic plan for implementing the decisions made at the Party congress. It brought up the measures for purposefully conducting the economic operations on the basis of the essentials of this year's economic work and carrying out without fail the national economic plan. It put main stress on the need for ministries, national institutions, provincial, city and county people's committees and enterprises to establish the system of the state's unified guidance over economic work, as required by the Cabinet-responsibility system and Cabinet-centered system, and on the need to establish the system and order to work after defining their duty, authority and scope of work. It underlined the need to put production on a normal track and positively promote upgrading and home production of raw and other materials and recycling by dint of science and technology by working out in a reasonable way and carrying out in a strenuous manner the goals of sci-tech development in all fields, which must be attained in the period of the five-year plan, on the principle of strategic concentration.
