It urged officials to intensify the study on the methodological issues in improving the economic management, as required by the objective economic law and timely correct deviations manifested in practices and wage an intensified struggle for putting an end to unit specialization and self-centeredness that breach the state law and infringe upon the interests of people. It set forth tasks for taking stronger measures to make constant efforts to complete the method of planning in accordance with the changing reality, level of development in productivity and the development of science and technology, and to ensure economic condition and legal environment for enterprises to independently and proactively conduct production and management activities, give full play to their creativity and promptly react to changing environment. The reporter stressed the need for the economic guiding officials to surely orient the economic work to encouraging fresh innovation, bold creation and ceaseless advance, bearing in mind the way of carrying out the goals of this year's struggle lies in bringing about a fundamental improvement in their traits of struggle and working manner. The enlarged plenary meeting heard speeches made by Kim Kwang Nam, manager of the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex, Ma Jong Son, minister of Chemical Industry, Ri Song Hak, vice-premier of the Cabinet, Choe Ryong Gil, vice-chairman of the State Planning Commission, Ju Chol Gyu, vice-premier of the Cabinet and minister of Agriculture, and others. The speakers referred to detailed ways to carry out the goals to be attained by their fields and units in the period of implementing the five-year plan set forth at the Eighth Party Congress and to fulfill their tasks set forth at the Second Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Party. They expressed their resolution to make epochal achievements in attaining this year's goals by displaying extraordinary working ability, enthusiasm and devotion, always remembering the deep trust and expectations by the Party and the people. The meeting discussed such issues as concentrating manpower, equipment, materials and fund on factories and enterprises in the fields of metal and chemical industries, solving technical problems arising in producing iron and steel with domestic fuel and improving the management control, business administration as required by the socialist system of responsible business operation. It confirmed chronological plans for pushing ahead with the strengthening of their technical forces in close liaison with the scientific research field and realizing home-production of raw and other materials. Also discussed at the meeting were proposals for finding out factors hindering the production and management activities and taking measures against them and studying and introducing realistic ways for putting production on a steady basis at all enterprises. The meeting underlined the need to increase the production of consumer goods by recycling idle materials, by-products and waste materials and making a positive use of substitute raw materials and to tighten the connection of production and consumption among all fields and enterprises. It also discussed such practical issues arising in unconditionally fulfilling the agricultural production plan as decisively improving the methods of management control with main emphasis on laying productive foundations of cooperative farms, and as restoring irrigation facilities and cropland. The meeting stressed the need for the Cabinet to perform its duty as the economic headquarters of the country, and for all economic guiding officials to set forth the improvement of socialist economic management and promotion of sci-tech development as the essential ways of implementing the new five-year plan and fulfill their responsibilities and duties in the struggle for the economic construction and improvement of the people's standard of living. On the basis of in-depth discussions, decisions of the Cabinet "On thoroughly implementing the five-year plan for national economic development set forth at the 8th Congress of the WPK" and "On thoroughly implementing the important tasks set forth at the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the WPK" were adopted with unanimous approval at the meeting. Rodong Sinmun

title: To Give Spectators Distinctive Art Performances
body: The officials, creators and artistes of the South Phyongan Provincial Art Troupe are all out to carry out the tasks set forth at the 8th Congress of the WPK. The SPPAT strives hard to ensure that its creators and artistes do all they can to improve their ability and skills before everything else and train themselves as talents of ability versed in creation and performance. Deeply conscious of their honorable mission and duty to the Party, the revolution and the people all the creators and artistes of the SPPAT are now devoting all their wisdom and enthusiasm to their art creative activities to bring about actual changes and innovations in them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Learners of Science and Technology Shown in Figures
body: Detailed knowledge of how science and technology learning spaces nationwide are run can be got at the information exchange of the Sci-Tech Complex. Ten thousand and several thousand science and technology learning spaces are omnipresent in the country. They are all registered at the complex. Pyongyang, Nampho and Rason Cities, South Phyongan and South Hamgyong Provinces and so forth lead the country in running the spaces. The spaces are run steadily and effectively at the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill, the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Silk Mill, the Songyo Knitwear Factory, the Information and Communications Bureau of South Phyongan Province and other units of the national economy. They mostly belong to the sectors of light industry and communications. Thousands of important technological discussions were held among many domains and units of the national economy for the last few years. They were participated in by the most advanced units more than 600 times. Rodong Sinmun

title: Tea Production Base Newly Built
body: Unjong Tea Factory Commissioned The Unjong Tea Factory was wonderfully built and commissioned under the great loving care and meticulous guidance of the Workers' Party of Korea. The modern factory with all processes ranging from water purifying to packing will produce health tea with peculiar flavour and fragrance. The Unjong tea is associated with the peerlessly great men's warm loving care for the people. President Kim Il Sung personally planted tea saplings and grew them at his house with his plan to produce tea by the country itself and provide it to the people. Chairman Kim Jong Il who was very concerned for the growing of tea trees named the tea produced by the country "Unjong Tea" so that the people could hand down to posterity the loving care shown by the President, drinking good tea. The Unjong tea associated with the great love of the President and the Chairman for the people became popular with the people thanks to the meticulous care shown by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un made sure that the tea growing area was expanded on an annual basis, that manuring and cultivating the tea trees were improved, that the tea was provided well to the people, and that a tea factory was built wonderfully so that the people would have tea at any time and place. True to the Party's plan, the officials of the Ministry of Agriculture and working people have built new production buildings, subsidiary and public service buildings, etc. of the factory in the area of Namsa-ri, Rangnang District, Pyongyang. Officials, scientists and technicians of relevant units including Pyongyang Han Tok Su University of Light Industry, Kim Chaek University of Technology, the State Academy of Sciences, the Light Industry Designing Institute of the Ministry of Light Industry and the factory have completed a solar energy generation system and a power-generating system through coal gasification, while building the integrated production system and realizing the domestic production and packing equipment. A water-purifying process, a tea-filter process and other production processes are made highly automatic and streamlined, and the factory is put on a perfect germ-free and dust-free basis. Now that tea has become one of three table luxuries in the world, a technique to produce tea peculiar to Korea has been newly developed so as to produce nutritious green tea, black tea and Cholgwanum tea with peculiar flavor, aroma and color. Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the DPRK, Ju Chol Gyu, vice-premier and minister of Agriculture, and officials concerned looked round the Unjong Tea Factory on Feb. 26. The officials and employees of the factory made up their minds to add warm flavor and beautiful emotions to the people by further improving the quality of the Unjong tea and developing many tea goods of various kinds by relying on domestic resources. Rodong Sinmun

title: Korean People Enjoy Folk Holiday
body: The Korean people, who create their own style civilization, aspiring after new innovation, bold creation and steady progress, pleasantly spent their folk holiday Jongwoldaeborum (the fifteenth day of the first month by the lunar calendar). Catering facilities in the capital city pleased citizens with different national dishes. Okryu Restaurant, Chongryu Restaurant and others were full of citizens enjoying national dishes such as Pyongyang cold noodle, boiled rice admixed with four other staple cereals, mung-bean pancake and dishes made of nine kinds of dried edible herbs. People enjoyed the holiday in Haeju City, Hamhung City and other cities. They feasted their eyes on the full moon on Moran Hill and at other scenic spots, new streets representing socialist civilization and villages newly built in the areas hit by natural disasters. Looking at the bright moon with the confidence in the new era when the ideal and desire for prosperity will come true, the people felt strong feelings of heartfelt thanks to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un who makes an endless journey of devoted service for the people's wellbeing, and wished him good health. Rodong Sinmun

title: Lecture Given by Chongryon to Commemorate Chairman Kim Jong Il's Birth Anniversary
body: There took place a lecture at the Korean Hall in Tokyo, Japan on Feb. 15 in celebration of the 79th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Attending the lecture were Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), Pak Ku Ho, first vice-chairman and concurrently director of the Organization Department of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, Nam Sung U, vice-chairman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, Pae Jin Gu, vice-chairman and concurrently director general of the General Affairs Department of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, Jo Il Yon, vice-chairman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, Song Kun Hak, vice-chairman and concurrently director of the Education Department of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, Ri Myong Yu, chairman of the Central Audit Committee of Chongryon, department directors and other officials of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee. The participants in the lecture watched a video "Noble Personality of Peerlessly Great Man." The video shows the revolutionary activities of Kim Jong Il who, regarding "The People Are God" as his motto throughout his life, made a history of devoted service for the people's wellbeing. The video also deals with the fact that the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un gives continuity to the history of the great leaders' love for the people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Hastening Research of New Breed and Production
body: The officials, scientists and employees of the Pyongyang Vegetable Science Institute of the Academy of Agricultural Science work hard to breed new vegetables of delicious, nourishing and productive varieties a lot and produce vegetables in their greenhouses on a scientific and intensive footing. The PVSI pays deep attention to establishing a well-knit system of scientific research projects, the introduction of research results and the production of new vegetables. The scientists of its bioengineering section make primary efforts to breed vegetable seeds of good strains. The scientists of its other sections do their utmost to invent new technologies for the nutritional care and environmental management of plants and the tending of them per hill in hydroponic greenhouses and technologies for raising vegetables and increasing their per-hectare yield in vinyl sheet-coated greenhouses. The PVSI tries hard to raise the level of the scientization and intensification of the production of vegetables in greenhouses and widely spread to other units the successes and experiences it registered in the process of this. Rodong Sinmun

title: Intensive Agitprop Inspires the Masses
body: Dynamic frontline agitprop activities are carried on in North Hwanghae Province. The provincial Party committee ensures that traveling art agitation squads actively conduct their activities in cities, counties, factories and enterprises to kindle the fierce flames of innovation. In the province the circulators of publications, too, visit its units inspected by President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un separately for firsthand guidance. They explained their related history to its employees with the help of book on it on the one hand and briskly conduct art agitation activities on the other. In the province agitators, propagandists for five families and other junior Party propaganda workers also intensify their ideological campaign by various ways and means. In response to the appeal of the workers of the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex the Nampho City Party Committee makes sure that good political work is done at its factories, enterprises, etc to bring about innovations in their production. In the city its ideological workers’ squads for agitation for increased production conduct effective agitprop activities in the fields of its cooperative farms, the Kangso Cement Factory and others by sound truck, by means of visual aids or by giving short pieces of art performance. The result is that their employees are encouraged greatly to work hard with revolutionary zeal. In the city the art agitation squads of the subsidiary organizations of the women’s union, the travelling art agitation squads of war veterans and so forth conduct novel agitprop activities at places of production. Rodong Sinmun

title: Meetings Held in Response to Appeal Made by Workers of Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex
body: Meetings of employees in different sectors and units of the national economy took place to pledge to carry out without fail the first-year tasks of the five-year plan, in response to the passionate appeal made by the workers of the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex. Read out at the meetings was the appeal to the working people across the country issued by the workers of the complex. Then, leading officials referred to the goals to be attained by their units this year, which was followed by speeches for taking pledges. Speakers were unanimous in stressing that the important tasks set forth at the Second Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea serve as a weapon for practice and innovation for attaining this year's goals. They said they would make a dynamic progress to usher in a new period of great upsurge and turn in socialist construction on the road of advance indicated by the Party Central Committee under the uplifted slogan "Let us thoroughly implement the first-year tasks of the five-year plan set forth by the 8th Party Congress!" They expressed their will to make a drastic innovation in viewpoint and way of work against the outmoded ones and substantially and unyieldingly push ahead with the work for adjusting and reinforcing the economy. They stressed that they would thoroughly carry out the tasks given by the Party through scrupulous operations and proficient commands with a firm determination to prove their high Party spirit, revolutionary spirit and popular spirit with their working ability and achievements. Pledging to attain the highly-set goals without fail, they expressed their resolution to bring about unprecedented innovations in the struggle for realizing the far-reaching plan of our Party. Rodong Sinmun

title: Koreans in Japan Launch Struggle to Defend Right to National Education
body: Koreans in different parts of Japan have continued their struggle for defending the right to national education against the Japanese authorities' discriminatory moves against Korean schools. The Yamaguchi prefectural network for supporting Korean schools and the Yamaguchi measure committee for the payment of subsidies co-sponsored "Yamaguchi prefectural network action" under the slogan "Right to education for all children!" in Yamaguchi Prefecture of Japan on February 10. Present there were Pak Chol, chairman of the Yamaguchi Prefectural Headquarters of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), O Yong Chol, principal of the Yamaguchi Korean Primary and Middle School, and Koreans and Japanese citizens in the prefecture. Noting that it is the core of the action to make the Japanese government recognize and ensure the right to national education, the speakers said it is a struggle which will lead to Japan's atonement for its colonial rule over Korea. They stressed that they would continue their struggle for the right of Koreans in Japan and for the right to education of the rising generations. Citizens of Fukuoka Prefecture held a rally on Feb. 13 to demand the application of tuition-free program for senior high schools to Korean schools. Speakers at the rally said that the Japanese government has become more desperate in its discriminatory policy against national education for the past ten odd years, and declared that they would continue the struggle for defending the right to national education against the authorities' discriminatory moves. Then, lawyers of the counsel for supporting Kyushu area made solidarity speeches. They denounced all courts in Japan for making a false judgment conniving at the state-sponsored discriminatory policy against Korean schools. An appeal was read out at the rally to express the will to wage a struggle for the application of tuition-free program to Korean schools and kindergartens. Rodong Sinmun

title: Halt to Japanese Authorities' Discrimination against Korean Schools Demanded
body: A rally took place in Saitama City, Saitama Prefecture of Japan on Feb. 22 to demand the resumption of payment of subsidies to Saitama Korean Junior Middle School under the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) and the settlement of the issue of support to Korean kindergarten. Present at the rally sponsored by the "network Saitama for the mechanical support to foreign and national schools" were Koreans and Japanese citizens in Saitama Prefecture. A lecture was given and speeches were made at the rally. The lecturer and speakers condemned the Japanese authorities for their evermore vicious discrimination against Korean schools, referring to the fact that after the suspension of subsidies to Saitama Korean Junior Middle School, the Korean kindergarten was excluded again from the supply of masks against the infection by the novel coronavirus. They claimed that the deep-rooted discriminatory feelings against Koreans are the source of discrimination against Korean schools. They stressed that they would wage a dynamic agitation campaign to disclose the injustice of the Japanese government's discriminatory moves against Korean schools. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Ambassador Presents Credentials to Hungarian President
body: The DPRK ambassador presented his credentials to the president of the Republic of Hungary on February 24. DPRK Ambassador Choe Kang Il courteously conveyed the greeting from Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, to President Ader Janos. The Hungarian president expressed deep thanks for it and asked the ambassador to convey his warm greeting to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. The president expressed hope that the relations between the two countries would further develop. Rodong Sinmun

title: South Phyongan Province Old People's Home Opens
body: South Phyongan Province Old People's Home was built and opened. The home built in the picturesque Ryongi-ri, Phyongwon County is equipped with all the conditions necessary for the health care for the occupants and their cultural and emotional life. Chief Secretary of the South Phyongan Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea An Kum Chol and Chairman of the Provincial People's Committee Kang Hyong Bong looked round the newly-built home on Feb. 28. Rodong Sinmun

title: Sinpho Canned Fish Factory Remodeled and Puts into Commission
body: The Sinpho Canned Fish Factory has been remodeled and put into commission. President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il who always paid deep attention to improving our people's diet, gave important instructions several times ranging from the building of the factory to the production of canned products and brightly indicated the tasks and ways arising in operating the factory. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un visited the Sinpho Distant-Sea Fishery Complex in May Juche 104 (2015), took a measure for building the Sinpho Canned Fish Factory in a modern way as required by the new century and made sure that necessary measures arising in construction and equipment modernization were taken. The computer integrated manufacturing system on production and management control has been established and the base for producing canned products whose hygiene and security are ensured has been built. Therefore, it has become possible for the factory to make contribution to the improving of the people's standard of living. Song Chun Sop, minister of Fisheries, and officials concerned looked round the remodeled factory on February 28. Rodong Sinmun

title: Undying Exploits Performed for Victorious Advance of Socialist Cause
body: The people of the DPRK as well as the progressive peoples of the world yearn for Chairman Kim Jong Il more ardently than ever despite the passage of time. This is because they do him sublime reverence for devoting his all to the victorious advance of the socialist cause. He did all he could for the cause of socialism and scored tremendous epochal achievements in it. The late-20th century and the first decade of the 21st century witnessed great worldwide political upheavals unprecedented in human history and the fiercest struggle between progress and reaction and between socialism and imperialism. In those decades he wisely led the struggle for socialism with scientific insight and uncommon wisdom holding the helm of history firmly. Kim Jong Il is an illustrious leader who positively proved the truth and superiority of socialism on a theoretical and practical basis and put its cause on the path of independence at a time when the world socialist movement was suffering serious setbacks. He shouldered the historic mission of rescuing the destiny of socialism from constant threat and published immortal works like “Abuses of Socialism Are Intolerable” and “Socialism Is a Science”, thus ensuring that the cause of socialism was advanced dynamically under the banner of Juche. The immortal works exposed the groundlessness and reactionary nature of all manner of slanders and calumnies on the part of the reactionaries of history and clarified the scientific accuracy and truth of socialism and the inevitability of its victory. They dealt a heavy blow to the enemies who slung mud at socialism and served as a banner of the struggle for the independence of the progressive peoples and the revival of socialism. Toward the end of last century the socialism of our style was clearly proved to be the most advantageous in the world. Kim Jong Il successfully led the struggle to defend and build socialism under the worst condition and circumstances and thereby proved in practice that the cause of the independence of the popular masses was justified, that socialism was a science and that socialism would surely emerge victorious without fail. Thanks to his great theory of socialist construction, our people could successfully overcome their arduous march and successive forced march despite their enormous difficulties and fully exert themselves to develop theirs into a powerful socialist country. Since imperialists and all sorts of reactionary forces joined hands with each other to hinder socialism in its progress and challenge it Kim Jong Il regarded it as an important requirement for the successful accomplishment of the socialist cause to strengthen the international unity and solidarity of revolutionary parties and energetically led the struggle to achieve it. The Pyongyang Declaration on defending and advancing the cause of socialism was adopted in 1992. It provided a program for the struggle of revolutionary parties in the world. The Pyongyang Declaration delivered a telling blow to the anti-socialist maneuvers of imperialists and revved up the struggle of revolutionary peoples for the rebuilding of socialism further. Our Party has been a dignified revolutionary party of Juche which leads the cause of socialism. The cause advances victoriously along its path, surmounting its hardship and trials. Kim Jong Il is an illustrious commander of extraordinary caliber who firmly defended the peace and security of northeast Asia and the rest of the world and the cause of socialism with his outstanding Songun-based revolutionary leadership. Our revolution was confronted with the greatest difficulties ever during the arduous march because the imperialist allied forces ran amok to stifle the DPRK and did their utmost to impede our revolution in its victorious march forward and obliterate our socialism. The imperialists concentrated all their attack on our country. Its people were forced to stand at the crossroads of life and death because they had to choose between coming off victors as the independent people and guards and being reduced to the colonial slaves of imperialists again. The whole world watched the Korean peninsula with concern. Kim Jong Il held the banner of Songun high without the slightest vacillation and roused all the people to righteous action to defend the country and socialism. With implicit faith that the destiny of the country and the nation depended on the arms of the revolution he strengthened and developed our armed forces into invincible ones further and moved our defence capabilities on to a new footing. He led our revolution to victory with confidence, resolutely overpowering imperialists and crushing their outrageous pressure and challenges by most toughly countering their knives with our swords and their guns with our cannon. United single-mindedly around Kim Jong Il in their fierce confrontation with imperialists our people brought their arduous march and successive forced march to a victorious conclusion and honorably defended their national security and sovereignty as well as their socialism. Our country contributed a great deal to defending the peace and security of northeast Asia and the rest of the world with its unbreakable political and military power. Thanks entirely to Kim Jong Il, our country solidly defended its socialism and ensured global peace and security despite the unparalleledly intensive machinations of imperialists and other reactionary forces of all hues against it. But for his exceptional wisdom, prominent leadership and iron will, the cause of socialism would not have been able to withstand the overlapping challenges of history and incessant political storms or blaze the way to its development with success. He is highly praised by all the people for rendering great services of world-historic significance to the times and history. His undying exploits are splendidly carried forward by Comrade Kim Jong Un at the head of our revolution. Kim Jong Un has mapped out a great plan to develop the cause of socialism further true to Kim Jong Il’s intentions and fully applies himself to carrying it out. Eternal luster will be added by Kim Jong Un to the undying exploits of Kim Jong Il and the cause of socialism will be advanced by him dynamically without cease. Ri Hak Nam

title: More Oath-taking Meetings Held across Country
body: More meetings took place in different units across the country to pledge to carry out without fail the first-year tasks of the five-year plan in response to the hearty appeal made by the workers of the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex. Read out at the meetings was the appeal to the working people across the country issued by the workers of the complex. And the goals to be attained by the units this year were mentioned, which was followed by oath-taking speeches of officials and workers to thoroughly carry out the decisions made at the Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) with the fighting spirit of self-reliance and perseverance. The speakers said that the appeal made by the workers of the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex is inspiring the patriotic zeal for revolution of the working people who are ushering in a new era of self-respect and prosperity, an era of our state-first principle, boldly overcoming all difficulties under the leadership of the Party. They expressed their firm will to make substantial change and successes by bringing about new innovation, bold creation and steady progress in response to the appeal made by the workers of the complex and thus firmly defend the prestige of the dignified WPK. Rodong Sinmun

title: Top Priority Given to Ensuring Quality
body: The Sariwon Tractor Parts Factory tries hard to mass-produce the good-quality accessories of tractors for busy cooperative farms. It sees to it that its employees preferentially raise the quality of their products so as to manufacture each of them qualitatively and contribute actually to enabling much farm work to be done with the help of machines. Of late, it introduced many technological innovations of value into its production. The workers and technicians of the STPF assigned to produce parts to be machined pool their creative wisdom and strength in melting iron ores with considerably less electricity as soon as possible and turning out quality castings. At the 1st and 2nd processing workshops of the STPF assigned to process the accessories of tractors workers improve their technological knowledge and skills and vigorously conduct a drive to overtake and outstrip each other, learn from each other and exchange experiences with each other, thereby effecting innovations in processing the accessories. Rodong Sinmun

title: Technologies of Realistic Importance Invented and Applied
body: The scientists and technicians of the Sinuiju High Technology Exchange of the State Academy of Sciences actively settle the scientific and technological problems of actual pressing urgency. They made solar energy traffic signposts and set them up along the roads of Sinuiju. The signposts were favorably commented on by pedestrians and drivers. The SHTE recently researched modern illumination technology and nanotechnology for grinding artificial stone floors and introduced them into many units. In addition, it achieved lots of other successes in developing technologies. Rodong Sinmun

title: Its Mountains Effectively Used
body: The Tunggong Farm in Manpho City has bolstered up its stockbreeding true to the Party policy of effectively using mountains in mountainous regions. The result is that it profits from it. It designated its third workteam as a model. It ensured that the workteam built an integrated stable there and raised animals in large numbers. On the basis of this it made sure that its other workteams, too, built an integrated stockbreeding base separately and extensively pushed ahead with their stockbreeding. A circular chain production system for farm production and stockbreeding has been established at the TF. Consequently, its fields have been enriched to lead to an increase in its cereal output. In addition, it rebuilt a saplings greenhouse, a tree nursery and a fishing pond and showed an example to other units in the city. It also built a solar heat greenhouse and a mushroom production center in a big way, thus helping toward improving the dietary standard of its agricultural workers. It always leads other units in scientific farming by briskly applying numerous advanced methods to it. Furthermore, it produces saplings of many superior strains on its own year by year and thereby contributes to afforestation. It boasts the Tunggong Health Complex which includes bathrooms, a barber shop, a beauty parlor, etc. It also produces honey for itself and regularly supplies it to its women in childbed. Rodong Sinmun

title: Captivated by His Great Charisma
body: The greatness of a great man is that of his philosophy and ideology. Chairman Kim Jong Il is the greatest of all great men. He gave perfect answers to all the problems of the accomplishment of the cause of human independence, that of socialism, by conducting energetic ideological and theoretical activities. Therefore, those who met him and received teachings from him or read his immortal encyclopedic works avidly were all fascinated by his outstanding charisma as a highly gifted thinker and theoretician and adored him very much. They include Vishwanath who was the secretary of the International Kim Il Sung Prize Council and the International Kim Jong Il Prize Council and the director general of the International Institute of the Juche Idea. He said from the bottom of his heart that Kim Jong Il was the sun of mankind who gave brilliant light to the world and powerfully led the cause of human independence to victory. Toward the end of last century the cause of human independence was faced with crisis due to the collapse of socialism in some countries, bloody wars on imperialists’ part, national disputes and so on. Imperialists and reactionary forces jubilantly chattered about “the absence of socialism in the 21st century”. Imperialist reactionary forces focused all their attack on socialist Korea. A preeminent thinker and theoretician, a champion of a rightful cause and an iron-willed man of matchless courage, Kim Jong Il announced the victory of the cause of socialism at that difficult and complex juncture. He published the immortal work “Socialism Is a Science”, in which he proved the inevitability of the victory of socialism as a science and manifested the ways to the final victory of socialism. Vishwanath was deeply moved. He keenly realized once again that the future of mankind was guaranteed by the outstanding ideology, theory and political ability of Kim Jong Il and that victory in the cause of human independence lay in adopting his great idea as guidelines on the struggle for it. Vishwanath made up his mind to trust and follow nobody but Kim Jong Il who was a great thinker, theoretician and philosopher as well as an outstanding veteran statesman and the most seasoned leader. He was firmly convinced that mankind would have a bright future only when it espoused him. Many other foreign friends, too, revered Kim Jong Il with their whole hearts charmed by his extraordinary wisdom and outstanding political ability. The politicians and mass media of the West also spoke very highly of him as a great personality. Despite the lapse of much time the personages in all walks of life and progressive peoples of different countries still respect Kim Jong Il warmly for having performed immortal exploits for the future of mankind. Moreover, they incessantly give presents to him and award him orders, medals and honorary titles. Kim Jong Il will always live in the hearts of mankind like the sun. Rodong Sinmun

title: Moved by His Warm Human Love
body: Heartily captivated by the charisma and human love of a great man one boundlessly respects and follows him. It is the product of one’s truest and most ardent thoughts and feelings. Chairman Kim Jong Il loved man most loftily and warmly. Nobody could excel him in it. Therefore, the progressive personages and people of the world in all walks of life passionately revered and followed him, boundlessly fascinated with his charisma. They persevere in doing so still today. Kim Jong Il brought numerous foreign aspirants after independence around and warmly loved them. This still lingers on the memory of world. When the Day of the Shining Star (February 16, the birthday of Kim Jong Il) approached several years ago, a letter was sent to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. It reads in part: "I (Jindallae) have already enshrined the great leader General Kim Jong Il in my heart as my real father. My family and I will firmly stand by the brothers and sisters of Korea anywhere and celebrate the Day of the Shining Star together with the Day of the Sun (April 15) year by year." The addressers were Mustafa Al Saphariny and his daughter named Jindallae Saphariny, the citizens of Palestine. The memory of Kim Jong Il is cherished deeply in their hearts. In 1985 Mustafa Al Saphariny was stationed in Pyongyang as a diplomatic representative of Palestine to the DPRK. That year his wife had her disease treated in the Pyongyang Maternity Hospital and gave birth to a lovely daughter. This pleased her and her husband very much because she had been to all famous foreign hospitals and taken all super medicines without exception, but to no avail. Saphariny and his wife decided to address a letter to Kim Jong Il and thank him for his benevolence from the bottom of their hearts. In the letter they wrote that from antiquity it was the ways of Palestine for its people to visit the most learned and esteemed men after the birth of their children and have them named by them and accordingly implored Kim Jong Il to name their daughter. Kim Jong Il was kind enough to name their daughter "Jindallae" at their request and what was more, give her many presents of hereditary value to wish her health and happiness. Since then, Mustafa Al Saphariny had often been called "Jindallae's father" by diplomats instead of being addressed as a representative. He took a great pride in it and frequently talked about the great charisma of Kim Jong Il because he boundlessly revered him for his fervent love for man. One year Jindallae Saphariny addressed a congratulatory letter to Kim Jong Il and presented him with a photo album on the occasion of his birthday. In the letter she said sincerely that she was born in Pyongyang and spent her childhood there, that the DPRK was her second motherland and that he was her true father who helped toward her birth and brought her up with warm love. There are also other examples of Kim Jong Il’s love. In mid-November 1994 a foreigner by the name of Wail Baracat was seriously injured in the major internal organs in a sudden accident and fell into a critical condition. He was brought to a hospital by car. He lay senseless and barely remained alive. As a result, its longtime doctors did not dare to operate on him resolutely. The mother of the patient, too, flew to Korea quite a distance from Egypt but gave him up as dead. At this juncture, Kim Jong Il was informed by the officials concerned of this and saw to it that necessary measures were taken to rescue the patient from death although the DPRK seriously mourned over its great national loss. Thanks to Kim Jong Il, competent doctors joined together to treat the patient and up-to-the-minute medical equipment and rare and precious medicines were used to this end. The doctors did their utmost day and night to bring the patient back to life. Consequently, a miracle was wrought. The patient hovered between life and death for over a month but finally regained his sense. A small number of days after, he recovered completely from his injuries and left the hospital. This was quite beyond imagination in capitalist countries. Therefore, Wail, his mother and other members of the Egyptian embassy were very grateful to Kim Jong Il for his solicitude. Wail said with great emotion that he owed his rebirth in the DPRK to Kim Jong Il, had the blood of Korean comrades in his body and was going to change his name to a Korean one. There are very great numbers of other stories of this sort. Kim Jong Il learned that the birthdays of many foreign delegates to the 13th World Festival of Youth and Students would occur during the festival and saw to it that all of them were served with Korean dishes and their favorite ones as well on their birthdays. This was and has so far been without precedent in the history of the WFYS. Kim Jong Il saw to it that all foreign visitors to our country were treated warmly, warmed their hearts with kind words, valued the relations he formed with them and retained them to the last. As a result, he advanced ideas and theories of love for man and consistently pursued benevolent policies for man. Therefore, the progressive mankind of the world passionately admires and lauds Kim Jong Il for his great personality century after century. Rodong Sinmun

title: Their Production Quotas under the National Economic Plan for February Carried Out
body: The plans for the manufacture of pig iron, steel, rolled steel and other important products were successfully fulfilled on indices last February in the sector of the metal industry. The Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex topped the plan for the production of its pig iron ahead of schedule by taking good technological care of its equipment. The Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex and the Chollima Steel Complex also achieved successes in their production, concentrating their energies on readjusting and reinforcing the foundations for it and bending every effort to manufacture irons and steels. The Unryul and Jaeryong Mines and other iron ore producers, plus the Hungnam Electrode Factory, the Puryong Ferroalloy Factory and many other units, reliably backed up the increased production of irons and steels. The sphere of the chemical industry executed its production plan for February. The Namhung Youth Chemical Complex tried hard to produce fertilizer for our socialist cooperative farms in the spirit of self-reliance. The February 8 Vinalon Complex registered successes in turning out caustic soda and many other chemical goods on indices. In addition, many other chemical factories hit their production targets for February by dint of hard work. The domain of the coal industry did its utmost to top the plan for the production of its coal. The coal mines of the Sunchon and Pukchang Area Youth Coal Mining Complexes and the Tokchon and Kujang Area Coal Mining Complexes focused on their prospecting and tunneling on the one hand and went all out to boost their coal output on the other, tapping out their internal reserves and potentials to the maximum. Many coal mines of the Tukjang, Kaechon and Anju Area Coal Mining Complexes overfulfilled the plans for the production of their coal by their tremendous efforts. The field of the lumber industry executed its production plan for February. Rodong Sinmun

title: Tens of Millions of Saplings Secured
body: North Hamgyong Province makes endeavors to produce the saplings needed for planting purposes in spring. Its provincial tree nursery and city and county forest management stations increased the production of their saplings paying attention to securing seeds of good varieties and improving their growing conditions. The province is now fertilizing and tending its saplings well and preparing for planting them in spring. Rodong Sinmun

title: Regarded as Important in Securing Raw Materials
body: Jagang Province secures the reserves for its raw materials purposefully relying on its regional features and potentials. It preferentially arranged for sunflowers of great economic effect to be grown in large numbers to set up the reserves for the raw materials for its oil production. It also ensures that all its cities and counties gather acorns and other wild fruits and vegetables for using them actively as the raw materials for the production of their foodstuffs and consistently procure the raw materials for the production of their soy and salted acorn paste. It pays close attention to the procurement of secondhand articles. It also gives due heed to securing the raw materials for the production of its soaps with its own strength and technology and strives mightily to produce caustic soda on its own. Rodong Sinmun

title: Output of Their Organic Compound Manure Increased
body: North Phyongan Province makes great efforts to produce organic compound manure. It has now procured hundreds of thousands of tons of raw materials for it and turned it out by tens of thousands of tons. Its cities and counties are now augmenting the output of their organic compound manure according to their regional features while bettering its quality. Rodong Sinmun

title: Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex Vigorously Supported
body: The officials and working people of North Hwanghae Province support the workers of the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex morally and materially. A few days ago they secured plenty of the raw and other materials needed to manufacture steel in large quantities and donated them to the HISC. Rodong Sinmun

title: 13th Enlarged Plenary Meeting of 9th Central Committee of Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League Held
body: The 13th Enlarged Plenary Meeting of the 9th Central Committee of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League took place via tele-conference system on March 3. It was attended by members and alternate members of the Central Committee of the youth league. Present there as observers were youth league officials of cities and counties. The meeting discussed the issue of devotedly implementing the first-year tasks of the five-year plan set forth at the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea, the issue of intensifying the struggle against anti- and non-socialist practices throughout society, etc. Pak Chol Min, chairman of the Central Committee of the youth league, made reports on the agenda items. The reporter analyzed and reviewed the shortcomings revealed by youth league committees of Pyongyang, provinces, cities and counties in drawing up this year's plans for carrying out the decisions of the Party Congress, and set forth the ways to demonstrate the dignity of the youth league as reliable reserves of the Party by further enhancing the fighting efficiency of youth league organizations and thus making a breakthrough in implementing the new five-year plan. He stressed the need for youth league organizations to launch a stout and vigorous ideological offensive, an intensive struggle for eradicating anti- and non-socialist practices and to powerfully organize and conduct the work for thoroughly establishing the socialist lifestyle. The reporter stressed the need to devotedly implement the militant tasks set forth at the 8th Party Congress and the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the WPK and to greet the 10th Congress of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League with achievements in the work of the youth league. Speeches were made at the meeting. Adopted at the meeting were resolutions reflecting the suggestions made on the basis of the study and discussion of the agenda items. Rodong Sinmun

title: Premier Kim Tok Hun Inspects Various Fields of National Economy
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the DPRK, inspected various fields of the national economy. Looking round the construction sites of the project for creating the C1 chemical industry, Kim Tok Hun called on officials to prepare reliable technical forces for further improving the self-sustenance of the chemical industry, certainly carry out the construction plan as scheduled and increase the proportion of locally available equipment and materials, bearing deep in mind the importance of duties they assumed in implementing the decisions of the Eighth Party Congress. After acquainting himself in detail with the production by the heavy-machine building shop of the Rakwon General Machine Enterprise, he took a measure for increasing the production of highly efficient machineries and equipment by timely introducing scientific research successes and pushing ahead with the upgrading of production processes in a far-sighted way. At the Sokha Cooperative Farm in Sinuiju City, he underscored the need to increase the fertility of soil by boosting the production of various organic compound fertilizers and actively introduce high-yielding species whose superior has been proved in the reality. The field consultative meetings discussed realistic ways to bring about practical changes and substantial progress in the struggle for implementing the first-year tasks of the new five-year plan in hearty response to the spirit of the Second Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the WPK. Rodong Sinmun

title: 13th Plenary Meeting of 14th SPA Standing Committee Held
body: The 13th Plenary Meeting of the Standing Committee of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly (SPA) of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) was held at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Wednesday. Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, and chairman of the Standing Committee of the SPA, presided over the plenary meeting. Attending the meeting were Vice-Chairmen Thae Hyong Chol and Pak Yong Il, Secretary General Ko Kil Son and members of the Standing Committee of the SPA. Present there as observers were officials concerned of the Standing Committee of the SPA and the Cabinet. Presented to the meeting as agendas were the issues of adopting the DPRK law on social insurance and social security and the DPRK law on disinfection of imports and approving the national economic development plan of the DPRK for Juche 110 (2021) and the master plan for land development in the east coastal area. Given at the meeting was an explanation of the main contents of the law on social insurance and social security and the law on disinfection of imports examined by the SPA Legislation Committee. The law on social insurance and social security that carries 90 provisions calls for protecting the people's health and providing them with stable and happy living conditions, and specifies in detail the accumulation and expenditure of social insurance money, the organization, operation and duty of social insurance organ, etc. It also deals with principled matters arising in the observation and execution of the law, including procedures for social security, organization and operation of social security organ, preferential treatment for meritorious persons and guidance and control over the work of social insurance and social security. The law on disinfection of imports stipulates the matters arising in defending the security of the state and reliably protecting the people's life by strictly establishing the system and order of disinfecting imports at border-passing spots, and the contents of due penalty for violating the proceedings, method and order of disinfection of imports and others. The meeting heard reports on the national economic development plan for Juche 110 (2021) and the master plan for land development in the east coastal area. On the basis of in-depth study and full discussion of the agendas, the plenary meeting adopted with unanimous approval the decrees of the SPA Standing Committee "On Adopting the DPRK Law on Social Insurance and Social Security", "On Adopting the DPRK Law on Disinfection of Imports", "On Approving the National Economic Development Plan of the DPRK for Juche 110 (2021)" and "On Approving the Master Plan for Land Development in the East Coastal Area". Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Baskets to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: The General Association of Koreans in China and the Federation of Korean Economic Workers in China sent floral baskets to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on the occasion of the 30th founding anniversary of the General Association of Koreans in China. The floral baskets were laid at the statues on March 3. Rodong Sinmun

title: Occasion for Important Turn in Strengthening Regional Bases of Socialist Construction
body: First Short Course for Chief Secretaries of City and County Party Committees Opens General Secretary of WPK Kim Jong Un Makes Opening Address The first short course for chief secretaries of the city and county Party committees was held at the conference hall of the office building of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) on March 3 at a time when the grand struggle is being waged to achieve the comprehensive development of our own-style socialism along the path of sure victory indicated by the ever-victorious WPK. The short course for chief secretaries of the city and county Party committees, the first of its kind in the history of our Party, comes to be an important occasion to consolidate the fighting efficiency of the entire Party and develop local economy and improve the people's standard of living by remarkably enhancing the function and role of the city and county Party organizations which are chiefly responsible for implementing the Party's idea of attaching importance to cities and counties and line on strengthening them. Attending the course were chief secretaries of the city and county Party committees across the country, chief secretaries of the provincial Party committees and officials of relevant departments of the provincial Party committees. Also present there were secretaries of the Party Central Committee, directors and first vice-directors of its relevant departments and its officials related with the local Party work. Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the WPK, appeared at the hall to guide the first short course for chief secretaries of the city and county Party committees. All the participants in the course raised stormy cheers of "hurrah!", full of great emotion that they came to receive precious instructions of the General Secretary at the supreme staff of the Korean revolution which sheds noble light as the symbol of great victory and glory in the hearts of the Party members and other people across the country. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un made an opening address. Kim Jong Un in the address said that after the dissemination of the spirit of the 8th Party Congress and the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee, the short course for chief secretaries of the city and county Party committees was organized before everything else with special importance attached to the significance of renovating the city and county Party work in shifting all the fronts of the socialist construction over to a new stage of development and promoting the balanced and simultaneous development throughout the country. He referred to the importance of city and county, which are the lowest-level guidance and executive units for the implementation of our Party's policies, regional bases directing the rural and local economy and powerful fortresses supporting the comprehensive development of the country, and to the status of the city and county Party committees. Noting that our socialist construction that entered on a new phase urges for a strong traction power to be provided to push ahead with the development of cities and counties on a full-scale, he said that the role of chief secretaries of the city and county Party committees, who are deputies of the Party Central Committee, is very important in making the city and county Party organizations steer the development of their regions. The chief secretaries of the city and county Party committees are the hard core of our Party in charge of regional bases of the socialist construction and the field political workers who are shouldering the heavy responsibilities of taking care of people while living nearest to them, he said, stressing that the decisions of the Party congress can be thoroughly implemented and our own-style socialism develop and advance rapidly only when the chief secretaries bring about fundamental changes in their work with revolutionary political awareness. He said that as the 8th Party Congress illuminated important policy orientations for developing cities and counties across the country in an independent and many-sided way, now everything depends on strenuous efforts and role of the chief secretaries, adding that under the present situation, the Party Central Committee is determined to enhance the level of their working ability and improve their style of work above all to provide a new turning point in the development of cities and counties and specially prepared the short course with much care. He said that through the course, the chief secretaries should review their overall work before the Party Central Committee and study in a positive, responsible and earnest manner to find a clear way for revitalizing their cities and counties while exchanging and sharing good experiences with correct recognition of the importance of strengthening cities and counties and political needs. He stressed that the chief secretaries should deeply bear in mind the heavy duty and sense of responsibility that they are in charge of important strategic fortresses and bases of the Party and the state and should earnestly study how to live up to the demand and great expectation of the people by turning the areas in their charge into socialist paradise and how to turn them into iron fortress, inviolable cornerstone impregnably defending the Party and the state. He stressed that the chief secretaries should deeply grasp the principles and methods of the Juche-oriented Party work, the embodiment of the people-first principle, and bear in mind the methodologies one by one for bringing about decisive turn in the work of the city and county Party committees one after another with a view to substantially consolidate their political and practical qualifications and ability to lead their regions. Expressing belief that as the short course is the first intersection meeting for implementing the decisions of the 8th Party Congress, it would be an important occasion to bring about a fundamental innovation in the ideological viewpoint, work style, qualification and mental and moral trait of the chief secretaries of the city and county Party committees and provide a fresh turning point in the development of cities and counties as planned and intended by the Party Central Committee, he declared the first short course for chief secretaries of the city and county Party committees open. There took place a meeting, as part of the short course, to comprehensively analyze the work done by the chief secretaries of the city and county Party committees in recent years, review successes, experience and mistakes revealed in it and their reasons and take measures for practical improvement. Jo Yong Won, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and secretary in charge of organizational affairs of the Party Central Committee, made a report calling upon the chief secretaries to thoroughly implement the Party's line on and policy of strengthening cities and counties by directing their efforts into the Party work. Referring to the important ideologies and theories and policies advanced by our Party for the development of cities and counties in every period of the developing revolution and their great vitality, Jo Yong Won introduced experiences gained by the chief secretaries who have made clear successes in developing their cities and counties true to the intention of the Party Central Committee. The report made an anatomical analysis of shortcomings being revealed in the work of some chief secretaries and some city and county Party committees. The report sharply censured the shortcomings of underrating the importance of the Party's internal work and failing to properly give Party guidance, policy-oriented guidance to the administrative and economic work and deviations of failing to properly apply our Party's people-first politics. Jo Yong Won said the present situation shows that if we fail to direct efforts into the Party's internal work, work with the people and keep the revolutionary climate throughout the Party while laying stress only on the administrative and economic work, our Party work can not be the vivid one and revolutionary guidance to actually strengthen the Party and revolutionary ranks into an integral whole and accelerate the speed of advance of the revolution. He in his report stressed the need for the city and county Party committees to thoroughly carry out the Party's line on and policy of strengthening cities and counties by becoming a powerful engine leading the development of their regions and masters of city and county economies as required by the era and the developing revolution. The report called upon all the chief secretaries of the city and county Party committees to fulfill their responsibility and duty as befitting the regional aides to the Party Central Committee in vigorously arousing officials, Party members and other working people to the struggle for implementing the decisions made at the 8th Party Congress and the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee. Made public at the meeting was the city and county standings decided by the Party Central Committee on the basis of the appraisal of the city and county Party committees' implementation of Party policies. Then speeches were made. The first short course for chief secretaries of the city and county Party committees continues. Political News Team

title: Tree-planting Day Marked in DPRK
body: The spring tree-planting has been launched in the DPRK on the occasion of the Tree-planting Day. Officials and working people across the country planted one million and hundreds of thousands of trees on March 2 alone. They took an active part in the tree-planting, looking back upon the immortal exploits of the peerlessly great persons who initiated the tree-planting movement and worked heart and soul to turn the whole country into thick woodland and greenery. The officials of working people's organizations and ministries have turned out as one in planting trees in hearty response to the Party's intention for covering the mountains of the country with green woods. They planted good species of trees and flower shrubs, including pine tree and pine-nut tree, around the statues of the peerlessly great men, revolutionary sites and other places. People in all provinces, cities and counties planted trees that day while stringently meeting anti-epidemic requirements. Rodong Sinmun

title: Jagang Province Art Theatre Opens
body: The Jagang Province Art Theatre was opened with due ceremony on Tuesday. The theatre built on the bank of the Jangja River in Kanggye City has an auditorium with over 1 500 seats, lobby, make-up-room, creation room, exercise rooms and welfare facilities. The construction of the new theatre means the creation of another base for making contribution to the cultural and emotional life of the people in the province. Present at the opening ceremony were Ri Hyong Gun, chairman of the Jagang Provincial People's Committee, officials concerned, artistes of the art troupe of the province, employees of the theatre, builders and working people in the city. Rodong Sinmun

title: Their Quotas Fulfilled under the National Economic Plans for February
body: Power producers countrywide fulfilled their plan for February working hard to execute the decisions of the 8th Congress of the Workers’ Party of Korea. The Pukchang Thermal Power Complex and the Pyongyang, Sunchon, Chongchongang and East Pyongyang Power Stations mobilized their reserves and potentials to the maximum and responsibly put their power-generating machines in full normal operation. The workers and management of hydropower stations scientifically controlled their water, operated their machines and repaired and maintained them on a normal footing so as to increase their power output. Those of the sector of the extractive industry carried out the plans for their important products for February. Those of the Sangwon and Sunchon Cement Complexes and the Chonnaeri Cement Factory fulfilled the plans for the production of their cement for February. Those of the railway sector executed their transport plan for February. The Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill and the Sinuiju, Sariwon, Kusong and September Textile Mills topped the plans for the production of their spun yarn and ordinary cloth intensifying cooperation between processes and conducting a vigorous socialist emulation. The Songyo, Aeguk and Hamhung Knitting Mills and other producers procured raw materials by tapping out their internal reserves and dynamically stepped up their production with the machines they managed with technological expertise. The Wonsan Shoes Factory, the Pyongyang Footwear Factory, the Pyongyang Daily Necessities Factory, the Sinuiju and Pyongyang Cosmetics Factories, the Kanggye Pencil Factory, the Hamhung Disabled Soldiers’ Essential Plastic Goods Factory and many other light industry units made good arrangements for their production and directed it well, thereby topping their plans for February. Rodong Sinmun

title: Realistic Measures Adopted to Ensure the Stability of Its Agricultural Production
body: Those who are on the Rural Economic Committee of North Hamgyong Province find the scientific and technological ways of stably ensuring its agricultural production for this year and put them in creditable execution one by one. To begin with, it makes primary endeavors to improve the structure of crops on the principle of the right crop for the right soil and the right crop in the right time to suit the physiographical features of a given area and properly distribute various strains of crops. It provides the units concerned with necessary seeds satisfactorily. In addition, it actively detects and settles important new problems of increasing the output of the province’s cereals. Rodong Sinmun

title: Youths in Nampho City Volunteer to Work in Rural Areas
body: Over 140 youths in Nampho City volunteered to work in over 20 farms of the city, including Chongsan Co-op Farm in Kangso District, Kumdang Co-op Farm in Onchon County and Okdo Co-op Farm in Ryonggang County. It is their unanimous desire to become passionate patriotic farmers, who safeguard the Party and revolution and firmly defend the socialist system with increased rice production by cultivating farm fields with devoted efforts of patriotism, as done by those of the preceding generations who had heartily responded to the call of the Party and the country. A meeting took place at the Nampho City Art Theatre on Thursday to congratulate the volunteers. Present there were Pak Chol Min, chairman of the Central Committee of the youth league, Song Sung Chol, chairman of the Nampho City People's Committee, officials concerned, those of the youth league and working youths in the city. Pledge-making speeches were made at the meeting. A congratulatory performance was given by the art squad of the Central Committee of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League and officials, youths and working people in the city saw the volunteers off. Rodong Sinmun

title: Enchanted by Greatness of Legendary Hero
body: Many foreign friends looked up to President Kim Il Sung and spoke highly of him as a legendary hero of the anti-Japanese war from long ago. They included T. B. Mukherjee, ex-director of Asian Regional Institute of the Juche Idea. He had come to admire Kim Il Sung since around 1940. In those days he was in his twenties and attended Patna University. During lessons his history professor frequently talked about the anti-Japanese revolutionary war organized and led by Kim Il Sung. It created a great stir in his heart. Since then he had looked forward to meeting Kim Il Sung. He visited the DPRK in June 1980 and was greatly honored to meet Kim Il Sung who led the anti-Japanese war to shining victory with his outstanding art of command. He came to know that the immortal Juche Idea he adhered to staunchly was created in the sanguinary war against the Japanese imperialists. Therefore, he always used to say that when he saw Kim Il Sung for the first time he felt as if he were apparently a general in his twenties and legendary hero who won the bloody anti-Japanese war through thick and thin. Myriads of the progressive people of the world still respect Kim Il Sung boundlessly for having led the arduous anti-Japanese armed struggle to victory and contributed greatly to the cause of human emancipation. The vice-chairman of the Socialist Freedom Party of Egypt, the general secretary of the central committee of the Lebanese Communist Party and other leaders of the political parties of many countries said that the liberation of Korea was a great historic event which constituted the victory of progressive fighters against imperialist colonial rule and that the fact that Kim Il Sung set a world-historic example to the struggle for national liberation by winning the revolutionary war against Japan would be cherished in the hearts of the Korean people and humankind forever. The mass media of the world also highly praise Kim Il Sung for liberating Korea from Japanese colonial rule. Rodong Sinmun

title: Warm Care Taken of the Orphans
body: Ri Hyok Il and Ri Yong Yon live in Neighborhood Unit 49, Phyongchon-dong 1, Phyongchon District, Pyongyang. They are 15 and 13 respectively. They, too, are cheerful, optimistic and ambitious like other children. They are orphans. They lost their father more than ten years ago and their mother two years ago. But they are carefree. Many women volunteer to call on the orphans at home and undertake them of their own accord. One of them washes their clothes, quilts and so on. The other examines their homework and gives them advices on their school lessons and activities in liaison with their teacher. Still the other cooks their meals at the kitchen of their flat. The rest, too, frequent it and do them good. Ri Yong Yon finished her primary school and entered the Tongan High Middle School in Central District enrolled in its vocal music class for children of early age. Admitted to the Changdok School her elder brother learns at a mathematical class of bright children. Last October another woman named Ri Ok Sim visited the orphans at their flat on the occasion of the birthday of the Workers’ Party of Korea. She is the head of the Phyongchon Chow Mein Eating House. She brought with her the special meals she and her employees cooked sincerely. Today the orphans have a good time loudly singing the song "We Are the Happiest in the World." Rodong Sinmun

title: When One Buckles Down with Determination
body: The labor and management of the Jongbangsan Mushroom Farm make efficacious nutritional agents and effectively use them for boosting the output of their mushrooms. The JMF used the nutritional agents in a process alone in the past. But its officials and technicians made active efforts to grow plenty of nourishing productive mushrooms and finally provided a guarantee for applying the nutritional agents to other processes, too. It still works responsibly to mass-produce delicious and nutritious mushrooms at all seasons. Rodong Sinmun

title: In Order to Raise Portion of Mechanization
body: The workers and management of a farm machine station in Kujang County produced tens of kinds of spare parts. They proceed to dynamically repair the tractors and rice seedling transplanters of the county. By their own efforts they repair lots of them every day and score successes also in making and remodeling farm machines. Rodong Sinmun

title: Production of Custom-built Equipment Pushed Ahead with
body: The workers and management of the Ranam Coal Mining Machine Complex have made detailed arrangements for producing an ore pulp-pipelining pump needed to convey concentrates to the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex and a set of plant for the Komdok Mining Complex. They are now doing their utmost to manufacture them. Above all, the RCMMC goes all out to make the pump by the appointed time. It also steps up the production of various kinds of valves and other auxiliary devices on schedule. In addition, it registers high results day by day in manufacturing a set of plant for the Komdok Mining Complex. Rodong Sinmun

title: 11th Enlarged Plenary Meeting of 7th Central Committee of GFTUK Held
body: The 11th Enlarged Plenary Meeting of the 7th Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea (GFTUK) took place via tele-conference system on Thursday. Attending the meeting were members and alternate members of the Central Committee of the GFTUK. Present there as observers were officials of the Central Committee of the GFTUK and its city and county committees. The meeting discussed the issue of devotedly implementing the first-year tasks of the five-year plan set forth at the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea, the issue of further intensifying the struggle against anti- and non-socialist practices throughout the society, etc. Pak In Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the GFTUK, made reports on agenda items. The reporter analyzed and reviewed in detail the shortcomings revealed in the work for mapping out the first-year plan of the new five-year plan, and referred to the ways for fully demonstrating the might of the GFTUK as a mass political organization of the working class in the on-going general offensive. He called upon all the officials of the GFTUK to carry out in a responsible manner the revolutionary tasks entrusted to them by displaying extraordinary work ability, enthusiasm and devotion and thus bring about revolutionary improvement in their fighting traits and work attitude. He stressed the need to further intensify the struggle for thoroughly eradicating anti- and non-socialist practices which are threatening our politico-ideological position, class position at present. Speeches were made at the meeting. Relevant resolutions were adopted at the enlarged plenary meeting after a full discussion of draft resolutions presented to the meeting was made. Rodong Sinmun

title: 12th Enlarged Plenary Meeting of 8th C.C., UAWK Held
body: The 12th Enlarged Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea (UAWK) took place via teleconference system on March 4. Attending the meeting were members and alternate members of the UAWK Central Committee. Present there as observers were UAWK officials in Pyongyang and other parts of the country. The meeting discussed the issue of devotedly implementing the first-year tasks of the five-year plan set forth at the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea. And the issue of further intensifying the struggle against anti- and non-socialist practices throughout the society was brought up. Han Jong Hyok, chairman of the UAWK Central Committee, made reports on the agenda items. The reporter seriously analyzed and reviewed the shortcomings of failing to map out the goals for this year in an innovative way and take revolutionary and positive measures for improving the work of the union, and raised practical issues arising in accomplishing the first-year tasks of the five-year plan. The reporter said that all UAWK organizations would wage a dynamic campaign for scientific farming and high-yielding emulation with main emphasis put on seed production, scientific farming, increased output in low-yielding fields and cultivation of new land, organize a powerful socialist emulation headquarters for increased agricultural production and enhance its sense of responsibility and role to the maximum. The reporter referred to the shortcomings revealed by UAWK organizations and officials in their struggle of the past against anti- and non-socialist practices, and lessons and causes. And he referred to the tasks and ways for consolidating our single-hearted unity and politico-ideological position, class position in every way and preserving the true nature of socialism. Speeches were made at the meeting. At the meeting, relevant resolutions were adopted on the basis of suggestions brought together through earnest study and discussion of draft resolutions on the agenda items. Rodong Sinmun

title: 11th Enlarged Plenary Meeting of 6th Central Committee of Socialist Women's Union of Korea Held
body: The 11th Enlarged Plenary Meeting of the 6th Central Committee of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea took place via tele-conference system on March 4. It was attended by members and alternate members of the Central Committee of the women's union. Present there as observers were women's union officials of cities and counties. The meeting discussed the issue of devotedly implementing the first-year tasks of the five-year plan set forth at the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea, the issue of intensifying the struggle against anti- and non-socialist practices throughout the society, etc. Jang Chun Sil, chairwoman of the Central Committee of the women's union, made reports on the agenda items. The reporter analyzed in detail the deviations latent in the work of the women's union and their causes on the basis of the main idea and spirit of the Party Congress, and referred to measures to bring about a fundamental turn in the work of the union by fulfilling the duty and role as an ideological education organization in this year's struggle. She stressed the need for women's union organizations to make substantial contribution to carrying out the first-year tasks of the five-year plan by giving full play to the mental and creative power of the masses. She underscored the need for women's union organizations to wage an intensive ideological offensive for eradicating anti- and non-socialist practices and further enhance the role of union members in the struggle for consolidating our own-style socialism. Speeches were made at the meeting. Relevant resolutions were adopted at the meeting on the basis of in-depth study of the draft resolutions. Rodong Sinmun

title: Sportspersons Meet
body: There took place a meeting of sportspersons at the Basketball Gymnasium in Chongchun Street Friday. Present there were Kim Chun Sik, secretary general of the National Sports Guidance Committee, Kim Jang San, secretary general of the DPRK Football Association, Kim Myong Gun, chairman of the Korean Taekwon-Do Committee, officials in the field of sports and sportspersons. At the meeting, Kim Il Guk, minister of Physical Culture and Sports, made a report which was followed by speeches.
