The reporter and speakers said that the sports field faces the task to steadily win more medals at international games as befitting the prestige and position of our dignified state by putting spurs to the development of sports techniques and powerfully promote the socialist construction by further stimulating the sports enthusiasm across the country during the period of the new five-year plan. They called for positively encouraging the people, who have turned out in the first-year march for implementing the decisions made at the Eighth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) by further heightening the sports enthusiasm throughout the country. They stressed the need to make a positive contribution to making our dignified state ranking among advanced sports countries by certainly making achievements of patriotic loyalty in this year's campaign for implementing the decisions made at the Second Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the WPK. A resolution was adopted at the meeting. Rodong Sinmun

title: Third-day Sitting of First Short Course for Chief Secretaries of City and County Party Committees Held
body: Chief secretaries of the city and county Party committees, who received the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un's important instructions comprehensively dealing with valuable guidelines and stratagems for turning cities and counties across the country into strong fortresses of socialist construction and rich and civilized regional bases, are attending the short course, full of firm confidence and enthusiasm. The first short course for chief secretaries of the city and county Party committees continued on March 5. In the third-day sitting, lectures were given to make the chief secretaries comprehensively and systematically renew the understanding of the issues arising in consolidating the single-hearted unity of the Party and the revolutionary ranks in every way and providing efficient Party guidance for developing cities and counties in an independent and many-sided way. Lectures were given by O Su Yong, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and secretary in charge of economic affairs of the Party Central Committee, and Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and director of the Organizational Leadership Department of the Party Central Committee. The lectures dealt with the issues calling on the city and county Party committees to consolidate the revolutionary position, class position by renovating the Party's organizational and ideological work and proficiently mobilize officials, Party members and other working people for implementing the decisions of the Party congress. Kim Jae Ryong gave a lecture on practical issues of the Party work arising in building up the ranks of cadres and Party ranks, improving the fighting efficiency of basic Party organizations, thoroughly applying the Party's people-first politics and preparing young people for successors to the revolution and reserves of the Party. He gave a detailed explanation of the tasks facing the city and county Party committees in transforming agricultural workers on a revolutionary and working class pattern by prioritizing the Party work in rural communities, intensifying the work with primary officials and discharged soldiers in rural areas and intensifying the three revolutions-ideological, technological and cultural- and ways to do so. He called for conducting fresh political education aiming at elevating the masses' ideological and spiritual strength and creative enthusiasm as urgently required by the era and the developing revolution and for increasing the penetration of idea and efficiency of ideological work by enlisting all the agitprop forces of the Party. The lecture also dealt with methodological matters for enhancing the role of the city and county Party organizations in developing local economy and improving the people's living standard. The secretary in charge of economic affairs in his lecture stressed that in order to turn every city and county into civilized and prosperous regional bases of socialist construction and developed regions retaining their inherent characteristics as specified in the general goal of our Party's idea of giving importance to city and county and its line of strengthening them, the city and county Party committees and chief secretaries should offer correct Party guidance and policy-oriented guidance to the economic work. He explained in detail the measures for settling the problems of food supply for people and raw materials for light industry by giving priority to boosting agricultural production, animal husbandry and fishing which hold a big share in developing the economy of cities and counties. Recommending the experience gained by the city and county Party committees which have achieved clear successes by encouraging farms to introduce scientific farming methods and correctly apply the socialist principle of distribution, he underscored the need to effectively guide the work for giving further momentum to the movement for high yield and consolidating the material and technical foundations of rural areas while giving priority to boosting the zeal of agricultural workers for production who are masters of agricultural output. He explained about the ways for increasing consumer goods by revitalizing local industrial establishments in harmony with natural and geographical characters of relevant areas and for sprucing up cities and counties and developing education, public health and physical culture. It was stressed in his lecture that all the chief secretaries of the city and county Party committees should strengthen the Party work to transform their cities and counties into revolutionary areas and should fulfill their responsibilities and roles as organizers and standard-bearers in the struggle for developing the local economy and improving the people's standard of living, bearing deep in mind the heavy duty entrusted by the Party and the people to them. Attending the lectures, which intensively dealt with the far-reaching plan of the Party Central Committee for strengthening cities and counties and practical ways for materializing it, with positive and earnest attitude, the chief secretaries are acquiring methodologies and admirable experience effectively applicable to turning their areas into the socialist paradises, model counties. Amid the continuation of the short course, their revolutionary enthusiasm to fully discharge their duty as deputies of the glorious Party Central Committee and field political officials is getting stronger. The short course continues. Political News Team

title: Great Efforts Made to Prevent the Flood Damage
body: Orang County makes efforts to readjust its waterway to prevent its farmland from being inundated. All its officials and working people roused themselves to action to rearrange the waterway well aware that it alone could promote the success of their farm work for this year. Above all, they exerted their greater efforts on fortifying a section of the waterway whose water is likely to soak into its soil owing to its characteristics. They accordingly clayed the bed of the section and hardened it. They also carpeted its flanks with large stones. As a result, the waterway is being put to rights on schedule. Rodong Sinmun

title: Inspiring Masses to Implementation of Decisions Made at Party Congress
body: North Phyongan Province carries on a dynamic political work to encourage the masses to carry out another five-year plan advanced at the Party Congress. The information department of the provincial Party Committee arranges for a squad for agitation for increased production in detail to be organized with ideological workers and for its members to conduct agitational activities for increased production at places of work and thus rouse them all to action spiritually. The province works according to its detailed plan to actively popularize good experiences in all its areas and improve the political ability of its ideological workers. The result is that the practical effect of their agitprop activities is heightened further. North Hamgyong Province, too, vigorously conducts frontline agitation for increased production. The artistes of its provincial art troupe and art propaganda squad go among the msses and conduct diversified agitational activities so as to spur them to perform miracles and exploits in their work. Rodong Sinmun

title: Model Technical Innovation Units Increase in Number
body: Many units across the country were qualified as models for technological innovations. They number 91 in all, including 9 thrice models for technological innovations and 34 twice models for technological innovations. The thrice models for technological innovations are the Mangyongdae Chicken Farm, the Mangyongdae Ponghwa Garment Factory, the Fuel Station of Moranbong District, the Pyongyang Car Station, the Changsong Foodstuff Factory, the Wonsan Children’s Foodstuff Factory, the Phyongchon Koryo Medicine Factory and the Songgan County Foodstuff Factory. The twice models for technological innovations are the Self-reliance Workshop of the Pyongyang Thermal Power Station, the Junggu Public Building Construction Company, the Repair and Maintenance Workshop of the Junggu Housing Construction Company, the Lift-installing Substation of the Pyongyang Construction Machine Plant, the 2nd Workshop of the Mirim Concrete Block Factory and the Pyongyang Cigarette Paper Factory, plus the 14 units of the Ministry of Electric Power Industry, the Capital City Construction Commission, the Ministry of Light Industry and many other ministries and national organs and the 20 units of many provinces (the cities under the direct control of the government) as well. Rodong Sinmun

title: Spring Land Realignment Begins
body: The North Hwanghae Provincial Brigade of the Land Realignment Shock Force buckled down to realigning marshy fields in Phungdap-ri, Yonthan County as a part of its related spring projects for this year. The brigade aimed at realigning over 1,000 hectares of land this spring. It decided to standardize more than 100 hectares of marshy land first thing. The battalions of the brigade made full preparations for their land realignment project and launched out into it. Rodong Sinmun

title: Socialist Cooperative Farms Vigorously Supported
body: South Hwanghae Province energetically supports its socialist cooperative farms. From the very beginning of this year it has recently exerted itself to help them in their farm work. It arranged for tens of thousands of tons of urban manure to be transported to their fields. Several days ago factories and enterprises under the control of the province transported plenty of urban manure to the fields of its cooperative farms with 100-odd autotrucks. The city and counties of the province accelerate the production and transport of their manure in full swing. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Has Photo Session with Participants in First Short Course for Chief Secretaries of City and County Party Committees
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, had a photo session with chief secretaries of the provincial, city and county Party committees, who participated in the first short course for chief secretaries of the city and county Party committees, at the office building of the Party Central Committee on March 6. The chief secretaries of the city and county Party committees were greatly excited for the great favors bestowed upon them by the respected General Secretary who specially organized the short course for the first time in the history of our Party at the supreme General Staff of the Korean revolution, gave important instructions while guiding the course for four consecutive days and had an honorable photo session with them. After declaring the short course closed, Kim Jong Un appeared in the photographing venue, talking with chief secretaries of the provincial, city and county Party committees. Expressing the expectation and belief that the chief secretaries of the provincial, city and county Party committees across the country who should leave for their dispatched places with fresh determination and readiness would prove their sacred pledge made before the Party Central Committee and the people true with practical successes by dynamically conducting the revolutionary work as they studied and armed themselves in the short course, he had a significant photo session with them. At the end of the photo session, the chief secretaries of the provincial, city and county Party committees raised enthusiastic cheers of "Hurrah!" in excitement in reflection of warm gratitude and loyalty to the General Secretary who repeatedly bestowed upon them great privilege and great political trust that they should become true Party officials, genuine revolutionaries holding the people with sincerity and sharing joys and sorrow with them. Kim Jong Un warmly encouraged them, waving back to the chief secretaries who were full of high confidence and fighting spirit. The chief secretaries of the provincial, city and county Party committees made a firm pledge to present the report of loyalty to the Party Central Committee by strongly consolidating the city and county Party organizations into powerful political general staffs and surely achieving clear and actual successes desired by the people, as field political officials who received instructions directly from the respected General Secretary. Political News Team

title: Let's Powerfully Propel Construction of Our Own-style Socialism by Enhancing Roles of City and County Party Organizations
body: First Short Course for Chief Secretaries of City and County Party Committees Closes with Fourth-day sitting General Secretary of WPK Kim Jong Un Makes Closing Address The first short course for chief secretaries of the city and county Party committees, which made a new milestone for the strengthening of the city and county Party committees, renovation of the Party work and regional development in the history of our glorious Party, was closed with the fourth-day sitting on March 6. The fourth-day sitting took place amid the strong revolutionary enthusiasm of the chief secretaries of the city and county Party committees who are determined to make devoted efforts for the development of their cities and counties and improvement of the people's standard of living, bearing deep in mind the high intention of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un who provided them with a precious opportunity for re-equipment and brush-up to become true Party officials honorable before the revolution and faithful to the trust of the people while carefully leading them. Jo Yong Won, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and secretary in charge of organizational affairs of the Party Central Committee, had a lecture under the title of more thoroughly establishing the unified leadership system of the Party Central Committee. He underscored the importance and significance of more thoroughly establishing the unified leadership system of the Party Central Committee in our Party building, its activities and the strengthening of its leadership and fighting efficiency, and gave a detailed explanation of the principles and tasks to be surely maintained by the city and county Party organizations to faithfully uphold the guidance of the Party Central Committee. He called on the Party organizations to thoroughly establish the revolutionary disciplines and order of acting as one under the instructions of the Party Central Committee and unconditionally implementing the Party's decisions to the end and thus firmly consolidate all the cities and counties into iron fortresses, inviolable cornerstones reliably defending the Party and the state. It was stressed in the lecture that the chief secretaries of the city and county Party committees should remain boundlessly loyal to the sacred duty entrusted to them by the era and the revolution, keeping in their minds the iron truth that the victory of our revolution, prosperity of the country and happy future of the people rests with defending and upholding the Party Central Committee led by the General Secretary. Adopted in the short course was a letter of pledge representing the firm resolution of the chief secretaries of the city and county Party committees to successfully turn their regions into fortresses of single-hearted unity and socialist paradises true to the Party's grand line on developing cities and counties. While guiding the short course, Kim Jong Un gave valuable instructions which would serve as guidelines in the work of the chief secretaries. Saying that city and county Party committees are major combat units that organize and carry out the implementation of the Party's line and policies, he noted that the flag of victory can be fluttered on the overall fronts of socialist construction when the city and county Party committees vigorously mobilize the popular masses for the revolutionary work by properly applying the leading idea and art of the Party Central Committee. He called upon the chief secretaries of the city and county Party committees to make the masses definitely turn the struggle for regional development into the work of their own by proficiently conducting the work with officials, Party members and other masses with higher sense of responsibility. Saying that the chief secretaries should equip not only themselves but also the officials of the city and county Party committees with our Party's idea of and line on attaching importance to cities and counties and unite them as one and achieve practical successes by brainstorming, he inspired them with confidence that there can be no fortress unconquerable when everything is organized in keeping with specific conditions as required by the Party's policies and carried out by relying on the broad masses of people. He noted that all the cities and counties will be turned into places good to live in when the chief secretaries set clear development-oriented goals and make uninterrupted innovations and struggle for their implementation, and introduced in detail the important works planned by the Party Central Committee for bringing balanced and rapid upheavals to local areas. Saying that the chief secretaries should determinedly fight a way out and energetically steer the development of their cities and counties by actively applying good experience introduced in the short course to their work, he gave earnest instructions that they should always attach importance to the mindset of people and let their work be appreciated by the people. He said that many problems raised in the work of the city and county Party committees are attributable even to the chief secretaries of the provincial Party committees, stressing that the chief secretaries of the provincial Party committees should discharge their duties in improving the work of the city and county Party committees in their provinces and guiding and assisting the chief secretaries of the city and county Party committees. Kim Jong Un made a closing address to the first short course for chief secretaries of the city and county Party committees. Noting that our Party Central Committee attached great importance to the short course with big expectation for the role of the chief secretaries of the city and county Party committees in decisively shifting the socialist construction onto the next stage, he said that through the short course, practical experience for equipping, awakening and inspiring them once again and improving and intensifying the work of the city and county Party committees was accumulated. He highly appreciated that the chief secretaries of the city and county Party committees across the country participated in a meeting and short course with elated political enthusiasm, cogitation and positive attitude, unanimously bearing deep in their minds the intention of the Party Central Committee. Saying the chief secretaries should always be aware that officials, Party members and other working people in their cities and counties will keep an eye of greater expectation on them who come back after participating in the first short course, the first of its kind in the history of our Party, he stressed that the solemn pledge taken by the chief secretaries is an oath they swore before the people of their counties and a supreme task to be carried out in any case without fail. He said that all the chief secretaries should display great courage, strenuous spirit, inexhaustible enthusiasm and devotion hundreds times stronger than ever before to determinedly strive hard with high ideal and great desire for turning their regions into the fortresses of single-hearted unity firmly linked with the Party Central Committee in idea and intention and into bases of happiness where the people enjoy actual wellbeing and civilization. He called upon the chief secretaries to fulfill their responsibility and role in renovating the Party work and developing their cities and counties in strict accordance with the strategic and tactical policies and tasks which were set forth at the historic Party congress and the plenary meeting of the Party Central Committee and detailed in the short course. He asked all the chief secretaries to conduct a powerful organizational and political work for implementing the Party's policies with a fresh view and attitude that they are newly appointed and start their work from now, play the role of steering the development of cities and counties well and thus bring about clear changes and successes to be welcomed and realized by the people. Saying that the chief secretaries should possess of the spirit of unconditionally serving the people and the organizing ability and drive, practical capability and noble moral traits appropriate for officials who are in charge of regional bases of socialist construction, he warmly called upon them to make every possible effort to record in history the decisions made at the 8th Party Congress as the ones successfully implemented. Enthusiastically appealing to them to become real servants accepted by the people on the road of serving our great people, he declared the first short course for chief secretaries of the city and county Party committees closed. When he finished the closing address, all the participants raised stormy cheers of "Hurrah!" with boundless respect for the General Secretary who indicated clear orientation and ways for epoch-making development of all cities and counties across the country with his rare wisdom and outstanding ideological and theoretical activities and instilled them with great confidence and courage. All the chief secretaries made a firm resolution to resolutely defend the dignity of the Party Central Committee and certainly repay the great trust of the people by thoroughly applying in their work the leadership traits of the General Secretary, who is spending the days of noble devotion to the prosperity of the country and happy life of our people, and thus registering practical success. The first short course for chief secretaries of the city and county Party committees to be specially recorded in the militant course of our Party towards fresh victory of the revolution will serve as an opportunity of great change to cement the foundation for the development of cities and counties, regional bases of socialist construction, and dynamically propel the strengthening of our Party and overall development of the country. Political News Team

title: March 8 International Women's Day Celebrated in DPRK
body: The 111th March 8 International Women's Day was splendidly celebrated in the DPRK. Many citizens visited the plaza of the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the sacred temple of Juche where President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il lie in state, and recollected with deep emotion the exploits the great leaders performed by enforcing the politics of prioritizing and respecting the women. People visited the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill and in other parts of the country and the mosaics depicting their smiling images to place floral baskets, bouquets and flowers and make a deep bow before them. Art performances were given at theatres and on outdoor stages in Pyongyang and local areas. A concert of the National Symphony Orchestra took place at the Moranbong Theatre and a music and dance performance of the Mansudae Art Troupe at the East Pyongyang Grand Theatre to mark the March 8 International Women's Day. Members of the art squad of the Central Committee of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea gave an art performance "Song of Blessed Women" at the Hall of Women. There were a performance of famous songs and scenes of revolutionary operas at the Pyongyang Grand Theatre, a one-act play at the National Theatre and a music and dance performance by the National Folk Art Troupe at the Ponghwa Art Theatre. The National Acrobatic Troupe gave a performance at the Pyongyang Circus Theater. The central art squad for agitation for increased production, the art squad of the Central Committee of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League and others gave outdoor performances in various parts of Pyongyang, livening up the festive atmosphere. Artistes across the country gave colorful performances. Officials of provinces, cities, counties, organs, factories, enterprises and cooperative farms warmly congratulated the exemplary female workers including innovators, scientists and teachers on the March 8 International Women's Day. Public catering establishments across the country pleased women with kind holiday service. Husbands and children presented greeting cards and flowers to their wives and mothers who have devoted themselves to society, collective and families. Rodong Sinmun

title: Workers in Metal Industry Vigorously Advance Forward
body: The workers and management of ironworks and steelworks countrywide work hard as ever to increase the output of their iron and steel with a full resolve to top their plan for this year by all means. The officials of the Ministry of Metal Industry plan and direct their economic work in detail focusing on ensuring that its major ironworks and steelworks attach importance to their production and repairs to their equipment and coordinate them with each other in a rational way so as to boost the production of their iron and steel incessantly. The labor and management of the Kim Chaek and Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complexes strive in high spirits to hit their iron and steel production targets without fail in March, too. The officials, workers and technicians of the Chollima Steel Complex try their hardest to carry out their plan. The labor and management of the Posan Ironworks register high results in their production day by day repairing and maintaining their machines well on schedule and taking care of them according to the demand of technological regulations and standard operation. Rodong Sinmun

title: The Flames of Collective Innovations Kindled
body: The workers and management of the Musan Mining Complex vigorously step up the production of their concentrated iron ores. Those of its open branch mine apply rational extractive methods to their work and responsibly repair and maintain their machines, thereby augmenting the output of their iron ores. A conveyor station for the removal of overburden and a station for ore conveyance which belong to the MMC bring about collective innovations in their work assignments strictly meeting the demand of technological regulations and standard operation and procuring repair parts on their own. The labor and management of the Hungnam Electrode Factory, too, make primary efforts to solidify the foundations for their production and heighten the quality of their electrodes while actively stirring themselves up for a technological innovation drive to introduce rational methods into their production. In addition, they thoroughly meet the demand of technological regulations and standard operation, check up their machines during their recesses and repair them beforehand effectively so as to put them in regular operation. Rodong Sinmun

title: Working Hard as One with an Uncommon Determination
body: The workers and management of the Pukchang Area Youth Coal Mining Complex vigorously speed up their production to thoroughly carry out the highly important tasks set forth at the 2nd plenary meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea. The Namdok Youth Coal Mine repairs and maintains the machines of its coalfaces with good care and puts them in good operation, thus overfulfilling the plan for its production. Those of the Inpho Youth Coal Mine built belt conveyors so far as their pits and thus increased their coal-conveying capacity considerably last year. They are now making great efforts to secure new coalfields. Those of the Hoean Youth Coal Mine laid a cableway for their trams to transport as much coal as possible from their pits and actively applied rational methods to their work. Consequently, their coal output is on the increase. The workers of the Songnam and Phunggok Youth Coal Mines fully display a spirit of collectivism the way shifts help each other in their pit faces. Rodong Sinmun

title: Waterway Tunneling Progresses at Final Stage
body: Kangwon Province dynamically steps up the construction of many army-people power stations. Its waterways have now almost been tunneled through mountains. Besides, they are widened and concreted on their flanks, ceilings and floors at full steam. The second brigade for tunneling a waterway of the Kosong Army-People Power Station has finished its work assignments before any others else. Suit is followed by other brigades. The brigade for building a waterway of the Sepho Army-People Power Station tunnels a waterway through a mountain a lot by rational working method. it also proceeds to expand the waterway in height and width and concrete its ceiling, floor and flanks. A waterway is tunneled through a mountain with all speed for the Kosong Army-People Power Station under construction. The brigade for building a waterway of the Hoeyang Army-People Power Station and other units introduce rational methods into their work on the one hand and provide its members with good living conditions on the other to inspire them to further efforts. Rodong Sinmun

title: Great Endeavors Made to Widen Their Cropland
body: Officials and working people across the country do all they can to increase their farmland in area. North Phyongan Province built a new reservoir. On the basis of this success it energetically pushes forward the construction of a waterway. South Phyongan Province has adopted technical measures to supply water to hundreds of hectares of its arable land short of it to enable good crops to grow there from this year onward. It is now carrying them into execution in a big way. South Hwanghae and South Hamgyong Provinces concentrate their efforts on recovering last year’s flood damages of fields in their numerous areas and restoring them to their original state. The officials and working people of Nampho and Kaesong Cities and other areas do their best to acquire even an inch of new land. Rodong Sinmun

title: Firm Determination Leads to Success
body: Hongwon County digs out the bed of its river, builds banks on its flanks and faces them with large stones. Consequently, it has improved the river for more than 10 kilometers this year. Furthermore, it acquired arable land anew a great deal in the process of this and laid another foundation for an increase in the output of its cereals. Rodong Sinmun

title: Premier Kim Tok Hun Inspects Kimhwa County
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the DPRK, inspected Kimhwa County of Kangwon Province to learn about the preparations for building local industrial establishments. Looking round the sites of the factories, he underscored the need for officials of Pyongyang and the province and county to make full preparations for building industrial establishments, true to the noble intention of the Party Central Committee to implement the line of strengthening cities and counties set forth at the Eighth Congress of the WPK and to create new standards in the building of local industrial establishments. He also took measures to make sure that the principle of the building of infrastructure first is thoroughly observed in the construction of public buildings, and to push ahead with river improvement. The field consultative meetings discussed the issue of stepping up technical preparations for each construction project on the principle of preserving the features peculiar to the county, the issue of completing the designs at the earliest date possible, the issue of preparing the skilled workers for ensuring quality in finishing projects, the issue of actively tapping raw materials to ensure full-capacity operation of factories. Meanwhile, the premier inspected the newly-built Wonsan general fishing tackle factory and the Phyonggang army-people power station under construction, where he called for consolidating material and technical foundations of the fishing sector and speeding up the building of the power station. Rodong Sinmun

title: Choe Ryong Hae Inspects Kwangchon Chicken Farm under Construction
body: Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, inspected the Kwangchon Chicken Farm under construction. Looking around the construction site, he stressed the need for officials and builders to do their best to ensure quality of structures, true to the high intention of the Party Central Committee to build the farm as a model and icon in the field of poultry of the country. He called for intensifying the guidance and control over all production processes including feed supply and chicken excrement disposal and paying due attention to afforestation and greening around the farm. The field consultative meeting discussed the ways to push ahead with the construction at the high quality level as planned and ensure timely supply of necessary equipment. Rodong Sinmun

title: Resolved to Produce More Cement
body: The workers and management of the Sunchon Cement Complex boost the production of their cement without cease the way they fulfilled their national economic plan for February by dint of hard work. The workers of its baking shop and cement shop overfulfill their production plans, preferentially maintaining their machines and applying rational methods to their work. The refractory branch factory of the SCC has acceleratedly refashioned its machines on technological lines through a fierce mass technological innovation drive and laid the foundations for the vitalization of its production. Its processing shop and steel-casting shop produce as many accessories of machines as necessary in time. The Sunchon Limestone Mine overfulfills the plan for the production of its limestone every day by operating its machines at full capacity. Meanwhile, it makes active arrangements for blasting a mountain on a large scale to get limestone and back up the production of the SCC’s cement reliably. Rodong Sinmun

title: Plans for Repairing Locomotives and Passenger Cars Fulfilled Everyday
body: The labor and management of the Kim Jong Thae Electric Locomotive Complex register high results in the maintenance of their locomotives and passenger cars day by day. They overfulfilled the plan for maintaining their locomotives and passenger cars in February. They proceed to top their daily maintenance plan by over 100% in March, too. They try hard as ever to fill up the shortage of their materials with their strength and technology and make technological preparations for the production of various kinds of insulants. Besides, they do other multifarious work according to their plan. They are now continuing to effect innovations in the maintenance of their locomotives and passenger cars surmounting their overlapping difficulties on their own. Rodong Sinmun

title: Ryanggang Province Works Hard to Increase Its Cement Production Capacity
body: Ryanggang Province tries its hardest to increase the capacity for the production of its cement. A mountain stands cheek by jowl with the Hyesan Cement Factory. It is rich in limestone. Several days ago it was blown up to get 100,000 tons of limestone for the HCF. Efforts are also made to augment the calorific power of both the inferior coal and soft coal which are produced at the Hyesan and Paegam Coal Mines and the Unhung area. The factories and enterprises of the province help each other and cooperate with each other in working with might and main to turn out various kinds of the machines and spare parts needed to increase the producing capacity for cement. Rodong Sinmun

title: Giving Priority to Consolidating Material and Technological Foundation
body: In South Hwanghae Province the irrigation offices of its city and counties strive actively to strengthen their material and technological foundations. The workers and management of the Anak County, Yonan County and Sinchon County Irrigation Management Stations briskly carry on a mass technological innovation drive. Better still, they focus their efforts on newly making the devices badly needed to irrigate the fields of their counties or remodeling their existing production processes. Those of the Jaeryong County, Paechon County and Pyoksong County Irrigation Management Stations and other county irrigation offices apply themselves to consolidating their material and technological foundations with great zeal and a high sense of responsibility. Rodong Sinmun

title: By Buckling Down with Fresh Determination
body: The cooperative farms of Songrim City do their utmost to enrich their low-yielding fields, carpet their other fields with humus soil, transport various kinds of organic manure there and ameliorate their cold waterlogged land intensively. The Chongun Cooperative Farm dug out the bed of its fish farm and carries the mud to its fields by vehicle. The Inpho Cooperative Farm and many other units improved their cold waterlogged land briskly. Rodong Sinmun

title: Its Scientific and Intensive Level Raised to Increase Its Output
body: The Jungphyong Vegetable Greenhouse Farm contributes to bettering the dietary standard of the people by increasing the output of its vegetables. This year it grew its vegetables on a high scientific and intensive level and produced hundreds of tons more of them than last year. Rational methods are actively applied to its cultivation by each of the greenhouses of the JVGF on the basis of the experiences it gained last year. The labor and management of the JVGF are now incessantly making innovations and headway in their work to contribute their separate share to registering actual changes and successes in improving the living standard of the people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Blasting of 260 000 Cubic Metre Earth Successful at Sunchon Limestone Mine
body: The Sunchon Limestone Mine in the DPRK successfully carried out the blasting of 260 000 cubic meters of earth on March 10. Its workers have turned out in a drive to implement the decisions of the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. The successful blasting makes it possible to fully supply the principal raw materials to the Sunchon Cement Complex. Workers of the mine are concentrating their efforts on conveying ores with the elated spirit. Rodong Sinmun

title: Production of Custom-built Equipment Hastened
body: The workers of the Ryongsong Machine Complex vigorously produce sets of plants for many domains of the national economy. The workers and management of the Songun Cast Iron Factory carefully stagger their production, maintain their machines and make good preparations for their production, thus casting volumes of quality iron. They pool their creative wisdom with each other and work with patriotism by the sweat of their brows to produce the cast iron needed to be machined for compressors in particular. The workers of its Songun Compressor Workshop overfulfill their production plan day by day overtaking and outstripping each other, learning from each other and exchanging experiences with each other. Its 1st and 2nd Machine Workshops fully display the spirit of collectivism the way one of their shifts helps the other and one of their workteams does the like. The workers of its auxiliary unit actively tap out and mobilize their internal reserves and energetically bring about technological innovations in their assignments. They boost the production of spare parts so that various kinds of their jigs and machines can be put in full operation to turn out sets of plants. Rodong Sinmun

title: Materials Responsibly Transported to the Key Industrial Sectors
body: The workers and management of the railway sector continue to concentrate their efforts on transporting materials to metal and chemical plants, coal mines and thermal power stations. The officials of the Ministry of Railways adopt detailed measures to arrange for its locomotives and freight cars to be used preferentially for transporting important materials. They also ensure that the Rahung Railway Factory and other factories and enterprises produce plenty of the accessories needed to repair locomotives and freight cars. Besides, they make it a rule to analyze and review the daily transport of materials in detail and generalize the good experiences in it. The labor and management of all the railway bureaus work hard with invincible fortitude to transport materials as much as possible. Rodong Sinmun

title: 7th Congress of Socialist Women's Union of Korea to Be Convened
body: The 7th Congress of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea will take place in Pyongyang in mid-June, Juche 110 (2021). The congress will comprehensively analyze and review the work of the union during the period under review, and discuss the tasks and ways for making tangible contribution to the all-round development of Korean-style socialism by further strengthening the women's union into the powerful political organization, true to the important tasks set forth at the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea. Rodong Sinmun

title: Endeavors Made to Remodel Its Production Process
body: The officials, workers and technicians of the Chongjin Chemical Fiber Factory focus their energies on readjusting and reinforcing the process for the production of their rayon pulp. The CCFF adopts detailed measures to find out all irrational defects in the process and remedy and improve it on the principle of profitability. Moreover, it strives mightily to increase the production capacity for its rayon pulp and its quality as well. Rodong Sinmun

title: Great Support to Farms in Pyongyang
body: Pyongyang has buckled down to supporting its cooperative farms extensively. A relevant municipal exhibition was held in Kangnam County on March 10th. Machines and materials were submitted to the exhibition by many districts, institutions, factories and enterprises of the capital city. They included the tractors, cultivators, bearings, various kinds of belts, knapsack sprayers and other farming materials secured by its Central, Moranbong and Pothonggang Districts. Taedonggang, Phyongchon, Tongdaewon, Sosong and Songyo Districts procured machines, spare parts, weld rods and lots of other materials on this occasion. Fully aware that supporting cooperative farms was important in agricultural production the officials of the Rungnado Trade Bureau, the city trade management bureau and garment industry bureau, the Pyongyang Thermal Power Station, the city rural economic committee, the central heat supply network station and other organs, factories and enterprises achieved good successes in helping the farms sincerely. Rodong Sinmun

title: Electricity Production Normalized on High Level
body: In the sector of the power industry workers and management top the daily power production plan of the Ministry of Power Industry in March. The workers of thermal power stations across the country produce electricity with success. The labor and management of the Pukchang Thermal Power Complex and the Pyongyang Thermal Power Station make great efforts to put their boilers and turbine electric generators in normal operation and increase their efficiency. The employees of the Sunchon, Chongchongang and East Pyongyang Thermal Power Stations normalize the production of their electricity taking good technological care of their machines. The workers of hydroelectric power stations countrywide boost the mass-production of their electricity. To this end they go round their machines and inspect them closely or check them up during their recesses while vigorously carrying on their mass technological innovation drive. Rodong Sinmun

title: Coal-mining Front Actively Supported
body: Many committees, ministries and national institutions make endeavors to support the sector of the coal industry, an advanced base of the independent economic development. They donated to coal mines across the country the accessories, materials and goods needed to consolidate the material and technological foundations for the coal industry and boost the production of coal, thus actively encouraging their employees to work hard. Consequently, the workers and management of the coal mines do all they can to turn out coal. Rodong Sinmun

title: Brisk Recycling in Kangwon Province
body: The light industry factories of Kangwon Province purposefully recycle waste paper, vinyl and cotton, plus other idle materials, as much as possible. Its cities and counties ensure that lots of idle materials are concentratedly purchased from their voluntary inhabitants every month. The province first calculates accurately how much raw materials its light industrial factories need for their production and then proceeds to adopt active measures to sort them out according to quality and transport them to the factories in time. In addition, it also makes sure that its light industry factories regard it as of vital importance in their development to recycle waste materials and make good the shortage of their raw and other materials by using industrial wastes and domestic garbage. Rodong Sinmun

title: Plastic Waste Used Effectively
body: The Haeju Roofing Tilery exerts itself to reclaim waste materials. It set itself the task of putting up a new workshop to reclaim plastic sacks and other plastic wastes and buckled down to carrying it out. Consequently, it built two tile kilns for the use of various kinds of plastic wastes in a short time. Rodong Sinmun

title: Ryanggang Province Seethes with Preparation for Potato Farming
body: The officials and agricultural workers of Ryanggang Province make vigorous preparations for their farm work. They focus their efforts on enriching their potato fields. The province also pays close attention to repairing and maintaining its farm machines and procuring medium- and small-sized farm implements. It renovates its potato seed storehouses and sheds for sprouting potato seeds. In addition, it fertilizes its low-yielding potato fields, selects the right high-yielding strains of potatoes for the right fields, produces vinyl foils with waste vinyl and makes good preparations for its other immediate farm work. Rodong Sinmun

title: Iron and Steel Production Goes Up
body: The metallurgical industrial sector of the DPRK is making success in the iron and steel production while directing its effort to the readjustment and reinforcement of production foundation. Iron works and steel plants across the country have pushed ahead with the work to build energy-saving oxygen heat blast furnaces and reinforce rolled steel production foundation. The Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex is readjusting and reinforcing production processes of the Juche-based iron-making system and strengthening the relations among production processes while working out a realistic plan for introducing dozens of technical innovation designs and taking measures for executing it. The oxygen separating branch factory has increased the oxygen production 1.3 times as against that in the previous period and the oxygen heat blast furnace shop has fulfilled daily, weekly and monthly pig iron production plan. The Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex is making innovations in the iron and steel production every day while stepping up a huge project for expanding its production capacity. It is increasing the molten iron production by positively introducing a reasonable operating method while taking measures to timely settle the matters arising in the readjustment and reinforcement of facilities including the oxygen heat blast furnace and oxygen separator. The steel shop is registering success by steadily searching and introducing methods for cutting the melting time of the UHP electric arc furnace and increasing the molten iron production per charge. The steel shop, rolling shop and gas producing shop of the Chollima Steel Complex are bringing about good production results every day and the Posan Iron Works in charge of the preceding process is pushing ahead with production in line with the schedule. Units in charge of the supply of raw materials to iron works and steel plants are guaranteeing the increased iron and steel production by making joint innovations. Rodong Sinmun

title: Proportion of Mechanization Increases in Agriculture
body: A work for increasing the proportion of mechanization in the farm work is being promoted in the field of agriculture of the DPRK. With the idea and spirit of the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea kept in their mind, officials and working people in the agricultural sector have repaired and kept in good condition tens of thousands of tractors and produced different kinds of farm machine accessories this year. The repair and maintenance of tractors are being promoted in the final stage. North Hwanghae Province fulfilled the plan for repairing and maintaining the tractors before others and South Hwanghae Province carried out the repair and maintenance over 20 days ahead of schedule. Kaesong City, too, finished the repair and maintenance of tractors in time and such work is going at the final stage in Pyongyang and Nampho cities and other areas. The production of farm machines and tractor accessories is being stepped up. The Haeju Farm Machine Factory has accelerated the production of farm machines like small rice harvester and mobile combined rice thresher and the Kangso Sprayer Factory is producing over twice as many knapsack-style sprayers as before. The Haeju Tractor Accessory Parts Factory has daily carried out its plan for production of main body of engine, crankshaft, various species of gears and others at over 130 percent. Other similar factories, too, are registering successes in the production by actively introducing the rational methods for reducing the processing time of farm machines and tractor accessories. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairpersons of Chongryon Headquarters Meet in Tokyo
body: There took place a meeting of chairpersons of the headquarters of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) at the Korean Hall in Tokyo on March 9 to decisively enhance the role of the prefectural headquarters as a regional guidance unit for the movement of Koreans in Japan in thoroughly implementing the decisions made at the fourth meeting of the 24th Central Committee of Chongryon. Present at the meeting were Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of Chongryon, Pak Ku Ho, its first vice-chairman and director of its Organization Department, vice-chairpersons, the chairperson of the Financial Committee, the chairperson of the Central Audit Committee, members of the Central Standing Committee of Chongryon and chairpersons of the headquarters of Chongryon. The meeting discussed the issues arising in thoroughly implementing the decisions made at the fourth meeting of the 24th Central Committee of Chongryon. In his report at the meeting, Pak Ku Ho stressed that the task to be unconditionally carried out by all the organizations and officials of Chongryon is to surely bring about a turn in strengthening the branches, holding fast to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's idea of attaching importance to the branches as the general orientation for building Chongryon organizations. He said that the chairpersons of the headquarters should decisively intensify before anything else the struggle for establishing the ideological and leadership system of Juche inside their organizations in keeping with today's high demand. He noted that they should also turn the building of Chongryon organizations into the direction of attaching importance to the branches by thoroughly implementing the important congratulatory message sent by Kim Jong Un to the participants in the Conference of Representatives of Branches of Chongryon last year. Then, speeches were made at the meeting. Chairman Ho Jong Man in his concluding speech expressed the belief that the chairpersons of the headquarters would surely bring about a turn in implementing the decisions of the fourth meeting of the 24th Central Committee of Chongryon, true to the main idea and spirit of the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea. The 10-point goal of the movement for setting an example of patriotism in the new heyday and the main principles for the campaign for "the year for strengthening branches of Chongryon" and the outline for the establishment of a work system for helping the branches of Chongryon were delivered at the meeting. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Ambassador Meets Interim President of Mali
body: The DPRK ambassador paid a courtesy call on the interim president of the Republic of Mali on March 11. DPRK Ambassador Ri Chong Gyong courteously conveyed the warm greeting sent by Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, to Interim President BAH N' DAW. The interim president expressed deep thanks for it and asked the ambassador to convey his heartfelt fraternal greeting to His Excellency Kim Jong Un. He said that the friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries are firm relations that were provided by first president of Mali Modibo Keita and the great President Kim Il Sung and have been developed on good terms up to now. He affirmed that the government and people of Mali would value the relations with the DPRK proud of sixty-odd-year-long history of friendship and cooperation and exert their efforts to invariably consolidate and develop them. Rodong Sinmun

title: It Will Be Hard to See Again Spring Days Three Years Ago
body: Kim Yo Jong, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), issued the following statement on Monday: I heard the news that the south Korean authorities, who had long been suffering from stress in a fix, launched a war game against our Republic on Mar. 8. In other words, they dared to send us a serious challenge. It seems as if they are capable of dealing with the consequences to be entailed by the war drill started despite our entirely just demand and all the fellow countrymen's unanimous protest and condemnation. Our Party Central Committee has already clarified the stand that whether the inter-Korean relations return to the new starting point of peace and prosperity as witnessed in those spring days three years ago or not depends on the attitude of the south Korean authorities. Everyone knows that it pointed to the hysteria for war drills manifested in the south every March and every August, and served as a meaningful warning that it might become the last chance for repairing the north-south relations. The south Korean authorities, accustomed to paying lip-service, are busy billing the drill as "annual" and "defensive one" and a computer-based simulation drill, as in the past. They say that the drill involves no actual maneuvers with its scale and contents drastically "reduced". Perhaps, they are expecting "flexible judgment" and "understanding" from us but it is, indeed, ridiculous, impudent and stupid. It seems that they were all born with stupidity and have become the dumb and deaf bereft of judgment as they always sit on the fence. Anyhow, we cannot but take note of this. We have opposed the joint military drills targeting the compatriots but never argued about their scale or form. It is because the essence and nature of the drills against the compatriots in the north never change despite any change in their forms - whether they are staged behind the scene or they poorly involve only 50 or 100 persons due to widespread malignant epidemic. They are not ashamed of remaining ignorant of the fact that we are not taken in by their nonsense coating mad dog with sheepskin. To be frank, we feel sorry about the plight of the south Korean authorities as they are to stake their lot on hostile acts against the compatriots even by resorting to shrunken war games, now that they find themselves in the quagmire of political, economic and epidemic crisis. Perhaps, their persecution mania resulting from abnormal hostility and distrust toward us has reached the extremes. They staged 110 big or small war drills in 2018, more than 190 in 2019 and over 170 in 2020 for so-and-so reasons in breach of their promise to halt such drills. We have long been aware of it and are ready to make them pay dearly for it at an appropriate time. They might know better than anyone else about what impact such continued north-targeted war drumbeats would have on the north-south relations. We have stressed it several times and offered ample opportunity to them, exercising patience. Nevertheless, they opted for "war in March" and "crisis in March" again under the eyes of all Koreans, instead of "warmth in March". They are about to bring a biting wind, not warm wind expected by all, in the spring days of March. The south Korean authorities should realize that they have chosen a wrong deed of crossing the "red line" by themselves though they also don't like to do so. Their idea of seeking confrontation with the compatriots in the north and hostile behavior toward the latter, which festered to be a chronic disease, have reached an incurable state. It is the conclusion drawn by us once again that we have nothing to talk with them. War drill and hostility can never go with dialogue and cooperation. Given the current situation that the south Korean authorities persist in hostile acts of denying dialogue and completely destroy the foundation of trust through ceaseless war games, we cannot but put on the agenda the issue of the Committee for the Peaceful Reunification of the Country, an organization for dialogue with the south which has no reason for its existence. We also examine the issue of dissolving the Kumgangsan International Tourism Bureau and other organizations concerned as any cooperation and exchange with the south Korean authorities antagonizing us are no longer necessary. Such crucial steps have already been reported to our supreme leadership. We will watch the future attitude and actions of the south Korean authorities. And if they dare resort to more provocative acts, we may take a special measure of resolutely abrogating even the north-south military agreement. Every action has its own result. One thing is clear. The south Korean authorities with just some months left in their term of office may find themselves in extreme uneasiness, for the grave challenging act. As clarified at our historic 8th Party Congress, they will receive as much as they have tried and paid. We take this opportunity to warn the new U.S. administration trying hard to give off powder smell in our land. If it wants to sleep in peace for coming four years, it had better refrain from causing a stink at its first step. Whatever and however the south Korean authorities may do in the future under their master's instructions, those warm spring days three years ago, which they desire so much, won't come easily again. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Premier Inspects Different Sectors in South Phyongan Province
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and premier of the Cabinet of the DPRK, inspected different sectors in South Phyongan Province. At the Sunchon Cement Complex, he encouraged officials and workers of the complex in their efforts for increased production to wage a brisk mass technological innovation movement for implementing the first year's tasks of the new five-year plan set forth at the 8th Congress of the WPK. Looking round different places of the complex including the calcinating shop and cement shop, he stressed the need to thoroughly take sci-tech measures for prioritizing the repair of equipment, dovetailing the processes and raising the productivity. At the organic compound fertilizer factory and the Yakjon Farm in Sukchon County, he urged agricultural officials to break with formalism and bragging and do their jobs with stress placed on increasing grain production on low-yielding fields and increasing the proportion of mechanization in farming. The field consultative meetings discussed the measures to lay a foundation for revitalizing cement production by mapping out urgent plans and long-term plans in detail and promoting the updating of equipment and technology. The meetings also called for stepping up the preparations for this year's farming and properly enforcing the field-responsibility-system within the framework of the sub-work team management system. Rodong Sinmun

title: Letter to Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un from General Association of Koreans in China
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a letter of pledge from the General Association of Koreans in China on March 3. The letter said that the General Association of Koreans in China marks its 30th founding anniversary in the stirring period when the vigorous stride for general advance towards a new victory of socialist construction is being made amid the deep emotion and great delight of all the people in the homeland that upheld Kim Jong Un as the leader of the Workers' Party of Korea again. The letter noted that the 30 year-long history of the General Association of Koreans in China is the one of noble love for compatriots of the great Generalissimos Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il and Kim Jong Un who let the Koreans in China have dignity and pride of being members of the Korean nation and took warm care of with paternal affection and the one of loyalty and patriotism of Koreans in China who have invariably followed the road of patriotism entrusting their destiny and future to the socialist homeland. The warm loving care shown by the peerlessly great men for the Koreans abroad generation after generation has been the rays of great sun always giving warmth whether they are near or far and whether they are in joy or in sorrow, the letter said, and went on: In the rays of the great sun, the Association has rallied closely the broad segments of Koreans in China around regional associations, branches, the Federation of Korean Economic Workers in China, the Federation of Young Korean Nationals in China under it for the past 30 years, and developed into the patriotic organization of the motherland of Juche all the members of which love the socialist homeland so much and make dedication to the reunification of the country. All the officials of the Association and all other Koreans in China are full of firm pledge to uphold the leadership of Kim Jong Un with loyalty as they have it as the iron principle of the life that upholding the peerlessly great men of Mt Paektu would guarantee the immense dignity and pride of Kim Il Sung's nation and their eternal happiness and future as overseas Koreans of socialist Korea. They pledged to wage strong patriotic movement to make tangible contribution to the prosperity of the motherland in keeping pace with the great stride being made by the people in homeland for the implementation of the first year's target of the new five-year plan under the clear blueprint indicated by Kim Jong Un at the historic 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea and the Second Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Party. The letter, in reflection of the unanimous wish of all the Koreans in China, wished Kim Jong Un, bright sun and kind-hearted father of the nation, well-being. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Greetings to Syrian President
body: Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a message of greeting to Bashar Al-Assad, president of the Syrian Arab Republic, on March 8. The message extended warm greetings to the Syrian president, government and people on behalf of the DPRK government and people upon the 58th anniversary of the March 8 Revolution in Syria. The message said that the March 8 revolution was a historic event through which the Syrian people brought about a great change in their struggle for achieving independent development, adding that the Korean people extend invariable support and solidarity to the Syrian people in their just cause for sovereignty of the country, territorial integrity, peace and development. The message expressed conviction that the friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries with long history and tradition would grow stronger on the road of defending independence, justice and peace. Rodong Sinmun

title: Increased Electricity Production Witnessed in DPRK
body: Power stations in the DPRK are boosting the output. Those under the Ministry of Electric Power Industry have fulfilled their daily plans in March as well as in January and February. They have kept every generator in full-capacity operation, taking timely measures to prevent a decrease in power production likely in the period of seasonal change. Officials and workers of the thermal power stations including the Pukchang Thermal Power Complex and the Pyongyang Thermal Power Plant have worked hard to keep boilers and turbo-generators in full-capacity operation, putting efforts into raising their efficiency. Their efforts led to earlier attainment of their January and February plans and increased output in March. The Hochongang Power Station, the Jangjingang Power Station and other hydro-power stations, too, have carried out their production plans without fail by taking due measures for overhauling equipment and ensuring maximum use of stored water. Similar successes are being witnessed in other power stations. Rodong Sinmun

title: Cultivation of New Land and Tideland Reclamation Brisk in DPRK
body: A brisk drive for cultivation of new land and tideland reclamation is going on in the DPRK in hearty response to the decisions of the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea. Officials across the country have meticulously directed the organizational and political work for attaining this year's goal of cultivation of new land, regarding it as a policy task to expand the area of cropland. Amid the vigorous campaign for cultivating more arable land, a prospect was opened in Pyongyang City to use tens of hectares of new land as arable land. South Phyongan Province and South Hamgyong Province are attaining actual results in the cultivation of new land. They launched a vigorous campaign for expanding the cropland area and reclaiming the forest soil with an incline of below 20 degrees, while restoring the flood-stricken lands. North Phyongan Province provided a guarantee for completing the Woldo tideland reclamation ahead of schedule by successfully conducting the blasting of 200 000 and 100 000 cubic meters of earth. It is now speeding up the Honggondo tideland reclamation while pushing ahead with the embankment project, as planned. Rodong Sinmun

title: Sowing of Wheat and Barley Seeds Brisk in Rural Areas of DPRK
body: Agricultural officials and workers in the DPRK have stepped up the preparations for farming in the first year for implementing the 5-year plan. Now sowing of wheat and barely seeds in spring is going in real earnest under the guidance of the Ministry of Agriculture. The ministry and the provincial rural economy committees have meticulously directed the campaign for finishing the sowing in time by increasing the fertility of soil and introducing various methods of seed processing. Agricultural workers in Pyongyang City rounded off the sowing. They overfulfilled their daily sowing plans by securing high-yielding seeds with a high growth rate and introducing good sci-tech methods into seed processing. Farms in some counties of South Phyongan Province completed the sowing in a brief span of time by carpeting fields with large quantities of quality manure and raising the operating rate of machines. Similar successes were witnessed in North Phyongan Province, North Hwanghae Province and Nampho City, too. Agricultural workers in North and South Hamgyong provinces have made progress in the sowing by applying the Juche farming methods. Rodong Sinmun

title: The Role of Its Ideological Workers’ Squads for Agitation for Increased Production Enhanced
body: Ryanggang Province pays close attention to the activities of the members of its ideological workers’ squads for agitation for increasd production and ensures that they go among the masses and talk and work with them so that their agitation for increased production can prove effective in actuality. They carry on energetic activities especially at the Hyesan Branch Steelworks and the Hyesan Cement Factory whose production capacity expansion is separately well under way. In Samjiyon City, Kapsan County and other counties, too, the members of ideological workers’ squads for agitation for increased production go among the masses and conduct dynamic agitprop activities to convince them to do all they can to carry out the ideas of the WPK and champion its policies. Rodong Sinmun

title: Convinced to Give Full Plat to Their Youthful Wisdom and Courage
body: The officials of the Central Committee of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League channel their great efforts on ideologically educating the members of its affiliated organizations across the country to spur them to execute the decisions of the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the WPK. The officials of the North Hamgyong Provincial and Nampho City Committees of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League positively conduct the ideological education of the members of their subordinated organizations in their major producers. The officials of the North and South Phyongan and Jagang Provincial Committees of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League energetically conduct political work among the members of their affiliated organizations in the factories, cooperative farms and construction sites of the separate provinces to encourage them to be in the van of production. In addition, they donate to them items for labor protection as well as foodstuffs and living necessities in plenty. Rodong Sinmun

title: Timber Production Goes Up in DPRK
body: The revolutionary enthusiasm of the workers in the forestry sector of the DPRK, who have turned out in implementing the tasks set forth at the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, is bringing forth high production. Some forestry stations and mine pillar production stations finished the timber production quotas for the year or for the first quarter of the year. The forestry and mine pillar production stations under Ryanggang, South Phyongan and Jagang provincial forestry management bureaus scrupulously mapped out their economic operations and direction to register good results in the winter timber production. The workers of the Paekja Forestry Station and other units successfully fulfilled this year's plans. And lots of mine pillar production stations have finished their plans for the first quarter of the year ahead of schedule. Officials and workers in the forestry sector continuously accelerate the timber production while directing efforts to strengthening their own material and technical foundations. Rodong Sinmun

title: Emergency Anti-epidemic Work Gets Brisk Together with Clean-up in DPRK
body: The anti-epidemic atmosphere is growing stronger in the DPRK. The central emergency anti-epidemic agency has tightened its control and guidance over the anti-epidemic work, as well as the work in the clean-up months in spring. Citizens are informed of the symptoms of COVID-19, its infection routes and common sense for its prevention through mass media, educational networks and broadcasting posts. Hygienic and anti-epidemic organs at all levels have taken timely measures to prevent the diseases likely to break out in spring. The city management organs have put their efforts into overhauling and disinfecting the water supply facilities and drinking water-producing facilities. Efforts for clearing the remnants of winter and unsanitary elements are going on at institutions and industrial establishments across the country. Gutter-cleaning, fence reinforcement and painting for bettering homes and villages in terms of hygiene and culture are getting brisk among people's neighborhood units. Rodong Sinmun

title: Efforts Focused on Strengthening Material and Technological Foundation of Salt Industry
body: Many saltworks of the Salt Production General Enterprise concentrate their efforts on maintaining and reinforcing their material and technological foundations. The labor and management of the Kwangryangman Saltworks vigorously push forward the immediate salt production and solidify the foundations for it without cease. Those of the Namyang and Kwisong Saltworks strive actively to increase their salt output with super-saline ground water. In addition, the officials, workers and technicians of the Kumsong and Namsi Saltworks and many other salterns take good care of their salt fields and devote all their wisdom and enthusiasm to producing their salt as much as possible. Rodong Sinmun

title: Hundreds of Preparatory Cutting Faces Secured
body: In the realm of the coal industry workers and management secured hundreds of extra coalfields by March 10th. They outnumber their counterparts of last year by several tens. The Sunchon and Pukchang Area Youth Coal Mining Complexes and the Tokchon, Tukjang and Kaechon Area Coal Mining Complexes go all out to push their tunneling ahead of others and procure their coalfields. The labor and management of other coal mining complexes, too, work hard by the sweat of their brows to secure many spare coalfields and mass-produce coal on a normal footing. Rodong Sinmun

title: Renovation of Production Processes Pushed Ahead with
body: The workers and management of the domain of the chemical industry actively push ahead with the projects for the reconstruction, modernization and expansion of their production processes. Those of the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex and the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex do their level best to finish the projects for the expansion of their production capacity as soon as possible and supply large quantities of fertilizer to cooperative farms throughout the country. Those of the February 8 Vinalon Complex also strive mightily to strengthen the foundations for their production. Those of the Chongjin Chemical Fiber Factory make courageous efforts to perfect the process of the production of their rayon pulp along technological lines. The Sinuiju Chemical Fiber Factory, the Myonggan Chemical Factory and many other units try hard to consolidate the foundations for their production fruitfully. Rodong Sinmun

title: Over 1 300 Young People Volunteered to Difficult and Labor Consuming Fields after Eighth Party Congress
body: More than 1,300 young people countrywide have actively petitioned for difficult jobs in the national economy, including the metal, coal and extractive industries and agriculture, since the 8th Congress of the Workers’ Party of Korea. Although he was on the North Phyongan Provincial Committee of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League after his military service and university graduation Kim Yong Min petitioned for employment at a youth subworkteam of the Taean Cooperative Farm in Taegwan County where he was born. Pak Song Rim gave up being on the Onsong County Committee of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League and petitioned for work at a branch of the most backward cooperative farm of the county. In response to the appeal of the Party 140-odd young people of Nampho City enrolled themselves at its cooperative farms of their own accord. Young others across the country, too, actively found employment at mines, coal mines and cooperative farms. In South Hwanghae Province over 260 young people petitioned for employment at its cooperative farms or joined its provincial youth shock force voluntarily. The youth of North Hamgyong and North Phyongan Provinces, too, enlisted at their major factories, enterprises, mines, coal mines and cooperative farms of their own free will. The 80-odd young people of Jagang Province entered its provincial youth shock force and are now working with all their might. Rodong Sinmun

title: Full Play Given to the Might of Mass Campaigns
body: The affiliates of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea and the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea dynamically organize and conduct a mass drive to spur all their members to carry out their tasks for the first year of another five-year plan. The Central Committee of the GFTUK proclaimed the 2021 socialist emulation for the five-year plan and then proceeded to ensure that not only the city and county committees of the GFTUK but also its subordinated organizations at the factories and enterprises of the whole country organized socialist emulations. Above all, it separately organized socialist emulations among major industrial sectors, fishery stations and fish farms and among the high-speed heading squads of coal mines. In addition, it makes great endeavors to see to it that science and technology learning spaces carry on a brisk campaign to be qualified as models and that the models grow in number. The Central Committee of the UAWK, too, energetically conducts many mass campaigns to encourage agricultural working people to do all they can to hit the cereal production target set them by the Party. Rodong Sinmun

title: Believing that Nothing Is a Waste
body: The managerial staff, workers and technicians of the Manpho August 2 Cement Factory exert themselves to recycle their industrial wastes. They have already made substitute gypsum and used it for their production. Accordingly, they incessantly reclaim wastes by dint of perseverance. They have already set up a process for the recycling of coal cinders and used the products for turning out their cement. On this occasion they have made a breakthrough in being able to reclaim coal gangues. They are now going all out to perfect their processes for the reclamation of wastes further. Rodong Sinmun

title: An Extensive Plan Executed Superbly
