body: The officials of Pyongyang pay deep attention to solidifying the material and technological foundations of the Pyongyang Farm Machine Accessories Plant and make sure that it boosts the production of the accessories of its farm machines. They got ample firsthand knowledge of all the problems of the modernization of the factory’s machines and mapped out a clear-cut step-by-step plan for the modernization projects. They are now carrying them out creditably in close liaison with the units concerned. Rodong Sinmun

title: A Work Place Full of Joy
body: The Mangyongdae District Wholesale Agency for Vegetables and Fruits raises lots of pigeons. It started to do so more than ten years ago. That time the pigeons did not eat feed well. Worse still, some of them did not return home after leaving it. Although they had their hands full with work the labor and management of the agency found time to read books on pigeons and visited keepers of many of them at home to learn relevant experiences. As a result, the pigeons of the agency multiplied rapidly into the scores in a few years. Thanks to them, the employees of the agency have been attached to their work place, having a happy time in their lives. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Birthday Spread to Anti-Japanese Revolutionary Fighter
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un sent a birthday spread to Ri Yong Suk, an anti-Japanese revolutionary fighter, on her 105th birthday. Ri Yong Suk has dedicated herself to the liberation of the country and the accomplishment of the revolutionary cause of Juche since she embarked upon the road of the revolution under the guidance of President Kim Il Sung. Under the loving care of the President she grew into a woman revolutionary, politically and militarily prepared, during the anti-Japanese war. She displayed matchless bravery in the final offensive operation for liberating the country and devoted herself to the struggle for the building of a new country and the socialist construction, true to the idea and leadership of the Party. President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il saw to it that she, who remained loyal to the Party, worked as a Party and administrative official. Thanks to the great leaders, she was honored with Order of Kim Il Sung, the title of labor hero and other Party and state commendations. Kim Jong Un made sure that she was awarded Order of Kim Jong Il and she took part in various meetings including the 7th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea as a delegate. Greatly excited to receive the birthday spread, the anti-Japanese revolutionary fighter and her family members vowed to cherish the great benevolence shown by Kim Jong Un and dedicate themselves to implementing the decisions of the 8th Congress of the Party, single-mindedly upholding its leadership. Rodong Sinmun

title: Holding Themselves Responsible for the Agriculture of the Country
body: The workers and management of the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex fulfill the plan for the production of their fertilizer day by day. They are assigned to carry out the immediate plan for the production of their fertilizer, increase their production capacity and rebuild the process for the production of their sodium carbonate. The executive board of the NYCC directs the production of its fertilizer and arranges for its daily plan for it to be fulfilled without fail. It also makes great efforts to draw ties between its workshops and processes close. Moreover, it pays deep attention to ensuring that its operators responsibly check and repair their machines for themselves and put various kinds of their machines in normal operation to ensure its current production smoothly. The NYCC strives dynamically to produce and use homemade catalyzers. Rodong Sinmun

title: Fulfillers of Their Plans for First Quarter and First Half of the Year Produced
body: The five locomotive engineers of the Pyongyang Railway Bureau fulfilled their plans for the first half of 2021 as of March 10th, and its 140-odd ones their plans for the first quarter of 2021. The locomotive engineers of the West Pyongyang and Sariwon Service Brigades of Engines ask their dispatchers from time to time if there is any freight for their trains. They actively apply rational methods to their operation, thereby transporting important freight every day in large quantities. The locomotive engineers of the Sinsongchon, Pukchang and Pyongyang Service Brigades of Engines, too, register one success after another in their transport carrying on a dynamic socialist emulation to establish rigid discipline and order, take good care of their trains and improve their driving technique. Rodong Sinmun

title: Socialist Cooperative Farms Supported Ceaselessly
body: South Hwanghae Province continues to support its socialist cooperative farms vigorously. A few days ago the labor and management of its institutions, factories and enterprises at provincial level transported more than 1,000 tons of urban manure again to many cooperative farms by autotruck. Its city and counties carry plenty of urban manure to cooperative farms by vehicle in a great endeavor to support them. Rodong Sinmun

title: All Out to Produce Ferroalloys
body: The workers and management of the Puryong Ferroalloy Factory have made it quite possible to produce quality ferromanganese with low-quality manganese ores richly available in our country. Consequently, they have provided a guarantee for turning out many kinds of ferroalloys through dozens of experiments. The PFF is now making earnest preparations for the mass-production of its ferroalloys on the basis of its already-won scientific and technological successes. Rodong Sinmun

title: In Order to Bring about Practical Change and Innovation
body: North Phyongan Province scores a number of successes in introducing the right high-yielding varieties for the right soil into its farming, treating seeds scientifically and growing healthy rice seedlings. The officials and researchers of the provincial agricultural science institute do all they can to breed paddy rice plants of salt-resistant varieties to raise and harvest them abundantly in tidal flats. The provincial rural economic committee makes sure that the production of the nutritional complex badly needed to grow rice seedlings in beds is stepped up briskly. The province pays profound attention to supplying the cooperative farms of the province with abundance of high-yielding seeds. Rodong Sinmun

title: Meticulous Preparations Made for Seeding Their Plots with Rice
body: The North Hwanghae Provincial Rural Economy Committee makes meticulous arrangements for seeding with the approach of the sowing season. The Migok Cooperative Farm in Sariwon City secured ample quality manure and carried it to its fields by vehicle from the beginning of this year on end. It is now treating its seeds well and making good preparations for its seedbeds. The Taechong Cooperative Farm in Unpha County prepares for its seeding in real earnest. In Sariwon City and Hwangju, Unpha and Pongsan Counties cooperative farms finished sowing their fields with barley by and large. They are now concentrating all their efforts on preparing for their immediate farm work at full steam. Rodong Sinmun

title: Haeju Taegyong Processing Station Inaugurated in DPRK
body: The Haeju Taegyong Processing Station has been newly remodeled and inaugurated in the DPRK. Thanks to the efforts of the officials and builders involved in the remodeling project, new laver-processing equipment was installed at the station. Production and welfare facilities including the factory for processing a variety of marine products were also built. The station, put on a perfect germ-free and dust-free basis, is operated by an integrated production control system. Officials concerned looked round the station on Thursday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Units Associated with Leadership Exploits Take Lead of General Offensive
body: The following units of the major sectors of the national economy, which were visited by President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il or Comrade Kim Jong Un for firsthand guidance, lead in a general offensive to thoroughly carry out the tasks for the first year of another five-year plan. The workers and management of the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex work with all their might day and night to put their air separator and other machines in normal operation and increase the output of their iron and steel as much as possible. The workers of the Chollima Steel Complex register high results in the manufacture of their steel day after day. The Namhung Youth Chemical Complex, the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex, the February 8 Vinalon Complex and other chemical factories lead others in bolstering the chemical industry. The stations and complex of the domain of the power industry and factories and complexes of that of the machine industry are all out for their production. Many of the labor and management of the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Silk Mill, the Huichon Silk Mill and many other filatures top the national economic plans for the first quarter of 2021 and the first half of 2021 one after another. Rodong Sinmun

title: Fields Carpeted with Humus Soil Ahead of Schedule
body: As last year this year, too, the Jungphyong Vegetable Greenhouse Farm planned to spread humus soil over a large area of the surrounding land and concentrated all its labor force, vehicles and others on doing that. It successfully carried out the project in a short time ahead of schedule. The result is that it has been enriched to be able to boost the yields of vegetable and cereal crops. In addition, it has made great strides also in forming a windbreak forest around it. Rodong Sinmun

title: Meritorious Researcher and Announcer Receive Birthday Spreads
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un sent birthday spreads to Ri Sin Ung, a researcher of Kim Chaek University of Technology, and Choe Song Won, chief announcer of the Radio and TV Broadcasting Committee of the DPRK, on their 80th birthdays. Ri Sin Ung, who has contributed to education of the rising generation and sci-tech development at the university for 50 odd years, pleased President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il several times by successfully carrying out many priority research tasks. He pioneered several subjects and authored many textbooks and reference books. He has trained scientists and educators including 10 odd doctors. The Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) honored him with Kim Il Sung Prize, the title of People's Scientist, academicianship, professorship and doctorate. It also made sure that he took part in the celebrations for its 75th founding anniversary as a delegate. Choe Song Won has worked as an announcer for nearly 60 years at the Radio and TV Broadcasting Committee of the DPRK. She has led a worthwhile and glorious life, giving full play to her gifted narrative skill, under the deep political trust and benevolence of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il. Under the warm care of Kim Jong Il, she became a winner of Kim Il Sung Prize, the title of labor hero and the title of People's Announcer, and a deputy to the Supreme People's Assembly. Kim Jong Un saw to it that she was awarded Order of Kim Jong Il and she took part in the 7th Congress of the WPK as a delegate and the celebrations of the 8th Congress of the WPK as a special guest. Rodong Sinmun

title: 63rd Graduation Ceremony of Korean University of Chongryon Held
body: The 63rd graduation ceremony of Korean University of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) took place at the university in Tokyo on March 14. Present at the ceremony were vice-chairpersons of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, officials of the university, graduates and parents of students. Congratulatory messages from the homeland, including those from the Education Commission of the DPRK and Kim Il Sung University, were read out at the ceremony. Pak Ku Ho, first vice-chairman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, made a congratulatory speech. He said there are many universities in the world but only the students of Korean university start their hopeful careers along the path of patriotism after enjoying their campus life in a foreign country under the care of the great leaders at their homeland generation after generation. Noting that Chongryon has launched a struggle for putting its patriotic movement on a new stage of development, true to the leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, he called on the graduates to constantly discipline themselves in the current stirring situation of the patriotic movement. He stressed the need for the graduates to add glory to their university in the struggle for the development of the Korean community in Japan and the prosperity and independent reunification of the country with their professional scientific knowledge, fresh ideas, insight and vigor. Rector Han Tong Song made a report. Then letters of commendation from the Education Commission of the DPRK, the Chongryon Central Standing Committee and Korean University were conferred on graduates. A graduate made an oath-taking speech on behalf of other graduates. A letter to Kim Jong Un was read out at the ceremony. Then, an art performance was given by the graduates. Rodong Sinmun

title: True Life of Scientists Lies in Their Ardent Patriotic Devotion
body: Scientists and technicians should exert more efforts on scientific research with ardent patriotism in order to steer the development of the national economy by dint of science and technology in the on-going dynamic all-people drive. To find pleasure in contributing to the prosperity of the country with sci-tech successes and fruition of scientific research and adding vigor to it is great pride and honor peculiar to our scientists and technicians. They cannot carry on the long journey of scientific research to the end without patriotism. The scientists and technicians who recorded remarkable successes in the history of building a prosperous country were the patriots with warm love for the country and people. The real value of patriotism is clearly proved in difficulties. There are many faithful patriots among our scientists and technicians who devote themselves with pure conscience to the scientific research for the economic development of the country and improvement of the people's living standard in the face of hardship. Fervent patriotism is displayed in producing sci-tech successes conducive to the prosperity of the country. It is high time for the scientists and technicians to positively contribute to bringing earlier a new victory of socialist construction with tangible results, creative wisdom and devotion. When our scientists and technicians devote their all efforts, wisdom and ardor to scientific research like the former generations who upheld the Party, the revolution and the country with sci-tech successes in the face of insufficient supply and difficulties, our advance toward a new victory will be further accelerated. Rodong Sinmun

title: Work to Raise Portion of Mechanization in Pit Work Pushed Ahead with
body: The sector of the coal industry strives mightily to increase the proportion of the pit work done by machines and increase the output of coal. The February 8 Jikdong Youth Coal Mine tries perseveringly to raise the rate of mechanization in its pit work, thereby boosting the production of its coal. The workers and management of the Myonghak and Ryongsan Coal Mines successfully made chain conveyors on their own with the internal reserves they tapped out and mobilized. The managerial and technological staff and workers of the Namdok Youth Coal Mine, too, strive to ensure that work can be done down at their pits with machines as much as possible. The Jenam and Namyang Coal Mines and the Inpho Youth Coal Mine produce dozens of accessories with which they put their electric cars, pit cars, compressors and hoisting machines in full operation. The Chonsong Youth Coal Mine, the Kaechon Coal Mine and many other coal mines turn out various sorts of accessories for themselves, thus maintaining their machines with them and doing as much work as possible down at their pits with their help. The Sunchon, Tukjang and Tokchon Coal-mining Factories and so forth make efficient machines of various kinds, maintain coal wagons and step up the production of their accessories incessantly so as to contribute to the production of coal. Rodong Sinmun

title: Sowing Rice in Seed Plots Begins
body: The cooperative farms of South Hwanghae Province have started to sow rice in their seedbeds. Its provincial rural economic committee detailedly arranges for rice to be sown in seedbeds in due season along scientific and technological lines. Some time ago the Paeksok Cooperative Farm in Sinchon County sowed its seed plot with rice by demonstration. The technological problems of doing that were underscored on that occasion. Seedbeds are being sown with rice in the Yonbaek and Jaeryong Plains and other plains of the province’s cooperative farms. Rodong Sinmun

title: Positively Helping Steel Front of the Country
body: Party members and working people nationwide donate plenty of scrap iron to metallurgical works. Pyongyang, Nampho City and South Hamgyong Province sent hundreds of ton of scrap iron respectively to metallurgical works for a fortnight this March and finally fired the zeal of their employees for production. Kangwon Province and many other provinces, too, did all they could to collect as much scrap iron as possible and donate it to metallurgical works. The railway sector made good arrangements for opportunely sending metallurgical works the scrap iron secured by Party members and working people countrywide with much effort. Rodong Sinmun

title: Primary Efforts Made to Solve Its Power Problem
body: North Phyongan Province defined it as the primary task for the development of its local industry to settle its electricity problem and has since exerted itself to accomplish the task. It ensures that its cities and counties finish building medium- and small-sized power stations as soon as possible, operate their existing ones on a normal basis and maximize the efficiency of their electric generators. In addition, it sees to it that its institutions, enterprises and families actively use natural energy and help toward resolving the problem of its electric power. Rodong Sinmun

title: Brisk Hydraulic Electricity Production In Jagang Province
body: Jagang Province makes brisk endeavors to build as many profitable power stations as possible across all its rivers to fill up the shortage of its electricity. Kophung County bends every effort to construct its power stations and profits from them. It has built one medium- and small-sized power station after another across its river, plus many mini-power stations. The Janggang County Post Office built a small dam and installed a hydraulic generator there. Electricity is produced and used effectively. What is remarkable is that all this was done by optimizing its use of materials locally available. The province makes sure that its families install micro-generators at home to get electricity. Rodong Sinmun

title: Enlarged Edition of "Complete Collection of Kim Il Sung's Works" Published
body: The Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House has brought out the enlarged edition Vol. 13 of "Complete Collection of Kim Il Sung's Works", which deals with President Kim Il Sung's works systematically and comprehensively in chronological order. It contains 106 works including speeches, talks and conclusions made by the President from September Juche 37 (1948) to January Juche 38 (1949). The works deal with the tasks and ways for strengthening the Party cells, the lower-echelon organizations of the Party, and developing the Party organizationally and ideologically. They clarify the idea of prioritizing the interests of the people and devoting oneself to preserving them. They also specify the idea of heightening the revolutionary vigilance to cope with the situation, intensifying the combat and political training of the Korean People's Army and augmenting the military muscle of the country by consolidating the material and technical foundations of the ordnance industry. They elucidate the idea of steadily enhancing the teachers' politico-ideological level and scientific and theoretical qualifications and improving the education contents and methods so as to train students to be reliable cadres of new Korea. They also give perfect solutions to the theoretical and practical issues in the building of a powerful independent and sovereign state. They include the issue of inspiring all members of the working people's organizations to the struggle for democratic construction, the issue of bringing up the sons and daughters of revolutionary martyrs to be the country's finest officials and the issue of implementing the people-oriented public health policy. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Verbal Message to President Xi Jinping
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a verbal message to Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC) and president of the People's Republic of China, to notify the accounts of the 8th Congress of the WPK, as required by the times that call for intensifying the strategic communication between the two parties on the basis of deep comradeship. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un in the message noted in detail that the 8th Congress of the WPK set forth scientific and realistic struggle lines and strategic and tactical tasks for achieving a fresh innovation in the Party and state affairs, as required by the changed internal and external situations and reality. The message said that the congress took practical measures to strengthen the leadership and fighting efficiency of the Party, bring about its sound development and consolidate the state and social system, and fixed the direction of the advance and struggle policies of the Korean revolution, including discussion of and decision on the economic strategy and a new long-term plan in the current stage. Informing in detail that the WPK discussed and decided on its policy stand on the bolstering of defence capabilities of the country, the inter-Korean relations and the DPRK-U.S. relations after an in-depth study and analysis of the situations of the Korean peninsula and the international relations, it stressed the need to strengthen the unity and cooperation between the two parties and two countries to cope with the hostile forces' all-round challenges and obstructive moves. Kim Jong Un in the message said that he rejoices, as over his own, over the remarkable successes made by the CPC and the Chinese people in the struggle for building a comprehensively well-off society under the leadership of General Secretary Xi Jinping, successfully tackling the terrible disaster caused by the world health crisis and firmly defending socialism in the face of vicious slander and pressure by the hostile forces. Stressing that it is the steadfast will of the WPK and the Korean people to vigorously advance the cause of socialism by dint of friendship and unity, the message expressed belief that the cooperation between the two parties would continue to go well and the friendly relations between the two countries would grow stronger, as required by the times and in conformity with the desires, wishes and core interests of the two peoples this significant year, too, which marks the 100th founding anniversary of the CPC and the 60th anniversary of the conclusion of the DPRK-China Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance. It sincerely wished Xi Jinping good health and bigger success in performing his heavy duty of leading the CPC and the Chinese people. Rodong Sinmun

title: General Secretary of WPK Kim Jong Un Sends Greetings to General Secretary of C.C., LPRP
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), Monday sent greetings to Thongloun Sisoulith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party (LPRP). The message extended warm felicitations to the general secretary of the LPRP, its Central Committee and all its members on the occasion of its 66th founding anniversary. The message said that the founding of the LPRP was a historic event that brought about a fundamental turn in realizing the long-cherished desire of the Lao people to achieve the liberation of the country and build a new independent and prosperous society. It expressed pleasure over the great achievements made by the fraternal Lao people in their efforts for consolidating the people's democratic system and advancing the socialist cause under the leadership of the LPRP. It expressed the firm belief that the traditional ties of friendship and cooperation between the two parties and the two countries would grow stronger in line with the needs of the new era and the desire of the peoples of the two countries. It also wholeheartedly hoped that the general secretary of the LPRP would be in good health and make greater successes in his responsible work of organizing and leading the entire Party and all the people to the drive for carrying out the decisions made at the 11th Congress of the Party. Rodong Sinmun

title: General Secretary of WPK Kim Jong Un Sends Floral Basket to General Secretary of C.C., LPRP
body: General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea Kim Jong Un sent a floral basket to Thongloun Sisoulith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party (LPRP), on the occasion of the 66th founding anniversary of the LPRP. The floral basket bearing the august name of Kim Jong Un was courteously conveyed to a secretary of the Central Committee of the LPRP who is also chairperson of its Committee for External Affairs by the DPRK ambassador to Laos. Rodong Sinmun

title: Ground-Breaking Ceremony of Project for Building 10 000 Flats Held in Pyongyang
body: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Makes Significant Speech at Ground-breaking Ceremony 50 000 modern flats will be built in Pyongyang in reflection of our Party's noble ideal of "The People Are God" and its idea of the Juche-oriented architectural beauty during the period of the new five-year plan, according to the grand plan of capital city construction unfolded at the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). The large-scale construction of the flats in Pyongyang to be built as new ideal streets for the people demonstrating the national power and socialist civilization is the top priority task for our Party and the government. In particular, to provide the citizens of the capital with 10 000 flats this year is a gigantic struggle for creation to thoroughly implement the decisions made at the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the WPK. A ground-breaking ceremony for building 10 000 flats in Pyongyang took place in the Songsin and Songhwa areas of Sadong District on Mar. 23. The venue of the ground-breaking ceremony for the great construction which will witness a great drive of another significant landmark in the history of the construction of the capital was full of high revolutionary enthusiasm of army- and people-builders to create new construction myth by dint of the great army-people unity in the worthwhile struggle to bring into a bright reality the noble intention of the Party Central Committee, and a great number of red flags, slogans and watchwords were seen there. Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, arrived at the venue of the ground-breaking ceremony. The moment, all the participants raised stormy cheers of "Hurrah!" in honor of him who has made all the Party and state affairs consistent with absolute and unconditional service for the people and made tireless efforts with his devoted service for the people's wellbeing to ceaselessly create a sacred history of the people-first principle on the motherland. Present there were Jo Yong Won and Kim Tok Hun, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, Ri Il Hwan and O Su Yong, who are secretaries of the WPK Central Committee, and Kim Yong Hwan, chief secretary of the Pyongyang City Committee of the WPK, and officials of the Cabinet, ministries, national institutions and in Pyongyang. Kwon Yong Jin and Kim Jong Gwan and other officials of the armed forces organs were also present. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un made an enthusiastic speech full of warm loving care for the people and deep trust in the builders. He said that building 50 000 flats in Pyongyang is something our Party has long intended, made preparations for and aspired to do in order to provide the citizens of the capital city with more cultured and stable living conditions, and an ennobling undertaking to turn the assets of the state and fruits of creative labour of the working masses thoroughly into their benefits. He stressed that the construction of 10 000 flats this year is the project of a massive scale, but our Party decided to push ahead with the project unconditionally as it is directly related with the living of the citizens of the capital city and as it is an important political undertaking of the first year of implementing the decisions of the Party Congress to the letter. He added that the potential of our state and the creative strength of our people will be displayed to the full once again in this course. He expressed the conviction that today, when we are advancing to achieve prosperity and development upholding our state-first principle, this project will constitute a major thrust area symbolic of the era of a fresh upsurge and massive transformation in socialist construction and that we will usher in an era of fresh dynamic advance which will develop socialist construction by stage with confidence. He noted that the grand construction of today will be of monumental significance in the history of building the capital city. He was convinced that the People's Army the Party Central Committee believes first will give full play to its militant temperament in this creative struggle of construction, too, and all the builders will achieve a sure victory with their creative enthusiasm, endeavour, and ardent patriotic spirit. He then set forth tasks arising in the construction. Nothing is more worthwhile and honourable and happier than to unhesitatingly dedicate our sweat and passion to building an ideal street which will be a dear cradle for nobody else but our people who are the best and greatest in the world, he said, and ardently appealed to fight vigorously for the future of our capital which will become more beautiful and magnificent, for our parents, brothers, sisters, sons and daughters who will create and enjoy there a new civilization to their heart's content, and for the brilliant implementation of the decisions of the Eighth Party Congress. When he concluded his speech, all the participants broke into enthusiastic cheers and loud shouts for devotedly implementing the Party's policies, hardly repressing their emotions. He personally awarded the leading officials the flag of the headquarters of the construction of 50 000 flats in Pyongyang. KPA Vice Marshal Kim Jong Gwan, minister of National Defence, made a pledge speech on behalf of the builders. He expressed the firm will of builders to create a new Pyongyang speed and perform new building miracles by becoming standard-bearers of charge and construction heroes in the ongoing struggle for bringing about a turning point of a new victory in the history of socialist construction, under the uplifted flag of the headquarters awarded by the respected General Secretary as the colors of the revolution. All the builders solemnly vowed before the Party and the people to enshrine the great loving care and trust shown by the General Secretary and become the first advancing group and the first vanguard who carry out the grandiose struggle programme advanced at the Party Congress in the van by building 10 000 flats in Pyongyang City at the highest level each year till 2025 which will mark the 80th founding anniversary of the Party by giving full play to the indomitable charging spirit and matchless spirit of breaking through hardships. There was a blasting, signaling the ground-breaking for building 10 000 flats in Pyongyang City. Following the blast that shook the earth in March vibrant with life, a number of excavators started working all at once amid the high spirit of all the builders in the vast construction site. Kim Jong Un warmly encouraged the builders who advanced into the responsible and honorable construction drive for living up to the promise which our Party made with the people in the name of the dignified Party Congress. The construction of 10 000 flats in Pyongyang City will further stir up the fighting stamina of all the people across the country who are all out in the campaign for implementing the decisions made at the 8th Congress of the Party, while clearly demonstrating the brave spirit of our own-style socialism making a dynamic advance and leap forward toward the fresh victory of the revolution, true to the ideals of "The people are God", single-minded unity and self-reliance. Political News Team

title: Let Us Renovate Our Capital City Splendidly Once Again by Building 50 000 Flats
body: Following is the full text of "Let Us Renovate Our Capital City Splendidly Once Again by Building 50 000 Flats", the speech made by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, at the ground-breaking ceremony of the project for building 10 000 flats in Pyongyang on March 23, Juche 110 (2021): All the builders and service personnel who have turned out in the honourable project for building up the capital city, Today we are honoured to set up another meaningful landmark in the history of building up our capital city. The Eighth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea and the Second Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Party held early this year decided on building 50 000 flats in our capital city and, to this end, building 10 000 flats every year while pushing ahead with the construction of houses across the country in the five-year plan period. The most worthwhile and glorious revolutionary task of the weighty and gigantic fighting tasks decided by the Party Congress will start to be undertaken full steam today. Building 50 000 modern flats in Pyongyang, the capital city of our great country, is something our Party has long intended, made preparations for and aspired to do in order to provide the citizens of the capital city with more cultured and stabler living conditions. The Party and the government acquainted themselves with the number of households that need houses and made an in-depth study of the measures for solving this problem. And they have regarded this project as their most important task. Having accepted this colossal project willingly as an honourable revolutionary task which it must implement without fail however difficult the conditions and environment may be, the Party Central Committee reaffirmed its plan of architectural development and construction policy on the principle of applying the people-first principle more thoroughly. It redefined the orientation and order of construction, ensured that a large share of the total state budget for construction was allocated for the construction of houses and, on the basis of plans and preparation to this end, made the construction of 50 000 flats a policy at its Eighth Congress. This large-scale operation for building flats unfolded by our Party and state is not something for pursuing any economic profits; it is an ennobling undertaking to turn the assets of the state and fruits of creative labour of the working masses thoroughly into their benefits. If we build from today 50 000 flats until 2025 when we will greet the 80th founding anniversary of the Party–10 000 flats every year–we will have almost 70 000 flats built, including over 16 000 flats now under construction, thus solving the housing problem of the citizens of the capital city once and for all. Undertaking the project of building houses in the capital city in a bold way and on a large scale is of great significance also in demonstrating the unquenchable fighting spirit of our state and people that are advancing audaciously against manifold difficulties. As you must all know, this project was decided after much thought. To tell the truth, to undertake this large-scale project in the circumstances of today, when the challenges and difficulties are harsher than ever before, is something beyond imagination. Construction of 10 000 flats this year is to be conducted in the circumstances completely different from when we started building Ryomyong Street five years ago; worse still, we have to do in a short time the amount of work many times larger than that of those days. Our Party, however, decided to push ahead with the project unconditionally as it is directly related with the living of the citizens of the capital city and as it is an important political undertaking of the first year of implementing the decisions of the Party Congress to the letter. We have the proud dignity and pluck that we are conducting a gigantic and wonderful project in the most trying days; we also have the self-confidence, experience and assets for surely carrying it out. If the characteristic multistoried and skyscraping apartment houses which we see in the architectural formation plan now are built in these Songsin and Songhwa areas by the end of this year, the potential of our state and the creative strength of our people will be displayed to the full once again. In the course of this, our Juche-oriented architecture will make another leap of development and our construction aimed at creating a new life of our own style by our own efforts and with our own hands will gain a bigger momentum. The advanced architectural technologies and construction methods such as green architecture and dry-building methods will be introduced in an aggressive and innovative way, the foundations of the industrial bases that produce building equipment and materials will be further expanded and strengthened, and our construction units and builders will become more powerful and skilful. The grand construction of today will be of monumental significance in the history of building the capital city. The project of building 50 000 flats, which begins now, is a historic one of building modern, large-scale streets, expanding the urban areas of Pyongyang, the capital city, to the direction of east, west and north. If 10 000 flats and distinctive public buildings are built every year in the areas of Songsin, Songhwa, Sopho, Kumchon and September 9 Street, respectively, the capital city of our state will witness a more magnificent change and they will become significant monuments, symbolic of the most arduous yet glorious third decade of the 21st century. The citizens and their offspring who will live in the new streets we are building will remember down through the generations the builders of our era, who built the enormous architectural groups of world class by overcoming the worst trials, as heroic people. Today's large-scale construction is, indeed, a great undertaking for writing an era of glory in history. Comrades, Construction is an ensemble of the mental standard of the relevant era and the strength of the relevant nation and a long step towards civilization and development. Today, when we are advancing to achieve prosperity and development upholding our state-first principle, this project will constitute a major thrust area symbolic of the era of a fresh upsurge and massive transformation in socialist construction. Through this project, we will renovate the appearance of the capital city once again and usher in an era of fresh dynamic advance which will develop socialist construction by stage with confidence. When mapping out this project of a massive scale, the Party Central Committee paid its primary attention to forming the major forces which would play the main, powerful role in the project. What our Party Central Committee believed first when deciding on this project was none other than the revolutionary armed forces that are boundlessly faithful to the Party and the people. While performing its mission and responsibility of staunchly defending the country and the people, the People's Army has always played a big role also in creating the people's happiness. Only when the People's Army which has performed heroic feats in numerous grand construction projects and in the theatres of rehabilitating damaged areas undertakes to a major project, can a sure victory be achieved in the overall construction projects. I know our People's Army better than anybody else. I am convinced that the officers and men of the People's Army will fully prove themselves worthy of the expectations of the Party and the people with thoroughgoing implementation by giving full play to their militant temperament in this creative struggle of construction, too. Also participating in the current grand construction are the major civilian construction units including the Capital City Construction Commission, High-Speed Youth Shock Brigade, Revolutionary Site Construction Bureau and External Construction Bureau that have performed remarkable feats at major construction projects like that of building Ryomyong Street. Success or failure in this grand construction depends on the commanding officials, service personnel and civilian builders who are in direct charge of it. The construction policy and guidance of our Party and state are ultimately translated into reality by the creative enthusiasm and endeavour of every commanding official, and the Party places its belief first in the ardent patriotic spirit and skills of our builders. The task facing the sector of designing is most important. Construction itself is a highly creative undertaking, and buildings are now getting formative, artistic, multi-functional and intelligent. This adds to the importance of designing. What our Party asks of the sector of designing is that a single dot or a line placed on a blueprint should reflect the ideology, soul and vibrant spirits of our times and embody the lofty ideals and standards of civilization that can proudly lead the world. In accordance with the street formation plan and the designing plan which have already been decided and issued, the designers should draw up all the designs of the project on a perfect level to fully embody the Party's idea on architectural beauty, and hand them over to the construction sector as soon as possible. All the construction units responsible for building operations should start construction work without delay and execute their daily, weekly and monthly plans without fail according to schedule to complete the frameworks of the buildings in their charge within the first half of this year in the main. All the construction detachments and units should regard it as their main task to improve the quality of construction, and consistently hold fast to the principle of ensuring quality throughout the whole process of construction work. When all the officials and builders always maintain the stance and attitude that their loyalty, patriotism and conscience will be verified by the Party, state, people, posterity and history, all structures can become excellent creations of our times both in name and reality. The construction supervision sector should enhance its role so as to ensure that the construction policy of the Party and state is executed and the people's demands and interests and the stability of architecture are thoroughly met. It is necessary to supply on a top priority and timely basis the materials and equipment needed for the construction of 10 000 flats. Factories and enterprises assigned for the production of cement, steel materials and various other building materials and equipment should fulfil their production quotas satisfactorily on schedule by giving fullest play to the revolutionary enthusiasm and creativity of the working class, thus ensuring the success of the construction of the flats in the capital city. The railway and other transport sectors should also launch a vigorous campaign for increased transport to ensure prompt transportation of the materials needed by the grand construction sites in the capital city and by the production bases of steel and other building materials. We should give precedence to political work and ideological offensive in all undertakings so as to give full play to the loyalty, patriotism and creative wisdom of the soldiers of the People's Army and other builders, and make all the construction sites seethe with a high spirit from the beginning to the end of the projects. In this way, we can not only enlist the masses in the worthwhile struggle for construction, but also turn the present gigantic capital city construction sites just into fierce revolutionary battlefields and excellent schools that produce a new spirit of the times and train brave practitioners and stalwart socialist working people. We should also attach utmost importance to taking good care of the health and life of the soldiers and other builders engaged in construction. In keeping with the requirements of the state epidemic prevention emergency system, it is necessary to build epidemic prevention stations and facilities and establish a climate of observing the epidemic prevention regulations voluntarily and thoroughly throughout the construction sites. Utmost concern should be directed to preventing all kinds of accidents and disasters and making the builders engage in their work without feeling any inconvenience. Supply service for the soldiers and other builders should not be left only to the units concerned, but the state supply system should be scrupulously organized so that the exact amount of supply for each builder is given to him. Comrades, Today we are breaking ground for this project, but some months later a new street for the people, a splendid architectural group we will all feel proud of, will be built in this area. Nothing is more worthwhile and honourable and happier than to unhesitatingly dedicate our sweat and passion to building an ideal street which will be a dear cradle for nobody else but our people who are the best and greatest in the world. For the future of our capital which will become more beautiful and magnificent, For our parents, brothers, sisters, sons and daughters who will create and enjoy there a new civilization to their heart's content, and For the brilliant implementation of the decisions of the Eighth Party Congress, Let us all fight vigorously.

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Wreath to Bier of Late Kim Pyong Hwa
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un sent a wreath to express his deep condolences over the death of People's Artist Kim Pyong Hwa, winner of the Kim Il Sung Prize and adviser to the creative department of the State Symphony Orchestra. Kim Pyong Hwa, who grew into the chief conductor of the prestigious artistic creative staff while bringing into full bloom his artistic talents under the care of the peerlessly great men, made a contribution to developing the Juche-oriented symphony by successfully conducting a number of compositions including orchestral music "A Bumper Harvest in the Chongsan Plain", "The Girl on the Swing" and "Arirang". The wreath was placed before the bier of the deceased on Mar. 23. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Verbal Message to Raul Castro Ruz
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), sent a verbal message to Raul Castro Ruz, first secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba, to notify the accounts of the 8th Congress of the WPK. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un noted in detail that the 8th Congress of the WPK set forth scientific and realistic struggle lines and strategic and tactical tasks for achieving a fresh innovation in the Party and state affairs, as required by the changed internal and external situations and reality, took practical measures for strengthening the leadership of the Party and consolidating the state and social system and discussed and decided on its policy stand on the bolstering of defence capabilities, the inter-Korean relations and the DPRK-U.S. relations. He clarified again the will of the WPK to develop the ties of strategic and comradely unity and cooperation with Cuba on the road of struggle for the victory of the socialist cause and launch a dynamic joint struggle against imperialism. Reaffirming the full support and solidarity of the WPK and the DPRK people with the struggle of the Communist Party of Cuba and the Cuban people to defend the socialist system, he expressed the conviction that the 8th Congress of the Communist Party of Cuba which is to be held in April would be a significant occasion to bring about a radical advance in the struggle of the Communist Party of Cuba for further strengthening the party, enhancing its leadership role and building a prosperous socialist state. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Verbal Message to Vietnamese President
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a verbal message to Nguyen Phu Trong, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam and president of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, to notify the accounts of the 8th Congress of the WPK. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un noted in detail that the 8th Congress of the WPK set forth scientific and realistic struggle lines and strategic and tactical tasks for achieving a fresh innovation in the Party and state affairs, as required by the changed internal and external situations and reality, took practical measures to strengthen the leadership of the Party and consolidate the state and social system, and discussed and decided on its policy stand on the bolstering of defence capabilities, the inter-Korean relations and the DPRK-U.S. relations. He clarified again the will of the WPK to steadily strengthen the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation with Vietnam on the road of struggle for the victory of the socialist cause. He wholeheartedly wished Nguyen Phu Trong greater success in his important work for organizing and leading the struggle of the Vietnamese people to build a prosperous socialist state by implementing the decisions of the 13th Party Congress. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Verbal Message to Lao President
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a verbal message to Thongloun Sisoulith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party and president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic, to notify the accounts of the 8th Congress of the WPK. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un noted in detail that the 8th Congress of the WPK set forth scientific and realistic struggle lines and strategic and tactical tasks for achieving a fresh innovation in the Party and state affairs, as required by the changed internal and external situations and reality, took practical measures to strengthen the leadership of the Party and consolidate the state and social system, and discussed and decided on its policy stand on the bolstering of defence capabilities, the inter-Korean relations and the DPRK-U.S. relations. He clarified again the will of the WPK to comprehensively develop the comradely and fraternal relations of friendship and cooperation with Laos on the road of struggle for the victory of the socialist cause. He wholeheartedly wished Thongloun Sisoulith greater success in his important work for organizing and leading the struggle of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party and the Lao people to implement the decisions of the 11th Party Congress. Rodong Sinmun

title: Resolved to Produce More Cement
body: The workers and management of many cement factories work with might and main day by day to produce cement. The Sunchon Cement Complex organizes and directs its production in detail. It mapped out a scrupulous plan for its current and long-term production first thing. It reviews the daily and weekly production of its employees and rectifies their shortcomings in it in time. In addition, it pays deep attention to solving the scientific and technological problems of tightening connections between its processes and enhancing its productivity. It accelerates its current production simultaneously with the increase of its production capacity. The Chonnaeri Cement Factory rigidly controls and superbly directs the work of its employees to ensure that they fulfill their production plans without fail. Besides, it takes good technological care of its machines and strictly demands that no abnormal defects be developed in their work. The Sunghori Cement Factory also goes all out to boost the output of its cement. Other cement factories, too, incessantly work hard to produce more cement for important construction sites. Rodong Sinmun

title: With Raw Materials Locally Available
body: In the past the Kanggye City Building Materials Factory had a very hard time in the production of its colored roofing tiles and coating materials for lack of sand, coloring agents and coating material binders. It succeeded in turning out colored roofing tiles with the weathered granite available near by it instead of sand. Besides, it found out raw materials for coloring agents and coating material binders. Consequently, it actively steps up the production of many kinds of building materials. The Sinuiju Reed-processing Factory produces fiberboards which serve as materials for formworks, fittings and furniture. It dynamically speeds up the production of its fiberboards on the one hand, and tries hard on the other to set up a process for the removal of their moisture, make a coating machine and hit other targets under its plan for this year. The Anbyon Ceramic Factory makes tangible advances in improving the quality of its products by securing new raw materials. Some time ago it found out raw materials for glazes such as centrallassite and calcite. It is now all out to devise new products and whiten them to a high degree. It finished making technological preparations for turning out multi-patterned tiles by recourse to printing technology and went into trial production. It is also very busy preparing for the building of a machine to produce glass mosaic tiles. Moreover, it exerts itself to make various shapes of ceramic washbasins and utensil sinks. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Congratulations to Lao President
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a congratulatory message to Thongloun Sisoulith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party (LPRP) and president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic, on March 23. The message sent warm congratulations and comradely greetings to Thongloun Sisoulith upon his election as president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic. The message said that his assumption of important duty of state leader in the recent election is an expression of deep trust and expectation of all the Lao people in him. The message sincerely hoped that the fraternal people of Laos would make momentous progress in their struggle for national defense and the building of a prosperous socialist state under the leadership of the LPRP headed by the general secretary. Expressing the conviction that the traditional bonds of friendship and cooperation between the DPRK and Laos will be given a steady continuity in the future, too, in the joint struggle for victory in the cause of socialism, the message sincerely wished Thongloun Sisoulith good health and greater success in his responsible duty. Rodong Sinmun

title: Obeying Scientific and Technological Requirements Thoroughly
body: The agricultural officials and workers of the west region of the country sow seeds in their fields by the sweat of their brows, thoroughly meeting the demand of technology for it. The agricultural officials of North Phyongan Province incessantly provide in-depth technological guidance as for sowing to afford a guarantee for the production of ample cereals from the start this year. The agricultural officials and workers of South Phyongan Province set much store by sowing qualitatively in the right time according to the strict demand of technology. North Hwanghae Province made full preparations for sowing and has since gone on with it on schedule. South Hwanghae Province, too, sows seeds in its fields along scientific and technological lines. The agricultural officials and workers of other provinces, too, devote themselves entirely to seeding their fields to make a breakthrough in harvesting bumper crops this year. Rodong Sinmun

title: Academy of Defence Science Test-fires New-type Tactical Guided Missiles
body: The Academy of Defence Science of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea test-fired newly developed new-type tactical guided missiles on Thursday. The test was guided by Ri Pyong Chol, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials of the Department of Munitions Industry of the Party Central Committee and leading officials in the sector of national defence scientific research. The newly developed new-type tactical guided missile is a weapon system whose warhead weight has been improved to be 2.5 tonnes with the use of the core technology of tactical guided missile that was already developed. The two testfired new-type tactical guided missiles accurately hit the target set in the waters 600 kilometers off the east coast of Korea. Right after the test-firing, the Academy of Defence Science clarified that the test-firing was very successful just as it had been confidently predicted, adding that the reliability of the improved version of solid fuel engine was confirmed through several engine ground jet tests and their test-firing processes, and that the irregular orbit features of low-altitude gliding leap type flight mode already applied to other guided missile were also re-confirmed. Ri Pyong Chol said that the test-firing is an important process in implementing the policy of national defence science set forth at the 8th Congress of the WPK and that the development of this weapon system is of great significance in bolstering up the military power of the country and deterring all sorts of military threats existing on the Korean Peninsula. He immediately reported the successful result of the test-firing to the General Secretary of the WPK and conveyed the congratulations of the Party Central Committee to the sector of national defence scientific research. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Clarifies Plan to Form Area of Riverside Terraced Houses around Pothong Gate
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), clarified a plan to newly erect the area of riverside terraced houses around the Pothong Gate, and looked around the site. Accompanying him were officials of the Party and the government Jo Yong Won, Kim Tok Hun, Jong Sang Hak, Ri Il Hwan, O Su Yong, Choe Sang Gon, Kim Jae Ryong and Chief Secretary of the Pyongyang City Committee of the WPK Kim Yong Hwan. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un explained the plan to form the area of modern terraced houses along the picturesque bank of the Pothong River flowing through the central part of the capital city and to turn the area in a peculiar way by putting up multi-story and low-story dwelling houses in a harmonious way. Calling for preserving the specific features and charm of the city by doing the designing of buildings and tree-planting well so that the beautiful natural scenery of our country would be fully displayed, he said that the area of the riverside terraced houses around the Pothong Gate will be wonderfully built to be a model of housing district in our country. He said that the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea is going to push forward the construction of the riverside terraced houses for 800 flats in the area around the Pothong Gate apart from the construction of 10 000 flats in Pyongyang City, complete them within this year and give them as gifts to working people including labor innovators and persons of distinguished services in all sectors, scientists, educators and writers who devote themselves to the Party and the state. Noting that our officials lack knowledge and common sense of urban greening and designing of cityscape and are also indifferent to them, he stressed the need to do the city construction by fusing buildings and nature into one and laying out the living space and ecological space in a scientific way so as to ensure the organic combination of work, relaxation and traffic. Kim Jong Un looked at the miniature of the area of riverside terraced houses and gave specific direction and tasks related to the construction plan. Political News Team

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Learns about Trial Products of New Passenger Buses
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), learned about trial products of new passenger buses. Always being considerate of the public transportation in the capital city, the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un unfolded the far-reaching plan for taking a decisive measure for the improved transportation for Pyongyang citizens though he was busy guiding the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Congress of the Party Central Committee, and made sure that detailed consultation was made of issues arising in the development of the public transportation network in the capital city. In hearty response to the tasks set forth by Kim Jong Un, the officials and workers of the Pyongyang General Passenger Service Enterprise and the Pyongyang City Bus Factory developed passenger bus and double-decker in a short period and reported it to the Party Central Committee. Kim Jong Un watched the trial products of the passenger buses at the building of the Party Central Committee together with Jo Yong Won, Kim Tok Hun, Jong Sang Hak, Ri Il Hwan, O Su Yong, Choe Sang Gon and Kim Jae Ryong who are officials of the Party and the government, and Kim Yong Hwan, chief secretary of the Pyongyang City Committee of the WPK. He boarded the buses and learned about the details of technical features one by one. He said that it is something admirable that Pyongyang City set out to make buses in reliance on its own technical force and production foundation to settle the problem of the public transportation means. He added that passenger buses that help city beautification and which are convenient for the people to use should be mass-produced, stressing that the Party will actively support it. He emphasized that to ease the strain on the passenger transport in the capital city and to promote the conveniences for the public transport of the citizens to the maximum is one of fundamental issues for the administration of the capital city and is of important significance for more satisfactorily providing social and cultured living conditions for the people. Learning about the issues arising in the production of passenger buses, he indicated the yearly production goal and took measures for implementing it. Political News Team

title: More Manure Sent to Coop Farms
body: Jagang Province actively supports the socialist cooperative farms. Some time ago it provided its cooperative farms by vehicle with great quantities of the urban manure secured by its provincial organs, factories and enterprises. Its provincial prospecting bureau and trade bureau exemplarily procured manure. Rodong Sinmun

title: Large Amount of Scrap Iron Sent to Metal Factories in Jagang Province
body: The officials and workers of Jagang Province collect and send large quantities of scrap iron to metallurgical factories. A few days ago they did that by autotruck. The provincial people’s committee, the provincial rural economic committee, the provincial trade bureau and the provincial post and telecommunication bureau set examples to other in gathering iron scraps. Rodong Sinmun

title: Giving Priority to Work to Provide Accessories, Materials and Prop Timber to Coal Mining Front
body: The workers and management of the sector of the machine industry vigorously step up the production of their accessories of machines and materials for that of the coal industry. The managerial and technological staff and workers of the Anju Insulating Material Factory apply rational methods to their work so as to put their machines in full operation. They accelerate the production of their insulating and coating materials tapping out and mobilizing their internal reserves to the maximum. Those of the Anju Pump Factory normalize the production of various kinds of pumps unraveling their knotty problems on their own. The workers and management of the Pyongyang Bearing Factory try hard to mass-produce good-quality bearings for the domain of the coal industry. The Ryangchaek Bearing Factory increases the production of various kinds of its bearing giving preference to the modernization of its production processes and the technological refashioning of its machines and carrying on its socialist emulation energetically. Many stations of the South Phyongan Provincial Forestry Management Bureau speed up the production of their mine lumber for coal mines in the western region of the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Technical Innovation Plans Actively Introduced
body: The workers and management of medium- and small-sized power stations across the country actively introduce technological innovations into the operation of their electric generators to boost the production of their electricity. Those of many power stations in Kangwon Province increase the output of their electricity giving importance and priority to their science and technology. Jagang and North Phyongan Provinces perseveringly push ahead with the normal operation of their medium- and small-sized power stations. The employees of power stations in North Hwanghae and South Phyongan Provinces and many other provinces, cities and counties also do their level best to produce as much electricity as possible. Rodong Sinmun

title: In Order to Send More Fertilizer to Socialist Coop Farms
body: The officials, workers and technicians of the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex produce fertilizer at full steam. The labor and management of its ammonium nitrate shop and urea shop boost their production before anyone else. Those of its 1st composition shop operate their machines at full capacity checking them in a traveling manner and during their recesses. The workers of the HFC’s steam generation shop maintained their steam generators in a short time and have since registered high results in their production. Meanwhile, its 1st and 2nd nitrogen shops noticeably enhance their productivity through a dynamic mass technological drive as never before. Rodong Sinmun

title: All Out to Build Dwelling Houses
body: Housing construction is buckled down to in real earnest for 10,000 families in the Songsin and Songhwa areas of Pyongyang. Red flags fly here and there in the construction site. Encouraging slogans and the hot notices of successes in building operations are posted there. Besides, an energetic agitation is going on there for better and faster construction to fire the servicepersons of the units of the Korean People’s Army and civilian builders as well with enthusiasm for progress. The servicemen put their machines in full operation and work with all their might in excess of their norms. Those engaged in the shock brigades of the Capital City Construction Committee and many other organs and institutions excavate the ground for the foundations of their apartment houses in full swing. Rodong Sinmun

title: Provincial Officials Make Efforts to Provide Raw and Other Materials to Light Industry Factories
body: In all the provinces officials do their utmost to provide their light industrial factories with raw and other materials. Now that a process for the reclamation of wastes has been set up at the Sinuiju Footwear Factory and the Sinuiju Textile Factory apiece, North Phyongan Province tries its hardest purposefully to supply them with plenty of the scrap rubber and plastic, old cloth, cotton wastes, etc. necessary for their production. South Phyongan Province makes efforts to normalize the production of the Sunchon Shoemaking Factory and the Anju Footwear Factory on a high level regarding it as one of its concerns. The officials of North and South Hwanghae Provinces conceive measures to secure raw materials for consumer goods and give guidances on it. The officials of Jagang and Kangwon Provinces and many other provinces pay profound attention not only to procuring raw materials for products and feeding them to factories but also to supplying their employees with good living conditions for their welfare. The result is that great advances are made in their production. Rodong Sinmun

title: Exhibition of Equipment, Gears and Tools for Construction Held in South Hwanghae Province
body: A few days ago South Hwanghae Province held an instructive exhibition for construction equipment, apparatus and implements to vigorously step up its local construction. It was participated in by the provincial external construction company, the provincial urban construction brigade, the provincial construction general enterprise and many other units. They submitted 6,000-odd building machines and implements of dozens of kinds into the exhibition. The workers and management of construction stations in the province are now working hard to modernize their construction equipment, apparatuses and implements on a higher level through a fierce mass technological innovation drive. Rodong Sinmun

title: Practical Measures Taken for Strengthening Construction Forces
body: Kangwon Province makes efforts to reinforce its building force. Above all, it strives hard to ensure that its cities and counties find the actual ways of employing good designers and put them in force. Moreover, it sees to it that its cities and counties adopt active measures to train skilled workers well. The province adopts measures to make sure that trainee skilled builders work with highly skilled builders at important construction sites and learn techniques from them. In addition, it ensures that its cities and counties channel their efforts on the work with the former soldiers of the KPA’s construction units and highly skilled builders and enable them to have their shares in training skilled builders. Rodong Sinmun

title: Construction of Sariwon Teacher Training College Actively Put Forward
body: North Hwanghae Province steps up the construction of its Sariwon Teacher Training College. An innovative plan was formulated to build the STTC on modern lines, the field headquarters was formed to carry it out and many people were employed as builders. The STTC is now well under construction. The field headquarters dynamically arranges for the STTC to be completed as soon as possible, providing good guidance to its construction. It makes certain that rational methods are applied to building operations briskly to ensure their high speed and quality. The provincial speed campaign youth shock force does much work to build the STTC. The members of the affiliates of the Socialist Women’s Union of Korea in the province help the builders of the STTC in their work at its construction site and conduct an energetic agitation for better and faster construction to inspire them to further efforts. The officials of the provincial people’ committee and other provincial organs as well as the working people of Sariwon City whole-heartedly lend a helping hand to the construction of the STTC. In the final analysis, it progresses apace. Rodong Sinmun

title: Regarding Recycling as Lifeline
body: In Ryanggang Province factories make great endeavors to recycle their scrap materials regarding it as of importance in reenergizing their production. It has designated the Hyesan Footwear Factory as a model reclaimer of industrial wastes and seen to it that it acquires experiences in recycling them. Meanwhile, it ensures that regarding it as vital to their development to reclaim their scrap materials its other factories, too, enhance the role of their technicians and skilled workers and enable them to improve the quality of their products and satisfactorily settle the technological problems of remodeling their machines. The Samjiyon Blueberry Drink Factory and many other factories exert themselves to collect their idle materials to boost their production. Fully aware that it is important in enlivening up their production to recycle their industrial wastes the local industry factories of Paegam County, too, turn out consumer goods of many sorts with them. The province ensures that experiences in the reclamation of wastes are shared and actively popularized in factories and encourages its inhabitants to go all out to recycle them in and out of work. Rodong Sinmun

title: Performances of Art Troupes Held in Pyongyang
body: Colorful art performances are actively given to our people at the theaters of Pyongyang to inspire them with revolutionary enthusiasm and optimism. They are now all out to implement the decisions of the historic 8th Congress of the Workers’ Party of Korea. The National Symphony Orchestra gave a concert at the Moranbong Theater on March 21st. Singular performances were staged at the Pyongyang Grand Theater, the East Pyongyang Grand Theater and the Ponghwa Art Theater, too. The artistes of the Phibada Opera Troupe sang the famous songs of the revolutionary opera and performed a collection of famous scenes at the Pyongyang Grand Theater. The Mansudae Art Troupe and the National Folk Art Troupe each gave a song and dance ensemble at the East Pyongyang Grand Theater and the Ponghwa Art Theater respectively. The acrobats of the National Circus gave a circus show at the Pyongyang Circus Theater. They staged physical strength feats, jugglery, animal feats and other popular stunts. As a result, the citizens of Pyongyang enjoyed the sublime and civilized socialist literature and art to the full. Rodong Sinmun

title: Plan and Command for Production Revitalization Conducted Scrupulously
body: The officials of the Ministry of Light Industry do their utmost to step up the production of light industrial goods with raw and other domestic materials and recycle relevant industrial wastes. In the first place they arrange for textile mills to manufacture their products with raw and other domestic materials and reclaim the industrial wastes. An upswing is brought about in the production of light industry factories and enterprises across the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Noble Traits Displayed by Korean Youth
body: Noble traits have been displayed among young people of the DPRK in the first year's advance for implementing the new five-year plan. Students near to graduation at universities across the DPRK volunteered to work at the revolutionary battle sites in the Mt Paektu area and schools in frontline and far-off mountainous areas and on remote islands. Several graduates-to-be of Kim Il Sung University, Kanggye University of Education and other universities volunteered to become lecturers of the revolutionary battle sites in the Mt Paektu area. Those of Pyongyang Teachers Training College and Kim Jong Suk University of Education found their jobs at schools in Samjiyon City. Those of Ri Kye Sun Sariwon University of Education expressed their will to devote their lives to the education of the rising generation at schools in frontline areas. Those of Kim Jong Suk Teachers Training College, Nampho University of Education and Kanggye Teacher Training College volunteered to become teachers at schools of island outposts, branch schools on islands and schools in remote mountainous areas. Rodong Sinmun

title: Exhibition of Medium and Small-sized Farm Machines Held in North Hamgyong Province
body: North Hamgyong Province strives mightily to support its cooperative farms both materially and morally. A medium- and small-sized farm implements exhibition took place at the Chongjin Stadium on March 25 under the auspices of the provincial organs, factories and enterprises and the districts of Chongjin City. Tens of thousands of farming equipments and materials of tens of kinds, including vinyl foils and sprayers for agricultural production, were submitted into the exhibition. The exhibits were provided to cooperative farms across the province immediately after the exhibition. Rodong Sinmun

title: Sericulture Held Fast to as Main Link of Regional Development
body: Jagang Province makes great efforts to develop its sericulture under a detailed long-term plan it formulated to suit its geographical features. Fully convinced that the prosperity of their province lies in developing its sericulture its officials makes far-sighted preparations for raising silkworms 3～4 times a year. In addition, the province exerts itself to propagate acclimated young mulberries of superior species in large numbers. The officials and agricultural workers of Kanggye City, Jonchon County and many other areas realize that the fertility of their mulberry fields leads to the output of mulberry leaves. They blanket them with abundant quality manure in order to produce 1.5 times as much mulberry leave as in 2020 this year. Rodong Sinmun

title: Medicinal Plants and Trees Cultivated with Much Effort
body: Ryanggang Province tries hard to raise medicinal plants and trees in an endeavor to open a wide avenue for its development. It is rich in Astragalus membranaceus and other medicinal plants. It has put forward the Paegam Astragalus Membranaceus Farm as a model and planned to introduce advanced methods of cultivation into its farms and increase their per-hectare astragalus yields. It also works hard to revitalize the Hyesan Herb Culture Experiment Station and thus secure the medicinal plants’ seeds and seminal roots which are acclimatized in its northern area. Meanwhile, it pays close attention to raising medicinal trees. Pochon County grows various sorts of medicinal plants and trees a lot in strips of vacant land which lies along the shores of the Karim Stream. Unhung County plants and raises vitamin trees in large numbers and reaps plenty of fruits year by year. The provincial Koryo medicines production office increases the production of medicinal saplings by method of tissue culture in its greenhouse. Rodong Sinmun

title: Sixth Conference of Cell Secretaries of WPK to Be Convened
