body: The Sixth Conference of Cell Secretaries of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) is to be held in the capital city of Pyongyang early in April at a stirring time when the whole Party and all the people are waging a vigorous struggle for achieving a fresh victory in building Korean-style socialism, true to the idea and spirit of the 8th Congress of the WPK and the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the WPK. The Secretariat of the Central Committee of the WPK decided to convene the sixth conference of cell secretaries to discuss and guide the affairs in prioritizing the position and role of the Party cells in thoroughly ensuring the General Secretary's unified leadership throughout the Party, consolidating the WPK organizationally and ideologically, as required by a new high stage of the developing revolution, and bringing about a radical improvement in the current work of the Party cells. The conference will analyze and review the successes and experience the Party cells have so far gained in their work since the end of the Fifth Conference of Chairpersons of Cells of the WPK, true to the policy of strengthening the Party cells set forth in the fifth conference. It will also discuss the detailed tasks and ways for the Party cells to successfully fulfill their mission and duty in the struggle for implementing the decisions of the 8th Party Congress by decisively improving their work. The Sixth Conference of Cell Secretaries of the WPK to be held amid the deep attention of all the Party members will mark an important historic occasion in strengthening the fighting efficiency of the WPK in every way and propelling the revolutionary cause of Juche and the cause of socialism under the guidance of the General Secretary. Rodong Sinmun

title: Centenarian Receives Birthday Spread in DPRK
body: The advantages of Korean-style socialism with the people-first doctrine as its lifeblood are clearly proven by the ever-increasing number of centenarians in the DPRK. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un sent a birthday spread to Jo Chun Bok, a centenarian living in Songnam-dong, Kim Chaek City. The grandmother, born into an extremely poor family before the liberation of the country, had lived in bitter tears. She could lead a worthwhile life only after President Kim Il Sung liberated the country and established a true country for people. She worked sincerely in the fishery sector for a long time. After becoming a pensioner, she did many good things for society and collective. Keeping her life optimistic, she always requests her children to do more good deeds for the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Further Successes Made Amid Keen Socialist Emulation
body: The officers and men of the units of the Korean People’s Army, who joined together to build dwellings for 10,000 families in Pyongyang, removed hundreds of thousands of cubic meters of soil and mainly finished excavating the ground for their foundations. The construction headquarters have organized a socialist emulation to ensure that fresh innovations are brought about in construction and that it is carried out on schedule by all means. Consequently, the ground was excavated for the foundations of dwellings and the preliminary beds for the foundations were concreted in a short time. Innovations and advances are made in building operations without cease. Rodong Sinmun

title: Cholsan Peak Pulsating with Innovative Spirit
body: The workers and management of the Musan Mining Complex fulfilled their concentrated ore production plan for the first quarter of 2021 by March 27th. They still proceed to effect innovation in their work day after day. The MMC adopts thorough measures to produce in time the components and accessories needed to maintain and reinforce its machines and put them in normal operation on the basis of science and technology in the spirit of self-reliance and thereby operate its mining, dressing and conveying machines at full capacity. Rotary drilling rigs and giant excavators operate without stopping in all the mining fields of the MMC’s surface branch mine. The drivers of the MMC’s transport station raise the rate of the operation of their heavy-duty autotrucks self-checking and self-repairing them and securing their accessories on their own. The overburden conveyor station of the MMC, too, repairs and maintains its belt conveyor well all along the line, thus affording a guarantee for being able to step up the production of its crude ores. The labor and management of the repair and maintenance branch factory, the motor vehicle repair branch factory, the iron ball branch factory, the borer branch factory and other auxiliary units of the MMC produce accessories, components and so on for themselves, thereby contributing to putting its mining, conveying and dressing machines in full operation. Rodong Sinmun

title: Precedence Given to Tunneling
body: The Sunchon Area Youth Coal Mining Complex perseveres in its efforts to make a breakthrough in the increased production of its coal by giving priority to its tunneling. Dozens of its units executed their tunneling plans for the first quarter of 2021 and acquired many coalfields. The Kim Yu Bok Youth Shock Force of the February 8 Jikdong Youth Coal Mine and the shock force of its trade union organizations as well topped their tunneling plans for the first quarter of 2021 ahead of schedule. The Chonsong Youth Coal Mine, too, makes dynamic efforts to tunnel its way into coal. As a result, its numerous units carried out their plans for the first quarter of 2021 at an early date. Many tunneling squads of the Ryongdae Youth Coal Mine fulfilled their plans for the first quarter of 2021 ahead of set time but still increase the speed of their tunneling by their concerted efforts without so much as resting on their laurels. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Reply Message from Lao President
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, received a reply message from Thongloun Sisoulith, general secretary of the C.C., Lao People's Revolutionary Party (LPRP) and president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic (LPDR), on March 29. The Lao president in the message expressed sincere thanks to Kim Jong Un for extending warm congratulations to him upon his election as president of the LPDR. He said in the message that he rejoices at the traditional and excellent ties of friendship and cooperation between the LPDR and the DPRK which have steadily grown stronger. Expressing his will to closely cooperate with Kim Jong Un to consolidate and enrich the traditional and excellent relations between the two countries, the Lao president hoped that the cooperation would bring tangible benefits to the peoples of the two countries and contribute to ensuring peace, stability and cooperative development in the region and the rest of the world. He wished Kim Jong Un happiness in good health and greater success in his noble work. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Reply Message from General Secretary of C.C., LPRP
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), received a reply message from Thongloun Sisoulith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party (LPRP), on March 26. In the message Thongloun Sisoulith expressed heartfelt thanks, on behalf of the LPRP Central Committee and on his own behalf, to Kim Jong Un for extending warm felicitations, best wishes and a beautiful floral basket on the occasion of the 66th founding anniversary of the LPRP. The message expressed conviction that the fraternal Party, government and people of the DPRK would successfully implement the decisions set forth at the 8th Congress of the WPK under the courageous and correct guidance of the WPK headed by Kim Jong Un, the successor to the great cause, and thus build a powerful socialist nation and bring happiness to the Korean people. It wished Kim Jong Un happiness in good health and success in his noble work. It sincerely hoped that the ties of friendship and cooperation between the two parties, the two states and the two peoples of Laos and the DPRK with long traditions would grow stronger in conformity with substantial interests of the two peoples and regional and global peace, friendship and cooperation. Rodong Sinmun

title: In Order to Send More Cement to Dwelling Construction Site in Pyongyang
body: The workers and management of many cement factories work hard day and night to produce cement. Despite considerable disadvantages in the operation of their machines due to a seasonal change those of the Sangwon Cement Complex responsibly maintain and operate their important machines like limekilns, cementkilns and clinker crushers, thereby putting them in full operation. Those of the Sunchon Cement Complex, too, bring about innovations in the production of their cement believing that it as good as boils down to providing actual combatants with ammunitions. The Sunghori Cement Factory without exception goes all out to turn out its cement. Rodong Sinmun

title: Fully Aware That Proper Supply of Iron and Steel Leads to Acceleration of Construction Speed
body: The labor and management of the sphere of the metalworking industry work hard as one to boost the production of their iron and steel needed to build dwellings for 10,000 families in Pyongyang. The officials, technicians and workers of the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex work devotedly by the sweat of their brows to manufacture their iron and steel products as much as possible taking good technological care of their machines and strictly meeting the demand of technological regulations and standard operation methods. The officials and workers of the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex do their utmost to produce iron and steel believing that they also join together to build dwellings for 10,000 families in Pyongyang. The workers of the Chollima Steel Complex do their possible to effect fresh innovations in their production firmly determined to mass-produce steel true to the ideas of the Party the way their predecessors rolled 120,000 tons of steel with a blooming mill with a production capacity of 60,000 tons after the Fatherland Liberation War. Rodong Sinmun

title: Hot to Mass-produce Lumber for Housing Construction
body: In the realm of the forestry workers and management do all they can to produce the lumber needed to build dwellings for 10,000 families in Pyongyang. The labor and management of the Rangrim, Jasong and Ryongrim Forestry Stations and the Koin, Songwon, Huichon, Tongsin, Kanggye, Wiwon and Samnak Mine Pillar Production Stations of the Jagang Provincial Forestry Management Bureau lead those of their counterparts in the production of lumber production. The officials and workers of the Jangjin and Toan Forestry Stations and the Hochon, Kumya, Sinhung, Jongphyong and Hongwon Mine Pillar Production Stations of the South Hamgyong Provincial Forestry Management Bureau repair and maintain their machines well and use them very efficiently. Meanwhile, they apply rational working methods to the reduction of their loading and unloading time. The result is that tangible results are registered in their production. Workers and management carry out their huge daily production quotas without fail at the Phungso and Kapsan Forestry Stations and the Paegam and Yonam Mine Pillar Production Stations of the Ryanggang Provincial Forestry Management Bureau and the Yuson, Mayang and Puryong Forestry Stations and the Hoeryong Mine Pillar Production Station of the North Hamgyong Provincial Forestry Management Bureau. The officials of the Ministry of Forestry are all out to supply lumber to the construction site of dwellings for 10,000 families in Pyongyang in good time in close liaison with the unit concerned with the increase of its output. Rodong Sinmun

title: Necessary Building Materials Transported Rapidly in Time
body: In the railway sector labor and management make innovations day by day in transporting the materials necessary for housing construction for 10,000 families in Pyongyang. Large quantities of cement, gravels, sand and lumber were promptly transported to the construction site of Pyongyang in time for a week after its ground-breaking. The employees of the Pyongyang and West Pyongyang Service Brigades of Engines of the Pyongyang Railway Bureau as well as the Sariwon Service Brigade of Engines actively apply advanced driving methods to their haulage according to the technological conditions of railways, thereby registering high results in their transport day after day. The case is similar to those of the Kaechon Railway Bureau. The workers of the Hamhung Railway Bureau built up an engine maintenance center. On this basis they get as many engines and freight cars as possible running and enable building materials to be carried to the construction site of Pyongyang in good time. The Chongjin Railway Bureau thoroughly checks and maintains its railroad track beds so that freight cars can run on rails smoothly. Rodong Sinmun

title: Electronic Teaching Plan Contest to Be Held
body: An electronic lesson plans competition is scheduled to take place soon to execute the decisions of the 8th Congress of the Workers’ Party of Korea and the 2nd Plenary Meeting of its 8th Central Committee. It will be entered for by teachers training colleges across the country. It is aimed at stirring up the mutual enthusiasm of teachers training colleges and their departments as a whole to effect innovations in the contents and methods of their education and thus elevating their teaching level to another phase. The electronic teaching plans for subjects, which are submitted by the colleges into the completion, will strictly be judged and its outcome published at a virtual meeting. When they will be commented on as excellent ones the electronic lesson plans will be disseminated to all the related colleges nationwide for generalization purposes. Rodong Sinmun

title: Experiences Exchanged at Reviewing Meetings
body: Teachers training colleges have many holders of academic degrees and titles. Consequently, they have become able to possess good qualifications. This leads to improving the quality of normal education. Kim Chol Ju University of Education holds a meeting once a week to review the treatises written by its teachers for academic degrees. It ensures that in the process of this its teachers exchange experiences with each other. It has produced tens of holders of academic degrees and titles for slightly more than last two years. The result is that it boasts them in large numbers. Rodong Sinmun

title: Roads Rebuilt in a Big Way
body: Anju County makes efforts to renew its roads. Its senior officials responsibly ensured that motor vehicles were used for doing so. Besides, they settled the problems of road renovation in time on the spot. The county is now rebuilding its roads as a whole along technological lines and consolidating its successes in it. Rodong Sinmun

title: Anti-land-sliding Project Is in Full Swing
body: South Hwanghae Province carries out an afforestation for erosion control under a step-by-step plan. The officials of the province and its city and counties got full firsthand knowledge of all dangerous places on the spot and drew up detailed plans to carry on projects for them. They then proceeded to adopt measures to inform the working people of building methods and supervise and control them so that the projects can be pushed forward qualitatively. Above all, the province attached importance to carrying through the projects for the protection of farmland and decided to finish them before a rainy season. It also actively helps its working people to carry out their work assignments qualitatively on schedule. In addition, it arranged for trees to be planted first in the places prone to landslides and ensured that soil and sand were prevented from being washed away from mountains and streams by rainwater, that the ground was also hindered from getting dug by rainwater and that the beds of rivers and streams were prevented from rising owing to the ensuing inflow to damage arable land. Many counties of the province are now making efforts to embank their brooks. Rodong Sinmun

title: Construction of Residential District of Modern Apartment Buildings on Bank of River Pothong Starts
body: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Looks Round Site Again The construction of the residential district of terraced apartment buildings on the bank of the River Pothong is to be undertaken in real earnest true to our Party's great plan for architectural development and its architectural idea based on the people-first principle. Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, looked round the site again with secretaries of the Party Central Committee. Another worthwhile construction project has begun to implement his great plan to build a residential district of modern terraced apartment buildings for our people in the excellent place on the bank of the picturesque river. Looking round the construction units deployed in the site getting themselves ready to get down to the construction, he learned about the areas assigned for the construction. He stressed that the construction of the terraced apartment buildings for 800 flats is a project reflecting the plan and intention of the Party Central Committee to give a facelift to the city by building apartment buildings of new styles and to provide highly-developed living environments and conditions for the people. He called on all the construction units to implement our Party's far-reaching policy for the capital city construction with great devotion and unyielding practice, being well cognizant of the importance of the project. He said he would always pay attention to the project and personally strengthen the organizing and leading of the construction work as the core construction units are responsible for the project. Elaborate plans for every stage should be mapped out, the construction and guidance successfully pushed forward with, equipment and building-materials provided without fail, and the political work for each unit and an emulation among the construction units encouraged, so as to create a model experience in the city construction of apartment buildings in terms of speed and practicality, he said. Strict supervision over every construction process must be exercised, building-materials economized in every way with high demand, accidents of all kinds prevented and excellent construction experience introduced to the capital city construction, he said. He stressed the need to make a good plan for planting trees in the residential quarter and give a facelift to the parks on the bank of the River Pothong, so as to provide the residents with the best conveniences for living and improve the natural environment. Stressing the need to improve the quality of the construction to make the most of the peculiar characteristics of different styles and elevation elements of good-looking terraced dwelling houses, he said the construction units should fulfill with success the immediate plans for building dwelling houses in the capital city for this year to demonstrate the modernity of our capital city as the centre of high civilization under socialism and the feature of Juche-oriented architectural development and to display once again our tremendous ideological and mental power with which we can bring about any epoch-making change and the potentiality of the self-supporting economy being consolidated. He specially emphasized the need to continue to thoroughly implement the people-first doctrine and the policy on applying formative art to architecture based on correct combination of national identity and modernity set forth by the Party in the construction of the capital city and provincial areas in the future, set a new standard in city administration and environmental management, in particular, and pay deep attention to cultured environmental management such as afforestation. He stressed the need to grasp once again the importance of housing construction, one of urgent problems in improving the people's standard of living, and undertake an innovative practice not only in the construction of 50 000 flats in Pyongyang but also in the construction in provinces. He said that within the new 5-year plan our Party will make more progress in housing, city management and ecological environment sectors to provide the people with material and cultural well-being as happy as any others. He voiced the expectation and belief that the able core building units involved in the building of a residential district of terraced apartment buildings for 800 flats on the bank of the River Pothong would build as soon as possible the cradle of happiness looked forward to by our people, true to our Party's great policy on capital city construction. Political News Team

title: Importance Given to Both Current Production and Readjusting and Reinforcing
body: The Sodusu Power Station pushes ahead with its current production laying the main accent on increasing the output of its electricity with the same quantity of water as ever. Its officials secure enough accessories, have them in hand and adopt thorough measures to feed electricity to the pumping equipment of the Mubong Pumping Station so that it can be put in full operation. It repairs its hydraulic structures well and keeps them in good conditions so as to retain as much water as possible. Its workers and technicians produce a great deal of electricity over and above their plan applying rational methods to their work and responsibly maintaining and checking their machines to prevent them from malfunctioning. Defining it as important in boosting its production to promote the efficiency of its hydraulic turbines the SPS purposefully overhauls and modernizes its generating equipment. Rodong Sinmun

title: Passionate Agitprop Leads to Successes in Construction
body: The brigade of the Capital City Construction Commission carries on a dynamic agitprop offensive to encourage the masses to perform feats in their work. It made primary efforts to beef up its agitprop squad and ensure that it conducted passionate agitprop activities at a builders’ yard. In addition, it optimized its use of sound trucks, built up its traveling artistic agitation squads and saw to it that they enthusiastically conducted multifarious activities for agitation. The squads conduct good political work at builders’ yards by means of visual aids and kindle them to work with all their might. Rodong Sinmun

title: Working Hard under a Detailed Plan
body: The officers and men of the brigade of the Pyongyang City People’s Committee work hard day and night to build a school and its substructure. This meets with one success after another. The officers formulate a detailed daily and weekly plan for building operations in view of the fact that changes are effected in them and allot and direct them adroitly. Consequently, temporary buildings are erected rapidly and innovations are brought about in digging up the ground for the foundations of the school and building access roads. The battalions of Sadong and Mangyongdae Districts build the schoolhouse mostly with machines and their members, of whom each is rationally assigned a job. Their projects are carried out on schedule in excess of their norms. Rodong Sinmun

title: Priority Given to Ensuring Rate of Rooting
body: The mountains of South Phyongan Province are reforested in spring in real earnest. Setting much special store by the rooting of its trees the province adopts necessary measures beforehand to prevent even the slightest deviation from being committed throughout the whole period of its reforestation, and what is more, its officials set personal examples to others. The working people of the province dig up pits, manure them, plant saplings there and water them to meet the demand of technology for them. As a result, the province is reafforested without deviations on schedule. Rodong Sinmun

title: Efforts Concentrated on Strengthening Construction Force and Material and Technological Foundation
body: The officials of the Tanchon Mining Construction Complex work hard to reinforce its building forces and solidify its material and technological foundations. The building forces are shored up well. The TMCC makes active endeavors to restore the performance of its machines to their original state and refashion them on technological lines with speed and thereby strengthen its material and technological foundations. It dynamically steps up the invention and production of its building parts by reclaiming its wastes. The technicians of the TMCC are all out to technologically perfect its already-built workshop for recycling wastes further and make preparations for developing new building parts with scrap lumber. Rodong Sinmun

title: First Quarterly Plan Completed in Many Sectors of National Economy
body: In the domain of the metalworking industry the workers and management of many units fulfilled their production plans for the first quarter of 2021. Those of the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex put their air separator and other machines in normal operation and produced pig iron, steel and rolled steel on schedule. Those of the Chollima Steel Complex registered great results in their steel manufacture every day with a full resolve to top their daily plan unconditionally. The Chongjin Steelworks and the Puryong Ferroalloy Factory mapped out detailed step-by-step production plans for this year and took good technological care of their machines, thereby fulfilling their production plans for the first quarter of 2021. Many units, too, did their utmost day by day to feed the factories concerned with the iron ores, electrodes, refractory and raw and other materials needed to turn out iron and steel. In the sector of the chemical industry many factories executed the plans for the production of their nitrogen fertilizer, vinalon, vinyl chloride, caustic soda and salt in the first quarter of 2021. The labor and management of the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex, the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex and the February 8 Vinalon Complex fulfilled their production plans for the first quarter of 2021 on many indices. Saltworks across the country were all out to operate their machines at full capacity and thus overfullfilled the plans for the production of their salt. In the field of the power industry the labor and management of many power stations topped the plans for the production of their electricity in the first quarter of 2021. The workers of the Pukchang Thermal Power Complex, the Pyongyang Thermal Power Station, the East Pyongyang Thermal Power Station, the Sunchon Thermal Power Station and other thermal power stations countrywide tried hard to explore the reserves and potentials of their increased power production and finally augmented their power output. The officials and workers of hydraulic power stations strove mightily to carry out the plans for the production of their electricity unconditionally. In the realm of the coal industry many coal mines nationwide fulfilled the plans for the production of their coal in the first quarter of 2021. They did all they could to increase the output of their coal further. Rodong Sinmun

title: 250,000 Cubic Meter Earth Blown Up
body: A mountain was blasted by 250,000 tons on March 31 to reclaim tideland round the Wol Island. The North Phyongan Provincial General Tideland Reclamation Enterprise gives definite priority to the supply of rubble stones and earth to finish damming up the second district of the tideland off the island to the shore and back across the sea primarily as fast as possible at the last stage. Despite their difficulties and shortage of materials the workers of the general enterprise finished preparing for the blast of a mountain in 10-odd days by actively applying rational methods to their work and giving full play to their collectivism. The labor and management of the general enterprise are now operating their motor vehicles at full capacity to dam up the sea with all speed. Rodong Sinmun

title: Brisk Agitprop Activities in Cutting Areas
body: Ryanggang Province strives mightily to mass-produce lumber in its mountains for the 10,000 families’ dwellings under construction in Pyongyang, coal mines in the western region of the country and other major units. Therefore, a dynamic agitation is conducted for the increased production of lumber. The officials and publication distributers of the Publications Management Bureau of Ryanggang Province briskly conduct political work in a diverse way here and there. When fellers took a respite the publication distributers informed them of the contents of books and sang them songs to spur them to confirm their determination to do their part in the production of their lumber. Rodong Sinmun

title: "Complete Collection of Kim Jong Il's Works" Vol. 34 Published
body: The Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House brought out Vol. 34 of "Complete Collection of Kim Jong Il's Works", a library of immortal Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism carrying Chairman Kim Jong Il's works in chronological order and in a systematic and comprehensive way. It contains 84 works including treatises, talks and speeches released by the Chairman from January to September Juche 71 (1982). The works comprehensively deal with the philosophical principle, the socio-historical principle, the guiding principles and the historic significance of the Juche idea, the firm guiding idea of the Korean revolution, recalling its foundation. They clarify the tasks and ways to preserve the unity and cohesion of the Party based on the revolutionary idea of President Kim Il Sung and further enhance the fighting efficiency of the Party by establishing strict revolutionary discipline within it. They also deal with the principled matters arising in firmly arming the men and officers of the People's Army with the revolutionary outlook on the leader, establishing a strict system of order and command in all units and developing the People's Army into an invincible revolutionary army. They advance the tasks to further strengthen the might of the Republic by properly conducting the socialist construction, push ahead with the housing construction in Pyongyang City and bring about a new upsurge in the agricultural production. They also give perfect solutions to the theoretical and practical problems arising in the revolution and construction, including the issues of giving full play to the traditional traits of revolutionary comradeship, training the children of the revolutionary martyrs to be examples of work and life and widening the university education. Rodong Sinmun

title: Meeting Held to Build Pothong Riverside Terraced Residential District into Modern and Excellent One
body: A terraced residential district is to be built in a peculiar way in the excellent location on the bank of the picturesque Pothong River together with the construction of the dwelling houses for 10 000 flats in the capital city of Pyongyang under the plan of the Party Central Committee to give a face-lift to the city and provide the people with developed living environment and conditions. The builders who took part in the construction of the Pothong riverside terraced residential district true to the Party's grand policy for capital city construction are full of great pluck and militant enthusiasm to strikingly demonstrate once again all over the world the development of architecture of our socialist country, inexhaustible ideological and mental power and potential of self-supporting economy. A meeting of officials and builders were held on the spot on Friday to thoroughly carry out the instructions given by the respected General Secretary to build the Pothong riverside terraced residential district into modern and excellent one. Present there were Jong Sang Hak, Ri Il Hwan and O Su Yong, secretaries of the Central Committee of the Worker's Party of Korea, and other officials of the Party Central Committee and members in charge of construction command and builders. Ri Il Hwan made a speech. He said the adoption of the decision at the 8th Congress of the Party and at the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Party to build dwelling houses for 50 000 flats in Pyongyang and the initiative to build terraced residential district on the riverside of the Pothong River as a separate project reflect the noble intention of the Party Central Committee to provide our people with highly civilized living conditions at an early date. He said that the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un unfolded the plan to build modern terraced dwelling houses in the excellent place of the city and provide them to the people and named it the "Pothong Riverside Terraced Residential District". He also said that Kim Jong Un clarified detailed tasks and ways ranging from designing to construction, heating of dwelling houses and traffic and assigned the construction to able core construction units. He stressed that all the officials and builders who took part in the construction should fully display unusual devotion and unyielding practical ability in the drive for finishing the construction of the residential district by the appointed date true to the intention of the Party Central Committee for devoted service for the people's wellbeing. He said that the designing sector should work out all project designing to be perfect which thoroughly embodies the Party's Juche-oriented idea of architectural beauty. He also stressed the need for the construction units to promote the organization of emulation drives, create model experience of building city dwelling houses in terms of speed and practicality and thus finish the project in a qualitative way within the date set by the Party. He ardently appealed to all the officials and builders to build on the highest level the Pothong riverside terraced residential district which is the cradle of happiness looked forward to by our people, true to the far-reaching architectural idea of the General Secretary and thus present the report of loyalty to the Party Central Committee. There were pledge speeches. The speakers evinced their firm pledge to enshrine deep in their hearts the warm love for the people of our Party, create new construction myth and new Pyongyang speed and thus fully display the stirring appearance of daily thriving country and its indomitable spirit. They said that they would build the riverside residential district as one of monumental edifices in the era of the Workers' Party by carrying forward the proud fighting tradition by which a great golden age of construction was opened up under the leadership of the Party. They expressed their unshakable will to keep their thought and pace with those of the General Secretary making every dedication for the people and glorify each process of the construction of the dwelling houses with loyalty and exploits. It was made public how to organize the construction headquarters of the Pothong riverside terraced residential district. All the officials and builders hardened their firm pledge to enshrine the greatest honor and privilege of taking part in the honorable construction drive for implementing the special militant order given by the Party Central Committee, work miracles of racing against time and thus uphold our Party's plan with loyalty. Rodong Sinmun

title: Kim Tok Hun Inspects Different Units in South and North Hamgyong Provinces
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and premier of the Cabinet of the DPRK, inspected different units in South and North Hamgyong provinces. Looking round units of the key industry sectors including metal, chemical, coal and machine industries in South and North Hamgyong provinces, he took measures to settle the important issues arising in keeping the production going at a high rate and carrying out the plan of readjustment and development with metal and chemical industries as a key link and in carrying out this year's economic tasks, as indicated by the 8th Congress of the WPK and the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the WPK. At the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex, the Chongjin Steel Plant, the Hungnam Electrode Factory and the Komdok Mining Complex which hold a very important share in the development of the metal industry of the country, he called for completing the Juche-based system of producing iron technically and expanding its capacity. He also underlined the need to concentrate efforts on producing in time iron and steel needed for building 10 000 flats in Pyongyang City and putting railway on a modern basis as an immediate task. He learned about the major tasks to be fulfilled by major industrial establishments, the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex, the Myonggan Chemical Factory, the Ryongsong Machine Complex and the Kyongwon Area Coal-Mining Complex this year to reinforce their foundations for production while revitalizing their present production, and referred to the ways to carry them out. The field consultative meetings took substantial measures after discussing in detail the issues arising in accelerating the economic development of the country by restoring and readjusting the organic nexus between all sectors and units and proactively promoting the work for cementing the self-supporting foundations, as required by the economic strategy set forth at the Party Congress. Meanwhile, the premier went round different areas in Hongwon County, South Hamgyong Province, the Sinpho Canned Fish Factory and the Sinpho Fishery Station. Rodong Sinmun

title: Japan Urged to Apologize and Pay for Past Crimes
body: A spokesman for the Association of Korean Victims of Forcible Drafting and their Bereaved Families issued a statement Thursday, 83 years since the Japanese imperialists fabricated and promulgated the criminal "National Mobilization Law". The statement said that the law cooked up by the first Konoe Cabinet on April 1, 1938 was a fascist wartime draconic law to justify Japan's reckless expansion of aggression war and replenish human and material resources for its implementation in a coercive manner under the pretext of "mobilization". Since the promulgation of this law up to August 1945 when the Japanese imperialists were defeated, Koreans numbering more than 8.4 million were taken to coal and other mines, shipbuilding sites, dam construction sites, railway project sites and other slave labor sites in Japan, to say nothing of those in Korea, and to battle fields of the Japanese imperialist aggression forces including China and the South Sea Islands, to undergo long-time harsh slave labor and maltreatment and to face the miserable fate of bullet shield, the statement said, and went on: Since then the Japanese imperialists further pushed ahead with the "recruitment of comfort women" and abducted or kidnapped 200 000 Korean women ranging from teenage girls to married women to force them into sexual slavery for the beast-like Japanese imperialist aggression troops. The Japanese imperialists forced many Koreans to be cannon fodder for the aggression war and to face sufferings and deaths as labor slaves and sexual slaves. Such atrocities against humanity are hideous state-sponsored crimes unprecedented in human history. However, the authorities of Japan, far from deeply repenting of and offering apology for the crimes against humanity committed by the Japanese imperialists in the past, have employed all sorts of shameless tricks to evade the responsibility for them while doggedly denying and justifying them. What is intolerable is that they are making ill-boding words in the international arena while regarding the DPRK, the biggest victim of the Japanese imperialists' crimes, as a thorn in the flesh, and openly revealing its attempt at reinvasion of the Korean peninsula. They are not only suppressing the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) and Koreans in Japan, victims of the forcible drafting and their descendents, and applying sanctions to them but also seriously violating the rights to education and upbringing of Korean students and children in Japan. We will never forget the cursed crimes committed by Japan but certainly force it to pay thousand-fold, no matter how much time may flow and how many times a generation is replaced by another. Rodong Sinmun

title: First-quarterly Plans Fulfilled in Many Sectors of National Economy
body: In the field of the machine industry the workers and management of many units fulfilled their national economic plans for the first quarter of 2021. Those of the Taean Heavy Machine Complex responsibly executed their plans for the production of hydroelectric generating sets for hydraulic power stations under construction in Kangwon Province and other ordered plants of various kinds for major units. The Taean Electric Appliances Factory actively adopted technological innovations to raise the performance of its electric motors and scored high results in its production day after day. The Kusong Machine Tool Factory, the Munchon Valve Factory, the Anju Pump Factory, the Anju Insulating Material Factory and many other machine-building units went all out for their products and carried out their production assignments every day. In the area of the extractive industry the Unpha and Yongyu Mines, the December 5 Youth Mine and many other mines topped the plans for the production of their minerals. In the sector of the Ministry of Mining Industry the Munphyong Smeltery and many other smelting works and factories mapped out and directed the preferential provision of their raw materials and the normalization of their production in detail and thus fulfilled the plans for their production in the first quarter of 2021. The Jagang, South Phyongan and Kangwon Provincial Forestry Management Bureaus and all their other provincial counterparts executed the plans for the production of their lumber in the first quarter of 2021. In the railway sector the labor and management of many units carried out the plans for the transport of their materials by dint of hard work. The workers of cement factories countrywide successfully fulfilled the plans for their production in the first quarter of 2021 by their selfless efforts. The managerial and technological staff and workers of the Sunchon Cement Complex raised the quality of their refractory and contributed to operating their machines on a normal footing by making various sorts of accessories on their own. The labor and management of the Sunchon Limestone Mine successfully blasted a mountain twice and procured the ample limestone needed to increase the output of cement. In the final analysis, they moved the production of their limestone on to a normal basis. The Sunghori Cement Factory and many other cement factories without exception topped the plans for the production of their cement as the result of the collective innovations of their employees. In the area of light industry labor and management executed the plan for their production in the first quarter of 2021 courageously surmounting their overlapping difficulties. Rodong Sinmun

title: Sowing Brisk in South Phyongan Province
body: The cooperative farms of South Phyongan Province briskly sow rice in their seedbeds. In Sukchon County all the subworkteams of cooperative farms secured utility farm implements. They are now sowing every phyong of their seedbeds with correct amounts of less rice than before to meet the demand of technology. The officials of Jungsan County rationally organize the labor of its cooperative farms for their spring agricultural work of different sorts on the one hand and lead their members in farming on the other, working body and soul to carry out their work plans without fail. Phyongwon County pays primary attention to the living and working conditions of its agricultural workers and unravel their knotty problems sincerely so that they can exert all their powers on their work. The officials and agricultural workers of the province’s other cities and counties also apply themselves wholly to their farm work. Consequently, its cooperative farms register successes in their sowing day by day. Rodong Sinmun

title: Substitute Mineral Fertilizer Produced with Raw Materials Abundantly Available in the County
body: The officials and workers of Kilju County produced substitute mineral fertilizer for their agriculture this year with raw materials richly available there. The officials paid attention to large deposits of barsowite, dolomite, etc because they are relatively near by a future processing factory for transport’s sake. They made endeavors to solve the technological problems of using them as the additives of substitute mineral fertilizer. The workers of the county’s farm machine station made and assembled necessary machines at a fast speed. The county secured barsowite and dolomite at the same time to use them as raw materials for its substitute mineral fertilizer. Thanks to the enthusiasm of the scientists, technicians and workers of the county and the devotion of its officials, substitute mineral fertilizer could be turned out in a short time. Rodong Sinmun

title: Well over a Hundred Youths in Jagang Province Volunteered to Major Front of Economic Construction
body: In Kanggye and Manpho Cities, Songgang, Wiwon and Hwaphyong Counties and many other counties of Jagang Province young people made up their minds to devote their all to national prosperity and add glory to their autobiographies the way their predecessors responded to the appeal of the country with their whole hearts. They then warmly petitioned their chiefs to send them to the important units of economic construction in the province. A hundred and several ten young volunteers left Kanggye City for their destination on April 1 firmly determined to perform great feats in their work before anybody else. The officials and workers of the province warmly saw them off. Rodong Sinmun

title: Ko Kyong Chan-led Hero Workteam Fulfills Its Yearly Quotas for National Economic Plan
body: The hero workteam of Ko Kyong Chan to the Komdok Mining Complex fulfilled its mineral production plan for the first quarter of 2021 last January. It proceeded to incessantly go all out for its minerals in high spirits as ever and ultimately topped the yearly plan for the production of them by March 31. In the KMC other workteams did their utmost to follow suit. Consequently, Pak Thae Son’s hero workteam, An Jong Min’s mining workteam and Ri Song Il’s youth tunneling workteam carried out their plans for the first half of 2021 late in March last. With the passage of time the workers of the KMC stir themselves further to set new standards and records in topping another 5-year plan set forth by the Party. Rodong Sinmun

title: Slow Action Fertilizer Production Bases Built Extensively
body: North Hwanghae Province is all out to mass-produce slow-acting fertilizer true to the Party’s policy of scientific agriculture. It detailedly arranged for its cities and counties to build their centers for the production of slow-acting fertilizer in a short time and solved the scientific and technological problems of manufacturing machines for its production and putting up workshops for their production. Consequently, Sariwon and Songrim Cities and Yonthan County built their centers with a great production capacity of slow-acting fertilizer in a short time and commissioned them. The other counties of the province, too, vie to build workshops for the production of slow-acting fertilizer with their technology for themselves. Rodong Sinmun

title: Myongmun Stream Being Improved in Full Swing
body: The officials and workers of Tongsin County almost finish improving the conditions of the Myongmun Stream at their second stage. The betterment of the stream is of importance in satisfactorily supplying local industry factories with industrial water and protecting the lives and properties of the people and arable land. The employees of many organs and enterprises of the county speedily embank the stream and coat its shores with large stones. They also build a bridge across it at the same time. As a result, the stream is now being renewed at a fast speed. Rodong Sinmun

title: The Banks of Its Rivers Reinforced in Real Earnest
body: The officials and workers of Kim Chaek City are all out for their river-dyke projects during their general mobilization for spring land administration. Above all, they concentrate their efforts on repairing the banks of their city’s rivers while they are preferentially provided with materials and enlist the use of motor vehicles. They dig up the ground for the foundations of levees along their riversides at full steam to strictly meet the demand of technological regulations. The city makes efforts to dig out the beds of rivers in its rural districts and renovate their banks. Rodong Sinmun

title: Participants in 6th Conference of Cell Secretaries of WPK Visit Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: The participants in the 6th Conference of Cell Secretaries of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, where President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il lie in state. The participants who visited the supreme temple of Juche were full of deep yearnings and reverence for the great leaders who built the invincible revolutionary Party and genuine mother Party, which took deep roots among the popular masses, and who made a new history of Korean-style socialism winning victory after victory with independence and single-minded unity with their unusual wisdom and outstanding leadership ability throughout their revolutionary leadership. The participants paid deep reverence, looking up to the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il, founder and builder of the glorious WPK and eternal sun of Juche. In the immortality hall where the great leaders lie in state, the participants paid tribute in the deepest reverence for the great leaders who set forth unique ideology and line on building basic Party organizations and developed our Party into the militant Party with strong sense of organization and disciplines. The participants hardened strong will to bring about a revolutionary turn in the Party cell work as required by the new period of upsurge and turn in socialist construction by upholding the ideology and leadership of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un with loyalty, and thus powerfully propel the all-people great advance for implementing the decisions of the 8th Congress of the Party. Rodong Sinmun

title: 9th Congress of UAWK to Be Convened
body: The 9th Congress of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea (UAWK) will take place in Pyongyang at the beginning of July Juche 110 (2021). The congress will review in a deep analysis the work of the union conducted in the period under review. And it will discuss the measures for making all the union organizations satisfactorily carry out their revolutionary duties while keeping idea, breath and pace with the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) by enhancing their militant function and role in the struggle to implement the important tasks set forth at the 8th WPK Congress. Rodong Sinmun

title: Pro-Reunification Patriotic Fighter Receives Birthday Spread
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un sent a birthday spread to Yang Jong Ho, a pro-reunification patriotic fighter, on his 90th birthday on April 3. Born into a poor peasant family in South Kyongsang Province before the liberation of the country, Yang Jong Ho keenly experienced how miserable a stateless nation is from his early years. He deeply revered President Kim Il Sung who liberated the country and built a new society governed by the people. He bravely fought with arms against the aggressors during the Fatherland Liberation War. He was arrested by the enemy while struggling for national reunification in the post-war period. Suffering all sorts of evil penalties in prison for over 30 years, he firmly preserved his fidelity as a member of the Workers' Party of Korea. Chairman Kim Jong Il saw to it that he and other pro-reunification patriotic fighters were repatriated to the DPRK and they spend the rest of their life in happiness. The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un added glory to the life of the revolutionary soldier by making sure that he took part as a delegate in the celebrations for the 100th birth anniversary of the President, the 4th National Conference of War Veterans and the 7th Congress of the WPK and as a special guest in the celebrations for the 8th Congress of the WPK. Rodong Sinmun

title: Participants in 6th Conference of WPK Cell Secretaries Arrive Here
body: The 6th Conference of Cell Secretaries of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) is drawing deep attention of all the Party members and other working people as it is to be convened at a time when the whole country is dynamically advancing toward a fresh victory in socialist construction along the path of the struggle indicated at the historic 8th Congress of the WPK. The participants in the conference arrived here on April 3. Leading officials of the Central Committee of the WPK warmly greeted the participants. The participants are full of boundless trust in the Party Central Committee which has led the secretaries of the Party cells so that they can fulfill their honorable mission and duty as an advancing group implementing the Party policies and core and primary political workers of the Party responsible for the work of elementary militant unit in the on-going all-people grand advance for carrying out a new struggle programme of the Korean revolution. Citizens waved at the participants along streets of the city. The participants are full of enthusiasm to make the conference an important occasion in cementing the cornerstone of the Party by strengthening all the Party cells as the group of men strong in ideology and faith remaining boundlessly loyal to the leadership of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un and the vanguard implementing the Party policies, as required by the new high stage of the development of the Korean revolution. Rodong Sinmun

title: Boost in Salt Production Witnessed in DPRK
body: Salt producers across the country are putting primary efforts into reinforcing their material and technical foundations. Officials of the General Salt Production Enterprise have organized and directed vigorous economic operations after formulating realistic stage plans for consolidating the foundations for production. A brisk mass movement for technological innovation was launched at different salt works to raise the proportion of the work done by machines. They made machines needed for restoring salt fields and improved their salt-gathering machines, thus boosting their own motive power for development. Salt production units increase the salt output while paying primary attention to strengthening their own technical forces. They have restored salt fields and enhanced the salt water-storing capacity under detailed plans. They have also boosted their production capacity by timely overhauling the drainage operation system and rationally using the preliminary evaporating ponds. Thanks to the efforts of workers at salt works across the country, the overall plan of the General Salt Production Enterprise for the first quarter of the year was over-fulfilled by 37%. Those salt producers have also concentrated efforts on further consolidating the foundations for salt production based on underground ultra-saline water, which was proved profitable in practice. Rodong Sinmun

title: Successes Scored in Construction through a Keen Socialist Emulation
body: A socialist emulation is carried on more fiercely than ever with the passage of time to build dwellings for 10,000 families in Pyongyang under the grandiose plan of our Party. Under these circumstances the construction headquarters detailedly arranges for a drive to overtake and outstrip each other, learn from each other and exchange experiences with each other to be conducted actively for speedy housing construction. It also ensures that the main principles of the emulation in the period and processes of building work are meticulously mapped out and that all the construction corps intensify the emulation to effect one fresh innovation after another in their operations. . At all the corps the activities of traveling art agitation squads, sound truck-based frontline agitation and field political work through sound facilities are conducted dynamically at the construction site to spiritually spur the servicemen and civilians to the maximum to work hard. Moreover, they post flash news of exemplary deeds, emulation charts, etc and widely publicize innovative successes in their building operations to enliven the emulation. Everybody is all out for the emulation at the brigades of the Capital City Construction Committee, the Youth Shock Force, the Revolutionary Site Construction Bureau and the External Construction Bureau, plus the first brigade of ministries and other national organs. The officials and employees of all the construction corps emulate the servicemen’s revolutionary mode of work and register high results in excavating and concreting the ground for the foundations of dwellings to strictly meet the demand of methods of construction. Rodong Sinmun

title: The Unjon Samgwang Stock Farm Actively Built
body: North Phyongan Province actively steps up the construction of the Unjon Samgwang Stock Farm. The officials of the provincial headquarters concentrate their efforts on the main building project of the farm and organize and direct its other building operations innovatively. The senior officials of the province often visit the construction site of the stock farm to get firsthand knowledge of its construction and unravel knotty problems in hand. They also encourage the builders to work hard. Consequently, success after success is achieved in building the stock farm. Rodong Sinmun

title: Water Channels Cleaned Out
body: Water channels countrywide have so far been cleaned out for more than 20,000 kilometers. The officials of the Ministry of Agriculture and all other provinces, cities and counties of the country formulated detailed plans to clean out water channels in a short time and worked hard to carry them out. Fully convinced that it is important in farming to irrigate arable land the workers and management of cooperative farms across the country continue to make energetic efforts to clean out water channels without so much as resting on their laurels. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Congratulatory Message to President of Vietnam
body: Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a congratulatory message to Nguyen Xuan Phuc, president of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, on April 5. In the message, the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un extended warm congratulations and greeting to Nguyen Xuan Phuc on his election as president of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam. The message said that Nguyen Xuan Phuc's assumption of the heavy responsibility as Vietnamese president is an expression of the great trust and expectations placed by the Communist Party of Vietnam and the Vietnamese people in him. Expressing belief that the good friendly and cooperative relations between the two parties and two countries with a long history and tradition would as ever invariably grow strong in conformity with the interests of the peoples of the two countries, the message sincerely wished the Vietnamese president good health and big success in his important and responsible work. Rodong Sinmun

title: Opening Speech Made by Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un at Sixth Conference of Cell Secretaries of WPK
body: The following is the opening speech made by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un at the Sixth Conference of Cell Secretaries of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK): Dear comrade cell secretaries, The Sixth Conference of Cell Secretaries of the Workers' Party of Korea is being held when the whole country is in a remarkably high spirit in the efforts for implementing the decisions adopted at the Eighth Congress of the WPK and the Second Plenary Meeting of its Eighth Central Committee. Availing myself of this opportunity of seeing you here, you comrade cell secretaries who always live and work with all the Party's members and the other working people boundlessly faithful to the Party and the revolution, I would like to extend, in the name of the Party Central Committee as well as mine, warm thanks and greetings to you, participants in this Conference, and all other cell secretaries and members of the Party for working with devotion for the strengthening of our Party and the prosperity and development of our country. Dear comrade cell secretaries, Really heavy are the duties you have assumed in this pivotal period, an important phase in the strengthening of our Party and the development of our revolution. This is because the implementation of the decisions of the Party congress aimed at advancing our style of the socialist cause on a higher stage by achieving a tangible change and development in the economic work, in improving the people's living standards and in all other fields even in the worst-ever situation in which we have to overcome unprecedentedly numerous challenges depends on the role played by the cells, the grass-roots organizations of the Party; it is also because the fighting efficiency of the Party cells depends on their secretaries. The fighting programmes and policies set forth by the Party congress and the plenary meeting of the Party Central Committee can be executed to the letter and bear rich fruits only when all the organizations of the Party, its cells to be concrete, accept them correctly and turn out in a fierce struggle for implementing them. Cell secretaries are replaced by other persons more often than not across the Party, and there are many cell secretaries who have just assumed their position. Given the situation, it is the intention of our Party Central Committee to meet the cell secretaries across the Party at a regular interval, so as to discuss the cell work, guide and assist them and thereby consistently strive to strengthen the Party cells. Proceeding from this, the Party congress prioritized the work of politically and practically preparing the cell secretaries who are in charge of the grass-roots combat units for executing the Party's lines and policies, and stipulated in the Party Rules that a conference of cell secretaries shall be held every five years in keeping with a Party congress. There are many Communist and Workers' parties in the world, but it is only our Party that holds a conference of leaders of its grass-roots organizations on a regular basis so that its Central Committee can discuss work with them face to face. To consolidate itself as a whole by strengthening grass-roots organizations is a principle of its building inherent and unique to our Party and its proud tradition. Our Party Central Committee frequently meets the cell secretaries, who are always among the Party's members, listens to their opinions and teaches them in order to communicate with the broad sections of the Party's members and the other working people in this course and lead the revolution and construction in conformity with their opinions and requirements. The work of thoroughly preparing the cell secretaries who are in the position of linking it with the masses by the same bond of blood relationship and organizing and enlisting the Party's members and the other working people to implement its lines and policies is the most important activity of the Central Committee of our Party. This is why the Party Central Committee regards a conference of cell secretaries as important as a Party congress and directs much effort to ensuring it a success. Although some successes have been achieved in the work of strengthening the Party cells and increasing their role since the Fifth Conference of the Cell Chairpersons of the Workers' Party of Korea, there are quite a few shortcomings as well. To immediately correct the shortcomings latent in the work of Party cells is an inevitable process that should be followed by our Party for its healthy and sustainable development; and only then can our Party creditably carry out its mission as the militant General Staff that leads the revolution and construction with its roots struck deep among the masses of the people. Even though the shortcomings may be partial and small, they should never be neglected. To identify a practical means for turning all the Party cells, its grass-roots organizations, into united and militant collectives and apply it actively to their work so as to make the short cut to strengthening the whole Party even shorter and dynamically advance socialist construction–this is the important objective of convening this conference in a grand manner. You must be well aware of this. Comrades, Cell secretaries are hard-core members of our Party and standard bearers in implementing Party policy. The Party Central Committee expects that you will work in a more proactive and responsible way to strengthen the Party cells. This conference will comprehensively review and analyze work of the cell secretaries since the Fifth Conference of Cell Chairpersons of the Workers' Party of Korea, and discuss the tasks and ways for decisively improving and intensifying the work of its cells at present. You should participate in this conference with a high level of political consciousness and enthusiasm, so as to study in real earnest how you are supposed to do if you are to inspire the Party's members and the other working people to the implementation of the decisions of the Party congress and possess the qualities befitting the primary political officials of the Workers' Party. It is important that, while looking back on your work in combination with the issues to be discussed at this conference and your past achievements, experiences, shortcomings and lessons, you find a methodology for turning the work of Party cells decisively into the work of understanding people's minds, feelings and emotions and uniting the members of Party cells and other working people with different personalities and qualifications as firmly as your own family members are. Participating in this conference are 10 000 persons including Party cell secretaries in various sectors, mainly the exemplary ones working at production sites, senior officials of provincial Party committees and other Party committees performing equivalent functions to them, chief secretaries of the Party committees of cities, counties and industrial complexes and relevant officials of the Party Central Committee. Fully convinced that this conference will mark a significant occasion in further consolidating the foundations of the Party, building our revolutionary ranks into more invincible ones and bringing about a remarkable progress in implementing the decisions of the Party congress and in socialist construction, I declare the Sixth Conference of Cell Secretaries of the Workers' Party of Korea open.

title: Occasion of Turn to Bring about New Advance in Strengthening Whole Party and Building Socialism
body: 6th Conference of Cell Secretaries of WPK Opens WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un Guides Conference The 6th Conference of Cell Secretaries of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) was opened in the capital city of Pyongyang on April 6 amid the great interest and expectation of all Party members and people all out in implementing new strategic line and struggle policy of the socialist construction set forth at the 8th Congress of the WPK and the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee. The conference, which was convened at a crucial time in strengthening our Party and developing the revolution, will be a significant occasion in strengthening the Party's leadership and the single-minded unity of the revolutionary ranks in every way and bring about an epochal advance in the implementation of the decisions of the Party Congress and in the socialist construction by more thoroughly establishing the unified leadership system of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un in the whole Party and firmly preparing Party cells to be vanguard ranks that defy death to implement the Party policy with strong sense of militant and fighting efficiency. The great victory and considerable achievements made in the socialist construction in the ideals of "The People Are God", single-minded unity and self-reliance defying all sorts of challenges and difficulties of history are the proud results brought about by the idea of the WPK's idea of giving importance to the Party cells and its line of strengthening the Party cells meant to open up a shortcut to strengthening the whole Party by constantly increasing the function and role of the Party cells, main unit linking the Party and the masses into one and militant units directly implementing the Party's line and policy. The 6th Conference of Cell Secretaries of the WPK will comprehensively analyze and review the work done by the secretaries of Party cells in implementing the tasks set forth at the 5th Conference of Cell Chairpersons of the WPK and discuss the tasks and practical ways of decisively improving and strengthening the work of Party cells at present. Attending the conference were Party cell secretaries working in various fields, mainly the exemplary cell secretaries working at production sites, and officials of the Party committees in Pyongyang and provinces. All the participants were full of ardent reverence for and trust in the General Secretary, who with primary significance attached to strengthening the basic Party organizations in building the revolutionary Party of Juche and accomplishing cause of socialist construction, led the Party cells to become solid cornerstones supporting our Party. Amid the playing of a welcoming music General Secretary of the WPK Kim Jong Un appeared on the platform to guide the conference. The moment, the venue for the conference was over-flown with stormy cheers of "hurrah!" of all the participants for the General Secretary who is confidently leading our style of the socialist cause only to victory and glory while demonstrating to the world the dignity and prestige of the great Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Party with his outstanding idea and energetic leadership. Taking the platform were Jo Yong Won, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK and secretary for organizational affairs of the Party Central Committee, Jong Sang Hak and Ri Il Hwan, secretaries of the Party Central Committee, Kwon Yong Jin, director of the General Political Bureau of the Korean People's Army, Kim Jae Ryong, O Il Jong and Ho Chol Man, department directors of the Party Central Committee, and senior officials of the central and local Party committees. Kim Jong Un made an opening address of the 6th Conference of Cell Secretaries of the Workers' Party of Korea. Stressing it is the unique and original party-building principle and proud tradition of the Party to strengthen the entire Party by consolidating lower-echelon organizations, he clarified the duties of secretaries of Party cells, the importance of consolidating Party cells, the reason why the Party Central Committee gives no less weight to a conference of secretaries of Party cells than a Party congress and the purpose in holding the conference. Expressing belief that the current conference will be an occasion of significance for further consolidating the foundations of the Party, making the revolutionary ranks invincible and bringing about an epochal advance in the implementation of the decisions of the Party Congress and socialist construction, he declared the conference open. Jo Yong Won made a report "Let's unconditionally and devotedly carry out the five-year plan set forth at the Eighth Party Congress by further boosting the militant and fighting efficiency of Party cells." He said that the current conference is held at a stirring time when the all-people general march for opening up an era of new advance in socialist construction is powerfully expedited under the wise leadership of the General Secretary. The General Secretary has ushered in a brilliant golden age in strengthening the entire Party by comprehensively developing the ideas and theories of building the great Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Party and seeing to it that they are applied to the work of Party cells to the letter, he said. Under the direct initiative and guidance of the General Secretary the Fourth Conference of Cell Secretaries of the WPK and the Fifth Conference of Cell Chairpersons of the WPK took place in the new century of Juche, he said, adding that the new century has been recorded as the one of glory and struggle when the great vitality of the Party's idea of prioritizing Party cells and line of strengthening them are fully displayed. He noted that the General Secretary set forth the militant slogan "Let Us Strengthen Party Cells into Loyal Cells, into Vanguard Ranks for the Implementation of the Party's Policies!" and indicated detailed orientation and ways for strengthening Party cells at the 5th Conference of Cell Chairpersons of the WPK. The Party cells serve as the primary units for creating bonds between the Party and the masses and as the militant units and the first-line trench for directly carrying out the lines and policies of the Party by organizing and mobilizing the Party members and other working people, he said, adding: This classical formulation constitutes the undying guidelines scientifically clarifying the importance of the position and role of the Party cells. The 8th Congress of the WPK and the first workshop for the chief secretaries of the city and county Party committees clearly set forth ideologies and theories including the issue of establishing a revolutionary climate of correctly adopting and unconditionally carrying out the Party decisions, the issue of intensifying criticism, ideological struggle and study within the Party and the issue of turning the work for strengthening Party cells in the one of Party committees, he noted, adding: This has made sure that the Party gets stronger in its revolutionary nature and appearance as a working, struggling and advancing party, and helped enhance its fighting efficiency in every way. The energetic ideo-theoretical activities of the respected General Secretary will shine forever along with the development of the Party cells, he said. The respected General Secretary has always paid deep attention to strengthening the basic Party organizations and wisely led the work for boosting the militant function and role of Party cells, he pointed out. He said that the wise guidance of the General Secretary assured the cell secretaries of the whole Party of whom they are, what they should do and where they should stand and how they should struggle when the Party and the state suffer hardships. He said that the proud life and high honor of the Party cell secretaries are unthinkable apart from the benevolence shown by the General Secretary who has placed the deepest trust in them, raised their spirit and led them step by step. His great love and trust have helped many cell secretaries grow into vanguard fighters and paragons of the times who carry out the Party policies, the reporter noted. The Party cells have so far been consolidated as firm integral organizations that achieved ideological and volitional unity of their members, basic foundations of the Party which have taken deep roots among the masses, and permanent cornerstone for ensuring the implementation of the Party line and policy, he said, and went on: This is the great fruition of outstanding idea and leadership provided by the General Secretary. The reporter, reflecting the unanimous feelings of all the participants and other people across the country, paid the highest tribute to President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il who developed the WPK into an invincible and powerful one with hundreds of thousands of militant Party cells, and extended the highest glory and warmest greeting to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, the tender-hearted teacher and father of the cell secretaries ushering in the greatest heyday of developing the Party cells with his extraordinary ideological and theoretical wisdom and energetic leadership. The report referred to the successes and experience in the work of the Party cells in the course of the struggle for thoroughly implementing the important tasks set forth at the 5th Conference of Cell Chairpersons of the WPK for developing the Party cells into the ones of loyalists and vanguard ranks for implementing Party policies. He cited facts of how the Party cell secretaries made a great advance in developing the Party cells into the ranks who take the lead in devotedly defending Kim Jong Un and groups of steadfast loyalists by conducting to good effect the ideological education of various forms and methods for training the Party members to be genuine Kimilsungists-Kimjongilists. He stressed that the Party cells brilliantly implemented the Party policy and fulfilled the main revolutionary tasks entrusted to their units by orienting organizing and guidance of Party life of the Party members to performing their revolutionary tasks. He said that the Party cells effected a collective innovation in implementing the Party policy through dynamic political work for arousing the mental power of the masses, and went deep among the people's life whenever they faced stern times before inspiring them with confidence and courage and leading them in order to let them cast in their lot with the Party Central Committee. He referred to the successes achieved by the Party cell secretaries in making a breakthrough in the van of difficult and tough work by setting personal examples for the masses to follow. He added that the experience of the Party cell secretaries achieving good successes in their work clearly prove that they can overcome difficulties encountered and bear good fruits in implementing Party policy when they train all the Party cell members as genuine loyalists who share intention and breath and keep pace with the General Secretary and develop the Party cells into an ideologically pure body and a patriotic collective united in thinking and purpose, morality and sense of obligation. The report reviewed the mistakes of failing to push forward the work of increasing the militant might of the Party cells in line with the Party's intention in the past. The report made an impartial criticism of Party cells that failed to firmly adhere to the work of establishing the unified leadership system of the General Secretary as the key point of their work, to organize and guide the Party life of the Party members under a meticulous plan that requires main emphasis put on hardening their Party spirit, to definitely turn the Party cell work to the one with the people and to fulfill their duty as direct militant units of implementing the Party policies.
