At the moment there are some Party members who fail to do their duties as they should. This is attributable in no small part to the fact that Party cells have so far failed to properly conduct the work of increasing Party membership. The General Secretary said that, in order to straighten out this matter, the Party Central Committee took appropriate measures for Party cells to adhere to Party principle, the principle of rigidly selecting those who are recognized by everyone else as eligible, in identifying and recommending people for Party membership, and continued. They should strictly adhere to Party principle and rigidly select, like sieving, and recommend for Party membership, whoever they may be and whatever others may say, those who really have a high degree of political and ideological preparedness, throw themselves into the performance of their revolutionary tasks and can play a core role. Along with this, they have to intensify education and training of the nominees for Party membership. They should keep up with their work and life and take steps for educating them to remedy defects, if any, and should train them in practice by entrusting them with arduous and difficult tasks facing their units while having them fulfill their own tasks in a responsible manner. They should also encourage them to study hard to improve their political and practical qualifications, cultivate their abilities with which to organize and enlist the masses and steadily inspire them to keep setting examples in their organizational life in their own organizations so that they can acquire the qualifications and personality due for a Party member. By doing so, we can admit to our Party ranks only those who are trustworthy and prepared enough to work with devotion for the Party and the revolution and keep the honour of being Party members. The eighth task facing Party cells at present is to put special efforts to educating young people. Young people are reserves of and successors to the Party, and so education of them is the most important matter that Party organizations should not neglect or loosen even for a moment. Moreover, there are now not a few factors that have a negative impact on the healthy growth and development of our young people, and a serious change is taking place in their ideological and mental state. This reality demands that Party cells that are always with young people put greater efforts into their education. All Party cells should accept education of young people as a matter of vital importance for the future of the Party and the revolution, the country and the people, a crucial one that cannot be overlooked any longer, and spare no effort for this work. Party cells should thoroughly overcome the deviation of simply putting education of young people in charge of the primary organizations of the youth league, and turn the education into an undertaking involving all their members. They should give their members assignments for taking charge of and educating young people, regularly review the results of fulfilment of the assignments and take relevant measures so as to have them pay attention to the education of young people purposefully and, especially, fully discharge their responsibility for their children's education. They should often learn about the work and life of young people, and help them adopt a loyal and patriotic frame of mind and spend their youth doing worthwhile things by participating well in their organizational life and performing their revolutionary tasks faithfully. They should take care of young people's attire, hairstyles, speeches, behaviours and relations with other people as meticulously as their mothers would do, and always educate and control them so that they may pursue an honest and lofty way in their spiritual and cultural life as well as in their economic and moral life. They should become benevolent Party cells by giving persistent and principled education to those young people, who followed a wrong path at one time, and prepare them to be proud members of society and their collectives. They should always pay attention to the work of the youth league, cultivate the independence and creativity of its primary organizations and actively support their work. They should wage in a substantial way the campaign of creating a model unit in rendering Party guidance to the work of the youth league to invigorate its work, and train all our young people well enough to carry on the baton of revolution faithfully. The ninth task facing Party cells at present is to actively promote the remoulding of man and make the collectives brim over with the communist trait of helping and leading one another forward. Our own style of people-centred socialism can maintain its original features and give full play to its advantages only when all its members are conscious of their duty as masters of the state and society and perform their roles as such with credit. The General Secretary noted that we should conduct a Party-wide undertaking to transform those who are lagging behind into socialist, patriotic working people as we did in the Chollima era in which the campaign for remoulding of man was conducted vigorously. It is the Party cells that are best acquainted with the sentiments, mental states and living conditions of the masses. Based on the stand that there is no one who cannot be educated and transformed in our society unless they degenerated from the class viewpoint, they should purposefully buckle down to the efforts for transforming people. Having one person educate and transform ten and ten, a hundred, and overcoming the negative by dint of the positive–this is a traditional working method of our Party. Party cells should assign the laggards and persons with serious issues in the present life and work to their members and lead them to educate and transform these persons with sincere efforts. No matter what serious mistakes one has made, Party cells should embrace them true to the Party's intention if they retain the original features of loyalty and patriotism and ensure that they enjoy a worthwhile life in the great socialist family. As everyone has both positive and negative aspects, they should steadily undertake the transformation of man in a way of identifying positive buds in him, even though trifle, and encouraging him to weaken the negative aspects and persuading him patiently and admonishing him in principle ten or one hundred times, not giving up after a few times of education. If each of the millions of our Party's members takes charge of just one person and educate and remould him, all the members of society can be transformed into working people who work with devotion for society and the collective. Collectivism whereby people help and lead one another forward is a proud tradition and national trait unique to our style of socialism. The preceding generations of our revolution have displayed a high level of ennobling virtues and traits to the wonder of the world even in the protracted arduous difficulties under the communist slogan "One for all and all for one!" This has served as a source of strength which enabled the Juche-oriented socialism to advance victoriously on the basis of the solidest single-hearted unity. Party cells, by upholding as ever the slogan "One for all and all for one!" which has demonstrated its great vitality throughout the course of our socialist construction, should efficiently lead the masses to establish in their collectives the communist trait and outlook on morality of helping and leading one another forward. They should see to it that the spirit of helping those lagging behind, supporting those with difficulties and doing something for the benefit of next shift and another workteam pervades the collectives, so that collective and collaborative innovation can be brought about. It is necessary to ensure that the Party's members and the other working people are equipped with the spirit of sharing weal and woe with one another, conceding good things and shouldering hard work and the ennobling moral trait of respecting one another and observing good manners, and the feelings of harmony, unity, comradeship and brotherly affection prevail in their collectives. The tenth task is to wage an intensive struggle against the anti-socialist and non-socialist practices. Today the most dangerous enemy in preserving the original features of our style of socialism and bringing its advantages into full play is the anti-socialist and non-socialist practices. This is not the target of law-enforcement organs alone. Only when all the people wage the struggle against them as a struggle for themselves, as a mass struggle, can they fully expose and wipe out the anti-socialist and non-socialist practices that are prevalent in various fields of social life. Party cells should fulfil their due responsibility and role in organizing and rousing the masses to stamp out the anti-socialist and non-socialist practices. They should give the Party's members and the other working people a tireless explanation of the forms of expression, dangers and harmful effects of these practices so that they themselves hate and denounce the practices and turn out actively in the struggle to stamp out all the negative practices that are revealed in their units and around themselves . Mindful of the fact that if Party cells are feeble, anti-socialist and non-socialist practices will prevail and, worse still, our revolutionary and class positions may crumble, they should never make any slightest compromise or concession in their struggle against such practices. It is necessary to wage a vigorous struggle against the practice of regarding one's unit as being "special," self-centredness, the abuses of power, bureaucratism and corruption. Party, administrative and legal struggle against such practices is getting more intensified after the Second Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Party Central Committee; in keeping with this, Party cells should strengthen education and the controls so as to prevent any of these practices budding in their units and collectives. Party cells in the units, in which such practices may be practised because of the characteristics of their work, should be more alert, tighten their grips on the Party life of the officials and the other Party's members, and launch an intensive criticism offensive against even their slightest manifestation without tolerating them, and thus resolutely stamp them out. These are the ten major tasks facing Party cells at present. The General Secretary said that the success of the work of Party cells depends entirely on the preparedness and roles of their secretaries, and continued. Party cell secretaries are grassroots-level political workers responsible for the Party life and political integrity of the Party's members, and they are also planners, organizers and executors of work and unity of their Party cells. There are no other political workers in our Party's organizational structure than cell secretaries who work with the Party's members shoulder to shoulder every minute of the day, explain the Party's policies to them in person and implement them. Party cell secretaries should become not only an amplifier that correctly conveys only the Party's ideas and intentions to the Party's members and the other masses but also a taintless mirror that reflects the features of the Party as they are; this is a demand of the Party and the times. The General Secretary seriously pointed out the deviant methods of work revealed by a number of cell secretaries with a low degree of political awareness and preparedness, and specified one by one the revolutionary and ennobling political and moral traits to be surely possessed of by Party cell secretaries. Party spirit, principled stand, political preparedness, sense of responsibility, setting practical examples, creativity, familiarity with the masses, humaneness, sincerity, optimism, ethics and uprightness are the twelve basic traits to be possessed of by cell secretaries, he said, adding that only when all the cell secretaries throughout the Party acquire these traits and work with devotion for the good of their organizations and collectives can they be called "our cell secretaries" with affection by the masses. Noting that the whole Party should proactively help the cells in their work and throw its full weight behind them, he underscored the need to build up the ranks of Party cell secretaries and work efficiently to raise their political and practical qualifications and inspire them with a sense of pride and honour of working as Party cell secretaries. He pointed out that all Party officials should go to Party cells in a planned way to have talks with the Party's members and the other masses as well as the Party cell secretaries, bring home to them the ideas and intentions of the Party Central Committee, correct the deviations revealed in the work of the cells and solve knotty problems, if any, and went on: Comrade cell secretaries, With the current conference as a momentum, our Party intends to set up a fresh turning point for the building up and unity of cells and steadily strengthen the unity and fighting efficiency of the entire Party by continuously directing great efforts to the work of cells in the future, too. Great are the Party Central Committee's expectations of the cell secretaries in performing this weighty task. The Party Central Committee firmly believes that the cell secretaries across the Party, with unusual preparedness, determination and fortitude, will devote all their efforts to turning Party cells into healthy and viable ones, whose members are closely knitted in the bonds of kinship, thereby further cementing our Party organizationally and ideologically and giving a powerful impetus to the grand all-people march towards a fresh victory in socialist construction. Comrade cell secretaries, Now, our revolution urgently demands a new change of our own style, and this great change can be brought about only by the utmost devotion and practical efforts of our Party cell secretaries. For the prosperity and development of our great state, the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, For the unity and strengthening of our great Party, and For the eternal happiness of our great people, Let us all fight more vigorously. The concluding speech made by General Secretary Kim Jong Un at the Sixth Conference of Cell Secretaries of the WPK is an important guideline in consolidating the cornerstone for the building up and unity of the entire Party and enhancing the fighting efficiency of Party cells in all aspects as required by the new stage of the developing revolution; it is also a great banner of struggle which dynamically inspires all the Party's members and the other people to implement the decisions set forth by the Eighth Party Congress and to make a revolutionary advance towards a fresh victory of socialism of our own style. Political News Team

title: DPRK Premier Inspects Construction Site of 10 000 Flats in Pyongyang and Central Tree Nursery
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected the construction site of 10 000 flats in Pyongyang and the Central Tree Nursery under the Ministry of Urban Management. Looking around the construction site bustling with the efforts for creating new Pyongyang Speed and working miracles in construction, he underlined the need for officials to enhance their responsibility and role in designing, construction and supervision, understanding that the construction project is an important work for realizing the long-cherished desire of the Party Central Committee to provide the people with more civilized living conditions. He underlined the need for the metal industry and railway transport field to put efforts into increasing iron and steel production and quickly carrying materials, true to the intention of the Party Central Committee in giving top priority to timely supplying materials and equipment needed for the construction project. He also called for giving precedence to the infrastructure construction in order to keep pace with the accelerated construction. At the Central Tree Nursery, he mentioned the need to step up the cultivation of saplings of good species for greening with a main emphasis put on upping the scientific and intensive level in sapling production. The field consultative meetings urged the units involved in the housing project to fully meet the requirements of designs, strictly observe the construction rules and apply rational methods to organizing and guiding the construction, thus successfully carrying out the construction policy of the Party and the state, meeting the demands and interests of the people and thoroughly ensuring architectural security. Also discussed at the meetings were the ways to improve afforestation and greening in Pyongyang City. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Congratulatory Message to Teaching Staff, Students of Korean University of Chongryon
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un sent a congratulatory message to the teaching staff and students of Korean University on April 10. He, in the message, offered warm congratulations and compatriotic greeting, reflecting the wish of the great leaders and feelings of all the people in the homeland, to the teaching staff and students, graduates of Korean University and their parents greeting its 65th founding anniversary in balmy spring days of April. The message said that the 65 years-long history of Korean University is shining as a glorious and proud one, in which the university has made a great contribution to the development of the movement of Koreans in Japan by training the new generations of Koreans in Japan to be true talents of the nation guided by a firm ideological and leadership system of Juche, and to be pillars of patriotism possessed of a noble sense of morality and rich knowledge, true to the Juche-oriented idea of national education and leadership of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. The message noted that Korean University is an invaluable patriotic legacy and the supreme temple of democratic national education, whose name is reminiscent of the tender-hearted images of the peerlessly great men. It pointed out that there are many universities in the world but it is the only Korean University of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) that is flying high its national flag in the middle of the alien soil and systematically training sons and daughters of Koreans in Japan to be excellent talents of the nation with noble spirit and patriotic soul. Kim Jong Un in the message expressed his conviction that the teaching staff and students of the university would bring about a fresh turn in their educational work and study, true to the traditions of loyalty, the single-minded unity and patriotism in the future, too, and thus make sure that the university fulfills its mission and duty as the one and only university of overseas compatriots in the world and the pedigree establishment for training the talents of the nation. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Pencil Drawing, Calligraphy Festival Opens
body: A national pencil and calligraphy festival opened with due ceremony at the Okryu Exhibition Hall on April 8 in celebration of the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Seen at the festival venue is an art work depicting tender-hearted President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il seeing the calligraphy skill of a schoolgirl. Such calligraphic works as "The People Are God" and "Fork to Mangyongdae" dealing with the exploits of the President arouse yearning and reverence for the President. A pencil drawing "We Will Go to Mt Paektu" and others depicting the working people and youth and students visiting the revolutionary battle sites in the area of Mt Paektu give fine ideological and artistic representation of our people's will to brilliantly carry forward and develop down through generations the revolutionary cause of Juche. Displayed at the venue were also the works showing with powerful and refined technique the spirit of the Korean people who turned out in the struggle for implementing the decisions of the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th WPK Central Committee. The works of various subjects vividly show the new generation volunteering to work in difficult and labor-consuming fields in response to the Party's call. Rodong Sinmun

title: Eternal Luster Will Be Added to His Great Contributions
body: 28 years have passed since all the people of the country and all the officers and men of the Korean People’s Army loudly acclaimed Kim Jong Il Chairman of the National Defence Commission of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea with great pride and joy in April 1993. Large numbers of military experts and generals were recorded in history. But they all were no match for Kim Jong Il who defended the country and demonstrated its dignity and might all over the world shattering the heinous machinations of the hostile forces despite so serious difficulties. Our people still recall warmly that he made an incessant anti-Japanese guerilla-style forced march and paved the way for building a powerful socialist country. He visited the Chollima Steel Complex and inaugurated another great revolutionary upswings in its production in December 2008. He then proceeded to make an extremely forced march toward national prosperity day and night to ensure that the whole country went out for them. He inspected the Seoul Ryu Kyong Su Guards 105th Tank Division of the Korean People’s Army early in January 2009. He had since visited Wonsan, Taean, Kiyang, the light industry factories of Pyongyang and the KPA units in a snowstorm. He called at myriads of units without so much as taking a rest on high days and holidays, too. In those days he inspired our people with the indomitable spirit of Mt Paektu and roused them to great action. They worked with all their might true to his ideas, thus winning signal victories in their struggle and performing miracles to the world’s astonishment. Our people will tell posterity forever that he devoted himself wholly to national security and prosperity, firmly defended the socialist country and laid the firm foundations for everlasting national prgress and prosperity. The history of Kim Jong Il will last forever and our country will surely develop into a dignified, strong and prosperous socialist country under the judicious leadership of respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Title of Labor Hero of DPRK Awarded to Officials of Merit
body: The title of Labor Hero of the DPRK and Gold Medal (Hammer and Sickle) and Order of National Flag 1st Class were awarded to Kang Song Il, Jang Tong Gil, Kye Chol Nam, Sin Song Chol, Sin Myong Son, Kim Hui Ok and Rim Yong Ok. They performed brilliant feats in the struggle for building monumental edifices of the age of the Workers' Party by displaying boundless loyalty and devotion to the Party and the revolution and made a great contribution to economic construction and improving the people's standard of living by powerfully enlisting the people in the struggle to implement the Party's ideas and defend its policies by means of their skilled political work and by dint of self-reliance and science and technology. A relevant decree of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK was issued on March 24. Rodong Sinmun

title: Title of Hero of DPRK Awarded to Hwang Chol
body: Hwang Chol was awarded the title of Hero of the DPRK and Gold Star Medal and Order of National Flag 1st Class. He has devoted his noble life to the sacred struggle to safeguard the revolutionary gains and people's lives and properties with a high sense of duty to defend the leader, social system and people. A relevant decree of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK was issued on March 24. Rodong Sinmun

title: Order of Kim Il Sung to An Il Rak
body: Order of Kim Il Sung was conferred on An Il Rak on the occasion of the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, the Day of the Sun. Serving as a party information worker for a long time, he intensified the ideological education aimed at arming Party members and other working people with the great Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism and powerfully encouraged shock brigade members to implement the Party policies, conducting front-line information and agitation activities by displaying the revolutionary traits of setting a personal example on construction sites. He, therefore, made a great contribution to building splendid monumental edifices of the age of the Workers' Party. A relevant decree of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK was issued on March 24. Rodong Sinmun

title: Week of Film Show Opens to Celebrate Day of Sun
body: A week of film show has been opened to celebrate the Day of the Sun, birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Documentary films dealing with the revolutionary career and exploits of the President and revolutionary films such as "Star of Korea" and "The Sun of the Nation" are set to be shown at cinemas and halls of culture in Pyongyang and local areas. Feature films on various themes which depict the high ideological and mental traits of the Korean people and service personnel and their true outlook on life will also be shown. An opening-ceremony took place at the Pyongyang International Cinema House on April 9. Present there were officials concerned, officials in the film sector, creative workers and artistes and working people in Pyongyang City. At the end of the ceremony, the participants watched the documentary film "Our Leader Praised by All People." Similar events were opened in every province on the same day. Rodong Sinmun

title: Technical Forces Strengthened First of All
body: The Hungnam Fertilizer Complex considers that the normalization of its production lies mainly in the active application of science and technology and tries hard to that end. This meets with success. For example, it mass-produces as much fertilizer as possible by increasing its available gas content. A program for the separation of carbon dioxide was developed anew to that end and an idea of raising the rate of its actual hydrogen yield was hit on and carried out without delay. Consequently, the HFC has become able to produce more hydrogen than before and help toward increasing the output of its fertilizer less energy, labor and cost. The HFC contrived and applied valuable technological innovations. The result was that it could register high results in its fertilizer production with its existing machines without replacing them with the good ones which were made or secured anew. While going out to integrate its production with science and technology the HFC got to actively vitalize its production with its technology. Rodong Sinmun

title: Thorough Measures Taken for Irrigation Water Supply
body: South Hwanghae Province makes endeavors to satisfactorily irrigate the fields of its cooperative farms this year. It adopts active measures to irrigate its reclaimed tideland. It speedily builds water channels as far as the latter’s paddy fields because last year its irrigation system was ameliorated, its irrigation setups were maintained, its agricultural waterway was readjusted, its irrigational structures were repaired and the levees of its rice paddies were bettered. The province plans to establish the satisfactory irrigation system for Kangryong and Ongjin Counties to raise crops there well and concentrates its powers on it. The officials and working people of the counties concerned finished building their water channels and pumping stations by dint of hard work. Irrigation projects are carried out in the tideland to enable a bumper harvest to be reaped there this year from the outset. In the province water channels are successfully cleaned out and irrigational structures repaired well so that much water can flow per unit hour. The province arranged for pumps in detail to be produced. Its city and county irrigation control offices lay the foundations for repairing their pumping equipment on their own. As a result, the farmland of the province, the target of ample irrigation, continues to grow in area. Rodong Sinmun

title: Performance Given to Commemorate 6th Conference of Party Cell Secretaries
body: A performance was given at the April 25 House of Culture on April 10 and 11 to commemorate the 6th Conference of Cell Secretaries of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). The venue of the performance was overflowing with great joy and excitement of the participants in the conference to see a significant performance after glorifying the conference, the sixth of its kind in the history of our glorious Party as an occasion of an epochal turn in consolidating the cornerstone of strengthening the whole Party and its unity and as a significant conference to be recorded in the history of Juche-oriented Party building. Among the audience were officials of the Central Committee of the WPK. The performance given by artistes of the band of the State Affairs Commission, the State Merited Chorus and major art troupes was divided into two parts. Put on the stage of the performance, which started with the overture instrumental music and song "Our National Flag" and "The Patriotic Song", were such numbers as male trio and chorus "Oh Party, It's Thanks to Your Care" and male solo "O Mother Party which Protected My Destiny" and "I Will Remain Your Son Forever" and instrumental music and serial songs "We Sing of the Party". The audience was gripped by the numbers giving an impressive artistic representation of the course of heroic struggle covered by the WPK that has brought about unprecedented miracles and epochal changes on this land, always relying on the popular masses and inspiring them. The performers sang highly of the immortal exploits of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il who set forth the unique line of Party building and the idea of giving importance to the basic organizations and developed the WPK into invincible militant General Staff, the Juche-oriented revolutionary Party which took deep roots among the popular masses. The venue resounded with songs "Opening My Heart" and "Voice of My Heart" reflecting the people's deep reverence for the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un who is ushering in the genuine era of the people by glorifying the WPK as the great mother Party, in which the idea of making selfless, devoted efforts for the good of the people prevails, after setting the people-first politics as a political ideology and his motto. When performers sang the song "Fly High, Our Party Flag", the audience felt their hearts being filled with the great pride of holding aloft the red Party flag of Juche towards the peak of communism. Mixed chorus "We Will Follow Our Party Forever" and male chorus "Let's Defend Socialism" aroused revolutionary enthusiasm of the Party cell secretaries to fully discharge their responsibility and duty in the grand struggle for achieving the overall development of our own-style socialism by becoming advancing group members in implementing Party policies, standard-bearers of the revolution. Song and dance "This Country Is So Good", dance "Golden Ears of Grain Sways" and mixed chorus and male chorus "My Prospering Country" reflected the great pride of our people realizing the beautiful dream and ideal under the unfurled banner of achieving prosperity by dint of self-reliance, greatly exciting the audience for their fascinating and peculiar artistic depiction. Singing along to the song "The Voice of the Mother," the words of which were personally written by the respected General Secretary on the letter from a Party cell secretary in token of his great trust in and affection for the Party cell secretaries, the audience kept in mind once again the earnest appeal of the General Secretary who called for redoubling efforts to serve the people. A narrative poem "What Makes the Workers' Party of Korea Strong!" helped the audience look back on the undying history of our Party that has made every effort to strengthen the Party cells since its foundation. The poem made the audience understand the great philosophy that the strengthening of the Party cell is just the one of our Party and the role of the Party cell precisely means the leadership and fighting efficiency of our Party. The performance reached its climax when serial songs for orchestra and male chorus "We Will Go along Road of Loyalty" and "We'll Travel One Road Forever" were given. This number reflected the steadfast faith of the Party members and all other people to always follow the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un along the road of revolution just as they did invariably in the days of hardship and happiness. The performance ended with the finale "Glory to Workers' Party of Korea" and "Glory to General Kim Jong Un", song and dance, which showed the irresistible might of our Party that is enjoying the absolute support and trust of the people and which demonstrated the brave spirit of our people dynamically advancing towards a bright future, firmly united behind the Party. Through the performance, the participants in the conference hardened their revolutionary will to further strengthen the Party cells into healthy and viable Party cells closely knitted in the bonds of kinship, regarding as an asset of their life the great trust of the Party Central Committee that called the Party cell secretaries hardcore of the hardcore of our Party and unassuming heroes of the unassuming heroes. All the participants in the conference were full of enthusiasm to demonstrate the dignity and invincible might of the great Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Party all over the world and make new innovations and progress in implementing the decisions of the 8th Congress of the WPK by enhancing the militant function and role of Party cells in every way, true to the important tasks set forth by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un at the 6th Conference of Cell Secretaries of the WPK. Rodong Sinmun

title: Enlarged Session of Plenary Meeting of Cabinet Held
body: The enlarged session of the plenary meeting of the Cabinet took place through video teleconferencing on April 11. Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and premier of the Cabinet, guided the session. Present there were Vice Premiers Pak Jong Gun and Jon Hyon Chol and other members of the Cabinet. Attending it in observer's capacity were officials of organizations directly under the Cabinet and those of ministries, chairpersons of provincial, city and county people's committees and those of institutions for agricultural guidance, and major factories and enterprises. The session reviewed the work done by the Cabinet for the first quarter of this year to thoroughly carry out the decisions made at the 8th Congress of the WPK and the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the WPK. A report was made by Pak Jong Gun, vice premier who is also chairman of the State Planning Commission. The report said that since the 8th Congress of the Party and the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the WPK, the Cabinet has carried out economic operation and commanding with a main emphasis put on readjusting and reinforcing the production foundation and on the sustained production growth, guided by the economic strategy of the WPK. He stressed that the work was pushed forward to put together creative ideas for solving issues arising in the reality, readjust the economic work system and order and provide systematic and legitimate conditions favorable for business activities of enterprises. It was mentioned in the report that production surge was effected in factories and enterprises in the metal and chemical industrial fields, collective innovation was witnessed in electric power, coal and building materials industries and railway and transport fields and a series of achievements was made in developing local economy in an independent and multi-lateral way. The report cited facts to analyze and review the shortcomings and deviations observed in implementing the plan for the first quarter of the first year of the new five-year plan, and stressed the need for economic guidance organs to wage powerful struggle against the acts of avoiding responsibilities and approaching the implementation of the plan in a formalistic way. The report emphasized that the officials should significantly raise their responsibility and role and consistently push forward the work for bringing about a substantial change and advance in the overall economic work for this year on which hinges the success in the implementation of the decisions made at the 8th Congress of the Party. It also proposed appropriate measures for it. Speeches were made at the conference. The speakers made resolutions to set up strict disciplines and order of accurately carrying out the plans given to them, ensure maximum production and economization and guarantee evident progress in accomplishing the plan for the second quarter of the year, out of high awareness that they are fully responsible for the work of their own fields and units before the Party and the state. The session made an in-depth discussion of the issue of pushing ahead with the major projects important for materializing the adjustment strategy and reinforcement strategy as planned, the issue of activating the production of consumer goods by actively exploring and enlisting reserves and possibilities, the issue of increasing the role of science and technology in railway modernization and in the economy as a whole, etc. The session also underlined the need for all the officials to fully display initiative and progressive spirit and ingenuity in the work and more firmly maintain revolutionary attitude and stand of braving manifold difficulties and obstacles through mutual support and cooperation. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Photo Exhibition Held
body: A national photo exhibition "Undying Footprints of Devoted Service for People's Well-being" opened with due ceremony at the People's Palace of Culture Sunday to celebrate the 9th anniversary of upholding the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un at the top post of our Party and the state. Displayed at the exhibition hall were photos documenting the undying exploits performed by Kim Jong Un. There are photos including the one "The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un clarifying revolutionary line for waging head-on charge as required by the present reality and the developing revolution at the 5th Plenary Meeting of the 7th Central Committee of WPK" which show the personality of the General Secretary as a great man as he has set forth the most scientific line and strategic and tactical policies for advancing our revolution straight along the path of victory and provided wise organization and leadership for their implementation. There are also photos dealing with the revolutionary leadership of the respected General Secretary leading the emergency anti-epidemic drive, visiting the sites for recovery from flood damage and expediting the bright future of a powerful socialist country while making continued guidance day and night for the economic construction and improvement of the people's standard of life. The exhibits also included photos showing the exploits made by the illustrious commander of Mt Paektu who has steadily developed the People's Army into the elite revolutionary army. Other photos show brave spirit and viable appearance of our people, all out in the general advance for ensuring dramatic advance in socialist construction, closely rallied around the Party in single mind and intention, and proud development of the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Short Course for Participants in 6th Conference of Cell Secretaries of WPK Given
body: A short course for participants in the 6th Conference of Cell Secretaries of the Workers' Party of Korea was given from April 9 to 11. The short course comprehensively dealt with practical matters to decisively enhance the work traits, militant ability and fighting ability of all the Party cells to the level desired by the Party Central Committee by brilliantly carrying forward the revolutionary spirit and fighting tradition peculiar to the Workers' Party of Korea, true to the basic idea of the Conference. The course was given amid active and high enthusiasm of the participants to grasp the essence of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's idea of attaching importance to the Party cells and his line of strengthening the cells and their validity, and to acquire concrete methods for further raising the function and role of the cells so as to adopt innovative way of thinking and work attitude and effect a fresh turn in the cell work. Stressed with importance during the short course was a matter of building Party cells into the vanguard organizations in which the unified leadership system of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un is firmly established. The lecturers said that the work of establishing the unified leadership system of the General Secretary is the most important work facing our revolution to which all the organizations of the whole Party including Party cells should put primary efforts and that there can never be perfection in this work and there must never be even an inch of concession and deviation in it. They called for conducting education in the loyalty for the leaders and in their greatness in an offensive way, properly carrying out education so that loyalty for the Party results in practical achievements in the work and establishing within the Party cells the revolutionary discipline by which work is done only according to the idea and intention of the General Secretary. It was also mentioned in the course to prepare the Party members to be reliable Kimilsungist-Kimjongilists by strengthening the work of organizing and guiding their Party life. The course dealt with the issue for the Party cell secretaries to give meticulous guidance over the Party organizational life with a main emphasis put on tempering the Party spirit of Party members and on implementing the Party's policies and accomplishing main revolutionary tasks entrusted to their own units, the issue of arming the Party members with the revolutionary idea of our Party and arousing them to implementing the Party's decisions by putting efforts into strengthening their Party ideological life, and the issue of conducting more dynamically the work to make the Party cells loyal cells and help them glorifying their honor of being loyal cells. The lecturers underlined the need to make Party cells stones supporting the citadel of single-minded unity by putting great efforts into the work with the masses. Also stressed was the need for the Party cell secretaries to correctly evaluate the present life of people and take motherly care of them, and to intensify the struggle against anti-socialist and non-socialist practices and thus turn Party cells into revolutionary posts standing firm guard over our own-style socialism. Emphasized was the need for the Party cell secretaries to enshrine deep in mind the respected General Secretary's noble idea of "The People Are God" and "Devoted Service for the People's Wellbeing", and to become roots and foundations in rallying the broad masses closer around the General Secretary and in consolidating our revolutionary position, the class position. The short course also dealt with the issue to direct the focus of the work of the Party cells into strengthening them into ranks of vanguard fighters for implementing the Party's policies. Mentioned during the course were the methodological issues for the Party cell secretaries to adopt the Party cell decisions for mobilizing cell members into realistic actions to consistently and thoroughly carry out the Party policies, and to play the role of standard-bearers and vanguard fighters of the ranks by steadily enhancing their political and work level and capabilities as required by the developing reality. The lecturers called for upholding the respected General Secretary with revolutionary conscience and obligations, while calling for more dynamically waging the work to establish socialist moral traits. They also underlined the need for the Party cell secretaries to take the lead in establishing noble moral traits among people, adopting sound and civilized lifestyle in society and working conscientiously and devotedly for the Party, the revolution, the state and society. Exchanging and sharing achievements and experiences, gained in the work of Party cells, during the short course, the participants directed their thinking and search to finding out distinct goals for effecting fundamental innovation in the Party cell work as intended by the General Secretary, and ways for doing so. The short course helped the participants to be more deeply aware of with what unusual resolution, determination and spirit they should exert themselves in order to live and struggle as standard-bearers and vanguard fighters in the great revolutionary work unfolded by our Party. All the participants were full of enthusiasm to enshrine deep in their minds the important tasks for strengthening the Party cells and key traits to be possessed by the Party cell secretaries, set forth by the General Secretary, and fully embody them in practical activities and make the Party cells healthy and viable ones closely knitted in the bonds of kinship and thus contribute to boosting the cohesion and militancy of the whole Party in every way. Rodong Sinmun

title: 9th Anniversary of Upholding Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un at Top Post of Party and State Celebrated
body: People across the country significantly celebrated the 9th anniversary of upholding the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un at the top post of the Party and state. Upholding Kim Jong Un at the top post of the Party and state in April, Juche 101 (2012) was a manifestation of absolute trust in and boundless loyalty to him of all the Party members and other people in the DPRK, and a great revolutionary event which provided a sure guarantee to the victory of our own-style socialism and its rosy future. On this significant occasion, visual aids with such letters as "The Fortune of Kim Il Sung's Nation, Kim Jong Il's Korea" and "Great Revolutionary Event" were displayed with flowers in full bloom in different parts of Pyongyang, adding festive mood. Central art squads and itinerant art squads and art circles in Pyongyang gave open-air performances in different parts of the city. Itinerant art squads and art circles of various factories and districts also performed at public places in front of the Pyongyang Grand Theatre, Pyongyang Circus Theater, Ryomyong Street Cinema, etc. in the city. Similar performances were given in North Phyongan, South Phyongan, South Hwanghae, Jagang, Kangwon, South Hamgyong and other provinces. Rodong Sinmun

title: Centenarian Receives Birthday Spread
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un sent a birthday spread to Ri Kum Ok, a woman living in Songpha-ri, Tanchon City of South Hamgyong Province on her 100th birth anniversary. When receiving the spread, Ri said that she, who was born into a fire-field peasant family in Yonsa County of North Hamgyong Province during the dark period of the Japanese imperialists' colonial rule, couldn't forget those days when she lost her parents in her early years and keenly experienced the sorrow of being a member of a stateless nation, adding with deep emotion that she came to have led a healthy and happy life in the era of the Workers' Party. She still likes working, enjoying her life in good health and happiness under the care of officials of power body, doctors and villagers. Rodong Sinmun

title: President Kim Il Sung's Exploits Praised Abroad
body: Seminars on the exploits of President Kim Il Sung took place in Russia, Nepal, DR Congo and Mexico from March 21 to 31 ahead of his birth anniversary. Present there were personages of political parties and public organizations and Juche idea followers of those countries, members of organizations for friendship and solidarity with the Korean people and figures of the International Institute of the Juche Idea. The first secretary of the Sakhalin Regional Branch Committee of the Lenin Young Communist League of the Russian Federation praised Kim Il Sung as a great politician, great general and eternal president of the DPRK, noting that he founded the Juche idea, liberated the country and nation from the Japanese imperialists' colonial rule and built a socialist paradise with people as its master on the land of Korea. Personages from Nepalese political parties and organizations spoke highly of the President's ideo-theoretical exploits and his whole life devoted to the people, lauding him as an outstanding leader of the global socialist movement. The chairman of the National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of Democratic Congo stressed that the immortal Juche idea founded by President Kim Il Sung is recognized as wealth notable in the history of human thought. He said that thanks to the Juche idea, the DPRK was able to defend socialism in the face of turmoil caused by the collapse of socialism in eastern European countries and emerge a powerful country admired by the world people. A congratulatory message to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un was adopted at an event held in Nepal. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Basket to Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un from Palestinian President
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a floral basket from Mahmoud Abbas, president of the State of Palestine, on the occasion of the Day of the Sun (birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung). The floral basket was handed over to Foreign Minister Ri Son Gwon by Ismail Ahmed Mohamed Hasan, Palestinian ambassador to the DPRK, on April 12. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Floral Basket and Congratulatory Letter from Diplomatic Corps Here
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a floral basket and congratulatory letter from the diplomatic corps here on the occasion of the Day of the Sun (birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung). They were handed over to Foreign Minister Ri Son Gwon by Ismail Ahmed Mohamed Hasan, Palestinian ambassador to the DPRK who is doyen of the diplomatic corps, on April 12. Rodong Sinmun

title: Sincerity
body: The employees of the Park and Recreation Ground Management Station of Phyongchon District refurbish the resting place for the people better than ever with their whole heart. They are happy to envision that working people will have a good time there. Moreover, they confirm their determination to take good care of the parks and recreation grounds built under the benevolent care of the Party and provide the people with civilized living conditions. As always they apply themselves to their work remaining indifferent to public acknowledgement and regard it as worthy and joyous. Consequently, our environment is so beautiful and full of the joy of the people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Rivers Bettered Vigorously
body: Officials and workers across the country go out to administer land this year with the outset of another five-year plan. They improve the conditions of its rivers and streams admirably with burning patriotism to prevent them against flood damages and change their looks completely. Many units have already finished digging up the beds of the rivers according to the plan for the general mobilization for spring land management. Mangyongdae and Ryokpho Districts and Kangdong County fulfilled their land administration plans. Phihyon County excavated the beds of its two rivers at the same time. Nyongbyon County successfully dug up its river under the plan for the general mobilization for spring land administration. Songchon County ceaselessly makes great efforts to better its river this year. It formulated a scientific plan for the project and made good preparations for it drawing on the successes and experiences it gained in the past. Consequently, it has carried out the project in a planned way. Phyongwon County responsibly and successively ameliorated the upper course of the Pothong River. To this end it gave precedence to the relevant design and arranged for the riparian work to be done effectively by way of demonstration. The officials and workers of Tokchon County try their hardest every day to manage its land. Koksan County concentrated its labor on its riparian work and finished excavating the bed of its river within six days although it took it more than a fortnight in the past. The officials and workers of Tonghungsan District, Hamhung City and Hongwon and Pukchong Counties dug out the beds of their rivers deep by dint of hard work. Other cities, counties and districts also focus their energies on putting their rivers to rights excellently. Successes are registered continuously in river improvement projects. Rodong Sinmun

title: Cement Mass-produced for Dwellings and Factories under Construction
body: The Sangwon Cement Complex is all out to come up to the expectation of the Workers’ Party of Korea with loyalty. Its managerial staff make a breakthrough in the increased production of the SCC’s cement organizing and directing its economic affairs adroitly on a scientific basis and unraveling the knotty problems of its major shops in their separate charge opportunely on their responsibility. The controllers of the SCC’s central control room monitor the operation of all its production processes in real time rationally controlling all the processes of the shops concerned ranging from the feeding of raw materials to the delivery of products in close liaison with them. The workers of the SCC’s cementkiln shop take scientific and technological care of their kilns in proportion to the supply of raw materials, fuel and electricity and put them in full operation to energize a main link in the whole chain of their SCC’s production. The result is that each of their shifts overfulfills its daily plan. At the cement shop of the SCC senior skilled workers actively help other junior skilled workers to improve their technological knowledge and skills. Its employees also secure necessary accessories beforehand responsibly take technological care of their machines, thereby mass-producing quality cement. The auxiliary shops of the SCC do their utmost to secure raw materials and fuel for its production. Rodong Sinmun

title: Letter to Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un from Teaching Staff and Students of Korean University
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un was presented with a letter by teaching staff and students of the Korean University on April 10. The letter said that they held a meeting for conveying the congratulatory message personally sent by Kim Jong Un to the teaching staff and students of the Korean University on the occasion of its 65th founding anniversary. It said that the 65 year-long history covered by the University which was born and developed under the care of the great leaders President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il represent the history of compatriotism and patriotism of the peerlessly great persons for the education of future generations of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon). It stressed that Kim Jong Un, who carried forward the intention of the great leaders just as it is, spared his precious time, though he was busy leading the Juche cause, to have a photo taken with the teaching staff and students of the University, and bestowed such great loving care as reading the humble letter presented by the students during their visit to the homeland. As there have been the leadership and loving care shown by Kim Il Sung, Kim Jong Il and Kim Jong Un, the Korean University could bring up students to be genuine talents of the nation who have firmly established the Juche ideological and leadership system and pillars who would carry forward the patriotic cause and could make contribution to strengthening the movement of Koreans in Japan for the past 65 years, the letter stressed. They pledged in the letter that they would enshrine the message full of trust sent by Kim Jong Un who is supporting the Korean University to make a fresh leaping progress, and would remain loyal only to Kim Jong Un, the sun of Juche Korea, with their destiny entrusted to him, no matter how wild storm may blow in the alien land and how many times the world may change. The letter added that all the students of the University would study harder and harder with far-reaching ambition, beautiful dream and ideal, bearing deep in mind the mission that they are responsible for the future of Chongryon and the movement of Koreans in Japan, and prepare themselves to be pillars of the patriotic cause who are transparent in faith and ready to sacrifice themselves to the organization and the collective. The letter wished Kim Jong Un, destiny of the country, the nation, Chongryon and the Koreans in Japan, and fatherly leader of all the teaching staff and students of the University, good health from the bottom of their hearts. Rodong Sinmun

title: State Academic Degrees and Titles Conferred on Intellectuals
body: State academic degrees and titles were conferred on intellectuals on the occasion of the Day of the Sun (birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung). They made achievements in researches conducive to the economic development and improvement of the people's standard of living, and made contributions to the education of the rising generations. Professorship was conferred on 18 intellectuals including O Chon Il, dean of a faculty of Kim Il Sung University, Kim Kum Nam, vice-rector of Kim Il Sung University, Kim Ryong Jin and Jon Mi Yong, teachers of Kim Il Sung University, Kim Tok Su, director of an institute of Kim Chaek University of Technology, Pak Yong Hui, teacher of Pyongyang Han Tok Su University of Light Industry, Pak Song Nam, researcher of the University of National Economy, and Wi Kwang Nam, section chief of the Academy of Social Sciences. Doctorate went to 56 persons including Pak Chol Myong, department head of Kim Il Sung University, Mun Chang Hyok and An Ye Gyong, teachers of Kim Chaek University of Technology, Kim Hyok, department head of Kim Hyong Jik University of Education, O Hung Son, section chief of Pyongyang University of Architecture, Ji Hak, department head of Pyongyang University of Mechanical Engineering, Hwang Sun Nam, deputy chief engineer of the Chollima Steel Complex, Kim Jong Son, chief engineer of the Tokchon Area Coal-Mining Complex, and Ryom Jong Suk, vice-director of the North Phyongan Provincial People's Hospital. Also, 113 persons received associate professorship and 733 persons received master's degree. Rodong Sinmun

title: Special Performance Given by Kumgang-san Opera Troupe of Chongryon in Tokyo
body: A special performance "Vernal Fragrance" was given by the Kumgang-san Opera Troupe of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) in Tokyo, Japan, on April 7. Among the audience were Pak Ku Ho, first vice-chairman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee and director of its Organization Department, and other vice-chairpersons, the head of the Kumgang-san Opera Troupe, the chairperson of the association for supporting the troupe, chairpersons of the Chongryon headquarters in Kanto, other Chongryon officials and compatriots. Put on the stage were colorful numbers praising President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un and those reflecting the love for the homeland and the nation. Performers impressively represented the earnest feelings of Chongryon officials and Koreans in Japan yearning for Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il who devoted their all to the country and the people all their life and performed immortal exploits in the cause of Juche and the movement of Koreans in Japan. The performance showed well the indomitable faith and strong spirit of Chongryon officials and Koreans in Japan determined to go along the road of patriotism to the last under the leadership of Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Congratulatory Message Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sent to Teaching Staff and Students of Korean University Conveyed
body: A meeting for conveying a congratulatory message sent by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un to the teaching staff and students of Korean University on the occasion of its 65th founding anniversary was held in the lecture hall of the university in Tokyo on April 10. Present there were Pak Ku Ho, first vice-chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) and concurrently director of its Organization Department, Song Kun Hak, vice-chairman and concurrently director of the Education Department, Han Tong Song, rector of the university, and its teaching staff and students. The message sent by Kim Jong Un was conveyed by First Vice-Chairman Pak Ku Ho. A letter to Kim Jong Un was read out at the meeting. Rodong Sinmun

title: Performance by Art Squad of C.C., Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea Commemorates Day of Sun
body: A Performance of the art squad of the Central Committee of the Union of Agricultural Workers was given in Sampong Co-op Farm, Phyongwon County on Monday to commemorate the 109th anniversary of the birth of President Kim Il Sung. Chorus "Let's Sing of the Day of the Sun", dialogic poem "The Leader's Life", female solo "We Can't Forget All Kinds of Hardships Underwent by Leader" and other numbers praised the revolutionary career and exploits of President Kim Il Sung who provided the undying program for settling the socialist rural questions for the first time in history and worked heart and soul for the agricultural development of the country. Mixed duet "A Dear Nam" and mixed quartet "My Prospering Country" touched the heartstrings of the audience as they represented immortal leadership by Chairman Kim Jong Il to firmly defend our socialist country, the heritage bequeathed by the President out of patriotism and make eternal foundation for the prosperity of the generations. Female solo "Oh, Tender-hearted Father", female trio "Our Dear Marshal" and other numbers convinced the audience that immensely bright and rosy is the future of our style socialism as there is the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. Watching the performance were Han Jong Hyok, chairman of the Central Committee of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea, officials concerned and agricultural workers in Phyongwon County. Rodong Sinmun

title: More Youths in DPRK Volunteer to Work at Major Economic Worksites
body: More than 1 000 officials of the youth league, working youths and students of the graduating class of universities and senior middle schools in North Hamgyong Province volunteered to work in major worksites for economic construction, and schools on islets in forefront areas and in remote mountain villages. Cha Chung Hyok, who had been working at the North Hamgyong Provincial Youth League Committee, volunteered to work at the Jungphyong Vegetable Greenhouse Farm associated with leadership feats of the Party and Thae Hak Chol, an official of the Myongchon County Youth League Committee, to work in a rural area with patriotic enthusiasm. Following their examples, a large number of youths in the province volunteered to work in rural areas with ardor to become core and pillars in building up rural outposts of socialism and to join the provincial youth shock brigades. Dozens of students of graduating class of universities volunteered to teach children on islets in forefront areas and in remote mountain villages. Enthusiasm among the youth in the province to volunteer to devote their patriotic efforts to implementing the decisions of the Party Congress is getting stronger with each passing day. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Has Photo Session with Participants in 6th Conference of Cell Secretaries of WPK
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), had a photo session with the participants in the 6th Conference of Cell Secretaries of the WPK on April 13. Attending the session were Jo Yong Won, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and secretary for Organizational Affairs of the Party Central Committee, and Jong Sang Hak and Ri Il Hwan, secretaries of the Party Central Committee, Kim Jae Ryong and O Il Jong, department directors of the Party Central Committee, and Kwon Yong Jin, director of the General Political Bureau of the Korean People's Army. The venue of the photo session was full of great reverence and trust of the participants in the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un who energetically guided the 6th Conference of Cell Secretaries to make it an occasion for epoch-making advance in the strengthening of the whole Party by indicating the undying great programme for consolidating the fighting efficiency and power of Party cells in every way, and repeatedly bestowed upon them unforgettable loving care and trust which will be conveyed down through generations. When Kim Jong Un appeared at the venue, all the participants raised stormy cheers of "Hurrah!", extending the highest glory to him who has further strengthened our Party into the powerful militant General Staff of the revolution, the invincible steel-strong Party taking a firm hold upon people's minds, and into the great mother party with the people-first principle as its lifeline with his rare and outstanding leadership. Waving back to the enthusiastically cheering participants, he extended warm and encouraging respects. Expressing his belief that all the cell secretaries, bearing deep in mind the idea of strengthening the Party cells and achieving unity in the Party cells, and tasks set forth in the Conference, would make redoubled efforts to further strengthen hundreds of thousands of Party cells into healthy and viable ones closely knitted in the bonds of kinship, advance groups for implementing the Party policy which would dynamically promote the on-going general advance, he had a photo taken with them against the venue of the conference. All the participants refreshed their iron will to make positive contributions to bringing earlier a fresh victory of the socialist construction by decisively implementing the decisions of the 8th Party Congress, extending their deep gratitude to the respected General Secretary who encourages secretaries of party cells to fulfill their honorable mission and duty as core members of our Party. Political News Team

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Educational Aid Fund and Stipends for Children of Koreans in Japan
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un sent 219.06 million yen to the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) as educational aid fund and stipends for democratic national education of the children of Koreans in Japan ahead of the 109th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. The educational aid fund and stipends sent by President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and Kim Jong Un total 48 879 390 390 yen in 167 installments. Rodong Sinmun

title: Civilian Defence Revolutionary Museum Opens
body: The Civilian Defence Revolutionary Museum opened ahead of the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. The museum comprehensively deals with the revolutionary history of the peerlessly great men who provided and glorified the sacred history and tradition of building the Juche-based militia forces, and with the militant course of the civilian defence forces which have performed exploits under the guidance of the Party. The revolutionary museum will serve as a powerful educational center for adding eternal glory to the undying exploits of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, the founder and builder of the Juche-oriented civilian forces, and for educating the Party members and other working people in the greatness of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, who is ushering in a new history of strengthening the civilian defence forces, and in the Juche-based idea and policy of the Party on civilian defence. An opening ceremony took place on April 13. Attending it were Ri Pyong Chol, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), vice-chairman of the Party Central Military Commission and secretary of the Party Central Committee, O Il Jong and Kang Sun Nam, department directors of the Party Central Committee, officials in the field of civilian defence, commanding officers and members of the Worker-Peasant Red Guards in Pyongyang City, officials of the units and shock brigade members involved in the construction, and employees of the museum. Before the ceremony, the participants made a bow before the portraits of the smiling President and Chairman at the lobby of the museum after laying a floral basket in the name of the Worker-Peasant Red Guards. Ri Pyong Chol made an opening address. At the end of the ceremony, the participants looked round the museum. Rodong Sinmun

title: His Noble View on the Rising Generation
body: President Kim Il Sung regarded children as the kings or queens of the country, loved them fervently and made them the happiest in the world. This has not been found yet in any other country. The Pyongyang Students and Children’s Palace is the epitome of his love for children. Despite the post-war difficulties of the country he saw to it that the PSCP was built on Jangdae Hill, the best site of Pyongyang. He checked up the design for the PSCP presented by officials. He suggested building it for children more splendidly on a larger scale than the planned palace. He arranged for the PSCP to be planned so that it could be built on the ground 50 000 square meters or over six times larger in area than the designed one. Being the greatest of all great men, he alone could courageously decide to do that for our children. When he was present at the opening ceremony of the PSCP, he looked at it again and again. He said that its floorage was very large enough to be equal to the floor space of several machine-building plants together and that millions of won was disbursed for the construction of the PSCP. He added with warmth and great satisfaction that nothing had to be spared to bring up schoolchildren well. Thanks to his noble view of the rising generation, the children enjoyed happiness and fully realized their ambitions in the country. Comrade Kim Jong Un remains true to the intention of Kim Il Sung’s infinite love for the children of the country. Consequently, the song “We Are the Happiest in the World” is still resounding far and wide year after year despite the passage of time. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Floral Basket and Congratulatory Letter from Military Attaches Corps Here
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a floral basket and congratulatory letter from the military attaches corps here on the occasion of the Day of the Sun (birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung). They were handed over to an official concerned by the military attache of the Vietnam embassy who is doyen of the military attaches corps, on April 13. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Baskets to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il from Abroad
body: Floral baskets were sent to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill by foreign personages and bodies on the occasion of the Day of the Sun (birth anniversary of Kim Il Sung). They include the family of Ryang Song Ryong, a Korean anti-Japanese revolutionary martyr in China, the family of Kim Sun Ok who is related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, the families of Zhou Baozhong, Chen Lei, Feng Zhongyun, Chai Shiying, Jie Qing, Hu Zhenyi and Jiang Zihua, Chinese related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, the family of Ya. T. Nobichenko who was an internationalist soldier, the Anti-imperialist Forum of Germany and Giancarlo Elia Valori, president of the International Group of Italy. The floral baskets were laid before the statues on April 13. On the same day, floral baskets in the name of missions of international organizations here were laid before the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Floral Baskets and Congratulatory Letters from Foreign Diplomatic Envoys
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a floral basket and congratulatory letter from the Indonesian ambassador to the DPRK on the occasions of the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (Day of the Sun) and the 56th anniversary of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il's visit to Indonesia. They were conveyed to an official concerned on April 13. On the same day, Kim Jong Un received floral baskets and congratulatory letters from the Indian and Vietnamese ambassadors to the DPRK on the occasion of the Day of the Sun. Rodong Sinmun

title: Matriculation Ceremony of Korean University of Chongryon Held
body: A matriculation ceremony of Korean University of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) for the academic year Juche 110 (2021) took place at the university hall in Tokyo on April 10. Attending the ceremony were Pak Ku Ho, first vice-chairman of the Central Standing Committee of Chongryon and director of its Organization Department, and other vice-chairpersons, Han Tong Song, rector of the university, Hong Nam Gi, director of the board of trustees of the university, the freshmen, their parents and the teaching staff of the university. Congratulatory messages from the homeland, including the one from the Education Commission of the DPRK, were read out at the ceremony. Pak Ku Ho made a congratulatory address. Han Tong Song made a report, which was followed by oath-taking speeches. Rodong Sinmun

title: Kim Il Sung Youth Honor Prize, Kim Il Sung Children Honor Prize Awarded
body: Kim Il Sung Youth Honor Prize and Kim Il Sung Children Honor Prize were awarded to exemplary primary youth league committees, youth league officials and members and children's union members on the occasion of the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (Day of the Sun). According to a decree of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, Kim Il Sung Youth Honor Prize went to 23 primary youth league committees and 22 youth league officials and members. They turned their youth league organizations into reliable ranks of the youth vanguard and distinguished themselves in adding shine to the honor of the advancing group in defending the country and building a powerful socialist nation and in study and organizational life. Kim Il Sung Children Honor Prize went to 105 children's union members who distinguished themselves in study, organizational life, socio-political activities and do-good-thing movement. Rodong Sinmun

title: Korean Book, Photo Exhibition Opens in Russia
body: A Korean book and photo exhibition opened at the hall of culture of Partizansk City, Russia on April 9 on the occasions of the 109th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung and the 2nd anniversary of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's visit to the Russian Federation. On display at its venue were photos showing the revolutionary career of the President and those dealing with Kim Jong Un's visit to Russia. Also displayed there were works of the President, Chairman Kim Jong Il and Kim Jong Un, and Korean books and photos. Present at its opening ceremony were personages of the city administration, the city branch of the United Russia Party and the city committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation, the DPRK consul general and consuls in Vladivostok, and others. Participants laid bouquets before photos of President Kim Il Sung and the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un. Congratulatory speeches were made. Meanwhile, a ceremony of donating Korean books was held at the city hall of culture on the same day. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Photo Exhibition Opens to Commemorate Day of Sun
body: A national photo exhibition "Always Finding Himself among People" opened to commemorate the 109th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (the Day of the Sun). On display at the venue of the exhibition were photos showing the revolutionary exploits and popular traits of the President. Displayed there were photos showing the loving care of the President who projected the workers as the eldest son of the country and performers of miracles and feats. Also on display are photos dealing with devotion and painstaking efforts made by the President who ceaselessly visited farms to discuss farming with agricultural workers till the last moments of his great life. Some photos help visitors recall the President's warm love for the revolutionary soldiers, the exploits he performed by rallying all the Koreans to the patriotic movement for national reunification, and the history of his loving care for the future generations. An opening ceremony took place at the People's Palace of Culture on Tuesday. It was attended by Ri Tu Song, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), officials concerned and citizens of Pyongyang. Sung Jong Gyu, minister of Culture, made an opening address. At the end of the ceremony, the participants looked round the exhibition hall. Rodong Sinmun

title: Workers' Art Group of GFTUK Central Committee Gives Performance
body: The Workers' Art Group of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea (GFTUK) gave a performance at the Central Hall of Workers on April 13 to commemorate the 109th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Put on the stage were colorful numbers representing the feelings of the people who ardently miss and revere the President who performed undying exploits for the country and the revolution, the times and history. Performers in male chorus "It's Thanks to President's Benevolence" and mixed chorus "A Dear Name" sang highly of the exploits of the President and Chairman Kim Jong Il. Female solo "Oh, Tender-hearted Father" and female quintet "Our Dear Marshal" touched the audience as they reflected the deep reverence for the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. Among the audience were Pak In Chol, chairman of the GFTUK Central Committee, trade union officials, workers and trade union members in Pyongyang City. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Visits Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, together with his wife Ri Sol Ju, on April 15, the Day of the Sun (birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung), the greatest auspicious holiday of the nation. Accompanying him were Jo Yong Won, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and secretary for Organizational Affairs of the Party Central Committee, Marshal of the Korean People's Army (KPA) Pak Jong Chon, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK and chief of the General Staff of the KPA and Kim Yo Jong and Hyon Song Wol, vice department directors of the C.C., WPK.
