Placed at the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il was a floral basket in the name of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. Kim Jong Un, together with his wife, paid high tribute to the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il and extended the best wishes of immortality at the halls where the President and the Chairman lie in state. He recollected with deep emotion the noble revolutionary careers and immortal exploits of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il who, regarding "The People Are God" as their mottos throughout their lives, made a new history of Juche Korea making steady victorious progress by dint of the people-first doctrine and provided the eternal foundation for the happiness of all generations to come. Political News Team

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Watches Joint Performance in Celebration of Day of Sun
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on Thursday watched joint performance "Along the Party Forever" given by major art troupes in celebration of the Day of the Sun. When the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un came to the auditorium of the theater with his wife Ri Sol Ju amid the playing of welcome music, all the participants raised enthusiastic cheers of "hurrah!" in deep reverence for him who is consolidating the guiding force and militant efficiency of the great Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Party in every way and thus vigorously leading the socialist cause along the path of victory. Watching the performance also were Choe Ryong Hae, Jo Yong Won, Ri Pyong Chol and Kim Tok Hun, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, and cadres and staff of the departments of the Party Central Committee and their family members. The artistes of the major art troupes including the Band of the State Affairs Commission and the State Merited Chorus sang highly of the undying exploits of the Party Central Committee which remarkably strengthened our Party into the powerful militant general staff of the Korean revolution and opened up the new era of self-sustenance and prosperity which is most glorious in the nation's history spanning 5 000 years, with its great ideology and theory and gigantic revolutionary practices. Enjoying the emotional hymns dating back to the decades characterized by revolution, the audience recalled the greatness of our Party which led the people by dint of its great ideology and strong cohesion despite grim hardships of history to build the large flower garden of people-first-principle on this land and to give birth to an invincible powerful country. When the performance was over, the audience again broke into stormy cheers for the General Secretary. All the participants hardened their iron will to make active contribution to ushering in a period of a great upsurge and turn in our revolution by channeling all their efforts into implementing the fighting programme advanced by the historic 8th Congress of the Party, by upholding most steadfastly and most faithfully the revolutionary leadership of the General Secretary who is putting into a brilliant reality the lifelong desire of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. Political News Team

title: Members of Leadership Body of Party Central Committee Visit Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: All the people across the country are extending the highest respects and ever-lasting glory to President Kim Il Sung, the eternal leader of our Party and people and noble image of socialist Korea, on the occasion of the Day of the Sun, the greatest auspicious holiday of the nation. Members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea Choe Ryong Hae, Ri Pyong Chol and Kim Tok Hun and other members of the leadership body of the Party Central Committee visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the supreme temple of Juche, on the occasion of the 109th birth anniversary of the President. They were full of deep reverence and yearnings for the President who opened up the new history of devoted service for the people and single-minded unity and consolidated the eternal cornerstone of our dignified state prospering by dint of independence in politics, self-supporting in economy and self-reliant in national defence with his profound ideology and theory, outstanding leadership and absolute trust and dedication to the people. Placed at the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il were floral baskets in the names of the WPK Central Committee, the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK and the Cabinet of the DPRK. The members of the leadership body of the Party Central Committee paid deep respects to the great leaders before the statues. At the halls where Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il lie in state, they made a deep bow in the humblest reverence. They renewed their firm will to uphold the idea and leadership of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un with loyalty, discharge high responsibility and dedication in the endeavors for carrying out the decisions laid out at the 8th Congress of the Party and thus bring about overall development of our style socialism. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Autograph Letter from General Secretary of C.C., Communist Party of Vietnam
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), received an autograph letter from Nguyen Phu Trong, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam (CPV). Nguyen Phu Trong extended deep gratitude to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un for sending a verbal message to him to notify the accounts of the 8th Congress of the WPK and warmly congratulated the successful congress once again. He said that the 8th Congress of the WPK held fast to the principle of believing in the people as in Heaven, attached importance to the work for building the party for the people and adopted the five-year plan for economic development toward the orientation of the sustained development of the country and the marked improvement of the people's living. He expressed belief that the WPK will definitely put the DPRK on the road of socialist construction and achieve more new successes in the socio-economic development by successfully implementing the decisions made at the 8th Congress. He notified in detail the accounts of the 13th Congress of the CPV which was held from January 25 to February 1. Especially, he said that in the period under review the CPV displayed the might of the great national unity and advantages of socialist system, stabilized the living of the people, and deepened the trust of the people in the party, state and socialist system. He added that the congress confirmed once again that the party's leadership is a determinant to victoriously ensuring the development of the country toward the orientation of socialism. Noting that the Vietnamese party and people will consistently enforce the external policy of independence, friendship, peace, cooperation and development, he expressed his will to make joint efforts for the interests of the peoples of Vietnam and the DPRK, the cause of socialist construction in the two countries and the contribution to peace, stability and development in the region and the world. He also manifested his expectation and conviction that the traditional friendship and cooperative relations between the two parties and peoples would be carried forward and developed day by day. He sincerely wished Kim Jong Un greater successes in the work of leading the WPK and the Korean people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Floral Baskets from Members of Board of Directors of Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Wednesday received floral baskets sent by members of the Board of Directors of the Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation on the occasion of the Day of the Sun (the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung). He received a floral basket in the joint name of Co-Chairman Johnny Hon and Vice-Chairman Keith Bennet, and floral baskets from Honorary Vice-Chairman Sai Tiejen and Honorary Directors Cui Tongwen, Qiu Shuibo and Qiu Jianliang. On the same day, he received floral baskets from the China Dandong branch of the Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation and an association for praying for immortality for the Palace of the Sun. Floral baskets to Kim Jong Un were also sent by members of the Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation; Cui Tongjun and his wife, Lin Gennan, Li Ailan, Jin Chengwu, Zhan Xueyan, Jin Chenyu, Tang Yiming, Cui Yan, Andrei Morkel and Henrik Nydqvist. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Floral Baskets from Foreign Organizations and Personages
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Wednesday received floral baskets from foreign organizations and personages on the occasion of the Day of the Sun (the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung). They include the Beijing Chao Ya International Cultural Exchange Center in China, Osaka of the Citizens Solidarity Demanding Earlier Normalization of the Relations between Japan and the DPRK, the family of Zhang Weihua, Chinese anti-Japanese revolutionary martyr, Estuardo Martinez Perez, president of the General Kim Jong Il Peruvian Amicable Institute, and Jindallae Saphariny, president of the Jindallae Children's Foundation. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Congratulatory Letter from Chongryon Central Standing Committee
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a congratulatory letter from the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) on Thursday, the 109th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. The letter feted the President as an outstanding thinker and theoretician and great man of practice who lighted the way ahead of the times and revolution and put modern history onto the orbit of independence by means of the immortal Juche idea, and as a savior of national restoration and father of socialist Korea who defeated the two formidable imperialisms in one century to save the destiny of the people and built the invincible state independent in politics, self-supporting in the economy and self-reliant in defence on the homeland. It also praised the President as the father of the nation who held all the fellow countrymen to his broad bosom out of boundless generosity and magnanimity and a peerlessly great elder statesman who was revered by heads of state and personages of many countries and even those who had different ideas and political views for his noble charisma. The President was a peerless patriot who demonstrated the prestige of the Korean-style socialism to the world by means of gigantic creation and change while braving all sorts of challenges and ordeals of history, and the lodestar of national reunification who led in the van the sacred struggle for the country's reunification, the long-cherished wish of the nation, by laying out lines and policies of independent reunification, the letter said. The President who opened up a new history of socialist Korea and the new era of independence and provided ever-lasting treasures for the eternal prosperity of the country and nation is immortal as the sun of Juche enjoying boundless reverence and praise from the Korean nation and world progressives, the letter stressed. Thanks to the respected Marshal Kim Jong Un, another peerlessly great man, the cause of Juche and the movement of Koreans in Japan, which President Kim Il Sung originated and Chairman Kim Jong Il advanced dynamically through centuries, will emerge ever-victorious, the letter pointed out. We will make distinguished contributions to the building of a powerful socialist state and the cause of national reunification, in hearty response to the fighting programme set forth at the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea, the letter said. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Congratulatory Letter from General Association of Koreans in China
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a congratulatory letter from the General Association of Koreans in China on Thursday, the 109th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. The letter said that the President rose as the sun of Juche shouldering the destiny of the country and nation at a time when dark clouds of distress hang low over the nation, feting him as a peerless patriot who devoted all his life solely to the people's freedom and happiness, the building of a thriving nation and the reunification of the country. The President is alive as the sun of the Juche in the hearts of all the fellow countrymen and world progressives as he provided the three charters for national reunification with all his heart and soul dedicated to the great unity of the nation and the independent reunification of the country out of his noble love for compatriots and boundless generosity and made undying contributions to the cause of global independence through his energetic foreign activities, the letter said. Thanks to the great General Kim Jong Il possessed of the same idea, leadership and virtue as the President, the glorious revolutionary history of the President could invariably make steady progress, the letter noted. As the Korean nation is led by the respected Marshal Kim Jong Un, another peerlessly great man, the revolutionary cause of Juche pioneered and led to victory by the great leaders has remained ever-victorious through centuries and the sacred history of the sun has continued in the homeland year after year, the letter said. The Koreans in China will keep pace with the dynamic struggle of the people in the homeland who are breaking through head-on all trials in the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance along the orientation of a historic advance indicated by the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea, make distinguished contribution to the patriotic work for the prosperity of the country and take the lead in the struggle for national reunification by outright smashing the divisive moves by anti-reunification forces within and without, the letter stressed. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Congratulatory Letter from AINDF
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a congratulatory letter from the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front (AINDF) on Thursday, the Day of the Sun (birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung). The letter said that the AINDF paid high respect to the great President Kim Il Sung and extended the highest glory and congratulations to the respected President of the State Affairs Kim Jong Un, reflective of the reverence of vanguard fighters and patriotic people of all social standings of south Korea for them in the morning of the Day of the Sun, the auspicious holiday. The birth of President Kim Il Sung as the sun of Juche Korea was the great fortune in history by which the Korean people acclaimed the outstanding leader of the nation, the peerlessly great man, and an event of great significance in world history by which the dawn broke in the era of independence of humankind, the letter said. The great President, the symbol of the dignity and glory of the Korean nation, opened a new horizon of the era of independence of humankind with the Juche idea and steered the world politics with outstanding leadership and gigantic revolutionary practice and, therefore, he is praised by the international community as the greatest man who glorified the 20th century as Kim Il Sung's century, the letter said. It noted that it is the great fortune and glory for the Korean nation and the progressive mankind to hold high as the eternal sun of Juche the great President who stood in the center of the eventful last century and performed immortal exploits by vigorously advancing the era and history along the track of independence. Today, witnessing the magnificent reality in which the revolutionary cause of Juche, that was pioneered by the great President Kim Il Sung and developed by the great Chairman of the National Defence Commission Kim Jong Il to one victory after another, is advancing toward the higher eminence of victory under the leadership of the respected President of the State Affairs Kim Jong Un, the people of south Korea are full of boundless emotion and joy, it said. The letter expressed the pledge to definitely turn the AINDF into the rank of loyalists of Juche who believe and follow Kim Jong Un only and to mount a vigorous revolutionary movement for carrying out the cause of national independence only along the path of independence indicated by Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism in any storm and stress. Rodong Sinmun

title: Women's Dancing Parties Held
body: A dancing party of officials and members of the women's union took place at the plaza of the Arch of Triumph on Thursday in celebration of the 109th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. The participants started dancing amid the song "The Day of the Sun, Spring Holiday". They danced to the tune of "Song of Mangyongdae", "One Large Family" and other songs, bearing deep in mind that as there is the spring day of Mangyongdae, there is the spring of socialist Korea and eternal prosperity of Kim Il Sung's nation. The participants dancing to the tune of "Ballad of Gold Mountains", "Ongheya" and other songs were full of pride and self-confidence of being the Korean women leading worthwhile lives as flowers of the country, life and family. On the same day officials and members of the women's union across the country held dancing parties in celebration of the significant Day of the Sun. Rodong Sinmun

title: Dancing Parties Held by Youth and Students
body: Dancing parties of youth and students took place in Pyongyang and other parts of the country on Thursday in celebration of the Day of the Sun, the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Dancing parties held in front of the April 25 House of Culture, the Pyongyang Indoor Stadium, etc. in Pyongyang, began with the song "Let's Sing of the Day of the Sun". The participants enthusiastically danced, extending the highest glory and respect to the President. Amid the playing of "Our Future Is Bright" and other songs, the venues of the dancing parties were prevailed by enthusiasm of the passionate youths to steadily carry on the march started on Mt Paektu, holding fast to the baton of the revolution. Dancing parties also took place in provincial seats, cities and counties on the same day. Rodong Sinmun

title: President Kim Il Sung Remembered in China
body: Families of Chinese related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle had a meeting to remember President Kim Il Sung at the DPRK embassy in Beijing on April 13 ahead of his birth anniversary (the Day of the Sun). Present at the meeting were families of Chinese related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, the DPRK ambassador to China and his embassy members. The participants laid a floral basket and bouquets before the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and made a bow to them. Speeches were made at the meeting. Yu Ming, son of Li Zade, said that he looked back with deep emotion upon the life of the President. Referring to the warm loving care shown by President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un for his family, he expressed his will to contribute to the development of the traditional friendship between China and the DPRK. Zhang Jinlu, daughter of Zhang Wei-hua, recalled that the President, valuing his revolutionary friendship with her father, took parental care of her and the Chairman bestowed immeasurable favors on her family generation after generation. She added that President Kim Il Sung will always be alive in our hearts, wishing the Korean people greater victory in socialist construction under the leadership of Comrade Kim Jong Un. Zhou Wei, daughter of Zhou Baozhong, said that President Kim Il Sung deeply revered by the Korean people devoted his life to national liberation and prosperity of the country, adding that he achieved world-startling successes in the socialist revolution and construction by founding the idea of independence and leading the Korean people. The son of Feng Zhongyun praised the President for his immortal exploits for national liberation and nation-building, expressing his conviction that the Korean people would accomplish the behests of President Kim Il Sung to the last under the leadership of Comrade Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un from Chongryon Organizations and Bodies
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received messages of greetings from organizations and bodies under the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) on the occasion of the Day of the Sun (birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung). They are the Standing Council of the Korean Federation of Workers in Commerce in Japan, the Central Standing Committee of the Korean Youth League in Japan, the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Democratic Korean Women in Japan, the Central Standing Management Board of the Korean Youth Commercial Association in Japan, the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Korean Teachers in Japan, the Central Standing Council of the Union of Korean Educational Association in Japan, the Central Standing Council of the Korean Scientists and Technologists Association in Japan, the Central Standing Council of the Korean Social Scientists Association in Japan, the Standing Council of the Korean Sportsmen's Federation in Japan, the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Korean Writers and Artists in Japan, the Central Standing Council of the Korean Health Workers Association in Japan, the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Korean Students in Japan, the Association of Koreans in Japan for Peaceful Reunification, the Central Standing Council of the Korean Human Rights Association in Japan and other Chongryon central organizations and their affiliated bodies. Among them are also the Choson Sinbo Company, the Korean News Service, the Hagu Bookshop, the Kumgang-san Opera Troupe, the Kumgang Insurance Company, the Committee for Promoting Korea-Japan Economic Exchange, and other affiliates, and prefectural headquarters of Chongryon, Korean University and Korean schools in Japan. The messages paid high respect to Kim Il Sung, who is the eternal sun of Juche and savior of the destiny of Koreans in Japan, and extended the highest glory to Kim Jong Un who is translating the desire and ideal of the great leaders into a bright reality, reflecting the boundless reverence on the occasion of the Day of the Sun. They expressed their will to make reports of joy to Kim Jong Un by making remarkable progress and achievements in the patriotic advance for hastening a fresh heyday in the movement of Koreans in Japan this year, one year before the 25th Congress of Chongryon. Rodong Sinmun

title: Evening Gala of Youth and Students, Fireworks Display Mark Day of Sun
body: Amid the great joy of the people celebrating the spring holiday of April there took place an evening gala of youth and students and fireworks display in Pyongyang in the evening on Thursday, the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung (the Day of the Sun). When darkness fell in streets, youth and students of the city gathered in Kim Il Sung Square. The reviewing stands and other places around the square were alive with the working people in the city who gathered to watch the fireworks display. The evening gala of youth and students began as the song "Let's Sing of the Day of the Sun" resounded through the nocturnal sky of the city. Youth and students presented a sea of dancers with the ardent yearning for the President who built the socialist state independent in politics, self-supporting in economy and self-reliant in defence on this land. They danced to the tunes of songs reflecting the revolutionary spirit of young vanguards determined to make a breakthrough of advance in every work site of a new great upsurge. As time wore on, the atmosphere of the evening gala reached climax with joy and delight of the young people, and colorful fireworks beautifully decorated the nocturnal sky on the Day of the Sun. Song "Our Leader Loved by People" reflective of the admiration of the people for the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un resounded throughout the square, and fascinating fireworks brightened the nocturnal sky over the capital city. The atmosphere of the spring holiday of April was revved up with the fireworks in the sky and the sea of dancers in the square. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: People and service personnel visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and mosaics of their smiling images across the country to pay high tribute on the occasion of the Day of the Sun (birth anniversary of Kim Il Sung). Bouquets and floral baskets in the names of the Party, power and armed forces organs, social organizations, ministries, national institutions, units of the Korean People's Army (KPA) and the Public Security Forces (PSF), institutions and industrial establishments and universities at all levels in Pyongyang were laid before the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill. The members of the Pyongyang mission of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front also laid a bouquet before the statues. The visitors made a bow before the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il. Placed at the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il and mosaics of their smiling images in various places of Pyongyang including Kim Il Sung University, the Ministry of National Defence, the Ministry of Public Security and the Mansudae Art Studio were bouquets and floral baskets in the names of institutions, enterprises, units of the KPA and the PSF, etc. Officials, working people and service personnel across the country paid tribute to the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il and mosaics of their smiling images in their residential areas. Rodong Sinmun

title: WPK Central Committee Sends Floral Basket to 8th Congress of Communist Party of Cuba
body: The Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) sent a floral basket to congratulate the 8th Congress of the Communist Party of Cuba. The floral basket was conveyed to an official of the International Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba by the DPRK ambassador to Cuba. Written on the ribbon of the floral basket were the letters reading "Warm Congratulations to the 8th Congress of the Communist Party of Cuba". Rodong Sinmun

title: Day of Sun Significantly Celebrated in DPRK
body: The people across the country significantly celebrated the Day of the Sun, the greatest auspicious holiday of the nation (birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung). Reverence for the President swept the country in the run-up to the holiday. Working people and service personnel visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and mosaics picturing their smiling images to pay homage to them. A national photo exhibition and a national pencil and calligraphy festival were held. Colorful art performances were given in Pyongyang and provinces. The artistes of the Mansudae Art Troupe gave a music and dance performance at the East Pyongyang Grand Theatre and those of the Phibada Opera Troupe gave a performance of famous music and scenes of revolutionary operas at the Pyongyang Grand Theatre. The revolutionary drama "Blood at an International Conference" was staged at the National Theatre and a music and dance performance was given by the National Folk Art Troupe at the Ponghwa Art Theatre. The National Acrobatic Troupe gave a combined acrobatic show at the Pyongyang Circus Theater. National and Pyongyang City art squads and art groups also gave outdoor performances in different places of the capital city, heightening the festive atmosphere. Art performances were given also in Jagang, Kangwon and North Hamgyong provinces. Public catering establishments across the country were alive with holiday services that day. Rodong Sinmun

title: Finals of Inter-Provincial Mass Sports Contest Held
body: There took place finals of the Inter-Provincial Mass Sports Contest-2021 for celebrating the Day of the Sun (birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung) at Kim Il Sung Stadium on Thursday. Watching the games were cadres of the Party and the government, chief secretaries of the provincial Party committees, members of the National Sports Guidance Committee, officials of the ministries, national institutions and armed forces organs and Pyongyang citizens. The football finals between students of Pyongyang City Football School and North Hamgyong Provincial Football School were held. The players of the two teams who had drawn attention of the professionals and fans with their good performance in the group league matches and semi-finals dynamically operated the games, making the most of the tactical intentions of their teams. The Pyongyang City team beat the North Hamgyong Provincial team 3:1, taking the first place. Tug-of-war games marked the climax of the contest. Players of Pyongyang City and North Phyongan Province, who defeated all their rivals before advancing into the finals, displayed team cohesion and spirit with strong will and perseverance. The spectators cheered their players in one mind. The team of Pyongyang City won the games. Cadres of the Party and the government gave pep talks to the players who performed well. The contest served as the significant occasion making the more fervent sporting atmosphere pervade the whole country and arousing the people to implement the decisions made at the 8th Congress of the Party and the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Party. Rodong Sinmun

title: Eternal Glory to the Historic Fork of the Road to Mangyongdae!
body: The fork of the road to Mangyongdae still reminds us warmly of the whole-hearted devotion of President Kim Il Sung to the country and the people. After Korean liberation from Japanese colonial rule he reached the fork on his way to the Kangson Steelworks but did not take the path and visit Mangyongdae although it is calling distance and boasts a home of his birth. More still, he always remembered Mangyongdae during his bloody 2-decade-long war against the Japanese invaders. In spite of this he followed the road to the KS and went visiting its workers with a sense of responsibility to the revolution and ardent love for the people to build a new Korea. Indeed, in our socialist country the people have owed all their happiness entirely to the immortal selfless devotion of Kim Il Sung to them. The fork of the road to Mangyongdae still testifies that Kim Il Sung was really the great leader of the people who traversed the long road of the revolution with and for them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Remains of Late Choe Ki Hyok Buried in Patriotic Martyrs Cemetery in Sinmi-ri
body: Remains of People's Artiste Choe Ki Hyok, a former concert master of the National Symphony Orchestra, were buried in the Patriotic Martyrs Cemetery in Sinmi-ri with due ceremony on April 17. He grew up to be a violinist of a prestigious art troupe under the care of the Party and exerted all his creative wisdom and zeal for the past 50 years. He wonderfully depicted and created a number of famous music pieces of the times like orchestra "Forever with the Leader and the Party" to be loved by the people. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un added luster to the life of the artiste who contributed to the development of the Juche-oriented symphony and saw to it that his remains were buried in the Patriotic Martyrs Cemetery. He also showed such great loving care as sending a wreath again. Present at the burial ceremony were Ri Tu Song, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Jang Ryong Sik, vice department director of the Party Central Committee, Sung Jong Gyu, minister of Culture, officials concerned, officials of the National Symphony Orchestra and bereaved family members. At the ceremony a speaker said that the exploits and life of the martyr became to shine long in the history of the country as there is the warm loving care of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un who is taking care of the destiny of the revolutionary soldiers to the last. He called on the officials and artistes of the National Symphony Orchestra and bereaved family members to thoroughly carry out the Party's policy on literature and arts by doing what the martyr would do if he were alive. The remains of the martyr were buried. A wreath from Kim Jong Un was placed at the grave. The participants laid wreaths and bouquets before the grave of the martyr and paid a silent tribute to the memory of the deceased. They hardened their pledge to fulfill their responsibility and duty in the present all-out advance for implementing the decisions made at the 8th Congress of the Party, true to the idea and the leadership of the Party, bearing deep in mind the great benefits shown by the General Secretary. Rodong Sinmun

title: Premier Kim Tok Hun Learns about Work in Unryul Mine and Agricultural Field in South Hwanghae Province
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the DPRK, learned about the work in the Unryul Mine and the agricultural field in South Hwanghae Province. Visiting the youth mining lot and several other places of the mine, he referred to detailed issues for producing lots of iron ore and sending them to the large bases of the metallurgical industry, stepping up the development of the Sohaeri branch mine and introducing advanced science and technology into production, true to the intention of the Party to make this year a year when the metal industry exerts its most strength. On several co-op farms of Unryul, Sinchon, Pyoksong, Chongdan, Pongchon, Yonan and Paechon counties of South Hwanghae Province, he underlined need to actively introduce substantial farming methods and markedly raise the proportion of mechanization in the farm operation. He called on the officials in charge of guidance over agriculture to thoroughly overcome outdated work attitude such as telling a tall lie and formalism and to conduct substantial work with an emphasis put on the production of organic compound fertilizer and on the increased production of grain in low-yielding fields, with awareness of being responsible for the farming for this year before the Party and the state. The field consultative meetings discussed the issue of boosting the production of iron ore through closely-organized operation and control for expanding production capacity, and the issue of increasing the production of granulated fertilizer at the organic compound fertilizer factories to supply them to farms. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Greetings to Syrian President
body: Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), sent a message of greeting to Bashar Al-Assad, president of the Syrian Arab Republic, on April 17. In the message the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un extended warm congratulations and greetings to the president, friendly government and people of Syria on behalf of the DPRK government and people on the occasion of the 75th anniversary of the independence of Syria. Since the independence of the country, the Syrian people have carried on the strenuous struggle to repel all kinds of aggression and interference by the imperialists and the forces following them, firmly defend the sovereignty and dignity of the country and build a new prosperous society, the message said. The Korean people always extend invariable support and solidarity to the Syrian people for their just cause to achieve independence, justice, peace and development, the message noted. In the belief that the historic friendly and cooperative relations between the DPRK and Syria would grow stronger in conformity with the noble intention of the preceding leaders and the desire of the peoples of the two countries, it sincerely wished the Syrian president good health and bigger success in his responsible work. Rodong Sinmun

title: Meeting of Koreans in Japan Celebrates Day of Sun
body: A meeting of Koreans in Japan took place at the Korean Hall of Culture in Tokyo on April 14 in celebration of the 109th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Present there were Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), its vice-chairmen, the chairman of the Central Audit Committee of Chongryon, the chairman of the Korean Federation of Workers in Commerce in Japan, the rector of Korean University, advisers and department directors of the Central Standing Committee of Chongryon, the director of the Research Institute on History of Korean Residents in Japan, chairpersons of the headquarters of Chongryon, leading officials of central organizations and affiliates and Korean compatriots. Ho Jong Man said that the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un sent again educational aid fund and stipends for the democratic national education of the children of Koreans in Japan. He in the report stressed that as there is April 15, the birthday of the President, Chongryon and the movement of Koreans in Japan could cover the path of victory along with the fatherland and Chongryon could exalt its honor as the model organization of the movement of overseas compatriots in the world. He continued that the noble patriotic cause of the President was brilliantly carried forward by Chairman Kim Jong Il and that the loving care and benevolence shown by the great leaders for the Chongryon officials and the Koreans in Japan have been given a steady continuity by the respected Marshal Kim Jong Un today. He stressed the need to powerfully demonstrate the true picture and might of Chongryon whose whole machinery ranging from the Central Standing Committee to branches is firmly united in the same idea and purpose and moves in single mind. A congratulatory message to Kim Jong Un was read out at the meeting. Rodong Sinmun

title: Lecture Given by Chongryon to Celebrate Day of Sun
body: A lecture of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) was given at the Central Hall of Chongryon in Tokyo, Japan on April 14 in celebration of the Day of the Sun (birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung). Present there were Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of Chongryon, and its vice-chairmen, the chairman of the Central Audit Committee of Chongryon, and members and officials of the Central Standing Committee of Chongryon. Shown at the lecture was video "Great Comradeship". The participants recalled how President Kim Il Sung provided the noble tradition of revolutionary comradeship with absolute trust, dedicated loving care and noble obligation and took warm care of the officials of Chongryon in the alien land, calling them his valuable comrades. Rodong Sinmun

title: Foreign Figures Visit DPRK Missions
body: The secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation who is also the head of the Russia-DPRK Friendship Parliamentary Group of the State Duma of Russia, the chairperson of the Party for Peace and Unity of Russia, the head of the Orchestra of the 21st Century of Russia and their parties paid congratulatory visits to the DPRK embassy in Moscow on April 8 on the occasions of the 109th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung and the 2nd anniversary of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's historic visit to the Russian Federation. Other foreign figures of various circles also paid congratulatory visits to the DPRK missions in their countries on April 8 and 9 on the occasion of the Day of the Sun (birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung). They include the general secretary of the Central Committee of the Nepal Communist Party (Marxist-Leninist) who is ex-deputy prime minister of Nepal, the chairman of the Central Committee of the Nepal Communist Party (United), the chairman of the Nepal Journalist Association for the Study of the Juche Idea and Songun Politics, the chairman of the Study Forum for Self-Reliance of Nepal, the chairman of the Nepali Literary Forum for the Study of Songun Politics, the chairman of the International Committee for the Study of Songun Politics for Peaceful Reunification of Korea in Nepal, the vice-chairperson of the Socialist Journalist Forum of Nepal for the Study of the Juche Idea, the chairman of the Nepal Institute for the Juche Studies, the editor-in-chief of the Nepalese newspaper Gorkha Express, members of the Political Bureau of the Nationalist Socialist Party of Syria in Lebanon, the chairman of the Permanent Standing Committee of the Belarus National Association of Friends of Korean People Named after Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il, the chairman of the Belarus Association for the Study of Juche Idea, the chairman of the Organizational Committee of the Communist Workers' Party of Belarus and members of the leadership of the Democratic Party of Equatorial Guinea. They laid floral baskets and bouquets before the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and the art works depicting them standing together and bowed to them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Popular Art Performances Celebrate Day of Sun
body: Popular art performances were given across the DPRK to celebrate the Day of the Sun (birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung). Songs of reverence and praise of all the people for Kim Il Sung resounded throughout the country. Performances were given in cultural halls and outdoor stages in each province, city and county, livening up the atmosphere of the balmy spring holiday of April. In the capital city performances were given by art groups of various units in Pyongyang. Art group performances in all parts of the country deepened the earnest yearning of the people for Kim Il Sung who walked the path of passionate love and devotion for the country and the people all his life. Colorful numbers given by art group members of various organizations in local areas showed the joy of the people celebrating the Day of the Sun. Performances in each province, city and county gave impressive depiction of our people's iron faith and will to add brilliance to the revolutionary feats of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, who opened up a new history of socialist Korea and a new age of independence, down through generations. Rodong Sinmun

title: Day of Sun Celebrated Abroad
body: Meetings for celebrating the Day of the Sun (birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung) were held in Russia, Bangladesh, Norway, Finland, Switzerland, Belarus, Equatorial Guinea and Libya between April 6 and 13. Present there were personages of political and public circles and masses of those countries, and speeches were made. The first secretary of the Central Committee of the Lenin Young Communist League of the Russian Federation said that President Kim Il Sung devoted his all to the freedom and independence of Korea, prosperity of the country and its people's happiness. The cause of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il has been given a steady continuity by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, he noted. The chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Bangladesh, the chairperson of the Bangladesh Jatiya Party and other people praised the whole life of Kim Il Sung as the noble one of the tender-hearted father who devoted himself to the people. The chairman of the Ostfold County Committee of the Communist Party of Norway and the international secretary of the Finnish Communists' League lauded Kim Il Sung for founding the Juche idea, brightly indicating the road for mankind in the era of independence and defeating two imperialisms in one generation. Congratulatory messages to Kim Jong Un were adopted at the meetings held in Russia, Norway, Finland and Switzerland. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Congratulatory Message from Chairman of Central Committee of CPRF
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), received a congratulatory message from G. A. Zhuganov, chairman of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation (CPRF), on April 15. The message said that on April 15 the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) greeted the 109th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, the great leader of the nation and the founder of the DPRK and WPK. It said that Kim Il Sung, son loyal to his country and wise leader and patriot, dedicated his whole life to the struggle for the future, independence and prosperity of socialist Korea. Noting that under his leadership the Korean people have steadily advanced along the road for building a just society, achieved great successes in the fields of science, industry and culture and put the national defense capability onto a new level, the message said the building of a socialist state started under the leadership of Kim Il Sung is being successfully carried out. It said that today under the leadership of WPK the working people of the DPRK are confidently advancing along the road for implementing the behests of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and building a prosperous society. It wished the Korean people greater success in socialist construction. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Congratulatory Message to Raul Castro Ruz
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un sent a congratulatory message to Raul Castro Ruz on Monday. The message extended sincere and warm congratulations to Raul Castro Ruz on the successful 8th Congress of the Communist Party of Cuba (CPC). Kim Jong Un said in the message that he was very pleased to see that under the energetic guidance of Raul Castro Ruz the 8th Congress of the CPC provided a sure guarantee for carrying forward the socialist cause of Cuba generation after generation, faithfully upholding the idea of Fidel Castro Ruz. The message recalled that the Cuban people have strenuously advanced along the road of socialism, safeguarding the sovereignty and dignity of their country under the correct guidance of the CPC headed by respected Raul Castro Ruz in the face of trials and tempests of history. It expressed conviction that the CPC and the Cuban people would invariably preserve the invaluable legacies of the revolution bequeathed by the revolutionaries of the elder generations and gain big successes in the struggle for building a prosperous socialist state, rallied closer around First Secretary Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez. Kim Jong Un in the message expressed his firm will to add shine to the comradely and fraternal relations of friendship and cooperation between the two parties and the two countries forged and verified in the struggle for carrying out the joint cause. Wishing Raul Castro Ruz good health and happiness, the message sincerely hoped that only victory and glory would be in store for the CPC and the Cuban people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Congratulatory Message to First Secretary of Central Committee of CPC
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a congratulatory message to Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez, first secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba (CPC) and president of the Republic of Cuba, on Monday. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un in the message offered the sincerest congratulations and warm comradely greetings to Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez over the successful 8th CPC Congress and his election as first secretary of the CPC Central Committee. The message noted that it is an expression of absolute support, deep trust and great expectations placed by all the members of the CPC and other Cuban people in him that he assumed the heavy responsibility as the first secretary of the CPC Central Committee at a crucial and historic time when the revolutionary cause of Cuba pioneered and advanced by the respected comrades Fidel Castro Ruz and Raul Castro Ruz is being carried forward generation after generation. Saying that it provided a sure guarantee for the Cuban revolution to vigorously advance along the road of independence, justice and socialism, true to the idea and intention of the preceding leaders, and for the Cuban people to make a steady and dynamic advance toward the future of socialism, full of confidence and optimism, Kim Jong Un noted in his message that he is sincerely pleased at it. The message expressed firm belief that the fraternal Cuban people would firmly defend the gains of revolution and surely build an independent and prospering socialist state by waging an all-out drive for implementing the decisions of the CPC Congress, firmly united behind the CPC Central Committee headed by the respected first secretary. It stressed that the relations between the two parties and the two countries, established on the basis of deep friendly relations and comradeship between Kim Il Sung and Fidel Castro Ruz, the great leaders of the peoples of the two countries, have grown stronger and closer in the course of weathering all tempests of history and developed into special comradely and strategic relations century after century and generation after generation. Kim Jong Un in his message reaffirmed his will to further develop the traditional friendship and unity and comradely cooperative ties between the two parties and the two countries along the road of the struggle for carrying out the joint cause under the banner of socialism, as agreed with the respected first secretary during a meeting in Pyongyang in November, 2018. The message sincerely wished the respected first secretary big success in his important and responsible work for leading the CPC and the Cuban people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Teacher Training Colleges Built and Rebuilt on a Modern Basis Dynamically
body: Teacher training colleges are actively built and rebuilt along modern lines throughout the country. North Hwanghae Province organized the field headquarters with competent Party officials and administrative workers and mobilized many people to build the Sariwon Teacher Training College. The builders disposed of huge amounts of soil in several days and actively applied advanced building methods to their work, thus carrying out their work assignments in 15 days although it took them a month to do that. North Hamgyong Province rebuilds the Kim Jong Suk Teacher Training College on modern lines with all speed. North Phyongan Province successfully builds the Sinuiju Teacher Training College according to a plan. Kangwon Province and other provinces, too, concentrate their powers on building their teacher training colleges and achieve one success after another in it. Rodong Sinmun

title: Fruit Farms Nationwide Planted Millions of Fruit Trees
body: The labor and management of fruit farms countrywide have so far planted millions of fruit trees this year. Resolved to develop their pomiculture on a high scientific and intensive level the officials and working people of Kwail County planted in a short time high-yielding fruit trees of fine strains which resist drought, wind, rain, cold, etc well. Pukchong County fertilized its orchards with an abundance of quality manure. It dug pits for fruit trees, planted them at right intervals and watered them according to the demand of technological regulations. It also took good care of them. Aware that planting fruit trees close was important in increasing the output of their fruits the officials and working people of the Kosan Combined Fruit Farm planted their fruit trees scientifically and technologically with good care. The Onchon Fruit Farm secured plenty of young fruit trees and humus soil. It selected varieties of fruit trees and allotted them to each of its fruit gardens to suit their geographical features and soil, thereby rotating its fruit trees on its considerable area. The working people of the Pyongyang Fruit Farm and many other fruit farms planted many fruit trees anew, heaped up soil over their roots and watered them with good care paying special attention to rooting as many of them as possible. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Words of Congratulations to First Secretary of Central Committee of CPC
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, sent words of warm congratulations to Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez in congratulation of the successful holding of the Eighth Congress of the Communist Party of Cuba (CPC) and his election as first secretary of the Central Committee of the CPC. Upon authorization of the General Secretary, Kim Song Nam, director of the International Department of the Central Committee of the WPK, paid a congratulatory visit to the Cuban embassy here on April 20 to courteously convey the words of congratulations from the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un to First Secretary of the C.C., CPC Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez to Cuban Ambassador to the DPRK Jesus De Los Angeles Aise Sotolongo. Kim Jong Un, as a genuine comrade, once again warmly congratulated Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez on taking the heavy responsibility as head of the CPC amidst the absolute support and warm expectations of all the Cuban party members and other people. Saying that he will always join hands with Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez on the road of foiling all sorts of challenges by the hostile forces and accomplishing socialism, he clarified the steadfast will of the WPK and the Korean people to further develop special comradely relations and strategic relations with Cuba on a new high level as required by the new era. He affirmed that the WPK and the Korean people will stand with the CPC and the Cuban people forever. He sincerely wished First Secretary Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez good health and big success in his responsible work of leading the party and the state. The Cuban ambassador expressed deep thanks to General Secretary of the WPK Kim Jong Un for sending his wholehearted words of congratulations to First Secretary of the C.C., CPC Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez and stated the will of the CPC and the Cuban people to further boost the friendly and cooperative relations between the two parties and two countries in the future. Rodong Sinmun

title: Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League to Convene Its 10th Congress
body: The 10th Congress of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League is to open in Pyongyang from April 27 at a time when all the people of the country are speeding up the grand revolutionary advance for a new victory in the socialist construction. The congress is to analyze and review in depth the achievements, experiences and the mistakes with their causes and lessons found in the youth league work during the period under review, and to discuss tasks and ways for the youth league to fully display its might as the militant reserve of the Party and as vanguard and shock brigade of the socialist construction in the struggle for carrying out the decisions made at the 8th Congress of the Worker's Party of Korea. The Central Committee of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League released an official notice on convening the congress on Monday. Rodong Sinmun

title: A Hundred and Several Ten Million Trees Planted throughout the Country
body: Trees are briskly planted in spring throughout the country. Officials and working people were out to plant trees in spring across the whole country true to the noble intention of the Party to reafforest and landscape it and planted one hundred and several ten million trees in a bit over a month. South Phyongan Province has so far planted twenty and several million trees in spring through an energetic mass drive. Its officials and working people dug pits for trees, carpeted them with humus soil and planted and watered trees in their territory on a thoroughly qualitative footing to root them and thus lay the foundations for the wealth of the nation and the happiness of posterity. The officials and working people of North Hwanghae Province bestirred themselves to make actual advances in their afforestation now that they have buckled down to another five-year plan this year. They planted trees whole-heartedly in thousands of hectares of land. South Hamgyong Province went all out to plant trees in spring. The officials and working people of Nampho and Kaesong Cities and other areas are zealous to convert all the mountains of the country into golden and treasured ones. They analyze their soil and weather conditions in detail and register great successes in planting trees thoroughly on the principle of the right tree on the right soil and in the right time. Rodong Sinmun

title: Feeling like Wishing to Put Down Floral Carpets for the Workers
body: A few years ago the people of the whole country enjoyed May Day. The air was full of spring. That day, too, Comrade Kim Jong Un travelled quite a distance and visited a machine-building plant for firsthand guidance. Its workers and management were hugely excited with boundless joy when they welcomed him to their plant. They were so anxious to see him even in a dream. That day he looked round the welfare service facilities and Kangsong Health Complex of the plant which were newly built for its workers. He was so much pleased with them. He warmly said that Chairman Kim Jong Il would be very happy to inspect the facilities and complex if he were with us. In the hearts of officials surged the strong yearning for Kim Jong Il who devoted himself wholly to the good of our working classes all his life. Looking about at them Kim Jong Un warmly said again that the thought of Kim Jong Il occurred to him spontaneously whenever he visited the plant and that he trained our workers body and soul and handed them over to him. He added that he was very eager to lay floral carpets on the premises of the plant for its workers. Kim Jong Un was quite ready to pick even stars from the sky and make flowers bloom even on stones for our workers. This greatly touched the hearts of the officials. They were firmly convinced that our workers would fully display their unfathomable strength in all the units of the national economy to make theirs a powerful socialist nation because Kim Jong Un loved them infinitely the way Kim Jong Il did. Rodong Sinmun

title: Happy Children Envisioned
body: The employees of the Pyongyang Bag Factory are very busy designing bags of many sorts. They fully exerted themselves to design schoolbags of different types for several months as against their counterparts of last year and finally produced good results. But they rest discontented with it believing that they should turn out the best schoolbags for the children loved and valued by the Party. It is envisaged that our children will attend school happily shouldering our bags with Mindulle-trademarked notebooks in them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Lighting Festival "Wonders of Light-2021" Commemorate Day of Sun
body: A lighting festival "Wonders of Light-2021" has begun here since April 18 to commemorate the Day of the Sun (birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung). The places around Pyongyang Department Store No. 1 and the foot of Jangdae Hill were crowded with people who gathered to watch the festival. The mysterious art of light began with the display of the title "Wonders of Light-2021", letters "Day of the Sun" and numbers "4.15". The festival vividly showed the feature of our socialist motherland ushering in a new era of development and era of our state-first principle under the guidance of the great Party and the worthwhile struggle and life of our people building rosy future through creation and construction. Scenes making unique reflection of the era of miracle and prosperity unprecedented in the 5000 year-old Korean history made the people look back upon the exploits of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il who accomplished the historic cause of founding the Party, the state and the army in the most successful way and provided the eternal foundation of building a socialist power independent in politics, self-supporting in economy and self-reliant in defence. The festival showed ever-changing scenes mirroring the current era, in which the laugh of our people and song of their happiness are growing with each passing day under the care of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un who gives steady continuity to the history of people-first principle, and the rosy future. The festival which has developed into another peculiar cultural event to be loved by the people was acclaimed by the spectators. Rodong Sinmun

title: Increased Agitation Propels Creation of New Pyongyang Speed in Construction Site of 10 000 Flats
body: Agitation has gained momentum in the construction site of 10 000 flats in Pyongyang, encouraging the solider and civilian builders to create the new Pyongyang speed and myth of construction. A number of large visual aid materials are displayed along the main road in Songsin and Songhwa areas to present a special scene. An agitation board titled "Let us fully demonstrate the might of guards unit in carrying out the militant order of the Party!" and others clearly show the noble fighting spirit and traits of the service personnel of the People's Army. Red flags and mobile news boards with titles "Stamina of Revolutionary Army" and "Tomorrow Is Late" encourage the builders setting new standards and new records with the passage of time. Songs "Footsteps", "Song of the Korean People's Army", "Song of Coast Artillerymen" and "It Is Offensive" performed by the artistes of the song and dance ensembles and members of art squads of KPA units, and their bands boost the atmosphere of the construction site. The art squad of the Capital City Construction Commission and an itinerant art squad of the High-Speed Youth Shock Brigade Management Bureau raise the morale of the builders and young vanguard with powerful agitation. Members of the Central Art Squad for Increased Production, the workers' art group of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea, the art squad of the Central Committee of the Union of Agricultural Workers and the art squad of the Central Committee of the women's union inject vitality into the construction site with agitation, comic story and other colorful numbers. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Floral Basket to First Secretary of Central Committee of CPC
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a floral basket to Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez, first secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba (CPC) and president of the Republic of Cuba, on his birthday. The DPRK ambassador to Cuba courteously conveyed the floral basket bearing the august name of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un to an official of the International Department of the Central Committee of the CPC on April 20. Written on the ribbon of the basket were letters "Warm congratulations to Comrade Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez, first secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba and president of the Republic of Cuba, on his birthday". Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Greetings to First Secretary of Central Committee of CPC
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a message of greeting to Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez, first secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba (CPC) and president of the Republic of Cuba, on April 20. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un in the message offered the warmest congratulations and sincere comradely greetings to Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez on his birthday. The message expressed firm belief that the new leadership of the party and state of Cuba led by the first secretary would firmly carry forward and vigorously advance the revolutionary cause of Cuba pioneered and developed by the revolutionaries of the elder generations. The message also extended firm support and solidarity to the fraternal Cuban people who have achieved great successes in the struggle for victorious advance of the socialist cause, despite the vicious sanctions and blockade by the hostile forces and manifold hardships, under the energetic guidance of the first secretary. Expressing conviction that the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation between the two parties and peoples of the two countries established in the joint struggle for accomplishing the socialist cause would grow stronger in the future, the message sincerely wished the first secretary and his whole family good health and happiness. Rodong Sinmun

title: President Kim Il Sung's Birth Anniversary Marked by Koreans in China
body: The General Association of Koreans in China held events on April 15, the 109th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Laid at the statue of the President at Yuwen Middle School in Jilin were the floral baskets in the names of the General Association of Koreans in China, the Association of Korean Women in China, the Jilin City branch of the Jilin Province Regional Association, the family of Hwang Paek Ha, a China-resident Korean related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, and the family of Hong Yong Sun who is a vice-chairperson of the Jilin Province Regional Association. Officials of the General Association of Koreans in China, the Federation of Korean Economic Workers in China, the Association of Korean Women in China and the Association of Young Korean Nationals in China, veterans of the Chinese People's Volunteers, family members of martyrs of the Chinese People's Volunteers and Koreans in China laid floral baskets before an art piece depicting President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il at the DPRK Consulate General in Shenyang before making a bow before it. There took place a meeting of the General Association of Koreans in China in Shenyang, China. Choe Su Bong, first vice chairman of the General Association of Koreans in China, in the report said that April 15, the birthday of President Kim Il Sung, is the day of great fortune when the Korean nation greeted the great sun of the people for the first time in its history spanning 5 000 years and the day of historic event when the world's progressive people greeted the dawn of the era of independence. He recalled the immortal exploits of the President for the country and the people, the times and history. A letter to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un was adopted at the meeting. Then there took place a film show and a banquet. Meanwhile, the Yanbian Regional Association and its branches, the Zhongnan Regional Association and the Mudanjiang Regional Association of the General Association of Koreans in China held a ceremony of laying floral baskets and colorful events like celebration, film show and round-table talks. Rodong Sinmun

title: The People, the Masters of Chollima
body: The bronze statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, who smile a sunny smile as if to wish our country eternal prosperity, stand on the Mansu Hill. It also has the statue of Chollima (the legendary winged horse of Korea) at the edge of the hill close by the bronze statues. It is a significant monument of the Korean people which symbolizes and glorifies a brilliant era of Korean history or the era of Chollima for all ages and adds to the pride of our great country. Chollima seems to dynamically soar high into the sky through clouds carrying on its back a male worker with the red letter of the Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea high in his hand and a female farmer with a sheaf of rice in her hand. They remind us that Kim Il Sung said that this was the era of the people and gave instructions to portray them and clearly show that the builders of this city, the masters of Chollima, were not individual heroes and heroines but the people. The world has myriads of monuments which symbolize ages and history. They all represent mythical beings and legendary heroes and rulers of the day, except for the statue of Chollima. Our people were very good in those days. They lived in half-underground houses and ate boiled corn with soybean paste as a side dish, but dedicated all their energy, wisdom and ardor to the country for the bright future of socialism and communism. They broke the rated capacity of their machines and produced more steel for the country to meet its needs. They made tractors and motortrucks without designs for themselves when the country needed them. They were too common. During Japanese colonial rule they were maltreated and humiliated more harshly than any others in the world and groaned under poverty and backwardness. But Kim Il Sung implanted the idea of single-hearted unity in the people and trained them to rely on themselves. This was to be found nowhere in the world. Today, too, the Korean people advance in the spirit of Chollima the way their predecessors did. They perform shining miracles in their work at their factories and cooperative farms in out-of-the-way mountain villages, in the sea and in all other parts of the country overcoming all manner of difficulties. It was nobody but Kim Il Sung who brought them up to be the dependable masters of Chollima with all devotion as always. A worker became a hero and a deputy to the people’s assembly although he had agonized over his undesirable vicissitudes of his life very much. A trader and manufacturer developed into a patriotic socialist worker who devoted his all to the country although he had stinted even an injection for his son to cure him of disease. This was quite unthinkable without the loving care of Kim Il Sung. Kim Il Sung gave his word that he would take care of all the people and lead them to communist society. They rode Chollima and soared high into the sky to develop the country by leaps and bounds. Indeed, the people became the new masters of the country and the honorable creators of the times under the care of Kim Il Sung. They will, no doubt, achieve the new victories of the revolution under the leadership of Comrade Kim Jong Un who creditably carries forward the cause of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il. Looking up to the statue of Chollima all the people confirm their confidence and determination to live just like their predecessors who trusted and followed Kim Il Sung alone and marched forward toward victory and glory in the era of Chollima and loyally go along the road of the revolution all their lives under the leadership of the C.C., WPK. Rodong Sinmun

title: His Resolve Mirrored in His Letter
body: A pupil of the Songrim Primary School in Songrim City named Pak Phyong Il carefully was writing a letter to the soldiers of the Korean People’s Army who impregnably defend the country and the revolution by arms. He asked his mother abruptly if he would get to receive letters after he joined the KPA in the future. She was reading his letter. She affectionately looked at him and replied meaningfully that not only she but also her husband and grandparents would send him letters after he entered the KPA. Pak Phyong Il said in joy that he was very eager to enlist in the KPA as soon as possible. All his family accepted his precious desire with a smile. They savored his letter. It reads: “Because you the soldiers of the Korean People’s Army firmly defend the country we are happy and fully realize our future ambitions. I will study hard and participate in my organizational life exemplarily to be a good soldier of the KPA….” Not only Pak Phyong Il but also all the other schoolchildren of the whole country make up their minds to emulate the good soldiers of the KPA and be one of them in the future when they address letters to them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Reply Message from President of Socialist Republic of Vietnam
body: Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a reply message from Nguyen Xuan Phuc, president of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, on April 22. The president in his message extended his wholehearted thanks to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un for sending a congratulatory message to him upon his election as president of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam. He said that he always remembers the meeting with Kim Jong Un which was held, full of friendly feelings, in Hanoi during his official goodwill visit to Vietnam in March, 2019. He noted that the visit made by Kim Jong Un marked a very important milestone in the traditional relations of friendship between the two parties and two states. He said that the party, the state and the people of Vietnam always attach a great importance to the traditional friendship with the party, the state and the people of the DPRK, and hope to further develop them. He stressed he was convinced that thanks to the common efforts of the two parties, two states and two peoples, the traditional relations of friendship between the two countries would steadily get cemented and develop in conformity with the interests of the peoples of the two countries and for peace, stability, cooperation and development of the region and the rest of the world. He wished Kim Jong Un good health and bigger success in his noble work. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Autograph Letter from Lao President
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), received an autograph letter from Thongloun Sisoulith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party (LPRP) and president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic (LPDR). Thongloun Sisoulith in his letter expressed his sincere thanks to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un for sending a verbal message to notify the accounts of the 8th Congress of the WPK, and wholeheartedly congratulated once again the congress of the WPK on its commendable successes. He said that he was very pleased to see that the friendly relations of long tradition between Laos and the DPRK provided by the preceding leaders have steadily developed despite the intricate regional and international situation and challenges in the past, adding this is highly considered by him. He notified in detail the accounts of the 11th Congress of the LPRP which was held between January 13 and 15. He said that in the period under review the LPRP led the whole nation and army and all the people overcoming all difficulties in the revolutionary spirit despite complicated situation to accomplish many successes and firmly ensure the political stability of the country, adding that the congress took steps to develop the party into the one upright, strong and sound enough to defend the country and lead the socialist construction in the new period by carrying out the party's political line and spurring the party building. And he noted that the congress adopted the 9th Five-Year Plan for the socio-economic development of the country and set forth it as the supreme goal of the party to steadily consolidate the people's democratic system by respecting the people's rights as the master and making sure they further exercise them, and to rely on the people, guarantee their interests and provide them with happiness. He expressed a firm stand that the Lao party and government would always value the friendly and cooperative relations between the two parties, states and peoples of Laos and the DPRK, which have a long tradition and are based on comradely and fraternal fellowship, and would make all efforts to further develop them, stressing that the LPRP will continuously maintain the external line for peace, independence, friendship, development and cooperation. He invited Kim Jong Un to visit the LPDR at a convenient time, saying that he wholeheartedly hope to meet him. He sincerely wished Kim Jong Un good health, happiness and successes in his noble work of leading the endeavors of the WPK and the Korean people to implement the decisions made at the 8th Congress of the WPK. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Autograph Letter from Raul Castro Ruz
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), received an autograph letter from Raul Castro Ruz. Raul Castro Ruz expressed wholehearted thanks to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un for sending a verbal message to notify the accounts of the 8th Congress of the WPK, and extended greetings to him on behalf of the Communist Party of Cuba and the Cuban people and on his own behalf. He affirmed his will to continue to develop the relations of friendship and cooperation between the two parties and peoples of the two countries, hoping that success will be achieved in the struggle of the WPK and the Korean people to implement the decisions adopted at the 8th Congress of the WPK which came to be a great event. Rodong Sinmun

title: Commuter Boats and Trains Start to Be Operated
body: Jagang Province has started to operate boats and trains for the day pupils and students of schools in Tongsin County, Manpho City and many other mountainous villages. The pupils and students, with schoolbags on their backs, vie with each other to run to the boats and trains and get on them to go to school in delight. Although they are on their way to work pedestrians pause and joyfully look at the children. Our country has built branch schools for the children of remote mountain villages and supplied them with school trains, buses and boasts. The Kyonghung Higher Middle School has a number of children who live in a forestry workers’ village far from it. However, they are careless thanks to their commuter boat. The education of children is the most important national affair in our country, and what is better, the greatest loving care is taken of them. Residents in the province feel very grateful to their socialist system and the Workers’ Party of Korea for the boats and trains for their children. The boats and trains serve the schoolchildren well testifying to our WPK’s love for the younger generation. Rodong Sinmun

title: 87 Model Schools Built in North Phyongan Province
body: The Eighth Party Congress of the Workers’ Party of Korea set forth the task of increasing the investment in and support for the field of education and working hard to build schools and renovate the educational conditions and environment of universities and schools. North Phyongan Province does its part accordingly and scores good successes in its educational work. It buckled down to building scores of model schools last year. It accelerated their construction at full steam this year and successfully completed them. The whole province, including Sinuiju and Jongju Cities and Changsong, Thaechon, Pyoktong, Sonchon and Sakju Counties, was all out to construct schools.
