Sinuiju City finished building the Sinbi Junior Middle School and the Sindo Primary School wonderfully first of all and showed them to others for demonstration’s sake. The result was that the construction of other schools could be stepped up on a high qualitative level. The officials of Thaechon, Sonchon, Sakju and Unsan Counties built flawless schoolhouses anew first and then proceeded to sincerely procure them various sorts of school fixtures, experimental apparatuses and other teaching facilities necessary for multi-functional classrooms. The other cities and counties of the province perseveringly pushed ahead with the construction of their schools despite their manifold difficulties and trials overtaking and outstripping each other, learning from each other and swapping experiences with each other. Consequently, 87 model schools were completed in no more than a year in the province to bring about a new turn in improving its educational conditions and environment. All the new schools opened a few days ago. Teachers, pupils and their parents were greatly moved by the unlimited love of the motherly Party for posterity. Rodong Sinmun

title: Preparations for 10th Congress of Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League Underway
body: Revolutionary enthusiasm of young vanguard run high across the country ahead of the 10th Congress of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League in the middle of the all-people advance for carrying out the decisions made at the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the WPK. The conferences of youth league organizations at all levels were held early in April in the run-up to the 10th Congress. They reviewed the overall work in the period under review in the light of the idea and spirit of the 8th Congress of the WPK and elected the new leadership organs and representatives to be sent to the Congress. The participants came to Pyongyang in the latter half of April and were warmly welcomed by citizens in the streets of the capital city. Officials of the Party Central Committee including Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the WPK Central Committee, and officials of the armed forces organs visited their lodging quarters and cordially congratulated them on their participation in the 10th grand gathering of the Korean youth amid the great trust of the Party Central Committee and the expectations of the young people across the country. The participants took an active part in the technical preparations for the Congress, being deeply cognizant of the importance of the Congress in the journey toward the new victory in building the Korean-style socialism. During the preparations, they visited the time-honored Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. The historical relics and data in careful preservation in the old home in Mangyongdae and the Mangyongdae Revolutionary Museum helped them feel as there is April spring when the sun of Juche rose, there are our country today independent, self-supporting and self-reliant, and its bright future and the eternal happiness of our people. They visited "Hall of Great Leaders and Their Comrades-in-Arms" in the Korean Revolution Museum where they hardened their resolution to uphold in one mind the idea and leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un with loyalty, by carrying forward the sacred history and tradition of the Juche revolution that started and emerged victorious by dint of comradeship. At the Youth Movement Museum they refreshed their pledge to eternally glorify the undying revolutionary exploits the peerlessly great men performed in strengthening the Juche-oriented youth movement and exalt their honor as an advancing group, a wing and a death-defying corps of the Party in the push for materializing the decisions made at the 8th Congress of the Party. They also watched documentary films including "Shining History of Youth Power". They are full of enthusiasm to glorify the coming congress as a significant occasion for demonstrating the revolutionary will and stamina of the Korean youth intensely loyal to the cause of our Party and effecting a fresh turn in the development of the youth league. Rodong Sinmun

title: Choe Ryong Hae Inspects Kangso District
body: Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, inspected the Chongsan Co-op Farm and the Kangso Knitwear Factory in Kangso District. He acquainted himself with the farming and production in those units bustling with the struggle for implementing the decisions of the 8th Congress of the Party and the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee, learning in detail about the law-abiding life of their officials and working people. At the farm, he underlined the need for its officials and agricultural workers to take sci-tech steps and lay material foundations for increasing the stable and sustainable cereal production with a pride of working at a glorious farm visited by the peerlessly great men, thus making good preparations for finishing the urgent rice-transplanting timely. Looking round different shops of the knitwear factory, he called for taking it as an important management strategy to realize home-production of raw materials and promote recycling, as intended by the Party, and for gaining substantial successes in production by mapping out scientific, feasible and dynamic plans. During the inspection, he also called for conducting education of different forms in various ways to promote the law-abiding spirit of officials and working people, stressing the importance of the work for thoroughly establishing the revolutionary law-abiding climate in the socialist construction. Rodong Sinmun

title: Participants in 10th Congress of Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League Visit Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: The participants in the 10th Congress of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, where President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il lie in state, to pay homage to them. The participants who visited the supreme temple of Juche were full of deep yearning and boundless reverence for the great leaders who brought up a legion of young people for firmly giving a steady continuity to the revolutionary cause of Juche by leading the Korean youth movement along the road of brilliant victory and glory with their unique idea of attaching importance to the youth and their wise guidance. The participants paid high tribute, looking up to the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il, pioneer and leader of the Juche-oriented youth movement, reflective of the unanimous mind of the youth across the country. In the immortality halls where the great leaders lie in state, the participants paid tribute in the deepest reverence for the great leaders who set it as one of the most important state affairs and a strategic line of the revolution to give priority to the youth and brought up the young people as vanguard fighters of the revolution and main players of the times with great trust and loving care. All the participants hardened their firm will to defend and glorify the Party's idea on the youth movement and exploits performed under its leadership, fully display the might as vanguard and shock brigade in the grand revolutionary advance for implementing the decisions made at the Eighth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea, upholding the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un with loyalty. Rodong Sinmun

title: Founding Anniversary of KPRA Commemorated in DPRK
body: The 89th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army (KPRA) was significantly celebrated in the DPRK. Many people visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the supreme temple of Juche where President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il lie in state. At the plaza of the palace, they made a bow before the portraits of the smiling President and Chairman. Service personnel and people visited the statues of the great leaders and mosaics portraying their smiling images on Mansu Hill and other parts of the country looked back upon the revolutionary careers of the peerlessly great men which will shine forever along with the history of building the Juche-based revolutionary armed forces. Art performances were given at theaters and outdoor stages in Pyongyang. A concert was given by the National Symphony Orchestra at Moranbong Theatre, music and dance performance by the National Folk Art Troupe at the Ponghwa Art Theatre and a revolutionary drama "Blood at an International Conference" at the National Theatre. A combined acrobatic performance was given by the National Acrobatic Troupe to please the citizens. National art troupes and art squads, art squads and itinerant art squads of Pyongyang gave outdoor performances to rev up the festive atmosphere. Similar performances were given in North and South Phyongan provinces, North Hwanghae Province and North and South Hamgyong provinces. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: All the service personnel of the People's Army and the people in the DPRK, commemorating the 89th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army, are paying the highest tribute to President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il who founded the first Juche-type revolutionary armed forces in the flames of the anti-Japanese war and provided a history and tradition of invincibility. On this significant day service personnel of the People's Army, working people, youth and students laid floral baskets before the statues of the great leaders in different parts of the country. Placed before the statues of the great leaders on Mansu Hill were bouquets and floral baskets in the names of Party, power and armed forces organs, public organizations, ministries, national institutions, units of the Korean People's Army (KPA) and the Public Security Forces (PSF), and organs, enterprises, factories and universities at different levels in Pyongyang. The visitors made a deep bow before the statues. Placed before the statues of the great leaders in Kim Il Sung University, the Ministry of National Defence, the Ministry of Public Security, the Mansudae Art Studio and other parts of the capital city and mosaics portraying their smiling images were bouquets and floral baskets in the names of units of KPA and PSF, organs, enterprises, etc. KPA service personnel, working people, youth and students in other parts of the country visited the statues of the great leaders and mosaics portraying their smiling images in their residential areas to pay homage. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Reply Message to Syrian President
body: Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a reply message to Bashar Al-Assad, president of the Syrian Arab Republic, on April 24. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un in his message expressed deep thanks to Bashar Al-Assad for sending the warmest congratulations to him on the occasion of the 109th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Expressing the belief that the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation between the two countries would grow stronger in the joint struggle for safeguarding independence and peace, Kim Jong Un wished the president good health and bigger success in his responsible work. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Ambassador Presents Credentials to Croatian President
body: DPRK Ambassador Ri Pyong Du presented his credentials to Zoran Milanovic, president of the Republic of Croatia, on April 20. The president hoped that everything would go well and good successes be made in the DPRK. Rodong Sinmun

title: Kim Tok Hun Inspects North Phyongan Province
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected the agricultural field in North Phyongan Province. He looked round organic compound fertilizer factories, several co-op farms and farming material exchange agencies in Nyongbyon, Pakchon, Thaechon, Unjon and Kwaksan counties and Jongju City. At the organic compound fertilizer factories he stressed the importance of producing and applying a great amount of quality organic compound fertilizer to achieve this year's goal for grain production. He called for giving precedence to procuring raw materials and promptly sending fertilizers fully commensurate with technical specifications to farms. He cited the necessity to enhance the role of the functionaries of primary organizations of farms so that the advantages of the field-responsibility-system are fully demonstrated within the framework of the sub-workteam management system, and to tend seedbeds in a scientific and technical way based on last year's farming experience and lesson. He mentioned the need for the officials to take the viewpoint that a key to high-yielding lies in scientific farming, and to lay material and technical foundation for ensuring secure grain production through quality-guaranteed river improvement and dredging while actively drawing on advanced farming method to low-yielding fields. The consultative meeting held on the spot discussed the technical issues for agricultural guidance officials in the province to take transparent ideological standpoint to devotedly carry out the Party policy, provide responsible farming operation and command for implementing the decisions made at the 8th Congress of the Party and the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Party and to ensure timely supply of farming materials. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Reply Message from Syrian President
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, received a reply message from Bashar Al-Assad, president of the Syrian Arab Republic, on April 25. The Syrian president in the message expressed his thanks to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un for sending congratulations on the occasion of the national day of Syria. The message expressed the will to develop the bilateral relations in all fields and boost the mutual cooperation in the interests of the peoples of the two friendly countries. Rodong Sinmun

title: Young People in North Hwanghae Province Volunteer to Work in Difficult and Labor-consuming Fields
body: Since the end of the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, over 150 young people in North Hwanghae Province have volunteered to work in difficult and labor-consuming fields of the national economy including collieries, mines and co-operative farms. More than 110 young people in Songrim City volunteered to work at the Kim Jin Youth Shock Brigade of the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex and devoted themselves to the project for expanding the capacity of producing Juche iron. Young people in Koksan, Unpha and Thosan counties volunteered to work at the Komdok Mining Complex and the Songnam Youth Coal Mine. Those in Sariwon City and Junghwa and Singye counties volunteered to work at co-operative farms in the province. They were given a warm send-off by officials and young people in the province. Rodong Sinmun

title: Potatoes Begin to Be Planted in Ryanggang Province
body: In Ryanggang Province potato farms are busy with their immediate farm work. Awakened to the importance of the farming for the first year of another five-year plan, the officials and agricultural workers of the province energetically sow potatoes in their fields in full swing to reap a bumper harvest this year. The officials dynamically arrange for potatoes to be sown in fields in the right season on the spot and also direct the work of sowers. Honored with the immortal leadership of the Party, Samjiyon City plants the fields of its farms with potatoes in high spirits from the outset. The officials and farmers of Taehongdan County are also all out to sow potatoes in the fields of their farms. Paekam County, which was visited by Chairman Kim Jong Il for firsthand leadership, focuses its labor and farm machines on farms in its Tokpho area and ensures that great results are registered in sowing potatoes in their fields. The fields of the farms of the province are successfully sown with potatoes one after another day by day by the devoted efforts of its officials and agricultural workers and with the sincere help of relevant units. Rodong Sinmun

title: Favors Given to the Aged
body: In our socialist system centered on the people the state takes direct responsibility for the health and life of the aged and looks after them. Our country adopted "the Socialist Constitution of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea" and "the Public Health Law of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea" scores of years ago. It is provided in them that all citizens shall be given universal free medical services and that aged patients in particular shall be taken responsible care of so that they can benefit from free medical treatment well. "The DPRK Law on Care of the Aged" was adopted on April 26, 2007 to provide a firm legal guarantee for their good living conditions. The law stipulates that the state shall supply the aged with all conditions for them to be able to fulfill their position and role as the forerunners of the revolution and the seniors of society and their families. Under the benevolent socialist system the state assumes full responsibility for the destiny of the people and warmly looks after them. Accordingly, the aged are protected in our country under the concern of the whole nation and entire society. Sanatoriums for war veterans and rest homes for the aged are built all over the country to take warm care of them every day. In the DPRK the state provides the people with the most valuable and worthwhile lives and the latter work body and soul to uphold their social system. This is the true image of the best socialism of our style. Rodong Sinmun

title: Korean Committee on Measures for Sexual Slavery for Japanese Army and Drafting Victims Blames Japan for Not Setting Right Past Crimes
body: A spokesman for the Korean Committee on Measures for the Sexual Slavery for Japanese Army and Drafting Victims released a statement on Wednesday, on the lapse of 25 years since the publication of the report of a special rapporteur on "wartime sexual slavery system". Released at the 52nd meeting of the UN Commission on Human Rights (UN Human Rights Council at present) in April 1996 was the report on "wartime sexual slavery system" by the special rapporteur that recommended the Japanese government to make efforts for the settlement of the sexual slavery issue. The report, based on the probing of the victims and related persons of the DPRK, Japan and south Korea, suggested six recommendations including the issue for the Japanese government to acknowledge the illegitimacy of the establishment of "comfort stations" and to make reparations to the victims out of legal responsibility, the issue of revealing all related documents and materials and making open written apology to the victims, the issue of reflecting historic fact in education courses and finding out and punishing criminals, saying that term "wartime sexual slavery system" is more appropriate than the term "comfort women". According to the statement, the report aroused full support and sympathy from broad international community as well as from the victims and the victimized countries immediately after its publication and was acknowledged as a landmark document rejecting violence against women and propelling the movement for safeguarding human rights worldwide. But nothing has been done for the settlement of the sexual slavery for the Japanese army by the Japanese government, 25 years since the publication of the report. What is done is only the tricky act to evade the responsibility of the Japanese state by creating the civilian-veiled "Asian peace people's fund for women" which is not even acknowledged by the victims, and the shameful act to delete the crimes by writing off the statements about sexual slavery from the textbooks of Japan. If the past is not properly set right and proper lessons are not drawn from history, crimes are bound to repeat themselves. Whatever option it may take, Japan can never get rid of its responsibility for the hideous state-sponsored crimes wantonly violating international law and human ethics including the sexual slavery of the Japanese army, and that the more Japan tries to evade its responsibility, the higher the international voices blaming and criticizing it will be. Rodong Sinmun

title: 10th Congress of Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League Opens
body: The 10th Congress of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League was opened in Pyongyang, the capital of the DPRK, on April 27. The congress is to comprehensively analyze and review in depth the youth league work during the period under review, take practical measures for bringing about a fundamental turn in the youth league work and discuss the tasks and ways for the youth league organizations and young people to thoroughly carry out the decisions made at the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the WPK. It was announced at the congress that the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un was presented with silk banners by the Central Standing Committee of the Korean Youth League in Japan and the Association of Young Korean Nationals in China on the occasion of the 10th Congress of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League. The congress approved the following agenda items: Review of the work of the Central Committee of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League Review of the work of the Central Inspection Commission of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League On renaming the youth league On revising the rules of the youth league Election of the central leadership organ of the youth league Pak Chol Min, chairman of the Central Committee of the youth league, made a report on the first agenda item. The reporter said that the congress is convened amid the great trust of Kim Jong Un who sets the youth work as the important work concerning the future of the Party, state and our-style socialism and the eternal strategic line of revolution. He noted that for the past five years since the end of the 9th Congress of the youth league, the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un has energetically led the youth league to develop it into the eternal youth league of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, as required by the new era of the Juche revolution, and to make sure that it demonstrates its might as the advancing group and wing of the Party. He said that the achievements made in the youth league work are entirely the bright fruition of the great leadership provided by the General Secretary who set the youth issue as a vital issue decisive of the destinies of the Party and the revolution and put his heart and soul into leading the youth league work step by step. He emphasized that the youth league faces the honorable task to fully demonstrate its militant power as the successors and reserves of the WPK in the all-out advance for carrying out the great fighting programme set forth at the 8th Congress of the WPK and at the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the WPK. He seriously analyzed and reviewed in detail the mistakes youth league organizations made by failing to push forward with the work of increasing their militant might in every way as required by their duty as organizations for ideological education in the period under review. He called for taking substantial measures to set right the mistakes latent in the youth league work in order to ensure that the league creditably fulfills its mission and duty for the times and the revolution. He called on the youth league organizations at all levels to hold fast to the important tasks set forth by the General Secretary at the 8th Congress of the WPK as immortal guidelines for effecting a fundamental turn in the youth league work and to go all out for implementing them. He said that they should eternally hold President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in high esteem as the sun of Juche and place above all and perfectly carry on the work of devotedly defending the absolute authority of the Party Central Committee. He emphasized the need to channel great efforts into building up the primary organizations of the youth league to be robust ones and steadily enhancing their function and role. He stressed the need for the organizations of the youth league to fully prepare the schoolchildren to be competent revolutionary talents and young revolutionaries, qualified intellectually, morally and physically, who will successfully carry forward the baton of the Juche revolution. He urged the officials of the youth league to become the locomotives leading the young people to always advance straight ahead following the Party as the reliable successors to the revolution, bearing deep in mind that whether or not the youth work is successfully carried out depends entirely on them. He said that the youth league organizations should wage a revolutionary ideological offensive, offensive defense and intensive struggle to root out the anti- and non-socialist practices and establish the socialist lifestyle. He stressed the need for the youth league organizations to inspire the youth to creating new standards and records and renewing them in the struggle for carrying out the new 5-year plan. He ardently appealed to all the young people to dynamically struggle for achieving a new victory of the socialist cause and the revolutionary cause of Juche, saying that only victory and glory are in store for the youth league and the youth led by Kim Jong Un. Speeches were made on the first agenda item. Speakers were Kim Chung Song, a delegate from the youth league organizations of the Korean People's Army, Pak Myong Jin and Paek Hak Ryong, delegates from the youth league organizations of Pyongyang City, and Han In Chol, a delegate from the youth league organizations of the High-Speed Youth Shock Brigade. Present at the congress were the delegates elected by the youth league organizations at all levels. Also present there as observers were officials of the Party and armed forces organs and officials in the field of education of young people and schoolchildren. Taking the platform were Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, Kim Jae Ryong, department director of the Central Committee of the WPK, and Kwon Yong Jin, director of the General Political Bureau of the Korean People's Army, who are members of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, officials of the executive committee of the Central Committee of the youth league, chairpersons of the provincial youth league committees, exemplary officials and members of the youth league, officials in charge of the youth work in the armed forces organs and soldiers. The congress continues. Rodong Sinmun

title: Devotion to War Veterans
body: A female war veteran named Choe Song Ok resides in Neighborhood-Unit 47, Ryonhwa-dong 2 in Central District. According to her, she is said to boast many children although she has a son and a daughter. They include Hyon Yong Ok and other employees of the Ryonhwa Grocery 2. They have been intimate with the war veteran for ten years. She was distinguished as “the lightning in the night sky” during the fierce war days. Since they got to know her the employees of the RG 2 have freely visited her on holidays and other ordinary days to take utmost care of her health and living conditions as if they were her daughters. Suit is followed by the officials of the Ministry of External Economic Relations and Sin Jong Sim, a teacher at the Ryonhwa Kindergarten in Central District. Although they have their hands full with their work the officials call on her any time and kindly help her in her housekeeping like her real children. The teacher, too, pleases her like her granddaughter. All the volunteers say that it is their bounden duty to take good care of the war veterans treasured by the Workers’ Party of Korea very much and that they earnestly wish them good health and longevity alone. They get more devoted than ever to the war veterans with the passage of time. Jang Ho Yong and his wife by the name of Kim Yun Mi reside in Neighborhood Unit 11, Saebyok-dong, Songrim City. They take whole-hearted care of Kyong Jin Yong, a war veteran who lives in their neighborhood. Like his real son and daughter they congratulate him on his birthday every year, procure him tonics for his health during their business trips and do all they can to prevent him losing his appetite. The employees of the Poultry Fodder Institute of the Academy of Poultry Science of the Ministry of Agriculture also look after a war veteran body and soul. He is Sang Mun Gil and resides in Konguk-dong, Mangyongdae District. The officials of the institute were informed of Sang by their employees last year. They visited him at his house, got detailed firsthand knowledge of his health and living conditions and gave their word that they would often visit him with their employees. Afterwards, they enrolled him in their institute as an honorary employee. They have since frequented him on holidays and other ordinary days, presented him with the goods they secured with sincerity and also sung songs to him so that he can lead an optimistic life. Rodong Sinmun

title: His Devotion to a Patient
body: One day the Kim Man Yu Hospital received a letter from Kung Un Sil, a resident in the 13th Neighborhood Unit, Paekun-dong, Kusong City. In the letter she expressed her heartfelt gratitude to its doctors for all they did selflessly to resuscitate her. When Kung Un Sil entered the hospital its doctor named Ri Song Jin read her case history sheet and knew that she suffered from cardiac mitral stenosis and many other complications as well. Worse still, she was in bad health. It went without saying that she must go under the knife. It would be difficult and complex, but her life could hardly be guaranteed. Ri Song Jin worried about her very much. But a doctor can restore patients to life when he is quite devoted to them. Doctors shoulder responsibilities to the Party for the health of the people under our socialist system centered on them. It is therefore their sacred duty to revive patients. Ri Song Jin made up his mind to resuscitate without fail the patient who join together to follow the road of the revolution under the care of the Party and formulated a plan to cure her of a heart disease. He did his best to improve the health of Kung Un Sil. It gradually changed for the better so she finally became able to be operated on for the heart. Prior to his operation, he met her confidently as always and encouragingly reassured her that she would see off her son with joy when he joined the army and left home and should trust him and other doctors. The operation ended in success beyond expectation and it was possible to guarantee her life. However, she was in a coma. Steady efforts were made every moment to revive her. Ri Song Jin watched Kung Un Sil all the time at her bed taking necessary measures to restore her to her senses. The day she moved to her sickroom from a resuscitation room she felt as if in a dream and said repeatedly: “Thank you.” In her letter Kung Un Sil most sincerely thanked the socialist system under which the people-centered policies of the Workers’ Party of Korea have been embodied for bringing her back to life while speaking highly of the doctors of the hospital. Rodong Sinmun

title: Internet Seminar Held to Commemorate Day of Sun
body: An internet seminar on the theme "The great leader President Kim Il Sung will always be alive in the hearts of the Korean people and world progressive people" took place on the occasion of the Day of the Sun, birth anniversary of the President, under the sponsorship of the Korean Friendship Association. Posted on the homepage which was established for the seminar was an art work portraying the President finding himself among the people. Also posted there were works of the President and other books and written speeches praising his revolutionary life and exploits. Figures of the organizations for friendship and solidarity with the Korean people in Switzerland, Britain, Spain, Finland, Brazil, Argentina and other countries in their speeches praised the President for founding the immortal Juche idea, thoroughly applying it to the revolution and construction, dedicating himself to the prosperity of the country and happiness of the people and the accomplishment of global independence throughout his life. They lauded Chairman Kim Jong Il, who faithfully carried forward the revolutionary cause of the President, for smashing the imperialists' moves to isolate and stifle the DPRK, defending the sovereignty of the country and providing solid foundations for building a powerful socialist country by enforcing the unique Songun politics. They stressed that under the sagacious and seasoned leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, the revolutionary lives and exploits of the President and the Chairman are being glorified century after century. They expressed their conviction that the Korean people's cause of building a powerful socialist country is sure to be accomplished as they are led by Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Floral Basket and Congratulatory Letter from Indian Ambassador
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a floral basket and a congratulatory letter from Atul Malhari Gotsurve, Indian ambassador to the DPRK, on the occasion of May Day, the international holiday of the working people all over the world. The floral basket and congratulatory letter were conveyed to an official concerned on April 29. Rodong Sinmun

title: Kim Tok Hun Inspects Third and Fourth Districts of Ryongmaedo Tideland
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the DPRK, looked round the completed third and fourth districts of Ryongmaedo Tideland. The premier was accompanied by officials of South Hwanghae Province and relevant units. Officials and workers of the South Hwanghae Provincial Tideland Reclamation General Enterprise completed the third and fourth districts of Ryongmaedo Tideland by dint of their spirit of self-reliance through indomitable struggle, true to our Party's far-reaching grand nature-remaking plan, thus securing thousands of hectares of new land. Going round the endless stretch of the anti-tidal dike of the tideland, he gave pep talks to the builders who created eternal wealth for the country's prosperity by devotedly implementing the Party's policies with a single mind of loyalty that the DPRK puts into practice anything once it is planned and determined by the Party Central Committee. He instructed officials to inform the relevant units of the completion. He stressed the need to make substantial contributions to the agricultural production of the country by introducing the strain highly resistant to salt. He took measures to proactively introduce the advanced methods and technical means into future reclamation projects to speed up construction with fewer materials. He called on the builders to steadily push ahead with tideland reclamation, the patriotic work of lasting significance, and thus make a tangible contribution to implementing the decisions made at the 8th Congress of the Party, bearing in mind the noble intention of the Party to bring about a decisive turn in the agricultural development of the country and food supply for the people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Youth League Renamed
body: A resolution of the 10th Congress of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League "On renaming the youth league" was adopted on April 28. The struggle for winning a fresh victory in the socialist construction is a sacred patriotic struggle for realizing the noble patriotic desire of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un for building a powerful country, the resolution said. It noted that it is the honorable task and bounden duty of our youths before the times and the revolution to make the breakthrough of advance in the van of this struggle. It is the unanimous will, desire and aspiration of all the youth league officials and the youths to enshrine the firm faith in validity and victory of the socialist cause and keep to the path of our own-style socialism to the last by dedicating their patriotic blood and sweat under the leadership of Kim Jong Un, the resolution said. Kim Jong Un saw to it that the youth league is renamed the Socialist Patriotic Youth League (SPYL), deeply considerate of the fresh requirements of the Korean revolution and development of the youth movement, and the unanimous will and desire of the youth league officials and the youths, it noted. It said that the name SPYL clearly reflects the essence and patriotic nature of the youth league, and means that it is the reserve force for the socialist construction. It stressed that the SPYL will regard it as its general goal and general task to model the whole league on Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism and regard the loyalty to Kim Jong Un as its lifeline. It will certainly accomplish the revolutionary cause of Juche pioneered on Mt Paektu generation after generation, enshrining the immutable faith that the eternal happiness and rosy future lie in upholding with loyalty and following Kim Jong Un, the great leader of our Party, state and armed forces and the banner of victory and glory of our people who ushers in a new heyday of the Juche-oriented youth movement while bringing up the youths to be the reserves of the Party and advancing group for the socialist construction with great care after setting it as the strategic line of the Party to value the youths, the resolution said. Rodong Sinmun

title: 10th Congress of Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League Closes
body: The 10th Congress of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League closed on April 29 after successfully completing its schedule amid extraordinary political awareness and enthusiasm of its participants. The congress, which lasted for three days, discussed in depth the measures to bring about a fundamental turn in the youth league work by thoroughly applying the main idea and spirit of the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea, and adopted relevant decisions. Speeches on the first agenda item continued at the congress. Speakers referred to the achievements and experiences made by the youth in their endeavors to creditably fulfill the sacred mission and duty of defending the country, people and revolution while opening up the breakthrough of advance in the difficult and labor-consuming fields, true to the appeal made by the Party. The congress comprehensively analyzed and reviewed the mistakes found in the youth league work in the period under review, and their reasons. The speakers evinced their pledges to redouble efforts to carry out the league building and activities thoroughly in line with the Party's idea and intention with fresh resolution and preparedness. The congress heard a report on the second agenda item "Review of the work of the Central Inspection Commission of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League" to be followed by speeches. A resolution was adopted with the unanimous approval. The congress discussed the third agenda item "On renaming the youth league". A resolution on renaming the youth league the "Socialist Patriotic Youth League" was adopted with the unanimous approval of the representatives. Then discussed was the fourth agenda item "On revising the rules of the youth league". There was a report on revising the rules of the youth league. The reporter summarized the contents of the rules to be revised and supplemented in conformity with the new fighting tasks facing the youth league, the requirements of the developing revolution and the principle of building the youth league. Stressing that the revised rules of the youth league reflect the actual requirements for raising the fighting efficiency of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League, the reserves of the Workers' Party of Korea, in every way, he brought the revised and supplemented rules to the congress for examination. A resolution on revising the rules of the youth league was adopted with the unanimous approval of the representatives. The congress discussed the fifth agenda item "On election of the central leadership organ of the youth league". First, it elected the central committee of the youth league. All the nominees were elected members and alternate members of the Central Committee of the youth league with the unanimous approval of the representatives. Then there was the first plenary meeting of the 10th Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League. Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, announced the decision made at the plenary meeting. The Executive Committee of the Central Committee of the youth league was elected. Mun Chol was elected chairman of the Central Committee of the youth league and Ri Ju Chol, Pak Myong Jin, Pae Chung Il, Paek Hak Ryong, Kang Yong Jin, Jang Ryong Gil, Kim Song Il, Kim Kyong Jun and Ham Kwang Chol vice-chairmen. The Organizing Committee of the Central Committee of the youth league was made up. The chairman, vice-chairman and members of the Central Inspection Commission of the youth league were elected. Department directors of the Central Committee of the youth league and the editor-in-chief of the Chongnyon Jonwi Office were appointed. The congress elected the committee for drafting the resolution of the congress with newly-elected members of the 10th central leadership organ of the youth league and the committee comprehensively examined the draft resolution on the first agenda item. A resolution on the first agenda item "Review on the work of the Central Committee of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League", which was supplemented with creative and constructive views of the delegates, was adopted with the unanimous approval of the representatives. Upon authorization of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Ri Il Hwan, member of the Political Bureau and secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, conferred the flag of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League. Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Political Bureau and department director of the Central Committee of the WPK, conveyed the important letter sent by Kim Jong Un to the Congress "Demonstrate to the Full the Might of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League on the Historic March towards a Fresh Victory in the Revolution". In the letter Kim Jong Un warmly congratulated in the name of the WPK Central Committee the 10th Congress of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League on making significant achievements for renovation and development of the youth league work amid high display of unusual revolutionary enthusiasm of Korean youths dynamically advancing along the path of new advance indicated by the 8th Congress of the WPK. The letter said that it is the incomparably great asset and the greatest pride for our Party to have promising main force made up of young people who are forming a fortress around the Party which is leading the revolution to make a leaping progress despite the worst challenges, subordinating their ambition and ideal to realizing the Party's plan and dashing forward through thin and thick. Kim Jong Un said in the letter that the Party Central Committee set a goal of bringing about landmark development in our-style socialist construction, counting on the strong desire and inexhaustible strength of youths, and clarified slogans to be held fast to by the Socialist Patriotic Youth League in opening up a great heyday of the Korean youth movement while strikingly demonstrating its militant might in the new historic advance of the revolution, and important tasks facing the youth league. Rodong Sinmun

title: Their Work Found by Conjugal Drivers Worthwhile
body: Kim Chol Nam and Jin Chun Sim are husband and wife. They are drivers at the Rangnang Tram Station in Pyongyang. Unlike the others, the drivers of the RTS cannot afford to enjoy themselves happily on holidays and off days owing to their passenger traffic in Pyongyang. But the couple chose to drive streetcars of their own will and have faithfully applied themselves to their work since then. Jin Chun Sim was employed in the RTS and functioned as a conductress of a streetcar after she left her secondary school more than a decade ago. In those days she was informed by the officials of the RTS that President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il did their utmost to settle the problem of passenger traffic in Pyongyang and benefit its citizens. She determined to devote her all to enabling the people to enjoy our Party’s love for them and became a streetcar driver of her own accord. She tried her hardest to be a good driver. Sometimes she burnt the midnight oil joining the repairmen of her RTS to repair her streetcar to run it on a normal footing. Moreover, she did not go home after the day’s shift work on many occasions but went on with her streetcar service to master operational skill. The repairmen of the RTS were quite ready to show her a kindness. They told her that they would check and repair her streetcar and earnestly asked her to go back home. But she turned them down replying that she was the master and driver of her streetcar and should check and repair it herself. She joined them in maintaining her streetcar without hesitation. Kim Chol Nam volunteered to work at the RTS when he was discharged from military service more than ten years ago. He was firmly resolved to serve the people devotedly the way he did so during his army life. He drove his streetcar all day long day by day and also improved his repair capability in a short period of time. He not only repaired his streetcar but also took it upon himself to maintain other streetcars, too. Consequently, Kim Chol Nam and Jin Chun Sim were distinguished as model drivers. They got tied to each other by assiduity and finally fell in love with each other. The day they were united in marriage Jin Chun Sim told Kim Chol Nam that she would remain a streetcar driver all her life. Kim Chol Nam fully endorsed this. They did their best day and night to perform their duties well every day. Consequently they always led all their fellow drivers of the Pyongyang Municipal General Passenger Transport Enterprise in taking good care of streetcars whenever their technological conditions were judged. They were never indifferent to all their passengers. Many of them became the old acquaintances of the couple. They included heroes, deputies to the Supreme People’s Assembly of the DPRK, scientists, researchers and many labor innovators. When passengers reported for work and went back home from it by streetcar talking about successes in their work Kim Chol Nam and Jin Chun Sim were pleased with them and took a pride in that they helped them in and out of work by dint of labor. Rodong Sinmun

title: What Should Be Bequeathed to Posterity
body: An out-of-the-way mountain village situated far away from the township of Sinphyong County boasts a forest of pine-nut trees. It is the fruition of the unselfish patriotic devotion of a veteran member of the Workers’ Party of Korea to posterity. Her name is Jang Pok Sun, a resident in Tongmun-dong 2, Taedonggang District, Pyongyang. She was born in Taeji-ri, Sinphyong County. She joined the Korean People’s Army at the age of 17 after her graduation from a middle school. After her discharge from military service she faithfully worked as a labor innovator, a skilled worker, a workteam leader and a cell secretary of the WPK. She thought of her future work a lot when she became a pensioner. Several days after she visited her hometown she left long ago. She took a bird’s eye view of it on a hill with emotion. When her eyes rested on its dear mountains her face shadowed with pity because they were almost denuded of trees. They had been thickly wooded when she left home in her girlhood. She made up her mind to reforest the mountains to remain a conscientious patriot not only to her children but also to the future generations of her hometown. Despite her old age, for many years she had since shuttled quite a distance between Pyongyang and Sinphyong County and between the county and the mountains of Taeji-ri. Whenever she went to Taeji-ri she carried young pine-nut trees to its mountains on her back and planted them there. They total up to tens of thousands. All the inhabitants of Sinphyong County know her. When she calls at the hometown with young pine-nut trees all its residents welcome her there. Even the members of the Korean Children’s Union there follow suit addressing her as an old patriot. The officials and other ordinary people of the county make great strides forward toward national prosperity emulating the devotion of Jang Bok Sun to the pine-nut trees in the county and Taeji-ri from the viewpoint of conscience. Not only our revolutionary predecessors but also we should, first of all, bequeath our boundless loyalty to the Party and the leader and the spirit of noble love for and great devotion to the country to our rising generations. Rodong Sinmun

title: Three Decades vs Six Years
body: Late in the spring of 1958 young people arrived in the northern section of the country in hearty response to the appeal of President Kim Il Sung to build the Kanggye Youth Power Station. As ever, its mountain peaks were capped by snow. Worse still, they were faced with overlapping difficulties. But they courageously tunneled into a mountain and built a water channel. Although a river flew in torrents they excavated its bed to build the foundations of a dam. One day they came across soft rocks 24m in width. The young people were all firmly determined to remove the soft rocks without fail despite their size. They built a catchment basin to dispose of the soft rocks in less difficult conditions. They conducted a vigorous technological innovation drive and worked like heroes, thereby hitting their target in eight months although it was believed that it would take them two years. Besides, the young people moved a winch up to a tall steep mountain fastening iron ropes to it and pulling them with their hands. They laid two-tiered rails in a water tunnel to carry dead rock out of it on ground rails and carry aggregate into it on upper rails. The result was that they fulfilled their daily plan by 500%. They ultimately completed the KYPS in no more than six years although during their colonial rule over Korea the Japanese invaders alleged that it could not be built even in three decades. Rodong Sinmun

title: Short Course for Participants in 10th Congress of Youth League Given
body: A short course for the participants in the 10th Congress of the youth league was given in Pyongyang on April 30. The short course dealt with the practical issues of making the youth league play its role well as the vanguard of our Party in the implementation of the decisions of the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) by bringing about fundamental innovations in the work of the youth league as required by the new stage of the developing revolution. Ri Il Hwan, member of the Political Bureau and secretary of the WPK Central Committee, gave a lecture titled "On making sure that the participants in the congress fulfill their responsibility and duty in the struggle for the implementation of the decisions of the 10th congress of the youth league." The short course stressed the importance of regarding it as the lifeline of the youth league to thoroughly establish the unified leadership system of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un throughout the youth league. The speaker underlined the need to intensify the work for establishing the unified leadership system of the General Secretary, deeming it a vital issue related to the destiny of the youth league and the young people and a basic principle of the work and activity of the youth league. He called for absolutizing the prestige of the General Secretary, defending the prestige in every way and preserving and glorifying the leadership feats of the Party. And he underscored the need to purposefully and scrupulously organize the work for implementing the Party policies and establish iron discipline and order for doing so. The short course urged the participants in the congress to seriously accept the decisions of the 10th Youth League Congress as the supreme tasks of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League for carrying out the plan and intention of the Party Central Committee. It also called on them to put their heart and soul into the work of the youth league with a determination to have loyalty and executive ability proved through practical struggle. The lecturer urged all the youth league organizations and their officials to conduct the political work in a unique manner so as to touch the young people, scrupulously organize the work for implementing the five-year plan, and display high control ability, effective leadership and strong executive power of the youth league officials. And he stressed the need for the entire Party and the whole society to positively help the youth league work and pay much attention to the youth education. The short course underlined the need for the entire youth league to deeply study the letter sent by Kim Jong Un to the congress and thoroughly carry out the important tasks advanced in the letter so as to bring about a great revolutionary turn in the work of the youth league. Rodong Sinmun

title: Art Performance Given for Participants in 10th Congress of Youth League
body: The participants in the 10th congress of the youth league enjoyed a performance "We Will Travel One Road Forever under Leadership of Party Central Committee" given by the art squad of the Central Committee of the youth league at the Central Youth Hall on April 30. Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, enjoyed the performance. Through the performance which began with chorus "Glory to General Kim Jong Un" and "March of Korean Youth", the performers sang highly of the exploits of the peerlessly great men who created a new history of the Juche-oriented youth movement and led it only to victory and glory. Touching the heartstrings of the audience were numbers that impressively represented the noble love of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il who set it as the most important state affair and the strategic line of the revolution to give importance to the young people and brought them up to be the most vibrant unit of society and vanguard fighters of the revolution. There were numbers that showed the revolutionary zeal and optimism of the young people performing great feats on the road for the country's prosperity, following the fighting spirit of the young people of the preceding generation who built monuments of heroic feats on this land. The performance ended with choral recitation of poem "We Are Successors of Revolution" and chorus "We Will Defend General Kim Jong Un with Our Lives". Rodong Sinmun

title: Tens of Youth Shock Forces Fulfill Their National Economic Plan for First Half of 2021 in Sector of Coal Industry
body: Youth shock forces do their parts briskly in the realm of the coal industry, the forward base for our independent economic development. Tens of youth shock forces executed their national economic plans for the first half of 2021 ahead of schedule in the sector of the coal industry. The young people of the Sunchon Area Youth Coal Mining Complex took the lead in making a breakthrough in the increased production of their coal and went all out to mass-produce coal. Many shock forces like the Kim Jin Youth Shock Force of the Tokchon Area Coal Mining Complex and the Ri Su Bok Youth Shock Force of the Tokchon Coal Mine worked in shifts twice a day, helped their relieves in their work under the slogan “One for all and all for one!”. The result was that they admirably topped their national economic plans for the first half of 2021. The shock forces of many coal mines of the Kaechon and Anju Area Coal Mining Complexes, including the Cha Kwang Su Youth Shock Forces of Jagang Province’s coalmine and the Pongchon and Ripsok Coal Mines and the Kim Hyok Youth Shock Force of the Hwaphung Coal Mine, overfulfilled their national economic plans for the first half of 2021 by successively drilling and blasting rocks for purposes of coal production despite their manifold difficulties. The youth shock forces of many coal mining complexes such as the Pukchang Area Youth Coal Mining Complex and the Tukjang and Kangdong Area Coal Mining Complexes tunneled their coalfaces with great youthful wisdom and courage more speedily than ever under the Party policy of giving priority to tunneling and securing many coalfields and thus carried out their national economic plans for the first half of 2021. Rodong Sinmun

title: Pledge Meeting of Youth Held
body: A meeting of the young vanguard was held at Kim Il Sung Stadium on April 30 to vow to fully display the might of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League under the leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. Present there were Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), delegates to the 10th Congress of the youth league and youth and students in Pyongyang City. There was a report by Mun Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League, to be followed by pledge speeches by Kim Song Hyok, chairman of the North Hamgyong Provincial Committee of the youth league, Ri Kum Hyok, chairman of the North Phyongan Province Unjon County Committee of the youth league, and Kim Chong Song, chairman of the Kim Il Sung University Committee of the youth league. They said that the immense trust placed by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un in the young people by giving important guidelines for strengthening the Juche-oriented youth movement and by having a significant photo taken with the participants in the congress led five million young vanguard to display their fighting spirit and courage like an erupting volcano. They stressed the need for all the youth league officials and young people to powerfully demonstrate the invincible might of the youth league, successor and reserve of the WPK and a shock brigade of socialist construction, in the new historic advance of our revolution. They pledged to consolidate the Socialist Patriotic Youth League into the vanguard organization of loyalists who breathe and act in line with the idea and will of Kim Jong Un and become passionate loyalists who unconditionally carry out the Party's plans and determinations through thick and thin. They underscored the need for the youth to leave their clear footprints in the most difficult sites of the economic construction and make the whole country be enlivened with the youth under the uplifted slogan "Let us demonstrate the mettle of patriotic youth in the worthwhile struggle for socialist construction!" They called on all the young people to consider it as the noblest duty and the greatest patriotic work to defend the country and firmly safeguard with arms the socialist country permeated with honored blood and sweat shed by the revolutionary forerunners. They called on the young people to steadily expand the ranks of young front-rankers possessed of noble traits and take the lead in making the atmosphere stirring with the creation of positive deeds and beautiful traits sweep across the country. They evinced their pledge to powerfully demonstrate all over the world the heroic spirit of young vanguard and the invincible might of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League in the worthwhile struggle to realize the great action programme set forth by the Party Congress, rallied close around Kim Jong Un. A letter of pledge to Kim Jong Un was adopted at the meeting. Then there was a pledge march. Mirrored on the faces of the young people marching in fine array to the dynamic tunes was a pledge to exalt their honor as the advancing group in the struggle for expediting the future of our style of socialism just how was done by the young heroes of the former generation who made a dash forward through thick and thin at the call of the Party. Rodong Sinmun

title: 14th Plenary Meeting of 14th SPA Standing Committee Held
body: The 14th Plenary Meeting of the 14th Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly (SPA) of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) was held on April 30. Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and chairman of the Standing Committee of the SPA, presided over the plenary meeting. Attending it were Vice-Chairmen Thae Hyong Chol and Pak Yong Il, Secretary General Ko Kil Son and members of the Standing Committee of the SPA. Present there as observers were officials concerned of the Standing Committee of the SPA. Put on the agenda were the issue of adopting the Law of the DPRK on the Administration of Revolutionary Relics, the Law of the DPRK on the Protection of Software and the Law of the DPRK on the Administration of Bar Codes and the issue of modifying and supplementing the Law of the DPRK on the Protection of Environment and the Law of the DPRK on the Construction. The participants were briefed on the main contents of the relevant laws and drafted modification and supplementation of the Law of the DPRK on the Protection of Environment and the Law of the DPRK on the Construction examined by the SPA Legislation Committee. The Law of the DPRK on the Administration of Revolutionary Relics, composed of 5 chapters and 44 articles, deals with the principles of the administration of the revolutionary relics, the honorable and important work for defending and carrying forward the glorious revolutionary history and immortal feats of the Workers' Party of Korea and arming the people firmly with the revolutionary traditions of Juche. The law also contains the detailed articles related to establishment of the system of administering the revolutionary relics for finding, collecting, ascertaining and preserving revolutionary relics. The Law of the DPRK on the Protection of Software stipulates the issues of protecting copyright of software, promoting the development of software and increasing investment in software development by establishing a strict system and order in registration and use of software. It also specifies the practical matters arising in observing and enforcing the law including the guidance and control over software protection. The Law of the DPRK on the Administration of Bar Codes deals with the issues arising in setting and using bar codes to ensure convenience of producers in development and undergoing relevant procedures for new products. It calls for ensuring the socialist commercial development and socio-economic stability by putting commodity sales on an IT basis and tightening supervision and control over the use of bar codes. The law on the protection of environment stipulates the legal guarantee for providing cultured living conditions and environment to people by enforcing a strict system and order in environment management, preservation and bettering of natural environment and prevention of environmental pollution while the law on the construction details the contents concerning guidance and control over the designing, building, inspection of completed structures and construction. These laws also specify penalties to be imposed on violations of the laws. On the basis of study and discussion of the agenda, the plenary meeting adopted with unanimous approval the decrees of the SPA Standing Committee "On Adopting the Law of the DPRK on the Administration of Revolutionary Relics", "On Adopting the Law of the DPRK on the Protection of Software", "On Adopting the Law of the DPRK on the Administration of Bar codes" and "On Modifying and Supplementing the Law of the DPRK on the Protection of Environment" and "On Modifying and Supplementing the Law of the DPRK on the Construction". Rodong Sinmun

title: Party and Government Officials Encourage Working People on May Day
body: All the people across the country marked the 131st May Day, the international holiday of the working people over the world, at a time when they are dynamically advancing full of confidence about the bright future of our style socialism under the leadership of the great Workers' Party of Korea. The whole country is full of joy and optimism of the working people including those in great construction sites, factories and co-op farms replete with fresh innovation, bold creation and steady advance for carrying out the decisions made at the historic 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the WPK. Officials of the Party and the government visited major sites of the socialist construction Saturday to congratulate the working people. Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, Ri Pyong Chol, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission of the Party and secretary of the Party Central Committee, Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and premier of the DPRK Cabinet, went to the construction sites of 10 000 flats in Pyongyang, the Chollima Steel Complex and others to commemorate the holiday with the builders and the workers. Party and government officials Jong Sang Hak, Choe Sang Gon, Kim Jae Ryong, O Il Jong, Kim Yong Chol, Ri Son Gwon, Kim Song Nam, Ho Chol Man, Pak Thae Dok, Kim Hyong Sik, Pak Myong Sun, Ri Chol Man, Thae Hyong Chol, Pak Jong Gun, Yang Sung Ho, Kim Yong Hwan and officials of the Cabinet and Party and power organs at all levels visited construction sites in the capital city, the Sangwon Cement Complex, the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill, the Taechong Co-op Farm in Unpha County, the Sunchon Phosphatic Fertilizer Factory, the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex and other factories and enterprises and farms to meet working people, agricultural workers and intellectuals. In the construction sites of 10 000 flats in Pyongyang and the construction site of Pothong Riverside Terraced Residential District, the officials of the Party and the government encouraged the builders of various units registering remarkable achievements while creating the new Pyongyang speed and construction myth, out of single loyal intention to bring into reality the cherished desire of our Party to provide our people with more stable and civilized living conditions, while working with them. Talking about the world of devoted service for the people's wellbeing of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un who made a determination to stage great construction which will leave another significant landmark in the history of construction of the capital city and provides energetic guidance, the Party and government officials called for wonderfully building the ideal streets for people at the level required by the Party within the period set by the Party so as to put the plan and determination of the Party Central Committee into practice and make happy people's laughter reverberate further and wider. At the industrial establishments and farms in different places, the officials of the Party and government placed floral baskets and bouquets before the mosaics depicting President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and paid tributes. They encouraged labor innovators at production sites, workers' hostels and other places and asked them to learn from the fighting spirit and traits displayed by the heroes during the post-war rehabilitation and construction period and Chollima era in the 1950s and put spurs to the first year advance of the new five-year plan and bring about substantial change and tangible achievements. The officials of the Party and government enjoyed sports and entertainment games like volleyball, table tennis and yut games and art performances given by itinerant art squads with working people. The happy appearance of the working people creating socialist civilization with worthwhile labor for opening up the period of new upsurge and turn of the socialist construction added to the delight on holiday. The working people across the country are full of enthusiasm to kindle the flame of setting new standard and new record and to arouse the hot wind of collective innovation in all work sites full of confidence in the victory of the socialist cause while following the direction of historic advance indicated by the Party Central Committee. Rodong Sinmun

title: Statement of Kim Yo Jong, Vice Department Director of WPK Central Committee
body: Kim Yo Jong, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), issued the following statement Sunday: "Defectors from the north" in south Korea recently scattered leaflets against the DPRK again, an intolerable provocation against it. We have already seriously warned the south Korean authorities of consequences their wrong act of giving silent approval to the human wastes' wild moves will bring to the north-south relations. However, the south Korean authorities again did not stop the reckless acts of the "defectors from the north", winking at them. Displeasure can not be hidden over such sordid acts. We regard the maneuvers committed by the human wastes in the south as a serious provocation against our state and will look into corresponding action. Whatever decision we make and whatever actions we take, the responsibility for the consequences thereof will entirely rest with the south Korean authorities who stopped short of holding proper control of the dirty human scum. We can no longer remain an onlooker. Rodong Sinmun

title: May Day Marked across Country
body: The Korean people significantly marked May Day, international holiday of the working people all over the world. Deep reverence was fully reflected in the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the supreme temple of Juche where President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il lie in state. At the plaza of the palace, the masses made a bow before the portraits of the smiling President and Chairman. Officials and working people placed floral baskets, bouquets and flowers and made a bow before the statues of the President and the Chairman on Mansu Hill and in all other parts of the country and mosaics portraying their smiling images. Colorful art performances for celebrating May Day were given at theatres and on outdoor stages in Pyongyang and across the country. The Mansudae Art Troupe gave a music and dance performance at the East Pyongyang Grand Theatre and the National Symphony Orchestra gave a concert at the Moranbong Theatre. A performance of famous music and scenes of revolutionary operas was given at the Pyongyang Grand Theatre, the revolutionary drama "Blood at an International Conference" staged at the National Theatre and a combined acrobatic show given at the Pyongyang Circus Theater. Members of the central art squad for increased production, the workers' art group of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea, the art squad of the Central Committee of the Union of Agricultural Workers, the art squad of the Central Committee of the women's union, the railway art squad, the art squad of the Capital City Construction Commission and art squads of the women's union in different districts including Moranbong District and Taedonggang District gave colorful performances in various places of the city. Performances were given in North and South Phyongan provinces, Jagang Province, North Hamgyong Province and other different parts of the country. There took place colorful sports and amusement games at the Chongjin Rolled Steel Factory, the Haeju Tractor Accessory Parts Factory, the Migok Cooperative Farm in Sariwon City and other places. Officials of provinces, cities, counties, institutions, industrial establishments and farms met scientists, technicians, innovators and other exemplary working people who are working miracles and innovations in all key sectors of economic construction to congratulate them on the holiday. Rodong Sinmun

title: A Song Reverberates in a Mountain Village
body: The place name of Usi was derived from the fact that rituals were performed there to pray for rain because it hardly rained. From of old the soil of Usi was too barren to be inhabitable. But it has now become a good place to live in under the benevolent socialist system. According to an official of the Usi County Commercial Agency, Kajung-ri is far away from the township of the county, but its store regularly supplies the inhabitants with condiments and daily necessities. They are produced at the light industry factories of the county with raw materials available there. He continued to say that he brought with him the seasoned soy and other condiments which were turned out at the county’s essential foodstuff factory and added with joy that the inhabitants of Kajung-ri would be fond of them. The store had diverse kinds of goods for the inhabitants. Saleswomen as well as buyers were all smiling happily at the store. A merry song echoes from somewhere as if to thank the Party for its love of the people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greater Beauty Added to the Recreation Center of the People
body: In Central District, Pyongyang the employees of the Management Office for the Moranbong Youth Park devote their all to converting the Moran Hill into a better cultural recreation center of the people. The hill bear eloquent witness to the noble love of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and Comrade Kim Jong Un for the citizens of Pyongyang. Beautiful followers are in full bloom in the hill thanks to the devotion of the employees of the Management Office for the Moranbong Youth Park to delight the eye. Rodong Sinmun

title: His Talent Developed in the Benevolent Country
body: Ri Hak Song was a poet out of a shock brigade. While working by the sweat of his brow as a young member of a shock brigade in the construction sites of Changjon Street and other major units he used to write poems from a desire to record his and his fellows’ worthwhile lives. The poems were carried in the newspaper “Chongnyon Jonwi (Young Vanguards)”. Afterwards, he became a literary correspondent. He attended literary classes and developed his talent for poetry. He is now a university student. Many of those poets, novelists and scriptwriters who were widely known to our people in the past studied at universities like Ri Hak Song and graduated from them. Our country develops everybody’s talent if any. Rodong Sinmun

title: Their National Economic Plans for April Fulfilled
body: In many fields of the national economy workers and management fulfilled their national economic plans for April in an effort to carry out the decisions of the 8th Congress of the Workers’ Party of Korea. The Namhung Youth Chemical Complex, the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex, the February 8 Vinalon Complex and many other chemical factories executed their plans for the production of nitrogen fertilizer, vinalon, caustic soda, vinyl chloride, salt, etc on all indices. The Salt Production General Enterprise and many other units, too, topped their national economic plans for April on all indices doing all they could for their production despite their hardships and trials. The Ministry of Electric Power Industry fulfilled its power production plan for April. In the realm of the coal industry labor and management carried out their coal production plan for April by dint of hard work. Rodong Sinmun

title: New Institutes under Academy of Agricultural Science Inaugurated
body: The Agrobiology Institute, Plant Protection Institute, Agricultural Nano-technology Institute and Institute of Agro-chemicalization have been successfully inaugurated in the area of the Academy of Agricultural Science. Those institutes have scores of up-to-date research rooms and labs, which serve as a material and technical foundation for scientific research conducive to stable and sustained development of the agricultural production. The completion of the modern institutes makes it possible to push ahead with the scientific research for carrying out the Party's policy of seed improvement by applying latest biological successes and for developing and introducing products of prediction and biological means of exterminating harmful insects. It also provides a firm foundation for the research into agrochemical products like various kinds of fertilizers, nutrients and seed-covering materials based on nano-technology, and for the establishment of effective production methods and application technologies. Ri Chol Man, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Ju Chol Gyu, vice-premier of the Cabinet and minister of Agriculture, and officials concerned visited the newly-built institutes on May 2. Rodong Sinmun

title: Hundreds of Hectares of Medicinal Herb and Tree Areas Created in Ryanggang Province
body: Medicinal herbs and trees have been planted in hundreds of hectares of land of Ryanggang Province with application of scientific and technical cultivation. The Ryanggang Provincial Koryo medicine production management bureau has ensured that every unit growing medicinal herbs and trees introduced advanced cultivation methods on the basis of soil analysis and terrain survey data and technical manuals. The Hyesan experimental herbal cultivation farm has sent young medicinal herbs to several areas of the province and makes sure they are planted to suit to the actual soil conditions under technical requirements. A herb cultivation station in Paekam County created scores of hectares of medicinal herb field in a little over a year and put nearly 100 hectares of land under cultivation. Unhung County has sent hundreds of thousands of vitamin tree saplings to various areas of the province this year after securing a sure technical guarantee for massively propagating vitamin trees. Rodong Sinmun

title: February 16 Sci-Tech Prize Awarded, Best Scientists and Technicians of State for 2020 Chosen
body: February 16 Science and Technology Prize and Scientific and Technological Innovation Prize have been conferred on scientific and technological achievements conducive to consolidating the independence and Juche character of the national economy, improving the people's standard of living and fully demonstrating the development of the Juche-oriented science.
