Certificates and medals of the prizes have been conferred on more than 10 scientific and technological findings which substantially helped to further boost the foundations of the self-supporting economy, improve the people's standard of living and their health and develop the Juche-oriented science by powerfully propelling the development of various fields of the national economy such as metallurgical, electrical power and coal industries. Certificates went to scientists, technicians and officials of the units who undertook major projects, including Kim Il Sung University, Kim Chaek University of Technology, Hamhung University of Hydraulic Engineering, Pyongyang University of Publishing and Printing, Mathematics Research Institute of the State Academy of Sciences, the Mechanical Engineering Institute, the Rice Research Institute of the Academy of Agricultural Science, the Tumour Institute of the Academy of Medical Science, the Pyongyang Thermal Power Plant and Pyongyang Wheat Flour Processing Factory. Chae Yong Chol, section chief of Hamhung University of Hydraulic Engineering, Im Song Jin, section chief of Kim Il Sung University, Kim Kwang Ho, section chief of the State Academy of Sciences, and Mun Myong Chol, section chief of the Academy of Agricultural Science, have been chosen as the best scientists and technicians of the state for 2020. Certificates of the best scientists and technicians of the state for 2020 were conferred on them as they have made distinguished contributions to developing the country's economy and science and technology, remaining true to the Party's line of prioritizing science and technology with high practical ability and results. Rodong Sinmun

title: Their National Economic Plans for April Overfulfilled
body: The workers of the Sangwon and Sunchon Cement Complexes, the Chonnaeri Cement Factory and other cement factories countrywide strove mightily to boost their cement production and thus fulfilled the plans for their cement production of April. Machine-building factories and enterprises were all out to manufacture products actively tapping out and mobilizing their internal reserves the way the Pyongyang General Electric Cable Factory 326, the Munchon Valve Factory, the Anju Pump Factory and other factories have done and dynamically conducting mass technological innovation drives. Drawing on the experiences and lessons they acquired in the execution of their plans for the first quarter of 2021 the Taean Heavy Machine Complex, the Ranam Coal Mining Machine Complex and many other factories consolidated the foundations for their production and carried out their national economic plans for April. Efforts were made in the railway sector to satisfactorily supply materials and goods by rail to metalworking and chemical factories, the construction site of dwellings for 10,000 families in Pyongyang and other major factories and units. The transport of materials was organized and directed well to this end so the plan for the transport of materials in April was topped. In the sphere of the lumber industry workers and management fulfilled the plan for their lumber production in April. Rodong Sinmun

title: In North Phyongan Province Hundreds of Young People Volunteered to Work at Major Sectors of Socialist Construction
body: The whole country is all out to implement the decisions of the 8th Congress of the Workers’ Party of Korea. Meanwhile, in North Phyongan Province hundreds of young people were employed in mines, coal mines, cooperative farms, power stations and so on of their own free will. Last March a hundred and tens of young people left for major economic units to repay the mother WPK for its love and kindness. Many other young people, too, voluntarily joined together to work at difficult and labor-consuming units in April when the 10th Congress of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Youth League was in session. Since they found employment at socialist cooperative farms to achieve with might and main the goals of grain production set them by the WPK young people have worked there by the sweat of their brows. In the province the affiliated organizations of the WPK and the Socialist Patriotic Youth League actively encourage the young volunteers in doing good farm work, hold them up as models and lead them forward so that they can live up to their volunteer determination and realize their ideals to the last. More and more young people volunteer to work at the major sectors of socialist construction. Rodong Sinmun

title: Medical Supplies Factory under Construction in Kangwon Province
body: A medical supplies factory is under construction in Kangwon Province. It is to be composed of a shop for the preparation of raw materials, a shop for the shaping of plastics, a shop for sterilization, etc equipped with modern machines. After its completion the factory can produce millions of medical supplies a year. Comrade Kim Jong Un gave instructions to build the factory on modern lines in Kangwon Province and named it the Maebongsan Medical Supplies Factory. He settled all the problems of its construction. The builders do their utmost day and night to complete the factory by and large in the first half of 2021. The officials of the Ministry of Public Health and the other units concerned adopt proactive measures to provide building materials to the construction site of the factory with the progress of its construction. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Watches Performance of Art Groups of Servicemen's Families of KPA
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), watched a performance given by the art groups of servicemen's families from large combined units of the Korean People's Army (KPA) on Wednesday. The Mansudae Art Theatre was full of immense happiness and enthusiasm of the members of the art groups of servicemen's families excited to give performance in the presence of the respected General Secretary whom they missed awake or asleep. When the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un came to the auditorium of the theatre together with his wife Ri Sol Ju, enthusiastic cheers of "Hurrah!" resounded the hall. All the participants raised enthusiastic cheers for the General Secretary who shows great loving care and trust to the servicemen's families, always having them in the deepest place of his mind together with the soldiers holding arms, and places them on the highest place of glory and happiness. Among the audience were Jo Yong Won and Ri Pyong Chol, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, and Jong Sang Hak, Ri Il Hwan, O Il Jong and other cadres of the Party Central Committee. Also watching it were Pak Jong Chon, Kwon Yong Jin, Kim Jong Gwan and other commanding officials of the armed forces organs. Members of art groups of servicemen's families under several large combined units of the People's Army performed. Put on the stage were colorful numbers including poem recital, large-scale Oungum ensemble, solo and chorus, serial songs, large-ensemble tale recital, dialogic drama, drum ensemble and song, narration and tale, drama tale, poem drama, real story drama, instrumental music ensemble and chorus. The performers made impressive depiction of the noble ideological and mental world of the servicemen's families glorifying each moment of their lives with ardent patriotism and loyalty for the new victory of the revolution, keeping pace with their husbands serving in the army for the Marshal on the sacred road of defending the country, people and revolution, with their destinies entrusted to the Party Central Committee. Touching the heartstrings of the audience were numbers that made truthful representation of the life of the servicemen's families who are fulfilling their moral obligation and responsibilities before their families and society as kindhearted mothers deeply solicitous for soldiers to improve their living conditions with ardent love and spirit of devotedly serving the soldiers, and also as dependable householders of servicemen's families actively supporting their husbands and responsibly bringing up their children. The performance clearly showed that our People's Army is fulfilling its noble mission and duty before the Party and the revolution as there are the large contingents of the eldest daughters-in-law of the country devoting their pure conscience for the prosperity of the country with more priority given to the state affairs than their own family affairs, and of women revolutionaries playing measurable roles in increasing the military capabilities. When the performance was over, stormy cheers of "Hurrah!" burst forth again. The respected General Secretary warmly waved back to the greatly excited performers. He expressed thanks, greatly satisfied with the fresh performance obvious in ideological and policy standard, the one of great cognitive and instructive significance that sang high praises of the Party's leadership exploits associated with the units of their husbands. He said that ordinary families of servicemen all became information workers correctly explaining our Party's policies, adding with great pleasure that this is a brilliant fruition of the validity and vitality of the idea of prioritizing mass-based culture and art consistently maintained by our Party. He stressed that it is something laudable that the People's Army always sets an example in implementing the Party's policy on mass-based culture and art. He said that the whole country should learn after the ardent patriotism, strong capacity for living and high ideological and spiritual world of the servicemen's families. He specified important tasks for guiding the servicemen's families, saying that all the wives of servicemen throughout the army should be prepared to be steadfast women revolutionaries so that they would fulfill their duties as eternal cooks for the revolution, true daughters of the Party and dependable eldest daughters-in-law. Calling the servicemen's families an important force of our revolution holding a big share in leading society with noble culture and high ideological and moral traits and in displaying patriotic spirit, he voiced his expectation and belief that they would make military posts and worksites burn with enthusiasm for the revolution and struggle through revolutionary mass-based culture and art activities and positively propel the development of socialist civilization in the future, too. The performers firmly pledged themselves to glorify their lives as dependable assistant shooters of their husbands and genuine servants for soldiers whom the Marshal loves and treasures most, extending their gratitude to the General Secretary who brings the servicemen's families to the honorable fore of the times with warm paternal love. Political News Team

title: Their National Economic Plans for April Fulfilled
body: In the area of the extractive industry workers and management worked hard for their production in April, too, the way they fulfilled their production plan for the first quarter of 2021. The December 5 Youth Mine executed its mineral production plan for April on indices while working in real earnest to set up a new production process. The Unpha Mine vigorously pushed forward its tunneling and preparations for its mining and also carried out its mineral production plan for April. The Sangnong Mine stepped up its production according to its plan giving priority to its tunneling and filling up the shortage of its equipment and materials for itself. The Riwon, Namgye and Sijung Mines, too, registered high results in their production. Many mines of the Phosphatic Fertilizer Industrial Management Bureau overfulfilled the plans for the production of their apatite concentrates with reagents of their making instead of imported ones. The labor and management of the Munphyong Smeltery, the Taedonggang Battery Factory and many other units topped their production plans for April finding methods of normalizing their production. In the sector of light industry workers and management carried out their national economic plan for April. The Sinuiju Textile Mill, the Sunchon Leather Shoes Factory, the Sinuiju Shoes Factory and many other textile mills and footwear factories laid the main accent on scientifically and technologically unraveling knotty problems of their reclamation, brought the creative talents of their producers into full play and improved their technological knowledge and skills. The result was that they overfulfilled their production plans. The Kangso Knitting Factory, the Pyongyang Hosiery Factory and many other knitting factories carried out the plans for the production of their knitwear and hosiery by actively tapping out their internal reserves and using them for their production and applying rational methods of production. The Sinuiju and Pyongyang Cosmetics Factories regarded it as of vital importance in using homemade raw and other materials and recycling their industrial wastes and successfully accelerated the production of their cosmetics of many kinds. Rodong Sinmun

title: Order Given to a Sportswoman
body: On December 27, 2011 an ordinary female handball coach of the Korean People’s Army was given an order to receive medical treatment in a hospital. In those days all the country deeply mourned over the loss of Comrade Kim Jong Il, the great leader and kind-hearted father of the Korean people. How did it come that she was issued the order? In May 2011 Kim Jong Il attended the inaugural ceremony of a gymnasium built by a unit of the KPA anew and enjoyed a handball match. He closely watched a female coach on the playing court. Worryingly, he said she looked sickly. The official concerned informed Kim Jong Il that she was an incurable invalid, uttered her will not to leave the playing court to the last moments of her life although she knew that her days were numbered and remained in a handball training ground almost all the time. Kim Jong Il said that she was a good woman and gave earnest instructions to cure her disease well. Kim Jong Il got firsthand knowledge of her medical treatment time and again when occasion came and adopted all necessary measures for it. Consequently, she changed for the better. This was quite a miracle. But to her astonishment, Kim Jong Il passed away in December 2011 too unexpectedly. Her disease again began to take turns for the worse. At that juncture Comrade Kim Jong Un was acquainted with her medical treatment and ensured that she was cured of the disease without delay. She repeatedly entreated officials to allow her to attend, aside from all others, the ceremony of bidding farewell to Kim Jong Il. They said, lump in throat: “Comrade Kim Jong Un ordered us to send you to the hospital as soon as possible…. “Please prepare yourself for your departure.” The sole order of the world could be issued by nobody but Kim Jong Un, the supreme incarnation of love for man. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Has Photo Session with Participants in Performance of Art Groups of KPA Servicemen's Families
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, met and had a photo session with the participants in a performance of servicemen's families of the Korean People's Army (KPA) at the office building of the Party Central Committee on May 6. They are members of the art groups of servicemen's families from several large combined units of the KPA. The servicemen's families were extremely excited and delighted to have realized the greatest wish of their life to have a photo of honor taken with the Marshal in the courtyard of the general staff of the Korean revolution. When the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un came to the garden of the office building, all the participants raised stormy cheers of "Hurrah!" as a token of their deep reverence for the General Secretary, who highly appreciated their simple performance, put forward the servicemen's families as the model of the times to be followed by the whole country and repeatedly showed warm loving care for them, which will be conveyed down through generations. Warmly waving back to the enthusiastically cheering participants, he highly appreciated once again their devoted efforts of successfully fulfilling their mission and duty as reliable assistants to their husbands holding arms and true servants for soldiers, while sharing the idea and intention with the Supreme Commander with their white gem-like loyalty and pure conscience. All the members of the art groups of servicemen's families hardened their pledge to make positive contributions to strengthening military capability and developing socialist civilization, while glorifying every moment of their lives as eternal cooks of the revolution boundlessly loyal to the respected General Secretary, true daughters of the Party and reliable eldest daughters-in-law, cherishing today's glory and happiness. Political News Team

title: Enjoying Happiness under Popular Policies
body: It happened that during his lecture a university teacher asked his students how many social policies were enforced in our country. Most of them replied that they numbered less than 10 and failed to multiply it. A disabled ex-serviceman of the Korean People’s Army, a resident in Taedonggang District, Pyongyang said: “…My family does not know well how many benefits the state grants it. I am preferentially given medical checkup as well as many other benefits. Moreover, kind-hearted strangers visit me and take warm care of me like their blood relative all the time. Ours is the most generous social system in the world. There is a match for it nowhere.” Today disabled ex-servicemen are looked after on a priority basis in our country when it comes to living conditions. Last year the 3rd Meeting of the 14th Supreme People’s Assembly of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea promulgated the decree "On adoption of the law of the DPRK on providing living conditions for discharged officers". This year the 13th Plenary Meeting of the 14th Standing Committee of the DPRK SPA adopted the Law on Social Insurance and Security in the DPRK. It is stipulated in the law in detail that the health of the people shall be protected, that they shall be supplied with stable and happy living conditions, that they shall be ensured social insurance, that social insurance money shall be disbursed for them and that they shall go through due formalities of social security and that a social insurance company shall be set up and run to perform its duty. The law also provides for the formalities of the people’s social security, the institution and running of a security company, the special generous treatment of merited persons, the guidance in and control of social insurance and security and the principles of the observance and execution of the relevant act. Our people live happily and proudly under the policies which are adopted for them one after another with the passage of time under the care of the benevolent mother Party. Rodong Sinmun

title: The Devotion of Doctors to a Patient
body: Last November Jong Yun Mi, a dweller in Rangnang District, Pyongyang was carried to the Pyongyang Maternity Hospital by ambulance. She lost her senses. At that time it could not be guaranteed that she could be restored to life. It was quite certain that she must be operated on. But she might be in great danger of losing her life while going under the knife. Her life was in the worst condition on all indices. Nobody could foreknow what would befall her during the operation and imperil her life. But the doctors of the first gynecologic section of the PMH bestirred themselves to cure and save her and did all they could to that end as if she were their blood relative. Consequently, she regained her senses in three days and her physical condition took turns for the better day after day. Jong Yun Mi was cared for by doctors as devotedly as ever after she left the PMH. She and all her family felt very happy that they lived under the benevolent social system. Rodong Sinmun

title: Photo Exhibition Marks Third Anniversary of Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's Visits to China
body: There took place a photo exhibition at the DPRK embassy in Beijing on May 7 to mark the third anniversary of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's visits to China. Displayed at the exhibition hall were photos showing Kim Jong Un paying visits to China three times in Juche 107 (2018). Present at the exhibition were Ri Ryong Nam, DPRK ambassador to China, and his embassy members. There were also Song Tao, head of the International Liaison Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, and officials of the Chinese party and government including those of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Ministry of Culture and Tourism. Ri Ryong Nam in his speech said that the visits to China by General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea Kim Jong Un offered another crucial occasion that opened up a new chapter of the DPRK-China friendship, noting that the DPRK would develop the traditional DPRK-China friendly relations in conformity with the noble intention of the leaders of the two parties and the desire, wish and fundamental interests of the peoples of the two countries. He voiced expectations that the Communist Party and people of China would make achievements in the historic journey for building a comprehensively well-off modern socialist country under the leadership of Xi Jinping and significantly greet the 100th anniversary of the founding of the Communist Party of China. Song Tao in his speech stressed that they would propel the China-DPRK relations to make them continue to reach a new stage, noting that the Central Committee of the CPC with Xi Jinping at the core sets great store by the traditional China-DPRK friendship. He wished the Korean people bigger achievements in the path to implement the decisions made at the Eighth Party Congress and develop the socialist cause under the guidance of the WPK led by General Secretary Kim Jong Un. Then the participants looked round the exhibition hall. Similar photo exhibitions were also held at the DPRK Consulate General in Shenyang of China and its branch in Dandong on the same day. Rodong Sinmun

title: Technological Courses Given to Agricultural Officials across Country
body: A few days ago the Unhung Cooperative Farm of Thaechon County gave the agricultural officials of the whole country courses in the scientific and technological problems of bedding out rice seedlings and fertilizing and tending dry crops in the fields to meet the demand of the Juche-based farming methods. The courses were attended by the officials of the Ministry of Agriculture, the chairmen of all the provincial rural economic committees, their sectional chiefs and other officials. The problem of properly setting the right season for crops to withstand adverse weather conditions and transplanting rice seedlings on a qualitative footing was handled most importantly of all others in the courses. To proceed, the attendees were taught in detail how to scientifically and technologically fertilize paddies and controlling their water according to the stage of rice growth. The attendees also paid deep attention to a lesson in seeding dry crops in the fields and fertilizing and tending them according to the demand of the Juche farming methods and technology. Rice seedlings were set out in paddies separately by varieties, substitute fertilizer and agricultural chemicals produced, corn and early crops manured and tended and beans planted by way of demonstration. The attendees were also greatly interested in all this. Besides, the attendees visited an organic compound fertilizer factory and many other model units in the county and got deep impressions. Rodong Sinmun

title: Fulfillers of Plans for 2021 and First Half of 2021 Produced in Succession
body: In the realm of light industry workers incessantly fulfill their plans for 2021 and the first half of 2021 one after another. A silk-reel worker of the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Silk Mill was the first to execute her yearly plan on April 8. All her fellow others redoubled their efforts to overtake and outstrip each other, learn from each other and exchange experiences with each other. As a result, in the silk mill its three others joined the pioneer in topping their yearly plans, and dozens of its other silk-reel workers carried out their plans for the first half of 2021. From the outset of 2021 the workers and management of the Huichon Silk Mill strove mightily to contribute whole-heartedly to enriching and strengthening the country by the sweat of their brows. The workers of the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill and many other light industrial factories also fulfill their plans for the first half of 2021 one after the other. Rodong Sinmun

title: Oath-taking Meetings of Youth and Students Held in DPRK
body: Young people and students of the DPRK held meetings in Pyongyang City and all provinces to vow to fully demonstrate the might of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League under the leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. Reports and speeches were made at the meetings attended by officials concerned, youth league officials, youth and students of Pyongyang and every province. Reporters and speakers referred to the fact that the recent 10th congress of the youth league reaffirmed the faith and oath of the young vanguard to remain absolutely faithful to the guidance of the Workers' Party of Korea and give full play to their heroism and bravery in accomplishing the cause of the Party, and marked a turning point in putting the youth movement of the country on a new stage. Saying that the whole country watches the heroic advance by millions of young people, they expressed their strong determination to become passionate loyalists who don't hesitate to go through thick and thin in order to implement the Party's intentions and plans. They vowed to perform new miracles and feats in all worksites for a great upswing by emulating the fighting spirit and traits of the heroes in the post-war rehabilitation period of the 1950s and in the Chollima age under the uplifted slogan "Let us demonstrate the mettle of patriotic youth in the worthwhile struggle for socialist construction!" They stressed that they will, regarding it as the most sacred duty and supreme patriotism to safeguard the country, firmly defend the country with arms and become genuine paragons of socialist virtue and culture so as to take the lead in the efforts for ensuring that good deeds, virtue and beautiful traits prevail throughout the country. They expressed their pledge to fully demonstrate the mettle of the young vanguards of the great era of Kim Jong Un in the ongoing general forward march for ushering in a new period of a great upsurge and turn in the revolution along the path indicated by the Party Congress by following the fighting spirit and traits of the youth of the former generations who upheld the leadership of the Party in the van. Letters of pledge to Kim Jong Un were adopted at the meetings. Then there took place processions. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Presentation of Sci-tech Successes in Fisheries Held
body: A national presentation of sci-tech successes in fisheries was given via video conferencing under the co-sponsorship of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea and the Ministry of Fisheries between May 4 and 6. Attending it were scientists, technologists, teachers, researchers and field officials of dozens of units including Kim Il Sung University, Wonsan University of Fisheries, Nampho University of Fisheries, Kamapho Fishery Station and the Songdowon Fishery Station. Presented there were more than sixty treatises conducive to boosting productivity by improving domestic aquaculture and promoting recycling, true to the Party's policy of systematically increasing the output of marine products through brisk aquaculture. The participants also heard and watched a lecture and video on the strategy of stimulating aquaculture and combined aquaculture. Rodong Sinmun

title: The Plan of the Party Carried Out with Single-minded Loyalty
body: Since housing construction started in Pyongyang for 10,000 families tens of thousands of the members of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League, the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea and the Socialist Women’s Union of Korea engaged in ministries, national organs and the factories and enterprises of Pyongyang and all its districts have so far been enrolled in separate shock forces. Meanwhile, they have carried tens of thousands of cubic meters of graves, sand and lumber, rezoned the ground for thousands of square meters and carried out many other work assignments. The young members of night helpers’ shock brigades work vyingly with devotion in the construction site to carry out the Party’s great plan for housing construction without fail. Particular mention should be made of tens of the officials of the SPYL’s affiliates who participated in its 10th congress. Although they have their hands full with their own duty they come to the construction site of dwellings every night and work there with all their might. The officers and members of the workteams of the Capital City Construction Commission and the Pyongyang Municipal Committee of the GFTUK help toward raising the speed of housing construction with the apparatus and implements they secured themselves. The members of the shock force of the SWUK, too, do their duty well in building dwellings. Rodong Sinmun

title: Emergency Anti-epidemic Campaign Further Intensified in DPRK
body: All sectors and units across the country strictly observe anti-epidemic rules and concentrate efforts on keeping the masses on high alert, while regarding the anti-epidemic work as the most important task of this year. The central emergency anti-epidemic sector more rationally modified and supplemented the anti-epidemic rules and regulations and press ahead with the work to thoroughly check the inroad of COVID-19. Hygienic and anti-epidemic organs make sure that their officials responsibly conduct hygienic information activities among the employees of the units in their charge. Measures have been taken to routinely conduct a hygienic and epidemiological check-up in the units frequented by many people. The education sector, heightening the teaching staff and students' awareness of the importance of the anti-epidemic work, sees to it that classrooms, laboratories, office rooms, dormitories and equipment are thoroughly disinfected. All the institutions, enterprises, factories and farms across the country put efforts into enhancing the responsibility and role of their hygienic information workers so that disinfection and sewage disposal are properly done as specified in the anti-epidemic rules. Posters are displayed in many places to promote the anti-epidemic campaign along with the work for creating a hygienic and cultural environment. Rodong Sinmun

title: Detailed Arrangements Made for Active Support of Cooperative Farms
body: The rice-planting season has come round. The whole country shows zeal in trying to help its cooperative farms in their work. The Party organizations of the Cabinet, ministries and national institutions are now making detailed arrangements for this underscoring its political importance. The Party organizations adopt practical measures to assign enough numbers of employees to cooperative farms to assist them in their work and convince them to responsibly do their part there thinking as their masters and also educate them in advance to be good helpers. The Party organizations intensify political and hygienic propaganda among those who will soon work at cooperative farms so that all of them can thoroughly keep emergency anti-epidemic rules and ensure that they obey them and that their actions are controlled as regards it. Rodong Sinmun

title: Over 400 Young People Found Employment in Major Sectors of Socialist Construction in North Hamgyong Province
body: 400-odd young people of North Hamgyong Province were employed in the major sectors of socialist construction on May 9. An instructor of the provincial committee of the youth league named Cha Chung Hyok found employment in the Jungphyong Vegetable Greenhouse Farm of his own accord, and the officials of the Onsong County committee of the youth league by the name of Thae Hak Chol and Pak Song Rim were voluntarily employed in different farms. A member of an affiliated organization of the youth league of the Hwadae County People’s Committee joined with his younger brother to get jobs at a cooperative farm saying that Comrade Kim Jong Un provided a new good house to his family when it fell victim to a flood last year and was left homeless and that it was his bounden duty as a citizen of the DPRK to repay him for his great love. Large numbers of young people were engaged in the Speed Campaign Youth Shock Brigade of their own will firmly determined to devote all their youthful wisdom and enthusiasm to carrying out the plan and ideas of the Party. All this testifies that in our times young people are faithful to the Party, the country, society and the collective and work selflessly for the future of the nation. Rodong Sinmun

title: Future of the Kosan Fruit Processing Factory Assured by Certificates of Matriculation of Its 64 Employees
body: In the Kosan Fruit Processing Factory to the Kosan Combined Fruit Farm 64 employees have matriculated in the teleeducation faculty of Pyongyang Han Tok Su University of Light Industry. In the summer of 2019 Pak Sung Ho was appointed manager of the KFPF under construction. He pondered over the operation of his factory. Most of its employees were tenders of fruit trees until a short time ago except for about five university graduates. Worse still, the graduates did not major in foodstuff processing. However, he could not hunt for and employ expert foodstuff processors right now. The senior officials of the KFPF decided to admit its employees into the teleeducation faculty of the university. Consequently, last spring Pak Sung Ho and other officials of the KFPF, plus scores of its other employees, were the first to enter the university. The rest of its employees followed suit. Studying while working all of them have fully mastered their machines as well as other relevant ones. More still, many of them have developed into inventors. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Sci-Tech Presentation in Field of Automation Held
body: A national sci-tech presentation in the field of automation was held via video conferencing under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea. The presentation under the theme of "Metallurgical industry and automation" was held for the purpose of actively propelling the technical completion of the Juche-based system of making iron and expansion of production capacity by strengthening the creative cooperation among scientists, technologists and producers in the fields of automation and metallurgical industry in the struggle for implementing the decisions of the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea and the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the WPK. Attending it were officials, teachers, researchers, postgraduates and field technologists of 10-odd units including Kim Il Sung University, Kim Chaek University of Technology, the Automation Institute and the Control Machine Institute of the State Academy of Sciences and the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex. Presented there were more than 130 papers completed in the course of search and creation for further developing the field of automation of the country. The presentation heard sci-tech successes and deeply discussed the technical methods for solving the problems arising in the field of automation of the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex and the Chollima Steel Complex. During the presentation there was a lecture on the latest technology. Rodong Sinmun

title: Youth Art Squads Compete in Agitprop Activities
body: Itinerant youth art squads from across the country and their announcers competed in their agitprop activities for encouraging workers at the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex and the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex from May 5 to 9. The art squads competed in agitprop activities for welcoming the workers entering the complexes in the morning and inspiring them to increased production inside the complexes. The announcers competed in their narrative skills for congratulating the innovators. Put on the stage at different shops and construction sites of the complexes were the numbers of high ideological and artistic value that markedly represent the Party policies. Narration and male solo "Red Snow Is Falling from Night Sky of Iron City" and other numbers instilled great confidence and courage into the minds of the workers increasing the production of Juche iron. Appealing narration and song "Advancing Socialism" and mixed chorus "Campfire, Flare Up" and other numbers reflecting the spirit of the times greatly stimulated the workers of the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex all out in the implementation of the first year tasks of the new five-year plan. During their agitprop activities, members of the art squads explained the Party policies with their high narrative skills at different shops and informed their workers of the good deeds done by employees of the complexes. Rodong Sinmun

title: Many Industrial Art Works Produced
body: New designs are being produced in the field of industrial art to facilitate fresh innovation, bold creation and steady advance, true to the idea and spirit of the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea and the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the WPK. The Korean Industrial Art Studio, Pyongyang University of Fine Arts, Pyongyang University of Publishing and Printing and other units have produced hundreds of diverse industrial art works. The designs of signboards and advertisements to be displayed at the public service facilities in Samjiyon City well represent the features of the mountainous city and help promote convenience of visitors and citizens as formative art was peculiarly applied to their fonts. The designs of educational experimental apparatus and equipment are favored by officials and teachers in the field of education. There are also designs of different kinds of trolleys to be used at commercial service facilities. Creators, teachers and students in the field of industrial art work hard to produce more good designs which will serve as country's valuable assets for providing the people with happier life. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Heritage Preserved with Much Care in DPRK
body: Officials and working people have achieved successes in the campaign for preserving national heritage like historical sites, scenic spots and natural monuments throughout the country in the spring months for taking care of national heritage. Pyongyang City has changed the roof tiles of Popun Temple, Ryonggok School and Kwangbop Temple and repaired their rafters. South Hamgyong Province concluded the improvement of the roads to the Manse Pavilion of Ryangchon Temple in Kowon County and to Ryonghung Temple in Yonggwang County and arranged their vicinity in a short period. South Phyongan and South Hwanghae provinces and Nampho City spruced up the Anguk Temple and Kangso Temple to better their appearances as historical sites representing the excellence of the Korean nation. Kaesong City has repaired the Koryo Museum, the Ryongthong Temple and the Sungyang Confucian Shrine in a planned way to restore their original state on the principle of historicism. The campaign for preserving scenic spots and natural monuments is also brisk. Good species of trees including pine-nut trees and apricot trees were planted at scenic spots and the work for arranging sanctuaries for Mayang musk deer and Mayang ferret is underway. Rodong Sinmun

title: Rice Transplantation Started in Wonhwa Cooperative Farm
body: The Wonhwa Cooperative Farm of Phyongwon County started to transplant rice seedlings. On May 10, 1952 when the Fatherland Liberation War was at its height President Kim Il Sung visited Wonhwa-ri and joined its peasants to sow rice in a paddy. The WCF began bedding out its rice seedlings in the paddy of all its paddies on May 10 this year. Its paddy fields are transplanted with rice seedlings one after another with the help of rice seedling transplanters day by day. Rodong Sinmun

title: Socialist Emulation for First Stage of Housing Construction for 10,000 Families in Pyongyang Summed Up. Construction Pushed ahead with Constantly
body: The socialist emulation for the first stage of housing construction for 10,000 families in Pyongyang was reviewed. During the emulation the ground was excavated and concreted for the foundations of dwellings and they were satisfactorily framed. Successes were also scored in building substructures and setups and realigning the surroundings of the dwellings. Since they broke the ground for their dwellings our dependable servicemen of the Korean People’s Army have vigorously demonstrated their revolutionary spirit in their construction. The officers and men of the brigade of the Ministry of Public Security regarded it as of key importance in ensuring the quality of their flats to train skilled builders and effectvely pushed forward the work on the one hand. They used many machines for their building operations on the other and thereby sped up their housing construction. The brigade of the Capital City Construction Commission actively organized a prize contest for innovations to increase the quality and speed of its housing construction as well as the proportion of its building operations done by machines. Consequently, many rational building methods were contrived and applied to economize on its labor, materials and time. The brigade of the External Construction Bureau and many other construction corps, too, carried out their building projects with speed through a fierce socialist emulation. When the first stage of the socialist emulation was summed up it was emphasized that during another stage of the socialist emulation the officials and workers of all construction units must successfully carry out their building projects till the date set them by Party as superbly as it wishes, basing themselves on the successes achieved during the first stage of the socialist emulation. Rodong Sinmun

title: More Young People Volunteer for Difficult and Labor-consuming Jobs in DPRK
body: Many young people in different parts of the DPRK have volunteered to work in difficult and labor-consuming fields, true to the important instructions given by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un in his letter to the 10th congress of the youth league. The number of such paragons of virtues and shining examples is on the increase. A thousand and hundreds of young people in North Hamgyong Province and South Phyongan Province volunteered to work in major construction sites, the leading sectors of the national economy and socialist countryside. Meetings were held in those provinces to congratulate the young people who volunteered to work in difficult and labor-consuming fields in hearty response to the call of the Party. There were congratulatory speeches and oath-taking speeches at the meetings. The speakers pledged to glorify their precious youth with loyalty and feats by ceaselessly performing new miracles and feats in the worthwhile struggle for socialist construction to demonstrate their honor of being members of the advancing group and shock brigade of the Party. The young volunteers were warmly sent off by officials, working people, youth and students in those provinces. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Ambassador Presents Credentials to Zimbabwean President
body: The DPRK ambassador presented credentials to the president of the Republic of Zimbabwe on May 6. DPRK Ambassador Jong Song Il courteously conveyed warm greetings from Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, to President Emmerson Dambudzo Mnangagwa. The president expressed deep thanks for this and asked the ambassador to convey his most heartfelt warm greeting to Kim Jong Un. Noting that President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il are illustrious leaders and outstanding state activists who rendered sincere assistance to Zimbabwe's independence and construction of new society, the president hoped that the bilateral friendly and cooperative relations with a long history and tradition would grow stronger in different fields including politics and economy. He wished the Workers' Party of Korea and the Korean people greater success in building a powerful socialist country under the outstanding and seasoned leadership of Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Premier Inspects Samjiyon City
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected several places of Samjiyon City. He went round construction sites including Phothae-dong and Rimyongsu-dong bustling with the third-stage project for remodeling Samjiyon City and the self-supporting bases of the 216 Division. He gave pep talks to the builders all out in the campaign of loyalty for more magnificently sprucing up the holy place of the Juche revolution, true to the idea and the spirit of the 8th Congress of the Party and the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Party. He also stressed the need to push forward with the construction as planned by ensuring timely supply of materials and actively use locally available finishing building materials. He went round the Samjiyon City People's Hospital, the Samjiyon Blueberry Drink Factory and the Samjiyon Potato Farina Production Factory, where he underscored the need for those units associated with the leadership exploits of the Party to promote their development with an innovative management strategy and set an example in implementing the Party policies in order to powerfully propel the improvement of the people's living standard and the development of local industry. The field consultative meetings discussed the practical issues arising in qualitatively completing the third-stage project for remodeling Samjiyon City as early as possible and turning all cities and counties into developed areas with their own specific features on the basis of a new standard created in the construction of the holy place of the revolution. Meanwhile, at the Hyesan Youth Mine, the premier chaired a consultative meeting for boosting the capacity of the mine. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Exhibition of Budding Artists' Works Opens
body: A national exhibition of budding artists' works opened with due ceremony at the Okryu Exhibition Hall on May 11 to commemorate the 7th anniversary of the publication of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's work "Let's Usher in New Heyday of Juche-oriented Literature and Art as Required by Era and Developing Revolution". The exhibition was opened to further develop national art and stimulate the struggle of the Party members and other working people all out in the first year advance for implementing the new five-year plan by letting promising young artists create more excellent art pieces. Displayed there are more than 230 Korean paintings, oil paintings, acryl paintings and sculptures created by budding artists across the country. Also displayed are diverse art pieces reflecting the revolutionary spirit of soldiers and civilians who perform feats in the gigantic construction sites including the one for 10 000 flats in Pyongyang City. They also portray the happy life of working people and deal with the glorious history and folklore of the Korean nation. During the exhibition there will be a technical workshop for the budding artists and a presentation of their experience. Rodong Sinmun

title: Maize Planting Concluded in South Hwanghae Province
body: Agricultural workers in South Hwanghae Province concluded maize-planting in major fields. In order to round off the maize-planting before the start of rice-transplanting, the province provided its farms with maize seed-covering materials in time and made sure that technical rules are thoroughly observed in all farming processes. After expanding the area of cultivating humus-potted maize, co-op farms in the province buckled down to creating good conditions for raising the germination rate. They finished maize-planting ahead of schedule by dovetailing its processes. Not resting on their laurels, agricultural workers in the province concentrate on preparations for rice-transplanting. Rodong Sinmun

title: Repairing Irrigation Facilities and River Improvement Brisk
body: Projects for repairing irrigation facilities and improving rivers are full steam ahead across the country to provide for disastrous climatic conditions. North Hwanghae Province has finished clearing and reinforcing the main waterways in the province including Lake Sohung and Miru Plain waterways. It is now taking stock of places vulnerable to floods. Reinforcing embankments and dredging river-bed have been done in qualitative way in various counties of South Hwanghae Province, which considerably increased the capacity of water passage. Effective overhauling and maintenance of pumping facilities have resulted in full-capacity operation and major pumping stations have been repaired with materials procured with much effort, all meant for smooth irrigation. Onchon County of Nampho City has completed the project for expanding capacity in some sections of the West Sea waterway and for building new irrigation structures or repairing existing ones in more than 10 points. New waterway has been set up in Ansok field, a guarantee for safe farming in the tideland. Farms in other provinces also take such measures as dredging river-bed and reinforcing embankments to minimize damage of arable land and crops by potential floods. Rodong Sinmun

title: Rabbit-Breeding Gets Popular among Agricultural Workers
body: Breeding rabbits is being popularized among organizations under the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea (UAWK). Provincial committees of the union are organizing socialist emulation drives among cities and counties to be followed by correct reviewing and assessing. They are also pushing ahead with the provision of breeding rabbits of good strains and building of coops. They set model units and regularly hold workshops to show good experience gained in breeding. They also make sure that lots of baby rabbits are bred and sent to the UAWK organizations in their provinces. Those organizations in cities and counties disseminate experience gained from breeding good-strain rabbits and also scientific breeding method, and are inoculating rabbits as a preventive measure, thereby lowering the morbidity and death rates. Feed supply is fully ensured in keeping with the increase in the number of the grass-eating animal. Rodong Sinmun

title: Collective Emulation Campaign Launched in DPRK
body: All sectors and units have launched a campaign for overtaking and learning from exemplary units and generalizing experience, thus making a series of innovations. The workers of the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex, who appealed to all other workers across the country to go all out for hitting the first year's target of the 5-year plan, are adding glory to their honor as pioneers. The workers of the complex are making uninterrupted innovations after fulfilling this year's first quarterly and April plans for pig iron, steel and rolled steel production through cooperation and competition. In hearty response to the appeal, workers of different units in metallurgical industry have made signal progress in fulfilling their national economic plans for the first quarter of the year and April. The workers of the February 8 Vinalon Complex over-fulfilled their first quarterly and April plans for producing vinalon and caustic soda. The Pukchang Thermal Power Complex and other thermal power plants have increased the output of electricity. An intensive collective emulation campaign has been waged among the complexes in the sector of coal industry. So dozens of youth shock brigades have completed their yearly or first half-yearly national economic plans ahead of schedule. The railway transport sector over-fulfilled its first quarterly and April freight transport plans and ensured the transport of important materials through a drive for extra-haulage on schedule without accident and inter-unit socialist emulation campaign. Light industry, agriculture and other sectors directly linked with the people's living have made successes since the start of the first year for implementing the 5-year plan. Collective emulation drives are being waged in the whole of the construction site of 10 000 flats in Pyongyang. Greater successes are being made every day amid the surging spirit of learning from each other, further enriching the construction experience and studying and introducing the rational way for speeding up the construction. Rodong Sinmun

title: It Is of Key Importance to Grant Actual Benefits to People
body: Many units produce plenty of vegetables in their greenhouses under the plan of the Party. The managerial staff and employees of the Jungphyong Vegetable Greenhouse Farm first calculated the days for the growth of various varieties of vegetables on scientific lines. On this basis they correctly distribute them to increase their yield and score successes in their production. The Jangchon Vegetable Farm of Sadong District, Pyongyang, the vegetable greenhouses of Tokchon City and many other vegetable greenhouse producers, too, responsibly raise their vegetable seedlings, grow their vegetables step by step and properly ensure the temperature, humidity and ventilation of their greenhouses in an endeavor to normalize their production. Consequently, this meets with due success. It is of vital importance in the lives of the people for the provinces to dynamically accelerate the construction of their modern vegetable greenhouse farms modeled after the JVGF under plans by year and for cities, counties and other units concerned to rebuild their vegetable greenhouses with an area of a hectare and boost their vegetable production definitely. Besides, it is also a matter of pressing urgency to adopt scientific and technological measures to vitalize the production of existing vegetable greenhouses and provide them with good conditions. It is essential to raise the level of scientization and intensification in the production of greenhouse vegetables. It also depends largely on the level of scientization and intensification whether hard-built vegetable greenhouses can actually help toward the lives of the people or not. Headway will be made in the production of vegetables in greenhouses when highly productive and nutritious fine varieties are chosen and grown a good deal, vegetables are distributed rationally and fertilized and tended scientifically and the producer masses are inspired to further efforts. Rodong Sinmun

title: Noble Traits Handed Down through Generations
body: We espouse the slogan "One for all and all for one!" Its idea is as high as ever despite the passage of time and the change of generations. The proud history of our gigantic national creations and transformations is unthinkable without the slogan. Our people have acquired in practice the truth that the interest of an individual lies in that of society and the collective and that the honor of an individual also consists in that of the collective. Our people still remember the workers of the Kangson Steelworks who ever lived in the Chollima era. In those days the DPRK Labor Hero Jin Ung Won tried persistently to ensure that the smelters of not only his shift but also other shifts held fast to the above slogan. Although the work of his shift was over he always failed to take a good rest to help other shift in its work. He went the length of often missing his lunch to aid another shift and returning home carrying his untouched lunchbox with him. Consequently, the workers of the KS effected innovations in their steel production. Much water has flown under the bridge since then. But the collectivist spirit of the Chollima era has so far lasted in the country as it is. The result is that the people still place the collective above themselves as during the era. It is considered the noble ethics of our society that all do good to one in the country. Thanks to the great leaders and benevolent fathers of the nation, the slogan has invariably held sway over the everyday lives of our people generation after generation despite the lapse of time. Indeed, the slogan is the epitome of a large socialist Korean family which loves the collective and puts the country before its all in single-hearted unity. This is unique to the DPRK alone in the world. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Premier Inspects Different Sectors in Eastern Area
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected several units in the eastern area of the country. He went round the Sinhong Dam and a generator room of the Tanchon Power Station No. 5. Learning in detail about the assembly of generating equipment and the power transmission system, he gave a pep-talk to the builders waging staunch campaign to carry out the decisions made at the 8th Congress of the Party and the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Party, and called for thoroughly ensuring scientific accuracy and safety in preparing for a trial operation of the generator and scrupulously managing hydraulic structure. Making rounds of the Nitrogen Shop No. 2 and a site for assembling a new generator at the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex, he stressed the need to concentrate all efforts on perfecting the production processes in a more scientific way on the principle of thoroughly putting the fertilizer industry on a Juche basis, and to fully meet the requirement of design and construction standard in the project of expanding capacity. Measures discussed at the field consultative meetings included correct assignment of tasks to relevant units to attain without fail the stepwise goals for implementing the decisions made at the Party's congress and the scrupulous and revolutionary operation and guidance. The meetings also discussed the measure for the relevant sectors to ensure the timely supply of products under contract. The premier visited the Chonnaeri Cement Factory where he acquainted himself with its foundation for production and the expansion of production capacity. He also inspected several co-op farms in Hamju, Jongphyong and Kowon counties and the Organic Compound Fertilizer Factory to learn about the preparations for springtime farming and push for relevant measures. Rodong Sinmun

title: Centenarian Receives Birthday Spread in DPRK
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un sent a birthday spread to Ryu Myong Hui, a grandmother living in Tongnam-ri of Nyongbyon County in North Phyongan Province, on her 100th birthday. Born into a tenant farmer's family before national liberation, she had lived in bitter grief resulting from statelessness, suffering all sorts of humiliation and contempt. Only after national liberation, she could lead a happy and worthwhile life in the country where people became masters of everything. She dedicated herself to farming and brought up her children to be pillars of the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Material and Technical Foundations for Fish Breeding Strengthened in DPRK
body: Fish farms across the DPRK put efforts into consolidating their material and technical foundations for boosting fish breeding. The Youth Tudan Breed Fish Farm in Pyongyang expanded the area for breeding insects to be used as feed and made pushcarts for supplying feed. New water filters were installed in the farm to raise the hatching rate. The Sohung Poman Fish Farm in North Hwanghae Province manufactured advanced feed processing equipment to increase productivity while reducing feed consumption. The Kanggye City Breed Fish Farm in Jagang Province provided hundreds of units in the city with many fries. The Rinsan Catfish Farm in North Hwanghae Province established a gravity-fed water-supply system to save electricity, provided a guarantee for ceaselessly breeding catfish and increased the area for cultivating feed grass. Other fish farms work hard to cement their material and technical foundations. Rodong Sinmun

title: Forest Conservation Brisk in DPRK
body: Forest conservation is in full swing in the DPRK. Relevant units in Pyongyang and other parts of the country established a stricter system for monitoring and notifying forest fire and mobilizing people to its prevention. They also scrupulously conduct the organizational and political work for providing necessary material and technical foundations. Mangyongdae District of Pyongyang takes measures to manage and operate in a responsible manner the monitoring cameras and forest fire belts installed in the forests of revolutionary sites and the area of Mt Ryongak. Sariwon City and Pongsan County in North Hwanghae Province enhance the responsibility of the reinforced forest fire watch posts and mobile posts to promptly tackle any circumstances. Other provinces take timely measures to get rid of dangerous elements by enhancing the roles of forest rangers, forest patrollers and forest fire watchers. They also engage in exterminating harmful insects, while pushing ahead with the anti-land-sliding project for protecting forest from flood. Rodong Sinmun

title: Emergency Anti-epidemic Work Intensified in DPRK
body: All fields and units are further intensifying emergency anti-epidemic work in the DPRK. Effective information service is conducted to raise awareness about pandemic and to remove indolence, slackness and carelessness among people, especially at loud-speaker posts set up across the country. Officials and workers in inspection and quarantine field have made it a habitual practice to disinfect and handle materials as required by anti-epidemic regulations. Medical treatment and preventive institutions and hygienic and anti-epidemic organs bring their employees and residents to the anti-epidemic and hygienic knowledge, and make sure thorough-going work system and order are in place to deal with problems in time. Anti-epidemic work has also been tightened in the large construction sites, where higher demands are raised to make it part of life to thoroughly disinfect living areas, worksites and utensils and tools. With the advent of the period of supporting the rural communities, such anti-epidemic measures are afoot by institutions, enterprises and farms as deployment of people and establishment of strict reporting system. Rodong Sinmun

title: Successes Registered in Cultivation of New land and Expansion of Grain Production Area
body: Officials and working people across the country are taking active part in cultivating new land and expanding crop production area. This year alone, over 900 hectares of new land have been put under cultivation and a large area has been turned into grain production land. South Hamgyong Province removed a large volume of deposited ore residue at several farms of Tanchon City and gave precedence to land surveying to finish the designing of field rezoning, irrigation network and structures in a short span of time. The province also finished gathering and transporting cobblestones necessary for embanking the upper stream of the River Pukchong in a short period and secured raw materials, thus providing a guarantee for turning the riverside area into cropland. Mangyongdae District and other districts in Pyongyang City have pushed ahead with turning idle land into cropland to put scores of hectares of new land under cultivation. Sakju County of North Phyongan Province has restored a large area of damaged farmland to cropland, and Unsan County of South Phyongan Province turned scores of hectares of dry field into paddy field by completing hundreds meters-long waterway. Rodong Sinmun

title: Campaign for Winning Title of Model Sci-tech Learning Space Brisk in DPRK
body: Trade union organizations at all levels are waging an intensive campaign for winning the title of model sci-tech learning space. Over 40 units won the title in the advance for implementing the decisions made at the 8th Congress of the Party and the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee. Trade union organizations at all levels scrupulously organize the ideological education work for helping their members deeply understand the Party's intention of regarding the sci-tech development as the core task and the optimum policy in the socialist construction. They also make sure that the members actively learn science and technology. The units associated with the leadership exploits of the Party distinguished themselves in helping their employees create new standards and records by routinely operating their sci-tech learning spaces. The validity and vitality of the movement for winning the title are clearly proved by experience gained by different units which succeeded in cementing the foundations for production and undergoing signal development by directing efforts to dissemination of science and technology to prepare the producer masses as intelligent workers. Rodong Sinmun

title: Preparations for Silk Culture Brisk among Women's Union Organizations
body: Women's union organizations at all levels in the DPRK are stepping up their preparations for silk culture. The Central Committee of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea (SWUK) launched a socialist emulation drive for brisk silk culture to facilitate the improvement of the people's standard of living, true to the decisions made at the Second Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. The SWUK committees in North and South Hwanghae Provinces have created scores of hectares of mulberry fields in a brief span of time, and those in Kangwon Province and South Hamgyong Province spread a large amount of manure on their mulberry fields. Women's union organizations in North Hamgyong Province and Nampho City applied advanced methods to sapling cultivation under a plan for producing mulberry saplings of good species, thus breeding hundreds of thousands of mulberry saplings. The North Phyongan Provincial Committee of the SWUK disseminated new technology and good experience among its organizations so that the union members are well versed in sci-tech information and knowledge concerning silk culture and mulberry cultivation. Other union members across the country are making sincere preparations for silk culture with a single mind to devote themselves to carrying out the first-year tasks of the new five-year plan. Rodong Sinmun

title: Area of Cultivating Aronia Melanocarpa Expands across Country
body: Aronia Melanocarpa, tree proven excellent for health, have been planted in over 550 hectares of land across the country in the spring tree planting period. Researchers of the Economic Forest Institute of the Academy of Forest Science, following their success in the study of markedly shortening the production cycle and boosting the rooting rate, tackled the problems arising in the application of the achievements. South Hamgyong Province has created lots of Aronia Melanocarpa field this year while Jagang Province keeps complying with scientific and technological demands in planting saplings to increase the rooting rate. In North Hwanghae Province, experience gained by Yonthan County in growing trees with economic efficiency has been generalized and the fields are properly manured and taken care of. Rodong Sinmun

title: Lots of Agrochemicals Produced with Raw Materials Locally Available
body: The Anak Fruit Farm (AFF) found a method of hitting its high fruit production target for this year in producing more agrochemicals than before. But the securement of raw materials for agrochemicals proved a hindrance to the production of them. The officials of the AFF gathered on many occasions and discussed how to increase the output of their agrochemicals. After all, they paid attention to using the raw materials richly available in their county for the production of their agrochemicals. They drew on their old experiences and studied scientific and technological data. They finally became convinced that they could mass-produce agrochemicals with the raw materials of their county. The AFF, first of all, set to work in reliance on its technicians. It also buckled down to applying the experiences of advanced units in the production of their agrochemicals to its production. The result was that the AFF could boost the production of its agrochemicals in a short time with the raw materials of its county. Without so much as resting on its laurels the AFF installed the agitator it made last year and thus increased the producing capacity of its agrochemicals. They are effectively used in exterminating the noxious insects of fruit trees. Rodong Sinmun

title: Coastal Culture Station Built and Equipment Assembly Actively Pushed Ahead with in Kangwon Province
body: Availing itself of its good coastal conditions Kangwon Province promotes its progress and improves the living level of its people purposefully. For example, it sees to it that its cities and counties vitalize their coastal culture and steps up the construction of the Kalma Coastal Culture Station(KCCS) dynamically. The building project for the KCCS has been finished in the main. Its culture beds are now being built on a wide area of the shallow coastal sea and the relevant equipment is being pieced together. The KCCS is to have a processing yard and a cold store,too. Officials make efforts to supply materials and equipment to those who are assigned to carry out the building projects and effectively ensure that they put up the culture beds and fix up the equipment at full steam. Fully awakened to the importance of their duty they perform in enriching the dietary lives of the provincials officials and workers give precedence to securing the materials for culture and strive hard to drive piles and stretch ropes. In addition, they preferentially fit processing machines and many other machines. Meanwhile, the province makes detailed preparations for the management of the KCCS on the one hand, and actively plant trees in and around it for landscaping purposes on the other. Rodong Sinmun

title: Hundreds of Dwellings Newly Built in North Phyongan Province
body: In North Phyongan Province (NPP) many nice houses were newly built for its working people under the great loving care of the Workers’ Party of Korea. The respected General Secretary of the WPK Comrade Kim Jong Un assigned the NPP a task of building houses for 500 families and adopted measures to provide it with the materials necessary for the project. True to the noble intention of his love for the people, the Provincial Party Committee of NPP organized a construction detachment and saw to it that motor vehicles were used for building purposes on a priority basis. As a result, tens of 4-, 5- or 6-story apartment blocks were completed admirably for hundreds of families. Trees of good species were planted and lawns sodded around the blocks for landscaping purposes. Each apartment has a living room, a room for man and wife, a kitchen, a wash room and so on for the sake of convenience. Workers began to remove to the apartment blocks from a few days ago so that they could live happily there thanks to the WPK. They were deeply moved by the unlimited selfless love of Kim Jong Un for them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Division 216 Refurbishes Samjiyon City Vigorously at Third Stage
body: The officers and men of Division 216 build Samjiyon City, the sacred place of our revolution, at the third stage according to their plan in the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance despite all their difficulties and obstacles to improve its looks more wonderfully than ever. They established the scientific methods of producing building materials with raw materials locally available by recourse to science and technology and laid the firm foundations for it. The result is that they have afforded a solid guarantee for promoting their construction project smoothly. The division effectively held an exhibition for finishing building materials, gears and tools and performed the starting-out ceremony of its motor vehicles so that all its building units could lose no time in assimilating the technological innovations and experiences gained in mutual building operations. Consequently, they make vigorous endeavors to solidify their material and technological foundations while they go all out to overtake and outstrip each other, learn from each other and swap experiences with each other. At the construction sites of the city the itinerant art squads of the division and its affiliates conduct vivid frontline agitprop activities with sound trucks, and sound amplifiers. The innovative successes are made in the construction of the city hour by hour. They show on news flash boards and competition chart boards without delay to stimulate the builders to further efforts. Rodong Sinmun

title: Pyongyang City Supports Metalworking Industry Actively
body: True to the Party’s intention of designating the metalworking industry as Height 1211 in economic construction Pyongyang actively aids the Chollima Steel Complex (CSC). On May 14 the city sent a large amount of scrap iron to the CSC with tens of motortrucks. Mangyongdae, Phyongchon, Moranbong, Tongdaewon and Pothonggang Districts registered satisfying results in collecting scrap iron. Their officials set personal examples to the popular masses in gathering iron scraps and took measures to intensively transport them to the CSC. The officials of the factories and enterprises of Pyongyang, including the Pyongyang Condiments Factory, the Pyongyang Hosiery Factory, the Pothonggang Footwear Factory and the Songyo District Fueling Station, scrapped their waste machines and thus secured iron scraps. Meanwhile, they arranged for their employees in detail to gather large quantities of scrap iron rousing their enthusiasm. The relevant officials of the Pyongyang City People’s Committee preferentially arranged for the collected iron scraps to be transported to the CSC at a time without delay. Encouraged by this, the workers of the CSC are now firmly resolved to uphold the Party with increased steel production. Rodong Sinmun

title: Its Efforts Concentrated on Renovating Phyongwon Breeding Rabbit Farm
body: South Phyongan Province fully exerts itself to renovate the Phyongwon Breeding Rabbit Farm (PBRF). It has arranged for many steady people to renovate the PBRF. It does its utmost to accelerate the project supplying the PBRF with materials for its renovation preferentially. The workhands energetically push ahead with their renovation project actively applying the advanced methods of economizing on materials and raising both its speed and quality. The officials of the PBRF, too, tap out all its reserves and potential and try hard to satisfactorily secure various kinds of materials for its renovation. The renovation project of the PBRF is accelerated fast by the officials and working people of the province to carry out their work assignments for the first year of another five-year plan admirably. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Premier Inspects Several Sectors in Sunchon Area
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected the Sunchon Cement Complex and the construction site for creating the C-1 chemical industry. He went round the Sunchon Limestone Mine responsible for the production of key raw material for cement. He called on officials and workers of the mine to set a realistic goal for increased production and take measures for it so as to ensure the smooth supply of cement for the construction of 10 000 flats in Pyongyang City, keeping in mind the importance of the project in implementing the decisions made at the 8th Congress of the Party and the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Party. He also urged them to actively introduce efficient working methods and put the work including the one for forming mining benches and increasing the capacity of conveyance on a long-term and three-dimensional basis. At the construction site for the C-1 chemical industry, he pushed for thorough-going technical preparations in all production processes and increasing the proportion of home-made equipment and locally available raw materials through close cooperation with scientific research institutions to consolidate the material and technical foundations for developing our style chemical industry. The field consultative meetings discussed the issue of taking thoroughgoing scientific and technological measures to complete the project for increasing the capacity of the Sunchon Cement Complex as early as possible and urged those units in charge of manufacturing equipment for the C-1 chemical industry to supply custom-built equipment in time in the spirit of self-reliance. The premier also visited the Phyongri Co-op Farm in Sunchon City to learn in detail about immediate farming. Rodong Sinmun

title: Fruit Trees Acclimated in Northern Part of Country Grow in Number
body: Fruit trees are in blossom in many parts of Ryanggang Province to add beauty to its landscape. The scientists and technicians of the provincial agricultural science institute, Hyesan University of Agriculture and Forestry and the provincial commission of science and technology dedicated all their wisdom and ardor to acclimating various kinds of fruit trees in the northern alpine region of Korea and developing them into hardy ones. The national scientific institutes aided in propagating the fruit trees throughout the province. The provincial Party committee convinced the scientists and technicians engaged in fruit culture that they could do whatever they decided to and energetically spurred them to carry out the ideas of the Party and defend its policies. The result was that apple trees, plums and many other fruit trees stroke root in Ryanggang Province. Fruit subworkteams and villages with fruit trees increase in number in the farms of the province. Under the guidance of the provincial Party committee the province consistently propagates fruit trees of delicious and nourishing varities true to the decisions of the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Congress of the Workers’ Party of Korea to promote its development and better the living standard of its people. Of late, the province produced large numbers of young fruit trees and sent them to many areas. Pochon County encourages its inhabitants in planning wild pear trees. Lots of fruit trees have taken root and thrive in the villages of the members of the Poso and Thongsin Farms in Samjiyon City. Rodong Sinmun

title: Third-stage Project for Remodeling Samjiyon City Pushed forward as Planned
body: The third-stage project for remodeling Samjiyon City is being pushed ahead as planned.
