There is a poster that calls on all farmers to devote themselves to grass-cutting in order to prepare more green manure for improving the fertility of soil. Rodong Sinmun

title: The Most Advantageous System under Which Everyone Can Learn to Their Hearts’ Content
body: In the DPRK, everybody learns to their hearts’ content under the benevolent socialist educational system. When they learned that a disabled soldier without two hands graduate from a university people may not readily believe it. But it is true. Ham Jong Ho, a resident in Jongo-dong 1, Rangnang District, lost his two hands while discharging his military duty at the front. Discharged from military service he returned home. Whenever he saw university students in the street he envied them very much. He was very anxious to study at a university as a child. But he thought that he could not do so for lack of hands and gave up studying. One day the teachers of the telelecture faculty of Pyongyang Han Tok Su University of Light Industry (PHTSULI) called on him at his house. This was quite beyond expectation. They said that they were told that he wished to study at a university. They reassured him that they would help him in his study as best they could. They encouraged him to study in real earnest and provided him with what was needed for his telelectures. Since then he had attended the telelectures of the university at home for many years on end as he earnestly wished. The university teachers frequented him and presented him with tonics and daily necessities as well as textbooks and reference books. In March 2021 he finally graduated from PHTSULI with a diploma. Employed in factories, farms, coal mines and other units large numbers of people are given lessons at colleges and universities throughout the country under the study-while-working system. At the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill alone hundreds of its employees are college and university students although they work there in the main. They include housewives and workers in their thirties and forties. Our country boasts the Sci-Tech Complex and the Grand People’s Study House in Pyongyang. All its provinces and their cities and counties each have libraries. They help all the people in their studies a great deal. Rodong Sinmun

title: More Youth Volunteer to Work in Major Socialist Construction Sectors
body: More young people of South Hamgyong, North Hwanghae and Jagang provinces have volunteered to work in major sectors of socialist construction, amid the loyalty and revolutionary spirit highly growing among young people in the DPRK in response to the idea and spirit of the 8th Party Congress and the 10th Congress of the youth league. Determined to realize their ideal and hope wherever the Party appealed to the youth to work, those of South Hamgyong Province volunteered to work in fruit farms such as the Ryongjon Fruit Farm and socialist rural areas, the February 8 Vinalon Complex, the construction site of the Tanchon Power Station and the fishing sector in the province. Over 700 graduates from middle schools for orphans and senior middle schools of North Hwanghae Province, who grew up happily while learning to their heart's content under the care of the mother Party, volunteered to work in difficult fields. They evinced their pledge to fulfill their role as young vanguards of the Party by devoting their energy, intelligence and passion in cooperative farms and at the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex and other places in the province. Tens of graduates from Huichon Middle School for Orphans in Jagang Province volunteered to the forestry sector in the province. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Congratulatory Message to Syrian President
body: Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a congratulatory message to Bashar Al-Assad, president of the Syrian Arab Republic, on May 28. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un in his message extended warm congratulations to Bashar Al-Assad upon the successful presidential election in Syria and his reelection as the president of the Syrian Arab Republic. He said that through the election the Syrian government and people demonstrated at home and abroad their will to resolutely frustrate ceaseless aggressive and obstructive moves and threats by the imperialists and all sorts of hostile forces and to firmly defend the sovereignty and security of the country under the leadership of the president. Expressing belief that the historic relations of friendship and cooperation between the DPRK and Syria would steadily develop, he sincerely wished the Syrian president greater successes in his responsible work for building peaceful and prosperous Syria. Rodong Sinmun

title: Oath-taking Meeting Held by Working Class and Trade Union Members
body: The working class and trade union members had a meeting on May 29 to vow to fully demonstrate the militant might of the heroic working class in the struggle for a new victory of socialist construction under the leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. Present at the meeting held before the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill were Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, delegates to the Eighth Congress of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea (GFTUK) and observers. Prior to the meeting, the participants laid a floral basket, bouquets and flowers at the statues before making a deep bow. Pak In Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the GFTUK, made a report to be followed by speeches. The reporter and speakers said that all the working class and trade union members are full of a determination to bring earlier a new victory of socialist construction without fail after receiving the important letter sent by Kim Jong Un to the participants in the Eighth Congress of the GFTUK. They called upon the working class and trade union members to bear in mind the great trust and love placed in them by the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un and successfully fulfill their role as the eldest son of the country and the vanguard unit making a breakthrough in carrying out the new five-year plan for national economic development. They also called for giving full play to the fighting spirit displayed in postwar reconstruction and during the great Chollima upswing, helping and leading each other forward under the communist slogan "One for all and all for one!" Saying that all the union members should become competent worker-inventors and masters of invention by studying modern science and technology hard, as required by the policy of making all the people well versed in science and technology, they stressed the need to make every worksite of upswing brim with optimism, good emotions, militant spirit and zeal through brisk mass-based sports, cultural and artistic activities. They underscored the need for all the sectors and units to effectively wage a socialist emulation drive, a movement to create model lathes following the example of Lathe No. 26, a mass technological innovation movement and other mass movements so as to make all worksites bustling places brimming with the efforts to create new standards and records and raise a strong wind of collective emulations without interruption. They vowed to become resolute class fighters who stamp out without mercy all sorts of anti-socialist and non-socialist practices which undermine the social system, thoroughly establish the socialist lifestyle across the country and defend the political and ideological position like an impregnable fortress. They expressed the steadfast will to demonstrate to the full the might of the vanguard unit in the sacred struggle for ushering in a period of a new upsurge in socialist construction by thoroughly implementing the important tasks set forth by Kim Jong Un in the letter. A letter of pledge to Kim Jong Un was adopted at the meeting. Rodong Sinmun

title: Short Course for Participants in 8th Congress of GFTUK Given
body: A short course for the participants in the 8th Congress of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea (GFTUK) was given in Pyongyang on Saturday. The short course dealt with practical matters for fully demonstrating the revolutionary spirit of the heroic working class of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il by deeply studying and grasping the essence of the important letter sent by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un to the participants in the congress and further enhancing the combat efficiency of trade union organizations in the campaign for carrying out the decisions of the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea and the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Party. Ri Il Hwan, member of the Political Bureau and secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, gave a lecture titled "On making sure that the participants in the congress fulfill their responsibility and duty in the campaign for carrying out the decisions of the 8th Congress of the GFTUK". He stressed that the important letter sent by the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un is the immortal guideline clearly indicating the tasks and ways for developing the trade unions into the vanguard unit opening a period of a new upsurge in socialist construction. The short course referred to the importance of regarding it as a lifeline to thoroughly establish the unified leadership system of Kim Jong Un within the trade unions and further intensifying the work for doing so. The lecturer stressed the need to direct all efforts of the trade union work to modeling the whole trade unions on the revolutionary idea of the General Secretary. He also emphasized the need to absolutize the authority of the Party Central Committee and safeguard it in every way, effectively conduct the work for defending and glorifying the Party's leadership feats, meticulously organize the work for devotedly implementing the Party policies and establish steel-like discipline and order in implementing them. The short course called for having full readiness to unconditionally implement the decisions of the 8th Congress of the GFTUK with the militant task set forth at the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea as the guideline. The lecturer said the success in implementing the decisions of the congress entirely depends on the ideological readiness of the participants in the congress who are the hard core of the GFTUK and its leading officials who organize and guide the trade unions' work, being responsible for education of the members. The lecturer urged the participants to have an ideological viewpoint and stand to have their loyalty to the Party and executive ability verified in practice, being well aware of the fact that the decisions of the congress are an organizational will of the whole trade unions and the objective to be attained by them without fail and that it is the fundamental guarantee for defending and glorifying the Party's leadership feats to implement the decisions of the congress. The course stressed the need for all the participants in the congress to thoroughly implement the tasks set forth in the historic letter so as to bring about a change through dynamic labor efforts on all fronts of socialist construction. The participants visited several places of Pyongyang before and after the congress. They watched a performance of the Workers' Art Group of the Central Committee of the GFTUK and a film, and conducted colorful political and cultural activities. Rodong Sinmun

title: Focusing All Their Efforts and Means on Agriculture
body: The officials and agricultural workers of North Phyongan Province are all out to transplant rice to hit the Party’s grain production target without fail this year when another five-year national economic plan has begun to be carried out. In order to bed out rice seedlings in paddies at the earliest possible date the province ensures that agitprop activities are conducted intensively by itinerant art squads and with the help of sound trucks to motivate farmers and their helpers ideologically to work with might and main. Kwaksan, Thaechon, Sakju and Phihyon Counties lead the province in rice transplantation. Their officials and agricultural workers register great results in their rice transplantation every day to finish it qualitatively in due season. Ryongchon County makes sure that its Jangsan and Sinam Cooperative Farms attain one success after another in bedding out rice seedlings, thus setting examples to its other farms and widely generalizing their experiences. The case is similar to Sonchon County as regards its Unjong and Samyang Cooperative Farms. In Tongrim County the officials of its county-level organs take the lead in rice transplantation. They bolster backward processes and make a breakthrough in them.In Unjon County officials set personal examples to farmers in work in hundreds of subworkteams, encouraging them to do their immediate farm work enthusiastically. The officials and agricultural workers of those cities and counties which lagged behind in agriculture in the past bestir themselves for their farm work with new determination. Rodong Sinmun

title: Dissemination of Advanced Sci-tech Information Brisk in DPRK
body: The Grand People's Study House puts efforts into disseminating advanced sci-tech information. It has secured and disseminated lots of new technological data required for increasing production in factories and enterprises and intensifying their research work. Since the outset of this year, it has stored in its database over 4.4 million pieces of technological data that help solve pressing sci-tech problems in various sectors of the national economy. Those data greatly help resolve technological problems in boosting production. Its online service also tangibly contributes to production growth in many units and their development through prompt dissemination of new information. Rodong Sinmun

title: Changdok School Nicely Forested and Landscaped
body: These days many people visit the Changdok School charmed by various kinds of flowering shrubs, trees and ground cover plants of ornamental value and good species which are planted in its premises for thousands of square meters for landscaping purposes. The teaching staff and pupils of the school affectionately call the grove a small botanical garden. The grove and the benches among it are a manifestation of the diligence and sincerity of the school. The school buckled down to wooding and landscaping its premises from three years ago up to now. Fully aware of the importance of the forestation of their school its principal by the name of Jon Jong Ho and its other officials as well drew up a plan for their forestation with the help of specialists in forestation. They saw to it that the staff of their school read botanical books and watched visual aids and went out to wood its premises. The Party is now emphasizing that a plan for forestation must be formulated definitely on a high level, that parks and recreation grounds must be spruced up beautifully and that trees, flowering plants and ground cover plants of good strains must be set out in good harmony to change the appearances of cities anew. When everybody turns out in afforestation with patriotism like the officials, teachers and pupils of the school our country will become more beautiful than ever. Rodong Sinmun

title: Devotion and Attachment to Their Products
body: The woman employees of the Pyongyang Musical Instrument Factory do their utmost to produce A1 musical instruments every time. They all take pride in that they work at an honored factory. Accordingly, they have tried their hardest to make great numbers of good products competitive in the world. The result is that they have won successes in turning out super musical instruments such as accordions and bayans. Each of them will make sweet melodies and inspire our people with confidence in victory and spur them to work miracles and innovations in their work. Rodong Sinmun

title: Potato-planting Finished in Ryanggang Province
body: Farms in Ryanggang Province finished potato-planting. Potato planting started earlier, as compared to the past, in almost every farm of the province. The Provincial Rural Economy Committee made sure that the farms thoroughly observed the requirements of the scientific potato farming method while piling soil on seed potatoes to protect them from the cold brought by unfavorable weather. The farms finished potato-planting at an early date by concentrating manpower and machines on it. Officials and agricultural workers in the province now engage in the immediate farming work. Rodong Sinmun

title: Successes Gained in Their Rice Transplantation across Country and Their Daily Plans Overfulfilled
body: Rice seedlings are bedded out at full steam in the paddy fields of cooperative farms nationwide. Officials and working people, plus their helpers, work hard as one throughout the country to make a breakthrough without fail in hitting their cereal production target for this year and overfulfill the plans for their daily rice transplantation. The cooperative farms of North Phyongan Province push ahead with their rice transplantation like lightning. Kwaksan County enhanced the role of its pump operators, rice cold-bed tenders and tractor drivers and stepped up all its farm work by processes excellently. Consequently, it made sure that rice seedlings were set out in its major paddies by and large as of May 28. Thaechon, Kujang and Yomju Counties bedded out rice seedlings in their paddies without delay harrowing them on a priority basis and putting their farm machines in full operation. The agricultural workers of other cities and counties and their helpers as well also do all they can to do their immediate farm work helping and leading each other forward on the principle of collectivism. As a result, the province scores good results day by day in transplanting rice in lots of its paddy fields. In South Hwanghae Province agricultural workers and their helpers work hard on rice fields in high spirits. Anak County executes its agricultural plan without fail paying close attention to bedding out standard rice seedlings in its paddies. The cooperative farms of Jaeryong County and Haeju City nourish their rice seedling and harrow their fields well. Meanwhile, their employees as well as their helpers go all out to transplant rice in the best season. In Sinchon County and other counties agricultural workers and their helpers work on their fields by the sweat of their brows fully aware that qualitative rice transplantation is not a simple practical problem but a responsible work to meet the demand of the Party policy of agriculture and the Juche methods of farming. Rice transplantation is sped up at the cooperative farms of North Hamgyong Province. Kilju, Myongchon and Hwadae Counties gave definite precedence to the leading processes of their farm work and thus finished setting out rice seedlings in their paddy fields giving full play to the vitality of taking charge of fields under the subworkteam management system. The agricultural workers of Kyonghung County and Kim Chaek County tried their hardest to harrow their rice fields and set out rice seedlings thoroughly according to the demand of the Juche methods of farming firmly determined to reap abundant harvests without fail this year. In other cities and counties agricultural workers and their helpers, too, do their parts responsibly deeply conscious that even a day’s delay in rice transplantation considerably decreases rice yield. South Hamgyong Province accelerates its rice transplantation actively carrying on intensive political work and widely generalizing the experiences of exemplary units. The agricultural workers of Hongwon County nourish their rice plants scientifically and technologically according to kinds and varieties and overfulfill their plan to reap bumper harvest this year. The cooperative farms of Jongphyong and Kumya Counties harrow their paddy fields well, take good care of their rice seedbeds, put their farm machines in full operation and set out rice seedlings under their plans. The officials and agricultural workers of Nampho City and their helpers as well transplant rice in paddies at full steam with one mind and one purpose. Kangso District, Nampho City successfully finished setting out rice seedlings in its major fields. The cooperative farms of its Chollima District bedded out accurate numbers of rice plants per phyong and per cluster in its paddies giving priority to quality. The agricultural workers of the other districts and counties of the city and their helpers as well transplant rice with all care and top their daily plans without fail overtaking and outstripping each other, learning from each other and exchanging experiences with each other. The officials and agricultural workers of Kaesong City and other areas as well as their helpers work hard in unison to set out rice seedlings in due season qualitatively and successfully, thereby registering great results in their work. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Premier Inspects South and North Hamgyong Provinces
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the DPRK, inspected several units in South and North Hamgyong provinces. Learning about the overall situation of the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex, he gave pep talks to its workers all out for attaining the goal of iron and steel production set by the Eighth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea. He stressed the need to concentrate forces on the construction of a new energy-saving iron blast furnace, increase the operation ratio of equipment and perfect the concentrates-transport system. At the Chongjin Steel Plant, he underlined the need to update the current production processes by dint of advanced technology and ensure timely supply of raw and other materials and fuel to decisively increase the production in line with the orientation of overhauling and developing the key industrial sectors set forth at the Party Congress. At the Musan Mining Complex, the premier stressed the need to boost the iron ore production by steadily cementing the material and technical foundations, according to the step-wise goal and plan for implementing the economic strategy of the Party. Inspecting the Ranam Coal-mining Machine Complex and the Hoeryong Coal-mining Machine Factory, he discussed the practical issues arising in developing and producing modern coal-mining machines, according to the orientation of developing the machine-building industry in the period of implementing the new five-year plan. The field consultative meetings discussed the measures for increasing the capacity of Juche iron production and using brown coal in the northern part of the country for the production of pig iron. They organized in detail the work for the relevant units to responsibly supply equipment and materials and fully supply iron and steel needed for the construction of 10 000 flats in Pyongyang City. Meanwhile, the premier inspected different farms in Tanchon and Hoeryong cities and Hongwon, Pukchong, Kumya and Kowon counties. He acquainted himself with the immediate farming there and took necessary measures. Rodong Sinmun

title: The Potato Farms of Ryanggang Province Actively Supported
body: The ministries and national organs of the country help Ryanggang Province in its potato farming both materially and morally in response to the Party policy of making a revolution in potato production. They have adopted detailed measures to support the farms of Samjiyon City and Paegam County and given assignments to their departments. They explore for and tap out all their reserves and potentials to supply the farms with farming equipments as much as possible. Many officials of the ministries and national organs have visited the farms of Samjiyon City unintermittently since the outset of last May. They enthusiastically support the potato farms of Paegam County, too. Many ministries and national organs donated to the farms the vinyl chloride sheets and other farming materials badly needed to grow potatoes as well as building materials and conducted fresh political work among their members. Consequently, the agricultural workers of the city and county fully apply themselves to their present farm work to report their ample potato harvest to the Party this year. Rodong Sinmun

title: Lots of Meritorious Persons of Socialist Patriotism Produced
body: Lots of meritorious persons of socialist patriotism have been produced across the country since the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea. They are living a life of ardent loyalty, pure conscience and unremitting dedication and enthusiasm for building a powerful and prosperous country whether they are recognized or not. Kim Kyong Chol, chief of the Furnace Shop of the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex, introduced more than 30 inventions into putting the production of Juche iron on a normal footing and played a vital role in producing three times as much pig iron as that in the early days after the start of operation. Dr. Ri Song Won, manager of the Munchon Coal Mine, has held a firm grip on science and technology for the past decade, thus boosting the coal production 1.8 times in the last few years and contributing to winning the three-revolution red flag title. Several officials and workers have been honored to receive the title of meritorious person of socialist patriotism in the first half of the year. Among them is Kim Tong Su, forest ranger in charge of Kaphyong-ri of the Ryongyon County Forestry Management Station, who turned the forest of more than 1 000 hectares into gold and treasure mountains for over the past two decades. Among the ever-increasing ranks are also many others in provinces, cities and counties across the country including the director of the power plant No. 3 of the Sodusu Power Station, a work-team leader of the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex and a work-team leader of the Puraesan Cement Factory, who are distinguished for their meritorious services for the prosperity of the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Birthday Spread Sent to Centenarian
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un sent a birthday spread to Kim Pyong Hun living in Paekam-ri, Sukchon County of South Phyongan Province, on his 100th birthday. He, born into a poor tenant's family during the Japanese colonial rule, lived a hard life. It was not until President Kim Il Sung liberated the country and built a genuine people's state that he could live a worthwhile life. He devoted himself to socialist rural construction as an official of a primary organization. Even after becoming a pensioner, the optimistic man volunteered to work to bring benefit to the country's economy. Now he enjoys doing a bit of farming and breeding. He always asks his family and neighbors to work hard for the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Their National Economic Plans for May Fulfilled
body: In the sector of the metallurgical industry workers and management of many factories and mines topped their national economic plans for May. The Musan Mining Complex, the Unryul, Jaeryong, Hungsan, Jangsan and Ramjong Mines, the Hungnam Electrode Factory and many other units bent every effort to satisfactorily turn out iron ores, refractory and electrodes while taking the initiative in adopting measures to unravel their actual knotty problems of their production. The workers of the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex and the Chollima Steel Complex also effected collective innovations in their production and thereby carried out the plans for the production of their iron and steel. The labor and management of the Puryong Ferroalloy Factory surmounted their difficulties courageously in the spirit of self-reliance with science and technology and registered great results in the production of their ferroalloy. In the field of the chemical industry the officials and workers of many units executed their national economic plans for May. Those of the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex made endeavors to balance their production processes and optimize their use of machines, thus bringing about an upswing in the production of their workshops. The Namhung Youth Chemical Complex mass-produced its fertilizer. The workers and management of the February 8 Vinalon Complex pushed forward the production of their vinalon, caustic soda and vinyl chloride according to their plan stepping up the home production of their catalysts and taking good technological care of their machinery. In the sector of the coal industry officials and workers strove mightily to produce coal aware that they took responsibility for developing the independent economy in the van of the country. The miners of the Sunchon Area Youth Coal Mining Complex and the Tokchon Area Coal Mining Complex increased the output of their coal despite their manifold difficulties. The February 8 Jikdong Youth Coal Mine, the Chonsong Youth Coal Mine, the Jenam and Namyang Coal Mines and other coal mines channeled their efforts on securing coalfields in areas with large coal deposits and favorable mining conditions and raising their carrying capacity of coal. The result was that they normalized the production of their coal. The Pukchang Area Youth Coal Mining Complex tried methodologically to generalize successes in its advanced technological innovations, thereby scoring great results in its coal production day to day. The miners of the Namdok, Phunggok, Songnam, Inpho and Hoean Youth Coal Mines drilled and blasted rocks one after another and boosted their coal production giving full play to their collectivism. The Kaechon and Tukjang Area Coal Mining Complexes achieved one success after another in their coal production actively contriving rational methods and applying them to their production and making efficient machines on their own. Rodong Sinmun

title: Rice Transplantation Finished One after Another across the Country
body: As of June 1, throughout the country about 70 cities, counties and districts as well as more than 1,200 farms and cooperative farms finished bedding out rice seedlings in their paddy fields. They grow in number hour after hour. North Phyongan Province led the whole nation in successfully finishing transplanting rice in its main paddies in due season by May 31. It is now ensuring that the water of its rice fields is controlled, that their harmful insects are exterminated and that rice plants are fertilized and tended there well. Meanwhile, it concentrates its efforts on weeding the fields. In North Hamgyong Province Kilju and Myongchon Counties were the first of all to finish setting out rice seedlings in their paddies. As of June 1, seven cities and counties like Hwadae County and Hoeryong City as well as over 160 farms and cooperative farms followed suit. In Kangwon, South Phyongan and North and South Hwanghae Provinces, Nampho City and other regions cooperative farms finish transplanting rice in their paddy fields one after the other. Rodong Sinmun

title: All Out to Support Cooperative Farms
body: All the country dynamically helps cooperative farms in their rice transplantation. From the beginning of this year officials and working people countrywide donated large quantities of organic manure, farm implements and various kinds of other farming materials to cooperative farms and helped their agricultural workers in preparations for their farm work in the fields as best they could. The officials of ministries and national institutions take the lead in assisting cooperative farms in their work. In North Phyongan Province provincial officials arrange for its cooperative farms to be aided in their work well under the guidance of the provincial Party committee. South Hwanghae Province, too, sees to it that assistance is given to its cooperative farms. Cooperative farms are backed up well without cease in South Hamgyong Province and other provinces. Rodong Sinmun

title: Their National Economic Plans for May Fulfilled
body: In the realm of the electric power industry workers and management boosted the production of electric power and overfulfilled their production plan for May. The Ministry of Electric Power Industry laid the main stress on increasing the production of hydroelectric and thermal power stations directing it well. The Suphung, Hochongang, Sodusu and Jangjingang Power Stations mass-produced electricity observing technological regulations thoroughly, following the methods of standard operation and operating their electric generators efficiently with the water which falls from a great height. The Pukchang Thermal Power Complex, the Pyongyang Thermal Power Plant and other thermal power stations countrywide fulfilled the plans for the production of their electric power operating their boilers and other turbine electric generators scientifically and technologically. The Ministry of Railways established the one-man traffic control system strictly, channeled its primary efforts on transporting materials to the major sectors of the national economy like the metallurgical and chemical industries and made sure that locomotives and freight cars were used effectively than ever. The result was that it executed its transport plan for May. In the domain of machine industry officials and workers topped their national economic plan for May. The labor and management of cement factories nationwide carried out their cement production for May. Those of the Sangwon and Sunchon Cement Complexes and the Chonnaeri Cement Factory brought about a daily upswing in their production carrying on an active drive to overtake and outstrip each other, learn from each other and exchange experiences with each other and intensifying their cooperation among workshops, workteams and shifts. Rodong Sinmun

title: Ordinary Working People Are June 4 Literature Prize Winners
body: Our country actively encourages working people, including literary correspondents, in producing literary and art works. Literary correspondents are individually guided by an author of the writers union of the district concerned in their works and are given intensive literary lessons for a certain period of time every year. Since the early 1980s our country has awarded the June 4 Literature Prize to those literary correspondents who created excellent works. An official of the Central Committee of the Writers Union of Korea said that tens of literary correspondents had so far been awarded the prize. An ordinary worker, farmer and office employee were the first in our country to receive the prize. A young female farmer of Yangdok County wrote a short novel which depicts the members of the Children’s Union of Korea taking the sincerest care of a revolutionary site, rain or snow. She was awarded the prize for it. When he was a workers of a building maintenance station in Pyongyang a young man composed a poem on mutual assistance and care prevalent in our society, for which the prize was conferred on him. Later on, he composed many other poems enjoyed by the people very much. The prize winners include a special class disabled soldier. Commoners such as the workers of mines and coal mines and university students carried off the prize, and what is better, have now grown into university teachers and authors. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Floral Basket to Raul Castro Ruz
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un sent a floral basket to Raul Castro Ruz on his birthday. The DPRK ambassador to Cuba courteously handed over the floral basket bearing the august name of Kim Jong Un to an official of the International Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba on Thursday. Written on the ribbon of the floral basket were the letters "Best Wishes for good health of the respected Comrade Raul Castro Ruz". Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Congratulatory Message to Raul Castro Ruz
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un sent a congratulatory message to Raul Castro Ruz on Thursday. Kim Jong Un in the message extended his sincere congratulations and warm comradely greetings to the respected Comrade Raul Castro Ruz on his birthday. He said in the message Raul Castro Ruz made distinguished contribution to achieving the freedom and liberation of the Cuban people by waging the hard-fought armed struggle in his early years together with Fidel Castro Ruz, the eternal leader of the Cuban revolution. He has victoriously led the Communist Party of Cuba and the Cuban people for firmly defending and adding luster to the sovereignty and dignity of the country and the gains of the revolution braving all kinds of hardships and difficulties of the history for the past decades, the message added. Kim Jong Un in the message said he was very glad that the sacred revolutionary cause of Cuba pioneered and led by Fidel Castro Ruz and Raul Castro Ruz all their lives has been steadily carried forward and is dynamically advancing. Our Party and people always remember and appreciate the great contributions made by Raul Castro Ruz to strengthening the genuine comradely unity and the ties of friendship and cooperation between the two parties and the two countries in the struggle for accomplishing the cause of independence and socialism against imperialism, the message noted. It sincerely wished Raul Castro Ruz, the veteran leader of the Cuban revolution and a close friend and revolutionary comrade-in-arms of the Korean people, good health and happiness. Rodong Sinmun

title: 2nd Enlarged Plenary Meeting of 10th Central Committee of Socialist Patriotic Youth League Held
body: The 2nd Enlarged Plenary Meeting of the 10th Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League (SPYL) took place through video teleconferencing on June 2. Attending the meeting were members and alternate members of the Central Committee of the youth league. Present there in observer's capacity were officials of the city and county committees of the youth league. The meeting discussed the matter of thoroughly carrying out the important tasks set forth in the letter "Demonstrate to the Full the Might of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League on the Historic March towards a Fresh Victory in the Revolution" sent by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un to the 10th Congress of the youth league. Mun Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the SPYL, made a report. He said that the important letter sent by the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un clearly indicates the tasks and ways for the Socialist Patriotic Youth League to fully demonstrate its militant might in a fresh and historic advance of socialist construction. Saying that the whole country follows with great trust and expectation the young people who are on their mark after receiving the letter of the General Secretary, he called upon them to fulfill their sacred mission and duty as the young vanguard in the historic advance for winning a fresh victory in the revolution, fluttering the flag of the SPYL. Speeches were made at the meeting. Adopted at the meeting was a relevant resolution on the basis of the study of the draft resolution. Rodong Sinmun

title: 3rd Plenary Meeting of 8th C.C. WPK to Be Convened
body: The Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) decided to convene the 3rd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Party in early June to make an interim summing-up of the execution of the immediate key policies of the Party and the state for 2021 advanced at the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Party and to discuss and decide a series of matters arising in dynamically and correctly pushing forward with them. A relevant resolution of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK was made public on June 4.

title: 1st Meeting of Political Bureau of 8th C.C., WPK Held
body: The 1st meeting of the Political Bureau of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) took place at the office building of the Party Central Committee on June 4. Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the WPK and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, presided over the meeting. Attending the meeting were members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK and members and alternate members of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK. The meeting made an interim summing-up of the execution of the key policies of the Party and the state for 2021 advanced at the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Party, and discussed as a major agenda the issue of convening a plenary meeting of the Central Committee of the Party to take additional state measures for solving pending problems urgent for the economic work and people's living. Positively appreciating that a lot of planned works are being sped up on a long-term basis, thanks to the ideological enthusiasm and fighting spirit of self-reliance of the entire Party and all the people which were considerably raised by the 8th Congress of the Party though the smooth development of the state affairs are being seriously challenged and restricted due to the prevailing unfavorable subjective and objective conditions and environment, the respected General Secretary briefed and analyzed the execution of major policy tasks in different fields for the first half of the year. He stressed that at the present point it is necessary to convene a plenary meeting of the Central Committee of the Party and make correct summing-up of the overall state affairs for the first half of the year to take additional measures for setting right the deflective matters in time. Saying that the Party and the government should make every possible effort, bearing in mind their very important mission and responsibility under the current situation prevailing at home and abroad, he emphasized that under the present situation it is necessary to propel a staunch campaign for the stability and improvement of the economy and people's living by signally enhancing the leading role of the Party. The Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Party adopted a decision on convening the 3rd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Party in early June. It also studied and discussed in depth the issue for the structural reorganization of departments of the Central Committee of the Party and other items to be presented to the plenary meeting of the Party Central Committee, and approved them. Political News Team

title: All Out for Their Increased Production the Way They Fulfilled Their National Economic Plans for May
body: In the domain of the mining industry officials and workers splendidly carried out their national economic plan for May. The labor and management of the Unpha Mine concentrated their efforts on securing reserved breakage faces and increased the output of their minerals. Those of the December 5 Youth Mine fully exerted themselves to establish their production processes speedily with their efforts and technology and fulfilled the plan for the production of their minerals. The workers and management of the Yongyu Mine, the major mines of the Management Bureau for the Phosphatic Fertilizer Industry, the Riwon, Sijung and Sangnong Mines and the Hyesan Youth Mine also brought about an upswing in their production in a collectivist spirit despite overlapping difficulties. The Taedonggang Storage Battery Factory and many other units designated the recycling of their wastes as the motive force for their development and executed their plans on all important indices through a fierce technological innovation drive. In the field of the lumber industry labor and management topped their lumber production plan for May effecting a collective innovation. In the sphere of light industry workers and management strove energetically to use domestic raw materials and reclaim their industrial wastes convinced that it was of vital importance in developing light industry. The result was that they fulfilled their national economic plan for May. Textile, knitwear and footwear factories across the country went all out to boost the production of their consumer goods. In the sector of the daily necessities and cosmetics industries officials and workers filled up the shortage of raw and other materials on their own and successfully carried out the national economic plan for May. The officials and workers of the Bureau of Sericulture and Silk Industry organized a socialist emulation to increase the output of their goods on the principle of giving priority to quality over quantity and thereby responsibly topped their plan. Rodong Sinmun

title: Plastic Bags Produced with Waste Materials
body: A process for the production of plastic bags was newly set up at a food administration station of Sinchon County. Consequently, lots of plastic bags can annually be produced with various kinds of plastic wastes. The director of the station and its other managerial personnel, workers and technicians tried their hardest to secure a machine for the production of plastic bags and repair, maintain and improve it. They obviated their technological difficulties in close liaison with researchers of the unit concerned. In addition, the station did all it could to establish a production process and erect a building. As a result, in a short time plastic bags became able to be produced with wastes. A few days ago the first bag was turned out at the station. Rodong Sinmun

title: We Are Also in Charge of Farm Work
body: In South Hwanghae Province many people stay at cooperative farms and join their members in doing farm work like masters, convinced that they are also responsible for it this year. Besides, they lend their great material help to them. In Ongjin and Kangryong Counties and many other areas helpers of farm work provided materials for visual aids to the cooperative farms they are attached to so that slogans can show in the fields to egg their members on to implement the decisions of the 8th Party Congress and that notices of innovations in work can be pasted on large bulletin boards and other mobile ones. The result is that farmers are very much inspired to further efforts. In a cooperative farm a tractor suddenly stopped while harrowing its paddy fields full steam. An official of a unit in Haeju City lost no time in securing toothed wheels and many other kinds of accessories, thereby enabling farm work to be done on schedule. Learning that a drainpipe of a workteam’s pumping station got broken to hinder irrigation water from being supplied to the fields of a farm an official procured an iron pipe and welding rods and repaired the drainpipe without delay. Consequently, rice seedlings were bedded out according to the plan. At a cooperative farm of Thaethan County an official of the South Hwanghae Provincial People’s Committee was informed that the suction pipes of a pumping station of a workteam corroded too much to feed water to a number of paddies smoothly. He secured necessary materials for the pipes. He also saw to it that the pumping station was supplied with electricity all the time. In Paechon, Unryul and Pongchon Counties the helpers of their cooperative farms paid close attention to the livelihood of their members and actively helped them. They also provided them with accessories of farming machines and various kinds of other farming materials and helped toward putting tractors and rice transplanters in full operation. The helpers of cooperative farms are firmly determined as never before to responsibly do their agricultural work like masters believing that their fields belong to them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Remains of Late Kim Yun Sim Buried in Patriotic Martyrs Cemetery in Sinmi-ri
body: Remains of Recipient of Order of Kim Il Sung and Order of Kim Jong Il Kim Yun Sim, general officer of the Korean People's Army (KPA), were buried in the Patriotic Martyrs Cemetery in Sinmi-ri with due ceremony on June 4. He, who grew up to be a steadfast and competent naval commanding officer under the care of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, firmly guarded the outpost for defending the country, people and revolution remaining boundlessly faithful to the leadership of the Party Central Committee till the last moments of his life. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un lavished great trust and love on him for his contribution to developing the Juche-oriented naval force and made sure that his remains were buried in the Patriotic Martyrs Cemetery. Present at the burial ceremony were KPA Vice Marshal Kwon Yong Jin, director of the KPA General Political Bureau, other KPA commanding officers and bereaved families. Kwon Yong Jin said that the martyr was given an everlasting life thanks to the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un, who adds luster to the feats and life of the revolutionary martyr who guarded the country's seas all his life. He called on the KPA commanding officers and the bereaved families to make positive contributions to the country's prosperity with substantial successes at the revolutionary posts entrusted by the Party by emulating the firm revolutionary spirit and fighting spirit displayed by the martyr. Then the remains were buried. The participants laid wreaths and bouquets at the grave and paid a silent tribute to the memory of the deceased. They vowed to uphold the guidance of the respected General Secretary with one mind and display loyalty and perform feats in the van of the struggle for carrying out the decisions of the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea and the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Party. Rodong Sinmun

title: Anti-Epidemic Work Intensified in All Fields and Units of DPRK
body: The worldwide health crisis getting worse due to the rapid spread of virus variants of high contagiousness and fatality demands that all people wage emergency anti-epidemic work on high alert. The central emergency anti-epidemic field is directing big efforts into establishing disciplines and orders for people to comply with anti-epidemic rules while taking thorough-going measures against all elements that can weaken the anti-epidemic wall. The public health field is ensuring responsible medical check-ups and steadily improving medical service. It is also preventing the outbreak of all kinds of diseases by further perfecting tele-medical service system. Institutions and industrial establishments are awakening people after setting up notice boards bearing anti-epidemic rules as part of intensified anti-epidemic information service. They have also set up a system of organizing and summing up daily work with a priority given to anti-epidemic work. Commercial and catering service units are managing and disinfecting facilities and apparatuses in a responsible way and paying deep attention to removing any pores through which virus may find its way. Educational institutions and child-care facilities are intensifying education to make sure students and children strictly abide by the rules. The emergency anti-epidemic field across the country has set higher demand for all citizens to observe anti-epidemic rules with full awareness. Rodong Sinmun

title: Coastal Structures in East Being Reinforced
body: Fishery units on the east coast are pushing forward with the project for reinforcing coastal structures to cope with potential typhoons and high waves. The South Hamgyong Provincial Fishery Management Bureau has made achievements in anti-tidal dyke and wharf projects. The Hongwon Fishery Station has reinforced the wharf with hundreds of square meters of concrete tamping with the use of effective construction method while the Tanchon Dockyard of the Sinpho Distant-Sea Fishery Complex is taking a measure to prevent damage with wire-netted rocks. The North Hamgyong Provincial Fishery Management Bureau is pushing for the preparations for reinforcing coastal structures. Fishery stations under the bureau are fulfilling the daily plan for the production of structural frames. Several units under the Kangwon Provincial Fishery Management Bureau are also pushing ahead with the project for repairing and reinforcing anti-tidal dyke and wharfs. Rodong Sinmun

title: Dozens of Units Well under Construction
body: Jagang Province actively steps up the construction of dozens of its units under a blueprinted plan to promote its development and improve the living standard of its people. It has aimed at renovating the underground structures of apartment buildings in Kanggye City according to the year because they must be built there without cease. It is now all out to hit the target. Besides, it does all it can to build the Hungju Youth Power Station 5 and spruce up Usi County and Manpho City. It has formulated an actual scientific plan to consolidate the foundations for the production of building materials this year which marks the beginning of another five-year plan. It is now doing its utmost to carry out the plan. The officials of the province carry out in real earnest the project for increasing the production capacity of the August 2 Manpho Cement Factory. Furthermore, they simultaneously push ahead with the construction of a tilery in Huichon City and the expansion of the production capacity of the Kanggye Steelworks. In addition, the province builds many medium- and small-sized power stations dynamically to produce on its own the electricity needed to develop its economy and make its people better off than ever. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Convenes Consultative Meeting of Senior Officials of WPK Central Committee and Provincial Party Committees
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the DPRK, convened a consultative meeting of senior officials of the Party Central Committee and provincial Party committees at the office building of the Party Central Committee on June 7. Present at the meeting were members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee, including Jo Yong Won and Kim Tok Hun, and secretaries and department directors of the Party Central Committee and chief secretaries of the provincial Party committees. The consultative meeting, on the threshold of the plenary meeting of the Party Central Committee, had an intensive check on the detailed situation of every field in regard to the implementation of main policies for the latter half of this year, and discussed the practical issues to cope with the situation. The respected General Secretary learnt about and examined the pending issues arising in guaranteeing the state economic work and people's living and assigned important tasks for it. Pointing out the direction of the work and study to be carried out by every department of the Party Central Committee, government organs and every provincial Party committee under the present situation, he unfolded a plan to bring about a tangible change in stabilizing the state economic work and people's living with the plenary meeting of the Party Central Committee as an occasion. Repeatedly underscoring the need for senior officials of the Party Central Committee, government and every provincial Party committee to make devoted efforts to fulfill their honorable duties of taking responsibility for the destiny of the country and the people, fully aware of their mission and duty, he gave important instructions on some measures to be taken for developing the economy of the country and improving the standards of people's material and cultural life. Political News Team

title: Preparation for Coping with Disastrous Climate underway in Agricultural Sector
body: The agricultural sector is taking foresighted measures to cope with disastrous climate. Officials of the Ministry of Agriculture push ahead with urgent farm work, upgrade network and improve the command system to update the agricultural units across the country on climatic conditions every week and month through close cooperation with relevant units. They dynamically propel clearing waterways and repairing irrigation structures after grasping conditions of irrigation system across the country in detail. Officials of agricultural guidance organizations in all provinces, cities and counties make full preparation for ensuring solidity of irrigation structures and regular operation of equipment after checking the overall state of work for dredging rivers and clearing out ditches in paddy and dry fields and the conditions of irrigation facilities. All the farms keep finding out the ways and taking measures for protecting crops from disastrous climatic conditions such as high temperature, drought, rainy wind and typhoon after making it a fait accompli that they would be affected this year, too. Rodong Sinmun

title: Corn Fields Are Solidly Weeded
body: Agricultural officials and workers and their helpers as well score successes in weeding corn fields throughout the country. Many cooperative farms finished weeding their corn fields twice qualitatively. They are now weeding them thrice with good success. North Phyongan Province weeds its corn fields in real earnest. The officials of the province mapped out a detailed plan to weed their corn fields to suit the features of their areas and cooperative farms. They adopt effective measures to concentrate all their efforts and means on weeding their corn fields. The officials and agricultural workers of Thaechon and Pakchon Counties work in the fields by the sweat of their brows. The officials and agricultural workers of other counties, too, weed their corn fields energetically with firm conviction. South Phyongan Province focuses its efforts on weeding its corn fields and registers successes in it. The province sees to it that its cities and counties draw up their weeding plans patently and detailedly arrange for their labor and means to be concentrated on weeding their corn fields and that their agricultural workers and their helpers attain great results in their weeding with great enthusiasm. The officials and workers of Hoechang County work hard in the fields in high spirits. Kaechon City uses its draft oxen a good deal to preferentially plow its fields. The greater successes Tokchon City achieves in weeding its corn fields, the harder it tries to weed them fast qualitatively. The other areas of the province concentrate their efforts on weeding their fields and thus carry out their daily assignments without fail on schedule. The cooperative farms of North Hwanghae Province register successes in their weeding. The officials of the province make good arrangements for weeding their fields on schedule and offer good technological guidance in it. North Hamgyong Province conducts intensive political work and widely generalizes the experiences of its advanced units while making sure that its fields are weeded promptly. Regarding it as important to weed their fields South Hamgyong Province, Nampho City and other regions, too, ensure that collective innovations are brought about in it. Determined not to fail to attain the cereal production goal set by the Party agricultural officials and workers across the country as well as their helpers continue to make advances in their work without a moment’s delay. As a result, successes are gained incessantly in weeding corn fields. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Premier Inspects Co-op Farms in South Hwanghae Province
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the DPRK, inspected different co-op farms in South Hwanghae Province. Officials and agricultural workers of the province are all out in rice-transplanting with a single determination to glorify the first year for implementing the new five-year plan with increased grain production, true to the important tasks set forth at the Eighth Party Congress. Inspecting different co-op farms in Anak, Sinchon, Jaeryong, Sinwon, Pyoksong, Samchon, Songhwa and other counties, the premier learned in detail about the present situation of farming, including the expected yield of first-crop wheat and barley, and progress made in rice-transplanting, while giving pep talks to agricultural workers and their helpers. Stressing the importance of this year's farming in implementing the decisions of the Party congress, he called for weeding every field qualitatively by concentrating labor and means on the work, by keeping the morale that has been boosted with the completion of rice-transplanting in the main paddy fields. He underscored the need to take measures in advance to prevent damage by disastrous climate like typhoon and flood and ensure the stability and sustained development of agricultural production. He also called for properly enforcing the field-responsibility-system within the framework of the subworkteam management system and thus making sure that farmers work responsibly with great eagerness to increase grain production. The field consultative meetings urged the leading agricultural officials of the province, cities and counties to conduct planning and guidance in a proper way, well aware that the province plays a big role in the state grain production. Measures were also taken there to apply scientific cultivation methods to all farming processes. Rodong Sinmun

title: Solid Measures Taken Beforehand
body: The agricultural workers of Pongsan County manure and tend their corns with great care so that they can grow well. The officials of the county adopt effective measures in advance to raise the healthy crops despite its unfavorable weather conditions. The county has planned to make primary efforts to nourish its crops and secure and use farming materials on its own. The cooperative farms of the county made endeavors to produce huminite and nutrient solutions with liquid manure and liquid fertilizer. The officials and workers of all the units of the county as well as dwellers in its neighborhood units procured raw materials for huminite and transported them all to their cooperative farms so as to help toward the production of the huminite. Consequently, the cooperative farms secured huminite and nutrient solutions according to their plans. They are now applying them to their fields sown with the crops. The cooperative farms of the county make active efforts to rid their corn fields of all weeds and prevent their crops from damage from wet fields. The officials of the farms personally arrange for their ditches to be dug deep and built qualitatively and see to it that their cowherds take good care of their draught oxen on their own responsibility. The crops become able to grow well in all the fields of the farms. The Chongyang Cooperative Farm makes sure that its farmers separately in charge of fields enhance their responsibility and role for them to produce substitute fertilizer on a priority basis and manure their fields effectively. The cooperative farm of the county’s township finished setting out rice seedlings in its paddies in the best season at a short time. It is now weeding and plowing its corn fields. It also apply advanced farming methods to them so that they can flourish. Rodong Sinmun

title: Preparations for Preventing Typhoon and Flood Damage Underway in Forestry Sector
body: The forestry sector steps up its preparations for preventing damage by disastrous climate. Workers of the Ryanggang Provincial Forestry Management Bureau thoroughly find out and eliminate the defects and dangerous things that may disturb timber transport. Those of the Yonam Mine Timber Production Station reinforced the ballast of forest railroads and supported them with new sleepers. Other stations engage in reinforcement of retaining walls, gutter-cleaning and readjustment of waterways to protect lumber transport routes from landslide. Those of the Jagang Provincial Forestry Management Bureau repair forest roads and bridges under a detailed plan. The Kangwon and South Hamgyong provincial forestry management bureaus have completed the reinforcement of several lumber yards in mountain forests to protect their lumber heaps, well aware that to prevent typhoon and flood damage is an important undertaking for protecting precious wealth of the country. They also pay primary attention to providing their lumbermen with better living conditions so that they would work in forest without any inconvenience despite unfavorable weather. Rodong Sinmun

title: Meeting of Chairpersons of Headquarters of Chongryon Held
body: There took place a meeting of chairpersons of the headquarters of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) at the Korean Hall in Tokyo on June 2 and 3. Attending the meeting were Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of Chongryon, Pak Ku Ho, first vice-chairman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee and concurrently director of its Organization Department, other vice-chairpersons and members of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, and chairpersons of the headquarters of Chongryon. Present there as observers were councilors and vice department directors of the Central Standing Committee of Chongryon. The meeting was convened to analyze and review the work of Chongryon after the 4th Meeting of its 24th Central Committee for thoroughly embodying the main idea and the main spirit of the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea and the main spirit of the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Party, and to correct the mistakes manifested in the work. Ho Jong Man made a report at the meeting. He stressed the need for Chongryon to glorify this year as the one of a great turn and vigorous struggle by keeping pace with the people in the homeland, who are speeding up their general advance toward new development and prosperity, true to the noble idea and intention of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. The reporter called for improving the overall work of Chongryon immediately. Then, chairpersons of the headquarters of Chongryon made speeches. Expressing their will to intensify the work for more thoroughly establishing the Juche-based ideological and leadership system within the organizations and build up the mass foundation of Koreans in Japan by turning the building of organizations of Chongryon into the one of prioritizing their branches, they said they would regard such work as their primary task and produce good results by conducting a bold and meticulous organizational work, true to the decision and instructions of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee. Ho Jong Man concluded the meeting. It is the main idea of the meeting that the hard-core leading officials of Chongryon should further intensify and speed up the movement of Koreans in Japan, true to the idea and leadership of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un. He called upon the Central Standing Committee and chairpersons of the headquarters of Chongryon to determinedly wage an all-out united struggle for making the movement of Koreans in Japan keep pace with the grand advance in the homeland by thoroughly implementing the respected General Secretary's idea of leadership over Chongryon. Rodong Sinmun

title: Enlarged Meeting of Asia-Pacific Regional Committee for Supporting Peaceful Reunification of Korea Held
body: An enlarged meeting of the Asia-Pacific Regional Committee for Supporting Peaceful Reunification of Korea took place through video conferencing. Peter Woods, co-chairman of the Committee and Asia-Pacific ambassador of the United Cities and Local Governments, made a report at the meeting. He recalled that the committee, as befitting its mission, has organized regional and international online seminars on the important occasions of the DPRK over the past five years to praise the immortal exploits of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. The committee has extended support and encouragement to the Korean people's struggle, denouncing the moves of the hostile forces infringing upon the Korean people's rights to existence and development, the reporter added. He stressed that the committee to be newly formed would give wide publicity to the actual situation of the DPRK on its websites and conduct brisk activities for promoting friendship with the Korean people and supporting their just cause in the future. The meeting laid down the rules of the Asia-Pacific Regional Committee for Supporting Peaceful Reunification of Korea and elected its leadership organ. Elected as co-chairpersons of the committee were Madav Kumar Nepal, former prime minister of the Nepalese government, Rachmawati Soekarnoputri, chairwoman of the Founding Committee of the Soekarno Foundation for Education of Indonesia, Dogu Ferincek, chairman of the Motherland Party of Turkey, Atul Kumar Anjan, secretary of the National Council of the Communist Party of India, Fumihiro Himori, chairman of the Japan Committee for Supporting the Independent and Peaceful Reunification of Korea, Rafael Mariano, president of the Philippines-Korea Solidarity and Friendship Society, and elected as co-chairman and executive director of the committee was Peter Woods, Asia-Pacific ambassador of the United Cities and Local Governments. A letter to Kim Jong Un was adopted at the meeting. Read out there was an appeal to organizations for friendship and solidarity with the Korean people across the world on the occasions of the 110th birth anniversary of Kim Il Sung and the 80th birth anniversary of Kim Jong Il. The appeal praised Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il as the peerlessly great men who lightened the road ahead of mankind for realizing independence with the bright rays of Juche, and wisely led the socialist construction in the DPRK and the cause of global independence with their extraordinary leadership and noble virtue. It expressed expectation and belief that the members of the organizing committee of the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu, organizations for friendship and solidarity with the Korean people across the world and other friends of the DPRK would fulfill their mission and role in greeting the year 2022 as an auspicious year of mankind. Rodong Sinmun

title: Many Tunneling and Mining Units in Coal Industry Sector Fulfill Their First Half-yearly Plans
body: One hundred and tens of tunneling and coal-cutting teams under the Ministry of Coal Industry have fulfilled their first half-yearly plan ahead of schedule. Coal miners across the country secured many reserve cutting faces by giving priority to tunneling, thus opening up bright prospects for increased production of coal this year. So the number of the teams which fulfilled their first half-yearly plans ahead of schedule is increasing. 20-odd tunneling teams of the Tokchon Area Coal-Mining Complex and the Pukchang Area Youth Coal-Mining Complex carried out their first half-yearly plans more than one month earlier than the scheduled. Dozens of tunneling units of the Sunchon Area Youth Coal-Mining Complex fulfilled their first half-yearly plans and 17 tunneling units of the Kaechon Area Coal-Mining Complex implemented their daily plans by over 110 percent on average. Scores of teams in other coal mines across the country successfully fulfilled their first half-yearly plan until the end of May. All the units in the field of coal industry steadily make redoubled efforts to carry out their national economic plans. Rodong Sinmun

title: Conference of DPRK Red Cross Society Held
body: A video conference of the Red Cross Society of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea took place on June 8 and 9. Present there were members of the Central Committee of the DPRK Red Cross Society and other officials of Pyongyang and provinces. There was a report on the work of the central committee from 2017 to 2020. The reporter recalled the achievements the society made by focusing its work on the construction of safer residential districts, according to the prospective goal specified in its strategic plan that expired in 2020. He noted that the society designated the areas most vulnerable to natural disasters as the targets of comprehensive development and attained its stage-by-stage goals in cooperation with local power organs. Much progress was witnessed in its work to tackle disasters, solidify its judicial foundations, promote its information activities and boost its capabilities for sustained development, he said, adding: The society has also strengthened its exchange and cooperation with the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies, the International Committee of the Red Cross and other Red Cross and Red Crescent organizations in different countries. The reporter called for safeguarding and glorifying the immortal achievements of the peerlessly great persons and further developing the RCS into a reliable auxiliary organization of the DPRK government. He called upon all the participants to make the spirit of devoted service for the people run through all Red Cross activities so as to fulfill their responsibility and role in the work for promoting the people's health and wellbeing and providing them with happier and more civilized living conditions. The conference adopted its until-2030 strategy, orientation of work of its each department and the modified rules and elected members of the new guidance organ. Rodong Sinmun

title: Ministries and National Institutions Intensify Support for Countryside
body: Ministries and national institutions of the DPRK continue their manpower and material support for the countryside. Officials of the Ministry of IT Industry who found themselves in different farms are sincerely working with farmers. The Ministry provided them with accessories and materials necessary for farm machines and repair of irrigation facilities. Several units including the National Pricing Commission and the Central Industrial Design Administration sent tractor accessories and bioactivity fertilizers to the relevant farms after learning in detail about their actual situations, thus helping them hasten rice-transplanting. Other ministries and national institutions sent a lot of materials necessary for current farming to the countryside and their officials involved in rice-transplanting carry out their daily task without fail while helping and leading one another forward. Material and moral assistance rendered by officials of the ministries and national institutions greatly encourage the agricultural workers. Rodong Sinmun

title: The Fields of Socialist Cooperative Farms Weeded with Great Patriotic Zeal
body: The whole country strives more mightily than ever to help its cooperative farms in their work. Meanwhile, they weed their fields with might and main. North Phyongan Province dynamically weeds its fields tapping out all its internal potentials. Kwaksan County takes the lead in weeding. Thaechon and Unjon Counties score great successes in weeding their fields. Yomju and Tongrim Counties and Jongju City are now weeding their paddies twice and their corn fields thrice. Suit is followed by many other counties one after another throughout the province. South Phyongan Province ceaselessly weeds its fields with all its might. Sukchon County gives patent daily work assignments to each of its farmers and their helpers and accurately assesses their work points so as to stimulate them to further competitive efforts. Tokchon City sees to it that its farmers stir themselves further to finish weeding their individual corn fields in charge three times at an early date as against last year. North Hwanghae Province registers good successes in its weeding. The province digs its ditches and plows its fields qualitatively to withstand a calamitous climate actively while weeding its fields with speed. South Hwanghae Province, a breadbasket on the West Sea of Korea, weeds its fields with great success. It ensures that agitprop activities are briskly conducted in its cooperative farms to spiritually encourage their members to fully exert themselves to weed their fields well and gain greater successes in it than usual. It also sees to it that a socialist emulation is carried on effectively among the subworkteams of its farms and farmers in charge of fields, that efficient small farming implements are made on their own and that a large area of its fields are weeded within unit time. Kangwon, North Hamgyong and South Hamgyong Provinces, Nampho City and other regions, too, weed a great area of their fields day after day. Rodong Sinmun

title: Kim Tok Hun Inspects Construction Sites of 10 000 Flats in Pyongyang City
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the DPRK, inspected the construction sites of 10 000 flats in Pyongyang City. Looking round the construction sites where a grandiose city construction plan of the Party is being realized, he gave pep talks to the builders who are creating another Pyongyang speed and performing miracles in construction through the all-out charge of loyalty and fierce day and night campaign to build ideal streets for the people, true to the decisions of the 8th Congress of the Party and the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee. He underlined the need for officials to provide more meticulous operation and command of the projects amid the elated enthusiasm of the masses. He also urged all units to carry out their step-wise plans without fail, increase the operation rate of construction equipment to the maximum and thoroughly ensure the quality of construction. The field consultative meeting underlined the need for the metallurgical industry to increase the production of iron and steel needed for the construction, urging other relevant sectors to give top priority to supply of materials and equipment. Meanwhile, the premier visited the Pyongyang Condiments Factory, where he called for increasing production and took measures to ensure full supply of raw materials. Rodong Sinmun

title: Equipment and Materials Are Supplied Timely to the Construction Site
body: The workers and management of the Sangwon and Sunchon Cement Complexes continue to accelerate their production to contribute actively to building many units. The Sunghori Cement Factory concentrates its efforts on turning out the cement needed to build 10,000 apartments in Pyongyang. Those of the Chollima Steel Complex boost the production of their steel manufactures taking good technological care of their machinery. In the field of the lumber industry labor and management try their hardest to produce as much lumber as possible in mountains and help toward building many units. The officials of the Ministry of Forestry and the provincial forestry management bureau went down to their forestry stations and mine lumber production stations, examined in detail how they carried out their assignments to produce lumber for 10,000 apartments under construction in Pyongyang. Consequently, the workers of the stations register good successes in their lumber production in high spirits actively applying rational methods to their work. Believing that they join together to build apartment blocks for 10,000 families in Pyongyang the workers and management of the Anju Pump Factory and the Pyongyang Bus Factory go all out to satisfactorily produce their assigned pumps although they are short of many things and in great difficulties.
