Besides, they continue to take one effective step after another to supply electricity to drainers uninterruptedly and put them in normal operation. Rodong Sinmun

title: Third-stage Project for Sprucing up Samjiyon City Proceeds in DPRK
body: Successes are witnessed one after another in the third-stage project for sprucing up Samjiyon City. Officials and builders, who finished the frame construction of hundreds of dwelling houses and production buildings and their exterior plastering in the first half of this year, promote the interior plastering and roof-tiling, true to the important tasks set forth at the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea and plenary meetings of the Party Central Committee. They produced a large amount of building materials by themselves through a movement of collecting idle materials. They also saved a large quantity of building materials by recycling waste materials and increased the production of building materials with locally available raw materials. Putting every work process on a mechanized and specialized basis and introducing advanced construction methods, they bring about collective innovations to complete the project ahead of schedule. Rodong Sinmun

title: Economic Organization Brisk in Machine Industry in DPRK
body: Units in the machine industrial sector scrupulously organize the economic work for accelerating the implementation of the first-year tasks of the five-year plan, true to the decisions made at the 3rd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. On the basis of analyzing and reviewing successes, experience and deviations revealed in the first half of the year officials of the Ministry of Machine-building Industry and relevant units have consulted substantial measures and assigned tasks for fulfilling the second half-yearly plan unconditionally, thoroughly and accurately. They encourage the masses to display the sense of responsibility, creativity and activeness in carrying out the national economic plan by directing efforts to the work of arming them with the idea and spirit of the plenary meetings of the Party Central Committee. They have seriously discussed ways for attaining the militant goal for this year without fail and taken practical measures as required by the reality. Now work is underway to readjust and reinforce production processes as clarified in the plan for the second half of this year according to the Party's economic strategy. Practical measures are being taken to produce more tractors and trucks of good efficiency through powerful mass technical innovation movement and stronger collaboration with relevant units. Also pushed ahead with is the production of goods to be sent to different sectors of the national economy and equipment to be sent to the construction site of 10 000 flats in Pyongyang City. Several units are solidifying the foundation for revitalizing production while further consolidating successes and experience gained in locally producing equipment, raw and other materials and recycling. Rodong Sinmun

title: Kim Tok Hun Inspects Various Units
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected several units concerning the national economy. He acquainted himself in detail with the work of the Ministry of Agriculture and the State Hydro-meteorological Administration for coping with disastrous and abnormal weather, which is an important link in the chain efforts for attaining the goal of grain production for this year, the first year for implementing the five-year plan. And he had a consultative meeting at the Ministry of Agriculture. The meeting stressed once again the importance of the agricultural work now prioritized by the Party and the state as the most important work. Officials of agricultural guidance organs were urged to scrupulously organize the farming operation and command with the maximum awareness and redoubled efforts and display strong executive power. The meeting also detailed the work for working out and issuing the instructions of the Cabinet on taking proactive sci-tech steps for minimizing the damage by disastrous and abnormal weather and on taking strong measures for promoting the growth of the crops and preventing damage by moisture, blight and insects and flood. Inspecting the State Hydro-meteorological Administration, the premier called for ensuring scientific accuracy, correctness and speed in the weather forecast. He urged the agricultural sector and the meteorological observation sector to cooperate in working out foresightedly a plan for preventing the natural damage, and stressed the need for other sectors to fully support it. He visited the food administration station in Rangnang District and other food administration units here so as to learn about the progress made in the efforts for implementing the special measure taken by the Party Central Committee to stabilize the people's livelihood. He underlined the need for the officials to enhance their role with the greater sense of responsibility in order to scrupulously organize the work for implementing the Party policy for loving the people. Earlier, he chaired a consultative meeting at the Ministry of Metallurgical Industry. At the meeting he called on officials to redouble their efforts to unconditionally carry out the tasks facing their sector and the iron and steel production goal for this year they pledged before the Party, true to the idea and spirit of the 3rd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Party. He also took steps for resolving the practical issues arising in doing so. Rodong Sinmun

title: Performance by Band of State Affairs Commission Goes On
body: The performance by the Band of the State Affairs Commission including hymns of the times showing the people's sincerity for the great mother Party is impressing more and more people with its great ideological and artistic value. The venue Samjiyon Theatre is full of citizens eager to watch the truthful and attractive performance adding vigor and vitality to our advance for the new victory of the revolution. Put on the stage were the hymns to the Workers' Party of Korea loved by all people, songs representing the fighting spirit and traits displayed by the preceding generations of the revolution, dynamic songs of the Korean People's Army reflecting the fighting spirit of the a-match-for-a-hundred revolutionary armed forces and famous songs of the era hardening the indomitable faith to carry on the revolution to the end. Songs sung by performers and the audience together from the bottom of their hearts resounded through the hall. They recalled with emotion the devotion to the people made by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, who is regarding it as the greatest honor to be called mother Party by the great people and readily goes through hardships if they are for the people. The performance was highly acclaimed by the audience as it wonderfully showed the development of Juche-oriented musical art that has ushered in the new era of efflorescence under the care of the Party Central Committee. The audience said that the performance showed well the greatness of the Party and its undying exploits with attractive and dynamic melodies, adding that it is the masterpiece which touched the heartstrings of all people with the most beautiful song about mother in the world that will remain true no matter how much water may flow under the bridge. The performance full of the idea and spirit of the historic 8th Congress of the Party and the plenary meetings of the Party Central Committee powerfully encourages the people who have turned out in the general advance for ushering in a new period of a great upsurge and turn in socialist construction in hearty response to the call of the Party Central Committee. Rodong Sinmun

title: A Street among Trees and Flowering Shrubs
body: Completed four years ago Ryomyong Street boasts modern apartment blocks and other buildings, plus lots of greens and parks. They blend well with each other to testify to our excellent Juche-oriented architecture and socialist civilization. The greens and most sections of the parks are blanketed with lawn grass studded with trees and flowering shrubs of good species. The apartment blocks and other buildings benefit from natural energy like solar beam and geotherm effectively. Greening technology has been applied to their roofs and the surface of their walls. The street is an energy-saving green street. It naturally follows that the air is always crisp in the street. It owes this to our national policy of giving importance to environmental protection. Rodong Sinmun

title: Officials, Members of Women's Union Mark Anniversary of Demise of President Kim Il Sung
body: Officials and members of the women's union met at the Hall of Women on Tuesday to mark the 27th anniversary of the demise of President Kim Il Sung. Present there were Ri Tu Song, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Kim Jong Sun, chairwoman of the Central Committee of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea, Hong Chol Jin, secretary of the Pyongyang City Committee of the WPK, and officials of the women's union and its members in Pyongyang City. The speakers praised the noble personality and virtue of the President. They called upon the officials and members of the union to add eternal luster to the immortal feats of the President on behalf of the country and the revolution, the times and the people and uphold the idea and leadership of the Party Central Committee with loyalty. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Baskets to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Floral Baskets were sent to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill from Co-Chairman Johnny Hon, Honorary Vice-Chairman Sai Tiejen, Director Jin Xian and Honorary Directors Cui Tongwen, Qiu Jianliang and Qiu Shuibo of the Board of Directors of the Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation, the family of Li Zade, a Korean anti-Japanese revolutionary fighter in China, the families of Ryang Song Ryong and Pak Kil Song, Korean anti-Japanese revolutionary martyrs in China, the family of Kim Sun Ok who is related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle and the families of Feng Zhongyun, Chai Shiying, Chen Lei, Hu Zhenyi, Fan Delin and Jiang Zihua, Chinese related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, ahead of the 27th anniversary of the demise of the President. The floral baskets were laid before the statues on July 6. On the same day, floral baskets sent by members of the foundation Zhan Xueyan, Cui Yan, Li Ailan, Jin Chengwu, Zhao Bin, Tang Yiming, Li Hu and Nan Yonghe were laid before the statues. Floral baskets in the names of missions of international organizations here were also laid before the statues. Rodong Sinmun

title: Dam for Sepho Army-people Power Station Enters the Last Stage
body: True to the decisions of the 3rd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea the officials and working people of Kangwon Province are all out to carry out their work assignments this year without fail. They build the dam for the Sepho Army-People Power Station (SAPPS) at the last stage. Many army-people power stations are now under construction in the province. But it concentrates all its efforts and means to building the SAPPS and sees to it that its construction progresses by finish-one-by-one method on the whole. Under arrangement made by the province officials go among the builders of the power stations and actively encourage them to enthusiastically accelerate their general march forward toward new victories in the revolution and demonstrate their mettle like labor innovators once again. The officials of a brigade for the building of a dam ensured that many machines were used to dam up the river and that rational working methods were actively contrived and applied to be in keeping with actual working conditions which changed from time to time. Unprecedented successes are registered in building the dam while great frontline agitprop activities are carried on. Enlisting the active help of their heavy machines and motortrucks the workers work strenuously day and night with strong conviction and optimism in the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance despite their difficulties the way their former generation brought about a great change in their production and construction in the era of Chollima. Other workers responsibly coat the banks of the river with large stones firmly resolved to hold liability for their work for a thousand years and guarantee it for ten thousand years. The officials and working people of Sepho County as well as the members of its women’s union work faithfully by the sweat of their brows on the spot to build the dam. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Visits Kumsusan Palace of Sun on Greatest National Memorial Day
body: All the people across the country are looking up to the supreme temple of Juche with boundless yearnings and in deep reverence for President Kim Il Sung on the occasion of the greatest memorial day of the nation. Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun at 0:00 on Thursday. Present there were members of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and the Party central leadership organ. The palace where President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, founder and builders of our great Party and our powerful state, fathers of the nation and the great sages of revolution, lie in state was wrapped in solemn atmosphere. A floral basket from the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un was placed at the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il. Placed were floral baskets in the names of the WPK Central Committee, the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK and the Cabinet of the DPRK. The respected General Secretary paid deep respects for Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il before their statues together with the participants. At the halls where Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il lie in state the General Secretary made a bow of best wishes to the President and the Chairman who performed undying feats before the country, the people, the times and the revolution with their profound ideas and theories, extraordinary leadership ability and sweeping revolutionary practices. The members of the Party central leadership organ made their firm pledge to fulfill their responsibility and duty as backbone of the Party and leading members of revolution in the present gigantic struggle for the progress and development of our style socialism, remaining faithful to the ideology and leadership of the respected General Secretary. Political News Team

title: Workers and Members of GFTUK Meet to Praise Virtues of President Kim Il Sung
body: A presentation on the virtues of President Kim Il Sung was held by workers and members of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea (GFTUK) at the Central Hall of Workers on Wednesday on the occasion of the 27th anniversary of the demise of the President. Present there were Ri Tu Song, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Pak In Chol, chairman of the GFTUK Central Committee, trade union officials, workers and trade union members in Pyongyang City. The speakers said that with a far-reaching plan for building a thriving country, the President undertook the unprecedented nation-building and arduous post-war reconstruction together with the people, leading them to victory. They praised the noble personality and virtue of the peerlessly great man who paid deep attention so that workers could work in clean and cultured workplaces, and took care of them with paternal affection. They expressed their will to thoroughly implement the last instructions of the President without an inch of deflection under the leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un and to attain without fail the goals for this year, the first year of the five-year plan, in the spirit displayed by the working class in the post-war rehabilitation period and the Chollima age. Rodong Sinmun

title: Agricultural Workers' Meeting Commemorates Demise Anniversary of President Kim Il Sung
body: Agricultural workers and members of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea (UAWK) held a meeting in memory of President Kim Il Sung at the Chongsan Co-op Farm in Kangso District, Nampho City on Wednesday, a day before the 27th anniversary of his demise. Speakers at the meeting told about the President's noble virtues. Attending the meeting were Ri Tu Song, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Han Jong Hyok, chairman of the Central Committee of the UAWK, officials concerned, officials of the union and agricultural workers in Kangso District. The floor was taken by Ho Tok Bok, former chairwoman of the Pyongyang City Committee of the UAWK, Ri Yong Ju, management board chairman of the Rihyon Vegetable Cooperative Farm in Sadong District, and Yun Chun Hwa. chairwoman of the Chongsan Co-op Farm in Kangso District. They told in excited tones about the noble career of Kim Il Sung characterized by his ceaseless journey to the countryside for agricultural development of the country and happy and wealthy life of agricultural workers. They expressed their determination to add luster to the immortal revolutionary career and exploits of the President and bring about a bumper harvest in every field by waging an intensive campaign for scientific farming and rich harvest, emulating the working spirit of the patriotic farmers of the preceding generations. The meeting ended with reciting of poem "My field is near a road to Pyongyang". Rodong Sinmun

title: Concrete Tamping of Sinhong Dam of Tanchon Power Station No. 5 Finished
body: Soldier-builders successfully finished the concrete tamping of the Sinhong dam of Tanchon Power Station No. 5, true to the Party's intention of completing the power station as early as possible. As the dam was constructed up the Namchon River, it has become possible to push forward with the overall construction of the Tanchon Power Station by ensuring the earlier inauguration of Tanchon Power Station No. 5 and to increase the electricity production at Hochongang power stations nos. 2, 3 and 4. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Baskets to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il from Foreign Organizations and Personages
body: Floral Baskets were sent to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill from the Beijing Chao Ya International Cultural Exchange Center in China, the Beijing international cultural development center for China-DPRK friendship, the Switzerland-Korea Committee, the family of Zhang Weihua, a Chinese anti-Japanese revolutionary martyr, and Fernando Sanchez, chairman of the Colombia-Korea Friendship Association, ahead of the 27th anniversary of the demise of the President. The floral baskets were laid before the statues on July 7. Rodong Sinmun

title: Every Arrangement Made to Prevent Flood and Typhoon Damages
body: Many sectors and units of the national economy continue to adopt thorough measures to prevent flood and typhoon damage in the rainy season. The Ministry of Metallurgical Industry concludes that it bears directly on the execution of its national economic plan for the second half of 2021 to ward off damages from possible floods and typhoons and ensures that all its factories take drastic precautions against them. In the field of the chemical industry officials and workers go all out to avert natural disasters in advance. Those employed in the domain of the electric power industry keep vigilance over possible floods and typhoons and make incessant efforts to prevent damages from them beforehand. Electric power stations countrywide qualitatively check and maintain their electric generators, transformers, breakers and other machines. In the realms of the extractive and machine-building industries workers and management take double and treble steps to protect their machinery, materials and buildings against natural disasters. They also find all possible victims of them and take precautions to keep them safe. Precautions are taken against possible flood and typhoon damages which may be caused to major buildings under construction and building materials and machines in the rainy season. Meanwhile, building operations are well under way. The sector of posts and telecommunications is engrossed in sheltering its communication lines and equipment against a flood and a typhoon if any. Fishing stations get detailed knowledge of all their fishing vessels and coastal structures and take thorough necessary steps for them. Many spheres and units of the national economy are continuously all out to keep themselves fully ready to meet any sudden emergency which may result from a flood and a typhoon and avert damages from them if any. Rodong Sinmun

title: Reception Given by DPRK State Affairs Commission
body: The State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) hosted a reception on Friday on the occasion of the 60th anniversary of the conclusion of the DPRK-China Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance. Present there were Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, Kim Song Nam, director of the International Department of the Central Committee of the WPK, Mun Song Hyok, vice department director of the Central Committee of the WPK, Army Lieutenant General Kim Chol Gun, vice-minister of National Defence, Pak Myong Ho, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, and other officials concerned. Present there on invitation were Li Jinjun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK, and his embassy members. Before the reception Choe Ryong Hae had a talk with the ambassador. Choe Ryong Hae courteously conveyed warm greeting from Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the WPK, president of the State Affairs of the DPRK and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, to Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC), president of the People's Republic of China (PRC) and chairman of the Central Military Commission of the PRC. He also courteously conveyed congratulations of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un to Ambassador Li Jinjun and his embassy members. Li Jinjun expressed deep gratitude for warm greeting from General Secretary Kim Jong Un to General Secretary Xi Jinping on the occasion of the 60th anniversary of the conclusion of the China-DPRK Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance. He also asked Choe Ryong Hae to convey sincere greeting from the members of his embassy to Kim Jong Un. Choe Ryong Hae said that after the conclusion of the treaty the peoples of the two countries have sincerely supported and helped each other, sharing their fate together as genuine revolutionary comrades-in-arms, close brothers and sisters and reliable allies on the road for independence against imperialism and for socialism. The significance of the treaty has not been played down even a bit despite the passage of 60 years and its strategic importance is getting further pronounced under the present international situation, he said. He stressed that the bilateral friendship with socialism, common ideal of the peoples of the two countries, at its core has been expanded and developed in an all-round way to meet the needs of the new times under the direct care of the top leaders of the two parties and the two countries. Saying that the special close relations between General Secretary Kim Jong Un and General Secretary Xi Jinping are a groundwork propping up the friendly relations between the two parties and the two countries and a motive force powerfully propelling their further development, he expressed the will to make joint efforts with the Chinese comrades to strengthen and develop the DPRK-China relations in all fields including politics, economy and military. We fully support the stand of the Chinese party and government and will always stand with the Chinese friends on the road of advancing the socialist cause in the future, too, he stressed. Li Jinjun said that Premier Zhou Enlai and President Kim Il Sung signed the China-DPRK Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance in Beijing 60 years ago, adding that the treaty has been endowed with meaning in the times through the five meetings between the top leaders of the two parties in the new era. He referred to the fact that the two parties and the two countries have advanced the socialist cause and propelled the friendly relations on to a new high stage while supporting and cooperating with each other over the past six decades since the conclusion of the treaty. He said that the common stand recently taken by the two countries on the international arena shows once again the real significance of the treaty, extending thanks to the DPRK for its firm support. There were toasts at the reception. Kim Song Nam said that President Kim Il Sung and Premier Zhou Enlai signed the treaty, leaving posterity a noble legacy. He continued that today the friendly relations between the DPRK and China have entered the new golden age of their development under the direct care of General Secretary of the WPK Kim Jong Un and General Secretary of the C.C., CPC Xi Jinping. He added that the Korean people are sincerely rejoiced over the grand celebration of the 100th anniversary of the founding of the CPC and over the world-startling achievements made by the Chinese people in their new course of building a modern socialist state under the leadership of General Secretary Xi Jinping, expressing belief that the cause of the CPC and the Chinese people to realize the great prosperity of the Chinese nation would surely come true. Li Jinjun said that the conclusion of the treaty was a strategic decision made by the leaders of the elder generation of the two countries, looking far into the future, and it marked a historic event for the two countries, adding that based on the treaty the two parties and the two countries have supported and cooperated with each other, powerfully propelled socialism and contributed to regional peace and security. Since 2018 Xi Jinping and Kim Jong Un have had close communications and propelled China-DPRK friendship, a common treasure, personally provided and cultivated with much care by the leaders of the elder generations, to a new strategic stage, he said. The congratulatory message sent by Kim Jong Un to Xi Jinping on the occasion of the 100th founding anniversary of the CPC demonstrated once again the invincibility of friendship between the two parties and close personal relations between them, he noted, adding that they are pleased over the new successes made by the Korean people in socialist construction by putting all efforts into implementing the spirit of the 8th Congress of the WPK under the energetic leadership of the WPK led by General Secretary Kim Jong Un. He said that invariable is the stand of the Chinese Party and government toward the Party and government of the DPRK no matter how the regional situation may change, and expressed the willingness to steadily develop the China-DPRK relations and contribute to the welfare of the peoples of the two countries and regional peace and security by maintaining the original purpose in the spirit of the treaty and true to the common understanding made by the top leaders of two parties and the two countries. The participants at the reception toasted to the eternal strengthening and development of the DPRK-China friendship. An amicable atmosphere prevailed throughout the reception. Rodong Sinmun

title: Homage Paid to President Kim Il Sung across DPRK
body: All the people throughout the DPRK looked back upon the memory of President Kim Il Sung in the greatest reverence on the occasion of the 27th anniversary of his demise, the greatest national memorial day. On the occasion, people, service personnel, youth and schoolchildren visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the sacred temple of Juche, where President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il lie in state, and paid noble tribute to them. Working people, officers and men of the Korean People's Army, youth and schoolchildren placed floral baskets, bouquets and flowers of best wishes before the statues of the President and the Chairman on Mansu Hill and their statues and the mosaics of their smiling images in different parts of the country. All the officials, Party members, working people, service personnel, young people and students watched documentaries on the noble personality of the President as a great man and his lofty traits at their worksites, posts and houses. Seeing documentaries "Finding Himself among the People All His Life" and "Our Leader Praised by All People", the people deeply grasped the greatness of the President, the eternal sun of Juche. That day the people in all the industrial establishments, farm villages and great construction sites pledged to hold the President in high esteem forever and build the people's paradise on this land without fail by translating his desire to build a thriving country into reality. All the people hardened their will to add eternal lustre to the idea and cause of the President and hasten a new victory in the revolution by implementing the decisions of the 8th Party Congress without fail under the leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Tributes Paid to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Working people, service personnel, youth and students paid the highest tribute to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in different parts of the country. Laid before the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill were floral baskets in the names of the Party, power and armed forces organs, social organizations, ministries, national institutions, units of the Korean People's Army (KPA) and the Public Security Forces (PSF) and institutions, enterprises and industrial establishments, universities and schools at all levels in Pyongyang. The chief and members of the Pyongyang mission of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front laid a bouquet before the statues. The visitors made a bow before the statues. Floral baskets in the names of institutions, enterprises and units of the KPA and the PSF were laid at the statues of the peerlessly great men and mosaics picturing their smiling images in different parts of the capital city including Kim Il Sung University, the Ministry of National Defence and the Mansudae Art Studio and bunches of flowers were also laid before the statues. Working people, servicepersons, youth and students across the country visited the statues and mosaics picturing the smiling images of the great leaders in their residential quarters to pay homage to them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Tribute to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il by Members of Vietnamese and Lao Embassies
body: The Vietnamese and Lao ambassadors to the DPRK and staff members of their embassies visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on Thursday, the 27th anniversary of the demise of the President. They made a bow after laying floral baskets and bouquets before the statues of the great leaders. Rodong Sinmun

title: Premier Kim Tok Hun Inspects Different Farms
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the DPRK Cabinet, inspected different farms. Inspecting several units including farms in Pongchon, Paechon, Yonan and Chongdan counties of South Hwanghae Province, the premier encouraged the agricultural workers striving to increase grain production despite unfavorable weather, true to the ideas and spirits of the Party congress and plenary meetings. He urged agricultural officials to take scientific and realistic measures on the basis of last year's experience and lessons, well aware of why the Party regards it as a key issue in attaining this year's grain production goal to tackle unfavorable weather. He also underscored the need to increase the production of organic compound fertilizers and other nutrients with locally available raw materials so as to constantly increase the crop yield while gradually reducing the consumption of chemical fertilizers and insecticide. At several farms in Sunchon City and Mundok County of South Phyongan Province, he pointed out the failure of the work for putting manuring and water control on a scientific basis in those farms, stressing once again that it is the best way of ensuring the high, stable yield to thoroughly implement the Party's policy of scientific farming. He also heard the opinions of officials of the farms about some practical measures to be taken by the Cabinet to improve the methods of economic management, as required by the developing reality. Meanwhile, he visited the units in charge of food administration in the above-mentioned provinces and nurseries and kindergartens in Mundok County to learn about how they are implementing the important measures taken by the Party. He appealed to the officials to do their jobs in a more responsible manner, true to the noble outlooks of the Party Central Committee on the people and younger generation. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from President Xi Jinping
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, received a message of greeting from Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC), president of the People's Republic of China (PRC) and chairman of the Central Military Commission of the PRC, on July 11. In the message General Secretary Xi Jinping, on behalf of the CPC, the government and the people of China and on his own behalf, extended warm congratulations and heartfelt best wishes to General Secretary Kim Jong Un and, through him, to the WPK and the government and the people of the DPRK on the occasion of the 60th anniversary of the conclusion of the China-DPRK Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance. The message recalled that in 1961 the leaders of the elder generation of the two countries made a far-sighted strategic decision to conclude the treaty, thus laying important political and legal foundations for consolidating the militant friendship forged by the peoples of the two countries at the cost of the blood and for promoting the long-term friendship and cooperation between the two countries. The message said that fully supporting each other and struggling hand in hand and shoulder to shoulder in the spirit of the treaty for the past 60 years, the two sides have strengthened the fraternal traditional friendship between the two parties and between the two countries, propelling the development of the socialist cause and preserving the peace and stability in the region and the rest of the world. General Secretary Xi Jinping said in the message that he, through several meetings with General Secretary Kim Jong Un in recent years, mapped out the prospects of the development of the relations between the two parties and between the two countries and reached a common understanding of various important issues for enriching the contents of the era of the China-DPRK friendship. Noting that the world undergoes a great and rapid change unprecedented in 100 years, General Secretary Xi Jinping stressed in the message that he is willing to provide greater happiness to the two countries and the two peoples by strengthening the strategic communication with General Secretary Kim Jong Un to properly control the direction of the advance of the China-DPRK relations and by steadily leading the relations of friendship and cooperation between the two countries to a new stage. Saying that the 100th founding anniversary of the CPC was grandly celebrated recently in China, General Secretary Xi Jinping once again expressed his thanks to General Secretary Kim Jong Un for sending a message of warm congratulations to him. Noting that the DPRK people are concentrating all their efforts on the implementation of the decisions of the 8th Congress of the WPK, uniting in one mind, the message expressed full support to the DPRK in its efforts for developing the economy, improving the people's standard of living and dynamically carrying out the cause of building socialism. The message expressed the belief that the WPK and the DPRK people would make new greater achievements without fail under the leadership of General Secretary Kim Jong Un. It wished the DPRK prosperity and its people happiness and wellbeing. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Greetings to President Xi Jinping
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, sent a message of greeting to Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC), president of the People's Republic of China (PRC) and chairman of the Central Military Commission of the PRC, on Sunday. In the message the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un extended warm congratulations on behalf of the WPK and the government and people of the DPRK and on his own behalf to General Secretary Xi Jinping and, through him, to the Central Committee of the CPC, the government and people of the PRC on the occasion of the 60th anniversary of the conclusion of the DPRK-China Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance. The message said that the conclusion of the treaty was a historic event which demonstrated to the whole world the firm will of the two parties and the governments and peoples of the two countries to ensure the long-term development of the DPRK-China friendship, which was forged at the cost of blood on the road of independence against imperialism and of socialism on the basis of the solid legal foundations. Over the past six decades, the DPRK and China have written a proud history of friendship while invariably supporting and cooperating with each other morally and materially in the struggle for accomplishing their joint cause, sharing sweets and bitters in all tempests of history, it added. It said despite the unprecedentedly complicated international situation in recent years the comradely trust and militant friendship between the DPRK and China get stronger day by day and the traditional DPRK-China friendship has, gaining momentum, comprehensively developed onto a higher stage in all fields including politics, economy, military and culture. The DPRK-China Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance is displaying its stronger vitality in defending and propelling the socialist cause of the two countries and ensuring peace and stability in Asia and the rest of the world now that the hostile forces become more desperate in their challenge and obstructive moves, it noted. It pointed out that it is the fixed stand of the WPK and the DPRK government to ceaselessly develop the friendly and cooperative relations between the DPRK and China as required by the new times and as desired by the peoples of the two countries. It stressed that the Party, government and people of the DPRK would set great store by the DPRK-China friendship, the valuable common wealth of the two countries, and would firmly join hands with the CPC and the government and people of China in the sacred struggle for building socialism and communism in the future, too. Expressing great pleasure over the fact that the Party, the government and the people of China have made remarkable successes in socialist construction with the Chinese characteristics under the guidance of the respected General Secretary Xi Jinping and grandly celebrated the 100th founding anniversary of the CPC, it hoped that the Chinese Party and people would continue to make big progress in comprehensively building a modern socialist state and achieving the prosperity of the Chinese nation. The message sincerely wished General Secretary Xi Jinping good health and bigger success in his responsible work for the prosperity of the country and the people's happiness. Rodong Sinmun

title: Demise Anniversary of President Kim Il Sung Observed by Foreign Media
body: Foreign media dedicated special write-ups illustrated with photos of President Kim Il Sung to the 27th anniversary of his demise. The Lao newspaper Pathet Lao in an article titled "The great leader Comrade Kim Il Sung" said that Kim Il Sung regarded it as his lifelong motto to believe in the people as in Heaven. The socialism centred on the popular masses could take its deep roots on the land of the DPRK, thanks to the noble benevolent politics of the peerlessly great man, the article noted, praising the President as a veteran statesman in the world who pioneered the era of independence and made a great contribution to the development of the socialist movement and non-aligned movement. Similar articles were carried by the Lao newspaper Vientiane Mai and the internet homepage of the Lao news agency. The Cambodian newspaper Pracheachon carried the following article titled "The most precious heritage of President Kim Il Sung": The Juche idea, the guiding idea of socialist Korea and the cause of global independence, is the most precious heritage bequeathed by President Kim Il Sung to the Korean people and progressive mankind. The Juche idea will shine forever with the victorious advance of the cause of human independence. The Bangladeshi newspaper The Daily Folk recalled that the DPRK rendered the selfless assistance to many countries which started building a new society after achieving independence in the past. It said the DPRK's assistance to other countries was too much in the light of its economic potentiality, human and material resources but the President regarded it as his due obligation. As he was a man with such genuine international obligation, he gave unsparing aids to lots of countries and nations aspiring to independence and justice, it added. The website of the Mexican Institute for the Study of the Juche Idea, and the Public Lens, the organ of the Uganda National Resistance Movement, also carried articles dealing with the personality of the President as a great man who took care of all people with his warm humanity. Rodong Sinmun

title: Second-phase Socialist Emulation Drive in Construction of 10 000 Flats in Pyongyang Reviewed
body: A meeting was held to review the second-phase socialist emulation drive in the construction sites of 10 000 flats in Pyongyang, where the militant tasks set forth at the 8th Congress of the Party and the plenary meetings of the Party Central Committee are being carried out unconditionally, thoroughly and correctly. During the socialist emulation drive, all construction units successfully carried out their tasks for building flats and dynamically pushed ahead with the construction of public and service buildings. So the ideal streets for the people begin to make their grand and peculiar appearances. Soldier-builders distinguished themselves in pushing forward with the project by giving full play to the might of the revolutionary army of the Party with a single mind to live up to the trust of their respected Supreme Commander with devoted practice. They made achievements in structural construction of skyscrapers with the fighting and creation spirit peculiar to the People's Army and speeded up the construction by drastically reducing the mixture-transporting time after updating their building equipment as required by the actual conditions. Other construction units fulfilled their plans ahead of schedule while strengthening the ranks of skilled workers and raising the level of specialization in every process. They ensured the speed and quality of the construction while positively introducing efficient working methods. The spirit of collectivism and economization was fully displayed in the construction units during the emulation drive. The meeting called upon officials and commanding officers to fully meet the requirements of the design and construction standard and thoroughly ensure the quality of structures. All the soldier- and civilian-builders are full of enthusiasm to steadily create the new Pyongyang speed and myth of construction in the next emulation drive, too, on the basis of the past successes and experience. Rodong Sinmun

title: Tens of Millions of Fry Released
body: Fish farms across the country, where a dynamic campaign for implementing the decisions made at the 8th Congress of the Party and the plenary meetings of the Party Central Committee is underway, have released tens of millions of fry into rivers and lakes this year. South Phyongan Province put efforts into strengthening the material and technical foundations for fish farming to over-fulfill the first half-yearly plan for releasing fry by 115 percent. The Sunchon City Breed Fish Farm and other units newly built or repaired necessary facilities to provide conditions favorable to breeding and released many fry of carp, goldfish and Ryongjong fish into rivers and reservoirs. Fish farms in South Hwanghae Province feed fishes on different kinds of feed suiting their biological features and positively apply profitable fish farming methods so as to breed more fry than the planned. Fish farms in North Phyongan Province and South Hamgyong Province make innovations in breeding fish on the basis of the successes and experience they gained in the first half of the year. Rodong Sinmun

title: Birthday Spread Sent to Centenarian
body: Under the care of our Party that makes selfless, devoted efforts for the good of the people after setting the people-first principle as its political ideology, the number of centenarians is increasing in the DPRK. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un sent a birthday spread to Ri Kwi Nam living in the township of Kilju County, North Hamgyong Province on her 100th birthday. She, born into a poor peasant family, keenly experienced how miserable a stateless nation's destiny is, being subject to all sorts of humiliation and contempt before the liberation of the country. She was able to lead a genuine life as a master of the country after President Kim Il Sung liberated the country. She has devoted her pure conscience and sincerity to society and the collective for decades and brought up all her sons and daughters to be pillars of the country. She requests her family members and relatives to do more good work for our social system, saying that our country where everyone helps each other is the best one in the world. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Basket to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il from Italian Figure
body: A floral basket was sent to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill from Giancarlo Elia Valori, president of the International Group of Italy, on the occasion of the 27th anniversary of the demise of President Kim Il Sung. The floral basket was laid before the statues on July 9. Rodong Sinmun

title: State Commendations Conferred on Creators, Artistes of Major Art Troupes
body: The title of honor and order of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea were conferred on creators and artistes of major art troupes, including the Band of the State Affairs Commission, who distinguished themselves in creative activities for ushering in a new period of efflorescence of socialist literature and arts, true to the important tasks set forth at the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). Creators and artistes performed the unique and vibrant art performances as required by the era aspiring after new innovation, bold creation and steady progress by displaying the burning loyalty to the Party and revolutionary creation traits, thus imbuing the whole country with vigor and vitality and adding luster to the revolutionary faith and will of our people. The performances gave vivid ideological and artistic description of the greatness and invincible leadership of the WPK and the fighting spirit of all the people to demonstrate to the whole world the great era of Kim Jong Un, getting united around the Party in one mind, and thus made positive contributions to powerfully encouraging all the people and officers and men of the People's Army to the implementation of the decision of the Eighth Party Congress and plenary meetings of the Party Central Committee. An awarding ceremony took place at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on July 11. Present there were Ri Il Hwan, member of the Political Bureau and secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, Ko Kil Son, secretary general of the SPA Standing Committee, Sung Jong Gyu, minister of Culture, and creators and artistes of major art troupes. Ri Il Hwan read out a decree of the SPA Standing Committee of the DPRK. The Title of People's Artiste went to Kim Ok Ju, Order of National Flag First Class to Ri Myong Il and Pang Chol Jin, Order of National Flag Second Class to Pak Myong Song, Kang Chol Bong, Pak Song Nam, Kim Un Il, Kim Kang Nam, Kim Ju Il, Pak Yong Il, Jo So Rim, Sin Ju Gyong and Pae Song Guk and Order of National Flag Third Class to An Ryong Gwon, Kim Hyon Il and Kim Ye Song. Oath-taking speeches were made by Ri Myong Il, head and concurrently conductor of the Band of the State Affairs Commission, vocalist Kim Ok Ju, and Pak Song Nam, composer of the State Merited Chorus. The speakers said in excitement that the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un credited his soldiers with all successes though he led them step by step as their benevolent teacher, provided them with the spirit of devotedly serving the Party, the revolution, the country and the people and helped them give full play to their abilities in creation of fresh civilization in the era of the Workers' Party. They vowed to devote all their wisdom and enthusiasm to developing the musical art of the country into the one based on the Party policies and the popular and militant one that pulsates with the spirit of the times by creating more influential and appealing masterpieces touching all the people, true to the noble intention of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un who puts forward the literature and art as powerful weapon for victorious advance of the revolution. All the participants had their hearts burning with a will to fulfill their honorable mission and duty as firm defenders, disseminators and educators of the Party policies who devotedly defend the ideas and lines of the Party, cherishing the great trust and loving care shown by the respected General Secretary and holding aloft the banner of the musical art revolution in the new era. Rodong Sinmun

title: All Out to to Make a Decisive Breakthrough in Putting the Metallurgical and Chemical Industries on a Juche-oriented Footing
body: True to the ideas and spirit of the 3rd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea those engaged in the sphere of the metallurgical and chemical industries are all out to make a decisive breakthrough in putting them on a Juche-oriented footing. The workers and management of the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex make primary efforts to increase the capacity for the production of their oxygen and solidify the material and technological foundations for their other production processes. The officials of the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex (HISC) encourage its workers to work hard with great revolutionary enthusiasm in their workshops and detailedly ensure that they unravel their knotty problems by recourse to science and technology. The workers and technicians of the HISC actively explore and tap out their internal reserves, vigorously conduct a mass technological innovation drive, build an energy-saving oxygen blast furnace and consolidate the foundations for their production one by one. The labor and management of the Chollima Steel Complex ceaselessly do their utmost to orient its production processes toward Juche. The workers and management of the Musan Mining Complex, the Jaeryong, Unryul and Hungsan Mines, the Hungnam Electrode Factory and many other units surmount their challenges and difficulties courageously and do their level best to strengthen the foundations for their long-term production and boost their current production. In the field of the chemical industry workers go all out to bring about actual changes in their production and develop the industry. The officials and workers of the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex step up their present production and make energetic efforts to finish their capacity expansion projects speedily. Those of the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex effectively accelerate their internal pipe projects to increase their production capacity. Meanwhile, they continuously make great efforts to produce catalysts on their own and build up their technological personnel. The workers and management of the February 8 Vinalon Complex vigorously refashion and repair their salt solution tanks and effectively solidify the foundations for their production. The Sinuiju Chemical Fiber Factory concentrates its efforts on reinforcing its major production processes and producing for itself the reagents needed to turn out paper. In addition, the labor and management of many units actively establish, readjust and reinforce new production processes to contribute to developing the chemical industry of the country and bettering the living standard of the people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Meets and Congratulates Creators and Artistes of Major Art Troupes
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Sunday met and congratulated the creators and artistes of the major art troupes on receiving state commendations. The creators and artistes were overwhelmed by the feelings of profound reverence and gratitude to the great mentor and kind-hearted father who met them in person following the conferment of high honor and state commendations to them though they just did their part as persons of art and literature of the Party on the road of advance for implementing the decisions made at the historic Party Congress. The respected General Secretary gave a pep-talk to them, warmly holding their hands one by one, in recognition of their distinguished services for the development of Juche music in the revolutionary traits of creation, keeping in mind the trust of the Party Central Committee and the expectation of the people. He said with appreciation that they created and portrayed masterpieces of the times loved by the people including song "Our National Flag" true to our Party's revolutionary line and idea, and thus glorified our state-first era and instilled confidence and optimism about sure victory into the people. He repeatedly expressed satisfaction, saying that it is something that has been craved for and which is worth welcoming before any other achievements that the Band of the State Affairs Commission has evoked positive responses and repercussions from the people with its art creation and performing activities marked by masterpieces and famous performances reflective of the intention of the Party Central Committee at a time when the field of art and literature is still in the dormancy and doldrums. The new era of advance and dynamism demands the creation of lots of more influential and appealing masterpieces pulsating with the spirit of the times than ever before in the field of art and literature entrusted with important mission and innovative role to play in the revolution and construction, he emphasized. Our art and literature are obliged to be responsive to the requirements of the Party's policies and the spirit of the times to make the Party's idea and will pervade the whole process of the creation and performing activities that conform to the people's mentality, he said, calling on the major art troupes to keep their honor and consolidate the achievements of creation and based on it give exceptionally high momentum to the creation in the overall art and literature field. The respected General Secretary expressed the trust and expectation that they would continue to glorify their honor as the trumpeters of the revolution on the sacred road of singing of our great era, our great Party, our great state and our great social system, and had a meaningful photo taken with all the artistes of the Band as well as the decorated creators and artistes. All the creators and artistes renewed their firm pledge to always share their intention and breath with the Party Central Committee, cherishing their honor and happiness all their lives, and to take the lead in opening the new era of efflorescence of socialist art and literature by waging more dynamic creation activities to imbue the whole society with our state-first spirit. Political News Team

title: Practical Measures Taken to Implement Party's Childcare Policy
body: All provinces give top priority to taking good nutritional care of children, true to the decision of the Third Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Party Central Committee on improving the Party's childcare policy. After acquiring the statistical information about the population of the children of the nurseries and kindergartens and the amount of milk production in the province, North Phyongan Province launched a socialist emulation campaign to increase the number of dairy goats, thus supplying goat milk to the children. South Hwanghae Province makes sure that several stock farms in the province boost the production of milk to be supplied to Haeju Baby Home and Orphanage and nurseries and kindergartens in Haeju City. The province mobilized vehicles in its cities and counties to ensure nonstop supply of milk to their children. Jagang Province provided its milk producers with necessary milk processing tools and took measures to produce convenient utensils for children. Many farms in other provinces also produced a large amount of cow and goat milk and goat milk powder in reliance on their strong stock raising foundations, thus supplying tasty and nutritious dairy products to the children. Different factories, enterprises, collieries and mines including the Chollima Steel Complex and the Pyongyang Electric Cable Factory 326 laid material and technological foundations for increasing the milk production to regularly supply dairy products to the children in their nurseries and kindergartens. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greening of Samjiyon City Done Distinctively
body: Afforestation and greening of Samjiyon City, Ryanggang Province has been done beautifully. Ten thousand and thousands of trees of good species and many flowers have been planted in every nook and cranny of the streets in the city this year, sprucing up the mountainous city. Lots of white birch, picea Koraiensis and syringa amurensis loved so much by Chairman Kim Jong Il were planted around his statue and in the area of Kwangmyongsong-dong. They help the city preserve its sublimity as the sacred place of the sun and its characteristics as the mountainous city at the center of the natural forests of Mt Paektu. The greening of the city conforms to the multifarious layouts of dwelling houses, public service network and public buildings as it is adorned with flower beds and planters bursting with various kinds of blossoms of high ornamental value. Commercial and public catering service units also arranged planters of various shapes, giving pleasant feelings to visitors. The Samjiyon Blueberry Drink Factory made its compound attractive with the arrangement of flower beds suited to the features of the industrial district and an excellent resting place for workers. The city is actively promoting the work for raising flowers and flower shrubs of good species for its long-term afforestation. Rodong Sinmun

title: South Phyongan Province Focuses on Developing Local Industry
body: A campaign for developing the local industry gains momentum in South Phyongan Province. Oil-bearing crops of appropriate species are massively cultivated in a proper manner in cities and counties of the province to secure enough raw materials. The province also scrupulously organizes the work for boosting the production through recycling. To this end, it puts efforts into generalizing the experience of the units distinguishing themselves in recycling. The provincial technical force has been reinforced to tackle the urgent problems arising in updating the production lines at factories. After mapping out a realistic plan for modernizing the local industrial factories, the province directs efforts to improving the abilities of their technicians and skilled workers. Foodstuff factories in the province including the one in Hoechang County propel the modernization of their production lines on a full scale, while manufacturing and installing a lot of new equipment by themselves. Pukchang and Mundok counties laid foundations for producing plastic pipes of different sizes by updating machinery. Amid a brisk campaign for developing local industry, officials of the province engage in mobilizing the adequate manpower for different projects and ensuring the full supply of raw materials. Rodong Sinmun

title: Plasterers' Contest Begins at Construction Site for 10 000 Flats in Pyongyang
body: A plasterers' contest began as part of the Contest of Skilled Workers according to Occupations and Sectors of National Economy-2021 at the construction site for 10 000 flats in Pyongyang on Monday. Ace skilled plasterers selected from different parts of the country took part in the contest whose aim is to further boost the level of technical skill of workers and to ensure both quality and speed in construction by giving further momentum to the drive in which one overtakes and learns from others and swaps experience with one another. Standings will be set by marks judging the acquirement of knowledge in the field of specialization and the preparation of tools and also assessing the quality and speed of plastering and the use of materials in the work. An outline of organization and judgment was announced before the contest. The entrants began the contest, being full of zeal to fully show their competency in the construction for 10 000 flats in Pyongyang. The contest will continue until July 21. Rodong Sinmun

title: 2nd Enlarged Plenary Meeting of 8th Central Committee of GFTUK Held
body: The 2nd Enlarged Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea (GFTUK) took place through video conferencing on Monday. Present at the meeting were members and alternate members of the Central Committee of the GFTUK. Attending it in observer's capacity were officials of the Central Committee of the GFTUK and its provincial, city and county committees. It discussed the issue of thoroughly carrying out the important tasks set forth in the letter "Let the Trade Unions Become Advance Units That Open Up a New Era of Upsurge in Socialist Construction in the Vanguard" sent by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un to the participants in the 8th Congress of the GFTUK. Pak In Chol, chairman of the C.C., GFTUK, made a report. He said that the historic letter sent by the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un serves as the important guidelines for the trade unions to creditably fulfill their mission and duty as organizations of ideological education training the workers and their members to be vanguard fighters and as advance units actively propelling the revolutionary advance in the new times. He proposed measures for developing the trade union organizations into powerful political organizations remaining true to the idea and leadership of the Party and into a powerful force for socialist construction by bringing about a radical turn in the trade union work, as required by the times and developing revolution. He called for fully demonstrating the revolutionary spirit and the might of unity of the working class firmly united around the Workers' Party of Korea and accelerating the all-people grand march towards a fresh victory in socialist construction by thoroughly implementing the important tasks set forth in the historic letter sent by the respected General Secretary. Speeches were made at the meeting. The speakers expressed their will to add luster to the honor of being the "eldest sons" of the country and advance unit by making a substantial leap forward and innovations in every working site for a great upswing to fulfill the five-year plan, emulating the fighting spirit and traits displayed by the working class during the periods of post-war rehabilitation and the great Chollima upswing. After studying a draft resolution, the meeting adopted a relevant resolution. Rodong Sinmun

title: Up-to-date Cannery under Construction on East Sea of Korea
body: A modern cannery with a great production capacity is built on a large area of land in Wonsan City under the great loving care of the mother Party. It will have a rabbit processing shop, a fish processing shop, a sterilizing and packing shop and others. The officials of the field construction headquarters set themselves great step-by-step building targets first thing. They strive energetically to ensure that they are hit as soon as possible. The buildings of the cannery are now being roofed while the main ones of them are covered with plaster in full swing. The employees of factories and enterprises in the city work hard on the spot with a clear conscience to complete the cannery under the slogan of holding liability for it for a thousand years and guaranteeing it for ten thousand years. The officials of the headquarters see to it that the construction of the cannery is stepped up ceaselessly with success. Meanwhile, they adopt foreseeing measures to secure materials for the construction of the cannery beforehand carry it out successfully in the rainy season, too. Rodong Sinmun

title: Demise Anniversary of President Kim Il Sung Observed by Koreans in Russia
body: A meeting of the United Confederation of Koreans in Russia took place on July 5 on the occasion of the demise anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, the greatest memorial day of the Korean nation. Present there were officials of the confederation. Kim Chil Song, chairman of the confederation, and others made speeches. The speakers said that President Kim Il Sung, the eternal leader and the sun of the Korean nation, was a great man who liberated the country and restored the usurped dignity, honor and sovereignty of the nation. They praised the President for building the socialist state centered on the people and laying the ever-lasting foundations for building a powerful country for the prosperity of the country and the nation. They said that there was no such a peerless patriot as the President who performed great exploits by devotedly working until the last moments of his life to provide the Korean nation with a reunified country. The President will always be remembered for the idea and exploits he performed by devoting himself to the happiness of the people all his life, regarding it as his maxim to believe in the people as in Heaven, and by making great contributions to implementing the cause of global independence, they stressed. Rodong Sinmun

title: Early Peaches from Kwail County Supplied to Pyongyang Citizens
body: A long line of trucks carrying early peaches from Kwail County arrived in Pyongyang Tuesday. The Pyongyang City People's Committee and commercial service units in the city carefully organized the transport and services to ensure the prompt delivery of the early peaches to relevant units and all the families. Destinations included baby home, orphanage, primary and middle schools for orphans, old people's home and commercial service units. The commercial service units supplied the fruit to citizens amid prompt measures being taken to stabilize and improve the people's living, in response to the decisions made at the 3rd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Rodong Sinmun

title: Koreans in China Commemorate Anniversary of Demise of President Kim Il Sung
body: The General Association of Koreans in China and its affiliated organizations held events on July 8, the anniversary of the demise of President Kim Il Sung and the greatest memorial day of the Korean nation. A ceremony of laying floral baskets before the statue of the President took place at Yuwen Middle School in Jilin. The participants made a bow to the statue of the President in the school after placing floral baskets in the names of the General Association of Koreans in China and the Association of Korean Women in China. Choe Su Bong, first vice-chairman of the General Association, officials and members of the General Association, its Zhongnan Regional Association, the Federation of Korean Economic Workers in China, the Association of Korean Women in China, the Association of Young Korean Nationals in China and Korean nationals of Shenyang City placed floral baskets before the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and art works depicting them at the DPRK embassy in Beijing and at the DPRK General Consulate in Shenyang. A meeting of the general association took place in Shenyang City. An article written by Choe Su Bong in memory of the President was read out at the meeting. A letter to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un was adopted at the meeting. Then the participants watched a film. Meanwhile, the Yanbian Regional Association of the general association held a memorial meeting. Rodong Sinmun

title: Certificate of Quality and February 2 Goods Certificate Granted to Scores of Units
body: The quality of the products from a hundred and tens of the production processes of more than 60 units was certified by the Administration for Quality Management in the first half of 2021. In addition, 100-odd goods produced by over 20 units were registered as the February 2 Goods. In the first half of 2021 many factories and enterprises fully exerted themselves to endure that the quality of their products was certified. The Pyongyang Cornstarch Factory preferentially saw to it that the scientific and technological demand of a qualitative index was strictly met in all its production processes. Consequently, its production process for sweet fizzy drinks and many other processes were certified under the system for the control of foodstuff safety. The Susongchon Foodstuff General Factory and many other pickles factories vigorously pushed forward the scientization of their production processes. The result was that the processes for the production of sugar, sweets, cakes and pickled vegetables were certified under the system for the control of foodstuff safety. The Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Silk Mill, the Sinuiju Unha Towel Factory and the Sinuiju Bag Factory set up their production process as a whole according to the strict demand of standard quality. Consequently, the processes for the production of floret silk, mulberry silk, clothing and bags were certified under the quality control system. The officials, workers and technicians of many traditional Koryo medicine factories were all out to raise the quality of their medical and pharmaceutical products with patriotism and contributed to ensuring that the production processes for their pills, granules and medical powder were authenticated because they followed the GMP. Besides, many other factories, too, conducted brisk technological innovation drives to improve the quality of their products. As a result, electronic goods and coating materials and paints of various kinds were authenticated. Active endeavors were also made to produce as superb goods as the February 2 Goods. The workers and management of the Songdowon Foodstuff General Factory regarded the demand of the people for excellent foodstuffs and their comment on their quality as a yardstick for their creation and accordingly tried hard all the time to augment the quality of their products further. Consequently, products of 30 sorts, including fried corn cakes, were inscribed as the February 2 Products. The officials, technicians and workers of the Kyonghung Unhasu Foodstuff Factory, the Kyonghung Unhasu Drink Factory and the Pyongyang Children’s Foodstuff Factory believed that it was important to standardize their products and made efforts to adopt measures for it. The result was that candies and sesame oil, cider, fruit jelly and scores of sorts of other foodstuffs were registered as the February 2 Products. The Sonhung Foodstuff Factory, the Songchongang Bag Factory, the O-Il Health Drink Combined Factory and many other factories turn out products of over 30 kinds like raw Schizandra chinensis’s fruit wine, enzyme, primary schoolchildren’s bags and hard liquor. They were also inscribed as the February 2 Goods. Rodong Sinmun

title: Deeply Conscious of Sense of Heavy Responsibility
body: In hearty response to the decisions of the 3rd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea (WPK) the officials of South Hamgyong Province focus their energies on boosting the production of the consumer goods badly needed to improve the living standard of the people. The officials of Hamhung City acquired detailed knowledge of the actual conditions of the local industrial factories in its districts. On this basis they make sure that realistic plans are mapped out to modernize them and carried out persistently. In Tanchon City local industrial factories make efforts to step up their production with domestic raw and other materials, reclaim their industrial wastes and modernize their equipment and strive purposefully to increase the output of their consumer goods. The officials of the city see to it that its foodstuff factory is all out to set up a production process which relies on an unpowered boiler and that its other local industrial factories made great efforts to establish the production processes fed with their own raw materials. Hochon County tenaciously executes a plan to build an up-to-date bean paste shop at its foodstuff factory to supply its inhabitants with delicious bean paste and simultaneously reinforces its equipment to improve the quality of its sunflower oil further. In addition, the county works with might and main to set up a shop for the production of toilet paper at its paper factory. Jangjin County ensures that its technicians settle one by one the technological problems of bolstering the workshops of its local industry factories to satisfactorily provide its dwellers with the goods needed to stabilize their livelihood. Moreover, the county has seen to it that new products are devised dynamically and that even liquid soaps and detergents are enabled to be turned out with raw materials richly available in its land. True to the WPK’s idea of unselfish devotion to the people the officials of many cities and counties, too, try hard to boost the production of their consumer goods. Rodong Sinmun

title: Building and Remodeling Schools Accelerated in South Phyongan Province
body: Construction of dozens of new model schools and remodeling of existing ones are briskly underway in South Phyongan Province, with importance given to renewing the educational conditions and environment. While ensuring the successful production and supply of cement, the province has taken measures to make sure each city and county improve the speed and quality of the projects after mapping out detailed construction plans and by preparing adequate manpower. Officials in various cities and counties including Phyongsong City visit schools to solve problems arising in securing teaching aids, while giving precedence to the provision of transport means and building materials. The projects have been given a shot in the arm by campaigns launched by cities and counties in which they try to overtake and learn from others and swap experiences with one another. They have set model units and held demonstration sessions in order to promote the quality construction and also pay attention to securing experimental apparatuses. Organizations sponsoring educational fields have upped their support also. Rodong Sinmun

title: Agricultural Sector Braces for Potential Disastrous Weather
body: A campaign for coping with imminent disastrous weather is dynamically underway in the countryside of the DPRK. According to data available, as of July 10, irrigation setups have been repaired and readjusted, namely hundreds of reservoirs, river embankments extending over one thousand kilometers, drainage canals extending more than three hundred kilometers and drainage ditches extending over two hundred kilometers, and tide-water control dykes have been reinforced in sections extending scores of kilometers. Pyongyang City and North Phyongan Province have turned out in rehabilitating irrigation setups such as drain pumping stations and floodgates, and South Phyongan Province pushes ahead with river improvement while servicing floodgate motors and water pumps. North Hwanghae Province is concentrating efforts on river dredging and embankment after finishing the rehabilitation of drain pumping stations, emptying gates and floodgates. Kangwon Province has completed rehabilitation of reservoirs and river improvement as planned and has improved drain pumping stations and facilities. Other provinces, having completed river embankment and clearing of drainage canals and ditches, now find out dangerous elements to take necessary measures. Rodong Sinmun

title: Remains of Martyrs Buried in Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery
body: Remains of martyrs Pak Chan Su and Pak Jong Won, heroes of the Republic, were buried in the Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery with due ceremony on July 15 ahead of the 68th anniversary of the victory in the Fatherland Liberation War. During the war, Pak Chan Su, who was awarded the precious title of a young heavy machine gunner on Height 1211 from President Kim Il Sung, took over "the Minchong" heavy machine gun associated with Hero Jo Kun Sil's feats and wiped out enemies to defend the height to the last. During the postwar reconstruction and socialist construction he worked with devotion to discharge his duties as a member of the victor generation. He served as a lecturer at the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum under the great loving care and trust of the Party, devoting his wisdom and energy to deeply implanting the spirit of defending the country displayed in the 1950s in the minds of the younger generation. Pak Jong Won took an active part in the aircraft-hunting campaign in hearty response to the outstanding military ideas and Juche-oriented tactics of the President and shot down three airplanes of the enemy between December 1951 and January 1952, contributing to ensuring wartime transport.
