After the war, he carried on his service in the army to firmly defend the outpost of the class struggle to safeguard the country and people. Their remains were buried at the graves. The remains of the wives of Pak Jong Won and 12 other martyrs who had already been buried were interred together with their husbands'. The participants in the ceremony laid bouquets at their graves and paid a silent tribute to them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Floral Basket from Foreigner
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a floral basket from Sai Tiejen, honorary vice-chairman of the Board of Directors of the Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation, on July 15 on the occasion of the ninth anniversary of the conferment of the title of the DPRK Marshal on him. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Olympic Committee Denounces Japan Sports World for Its Shamelessness Besmirching Idea and Spirit of Olympic Movement
body: A spokesman for the DPRK Olympic Committee issued the following press statement Friday: The Japan sports world has reached the extremes in its shameless act designed to seize Tok Island, part of the inviolable territory of Korea, even in defiance of the sacred idea and spirit of the Olympic movement. The Tokyo Olympic Games Organizing Committee on an Olympic torch relay map posted on the official website of the 32nd Olympics marked Tok Island, the territory of the DPRK, as "Japanese territory", and as this sparked off a flurry of censure and protests, it reeled off excuses that "it is purely a geographical representation" and "no political statement was intended in its creation". It is irrefutable that Tok Island is part of the inalienable territory of Korea in view of international law and from historical and geographical points of view. Political issues are inseparable from territorial issues, and it is shameless and groundless sophism to insist that it is just a geographical concept that part of Korea is marked as part of Japan. The act of abusing the Olympic Games for realizing territorial ambition though they are supposed to promote friendship and harmony is a mockery of sportspersons all over the world and the desire of mankind for peace and an intolerable provocation violating the sovereignty of the Korean nation. Presumably, Japan and the Tokyo Olympic Games Organizing Committee are the only country and Olympic organizing committee on earth which go so shameless as to mark the territory of other country as their land on the Olympic torch relay map and maintain that it is simply a geographical representation and no political statement was intended in the creation of the map by taking the advantage of hosting the Olympics. Lurking behind the sordid act committed by the Tokyo Olympic Games Organizing Committee by taking the advantage of hosting the Olympics is Japan's dirty scheme to create a precedent for marking Tok Island as "Japan's territory" at future international sports games and to establish Japan's dominium over Tok Island in the world. The International Olympic Committee's response to the wrong assertion made by the Tokyo Olympic Games Organizing Committee is also problematic. The IOC categorically opposed marking Tok Island on the Korean peninsula flag for the 23rd Winter Olympic Games in Phyongchang, south Korea, in February 2018, stating it is a political issue to mark Tok Island on the Korean peninsula flag to be used by the single north-south team and political neutrality must be maintained in sports and Olympics. In July 2019 the IOC in a letter sent to the chairman of the DPRK Olympic Committee said that it reminded the Games Organizing Committee of its strong stand on political neutrality regarding the description of Tok Island as "Japan's territory" on the Olympic torch relay map by the Tokyo Olympic Games Organizing Committee. But with an abrupt change in its stand on July 2 the world body forwarded letters to its members, honorary members and honor members which said that Tok Island issue is the one related to the Olympic Games Organizing Committee and therefore, when the issue is tabled, they should take note of the assertion of the Tokyo Olympic Games Organizing Committee. The DPRK Olympic Committee denounces the sinister behavior of the Tokyo Olympic Games Organizing Committee of insulting the sacred charter and idea of the Olympics and justifying its territorial claim by abusing the opportunity of hosting the games, and is compelled to call to account the International Olympic Committee for its double-dealing behavior. The 32nd Olympic Games Organizing Committee must correct the Olympic torch relay map though belatedly, and the International Olympic Committee should behave with impartiality as befitting the international organization overseeing Olympic movement worldwide. Rodong Sinmun

title: Phibada Opera Troupe Marks Its Golden Jubilee
body: The Phibada Opera Troupe marked its 50th founding anniversary. The history of the troupe which was organized with the start of the revolution in the operatic art is the one of loving care and honor in which it has developed under the care of the peerlessly great men. President Kim Il Sung set forth the idea of creating an example of the Korean-style opera, illuminated the orientation and ways for implementing it and bestowed warm favors on creators and artistes of the troupe. Chairman Kim Jong Il set July 17, Juche 60 (1971) when it gave the premiere of the revolutionary opera "Sea of Blood" in the presence of the President as its founding day and put great trust in it so that it can steadily add luster to the glorious tradition of the anti-Japanese revolutionary literature and art. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un has led the troupe so that its creators and artistes could creditably fulfill their honorable mission and duty as the thoroughgoing defenders and implementers of our Party's line on literature and art who are boundlessly faithful to the Party. A meeting took place at the Pyongyang Grand Theatre on Friday to mark the anniversary. Rodong Sinmun

title: Foreign Figures Visit DPRK Missions
body: Personages of various countries and regional organizations visited the DPRK missions in their countries on the occasion of the 27th anniversary of the demise of President Kim Il Sung. They laid floral baskets and bouquets before the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and the art works depicting the great leaders standing together, and paid tribute to them. They included the general secretary of the Central Committee of the Nepal Communist Party (Marxist-Leninist) who is ex-deputy prime minister of Nepal, the chairman of the Nepal Journalist Association, the chairman of the Study Forum for Self-Reliance of Nepal, the chairman and the secretary general of the Nepalese Association for Supporting the Songun Politics, the editor-in-chief of the Pakistani newspaper Election Times, the national secretary of the People's Progressive Party of Nigeria, the chairman of the Nigerian National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, the general secretary of the Workers' Party of Democratic Congo, the national chairman of the Federation of Students and Pupils of DR Congo, members of the Democratic Party of Equatorial Guinea, the special political adviser to the Senegalese president, members of the Political Bureau of the Workers' Party for the Independence of Senegal and the secretary general of the African Regional Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Floral Baskets
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received floral baskets from Jin Xian, director of the Board of Directors of the Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation, and Tang Yiming, member of the foundation, on Friday on the occasion of the 9th anniversary of the conferment of the title of the DPRK Marshal on him. Rodong Sinmun

title: Emergency Measures for Coping with Fierce Heat and Drought Taken in DPRK
body: Sultry weather continues in most areas of the DPRK though it is rainy season. Officials and working people in all the fields and regions across the country have turned out in the campaign for preventing the damage from fierce heat and drought. In the field of education and childcare, teachers, kindergarteners and nurses are urged to take care of the living and health of pupils and children in a responsible way. The agricultural field takes measures for sufficiently supplying water necessary for the growth of crops by making maximum use of pumping stations and groundwater-tapping facilities including well, tube-well and underground reservoir, and for mobilizing various sorts of irrigation equipment. It pays primary attention to making an efficient use of water through the responsible control over irrigation waterways. It endeavors to take technological measures like correct observation and rapid extermination of harmful insects and regular application of various growth stimulants and biological activators to prevent the crops from getting damaged. Setting it as an important matter to sufficiently supply electric power for pumping water to farms, the field of the electric power industry scrupulously checks transmission lines and manages equipment to keep power transmission and transformer equipment from damage by overheat. The fields of urban management and land and environment protection take appropriate measures to provide the inhabitants with enough drinking water and prevent roadside trees, turfs, flower bushes and saplings of tree nurseries from getting damaged by high heat and drought. All the sectors of the national economy are taking timely measures to eliminate factors which can occur in the course of management and operation of machinery and electric equipment and also in the operation of trains. Every province, city and county are setting up regular control system and deploying observation posts in relevant places, while taking detailed and realistic measures to suit the specific features of their regions. Ministries and national institutions press for measures for sufficiently mobilizing manpower, equipment and materials to effectively cope with fierce heat and drought. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Premier Inspects Different Sectors in Samjiyon City
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected several sectors in Samjiyon City. He gave pep talks to the shock brigade members of the 216 Division who are making innovative achievements in the project for improving the road for an expedition to revolutionary battle sites in the area of Mt Paektu and the third-stage project for remodeling Samjiyon City including Sinmusong-dong true to the decisions made at the historic Party Congress and the plenary meetings of the Party Central Committee. He called upon officials and shock brigade members to ensure the quality of the construction at the highest level and finish the project without fail by deadline with the pride and honor of launching the grand construction campaign for further sprucing up the sacred place of the revolution. A field meeting reviewed the state of the projects. It then took necessary measures based on the discussion of the issue for all officials to surely convert the construction to a process of implementing the decision of the Party and raise a hot wind for collective emulation, the issue of using finishing building materials that are either locally produced or recycled and the issues arising in ensuring perfection in epidemic prevention work. Visiting a nursery, kindergarten, unit in food administration field and a construction site of goat stock-farm in the city, he stressed the need for officials to more scrupulously organize the work to thoroughly and devotedly implement the decisions made at the plenary meetings of the Party Central Committee without fail, bearing in mind the intention of the Party Central Committee which had taken important measures for the people and the rising generations. Acquainting himself with wheat and potato farming in the Junghung Farm, he stressed the need to take proactive sci-tech measures for reaping a rich and stable harvest despite unfavorable weather conditions and to direct main efforts to the research into high-yielding strain. Rodong Sinmun

title: The Looks of the Silk Mill Change Day by Day Thanks to the Plant Life of Its Compounds
body: The Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Silk Mill is widely known to the whole country for good cultured practices in its production and life. Lots of flowering shrubs and trees are now flourishing in the compounds of the silk mill. They include hundreds of fruit trees of more than 10 kinds like apricots, peaches and plums as well as thousands of flowering shrubs of dozens of species such as magnolias, roses and redbuds. The compounds of the silk mill boast many metasequoias, firs, etc, too. The employees of the silk mill say that their mill is just like a botanical garden. The silk mill tends the flowering shrubs and fruit trees well so its employees profit from them in their dietary lives. The silk mill harvests plenty of fruits from the fruit trees and supply them to the children of its crèche and kindergarten. It has a greenhouse on the rooftop of its workers’ dormitory and gathers several tons of vegetables from it. The dispensary of the silk mill uses gingko nuts, the fruits of Aronia melanocarpa and the roots of broad bellflowers for helping toward promoting the health of its employees. The officials of the silk mill still dedicate all their wisdom and zeal to planting and tending trees and flowering plants for landscaping purposes under a great long-term plan. Rodong Sinmun

title: Demise Anniversary of President Kim Il Sung Commemorated Abroad
body: There took place internet photo exhibitions with various titles such as "Kim Il Sung, prominent great leader" and "President Kim Il Sung of Korea who boundlessly loved children" in China, Russia, Nepal, Laos, Iran, Indonesia, India, Thailand, Bulgaria, Austria, Serbia, Senegal and Brazil on the occasion of the 27th anniversary of the demise of President Kim Il Sung. Websites carried photos of the President finding himself among pupils and children with sunny smile on his face and those documenting his revolutionary activities that show his warm loving care for the younger generations. They included the Chinese Huan Qiu network, Russian websites Patrioti Moskva, Khabinfo. ru, Indonesian internet newspaper RMOL, Indian internet news Voice of Millions, and websites of Nepalese newspaper Gorkha Express, Lao news agency, Iranian Ilna, the Indonesia-Korea Association for Friendship and Cultural Exchange, the Organization for the Study of the Juche Idea of Thailand, the Bulgarian Group for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, the Serbian National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea and the Brazilian Center for the Study of Songun Politics. Rodong Sinmun

title: Technology of Production of Profitable Protein Feed Applied
body: North Hwanghae Province channels its great energy into its stock and fish farming under the Party’s policy of developing it. First of all, it ensured that the technology of the production of protein feed was applied to the Poman Fish Farm in Sohung County to register successes in its production. Shortly after, it expertly arranged for the relevant experiences to be widely generalized in its other units. It vividly showed its officials and the officials of its cities and counties the data on the consumption of cereals and the output of fish which were contrastively analyzed pursuant to the use and nonuse of a kind of Stratiomyidae so that they could keenly realize how much they would profit from the use of the insect. Afterwards, the habitats of the insect were built competitively across the length and breadth of the province. The officials of the provincial people’s committee rapidly built a habitat of a kind of Stratiomyidae at a catfish farm. The senior officials of the province’s cities and counties each dynamically built the habitats at their breeding stock farms and breeding fish stations in real earnest. The cooperative farms of the province set up the habitats at the bases of their stockbreeding workteams and cattle fattening subworkteams. Its factories and enterprises did that at their livestock centers and fish farms. Consequently, the habitats were completed anew throughout the province in a short time. The officials of the province continue to see to it that the above units run the habitats on scientific and technological lines and gain actual profits from them without so much as resting on their laurels. Rodong Sinmun

title: Tens of Millions of Trees Planted in Cyclic Felling Areas
body: Forestry workers have planted tens of millions of trees in more than 11 000 hectares of logging areas and treeless places. Officials in the Ministry of Forestry took necessary measures after learning in detail about the number of saplings secured by forestry stations, mine timber production stations and afforestation stations. Different provincial forestry management bureaus produced stimulants for raising the survival rate of saplings and supplied them to relevant units. This was followed by strict review and appraisal to produce high results in tree planting. Forestry stations, mine timber production stations and afforestation stations have registered good successes by pushing ahead with land leveling and tree planting simultaneously. They produced healthy saplings of good species under detailed afforestation plans. Rodong Sinmun

title: "Complete Collection of Kim Jong Il's Works" Vol. 37 Published
body: The Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House brought out Vol. 37 of "Complete Collection of Kim Jong Il's Works", a library of immortal Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism carrying Chairman Kim Jong Il's works in chronological order and in a systematic and comprehensive way. The volume contains 54 works including speeches, talks and letters released by the Chairman between May and December, Juche 73 (1984). Among them are the works clarifying the idea that the unity and cohesion of our Party is the ideological and volitional unity based on the revolutionary idea of President Kim Il Sung and organizational unity centered on the President, and the works of expounding the orientation and ways for the Party organizations to efficiently conduct Party work. Other works deal with the idea of rallying all the service persons of the Korean People's Army closely behind the leader and making the People's Army ever-victorious militant ranks. Other works clarify the ways to dynamically wage the struggle to attain the ten long-term objectives for socialist economic construction and the idea of providing the people with more well-off and civilized living conditions. Other works detail the idea that socialist education is, in essence, human remolding work for training man to be a powerful being, set forth the tasks for bringing about a fresh revolutionary turn in the educational work by thoroughly implementing the educational policy of the Party, and put forward the policy calling on the organizations of the trade unions to dynamically carry out the three revolutions - ideological, technical and cultural, regarding them as their main revolutionary task. The volume also contains the works dealing with the ways of representing the greatness of the President on a scientific and philosophical basis and with the ways to help our newspapers and radio fulfill their missions. Other works give answers to the theoretical and practical issues arising in the revolutionary struggle and construction including the issue of improving and intensifying the land management. Rodong Sinmun

title: Second Enlarged Plenary Meeting of Seventh Central Committee of SWUK Held
body: The Second Enlarged Plenary Meeting of the Seventh Central Committee of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea (SWUK) was held through video conferencing on July 19. Present there were members and alternate members of the Central Committee of the union. Officials of the Central Committee and the provincial, city and county committees of the union were on hand as observers. The meeting discussed the ways to thoroughly implement the tasks set forth at the letter "Let the Women's Union Become a Powerful Unit in Propelling the Advance and Development of Our Style of Socialism" sent by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un to the participants in the Seventh Congress of the SWUK. Kim Jong Sun, chairwoman of the C.C., SWUK, said in her report that the women's union is now faced with an honorable task it is obliged to fulfill by giving fresh impetus to the advancing Korean revolution and propelling the ongoing general march by encouraging all the union members to implement the decisions made at the historic Party Congress and plenary meetings of the Party Central Committee. She referred to the measures to carry out the task. She called on women's union organizations at all levels to focus on their internal work, scrupulously organize their work for enhancing the practical abilities and qualifications of primary officials and turn the work with union members into the one to understand their minds and feelings. She called for powerfully accelerating the revolution and construction with the great spiritual strength and patriotic devotion of the Korean women by thoroughly carrying out the important tasks set forth by the respected General Secretary in his historic letter. Speeches were made at the meeting. After studying a draft resolution, the meeting adopted a relevant resolution. Rodong Sinmun

title: Welders' Contest Begins at Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex
body: A welders' contest started as part of the Contest of Skilled Workers according to Occupations and Sectors of National Economy-2021 at the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex on July 19. The contest is aimed at improving the technical level of skilled workers and consolidating the material and technical foundations of the metal industry. Ace welders selected from ministries, national institutions and provincial people's committees take part in the contest. The participants, divided into different groups, will have their expert knowledge and tools verified during the contest. They have to implement their tasks in a fixed time while observing the technical rules. Then, quality of their work will be appraised and the rankings decided. The contest will continue until late July. Rodong Sinmun

title: All Out to Luster the Martial Arts of the Nation
body: These are the instructors and athletes of the Taekwon-Do Team of the Korean Taekwon-Do Committee. They have displayed the honor of the country in the world with Taekwon-Do, the orthodox martial arts of Korea and the fruits of the wisdom and spirit of the nation. They aim high at developing the techniques of Taekwon-Do further and train themselves zealously with a firm resolve to luster and dignify the country throughout the world. Rodong Sinmun

title: The Seascape "The Waves off Ongchon"
body: The seascape “The Waves off Ongchon” was painted by Jong Son, a realistic landscapist of Korea, in the the first half of the 18th century. It depicts the sea off Thongchon in Kangwon Province. Thongchon is not only beautiful but also noted for its patriotic people who destroyed all the Japanese pirates when they invaded Kangwon Province in former times. The seascape realistically depicts a precipitous cliff standing deep in the East Sea of Korea and the waves freely crashing against the cliff, surging and fretting over rocks and swirling across the sea. In addition, a weather-beaten evergreen pine trees on the cliff serve to praise the patriotic people for driving out the Japanese invaders and defending the country. The seascape was painted delicately and vividly with marrowy touches. It belongs to the best landscape paintings of our Korean ancestors. Rodong Sinmun

title: More Successes Seen in Construction Sites of Dwelling Houses in DPRK
body: More successes are witnessed in the construction sites for 10 000 flats in Pyongyang City and the construction sites of dwelling houses in the Pothong riverside terraced residential district and Komdok area. Excellent buildings to be seen in the layouts only some months ago began to take on their magnificent appearances. Those involved in building 10 000 flats make uninterrupted progress in the project while ensuring high speed and quality in construction. Soldier-builders in charge of building skyscrapers and high-rise apartment buildings invented and introduced rational working methods through an experience-sharing campaign among their work teams, thus registering good results. Soldier-builders in the construction sites of dwelling houses in the Pothong riverside terraced residential district and Komdok area have achieved successes one after another through their all-out fierce day and night campaign for carrying out the Party policy. Red flags, notice boards, visual aids and socialist emulation diagrams that can be seen at every nook and corner of the construction sites arouse the builders' revolutionary enthusiasm. Different kinds of agitprop activities are also underway to encourage the builders. Thanks to the strong fighting spirit of the builders to devotedly implement the Party policy, the construction projects make rapid progress. Rodong Sinmun

title: Efforts Made to Keep and Tend Their Goats on a Scientific Footing
body: True to the decisions of the 3rd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea the labor and management of the Kanggye Goat Farm go all out to mass-produce dairy products. They calculated the number of the children of the crèches and kindergartens of their city and the daily output of their dairy products in detail and aimed high at boosting their production. Above all, they make great endeavors to increase the number of their goats and keep and tend them on scientific lines. The farm has chosen to graze its goats in separate flocks and fixed the number of them in a flock at 50 or so. Besides, it tries its hardest to ensure that its employees acquire extensive scientific and technological knowledge of goat raising. Its managerial staff and workers are now striving mightily to augment the number of their goats and simultaneously intensifying their epizootic prevention to produce more dairy products. Rodong Sinmun

title: The Traditional Dishes of the Nation for the Period of Sweltering Midsummer Heat
body: We are now in the sweltering heat of midsummer. The wholesome traditional dishes of the nation are accordingly very popular among the people everywhere in our country. Tangogi soup is typical of the dishes during the period of sweltering midsummer heat. From ancient times our people have enjoyed hot tangogi soup and cooked foxtail millet and perspired copiously during the period of sweltering midsummer heat to counter heat with heat and invigorate their bodies well. It has long been said that chicken dishes, too, vitalize oneself. "Samgyetang" is a tonic. It is prepared by stuffing a chicken with glutinous rice, whole bulbs of garlics, ginseng, etc and boiling it hard. In the ingredients, ginseng is of the essence. From olden times the people of Pyongyang have enjoyed eating cooked rice mixed with various kinds of boiled meats, edible grass and so on, plus a spitchcock during the period of sweltering midsummer heat. Our national dishes do themselves fuller justice today developing our culinary and dietary culture. Rodong Sinmun

title: Seminars, Lectures and Film Shows Held Abroad in Memory of President Kim Il Sung
body: Seminars, lectures and film shows took place in Russia, Romania, Belarus, Italy, Serbia, Bangladesh, India, Thailand, Guinea, Nigeria, DR Congo, Uganda and Brazil on the occasion of the 27th anniversary of the demise of President Kim Il Sung. The participants in the film shows watched the Korean films on the President's revolutionary career, feats and noble outlook on the rising generation. Attending the events were public figures and citizens in those countries. The first secretary of the Khabarovsk Territorial Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation and the first secretary of the Central Committee of the Lenin Young Communist League of the Russian Federation said that the demise of the President was a great loss to the Korean people and all other progressives in the world. They praised the President as a legendary hero of the Korean nation and an invincible and iron-willed commander. The chairman of the Socialist Party of Romania and the chairman of the Romania-Korea Friendship Association stressed that the President's feats would always be remembered by all people. Belarusian and Serbian personages said that the President was the great leader of the Korean people and an outstanding great man in the 20th century who devoted his whole life to the independence and prosperity of the country and the happiness of the people. The chairman of the Italian Committee for the Study of Songun Idea for Independence and Sovereignty and the chief editor of La Voce praised the President as an extraordinary thinker and theoretician, great statesman, peerless military strategist and the greatest man who firmly defended the freedom and independence of the DPRK. A memorial service was held in Britain on the same occasion. Rodong Sinmun

title: Farming Fertilizer Supply Plans Fulfilled in DPRK
body: Officials and workers of the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex and the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex have fulfilled their farming fertilizer supply plans for the manuring year. The officials of the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex puts big efforts into ensuring closer cooperation among workshops and dovetailing all processes while intensifying control and guidance over the workers to help them fulfill their daily, weekly and monthly plans for producing fertilizer without fail. They work hard to realize the home-production of catalysts and give full play to creative wisdom and efforts of the workers and to tap all reserves and potential. The Hungnam Fertilizer Complex waged an intensive campaign to fulfill the fertilizer supply plan for the manuring year. The complex scrupulously organized the economic operation and guidance to make a breakthrough in increasing production by dint of science and technology while giving priority to supplying raw and other materials in close cooperation with relevant units. Not resting on their laurels, the workers of the complexes buckled down to attaining a higher goal in order to bring about practical change and substantial progress from the first year for implementing the five-year plan. Rodong Sinmun

title: KCNA Releases Detailed Report on Heroic Struggle of People behind Front during Fatherland Liberation War
body: The Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) made public a detailed report on the heroic struggle feats performed by the people behind the line in the spirit of hard-work and fortitude during the three-year Fatherland Liberation War. The report came on July 23, a few days leading up to the 68th anniversary of the great victory won by the Korean people in the war. The report recalled that the Kunja-ri spirit was created by the workers in the munitions industry, an inheritance of the Yongil bomb spirit of Paektu dating back to the grim anti-Japanese war, and that dynamic campaigns for increasing food production, the volume of transport, and production of goods in the wartime and the campaign for supporting the front prevailed throughout the country. Throughout the war period, the munitions factories in the rear never stopped operation. The workers in Kunja-ri, cherishing the honor of making submachine guns and mortars for the first time after the liberation of the country by their own efforts and technology, created the Kunja-ri spirit replete with the spirit of self-reliance and fortitude in the underground tunnel in Mt Paekyang. During the war they produced over three times as many arms as those before the war, making the spirit of self-reliance and fortitude run through their everyday life. The Kunja-ri spirit with which the workers there responded to President Kim Il Sung's call "Everything for victory in the war!" with the struggle for devoted implementation, spread to all other munitions factories. Workers of a munitions factory performed a miracle of fighting Korea by setting up a cupola in a mountain and producing hundreds of thousands of hand grenades in over 40 days in the blizzards of winter. Farmers, under the militant slogans set forth by the President "The struggle for food is a struggle for the country" and "Let not an inch of land lie idle and let us produce even a single grain more!" performed feats in increasing the food production in the wartime. Wonderful successes were registered in the agricultural production year after year through the dynamic struggle for increased food production in the wartime. The agricultural production in 1950 far exceeded that in 1948, the peak year before the war, and in 1952 the total area that had been sown showed two percent increase while the total agricultural output 13 percent rise as compared with those in 1951. The report also covered the heroic struggle of the workers in the railway sector who ensured wartime transport despite gunfire. Bearing in mind the militant orders of the President, they increased transport by displaying matchless patriotic devotion and bravery for war victory despite the frantic bombing by the enemies and the insidious manoeuvres by spies and saboteurs. The whole period of the war saw a vigorous campaign to create a new level in the volume of freight carried and the distance covered. A hero engine driver of a locomotive was produced who ran 3 400 kilometers more than the yearly running distance and hauled cargoes of 180 more freight cars than the amount assigned. Lots of innovators were also produced among whom were engine drivers who increased the fixed pulling quantity up to 200 percent. The railway cargo transport plan for 1952 was over-fulfilled thanks to the dynamic struggle by dint of invincible fortitude, and the workers in the sector were honoured to receive a letter of thanks from the President. Officials and workers in the railway sector redoubled their efforts and transported 96 percent more cargo for the first half of 1953 as compared with that in the same period of the previous year. During the war, this sector witnessed the production of over 16 780 order-bearers including scores of heroes. In hearty response to the militant call of the President to meet the demand for war supplies and daily necessities in the front and the rear, a campaign for production increase was waged as a mass emulation movement throughout the war. In each sector of the national economy, front shock brigade movement, front workteam movement, youth workteam movement and various other mass movements were waged to inject vitality into the struggle for bringing about advance and rapid progress in the overall national economic sectors even in the difficult wartime conditions. It is thanks to the wartime struggle for production increase waged as a mass emulation movement that a lot of factories and enterprises in the DPRK increased the production level over 1.5 times in the first period of the war as compared to that before the war and implemented the two-year plan of the national economy ahead of schedule. The indomitable spirit was fully displayed also in the struggle to rapidly restore and readjust the economy devastated by the barbarous acts of the enemies. The plan for the first half of 1951 was successfully carried out ahead of schedule amid the dynamic struggle of the mass emulation campaign for production increase waged in all sectors of the national economy. The wartime emulation movement for production increase developed into an unprecedented campaign to create a new standard as the war became longer. Amid the above-said mass movement, the first half of 1951 alone witnessed the production of 2 650 order-bearers and new norms which had been unthinkable in the peaceful period were created one after another. Thanks to the dynamic emulation campaign for production increase the total industrial output value and trade turnover increased on a yearly basis even in the wartime conditions, and the monthly and quarterly national economic plans for 1953 were overfulfilled until July when the war ended. While the movements for my height, vengeance-taking, "the Minchong" weapon-winning and model company were brisk on the front, the people at the rear waged an all-people campaign to support the front, which reflected their will to share the destiny with soldiers. Civilians across the country ensured the advance of the Korean People's Army units by restoring the wrecked railway sections, bridges and roads in a self-sacrificing way, and scrambled to deliver ammunition, food and other military supplies to the front. Their heroic support for the front was a succession of the brilliant tradition of army-people unity created by the President during the anti-Japanese armed struggle and this reliably guaranteed the victory in the war by linking up the front and the rear as one bloodline. The detailed report stressed that the great spirit and feats of the victor generation will be immortal along with the victorious advance of the revolutionary cause of Juche whatever the situation. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Premier Inspects Several Sectors of National Economy
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected several sectors of the national economy. Going round the Sunchon Pharmaceutical Factory, Kim Tok Hun called for powerfully propelling the work for boosting production with locally available raw and other materials and modernizing the production lines by proactively tapping the sci-tech potentiality in order to increase the production of medicines urgently needed for the people's health, medical treatment and disease prevention. At the Pyongyang Mechanical Pencil Factory, Mangyongdae Disabled Soldiers' Fountain Pen Factory and Pyongyang Disabled Soldiers' Ball Pen Factory, he took measures to help the factories meet the public demand by producing more quality pens of different kinds favored by students and people. The field consultative meetings discussed the issues of conducting business and management activities in a feasible way under the scientific calculation, increasing the quantity and quality of products with priority given to the production of necessities and making sure that relevant units supply raw and other materials in time. After acquainting himself with the farming in Suan, Singye, Sohung and Hwangju counties in North Hwanghae Province, the premier urged officials to take positive measures to prevent fierce heat damage to crops and arouse the enthusiasm of farmers by enforcing in a methodological way the field-responsibility-system within the framework of the sub-work team management system. Visiting various units in the sector of food administration, nurseries and kindergartens, he urged officials to correctly implement our Party's policies for the people and children with the spirit of devotedly serving the people. Meanwhile, he discussed and took measures to resolve the comprehensive issues arising in normalizing the production at the Sunchon Phosphatic Fertilizer Factory. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Verbal Message of Sympathy to President Xi Jinping
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a verbal message of sympathy to Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC) and president of the People's Republic of China, as regards the recent flood that claimed heavy casualties and material losses in several areas including Henan Province of China. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un expressed profound sympathy to General Secretary Xi Jinping and deep condolences to the victims and the bereaved families over the flood damage, and extended militant greeting to the members of the CPC and soldiers of the Chinese People's Liberation Army devoting themselves in the van of the damage prevention and restoration campaign. Kim Jong Un expressed full support for Xi Jinping, the CPC and the Chinese people in their struggle for eradicating the aftermath of the flood and stabilizing the life of the victims as soon as possible. He expressed belief that the people in the affected areas would remove the aftermath of the natural disaster and restore their stable life within a short span of time thanks to the guidance of General Secretary Xi Jinping and devoted efforts by the members of the CPC and Chinese people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Measures Taken to Prevent Damage from Severe Heat in Rural Areas
body: As sultry weather hits the country, agricultural officials and workers of the DPRK turned out in taking good care of the crops in the latter half of their growth. The Ministry of Agriculture informs the farms throughout the country of future weather and appropriate technical measures through video conferencing and the tele-conversation system for exchanging farming techniques. Providing detailed technical guidance, the ministry also focuses on supplying necessary materials for scientific farming. North Phyongan Province distributed manuals on the methods for identifying the paddy and dry fields where crops suffer from malnutrition and taking necessary measures. The province also established a stricter system for controlling water supply and guided the work properly. Those in charge of managing waterways and supplying water to paddy fields are urged to fulfill their responsibilities. Farmers in South Phyongan Province spray nutrient solution over crops while plucking maize tassels. Directing efforts to taking care of rice in paddy fields, they also carpet the hillside fields and other maize fields vulnerable to drought with hulls of rice, wheat and barley straw. By tapping all water resources and mobilizing vehicles and pumping equipment, North and South Hwanghae provinces concentrate on irrigating the paddy and dry fields with different methods. Agricultural workers in Kangwon and North Hamgyong provinces exert themselves to prevent damage by severe heat, repeatedly checking the state of wells and tube-wells. They make preparations to protect crops from unfavorable weather. Rodong Sinmun

title: Diplomatic Corps Here Visit Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum
body: Staff members of the diplomatic corps here visited the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum on July 21 and 22 ahead of the 68th anniversary of the Korean people's victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War. The visitors made the rounds of the hall housing a large panorama depicting the operation to liberate Taejon, the hall of international support and solidarity and the hall showing heroes of the Republic, being briefed about the fact that President Kim Il Sung led to victory the war against the armed invasion by the imperialists with his Juche-oriented military ideas and superb strategy and tactics. Earlier, they looked round the Statue of Victory at the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum and the exhibition hall for captured arms showing the heroic feats of the Korean People's Army. At the end of the visit, they made entries in the visitor's book. Rodong Sinmun

title: Efficient Rice Harvesters Produced
body: The Haeju Farm Machine Plant succeeded in making an efficient handy rice harvester at less cost on its own. Actively rousing the creative enthusiasm of its employees the plant made with its technology for itself the jigs and equipment needed to turn out the rice harvesters and produced them at full steam. The plant did not at all rest on its laurels but aimed high at making a rice combine harvester. It has already finished designing it and made the related jigs and machines. It is now producing it on trial. Fully awakened to the importance of their duty they must do in increasing the proportion of the farm work done by machines the officials, technicians and workers of the plant go on with their work for agriculture. Rodong Sinmun

title: Epidemic Prevention Rules Strictly Observed in DPRK
body: Now that the global health crisis caused by COVID-19 gets worse, the campaign for checking the inroads of the malignant virus has become more intensified in all the sectors, units and areas of the DPRK. The central emergency epidemic prevention sector correctly outlined the rules of conduct and regulations for officials, working people and other citizens, and has notified everyone of the rules and taken measures in advance to fill the gaps in the epidemic prevention work. The public health sector makes sure that workers at the epidemic prevention posts and health workers fulfill their roles and conduct health education among the public in a diverse way. Educational institutions and nurseries carefully disinfect teaching tools and toys and conduct education for preventing diseases. Institutions, industrial enterprises and farms make sure that their employees frequently disinfect their offices, worksites, equipment, materials and tools and voluntarily abide by the epidemic prevention rules. Officials of the epidemic prevention units across the country intensify supervision and control in public areas to prevent the inroads of the malignant virus, while urging the people to drink boiled water only so as to prevent the outbreak of various contagious diseases in sultry weather. Rodong Sinmun

title: Meetings with War Veterans Held
body: Meetings with war veterans were held by working people's organizations on July 23 ahead of the 68th anniversary of the Korean people's victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War. Present there were Mun Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League, Kim Jong Sun, chairwoman of the C.C., the Socialist Women's Union of Korea, officials and members of the youth league and the women's union, youth and students. At the meeting with youth and students of Pyongyang held at the Central Youth Hall, war veteran Pak Myong Sik made a speech. He recalled that the Korean people won a proud victory in the Fatherland Liberation War by smashing the armed invasion by the imperialist allied forces under the guidance of President Kim Il Sung, an invincible and iron-willed commander. He asked all the young people to demonstrate to the full their wisdom and bravery in their worksites by emulating the fighting spirit of the war heroes. Meanwhile, women's union officials and members met with war veteran Rim Chan Ju at the Hall of Women. The war veteran said the victory in the war was a fruition of the President's outstanding military idea and strategy and tactics, steel-strong courage, will and wise guidance and the outcome of the matchless bravery and popular heroism displayed by service personnel of the People's Army and the people. She ardently appealed to all of the women's union officials and members to firmly trust and follow the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un only whatever happens, and to perform great feats in the struggle for implementing the decisions of the Party congress by giving full play to their strong mental power. Rodong Sinmun

title: State Academic Degrees and Titles Conferred on Intellectuals
body: State academic degrees and titles were conferred on the intellectuals who contributed to the economic development, the improvement of the people's standard of living and the education of the rising generation by devoting their wisdom and zeal to scientific research for implementing the five-year plan, true to the idea and spirit of the Party congress and plenary meetings of the Party Central Committee. The title of Academician went to Kim Haeng Son, a teacher of Kim Chaek University of Technology, and the title of Candidate Academician to Kwak Son Il, a teacher of Kim Il Sung University, Sin Jae Yong, dean of a faculty of Kim Chaek University of Technology, Jang Ui Jun, a teacher of Kim Chaek University, Ri Myong Chol, vice-rector of Pyongyang University of Mechanical Engineering, Choe Jong Su, a researcher of Phyongsong University of Coal Mining, and Kong Myong Song, director of an institute of the Academy of Social Sciences. Professorship was conferred on Jo Kil Hyon, department head of Kim Il Sung University, Kim Hyon, vice-director of an institute at Kim Hyong Jik University of Education, Ri Jin U, a teacher of Pyongyang University of Architecture, Kim Yong, dean of a faculty at the University of Sciences, and Sim Yong Nam, section chief of the Academy of Forest Science, and other persons. Doctorate went to Kim Kyong Ho, head of a department of Pyongyang University of Mechanical Engineering, Jo Won Song, section chief of the University of Sciences, and Yun Jong Ju, a teacher of the University of National Economy, and other persons. 185 persons received associate professorship and 632 master's degree. Rodong Sinmun

title: The Korean Painting "A Cowherd"
body: The Korean painting "A Cowherd" is a typical work of Kim Tu Ryang, a realistic painter of Korea. He reflected its social life in a lot of his art works in the first half of the 18th century. In the painting a cowherd is depicted as a sound sleeper tired from hard work. His body is sunburnt, his hair shaggy and his mouth shut hard. The tails of both his eyes slant up. His thick right arm is put on his head and his left arm rests on the grass. This manifestly shows the uprightness and optimism of his character. In the painting the front part of the unlined summer jacket of the cowherd remains open and his pants is uncorded to expose his belly in his deep slumber. This evokes a smile from spectators. A big ox, tied to the lower part of a willow, is seen in the center of the painting. It seems to chew the cud carefully for fear of waking his master up while the twigs of the willow sway in the breeze. After all, the cowherd takes a nap while his cow grazes. The painting truthfully and interestingly shows the lives of the then diligent and simple Korean farmers. Rodong Sinmun

title: Leading Officials of WPK Central Committee Visit Lodging Quarters of Participants in National Conference of War Veterans
body: Leading officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) visited the lodging quarters of the participants in the 7th National Conference of War Veterans on Sunday. Secretaries of the WPK Central Committee Ri Il Hwan, Jong Sang Hak, O Su Yong and Thae Hyong Chol, Department Directors of the WPK Central Committee Kim Jae Ryong and O Il Jong and vice department directors of the WPK Central Committee visited the lodging quarters to award the participation certificates and congratulate the war veterans put on the meridian of glory. The leading officials of the Party Central Committee said that the significant conference is to be held again to congratulate the war veterans across the country on the occasion of the 68th anniversary of the victory in the Fatherland Liberation War under the warm solicitude of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un who glorifies the war victor generation as the benefactors who shed their blood to defend the country and as wonderful examples of revolutionaries. The war veterans extended the warmest gratitude to the Party Central Committee, hardly repressing their excitement at the profound trust and loving care shown by it. Rodong Sinmun

title: Participants in 7th National Conference of War Veterans Arrive Here
body: The 7th National Conference of War Veterans is to be held in Pyongyang with splendor on the occasion of the 68th anniversary of the victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War. The national conference adds delight to the whole country ahead of the V-Day as it shows the noble moral obligation of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea which puts forward the generation who won the victory in the Fatherland Liberation War as excellent revolutionaries and patriots who devoted themselves for the country and rising generations and the matchless treasures of our revolution. War veterans arrived here on Sunday. Officials of Party and power organs and working people in different local areas had congratulated and warmly seen off war veterans heading for Pyongyang with decorations and medals on their chests reflective of their immortal feats of glorifying the years of defending the sacred country and revolution with great victory. Leading officials of the Party Central Committee and officials concerned warmly greeted the participants upon their arrival in Pyongyang. Citizens warmly welcomed the victors of the great years with high respect at Pyongyang International Airport and along streets of Pyongyang. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Premier Kim Tok Hun Inspects Construction Sites of Dwelling Houses in Pyongyang
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected construction sites in Pyongyang City. Making the round of the construction site for 10 000 flats in Pyongyang, he encouraged the builders creating the new Pyongyang speed and the new myth of construction with a high degree of enthusiasm to devotedly materialize the Party Central Committees' magnificent plan of building the capital city. He stressed the need to scrupulously conduct the operation and command under scientific calculation to suit the construction being accelerated at a lightening speed in three dimensions. He called for paying due attention to the working and living conditions of the builders in the face of the persistent fierce heat. A field consultative meeting reviewed successes and deviations found in the construction and stressed the need for construction units to create a new standard and a new record through the drive to overtake and learn from others and swap experience with one another. It took the measures for responsibly providing building materials and equipment, finishing materials in particular. The premier also learned about the construction of dwelling houses in Taephyong area and called on the officials to work harder, bearing in mind the intention of the Party regarding the solution of housing problem in the capital city as the top priority task. He also made detailed organization for pushing forward the construction. Rodong Sinmun

title: More Fishing Boats Built
body: Several units in the fishing sector are putting great efforts into building more fishing boats. Nampho Fishery Station introduced rational innovations on the basis of the past experience and drastically sped up the ship-building, while positively exploring and tapping the internal reserves. As a result, it built a transport ship of huge capacity. Chongjin Fishery Station and Chongjin Net-weaving Factory completed the design of a fishing boat to ensure practicality on the basis of advanced science and technology, and ensured close coordination between ship-building processes, thus building fishing boats of great capacities. Officials and employees of various units including Riwon Fishery Station built several fishing boats in the first half of the year, and are now expanding the achievements. Rodong Sinmun

title: Korean Women's Heroic Feats Associated with War Victory
body: The history of the great victory won by the DPRK in the Fatherland Liberation War records the heroic feats performed by women who bravely fought to defend the country in response to the call of their leader. During the hard-fought war, the Korean women devoted their youth and lives to defending the leader, country and people, and more than ten heroines and some 20 000 winners of official commendation were produced. In hearty response to the patriotic call of President Kim Il Sung to go all out for victory in the war, hundreds of thousands of women volunteered to join the army in just more than three months after the war started. Serving in different arms of the army during the war, they displayed matchless heroic spirit and self-sacrificing spirit in life-and-death battles. Heroine Jo Sun Ok, a nurse who destroyed an enemy tank through a sacrifice attack at the age of 21, and Heroine Thae Son Hui, the first woman pilot of the DPRK who was called a phoenix, are models of the Korean women. There was also the first women's tank crew who operated a heavy tank, which even men dared not do, to annihilate enemies and contributed to the war victory. Devoted efforts of women for the war victory could be seen at the rear. Heroine Sin Pho Hyang, a worker at the Rakwon Machine Factory, put her heart and soul into making grenades and Heroine Kim Rak Hui struggled to increase wartime grain production, not leaving an inch of land to lie idle. Like this, the Korean women willingly turned out and devoted their blood and lives to the war victory at the crucial time when the country faced severe ordeals The President highly appreciated their role in the war and conferred high titles on them, calling them heroic women and a valorous militant unit without an equal in the world. Rodong Sinmun

title: Patriotic Songs of Era
body: Famous songs of the times have been produced in recent years to implant patriotism in the hearts of all the people. The song "Ode to the Motherland", created in September, Juche 102 (2013) ahead of the 65th founding anniversary of the DPRK, is a treasure song of the nation and a true textbook of patriotism. As the song truly represents all the people's ideological sentiments about their country, it soon touched their heartstrings, bringing together the country and its people as one integral whole. The songs "We Love Our Country" and "Our National Flag" are also patriotic hymns born of the dynamic era. These songs contain profound ideas that patriotism is not an abstract concept but it originates in one's house yard, and that love for one's parents, wives, husbands and children and love for one's native home and job can develop into the love for his or her country and people. Songs "July 27 March", "Respects to Victors of Great Years", "Tell, Fireworks of War Victory" and "Holiday of Great War Victory" were awarded the 60th Anniversary of Victory in the Fatherland Liberation War Order and are popular with the Korean people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Many Youths in Coal Mines Fulfill Yearly, Two Yearly National Economic Plans
body: Scores of youth shock brigades in coal mines in South Phyongan Province have fulfilled their national economic plans for this year, and some of them for the next year. Members of Kang Ho Yong Youth Shock Brigade and Kim Hyok Youth Shock Brigade under the Sunchon Area Youth Coal Mining Complex increased the number of blasting per shift and conducted active movement for helping the next shift, thereby increasing tunneling more than twice and fulfilling the national economic plans for two years. Lots of youth shock brigades of the Pukchang Area Youth Coal Mining Complex, Tukjang Area Coal Mining Complex, Tokchon Area Coal Mining Complex, etc. have honored their yearly tunneling plan. They have registered high tunneling records every day by ensuring that successive drilling and blasting are promptly followed by the transport of refuse. Rodong Sinmun

title: The 4th Power Station of the Huchang Mine Built Anew
body: The fourth power station of the Huchang Mine has been built and gone into production in Ryanggang Province. Consequently, the mine has become able to normalize its production as a base for the production of nonferrous metallic mineral and the families round the mine have been able to benefit from electricity satisfactorily. Scores of years ago President Kim Il Sung gave Ryanggang Province instructions to build many medium- and small-sized power stations and said that power stations with a large generation capacity of electricity could be built by damming the Huju River and its branches alone. True to the instructions, the provincial Kumgang management bureau built a power station with a production capacity of hundreds of kilowatts of electricity across the Huju River. Drawing on this experience it went all out to build another efficient power station. Under the guidance of the provincial Party committee the bureau formed a corps of builders and dynamically stepped up the construction of the power station day and night. The officials concerned took the lead in making a breakthrough in difficult undertakings and organized and directed the projects for the construction of the power station in detail. The builders of the power station worked hard in high spirit of their own accord in response to the great action program set forth at the historic 8th Party Congress and registered one success after another day by day in erecting a dam for the power station. As a result, an electric generator room, a surge tank and a waterway tunnel were well under construction. In close liaison with the units concerned the builders of the power station actively contrived rational building methods and new technological innovations and applied them to their work. Thanks to the hardworking builders the fourth power station was ultimately completed with success. It is the product of the province’s self-reliance. In addition, dwellings as well as a fish farm were also built anew round the power station. The power station runs at full capacity. Rodong Sinmun

title: Poem-reciting Meeting Held by Agricultural Workers
body: A poem-reciting meeting "Tell, Fireworks of War Victory" was held by agricultural workers on Sunday to celebrate the 68th anniversary of the victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War. Attending the meeting were Ri Tu Song, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), Han Jong Hyok, chairman of the Central Committee of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea, Hong Chol Jin, secretary of the Pyongyang City Committee of the WPK, officials of the union and agricultural workers in Pyongyang City. Those who took the stage recited the poems praising the immortal war victory exploits President Kim Il Sung performed by resolutely smashing the imperialist allied forces' aggression with his Juche-oriented military idea, tactics and superb leadership and creating a military miracle to be specially recorded in the world war history. Rodong Sinmun

title: New Facilities Built at Universities in Hamhung
body: A chemical laboratory hall was newly built at Hamhung University of Chemical Engineering and an indoor stadium at Hamhung University of Medicine. The laboratory hall and indoor stadium have laboratory rooms, teachers' rooms, research rooms, physical training room, etc. favorable for the study, scientific research and extracurricular sports activities. Officials concerned made rounds of the laboratory hall and indoor stadium on Sunday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Damage from Drought Witnessed in DPRK
body: A sultry weather caused by the northwest Pacific subtropical anti-cyclone has continued in most parts of the DPRK from July 12, badly affecting the crops. The mean precipitation as of mid-July stands at 21.2 mm, 25.8 percent of the average and the second-lowest one in the records of meteorological observation after 1981. In South Hwanghae Province, the maximum daytime temperature reaches 35 degrees centigrade on an average and some areas witness over 36.5 degrees centigrade since July 20, which makes thousands of hectares of rice and corn fields dry and interferes with the growth of rice and withers corn leaves. The maximum daytime temperature has risen to 35.8 degrees centigrade in Hoeryong City from July 22, leaving corn leaves wilted, and many corn and bean fields in North Hamgyong Province suffer from drought. In Sohung, Junggang, Jasong, Kosong, Anbyon, Hongwon and Sinhung counties, many corn and bean fields got dry to the depth of 5-20 centimeters and the soil humidity of the layer beneath the depth is only 30-50 with an increasing area of fields damaged by drought which is attributable to a lingering sultry weather. The Ministry of Agriculture and the party, government and agricultural guidance organs in all provinces, cities and counties are taking emergency measures to mobilize all manpower and means for preventing crops from drought damage. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Visits Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, visited the Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery at 00:00 on July 27, the 68th anniversary of the victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War. The respected General Secretary was greeted at the spot by commanding officers of the Korean People's Army (KPA), including Pak Jong Chon, Kwon Yong Jin and Ri Yong Gil, and commanders of the large combined units and combined units of the KPA. He laid a flower before the cemetery. He paid a noble tribute to the heroes of the great years who honorably defended the sovereignty and dignity of the country and made the history of brilliantly carrying forward the Korean revolution, burning with boundless loyalty to the leader, confidence in victory and ardent patriotism. He made a round of the cemetery together with the participants. He said that no matter how much time may flow and how many times a generation is replaced by another, the noble revolutionary spirit and heroic exploits of the generation who won the victory in the war would dynamically propel the victorious advance of our people towards a fresh victory of the revolution, steadily stimulating and sublimating patriotism and enthusiasm of the rising generations for struggle. Political News Team

title: Building and Remodeling of Schools Brisk in DPRK
body: The nationwide campaign for building and remodeling schools has been brisk in the DPRK, true to the Party's idea of attaching importance to education. Many schools have been built or remodeled in the first half of the year. In Jagang Province, where a dynamic campaign for building model schools is underway, the construction of two schools has finished and the building of other schools is in the final stage. North Hwanghae Province has finished the structural construction of several model schools. The structural construction of model schools planned for this year has been completed in Anju City of South Phyongan Province, Hamju County of South Hamgyong Province and other cities and counties. The work for remodeling and modernizing schools has also been pushed forward across the country. Remodeling of tens of schools in different parts of the country has been carried out by 70 percent. Pyongyang City has completed the remodeling of nine schools after setting a high goal to modernize tens of schools this year. North Hwanghae Province has remodeled five schools. Thousands of classrooms have been remodeled into multi-function ones across the country. Building and remodeling of teacher's training colleges is also brisk in provinces. Rodong Sinmun

title: No Stone Left Unturned to Withstand Drought
body: The cooperative farms of North Hwanghae Province are all out to protect their crops from drought damage. The officials and working people of Sariwon City and Hwangju County have bestirred themselves vigorously to withstand a drought. The city arranges for all the motor vehicles of not only its cooperative farms but also its other units to be used for transporting water to the fields of the farms. In addition, it ensures that its labor force is rationally allotted and effectively used to minimize damage from a drought. The Hwangju County Party Committee spurs the officials and working people of the county with ideological intensity to work hard as one to overcome a drought deeply aware that it also serves to realize the ideas of the Party and defend its policies. Besides, it sees to it that all the tractors, cultivators and other transporters of the county are used to water the fields of its farms concentratedly. Fully conscious that they join agricultural workers in being responsible for the agriculture of the country, a main sector of its socialist economic construction the officials and working people of other city and counties of the province, too, work in the fields by the sweat of their brows to wet them. The province adopts active measures to sink wells and build pools in great numbers and install tube wells to tap sources of water to the maximum and cope with a prolonged drought. The province reviews the prevention of drought damage in detail every day and makes sure that its officials and working people obviate defects in it and work perseveringly with redoubled courage to resist a drought. Rodong Sinmun

title: Performance Given for Participants in 7th National Conference of War Veterans
body: A performance was given for the participants in the 7th National Conference of War Veterans at the People's Theatre on July 26 amid the deep respect shown by the people across the country for the victors of the great years on the occasion of the significant V-Day. Among the audience were Choe Ryong Hae and Kim Tok Hun, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and other leading officials of the Party and the government. The performance was given by artistes of the State Merited Chorus and major art troupes. Put on the stage of the performance, which started with the playing of the national anthem of the DPRK and the prelude "July 27, Our Victory Day", were wartime songs and other famous songs sung by the Korean people during the years of the struggle for victorious advance. Performers, through those memorable songs, sang highly of the immortal revolutionary feats of the peerlessly great men who performed military miracles of the 20th century in the anti-imperialist revolutionary war and glorified the traditions of invincibility century after century. When the sacred image of ever-victorious iron-willed commander President Kim Il Sung making a historic radio speech to arouse the whole country to the sacred war for defending the country and his image announcing the great victory of the Korean people in the war at the venue of the military parade were shown and when his recorded speech was replayed, the audience broke into stormy applause as a token of their boundless reverence for him. Put on the stage one after another were the numbers representing the transparent spirit of devotedly safeguarding the leader, noble patriotism and do-or-die spirit of defending the country displayed by the generation of the victors, who reliably defended the country and solidified the firm foundation for the country, true to the call of the leader, and their heroic feats. Orchestral music and male chorus "Let's Support Our Supreme Commander with Arms" and "Revolutionary Armed Forces Upholds Leadership of Marshal Only" revved up the atmosphere of the performance as they reflected the deep respect for the great Party Central Committee which opened up the great era of our-state-first principle and built up the matchless and absolute strength of socialist Korea. The performance, which demonstrated the firm faith and will of the Korean people to glorify the history and tradition of great victory of our country, ended with the finale "Holiday of Great War Victory", "Respects to Victors of Great Years" and "July 27, Our Victory Day." The audience and performers were full of strong determination to fulfill their honorable missions and duties in the historic advance toward the new great victory of socialism, true to the leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un who represents the mightiness of Juche Korea and the banner of invincibility. Rodong Sinmun

body: There took place a meeting between a war veteran and workers and members of the trade unions at the Central Hall of Workers on Monday on the occasion of the 68th anniversary of the Korean people's victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War. Ri Ye Chol, who fought as a scout during the Fatherland Liberation War, made a speech at the meeting. He said that July 27, the V-Day, is a precious fruition of President Kim Il Sung's outstanding military idea, original Juche-oriented war methods and energetic leadership and the victory achieved by the ardent patriotism and indomitable fighting spirit of the Korean people who fought, firmly united around the President. He called upon the workers and members of the trade unions to bear in mind the immutable faith that they only know the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, and to uphold with loyalty the idea and leadership of the Party Central Committee.
