title: Participants in 7th National Conference of War Veterans Visit Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery
body: The participants in the 7th National Conference of War Veterans visited the Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery on Monday. The participants laid flowers before the gravestones of martyrs and observed a moment's silence in memory of the martyrs who dedicated their lives to the sacred war for the reunification and independence of the country and the freedom and happiness of the people, true to the leadership of President Kim Il Sung, invincible and iron-willed commander. Looking round the cemetery, the visitors keenly realized the noble sense of revolutionary obligation and comradeship of our Party which exalts the exploits and life of the generation who won the victory in the war, bestowing all sorts of honor upon them. They recalled the immortal feats of their comrades-in-arms who charged for the victory, shouting hurrah for the leader and the country, in every battlefield. Rodong Sinmun

title: Endless Visit Paid to Jonsung Revolutionary Site
body: The number of people visiting the Jonsung Revolutionary Site associated with the immortal exploits of President Kim Il Sung, who brought about July 27 of eternal victory of Juche Korea, is on the increase. In July alone, a number of workers, service personnel of the People's Army, youth and students, including those from Kim Il Sung University and the Pyongyang Automation Appliances Factory, visited the revolutionary site. The site is a significant place where the President stayed from January, Juche 40 (1951) to December, Juche 42 (1953) to lead the Fatherland Liberation War to a brilliant victory and unrolled a great blueprint for postwar reconstruction, while guiding the work of the Military Commission and the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. The visitors laid bouquets and made a bow before the mosaic of the President, the invincible and iron-willed commander and brilliant military strategist who defeated the formidable imperialists and honorably defended the freedom and independence of the country with his Juche-oriented military idea and strategy and tactics and rare commanding art. Looking up to the photos of the President in the revolutionary museum, they recollected with deep emotion the undying exploits for war victory performed by the heaven-sent great man who created the legend of victory to be specially recorded in the world war history by wisely leading the entire Party, the whole army and all the people during the period of the 3 year-long hard-fought Fatherland Liberation War. Looking round the historic data preserved with much care at the revolutionary site, they kept deep in mind the iron truth that the country and people led by the great leader are ever-victorious. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Gifts to War Veterans
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un sent gifts of loving care to war veterans across the country on the occasion of the V-Day. All the war veterans across the country, receiving various foodstuffs and precious tonics, were full of joy leading a worthwhile life of great honor and happiness, hardly repressing their excitement over the loving care shown by the Party Central Committee. The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un made sure that the celebrations and the National Conference of War Veterans take place significantly on the occasion of the V-Day, so as to glorify the merits of war veterans all over the world and put forward them as eternal models to be followed by the rising generations. The war veterans extended humble gratitude to Kim Jong Un for sending the gifts to them again. Rodong Sinmun

title: 7th National Conference of War Veterans Held Splendidly
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un attended the conference to deliver a significant speech On the occasion of the 68th anniversary of the great victory in the Fatherland Liberation War, all the people and service personnel of the People's Army are paying high tribute and extending militant greetings to the respectful war victor generation who performed distinguished service to remain long in the history. The 7th National Conference of War Veterans was splendidly held on Tuesday in front of the Monument to the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War in Pyongyang. Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, attended the conference. Entering the venue, he met the war veterans who had worked at important posts of the Party, government and armed forces organs for a long time to shake hands with each of them and warmly congratulate them. Amid the playing of the welcome music, he appeared at the platform of the conference with the war veterans. The moment, fireworks were displayed and all the participants raised stormy cheers of "Hurrah!" in great reverence for Kim Jong Un who is the symbol of the might of the ever-victorious WPK and dignified DPRK and a banner of all the victories and glory. Warmly waving back to the enthusiastically cheering participants, he heartily congratulated them and other war veterans across the country. Present at the conference were the war veterans and persons of wartime merits, who are the heroes of the great years, as well as the service persons of the heroic armed forces of the Republic, university students and personnel and students of revolutionary schools. Appearing at the platform were Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, Jo Yong Won, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, and Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK and premier of the Cabinet of the DPRK. Leading officials of the Party and government Ri Il Hwan, O Il Jong, Jong Kyong Thaek, Kim Yong Hwan and chief secretaries of the provincial committees of the WPK also took the platform. Commanding officers of the armed forces organs including Pak Jong Chon, Kwon Yong Jin and Ri Yong Gil were also seen at the platform. As the 7th National Conference of War Veterans was declared open, the national anthem of the DPRK was solemnly played. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un made an impassioned and significant congratulatory speech. He extended warm congratulations to all the war veterans, persons of wartime merits and all other people across the country greeting the great V-Day, expressing his pleasure to celebrate the anniversary together with war veterans again. He highly praised the defenders and builders of the country in the 1950s who created the heroic fighting spirit and traits as benefactors and genuine teachers we should admire and learn after with feelings of gratitude forever. He said that it was the honorable mission for descendants of the generation who won the victory in the war to further consolidate and bring to prosperity forever the country, which was defended and built by martyrs, by successfully carrying forward the tradition of great victory and the heroic spirit created under the leadership of the great leader and the great Party. He added that the revolutionary assets gained by the war victor generation at the cost of their lives are firm, and the cause of our state and socialism is bright. He wished war veterans a long life in good health, saying that it is the great encouragement for our Party, the people and our revolution to have them in good health. The participants in the conference were greatly excited by the speech of the General Secretary full of lofty sense of revolutionary obligation and noble comradely love for the war veterans who created the history of great victory of the country. When the respected General Secretary concluded his speech, enthusiastic cheers of "Hurrah!" resounded through the venue of the conference and fireworks were shot off. Watching the brightly illuminated sculpture "Victory" together with war veterans, he expressed his conviction that the great spirit and will instilled by the V-Day would be an eternal impetus promoting the advance and development of socialist construction. The conference ended amid deep gratitude for the General Secretary putting forward the war veterans to the meridian of glory and the single-minded will of the participants to uphold the Party Central Committee with loyalty. The conference demonstrated the unshakable will of our people to make a dynamic advance in the spirit of defending the country and the revolution and in the fighting spirit of self-reliance and fortitude displayed by the heroes of the great years and thus win the final victory of the socialist cause under the leadership of Kim Jong Un. Political News Team

title: V-Day Marked in DPRK
body: All the people across the country and the service personnel of the Korean People's Army (KPA) significantly celebrated the 68th anniversary of the victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War. Many people visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the supreme temple of Juche where President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il lie in state. At the plaza of the palace they paid tributes to the portraits of the smiling great leaders, matchless legendary heroes and iron-willed brilliant commanders who provided a tradition of victory of heroic Korea and glorified it generation after generation. The service personnel of the KPA and the masses who visited the revolutionary sites associated with Kim Il Sung's leadership for war victory deeply grasped the immortal exploits of the peerlessly great man. Working people, youth and students in different parts of the country visited the statues and cemeteries of martyrs, monuments to the fallen soldiers of the KPA and graves of martyrs to pay tribute to the victors of the great years, the proud generation who created the history of new succession of Korean revolution by devoting themselves. Colorful performances were given in Pyongyang and other places. The performers highly praised the great personality of the great leader who led the Fatherland Liberation War to victory with his outstanding stratagem, matchless courage and original art of command, shouldering upon himself the destiny of the country and nation. Working people, youth and students met with war veterans on the occasion of the V-Day. They visited families of war veterans leading a worthwhile life under the warm care of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un to congratulate them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Receptions Given in Honor of Participants in 7th National Conference of War Veterans
body: There were receptions in honor of the participants in the 7th National Conference of War Veterans at the People's Palace of Culture, Okryu Restaurant, Chongryu Restaurant and the Pyongyang Noodle House on July 27. Joining the war veterans at the receptions were leading officials of the Party and the government including Choe Ryong Hae and Kim Tok Hun, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Speeches were made there. The speakers said that word "war victory" uttered by all our people with great pride and self-confidence is always associated with the august name of President Kim Il Sung and also the war veterans, stressing that 68 years have passed since the moment when they were greatly excited to watch the fireworks celebrating the victory in the war. Saying that only when they are led by the great leader, the noble exploits can be handed down generation after generation and worthy life can be eternal, they stressed that the exploits performed by the generation who won the victory in the war are shining further under the loving care of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un who is exerting himself to respect, value and put forward the war veterans and bestow greater glory and happiness on them. They said that the good health of war veterans, personifiers and witnesses of the mightiness of heroic Korea and its history of victory, is the great encouragement to the Party and country, adding that our people would steadily carry forward the noble spirit and tradition of victory created by the war veterans. The participants toasted the well-being of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, who represents our destiny and future, great victory of our ideology and cause defended by the generation who won the victory in the war at the cost of blood and good health and happiness of the war veterans. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Congratulations to Vietnamese President
body: Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Monday sent a congratulatory message to Nguyen Xuan Phuc, president of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un in the message warmly congratulated Nguyen Xuan Phuc upon his reelection as the president of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam. The message said that his assumption of heavy responsibility as the head of state is an expression of great trust and expectation of the Communist Party of Vietnam and all the Vietnamese people. Expressing belief that the friendly and cooperative relations between the two parties and two countries developing on good terms would grow stronger in conformity with the interests of the peoples of the two countries, the message sincerely wished the Vietnamese president good health and big success in his responsible work. Rodong Sinmun

title: Prize for Best Inventors Instituted
body: The prize for best inventors was instituted in the DPRK. The prize will be awarded to the best inventors every year on the occasion of the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The February 16 Science and Technology Prize and sci-tech invention prize have been bestowed upon scientists and technicians who made prominent sci-tech achievements conducive to the development of science, technology and economy of the country and the improvement of the people's standard of living, but the prize for best inventors will go to anyone, including official, worker, clerk and student, who make the best inventions. 3-5 persons will be selected as best inventors every year. Rodong Sinmun

title: Vietnamese Embassy Members Pay Floral Tribute to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: The Vietnamese ambassador to the DPRK and members of his embassy laid a floral basket before the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on July 27, the 68th anniversary of the victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War. After laying the floral basket, they paid a tribute to the statues. Meanwhile, floral baskets in the names of Zhan Xueyan, member of the Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation, and Jin Yongguan, general manager of the Beijing Jinchuan Power Science and Technology Co. Ltd., China, and his wife, were laid before the statues. Rodong Sinmun

title: Young People's Dancing Parties Celebrate War Victory Day
body: There were dancing parties of youth and students for celebrating the 68th anniversary of the victory in great the Fatherland Liberation War in different parts of the country on Tuesday. The events started with the song "Holiday of Great War Victory" in venues in Pyongyang including plazas of the Arch of Triumph and the Pyongyang Indoor Stadium. Amid the play of songs like "Long Live Generalissimo Kim Il Sung" and "Our General Is the Best" the venues turned into the seas of dancers presenting the eternal glory to President Kim Il Sung who created the myth of a shining victory of heroic Korea in the war and Chairman Kim Jong Il who laid an eternal foundation for the prosperity of the future generations with their outstanding ideology and leadership. Youth and students danced, singing the songs pulsating with the fighting spirit of those who defended the country in the 1950s by dedicating their youth and life to their only country. The atmosphere revved up with song "Our Leader Loved by People" singing highly of the honor and pride under the leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un who is glorifying the history and tradition of eternal victory of heroic Korea and leading our style socialism to new victory. Similar dancing parties were also held in provincial seats, cities and counties on the same day. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Visits Friendship Tower
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), Wednesday visited the Friendship Tower on the occasion of the 68th anniversary of the great victory in the Fatherland Liberation War. Accompanying him were Jo Yong Won, Ri Il Hwan, Jong Sang Hak, Ri Pyong Chol, Pak Jong Chon, Kwon Yong Jin and Ri Yong Gil. Amid the playing of the wreath-laying music, a wreath in the name of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un was laid before the tower. The ribbon of the wreath bore letters reading "We pay noble respect in the name of all the Korean people. On behalf of the Korean people, Kim Jong Un." The respected General Secretary paid tributes to the martyrs of the Chinese People's Volunteers (CPV) who joined the Korean people in the Fatherland Liberation War for repelling the imperialists' invasion and dedicated their valuable lives. There was a march-past of the guard of honor of the Korean People's Army (KPA). The General Secretary looked round the tower together with the officials who accompanied him. He said that remaining fresh in the history of the great victory in the war and in the memory of our people are the true militant friendship and matchless sacrificing spirit displayed by officers and men of the CPV who fought shoulder to shoulder with the KPA during the harsh days of the war under the uplifted banner of resisting America and aiding Korea, safeguarding the home and defending the motherland. The noble soul and exploits of the Chinese people who aided the sacred historic struggle of the Korean people at the cost of their blood when the DPRK was undergoing the harshest and most difficult trials will remain immortal along with prospering socialist Korea, he said, stressing that the DPRK-China friendship forged as kindred ties will be firmly carried forward generation after generation on the road for the common cause. Political News Team

title: Commuter Train Runs for Schoolchildren in DPRK
body: Manpho City of Jagang Province is situated on the bank of the River Amnok in the northern extremity of the DPRK. In the city there is a commuter train that runs for the schoolchildren living in remote mountainous villages. 47 years have passed since the train service started. President Kim Il Sung saw to it that the train service began in September, Juche 63(1974) to ensure the school attendance of scores of schoolchildren living in remote mountainous villages. Since then, the train has run between Rimtho Station and Sipridong Station of Manpho City to ensure the school attendance of the schoolchildren. Chairman Kim Jong Il acquainted himself with the operation of the commuter train and sent a new passenger car as the number of schoolchildren increased. Therefore, the number of passenger cars increased and electric locomotive service started. In 2019 the commuter train service extended to ensure the school attendance of the schoolchildren of Samgang Senior Middle School. Visual aids and TVs were installed in the cars to promote the education of the schoolchildren. The commuter train tells about the great loving care shown by the great leaders for schoolchildren. Rodong Sinmun

title: First Workshop of KPA Commanders and Political Officers Held
body: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Guides Workshop The first workshop of the commanders and political officers of the Korean People's Army (KPA) was held in Pyongyang, the capital of the revolution, from July 24 to 27 under the guidance of Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK). The Central Committee of the WPK and the Central Military Commission of the WPK organized a great meeting of military and political cadres of the whole army to further enhance the military and political strength and revolutionary fighting spirit of the KPA, the backbone of the national defence capacity and the revolutionary armed forces of our Party, and to awaken the military and political cadres again to the important military strategic and tactical idea of the Party Central Committee and also to the orientations and policies for the army-building as required by the changed situation. The workshop, the first of its kind in the history of army-building, was focused on developing units, combined units and large combined units at all levels of the KPA into the politically and ideologically steel-strong army and invincible militant ranks faithfully upholding the leadership of the WPK, awakening and encouraging military and political cadres to fulfill their responsibilities and roles as the hard core in carrying out these honorable tasks, and comprehensively rearming them. Attending the workshop were military commanders and political commissars of all the services, corps, divisions, brigades, regiments and members of the executive committee of the KPA Committee of the WPK and officials of the KPA General Political Bureau, the KPA General Staff and the Ministry of National Defence of the DPRK. Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Makes Opening Address for Workshop and Guides First-day Sitting The first workshop of commanders and political officers of the Korean People's Army, which will mark another remarkable milestone in strengthening and developing the Juche-based revolutionary armed forces, began on July 24. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un was greeted by the KPA commanding officers as he arrived at the April 25 House of Culture, the venue of the workshop, to guide it. A military ceremony of respectfully receiving the Supreme Commander of the armed forces of the DPRK was held at the April 25 House of Culture. Kim Jong Un received a salute from the chief of the honor guard of the KPA, amid the solemn playing of the national anthem of the DPRK. The respected General Secretary reviewed the honor guard and commanding officers of the services and corps-level units and glorious colors of the large combined units and met with commanding officers of the KPA. The military and political cadres of units, combined units and large combined units warmly welcomed the General Secretary of the WPK and Supreme Commander of the armed forces of the DPRK who firmly defends the security of our state and people with his outstanding and seasoned leadership and dynamically leads them along the path of victory and glory, extending the highest respect with loyalty. As the respected General Secretary appeared at the platform of the venue of the workshop with Pak Jong Chon, chief of the KPA General Staff, Kwon Yong Jin, director of the KPA General Political Bureau, Ri Yong Gil, minister of National Defence, and commanders of the KPA large combined units, the stormy cheers of "hurrah!" raised by all the participants burst forth. Looking up to Kim Jong Un who proposed the grand workshop unprecedented in the history of army-building and came out to the venue of the workshop to guide it personally, the military and political cadres of the whole army were filled with great joy and excitement of seeing the Supreme Commander whom they yearned and admired awake or asleep at the posts on the defence line of the country. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un made an opening address. The General Secretary clarified the purpose of holding a grand meeting of military and political cadres of units, combined units and large combined units of the whole army as the first meeting of the KPA after the 8th Congress of the Party, saying that the first workshop of commanders and political officers of the KPA is held ahead of meaningful V-Day at a time when all the people across the country are waging an indefatigable struggle for a new victory of the revolution. He stressed that the Party Central Committee gives special importance to strengthening all the services, corps, divisions, brigades and regiments of the KPA in overcoming severe difficulties lying ahead of our revolution and winning a new victory. He extended warm militant greetings to servicemen of the whole army, availing himself of the meaningful opportunity. He added that he has never forgotten the military and political cadres of units at all levels making devotion on the outpost lines for increasing the military capabilities and at sites of the grand campaigns for prosperity of the country and happiness of the people. All the threats will be in vain and our revolutionary advance will be victorious if the divisions, brigades and regiments of the whole army are readied as one, he said, stressing that the commanders of the services, the commanders of corps, divisions, brigades and regiments and other commanding officers and political commissars of the KPA should make redoubled efforts than ever before. He analyzed in detail the operation commanding ability, the level of managing units and political and practical qualifications of military and political cadres. He said that the military and political cadres of the KPA should seriously review their overall work in the units and find ways to overcome shortcomings and deviations while exchanging good experiences, well aware of the intention of the Party Central Committee and the Central Military Commission of the WPK that organized the workshop in a large scale. He stressed the need for the commanding officers and political commissars at all levels to regard the workshop as the best precious occasion for acquiring a deeper understanding of the importance of strengthening services, corps, divisions, brigades and regiments and policy orientation and policies of the Party for army-building, for finding good methods for realizing them and for undergoing revolutionary self-cultivation and training and to make positive efforts to learn more and more. Expressing belief that the workshop would serve as an important starting point for revolutionizing cadres i.e. for preparing all the military and political cadres of the whole army to be the genuine commanding officers of the revolutionary armed forces of the Party and as an occasion of making radical advance in strengthening in every way the operation and combat abilities and political and military might of the units, he declared the first workshop of commanders and political officers of the KPA open. A report was made at the workshop. KPA Vice Marshal Kwon Yong Jin, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, member of the Central Military Commission of the WPK and director of the KPA General Political Bureau, made a report. The respected General Secretary organized the grand workshop of the commanders and political commissars of services, corps, divisions, brigades and regiments of the whole army on the occasion of the anniversary of the victory in the Fatherland Liberation War in the important and crucial period of our revolution, the reporter said. He added that herein lies his noble intention to glorify generation after generation the immortal feats of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in leading the army and prepare commanding officers, the hard-core members of the KPA, to be genuine military and political cadres of the Party's army possessed of high political consciousness, revolutionary style of work and noble moral traits. Thanks to the feats the President and the Chairman, the founder and builder of the revolutionary army of the Party, performed in leading the army, our army could make proud development as the revolutionary army of the Party, he said, noting that the Party and the country highly praise the guard units and military and political commanding officers of the former generations that made brilliant military achievements and performed shining feats by faithfully upholding the leadership of the President and the Chairman. Stressing that the immortal feats of the President and the Chairman in leading the army are shining more brightly under the leadership of Kim Jong Un, another ever-victorious iron-willed brilliant commander and great leader of our Party, state and people, he noted that the KPA has been modernized at a remarkably high speed and has fully demonstrated a-match-for-a-hundred militant spirit and might at outpost lines of national defense and socialist construction in recent years under the outstanding leadership of Kim Jong Un. Analyzed in detail in the report were major shortcomings in the work of units at all levels and military and political cadres in the implementation of the military lines and policies of the Party and the causes behind them. The reporter called on all the participants to strengthen the fighting efficiency of the units at all levels in every way, true to the decision made at the Eighth Congress of the Party and the policy tasks set forth at the major Party meetings, and to step up political, ideological, military and practical preparations for realizing them through the workshop. Speeches were made there. Realizing once again their heavy missions and responsibilities as the military and political cadres of the revolutionary army of the Party, the participants attentively listened to the speeches about experiences and lessons gained in strengthening the units. Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Makes Important Conclusion at Second-Day Sitting of Workshop Speeches continued at the second-day sitting of the workshop following the first-day sitting. The second-day sitting was held amid the high ideological readiness and enthusiasm of the military and political cadres to review their work comprehensively before the Party Central Committee, arm themselves more thoroughly with the Party's military lines and policies and fulfill their heavy responsibilities and duties. Commanders and political commissars of units and combined units who took the floor referred to the successes and experiences in preparing their respective units to be the first death-defying corps for defending the Party Central Committee that inherited the noble spirit of the heroic soldiers in the period of the Fatherland Liberation War, in making soldiers temper their iron fists as a-match-for-a-hundred soldiers, in getting themselves always fully prepared for decisive battles, in improving living conditions for soldiers and in waging grand construction campaigns. Speeches roundly analyzed and criticized the shortcomings that were seen in military and political work such as combat and political training, unit command and management and education of soldiers. The military and political cadres renewed their firm pledge to be genuine loyalists making strenuous efforts to fulfill the Party's orders and instructions and unconditionally upholding the leadership of the Party Central Committee by inheriting the tradition of loyalty and the indomitable fighting spirit left by the commanders of the war victor generation in the proud history of battles of their units. There was an evaluation of exemplary units in increasing combat power, establishing military discipline and improving the living conditions for soldiers true to the Party's military policy. All the military and political cadres who participated in the workshop greeted the most valuable and significant moment which they had been eagerly waiting for with ardent desire. As the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un made his appearance at the speaker's table, the entire venue stirred with excited participants who were to receive the precious army-building theory and great programme from the great brilliant commander. He made a vital concluding speech regarding the important revolutionary struggle tasks of the KPA at present in implementing the line and policy of the Party on army-building, and on the issues presented at the workshop. In his concluding speech, he referred to the purpose of organizing the grand workshop for leading commanding officers of the whole army, the first of its kind in the history of army-building. The first workshop of commanders and political officers of the KPA was organized to decisively raise the roles of commanders and political officers of units at all levels in accurately and thoroughly implementing the line and task of developing the revolutionary armed forces into a powerful elite army set forth at the historic 8th Party Congress, he said. He said that commanders and political commissars of units and combined units are the core military and political cadres who form the backbone of our revolutionary armed forces, and are field commanders and political officers who lead their units in battles according to the operational plan of the Supreme Command. He added that preparing commanders and political officers well and rearming them steadily is a strategic policy consistently maintained by our Party in modernizing the army. Noting that the workshop was organized on the occasion of the V-Day, he said that the tradition of the great victory in the war is what should be kept most dear and what should be brought into reality today, now that we face heaps of unprecedented challenges and difficulties and each one has to be surmounted by dint of strong will and firm decision. He stated that succession of the revolution does not mean merely handing it down to posterity but a succession of the fighting spirit and the indomitable spirit full of vigor. And the great fighting spirit of the war victor generation is something that should be carried forward steadily with great efforts and that should never be left to get blurred or tarnished despite the passage of time, he stressed. In the concluding speech, he laid down the general task for strengthening units, combined units and large combined units. He formulated it as the general task facing the units of the KPA at all levels to turn them into invincible militant ranks that are boundlessly loyal to the cause of the WPK. He said that this meant turning them into a politico-ideological group which is absolutely loyal to and obeys the WPK's idea and leadership, and conducting all the operations and battles, unit management and military service of officers and servicemen according to the policy, way and intention of the Party. He stressed that the KPA is the armed forces of the Party and therefore all the military and political activities should reflect the Party's will, strength and voice and should be aimed at realizing the Party's intention. He clarified the principled issues and tasks to be maintained in thoroughly establishing the Party's monolithic command system in the KPA. He gave important instructions to make every occasion and process in Party political work and military work a course of defending the Party's idea and authority and tightening the country's security at the units at all levels, and to completely establish the revolutionary military discipline of promptly receiving the orders and instructions of the Party Central Committee and devotedly carrying them out. He stressed that commanders and political officers should focus all efforts on completing preparations for actively and offensively coping with any military provocation of enemies, and said this is the highest order given to the KPA by the Party and the revolution, nobody can take their place in implementing it and it is an urgent task which the commanding officers should be responsible for with their lives. Saying that at present the hostile forces systematically keep bolstering up their capabilities for making a preemptive attack on the DPRK and increase armaments while intensifying all sorts of frantic and persistent war drills for aggression, he noted such situation has hardened the determination and fighting will of the KPA to eradicate the root cause of the evil cycle of escalating tensions. He called for all the military and political cadres to put the greatest efforts into bolstering up the combat efficiency of their units, always mindful that the first criterion for assessing their loyalty to the Party and revolution and their practical ability and performance lies in how hard they try to perfect the preparations for correctly performing their wartime operation and combat missions. In the concluding speech, he set forth the detailed tasks for the units at all levels to make their training more intensive by holding fast to the five-point policy for a revolution in the training and the specific methods for them to provide soldiers with better living conditions. Referring to the need to further intensify the ideological education within the army, he said it is important to make sure that soldiers involved in socialist construction take pride and self-confidence in being the creators of the people's happiness, the sentinels responsible for preserving the people's trust in the Party and stones for building a fortress of the single-minded unity. He underscored the need to conduct efficient education among soldiers to give full play to the good traditional traits of the army-civilian unity so that they can always respect and love the people like their parents and brothers and devote their lives to protecting the people's lives and properties. In his concluding speech he specially stressed the need for the military and political cadres to enhance their qualifications, abilities, sense of responsibility and role. He said that the military commanding officers and political commissars wanted by the Party are the ones modeled on the WPK who carry forward the tradition of boundless loyalty to the WPK, possessed of proficient work style and strenuous militant disposition peculiar to the WPK. Noting that loyalty to the Party Central Committee constitutes the very lifeblood and criterion for the commanding officers of the KPA, the revolutionary army of the Party, he called on the commanders and political commissars of the units, combined units and large combined units to become the ones possessed of firm faith and obligations who share the idea, will and destiny with their Party forever and fight tooth and nail to defend the WPK and the revolution whatever the adversity. He added that they should also become the ones strong in ideology and the famous brave generals whose mere names strike horror into the hearts of the enemy. He stressed that military and political cadres should implement, without an inch of deflection, all the military and political tasks set forth at the 8th Party Congress, the plenary meetings of the Party Central Committee and the enlarged meetings of the Party Central Military Commission, and take the lead in implementing them and powerfully mobilize the soldiers in doing so. Saying that the Party spirit and political consciousness are the fundamental yardstick for determining the qualifications of the commanding personnel of the KPA, he specifically pointed out the issue of properly analyzing and addressing all the problems arising in military activities and Party political work in line with the Party policies, the issue of purposefully and consciously endeavoring to have a correct understanding of the Party ideas and policies and keep pace with the Party and the issue of honestly and voluntarily participating in the Party organizational and ideological life. He also instructed them to possess high-degree practical abilities and strenuous militant stamina. He said all the commanding officers should become enterprising military and political cadres and commanding personnel with strong grasping power, who strive to surpass the limits of their current levels and qualifications and make remarkable achievements with staunch courage, strenuous efforts, inexhaustible passion and fighting spirit after setting high goals. He called on the military and political cadres to cherish ambitious courage and disposition to make their units entrusted by the Party famous units known by the entire army and a-match-for-a-hundred militant ranks, plan and conduct all undertakings in a bold way and fully display the self-sacrificing spirit and sense of devoted service. He also stressed that they should get firmly united in the same idea and purpose and in the bonds of kinship to achieve close cooperation between military commanders and political officers and work hard to prepare themselves as paragons of competent work style and noble morality befitting the commanding officers of the revolutionary army. After stressing the importance of the position and duty of the General Political Bureau, General Staff and Ministry of National Defence in strengthening the entire army, he clarified the ways of unswervingly directing and subordinating the Party political work and military work to the thorough implementation of the militant tasks assigned by the Party Central Committee to the People's Army. He underlined the need for all the units to bring about the fundamental improvement in the political and ideological preparation and mental and moral traits of the commanding personnel and soldiers and consolidate the fighting capacity of the units in every way by waging more dynamically the Movement for Winning the Title of O Jung Hup-led 7th Regiment, the Three-revolution Red Flag Movement and other mass movements. He said that the glorious victory tradition of our revolutionary armed forces could be successfully carried forward only by the resolute struggle and devotion of the commanding personnel of younger generation remaining boundlessly loyal to the Party's leadership, expressing the belief that all the military and political cadres would redouble their efforts to thoroughly establish the Party Central Committee's monolithic command system throughout the army and make radical progress in rounding off the war preparations and improving soldiers' living. Finishing the concluding speech, he ardently called on everyone to unite firmly around the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, our guide, with one mind and wage a dynamic struggle for the security and eternal prosperity of our glorious country, for our great people, for the strengthening and developing of the People's Army and for a fresh victory in our revolution. Courteously receiving the precious great programme given by him, all the participants kept in mind his every word with great admiration and excitement and had their hearts burning with boundless gratitude to him who clarified the ways for invincibility. His important concluding speech comprehensively dealing with the outstanding military idea and theory of building a strong army and full of his great trust in and love for military and political cadres and soldiers serves as an invaluable revolutionary document indicating the guidelines for further strengthening our People's Army into the invincible militant ranks remaining boundlessly faithful to the cause of the WPK and into the reliable defender of the country and the people. Intensive Training Course Given for Participants At the third-day sitting of the workshop there was a training course to make the participants grasp the ways of thoroughly implementing the militant tasks set forth by the Party and further developing the military and political work of the units in the same noble fighting spirit and traits as was displayed by the commanding personnel of the guard units in the wartime. The training course dealt with the issue of following the war victory generation's transparent spirit of devotedly defending the leader to make the units a crystallization of devotedly defending the Party Central Committee, the issue of making full preparations for fighting any type of war in the indomitable spirit of defending the country and the heroic fighting spirit displayed by the warriors of the People's Army during the Fatherland Liberation War and the issue of making the revolutionary fighting and living traits created by the war victory generation pervade all the units. The speakers underscored the need for the military and political cadres of the whole army to firmly prepare themselves as those strong in ideology and faith, who know nobody but the Party Central Committee, the first bodyguards devotedly defending the Party Central Committee and resolute revolutionary fighters unconditionally implementing the orders and instructions of the Party Central Committee like the formerly commanding officers of the anti-Japanese guerrillas who remained boundlessly loyal to the leadership of President Kim Il Sung in the wartime. They also underlined the need for the military and political cadres to steadily improve their operation-commanding ability to carry out their units' operation and militant tasks in any circumstances, intensify the combat training of the units, round off the preparations for regular mobilization of the personnel, weapons and combat and technical hardware and establish the strict military discipline. The training course referred to the practical issues for applying the indomitable revolutionary spirit and the stubborn fighting traits created during the hard-fought Fatherland Liberation War to the present military and political work and mentioned the experience of exemplary units. Through the training course, the participants deeply grasped the ways and experience for training their units to be elite ones embodying the Party's military policy and having invincible fighting capability. They were also given the ideological and spiritual food for cultivating themselves and improving their work style and traits befitting the commanding officers of the revolutionary army of the Party. Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Makes Closing Address Amid the great zeal of military and political cadres for making all the units of the entire army the invincible military ranks remaining boundlessly loyal and obedient to the leadership of the WPK, the first workshop of the commanders and political officers of the Korean People's Army closed on July 27 with the fourth-day sitting. As the respected General Secretary appeared in the venue of the workshop, all the participants raised stormy cheers of "hurrah!" as a token of their absolute trust in him and great excitement. The respected General Secretary made a closing address of the first workshop of the commanders and political officers of the KPA. He said that the recent workshop in which all the military and political cadres had a proper and new understanding of the plan and intention of the Party Central Committee and their position and duty and found clear practical ways to bringing about a radical turn in increasing the fighting efficiency of their units served as a significant meeting which provided a new landmark in modernizing our army. Saying that our military and political cadres should redouble their efforts to lead their units, as required by the Party and the revolution, he called upon the participants to strive to complete their units' combat readiness, always bearing in mind that officers and soldiers of the units place great expectations on the commanders and political officers who would come back after participating in the workshop held for the first time in the army-building history. He repeatedly stressed that the commanders and political commissars should further strengthen politically and militarily their services, corps, divisions, brigades and regiments by thoroughly carrying out the fighting tasks set forth at the workshop with high goals and strong will to turn their units into a powerful fortress for defending the revolution and the country. He called on the commanders and political commissars to bring about a radical improvement in the idea, spirit, working style, manner of work, practical ability and moral traits by enhancing their Party spirit and improving themselves, and to completely break with non-revolutionary and non-militant ideological viewpoint and working style. Saying that no matter how severe the current trial is, there is no difficulty or fortress insurmountable or unconquerable, if commanders and political officers live and struggle with the indomitable revolutionary fighting spirit and will of the WPK, he expressed the firm will of our Party to vigorously carry forward the glorious traditions of victory by relying on the People's Army, the invincible revolutionary army of the Party, and the military and political cadres of the whole army. Expressing conviction that all military and political cadres would bring about signal progress in increasing the fighting efficiency of their units by making devotion, bearing in mind the Party's important ideas on army-building and the tasks and ways emphasized at the workshop, he declared the closing of the first workshop of the commanders and political officers of the KPA. Looking up with great emotion to Kim Jong Un, who gave them powerful and practical guidelines for strengthening the units and set forth clear orientation and ways for them to prepare themselves as experienced military and political activists, while energetically guiding the four-day-long workshop, the commanders and political commissars of the units, combined units and large combined units of the KPA took an oath of loyalty to devotedly implement the army-building plan of the great brilliant commander and his strategic intention. The first workshop to be specially recorded in the Juche-oriented army-building history marked a significant occasion in signally increasing the fighting efficiency of the entire army. Political News Team

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Has Photo Session with
body: Participants in 7th National Conference of War Veterans Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, met and had a photo session with the participants in the 7th National Conference of War Veterans on July 29. The participants were overwhelmed by great excitement and joy as they came to have the highest honor and greatest happiness to be handed down from generation to generation after hearing the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's congratulatory speech run through with his profound feelings of respect and trust at the national conference of war veterans held with splendor in his presence. When the respected General Secretary arrived at the venue of the photo session, all the participants raised enthusiastic cheers as a token of their deep reverence for him who projects the war veterans as the models of the era of legendary heroes to be admired by the rising generations and makes sure that their heroic spirit is engraved in the history of the country with golden letters. Saying that the great feats of the generation of the war victors, etched in the glorious history of the development of the DPRK, encourage the Korean people to wage a fresh heroic struggle, he stressed that it is the great pride of the WPK and the Korean people to have such revolutionary forerunners, the great paragons with a lofty outlook on the rising generations and the revolution. He had a photo session with the war veterans, affirming his firm will to do his best to build a prosperous power looked forward to by the wartime heroes and provide the people with the happiest life in the world. At the end of the photo session all the participants again broke into cheers of "hurrah!" He warmly held the hands of war veterans earnestly following him, unwilling to part from him, and waved back to them for a long time as a token of his sincere wish for their good health. Political News Team

title: Reception Given for Participants in First Workshop of KPA Commanders and Political Officers
body: The Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and the Central Military Commission of the WPK hosted a reception for the participants in the first worship of the commanders and political officers of the Korean People's Army (KPA) on July 28. Present there to congratulate the participants in the workshop were members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee Choe Ryong Hae, Jo Yong Won and Kim Tok Hun and members of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and members of the Party Central Military Commission. Speeches were made there. Speakers said the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un, who organized and energetically guided the workshop for the core military and political cadres of the whole army, the first of its kind in the army-building history, to provide important guidelines for strengthening the units, showed unforgettable loving care and benevolence for the participants and made sure that a significant reception is given for them. They earnestly asked the participants to cherish the great trust of the respected General Secretary as lifeblood of their destiny and become true loyalists who unyieldingly carry out the Party's military line and policy through thick and thin. The military and political cadres, who participated in the reception, expressed deep thanks to the respected General Secretary for making sure that they enjoy worthwhile life and honor as the revolutionary soldiers, giving detailed instructions to help them fulfill their heavy responsibilities for the Party and the revolution, the country and the people, and putting his heart and soul into leading them step by step. The atmosphere of the reception halls was revved up by determination of loyalty and sky-high morale of the commanders and commissars of the units, combined units and large combined units expressing the strong impression and excited feelings they got during the workshop. The military and political cadres made a firm pledge to devotedly defend the Party Central Committee, the supreme Staff of the Korean revolution, with arms by strengthening their units into invincible militant ranks remaining boundlessly loyal to the cause of the WPK, cherishing the great honor bestowed by the respected General Secretary. Political News Team

title: Art Performance Given for Participants in First Workshop of KPA Commanders and Political Officers
body: An art performance was given by the band of the State Affairs Commission for the participants in the first workshop of the commanders and political officers of the Korean People's Army (KPA) at the Samjiyon Theater on Thursday. The performance was specially prepared by the artistes of the band, true to the lofty intention of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un to encourage the participants in the workshop of the military and political cadres of the whole army devoting themselves, together with the officers and soldiers of the units in their charge, to carrying out the orders given by the Party in the forefront for national defence and socialist construction. Prior to the performance, the artistes of the band warmly congratulated the commanding personnel of the KPA on their great honor of being given warm affection and important instructions for their development by the respected Marshal whom they missed so much, and of being received by him in the courtyard of the Party Central Committee, the courtyard of the Supreme Command they have deemed dearer than their own lives while standing guard at far-off posts. Put on the stage of the performance, which started amid the feelings of deep gratitude to the respected General Secretary, were the songs which reverberated throughout the proud annals of the Korean revolution which has emerged victorious under the guidance of the great Party, furthering the enthusiasm of our people and the service personnel of the KPA for the revolution and struggle. Strong and dynamic tunes of the songs, instilling stronger enthusiasm into the elated military and political cadres of the KPA determined to develop all units of the KPA into invincible combat ranks remaining loyal to the cause of the WPK, made the venue of the art performance seethe with the strong will to annihilate the enemy and great excitement. Watching the performance overflowing with the fighting spirit of the brave KPA which has developed into the mighty revolutionary army of the Party and invincible one-match-for-a-hundred army under the guidance of the great Party, the audience felt surging immense honor and happiness of being the revolutionary soldiers of the respected General Secretary. The performance, each number of which was run through with the earnest request of the Party urging them to remain true to the pledge they made at the beginning of their military service to keep to the glorious road of defending our great state and people, added to the enthusiasm and courage of the military and political cadres of the KPA to devotedly protect the respected General Secretary with arms and honor their sacred mission and duty for defending the country, the people and the revolution. Realizing once again the deep trust and fatherly loving care shown by the respected General Secretary, who clearly indicated the way of their struggle for fulfilling their mission and duty as commanding personnel of the revolutionary army of the Party and gives them great strength and courage, the military and political cadres of the KPA firmly pledged to contribute to carrying out the cause of building a powerful army of the Party by becoming the commanders and political officers modeled on the WPK who take the lead in upholding the great revolutionary idea of the respected General Secretary and his leadership over the military. Political News Team

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Has Photo Session with Participants in First Workshop of KPA Commanders and Political Officers
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, had a significant photo session with the participants in the first workshop of the commanders and political officers of the Korean People's Army at the office building of the Party Central Committee on July 27, the holiday of the great war victory. The commanders and political commissars of the units, combined units and large combined units were full of deep emotion and delight of having a photo of honor taken with the respected General Secretary in the sacred courtyard of the Party Central Committee, the courtyard of the Supreme Command that they have kept dear in mind awake or asleep in the days of military service for defending the security of the country and the people. When the respected General Secretary appeared, the military and political cadres raised stormy cheers of "Hurrah!" grateful for the strong feelings of affection and warmth shown by the great illustrious commander and the kind-hearted teacher, who organized the large workshop for the first time in the history of the army-building and energetically guided it and thus provided a significant milestone in the glorious development of the revolutionary armed forces and precious teachings for increasing the fighting efficiency and gave them great trust and love. The General Secretary had a significant photo session with them, expressing expectation and belief that the military and political cadres, the core of the revolutionary armed forces of our Party, would skillfully apply the strategic and tactical plan and policies of the Party Central Committee and the best method and methodology of strengthening the units they grasped at the current workshop into the military and political activities and thus thoroughly keep the oath they made before the revolution and strengthen all units of the whole army into the invincible militant ranks boundlessly loyal to the cause of the WPK. As the photo session was over, they broke into loud shouts for devotedly defending the Party Central Committee reflective of their firm readiness and will to live and struggle as reliable brave commanders and commissars loyal to our great Party and to devotedly defend the Supreme Staff of the Korean revolution as earnestly taught by the respected General Secretary. They made a loyal oath to uphold the leadership of the General Secretary with all possible efforts and carry on the dynamic struggle toward a fresh victory of the revolution, cherishing in their minds the moment of honor when they left the immortal photo forming a manifold fortress around the great Comrade Kim Jong Un in the courtyard of the office building of the Party Central Committee, the courtyard of the Supreme Command where the red Party flags flutter. Political News Team

title: Participants in 7th National Conference of War Veterans Leave Here
body: The participants in the 7th National Conference of War Veterans who spent pleasant days under the warm loving care of the Party Central Committee which puts forward the war veterans as the old forerunners of the revolution and great savior of the destiny and future of the country left here for home on Thursday. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un who associates everything dear to our fatherland with the feats of the generation who won the victory in the war added luster to their great heroic spirit and made sure that it is firmly carried forward generation after generation while celebrating the V-Day together with war veterans. Leading officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and Pyongyang citizens warmly sent the war veterans off at Pyongyang International Airport and Pyongyang Railway Station and on streets. The participants in the conference were full of enthusiasm to fulfill their duty as educators who hand over the tradition of victory and fighting traits in the 1950s to the rising generations, always bearing in mind the great benevolence and noble trust of our Party. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Reply Message from General Secretary Xi Jinping
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a reply message from Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC) and president of the People's Republic of China, on July 23. General Secretary Xi Jinping in the message recalled that General Secretary Kim Jong Un sent a message of fervent congratulations at an early hour on the 100th founding anniversary of the CPC to highly appreciate the historic successes the CPC has achieved by uniting and leading the Chinese people for one hundred years. This showed the friendship of General Secretary Kim Jong Un, the WPK and the Korean people with General Secretary Xi Jinping, the CPC and the Chinese people, the message said. It expressed deep thanks on behalf of the CPC and the Chinese people and extended sincere greeting to General Secretary Kim Jong Un, the WPK and the Korean people. General Secretary Xi Jinping in the message also expressed his thanks to General Secretary Kim Jong Un for sending a special verbal message of sympathy to him over the damage by heavy rain that hit Henan Province and other regions of China. Stressing that both China and the DPRK are the socialist states led by the communist parties, the message said under the new situation the Chinese side, together with the DPRK side, will contribute to accomplishing the cause of socialism in the two countries and make positive contributions to providing the peoples of the two countries with happiness and achieving regional peace, stability, development and prosperity by successfully implementing the important common understanding reached by the two sides to successfully defend, consolidate and develop the China-DPRK relations. The message hoped General Secretary Kim Jong Un would achieve ceaseless, fresher and bigger successes in carrying out the cause of socialist construction by leading the WPK and the Korean people, and that his work would go well. Rodong Sinmun

title: War Veterans Enjoy Themselves at Yangdok Hot Spring Resort
body: The participants in the Seventh National Conference of War Veterans enjoyed themselves at the Yangdok Hot Spring Resort before and after the conference under the special benevolence of the Workers' Party of Korea which bestows all favors on war veterans, elders of the revolution, wishing them good health. Under the warm loving care of the mother Party, the veterans visited the fantastic hot spring resort this year, too, as they did last year. They were given full VIP treatment in the whole period of recreation. They, walking along the winding corridor, feasted their eyes on the beautiful landscape, had shower bath and hot hydropathy in the outdoor spa set up in the green pine forest of Onjong Peak, and in the indoor spa that consists of scores of personal bathtubs like Kumdanghwa, pine-needle and medicinal wormwood bathtubs. The resort was enlivened everywhere with veterans who were spending a pleasant time while receiving kind services wherever they go at the resort, including the general service centre full of various kinds of fitness apparatuses and cultural recreation facilities and the egg-boiling site. They sang wartime songs and danced to the tune of folk songs with artistes of the art troupes from Pyongyang that gave colorful performance, and had photos taken. The war veterans from Pyongyang, Sinuiju, Kanggye, Hamhung and Nampho cities and Unjon and Phungso counties received birthday spreads during their recreation period, being warmly congratulated by service workers. Keenly feeling the Party's benevolence getting bigger as the days go by, all the veterans hardly repressed their excitement, saying it seemed they regained their youth. Marshal Kim Jong Un, celebrating the V-day together with the veterans, made a congratulatory speech full of enthusiasm in which he said good health of the war veterans is a great inspiration to our Party and people and a great encouragement to our revolution. Not content with such great trust and loving care shown to them, he had a photo session to be handed down generation after generation and made sure they had a pleasant rest, the war veterans said, bursting out their excitement that such a great man as Kim Jong Un could not be found in any other parts of the world. The war veterans who spent happy days at the Yangdok Hot Spring Resort extended gratitude again and again to the respected Marshal who lavishes warm affection and loving care on the war veterans so that they can remain full of energy despite their advanced ages while leading a life of all happiness and comfort in the prosperous era of the Workers' Party. The participants in the Seventh National Conference of War Veterans were full of enthusiasm to always cherish the great benevolence of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un and fully fulfill their duty as the second generation of the revolution in making the rising generation steadily carry forward the heroic spirit of the 1950s and tradition of victory. Rodong Sinmun

title: Kim Tok Hun Inspects Several Sectors of South Phyongan Province
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the DPRK, inspected several sectors of South Phyongan Province. Looking round farms in Mundok, Sukchon and Taedong counties, he called on officials guiding the agricultural field to take thorough-going measures to prevent damage by persisting fierce heat and harmful insects, being well aware of the importance of farming for this year, and to guarantee stable yield through scientific nutritional cultivation of crops by actively generalizing experiences of leading units. He learned about production at the Namyang Salt Works and stressed the need for salt production units across the country to drastically increase the production by introducing advanced method, regarding it as an important policy task to put the salt production on an intensive, mechanized and modern basis. At the Anju Area Coal Mining Complex, he got himself familiar with issues arising in ensuring stable supply of electricity needed for the mining pit construction and coal production and took measures for them. He pointed to mistakes revealed by officials in the Jangsan Mine who fail to hold initiative and do not actively display creative ingenuity in business management, and discussed the ways for consolidating the foundation for the production of fireproof materials. Field consultative meetings pressed for detailed measures for farms in the province to more scrupulously organize the manuring and cultivation of crops in the latter half of their growth, for economic guidance officials to combine operation and command with practice by heightening their responsibilities and roles and to ensure organic connection between sectors and units so as to invigorate the production. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Sci-Tech Presentation in Field of Pharmacy Held
body: A national sci-tech presentation in the field of pharmacy was held through video conferencing under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea. The presentation on the theme of "Realization of domestic production of medicines and scientification of Koryo medicines" was held to share and widely disseminate the sci-tech successes conducive to producing efficacious pharmaceuticals including reserve medicines and ensuring the domestic supply of raw and other materials needed in the pharmaceutical industry. Attending the presentation were teachers, researchers and medical workers of more than 30 units including Kim Il Sung University, Hamhung University of Pharmacology, the Bioengineering Branch of the State Academy of Sciences and the Pharmacy Research Institute of the Institute of Medical Science. Presented there were over 100 sci-tech successes and treatises gained or completed in the course of research for producing the medicines needed for medical treatment and disease prevention with domestic raw materials and technology. Rodong Sinmun

title: Much Headway Made in Remodeling of Samjiyon City
body: The officials and builders involved in the remodeling of Samjiyon City are pushing ahead with the construction project. Thanks to the efforts of the builders determined to finish the project at the highest level, interior and exterior plastering and roofing of hundreds of houses and public buildings were mainly completed within July. They shored up the bases for producing fittings and bricks while actively introducing technical innovation schemes to expedite the project. They stepped up the interior project of the dwelling houses and public buildings by making a variety of interior and exterior coating materials by their own efforts. They successfully carried out their tasks through the campaigns in which one overtakes and learns from others and swaps experiences with them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Big Successes Achieved in Construction of Dwelling Houses in Komdok Area
body: Service personnel of the revolutionary army of the Party are giving full play to the militant spirit in the construction of dwelling houses in the Komdok area where the best mining city is being built. They are staging a vigorous struggle for finishing the framework construction of the dwelling houses as specified in this year's plan for the first-stage construction. By directing primary efforts to applying rational construction methods in conformity with the specific features of regions and structures, the units involved in the project also provide scrupulous guidance to wage a three-dimensional construction campaign in a blitz war formula. They organize a brisk socialist emulation campaign while rationally distributing building equipment and manpower on the principle of preserving the features of structures to push ahead with the building of retaining wall and infrastructure simultaneously. They also regularly organize a demonstration of good experience and field technical sessions. Thus, several units finished the framework construction of the dwelling houses ahead of schedule. Rodong Sinmun

title: The Korean Painting "A Kingfisher by a Lotus Pond"
body: The Korean painting "A Kingfisher by a Lotus Pond" was produced by Jang Sung Op, a talented painter of Korea who left clear traces in its art history in the 19th century. It belongs to his typical paintings which show his individuality well. The lotus flower, reed, fish and bird, which are often found in and by a pond, were painted with light and gentle strokes in mild color tones to give peace and quiet. The smart ample petals of a big and beautiful lotus flower are painted in the middle of the painting. A kingfisher perches on a thin reed below the petal. The painting graphically portrays the pondscape, the relevant autumn colors, the distinct nationality of Koreans and their love for the home country. The painting was boldly made with single strokes and conspicuously colored so that it can look bright and give a cold and warm feeling. Besides, fish gather round the end of the top of the reed which droops and soaks in the pond. It is mistaken for feed. This proves that the painter was sharp-eyed. Jang Sung Op struck a new path in painting flowers and birds, thus demonstrating the superiority of the Korean paintings based on keen observation, artistic portrayal and the brush. Rodong Sinmun

title: All Out to Consolidate Foundations for Current and Prospective Electricity Production
body: In the sector of the electric power industry workers and management go all out to consolidate the foundations for the current and prospective production of their electricity. The labor and management of hydroelectric power stations fully exert themselves to repair their structures qualitatively before anything else. The Orangchon Power Station 1 and the Samsu Power Station try hard to repair preliminary tunnels for their waterway tunnels and build waterproof breast walls in a short time to prevent even a drop of water from being lost during their electricity production. The workers of the Huichon and Thaechon Power Stations ceaselessly reinforce their dams to secure and store as much water as possible. All power stations make endeavors to maintain their generating equipment qualitatively and take good technological care of it to operate it at full capacity during the rainy season and produce their electricity stably the next year. The Jangjingang and Hochongang Power Stations are all out to perfect further their real-time efficiency measuring systems and their programs for flood calculation which have been applied to them on trial and complete the integrated system for the power control of all hydraulic power stations and thus put their water control on a scientific footing. Thermal power stations, too, do all they can to solidify the foundations for the production of their electricity. Although they were faced with many difficulties in their current production the workers and management of the Sunchon Thermal Power Station worked hard as one to successfully increase the storage capacity of their coal yard in a short time. The Pukchang Thermal Power Complex and the Pyongyang Thermal Power Station make turbine blades and replace their old ones with new ones in concert with the unit concerned. Meanwhile, they strive to examine their break-and-make switches as a whole, find and repair all their bad equipment and augment the output of every electric generator. Power transmission and transformation stations maintain their main transformers, breakers and disconnectors and reinforce their power transmission pylons in the second half of this year so as to put their power transmitters and transformers in normal operation and ensure the thorough stability of their power system. Rodong Sinmun

title: Several Units Fulfill National Economic Plans for July
body: Units in different sectors of the national economy fulfilled their national economic plans for July. Several units in the field of metallurgical industry distinguished themselves in fulfilling their plans. Workers of the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex have carried out the plans for producing pig iron, steel and rolled steel by increasing the operating ratio of the oxygen heat blast furnace, the UHP electric arc furnace and other equipment. The Chollima Steel Complex, the Posan Iron Works and the Puryong Ferroalloy Factory also fulfilled their plans. Miners of the Musan Mining Complex, the Unryul Mine and the Jaeryong Mine increased the production of iron ores by expanding the mining and hauling capacities and stepping up the earth-scraping and deep exploration. Workers in the field of machine industry also took the lead in implementing the plans. Workers of the Ryongsong Machine Complex successfully finished the production of air compressors and other machines by establishing a new casting process for producing different kinds of quality castings, giving priority to the production of materials and propelling the processing of components. The Taean Heavy Machine Complex has achieved successes in producing generating equipment and the Pyongyang Electric Cable General Factory 326 has fulfilled its national economic plan for July by 120 percent. The Kusong Machine Tool Factory, Mangyongdae Machine Tool Factory, the Ryangchaek Bearing Factory and other units also implemented their plans for July. Meanwhile, the Ministry of Railways over-fulfilled the July plan for freight transport. Rodong Sinmun

title: Photo Exhibition Held at Russian Embassy Here
body: A photo exhibition was held at the Russian embassy here on August 3 to mark the 20th anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's historic visit to Russia and the 10th anniversary of his visit to the Siberian and the Far Eastern Regions. On display there were photos dealing with the undying exploits performed by Kim Jong Il and the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un for the development of the DPRK-Russia friendship through their energetic external activities. Present there on invitation were Im Chon Il, vice foreign minister, and officials concerned. Present there were Ambassador Alexandr Matsegora and members of the Russian embassy. Speeches were made. Speakers said that Kim Jong Il's and Kim Jong Un's historic visits to Russia served as important events that made distinguished contribution to further developing the DPRK-Russia friendly relations and ensuring the peace and security of the region. Meetings and talks between the top leaders of the two countries served as historic occasions in providing a new motive power of developing the DPRK-Russia relations and laying a firm foundation for expanding many-sided cooperation between the two countries, they stressed. Saying that it is an important guarantee for achieving the prosperity of the peoples of the two countries to steadily develop the friendly and cooperative relations on the principle of equality and mutual benefits, they expressed belief that the agreements reached at the DPRK-Russia summit meetings and talks would be successfully accomplished by concerted efforts. The participants appreciated the photos on display. Rodong Sinmun

title: Monument to Field Guidance by Kim Jong Un Built in Jungphyong Vegetable Greenhouse Farm
body: Monument to the field guidance by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un "May footprints of love for people left in Jungphyong land shine long" was built at the Jungphyong Vegetable Greenhouse Farm.
