The farm, a gigantic creature on the northeastern coast of the country reflective of loving care for the people, is associated with the undying leadership feats of Kim Jong Un who made ceaseless journey of dedication to the promotion of people's well-being. The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un chose the site for the farm on July 15, Juche 107(2018) and since then visited the far-off and dangerous construction site several times and solved all the problems. Saying that building a modern vegetable greenhouse farm is what he had always wanted to do for the people, he provided energetic guidance to build the greenhouse farm and the farm village as an iconic large-scale vegetable greenhouse farm and model socialist rural village. He led the work to make the farm a land- and labor-intensive modern one that combines hydroponic greenhouse and soil greenhouse, and to push forward the preparations for the farm operation in a far-sighted way. He also illuminated the direction and ways for bringing about a turn in the greenhouse farming and as a result of his detailed guidance the vast sea of greenhouses appeared in the formerly dusty Jungphyong area. He personally attended the ceremony for the opening of the greenhouse farm and cut the tape. He earnestly asked the farm to produce lots of tasty and nutritious vegetables to greatly contribute to the diet of the people, stressing that geographically there are places that are near and far for him but as for the people they are all close to him. With pure loyalty to convey to posterity the undying feats of the General Secretary, the officials and working people of the farm built the wonderful monument with natural granite. Chief Secretary of the North Hamgyong Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea Kim Chol Sam, Chairperson of the Provincial People's Committee Pak Man Ho and other officials of the province and the farm looked round the monument on Tuesday. The officials and working people of the farm were full of enthusiasm to glorify the leadership feats of Kim Jong Un, who have turned the Jungphyong area into the golden land with his ardent loving care for the people, with greater vegetable production results. Rodong Sinmun

title: U.S. Interference in Internal Affairs of Cuba
body: The U.S. has gone to the extremes in its moves to bring down the governments of independent countries. As regards the anti-government demonstration that broke out in Cuba recently, the international community expressed support and solidarity with the Cuban government and people in their efforts for tiding over the crisis. But the U.S. authorities, deeming it a good opportunity for criticizing Cuba, expressed "support for the demonstration", saying "the U.S. stands on the side of the Cubans who claim their right to protest." The U.S. Department of State even announced that it examined options to help the Cuban residents. It clearly proves that the U.S. was behind the recent anti-government demonstration in Cuba. The crisis, a direct product of the U.S. backstage manipulation and persistent policy of blockading Cuba, is the extension of the U.S. conspiratorial moves to topple down the government of Cuba invariably holding aloft the banner of socialism in the Western Hemisphere and to bring down its socialism. It is well known that the U.S. has made every vicious attempt for several decades to overthrow the legitimate government of Cuba and restore the pro-U.S. reactionary regime. The U.S., which had invaded new-born Cuba after the latter's victory of the revolution, plotted hundreds of terrorist assassination attempts against its leadership. It has persistently and desperately resorted to heinous economic sanctions, blockade, ideological and cultural poisoning against Cuba. It has viciously checked the normal development of Cuba by enacting various evil laws including Helums-Button Law and worked hard to foster illusions about capitalism and distrust of their present government among the Cuban people by intentionally tightening and loosening the economic blockade against Cuba. Recently, the U.S. appropriates tens of millions of U.S. dollars for propaganda broadcasting against Cuba one year while getting frantic in psychological warfare for paralyzing the Cuban people's revolutionary consciousness and stirring up their internal division and destabilization, using the Internet as a space for scaling up propaganda against the Cuban government and rallying reactionary elements. The interference in the internal affairs of a sovereign state and the moves for bringing down its social system constitute an unpardonable crime violating the basic principles of the UN Charter and international law concerning the respect for sovereignty of other nations, non-interference in their internal affairs and the right to their self-determination. This can never be an issue confined to Cuba only, now that the U.S. directs the spearhead of attack to the countries aspiring to socialism and makes a desperate effort to disrupt the cause of global independence, the socialist cause. The U.S. tries to bring down the Cuban government and thwart the global socialist cause. Herein lies the gravity of the danger of the unpardonable moves of the U.S. against Cuba. Socialism is an independent option of the Cuban people. No outside force can check the advance of the Cuban people regarding socialism as their faith. The Cuban people will surely win the struggle for protecting socialism and their revolutionary gains. Kim Yun Mi, International Affairs Analyst

title: Foundations for Producing Building-materials Consolidated in North Hwanghae Province
body: North Hwanghae Province of the DPRK is consolidating the foundations for producing building materials with its efforts, technology and resources. The province pushes ahead with the project for expanding the capacity of the Kyongam Cement Factory, putting big efforts into remodeling the cement factories in cities and counties. A base for producing building parts and elements was built at a building materials factory of the province. A granite mine is being transformed into a comprehensive base for producing building stones. The province also pays attention to establishing a line for producing various kinds of finishing building materials with locally available raw materials. It pushes forward with the construction of a general building materials factory. It also makes sure that construction units produce various kinds of finishing building materials after laying their own foundations for producing building materials. Cities and counties of the province built and operate their own bases for producing building materials with locally available raw materials. They vie with each other to produce more roofing materials and paint needed for local construction projects. Rodong Sinmun

title: Title of Model Law-observation Unit Awarded to Exemplary Units
body: The title of Model Law-observation Unit was conferred on the branch of the Pyongyang College of Technology, Janggyong Junior Middle School in Sosong District, the Taedongmun Cinema, the Phyongsong Noodle House, the Wonsan Disabled Soldiers' Bag Factory, the Songdowon Pleasure Park Management Office, the Designing Institute of the State Academy of Sciences and other units. Those units established the revolutionary law-abiding climate by intensifying the socialist law-observance life, as required by the developing revolution, and distinguished themselves in carrying out the Party policies and their revolutionary tasks. A relevant decree of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK was issued. Rodong Sinmun

title: Koreans in Japan Launch Actions for Preserving Their Right to National Education
body: A rally of citizens in Fukuoka Prefecture of Japan took place at Kyushu Korean Middle and High School on July 17 in protest against the unjust judgment made by the Japanese Supreme Court pursuant to the Japanese regime's discriminatory measure against Korean schools. Participants in the rally recalled that Koreans in Japan and students of Korean schools have staged actions in solidarity with the civic and social organizations of Japan to urge the Japanese regime to lift the policy of discrimination against Korean students. They accused the court authorities of turning down the appeal lodged by Koreans in demand of the application of the tuition-free program for senior high schools to the Korean students. They termed it an unjust judgment made at the beck and call of the Japanese regime pursuing the policy of discrimination against Koreans in Japan. They declared that they would stage a ceaseless struggle to preserve their right to national education. Rodong Sinmun

title: Technical Innovation Shock Brigade Movement Underway in DPRK
body: In all sectors and units of the DPRK's national economy, the April 15 Technical Innovation Shock Brigade Movement has been vigorously waged to make a breakthrough in boosting the production by dint of science and technology. As a result, the past few months have witnessed thousands of technical innovations made by many units. The Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex has pushed ahead with the project to introduce new technology into the Juche-based iron-making processes. Thus, a number of relevant designs were completed and many technical innovations made to speed up the introduction. The Musan Mining Complex made scores of innovations to raise the efficiency of the mining equipment and improve the capacity of removing the earth. The Hungnam Fertilizer Complex introduced profitable and efficient innovations conducive to boosting fertilizer production. The East Pyongyang Thermal Power Plant invented and applied several new technologies to establishing the process for producing heat-resistant materials by itself. Members of the April 15 Technical Innovation Shock Brigades of various co-op farms put forward proposals to increase the rate of mechanization in farming and wage a technical innovation campaign to apply advanced farming technology. In this way, they have made a positive contribution to the agricultural development on their farms. The Pyongyang Children's Foodstuff Factory improved the quality of the soy products by adopting new several technologies and the Pyongyang Cornstarch Factory established a new process for increasing the production of ferment necessary for making corn sugar. The Wonsan Disabled Soldiers' Essential Plastic Goods Factory and the Wonsan Leather Shoes Factory push ahead with the research to use the waste vinyl as raw material and made plasticizer and glaze by themselves. Several units established processes for producing quality vinyl sheets and plastic vessels with waste plastic, established the sawdust-based mushroom production process and achieved many other invaluable innovations conducive to the economic development and the improvement of the people's living standard. Rodong Sinmun

title: Expansion of Production Capacity Propelled in DPRK
body: The metallurgical and chemical industrial establishments in the DPRK push forward with the work for expanding their production capacity. The Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex resolves the technical problems arising in expanding its capacity in cooperation with different units. The Chollima Steel Complex speeds up the construction of a gas producer for furnace heating metal materials to be fed into 6 000-ton press. It also puts efforts into reducing the melting time of electric furnaces by introducing advanced technologies in cooperation with a scientific research institute. To attain a long-term goal of drastically increasing the iron ore production capacity in the western area, the development of the Sohaeri branch of the Unryul Mine is underway. Chemical industrial establishments across the country are bustling with the work for remodeling the structure of the chemical industry to put it on a Juche and modern basis. Efforts are concentrated on the projects for expanding the production capacity of the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex, establishing C-1 chemical industry and remodeling the Sinuiju Chemical Fibre Mill. Coal, electric power, machine, mining and construction and building-materials industries also direct efforts to expansion of production capacity, while updating or reinforcing the production lines of factories. Rodong Sinmun

title: Korean Photo, Book, Stamp and Handicraft Exhibition Held in Russia
body: A Korean photo, book, stamp and handicraft exhibition took place in Vladimir Region of Russia to commemorate the 20th anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's historic visit to the Russian Federation and the 10th anniversary of his visit to the Siberian and the Far Eastern Regions. It was co-sponsored by the administration and the legislative assembly of the region. Displayed at the venue of the exhibition were photos showing the exploits of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un for developing the DPRK-Russia friendship. Also on display there were works of the peerlessly great men and photos, books and stamps dealing with the development of Juche Korea and the history of the DPRK-Russia relations and handicrafts associated with the wisdom and talent of the Korean nation. Present at the opening ceremony were figures of various circles in the region, including those of the administration and the legislative assembly, the DPRK ambassador to Russia and his embassy members. Speeches were made at the ceremony. Rodong Sinmun

title: Many Units Win Title of Model Technical Innovation Unit
body: Amid the vigorous struggle to achieve substantial development of science and technology in all sectors and units, over 170 units won the Title of Model Technical Innovation Unit recently. Over 260 units across the country including those units have so far won the title. Among them not a few units won the title thrice and twice. The units that won the title stepped up the work for putting the production lines on a modern and IT basis and carried out a brisk mass technological innovation movement for realizing the home-production of raw and other materials and recycling. They also meticulously organized the work for actively enlisting the spiritual strength and creative enthusiasm of the technicians and skilled workers. By doing so, they strengthened their scientific and technological foundations and potentiality and continuously enhanced the scientific level of the production and management activities. All the technical innovations achieved in the vigorous nation-wide mass technological innovation movement tangibly contribute to opening a shortcut to implementing this year's economic plan by dint of science and technology. Rodong Sinmun

title: Valuable Hi-tech Products Developed in DPRK
body: Educational and scientific research institutes of the DPRK have developed high-tech products conducive to the economic development and improvement of the people's living. Teachers and researchers of the physics faculty of Kim Il Sung University have invented cost-effective, high-performance metal-bonded diamond blades for cutting and grinding tiles or building stones with domestic raw materials and technology. Scientists and technicians of the State Academy of Sciences invented products for practical use in different fields of the national economy. The Electronic Institute invented an automatic nutritious liquid feeder for vegetables to be introduced in hydroponic greenhouses. The Building Materials Institute produced cost-effective vessels needed in the fields of metallurgical and chemical industries and urban management. The Nano Engineering Branch made a new high-speed cracking device to enable the production of binding materials with locally abundant bio-materials. University of Sciences invented a digital omni-directional fish finder that can display various information quickly and accurately. Many other newly developed high-tech products contribute to the development of construction and building-materials industry and improvement of the people's health. Rodong Sinmun

title: WPK Central Military Commission Instructs to Urgently Convene Enlarged Meeting of South Hamgyong Provincial Party Military Commission
body: The Central Military Commission of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) on August 5 issued an instruction to urgently convene an enlarged meeting of the South Hamgyong Provincial Party Military Commission for the recovery from damage by downpour and flood and other relevant instructions. The WPK Central Military Commission issued an instruction to grasp the scale of the damage by downpour and flood in some regions of South Hamgyong Province, immediately restore the damaged roads in the afflicted regions by mobilizing engineer units and set the units of the People's Army stationed in the province on the recovery campaign from damage according to the decision of the provincial Party military commission, so as to finish the recovery campaign as soon as possible in cooperation with the forces of the province. The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un, taking a measure to urgently supply basic materials necessary for the recovery by using the state reserves, issued an order to render powerful national material and financial support to South Hamgyong Province in its recovery campaign. Political News Team

title: Enlarged Meeting of South Hamgyong Provincial Military Commission of WPK Convened
body: An enlarged meeting of the South Hamgyong Provincial Military Commission of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) was convened on Aug. 5, according to an instruction of the WPK Central Military Commission. Present there were members of the provincial Party military commission, chief secretaries of the city and county Party committees, leading Party and administrative officials of province-level institutions and major factories and enterprises, officials concerned of construction and designing fields and military and political cadres of the People's Army units stationed in the province. The instruction of the Central Military Commission of the WPK was conveyed by Chief Secretary of the South Hamgyong Provincial Committee of the WPK Ri Jong Nam. It was mentioned at the meeting that upon receiving the news about damage by downpour in the province, the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un specified the direction and ways for recovery from damage several times and took measures for providing materials urgently needed for it. It was particularly mentioned that the General Secretary set forth it as an important task facing the chief secretaries of the city and county Party committees to pay primary attention to the life of people in the disaster-stricken areas and strengthen Party work, the work with the people, to rally the broad masses closer around the Party under such difficult situation as now. It was also emphasized that he called for awakening and arousing the officials of the city and county Party committees and Party organizations into waging the recovery campaign skillfully and unyieldingly. The meeting heard in detail the scope of flood damage in the province and took specific measures for thoroughly carrying out the instruction of the Party Central Military Commission. The meeting discussed such technical matters as the formation of construction forces to be rapidly dispatched to the relevant areas according to the fixed scope of recovery, the provision of designs on a preferential basis and the transport of materials. The meeting also organized a powerful damage recovery commanding team with leading officials of the Party, administrative, security and defence institutions and military and political cadres of the People's Army in the province. Also discussed at the meeting was the issue of taking emergency measures to promptly stabilize the living of people in the disaster-hit areas, further tightening emergency epidemic prevention work and minimizing the damage to crops. The meeting called on all the Party organizations, people and service personnel in the province to turn out in the recovery from damage with strong confidence that we will surely win if we display to the full the might of the single-minded unity, the army-people unity around the Party Central Committee whatever the wildness of the nature and the manifold challenges and trials. The enlarged meeting of the South Hamgyong Provincial Military Commission of the WPK adopted with unanimous approval a decision on finishing the recovery from damage by dint of the great army-people unity till the founding anniversary of the Party, guided by our Party's people-first idea. Rodong Sinmun

title: Premier Kim Tok Hun Visits Several Fields of South Phyongan Province
body: Premier of the DPRK Cabinet Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, visited several fields in South Phyongan Province to learn about the work there. He looked round units of several fields including electricity, coal, machine, railway transport, building materials and agriculture and encouraged officials and workers in their endeavors to carry out the decisions made at the Party Congress and the plenary meetings of the Party Central Committee through do-or-die practices. He learned about work at the Pukchang Thermal Power Complex and the Tokchon Area Coal-mining Complex and pressed for technical measures to adjust and reinforce production foundation and carry out current production thoroughly based on modern science and technology. At the Inpho Youth Coal Mine, he discussed the expansion of coaling capacity. At the Sungri General Motor Enterprise, he stressed the need to perfectly ensure technical conditions according to each process and increase the quality of vehicles. At the Pukchang Railway Sub-bureau, he stressed the need to consolidate its own material and technical foundation and drastically improve the transport of coal for thermal power stations. At the Sunchon Cement Complex, he called for increasing production and expanding capacity at the same time. Field consultative meetings called on all the officials to bring about innovation in economic operation and command and business management to meet the requirement of reality, ensure close cooperation between relevant fields and units and pay deep attention to the logistic supply for employees, bearing in mind that the implementation of the Party's decisions and progress of their own fields and units depend on their responsibilities and roles. The premier learned about immediate farming at several co-op farms in Pukchang County and Tokchon City and the preparations to prevent damage by flood and rainy wind, and took measures. At the Sunchon Pharmaceutical Factory, he discussed the ways of producing and supplying sufficient amount of essential medicines. He also visited the Posan Iron Works where he called for drastically increasing Juche iron production. At the construction site for 10 000 flats in Pyongyang, he reviewed the state of current construction and provision of raw materials and equipment by ministries and national institutions and pressed for measures for pushing forward the next-stage project. Rodong Sinmun

title: Tougher Measures Taken to Prevent Damage from Downpour and Flood
body: Efforts are directed to preventing damage from downpour and flood in the fields of electric power and coal industries. Officials and working people in the field of electric power industry, checking every measure taken, are taking thoroughgoing measures from the viewpoint that any slightest negligence should not be allowed in preventing natural disasters. Thermal power plants across the country are taking timely measures while ascertaining whether there is any imperfection. They are pushing ahead with the prevention of damage, focusing efforts on protecting coal yards, coal-conveying system, outdoor electric power substations, pumping stations, etc. Hydro-power stations are checking the state of sluice gates and having mechanisms and communication equipment full prepared to ensure smooth opening and shutting of sluice gates. Power distribution units are keeping an itinerant check on power-transmission towers, power transformers and transmission lines in a responsible manner and taking immediate measures against abnormal points. Officials and miners in the field of coal industry have rebuilt watertight walls against dangerous spots like once-waterlogged pits, while meticulously cleaning out waterways in the pits. The urban management field dynamically carries out the work for preventing damage from downpour and flood on the principle of giving priority to the convenience of people, while scrutinizing possible situations to be entailed by downpour and flood. Rodong Sinmun

title: Photo Exhibition and Seminar Held at DPRK Embassy in Moscow
body: A photo exhibition and seminar were held at the DPRK embassy in Moscow on August 5 to commemorate the 20th anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's historic visit to the Russian Federation and the 10th anniversary of his visit to the Siberian and Far Eastern Regions. Present there were the DPRK ambassador to Russia and his embassy members and figures of the Russian government, political parties, organizations and institutions including the Foreign Ministry, the State Duma, the Party for Peace and Unity of Russia, the "Orchestra of the 21st Century", the Russian Association for Friendship and Cultural Cooperation with the DPRK, the Association for the Study of the Juche Idea and the Korean War Veterans' Council. The participants laid bouquets and made a bow before the art work at the embassy depicting President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il standing together. Then they looked around the photo exhibition hall. Displayed at the hall were photos dealing with the exploits performed by Chairman Kim Jong Il and the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un to strengthen and develop the DPRK-Russia friendship. Also on display there were photos showing the development of our Republic. There was a seminar. The director of the Asia 1 Department of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs noted that the development of the bilateral relations in many fields conforms to the interests of the Russian and Korean peoples, praising the exploits of Chairman Kim Jong Il and the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un in the development of the DPRK-Russia relations. The secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation who is also the head of the Russia-DPRK Friendship Parliamentary Group of the State Duma of Russia said that the visit to Russia by Chairman Kim Jong Il who is an outstanding politician served as an important landmark in the modern political history of the two countries and as a significant occasion of providing a firm foundation for the establishment of the strategic partnership. The chairperson of the Party for Peace and Unity of Russia expressed pleasure over the successful inheritance of the revolutionary cause of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il by Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea. The head of the Orchestra of the 21st Century of Russia recalled how he admired at the profound knowledge of all sectors, including politics, economy and culture, possessed by Kim Jong Il, when meeting him. He pledged to work hard for the cultural exchange between the two countries in the future. Rodong Sinmun

title: Rabbit-Breeding Brisk in DPRK
body: Rabbit-breeding has gained momentum as an all-people movement across the country. All units in North Hamgyong Province direct efforts into laying material and technical foundations essential to the rabbit-breeding, and broadly generalize the experience of the units which are registering successes in the rabbit-breeding. North Phyongan Province actively promotes rabbit-breeding by meaningfully organizing workshops. It has increased the number of rabbits through education on seasonal tending of rabbits. Pyongyang City set realistic step-wise goals for rabbit-breeding and applies reasonable ways to meticulously carry out socialist emulation drives, thus raising the public awareness of rabbit-breeding. Other provinces continuously direct efforts into remarkably lowering the contraction rate of diseases and mortal rate through steady enhancement of the level of caretakers, and into preventing the rabbit diseases with the use of preventive and other medicines made from raw materials abundant in local areas, thus registering a good result. Rodong Sinmun

title: More Achievements Made in Building Dwellings in DPRK
body: More successes have been registered in constructing 10 000 flats in Pyongyang, the Pothong Riverside Terraced Residential District and the dwellings in Komdok area. Those involved in building 10 000 flats create a new Pyongyang speed and construction myth. The headquarters put great efforts into the build-up of the builders, supervisory staff and skilled builders and into giving precedence to the supply of building materials. A proactive plan is being carried out to push forward with the dwelling-building project without any slightest deviation in the rainy season, in particular. Soldier-builders positively explore and introduce rational work methods in order to increase the speed and quality of the project, thereby scoring great successes every day. They make sure plastering is done qualitatively by inventing and applying new building tools. More successes are being registered in the construction site for the Pothong Riverside Terraced Residential District vibrant with militant and mobile art performances, loud-speaker agitation, etc. More reports about successes in building dwellings in Komdok area have also been aired. Solider-builders, who finished the first-stage frame project for this year and started the second-stage construction project, have completed the foundation work through a nonstop campaign. Rodong Sinmun

title: Pipha Seal Registered as Natural Monument
body: Recently, the Pipha seal was registered as a natural monument in the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. In Rason City, there is a cape named after pipha (Korean mandolin) for its appearance. Cape Pipha is rich in marine products and serves as a habitat of seals. The Pipha seal is 1.5 to 2 meters long, weighs 120 to 150 kilograms and inhabits Cape Pipha from spring and autumn every year, feeding on fish and cephalopod like octopus and squid. As the Pipha seal was registered as natural monument, its protection came to be carried out amid national concern. The protection of endangered and rare species like useful animals has been brisk in the DPRK from long ago. Rodong Sinmun

title: Cement for Recovery Project Arrived in South Hamgyong Province
body: Cement for the reconstruction of flood-hit areas arrived in South Hamgyong Province. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un saw to it that the Central Military Commission of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) issued an order to powerfully propel the reconstruction project in South Hamgyong Province by dint of the great army-civilian unity and render powerful national financial and material support to the provincial recovery campaign. He clarified in detail the orientations and ways for the reconstruction several times and took a measure to urgently allocate a share of the state reserves for supplying basic materials necessary for the recovery project. The officials, working people and service personnel of the province are waging an all-out recovery campaign, being convinced that they will surely emerge victorious by dint of the single-minded unity and the army-civilian unity in which people and service personnel are closely rallied behind the Party. Rodong Sinmun

title: The Souvenir Stone Slabs from Progressive Mankind
body: The Tower of the Juche Idea soars high on the bank of the Taedong River opposite the Kim Il Sung Square in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK. It is the highest stone tower in the world. It was erected and unveiled in April 1982 on the occasion of the 70th birthday of President Kim Il Sung. Enslaved by the Juche idea a large number of precious and rare stone slabs have so far been donated to the tower for about half a century by heads of state of many foreign countries, foreign political Parties and organizations, international organizations, and personages from all social strata, including political and public figures. The 300-odd stone slabs from over 100 countries have been fixed to the walls of the anteroom to the tower’s stylobate. Each of the stone slabs manifests the desire of progressive mankind for an independent new world brightly illuminated by the Juche idea. Rodong Sinmun

title: State Emergency Measures Taken to Recover from Flood Damage in DPRK
body: State emergency measures are taken to eradicate the aftermath of flood and heavy rain as soon as possible in the DPRK. The central team for guiding the project for recovery from flood damage is staffed by officials of the Cabinet, ministries and national institutions. The team scrupulously organizes the work for acquainting itself with the problems arising in powerfully backing the reconstruction project in several disaster-hit areas in South Hamgyong Province and other regions and for taking timely measures for resolving them on the spot. Prompt measures are taken to stabilize the life of the residents in the flood-hit areas. Ministries took steps for providing the people with food, non-staple food, condiments and others. Necessary medicines are being supplied and the quality of drinking water thoroughly ensured to prevent various diseases. Hundreds of medical workers were urgently dispatched to the disaster-stricken areas to conduct medical examination and treatment for the residents and builders. They further intensify the emergency epidemic prevention work with adequate disinfectants and epidemic prevention tools. Officials of ministries and national institutions sent the aid materials they prepared with sincerity to share sorrow with the people in the disaster-hit areas, thus giving full play to the fine traits of helping and caring for one another more sincerely at a time of hardship, which prevail in society. The reconstruction campaign gets brisk. While making a field survey, officials of the State General Bureau of Design push ahead with drawing up the arrangement plans and designs for the dwelling houses to be built in the flood-hit areas and providing technical manuals urgently needed for the reconstruction of damaged structures. Rodong Sinmun

title: Kim Yo Jong, Vice-department Director of WPK Central Committee, Issues Press Statement
body: Kim Yo Jong, vice-department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), issued the following press statement Tuesday: The U.S. and the south Korean army desperately started joint military exercises further accelerating the instable situation despite the unanimous denunciation and rejection at home and abroad. The joint military exercises are divided into an "exercise of the staff for crisis control" from Aug. 10 to 13 and a "combined command exercise" from Aug. 16 to 26. They are the most vivid expression of the U.S. hostile policy towards the DPRK, designed to stifle our state by force, and an unwelcoming act of self-destruction for which a dear price should be paid as they threaten the safety of our people and further imperil the situation on the Korean peninsula. The dangerous war exercises pushed ahead by the U.S. and the south Korean side disregardful of our repeated warnings will surely make them face more serious security threat. Whatever the scale and mode, the joint military exercises are of aggressive nature as they are a war rehearsal and preliminary nuclear war exercise for further rounding off the preparations for putting into practice the operational plan with the preemptive strike at us as the gist. Every March and August, military tension and the danger of conflict flare up in and around the Korean peninsula due to the war frenzy of the U.S. and south Korea. Now the U.S. doggedly pushes forward with the aggression war drills at such a sensitive time as now when the international eyes are focused on the development of the situation on the peninsula. It is indeed a chief architect destroying peace and stability in the region. This also proves that "diplomatic engagement" and "dialogue with no strings attached" touted by the present U.S. administration is hypocrisy to cover up its aggressive nature. The prevailing situation proves once again that we were quite just when we decided to steadily build up the capabilities for national defence. For peace to settle on the peninsula, it is imperative for the U.S. to withdraw its aggression troops and war hardware deployed in south Korea. As long as the U.S. forces stay in south Korea, the root cause for the periodic aggravation of the situation on the Korean peninsula will never vanish. The reality proves that only substantial deterrent, not words, can ensure the peace and security of the Korean peninsula, and that it is a vital requirement for us to build up the force powerful enough to fully contain the external threats to us. We have already clarified that we will counter the U.S. on the principle of power for power and goodwill for goodwill. We will put more spur to further increasing the deterrent of absolute capacity to cope with the ever-growing military threats from the U.S., i.e. the national defence capabilities and powerful preemptive strike for rapidly countering any military actions against us. Availing myself of this opportunity, I would like to express my deep regret at the perfidious behavior of the south Korean authorities. I release this press statement upon authorization. Rodong Sinmun

title: All-out Campaign for Recovery from Flood Damage Launched in South Hamgyong Province
body: Officials, people and service personnel in South Hamgyong Province turned out in the campaign for eradicating the aftermath of natural disaster as soon as possible, true to the order issued by the Central Military Commission of the Workers' Party of Korea. The roads destroyed by heavy rain and flood are being restored. In order to restore the road between Yonggwang County and Sinhung County, units of the Korean People's Army are rebuilding broken embankments while increasing the operation rate of building machines. The might of the army-people great unity is being fully displayed in the campaign for restoring roads. Construction of dwelling houses is underway in the disaster-hit areas. Leading officials of city and county Party committees brought the field investigation teams in their charge to the disaster-hit areas to learn in detail about the situation. Construction forces were formed in cities and counties and dispatched to relevant areas. Underway is the work for fixing the sites of dwelling houses and public buildings and quickly finish the designing. Relevant units strive to produce and supply wood, various plastic tubes, fittings, titles and others. Support for the people in the disaster-hit areas gets brisk. Officials of the provincial organs visit the disaster-hit areas to relieve the troubles of people. Aid materials associated with the sincerity of people in other parts of the province are being sent to the disaster-hit areas. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Premier Inspects Flood-hit Areas in South Hamgyong Province
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected the flood-hit areas in South Hamgyong Province to learn about the recovery campaign. Looking round the flood-afflicted areas in Yonggwang, Sinhung and Hongwon counties and Tanchon City, he inspired the service personnel of the People's Army and people in the province who are fully displaying the might of the great army-civilian unity in their dynamic recovery campaign to thoroughly implement the instruction given by the Party Central Military Commission and the decision made at the enlarged meeting of the South Hamgyong Provincial Military Commission. Learning about the living conditions of the flood victims, he stressed the need for the officials of the province to relieve the troubles of the victims in time while sharing pain with them, bearing in mind the Party Central Committee's intention of paying primary attention to the living of the people in the disaster-hit areas. The field consultative meeting discussed in detail the issue of frequently inquiring and solving the problems arising in the recovery campaign by ensuring the on-the-spot operation and command by the central team for guiding the project for recovery from flood damage, the issue of taking urgent measures for minimizing the damage to crops in the inundated fields and the issue of making preparations to cope with future heavy rain and flood. Meanwhile, the premier visited the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex, the Ryongsong Machine Complex and the February 8 Vinalon Complex playing important roles in attaining the goals for the first year in implementing the five-year plan. He took practical measures for putting their production on a normal basis and pushing ahead with reinforcing and expanding their production foundations. Rodong Sinmun

title: Pukchong Pig Farm Inaugurated
body: Pukchong Pig Farm has been newly built in the DPRK. The farm has feed and meat processing lines, conveyance system, process of producing organic fertilizers, etc. And the ring-shaped rotation production system is established at the farm. Officials of South Hamgyong Province and Pukchong County walked round the newly built farm. Rodong Sinmun

title: The Korean Painting "The Blacksmith’s"
body: The Korean painting "The Blacksmith’s" was made by Kim Hong Do, a famous painter of Korea who lived in the 18th century. The painting vividly and truthfully depicts simple and diligent smiths forging and finding joy in their work. A man, who is apparently the doyen, takes and adjusts a lump of iron with a pair of tongs. His attention is focused on his work, his mouth slanted. Meanwhile, a bushy-whiskered man has just struck the lump on an anvil forcefully with his sledge. Another man is wielding his sledge, his weight concentrated on his right leg. A cucullate young man is simultaneously blowing with bellows in high spirits while a boy is whetting his sickle on a stone near by his A-frame carrier he has just seemed to put on the floor off his shoulders. The blacksmith’s vibrates with life and energy so even pleasing rhythms in the work of smiths are sensed tangibly. The painter composed the painting perfectly and applied graphic masterly strokes and confident lines to it. Consequently, it clearly manifests his excellent portraying skills. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Congratulatory Messages and Letters from Foreign Personages
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received congratulatory messages and letters from different countries on the occasion of the 68th anniversary of the Korean people's victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War. They include the chairperson of the Bangladesh Jatiya Party, the chairman of the Hungarian Workers' Party, the general secretary of the Central Committee of the Czechoslovak Communist Party, the general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party-21 of the Czech Republic, the secretary of the Central Committee of the Slovak Communist Party, the vice-chairman of the Socialist Freedom Party of Egypt and the first vice-chairman of the United Socialist Party of Venezuela. They also include high-ranking personages of political, public and economic circles and military and representatives of organizations for the study of the Juche Idea and organizations for supporting Korea's reunification and friendship organizations in China, Russia, Bangladesh, the Philippines, Japan, Belarus, Switzerland, the Czech Republic, Austria, South Africa, Angola, Peru and Ecuador. Rodong Sinmun

title: Meeting of Workers and Trade Union Members Observes Anniversary of National Liberation
body: Workers and members of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea (GFTUK) met at the Central Hall of Workers on Thursday to celebrate the 76th anniversary of President Kim Il Sung's accomplishment of the historic cause of national liberation. Attending the meeting were Ri Tu Song, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), Hong Chol Jin, secretary of the Pyongyang City Committee of the WPK, officials of the trade union, workers and members of the trade union in Pyongyang City. Pak In Chol, chairman of the C.C., GFTUK, made a report at the meeting. His report was followed by speeches made by Kim Yong Gil, chairman of the trade union of Kim Il Sung University, Ryo Kyong Hui, a lecturer of the Korean Revolution Museum, and Hwang Ho Chol, a worker at the Mangyongdae Aeguk Aluminum Sash Factory. The reporter and speakers said that the great event of national liberation is the brilliant victory won thanks to the transparent independent idea and faith of President Kim Il Sung, noting that all the people across the country celebrate the 76th anniversary of national liberation with great national pride. They noted that the proud history and traditions of the Republic founded by President Kim Il Sung and developed by Chairman Kim Jong Il are steadily carried forward under the outstanding and tested guidance of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. They called for adding eternal luster to the revolutionary tradition of Mt Paektu and fully demonstrating the militant power of the heroic working class in the ongoing advance for ushering in an era of fresh upsurge in socialist construction, true to the idea and leadership of Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Oratorical Meeting of Youth and Students Held
body: An oratorical meeting of youth and students was held at the Central Youth Hall on August 13 in celebration of the 76th anniversary of Korea's liberation. Performers loudly praised the immortal exploits of President Kim Il Sung who accomplished the historic cause of national liberation while waging a hard-fought struggle against the Japanese imperialists. They expressed in an excited tone the unanimous will of young vanguard to fully demonstrate the might of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League in the historic advance towards fresh victory of revolution, regarding the revolutionary traditions of Paektu as their eternal lifeline. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un ascended Mt Paektu on horseback despite the harsh winter in the northern part of the country, demonstrating before the world Juche Korea's spirit of advance. It was a significant occasion that brought about a signal turn in educating people in the revolutionary traditions and arming them with the revolutionary spirit, they said. They called for making a tangible contribution to the prosperity of the country, keeping deep in mind the devoted service for the people's wellbeing provided by the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un who devotes his all to the wellbeing of the people, believing in the people as in Heaven. Attending the meeting were Ri Tu Song, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Mun Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League, officials of the league, youth and students in Pyongyang. Rodong Sinmun

title: Agricultural Workers in DPRK Commemorate Anniversary of National Liberation
body: Agricultural workers and members of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea met at the Jangchon Vegetable Cooperative Farm in Sadong District, Pyongyang City to commemorate the 76th anniversary of national liberation. At the meeting, Han Jong Hyok, chairman of the Central Committee of the Union, made a report to be followed by speeches. The reporter and speakers said that the national liberation brought about by President Kim Il Sung was a great event which put an end to the distress-torn history of the Korean nation and made a fundamental turn in carving out the destiny of the Korean people. The anti-Japanese revolutionary war, in which bloody life-or-death battles were fought against the brigandish Japanese imperialists in such worst conditions as having no state backing and support of a regular army, was the most arduous and harshest one against imperialism unprecedented in the world war history, they said. They stressed that the revolutionary exploits of the President, who saved the country and the nation from the fate of colonial slaves and set a world-historic example of the struggle for national liberation by leading the anti-Japanese war to victory, will shine forever. They expressed their determination to make tangible contributions to hastening the accomplishment of the socialist cause by thoroughly carrying out the important tasks set forth at the 8th Party Congress and plenary meetings of the Party Central Committee, fully demonstrating the dignity and mettle of Kim Il Sung's and Kim Jong Il's Korea under the leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. Attending the meeting were Hong Chol Jin, secretary of the Pyongyang City Party Committee, officials of the union and agricultural workers. Rodong Sinmun

title: Performance Given by Art Squad of Central Committee of Women's Union
body: The art squad of the Central Committee of the women's union gave a performance at the Hall of Women on Friday to commemorate the 76th anniversary of national liberation. Among the audience were Ri Tu Song, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), Kim Jong Sun, chairwoman of the Central Committee of the women's union, Hong Chol Jin, secretary of the Pyongyang City Committee of the WPK, and officials and members of the union in Pyongyang City. The performance, which started with chorus "Long live Generalissimo Kim Il Sung", sang highly of the exploits of President Kim Il Sung who achieved the historic cause of national liberation by leading the 20-year anti-Japanese revolutionary war to victory. Put on the stage were the numbers reflecting the people's profound reverence for Chairman Kim Jong Il who continued his high-intensity forced march all his life, holding aloft the red flag of the revolution out of his unshakable will to successfully carry forward and accomplish the revolutionary cause of Juche pioneered on Mt Paektu. The performance, which ended with poem and chorus "We Will Go to Mt Paektu" and "Marshal Is among People", vividly represented the strong enthusiasm of the women across the country to firmly equip themselves with the revolutionary traditions of Paektu and accelerate the advance and development of Korean-style socialism, true to the leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Baskets to Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un from Members of Board of Directors of Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received floral baskets Friday from Sai Tiejen, honorary vice-chairman of the Board of Directors of the Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation, and its Honorary Directors Cui Tongwen, Qiu Jianliang and Qiu Shuibo on the occasion of the 76th anniversary of Korea's liberation. On the same day Kim Jong Un received floral baskets from the China Dandong Branch of the Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation and Lin Gennan, member of the foundation. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Baskets to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Floral Baskets were sent to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill from the family of Kim Sun Ok who is related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, Sha Yunzhu, director of the board of directors of the international martial arts foundation, and his wife and Ibrahim Mantu, chairman of the Nigeria-Korea Friendship Association, on the occasion of the 76th anniversary of Korea's liberation. The floral baskets were laid before the statues on Friday. On the same day, a floral basket was sent to the statues of the President and the Chairman from the Association of Korean Nationals in Dandong City of China. Rodong Sinmun

title: Korean Committee on Measures for Sexual Slavery for Japanese Army and Drafting Victims Issues Statement
body: The Korean Committee on Measures for the Sexual Slavery for Japanese Army and Drafting Victims issued the following statement on Sunday on the lapse of 76 years since the defeat of the Japanese imperialists who had inflicted misfortune and pain upon hundreds of millions of people of Korea and other Asian countries: Traces of plunder and massacre committed by the Japanese imperialists have faded away and the generation of the victims has been replaced for over half a century, but still running deep in the memory of people are the pains which are conveyed generation after generation, unforgotten and unhealed. More than 8.4 million innocent Korean people were forced into animal-like slavery at the war theaters, labor sites and "comfort stations" of the Japanese imperialists and over one million were mercilessly killed under the Japanese imperialists' massacre and plunder. Still kept buried everywhere in Asia where the feet of the Japanese imperialist aggression forces reached and even under the sea, to say nothing of in Japan, are remains of the Korean people who met grievous deaths. With nothing can their grievance be relieved. Problem is that Japan, imposer of irrevocable horrendous damage, has done nothing to redress its crimes against our people up to now since its defeat. Far from making apology and repentance of the crimes against humanity committed by the Japanese imperialists, Japan has adopted mean hostile policy toward the DPRK, has extended sanctions against it year after year and exposed the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan and Korean nationals in Japan to unreasonable political suppression and discrimination and resorted to the brazen-faced acts of embellishing and justifying the past crimes. Just a few months ago, the Japanese government at a Cabinet ministers' meeting said it is inappropriate to describe mobilization of workers to Japan proper from the Korean peninsula during the Second World War as forced drafting, and at the 47th UN Human Rights Council it termed the forced recruiting of "comfort women" by the Imperial Japanese Army a cooked-up story. This clearly proves that Japan carries no guilty conscience for its past history of aggression, and instead it has become all the more reckless to return to its position in the past when it professed the "leader of Asia". It is a legal responsibility and moral obligation bounden to Japan to properly repent of and fully settle the aggression and unethical crimes against our country and people and other people in Asia. We will certainly take stock of how much human, material and mental damage Japan had caused to the Korean people after occupying Korea for over 40-year occupation of Korea in the last century and how viciously it antagonized the DPRK and persecuted Koreans in Japan for scores of years after its defeat and make it pay for its crimes. The Japanese authorities must understand the firm will of including all our victims and their bereaved families and our people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Congratulatory Message from Russian President
body: Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a congratulatory message from V. Putin, president of the Russian Federation, on August 15. The message extended sincere congratulations to Kim Jong Un on the day of the liberation, the national holiday. It said that they cherish the memory of the service personnel of the Red Army and Korean patriots who dedicated their lives to the freedom of Korea. Important is that the tradition of good friendship cemented in the grim days now serves as the firm foundation for developing the relations between the Russian Federation and the DPRK, it noted. It expressed the belief that the bilateral cooperation of mutual benefits would be further promoted through the implementation of the agreements reached at the 2019 meeting in Vladivostok. This would no doubt contribute to ensuring the security in the Korean Peninsula and the Northeast Asian region as a whole, it noted. It wished Kim Jong Un good health and success and all the citizens of the DPRK happiness and wellbeing. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Congratulatory Message to Russian President
body: Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a message of greeting to Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation, on August 15. The message extended warm felicitations to the president, government and people of Russia on behalf of the government of the DPRK and its people on the 76th anniversary of the liberation of Korea. The DPRK-Russia friendship forged in blood in the struggle against the common enemy during the great hard-fought anti-Japanese war has invariably been carried forward century after century and generation after generation despite all kinds of challenges of history, it noted, adding that the Korean people are looking back with deep emotion on the servicepersons of the Red Army who dedicated their precious lives to the sacred cause for liberating Korea. It expressed the belief that the friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries with long history and traditions would grow stronger onto a new strategic level on the basis of the agreements reached at the 2019 meeting in Vladivostok. The message sincerely wished the Russian president good health and bigger success in his responsible work for the prosperity of the country and the happiness of the people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Wreaths Laid at Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery on Mt. Taesong
body: Wreaths were placed at the Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery on Mt. Taesong on Sunday, 76th anniversary of the liberation of Korea. Present at the wreath-laying ceremony were Jong Sang Hak, Thae Hyong Chol, Kim Yong Hwan, Kim Jong Ho and other Party and government cadres, officials of the WPK Central Committee, the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly and the Cabinet and officials of the Party and power organs in Pyongyang. Also present there were members of the armed forces organs including Kwon Yong Jin. Wreaths in the names of the WPK Central Committee, the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, the Standing Committee of the SPA of the DPRK and the Cabinet of the DPRK were laid at the wreath-laying stand. The participants offered silent tribute to the revolutionary martyrs. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Congratulatory Message from Palestinian President
body: Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a congratulatory message from Mahmoud Abbas, president of the State of Palestine and chairman of the Executive Committee of the Palestine Liberation Organization, on Sunday. The Palestinian president said in the message he was pleased to send the warmest and sincere congratulations to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un and, through him, to the friendly government and people of the DPRK on behalf of the state and people of Palestine and on his own behalf on the liberation day of the glorious DPRK, and wished the DPRK and its people greater progress and prosperity. Availing himself of the good opportunity, the Palestinian president reaffirmed his will to strengthen the bilateral relations based on friendship and solidarity in the interests of the two countries and the two peoples, and made high appreciation of the DPRK taking the stand of support for the Palestinian people in their just cause to realize legitimate freedom, independence and the right to self-determination. He wished Kim Jong Un happiness in good health and success in his work. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Officials, working people, service personnel of the People's Army, youth and students in the DPRK visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il to pay floral tribute on the occasion of the 76th anniversary of national liberation. Floral baskets in the names of the Party, power and armed forces organs, social organizations, ministries, national institutions, units of the Korean People's Army (KPA) and the Public Security Forces (PSF), and organs, enterprises, factories, universities at all levels, etc. in Pyongyang City were placed before the statues of the President and the Chairman on Mansu Hill. The chief and members of the Pyongyang mission of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front laid a bouquet before the statues. The visitors made deep bows before the statues. Bouquets and floral baskets in the names of different organs, enterprises, units of KPA and PSF were placed before the statues of the great leaders and mosaics portraying their smiling faces in other places in Pyongyang. Working people, service personnel, youth and students across the country visited the statues of the great leaders and mosaics portraying their smiling faces in their residential areas to pay tribute. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Wreath to Liberation Tower on 76th Anniversary of National Liberation
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a wreath to the Liberation Tower on August 15, the 76th anniversary of national liberation. The guard of honor of the Korean People's Army lined up before the tower. Upon authorization, Ri Il Hwan, member of the Political Bureau and secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, laid the wreath sent by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un before the tower. Written on the ribbon of the wreath were letters "We don’t forget the merits of the martyrs of the Soviet Army." Present at the wreath-laying ceremony were Choe Hui Thae, chairman of the Pyongyang City People's Committee, Im Chon Il, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, and officials concerned. The participants observed a moment's silence in memory of the martyrs of the Soviet Army who dedicated their precious lives to the sacred war for liberating Korea with noble internationalist duty. Rodong Sinmun

title: Enlarged Edition Vol. 14 of "Complete Collection of Kim Il Sung's Works" Published
body: The Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House has brought out the enlarged edition Vol. 14 of "Complete Collection of Kim Il Sung's Works", a library of the immortal Juche idea dealing with President Kim Il Sung's works systematically and comprehensively in a chronological order. It contains 96 works such as speeches, press statements and concluding speeches made by the President from February to July, Juche 38 (1949). The works deal with inevitability and significance of merging the workers' parties in the north and south of Korea which are militant vanguard and guiding forces of the popular masses, immediate tasks of the Party and important tasks for strengthening the unity and cohesion of the Party. They comprehensively clarify the revolutionary policies for building a regular army like putting great efforts on intensifying political and ideological education among soldiers as required by the prevailing situation and expanding the forces of all arms and services, and outline the tasks and ways for independently developing the national economy. They also indicate the tasks for teachers to firmly prepare themselves in a political and ideological way and train students to be competent talents of new Korea with profound knowledge, and clarify the strategic line on reunifying the country with the efforts of the Korean people themselves by rallying the patriotic people, progressive political parties and social organizations as one democratic force. Also clarified in the complete collection are the important guidelines on the building of the prosperous country such as the issue of increasing the grain production by putting great effort on land management and raising the land utility rate, and the issue of granting preferential treatment to workers and technicians in the field of coal and other mines. Rodong Sinmun

title: Anniversary of National Liberation Marked in DPRK
body: All the people in the DPRK celebrated the 76th anniversary of national liberation. On the occasion, many people visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the sacred temple of Juche where President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il lie in state, and looked back with deep emotion on the feats of the peerless patriot, the great sage who liberated the country and built a new country where the people became its master. Working people, service personnel, youth and students placed floral baskets, bunches of flowers and flowers before the statues of the President and the Chairman on Mansu Hill and their statues and mosaics of their smiling images in different parts of the country. Visitors to the Arch of Triumph showed great reverence for the President who set a world-historic example of the struggle for national liberation in colonial countries. Working people, service personnel, youth and students visited the Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery on Mt. Taesong to pay tribute. The flags of the DPRK were hoisted in the streets of the capital city and major places of local areas and visual aids displayed to rev up the atmosphere of the holiday. And colorful performances were given at theatres. The Mansudae Art Troupe gave a music and dance performance at the East Pyongyang Grand Theatre, the National Symphony Orchestra a concert at the Moranbong Theatre. And a circus show was given at the Pyongyang Circus Theater. Central art troupes and itinerant art squads gave performances in different parts of the capital city to liven up the atmosphere of the holiday. Celebration performances were also given by the artistes of provincial art troupes in different parts of the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Officials of C.C., WPK Render Support to Flood-victims
body: Officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) rendered sincere support to the flood-victims in South Hamgyong Province. They prepared a large amount of food and fund necessary for stabilizing the life of the flood-victims at an early date, true to the noble intention of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un to pay primary attention to the life of the flood-victims and give strong financial and material support to the recovery from flood damage in the present difficult period. The food and fund were conveyed to the inhabitants in flood-afflicted Sinhung County on Aug. 15. Telling about the fact that the respected General Secretary spends restless night, worrying over the life of the flood-victims, and works heart and soul, the officials of the Party Central Committee called on the officials in the flood-stricken areas to share bitters and sweets with flood-victims and timely solve problems arising in their living. Learning in detail about the conditions and health of the flood-victims living in the office building of the county Party committee, the officials of the Party Central Committee encouraged the officials and people in the county to dynamically step up the recovery campaign for building the homes of happiness, so as to significantly greet the founding anniversary of the WPK. Rodong Sinmun

title: President Kim Il Sung's Exploits for National Liberation Praised Abroad
body: Seminars took place in Bangladesh, Belarus and Algeria and a lecture in Guinea on the occasion of the 76th anniversary of Korea's liberation. The chairman of the Belarus Association for the Study of Juche Idea said in a speech that August 15 is a historic day when Korea was freed from the colonial rule by the Japanese imperialists. President Kim Il Sung, who embarked on the road of revolution in his early years, set forth the original line of armed struggle to inspire all people to turn out in the great anti-Japanese war, he pointed out. The great exploits of the President, who built a socialist state independent in politics, self-supporting in economy and self-reliant in defence after liberating the country from the Japanese imperialists' aggression by applying the undying Juche idea, will be immortal, he noted. The chairman of the Algeria-Korea Friendship Association paid the highest tribute and glory to the President for accomplishing the cause of Korea's liberation, stressing that the President will always be alive in the hearts of all people. Members of the Tangail Branch of the Bangladesh Institute of the Juche Idea praised the shining victory in the anti-Japanese revolutionary war as a miracle of the 20th century which opened a road for the resurrection of the Korean nation and encouraged a new upsurge in the anti-imperialist national liberation struggle. The victory in the great anti-Japanese war brought about a new era of revolution for national liberation, new era of independence in which the popular masses carve out their destiny in an independent and creative way, they said, adding that progressive mankind will always remember the feats of the President who set an example of the anti-imperialist struggle for national liberation. Rodong Sinmun

title: Dancing Parties Held by Youth and Students
body: Youth and students across the country held dancing parties on Sunday in celebration of the 76th anniversary of national liberation. The dancing parties began with the song "Long Live Generalissimo Kim Il Sung". The participants danced with the feelings of admiration for Kim Il Sung, the peerless patriot and the savior of national restoration, at dancing venues in Pyongyang including the plaza of the Arch of Triumph. The youth and students who danced cheerfully to the tunes of "A Dear Name" and "We Will Hold Our General in High Esteem" expressed the greatest glory and respect to Chairman Kim Jong Il. Reverberating through the dancing venues prevailed by the pride of having the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un were songs "Our Leader Loved by People" and "Our Comrade Kim Jong Un". Songs "Young People, Be Loyal to our Party" and "March of Socialist Youth Builders", which show the strong spirit of our young vanguard, revved up the atmosphere of the events. Similar dancing parties were also held in provincial seats, cities and counties on the same day. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Reply Message from Vietnamese President
body: Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a reply message from Nguyen Xuan Phuc, president of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, on Aug. 16. Nguyen Xuan Phuc in the message expressed his sincere gratitude to Kim Jong Un for sending a congratulatory message to him upon his election as president of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam for 2021-2026 tenure at the First Meeting of the 15th National Assembly (July 26, 2021). The message expressed the belief that thanks to the common efforts of the two parties, two states and two peoples, the traditional friendly relations between the two countries would steadily grow stronger for peace, stability, cooperation and development of the region and the rest of the world in the interests of the peoples of the two countries. Nguyen Xuan Phuc said in the message that he takes this opportunity to sincerely hope that the Korean people continue to make fresher and greater successes in the cause of construction and development of the country under the leadership of Kim Jong Un. The message wished Kim Jong Un good health and more successes in performing his noble duty. Rodong Sinmun

title: Fine Art Exhibition Marks 74th Anniversary of Pyongyang University of Fine Arts
body: A fine art exhibition was opened at the Okryu Exhibition Hall on August 17 to mark the 74th founding anniversary of Pyongyang University of Fine Arts. Presented to the exhibition were over 530 art pieces created by teachers, creators and students of the university, including industrial art designs and posters over which the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un gave guidance from Juche 107(2018). Among them are Korean paintings, calligraphies, oil and acryl paintings and woodcuts. There are also paintings drawn at the construction sites of 10 000 flats in Pyongyang depicting soldier- and civilian-builders. The exhibition will continue until August 31. Rodong Sinmun

title: Protests against National Discrimination Staged in Japan
body: Strong protests have been staged across Japan against an unfair ruling made by Japanese judicial authorities availing themselves of the Japanese authorities' discrimination against Korean schools in Japan. The 435th Tuesday-action was sponsored by a Japanese organization in Osaka on August 3 in denunciation of the Japanese judicial authorities. During the action, Koreans and Japanese citizens in Osaka denounced the Japanese regime and judicial authorities for having drawn the sword of vicious national discrimination on the students of Korean schools. The Tuesday-action also took place on Aug. 10. On Aug. 6, a Friday-action was held outside the Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology by students of Korean schools, their parents, teachers and other Koreans and Japanese citizens to demand the application of the tuition-free program for senior high schools to Korean schools. Participants in the action said that the ruling made by the Japanese judicial authorities is a clear proof of deep-rooted national chauvinism rampant in Japanese society. Meanwhile, there took place in Sapporo on July 31 street propaganda activities and demonstration calling for defending the right to national education, which were attended by officials of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), members of the Korean Youth League in Japan, teachers and members of the mothers society in Hokkaido and Japanese personages of a society supporting Korean schools in Hokkaido. Saying that the Japanese authorities get ever more undisguised in their discrimination against students of Korean schools, they vowed to struggle till the just right to national education is acquired. Rodong Sinmun

title: Japan's Discrimination against Korean Schools Blasted
body: An emergency protest rally of Korean compatriots in Hiroshima Prefecture took place to denounce the supreme court of Japan for its unreasonable judgment related to the aid program for Korean schools in Japan. It was held at Hiroshima Korean Primary Senior High School on August 7. Present there were students of Hiroshima Korean Primary Senior High School, those concerned with the Korean schools, Koreans in Japan and Japanese citizens. At the rally, speakers blasted the supreme court of Japan for dismissing the lawsuit the graduates of Hiroshima Korean School and Hiroshima Korean Primary Senior High School filed against Japan on July 27 for excluding Korean high schools from the tuition-free program for senior high schools. They said that the Japanese regime's discrimination against Korean schools is utterly intolerable as it is a manifestation of Japan's colonialism. The rights to learn of students of Korean schools are infringed upon due to the Japanese government and judicial authorities, they noted. They stressed they would struggle for the right to national education against the unjust action of the Japanese government, saying that the litigation struggle helped them feel great pride of being Koreans. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Sci-Tech Presentation of Power Industrial Field Held
body: A national sci-tech presentation of power industrial field was held through video conferencing from August 16 to 18 under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea. The theme of the presentation was adjustment and reinforcement of production foundation and optimal operation of power stations. The aim was to encourage the exchanges and generalization of rational sci-tech methods for increasing power production to satisfactorily meet the demand of the national economy for power. Presented were more than 60 scientific and technological pieces from scientists, technicians and members of the three-revolution teams of more than ten units including Kim Il Sung University, Kim Chaek University of Technology and the Heat Engineering Institute of the State Academy of Sciences. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Sci-tech Presentation of IT Field Held in DPRK
body: A national sci-technological presentation of the IT field was held through video conferencing on Aug. 17-19 under the joint sponsorship of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea and the Education Commission. The presentation was aimed at sharing and generalizing educational IT successes conducive to ensuring nonstop education of students under such emergency situation as protracted global health crisis and natural disaster. More than 100 pamphlets on such successes were submitted to the presentation attended by teachers, researchers, postgraduates and undergraduates from Kim Il Sung University, Kim Chaek University of Technology, Kim Hyong Jik University of Education, etc. During the presentation there was a lecture on the issues arising in applying artificial intelligence to education. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Sci-Tech Presentation of Construction Field Held in DPRK
body: A national sci-tech presentation of the construction field was held through video conferencing from Aug. 17 to 19 under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea. The presentation held on the theme of "Industrialization and Modernization of Construction" was aimed at sharing and introducing the successes and experience achieved in studying and developing the up-to-date and efficient construction equipment and tools, true to the Party's policy of positively developing and producing the construction equipment and tools. Scores of treatises were submitted by officials, scientists, technicians, teachers, researchers and three revolution team members of over 20 units including the Capital City Construction Commission and Pyongyang University of Architecture. A lecture on the world trends in the development of construction machines was given during the presentation. Rodong Sinmun

title: Meetings, Photo and Book Exhibitions and Film Shows Held in Russia
body: Meetings, photo and book exhibitions and film shows took place in Russia on the occasion of the 20th anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's visit to the Russian Federation and the 10th anniversary of his visit to its Siberia and Far Eastern Region. Displayed at the exhibition halls were photos dealing with the exploits performed by the Chairman for promoting the DPRK-Russia friendship. Also on display were works of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, and other DPRK books and photos showing the development of socialist Korea. Korean films documenting the Chairman's Russia visits were shown at the film shows.
