The events were attended by personages of the political parties, organizations and institutions, including the Maritime Territorial Regional Committee and the Amur Regional Branch Committee and the Vladivostok City Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation, the Association for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism in the Far Eastern Region of Russia, the Maritime Territorial Regional Committee of the Lenin Young Communist League of the Russian Federation and the Maritime Territorial Regional Committee of the Russian Women's Union, and the masses, the DPRK consul general and consuls in Vladivostok. Speeches were made at the events. Meanwhile, photo shows were hosted by the website Patrioti Moskva, the website of Khabarovsk Territory Khabinfo and others and a meeting was held by the Russian Group for International Solidarity with the DPRK on the occasion of the above-said anniversaries. Rodong Sinmun

title: Many Art Works Created in DPRK to Encourage Capital City Construction
body: Artists in the DPRK are creating many art works at the construction site of 10 000 flats in Pyongyang to encourage the builders. Artists of the Mansudae Art Studio, Korean Central Fine Arts Studio and Pyongyang University of Fine Arts created lots of art works portraying soldier-builders performing praiseworthy feats in creating a new Pyongyang speed in construction. Among the art pieces are oil painting "Devoted Implementation of Party Policies", Korean painting "Performers of Miracles" and pencil drawing "24-7 Campaign". The art works strongly encourage the builders to perform feats with loyalty and patriotism. Rodong Sinmun

title: Youth Sub-workteam and Youth Workteam Movements Brisk in DPRK
body: Youth sub-workteam and youth workteam movements are in full swing at factories, rural areas and other major sites for attaining the goals of the first year for implementing the five-year plan for national economic development. Youth sub-workteams and youth workteams are performing collective innovations every day, giving energy and vitality to the on-going drive. Members of a youth workteam of the furnace workshop at the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex are demonstrating their wisdom and bravery in the efforts for contributing to fulfilling the shop's economic plan every month. Young people of the youth workteam in charge of sodium carbonate production at the methanol workshop of the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex have waged a campaign for increased production since the beginning of July, thus producing more sodium carbonate. The youth workteam at the Sinuiju Bag Factory completed their yearly plan late in July. Youth sub-workteams at the Samhwa Vegetable Cooperative Farm of Phyongsong City and the Naejung Co-op Farm of Yomju County properly cultivated earlier crops to over-fulfill their wheat production plan. Over hundreds of youth workteams and sub-workteams in farms of North Phyongan Province completed their tasks of digging wells, maintaining water holes, clearing waterways and reinforcing embankments, thus minimizing the damage to crops from disastrous weather. Members of the youth sub-workteam of the Ransan Stockbreeding Cooperative Farm in Kangdong County completed their yearly milk production plan. Many youth workteams and sub-workteams of other stock-breeding farms across the country increased the production of dairy products and supplied them to nurseries and kindergartens in their areas. Rodong Sinmun

title: Production of Building Materials for Flats Construction in Pyongyang Stepped Up
body: Officials and workers of various factories and enterprises are putting more efforts into producing equipment and building materials on time as the construction of 10 000 flats in Pyongyang is making rapid progress. The Sangwon Cement Complex and other cement producing units are increasing production by giving priority to provision of raw materials and fuel and putting the operation of production lines on a sci-tech basis. The workers of the Chollima Steel Complex and others strive to timely supply iron and steel needed for the construction project. Factories and enterprises in the field of machine industry push ahead with the production of electric wires, valves, motors and current transformers by finding and tapping internal reserves. The Anju Pump Factory finished the planned production of pumps. Brick producers also boost production to contribute to speeding up the construction. Other units responsible for the production of stone products, foam prefab parts and finishing building materials are waging a campaign for increased production. Officials in the railway transport sector provide meticulous guidance to transport the goods needed for the construction on time. Rodong Sinmun

title: Epidemic Prevention Campaign Further Intensified in DPRK
body: The emergency epidemic prevention units at all levels in the DPRK further intensify the prevention campaign to cope with the spread of COVID-19 variants in many countries and regions. The central emergency epidemic prevention unit strictly reviews the emergency epidemic prevention work, so as to thoroughly establish among the people a strong discipline and order of absolutely obeying the unified guidance and control of the state and make officials take timely measures against defects and faults. All sectors and units have ensured officials, working people, youth and students a habit of studying common epidemic prevention knowledge and rules like manuals for disinfection, which comes to be a prevailing public climate. Officials of inspection and quarantine units fulfill their responsibilities for defending the forefront of epidemic prevention campaign, bearing in mind that there can be neither any concession nor idleness in the campaign. Institutions for preventive and curative medical care and hygienic and epidemic prevention organs are further intensifying the medical examination of inhabitants to find out those with fever and trace the origin of fever, and pushing ahead with the work to remove spaces for the inroads of malignant virus. Institutions and industrial establishments are scrupulously organizing the work to disinfect office rooms and worksites on a regular basis and prevent disordered flow of manpower and mechanical equipment. Education of and control over residents are also being intensified across the country to urge them to strictly abide by the epidemic prevention rules like wearing of mask at public places. Rodong Sinmun

title: "Complete Collection of Kim Jong Il's Works" Vol. 38 Published
body: The Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House brought out Vol. 38 of "Complete Collection of Kim Jong Il's Works", a library of immortal Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism carrying Chairman Kim Jong Il's works in a chronological order and in a systematic and comprehensive way. The volume contains 61 works including historic speeches, talks and letters released by the Chairman from January to October, Juche 74 (1985). It carries the works which underline the need to bring about a new turn in the Party ideological work as required by the developing reality and carry out revolutionary tasks by always holding fast to the Party's policies and mobilizing the Party organizations and members in guiding the economic work. Some works stress the need to thoroughly implement the Party's military line to further develop the Korean People's Army into a matchless rank capable of defeating any provocations by the enemy, and indicate the idea that all sectors and units should break through difficulties and obstacles with the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance and fortitude to achieve greater successes in production and construction by giving full play to the advantages and vitality of a new administrative and economic guidance system. Some works underscore the need to build Pyongyang City in a far-sighted way and Nampho Barrage as an edifice of eternal value, and indicate the orientation and ways to wage a vigorous struggle for creating more famous songs and masterpieces in the field of literature and art. The volume also carries works giving perfect answers to theoretical and practical issues arising in the revolutionary struggle and construction, including the issue of producing more good-quality daily necessaries, the issue of building public catering service centers to improve public welfare services, the issue of setting up more bases for education of gifted students and positively encouraging swimming. Rodong Sinmun

title: President Kim Il Sung's Exploits for National Liberation Praised Abroad
body: Meetings, seminars, lectures and photo exhibitions took place in Russia, UK, Nepal, Venezuela and DR Congo on the occasion of the 76th anniversary of Korea's liberation. The Chairman of the Rostov Association for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism of Russia said that August 15 is a significant day when the Korean people defeated the Japanese imperialists and achieved the national liberation. He said that the savior of the Korean people from the oppression of the Japanese imperialists was President Kim Il Sung. He founded the revolutionary armed forces and united all the people under the banner of anti-Japanese struggle for an all-people resistance against the Japanese imperialists' colonial rule, he stressed. He said that thanks to the President's leadership, the Korean people were able to bring the anti-Japanese armed struggle to victory, achieve the historic cause of national liberation and become the genuine masters of the country to build a new country, adding that the anti-Japanese revolutionary war waged by the Korean people is brilliantly recorded in the world history of wars. The chairman of the British Association for the Study of Songun Policy said that Kim Il Sung defeated the Japanese imperialist gangsters to liberate the country and built a socialist country independent in politics, self-supporting in economy and self-reliant in defence, thus laying an eternal foundation for building a powerful country. He stressed that no formidable enemy can stop the dynamic advance of the Korean people armed with the revolutionary spirit of Paektu. Personages of political parties and organizations in Nepal praised Kim Il Sung as a prominent leader of the anti-imperialist struggle for national liberation who achieved the national cause of liberating Korea from the Japanese imperialists' military occupation, noting that his revolutionary feats will remain long with the century. A congratulatory message to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un was adopted at an event held in Nepal. Rodong Sinmun

title: Dancing Party of Women's Union Officials and Members Held in DPRK
body: A dancing party of officials and members of the women's union took place at the plaza of the Arch of Triumph on Wednesday, the 61st anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's first field guidance to the revolutionary armed forces. The dancing party started with the playing of the song "Glory to General" with the venue of the dancing party overflowing with the pleasure and excitement of the officials and members of the women's union. The participants danced to the tunes of such songs as "Our General Is the Best" and "The General Star beyond the Clouds" with boundless reverence for the peerlessly great man. The participants danced to the tunes of such songs as "Ballad of Gold Mountains" and "Ongheya", representing their joy of leading a happy life in the socialist country guarded by an invincible army. Amid the playing of such songs as "Cheers of the People" and "Our Leader Loved by People", the dancing party reached its climax with the manifestation of the gratitude toward the mother Party that adds glory to the life of the women. Dancing parties of the officials and members of the women's union took place across the country on the same day. Rodong Sinmun

title: Youth and Students Hold Dancing Parties
body: Youth and students in the DPRK held dancing parties in different parts of the country on Aug. 25, the 61st anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's first field guidance to the revolutionary armed forces. The dancing-party venues in the capital city, including the plazas in front of the April 25 House of Culture and the Pyongyang Indoor Stadium, were full of joy and optimism of youth and students celebrating the significant day. The dancing parties began with song "Fortune of Korea". Looking back with deep emotion on the noble career of the Chairman, the youth and students danced to the tune of songs like "Our General Is the Best". When "Cheers of the People" and other songs were played, the venues were full of the reverence for the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. Songs "Let's Defend Socialism" and "Let Us Meet on the Front" showing the spirit of patriotic youth to firmly defend and glorify our style socialism revved up the atmosphere of the dancing parties. Similar dancing parties were held in provincial seats, cities and counties on the same day. Rodong Sinmun

title: Session of the DPRK SPA to Be Convened
body: The Fifth Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly (SPA) of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea will be convened in Pyongyang on Sep. 28, Juche 110 (2021). A decision of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly on it was released on Tuesday. According to an official notice on convening the session released Tuesday, the session will make discussions on the issue of adopting the law on developing cities and counties and the law on ensuring education of young people, the issue of modification and supplementation of the law on national economic plan, the issue of inspecting and supervising the enforcement of the law on recycling and the organizational issue. Rodong Sinmun

title: 16th Plenary Meeting of 14th Standing Committee of SPA of DPRK Held
body: The 16th Plenary Meeting of the 14th Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly (SPA) of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) was held at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Aug. 24. Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and chairman of the SPA Standing Committee, presided over the plenary meeting. It was attended by Pak Yong Il, vice-chairman of the SPA Standing Committee, its Secretary General Ko Gil Son and members of the SPA Standing Committee. Present there as observers were officials concerned of the SPA Standing Committee, the Secretariat of the Cabinet, ministries, national institutions and the central emergency epidemic prevention sector. Placed on the agenda were the issue concerning the convention of a session of the SPA of the DPRK and the issue of modification and supplementation of the law on road traffic and the law on forest. First, a decision of the Standing Committee of the SPA on convening the 5th Session of the 14th SPA of the DPRK was adopted with the unanimous approval. Then a report was made on the gist of the draft modification and supplementation of the said laws. The law on road traffic has been supplemented with more subdivided and detailed contents for ensuring security and promptness in road traffic with a view to protecting the people's lives and ensuring their convenience. The law on forest has been supplemented with one chapter and 19 articles for unified and planned creation and management of forest conducive to the development of the national economy and the promotion of the people's wellbeing. Based on the in-depth study and discussion of the presented draft modification and supplementation of the laws, decrees of the SPA Standing Committee "On modification and supplementation of the law of the DPRK on road traffic" and "On modification and supplementation of the law of the DPRK on forest" were adopted with the unanimous approval at the plenary meeting. The plenary meeting stressed the need to make substantial preparations for the 5th Session of the 14th SPA and the need for the SPA Standing Committee, the Cabinet and the relevant institutions to keep modifying and supplementing rules and bylaws for the enforcement of the laws as required by the law on the enactment of laws and tightening control by law so as to legally guarantee the struggle for implementing the militant tasks set forth at the 8th Congress of the Party and the plenary meetings of the Party Central Committee. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: All the people and service personnel of the People's Army commemorate the 61st anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's first field guidance to the revolutionary armed forces. Officials, service personnel of the People's Army and working people visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill to pay tribute to the peerlessly great men who developed the People's Army into an invincible revolutionary army and laid eternal foundations for the revolutionary cause of Juche with their Juche-based army-building idea and leadership. Floral baskets in the names of the Party, power and armed forces organs, public organizations, ministries, national institutions, units of the Korean People's Army (KPA) and the Public Security Forces (PSF), institutions, factories and enterprises at all levels in Pyongyang City were laid before the statues. The visitors made deep bows before the statues, recollecting the undying exploits of the President and the Chairman. Floral baskets in the names of units of the KPA and PSF, institutions and enterprises and bouquets were laid before the statues of the great leaders and mosaics portraying their smiling images in different places of the capital city including Kim Il Sung University, the Ministry of National Defence and the Mansudae Art Studio. Officials, service personnel and working people paid floral tribute to the statues of the great leaders and mosaics portraying their smiling images in their residential areas. Rodong Sinmun

title: Rooftop Gardening Gains Momentum in DPRK
body: Now that afforestation and greening get brisk in the DPRK, many factories and enterprises pay deeper attention to rooftop gardening. The Pyongyang Electronic Medical Appliances Factory built a rooftop garden for its employees. The garden, where various flowers, turf, trees, ornamental plants grow in harmony with masses of rocks, waterfalls, walkways and benches, is just like a small park. The Songyong Delicacy House in Central District of Pyongyang City cultivates various kinds of vegetables in its rooftop garden, harvesting over two tons of vegetables every year. A nursery situated in Mirae Scientists Street in Phyongchon District of the city benefits from mixed roof greening. The nursery beautified its building by arranging many potted plants on the edges of its roof. Different crops grow in the rooftop greenhouse and vegetable garden. Fishes are bred in the artificial ponds built on the roof. Rooftop greening is brisk in other parts of the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Memorial Meeting for Korean A-bomb Victims Held in Japan
body: A meeting took place in Tokyo on August 9 in memory of the Korean victims of the A-bombs dropped by the U.S. Present there were Kim Ik Sun, chairperson of the Nishi Tokyo Headquarters of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), Ha Su Gwang, secretary general of the Fact-Finding Group for the Probe into the Truth about the Forcible Drafting of Koreans, Ri Tong Je, chairman of the Association of Koreans in Japan for Peaceful Reunification, other Koreans in Japan, and Japanese citizens. The participants observed a moment's silence in memory of the victims. Speakers said that Koreans, who had been abducted by Japanese imperialists and forcibly brought to Japan in the past, suffered untold misfortune due to A-bomb disasters, while being subjected to inhumane treatment, contempt and grinding toil. However, the Korean victims have not yet got any apology and reparation, due to the Japanese government's policy of national discrimination, they said. On the contrary, the Japanese authorities are justifying the past wars of aggression and persistently committing heinous acts hostile toward the DPRK and Koreans in Japan, they pointed out. They expressed their will to intensify a solidarity struggle for probing into the truth about the crimes against humanity committed by Japan in the past and exacting apology and reparation for them. Rodong Sinmun

title: New Books Published in DPRK
body: New books were published in the DPRK. The Art and Literature Publishing House released the enlarged editions of full-length novels such as "The Arduous March", "On the Tuman River" and "The Grim Battle Area", parts of the cycle of novels "Immortal History" dealing with the exploits performed by President Kim Il Sung who accomplished the historic cause of national liberation through the hard-fought anti-Japanese struggle. It newly published the book titled "A Flower Blooms on a Millennium-old Tree" as a part (legends about the Shining Star of Mt Paektu) of the cycle of the books on revolutionary legends, which reflects the feelings of the Korean people ardently missing Chairman Kim Jong Il. It also brought out a collection of short stories vividly depicting the love of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un for the younger generations. New full-length novels, collection of medium-length stories, a collection of epics and collection of poems were also released. The Kumsong Youth Publishing House published many books including a full-length real-life story "Mt Madu", full-length novels "The Voice of Mother" and "The Blare of Bugle" and a collection of fairy tales and fables. The Working People's Organizations Publishing House and the Science and Encyclopedia Publishing House published books conducive to preparing people to be intelligent workers and creators of new culture. Rodong Sinmun

title: Symposium on Greenhouse Vegetable Sector Held
body: The sci-tech symposium on greenhouse vegetable sector-2021 was held through video-conferencing from Aug. 18 to 24 under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea. The symposium on the theme of "Scientific and intensive greenhouse vegetable farming" was aimed at sharing and generalizing successes and experiences made during greenhouse vegetable cultivation technique research and production. Published at the symposium were over 70 scientific and technical proposals presented by scientists, technicians, teachers, post-graduates and field officials from dozens of units including the State Academy of Sciences, the Academy of Agricultural Science, Kim Chaek University of Technology, Pyongyang University of Agriculture, Wonsan University of Agriculture and provincial rural economy committees. There were lectures and watching of videos on technical issues arising in preventing damage from disastrous weather and harmful insects in greenhouse vegetable farming and cultivating vegetables in different conditions during the symposium. Rodong Sinmun

title: Production of Custom-built Equipment Increases in DPRK
body: Workers of the machine industry sector are concentrating on producing custom-built equipment entering the second half of this year. The Ryongsong Machine Complex is accelerating the production of custom-built equipment to be sent to various units including the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex. Workers and technicians have successfully carried out the processing of the main bodies of high-capacity compressors with existing equipment and technical forces through technical innovation. They have also produced good quality castings of complicated internal structure. Technicians and researchers of the Taean Heavy Machine Complex carry out the daily plan for the production of power generating equipment without fail by introducing sci-tech successes for increasing the processing speed of various kinds of parts. Similar successes are being made at the Ranam Coal-mining Machine Complex, the Rakwon General Machine Enterprise, etc. Rodong Sinmun

title: Participants in Celebrations of Youth Day Arrive Here
body: Celebrations will be held with splendor on the occasion of the 30th anniversary of the institution of the Youth Day, true to the noble will of the Workers' Party of Korea to exalt the beautiful life of the patriotic youth remaining faithful to the call of the country in the historic advance toward a fresh victory of the revolution and to powerfully propel socialist construction by dint of the strong spirit and zeal of millions of young people. 10 000 youths including the young people who volunteered to work in difficult and labor consuming fields, true to the decisions of the 8th Congress of the Party, and exemplary officials of the youth league will take part in the celebrations of the Youth Day. They, who were warmly sent off by officials, working people, youth and students, arrived in Pyongyang on August 26. Leading officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea including its Department Director Ri Tu Song and officials of the Central Committee of the youth league warmly greeted the participants. The participants were overwhelmed by their gratitude to the Party Central Committee for leading the young people of the new generation to dynamically advance straight forward, always following the Party, and bringing them up to be performers of heroic feats. Many youth and students and citizens extended warm greetings to the participants, waving flowers along the streets of Pyongyang including Sungri Street, Changjon Crossroads and University Street. The participants headed for their lodging quarters, feeling the great pride and self-confidence of glorifying their youth as honorable socialist builders under the great loving care and trust of the mother Party. Rodong Sinmun

title: Officials of C.C., WPK Visit Lodging Quarters of Participants in Celebrations of Youth Day
body: Officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) visited the lodging quarters of the participants in the celebrations of the Youth Day on August 27. Secretaries of the WPK Central Committee Ri Il Hwan, Jong Sang Hak and O Su Yong, Department Director of the WPK Central Committee Ri Tu Song and other officials of the Party Central Committee encouraged the young people and the exemplary officials of the youth league who dedicate their wisdom and enthusiasm in all fields of building a powerful and prosperous country. They asked the participants to add luster to their honor of being builders of socialism in the struggle to carry out the decisions made at the 8th Congress of the Party by carrying forward the baton of loyalty and patriotism given by the forerunners of the revolution, bearing deep in mind the noble intention of the Party Central Committee of attaching importance to and loving youth. Rodong Sinmun

title: Participants in Youth Day Celebrations Visit Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: The participants in the Youth Day celebrations visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, where President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il lie in state, to pay homage on Aug. 27. They entered the plaza of the palace, with the feelings of deep reverence for Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il. The participants made deep bows toward the portraits of smiling Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il, representing the unanimous loyalty of all the young people. They vowed to fly the flag of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League higher and fully display their might as a shock brigade in the van of the struggle to implement the decisions made at the 8th Party Congress by faithfully upholding in single mind the idea and leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un who is opening up the greatest heyday of the Korean youth movement. Rodong Sinmun

title: Evening Gala of Youth and Students Marks Youth Day
body: An evening gala of youth and students was held at Kim Il Sung Square in Pyongyang on Aug. 28. The evening gala was watched by Ri Tu Song, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Mun Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League, officials of the youth league and the participants in the Youth Day celebrations. When the song "Glory to General Kim Jong Un" was played, the evening gala began. The participants in the gala danced, paying the highest honour and sending the warmest greetings of gratitude to the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un who is ushering in a golden age of the Korean youth movement while training the youth ranks as a group of steadfast patriots and the Party's reliable detached force devoting themselves to the prosperity of the socialist country. While watching the youth and students dancing the lilting dances, the audience felt confident that immensely rosy is the future of the country glorifying the praiseworthy era of youth in the blessings of the great sun. When the atmosphere of the evening gala was revved up, the nocturnal sky was alight with fireworks. The evening gala reached its climax when the song "We Will Defend General Kim Jong Un with Our Lives" was played in the square where the flags of the DPRK and the flags of the youth league were fluttering. Singing the song of devotedly defending the Party Central Committee in chorus, waving red flags vigorously, al the participants were flooded with the zeal of loyalty with which to repay with miracles and feats the great benevolence of the respected General Secretary, who sent a letter of congratulations of love and trust to the youth and makes the lives of the youth the most praiseworthy. Rodong Sinmun

title: Dancing Parties of Youth and Students Mark Youth Day
body: Dancing parties of youth and students for celebrating the Youth Day took place in different parts. Venues of the dancing parties, the plaza of the April 25 House of Culture and the plaza of the Arch of Triumph, were full of young people greeting the 30th Youth Day. Circle dance started as song "Glory to General Kim Jong Un" was played. Dances to tunes of songs like "Our Comrade Kim Jong Un" and "Cheers of the People" represented the deep reverence for the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un who drastically increased the position and role of young people in the new era of building a great powerful country and repeatedly bestowed great loving care and favor on them. Adding vigor of vibrant youth were songs reflecting the strong spirit of young people to open up the breakthrough at the sites of a great surge. Songs representing the will of young people to firmly carry forward the tradition of loyalty and patriotism displayed by the young people of the preceding generation revved up the atmosphere of the dancing parties. There were similar dancing parties in other parts of the country including Sinuiju, Haeju, Kanggye, Hyesan and Chongjin. Rodong Sinmun

title: KCNA Report on Heroic Feats Performed by Young People in Annals of Socialist Construction
body: The Korean Central News Agency issued a report on Saturday on the heroic feats performed by young people of the country at the most difficult and labor-consuming sites in the annals of socialist construction. The idea of the Workers' Party of Korea of prioritizing youth and its leadership has been a motive power that helped our passionate young people to glorify their youth period as performers of feats in socialist construction and heroes of the times, the report said, and continued: When the whole country turned into ruins after the three-year war, President Kim Il Sung made sure that the young people took the lead in the grand project for building a powerful and prosperous socialist country, counting on them. Within just 12 hours after the end of the war Pyongyang-Sinuiju passenger train began operation and within one week passenger trains were put into operation in all the main railway lines and in less than two months, the electric furnace No. 2 of the Kangson Steel Plant (at that time) was restored. All these miraculous achievements were associated with the proud feats performed by the young people. The national young socialist builders' conference in March 1958 which was held in the presence of the President drastically raised the high spirit and revolutionary enthusiasm of the young people determined to dedicate themselves to the worthwhile struggle for solidifying the foundation for building a powerful and prosperous country. After the conference more than 2 300 young people from across the country volunteered to work at the site for developing Phyongnam coal field. And lots of other young people volunteered to fields of important significance in the development of the national economy and improvement of people's living. In 1961-1969 period, over 1.5 million young people volunteered to difficult and labor-consuming fields and over 2.6 million young people joined more than 70 000 youth shock brigades. Also the number of youth workteam, youth workshop (pit) and "the Minchong (the Sarochong)" machine tools increased to over 3 580, 520 and 3 800 each. This is clear evidence showing the revolutionary stamina and fighting spirit of young people who glorified the era of legendary stories on Chollima. The tradition of heroic struggle of young people opening up the breakthrough in socialist construction with great creation and innovation were steadily carried forward in the decades of the revolution and construction. The feats of young people were further glorified under the outstanding politics of attaching importance to youth pursued by Chairman Kim Jong Il who set forth the slogan "Love Youth!" for the first time in history and led the rising generations step by step to grow up to be the successors of the revolutionary cause of Juche. The High-Speed Youth Shock Brigade personally organized by the Chairman fully demonstrated its might as a regularized and powerful militant unit opening up the breakthrough in major sites of socialist construction in the speed campaign. The members of the youth shock brigade went to the new Pyongyang-Madong railway construction site and finished the railway electrification project in less than two months though it was said to take more than two years. Numberless are admirable creations built by the High-Speed Youth Shock Brigade in the era of the Workers' Party including the Dressing Plant No. 3 of the Komdok Mining Complex, Kowon-Pongsan railway electrification project, Haeju-Sariwon railway electrification project, Grand People's Study House, Mangyongdae Fun Fair, Pyongyang Department Store No. 1, Changgwang Health Complex and Changgwang Street (1st phase). The young people displayed their patriotism and militant spirit in the struggle to carry out the grand fighting programme set forth by the 6th Congress of the Party. With the 7th Congress of the League of Socialist Working Youth of Korea held in October 1981 as an occasion, the young people took further confident steps forward along the direction of advance indicated by the Party, hardening their pledge to display their honor as pioneers and shock brigade of socialist construction. Slogan "Let's become young heroes in worthwhile struggle for glorifying Kim Jong Il's era!" served as a sign of faith of the young people who volunteered to work at the site for laying railways in the northern part of the country and it represented their revolutionary enthusiasm. Since the start of the project on December 1, 1983, the members of the youth shock brigade advanced in full spirit, thus completely finishing all the project construction in the first phase section by August 25, 1988. Whenever there presented difficult and heavy tasks in the revolution and construction, our Party opened up the breakthrough of advance, firmly believing in youth as the reliable support point. It brought the young people to the fore of the grand advance movement in the 1990s. The revolutionary stamina and indomitable fighting spirit of our young people were fully displayed in the construction of the Youth Hero Motorway. Young people went to the construction site from across the country and completed the huge project in a span of over 700 days despite difficult conditions beyond imagination. Our young people grew up to be patriots and heroes who put the country above their own luxury under the care of the Chairman, and the youth league has been honored with the noble title of reserve combat unit and detached corps of the supreme commander. Under the wise leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, our young people have grown up to be pillars propping up the socialist country and have greeted the greatest heyday of the youth movement in the new era of the Juche revolution. In hearty response to the Party's militant appeal to wonderfully build Paektusan Hero Youth Power Station by the 70th anniversary of the Party, the members of the youth shock brigade created the spirit of Paektusan hero youth and the myth of heroic youth of carrying out the huge task which would take 10 years at normal speed in little over 120 days despite the severe cold in the northern area. During the 70-day campaign for greeting the 7th Congress of the WPK with high political enthusiasm and shining labor achievements, a total of more than 1.2 million young people vied each other to take part in shock brigade activities and performed collective innovation. The young people of the whole country are now all out to the gigantic struggle to open up the breakthrough in the implementation of the new five-year plan along the direction of historic advance indicated by the 8th Congress of the Party. More than 10 000 young people readily volunteered to difficult and labor-consuming fields desired by the Party, stirring up the era up to now since the Party Congress. The revolutionary enthusiasm and fighting spirit of millions of young vanguard upholding the idea and spirit of the 8th Congress of the Party has gained further momentum with the 10th Congress of the youth league as an occasion. Our young people are full of revolutionary enthusiasm to powerfully demonstrate their honor as a reliable scouting unit, a wing and death-defying corps of the Party in the sacred and patriotic path for ushering in the new era of a powerful country under the leadership of Kim Jong Un while carrying forward the proud history and tradition of the Korean youth movement generation after generation. Rodong Sinmun

title: Letter of Congratulations of Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Conveyed
body: Celebrations of the Youth Day are being held with splendor here amid the deep attention and blessings by the Workers' Party of Korea and people. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un reposed trust in and bestowed favors on the youth by inviting the young people, who performed merits in the pilot sectors of socialist construction true to the decisions made at the 8th Congress of the Party, to the celebrations and sending them a letter of congratulations. A meeting was held on Aug. 28 to convey the letter of congratulations sent by Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, to the reliable young people who volunteered to work in difficult and challenging sectors of socialist construction. Attending the meeting were Ri Il Hwan, member of the Political Bureau and secretary of the C.C., WPK, Ri Tu Song, department director of the C.C., WPK, the young people who volunteered to work in the difficult and challenging sectors, officials of the Central Committee of the youth league, chairpersons of the provincial committees of the youth league, exemplary officials of the youth league and officials in charge of youth affairs. The letter of congratulations sent by Kim Jong Un was conveyed by Ri Il Hwan. In the letter of congratulations Kim Jong Un highly appreciated the laudable patriotic deeds of the young people, who volunteered to work in the difficult and challenging sectors of socialist construction in the stirring period when a dynamic struggle is being waged for the rejuvenation of our great state, demonstrating far and wide the revolutionary character and fighting mettle of the Korean youth who go through fire and water in response to the call of the Workers' Party of Korea, and extended warm congratulations and militant greetings to them. He said that the young people, who left their dear homes and brightly illumined cities to settle in the workplaces, to which others do not dare to go, and in other places strange to them, with the same dream and ideal of supporting the Party's intention, are a great pride of socialist Korea and source of its great strength, as well as young patriots of our era, stressing that the remarkably soaring enthusiasm for volunteering by young people after the Eighth Congress of the Party is an expression of their outlook on beautiful life. Saying that a state with a huge army of young people, who stoutly carry forward the revolutionary spirit and fighting stamina created by their preceding generations, advances by leaps and bounds full of youthful vigour without knowing any senility for ever, he expressed conviction that the communist society, which the hot-blooded young revolutionaries pictured in their minds at the beginning of the Korean revolution, will turn into reality without fail thanks to the unflinching struggle of the patriotic young people boundlessly loyal to the call of the WPK. Firmly believing that all the young people, who volunteered to work in the difficult and challenging sectors, will further heighten the patriotic zeal and fighting spirit and exalt their honour of being heroic youth who will remain in the memory of their motherland and fellow people in the vanguard of the advancing rank as befits true sons and daughters of the Party, he wished a bright future of the beloved young people. Oath-taking speeches were made at the meeting. The speakers said that the letter of congratulations sent by the respected General Secretary, every paragraph of which instills the great pride, self-confidence and revolutionary enthusiasm of the patriotic youth into their hearts, is the blessings of great love offered by him to all the young people across the country who glorify their precious youthful days, deeming it their biggest honor and pride to remain loyal to the Party and the country and dedicate themselves to them. Then, led by Mun Chol, chairman of the C.C., the Socialist Patriotic Youth League, all the participants solemnly vowed to the respected General Secretary to cherish such honor as the best assets of their careers and fully demonstrate the mettle of the true sons and daughters of the WPK and the socialist patriotic youth in every worksite for implementing the decisions of the 8th Congress of the WPK. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Letter of Congratulations to Trustworthy Young People
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, sent a letter of congratulations to the trustworthy young people who volunteered to work in the difficult and challenging sectors of socialist construction on Saturday. The full text of the letter of congratulations is as follows: In the stirring period, when a dynamic struggle is being waged for the rejuvenation of our great state, our excellent young men and women volunteered to work in the difficult and challenging sectors of socialist construction, instilling a firmer confidence and greater fighting spirit in all other people and demonstrating far and wide the revolutionary character and fighting mettle of the Korean youth, who go through fire and water in response to the call of the Workers' Party of Korea. With an ardent affection for and unshakable conviction in socialism, you have turned out to work bravely for the revolution, defying trials and sacrifice; I highly appreciate your laudable patriotic deeds, and extend warm congratulations and militant greetings to our young people. My warm thanks go to the excellent parents and teachers, who supported the laudable determinations of their beloved children and students and encouraged them without hesitation, and to the organizations and officials of the youth league, who helped these young people's valuable decisions turn into patriotic minds and inspired them. I also would like to extend warm congratulations to all other young people across the country, who have greeted Youth Day while demonstrating the stout mettle of the Korean youth with hot blood and soaring passion in every corner of the country. Though your native homes and the dreams you nurtured in your minds are different, you, with the same dream and ideal of supporting the Party's intention, have settled in the workplaces, to which others do not dare to go, and in other places strange to you; you are a great pride of socialist Korea and source of its great strength, as well as young patriots of our era, beloved of your country and fellow people. Your deeds are an expression of your thoroughgoing faith to share your destiny for ever with socialism, your ardent love for your state and your outlook on beautiful life of finding the honour and worth of life on the road of working for the Party and revolution. Amid the remarkably soaring enthusiasm for volunteering by young people in response to the call of the times and their motherland in practice, not in words, the ranks of young people who volunteered to the difficult and challenging sectors have increased rapidly after the Eighth Congress of the Party; this fact showcases the wonderful ideological and spiritual state of our current young men and women. Young people around the world are flowing into their capital and other cities in pursuance of their avarice and personal pleasure. Only the Korean young people who have grown up under the embrace of the socialist motherland unhesitatingly volunteer to exchange their cards of capital citizenship with notes of dispatch to coal mines, cooperative farms, grand construction sites and islands far from cities. Our Party identifies, in your beautiful and laudable spiritual world, the patriotic soul and revolutionary spirit which remain unchanged and yet alive no matter how many generations have been replaced. You volunteered for the posts at which, you knew, you would have to suffer extraordinary hardships away from your dear homes, brightly illumined cities and beloved families. Your lofty spirit is a splendid inheritance of the ennobling spirit of the anti-Japanese revolutionary fighters who fought shedding blood in the blizzard-swept wilderness after parting with their families. The red blood of the anti-Japanese forerunners who pioneered the revolution under the leadership of Comrade Kim Il Sung is now running through the veins of the rising generations, and this clearly proves that the lineage of the revolutionary cause of Juche which started in Mt Paektu is being stoutly inherited. The enemies are now trembling with terror at this powerful current and spirit. The imperialists' anti-DPRK attempt to degenerate and undermine the ranks of our young people by means of vicious sanctions and pressure and tenacious ideological and cultural infiltration has vanished like bubbles in the face of this strong current. It is a wild goose chase to try to pull down the bulwark of socialism by breaking away our younger generations from the revolution. The revolutionary advance made by you, hot-blooded young people, is heightening the morale of the ranks of the general onward march as the days go by and injecting confidence in sure victory and youthful vigour into the whole country. To look back, every upsurge of our revolution has begun with the sweeping enthusiasm of the young people for volunteering, and this enthusiasm has always given rise to a revolutionary and patriotic zeal, resulting in a stirring era. Thanks to the boundless loyalty and devoted passion of the young people, who had settled down on the rugged mountains and wild sea and shed valuable sweat true to the appeal of the Party that had called young people to the mountains, seas and development areas, monumental edifices of the era mushroomed in the desolate areas and a great heyday of the legendary Chollima era and WPK era opened on this land. Young people courageously volunteered to work on the first lines designated by the Party and revolution when the country was going through trials and demanding another leap forward, and performed undying exploits, shaking the land and sky; these legendary tales are never a thing of the past, living only in memory; they now serve as a driving force that encourage our revolution to advance vigorously. A state with a huge army of young people, who stoutly carry forward the revolutionary spirit and fighting stamina created by their preceding generations, advances by leaps and bounds full of youthful vigour without knowing any senility for ever. The communist society, which the hot-blooded young revolutionaries pictured in their minds today 94 years ago at the beginning of the Korean revolution, is not a thing of a distant future, but will turn into reality without fail thanks to the unflinching struggle of the patriotic young people boundlessly loyal to the call of the WPK. Now we are in the severest-ever trials since the founding of our state, and are overcoming the unprecedented difficulties with an indomitable spiritual strength. In this situation, the news that our young people volunteered, in groups and one after another, to work on the major fronts of socialist construction is more encouraging than that hundreds of thousands, nay millions, of tons of steel and fertilizer or tens of thousands of sets of machine have been produced. What delighted me most is that the young people, who had been lagging behind others, reached an excellent decision to devote themselves to their motherland as befits members of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League that has been rallied on the strength of patriotism, and made a new start of their lives by volunteering to work at the difficult and challenging sectors. When the youthful hearts burning with patriotism fire millions of others' and the fire burns up all sorts of feeble and impure elements that remain and are hindering our advance, the timetabled victory of the Korean revolution will be hastened that much. The Party expects that you will further heighten the patriotic zeal and fighting spirit that are running high at the moment to become standard-bearers and fighters who achieve breakthroughs in the vanguard of the advancing ranks. Many difficulties and trials may lie on the road you have to follow from now on. Of course, you must have set out on this road with a mental preparation to brave difficulties; whenever you vacillate even for a moment, you should invariably follow the road of patriotism to the end, recalling the pledges you made on the day when you volunteered and reflecting yourselves on the spiritual world of your preceding generations. When all of you transform the whole country including the remote villages on the communist lines by turning the outposts of socialist construction into theatres of struggle and feats and demonstrating the mettle of the youth shock brigade and youth death-defying corps, the speed of advance of our revolution will be further accelerated and our politico-ideological and class position will be further consolidated. I am in belief that all the young people, who volunteered to work in the difficult and challenging sectors and are unsparingly devoting their loyal and patriotic sweats at early ages in order to ease the anxiety and agony of the Party and the state as much as they can, will exalt their honour of being heroic youth who are loved by their collectives and comrades as treasures of their workplaces and artists of great feats and who will remain in the memory of their motherland and fellow people. As a saying goes that suffering borne in youth is more precious than gold, the worthwhile traces of our young people who devoted their youth, accepting trials with pleasure, in the difficult and challenging sectors will be their most valuable life-long wealth that cannot be bartered with anything else and a precious asset which they can proudly hand down to the coming generations. Recently, the youth league officials are putting the main emphasis on the league's internal work and ideological education as intended by the Party, and are bringing about a turn in the spirit and manner of their work. As a result, visible changes are taking place in the political consciousness and mental state of our young people. Youth league organizations and officials should further enhance the atmosphere of the positive begetting another positive by drawing on this experience, and conduct the work with the sentiments and feelings of young people in a substantial way. In this way, they can prepare the ranks of our youth into a collective of steadfast patriots, into a reliable special detachment of our Party, who work with devotion for the prosperity of our socialist motherland. It is a firm determination of our Party to take each and every young man and woman born on this land to the communist society. Party organizations should channel their particular efforts into the work with young people, regarding the work of the youth league as part of Party work, so that all the young people can display their youthful wisdom and courage in the struggle for fresh victory in socialist construction. Party organizations should take maternal care of the work and life of the young people who volunteered to their relevant areas and units, and lead them to live with honour at every step on the road of loyalty to the Party. They should also hold the families, which sent their children to the difficult and challenging sectors, as patriotic families, and take good care of them. The millions of young people are a firm cornerstone, which our Party relies on at any time, and a strong force that demonstrates a more formidable strength the harder the times are. The cause of our Party will win victory after victory by dint of the ardent loyalty of our proud and trustworthy young people and of the full support and trust of all other people. My earnest request is that you, in good health at new workplaces in strange localities, should add brilliance to your beautiful life by creating new innovations and performing uninterrupted feats without betraying the expectations of your parents, siblings, teachers, organizations and comrades. I wish a bright future of our beloved young people. Let us all struggle dynamically for the fresh victory of our revolution and the bright future of our great state. I firmly believe that you will fully demonstrate to the whole world the heroic mettle of the Korean youth as befits true sons and daughters of the motherly Party.

title: National Sci-Tech Presentation and Symposium in Cosmetics Field Held
body: A national sci-tech presentation and symposium in the cosmetics field was held through video conferencing on August 26 and 27 under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea. The presentation held on the theme of "Domestic production of raw and other materials and equipment and recycling, development of new products and improvement of quality" was aimed at sharing and generalizing sci-tech successes and experience achieved by cosmetics development and production units, and increasing self-reliance in the cosmetics industrial field. Taking part in the presentation were officials, teachers, researchers and post-graduates from the Aromatic Cosmetics Analysis Institute under the Academy of Light Industry, Pyongyang Han Tok Su University of Light Industry, the Pyongyang Cosmetics Factory, the Sinuiju Cosmetics Factory, the Pyongyang Essential Oil Factory, etc. Presented there were over 40 valuable treatises that gave answers to various sci-tech problems in implementing the domestic production of raw and other materials for cosmetics and recycling, upgrading production processes and developing new products keeping up with the world trend. There was also a symposium on the direction of developing multi-purpose cosmetics. Rodong Sinmun

title: Celebration Stage Given by Youth and Students
body: There was a celebration stage "We Will Display the Might of Patriotic Youth" at the Pyongyang City Youth Park Open-Air Theatre on Sunday on the occasion of the Youth Day. Among the audience were Ri Tu Song, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Mun Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League, officials of the youth league and the participants in the Youth Day celebrations. Put on the stage which began with the prologue "We Are Successors to Revolution" and "Song of Youth" were such colorful numbers as narrative poem and chorus "Glory to General Kim Jong Un", male solo "We Follow His Tender Heart" and female quartet "Campfire, Flare Up". The performers represented the faith and will of young vanguards to create myth of miracles in the historic advance towards a new victory in the revolution while adding luster to the history and tradition of the Juche-oriented youth movement under the leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. Stories of the young people who volunteered to work in difficult and challenging sectors of socialist construction and songs "Glory of Our Life" and "We Call You Father" showed the mental world of the young people. A congratulatory poem of schoolchildren, earnestly asking the patriotic youth to glorify their youth as treasures of their worksites and performers of feats and always give delight to the mother Party, not forgetting the pledges they made on the day of petition, touched the heartstrings of the audience. When youth heroes of the former generation who performed feats in the struggle to build monumental edifices of the Workers' Party era mounted the stage, the participants congratulated them with bouquets and loud applauses. Their stories of creating world-startling miracles in steep mountains, wild seas and areas under new development in response to the calls of the Party, and their song "March of Socialist Youth Builders" stirred up the venue. Male chorus "Our Trench" reminded the audience that the pilot fields of socialist construction are revolutionary positions and posts to be occupied by young vanguards, which are linked to the premises of the Party Central Committee. The number aroused active responses from the audience. Young people of the new generation mounted the stage and evinced their pledges to be the vanguard and shock brigade in the struggle to glorify the great era of Kim Jong Un by carrying forward the revolutionary spirit created by the former generation. Rodong Sinmun

title: Construction of Chonsong-Songsanchon Gravity-Fed Drain Pit Completed
body: The construction of the Chonsong-Songsanchon gravity-fed drain pit has been completed. Members of the South Phyongan Provincial youth shock brigade engaged in the project have successfully finished the construction which involved the excavation of a waterway tunnel extending thousands of meters. The completion of the construction has laid a material and technical foundation for markedly increasing the coal production in the coalfield areas in the western part of the country by draining underground water from large-scale coal mines. Rodong Sinmun

title: Over 1 000 University Student Scientific Research Prize Winners Produced
body: University students in different parts of the DPRK are carrying out energetic scientific researches. This year, over 1 000 university students were awarded University Student Scientific Research Prize and some university students proved successful at the international internet program contest Codechef several times. Students of Kim Il Sung University contributed to solving the theoretical problems arising in developing the control technology in the field of automatic control and to finding the ways of their implementation. And they also registered other achievements in resolving the pressing issues arising in several sectors of the national economy. Students of Kim Chaek University of Technology completed the automatic control system necessary for cooling the electric generator of the Pyongyang Thermal Power Plant. This provided a scientific and technological guarantee for putting the power generation on a normal and safe basis. Among the prize winners are students of Pyongyang University of Architecture who displayed their high abilities in drawing up layout plans for sprucing up Samjiyon City and other important projects. Students of Pyongyang University of Medicine, Hamhung University of Pharmacology and Koryo Songgyungwan University have succeeded in developing ability-assessing program and carrying on study of ointments and functional soft drinks. This has contributed to the improvement of students' ability and the promotion of the people's health. The prize was also conferred on many students of Kim Hyong Jik University of Education, and other universities. Students of Kim Il Sung University and University of Sciences won in several Codechef contests this year. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Has Photo Session with Participants in Youth Day Celebrations
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, met and had a significant photo session with the participants in the Youth Day celebrations. Present there were Jo Yong Won, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretary for organizational affairs of the Central Committee of the WPK, Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the WPK Central Committee, Ri Tu Song, department director of the WPK Central Committee, and Mun Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League. The young people were overwhelmed with great emotion and joy as they were about to have the greatest honor of having a photo session with the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un they had always missed. When he arrived at the venue of the photo session amid the playing of the welcome music, the young vanguards broke into stormy cheers of "hurrah!" The participants in the celebrations raised enthusiastic cheers for the respected General Secretary who made sure that their deeds are known throughout the country and repeatedly showed great benevolence for them, sending a letter of congratulations representing loving care and trust, though their deeds are what should be naturally done by young people of the new generation grown up in the embrace of the socialist country. He sent warm greetings of encouragement to the reliable young people who volunteered to the outposts of socialist construction with one dream and ideal for upholding the intention of the Party, and devote themselves with the mind of loyalty and patriotism. Saying that the ideological and mental state of our young people are excellent as they always respond to the calls of the country with intense loyalty, and regard their devotion to the future as the greatest honor and pride of life, he highly appreciated the patriotic young people who are firmly carrying forward the revolutionary spirit and fighting traits created by the former generations. Expressing the belief that the participants would bear in mind the valuable call as the dependable young vanguard of the WPK as the biggest treasure of their life and demonstrate their name as heroic youth the country and the people are proud of in the worthwhile struggle for hastening the bright future of our glorious country, he posed for a picture with them. At the end of the photo session, the young people raised stormy cheers of "hurrah!" and shouted "Kim Jong Un", "Devoted Defence". Kim Jong Un extended militant greeting to the young people, waving for long to them who are cheering at the top of their voices with great emotion. All the participants firmly vowed to always remember the present honor and glorify their honor as being detached force of the Party and young patriots upholding the revolutionary idea and leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un with loyalty. Political News Team

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Meets Young People WhoVolunteered to Difficult and Challenging Sectors
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, met young people, who volunteered to work at difficult and challenging sectors of socialist construction and started with a clean slate, and blessed them bright future on August 30. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un was accompanied by Jo Yong Won, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretary for organizational affairs of the C.C., WPK, Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the C.C., WPK, Ri Tu Song, department director of the C.C., WPK, and Mun Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League. He held hands of each of the young people who volunteered to work at difficult and challenging sectors with high awareness and enthusiasm to glorify their youth in the van of the worthwhile era, highly estimating their deeds and mental world. Those young people, who had been lagging behind others, realized the gratitude of the mother Party and the socialist system that embraced and brought them up and started with a clean slate by volunteering to work at the most difficult and challenging posts. He said he fully supports them and praised their deeds as laudable and admirable ones. The production of lots of young people heartily responding to the call of the Party and the revolution in the era when an arduous struggle is being waged to bring about a new victory of the revolution is an expression of the advantages of the socialist system in our country, and a demonstration of the noble view on the life and future of our youth, he said, adding: It is the best pride, asset and motive power for the development for a Party making revolution to have its reliable successors, reserves and promising main force. He earnestly called on the young people to become a kindling spark and a great fire in the on-going gigantic general advance and to become youth heroes endeavoring to bring about prosperity and progress of the country with gem-like patriotism. He underlined the need for the Party organizations and youth league organizations to take warm care of the work and life of young people, who volunteered to areas and units under their responsibilities, and to support them and push them forward so that they can lead the most excellent lives. He had a photo taken with those greatly excited young people, wishing the bright future for the dependable youth who responded to the call of the Party in practice out of firm faith in socialism. He expressed expectation and belief that all the young people who volunteered to the pilot sectors of socialist construction would glorify their precious youth with heroic feats for the Party and the country and keep to the path of patriotism to the last, true to the pledges they made at the new starting line of their lives. Political News Team

title: The Series of Korean Paintings “Farmers’ Lives”
body: The “Farmers’ Lives” are a series of Korean paintings that depicted country life in a year according to the months or seasons including some major farm works like plowing, weeding, thrashing, etc, thread spinning, many holiday amusements and other folk customs. There are many series of the same kind and a famous one is by U Jin Ho, a painter of Korea who lived in the 19th century. His paintings described well the diverse lives of our people by means of deep national emotion and rich local color and are therefore friendly to beholders. The painting “Welcoming the First Full Moon” picturizes the then men and women of all ages seeing the moon rising on the evening of the 15th day of the first lunar month. The painting “Weeding” portrays the farmers enjoying lunch brought by women after working by the sweat of their brows. In addition his works comprehensively figure the lives of not only farmers but also the people of different classes and strata. As it depicts the diverse folk customs of our people, the series of the Korean paintings “Farmers’ Lives” is quite significant in the study of the Korean customs. Rodong Sinmun

title: New Science Films Produced in DPRK
body: Recently the Korean Documentary and Science Film Studio produced science films conducive to broadening the sci-tech knowledge of the people and raising their theoretical and practical abilities. The films include "Power-saving oval electrical transformer" and "Household-friendly egg coal 'Yongam'". The newly produced film "Common Sense of Science No. 138" deals with the popular cards used in electronic settlement and smart phones. Rodong Sinmun

title: Participants in Youth Day Celebrations Conduct Diverse Political and Cultural Activities
body: The participants in the Youth Day celebrations conducted colorful political and cultural activities during their stay in Pyongyang. The participants watched the documentary film "Brilliant History of Youth Power" at the People's Palace of Culture. The film, dealing with the exploits of the peerlessly great men who ushered in a heyday of the Juche-oriented youth movement, touched the audience. The participants also watched revolutionary dramas, operas and music and dance performances given by artistes of different national art troupes at theatres in the capital including the Pyongyang Grand Theatre. Creators and artists of the art troupes warmly congratulated the young people who volunteered to work in difficult and labor-consuming fields of socialist construction in hearty response to the call of the times and the country. The participants spent a pleasant time at the Amusement Park of the Kaeson Youth Park and the Rungna People's Pleasure Park. Rodong Sinmun

title: Participants in Youth Day Celebrations Tour Pyongyang
body: The participants in the celebrations of the Youth Day toured different places of Pyongyang City. They visited Mangyongdae, the sacred place of revolution. Being briefed on the historic data and mementoes displayed at the Mangyongdae Revolutionary Museum, the visitors recalled the revolutionary career of President Kim Il Sung. They looked round the historic relics preserved at the President's old home in Mangyongdae. They also went to the Youth Movement Museum. They made a deep bow to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il at the main lobby of the museum. During the visit, they learnt about the achievements the peerlessly great persons made in leading the Juche-oriented youth movement to victory and glory. They made the rounds of the Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery on Mt Taesong and the Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery. They also visited the Phyongchon Revolutionary Site. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Egyptian President
body: Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Abdel Fattah al-Sisi, president of the Arab Republic of Egypt, on Aug. 29. The message said: On the anniversary of the foundation of the DPRK, it gives me utmost pleasure to extend to Your Excellency and your friendly people my heartfelt felicitations and best wishes. Our two countries have always maintained very good relations, and I am confident that these relations will be further developed in the years ahead to the benefits of our two friendly peoples. Please accept, Your Excellency, my cordial wishes for the best of your well-being and for the progress and prosperity of the friendly people of the DPRK. Highest consideration and appreciation. Rodong Sinmun

title: More Light Industrial Workers Fulfill Two-yearly or Yearly Plans
body: An increasing number of workers in several units in the light industrial sector have fulfilled their two-yearly or yearly plans. The campaign in which one overtakes and learns from others and swaps experiences with each other has gained further momentum among the machine operators of the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Silk Mill and as a result, over 10 workers have fulfilled their two-yearly plans and over 140 workers their yearly plans. A silk reeling worker, who had come on the top in fulfilling her yearly plan fulfilled two-yearly plans on August 12 by curtailing the shuttling time. Following her, a large number of workers have fulfilled their two-yearly and yearly plans. The number of labor innovators is on the steady increase at the Kangso, Hamhung and Songchon silk mills and several textile mills. Rodong Sinmun

title: Association of Korean Victims of Forcible Drafting and Their Bereaved Families Issues Statement
body: A spokesman for the Association of Korean Victims of Forcible Drafting and Their Bereaved Families issued a press statement with the lapse of 98 years since the Japanese imperialists perpetrated the shuddering massacre of Koreans in Japan occasioned by a great earthquake that jolted the Kanto area. At noon on September 1, 1923, a strong earthquake which shook Tokyo and its surrounding areas accompanied by widespread fires destroyed hundreds of thousands of houses and buildings and took lives of a great number of people, the press statement said, and went on: To stop rapidly spreading social uneasiness and horror and to calm down confusion and discontent of the afflicted people, the cunning Japanese imperialists hatched a vicious plot to sacrifice innocent and bare-handed Koreans in Japan. The Japanese imperialists cooked up the "story of Koreans' rioting" and spread rumors that "Koreans set fire and put poison in water wells". They massacred more than 23 000 Koreans in Japan in the most barbarous way in a little over ten days, with the involvement of the army, police and ultra-right organizations. The massacre of Koreans in Japan committed during the great Kanto quake proves that the Japanese imperialists are ogres steeped in misanthropy and national chauvinism to the marrow of their bones and blood-suckers and sworn enemies of the Korean people. Almost a century has passed since then, but the Japanese authorities do not feel even an iota of guilty conscience or responsibility, much less clarifying the truth about it. They are busy denying or covering up the past crimes and inciting extreme national chauvinism in the Japanese society through a smear campaign against the DPRK. They are now trying every possible attempt to get the right-wing reactionaries to disrupt memorial services for the Korean victims and even remove a memorial monument. We strongly denounce in the name of all the past victims and the bereaved families the reckless acts of the Japanese authorities and the right-wing reactionaries getting hell-bent on the anachronistic moves for distorting history and opposing the DPRK and the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan, far from making an apology and reflection on the massacre. We will never forget the barbarous acts of the Japanese imperialists during the great Kanto quake and will certainly force them to pay a thousand-fold no matter how much water may flow under the bridge. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Greetings to General Secretary of C.C. of CPV and President of SRV
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), sent a message of greeting to Nguyen Phu Trong, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam (CPV), and Nguyen Xuan Phuc, president of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam (SRV), on Sep. 2. The message extended warm congratulations to the Vietnamese general secretary and president and the friendly Vietnamese party, government and people on the occasion of the 76th founding anniversary of the SRV. It said that the SRV has vigorously struggled to build socialism after achieving national liberation and country's reunification for the past 76 years since its foundation. The message expressed pleasure over the fact that the Vietnamese people have made progress in the efforts to implement the decisions of the 13th party congress and build a prosperous and civilized socialist state under the leadership of the CPV. It expressed belief that the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation developing on good terms between the two parties and two countries would continue to develop in the spirit of the agreement reached at the historic summit in March 2019. It sincerely wished the general secretary and the president good health and bigger success in their responsible work leading the party and state. Rodong Sinmun

title: Participants in Youth Day Celebrations Leave Pyongyang
body: The young people, who came here to significantly and splendidly celebrate the Youth Day amid the blessings by the whole country, left here on Sep. 1. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un projected the participants, trustworthy and patriotic young people, who volunteered to work in difficult and challenging sectors of socialist construction in hearty response to the call of the times and the country after the Eighth Party Congress, as the pride of the country. He also sent a letter of congratulations to them and had a photo session with them. During their stay in Pyongyang, the participants keenly realized that they live under the great motherly care of Kim Jong Un. Officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and officials of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League saw them off at the April 25 Hotel and Pyongyang Railway Station. Citizens warmly sent them off, waving flowers and hands, when the buses carrying them passed along the streets of the capital. Rodong Sinmun

title: Universities of Education Mark Their 60th Founding Anniversaries
body: Meetings took place at Kim Jong Suk University of Education, Cha Kwang Su Sinuiju University of Education No. 1, Kim Jong Thae Haeju University of Education, Phyongsong University of Education and Hamhung University of Education to mark their 60th founding anniversaries. Present there were local party officials and officials, teaching staff and students of the universities. Reports were made there. The reporters said that the 60-year-long proud histories of the universities are associated with the wise leadership and warm care of the peerlessly great men who devoted themselves to developing the education of the country. They stressed that the universities, which were developed into the pedigree establishments for the education of the rising generation thanks to the peerlessly great men's outstanding idea of attaching importance to education and their leadership, have effected innovations in the educational contents and methods and achieved many scientific research successes in the campaign for bringing about a radical turn in education. They called on all the teaching staff and students to adhere to and glorify the peerlessly great men's idea and theory on education and leadership exploits and dedicate their patriotic zeal and pure conscience to the struggle for turning education into the one that can be entrusted with the future of the country. They called for making tangible contributions to developing the DPRK into an educational power and a talent power by faithfully upholding the leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un and bringing about a radical improvement in education and scientific research. Rodong Sinmun

title: Third Enlarged Meeting of Political Bureau of 8th C.C., WPK Held
