The message sincerely wished Kim Jong Un good health and happiness and the people of the DPRK steady progress and prosperity under his wise guidance. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Kenyan President
body: Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on Aug. 31 received a message of greeting from Uhuru Kenyatta, president of the Republic of Kenya. The message said: Your Excellency. On behalf of the Government and the People of the Republic of Kenya and on my own behalf, I convey our warm greetings and congratulations to Your Excellency, the Government and the Great People of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. As we join you in commemorating this important day in your country history, I take note with appreciation the long-standing and friendly cooperation between Kenya and the DPRK both at the bilateral and multilateral fora. I firmly believe that our relations will further strengthen in the years ahead for the common good of our people. Your Excellency, I also wish to express my gratitude to the DPRK support during Kenya's successful bid in joining the United Nations Security Council (UNSC) as a non-permanent member for the years 2021-2022 term. I am confident the two countries will work closely to cultivate a climate of trust, transparency and consensus in order to promote the respect for international rules and norms in the advancement of peaceful resolution of conflicts and increased cooperation in enhancing global peace and security, fight against terrorism and tackling climate change among other global issues of mutual interest. I look forward to working closely with you and your Government to further strengthen our relations for the mutual benefit of our countries and people. I wish Your Excellency good health, success and prosperity for the people of the DPRK. Please accept, Excellency, the assurances of my highest consideration. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Ugandan President
body: Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), received a message of greeting from Yoweri Kaguta Museveni, president of the Republic of Uganda, on August 30. The Ugandan president in the message extended the warmest congratulations on behalf of the government and people of the Republic of Uganda and on his own behalf to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un and to the government and the people of the DPRK on the occasion of the 73rd founding anniversary of the DPRK, September 9. The message said that the great devotion made by the preceding leaders, people and service personnel for defending the sovereignty of the DPRK would be remembered forever along with its national day. The message noted that the friendly relations between Uganda and the DPRK would be further strengthened in mutual interests of the peoples of the two countries. It added that Uganda hopes Korea will be reunified and the reunification of Korea will make a great contribution to world peace, progress and prosperity. It hoped that the DPRK would remove the aftermath of the flood damage as soon as possible, expressing deep sympathy to Kim Jong Un and to the victims as regards the fact that dwellings and roads were destroyed and crops damaged by floods in different areas of the east coast including South Hamgyong Province of the DPRK. Hoping to work together with Kim Jong Un, the message wished him good health and happiness. Rodong Sinmun

title: Long-range Cruise Missiles Newly Developed by Academy of Defence Science Successfully Test-fired
body: The Academy of Defence Science of the DPRK successfully test-fired new type long-range cruise missiles on September 11 and 12. Pak Jong Chon, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, watched the test-launches with Kim Jong Sik and Jon Il Ho, vice department directors of the Party Central Committee. Leading officials and scientists in the field of the national defence science took part in the test-launches. The development of the long-range cruise missile, a strategic weapon of great significance in meeting the key target of the five-year plan for the development of the defence science and the weapon system set forth at the 8th Congress of the Party, has been pushed forward according to the scientific and reliable weapon system development process for the past two years and, in this course, detailed tests of missile parts, scores of engine ground thrust tests, various flight tests, control and guidance tests, warhead power tests, etc. were conducted with success. The development of this weapon system that has been powerfully pushed forward as a crucial work under the special concern of the Party Central Committee holds strategic significance of possessing another effective deterrence means for more reliably guaranteeing the security of our state and strongly containing the military maneuvers of the hostile forces against the DPRK. The test flights were successfully held. The launched long-range cruise missiles traveled for 7 580 seconds along an oval and pattern-8 flight orbits in the air above the territorial land and waters of the DPRK and hit targets 1 500 km away. The test launches showed that the technical indices such as the thrust power of the newly developed turbine-blast engine, the missiles' navigation control and the end guided hit accuracy by the combined guided mode met the requirements of designs. In all, the efficiency and practicality of the weapon system operation was confirmed to be excellent. Pak Jong Chon, upon authorization of the Party Central Committee, conveyed warm congratulations and thanks to the scientists in the field of defence science and the workers in the munitions field for succeeding in the development of the long-range cruise missiles. The achievement is a bright fruition of our Party's policy of prioritizing defence science and technology and a signal success made in the defence field whose members are all out for implementing the decisions made at the 8th Congress of the Party, he noted. This is another great manifestation of the tremendous capabilities of the defence science and technology and the munitions industry of our country, he added. He stressed the need for the field of the national defence science to go all out to increase the defence capabilities, the war deterrence of the country and keep making achievements in meeting the grand and long-term targets of securing war deterrence set forth at the 8th Congress of the Party. Rodong Sinmun

title: Mountain-climbing Route Newly Paved in Area of Mangmi Pavilion
body: A mountain-climbing route from Mangmi Pavilion, one of the historic relics in Kanggye City, to the Jangjagang People's Pleasure Park was newly paved in Jagang Province of the DPRK. The pavilion has been called Mangmi Pavilion as visitors can feast their eyes on the beautiful scenery of the Kanggye area there. Balconies and a pleasure park were built there so that working people, youth and schoolchildren can have a bird's-eye view of Kanggye City during their rest time. Visitors can see new diverse sculptures, decorations in relief and flowerpot stands there. Lots of trees were planted along the route decorated by colorful electric lights. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Bangladeshi President
body: Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), received a message of greeting from Md. Abdul Hamid, president of the People's Republic of Bangladesh, on September 7. The message said: On the occasion of the Founding Anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, I would like to extend, on behalf of the people of Bangladesh and my own behalf, heartiest felicitations to you and through you to the people of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. Bangladesh and Democratic People's Republic of Korea enjoy friendly relations that are based on the principle of mutual respect for each other's sovereignty and the understanding of each other's interest. It is my firm conviction that under your able leadership the existing friendly relations will be further strengthened in the days to come. I take this opportunity to wish you good health, happiness and long life and the friendly people of Democratic People's Republic of Korea continued peace, progress and prosperity. Please accept, Excellency, the assurances of my highest consideration. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Indian President
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, received a message of greeting from Ram Nath Kovind, president of the Republic of India, on Sept. 7. The message says: Excellency, On behalf of the Government, and the people of India and on my own behalf, I extend my heartiest felicitations to Your Excellency, the Government and to the people of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea on the occasion of your Foundation Day. India and the Democratic People's Republic of Korea traditionally enjoy long-standing friendly and cordial relations. I am confident that these bonds of friendship between our two countries will continue to grow in future. I convey my best wishes for Your Excellency's good health and for the well-being and prosperity of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. With assurances of my highest consideration. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Cambodian King
body: Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), received a message of greeting from Norodom Sihamoni, king of the Kingdom of Cambodia, on September 7. The king in the message extended warm congratulations, on behalf of the people of the Kingdom of Cambodia and on his own behalf, to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un and the Korean people on the occasion of September 9, 2021, the 73rd founding anniversary of the DPRK. The message highly appreciated the wise leadership of Kim Jong Un for the development of the DPRK and good health of all the Korean people. It expressed firm conviction that the bonds of friendship and cooperation between the Kingdom of Cambodia and the DPRK would continue to develop on good terms for the interests of the two countries and their peoples. It wished Kim Jong Un good health and bigger success in his noble work. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from President of Cape Verde
body: Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), received a message of greeting from Jorge Carlos Fonseca, president of the Republic of Cape Verde, on Sept. 7 On the occasion of Sept. 9, the 73rd founding anniversary of the DPRK, the president of the Republic of Cape Verde in the message extended heartfelt congratulations to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un on behalf of the people of Cape Verde and on his own behalf. The message wished Kim Jong Un good health and happiness and the DPRK and its people progress and prosperity. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un from Captains Regent of San Marino
body: Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), received a message of greeting from Gian Carlo Venturini and Marco Nicolini, captains regent of the Republic of San Marino, on Sept. 7. On behalf of the people of San Marino and on their own behalf, the captains regent in the message extended best wishes to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un and the friendly people of the DPRK on the occasion of the founding anniversary of the DPRK. The message warmly wished Kim Jong Un success in his work and the people of the DPRK bright and prosperous future on the occasion of the special day. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Message of Greeting from President of Mozambique
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, received a message of greeting from Filipe Jacinto Nwussi, president of the Republic of Mozambique, on September 8. The Mozambican president in the message extended the warmest congratulations on behalf of the Mozambican government and people and on his own behalf to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un and to the government and the people of the DPRK on the occasion of the 73rd founding anniversary of the DPRK. The message extended support and solidarity to the government and the people of the DPRK in their efforts for checking the inroads of a pandemic disease caused by novel coronavirus. It expressed satisfaction over the excellent relations of friendship, solidarity and cooperation between the two countries and peoples which were provided and consolidated through the struggle against colonialism. It sincerely wished Kim Jong Un good health and the people of the DPRK prosperity. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Maldivian President
body: Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Ibrahim Mohamed Solih, president of the Republic of Maldives, on Thursday. The message said: Excellency, On the joyous occasion of 73rd Anniversary of the Founding of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, I wish to convey, on behalf of the Government and the people of the Maldives, and on my own behalf, warm felicitations and sincere good wishes to Your Excellency, the Government and the people of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. Let me also extend, Excellency, my personal best wishes for your good health and happiness, and for the continued progress and welfare of the people of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from King of Sweden
body: Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), received a message of greeting from Carl ⅩⅥ Gustaf, king of the Kingdom of Sweden, on Sept. 9. The message said: On the occasion of the anniversary of the founding of the DPRK, I wish to convey to Your Excellency my best wishes for the future and for the welfare of the people of the DPRK. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Message of Greeting from President of Senegal
body: Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), Thursday received a message of greeting from Macky Sall, president of the Republic of Senegal. The Senegalese president said in the message that he was pleased to extend warm congratulations to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un on the occasion of the national day of the DPRK. The message sincerely wished Kim Jong Un and the friendly Korean people happiness, prosperity and ceaseless successes. The message affirmed the will to develop the friendly and cooperative ties between the two countries. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Premier Inspects Economic Sectors
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the DPRK, inspected several units of the national economy. He learned about the immediate farming state at Hakhung-ri and Tongha-ri of Ryongchon County and Naejung-ri of Yomju County where farmers are working hard to implement the decisions of the third enlarged meeting of the Political Bureau of the eighth Central Committee of the WPK which called for admirably finishing this year's farming. He called for focusing steady efforts on ensuring the maximum yields by responsibly tending the crops under possible disastrous weather conditions so as to successfully wrap up this year's farming and make preparations for next year's farming. At the construction site of the Pothong Riverside Terraced Residential District, he underscored the need to ensure the formative art in greening by planting trees and flower shrubs of good species and to take proper sci-tech measures to create lawns and manage green areas, pointing out that a model terraced residential district would be put up thanks to the Party's warm love for the people. The field consultative meetings discussed practical issues arising in tapping all efforts to harvesting and thrashing and improving the agricultural management control methods in keeping with the developing realities, and detailed assignment of work were given to green the district and parks on the bank of the Pothong River in harmony with the natural landscape and in a unique way. Meanwhile, the premier visited Kim Chaek University of Technology to discuss technical issues for further developing the university into a research-oriented university and one of world-level universities. Rodong Sinmun

title: Koreans in Russia Celebrate 73rd Founding Anniversary of DPRK
body: The United Confederation of Koreans in Russia held a meeting in Moscow on Sept. 6 to celebrate the 73rd founding anniversary of the DPRK. Present there were officials and members of the confederation and members of the Russian Association for Friendship and Cultural Cooperation with the DPRK and the Group for International Solidarity with the DPRK. Ro Yong Jin, chairman of the Moscow City United Confederation of Koreans, made a report which was followed by speeches. The reporter said that as President Kim Il Sung founded the DPRK, the Korean people became the proud masters who carve out their destinies independently for the first time in history. Our country emerged as a powerful socialist country thanks to the wise leadership of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, he noted. Speakers extended the highest glory to Kim Il Sung who founded the DPRK. They stressed that the Korean people have wrought world-startling miracles one after another in all fields including politics, economy, culture and national defense under the wise leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Enlarged Meeting of South Hamgyong Provincial Military Commission of WPK Convened
body: An enlarged meeting of the South Hamgyong Provincial Military Commission of the Workers' Party of Korea on Sept. 12 reviewed the reconstruction campaign conducted in August. The campaign is now in full swing in the flood-afflicted areas in the province through joint army-people operation. Present at the meeting were members of the provincial Party military commission, chief secretaries of the city and county Party committees, senior Party and administrative officials of province-level institutions and major factories and enterprises and military and political cadres of the People's Army units stationed in the province. Officials of cities and counties and relevant units deployed in the flood-hit areas took part in the meeting through video conferencing. At the meeting the instruction of the Central Military Commission of the WPK and the decision adopted at the August 5 enlarged meeting of the provincial Party military commission were read out again first by Chief Secretary of the South Hamgyong Provincial Committee of the WPK Ri Jong Nam. The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un took benevolent measures of urgently supplying major materials necessary for rehabilitation from the state reserves and seeing to it that powerful national material and financial support was rendered to the province for its recovery campaign, he said, and went on: The recovery campaign has been waged on a full scale true to the noble intention of the General Secretary who made sure the recovery campaign was launched by dint of the great army-people unity and building forces were dispatched, and who showed repeated paternal affection to stabilize the living of the flood victims as soon as possible. There was a detailed report on the rehabilitation campaign and analysis and review of the project conducted in August. Measures were taken for the Party organizations and officials to intensify the organizational and political work to thoroughly carry out the instruction of the Party Central Military Commission and to ensure the speed and quality of the construction at a high level. The meeting stressed the need for all the construction units to fully meet the requirements of design and construction method and push forward the overall project including construction of dwellings, rebuilding of bridges and river embankments and arrangement of roads and sections in a three-dimensional way. It also discussed the issues including the one of further scrupulously organizing the work for taking utmost care of the living of the flood victims, successfully finishing this year's farming, improving the land management and tightening emergency epidemic prevention work. The enlarged meeting emphasized that all the builders and servicepersons of the People's Army should exert themselves and successfully finish the rehabilitation campaign by the Party founding anniversary and present a report of loyalty and glory to the Party Central Committee. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Founding Anniversary Celebrated by Koreans in China
body: Celebrations were held by Koreans in China on the occasion of the 73rd founding anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK). On this occasion, they laid floral baskets and made a bow before the statue of President Kim Il Sung in Yuwen Middle School in Jilin and the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and art works depicting them at the DPRK embassy in Beijing and at the DPRK General Consulate in Shenyang. The General Association of Koreans in China sponsored a round-table talk at its conference hall on Sept. 7. Present there were officials of the general association including First Vice-Chairman Choe Su Bong, Vice-Chairman Cha Sang Bo who is also chairman of the Yanbian Regional Association, Vice-Chairpersons Ri Sun Nam and Kim Yong Nyo and other officials of the general association, Chairperson Han Song Ok and other members of the Federation of Young Korean Nationals in China and vice-chairpersons of the Federation of Korean Economic Workers in China. Speeches were made there. Colorful celebrations like meetings were held by the Yanbian and Mudanjiang regional associations under the general association. Rodong Sinmun

title: Founding Anniversary of DPRK Observed Abroad
body: Celebrations were held in different countries to mark the 73rd founding anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK). There took place meetings, seminars, lectures, film shows, book and photo exhibitions in Russia, Mongolia, Bangladesh, Syria, Pakistan, Denmark, Sweden, Ukraine, Finland, Serbia, Guinea, Nigeria, Libya, Algeria, Uganda and Mexico. Korean films were screened at film shows. The first secretary of the Khabarovsk Territorial Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation said that President Kim Il Sung organized and led an armed struggle against the powerful Japanese imperialists to liberate the country, adding that the foundation of the DPRK by the President came to be a great event to be specially recorded in the 5 000-year-long history of the Korean nation. The chairman of the Denmark-DPRK Friendship Association said that the DPRK has followed the road of victory and glory for a long time since its foundation under the leadership of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, noting that the DPRK is dynamically advancing toward the rosy future as it is now led by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. The chairman of the Central Committee of the Worker-Peasant Party of Pakistan and other personages of political and public circles referred to the significance of the foundation of the DPRK. Congratulatory messages to Kim Jong Un were adopted at the events held in Russia, Sweden and Finland. Rodong Sinmun

title: Pak Jong Chon Guides Test Firing Drill of Railway-borne Missile Regiment
body: Pak Jong Chon, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, guided a test firing drill of a railway-borne missile regiment. Among the spectators were officials of the Department of Political Leadership over Military Affairs and the Department of Munitions Industry of the C.C., WPK, leading officials of the General Staff of the Korean People's Army and the sector of research on national defence science. The 8th Congress of the Party, as part of the establishment of a new national defence strategy, organized a railway-borne missile regiment to increase the capability of dealing an intensive multi-concurrent blow at the forces posing threats to us at a time of conducting necessary military operations and to markedly improve the capability for more positively coping with various sorts of threats. The test firing drill took place for the purpose of confirming the practicality of the railway-borne missile system deployed for action for the first time, of judging the combat readiness and capability of performing firepower duty of the newly-organized regiment all of a sudden and of attaining proficiency in the action procedures in case of fighting an actual war. The railway-borne missile regiment took part in the drill with a mission to strike the target area 800 kilometers away from its location after moving to the central mountainous area at dawn on September 15. The regiment finished rapid movement and deployment according to the norm of the operation and action procedures of the railway-borne missile system, and accurately struck the target in the East Sea of Korea according to the firepower mission. Pak Jong Chon appreciated that the test firing drill of the regiment was successfully conducted in line with the strategic and tactical design and intention of our Party. Saying that the railway-borne missile system serves as an efficient counter-strike means capable of dealing a harsh multi-concurrent blow to the threat-posing forces through separate performances of firepower duty in different parts of the country, he called upon the army and relevant field to steadily round off tactical plans for properly applying this system to suit to the geographical conditions and actual situation of our country. He discussed in detail the matter of making the railway-borne missile regiment acquire the operational experience for actual war and expanding and reorganizing it as a railway-borne missile brigade at an early date in the future. He said that the deployment of the railway-borne missile system for action in accordance with the line and policies on modernizing the army set forth at the 8th Congress of our Party holds very great significance in increasing the war deterrence of the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Increasing Number of Locomotive Drivers Over-Fulfill Yearly Plans in Railway Transport
body: The number of locomotive crew members who have over-fulfilled yearly transport plans is on the increase in the field of railway transport. More than 200 crew members under the Ministry of Railways have fulfilled their yearly transport plans and several of them have honored their yearly plans at 200 percent. At least 70 locomotive crew including engineers of the Wonsan Service Brigade of Engine, the Tanchon Youth Service Brigade of Engine and the Kowon Service Brigade of Engine under the Hamhung Railway Bureau have finished yearly transport plans through an increased transport drive. Many crew members of the West Pyongyang Service Brigade of Engine under the Pyongyang Railway Bureau, the Sinsongchon Service Brigade of Engine and the Sariwon Service Brigade of Engine have recorded high results. At the Chongryong Rolling-Stock Service Brigade one locomotive engineer has finished yearly transport plan at over 220 percent and more than 10 have transported lots of materials to the different sectors of the national economy. Rodong Sinmun

title: Japanese Regime Accused of Discrimination against Korean Schools
body: Koreans in Japan and Japanese citizens continue their struggle in protest against the Japanese authorities' discrimination and violation of human rights against Korean schools. In February, the UN special rapporteurs on human rights in a joint letter warned the Japanese authorities not to engage in discriminative acts of excluding the students of Korean University from the subsidy program for students in connection with the widespread COVID-19, and urged them to correct their deeds. However, the then Japanese authorities justified their deeds, saying that the exclusion of students of Korean University "is not discrimination" and "the subsidy program already expired". Still now, the Japanese Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology and Foreign Ministry have Koreans in Japan excluded from the subsidy program, claiming that "there is no discrimination and the joint letter of the UN special rapporteurs on human rights is a view of individuals, not the one of the UN". Japan makes the judiciary authorities justify the discrimination. Students and teaching staff of Korean University and members of the national network, a solidarity organization supporting Korean schools that embraces Japanese civic organizations, held a meeting at the hall of members of the House of Councillors in Tokyo on September 7 to urge the Japanese authorities to correct their unreasonable discriminative system. Read out at the press conference held after the meeting was a letter of request to the minister of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology and foreign minister of Japan in demand of materializing the gist of the joint letter of the UN special rapporteurs on human rights and ensuring the impartiality in applying the subsidy program. A petition to the UN special rapporteurs on human rights was also read out there. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Inter-Sector Symposium on Medical Science Held
body: A national inter-sector symposium on medical science was held through video-conferencing from August 10 to September 15 under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of the Medical Association of Korea. The symposium was aimed at putting medical service on a higher scientific and modern basis and consolidating the material and technical foundations for public health. The symposium was divided into panels of 16 sectors and it was attended by about 600 doctors, researchers and teachers of over 60 units, including Kim Il Sung University, Korea General Red Cross Hospital, Kim Man Yu Hospital, Koryo Medicine General Hospital, the Academy of Medical Science, the Biomedicine Institute, the Medical Instrument Institute, provincial people's hospitals and universities of medicine. Hundreds of essays contributing to accelerating the development of the nation's medical science and technology and to promoting the people's health, including the issues of putting Koryo medicine on a scientific basis, applying advanced diagnosis and curative methods to clinical practice and ensuring the domestic production of medical instruments, etc. were presented at the symposium. During the symposium lectures were given on scientific and technological issues arising in the treatment of some diseases with high rates of contraction and death. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Symposium on Science and Technology in Field of Building Materials Held
body: A national symposium on science and technology in the field of building materials was held through video conferencing on September 14 and 15 under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea. The symposium held on the theme of "Local production of paints and coating materials" aims at contributing to boosting the independence of the building-materials industry by sharing and exchanging achievements and experiences gained in developing paints and coating materials on the basis of our own raw materials. Attending the symposium were scientists, technologists and researchers of more than ten units including the Paektusan Institute of Architecture, Pyongyang University of Architecture, Wonsan University of Agriculture and the Pyongyang Jonghyang Building Materials Factory. Teachers of the universities also attended the event. Presented there were over twenty valuable papers. During the symposium there was a lecture on the global trend of the development of paints and coating materials. Rodong Sinmun

title: Blasting of 250 000 Cubic Metres of Earth Successful at Sunchon Limestone Mine
body: Officials and workers of the Sunchon Limestone Mine all out for implementing the decisions of the Third Enlarged Meeting of the Political Bureau of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea have successfully carried out the blasting of 250 000 cubic meters of earth, providing another guarantee for increasing mineral production. They are concentrating efforts on the transport of limestone with high enthusiasm to uphold the grand plan of the Party with practical successes. Rodong Sinmun

title: Technology of Cultivating New Species of Blueberry Established
body: The Forest and Plant Engineering Institute under the Academy of Forest Science has established a technology of cultivating a new species of blueberry. The researchers of the institute buckled down to developing the technology from over 10 years ago to widely spread the new species, which is tasty and nutritious. Their strenuous research led to the cultivation of a new species which has high per-hectare yield and has been acclimatized to the climate not only in the central region of our country including Pyongyang but also in the areas south of it. Rodong Sinmun

title: 3rd Enlarged Plenary Meeting of 10th Central Committee of Socialist Patriotic Youth League Held
body: The 3rd Enlarged Plenary Meeting of the 10th Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League was held through video-conferencing on Thursday. Attending the meeting were members and alternate members of the Central Committee of the youth league. Present there as observers were officials of the ministry, national institution and provincial committees of the league. Discussed as major agenda items at the meeting were matters of thoroughly carrying out the important tasks set forth in the letter of congratulation sent by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un to the young people who volunteered to work in the difficult and challenging sectors of socialist construction and at the 3rd Enlarged Meeting of the Political Bureau of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Mun Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the youth league, made a report on the agenda items. He called upon the youth league organizations to prepare all the young people to be vanguard fighters who keep the boundless loyalty to the Party as their faith through offensive ideological education in various forms and ways to thoroughly implement the important tasks set forth in the letter of congratulation. He stressed the need for the officials of the youth league to go among the young people to explain the Party's policies, settle knotty problems and positively promote virtue and noble traits displayed among young people so as to increase the number of young people displaying noble traits. He detailed the achievements and mistakes made in the work of the youth league after the 8th Congress of the Party and set forth the ways for arousing the members of the league to the campaign for carrying out the important tasks set forth at the 3rd Enlarged Meeting of the Political Bureau of the 8th Central Committee of the Party by further boosting the militant function and role of the league organizations. Speeches were made there. Adopted at the meeting were relevant decisions based on the deep study of draft decisions. Rodong Sinmun

title: Workshop Held for Chairwomen of City and County Committees of Women's Union
body: A workshop for the chairwomen of the city and county committees of the women's union was held in Sariwon City from September 14 to 16. The workshop dealt with important matters arising in the current work of the women's union, including the one to increase the role of the city and county committees of the union in the struggle for thoroughly carrying out the important tasks set forth in the historic letter sent by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un to the participants in the 7th Congress of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea (SWUK). Kim Jong Sun, chairwoman of the Central Committee of the SWUK, and officials of the Central Committee of the union, took the platform. The workshop discussed it as an important subject to preserve and glorify the revolutionary nature of the women's union by furthering the work for establishing the unified leadership system of the respected General Secretary. It was dealt with at the workshop to launch a dynamic offensive for ideological education to fully prepare all members of the women's union to be genuine Kimilsungists-Kimjongilists. The workshop also discussed the matters of intensifying the education and campaign for sweeping away the anti-socialist and non-socialist practices. During the workshop, the participants visited the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex and conducted various political and cultural activities, including a show of multimedia. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Seminar Held in DR Congo
body: There took place a national seminar on the nation-building exploits of President Kim Il Sung and the revolutionary leadership exploits performed by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un for the last 10 years, during which he has led our Party and revolution to victory, in Kinshasa, DR Congo on September 9, the 73rd founding anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. Attending the seminar were figures of the African Regional Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea, the Communist Party of the Democratic Congo and the Democratic Congo-Korea Friendship and Solidarity Association and members of the organizations for the study of the Juche idea in DR Congo, including the National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of DR Congo. The deputy general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the DR Congo who is the chairman of the Democratic Congo-Korea Friendship and Solidarity Association made a keynote address at the seminar. He said that President Kim Il Sung founded the DPRK to open up a new era for the building of an independent and sovereign state. Saying it is the greatest exploit of Kim Il Sung that he successfully settled the issue of succession to the revolutionary cause of Juche, the speaker stressed that thanks to the outstanding leadership of Chairman Kim Jong Il, the DPRK could invariably follow the road of its development, breaking through the upheavals of history, under the uplifted banner of the Juche idea. He praised the revolutionary exploits of Kim Jong Un who has put the DPRK on the position of strategic state with his toughness despite the vicious moves of the hostile forces and developed it into the one and only country of the people in the world. Speakers said that African countries should build a new society by relying on the might of the people, smashing the imperialists' moves for interference and aggression, under the uplifted banner of independence. A solidarity statement was adopted at the seminar. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Sci-Tech Presentation of Chemical Materials Field Held
body: A national sci-tech presentation of chemical materials field took place through video conferencing from September 14 to 16 under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea. The theme of the presentation was "Local Production of Raw and Other Materials and Recycling" and the aim was to widely disseminate and generalize the successes and experience gained in the researches on chemical materials and to increase the production of chemical goods conducive to the economic construction and the improvement of the standard of people's living. Officials, teachers, researchers and graduate students of scientific and educational organs including Kim Il Sung University, Kim Chaek University of Technology and the State Academy of Science participated in the presentation. Presented to it were over 100 essays, completed in the course of academic pursuit and creation for developing chemical materials sector. Highly appreciated to be of great practical significance were those essays that proved in depth the sci-tech problems arising in making our own-type catalyst, pencil lead material, nano-paint powder, nano-sulfur liquid, etc. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Sci-Tech Presentation of Metallic Materials Sector Held
body: A national sci-tech presentation on metallic materials took place through video conferencing from September 14 to 16 under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea. The theme of the presentation was "Development of Metallic Materials Based on Our Country's Resources". The presentation was aimed at dynamically promoting the country's development of materials technology through comprehensive sharing of sci-tech successes made in metallic materials sector and exchange of good experience. It was attended by teachers, researchers, graduate students and field technicians from Kim Chaek University of Technology, Ferrous Metal Research Institute under the State Academy of Sciences and other several units. Presented to it were over 40 essays on scientific research successes conducive to the development of the national economy. During the presentation, a lecture on the trend of development of metallic materials was given. Rodong Sinmun

title: Remains of Martyrs Buried in Patriotic Martyrs Cemetery in Sinmi-ri
body: Remains of martyrs who left indelible traces on the sacred road for the Party, revolution, country and people were buried in the Patriotic Martyrs Cemetery in Sinmi-ri with due ceremonies on September 16. Jon Ku Gang was the first female general officer who lived a worthwhile military service life as an officer in medical field for decades and then as a lecturer of the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum. Choe Pong Man contributed to the development of our Party while working at the Central Committee of the Party. Kang Song San devotedly worked for the country and people while working at important posts of the Party and the government for a long time. Pak In Yong, former general officer of the Korean People's Army, made a positive contribution to bolstering up the defence capabilities of the country, and Kim Pyong Hwa, former adviser of the creation section of the National Symphony Orchestra, contributed to the development of the Juche-oriented symphony orchestra. Speeches were made at the ceremonies and remains of the martyrs were buried. Participants laid wreaths, bouquets and flowers before the graves of martyrs and observed a moment's silence in memory of them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Collective Innovation Drive Brisk in Several Sectors of National Economy
body: Several fields of the national economy are waging collective innovation drive by positively organizing the campaigns in which one overtakes and learns from others and swaps experience with one another. The Ministry of Electric Power Industry is scrupulously organizing the work for generalizing the good experiences gained in overhauling generating equipment and operating them after setting the Pyongyang Thermal Power Plant and the Jangjingang Power Station as exemplary units. Thermal power plants and hydro-power stations across the country are pushing ahead with the work for applying the successes made in recycling waste oil and establishing real-time efficiency-measuring system. They are creating fresh experience and technology while sharing experience. The Ministry of Coal Industry is organizing video conferencing to help all the coal mines quickly draw on experience and sci-tech achievements made in the campaign for increasing the coal production. It is conducting effective work for generalizing them by various modes and methods including visit, exhibition and show. It makes sure collective innovation drive is effected by turning the high-speed tunneling game into the course of exchanging and sharing successes and excellent experience with those units going ahead of them, not simple competition for deciding standings. In the course of doing it, hundreds of reserve cutting faces were secured and more than 3 000 valuable sci-tech achievements made and applied this year alone. Traits of teaching and learning from each other and enriching experience are prevailing in several sectors including light industry and railway transport. Rodong Sinmun

title: Farm Machines Overhauled
body: Agricultural officials and workers in the DPRK have finished the overhaul of farm machines as part of preparations for harvesting and threshing. Officials of the Ministry of Agriculture and provincial rural economy committees drew up detailed plans for overhauling farm machines and scrupulously controlled the overhauling. Pyongyang City had tens of combined rice threshers remodeled and hundreds of threshers overhauled. Paechon County of South Hwanghae Province produced more than 1 800 spare parts of over 20 kinds and other counties tackled technical problems arising in the production of spare parts. South Phyongan and North and South Hamgyong provinces, etc. manufactured various farm machines while overhauling farm machines. Rodong Sinmun

title: 73rd Founding Anniversary of DPRK Marked Abroad
body: A joint celebration meeting was held in Dakha by the Workers' Party of Bangladesh, the Bangladesh National Socialist Party, the Communist Party of Bangladesh (Marxist-Leninist), the Bangladesh Institute of the Juche Idea and the Bangladesh-Korea Friendship and Solidarity Committee on Sept. 8 ahead of the 73rd founding anniversary of the DPRK. Speeches were made by the chairperson of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Bangladesh, the general secretary of the Central Executive Committee of the Bangladesh National Socialist Party, the secretary general of the Bangladesh Institute of the Juche Idea and others. Meanwhile, similar meetings took place in Russia, Belarus and Britain and lectures in Nepal, Mexico and Venezuela from Sept. 7 to 9. The events were attended by personages and other people of those countries. A congratulatory message to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un was adopted at the celebration meeting held in Belarus. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Hypotheses and Ideas Presentation Held
body: There took place the 12th national hypotheses and ideas presentation under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea through video-conferencing from September 13 to 17. The presentation was aimed at developing more hypotheses and novel ideas to be conducive to the economic development and improvement of people's living standard. It was attended by teachers, researchers, technicians, field officials and others of education, scientific research and production units, including Kim Il Sung University, Kim Chaek University of Technology, the State Academy of Sciences, the Academy of Agricultural Science, Pyongyang Dental Hygiene Products Factory and Wonsan Disabled Soldiers' Essential Plastic Goods Factory. More than 190 proposals were introduced at the presentation held divided into eight panels including agriculture and chemistry. Rodong Sinmun

title: Ryongjon Fruit Farm Reaps Rich Apple Harvest
body: Picking apples is in the height at the Ryongjon Fruit Farm, a thriving orchard in Pukchong County, South Hamgyong Province. Its officials and agricultural workers have tended apple trees with much care with a single mind to glorify this year, which marks the 60th anniversary of the Pukchong enlarged meeting of the Presidium of the WPK Central Committee, with increased production. Now the farm is registering a high record every day in collecting apples by meticulously organizing and commanding the collection so as not to leave even a single apple. Tractor drivers timely carry the collected apples to storehouses to prevent them from being bruised. Rodong Sinmun

title: Cuban President Sends Floral Basket to DPRK Embassy
body: Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez, president of the Republic of Cuba, on Sept. 14 sent a floral basket to the DPRK embassy in Havana to congratulate the 73rd founding anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. Rodong Sinmun

title: Founding Anniversary of DPRK Marked in Brazil
body: A joint online seminar on the theme "The 73rd founding anniversary of people's Korea-Korean leaders" took place in Brazil on Sept. 9, the founding anniversary. The chairperson of the Brazilian Center for the Study of Songun Politics said that President Kim Il Sung founded the DPRK, the people's country, the first of its kind in 5 000-year-long history of the nation and ensured that the DPRK shines brilliantly as a socialist country of Juche all over the world. The chairperson of the Brazilian Center for the Study of the Juche Idea stressed that Chairman Kim Jong Il left the record of immortal revolutionary activities with his strong will to champion socialist Korea, the greatest legacy left by Kim Il Sung out of patriotism, at a time when the country faced the harshest-ever ordeals. The chairperson of the Brazil-People's Korea Study Center pointed out that socialist Korea founded and developed by the preceding leaders sheds bright rays as ever under the guidance of the respected H.E. Kim Jong Un. Meanwhile, the Democratic Rally of Africa-Democratic Party of Guinea held a seminar on Kim Jong Il's works, the Nigerian Group for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism a seminar on the achievements performed by Kim Jong Un during his 10-year-long revolutionary leadership and the Nepal Journalist Association a seminar on the exploits by the peerlessly great persons in founding and developing the DPRK on the same occasion. Rodong Sinmun

title: Emergency Epidemic Prevention Campaign Toughened in DPRK
body: The emergency epidemic prevention sectors of the DPRK at all levels are steadily intensifying the anti-pandemic campaign. The central emergency epidemic prevention sector is constantly reinforcing the anti-pandemic system, keeping a close watch on the worldwide spread of COVID-19, while putting primary efforts into thoroughly establishing tough discipline and order to make all sectors and units absolutely obey the state's unified command and control. The inspection and quarantine sector makes sure that its personnel guard the country's epidemic prevention field, mindful that even a tiny failure is not tolerable. The medical treatment sector is further toughening the medical check-up and examination of residents and making scrupulous work to find and treat in good time patients including those who suffer from chronic diseases. The passenger service sector ensures that vehicles are correctly disinfected and that customers at stops abide by a rule of hand-disinfecting and temperature-measuring. The emergency epidemic prevention sectors across the country are toughening education and control to ensure that the inhabitants strictly abide by anti-pandemic rules and orders of conduct in public places and that they inform the relevant organs of any abnormal practices in time. Rodong Sinmun

title: Anti-Epizootic Work Intensified in DPRK
body: Officials and workers of veterinary and stock-breeding field play big roles in developing stock-breeding in a stable and sustainable way. The Ministry of Agriculture is intensifying command and guidance for relevant units to take practical measures under a detailed autumn-season anti-epizootic plan. The Central Epizootic Prevention Center of the Ministry and anti-epizootic institutions at all levels are tightening regional epidemic surveillance and disease outbreak notification system based on their own material and technical foundations. Provincial, city and county anti-epizootic stations make sure stock-breeding units inoculate domestic animals on the occasion of veterinary and hygienic anti-epizootic month. They are also actively exploring and tapping resources for producing veterinary medicines. Anti-epizootic officials of stock-breeding units across the country are doing inoculation and examination of domestic animals to suit to their growth state and the seasonal characteristics. They are putting efforts into encouraging people to set up epidemic prevention facilities and to ensure clean and hygienic environment to make the anti-epizootic work part of their daily life. Rodong Sinmun

title: Reception Given in China to Mark DPRK Founding Anniversary
body: The Chinese People's Association for Friendship with Foreign Countries and the China-Korea Friendship Association jointly hosted a reception in Beijing on September 17 to mark the 73rd founding anniversary of the DPRK. Present there on invitation were DPRK Ambassador to China Ri Ryong Nam and staff members of his embassy. On hand were Lin Songtian, president of the Chinese People's Association for Friendship with Foreign Countries, and officials concerned including those of the International Liaison Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Ministry of Culture and Tourism, the Central Military Commission of China. Speeches were made. The president of the Chinese People's Association for Friendship with Foreign Countries wished the Korean people greater success in the struggle for implementing the decisions made at the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea under the leadership of the Party led by General Secretary Kim Jong Un, adding that the DPRK has achieved a great progress in carrying out the cause of socialism despite all difficulties for the last 73 years. He noted that the friendship between China and the DPRK provided and cultivated by the leaders of the two parties and two countries in the course of protracted revolutionary struggle and socialist construction has steadily developed to be handed over as common wealth generation after generation, despite the changes of international situation and times. DPRK Ambassador Ri Ryong Nam said that the foundation of the DPRK was a birth of independent and popular state, the first of its kind in the 5 000-year-long history of the Korean nation, and a great event ushering in a new era of building a powerful country. He said that the DPRK would make positive efforts, together with Chinese comrades, to consolidate and develop the relations of friendship and cooperation between the DPRK and China which have been placed on a new high stage as intended by the top leaders of the two countries. A performance was given by Chinese artistes and children at the reception. Rodong Sinmun

title: Emergency Measures Taken to Prevent Damage by Strong Wind and Hailstorm
body: True to the intention of the Party that set it as a vital issue in attaining this year's goal of grain production to surmount disastrous abnormal weather, the agricultural sector of the DPRK is directing efforts to protecting the crops from damage by possible strong wind and hailstorm. Officials of agricultural guidance organs at all levels, regarding it as a fait accompli to be inflicted by hailstorm, discussed the technical issues and have taken emergency measures to cope with it, while conducting powerful political work to arouse the popular masses to harvesting and threshing. The Ministry of Agriculture is widely disseminating technical methods to prevent damage by strong wind and hailstorm and sending officials to rural areas to solve problems in time. North Phyongan Province is tapping all efforts and means to obviate imperfection in preventing damage. South Hwanghae Province steps up rice harvesting after examining the ripeness of rice. Several counties of South Phyongan Province are speeding up the work to cord cornstalks in sheaves, while taking measures to harvest crops in the fields vulnerable to damage by hailstorms. And the units where rice harvesting began are tying rice in sheaves and piling them in an effective way. North Hwanghae Province, Nampho City, etc. are properly cultivating unripe paddy rice to lower the loss. Rodong Sinmun
