He said that the scientific research field should regard it as the core, main assignment and priority task to immediately resolve the urgent sci-tech problems in economic construction and people's living, step up the research and development for it and introduce its successes into practice in order to gain actual benefits. Saying that it is one of the very important tasks facing the government of the Republic to turn the country into an advanced country in education, he called for opening up a new period of development in socialist education, guided by the Party's policy of attaching importance to education and talents. He also stressed the need to constantly conduct the work for properly training teachers, proactively exploring and introducing new contents, system and methods into further improving the quality of education, promoting the university education as required by the global education development trend in order to train more talents majoring in development and creation and those with practical knowledge. He also referred to the important tasks in improving education conditions and environment and the issue of increasing the stipends for university students. Saying that to establish the health system capable of tangibly promoting the health of all the people is an important task of our socialist state, the fulfillment of which brooks no further delay, he called for taking decisive measures to put the material and technical foundations of the public health sector on a high level and improving the quality of health service. Saying that the government of the Republic should develop the art and literature, media and sports as required by the times and the reality and as demanded and intended by the people as it is duty-bound to assume the responsibility for taking care of the destiny and moral and cultural life of the people and the rising generations and for leading them to a right path, he laid down the immediate tasks for doing so. He said that the government of the Republic should ceaselessly intensify the education in communist morality and collectivism in a methodological way among officials, working people and the younger generations in accordance with the people's state of consciousness and the changed environment. He advanced the tasks to be fulfilled to further tighten epidemic prevention measures, the top priority work of the government of the Republic at present that requires flawlessness. Calling for turning the present epidemic prevention system into more reliable and developed one, he referred to the important issues arising in steadily preserving the public epidemic prevention atmosphere and the people's voluntary unity of action by making the work of abiding by the epidemic prevention regulations and order their own vital requirements and habit, and in putting the country's epidemic prevention foundations on a scientific basis and thoroughly ensuring the popular character in the emergency epidemic prevention work. Noting that it is the top-priority right of a sovereign state to bolster the national defence power and the existence and development of our own-style socialism would have been absolutely unthinkable without the steady strengthening of the national defence power, Kim Jong Un called for attaining with thorough-going practices the goals of defence up-building set forth at the 8th Party Congress by strengthening the armed forces of the Republic in every way and putting the defence industry on a high-level Juche, modern and scientific basis. He underscored the need to strengthen the socialist legal system, further improve the function and role of people's power as required by the times and thus consolidate our politico-ideological position and class position in every way. People's power organs should make sure unconditional service for the people run through all their activities in conformity with their duty, direct them towards the realization of the will, demand and interests of the people and never allow any slightest practices and elements against the nature of the people-centered socialist system, he said. He noted the methods to build up the ranks of power organ officials with men of ability, who will conduct every work in a brave and innovative way with high Party spirit, revolutionary spirit and loyalty to the people, rationally rearrange the structure and work system of power organs and thus make our people's power fulfill its role as a political weapon dynamically advancing the cause of socialism. Kim Jong Un outlined and assessed the present inter-Korean relations still locked in insecure and grave deadlock and the situation of the Korean peninsula before clarifying the policy towards the south at the present stage. He said that different military drills and arms buildup under the pretext of "containing" the DPRK have become conspicuous in south Korea and dishonest remarks and behaviors getting on our nerves and provoking us regardless of time have been heard from it. Noting that the south Korean authorities are bent on begging external support and cooperation while clamoring for international cooperation in servitude to the U.S., he said that as regards the issue of declaring the termination of war proposed by south Korea recently, though the termination of war is declared, hostile acts would be continued and, therefore, unexpected different clashes repeated, arousing the anxiety of all the fellow countrymen and international community only, as long as there remain factors, the apple of distrust and confrontation between the north and the south, intact. It is the invariable demand repeatedly explained by us to ensure the respect for each other and withdraw the partial view, unfair and double-dealing attitude and hostile viewpoint and policies towards the other side before declaring the termination of war, and this is an important task to be settled beforehand in order to control the inter-Korean relations and open up a bright future, he noted. Pointing out to the attitude of the south Korean authorities who have shown no sign of change while ignoring and neglecting the sources of aggravated inter-Korean relations though they are well aware of them, he said that now the inter-Korean relations stand at the crossroads of serious choices-either to advance toward reconciliation and cooperation after warming the present cooled-off relations or to suffer from national division amid a vicious cycle of confrontation and advanced the principled matters for the fundamental settlement of the north-south relations. It is important for the south Korean authorities to change its confrontational and habitual attitude toward our Republic, keep the stand of national independence through practices, not with words, deal with the inter-Korean relations with a view to settling the essential matters and give weight to and sincerely implement the north-south declarations, he stressed. Kim Jong Un said we are closely watching the fact that recently, the U.S. and south Korea are destroying the stability and balance around the Korean peninsula and inviting more complicated dangers of clash between the north and the south through excessive arms buildup and allied military activities that arouse concerns, underscoring the need to stand against the gangster logic of the U.S. and south Korea, bitterly denounce it, firmly maintain our invariable standpoint to check such dangerous trend, and take all necessary tough measures. Saying we obviously remind the south Korean authorities of the fact once again that it depends on the attitude of the south Korean authorities whether the inter-Korean relations would be restored and develop onto a new stage or continue to keep the present state of worsening, he noted that we have neither aim nor reason to provoke south Korea and no idea to harm it and it is necessary for south Korea to promptly get rid of the delusion, crisis awareness and awareness of getting harmed that it should deter the north's provocation. He expressed the intention to see to it that the north-south communication lines that had been cut off due to the deteriorated inter-Korean relations are restored first from early October as part of the efforts for realizing the expectations and desire of the entire Korean nation to see the earlier recovery of the north-south relations from the present deadlock and durable peace settling in the Korean peninsula. He analyzed the current international political situation and underlined the need for the field in charge of foreign affairs to more proactively and positively cope with the eventful ever-changing external environment. Saying that there now exist not a few serious crises and challenges facing the world but the fundamental danger comes from the U.S. and its vassal forces' high-handed and arbitrary practices that destroy the foundation of international peace and stability, he noted that the current international situation is mainly characterized by the fact that it has got more complicated as the structure of the international relations has been reduced to the structure of "neo-Cold War" due to the U.S. unilateral and prejudiced bloc-forming style external policy. Pointing out that the U.S. remains utterly unchanged in posing military threats and pursuing hostile policy toward the DPRK but employs more cunning ways and methods in doing so, as proven by the deeds done by it over the past eight months since the emergence of its new administration, he said that the U.S. is touting "diplomatic engagement" and "dialogue without preconditions" but it is no more than a petty trick for deceiving the international community and hiding its hostile acts and an extension of the hostile policy pursued by the successive U.S. administrations. He tasked the field in charge of foreign affairs with concentrating on providing tactical measures for thoroughly implementing the strategic policy of the DPRK government toward the U.S. on the basis of strictly studying and analyzing the present U.S. administration's stand on the DPRK, the prospects of the U.S. political situation and ever-changing international balance of forces within the framework of their correlations. He urged the field in charge of foreign affairs to put primary efforts into the work for firmly protecting the sovereignty of the country and its independent development interests while proactively coping with the international political situation and the surrounding environment that get more and more unstable. He affirmed that the DPRK government will as ever develop its good neighborly relations with all the countries in the world that respect its sovereignty and are friendly toward it, and fulfill its responsibility and role in the struggle for preserving peace and stability of the Korean peninsula. Saying that all the people in the country entrust their destiny totally to the Republic, regarding it as the very one ensuring their worthwhile life, he noted that such great trust is the dearest and most valuable asset possessed by the WPK and the DPRK government and it is the most sacred and glorious obligation we assumed before tens of millions of citizens of the country to live up to the trust. Solemnly evincing the iron will of the WPK and the DPRK government to remain boundlessly loyal to the great people and do their best to fulfill their weighty mission and responsibility, he ardently appealed to everyone to work hard for the prosperity of the great country DPRK, for happiness and wellbeing of the great people and for fresh development of Korean-style socialist construction under the uplifted slogan of "The People Are God", single-minded unity and self-reliance. The important policy speech made by him at the session is an undying program that powerfully accelerates the development of Korean-style socialist construction by injecting great vitality and courage into the all-people struggle for attaining the goals for victory set by the 8th Congress of the WPK and enhancing the fighting efficiency of the state power organs in an all-round way. The full text of the historic policy speech will be published and distributed among party organizations and working people's organizations, people's power organs, armed forces organs, judicial and prosecutorial organs and public security organs at all levels and organs in charge of south Korean and foreign affairs. Political News Team

title: Bouquets
body: Women innovators of the Phyongchon Trolleybus Station are broadly smiling after receiving bouquets. They keep travelling along the street regarding the citizens’ smiles as their own joy. Kept in their hearts is the attachment to their workplace and sense of duty as servants of the people. The bouquets they received reflect the collectives’ love for and trust in the women innovators who carry on their service out of invariable conscience and patriotic loyalty. We proudly boast of the women innovators who value national affairs more than their family ones and shoulder upon themselves the heavy burdens of the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: World of Working People
body: All countries have their own systems and they all have their own ways of life. However, no one but only our people enjoy the most proud and worthwhile life in the most superior social system throughout the world. Our society is the genuine one for people in which the working people enjoy the valuable life as the masters of everything. In our country the slogan "We Serve the People!" can be seen everywhere and the edifices for people such as the Grand People’s Study House and the People’s Palace of Culture have been built in every quarter of the country. The issue of dwelling houses alone clearly shows the popular nature of our society. Our country is the only one in which the Party and state direct much efforts to building dwelling houses and provide them to ordinary working people free of charge. Socialism is our people’s life and blood. Such iron truth is not taught by anyone else at all. However our people have discerned it by themselves while enjoying happiness and overcoming trials on the long road of history. Our people have never considered their destiny to be apart from socialism. We like best our country in which the working people enjoy dignified and worthwhile lives as its masters and our system where everybody lives in a large harmonious family sharing pleasure and sorrow together. Our people’s support for and trust in our socialism are unshakable. Without socialism, there is no happiness of my own and our family as well as the rosy future of our sons and daughters! This is the firm faith kept deep in our people’s hearts. Rodong Sinmun

title: Warm Cradle
body: Seen at the windows of the brightly-lit Pyongyang Baby Home are children who received dairy products bearing great love. Little as they are, they don’t know how great and warm the love they are bestowed upon is. They look as if they were ready to say “We are happy!” in clear voices. The children grow under the daily deepening warm care of the Party. We are reminded of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un’s words that touched the heartstrings of tens of millions of parents throughout the country. He said that there is no more important revolutionary work than the work of bringing up children, the future of the country, to be strong and sound and that it is the most important policy and supreme desire of our Party and state to provide children with more improved conditions even at the cost of huge sum of money. Our children are growing up healthily under the warm love and care of the General Secretary. Grow up to be more bright and more cheerful, you lucky children. As you have the socialist country, a warm cradle which holds up children as its king, your future will be bright and rosy as ever. Rodong Sinmun

title: Anti-aircraft Missile Newly Developed by Academy of Defence Science Test-fired
body: The Academy of Defence Science of the DPRK test-fired an anti-aircraft missile newly developed by it on September 30, to confirm the practicality of operation of the launcher, radar and all-purpose battle command vehicle as well as the comprehensive combat performance of the missile. Pak Jong Chon, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, watched the test-launch with leading officials in the sector of national defence scientific research. The Academy of Defence Science said that the overall test is of very practical significance in studying and developing various prospective anti-aircraft missile systems, noting that the remarkable combat performance of the new-type anti-aircraft missile that has brought about a substantial increase in the rapid responsiveness and guidance accuracy of missile control system as well as the distance of downing air targets with the introduction of new key technologies like a twin-rudder control technology and double-impulse flight engine has been verified. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Greetings to President Xi Jinping
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), sent a message of greeting to Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC) and president of the People's Republic of China (PRC), on Oct. 1. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un in the message extended warm congratulations on behalf of the WPK, the government of the DPRK and the Korean people and on his own behalf to General Secretary Xi Jinping and to the CPC, the government of the PRC and the fraternal Chinese people on the occasion of the 72nd founding anniversary of the PRC. The message said that for 72 years after the foundation of the PRC, the Chinese people have made great successes in the struggle to carve out the destiny of the nation and achieve its prosperity under the leadership of the CPC, braving all sorts of challenges and difficulties of history. Noting that the Chinese people entered a historic course for attaining a fresh goal of building a modern socialist country after comprehensively building up a well-off society, the message said that as comrades and friends, we are pleased with the successes made in socialist China as our own. The message expressed belief that the Chinese nation's dream of rejuvenation will surely come true as there are the socialist idea with the Chinese characteristics for the new times and devoted efforts of the Chinese people close rallied around the CPC with General Secretary Xi Jinping as its core. The message said that the WPK, the DPRK government and people will firmly support the Chinese party, government and people in their just struggle to defeat the hostile forces' frantic anti-China confrontational moves and defend the sovereignty, right to development and territorial integrity of the country. Saying that now the two parties and two countries demonstrate the comradely unity while strengthening the strategic and tactical cooperation in the common struggle for advancing the cause of socialism and defending the regional peace and stability, the message expressed belief that the traditional friendly and cooperative relations between the DPRK and China will steadily develop in conformity with the common desire of the two parties and the peoples of the two countries in the future, too. The message sincerely wished General Secretary Xi Jinping good health and greater success in his work. It also wished the PRC prosperity and the Chinese people happiness and well-being. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK's Founding Anniversary Marked Abroad
body: The progressive humankind significantly celebrated the 73rd anniversary of the founding of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK). The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received congratulatory messages and letters from party and state leaders of different countries including China, Russia, Mongolia, Syria, Iran, Vietnam, Indonesia, Cambodia, DR Congo, Algeria, Uganda, Ethiopia, Equatorial Guinea, Zimbabwe, Belarus, Italy, the Czech Republic, Serbia, Nicaragua, Mexico, Venezuela, Ecuador and Peru and personages of political, public and economic circles, the military, and international and regional bodies on the occasion of the founding anniversary of the DPRK. He received floral baskets from heads of state of Laos and Palestine and the national chairman of the People's Progressive Party of Nigeria and members of the Board of Directors of the Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation. Floral baskets were sent to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill by the families of overseas persons related to the revolutionary activities of the President, foreign organizations and personages. The president of the Republic of Cuba, the president of the International Group of Italy, the Lao foreign minister, political party leaders and chiefs of organizations of Mexico, and governments, political parties and organizations of different countries sent floral baskets and bouquets to DPRK missions in their countries. Personages of many countries and international bodies paid congratulatory visits to the DPRK missions. Representing boundless reverence for the peerlessly great men who demonstrated the powerful might of Juche Korea to the world, an Indonesian organization issued a statement, the chairman of the Supreme Council of the National Socialist Party (Romania), the chairman of the Sweden-Korea Friendship Association and the secretary general of the Korean Friendship Association UK dedicated articles, and the first secretary of the Sakhalin Regional Branch Committee of the Lenin Young Communist League of the Russian Federation, the chairman of the Arab Committee for Solidarity with Korean People and Supporting the Reunification of Korea and the chairman of the Kuwait-DPRK Friendship Association issued press statements. Meanwhile, colorful political and cultural events took place all over the world including a national seminar, a joint online seminar, a joint celebration meeting in DR Congo, Brazil and Bangladesh. The events praised President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un for making great contributions to the founding of the DPRK and its development. World media dedicated special write-ups before and after September 9. The media carried articles illustrated with portraits of smiling Kim Il Sung and his photos, photos of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il standing together and photos dealing with revolutionary activities of Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK's Delegation Attends 11th International Legal Forum
body: There was the 11th International Legal Forum of the Asia-Pacific on September 30 through video conferencing. Attending the forum were delegations and delegates from various countries including the delegation of the Central Court of the DPRK headed by President Cha Myong Nam. Congratulatory speeches were made. The head of the DPRK delegation said in his speech that the forum serves as a significant and important occasion in promoting the common understanding of laws and practical activities of regional countries for achieving steady prosperity and development, noting that the Asia-Pacific regional countries are faced with the joint task to cope with worldwide challenges though they have differing development history and economic conditions. He appealed to each country and region to get united in the idea of independence, peace and friendship and boost the legal cooperation for peace, stability and prosperity, expressing the belief that the forum will make a due contribution to cementing the scientific foundation for just and fair law. Speeches were made then. A member of the DPRK's delegation referred to the fact that the DPRK provides a legal foundation for acknowledging the judgments of foreign courts and for approving and executing arbitration decisions conducive to court activity and economic development of regional countries, and that it protects legitimate rights, interests and management activities of foreign investment enterprises and creates a legal environment favorable for international economic cooperation. He said that an important matter essential for ensuring the stability of international economic cooperation is to wage a joint struggle to cope with the U.S. arrogant moves, calling upon every country in the region to further boost the international cooperation and solidarity for achieving the regional security and economic prosperity in the face of the U.S. reckless and hostile moves toward the DPRK. He said that the Central Court of the DPRK would continue to provide an international legal guarantee for the settlement of economic disputes with regional countries on the principles of respect for sovereignty, equality and mutual benefits in the future, too, emphasizing that the DPRK would steadily develop the legal support and cooperation with countries aspiring after sound economic development of the region. Rodong Sinmun

title: Afforestation and Conservation of Cyclic Felling Areas in Full Swing
body: The forestry sector is directing efforts into afforestation and conservation of cyclic felling areas. The Ministry of Forestry set yearly and long-term plans based on the geographical characteristics and realistic conditions of the areas, and is carrying them out without fail. Until September, the ministry has carried out tree-planting in thousands of hectares of felled and treeless areas respectively followed by the additional planting of saplings and substantial cultivation and management, thus highly increasing the rate of rooting. Forest fire prevention, the primary task in forest protection, was carried out on a mass scale and many structures such as stone cut-offs and water catchments were made. Afforestation stations have created parasitic bee breeding grounds, solved the breeding parasitic bee and feed issues on their own and released lots of parasitic bees so as to minimize damage by forest pest. They have also set up a biological insecticide production process and regularized production. Rodong Sinmun

title: International Day of Older Persons Celebrated in DPRK
body: The elderly of the DPRK celebrated International Day of Older Persons. Officials of Party and power organs at all levels visited old folks' homes. They presented the old folks, who had dedicated themselves to the prosperity of the country, with souvenirs and asked about their living and health. Public catering and welfare service units of Pyongyang provided special services for the elderly. Staff of public catering centers such as Okryu, Chongryu and Hyangmanru restaurants served famed national and other dishes to them with utmost sincerity. The welfare service establishments accorded the old folks special services, pleasing them. There were also various activities for the elderly across the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Presentation on Recycling Technology Held in DPRK
body: A presentation on recycling technology took place from Sept. 27 to Oct. 1 through video conferencing under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea. The presentation was aimed at widely sharing and generalizing the sci-tech successes and experience gained in the efforts for implementing the Party's policy on realizing domestic production of raw and other materials and promoting recycling. It was attended by officials, scientists, technicians, teachers, three-revolution team members and others from over 70 units including the State Academy of Sciences, Kanggye University of Agriculture and Forestry, Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Silk Mill and the Unryul Mine. More than 150 proposals were submitted to the presentation which was held divided into the panels of light industry, agriculture, chemical industry, building materials industry, food and consumer goods industry. During the presentation, the participants watched a video titled "Economical Recycling." Rodong Sinmun

title: National Exhibition of IT Successes 2021 Opens
body: The National Exhibition of IT Successes-2021 opened on Friday. The exhibition on the theme of "Self-reliance and Enthusiasm for Making IT Successes" is aimed to give wide publicity to the IT industrial successes and IT products made in the first year for implementing the 5-year plan for national economic development and exchange and disseminate them in order to promote the development of science and technology. Displayed at the exhibition opened through local network are over 1 200 good research successes and IT products presented by hundreds of units including ministries, national institutions, the people's committees of each province (municipality), scientific research institutions and education and public health organs. Homepages for prize show, 3-D and 2-D exhibitions, artificial intelligence program contest, sharing of experience, public estimation and exchange and presentation of impressions were set up under the title "National Exhibition of IT Successes-2021" in the website "Platform for National Exhibition of IT Successes". The homepages for 3-D and 2-D exhibitions are divided into the panels for IT successes, IT industrial successes, sectional successes and regional successes. Everyone can browse the exhibited IT successes and products any time on the network. The exhibition will last till October 29. Rodong Sinmun

title: 25th General Meeting of Korean Youth Commercial Association in Japan Held
body: The 25th general meeting of the Korean Youth Commercial Association in Japan took place in Tokyo on Sept. 25. Attending the meeting were Pak Ku Ho, first vice-chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) who is also director of its Organization Department, Jo Il Yon, vice-chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the Chongryon, Ri Song Chol, director of its Economic Department, and members and representatives of the commercial association including Chairman Paek Kyu Yong. The meeting discussed and decided the orientation of work and tasks for the 25th-term Central Standing Management Board of the commercial association to play a leading role in ushering in a new heyday of patriotic movement. Pae Chang Ryol, chairman of Central Standing Management Board of the association, made a report on its work. He referred to such successes made by the 24th-term Central Standing Management Board as further increasing the role of the organization and consolidating the single-minded unity by giving the fullest play to the spirit of officials of the association. He brought forward 6 major tasks, saying that the commercial association set it as the general orientation of the work of the 25th-term Central Standing Management Board to further rev up the overall atmosphere of the Korean community in Japan by strengthening all its basic organizations into more vibrant ones. Speeches were made by officials from different organizations under the commercial association. The general meeting elected Choe Pyong Ho as chairman of the commercial association and Song Myong Nam, chairman of its Central Standing Management Board. Rodong Sinmun

title: KCNA Report
body: The Korean Central News Agency issued the following report on Monday: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), in the historic policy speech he made at the 5th Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, expressed the intention of restoring the cut-off north-south communication lines as part of the effort to realize the expectation and desire of the entire nation who want the north-south relations to be restored as soon as possible and lasting peace to be settled on the Korean Peninsula. The relevant organs decided to restore all the north-south communication lines from 9:00 on Oct. 4 true to his intention. The south Korean authorities should make positive efforts to put the north-south ties on a right track and settle the important tasks which must be prioritized to open up the bright prospect in the future, bearing deep in mind the meaning of the restoration of communication lines. Rodong Sinmun

title: New Posters Produced in DPRK
body: The Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House has produced posters encouraging all the people to the implementation of the important tasks set forth in the historic policy speech made by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. The posters ardently call for working hard for glorifying the most dignified era of our state-first principle in which the ideal of the people is brought into full bloom, upholding the administrative policy as immortal great programme and inspiring banner for dynamically promoting the fresh development for socialist construction. Other posters deal with the idea of consolidating the political and ideological position of socialism as firm as a rock by unfolding the work of consolidating the people-first principle as the political climate and social customs of our state in a more substantial and purposeful manner. The other posters show the transparent revolutionary spirit and high fighting spirit of all the people ready to surely bring about practical successes and substantial changes through fresh innovation, bold creation and steady progress. Rodong Sinmun

title: Paektusan Spring Water Factory Completed
body: The Paektusan Spring Water Factory was built in the area of Rimyongsu, Samjiyon City of Ryanggang Province. All the production processes are put on an automatic and streamlined basis in the factory with all sorts of necessary equipment. As a result, another asset conducive to improving the standard of people's living has been created. The spring water having its origin in Lake Chon on Mt Paektu is cool and contains various minerals essential for human health. The inaugural ceremony was held on October 3. Present there were Ri Thae Il, chief secretary of the Ryanggang Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Ri Song Guk, chairman of the Ryanggang Provincial People's Committee, officials concerned and employees of the factory. At the end of the ceremony, the participants looked round the factory. Rodong Sinmun

title: Foundation Day of Korea Marked
body: A celebration for the Foundation Day of Korea took place in front of the Mausoleum of King Tangun on Sunday. Attending the event were Pak Yong Il, chairman of the Central Committee of the Korean Social Democratic Party, Pak Myong Chol and Kim Wan Su, presidium members of the Central Committee of the Democratic Front for the Reunification of Korea, officials of the Council for the Reunification of Tangun's Nation, officials concerned and working people in Pyongyang City. They performed an ancestral rite for Tangun. Ri Myong Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the Chondoist Chongu Party, made a report. He highly praised the patriotic exploits of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il who founded the ancestral father of the Korean nation and demonstrated the excellence of the nation far and wide. He referred to the fact that the dignity and prestige of our socialist state have been put on the highest level and the new era of self-respect and prosperity and the era of our state-first principle unprecedented in the nation's history spanning 5 000 years has opened on this land thanks to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un possessed of rare wisdom and outstanding political caliber. He called for turning out as one in building a prosperous country and accomplishing the cause of national reunification by carrying out the important tasks set forth at the historic policy speech made by Kim Jong Un at the 5th Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly, bearing in mind the national pride and self-confidence of holding the outstanding great man as the father. He stressed that our fatherland would shine long as the great and dignified state and a prosperous power in the world thanks to the tested guidance of Kim Jong Un and the single-minded unity of all the people. Rodong Sinmun

title: The Aged Lead Blessed Life Thanks to Benefits of Country
body: Now in our country the state takes full responsibility for health and life of the aged and to respect the aged and treat them preferentially is the people’s sentiment and a trend of the society. In our country the popular policy on the state’s responsibility for the aged has been enforced and all members of the society have established the traits of respecting the aged and treating them preferentially. This is unthinkable without the warm love of the peerlessly great persons. The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un, who has carried forward the love of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, is always concerned about the life of the aged. It is proved by the Pyongyang Old People’s Home situated on the picturesque bank of the Taedong River next to the Pyongyang Orphanages and Baby Home, the palaces of children. Everything of the old people’s home is associated with the paternal affection of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. In the socialist system of our country the state directly takes responsibility for health and life of the aged and takes good care of them. The Socialist Constitution of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea and the Public Health Law of the DPRK which were adopted scores of years ago have already stipulated that the state should take care of the life and health of the aged in a responsible way. In addition, on April 26 in Juche 96(2007), the Law on the Protection for the Aged of the DPRK was adopted for a legal guarantee for providing the aged with better life conditions. Thanks to the favor of the state centenarians increase in number in our country and the motherly Party sends them birthday spreads on their 100th birthdays. The aged persons in our country enjoy the blessed life under the warm care of the great father and the thankful socialist system. Rodong Sinmun

title: Eternal Spring of Love
body: A few days ago we visited the Ryongaksan Spring Water Factory located on the foot of the picturesque Mt Ryongak. When we entered the factory we saw the monument to the field guidance of Chairman Kim Jong Il and the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un. The sentences engraved on the monument conveyed us the story about the devoted efforts of the peerlessly great men for happy life of our people. Saying that five years have passed since then, Manageress Kim Tong Suk, who is a deputy to the Supreme People’s Assembly, recollected the day when the respected General Secretary visited the factory in deep emotion. We went first to the rooms devoted to the education in the revolutionary history and to the history of the factory. In front of a meaningful photograph in the room devoted to the education in the revolutionary history we could not help being deeply impressed. It was the photo of Chairman Kim Jong Il who sampled cold spring water despite the freezing weather during his visit to the Ryongaksan Spring Water Factory on Jan 20, 2011. The manageress told us that the respected General Secretary warmly said anybody could know well how much efforts Chairman Kim Jong Il devoted to provide spring water of quality to our people from the photo alone. The respected General Secretary earnestly said that provision of spring water to the people was not merely the issue of providing edible water to the people but the issue on the people-oriented character. He learnt in detail about all production processes of the factory and gave precious teachings to the factory with warm affection for the people. He dropped by the newly-arranged modern container producing place and personally estimated the weight of the container. The spring water resource pumping site was a small building. However, the respected General Secretary visited it and learnt about the amount of spring water and others in detail. He gave instructions for a long time on issues of providing hygienic safety of the goods, color of glass bottles containing spring water and even the height of spring water in the bottles. He also took benevolent measures for transport of spring water. Walking along the field guidance route of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, we came to feel keenly that he is the benevolent father who devotes himself to the work for happiness of the people. Officials and employees of the factory have achieved successes in the work to change its appearance and realize the modernization of production processes for the last five years. They continue to make efforts to send more spring water of quality to people while keeping the production at a high rate in spite of difficulties and lack of everything. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Premier Inspects Agricultural Sector
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the DPRK Cabinet, inspected the agricultural sector of North and South Hwanghae provinces. Visiting food administration units in Sariwon City and Jaeryong, Sinchon and Anak counties, the Paeksok and Songo co-op farms in Sinchon County, the Oguk Co-op Farm in Anak County and other farms, the premier gave pep talks to the working people striving to stabilize and improve the people's living and successfully conclude this year's farming, true to the administrative policy of the DPRK government clarified at the 5th Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly. He underlined the need for cities and counties to put efforts into sprucing up their food administration units, modernizing their grain processing lines and increasing their capacity as intended by the Party that prioritizes the role of food administration field in providing the people with stabilized and wealthy life. Urging officials and workers to bear in mind that to finish harvesting and threshing in time is indispensable for successfully concluding this year's farming, he called for conducting meticulous operations and guidance to mobilize all manpower and means while raising the operational rate of farm machines to the maximum. The field consultative meetings discussed the measures to set an example in the city and county food administration and generalize it, expand the wheat and barley sowing area as required by the agricultural development strategy of the Party and make full preparations for next year's farming. He also visited the Pyongyang Corn Processing Factory where he took measures for improving the grain processing and supply as required by the present situation. Earlier, he learned about the progress made in the production of custom-built equipment at the Taean Heavy Machine Complex. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Floral Basket from Lao President
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a floral basket from Thongloun Sisoulith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party and president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic, on the occasion of the 76th anniversary of the founding of the Workers' Party of Korea. The floral basket was conveyed to an official concerned by the Lao ambassador to the DPRK on October 4. Rodong Sinmun

title: Choe Ryong Hae Inspects Sinphyong County, North Hwanghae Province
body: Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, inspected different units in Sinphyong County. Looking round the power station under construction, cement factory and foodstuff factory in the county seething with the efforts to carry out the administrative policy of the DPRK government, he took measures for the issues arising in developing the local economy and improving the people's living standard, true to the Party's idea of attaching importance to cities and counties and the Party's line of strengthening cities and counties. He stressed the importance of solving electric power to suit the regional characteristics. He also called for putting efforts on thoroughly ensuring the quality in the construction of the power station and meticulously conducting operation and command to hasten its completion. He underlined the need to positively promote technical remodeling at local industrial factories and, in particular, push ahead with the modernization of cement factory in order to increase production at an early date. Therefore, a material foundation for strengthening the county including the rural construction should be cemented, he noted. He stressed the need for officials to fulfill their responsibility and duty in decisively increasing consumer goods production for improving the people's living standard and to display the spirit of unconditionally serving the people. The field consultative meetings discussed the issue for the organs at all levels including power organs to set clear goals and carry on the struggle to attain them, true to the plan of the Party Central Committee to achieve the balanced and comprehensive development of local areas, and the issue of conducting education in law observance and morality in various forms and by various methods in order to make sure the dignity and personality befitting the people of a powerful country are fully displayed. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Floral Basket and Congratulatory Letter from Diplomatic Corps Here
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a floral basket and congratulatory letter from the diplomatic corps here on the occasion of the 76th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea. They were handed over to an official concerned by the Palestinian ambassador to the DPRK who is doyen of the diplomatic corps on Oct. 6. On the same day, Kim Jong Un received a floral basket from the Vietnamese ambassador to the DPRK. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Basket to Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un from Palestinian President
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a floral basket from Mahmoud Abbas, president of the State of Palestine, on the occasion of the 76th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea. The floral basket was handed over to an official concerned by the Palestinian ambassador to the DPRK on Oct. 6. Rodong Sinmun

title: Hyesan Kimchi Factory Inaugurated
body: The Hyesan Kimchi Factory was newly built in the DPRK. The factory with various equipment including ozone disinfector is capable of making whole cabbage kimchi, sliced radish kimchi, etc. An inaugural ceremony took place on October 5. Rodong Sinmun

title: Songs in Praise of Socialism Ring Out Louder
body: We Can Never Live without Socialism We value socialism dearer than we do our own lives and devote everything to defending and glorifying it. Then why? A famous song "The Masters of This Land Tell" gives an answer to this question. As the song says our socialist system is the best in the world. In the socialist country of Juche founded and glorified by President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il the people enjoy endless happiness under the wise leadership and warm love of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un. We can never think of our dignified life and future without the socialist system. We all know the iron truth that we cannot live out of the socialist system. Hence all the people including soldiers who defend the country with arms, workers and farmers who unsparingly devote their sweat for the country and scientists who continue their study day and night proudly declare that they will defend the best socialist system in the world more firmly. Our Homeland Where Red Flag of the Party Is Flying As we think of the socialist system, our love for the thankful society and the worthwhile life we enjoy gets more fervent. Our socialist system is indeed the bright home President Kim Il Sung provided us with his lofty idea of believing in the people as in heaven and the happy home Chairman Kim Jong Il defended all his life. The desire of the great leaders who tried to let all live in the socialist society without any gloom and with nothing to envy in the world is being realized by the respected General Secretary’s devoted service for the people. Accordingly our people love the song "We Love You, Socialism". We sing the song from the bottom of our hearts, deeply feeling gratitude for the socialist system under the leadership of the Workers’ Party of Korea headed by the respected General Secretary. Our Life and Our Faith We have rushed forward along the road of socialism following the great Party. We didn’t stop though we had a long way to go. We also did not change the direction in face of difficulties. As the ideal and happiness that our people have wished for centuries lie in this way we have advanced along this way unyieldingly. It is the unshakable faith and rock-firm will of our people to share destiny with socialism forever. The song “Along the Road of Socialism” carries the faith and will. Today our people sing the song loudly with the resolution to go along the road of socialism invariably holding the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un in high esteem. Our people will build a powerful socialist country, a paradise for people, on this land without fail singing this song. Rodong Sinmun

title: Kept in Respected General Secretary’s Heart Are His People Alone
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers’ Party of Korea (WPK), always thinks of the people and devotes his all to them. Loyalty of the people of this country toward the respected General Secretary gets more fervent day after day and they are in high spirits as they have his ardent love for them as well as the unshakable confidence that they will always emerge victorious when they follow him. Comrade Kim Jong Un, solemnly evincing the iron will of the WPK and the DPRK government to remain boundlessly loyal to the great people and do their best to fulfill their weighty mission and responsibility, ardently appealed to everyone to work hard for the prosperity of the great DPRK, for happiness and wellbeing of the great people and for fresh development of Korean-style socialist construction under the uplifted slogan of "The People Are God", single-minded unity and self-reliance in his historic policy speech at the 5th Session of the 14th Supreme People’s Assembly of the DPRK. Comrade Kim Jong Un took every practical measure for vigorously promoting the mid-term and long-term prospective works conducive to the eternal prosperity of the country and for successfully carrying out urgent immediate tasks. The issues of thoroughly implementing the Party’s policy on land management, taking thoroughgoing epidemic prevention measures as the global health crisis is getting worse day by day, increasing the production of mass consumption goods and successfully finishing this year’s farming… Every issue he studied and discussed was for the good of people. We still remember his forced march of devoted service for the people in the sweltering mid-summer heat in 2018. In 2018 the unusual high temperature and sultry weather started in the late June and the maximum temperature reached 40℃ in midsummer. However in such sultry days Comrade Kim Jong Un kept devoting himself to the people, giving on-the-spot guidance to 20-odd units for over 30 times. In those days we cherished deep in our hearts that thanks to Comrade Kim Jong Un, the great father of the people taking full responsibilities for the people’s destiny and shaping bright future of the country with his devoted service, we will become happier and the bright future will be brought earlier despite manifold hardships and trials. The respected General Secretary personally inspected new passenger buses at the building of the Party Central Committee, made a significant speech at the ground-breaking ceremony of the project for building 10 000 flats in Pyongyang although he was very busy with the state work and unfolded a plan to construct the residential district of terraced apartment buildings on the bank of the River Pothong and repeatedly looked round the construction site. There is no difficulty or fortress insurmountable or unconquerable for us as we advance with confidence in sure victory toward the bright future keeping deep in our mind the eternal truth that only victory and glory are in store for us when we follow the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. A fresh victory of socialism of our own style will be brought earlier as we are led by the respected General Secretary, the peerlessly great man, and we have the rock-firm faith and will to go along the road of loyalty in spite of any hardships and trials. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Industrial Art Exhibition Opens
body: A national industrial art exhibition was opened to mark the 76th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea. On display at the venue of the exhibition is a photo of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un appreciating the samples of riding dresses. Presented to the exhibition with the theme "In our own way and by our own might and efforts" are over 110 typical designs which the respected General Secretary has guided this year. Displayed at the exhibition were at least 800 pieces of various designs, products, models, etc. created by creators, teachers, researchers, students and amateurs of industrial art units, industrial establishments and educational institutions in Pyongyang and local areas. Vice-premier of the Cabinet Ri Song Hak, leading officials of ministries and national institutions, officials and creators in the industrial art sector and others looked around the exhibition on October 6. The exhibition will go on till the beginning of November. Rodong Sinmun

title: Celebrations Held in Different Countries
body: Celebrations were held in different countries to mark the 24th anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's election as general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and the 76th founding anniversary of the WPK. Celebration meetings took place in Romania and Bulgaria, seminars in Bangladesh and Kyrgyzstan and a film show in Nigeria. The Korean film "Pyongyang Today" was screened at the film show. Vasile Orleanu, chairman of the Supreme Council of the National Socialist Party of Romania, said that the WPK has been built into the guiding force of the Korean society and into an invincible party under the leadership of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. He stressed that the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un has further strengthened the WPK into the party of the leader, which forms a harmonious whole with the popular masses, by carrying forward the party-building idea and exploits of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il. Lyudmil Kostadinov, chief of the Bulgarian Group for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, Kaben Taskov, its secretary general, and other speakers highly praised the party-building exploits of Kim Il Sung, Kim Jong Il and Kim Jong Un. A. Usupbayev, chairman of the Central Council of the People Unity-"Kyrgys El" Republican Political Party of Kyrgyzstan, noted that the history of the WPK is a brilliant one during which it has vigorously led the revolution and construction along the road of victory and glory, holding in high esteem the prominent and outstanding leaders. Rodong Sinmun

title: Thorough Emergency Epidemic Prevention Posture Maintained in DPRK
body: The emergency epidemic prevention units at all levels are further intensifying the work for thoroughly checking the inroads of COVID-19 while ensuring perfection in the emergency epidemic prevention campaign, true to the administrative policy of the DPRK government. The central emergency epidemic prevention unit is concentrating on turning the present epidemic prevention system into a more reliable and developed one and establishing strong discipline and order to make sure that all units and people across the country strictly observe the epidemic prevention rules instituted by the state. Information activities are dynamically conducted for steadily preserving the public atmosphere for epidemic prevention and ensuring the people's voluntary unity of action. The public is regularly informed of the infection routes and danger of the worldwide spread of COVID-19 through mass media. Emergency epidemic prevention units across the country are steadily intensifying the work for letting the citizens thoroughly observe the state epidemic prevention guidelines and rules of conduct and inform the relevant organs of any abnormal phenomenon, while taking measures for tackling them in time. Organs and industrial establishments thoroughly disinfect the areas in their charge, equipment, raw and other materials, while scrupulously conducting the educational work for making voluntary helpers in farm fields abide by the preventive discipline. The public health organs pay attention to further intensifying the medical examination of residents and preventing the outbreak and spread of various diseases. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Fine Art Exhibition Opens
body: A national fine art exhibition opened with due ceremony at the Okryu Exhibition Hall on October 7 to mark the 30th anniversary of the publication of Chairman Kim Jong Il's famous work "On Fine Art". On display in the centre of the exhibition hall are fine art pieces depicting President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il which help visitors recall their exploits for the development of the Juche-oriented fine art. Also on display there are hundreds of excellent art pieces including Korean painting, oil painting, sculpture and handcraft presented by art studios in Pyongyang and provinces. Those art pieces represent the Party's Juche-based idea and theory on literature and art. There are also art works dealing with the proud reality of the country that braves the worst-ever challenges and difficulties, guided by the outstanding idea and leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, and representing the happy life of the Korean people enjoying a worthwhile life under the care of the mother Party. Present at the opening ceremony were officials, artists and students in the relevant sector, art studios and educational organs, and working people in the city. Sung Jong Gyu, minister of Culture, made a speech at the ceremony. He expressed the belief that the exhibition would serve as an occasion for firmly defending the valuable exploits of the peerlessly great persons and adding eternal luster to them, and for encouraging the dynamic struggle of the Korean people for achieving a fresh development in socialist construction under the leadership of the great Party. The exhibition will continue till October 31. Rodong Sinmun

title: Performance Given by Workers' Art Group of GFTUK Central Committee
body: The Workers' Art Group of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea (GFTUK) gave a performance "Song Dedicated to Mother Party" at the Central Hall of Workers on October 7 to celebrate the 76th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). Among the audience were Ri Tu Song, department director of the Central Committee of the WPK, Pak In Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the GFTUK, trade union officials, workers and trade union members in Pyongyang City. Put on the stage of the performance, which began with narration "Glory to Our Great Party," were such numbers as male solo "We Have the Great Party" and female solo "I Will Live like a Star Following Party." The performers praised the leadership exploits performed by President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in party-building. Also put on the stage were numbers recalling that the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un is the people's benevolent father who dedicates himself to their wellbeing through his ceaseless journey. Other numbers reflected the gratitude toward and trust in the great Party, which projects the workers as the eldest sons of the country and wisely leads them, and represented the faith of the working class to accelerate the grand march of self-reliance with the fighting spirit and traits displayed by the heroes of the preceding generations. Rodong Sinmun

title: Our Party’s Matter of Greatest Importance
body: The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un is gladdest when he has done something good for children and happiest when the laughter and singing voice of the children reverberate loudly. Therefore he sincerely said at the 3rd plenary meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea that it has to be the way of advance and development of our revolution to exert more sincerity to children even the condition becomes worse and to take dynamic steps forward towards the future of communism with the might of that love. If the children who are born and grow up on this land eat well and are raised healthily in good environment from their childhood, so much vibrant vitality and vim will overflow our society after 20 or 30 years and the national power of the Republic will grow and gain in strength, he added. Thanks to the warm love of the benevolent father for rising generations a lot of touching stories are coming into full bloom on this land. Here goes one story. It was early dawn on the International Children’s Day years ago when the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited the Wonsan Baby Home and Orphanage near completion. Looking up to him, officials felt keenly his noble view of posterity. That day the respected General Secretary highly appreciated that the slogan “We Are the Happiest in the World!” displayed on the building of the orphanage was nice and the gatepost of the orphanage was built well so that people might know by intuition that it is the house of the children. Looking round the various places of the orphanage, he gave precious instructions on matters arising in education of orphans and said that the Wonsan Baby Home and Orphanage are eyewitnesses showing the superiority of our style socialism which capitalist countries can never imitate and that whenever excellent buildings such as Wonsan Baby Home and Orphanage are built, the people like them and the country gets bright. The children of our country are the happiest in the world as they have the peerlessly great man as their father who takes care of destiny and future of them with benevolent care. Noting that the Wonsan Baby Home and Orphanage are the cradle of happiness provided with all conditions and environment necessary for bringing up orphans as pillars of the country, he emphasized that the work for rising generation is the matter of the greatest importance to our Party. Children have lived in all ages and there are many countries which put on a show of advocating policy for children. But, there are no great persons but the respected General Secretary who has embodied the noble love of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il for rising generation and puts forward the work for rising generation as the most important policy of the Party and the state. Before leaving that day the respected General Secretary said with love and affection as follows; In inaugural ceremony of the Wonsan Baby Home and Orphanage the tape must be cut by the orphans. If so, the orphans will never forget it. Our children grow up under such great care. Therefore our people follow the respected General Secretary, entrusting the destiny and future to him. Rodong Sinmun

title: Rainbow of Love
body: In Pyongyang the full service ship Mujigae (Rainbow) is floating on the River Taedong. On Sept 27, 2015 the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un, watching the ship decorated with light lamps on the promenade on the river bank, said that the full service ship Mujigae looks like a colorful rainbow, the River Taedong gets brighter and Pyongyang is wonderful by day as well as by night. Officials could hardly repress their emotions because they recalled again the devotion of the respected General Secretary who personally guided the design of the full service ship for several times, solved the knotty problems arising in its building and also named it Mujigae. The respected General Secretary, looking round the ship to learn in detail about its building and preparations for service, took a benevolent step for normal operation of the full service ship and emphasized that they must offer the minute and delicate service to people lest the people should feel inconvenience. He warmly said that thinking of the people who will cheerfully laugh and talk while cruising the River Taedong helps him recover from the pent-up fatigue and he feels the greatest pleasure when having provided one more wealth to the people. It was not long before a picturesque scene was unfolded in the River Taedong. The floating full service ship Mujigae reminds people of a rainbow standing on the River Taedong. And the people on board seem to be virtuous men and women from the sky. Therefore people visiting the ship keenly feel the love of the respected General Secretary, who devotes his all to people, and say, bursting out their excitement, as follows; A natural rainbow disappears, but the Mujigae(rainbow in Korean) on the River Taedong is standing for all seasons conveying the history of love for people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Floral Basket and Congratulatory Letter from Military Attaches Corps Here
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a floral basket and a congratulatory letter from the military attaches corps here on the occasion of the 76th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea. They were handed over to an official concerned by the military attache of the Vietnamese embassy who is doyen of the military attaches corps on October 7. Rodong Sinmun

title: Solemn Pledge
body: At the historic 8th Congress of the Workers’ Party of Korea, the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un solemnly pledged that he will make every effort to implement the fighting programmes put forth by the Party Congress and, regarding the great people as the god of his life, work at the risk of his life as a faithful servant of the people on the road of devoted service for them fully aware of the sacred mission that he is representing and in charge of the great Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist party. This meaningful pledge is pregnant with the original nature of the sacred life of the respected General Secretary who regards himself as a faithful servant who makes devoted services for the good of the people. Achievements he made for his people being indescribable and love he bestowed upon his people being immeasurable, the General Secretary made this pledge which naturally had to be offered to him by his people instead. Indeed, "to make devoted efforts" is a phrase from the bottom of a great man’s heart and the mode of revolution and struggle of the great father who carries on his devotion to his people. We vividly remember the sublime image of the respected General Secretary who ardently appealed to everyone to work hard for the prosperity of the great DPRK, for happiness and wellbeing of the great people and for fresh development of Korean-style socialist construction under the uplifted slogan of "The People Are God", single-minded unity and self-reliance. With such noble intention and by making painstaking efforts, he unfolded an illuminant blueprint for the country’s prosperity and people’s happiness. He made unprecedented decisions for his beloved people and taught to improve and intensify the Party’s childcare policy. He sent a historic letter to the significant meeting of young people to bring them up to be reliable successors to our Party. He also extended congratulations to trustworthy young people who volunteered to work in the difficult and challenging sectors of socialist construction and met them in person to lavish great trust and love upon them. Marvelous dwellings in Songsin and Songhwa areas and the residential area with the new name “Kyongru-dong” are all people’s dear homes which are being built thanks to the noble intention of the respected General Secretary to provide his people with the greatest happiness and nothing to envy in the world. Therefore, all the people are unanimous in their faith to follow the respected General Secretary forever. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un from Lao President
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, received a message of greeting from Thongloun Sisoulith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party (LPRP) and president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic (LPDR), on Friday. In the message the Lao president extended warm congratulations and best wishes to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un and the Central Committee of the WPK, all the Party members and the fraternal Korean people on the occasion of the 76th founding anniversary of the WPK (October 10, 1945 - October 10, 2021). We are pleased and proud that the DPRK and the fraternal Korean people have achieved great successes in preserving the political stability, strengthening the national defence and security, developing the economy and improving the people's livelihood by struggling to firmly defend the gains of the revolution, while further raising the status and role of the country in the regional and international arenas by expanding and developing the external relations, under the bold guidance of the WPK led by President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, the great preceding leaders of the Korean people, and Comrade Kim Jong Un, successor to the revolutionary cause, for the past 76 years, the Lao president noted in the message. The message expressed firm belief that the Party, state and people of the DPRK would continuously achieve great successes in defending the country and carrying out the cause of building a powerful socialist country and the cause of peaceful national reunification by implementing the decisions set forth at the 8th Party Congress under the leadership of the WPK. The message wished Kim Jong Un good health, happiness and great success in accomplishing the noble cause. It hoped that the friendly and cooperative relations with a long tradition between the two parties, two states and two peoples would steadily grow stronger to meet the interests of the peoples of the two countries and promote regional and global peace, friendship, cooperation and development. Rodong Sinmun

title: Meeting of Women's Union Officials and Members Observes Founding Anniversary of WPK
body: A meeting of women's union officials and members took place at the Hall of Women on October 8 to celebrate the 76th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). Present there were Ri Tu Song, department director of the Central Committee of the WPK, Hong Chol Jin, secretary of the Pyongyang City Party Committee, officials of the Central Committee of the women's union and officials and members of the women's union in Pyongyang City. Kim Jong Sun, chairwoman of the C.C., the Socialist Women's Union of Korea, made a report to be followed by speeches. The reporter and speakers said that the WPK's history spanning over seven decades is a proud one in which a brilliant example was set in the building of a revolutionary party of Juche type under the guidance of the great leaders. Noting that President Kim Il Sung provided a historical origin of the WPK through the formation of the DIU (Down-with-Imperialism Union) in the early period of his revolutionary activities, they said that he achieved the historic cause of founding the Party after national liberation by firmly consolidating the organizational and ideological foundations for founding it. They said that Chairman Kim Jong Il, with his original party-building ideology and theory and outstanding leadership, developed the Party into a revolutionary party in which the ideological and leadership system of the leader was firmly established, and into a mother party that formed a harmonious whole with the popular masses and an invincible party with steel-strong discipline and fighting capabilities. They stressed that the Juche-oriented party-building ideology and cause of the President and the Chairman are now carried forward successfully by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, a peerlessly great man. They called for fully displaying the revolutionary spirit of the Korean women in the historic advance for a fresh development of socialist construction under the leadership of Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Agricultural Workers Observe Founding Anniversary of WPK
body: A poem-recital and concert "Glory to Our Mother Party" was given by agricultural workers and members of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea (UAWK) at the Samjigang Cooperative Farm in Jaeryong County, on Friday ahead of the 76th anniversary of the founding of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). Among the audience were Ri Tu Song, department director of the Central Committee of the WPK, Han Jong Hyok, chairman of the C.C., the UAWK, Pak Thae Sop, secretary of the South Hwanghae Provincial Committee of the WPK, officials concerned and agricultural workers in the cooperative farm. The concert began with chorus "Mother's Birthday". Performers highly praised President Kim Il Sung for achieving the historic cause of founding the Party and the single-minded unity between the Party and the revolutionary ranks and bequeathing them as a revolutionary legacy. Male solo "Do Prosper, Era of the Workers' Party" and lyric poem "Mother" reminded the audience of the career of Chairman Kim Jong Il who turned the WPK into a mother party, an ever-victorious guiding force, which defends the destiny of the popular masses and takes care of them. The audience was deeply moved by numbers including female solo "My Mother" and serial song "Our Dear Marshal" highly praising the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un for pursuing the people-first policy after setting forth the original idea of turning the Party into the one of truly serving the people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Syrian President
body: Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), received a message of greeting from Bashar Al-Assad, president of the Syrian Arab Republic, on October 4. The Syrian president in the message extended the warmest and heartfelt congratulations to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un and, through him, to the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), all the Party members and the people of the DPRK on the occasion of the 76th founding anniversary of the WPK. The message sincerely hoped that the great WPK would always register successes in different fields including economy, society and military affairs through ceaseless great upsurge. It said that the WPK, which has led the Korean people's struggle for progress, socialism and social justice, is playing an important role in the struggle against all sorts of moves of imperialism to force its will upon other countries, interfere in their internal affairs and deprive their people of their rights to self-determination. The Syrian president in the message expressed his will to make joint efforts for strengthening the historic relations of friendship between the two countries and expanding the fields of bilateral cooperation in the interests of the peoples of the friendly two countries. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Officials, working people and service personnel of the People's Army laid floral baskets before the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il to mark the 24th anniversary of Kim Jong Il's election as general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea. Placed before the statues of the great leaders on Mansu Hill were floral baskets in the names of the Party, power and armed forces organs, social organizations, ministries, national institutions, units of the Korean People's Army (KPA) and the Public Security Forces (PSF) and institutions and industrial establishments and universities at all levels in Pyongyang City. The visitors made bows to the statues. Floral baskets in the names of units of the KPA and the PSF, institutions and enterprises and bouquets were laid at the statues of the great leaders and mosaics picturing their smiling images in different parts of Pyongyang, including Kim Il Sung University, the Ministry of Public Security and the Mansudae Art Studio. Officials, working people and servicepersons in other parts of the country also visited the statues of the great leaders and mosaics depicting their smiling images in their residential areas to pay high tribute. Rodong Sinmun

title: Blood Ties Which Can Never Be Broken
body: The Most Valuable Treasure It was one day some years ago, when the rehabilitation of flood-hit area of Rason City was in full swing. The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un was informed by an official that some residents of the flood-hit area had pulled down their houses of some value by themselves after they knew that the Party was building new houses for those who were left homeless. The relevant officials tried to call the matter to account seeing it as a selfish act disregarding the difficult situation of the state. However the respected General Secretary dissuaded the officials from doing it, saying that they couldn’t do that if they did not trust in the Party. People’s trust in the Party is the most precious one for us and the most valuable treasure is the trust of the people, he noted, and went on: We must repay their trust with our devoted service from the viewpoint that there is nothing more to desire when we are trusted by the people. The officials were so impressed by his profound love and trust and the people were moved to tears to receive his words. A Baby Named by Respected General Secretary at Meeting It was one day in April, 2014. The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un declared that the first meeting of airpersons of the Korean People’s Army (KPA) closed. Then he said that he promised a woman pilot to name her newborn son when he visited a women pilots’ unit of the KPA some time ago but he did not keep it yet. All the participants in the meeting were so surprised and impressed to hear him. Kim Jong Un called the woman pilot to him and kindly asked her if her son was named or not. She answered him that she had not yet done it. Beaming with a smile, he offered his opinion. He suggested calling him Ri Chung Do(the road of loyalty in Korean) to the effect that he will go along the only road of loyalty in his whole life upholding the Party with pure conscience and patriotism. Like this, the baby was named at the meeting. This shows the genuine feature of our country in which the leader and people are linked with the unbreakable blood ties to form a harmonious whole. Rodong Sinmun

title: Setting Brilliant Example of Revolutionary Party Building
