The central emergency epidemic prevention unit puts primary efforts into turning the present epidemic prevention system into a more reliable and developed one, while letting all citizens maintain high vigilance. As the danger of COVID-19 infection increases in colder weather and the epidemic prevention work is protracted, the unit conducts agitprop activities to make sure that officials, working people and residents turn out as one in the prevention work, well aware of the gravity of the global health crisis. Emergency epidemic prevention units in all provinces, cities and counties focus on preventing any slightest deviations in the preventive work, while securing material and technical means for the work, steadily improving the professional qualifications of epidemic prevention workers and enhancing the responsibility of the workers at the epidemic prevention posts. Rejecting indolence and carelessness, relevant organs engage in finding and tackling the defects in the prevention work, while pushing ahead with perfecting the exclusive disinfecting facilities and establishing a more effective disinfection system. Hygienic and epidemic prevention units make full preparations for rooting out the sources of the outbreak of various diseases and coping with any abnormal situation. Public health organs conduct health check-ups of people regularly and medical workers in charge of households also enhance their role. Industrial establishments, co-op farms and neighborhood units rev up the atmosphere of overcoming the on-going health crisis by dint of collectivism, while making sure that all employees and citizens make it part of their lives to wear masks and disinfect their hands and voluntarily observe the preventive rules and order. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Basket to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il from Italian Figure
body: A floral basket was sent to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill from Giancarlo Elia Valori, president of the International Group of Italy, on the occasion of the 76th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea. The floral basket was laid before the statues on October 12. Prior to it, a floral basket in the name of the Anti-Imperialist Forum of Germany was laid before the statues. Rodong Sinmun

title: For Our Great People!
body: The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un teaches the officials with his noble practical examples how to love people and devote to them and leads our people towards the endless happiness and bright future even in the teeth of the worst difficulties. He has the noble outlook on people of upholding them as he would do President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. The respected General Secretary, in his historic policy speech at the 5th session of the 14th Supreme People’s Assembly of DPRK, ardently appealed to everyone to work hard for prosperity of the great country DPRK, for happiness and wellbeing of the great people and for a fresh development of Korean-style socialist construction under the uplifted slogan of "The People Are God", single-minded unity and self-reliance. This is the gush of great heart of the respected General Secretary, the peerlessly great man who is the best in love for people and practice for people. Therefore the whole country is full of boundless gratitude to the respected General Secretary. The call “For Our Great People!” will resound forever on this land as we uphold him, the supreme incarnation of love for people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Internet Seminar of East European and Central Asian Regions Held in Russia
body: An internet seminar of the East European and Central Asian regions under the theme of "Sovereignty and independence are the goal of the 21st century and the experience of party building in the DPRK" was held in Sankt-Peterburg, Russia on Oct. 7 on the occasion of the 76th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). Attending the seminar were chiefs of the International Alliance of Societies for the Study of the Juche Idea and Songun Policy in East European and Central Asian Regions and the groups for studying the Juche idea and Juche idea followers of Russia, Ukraine, Moldova and other countries. Mikhail Panchenko, general secretary of the International Alliance of Societies for the Study of the Juche Idea and Songun Policy in East European and Central Asian Regions, made a speech at the seminar. President Kim Il Sung set forth an original party-building idea in consideration of the situation of Korea, not depending upon any established theory, thus building the WPK into the vanguard organization of the working people, he noted. The WPK has carried on the struggle to satisfy the demands of the people and defend their interests since it inscribed a hammer, sickle and writing brush in its red flag, he said. All progressive parties of the world should learn from the experience of the WPK, he said, adding that in order to realize independence, it is necessary to briskly conduct the work of studying and disseminating the outstanding idea and theory of Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the WPK. Speeches were made by Nikolai Polishk, chairman of the Ukrainian "Treasured Sword of Songun" Association for the Study of the Juche Idea, Dmitri Kostenko, chairman of the Russian Association for the Study of the Juche Idea, the chairman of the All-Russian Society for the Study and Dissemination of Kimilsungism, and Oleg Vernik, chairman of the Moldovan Songun Youth Union for the Study of the Juche Idea. A congratulatory message to the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un was adopted at the seminar. Rodong Sinmun

title: Dynamic Autumn Campaign for Land Administration Launched in DPRK
body: A lot of successes have been made in a dynamic autumn campaign for land administration launched by people across the DPRK. Thanks to the efforts of officials of the Ministry of Land and Environment Protection, provinces, cities and counties and working people, hundreds of kilometers of roads were technically improved and millions of cubic meters of river-beds dredged within fifteen days across the country. Officials and working people in North Hamgyong Province successfully completed dozens of projects such as river improvement, dredging of river-beds and reinforcement of embankments with earth and stones at the earliest date. Technical improvement and building of roads are being dynamically pushed ahead with in different areas. More than 2 000 square meters of retaining walls were built and safety and protective poles newly set up at one hundred and dozens of spots in Cholsan County and 30-odd kilometers of roads technically improved and structures established to ensure safety in Kosan County. Millions of cubic meters of river-beds were dredged in segments extending for thousands of kilometers across the country. A mass campaign for attaining the ambitious plans for river improvement is underway in many cities and counties. Rodong Sinmun

title: Many People Visit Venue of Defence Development Exhibition
body: Many people are visiting the venue of the Defence Development Exhibition amid the increasing public interest in the exhibition, an epitome of the tremendous defence capabilities of our great state. Officials of ministries and national institutions and officials and service personnel of the armed forces organs visited the venue of the exhibition on October 13. Being briefed on cutting-edge military hardware and equipment that show the rapid development of defense industry for self-defence, the visitors felt the great might of the DPRK and the strategic position of the country that has been put on a new stage. They were full of confidence in the rosy future of the country which will prosper under the wise leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea and in the victory of socialism, as they recollected with great pride how just they were when they opted for the do-or-die road of fortitude for acquiring a strong treasured sword for preserving peace and as they realized that it was the most proud and worthwhile journey. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Sci-Tech Presentation in Field of Veterinary Science and Animal Husbandry Held
body: A national sci-tech presentation in the field of veterinary science and animal husbandry was held through video conferencing on Oct. 12 and 13 under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea. Participating in the presentation were scientists, technicians and field officials at over 20 units, including the Microbiological Research Institute under the State Academy of Sciences, the Zootechny Institute under the Academy of Agricultural Science, Pyongyang University of Agriculture, Phyongsong University of Veterinary Science and Animal Husbandry and the Kuwa Co-op Farm in Anak County. Submitted to the presentation were more than 50 valuable treatises on achievements made in scientific researches and production for the development of stockbreeding. The presentation was aimed at popularizing sci-tech successes and experience which make substantial contributions to the implementation of the Party's childcare policy. During the presentation there were technical lectures on sci-tech issues arising in milk production and on the technique for the production and transplantation of an embryo of a milking cow of a good breed. Rodong Sinmun

title: Most Precious and Valuable Treasure
body: We feel boundless gratitude to and reverence for the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un who, regarding people’s trust as the most precious treasure, is making painstaking efforts to build ours into a powerful socialist country in which people’s dreams all come true. For him, people’s trust is equivalent to the most valuable of all treasures and an inexhaustible strength. Therefore, he solemnly swore once again in the venue of the October festival celebrating the 75th birthday of the WPK that he will live up to the people’s trust without fail even if his body is torn and crushed to pieces on the way of defending their great trust and that he will remain faithful to that trust. And that’s why he keeps the troubles he takes for the good of the great people as the greatest honor and dedicates his heart and soul to living up to the people’s great trust. The sleepless nights he spent for his people, traces of services he left throughout the country and all sorts of relevant stories cannot be described in mere words. Indeed, our history is a succession of days and months of his devoted service for the people to defend the people’s trust and, as the days go by, people’s trust in him is being further cemented to be absolute one which will be eternal in any storm and stress. Rodong Sinmun

title: Women's Union Members Dedicate Themselves to Socialist Construction
body: Women's union members across the country devote themselves to major socialist construction projects. Members of women's union shock brigade in Pyongyang City are encouraging the builders at the site of the construction of 10 000 flats by carrying building materials, tidying up the area and providing welfare service. At the construction site of dwelling houses in Komdok area, women's union members of the General Bureau of the Tanchon Area Mining Industry are responsibly making concrete blocks and doing other good deeds, thus having a large share in overfulfilling the daily plans. Women's union members in Hamhung City, Sinhung County, etc. filled the low ground with the earth of thousands of cubic meters and laid turf in a large area in order to help the builders in the fierce 24-7 struggle to turn the affected area into a socialist fairyland. Women's union members in Nampho City built goat corrals, drying-places, etc. by themselves in a short span of time so as to build a goat farm and create a pasture. Women's union members in South Phyongan Province, South and North Hwanghae provinces, etc. helped the farms in harvesting and threshing. Rodong Sinmun

title: WPK Founding Anniversary Marked in Bangladesh
body: A joint celebration meeting took place in Dhaka City, Bangladesh on October 7 on the occasion of the 76th anniversary of the founding of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). Speeches were made by the chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Bangladesh, the chairman of the Central Executive Committee of the Bangladesh National Socialist Party, the general secretary of the Bangladesh Institute of the Juche Idea and others. They said that the WPK has developed into a steel-strong party in which the leader's ideological and leadership system was firmly established with the great Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism as its only guidelines and into a veteran and experienced party leading the revolution and construction to victory and glory amid absolute support and trust by the people. The popular nature of the WPK, which has served the people, giving priority to the interests of the people since its founding, has never changed despite stern trials, and it is the steadfast will of the Party to take care of the people, being responsible for their destiny, they said, and went on: Under the wise leadership of the WPK the Korean people are vigorously advancing toward a bright future in the face of hardship and trials. Saying that progressive political parties and people in Bangladesh firmly believe that the heroic Korean people would achieve greater successes in socialist construction by getting united single-mindedly around H.E. Kim Jong Un, they expressed their invariable support for and solidarity with the Korean people in their struggle for implementing the decisions made at the 8th Congress of the WPK. Rodong Sinmun

title: Defence Development Exhibition Draws Large Crowds
body: Defence Development Exhibition Self-Defence-2021 continues day after day, drawing large crowds. Officials, scientists, technicians and workers in the field of munitions industry inspected the exhibition with immense pride and self-esteem. Going round the historic scenes showing the immortal field leadership history of our Party which covered the path of defence industrial revolution for the security of the country, eternal dignity and happiness, and their noble crystallizations, the visitors recollected solemnly the days when they built the most powerful capabilities for self-defence while sharing thought, intention, sweets and bitters with the Party Central Committee. They made their firm pledge to cherish the great trust and loving care of the Party Central Committee, which takes good care of soldiers in the defence field, as the bloodline of their destinies, and to put their heart and soul into successfully carrying out the five-year plan for the defence science development and weapon system development set forth at the 8th Party Congress. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Premier Kim Tok Hun Inspects Agricultural Sector in North Phyongan Province
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, inspected the agricultural sector of North Phyongan Province. Visiting the Chojang Co-op Farm of Kwaksan County, the premier called upon officials and agricultural workers to reap in time the crops they cultivated with much effort by conducting harvesting and threshing in a proper way. He, at the food administration stations in Jongju City, Kwaksan County and Pakchon County, called for sprucing up city and county food administration stations, responsibly organizing the work of putting the grain processing on a modern basis and for timely tackling technical problems arising in increasing the operating rate of facilities in order to thoroughly carry out the tasks set forth in the administrative policy of the government of the Republic. The field consultative meetings stressed the need for farms to concentrate on concluding this year's farming and make full preparations for next year's farming and for the food administration stations to further raise the level of grain drying, storage and quality of processing. Rodong Sinmun

title: WPK's Birthday Celebrated by Koreans in China
body: Koreans in China significantly celebrated the 76th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). Choe Su Bong, first vice-chairman of the General Association of Koreans in China, and other officials of the association visited the DPRK consulate general in Shenyang on October 10 to lay a floral basket before the art work depicting President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and pay tribute to them. Laid at the statue of the President at Yuwen Middle School in Jilin were the floral baskets in the names of the General Association of Koreans in China, the Association of Korean Women in China, the Jilin City Branch of the Jilin Province Regional Association, the family of Hwang Paek Ha, a China-resident Korean related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, and the family of Hong Yong Sun, vice-chairperson of the Jilin Province Regional Association. Officials of the Association of Young Korean Nationals in China, the Association of Korean Women in China and the Dandong City Branch of the Liaoning Province Regional Association visited the DPRK mission in Dandong to lay floral baskets before the portraits of smiling Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il. Paek Kyong Hyon, chairman of the Zhongnan Regional Association, and officials of the association and the Beijing City Branch laid floral baskets before the portraits of smiling Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il at the DPRK embassy in Beijing on October 9. The General Association of Koreans in China held round-table talks to observe the 76th founding anniversary of the WPK. Attending there were Choe Su Bong, first vice-chairman of the General Association of Koreans in China, and officials of the association, the vice-chairperson of the Federation of Korean Economic Workers in China, officials of the Liaoning Province Regional Association and citizens in Shenyang City. Speeches were made there. The participants watched a Korean feature film. The Zhongnan Regional Association and the Ningan City Branch of the Mudanjiang Regional Association and the Yanbian Regional Association of the General Association of Koreans in China held celebration meetings and photo exhibitions. Cha Sang Bo, vice-chairman of the General Association of Koreans in China, made public a press statement on October 6. Rodong Sinmun

title: Labor Hero Mother in Kangdong County
body: In Rimgyong Workers’ District of Kangdong County is Pak Un Jong, who gave birth to her 10th child at the Pyongyang Maternity Hospital. Three of her 10 offspring are doing their military service. There is a reason why she gave birth to many children. One day when she bore the second baby and took aftercare she read an article of Rodong Sinmun introducing a family 18 members of which did their military service. That day she told her husband that she would like to have many children and bring them up to be good soldiers for defending the socialist country. Thus she became a prolific mother. The country gave her the medical treatment ticket for prolific mothers and looked after her family carefully lest they feel inconvenience. When she was in the Pyongyang Maternity Hospital the country sent her the wild honey and various tonics for her nutrition and also the medical workers did their best. Pak Un Jong and her husband Ri Kwang Chol always asked their children to become soldiers to defend the benevolent system and socialist country. She took part in the state conference thanks to the measure of the Workers’ Party of Korea that valued her highly because she bore many children. Moreover the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un personally read the letter of her resolution to bring up their children as soldiers. Last September Pak Un Jong was awarded with the title of Labor Heroine, the supreme honor of citizen of the DPRK. She says that she will repay the great love and trust of the Party with bringing up their offspring well as pillars of the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Gift from Mongolian Cultural and Research Center of DPRK
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a gift from the Mongolian Cultural and Research Center of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea on the occasion of the 76th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea. The gift was conveyed to the DPRK ambassador to Mongolia by N. Byambadorj, chairman of the center, on Oct. 10. Rodong Sinmun

title: Choe Ryong Hae Inspects Taedonggang Electric Appliances Factory and Pyongyang Electric Cable General Factory 326
body: Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, inspected the Taedonggang Electric Appliances Factory and Pyongyang Electric Cable General Factory 326. Looking around the factories, he stressed the need to enhance the responsibility and role of the officials for carrying out the tasks set forth in the administrative policy of the government of the Republic and to put primary efforts into upgrading the current production lines and increasing the production capacity in order to produce and supply enough raw and other materials and equipment needed for economic construction. At the Taedonggang Electric Appliances Factory he called for raising the scientific level of production, prioritize the work for consolidating the material and technical foundations and wage vigorous campaigns among units and producers in which one overtakes and learns from others and swaps experience with them. Emphasizing the importance of increasing the production capacity of the Pyongyang Electric Cable General Factory 326 in fully supplying various electric wires urgently needed for different sectors of the national economy, he stressed the need to regard it as the lifeline to promote the home production of raw and other materials and recycling and hasten the technical remodeling of equipment. The field consultative meetings discussed the issue of propelling the work for realizing the adjustment strategy and reinforcement strategy set forth by the Party, the issue of implanting into the minds of officials and employees the idea that the national economic plan precisely means a state law and the issue of conducting in various forms and methods the work for establishing a law-abiding climate. Rodong Sinmun

title: Enlarged Edition Vol. 15 of "Complete Collection of Kim Il Sung's Works" Published
body: The Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House has brought out the enlarged edition Vol. 15 of "Complete Collection of Kim Il Sung's Works", a library of the Juche idea dealing with President Kim Il Sung's works systematically and comprehensively in chronological order. It contains 97 works such as speeches, talks, reports and concluding speeches made by the President from August to December, Juche 38 (1949). The works deal with principled issues arising in Party work and activities including the issue of intensifying the Party guidance over all the fields of revolution and construction. They clarify the idea of properly preparing all the soldiers politically, ideologically and in military technique by intensifying combat and political training and the idea that officials should improve the management of enterprises such as management of labor and equipment, always finding themselves at inferior units to guide their production. They indicate the task of putting efforts into training national cadres and technical talents needed for the development of the national economy, the idea of achieving national reunification by the concerted efforts of the Korean nation through the firmer unity of people from all walks of life and the idea of waging a positive struggle for building a full-fledged independent and sovereign state. Other works in the edition give perfect solutions to theoretical and practical issues arising in revolutionary struggle and construction including the issue of producing excellent popular art and literature works touching the hearts of the people, the issue of preserving and managing nation's cultural heritage with much care and the issue of strengthening the unity and solidarity with the progressive peoples in the world. Rodong Sinmun

title: Performance Given by Art Squad of Central Committee of Youth League
body: The art squad of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League gave a performance "Fly High the Flag of Down-with-Imperialism Union" at the Central Youth Hall on Friday to mark the 95th anniversary of the formation of the Down-with-Imperialism Union (DIU) by President Kim Il Sung. Put on the stage of the performance were diverse numbers including poem recitation, male solo, songs and dances and national instrumental ensemble. Performers highly praised the President for providing the historic origin of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) by founding the DIU, a new-type vanguard organization, at the dawn of the Korean revolution, and for setting a world-historic example in building a revolutionary party with his original idea and leadership. They impressively represented the history of the party-building leadership of Chairman Kim Jong Il who developed the WPK into an invincible steel-strong party, a genuine mother party, by successfully embodying the President's party-building idea. The repertoire included the numbers dealing with the personality of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un as a peerlessly great man, who continues the journey of devoted service for the good of the people, true to the noble intention of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il. Among the audience were Ri Tu Song, department director of the Central Committee of the WPK, Mun Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the youth league, Hong Chol Jin, secretary of the Pyongyang City Party Committee, officials of the youth league and youth and students in Pyongyang. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Reply Message to Syrian President
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a reply message to Bashar Al-Assad, president of the Syrian Arab Republic, on October 14. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un in the message expressed deep thanks to the Syrian president for sending warm congratulations on the occasion of the 76th founding anniversary of the WPK. Wishing the Syria's Baath Arab Socialist Party and the Syrian people greater successes in the struggle for defending the sovereignty of the country, the message expressed belief that the ties of friendship, unity and cooperation between the two parties and the two countries would further develop. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Reply Message to Lao President
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), sent a reply message to Thongloun Sisoulith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party (LPRP) and president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic (LPDR), on October 14. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un in the message expressed deep thanks to the general secretary of the C.C., LPRP for sending warm felicitations and best wishes on the occasion of the 76th founding anniversary of the WPK and extending support and encouragement to the WPK and the DPRK people in their struggle for implementing the decisions made at the 8th Congress of the WPK. Extending full support for the Lao people striving to implement the decisions made at the 11th Congress of the LPRP under the guidance of the LPRP, the message sincerely wished the general secretary of the C.C., LPRP greater success in his responsible work for strengthening the party and building a powerful and thriving socialist state. It expressed belief that the traditional friendly and cooperative relations between the two parties and the two countries would grow stronger. Rodong Sinmun

title: WPK's Birthday Celebrated Abroad
body: There took place celebration meetings and lectures in Britain, Mexico, Brazil, Venezuela, Guinea, Algeria, Uganda and Tanzania from October 4 to 11 on the occasions of the 24th anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's election as general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and the 76th founding anniversary of the WPK. Attending the events were personages of various circles and people in those countries. The general secretary of the Central Committee of the People's Socialist Party of Mexico praised the exploits performed by President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il who had vigorously advanced the socialist cause by founding the Juche-type revolutionary party and signally strengthening its leading role, and the experienced and tested leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un who put the strategic position of the country on the highest level. Several figures including the chairman of the Venezuelan National Society for the Study of the Juche Idea said that Kim Il Sung who provided the organizational and ideological foundations for founding the party in the period of the arduous anti-Japanese war successfully accomplished the historic cause of party-building right after Korea's liberation. The chairman of the Brazilian Center for the Study of the Juche Idea in a lecture on Kim Jong Il's work "The Workers' Party of Korea Organizes and Guides All the Victories of Our People" praised the greatness of the peerlessly great men who made great contributions to the founding and development of the WPK, and the chairman of the Algeria-Korea Friendship Association said that the WPK has further demonstrated its dignity and might to the world as it is led by Kim Jong Un. The director-general of the International Institute of the Juche Idea who doubles as chairman of the Mexican Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism explained in detail the main contents of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un's work "The Cause of the Great Party of Comrades Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il Is Ever-Victorious". Personages of the Ugandan National Executive Committee of the Pan-African Movement, Ugandan National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea and the Uganda-DPRK Friendship Association said that it is the party-building idea and ideal of Kim Jong Un to develop the WPK into the servant party which devotes itself to the well-being of people, adding that the WPK will be ever-victorious as it is led by him. Rodong Sinmun

title: Seasonal Sowing of Wheat and Barley Seeds Finished in DPRK
body: The nationwide seasonal sowing of wheat and barley seeds has been finished thanks to the devoted efforts of agricultural officials and workers all out in the campaign for implementing the administrative policy of the DPRK government. Officials of the agricultural guidance organs in all the provinces, cities and counties scrupulously organized the work for choosing the right soil, expanding the sowing area and making all the farms sow seeds in a sci-tech way. Agricultural workers in Pyongyang City expanded the sowing area by 1.8 times larger than last year and carried out the sowing of seeds ahead of schedule by dovetailing the processes. All the provinces secured the high-yielding varieties of wheat and barley acclimatized to regional climatic and soil conditions, and finished the sowing in a short span of time by ensuring good conditions for sprouting. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Sci-Tech Presentation in Field of Welding Held
body: A national sci-tech presentation in the field of welding was held from October 12 to 15 under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea. Participating in the presentation were teachers, researchers, graduate students, field engineers, members of the three-revolution team and others of more than ten units including Kim Chaek University of Technology and the welding research institute under the State Academy of Sciences. Submitted to the presentation held through video conferencing were over sixty treatises on the achievements made in the study of fresh welding methods and the work of realizing the domestic production of equipment and raw and other materials in the field of welding. There took place a lecture on the trend and prospect of the development of the laser-welding technology during the presentation. Rodong Sinmun

title: Seminar on Policy Speech Made by Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Held by Koreans in China
body: A seminar on the policy speech made by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un at the 5th Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK was held by the General Association of Koreans in China on October 10. Attending the seminar were Choe Su Bong, first vice-chairman of the general association, and its officials, Kim Kyong Su, vice-chairman of the Federation of Korean Economic Workers in China, and citizens in Shenyang City. Read out there was an article of Rodong Sinmun dealing with the fact that Kim Jong Un made the policy speech "On the Orientation of Present Struggle for a Fresh Development of Socialist Construction". Speeches were made there. Choe Su Bong and other speakers said that the policy speech clarified the policy tasks of the Party and the government of the Republic for putting the construction of Korean style socialism onto a fresh stage of development including the issues arising in powerfully propelling the independent and overall development of the state's economy and improving the people's standard of living. They noted that it is the natural demand of the socialist system and the important policy being consistently maintained by our Party and the government of the Republic to take full responsibility for the people's living and sufficiently satisfy the increasing material and cultural demand of the people. They stressed that Kim Jong Un's policy speech gives the correct understanding of the inter-Korean relations on the Korean peninsula at home and abroad and further inspires the desire of all the fellow countrymen for national reunification. Rodong Sinmun

title: Iron Truth He Deeply Engraved in Their Hearts
body: The Core of Modernization One day in November several years ago, the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited the Pyongyang Children’s Foodstuff Factory. Going around the modernized factory, he said that what particularly pleased him was the fact that each production process was equipped with up-to-date facilities designed by our scientists and technicians and made by our own efforts. He stressed that localization constituted the core of the Party’s policy on modernization. The officials were deeply moved by his words. The respected General Secretary values the products made by our own efforts, technology and our materials, though they are small, wherever he visits. He sees to it that our people create and innovate everything to be proud of which in the world. The officials determined to display the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance and self-development. In Practice, Not in Words The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited the Kim Jong Thae Electric Locomotive Complex and watched a newly manufactured subway train in October, Juche 104 (2015). He said that the success proved again in practice that we can create everything from nothing by enlisting wisdom of our scientists and technicians and unfathomable strength and revolutionary spirit of self-reliance of working class. After a while he stressed that he attached great importance to the development and production of subway trains in order to show in practice, not in many words, some people with proclivity to import the truth that when everything is made in the Korean style by our own efforts and technology just as what manufactured by the heroic workers equipped with Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism and patriotic scientists and technicians, those will be more valuable and shine. He added that the subway train made by our working class gave him a great courage. The officials kept again in their minds the truth that they can open up a new era of prosperity on this land when they uphold the respected General Secretary’s lofty intention on self-reliance in practice. Rodong Simun

title: Great Bosom Which Brings Up Revolutionaries and Patriots
body: On Sep. 8, 2021 the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un had a photo session with the labour innovators and merited persons who participated in the celebrations of the 73rd founding anniversary of the DPRK at the office building of the Party Central Committee and hosted them a splendid banquet. Among them were 20-odd scientists of the State Academy of Sciences. Prof. and Dr. Ko Kyong Min, researcher of the Manufactory No. 111 of the State Academy of Sciences, expressed his feelings as follows: “We keenly sensed in our hearts that we were the luckiest in the world when we had a photo session with the respected General Secretary in the courtyard of the Party Central Committee.” Dr. Kim Kwang Ho, room chief of the Mathematics Research Institute of the State Academy of Sciences who was selected as one of the very best national scientists and technicians of 2020 for his valuable scientific and technological successes, said as follows: “We could make contributions to the prosperity and development of the country even a little thanks to the respected General Secretary who firmly trusted in us, led us step by step taking care of us with attentive affection. His affection and trust provide us with novel conceptions, passion for creation and stubborn will.” The respected General Secretary highly appreciated our scientists and technicians saying that they take an important part in implementing the Party’s line of attaching importance to science and the scientists and technicians are the main force of the scientific and technological front, the front line in defending the Party and revolution and carrying out our cause. It is the unshakable will of the respected General Secretary to accelerate a fresh victory of socialist construction by dint of science and technology. The happiest in the world are our scientists and technicians in the bosom of the peerlessly great man who recognizes their unnoticeable efforts and highly appreciates their services. In the great bosom of the respected General Secretary our scientists and technicians will lead brilliant lives forever and thanks to his wise leadership our Juche-oriented science will be dynamically developed. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Premier Inspects Key Industrial Sectors of North and South Hamgyong Provinces
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, inspected the key industrial sectors of North and South Hamgyong provinces. At the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex and the Chongjin Steel Plant, the premier discussed economic and technical issues for putting production on a normal footing and expanding capacity, saying that the metal industry, pivotal one of the country, plays a very big role in achieving the independent and comprehensive development of the national economy. He underscored the need for the iron and steel plants to scientifically manage equipment for the sustainable growth of iron and steel production, to push ahead with the work for putting the production lines on an intensive basis and to step up the construction of an energy-efficient iron blast furnace. Learning about the production states at the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex, the February 8 Vinalon Complex and the Chongjin Chemical Fibre Mill, he called for pressing ahead with technical remodeling by ramping up their own technical force and for producing plenty of basic chemicals needed for various sectors of the national economy including agricultural, light and pharmaceutical industries. Looking round the Jangjingang Power Station, he stressed the need to reinforce the hydraulic structure, do generator-overhauling in a qualitative way and ensure the stability of power production by securing water in a proper way. The field consultative meetings stressed it was important for North and South Hamgyong provinces and other industrial provinces to turn out in thoroughly implementing the important tasks set forth in the administrative policy of the government of the Republic, pointedly calling for increasing the responsibility and role of officials. Meanwhile, the premier learned about the farming situation in Kumya County, the modernization of grain-processing lines at the Kowon County food administration station and the recovery from flood damage in Sinhung County. Rodong Sinmun

title: ﻿Founding Anniversary of WPK Celebrated in Russia
body: Meetings and floral basket-laying ceremonies took place in Russia on Oct. 6 and 8 to mark the 76th anniversary of the founding of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). Attending there were personages of various units including the Amur Regional Branch Committee and the Khabarovsk Territorial Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation, the Russian Blagobeshensk Association for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism and the Lenin Young Communist League of the Russian Federation. The second secretary of the Amur Regional Branch Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation said that President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il built the WPK to be the vanguard defending the interests of the people, and that the WPK is further developing into a genuine mother Party thanks to the wise leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un thoroughly applying the people-first principle to the overall work of the Party. The first secretary of the Khabarovsk Territorial Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation said that the President laid organizational and ideological foundations for Party-founding during the anti-Japanese war and successfully accomplished the Party-building cause right after Korea's liberation. The first secretary of the Central Committee of the Lenin Young Communist League of the Russian Federation highly praised Kim Jong Un for having developed the WPK into a revolutionary party and invincible leading force, in which the oneness of the idea and leadership has been more firmly ensured, for the past ten years. The Communist Party of the Soviet Union held a meeting for marking the 76th anniversary of the founding of the WPK on Oct. 5. The first secretary of its Central Committee noted that since its founding, the WPK has successfully played its role as the vanguard of the revolution. He said that the WPK's politics of the love for the people is arousing the international community's admiration, adding that the WPK with the great Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism as a guideline is invincible. Congratulatory messages to Kim Jong Un were adopted at the events held by the Khabarovsk Territorial Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation and the Central Committee of the Lenin Young Communist League of the Russian Federation. Rodong Sinmun

title: Dancing Parties of Youth and Students Held
body: Youth and students held dancing parties across the country on Oct. 17, the 95th anniversary of the formation of the Down-with-Imperialism Union (DIU) by President Kim Il Sung. Youth and students in Pyongyang City held dancing parties at the plazas of the Arch of Triumph and the Pyongyang Indoor Stadium. The dancing parties began with song "Glory to Our Great Party". The participants danced in deep reverence for President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il who provided the historic roots of the Party in the period of pioneering the Korean revolution and led the revolutionary cause of Juche to victory and glory only. They danced to the tunes of the songs which helped look back on the proud years and heroic course of the Korean revolution during which the tradition and cause of the DIU have been defended and comprehensively applied generation after generation under the leadership of the Party. They were full of great happiness and pride of the youth adding luster to the new era of the great powerful country under the leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. The dancing parties ended with the playing of the song "We Will Defend General Kim Jong Un with Our Lives." Similar dancing parties took place in all the provincial seats on the same day. Rodong Sinmun

title: Defence Development Exhibition Gives People Faith in Certain Victory and Courage
body: Officials, staff and students of the field of national defense science and education, military schools at all levels and universities here and many other people visited the venue for the Defence Development Exhibition Self-Defence-2021 from Oct. 15 to 17 amid the daily-increasing zeal for the visit to the exhibition. Looking at the immortal photos displayed in the venue, the visitors felt deep reverence for the great Party Central Committee bringing about a new turning point in strengthening the defense capability of the nation by leading the great cause of building a powerful and prosperous country to victory and glory. The exhibition showing great successes made in the revolution in national defense industry gave the visitors the great pride in the invincible military force firmly guaranteeing the eternal security and future of the country and the conviction of sure victory, and hardened their will to devote all their wisdom and zeal to the sacred struggle for adding luster to the dignity and glory of a powerful country. The visitors watched the video showing the performance and power of the cutting-edge weapon systems of our own types and looked round the exhibits with deep emotion. Rodong Sinmun

title: Red Flag Reflecting Our Ideal
body: The Korean revolution has been vigorously advanced with the greatest ideal of accomplishing the cause of independence of people from its start. President Kim Il Sung drew up the program of the Down-with-Imperialism Union(DIU) and declared the formation of the DIU to down all the imperialisms in the world. It was the manifestation of his great ideal. It was the lofty ideal and aspiration of the President to finish the miserable life of the people suffering from the misdeeds of aggressors and exploiters and build a socialist and communist paradise whose masters are the working people and where they enjoy happy lives. It was also the supreme desire of the people. The Korean revolution made a fresh start with the red flag of the DIU reflecting the ideal. Members of the DIU, burning their hearts with the great aspiration struggled for the future and devoted their all to the revolutionary cause. Holding high the flag of the DIU the Korean revolutionaries unbendingly struggled to realize the historic cause of the national liberation and the class emancipation. Our people defeated two imperialisms in one generation and built a socialist paradise flying the red flag which is imbued with the spirit of DIU. Under the leadership of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il our people grew up into giants of creation realizing their lofty ideal and aspiration on their own hands and into heroic people performing epoch-making miracles century after century. The people’s grand ambition reflected in the red flag of the revolution is being realized more brilliantly under the leadership of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un. Under the guidance of the respected General Secretary our people, keeping in their mind the pride of the people of the great power vigorously advance with confidence and optimism towards an ideal society for mankind set forth by the DIU. Rodong Sinmun

title: Eternal Banner of Victory
body: 95 years have passed since the Down-with-Imperialism Union(DIU) was formed by President Kim Il Sung. Even now the banner of the DIU brightly lights the way of our revolution after a long torrent of time which witnessed changed mountains and streams and several generations replaced. The formation of the DIU meant declaration of live-or-die struggle to down the Japanese imperialists and proclamation of confrontation with all imperialisms on the earth. It was also the solemn thunder which showed the grand ambition and ideal of Korean revolutionaries to build socialism and communism. The world has never witnessed such a great person as President Kim Il Sung who set forth the fighting goal filled with matchless pluck and grandiose ideal and opened a new era under the banner of independence by forming the Juche-oriented revolutionary vanguard organization. Thanks to the formation of the DIU the revolutionary struggle of our people came to enter the new way of its development and our glorious Party began to take root. The program of the DIU became the basis of the program of our Party and the principle of independence set forth by the DIU the principle of our Party in its building and activities. Also the new generation revolutionaries became the backbone for foundation of our Party. The Workers’ Party of Korea was developed into the revolutionary Party of Juche and emerged ever-victorious under the wise leadership of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The immortal exploits of the President and the Chairman, who upheld the idea of the DIU for their whole lives and opened a history of prosperity on this land, shine more brightly as we hold the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un in high esteem. The respected General Secretary realizes the cause of immortalizing the great leaders on the highest level with the noblest moral obligation and sees to it that the history of the great leaders and the idea and tradition are continued invariably. Our people see the great inheritance of the DIU from the present reality that the revolutionary spirit of Mt Paektu is pulsating in the hearts of all the people, the revolutionary armed forces display its dignity as the ever-victorious revolutionary army of the Party and the laughter and hurrah of our people for the Workers’ Party of Korea resound louder. Rodong Sinmun

title: Excellent Life
body: Last Aug 30 the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un met young people, who volunteered to work at difficult and challenging sectors of socialist construction and said that they should lead excellent lives by devoting themselves to bring about prosperity and progress of the country. This bears his noble instruction that they should add luster to their youthhood with ardent loyalty and feats. The young people, who volunteer to serve in the army and work at difficult and challenging sectors by the sweat of their brows, are the genuine youths of our times who are leading excellent lives. A man can lead the valuable life when he personifies the true outlook on life during his youthhood and goes along the road for the Party and the country unyieldingly. But, if not, he can enjoy life of no value. The respected General Secretary, encouraging the youths who volunteered to work at difficult and challenging sectors and started with the clean slate, instructed that they should always live in unshifted and unyielding ways cementing their resolutions made before starting the new lives when they feel tired, hungry and mental agony. The country and people are sure that the youth vanguards will lead excellent lives full of a single-hearted will not to change their ways and attitudes weaving their youthhood with ardent loyalty and patriotism. Rodong Sinmun

title: Jagang Province Hits Its Yearly Cocoon Production Target
body: Jagang Province has honored its yearly cocoon production plan at 102 percent. The province widely applied the effective methods of rearing silkworms and took necessary measures to conquer the unfavorable climatic condition. It organized the breeding of silkworms in a scientific and technological way and finished this year's cocoon production by actively waging the campaign in which one overtakes and learns from others and swaps experiences with them. It sends cocoons to silk mill and silk thread mill and also makes preparations for rearing silkworm next year in a foresighted way. Rodong Sinmun

title: Touching Story Conveyed by Wisong Scientists Residential District
body: Visiting the Same Apartment Twice There is an apartment visited twice by the respected General Secretary in the smartly-decorated fifth block of the Wisong Scientists Residential District. Residing there is a family of an ordinary researcher of the State Academy of Sciences. Whoever visits there can keenly realize how fervent the General Secretary’s love for scientists is. On October 13, Juche 103 (2014), the General Secretary visited the completed residential district. He saw the four vestibules of the fifth block and was satisfied that they looked good with the circular windows newly installed into them as taught by him during his visit in June and that the apartment buildings looked much better. Then he entered Unit 1 on the first floor of the first apartment building. During his inspection of the residential district under construction on June 19, he had visited the same apartment. At that time, the General Secretary had taught that TVs had to be installed in the apartments and that a wide-screen LCD TV was needed for the living room equipped with a large TV table. On his second visit there, he saw to it that the TV he had brought with him was installed in the living room and said affectionately that he was going to present LCD TVs, quilts and utensils to the families of the scientists who were to move to the residential district. Indeed, every apartment of the Wisong Scientists Residential District is full of warm love of the respected General Secretary who is eager to give scientists all the good things. Primary School Conveys His Attentive Care When giving on-the-spot guidance to the completed Wisong Scientists Residential District, the respected General Secretary visited first the Wisong Primary School where the scientists’ children would study. The General Secretary was wearing a broad smile on his face throughout his visit to the school while picturing the children reading out loud and laughing happily in the residential district. That day, he said that as children of the scientists at the State Academy of Sciences would study in the Wisong Primary School it could be called a place where reserves of scientists would grow up and that scientific research as well as revolution had to be carried out generation after generation. He entered the room of Class F in the first grade, expressed satisfaction over the green board and asked with what children would write on the board. He carefully looked at the upper surface of the desk, personally examined it by the hand and pointed out what had to be corrected. He also requested them to make sure that children study in warm classrooms. He inspected every corner of the school including the barber’s, treatment room and indoor swimming pool and took fatherly care of the children. Recollecting that unforgettable day, the headmistress, Ri Hyang Wol said as follows: "'A place where reserves of scientists will grow up'—these words reflect the warm love of the respected General Secretary who pays close attention to the healthy and sound growth of the scientists’ children. True to his lofty intention, we will exert ourselves to train all our pupils to be future talents in the scientific and technological fields." Rodong Sinmun

title: Academy of Defence Science Succeeds in Test-Launch of New Type SLBM
body: The Academy of Defence Science of the DPRK test-fired a new type submarine-launched ballistic missile on Tuesday. The test-launch was guided by Yu Jin, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Kim Jong Sik, vice department director of the Munitions Industry of the Central Committee of the WPK, and leading officials of the Academy. The Academy said that it presented a report of loyalty to the Party Central Committee with the pride and honor of succeeding in the test-launch of new type SLBM from the same "8.24 Yongung" ship from which the first submarine-launched strategic ballistic missile was successfully launched five years ago to demonstrate the military muscle of the DPRK. It clarified that the new type SLBM, into which lots of advanced control guidance technologies including flank mobility and gliding skip mobility are introduced, will greatly contribute to putting the defence technology of the country on a high level and to enhancing the underwater operational capability of our navy. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Chairman of Liberal Democratic Party of Russia
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, received a message of greeting from V. V. Zhirinovsky, chairman of the Liberal Democratic Party of Russia, on October 10. The chairman in the message extended congratulations to Kim Jong Un on behalf of the Liberal Democratic Party of Russia, the oldest political party in Russia, and on his own behalf on the occasion of the 76th founding anniversary of the WPK, the significant day for the WPK and all the people of the DPRK. The message said that the day signifies the undying feats of the Korean communists who built the first socialist state on Korean Peninsula, adding this day would be unthinkable without the careers of Comrades Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il, the great leaders of the Korean people. It wished Kim Jong Un and all the members of the WPK greater successes in building a peaceful and prosperous country, extending congratulations to Kim Jong Un and all the people of the DPRK on this holiday. Wishing Kim Jong Un good health, the message noted that the eternal leaders of the Korean people will remain forever in the memory of the world people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Chairman of C.C., Communist Party of Russian Federation
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), received a message of greeting from G. A. Zhuganov, chairman of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation, on October 10. In the message the chairman extended congratulations to Kim Jong Un and all the people of the DPRK on the occasion of the 76th anniversary of the founding of the WPK, an auspicious holiday. He also extended the sincere congratulations to Kim Jong Un on behalf of millions of communists of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation, supporters and 18 communist parties under the Communist Parties-the Communist Party of the Soviet Union on the occasion of the 24th anniversary of Comrade Kim Jong Il's election as general secretary of the WPK. The WPK was founded, enabling to unite the Korean nation in the struggle for accomplishing the gigantic cause and bring a bright future to them, the message said. Thanks to the wise politics and experienced organizational ability of Comrade Kim Il Sung the WPK achieved victory in the national liberation struggle, occupied a full-fledged position in the international community and brought a great change in the economic and social spheres of the new-born state, the message said, and went on: For over seven decades a great change has been witnessed in the life of the whole mankind. The world civilization has faced a new challenge. However, the WPK is keeping to the path of creation under your leadership. The WPK has made signal achievements in raising its influence on the unity of the world progressive forces standing against invasion by the imperialists and loving peace, and on the development of modern history. In the domestic political field, your party has attached importance to the work for taking good care of the working popular masses, and aroused their ingenuity and creativity. On this significant day, the chairman in the message sincerely reaffirmed that the Communist Party of the Russian Federation and the Communist Parties-the Communist Party of the Soviet Union would keep strengthening in every way the traditions of cooperation between our two parties that have been proven in the past. The message sincerely wished Kim Jong Un good health and happiness, and new success in his responsible work for attaining the important goals of the WPK for the well-being of people of the DPRK and the working people of the world. Rodong Sinmun

title: New Books on Various Themes Published
body: Some publishing houses have recently published books giving the people a great store of knowledge and common sense and contributing to educating them in a revolutionary way. The Industrial Publishing House has published books about industrial art and products of indices for enterprises. The books about industrial art deal with the wise leadership and undying revolutionary feats of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un indicating the bright path for the development of the industrial art. The books about the products of indices for enterprises clarify the issues for socialist enterprises to select and produce the goods according to indices for enterprises as required by the socialist system of responsible business operation. The Science and Encyclopedia Publishing House has brought out the book on the clinical medicine of peritonitis, etc. The books published by the Kumsong Youth Publishing House include collections of poems and scientific books helping educate the schoolchildren. The Art and Literature Publishing House has published new full-length novels, which are gaining popularity with people. Rodong Sinmun

title: 15th Enlarged Plenary Meeting of 8th Central Committee of UAWK Held
body: The 15th enlarged plenary meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea (UAWK) was held by way of video conferencing on Tuesday. Present there were members and alternate members of the Central Committee of the UAWK. Officials of the UAWK in Pyongyang and provinces were present as observers. The meeting had a discussion of how to thoroughly carry out the important tasks set forth by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un in his historic policy speech "On the Orientation of Present Struggle for a Fresh Development of Socialist Construction" at the 5th Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK. Han Jong Hyok, chairman of the Central Committee of the UAWK, made a report. He said that the policy speech serves as an immortal militant banner instilling confidence in sure victory and courage into the hearts of all the people in their drive for a new victory of the revolution and enabling the acceleration of the overall development of our style socialist construction. He stressed the need for all the organizations of the union to direct primary efforts into further consolidating the politico-ideological position which represents the invincible might of our Republic, true to the historic policy speech. He called for arousing the officials and members of the union to the drive for increasing the grain production, waging brisk mass movement for raising the per hectare yield in rice, wheat and barley farming and increasing the ranks of high-yielding farms, workteams, sub-workteams and farmers. He underlined the need for all the officials and members of the union to uphold the important tasks set forth in the administrative policy of the government of the DPRK and fulfill their duty as masters responsible for the granary of the country in the sacred struggle for a fresh development of socialist construction. Speeches were made at the meeting. The meeting made an in-depth study of the draft resolution and put together opinions and, based on them, adopted a relevant resolution. Rodong Sinmun

title: New Goat Farm Built in Sunchon City
body: Sunchon City, South Phyongan Province has built a new large-capacity goat farm amid a brisk drive to expand the capacity of milk producing bases in different parts of the country, true to our Party's childcare policy. The farm is where there are a hundred and tens of hectares of meadow, and it comprises buildings for breeding goats, baby goats and meat goats and also a vet room and a milk processing room. The farm has provided another material foundation for ensuring regular supply of dairy products to children of nurseries and kindergartens in the city. Rodong Sinmun

title: Touching Stories Conveyed by His Road of Devoted Service for People
body: Endless Love One day in June several years ago, the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited the Jangchon Vegetable Co-op Farm in Sadong District. He was so glad since the co-op farm was totally face-lifted to become another fairyland of the era of the Workers’ Party. That day, he dropped by the cultural house of the farm, too, and made rounds of its interior. He expressed his satisfaction over the fact that the cultural house had been laid out as splendidly as an art theatre. Being informed of how the farmers felt about the superb cultural house by the chairwoman of the management board of the co-op farm, he said that the farmers were excited for a good reason and that doing cultural and leisure activities at such a wonderful cultural house would make them as cultured and enterprising as urbanites. After looking round the cultural house, he sincerely said to officials that all the farms had to be laid out well like the co-op farm to let their farmers shout hurrahs for the Workers’ Party of Korea of their own accord. The officials were greatly excited. They could already visualize the happy tomorrow of farms across the country to be brought by the General Secretary’s attentive care. The Greatest of All Pleasures One April day in Juche 108 (2019), the respected General Secretary visited the Yangdok Hot Spring Resort under construction. During his inspection, he went to the site of the pavilion being built on the mountain ridge. He said to the accompanying officials that he had decided to inspect all major construction sites before the significant meetings to be held in the month because the major construction projects were no less than a promise he had made to the people and so he wanted to check in person. The officials couldn’t repress their excitement. The General Secretary went on to say that as he always said, officials had to regard the burdens they shouldered on themselves for the people as the greatest of all pleasures and good lucks and that nobody else could take their place to take pains for the good of the people. This touching story about the General Secretary’s deep love for the people still inspires the officials to devote themselves to the people’s wellbeing. Rodong Sinmun

title: With Hallowed Traces of His Devotion to People
body: For the Laugh of People A mother gets unbounded courage from her laughing child and devotes everything to gladness of her child. Now our people lead happy lives enjoying big laughs and the treasures for their happiness ceaselessly increase in number despite harsh trials. It is unthinkable without the ardent devotion of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un who takes care of people with his warm love. One day the respected General Secretary said that our Party’s idea and will is to make our people and children live with nothing to envy in the world and their happy laughing and hurrah for the Workers’ Party resound everywhere. He added that he could do any difficult works optimistically as he thought of the slogan "We are the happiest in the world! " The laugh of people is the greatest pleasure and courage for him. So the respected General Secretary is carrying on his devoted service for the people. Indeed, the treasures for people are increasing constantly and the people enjoy a happy life under the loving care of the respected General Secretary. The Most Valuable Treasure The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un regards the trust of our people as the most valuable treasure. At the military parade celebrating the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers’ Party of Korea the respected General Secretary said our people had placed trust, as high as sky and as deep as sea, on him, but he had failed to always live up to it satisfactorily and he was really sorry for that. And he solemnly swore once again in that place that he would live up to the people’s trust without fail even if his body was torn and crushed to pieces on the way of defending their great trust and that he would remain faithful to that trust. His words are touching heartstrings of the people in the country even now. The respected General Secretary is continuously going his way of devoted service for our people keeping in his mind the trust of the people as the most valuable treasure and our people believe in him as in heaven and remain loyal to him. This harmonious whole is what makes our country strong. Rodong Sinmun

title: Rice Harvesting Finished in DPRK
body: The agricultural officials and workers across the country have finished the rice harvesting. Officials of the Ministry of Agriculture and provincial rural economy committees scrupulously organized the work for finishing the harvesting with lightning speed and aroused the people with brisk field political work and their practical examples. The agricultural workers in Pyongyang have made distinguished successes in the rice harvesting. The farms in Mangyongdae, Ryokpho and Hyongjesan districts raised the operating rate of the farm machines like combine rice-harvester, scrupulously rationalized the manpower allotment, and thus overfulfilled the daily plan of cutting rice plants. The agricultural workers in other provinces direct their efforts into threshing in the spirit of having finished the rice harvesting. Rodong Sinmun

title: Centenarians on Increase in DPRK
body: The number of centenarians has increased among the Korean people. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un sent a birthday spread to Kim Thae Suk, a centenarian living in Pyongyang. A ceremony for conveying the birthday spread took place at neighborhood unit No. 38 of Ponghwa-dong in Pothonggang District. Before the liberation of Korea she was subject to all sorts of hardships as a member of the ruined nation. It was not until President Kim Il Sung liberated the country that she could enjoy a worthwhile life as a master of the country. She, being conscious of preciousness of the Workers' Party of Korea and the country, became a member of the Party before others and worked as an official of the women's union and in the public catering sector. She is fond of reading and enjoying her remaining life in good health under the care of the officials of the dong, doctors, neighbors and the whole family members. She requests her descendants and neighbors to do work for the socialist system of our country with sincerity. Rodong Sinmun

title: 4th Enlarged Plenary Meeting of 10th Central Committee of Socialist Patriotic Youth League Held
body: The 4th Enlarged Plenary Meeting of the 10th Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League was held through video-conferencing on Wednesday. Attending the meeting were members and alternate members of the Central Committee of the youth league. Present at the meeting as observers were officials of the youth league committees of ministries, national institutions and provinces. Discussed at the meeting were matters of thoroughly implementing the important tasks set forth by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un in his historic policy speech "On the Orientation of Present Struggle for a Fresh Development of Socialist Construction" at the 5th Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK. Mun Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the youth league, made a report. He said that the historic policy speech made by the respected General Secretary is an action programme which most correctly reflects the requirements of our revolution that has entered the stage of signal development, and an immortal programme which instills tremendous vitality and encouragement to the all-people efforts to attain the goals of victory set forth by the 8th Party Congress. Saying that there is a heavy and sacred task before the young people to glorify the honor of the socialist patriotic youth league in the van of the general offensive for the overall development of our style socialist construction, bearing deep in mind the great trust and expectation of the Party Central Committee, he suggested the measures to implement the tasks set forth in the administrative policy. He called upon the organizations of the youth league to enhance their militant function and role in the struggle for thoroughly implementing the important tasks set forth by the respected General Secretary in his policy speech, and upon all the young people to fully demonstrate the mettle of the patriotic youth in the advance towards the fresh development of our style socialist construction. There were speeches at the meeting. The meeting adopted a relevant resolution based on the study of the draft resolution. Rodong Sinmun

title: 76th Founding Anniversary of WPK Observed Abroad
body: Celebrations took place in different countries on the occasion of the 76th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). There were celebration meetings, film shows and photo exhibitions in Norway, Denmark, Sweden and Finland, and a lecture in Brazil between October 7 and 11. Edits about the might of the WPK were shown at the film shows. The chairman of the Ostfold County Committee of the Communist Party of Norway praised the WPK for accomplishing the historic task of socialist industrialization in a short period under the outstanding and experienced leadership of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and building a socialist country, independent in politics, self-supporting in economy and self-reliant in defence, adding it has demonstrated its might decade after decade. The chairman of the Denmark-DPRK Friendship Association said that all the victories the Korean people won are a fruition of the outstanding leadership of the WPK, adding it is being admired by the world revolutionary parties and progressive people. The chairman of the Finland-Korea Society and the international secretary of the Finnish Communists' League said that the WPK is the most powerful party which is victoriously advancing the Korean revolution and the cause of global independence, and the proud achievements the DPRK has made encourage the progressive people struggling to achieve independence. The chairman of the Brazilian Center for the Study of Songun Politics said that the WPK is upholding H.E. Kim Jong Un at the top posts and developing into a genuine mother party devoting efforts for the good of the people under the uplifted banner of great Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism. Congratulatory messages to Kim Jong Un were adopted at the events held in Norway, Sweden and Finland. Rodong Sinmun

title: Third Enlarged Plenary Meeting of Seventh Central Committee of SWUK Held
body: The Third Enlarged Plenary Meeting of the Seventh Central Committee of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea (SWUK) was held through video conferencing on October 20. Present there were members and alternate members of the Central Committee of the union. Officials of the Central Committee and the provincial, city and county committees of the union were present as observers. The meeting discussed the ways of thoroughly implementing the tasks set forth by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un in his historic policy speech "On the Orientation of Present Struggle for a Fresh Development of Socialist Construction" at the 5th Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK. Kim Jong Sun, chairwoman of the C.C., SWUK, said in her report that officials and members of the union across the country were full of extraordinary revolutionary enthusiasm to vigorously advance toward a bright future under the leadership of the respected General Secretary, upon receiving an immortal great programme hardening firm faith in socialism and steadfast will. She said that the women's union is now faced with an honorable duty to propel the ongoing all-people general march for the prosperity of our state by arousing all the union members to implementing the tasks set forth in the administrative policy of the DPRK government. She referred to the tasks to carry it out. She called for thoroughly implementing the important tasks set forth in the historic policy speech made by the respected General Secretary, and thus vigorously propelling the new development of socialist construction of our own style with the Korean women's strong mental power and patriotic devotion. Speeches were made at the meeting. The meeting adopted a relevant resolution after studying a draft resolution. Rodong Sinmun

title: Joint Internet Photo Exhibition Marks 55th Anniversary of Raul Castro Ruz's Visit to DPRK
body: The joint internet photo exhibition of the Korean Central News Agency and the Prensa Latina News Agency of Cuba "DPRK-Cuba Friendship, Century after Century" opened on October 20 on the occasion of the 55th anniversary of Comrade Raul Castro Ruz's visit to the DPRK. Posted on the internet websites are photos documenting the immortal exploits performed by President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un together with the Cuban leaders for the development of friendly relations between the two countries. The photo exhibition will serve as an excellent occasion conducive to carrying forward the deep-rooted history of the strategic and comradely relations of friendship and cooperation between the DPRK and Cuba forged in the joint struggle for accomplishing the cause of independence and socialism against imperialism and to further consolidating them as required by the new era. The exhibition will continue till November 6. Rodong Sinmun

title: North Phyongan Provincial Children's Camp Inaugurated
body: The North Phyongan Provincial Children's Camp has been inaugurated. The children's camp, which has been built on the picturesque shore of the River Samgyo in Phihyon County, has a pavilion, dining hall, multi-purpose hall and all other amenities for the convenience of camping. This general center for the extracurricular education of schoolchildren will contribute to training children to be revolutionaries, knowledgeable, morally impeccable and physically sound. An inaugural ceremony took place on Oct. 20. Attending it were Mun Kyong Dok, chief secretary of the North Phyongan Provincial Party Committee, Hong Su Jin, chairman of the provincial youth league committee, officials concerned, the builders, the staff of the camp, schoolchildren and working people in the county. Rodong Sinmun

title: Jongbangsan Hotel Inaugurated
body: A modern hotel has been built and inaugurated at the foot of picturesque Mt Jongbang. The hotel, which harmonizes with the natural environment of the celebrated mountain and is perfect in formative artistic terms, has three main buildings, a gym, a swimming pool, etc. An inaugural ceremony took place on the spot on Oct. 20.
