It was attended by Pak Chang Ho, chief secretary of the North Hwanghae Provincial Party Committee, officials and working people of Party and power organs and enterprises in the province, the builders and hotel employees. Im Hun, chairman of the provincial people's committee, made an inaugural speech. Rodong Sinmun

title: Defence Development Exhibition Self-Defence-2021 Closes
body: The Defence Development Exhibition Self-Defence-2021 closed after running for ten days. It was opened on October 11 to mark the 76th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea. At the exhibition which was held before full houses amid the great interest of the people, the visitors keenly felt once again the irresistible strength of the dignified DPRK and its strategic position and cherished the great pride and self-confidence living and struggling in a powerful socialist country and the conviction in the future which will witness a more powerful and prosperous country. A closing ceremony took place on Friday. Attending it was Pak Jong Chon, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Present there were Yu Jin, department director of the Central Committee of the WPK, leading officials, scientists and technicians in the fields of defence science research and the munitions industry. Pak Jong Chon made a closing speech. The exhibition intensively showed the weapons prioritized by our Party and thus further consolidated the position of the DPRK as a military power of self-defense capable of coping with any types of military threats and situations in an active and powerful way, the speaker said. At the exhibition the national defense science field and the working people of the munitions industry once again warmly felt the worth and honor in the weapons of the revolution they produced with painstaking efforts, came up with new ideas and raised their strenuous spirit and emulation passion while sharing each other's advanced experience and technologies, he said, adding this served as a valuable asset for more greatly toughening the country's military muscle and also was a major achievement made in the exhibition. The Party's policy on national defense is a fair and just state policy that nobody can violate and the uninterrupted beefing up of the defense capability for the future is the invariable path that no force can hold in check, he said, stressing that the exhibition was a proud review of the development of the defense industry that underwent great change in the great era of Kim Jong Un and, at the same time, a start of a new forced march. In the unstable situation in the vicinity of the Korean Peninsula, resting on one's laurels and praising oneself are the worst taboo, he said, calling for attaining at the shortest time the goals of the national defense development strategy set forth at the Eighth Party Congress with the current achievements as a springboard so as to make the military and technical strength of the country absolute and everlasting. When the exhibition was declared closed, the song "The Glorious Motherland" was solemnly played. All the participants were determined to make strenuous efforts to develop the state defense capability, deeply cherishing the iron truth that the security of the country, happiness of the people and eternal future for all generations to come will be guaranteed when they remain faithful to the idea and leadership of Kim Jong Un with a single mind. The exhibition will serve as a meaningful festival that accelerated the strengthening of the defence capability of the country and a significant occasion that further propelled the overall development of our style of socialist construction as it fully showed the validity and the shining vitality of the revolutionary national defence policy of the ever-victorious WPK. Rodong Sinmun

title: Foreign Personages Pay Congratulatory Visits to DPRK Missions
body: Foreign figures paid congratulatory visits to the DPRK missions in their countries on the occasion of the 76th anniversary of the founding of the Workers' Party of Korea. They laid floral baskets and bouquets at the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and the art pieces depicting them together and made bows. They include the first secretary and the secretary of the Khabarovsk Territorial Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation, the first secretary of the Khabarovsk Territory Committee of the Lenin Young Communist League of the Russian Federation, the general secretary of the Central Committee of the Nepal Communist Party (Marxist-Leninist), members of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Nepal Communist Party (United), the chairman of the Nepal Journalist Association for the Study of the Juche Idea and Songun Politics, the chairperson of the Study Forum for Self-Reliance of Nepal, the chairperson of the Nepali Literary Forum for the Study of Songun Politics, the chairperson of the International Committee for the Study of Songun Politics for Peaceful Reunification of Korea in Nepal, the vice-chairperson of the Socialist Journalist Forum of Nepal for the Study of the Juche Idea, the editor-in-chief of the Nepalese newspaper Gorkha Express, the chairperson of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Bangladesh, the chairman of the Central Executive Committee of the Bangladesh National Socialist Party, the general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Bangladesh (Marxist-Leninist), the secretary general of the International Taekwon-Do Association in Iran, the director general of the Department of International Cooperation of the Vietnam Academy of Social Sciences, the director of the Central Secretariat of the Pakistan People's Party, the chairman of the Anti-Imperialist Forum of Germany, the chairman of the Permanent Standing Committee of the Belarus National Association of Friends of Korean People Named after Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il, the first secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Belarus, the chairman of the Organizational Committee of the Communist Workers' Party of Belarus, the chairman of the Belarus Association for the Study of Juche Idea, the chief of the Belarusian Group for Solidarity with the DPRK, the deputy general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the DR Congo, the chairperson of the National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of the DR Congo, a member of the Political Bureau of the Workers' Party for the Independence of Senegal, a lawmaker from the Socialist Party of Senegal, the chief of a regional group for the study of the Juche idea in Senegal, the director of the International Department of the Democratic Party of Equatorial Guinea, the chairman of the Ethiopian Committee for the Study of the Independent Politics, and members of the China Dongfangyi Tuozhan Association and a Chinese organization. The chairman of the Laos-Korea Friendship Association and his party, the general secretaries and members of the political bureaus of the Syrian Communist Party (Unified) and the Socialist Unionist Party of Syria, the general secretary of the France-Korea Friendship Association and his party, a member of the National Leadership of the Brazilian Democratic Workers' Party and the vice-chairman of the Socialist Freedom Party of Egypt also visited the DPRK missions. Meanwhile, floral baskets and bouquets were sent to the DPRK missions by the Committee for External Affairs of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party, the Commission for External Affairs of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam, the Vietnamese Ministry of Public Security, the Ho Chi Minh Communist Youth Union of Vietnam, Newspaper Nhan Dan, the Vietnam Academy of Social Sciences, the chairman of the Pakistan-Korea Friendship and Solidarity Committee, the national leader of the Workers' Party of Mexico and the general secretary of the Central Committee of the People's Socialist Party of Mexico. Rodong Sinmun

title: 3rd Enlarged Plenary Meeting of 8th Central Committee of GFTUK Held
body: The 3rd Enlarged Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea (GFTUK) was held through video-conferencing on October 21. Present there were members and alternate members of the Central Committee of the GFTUK. Officials of the Central Committee of the GFTUK were present as observers. The meeting discussed the ways of thoroughly carrying out the important tasks set forth by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un in his historic policy speech "On the Orientation of Present Struggle for a Fresh Development of Socialist Construction" at the 5th Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK. Pak In Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the GFTUK, made a report. He stressed that the policy speech made by the respected General Secretary, reflective of the firm will to glorify our great state in the world and the spirit of unconditionally serving the people, is a militant banner encouraging all the people to implement the action programme set forth by the Party Congress. He proposed the measures arising in vigorously arousing officials and members of the GFTUK to the all-people general advance for winning a fresh shining victory on all fronts of socialist construction. Speeches were made at the meeting. The meeting adopted a relevant resolution after studying a draft resolution. Rodong Sinmun

title: What Makes Our Country Young
body: Still kept in the young people’s hearts is the great trust of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un who wrote in his letter of congratulations to young people that a state with a huge army of young people, who stoutly carry forward the revolutionary spirit and fighting stamina created by their preceding generations, advances by leaps and bounds full of youthful vigor without knowing any senility forever. In the van of socialist construction led by our Party despite all challenges and hardships to victory have always stood brave and gallant young people firmly rallied round the Party. Besides, they have grown to be strong pillars of our socialist country in the new era of the Juche revolution. Our country is advancing by leaps and bounds always full of vitality and vigor in spite of difficulties as it has a large contingent of such trustworthy young people who are adorning their prime days with creation and innovation out of eagerness to shoulder all the heavy burdens of the country on themselves. Youth of a country is ensured by its young people who constitute the most active unit of the society and the heroes of the future. Making leaps and bounds full of youthful vigor, our great country now calls upon young people to go to the places where new feats are being achieved. Let us become a kindling spark and a prairie fire in the ongoing gigantic general advance!—This is the faith and will of the young people today. Our country will be vibrant with youthful vigor forever thanks to its millions of promising young people who have staunchly inherited the loyalty and patriotism bequeathed by their revolutionary forerunners. Rodong Sinmun

title: We Will Devote Our Youth to Country
body: More young people across the country volunteer to work at difficult worksites after receiving the congratulatory letter sent by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un to the young people who volunteered to work in difficult and challenging sectors of socialist construction. The volunteering atmosphere grows stronger. Then why do they leave their dear homes and cities and go to mines, coal mines, construction sites and farms? After the Eighth Congress of the Workers’ Party of Korea, a young volunteer from Nampho City, a graduate of Kim Il Sung University, volunteered to work at a socialist farm with his diploma, saying that he regards it as the greatest honor to take the lead in upholding and carrying out the respected General Secretary’s intention and desire. Those, who have settled in the workplaces and places strange to them with firm determination to throw themselves into resolving the afflictions of the Party and the state, are trustworthy young vanguards with excellent character. Every upsurge of our revolution has begun with the sweeping enthusiasm of the young people for volunteering, and this enthusiasm has always given rise to a revolutionary and patriotic zeal, resulting in stirring eras. "Go through fire and water in response to the Party’s call!" Keeping in their minds the slogan of faith, our youths will devote their efforts and enthusiasm to performing brilliant miracles and feats. Rodong Sinmun

title: In Days of Bringing Up Those with Strong Will
body: Great Encouragement One day in June, Juche 105 (2016), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Silk Mill. When he entered its silk-reeling workshop, he was informed that a girl silk reeler had overfulfilled her yearly national economic assignments by four times for four years, fulfilled her yearly quota for the national economic plan ahead of schedule during the 70-day campaign of loyalty and had thus become a member of the Workers’ Party of Korea. He met the girl in person, shook her wet hands and praised that she really did an excellent job. The girl was too excited to repress her tears. Feasting his trusting eyes on her, he went on to say that heroes in the Chollima era worked just like her and that it was important for those making revolution to become members of the Party but what was even more honorable for them as Party members was to luster their precious political lives till their last moments. Greatly encouraged by his teachings full of fatherly affection, the girl expressed her firm determination to carry out her national economic plans for six years during the 200-day campaign at any cost. He patted her on the back with satisfaction and told her he hoped she would attain her ambitious goal without fail. Like this, the respected General Secretary’s ardent love and great trust constitute a driving force which gives full play to the popular masses’ tenacity and mental strength and hardens their faith of creation. To Ensure That They Regard Party’s Policy on Home-Production as Lifeline One day in October, Juche 105(2016), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un provided field guidance to the Mangyongdae Revolutionary Site Souvenir Factory. Looking round the factory he expressed great satisfaction over the fact that the level of the home-production of the raw and other materials in the factory was very high. That day he looked round the factory for a long span of time and said that all factories and enterprises in the sector of light industry should step up the work for home-production of their equipment and use of domestically available raw and other materials noting that the sector of light industry could never lift itself up by its own bootstraps if it continued to rely on import of equipment and raw and other materials needed for the production of consumer goods. He stressed that we must hold fast to the Party’s policy of home-production as our lifeline and officials of the light industry sector must never give up the Party’s policy of home-production like the farmers who never boil seeds in any hunger. Receiving his earnest teaching the officials kept in their minds the iron truth that unlimited motive power of the officials’ creation lay in their spirit of believing in their own strengths, the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance. Rodong Sinmun

title: His Kind Question - "Do People Like It?"
body: The respected General Secretary, who continues his devoted service for the people, always asks a question to officials whenever he witnesses works for the good of the people or creatures for them. "Do the people like it?" It is not a long question but it reflects the pains of the great father who always considers the people’s minds, devotes his all to them and thoroughly pursues the people’s demands and interests in his all works and practices. He coherently considers how to provide the people with greater delight and happiness. He always sees to it that officials do every work as demanded by the people and estimates the success or failure by the appreciation of people. This is his boundlessly lofty spirit of serving the people and noble view on them. When he visited a new picturesque village in Kangbuk-ri he repeatedly asked if the inhabitants, the farmers were pleased with the new living environment that had been rebuilt after damage due to rainstorm and strong wind. Noting that he was very pleased to hear that they were feeling glad, he said that our Party certainly had done good things. On the day when he visited the Kumkhop General Foodstuff Factory for Sportspeople, hearing in delight that the people liked the foodstuffs of the factory he said that it was good if the people liked it and the criterion of evaluation was precisely the people’s appreciation. At that time seeing his broad smile the people deeply engraved in their minds the peerlessly great man’s world of love for the people. "Do the people like it?" His question comprises his absolute criterion that every work must be planned true to the people’s demands and interests and the result must be estimated by the people’s appreciation. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Nano Sci-tech Exhibition-2021 Opens
body: The National Nano Sci-tech Exhibition-2021 opened on Oct. 22 under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea. The exhibition on the theme of "Consolidation of Foundations for Creation of Nano Industry" aims to show, popularize and exchange nano-products as well as the scientific research successes made in the nanotechnology field so as to positively propel the development of nano industry. Attending the exhibition are teachers, researchers and postgraduate students, etc. of scores of units, including Kim Il Sung University, Kim Chaek University of Technology and the Nano Engineering Branch of the State Academy of Sciences. The exhibition of over 190 entries will take place as a virtual exhibition and also as a video teleconference presentation. During the exhibition there will be a lecture on the world's trend of the development of nano industry and its features. The exhibition will continue until Oct. 29. Rodong Sinmun

title: Staff Members of Cuban Embassy Visit Korean Revolution Museum
body: Cuban Ambassador to the DPRK Jesus De Los Angeles Aise Sotolongo and his embassy members visited the Korean Revolution Museum on October 22 on the occasion of the 55th anniversary of Comrade Raul Castro Ruz's visit to the DPRK. They bowed to the color statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in the general review room. They went around various rooms, being briefed on the revolutionary exploits of Kim Il Sung, Kim Jong Il and the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. Looking round photos and data showing the solidity and invincibility of the relations of friendship and cooperation between the DPRK and Cuba forged by the leaders of the two countries on the way for the victorious advance of socialist cause, they expressed deep impression. The Cuban ambassador said that the visit helped him know about the old history of friendship between Cuba and the DPRK better, and expressed his will to contribute to strengthening the traditional friendship between the two countries. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Seminar Held in DR Congo
body: A national seminar on the party-building exploits performed by President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un took place in Kinshasa of the DR Congo on the occasion of the 24th anniversary of Kim Jong Il's election as general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and the 76th founding anniversary of the WPK. Present there were Andre Lohekele Kalonda, secretary general of the African Regional Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea, Otete Gaston Mboyo, deputy general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the DR Congo and chairman of the DR Congo-Korea Friendship and Solidarity Association, the general secretary and the deputy general secretary of the National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of the DR Congo and other personages from various circles and followers of the Juche idea. A reporter and speakers said that the Juche idea, the guiding idea of the ever-victorious WPK, was founded and developed by the President and the Chairman and that the idea is widely studied and disseminated throughout the world. Saying that the WPK, a party strong in the sense of independence, has formed a harmonious whole with the popular masses and holds the people absolute with priority given to their interests, they praised the party-building exploits of the leaders. They stressed that the Korean-style socialism is the one centered on the people without an equal in the world, the people's dreams and ideals are translated into a reality in the DPRK and that the study and dissemination of the Juche idea will have to be intensified so as to contribute to building a new society in the DR Congo. A letter to Kim Jong Un was adopted at the seminar. Rodong Sinmun

title: Title of Model Forestation County (City and District) Instituted
body: The title of model forestation county (city and district) was instituted in the DPRK. Official commendations are to be given to the counties (cities and districts) which set an example in sprucing them up and providing their people with highly civilized living environments by improving the work of afforestation and greening in keeping with the requirements of the great era of Kim Jong Un. The relevant decree of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK was made public on Oct. 18. Rodong Sinmun

title: Title of Model Law-observance County (City and District) Instituted
body: The title of model law-observance county (city and district) was instituted in the DPRK. Official commendations are to be given to the counties (cities and districts) which contribute to thoroughly creating the revolutionary law-observance atmosphere and further consolidating our state social system by turning the observance of socialist law into the work of the masses themselves as required by the great era of Kim Jong Un. The relevant decree of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK was made public on Oct. 18. Rodong Sinmun

title: New Veterinary Medicine Factory Built in North Hwanghae Province
body: A veterinary medicine factory of the North Hwanghae Provincial Epizootic Prevention Center was inaugurated with due ceremony on October 22. The factory, a foundation for the massive production of essential Koryo veterinary medicines for prevention and treatment, would ensure the improvement of epizootic prevention and sustainable development of stockbreeding. The ceremony was attended by Pak Chang Ho, chief secretary of the North Hwanghae Provincial Party Committee, officials and working people in the agricultural sector of the province. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Reply Message from General Secretary Xi Jinping
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a reply message from Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC) and president of the People's Republic of China (PRC), on October 19. Xi Jinping in the message expressed his heartfelt thanks to Kim Jong Un for sending a sincere and passionate message of greeting on the occasion of the 72nd founding anniversary of the PRC. This year marks the 72nd anniversary of the foundation of new China and the 100th founding anniversary of the CPC, the message said. It said that various nations of China have got united and made exertions under the leadership of the CPC for the past 72 years and thus registered successes of development drawing the attention of the world people. It noted that China has accomplished the first 100-year goal of building a comprehensively well-off society before the time set and is dynamically advancing toward the second 100-year goal for building a comprehensively modern and powerful socialist country. The message said that the two countries, PRC and DPRK, are linked by the same mountain and rivers, and the traditional friendship between the two countries is getting more solid over time. It noted that currently, COVID-19 is still sweeping the world and the greatest change in 100 years is being witnessed in the world. It stressed that soundly safeguarding, strengthening and developing the friendship between China and the DPRK comply with the fundamental interests of both sides and are beneficial to the stability and prosperity of the region. Xi Jinping in the message said that he attaches great importance to the development of the China-DPRK relations and has intent to steadily propel the relations to a new stage by strengthening strategic communications, deepening the friendship and cooperation and leading them to be conducive to mutual support through joint endeavors with Kim Jong Un. Recalling that some days ago, the Korean people celebrated the 76th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea with splendor, Xi Jinping expressed belief that the Korean people would thoroughly implement the decisions made at the 8th Congress of the WPK and surely and steadily achieve a new and greater success in the cause of socialist construction by getting united and exerting persevering efforts under the firm leadership of the Central Committee of the WPK led by Kim Jong Un. The message wished Kim Jong Un good health and hoped that work would go on well for him. It also wished the DPRK prosperity and its people happiness and well-being. Rodong Sinmun

title: Large Harmonious Family Full of Virtue and Affection
body: The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un bestows great love upon doers of laudable deeds who devoted themselves to their society, collectives and country. Thanks to him, numerous models of virtue are respected and beloved as credits to our era and patriots to be emulated by everybody. Such models include Jang Jong Hwa whom the General Secretary personally called “a mother girl” and teachers who volunteered for island branch schools, schools in frontline areas or mountain regions. That’s not all. The General Secretary went out to the dangerous typhoon-stricken areas out of worries about the victims and saw to it that every possible measure was taken lest they feel inconvenience in their living. He roused all the Party members in Pyongyang to the recovery work, saying that it is a national trait that all the parts of the country always defend the capital, its heart, in every possible way, but it can also be called our proud national trait that the citizens of the capital city give sincere support and encouragement to the provincial people when they are in difficulties. As a result, Party members in Pyongyang and service personnel turned out in the recovery campaign and people across the country helped the typhoon sufferers both mentally and materially. All of these were what could be witnessed only in our great socialist family with a great father. Indeed, no one in the world can match our country brimming with ennobling moral traits and fraternal affection and our people firmly rallied behind the great leader in terms of ideology, purpose, morality and sense of obligation Rodong Sinmun

title: We Live under Warm Care of Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un
body: It Is Not a Simple Matter The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un never tolerates inconveniences to people no matter how trivial they may be. Once, a clock at the Munsu Water Park ran out of order for a while. However, nobody took it as a big deal and even officials failed to take care of it. Informed of this, the General Secretary said that it could by no means be taken as a simple matter of stopped clock but what had really stopped were the hearts of officials who served the people. Advising Them to Replace Mat One October day in Juche 104 (2015), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited the Kim Jong Thae Electric Locomotive Complex. Having learnt in detail about the style, color and technical features of the new-made subway train, he got on its passenger car. Then, all of a sudden, he felt the smooth plastic mat on the floor of the car by his hand. Looking at the puzzled official, he pointed out that the passenger car had to be carpeted with a rough mat, not a smooth one. Consequently, the mat of the subway train was replaced thanks to the attentive care of the respected General Secretary who puts people’s convenience above all. Rodong Sinmun

title: Rice Harvesting Finished in DPRK
body: The agricultural officials and workers across the country have finished the rice harvesting. Officials of the Ministry of Agriculture and provincial rural economy committees scrupulously organized the work for finishing the harvesting with lightning speed and aroused the people with brisk field political work and their practical examples. The agricultural workers in Pyongyang have made distinguished successes in the rice harvesting. The farms in Mangyongdae, Ryokpho and Hyongjesan districts raised the operating rate of the farm machines like combine rice-harvester, scrupulously rationalized the manpower allotment, and thus overfulfilled the daily plan of cutting rice plants. The agricultural workers in other provinces direct their efforts into threshing in the spirit of having finished the rice harvesting. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Wreath to Cemetery of Fallen Soldiers of CPV
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a wreath to the Cemetery of the Fallen Soldiers of the Chinese People's Volunteers (CPV) in Hoechang County, South Phyongan Province, on the occasion of the anniversary of the CPV's entry into the Korean front. The historic significance of the CPV's entry into the Korean front which clearly manifested the militant friendship and great unity between the peoples of the two countries remains unchanged as it is even after the lapse of over 70 years, and it is immortal in the annals of bilateral friendship. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un said that during the past Fatherland Liberation War, the Chinese party and government made a strategic decision of dispatching the CPV to the Korean front under the banner of resisting America and aiding Korea, safeguarding the home and defending the motherland despite the very difficult situation, rendered disinterested revolutionary assistance and won the great victory in the war with the united forces of the peoples and armies of the two countries and thus defended the security of the two countries and wrote a brilliant page in the history of the DPRK-China friendship with blood and life. Saying that the Korean people would never forget the blood shed by the CPV officers and men and the feats performed by them for helping our revolution in the same trench for repelling the imperialist invasion, and that the DPRK-China friendship sealed in blood would be further consolidated without any change despite the replacements of generations, Kim Jong Un added that he sent the wreath to the cemetery, carrying his respect and sincerity for the eternal glorification of the noble souls of the martyrs on the platform of honor. The wreath sent by Kim Jong Un on behalf of all the Korean people was politely laid before the Cemetery of the Fallen Soldiers of the Chinese People's Volunteers on Monday. And wreathes sent by the Central Committee of the WPK and the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK were reverently placed. Political News Team

title: ﻿Branch of Institute of Pomiculture Built in Sariwon
body: The Sariwon branch of the Institute of Pomiculture under the Academy of Agricultural Science was built. The research base, another contribution to the development of the fruit farming of the country, has a general laboratory, cultivation research room, insect research room and other conditions necessary for studying fruit farming. An inaugural ceremony took place on the spot on Sunday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Swan Corral Built in Kwangpho Duck Farm
body: A swan corral has been built in the Kwangpho Duck Farm. The enclosure belonging to the swan work-team of the Sondok breeding poultry shop has several blocks of sheds, a block for young birds and sanitary inspection rooms and other conditions necessary for breeding. The construction has provided a foundation for improving the people's living standard through the industrial breeding of black swan, rare ornamental bird. A completion ceremony took place on the spot on Sunday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Noble Love and Affection Beget Indomitable Fighting Spirit
body: Noble love and affection underlie the burning patriotic passion and creating manner displayed by Party members and other working people and service personnel in their worksites of socialist construction. Noble love and affection become a source of tremendous strength and passion exceeding one's physical limits whatever the adversity. Only those who have warm love and affection as well as steadfast idea and faith can follow through on the path of the revolution fraught with untold harsh ordeals and difficulties. The fighters who pushed their way through endless snowstorms and waged long bloody battles during the anti-Japanese war and the heroic soldiers during the Fatherland Liberation War who muzzled the enemy's pillboxes with their chests and destroyed the enemy's tanks at the cost of their lives were all genuine sons and daughters of Korea who loved the country and people more warmly than anyone else. Our people's noble love and affection get stronger whenever more ordeals and trials crop up and it is a source multiplying their strength and courage. The indomitable revolutionary spirit and heroic fighting traits fully displayed by our people are a manifestation of their kinship with the leader and their noble moral obligation. The kinship between the great leaders and our people continues thanks to the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un. Today our people remain faithful to him to live up to his loving care, bearing deep in mind the kinship with him. All the officials, Party members and other working people should deeply cherish the warm love and affection and make proud achievements in the ongoing struggle for a new victory of socialism. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chemical Industry Reinforces Self-supporting Foundation
body: The chemical industry has become innovative in its endeavors to reinforce its self-supporting foundations. The Hungnam Fertilizer Complex has completed a new ammonia production process through anthracite gasification to keep the normal operation of the generator. The February 8 Vinalon Complex, which had opened up prospects for the revitalization of production by building a catalyst production base essential to the production of vinyl chloride and vinalon with its own efforts and technology, has put the production of caustic soda on normal footing by rebuilding the salt-dissolving ground. The Ponghwa Chemical Factory has updated the production lines and increased the production of chemical goods conducive to the economic construction and the improvement of the standard of people's living. The Sinuiju Chemical Fibre Mill is further perfecting the process of producing paper with reed as raw material and also locally manufacturing reagents with locally available raw materials in its hard push for paper production. It is also pushing ahead with the projects for new construction and modernization as scheduled. The Chongjin Chemical Fibre Mill is speeding up the trial operation of the rayon pulp production process for confirming its technical specifications. The Pyongyang Rubber Factory and the Wonsan Chemical Factory are stepping up the rubber production by producing adhesive from waste pulp fluid and the Myonggan Chemical Factory is rounding off the brown coal dry distillation process with their own efforts and technology and with locally available materials. Rodong Sinmun

title: New Technologies Introduced in Metallurgical Industry
body: The metallurgical industry is continuously strengthening the production foundation, giving priority to science and technology. The Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex has introduced the technology of measuring the slag level into the oxygen heat blast furnace and is actively drawing on advanced sci-tech achievements to perfect the current production lines. The Chollima Steel Complex has introduced the oxygen-pulverized coal injection technology into UHP electric arc furnace in close cooperation with a scientific research institution, thus opening up prospects for saving time and electricity needed for steel making line and lowering the standard of material consumption per unit. The Puryong Ferroalloy Factory has developed an additive essential to electrode production and established the manganic ferroalloy production process using low-grade ore. Rodong Sinmun

title: 76th Founding Anniversary of WPK Observed Abroad
body: There took place seminars, lectures, film shows and photo exhibitions in Mongolia, Thailand, Italy and Algeria on the occasion of the 76th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea. Attending the events were political and public personages and other people of those countries. Screened at the film shows were edits introducing the proud reality of socialist Korea. The general secretary and the international secretary of the Movement for Peace and Socialism of Italy praised the WPK, which was founded by President Kim Il Sung and led by Chairman Kim Jong Il, for having guided the Korean people to victory by smashing the imperialists' moves for stifling the DPRK, under the uplifted banner of Juche. They noted that the WPK has developed into a servant party, genuine mother party which devotes itself to the well-being of the people with priority given to their interests under the leadership of General Secretary Kim Jong Un. The chairman of the Algeria-Korea Friendship Association said that the 70 odd year-long history of the WPK is just the revolutionary history of the great President Kim Il Sung, H.E. Kim Jong Il and the respected H.E. Kim Jong Un. He said with appreciation that H.E. Kim Jong Un is leaving immortal footprints on the road for building a prosperous country and making dedication to the people with his warm love for and trust in them. The speakers at the seminar attended by the figures of the government, political parties, organizations and institutions including the State Great Hural of Mongolia, the Mongolian People's Party, the Mongolian Democratic Party, the Mongolian Academy of Sciences, the Mongolian Mt Paektu Association for Independent Development, the Mongolian Association for the Study of the Juche Idea-Songun Idea, the Mongolian Centre for the Study of Juche and the Mongolian Cultural and Research Center of the DPRK said that the WPK could confidently advance the revolution and construction in the face of trials and difficulties as it was led by the peerlessly great men. Wishing the Korean people greater successes in their struggle for implementing the decisions set forth at the 8th Party Congress, firmly united around the WPK led by Kim Jong Un, they voiced their will to actively contribute to the development of the friendly relations between the peoples of the two countries. Rodong Sinmun

title: Warmhearted Mind of Fatherly Leader
body: The Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill has undergone quite a change over the past 8 years. An imposing gate was erected with the respected General Secretary’s autograph which reads "Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill" engraved on it and a new hostel was built to resemble a giant flower on the bank of the River Taedong. Several production lines and ten-odd vegetable greenhouses were also laid out anew. All of these started on one October day in Juche 102 (2013) when the respected General Secretary visited the mill for the first time. Throughout his inspection, he paid more attention to the workers’ living conditions than to production. He took close care of the workers’ housing problem and other conditions for their living. Wherever in the mill he went, he was obsessed with the thought about workers. That’s why he went the length of visiting the weedy and rugged site for the hostel instead of getting in his car and leaving the mill. Besides, he saw to it that soldiers were dispatched there that day and took benevolent measures to complete the hostel by the next May Day. The workers felt most grateful for his such attentive care and warm love. Indeed, workers will remain happy forever thanks to the respected General Secretary who is eager to let them lead proud lives. Rodong Sinmun

title: Wreaths Laid before Cemetery of Martyrs in China
body: Members of the DPRK General Consulate in Shenyang, China and its branch in Dandong laid wreaths before the cemetery of the martyrs, who fell in resisting America and aiding Korea, in Shenyang City, Liaoning Province and the monument to resisting America and aiding Korea in Dandong City on Monday on the occasion of the 71st anniversary of the entry of the Chinese People's Volunteers into the Korean front. Wreaths in the name of the DPRK missions were placed before the cemetery and the monument. On the same day, laid before them were wreaths in the names of the General Association of Koreans in China and the party organs and people's governments in Dandong City and Liaoning Province, China. Rodong Sinmun

title: Painters' Contest Held
body: The painters' contest that had begun as part of the Contest of Skilled Workers according to Occupations and Sectors of National Economy-2021 took place from October 21 to 25. Participating in the contest were excellent skilled workers selected from ministries, national institutions and provincial people's committees. Standings were set by marks judging the acquisition of knowledge in the field of specialization and the preparation of tools and also assessing the quality and speed of painting, the use of materials and the harmony of color. The standings were made public on Monday. The trophy cup went to winner Pak Song Chol, who is a worker of the South Hwanghae provincial urban construction brigade, and prizes to other excellent skilled workers. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Basket Laid at Friendship Tower
body: Staff members of the Chinese embassy here laid a floral basket before the Friendship Tower on October 25 on the occasion of the 71st anniversary of the entry of the Chinese People's Volunteers (CPV) into the Korean front. Present at the floral basket-laying ceremony were Li Jinjun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK, and staff members of his embassy. The national anthems of the People's Republic of China and the Democratic People's Republic of Korea were played. Placed at the tower was a floral basket in the name of the Chinese embassy. The participants observed a moment's silence in memory of the CPV martyrs who bravely fought by devoting their youth and lives to the Korean front. Earlier, the ambassador and his embassy members laid a floral basket and flowers at the cemetery of the CPV martyrs in Jangjin County, South Hamgyong Province. Rodong Sinmun

title: Wreaths Laid before Friendship Tower
body: Wreaths were laid before the Friendship Tower on Monday, the 71st anniversary of the entry of the Chinese People's Volunteers (CPV) into the Korean Front. Present at the wreath-laying ceremony were Kang Yun Sok, vice-chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly (SPA), Mun Song Hyok, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), Army Lieutenant General Kim Chol Gun, vice-minister of National Defence, Pak Myong Ho, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, and other officials concerned. The national anthems of the People's Republic of China (PRC) and the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) were played. Placed at the tower was a wreath in the joint name of the WPK Central Committee, the SPA Standing Committee of the DPRK and the Cabinet of the DPRK. Also laid were wreaths in the names of the Ministry of National Defence, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Ministry of Public Security, the Ministry of External Economic Relations and the Ministry of Culture and wreaths in the joint names of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries and the DPRK-China Friendship Association, and the Pyongyang City Committee of the WPK and the Pyongyang City People's Committee. The participants walked round the tower after paying a silent tribute to the memory of the CPV martyrs who displayed noble internationalist fidelity and matchless self-sacrificing spirit in the sacred war against the imperialists' invasion under the banner of resisting America and aiding Korea, safeguarding the home and defending the motherland. On the same day, wreaths were laid at the cemeteries and graves of the CPV martyrs in Hyongjesan District of Pyongyang City, Anju City and Hoechang County of South Phyongan Province, Onsong County of North Hamgyong Province and Kaesong City. Rodong Sinmun

title: Birthday Spread Sent to Centenarian
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un sent a birthday spread to Kim Tal Bok living at Sunchon-dong of Sunchon City, South Phyongan Province on her 100th birthday. Kim Tal Bok, born into a poor peasant's family, had suffered the grief of statelessness during the Japanese imperialists' colonial rule over Korea. She could lead a worthwhile life as a master of the country only after the liberation of the country. She dedicated herself to the country with patriotism and is doing the work conducive to the economic life of the country after retirement. She keeps herself optimistic and diligent, while doing housework and cultivating kitchen garden in good health. Rodong Sinmun

title: Endlessly Bright and Rosy Future of Our Country
body: Day after day, we witness touching events eloquent of the respected General Secretary’s ardent love for the young generation. It is none other than him who personally worked out on his handbook the amount of fishes to be fed to orphans at baby homes, orphanages and primary and secondary schools for orphans in our country, saying that it is the determination and will of the Party to let them grow up healthily to be successors to and pivots of the revolution free from sorrow and with nothing to envy. His attentive care for the coming generation pervades children’s palaces and camps in different parts of the country full of their laughter and songs and their new school uniforms, notebooks, schoolbags and schools. The Party’s new childcare policy also reflects the painstaking efforts he makes to bring up children to be sound and strong. The General Secretary stressed that there is no more important revolutionary work than the work of bringing up children, the future of the country, to be strong and sound and that it is the most important policy and supreme cherished desire of our Party and state to provide more improved conditions of bringing them up even at the cost of huge sum of money. He also noted that it has to be the way of advance and development of our revolution to exert more sincerity to children even though the condition becomes worse and to take dynamic steps forward towards the future of communism with the might of that love. Every single word of his teachings bears his love for posterity. They convince us of the fact that thanks to him, our benevolent father, the song “We Are the Happiest in the World” will resound louder in our country and that a bright and rosy future is in store for us. Rodong Sinmun

title: Enlarged Plenary Meeting of Cabinet Held
body: The enlarged plenary meeting of the Cabinet took place through video teleconferencing on Oct. 26. Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, guided the meeting. Present there were Vice-Premiers Jon Hyon Chol and Pak Jong Gun and other members of the Cabinet. Attending it as observers were officials of institutions directly under the Cabinet and those of ministries, chairpersons of the provincial, city and county people's committees and those of institutions for agricultural guidance, and major factories and enterprises. The meeting reviewed the implementation of the national economic plan for the third quarter of this year for carrying out the decisions made at the 2nd and the 3rd plenary meetings of the 8th Central Committee of the WPK. It also discussed the measures of thoroughly carrying out the important tasks set forth by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un in his historic policy speech at the 5th Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly and of successfully concluding this year's plan. A report was made by Pak Jong Gun, vice-premier who is also chairman of the State Planning Commission. The reporter said that in the third quarter all the sectors and units of the national economy have made achievements by strengthening production foundations and making scrupulous economic organization and command for increasing the production as required by the strategy of the Party for readjustment and reinforcement. He said that to unconditionally carry out the national economic plan, which amounts to decision of the Party and law of the state, the major industrial fields and all other sectors of the national economy have effected a surge in production by putting emphasis on ensuring local production of raw materials and recycling despite unfavorable conditions and difficulties. He cited facts to inform the participants of a series of shortcomings and deviations observed in the economic work in the third quarter, and analyzed their causes and stressed the need to decisively root out the irresponsible work style and attitude of some leading economic officials. The reporter called for surely fulfilling the national economic plan for the first year of implementing the five-year plan on all indices through dynamic year-end economic organization and thus bringing about substantial achievements and practical changes waited for and welcomed by the people. Speeches were made at the meeting. The meeting discussed immediate tasks in detail to thoroughly implement the administrative policy of the DPRK government including those to tighten the production-consumption connection among key industrial fields, successfully conclude this year's farming and increase the varieties of mass consumption goods. It adopted the decision of the Cabinet "On thoroughly carrying out the important tasks set forth by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un in his historic policy speech at the 5th Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK". Rodong Sinmun

title: The Gold Painting "The Eagle"
body: The gold painting "The Eagle" is a typical one of Ri Jing, a leading gold painter in the 17th century. Ri had developed the Korean painting in the traditional gold-paint style. He depicted flowers and animals well with gold paint without formality and consequently contributed to enriching the pictorial mood of the Korean artists. He liked to draw birds so much from his childhood that he even drew a bird with his tears when he was getting whipped on the calf by his father when he was a child. For that reason there are many bird paintings among his gold paintings. All of his paintings are beautiful and moreover they vividly describe the feature of the birds and the birds in the pictures look like as if they were alive. The gold painting "The Eagle" belongs to his album of eight gold paintings. The painting depicted an eagle standing on a trunk clutching it with its strong foot. It preserved the feature of an eagle including a fierce eye, a curved beak, cuspidate wings, sharp-edged talons, etc. In addition it displays a splendid harmony with gold-dust painting on a deep blue ground and fluently presents the shade of color and the strong and the weak of lines. Rodong Sinmun

title: People Move to New Modern Houses in Samjiyon City
body: Modern dwellings for a thousand and hundreds of families have been built in the area of Mt Paektu. All the commanding officers and shock brigade members of 216 Division turned out in the third-stage project for sprucing up Samjiyon City and made the shining achievements of concluding the construction of all the dwelling houses they were tasked to fulfill by braving the grim weather conditions in the northern part and difficulties in the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance. The construction of 10-dongs and ris of single-storey, small-storey and multistorey modern dwelling houses in good harmony with the natural undulation built at the foot of Mt Paektu has turned the holy place of the revolution into the modern socialist villages good to live in. Meetings for moving to houses were held in Rimyongsu-dong, Sinmusong-dong, Ohomuldong-dong, Phothae-dong, Poso-ri, Thongsin-ri, Paeksam-ri, Junghung-ri, Hunggyesu-ri and Sobaeksan-ri from October 20 to 27. Present there were Vice Department Director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea Kim Jong Song, Chief Secretary of the Ryanggang Provincial Party Committee Ri Thae Il and officials and working people of Samjiyon City, commanding officers and shock brigade members of 216 Division. At the meetings the speakers said that modern dwellings were built one after another in the area of Mt Paektu thanks to the warm loving care of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un who is making ceaseless journey of devoted service for the people's wellbeing while readily undergoing pains for the people. The speakers said that the builders of 216 Division, always upholding the Party Central Committee's leadership with death-defying practice, turned Samjiyon City on the northern tip of the country into villages of high civilization under socialism through unrelenting struggle in the spirit of Mt Paektu and the spirit of self-reliance. They extended thanks to Kim Jong Un who is showing boundless benevolence for the people in Samjiyon City, always having them deep in his mind. They vowed to spruce up the holy land of the revolution as the socialist utopia, upholding the great Party Central Committee with their pure conscience and obligation as befits the frontline soldiers safeguarding the noble traditions of the Korean revolution. Licenses for the use of houses were conveyed to house owners. As the moving to new houses began, the villages were wrapped in holiday atmosphere with joyful dancing parties, and laughter and songs of people's happiness resounded far and wide in the clear and blue sky of October. Officials visited families that moved to new houses to congratulate and share joy with the owners. Rodong Sinmun

title: Our Life and Foundation of Revolution
body: Today more unfavorable environment and difficulties check our progress than ever before. However, we redouble our effort to vigorously advance towards a fresh victory, instead of giving up. It is because we are convinced that we, who have come along the road of national self-existence illuminated by the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un, are absolutely correct. And because we have the rock-firm faith to always go along the road unshakably in any circumstances. What cannot be bartered away at any cost and can be discarded under no circumstances is the principle of national self-existence. Self-existence v dependence, Herein lies the sharp and dramatic difference between love for country and treachery to country, victory and defeat and prosperity of country and national ruin. Self-existence is a tonic to strengthen the might of country and dependence is a toxic to ruin the country. On one occasion the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un gave us the meaningful instruction that the national self-existence is our life and becomes the foundation and groundwork of our revolution. Many world-startling creations built on this land and the miraculous events made in the face of difficulties and hardships clearly reflect the spirit of national self-existence to strengthen our own driving force and pave the road for our people in reliance on our own strength, technology and resources. Today our people brave manifold difficulties and trials and vigorously wage the struggle to open a new era of a fresh upsurge and massive transformation in the revolution. It is because we have the spirit of national self-existence implanted by the respected General Secretary. Rodong Sinmun

title: New Dwellings Built in Ryongmaedo Tideland
body: New houses have been built in Ryongmaedo Tideland. Tens of newly-wed young people of the South Hwanghae Provincial Tideland Reclamation General Enterprise moved into the new houses. They had volunteered to work at the construction site of the tideland and brought their beautiful love into bloom on the road of the worthwhile struggle for enlarging the land of the country. The semi-detached houses neatly built on the sunny hill have all conditions for living. The provincial organs like the provincial people's committee and the provincial rural economy committee and cities and counties positively helped the building and sent kitchen utensils, household goods and furniture necessary for living. Rodong Sinmun

title: Fishing Campaign Begins in East Sea of Korea
body: Fishery stations in the eastern coastal area of the DPRK have started fishing all at once. They are actively engaged in a fishing campaign in main fishing grounds based on the thorough-going repairing of ships and preparations of fishing tackle. Organizing in detail the labor for carriage and processing, they intensively carry out fishing with scientific fishing methods while sharing fishing information. Rodong Sinmun

title: Hundreds of People Finish Two-yearly or Yearly Plans
body: The number of labor innovators is on the increase at the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Silk Mill amid the high-pitched drive for increased production to implement the decisions made at the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea and the administrative policy of the DPRK government. Over 20 workers have finished their two-yearly plans and hundreds of workers finished their yearly plans up to now. The number of labor innovators is on the increase amid the vigorous emulation drive for increased production. Among them is a worker of workshop No. 2 who became the first worker of the mill to finish the yearly plan in April. Tens of reeling workers of workshop No. 3 finished their two-yearly or yearly plans ahead of schedule on the occasion of the significant founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea. A large number of workers of other workshops have also ranked themselves among labor innovators. Rodong Sinmun

title: One Family
body: Some years ago a woman residing in Central District, Pyongyang came to know an orphan at Tonghae School for Orphans. The orphan had been unable to walk after an unexpected matter. She determined to make the orphan able to walk again without fail when she met the orphan. She, taking the orphan on her back, walked a long distance to see able doctors about the trouble of the orphan. She read many medical books to find the method to cure the orphan. Being mentioned that the cure had to be backed up by nutritive conditions, she provided a lot of tonics and nourishing food to the orphan. All she did was not done in the light of sympathy. She regarded the orphan as a member of the great socialist family. And thus she devoted motherly love to the orphan for years. She finally let the orphan walk by herself and now she has become the foster mother of the orphan. This is only one story among a lot of good deeds displayed in our society. It is the genuine feature of our society that our people devote their sincerity conscious that they are members of the great socialist family. Rodong Sinmun

title: Green Forest of Pine-nut Trees Tells of Their Patriotic Devotion
body: There is a thick pine-nut forest on the mountain in the rear of Sangso Higher Middle School in Sangso-ri, Anju City. Scores of years ago President Kim Il Sung, on a tour of his on-the-spot guidance, met in person teachers and pupils of the school who were helping farmers and had a picture taken with them. Later, he sent tens of kilograms of pine nuts to them who were doing many good deeds to better their hometown. The teachers and pupils of the school pooled their efforts and wisdom to form a pine-nut forest in their hometown visited by President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il several times. Keeping in their minds the great love and trust of the President they made the pine-nut trees take root in their hometown with all their efforts and sincerity. Then they presented to the Chairman the meaningful first pinenuts with a sincere letter carrying their loyalty. The Chairman read the letter and saw to it that their deeds were widely introduced to the country. Since then the pine-nut forest has become a part of their life. All of them became the masters of the forest, brought up more pine-nut seedlings by increasing the nursery and planted them in their Youth Forest and Children’s Union Forest. Consequently, a thick pine-nut forest was formed in Sangso-ri and it was kept in minds of the graduates of the school as the seeds of patriotism. The green pine-nut forest tells of the ardent loyalty and patriotism of those who feel proud on the road of realizing the noble desire of the peerlessly great men. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Presentation of Mushroom-growing Techniques and Experience and Technical Course Held
body: A national presentation of mushroom-growing techniques and experience and technical course was held through video conferencing from Oct. 26 to 28 under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea. The aim of the events was to share, popularize, and positively apply the advanced scientific and technical successes and the mushroom-growing experience. Over 40 valuable papers were submitted to the presentation, at which scientists, technicians, teachers, researchers and graduate students from more than 30 units, including Kim Il Sung University and the Central Mushroom Institute of the Ministry of Agriculture were present. The technical course dealt with the scientific and technical issues arising in growing larger quantities of tasty and highly nutritious mushrooms. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Sci-Tech Presentation in Field of Biology Held
body: A national scientific and technological presentation in the field of biology was held through video-conferencing from Oct. 26 to 28 under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea. The presentation held on the theme of "Promotion of development of core and advanced ultra-modern technology" was aimed at accelerating the development of ultra-modern technology in the field of biology. Attending the presentation were teachers, researchers and postgraduate students of Kim Il Sung University, Sariwon Kye Ung Sang University of Agriculture, the Bioengineering Branch of the State Academy of Sciences and other units. Submitted to the presentation which was held divided into panels of bioengineering, biology, botany, zoology and microbiology were over 180 papers conducive to the development of the self-supporting economy and the improvement of the standard of the people's living. Rodong Sinmun

title: "Complete Collection of Kim Jong Il's Works" Vol. 36 Published
body: The Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House brought out Vol. 36 of "Complete Collection of Kim Jong Il's Works", a library of immortal Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, carrying Chairman Kim Jong Il's works in a chronological order and in a systematic and comprehensive way. The volume contains 62 works including historic speeches, talks and letters published by the Chairman from August, Juche 72 (1983) to April, Juche 73 (1984). The works give perfect answers to the theoretical and practical problems arising in strengthening the Party and revolutionary ranks and further accelerating socialist construction. The volume contains the works to be regarded as guidelines in several fields of socio-economic life including the matter of turning the then Pyongyang Senior High School No. 1 into an exemplary school, the matter of publishing more books conducive to the education of children and the matter of establishing the socialist lifestyle in dressing. Rodong Sinmun

title: Devotion to Orphans
body: One day several years ago, an official of a unit in the North Phyongan Provincial People’s Committee visited Sinuiju Middle School for Orphans. It was high time she had left but she couldn’t. She was engrossed in the thought about the teachers who told her that the broad playground looked narrow when orphans were playing there to their hearts’ content. Regarding it as a civic duty to do what little she could do to contribute to bringing up orphans beloved by the Party, she visited the school again a few days later together with employees of her unit with a lot of daily commodities. She handed the materials over to teachers of the school, expressing her willingness to exert herself to translating our Party’s love for the coming generation into reality. Since then, she has been engaged in making devotions to orphans. To tell the truth, she had already adopted an orphan. Besides, she had sincerely assisted major construction projects and soldiers of the Korean People’s Army to please the Party. Indeed, children’s happy songs are ringing out louder in our country thanks to a large number of such units and officials shouldering heavy burdens on themselves for the rising generation and the future of the country in spite of difficulties and want of everything. Rodong Sinmun

title: Be True Servants of People
body: Once the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un told officials that Chairman Kim Jong Il believed in the people as in heaven and that they must become true servants of the people. Chairman Kim Jong Il regarded the popular masses as the excellent, greatest and most beautiful beings saying that if there were an almighty being in the world, it would not be god, but the masses of the people. Saying that he was very pleased when he did something for the good of people he found the greatest worth and happiness in devoting his all to the people’s happiness and joy. Noting that every line and policy of our Party is for the good of people and whether they are thoroughly carried out or not entirely depends on how the officials struggle for them, the respected General Secretary stressed the need for the officials to demonstrate the validity and vitality of Party policies through people’s living and to make tireless efforts for the good of people with extraordinary determination to solve the problem of people’s living at any cost. Be the true servants of people. This reflects the Party’s great trust in and expectations for the officials. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Exhibition of IT Successes-2021 Closes
body: The National Exhibition of IT Successes-2021 closed on Friday. IT successes achieved this year for implementing the five-year plan for national economic development were introduced at the exhibition held in the form of virtual show through state information communication network. Attracting visitors were IT products, achievements made in putting production process on an automatic and IT basis and information, communication and measure equipment. There were an artificial intelligence program contest and presentation. During the exhibition, successes and experience gained by leading units were widely introduced in the presentation and workshop, and there was brisk technological swapping for positively introducing the latest technologies. Units including Kim Il Sung University and Kim Chaek University of Technology were selected as ten best IT enterprises for the year 2021 and Kumsong Secondary School No. 1 and other units as ten IT model units for the year 2021. Electronic newspaper board, information system for the general hospital, etc. were appreciated as ten best IT products for the year 2021. Prize banners, diplomas, certificates, medals and souvenirs were awarded to exemplary units, participants and products. Rodong Sinmun

title: Weavers' and Spinners' Contests Held
body: Weavers' and spinners' contests were held as part of the Contests of Skilled Workers according to Occupations and Sectors of National Economy-2021 at the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill from October 24 to 29. Ace skilled persons selected from different production units under the textile industry management bureau of the Ministry of Light Industry took part in the contests. Standings were set by judging the acquisition of knowledge in the field of specialization and the preparation of tools and also by assessing the speed, quality and quantity of clothes and thread produced per unit time. The participants fully displayed the good skills they have cultivated in field. A weaver of the Sinuiju Textile Mill won the first place in the weavers' contest and a spinner of the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill the first place in the spinners' contest. Rodong Sinmun

title: Source of Inexhaustible Creativity
body: The scientists and technicians of keen intelligence in charge of sci-tech development can bear good fruit for the country and people only under the care of the fatherly leader who trust in and treat them preferentially. The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un instructed that the scientific and technological front is the forefront in defending the Party and revolution and quickening our cause and scientists and technicians are the main force, and that bearing deep in their minds the trust and expectation of the Party and people, all the scientists and technicians must turn out to research and creation to fulfill their duty as pioneers and pacemakers of the socialist construction. He, seizing every opportunity, took benevolent measures for them and brought about the dream-like reality. Some years ago the respected General Secretary guided a scientific research unit on the spot. At that time he said that the scientists there are patriots as they developed the cutting-edge agrochemical with readiness to devote their all to the scientific research in order to implement the behests of Chairman Kim Jong Il. And he added that he would like to carry on his back the scientists there, who made a proud success with single mind to be genuine scientists serving the country and people, and to give everything to them. The scientists and technicians of our country live in such benevolent father’s bosom. They add luster to their lives as the most dignified ones in the world thanks to his love and trust. Under the great leadership of the respected General Secretary who value the scientists devoting themselves to the research and encourages them, they achieved the world-startling successes one after another by giving full play to their mental strength. Today our scientists and technicians are full of ardent enthusiasm to display the inexhaustible creativity to the full on the onward march towards a fresh victory of the socialist construction regarding the noble spirit and rich knowledge acquired under care of the respected General Secretary as the absolute weapons. Rodong Sinmun

title: Root of Our People’s Faith
body: One day in December, Juche 106(2017) the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un climbed Mt Paektu. When the respected General Secretary started his journey to Mt Paektu, the weather was not so good. But when he ascended to the top of it, Mt Paektu showed its majestic figure under the cloudless blue sky. He overlooked the sublime view of Mt Paektu recalling the emotional days of unyieldingly leading the socialist cause to the victory with the firm will. His bright eyes were full of the firm revolutionary faith. He solemnly said that whenever he climbed Mt Paektu he redoubled his will to accomplish the revolutionary cause of Juche which was opened up and led by President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. The respected General Secretary has braced the unchangeable faith to carry out the revolutionary cause, talking with the President and the Chairman in his mind, and formulated the grandiose plan to make a turning point in the revolution. The great revolutionary faith of the respected General Secretary bore the strong national power of our country and became the root of faith of the people. Our people make the solid pledge to carry on the sacred march started from Mt Paektu following the respected General Secretary and greet all the victories and glory on this march. Rodong Sinmun

title: As He Takes Attentive Care of Us
body: The Showground He Visited In September, Juche 104(2015), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited a competitive show for daily necessaries. He earnestly said that it was useless to produce even millions of goods if the people did not like nor demand them and that it was essential to be aware of what kind of goods the people demanded in order to produce high-quality goods. And he added that it was the intention of the Party to make every shop full of homemade high-quality daily necessaries. Quality of daily necessaries must be judged by the people’s demands for them! This was the main point the respected General Secretary emphasized at that time. The Meaningful Souvenir Photo One scorching summer day the respected General Secretary visited the Taedonggang Combined Fruit Farm. Although his neckband was getting wet with sweat he expressed great satisfaction over the fact that an unusually rich harvest of apple visited the farm. With a broad smile, as if he was picturing the happy people after being supplied with the apples, he suggested having a picture taken to the officials. Saying that he would show our people the rich apple harvest of the farm of the year through the photo taken against the background of the bumper apple trees, he personally chose a tree for the background. Indeed the photo taken that day reflects the burning heart of the respected General Secretary eager to provide our people with more bountiful and happy life. Rodong Sinmun

title: North Phyongan Provincial Quality Analytical Institute Inaugurated
body: The North Phyongan Provincial Quality Analytical Institute was inaugurated with due ceremony in Sinuiju City on Oct. 31. The newly-completed institute will serve as a foundation for improving the material and cultural life of the people in the province as it will help put the means and ways of quality analysis on a modern and scientific basis and decisively increase the quality of products. Rodong Sinmun

title: Life-giving Water
body: The Sci-Tech Complex and its pen-shaped symbol tower make spectators admire and, also, add beauty to Ssuk Islet. Our people, being convinced of the might of the up-to-date technology again, wrote the annals of enormous changes and experienced the inexhaustible strength of science in their real life under the leadership of the respected General Secretary. It is the truth witnessed by a long history that a country cannot progress even an inch nor achieve a continuous development without knowledge of science though it has a good economical foundation. Therefore the respected General Secretary has prioritized science and technology so much after declaring the grand intention of making all the people well versed in science and technology. The respected General Secretary said at the 7th Congress of the Workers’ Party of Korea that we should ensure that the new scientific and technological data are disseminated from the centre to the lowest unit like flowing water by forming the national dissemination network with the Sci-Tech Complex, multi-functional hub for sci-tech dissemination and haunt of all learners, as its center. The Sci-Tech Complex, from which the life-giving water of science gushes out all the time, reflects the grandiose plan of the respected General Secretary to make our country into a scientific and technological power developing and prospering with science and technology. Rodong Sinmun

title: Proud Results Brought About by Indomitable Mental Power
body: Vigorous Spirit Surged in Huichon In February Juche 60(1971) President Kim Il Sung visited the then Huichon Machine-tool Factory(the Huichon General Machine-tool Plant today) and assigned the factory a task of making 10 000 machine tools. It was a difficult task for the factory at that time as it amounted over four times more than it produced in the preceding year. However the working class of the factory who were endlessly loyal to the leader and the Party dynamically turned out in endeavors to carry through the task as early as possible. Despite manifold trials and difficulties they, fully displaying the indefatigable fighting spirit, finally increased their yearly production capacity to 10 000 machine tools. Their spirit still touches our people’s heartstrings. It Was Not a Matter of Condition In May Juche 73(1984) Chairman Kim Jong Il visited the Ryongsong Machine Complex and assigned its officials and working class the task of making a 10 000-ton press. The 10 000-ton press was composed of tens of thousands of fittings of thousands of sorts and as tall as a ten-storied apartment. Only a few countries could produce such press at that time. As the working class of the complex had never experienced making such gigantic and delicate machine before, there was not enough guarantee for the possibility. However they made the press by their own efforts within a year and three months and made a report of loyalty to the Party. The 10 000-ton press made by the complex was a priceless creation of revolutionary spirit of self-reliance. World-Startling West Sea Barrage The construction of the West Sea Barrage was a gigantic nature-remaking project unprecedented in the world history of building barrage. In those days world people doubted that the DPRK, not a big country, could build such a gigantic barrage across the wide sea in such a short period of five years. However our people did not depend on other’s help but believed in our own force and wisdom. The builders of the barrage dynamically pushed ahead with the construction by overcoming every obstacle and insufficiency in the spirit of self-reliance and fortitude. Consequently they finished the construction of 8-kilometer-long barrage in such a short period of five years though the others said that it would take scores of years. The grand monumental edifice startled the world people. It was a brilliant victory brought about by the great spirit of self-reliance and fortitude. Rodong Sinmun

title: People Move to New Houses in Phyongwon County
body: In Namdong-ri of Phyongwon County, South Phyongan Province, people moved to new houses, a reminder of the realization of the Party's great plan for building socialist rural areas. The area changed beautifully as over 700 elegant single- and low-storied houses were built together with the building of the farm management board, hall of culture, nursery and other buildings. The houses have all conveniences for living like pens for domestic animals and storerooms, to say nothing of living rooms and kitchens.
