Fruit trees around the dwellings add to the scenery of the area. There was cheerful and bustling dancing as people moved to new houses on Monday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Traces Left on Road of Devoted Service for People
body: Metal Ladder Conveys Touching Story One May day in Juche 108(2019) the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited the Kumyagang Power Station No. 2. He said that the dam of the station was built at an ideal site expressing a great satisfaction over the fact that the reservoir was filled with much water in the dry season. While he was acquainting himself with the operation of the power station he revealed his intention to ascend to the dam. He found a metal ladder after a moment’s survey and suggested ascending to the dam by the ladder to the accompanying officials. To tell the truth, the ladder was used by employees of the power station to observe the state of the dam, floodgate and water level when they were on patrol duty. Although the officials dissuaded him from doing it, the respected General Secretary unhesitatingly climbed up such a dangerous metal ladder eager to provide people with more civilized living condition. Construction Site He Visited at Daybreak One early morning in March a few years ago the respected General Secretary visited Ryomyong Street under construction. Going round various places of the construction site he said that Ryomyong Street to which the technology of green architecture was introduced looked spectacular and it would be more wonderful if he looked down from an airplane over it. He examined over 1 390 miniatures of Ryomyong Street on scores of occasions in order to build the street into monumental edifices in the era of the Worker’s Party, an epitome of socialist civilization. His visit to the construction site on the early morning manifested his will to build the socialist power full of people’s happiness at the earliest date without fail. Rodong Sinmun

title: Capital Idea Proposed by Respected General Secretary
body: Once the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited the January 8 Fishery Station. He asked the manager of the station how much fish they caught that year and was so satisfied with his answer that the station overfulfilled the quota of fish haul remarkably. Each of the accompanying officials said to him that the station made the biggest fish haul and the manager worked well. After learning that the manager had worked as an officer for logistics in the Korean People’s Army for a long period before his appointment, the respected General Secretary said that he would not be well versed in fishing and therefore he should make big efforts to learn more to catch a lot of fish. Ahead of leaving the station that day the respected General Secretary stressed that the manager should not be content with the success but study hard to learn more about fishing and research fishing method to fulfill his duty. His instruction means that if one works by rule of thumb, one can’t produce success and that only when one study hard to improve one’s ability one can bring about good results. Today, in the era of science and technology, the key to success lies in making efforts to learn scientific business management and meditating a lot to apply the acquisition in reality. It is just the capital idea to achieve success in the work. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Premier Kim Tok Hun Inspects Construction Sites of 10 000 Flats in Pyongyang City
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, inspected construction sites for building 10 000 flats in Pyongyang City. He, going round the construction sites presenting majestic appearance of modern streets with peculiar multistoried and skyscraping apartment houses that fill Songsin and Songhwa areas, gave pep talks to builders devoting their enthusiasm of loyalty and patriotism in order to flawlessly finish the construction within the period set by the Party and on the level demanded by the Party. He stressed the need to successfully realize the Party's plan and intention to make the people enjoy more civilized and happy life by carrying out step-wise plans for units and objects without fail now that the construction is in the final stage, strictly observing the demand of design and construction and thoroughly ensuring the quality of final project and afforestation and greening. Meanwhile, the premier inspected the field of agriculture in Sunchon City. He, going round the Phungthan Co-op Farm, the Phyongri Co-op Farm and the grain store in the city, called upon officials to increase their responsibility and role in taking full measures to successfully conclude this year's farming including effective use of combined rice threshers, meticulously conducting the operation of the grain stores and making substantial preparations for next year's farming. Rodong Sinmun

title: Getting on Cableway in Person
body: One day in December, Juche 108(2019), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited the Yangdok Hot Spring Resort that neared completion. After making rounds of the horse-riding park and skiing service complex, the respected General Secretary suggested going to the skiing ground again and went to the cableway. The cableway was test operated several times only. In spite of the officials’ dissuasion, the respected General Secretary went up to the top of the second ski run by cable car in person.He asked about the capacity of skiing ground and gave instructions to set the safety net at the junction of the second and third ski runs for fixing the boundary between them. The respected General Secretary said that visitors could have a hot spring bath and enjoy skiing and horse-riding at the Yangdok Hot Spring Resort, a combined hot spring facility and multi-functional sports and cultural complex, expressing his satisfaction over the fact that our people could enjoy peculiar cultural life. Indeed, it is none other than our General Secretary who devotes himself to our people’s happy life. Rodong Sinmun

title: Solely for People
body: It was one day at the beginning of Juche 101(2012) when our people greeted New Year grieving over the death of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The respected General Secretary sat together with officials and gave them the important instruction to turn the intention and desire of the Chairman into reality. He said that whenever he missed the Chairman who devoted his all to happiness of the people, the image of the Chairman was pictured from that of our people and we must spare nothing for people and uphold the people as we would do the Chairman. The respected General Secretary regards it as the most important work to respect the people, defend their destiny and prioritize their interests and convenience. He set forth the revolutionary slogans like “Everything for the people and everything by relying on them!” and “Let the entire Party make selfless, devoted efforts for the good of the great people!” and personally made devoted service for people day by day. Thanks to his devotion, a lot of creations for people have been built on this land, including the Rungna People’s Pleasure Park, Changjon Street, the Ryugyong Health Complex, the Okryu Children’s Hospital, the Munsu Water Park, the Masikryong Ski Resort, the Yonphung Scientists Holiday Camp, the hostel of the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill, the Songdowon International Children’s Camp, Mirae Scientists Street, the Sci-Tech Complex and Ryomyong Street. The heart of the respected General Secretary is filled with great enthusiasm for devoting himself to happiness of the people. For our great people! This is the slogan which endlessly resounds in the mind of the respected General Secretary who continues his walk of devotion to the people. It is the true feature of our socialist country of Juche led by the respected General Secretary where the leader devotes his all to the people and the people enjoy all blessings. Rodong Sinmun

title: Changsong County Receives Title of Model Law-observance County
body: Changsong County of North Phyongan Province of the DPRK received the title of model law-observance county. The officials and working people of the county made the socialist law-abiding life their own undertaking as required by the times of our state-first principle and showed examples in making voluntary law-observance by the people a social trend, thus making positive contributions to developing the Korean-style socialist system. The awarding ceremony was held on the spot Wednesday. Present at the ceremony were Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly (SPA). Also present were Jang Se Chol, chairman of the North Phyongan Provincial People's Committee, and officials and working people of the county. The decree of the Standing Committee of the SPA was read out by Choe Ryong Hae to be followed by conferment. Rodong Sinmun

title: Protector of Genuine Life
body: The Nyongbyon Silk Mill boasts Kim Kum Sil, its workshop leader who is a recipient of Order of Kim Jong Il, Labor Heroine and deputy to the Supreme People’s Assembly. She is also a meritorious person of socialist patriotism and a doctor. She says that she often thinks of the benevolent care which let her enjoy a genuine life, pride and dignity. Her parents who had suffered pre-liberation misery and maltreatment, used to tell her about the happy lives they had led after the country was liberated by President Kim Il Sung. Always remembering their stories, Kim Kum Sil spared no wisdom and enthusiasm to carry out her assignments. The socialist country honored her as an innovator and a female leader of a workshop and, when she was widowed, let her children study at a revolutionary school. There is a disabled soldier-poet in Chongjin City who returned home after unexpectedly getting injured during the discharge of his duty. Doctors visited him for recovering of his health and writers from Pyongyang came to see him who was zealous to become a poet. His house was also frequented by officials and numerous strangers who brought with them lots of books helpful to his poem-writing. What’s more, he received tele-education from Kim Il Sung University and was awarded with the Youth Literary Prize thanks to the warm care of the country. Among the world’s treasures, our socialism, the great guardian to which the people’s happiness and future are entrusted and which exalts and safeguards the country’s dignity and honor, is the most precious. We live in the socialist country centred on the popular masses that holds up its people like Heaven! Rodong Sinmun

title: Story of Ski Run for Children
body: One day in April, Juche 108(2019), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited the Yangdok Hot Spring Resort under construction. Pointing to the mountain valley where the ski runs were to be laid, he learnt in detail about the altitude of the mountain and the width of the ski runs. Giving instructions about the construction and operation of the ski ground, he pointed out that the ski ground had no ski run for children and suggested that a run be built for our children, the kings of our country. To tell the truth, designers had never thought of building a ski run for children. The respected General Secretary said that one more ski run could readily be built for children in addition to the three ski runs to be laid and that the run had to be built in such a way that children would be able to ride sleds there, too. Like this the ski run for children was built in the ski ground of Yangdok Hot Spring Resort. Rodong Sinmun

title: Dear Home
body: It has been eight years since our common educators moved to the new apartment houses for educators of Kim Il Sung University. Whoever visits those houses cannot help admiring its wonderfulness which equals to a high-class hotel. Such houses are permeated with the deep care and love of the respected General Secretary for our educators. In September, Juche 102(2013) the respected General Secretary visited the apartment houses nearing completion. After looking around a unit on the third floor, he headed towards the resting hall on the 17th floor. At that time the elevator was on trial. Despite officials’ repeated dissuasions the respected General Secretary went up to the 17th floor, ascending two or three steps at a time. His collar became wet with sweat to ascend more than 200 steps. On October 9 that year the respected General Secretary went round Unit 3 on the 44th floor. He looked carefully at the bottom of the mirror on the wall and said a sill should be fixed there for a comb. Everything in the kitchen equipped with sufficient utensils represents fatherly love of the respected General Secretary. Indeed, the apartment houses for educators of Kim Il Sung University are the fruition of warm love of the respected General Secretary. Rodong Sinmun

title: Rice-harvesting Contest Reviewed
body: A rice-harvesting contest which had been held among provinces and exemplary co-op farms was reviewed at the Central Committee of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea (UAWK) on Thursday through video conferencing. Organizations of the UAWK at all levels conducted the political work to raise the spirit of the agricultural workers for implementing the decisions set forth at the Party Congress and in the administrative policy of the DPRK government with the rice-harvesting contest as an occasion. Agricultural workers across the country have recorded high results every day during the contest. Officials of the UAWK and lecturers made positive contributions to promoting the rice-harvesting as scheduled through agit-prop activities. During the contest a farmer harvested rice in the area which is 4.6 times bigger than the planned one. An edit introducing the contest held in different places of the country was shown. Citations were awarded to the South Hwanghae Provincial committee and other UAWK committees and UAWK primary committees including the Oguk Co-op Farm primary committee in Anak County. Rodong Sinmun

title: Over 2 000 Hectares of Land Put under Cultivation in DPRK This Year
body: The campaign for cultivating new land was dynamically waged across the DPRK, bringing over 2 000 hectares of new land under the plow this year. Officials of Pyongyang and each province, city and county unfolded the campaign as a mass movement true to the decisions made at the 8th Party Congress, and working people across the country worked hard to cultivate more arable land. They worked out plans based on the survey of areas such as arable land and riversides and carried them out briskly. They took necessary measures such as vehicle and material supply and put huge areas under cultivation by removing stones and puddles. Bearing in mind that expanding the area of arable land is important in solving the food problem by producing grain plentifully, working people across the country take part in the campaign with a high sense of patriotism. Rodong Sinmun

title: "Complete Collection of Kim Jong Il's Works" Vol. 40 Published
body: The Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House brought out Vol. 40 of "Complete Collection of Kim Jong Il's Works", a library of immortal Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, carrying Chairman Kim Jong Il's immortal classic works in a chronological order and in a systematic and comprehensive way. The volume contains 54 works including historic speeches, talks and letters published by the Chairman from July, Juche 75 (1986) to June, Juche 76 (1987). The works comprehensively deal with the outstanding ideological and theoretical exploits of the Chairman who indicated the road of struggle for dynamically pushing forward our revolution under the uplifted banner of the Juche idea and bringing about a new upsurge in all fields of socialist construction by strengthening the Party's fighting efficiency in every way. The volume also carries the works which give clear solutions to theoretical and practical issues arising in the revolution and construction, including the issue of further improving and strengthening the work of Chongryon as required by the developing reality, the issue of intensifying external information service, the issue of improving the school education and developing physical culture and the issue of effectively arranging environment of Pyongyang. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Sci-tech Presentation in Field of Chemical Industry Held
body: The national sci-tech presentation in the field of chemical industry was held via video conferencing from Nov. 2 to 4 under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea. This year's theme was "Readjustment and Reinforcement of the Current Manufacturing Process for Chemical Products". Present at the event were teachers, researchers, postgraduates and field officials, etc. from more than 10 units including Kim Il Sung University, Kim Chaek University of Technology, the State Academy of Sciences and the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex. Over 130 valuable papers conducive to producing chemical fertilizers, establishing C-1 chemical industry, manufacturing basic chemical goods using glauberite and domestic production of catalysts, etc. were submitted. The presentation also included a lecture on the current state and development prospects of the chemical industry of our country and a rational plan to establish a new catalyst industry. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Experience-swapping Seminar of Public Health Workers Held
body: The 16th national experience-swapping seminar of public health workers took place at the South Hamgyong Provincial People's Hospital on Wednesday and Thursday. Present there were Minister of Public Health Choe Kyong Chol, officials concerned and exemplary medical workers. Presented at the seminar were achievements and experience gained by medical workers who exerted themselves to the utmost and discharged their high responsibilities in medical work and emergency epidemic prevention work for protecting and promoting the lives and health of the people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Common Working People Become Assemblypersons
body: In our country popular masses are genuine masters of the country and everything serves the people. The Phyongchon District People’s Assembly has a hundred and tens of deputies and all of them are ordinary working people. Among them are the head of scaffold workers’ team of repair shop for steam generators at the Pyongyang Thermal Power Plant and a doctor of the Phyongchon District People’s Hospital who has fulfilled the duty true to the intention of the Party which values the health of the people. The head of Work-team No. 2 of the Pyongyang City Floricultural Station is also a female deputy to the Phyongchon District People’s Assembly, who has contributed to adding beauty to the streets of the city by raising lots of flowers for tens of years. Besides, the ordinary working people, including a silk-reel worker, water supply and drainage controller, needle worker and teacher enjoy the worthwhile life as deputies of people. Like this in our country common working people are elected deputies to the People’s Assemblies to serve the people since the formation of the people’s government. Therefore they are called as deputies of people. It is a matter of course that all policies of the state are established and realized for the interests and happiness of popular masses in our country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Who Are the Masters of This Land
body: People on this land love our socialist country calling it "My Country". In the capitalist society based on individual selfishness the word “Mine” means private ownership and personal property. However, in our country the ordinary working people as the masters of everything say "Mine" in an honorable and proud way. "My Village", "My Machine", "My Worksite", "My Field", "My Factory", etc. It was since President Kim Il Sung liberated the country and founded the genuine country of people that all the people have kept in mind that everything is mine, mine is ours and ours is precisely all the people’s. It was since all the working people became the masters of land and factory for the first time in history and exercised their rights as the masters of the country with dignity. Because all of those are precious "mine" as much as life, the generation of war victors, calling the height of the country "My Height", defended it at the cost of their lives and the working class treasured their "My Machine" on the verge of starvation and the farm workers, calling the fields of farm "My Fields", cropped the bumper harvest despite harsh conditions. The call "Mine" was handed down through decades and, today, inspires our people with the zeal for revolution, struggle and patriotism. All our people regard everything on this land as "Mine" and make devoted efforts to add luster to them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Artillery Fire Competition of Artillery Sub-units under Mechanized Troops at All Levels of KPA Held
body: At a time when the enthusiasm to undergo intensive training prevails throughout the Korean People's Army (KPA) for ushering in a new heyday in strengthening the state defence capabilities under the banner of self-defence, an artillery fire competition of artillery sub-units under mechanized troops at all levels of the KPA was held on Saturday. The artillery fire competition was aimed at inspecting and evaluating how the mechanized troops of the KPA have conducted drills in order to increase their mobile artillery combat capabilities true to the militant policy set forth by the Central Military Commission of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) at the first workshop of military and political cadres of the KPA and at further intensifying the competitive training throughout the KPA. Pak Jong Chon, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, guided the artillery fire competition. Army General Rim Kwang Il, chief of the General Staff of the KPA, and commanders of the combined units greeted Pak Jong Chon on the spot and inspected the competition with him. In the competition firing positions and the firing sequence were set by drawing lots, and then the tactical and firepower duties of supporting mechanized troops entering the decisive battle with artillery firepower were issued to the commanders of the combined units so that they can make their decisions and personally command the firing of artillery sub-units to destroy the target. As soon as the firing orders were given by the commanders of the combined units, gun barrels to annihilate the enemy competitively shelled the target to accurately hit it. The artillery sub-unit under KPA Unit 604, artillery sub-unit under KPA Unit 337, artillery sub-unit under KPA Unit 243, artillery sub-unit under KPA Unit 671, artillery sub-unit under KPA Unit 488 and artillery sub-unit under KPA Unit 757 attained first, second, third, fourth, fifth and sixth places respectively in the competition. In the competition, the unit which had an excellent score and won first place received a master gunner certificate, medal and badge, and the sub-units which had excellent scores were awarded certificates and badges of master gunner sub-unit. Pak Jong Chon was greatly satisfied with the competition results. Rodong Sinmun

title: Choe Ryong Hae Inspects Changsong County, Thaechon County in North Phyongan Province
body: Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, inspected various units in Changsong County and Thaechon County of North Phyongan Province. He learned about stockbreeding, the conclusion of this year's farming and preparations for the next year's farming in the Okpho Stockbreeding Co-op Farm of Changsong County and the Unhung Co-op Farm of Thaechon County. He called on the officials and working people of the farms to create and positively generalize good experience in implementing the agricultural policy of the Party and to wage dynamic struggle for bringing about cultural development peculiar to rural areas and thus turn the farms into highly civilized places good to work and live. Looking round a foodstuff factory and a paper factory of the counties and the Changsong County Sack Factory, he stressed the need for the officials of the power organs and administrative and economic organs to always pay deep attention to the development of local industry and stable improvement of the people's living, put to the maximum use locally available raw materials and sources, produce more condiments and essential consumer goods and steadily raise their quality. Field consultative meetings stressed the need for the officials to fulfill their responsibilities and duties in thoroughly carrying out the Party's line of strengthening cities and counties and pressed for taking detailed and technical measures so as to effectively conduct the movement for winning the title of exemplary law-observance units, like the title of exemplary law-observance county, in close combination with the three revolutions - ideological, technical and cultural. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Thanks to Agricultural Workers in Yonggwang County, South Hamgyong Province
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un sent thanks to agricultural workers of Yonggwang County of South Hamgyong Province for the letter they sent with the delight and pride of reaping a bumper harvest despite the unfavorable conditions of suffering from floods. A meeting for conveying the thanks of Kim Jong Un to the agricultural workers of the county was held Friday at the Sangjung Cooperative Farm of the county. Present at the meeting were Ri Jong Nam, chief secretary of the South Hamgyong Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), Pak Tong Chol, chairman of the provincial rural economy committee, and officials and working people of the county. Ri Jong Nam made an address for conveying Kim Jong Un's thanks. The speaker said with strong emotion that the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un earnestly requested to tell the agricultural workers of the county, who sent happy news of rich harvest, that he and the WPK Central Committee send thanks to them. He said that the thanks he sent reflects the warmest love for the people that can be shown only by the peerlessly great man, the greatest popular leader, who regards the pleasure and happiness of the people as the most valuable treasure and infinite power that cannot be bartered with anything else in the world. He called upon all officials and the working people in the county to become patriotic farmers and bumper croppers who faithfully uphold the Party with increased rice production by bringing about a great victory in next year's farming once again in order to live up to the great trust and benevolence of the great father. Oath-taking speeches were made at the meeting. Speakers vowed to firmly trust and follow the respected General Secretary only, the sun of our destiny and pillar of our life, and spruce up their village as a socialist ideal land, keeping in mind the honor and happiness of today. Rodong Sinmun

title: More People Become Centenarians in DPRK
body: The number of centenarians is increasing in the DPRK under the benefits of the socialist system. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un sent birthday spreads to Kim Mi Sun living in Kyo-dong, Sinam District of Chongjin City, North Hamgyong Province, Won Hwa Hyang living in Unphung-ri of Kusong City in North Phyongan Province, and Paek Yun Su residing in Sangdan-ri, Thaechon County of the same province, on their 100th birthdays. Kim Mi Sun, born into a poor family before the liberation of the country, spent her life in the welfare service sector with the single purpose of paying back the unlimited benevolence of the peerlessly great men who liberated the country and provided her with a genuine life, together with her husband who was a honored disabled soldier and war veteran. Won Hwa Hyang and Paek Yun Su worked devotedly in the agricultural sector for decades true to the Party's agricultural policy, and even after retirement they continued to do good things helpful for the country's economy. The centenarians keep telling their children, grandchildren and neighbors to work hard for the country, saying that our socialist system, a large harmonious family where doctors regularly visit them for medical check-up to prevent them from falling ill and people help each other, is the best in the world. Rodong Sinmun

title: Meaningful Slogan at Children’s Camp
body: One April day several years ago, the respected General Secretary visited the Songdowon International Children’s Camp near completion. He was satisfied that the camp was splendidly remodeled to be presented to our children. He said with joy that the camp looked as if it had been built anew, not remodeled, and that it just resembled a beautiful picture. He told officials that he liked “We are the happiest in the world!” and “Let’s learn for Korea!” best among the slogans concerning children and recommended that the slogan “We are the happiest in the world!” be engraved on the camp’s gate. The accompanying officials marveled at his idea as the slogan could vivify the features of the children’s camp. Later at the theatre of the International Friendship Children’s Hall, he once again advised that the slogan “We are the happiest in the world!” had to be hung on the forehead of the stage. He went on saying that whenever he saw that slogan, he visualized the images of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. In front of the office building, too, he saw the same slogan hanging out of the building and stressed that the slogan enabled him to brave difficulties with a smile. Consequently the slogan “We are the happiest in the world!” was engraved on the gate of the camp. Rodong Sinmun

title: Touching Stories Woven with Devoted Service to People
body: Driving Force for Leap Forward A few years ago the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited a machine plant which was making constant successes in the production. He highly appreciated that the products of the factory played a big part in reality and they were in great demand. He expressed satisfaction over the fact that the employees of the factory achieved great successes in developing new products by pooling their creative enthusiasm and wisdom and actively introducing cutting-edge science and technology. To tell the truth the employees of the factory brought about a leap forward and innovation in the do-or-die spirit and self-reliant spirit regarding science and technology as the weapon for development as taught by the respected General Secretary. Saying that the factory should develop its peculiar products from the Juche-oriented standpoint and with ambitious mettle of making things which others couldn’t even conceive the idea of doing, the respected General Secretary taught officials the practical methods in detail. The respected General Secretary put forward the working classes as the masters of the era and infused them with courage and mettle of looking down the world. His love for and trust in them became the driving force for a leap forward, encouraging them to perform miracles and feats. We Should Never Feel Contented One day in July Juche 104(2015) the respected General Secretary visited a hygiene products factory in the plaguing rain. Attentively looking at a product he said that its trademark was not kind nor cultured and its font was not respectable. Saying that the trademark should be made in an elegant and cultured way to suit the aesthetic tastes of our people, he gave detailed instructions to improve it. In fact the factory had only intended to produce more products of high quality but never paid attention to the trademark of its products. Even the trademark of the products our people use must be made on the highest level and we must never feel contented. This is the intention of the respected General Secretary. Rodong Sinmun

title: Political Leader of DR Congo Praise WPK's Success Made under Leadership of Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un
body: Jimmy Kikoni, general secretary of the Workers' Party of DR Congo, published a press statement on Oct. 31 supporting the important speech made by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un at the lecture commemorating the 76th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). He said that the DPRK is making tremendous development in all fields as Comrade Kim Jong Un is leading the WPK. We highly praise the brilliant successes achieved by the WPK under the leadership of Kim Jong Un during the past 10 years, he noted. He pointed out that the Party and state work, apart from people and not depending on them, would be unthinkable. This is the invariable guideline and principle which have run through the whole course of the building of the WPK and its activities, he stressed. He said the unconditional service for the people is becoming the unique party climate for the WPK which is consistently applying the principles of the Juche idea in the party building and activities. He stated that the WPK has firmly established the ideological and leadership system of the leader and strengthened into the militant staff and guiding force advancing under the uplifted banner of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism to meet the fresh requirement of the developing revolution. He continued that Kim Jong Un in his speech at the commemorative lecture stressed that the entire Party should get united and concentrate the Party guidance into the one direction in accordance with the struggle line and principle set forth by the WPK Central Committee. We are convinced that the Korean people would bring about a brighter tomorrow under the leadership of the General Secretary of the WPK, he added. Rodong Sinmun

title: ﻿Seminar on Idea and Theory of Party Building Held in Russia
body: A seminar on the idea and theory of the party building indicated by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un at the lecture commemorating the 76th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) was held by the Vladivostok City Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation on Oct. 29. The first secretary of the Vladivostok City Committee said in his speech that Comrade Kim Jong Un in his speech at the lecture commemorating the 76th founding anniversary of the WPK set forth the principled issues and practical ways of further strengthening the Party ideologically and politically as befits the vanguard unit of the revolution and thoroughly applying the people-first principle in the overall Party work. He noted that he will deeply study Kim Jong Un's idea and theory of the party building and apply it into the party activities. The second secretary of the Vladivostok City Committee said in his speech that he deeply felt once again the source of WPK's strength through the seminar, stressing that he will keep the firm faith in the victory of socialism and fully support the Korean people's just cause. In another development, a briefing on the speech made by Kim Jong Un at the lecture commemorating the 76th founding anniversary of the WPK and on the historic policy speech made by him at the 5th Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK was held by the Organizational Department of the Central Leadership of Syria's Baath Arab Socialist Party on Oct. 28. Rodong Sinmun

title: Do Reflect People’s Ideals and Dreams
body: One day the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited the Paektusan Institute of Architecture. He told the designers of the institute that they should reflect the socialist civilization in the era of the Workers’ Party of Korea and the ideals and dreams of people as they were. His words manifested his warm love for the people, regarding them as Heaven and endeavoring to provide them with the happiest life in the world. Munsu Water Park conveys another great devotion made by the respected General Secretary to provide the people with a wonderful resort. He examined in person 113 designs of the water park. He added to the idea of the designs even on holidays and at midnight and dawn. He also dropped in the construction site several times, looked it round for a long time and saw to it that the designs were mapped out again. Indeed his devoted efforts are immeasurable. Thanks to the respected General Secretary who continues the days of devoted service to people our ideals and dreams will be certainly translated into reality. Rodong Sinmun

title: Issue Which Must Not Be Neglected
body: In April two years ago, the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un provided field guidance to Taesong Department Store just before its opening. Earlier, he had already visited Samjiyon City, Wonsan-Kalma Coast Resort and Yangdok Hot Spring Resort, which were all under construction, for several days. In spite of his pent-up fatigue, he visited the department store late at night. On the first floor, he made rounds of the commodities for sale. Looking at the foodstuffs on display, he said that the foodstuffs of our own making greatly satisfied him. Then, all of a sudden, he asked an official of the department store how the commodities had been priced. Lots of officials had visited the department store and admired the store for its thousands of commodities but nobody had asked about the price. Only the respected General Secretary, who fervently loves the people, thought about how the people would feel visiting the department store rather than feasting his eyes on the commodities. It is only him who judges everything by whether they can actually contribute to people’s living and benefit the people or not. Rodong Sinmun

title: Forced March He Continues with Noble Loyalty
body: The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un continues his revolutionary leadership with his noble loyalty to realize as soon as possible the desire of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il who devoted their all to prosperity of the country and people’s happiness. In midsummer Juche 107(2018) he continued his way of great devotion despite sultry weather. Story of Suspension Bridge Touches People’s Heartstrings In Juche 107(2018) high temperature and sultry weather which unusually began from the end of June reached the limit in midsummer. However the respected General Secretary visited the Yombun Revolutionary Site in Kyongsong County, North Hamgyong Province on July 11. That day after looking round different places of the revolutionary site, associated with the immortal leadership exploits of the President and Chairman, he directed his course towards the Yombunjin Pavilion. The accompanying officials worried about a suspension bridge on the way to the pavilion because of its imperfect state. But the respected General Secretary entered the bridge without hesitation. He redoubled his will on the defective bridge to defend and add glory to the revolutionary exploits of the great leaders, the bloodline of revolution and the banner of struggle and source of victory which encourages our Party building and the revolutionary cause of Juche. A Holiday Camp He Visited at Midnight The respected General Secretary arrived at the Onpho Holiday Camp late at night. Though the people fell asleep, he looked around many places of the camp associated with the warm love of the great leaders. President Kim Il Sung paid meticulous attention to make the camp into a cultural recreation ground conducive to the cultural and emotional life of the people. He appointed the site for the camp in person and even planned the daily schedule for the campers. Chairman Kim Jong Il saw to it that a modern building built by soldiers of the Korean People’s Army opposite the camp for a catfish factory turned into an all-round service center for the campers. The respected General Secretary said that the officials of the units associated with the leadership exploits of the great leaders should work well in order to make the people substantially benefit from the leadership exploits and thus make them keenly realize what precious legacy was bequeathed by the great leaders. Indeed the respected General Secretary continued his way day and night to add luster to the leadership exploits of the great leaders who so much loved the people. Story of Ryongpho Revolutionary Site On July 23 the respected General Secretary visited the Ryongpho Revolutionary Site. The maximum temperature of the day was 40℃. The Ryongpho Revolutionary Site is the place where President Kim Il Sung encouraged People’s Army soldiers of a coast-defense unit in Wonsan area to the victory during the Fatherland Liberation War. It was also visited by Chairman Kim Jong Il. The respected General Secretary suggested going to the place where the President made a speech. The accompanying officials dissuaded him saying the way there was so high-pitched with a sharp slope that he had to go there by car and that he was straining himself in such a hot weather. But he walked up to the place saying he would walk there as the President did and go wherever the President went. Wiping the sweat away he reached the speech-made place and said that we should hand down generation after generation the undying exploits of the President who led the war to the victory and inform the rising generation of the great labor of the Chairman who added luster to the history of the President’s leadership for the war victory. Rodong Sinmun

title: Phalhyang Dam Conveys Indelible Traces of Respected General Secretary
body: On July 12, Juche 107(2018) the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un inspected the Orangchon Power Station under construction. Saying that he came to learn about the situation and take decisive measures as the project had not yet been completed, he acquainted himself with the reason of the delayed project. In early days, President Kim Il Sung indicated detailed orientation and ways for the construction after appointing the site for dam and Chairman Kim Jong Il visited the Orangchon Power Station under construction four times. Looking round the construction site with dark face, the respected General Secretary said his heart was broken when recalling Chairman Kim Jong Il who visited the power station through muddy roads to solve the problem of electricity. The respected General Secretary earnestly said that we should accomplish the last instructions of the President and Chairman by completing the construction as early as possible. He said to the officials that we had to present the gift of loyalty to the Chairman after completing the construction. He determinedly stressed the need for those in North Hamgyong Province to carry on the spirit of creating heroic and legendary stories at the foot of Mt Paektu. Thus the dam could be completed in slightly over one year. We will build the powerful socialist country under the wise leadership of the respected General Secretary who turns the last instructions and aspiration of the President and Chairman into reality. Rodong Sinmun

title: Where Do Their Laughs Come from
body: In Jungdok-dong, Phyongsong City, there live a couple of disabled soldiers. People call them optimists as they live in an optimistic way in spite of their discomfort. Then, what is the source of their optimism? Since their marriage they have led a happy life under the warm loving care of the country. Thanks to the state measures they are living in a new dwelling house without any inconvenience and receive medical treatment at a health resort for dozens of days every year. The number of people helping the disabled soldiers like their own family members is increasing day by day. They constitute officials of the City Party Committee who have visited their home regardless of the time to learn about their living and look after them with great kindness, officials and employees of many other units and enterprises who have sincerely helped them after registering them as honorary employees of their units, etc. Our Party let their darling daughter study at Kang Pan Sok Revolutionary School. She was honoured with a souvenir picture taken with the respected General Secretary when she attended the parade celebrating the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers’ Party of Korea. Like this they have led a happy life without any worry thanks to the benevolent bosom of our Party valuing disabled persons. Happiness and optimism in their family reflect the greatness of our socialist country in which all the people help and lead each other upholding the respected General Secretary as the father of the nation sharing all joys and sorrows with him and the conviction that our future is bright since we are living under the warm care of our Party. This is what renders optimism that enables us to go the thorny path cheerfully. Rodong Sinmun

title: For Country’s Sci-tech Development
body: His Plain Instruction One day in February, Juche104(2015), despite the bad weather of cold wind the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited the construction site of Sci-Tech Complex. After seeing the drawing of a bird’s eye view of the Sci-Tech Complex the respected General Secretary expressed his satisfaction at its wonderfulness highly appreciating the miniature of the complex. After a while the respected General Secretary earnestly instructed that the Sci-tech Complex should serve as a grand palace of learning and a centre for dissemination of advanced science and technology for all the people including scientists and technicians. He added that people must constantly learn the up-to-date scientific and technological knowledge in this complex and thus the complex should serve as a learning space for constant circulation of scientific and technological information, not as a place where water stays still. His instructions reflected his great aspiration to bring about rapid development of science and technology with advanced sci-tech as the dynamic force and accelerate our revolution by dint of it as well as the need to build the complex in a peculiar way. Study Regularly One day some years ago the respected General Secretary visited a factory in North Phyongan Province. He asked one of the accompanying officials how many people had used this learning space seeing its operation plan. In fact, the officials of the factory were planning to open the sci-tech learning space just after showing it to the respected General Secretary. The respected General Secretary said in a low voice that such formalism was unnecessary and they must stop erecting the building for form’s sake. The respected General Secretary sincerely requested them to convert the work of operating sci-tech learning space into regular work, obligatory for everyone. He added that all the employees should regard the work to equip with contemporary science and technology as production campaign and run this learning space in a substantial way to normalize it and make it a part of daily life. The officials determined to work harder true to the lofty will of the respected General Secretary to bring earlier the bright future of our socialism by dint of science and technology. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Floral Basket to General Secretary of C.C., LPRP
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a congratulatory floral basket to Thongloun Sisoulith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party (LPRP) and president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic (LPDR), on the occasion of his 76th birthday. The DPRK ambassador to Laos courteously conveyed the floral basket bearing the august name of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un to the vice-chairman of the Committee for External Affairs of the Central Committee of the LPRP on Nov. 8. Rodong Sinmun

title: Mass Epidemic Prevention Campaign Ramped Up in DPRK
body: The emergency epidemic prevention sectors across the DPRK are further intensifying mass epidemic prevention work to thoroughly block the inroads of the pandemic and get rid of any possibilities of the virus spread. To cope with the increasing danger of the virus spread in the winter, the knowledge of epidemic prevention and manuals on private hygiene are widely disseminated at broadcast posts and through educational networks and billboards against COVID-19 have been put up here and there, so as to enhance the efficiency of the information service. All the people are readily observing the state epidemic prevention guidelines and rules of conduct and immediately taking measures against any bias while making it a rule to address the slightest abnormal practices with caution from the viewpoint of epidemic prevention and inform the relevant organs of them. Public health organs are further intensifying the medical examination of the residents and hygienic education among them and are taking thorough measures to find out and treat the patients with respiratory diseases including those who contracted flu. Institutions, industrial establishments and farms are ensuring the careful disinfection of areas in charge, equipment, raw and other materials and utensils and tools and make it an iron rule to review daily work giving top priority to the epidemic prevention work. Educational and child-care organs are intensifying education among pupils and children in contact with their parents to ensure that they strictly abide by anti-pandemic rules and regulations such as hand-disinfecting, mask-wearing and epidemic prevention distancing. Rodong Sinmun

title: Premier Inspects Agricultural Field of South Hwanghae Province
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, inspected the work of the agricultural field in South Hwanghae Province. Looking round farms in Pongchon, Paechon, Yonan, Chongdan, Pyoksong and Sinchon counties bustling with the struggle for successfully concluding this year's farming, he called for threshing, drying and storing minutely so as not to lose even a grain, and for pushing forward the preparations for next year's farming in a foresighted way. He stressed the need to increase the areas for cultivating wheat and barley, positively introduce advanced farming methods and thus decisively raise the per-hectare yield, bearing in mind that an important reserve for agricultural development of the country and increased grain production lies in thoroughly carrying out the tasks set forth before the agricultural field in the administrative policy of the government of the Republic. The field consultative meetings discussed the issue for officials in the agricultural field of South Hwanghae Province holding an important share in the grain production of the country, to fulfill their responsibility and role, the issue of further raising the zeal of agricultural workers for production, the issue of giving priority to taking material and technological measures to operate farm machines like combine rice harvester and mobile rice thresher at full capacity, the issue of sharing and disseminating the experience of bumper croppers, etc. Earlier, the premier inspected the Sunchon Cement Complex and the construction site for the project for the establishment of C-1 chemical industry, and took relevant measures. Rodong Sinmun

title: Training Sci-tech Talents with Practical Ability
body: Students at Wonsan University of Fisheries are enthusiastic about experiments and practical training. Young students who carry on researches with great ambition and ideal make people picture the bright future of our country, developing by dint of science and technology. Rodong Sinmun

title: Most Delicious Are Fruits Raised by One’s Own Efforts
body: A few months ago the plastic-bottle mineral water production workshop of the Kangso Mineral Water Factory successfully manufactured a carbonated-syrup packing machine by itself. As the employees of the factory engraved in their mind that no other things were more valuable and precious than those made on their own, even if they do not glitter, they could have made the packing machine by their own efforts and techniques. Although it was not a big success it proved an uncommon truth. Everything we make does not come of its own accord but is created by our painstaking and sincere efforts. They are the fruits of self-reliance and output of our patriotism. Our ardent patriotic aspiration to rise by our own efforts brings about progresses together with the prosperous future of the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Mass Gymnastic Production Company Marks Its Golden Jubilee
body: The Mass Gymnastic Production Company marked its 50th founding anniversary. President Kim Il Sung, who opened up a new era of our own-style mass gymnastics in the period of the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, led the work for founding a professional creation group on November 10, Juche 60 (1971), which came to be an occasion for making mass gymnastics popular. Chairman Kim Jong Il clarified an original idea that mass gymnastics is an art work giving a grand epical description of the lines and policies set forth by our Party and the history of struggle and exploits of our Party and people and the ranks for gymnastics, background stand and music are three main constituents of mass gymnastics. Monumental masterpieces, ranging from "The Era of the Workers' Party" in 1961 to the Grand Mass Gymnastics and Artistic Performance "Arirang" famed as a world masterpiece in the 21st century, have been successfully created and staged under the energetic guidance of Kim Jong Il all to represent the spirit, culture, might and stamina of the DPRK. Those masterpieces have enriched the cultural wealth of our state, fully displaying their vitality as a powerful weapon for sound ideological, cultural and physical edification of the people and as a special means of demonstrating the tremendous power of Juche Korea all over the world. Under the wise leadership of the peerlessly great men, the mass gymnastics has recorded a proud history of its development as sports and cultural event demonstrating the might of single-minded unity of Juche Korea and as one of popular sports forms raising the national self-esteem and patriotic enthusiasm of our people. A meeting took place on November 9 to mark the anniversary. At the meeting, Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), conveyed a congratulatory message sent by the C.C., the WPK to the creators and employees of the company greeting the 50th founding anniversary. Rodong Sinmun

title: Forest Science Institute Remodeled in North Phyongan Province
body: The North Phyongan Provincial Forest Science Institute was remodeled. The remodeled institute will serve as a firm foundation for fully solving sci-tech problems arising in provincial forestation and forest conservation. Its inaugural ceremony was held on November 9. Rodong Sinmun

title: Birthday Spread Sent to Centenarian
body: Nam Chun Saek, a resident living at people's neighborhood unit No. 64 in Ryongak-dong of Sunchon City, South Phyongan Province, attained her 100th birthday. In the DPRK, the number of macrobians is on the increase thanks to the popular policies of our Party and state. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un sent a birthday spread to her. She, born into a poor peasant family, was subject to all sorts of humiliation and insult in the dark period of the Japanese imperialists' colonial rule over Korea. She could have led a happy life under the socialist system. Even after retirement, she has continued to do good things for the society and collective with zeal for repaying the loving care of the country. She lives optimistically and has a liking for fruits and fish. Saying that she enjoys longevity thanks to our grateful social system, she used to ask all her family members and neighbors to do their jobs well for the development of the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Do Race against Time
body: Do race against time, it is the constant view of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un always being prioritized in the work for prosperity of the country and happiness of our people. This is the timetable for rapid progress towards the victory of building a powerful socialist country given by the respected General Secretary to our people. His consciousness of racing against time to outpace the world and his extraordinary sense of duty that as much as he devotes himself, can our country become prosperous and the people’s dreams and ideals be realized, serve as a starting point of all his thoughts and activities and a source of the iron will of the respected General Secretary leading the van of today’s general onward march. Under the energetic guidance of the respected General Secretary our people have fostered an insight into the world and recorded a chronicle of gigantic creation and leap forward burning their hearts with high aims and ideals for the future. Rodong Sinmun

title: With All Selfless Devotion
body: The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un engraved the immortal motto of life and struggle with his devotion on our officials’ hearts. With all selfless devotion! The respected General Secretary has devoted his boundless love and care and unconditional service to our people. His lofty idea of devoted service to the people is regarded as the cornerstone of the strategies and tactics of our Party and its line and policies and the criterion of our officials’ daily action and thinking. Day by day the respected General Secretary strives to translate our people’s dreams into reality. We do not fear any hardships and trials as long as we are led by the respected General Secretary. We will go to the utmost ends of the sky and the earth, following the respected General Secretary! Rodong Sinmun

title: Cuban Personages Call for Boosting DPRK-Cuba Friendly Ties
body: There took place a joint internet photo exhibition "DPRK-Cuba Friendship, Century after Century" by the Korean Central News Agency and the Cuban Prensa Latina News Agency from Oct. 20 to Nov. 6 on the occasion of the 55th anniversary of Comrade Raul Castro Ruz's visit to the DPRK. Posted on the websites were photos dealing with the undying exploits performed by President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un together with the Cuban leaders in developing the friendly relations between the two countries. Since the first day of the photo exhibition many people visited the websites every day and expressed their impressions of the history and prospects of the friendly and cooperative relations between the DPRK and Cuba which had been formed in the joint struggle for anti-imperialist independence and socialism and which have further boosted as required by the new era. The deputy head of the International Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba said: The joint photo exhibition helped the people have deep understanding of the history of Cuba-DPRK friendship and the special close relationships between the leaders of the two countries. Our party has posted on its website commemorative articles together with the precious photos displayed in this photo exhibition. This is another manifestation of the will of the Communist Party of Cuba to hold dear its relations with the DPRK and ceaselessly boost them. The president of the Prensa Latina News Agency stressed: The joint photo exhibition served as a good occasion in showing the traditional friendship between Cuba and the DPRK developing century after century. The friendly relations provided by Fidel Castro and Raul Castro and President Kim Il Sung and Leader Kim Jong Il, the historic leaders of the two countries, are expanding and developing amid the attention of Comrade Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel and Comrade Kim Jong Un. We will actively contribute to the development of the friendly relations fostered by the leaders of the two countries by continuing to ramp up exchange and cooperation. A department director of the Prensa Latina News Agency said that he came to know better about the achievements of the leaders of the two countries who made great contributions to developing the friendly relations between the two countries, affirming that he was reassured to have a fraternal country like the DPRK and that the Cuban people will always side with the Korean people on the same front against imperialism. Meanwhile, the Cuban media carried special write-ups on the same occasion. Posted on the website of the Communist Party of Cuba was an article titled "Cuba and the DPRK, on the occasion the 55th anniversary of the historic visit" illustrated with photos showing Kim Il Sung, Kim Jong Il and Kim Jong Un meeting with Cuban leaders. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greeting Cards Issued for Mother's Day
body: Greeting cards have been issued ahead of the significant Mother's Day. Written on the cards are letters in different fonts reading "Happy Mother's Day", "I Love You Mother", etc. decorated with various kinds of flowers, bouquet and garland. The cards represent respect for mothers who add beauty and fragrance to families and society with tender loving care. Rodong Sinmun

title: Heroic Feats Performed by Builders of 216 Division
body: Drastic Change of Samjiyon City The drastic change of Samjiyon area is unthinkable apart from the gigantic plan of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un. The respected General Secretary said that we should continue to wage great construction campaigns of model and weighty significance, so as to develop regional construction with vivid local characters on the basis of the Juche-based architectural aesthetic idea in all parts of the country. Builders of the 216 Division created the model of local construction and fresh civilization in the era of the Workers’ Party, overcoming the countless difficulties by themselves without a momentary hesitation in the harshest environment. In those days they learnt to be more powerful in the face of trials, live on their own and deal with difficulties all the time. The important significance of a new drastic change of Samjiyon area is that they have made the firm breakthrough in realizing the plan of our Party for the local development. To be concrete, the significance is that they have created the exemplary experience and its model for remodeling not only all the cities and county seats but also agricultural villages in the future. And also the powerful militant rank and pivotal force to carry out the plan of our Party for the local development grew up through the gigantic campaign of creation so as to provide another springboard for our development. Make the Impossible Possible Builders of the 216 Division always carried out unconditionally the orders of our Party. Then what is the source of their limitless spiritual strength? An on-the-spot announcer in the construction site said that the song of yearning for the respected General Secretary was the most popular among the officials and members of the division and also was the source of boundless strength to overcome any difficulties with laugh. The absolute loyalty to the respected General Secretary! The loyalty to him is the source of tenacious spirit of overcoming the difficulties, self-sacrificing spirit and the conviction of victory. Their ardent desire to repay him and loyalty to him performed the miracle, turning an impossibility into a possibility. Their faith and will strengthened through the struggle for turning Samjiyon City into paradise of our people. The respected General Secretary’s plan and determination is our practice. Under the guidance of the respected General Secretary we can do anything without fail. Creative Method of 216 Division In the days of building socialist paradise in Samjiyon City after aiming the highest goal in the harshest environment the builders of 216 Division established the example of creative mettle and method for us. The method of creation of 216 Division is characterised by the spirit of self-reliance and the might of science and technology and collectivism. Trust in one’s own strength! The faith and spirit the builders gained through the decisive struggle for the completion is the greatest strength and asset. Self-reliance was the fruition of painstaking speculation and courageous creation. No creativeness without speculation and no creation and innovation without creativeness. The key was science and technology. The might of spirit of self-reliance and science and technology was strengthened in combination with the spirit of collectivism day by day. The united might and collective innovation were characteristic of the creative mettle and method of creation in the area of Mt Paektu. The days of the third-stage project for sprucing up Samjiyon City ensured vividly that we can do anything as we trust in our own strength and we are firmly united. Rodong Sinmun

title: Boundless Fatherly Love
body: Why Does He Come Back Once, the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un inspected a factory of the Korean People’s Army in the dead of night. After giving precious instructions, he looked at its female official in a friendly way and praised her for her merits. Before departure, he said that he hoped she would carry on her work in the future, too, in good health. However, his car returned shortly afterwards. The respected General Secretary said that he hadn’t had a picture taken with her, which had weighed so heavily on his mind, and that was why he had come back. Then, he posed for a souvenir photo with her. He turned back on his way to bestow glory upon a female official invariably faithful to the Party. It is without doubt that no other people in the world are as happy as we are, enjoying the fatherly love of the benevolent leader for his revolutionary soldiers. One of Top-Priority Tasks One August day last year, the respected General Secretary inspected the typhoon-stricken area in South Hwanghae Province. He said that it is one of top-priority tasks to be surely carried out by our Party to go among the people and encourage and sincerely help them when they are in trouble and feel difficult and that the Central Committee of the Party should always be with them both when they are in weal and woe. Indeed, the respected General Secretary is the writer of the epics about loving and prioritizing the people who is carrying on his devoted service for them. Rodong Sinmun

title: He Always Takes Attentive Care of Us
body: Touching Story about Water Slide One day the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited Rungna People’s Pleasure Park and learned about the water slide in the park. He told officials that it was important to eliminate all the elements which may cause accidents during its operation in advance. After listening to one official saying that they had made all the junctions smooth enough, the respected General Secretary said there might appear cracks during its operation. He stated that they must always scrutinize and examine all the elements relating to the slide including junctions stressing once again that there should be rules on display for some hotheaded and adventurous young people and make them strictly abide by the rules. The officials were deeply impressed by his lofty viewpoint on people guaranteeing the best in the work for our people. Repeatedly Emphasized Issue One day in November, Juche104(2015), the respected General Secretary visited the remodeled Mangyongdae Schoolchildren’s Palace. He expressed his concern about the temperature of the rhythmic gymnastic squad room saying the big windows in the room would not insure enough warmth for our children during their exercise in winter. He also dropped in at the swimming pool and the dormitory to point out and correct all the unnoticeable shortcomings with the desire to eliminate inconvenience of our schoolchildren. The officials were full of confidence that the Mangyongdae Schoolchildren’s Palace would remain as our children’s dear home and ever-benevolent palace under the fatherly care of the respected General Secretary. Rodong Sinmun

title: "Complete Collection of Kim Jong Il's Works" Vol. 41 Published
body: The Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House brought out Vol. 41 of "Complete Collection of Kim Jong Il's Works", a library of immortal Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, carrying Chairman Kim Jong Il's works in a chronological order and in a systematic and comprehensive way. The volume contains 47 works including speeches and talks given by the Chairman from July Juche 76 (1987) to March Juche 77 (1988). Some of them deal with the idea of staunchly adhering to the working class's revolutionary stand and invariably taking the road of socialism and the idea of cherishing the unshakable revolutionary faith and devotedly struggling for the accomplishment of the revolutionary cause of Juche. Among them are works clarifying the tasks and ways of preparing all the Party members for genuine communist revolutionaries boundlessly loyal to the leader by waging a vigorous struggle to make a revolutionary climate prevail throughout the Party to meet the new requirements of the developing revolution and of developing our Party into a revolutionary party of Juche for ever. The volume also contains works underscoring the need to strengthen the People's Army and dealing with the orientation and ways for economic construction and improvement of the people's standard of living. There are other works providing excellent solutions to the issue of preserving well the Fatherland Liberation War Historic Site to strengthen the edification through it, the issue of further intensifying the education of young people and other theoretical and practical issues arising in the revolution and construction. Rodong Sinmun

title: His Great Ideal Touches Our Hearts
body: The Best Things for Our People One October day in Juche 108(2019), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un inspected Yangdok Hot Spring Resort near completion. Making rounds of the resort under construction, he pointed to the spaces around the outdoor bathing tub and told officials that hangers for clothes or towels had to be installed there for the sake of bathers’ convenience. As for the bathing tub, he said that it had to be filled with enough hot spring water to soak bathers as much as their shoulders to make sure that they wouldn’t feel cold while having a hot spring bath in winter. He also taught that heating pipes had to be buried under the passage to the outdoor spa and be heated with waste hot spring water so that the passage could remain unfrozen even in winter. He went on to say that as the construction was at its final stage, potential seasonal problems in operating the resort had to be taken into proper consideration and be taken care of. He earnestly requested that the resort had to be completed on a high qualitative level to ensure that people wouldn’t feel the slightest inconvenience there. Like this, the respected General Secretary regards it as an iron rule that only the best things in the world have to be provided for the people and they must remain flawless even in the distant future. Thanks to such devotion of his, proud monumental edifices for the people have mushroomed in our country. Just What He Wanted to Do When seeing things to be provided for the people during his energetic field guidance, the respected General Secretary often says that they are just what he wanted to do for the people. He said so with satisfaction when he visited Mangyongdae Revolutionary Site Souvenir Fatory, Jungphyong Vegetable Greenhouse Farm and the newly-built Ryugyong General Ophthalmic Hospital. Wherever he goes, he makes strict demands to create things for the good of the people in larger numbers and at a faster speed and he is greatly delighted every time people’s demands and interests are satisfied. Grains of Sand in a Mountain At the ground-breaking ceremony for the construction of the Pyongyang General Hospital, the respected General Secretary said out of earnest feelings that in recent years, modern ophthalmic, dental and other specialized hospitals and children’s hospital were built in Pyongyang but he couldn’t be satisfied with those successes as they were only grains of sand in a mountain when compared to the lofty ideals and ambitions of the Party. When the general service ship “Mujigae” opened thanks to his round-the-clock painstaking efforts, he said that the ship “Mujigae” was no more than a grain of sand as far as things to do for people’s sake were concerned and that these grains of sand had to be put together to build a great mountain. Nowhere else in the world can we find such a great man possessed of the lofty ideal and intention run through by fervent love for his people. That’s what we have keenly realized every moment and every day for the last ten years. Thanks to his great devotion, people’s dreams and ideals have been translated into reality and people’s laughter and hurrahs for the Workers’ Party of Korea have rung out loud in our country however fierce wind may have blown. Rodong Sinmun

title: Green Forest Tells of an Unforgettable Story
body: Even If Their Bodies May Serve as Roots and Base Manure On the Tree-planting Day a few years ago, the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited Mangyongdae Revolutionary School and planted trees with its students. That day he said that the teachers should lead the students to devote their sincerity and enthusiasm to tree-planting with extraordinary awareness that they should display their clear conscience and ardent patriotism before planting trees and with the will to take good care of woodland even if their bodies may serve as roots and base manure. He personally planted trees for a long while, digging a hole, watering and tamping with students. Looking at carefully the planted trees one by one, he praised all of the students for doing good work. He said if they grew up and visited the school they would recollect that day, seeing tall trees. His instructions taught that the country would become more beautiful when everybody devoted their sweat and sincerity unsparingly to tree-planting valuing even a single tree and those who possessed such ardent patriotism could sincerely contribute to the country’s prosperity. For Rising Generation One December day the respected General Secretary visited a tree nursery of the Korean People’s Army. He earnestly said that we should not slacken our forest restoration campaign even though noticeable success was not achieved after planting trees for a few years as the campaign was a patriotic work of lasting significance and long-term one which calls for foreseeing ten years. Then he underscored the need to plant and tend even a single tree with care, thinking of the future when the mountains and fields of the country would be thickly wooded, though we worked hard at present. He expressed great satisfaction at the success gained by the tree nursery saying that the forest restoration campaign was the patriotic undertaking of eternal value we must do for the rising generation at any cost. True to the noble intention of the respected General Secretary, the officials confirmed their will to devote themselves to the rising generation and the prosperous future of the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Guidance on Trial Run of New Trolleybus
body: On mid-night of one February day, Juche 107(2018), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un went to the front part of the People’s Palace of Culture to guide the trial run of a newly-manufactured trolleybus. The respected General Secretary expressed his satisfaction at the new trolleybus saying that it looked more handsome at night. He suggested taking a ride to learn about its efficiency noting that he would feel easy when he personally took the new-type trolleybus as they were made for the sake of our people’s convenience. Thus the respected General Secretary went round the city aboard the trolleybus. He took a seat on the bus and estimated the width of the seat saying it was all right. He earnestly called on the sector of the passenger service in the capital to strive to keep the service going regularly, always regarding the popular masses’ demand and appreciation as absolute standard and strictly relying on it. The trolleybus is comfortable and reliable as its damper and speed are good and it has little vibration and noise, he noted, appreciating its technical conditions. It is sure that happiness of our people will come into full bloom on this land under the benevolent care of the respected General Secretary devoting his all to our people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Meetings of Young Activists in Displaying Noble Traits Held in DPRK
body: Meetings of young activists in displaying noble traits are being held in every province of the DPRK. The meetings took place in Kangwon Province, South Hamgyong Province, Ryanggang Province, Nampho City and Kaesong City respectively. Officials from local Party and power organs, youth league officials, activists in displaying noble traits and youth and students attended the meetings, where speeches were made. Reporters and speakers said that young people across the country fully demonstrated the prestige of the young vanguard in the sacred struggle of defending the Party, revolution and country and that an increasing number of young people are displaying noble and beautiful traits of devoting themselves to society, collectives and comrades. They referred to the soaring aspiration and burning passion of the undergraduates who are determined to make a positive contribution to building a thriving nation with precious sci-tech achievements through brisk scientific research activities. Young people are eager to do good things for the country and people while cherishing patriotism like those of the Chollima age, and youths getting married to honored disabled soldiers are increasing, they said. Those noble virtue and traits displayed among young people are attributable to the warm loving care and wise guidance of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, who built a youth power without an equal on this land, they stressed. They called on all the young vanguard to give full play to the heroic spirit of the Korean youths as befits the new generation grown under the care of the Party and to dedicate the wisdom and enthusiasm of youth in the worthwhile struggle for the country's prosperity. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Sci-Tech Presentation in Sector of Coal Industry Held
body: The national sci-tech presentation in the sector of coal industry was held through video conferencing from Nov. 10 to 12 under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea. More than 160 valuable papers conducive to developing the coal industry under a long-range program were made public at the presentation which was participated in by teachers, researchers, field officials, etc. of over 20 units, including Kim Chaek University of Technology, Phyongsong University of Coal Mining and the Geology Institute under the State Academy of Sciences.
