During the presentation there was a lecture on the real state of the coal industry of our country and the prospects of its development. Rodong Sinmun

title: High-speed Tunneling Competition Brisk in Coal Industry
body: The third-stage high-speed tunneling competition is briskly underway in the coal industry of the DPRK. As the competition gets into full swing, coal mines are actively introducing rational tunneling methods to produce more coal. All the coal mines under the Sunchon Area Youth Coal Mining Complex have recorded high results in the competition every day. Notably, the February 8 Jikdong Youth Coal Mine is speeding up tunneling and securing more preparatory cutting faces by rationally allocating tunneling forces in consideration of the condition of each working face. Other coal mining complexes competitively participate in the event while sharing and generalizing excellent technology and experience. Rodong Sinmun

title: Many Units Win Title of Model Technical Innovation Unit
body: The number of units which won the title of model technical innovation unit is increasing in DPRK. A lot of units of the national economy took up the movement for winning the title of model technical innovation unit 8 years ago. The title is awarded to units which firmly consolidate their sci-tech foundations and boost production by actively introducing valuable technical innovations into production and management through active mass technological innovation movement. In January Juche 104 (2015) over 90 units won the title of model technical innovation unit. Now the number has reached over 1 480. In 2015 alone, 132 units won the title. For 5 years since the 7th Party Congress nearly 130 units have won the title of thrice model technical innovation unit, more than 340 units the title of twice model technical innovation unit and some 540 units the title of model technical innovation unit and thus the ranks have been further expanded. With the struggle for guaranteeing the accomplishment of the national economic plan with the might of science and technology getting active in every unit this year, over 340 units have won the title of thrice and twice model technical innovation unit and the title of model technical innovation unit so far. Rodong Sinmun

title: Our Future and Destiny Are Entrusted to Respected General Secretary
body: Warm Love of Respected General Secretary One March day in Juche 104(2015), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited the Pyongyang Old People’s Home under construction. Looking round the home the respected General Secretary gave detailed instructions for the construction. At that time not only the barbershop, beauty parlor, bathroom and laundry but also the gym, library, entertainment center, medical treatment room and cinema were laid out meticulously in the design for the home. However the respected General Secretary told an official to discuss to find out anything else necessary. That day after learning about several problems from the official he took measures to solve them one by one. The respected General Secretary said that melamine resin vessels should be provided for the old. Indeed the old people’s home could be built elegantly under the deep care for people of the respected General Secretary. Visiting Onpho Holiday Camp at Mid-night In July some years ago the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited the then Onpho Holiday Camp in Kyongsong County. The respected General Secretary learned in detail the actual condition of management and operation of the camp and put forward the task to remodel it modernly. He indicated vital instructions in order to turn the county into a place good to live in and led the officials to be the genuine servants of our people devoting their all. Thanks to the warm love of the respected General Secretary everything is conducive to the promotion of people’s well-being in our country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Premier Kim Tok Hun Inspects Various Fields of Kangwon Province
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, inspected the fisheries field and the construction site of a local industrial factory in Kangwon Province. He looked round the Thongchon Fishery Station and the Songdowon Fishery Station. There he underlined the need to put the search for fishing ground on a higher scientific basis, ensure prompt advance to the main fishing ground as required by the policy for catching more fish through intensive fishing campaign and thus increase haul per ship. He also called for paying deep attention to the living of fishermen. He learned in detail about the construction of a local industrial factory in Kimhwa County. He emphasized that officials should provide responsible organization and command for different construction projects to set a model in all aspects, bearing deep in mind the intention of the Party Central Committee to create a new standard of local industrial factory. There took place field consultative meetings. Discussed there were the issue of continuing the fishing campaign through thorough-going technical management of fishing ships and fishing tackle preparations and the issues essential for all the processes like fishing, discharging, freezing and storing of fish. Ways of completing the construction of the local industrial factory in Kimhwa County within the date set by the Party and on a level demanded by the Party was also discussed. Earlier, Kim Tok Hun visited the construction site of Sinphyong Power Station and pressed for relevant measures. Rodong Sinmun

title: Kanggye Koryo Medicine Factory Remodeled
body: The Kanggye Koryo Medicine Factory associated with the immortal leadership exploits of Chairman Kim Jong Il has been remodeled. In this factory, where the processes ranging from input of raw materials to package of the products have been put on the germ-free and dust-free basis, they can produce more quality Koryo medicines. By installing an active electric boiler the production process has been turned into an energy-saving one and a progress has been made in establishing a cultured way of production and life. Rodong Sinmun

title: Monument to Kimilsungia Unveiled in Indonesia
body: A monument to Kimilsungia was unveiled with due ceremony at an orchid greenhouse of the Bogor Botanical Garden in Indonesia on November 10. Seen at the venue of the event were photos showing the exploits performed by President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in developing the friendly relations between the DPRK and Indonesia and a photo of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un together with children. Present there were personages of the parliament, government and political parties, including the People's Consultative Assembly, the Indonesian Democratic Party of Struggle and the Foreign Ministry, and the Indonesian ambassador to the DPRK. The DPRK ambassador to Indonesia was also present there. Personages from political, academic and economic circles of Indonesia and other countries like Australia and New Zealand and members of organizations for friendship and solidarity with the Korean people attended the event through video teleconferencing. A Korean film on Kim Il Sung's visit to Indonesia was screened at the event before the unveiling of the monument. The monument carries letters saying that on April 13, 1965, President Kim Il Sung and Leader Kim Jong Il of the DPRK visited the greenhouse where the then President Soekarno gave a name of Kimilsungia to the most beautiful orchid newly cultivated by the greenhouse to represent the august name of Kim Il Sung. A video clip sent in congratulation of the unveiling of the monument was screened and speeches were made at the event. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Wreath to Bier of Late Ri Yong Suk
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un sent a wreath to the bier of the late Ri Yong Suk, an anti-Japanese revolutionary fighter, to express deep condolences over her death. Ri Yong Suk, who had dedicated herself to the liberation of the country and the accomplishment of the revolutionary cause of Juche since she embarked upon the road of revolution under the loving care of President Kim Il Sung, had faithfully upheld the leadership of the Party as befits a member of the first generation of our revolution till the last moments of her life. The wreath sent by Kim Jong Un was laid before her grave at the Revolutionary Martyrs' Cemetery on Mt Taesong on Monday. Rodong Sinmun

title: ﻿Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Provides Field Guidance to Samjiyon City
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, gave on-the-spot guidance to Samjiyon City to learn about the real state of the third-stage project with the conclusion of Samjiyon City construction now in hand. Accompanying him were Jo Yong Won, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretary for Organizational Affairs of the WPK Central Committee, Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and premier of the Cabinet, Pak Jong Chon, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretary of the WPK Central Committee, Kim Jae Ryong, department director of the WPK Central Committee, Pak Hun, vice-premier of the Cabinet, and leading officials in the construction sector. Thanks to the energetic leadership of Kim Jong Un determined to turn the city into a model of a mountainous cultured city and into an ideal local city as befits the sacred place of the revolution, the construction of the city has been vigorously pushed forward with as the work of the whole Party and state, being divided into three stages. And the construction of the city is due to be concluded this year. According to the plan and policy of the Party to spruce up the areas and farms adjacent to the township of Samjiyon City in a three-stage project in the wake of the completion of the township, the huge project comprising the construction of dwelling houses for thousands of families, public and production buildings, educational facilities, water supply and drainage system, roads, afforestation and greening and power grid system in the ten-odd dongs and ris including Paektusan Secret Camp-dong, Rimyongsu-dong, Sinmusong-dong, Dam No. 5-dong, Phothae-dong, Junghung-ri, Hunggyesu-ri, Sobaeksan-ri, Paeksam-ri, Poso-ri and Thongsin-ri is due to be finished soon. The respected General Secretary learned comprehensively about the real state of the construction of Samjiyon City, city management and farming while giving field guidance to dwelling houses, educational facilities, cultural and welfare facilities, camping buildings for study tour teams in Paektusan Secret Camp-dong, Rimyongsu-dong and Phothae-dong and several other units in the city including Junghung Farm which had been built, being divided into three stages. He said with high appreciation that all the buildings highlight the peculiar local features as well as natural environment and thoroughly embody practicality, diversity and formative art in keeping with our Party's idea on the Juche-oriented architectural beauty and with the policy requirement for local construction. Saying that all the buildings of Samjiyon City are associated with the lofty loyalty, strong will and sweat of our people who are determined to absolutely support and uphold the grand plans and resolutions of the Party and implement them, the General Secretary noted that not only the township but also several areas and farms in the city have turned into examples of a mountainous cultured city under socialism and standard units of rural development thanks to the dynamic struggle of the builders who vigorously pushed ahead with the huge project without a stop despite the unfavorable environment in the northern tip of the country. Saying that, as he continuously stressed, it is the deserved duty and revolutionary obligation of our people and new generations who are the soldiers and disciples of the great leaders to turn Samjiyon City, the sacred place of the sun where the native home of the revolution is located, into a firm base for education in revolutionary traditions and a model of civilized mountainous towns, the General Secretary said that the noble struggle helped fully demonstrate the unyielding faith and will of all the people to remain loyal to the leader to the end and add eternal luster to the revolutionary exploits of the leader, and this has more firmly provided a fundamental guarantee for carrying forward and accomplishing the revolutionary cause of Juche. Noting that the 4 year-long construction of Samjiyon City proved the irresistible might of the single-minded unity and harmonious whole of the Party and the people and also the iron will of our state to achieve prosperity our own way and with our own efforts, as well as its self-confidence and possibility of independent development, the General Secretary, in the name of the Party Central Committee, sent thanks to the builders, supporters and the people of the whole nation who brilliantly realized the decisions and policies of the Party. He said that the achievements, experience and standards gained through the construction of Samjiyon City serve as correct guidelines for pushing forward our Party's policy of local construction in the right direction. He added that this has great significance in the on-going struggle for making a new start for the change of local areas. Calling for bringing about a radical turn in development of local construction and the building of civilized society by actively encouraging and expanding excellent experience gained in the construction of Samjiyon City, the General Secretary said that in order to correctly propel the grandiose construction policy of our Party without deviation, it becomes priority issues and strategic task to promptly strengthen the construction and designing forces in the local areas and firmly lay their material and technical foundations. The General Secretary emphasized that the provinces, cities and counties should take organizational and institutional steps and press for prompt state measures to strengthen construction and designing forces. He also underlined the need to raise the specialization level of construction units and to enhance the role and function of institutions supervising construction and thus ensure the maximum quality in construction. Looking round modern houses of peculiar styles and ri cultural hall built in the Junghung farming area, the General Secretary said that the area can be called a picturesque model unit in rural buildup. Calling for making substantial farming preparations for next year by learning from experience of potato farming for this year, he underscored the need to make scientific and technological study and taking measures to ensure stable increase in potato production without fluctuation despite the unfavorable conditions in the northern alpine areas. He encouraged the agricultural field to raise once again the hot wind of potato farming. He learned about issues arising in the farm one by one, and said that the Party will render active support to make the farm a model unit in the introduction of farm machines, now that it has been spruced up as a standard unit in farm buildup. Calling for flawlessly paving roads in the city to correspond with the living environment in Samjiyon City that has undergone a great change, the General Secretary held consultation over the yearly road pavement section plan for the future and set forth concrete direction. Referring to the ecological environment and afforestation of Samjiyon City, the General Secretary stressed the need to make deep study of relevant field so that thorough-going measures can be taken to protect forests, and scientific and technological management is realized to cope with all sorts of factors like damage by harmful insects and climate change. He said that the construction of Samjiyon City becomes a starting point of a new revolution in making the people in local areas witness a leaping progress to a highly civilized material and cultural life. The General Secretary said that he felt pride in having done worthwhile work welcomed by the people, upon hearing a report that the people in the land of Samjiyon were very happy over the change in Samjiyon and they were singing highly of the benevolence of our Party. He added that people's opinion is precisely the general evaluation of the construction of Samjiyon City, repeatedly expressing great satisfaction. Noting that the construction of Samjiyon City has been wonderfully done as planned and intended by the Party, the General Secretary warmly wished for the happiness and well-being of all the people of Samjiyon City who would lead a highly civilized and wonderful cultured life in the place dear to heart, the place housing the native home of Chairman Kim Jong Il and in which Mt Paektu stands. Political News Team

title: ﻿Many People Graduate from Online Education Courses
body: Many working people of the DPRK have attended lectures through the well-organized online education system over the last ten years since the online education started at Kim Chaek University of Technology. And there have been an increasing number of those attending such lectures. Kim Il Sung University, Kim Chaek University of Technology and other major universities turned into tele-education centers, and online education has been underway across the country. As a result, the working people get modern scientific and technological knowledge of the subjects they wish to learn. Kim Chaek University of Technology produced over 110 graduates of the tele-education faculty in the first year of the online education course, and since then lots of working people entered major universities and finished tele-education course. Hamhung University of Chemical Engineering also produced the first graduates of the online education course. There took place the first year graduation ceremony of the tele-education faculty under Hamhung University of Chemical Engineering at the Ponghwa Chemical Factory on Nov. 9. The working people prepare themselves to be intellectual-type workers while acquiring modern science and technology at their working places. The achievements made in the online education, inspiring the working people with the firm confidence that our Party's plan to make all the people well versed in science and technology will be successfully implemented in the near future, encourage the working people across the country to create and make rapid progress. Rodong Sinmun

title: ﻿Stricter Emergency Epidemic Prevention Measures Taken
body: Emergency epidemic prevention units at all levels take stricter emergency epidemic prevention steps to meet the conditions of the winter. Through the mass media, the education networks, etc. the central emergency epidemic prevention units intensify the ideological education and hygiene information campaign to make the people strictly observe the emergency epidemic prevention rules and orders. The public health units ensure that the medical workers in charge of households play their roles well to make all the people take good care of their health, to thoroughly prevent the outbreak and spread of the respiratory diseases, and to pay special attention to those with chronic diseases. At institutions, enterprises, factories and farms those in charge of hygiene do temperature-taking, disinfection, ventilation, etc. responsibly and are making preparations to take corresponding steps with good knowledge of the code of conduct in case of the occurrence of fever patients. The fishery stations are making fishermen strictly keep the epidemic prevention rules and orders and make them stay alert to deal with even trivial matters from the epidemic prevention viewpoint. Neighborhood units are ensuring that people clean up villages and families better and drink boiled water. Rodong Sinmun

title: Leading Officials of C.C., WPK Visit Lodging Quarters of Participants in 5th Conference of Frontrunners of Three Revolutions
body: Leading officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) visited the lodging quarters of the participants in the 5th Conference of Frontrunners of the Three Revolutions on Sunday. Leading officials of the Party Central Committee, including Secretaries of the WPK Central Committee O Su Yong and Thae Hyong Chol, and Department Directors of the WPK Central Committee O Il Jong, Ho Chol Man and Yu Jin visited the lodging quarters and met the participants. The leading officials congratulated the three revolution standard-bearers and three revolution team members who will participate in the grand meeting of the frontrunners of the three revolutions, the fifth of its kind in the history of the WPK. The leading officials called on the participants to keep deep in mind the intention of the Party Central Committee for promoting the balanced and simultaneous development of every sector, unit and region by enhancing the might of the three revolutions in every way, and to continue to add luster to their honor of being the pioneers in waging the Juche-oriented mass movement more vigorously. Rodong Sinmun

title: ﻿Participants in 5th Conference of Frontrunners of Three Revolutions Arrive Here
body: The 5th Conference of Frontrunners of the Three Revolutions is to be held in Pyongyang, the capital of our revolution, at a time when the general march for successfully concluding the campaign for this year, the first year for implementing the five-year plan, is briskly underway on all fronts of socialist construction, true to the decisions made at the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). Arriving here on Sunday were participants in the conference, including three-revolution standard-bearers and three-revolution team members who set practical examples in carrying out the revolutions―ideological, technological and cultural― under the leadership of the Party. Leading officials of the Central Committee of the WPK warmly greeted the participants. Citizens welcomed the participants with waving hands in the streets of the capital. All the participants were full of ardent enthusiasm to glorify the era of vigorous advance and dynamism in the van by bearing deep in mind the important requirement of our revolution and their obligation before the times and further boosting the might of the three revolution red flag movement and the three revolution team movement through the conference. Rodong Sinmun

title: Conscious That They Should Serve the People
body: These female workers with smart new shoes in their hands are from Ryuwon Footwear Factory. Their smiles are indicative of their pride of being the people’s servants. We feel as if we would hear them whispering about the smart shoes. This snapshot reflects their sense of duty to produce quality shoes popular among consumers. Indeed, "Fresh Innovation, Bold Creation and Steady Advance" is not merely a watchword hung at their place of work but an aspiration kept precious in their hearts to devotedly serve the people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Unforgettable Story about His Devotion to People
body: Rungna Islet Tells of a Touching Story One day in July, Juche 101(2012), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited the Rungna People’s Pleasure Park just before the start of operation in the summer heat. He expressed satisfaction at the whole atmosphere of the wading pool decorated in clean and refreshing way with all kinds of facilities and surroundings being white, blue and green. Going around basketball, volleyball and beach volleyball courts built on the roof of the bathing booth and shower cubicle, he appreciated that spaces were used in a reasonable way. Then he told officials the need to equip the wading pool with a first-aid room. In the past when he gave the first guidance to the pleasure park under construction he said that the pleasure park must be named with the word “people” and he should call it the Rungna People’s Pleasure Park. Indeed the respected General Secretary was so anxious to provide people with more things although he had already provided them with such a wonderful wading pool. View of Service He Inculcated One January day in Juche 101(2012), the respected General Secretary visited the Mirae Shop. Looking around many places of the shop he gave precious instructions to unfold the service activities well. Then he halted in front of an electrical appliances stand on the second floor. Set out on the stand were various sorts of fans and among them was a new kind of fan. It was wingless. He asked an official of the shop about the advantage of the new fan. The official answered him, without apprehending distinctly his question, that it was wingless that children would not be hurt even they put their hands in it. Then he said that he was actually asking about the principle of the fanning. The official couldn’t answer him as well as the saleslady of the stand as they had never paid attention to the operation principles of goods. After a while the respected General Secretary said that salespersons should know well the principles of goods because some customers may ask about it when they buy things. A Carton of Tiles He Weighed One August Day in Juche 103(2014), the respected General Secretary gave a field guidance to the Chollima Tile Factory despite sultry weather in midsummer. He looked round the factory appreciating its employees for their workmanship. He kept his eyes on the employees who were packing up tiles for a while and weighed a tile carton which was tens of kilograms heavy. And he appreciated the workers for their labor. To tell the truth officials who used to visit the production site almost every day had never weighed the labor of the workers by weighing the heavy tile carton. It was the hottest time of the day when the respected General Secretary looked round the factory that day. However fierce heat of nature was not as hot as the heat of his devotion to the people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Paying Deep Attention to Heating System of a Kindergarten
body: One May day in Juche 101(2012), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un dropped in at a room of Kyongsang Kindergarten built anew in Changjon Street. After going to the veranda of the room, the respected General Secretary looked round the roomy veranda and its surrounding. Saying that the other rooms might have verandas too, he worried that a cold wind might blow in through cracks in the door in winter. In the dining room the respected General Secretary asked the accompanying officials about the heating system, placing his hands on the floor. After listening to an official replying that it was designed to be warmed by central heating, the respected General Secretary said that it would be proved in winter. It was benevolent parental love. Indeed, the respected General Secretary who loves children most and devotes his all to them is the tenderhearted father of our children. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Congratulatory Message to Syrian President
body: Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a congratulatory message to Bashar Al-Assad, president of the Syrian Arab Republic, on Tuesday. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un in his message warmly congratulated the president and friendly government and people of Syria on the 51st anniversary of the corrective movement in Syria. Kim Jong Un said that the corrective movement served as a signal event in the struggle of the Syrian people for building an independent, prosperous and new society. He wished the president and people of Syria bigger success in accomplishing their just cause to smash the hostile forces' disturbance, defend the country's sovereignty and accelerate reconstruction. Rodong Sinmun

title: More of Young People Volunteer for Major Sectors of Socialist Construction
body: After the 8th Congress of the Workers’ Party of Korea a lot of young people volunteered for difficult and challenging sectors of the national economy including the sectors of metal, coal and mining industry and socialist farms across the country. The respected General Secretary sent a letter of congratulations to trustworthy young people and had a photo taken with them. After hearing the news enthusiasm for volunteering runs high among the youth league officials and young people. In South Hwanghae Province over 200 young people, full of determination to live and struggle as heroic youth to be remembered by the country, volunteered to work at socialist farms. In the Ministry of Railways over 100 young people volunteered for difficult and challenging sectors with ardent love for and unshakable confidence in socialism. The advance of our country towards a fresh victory of the socialist construction will be further accelerated by the young people who volunteer for difficult and challenging sectors of the national economy fully demonstrating the stout mettle of the Korean youth with warm blood and soaring passion. Rodong Sinmun

title: Dear Homes for Happy Living
body: Once the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un told officials with great pride about the Juche-oriented socialism in which everything serves the people and said that everything for people and things popular become the most just one and prioritized in our-style socialist country. Endless is the painstaking efforts of the respected General Secretary who devotes himself to turning our socialist country, the happy and bright home of people built and defended by President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, into the people’s eternal place for happy living and the best paradise in the world. Our people including ordinary educators, scientists and working people, without paying even a penny, settled in such rare homes like those in Unha Scientists Street, Mirae Scientists Street and Ryomyong Street, in which only the riches can live in other countries. Moreover, thanks to the great leader’s loving care for the people and noble idea of believing in the people as in Heaven, commoners became the masters of the new houses in Manbok-dong, Rason City and Kangbuk-ri in Kumchon County and Taechong-ri in Unpha County of North Hwanghae Province after being drowned out. It is the reality of our country where people never worry about homelessness even if they lose their homes by flood and typhoon. These are the legendary tales unique to our socialist country led by the great father. Therefore we speak out loudly that our socialist country led by the respected General Secretary is the best in the world and our confidence in it gets stronger. Rodong Sinmun

title: Mother's Day Celebrated in DPRK
body: Mother's Day was significantly celebrated across the country. People visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, where President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il lie in state, and paid high tribute to them. A lot of people visited the statues of the President and the Chairman and mosaics picturing their smiling images in different parts of the country including Mansu Hill and paid tribute after placing bouquets and flowers. Pervading the whole country on the day were the happiness of women living a worthwhile life as flowers of the society and collective and greetings to all the mothers. Service personnel firmly defending the defense line posts of the country and young people performing feats in the great struggle for a fresh development of socialist construction sent greeting cards to their mothers. At flower shops and flower counters in different parts of the country youth and students bought beautiful flowers for their mothers who have shown deep love and affection for them. Colorful art performances revving up the holiday atmosphere were given in Pyongyang and the provinces. Mansudae Art Troupe gave a music and dance performance at the East Pyongyang Grand Theatre, the National Symphony Orchestra a concert at Moranbong Theatre, artistes of the National Folk Art Troupe a music and dance performance at Ponghwa Art Theatre, and opera "Eternal Victors" was staged at Pyongyang Grand Theatre. A circus show and magic suite "mysterious wonder" were given at Pyongyang Circus Theater and magic theater of National Acrobatic Troupe to please the citizens celebrating Mother's Day. Artistes in North and South Phyongan, South Hwanghae and North and South Hamgyong provinces also gave special art performances. Rodong Sinmun

title: Kimchi-making Season Full of National Flavour
body: We call this time of year Kimchi-making season and traditionally prepare Kimchi, our traditional dish. This year also there can be seen every family making Kimchi. From olden times our people have pickled Kimchi with vegetables harvested in autumn and it has been reserved as an important dish in winter. Whenever this season comes neighbors and relatives help each other to pickle and wash vegetables, prepare seasonings and store them in jars. This has been a laudable custom. They taste Kimchi and seasonings and share pleasure with each other. The scene of Kimchi-making season represents custom of our nation living harmoniously while helping each other and the life of our people diversifying the diet, regarding ours as the best. This is, indeed, the view seen only on this land and one of customs to be handed down from generation to generation. Rodong Sinmun

title: Unforgettable Story about His Love for Children
body: Play Area Newly Arranged At the Pyongyang Children’s Department Store play areas were arranged for children on every floor. They are associated with the deep love of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un. One May day in Juche 101(2012), the respected General Secretary visited the department store nearing completion. Going round it he told officials to arrange play areas for children on every floor. Some days later he sent thousands of pieces of indoor amusement facilities to the department store. A month later he visited the department store again and looked at the newly-arranged play areas. He kept his eyes on a play area for a while and said that they were well arranged and when children saw those amusement facilities they would be fond of playing there instead of following their parents at the department store. He added that children would have no mind to go home when they found pleasure in the amusement facilities, therefore their parents would not worry about losing them and that’s why he saw to it that the play areas were arranged there. Indeed the play areas were the cradle of happiness for the children overflowing with the warmest love of the great father. Defect He Detected in an Instant In October several years ago the respected General Secretary looked round the newly built Wisong Scientists Residential District. He dropped into a classroom of Wisong Junior Middle School. Glancing about the classroom contentedly he said with pleasure that it was well arranged. However, after a little while he sat at a desk and asked an official to put a ballpen on it. The official couldn’t make head or tail but he did so. When the respected General Secretary opened the lid of the desk the ballpen rolled down on to the floor. Drawing a line with his hand on the front part of the lid, the respected General Secretary gently said to the officials that there were no flange on the front part and there must be a flange or groove on the lid or pencils or ballpens might fall down on to the floor by a slight touch. Then he earnestly told officials to design school desks well. The officials were deeply moved by his scrupulous care. Rodong Sinmun

title: 5th Conference of Frontrunners in Three Revolutions Opens
body: The 5th Conference of the Frontrunners in the Three Revolutions opened in Pyongyang, the capital of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), on November 18. The conference is to share the successes and experience, and analyze and review the mistakes and lessons drawn in the course of the mass movement for implementing the three revolutions after the 4th Conference of the Frontrunners of the Three-Revolution Red Flag Movement and the national meeting of active three-revolution team members, and to discuss the practical problems arising in bringing about a new innovation in the three-revolution red flag movement and the work of the three-revolution teams. The conference was participated in by three-revolution standard-bearers and the three-revolution team members who are taking the lead in implementing the revolutions-ideological, technological and cultural-, leading officials of the provincial, city and county Party committees, chief Party officials of ministries and national institutions, political officers of the armed forces organs, officials of relevant departments of the Party Central Committee and officials concerned. The platform was taken by Choe Ryong Hae, Kim Tok Hun and Pak Jong Chon who are the members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). Among those on the platform were the leading officials of the Party and government, chief secretaries of the provincial committees of the WPK, leading officials of the working people's organizations, ministries and national institutions and officials who set practical examples in carrying out the revolutions-ideological, technological and cultural-, three-revolution standard-bearers and three-revolution team members. Leading officials of the armed forces organs also took the platform. The letter "Let's Achieve a Comprehensive Development of Socialism by Kindling the Fierce Flames of the Three Revolutions" sent by Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the WPK and president of the State Affairs of the DPRK, to the participants in the 5th Conference of the Frontrunners in the Three Revolutions was conveyed by Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un in his letter referred to the intention of the Central Committee of the Party in convening the 5th Conference of the Frontrunners in the Three Revolutions at a time when the era of great turn has come, and extended deep thanks and militant greetings in the name of the Central Committee of the Party and the government of the Republic to the participants in the conference, three-revolution standard-bearers and members of the three-revolution teams across the country who have made a great contribution to the three revolutions-ideological, technological and cultural- as the frontrunners in human remodeling and heroes of collective innovation true to the general line of our Party. Kim Jong Un mentioned the main spirit that permeates our Party's line of the three revolutions and great significance and immortal vitality of the three revolutions and gave a classic formulation that the accomplishment of the three revolutions in every field, unit and region precisely means the comprehensive development of socialism and the emergence of a powerful socialist country which has achieved prosperity by dint of self-reliance and self-respect and a utopian society of the people. He also clarified the tasks for carrying out the three revolutions throughout society and detailed practical methods. He said that the participants in the conference should steadily add luster to the honor of being frontrunners in the struggle for putting the three-revolution red flag movement and the three-revolution team movement, which are noble revolutionary heritages bequeathed down by the great leaders President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and powerful engines of socialist construction, on a new level, and expressed belief that all the officials, Party members and other working people would certainly bring about the comprehensive prosperity of our style socialism by kindling fierce flames of the three revolutions. Ri Il Hwan, member of the Political Bureau and secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, made a report. He said that the three-revolution red flag movement and the three-revolution team movement are the mass movement of the highest form and a powerful revolutionary mode of our era to which the original idea of the WPK on the mass movement is thoroughly applied and whose validity and vitality have been fully displayed in the historical course of the revolution and construction. He referred to the immortal guidance exploits of the peerlessly great men who had led socialist construction along the road of one victory after another while regarding the three-revolution red flag movement and the three-revolution team movement as the powerful weapon of carrying out the three revolutions, the general line of our Party. The reporter said that for the first time in history, Kim Il Sung advanced the idea that the revolution should be carried on in the ideological, technical and cultural fields even after the establishment of socialist system, put forward the three revolutions as a strategic line for socialist construction, and made every effort to develop the three-revolution red flag movement and the three-revolution team movement. The reporter referred to the fact that Kim Jong Il clarified the idea that the struggle to implement the three-revolution line is a historic struggle for rapidly transforming the appearance of the country in all spheres and stepping into communism ahead of others and that he made a lot of effort to develop the three-revolution red flag movement and the three-revolution team movement. The reporter stressed that the undying revolutionary feats performed by the President and the Chairman in developing the above-said movements are being successfully carried forward and developed by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. Our revolutionary ranks have turned into elite ranks by loyal persons firmly equipped with the Party's ideas and lines, a new era of self-reliance and prosperity, an era of our state-first principle, came into being on this land, and precious and significant successes have been made for the prosperity and development of the country, all of which are the precious fruition of the energetic leadership of the respected General Secretary who has made big efforts to implement the three-revolution line. The reporter referred to the achievements made after the Fourth Conference of the Forerunners of the Three-revolution Red Flag Movement and the national meeting of active three-revolution team members. He said that as a result of the vigorous ideological revolution through the three-revolution red flag movement, the ideological and political might, the first motive power of our revolution, has been rapidly increased and the ranks of staunch revolutionaries boundlessly loyal to the leader have been grown and expanded. Technical revolution made headway in the course of the three-revolution red flag movement, thereby putting the scientific and technical power of the country on a higher level and consolidating the self-sustaining foundation of the national economy, the reporter said. He also noted the development made in the range of cultural life of our people and the construction of socialist civilization. He said that sci-tech learning spaces have been built across the country as part of the efforts for making all the people well versed in science and technology, and the broad masses of people have come to learn intently, being enrolled in the study-while-working education system, which has been led to a production of many three-revolution standard-bearers possessed of modern science and technology. The report also deals with some faults witnessed in the three-revolution red flag movement and the three-revolution team work against the intention of the Party and requirements of the developing revolution as well as their causes. A key to building one's own driving force in every way and successfully tiding over the present difficulties lies in turning the three-revolution red flag movement and the three-revolution team work into powerful mass movements propelling socialist construction and a substantial power propelling the development of relevant units, the reporter said, calling for bringing about a fundamental turn in the three-revolution red flag movement and the three-revolution team work with the on-going conference as an occasion. The reporter underscored the need to decisively improve the Party guidance and the administrative and technical guidance over the three-revolution red flag movement and three-revolution team work. Saying that when the whole country is seethed with the three revolutions, eye-opening changes will be brought about in the overall socialist construction and our cause rapidly propelled, he called for materializing at an early date the far-reaching aspiration and ideal of our Party to bring earlier the V-day of socialism and communism by bringing about a great change in the three-revolution red flag movement and the three-revolution team work. Speeches were made at the conference. The conference continues amid the sincere and strong enthusiasm of the participants. Rodong Sinmun

title: Our Party’s Noble View on Rising Generation
body: His Limitless Love and Passion In January, Juche 106(2017), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un inspected the Pyongyang Bag Factory for his first field guidance of the year. Following is the meaningful instruction he gave then. From of old, it has been told that even a single offspring takes all sorts of trouble to bring up. However, the Workers’ Party of Korea have millions of sons and daughters. In other words, our Party is blessed with a lot of children. However much effort it may take me to bring them up, I regard it as happiness, not trouble. It is our respected General Secretary who arranged a camping tour for schoolchildren from the country’s northern part hit by unexpected natural disasters lest their faces should become shadowed with sorrow. He visited Okryu Children’s Hospital under construction even on a rainy day to provide a modern hospital for children. It is none other than him who inspected the production site of schoolbags and school things and made an earnest request that motherly sincerity had to be devoted to every single product. He once told that he would be quite satisfied even if he served as a grain of sand on the road to be trodden by the rising generation if it was to build ours into a powerful socialist country true to the intentions of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. Thanks to such a great father, the coming generation of our revolution is growing up healthily to be future pillars of socialist Korea. Our Party blessed with a lot of children! The respected General Secretary regards it as a blessing the devotion he makes for tens of millions of children in our country. For Future Generations! In November six years ago when the respected General Secretary visited the splendidly-remodeled Mangyongdae Schoolchildren’s Palace, he said that it is the view on the rising generation and the revolution to be possessed by us, revolutionaries, to love and bring up future generations. Children constitute the force that promotes the country’s present and brings earlier its future; this is the great love for future generations kept precious in our General Secretary’s heart. Also reflective of his such noble love are Pyongyang Baby Home and Orphanage, Samjiyon Schoolchildren’s Palace at the foot of Mt Paektu, Songdowon International Children’s Camp and Children’s Camp in Pyongyang City for Climbing Mt Myohyang. Indeed, his noble view on the coming generation serves as a textbook that teaches us the purpose of building a powerful country, the source of power that enables us to stand strong in the face of hardship and how to bring earlier victory of revolution. Be Future Pillars of Prosperous Country The respected General Secretary always sees to it that only the best things in the world are provided for our children. That is not only because he wants the children to be enjoyers of happiness but also to train them sound and strong to be reliable pillars of the prosperous country in the future. In his speech at the joint national meeting of the Korean Children’s Union organizations held in celebration of its 66th founding anniversary, he said that the prosperous DPRK in the future whose masters are the KCU members will be the strongest one in the world where every family is full of happy laughter and everyone lives in harmony. With this noble intention, he pays the greatest attention to upbringing of children. His will to train the children to be successors to our revolution and future pillars is permeated into books for intellectual education of children he repeatedly guided for the education and edification of orphans at orphanages and baby homes, and Pyongyang Secondary School for Orphans which he highly appreciated to have been built to be helpful to the mental, moral and physical development of orphans. The respected General Secretary says that his love for children is, after all, an inheritance of the view on the rising generation of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and that we have to value and love the rising generation and train them to be reliable heirs to the revolution in order to carry forward and accomplish the revolutionary cause of Juche generation after generation. Endlessly rosy is the future of our country with a great father who works heart and soul to add beauty to the country’s future. Rodong Sinmun

title: Request Made out of Love
body: One day in Juche 103(2014) the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited Pyongyang Baby Home and Orphanage. He was so pleased that he looked several times at the buildings. To his satisfaction, a dear home for our children had been provided. Saying he felt as if he had plucked a star from the sky the respected General Secretary headed towards the dining room of the Baby Home. One official of the baby home displayed the assorted kitchen utensils to be used by the children. Holding a melamine resin plate in his hand the respected General Secretary carefully looked at it and said it was also an education for children from their childhood to be served rice in these good quality bowls. He said in the parental voice that they should teach our children how to use their spoons and chopsticks correctly. He noted there could be seen in a film some people holding spoons and chopsticks in one hand while they were having a meal but we must prevent our children from learning after them. He earnestly instructed that the children should be taught in a correct way from childhood noting that to make them preserve morality while taking a meal also belongs to the domain of family education. The request made on that significant day served as the manifestation of affection and parental love of the respected General Secretary bestowed on our children. Rodong Sinmun

title: Educational Conditions and Environment Improved in DPRK
body: The work for improving educational conditions and environment like the building of model schools is vigorously carried out in the DPRK. Pyongyang City takes the lead in it. Over 18 000 pieces of information equipment of 78 varieties and a large amount of materials, fund and school fixtures have been sent to the schools in the city. Achievements include renovating several kindergartens, building and rebuilding 19 schools as models and making 500 classrooms multi-functional ones as planned for this year. North Hwanghae Province built and reconstructed 8 schools as model ones as of September and has pushed ahead with the erection of Sariwon Teacher Training College. Nampho City finished the construction of Nampho Teacher Training College by October this year, built and upgraded 6 schools as model ones and made over 270 classrooms multi-functional as planned for this year. Other regions vigorously organized and conducted the work for improving the educational conditions and environment and the work for aiding educational field. Rodong Sinmun

title: High-yielding Units and Bumper Sericulturists Produced in Field of Sericulture
body: Amid the vigorous struggle for producing more cocoons this year, high-yielding units and bumper sericulturists have been produced in the field of sericulture. More than 50 workteams and sub-workteams under the Sericulture and Silk Industrial Bureau became high-yielding units for producing 500 kilograms of cocoons per hectare of mulberry field. And 900 bumper sericulturists emerged out of whom over 30 have produced more than one ton at the maximum. Especially, officials and workers in Songha Cocoon Co-op Farm in Songgan County of Jagang Province have had the honor of being a high-yielding farm by waging a strenuous struggle. In the province, high-yielding units which have produced over 500 kg of cocoons per hectare number over 20. And bumper sericulturists total above 60 and several of them have produced above one ton. Rodong Sinmun

title: KCNA Issues Detailed Report on Fighting Spirit and Traits of Three-Revolution Frontrunners in 1970s
body: The Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) Wednesday made public a detailed report on the fighting spirit and traits of the three-revolution frontrunners in the 1970s who pushed forward with the ideological, technical and cultural revolutions. The detailed report said that the 1970s, which our people entered after successfully accomplishing the historic cause of socialist industrialization at the speed of Chollima, was exciting years when the mass movement of the highest form of our era started with the idea and line of the Workers' Party of Korea of three revolutions and under its wise leadership, and when the validity and inexhaustible vitality of the mass movement was fully displayed. President Kim Il Sung initiated the three-revolution team movement in keeping with the requirements of the developing revolution according to which the modeling of the whole society on the Juche idea became a priority, and made sure at the enlarged meeting of the Political Committee of the Party Central Committee held in February Juche 62 (1973) that three-revolution teams that consist of core party members and young intellectuals prepared politically and practically were organized and sent to industrial and agricultural sectors. And he set out a plan to launch the Three-revolution Red Flag Movement. True to the high intention of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il let the Komdok Mine and the Chongsan Co-op Farm raise the first torch of the three-revolution red flag movement in November Juche 64 (1975) and wisely led them so that the flame of this movement rapidly spread throughout the country. Under the energetic leadership of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il the whole country became alive with the three-revolution red flag movement and the three-revolution team movement, and excellent examples were set in implementing the line of the three revolutions in the 1970s. The detailed report said that there were three-revolution team members who vigorously encouraged the popular mass to the implementation of Party's policies by injecting vitality into the unity and fighting efficiency of groups at the worksites across the country in the 1970s. The work for instilling into all the people the revolutionary idea of the Party was carried out in a unique manner. The revolutionary traits were established such that everybody deeply studied the immortal classic works of President Kim Il Sung in a comprehensive and systematic way with "The Room for the Study of the Revolutionary Ideas of Comrade Kim Il Sung" as a base and studied more than 2 hours a day. As required by such atmosphere of the times the three-revolution teams gave momentum to the enthusiasm for studying with various forms and methods like a question-and-answer study, lectures, explanatory statements and dissemination of songs at units under their charge. In particular, the question-and-answer study method which was created by President Kim Il Sung during the anti-Japanese armed struggle displayed great vitality in raising the political awareness of working people. The activities conducted by the three-revolution teams by applying the anti-Japanese guerrilla agitation work method in all fields also brought about a fundamental change in agitation and information work. Amid the fierce flame of ideological revolution, lots of ranks of loyalists, typically "Phibada" guards and "The flower girl" guards, were formed and became active in different parts of the country, and the mass movement guaranteeing the thorough-going implementation of the decisions of the Party Congress stirred up the whole country in the period when the six-year plan was carried out. The 1970s saw the production of a number of three-revolution front-rankers who defended the Party policies through the great surge in the self-reliance amid the high flame of technical revolution, the detailed report stressed, adding: It was thanks to the struggle waged by three-revolution standard-bearers that in just two years since the 5th Congress of the Party, the numbers of Chollima workteam, Chollima factory and Chollima co-op farms increased across the country. That of Chollima workteam became over 70 000 while that of Chollima factory and Chollima co-op farms became more than 410 across the country. It was amid the high-pitched drive waged by the three-revolution front-rankers who advanced forward by letting one person arouse a ten, by letting the ten arouse a hundred and by letting the hundred arouse a thousand in all the work sites that the six-year national economic plan set forth by the 5th Congress of the Party was fulfilled a year and four months earlier than planned and in the period between 1970 to 1979 the industrial output of the country showed annual growth of 15.9% and the total industrial output increased 3.8 times. The detailed report pointed out that socialist culture made rapid development and three-revolution front-rankers were always in the van in the 1970s when the slogan "Let us meet the requirements of Juche in ideology, technology and culture!" became guidelines of work and life for all the people of the country. Under the energetic leadership of Chairman Kim Jong Il, true literary and art soldiers of our Party took the lead in the cultural revolution and therefore brought about renaissance in the 20th century. By thoroughly applying the speed campaign and the principle of collectivism, they created and completed revolutionary opera "Sea of Blood" in such a short period of just four months. They created revolutionary opera "The Flower Girl" in just over 120 days and the revolutionary operas "The Story of A Nurse", "Tell the Story, Forest" and "Song of Mt. Kumgang" in a little over two years, thus making the birth of five revolutionary operas known to the world. Amid the energetic creation traits displayed by creators and artistes who defended the Party with the creation of famous pieces, revolutionary poems and songs and excellent films and dramas were produced day after day, instilling immense vigor and vitality to the whole country. The increased production agitation activities waged by the artistes of the Phibada Opera Troupe and the Pyongyang Art Troupe in the land of Kangson were an epitome of the revolutionary culture that could be seen in sites for effecting great upswing at that time. Amid the flame of the anti-Japanese information and agitation drive, economic agitation drive was waged at the grand construction sites across the country. The new culture of the working class came into existence, adding vitality to the whole country. Miners of Komdok who first raised the torch of the three-revolution red flag movement took the lead in establishing the cultured way of production and life. Workers from different parts of the country took an active part in the national art group festival of workers, fully showing the new ground of mass-based culture and art and the high cultural attainments of the working class. There were numberless three-revolution front-rankers who devoted their pure conscience to the worthwhile struggle for glorifying the socialist education system. In the first year for the implementation of the six-year plan, scores of merited teachers were produced, and the number of exemplary education counties increased year after year, notably Ryonggang County, Kyongsong County, Mundok County and Phyonggang County, thus demonstrating the advantages of socialist system that has turned into the country of learning, the country of education. The decision of the 5th Congress of the Party on bringing up a large contingent of more than one million intellectuals was brilliantly carried out and our country came to have a large contingent of technicians and experts. Amid the all-people study enthusiasm, more than 523 000 technicians and experts were trained in the period between 1971 and 1975 and this increased the ranks over two times and therefore the number of technicians and experts reached 19.2% in 1976 out of the total number of employees in the national economic fields. The three-revolution front-rankers in the 1970s brilliantly implemented the decisions of the 5th Congress of the Party with shining achievements in the struggle to carry out the ideological, technical and cultural revolutions and then started implementing the second seven-year national economic plan advanced by the DPRK government, thus greeting the 6th Congress of the Party with heroic exploits. The detailed report stressed that it is the fixed will of our people to carry forward the fighting spirit and creation traits displayed by the three revolution front-rankers in the 1970s and glorify the era of our state-first principle, the new era of a powerful and prosperous country, by dint of the single-minded unity of loyalty and with the strong might of self-reliance in hearty response to the idea and leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Ploughing in Full Swing across DPRK
body: The autumn ploughing is going on at full speed in rural communities of the country. Thanks to the devoted struggle of agricultural officials and workers, the autumn ploughing has been carried out at 50 or 75 percent across the country. Officials of the Ministry of Agriculture and provincial rural economy committees mapped out detailed plans for preparations for next year's farming like autumn ploughing and scrupulously carry out the organization and control, while speeding up the threshing to finish this year's farming. Autumn ploughing has been finished in some areas. High results have been witnessed in autumn ploughing across the country, amid deep attention being paid to meeting the technical regulations in ploughing. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Letter to Participants in Fifth Conference of Frontrunners in Three Revolutions
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un sent a letter "Let Us Achieve a Comprehensive Development of Socialism by Kindling the Fierce Flames of the Three Revolutions" to those attending the Fifth Conference of the Frontrunners in the Three Revolutions on November 18. The full text of the letter is as follows: The Fifth Conference of the Frontrunners in the Three Revolutions has opened in grand style when precious successes that testify to the vigorous advance of our revolution are being achieved thanks to the heroic struggle of all our people, who are carrying out the far-reaching programmes of the Workers' Party of Korea wholeheartedly. In the face of severe trials of history, our people's faith has become firmer, the strength of our state has become more powerful, and an era of great change has arrived in front of us. On the basis of analysis and appraisal of the struggle tasks of the present stage we have reached in socialist construction and of its next stage, the preparedness of our revolutionary forces and the prevailing internal and external situations, our Party has confirmed once again that the road to achieving the sure victory of our style of socialism is to bring about a fundamental change in all the realms of ideology, technology and culture by holding higher the banner of the three revolutions. Proceeding from this, the Party Central Committee reached a decision on convening the Fifth Conference of the Frontrunners in the Three Revolutions as an important occasion for understanding and confirming once again the strategic position and great significance of the line of the three revolutions consistently maintained in our socialist and communist construction and for kindling the fierce flames of the three revolutions across the country. This conference will prove to be a decisive occasion in turning the Three-Revolution Red Flag Movement and the Three-Revolution Team Movement into a powerful propellant for the ideological, technological and cultural revolutions, and set up a new milestone in achieving a comprehensive development of our style of socialism. Availing myself of this opportunity, I, in the name of the Party Central Committee and the government of the Republic, extend warm gratitude and militant greetings to the participants in the conference, who have made great contributions to carrying out the three revolutions as frontrunners in remoulding other people and as masters of collective innovation true to the general line of our Party, and to other Order of the Three-Revolution Red Flag laureates and three-revolution team members across the country. When our Party is going to lead with vigour the comprehensive development of socialism by flying higher the three red flags, the number of frontrunners in the three revolutions, who are creating new criteria and standards and setting personal examples in the vanguard of the times, is increasing. This is a source of great strength that makes us convinced of the victory of our cause. The line of the three revolutions is a programme for socialist and communist construction and the general line of our Party invariable even today as it was yesterday. The whole course of our state building was a history of the three revolutions, and we must achieve the final victory of socialism and greet the communist society on the road of carrying out the line of these revolutions. Three revolutions-ideological, technological and cultural, coined for the first time in history by the great Comrade Kim Il Sung, are famous words that explain in a concentrated way the idea and spirit and the principles and contents which must be regarded as invariable guidelines in the whole course of socialist and communist construction, as well as the ways for implementing them. The spirit that runs through the line of the three revolutions is the thoroughgoing spirit of independence, of implementing the revolution of one's country by one's own efforts. The main thing here is that one's own revolutionary forces should be strengthened in every way possible. In the historical course of building socialism and communism, the tasks and subjective and objective conditions at each revolutionary stage change constantly, but the revolutionary strategy, whose core is one's own efforts, cannot change. In implementing the socialist cause we must follow an untrodden path and brave unpredictable challenges and difficulties; in this course, we must cultivate our own efforts, which we can firmly believe in and rely on at all times. Herein lie the great significance and undying viability of the three revolutions. The great transformations made by Juche Korea, which fundamentally remoulded man, nature and society in such a shortest historical period, are ones, from A to Z, achieved by dint of the three revolutions; and all the miracles wrought by our state striking the world people with wonder are a victory of the line of these revolutions. Had we not held the banner of the three revolutions in the first days of building a new country, we could not have witnessed the birth of a heroic people, who are carving out their destiny by their own efforts, and the epochal development of our Republic, which has emerged as a powerful country from ashes, and the existence of socialist Korea that remain unperturbed in worldwide political turmoils and unprecedented challenges would have been unimaginable. It is a source of great dignity and pride for our Party and state to have such a struggle programme as the line of the three revolutions, which conforms to the law-governed nature of socialist and communist construction and to our people's revolutionary aspirations and whose truthfulness, advantages and invincible might have been fully verified from one century and generation into the next. We must carry forward this line for ever in its pure form, and apply it fully. Our Party, by accelerating the comprehensive development of socialism, intends to build in the near future a powerful socialist country that prospers by dint of self-sufficiency and self-dependence. The period of comprehensive development of socialism is a historic watershed our Party and people have reached through their protracted struggle for applying the line of the three revolutions, as well as a new era of development which will be achieved by dint of the three revolutions of a higher stage. The line of building a country that is independent, self-supporting and self-reliant in defence, which the government of our Republic set forth at the beginning of its state administration aspires after simultaneous development of the political, economic, cultural, defence and all other fields, and in order to achieve this, our Party and people have waged an arduous and yet unyielding struggle upholding the banner of the three revolutions. In this historic course of struggle, the political and military forces of the Republic have grown remarkably, and at last we have greeted a turning phase, in which we are definitely putting all the realms of socialist construction on the track of new change and innovation, growth and development. Now that decisive factors and fundamental conditions for staunchly defending and vigorously promoting socialism have been created, building a developed, prosperous and powerful socialist country is not an ideal of distant future but a realistic target. The great transition to a powerful socialist country is the process of making all the members of society revolutionary, developing the technological and economic might on the highest level and civilizing the whole society. In building such a country we are faced with various crucial tasks including improving the refinement and personality of the people as required by the our-state-first era, making the national economy switch over to an overall development, changing the agricultural production structure and establishing a new cultural lifestyle of our own. These tasks presuppose change, development and civilization of all the fields, all the sectors and all the people and require a general onward march of the three revolutions involving the entire Party, the whole country and all the people. The comprehensive development of socialism of our own style is, in essence, a new revolution in the three realms of ideology, technology and culture. Only when we attain the goals of the three revolutions-uniting all the people by means of the Party's ideas, laying scientific and technological foundations that can guarantee the self-supporting and sustainable development of the economy, making all the people talented persons and liquidating every manner of cultural backwardness-can we raise the progressiveness and modernity of our state onto a new high. In flying the three red flags more highly lies the shortcut to realizing our Party's ideals and meeting the demands of our revolution concerning the comprehensive development of socialism. To dynamically promote the simultaneous and balanced development of all the fields of state and social life and all the regions of the country with the three revolutions as a driving force-this is the main spirit of the current conference. "Let us transform all our revolutionary positions in line with the demands of the three revolutions!"-we should uphold this slogan. If all sectors, all units and all regions are transformed as required by the three revolutions, it precisely means the comprehensive development of socialism we intend to achieve and the powerful socialist country, people's ideal society, which prospers by dint of self-sufficiency and self-dependence. In order to transform the whole society as required by the three revolutions, we need to give fresh impetus to the Three-Revolution Red Flag Movement and the Three-Revolution Team Movement. No driving force is more powerful than the Three-Revolution Red Flag Movement and the Three-Revolution Team Movement in accelerating the ideological, technological and cultural revolutions, whose validity and viability have been proved through the practice of our socialist construction. The Party has already clarified comprehensively and in detail the character and mission of these movements and the principles, demands and methods to be adhered to in waging them. What is important is how to apply them in line with the developing times and prevailing conditions. On the basis of an understanding and analysis of the prevailing situation of the movements, the Party Central Committee has worked out a policy for injecting a fresh life into them. First of all, we should expand and intensify the Three-Revolution Red Flag Movement in keeping with the demands of the developing revolution. Proceeding from the requirements of the times to vigorously accelerate the three revolutions on a new high, our Party has decided to expand the movement onto a wider scope involving cities, counties and industrial complexes, not confining it merely to organs, enterprises, factories, cooperative farms, workshops and workteams as is now, and thereby to make it an all-society and all-people movement both in name and in reality. To expand it to cities, counties and industrial complexes is right in the light of the character of the movement as a mass movement of the highest form, of the inevitable demands of the struggle for victoriously accomplishing the socialist cause by dint of single-minded unity of all people and of the tasks of the revolution at the current stage. When he kindled the torch of the Three-Revolution Red Flag Movement in the 1970s, General Kim Jong Il already put forward the wise policy of conducting the movement with city, county and industrial complex as a unit as it would develop in depth in the future. Since cities and counties are local bases of socialist construction in our country, they should naturally serve as the strongholds of the three revolutions. It is a law-governed nature that the Three-Revolution Red Flag Movement is launched with city and county as a unit as socialist construction makes in-depth progress. The movement, which will be conducted with city and county as a unit, presupposes a responsible attitude of Party organizations and officials at all levels including city and county Party committees as well as the participation of all the population; and it is an incomparably powerful mode in making the whole country pulsate with the three revolutions. Attaching great importance to cities and counties as the basic units in organizing and executing the implementation of its policies in a direct, coordinated and comprehensive way, our Party is strongly pushing ahead with the policy of facilitating prosperity of our state through their development. Implementation of Party policy and the three revolutions are not separated from each other. All our Party policies fall within the three realms of ideology, technology and culture in terms of their inclusive range and contents, and the cities and counties are responsible for carrying out many of the policy-oriented tasks. To say nothing of the tasks of modernizing local industrial factories, making a smart facelift of rural villages and renovating schools and hospitals, the major policies put forward by the Party-like the ones of housing construction, landscaping and conservation of mountains and rivers-consist in the tasks of the three revolutions which are to be done with such regions as city and county as a unit; and their success will be guaranteed only when the principle of carrying out the technical and cultural revolutions simultaneously while giving precedence to the ideological revolution is maintained without any deviation. Even under the prevailing condition that is worse than ever before, some cities and counties are distinguishing themselves in all aspects as nicely as to be admired by all others in the country. They are, without exception, under the control of chief Party officials who are turning the implementation of Party policies into the process of carrying out the three revolutions, well aware of the merits of the Three-Revolution Red Flag Movement. If the 200 and over cities and counties across the country rise up forcefully under the banner of the three revolutions, a new phase will unfold in which local regions change, and our rural communities turn, in the near future, into rich and cultured socialist ones equipped with modern technology and civilization. The time of comprehensive development of socialist construction will begin with the facelift of local regions and the striking contrast of the rural communities between their past and present, and this will surely provide a demonstration of the advantages and true image of the socialism of our own style. Holding fast to the Three-Revolution Red Flag Movement as a powerful weapon for building up cities and counties, city and county Party committees should orientate all their work to the movement, and their work should naturally be reviewed and appraised with the stress put on examining how they have conducted the movement. The Three-Revolution Red Flag Movement should begin with launching a political campaign to encourage all the people to adopt the three revolutions as something for their own interests. What the Party Central Committee put great confidence in while planning to expand the movement to the scale of cities and counties was the voluntary and proactive turnout of the masses who are conscious of their demands and interests. If the broad masses of the people learn that the three revolutions are just aimed at transforming themselves into more faithful and cultured humans and making a wonderful place of the land where they live and their coming generations will live, they will rise and exert formidable strength. While informing all people, ranging from city and county officials down to the rank-and-file farmers, of the intention of the Party Central Committee so that they join the movement for themselves, it is necessary to give constant precedence to their spiritual and cultural enlightenment. In drawing up a long-term plan and design for the development of their respective regions and organizing an artistic performance and a sports or cultural event, they should improve their political and cultural quality and level so as to make them serve as occasions for enlightening people and teaching them advanced culture. The consciousness of our people has been remarkably transformed.
