Looking round various places of the factory, he gave them detailed instructions on issues of producing diversified and multi-colored convenient bags suited to children’s interest, taste and age and setting right size of them in keeping with physical characters and the way of improving quality of key of bags. Like this, his love for our children was endless. That day, he noted that from olden times, much efforts had been paid to bringing up one child, but we had millions of children, adding that he regarded it as happiness, not hardship. Indeed, our children are blessed fortunates. The accompanying officials could be convinced that the singing "We Are the Happiest in the World" with hurrah for the Workers’ Party of Korea would resound far and wide across the country forever under the warm care of the respected General Secretary for our children. Rodong Sinmun

title: Caring for Development of Local Specialties
body: In April, Juche 108(2019), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un taught how to cook boiled rice with clams from the East Sea of Korea. That day, he personally named the dish and made sure it became a specialty of Kangwon Province. Here are other stories about his efforts to develop local specialties. In July several years ago, the respected General Secretary told officials it was important to make nice local specialties in developing traditional dishes. He taught that such specialties had to be made with marine products in seaside regions and with wild vegetables like brackens or ferns in mountainous areas and that, in seaside regions alone, laver dishes had to be made in laver-producing places and pickled dishes in shrimp- or anchovy-producing places. One August day, he instructed to do full justice to the peculiar flavor of green gram jelly and, one spring day, said earnestly that officials as well as experts had to be well versed in culinary culture in order that provinces might properly invent and develop special dishes of their own. Blessed with such loving care of the respected General Secretary, we are heading towards a brighter future full of joy and optimism. Rodong Sinmun

title: Movement for Winning Title of Forest of Socialist Patriotism Brisk in DPRK
body: Amid a dynamic mass-based campaign for land management, the number of units which won the title of Forest of Socialist Patriotism increases day after day in the DPRK. The movement for winning the Title of Forest of Socialist Patriotism is a new-type mass movement which the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un initiated to inspire all the people into a drive for afforestation. The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un, with a firm determination and will to turn all the mountains of the country into thick woodlands, visited the Central Tree Nursery of the Ministry of Land and Environment Protection in November, Juche 103 (2014) to give instructions to dynamically wage a movement for winning the Title of Forest of Socialist Patriotism and a movement for winning the Title of Model County in Afforestation across the country. True to his instructions, a mass campaign has been vigorously waged to turn all the mountains of the country into thick woodlands. Officials of each area took the lead in the campaign for afforestation after setting up a long-term goal and stepwise plan for forest restoration, thus achieving great successes. A work for growing and planting saplings in a sci-tech way is briskly waged among working people and there is also active emulation among units. More than 400 units have won the title of Forest of Socialist Patriotism this year alone. Rodong Sinmun

title: Successes Made in River Improvement in DPRK
body: Successes have been made through a dynamic mass campaign for river and stream improvement across the country. Thanks to the efforts made by officials and working people, over 28 million cubic meters of river-beds were dredged and over 94 million cubic meters of earth and over 32 million square meters of stones laid to reinforce embankments this year. In Hyangsan County, North Phyongan Province in particular, a river improvement project planned to be completed in the period of the general mobilization for land administration was finished in the first half of this year and an additional plan of dredging over 10 thousand cubic meters of river-beds fulfilled by early November. Similar campaign is being pushed ahead with as planned in other provinces, cities and counties. Rodong Sinmun

title: Meetings of Young Activists in Displaying Noble Traits Held
body: Meetings of young activists in displaying noble traits were held by North Phyongan Province, North Hwanghae Province, South Hwanghae Province, and youth league committees of the Capital City Construction Commission and the High-Speed Youth Shock Brigade Management Bureau. The meetings were attended by officials of the Party and power organs, youth league officials, activists in displaying noble traits and other young people in the provinces and relevant units. It was mentioned at the meetings that the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un who is glorifying the idea of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il of attaching importance to youth led the young people to be creators of miracles and feats who display beautiful virtues and noble traits in the struggle for winning fresh victory in socialist construction. The meetings said that beautiful traits displayed among young people include the display of the spirit of devotedly safeguarding the Party Central Committee, actively advancing to difficult and labor-consuming fields and devoting themselves to society, collectives and comrades. Young people get married to honored disabled soldiers, look after war veterans as their kinsmen would do and volunteer to revolutionary battle sites in Mt Paektu area and posts on forefront island and devote their wisdom and enthusiasm, the meetings said, adding: This is an expression of a beautiful view on life of finding the honor and worth of youth in the road for the Party and the revolution. Pledges to create miracles and become heroes on the major fronts for accomplishing the new five-year plan were expressed at the meetings. Rodong Sinmun

title: A Centenarian Regains Her Sight
body: A few days ago we visited a centenarian in Tongdaewon District. As we arrived, we saw her reading Party Paper Rodong Sinmun in the room. When we asked her if the letters were clear to her she nodded at us. In fact, she had poor sight before. Her children sent her to the Ryugyong General Ophthalmic Hospital to have an operation. Her life in hospital enabled not only the centenarian herself but also her whole family to keenly feel the gratitude to our socialist system. Doctors and nurses there had provided her with a particularly ordered eye patch and gave her pleasure by carrying pharmaceuticals good for recuperation and foodstuffs. The centenarian showed us several photos. In the photos she was with her children and grandchildren when she received the benevolent birthday spread in April. The happiness of the whole family reflected in the photos was, indeed, not merely brought by the passage of the time. It is attributable to our great Party and socialist society constantly implementing the popular policies in spite of all trials and difficulties. Rodong Sinmun

title: His Lecture Continues
body: On November 26, Juche 102(2013), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited Pyongyang University of Architecture. After making rounds of several places in the university, he dropped in at its fine arts rehearsal room. Then and there, students were absorbed in their drawings. Looking at them, the future promising architects, with an air of satisfaction, he asked how many minutes it took them to make a sketch. One of the students answered him that it took them about five minutes. The respected General Secretary allowed them ten minutes for a sketch. Ten minutes later, he viewed the sketches made by three of the students which were still incomplete and pointed out their merits and defects one by one. Then he advised them in a friendly way that they had to do justice to the features unique to the object person in making a figure sketch and that correctly deducing one of the person’s features and vividly describing it would be just enough to frame the sketch. After all, the respected General Secretary gave a lucid explanation of the practical requirements and ways of the fine arts on viewing only a few drawings. His precious teachings were equivalent to a special lecture that made students and officials realize the profoundness of architecture, an incorporation of social development and all modern intelligence, creative thinking and ability, and the level of abilities they must be possessed of to master architecture. His meaningful lecture that day still continues along with the monumental edifices mushrooming in our country. Rodong Sinmun

title: It Has to Be Judged by People
body: One August day in Juche 107(2018), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un inspected the Songsan Tram Station despite extreme heat of the sultry summer. He got on the newly-made tram and said satisfactorily that its interior was trim and flawless. Presently, he suggested trying it out that evening to the accompanying officials. Hence, the new tram’s trial run in the presence of the respected General Secretary that night. On the tram, he taught that it had to be made sure that its chairs didn’t give passengers a chill when they sat in winter and gave other detailed instructions for people’s convenience’s sake. And then he emphasized that the new tram had to be judged by the people, not by him. This precious teaching taught the officials that to be good or bad has to be decided by the people and the result of everything hinges upon their estimation. Rodong Sinmun

title: Emergency Epidemic Prevention Work Is Further Intensified
body: A new COVID-19 variant virus which is five times stronger than delta virus appeared in the world, arousing serious concerns. To cope with the rapid spread of the new variant worldwide the central emergency epidemic prevention unit is putting all efforts to thoroughly ensuring the perfect state emergency epidemic prevention system by putting officials and working people on a high alert and making them steadily maintain the voluntary uniformity in action and dedication. Officials keep giving further momentum to the mass epidemic prevention campaign to take measures against any porosity and faults that may lead to the inroads of the dangerous and fatal virus to their fields and units. With the epidemic prevention work becoming prolonged and with new variant viruses of stronger infectivity and spreading power emerging one after another, ideological education and health information service are being conducted through mass media to arouse awareness about epidemic crisis among people and make them observe epidemic rules and orders. The public health field, with the approach of winter season, makes sure the people take care of their health in a responsible way, and takes measures to find out patients with chronic diseases and treat them. Institutions, industrial establishments and farms make all people adopt it as part of their life and habit to measure temperature, disinfect their hands, wear masks and voluntarily take part in disinfecting buildings, facilities, utensils and tools, etc. In public places, the epidemic prevention rules including distancing are strictly observed. All inhabitants have accepted it as an essential demand to prevent emergence and spread of various kinds of infectious diseases by keeping streets, villages and houses clean and boiling water to drink. Rodong Sinmun

title: Kumgang-san Opera Troupe of Chongryon Makes Performance Tour This Year
body: The Kumgang-san Opera Troupe of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) famous as the prestigious overseas compatriots' art organization has made active tour performance of different parts of Japan this year. The performance tour made by the troupe with loyalty to uphold President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il as the eternal sun of the nation and go along the way of patriotism following the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un inspired patriotism in the hearts of Korean compatriots and made the spirit of preserving national identity sweep across Japan once again. The Kumgang-san Opera Troupe actively carried out creative performing activities from early this year with the zeal to thoroughly apply the spirit of new advance and leaping progress prevalent in the homeland to their performing activities. A special performance "Vernal Fragrance" given in Tokyo before full houses infused the national fragrance and emotion and vitality and vigor into the Korean community and won great admiration from the Korean compatriots. The troupe conducted small-size performance activities as COVID-19 created many obstacles and difficulties. The performances given in various parts of Japan including Tokyo, Hyogo and Kanagawa prefectures amid great applauses by compatriots totaled over 20 in 12 places. The performers showed patriotism of Chongryon officials and other Koreans keeping to the path of invariable loyalty for Kim Jong Un while glorifying the revolutionary idea and undying feats of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il for all ages. The performances also showed well the strong spirit and optimism of Chongryon and Koreans propelling the patriotic movement with dignity and honor of being overseas members of the powerful country of Juche. Rodong Sinmun

title: Sinuiju Chicken Farm Remodeled
body: The Sinuiju Chicken Farm was successfully remodeled. Officials of North Phyongan Province worked out a detailed yearly plan to remodel poultry farms and have pushed ahead with the construction with precedence given to the provision of materials and equipment under the object of finishing the upgrading of the Sinuiju Chicken Farm in the first year of carrying out the decisions made at the Party Congress. Workers of the factory and builders established the industrial production process of feed additive and fermented feed based on locally available raw materials and built a Hermetia illucens breeding ground and substitute feed production base. They also built an integrated control room to automatically control the temperature, humidity, ventilation and feed supply for chicken corrals. They remodeled a hatchery, dozens of chicken and duck corrals and built a sci-tech learning space, a ground for producing organic compound fertilizer and others. There took place an inaugural ceremony of the farm on Sunday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Hundreds of Technical Innovations Introduced
body: Three-revolution team members of Ryanggang Province provide a scientific and technological guarantee for carrying out tasks for the first year of five-year plan. Three-revolution team members at the Hyesan Youth Mine and Wiyon Woodwork Factory contributed to consolidating the production base by fully introducing technical innovations in creative cooperation with field engineers and workers. At Chongbong Combined Foodstuff Factory, Taehongdan Potato-processing Factory and Hyesan Footwear Factory, the three-revolution team members made valuable technical innovations contributing to increase of the productive capacity and output of consumer goods. In the process they achieved hundreds of valuable successes in their technical innovations to strengthen the scientific and technical force and the foundation of improving the people’s living standard of the province. The three-revolution team members of the province are carrying out the tasks laid down in the letter sent to participants in the Fifth Conference of Frontrunners in Three Revolutions by the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Construction of Livestock Farming Base Gains Momentum
body: South Phyongan Province pushed forward the construction of ten stockbreeding bases in Nyongwon County and pens and annexes were built. Builders paid big efforts to completing the construction at an early date on a high qualitative level. They raised the tempo of construction by opening up the transport route and introducing rational transport method. For building the perfect structures even in the distant future, they collectively introduced great innovation giving top priority to ensuring the quality of building work. Meanwhile, officials of the province organized the socialist emulations in a substantial manner and made the provincial factories actively conduct the campaign which one overtakes and learns from others and swaps experiences with one another. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Floral Basket from President of Jindallae Children's Foundation
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a floral basket from Jindallae Saphariny, president of the Jindallae Children's Foundation, on Monday on the occasion of the 9th anniversary of the establishment of the foundation. Rodong Sinmun

title: "We Are under Your Unlimited Love"
body: The Samjiyon City People’s Hospital which was built as a standard regional hospital, has everything needed to diagnose and treat patients quickly and accurately. The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un said that competent medical workers must be prepared to use and run the modern medical appliances. True to his instruction, numbers of medical workers of the hospital had practical training at a central hospital and medical workers of central hospitals came to Samjiyon for improving their abilities. A lot of touching stories are heard at the Samjiyon City People’s Hospital erected thanks to the benevolent love of the respected General Secretary. In August, a child in a critical condition was carried to the pediatrics of the hospital. The medical workers of the hospital did their best to cure the child. They sat up all night with the patient for several days and strived to improve the patient’s nutritive conditions. The child’s parents were deeply moved to tears. At last a miracle happened. The patient was restored to health after ten-odd days. The parents extended their gratitude to the respected General Secretary and burst out the excitement as follows; "We are under your unlimited love." This is the voice of all the people in Samjiyon City. It conveys the warm love of our Party for the people and their ardent will to repay its love. Rodong Sinmun

title: Keeping in Mind His Love and Trust
body: In November a few years ago, the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited a factory. Having a bird’s eye view of the factory which was changed beyond recognition, he said satisfactorily that the factory was really excellent and its external appearance alone revealed a foodstuff factory. He toured various places of the factory to learn in detail about its modernization. He expressed great satisfaction at the fact that every production process of the factory was put on an automated, unmanned, germ-free and dust-free basis, true to the intention of the Party. The afforestation of the factory was admirable and its cultured ways in production and life has been established on a high level, he said, highly praising it as a model factory in the era of the Workers’ Party of Korea, a factory excellent both in interior and exterior. As a matter of fact, thanks to the benevolent care of the respected General Secretary, the factory could establish a perfect integrated control system over production and management activities, removed manual labor in all the processes while remarkably raising the productivity with less manpower and establish cultured ways in production and life on a high level. He also enjoyed the performance given by the art group of the factory. Saying that its every program dealt with the Party policies well and they were full of the workers’ ardent love for their factory, he highly praised its lofty ideological content combined with high artistic value. He added that it proved the revolutionary and militant nature of its workers who endeavor to become standard-bearers and shock brigade in carrying out the Party’s line and policies. Noting that he was pleased to see the modernized factory and he was more pleased to feel the ideological and moral qualities of its workers thoroughly armed with the Juche idea, he said that he got strong courage and energy while reading their mind to share their destiny with the Party and hardened his belief that he could cheerfully overcome any difficulties as there was the creditable working class. Thanks to his love and trust, our working class successfully discharges their honorable mission and tasks for the revolution and country as befits the advance force of the Juche revolution and “eldest sons” of the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Resolution of Political Bureau of WPK Central Committee Announced
body: The Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) announced a resolution on convening the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the WPK on December 1. According to the resolution, the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the WPK is to be convened in the last third of December to review the implementation of major Party and the state policies for 2021 and to discuss and decide on work plans for the new year. Rodong Sinmun

title: 5th Political Bureau Meeting of 8th C.C., WPK Held
body: The 5th Political Bureau Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) took place at the office building of the Party Central Committee on December 1. Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the WPK, was present at the meeting. Also at the meeting were members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK and members and alternate members of the Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee. The meeting discussed the issue of convening the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the WPK. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un presided over the meeting. General Secretary Kim Jong Un referred to the fact that the major policy targets decided at the 8th Party Congress have been pushed forward forcefully and militantly all the year round thanks to the correct guidance of the Party Central Committee though difficulties still lie in developing the country's economy. He said that it is very encouraging that the positive changes were made in the overall state affairs including politics, economy, culture, and national defence as evidenced by the stable management of the state economy and big successes made in the agricultural and construction sectors prioritized by our Party, adding that every field accumulated valuable experiences needed for the future development in this course. Saying that the successes registered by us show that the overall affairs that had been planned to lay a foundation for the economic development of the country and the improvement of people's living standard have been vigorously pushed forward and that they give self-confidence in a fresh victory of our own-style socialism, he noted that the appraisal of this year by the Party Central Committee is that it is the one of victory in general. Noting that next year will be an important one as we should wage a very giant struggle as much as we did this year, he said that the Party Central Committee should work out the plans for the new year well to be dynamic, onward, scientific and detailed, and consolidate the foundation for implementing the five-year plan. He gave assignments for the preparation of the plenary meeting. The Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK adopted a resolution on convening the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Party during the last third of December and discussed what to put on the agendas of the plenary meeting. Political News Team

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Floral Basket to General Secretary of C.C., LPRP
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a floral basket to Thongloun Sisoulith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party (LPRP) and president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic (LPDR), on the occasion of the 46th founding anniversary of the LPDR. The DPRK ambassador to Laos courteously conveyed the floral basket bearing the august name of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un to a vice-minister of Foreign Affairs of Laos. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Greetings to General Secretary of C.C., LPRP
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a message of greeting to Thongloun Sisoulith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party (LPRP) and president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic (LPDR), on Thursday. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un in the message extended warm congratulations to the general secretary and the fraternal party, government and people of Laos on the occasion of the 46th founding anniversary of the LPDR. The message noted that over the past 46 years after its foundation, the LPDR has conducted dynamic struggle to consolidate the people's democratic system and brought about great socio-economic changes under the guidance of the LPRP. The message expressed the firm belief that the party, government and people of Laos would achieve fresh progress in the building of a prosperous socialist state by implementing the decisions of the 11th Congress of the LPRP. It expressed conviction that the good friendly and cooperative relations between the two parties and the two countries would steadily grow stronger, and sincerely wished the general secretary of the LPRP bigger success in his responsible work. Rodong Sinmun

title: Paekma Veterinary Biomedicine Institute Remodeled
body: The Paekma Veterinary Biomedicine Institute was successfully remodeled in North Phyongan Province. After setting a target for updating the institute in the first year for implementing the new five-year plan in order to consolidate the material and technical foundation for veterinary and anti-epizootic field, true to the decisions made at the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, the province has dynamically pushed ahead with the remodeling. It has excellently remodeled the room dedicated to the history of the institute, hall of culture, laboratory, etc. and provided equipment to the institute, thus laying a foundation for improving the veterinary and anti-epizootic work. It has built a new hostel and planted many fruit trees to spruce up the appearance of the institute. Rodong Sinmun

title: Designing Institute of Electronics and Automation Marks Its Golden Jubilee
body: There took place a meeting on Tuesday to mark the 50th founding anniversary of the Designing Institute of Electronics and Automation. Attending the meeting were O Su Yong, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Ju Yong Il, minister of IT Industry, officials concerned and officials and employees of the institute. Read out at the meeting was a congratulatory message sent by the C.C., WPK to the designers and employees of the institute. The Central Committee of the WPK in its message said that the history of the institute is adorned with fruitful days in which it has faithfully upheld with deep knowledge and high technology the Party's line on putting the national economy on a Juche, modern and scientific basis. The message highly appreciated the designers and employees of the institute who have made valuable achievements at the honorable post in charge of designing, a cornerstone of the industry, in breaking through the cutting edge and made contributions to propelling the independent and modern development of the state economy. A report and speeches were made there. The reporter and speakers stressed that they would steadily make scientific research achievements to put the country's electronic industry on a new basis and propel the independent and modern development of the national economy through more dynamic campaign of technology and brains. Rodong Sinmun

title: Noble Idea about His Devotion to People
body: Important Policy Issue A few years ago the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited a general machinery plant. Looking round several places of the plant the respected General Secretary praised the plant as a highly civilized one in which the production culture had been realized on the highest level among the recently remodeled factories. That day he viewed various kinds of daily necessaries made by working class there. Highly appreciating the working class the respected General Secretary instructed that they should continuously wage a vigorous struggle to normalize the production of daily necessaries with idle materials, expand the variety and enhance the quality of goods. He emphasized that this was the measure taken by our Party for the sake of the improvement of people’s living standard and served as an important policy issue. Like this the respected General Secretary always regards the improvement of people’s living standard as the most important and gives top priority to the production of daily necessaries by making use of idle materials in parallel with current production. Giving Priority to People’s Convenience Once, the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un guided the master plans for Kanggye and Manpho cities. That day he set forth the tasks and ways for successfully sprucing up the cities and stressed the importance to thoroughly observe the principle of ensuring people’s convenience in city construction. Emphasizing it, he gave detailed answers to such problems as increasing the electricity production and solving the heating issue of buildings by making good combination of electricity and geothermal energy and other natural energies, remarkably raising the water production capacity of reservoirs to ensure the daily water supply to each citizen on a high level, and strictly purifying and treating industrial waste water and sewage by putting infrastructural project on a scientific basis and operating sewage treatment facilities. Indeed, all the edifices are being built on the principle of putting the conveniences and interests of the people above all thanks to meticulous care of the respected General Secretary. Rodong Sinmun

title: True to Party’s Policy on Recycling
body: A refuse recycling factory was built in Haeju City, South Hwanghae Province. It consists of grading line, organic fertilizer production line and block production line and can deal with a large amount of rubbishes annually. Upholding the Party’s policy on recycling the South Hwanghae Provincial Party Committee dynamically called on the officials and working people to build the refuse recycling factory at lightning speed which had been adopted as a Party decision. The officials of the Provincial People’s Committee made daily plans minutely and arranged the organization and command of the construction work ambitiously. Officials and working people of several units turned out for the work to implement the Party’s decision and pushed forward the construction on a high qualitative level by tapping out internal reserves and pooling their wisdom and strength together. Thanks to the vigorous struggle of the officials and working people of South Hwanghae Province the construction of the factory concluded in a short period. Rodong Sinmun

title: Meetings of Young Activists in Displaying Noble Traits Held
body: Meetings of young activists in displaying noble traits were held by the youth league committees of Pyongyang City and Jagang Province and the Ministry of Culture. The meetings were attended by leading officials of the Party committees, youth league officials, young activists in displaying noble traits and other young people of the city and province and the ministry. The reporters and speakers said at the meetings that a proud heyday of the youth power is being ushered in on this land thanks to the wise guidance of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un who remains faithful to the noble intention of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. They said that the young people are growing up to be possessors of noble ideological and spiritual qualities and youth heroes fully displaying their mettle with patriotism in the building of a powerful socialist country under the loving care of the benevolent father. They referred to the noble traits displayed among the young people like rendering material and moral assistance to the People's Army, looking after the war veterans with kindred feelings and getting married to honored disabled soldiers. They expressed their resolution to further glorify their honor as vanguard and shock brigade in the struggle for ushering in a new period of a great upsurge and turn in the revolution, with firm faith in socialism and confidence in victory and optimism. Rodong Sinmun

title: Steel-Strong Ranks Advance Full of Confidence in Sure Victory
body: The steel-strong ranks continue to march toward Mt Paektu, holy mountain of the Korean revolution. The ranks reflect the unshakable faith and will of our people determined to follow the road of socialism to the end with revolutionary spirit of Mt Paektu and the spirit of blizzards of Paektu as eternal ideological and spiritual weapon. Despite the manifold hardships, the march started in Mt Paektu leads us to victory and prosperity. The spirit of defending the leader unto death and the spirit of self-reliance and fortitude displayed by the anti-Japanese revolutionary forerunners enable us to win a new victory of our revolution earlier. Thus our people stoutly continue the march toward Mt Paektu, longing for the mountain. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greetings to General Council of United Russia Party
body: The Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) sent a message of greeting to the General Council of the United Russia Party on Wednesday. In the message, the WPK Central Committee warmly congratulated the General Council and all the party members of the United Russia Party on the occasion of its 20th founding anniversary. The message said that the United Russia Party fulfilled its responsibility and role in the work for steering the whole socio-political life of the country and building a powerful Russia in the past. Noting that the WPK Central Committee closely watches the fact with deep attention, the message wished the United Russia Party greater success in its activities for strengthening the party and realizing the future-oriented state plans. It expressed the belief that the friendly ties between the two parties would further develop in accordance with the DPRK-Russia friendly and cooperative relations which have entered the new stage of development. Rodong Sinmun

title: Continuous People-oriented Policies Pursued by Our Party
body: Our-style socialism is a superior one in which every policy of the Party and state is enforced for the people. On September 25 in Juche 101(2012), the ordinance of the Supreme People’s Assembly of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea promulgated enforcing the universal 12-year compulsory education. Many modern hospitals like the Okryu Children’s Hospital, Ryugyong Dental Hospital and Ryugyong General Ophthalmic Hospital were built one after another followed by Breast Tumour Institute of the Pyongyang Maternity Hospital in Juche 101(2012) to make our people enjoy the benevolence of the socialist public health to the full. In Juche 105(2016), 20-odd baby homes, orphanages, primary and middle schools for orphans were built across the country. In Juche 101(2012), the first year of the new century of Juche, the Ryugyong Health Complex, People’s Open-Air Ice Rink and Skate Park and Rungna People’s Pleasure Park were erected and Munsu Water Park and Mirim Riding Club were opened the next year to add pleasure to the people. Ordinary working people enjoy cultural and pleasant life at the Central Zoo, Masikryong Ski Resort, Yangdok Hot Spring Resort and other cultural recreation grounds. This can be witnessed only in our socialist regime which spares nothing for the people. Indeed, all these are the practical reality of our country led by the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un, the father of the socialist large family. Rodong Sinmun

title: Achievements Made in Autumn Land Management
body: Achievements were made in the DPRK as a result of vigorous mass campaign for autumn land management. Officials and working people of North Hwanghae Province improved dozens of kilometers of roads and rivers and repaired a lot of dwelling houses and public buildings during the autumn period of the general mobilization for land administration. Officials of several units including the Provincial Land and Environmental Conservation Bureau worked out a detailed plan to be carried out in the period of the general mobilization and conducted the organizational and political work to turn the land administration into the work of the masses themselves. The working people of provincial-level organs paved sections of the Pyongyang-Kaesong motorway with gravel and cement qualitatively in a short period. Cities and counties expanded the width of bridges and roads, newly built revetment, dredged river-beds, rebuilt embankments, built terraced fields, improved public service facilities and parks and planted trees of good species, thereby registering a lot of achievements. Rodong Sinmun

title: Distinguished Ideo-theoretical Wisdom
body: The great ideo-theoretical wealth is positively necessary for one country and nation to achieve the victory and prosperity by steadily advancing without flinching in any adversity. In the course of advancing to socialism and communism, human ideal, the importance of the ideo-theoretical guidelines is more clearly displayed as the revolution and construction progress vigorously. Chairman Kim Jong Il, a peerless philosopher and outstanding ideological theoretician, bequeathed the great ideological and theoretical treasure-house to us in his lifetime. In the whole period of his revolutionary career, the Chairman, eternal leader of the Workers’ Party of Korea and our people and the great man lauded by the world, provided the noble guidelines illuminating the road ahead of all generations of the nation with his outstanding wisdom and energetic ideological and theoretical activities and achieved undying feats to turn the country into an invincible ideological power. He formulated the President Kim Il Sung’ s revolutionary idea as Kimilsungism, put forward modeling the whole society on Kimilsungism as the supreme programme of the WPK and gave unique and clear answers to the theoretical and practical problems arising in each period and stage of development of the revolution. Today the treasure-house of Juche idea provided by the Chairman is being enriched by the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un. Our people vigorously advancing toward a great fresh victory of the revolution under the guidance of the respected General Secretary will surely build the powerful socialist country of Juche by glorifying the immortal ideo-theoretical feats of the Chairman and thoroughly implementing his behests. Rodong Sinmun

title: With Sense of Obligation towards Revolutionary Forerunners
body: At the Pyongyang Old People’s Home, there lives an old woman superannuated after working as an official in a factory for a long time. Officials and employees of the factory who worked together with her, take care of the childless woman with brotherly love. They visited her to celebrate her birthday and holidays. They sent thick new dresses to her in order that she might not feel cold and often phoned to learn in detail about her living conditions and helped her lest she should feel lonely. It is a common thing in our society. However, their deeds are excellent as they have devoted their sincerity to her for a long time with moral obligation. Such deeds have been conveyed as learning after the mental world of war veterans who fought to defend the country and looking after their health and life materially and morally, and discharging duty of disciple having moral obligation towards a benevolent teacher. Today the stories about noble moral obligation pervading the country vividly show the realities of our society in which the people regard as a part of their life to respect the revolutionary forerunners and inherit their soul. Rodong Sinmun

title: Here Is Our Working Place
body: Employees of the Phyongchon District Water Supply and Drainage Management Station sincerely discharge their duty. Their working place is unknown to people. Though it is not where the signal feats are performed, they keep in mind peculiar cling and pride. It is just that the streets and villages are cleaned and its residents can lead a life without inconvenience only when they soundly carry out their job. Now they are devoting the sweats of their pure conscience to undertakings all the year round, no matter whether they are recognized or not. Rodong Sinmun

title: Single-minded Unity, Precious Revolutionary Legacy
body: Only our socialist motherland advances by dint of great idea of single-minded unity and shines with peculiar features which no other country can imitate. Chairman Kim Jong Il said that he regarded the single-minded unity as the weapon of our revolution since he set out on the struggle to carry forward and accomplish the glorious revolutionary cause of Juche. He warmly instructed that the single-minded unity is his revolutionary philosophy. Looking back upon human history, every statesman stressed the importance of unity and strived to achieve the unity. But, any other party in the world and statesman did not even present the idea of ten millions’ firm unity based on one ideology and one center. It is none other than Chairman Kim Jong Il who could form the great single-minded unity centred on the leader based on the revolutionary comradeship and obligation with the same idea and will. Our single-minded unity has been further strengthened as the absolute weapon of Juche Korea and the irresistible force by seasoned and wise leadership of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un to fully display its might. Rodong Sinmun

title: Devotion of All His Life to People
body: Whenever December comes, all our people ardently yearn for Chairman Kim Jong Il. Chairman Kim Jong Il devoted himself to happiness of our people with love for people as his natural disposition. All the people solemnly recollect the great feats of the Chairman to whom we entrusted our destiny and future. Every part of this land is associated with guiding exploits of the Chairman who visited every nook and corner of the country ranging from alpine areas to areas on borders to provide our people with bases of happiness. We can vividly remember the roads to front and blizzard-swept roads which our Chairman went through with indomitable will to defend our people’s dignity and destiny in the period of Arduous March which was the toughest in history of our country. The Chairman couldn’t have the humble gruel-prepared-meal by the thought of our people suffering hardships and often brought back the rice-balls untouched by lack of time during his field guidance. Thanks to his such painstaking efforts the sky over our country has always remained blue and eternal foundation for building a thriving nation has been further consolidated. Indeed, these achievements serve as national-historic feats to defend our people and make our people enjoy wealthy lives and guarantee the eternal future of our people. To sum up the whole life of the Chairman, who made high-intensity forced march on a train of journey for the people all his life burning his heart with the desire to find out even one more thing to do for the sake of our people, there was only people in his mind. Rodong Sinmun

title: Picturing Better Scenic View of Capital City
body: This is the scene we can witness everywhere these days. From early morning working people in the capital city go to the street as if prearranged, devoting their sincerity to planting and tending trees. Besides in the sunshiny greenhouse, girls produce fragrant flowers for borders and flowerpot stands that they will be pranked with flowers in the next spring. Their faces beam with joy as if they saw beautiful flowers in full blossom in the streets and villages. Working people full of patriotism make up their minds to change the looks of Pyongyang City beyond recognition next spring. They plant trees of good breeds and grow a lot of flowers in every part of the city. Let us plant trees and raise flowers for turning our capital city into the socialist fairyland and people’s paradise. Rodong Sinmun

title: Stevia Processing Factory Built in North Phyongan Province
body: The Stevia Processing Factory was excellently built in Jongju City, North Phyongan Province, and its inaugural ceremony took place on Dec.3. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un made sure that measures were taken to build the modern stevia processing factory in North Phyongan Province and starch syrup production processes in every province. The construction of the factory provided a foundation for the successful production of stevia sugar and extract which are high in sweet taste and low in sugar content. Present at the ceremony were Mun Kyong Dok, chief secretary of the North Phyongan Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Jang Se Chol, chairman of the North Phyongan Provincial People's Committee, officials concerned, officials and employees of the factory and builders. Rodong Sinmun

title: Successes Made for Development of Agricultural Production
body: Officials and researchers of the Academy of Agricultural Science have bred tens of new species of crops this year and achieved a number of scientific successes conducive to the stable and sustaining development of agricultural production. The Academy of Agricultural Science set and has carried out stepwise goals, including the breeding of high-yielding species adapted to geographical and climatic features of the country and highly resistant to high temperature, drought, coldness, saltiness and harmful insects. As a result, there have been achieved sci-tech successes conducive to the consolidation of material and technical foundation for agricultural production and valuable research successes needed for developing fruit farming and stock breeding and putting agricultural production on a scientific and IT basis. Rodong Sinmun

title: Putting Spurs to Production of Consumer Goods While Enlisting All Reserves and Potentialities
body: The officials and working class of the light-industry sector are giving spurs to the work to conclude the year-end’s production campaign with a wholehearted desire to decisively increase the production of quality consumer goods conducive to the improvement of people’s living standard. Officials and working class of the textile and knitting industries, aware that production results depend on the operation rate of equipment, are striving to increase the production of consumer goods strictly observing technical and standard regulations of operation. Shoes making units including the Ryuwon Footwear Factory and Pyongyang Footwear Factory are conducting a vigorous struggle to victoriously conclude this year’s production campaign ensuring raw and other materials by tapping and enlisting latent reserves and potentialities in parallel with the persevering work to produce more new goods which meet our people’s taste and demand. The officials, technicians and working people of daily necessities and cosmetics industry including the Hamhung Disabled Soldiers’ Essential Plastic Goods Factory, Pyongyang Cosmetics Factory and Sinuiju Cosmetics Factory are putting primary efforts to the work of strengthening technical forces from the standpoint that only when they hold fast to science and technology can they produce more consumer goods. And also they are actively conducting the work to transfer and share the advanced technology and experiences and to gain better results in accordance with the progress they have made by regarding domestic production of raw and other materials and their recycling as the main solution. Rodong Sinmun

title: People-first Principle, Political Climate and Social Customs of Our State
body: The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un emphasized that we should conduct the work to consolidate the people-first principle as political climate and social customs of our state in a more substantial and purposeful manner at the 5th Session of the 14th Supreme People’s Assembly of the DPRK in September. "Everything for the people and everything by relying on them!" This serves as the basic method of our Party activity and action principle of officials firmly established by the respected General Secretary in the new century of Juche. If it was for the sake of our people the respected General Secretary went to the front without hesitation and guided the trial runs of new tram car and trolley bus despite the fierce heat in summer. Showing his concern about the people stricken by natural disaster the respected General Secretary said that they were waiting for him looking at the sky over the capital city being exposed to rainy wind without any shelter provided. Indeed, our people can never forget the days the respected General Secretary spent inspecting several typhoon-affected areas. Thanks to the prominent guidance of the respected General Secretary the spirit of devoted service for the people is pervading our Party and state and all production and construction are conducted for the promotion of people’s well-being. Consequently the people-first principle has been defined as political climate and social customs of our state. Rodong Sinmun

title: Eager to Hold Up Our Party with Steel Production
body: This is a scene of molten-iron production site of furnace shop at the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex. At the melting site where fire blazes high into the air, the smelters are in raptures seeing the molten iron turned out just before. Let us display to the full the stamina of the working class of the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex in the first year’s advance in carrying out another five-year plan set forth by the Eighth Party Congress. Let us support our Party with increased steel production! These are firm will of the working class of the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex. With such fervent enthusiasm they successfully overhauled the oxygen heat blast furnace and increased the production of iron and steel while carrying out the production-capacity-expanding project as scheduled. It has only a few weeks to the end of this year. At present they keep redoubling their efforts to turn out more iron and steel at the most important field in the national economic construction. Rodong Sinmun

title: Eighth Conference of Military Educationists of KPA Held
body: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Guides Conference The Eighth Conference of Military Educationists of the Korean People's Army was held at the April 25 House of Culture on December 4 and 5. The Central Committee and the Central Military Commission of the Workers' Party of Korea convened the conference involving the entire army with a view to consolidating the core position of the Korean revolutionary armed forces in every way by bringing about a radical turn in the military education as required by the changing times and revolutionary situation. Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the WPK and chairman of the Central Military Commission of the WPK, attended and guided the conference. Present at the conference were exemplary military educationists and relevant cadres and commanding officers from the General Political Bureau, the Ministry of National Defence and the General Staff, commanding officers of the services and those of units at corps level and merited officials of the logistic units for education. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un came to the venue of the conference amid the playing of welcome music. The moment all the participants burst into stormy cheers of "Hurrah!" looking up to the General Secretary who is ushering in a new period of development and a golden age in beefing up the military force by more firmly training the KPA to be a revolutionary army of the WPK, a highly advanced modern army and the reliable guardian of the state and people with his outstanding army-building ideas and energetic guidance. Taking the platform were Pak Jong Chon, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK and secretary of the Party Central Committee, and O Il Jong, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK and department director of the Party Central Committee. Commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence of the DPRK, and officials, teachers and researchers who rendered distinguished service to military education also mounted the platform. Kim Jong Un made an opening address. He sent warm thanks to all the military educationists for devoting themselves to training commanding officers and backbones of the KPA, lavishing all their wisdom, passion and soul on their work on the platform of the revolution, true to the Party's policy and line of training reserve military and political cadres. He referred to the intention of our Party of giving top priority to the military education, the importance of the mission and duty of the military educationists and the purpose of convening the conference. Expressing the belief that the 8th KPA Conference of Military Educationists would serve as an occasion of an epochal turn and a process of leaping progress in the course of the development of Juche-based military education thanks to the high political enthusiasm and deep attention of all the participants, he declared the conference open. Army General Ri Yong Gil, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK and minister of National Defence of the DPRK, made a report to be followed by speeches. The report and speeches introduced and shared achievements and experience made in helping teachers possess political and moral traits and qualifications befitting teachers and in improving the educational conditions, environment and methods in military academies through the struggle to bring about practical improvement and substantial advance in military education. Some deviations witnessed in the military education due to the lack of ideological awareness to prove the validity and the vitality of the Party's idea of prioritizing military education with substantial progress and renovation in their units, and their causes were analyzed and reviewed. The report and speeches called on all the educationists to display matchless bravery, strong endeavors, high enthusiasm and fighting spirit with a pledge and self-confidence to put the military education on a higher level at an early date and to bring about new innovation, bold creation and steady progress in the overall military education field. The standings of military academies were announced at the conference based on the assessment of their implementation of the Party's policy of bringing about revolution in the military education field, and pennants were awarded to exemplary units. Kim Jong Un made an important conclusion. He said that the conference is underway at a crucial time when our revolution is moving on to the next stage of new victory according to the grand fighting programme and policy set forth by the historic Party Congress, repeatedly stressing the strategic intention of the Central Military Commission of the WPK in giving guidance to the conference with special consideration and deep attention given to it and the importance of the military education in the current situation. He underscored the need to prepare all the military educationists to be true soldiers immensely loyal to the idea and leadership of the Party and to organize and provide the military education, strictly guided by the Party's idea, policy and method so as to bring up all the cadets to be commanding officers who remain absolutely loyal to the Party Central Committee. For this he set forth principles, direction of development of the military education and tasks and ways. It is important for military educationists to be deeply aware of their noble mission and duty before the Party and the revolution and to turn out as one in effecting the revolution in the military education field, he said, clarifying the main traits to be possessed by them. He ardently called for opening up the period of new surge and leaping progress in effecting the revolution in the military education field by putting all-out efforts for our great Party, for our great state and people and for the eternal mightiness and invincibility of our revolutionary armed forces. After the conclusion of the General Secretary, all the participants raised thunderous cheers for the outstanding teacher brightly indicating the path for bringing about the revolution in the military education field with his unique ideological and theoretical wisdom and unending trust and loving care. Kim Jong Un made a closing address. He appreciated that the 8th Conference of Military Educationists in the history of our revolutionary armed forces met its original purpose thanks to the high enthusiasm of the participants. He repeatedly called for making the military education the most advanced one in the country and the one truly conducive to strengthening the core position of the revolutionary armed forces. He expressed great trust and expectation that all the participants would bear deep in mind the idea and spirit of the conference, make redoubled efforts and make a decisive stride forward in the struggle to carry out the Party's policy of bringing about a turn in the military education and thus make tangible contributions to building the revolutionary army of the Party and building the elite army. The conference was held amid the iron pledge and revolutionary enthusiasm of all the participants fully determined to work heart and soul to strengthen the military education, so as to bring up more competent military talents remaining absolutely loyal to our Party, true to the revolutionary idea and leadership of the Party Central Committee. During the conference, there was a lecture. The conference became a meaningful occasion in consolidating the military education field as a firm fortress for devotedly defending the Party Central Committee and in turning military education into a powerful force for propelling army building and military activities and furthermore, the victorious advance of the Juche revolution. Political News Team

title: Production of Hothouse Vegetables Increases in DPRK
body: The agricultural sector of the DPRK put efforts into the hothouse vegetable farming, resulting in excellent harvest this year. Thanks to the devoted efforts of the officials and workers of the agricultural sector, the hothouse vegetable production plan made by the Ministry of Agriculture was over-fulfilled at 104 percent. Agricultural workers of Pyongyang City produced hothouse vegetables of over 300 tons per hectare. Co-op farms properly arranged different varieties, and met technological requirements in manuring, selected species, tiered cultivation, soil management and environmental preservation, thus producing more than last year. Nampho City, North Phyongan Province and other regions actively introduced sci-tech and three-dimensional cultivation methods and thus produced lots of cucumber, tomato, pepper, spinach and the like, contributing to improving the people's diet. Rodong Sinmun

title: Dairy Cattle Farm Built in North Phyongan Province
body: A wonderful dairy cattle farm has been completed in North Phyongan Province. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un gave instructions for every province to build a modern cattle farm to raise high-yielding dairy cattle with the aim of supplying children with more tasty and nutritious dairy products. The province pushed ahead with the project while taking timely measures for the designing of the farm and manpower and materials needed for the project after selecting a good place with prospects of animal husbandry under a high goal of finishing the project within this year. The builders splendidly built cattle sheds, a milk-processing building, a feed-processing shop, etc. In addition, the province made and installed the equipment for milk-processing and milk powder production by its own efforts and technology, and a combined control room was built to make it possible to correctly manage the temperature and humidity of the sheds and the supply of feed. An inaugural ceremony was held at the cattle farm on Dec. 5. Rodong Sinmun

title: Drastic Change Is Witnessed at Foot of Mt Paektu
body: Samjiyon City, native place dear to the hearts of our people, underwent a radical change. In November, the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un came to the spot in relation to finishing the construction of Samjiyon City and looked round various objects. He warmly said to accompanying officials that he decided to declare the completion of the third-stage project for sprucing up Samjiyon City. Consequently, mountainous villages of Samjiyon City have turned into a great ideal land. There are many bustling quarters and luxury villages in the world, but the city is called an ideal land for people. Thanks to warm love of the respected General Secretary, the city was built as a model of socialist mountainous cultured town, to be proud in the world, at the birthplace of Chairman Kim Jong Il and the revolutionary battle area with traces of the anti-Japanese revolutionary forerunners. Now the builders of Samjiyon City cannot forget December 3, Juche 106 (2017), when the respected General Secretary visited its construction site. At that time, he looked round various places for a long time and gave vital instructions to bring about revolutionary turn in the construction of Samjiyon City. Under his energetic guidance, the city greeted the new day. His thoughts and whole energy are reflected in the new style of street formation quite different from before and harmonious composition of each section and a single dot or a line pictured on a blueprint of the beautiful mountainous cultured town and even color of any wall, ranging from designing to building work of all buildings. Indeed, the radical change of Samjiyon City at the foot of Mt Paektu is a monument associated with his devoted service for the people, which implants in the people’s hearts the far-reaching ideal of our Party and emotionally conveys the indomitable spirit and fighting traits of them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Great Leaders Would Be So Much Pleased
body: This is the marvelous view of the Phothae-dong area with which the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un was so satisfied during his field guidance to Samjiyon City last November. On that unforgettable day, he viewed the area again and again as if he wanted to keep precious in his heart the people’s ideal village which had been built at the foot of Mt Phothae to resemble a beautiful picture. He said with great delight that President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il would have been so glad if they had witnessed this dramatic change. Led by the respected General Secretary, our socialist country will dash along the road of comprehensive prosperity and development and our people will laugh louder and happily. Rodong Sinmun

title: Making Strenuous Efforts with Death-defying Will
body: The dynamic struggle of workers in metal and chemical industries, the twin pillars supporting the independent economy, gathers momentum. Those of the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex, Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex and Chollima Steel Complex brace themselves up to increase production. Workers at the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex, fully aware of their heavy tasks in developing the independent economy and improving the people’s standard of living, engage themselves in the project to expand fertilizer production capacity and other undertakings for carrying out the decisions of the Eighth Congress of the Workers’ Party of Korea. Such units as the February 8 Vinalon Complex and Sinuiju and Chongjin Chemical Fiber Mills make exertions to implement tasks for the first year of the five-year plan at an early date. Workers in the electric power and coal industries go all out to attain their goals, overcoming difficulties in an indomitable spirit. The Pukchang Thermal Power Complex and Pyongyang Thermal Power Plant put spurs to their struggle to carry out without fail this year’s electricity production plan while strictly observing technical rules and standard regulations. The Suphung, Hochongang and Jangjingang Power Stations and others in the hydroelectric sector control the water in a scientific manner and intensify checkups in order to increase production. Coal mines of the Tokchon Area Coal-mining Complex and Pukchang Area Youth Coal-mining Complex apply themselves to the drive for increased production in an effort to actively adopt advanced tunneling and mining methods and put their coal production on a normal track. Meanwhile, machine factories in the coal-mining industry make endeavors to provide coal mines with plenty of equipment, accessories and small tools. The Taean Heavy Machine Complex, Ranam Coal-mining Machine Complex and other counterparts in the machine-building industry also strive to hit this year’s production target. Suit is followed by the mining industry and forestry sector. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chongryu Restaurant Marks Its 40th Founding Anniversary
body: Chongryu Restaurant marked its 40th founding anniversary. President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il visited the public catering center, which was built in a peculiar way on a bank of the Pothong River, on December 6, Juche 70(1981) and expressed great satisfaction, calling it a restaurant which can stand comparison with famous ones in other parts of the world, and gave it the meaningful name Chongryu Restaurant. At Chongryu Restaurant which was built as a comprehensive national food service base for the people under the care of the President and the Chairman, service workers, employees and officials have made brilliant records in 40-year-long history of its development with sincere service activities and laudable successes conducive to the development of the culinary culture of the country and improvement of the dietary life of the people. A meeting was held on December 6 to convey the letter of congratulations sent by the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea to the employees and officials of Chongryu Restaurant who greeted the 40th founding anniversary. The Central Committee of the WPK in the letter highly appreciated the merits of service workers, employees and officials of the restaurant who devoted themselves to the happiness of the people and the development of the culinary culture peculiar to our nation by firmly holding their revolutionary posts and exerting themselves to the utmost to the service activities with boundless loyalty to the leader and the spirit of devotedly serving the people. Attending the meeting were O Su Yong, secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, and officials and employees of the restaurant. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Has Photo Session with Participants in 8th Conference of Military Educationists of KPA
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), had a photo session with the participants in the 8th Conference of Military Educationists of the Korean People's Army (KPA) on December 7. Present there were Pak Jong Chon, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretary of the WPK Central Committee. O Il Jong, member of the Political Bureau and department director of the WPK Central Committee, and commanding officers of the DPRK Ministry of National Defence also attended the photo session. Military educationists were greatly excited and were full of great joy of having a photo of honor taken with the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un after receiving an important guideline clearly indicating the path of the development of military education at the significant conference. When he arrived at the venue of the photo session, all the participants raised stormy cheers of "Hurrah!" The participants in the conference, reflecting their boundless gratitude for Kim Jong Un, paid the highest tribute to the great brilliant commander, who took the decisive measure for bringing about a revolutionary turn in the military education field, the outpost for consolidating the core position of our revolutionary armed forces, with his gifted ideological and theoretical wisdom and scientific insight and bestowed great affections and trust upon them again. He extended warm greetings of encouragement, waving back to the enthusiastically cheering participants. Noting that the teachers' responsibility is very important in carrying out the revolution in the military education, he once again stressed that our military educationists should become the hardcore revolutionaries to defend the sacred revolutionary position safeguarding the dignity and well-being of the Party, the state and the people and guaranteeing the mightiness and invincibility of the army of the Party. Expressing his conviction that the military educationists will cherish deep in mind the idea and spirit of the conference, achieve practical success and substantial change in education and thus make tangible contributions to the building of the Juche-oriented revolutionary armed forces, he had a significant photo session with them. All the participants vowed to open up the period of new surge and leap forward in bringing about the revolution in military education by unconditionally and thoroughly implementing the militant tasks set forth in the important concluding speech of the respected General Secretary without an inch of deflection, bearing in mind the loyalty to the Party and revolution as the first and foremost faith and the mainstay of their life. Political News Team

title: Wherever We Go and Whoever We Meet
body: Giving Top Priority to Working People’s Health In April, Juche 53(1964), Chairman Kim Jong Il visited the Kanggye Youth Power Station nearing completion. Looking round the power station, the Chairman stopped suddenly by the moisture formed in one corner on the ceiling. Having a shadow pass over his face, the Chairman said that if workers labor in such a damp place their health could be damaged by arthritis and the officials must take measures to rectify it at an early date. On the reply of the officials that they would surely rectify it later, the Chairman said they must start right away, not in future. He earnestly instructed that we could not run the plant without proper measure with regard to labor safety and we must guarantee the health of our working people even though inaugural ceremony was delayed. Loving Care Shown for Woman Assembler Twenty-odd years ago, Chairman Kim Jong Il visited a factory. Looking at a woman assembler’s working he praised her for quickness in assembling bearings. He was informed by an accompanying official that she had a nursing baby and her husband was a long way from her factory. Then the Chairman appreciated that she assembled bearings quickly without any mistake although she cared family circumstances. After listening to her saying that she would never leave the factory even though she had to change her job following her husband, serving as an officer, the Chairman took benevolent measures to let her husband move to another place near her factory. It was an honor that she hardly deserved. Giving Undeserved Thanks Once, Chairman Kim Jong Il visited a complex located on the east coast of the northern end of Korea. That day, he looked round the duck farm, which was built by the complex itself and had put the production on a normal basis. Looking with an air of satisfaction at officials of the complex, he said that the complex changed its looks beyond recognition within a few years and all the factories and enterprises must learn from its achievements and experiences. Expressing his satisfaction at the complex, he instructed to convey his thanks to all its workers, technicians and officials. Looking up to the Chairman who gave benevolent thanks to them the working class of the complex extended greetings of thanks to him. Rodong Sinmun

title: Saying Self-reliance Is the Best
body: In September, Juche 88(1999), Chairman Kim Jong Il visited an electric appliances general factory. Passing through the case-assembling shop, he went to the general-appliances shop and approached a switchboard under assembling. He looked at every nook and corner of the switchboard attentively and said that he didn’t care about its unattractive appearance and electricity was not generated by a switchboard or a feeder box but an electric generator. Then he added that he didn’t like those who boasted of their pretentiously-constructed buildings of small- and medium-sized power stations and glittering incidental equipment such as switchboards. After a while he said that when he visited a place there was a showy imported switchboard but it was out of order and, worse still, there were no spare parts to fix it up. Then he proudly asserted that it carried conviction to him that ours were the best. Ours are the best! His teachings on the day were precisely a priceless appraisal of our workers’ revolutionary spirit of self-reliance. Rodong Sinmun

title: Emergency Epidemic Prevention Work Further Intensified in DPRK
body: A new COVID-19 variant with high infectivity now rapidly spreads to different countries and regions in the five continents and the number of the infected is on the increase, arousing serious public concern. The central emergency epidemic prevention unit and emergency epidemic prevention units at all levels in the DPRK are taking preemptive epidemic prevention measures of our own style to thoroughly check the inroads of the malignant virus while keeping close tabs on the worldwide spread of COVID-19. They inform the people of the worldwide spread of the malignant virus through mass media and make everyone turn out in the emergency epidemic prevention campaign with shared awareness of the gravity of the pandemic and the importance of the emergency epidemic prevention work. Posters disseminating anti-epidemic regulations are displayed in public places and worksites and all the people adopt it as part of their life and habit to disinfect their hands, wear masks and measure temperature and give priority to leading their life as required by the emergency epidemic prevention system and rules. Officials and working people of inspection and quarantine units have further tightened the rules on disinfection and treatment of materials while rejecting indolence, slackness, self-complacency and carelessness. Public health organs and hygienic and epidemic prevention units frequently organize intensive medical check-up of in-patients, outpatients and residents and disseminate hygienic information among them. Institutions, industrial establishments and farms make sure office rooms, worksites, equipment and apparatuses are regularly disinfected and efforts are put into enhancing the role of their hygienic information workers to let them find out fever patients and those with chronic diseases and take measures for them. All the inhabitants voluntarily observe emergency epidemic prevention regulations and rules and intensify the work for combating any disobedience of anti-epidemic orders. Thorough-going habit is in place to promptly inform the relevant units of even the trifling abnormal matters for their proper handling. Rodong Sinmun

title: Credentials to Latvian President
body: The DPRK ambassador presented credentials to the Latvian president on Dec. 3. Ambassador Ri Won Guk politely conveyed warm greeting from Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the DPRK, to Egils Levits, president of Latvia. The Latvian president expressed deep thanks for it and asked the ambassador to convey his cordial greeting to Kim Jong Un. Wishing for the development of friendly relations with the DPRK, he hoped everything would go on well in the DPRK. Rodong Sinmun

title: Just before Completion of Yangdok Hot Spring Resort
body: In November, Juche 108(2019), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un again visited Yangdok Hot Spring Resort under construction near completion. On arriving he had a bird’s eye view of the resort boasting itself of modern architectural beauty and expressed a great satisfaction saying that the more he looked at it, the more he liked it. After a while, he made round various places of the resort. At a block, saying that service buildings must have guideboards so that people could easily find their destination, he instructed to the officials to put up guideboards at entrance halls. Looking round a dining room he saw to it that the number of its seats was increased in line with the sleeping accommodations of blocks. In a room he pointed out that the cabinet for keeping guests’ clothes and luggage seemed small and that the rooms should have a table for putting luggage such as trunks on. When he looked around a bed-room he said that one more bedstead should be put up to the empty space of the room. Officials, who considered that it would be good enough, took off their hats to the exact demands of the respected General Secretary. Then he, pointing at the wall cabinet of the bed-room, suggested putting a small refrigerator in it. Indeed, Yangdok Hot Spring Resort conveys great devotion of the respected General Secretary for people who spares nothing for the sake of their happiness and regards it as the greatest pleasure to toil for them. Rodong Sinmun

title: In Order to Build Up Might of Science and Technology
body: Shortcut to Socialist Power In February, Juche106(2017), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un examined equipment manufactured by technicians and scientists in the State Academy of Sciences. The equipment is a proud creation whose efficiency is higher and its power consumption is much less than other imports. The respected General Secretary highly praised the equipment again and again saying that to develop science and technology was our Party’s strategic line and an important issue for the future of our state. He noted in full confidence that the shortcut to the socialist power lay in giving importance to science and technology and prioritizing them. It was the precious instruction which enabled us to cherish deep in our minds the validity of our Party’s policy of attaching importance to science. That day the respected General Secretary stressed that we had nothing but the might of science and technology and the clear head of our scientists and technicians to rely on adding that we must conduct the construction of economy giant and civilized power by dint of science and technology. Work to Be Conducted with Conviction One day in October, Juche 103(2014), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un gave field guidance to the completed Wisong Scientists Residential District. Going round the district successfully built as one of monumental edifices in the era of the Workers’ Party, he stressed the importance of carrying on scientific work with the conviction.
