He said to officials that there is no border in science, but our scientists should have the faith that they are frontline soldiers in the defence of socialism. After a while, looking around the officials in solemn emotion, he emphasized again that science required faith. His teachings reflected that if our scientists firmly carry on the harsh and difficult scientific research, they should be strong men possessed of mental strength with firm faith and conviction in sure victory. Special Guest One June day in Juche 104 (2015), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited a scientific research unit. That day, he met a scientist who contributed to developing products in our own way overcoming all sorts of trials and obstacles. After acquainting himself in detail with the research process, he said that he was very glad to meet the patriots who have devoted all to implementing the behest of Chairman Kim Jong Il and to scientific research whether they are known or unknown. Calling researchers of the unit patriotic scientists, he added he would vail to their patriotic conscience. And he saw to it that the meritorious officials and scientists, who positively contributed to research and industrialization of production, were highly appraised and invited them as special guests to the celebrations of the 70th anniversary of the Workers’ Party of Korea. Indeed, it was the greatest love for and trust in our scientists and technicians who uphold him as the great father. Rodong Sinmun

title: Sincerity of Father
body: The word "people" has existed through all times of history but it has never been regarded so sacred and dignified as it is in our country today. Calling our people the greatest to be found nowhere else in the world, the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un said it was a pity that he couldn’t describe them otherwise despite the variety of Korean vocabularies. Throbbing in his heart is the absolute trust in the people. Also on his mind are warm feelings and inexhaustible fatherly love for the greatest, strongest and most beautiful people who trust and follow their Party alone in any storm and stress. It was him who took all the measures for people’s convenience' sake in December, Juche 99(2011) when the people were seized by sorrow after the demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Once, he detected slight air leaking through the window on the veranda of one of the new dwellings to which the people were to move in. At one time he hugged tightly the orphans who rushed toward him at a breath. Every time, we couldn’t repress tears out of happiness for having such an attentive, tender-hearted and benevolent father. Thinking of him, we feel that he is the most generous father in the world before the veteran statesman and invincible commander respected by the world. Together with our people! For our people! This is always the starting point of his thought and serves as a solid cornerstone lying beneath his plan for both today and tomorrow and the fruits of his great guidance. With this immovable faith and steadfast will, he always stays strong and wins victory all the time. Rodong Sinmun

title: Spring Water Control Law Associated with Warm Love
body: One September day in Juche 105 (2016), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un gave field guidance to the Ryongaksan Spring Water Factory. He, recollecting with deep emotion the fact that Chairman Kim Jong Il visited the factory early on the morning of one January day in Juche 100 (2011) despite the intense cold and personally got a taste of spring water produced in the factory, was very satisfied that Pyongyangites could enjoy the benefit from the spring water known as macrobiotic water all the year round under the care of the Chairman. And then he earnestly said that the officials and employees of the factory should glorify forever the Chairman’s love for people with great production success, never forgetting even a moment the devotion and efforts of the Chairman who was anxious for providing the people with tasty and quality spring water. Sincerely saying that it was not a mere matter of supplying the people with spring water but the issue related to outlook on people, he set forth tasks to be fulfilled by the factory such as the issue of keeping its production going at a high rate, the issue of taking necessary measures to transport the produced spring water in good time and the issue of standardizing and diversifying colors and shapes of glass bottles. In particular, he stressed that the factory prohibited employees from producing water without hygienic security based on the analysis of spring water's quality and gave detailed instruction to make a law to evaluate the quality of spring water and control its production. By doing so, the "Spring Water Control Law of the DPRK" came into being true to noble intention of the respected General Secretary. Rodong Sinmun

title: Tokyo Korean Middle and High School Marks Its 75th Founding Anniversary
body: A meeting was held at Tokyo Korean Middle and High School in Japan on Nov. 21 to mark the 75th founding anniversary of the school under the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon). Present there were Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, Song Kun Hak, vice-chairman of Chongryon Central Standing Committee and director of the Education Department, Kang Chu Ryon, vice-chairwoman of Chongryon Central Standing Committee and chairwoman of the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Democratic Korean Women in Japan, Pak Chung U, chairman of the Korean Federation of Workers in Commerce in Japan, chairpersons of Chongryon headquarters, chairpersons of Chongryon branches, principals of schools at all levels and teaching staff, students, parents and graduates of Tokyo Korean Middle and High School. Introduced there was a congratulatory message from the homeland. Chairman Ho Jong Man said in a speech of congratulation that the school marking its 75th founding anniversary was associated with the leadership exploits of the peerlessly great persons and proud decades of patriotic activities by Koreans in Japan. He called for firmly putting the national education at the center of the building of the organization and patriotic activities, whatever the adversity, bearing in mind the instructions by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un and for concentrating all efforts on defending and developing the national education. Principal Yun Thae Gil made a report. Then, an art performance was given to mark the anniversary. Rodong Sinmun

title: People in Kaesong City Move into New Houses
body: Houses for a hundred and tens of families have been newly built in Kaesong City. Villages in Haephyong-ri of Kaephung District and Sinhung-ri of Phanmun District house cosy dwellings with living rooms, kitchens and warehouses for the conveniences of farmers, whose view has been improved with fruit trees around the houses. Ris in the districts have been facelifted as they have threshing grounds, pens and pumping stations along with modern houses peculiar to the rural areas. Meetings for moving to new houses took place in the farm villages in Haephyong-ri of Kaephung District and Sinhung-ri of Phanmun District. People danced and officials visited the families that moved to the new houses to congratulate them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Annual Meeting of KFA Held
body: An annual meeting of the Korean Friendship Association (KFA) took place in Barcelona of Spain. Present there were the chairman of the KFA and representatives of its branches in Britain, Switzerland, Spain, Austria, Greece, Singapore, Turkey, etc. Speakers praised the revolutionary careers and exploits of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and the personality of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un as the heaven-sent great man, expressing conviction that the Korean people would surely build a powerful socialist country. Alejandro Cao de Benos, chairman of the KFA, noted that the DPRK is now struggling to build comprehensively developed socialism based on the Juche idea founded by President Kim Il Sung and developed and enriched by leader Kim Jong Il. He pointed out that under the leadership of His Excellency Kim Jong Un the Korean people are defending the country's sovereignty and performing epoch-making miracles in the building of a powerful socialist state while smashing every move of the imperialists to stifle their country. Dermot Hudson, chief of the branch in Britain and chairman of the British Group for the Study of the Juche Idea, stressed that under the guidance of Kim Jong Un the DPRK has won great victory in the national defense field and continues to demonstrate its prestige as a military power capable of beating back any imperialist forces of aggression at one strike. The meeting discussed issues of more briskly waging solidarity activities with the Korean people under the prevailing situation. A letter to Kim Jong Un was adopted at the meeting. Rodong Sinmun

title: His Devotion to Our Country and People
body: Chairman Kim Jong Il is a great father who worked heart and soul for his country and people alone. His toils and moils brought more strength to our country and greater happiness to the people. That’s why we cannot forget his life of devotion even for a moment no matter how much water may flow under the bridge. Once, the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un said that the Chairman’s life could be boiled down to a life like fire and that his life was literally like a flaring flame. His meaningful words are also how the people most keenly feel about the great revolutionary career of the Chairman. The Chairman made devotions for the country and people without even a moment’s rest throughout his life. He worked himself beyond the boundaries of man’s mental and physical abilities and thus contributed a great deal to the construction of a socialist power, the lifetime desire of President Kim Il Sung, and to the cause of national reunification and global independence. Furthermore, he was on his way of forced march even at his last moments. That’s why we liken his life to a flaring flame. He burnt himself out to illuminate the road ahead of the times and the people, kindled the flame of revolutionary upswings and, braving challenges of history, ushered in a beautiful spring when the country’s prosperity and people’s happiness come into full bloom. His great patriotic will enabled us to remain ever-victorious through harsh trials and difficulties and provided an eternal foundation for building a prosperous country. The Chairman is, indeed, a great revolutionary and peerless patriot and his patriotic devotion will live forever with the prospering country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Great Revolutionary and Unmatched Patriot
body: We are greatly moved to tears whenever we recollect devotion of Chairman Kim Jong Il throughout all his life to happiness of our people. Chairman Kim Jong Il said it was his will and faith to cross all the rugged mountain passes for the people and continued his field guidance with superman energy. The numbers in the picture reflect the undying feats of the Chairman who devoted himself to glorifying our country’s dignity and might and to training the whole people into those strong in ideology and faith. This is the immortal record of history which enables us to deeply feel that we were led by the peerlessly great man and we achieved a glorious victory and prosperity thanks to his patriotic devotion. Our people will definitely build the most powerful country in the world under the leadership of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un, cherishing deep in mind the patriotic life of the Chairman. Rodong Sinmun

title: Members of Diplomatic Corps Here Visit Korean Revolution Museum
body: Members of the diplomatic corps in the DPRK visited the Korean Revolution Museum on the occasion of the 10th anniversary of the demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Being told about the fact that the Chairman made untiring efforts for the sake of the country's prosperity and people's happiness until the last moments of his revolutionary career and that the country's dignity and national power have reached the highest level under the leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, the visitors looked round various rooms about the period of turning-point for building a powerful socialist country. At the end of the visit, they made entries in the visitor's book. They also toured the Hana Musical Information Centre. Rodong Sinmun

title: The Highest Commendation
body: Chairman Kim Jong Il regarded our people’s appellation "Our General" as the highest commendation. The other day, the Chairman called an official who had been to Sinuiju for conveying the relief goods to residents in the flooded area. The official said that the residents in the flood affected area moved to tears, receiving the relief goods. Then he told the Chairman that they were believing in "Our General" as in heaven. For a long while the Chairman looked out of the window. Then he said with deep emotion that he felt our people’s trust in and love for him whenever he listened to the appellation "Our General". He noted that he took an immense pride in our people’s sincerity, regarding him not only as the leader but also as the family member. He gave words to his burning heart that he regarded the appellation "Our General" as the highest commendation of our people and that he would serve the people in good faith for coming up to their expectations. Indeed, our General was not only the great master of politics and ever-victorious general but also the great man and father of our people. Thus he was always strong and won victory after victory. Rodong Sinmun

title: Drama "Devoted Service" Played Daily
body: The drama "Devoted Service" is daily performed at the National Theatre. The drama, completed by creators and artistes of the National Theatrical Troupe, represents a county party chief official who strives to turn his county into an independent and diversely developed socialist paradise. It shows, through the portrayal of the hero's character and vivid details of life, the idea that when officials uphold the ideas and leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un with a single mind, all the cities and counties can be turned into highly civilized socialist ideal lands and the comprehensive development of Korean-style socialism be stepped up. Rodong Sinmun

title: Presentation on Achievements Made in Soybean Farming Held
body: A presentation on achievements made in soybean farming was held through video conferencing under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea from Dec. 8 to 10. The presentation, held on the theme of "The introduction of high-yielding soybean species appropriate for the features and cultivation conditions of relevant regions and the putting of soybean farming on a scientific footing", was aimed to give wide publicity to and generalize the scientific and technological achievements and experience gained by many units. Attending it were officials, scientists, technicians, teachers and researchers from scores of units including the Academy of Agricultural Science and Wonsan University of Agriculture. Submitted to the presentation were more than 40 papers conducive to the research for settling the soybean seeds suitable for the specific conditions of the country and to increasing a per hectare yield by putting soybean farming on a scientific and technological basis. During the presentation, there took place a lecture and a video show. Rodong Sinmun

title: Frostwork Scenery at Rimyongsu
body: The Rimyongsu Waterfall has been dazzlingly decorated with snow and frost flowers. Here, the water temperature doesn’t go below four degrees Celsius even in winter. So the waterfall keeps running in the freezing cold of tens of degrees Celsius below zero. Everybody marvels at the attractive beauty unique to the waterfall and says that the waterfall with white frostwork looks even better than that in summery greens. This spectacular view cannot be taken merely as a miracle wrought by nature. It has been beautified further by the grandiose plan of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un to spruce up Samjiyon City bearing the timeless achievements of peerlessly great persons of Mt Paektu. Rodong Sinmun

title: Outlook on Revolution and Life of Peerlessly Great Man
body: Philosophy of Snow Snow falling quietly in December brings warmth to our heart, in reflection of the great philosophy of life and the noble revolutionary world of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Once, he told officials, who could hardly repress their surging emotion while recalling the Chairman’s traces devoted to the country’s prosperity and the people’s happiness, that his philosophy of snow was self-sacrifice. Snow, which preserves all sorts of wildness of nature in winter and vitalizes the revival of all things in the universe with call of warm spring, shows the sacred life of the Chairman intact. There was no man like the Chairman in the world, who was born in Mt Paektu, the holy mountain of revolution, made a long journey for the revolution without even a moment’s rest through the fierce snowstorm and passed away on a running field train while carrying on his journey for field guidance till the last moment of his great life saying that one’s life is for the country and people. All the sons and daughters in the country desired and requested the Chairman not to go along the road covered with snow, but he loved the snow more than others and dedicated himself to the country and people with a pure and ardent mind like snow. Thus, the Chairman's philosophy of snow was deeply kept in our people’s mind till now conveying the boundless loving care and noble sacrifice and devotion of the peerlessly great man. Let Us Become Roots Suppose there is a great tree growing highly boasting of fresh and green leaves. If it was a revolution, the man who provided the revolution with nutrient and helped it spread its twigs becoming roots in his life time, was just Chairman Kim Jong Il. One February day, the Chairman gave instructions on the outlook on life of a revolutionary. Listening to officials’ pledge to be leaves of a green big tree with the will to devote themselves to the country and revolution, he said that if the revolution was a big tree, the revolutionaries were its roots. In order to make a long journey following up the victory in any raging wind, revolutionaries, as roots, must be sound and loyal, he noted, adding that he would become strong roots of the revolution together with them. The Chairman had burnt his mind with outlook on life that he would be roots, if the revolution was a big tree, wishing our country to become powerful and prosperous. That’s why he could carry on his journey for prosperity of the country and happiness of the people in his lifetime, like roots. Thanks to his devotion and noble sincerity, our people could open up the avenue for building a powerful socialist country despite all sorts of trials. Geat Ideal On the New Year’s Day in Juche 84 (1995) after the unexpected loss of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il gave field guidance to Dwarf Pine Post of the Korean People’s Army. Then he gave significant instructions to officials. Expressing his iron will to accomplish the revolutionary cause of Juche, the Chairman sincerely said that it was his ideal and pledge to turn our country bequeathed by the President into a paradise of the people the richest and best to live in the world and powerful socialism. At that time, the imperialists had persisted in their unprecedented moves to isolate and stifle the DPRK, clamoring about the "end" of socialism and our people suffered in their life due to manifold economic trials. However, the iron will and great ideal was firmly kept in mind of the Chairman to solidly defend the country and destiny of the people entrusted by the President and to glorify the Juche Korea as the country for the people envied by the world. Therefore, the Chairman had built a paradise where the people’s ideal is realized on this land, overcoming all hardships through the thorny paths. So the people always remember his efforts made to build a prosperous powerful socialist country on this land, when they enjoy bigger happiness and pleasure. Our country will bring earlier the hopeful tomorrow and rosier future under the wise leadership of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un who makes tireless efforts with his devoted service for the people to translate the Chairman’s ideal and desire into reality on this land. Rodong Sinmun

title: Mt Osong Conveys His Immortal Exploits
body: Mt Osong reminds us of Chairman Kim Jong Il’s self-sacrificing devotion on his road to the front. 20-odd years have passed. However, we still remember the touching stories associated with the thorny path of Mt Osong, which the Chairman passed through to the front. The Chairman’s road to the front was not simply a cliffy one but a fatal one deciding whether our people would live independently or become enslaved. We never knew how rough and long his journey to the front was in hard times but fully grasped it in happy days. Witnessing the present reality in which his desire is realized to provide our people with all blessings, we learned that his journey to the front was for the happiness of people and children. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Premier Inspects Major Industrial Establishments
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, inspected factories and enterprises in major fields of the national economy including the metallurgical industry. Going round the blast furnace shop, the steel shop and other places of the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex, he encouraged the officials and workers who are making innovation to glorify the first year of the 5-year plan with the increased iron and steel production. He stressed the need to hit the iron production goal set by the Party without fail by scrupulously improving the technical control over production processes to shorten the melting time and expanding the production capacity in a far-sighted way, with the pride and responsibility for taking charge of the country's leading industry. Visiting the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex, he called for increasing the production of fertilizer on a stable and steady basis, bearing deep in mind the importance of duty the complex has to fulfill in raising good crops, an issue to which top priority is given by the Party and the state. At the Anju Insulating Material Factory, he called for producing and supplying much more insulating materials urgently needed in all the fields of the national economy by further perfecting the production processes, improving the performance of equipment and steadily raising the proportion of locally available raw and other materials as required by the development trend of the world and the specific situation of the factory. The field consultative meetings discussed such issues as those of firmly cementing the material and technological foundation for increase in the iron and steel production, producing and supplying enough fertilizer needed for next year's farming, improving the quality of insulating materials and increasing the ranks of technicians and skilled workers and expanding the production capacity in conformity with the decision made at the 8th Congress of the WPK and the administrative policy of the DPRK government. Rodong Sinmun

title: On Road for Country’s Prosperity
body: Key to Growth of Production Once, the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited a factory in Jagang Province. Recollecting with deep emotion the undying exploits of great leaders associated with the factory, he said that Chairman Kim Jong Il’s care about the factory was special, and in particular, the Chairman dropped in at the factory irregularly and often remembered it, although he was in Pyongyang. Telling officials wrapped in profound emotion that the factory conducted the substantial education through the guidance exploits of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il among its employees in the well-arranged revolutionary museum, the respected General Secretary instructed that the key to increasing the production was attributable to enlisting the mental spirit of masses, and the decisive factor for raising the production of the factory to the peak-year level was to deeply instill the exploits of great leaders associated with the factory into their mind and make them fully feel the pride of their worksite. Its officials deeply kept again in their mind what was the work to be held fast to before anything else in enlisting the mental spirit of masses, bearing his precious teachings each word and phrase. Create Everything in Our Style One May day in Juche 107(2018), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un inspected the completed Koam-Tapchon Railways. Feasting his eyes on the railways built across the rough sea of Sokjon Bay as an important maritime traffic route for improving the people’s living standard, he expressed his satisfaction with a broad smile. The respected General Secretary said that the bridge in Sokjon Bay was the monumental edifice in the era of the Workers’ Party. He noted that another monumental edifice built by our own efforts was a very rewarding work. That day the respected General Secretary stressed that there was nothing impossible for our people, vigorously advancing by dint of science and technology and in the spirit of self-reliance and self-development, and that we could create everything when we were determined. Then he instructed that we should create and develop everything in our style, relying on our own strength, technology and resources in the future, too. The dynamic struggle to create and develop everything in our style is underway by our people with the firm will to surely win victory as long as they are led by the respected General Secretary. Rodong Sinmun

title: Family of Patriots Highly Praised
body: One December day in Juche 103(2014) the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill. When he was looking round the mill he let his eyes rest on the trees in the compound with a broad smile. Various sorts of tall trees like Metasequoia glyptostroboides and thuja were swaying in the compound to add beauty to the charming view of the mill. An accompanying official introduced to the respected General Secretary the chief engineer of the mill whose father had worked as a manager of the mill in the past adding that the father carried out the afforestation well during his term of office. Looking at the chief engineer in a friendly way, the respected General Secretary praised his father for having planted lots of trees in the compound. And he warmly said that his family was one of patriots who defended the textile mill generation after generation. In fact, the chief engineer’s father had only tried his best to uphold the noble intention of the great leaders. However the respected General Secretary comprehended the patriotism of an ex-official from the trees in the compound. Indeed, the number of patriots is increasing day by day in the country under the warm care of the respected General Secretary. Rodong Sinmun

title: Huichon Tile Factory Goes Operational
body: The Huichon Tile Factory was inaugurated thanks to the devoted efforts of officials and working people in Jagang Province. The newly-built large-scale tile factory based on locally available resources and technology will serve as another material foundation for further propelling the local construction. Its inaugural ceremony took place on the spot on December 12. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Remembered in Different Countries
body: There took place memorial meetings in Nepal and Kyrgyzstan, a lecture in Tanzania and a photo exhibition in Cambodia on the occasion of the 10th anniversary of demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The general secretary of the Central Committee of the Nepal Communist Party (Marxist-Leninist) who is ex-deputy prime minister of Nepal said that the whole life of Kim Jong Il was the noble one dedicated to the prosperity of the DPRK and happiness of its people and to the realization of independence of the world oppressed working masses. The chairman of the Central Council of the People Unity-"Kyrgyz El" Republican Political Party of Kyrgyzstan highly praised Kim Jong Il as the outstanding thinker-theoretician, great master of the art of leadership, prominent leader and genuine father of the people. The secretary general of the Tanzanian National Coordinating Committee of the Juche Idea Study Groups stressed that the image of Kim Jong Il would be kept deep in the hearts of the Korean people and the progressive mankind. The former president of the Khmer Democratic Party of Cambodia said with firm belief that the Korean people would achieve great success in the building of a powerful socialist country as they are upholding His Excellency Kim Jong Un carrying forward the cause of His Excellency Kim Jong Il at the top post of the Party and the state. A message to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un was adopted at the memorial meeting in Nepal. Meanwhile, a seminar on Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us Brilliantly Accomplish the Revolutionary Cause of Juche, Holding the Great Comrade Kim Jong Il in High Esteem as the Eternal General Secretary of Our Party" took place in Algeria to commemorate the anniversary of Kim Jong Il's demise. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Remembered in DR Congo
body: Sylvere Boswa Isekombe, general secretary of the Communist Party of the Democratic Congo, made public a press statement on Dec. 1 ahead of the 10th anniversary of the demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. He, in his press statement, paid the noblest tribute to leader Kim Jong Il on the occasion of the greatest national memorial day of the DPRK. The press statement said that the great leader Kim Jong Il conducted broad and deep ideo-theoretical activities with his energetic pursuit and study and made the forced march of tireless on-site guidance for the building of a thriving nation and the improvement of the people's standard of living. It noted that he always found himself among the people throughout the period of his revolutionary leadership. Saying that always going among the people, he shared his destiny with them and reflected their simple opinions in the policies, it pointed out that he always asked if the people liked it when something was created, and found worth of living in people's happiness. The Korean people are holding him in high esteem as the eternal leader of the Workers' Party of Korea, it stressed. The lines and policies set forth by the WPK in each period and at each stage of the revolution and construction were what he conceived and proposed by reflecting the people's demand and aspiration during his ceaseless field-guidance, it noted. For him, the people were teachers and their desires and interests were the starting point for the WPK to formulate all the lines and policies, it said. The footprints of Kim Jong Il who devoted his all to the people are everywhere in the DPRK, it said. It stressed that Kim Jong Il will continue to bless with his sunny smile the Korean people who are dynamically struggling for the dignity and glory of the great country and the victorious advance of socialism with confidence in victory and indomitable will. Rodong Sinmun

title: Anniversary of Demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il Observed in Different Countries
body: There took place a memorial meeting in DR Congo, lectures in Mongolia, Uganda and Senegal and a film show in Russia from Nov. 17 to 28 on the occasion of the 10th anniversary of demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. A DPRK film on the Chairman's visit to the Far Eastern Region of the Russian Federation was shown at the film show. The chairman of the Mongolian Cultural and Research Center of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea said that Chairman Kim Jong Il who faithfully carried forward the leadership of President Kim Il Sung, the founder of the DPRK, formulated the revolutionary idea of the President as Kimilsungism and applied it thoroughly to the revolution and construction. The first vice-chairman and members of the DR Congo-Korea Friendship and Solidarity Association stressed that the revolutionary career and feats of Chairman Kim Jong Il remains shining day after day as the great vitality of Juche-oriented ideology and theory developed by him are being more and more vividly verified through the reality of socialist Korea which achieves prosperity under the leadership of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un. The chairman of the Ugandan National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea, the chairman of the Ugandan National Executive Committee of the Pan-African Movement, the chairman of the Uganda-DPRK Friendship Association and other political and public personages of Uganda praised the feats of the Chairman performed in accomplishing the human cause of independence. A message to the respected General Secretary was adopted at the memorial meeting that took place in DR Congo. Rodong Sinmun

title: Internet Seminar Held in Russia
body: An internet seminar was held in Moscow on Dec. 5 ahead of the 10th anniversary of the demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Present there were chiefs and members of the organizations for the study of the Juche idea of Russia. Dmitri Kostenko, chairman of the Russian Association for the Study of the Juche Idea, said at the seminar that the world progressives reverently look back upon the revolutionary career of Comrade Kim Jong Il on Dec. 17, the anniversary of his demise, every year. He said that Comrade Kim Jong Il developed and enriched the Juche idea and devoted his all to the country's prosperity and the people's happiness. He praised Kim Jong Il as an outstanding state leader who laid the firm groundwork for building a powerful socialist country at a time when the country faced harsh trials, and markedly boosted the political and military power of the DPRK. The world progressives pay the highest tribute to Kim Jong Il together with the Korean people, he stressed. Vadim Kudimin, director of the Russian Institute of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, and Dmitri Remizov, chairman of the Rostov Association for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism of Russia, said that it was thanks to the energetic leadership of Kim Jong Il that the Korean People's Army developed into an invincible powerful army and the DPRK turned into a politico-ideological power and military power. They stressed that Kim Jong Il who performed great exploits for the prosperity of Juche Korea and the development of the global revolution will be alive in the hearts of humankind. A message to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un was adopted at the seminar. Rodong Sinmun

title: Seminars on Chairman Kim Jong Il's Exploits Held Abroad
body: Seminars on the exploits of Chairman Kim Jong Il took place in Romania, UK and Bangladesh on December 3 and 4 on the occasion of the 10th anniversary of his demise. The chairman of the Supreme Council of the National Socialist Party of Romania praised Comrade Kim Jong Il as an outstanding leader who showed the Korean people and the world progressive peoples how to defend and glorify socialism with his noble practical examples. Though 10 years have passed since Kim Jong Il demised, he is alive in the hearts of humankind as he performed great exploits in the development of the socialist cause and the independent cause against imperialism, the chairman added. The general secretary of the Central Committee of the New Communist Party of Britain said that Comrade Kim Jong Il wisely led the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and the people to the road of socialism in the period of the severest trial, adding that thanks to his energetic leadership the WPK firmly consolidated the single-minded unity of the whole society amid absolute support and trust of the people and fully demonstrated the might of the invincible party while overcoming all difficulties and ordeals. The general secretary and members of the Bangladesh Institute of the Juche Idea said that H.E. Kim Jong Il dedicated himself to the people, proceeding from the creed that one should bring a flower into bloom even on a rock if the people want it. They noted that H.E. Kim Jong Il never allowed himself any benefits all his life, saying that the idea of "The People Are God" which he applied throughout life more clearly shows the international society his personality as the true son of the people and genuine leader of the people. Rodong Sinmun

title: On Way of Devotion to Building Thriving Country
body: Boldly Break with Previous Standard! One August day a few years ago, the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited a machine factory. That day, he saw the latest machine products assembled by the factory and praised for making them well by its own strength and technology. He said that the factory should carry out its assignments without fail by normalizing the production and soundly prepare for attaining the higher production goal. His teachings with trust inspired officials with confidence. The respected General Secretary emphasized that the factory must boldly break with previous standard in the development of new products and production as there were talented technicians and working class strong in revolutionary spirit. Boldly break with previous standard! Reflected in his significant word was the great trust of the respected General Secretary wishing the factory to take the lead in implementing the Party’s economic policy by bringing about a fresh leap in the production of modern machines. One’s Own Technique Is Genuine Technique Once, the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited the then Central Mushroom Institute under State Academy of Sciences. The respected General Secretary acquainted himself in detail with characteristic features of the equipment which the scientists and technicians there manufactured and installed by their own efforts. Highly appreciating the cutting-edge equipment he noted it was glad to see the newly built modern central mushroom institute, and yet he was more pleased with painstaking endeavor of our scientists and technicians to carry out the Party’s instructions to sweep away proclivity to import. That day the respected General Secretary added that it was the genuine technique with which they could do something useful. Indeed, his precious teaching contained the true definition of self-reliance and self-development which means to strengthen one’s own scientific and technical force and promote nation’s science and technology by relying on it serves the best. Rodong Sinmun

title: Expanding Achievements Gained in Construction of Major Projects
body: Officials and working people of North Hwanghae Province go all out to implement the Party’s decisions by successively completing major construction projects for local development and improvement of people’s living standard. This year they finished the construction of the Jongbangsan Hotel, the Sariwon Branch of Institute of Pomiculture of Academy of Agricultural Science, a new veterinary medicine production base of the provincial anti-epizootic center and the Kwangmyong Daily Necessities Factory in Sungho County by waging an all-out struggle for implementing the Party’s decisions. They also successfully completed the first stage of modernization of the Sariwon Tractor Parts Factory and the construction of public and production buildings in Taechong-ri in Unpha County. They newly built hundreds of rural dwellings in the Province. The officials and working people have launched a loyal offensive, a fierce struggle and a resolute lightning campaign to spruce up the villages of the feed supply farms under the Kwangchon Chicken Farm. The constructions of the gymnasium in sports village and the quality analysis station in the Province are near completion amid the campaign for swapping experience, overtaking and learning from others. The construction of camping buildings for study tour teams in the Sariwon Revolutionary Site, the sewage purification plant and the Kumchon Snapping Turtle Farm keeps progressing at high speed. Rodong Sinmun

title: Absolute Criterion for Evaluation
body: In November Juche 110(2021), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited Samjiyon City. He said that he felt a glow of pride in having done a worthwhile work welcomed by the people, upon hearing a report that the people in the land of Samjiyon were very happy over the change in Samjiyon and they were singing highly of the benevolence of our Party. He added that people’s opinion was precisely the general evaluation of the construction of Samjiyon City, repeatedly expressing great satisfaction. People’s opinion is precisely the general evaluation of the construction of Samjiyon City! This means all creatures can be regarded worthwhile only when they are favored by the people who will use them and the criterion for evaluation of every work lies in the people’s appreciation. In October several years ago, the respected General Secretary visited the then Paekhak-dong in Sonbong District of Rason City which was newly built as a socialist fairyland after being flooded. At that time he solemnly said that he and all officials must always listen to the people’s voice and regard it as their criterion. Thus, the respected General Secretary has always instructed officials to always listen to the people and regard the people’s demands as their absolute criterion. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Wreath to Bier of Late Om Ha Jin
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un sent a wreath to the bier of Om Ha Jin, former curator of the Juche-oriented Musical Art Museum who is winner of Kim Il Sung Prize and People's Artist, expressing deep condolences over his death. Om Ha Jin became a talented composer and a senior official in the field of art creation under the care of our Party and contributed to the development of the Juche-oriented musical art for decades by producing a lot of famous songs in the era including "Our Leader", "We Will Never Forget" and "Long Live the Workers' Party of Korea". The wreath from Kim Jong Un was placed before the bier of the deceased on Dec. 14. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Wreath to Bier of Late Kim Yong Ju
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un sent a wreath to the bier of Kim Yong Ju, former honorary vice-chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly who is the winner of Order of Kim Il Sung and Order of Kim Jong Il and Hero of the Republic, expressing deep condolences over his death. Kim Yong Ju devotedly struggled to implement the Party's lines and policies and made a contribution to accelerating socialist construction and developing the Korean-style state social system, while working at important posts of the Party and the state for many years. The wreath from Kim Jong Un was placed before the bier of the deceased on Dec. 14. Rodong Sinmun

title: Provincial Exhibition of Consumer Goods
body: A South Hamgyong Provincial exhibition of consumer goods was opened at the provincial sci-tech library in Hamhung City on Dec. 10. Light industrial factories and enterprises and lots of daily-necessaries making units in the province are taking part in the exhibition and more than 75 000 consumer goods of 570-odd kinds are on display. Distinguished among them are light industrial units associated with the leadership exploits of the peerlessly great persons which have concentrated on increasing the proportion of locally available raw and other materials and on recycling. Rodong Sinmun

title: Birthday Spread to Centenarian
body: There is an increasing number of people enjoying a long happy life in the DPRK thanks to the Korean-style socialist system centered on the masses. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un sent a birthday spread to Ri Pun Nyo, a woman centenarian living in Sangso-ri of Hyangsan County, North Phyongan Province. Ri had to undergo hardships with the sorrow of statelessness under the colonial rule of the Japanese imperialists before Korea's liberation, but she has enjoyed a worthwhile life since President Kim Il Sung liberated the country. She devoted herself to farming for the sole purpose of adding luster to the socialist country, which made her the owner of land and the master of the country, with success in grain production. She is revered for bringing all her children up to be fine persons. She leads an optimistic life, tending flowerpots and cultivating a vegetable garden. Rodong Sinmun

title: Dozens of Model Schools Built or Remodeled at Final Stage
body: South Phyongan Province makes endeavors to improve conditions and environment for education and registers successes. Here, dozens of model schools are being built or remodeled at the final stage. Under the guidance of the provincial Party committee, the province mapped out a detailed plan for building and remodeling model schools and made political and organizational arrangements to this end. It made cities and counties push forward the projects as scheduled and fully satisfy the requirements of building operations. It arranged socialist emulations among cities and counties and regularly generalized excellent experiences gained in Sunchon City, Maengsan County and the like to rev up campaigns in which one overtakes and learns from others and swaps experience. In this way, the model school construction and remodeling gather momentum in the province. Rodong Sinmun

title: Seeing Children Smiling Brightly
body: In July, Juche 107(2018), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un inspected the Chongjin Bag Factory during his field guidance in spite of the scorching heat of the dog days. He dropped in at the exhibition room and had a look at the schoolbag for girls. Then he said that more sponges had to be filled in the shoulder straps and that, in particular, twice as much sponge had to be filled in the parts directly touching the shoulders lest schoolchildren should feel pain if they carried heavy bags on their shoulders. He told officials that the textbooks, notebooks, uniforms and bags were all essential to schoolchildren but among them he paid special attention to the bags and uniforms and gave them priority. He taught that bag accessories had to be sewn with short stitches so that the stitches remained unloosened or unbroken however roughly the kids might handle their bags and that the bag producers had to lend an ear to public opinions and constantly improve the quality of their products as demanded by the people. The respected General Secretary, at the 3rd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea, noted that it has to be the way of advance and development of our revolution to exert more sincerity to children even the condition becomes worse and to take dynamic steps forward towards the future of communism with the might of that love. Indeed, our children are so happy with their benevolent father who takes care of them through thick and thin. Rodong Sinmun

title: In Course of Training Genuine Patriots
body: Real Meaning He Taught in Practice The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited Mangyongdae Revolutionary School on the significant Tree-planting Day four years ago. That day, patriotism is a noble spirit of valuing even a tree in the country and devoting oneself and one’s sincerity to cultivating it, not the abstract concept, he said, adding that the students of the school could deeply keep in their mind Kim Jong Il’s patriotism in the course of planting even a tree with their own hands and kindly cultivating it. His teachings reflected that it is just patriotism to help the country in practice, not in words or letters. Saying that the students’ patriotism would grow up together with the trees they planted, he stressed that only when one has warm love for the country, one can become a true patriot and a genuine official desired by the Party who does the work for prosperity of the country for oneself at any post assigned by the Party in the future. He taught the students in a way easy to understand, saying it is possible to ensure the rate of rooting when trees are planted in line with the scientific and technical requirements and what is important in tree planting is not how many trees are planted but how many trees are rooted, and personally planted trees for a long time, ranging from digging holes to watering and tamping. Indeed, a lot of patriots come into being thanks to the great care of the respected General Secretary who has kindled the flame of patriotism in mind of the people in great practice and led them step by step to uphold the country. Patriotism Must Be Displayed from Childhood One July day in Juche 107 (2018), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited the Wonsan Disabled Soldiers’ Bag Factory, regardless of the sultry weather of the hottest period. Giving detailed instructions on issues arising in the bag production,he said that it was a consistent policy of our Party to bring up rising generations to be reliable successors. He earnestly told that our Party set forth an idea of attaching importance to the education of the rising generations and has waged a struggle for providing all the children and students with school things, school bags and school uniforms to train them as pillars of the country, with nothing to envy in the world, while enjoying the benefits of the socialist system. That day, he said that it was the intention of our party to provide them with home-made quality notebooks, school bags, school things and school uniforms so as to make them cherish patriotism of taking their own things dear to them and loving them since their childhood and repeatedly asked the officials and employees of bag factories across the country to work heart and soul with devotion to make quality bags with sincerity of a mother making bags for her own children. Looking up to the benevolent image of the respected General Secretary, the accompanying officials again cherished deeply in mind his patriotic will. Rodong Sinmun

title: Session of SPA of DPRK to Be Convened
body: The 6th Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly (SPA) of the DPRK will be convened in Pyongyang on February 6, Juche 111 (2022). A relevant decision of the Standing Committee of the SPA was adopted on December 14. According to an official notice on convening the SPA session issued on the same day, the 6th Session of the 14th SPA will have discussions of the issue of the work of the Cabinet in Juche 110 (2021) and its task for Juche 111 (2022), the issue of the fulfillment of the state budget for Juche 110 (2021) and the state budget for Juche 111 (2022), and the issue of adopting the law on childcare and the law on the protection of the rights and interests of overseas compatriots. The notice said that there will be the registration of deputies on Feb. 5, Juche 111 (2022). Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Reply Message from Lao President
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, received a reply message from Thongloun Sisoulith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party (LPRP) and president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic (LPDR), on Dec. 13. In the reply message, Thongloun Sisoulith expressed heartfelt thanks on behalf of the LPRP Central Committee and the LPDR government and people and on his own behalf to Kim Jong Un for sending warm congratulations and the best wishes that became a great encouragement to the LPRP, the Lao government and people and him on the occasion of the 46th anniversary of the founding of the LPDR. The message expressed the belief that the DPRK would continue to make greater fresh success in defending the country, accomplishing the cause of building a powerful socialist country and improving the people's standard of living, under the leadership of Kim Jong Un. In the message Thongloun Sisoulith said that he was so pleased over the fact that the bilateral friendly and cooperative relations with fine traditions brought the two peoples substantial interests and steadily strengthened in keeping with the regional and global peace, stability, cooperation and development. The message wished Kim Jong Un good health and happiness and greater success in his noble work. Rodong Sinmun

title: Agricultural Workers Commemorate Demise Anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Agricultural workers and members of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea (UAWK) held a meeting in memory of Chairman Kim Jong Il at the Oguk Co-op Farm in Anak County of South Hwanghae Province on Tuesday on the occasion of the 10th anniversary of his demise. Speakers at the meeting said that Kim Jong Il devoted his whole life to turning the countryside across the country into an ideal land good to live and work on. They noted that they can never forget the loving care shown by Kim Jong Il who was pleased than ever before, sent a message of thanks and put them on the meridian of glory when they over-fulfilled the grain production plan every year while overcoming manifold trials and hardships by dint of the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance. They said that the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un has ushered in a new history of golden fields on this land, true to the high intention of Kim Jong Il who devoted his efforts and energy to the agricultural development of the country. They stressed that regarding the behests of Kim Jong Il as lifeline they would bring a rich harvest to every field as befits frontline soldiers defending the socialist country in the same fighting spirit as was displayed by the patriotic farmers of the preceding generations. Attending the meeting were Ri Tu Song, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Han Jong Hyok, chairman of the Central Committee of the UAWK, Pak Thae Sop, secretary of the South Hwanghae Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials concerned, and agricultural workers of the Oguk Co-op Farm. Rodong Sinmun

title: Brisk Recycling
body: True to the intention of the Workers’ Party of Korea, the recycling is gaining momentum in North Phyongan Province. The province makes the cities, counties, factories and enterprises succeed in recycling by exchanging and sharing good experiences gained with the zeal for emulation between them. On the basis of holding fast to recycling as a main factor in normalizing the production, the Sinuiju Bag Factory wages a vigorous struggle to develop and produce various kinds of new goods. The factory produces itself the plastic lead line necessary for the bag production by making use of waste materials and makes useful tens of kinds of goods with scraps of bag, while equipping with the production process of compressed sponge in recent years. The Sinuiju Textile Mill pays big efforts to recycling. The factory, which manufactures and installs necessary facilities with the help of its technicians and skilled workers, boosts the production by recycling waste materials like cotton waste and rag. Meanwhile, amid the daily growing zeal for emulation between cities and counties for recycling, the Changsong Jute Bag Factory has increased its production based on well-arranged recycling process by its own efforts and technology. Similar successes have been made in many units including local industrial establishments in Kwaksan, Thaechon, Tongrim and Unsan counties. Rodong Sinmun

title: By Consolidating Building Materials Production Base
body: In Ryanggang Province they are directing more efforts to strengthening building materials production base. In hearty response to the decisions made at the 8th Congress of the Workers’ Party of Korea they meticulously organized the economic work for increased production by consolidating building materials production base dependent on their own locally available materials. They dynamically pushed forward the work for establishing rational producing line and assigning the skilled and experienced technicians to the right posts while enlisting all the locally available materials. At the Hyesan Cement Factory they have accelerated the work for increased cement production by exploiting large amount of limestone which is abundant in the region. They have increased the production capacity much larger than before by introducing advanced burning method and prioritizing technical updating of the over-all production lines. At the Hyesan Finishing Building Materials Factory and Hyesan Jaegyong Fixtures Manufactory they have established production bases on which they can annually produce a large amount of setting accelerators, various kinds of paints, etc. with use of locally abundant resources. In Samsu County and other counties they have exploited building stones resources and introduced rational processing methods to produce various kinds of building materials. In the province they open up bright prospects for vigorously accelerating local construction while continuously putting spurs to consolidating building materials production base dependent on locally available materials. Rodong Sinmun

title: Eternal Father of People
body: For our people Chairman Kim Jong Il was rather the benevolent father of the large family of our country than the leader. There are words deeply inscribed in the mind of all our people. Family of General, these words bear the pride and dignity of life through which we carried out the revolution upholding the peerlessly great man as the father of the nation as well as the burning desire and intensive aspiration of our people to venerate Chairman Kim Jong Il as the eternal father of our people for all ages. The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un said with deep emotion that believing in people as in heaven was the Chairman’s lifetime motto and his noble intention and will cherished deep in his mind that one should pluck even a star and bring a flower into bloom even on a rock if the people want. Together with December we bear in mind the glory and happiness and matchless pride and self-confidence of having made the revolution under the leadership of the Chairman, the great leader of our people and the benevolent father. In any storm and stress, our people will invariably continue to go along the road of revolution to the end, keeping in mind the ties of kinship with the Chairman, though one generation is replaced with another. Our people will surely achieve all sorts of happiness envied by the world, sharing their destiny with the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un as members of the family of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Rodong Sinmun

title: Dynamically Pushing Forward River Improvement Work
body: Officials and working people in Jagang Province strive to bring about a fundamental improvement in land administration work true to the decisions of the Third Enlarged Meeting of the Political Bureau of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea. In particular, they have mapped out detailed plans for river improvement and made endeavors to that end. Take the arrangement of the surroundings of Hungju Youth Power Station No. 5 for instance. Officials in the province, aware that what counts in land administration is none other than ideological viewpoint, went among the masses of the people and reminded them of the significance of land administration, thus evoking their enthusiasm. Besides, the officials allotted clear assignments to every unit and reviewed the results in a rigid manner. Consequently, the big project was concluded in fifteen days. Tongsin County, Manpho City and other cities and counties actively encouraged the people and secured what they needed by themselves in their land administration project. Officials in Rangrim County checked over the situation of their land administration and made arrangements after setting an ambitious river improvement goal. It was a huge project but they made desperate efforts to effect a decisive turn in land administration with priority given to materials supply. Their hard work paid off. Rodong Sinmun

title: Letter to Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un from AINDF
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a letter from the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front (AINDF) on Friday, the greatest memorial day of the nation. The letter said that strong yearnings for the great Chairman of the National Defence Commission Kim Jong Il pervade the whole 3 000-ri country from Mt Paektu to Mt Halla on the memorial day in December. On the day, the AINDF prayed for the eternal life of Kim Jong Il, carrying the deep respect and yearnings for him of the vanguard fighters and the patriotic people from all walks of life in the south, the letter noted. The past 10 years were the days of solemn emotion which helped all the fellow countrymen harden the faith that Kim Jong Il is always alive as there is the respected President of the State Affairs Kim Jong Un, a peerlessly great man born of Heaven, the letter said. Being convinced as the iron truth of history that there will be the bright future of Juche Korea and the prosperity of the reunified nation as there is Kim Jong Un, the AINDF and all the patriotic people renewed their pledge to keep to the path of independent reunification under his leadership in single mind, the letter added. It stressed that they would consolidate as firm as a rock the AINDF as ranks of passionate loyalists and an invincible vanguard organization following and upholding Kim Jong Un only and further speed up the struggle for the realization of national independence under the uplifted banner of the immortal Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism. Rodong Sinmun

title: Memorial Service for Chairman Kim Jong Il Held at DPRK Embassy in China
body: A memorial service was held at the DPRK embassy in Beijing on Dec. 16 on the occasion of the 10th anniversary of the demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Attending it were Wang Chen, vice-chairman of the Standing Committee of the Chinese National People's Congress who is a member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC), and officials of the party, government and social organizations of China. The participants placed a floral basket in the name of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China before the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and observed a moment's silence in memory of the Chairman. Then they looked round the pictures showing the revolutionary career of Chairman Kim Jong Il and the undying feats performed by Kim Jong Il and the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un in developing the DPRK-China friendly relations. Wang Chen asked DPRK Ambassador Ri Ryong Nam to convey the warm greetings and best wishes of Xi Jinping, general secretary of the CPC Central Committee, to Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). Wang Chen said that he, upon authorization of the C.C., CPC, visited the DPRK embassy. He said that Chairman Kim Jong Il, who devoted all his life to the prosperity of the DPRK and the people's happiness and made a great contribution to the development of the China-DPRK friendly relations, will be alive in the hearts of the peoples of the two countries. He said that the traditional China-DPRK friendship serves as precious wealth for both sides, expressing the firm stand of the Chinese side to propel the steady development of the China-DPRK friendly ties by thoroughly implementing the joint understanding of the top leaders of the two parties. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Basket to C.C., WPK from C.C., CPC
body: The Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC) sent a floral basket to the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) on the occasion of the 10th anniversary of the demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Chinese Ambassador to the DPRK Li Jinjun conveyed the floral basket to Han Man Hyok, vice department director of the WPK Central Committee, on Thursday. Written on the ribbons of the basket were letters reading "Comrade Kim Jong Il will be immortal". Rodong Sinmun

title: Letter to Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un from General Association of Koreans in China
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a letter from the General Association of Koreans in China on Dec. 17, the greatest national memorial day. The letter paid noble tribute to Chairman Kim Jong Il who performed everlasting feats for the prosperity of the country and the nation. It praised the Chairman as the benevolent father of the nation who showed all sorts of loving care for the compatriots living in an alien country, always regarding them as members of Kim Il Sung's nation out of his noble, warm love for the nation and compatriots. Always kept in the hearts of all the fellow countrymen and mankind is the venerable image of the Chairman who did everything he could for the sake of the country and the nation, burning himself out till the last moments of his great life, and his undying revolutionary exploits will shine forever along with the socialist homeland, the letter stressed. It said that the Chairman's noble intention and desire come into reality thanks to Kim Jong Un. It noted that Kim Jong Un added eternal luster to the great revolutionary career and noble exploits of the Chairman, upholding him as the eternal sun of the nation with loyalty as pure as a white gem and opened up a new history of victory of Juche Korea by carrying forward without an inch of deflection the revolutionary idea and line of the Chairman. The letter stressed that the officials of the General Association of Koreans in China and all other Koreans in China would remain faithful to the leadership of Kim Jong Un with the unwavering faith that they will follow only him. Rodong Sinmun

title: ﻿Letter to Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un from Chongryon Central Standing Committee
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a letter from the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) on Dec. 17, the 10th anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's demise. The letter said that the committee paid the highest tribute to Kim Jong Il, the eternal leader of Juche Korea, wishing for his immortality. It lauded Kim Jong Il as a prominent great man and peerless patriot who developed the DPRK into a politico-ideological power of single-minded unity and an invincible military power and provided the eternal foundation for building a prosperous country by wisely guiding the Party and people with his rare leadership. He is an outstanding leader who developed Chongryon, organized by President Kim Il Sung, into a pioneer organization of patriots and model organization of overseas compatriots, and also the defender of the destinies of Chongryon and Korean residents in Japan, the letter said. It said that the last ten years when all the people have been out for the implementation of the behests of Kim Jong Il under the uplifted slogan of faith that "Chairman Kim Jong Il Will Always Be with Us" were the days of glory when his revolutionary idea and exploits shed bright rays with each passing day as the DPRK has held the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un in high esteem as the great sun. It noted that Kim Jong Un opened up new golden days for the movement of Koreans in Japan with his deep loving care while always standing by Chongryon organized by Kim Il Sung and led by Kim Jong Il. It stressed that they would uphold Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il forever as taught by Kim Jong Un, add luster to the idea of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il for building Chongryon and their leadership feats and adhere to the idea and feats as the great undying programme for the movement of Koreans in Japan. Rodong Sinmun

title: 60th Anniversary of Creation of Taean Work System Marked
body: A meeting in commemoration of the 60th anniversary of the creation of the Taean work system took place at the cultural hall of the Taean Heavy Machine Complex on Dec. 15. Visiting the then Taean Electric Appliances Factory in December Juche 50 (1961), President Kim Il Sung learned in detail about the party work, production guidance, equipment, material supply and welfare supply service there. Then he convened an enlarged meeting of the Political Committee of the Party Central Committee to take a revolutionary measure for setting up a Korean-style new industrial management system. After all, the Taean work system was created under his wise leadership, which made it possible to speed up the socialist economic construction by organically combining the Party political work with the administrative and economic work. True to the President's idea of economic management, Chairman Kim Jong Il wisely led the work to steadily display the advantages and vitality of the socialist economic management system of Juche. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un made public "On Some Tasks for Effecting a Turn in Economic Work" and other works to clearly expound the issues arising in improving the socialist economic management in line with the requirements of the developing reality. Under the guidance of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), the advantages of the Juche-based economic management system have been fully displayed over the last ten years to further strengthen the self-supporting foundation for the country's economy and the driving force for its development despite the hostile forces' vicious sanctions and blockade. Attending the meeting were O Su Yong, secretary of the WPK Central Committee, Pak Jong Gun, vice-premier of the Cabinet and chairman of the State Planning Commission, Kim Jong Nam, minister of Machine-building Industry, Ri Jae Nam, chief secretary of the Nampho City Committee of the Party, officials concerned, and officials and workers of the complex. Rodong Sinmun

title: Oath-taking Meeting of Young People
body: An oath-taking meeting was held by young people of the DPRK on Wednesday ahead of the 10th anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's demise. The meeting held before the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill was attended by Ri Tu Song, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials of the youth league and youths and students of Pyongyang. Before the meeting, the participants placed a floral basket and bouquets before the statues of the great leaders and paid high tribute to them. A report was made by Mun Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League, at the meeting, to be followed by speeches. Saying that the young vanguards' ardent yearning for Kim Jong Il grows all the more stronger in December, the reporter and speakers said that his revolutionary life is a noble history of attaching importance to and loving youth in which he dedicated his loving care to bringing up the young people to shoulder the destiny of the country and the nation. They stressed that the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un has given limitless strength and courage to the young people so that they can always march straight forward, following the Party and raised them up to be creators of legendary tales about the heroic youth and masters of a youth power. A letter of pledge was then read out at the meeting. The letter expressed the iron will of all youths in the country to glorify the immortal revolutionary careers of the peerlessly great men for all ages and build without fail a powerful socialist country where the noble desires and wishes of the President and the Chairman have been realized under the leadership of Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Workers Commemorate Demise Anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Workers and members of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea (GFTUK) held a meeting for telling stories about virtues of Chairman Kim Jong Il at the Central Hall of Workers on Wednesday on the occasion of the 10th anniversary of his demise. Present at the meeting were Ri Tu Song, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Pak In Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the GFTUK, Hong Chol Jin, secretary of the Pyongyang City Committee of the WPK, officials of the GFTUK and workers and GFTUK members in Pyongyang. Speakers at the meeting talked about the immortal devotion and efforts made by Chairman Kim Jong Il making ceaseless journey to provide more civilized and better living conditions to the people throughout the period of his revolutionary leadership. They expressed their unanimous determination to make innovations everywhere they work, not forgetting even a moment the immortal revolutionary life and exploits of the Chairman who devoted his all to the prosperity of the country and the happiness of posterity. Rodong Sinmun

title: Birthday Spread to Centenarian
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un sent a birthday spread to Ri Jong Ae living in Ryonggye-ri, Kyongwon County of North Hamgyong Province on her 100th birthday. She was born into a poor peasant family in the days of the Japanese occupation and experienced the painful grief of an enslaved nation. After the liberation of Korea, she could live a life of devotion to the new country founded by President Kim Il Sung. She returned the benevolence of the country with decades of dedicated farm work and even after retirement she continued to do work conducive to the economy of the country. Enjoying soy-bean food, she continues to do housework and tend her garden in good health with optimism. Rodong Sinmun

title: Message to Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un from Syrian President
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, received a message from Bashar Al-Assad, president of the Syrian Arab Republic, on Dec. 13. The message expressed deep condolences to Kim Jong Un and the people of the DPRK on the occasion of the 10th anniversary of the demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The message said that over the last decade, Kim Jong Un has enforced the politics of prioritizing the interests of the Korean people with his outstanding leadership and resolutely fought against all the pressure of the outsiders seeking to break the independent will of the DPRK. The Syrian president in the message expressed his will to strive together with Kim Jong Un to consolidate the historic friendly relations between the two countries and further strengthen the bilateral cooperation in all fields in the interests of the two peoples. Rodong Sinmun

title: Memorial Services for Chairman Kim Jong Il Held in DPRK
body: Memorial services for Chairman Kim Jong Il took place in every province, city (district) and county of the DPRK on Friday, the 10th anniversary of his demise. Attending them were officials of local party and power organs, working people's organizations, industrial establishments, farms, universities and other units and working people of all social strata and youth and students. The participants observed a moment's silence in memory of the Chairman with deep reverence for him. Memorial addresses were given at the services. Speakers expressed the highest respects to Kim Jong Il with boundless yearning and intense loyalty, saying that they are looking back upon the sacred revolutionary career and immortal revolutionary exploits of Kim Jong Il who devoted his life to the prosperity of the country and the happiness of the people on the occasion of the greatest memorial day of the nation. They said that for the last decade they have keenly realized how great and valuable the revolutionary exploits performed by the Chairman for the country and nation are, and more deeply cherished the high national pride and dignity of holding him in high esteem as the eternal leader of the Party and the revolution. They stressed that the beaming images of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il would be always kept in the hearts of the people no matter how much water may flow under the bridge and no matter how frequently a generation is replaced by another. The speakers called on the officials, Party members and working people to devotedly implement the instructions of the Chairman and go all out for implementing the decisions made at the historic 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea, true to the idea and leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Korean People Pay Silent Tribute to Memory of Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: All the people in the DPRK greatly miss and revere Chairman Kim Jong Il on the occasion of the 10th anniversary of his demise. The national flag was hung at half-mast at all units including institutions, enterprises and factories at all levels and farms, fishing villages and schools in Pyongyang and provinces and at the far-off guard posts. An endless stream of people with profound respect for the Chairman, who devoted all his life to the country and the people, socialism and world independence, visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill in the capital city of Pyongyang and the statues of the great leaders, mosaics portraying their smiling images, towers to the immortality of the great leaders, revolutionary battle sites, revolutionary sites and monuments to the field guidance by the great leaders across the country. At noon on December 17, the greatest memorial day of the nation, sirens blared simultaneously across the country. Vehicles and locomotives stopped to blow horns and the sound of sirens were heard in all cities and villages and at all units including worksites. All party members, civilians and service personnel simultaneously paid a silent tribute towards the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the sacred temple of Juche where the Chairman lies in state, for three minutes. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of Great Leaders
body: Working people, servicepersons and schoolchildren in the DPRK laid floral baskets and bunches of flowers before the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and mosaics depicting their smiling images across the country on Friday, the 10th anniversary of demise of Kim Jong Il. Floral baskets in the names of the Party, power and armed forces organs, social organizations, ministries, national institutions, units of the Korean People's Army (KPA) and the Public Security Forces (PSF) and organs, enterprises, factories, universities at all levels, etc. in Pyongyang City were placed before the statues of the President and the Chairman on Mansu Hill. A floral basket in the name of the Pyongyang mission of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front was laid before the statues. The visitors made deep bows before the statues. Bouquets and floral baskets in the names of different organs, enterprises, units of KPA and PSF were placed before the statues of the great leaders and mosaics portraying their smiling images in different places of Pyongyang including Kim Il Sung University, the Ministry of National Defence, the Ministry of Public Security and the Mansudae Art Studio.
