Working people, service personnel and schoolchildren across the country visited the statues of the great leaders and mosaics portraying their smiling images in their residential areas to pay high tribute. Rodong Sinmun

title: Large Floral Baskets to DPRK Embassy from Cambodian King and Great Queen
body: Cambodian King Norodom Sihamoni and Great Queen Norodom Monineath Sihanouk sent large floral baskets to the DPRK embassy in Phnom Penh on December 16 on the occasion of the 10th anniversary of demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Upon authorization of the king and the great queen, a delegation of the Cambodian Ministry of the Royal Palace led by Kong Sam Ol, deputy prime minister for the Royal Palace, laid the floral baskets and made a bow before the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. Rodong Sinmun

title: Foreign Diplomats Pay Floral Tribute to Statues of Great Leaders
body: The diplomatic corps here laid a floral basket before the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on Friday, the 10th anniversary of Kim Jong Il's demise. After laying the floral basket, the visitors made a bow before the statues of the great leaders. On the same day, members of the Vietnam and Lao embassies here placed floral baskets and bouquets before the statues. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Will Always Be with Our People: Choe Ryong Hae in Memorial Address
body: Chairman Kim Jong Il will always be with us and a powerful socialist country desired by him will surely be built as there is the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. This is the revolutionary faith cherished by our people through the last decade-long struggle. Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, said this in an address made at the national memorial service commemorating the 10th anniversary of demise of Kim Jong Il on Friday. Choe Ryong Hae in his address said that the revolutionary life of Kim Jong Il is the shining one of an outstanding leader and peerless patriot who firmly defended the destinies of the country and the people and put socialist Korea on the position of a dignified powerful country by covering the stern untrodden path of history. Kim Jong Il is the eternal sun of the people who will be always alive in the hearts of the people for his sacred revolutionary life and great revolutionary feats dedicated to the country and the nation, the era and humankind, the speaker noted, and went on: It is one of the immortal feats performed by Kim Jong Il before the history that he firmly defended the socialist country of Juche founded and glorified by President Kim Il Sung. Along with the immortal august name of Kim Il Sung, the august name of Kim Jong Il is deeply carved on the course of brilliant victories of the DPRK which has defended its rights and interests as a sovereign state and the dignity of socialism, smashing all the arbitrary practices, interference and aggression moves of powers. There were many famous statesmen and strategists in the world, but Kim Jong Il is the only great man of the century and legendary hero as he saved the country and the nation and socialism, frustrating the unprecedented pressure and blockade in the fight against the imperialist allied forces whose territories, populations and economic and military capabilities are incomparably greater. He created a history of victory of war in the only country on the planet that has been exposed to the unprecedented political and military pressure and economic sanctions for over half a century, and honorably defended the DPRK, the socialist homeland of Juche. His personality as a peerlessly great man is shining brilliantly in the hearts of the Korean people as a national hero and a symbol of the victory of socialism. He made the country a dignified power by performing epoch-making miracles in building a thriving nation. It is one of Kim Jong Il's immortal historic feats that he turned the DPRK into a single-mindedly united politico-ideological power. He formulated the revolutionary idea of President Kim Il Sung as Kimilsungism and set the idea of modeling the whole society on Kimilsungism as the Party's supreme programme. This became a turning point in building an invincible party united by one thought and purpose and in opening up a new age of single-minded unity. The single-mindedly united DPRK which advances with one goal, one purpose and at one pace first emerged in history and fully displayed its beauty and inexhaustible strength thanks to Kim Jong Il. He was an iron-willed commander who steered the trend of history while holding the formidable enemies at bay amid the upheaval of the times. He was also a tender-hearted man who was thoughtful of the people's pains and shed lots of tears, and a benevolent father who loved the young people and children of the country very much. Another of his undying historic feats is that he consolidated the potentials for our state's independent development. Always cherishing the noble intention and strong will of the President who held high the banner of self-reliance in the earliest period of nation-building and on the ruins after the war, he had worked heart and soul to build up the self-reliant defence capability and the solid foundation for the self-supporting economy. Setting it as the supreme task of the nation to reunify Korea, Kim Jong Il made successive weighty decisions to put an end to the tragedy of national division, thus ceaselessly inspiring the enthusiasm for national reunification. He also smashed all challenges and obstructive moves by anti-reunification forces and opened up a new era of independent reunification advancing in the idea of By Our Nation Itself under the uplifted banner of the three charters for national reunification. Kim Jong Il, a world-renowned elder statesman, set forth the strategy and tactics for realizing the global independence and made energetic external activities for independence against imperialism and for socialism, the world peace and friendship and solidarity among the peoples, thus considerably raising the international prestige and influence of the DPRK and making a great contribution to the accomplishment of the human cause of independence. Kim Jong Il's sacred revolutionary career our people more deeply keep in their hearts with the passage of the times is an immortal biography of the greatest leader and the greatest man in the human history and a precious textbook of life and struggle to be always read by anyone who wants to be guided by justice, truth and patriotism. To carry on the long journey of the revolution to the end generation after generation, the Chairman put forward the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, boundlessly revered and absolutely trusted by all the Party members, people and service personnel of the People's Army, as the guide of the Juche revolution and entrusted the future and the destiny of the socialist country and its people to him. After the demise of the Chairman, the biggest loss to our nation, our people bade their last farewell to him, grieving over his demise in tears. But for the past decade they have never thought that he is not with them. Our nation and state are as ever the great Kim Il Sung's nation and Kim Jong Il's Korea and all of us are the descendents of Kim Il Sung and soldiers and disciples of Kim Jong Il. No matter how much water may flow under the bridge and how frequently a generation may be replaced by another, we should always keep in our hearts the beaming images of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il and remain faithful to the revolutionary cause of the great leaders to the end. The cause of building a powerful socialist country, the revolutionary cause of Juche associated with the whole life of Kim Jong Il, will be certainly accomplished as the valuable revolutionary legacy bequeathed by Kim Jong Il shines as the eternal treasure and there is the tested guidance of the WPK. Choe Ryong Hae called upon all to wage a dynamic struggle for a brilliant new victory of socialism and steady advance of the Juche revolution under the leadership of Kim Jong Un, holding Kim Jong Il in high esteem as the eternal sun of Juche. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Memorial Service for Chairman Kim Jong Il Held
body: Deep yearning and reverence of all the people across the country for Chairman Kim Jong Il, the eternal leader of our Party and people and great sage of the revolution, pervade the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the sacred temple of Juche, on the greatest national memorial day. The whole life of Kim Jong Il who paved an untrodden thorny path with the iron will and superhuman energy, holding aloft the red flag of Juche from the first days of his great revolutionary leadership to the last moment of his life, shines as the noble revolutionary life of the outstanding leader and peerless patriot who dedicated his all to the eternal prosperity of socialist Korea, happiness of the people and accomplishment of the revolutionary cause of Juche. Over the last ten years in which the holy history of the cause of perpetuating the memory of the leader has been given a steady continuity, our people have confidently advanced the socialist cause of Juche while creating epoch-making changes to be specially recorded in the 5 000-year-old national history under the guidance of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, cherishing the august name of the sun of Kim Jong Il as the banner of invincibility and regarding his behests as the lifeline. A national memorial service for Chairman Kim Jong Il took place at the plaza of the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun in a solemn atmosphere on December 17, the 10th anniversary of his demise. Attending the service were officials of the Party and power organs, working people's organizations, ministries, national institutions and armed forces organs, service personnel of the Korean People's Army and the Public Security Forces, officials and working people in Pyongyang City. The venue of the service where the portrait of smiling Kim Jong Il was displayed was wrapped in the most solemn atmosphere. Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, took the platform of honor. Accompanying him were Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, Jo Yong Won, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretary for Organizational Affairs of the WPK Central Committee, Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, and Pak Jong Chon, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK. Seen on the platform were Ri Il Hwan, Jong Sang Hak, O Su Yong, Thae Hyong Chol, Kim Jae Ryong, O Il Jong, Kim Yong Chol, Jong Kyong Thaek, Kim Yo Jong, Kim Song Nam, Ho Chol Man, Pak Thae Tok, Kim Hyong Sik, Yu Jin, Pak Myong Sun, Ri Chol Man, Jon Hyon Chol, Pak Jong Gun, Yang Sung Ho, Ju Chol Gyu, Ri Son Gwon, U Sang Chol and Kim Yong Hwan who are senior officials of the Party and the government, Pak Yong Il, chairman of the Central Committee of the Korean Social Democratic Party, and officials and persons of distinguished services who set examples in carrying out the behests of Chairman Kim Jong Il and the tasks for the first year of the five-year plan set forth at the 8th Party Congress. Taking the platform were also officials of the armed forces organs including Kwon Yong Jin and Ri Yong Gil. Ri Il Hwan, member of the Political Bureau and secretary of the C.C., WPK, declared the national memorial service open. All the participants observed a moment's silence in memory of Chairman Kim Jong Il with deepest reverence. The "Song of General Kim Jong Il" was played there. Choe Ryong Hae made a memorial address "The great leader Comrade Kim Jong Il will always be with our people". The speaker said that after starting his unusual life in Mt Paektu, the sacred mountain of the revolution, Kim Jong Il set it as his lifelong cause to build a powerful and prosperous people's country on this land and devoted all his life to the struggle for realizing it. He highly praised the immortal revolutionary feats of Kim Jong Il who firmly defended the country, the nation and socialism of Juche with his firm faith in independence and iron pluck throughout the period of his revolutionary leadership and created epochal miracles in building a powerful country to put our country on the position of a dignified power. Kim Jong Il is always with us, and the powerful socialist country wished for by him will surely be built as there is the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. This is a revolutionary faith kept deep by our people through the past decade-long struggle, the speaker stressed. The speaker called on all the Party members, other people and service personnel of the People's Army to uphold Kim Jong Il as the eternal sun of Juche and vigorously struggle for a new brilliant victory of socialism and for steady advance of the Juche revolution under the leadership of Kim Jong Un. The memorial service ended with playing of the song "The General Is Immortal as the Sun". A gun volley for the dead was fired in memory of Kim Jong Il. All the participants paid a silent tribute to the memory of Kim Jong Il with their firm faith and will to add eternal luster to his noble revolutionary career and undying revolutionary exploits for all ages. Only victory and glory will be in store for our people dashing forward to accomplish the revolutionary cause of Juche while adding eternal shine to the era of our state-first principle true to the idea and leadership of Kim Jong Un with single mind. Political News Team

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Visits Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: All the people in the DPRK greatly missing Chairman Kim Jong Il, the venerable image of socialist Korea, look back upon his life with the deepest reverence for him on the occasion of the 10th anniversary of his demise. The first decade since his demise witnessed their sacred struggle for realizing his desire for building a powerful nation under the wise guidance of the Party Central Committee that opened up a new chapter of the leader's immortality. During the struggle they keenly realized the greatness of the revolutionary exploits of the peerlessly great man for the country, the nation and humankind, hardening their belief that the history of the tender-hearted leader will go on forever. Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on December 17, the greatest national memorial day. Accompanying him were Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, Jo Yong Won, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretary for Organizational Affairs of the WPK Central Committee, Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, Pak Jong Chon, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, and other senior officials of the Party and the government and leading officials of the ministries and national institutions. Leading officials of the armed forces organs were present there. The palace, where President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, the eternal leaders of the dignified Party, state and people of the DPRK and the great sages of the revolution, lie in state, was wrapped in the most solemn atmosphere. Placed at the statues of the President and the Chairman was a floral basket on behalf of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. Laid before the statues were floral baskets in the names of the WPK Central Committee, the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK and the Cabinet of the DPRK. Kim Jong Un, together with other visitors, made a deep bow before the statues of the great leaders. At the hall, where Chairman Kim Jong Il lies in state, the General Secretary paid homage to him as a token of his best wishes for immortality to the Chairman who laid a solid foundation for eternal dignity and prosperity by dedicating all his life to the sacred cause for the country and people under the uplifted red flag of Juche. Senior officials of the Party and the government renewed their firm pledge to fulfill the honorable mission and duty entrusted to them by the times and the revolution in the ongoing grand struggle for powerfully propelling the comprehensive development of socialist construction by increasing the strong power with which they pioneered the era of our state-first principle under the guidance of Kim Jong Un, cherishing deep in their hearts the beaming image of the Chairman. Political News Team

title: We Are Soldiers and Followers of Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: We are the soldiers and followers of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Soldiers of Chairman Kim Jong Il! Followers of Chairman Kim Jong Il! These titles reflect the great honor, pride, dignity and happiness of the people who have made the new history of victory and glory following the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un for the last ten years of hardship. We grew up to be revolutionaries and fighters under the care of the Chairman and learnt about the Party and the country, how to make the revolution and struggle and how to lead a genuine life. Everything turned out well when we did them as taught by the Chairman, no matter where we were and who we were. That’s why we call ourselves eternal soldiers and followers of the Chairman and make a hearty resolve to remain loyal to him till our last moments and the end of the Earth and to learn what we need from his ideology and achievements. The Chairman’s soldiers and followers! It is the respected General Secretary who enabled us to enjoy this great glory generation after generation. With him in the van of revolution, we add luster to our glory of the Chairman’s soldiers and followers despite the unprecedentedly harsh trials. As we hold in high esteem the respected General Secretary who warmly embraces us, the eternal solders and followers of the Chairman, and brings us up, the victory of the revolutionary cause of Juche is a science. Rodong Sinmun

title: Teaching Immovable Truth of Patriotism
body: A few years ago, the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited a factory. He made an inspection of the factory which had undergone the second-stage project for capacity expansion. He was rejoiced to learn that the factory’s products were as high-quality as the exotic ones. The factory’s senior official informed him with respect that, when they completed the lines for producing all sorts of finishing building materials, the officials and employees hugged each other and hurrahed for self-reliance out of delight. Then the respected General Secretary responded with satisfaction that they could readily do everything by themselves as they wished. That day, he highly appreciated that the officials there studied about their work, mapped out plans and made strenuous efforts, thus making achievements one by one despite lack of everything. He went on saying that their pride in their work, their enterprising and pushing attitude toward work and their patriotism had to be valued. He praised that the factory’s officials and employees applied patriotism in action, not in words. Like this, the respected General Secretary encouraged their spirit of self-reliance and let them fully display their patriotism. Rodong Sinmun

title: All Employees of Factory Become University Students and Graduates
body: The Pyongyang Jonghyang Building Materials Factory is famous for producing quality building materials conducive to building of socialist civilization by its own efforts and technology. Among them are diverse sorts of paints, waterproofing material with high capacity, heat insulator, putty and tens of kinds of building materials being widely used in various fields of the national economy. We can find the key to success through one fact. According to the factory’s manager, all the employees are university graduates or students enrolled in study-while-working educational system. After remodeling the sci-tech learning space, the factory successfully solved all the problems arising in purchasing teaching aids and reference books necessary for study in close connection with university teachers, while making everybody harden their knowledge at the industrial laboratory. Its employees, who regard it as the way of bringing earlier the future of the factory to prepare them as intelligent workers true to the Party’s intention, study being enrolled in study-while-working educational system vying with others and their enthusiasm is very great. In those days, many workers contributed to realizing the localization of various building parts and grew up into master-hands at contrivance and inventors in the course of solving the sci-tech problems in the production by themselves. Thus, everybody contributes a large share to development of the factory. This is the proud reality that can be seen under the benevolent socialist system which provides the most superior education system in the world and makes everybody display their talents to the full. Rodong Sinmun

title: 60th Anniversary of New Agricultural Guidance System Marked
body: The 60th anniversary of the creation of the new agricultural guidance system was marked in the DPRK. President Kim Il Sung visited Sukchon County on Dec. 18, Juche 50 (1961) to set up a cooperative farm management committee of the county and create the above-said system for business guidance over the rural economy. The system, based on the Juche idea and revolutionary mass line created under the wise leadership of the President, made it possible to intensify the state guidance and support for the cooperative economy in every way and fully display the might of the socialist rural economic system on the principle of collectivism. Chairman Kim Jong Il steadily improved and strengthened the guidance over the rural economy and the management and operation of co-op farms by carrying forward the President's idea on agricultural guidance system and his feats for it. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un expounded all the issues arising in improving the rural economy and has wisely led the work to achieve rapid development of socialist agriculture with the might of the Korean-style agricultural guidance system. A meeting in commemoration of the anniversary took place at Sukchon County Hall of Culture on Dec. 18. Attending it were Ri Chol Man, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Ju Chol Gyu, vice-premier of the Cabinet and minister of Agriculture, An Kum Chol, chief secretary of the South Phyongan Provincial Committee of the Party, Pak Yong Nam, chairman of the Rural Economy Committee of the Province, officials concerned and agricultural workers in Sukchon County. Rodong Sinmun

title: Achievements Made in Intense Competition to Improve Quality of Products
body: There has been a great competition between industrial establishments in technical modernization and development of new products, all of which were aimed at producing quality products with locally available raw and other materials. As a result, over 600 production processes of more than 250 units were awarded management system authentication, and hundreds of products made by many economic units the February 2 Goods Certificate of Inscription. There is also more positive competition to produce world-famous products and commodities contributing to the national economic development and the improvement of people's standard of living. Rodong Sinmun

title: Memorial Services for Chairman Kim Jong Il Held Abroad
body: Memorial services for Chairman Kim Jong Il took place in different countries on the occasion of the 10th anniversary of his demise. A seminar on Chairman Kim Jong Il's exploits was held in Denmark, memorial meetings in Norway and Finland, lectures in Guinea and Algeria and film shows in Syria and Nigeria from Dec. 6 to Dec. 15. Korean films on Kim Jong Il's revolutionary life were shown. The chief of the Danish Group for the Study of the Juche Idea in his speech said that Kim Jong Il was an extraordinary statesman who thoroughly applied the Juche idea founded by President Kim Il Sung to all fields of revolution and construction and an outstanding thinker-theoretician who gave guidelines to the progressive people aspiring to independence and socialism. The chairman of the Ostfold County Committee of the Communist Party of Norway and other speakers said that Kim Jong Il provided the world people with a firm faith in the victory of socialism by proving the scientific accuracy and truthfulness of socialism through his immortal literary activities. They noted that he smashed the vicious moves of the imperialists to stifle the DPRK through his unique Songun politics and steadfastly defended the destiny of the country and nation. The international secretary of the Finnish Communists' League and the chairman of the Finland-Korea Society highly praised Kim Jong Il, saying that under his leadership socialist Korea demonstrated its might as an invincible country giving unlimited strength and courage to the progressive people of the world aspiring after independence and justice. The vice-president of the General Union of the Peasants of Syria and the chairman of the Algeria-Korea Friendship Association praised Kim Jong Il as a peerless patriot and benevolent father, stressing that under the leadership of H.E. Kim Jong Un the Korean people will certainly fulfill the patriotic desire of H.E. Kim Jong Il for building a powerful country. Messages to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un were adopted at the memorial meetings in Norway and Finland. Rodong Sinmun

title: Iron Faith and Will to Glorify Cause of Sun Forever
body: Pervading the whole country are an ardent yearning and boundless reverence for Chairman Kim Jong Il who devoted his all to the good of the country and people. According to the amassed data, a total of over 49.39 million people including officials, workers, service personnel and schoolchildren have visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill and paid the highest tribute to them since April, Juche 101(2012). In this meaningful year in which the historic 8th Congress of the Workers’ Party of Korea was held, for instance, numbers of people including officials, workers and schoolchildren have frequented the Mansu Hill out of endless reverence for the President and the Chairman and determination to carry out their behests. Meanwhile, a lot of overseas compatriots and foreign friends have often visited the statues. Today, Mansu Hill is further lustered thanks to the fervent loyalty and pure moral obligation of the people and service personnel who are resolved to hold up higher the President and the Chairman. Thronging to the Mansu Hill in the future, too, will be the people and service personnel who are possessed of iron faith and will to add eternal glory to the cause of the Sun by fulfilling their duties as the President’s descendants and the Chairman’s soldiers and followers and the progressive peoples of the world respecting and following the Sun of mankind. Rodong Sinmun

title: Always Keeping People in His Heart
body: With Parental Affection One April day in Juche 103(2014) the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un inspected the completed Workers’ Hostel of the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill. Its corridors were harmoniously painted with girls’ favorite colors like pink and pale yellow and halls of every floor had TVs. The hostel with well-decorated rooms, a medical treatment room, library, etc. was, indeed, the hotel for workers and palace for workers. When the respected General Secretary dropped in at a room, he personally opened the door of wall closet. The closet had three compartments. The lower one was to keep quilts and the upper one was to hold clothes. After measuring with his eyes the length of the wardrobe compartment, the respected General Secretary regretted that the Korean-style coat and skirt would be folded as the length was short. Like this, after providing the workers there with home of happiness the respected General Secretary took meticulous care of their life with his parental affection lest they should feel any inconvenience. Officials of the mill were moved to tears for his ardent love and care for our people. Why Respected General Secretary Was So Pleased In April, two years ago, the respected General Secretary visited again the Samjiyon Potato Farina Production Factory. Telling officials that the factory was built with much effort made by our Party, he said it was important to manage well the factory and make all the people in the county share in the benefit by increasing its production. He gave the officials precious instructions to improve management of the factory. The officials of the factory were so impressed with the pains of the respected General Secretary who repeatedly visited their factory far away in the northern part of the country, in order to make it conducive to improving people’s diet. After a while, looking with a broad smile at the scene of thousands of tons of potato farina piled up mountain-high, the respected General Secretary said that potatoes which had been piled up in the storehouse the last year turned into a mountain of potato farina. Indeed, our people’s ideals and dreams are translated into reality one after another thanks to the respected General Secretary, benevolent father who takes delight in their happiness. Rodong Sinmun

title: Valuing Ours
body: In August several years ago the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited the Pyongyang Hosiery Factory. After looking round workshops he dropped in at the sample display room and approached the children’s socks display shelf. There he was very pleased to see children’s socks carrying dozens of pictures. With a broad smile the respected General Secretary looked round the room for a while and highly praised for pretty and handsome appearances of the samples with animal patterns. The respected General Secretary personally held one pair of socks to look into its quality. While he was taking an attentive look at them he gave the accompanying officials instructions to depict the three intimate friends of a raccoon dog, cat and bear which are popular in the cartoon film titled "Clever Raccoon Dog" on the socks for our children. Indeed, the respected General Secretary pays his special concern to patterns of the children’s socks which would be seen humble and trivial to anyone. It is his lofty intention to give importance to all things relevant to the future generation and he makes painstaking efforts to train our children into genuine pillars valuing ours. Thanks to the benevolent care of the respected General Secretary who is devoting himself to the rising generation with motherly love our children are growing into able and reliable pillars of our revolution. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Praised Abroad
body: Personages of different countries made public press statements and articles from December 14 to 16 on the occasion of the 10th anniversary of demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Saying that the noble life of Kim Jong Il, the peerlessly great sage, is the model from whom the world's revolutionaries should learn, the deputy general secretary of the National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of the DR Congo stressed that his exploits would shine forever. Sonkori Baroti, chairman of the Nepali Literary Forum for the Study of Songun Politics, said that Kim Jong Il with extraordinary ideological and theoretical wisdom, outstanding leadership, matchless pluck and grit, rock-firm faith and noble personality is the greatest man boundlessly admired by the Korean people and the world's progressives. Aleksei Kozitski, chairman of the Maritime Territorial Branch Committee of "A Just Russia", noted that under the wise leadership of Kim Jong Il the Korean people wrought one miracle after another in socialist construction, overcoming all trials and difficulties. The general secretary of the National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of the DR Congo, in an article lauded Kim Jong Il for firmly consolidating the single-minded unity of the whole society and glorifying socialism. The article said that socialist Korea remains unperturbed at the imperialists' obstructive moves as it is led by President of the State Affairs Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Memorial Meeting Held in Russia
body: There took place a memorial meeting of the government, political parties and organizations of Russia in Moscow on Dec. 15 on the occasion of the 10th anniversary of the demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Attending the meeting were personages of the Russian government, political parties and organizations, including the State Duma of Russia, the Communist Party of the Russian Federation, the Party of Peace and Unity, the Liberal Democratic Party, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Russian Association for Friendship and Cultural Cooperation with the DPRK, the Russian Association for the Study of the Juche Idea, the Korean War Veterans' Council, the Lenin Young Communist League of the Russian Federation, the Academy Ensemble of the National Guard of the Russian Federation, the "Orchestra of the 21st Century", the State Academy Beryozka Dancing Troupe Named after N.S. Nadezhdina, and the DPRK ambassador to Russia and embassy members. The participants paid silent tribute to Kim Jong Il. Speeches were made at the meeting. Meanwhile, a memorial service was given at the DPRK mission in Khabarovsk on December 16. The participants laid a floral basket and bunches of flowers at an art work depicting President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il standing together, and paid tribute to them. Rodong Sinmun

title: To Keep Laugh of Children
body: In November several years ago the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un inspected the Pyongyang Children’s Foodstuff Factory modernized in our style. After going round the newly-built room for education in the revolutionary history and room dedicated to the history of the factory, the respected General Secretary praised officials and employees of the factory for having built them well to convey the favor of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, who had parental affection for the children of our country. He stressed the need for the officials and employees of the factory to intensify the education in the undying leadership feats of the President and the Chairman and thus translate the desire of the great leaders into reality with great successes in production. That day the respected General Secretary said that making a revolution in hardship was for the children, the future of our country, and that he could be optimistic about a bright and rosy future listening to the children’s laughter even though he was fatigued with his works today. The respected General Secretary earnestly said that the officials and employees of the factory should always bear in their mind that to normalize the production was the way to keep the laughter of children. Indeed, palaces for children and the splendid homes for them have been built in different parts of our country thanks to the whole energy and pains of the respected General Secretary. Under the care of the respected General Secretary with noble outlook on posterity, the happy laughter of children and their song "We Are the Happiest in the World" will resound far on this land and the future of our country will be endlessly bright and rosy. Rodong Sinmun

title: For Children in Mountain Village
body: Nowadays, schoolchildren from mountain villages in Kujang County go to school by bus to the people’s pleasure. Officials of the County Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea and drivers of the county automobile station made detailed arrangements to provide means of commute for schoolchildren on top priority basis in a responsible manner. Since mid-February this year, the buses at the county automobile station have shuttled between schools and mountain villages in Jungcho and Sanggu ris as well as Sao ri with schoolchildren on board. The cheerful children on the buses to their schools make people keenly feel grateful for our system and eager to work harder for the benevolent country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Basket to Statues of Great Leaders from Equatorial Guinea
body: The Democratic Party of Equatorial Guinea sent a floral basket to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill here on the occasion of the 10th anniversary of the demise of Kim Jong Il. The floral basket was placed before the statues on December 20. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Remembered Abroad
body: There took place memorial meetings, seminars, lectures and book and photo exhibitions in Switzerland, Belarus, Mexico and Venezuela from December 9 to 14 on the occasion of the 10th anniversary of the demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Felix Jesus Velasquez Castillo, general coordinator of the Federal Political Secretariat of the United Left Party of Venezuela, said at a seminar in Venezuela that the Korean people and the world progressives are now cherishing with deep reverence the memory of Kim Jong Il, a great master of ideology and leadership. He noted that Kim Jong Il developed and enriched the Juche idea founded by President Kim Il Sung and devoted his all to the country's prosperity and people's happiness. Sergei Zebyatikh, chief of the Vitebsk Juche Pedagogy Association of Belarus, said at a seminar that Kim Jong Il passed away but he is alive in the hearts of all people for his great exploits performed in accomplishing the cause of human independence. Jesus Antonio Carlos Hernandez, general secretary of the Central Committee of the People's Socialist Party of Mexico, said at a memorial meeting that Kim Jong Il firmly defended Korean-style socialism from the imperialists' persistent moves for aggression with the treasured sword of Songun. A message to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un was adopted at a memorial meeting in Switzerland. A seminar on the exploits of Kim Jong Il was held by the Communist Party of the Soviet Union on December 9 on the occasion of the anniversary of his demise. Rodong Sinmun

title: Joint Seminars Held in Bulgaria and Bangladesh
body: There took place joint seminars of political parties and organizations in Sofia of Bulgaria and Dakha of Bangladesh on December 9 and 12 on the occasion of the 10th anniversary of the demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Attending the seminars were figures of political parties and organizations including the Bulgarian Communists' Party, the Bulgarian Group for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, the Kim Il Sung Library in Sofia, the Bulgaria-Korea Friendship Association, the Workers' Party of Bangladesh, the Bangladesh National Socialist Party, the Communist Party of Bangladesh (Marxist-Leninist), the Awami League of Bangladesh, the Bangladesh Institute of the Juche Idea and the Bangladesh-Korea Friendship and Solidarity Committee as well as people from all walks of life. The political and public personages of Bulgaria said it is the greatest exploit of Chairman Kim Jong Il that he developed in depth the Juche Idea, provided a firm foundation for perfectly carrying forward the cause of President Kim Il Sung, defended socialist Korea from the imperialists' aggression under the uplifted banner of Songun and gave confidence in the victory of socialism to the mankind. They stressed that Kim Jong Il who added beauty to the flower garden of single-minded unity with his boundless love for the people will always be alive in the hearts of not only the Korean people but also the world's progressives. The chairperson of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Bangladesh, the chairman of the Central Executive Committee of the Bangladesh National Socialist Party and the general secretary of the Bangladesh Institute of the Juche Idea said that Kim Jong Il is a prominent man who, with his outstanding ideology and theory and rare leadership, strengthened and developed the Workers' Party of Korea into an ever-victorious party which serves the people, forming a harmonious whole with the popular masses and that his exploits will be immortal along with thriving socialist Korea. Rodong Sinmun

title: Emergency Epidemic Prevention Work Intensified in DPRK
body: The emergency epidemic prevention units at all levels in the DPRK continue to reinforce and perfect the epidemic prevention system while firmly cementing the anti-epidemic walls of our own style. The central emergency epidemic prevention unit is directing its efforts into the work for putting the anti-epidemic base on a firm scientific basis, thoroughly ensuring the popular character in the emergency epidemic prevention work and more thoroughly establishing the climate of observing the epidemic prevention disciplines throughout society. The information service for further enhancing the public awareness of the importance of the epidemic prevention is being ceaselessly carried out in various patterns and methods. Public health workers across the country responsibly carry out the medical checkups of employees at the units in their charge and of citizens under their care to find those persons with high temperature, timely identify their causes and take measures for their treatment and prevent the outbreak and spread of respiratory diseases likely to break out in winter. The work for ensuring the security of the emergency epidemic prevention campaign to the maximum is being pushed ahead with through development and introduction of efficient antiseptic solution and system. Epidemic prevention units make sure that the industrial establishments organize their work scrupulously to thoroughly check the inroads of COVID-19. They also see to it that there would not be any tiny fault in temperature-measuring and disinfection of passers-by and vehicles at epidemic prevention posts. Rodong Sinmun

title: Notebook Factory Built in Haeju
body: Officials and working people in Haeju City, South Hwanghae Province of the DPRK, newly built a notebook factory. The factory has labor-intensive, energy-efficient and environment-friendly production lines, ensuring production with locally-available raw materials and recycling. It will contribute to supplying quality notebooks to the children and students in the city. Its inaugural ceremony took place on the spot on December 20. Attending it were Ri Yun Jae, secretary of the South Hwanghae Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials concerned, officials and workers of the factory and working people in the city. Kim Yong Chol, chairman of the Provincial People's Committee, made an inaugural speech. Rodong Sinmun

title: Warm Loving Care for Citizens in Pyongyang
body: The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un made sure that Pyongyang citizens are supplied with fish. This loving care for Pyongyang citizens represents his devoted service for the people's wellbeing. He saw to it that the people still feel the loving care of Chairman Kim Jong Il who took a benevolent measure of supplying fish to the Pyongyang citizens in the last days of his great life. Thousands of tons of fish, prepared by officials and fishermen in the fishing sector of the People's Army, arrived in Pyongyang by train and truck. Officials of Party and government organs in Pyongyang City greeted the carriers at parking spaces and railway stations. Looking at the fish carriers, working people and youth and students in Pyongyang keenly felt that the loving care of the Chairman is given steady continuity by the General Secretary. Public catering establishments in the city were crowded with citizens pleased to receive fish associated with the loving care of the Party. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK's Best Players, Coaches for 2021 Chosen
body: Ten best players and ten best coaches for 2021 have been chosen in the DPRK. Ten Best Players 1. Ri Song Gum, weightlifter of the April 25 Sports Team 2. Ri Chong Song, weightlifter of the April 25 Sports Team 3. Kim Yu Sim, player from the Taekwon-Do Team of the Korean Taekwon-Do Committee 4. Rim Un Sim, weightlifter of the Kigwancha Sports Team 5. Choe Hyo Sim, weightlifter of the Kigwancha Sports Team 6. Kim Mi Rae, diver of the Pyongyang Sports Team 7. Pang Chol Mi, boxer of the Kumgangsan Sports Team 8. Kim Phyong Hwa, footballer of the April 25 Sports Team 9. Kim Myong Sun, footballer of the April 25 Sports Team 10. Kwon Kwang Il, shooting player of the Amnokgang Defence Sports Team Ten Best Coaches 1. Kye Song Il, weightlifting coach of the April 25 Sports Team 2. Ri Chol Nam, weightlifting coach of the April 25 Sports Team 3. Sa Ok Jin, coach of the Taekwon-Do Team of the Korean Taekwon-Do Committee 4. Choe Song Hui, diving coach of the Pyongyang Sports Team 5. Pak Chol Jun, boxing coach of the Kumgangsan Sports Team 6. Han Chol Hak, football coach of the April 25 Sports Team 7. Kim Chun Sam, shooting coach of the Amnokgang Defence Sports Team 8. Han Jong Ae, coach of the Taekwon-Do Team of the Korean Taekwon-Do Committee 9. Han Won Chol, football coach of the Kigwancha Sports Team 10. Ri Chol Ok, coach of the Jagang Provincial Taekwon-Do Team Rodong Sinmun

title: At Stall for Wheat Cakes Stuffed with Meat
body: There can be seen at a stall the people having wheat cakes stuffed with meat and saleswomen kindly expounding to the customers on the nutrition value. This harmonized scene adds luster to its popularity. Whenever we witness such scenes we recollect with deep emotion the image of Chairman Kim Jong Il being pleased during his field guidance to the newly built workshop at the Kumsong Foodstuff Factory. When the Chairman dropped in at a mobile service stand he instructed that they should serve people the stuffed wheat cakes warmed up. Still we recollect his words saying our people would be more delightful to be served mineral water in summer while hot tea in winter with wheat cakes at stalls. The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un, who has succeeded to the history of noble love for people of the Chairman, took meticulous interest in the wheat cakes ranging from its production to service and took measures for it. Indeed, a small stall for stuffed wheat cakes is associated with the motherly love of our Party. Rodong Sinmun

title: Most Powerful Weapon of Revolution
body: What defends the lifeline of our revolution and accelerates it is nothing but ideology. Our revolution honored with victory and glory faced manifold trials and obstacles which nobody had experienced. The one who is strong in ideology fears nothing in the world and can create "thing" out of "nothing" and turn impossibility into possibility. This is the firm belief of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il which our people regarded as their motto in their struggle to brave all the obstacles with unshakable confidence. The other day, the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un said our Party successfully guided the revolution and construction by dint of ideology which has been regarded as the most powerful weapon in the whole course of Juche-oriented revolutionary cause. And he earnestly instructed that we should put continuous efforts to the ideological revolution mindful that the victory of our revolution and prospects of our country depend on it. His instructions represent his invariable faith and will to steadily emerge victorious in the revolution and construction by giving top priority to the ideological work. The great revolutionary ideology serves as the unique and powerful weapon of the Party of working class and the source of miracles. Therefore, the respected General Secretary instructed in his report made at the lecture for commemorating 76th founding anniversary of the Workers’ Party of Korea that ideology is the most powerful and unique weapon for our revolution which has to blaze an untrodden path and accomplish the great cause of building a powerful and prosperous country with its own efforts. The more spurs are put to the ideological front, the more mental strength of the popular masses is displayed. And this propels the advance of our revolution. This is the iron truth proved by our Party through the course of our revolution. Ideology will serve as the most powerful sword forever. Rodong Sinmun

title: Haeju Youth Open-Air Theatre Newly Built
body: The Haeju Youth Open-Air Theatre has been newly built. The theatre with a 5 000-seat stand, a conference hall, club rooms, etc. will contribute to leisure activities of working people and after-school education of youth and students in South Hwanghae Province. Present at an inaugural ceremony held on December 21 were Pak Song Chol, chief secretary of the South Hwanghae Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials concerned, members of the youth league of the province, employees of the theatre and builders. Kim Yong Chol, chairman of the Provincial People's Committee, made an inaugural speech. Rodong Sinmun

title: Sariwon Gymnasium Built
body: The Sariwon Gymnasium has been newly built in North Hwanghae Province. The gymnasium with a 1 000-seat stand has a multi-purpose sports ground for Futsal, basketball and volleyball and other events, lounges for players, a physical training room and a sci-tech learning space, which will help develop mass sports. An inaugural ceremony took place on the spot on December 21. Attending it were Pak Chang Ho, chief secretary of the North Hwanghae Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials concerned, sports officials, sportspersons, employees of the gymnasium and working people in Sariwon City. An inaugural speech was made by Im Hun, chairman of the Provincial People's Committee. Rodong Sinmun

title: Memorial Events Held in Russia
body: There took place memorial events by the United Confederation of Koreans in Russia and Korean residents in Russia on the occasion of the 10th anniversary of demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. There was a memorial meeting of the United Confederation of Koreans in Russia in Moscow on December 15. Speaking at the meeting, Kim Chil Song, chairman of the confederation, expressed the everlasting yearning and ardent reverence for Kim Jong Il, noting that 10 years have passed since his demise. The greatest feat of Kim Jong Il is that he provided a firm foundation for accomplishing the revolutionary cause of Juche by faithfully carrying forward the idea and exploits of President Kim Il Sung, the speaker stressed. The United Confederation of Koreans in the Far Eastern Region of Russia held a memorial event on December 17. The participants laid a floral basket and bunches of flowers before the portrait of smiling Kim Jong Il and paid a silent tribute to the memory of him in humble reverence. The chairperson of the United Confederation of Koreans in the Far Eastern Region of Russia said that Kim Jong Il is the greatest man as he proved before the world that the DPRK is alive and socialism is sure to emerge victorious, in the 1990s, a grim period when socialism collapsed in the former Soviet Union and socialist countries in East Europe and the imperialist allied forces went berserk to remove the DPRK from the surface of the earth. Kim Jong Il is a peerless statesman and outstanding leader whom the world acknowledges and admires, the chairperson added. The Korean War Veterans' Council of Russia, too, held a memorial meeting on December 11. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Remembered by Koreans in China
body: The General Association of Koreans in China and its affiliated organizations held memorial services for Chairman Kim Jong Il on the occasion of the 10th anniversary of his demise. Officials of the General Association and citizens in Shenyang laid a floral basket and paid tribute before the art work depicting the images of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il at the DPRK Consulate General in Shenyang. The Zhongnan Regional Association of the General Association placed a floral basket before the portrait of smiling Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il at the DPRK embassy in Beijing. A memorial service by the General Association of Koreans in China took place in Shenyang on Dec. 17. Attending it were First Vice-Chairman Choe Su Bong and officials of the General Association, members of the Federation of Korean Economic Workers in China and the Association of Young Korean Nationals in China, officials of branches of the Liaoning Province Regional Association, citizens of Shenyang and Dandong and compatriots. Members of the DPRK Consulate General in Shenyang were also present. The participants paid a silent tribute to the memory of Kim Jong Il. Choe Su Bong said in a memorial address that Kim Jong Il was a peerless patriot and benevolent father of the people in the homeland and overseas compatriots who recorded the whole course of revolutionary struggle with his ardent love and noble dedication to the country and the people. A letter to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un was adopted at the memorial service. Memorial services were also held by affiliated organizations of the General Association, including the Yanbian Regional Association, the Mudanjiang Regional Association, the Jilin Province Regional Association and the Shanghai Municipal Branch of the Zhongnan Regional Association. Rodong Sinmun

title: Socialist Emulation Drive for 2021 Reviewed in DPRK
body: The socialist emulation drive in the field of fruit farming for 2021 was reviewed on December 21 through video-conferencing. Present there were Ju Chol Gyu, vice-premier of the Cabinet and minister of Agriculture, Ri Tu Song, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials concerned and officials of the Ministry of Agriculture and the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea and officials of those units which took part in the emulation. Officials and working people in the field of fruit farming had conducted the socialist emulation for producing more fruits this year, the first year of the implementation of the new 5-year plan, in response to the decisions set forth at the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea. Han Jong Hyok, chairman of the Central Committee of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea, made a report on the review. Then the standings of the drive were announced. Citations in the joint name of the C.C., WPK and the DPRK Cabinet and rotating silk banner of the socialist emulation were awarded to Pukchong County and the Toksong Apple Farm and the Onchon Fruit Farm. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Remembered in Different Countries
body: There took place memorial meetings, seminars, lectures, photo exhibitions and film shows in Nepal, India, Thailand, Denmark, Germany, Italy, Guinea, Senegal, Egypt and Ethiopia from Dec. 9 to 17 on the occasion of the 10th anniversary of demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Korean films dealing with his revolutionary career, noble feats and sublime and popular traits were screened at the film shows. Personages of political and social circles and masses who took part in the events expressed their boundless reverence for the peerlessly great man and great sage of revolution. Personages from the Central Committee of the Nepal Worker-Peasant Party praised HE Kim Jong Il as an outstanding leader with the great idea, many-sided knowledge and broad political vision who guided the DPRK to steadfastly advance along the road of independence and socialism against high-handed and arbitrary practices of the imperialists. Figures of the Communist Party of India (Marxist), the All-India Forward Bloc, the All-India Peasants' Union, the All India Indo-Korean Friendship Association and other political parties and organizations praised Kim Jong Il as the great master of independent politics who performed great exploits for the Korean revolution and the world revolution. The chairman of the Denmark-DPRK Friendship Association said that Kim Jong Il remarkably raised the international prestige of the DPRK through his energetic external activities and performed immortal feats for ensuring the world peace and strengthening the solidarity among peoples of the countries struggling under the banner of independence against imperialism. Meanwhile, a Korean book and handicraft exhibition was held in Mexico and a round-table talk in Vietnam to commemorate the 10th anniversary of Kim Jong Il's demise and the 10th anniversary of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's assumption of the supreme commandership of the armed forces of the DPRK. Rodong Sinmun

title: By Opening New Phase of Transforming All Our Revolutionary Positions in Line with Demands of Three Revolutions
body: The three red flags of ideological, technological and cultural revolutions are fluttering in the way of the general advance of masses to bring about a new victory of the revolution following the leadership of great Party. The comprehensive development of socialism of our own style is, in essence, a new revolution in the three realms of ideology, technology and culture. The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un held higher the banner of the three revolutions with the iron will to hasten a brilliant future of powerful socialist country overcoming all sorts of challenges of history and open a bright road toward communism. Reflected in the Three-Revolution Red Flag Movement are high intention and unshakable creed of the respected General Secretary who has worked heart and soul to make all the members of society revolutionary, develop the technological and economic might on the highest level and civilize the whole society. The line of the three revolutions is a programme for socialist and communist construction and the general line of our Party invariable even today as it was yesterday. Saying that we must carry forward this line forever in its pure form, and apply it fully, the respected General Secretary earnestly called for upholding this slogan "Let us transform all our revolutionary positions in line with the demands of the three revolutions!". Our revolution will be further dynamically advanced when all the people transform all our revolutionary positions in line with the demands of the three revolutions, upholding the line of the three revolutions bearing the lifelong desire of great leaders with the iron faith and will of the respected General Secretary as a treasured sword for victory of the revolution and an ever-victorious banner, and thus the rosy future of our style socialism will come as early as possible. Rodong Sinmun

title: Frostwork in Sobaeksu Valley
body: Frostwork in the Sobaeksu Valley is one of eight scenes of the Sobaeksu Valley. Its snow scene spread out in winter is very spectacular. Water haze rises from the Sobaeksu Stream flowing through the virgin forest covered with snow and frostwork is in full bloom on the trees standing by the stream. Frostwork can be seen frequently everywhere of our country in winter. But frostwork in the Sobaeksu Valley is more sublime and beautiful than others as it is formed in the holy place of the revolution housing Chairman Kim Jong Il’s native home in the Paektusan Secret Camp. Frostwork is at its best in the intense cold of midwinter. Around the Chairman’s native home are mysterious springs. They say the spring water of four degrees Celsius in temperature flow into the Sobaeksu Stream. At that time, water haze rises from the stream and surroundings are decorated with beautiful frostwork. Meanwhile, frostwork in full bloom on branches of larch trees, Abies nephrolepis and Picea jezoensis and small and big stones clouded up with steam add beauty to the landscape of the Sobaeksu Valley. Like this, the Sobaeksu Valley is deep and majestic and its physical aspect is superb. Frostwork in the Sobaeksu Valley conveys the revolutionary history of Chairman Kim Jong Il who brought happiness and proud victory to this land with boundless love for and burning devotion to the country and people. That’s why our people immensely love frostwork in the Sobaeksu Valley. Rodong Sinmun

title: Intensified Struggle for Concluding This Year's Campaign in DPRK
body: A vigorous struggle for successfully attaining the goals of this year, the first year for implementing the 5-year plan, has been waged at the units in major fields of the national economy inspected by President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un. The Chollima Steel Complex introduced a valuable technical innovation to reduce the power consumption of its UHP electric arc furnace and shorten the melting time in close cooperation with a unit concerned, thus consolidating its foundations for production. The Hungnam Fertilizer Complex and the February 8 Vinalon Complex pushed ahead with the work to maintain and reinforce their production bases while giving spurs to putting the production of fertilizer on a normal basis and increasing the production of different chemical products. The Pukchang Thermal Power Complex and the Pyongyang Thermal Power Plant have invented and introduced technological innovations to satisfy the future demand for electric power while putting the winter power production on a normal basis. Various units in the fields of machine-building and light industries are taking the lead in the all-out drive to successfully conclude this year's campaign. Rodong Sinmun

title: "Our National Forum 2021" Held in Japan
body: "Our National Forum 2021" for positive contribution to opening a new heyday of the movement of Koreans in Japan took place at the Korean Hall of Culture in Tokyo, Japan on Dec. 12. Present at the forum were Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), and Pak Ku Ho, first vice-chairman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee and director of its Organization Department, vice-chairmen the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, chairpersons of Chongryon headquarters across Japan, Choe Pyong Ho, chairman of the Korean Youth Commercial Association in Japan, and representatives of its affiliated organizations and other compatriots. The forum, sponsored by the Korean youth commercial association in Adachi of Tokyo Metropolitan, was broadcast live to compatriots. Its participants, together with the members of the Adachi regional youth commercial association, watched a great chorus "To Young Heroes" performed by 1 000 persons including members of the Korean youth commercial associations in Tokyo and other areas, compatriots, Korean students in Tokyo and students of Pyongyang Secondary School No. 1 in the DPRK. The students of Pyongyang Secondary School No. 1 took part in the chorus through video recording. Ho Jong Man stressed that the forum instilled great strength and courage into the compatriots at a hard time and fully displayed the spirit of the Korean Youth Commercial Association. Rodong Sinmun

title: Big Blasting Conducted at Sunchon Limestone Mine
body: The Sunchon Limestone Mine successfully carried out the blasting of 300 000 cubic meters of earth on December 22. The successful blasting is another breakthrough in providing a production foundation for securing more minerals in the future. Officials and workers of the mine have effected uninterrupted innovations and progress by concentrating efforts on conveying ores. Rodong Sinmun

title: South Hwanghae Provincial Medical Oxygen Supply Station Inaugurated
body: A medical oxygen supply station was built in South Hwanghae Province of the DPRK. Its inaugural ceremony took place on the spot on Dec. 22. The completion of the station laid groundwork for supplying sufficient medical oxygen to curative and preventive institutions in the province. Rodong Sinmun

title: Choe Ryong Hae Meets Outgoing Chinese Ambassador
body: Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and chairman of the Standing Committing of the Supreme People's Assembly, Wednesday met Li Jinjun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK who paid a farewell call on him, at the Mansudae Assembly Hall. Upon the authorization of Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, Choe Ryong Hae courteously conveyed the words of Kim Jong Un to Li Jinjun. Saying he is very satisfied over the fact that the DPRK-China friendship with socialism as the core has entered a fresh heyday under the leadership of the heads of the two parties today, Kim Jong Un highly praised the ambassador for successfully assisting several DPRK-China summit meetings over the past seven years, making much effort to develop the friendly relations between the two parties and the two countries and sharing bitters and sweets with the Korean people. Hoping that the ambassador would make steady efforts to develop the friendly relations between the DPRK and China in good health, he sincerely wished the party, government and people of China bigger successes in their new one-hundred-year-long journey for achieving the prosperity of the Chinese nation under the leadership of General Secretary Xi Jinping. Li Jinjun said that he could hardly repress his emotion at the words from General Secretary Kim Jong Un, and asked Choe Ryong Hae to convey his gratitude to Kim Jong Un for having shown deep care and solicitude for his work and life during his tenure. The ambassador said he sincerely congratulates the Korean people on making progress in all fields of socialist construction and registering success in the first year for implementing the decisions made at the 8th Congress of the Party, in particular, by displaying the spirit of self-reliance and fortitude under the leadership of General Secretary Kim Jong Un. He expressed his will to continue to strive for further developing the friendly relations between the two countries that have entered a new era under the direct guidance of the top leaders of the two parties and the two countries. Attending the meeting were Kang Yun Sok, vice-chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, Sung Jong Gyu, minister of Culture, So Ho Won, chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries, and Mun Song Hyok, vice department director of the Central Committee of the WPK, and members of the Chinese embassy. Earlier, Choe Ryong Hae conferred the Order of DPRK Friendship 1st Class on Li Jinjun. The State Affairs Commission of the DPRK hosted a reception in honor of the ambassador in the evening. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Premier Meets Outgoing Chinese Ambassador
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, met and had a friendly talk with Chinese Ambassador to the DPRK Li Jinjun who paid a farewell call on him at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Wednesday. Present there were Vice-Premier Kim Song Ryong, Minister of External Economic Relations Yun Jong Ho, Vice-Minister of Foreign Affairs Pak Myong Ho and members of the Chinese embassy. Meanwhile, Kim Song Nam, director of the International Department of the WPK Central Committee, and Ri Son Gwon, minister of Foreign Affairs, respectively met the ambassador on the same day. Rodong Sinmun

title: Production of Modern Medical Appliances Gets Brisk in DPRK
body: The Myohyangsan Medical Appliances Factory in the DPRK developed over 40 kinds of modern medical appliances, including general dental equipment, universal ear-nose-throat-treating equipment and all-purpose operating table, in a little over one year since its completion. The Huichon Hospital Bed Factory, built at the end of last year, developed 10 kinds of hospital beds for various uses and is speeding up their production. Those factories supplied medical appliances made by their efforts and technology to hospitals and clinics in different parts of the country. The factories, which gained good experience in development and production of medical appliances, have mapped out a goal for making a new leap forward next year. They now step up the preparations. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Remembered in Russia
body: Memorial meetings, seminars and film shows were held by political parties and social organizations of Russia on Dec. 10-16 to commemorate the tenth anniversary of the demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. A Korean film on the exploits of the Chairman for developing the DPRK-Russia friendly relations was screened at the film shows. Speeches were made at the events attended by political and social personages and other people. The first secretary of the Khabarovsk Territorial Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation said at a memorial meeting that the greatest of Kim Jong Il's feats was that he defended the destiny of socialism from the imperialists' moves, put the DPRK on the position of a politico-ideological power and military power and provided a solid springboard for building a powerful socialist nation. The chairperson of the Party for Peace and Unity of Russia and other speakers praised Kim Jong Il as a great man who cemented a harmonious whole of the Party and the people and performed gigantic feats in developing socialist Korea with his superb leadership. Meanwhile, a floral basket was laid with due ceremony before the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il at a school in the city of Khabarovsk. Rodong Sinmun

title: Foreign Figures Visit DPRK Missions
body: Personages of different countries and regional organizations visited the DPRK missions in their countries on the occasion of the 10th anniversary of demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. They laid floral baskets and bunches of flowers before the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and art works depicting the President and the Chairman standing together, and made a bow before them. The visitors include the chairperson of the Party for Peace and Unity of Russia, the head of the State Academy Beryozka Dancing Troupe of Russia Named after N. S. Nadezhdina, the deputy head of the Academy Ensemble of the National Guard of the Russian Federation, the general secretary of the Central Committee of the Nepal Communist Party (Marxist-Leninist), the chairman of the National Democratic Confederation of Nepalese Trade Union, the chairman of the Nepal Journalist Association for the Study of the Juche Idea and Songun Politics, the chairman of the Nepalese Association for Supporting the Songun Politics, the general secretary of the Syrian Arab Socialist Union Party, the general secretary of the Al Ahd al Watani Party of Syria, the secretary general of the International Taekwon-Do Association in Iran, the vice-chairman of the Commission for External Affairs of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam, the vice-minister of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Vietnam, the director general of the Department of International Cooperation of the Vietnam Academy of Social Sciences, the vice-chairperson of the Vietnam-DPRK Friendship Association, the chairperson of the China World Peace Foundation, the chairman of the Dongfangyi Tuozhan Association of China, the vice-chairperson of the Red Crescent Society of Kuwait, a senator of Pakistan, a member of the Central Committee of the Pakistan Awami National Party, the secretary general of the Pakistan Association for Self-Reliance Studies, the chairman of the Pakistani Organization for the Study of the Juche Idea, the general secretary of the Workers' Party of DR Congo, the vice general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of DR Congo, the vice-chairperson of the Socialist Freedom Party of Egypt, the chairperson of the Anti-Imperialist Forum of Germany, the chairman of the Permanent Standing Committee of the Belarus National Association of Friends of Korean People Named after Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il, the chairman of the Society for the Promotion of the Relations between Austria and the DPRK and the secretary general of the African Regional Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea. The chairperson of the Central Committee of the Nepal Communist Party (United Socialist), the general secretary of the Central Committee of the Czechoslovak Communist Party, the chief of the Vietnam-DPRK Friendship Kindergarten and other foreign figures visited the DPRK missions in their countries. Meanwhile, the Ministry of Defense of Vietnam, the Ministry of Public Security of Vietnam and the chairpersons of the Nepal Communist Party (United Socialist) and the Nepalese Family Party sent floral baskets to the DPRK missions in their countries. Rodong Sinmun

title: European Online Seminar Commemorates Anniversary of Demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: A European on-line seminar was held on Dec. 18 to commemorate the 10th anniversary of demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Present at the seminar on the theme of "Legacies of Leader Kim Jong Il" were the secretary general of the International Institute of the Juche Idea, members of the European Society for the Study of the Juche Idea, and Juche idea followers in different countries. Matteo Carbonelli, secretary general of the European Society for the Study of the Juche Idea, made a keynote report. He said that the world progressives reverently remember leader Kim Jong Il who made undying achievements in socialist construction in the DPRK and in accomplishing the cause of global independence, on the occasion of Dec. 17, his demise anniversary. He praised Kim Jong Il as a peerless statesman who mastered knowledge about all fields including politics, economy and culture and as the guardian of socialism who defended the DPRK's sovereignty and its people's destiny under the uplifted red flag of the revolution. There were speeches following the report. Speakers said that Kim Jong Il, who led to victory the Korean revolution with his unique Songun politics, was a great leader who indicated the path for the struggle of the oppressed the world over, stressing that the exploits of him who devoted all his life to the country and people will be immortal along with the century. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Remembered in Latin America
body: A Latin American online seminar on the immortal revolutionary exploits of Chairman Kim Jong Il took place on December 18 to commemorate the 10th anniversary of his demise. The chairman of the Latin American Institute of the Juche Idea, who is director-general of the International Institute of the Juche Idea, made a keynote speech at the seminar. He said that the greatest exploit of Kim Jong Il is that he comprehensively systemized the Juche idea founded by President Kim Il Sung and developed and enriched it as required by the times, stressing that thanks to him, the popular masses could dynamically accelerate the cause of global independence with the perfect guiding idea in the era of independence. Speeches were made by the chiefs of Juche idea study organizations and friendly and solidarity organizations with the Korean people in Mexico, Venezuela, Brazil and Costa Rica and other personages. Saying that a radical turn was brought about in the development of the Workers' Party of Korea after Kim Jong Il started his work at the Party Central Committee, the speakers praised the exploits of the peerlessly great man who developed the WPK into a party in which the steel-like unity and cohesion were realized and into an experienced and tested political general staff guiding the socialist cause. They also noted that Kim Jong Il pursued the original Songun politics in the days when the imperialist allied forces' moves to isolate and stifle the DPRK got further undisguised and thus led the struggle for defending socialism to a brilliant victory and provided the firm foundation for building a power. Adopted at the seminar was a letter to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: State Academic Degrees and Titles Conferred on Intellectuals
body: Intellectuals were awarded the state academic degrees and titles in the DPRK. They made research achievements conducive to successfully carrying out the first-year tasks of the new five-year plan set forth at the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea, through a brisk campaign of intelligence and brains, and greatly contributed to the education of the rising generations. The title of Academician went to Kim Il Gwang, a researcher of Kim Il Sung University, Pak Yong Thaek, director of an institute of Kim Chaek University of Technology, Chae Hyok Gi, an academic adviser to Pyongyang University of Computer Science, and Ri Ki Song, a researcher of the Academy of Social Sciences, and the title of Candidate Academician to Pak Song Ho and Pak Ho Nam, researchers of Kim Il Sung University, Hyon Song Chol and Ri Mu Chol, section chiefs of Kim Chaek University of Technology, Kim Il Hwan, a researcher of Kim Hyong Jik University of Education, Kim Kol, a researcher of the University of Sciences, Section Chief Kim Chang Gyong and researchers Kim Hyok Mo and Choe Sun Ok of the Academy of Social Sciences, Ri Thae Nam, a researcher of the Academy of Agricultural Science, and Cha Ki Chol, president of the Pedagogical Institute. Professorship was conferred on 29 persons including Vice-President Jong Man Ho and Department Heads Kim Man Ho, Kang Jin U, Ri Hyok and Ho Chol Man and Director of an institute Pak Hui Chol of Kim Il Sung University, Deputy Dean of a faculty Kim Sun and teacher Paek Sok of Kim Hyong Jik University of Education. Doctorate went to 127 persons including Department Head Kim Un Chol and Director of an institute Ri Kum Chol of Kim Il Sung University, Dean of a faculty Kim Kyong Ho and Director of an institute So Yong Guk of Kim Chaek University of Technology. 268 persons received associate professorship and 1 307 master's degree. Rodong Sinmun

title: Many People Win Model Worker Honor Prize
body: A large number of people in the DPRK won the Model Worker Honor Prize this year, the first year of the implementation of the five-year plan. Among them is a miner of Namgye Mine who has over-fulfilled the national economic plan every year, dedicating himself to training able persons, the future pillars of the mine. There are also a mail carrier at the Sinhung County Post Office who has kept her post with devoted service for more than 30 years, and a chief nurse at the South Hamgyong Provincial Maternity Hospital who has donated her blood and flesh to many patients and trained scores of nurses to be faithful health workers. Rodong Sinmun
