title: 12 000-Ton Cargo Ship "Jangsusan" Sets Sail
body: The 12 000-ton cargo ship "Jangsusan", newly built by the Ryongnam Dockyard, set sail. Its sailing ceremony took place at the dockyard on Dec. 23. Present there were O Su Yong, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Yang Sung Ho, vice premier of the Cabinet, Kang Jong Gwan, minister of Land and Maritime Transport, officials concerned and officials and employees of the Ryongnam Dockyard. A letter of thanks from the WPK Central Committee to the workers, technicians and officials of the Ryongnam Dockyard was read out. The WPK Central Committee stressed in the letter that the successful building of a cargo ship of over 10 000-ton at the dockyard, which is not a professional shipbuilding base, is a proud result of the high political enthusiasm, boundless patriotism and persevering attack spirit of the working people of the dockyard. The letter expressed belief that the workers, technicians and officials of the Ryongnam Dockyard would add eternal glory to the proud history and tradition of upholding the Party and the socialist country with the spirit of self-reliance and self-development and through steady practice by achieving great innovation in the work to expand and cement the production foundation and build and repair cargo ships. Kang Jong Gwan made a report to be followed by speeches at the ceremony. After the ceremony the ship left sounding a whistle. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Remembered Abroad
body: There took place memorial meetings, seminars and lectures in Romania, Italy, Germany, Nigeria, DR Congo, Equatorial Guinea and Brazil from December 16 to 18 to commemorate the 10th anniversary of the demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Constantin Rotaru, chairman of the Socialist Party of Romania, said that the exploits of Kim Jong Il, who dedicated his whole life to the people's happiness and had been on the road of field-guidance for the wellbeing of the people till the last moments of his life, would be remembered forever. Roberto Gabriele, general secretary of the Movement for Peace and Socialism of Italy, and other speakers lauded Kim Jong Il as the master of ideology and theory who illuminated the road ahead of the socialist movement and as the peerless statesman and iron-willed brilliant commander who developed the Party, the state and army of the DPRK into the invincible guiding force, unconquerable socialist fortress and matchless army. Alhassan Mamman Muhammad, chairman of the Nigerian National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, and other figures said that HE Kim Jong Il is the leader who guided the DPRK at a time when the whole world was undergoing a political turmoil, adding that the DPRK defended socialism despite the complicated international situation and became a power which no one dares to provoke. Andre Lohekele Kalonda, secretary general of the African Regional Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea, said that Kim Jong Il defended socialist Korea by devoting himself all his life and turned it into the people's paradise without an equal in the world and inspired mankind with a rosy hope. A message to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un was adopted at the memorial meeting held in DR Congo. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Remembered in Mongolia
body: A memorial meeting took place in Mongolia on December 16 to commemorate the 10th anniversary of the demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The participants laid a floral basket before the art work depicting President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il standing together and paid tributes to them. Speeches were made at the meeting. The chairman of the Mongolia-Korea Parliamentary Group of the State Great Hural said that the great HE Kim Jong Il led the Korean people in their struggle for socialist construction and that the noble exploits performed by him who made a ceaseless journey of devotion to the prosperity of the country all his life would shine forever. The chairman of the Mongolian Mt. Paektu Association for Independent Development referred to the fact that Kim Jong Il made a great contribution to the development of the friendly relations between the DPRK and Mongolia. The chairman of the Mongolian Association for the Study of the Juche Idea-Songun Idea said that Kim Jong Il pursued the Songun politics in the days when socialism tragically collapsed in one country after another and the imperialists' moves for stifling the DPRK became undisguised and thus defended the country's sovereignty and the people's happiness. A message to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un was adopted at the meeting. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Egyptian President
body: Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Abdel Fattah al-Sisi, president of the Arab Republic of Egypt, on December 22. Abdel Fattah al-Sisi in the message extended his heartfelt greetings to Kim Jong Un and the friendly Korean people on the occasion of the New Year. He said that we defended the health and lives of the people in the optimistic spirit despite the worldwide challenges in 2021. He hoped that 2022 would be a year of peace, prosperity and development thanks to the common efforts of the peoples in the two friendly countries and the rest of the world. Rodong Sinmun

title: Construction Projects Completed in North Hamgyong Province
body: The officials and working people of North Hamgyong Province, who have turned out to implement the Party’s decisions, complete this year’s construction projects one after another. Those people participating in the construction of Orangchon Power Station No.3 greatly significant for economic development of the province made strenuous efforts day and night to successfully complete its dam with the strong will to unconditionally finish the construction project to which our Party attaches importance. In the province, they built the Forest Science Institute, equipped it with necessary facilities to lay a firm foundation for solving the scientific and technical problems arising in afforestation and forest conservation. Their spirit of implementing the Party’s ideas and upholding its policies was fully displayed in the struggle to carry through the childcare policy. The officials and working people of cities, counties and districts devoted their sincerity to strengthening the material and technical basis of goat farms. Thus ten-odd livestock farming bases were newly built or remodeled and the area of pastures for goat farms was expanded and the work of equipping the farms with milk processing facilities was accelerated. Meanwhile, the work for remodeling several Koryo medicine factories in cities and counties was activated and the material and technical basis of public health field was laid more perfectly. The Chongjin Theater and Kyongsong Tangogi Restaurant were built to spruce up the province. The officials and working people of the province fully displayed the spirit of self-reliance and put spurs to raising the proportion of domestically-produced finishing materials and realizing specialization of building work. So, the buildings were erected to suit to the modern aesthetic sense and national emotion, in good harmony with regional scenic beauty. In the province, they built peculiar fountains and fountain parks in several places in Chongjin City and paved roads. The builders, full of desire to attain this year’s goals, are accelerating the construction projects of Yombunjin coast park area, Onpho Working People’s Holiday Camp and youth open-air theatre and remodeling of Kim Jong Suk Teachers Training College. Rodong Sinmun

title: For Consolidating Production Basis of Dairy Products
body: This year the officials and working people in Nampho City made achievements in thoroughly implementing the childcare policy of the Workers’ Party of Korea. In hearty response to the tasks set forth by the 3rd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Party, the city organized the work down to the last detail on the basis of setting the targets for newly building goat farms, breeding farm, etc. or expanding the production capacity. The officials held a conference to give clear-cut assignments to each unit and waged political work in a progressive manner for arousing the masses while keeping supply of manpower and materials ahead of others. With ardent zeal to uphold the noble intention of respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un in practice, the officials and working people launched a devoted struggle in every construction site. The officials of city’s rural economy committee and builders propelled the project for building a breeding farm with bigger capacity in the place of old building in the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance. The officials and members of the city’s youth league and the officials and members of city’s women’s union, who turned out in the goat farm construction, devoted themselves to the construction. Meanwhile, similar successes were reported in districts and counties including Taean District. As a result, goat farms were built splendidly and breeding farms underwent a complete change. Now the city has mapped out plans for increasing the number of goats and remodeling the farm of dairy cattle in a modern style, and has put spurs to its realization. Rodong Sinmun

title: Many Educators Win Title of October 8 Model Professor
body: Many educators have been honored with the title of October 8 Model Professor this year. A brisk work for increasing the ranks of model professors was conducted in the higher education sector. Teachers and researchers of Kim Il Sung University, Kim Chaek University of Technology and other universities found new teaching methods and strove to enhance their effectiveness. And lots of achievements, made through scientific research activities at pace-setting domains of the national economy and major construction sites, were proactively introduced into teaching students. Many educators at factory colleges also won the title. In the general education field, national teaching contests and teaching-experience sharing meetings were held to create new, effective and superior teaching methods. Multimedia programs were made and introduced into teaching. The number of model professor title winners is increasing amid the great zeal and attention of educators across the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Reply Message to Syrian President
body: Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a reply message to Bashar Al-Assad, president of the Syrian Arab Republic, on Dec. 24. He in the message expressed deep thanks to the Syrian president for having sent a sincere message to him on the occasion of the 10th anniversary of the demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. He also expressed belief that the good relations of friendship and cooperation between the DPRK and Syria provided by the preceding leaders would steadily strengthen in the common struggle for independence against imperialism. Rodong Sinmun

title: December Sees Warm Loving Care in DPRK
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un sent gifts to orphans and health seekers across the country on the occasion of the meaningful day Dec. 24. Children of Mangyongdae Revolutionary School, Kang Pan Sok Revolutionary School and Nampho Revolutionary School were filled with strong emotions and those of baby homes, orphanages, primary and middle schools for orphans across the country, too, felt great happiness. The loving care of the mother Party looking after all the people also reached the old people's homes and homes for the disabled in different parts of the country. The elderly and health seekers expressed their deep gratitude toward the Party's loving care. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of Anti-Japanese War Heroine Kim Jong Suk
body: Officials, working people and service personnel in the capital city of the DPRK laid bouquets and flowers before the bust of anti-Japanese war heroine Kim Jong Suk at the Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery on Mt Taesong on significant December 24. The visitors observed a moment's silence in memory of her noble life. On the same day, local officials, working people and service personnel paid high tribute to the statues of Kim Jong Suk in different parts of the country, including Hoeryong City, Kim Jong Suk County and Kim Jong Suk Naval University. Rodong Sinmun

title: Symposium in Field of Forestry Held in DPRK
body: A national symposium in the field of forestry took place through video-conferencing on December 23 and 24. The symposium on the theme of "Scientific management of forest in the area of Samjiyon" was aimed at fixing the topic of symposium to be regularly held in the future, as well as taking proactive measures for putting the management of forests in the area of Samjiyon on a scientific and technological basis of higher level. Present at the symposium, sponsored by the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea, were officials, scientists and technicians of over 20 units like Kim Il Sung University, Pyongyang University of Agriculture, Kanggye University of Agriculture and Forestry and the State Academy of Sciences. Suggested at the symposium were many plans for resolving the scientific and technological problems arising in finishing the afforestation in the area of Samjiyon in two or three years. Also discussed there were the ways of doing so. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Premier Inspects Chollima Steel Complex, State Academy of Sciences
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea, vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, made a field survey of the Chollima Steel Complex and the State Academy of Sciences. Going round the steel and rolling shops of the complex, the premier called on its officials and workers to take the lead in carrying out the five-year plan unveiled at the Eighth Party Congress in the same fighting spirit and traits that the preceding generation displayed to powerfully accelerate the advance of the country with increased steel production. He stressed the need for the complex to maximize the operating rate of equipment and lower the cost of iron production by fully tapping its own technical force and potentials and to take timely measures for the supply of raw and other materials. Learning about the research work at the State Academy of Sciences, the premier called for making more scientific research achievements conducive to the development of the national economy and the improvement of the people's standard of living, bearing in mind the intention of the Party which set science and technology as an engine for socialist construction. Discussed at the field consultative meetings were measures for pushing ahead with the work to constantly increase the production capacity in a planned way to meet the growing demand for iron and steel and for thoroughly orienting the research work towards the settlement of urgent sci-tech problems arising in such major economic sectors as metallurgical and chemical industries. Rodong Sinmun

title: Implanting Spirit of Paektu in People’s Minds
body: One July day twenty-odd years ago, the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un climbed Mt Paektu, the sacred mountain of revolution, with Chairman Kim Jong Il. Although it was summer, wild winds and dark clouds were roaming the ridge of the mountain. The accompanying officials were sorry that they could not show the Chairman and General Secretary the spectacular features of the mountain. Reading their minds, the respected General Secretary told them that, at the summit of Mt Paektu, they must not only enjoy the views but also look back on all the hardships President Kim Il Sung underwent there. He went on to say that the officials must purify their bodies and souls with the mountain’s fresh air while feeling its blizzards and making rounds of its secret camp and take in the ideological and mental nutrients. His words that day bear a precious truth that one unable to appreciate the blizzards of Mt Paektu cannot become strong in faith nor make revolution till the end. Rodong Sinmun

title: Story about His Love for People
body: In October, Juche 108(2019), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited for a long time apartment houses of the Jungphyong Vegetable Greenhouse Farm of Kyongsong County in the northern end of the country nearing completion. When he went out, dusk had already fallen. Although an official told that it had already darkened, the respected General Secretary headed towards the residential area saying he couldn’t leave without seeing the apartment houses where the employees of the greenhouse farm would live. The respected General Secretary highly appreciated the newly-built apartment houses which would be perfect even in the distant future. And he said if the employees of the farm moved to such wonderful houses, they would delightfully sing the song “We Are the Happiest in the World”. After looking round the houses the respected General Secretary came out of the entrance hall and sat on a stone bench in the resting ground. He noted with deep emotion Chairman Kim Jong Il saw to it that excellent modern houses were built in Oguk-ri, Anak County, and Migok-ri, Sariwon City, personally taking charge of the building, as the issue of modern houses in rural areas was important in the construction of dwelling houses for the people. Looking round the officials, the respected General Secretary said he was greatly pleased at the thought of having done another great thing for our people and it cleared away all his fatigue. He added in gladness that it was worthwhile to make a revolution. This story about the respected General Secretary’s limitlessly lofty love for people will be handed down forever. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of Great Leaders
body: Officials, working people and service personnel visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill in the capital city of Pyongyang on the occasion of December 24, a significant day of the DPRK. The visitors laid floral baskets and bouquets and made a bow before the statues of the great leaders. Floral baskets and bouquets were also laid before the statues of the great leaders and mosaics depicting their smiling images in other parts of Pyongyang, including Kim Il Sung University, the Ministry of Public Security and the Mansudae Art Studio. Meanwhile, officials, working people and service personnel across the country paid high tribute to the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il and mosaics depicting their smiling images in their residential areas. Rodong Sinmun

title: Spare Cutting Faces Secured in Field of Coal Industry
body: The Ministry of Coal Industry secured more than 470 spare cutting faces by the efforts of officials and working people in the field of coal industry, and thus provided a guarantee for boosting the production. Officials of the Ministry of Coal Industry and coal mining complexes across the country raised the hot wind for collective competition and took a measure of supplying equipment and materials needed for tunneling by organizing high-speed tunneling competition. The Sunchon Area Youth Coal Mining Complex secured a hundred and tens of spare cutting faces by giving definite precedence to tunneling. In the Tokchon Area Coal-Mining Complex, over 50 tunneling workteams and youth shock brigades have made uninterrupted innovations and progress while preparing more coal fields in the spirit of finishing two-year and yearly plans ahead of schedule. Colliers of various complexes studied and introduced efficient drilling equipment and blasting method and keep securing new coal fields by vigorously conducting the campaign of high-speed tunneling. Rodong Sinmun

title: Provincial Building Material Exhibition-2021 Opens
body: The provincial building material exhibition-2021 opened under the sponsorship of the State Commission of Science and Technology on December 18. The theme of the exhibition is "Local production and recycling of building materials". Presented to the exhibition were building materials including cement, bricks, additives, adhesives and stone building materials produced by at least 430 producers in all provinces (cities directly under the central authority). Building materials made with non-calcination method and those made from locally available raw materials attract visitors as they save energy and are beneficial to the protection of environment. The exhibition being held as a video teleconferencing presentation will last until December 31. Rodong Sinmun

title: 58 Years as Tamer of Beast of Prey
body: 58 Years! In fact, it is equivalent to one’s whole life. From virginhood, a woman Kim Sun Ok has devoted her wisdom, passion and even her life unsparingly to breeding the beast of prey about which anybody hesitated. In those days, she has directed big efforts to breeding them and increasing their numbers in the Central Zoo. Now she carries out her undertaking in a responsible manner while finding her pride among the people’s pleasure with the will to repay the benefit of the country which put forward her as a Labour Hero and Merited Breeder. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il’s Road to Front
body: The 20 years long history of Chairman Kim Jong Il’s revolutionary activities of leading our revolutionary armed forces shines as the sacred chronicle during which he performed the greatest exploits in the face of the worst adversity. His way was the "do-or-die" way of indescribable hardships and sacrifice. Here goes a touching story. The Chairman was on a tour of inspection towards the front from an early dawn. When he returned from the inspection after lunchtime, there were still rice-balls for breakfast and lunch in his jeep. It made an official move to tears. The Chairman with a smile said to the official that he set out at early dawn, with rice-balls lest soldiers should await him but he could not take them. Visiting posts at the outpost line of the country with iron will and superman efforts the Chairman trained soldiers into a-match-for-a-hundred combatants and fortified defense line posts impregnably. The Chairman built our country into the invincible power and made the people’s army into the politically and ideologically strong one with his high-intensity forced march without sleep and rest. Today our revolutionary armed forces face the greatest heyday of development under the respected Supreme Commander Kim Jong Un. The Chairman’s immortal exploits of defending the country will shine forever and the future of socialist powerful country will be brought under the guidance of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Way of Devotion to Glorify Exploits of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Newly Built Exhibition Hall One July day in Juche 102(2013), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un summoned a senior official of the Korean People’s Army and gave instructions to build an exhibition hall showing the undying exploits of Chairman Kim Jong Il at the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum. He said that, in view of the principle of continuity of our revolution, too, an exhibition hall indicative of the Chairman’s achievements had to be built to convey them to our people and rising generations. Actually at that time, the construction work and display and exhibition were progressing at the final stage thanks to the wise guidance of the respected General Secretary, who initiated the construction of the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum, appointed the site for the museum on the spot in person and gave other detailed instructions. An intensive campaign to build the exhibition hall was launched by his immovable faith and will to luster the Chairman’s achievements made in the building of revolutionary armed forces for all generations to come. His ardent loyalty and noble moral obligation enabled the exhibition hall to be built with splendor in a short period of time. Immutable Will The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited the Chonapho Fishery Research Institute in July, Juche 103(2014). At that time, the institute was not running on a normal track. Some officials were only making administrative calculations and worrying about the prospects of the institute. After making rounds of the institute, the respected General Secretary stressed that the institute associated with the guidance of Chairman Kim Jong Il, who had cared so much to provide the people with delicious fishes, had to be revitalized at any cost to defend the Chairman’s high prestige and carry out his behests with credit. That day, he said that all the undertakings the Chairman had planned, decided and conducted were important affairs for the prosperity of the country and future of the nation and this fact was more keenly recognized. He went on to say that the Chairman’s ideology and prestige had to be defended without fail and be adhered to in any circumstances. His lofty fidelity and devotion turned the Chonapho Fishery Research Institute into a unit conveying the Chairman’s achievements, a hub for studying and disseminating fishery science which is conducive to the country’s prosperity and improvement of people’s living standard and a pivotal base for fish farming and processing. Best Delight One day in February several years ago, the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited the Samchon Catfish Farm. He expressed great satisfaction at the fact that the farm had been drastically turned into the world-level farm and a precious wealth associated with Chairman Kim Jong Il’s benevolent care as the leading fish farm of our country able to solve a big problem in improving diet of the peopleand servicemen. He added that the farm was praiseworthy in the world. Making rounds of the farm, he recalled with deep emotion the historic day when he visited the farm with the Chairman and gave precious instructions for management of the farm. He stressed that the officials should regard the Chairman’s last instructions as lifeline and live and struggle with strong will to devote themselves to implementing them and high sense of responsibility. That day after field guidance to the farm, the respected General Secretary said to the accompanying officials that his last visit to the farm had made him heavy-hearted but the current visit gave him a pleasure. Indeed, he secures the Chairman’s authority in every way and adds eternal luster to the Chairman’s leadership achievements. It is the respected General Secretary’s best pleasure and pride. Rodong Sinmun

title: Lodging Quarters for Visitors to Sariwon Revolutionary Site Opens
body: A lodging quarters for visitors to the Sariwon Revolutionary Site was newly built in North Hwanghae Province. The lodging quarters, covering a total floor space of more than 1 500 square meters, has bedrooms, clinic, sci-tech learning space, etc. It will contribute to the education in revolutionary traditions among the Party members, working people and youngsters. Present at its opening ceremony held on the spot on December 26 were Mun Chang Il, secretary of the North Hwanghae Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials concerned, working people and employees of the lodging quarters. Rodong Sinmun

title: "Complete Collection of Kim Il Sung's Works" Published
body: The Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House brought out Vol. 16 (enlarged edition) of the "Complete Collection of Kim Il Sung's Works", a library of the immortal Juche idea dealing with President Kim Il Sung's works systematically and comprehensively in chronological order. Contained in the book are 94 classic works such as historic speeches, talks and conclusions made by the President in the period from January to June Juche 39 (1950). Among them are works clarifying the idea that all servicepersons should be fully prepared in politico-ideological and military-technological aspects and the military units' combat efficiency further enhanced, as required by the prevailing situation. Some of them expound the ideas of training many competent cadres of the nation, devoting all efforts to the preventive and curative medical care for the working people and giving wide and effective publicity to the excellent national art of the Korean people. There are also works that give perfect solutions to the theoretical and practical issues arising in the revolutionary struggle and construction, including the issue of helping the children of the revolutionary martyrs become excellent officials through hard study, the issue of building modern villages, the issue of developing agriculture and sprucing up the land through river improvement and tideland reclamation projects and the issue of editing the Korean grammar textbook well. Rodong Sinmun

title: Gift to Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un from Russian Party Leader
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a gift from the chairwoman of the Party for Peace and Unity of Russia on the occasion of the New Year Juche 111 (2022). The gift was conveyed to the DPRK ambassador to Russia by Chairwoman Sazhi Umalatova. Rodong Sinmun

title: 4th Plenary Meeting of 8th WPK Central Committee Convened
body: The 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) was convened on December 27. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the WPK, was present at the plenary meeting. Attending the meeting were members and alternate members of the WPK Central Committee. And officials of the departments of the Party Central Committee, leading officials of ministries, national institutions, province-level guidance organs, cities, counties and major industrial establishments and officials of relevant major sectors were on hand as observers. Upon the authorization of the Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee, Kim Jong Un presided over the plenary meeting. The plenary meeting is to review the implementation of main Party and state policies for the year 2021 and discuss and decide on the strategic and tactical policies and practical tasks for dynamically guiding the struggle of our Party and people to usher in a new period of the development of socialist construction to the next stage of victory. The plenary meeting approved the agenda items and went into the discussion of them. Political News Team

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Birthday Spread to Centenarian
body: Those who enjoy a healthy longevity are increasing thanks to the popular polices of the Party and state in the DPRK. Han Yong Son, who lives in Jonsan-ri of Sangwon County, has celebrated her 100th anniversary. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un sent a birthday spread to her. She, born as a daughter of a poor share cropper before national liberation, bitterly experienced the sorrow resulting from statelessness, subject to all sorts of humiliation and contempt. It was not until President Kim Il Sung liberated the country that she could live a genuine life as a master of the country and the land. She worked hard as a farmer to live up to the Party's benevolence. During the hard-fought fatherland liberation war, she took the lead in supporting the front. During the post-war rehabilitation and socialist construction she fulfilled her responsibility and duty as an agricultural worker for decades, true to the Party's agricultural policy. She let her five sons and daughters join the army for the defence of the country and work at important sectors of socialist construction. She still voluntarily works for the country though she is a pensioner. Working in good health, she always asks her descendants and neighbors to do more work for the socialist system of the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Venerable Great Personality Kept in Mind of People
body: Declaration of Iron Faith and Will Toward evening on December 31, Juche 83(1994), Chairman Kim Jong Il visited a firing range to shoot. With a sound of running fire of automatic rifle, breaking the silence like the calm before a storm, the target was destroyed out of recognition. In the wake of emptying a magazine, he fired again a machine gun at another target. A few hours later since his shooting, the Chairman visited the Kumsusan Palace of Sun to pay homage to President Kim Il Sung who lies in state and started on a tour of inspection to the Dwarf Pine Post. The gun report that rang out carrying the painful meaning at that time when the moves of hostile forces to isolate and stifle our style socialist country, legacy of the President, had reached an extreme and thus our revolution faced harsh trials and obstacles reflected his iron faith and will to defend the red flag of Juche bearing the whole life of the President forever, firmly holding arms of the revolution in our hands. Matchless Courage and Boldness It was one April day 10-odd years ago when the challenges and desperate behaviors of hostile forces against the DPRK reached an extreme. That day, Chairman Kim Jong Il met senior officials of the state and military and instructed them that he did not make empty promises and did everything without condition when he was determined. Many eye-opening victories were achieved on this land thanks to the wise leadership of the Chairman who had matchless courage and boldness. Therefore, President Kim Il Sung highly praised the Chairman’s courage and boldness and used to say that the Chairman was unperturbed even though tens of millions of powerful enemies came in crowds, he was so surprised at the Chairman’s courage and boldness and he was greatly encouraged by the Chairman’s courage and boldness on several occasions. Our people convey the great personality of the Chairman, who led our revolution to victory with matchless courage and boldness, year after year. Slogan "Let Us Help the People!" One February day Juche 97(2008), Chairman Kim Jong Il inspected a unit of the Korean People’s Army. Carefully looking the letters "Army-civilian Unity", written on signboard of the unit’s education room, he said that the army-civilian unity means that the army helps the people and the people assist the army. And he stressed that lower units like company should uphold the slogan "Let Us Help the People!" Chewing over its meaning, there was the noble intention of the Chairman that the servicepersons should become the reliable creators of the people’s happiness who devote their sincerity to the people’s happiness despite hardships, create "something" out of "nothing" and turn a misfortune into a blessing. The slogan "Let Us Help the People!" reflects the true character of our revolutionary armed forces further strengthened as the genuine people’s army under the leadership of the Chairman. Rodong Sinmun

title: Servicepersons Full of Ardent Yearning for Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: A touching story about Persimmon-Tree Company! In mid-October 10 years ago Chairman Kim Jong Il appreciated a performance given by the soldiers of the Persimmon-Tree Company. He was informed that the soldiers there couldn’t calm themselves down by the thought of arrival of the Chairman when they heard the sound of a car. He recollected with deep emotion that he had become familiar with them during the Arduous March. When the Chairman was told that all the soldiers of the People’s Army including Persimmon–Tree Company were looking forward the day of his visit, he made a promise to visit them saying he also missed them. Still, the soldiers of Persimmon–Tree Company bearing deep in their minds the promise made that day are yearning for him all the time at the thought of his sudden visit to their post. Therefore they reveal their heartfelt words looking up the sky over Pyongyang as follows. "Great General, persimmons are ripe." Rodong Sinmun

title: Seminar of Chongryon Officials Held
body: Officials of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) held a seminar for deeply grasping the greatness and immortal exploits of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un at the Central Hall of Chongryon in Tokyo of Japan on December 24. Present there were Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, Pak Ku Ho, first vice-chairman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee and director of its Organization Department, members of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee and other officials of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee. Speeches were made at the seminar by Pae Jin Gu, vice-chairman and concurrently director general of the General Affairs Department of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, Jo Il Yon, vice-chairman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, Song Kun Hak, vice-chairman and concurrently director of the Education Department of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, Kim Song Hun, first vice-director general of the General Affairs Department of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, and So Chung On, director of the Department for International Affairs and Reunification of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee. The speakers recalled with deep emotion that with his brilliant wisdom, outstanding political ability and loving care for the people, the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un made a new turning point of prosperity unprecedented in the 5 000-year-long history of the nation and has led the Chongryon and Koreans in Japan along the road of patriotism. Rodong Sinmun

title: Second-day Sitting of 4th Plenary Meeting of 8th WPK Central Committee Held
body: There was the second-day sitting of the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea for indicating the new fighting guidelines for the prosperity of the country amid high political enthusiasm of the participants. In the wake of reviewing the execution of major Party and state policies for 2021 and discussing issues related to the work plan for the New Year at the first-day sitting, the plenary meeting mainly dealt with the immediate tasks for the proper solution to socialist rural questions on Tuesday. At the first-day sitting, General Secretary Kim Jong Un made a historic conclusion "On Direction of Party and State Work for 2022". And at the second-day sitting, he made a historic report of important significance in the socialist rural development. He set forth medium- and long-term development strategies and major tasks for attaining the grand goal of rural development in line with the realistic conditions and the requirement of the times for the overall development of our style socialist construction, before advancing detailed ways for its implementation and taking important revolutionary measures. The new programme on socialist rural construction won full support and approval by the participants in the meeting as it indicated the most scientific and revolutionary path for the solution to rural question in our country at present. The meeting is continuing the discussion of the agenda items referred to it. Political News Team

title: Story about His Devoted Service for People
body: Lofty Outlook on Life One August day in Juche 107(2018), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited the Wonsan-Kalma coastal tourist area under construction, in the wake of hot spring area in Yangdok County. Looking round the construction site, he said that the work for building the Wonsan-Kalma coastal tourist area in Myongsasipri (four-kilometer-long beautiful beach) was the one that he most impatiently wanted to do for the people. Looking back upon the past, he has worked heart and soul and devoted himself to creation of wealth for the people. However, he has unfolded blueprint for the people and strived to give all blessings to the people. After a moment, he said that the spirit of making selfless devotion for the people was his outlook on life and a legacy bequeathed by President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. Today all happiness our people enjoy is owing to tireless efforts of the respected General Secretary. Seeing One Product One day the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited an enterprise in the northern part of the country. That day, he watched a product displayed on computer screen at the inventions exhibition and said with satisfaction that its technical state was very great. Noting that it was great technical innovation to mass-produce with low manpower while economizing the materials, he asked officials about opinions of users. The officials informed him of the fact with pride that the product was popular among users and even an official of a unit was deeply impressed by it. Thereon, the respected General Secretary appreciated again that it was good when users liked it. The users he meant were none other than the people. The officials deeply kept in mind his noble intention that the standard of evaluating a product is demand and interest of the people who would use it. Rodong Sinmun

title: Criterion of Appraisal He Set Up Newly
body: One July day in Juche 107(2018) the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un inspected the construction sites in the then Samjiyon County. That day he gave detailed instructions concerned with the construction of Samjiyon County on the spot and also set out a precious guideline for education. It was when a provincial official told him that the province was to renovate Hyesan Teachers Training College upholding his teaching given during his visit to Pyongyang University of Education. He told the accompanying officials that the provinces should raise large numbers of talents by developing education to thoroughly implement the Party policy of making all the people well versed in science and technology. And he said that the talent is a treasure of the country and also main resource for development of the province, city and county and that the education of the rising generation is talent farming. Noting that the provinces should raise a lot of talents in a short period by doing talent farming on a scientific and intensive basis as well as potato farming, he gave the clear instruction that the provinces should put the teacher training system on a scientific and IT basis and produce able teachers by introducing the advanced education method embodied with originality and Juche character. Looking up to him, the officials came to keep deep in their minds the importance of the education. The respected General Secretary said that the related local Party organizations should attach importance to the work to put the basic education of primary and middle schools in their counties on a higher stage, stressing that the provinces should put efforts into education and the work to put the overall education organs in the provinces on a higher level should be done by the provinces. He added that the education should be set as the important criterion in appraisal of the provinces. Set the education as the important criterion! Herein lies the great intention of the respected General Secretary to put the overall education of the country on a higher stage and guarantee the future of the country by making all regions have the big interest in education and channel big efforts into development of education. Rodong Sinmun

title: This Year Witnesses Vigorous Campaign for Bumper Harvest in Agricultural Sector
body: A vigorous campaign for high yield has been waged in the agricultural sector this year. More than 160 farms across the country won the title of high-yielding farm and laid firm foundations for increasing the agricultural production. Farms in eastern and western coastal areas and Pyongyang City carpeted their fields with lots of huminite, compost fermented by microorganisms and organic compound fertilizers. They also increased the grain production by managing the water control in a responsible way while putting the cultivation of crops on a scientific and technical basis. They boosted the per-hectare yield by distributing different kinds of crops in a proper way and introducing different advanced farming methods and technologies. Amid the brisk socialist emulation drive, more than 2 400 workteams and 9 900 sub-workteams of co-op farms across the country were honored with the titles of high-yield workteam and high-yield sub-workteam. They considerably raised the thousand-kernel weight of rice by pushing ahead with the work to enhance the fertility of soil and displaying the communist traits of helping and leading each other. At least 68 000 agricultural workers across the country won the title of bumper cropper by devoting themselves to the farming in the fields throughout this year. Rodong Sinmun

title: Third-day Sitting of 4th Plenary Meeting of 8th WPK Central Committee Held
body: The third-day sitting of the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea took place on December 29 amid enthusiasm for the revolution and struggle of all the participants growing higher after receiving the practical programme that indicates a new path for the development of our style socialism. In the second-day sitting, the plenary meeting organized sectional workshops and entered into a study and discussion to map out plans according to the fighting policies set forth in General Secretary Kim Jong Un's historic conclusion "On the Orientation of the Work of the Party and State in 2022" and his important report "On the Immediate Tasks for the Correct Solution of the Socialist Rural Question in Our Country". The meeting continued the study and discussion in the third-day sitting. Upon authorization of the plenary meeting, a state budget assessment group for discussing the second agenda item "On the implementation of the state budget for 2021 and the draft state budget for 2022" was organized to study a draft document. Sectional workshops and consultative sessions are studying and discussing in depth a draft resolution to be presented to the plenary meeting. The workshops and consultative sessions are guided by members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and members of the Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee. Political News Team

title: DPRK Ambassador Presents His Credentials to Sri Lankan President
body: The DPRK ambassador presented his credentials to the president of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka on December 21. Ambassador Choe Hui Chol cordially conveyed the greeting of Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, to President of Sri Lanka Gotabaya Rajapaksa. The Sri Lankan president expressed deep thanks for it and asked the ambassador to convey his warm greeting to HE Kim Jong Un. He hoped that everything would go well in the DPRK and the relations between the two countries further develop. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Floral Basket from Palestinian President
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a floral basket from Mahmoud Abbas, president of the State of Palestine, on the occasion of the New Year, Juche 111 (2022) on Dec. 28. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Floral Basket from Lao President
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a floral basket from Thongloun Sisoulith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party and president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic, on the occasion of the New Year, Juche 111 (2022). The floral basket was conveyed to an official concerned by the Lao ambassador to the DPRK on Dec. 28. On the same day, the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a floral basket from the Lao ambassador to the DPRK. Rodong Sinmun

title: Opening Wide Avenue for Rapid Progress through Courageous Offensive
body: It is the unshakable faith and firm will of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un to resolutely preserve and carry on the indefatigable offensive idea and tradition President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il adhered to throughout their lives. The thoroughgoing offensive spirit of the respected General Secretary constitutes the motive force for giving full play to the mental power of our people and creating world-startling miracles in every sector of socialist construction. At every opportunity, the respected General Secretary used to emphasize on the need to constantly create and keep advancing forward without knowing any stagnation and inertia and self-praise and self-contentment. And he brought up all the people into the fighters with attacking spirit. This year alone, while guiding the important Party meetings, he mainly stressed on the issue of making a breakthrough head-on all the difficulties and challenges facing our revolution by dint of our own force and technology. Thanks to his energetic leadership, continuous offensives were vigorously launched throughout the country for a fresh advance and leap forward as the stubborn attacking spirit pervaded the times. The stubborn offensive unfolded by the respected General Secretary thoroughly serves for people’s happiness. Therefore his offensive always evokes people’s absolute sympathy and emerges victorious. Indeed, the respected General Secretary is the supreme incarnation of the attacking spirit of Paektu who wins all the victories breaking through difficulties in an offensive way in the face of trials of history. With him in the van, the construction of a powerful socialist country is sure to emerge victorious and its future is rosy. Rodong Sinmun

title: Touching Story on an Ordinary Day
body: One day in mid-April Juche 108(2019), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un thirdly visited the Sinchang Fish Farm, associated with immortal guidance exploits of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. Going round the farm, he stopped at a fishpond. After walking up to a feed table, he personally shoveled up feed and scattered it over the fishpond. The respected General Secretary earnestly said that fish farming needed large funds and much labor but it was our Party’s idea and will to make our people lead an affluent life having delicious fish including rainbow trout and freshwater salmon. That day the respected General Secretary stressed that it required much labor to build the fish farm but our people could surely share in the benefit of it in case we build and run the farm well. Then he instructed that fish farms in good surroundings should be built in the places with the source of water to breed fish in an intensive way. The story about his love for our people touches all people’s heartstrings and his benevolent and loving care brings happiness to all of us. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Messages, Letters from Foreign Personages
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received messages and letters from foreign personages on the occasion of the 10th anniversary of demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il. They include the general secretary of the Central Committee of the Nepal Communist Party (Marxist-Leninist), the chairperson of the Nepal Communist Party (United Socialist), the secretary general of the Lebanon Federation of Workers, the general secretary of the Mongolian People's Party, the chairperson of the Central Executive Committee of the Bangladesh National Socialist Party, the general secretary of the C.C., Syrian Communist Party, the general secretary of the Syrian Communist Party (Unified), the general secretary of the Arab Democratic Union Party of Syria, the general secretary of the Al Ahd al Watani Party of Syria, the general secretary of the Socialist Unionist Party of Syria, the general secretary of the Syrian Arab Socialist Union Party, the general secretary of the Political News Team

title: His Warm Affection Touches Heartstrings of People
body: Spending His Precious Time One September day, Juche 102(2013), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited the Rungna 4D Simulation Cinema which had been built with splendor on the picturesque Rungna Islet. That day, he dropped in at one of the rooms and watched several 4D simulation movies. Learning in detail about the quality and acoustic effects of every scene, he instructed that even a single movie had to be made well to suit the people’s tastes and reflect the psychological features and demands of young people and children. The Rungna 4D Simulation Cinema is not big in size. However, the respected General Secretary valued so much the people’s happy laughter to be heard there. That’s why he unsparingly spent his precious time guiding even every movement of the simulation equipment and every scene of the movies. That day, he taught the accompanying officials that 4D simulation cinemas had to be also built in districts of Pyongyang City and other provinces. Looking up to the respected General Secretary feasting his eyes on the cinema with a broad smile on his face, the officials could visualize the cinema full of the people’s happy laughter. Earnest Request He Made Out of Delight One September, the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un inspected the Kosan Combined Fruit Farm. He had been informed of the fruit farm’s unprecedentedly rich harvest and so delighted that he could arrive there in a breath. He said that the trees covered with red apples in the area below Chol Pass as a whole represented a spectacular ruddy view. He continued with passion that such a view couldn’t be found anywhere else in the world. Then he entered the orchard, felt the ripe apples in his hand and expressed his satisfaction over and over. Presently, he stressed that those apples had to be conveyed without any scar to the people. Without any scar! It was an earnest request bearing warm love of the father who regards the people’s joy and happiness as his greatest delight and pride and intends that things to be provided for the people should be flawless and things for their sake always be done on the highest level possible. Indeed, all blessings in our country are the fruits of the great father’s devotion and tireless efforts. Special Nursery This story happened during the 4th National Meeting of Mothers. The issue of representatives to the meeting who had nursing babies became an important matter of discussion. At that time, many of the representatives had nursing babies. However, they couldn’t bring their babies to the meeting. Those mothers were so upset because they had no choice but leave their babies alone. When the officials in charge of the preparations for the meeting as well as the participants with nursing babies were all at a loss, a measure was taken to their surprise. The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un saw to it that a nursery was prepared at the lodging quarters in order that the nursing mothers might feel convenient during the meeting. All the representatives including those nursing mothers couldn’t repress their gratitude for his benevolence. The nursery was truly the fruit of the benevolent father’s love. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Society Overflowing with Virtues and Affection
body: New House Waits for Its Owner In Juche 104 (2015) when Rason City was damaged by flood, a boy called Hong Yong Won was carried to the Rason City People’s Hospital without consciousness. Medical workers of the hospital worked hard to bring back to consciousness the boy who lost his family and house by flood. Expensive medicines which the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un sent to the people in the flood-hit areas were used for his treatment. Doctors and nurses of the hospital showed their every sincerity for his early recovery. And many people including strangers helped him with the mind of real parents and brothers. It was when he was in the hospital that the Party provided him a newly built house in Manbok-dong, Sonbong District. He became able to walk again after 60-odd days of hospitalization and left for his new house built by warm love of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un. Hong Yong Won, the then pupil of Sonbong Senior Middle School, is now undergoing service in the Korean People’s Army to defend the benevolent socialist house with arms. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Congratulatory Message from President of State of Palestine
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), received a message of greeting from Mahmoud Abbas, president of the State of Palestine and chairman of the Executive Committee of the Palestine Liberation Organization, on December 20, 2021, ahead of the New Year 2022. Mahmoud Abbas said that he is pleased to extend wholehearted warmest congratulations to Kim Jong Un, and through him, to friendly WPK, DPRK government and people on behalf of the State and people of Palestine and on his own behalf on the occasion of the New Year 2022. He wished Kim Jong Un good health and happiness and the DPRK people and all other people in the world wellbeing, prosperity and peace in the new year. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Congratulatory Message from Emir of State of Kuwait
body: Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Nawaf Al Ahmad Al Jaber Al Sabah, emir of the State of Kuwait, on Dec. 20, 2021 on the occasion of the New Year 2022. The emir in his message said that he is pleased to extend his heartfelt congratulations and best wishes to Kim Jong Un on the occasion of the New Year 2022. He said that he takes this opportunity to hope that the new year will be a fine year when peace and stability will settle in the whole world and well-being and prosperity be brought to all people. The message wished Kim Jong Un good health and hoped that the relations between the two friendly countries and between the two peoples would grow stronger. Rodong Sinmun

title: Congratulatory Message to Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un from President of DR Congo

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Floral Basket to President of Cuba
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), sent a floral basket to Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez, first secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba and president of the Republic of Cuba, in celebration of the 63rd anniversary of victory of the Cuban revolution. The congratulatory floral basket bearing the august name of Kim Jong Un was cordially conveyed to an official concerned of the Cuban Foreign Ministry by the DPRK ambassador to Cuba. Written in the ribbons of the basket were letters reading "Warm congratulations to the 63rd anniversary of the victorious Cuban revolution". Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Congratulatory Message toChairman of Chongryon Central Standing Committee
body: Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a congratulatory message to Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), on Saturday. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un in the message extended warm compatriotic greetings to the chairman and all the officials of Chongryon and other compatriots in Japan vigorously advancing toward a new heyday of the movement of Koreans in Japan on the occasion of the New Year 2022. Last year, Chongryon and Koreans in Japan fully demonstrated once again the true picture of Chongryon, which is strong and firm by dint of ideology, virtue and affection, while braving all manifold challenges and threats even under the unprecedentedly dreary situation of an alien land, the message noted. Kim Jong Un extended warm thanks to all the Chongryon officials and Koreans in Japan who adorned the year 2021 with patriotic journey and dedicated their invariable loyalty to the national reunification, development and prosperity. He said in the message that the New Year 2022 is a great auspicious year in the Korean nation's history that will greet the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung and the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il and a year of historic advance when a big stride should be made for socialist construction and the overall development of the movement of Koreans in Japan. This year, Chongryon should hold Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il in high esteem and glorify the 25th Congress of Chongryon as a meeting of single-minded unity, succession and innovation, dedicate itself to the sake of Koreans in Japan and more strikingly prove the validity and vitality of the Juche-based idea on the overseas compatriots' movement in practice by waging a vigorous patriotic movement with the infinite power of the broad masses of compatriots, the message said. In this auspicious year, our Party and the DPRK government will devotedly implement the policies awaited and welcomed by all the compatriots, including the provision of a stronger legal guarantee for defending and ensuring the rights and interests of the overseas compatriots, true to the behests of the President and the Chairman, the message pointed out. The message hoped that the beloved Korean children and students in Japan would grow up lively and stoutly and that peace and happiness would settle in all compatriots' families in the hopeful New Year, too. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Congratulatory Message to Cuban President
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), sent a congratulatory message to Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez, first secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba and president of the Republic of Cuba, on Saturday. In the message, Kim Jong Un extended warm congratulations to Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez and the friendly Cuban party, government and people on the occasion of the 63rd anniversary of victory of the Cuban revolution. He noted that over the past 60-odd years after the victory in the Cuban revolution, the fraternal Cuban people have resolutely defended and developed the socialist system, the gains of the revolution, united firmly around the Communist Party of Cuba. Expressing his sincere pleasure over the fact that under the leadership of the first secretary, the Cuban party and people have smashed all sorts of challenges and wicked maneuvers of the hostile forces and reliably carried forward the revolutionary cause pioneered and advanced by the preceding leaders while waging a dynamic struggle to implement the decisions made at the 8th Congress of the Communist Party of Cuba, he extended his full support and firm solidarity with it. The message expressed the firm conviction that the precious traditions of friendship and unity between the two parties and two countries would steadily develop in the common struggle to realize the socialist cause. And it wholeheartedly wished the first secretary bigger success in his responsible and noble work. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Basket to Statues of Great Leaders from IMAF Board of Directors
body: The Board of Directors of the International Martial Arts Foundation (IMAF) sent a floral basket to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill here on the occasion of the New Year, Juche 111 (2022). The floral basket was placed before the statues on Dec. 30. On the same day, the floral baskets in the names of missions of international organizations here were laid before the statues of the great leaders. Rodong Sinmun

title: His Noble Idea of Devoted Service for People Touches People’s Heartstrings
body: When we think of the twelve months of this year a phrase flashes across our minds. It is "the devoted service for the people." This is the phrase which all our people graved in their hearts in 2021, the year of love for people. It is reflective of the devotion of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un who has worked heart and soul for the people’s wellbeing all the year round. Indeed, this phrase is an implication of his delight and happiness, idea and wish, thoughts and efforts. That’s why we cannot repress our tears whenever we look back upon his revolutionary activities this year. His idea of devoted service for the people contains the immutable faith of regarding the people as his everything and persevering will of doing whatever wanted by the people in a perfect way. The respected General Secretary, who is illustrating the meaning of the devoted service for the people with his action, is truly the greatest father of the people. His great leadership and devotions to the people will create a people’s paradise envied by the world. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Flag-hoisting Ceremony Marks New Year
body: A national flag-hoisting ceremony was solemnly held at Kim Il Sung Square on January 1, Juche 111 (2022). The square was crowded with Pyongyangites to greet the moment when the national flag would be hoisted. At 00:00 sharp, a bell tolled the start of the New Year and melodies of the immortal revolutionary hymns "Song of General Kim Il Sung" and "Song of General Kim Jong Il" reverberated far and wide, providing people with great pride and confidence of being members of Kim Il Sung's nation and Kim Jong Il's Korea. Exemplary workers, farmers, intellectuals, young people and students of the capital city solemnly spread out the flag of the DPRK and it was slowly hoisted up amid the playing of the national anthem of the DPRK. At this significant moment, everyone paid their respects to the national flag. Gorgeous fireworks were displayed in the nocturnal sky over Pyongyang along with the fluttering flag of the Republic, adding to the festive mood. Rodong Sinmun

title: Banquet in Celebration of New Year 2022 Given
body: A banquet in celebration of New Year 2022 was held at Mokran House on Dec. 31. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un was so considerate as to invite the meritorious workers and labor innovators to present at the banquet as main members in recognition of their distinguished feats in the struggle for attaining the first eminence in the new five-year plan. Those who were honored to be present at the banquet as the pride of the country in 2021 under the great affection and trust of the great father were greatly excited to be invited to the event of honor and happiness. They felt deep gratitude to Kim Jong Un for taking highly of the simple achievements made by ordinary soldiers although he himself brought about the great victory of today with his day and night dedication to the people the year round. Present there together with the meritorious workers and labor innovators were Choe Ryong Hae, Kim Tok Hun, Pak Jong Chon, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), and other members of the Party central leadership organ. Ri Il Hwan, member of the Political Bureau and secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, made a speech there. He, upon authorization of Kim Jong Un, warmly congratulated those meritorious workers and labor innovators who were invited to the meaningful banquet. He said that all the achievements made in the journey which left another page of victory in the history of the country are a result of the heroic struggle waged by all the people across the country including the meritorious workers and labor innovators who enthusiastically supported and faithfully upheld the Party's determination while sharing the thought and intention with the Party Central Committee all the time. He said that amid the stirring struggle that swept across the country with the drive for implementing the decisions of the Party Congress, the ranks of fighters of self-reliance braving through difficulties in reliance on their own efforts and communists who helped and led each other forward and created collective innovation have seen further expansion. This is a matchless precious success and valuable asset guaranteeing the bright future of the country, he added. He said that when the meritorious workers and labor innovators become seeds of fire in their posts and workplaces and adorn each minute and second in the new year with creation and innovation as pace-setters, our country will make a stride forward toward the great goal and the cause of building our style socialism will greet a great victory certainly. All the participants were reminded of the iron truth that there is genuine honor and happiness of their life in entrusting their destiny and future to the General Secretary and upholding him with single mind, and hardened their firm pledge to make hundred-fold efforts in the van of the times making leaping progress in high spirit. Rodong Sinmun

title: People in Komdok Area Move into New Houses
body: Under the far-reaching plan of the Party Central Committee to build the Komdok area into a mine city and a gorge city without an equal in the world, single-, low-, many- and multi-storied dwelling houses and terraced houses in good harmony with each other have been built in Kumgol-dong 1, 2 and 3, Taehung-dong 2, Paekgumsan-dong and Thamsa-dong of Tanchon City in a gorge. As a result, another fairyland has sprung up in the new era when the local areas are changing. The ceremonies of moving into new houses built thanks to the affection of the Party took place in those areas on Dec. 30 and Dec 31, Juche 110 (2021). Present at the ceremonies were Kim Myong Du, vice-chairman of the South Hamgyong Provincial People's Committee, officials of the General Bureau of the Tanchon Area Mining Industry, the Komdok Mining Complex, the Ryongyang Mine and the Taehung Youth Hero Mine and residents. The speakers said that thousands of modern flats have been built in less than one year in the Komdok area associated with the undying leadership feats of our Party and that people in the area became to move into new houses, adding that it is the brilliant fruition of the noble affection of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un for the people. They expressed the determination to fully display the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance and fortitude in the ongoing general onward march for the implementation of the decisions of the 8th Party Congress, always remembering the great affection of our Party all their lives, and thus increase the production of minerals decisively and fulfill their duty reliably in the major sector of the national economy. The residents were awarded house use licenses at the ceremonies. Officials visited those who were excited to move to the new houses with all excellent living conditions provided to congratulate their owners. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Has Photo Session with Meritorious Workers and Labor Innovators
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the DPRK, met meritorious workers and labor innovators who performed distinguished feats in the struggle of the first year for implementing the decisions made at the Party Congress, and had a significant photo session with them. The participants were greatly excited to be honored to have the photo taken before the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, supreme temple of Juche, in the morning on the New Year's Day in 2022 in the presence of the respected General Secretary whom they had missed even in their dreams. When the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un arrived, they enthusiastically cheered the great father who brought about miraculous victory to be specially recorded in the history of socialist construction with his energetic revolutionary leadership the year round but counted all those achievements to the credit of the people and repeatedly bestowed the greatest honor and considerations on the ordinary workers who did what they were obliged to do. The General Secretary warmly shook hands and gave pep talks to those meritorious workers and labor innovators who made valuable achievements in their posts and workplaces with absolute loyalty for the Party and the revolution and with strenuous efforts to contribute to brilliantly concluding 2021. He had the photo taken with them, voicing expectation that all the participants would continue to creditably perform their core and pioneer roles in the gigantic struggle in the New Year to lay a sure guarantee for implementing the five-year plan and to bring about obvious change in the state development and people's living standard. As the photo session was over, the emotion-charged participants again broke into thunderous cheers of "Hurrah!", running into the arms of the kind-hearted Marshal and presenting impressive scene of inseparable bonds of kindred feelings. All the participants renewed their firm pledge to bear deep in mind the great loving care and trust of the General Secretary and make contribution to winning a new great victory through all-people general march for the prosperity of our socialist country. Political News Team

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Visits Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: Greeting the new year with confidence and optimism after seeing off the year 2021 that witnessed the clear victories etched in the history of the country along with the historic 8th Congress of the Party, the whole country is overflowing with great reverence for President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, the founder and builders and the eternal leaders of our dignified and strong Party and state. Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on Jan. 1, Juche 111 (2022). Accompanying him were Choe Ryong Hae, Jo Yong Won, Kim Tok Hun and Pak Jong Chon, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, and members of the Party central leadership organ. Placed at the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il was a floral basket from the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. Also laid before the statues were floral baskets in the names of the WPK Central Committee, the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK and the Cabinet of the DPRK. The respected General Secretary together with the visitors paid high tribute to the statues of the great leaders. At the halls where the great leaders lie in state, Kim Jong Un made deep New Year's bows to them as a token of his deepest reverence for them, who victoriously advanced the revolution and construction by dedicating their precious whole lives to laying the eternal cornerstone of prosperous socialist Korea and still provide the people across the country with invincible power and courage and bless their brighter future by becoming the pillar of their faith. The members of the Party central leadership organ hardened their firm pledge to remain absolutely loyal to the idea and leadership of Kim Jong Un and fulfill their heavy responsibility given by the country and the people and thus make this year, in which crucial struggle for expediting the overall development of socialist construction is expected, a year of great revolutionary auspicious event and another watershed in the great march toward the bright future. Political News Team

title: New Year Performance Given in DPRK
body: A performance for celebrating the New Year was given in Pyongyang on the night of December 31, Juche 110(2021). Kim Il Sung Square brightened by a special stage and colorful decorations was full of citizens. The songs "My Great County" and "Pyongyang Is Best" resounded at the venue of the New Year performance. The performers sang high praises of the immortal feats and greatness of the Workers' Party of Korea that ushered in the era of new development and prosperity and the era of our state-first principle on this land with the politics based on the people-first principle. The atmosphere was revved up by the youth songs which represented the spirit of the patriotic youth. The performance climaxed with a large chorus "Cheers of the People" which reflected the all-people emotion to live with dignity in boundless glory and happiness of holding the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un in high esteem, at the square nearing the first start of the hopeful New Year. The performance, which was run through with the joy, optimism and excitement of greeting the New Year, ended with large choruses and dances "We Are the Happiest in the World" and "Snow Is Falling on New Year's Day". Rodong Sinmun

title: New Posters Produced in DPRK
body: The Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House produced posters inspiring all the people to carry out the decisions of the Fourth Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. The posters represent the revolutionary will and burning pledge of the Korean people to make continuous innovations and advance in this meaningful year in the same spirit and mettle that they displayed in glorifying the first year for implementing the five-year plan with great victory. They also show the revolutionary spirit of the people to continue ushering in the golden age of capital city construction and opening up an era of changing local areas on the strength of great army-civilian unity. Reflected on the posters is the idea that a new programme for socialist rural construction should be upheld to wonderfully turn all the rural communities into a socialist paradise and put the country's agriculture on a stage of sure progress. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Premier Inspects Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea, vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, inspected the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex which started the first campaign in the New Year. Encouraging the working people of the complex who devotedly defended the dignity of the Party Congress with increased iron and steel production last year, he implanted the basic idea and spirit of the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the WPK into them and stressed the need to raise the elated fighting spirit. Referring to the importance of the duty the complex assumed in this year's advance for providing the firm foundation to implement the five-year plan at the furnace and steel shops, he called for waging a high-pitched drive for increased production through meticulous equipment and technical control with strict preparations and through technical innovation movement. The field consultative meeting stressed the need for officials to carefully organize operation and command for unconditionally accomplishing this year's goal for iron and steel production in line with the decision made at the plenary meeting of the Party Central Committee, and discussed measures to push ahead with the expansion of capacity and modernization stage by stage. Rodong Sinmun

title: Intensive Transport of Scrap Iron
body: Inhabitants in North Hwanghae Province of the DPRK started an active campaign from the beginning of the new year to support the steel sector. Institutions and cities and counties of the province sent several hundred tons of scrap iron that they collected to the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex on Jan. 1.
