The province mapped out a detailed plan to send much more scrap iron to the metal industrial sector before launching a brisk campaign to collect scrap iron by mobilizing all its force and means. Rodong Sinmun

title: Visual Aids Encouraging Implementation of Party Decisions Intensively Displayed
body: Displayed on the streets of the capital and in every province, city, county and village of the DPRK are slogans, watchwords and posters that inspire all the people to implement the decisions of the Fourth Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers' Party Korea. Those visual aids ardently appeal to all the Party members and other working people to turn out as one in a new revolutionary advance with boundless loyalty to the idea and cause of the Party. They reflect the idea of making this meaningful year be notably etched as a glorious chapter in the history of the country by unconditionally carrying out the decisions of the plenary meeting which clarified the principled issues and fighting policies for fresh development in socialist construction. They also represent the revolutionary spirit of the people who are determined to put the country's agriculture on a stage of considerable progress and usher in a great, new era for radical development of the Korean-style socialist countryside by powerfully stepping up the rural development, true to the Party's far-reaching plan for rural construction. The visual aids vividly representing the idea of the plenary meeting are further stirring up everyone's high zeal to more vigorously struggle for the great country's prosperity and the people's wellbeing, remaining faithful to the Party's plan and leadership. Rodong Sinmun

title: Choe Ryong Hae Inspects Pyongyang Thermal Power Plant
body: Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, inspected the Pyongyang Thermal Power Plant. He gave pep talks to its officials and workers who are striving to raise the production of electricity from the start of the new year, true to the decisions of the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee, by putting spurs to the spirit of last year's dynamic advance in which the overall economy had been pushed ahead. Stressing that the plant should take the lead in the general advance in the new year for the overall development of socialist construction, he called for making a positive contribution to reenergizing the national economy by strengthening the existing production foundation and raising the production to a higher level to satisfactorily meet the growing demand for electricity. He underlined the need for the plant to vigorously conduct the three-revolution red flag movement as the key work in bringing about a productive upswing and direct big efforts to cultivating its own sci-tech force through substantial sci-tech dissemination and increasing of the ranks of technicians and skilled workers. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Society Overflowing with Virtues and Affection
body: Crippled Girl of Yesterday to Be Student Ten-odd years ago, Ham Ok Suk, a woman teacher at Jesan Primary School, happened to see a crippled girl Pak U In in Hyongjesan District, Pyongyang, during the survey of school-age children. From her babyhood, Pak could not walk, suffering from cerebral palsy. Conscious of being an educator, she helped the crippled girl with her lessons and treatment, carrying her on her back to school for three years. Later, Pak was able to walk on her foot after getting treatment at the Pyongyang University of Medicine Hospital. When she left the hospital, Pak wrote a letter of thanks to respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un. The respected General Secretary personally saw her letter and sent an autographic reply to her. Pak had honor of taking part in the celebrations of the 70th anniversary of the Korean Children’s Union and became a student of Pyongyang City College of Medicine. Rodong Sinmun

title: Hypersonic Missile Newly Developed by Academy of Defence Science Test-Fired
body: The Academy of Defence Science of the DPRK test-fired a hypersonic missile on Wednesday. Leading officials concerned of the Department of the Munitions Industry of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and the sector of national defence science watched it. The successive successes in the test launches in the hypersonic missile sector have strategic significance in that they hasten a task for modernizing strategic armed force of the state put forward at the 8th Party Congress and help fulfill the most important core task out of the five top priority tasks for the strategic arms sector in the five-year plan. The Party Central Committee expressed great satisfaction at the result of the test-firing and extended warm congratulations to the relevant sector of the national defence science research. In the test launch the academy reconfirmed the flight control and stability of the missile in the active-flight stage and assessed the performance of the new lateral movement technique applied to the detached hypersonic gliding warhead. Having been detached after its launch, the missile made a 120 km lateral movement in the flight distance of the hypersonic gliding warhead from the initial launch azimuth to the target azimuth and precisely hit a set target 700 km away. The reliability of fuel ampoule system under the winter weather conditions was also verified. The test launch clearly demonstrated the control and stability of the hypersonic gliding warhead which combined the multi-stage gliding jump flight and the strong lateral movement. Rodong Sinmun

title: Congratulatory Letter to Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un from Chongryon Central Standing Committee
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a congratulatory letter from the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) on New Year's Day. The letter paid high respect and glory to President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and extended the greatest glory and warmest congratulations to Kim Jong Un as a token of the boundless reverence and loyalty of all the officials of Chongryon and other Koreans in Japan on the occasion of the New Year 2022. Last year Kim Jong Un showed all paternal love and care for Chongryon and Koreans in Japan and guided the movement of Koreans in Japan step by step, brightly indicating the victorious path ahead of Chongryon and the movement despite the complicated situation and the global health crisis, the letter said. Kim Jong Un, who takes warm care of Chongryon and Koreans in Japan with fatherly love, is the guardian of the destiny of Chongryon, the savior of their lives and a benevolent teacher who guides Chongryon to become a model organization of the movement of overseas compatriots of the world, the letter stressed. The letter vowed to go all out for the struggle to glorify the 25th Congress of Chongryon as a historic one in which a new milestone will be marked in the movement of Koreans in Japan and to implement the decisions of the congress, true to the noble idea and intention of Kim Jong Un in the meaningful New Year. It also pledged to make a tangible contribution to the independent reunification of the country and the building of a powerful socialist country by fully inspiring the ardent patriotism and loyalty of the officials of Chongryon and other Koreans in Japan, and to fulfill the patriotic duty for the country and nation by waging proactive external activities. It wished Kim Jong Un good health for the victorious advance and rosy future of the revolutionary cause of Juche and the patriotic cause of Chongryon. Rodong Sinmun

title: Letter to Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un from General Association of Koreans in China
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a congratulatory letter from the General Association of Koreans in China on Saturday, on the occasion of the New Year 2022. The letter said that the officials of the association and all Koreans in China offer their prayer of greetings for the immortality of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, together with new year greetings to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, the bright sun of the nation and the banner of victory and glory. The year 2021 was a year of great victory in which the people in the homeland made a new development in socialist construction while displaying the invincibility, mightiness and inexhaustible national power of Juche Korea to the full, upholding Kim Jong Un as the general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) on the road to victory indicated by the 8th Party Congress, it noted. It noted that having Kim Jong Un, the world's mightiest and greatest man who has taken warm care of the homeland and the people in the midst of manifold unimaginable challenges and difficulties and guided them towards a bright future, as the leader of the nation is the great fortune and glory of all the fellow countrymen and overseas compatriots. The letter said that the officials of the association and every Korean living in China are filled with burning resolution to glorify the year 2022, a year that will greet the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung and the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il, as a year of great national festivity and fresh victory, bearing the firm faith that final victory is certain as long as there is Kim Jong Un. It wished the benevolent father of Koreans in China, Kim Jong Un, good health, carrying the boundless reverence and unanimous desire of all Koreans living in China. Rodong Sinmun

title: Congratulatory Letter to Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un from AINDF
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a congratulatory letter from the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front (AINDF) on Saturday on the occasion of the New Year 2022. The letter paid the highest tribute to President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in reflection of the reverence of the vanguard fighters and patriotic people of different circles in south Korea, and made a New Year's bow to Kim Jong Un. It said that as Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs, provided detailed practical policy for building a powerful country and source of innovation and upswing for the people in the north and energetically led the struggle for realizing it last year, the DPRK struck the world people with wonder by making substantial advance and practical changes in every field of building a powerful country under the uplifted banner of prosperity by dint of self-reliance despite the unprecedentedly severe worldwide political and economic upheavals and the hostile forces' persistent offensive for stifling it. Under his guidance, the days of Juche Korea have been woven with a series of world-startling miracles and victories and the dignity and mightiness of the DPRK is put on the highest level, the letter said. It pledged to turn south Korea into a great garden of sunflowers cultivated by the loyalists firmly trusting and following Kim Jong Un only and to firmly consolidate the AINDF into a Juche-type vanguard organization steering the revolutionary movement in south Korea under the invincible banner of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism. It expressed belief that as the bright sunrise over Mt Paektu brings dawn to the 3 000-ri land of Korea, a new morning of the reunified country when the entire nation will enjoy eternal prosperity as one is sure to come under the outstanding leadership of Kim Jong Un. Lauding Kim Jong Un as the sun of the Korean nation and peerlessly great man, the letter wished him good health. Rodong Sinmun

title: Lots of Manure Sent to Countryside in DPRK
body: Nationwide support to the agricultural sector gains momentum from the very beginning of the new year in the DPRK. A large amount of manure was transported to farms on Jan. 4. Pyongyang City sent more than 20 000 tons of manure to farms and North Phyongan Province tens of thousands of tons of manure to farms. North Hwanghae and Kangwon provinces have produced much more manure than the last year's and organized intensive transport. Officials and workers of different units in Ryanggang Province, too, carried lots of compost to the potato fields. Agricultural workers, inspired by the nationwide support, are all out in making preparations for the immediate farming. Rodong Sinmun

title: Strenuous Efforts to Increase Production in Metal Industry
body: In hearty response to the important tasks set forth at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea, officials and working people in the metal industry sector have buckled down to the drive for increased production since the first day of the New Year. Officials of the Ministry of Metal Industry brace themselves up to further refine the iron production method of our style, sufficiently provide raw and other materials and fuel to produce iron and steel as planned and push simultaneously ahead with the capacity expansion project and modernization. Those at the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex, an iron and steel producer in the northern part of the country, also work in high spirits. With lessons and precious experiences drawn from their last year’s struggle to maintain and reinforce the foundation for Juche-based iron production, they have gone all out to increase production with fresh preparedness. Officials and workers at the Chollima Steel Complex make innovations day after day in their first campaign in the New Year. Better still, output of iron trioxide is on the increase at the Posan Iron Works and Chongjin Steel Plant. Like this, the officials and workers in the metal industry sector step up production true to the great fighting programme put forward by the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea. Rodong Sinmun

title: Hungnam Fertilizer Complex Increases Production
body: Officials and workers in the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex have made a stride forward in the grand march toward a greater victory true to the fighting programme set forth at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea. The officials of the complex have been in the production site since the beginning of the new year to conduct political work for kindling the flames of performing labor feats in hearts of the popular masses. They have launched an intensive drive for putting the production on a higher scientific basis by more meticulously organizing the work for management of equipment and technology in every process. Officials and working people in Composition Shops No.1 and No.2 increase the operation rate of compressor by pooling their wisdom and efforts from the beginning of the first campaign. In every workshop they raise the actual extraction rate by strictly adhering to standard regulations of operation and technical rules amid the vigorous campaign for activating fertilizer production with sci-tech as the dynamic force. In several workshops including the Nitrogen Shop No.2 they make a contribution to increased production of ammonia by means of scientific operation of the facilities and introduction of new working method. Production directing officials dovetail the production lines well and meticulously organize the alternate production work and its guidance. Directors observe technical indexes displayed in the combined control room in real time and settle rising problems in good time. Thus they ensure perfect running of the production lines ranging from input of raw materials to output of products. Rodong Sinmun

title: Railway Workers’ Spirit of Continuous Advance
body: In hearty response to the idea and spirit of the historic 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea, the officials and workers of the railway transport sector make big innovation in the struggle for increasing the railway transport from the outset of the New Year. The railway workers of the Pyongyang Railway Bureau kindle the fierce flame of collective innovation in freight. Keeping in their mind that the rate of locomotives’ operation is precisely results of transportation, those of the Pyongyang Service Brigade of Engine and the West Pyongyang Service Brigade of Engine make successes in increasing the transportation by making self-checking and self-repair and repair in a qualitative way. The Hamhung Railway Bureau puts the transport organization and control on a scientific and rational basis and thus overfulfils the daily cargo transport assignments. Rodong Sinmun

title: Pyongyang City Rally
body: A Pyongyang city rally took place at Kim Il Sung Square Wednesday to vow to carry through the decisions of the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). The platform of the rally was taken by Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet. Attending the rally were senior Party and government officials and city officials, labor innovators and officials of institutions, industrial establishments and farms, working people and youth and students in the city. Kim Yong Hwan, alternate member of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and chief secretary of the Pyongyang City Committee of the WPK, made a report. The 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th WPK Central Committee proudly reviewed the first year's work for implementing the decisions of the Party Congress and set forth the grand fighting goal and tasks for glorifying this year as a great watershed in the revolutionary development and a new programme for the socialist rural construction, the reporter noted, saying: Let us strive for our great state's prosperity and development and our people's wellbeing. This is the great patriotic call made by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un and it is a fighting slogan that should be cherished deep in the minds of all the people out in the struggle to carry out the tasks set forth at the plenary meeting of the Party Central Committee. Saying that 2022 is a significant year marking the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung and the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il and a year of great importance in the historic struggle toward a rosy tomorrow, the reporter called on all the officials, Party members, working people and other citizens in the city to defend the Party Central Committee politically, ideologically and at the cost of their lives and glorify this significant year as a year of great revolutionary events to be etched in the history of the DPRK, cherishing the high pride and sense of duty as citizens of the capital. He stressed that though the tasks for this year are enormous and manifold difficulties disturb the Korean people's advance, greater glory is in store for them as the great Party is always with them and the ever-victorious banner of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism leads them to a fresh victory. Then speeches were made. The speakers said they hardened their unshakable faith through the last year's great struggle that they don't fear any difficulties as they are led by the respected General Secretary and they can surely perform world-startling miracles and changes this year, too, when they do everything as instructed by him. They expressed the determination of Pyongyang citizens to take the lead in implementing the benevolent policy of the mother Party that takes warm care of the people, being entirely responsible for their destiny. They called on all the agricultural workers to dedicate themselves to farming so as to make this significant year a year of bumper crop and great successes in the agricultural sector. They expressed the will of intellectuals to dynamically wage the struggle to devotedly defend the Party Central Committee and bring earlier the comprehensive prosperity of Korean-style socialism by achieving signal scientific and educational achievements, as befits the revolutionary intellectuals brought up under the care of the Party. They also evinced the will of the young people in the capital city to take the lead in performing difficult and arduous tasks in every economic construction site and to continue setting new standards and records by waging a hot collective emulation campaign and performing miracles. The speakers said that it is a firm pledge of the officials, Party members and working people in the city out in the new year's advance to unconditionally and thoroughly implement the grand practical programme set forth by the Party. A letter of pledge to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un was adopted at the rally. Then there was a public procession. Flying the Party flag, national flag of the Republic and red flags, officials, working people and youth and students in the city including workers, farmers, intellectuals, primary information workers of the Party and members of the women's union marched past the square, responding to the chant of revolutionary and militant slogans. Rodong Sinmun

title: Successes Made at Mines and Cement Factory
body: The Sangwon Limestone Mine, the Sunchon Limestone Mine and the Manpho August 2 Cement Factory in the DPRK conducted the successful blastings of 110 000, 170 000 and 200 000 cubic meters of earth respectively in order to carry out the militant tasks set forth at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee. The successes provided a sure guarantee for boosting the cement production. Rodong Sinmun

title: Success Made at Tideland Reclamation Project
body: Workers of the North Phyongan Provincial Tideland Reclamation General Enterprise in the DPRK, out in a drive for implementing the decisions of the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee, successfully conducted the blasting of 250 000 cubic meters of earth at Woldo Tideland under reclamation on Jan. 5. The successful blasting made a breakthrough in pushing ahead with the first-stage project for damming up District No. 1 of Woldo Tideland on a full scale by securing a huge amount of earth and rubble stones. On the same day, there was the blasting of 50 000 cubic meters of earth in Jangsong area. Rodong Sinmun

title: Congratulatory Messages to Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un from Chongryon Organizations
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received congratulatory messages from organizations under the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) on the occasion of the New Year Juche 111 (2022). They are the Standing Council of the Korean Federation of Workers in Commerce in Japan, the Central Standing Committee of the Korean Youth League in Japan, the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Democratic Korean Women in Japan, the Central Standing Management Board of the Korean Youth Commercial Association in Japan, the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Korean Teachers in Japan, the Central Standing Council of the Union of Korean Educational Association in Japan, the Central Standing Council of the Korean Scientists and Technologists Association in Japan, the Central Standing Council of the Korean Social Scientists Association in Japan, the Standing Council of the Korean Sportsmen's Federation in Japan, the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Korean Writers and Artists in Japan, the Central Standing Council of the Korean Health Workers Association in Japan, the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Korean Students in Japan, the Association of Koreans in Japan for Peaceful Reunification, the Central Standing Council of the Korean Human Rights Association in Japan and other central organizations of Chongryon and its affiliated organizations, the Choson Sinbo Company, the Korean News Service, the Hagu Bookshop, the Kumgang-san Opera Troupe, the Tonghae Co. Ltd., Kumgang Insurance Company, the Committee for Promoting Korea-Japan Economic Exchange and other businesses, local headquarters of Chongryon, Korean University and Korean schools at all levels in Japan. The messages paid the noblest respect to President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and extended the greatest glory and the warmest congratulations to Kim Jong Un. They noted that last year was a year of great excitement, heroic feats and devoted struggle when great victories were achieved in the struggle for implementing the important tasks set forth at the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea under the wise leadership of Kim Jong Un. They stressed that to Chongryon, the new year is a year when the 25th Congress of Chongryon will be held and a vital year when a radical turn should be made in the patriotic movement for bringing earlier a new golden age of the movement of Koreans in Japan. They evinced the will to further accelerate the patriotic advance for hastening a new golden age of the movement of Koreans in Japan in the great era of Kim Jong Un by comprehensively implementing the tasks specified in his congratulatory message to the 24th Congress of Chongryon. The congratulatory messages wished Kim Jong Un good health. Rodong Sinmun

title: Electricity Producers at Sunchon Thermal Power Station
body: This picture shows ordinary workers on an ordinary day. However it is an uncommon picture. Electricity producers of the Sunchon Thermal Power Plant readjust and repair generating equipment in a responsible manner. They work hard for production of electricity, regardless of whether they are known or not and recognized or not. They are full of enthusiasm of loyalty and patriotism to endlessly invigorate the advance of the country with increased electricity production by fully implementing the militant tasks set forth at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. The trustworthy workers devote their sincerity and conscience to the production of electricity. Rodong Sinmun

title: Activities of the Field Medical Teams Brisk in DPRK
body: Field medical teams do their part well in different domains of the socialist economic construction. At the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill, a field medical team of the Kim Man Yu Hospital has examined health of employees there and offered medical treatments on the spot since late December last year. The team has given field medical service to them for many years. Officials and employees of the mill unanimously say that their proud labor achievements were encouraged by utmost sincerity and devotion of the medical team. Besides, medical workers of several hospitals like the Pyongyang University of Medicine Hospital offer intensive field medical services to the workers of the Pyongyang Thermal Power Plant and East Pyongyang Thermal Power Plant from the New Year’s Eve. Those of the Pyongyang Maternity Hospital, Ryugyong General Ophthalmic Hospital and other medical and preventive institutions across the country set high goals to unfold field medical activities in a bolder way at major fields of the socialist construction from the beginning of this meaningful year. Rodong Sinmun

title: Innovations Witnessed in Forestry Sector in DPRK
body: Officials and workers in the forestry sector exert their efforts on winter forest timber production, true to the decisions of the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Forest timber producers of Jagang Province take the lead in the production. Forestry stations and mine pillar production stations under the Forestry management bureaus in Ryanggang and South Hamgyong provinces over-fulfill their daily plans by pushing ahead with lumbering and tiller cutting and increasing the operation rate of vehicles. Forestry stations and mine pillar production stations in other provinces register good production results every day. Rodong Sinmun

title: Documents of 4th Plenary Meeting of 8th C.C., WPK Intensively Studied
body: Intensive study of the documents of the plenary meeting of the Party Central Committee are being held by the Party organizations at all levels. The Party organizations of key industrial sectors like those in the Ministry of Metallurgical Industry, the Ministry of Chemical Industry and the Ministry of Electric Power Industry and those in construction and light industrial sectors deepen study with an emphasis put on getting across the intention of the Party to provide a sure guarantee for implementing the five-year plan this year and bringing about an evident change in state development and in improvement of people's living standard. Scientists and researchers of the scientific research field including the State Academy of Sciences put an emphasis on deeply grasping the essence of the historic documents which call for setting it as the basic task to develop and complete technologies of urgent significance in raising the independence of the national economy and in improving the standard of people's living. The Party organizations in agricultural sector make sure that the study course serves as an occasion of giving inspiration for the thorough-going implementation of the fighting tasks set forth in the new socialist rural construction programme and immediate key tasks. The organizations in the fields of education, public health, art and literature, media and sports are also deepening study. Rodong Sinmun

title: Provincial Rallies Held in DPRK
body: There took place rallies in North Phyongan Province and Ryanggang Province to pledge to thoroughly implement the decisions made at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea on Thursday. Present at the rallies were officials of party and power organs, working people's organizations, industrial establishments, farms and universities and working people and students in those provinces. At the rallies it was recalled that according to the proposal made by Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee extended thanks in the name of the Party Central Committee to the exemplary officials, workers, scientists and technologists in the field of agriculture. Reports and speeches were made there. Reporters and speakers said that the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee reviewed with pride the work of the first year for carrying out the decisions made at the Party Congress and set forth a grand goal and tasks for glorifying this year as a great watershed in the development of the revolution and a new programme on socialist rural construction. They called upon all sectors and units to make steady progress in production and construction by fully displaying the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance and fortitude this year of significance commemorating the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung and the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. They ardently appealed to all officials, Party members and working people to register substantial successes in socialist construction with redoubled revolutionary zeal and thus devotedly defend the Party Central Committee and fully demonstrate once again the might of Juche Korea in which all the people are single-mindedly united. A letter of pledge to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un was adopted at the rallies. At the end of the rallies, there were processions of the participants. They marched past squares and streets, responding to revolutionary and militant slogans. Rodong Sinmun

title: Letter to PRC Olympic Committee
body: The DPRK Olympic Committee and the DPRK Ministry of Physical Culture and Sports sent a letter to the Olympic Committee of the People's Republic of China (PRC), the Organizing Committee of the 2022 Beijing Winter Olympics and Winter Paralympic Games and the General Administration of Sports of the PRC. The letter noted that the preparations for the 24th Winter Olympics are being satisfactorily made thanks to the positive efforts and devoted struggle made by the Chinese party, government and people under the correct leadership of General Secretary Xi Jinping despite the worldwide health crisis. However, the U.S. and its vassal forces are getting evermore undisguised in their moves against China aimed at preventing the successful opening of the Olympics, it pointed out, saying: The DPRK Olympic Committee and the DPRK Ministry of Physical Culture and Sports resolutely reject those moves, branding them as an insult to the spirit of the international Olympic Charter and as a base act of attempting to disgrace the international image of China. Saying that we could not take part in the Olympics due to the hostile forces' moves and the worldwide pandemic, but we would fully support the Chinese comrades in all their work to hold splendid and wonderful Olympic festival, the letter expressed the belief that the fraternal Chinese people and sportspersons would successfully open the Beijing Winter Olympics by overcoming all sorts of obstructions and difficulties, rallied close around General Secretary Xi Jinping and the Communist Party of China. The DPRK Olympic Committee and the DPRK Ministry of Physical Culture and Sports will do their utmost to contribute to the development of the traditional friendship between the DPRK and China by further strengthening the friendly exchange, cooperation and visits with the Chinese sports organs and sportspersons, true to the wise leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, the letter stressed. The DPRK ambassador to the PRC met a leading official of the General Administration of Sports of the PRC and conveyed the letter on January 5. Rodong Sinmun

title: Nigerian Figures Visit DPRK Embassy
body: Nigerian figures visited the DPRK embassy in Abuja on December 31, 2021 on the occasion of the New Year, Juche 111 (2022). The national secretary of the People's Progressive Party of Nigeria, the chairman of the Nigerian National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism－Kimjongilism and others laid a floral basket before the art work depicting President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il standing together and made a bow before it. Prior to this, the Democratic Rally of Africa-Democratic Party of Guinea sent a floral basket to the DPRK embassy. Rodong Sinmun

title: Custom-built Equipment Production at Full Steam
body: Innovations are witnessed at the Ryongsong Machine Complex, one of the country’s leading producers of custom-built equipment. Officials, workers and technicians in charge of supplying materials for production of custom-built equipment make collective innovations, desirous of performing feats in this year’s all-people grand march. Not long ago, they produced large steel castings on a qualitative basis by cooperative steel casting and thereby contributed to stepping up the production of custom-built equipment. What’s more, those responsible for equipment processing engage themselves in a heated campaign for fulfilling the production assignments on schedule. Officials and workers engaged in sheet metal processing give full play to the collectivist traits with which one shift helps another and a work-team leads another. Workers in the supply field actively tap latent reserves and conduct a brisk technical innovation movement in order to make various jigs to be used in the production of custom-built equipment and spare parts for the normal operation of machine tools. Achievements are made one after another at the complex thanks to the strenuous efforts of its officials and workers who have applied themselves to a bold campaign true to the important tasks set forth at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea. Rodong Sinmun

title: Cement Sent to Major Sectors of Socialist Construction
body: Workers of the Sangwon Cement Complex have turned out to carry out the tasks set forth at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea. They have overfulfilled their production tasks since the outset of the new year. Thus, trains loaded with cement leave for major sectors of the socialist construction one after another. Officials of the complex offensively conduct field political work on the production sites to further enhance the enthusiasm of masses who have single-heartedly turned out for the struggle in response to the militant appeal of the Party. Besides, they take thorough measures to operate the equipment on a normal basis, giving definite precedence to providing raw materials and fuel. Technicians and workers of the complex are waging bold production drive through collective innovations, firmly resolved to achieve honorable successes this year too, as they did in the past. Controllers of central control room operate the equipment to meet the demand of technological regulations and standard operation methods. They introduce rational operation methods on the basis of scientific analysis of the state of the equipment, thus contributing to the increased production. Those in charge of raw materials and fuel accelerate their production by enhancing the operation ratio of their equipment. Workers of the forwarding shop devotedly work hard to reduce the wagon’s stoppage time and therefore the produced cement is immediately transported to the major sectors of the socialist construction. Rodong Sinmun

title: Goshawk
body: The goshawk is the national bird of our country. It is well-known and familiar to Koreans for long because it has unflagging and brave characteristics like them. Though it is small in size, it has a sharp beak, burly claws, amazing speed, cleverness and good vision. The goshawk, a national symbol of the DPRK, adds love for country to our people. Rodong Sinmun

title: More Rallies Held in DPRK
body: Rallies were held in South Phyongan, North Hwanghae, Jagang, Kangwon and North Hamgyong provinces and Nampho City of the DPRK on Friday to pledge to thoroughly implement the decisions made at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Present at the rallies were officials of Party and power organs, working people's organizations, industrial establishments, farms and universities and working people and students in those provinces and the city. Reports and speeches were made at the rallies. The reporters and speakers said in excitement that the Party Central Committee's high appreciation and encouragement at a time of starting a new year's advance full of confidence and optimism in victory are the highest honor of all the officials, Party members and working people. The path being taken by the Korean people under the guidance of the great Party Central Committee is the triumphant and glorious one hastening the rosy future, and the great honor and value of life lie in thoroughly carrying into practice the Party's plan and intention in the van, they said, adding it is the philosophy they learnt more deeply in the last year's struggle. They ardently called upon all the Party members, working people and officials to go all out for making a fresh turning point in the struggle for achieving the overall development of socialism in 2022, cherishing intense loyalty to the Party and fervent patriotism. Letters of pledge to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un were adopted at the rallies. At the end of the rallies, there were processions of the participants. Rodong Sinmun

title: His Devoted Service for the People Touches Our Heartstrings
body: At Office Building of Party Central Committee It was one March day last year. Although the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un was very busy with guidance on the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, he unfolded a far-reaching plan for taking a decisive measure to solve the traffic problem of Pyongyangites and discussed in detail the problems arising in developing the traffic network of capital city. That day he saw the trial products of new passenger buses at the building of the Party Central Committee. After learning about the technical specifications one by one on a bus, he earnestly said the Party would positively support the mass-production of buses which are suitable for the city beautification and convenient for the citizens. As the respected General Secretary is the leader of the people, he had a photo session at the office building of the Party Central Committee with chief secretaries of the provincial, city and county committees of the WPK who participated in the First Short Course for Chief Secretaries of City and County Party Committees, in token of his trust and expectation that all the participants would become honest Party officials and genuine revolutionaries respecting the people with loyalty and sharing bitters and sweets with them. Saying that it was a great strength and encouragement for our Party and state that, in the country, there were many patriots who make painstaking efforts to reduce, even a bit, the heavy burden of the country while thinking about the state affairs before their family affairs and doing any jobs, easy or difficult, without hesitation, he had a photo session in the courtyard of the Party Central Committee with labour innovators and merited persons who participated in celebrations of the 73rd anniversary of the DPRK. The courtyard of the Party Central Committee is ,indeed, the courtyard overflowing with the warmest love of the respected General Secretary for the people. Making Our Party into "Servant" Party for People "Servant" Party for the People! This call shows the noble personality of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un who beautifully cultivates the garden of the people-first principle. Once, he told officials that now our people are invariably following our Party calling it the motherly Party in times of both happiness and difficulty. He added that in order to repay the great trust of the people who unreservedly address it as "mother", our Party must become the genuine "servant" Party for them. It is his idea of Party building and steadfast will to make our Party into the genuine "servant" Party for the people which devotes all to the people. Thus, addressing at the Sixth Conference of Cell Secretaries of the Workers' Party of Korea that now our Party must, at all costs, prove itself worthy of the great trust of the people who unreservedly call it "mother", he stressed that, to this end, the Party must be the genuine "servant" Party for them, and he lost no opportunity to give an important instruction to officials that our Party should serve the people faithfully. With this call, the genuine "servant" Party for the people, all the people are convinced of brilliant future of socialist paradise where their dream and ideal are to be translated into reality. Rodong Sinmun

title: Teacher and Disciples
body: Prof. and Dr. Jo Hui Ju is a Merited Scientist and a teacher in the Second Medicine Faculty of Haeju University of Medicine. He has attained many successes in his research work conducive to development of national medical science and written tens of thousands of pages of studying materials during 60-odd years. Uncountable are his disciples including many holders of academic degrees and titles in the university and public health institutions across the country. The veteran professor is full of enthusiasm for achieving greater successes in science and education in the New Year saying whenever he meets his loving disciples he hardens his resolution to devote his all to our country, people, society and collective. Indeed, harmonious human relationship and noble morals in our society imbue every individual with such a great strength. Rodong Sinmun

title: "Girl Mother"
body: A girl who has a hairdo with a single pigtail is running full of happiness, taking hold of her "son’s" hand. She is Jang Jong Hwa, the "girl mother" of Kangson well-known throughout the country. She became the "girl mother" at the age of 20 by raising seven orphans with motherly affection. Her noble spirit and virtue moved people very much. In 2015 Jang Jong Hwa was awarded Kim Jong Il Youth Honor Prize. Rodong Sinmun

title: Intensive Transportation of Scrap Iron
body: Ministries and national institutions transported iron scraps to the Chollima Steel Complex on Jan. 5. Over 40 units took part in the transportation. Officials of ministries and national institutions made arrangements for the intensive transportation of scrap iron to the complex with an eagerness to actively help the metal industry sector. Officials of the Ministries of Culture and IT Industry buckled down to collecting scrap iron in a bold manner, regarding production of iron and steel as important in carrying out the overall five-year plan and the metal industry as decisive of the destiny of self-supporting economy. Suit was followed by those of the Capital City Construction Commission, Ministry of Physical Culture and Sports and External Construction Bureau. The Ministries of External Economic Relations, Chemical Industry and Electric Power Industry ensured successes in the first intensive transportation of scrap iron by allotting necessary vehicles to the transportation beforehand. Consequently, hundreds of tons of scrap iron secured by officials and other employees of the ministries and national institutions were transported to the Chollima Steel Complex. Such an active support inspired the workers of the complex with a zeal to bring about a rapid progress in iron and steel production. Rodong Sinmun

title: How They Become One Family
body: There lives Jon Nam Chol, a disabled soldier, in neighborhood unit 104, Sinpho-dong, Sinpho City. He and his wife lived alone long. However, Ri Hye Jong, a beautiful and tender-hearted girl, became their "daughter" three years ago. She is a teacher of Sinpho City Kindergarten. She is 25 years old this year. She got acquainted with them for the first time one day in May, five years ago. At that time the disabled soldier roused masses through an agitation for increased production. And his wife helped him to keep the flower of revolution in bloom even though she was ill. His noble spirit and his wife’s laudable deed touched Ri’s heart. Since then Ri had visited their home almost every day. At early dawn she visited their home to help with their kitchen work before she went to work and after leaving her work she took tender care of them. Then she prepared souvenirs and birthday spreads on their birthdays and also her parents gave her positive helps. As the days went by she got familiar to the disabled soldier’s family. One day Ri made a decision to become their "daughter". Thus Ri and the disabled soldier and his wife have become one family. People are loud in praise of her good deed. Rodong Sinmun

title: State Academy of Sciences Full of Ardent Loyalty and Patriotic Enthusiasm
body: All the scientists and officials of the State Academy of Sciences upgrade goals of this year with their revolutionary enthusiasm to implement the tasks set forth at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea. They reexamined all the goals and modify and supplement them to make scientific and technological successes which will substantially contribute to economic construction and improvement of people’s living standard by fully implementing the militant tasks for the sector of science and technology set forth by our Party. Yun Kum Chol, a section chief of the Microbiological Research Institute, said that they had developed the active enzymes for sugar production last year and that they made pledge of loyalty in front of statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on New Year’s Day before they have made enzymatic products for dozens of units. Not only they but also scientists and officials of the Bioengineering Branch and Central Mining Research Institute of the State Academy of Sciences made higher goals to carry out the tasks for the second year of another five-year plan. The laboratories of the State Academy of Sciences and places for applying research findings in different parts of the country are seething with their zeal for inquiry. Their painstaking research and efforts will bring big scientific and technological successes in the struggle of this year. Rodong Sinmun

title: Story about Five Years at Workers’ Palace
body: It has been five years since ordinary girls of the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Silk Mill occupied workers’ hostel of the mill, a palace of workers. Kim Jong Hyang and Pak Il Ju are the first dwellers of Room No. 306 which was visited by the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un. We could not meet them as they had already left the room. They, with a single desire to repay the generous love of the respected General Secretary, had fulfilled their yearly quotas of the natinal economic plan ahead of schedule every year. In this course, they had the honor of becoming members of the Workers’ Party of Korea. Now they are mistresses of houses as well as mothers of dear children. New dwellers of the room continue to add luster to the honor of the room by registering honorable successes in their work modeling after their predecessors. They continue making innovations keeping in minds the honor of dwellers of the room visited by the respected General Secretary. Not only those but also all residents of the hostel constantly perform labor feats in their work with loyalty to the Party and patriotism. A house overflowing with the affection of great fatherly leader and a dear home with lots of innovators―it was the increased pride of the workers’ hostel in the last five years. That’s not all. During the last five years, several hostellers became university graduates. At present scores of hostellers are enrolled in the study-while-you-work system and bringing their hopes into bloom. The hostel, a dear home of the girl-workers which engraves in their hearts with the love of the motherly Party, pride of labor and genuine beauty of maidenhood will convey more prides in the future. Rodong Sinmun

title: Musan Mining Complex Makes Headway
body: The officials and workers of the Musan Mining Complex in the DPRK have registered innovations in production from the beginning of this year. The complex has fulfilled the daily production plan without fail. It is producing much more iron ore than planned by intensively deploying most of large excavators and rotary drilling rigs at the mining benches to raise their operation rate. The complex secured enough reserve tools and accessories and guided the iron ore transportation in a rational way. It also ensured the operation of crushers and belt conveyors in a sci-tech way to rapidly remove overburden, while raising the operation rate of ore-dressing machines to increase the production of concentrated iron ore. Rodong Sinmun

title: Decisions of Plenary Meeting of C.C., WPK Supported Abroad
body: A Russian organization and a Danish personage made public press statements in support of the decisions made at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). The Russian Association for Friendship and Cultural Cooperation with the DPRK said in its press statement on January 4: The plenary meeting, which set forth the strategic policies for accelerating the comprehensive development of socialist construction, is an event of great significance in the history of the WPK. It is the unanimous desire and revolutionary will of all the Korean people to provide a firm foundation for implementing the 5-year plan and bring about a remarkable change in the development of the country and the improvement of the people's living in 2022 marking the 110th birth anniversary of Comrade Kim Il Sung, the eternal President of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, and the 80th birth anniversary of Comrade Kim Jong Il. Despite the brutal moves of the hostile forces to stifle the country and the protracted global health crisis, the Korean people have honorably defended the sovereignty of the country and confidently advanced toward the implementation of the 5-year plan in the face of manifold obstacles and difficulties under the wise leadership of Comrade Kim Jong Un. We are sure that the Korean people will achieve greater successes in all fields in the new year, too, true to the idea and spirit of the plenary meeting. Recalling in detail the conclusion and the report made by the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un at the plenary meeting, the chairperson of the Denmark-DPRK Friendship Association said in a press statement on January 1: The plenary meeting is of weighty significance as it clarified the orientation and ways for further accelerating socialist construction in the DPRK in the new year. Guided by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, the Korean people will successfully implement the decisions of the plenary meeting without fail. We will express our invariable solidarity with the Korean people over their just cause, fully supporting the decisions of the plenary meeting. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Lauded by Political Figure of DR Congo
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un is not only the outstanding leader, who set a goal for the fresh victory of socialism with his rare ideological and theoretical wisdom and provided a firm foundation for prosperity of the country through his energetic guidance, but also the symbol of the mightiness of the DPRK. The general secretary of the Communist Party of the DR Congo said this in a press statement issued on January 3 in connection with the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. The press statement recalled that the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un set forth the guiding policy of struggle for successfully leading the Korean-style socialist construction to the next stage of victory in his important conclusion "On the Orientation of the Work of the Party and State in 2022" at the plenary meeting. Kim Jong Un said that the struggle in 2022 is a great life-and-death struggle to be vigorously waged without further delay and concluded successfully for sure for the overall development of socialist construction, the great Korean people and the beloved posterity, it pointed out, adding: Kim Jong Un also clarified the goal and the immediate main tasks for socialist rural construction and declared a preferential measure for the rural development in his historic report "Let Us Open Up a New Great Era of Our Style Socialist Rural Development". The Workers' Party of Korea and the Korean people will surely win a proud victory in their historic struggle for the overall development of socialist construction, thanks to the outstanding leadership ability of Kim Jong Un, the brave people who have the firm faith to overcome all sorts of trials, single-mindedly united around him, and valuable experience of having made great achievements by dint of self-reliance in a severe environment. Rodong Sinmun

title: Russians Support Decisions of Plenary Meeting of C.C., WPK
body: Russian adherents to the Juche idea fully support the decisions made at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and sincerely hope that the Korean people will successfully carry out this year's tasks for fulfilling the five-year plan. The director of the Russian Institute of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, the chairman of the Rostov Association for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism of Russia, the chief of the Moscow Association for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism and the chairman of the Russian Association for the Study of the Juche Idea stressed this in a joint press statement issued on January 5. Noting that for the DPRK, 2021 was a year of great victory that opened up a prelude to the great change toward the overall development of socialist construction despite severe trials, the press statement said: At the plenary meeting, the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un set forth the tasks to be fulfilled by the Korean people this year. His important conclusion and historic report are the immortal guidelines for the Korean people to overcome all trials and challenges in the current situation and dynamically advance socialist construction. The plenary meeting, which attracted the world attention, marked a historic occasion in demonstrating the brave mettle of the DPRK advancing towards the eminence of a powerful socialist nation by dint of single-minded unity. Rodong Sinmun

title: "Complete Collection of Kim Il Sung's Works" Published
body: The Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House brought out Vol. 17 (enlarged edition) of "Complete Collection of Kim Il Sung's Works", a library of the immortal Juche idea dealing with President Kim Il Sung's works systematically and comprehensively in chronological order. Contained in the book are 121 works such as historic speeches, talks and orders made by the President in the period between June and September Juche 39 (1950). Kim Il Sung made public works permeated with his outstanding military and strategic idea and great courage and warm love for the country and the nation to provide all the people and servicepersons out in winning the Fatherland Liberation War with confidence in victory and correct fighting guidelines. There are other works giving clear-cut solutions to the theoretical and practical issues arising in the struggle for victory in the Fatherland Liberation War, including the issue of saving national cultural heritage, the issue of improving the wartime communications service and the issue of taking measures for fully ensuring the transport of war supplies. Rodong Sinmun

title: Everyone Is Touched by Favored Measure
body: On the meaningful platform of the 4th Plenary Meeting of 8th Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un declared a favored measure to completely release cooperative farms from the arrears of state loans as part of important measures to let the rural communities stand on their own and consolidate their economic foundations. The respected General Secretary set forth as the top priority task of our state to boost agriculture sector which must be carried out at any cost to successfully accelerate socialist construction and he devoted himself to its development. Although he was very busy with state affairs he indicated the Farm No. 1116 as the experimental farm of Party Central Committee and guided its work step by step to raise more good-breeding species at world level. And he saw to it that material and technical foundations of rural economy were consolidated and the crops raised by strenuous efforts protected and stable harvest secured while the whole world was in deep turmoil caused by drought and typhoon. The officials and working people of agricultural sector owe all the successes achieved last year to the energetic leadership of the respected General Secretary. However, the respected General Secretary courteously proposed to the plenary meeting sending thanks in the name of the Party Central Committee to the exemplary agricultural officials, workers, scientists and technologists who greatly contributed to doing farming well despite the unfavorable conditions last year and took the favored measure. The history will witness great miracles in our rural areas under the love and trust of our motherly Party. Rodong Sinmun

title: With All Farms and Agricultural Workers across Country on His Mind
body: The immortal programme heralding a new era of socialist rural development in our country makes the whole country seethe with strong emotion. At the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea, the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un clarified the goal of socialist rural construction and the major task at present, calling for putting the country’s agriculture on a definite upward stage and opening up a new great era of effecting drastic development of our style socialist countryside by pushing forward the rural development under the uplifted slogan of "For New Victory of Socialist Rural Construction!" Setting the settlement of rural question as an important revolutionary task in achieving prosperity and development of the country and welfare of the people, he has worked heart and soul to provide the agricultural workers with the best life in the world and to bring a brilliant reality of tremendous changes to our rural community. It is the burning sincerity and steadfast will kept in mind of the respected General Secretary to turn our rural community into the socialist paradise to be proud in the world so that our farmers lead an affluent and civilized life as happy as any others by translating the high intention of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, who were anxious about socialist rural construction in their lifetime, into realities on this land. The new programme of socialist rural construction is a just congelation of warm love and endless thinking of the respected General Secretary who devotes himself to the socialist rural construction. And this great fighting programme heralding a new era of socialist rural development is the immortal banner and milestone of victory which inspire all the people with tremendous confidence and courage. Thanks to wise leadership of the respected General Secretary who clearly shows the road ahead of socialist countryside to follow in the new era of Juche revolution and vigorously arouses all the people to the struggle for hastening the rosier future, the epoch-making progress and change will be brought about and the centuries-old desire of our people will be surely realized with the overall development of socialism. Rodong Sinmun

title: Powerful Support to Coal Mines
body: Officials and working people in South Hamgyong Province strongly support the coal-mining industry, an outpost for development of the self-supporting economy in response to the important tasks set forth at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea. They supplied many aid materials to miners of the Hamnam Area Coal Mining Complex on January 4. They give active support to the coal mines, mindful that only when coal is mass-produced can they solve the problem of electricity and satisfy the demand for fuel and raw materials for different sectors of the national economy including the metallurgical and chemical industries. In a short time, thousands of aid materials of 40-odd kinds were prepared in the province. Those officials who went to coal mines worked with miners and encouraged them through an agitation for increased production. The officials also learnt in detail about the coal production and mapped out plans for giving more itemized and normalized support to coal mines. Encouraged by powerful support, officials and miners of the Hamnam Area Coal Mining Complex are now endeavoring to increase production bearing deep in minds their responsibility. Rodong Sinmun

title: Bouquets of Congratulation to Trustworthy Engine Drivers
body: Beautiful garlands and bouquets are being presented to the engineers of the Pyongyang Service Brigade of Engine who are to start another transportation. The trustworthy transport workers are full of a determination to increase transport upholding the decision of the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea. Greater feats and miracles will be created everywhere they reach with the fully loaded trains. Both the innovators being presented with the bouquets and the employees who are congratulating them are full of confidence and optimism to become honorable victors in the grandiose struggle of this year. Rodong Sinmun

title: Provincial Rallies Held in DPRK
body: There took place rallies in South Hwanghae Province, South Hamgyong Province, Rason City and Kaesong City on January 9 and 10. Participants in the events pledged to thoroughly implement the decisions made at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Present at the rallies were officials of party and power organs, working people's organizations, industrial establishments, farms and universities and working people and students in those provinces and cities. At the rallies, it was recalled that according to the proposal made by Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee extended thanks in the name of the Party Central Committee to the exemplary officials, workers, scientists and technicians in the field of agriculture. The participants were reminded that the respected General Secretary, on behalf of the Party Central Committee, highly praised all the Party members, working people and service personnel for glorifying Juche 110 (2021) as a year of proud victory to be specially recorded in the DPRK's history of socialist construction, and sent warm greetings to them. Reports and speeches were made there. The reporters and speakers said that through the last year's struggle, they kept in mind once again the philosophical principle that the road of remaining faithful to the idea and leadership of Kim Jong Un is the one of victory and glory bringing earlier the rosy future, and to devotedly carry out the plan and determination of the Party Central Committee is the greatest glory and pride. Under the wise guidance of the General Secretary who taught the ways of overcoming difficulties and winning victory and provided us with redoubled strength and courage in the struggle, we could make miraculous achievements and win one victory after another, they added. They appealed to the participants to turn out as one in the struggle for glorifying this year of significance marking the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung and the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il as a year of great revolutionary events and fresh victory, true to the idea and spirit of the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee. Letters of pledge to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un were adopted at the rallies. At the end of the rallies, there were processions of the participants. Rodong Sinmun

title: Meeting of Youths Held in DPRK
body: A meeting of young people took place at the Youth Park Open-Air Theatre in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, on Monday. At the meeting, its participants pledged to thoroughly implement the decisions made at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). Present there were Ri Tu Song, department director of the WPK Central Committee, and officials of the youth league, officials concerned, youths and students in the city. Mun Chol, chairman of the C.C., Socialist Patriotic Youth League, made a report. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the WPK, highly praised the youth, for many of them volunteered to work in difficult and labor-consuming fields and became the paragons of admirable virtues and traits last year when the Party Congress was held, terming such high morale of the youth a remarkable success, the reporter recalled, adding it is an expression of the respected General Secretary's deepest trust in the youth. The reporter went on: There are many countries in the world and each country has the young people, but there are no such young people as the confident and happy youth of the DPRK who are advancing proudly toward a bright future of socialism full of confidence and optimism under the motherly care of the respected General Secretary. The reporter called upon the young people across the country to fully demonstrate the might of the socialist patriotic youth in the new year's grand march for accelerating the overall development of Korean-style socialism and bringing about the happiness of the people, single-mindedly united around the respected General Secretary. Oath-taking speeches were made there. Speakers expressed their will to add glory to the honor of being members of the youth vanguard in the efforts for crowning this year with the auspicious revolutionary events to be recorded in the history of the country by going all out for implementing the decisions made at the plenary meeting, as befits the young vanguard in the great era of Kim Jong Un. A letter of pledge to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un was adopted at the meeting. Then, there took place a procession of its participants. Rodong Sinmun

title: Distinguished Feat of WPK in History of Leading Juche-based Defence Industry
body: Success in Another Hypersonic Missile Test-fire Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Watches Test-fire in Field Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), watched the test-fire of hypersonic missile conducted by the Academy of Defence Science on Tuesday. He was accompanied by Jo Yong Won, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretary for Organizational Affairs of the WPK Central Committee, vice-directors of the departments concerned of the Party Central Committee and leading officials in the sector of the national defence science. The 8th WPK Congress set forth a strategic task of developing the hypersonic missile sector on a preferential basis for the sector of the national defence scientific research in order to bolster up the country's war deterrent, and the Party Central Committee has powerfully led the whole course of developing the hypersonic weapon system for implementing the task. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un was briefed on the hypersonic missile weapon system by the president of the Academy of Defence Science before the test-fire. The test-fire was aimed at the final verification of overall technical specifications of the developed hypersonic weapon system. Toward daybreak, the Juche weapon representing the power of the DPRK roared to soar into sky, brightening the dawning sky and leaving behind it a column of fire, under the supervision of Kim Jong Un. After its release from the missile, the hypersonic glide vehicle made glide jump flight from 600 km area before making a 240 km turning maneuvering from the initial launch azimuth to the target azimuth and hitting the set target in waters 1 000 km off. The superior maneuverability of the hypersonic glide vehicle was more strikingly verified through the final test-fire. Kim Jong Un highly appreciated the practical achievements made by the scientists, technicians and officials of the missile research sector and by the Party organizations concerned that brought a great success in the field of developing hypersonic weapon which is of the most important strategic significance in the five core tasks of the five-year plan for building up the national defence capability set forth at the 8th WPK Congress. He gave special thanks on behalf of the Party Central Committee to them. Stressing the need to further accelerate the efforts to steadily build up the country's strategic military muscle both in quality and quantity and further modernize the army, Kim Jong Un encouraged the national defence scientific research sector to continuously make admirable successes in the historic sacred cause for remarkably increasing the war deterrent of the country, true to the Party's strategic policy of national defence development and strategic guidelines. That day he called the core members in the sector of hypersonic weapon research and development to the office building of the Party Central Committee and warmly congratulated them. He had a photo session with them, expressing great expectation and conviction that they would help bolster the war deterrent of the country with their continued ultra-modern scientific research achievements for national defence and reliably guarantee the sovereignty and security of the state. Political News Team

title: Main Waterway Tunnel Project Progresses Apace
body: Signal successes have been made in the construction site of hydropower station in Ryanggang Province since the outset of the New Year. Its builders, who have turned out to implement the decisions of the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea, started the main waterway tunnel project with high spirit after ending the construction of a working pit. They are bringing about good results every day. Now the builders raise the operating rate of equipment and conduct successive drilling and blasting to shorten the date of completion of the waterway tunnel project. Officials of the field headquarters inspire the masses to perform feats with responsible operation and command for speeding up the waterway tunnel project on a full scale, the most important object in the power station construction. Meanwhile, the provincial officials and working people fully support its construction which is of great significance in the provincial economic development. Encouraged by their sincerity, its builders vigorously push ahead with the waterway tunnel project with their enthusiasm for glorifying this year a year of adorning an honorable page of the history of motherland. Rodong Sinmun

title: Big Efforts to Strengthen Designing and Construction Forces
body: Big efforts are being directed to strengthening the designing and construction forces in Nampho City. The city assigns able designers to the designing institutes and require them to further raise their level to push ahead with the work for laying firm material and technical foundation of the institutes, while waging the works for strengthening the ranks of skilled workers in the construction brigades and equipping with construction setups in full. While reinforcing the commanding forces with officials having a high sense of responsibility, the building units increase the ranks of skilled workers with young people including discharged soldiers. And the works are conducted in a substantial way to equip the units with such construction setups as mixer and vibrating compactor. The city launches the works to consolidate the material and technical foundation on a higher level through the exhibition of equipment and tools. A work is vigorously carried on to reinforce the construction forces in various regions including Chollima, Kangso and Hanggu districts. The city also promotes the work to reliably ensure the successful achievement of planned project by consolidating the material and technical foundation of buiding material production bases. Rodong Sinmun

title: His Ardent Love for Posterity That Stirred the Venue of Plenary Meeting
body: Declaring It as Eternal State Policy of the Republic The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un took important measures at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea. He said that the supply of school uniforms to the children across the country at the state’s expense is not a work which may be omitted at one’s discretion in line with conditions but a policy of the Party and an eternal state policy of the republic which must be carried out unconditionally and preferentially. In retrospect, the history of our republic is the one in which the state has regarded the work for posterity as its important policy and done everything possible for it. President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, saying that the children are the kings of the country, saw to it that every state affair of the republic was thoroughly oriented toward the good of the rising generations. The respected General Secretary set the work for the rising generation as an eternal core state policy of the republic with his iron will to carry forward the history of love for the rising generation which is continued with the history of the republic. Today in our country, children are bringing their beautiful dreams and hopes into full bloom despite severe ordeals which would have brought others to their knees. This proud reality is unthinkable without the wise leadership of the respected General Secretary who regards it as the eternal state policy of the republic to carry out the work for children unconditionally and preferentially. Duty and Fundamental Obligation of Revolutionaries The respected General Secretary said that to direct Party and nationwide efforts to the work for children is the fundamental duty and obligation of revolutionaries. Benevolent care of the respected General Secretary reaches every baby home and orphanage, primary and middle school for orphans across the country as well as factories for the sake of children’s happiness, nurseries, kindergartens and schools. Although he was so busy with national affairs, he gave field guidance to lots of units, giving precious instructions to pluck even a star out of heavens for the rising generation. Indeed, thanks to the great revolutionary, the great fatherly leader, happiness of children is firmly guarded and the future of the nation is definitely ensured. The 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th WPK Central Committee will be recorded in the history of Juche revolution as a historic meeting which engraved deep in minds of officials and people with the genuine meaning of the revolution and the true sense of duty of revolutionaries. Along with Hearts of Great Leaders At the plenary meeting the respected General Secretary, frankly stating his rock-ribbed will to supply smart and fine school uniforms to the students across the country, emphasized that the light industrial sector should exert itself to the production of school uniforms along with the hearts of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il who, for the first time in the world history, set it as a policy of the Party and state to provide school uniforms to the children at the state’s expense. Endless is the heart and soul the respected General Secretary put to provide the rising generation with homemade school uniforms, schoolbags and school things. He has spent his valuable time examining designs for new school uniforms and frequently gave officials instructions on it. Once the new school uniform designs even crowded the conference hall of the Party Central Committee where the Party and state’s important affairs are discussed. Thanks to his inexhaustible love, all the preschool children across the country have been presented with "Haebaragi (Sunflower)"-trademarked school supplies. He continues his unprecedented devotion day after day to bring about and defend the happiness of the rising generations. Under his benevolent love, the history of love for the rising generation created by the President and the Chairman continues and rosy is the future of our country where the children are put forward as king. Rodong Sinmun

title: Large-size Wall Clock at Munsu Water Park Tells a Touching Story
body: One September day in Juche 102(2013), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un gave a visit to Munsu Water Park under construction. Loaded in his car were large-size wall clocks. He brought them with a good reason. During his previous visit to the water park a few days before, he had taught that wall clocks had to be installed there lest the people should get too absorbed in having fun to be aware of the passage of time. Though he had his hands full with all the state affairs, he brought wall clocks with him in person. Anxious to make his people the happiest in the world as soon as possible, he came to the water park when the people across the country were all in bed although he could have visited it in the daytime. History has never witnessed such a leader of a country as him who visited the construction site of the people’s cultural recreation ground with wall clocks loaded in his car.
