The large-size wall clocks convince us of the fact that we will enjoy all the blessings under the benevolent care of the greatest father in the world and that a rosier future is in store for us striving for the comprehensive development of socialist construction according to the grandiose plan of our Party. Rodong Sinmun

title: Metallurgical Industry Positively Supported in DPRK
body: Officials and working people in North Phyongan, Kangwon and South Hamgyong provinces of the DPRK distinguish themselves in supporting the metallurgical industry. Officials of provincial institutions and working people in different counties and factories in North Phyongan Province provided a metal factory with a large amount of scrap iron they collected by tapping internal reserves. Officials and working people in Kangwon Province sent hundreds of tons of scrap iron to metal factories in the province. Those in South Hamgyong Province intensively transported lots of collected scrap iron to metal factories, thus encouraging the workers of the metallurgical industrial sector out in the struggle to attain the iron and steel production goal. Rodong Sinmun

title: Meeting of Workers and Trade Union Members Held in DPRK
body: A meeting of workers and members of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea (GFTUK) took place at the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex on Tuesday to vow to carry through the decisions made at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee. Present there were trade union officials in Pyongyang and provinces, officials concerned and officials, workers and trade union members of the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex. Pak In Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the GFTUK, said in his report that the important conclusion and historic report made by General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea Kim Jong Un at the plenary meeting serve as a militant banner giving inexhaustible strength and courage to all the workers and trade union members out in the struggle for building a socialist paradise on this land. The reporter said that facing the workers and trade union members are heavy yet honorable tasks for providing a firm guarantee for fulfilling the five-year plan and bringing about a marked change in the development of the country and the improvement of the people's living standard by further accelerating the all-people grand drive for the overall development of socialist construction. He called upon the workers and trade union members to fully demonstrate the mettle of the vanguard unit taking the lead in ushering in a fresh period of development in socialist construction by waging a fierce campaign for creation and innovation. Saying that a sure victory is in store for their struggle as they are led by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, he appealed to all the officials, workers and trade union members to wage a dynamic struggle for crowning this year with a new victory, following the path indicated by the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee. Oath-taking speeches were made at the meeting. The speakers expressed their determination to make ceaseless innovations and progress in this year's grand struggle, demonstrating the indomitable mettle of the heroic working class like the preceding generations who devotedly defended the Party under the uplifted banner of self-reliance. A letter of pledge to Kim Jong Un was adopted at the meeting. Rodong Sinmun

title: Joint Innovations Made in Different Sectors of National Economy
body: Upholding the tasks set forth at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea officials and working people in several national economic sectors are in high spirits from the first campaign of New Year. Those in the electric power industry sector are waging a vigorous struggle to increase the production while sufficiently meeting the immediate demand for the electric power. At the Pukchang Thermal-power Complex, a high-capacity power generation base, they are enhancing the responsibility of engineers in charge and operators as well as increasing the operation rate of equipment. At other thermal-power stations including Pyongyang, Sunchon, Chongchongang Thermal-power Stations they meticulously organize the production work to cope with the winter season and discharge their tasks on schedule while observing the technical regulations and standard operating instructions. At hydroelectric power stations in various areas they secure sufficient water, acquaint themselves with the hydraulic structures and thoroughly set up a system of checking and repairing equipment, and guarantee the full operation of the generating equipment. Particularly, they are directing big efforts to technical management of generating equipment including water turbine and to putting the water conservation on a scientific basis. Officials and coal miners in coal mining industry sector are putting more spurs to coal mining. At the Sunchon and Pukchang Area Youth Coal Mining Complexes and Tokchon and Kaechon Area Coal Mining Complexes they speed up the tunneling by introducing an advanced blasting method and repair the coal wagons and keep them in good condition by ensuring the orderly functioning of their repair and maintenance shops so as to increase the production. At the Chonnae, Anju, Kujang and Hamnam Area Coal Mining Complexes the working people are unfolding a production campaign vigorously with a single desire to send more coal to various sectors of the national economy. Officials and working class in the timber industry sector are pushing ahead with timber production to be sent to various sectors of the national economy as scheduled. Forestry stations and mine pillar production stations of every provincial forestry management bureau are bringing about good results day after day giving priority to felling. At building material production units they are channeling primary efforts to securing sufficient raw materials needed for production while normalizing the operation of equipment by dint of science and technology. They are also kindling fierce flames of introducing innovations while taking technical and practical measures scrupulously to enhance productivity. Officials and working people in the machine-building industry sector and railway transport field are all out for a comprehensive development of the national economy and giving full play to strenuous spirit. Rodong Sinmun

title: Project for Expanding Cement Storage Capacity Actively Promoted
body: In North Hamgyong Province they are putting more spurs to the preparation work for rural construction. The historic 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea emphasized the need to dynamically wage the struggle for drastically changing the living environment of rural inhabitants. Cherishing deep in their minds the importance of perfect preparation in achieving the goal of socialist rural construction, the officials there are directing primary attention to it under the guidance of the North Hamgyong Provincial Party Committee. Accordingly, the work for building or expanding storehouses of cement is brisk in cities and counties. In Hoeryong City they are accelerating the construction of cement storehouses of large capacity at the final stage by tapping and enlisting all their internal reserves. In Yonsa County they are pushing ahead with the construction while taking drastic measures to prevent buildings from being frozen and keep them warm in winter and guaranteeing its quality. Other areas such as Kilju and Kyongwon counties are also pushing forward the construction while channeling efforts to strengthening the construction forces. In the province they awaken the officials on several occasions, strengthen their construction forces, secure ample construction equipment, supply finishing building materials on their own, etc. Like this, they are making the preparation work for rural construction in three dimensions. Rodong Sinmun

title: Steelworkers Carry Out Steel and Iron Assignments Day after Day
body: The Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex is seething with its employees’ enthusiasm for implementing decisions of the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea. From the outset of the New Year officials, working people and technicians of the oxygen heat blast furnace shop and the oxygen separator branch factory bring about an upsurge in their production. They keep equipment in full-capacity operation even in unfavorable seasonal condition by displaying the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance and hard work. Officials, workers and technicians of the steel shop No.2 conduct the dynamic drive for increased production. Working people of the steel ingot management shop briskly wage the mass technological innovation drive to raise the actual extraction rate of rolled steel production. Steelworkers at the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex also make innovations in their production. Officials, technicians and workers of the furnace shop search and introduce a rational method of operating furnace to shorten the melting time and improve the quality of molten iron. Officials and working people of the units which have charge of rolled steel production manage equipment and improve technical control in a responsible manner and they solve technical problems arising from the bar steel production by themselves. Officials and workers of the Chollima Steel Complex make strenuous efforts to increase steel production. They overfulfill their daily steel production assignments from the outset of the New Year. Rodong Sinmun

title: Meeting of Agricultural Workers Held in DPRK
body: A meeting of agricultural workers and members of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea (UAWK) took place in Oguk-ri of Anak County, South Hwanghae Province on Wednesday to vow to carry through the decisions made at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). Present at the meeting were Ri Tu Song, department director of the WPK Central Committee, Pak Thae Sop, secretary of the South Hwanghae Provincial Committee of the WPK, officials of the UAWK and other officials concerned, agricultural workers and members of the UAWK. Han Jong Hyok, chairman of the UAWK Central Committee, made a report there. The reporter, in reflection of the boundless reverence and intense loyalty of all the agricultural workers and union members across the country, extended the highest glory and deepest thanks to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un who is ushering in a new era of great prosperity on this land with his far-sighted wisdom and outstanding guidance. He said that the agricultural workers and union members are faced with heavy yet honorable tasks for adding a new page of glory to the annals of the country by waging a fierce campaign for rural revolution, true to the great programme that unrolled a bright blueprint for settling the socialist rural question in the new century. He called upon all the agricultural workers and union members to devotedly carry out the Party's programme on socialist rural construction, cherishing the firm faith that they do not know anyone but the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, and the single-minded loyalty to him. He ardently appealed to all the agricultural workers and union members to attain the agricultural production goal set by the Party without fail by conducting a dynamic struggle for the implementation of the programme on socialist rural construction drawn up at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee and thus glorify this year of significance marking the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung and the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il as a year of great revolutionary events. Then, oath-taking speeches were made at the meeting. The speakers expressed their will to crown this year with an unprecedented increase in grain production while pushing forward with the rural development, true to the Party's call for ushering in a great fresh era of Korean-style socialist rural development. A letter of pledge to Kim Jong Un was adopted at the meeting. Rodong Sinmun

title: Greatest Exploit of Workers’ Party of Korea
body: Great are the achievements the Workers’ Party of Korea has made for the past 70-odd years during which it has led the country and people only to victory and glory with its invincible leadership ability. In his important speech made at the lecture to commemorate the 76th founding anniversary of the WPK held last October, the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un said the greatest exploit our Party performed in the whole course of its revolutionary leadership is that it has brought up the people of a distress-torn nation, small and weak, to be a great and excellent people single-heartedly rallied around the Party and the leader with strong self-esteem and creativity. It was not an accidental gift from Heaven but a dramatic event brought about by the great WPK. Holding great leaders in high esteem generation after generation, we realized our strength and grasped the might of unity. We gave full play to our national mettle regarding national self-respect as our life and, better still, were able to turn our country into a socialist paradise by dint of inexhaustible creativity. During the last ten years, for instance, we have dashed along the road of advance in the new era of the Juche revolution following the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un, another great man history has rarely witnessed. In the meantime, we have acquired better features of citizens of a powerful country in terms of ideological and spiritual traits, united strength and creative ability. It is our unshakable determination to remain loyal to the respected General Secretary, to whom we have entrusted our destiny and future, and follow the great WPK forever. Rodong Sinmun

title: Priceless Calls He Kept in Mind
body: Excellent People One August day a few years ago, the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited again the then Samjiyon County under construction. That day, looking at the stirring construction site, he said that the people across the country were devoting pure consciences and sweats of obligation to sprucing up the county housing the native home of Chairman Kim Jong Il as their own house true to the call of the Workers’ Party of Korea. Adding that no matter how the water of Lake Chon on Mt Paektu is fresh and clear, it cannot be compared with their sweats of flawless loyalty, that we are hastening the great period with very good people and that he fearlessly will go anywhere in the world together with them, he asked to surely convey his warm comradely greetings to all the builders who fulfil their obligation and duty as eternal soldiers and loyal sons and daughters to the Chairman. The very good people, excellent people! Reflected in his words are his warm trust in and noble appreciation for our people who sincerely uphold and follow their leader, showing no affectation and vacillation, and remain loyal to the cause of Party firmly keeping their burning single-mindedness in mind. And it shows noble outlook on people and profound revolutionary trait of the respected General Secretary who regards it as his greatest pride to make a revolution with our people possessed of firm faith and burning loyalty, lofty moral consciousness and pure conscience. Heroic People Our people have performed world-startling miracles, which others would not dare do, one after another by getting rise to their feet in the worst conditions. It is the rock-firm faith of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un that there is neither difficulty insurmountable nor fortress unconquerable as long as there are heroic people who turn out as one in response to the call of the Workers’ Party of Korea and perform miracles and feats with the fighting spirit of do-or-die fulfilment. Therefore, the respected General Secretary said at the First Session of the 14th Supreme People’s Assembly of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea that the foundations of our self-supporting economy that have been laid for several decades, able scientific and technical personnel, and the creative strength of the heroic people who have made self-reliance part of their mental qualities and are brimming with patriotic enthusiasm―these constitute our valuable strategic resources and that by making the most of these enormous and unlimited potentialities, we must create another legendary tale of world-startling, miraculous successes and go ahead of others by making a greater leap forward. Heroic people! Thanks to this call firmly kept in his mind and the said his profound trust, our people will constantly write a history of miracle and feat. Great People Great people, this is the most sacred call kept in mind of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un. This call has been always warmly kept in his mind when reviewing the glorious and victorious history of the Workers’ Party of Korea, overcoming the rigorous difficulties and unfolding the rosy blueprint for the country’s prosperity, and it has served as strength, courage, pride and confidence for him every time. As there are our great people! For our great people! These calls reflect the respected General Secretary’s greatest appreciation and trust in our people and his steadfast faith and will to uphold the people forever as sky by devoting all to them. At the historic 8th Congress of the WPK, the first workshop for the chief secretaries of the city and county Party committees, the Sixth Conference of Cell Secretaries of the WPK and a historic policy speech of the First Session of the 14th Supreme People’s Assembly of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, he called for waging a vigorous struggle for the people while expressing his firm will with this call, our great people. Indeed, the respected General Secretary is an extraordinary man who puts the people on the top place of the world and shines their dignity and life on the highest level. With this call, the great people, our country will further dynamically advance toward the dream and ideal of the people and the faith and will of the people’s loyalty to dash forward along the road of socialism, road of revolution, following the Party will be redoubled. Rodong Sinmun

title: Press Statement of Int'l Festival Organizing Committee
body: The Organizing Committee of the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu issued its press statement at a consultative meeting held through video-conferencing on January 7. According to the press statement, the meeting decided on action programs for significantly celebrating the greatest national holidays of the Korean people. It said that the Organizing Committee of the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu would set an international celebration period for the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung and the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il, auspicious holidays common to mankind, and rev up the atmosphere for celebrating them worldwide. The press statement noted that the organizing committee would set an international celebration period from February greeting the Day of the Shining Star, the birthday of Kim Jong Il, to April greeting the Day of the Sun, the birthday of Kim Il Sung, and organize colorful events and actively promote and coordinate the activities to celebrate the birth anniversaries worldwide. It will organize colorful and peculiar international functions through internet, it said. During the celebration period, the committee will splendidly organize an internet seminar "Kim Jong Il, image of Juche Korea" and an internet photo exhibition "Mt Paektu" in February and an internet celebration stage "Kim Il Sung, the eternal sun of mankind" in April and conduct publicity activities to attract more personages to an international literature prize contest to be held on the birth anniversaries, it added. It expressed the will to glorify this meaningful year by conducting ceaseless activities for supporting the just cause of the Korean people worldwide. Rodong Sinmun

title: Consultative Meeting of Int'l Festival Organizing Committee
body: A consultative meeting of the Organizing Committee of the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu was held through video conferencing on Jan. 7. Present there were Jesus Antonio Carlos Hernandez, general secretary of the C.C., People's Socialist Party of Mexico, Damian Ogbonna, national chairman of the People's Progressive Party of Nigeria, Peter Woods, co-chairman of the Asia-Pacific Regional Committee for Supporting Peaceful Reunification of Korea, Victor Petrov, chairman of the Russian Association for Friendship and Cultural Cooperation with the DPRK, and Yehia Zakaria Khairullah, vice-chairman of the Socialist Freedom Party of Egypt, who are co-chairmen of the organizing committee, and C. P. Mainali, general secretary of the C.C., Nepal Communist Party (Marxist-Leninist) who is vice-chairman of the organizing committee, and members of the organizing committee and delegates from national and regional organizations for friendship and solidarity with the Korean people. The consultative meeting reviewed the work of the organizing committee and discussed an action program for celebrating 2022 with splendor worldwide. The national chairman of the People's Progressive Party of Nigeria made an opening address to be followed by a report of the co-chairman of the Asia-Pacific Regional Committee for Supporting Peaceful Reunification of Korea. The reporter recalled that the organizing committee had praised the exploits of the great leaders of the Korean people and given wide publicity to the reality of the DPRK, true to its principal mission. He extended thanks to the friends in several countries who made positive contributions to the successful worldwide celebrations. Expressing the belief that the consultative meeting would be an occasion of exchanging sincere and constructive opinions in mapping out the action program, he appealed to the participants to more briskly conduct the solidarity activities praising the immortal exploits of the outstanding leaders and supporting the just cause of the Korean people this year of significance. Speeches were made at the meeting. Then a press statement of the organizing committee was issued. A letter to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un was adopted at the meeting. Rodong Sinmun

title: Letter to Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un from Int'l Festival Organizing Committee
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a letter from the participants in the consultative meeting of the Organizing Committee of the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu on January 7. The letter said that the organizing committee held a consultative meeting out of the common aspiration and desire to glorify the year 2022 marking the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il and the 10th anniversary of HE Kim Jong Un's assumption of the top party and state post in the DPRK as an auspicious year of the progressive mankind. It said it was proved once again through the consultative meeting that the aspiration and enthusiasm of the progressive mankind to celebrate, together with the Korean people, the birth anniversaries of the great leaders of the DPRK, who made immortal contributions to the human cause of independence with their outstanding idea and theory, rare leadership and noble virtues, are growing stronger with each passing day. It noted that today the world pays attention to the actual reality of the DPRK, in which the idea and cause of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il are being comprehensively carried forward and developed thanks to HE Kim Jong Un, with deep emotion and admiration. Many countries and regions suffer from grave social instability but miraculous events are witnessed in the DPRK one after anther, thanks to the far-sighted wisdom, outstanding leadership and devoted service of Kim Jong Un for the people's wellbeing, it pointed out. The letter said that they are convinced that Korean-style socialism centered on the popular masses, the ideal society of mankind, would steadily emerge victorious and the cause of global independence advance more dynamically under the guidance of Kim Jong Un. The Organizing Committee of the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu will fulfill its mission and duty in adding shine to the revolutionary careers and exploits of the President and the Chairman and fully supporting the Korean people's just cause for building a powerful socialist nation, it concluded. Rodong Sinmun

title: Meeting of Women's Union Officials and Members in DPRK
body: A meeting of officials and members of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea (SWUK) took place at the plaza of the Arch of Triumph in the capital city of Pyongyang on Thursday to vow to carry through the decisions made at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). Present there were Min Sung Chol, vice department director of the WPK Central Committee, officials concerned, officials of the SWUK and union members in the city. In her report at the meeting, Kim Jong Sun, chairwoman of the SWUK Central Committee, noted that the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, paying deep attention to the work of the women's union and guiding it step by step, made sure that the 7th Congress of the SWUK was convened last year when the 8th Congress of the WPK was held and sent a letter carrying his trust and loving care to its participants. Saying that the great practical programme drawn up at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee is associated with the firm faith and will of our Party, the reporter called for fully demonstrating the might of the women's union in the struggle to implement the Party's decisions. Victory is in store for us under the wise guidance of the Party Central Committee, the reporter stressed, appealing to the participants to make a positive contribution to glorifying this year as a watershed in the developing revolution by displaying their rare work ability, passion and fighting spirit. Then, oath-taking speeches were made. The speakers said that they would turn out as one in the struggle to implement the decisions of the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th WPK Central Committee, cherishing the trust of the Party which projects the women as a powerful force pushing one of the two wheels of the revolutionary chariot. They vowed to become genuine patriotic women performing marked exploits in the ongoing grand advance, guided by the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un. A letter of pledge to Kim Jong Un was adopted at the meeting. Then, women's union members in the city launched intensive agit-prop activities. Rodong Sinmun

title: Firing Drill of Railway-borne Missile Regiment Held
body: A firing drill for checking and judging the proficiency in the action procedures of the railway-borne missile regiment of North Phyongan Province took place on Friday. It was supervised by commanding officers of the Korean People's Army and leading officials of the Academy of Defence Science. The drill was aimed at checking the alert posture of the combatants of the regiment and bolstering their ability of discharging firepower mission. The regiment received a firepower mission at short notice from the General Staff in the morning on Friday before swiftly moving to the firing ground, and precisely struck the set target in the East Sea of Korea with two tactical guided missiles. The combat posture of the railway-borne missile regiment of North Phyongan Province which demonstrated high maneuverability and rate of hits in the drill was highly appreciated in the review and the issues were discussed to set up proper railway-borne missile operating system across the country and to find out ways for further completing our style fighting methods with the railway-borne missiles. Rodong Sinmun

title: Implanting Spirit of Blizzards of Paektu in Minds of People
body: Ever-victorious Weapon In January Juche 105(2016), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un sent a congratulatory message to the workers, technicians and officials of the Sangwon Cement Complex who surpassed the peak-year level in production of cement in the preceding year. He declared with pride in the message that our soldier-builders, workers and youths built the Sci-Tech Complex, Mirae Scientists Street, Paektusan Hero Youth Power Station, Chongchongang Power Station in Tiers and other grand monumental structures in different parts of the country in the revolutionary spirit of Paektu, the spirit of the blizzards of Paektu under the leadership of the Party and thus ushered in a great era of the country’s prosperity by doing ten years’ work in just one year, bringing about the dramatic change in the appearance of the country. And he stressed that the remarkable success made by the Sangwon Cement Complex made us confident that the heinous moves of the hostile forces would never work on us as long as there were Kim Il Sung’s and Kim Jong Il’s heroic working class who have struggled holding fast to the revolutionary spirit of Paektu and principle of giving priority to self-development as an invincible weapon, only the glorious way would be opened in the future, too. The respected General Secretary deeply implants in mind of the people the revolutionary spirit of Paektu as an invincible weapon. Our people could make the first step in this year’s gigantic march for a fresh victory thanks to the wise leadership of the respected General Secretary who makes all the people perform miracles and bring about changes while smashing all the difficulties, bearing the revolutionary spirit of Paektu, the spirit of blizzards of Paektu in their mind as a firm faith. Faith He Engraved on His Horse March The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un ascended Mt Paektu on horseback three years ago. At that time he told accompanying officials that the reason he spared his time to look round the revolutionary battle sites in the area of Mt Paektu was to establish the social atmosphere of further strengthening the education in the revolutionary traditions. He continued that this was to instill the indefatigable revolutionary spirit of Mt Paektu into the Party members and other working people, soldiers of the Korean People’s Army and youths and students in line with the present situation and environment of our revolution in which the entire Party, the whole army and all the people have turned out for building a powerful socialist country with the indomitable mental power of self-reliance by regarding the line for self-prosperity advanced by our Party as their lifeline despite the unprecedented blockade and pressure imposed by the imperialists, and also in line with the needs to get prepared for the harshness and protracted character of our revolution. The revolutionary idea and indomitable charging spirit of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il pervades all the revolutionary battle sites and revolutionary sites in the Mt Paektu area and the idea and spirit is ideological and mental treasure which makes us overcome all difficulties and open up the way of advance. Therefore the respected General Secretary let all the people bear in their minds the spirit of the blizzards of Paektu. Following his meaningful horse march from the bottom of their hearts, our people retain the revolutionary spirit of Paektu and the spirit of the blizzards of Paektu as their firm faith and make pledges to undauntedly advance towards the victory under the leadership of the respected General Secretary. Rodong Sinmun

title: Production of Cloth for School Uniforms and Bags Hastened
body: Officials and workers of the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill, who are all out to carry out the important tasks set forth at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea, push ahead with the production of cloth for school uniforms and bags. Those in charge of spun yarn production, preceding process of the production, bring about good results in their production day after day, fully aware of their important duty in realizing the Party’s intention of love for the rising generations. Workers of the spinning combined shop increase the thread output per unit hour by managing their equipment in a scrupulous and technological way. Those of the chemical fiber spinning combined shop bring about successes in the yarn production by raising the operation ratio of their equipment while conducting a brisk multi-spindle, multi-loom tending campaign. Officials, workers and technicians of the silk-spinning combined shop and general weaving shop pool their wisdom and enthusiasm in the production while displaying a high degree of collectivist spirit. Weavers of Tetron rayon fabrics shop under the silk-spinning combined shop work to the best of their ability to improve quality of products by briskly conducting the campaign of overtaking and learning from others and sharing experience with one another. Big successes are being made thanks to the revolutionary enthusiasm of the officials and working class of the mill who are extraordinarily resolved to contribute to the improvement of the people’s living standards by revitalizing the consumer goods production in this significant year. Rodong Sinmun

title: People in DPRK Study Idea and Spirit of Plenary Meeting of WPK Central Committee
body: Working people's organizations in the DPRK have intensified the study of the documents of the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Through the study, all their officials and members prepare themselves as communists who strive for the prosperity and development of the country, guided by the Juche idea. The Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League made the course of studying the important documents an occasion for taking innovative measures for achieving greater successes, cherishing the trust of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un who highly appreciated the feats of the young people as last year's noteworthy political success. The Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea and its affiliated organizations at all levels see to it that all the workers and trade union members grasp the idea and spirit of the historic conclusion and report made by the respected General Secretary at the plenary meeting through intensive study. The Central Committee of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea and its affiliated organizations in all provinces, cities and counties take measures for improving the work of the union, true to the steadfast determination of the Party Central Committee to bring about rapid development of the Korean-style socialist countryside. The Central Committee of the women's union and its affiliated organizations at all levels are making a deep study of the idea of the plenary meeting, aware that its purpose is to achieve substantial successes in carrying out the revolutionary tasks. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected General Secretary Opens Broad Avenue for Fresh Victory with Continuous Offensive
body: The 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea was held in the historic period when the entire Party, the whole country and all the people were confidently moving onto the next-stage struggle for the comprehensive development of socialist construction. Discussed there were agenda items reflecting gigantic and unfathomable ideals and ways for invincibility. The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un is, indeed, the supreme personifier of an indefatigable attacking spirit of not tolerating even a moment’s standstill and stagnation on the road of struggle for the country and people and, as we hold him in high esteem, only dynamic progress and victory are in store for us―this is what we keenly felt once again when we received the precious practical programme and an invincible militant banner encouraging the struggle for 2022 to bring earlier the overall development of the Korean-style socialism and the happiness of the people. The persevering fighting spirit of the respected General Secretary, who leads our revolution along the road of incessant upturns in the mettle of making continued innovations and steady progress, has brought about numerous great events, which have never been witnessed in the 5 000-year-long history of the nation, one after another and enabled us to translate into reality the ideals and dreams of a powerful country envied by the world. History does not know such a great man as our respected General Secretary who has put the independent dignity and position of the country and nation on the highest level in such a short period through an offensive as strong as Mt Paektu and as fierce as its blizzards. The more ordeals he encounters, the stronger his attacking spirit becomes. Indeed, his attacking spirit is a driving force that makes it possible for our revolution to leap from one victory up to a greater one. No strength in the world can check the advance of our people marching on with confidence in sure victory following the leadership of the respected General Secretary. Rodong Sinmun

title: Meetings Held at Units in Major Economic Sectors
body: Meetings took place at units in major sectors of the national economy to vow to carry through the decisions of the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Reports and speeches were made there. The reporters noted that the respected General Secretary of the WPK Kim Jong Un suggested the plenary meeting send thanks in the name of the Party Central Committee to the exemplary agricultural officials, workers, scientists and technologists who greatly contributed to raising good crops last year. They recalled that the respected General Secretary, on behalf of the Party Central Committee, highly praised all the Party members, working people and the service personnel who glorified Juche 110 (2021) in which the Party Congress was held as a year of proud victory to be specially recorded in the history of socialist construction, and sent warm greetings to them. The reporters and speakers said that the conclusion and report made by the respected General Secretary at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee are monumental documents of important and epochal significance in accelerating the prosperity and development of our state and realizing the cherished desire of the people as soon as possible and a militant banner of propping up this year's struggle. All the people across the country, who received with great excitement the immortal programme for powerfully leading our-style socialist construction to the next stage of victory, are now filled with the resolve to usher in a new era of the state's prosperity by keeping in their minds the idea and the spirit of the plenary meeting and spurring the dynamic advance, they noted. They called upon the officials, party members and working people to perform ceaseless miracles and innovation in the all-people grand advance for glorifying 2022 as a watershed in developing revolution under the invincible guidance of the great Party. Written pledges were adopted at the meetings. Rodong Sinmun

title: More Achievements Made in Economic Sectors of DPRK
body: The Kim Jong Thae Electric Locomotive Complex achieved innovative successes at the beginning of this year's campaign. The complex set forth practicable stepwise goals of improving the capability to repair locomotives and passenger cars this year, and concentrates on attaining them. While pushing ahead with the production of accessories needed for erecting locomotives and repairing the chassis, etc., the complex is rapidly erecting locomotives through the present capability. The complex is pushing forward the work to make wagons our own way at its final stage and carrying out its daily plan to produce railway fixtures. It also produces accessories for compressors, motors, etc. Rodong Sinmun

title: His Precious Teaching Reflected in Souvenir Photograph
body: One day in July some years ago the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited the then Samjiyon County and suggested having a photo session with the officials of Samjiyon County Party Committee and devoted his precious time to waiting for them. Then the respected General Secretary posed for a photo with the officials in front of the statue of Chairman Kim Jong Il in the county. After the photo session, the respected General Secretary instructed the officials of the Samjiyon County Party Committee to discharge their duty in a responsible manner. He said the officials there should be genuine servants of our people. That day, the respected General Secretary earnestly instructed that they should believe in people as in heaven and uphold our people as they did the Chairman. And he added that they should transform the County Party Committee into people’s "parents’ home" where they could reveal their inward thoughts without reserve and a place firmly rooted in masses’ minds. Only when we officials cherish deep in our minds his teaching given that day and remain loyal to people, can we be called their true servants as desired by the respected General Secretary. Rodong Sinmun

title: Test-fire of Tactical Guided Missiles Held
body: Test-fire of tactical guided missiles was conducted on Monday under a plan of the Academy of Defence Science, the Second Economy Commission and other institutions concerned. The test-fire was aimed to selectively evaluate tactical guided missiles being produced and deployed and to verify the accuracy of the weapon system. The two tactical guided missiles launched in the western area of the DPRK precisely hit an island target in the East Sea of Korea. The Academy of Defence Science confirmed the accuracy, security and efficiency of the operation of the weapon system under production. Rodong Sinmun

title: Production Targets Hit Day by Day in Metal and Chemical Industries
body: The working class of metal and chemical industries acorss the country carry out their militant tasks day by day. The officials and workers of the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex work harder than before with redoubled courage and high spirits. They wage a dynamic drive for increased production while making a firm determination to strongly uphold the Workers’ Party of Korea with increased steel production this year. The workers of its furnace shop assigned for the production of pig iron raise their production records to the full by introducing the rational working methods conducive to shortening the melting time and increasing the output of molten iron per charge. Also those of the steel shop positively strive to boost the number of tappings per shift. Those of the Chollima Steel Complex are also in sky-high spirits. The officials and workers of the steel and rolling shops, too, introduce rational working methods and fully meet the demand of technical rules and standard operation methods, while directing efforts to the technical innovation movement for improving the capacity of setups. Those of the Posan Iron Works attain their assignments every day by carrying on readjusting and repairing rotary kiln in a foresighted manner. The Musan Mining Complex and other units in charge of the production of iron ore, fireproof materials and ferroalloy keep deep in mind the importance of its mission in solidifying the self-reliant steel pillar and launch fierce offensive. Meanwhile, the Namhung Youth Chemical and Hungnam Fertilizer complexes succeed in the fertilizer production, and the February 8 Vinalon Complex speeds up the production of various kinds of chemical goods. Now the officials and workers of the metal and chemical industrial sectors continually give spur to the production of iron and steel and chemical goods needed in various sectors of national economy, fully aware of the important mission assigned to them in carrying out the five-year plan. Rodong Sinmun

title: Art Performance Given to Mark Anniversary of Youth League
body: A performance of the art squad of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League "May the youth shine under guidance of the great Party" was given at the Central Youth Hall in the DPRK on Monday to commemorate the 76th anniversary of the youth league. Put on the stage were diverse numbers showing the pride of the Korean youth who have glorified the proud history and tradition of the Juche-oriented youth movement. The performers sang of the love of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il who put forward the young people as successors to the revolution and the masters of the future. There were also numbers reflecting the loyalty of all the Korean people entrusting their destinies to and single-heartedly following the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un who opens up a bright future of the country in the van. And performed were numbers carrying the will of the youths to always march straight ahead, following the Party by inheriting the revolutionary spirit and fighting traits of the preceding generations. Enjoying the performance were Ri Tu Song, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Mun Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League, officials of the youth league and youth and students in the city of Pyongyang. Rodong Sinmun

title: Young People of DPRK Volunteer to Work at Difficult Sectors
body: Hundreds of young people in North and South Phyongan provinces of the DPRK volunteered to work at major fronts of socialist construction. Over 220 young people from South Phyongan Province vowed to work at difficult and labor-consuming sectors. Those of Anju City and Sukchon County volunteered to work at farms in the province. Youths from Sunchon, Kaechon, Phyongsong and Tokchon cities and a youth league official from Yangdok County volunteered to work at the livestock farming base in the Sepho area, cooperative farms and coal mines. More than 100 young people from North Phyongan Province, too, are filled with enthusiasm to work miracle at the frontline of socialist construction. Those from various cities and counties such as Sinuiju City and Tongrim and Pakchon counties volunteered to work at co-op farms, coal mines, general machine enterprise, etc. Gatherings to congratulate the young volunteers were respectively held in each area on Jan. 17. Rodong Sinmun

title: Writing Activities Brisk in DPRK
body: Enthusiasm for writing is getting high among working people in the DPRK. Activities of mass literary groups gain momentum in different areas and units, and works for picking out those with high writing ability have been conducted. The amateur writers in different cities and counties and at various industrial establishments are producing fresh works showing the vibrant realities. And many people have attended the national mass literary work prize contest marking the birth anniversaries of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il (the Day of the Sun and the Day of the Shining Star). Meanwhile, a large number of literary works of different kinds including novel, drama, lyrics and fairy tale have been contributed by ordinary people across the country. More than 100 work pieces were contributed in the first 10-odd days of this year. The brisk mass writing activities greatly inject vitality in the struggle of the Korean people out in the advance of this year. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Society Overflowing with Virtues and Affection
body: A Worker Regains His Sight In July Juche 109(2020), Ri Kwang Ho, a worker of the Hungnam Pharmaceutical Factory in the eastern part of the country came to the Ryugyong General Ophthalmic Hospital in Pyongyang. He had been seriously injured on his eyes by an unexpected accident. His mother, who accompanied him, said to the doctors with tears in her eyes that people inspired her to go to the Ryugyong General Ophthalmic Hospital which was built thanks to the love of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un for the people. Medical workers of the hospital successfully conducted several rounds of difficult and elaborate operation on Ri’s eyes and showed utmost sincerity for him. Not only the medical workers but also many other people helped Ri. Employees of the factory and even strangers visited Ri on his sickbed with various tonics and food. Thus, Ri Kwang Ho, who had been regarded to go blind, regained his sight under such warm love and assistance of the collective in our society which forms a large harmonious family and returned to his home. Rodong Sinmun

title: With Mind of Making Bags for Their Own Children
body: This picture shows officials and employees of the Chongjin Bag Factory striving to produce perfect ones. Devoting their sincerity to the production with minds of making bags for their own children, they give priority to raising quality of bags, while pooling their wisdom and efforts. On New Year’s Day they received with great excitement the news that the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un set forth a task for supplying all the students with quality uniforms and bags of new forms without exception and took an important measure for implementing it at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea. They devote their wisdom and passion to raising quality of bags with the thought that quality of bags reflects their attitude to future generations. Rodong Sinmun

title: More Agricultural Workers Enrolled in Online Educational System
body: Entering the new year, enthusiasm for learning is growing higher among the agricultural workers in the DPRK. In this regard, various universities across the country like Pyongyang University of Agriculture, Wonsan University of Agriculture and Sariwon Kye Ung Sang University of Agriculture push ahead with the work to further increase the number of students in online educational system. At present, officials of various cities and counties (districts), including Rangnang and Mangyongdae districts of Pyongyang and 10-odd counties of North Phyongan Province, and co-op farms across the country are studying via online educational system. In particular, tens of agricultural workers from the Migok Cooperative Farm in Sariwon City, North Hwanghae Province are studying via the online educational system of Sariwon Kye Ung Sang University of Agriculture. Officials of the farm are taking measures to provide a better educational environment for increasing the number of students. Rodong Sinmun

title: 6th Political Bureau Meeting of 8th C.C., WPK Held
body: The Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) convened its 6th Meeting of the 8th Central Committee at the office building of the Party Central Committee on January 19 to discuss and decide immediate work and important policy issues of the Party and the state. Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the WPK, was present at the meeting. Attending the meeting were members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK and members and alternate members of the Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un presided over the meeting. The meeting first discussed the issue of celebrating with splendor the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung and the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il (the Day of the Sun and the Day of the Shining Star). To most auspiciously and significantly celebrate the Day of the Sun and the Day of the Shining Star this significant year is the bounden duty and moral obligation of the descendants of the President and the soldiers and disciples of the Chairman and also the boundless honor and pride of our people who have struggled, remaining faithful to the cause of the President and the Chairman. No holidays are more significant than the Day of the Sun and the Day of the Shining Star for our Party and people struggling to carry forward and accomplish the revolutionary cause of the President and the Chairman under the uplifted banner of great Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism. The very existence of our dignified Party and state is unthinkable without the immortal exploits left by the President and the Chairman in the glorious course of the Korean revolution. The meeting called for making the Day of the Sun and the Day of the Shining Star this historic year important political occasions of further cementing the firm faith of our people to carry forward and accomplish the revolutionary cause of Juche pioneered and led by the President and the Chairman under the guidance of the Party to the end, and also of demonstrating before the world the high enthusiasm and revolutionary mettle of all the Party members and other people to glorify the decade of Juche 110 as the annals of victors bringing about the overall development of our style socialism. The Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee gave detailed assignments to the organs of the Party and the state to celebrate with splendor the 110th birth anniversary of the President and the 80th birth anniversary of the Chairman as the great festivals of victory and glory to shine long in the annals of the country. The meeting adopted a resolution of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee "On celebrating with splendor the 110th birth anniversary of the Great Leader Comrade Kim Il Sung and the 80th birth anniversary of the Great Leader Comrade Kim Jong Il". The meeting heard a report analyzing the current situation around the Korean peninsula and a series of international issues and discussed the orientation for countermeasures against the U.S. for the future. Also communicated to the participants were the U.S. recent moves of recklessly faulting for no reason the DPRK's legitimate exercise of sovereignty. In the last few years alone after the DPRK-U.S. summits the U.S. held hundreds of joint war drills which it committed itself to stop and conducted tests of all kinds of strategic weapons, while shipping ultra-modern attack means into south Korea and nuclear strategic weapons into the region around the Korean peninsula, seriously threatening the security of our state. The U.S. viciously slurred our state and committed the foolish act of taking over 20 independent sanctions measures. Especially the present U.S. administration persists in maneuvers to deprive the DPRK of its right to self-defence. All the facts clearly prove once again that the hostile policy towards the DPRK will exist in the future, too as long as there is the hostile entity of U.S. imperialism. Assessing that the hostile policy and military threat by the U.S. have reached a danger line that can not be overlooked any more despite our sincere efforts for maintaining the general tide for relaxation of tension in the Korean peninsula since the DPRK-U.S. summit in Singapore, the Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee unanimously recognized that we should make more thorough preparation for a long-term confrontation with the U.S. imperialism. It concluded to take a practical action to more reliably and effectively increase our physical strength for defending the dignity, sovereign rights and interests of our state. The meeting of the Political Bureau reassigned the policy tasks for the national defence to immediately bolster more powerful physical means which can efficiently control the hostile moves of the U.S. against the DPRK getting ever more serious day by day. It gave an instruction to a sector concerned to reconsider on an overall scale the trust-building measures that we took on our own initiative on a preferential ground and to promptly examine the issue of restarting all temporarily-suspended activities. The decision of the meeting is a timely and rightful step for reliably guaranteeing the existence and sovereign rights of our state in view of the urgent requirements of the developing revolution and under the prevailing situation. The meeting fully demonstrated the revolutionary will and indomitable spirit of the WPK to uphold President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, who are the eternal sun of Juche and sacred image of socialist Korea, in high esteem forever and to build an independent and dignified powerful country on this land without fail. Political News Team

title: Agricultural Research Work Stepped Up in DPRK
body: The Academy of Agricultural Science is concentrating efforts on the researches to breed high-yielding strains of rice and wheat which stand the disastrous weather conditions and to put their cultivation technology on a scientific basis. After setting it as a main goal for this year to establish the technology of cultivating newly-bred rice strains in various areas of the country, the Rice Research Institute has made good preparations for it. Some research teams strive to take sci-tech measures for introducing new rice strains as soon as possible. After grasping the ecological adaptability of wheat strains widely cultivated in the country in liaison with provincial agricultural science institutes, the Dry-field Crop Research Institute has paid effort to the research for establishing a high-yielding cultivation technique suited to relevant regions. It also set it as a main target to breed a new spring barley strain appropriate for beer brewing. And it is conducting the research into new strains of potato and after-crop bean for double-cropping. Rodong Sinmun

title: ﻿Pro-reunification Patriotic Fighter Receives Birthday Spread
body: Pro-reunification patriotic fighters of the DPRK, strong in faith and will, are leading a worthwhile life full of energy despite their advanced age. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un sent a birthday spread to Ham Se Hwan, one of those fighters, on his 90th birthday. Ham was born into a poor peasant family in Ongjin County of South Hwanghae Province on January 18, Juche 21 (1932) and had to undergo sorrow as a stateless nation. After Korea's liberation, he came to realize, witnessing the reality in the northern half of the Republic, that true happiness can only be achieved under the care of President Kim Il Sung. That's why he took an active part in the guerilla struggle against the heinous maneuvers of the anti-reunification forces within and without and bravely fought for the victory in the Fatherland Liberation War before being captured by the enemy. During his 34 years of imprisonment, he never succumbed to the enemies' unimaginable, barbaric tortures, appeasement and deception. After his release from prison, he had devoted himself to the movement for national reunification. Chairman Kim Jong Il, the supreme incarnation of revolutionary comradeship and obligation, took a step to bring Ham and other unconverted long-term prisoners in south Korea back to the DPRK and put them forward as heroes of the Republic and winners of the National Reunification Prize. Ham Se Hwan and his family extended their feelings of gratitude to Kim Jong Un who glorifies a revolutionary soldier's life. Rodong Sinmun

title: Meaningful Trace Left on an Ordinary Day
body: On January 16, Juche 107 (2018), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited newly-remodeled Pyongyang Teacher Training College. His greatest satisfaction was that the officials and teaching staff of the college set an excellent example in improving the contents of the college’s education, teaching methods, educational conditions and environment. After learning in detail about the work of the college, the respected General Secretary highly appreciated that they developed five-point educational programs, e-education materials and education aid programs, wrote a large number of teaching materials to implement the universal 12-year compulsory education programme, introduced educational forecasting technology to give scientific lectures with the main emphasis on the independent thinking of the students and achieved many other successes in the scientific research. Looking round the college that day, he said with satisfaction that all the classrooms were well equipped to be multi-functional classrooms capable of giving students practical training in their specialties and that the teaching methods in the virtual teaching situation and in the actual teaching situation were new and peculiar. When he dropped in at the gymnasium, he was pleased to see the multi-functional hall for political and cultural events as well as various sports games. Looking round the library, he said with a broad smile that it was wonderful and it was a miniature of the Sci-Tech Complex. He said with great satisfaction that the excellent educational conditions and environment were provided for the teachers and students. He noted that he seemed to have picked even a star from the sky for the educators in charge of our future and provided a golden cushion to them, adding that the bright future of the country was well pictured before him. The proud reality at Pyongyang Teacher Training College makes sure that our country will shine as a country of education and a talent power envied by the whole world, thanks to the respected General Secretary who is making a new history of love for the rising generations and the future on this land. Rodong Sinmun

title: Production of School Things Brisk in DPRK
body: On the occasion of the meaningful Day of the Shining Star and the new school year, school supplies are to be provided to the preschoolers, first-grade pupils at primary schools moving up to the second grade and newly incoming pupils to the junior and senior middle schools across the country. The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un stressed at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea that the supply of school uniforms and things to the students across the country at the state’s expense is a consistent policy of the Party and the state. True to the intention of the respected General Secretary and his ardent love for the coming generations, the Ryongbong and Sonamu school supplies factories push forward the production of school things. The Ryongbong School Supplies Factory, well-known to the people for its "Haebaragi(Sunflower)"-trademarked school things, engages itself in producing quality school supplies like writing materials, crayons and pencil cases to be given to preschoolers on the occasion of the Day of the Shining Star, the greatest holiday of the nation. The foregoing news adds much to the patriotic zeal and fighting stamina of our people out in the New Year’s advance. Rodong Sinmun

title: Meetings of Officials and Members of Working People's Organizations Held
body: Joint meetings of officials and members of the working people's organizations took place in Pyongyang City and all provinces of the DPRK to vow to carry through the decisions made at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Present there were officials of the Party committees and officials and members of the working people's organizations in Pyongyang and local areas. Speeches were made at the meetings. The speakers said that the important conclusion and historic report, made by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th WPK Central Committee, are an ever-victorious banner guiding the Korean revolution to fresh victory. They stressed the need for the working people's organizations to energetically conduct the organizational political work for arousing their members to the implementation of the plenary meeting decisions while regarding the inner-union work as their main task for ideological education. They appealed to all the officials and members of the working people's organizations to carry through the important tasks set forth at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee with the indomitable spiritual strength and in the fighting spirit of self-reliance and thus establish a firm guarantee for implementing the five-year plan with their own efforts and style. Letters of pledge to Kim Jong Un were adopted at the joint meetings. At the end of the meetings, there were processions of the participants. Rodong Sinmun

title: Motivational Work Brisk in DPRK
body: A number of art troupes and itinerant art squads in the DPRK launched all at once a motivational campaign at worksites of various economic sectors seething with a vigorous struggle for the comprehensive development of socialist construction. Artistes of the Central Art Squad for Agitation for Increased Production began their performing activities at the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex to encourage its workers. Those of the North Hamgyong Provincial Art Troupe are conducting their agit-prop activities with art works strong in militancy and appeal, at the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex and the Chongjin Steel Factory. At the February 8 Vinalon Complex, members of the South Hamgyong Provincial Art Squad started their performance encouraging the workers to collective innovation. Among the art troupes and squads engaged in field agit-prop activities are also artistes of the Workers' Art Group of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea and the art squad of the Central Committee of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea. Rodong Sinmun

title: Publication Anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's Work Marked
body: A meeting took place at the National Theatre in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, on Wednesday to mark the 30th publication anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's classic work "On Juche Literature". Kim Hye Song, chairperson of the Central Committee of the Writers Union of Korea, made a report at the meeting. The reporter noted that Kim Jong Il, who made an immortal contribution to the Korean revolution and the history of human thought through his rare ideo-theoretical activities in the whole period of his revolutionary life, made public the work "On Juche Literature" on Jan. 20, Juche 81 (1992) to provide a new historic landmark for the Juche-oriented literature construction. The work is a great programme of Juche-oriented literature giving clear answers to all the problems arising in the literature creation and construction with the immortal Juche idea as an ideo-theoretical and methodological basis, the reporter said, adding: Over the past three decades, our writers have made achievements in creating literary works that inspiringly arouse all the people to the worthy grand march and make a true contribution to the development of the Juche-based literature and arts, along the bright course indicated by the immortal programme. Under the guidance of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, our literature greets a heyday of its development in the new century of Juche. The reporter called on all the creation guidance officials and writers to thoroughly apply the idea of Kim Jong Un on aesthetics and his style of writing in their creation activities and thus fulfill their mission and duty as the soldiers faithful to the Party in the field of literature and arts in the ongoing struggle for the overall development of socialist construction. Attending the meeting were creation guidance officials, writers and examinants of the April 15 Literary Production Company and the Central Committee of the Writers Union of Korea and incumbent writers in Pyongyang including teachers, researchers and editors of Kim Il Sung University, Kim Hyong Jik University of Education, the Academy of Social Sciences and the Art and Literature Publishing House. Rodong Sinmun

title: Young People Volunteer to Work on Major Fronts of Socialist Construction
body: The noble spirit is being fully displayed among the youths in the DPRK to stir up the people's revolutionary and patriotic zeal for this year's advance. 30 young people in the capital city of Pyongyang volunteered to work in difficult and labor-consuming sectors of socialist construction including coal mines and farms. Among them are a youth league member from the Moranbong Printing Plant and a girl worker from the Aeguk Choe Jong Rak Garment Factory. A meeting of youths in the city was held at the hall of the Pyongyang City Committee of the youth league on January 19 to congratulate the volunteers. Earlier, youth league members of the Taehung Trading Guidance Bureau and the Central Zoo volunteered to work at the Management Office for Revolutionary Battle Sites in the Secret Camp of Mt Paektu and the Komdok Mining Complex. Rodong Sinmun

He also received congratulatory messages and letters from high-ranking political, public, economic and military personages and representatives of Juche idea study organizations and organizations for friendship and support to Korea's reunification in China, Russia, Nepal, Malaysia, Myanmar, Bangladesh, Singapore, Thailand, Pakistan, Kazakhstan, Cyprus, Turkey, Iran, India, Japan, Norway, Denmark, Germany, Romania, Moldova, Belarus, Switzerland, Sweden, the Czech Republic, France, Finland, Poland, Britain, Austria, Italy, Spain, Guinea, Nigeria, South Africa, Libya, Benin, Zambia, Tanzania, the DR Congo, Tunisia, Angola, Mexico, Brazil, Peru, Ecuador and Australia, including the deputy general secretary for international affairs of the Islamic Coalition Party of Iran, the senior leader of the Indian People's Party, the secretary of the C.C., Communist Party of Malta, the secretary of the C.C., Slovak Communist Party, the director of the International Department of the Socialist Workers' Party of Croatia, the international secretary of the C.C., Communist Party of the People of Spain, the deputy general secretary of the National Democratic Congress of Ghana, the vice chairman of the Socialist Freedom Party of Egypt, the president of the International Group of Italy, the director-general of the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations, the chairman of the Afro-Asian People's Solidarity Organization, the secretary general, the director-general and the vice director-general of the International Institute of the Juche Idea, the vice director- general of the Asian Regional Institute of the Juche Idea, the secretary general and a councilor of the European Society for the Study of the Juche Idea, the secretary general of the African Regional Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea and the head of the Orchestra of the 21st Century of Russia, and diplomatic envoys and representatives of international bodies' missions here. Meanwhile, the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea received congratulatory messages from the Central Committee of the Jordanian Communist Party, the Central Leadership of the Baath Arab Socialist Party, the secretary general of the PKP-1930, the general chairman of the Democrat Party of Indonesia, the general secretary of the Central Committee of the Czechoslovak Communist Party, the general secretary of the Revolutionary Communist Party of France, the first secretary of the Workers' World Party of the United States of America, the secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Malta and the vice-president of the Brazilian Communist Party who doubles as its political and international secretary. Rodong Sinmun

title: Amnesty to Be Granted in DPRK
body: The Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK decided to grant an amnesty to those who had been convicted of the crimes against the country and people, on the occasion of the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung and the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The amnesty will be enforced from January 30, Juche 111 (2022). The DPRK Cabinet and relevant organs will take practical measures to help the released people settle down for normal working life. The Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK announced a decree in this regard. Rodong Sinmun

title: Care of Endlessly Benevolent Teacher
body: Officials Exist for People One day in April, Juche 101(2012), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un gave the accompanying officials precious teachings to be kept as their motto. He earnestly said that the officials should devote themselves to the people and that the officials exist for the people, not vice versa. Looking at the officials filled with emotions, he continued that they should occupy themselves only with the undertakings for people’s sake, work diligently and skillfully for the people and be their genuine servants who find it delightful and worthwhile to work for them. Be true servants of the people! These words brought the officials to keenly feel his noble love for the people. The officials were all afire with a determination to work heart and soul for the people with the noble intention of the respected General Secretary as their motto and precious guideline. Invaluable Title One December day in Juche 104(2015), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un met an official and gave him the following meaningful words. The officials should be taught to possess a correct view on the people. Ours are the best people in the world who follow the Party single-heartedly and share weal and woe with it. The best people in the world! These words were reflective of his endless love and care for the people whom President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il entrusted to him. The greatest in the world indeed is the respected General Secretary who makes tireless and painstaking efforts to let the people enjoy every good blessing in the world. Rodong Sinmun

title: Precious Treasure
body: Once the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un instructed officials that they should regard the trust and expectation of people as their whole life and said as follows: There is nothing more great, precious, thick and powerful than trust in both revolutionary struggle and life. The revolutionaries can be more indomitable and genuine persons than anyone else as they have trust in righteousness of their cause and in their comrades and people. And also the revolutionary struggle is the most worthwhile and the life of revolutionaries shines as they are trusted by comrades and people. It is the struggle and life of a revolutionary that if he is trusted by comrades and people, he can brave all kinds of difficulties and adversities and if not, he cannot advance even a step forward and loses everything; hence it can be said that the trust precisely means the life of the revolutionary and all of his life. The respected General Secretary, who believes in the people as in heaven and values the trust of people, emphasizes on every occasion that the officials should repay the trust and expectation of people without fail. Be faithful to the trust of people to the end! This is the unshakable will and the ardent desire of the respected General Secretary. There is no such a benevolent father of people and great defender of people in the world as the respected General Secretary who goes through the road of do-or-die revolution without hesitation and accepts difficulties with pleasure to live up to the people’s trust. Rodong Sinmun

title: Yonbaek Plain of DPRK Bustling with Farming Preparations
body: Yonan, Chongdan and Paechon counties in Yonbaek plain of South Hwanghae Province of the DPRK have stepped up their preparations for this year's farming. After working out a detailed plan on the basis of the study and discussion over the experience and lessons gained in last year's farming, those counties launched a mass campaign to help their farms make farming preparations. They arranged various shows of farm implements in an effective way to generalize the successes and experience and organized a hot emulation for overtaking and learning from the model units. They also aroused the popular masses to dredging fish-breeding grounds to produce organic compound fertilizer. Farm implement factories and farm machine stations are producing all kinds of farm implements while overhauling tractors in a responsible way. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives New Year Cards from Foreign State and Party Leaders
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received New Year cards from state and party leaders and public figures of different countries on the occasion of the New Year, Juche 111 (2022). The New Year cards came from Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez, president of the Republic of Cuba who is first secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba, Raul Castro Ruz, MD. Abdul Hamid, president of the People's Republic of Bangladesh, Joko Widodo, president of the Republic of Indonesia, Muhammadu Buhari, president of the Federal Republic of Nigeria, Obiang Nguema Mbasogo, president of the Republic of Equatorial Guinea, and his wife, and Rumen Radev, president of the Republic of Bulgaria, and his wife. Among them are also the prime minister of the People's Republic of Bangladesh, the general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of India (Marxist), the general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Portugal, the national leader of the Communist Party of Canada (Marxist-Leninist), the co-chairman of the Board of Directors of the Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation, the director-general of the UNESCO, and the director of the Regional Office for Southeast Asia of the WHO. Meanwhile, the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea received a New Year card from the Communist Party of Canada (Marxist-Leninist). Rodong Sinmun

title: Fatherly Love Reaches Every Part of Our Life
body: For People’s Convenience Sake In January several years ago, the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited the Pyongyang Trolley Bus Factory. That day, he inspected the factory’s new-type trolley bus. Aboard the trolley bus, he had a close look at its interior. All of a sudden, he asked the accompanying officials why horizontal bars had been installed by the windows. Informed that they were to protect the windowpanes, he had a seat shoulder to shoulder with one of the officials to check if the bar was causing inconvenience. Presently, he said that the bars were inconvenient as they might touch the shoulders of those sitting on chairs right beside them. He continued that it was advisable to remove the bars and reduce the height of the windows instead. He also advised that the plastic chairs on the trolley bus had to be covered with something soft and warm. Like this, he thought of inconveniences to the people before anything else even when he saw a single bar and a single chair. And this taught the officials the viewpoint and attitude they should adhere to in thinking and action. Banquet for Workers In late April some years ago, the respected General Secretary inspected the completed hostel of the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill. When he dropped in at the dining hall, he praised its splendor and said with warm feelings that a nice banquet had to be given there on May Day that year. After making rounds of the kitchen and outdoor resting ground, he emphasized once again that he would personally give a banquet for workers on May Day; hence a grand May Day banquet at the hostel of the textile mill that year. Indeed, the banquet was an impressive event which could be witnessed only in our country whose masters are ordinary working people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Electricity Production Normalized on High Level
