body: The officials and workers of hydropower stations kindle the fierce flame of increased production of electricity upholding the decision of the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee. Officials of the Ministry of Electric Power Industry dynamically organize and command the campaign to normalize the electricity production on a high level this year, too, by encouraging and amplifying the successes and experiences gained last year. The large-scale hydropower stations across the country increase their electricity production. The working class of the Suphung, Hochongang and Jangjingang Power Stations put spurs to the electricity production regarding self-reliance, science and technology as their treasure sword. The workers and technicians of the Sodusu and Thaechon Power Stations make high records of electricity production every day by operating generating equipment in a responsible way. Those of other hydraulic power stations including the Wiwon and Huichon Power Stations increase electricity output per generator by thoroughly observing technical rules and standard regulations as well as putting efforts in maintaining and reinforcing production foundation. Otherwise the Ministry of Electric Power Industry scrupulously organizes the work to strengthen the material and technical foundation of hydropower generating facility production base further and produce hydraulic turbines of high efficiency. Thanks to the devoted efforts of the officials and workers, a bigger success in electricity production is witnessed. Rodong Sinmun

title: Meeting of Chongryon Officials Held
body: A meeting of officials of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) took place at the Korean Hall in Tokyo on Jan. 19 to vow to carry through the important tasks set forth at the congratulatory message the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un sent on the occasion of the New Year, Juche 111 (2022). Attending it were Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, Pak Ku Ho, first vice-chairman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee and director of its Organization Department, Nam Sung U, vice-chairman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, Pae Jin Gu, vice-chairman and concurrently director general of the General Affairs Department of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, Jo Il Yon, vice-chairman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, Kang Chu Ryon, vice-chairwoman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee and chairwoman of the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Democratic Korean Women in Japan, Ri Myong Yu, chairman of the Central Audit Committee of Chongryon, department directors of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, the director of the Research Institute on History of Korean Residents in Japan, chairpersons of Chongryon headquarters in Kanto area, officials of central organizations and affiliates and principals of schools at all levels. Read out at the meeting was the congratulatory message sent by Kim Jong Un to the chairman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee on the New Year. Ho Jong Man noted in his report that Kim Jong Un sent warm congratulations to the officials of the Chongryon and compatriots in Japan in the early morning of this year. He stressed it is thanks to the warm loving care of Kim Jong Un that the Chongryon could boldly reject all sorts of challenges and threats by the reactionaries despite the desolateness in an alien land. The reporter said that it is the revolutionary conscience and bounden duty of the Chongryon officials to make this significant year another watershed in implementing the behests of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. He appealed to all the officials of the Chongryon to make a report of victory without fail by registering marked achievements in the struggle for the overall development of the movement of Koreans in Japan along with the homeland in the year of great auspicious event to be recorded in the national history, cherishing the absolute loyalty to Kim Jong Un. Then, oath-taking speeches were made at the meeting. A letter to Kim Jong Un was read out there. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends New Year Cards to Foreign Party, State Leaders
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent New Year cards to party and state leaders of different countries on the occasion of the New Year, Juche 111 (2022). His New Year cards went to Xi Jinping, general secretary of the C.C., Communist Party of China and president of the People's Republic of China, Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation, Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez, first secretary of the C.C., Communist Party of Cuba and president of the Republic of Cuba, and Raul Castro Ruz, Thongloun Sisoulith, general secretary of the C.C., Lao People's Revolutionary Party and president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic, Nguyen Phu Trong, general secretary of the C.C., Communist Party of Vietnam, Nguyen Xuan Phuc, president of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, and Bashar Al-Assad, president of the Syrian Arab Republic. Rodong Sinmun

title: His Attentive Care for the People
body: Tasting Hot Spring Water in Person The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un inspected the hot spring area in Yangdok County some years ago. Feasting his eyes on the gushing-out hot spring water of over 80 degrees Celsius, he expressed his great satisfaction with a broad smile. For the construction of the hot spring resort, he had made rounds of the hot springs in and around Onjong-ri, Yangdok County, and learnt about the yield of hot spring water and the surroundings in person. Out of indescribable delight which filled his heart, he tried the hot spring water and said in pleasure that it tasted as sweet as honey. His words vividly showed how he valued the spring water which was to benefit the people and give them added pleasure. Equivalent to the spring of eternal happiness to the people is the respected General Secretary’s inexhaustible devotion and love for them. Thinking of People’s Convenience First One June day in Juche 107(2018), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited the Pyongyang Taedonggang Seafood Restaurant. The restaurant resembling a ship on the water has large indoor pools teeming with delicious fishes and shellfishes, fishing area and so on its first floor. He said the first floor of the restaurant was worthy of notice and the indoor pools full of fishes gave him so much pleasure. The accompanying officials, too, marveled at the panorama of the restaurant’s interior. Presently, the respected General Secretary pointed out that the tiles around the indoor pools might get slippery in case of getting wet and that interior paving blocks had to be laid aslant instead to drain water off promptly. He went on to teach officials that people’s convenience had to be given top priority and regarded as absolute in doing everything no matter how trivial they might be. Thanks to his attentive care for the people’s convenience, the tiles were replaced with interior paving blocks. Rodong Sinmun

title: Most Sacred Call
body: In the long human history, the word "people" was the synonym for common and ordinary human beings. But in our country they are regarded as heaven to be most sacredly upheld and the most precious being to whom everything should be devoted. The people have existed in every age of the time. But history has not witnessed such people in our country who are upheld with dignity before. Only in our country all the issues related to people are prioritized as the most important revolutionary tasks and the overall Party and state affairs are oriented to people thanks to the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un. The respected General Secretary, at the speech made at the military parade and public procession of Pyongyang citizens marking the 70th founding anniversary of the Workers’ Party of Korea, reviewed our Party’s 70-year-long history and attributed everything－mightiness, greatness and victories achieved by our Party to people. Indeed, no other man in the world can be equal to him, a great politician who holds people in high esteem. The respected General Secretary believes in people as in heaven succeeding the lofty viewpoint on people of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. Rodong Sinmun

title: Steel Shop Full of Patriotic Enthusiasm
body: The furnacemen in the steel shop of the Chollima Steel Complex make strenuous efforts to produce more steel upholding the decision of the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of Workers’ Party of Korea. Their trustworthy appearances remind us of the Chollima riders tens of years ago. They are all of a sweat; however, they are all out to produce steel. They are burning their hearts with warmer patriotic enthusiasm than the molten iron in the furnace. They regard it as the pride and worth of life to live as vanguard fighter in steel production. Thus the steel shop is always filled with their patriotic enthusiasm. Rodong Sinmun

title: Lots of Scrap Iron Sent to Chollima Steel Complex
body: Pyongyang renders powerful assistance to the metal industry sector. On Jan. 17, it sent a large amount of scrap iron to the Chollima Steel Complex. Its officials went out to districts, counties and factories and enterprises to inform the people there in depth of the idea and spirit of the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea, thus revving up their enthusiasm for assisting the metal industry. Meanwhile, scrupulous arrangements were made for the transportation of scrap iron. Officials in Songyo, Sosong, Central, Sadong and Moranbong districts gave precedence to rousing the residents to scrap iron collection and set personal examples in obtaining lots of scrap iron in a short period. Officials of Mangyongdae, Taedonggang and Rangnang districts tried to convert the scrap iron collection into a mass-based undertaking on one hand and strived to send the collected scrap iron timely to the steel producers on the other. Factories and enterprises in Pyongyang like its Power Distribution Station, Rubber Factory and Condiment Factory made achievements by focusing on tapping as many sources of scrap iron as possible. Encouraged by the sincere assistance of officials, Party members and other working people in Pyongyang, workers at the Chollima Steel Complex are making redoubled efforts to increase production. Rodong Sinmun

title: Work for Rice and Wheat Farming Intensified in DPRK
body: Officials in the agricultural field of the DPRK are intensifying the work to push ahead with the cultivation of rice and wheat this year. Officials of the provincial-level agricultural guidance organs conduct in a planned way the work for securing the cultivation areas, one of the main ways for implementing the grain production plan. They have concentrated efforts on expanding the area of paddy fields, ensuring double-cropping on a large scale and widely cultivating the dry-field rice. They strive to find a way for carrying out the plan for spring sowing while analyzing the condition of wheat plants in the fields where seeds were sowed in autumn last year and reconfirming the cultivation area. In order to provide a favorable condition for rice farming, North Phyongan Province focused efforts on the building of setups in the reclaimed tideland to expand the area of paddy fields and improve the irrigation system. South Phyongan Province is taking measures to expand the area of rice fields by planting dry-field rice in dry lands and rain-dependent paddies and readjusting the areas around river basin. Farms in Kangwon Province are transforming dry fields of large area into paddy fields while finding a way for supplying irrigation water. Farms in North Hwanghae Province are increasing the area of spring sowing under a plan for securing the cultivation area. Agricultural officials in various provinces take steps to bring the guidance over farming close to the field with accurate plan, while pushing ahead with the work to make the production bases in provinces, cities and counties supply various kinds of nutrition liquid to farms. Rodong Sinmun

title: Meetings Held in DPRK
body: Officials and workers of every city, county and complex of the DPRK had meetings to vow to step up the three-revolution red flag movement as required by the great era of Kim Jong Un. Reports were made at the meetings. The reporters stressed that the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un's historic letter "Let Us Achieve a Comprehensive Development of Socialism by Kindling the Fierce Flames of the Three Revolutions" is a great practical programme and a militant banner as it clarified the clear-cut tasks and ways for bringing about fresh innovations and changes on all fronts of socialist construction by transforming all our revolutionary positions in line with the demands of the three revolutions. Basing himself on the scientific analysis and appraisal of the prevailing situation and circumstances, the General Secretary clarified the idea that fundamental turns should be effected in all realms of ideology, technology and culture under the uplifted banner of the three revolutions so as to achieve the victory of Korean-style socialism without fail, they noted. Speaking out their mind over the great programme for transforming the whole society in line with the demands of the three revolutions in the worthwhile course of ushering in the period of a new transformation in our revolution, the reporters expressed the resolution to attain the high goals for the five-year plan set forth by the 8th Party Congress by dint of the three revolutions, ideological, technical and cultural, and to bring earlier the victory of socialism. At the meetings, the objectives of the three-revolution red flag movement were announced and then oath-taking speeches were made. Speakers called on officials, Party members and other working people to bring about a great turn in the three-revolution red flag movement so as to realize as soon as possible the great aspiration and ideal of our Party to bring earlier the victory of socialism and communism. Rodong Sinmun

title: Innovations in Machine-building Industry of DPRK
body: Officials and workers in the machine-building industrial sector of the DPRK are making innovations in the production of equipment and spare parts needed for various economic sectors, true to the decisions of the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. The Ministry of Machine-building Industry set stepwise goals for producing quality machine tools, trucks, tractors, transformers, etc. before taking practical measures to attain them. Officials and workers in different machine-building bases have striven to produce ordered equipment of various kinds and spare parts. The Taean Heavy Machine Complex pushes ahead with the production of spare parts of machines to be supplied to different units including the Sunchon Cement Complex, and the Taean Electric Appliances Factory accelerates the manufacturing of electric motors needed for the major construction projects. The Ryongsong Machine Complex puts spurs to the production of compressors to be sent to the coal industrial sector while the Ryangchaek and Pyongyang bearing factories produce various sizes of bearings necessary for different economic sectors. Officials and workers at the machine tool factories, too, are exerting their strenuous efforts on producing more quality machine tools. Rodong Sinmun

title: With the People on His Mind All the Time
body: Fruit of His Painstaking Efforts Once, the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un inspected the Mirim Riding Club near completion. Wherever in the riding club he went, he expressed his satisfaction with its splendid view. Noting that a lot of construction projects were done that year, he said with pride that modern monumental edifices were built to contribute to the people’s cultural and emotional life and their wellbeing. That day, he said that he was always obsessed with the thought about what else could be done for the people who are honest, diligent and revolutionary and that construction for them had to be carried on. Indeed, the treasures growing in number in our country are precious fruits of ardent love and painstaking efforts of the respected General Secretary for the people. Officials made up their minds to actively contribute to letting the great heyday of construction continue true to the lofty intention of the respected General Secretary. The Greatest of All Prides Whenever the respected General Secretary sees things for the people, he says that they make him feel the pride of making revolution. One October day in Juche 104(2015), he visited Paekhak-dong in Sonbong area, Rason City, which had been completely recovered from the flood damage, thanks to the noble love of the Party. He asked if the newly-built dwellings were better than the former ones, if the floor heaters worked well and if water was provided sufficiently, and said he was glad that the people liked the new houses, which made him feel the pride of making revolution. Feasting his eyes on the picturesque houses built anew in the flood-stricken region, he expressed his greatest satisfaction and happiness in warm feelings. We are truly the happiest people in the world as we hold the respected General Secretary in high esteem, who devotes his life only to providing the people with joy and happiness, as our father. Rodong Sinmun

title: Premier Inspects School Things Producers in Pyongyang
body: Premier Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea and vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, inspected school things production units in Pyongyang. At the Sonamu School Things Factory, the Ryongbong School Things Factory, the Pyongyang School Things Factory and the Pyongyang Mechanical Pencil Factory, he called upon their officials and employees to fulfill their responsibility and duty in supplying quality school things to the children and pupils and students, true to the noble intention of the Party Central Committee giving top priority to the work for posterity. Learning in detail about the production of school things, he stressed the need to raise the operation rate of equipment to the maximum through meticulous technical control over the production processes, design a richer variety of school things in conformity with children's mind and steadily improve the quality of products. Discussed at the field consultative meetings were the issue of giving full play to the official's revolutionary working spirit and manner in the struggle to implement the decisions of the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee, the issue of ensuring the timely supply of raw materials and increasing the variety of school things, and the issue of strengthening the ranks of technicians and skilled workers and conducting the expansion of production capacity in a far-sighted way. Earlier, the premier inspected different units in Sunchon City including the Sunchon Engine Factory, where he took relevant measures. Rodong Sinmun

title: Movement for Winning Title of Exemplary Law-observance Unit Brisk in DPRK
body: More than 890 units across the country won the title of exemplary law-observance unit last year. Pyongyang City and North Phyongan Province take the lead in the movement for winning the title. By waging the movement along with the three-revolution red flag movement, every province (municipality) gave full play to its validity and vitality. The movement for winning the title of exemplary law-observance unit is gaining momentum as days go by. Rodong Sinmun

title: Intensive Transport of Cement Begins
body: A work for providing cities and counties with cement is now being dynamically conducted in the DPRK. The major cement producers have striven to turn out a large amount of cement necessary for local construction. All the provinces launched scrupulous operation and command for transporting cement. North Hwanghae Province acquainted itself with the cement storage capacity of relevant cities and counties and took measures for improving the conditions of roads and railways to carry a lot of cement to the spots. Jagang Province increases the operation rate of vehicles in order to transport cement to relevant cities and counties in time. Officials of South Hamgyong Province are pushing forward with the cement transport after overhauling tens of freight cars in connection with railway transport sector. Other provinces, too, are putting spurs to the work for transporting cement in time. Rodong Sinmun

title: Another New Morning Dawns on Motherland Advancing toward Future with Confidence in Sure Victory
body: Another new morning dawns on our motherland advancing toward the victory for the overall development of socialist construction. We picture to ourselves new streets which will appear before long, natural smiles of children who will be happy after receiving new school uniforms and things, people enjoying daily increasing wellbeing and new era when the local areas will change. Indeed, our people are full of confidence in sure victory as they are guided by the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un. A new hopeful morning dawns on our motherland giving our people the confidence in future and optimism. Rodong Sinmun

title: With Warm Love and Sincerity
body: On the school-starting day some years ago, among the new pupils entering Thongilgori Senior Middle School in Rangnang District, was Ri Yon Hui with sadness of losing her mother unexpectedly. On the evening of that day a woman visited her house. She was teacher Kim Myong Hui. Saying that she was to be in charge of Ri Yon Hui and the country took warm care of the children across the country, she suggested bringing up Ri to be an excellent pupil. Looking at the teacher Yon Hui’s grandmother and father were moved to tears. Since then Kim Myong Hui has been the strict teacher sometimes and other times Yon Hui’s careful mother to channel the love and affection to Ri. Thanks to her sincerity Ri Yon Hui and her family got close as if they were one family. Kim Myong Hui visited their home on holidays and birthdays annually to congratulate and add animation and vitality to them. Looking at her who spent the New Year’s Day with them, they felt keenly the warm love and affection full in the socialist society. Thanks to love and affection, happy laughter reverberates throughout the country despite any manifold hardships. Rodong Sinmun

title: New Data on Japanese Imperialists' Distortion of History Discovered
body: The historical sector of the DPRK newly discovered data disclosing the cunning and vicious crimes committed by the Japanese imperialists to distort the history of Korea. In the course of their study to scientifically prove the crimes committed by the Japanese imperialists in Korea, historians of the Academy of Social Sciences recently found out that the obit of Kojong, the 26th king of the feudal Joson dynasty, is at variance with the historical fact. According to a book published in 1927 and a diary and a book published in Japan in 1965 and 2007 respectively, the obit of Kojong was January 21, 1919. They say that Kojong was dead on this day, but it was kept secret for fear that his death would exert bad influence on the Korean people and evoke anxiety and unrest among them. The Japanese imperialists "officially" announced in a "gazette of the government-general in Korea" dated Jan. 23, 1919 that Kojong fell into a critical state by brain hemorrhage on Jan. 21 and died on Jan. 22. The Japanese imperialist's distortion of the obit of Kojong was aimed to cover up their crime of secretly poisoning Kojong, an obstacle to their colonial domination over Korea, as a death by brain hemorrhage and to pacify the anti-Japanese sentiments of the Korean people. The History Society and the Folklore Society of the DPRK held a consultative meeting and confirmed the obit of Kojong as January 21, 1919. Rodong Sinmun

title: 4th Enlarged Plenary Meeting of 7th SWUK Central Committee Held
body: The 4th Enlarged Plenary Meeting of the 7th Central Committee of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea (SWUK) took place through video conferencing on January 25. Attending it were members and alternate members of the Central Committee of the union. Officials of the Central Committee and the provincial, city and county committees of the union were present as observers. The meeting discussed the issues of thoroughly implementing the tasks for the year 2022 of the five-year plan set forth at the 8th Party Congress and the great fighting programme for the Korean-style socialist rural construction, etc. Kim Jong Sun, chairwoman of the C.C., SWUK, made a report on the agenda items. The reporter analyzed and reviewed in detail the experience and lessons drawn from the union's work in the first year for carrying out the five-year plan and referred to the measures for the union to fully display its might as an ideological and educational organization. She urged the union organizations to fulfill their responsibility and duty in this year's struggle for providing a firm guarantee for the implementation of the new five-year plan. She said that the union organizations in the agricultural field would have to make all their members do every farm work with high patriotic enthusiasm, through the effective education for equipping them with the Party's policy on agriculture. She stressed the need to turn out as one in assisting farming and do more good things helpful to boosting the material and technological foundation for the rural economy. She called for fully demonstrating the militant might of the women's union in the responsible struggle to push ahead with the overall development of Korean-style socialism and glorify this year as a year of great revolutionary auspicious events and fresh victory. Speeches were made at the meeting. The meeting made a study of the draft relevant resolutions before adopting them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Ministry of Agriculture Renamed Agricultural Commission
body: The Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK decided to rename the Ministry of Agriculture the Agricultural Commission in its decree last Friday, given its stated mission to provide the unified guidance to the agricultural production of the country. The decree obliged the Cabinet and relevant organs to take technical measures to carry out the decision. Rodong Sinmun

title: Symposium on Greatness and Exploits of Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un
body: A national symposium was held on Tuesday to deeply grasp the greatness and undying exploits of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. It was attended by Party and administrative officials, those from working people's organizations and theory information officials from armed forces organs, the fields of science, education, literature and art, media, the preservation of revolutionary relics and party cadres training institutions in Pyongyang. Presented to the symposium were papers proving in depth the immortal ideo-theoretical exploits of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un and the greatness of his leadership. The presenters were Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Kang Yun Sok, vice-chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, Han Chang Sun, president of Kim Il Sung Military University, Kim Sung Chan, president of Kim Il Sung University and minister of Higher Education of the Education Commission, Sim Sung Gon, president of the Academy of Social Sciences, and Ri Song Hak, vice-premier of the Cabinet. They said that the past ten years marked by dynamic advance under the leadership of Kim Jong Un were meaningful days when the validity and vitality of the Party's revolutionary ideas were fully demonstrated. They praised the General Secretary as a brilliant thinker-theoretician and distinguished statesman who shows the road ahead of revolution with his outstanding ideas and ushers in a new era of great changes by giving full play to the mental power of the popular masses. They explained that the era of our state-first principle is a new era of the Juche revolution resulting from the efforts of Kim Jong Un who set the people-first doctrine as a political idea of the Party and the state and made the DPRK shine as a dignified country of the people, a country of single-minded unity guided by the monolithic idea. They referred to the feats of Kim Jong Un who provided the absolute strength for reliably guaranteeing the eternal security and future of the country by leading the rapid development of the military capability for self-defence with his matchless bold pluck and seasoned guidance. The credit for a new history of changes on this land goes to the respected General Secretary who, with his excellent leadership and patriotic devotion, is wisely guiding the all-people struggle for creation in the Korean-style mode of creation, they stressed. Saying that Kim Jong Un is the kind-hearted father writing a history of dedicated service for the people, they renewed their determination to firmly defend and glorify the revolutionary idea and undying feats of the Party Central Committee and fulfill their mission and duty for absolutely defending and implementing the Party's idea and line in the grandiose struggle toward fresh victory of our-style socialism. Rodong Sinmun

title: Nothing Is Out of Our Reach If We Have Strong Confidence
body: Truth He Taught during Trial Trip One November night in Juche 104(2015), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un attended the trial run of the new-made subway train. About a month earlier, he had inspected the subway train newly made by the Kim Jong Thae Electric Locomotive Complex and had promised to take part in its trial run. To keep his word, he went to the site of trial run late at night. When he visited the complex on the meaningful day of October, he said with pride that he had asked it to make the subway train of our style by itself because he had wanted to prove to those with proclivity to import through action, not through wordy explanation, the truth that things of our own making are the most valuable and precious. During the midnight trial trip in November, he emphasized that everything we need must be made by our efforts and technology and with our own resources and that all the Party members and other working people must be implanted with the faith of regarding their own things and self-reliance as the best. The trial trip of the respected General Secretary that day was no more than a meaningful lecture that taught the immovable faith that self-reliance is the best. Key to Performing Miracles In November some years ago, the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited a factory and taught its officials the main key to production growth and performing miracles. He highly appreciated that the factory had built bases of ideological education to be of educational significance and was running them regularly without fail and effectively conducting the educational work among its officials and employees to deeply implant the undying leadership exploits of the WPK in their hearts. He continued that, as he always stressed, the main key to production growth and performing miracles hinged on the people's ideas and spirits and that it was of utmost importance to intensify ideological education. He went on saying that the factory's Party organization had to keep making efforts to arm its workers with the Party's revolutionary idea with the main emphasis placed on education in greatness of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, thereby training its officials, Party members and other working people to be fighters who, with firm faith and will in any adversity, stand in the van of upholding the Party's line of building an economic power. Listening to the respected General Secretary, the officials of the factory keenly realized that the people's ideas and spirits decide the success or failure in production and construction and that efforts must be directed preferentially to the ideological education of employees in order to brave difficulties and perform miracles. Rodong Sinmun

title: First Triplets Born in Pyongyang Maternity Hospital This Year
body: On January 14, the first triplets of this year were born in the Pyongyang Maternity Hospital. They are recorded as the 523rd triplets in the Pyongyang Maternity Hospital. Their mother Choe Jong Sim is an ordinary worker's wife. Choe from Unhung County, Ryanggang Province was sent to this hospital last October and received medical treatment under the intensive care of the medical service team there. She is still being treated with tonics good for health and is receiving medical service, thanks to our Party's loving care for women in childbed. She has been in hospital being regularly provided with various nutritious food and tonics, such as honey, for several months. Medical workers of the hospital had 10-odd times of consultations for improvement of her health to take immediate measures and provided Koryo medicines good for producing blood treatment with their sincerity. Thanks to their devotion, Choe was fortunate in her confinement on the 14th of January. The triplets' average weight is 1.9 kg. Presently they are in good state of health. They are about to be raised in the hospital until they weigh 4 kg under the care of our state. While the tales on our Party's noble love for posterity are brought into full bloom in succession, the news announcing the birth of these triplets bolsters our people's confidence and optimism for brighter future as well as endless gratitude to our Party. Rodong Sinmun

title: Ri Yong Mu Passes Away
body: An obituary of winner of Kim Il Sung Order and Kim Jong Il Order and DPRK Hero Ri Yong Mu, an adviser of the former Ministry of the People's Armed Forces and the Central Land Rezoning Headquarters, was issued by the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea Thursday. He died of acute myocardial infarction at 08:40 Thursday at the age of 97. He was a revolutionary soldier loyal to President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and a veteran revolutionary who lived a worthwhile life under the great trust and care of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, the obituary said, and went on: Born into a poor peasant family during the Japanese imperialists' colonial rule, he lived a bitter life as a member of the stateless nation in an alien land with his parents. After the liberation of Korea, he became a competent military and political official of the revolutionary army under the care of the President. He devoted his all to the sacred cause for the victorious advance of the Juche revolution with intense loyalty to the party and the leaders. He worked as a military and political official at units at all levels of the People's Army ranging from a deputy battalion commander for political affairs to the chief of the political department of a division and a divisional commander. In the period of laying the Party's foundation for carrying forward the cause of Juche, he consecutively worked as deputy director and concurrently director of organizational department of the General Political Bureau of the Korean People's Army and also its first deputy director and director, performing distinguished feats in thoroughly establishing the monolithic command system of the leader across the entire army and implementing the Juche-based army building idea and line. Working at major state institutions including the State Inspection Commission, the Ministry of Public Security and the Traffic Commission, he actively contributed to the steady advance of our-style socialist cause, true to the idea and leadership of the President and the Chairman. Especially for nearly 20 years he had displayed high responsibility and leadership ability at an important post of the vice-chairman of the National Defence Commission, performing considerable feats in carrying out the grand plan of the Chairman to transform the land of the country as befitting that of socialist Korea. In the period of the new succession of the revolutionary cause of Juche, he remained loyal to his responsibility and duty as a veteran revolutionary in holding in high esteem Kim Jong Un as the only center of the leadership and unity and reliably carrying forward the revolutionary idea and cause of the great leaders. Though he passed away, the feats he performed with total dedication to the Party and the revolution will be remembered long by our people and the officers and men of the People's Army. Rodong Sinmun

title: Academy of Defence Science Conducts Important Weapons Tests
body: The Academy of Defence Science of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea conducted the test-fire for updating long-range cruise missile system and the test-fire for confirming the power of conventional warhead of surface-to-surface tactical guided missile on Tuesday and Thursday respectively. Officials of the Department of the Munitions Industry of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and leading officials of the Academy of Defence Science guided the important weapon tests in field. In the test-fire for updating the long-range cruise missile system conducted on Tuesday, two long-range cruise missiles flew for 9 137s along the flight trajectory over the East Sea of Korea to hit the target island 1 800 km away. The practical combat performance of the long-range cruise missile system would hold a reliable share in boosting the war deterrence of the country. In the test-fire for confirming the power of conventional warhead of surface-to-surface tactical guided missile conducted on Thursday, two tactical guided missiles precisely hit the target island, proving that the explosive power of the conventional warhead complied with the design requirements. The Academy of Defence Science clarified that the missile warhead institute under it will keep developing powerful warheads capable of performing combat function and mission. The results of the successful test-fires of the weapon systems were reported to the WPK Central Committee to be highly appreciated. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Inspects Site Set for Building Ryonpho Vegetable Greenhouse Farm
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected a site in Ryonpho area of Hamju County, South Hamgyong Province set for building a large-scale vegetable greenhouse farm. He was accompanied by Jo Yong Won, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretary for Organizational Affairs of the WPK Central Committee, and Pak Jong Chon, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretary of the WPK Central Committee. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un was greeted on the spot by officials of a relevant department of the Party Central Committee and design institution and commanding officers of the units of the People's Army to be involved in the construction. A preparation for the building of the large-scale vegetable greenhouse farm in Ryonpho-ri area of Hamju County, South Hamgyong Province has already been pushed forward according to the far-sighted plan of the WPK which struggles, setting it as the supreme principle of its activities to promote the wellbeing of the people. Personally making field survey in April 2019, Kim Jong Un matured his plan to build in Ryonpho area a modern greenhouse farm bigger than the greenhouse farm built in Jungphyong area of Kyongsong County, North Hamgyong Province to contribute to the improvement of the diet of the people in South Hamgyong Province. He gave important teachings related with the construction of the Ryonpho area large-scale vegetable greenhouse farm several times and has guided the designing. The 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee set the construction of the Ryonpho Vegetable Greenhouse Farm as a top-priority task of the major state construction policy tasks for the year 2022 and decided to complete it by the founding anniversary of the Party this year before assigning duties. On the spot, Kim Jong Un was first briefed on the master plan for construction of the Ryonpho Vegetable Greenhouse Farm. Noting that the greenhouse farm to be built in Ryonpho area this time is a project huger than the greenhouse farm built in Jungphyong area of Kyongsong County, North Hamgyong Province a few years ago in terms of size and volume of construction, he said that when the 100-hectare greenhouse and district of farm dwelling houses are built in Ryonpho area, the area will undergo tremendous changes and be of a great help to the diet of the people in Hamhung City and other areas of South Hamgyong Province. Saying he was determined to assign the construction of a new large-scale greenhouse farm again to the units of the People's Army that have already accumulated a lot of experience in building greenhouse farms, he stressed that service personnel of the relevant units should remain faithful to their noble mission befitting the absolute executors of the Party's plan and policy and the creators of the people's happiness and wage an all-out campaign of loyalty to realize the cherished desire of our Party as soon as possible. All the merits and demerits of the Jungphyong Vegetable Greenhouse Farm should be considered in the design layout of the greenhouse farm to be built this time to further develop sci-tech aspects and operational aspect, he said, calling for markedly raising the modernization level of over 850 greenhouses covering 100 hectares. He stressed the need to give precedence to windbreak forest formation along the edge of the greenhouse farm to suit the characteristics of the coastal area. Diversity in designing residential blocks and shapes of houses on the farm should be applied in a peculiar way, he added. He specified the issues arising in the construction of the greenhouse farm ranging from the formation of a powerful construction headquarters for pushing forward the construction, organization of sector-specific panels, perfect designs on the highest level, priority to the provision of building materials and manufacturing of greenhouse equipment, strengthening of construction guidance and supervision to responsible windbreak forest creation and greening. He also called for selecting and training technicians and employees for the operation of the greenhouse farm from the next year and pushing forward the provision of vegetable seeds and farm implements and farming materials so as to most perfectly build the farm to be one making tangible contribution to the diet of the people as early as possible and model and standard one for the Party's policy on greenhouse farm construction. With the great expectation and trust of the respected General Secretary, all the builders hardened their pledge to successfully complete the vegetable greenhouse farm on the world level through miracles, within the date and standard set by the Party, true to the intention of the General Secretary working heart and soul to bring about substantial achievements and changes awaited and welcomed by the people. Political News Team

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Inspects Munitions Factory
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected a munitions factory producing a major weapon system. He was accompanied by Jo Yong Won, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretary for Organizational Affairs of the WPK Central Committee, Kim Jong Sik and Kim Yo Jong, vice department directors of the WPK Central Committee, and leading officials in the sector of the Academy of Defence Science. Looking round the room for education in the revolutionary history and various worksites of the factory, the respected General Secretary learned in detail about the recent technical updating and modernization of production processes done by the factory and its current production from leading officials of the factory. He highly appreciated the factory for arming itself fully with the idea of the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee and effecting collective innovation and leaping progress in producing major weapons to implement the Party's decisions. Saying that the factory holds a very important position and duty in modernizing the country's armed forces and realizing the national defence development strategy, he indicated the tasks and ways for steadily developing it into an icon factory symbolic of modernity of the country's defence industry. He ardently appealed to the workers, technicians, officials and military inspectors of the factory to turn out as one in an all-out drive for thoroughly implementing the munitions policies set forth at the 8th Party Congress by carrying forward the traditions and history of our proud defence industry which has safeguarded the Party and the revolution with munitions production, bearing in their minds the single intention to defend the revolutionary cause of the Party with powerful cutting-edge arms. All the officials and workers of the factory hardened their pledge to fulfill the honorable mission and duty of being soldiers of the defence industry faithful to the Party who reliably defend the security of the state, cherishing the unwavering will of the respected General Secretary who smashes with his bold pluck the challenges of the U.S. imperialists and their vassal forces trying to violate in every direction our Republic's right to self-defence dearer than life and dedicates his devotion and zeal to the path of the development of the Juche-oriented defence industry for providing a shortcut to the greatest military power in the harshest-ever adversity. Political News Team

title: 4th Enlarged Plenary Meeting of 8th Central Committee of GFTUK Held
body: The 4th Enlarged Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea (GFTUK) was held through video-conferencing on January 26. Attending it were members and alternate members of the GFTUK Central Committee. Officials of the Central Committee and provincial, city and county committees of the GFTUK were present as observers. The meeting discussed the issues of thoroughly implementing the tasks for the year 2022 of the five-year plan set forth at the 8th Party Congress and the great fighting programme for the Korean-style socialist rural construction, etc. Pak In Chol, chairman of the GFTUK Central Committee, made a report on agenda items. The reporter analyzed and reviewed in detail the successes, experience and lessons drawn from the work of the first year for implementing the decisions of the 8th Party Congress and referred to the ways for decisively improving and intensifying the work of the trade unions as required by the developing reality. He said that the trade union organizations at all levels would have to help all their members perform steady miracles and feats in the ongoing struggle for fresh victory in socialist construction by conducting various effective mass movements that contribute to providing a firm guarantee for the implementation of the five-year plan and bringing about a clear change in the development of the state and the improvement of the people's living standard. He called for establishing the socialist lifestyle, further intensifying the campaign against anti- and non-socialist practices and accepting it as a duty proper to a citizen and vital demand to strictly observe the epidemic prevention rules and orders and making it part of life and habit. He urged the trade union officials and members to positively contribute to bringing about great and innovative changes every year under the programme for rural construction by grappling with the work to implement the Party's policy on the socialist rural construction in a revolutionary way. He stressed the need to glorify their honor of being the eldest sons of the country and the vanguard in the all-people general advance for bringing about the overall development of Korean-style socialism with confidence in victory under the invincible guidance of the great Party. Speeches were made at the meeting. The meeting adopted relevant resolutions after studying draft resolutions. Rodong Sinmun

title: 5th Enlarged Plenary Meeting of 10th SPYL Central Committee Held
body: The 5th Enlarged Plenary Meeting of the 10th Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League (SPYL) took place through video conferencing on January 26. Attending it were members and alternate members of the Central Committee of the youth league. Officials of the Central Committee of the youth league and those of the league committees in ministries, national institutions, provinces, cities and counties were present as observers. The meeting discussed as its main agenda items the issues of thoroughly implementing the tasks for the year 2022 of the five-year plan set forth at the 8th Party Congress and the great fighting programme for the Korean-style socialist rural construction, etc. Mun Chol, chairman of the SPYL Central Committee, made a report on the agenda items. The reporter noted that the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee highly praised the youths, saying it is a remarkable political success that they have been in high spirits, as evidenced by such facts that many of them volunteered to work in difficult and labor-consuming fields and did good deeds touching the people's hearts. He analyzed in detail the experience and lessons drawn from the youth league organizations' work for carrying out the important tasks set forth at the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea and plenary meetings of the Party Central Committee and referred to the tasks for glorifying this year as a year of great revolutionary auspicious events and great victory. He said that the league organizations should prepare the youths politically, ideologically and culturally and train them to be masters of socialist rural communities with profound scientific and technological knowledge through the unique and effective work for stepping up the three revolutions－ideological, technological and cultural. He called on all the youths to fulfill their mission and duty as an advancing group and wing of the Party in the struggle to thoroughly implement the tasks for the year 2022 of the five-year plan set forth at the 8th Party Congress and the great fighting programme for the Korean-style socialist rural construction by redoubling their efforts with confidence in victory. Speeches were made at the meeting. The meeting made a study of the draft relevant resolutions before adopting them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Researches Conducive to Sports Development
body: Officials and scientists of the Academy of Sports Science in the DPRK are striving to obtain good research findings conducive to putting sports on a scientific basis. They have explored and introduced the scientific training means and methods through discussion after learning and analyzing the real state of sports teams and training grounds. The Sports Science Institute completed on a high level the system of rating players' ability in events. And it is designing new measuring instruments helpful to putting the teaching and training on a scientific basis. The Sports Medicine Institute conducts the research on making clear the training burden of athletes and maintaining the peak form condition. The Sports Nutrient Research Institute expedites the researches on reasonable nutrition management and health food development for raising players' physical capacity to the maximum, including the issue of developing a nutritive substance conducive to improving the anaerobic exercise capacity and muscle strength. The Athletic Apparatus Institute deepens its study for producing Korean-style training apparatuses in connection with the associations of sporting events. The Sports Science Library concentrates its efforts on timely disseminating among the players the latest sports scientific research successes, improving the sports science information system and compiling data quickly and accurately and comprehensively systematizing them. Rodong Sinmun

title: A Small But Big Factory
body: The Pyongyang Dental Material Factory, with fewer employees than others, is not so big in size, but its employees are in high spirit to glorify this year with increased production. In the past, the factory produced dental materials of ten-odd kinds to send to units for the medical treatment and prevention by waging the powerful struggle for localizing raw and other materials, and was highly appraised at the national exhibition of scientific and technological achievements in public health. Its research group successively made sci-tech achievements conducive to realizing the localization of necessary dental materials and thus made a big stride in the work for implementing the last instructions of President Kim Il Sung to replace missing teeth for a million of people every year. An official of the factory said that it was the steadfast determination of its employees to turn the factory into one well-known to the people, like the officials and employees of various units in public health who gave pleasure to the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un. The factory’s officials and employees, who have turned out as one to implement the decisions set forth at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea, make strenuous efforts on the basis of setting a goal to further improve the quality of dental materials. Rodong Sinmun

title: As We Held President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in High Esteem
body: Time flows with the people’s boundless reverence and ardent yearning for President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in our country. Our people have never thought of the country and their life without the President and Chairman. All our people unanimously say from their hearts that we could enjoy dignified and happy life today as we held the President and the Chairman in high esteem. The Day of the Sun (birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung) and the Day of the Shining Star(birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il) are the nation’s greatest and most auspicious holidays and the greatest honor and pride for our people. For our people, who carry forward the revolutionary cause of the President and the Chairman under the banner of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, there are no holidays more significant than the Day of the Sun and the Day of the Shining Star. Besides, the very existence of our dignified Party and state is unthinkable apart from the undying exploits of the President and Chairman recorded in the glorious course of the Korean revolution. As we held the President and Chairman in high esteem, our country could reach the apex of the victory and honor and our people could demonstrate to the world the dignity and might of the most powerful and heroic people. Now our people are taking greater steps forward with a single burning desire to live and fight as befits the descendants of the President and the soldiers and followers of the Chairman. Rosy is our future and all the dreams and ideals will come true under the wise leadership of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Visits Bier of Ri Yong Mu
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, visited the bier of winner of Kim Il Sung Order and Kim Jong Il Order and DPRK Hero Ri Yong Mu, an advisor of the former Ministry of the People's Armed Forces and an advisor of the Central Land Rezoning Headquarters, on Friday to express deep condolences over his death. He was accompanied by Jo Yong Won, Kim Tok Hun and Pak Jong Chon, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the Party Central Committee, Ri Yong Gil, minister of National Defence, and Kwon Yong Jin, director of the General Political Bureau of the Korean People's Army. Amid the playing of dirge, the hall was wrapped in bitter sorrow over the loss of a revolutionary soldier loyal to President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and a veteran revolutionary who contributed to giving steady continuity to the revolutionary idea and the cause of our Party. A wreath in the name of Kim Jong Un was laid before the bier of the deceased. Kim Jong Un paid a silent tribute to the memory of Ri Yong Mu who made a distinguished contribution to thoroughly establishing the Party's monolithic command system in the People's Army and implementing the Juche-based army building idea and line and devoted his all to the sacred struggle for the victorious advance of our-style socialist cause. With bitter grief over the loss of a precious revolutionary comrade, who had dedicated himself to the development of our Party, state and revolutionary armed forces till the last moment of his life with boundless loyalty and the spirit of devoted service for the country and the people, Kim Jong Un went round the bier of Ri Yong Mu. He expressed his deep sympathy with the family of the deceased and warmly consoled them. Political News Team

title: Winter Pruning Brisk in DPRK
body: Winter pruning is brisk at fruit farms across the DPRK. Last year many fruit farms in the country increased the per-hectare yield through proper manuring and tending. Fruit farms in Kwail County of South Hwanghae Province let their workers learn their good experience. By concentrating manpower, they register high results in pruning. Pruning also gets brisk on the farms in Pukchong County of South Hamgyong Province. Other fruit farms carry out the daily pruning plans without fail. Rodong Sinmun

title: Family of Capital Citizen Volunteers to Work in Northernmost City of DPRK
body: Now that many people in the DPRK volunteer to work in the difficult and labor-consuming fields in hearty response to the call of the Workers' Party of Korea, a family living in Mangyongdae District, the capital city of Pyongyang, has volunteered to work in northernmost Samjiyon City. It is the family of Song Myong Sim, a teacher of the Sunhwagang Senior Middle School in Mangyongdae District. Mangyongdae District is the land of glory where the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung is located. Song Myong Sim, born in the district, has taken care of the Mangyongdae Revolutionary Site since she joined the children's union. It was her daily routine to clean the site with her sister every morning. In this course, she realized that it is the bounden duty of the younger generation to staunchly carry forward the lineage of Mangyongdae, the lineage of Paektu. Last August the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un highly praised the young people who volunteered to work in difficult and labor-consuming fields, met those who started with a clean slate and wished them a happy future. Inspired by the news, Song decided to work as an educator in Samjiyon City overlooking Mt Paektu and add luster to the glorious revolutionary traditions of our Party. Her sister, a worker of the Taehung Trading Guidance Bureau, too, volunteered to work at the Management Office for Revolutionary Battle Sites in the Secret Camp of Mt Paektu with a single mind to leave a trace of her life in the sacred land of revolution. Their parents Song Man Chol and Kim Jong Ok supported the determination of their two daughters and decided to go with them with a mind to help them invariably take the road of loyalty and patriotism. Rodong Sinmun

title: Choe Ryong Hae Inspects Kwangchon Chicken Farm under Construction
body: Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, inspected the Kwangchon Chicken Farm under construction. Making a round of the construction site, he called on the officials and builders to successfully build the farm, which will hold an important share in improving the people's livelihood, into a model and standard one in the country's poultry field, true to the idea and spirit of the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee. He underscored the need to focus on ideological and political dimensions in construction, as constantly emphasized by the Party, and make the farm look like a green park suited to the topographical characteristics. The field consultative meeting discussed the issues of ensuring perfect building so as to meet the high demand of the Party, giving priority to quality in manufacturing the equipment for the farm and making full advance preparations for its operation. Rodong Sinmun

title: Preparations for Local Construction Make Headway
body: Every province is pushing ahead with the preparations for local construction in hearty response to the task set forth at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea to open an era when the local areas will change by effecting a new construction revolution for fundamentally changing the living environments of the people. In particular, North Phyongan Province, which made signal progress in the construction of dwelling houses last year, has a great deal of enthusiasm. On the basis of setting high goals including building lots of dwelling houses in its Sinuiju City, the province propels the work for strengthening its construction forces. In South Hwanghae Province, the work to map out miniatures of dwelling houses to be built in various cities and counties is being conducted day and night by mobilizing all its city designing forces. And the province directs efforts to the preparations for opening the exhibition of construction setups and tools. South Hamgyong Province dispatched relevant officials and dozens of designers to cities and counties to confirm the building sites and substantially pushes forward the work for completing the designs of dwelling houses in cooperation with national designing group. The province pays efforts to establishing the process of producing tiles for inner walls. Besides, the other provinces also put spurs to such preparations for launching the local construction in a big way as strengthening the force of technological supervisors, activating the building material production bases and developing the finishing building materials in keeping with local specific character. Rodong Sinmun

title: Warmhearted Mother’s Voice
body: Devote Sincerity The historic conclusion, which was made by the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un at the 4th Conference of Cell Secretaries of the Workers’ Party of Korea held in January Juche 102(2013), touches heartstrings of all the people even now. Earnestly saying that the WPK is the genuine motherly Party which embraces our people with love and sincerity, irrespective of affected and wounded sons and daughters, at the conference, he instructed that it is the steadfast determination to uphold our people and devote everything to them as we would do the great leaders. And then, for moving the hearts of the people, the cell secretaries should devote their sincerity to the people like a mother who puts big efforts into bringing up her children, he said. Indeed, his instruction was warm voice of the motherly Party which takes responsibility for the people’s destinies and futures. Therefore, our people ardently have a heart-to-heart talk with each other that they cannot live even a moment apart from the bosom of the Party. A Grain of Sand and a Big Mountain It was one September day in Juche 104(2015) a few days after the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un had looked around the general service ship Mujigae. At that time, he said to officials that the ship was fantastic and he felt the pride of carrying on revolution while seeing the valuable treasures on increase which make the people enjoy the civilized and happy life. Adding that the ship was like a grain of sand in the light of works that must be done by us for the people, he stressed that we should make a big mountain with grains of sand. Bearing deep in mind his instructions, the officials keenly felt that even if the grains of sand form a big mountain and become giant mountains reaching the sky, he will endlessly unfold the grand blueprints for the people. It Is Good Thing If People Like It One January day in Juche 104(2015), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited a foodstuff factory. Making rounds of various production processes from where the foodstuffs flew out in rows, he dropped in at one place. Watching with satisfaction the foodstuffs, he said with a broad smile that he was glad if the people liked all those foodstuffs and the criterion of all evaluations was the people’s assessment. It is a good thing if the people like it! The criterion of all evaluations is the people’s assessment. Like this, he always thinks of the people before anything. Therefore, wherever he goes and whatever he sees, he habitually asks officials if the people like it, if the people can enjoy substantial benefit from them and if there is any slightest inconvenience to the people. Those questions tell what the criterion of endless thinking and practice of the respected General Secretary who makes ceaseless journey of devotion for the good of the people is. Rodong Sinmun

title: 19th Plenum of 14th SPA Standing Committee of DPRK Held
body: The 19th Plenary Meeting of the 14th Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly (SPA) of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) was held at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Jan. 28. Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and chairman of the SPA Standing Committee, presided over the plenary meeting. It was attended by Kang Yun Sok and Pak Yong Il, vice-chairmen of the SPA Standing Committee, its Secretary General Ko Kil Son and members of the SPA Standing Committee. Present there as observers were officials concerned of the SPA Standing Committee, the Secretariat of the Cabinet, ministries and national institutions. Placed on the agenda were the issue of adopting the DPRK law on supplying cement to cities and counties, the issue of modifying and supplementing the law on national flag and the law on trade, and the issue of recalling and electing to fill vacancies judges of the Central Court of the DPRK. Then a report was made on the gist of the relevant laws and the draft amendments examined at the SPA Legislation Committee. The law on supplying cement to cities and counties specifies the issues arising in working out a cement supply plan, establishing a robust production, supply and use system and strengthening the scientific research and quality control for raising the quality of cement, as required by the Party and state policy aimed to promote the independent and many-sided development of cities and counties and bring about the cultural development peculiar to the countryside. The law on national flag deals with the use of national flag and its hoisting ceremony in further detail. Paragraphs were added to the law on trade. They deal with the issues of expanding and developing all trade activities in the direction to promote the independent development of the national economy and of further tightening the centralized, unified guidance and control over trade. The plenary meeting studied and examined the presented draft laws and adopted the decrees of the SPA Standing Committee "On adopting the DPRK law on supplying cement to the construction of cities and counties", "On modifying and supplementing the DPRK law on national flag" and "On modifying and supplementing the DPRK law on trade". The plenary meeting recalled and elected to fill vacancies judges of the Central Court of the DPRK. Rodong Sinmun

title: 9th Congress of UAWK Held
body: The 9th Congress of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea (UAWK) was held here on Thursday and Friday. The congress comprehensively analyzed and reviewed in depth the work of the union during the period under review and discussed and decided the tasks and ways for the union to fully demonstrate its might as a mass-based political organization in thoroughly implementing the decisions made at the historic 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea and the Party's new programme for rural construction. Attending the congress were delegates elected by the union organizations at all levels. Present there as observers were officials of the Party, administrative and armed forces organs. The platform was taken by Ri Il Hwan, member of the Political Bureau and secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), Ri Tu Song, department director of the Central Committee of the WPK, executive members of the Central Committee of the UAWK, chairpersons of the provincial union committees, exemplary officials of the union organizations, functionaries of union primary organizations and officials of the relevant field. The congress approved the following agenda items: 1. Review of the work of the Central Committee of the UAWK 2. Review of the work of the Central Inspection Commission of the UAWK 3. On revising the rules of the UAWK 4. Election of the central leadership organ of the UAWK At the congress, Ri Il Hwan read out "Let the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea Become the Vanguard in the Struggle for Achieving Our Style of Socialist Rural Development", the important letter sent by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, to the participants in the 9th UAWK Congress. Kim Jong Un in his letter referred to the important significance of the 9th UAWK Congress, warmly congratulated the participants on behalf of the Central Committee of the Party and warmly encouraged all the agricultural workers and members of the union across the country who turned out in this year's farming with high resolution and determination. Kim Jong Un highly praised the agricultural workers as faithful and patriotic workers who have firmly defended the revolutionary position in the countryside and safeguarded the Party and revolution with grain production while always sharing their intention and destiny with the Party and socialism. Saying that the goal of socialist rural construction reflects the intention of the Party to make the agricultural workers enter the communist society before others by training them to be rural revolutionaries in a new era and turning all the local areas across the country into a paradise to be envied by the world, he set forth the tasks and ways for the union to implement the programme for the socialist rural construction. Only when all the union organizations across the country share thought with the Party and breathe the same air with it, proud and ground-breaking achievements will be made, he said, expressing great expectation that all the organizations and members of the union would creditably fulfill their honorable mission and duty before the times and revolution and thus positively contribute to ushering in a new great era of socialist rural development. Han Jong Hyok, chairman of the UAWK Central Committee, made a report on the first agenda item. The reporter noted that Kim Jong Un led the union to fulfill its responsibility and duty in the campaign for implementing the ideas of the Party and upholding its policies with his outstanding guidance and great loving care and trust during the period under review. He referred to the fact that during the period under review members of the union fully displayed the fighting spirit of devotedly defending the leader and implementing the Party's policies unto death as the UAWK Central Committee conducted the work for holding President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in high esteem forever and remaining faithful to the idea and leadership of Kim Jong Un, keeping up it as its main task. He said that the union organizations launched on an extensive scale the campaigns in which one overtakes and learns from others and swaps experiences with each other and, as a result, the peak-year level of grain production was surpassed despite the bad weather conditions, a lot of units and farmers reaped a good harvest, units which won the Lathe No. 26 Model Machine Prize in the flames of the mass movement were increased and new multi-purpose farming machines and tools of Korean style were developed and introduced to propel the rural technical revolution. He called upon the union to usher in a new great era of socialist rural development by dynamically conducting three revolutions-ideological, technological and cultural- under the slogan "For a Fresh Victory in Socialist Rural Construction!" set forth at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee. He cited facts to analyze and review the mistakes revealed in the period under review and their causes. He stressed the need for the union to fully discharge its mission and role in remaining faithful to the intention of the Party which set it as a major urgent task in settling the rural question to steadily increase the country's agricultural production. He called on the UAWK committees in Pyongyang and provinces, cities and counties to vigorously conduct mass movements and socialist emulations for creating and generalizing new models and exemplary units in the agricultural field to meet the need of the developing times. He ardently appealed to all to work hard for the new victory of the socialist cause, stressing that only victory and glory will be in store for the agricultural workers and members of the union whatever hardships as long as there is Kim Jong Un. Speeches on the first agenda item were made at the congress. The congress heard a report on the second agenda item "Review of the work of the Central Inspection Commission of the UAWK" which was followed by speeches. A resolution was adopted with unanimous approval. Then the congress discussed the third agenda item "On revising the rules of the UAWK". There was a report on the revised rules of the UAWK that had been modified and supplemented, and a resolution was adopted with the unanimous approval of the delegates. The congress discussed the fourth agenda item "Election of the central leadership organ of the UAWK". It elected the Central Committee of the UAWK. All the nominees were elected members and alternate members of the Central Committee of the UAWK with the unanimous approval of the delegates. Then there was the first plenary meeting of the 9th Central Committee of the UAWK. The Executive Committee of the UAWK Central Committee was elected. Han Jong Hyok was elected chairman of the Central Committee of the UAWK and Yun Chol, Ri Yong Chol and Kil Sang Bong were elected vice-chairmen. The Organizing Committee of the Central Committee of the UAWK was formed. The chairman, vice-chairmen and members of the Central Inspection Commission of the UAWK were elected. Department directors of the Central Committee of the UAWK and the editor-in-chief of the organ of the Central Committee of the UAWK were appointed. The congress elected the committee for drafting the resolution of the congress with newly-elected members of the 9th central leadership organ of the UAWK, and the committee comprehensively examined the draft resolution on the first agenda item. A resolution on the first agenda item which had been supplemented with the creative and constructive opinions of the delegates was adopted with unanimous approval. Rodong Sinmun

title: Let the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea Become Vanguard in the Struggle for Achieving Our Style of Socialist Rural Development
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un sent a letter "Let the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea Become Vanguard in the Struggle for Achieving Our Style of Socialist Rural Development" to those attending the Ninth Congress of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea on January 27. The full text of the letter is as follows: The Ninth Congress of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea has opened when the struggle for achieving the prosperity and development of our state and the wellbeing of the people has entered a period of fresh upsurge and a great new era is being opened for our style of socialist rural development in line with the strategic policy advanced by the Fourth Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea. This congress will reaffirm the position and tasks of the UAWK in implementing the historic cause of the rural revolution, rural rejuvenation, in the new era and set up an important milestone in enlisting the UAWK members and other agricultural workers across the country to a new struggle for achieving progress and transformation in our socialist countryside. In the name of the Party Central Committee, I extend warm congratulations to the congress in the hope that, in line with the Party’s intention to achieve a comprehensive development of socialist construction by powerfully promoting the radical development of our socialist countryside and with the soaring revolutionary spirit and enthusiasm of UAWK members and all other agricultural workers, it will prove a turning point in readjusting the union’s work and bringing about a turn in it. I also extend warm and militant greetings to all other UAWK members and agricultural workers across the country, who have launched into this year’s farming with a firm determination to hit without fail the socialist rural construction goal set by the Party. Our agricultural workers are faithful and patriotic people, who have firmly defended the rural position of our revolution and defended the Party and the revolution through rice production while always sharing the intentions with the Party and throwing in their lot with socialism. In the victorious struggling course, through which our Party and people ushered in a new heyday of strengthening the national strength in the face of unprecedented trials, the agricultural workers accepted the Party’s concern and the country’s difficulties as their own pains and worked heart and soul in the major thrust area in socialist construction, thus achieving the proud success of increasing agricultural production almost every year. Last year everything was in shorter supply than ever before owing to the protracted emergency epidemic prevention work, and disastrous abnormal weather conditions persisted, but in these unfavourable circumstances UAWK members and other agricultural workers farmed tenaciously with the belief that they could fully increase agricultural production if they did as the Party instructed them, proving in practice once again the justness of our Party’s agricultural policy and greatly inspiring and encouraging other people across the country, who turned out in the efforts for implementing the decisions of the Eighth Party Congress.
