body: Hundreds of young people in South Hwanghae, North Hamgyong, North Hwanghae and Ryanggang provinces of the DPRK volunteered to work at major worksites for socialist construction with a single mind to perform labor feats and set good examples in the van of the sacred struggle for the prosperity and development of the country in hearty response to the appeal of the great Party Central Committee. More than 310 young people in South Hwanghae Province volunteered to work in the socialist countryside with the determination to live up to the great love and trust of the Party Central Committee greatly valuing the youth. More than 200 youths in North Hamgyong Province vowed to work in the field of metallurgical industry and at coal mines and farms. Many young people in North Hwanghae and Ryanggang provinces volunteered to work in different sectors of national economy, including the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex and socialist cooperative farms. Meetings took place to congratulate the young volunteers. Volunteer certificates were awarded to them in the meetings. Then, art performances were given for them. Officials and young people in those provinces warmly sent the volunteers off, presenting them bunches of flowers. Rodong Sinmun

title: New Poster for People's Art Festival Produced
body: A poster has been produced for the first people's art festival to be held to celebrate the Day of the Shining Star, the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Depicted at the upper part of the poster is the grandiose appearance of snow-capped Jong Il Peak in the historic sacred place where the Chairman was born as the Shining Star of Mt Paektu. Seen at the middle part is the music of the popular ode "Shine, Jong Il Peak" with the emblem of the festival. The lower part has letters reading "The First People's Art Festival for Celebrating the Day of the Shining Star" with the festival period. Rodong Sinmun

title: Way to Front and Way to Camps
body: One April day in Juche 103(2014), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited the Songdowon International Children’s Camp near completion. He dropped in at the camp on the way to the front for seeing soldiers of the Korean People’s Army. When he saw the slogan "We Are Happiest in the World!" put up in the compound, he said that it is our Party’s determination and will to make our children and people lead a happy life with nothing to envy in the world and their happy laughter and hurrah for the Workers’ Party resound far and wide. Going round the buildings and facilities of the camp, the respected General Secretary said that the Songdowon International Children’s Camp is the splendid establishment reflecting our Party’s noble outlook on rising generations and that the camp is the only children’s hotel and palace in the world, expressing his great satisfaction. Then he said with a broad smile that he felt pride of his labor when he pictured himself the day when happy laughter of our children would fill the camp. The respected General Secretary spent his precious time to look round the camp for making our children’ s happy laughter and songs resound far and wide at the camp. After a long while, he took the road to the front again, failing to recover his fatigue. Indeed, his way to the front and the camping of children that day reflected the noble love of the respected General Secretary who devotes his all to our rising generations and future of our revolution. Rodong Sinmun

title: People across DPRK Celebrate Lunar New Year's Day
body: All the people of the country meaningfully greeted Lunar New Year's Day, Juche 111 (2022), full of confidence and optimism. The people who visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun recollected the sacred revolutionary careers and exploits of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, who built a genuine country of the people, a single-mindedly united country, on this land and laid ever-lasting foundation for making the country prosperous. People including service personnel laid floral baskets and flowers at the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill before making a deep bow. The streets of the capital and other parts of the country were in a festive mood and laughter of happiness was heard from every flat and the songs "We Are the Happiest in the World" and "Pyongyang Is Best" resounded throughout the country. Colorful performances took place at theatres in Pyongyang and provinces. The drama "Devoted Service" given at the National Theatre, circus performance at the Pyongyang Circus Theater and magic performance at the magic theater of the National Acrobatic Troupe added to the joy and delight of the capital citizens. Artistes who gave performances in every province also highly sang of the great pride and self-confidence of living in a powerful country that is winning a series of victories under the leadership of the great Party. Public catering establishments across the country pleased the people with kind service. Rodong Sinmun

title: Diplomatic Corps and Military Attaches Corps Here Enjoy Circus
body: Members of the diplomatic corps and military attaches corps here enjoyed a circus performance at Pyongyang Circus Theater on Feb. 1 on the occasion of the Lunar New Year's Day, Juche 111 (2022). Diverse programs such as physical and comic acrobatics and animal feats were put on the stage. The performers vividly represented the revolutionary spirit of the Korean people who are opening up a period of overall development of socialist construction full of confidence in victory and optimism, their joyful life and the development of the Juche-oriented acrobatics. The performance was applauded by the audience. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Tribute to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Working people, service personnel, youth and students laid floral baskets and bouquets at the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on the occasion of the Lunar New Year's Day, Juche 111 (2022). Floral baskets and bouquets were placed at the statues on Mansu Hill in the names of Party, power and armed forces organs, social organizations, ministries, national institutions, the units of the Korean People's Army (KPA) and the Public Security Forces (PSF) and institutions, industrial establishments, universities at all levels in Pyongyang. The visitors bowed to the statues. Floral baskets in the names of industrial establishments and units of the KPA and the PSF were laid before the statues of the President and the Chairman and the mosaics picturing their smiling images at Kim Il Sung University, the Ministry of National Defence and the Ministry of Public Security, the Mansudae Art Studio and other parts of the capital. Working people, service personnel, youth and students in other parts of the country visited the statues and the mosaics in their residential areas to pay homage to them. Rodong Sinmun

title: With Warm Love and Affection
body: Among the medical workers devoting themselves to the work for promoting the people’s health is Hong Mi Ran, a doctor of Yongjung-ri People’s Hospital in Sinpho City. Since her girlhood, she has put much effort into treatment with warm love and affection for the people for nearly four decades. For her, visitors to the hospital have been rather her blood relations and family members than patients. The people do not know how many nights she passed without sleep for the promotion of the inhabitants’ health. When serious cases were hospitalized, Hong brought them back to life by treating day and night and showed her sincerity to them while providing tonics. Her figure was unchanged even when she was worked as director of the hospital. Since then, she has channeled efforts into showing utmost sincerity to the people and improving quality of medical service. In those days, she put various technical findings, inspired medical workers of the hospital to establish a production foundation of Koryo medicine on their own and changed the appearance of the hospital. After handing over the work as director of the hospital from age, she has invariably devoted her warm sincerity to inhabitants. They respect and follow her calling "Our Doctor" in reflection of love. Rodong Sinmun

title: Devoting Her Sincerity to Education
body: O Yong Ran, a teacher at Uppha Senior Middle School of Haeju City, is a genuine educator who has rendered her pure conscience to the education of the rising generation for nearly 30 years. She started her career as a teacher when the whole country was on the Arduous March. During those days she never imagined herself apart from teacher’s platform. The title “career revolutionary” rendered by our Party was the most precious treasure to her. This made her invariably keep her position in that harsh period which examined the faith of a revolutionary and she devoted her all to education of the rising generation. She passed numbers of wakeful nights researching teaching materials and new teaching methods. It was her goal to bring rising generation up to be able and reliable pillars defending socialist rural position generation after generation. So, she developed and introduced many novelties in succession in order to secure the efficiency in foreign language subject which she was in charge of. She was awarded several certificates of new instructional methods and invention certificates of experimental equipment and teaching aids during those days. She has worked to the best of her ability, mindful that every one of her students is our country’s future assigned by our Party to her and that to educate our children well is honorable mission to her. Until now she has brought up many honor pupils and sent them to posts for defence of the country. Whenever her students return home after military service and she receives letters from them yearning for their alma mater in the distance, she feels boundless pride and dignity. She is dedicating herself to education work even today. Rodong Simnun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Greetings to President Xi Jinping
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a message of greeting to Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC) and president of the People's Republic of China (PRC), on Friday. Kim Jong Un in the message warmly congratulated the 24th Winter Olympics to be held in Beijing, on behalf of the WPK, the DPRK government and the Korean people. He also extended the heartfelt greetings to the general secretary, the CPC, the PRC government and all the Chinese people. The message said that the Beijing Winter Olympics is the first auspicious event that the CPC and the Chinese people greet in the first year of the new one-hundred-year journey for achieving the prosperity of the Chinese nation, and a festival common to the peoples and sportspersons of all countries in the world aspiring after peace, friendship and solidarity. The successful opening of the Beijing Winter Olympics despite the worldwide health crisis and unprecedented severe circumstances is another great victory won by socialist China, it noted. The Olympic torch flaring up in Beijing clearly proves that no difficulty and challenge can ever prevent the Chinese people from vigorously advancing, rallied close around the CPC with the general secretary at the core, the message said. The message expressed the belief that the Olympics would record one brilliant page in the history of international sports movement as a plain, secure and colorful one and strikingly demonstrate the dynamic spirit of China and its national power under the correct leadership of the general secretary and thanks to the sincere efforts of the CPC and the Chinese people. The DPRK-China relations have been cemented into invincible strategic relations that can never be broken by anything in the struggle for defending and advancing the common cause, and the two parties and the peoples of the two countries have consolidated the unity and cooperation in all fields including politics, economy, culture and sports, the message noted. Kim Jong Un in the message said that he would steadily develop the relations between the two parties and the two countries to a new high stage in conformity with the desire of the peoples of the two countries, together with the general secretary in the future, too. The message sincerely wished the general secretary good health. Rodong Sinmun

title: 10th Anniversary of State General Bureau of Design Marked
body: The State General Bureau of Design in the DPRK marked its tenth founding anniversary. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un saw to it that the state design guidance bureau was established on Feb. 1, Juche 101 (2012), and has guided the bureau to play a pivotal role in bringing about a radical development in construction. A commemorative meeting was held on Feb. 2. Rodong Sinmun

title: "Complete Collection of Kim Jong Il's Works" Vol. 42 Published
body: The Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House brought out Vol. 42 of "Complete Collection of Kim Jong Il's Works", a library of immortal Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism carrying Chairman Kim Jong Il's works in a chronological order and in a systematic and comprehensive way. The volume contains 42 works authored by the Chairman from April to July of Juche 77 (1988). Comprehended in the book are ideas and theories expounded by the Chairman to show the road ahead of the struggle for further cementing the unity and cohesion of the Party and bringing about a great upsurge on all fronts of socialist construction. The works deal with such theoretical and practical issues arising in all spheres of the revolution and construction as training more talented writers, properly conducting an embankment project along the Taedong River to add to the scenery of the capital city and improving the spirit of service among service workers. Rodong Sinmun

title: WPK Central Committee Sends Floral Basket to CPV Central Committee
body: The Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) sent a floral basket to the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam (CPV), congratulating it on its 92nd founding anniversary. The floral basket was conveyed to an official of the External Affairs Commission of the Central Committee of the CPV by the charge d' affaires a.i. of the DPRK in Hanoi. Rodong Sinmun

title: Eternal Treasures of Our Revolution
body: It Must Be Handed Down to Posterity In March, Juche 106(2017), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited the Korean Revolution Museum, which was successfully remodeled as the great hall and treasure house of education in the revolutionary traditions, to learn in detail about its remodeling. He said that the Korean Revolution Museum newly-remodeled in the period when a generation of revolution changes would be of agreat historic significance in carrying forward the lifeline of our revolution and serve as a powerful verification showing that our Party has attached great importance to the education in revolutionary traditions. That day, he stressed the need to manage well it as the museum was successfully remodeled. He added that it is very important work before anything else to conserve and manage well the revolutionary relics, and those relics on display at the museum are the invaluable treasures which must be handed down to posterity. His instructions given that day are precious guideline for all the people of the country including the officials and working people in the field of preservation of revolutionary relics and those of all the units associated with leadership exploits of the great leaders across the country to keep in mind all the time. While Looking Round a Street In March, Juche 102(2013), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un inspected the sports village in Chongchun Street, Pyongyang and instructed to modernize the sports village. He recollected with deep emotion that President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il personally appointed the site for the sports village, led its construction from planning to completion, took part in the inaugural ceremony to celebrate its completion and gave detailed advices on its management. He added that a monument to revolutionary activities of the President and the Chairman should be built meaningfully together with an education place and that should be involved in the modernization plan. Thanks to the iron will of the respected General Secretary who intends to add shine to the immortal guiding exploits of the President and the Chairman forever and noble sense of moral obligation of our people, a mosaic mural depicting the images of the great leaders was erected as well as the monument to their revolutionary activities. What He Emphasized One July day in Juche 105(2016), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un inspected the Phyongsong Artificial Leather Factory. Making a round of the factory associated with the guidance exploits of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, he said with deep emotions that, under the special care of the President and the Chairman, the factory had grown to be a treasure of the country that contributes to the improvement of the people’s living standard. He stressed that the factory must properly conduct education through the room for education in the revolutionary history and thereby make its workers live and work with great pride and confidence that their factory had been prioritized by the President and the Chairman. To make its workers live and work with great pride and confidence! His instruction bears his noble intention that units associated with guidance exploits of the President and the Chairman must give top priority to education of its officials and employees through revolutionary facts, thus letting them be well aware of and add luster to those guidance exploits. Rodong Sinmun

title: Brisk Campaign for Bettering Urban Landscape
body: Officials and working people in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, push forward with the work to create a more beautiful urban landscape. Different floriculture stations have stepped up the preparations for floral decoration after manufacturing various flower beds, flowerpot stands and mobile flowerpot stands. The Pyongyang Floriculture Institute produced hundreds of thousands of various flowering plants. District floriculture stations, organs and enterprises in the city are working hard to produce more than one million flowering plants. Not only the officials and working people in charge of urban landscape renewal but also many citizens devote themselves to urban afforestation and greening. Tens of thousands of trees of good species have so far rooted in hundreds of places of Pyongyang. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Photo Exhibition Opens
body: A national photo exhibition "For the prosperity of the country and the people's happiness" was opened to celebrate the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Seen at the venue of the exhibition is a photo of Kim Jong Il wishing socialist Korea a rosy future. On display are photos showing the exploits of the Chairman who developed the Workers' Party of Korea into the eternal party of the leader and an invincible and powerful general staff of the revolution. Also there are photos dealing with the remarkable development of the motherland, the firm faith and will of all the people to follow only the road of Juche and the dignified feature of our revolutionary armed forces. An opening ceremony took place at the People's Palace of Culture on Thursday. It was attended by Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Choe Hui Thae, chairman of the Pyongyang City People's Committee, officials concerned and citizens of Pyongyang. Sung Jong Gyu, minister of Culture, made an opening address. He said that the revolutionary career of Kim Jong Il was the most brilliant one of the legendary hero and peerless patriot who dedicated his all to the sacred cause for achieving the prosperity of the country and happiness of all generations to come. He called upon all the officials, Party members and other working people to make a tangible contribution to adding shine to the revolutionary exploits of Kim Jong Il and glorifying this year as a year of great revolutionary auspicious events to be significantly recorded in the history of the country, united close around the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: State Non-permanent Measure Committee against Disaster Convened
body: The state non-permanent measure committee against disaster was convened on Thursday. Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, guided the meeting. Attending it were members of the measure committee. Present as observers through video-conferencing were leading officials of ministries and national institutions and chairpersons of provincial, city and county people's committees. The meeting reviewed last year's work including the project for recovery from flood damage, the work of putting natural disasters under control and the performance of the members of the measure committee. Reports made there analyzed and reviewed the successes and shortcomings in the work of overcoming natural disasters together with their causes, including the recovery from flood damage conducted last year to carry out the important task set forth at the 3rd Enlarged Meeting of the Political Bureau of the 8th WPK Central Committee. Also informed was the fulfillment of tasks assigned to the members of the measure committee for strengthening the state crisis control system. The meeting stressed the need for all the officials to ensure the scientific accuracy and promptness of the state crisis control system and meticulously organize the work to rapidly cope with various kinds of disasters by thoroughly implementing the decisions of the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central committee. The measure committee assigned detailed tasks to its members. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Technical Course on Production of School Uniforms Held
body: The 1st national technical course for producing new types of school uniforms was held in Phyongsong City of the DPRK on Feb. 3. The course was aimed at providing the pupils and students with new types of quality school uniforms, true to the idea and spirit of the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Attending it were officials and technicians of the Ministry of Light Industry and garment institutes and production units in Pyongyang City and provinces. Dealt at the course were the issues arising in the production of school uniforms, including the shapes of trousers and knee trousers for schoolboys, dresses and winter skirts for schoolgirls of primary schools and jackets, trousers, skirts and shirts for male and female university students, and their designs for standard sizes and processing. The lecturers briefed in detail on the general principles and processing technical demands to be observed in cutting, sewing and finishing through the displayed samples of school uniforms. There was a question-and-answer session on practical matters arising in the production of school uniforms. Rodong Sinmun

title: Paektusan Prize Sports Contest among Officials of National Institutions Opens
body: The 25th Paektusan Prize Sports Contest among Officials of National Institutions was opened with due ceremony at the Basketball Gymnasium in Chongchun Street here on Thursday to mark the Day of the Shining Star, the greatest auspicious holiday of the Korean nation (the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il). The participants, divided into four groups, will compete in basketball, volleyball, Taekwon-do, shooting, tug of war and other events at the Basketball Gymnasium, the Taekwon-Do Hall, the Meari Shooting Gallery, etc. in Chongchun Street. Present at the opening ceremony were Kim Song Ryong, vice-premier of the Cabinet, Pak In Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea, officials concerned and officials and players of commissions, ministries and national institutions exemplary in mass-based sports activities. Ri Tu Song, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea who doubles as vice-chairman of the National Sports Guidance Committee, made an opening address. The speaker said that the contest to be held on the occasion of the significant Day of the Shining Star would be an important opportunity of fully showing the revolutionary enthusiasm of officials of the commissions, ministries and national institutions to glorify this year as a year of great revolutionary auspicious events to be recorded in the history of the country as well as the sports techniques acquired by them through mass-based sports activities. There was a march-past by the players. After the ceremony, there took place a men's basketball match between teams of the Ministry of Land and Environment Protection and the Ministry of Land and Maritime Transport. Rodong Sinmun

title: Paektusan Prize Sports Games Opens in DPRK
body: The Paektusan Prize Sports Games was opened with due ceremony at the Basketball Gymnasium in Chongchun Street here on Thursday in celebration of the Day of the Shining Star (the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il). The participants in the games will compete in football, basketball, volleyball, ice hockey and other events in Pyongyang, Samjiyon, Phyongsong, Sariwon cities and other places. Present at the ceremony were Ri Tu Song, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea who doubles as vice-chairman of the National Sports Guidance Committee, Kim Il Guk, minister of Physical Culture and Sports, officials concerned and sports persons. Kim Song Ryong, vice-premier of the Cabinet, made an opening address. The speaker said that the games will be an important occasion to celebrate with splendor the 80th birth anniversary of Kim Jong Il as a great revolutionary auspicious event, add shine to the immortal exploits performed by the peerlessly great man in building the physical culture and sports of the country and develop the professional sports techniques. At the end of the ceremony, there took place a march-past by players and men's 3x3 basketball match between the April 25 Sports Team and the Amnokgang Sports Team. Rodong Sinmun

title: Riwon Ballstones, Natural Monuments
body: Riwon ballstones are seen on the beach of the sea off Rahung Workers’ District in Riwon County. Quartzites which were weathered into lumps and fell into the sea were gradually worn by incessant effect of waves. In the end they became the present egg-shaped, spherical, smooth and small and big ballstones. They are white or yellow-white and oval. They have been used as decorations of buildings as well as balls for crusher and grinder. They add beauty to scenery of the beach while having significance in scientific research. The Riwon ballstones are rare natural monuments of the world. Rodong Sinmun

title: On the Way of Maintaining Juche Character and National Identity
body: Creating Even a Song One January day in Juche 52(1963), President Kim Il Sung gave precious instructions about important issues to thoroughly preserve and develop national character in the field of culture and art. He said that national character was important in culture and art and culture and art represented not only the life of people but also peculiar national character as national identity was formed from the people’s thoughts and feelings, sentiments of life, national customs and desire in the situations of its country through the long period. That day the President said that the art without national character could not exist nor be meaningful. He noted that the national character was individuality peculiar to the nation and our national character was unique, beautiful and lofty. Then he added that we should excellently develop our national art, fully conveying beautiful, lofty and unique national sentiments. The art without peculiar national character and feature will lose its vital energies. Therefore the President repeatedly stressed the need to create a song and play a musical instrument conducive to establishing our national indentity and Juche character in the sector of culture and art. Korean Dress Samples He Examined in Person One day in October, Juche 77(1988), Chairman Kim Jong Il came to the People’s Palace of Culture to examine designs of dressing, shoes and hair arrangement and their samples. The sun was almost below the west when the Chairman came to the exhibition hall to examine Korean costume samples. After a few days the Chairman visited the exhibition hall again and stressed that we should preserve national character in making Korean costumes. And he earnestly instructed that they must complete those samples by conducting research work well into our folklore data and our national clothes. To promote and develop our national costume is of great significance in inspiring our people with national pride, self-confidence and sentiments and in giving full play to national character. One day the Chairman emphasized that we should love national costumes in our people’s clothing and that to dislike national costumes was the expression devoid of national character. The lofty intention of the Chairman, who inspired our people to give full play to our nation’s noble character although he was busy with guidance of the revolution, touches our people’s heartstrings even now. In Keeping with Our Flavor and Realities One July day in Juche 103(2014), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited the Terminal 2 of Pyongyang International Airport under construction. That day, he said that the Juche character and national identity should be preserved in building work. He added that it would be good to erect gateposts of national style with letters "Pyongyang International Airport" at the entrance to the airport, like the Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery on Mt Taesong, and to prominently decorate the pattern of Paekho (white tiger) under the eaves of the terminal with the same color. Noting that the Terminal of Pyongyang International Airport is like a gateway to Pyongyang, the face of the country and a symbol of economic power of the country, he underscored the need to build it as a proud edifice in the era of the Workers’ Party both in architectural style and contents. He instructed officials to introduce the world trends and good experiences of other countries into the construction of the terminal and, at the same time, make sure that national identity is preserved in it. And he earnestly noted that the terminal must be decorated with various styles in keeping with our people’s emotion and taste. After that, stressing the need to maintain the Juche character and national identity in the construction of the terminal, he gave precious instructions to provide the terminal with all the facilities suited to our flavor and realities. Thanks to the great guidance of the respected General Secretary who sees to it that the Juche character and national identity are preserved in keeping with our people’s taste when we build even a single structure, all the monumental edifices being built on this land win admiration of the world people while boasting of our flavor. Rodong Sinmun

title: Daily and Ten-day Plans Fulfilled in Key Industrial Sectors of DPRK
body: A campaign for increasing production and creating new things has been dynamically conducted in key industrial sectors of the DPRK. The metallurgical industrial sector has fulfilled its pig iron and steel production plan. Iron ore producers and electrode and fire-resisting material production bases creditably ensured the supply of necessary materials for metal factories. Major chemical factories strive to increase the production of raw materials for light industry and pharmaceutical industry. Power stations across the country over-fulfill their daily production plans. Several complexes in the coal mining industrial sector have waged a campaign for increased production while giving priority to prospecting and tunneling and proactively introducing the technological innovation plans. The machine-building industrial sector has worked hard to supply all sorts of custom-built equipment and accessories necessary for maintenance and reinforcement in various economic sectors and units since the beginning of the year. Cement producers put the production on a normal track while ensuring scrupulous equipment management and technical control. Increased production is witnessed in mining and forestry industrial sectors. The railway transport sector makes sure that key materials are transported to their destination in time. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Premier Inspects Kumsong Tractor Factory
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, inspected the Kumsong Tractor Factory. Looking round the modernization project sites of the factory alive with the endeavors to carry out the decisions of the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the WPK, he urged the factory to play a pivotal role in the struggle for realizing the plan and intention of the Party Central Committee which took a special crucial measure to bring about complete innovation in the agricultural machine industry of the country. He said that officials should become standard-bearers to conduct operation in a bold and big way and make a breakthrough with high scientific and technological insight, in order to successfully carry out the modernization of the factory which holds a very important position in implementing the rural technical revolution. A consultative meeting, held on the spot, discussed and took measures for such issues as the one of mapping out modernization target in a development-oriented way based on the Party policies and unconditionally carrying it out in a phased way, the one for scientists, technicians and researchers to responsibly carry out the technical tasks entrusted to them while making perfect technical preparations for developing and producing modern farm machines and the one of improving the steel quality for tractor parts. Rodong Sinmun

title: Emergency Epidemic Prevention Campaign Brisk in DPRK
body: The emergency epidemic prevention units at all levels in the DPRK are waging an offensive campaign to ensure the unity in action of all the people amid the world health crisis getting worse due to the rapid spread of the Omicron variant. The central emergency epidemic prevention sector makes sure that emergency epidemic prevention institutions further enhance their function and role to strengthen the lockdown, physical test and examination and disinfection. Officials are establishing the strict discipline and order to implement the state anti-epidemic measures correctly in time. They conduct the offensive ideological education to fuel the atmosphere of mass anti-epidemic campaign where all the people help and control each other. Also, an agitprop offensive is propelled to ensure that everyone maintains high tension and nation-wide voluntary unity in the emergency epidemic prevention campaign. All institutions, industrial establishments and farms direct efforts to making their employees get a proper understanding of anti-epidemic knowledge and general information on hygiene, while urging them to thoroughly and regularly conduct the disinfection of offices, worksites, fixtures, equipment and raw materials. Public health institutions pay attention to preventing respiratory diseases like a cold among inpatients and residents under the winter weather conditions and more strictly conduct the physical examination of outpatients. Hygienic and anti-epidemic institutions launched a work for coping with epidemics that can occur in the winter as well as COVID-19. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Congratulations from Military Attaches Corps
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a floral basket and a congratulatory letter from the military attaches corps here on the occasion of the 74th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Army. The floral basket and congratulatory letter were handed over to an official concerned by the military attache of the Vietnamese embassy who is doyen of the corps on February 4. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il’s Care for Pyongyang Cold Noodle
body: On several occasions including February 2 and October 17 in Juche 100(2011), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un gave precious instructions on nicely cooking Pyongyang cold noodle at Okryu Restaurant associated with warm love of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il for the people. He saw to it that a noodle-making contest was arranged among famous restaurants in Pyongyang and personally taught how to evaluate the results of the contest. When Okryu Restaurant took the first place at the contest, he was considerably satisfied and granted great favors to the restaurant. He gave attentive teachings even about the broth and noodle strips well known for their sapidity, refreshingness and fragrance. Once, the respected General Secretary taught in detail about the cuisine for Pyongyang cold noodle including the thickness of noodle strips and dough-kneading. He also requested time and again that Okryu Restaurant must retain the peculiar flavor and traditions in making Pyongyang cold noodle. Stressing the need to make Okryu Restaurant thrive, he highly praised that its cold noodle is the best. Thanks to the benevolent care of the respected General Secretary, the peculiar flavor of Pyongyang cold noodle is kept as it is and the cold noodle is enjoying popularity as national food. Rodong Sinmun

title: Good Fortune of All Generations of Nation
body: February 16, 1942! The news that the Shining Star appeared on Mt Paektu was a joyful event which gave the whole nation hope and excited the people. Our people had held in high esteem President Kim Il Sung, the peerlessly great man, at the head of the revolution and greeted another great man born of heaven who would carry forward his intention and cause. It became the greatest honor and the best luck of our people. As our people upheld Chairman Kim Jong Il, the lifeline of the Juche revolution was continuously maintained and our people greeted the glorious era. Our people kept in their minds the truth that the signal victory of Juche Korea and the bright future of ourselves and rising generation were in store since we greeted the Chairman on Feb. 16. During the arduous period in which our revolution faced the severe hardships the Chairman braved the long thorny path with the indefatigable faith and will that Songun is precisely independence, dignity and love for country and nation at the crossroads of being slaves of imperialism or guards of independence. He was indeed the steadfast guardian of socialism and the heaven of our people’s destiny. Feb. 16 is also the historic day telling how benevolent the father of people we upheld was. The Chairman was anxious to provide our people and children with delights on his annual birthday and to send the birthday spreads to his soldiers, ordinary working people and centenarians. But he continued his way for field guidance without rest. The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un ensured that Feb. 16, the greatest holiday of our nation on which the Chairman was born, was enacted as the Day of the Shining Star in reflection of the unanimous desire of all our people. As we hold the President and the Chairman in high esteem for all ages and follow the respected General Secretary, we are sure to emerge victorious and the future of Juche Korea is bright. Rodong Sinmun

title: Regarding Hardship as Pleasure
body: One December day when our country was undergoing severe trials and hardships, Chairman Kim Jong Il said that he hadn’t slept a night in peace as he continued field guidance day after day, which he by no means regarded as toilsome but rather found worthwhile. He went on saying that news about people living happily relieved him of pent-up fatigue and gave him strength. Since his birth, the Chairman had shared weal and woe with the distress-torn Korean nation and the troublous Korean revolution and braved numerous difficulties and ordeals. The Chairman took all the burdens on his shoulders like white snow or the roots of a tree and granted the people all good blessings. Our socialist country is the fruit of the Chairman’s lofty life devoted solely to providing the people with eternal dignity and rosy future. Indeed, the Chairman is a peerless patriot and the eternal Sun of the people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Cheers in February Resounded through the Country
body: The birth of Chairman Kim Jong Il on February 16, 1942 was the bright sunrise heralding the rosy future of Korea. Anti-Japanese revolutionary fighters carved words on trees for conveying this historic event to posterity. The news soon spread to the underground revolutionary organizations in the homeland. Here and there the patriots contained their violent emotion in such words as "The shining star of Paektu rose up. Let 20 million compatriots achieve the country’s liberation upholding the star generation after generation" and "The birth of the shining star in Mt Paektu, successor to General Kim Il Sung". The slogans engraved on trees across the country reflected the boundless reverence of anti-Japanese revolutionary fighters and the people for Chairman Kim Jong Il born with the spirit of Paektu and their endless jubilation for a brilliant future of the nation. Conveyed in the history are various stories about the births of great men. There has been no example in the annals of human history like the Chairman’s birth that the whole country greeted as the great good luck of nation and remarkable celebration. The birth of the Chairman was a national-historic event to instill fresh confidence and conviction of future into minds of the people who looked at Mt Paektu with hope. Those words carved on trees by patriots of the country breaking into cheers "Long Live the Shining Star of Paektu!" vividly convey the then strong emotion even now. Rodong Sinmun

title: Report on State Budget at 6th Session of 14th Supreme People's Assembly of DPRK
body: Deputy Ko Jong Bom, minister of Finance, made a report on the fulfillment of the state budget for Juche 110 (2021) and on the state budget for Juche 111 (2022) at the 6th Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK. The reporter said that the state budget for Juche 110 (2021) was successfully fulfilled, thanks to the efforts of all the people who waged an all-out drive for making a breakthrough in the implementation of the five-year plan, thus contributing to increasing the economic potentialities of their sectors and units and the state. Last year witnessed an increase in the state budgetary revenue as all production and service units were included in the state budget system along with the efforts for finding and tapping all sources of financial income, he noted, adding that amid the strict measures taken across the country for emergency epidemic prevention, the state investment was focused on mobilizing the potentialities of the self-supporting economy and doing the best to stabilize the people's life. Last year the state budgetary revenue was fulfilled by 100.2 percent, which marked an increase to 101.1 percent, as compared to 2020. Many industrial establishments over-fulfilled their payment plans for the state budget. Provinces, cities and counties carried out their local budgetary revenue plans by 100.1 percent. The state budgetary expenditure was implemented by 99.9 percent last year. Budgetary funds were allocated by 100.4 percent for the economic construction to round off the independent structure of the national economy and stabilize the people's living, as compared to 2020. As funds were successfully allocated for the construction sector as planned, housing projects were pushed ahead with and major construction projects completed. Concentrating investment on the metal and chemical industries, funds were channeled into the development of the national economy by 100.6 percent, as compared to 2020. Investment on the sci-tech field increased to 101.6 percent, as compared to 2020, thus contributing to the economic development and the improvement of the people's living. Funds were directed by 101.8 percent, as compared to 2020, to the affairs concerning the socialist cultural development, including the one of intensifying the emergency epidemic prevention work, the top priority affair of the country, renewing the educational conditions and environment and improving the material and technical foundations for the field of public health. 15.9 percent of the total expenditure was used for the work for further bolstering the war deterrent both in quantity and quality and ensuring the security of the country, which contributed to safeguarding the dignity and security of the country and its people. Then, the reporter underlined the need to financially ensure this year the comprehensive development of Korean-style socialism, as clarified at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee. The state budgetary revenue is expected to grow by 100.8 percent, as compared to 2021. The sales tax, the main item of the budgetary revenue, will increase to 100.6 percent and the state-run enterprises' income to 100.9 percent to reach 83.5 percent of the total income. Besides, the profits of cooperative institutions are expected to reach 100.4 percent, depreciation expenses 100 percent, real estate tax 100.3 percent, social insurance 100.2 percent, income from property sale and price fluctuation 100 percent, income from money collection 680 percent, income from other factors 100.2 percent and income from special economic zones 100 percent. The central budgetary revenue will hold the lion's share of 73.9 percent in the state budgetary revenue and the provinces, cities and counties are to largely fund the central budget while ensuring expenditure with their own income. The state budgetary expenditure will increase to 101.1 percent, as compared to last year. Investment on the economic construction will increase to 102 percent, as compared to last year. An exclusive item for agriculture was added to the budget and this year's budget for agriculture has been drawn up to far exceed the last year's. Financial demands will be fully met in the work for furthering the overhaul and reinforcement of the foundations for production while boosting the current production in all sectors of the national economy, including the key industries like metal, chemical, electric power and coal-mining and machine-building industries and railway transport and the light industry and the fishing industry. Investment on the sci-tech field will increase to 100.7 percent, as compared to last year. Funds will be allocated for pushing ahead with the major construction projects, as planned. 15.9 percent of the total expenditure will be allocated for bolstering the national defence capability. An expenditure item for tackling the pandemic diseases and global health crisis will be established within the state budget and expenditure for the emergency epidemic prevention work will increase to 133.3 percent, as compared to last year. As compared to last year, funds for the comprehensive development of socialist culture will increase to 100.4 percent - 102.6 percent in education, 100.7 percent in public health, 100.3 percent in culture and 100.8 percent in sports. Large educational aid fund and stipend for children of compatriots in Japan will be remitted to accelerate the development of the democratic national education of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon). The reporter stressed that this year's state budget will be fulfilled without fail to financially support the all-people drive for building a power of self-esteem and independence as early as possible. Rodong Sinmun

title: Report on Cabinet's Work Made to 6th Session of 14th SPA
body: Deputy Kim Tok Hun, premier of the DPRK Cabinet, made a report on the work of the Cabinet at the 6th session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly (SPA). The reporter noted that last year the Cabinet organized and undertook the struggle for carrying out the Party's economic policy with an emphasis on adjusting and reinforcing the already existing production foundation and putting the production on a regular basis in all sectors of the national economy while regarding the metal and chemical industries as key links, true to the Party's economic strategy. He continued: Last year the economic construction field faced more difficult and complicated problems than expected due to the hostile forces' persistent sanctions and worldwide health crisis, but waged persevering struggle for putting the country's economy on a new orbit of development. As a result, nationwide total yearly industrial output plan was fulfilled at 148 percent and lots of ministries, national institutions, city and county people's committees and factories and enterprises over-fulfilled their yearly national economic plans. The agricultural sector waged a high-yielding campaign despite persistent disastrous climatic conditions and short supply of farming materials, thus bringing good results. The amount of dairy produce also increased, enabling to start the supply of dairy goods to children. In the construction field, the construction of 10 000 flats in Songsin and Songhwa area, the third-stage project for sprucing up Samjiyon City, the construction of dwellings for 5 000 families in Komdok area and the Pothong riverside terraced residential district and other huge construction projects successfully progressed, strikingly displaying the potential power of our style socialism making dynamic development. Major economic sectors including the metal and chemical industries, too, made not a few achievements in the struggle for carrying out the national economic plan last year. Focus put on strengthening the state's unified guidance and control over the economic work and improving the economic management method last year resulted in progress in the economic development and the stabilization of people's livelihood. Lots of achievements were also made in the emergency epidemic prevention work to check the inroads and spread of the vicious virus sweeping the world and in the endeavor to sweep away anti-socialist and non-socialist practices. The achievements made last year renewed the conviction that the fighting goals for the new five-year plan can be certainly attained as long as there is the wise leadership of the Party and the strength of the people who rose up as a mountain to surely guarantee the prestige of the Party Congress, the reporter said, and continued: We are now faced with heavy yet responsible task to lay a sure guarantee for implementing the five-year plan and make evident changes in developing the economy and improving the standard of people's living. This year the Cabinet will meticulously carry on the economic organization and command for the overall economic development of the country, with stress put on adhering to the principle of giving precedence to the metal and chemical industries and consolidating the foundations for the implementation of the five-year plan by stepping up the Party's adjustment and reinforcement strategy. The metal industrial sector will take careful economic and technical measures to keep the production at major iron works, steel works and iron ore mines going at a high rate so as to produce iron trioxide, pig iron and rolled steel as planned, and dynamically push forward the production capacity expansion and modernization projects. The chemical industrial sector will produce all sorts of chemical products like nitrogenous fertilizer, phosphatic fertilizer and caustic soda as planned while focusing on the establishment of the C-1 chemical industry. The power industrial sector will flexibly adjust the production in the direction of mainly relying on hydro-power while promoting thermo-power generation in parallel, reduce the transmission loss of electricity and raise the operational level of the state integrated electricity management system so as to ensure the satisfactory power supply to different sectors of the national economy. In the coal industrial sector, coal mines should be made to give definite precedence to prospecting and tunneling, actively introduce advanced mining methods and keep pushing forward the development of new mining fields. The sector will thus keep up the coal production capacity with the demand of the national economy. The machine industrial sector will actively propel the modernization and the revival of the original performance of processing equipment and take measures to raise the quality of products while producing lorries, tractors and hydro-power equipment and other machines as planned. The natural resources development sector will put on inventory more deposits of minerals, building stones and other valuable minerals and explore for natural gas and hot spa. The mining industrial sector will expand the production capacity of mines, refining works and factories and actively introduce advanced mining, ore-dressing and refining methods to increase the production of non-ferrous metal and non-metal minerals. The transport sector will increase the freight, lorry and cargo ship transport, and the material and technological foundation of the forestry sector will be consolidated to fulfill the log production plan and the afforestation plan. The building material sector will build up the construction units and equip them with efficient construction machines to powerfully propel the construction projects. It will also put the cement production on a regular basis while actively pushing forward the creation of cement production capacity for major construction projects and rural construction. The IT industrial sector will concentrate efforts on developing the telecommunications of the country and ensuring the home production of various electronic goods and equipment and putting the government affairs on an IT basis. The land management and city management sectors will push forward the general mobilization for land management and qualitatively repair dwellings, public buildings, roads and bridges to provide the people with convenient and cultured living conditions and environment. The external economic sector will keep pushing forward the work to recover the unitary trade system of the state. The agricultural sector will produce much more grains to normalize the food rationing for the people. It will increase the production of meat, egg and dairy goods and put efforts into the production of fruits, vegetables, mushrooms and oil-bearing crops so as to greatly contribute to the people's diet. Provinces, cities and counties will work out the realistic long-term, phased and yearly plans for turning all rural villages of the country into modern socialist villages as high affluent and cultural as the rural villages in Samjiyon City and dynamically carry them out. The light industrial sector will turn out varieties of consumer goods as planned and the fisheries sector will do active scientific fishing to increase fish haul and seafood production. The commercial sector will rapidly revive the state's unified commercial control system to preserve the original nature of socialist commerce. The Cabinet will pave a broad avenue to development and prosperity by dint of self-reliance with the help of sci-tech development and further improve the work of the cultural sector including education and public health. The emergency epidemic prevention work will be made the top priority of the state affairs and the epidemic prevention walls will be further intensified. Also the anti-epidemic foundation will be put on a scientific basis to guarantee the security of the country and the people and ensure the successful socialist construction. The Cabinet will definitely ensure the unified operation and command over the overall economic development of the country and guarantee the careful economic organization and unyielding practices and thus fully discharge its responsibility and duty in the struggle for making this significant year a year of victory worthy special record in the history of the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: 6th Session of 14th Supreme People's Assembly of DPRK Held
body: The 6th Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly (SPA) of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) took place at the Mansudae Assembly Hall from Feb. 6 to 7. Present there were deputies to the SPA and, as observers, officials of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) Central Committee, the SPA Standing Committee, the Cabinet, armed forces organs, ministries and national institutions and chairpersons of the city and county people's committees and officials of provincial institutions. The platform was taken by Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission (SAC) of the DPRK and chairman of the SPA Standing Committee, and Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, vice-president of the SAC of the DPRK and premier of the DPRK Cabinet. Among those on the platform were Ri Il Hwan, O Su Yong, Thae Hyong Chol, Kim Jae Ryong and others, the vice-chairpersons, the secretary general and members of the SPA Standing Committee, and a vice-chairperson of the SPA. Choe Ryong Hae, chairman of the SPA Standing Committee, made an opening address. The session decided on its following agenda: First, on the review of the DPRK Cabinet's work in Juche 110 (2021) and its tasks for Juche 111 (2022) Second, on the fulfillment of the state budget for Juche 110 (2021) and on the state budget for Juche 111 (2022) Third, on adopting the DPRK law on childcare Fourth, on adopting the DPRK law on the protection of the overseas compatriots' rights and interests Deputy Kim Tok Hun, premier of the Cabinet, made a report on the first agenda item and Deputy Ko Jong Bom, minister of Finance, on the second item. Speeches were made at the session. Saying that the reports on the last year's work of the Cabinet and the state budget, which were referred to discussion, correctly reviewed the first year's work for implementing the five-year plan for national economic development, specified the tasks to be fulfilled by the Cabinet this year to ensure the successful implementation of the tasks set forth at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee and properly worked out the state budget, the speakers expressed full support and approval. In their speeches they sternly analyzed and reviewed their successes, experience, mistakes and lessons in last year's work, and suggested feasible ways to develop the work in the sectors and units in their charge as required by the policy. They expressed their determination to provide a firm guarantee for implementing the five-year plan and glorify this year of great significance as a year of victory and glory to be specially recorded in the history of the country by fully discharging their responsibility and role in the on-going struggle for accelerating the comprehensive development of socialist construction. Then, the session adopted the DPRK Supreme People's Assembly's decision "On approving the report on the work of the DPRK Cabinet and the fulfillment of the state budget for Juche 110 (2021)" and decree "On the state budget of the DPRK for Juche 111 (2022)". Reports on the third and fourth agenda items were made by Deputy Kang Yun Sok, vice-chairman of the SPA Standing Committee. Noting that the law on childcare and the law on protection of the overseas compatriots' rights and interests stipulate the WPK's idea and intention on bringing up the children representing the future of the country to be robust and protecting and ensuring the democratic national rights and interests of the overseas compatriots, the reporter explained the relevant draft laws chapter by chapter. The SPA Standing Committee brought up the draft laws for discussion at the session according to Article 95 of the Socialist Constitution. SPA deputies had a study and discussion on the draft laws. Acknowledging that the suggestions made by them were of significance in legally guaranteeing the implementation of the Party policies, the session decided to add them to relevant articles. Then, speeches were made. Fully supporting the relevant draft laws reflecting the WPK's noble outlook on the posterity and its idea of valuing the overseas compatriots, they expressed their resolve to give full play to the validity and vitality of the socialist laws. The session adopted the SPA decrees "On adopting the DPRK law on childcare" and "On adopting the DPRK law on the protection of the overseas compatriots' rights and interests" with the unanimous approval of the participants. Choe Ryong Hae made a closing address. Rodong Sinmun

title: Efforts for Increasing Per-hectare Yield of Grains Brisk in DPRK
body: Agricultural officials and workers in the DPRK push ahead with the work to increase the per-hectare yield of grains this year. Agricultural guidance organs of each province, city and county focus their efforts on the introduction of high-yielding strains which need less fertilizer and are shorter in growth term and resistant to different kinds of damage. The introduction of new high-yielding strains is in full swing in South Hwanghae Province where the area for their cultivation has been expanded in recent years. Agricultural officials and workers in the province also step up the preparations for farming like production and transport of compost. By deepening a collective discussion for the establishment of scientific farming system and method, North Phyongan Province directs main efforts to applying the cultivation methods for tackling damage by disastrous abnormal weather. In particular, the province propels the work for increasing the production of highly effective organic compound fertilizer. South Hamgyong Province concentrates efforts on the preparations for cultivating newly found or rehabilitated tracts of land. Other provinces put their efforts into improving the fertility of low-yielding farm fields, repairing and reinforcing the irrigation system and increasing the proportion of mechanized farm work. Rodong Sinmun

title: Farms Materially Supported in South Hwanghae Province of DPRK
body: A mass campaign is underway in South Hwanghae Province of the DPRK to cement the material foundations for agricultural production. The province provided more than 185 000 medium and small farming tools of twenty kinds, farming materials and at least 190 000 tons of compost to the cooperative farms. The provincial people's committee and the provincial youth league committee, the Haeju Footwear Factory, the Haeju Steel Works and other units prepared ten thousands of medium and small farming tools and various farming machine accessories for farms through proactive tapping of reserves and potentiality. Officials and workers of various units including the provincial publications bureau and the provincial old metal-collecting station sent a large amount of compost to the cooperative farms. Industrial establishments in Haeju City supplied farming materials like vinyl sheets and sprayers and over 10 000 tons of compost to the farms in the city. Rodong Sinmun

title: Photo Show Commemorates Birthday of Chairman Kim Jong Il in DPRK
body: A photo exhibition on the theme of "For the Prosperity of the Country and the Happiness of the People" opened in each province, city and county of the DPRK in the run-up to the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. On display at each venue for the exhibition is a photo of the smiling Chairman wishing the people of socialist Korea a bright future. Also, there are photos showing the revolutionary activities of the Chairman who reliably defended the destiny of the country and people and demonstrated to the world the dignity and power of socialist Korea with his outstanding idea and through his energetic guidance. Portrayed in photos are the exploits the Chairman performed by leading the revolutionary cause of Juche to victory with his rare ideo-theoretical wisdom and through his great revolutionary activities. Photos also deal with the wise leadership of the Chairman who guaranteed the rosy future of Juche Korea by successfully resolving the issue of succession to the revolutionary cause with foresightedness. Visitors can see the photos depicting DPRK people leading a happy, independent and creative life as masters of the state and society under the care of the peerlessly great men. The exhibition draws an endless stream of visitors. Rodong Sinmun

title: His Warm Love Reaches Every Part of Country
body: Regardless of Midwinter Cold On December 3, Juche 108(2019), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un attended the completion ceremony of the Jungphyong Vegetable Greenhouse Farm. He had chosen the site of the farm in person and solved all the problems arising in the construction. Making rounds of the farm with a broad smile on his face, the respected General Secretary said that there are geographically far and near places but people are all close to him and that he would have nothing more to desire if the vegetable greenhouse farm contributes to the diet of the people in North Hamgyong Province. Listening to these words full of fervent love for the people, people across the country keenly felt that the respected General Secretary is truly the father of the people who is taking care of all the people with love and affection warmer than their own parents’. Wherever His People Are In June some years ago, the respected General Secretary inspected Sindo County. The tide had almost gone out to reveal the sludgy land and, moreover, there was no footboard for landing on the island. However, the respected General Secretary stepped on the sludge unhesitatingly. The moment, the accompanying officials were so surprised. In fact, the officials had been feeling uneasy about the respected General Secretary leaving for the island as it was difficult to put the boat ashore on the ebb tide. As if he had read their thoughts, the respected General Secretary had told them that there were his beloved people on the island and he felt as if they were calling him. Then he set out on the voyage without hesitation. Treading on the muddy land, he gave instructions to effect a dramatic change to the island. Looking up to the respected General Secretary, the officials and people in Sindo County pictured to themselves in excitement the rosy future of their county. Benevolent Blessing Last November, the respected General Secretary inspected Samjiyon City. Making rounds of different places in the city which had been turned into a model mountainous cultured city and an ideal local city, he was informed that the people in the city were very happy and were singing highly of the benevolence of our Party. Saying that he felt pride in having done something worthwhile welcomed by the people, he repeatedly expressed great satisfaction adding that people’s opinion is precisely the general evaluation of the construction of Samjiyon City. Then, he warmly wished for the happiness and well-being of all the people of Samjiyon City who would lead a highly civilized and wonderful cultured life in the place dear to heart, the place housing the native home of Chairman Kim Jong Il and in which Mt Paektu stands. These words were blessings given not only to the people in Samjiyon City but also all the other people in the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Promise Made by Chairman Kim Jong Il in Front of His Birthplace
body: It was when Chairman Kim Jong Il visited his birthplace in the Paektusan secret camp in March, Juche 89(2000). Officials implored him to have a photo taken against his native home. Looking around the officials present, he rejected their request and said that we had a lot of things to do for the revolution and people and he would have a photo taken gladly when all the people lead a happy life envying nothing. I will have a photo taken when all the people lead a happy life envying nothing! His promise made in front of his native home that day was the announcement of his rock-firm decision and will to serve the people and build the socialist paradise of people on this land without fail. Rodong Sinmun

title: Meetings with War Veterans and Hero Held in DPRK
body: The working people's organizations held meetings with war veterans and a hero of the Republic on January 7 on the occasion of the 74th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Army (KPA). Attending the meetings were Mun Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League, Han Jong Hyok, chairman of the Central Committee of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea (UAWK), youth league, trade union and UAWK officials, youth and students, workers and trade union members and agricultural workers and union members. Recalling that the People's Army, though it was only two years old, defended the sovereignty and dignity of the nation by defeating the imperialist aggressor forces, which had boasted of being "the strongest" in the world, a war veteran Kim Yong Hwang said at the meeting with youth and students that it was the fruit of President Kim Il Sung's outstanding military idea, Juche-based war methods and superb strategy and tactics. He called upon the youth and students to become performers of feats and young heroes by dedicating themselves to national defence and socialist construction. There was a meeting between war veteran Kim Juk Song and workers and trade union members. Reminding the audience of the fact that President Kim Il Sung founded the Korean People's Army, the regular revolutionary armed forces, the war veteran said that it provided a powerful military guarantee for reliably defending the destiny of the country and nation and made it possible to win a historic victory in the Fatherland Liberation War. He appealed to the workers and trade union members to fulfill their role as the eldest sons of the country and the vanguard in carrying out the five-year plan. At the meeting with agricultural workers, Hero of the Republic Pak In Ho, a lecturer of the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum, recalled that the KPA has defended the country and the revolution with its invincible arms in every decade of the revolution. He called upon all the agricultural workers and union members to defend socialism and the Korean revolution with increased grain production, being responsible for the rural revolution. Oath-taking speeches were made at the meetings. Speakers vowed to fulfill their mission and duty as the advancing group and wing of the Party in every worksite of socialist construction, following the fighting spirit of the defenders of the country in the 1950s. Rodong Sinmun

title: Performance Given by Art Squad of C.C., Women's Union in DPRK
body: The art squad of the Central Committee of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea gave a performance "We will carry forward the tradition of victory in the spirit of Mt Paektu forever" at the Hall of Women on Monday to celebrate the 74th anniversary of the Korean People's Army. Put on the stage were colorful numbers representing the proud course of struggle covered by the revolutionary armed forces. The performers sang of the boundless reverence and praise of all the people for President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il who performed the great exploits of building a prosperous country and a powerful army by carrying through the great cause of founding the army from scratch by dint of self-reliance and developing it into an elite revolutionary army with their Juche-oriented army-building idea and outstanding leadership. There were also the numbers overflowing with the profound gratitude toward the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, the peerlessly brilliant commander who records a new chapter in the history of building the Juche-based revolutionary army of the Party with his rare wisdom, outstanding commanding art, matchless courage and pluck, and deep trust and love. Narration and chorus "I Love My Mother" was put on the stage to represent the fervent will of all the people to single-mindedly uphold the great Party. Among the audience were officials of the Central Committee of the women's union and union officials and members in Pyongyang City. Rodong Sinmun

title: KCNA Report on Revolution in Past Ten-Year Construction
body: The Korean Central News Agency on Monday issued a report on the fact that the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un unfolded a grand plan to bring about a revolution in construction as required by the development of the era and wisely guided the struggle for materializing it over the past ten years. According to the report, the first great workshop for officials in the field of construction held on December 8, Juche 102 (2013) was a historic event that set a milestone of the struggle for ushering in a great golden age of construction and gave a powerful stimulus to bringing about a radical turn in construction. The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un gave instructions on numbers of architectural layouts and completed each of them despite busy schedule of dealing with lots of important Party and state affairs. He has continued his field guidance to construction sites day and night, rainy or snowy in order to give detailed instructions on the orientation and ways for construction, which served as immortal guidelines for thoroughly embodying the people-first principle in construction. Under the care of Kim Jong Un who devotes all his efforts to the people's happiness, lots of bases for cultural and leisure activities, mass sports centers, etc. have been built for the people, all of which are fully equipped to be able to serve the people's interests and convenience at the highest level. There is a hospital village in Munsu area of Pyongyang among a lot of architectural wealth created in the great era of Kim Jong Un on the people-first principle. Baby homes, orphanages, primary and middle schools for orphans, schoolchildren's palaces, children's camps, etc. built in different places of the country are the precious fruits of the warm paternal love of Kim Jong Un for the people and children. What the respected General Secretary has always given priority to and devoted his all to in the construction is the issue of dwelling houses for the people to live in. True to the noble intention of the Party Central Committee, new streets including Ryomyong Street perfectly reflecting the vital demand of the people came into being one after another. Local areas are undergoing changes as evidenced by the appearance of Samjiyon City, an ideal mountainous town built as a model of local construction. Under the bright blueprint for capital construction set forth at the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea, the construction of 50 000 flats is proceeding in full swing in Pyongyang City as an undertaking to materialize the cherished desire of our Party, being reflective of the noble idea of believing in the people as in Heaven and the idea of Juche-oriented architectural beauty of the Party Central Committee. Our architecture has made remarkable leaping progress amid the vigorous construction revolution, ushering in a new era of cultural efflorescence in the 21st century. Thanks to the noble loyalty and moral obligation and outstanding leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un who opens a new chapter of perpetuating the memory of the great leaders, the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun was most solemnly and perfectly rebuilt as a grand monument to the immortality of the leaders which cannot be found anywhere else in the world in its content, form and scale. The Korean Revolution Museum was rebuilt as a grand seat of education in the revolutionary traditions and a great treasure house of Kim Il Sung's Korea, and the Youth Movement Museum was built as a monumental edifice. Kim Jong Un saw to it that a new model was constantly created in the construction in line with the demand of the times and the whole country was spruced up with it as a spark. An architectural revolution was brought about in the construction of Samjiyon City to provide a springboard for the local construction of the country. A wonderful terraced residential district with the best convenience and modern beauty was built for ordinary working people at the riverside of the Pothong River in the capital city, and thus a new type of architecture was created, making it possible to further raise the level of modernization and civilization of the capital and local cities. A powerful struggle is underway to create a new standard of local industrial factories in Kimhwa County of Kangwon Province, and an operation is being unfolded to complete the technical remodeling of local industrial factories in all cities and counties across the country at an early date, on the basis of the experience gained in the county. The energetic guidance of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un made it possible to create world-startling stories in construction and let the flames of a great leap sweep the whole country over the past 10 years. Solider-builders completed the project for construction of Masikryong Ski Resort in just less than one year to others' surprise. They cut rocks in the mountain to build ski courses totaling over 100 000 meters in hundreds of thousands of square meters of areas. A great number of edifices appeared in 2013, typical of which are the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum which turned into a comprehensive educational centre and a grand open-air museum in just 10 months, the Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery that was built as a grand monument, a scientists street that reminds one of a city, dwelling houses of distinctive styles for educators and sportspersons, modern medical service centers, a large all-purpose water park and horse-riding service center. Young vanguard built the Paektusan Hero Youth Power Station as an imposing symbol of a youth power. The Satellite Control Centre of the National Aerospace Development Administration was built as a monumental edifice in the era of the Workers' Party in just eight months, and the Koam-Tapchon railway section was completed in a short span of time, which opened up a new path in laying railways in the country. Modern streets as huge as cities have also sprung up year after year thanks to the initiative and leadership of the Party Central Committee. Unprecedented construction campaigns were waged on all fronts of the economic sectors including pilot sectors of the national economy as well as the basic industry, light industry and agriculture.
