The last 10-year history of construction clearly proved that the future of our socialist country and our people is bright thanks to Kim Jong Un who is adding luster to the golden age of construction based on the people-first principle with the most revolutionary and scientific architectural programme of Juche and by his tireless patriotic devotion. Rodong Sinmun

title: We Should Never Rest Contented with Work for People
body: One day in September Juche 104(2015), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited Rason City at the northern end of the country, where the reconstruction campaign was conducted to heal the damage from the flood, and was anxious for its people. Being informed that the living of the people in the afflicted area was brought to normal as the Party took important measures one after another for the recovery from the flooding and sent a lot of foodstuff, daily necessities, etc. to them and they were deeply touched by the repeated loving care shown by the Party for them, he said that it is the bounden duty of the Workers’ Party of Korea to take warm and responsible care of the destiny of the people whom President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il regarded as Heaven in their lifetime, and officials should not rest contented with the work for the people. We should not rest contented with the work for the people! This represents his noble sincerity. A vegetable greenhouse farm was built for the people of North Hamgyong Province a few years ago, and another large-scale vegetable greenhouse farm was to be built for the people of South Hamgyong Province. This stirring reality makes all the people deeply feel the noble world of our Party’s devoted service for the people. It is the steadfast resolve and will of our Party to let the people, who have firmly followed the road of socialism with a single heart under the leadership of the Party, fully enjoy all blessings of socialism. Rodong Sinmun

title: 2nd Grand Workshop for Officials in Construction Sector Opens
body: The 2nd grand workshop for officials in the field of construction began in Pyongyang. The workshop under the theme of "The rapid development of the Juche-oriented architecture and period of great prosperity in construction" serves as an important occasion of grasping the immortal exploits performed by our Party for the development of the Juche-oriented architecture, analyzing and reviewing the successes, experience, mistakes and lessons after the 1st grand workshop for officials in the construction sector and finding the ways for bringing about another leap forward in the field of construction. The workshop is to deal with the theoretical and practical matters arising in making the officials in the construction sector kindle the flames of new construction revolution in line with the Party's idea on Juche-based architecture and its construction policy. Attending it were officials in the fields of architecture design, execution, building-materials production, construction supervision, land and environment protection and urban management in Pyongyang, local areas and armed forces field, officials of construction science research and education organs and leading Party and administrative officials of the Cabinet, ministries and national institutions. The 2nd grand workshop for officials in the construction sector was opened on February 8. The platform of the workshop was taken by Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and premier of the Cabinet. Among those on the platform were O Su Yong, secretary of the C.C., WPK, Pak Jong Gun, vice-premier of the Cabinet and chairman of the State Planning Commission, Pak Hun, vice-premier of the Cabinet, chairpersons of the provincial people's committees, leading officials of the ministries and national institutions, officials of the armed forces organs and persons of merits who performed feats in the important construction projects. As the workshop was declared open, the national anthem of the DPRK was played solemnly. O Su Yong read out the letter "Let us lead the development of civilization of our own style of socialism by waging a new revolution in construction" sent by Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, to the participants in the 2nd grand workshop for officials in the construction sector. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un in his letter warmly encouraged the officials in the construction sector who participated in the workshop with high enthusiasm to display the development and might of the Juche-oriented architecture put on a higher stage through the struggle of ushering in a period of a new upsurge and overall development in socialist construction, and all the builders and servicepersons across the country who are creating a myth of construction in the era of the Workers' Party while demonstrating the might and mettle of our state in the worksites of great construction for a highly civilized and prosperous nation, true to the call of the Party. Saying it is the success to be reviewed with special pride that the work of sprucing up Samjiyon City was victoriously concluded as a gift of loyalty to the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il, he extended thanks to all the people, builders and service personnel across the country who had dedicated their efforts and wisdom and rendered sincere material and moral assistance to the work of sprucing up Samjiyon City with clear and pure loyalty to the Party and the leader. He stressed the importance of the construction sector's position and role in the current struggle for bringing about a new victory in socialist construction and clarified the grand plan for giving further momentum to the construction revolution and illuminated the main orientation and demand to be maintained in the work of construction and the tasks and practical ways for making a signal development in the construction. Then, a meeting of reviewing the work in the field of construction was held. Kim Tok Hun in a report stressed the intention of the Party attaching great significance to the workshop in making innovation and leap forward once again in the field of construction to more strikingly display the latent power and development potential of our state and ushering in a new phase of creating the socialist civilization. He said that giving priority to construction as an important political work for enhancing the overall might of the country, instilling conviction into the people and leading the socialist civilization, Kim Jong Un made sure that a grand offensive for bringing about a radical turn in the work of construction was organized and launched. He said that the ideas and theories set forth by the General Secretary, including the idea of properly combining the Juche character with national identity and modernity in construction while regarding the people-first principle as the immutable ideal and the idea of carrying on the local construction as an important strategic task are the important guidelines correctly reflecting the desire of our people and demand of the times. He referred to the proud successes which demonstrated the might and rapid development of Korean-style socialism in the work of construction after the 1st grand workshop. A series of mistakes made in the field of construction were analyzed and reviewed. The reporter called upon all the officials and workers in the construction sector to make a positive contribution to enhancing the might of the country and pushing ahead with the building of the socialist civilization, upholding the Party's idea and policy on construction with devoted practices. He called for fanning up the flames of new construction revolution, united as one in mind around Kim Jong Un and thus dynamically leading the overall development of the Korean-style socialist construction. Speeches were made there. The workshop continues. Rodong Sinmun

title: Preparations for People's Art Festival Brisk in DPRK
body: Brisk in the DPRK are the preparations for the First People's Art Festival Celebrating the Day of the Shining Star. Works for arranging performance venues and providing lodging and boarding conditions for the festival participants have been accelerated. The poster creation and dissemination and the production of festival certificates, cups, etc. were already completed. A work is going on at the final stage to create the festive mood with colorful decorations at performance venues and in different parts of the city. And the festival participants are striving to enhance their artistic level in order to present distinctive and wonderful performances. The festival is to be held in the forms of provincial performances and performances by art groups from ministries and national institutions at theatres and halls in the capital city. Taking part in it will be art groups from ministries and national institutions, provincial art troupes and itinerant art squads from industrial establishments and co-op farms. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of Great Leaders
body: Servicepersons, working people and schoolchildren in the DPRK visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in different parts of the country to pay floral tribute on the occasion of the Day of Army Founding. Placed at the statues of the President and the Chairman on Mansu Hill were floral baskets in the names of Party, power and armed forces organs, social organizations, ministries, national institutions, units of the Korean People's Army (KPA) and the Public Security Forces (PSF) and institutions, industrial establishments and universities at all levels in Pyongyang. The visitors paid high tribute before the statues of the great leaders. Floral baskets in the names of KPA and PSF units and industrial establishments were laid before the statues of the great leaders and the mosaics picturing their smiling images at Kim Il Sung University, the Ministry of National Defence, the Ministry of Public Security and other parts of Pyongyang. Servicepersons and citizens in local areas visited the statues of the great leaders and mosaics picturing their smiling images in their residential areas to pay tribute. Rodong Sinmun

title: Dancing Parties of Youth and Students Held
body: Youth and students of the DPRK held dancing parties across the country on Feb. 8 to celebrate the 74th anniversary of the Korean People's Army. When the parties in the capital city of Pyongyang began with song "Long Live Generalissimo Kim Il Sung", the participants showed a wave of dancing with deep reverence for President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. Every face of the participants, dancing to the tunes of such songs as "Our Comrade Kim Jong Un" and "Cheers of the People", was filled with high honor and pride of being guided by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. The dancing parties where the young people sang the "Song of National Defence" and other wartime songs in chorus were overflowing with the enthusiasm to glorify the honor of being the advancing group in the struggle for hastening the future of Korean-style socialism. The songs "We Will Go to Mt Paektu" and "Song of Youth" revved up the atmosphere of dancing parties. Similar dancing parties took place in all provincial seats, cities and counties on the same day. Rodong Sinmun

title: Congratulatory Visit to KPA Units in DPRK
body: Senior party and government officials and members of the people's delegations visited soldier-builders and service personnel on the defense lines on February 8 to celebrate together with them the 74th founding anniversary of the heroic Korean People's Army (KPA). Senior officials of the Party and the government and officials in Pyongyang and local areas congratulated the servicepersons on the Day of Army Founding at the grand construction sites, including housing construction fields in the capital city, and at KPA units across the country. They gave the regards of civilians to the soldiers who are devotedly serving at major socialist construction sites. At the grand construction sites in the capital city, the members of people's delegations handed over letters of greeting to the soldier-builders and requested them to fulfill their duty as the creator of the people's happiness. Units of all the KPA services and arms were overflowing with the military-civilian affection. The people's delegations were welcomed by servicepersons and their families. Members of the delegations informed them of the news about the struggle of civilians and handed over the aid materials to them. Watching the training of soldiers, they felt the pride of having the invincible revolutionary army faithful to the cause of the Party. Sharing the affection with soldiers, they conveyed the request of the civilians for adorning the days of military service with feats and watched celebration performances given by the units and colorful sports and amusement games. The units were full of joy and optimism of the soldiers marking the Day of Army Founding. Rodong Sinmun

title: Officials of Armed Forces Organs Visit Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: Officials of the armed forces organs, including Ri Yong Gil, Kwon Yong Jin, Rim Kwang Il, Jong Kyong Thaek and Ri Thae Sop, visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on the occasion of the 74th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Army. The visitors were overwhelmed by profound reverence for the great leaders. A floral basket in the name of the Korean People's Army was placed before the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. The visitors paid high tribute to the statues of the President and the Chairman. At the halls where the President and the Chairman lie in state, the visitors made a deep bow to them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Noble Intention for Service Emulation
body: One day in May, Juche 101(2012), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited a restaurant in Changjon Street nearing completion. Looking round the first and second floors of the building he was informed that several restaurants were about to be placed there. Then the respected General Secretary instructed them to wage an emulation between them in terms of service. He said the number of restaurant-customers depends on their service level and quality of the dishes. The respected General Secretary worked heart and soul not only to provide our people with wonderful service facilities but to make them beloved by people after their construction. Indeed, he only cares to bring our people’s happiness and laughter into full bloom. Looking up the venerable image of the respected General Secretary the officials pictured the scene of people full of laughter in those newly built restaurants and brisk emulation for the sake of our people conducted between those cooks and waiters. The service emulation taught by the respected General Secretary was not merely a practical one but a worthwhile one in serving our people with sincerity. Rodong Sinmun

title: State Commendations Awarded to Persons of Merit
body: The Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK issued a decree on conferring Order of Kim Jong Il, the title of DPRK Labor Hero together with Gold Medal (Hammer and Sickle) and Order of National Flag First Class, titles of honor and orders on 8 732 officials, workers and servicepersons who distinguished themselves in the struggle to implement the Party's policy on the occasion of the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. According to it, Order of Kim Jong Il was awarded to four persons, the title of DPRK Labor Hero to one person, the title of People's Scientist to one person, the title of People's Teacher to two persons, the title of Merited Scientist to three persons, the title of Merited Teacher to one person, the title of Merited Technologist to one person, the title of Merited Historical Site Lecturer to one person, the title of Merited Smelter to four persons, the title of Merited Chemical Manufacturer to one person, the title of Merited Electrician to one person, the title of Merited Boilerman to one person, the title of Merited Coal Miner to five persons, the title of Merited Miner to one person, the title of Merited Timber Carrier to one person, the title of Merited Ranger to two persons, the title of Merited Engineman to one person, the title of Merited Fisherman to two persons, the title of Merited Truck Driver to one person, the title of Merited Doctor to two persons, the title of Merited Accountant to one person, Order of National Flag First Class to 128 persons, Order of Labor to 339 persons, Order of National Flag Second Class to 3 749 persons and Order of National Flag Third Class to 4 479 persons. Rodong Sinmun

title: Party and State Commendations Conferred on Persons of Merit
body: On the occasion of the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il, party and state commendations were awarded to officials, working people and servicepersons who distinguished themselves in carrying out the Party's policy. All the people and service personnel across the country have made unprecedented feats and labor successes in the work for national defence and on every front of socialist construction, remaining faithful to the guidance of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. An awarding ceremony took place at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Wednesday. It was attended by Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, and persons of merit. Choe Ryong Hae read out a decree of the SPA Standing Committee of the DPRK. Order of Kim Jong Il was conferred on Ho Thae Chol, Jong Kwang Chol and Pak Mun Ho. O Pyong Gon was awarded the title of DPRK Labor Hero, together with Gold Medal (Hammer and Sickle) and Order of National Flag First Class. Watches bearing the august name of Chairman Kim Jong Il were conferred on Kim Yong Nam, Kim Son Hwa, Ri Chol Min, Jong Yong Chol and Choe Myong Chol and the citations of Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, on Hyon Ok Ju, Pak Hyong Ryol, Ri Chang Hyok, Ro Myong Chol, Kim Jong Chol, Han Pyong Ik, Ri Kyong Do, Ju Yong Sok, Choe Yong Su, Ri Kum Ae and Pak Yong Chan. Yun Yong Chol was awarded the title of People's Scientist, Hong Yon Hui and Pak Hwa Sun the title of People's Teacher, Kim Jae Yong, Pak Kyong Ryong and Ryu Hyang Gum the title of Merited Scientist, Kwak Sim the title of Merited Teacher, Kim Kil Hak the title of Merited Technologist; Kim Ju Song, Cha Kwang Hyok, Pak Myong Ho and Ri Chun Jo the title of Merited Smelter, Choe Jong Hwan the title of Merited Electrician, Ri Sun Chan the title of Merited Boilerman, Kim Chan Song, Kim Myong Jun, Pak Kwang Song, An Jae Gon and Sin Chol Ryong the title of Merited Coal Miner, Kim Yong Son the title of Merited Miner, Ri Myong Chol the title of Merited Timber Carrier, Kim Ju Chol and Jo Myong Il the title of Merited Ranger, Kim Yong Il the title of Merited Engineman, Ryu Kum Chol the title of Merited Truck Driver, Om Jong Nam and Kim Un Chol the title of Merited Doctor, and Hong Song Ae the title of Merited Accountant. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Art Exhibition Commemorates Birthday of Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: A national art exhibition was opened with due ceremony as part of the national art festival "Career of Patriotic Devotion" for celebrating the Day of the Shining Star (birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il). Seen at the center of the exhibition hall is an art piece depicting Chairman Kim Jong Il standing on the top of Mt. Paektu. On display are art pieces showing the revolutionary career and personality of the Chairman as a great man. Also, there are art pieces on the stirring reality of the country in which the patriotic desire of the Chairman for building a powerful nation comes true. An opening ceremony took place at the Korean Art Gallery on Wednesday. Attending it were Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials concerned and working people in Pyongyang City. Sung Jong Gyu, minister of Culture, made an opening address. At the end of the ceremony, the participants looked round the exhibition hall. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Symposium on Exploits of Chairman Kim Jong Il Held in DPRK
body: A national symposium was held at the People's Palace of Culture on Wednesday to get a deep understanding of Chairman Kim Jong Il's immortal revolutionary exploits. Attending it were Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Party and administrative officials, officials of the working people's organizations, theorists and information workers from armed forces organs, the fields of science, education, literature and art, media and the preservation of revolutionary relics and party cadres training institutions in Pyongyang. The symposium heard the treatises proving in depth the ideo-theoretical exploits of Kim Jong Il and sagacity of his guidance. Their presenters were Kim Yong Gwang, director of the Party History Institute of the WPK Central Committee, Paek Hyong Chol, head of the Central Cadres Training School of the WPK, Pak Yong Il, general of the Korean People's Army, Kim Chol Ho, director-general and editor-in-chief of the Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House, and Mun Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the youth league. They praised Kim Jong Il as a prominent thinker-theoretician who formulated the revolutionary idea of President Kim Il Sung as Kimilsungism and enriched it as required by the era and the developing revolution and thus made sure that it shines as the eternal guiding idea in the era of independence. They said that Kim Jong Il's history of guidance over party-building shines as the immortal annals in which the invincible might of the WPK was fully demonstrated. They lauded him as the greatest-ever commander who reliably defended the destiny of the country and revolution with his invincible Songun politics. They stressed that Kim Jong Il was the peerless patriot who performed the exploits to be eternally recorded in the history of the country by dedicating his whole life to the work for the prosperity of the country and the people's happiness. His greatest feat for the times, revolution and country is that he provided a firm guarantee for our Party and people to accomplish the sacred revolutionary cause of Juche pioneered in Mt Paektu, they pointed out. They expressed their determination to fulfill their responsibility and duty in adding luster to the revolutionary career and exploits of Kim Jong Il forever. Rodong Sinmun

title: 10th National Cooking Competition Opens in DPRK
body: The 10th National Cooking Competition for marking the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il (the Day of the Shining Star) was opened at the Pyongyang Noodle House on February 9, under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of the Korean Association of Cooks. The purpose of the competition is to raise the technical skills of cooks and waiters and waitresses and apply excellent cuisines so as to contribute to the improvement of the dietary life of the people. The competition, which brings together more than 90 units, is to be held divided into a cooking and beverage-making contest in which dishes and beverage are made on the spot and an exhibition of inventive dishes. There will take place a show of cuisine based on potato farina and a demonstration of excellent cooks and waiters and waitresses on February 11, the last day of the competition. Present at its opening ceremony were Minister of Commerce Pak Hyok Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the Korean Association of Cooks, Ri Yong Min, director of the Guidance Bureau of Public Catering Service, and officials concerned. Ri Song Hak, vice-premier of the Cabinet, made an opening address. After the ceremony the participants looked round the venues of cooking and beverage-making contest and exhibition of inventive dishes. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Youth and Children's Festival of Loyalty Opens
body: The 23rd National Youth and Children's Festival of Loyalty opened with due ceremony on the occasion of the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The festival is to be held, divided into political, art, sports and economic sections. A question-and-answer study contest, art piece contest, sports games and other colorful events are included in the festival. An opening ceremony took place at the Central Youth Hall on Wednesday. Attending the ceremony were officials of the youth league and schoolchildren in Pyongyang City. Mun Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League, made a report there. Rodong Sinmun

title: Stamp Show for Marking Birth Anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il Opens
body: A stamp show for marking the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il opened in the DPRK on Wednesday. Seen at the venue of the show is a photo of a stamp with the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. On display are stamps dealing with the immortal revolutionary career and exploits of Kim Jong Il who led the socialist cause of Juche to the brilliant victory, holding aloft the red flag of revolution all his life. There are also stamps of different themes showing the proud successes made by the Korean people in the annals of the socialist construction and the reality of the country with dynamism in which a new era of the prosperity of the state was ushered in. And exhibited are various stamps presented by philatelists. An opening ceremony took place at the Korean Stamp Exhibition House. Attending it were Ju Chang Il, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials concerned, officials and employees of the State Stamp Bureau and philatelists in Pyongyang City. Rodong Sinmun

title: 2nd Grand Workshop for Officials in Construction Sector Continues
body: The 2nd grand workshop for officials in the construction sector continues. More speeches were made in the Wednesday second-day sitting of the meeting where work in the field of construction was reviewed. Speakers said that the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's letter "Let Us Lead the Development of Civilization of Our Own Style of Socialism by Waging a New Revolution in Construction" is the immortal great programme that vigorously guides us to a new revolution in construction for our great state's prosperity and development and our people's well-being. They, reflecting the boundless reverence of all the participants in the workshop and all other people in the country, extended the highest glory and the warmest greetings to Kim Jong Un who ushered in a great golden age of construction in the country on the people-first principle with his outstanding ability and seasoned leadership and is guiding the historic cause for the overall prosperity of our state to victory. They referred to the immortal feats of General Secretary Kim Jong Un who attached importance to the construction work in the struggle for building a powerful socialist country, saying that he clarified the great programme for Juche-oriented architecture in the new era with his gifted ideo-theoretical wisdom and indefatigable and energetic leadership, helped officials gain broad insight into construction and brought about a construction revolution. They also noted that the Party's policy on preserving the people-first principle, Juche character, national identity and modernity in architecture has been fully applied and successes were made in training talents in the field of construction. They recalled that the People's Army has fully demonstrated the mettle of the Party's invincible revolutionary army in lots of major construction projects, responding to the Party's call with heroic practice. The production of cement and other building materials was boosted in the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance to significantly contribute to the grand construction campaign, they noted. The speakers stressed the need for all the officials to fulfill their responsibility and role as organizers and standard-bearers in implementing the Party's construction policy. They expressed their resolve to further spruce up Pyongyang City and effect continued innovation in the construction revolution for ushering in a new era of radical change in the appearance of local areas to carry out the militant tasks set forth in the historic letter. In the speeches, officials analyzed and reviewed the mistakes of defaulting on their duties in implementing the Party's policy on the construction revolution. Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, and premier of the Cabinet, concluded the meeting of reviewing the work in the construction sector. After the meeting, Party and state commendations were conferred on designers, officials and innovators who distinguished themselves in the construction. Under a decree of the Standing Committee of the DPRK Supreme People's Assembly, Order of Kim Il Sung was awarded to Jong Yong Thaek and Maeng Kyong Chan and Order of Kim Jong Il to Kil Song Ung. The title of DPRK Labor Hero, together with Gold Medal (Hammer and Sickle) and Order of National Flag First Class went to Paek Song Un, Kim Sun Chol, Pak Song Min, Kim Sang Ryong, Song Hak and Ro Ik. A watch bearing the august name of Chairman Kim Jong Il was conferred on Ri Chol Sam and the citation of Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, on Kim Tae Gil, Pak Jong Ryol, Kim Mu Song, Kim Kwan Su and Han Yong Nam. Kim Il Sung Youth Honor Prize was awarded to Kim Kuk Chol, Pae Rim Gwang, Kim Il Hyok, Ryu Ji Song and O Yong Un and Kim Jong Il Youth Honor Prize to Won Hyok Chol, Kim Chung Mi, Roe Jin Song and Sin Chol Min. The title of People's Designer went to Kim Hwa Song, the title of Merited Designer to Kim Jong Bom, Kim Song Hak, Ri Pyong Hak, Rim Kwang and Kim Jong Gwan, the title of Merited Builder to Ri Song Ho, Hyon Ki Son, Ryu Myong Do and Jong Chol, the title of Merited Truck Driver to Yun In Jin, Choe Ryong Se and Ri Yong Su, the title of Merited Technologist to Kim Chang Ho, the title of Merited Calcinations Worker to Ri Kwang Chol and the title of Merited Mechanical Engineer to Pak Kwang Thae. Besides, Order of National Flag First Class was conferred on 20 persons, Order of Labor on 28 persons and Order of National Flag Second Class on 56 persons. The participants in the 2nd grand workshop entered into technical course. Rodong Sinmun

title: Unforgettable Story about His Devotion to People
body: Golden Cushion of Love One January day 8 years ago, the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un took his way towards Lake Yonphung soon after visiting the State Academy of Sciences in an attempt to appoint the site for a scientists holiday camp. When he reached the lakeshore he said to an official of the State Academy of Sciences who accompanied him that he had already looked round every corner of the lake on board twice in the previous summer and consequently found that site. And he warmly said that everything for our scientists should be provided on the highest level. Thanks to his noble intention, the Yonphung Scientists Holiday Camp was splendidly built by Lake Yonphung in a few months. The scientists holiday camp was not a mere building but a product of the great love of the respected General Secretary for scientists and technicians and a golden cushion that can never be found anywhere else. His Earnest Request Several years ago the respected General Secretary visited the Ryuwon Footwear Factory. Looking round the factory, he said that the issue of successfully ensuring the quality consumer goods was not a simple economic and business issue but an important issue of holding everything made locally dear and protecting it. Then he emphasized that the industrial establishments in the field of light industry should not confine to producing trial goods and samples for show or displaying them at shops but put production on a normal footing and steadily improve their quality so that the people may substantially benefit from them. He earnestly called upon officials of the relevant ministries and national institutions including the light industrial sector to properly work out strategies to raise the hot wind of leap forward in the production of consumer goods and make redoubled efforts to carry them out, deeply aware of the responsibility and duty they assumed before the people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Foreign Personages Hail Decision of Political Bureau of C.C., WPK
body: Political figures of DR Congo and Bangladesh issued statements from Jan. 26 to Feb. 1 in support of the decision of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Sylvere Boswa Isekombe, general secretary of the Communist Party of the DR Congo, said that the birth anniversaries of Comrade Kim Il Sung and Comrade Kim Jong Il are the most meaningful holidays and it is their bounden duty and moral obligation to celebrate the holidays splendidly and significantly. He expressed his conviction that the holidays this year would serve as important occasions for further hardening the unshakable faith of the Korean people to carry forward and accomplish the revolutionary cause of Juche, pioneered and guided by the great leaders, under the leadership of the WPK. He stressed that the WPK and the Korean people will surely register proud successes in their historic struggle for the comprehensive development of socialism, thanks to the outstanding leadership of Comrade Kim Jong Un. Mostafa Jamal Haider, chairman of the Bangladesh Jatiya Party, expressed his will to give wide publicity to the immortal feats performed by President Kim Il Sung and His Excellency Kim Jong Il for the Korean revolution and the human cause of independence in order to create an atmosphere of praising the great leaders of the DPRK among the Bangladeshi people on the occasion of their birth anniversaries. Garib Newaz, president of the Bangladesh People's League, stressed that he is really pleased at the celebration of the birth anniversary of His Excellency Kim Jong Il as the holiday common to mankind. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Remembered in India
body: Personages from the Communist Party, the Communist Party (Marxist), the national committee of minorities, the Nationalist Congress Party and the People's Party of India and the All-India Forward Bloc jointly issued a statement on Jan. 27 to mark the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. In the joint statement, they praised Kim Jong Il as a paragon of popular leader who devoted all his life to the people's happiness, always finding himself among them. Noting that February 16 this year is his 80th birthday, the statement said: Thanks to his energetic ideo-theoretical activities, the Juche idea founded by Comrade Kim Il Sung could shine as the great guiding idea in the era of independence. Comrade Kim Jong Il developed the Workers' Party of Korea into an ever-victorious guiding force, the DPRK into an invincible socialist state and the Korean People's Army into a matchless strong revolutionary army. It would have been unthinkable without his achievements in beefing up the military force that the DPRK fully demonstrates its prestige as a world military power. We warmly congratulate the Korean people on the victory achieved in the first year's struggle for implementing the decisions of the Eighth WPK Congress. We are convinced that they will surely implement the decisions of the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the WPK. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Book Exhibition Opens in DPRK
body: A national book exhibition opened in Pyongyang in the run-up to the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. On display at the exhibition hall are more than 15 000 publications of ten thousand kinds, including works of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. An opening ceremony took place at the Okryu Exhibition House on Thursday. Present there were Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials of publishing houses, journalists and editors. Ri Il Hwan in his speech noted that Chairman Kim Jong Il formulated the immortal Juche idea into Kimilsungism, developed it as required by the times and the developing revolution and thus glorified it as the eternal guiding idea in the era of independence. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un has authored a lot of immortal works since the start of the new century of Juche and indicated the road of the historic struggle for strengthening the Party's leadership role in every way and ushering in an era of our state-first principle, he stressed. Rodong Sinmun

title: Oath-taking Meeting of Youths
body: An oath-taking meeting of youths took place on Feb. 10 on the occasion of the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Attending the meeting held before the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill were officials of the youth league and youths and students. Prior to the meeting, its participants placed a floral basket and bouquets before the statues of the great leaders and made a deep bow toward them. Then, led by Mun Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League, the participants vowed to hold Chairman Kim Jong Il in high esteem for all ages and accelerate the comprehensive development of Korean-style socialist construction under the leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. All the participants chanted slogans reflecting their determination to fully display the heroic stamina and wisdom of the Korean youth in the struggle for bringing about a fresh victory in socialist construction. Rodong Sinmun

title: Week of Film Show Begins in DPRK
body: A week of film show began in the capital city and provinces of the DPRK in the run-up to the Day of the Shining Star, the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. "The Shining Star of Mt Paektu" and "Shine, Jong Il Peak" and other documentary films dealing with the revolutionary career and exploits of the Chairman and feature films such as "Former Bodyguard" will be screened at cinemas and cultural halls across the country. An opening ceremony took place at the Pyongyang International Cinema House on Thursday. Present there were Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and officials, creators and artistes in the film industry and working people in Pyongyang City. An opening address was made by Jong Yong Nam, director-general of the National Administration of Motion Picture Industry. At the end of the ceremony, the participants watched Part 1 "Life Dedicated to People" of the documentary film "General Kim Jong Il, Peerless Patriot." Rodong Sinmun

title: Oath-taking Meeting of Workers and Trade Union Members Held in DPRK
body: A meeting of workers and trade union members took place at the plaza before the statue of Chairman Kim Jong Il in Samjiyon City of Ryanggang Province, the DPRK on Thursday. The participants in the event pledged to hold the Chairman in high esteem forever and remain true to the idea and guidance of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. Present there were officials concerned, trade union officials, and workers and trade union members in the city. The participants laid a floral basket and bouquets and made a bow before the statue. A letter of pledge to Kim Jong Un was read out by Pak In Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea. The letter stressed that the revolutionary career of Chairman Kim Jong Il was the most brilliant one of an outstanding leader and peerless patriot who firmly defended the destiny of the country and the people and put socialist Korea on the status of a dignified power despite the stern trials of history. It expressed the revolutionary will of all the participants to hold the Chairman in high esteem as the eternal leader of the Workers' Party of Korea and the revolution and the sun of Juche generation after generation and to devotedly implement his instructions without any deflection or concession. All the workers and trade union members, deeming Kim Jong Il's birthplace in the Paektusan Secret Camp their mental pillar, will vigorously carry on the march started in Mt Paektu under the guidance of Kim Jong Un and add glory to the tradition of loyalty of the workers of the former generations and the history of single-minded unity, it pointed out. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Floral Basket and Congratulatory Letter from Diplomatic Corps Here
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a floral basket and a congratulatory letter from the diplomatic corps here on the occasion of the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The basket and letter were conveyed to Kim Song Nam, director of the International Department of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, by Russian Ambassador to the DPRK Alexandr Matsegora and Cuban Ambassador to the DPRK Jesus De Los Angeles Aise Sotolongo on behalf of the corps at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Feb. 10. On the same day, Kim Jong Un received a floral basket and a congratulatory letter from Vietnamese Ambassador to the DPRK Le Ba Binh and a congratulatory letter from the Cuban ambassador. Rodong Sinmun

title: Diplomatic Corps Here Visit Oun Revolutionary Site
body: Members of the diplomatic corps here visited the Oun Revolutionary Site on Thursday on the occasion of the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. They went round several places of the site, being briefed on the fact that Kim Jong Il further acquired the personality and qualification of a brilliant commander through his energetic ideo-theoretical and military activities in the days of military camping in Juche 51 (1962). At the end of the visit, they made entries in the visitor's books. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Floral Basket from Palestinian President
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a floral basket from Mahmoud Abbas, president of the State of Palestine, on Feb. 10 on the occasion of the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Makes Speech at Ground-breaking Ceremony for Construction of 10 000 Flats in Hwasong Area
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un made a speech "Let Us Further Glorify the Golden Age of Capital City Construction by Bringing About a Sea Change in the Hwasong Area" at the ground-breaking ceremony for the construction of 10 000 flats in the Hwasong area on February 12. The full text of the speech reads: Comrades, Today, filled with fresh vigour and self-confidence, we are holding a meaningful ground-breaking ceremony for building in our capital city a new street for the people, a street symbolic of an era of another transformation. First of all, I, on behalf of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and the government, would like to extend warm congratulations and greetings to the builders of the capital city and the service personnel, who are starting our struggle in the grandiose year of 2022 through this grand ground-breaking ceremony for a project to build 10 000 flats in the Hwasong area true to the decisions adopted at the Fourth Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Party. This project, one of the major tasks facing the construction sector this year, is the second of its kind for hitting the long-term goal of housing construction in Pyongyang, which our Party aspires to and which started last year; it is also the first stage of building a new, modern urban district in this area. The long-term capital city development plan approved by our Party and the government envisages creation in this area, which is near the sacred place of the sun and adjoins September 9 Street, of splendid streets and a new administrative district with flats, numbering well over ten thousand, public buildings and welfare service facilities. This will be done within three years or so. If the goal of building 50 000 flats in Pyongyang, including that of this gigantic project, is hit with success, our Party will have fulfilled the most important promise it made to the people and the housing problem of the citizens of our capital city will have been solved once and for all. This is why the Party and the government is forcefully pushing ahead with the construction of 10 000 flats in Pyongyang every year even though the present conditions and circumstances are more difficult than ever before. Comrades, We have become able to launch this important and gigantic project in the Hwasong area as planned in the second year of implementing the decisions of the Eighth Congress of the Party entirely thanks to the efforts of the builders and service personnel, who have turned out in Pyongyang's development. Last year the project to build 10 000 flats in the Songsin and Songhwa area was conducted under arduous conditions, where the country's economic situation was harsh and difficulties piled up. However, our builders bravely promoted the construction as planned, overcoming all the trials with indomitable will and a strenuous effort, thus building at the eastern gate of Pyongyang a splendid street, lined with high-rise and superhigh-rise apartment houses, in less than one year. As a result, we can now visualize many citizens of the capital city moving in delight into new houses on the new street in the run-up to the Day of the Sun. The Fourth Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Party Central Committee made a high appreciation of this. As there was such a struggle and substantial success, our Party Central Committee could decide on and organize the construction of 10 000 flats of the next stage with confidence, and today we are holding a ground-breaking ceremony, officially proclaiming the start of housing construction in the Hwasong area. Our Party has no doubt in the least that the elated enthusiasm for labour and aggressive spirit for advancement witnessed last year will be displayed in this year's project and more inspiring and more meaningful successes will be achieved. Our builders are proud artists and dignified trail-blazers who, possessed of miraculous power, write a new chapter of the history of prosperity and development in the era of the Workers' Party. As the Party's people-oriented policies have been put into reality wherever the workers of the country's major construction units and service personnel of the People's Army are dispatched, homes where many people will live generation after generation are appearing and monumental creations symbolic of the civilization of the era springing up each and every year. In the course of a fierce struggle for grand construction, vacillation and inability are overcome, courage and wisdom displayed, backwardness and stagnation eliminated, progress and innovations made, and our state's and people's might for shaping the future increased. In short, our vigorous advance and development will be proved in practice and all that hampers this, that is, objective and subjective challenges, will be broken to pieces and lose power. And this itself will be a crushing blow to the forces hostile towards us. This is the very change, revolution and victory we aspire to. And the masters who stand in the vanguard of this revolution are none other than you, builders. Our builders are pioneers and dependable vanguard fighters of our era, who conceive morrow though they are living today and bring the beautiful future earlier. I am convinced that, thanks to our Party's correct policy of construction and to the builders' creative labour, our construction will change and develop into a more advanced and progressive sector, while sustaining its socialist character, the original feature of our people-first architecture, which consistently serves the purpose of promoting the people's wellbeing. In building apartment houses in the Hwasong area this year, we should push ahead with the grand construction project in a more dynamic and scrupulous way by making the most of the experiences and lessons we learned from the construction of 10 000 flats in the Songsin and Songhwa area. The grand construction campaign is a gigantic creative effort to bring new entities into existence by concentrating human, material and technical potentialities of the country on it. Therefore, whether it results in complete success or not depends on how it is planned and commanded. The construction headquarters should, by taking into careful consideration the existing building forces, capacities of building materials production and transport as well as seasonal factors, make a well-thought-out plan for each process of designing and building work, and push ahead with it forcefully. In construction we should aspire to giving definite precedence to the supply of building materials and ensuring both the quality and speed of construction by enhancing the role of building units and supervision organs. What is important here is to steadily execute scientific proposals and plans, aimed at developing the construction sector in a prospective way, by eradicating the short-sighted view of laying stress only on immediate building tasks in planning and commanding construction projects. The grand construction campaign of national importance, including the development of Pyongyang, is far from something to be done in a year or two; it is a long-term undertaking to be continued on an ever higher level even when all our people live in good houses and even after our country has undergone a facelift. Therefore, there should be no delay or stagnation in whatever is related with our construction sector, typically in consolidating its material and technical foundations in terms of both quality and quantity, in producing various kinds of building materials domestically, in raising the proportion of work done by machines and in introducing advanced methods and architectural technology extensively. In the whole course of construction such tasks should be reflected in planning, designing, materials supply and standards at every building stage, carried out and reviewed. And innovative initiatives, reasonable technical proposals and audacious endeavours should be actively encouraged and presented. In this way, when a new street of 10 000 flats is built year after year, not only the appearances of the capital city and further that of the country will be changed but also our construction forces should grow in strength and a new development should be made in the mode of construction. All in all, with the simultaneous promotion of the work of successfully carrying on the construction of houses and putting our construction sector on a modern basis, we will prepare ourselves to carry on more gigantic and greater construction projects in the future. Our Party regards as an important and decisive factor that is vital to its success the great enthusiasm, sense of responsibility and sincere efforts of every official and builder towards construction. This is why inspiring slogans are put on, red flags flutter and marches resound at our socialist construction sites. Novel and moving political work encourages every one to cherish ennobling ideals and beautiful hopes, to feel the honour and pride that their enthusiasm and endeavour has become a source of great strength of their collective, and to get inspiration from other's positive examples and merits. It is a dynamic force peculiar to socialism, which trains ordinary working people into performers of innovations and feats and which works miracles under any conditions. You should conduct vigorous frontline-style political work so that all the builders can feel the sense of mission and pleasure that they create with their own hands the daily-renewing happiness and development of our times, and so that they can take great pride in bringing a more cultured future earlier through their own efforts. You should create a hot wind of collective emulation drive for overtaking and learning from one another and give fuller play to your patriotic enthusiasm. By doing so, you can build flourishing socialist living quarters, which are permeated with a great generation's indomitable perseverance and untiring spirit of creation and which are brimming with the people's laughter of happiness, in this very Hwasong area before the eyes of the world. Comrades, Today our grand construction front covers not only this construction site of 10 000 flats in the capital city but the whole country. A large number of construction projects, which have been designed for our great state's prosperity and development and for the people's well-being, are being prepared or under way in large metallurgical bases, chemical industry bases, construction sites of new power plants, tideland reclamation sites, Komdok and Ryonpho areas and rural communities across the country. Among all the construction projects that will constitute a powerful engine of the comprehensive development of socialist construction, the house construction project in the Hwasong area is the main theatre that should take the lead. In implementing the Party's policy of construction in a perfect and thoroughgoing way and conducting intense and energetic campaigns in high spirits, the construction units deployed in the Hwasong area should naturally become standard-bearers and models for all other theatres of construction. I firmly believe that all the builders and service personnel present here, bearing in mind an extraordinary sense of glory and pride in building a new street for the people, will complete with credit the construction project in the Hwasong area as scheduled with redoubled wisdom, enthusiasm and fortitude. For the great new era of the development of our own style of socialism, For our Pyongyang, and To bring earlier the happy day, when our parents, brothers, sisters and children will move into new flats of the dramatically transformed Hwasong area, Let us all struggle dynamically.

title: Ground-breaking Ceremony for Construction of 10 000 flats in Hwasong Area Held
body: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Makes Meaningful Speech at Ceremony A new project for building 10 000 flats started in the capital city of Pyongyang amid the growing revolutionary enthusiasm and devoted efforts of the people across the country to celebrate the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il as a great revolutionary auspicious event. The construction of 10 000 flats in the Hwasong area will begin under the plan for building 50 000 flats in Pyongyang City set forth at the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea and the decision made at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the Party Central Committee. The housing construction projects undertaken by our Party one after another serve as a striking demonstration of the people-first principle and the power of strenuous execution of its Central Committee that subordinates and orients everything to bringing earlier a new world of a prosperous power where the people enjoy the highest dignity and the best happiness. A ground-breaking ceremony for the construction of 10 000 flats in the Hwasong area was held with splendor on February 12. The venue for the ceremony was overflowing with the enthusiasm of the soldier-builders and civilian-builders determined to translate the long-cherished desire of our Party into a brilliant reality and take the lead in accelerating the development of our-style socialist civilization by ceaselessly performing exploits in the most worthwhile and glorious work determined by the Party Congress, true to the new construction revolution programme of the Party Central Committee. Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, attended the ground-breaking ceremony. When the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un arrived at the venue for the ceremony, all the participants greeted him with enthusiastic cheers of "Hurrah!" as a token of their reverence for him who brings about the bright morrow of a highly civilized and prosperous power and ushers in a new era of startling changes with his steel-strong faith, far-sighted wisdom and invincible leadership, remaining faithful to his great duty for the country, the people and the revolution. Present there were Jo Yong Won and Kim Tok Hun, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, Ri Il Hwan and O Su Yong, secretaries of the Party Central Committee, Pak Hun, vice-premier of the Cabinet, and other Party and government cadres, and officials in the city including those of the Cabinet, ministries and national institutions. Also present were Ri Yong Gil, Kim Jong Gwan and other officials of the armed forces organs. When the start of the ceremony was declared, the national anthem of the DPRK was solemnly played. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un made a meaningful speech "Let Us Further Glorify the Golden Age of Capital City Construction by Bringing about a Sea change in the Hwasong Area." Expressing his pleasure over the ground-breaking ceremony for building another new street for people symbolic of the era of great changes in the capital city full of fresh courage and confidence, Kim Jong Un warmly congratulated, on behalf of the Party Central Committee and the DPRK government, the capital city builders and service personnel of the People's Army on opening up a prelude to the struggle in 2022 by starting with a splendid ceremony the construction of 10 000 flats in the Hwasong area, true to the decisions made at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee. He said that the construction of 10 000 flats in the Hwasong area, one of the top priority tasks facing the construction sector this year, is not only the second project for carrying out the long-term goal for housing construction in Pyongyang City, a long-cherished plan of the Party whose implementation started last year, but also the first-stage construction for turning the area into a new modern town. He highly praised the service personnel and civilians involved in the construction of 10 000 flats in the Songsin, Songhwa areas, the eastern gateway to Pyongyang, for turning the areas into an excellent street with their indomitable spirit and strenuous efforts, thus achieving great successes and providing a sure guarantee for pushing ahead with the housing construction in the Hwasong area, as planned, this year, the second year for implementing the decisions made at the 8th Party Congress. Expressing the belief that their sky-high enthusiasm and the spirit of the offensive will be fully displayed in the construction of 10 000 flats to be launched in the Hwasong area and more encouraging and significant greater successes achieved in the construction project, he advanced the tasks and ways to dynamically and scrupulously conduct the grand construction campaign this year. Terming the construction of 10 000 flats in the Hwasong area the major thrust, in which the biggest progress should be made, on the front of the great construction involving the whole country, he expressed expectation that the construction units deployed in the Hwasong area would dedicate all their wisdom, enthusiasm and high spirit to the sacred construction campaign by taking the lead in the campaign and becoming examples to the builders of other construction sites. When Kim Jong Un finished his impassioned speech, all the builders raised stormy cheers of "Hurrah!", filled with a firm will to build a thriving street symbolic of socialism in the Hwasong area and ensure the continuity of the heyday in the capital city construction by dint of indomitable tenacity and inexhaustible spirit of creation, true to the noble intention of Kim Jong Un who goes to great pains for a new great era of the development of Korean-style socialism, for the capital city of Pyongyang and for the people's happiness to be brought into full bloom along with new magnificent streets. A letter of pledge to the Party was read out by Kim Jong Gwan at the ceremony. He mentioned the builders' high enthusiasm to live up to the deep trust of the Party Central Committee which unfolded a grandiose blueprint for turning the area near the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the sacred temple of Juche, into an icon of the Korean-style socialist civilization and called them to the sacred construction site. Noting that all the builders regard it as a due obligation and bounden duty of them who are the descendants of President Kim Il Sung and soldiers and disciples of Chairman Kim Jong Il to spruce up the area near the palace, he said they will surely build a model street, fresh wealth of the people vividly representing the great era of Kim Jong Un and the ideal of the Party, as scheduled by its Central Committee, in the Hwasong area, on which the global attention is focused, as expected by the people. The letter expressed the steadfast will of the builders to create a new construction speed of Hwasong, the myth of Hwasong, in the decisive campaign of loyalty, holding aloft the flag of the headquarters of the construction of 50 000 flats in Pyongyang, which Kim Jong Un personally handed over to them, as a banner of struggle and advance. All the soldier-builders solemnly made a pledge of loyalty toward the Party that they would strikingly demonstrate to the world what kind of miracle will be made under the grandiose plan of the Party Central Committee remaining faithful to the people by bringing about a tremendous change in the Hwasong area through an all-out drive with full confidence in victory. Then there was a blasting, signaling the beginning of the construction of 10 000 flats in the Hwasong area. Following the blast, fireworks were displayed in the sky along with thunderous cheers. The soldier-builders and civilian-builders chanted slogans representing their pledge to devotedly carry out the plan of the Party out of their will to fully demonstrate their honor and spirit as proud creators and dignified pioneers who write a new history of prosperity and development in the era of the WPK in the construction of the Hwasong area. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un warmly waved back to the trustworthy soldier-builders and civilian-builders as a token of his encouragement to them who have gone all out for the grand construction campaign for demonstrating the militant might of the great WPK and the revolutionary spirit of socialist Korea, true to the intention and will of the Party Central Committee. The construction of 10 000 flats in the Hwasong area will clearly prove the fervent patriotic zeal and extraordinary creativity of the Korean people vigorously advancing toward the bright future of socialism and the development level and potentialities of the country dynamically advancing toward the attainment of grand goals, guided by the great Party Central Committee. Political News Team

title: National Sketch and Calligraphy Festival Opens in DPRK
body: A national sketch and calligraphy festival was opened with due ceremony as part of the national art festival "Career of Patriotic Devotion" for celebrating the Day of the Shining Star, the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Seen at the venue of the festival is an art piece depicting President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il watching the calligraphy of a schoolgirl. On Display are hundreds of pieces of art works in diverse themes including sketches made by professionals and amateurs and calligraphic works depicting famous sentences and lines of poems in a mellowed style. There are also art works dealing with the reverence of all the people across the country for Kim Jong Il who led the socialist cause of Juche only to victory. Among the art works are those depicting young people who volunteer to work in the difficult and labor-consuming fields in response to the call of the Party and happy looks of children. An opening ceremony took place at the Okryu Exhibition Hall on Feb. 11. Attending it were Jo Kyong Jun, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Mun Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League, Kim Song Min, chairman of the Central Committee of the Artists Union of Korea, officials concerned, creators and working people in Pyongyang City. Minister of Culture Sung Jong Gyu made an opening address. Rodong Sinmun

title: Performance of Youth League Art Squad Marks Birthday of Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: The art squad of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League gave a performance at the Central Youth Hall on Feb. 11 to commemorate the 80th birthday of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Put on the stage of the performance, which began with the prelude "A Dear Name", were mixed chorus "O Korea, I Will Add Glory to Thee", an immortal masterpiece, piano solo and mixed chorus "Shine, Jong Il Peak" and other numbers. The performers sang highly of the revolutionary career and exploits of the Chairman who was born in Mt Paektu and dedicated himself to the prosperity of the country and the people's happiness all his life. The performance represented the pride and confidence of the youth who demonstrated their might as a reliable advanced group and wing of the Party in the struggle for defending the country and socialist construction under the guidance of the Chairman. It also vividly depicted the appearance of the youth enjoying endless glory and happiness under the care of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un who is ushering in a heyday of the Juche-oriented youth movement. Among the audience were Ri Tu Song, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Mun Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League, youth league officials, young people and students in Pyongyang City. Rodong Sinmun

title: Joint National Meeting of KCU Organizations Held in DPRK
body: A joint national meeting of the Korean Children's Union (KCU) organizations was held in Pyongyang on Friday to commemorate the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. It was attended by students of Mangyongdae Revolutionary School and Kang Pan Sok Revolutionary School, schoolchildren in Pyongyang and new members of the KCU. Invited to the event were Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Kim Yong Hwan, chief secretary of the Pyongyang City Committee of the WPK, Ri Tu Song, department director of the Central Committee of the WPK, officials of the youth league and merited persons of the city. Mun Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League, made a report. He referred to the undying exploits Chairman Kim Jong Il performed by bringing up the rising generations to be pillars of future Korea with his warm love. He recalled that the Chairman visited many schools and school children's palaces to take warm care of the school children so that they could grow up to be cheerful and stalwart ones, knowledgeable, morally impeccable and physically fit. Thanks to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un who bestows great love and benevolence on the KCU members, regarding them as treasure of the country, a rosier future is in store for the rising generations, the reporter stressed. He called on all KCU members to cherish the great love and trust of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un and prepare themselves to be genuine sons and daughters of the socialist country and young revolutionaries, true to the pledge they made before the KCU flag. Then, an admission ceremony for new KCU members began. Led by Secretary Ri Il Hwan, new KCU members were sworn in. Officials and merited persons put red ties around their necks and pinned KCU badges on their uniforms. Congratulatory speeches were made by Pak In Ho, a lecturer of the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum, Choe Yong Rim, a section chief of Kim Il Sung University, and Kim Chun Hui, secretary general of the Weightlifting Association. Rodong Sinmun

title: First People's Art Festival Celebrating Day of Shining Star Opens in DPRK
body: The First People's Art Festival Celebrating the Day of the Shining Star opened with due ceremony in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK on the occasion of the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The festival, which brings together more than 2 900 artistes, officials and working people of 40-odd groups selected from each region and unit, is to be held in the forms of provincial performances and performances by art groups from ministries and national institutions. The opening ceremony took place at the East Pyongyang Grand Theatre on Friday. Present there were Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Ri Song Hak, vice-premier of the Cabinet, officials concerned and the participants in the festival. In his opening address, Sung Jong Gyu, minister of Culture and chairman of the festival organizing committee, said that the festival is an all-people grand political art festival peculiar to Juche Korea where the participants will represent through dances and songs the people's invariable, wholehearted loyalty to Chairman Kim Jong Il and their firm faith and revolutionary will to hasten a new victory of socialist construction under the guidance of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. The speaker expressed the belief that all the participants would actively contribute to revving up the festive mood of the auspicious February holiday and making the whole society burn with enthusiasm for the revolution and struggle by singing loudly of the immortal revolutionary feats of the Chairman and fully displaying the ideological and spiritual qualities of the revolutionary people and the artistic abilities. The flag of the festival was hoisted amid the playing of the song "Shine, Jong Il Peak". Then followed an opening performance. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Congratulatory Message from Russian Party Leader
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a congratulatory message from G. A. Zyuganov, chairman of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation, on February 9. Saying that the 80th birth anniversary of Kim Jong Il, eternal general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and leader of the DPRK, is approaching, the message noted that he made a great contribution to the building of socialist society in the DPRK. He was a genuine patriot of the country and thoroughgoing implementer of the WPK's idea and a great man who regarded it as his lifetime task to bear responsibility for the present and future of the Korean people and achieve the development of the country, it stressed. It said that under his guidance the Korean people made remarkable successes in the fields of science, industry and culture and put the national defence capability on a new level. It added that the working people of the DPRK are now building their rosy future with confidence, true to the behests of Comrades Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il. The message wished the Korean people big success and prosperity. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: The participants in the First People's Art Festival Celebrating the Day of the Shining Star visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on February 11. They laid a floral basket and bouquets before the statues of the great leaders and made a bow to them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Baskets to Statues of Great Leaders from Abroad
body: Foreign organization and personages sent floral baskets to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill here on the occasion of the 80th birth anniversary of Kim Jong Il. They are the Mongolian preparatory committee for celebrating the Day of the Shining Star, the chief of the Kim Jong Il Library in Ecuador, the curator of the Kim Jong Suk Library in Peru and the chairman of the Mongolian Cultural and Research Center of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. The floral baskets were placed at the statues of the great leaders on February 11. Rodong Sinmun

title: State Academic Degrees and Titles Conferred on Exemplary Intellectuals in DPRK
body: State academic degrees and titles were conferred on exemplary intellectuals on the occasion of the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. They achieved research successes conducive to the development of the national economy and improvement of the people's living standard and tangibly contributed to the education of the rising generations through their strenuous efforts. Professorship went to 27 persons including Kang Chol, department head of Kim Il Sung University, Kim Yong Chol, faculty head of Kim Chaek University of Technology, Choe Pom Hun, director of the post-graduate school of Pyongyang University of Transport, Hwang I Chol, academic advisor to the University of National Economy, Ri Yong Sok, department head of the Phyongsong University of Veterinary Science and Animal Husbandry, Kim Chol Su, director of the Academy of Coal Mining Science, and Kim Un Chol, deputy director of Korea General Red Cross Hospital. Doctorate was conferred on 105 persons including Choe Myong Ok, teacher of Kim Il Sung University, Sim Kyong Ho, teacher of Kim Chaek University of Technology, Kim Song Chol, department head of Pyongyang University of Mechanical Engineering, Mun Yong Ran, a teacher of the University of Sciences, Ri Il Ju, a researcher of Pyongyang University of Architecture, Jang Hak Chol, deputy department head of Phyongsong University of Coal Mining, Chae Yong Chol, section chief of Hamhung University of Hydraulic Engineering, and Ri Yong Chol, manager of the Tokchon Area Coal-Mining Complex, and Ri Kye Bong, manager of the Kumsong Tractor Factory. Associate professorship went to 110 persons and master's degree to 991. Rodong Sinmun

title: Industrial Art Exhibitions Open to Mark Day of Shining Star
body: Industrial art exhibitions celebrating the Day of the Shining Star (the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il) opened in Pyongyang and every province in the DPRK. Displayed at the exhibition venues are model designs personally guided by Chairman Kim Jong Il and the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. Industrial artists and amateurs from across the country presented new designs and products conducive to the economic and cultural development of each respective area and improvement of the standard of people's living. The theme of the exhibition in Pyongyang is "Bringing the beautiful dreams and ideals of the people into reality" and it showcases an artwork depicting Kim Jong Il visiting his birthplace in the Paektusan Secret Camp. Also on display are new designs of school uniforms as well as designs for streets and building roofs in Pyongyang. Typical of them are those showing greening decorations at crossroads and roof greening characterized by combination of Juche character with national identity and modernity. On display at provincial exhibitions are unique designs helpful for local construction, betterment of people's living, modernization of local industrial factories and production of consumer goods. Among the exhibits are designs and products including various hairpins for women and varieties of bags and shoes showing the people's demands and tastes as well as advertisements. The exhibition will last until the middle of March. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Ambassador Meets Iranian President
body: The DPRK ambassador to Iran met the president of the Islamic Republic of Iran on February 10. Ambassador Han Song U cordially conveyed the warm congratulations and greetings sent by Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the DPRK, to President Seyyed Ebrahim Raeisi on the occasion of the 43rd anniversary of the victory in the revolution of the Islamic revolution of Iran. The president expressed deep thanks for it and asked the ambassador to convey his sincere greetings to Kim Jong Un. Wishing the government of the DPRK big successes in its work for the prosperity of the country and people's wellbeing, the Iranian president hoped that the friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries would grow stronger. Rodong Sinmun

title: Art Performances Commemorate Day of Shining Star in DPRK
body: Performances were given here as a curtain-raiser to the First People's Art Festival Celebrating the Day of the Shining Star (birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il) on Saturday. Performances were given by artistes from South Hwanghae Province and Jagang Province at the East Pyongyang Grand Theatre. Those from Kangwon Province and North Hwanghae Province gave a performance at the Ponghwa Art Theatre. A performance by artistes from South Hamgyong Province and North Phyongan Province was held at the Central Youth Hall and a performance by art groups from ministries and national institutions at the People's Palace of Culture. Through the performances, artistes of the provincial art troupes and art squads and officials and working people of the ministries and national institutions, industrial establishments and co-op farms gave an elegant artistic description of the deep reverence of all the people for the Chairman and their pride and confidence of opening up a new era of national prosperity under the guidance of the Party. The performances vividly represented the revolutionary will of all the people to hold President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in high esteem as the sun of Juche forever and remain single-heartedly loyal to the leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. Among the audience were officials of ministries and national institutions, workers, young people and students in Pyongyang. The performances continue. Rodong Sinmun

title: Students in Their Final Year at Senior Middle Schools in Kangwon Province Make Study Tour to Chol Pass
body: Students of the graduating classes at senior middle schools in Kangwon Province made a study tour to Chol Pass associated with the traces of immortal Songun revolutionary leadership of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Under the guidance of the Kangwon Provincial Party Committee, at the youth league committee of the province they conducted with various forms and methods the ideological education to implant confidence in victory of our socialism and iron will in the students’ minds and to let them fully demonstrate resourcefulness and gallantry of youth in the present historic march towards a fresh victory of revolution. On February 6, students of graduating classes of the province left for Chol Pass after they had a kick-off meeting separately in every city and county. They set out on the tour march in soaring spirit and they were full of burning resolution to follow the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un to the end in accomplishing the revolutionary cause of Juche pioneered in Mt Paektu.
