They hastened their march singing the songs of faith and struggle with firm resolution to go along the road of revolution to the end. During the study tour they had a meeting to hear impressions of the reminiscences of anti-Japanese guerrillas and a poem recitation meeting. On the peak of the pass, they made up their minds to lead worthwhile lives by joining the army and volunteering to work at labor-consuming worksites as required by our Party. Rodong Sinmun

title: Serials of Memoirs "Glorifying the Era of Juche" Conveys Noble Revolutionary Life and Immortal Exploits of Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: The Workers’ Party of Korea Publishing House brought out Vol. 80 of memoirs "Glorifying the Era of Juche" on the occasion of the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The memoirs deal with several reminiscences which show the wise leadership and lofty personality of the Chairman who devoted his whole life to prosperity of the country and happiness of the people. Its first volume was brought out on Aug. 10, Juche 65(1976) in compliance with unanimous wishes of the whole people, officers and men of the Korean People’s Army and progressive mankind. Since then over ten million copies have been brought out in 80 volumes. They deal with 1 300-odd reminiscences of reminiscents of every walk of life who had met the Chairman in the past including anti-Japanese revolutionary fighters, officials of the Party, state, economic organs and working people’s organizations, officers and men of the KPA, workers, farmers, intellectuals, bereaved families of revolutionary and patriotic martyrs, overseas compatriots and so on. Contained in the memoirs are the leadership exploits of the Chairman in every unit and field of the revolution and construction such as the administration of the revolutionary relics, Party affairs, youth work, industry, agriculture, transportation, construction, land administration, city management, commerce, food administration, materials supply, etc. These reminiscences become the history of his revolutionary activities if they are put in daily order consecutively and his gem-like propositions recorded in the memoirs are precious guiding principles that our people must adhere to forever. The serials of the memoirs "Glorifying the Era of Juche" are the records in praise of the extraordinary leadership ability and lofty personality of the Chairman who performed undying exploits in carrying out the revolutionary cause of Juche true to the noble purpose of President Kim Il Sung. The serials of the memoirs which reflect the whole life of Chairman Kim Jong Il constitutes a textbook of life and struggle for all the Party members, working people, students and schoolchildren as well as a precious treasure of the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: January 15 of Lunar Calendar and Folk Customs
body: Jongwoldaeborum(the fifteenth day of the first month by the lunar calendar) is one of the folk holidays our people celebrate from olden times as well as the Lunar New Year’s Day and Chusok(Harvest Moon Day). Jongwoldaeborum is the first full-moon day in the lunar new year. From olden times our people used to celebrate the Jongwoldaeborum most splendidly after the Lunar New Year’s Day, regarding it as an important occasion to pray for the bumper harvest, bumper catch and happiness in the year. Our people used to celebrate the holiday from the January fourteenth of the lunar calendar. All formalities, amusements and foods on the days were related with the happiness and bumper crops of the year. Included in the formalities were setting up poles with grains on January 14th of the lunar calendar and enjoying the first full moon. Our people used to set up long poles on the ground and hang ears of grains like rice, kaoliang, millet and opened cotton fruits and etc. And they also carried manure on their back to rice fields early in the morning. Such customs were originated from their aspiration after rich harvest in the new year and sincere attitude towards labor. In the evening of the first full-moon day people went up to the hills at the back of their villages and talked each other looking up at the first full moon in the new year. Various folk games were played in the day such as kite-flying, revolving toy pinwheels, tug of war, etc. Boiled rice admixed with four other staple cereals and dishes made of nine kinds of dried edible herbs were typical festival foods on the day. Such various folk customs on the Jongwoldaeborum have been developed in close link with our people’s life. At present they are being preserved and developed in line with our socialist life developing day after day. Rodong Sinmun

title: To Provide Guarantee for Development of Pharmaceutical Industry
body: Officials and workers in the field of pharmaceutical industry have turned out as one to implement the task facing the public health sector set forth by the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea. Modernization is being propelled in pharmaceutical factories across the country. Officials and employees of the Pyongyang Pharmaceutical Factory, builders and shock brigade members make strenous efforts to hasten its completion in hearty response to the intention of the Party to successfully renovate the factory into a model and standard one in the pharmaceutical industrial sector of the country and thus modernize all the pharmaceutical factories. The Sunchon Pharmaceutical Factory and others set step-by-step goals for modernization and push ahead with the technical preparations for it, while accelerating the work for localizing and recycling raw materials and other materials. Meanwhile, the Hungnam Pharmaceutical Factory substantially conduct the work for localizing raw materials and intermediates necessary for production of medicines. The factory solves sci-tech problems arrising in localizing tens of kinds of raw materials and intermediates in reliance of its own technical forces and in close cooperation with relevant units. And it lays the foundation for putting the production of medicines on a normal basis by introducing into production various kinds of intermediates, technical preparations of which for localization were already completed. Similar works are being progressed in the Sinuiju Pharmaceutical Factory and others. Rodong Sinmun

title: Second-Day Performances of First People's Art Festival Given
body: The First People's Art Festival Celebrating the Day of the Shining Star, the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il, is now going on in Pyongyang successfully. The second-day performances were given at the People's Palace of Culture, the East Pyongyang Grand Theatre, the Ponghwa Art Theatre and the Central Youth Hall on February 13. Artistes of the provincial art troupes, members of art squads and itinerant art squads and art group members of the ministries, national institutions, counties, industrial establishments and co-op farms put on the stage colorful numbers praising the great exploits the Chairman performed before the century and his noble revolutionary career. Performers also sang highly of the greatness of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un who is ushering in on this land a new world and a new era, where the people's ideals and happiness and desire for a powerful country are comprehensively translated into reality, with his rare wisdom, seasoned leadership and warm love for the people. The performances hardened the revolutionary spirit and militant stamina of the Korean people to hold the Chairman in high esteem as the sun of Juche forever and bring without fail the future of communism powerful, civilized and prosperous on this land, rallied close around Kim Jong Un. Officials of ministries and national institutions, working people and youth and students in Pyongyang watched the performances. The festival continues. Rodong Sinmun

title: Field Survey by DPRK Premier
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, inspected the State Academy of Sciences and the construction site for the establishment of C-1 chemical industry. At the State Academy of Sciences, he called upon its scientists and researchers to focus on technical development and perfection, which are of crucial significance in the economic construction and the improvement of the people's living standard, and to enhance their responsibility and creativity in their drive for carrying out the important research tasks, true to the decisions of the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Learning about the progress made in the project for establishing C-1 chemical industry, he stressed the need for officials and builders to attain the goal for this year's struggle, well aware of the Party Central Committee's intention to develop the chemical industry into the sector stronger in independence. The field consultative meetings urged officials, scientists and researchers to give full play to their creativity with redoubled efforts, discussing the issues of strengthening the organic nexus and cooperation between scientific and research institutes and of pushing ahead with the project for establishment of C-1 chemical industry as planned. Rodong Sinmun

title: Officials in Construction Sector Tour Pyongyang
body: The participants in the 2nd grand short course for officials in the construction sector toured several places in Pyongyang. They visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. Being briefed on the historical data and relics displayed at the Mangyongdae Revolutionary Museum, the visitors keenly realized that socialist Korea is the most precious legacy left by the President for the people. They saw historical relics preserved with much care at the old home of the President. The participants also toured the Korean Revolution Museum, the Sci-Tech Complex, the Pothong Riverside Terraced Residential District and the Songsin and Songhwa areas. Rodong Sinmun

title: Synchronized Swimming Demonstration Marks Day of Shining Star
body: A synchronized swimming demonstration in celebration of the Day of the Shining Star, the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il, took place at the Indoor Swimming Pool Complex in Chongchun Street of Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, on Feb. 13. The event began with group synchronized swimming "A Dear Name". It showed the loyalty of the Korean people yearning for the Chairman, who was born as the Shining Star of Mt Paektu and performed undying feats during the protracted Juche revolution. The demonstration won great applauses of the audience as it showed the Korean people's strong desire and will to create a praiseworthy history of prosperity of the country, true to the leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un creditably carrying forward the idea and cause of the Chairman. Enjoying it were Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Kim Song Ryong, vice-premier of the Cabinet, Ri Tu Song, department director of the Party Central Committee, Kim Il Guk, minister of Physical Culture and Sports, officials concerned and university students in Pyongyang. Rodong Sinmun

title: 2nd Conference of Secretaries of Primary Party Committees to Be Convened in Pyongyang
body: The 2nd Conference of Secretaries of Primary Committees of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) is to be convened in Pyongyang during the latter part of February in the period of dynamism when the entire Party and all the people go all out for the implementation of the fighting programme drawn up at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the WPK, guided by the great Party Central Committee. The WPK Central Committee decided to convene the conference in order to review the work for implementing the tasks set forth at the 1st Conference of Chairpersons of Primary Party Committees and thoroughly carry out the tasks set forth at the 8th Party Congress by radically increasing the fighting efficiency of the primary Party organizations, the lower-echelon organizations and main fighting units of the Party, as required by the new era when the Korean-style socialism has entered the phase of comprehensive development. The conference will serve as an occasion of great significance in establishing the unified leadership system of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un throughout the Party, further cementing the organizational and ideological foundation and the single-minded unity of the revolutionary ranks and accelerating the all-people march for the prosperity and development of our great state. Rodong Sinmun

title: Fifth Meeting of 24th Central Committee of Chongryon Held
body: The fifth meeting of the 24th Central Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) took place at the Central Hall of Chongryon in Tokyo on Feb. 11. It was attended by Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, Pak Ku Ho, its first vice-chairman and director of its Organization Department, and vice-chairpersons, the chairman of the Central Audit Committee of Chongryon, department directors and advisers of the Central Standing Committee of Chongryon, members of the Central Committee and the Central Audit Committee of Chongryon and the director of the Research Institute on History of Korean Residents in Japan. At the meeting, Ho Jong Man made a report on the agenda item "On glorifying the 25th Congress of Chongryon as the one of single-hearted unity, inheritance and innovation." The reporter stressed that the respected Marshal Kim Jong Un called on Chongryon to make a big stride for the overall development in the movement of Koreans in Japan in step with the homeland in the year of great auspicious event to be recorded in the national history. He said that the national education work of Chongryon and business activities of Korean traders and industrialists in Japan are further revitalized under the parental love of the respected Marshal and the legal protection of the homeland and overseas compatriots of various strata are turning out in the patriotic movement with fresh faith and courage. He called for glorifying the 25th Congress of Chongryon as the epoch-making one of recording a new chapter of upsurge and innovation in the history of the movement of Koreans in Japan along with the homeland by putting spurs to the patriotic movement. Speakers expressed their determination to fulfill their bounden duties as officials in the historic advance of this significant year. The report of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee was adopted as a decision of the Central Committee of Chongryon at the meeting. The meeting also heard a report on the examination of qualifications before dismissing and by-electing some members of the Central Committee of Chongryon. A letter to Kim Jong Un was read out at the meeting. Rodong Sinmun

title: Phyongsong Building Materials Factory, Bee Institute Inaugurated in DPRK
body: The Phyongsong Building Materials Factory and the Bee Institute of the Academy of Agricultural Science have been inaugurated in the DPRK. The factory and the institute serve as material and technical foundations for pushing ahead with the rural construction in real earnest with the locally available raw and other materials and for successfully resolving the scientific and technical problems arising in breeding and keeping bees. The inaugural ceremonies took place on the spots on Feb. 14. Present there were An Kum Chol, chief secretary of the South Phyongan Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials in the province, working people, builders and employees of the factory and the institute. Rodong Sinmun

title: Celebration Meeting of Women's Union Officials and Members in DPRK
body: A meeting of women's union officials and members took place at the Hall of Women on Feb. 14 to celebrate the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Present there were Ri Tu Song, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Hong Chol Jin, secretary of the Pyongyang City Party Committee, officials of the Central Committee of the women's union and officials and members of the women's union in Pyongyang City. Kim Jong Sun, chairwoman of the C.C., Socialist Women's Union of Korea, made a report at the meeting to be followed by speeches. The reporter and speakers praised the revolutionary career and feats of the Chairman who dedicated his all to the prosperity of the country and the happiness of the people till the last day of his life since he took the first step of his great life in Mt Paektu. They noted that he firmly defended the country, holding aloft the banner of Juche and socialism, and turned it into an invincible political and ideological power by successfully realizing the single-minded unity between the Party and the masses. He was also a tender-hearted man who was thoughtful about the people's pains and shed lots of tears, and a benevolent father who loved the people and the rising generations very much, they said. The noble patriotic desire for building a powerful country kept by Kim Jong Il, who provided eternal foundation for the bright future of the socialist country with love for the country and the people, is being translated into shining reality thanks to the leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, they stressed. Rodong Sinmun

title: Dancing party of Women's Union Officials and Members
body: A dancing party of officials and members of the women's union took place at the plaza of the Arch of Triumph in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, on Feb. 14 to celebrate the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The dancing party started with the playing of the song "Fortune of Korea". The participants danced to the tunes of such songs as "Thunder over Jong Il Peak" and "February Is Spring" with boundless reverence for the Chairman who brought about a bright future of socialist Korea thriving for all ages with love for the country and the people. All the faces of the participants were shining with pleasure and happiness of leading a worthwhile life as flowers of the country, life and family while pushing one of the two wheels of the revolutionary chariot under the care of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. Amid the playing of such songs as "Your Embrace Is the Best" and "Victory Will be Won Generation after Generation", the dancing party reached its climax. Rodong Sinmun

title: Grand Performance Given
body: A grand performance in celebration of the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il "Shine, Jong Il Peak" was given at the Pyongyang Indoor Stadium on Feb. 14. The national anthem of the DPRK was solemnly played and then the performance began with mixed duet and chorus "Ode to Comrade Kim Jong Il" and orchestral music and chorus "Shine, Jong Il Peak". The program of the performance included monumental anthems, songs in praise of the Workers' Party and famous songs on the theme of patriotism. "Our Comrade Kim Jong Il", "The General Is the Son of the Guerrillas", an immortal classic masterpiece "O Korea, I Will Add Glory to Thee" and other songs in praise of the Chairman and famous songs of the times were played to arouse the deep yearning and reverence of all the people for Kim Jong Il, the father of the nation. Through famous songs in praise of his rare and outstanding personality as a great man, the performers showed that the Korean revolution could always emerge victorious and glorious thanks to the February holiday which brought great fortune to the Korean nation. Male quintet "People Are of a Single Mind", female chorus "Our Comrade Kim Jong Un", etc. vividly showed the pride of the Korean people led by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un translating into a brilliant reality the Chairman's patriotic desire for building a powerful country. Instrumental music and song for sand picture "We Are the Happiest in the World", male trio and chorus "Oh Party, It's Thanks to Your Care", etc. well represented the stamina of the socialist country dynamically advancing with confidence in victory. Pyongyang citizens appreciated the performance given by national art troupes and creators, artistes and students of art educational institutions. The performance will continue. Rodong Sinmun

title: Oratorical Meeting Held in DPRK
body: An oratorical meeting was held at the People's Palace of Culture in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, on Feb. 14 to celebrate the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The performers loudly praised the noble revolutionary life and immortal exploits of Kim Jong Il, a great-sage of the revolution, tender-hearted father of the people and peerless patriot, and impressively conveyed the great personality of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un who has written a new history of devoted service for the people on this land. They stressed that as the Chairman reliably defended the sovereignty of the country and the nation with arms out of iron-willed courage and pluck, the dignity of the Republic could be displayed to the full and the powerful and prosperous country could be provided. Present there were Ju Chang Il, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Sung Jong Gyu, minister of Culture, officials and working people in Pyongyang City. Rodong Sinmun

title: Young People Volunteer to Work in Major Sectors of Socialist Construction
body: Young people of South Hamgyong and Jagang provinces and Kaesong and Rason cities in the DPRK volunteered to work in major sectors of socialist construction. Over 190 youth league officials and young people in South Hamgyong Province volunteered to work in difficult and labor-consuming sectors of socialist construction. Youth league officials of Hamju and Pukchong counties and youth league members of Tanchon City and Hochon, Sinhung and Riwon counties vowed to work in the sectors of construction and land management. Young people of Jangjin, Hongwon and Kowon counties pledged to work at farms, and those of the provincial foreign trade administration bureau, Hamhung City and Jongphyong and Kumya counties volunteered to work at stockbreeding bases. Young people of Sinpho Distant-Sea Fishery Complex, Sinpho City, etc. vowed to work at the Ryonpho Vegetable Greenhouse Farm under construction. 50 youths in Jagang Province volunteered to work at major machine-building factories and co-op farms. Scores of young people in Kaesong and Rason cities, too, joined the ranks of volunteers. There were meetings on the spots to congratulate those volunteers. Rodong Sinmun

title: Third-Day Performances of First People's Art Festival Given
body: The third-day performances of the First People's Art Festival Celebrating the Day of the Shining Star, the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il, were given in Pyongyang on Feb. 14. The performances well showed the strong will of the Korean people to surely build on this land a powerful prosperous socialist country, desired by the Chairman. A performance of artistes from Jagang and South Hwanghae provinces was given at the East Pyongyang Grand Theatre, a performance by artistes from North Hwanghae and Kangwon provinces at the Ponghwa Art Theatre and a performance by artistes from North Phyongan and South Hamgyong provinces at the Central Youth Hall. A performance by art groups from ministries and national institutions took place at the People's Palace of Culture. The performances well represented the militant stamina and revolutionary optimism of the Korean people stepping up the general onward march for the prosperity of our state and the overall development of socialist construction under the guidance of the great Party while braving the unprecedented trials and hardships. The performances were enjoyed by officials of ministries and national institutions, working people, youth and students in Pyongyang. The performances continue. Rodong Sinmun

title: 2nd Grand Short Course for Officials in Construction Sector Closes
body: The 2nd grand short course for officials in the construction sector successfully closed in the DPRK. The short course, the second of its kind in the country's history of construction, served as an important milestone in opening up a new phase of creating socialist civilization by making another quality upsurge of the Juche-oriented architecture through fresh innovations in overall construction work. The letter "Let Us Lead the Development of Civilization of Our Own Style of Socialism by Waging a New Revolution in Construction" sent by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un to the participants in the short course is an inspiring banner that gave thousand-fold strength and courage to all the builders across the country and the servicepersons taking part in construction. It is also an immortal programme indicating a shortcut to the building of a highly-civilized and prosperous ideal socialist country. Through the short course held on the theme of "The rapid development of the Juche-oriented architecture and the period of great prosperity in construction", all its participants more thoroughly armed themselves with the Party's idea of Juche-oriented architecture and construction policy, shared examples and experience gained in performing the gigantic construction tasks and confirmed a clear way for giving a facelift to their units and regions. The short course helped the officials in the construction sector, who are directly in charge of a fresh revolution in construction, markedly raise their political and practical qualifications. The 7-day short course came to a close on Feb. 14. The participants adopted a letter of pledge to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un before closing the short course. The letter expressed the unshakable will of the participants to faithfully discharge their mission and duty as the advancing group and the pioneers leading Korean-style socialism to a fresh victory. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Birth Anniversary Marked Abroad
body: Seminars on Chairman Kim Jong Il's work "On the Juche Idea" and the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's work "Let Us Add Eternal Brilliance to Comrade Kim Jong Il's Great Idea and Achievements of the Songun Revolution" were held in Switzerland and Syria, and seminars on the exploits of the Chairman in Nepal, Bulgaria and Egypt. Present there were personages of political and public circles and people in those countries. The participants in the events highly praised the Chairman for his immortal exploits for the Korean revolution and the accomplishment of the cause of global independence. Noting that Kim Jong Il turned the DPRK into a dignified socialist state, the general secretary of the Central Committee of the Nepal Communist Party (Marxist-Leninist), the general secretary of the Central Committee of the Nepal Communist Party (United) and the chairperson of the Nepal Journalist Association said that it is an expression of boundless reverence of the progressive mankind for the Chairman to splendidly celebrate his birth anniversary. The chief of the Bulgarian Group for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism lauded the Chairman as the benevolent father of the people who devoted his whole life to building Korean-style socialism centered on the popular masses and providing the Korean people with happy life. Noting that Kim Jong Il's Songun revolutionary idea was the unique one for dynamically accelerating the revolution and construction by bolstering the military muscle of the country in every way, personages of the Syrian Arab Writers Union said that thanks to his leadership based on the Songun idea, the DPRK won a miraculous victory in the face of severe hardship. Messages of greeting to Kim Jong Un were adopted at the seminars held in Nepal. Rodong Sinmun

title: Epidemic Prevention Work Intensified
body: The emergency epidemic prevention units at all levels in the DPRK are taking all necessary measures to intensify the nationwide epidemic prevention atmosphere. Since the outbreak of the malignant virus epidemic in foreign countries, the Party and the state of the DPRK have taken the most proper measures to prevent the epidemic. Responding to those measures, the epidemic prevention units intensify the ideological work and hygienic propaganda for making all the people in the country sympathize with the steps and for making it part of their life and habit to observe the rules and order of epidemic prevention. Officials set detailed tasks of epidemic prevention and took the proper measures. They also established a well-organized system of exactly informing the people of every instruction and assignment in time and carried out the epidemic prevention work in a responsible manner by reviewing the work. Those in charge of health education more responsibly inform the people of common epidemic prevention and hygienic knowledge with detailed data and learn about how they understand it. They also make it part of life to strictly observe the epidemic prevention rules and order and the hygienic regulations in villages, houses as well as public places. Rodong Sinmun

title: Senior Party and Government Officials Visit Dwellings in Samjiyon City
body: Choe Ryong Hae and Kim Tok Hun, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Wednesday visited dwellings in Paektusanmilyong-dong and Rimyongsu-dong in Samjiyon City given a facelift to be a model of socialist mountain cultural cities. They congratulated the residents upon leading a highly civilized and happy life at fine dwelling houses newly built true to the noble intention of the Party. Inquiring about the residents' living conditions, they shared the holiday pleasure with the residents, hearing the stories about new houses. The residents were moved by touching stories of the officials about the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's tireless efforts to make cheers of "hurrah!" for socialism and the Workers' Party start resounding more loudly from the holy land of the sun, associated with President Kim Il Sung's immortal history of struggle, where Chairman Kim Jong Il was born as the Shining Star of Paektu. All of the residents further hardened their will to devote patriotic efforts to implementing the decisions of the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee, bearing deep in mind the unlimited benevolence shown by Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Banquet Given to Celebrate 80th Birth Anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: A celebration banquet was given in Samjiyon City on Wednesday, the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. It was given in honor of officials in the field of the preservation of revolutionary relics in Samjiyon City including lecturers of the Mt. Paektu secret camp performing an important duty of firmly defending and glorifying the revolutionary traditions of our Party, and exemplary working people and soldiers. Joining them were Choe Ryong Hae and Kim Tok Hun, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and other leading officials of the Party, the government and the armed forces organs. Ri Il Hwan, member of the Political Bureau and secretary of the WPK Central Committee, made a speech. He said that they were significantly celebrating the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il in the time-honored sacred place of the revolution, where the Juche cause originated and the Mt. Paektu secret camp housing his native home is situated, in Samjiyon City in which yearnings for the Chairman gets stronger over time. He, upon authorization of the Party Central Committee, warmly congratulated the genuine owners of the modern mountainous city, honorable frontline soldiers of the sacred place of Paektu reliably defending the eternal treasures of our revolution rainy and snowy, regarding it as their greatest happiness to live and work in the yard of Mt. Paektu, which is the spiritual mainstay of our people and the source of the inexhaustible strength of our country. He stressed the need for all of them to more wonderfully spruce up the native land of the revolution with ardent loyalty, being aware that the Chairman is wishing their future while always watching them who have made a great stride forward in the drive for the overall development of socialist construction. Rodong Sinmun

title: Senior Party and Government Officials Visit Chairman Kim Jong Il's Birthplace in Paektusan Secret Camp
body: Choe Ryong Hae and Kim Tok Hun, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and other senior Party and government officials, leading officials of the armed forces organs and those of the ministries and national institutions visited Chairman Kim Jong Il's birthplace in the Paektusan Secret Camp on Wednesday, his 80th birth anniversary. Entering the sacred place of the revolution, they laid bouquets before the mosaic portraying the peerlessly great persons and made a deep bow. Being briefed on the history of the sacred revolution of the Chairman at the yard of the time-honored old home, they recollected with deep emotion the noble life of the peerlessly great man who led the country and its people to one victory after another while weathering the stern tempest of the revolution with his strong faith and spirit of staunch attack of Paektu in the van. They saw round with deep attention the historic mementoes preserved with much care at the historic home. At the Headquarters log cabin where the red flag of the revolution is vigorously fluttering today, too, they deeply cherished the immortal feats of President Kim Il Sung who led the hard-fought anti-Japanese revolutionary war to a brilliant victory. Bearing deep in mind the phrases of the immortal monument inscribed with the poem "Shining Star" written by the President in February 30 years ago wishing the rosy future of Juche Korea, they cherished deep again what a great man our Party and people had as the leader in making the revolution. The senior Party and government officials hardened the strong will to accomplish to the end the revolutionary cause of Juche, that started on Paektu, under the leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un while eternally glorifying the immortal revolutionary life and feats of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Syrian President
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, received a message of greeting from Bashar Al-Assad, president of the Syrian Arab Republic, on February 13. The Syrian president in the message sent the warmest and heartfelt congratulations to Kim Jong Un and, through him, to the friendly Korean people on the occasion of the 80th birth anniversary of the great leader Comrade Kim Jong Il, wishing the DPRK continuous progress, prosperity and development. He reassured his will to further strengthen the historic relations of friendship between the two countries and expand the fields of bilateral cooperation in the interests of the peoples of the two countries. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Reply Message from Cuban President
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, on January 28 received a reply message from Miguel Diaz-Canel Bermudez, first secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba and president of the Republic of Cuba. The Cuban president in the message expressed thanks on behalf of the Cuban party, government and people to Kim Jong Un for sending sincere felicitations on the occasion of the 63rd anniversary of victory of the Cuban revolution. In the message, he reaffirmed his will to steadily strengthen the bonds of friendship, cooperation and solidarity between the two countries forged by the great leader Comrade Kim Il Sung and Supreme Commander Fidel Castro Ruz. Rodong Sinmun

title: Firework Display in Samjiyon City Marks Birthday of Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: There was a firework display in Samjiyon City, the sacred place of the sun, on February 15 to commemorate the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il (Day of the Shining Star). Among its spectators were Choe Ryong Hae and Kim Tok Hun, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and other party and government cadres, senior officials of armed forces organs, ministries and national institutions and citizens. Fireworks of celebration were set off to the sky over the area of Mt Paektu amid the playing of the song "Fireworks". Reminding the spectators that victory and glory are in store for socialist Korea and the lifeline of the Korean revolution started in Mt Paektu is ensured, thanks to the Day of the Shining Star, colorful fireworks spluttered in the sky above the city, heralding a new victory of socialism. Amid the deep reverence for the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, who ensured the eternal continuity of the history of the Chairman by turning the city, the sacred place of the revolution dear to the Korean people, into a powerful base for education in the revolutionary traditions and a highly civilized mountain town, beautiful fireworks were let off one after another, exciting the spectators. Rodong Sinmun

title: Meetings Commemorate Birth Anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Meetings took place in Pyongyang and provinces, cities and counties of the DPRK on February 15 to commemorate the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Leading officials made reports at the meetings attended by officials of Party and power organs, working people's organizations and industrial establishments and working people in those areas. The reporters paid the highest tribute and greeting of the best wishes of immortality to the Chairman in reflection of the unanimous feelings of the people across the country greeting the greatest auspicious holiday of the nation. They said that the Chairman's immortal exploits began to be recorded in the history of the Korean revolution from his childhood. They pointed out that the Chairman comprehensively reviewed a hundred-year-long history of ideology of the working class through his distinguished ideo-theoretical activities in only a few years and scientifically proved the originality, truthfulness and historical position of the revolutionary idea of President Kim Il Sung and its significant role to lay a firm guarantee for the Korean revolution to victoriously advance in the face of trials of the history. They stressed that the sacred history of revolutionary activities of the Chairman who performed the greatest exploits under the uplifted red flag of Paektu obviously shows what the might of Korea is and how victories and miracles have been performed. They called on all the Party members, people and servicepersons of the People's Army to uphold the leadership of the Party Central Committee led by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un with intense loyalty and revolutionary practice and thus turn socialist Korea, fruition of the life-long efforts and dedication of the Chairman, into a developed and highly civilized prosperous country admired by the world. They underscored the need to provide a sure guarantee for implementing the five-year plan and bring about an evident change in the economic work and improvement of people's living standard this year, true to the decisions of the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee. They called for making strenuous efforts for achieving comprehensive prosperity and development of our-style socialism in order to translate into reality President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il's patriotic desire for building a powerful country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Tribute Paid to President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Floral tribute was paid to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and mosaics portraying their smiling images by officials, working people, service personnel of the People's Army, school children across the country on the occasion of the 80th birth anniversary of the Chairman. Placed at the statues of the great leaders on Mansu Hill were floral baskets in the names of the Party, power and armed forces organs, social organizations, ministries, national institutions, units of the Korean People's Army (KPA) and the Public Security Forces (PSF), and institutions, enterprises, factories and universities at all levels in Pyongyang. The chief of the Pyongyang mission of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front and its members also laid a floral basket before the statues. The visitors paid high tribute to the great leaders. Floral baskets in the names of units of the KPA and the PSF and institutions and enterprises and flowers were also placed before the statues of the great leaders and mosaics depicting their smiling images in different parts of the capital city including Kim Il Sung University, the Ministry of National Defence and the Mansudae Art Studio. Officials, working people, service personnel, school children across the country visited the statues and mosaics in their residential areas to pay homage to the great leaders. Rodong Sinmun

title: Grand Performance Celebrates Birth Anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: A grand performance in celebration of the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il "Shine, Jong Il Peak" was given at the Pyongyang Indoor Stadium Wednesday. The performance, highly acclaimed by audience, started with mixed duet and chorus "Ode to Comrade Kim Jong Il" and orchestra and chorus "Shine, Jong Il Peak". Its numbers included female quartet folk song and dance "Greeting Spring on Jong Il Peak", female chorus "Our Comrade Kim Jong Un" and duet etude "I Think, Looking at You". The performers sang highly of the revolutionary career and exploits of the Chairman who devoted his all to the prosperity of the country and happiness of the people from the first days of his revolutionary leadership to the last moments of his life. The performance greatly impressed and moved the audience with the wonderful artistic depiction of the happiness our people have had under the care of the peerlessly great men and of the bright future of our style socialism. Famous music of the times singing of the exploits of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un demonstrating the dignity and mightiness of Juche Korea and leading the cause of building a powerful socialist country to victory helped the audience picture the future when the wish of the Chairman would come true. The performance of high ideological value and artistry which made impressive depiction of the noble revolutionary career of the Chairman who is alive in the hearts of the people delightfully and significantly decorated the spring holiday in February. Members of the diplomatic corps in the country were among the audience. Rodong Sinmun

title: Joint Online Seminar in Russia and CIS Countries Marks Chairman Kim Jong Il's Birth Anniversary
body: Political parties of Russia and the Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS) held a joint online seminar to mark the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Attending the seminar were delegates of political parties in more than ten countries and regions, including Russia, Azerbaijan, Armenia, Belarus, Tajikistan and Uzbekistan. Kazbek Taysaev, first vice-chairman of the Central Council of the Communist Parties-the Communist Party of the Soviet Union who is secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation, presided over the seminar. He said that Comrade Kim Jong Il made a great contribution to the development of the relations between Russia and the DPRK, adding that he is a distinguished leader who defended the banner of socialism and advanced the socialist cause victoriously at a time when the imperialists were trying viciously to stamp out socialism on the globe. The feats, performed by Kim Jong Il in frustrating the moves of the hostile forces to isolate and stifle the DPRK and in reliably defending the dignity and sovereignty of the country and nation, will go down forever along with the prosperity of socialist Korea, he stressed. Then speeches were made. Speakers highly praised Kim Jong Il's undying feats for strengthening the DPRK and accomplishing the global socialist cause, saying that he will always be alive in the hearts of humankind. They expressed the will to make a positive contribution to the development of the friendly and cooperative ties with the DPRK. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Basket to Statues of Great Leaders from GAKC
body: A floral basket was sent to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill from the General Association of Koreans in China (GAKC) on the 80th birth anniversary of the Chairman. The floral basket was laid before the statues on Feb. 16. Floral baskets in the names of Sim Chong Song, chairman of the Association of Korean Nationals in Dandong City of China, and Piao Guang Jie, CEO of the Dandong Jincheng Co. Ltd. of China, were laid before the statues of the President and the Chairman on the same day. Rodong Sinmun

title: Evening Gala of Youth and Students and Firework Display Mark Day of Shining Star
body: There took place an evening gala of youth and students and a firework display at Kim Il Sung Square in Pyongyang on Wednesday, the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The evening gala began with the song "A Dear Name". The venue was overflowing with deep reverence for Kim Jong Il who led the revolutionary cause of Juche pioneered on Mt Paektu to only victory and performed immortal exploits for the country and revolution, the times and history. The atmosphere of the venue got warmer with continuous formation changes of the dancers, with the letters "Celebration 80" and "Feb. 16" implied. The atmosphere of the evening gala was further raised with colorful fireworks beautifully decorating the nocturnal sky on the Day of the Shining Star. The fascinating firecrackers seemed to reflect the enthusiasm of the young vanguard to fully demonstrate their wisdom and valor in the on-going grand march forward for implementing the decisions made at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Among those enjoying the event were members of the diplomatic corps here. The evening gala reached its climax when the songs "We Will Hold Our General in High Esteem" and "We Will Defend General Kim Jong Un with Our Lives" reverberated throughout the square where the flags of the Party, the Republic and the youth league were fluttering. Rodong Sinmun

title: Whole Country Celebrates 80th Birth Anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: All the people of the country significantly celebrated the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il as the grand festival of victory and glory in great excitement. People visited the plaza park of the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, sacred temple of Juche, where President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il lie in state, and paid tribute to the mosaics depicting their smiling images. Working people and service personnel visited the statues of the great leaders and mosaics portraying their smiling images in different parts of the country including Mansu Hill and Samjiyon City and paid floral tribute. Lots of people visited the Korean Art Gallery, the Korean Stamp Exhibition House and the Industrial Art Exhibition Hall where national fine art exhibition, national pencil drawing and calligraphy festival, stamp exhibition and industrial art exhibition are underway. Schoolchildren across the country were admitted to the Korean Children's Union with determination to become competent revolutionary talents and child revolutionaries equipped with knowledge, good moral character and good health. There were colorful performances at theaters in Pyongyang and provinces in celebration of the auspicious Day of the Shining Star, the greatest national holiday. Ice sculptures displayed in time-honored Samjiyon City presented a spectacular view in the fantastic street of the people. In South Hamgyong Province an aero model remote control demonstration given by players of the provincial air club caught the interest of working people, youth and students. Public catering outlets in different parts of the country including those in Pyongyang were lively with visitors. Cultural leisure grounds in the capital city including the Central Zoo, the Natural History Museum and the Mirim Riding Club were full of laughter of holiday-makers. There took place a women's football match between April 25 and Amnokgang teams at the Kim Il Sung Stadium, a men's football match between Hoebul and Sonbong teams at the Sosan Football Ground, and a demonstration performance by instructors of the Taekwon-Do Instructors' Group of the Korean Taekwon-Do Committee and its Taekwon-Do Players' Group and men's and women's group sparring matches at the Taekwon-Do Hall. In the evening, galas and firework display of youth and students and working people in Pyongyang and provincial seats further added to the festive mood. Rodong Sinmun

title: Foreign Figures Issue Statements
body: Foreign personages released statements in the period between Jan. 26 and Feb. 8 to mark the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The chairman of the Thailand-DPRK Friendship Association said that His Excellency Kim Jong Il was born as the son of guerrillas in Mt Paektu when the Korean revolutionaries waged an armed struggle to put an end to the Japanese imperialists' military occupation of Korea and liberate the country under the leadership of President Kim Il Sung. And he noted that Kim Jong Il, through his rare ideo-theoretical activities, comprehensively systematized the Juche idea founded by the President and performed great feats in accomplishing the cause of global independence through his energetic external activities. Saying that the august name of leader Kim Jong Il is always kept in the mind of the Korean people and the world progressives, the chairman of the Kuwait-DPRK Friendship Association noted that General Secretary Kim Jong Un realizing the desire of Kim Jong Il for the building of a powerful country has led the DPRK to victory over the past ten years with his rare political caliber. Under his seasoned leadership, the Korean people are dynamically advancing along the road to socialism with confidence in victory, he added. The director of a publishing house in Myanmar and the director of the Myanmar Medical Research Institute highly praised Kim Jong Il as a peerless elder statesman and expressed support and solidarity with the struggle of the DPRK people advancing towards the rosy future, firmly united behind Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Birth Anniversary Celebrated in Moscow
body: A celebration meeting of Russian government, political parties and organizations took place in Moscow on Feb. 9 to commemorate the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Attending it were personages of the State Duma of Russia, the United Russia Party, the Communist Party of the Russian Federation, the Party for Peace and Unity, the Liberal Democratic Party, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Russia, the Russian Association for Friendship and Cultural Cooperation with the DPRK, the Russian Association for the Study of the Juche Idea, the Korean War Veterans' Council, the Lenin Young Communist League of the Russian Federation and the "Orchestra of the 21st Century". The DPRK ambassador to Russia and his embassy members were also present there. The participants paid a floral tribute to an art piece depicting President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il at the DPRK embassy. After seeing photos of Kim Il Sung, Kim Jong Il and the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un and pictures showing the appearance of developing Juche Korea on display, they watched a Korean film dealing with the immortal exploits performed by Kim Jong Il in developing the friendly DPRK-Russia relations. Speeches were made at the meeting. The director of the Asia 1 Department of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Russia said that the august name of Comrade Kim Jong Il is cherished in the hearts of not only the Korean people but the world progressives as a wise and ardent leader and an outstanding politician. The vice-chairperson of the Central Council of the Communist Parties-the Communist Party of the Soviet Union who is member of the C.C., Communist Party of the Russian Federation lauded Comrade Kim Jong Il as a prominent politician admired by the world people for his far-sighted wisdom and distinguished leadership ability. Praising Kim Jong Il as an outstanding state leader as well as his exploits, the chairperson of the Party for Peace and Unity said that he firmly defended the sovereignty of the country and socialism and built up the single-minded unity of the whole society to be an invincible one in the period of severe trials in the world socialist movement. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Floral Basket from Chinese Organization
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a floral basket from the China Association for International Friendly Contact on the occasion of the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Officials of the association conveyed the floral basket to the DPRK ambassador to China on Feb. 16. Rodong Sinmun

title: Internet Seminar Observes Birth Anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: An internet seminar of the International Alliance of Societies for the Study of the Juche Idea and Songun Policy in East European and Central Asian Regions was held on February 3 on the occasion of the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Attending the seminar were members of the international alliance and chiefs of the Juche idea study groups and Juche idea followers in Russia, Kazakhstan, Ukraine and Moldova. Mikhail Panchenko, general secretary of the international alliance, made a speech at the seminar. Noting that events are held worldwide to celebrate the birthday of the Chairman, he praised him as the peerless patriot who devoted himself to the prosperity of the DPRK and the happiness of the people until the last moments of his life. Saying that patriotism possessed and put into practice by him is the noblest and ardent one going by his august name, he stressed that the venerable image of the Chairman will be kept in the hearts of mankind forever. At the seminar, Vadim Kudimin, director of the Russian Institute of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, Dmitri Kostenko, chairman of the Russian Association for the Study of the Juche Idea, and Nikolai Polishk, chairman of the Ukrainian "Treasured Sword of Songun" Association for the Study of the Juche Idea praised the Chairman as a great man in the century who performed the greatest-ever exploits during his revolutionary guidance. A congratulatory message to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un was adopted at the seminar. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Chongryon Organizations
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received messages of greeting from organizations under the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) on the occasion of the Day of the Shining Star (Chairman Kim Jong Il's birth anniversary), the greatest auspicious holiday of the nation. The messages were sent by the Standing Council of the Korean Federation of Workers in Commerce in Japan, the Central Standing Committee of the Korean Youth League in Japan, the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Democratic Korean Women in Japan, the Central Standing Management Board of the Korean Youth Commercial Association in Japan, the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Korean Teachers in Japan, the Central Standing Council of the Union of Korean Educational Association in Japan, the Central Standing Council of the Korean Scientists and Technologists Association in Japan, the Central Standing Council of the Korean Social Scientists Association in Japan, the Standing Council of the Korean Sportsmen's Federation in Japan, the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Korean Writers and Artists in Japan, the Central Standing Council of the Korean Health Workers Association in Japan, the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Korean Students in Japan, the Association of Koreans in Japan for Peaceful Reunification, the Central Standing Council of the Korean Human Rights Association in Japan and other central organizations of Chongryon and its affiliated organizations, the Choson Sinbo Company, the Korean News Service, the Hagu Bookshop, the Kumgang-san Opera Troupe, the Tonghae Co. Ltd., Kumgang Insurance Company, the Committee for Promoting Korea-Japan Economic Exchange and other businesses, local headquarters of Chongryon, Korean University and Korean schools at all levels in Japan. Rodong Sinmun

title: Day of Shining Star Celebrated at DPRK Embassy in Beijing
body: An event took place at the DPRK embassy in Beijing on Feb. 16, the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The participants laid a floral basket in the name of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China before the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il before making a bow. They looked round the photos showing the exploits of the Chairman. At the conversation Ji Bingxuan, vice-chairman of the Standing Committee of the Chinese National People's Congress, asked DPRK Ambassador Ri Ryong Nam to convey the warm greetings and best wishes from Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, to Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea. Recalling the days of meeting with Kim Jong Il, Ji Bingxuan highly praised him as a prominent leader of the Korean people and a close friend of the Chinese people. Saying that the China-DPRK friendship, provided by the leaders of the elder generation and developed by the top leaders of the two countries, is the precious one forged in blood, Ji Bingxuan stressed that the two peoples share the same mind no matter how the international situation changes. Noting that a new chapter in developing the China-DPRK friendly relations was unfolded through several meetings between Kim Jong Un and Xi Jinping, he said the Chinese party, government and people sincerely hoped that the DPRK would be further prosperous under the leadership of Kim Jong Un. Expressing heartfelt gratitude for the DPRK's recent supports to China in the international arena, he affirmed that China, attaching foremost importance to the China-DPRK friendship, would as ever support the DPRK and strive together with the comrades of the DPRK to further develop the traditional relations between the two countries. Attending the event were officials of the Chinese party and government and personages of different circles including those from the Communist Youth League, the Xinhua News Agency, the Chinese People's Daily, the All-China Federation of Trade Unions and the All-China Women's Federation. Rodong Sinmun

title: Celebration Performance Given by Ensemble of National Defence Ministry
body: The Ensemble of the Ministry of National Defence gave an outdoor performance at the Yangdok Hot Spring Resort on Wednesday and Thursday in celebration of the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The performance began with congratulatory poem "Convey Long, Yangdok Hot Spring Resort, Paradise of All Blessings". Its numbers included songs admiring the great men and praising the Workers' Party and folk songs. Female duet and pangchang "Greeting Spring on Jong Il Peak", male quartet "Shine, Jong Il Peak" and other numbers showed the Korean people's world of loyalty to the Chairman. There were also numbers reflecting gratitude and confidence in the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. Numbers rich in national flavor and showing the people's happiness of leading all blessings added to the pleasure of the holiday-makers. The audience enthusiastically applauded the performers, dancing together with them, which made the atmosphere all the more lively. Rodong Sinmun

title: Ground-Breaking Ceremony for Construction of Ryonpho Greenhouse Farm Held
body: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Makes Stirring Speech and Shovels First Spadeful of Earth A large-scale modern greenhouse farm is to appear in Ryonpho area of Hamju County, South Hamgyong Province of the DPRK, under a decision made at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) enshrining its far-reaching plan for bringing about the overall development of our style socialist construction and according to a relevant assignment. The Party Central Committee, which regards it as the supreme principle of its activities to promote the civilization and welfare of the people, formulated it as a policy to build modern and profitable greenhouse farms on a large scale across the country and improve the standard of people's diet. It set it as a top task of the major state construction policy tasks for the year 2022 to build the Ryonpho Greenhouse Farm and entrusted the honorable task to the units of the People's Army which accumulated lots of experience in greenhouse farm construction. There was a grand ground-breaking ceremony on Friday. The revolutionary enthusiasm and militant stamina of the soldier-builders, determined to wonderfully complete the construction project entrusted to them through an all-out charge of loyalty and brilliantly adorn this significant year with shining achievement in devotedly carrying out the Party's policies, prevailed the ceremony venue starting the worthwhile project for realizing the cherished desire of our Party. Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, attended the ceremony. When he arrived at the venue, all the participants broke into thunderous cheers of "hurrah!" for him bringing into great reality the dream and ideal of the people with his warm loving care and indefatigable thinking and devotion. Present there were Jo Yong Won, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretary for Organizational Affairs of the WPK Central Committee, Ri Jong Nam, chief secretary of the South Hamgyong Provincial Committee of the WPK, and officials and working people in South Hamgyong Province. Also on hand were Ri Yong Gil, Kim Jong Gwan and other officials of the armed forces organs and soldier-builders. When the start of the ceremony was declared, the national anthem of the DPRK was solemnly played. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un made a stirring speech. He expressed excitement at launching the construction of the large-scale greenhouse farm to be greatly helpful to the life of residents in Hamhung City and South Hamgyong Province in the wake of the start of the construction of 10 000 flats for the year 2022 which is of weighty significance in solving a housing problem in the capital city. He made a militant solute to the service personnel and the construction officials who gathered on the Ryonpho front out of a will to successfully carry out the most important construction policy task of the Party and the state. Noting that the Party Central Committee has planned to build a modern greenhouse farm in Ryonpho area from several years ago, always showing concern for the supply of vegetables to the people in Hamhung City, a major industrial and science city of the country, and South Hamgyong Province as an important affair, and stepped up the preparations for its construction, he mentioned the significance and importance of the construction of the Ryonpho Greenhouse Farm. He underlined the plan of the Party Central Committee to build the Ryonpho Greenhouse Farm to be the largest modern one, which will be a farm of practical education disseminating the advanced agricultural technology and a new base for creating the Korean-style rural civilization, and a socialist civilized farm good to live and work, and to more powerfully and confidently push ahead with the overall rural development throughout the country with the greenhouse as a standard and a torch. And he set forth the tasks and ways for dynamically accelerating the construction. Calling for making redoubled efforts to provide creation for the people as early as possible for the rosy future of the country to be further prosperous and overflowing with happiness at every home, he expressed expectation and belief that the heroic men and officers of the People's Army will creditably carry out the order of the Party Central Committee by displaying the militant spirit of the revolutionary army to the full. After he finished his speech full of the noble intention believing the people as in heaven and the great trust in the soldier-builders, all the emotion-charged participants raised enthusiastic cheers again, which resounded far and wide. Kim Myong Sik and Kim Kwang Hyok, general officers of the Korean People's Army, made pledge speeches at the ceremony. They said that all the soldier-builders are filled with burning enthusiasm for fully demonstrating the ever-victorious spirit of the revolutionary army of the Party in the worthwhile and glorious campaign for materializing the plan of the Party Central Committee upon receiving the heartening call of the respected Supreme Commander Kim Jong Un. They expressed a firm will to effect another round of miracle in the Ryonpho campaign in the same spirit with which they built the modern greenhouse farm in Jungphyong area. They firmly pledged, in reflection of all the soldier-builders' unanimous will, to complete all the structures in Ryonpho area to be models of rural development in the new era and symbols of the Party's people-first principle, and make a report of loyalty and victory to the Party Central Committee. Kim Jong Un shoveled the first spadeful of earth in commemoration of the ground-breaking ceremony and personally pressed the button for blasting. This was followed by a loud boom of the blasting signaling the start of the construction and then a series of fireworks. The venue which would leave a shining page in history was full of deep reverence and feelings of trust of the participants in Kim Jong Un who always brings about the best results while considering the work for the people as the one of foremost importance, a top-priority one that can never be delayed even a minute. Kim Jong Un gave warm encouragement to all the soldier-builders, expressing his expectation and conviction that they would fulfill their honorable mission and duty as thorough-going executors of the Party's plans and policies and creators of happiness for the people in the on-going construction project in the same devoted fighting spirit and stamina with which they had always responded to the Party's calls with perfect practical results. The soldier-builders shouted "Kim Jong Un" and "devoted defence" at the top of their voices, reflective of their deep reverence for Supreme Commander Kim Jong Un who came to the spot, busy as he was shouldering upon himself all the Party and state affairs, and showed deep trust and love for them. The venue, charged with the resilient feelings of kinship between the leader and soldiers, was full of the transparent faith of service personnel that there is nothing impossible as long as the Party places trust in them and that the most worthy honor of one's life lies in upholding the Party Central Committee. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un waved back long to the dependable soldier-builders full of courage and enthusiasm to become fortresses and shields in defending the idea and cause of the Party Central Committee and throw themselves into implementing them. The construction of the greenhouse farm reflective of our great Party Central Committee's noble outlook on the people will give a boost to the revolutionary enthusiasm of all the people out in the general advance to carry through the grand fighting task and the socialist rural construction programme set forth at the 8th Congress of the Party. Political News Team

title: Cambodian King and Great Queen Send Large Floral Baskets to DPRK Embassy
body: Cambodian King Norodom Sihamoni and Great Queen Norodom Monineath Sihanouk sent large floral baskets to the DPRK embassy in Phnom Penh on Feb. 15 to commemorate the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Upon authorization of the king and the great queen, a delegation of the Cambodian Ministry of the Royal Palace led by Kong Sam Ol, deputy prime minister for the Royal Palace, laid the floral baskets before the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il before making a bow to them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Letter to Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un from Participants in Int'l Seminar
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a letter on Feb. 14 from the participants in an inaugural ceremony for the international E-seminar and online photo exhibition in celebration of the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The letter said that Leader Kim Jong Il, the eternal sun of humankind, enjoyed the immeasurable commendation from everyone as the greatest of the great men for guiding the Korean revolution and the cause of global independence by dint of his outstanding ideology and theories, prominent leadership and ennobling personal magnetism. It is particularly Leader Kim Jong Il's greatest achievement that he firmly safeguarded the socialist cause of Korea holding even higher the banner of anti-imperialism and independence during the period of the most trying ordeals in the late last century and opened up a way out for building a thriving nation, thus glorifying the 21st century as the one of independence, the letter said. Today Leader Kim Jong Il lives forever in the minds of the Korean people and other progressives in the world as the Shining Star of Paektu and the sun of humankind, thanks to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un who is identical to him in ideology, cause and personality and develops and enriches them furthermore, the letter said, adding: Thanks to Your Excellency Kim Jong Un, the cause of immortalizing the leader was materialized at the highest level and the revolutionary ideas of the preceding leaders are shining as the immortal guiding ideology of the independent era. Meanwhile, the DPRK ushered in the golden age of prosperity, never known in its history in the last decade, and rose up aloft in the center of the world politics. Nothing but victory and glory will stand in the way forward of Korea which is dynamically advancing towards the comprehensive development of socialism and the ideal society of humankind, where the dreams of people will come true, while overcoming all kinds of difficulties and trials under the wise leadership of Your Excellency Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Birth Anniversary Commemorated by Koreans in Japan
body: A meeting of Koreans in Japan took place at the Central Hall of Chongryon in Tokyo on Feb. 15 to celebrate the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Attending it were Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), Pak Ku Ho, its first vice-chairman and concurrently director of its Organization Department, Nam Sung U, its vice-chairman, Pae Jin Gu, its vice-chairman and director general of its General Affairs Department, Jo Il Yon, its vice-chairman, Song Kun Hak, its vice-chairman and director of its Education Department, Kang Chu Ryon, its vice-chairwoman and chairwoman of the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Democratic Korean Women in Japan, Ri Myong Yu, chairman of the Central Audit Committee of Chongryon, advisers and department directors of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, the chief of the Research Institute on History of Korean Residents in Japan, chairpersons of the Chongryon headquarters, leading officials of the central leadership bodies and affiliates and other Koreans in Japan. Ho Jong Man made a report. The reporter paid high tribute to Chairman Kim Jong Il, the benevolent father of Chongryon and Koreans in Japan, on the occasion of the greatest national holiday. He said that all the officials of Chongryon and Koreans in Japan greeting the Day of the Shining Star (birth anniversary of Kim Jong Il) this significant year keep in their minds once again that thanks to the exploits and dedication of the Chairman who devoted himself to the country and the people all his life, the destiny of the country and the people was firmly defended and firm foundations for building a prosperous and powerful country were provided. The outstanding wisdom and leadership exploits of the Chairman who took warm care of Chongryon and Koreans in Japan will be immortal along with the movement of Koreans in Japan, he said, and went on: The fundamental guarantee for thoroughly implementing the instructions of the Chairman without any deflection lies in firmly believing in the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un only and remaining loyal to his idea and leadership. The reporter ardently called for adding eternal glory to the revolutionary career of the Chairman and his immortal leadership exploits for the movement of Koreans in Japan and waging a more vigorous patriotic movement by getting firmly united in one mind under the leadership of Kim Jong Un. A congratulatory letter of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee to Kim Jong Un was read out at the meeting. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chongryon Officials Pay Floral Tribute to Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Officials of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) laid a floral basket before the portrait of smiling Chairman Kim Jong Il on Feb. 14 on the occasion of the Day of the Shining Star, his birth anniversary. Chairman Ho Jong Man, First Vice-Chairman and Director of the Organization Department Pak Ku Ho, vice-chairpersons, the chairman of the Central Audit Committee, department directors and other officials of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee placed a floral basket in the name of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee before the portrait of Kim Jong Il at the Central Hall of Chongryon and made bow. Rodong Sinmun

title: Int'l Seminar and Photo Exhibition Opened in Indonesia
body: An international E-seminar "Kim Jong Il: Eternal Incarnation of Juche Korea" and online photo exhibition "Mt Paektu" was opened in Jakarta of Indonesia on February 14 to celebrate the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The homepage, established for the seminar and exhibition, carried photos dealing with the immortal exploits the Chairman performed for the country and people, the times and the history during his revolutionary lifetime. Posted on the homepage were photos showing the world progressives on a visit to Kim Jong Il's birthplace in the Paektusan Secret Camp, revolutionary battle sites in the area of Mt Paektu, the landscape of Mt Paektu, face-lifted Samjiyon City and Mt Paektu, the sacred mountain of revolution. Also posted there were speeches made by personages of governments and political parties, organizations for friendship and solidarity with the Korean people, Juche idea study organizations and international democratic organizations in different countries and regions. Present at the opening ceremony of the seminar and exhibition were personages of the Organizing Committee of the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu and public figures in different countries and regions. Present there on invitation was the DPRK ambassador to Indonesia. After speeches by personages of different countries at the ceremony, congratulatory letters from organizations for friendship and solidarity with the Korean people in various countries and regional organizations were read out. The chairman of the African Regional Committee for Friendship and Solidarity with the Korean People who is co-chairman of the Organizing Committee of the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu made a keynote report there. The reporter expressed the highest respect to HE Kim Jong Il on the occasion of his 80th birth anniversary, lauding him as a peerless elder statesman admired by the world people and brilliant commander of Songun who wisely led the Korean-style socialist construction and the cause of independence against imperialism with his profound ideology and theory, outstanding leadership and boundless devotion. He affirmed that the event would serve as an occasion of expressing the feelings of mankind boundlessly revering the great man and their support to and solidarity with prosperous socialist Korea, saying that Kim Jong Il who made a big contribution to the Korean revolution and the cause of independence against imperialism will always be alive as the image of Juche Korea and the sun in the era of independence. At the ceremony, speeches were made by the general secretary of the Central Committee of the People's Socialist Party of Mexico, the chairman of the Ugandan National Executive Committee of the Pan-African Movement, the chairman of the Lebanese Committee for Support to the Reunification of Korea, the chairman of the Tanzania-DPRK Friendship Association and the co-chairman of the Arab Regional Committee for Friendship and Solidarity with the Korean People. A letter to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un was adopted there. Rodong Sinmun

title: First People's Art Festival Closes
body: The First People's Art Festival for Celebrating the Day of the Shining Star closed in the DPRK. A closing ceremony took place at the East Pyongyang Grand Theatre on February 18. Attending the ceremony were Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Ri Song Hak, vice premier of the Cabinet, officials concerned and the participants in the festival. There was a prize-giving ceremony, where 24 persons were awarded individual prize, 6 works prize of ensemble and 13 units group prize. And festival certificates and cups were conferred on them. A letter of loyalty to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un was adopted amid the enthusiastic cheers of the participants. Minister of Culture Sung Jong Gyu, chairman of the festival organizing committee, made a closing address. He said that the first festival strikingly demonstrated the iron faith and will of the Korean people to hold Chairman Kim Jong Il in high esteem as the sun of Juche forever and achieve a new victory in socialist construction under the guidance of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un. He called on all the working people to become true creators and enjoyers of Korean-style socialist civilization by thoroughly implementing the Party's policy of making art prevail throughout the country and popularizing art and to sing more loudly songs in praise of the leaders, songs about unyielding struggle and advance and songs about revolutionary optimism at every socialist construction site. Then a closing performance was given. Rodong Sinmun

title: Foreign Personages Pay Congratulatory Visits to DPRK Missions
