body: Foreign figures paid congratulatory visits to the DPRK missions in their countries from Feb. 6 to 16 on the occasion of the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il (Day of the Shining Star). They laid floral baskets and bouquets at the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and the art pieces depicting them standing together and made bows. They included personages from the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Cuba, the Ministry of Revolutionary Armed Forces of Cuba, the Ministry of Foreign Investment and Economic Cooperation of Cuba, the Cuban Institute of Friendship with the Peoples, the Cuban Committee for Supporting Korea's Reunification, the Prensa Latina News Agency, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Ministry of Defence of Vietnam, the Vietnam-DPRK Friendship Association, the newspaper Nhan Dan, the China World Peace Foundation, the China Association for International Friendly Contact, the Maritime Territorial Branch Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation, the Maritime Territorial Social Organization "Association for Friendship with Korea", the Far Eastern State University of Russia, the Central Committee of the National Construction Front of Laos, the Lao People's Revolutionary Youth Union, the Lao Federation of Trade Unions, the Lao Women's Union, the Lao Veterans Federation, the Syrian Communist Party (Unified), the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Expatriates of Syria, the Syria-Korea Friendship Parliamentary Group, the Revolutionary Youth Union of Syria, the Syria Baath Children Organization, the Taekwon-Do Federation of Cambodia and other foreign political parties, governments, organizations and institutions. The vice-chairman of the FUNCINPEC Party of Cambodia and the vice-chairman of the Commission for International Relations of the People's Party of Cambodia paid congratulatory visits to the DPRK mission. The Ministry of Public Security, the Women's Union and the Ho Chi Minh Communist Youth Union and other organizations of Vietnam sent floral baskets to the DPRK mission on the same occasion. Rodong Sinmun

title: Photo Exhibition Sponsored by Chongryon
body: A photo exhibition of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) was held at the Central Hall of Chongryon in Tokyo on Feb. 15 to celebrate the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Seen at the center of the exhibition hall was a portrait of smiling Chairman Kim Jong Il. On display there were photos in chronological order documenting the noble revolutionary career of the Chairman and his immortal feats. There were also photos of the smiling Chairman meeting Chongryon officials and other compatriots from Japan and showing warm love for them. Chairman Ho Jong Man, First Vice-Chairman and concurrently Director of the Organization Department Pak Ku Ho and vice-chairpersons of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, the chairman of the Central Audit Committee of Chongryon, advisers and department directors of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, chairpersons of Tokyo Metropolitan, Kanagawa Prefectural, Nishi Tokyo, Chiba Prefectural and Saitama Prefectural headquarters of Chongryon, leading officials of central organizations and affiliates and Chongryon officials in Kanto area looked round the exhibition hall. Rodong Sinmun

title: Meeting Marking Chairman Kim Jong Il's Birth Anniversary Held in Japan
body: A Juche idea and Japan-DPRK friendship and peace meeting was held in Kochi City of Japan on Feb. 12 on the occasion of the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Attending the meeting were Kenichi Ogami, secretary general of the International Institute of the Juche Idea (IIJI), representatives from the Juche idea study organizations and personages in Japan. In the first part, lectures were given by Yuji Fukuhara, professor of the postgraduate course of Shimane Prefectural University, and So Sun Ae, assistant professor of the Political Economy Faculty of Korean University. The speakers said that Chairman Kim Jong Il provided an eternal foundation for building a powerful country by developing the DPRK into an invincible power with his outstanding idea and indefatigable revolutionary leadership. Rector of Korean University Han Tong Song, who is a director of the IIJI, made a concluding speech. In the second part, a performance was given by members of the Japan-Korea Society for Music and Art Interchange and Juche idea study organizations and artistes. At the meeting, a letter to the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un by the Kochi Society for the Study of the Juche Idea and the IIJI was read out. Rodong Sinmun

title: Koreans in China Celebrate Day of Shining Star
body: There were celebrations by organizations of Koreans in China from Feb. 14 to 16 on the occasion of the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Floral baskets were laid before the statue of President Kim Il Sung at Yuwen Middle School in Jilin by the General Association of Koreans in China (GAKC), the Association of Korean Women in China, the Jilin branch of the Jilin Province Regional Association of the GAKC, the family of Hwang Paek Ha, a China-resident Korean related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, the family of Hong Yong Sun, former deputy chief of the Jilin Province Regional Association, and others. The GAKC placed a floral basket before the art work depicting the President and the Chairman at the DPRK Consulate General in Shenyang. Floral tribute was paid to the portraits of smiling Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il at the DPRK embassy and mission in China by the branch organizations of the GAKC, the Federation of Korean Economic Workers in China, the Association of Korean Women in China and the Association of Young Korean Nationals in China. A celebration meeting of the GAKC was held in Shenyang, China. The meeting was attended by the GAKC officials, and Choe Su Bong, first vice-chairman of the GAKC, made a report. The reporter said that Chairman Kim Jong Il performed great feats for the country, the nation, the times and history by giving steady continuity to the revolution and construction, true to the idea and intention of the President. He remarked that the Chairman looked after the overseas Koreans with fatherly loving care though he was busy leading the revolution and construction. Saying that the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un is in the van of the revolutionary cause of Juche today, he reiterated the pledge to uphold his leadership in the same single mind with which they trusted and followed the President and the Chairman. The reporter ardently called on all to fulfill their duties as nationals of the DPRK, rallied closer in single patriotic mind in glorifying the undying revolutionary feats of the Chairman and in upholding Kim Jong Un with loyalty. A congratulatory letter to Kim Jong Un was adopted at the meeting. Organizations affiliated to the GAKC took part in the meeting through video conferencing. The meeting was followed by an art performance for celebrating the Day of the Shining Star. Meanwhile, the GAKC and organizations under it watched a Korean documentary "Developing Our Party into Ever-victorious Revolutionary Party", Part 6 of "General Kim Jong Il, Peerless Patriot". There were also colorful events like seminar, celebration gathering and reception. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Birth Anniversary Celebrated in Mongolia
body: A seminar, meeting for adopting a congratulatory message, round-table talk, lecture and photo exhibition took place in Mongolia on the occasion of the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Attending the events were personages of political and public circles and people in Mongolia. At the seminar the chairperson and the executive chairperson of the Mongolian Association for the Study of the Juche Idea-Songun Idea highly praised Kim Jong Il for dedicating himself to the country and people all his life. They stressed that the august name of the great man who safeguarded Korean-style socialism and the destiny of the people will always be remembered by the world progressives. At the round-table talk the chairperson of the Mongolian Centre for the Study of Juche praised Chairman Kim Jong Il for formulating the revolutionary idea of President Kim Il Sung as Kimilsungism and developing the DPRK into a powerful country dignified with independence in politics, self-sufficiency in economy and self-reliance in defence. At the lecture the chairperson of the Mongolian Cultural and Research Center of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea said that it would be unthinkable without exploits of Kim Jong Il who provided a solid foundation for bolstering the military muscle that the DPRK has fully demonstrated its might as a power. Meanwhile, a ceremony of displaying a portrait of smiling Chairman Kim Jong Il was held at Kim Jong Il Kindergarten in Mongolia. Rodong Sinmun

title: Touching Stories Conveying His Love for People
body: His Earnest Request It was one day in the run-up to the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Officials were racking their brains on the issue to prepare a birthday spread for the Chairman. It was because they knew well that the Chairman would never permit them to do that. After being informed of the fact the Chairman called the relevant officials and held them back from doing that. A few days later, the Chairman told officials that he received the birthday spread. The officials were so surprised. Because the Chairman had a lodgers’ meal on his birthday. The officials could not help feeling sorry. A year ago since then he had taken a meal among those being served to lodgers and requested officials to heighten their responsibility and role. The Chairman instructed officials who were sorry about it in an earnest voice as follows: People call our Party mother Party. That’s why the Party officials should fulfill their duty as the genuine mother of masses, proving themselves worthy of the people’s expectations. They should sincerely take care of the living of people like mothers who pick out unhulled rice one by one for fear that an unhulled rice is mixed into rice for their children. His earnest request was the precious instruction that our officials as true servants of the people should bear deep in their mind forever and fully embody in their work and life. Consultative Meeting Organized on His Birthday On Feb.16 of Juche73(1984), an official was informed that the Chairman called him. When the official arrived at a destination, some officials had already been there. On the faces of the officials were reverences because they were called on the auspicious day, the birthday of the Chairman. Before long the Chairman entered the room. The officials bowed to the Chairman with endless reverence for him. However, they could not know a noble story of love for the people to be woven on that meaningful day. Expressing his gratitude to the greetings of officials, he shook their hands one by one and said that he called them to convene a consultative meeting with them. Officials requested him in earnest to have a rest even on his birthday. Then the Chairman said that he could appreciate their minds, but he had a lot of things to do and so he was going to discuss the measures to improve the people’s living on a higher level. Therefore the consultative meeting to discuss the issue about the people’s living was held that day. Chairman Kim Jong Il refused to accept the wish of people who earnestly asked for him to rest even a moment and worked energetically on his birthday. There were only our people in the mind of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Verbal Message to President Xi Jinping
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a verbal message to Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and president of the People's Republic of China, upon successful holding of the Beijing Winter Olympics. In the message the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un extended heartfelt warm congratulations to General Secretary Xi Jinping upon the splendid proceeding of the Beijing Winter Olympics as a novel and special grand sports festival amid the great expectation and interest of all the Chinese people and other world people. The message appreciated that the Chinese party and people have left an indelible trace in the history of the Olympics with their indefatigable efforts under the leadership of General Secretary Xi Jinping in the face of unprecedentedly severe health crisis and the hostile forces' maneuvers and demonstrated the stamina of China dynamically advancing in the direction indicated by the socialist ideology with the Chinese characteristics in the new era. And it expressed belief that they would bring about a bigger success in the efforts to build a modern socialist country in an all-round way this year when the 20th Congress of the Communist Party of China is to be held. Noting that the two parties of the DPRK and China and the two countries are defending and advancing socialism, their common cause, while frustrating the undisguised hostile policy and military threat of the U.S. and its satellite forces by strengthening the bilateral strategic cooperation and unity, the message expressed the will to more firmly consolidate the DPRK-China relationship into the invincible one together with General Secretary Xi Jinping and to positively contribute to building a peaceful and developing world. The message sincerely wished General Secretary Xi Jinping bigger successes in his responsible work for leading the Communist Party of China, the People's Republic of China and the Chinese nation in good health. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Congratulatory Message to Ho Jong Man
body: Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Tuesday sent a congratulatory message to Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon). The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un in the message extended warm congratulations and comradely greetings to Ho Jong Man on the occasion of his 87th birthday, together with the mind of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The message praised him as a veteran revolutionary and a true patriot and loyalist who has dedicated himself to the patriotic work for the reunification and development of the country and its prosperity for more than six decades from his twenties. The message said that our Party and the DPRK government put forward Ho Jong Man as the first overseas revolutionary comrade whom Chairman Kim Jong Il personally formed a connection with and always remember his distinguished patriotic feats vividly manifested in the history of the Juche-based movement of overseas compatriots. Chongryon celebrated the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il with splendor shortly ago despite the worldwide health crisis, it noted, adding this is the manifestation of pure loyalty and uprightness of Ho Jong Man and other Chongryon officials and compatriots in Japan towards the Chairman. Kim Jong Un in the message wished Ho Jong Man good health and his family happiness, hoping that he would more vigorously guide the sacred struggle for the development and prosperity of Chongryon and for the protection of the compatriots' rights and interests, full of energy despite his advanced age. Rodong Sinmun

title: Young People Volunteer to Work in Major Sectors
body: More youths in North Phyongan Province of the DPRK have volunteered to work in major sectors of socialist construction this month in the wake of January. A large number of young people volunteered to work at farms in Uiju, Sakju, Sonchon and other counties of the province with a determination to become masters responsible for the granary of the country and dedicate themselves to the grain production in the fields of socialist cooperative farms. Scores of graduates-to-be of university of education and teacher training college expressed their will to glorify their youth at branch schools on islands and schools in mountainous areas. Young people in Ryongchon, Taegwan, Pyokdong and Tongchang counties volunteered to work at mines and forestry stations out of the will to live like the youth vanguard and the elder generations in the Chollima age. Mun Kyong Dok, chief secretary of the North Phyongan Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials concerned, officials of the youth league and youth and students gave pep talks to the volunteers. Rodong Sinmun

title: Epidemic Prevention Regulations Strictly Observed in DPRK
body: The world health crisis gets worse due to the rapid spread of the highly-transmissible COVID-19 variants. This requires all the people to strictly observe preventive regulations on high alert, regarding it as part of their life and habit. The central emergency epidemic prevention field is pushing forward with the work for establishing strict disciplines and orders so that all the people thoroughly abide by the preventive rules and adopt it as their life and habit to observe the rules, while taking thorough-going measures to get rid of all elements that can weaken the anti-epidemic wall. Institutions, industrial establishments and farms keep their employees on high alert by intensifying anti-epidemic information activities. They have also set up a system of summing up their daily work with a priority given to the epidemic prevention work, while thoroughly taking the temperature of their employees and disinfecting their office rooms, workshops, equipment and materials. The emergency anti-epidemic units across the country are persevering with their work to find out and get rid of all defects, as required by specific situations in the units and areas under their supervision, while rejecting indolence, slackness, self-complacency and carelessness. They also urge all citizens to keep their streets and villages clean and tidy, adopt it as part of their life to immediately inform the relevant units of abnormal practices and tackle them as required by the epidemic prevention rules. Rodong Sinmun

title: Birth Anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il Commemorated by Koreans in Russia
body: The United Confederation of Koreans in Russia held an event to celebrate the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The participants laid bunches of flowers at the art piece portraying President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il at the center of the hall in the building of the confederation before making a bow. Then a celebration meeting was held. Kim Chil Song, chairman of the confederation, made a report. He said that Chairman Kim Jong Il is always alive in the hearts of the world people as well as the Korean people for his great achievements. He praised the Chairman as an outstanding leader who staunchly defended the country's sovereignty and put the people's dignity on the highest eminence. His greatest achievement was that he projected the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un as his successor, the reporter stressed. He praised Kim Jong Un for providing the powerful national defense capabilities surely guaranteeing the dignity and sovereignty of the DPRK by creditably carrying forward the cause of the preceding leaders. Then a poem in praise of the Chairman was recited. Meanwhile, the confederation gave wide publicity to the undying achievements of Kim Jong Il and Kim Jong Un through its website. Rodong Sinmun

title: Meeting of AKJPR Held
body: Members of the management board of the Association of Koreans in Japan for Peaceful Reunification (AKJPR) had an oath-taking meeting in Tokyo on February 18 on the occasion of the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The meeting was attended by Nam Sung U, vice-chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), So Chung On, director of its Department for International Affairs and Reunification, Chairman Ri Tong Je and vice-chairpersons of the AKJPR, representatives from its regional councils and members of its management board in the area of Kanto. Videos dealing with the revolutionary career and exploits of the Chairman were screened at the event. Then oath-taking speeches were made. Speakers praised the Chairman as a peerless patriot and lodestar of national reunification who smashed the imperialist allied forces' moves to stifle the DPRK and led the cause of independent reunification to victory by devoting his whole life. They recalled that the Chairman saw to it that the AKJPR was formed and wisely led it to make a distinguished contribution to the movement for national reunification. They vowed to devote themselves to glorifying the immortal exploits of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il for national reunification and faithfully upholding the idea and leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un in this meaningful year. Rodong Sinmun

title: Day of Shining Star Marked Abroad
body: There took place celebrations, film shows and photo shows in Norway, Denmark, Switzerland, Sweden, Finland, Poland, Mexico and Ecuador from February 6 to 13 ahead of the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il, the Day of the Shining Star. The events were attended by personages and other people in those countries. A Korean film on the revolutionary career and exploits of the Chairman and others were screened at the film shows. All the events showed deep reverence for the Chairman. The chairperson of the Sweden-Korea Friendship Association said that the Chairman instilled great confidence and inspiration into the peoples of the countries aspiring to independence by championing the banner of socialism during the harshest-ever times. The general secretary of the Central Committee of the People's Socialist Party of Mexico praised the Chairman for turning the DPRK into a politico-ideological power and military power and firmly defending the sovereignty of the country and nation. The chairman of the Ostfold County Committee of the Communist Party of Norway praised Kim Jong Il as a peerless statesman and great man who developed the Workers' Party of Korea into a Juche-type revolutionary party and laid firm foundations for building a powerful socialist country. The international secretary of the Finnish Communists' League recalled that the Chairman made an endless journey of field guidance for improving the people's living standard, always giving priority to their interests and demonstrated to the world the dignity and prestige of Juche Korea through his energetic external activities. The chairman of the Denmark-DPRK Friendship Association said that Kim Jong Il's achievements for the global socialist cause would be remembered forever. Congratulatory messages to the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un were adopted at the events in Switzerland, Sweden and Poland. Rodong Sinmun

title: Vigorous Activities of Scientists and Technicians in Socialist Construction
body: Shock brigades of scientists and technicians in the DPRK have conducted a vigorous campaign on major fronts of socialist construction. Members of the February 17 Shock Brigade of Scientists and Technicians dispatched to the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex finished the preparations for technical updating for building a new energy-saving oxygen heat blast furnace, while working hard to carry out their research tasks for this year. The brigade members dispatched to the establishment of C-1 chemical industry make strides in resolving the sci-tech problems to ensure the test operation of methanol production process, while putting efforts into training skilled workers. Those dispatched to the Pukchang Thermal Power Complex carried out their major research tasks in order to produce a lot more electricity. Those dispatched to the construction of the Tanchon Power Station set stepwise goals to resolve sci-tech problems arising in the construction of waterway tunnel, the production of generating equipment and their installation and operation. Rodong Sinmun

title: More Areas Put under Cultivation of Tea Trees
body: Areas cultivating tea trees are on the increase in Unjong Tea cultivation districts in the DPRK. New push has been given in Kangryong Unjong Tea Cultivation District and Kumdong Unjong Tea Cultivation District to bring more areas under the cultivation of tea trees. Since the end of last year up to date they have put 30 and 15 more hectares under cultivation respectively. Rodong Sinmun

title: Model Technical Innovation Units for 2022 Named
body: Model technical innovation units for the year 2022 were named in the DPRK. 50 units won the title of model technical innovation unit. Five units of them are thrice model technical innovation units including the Pyongyang Textile Machine Factory and 26 units are twice model technical innovation units including the Pyongyang Mechanical Pencil Factory and the Kaechon Coal Mine. More than 1 660 units across the country have won the title since the movement began. Rodong Sinmun

title: Construction of Teacher Training Colleges in Provinces Pushed Forward in Final Stage
body: The construction of teacher training colleges in provinces is being stepped up in the final stage. Last year North Hwanghae Province finished large amounts of construction project following the completion of the framework of school building, dormitory, gym and other parts of the project earlier than schedule despite difficulties. Now builders are making lots of achievements in the next-stage construction project. North Hamgyong Province has put great efforts to refurbishing Kim Jong Suk Teacher Training College. While taking the proper step to supply finishing building materials, the province heightens emulation atmosphere among construction units, thereby markedly increasing results. North and South Phyongan and South Hwanghae provinces, too, try to provide educational facilities and fixtures, keeping step with the progress in the construction. Rodong Sinmun

title: Central Zoo Filled with Laughter
body: The Central Zoo built at the foot of Mt Taesong of scenic beauty are the places which our people, youths and schoolchildren love to visit. The Central Zoo can be called as the epitome of fauna on the world and the cradle of animals in all seasons. Laughter of working people and schoolchildren are resounded incessantly who are plunged in interesting world of animals and lose count of time. The Central Zoo is an educational base as well as a cultural and emotional life base which gives the omnifarious knowledge of nature, happiness of life and rich emotion to people. It was built by our Party for our ordinary people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Symposiums Mark Publication Anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's Work
body: Symposiums were held in Pyongyang and every province of the DPRK to mark the 60th publication anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's work "On Firmly Establishing the Revolutionary World Outlook among Students". Present at the symposium held at Kim Il Sung University were Ri Tu Song, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Kim Sung Chan, president of the university and minister of Higher Education under the Education Commission, Mun Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League, Hong Chol Jin, secretary of the Pyongyang City Committee of the WPK, and party and youth league officials and students of universities in Pyongyang. Hong Hye Myong, department head at Kim Il Sung University, Rim Chol Song, a student at Kim Chaek University of Technology, and others talked about the historic significance and vitality of the work as well as the ways for steadily pushing ahead with thoroughly establishing the revolutionary world outlook among students. Speakers stressed that the Chairman's talk to primary officials of the student organizations in the faculty of economics at Kim Il Sung University on February 22, Juche 51 (1962) "On Firmly Establishing the Revolutionary World Outlook among Students" is a classic document in which he advanced an original idea on the revolutionary world outlook for the first time in history and set forth the important guidelines for training all the university students into ardent loyalists boundlessly faithful to the Party. They referred to the fact that the Chairman, who most perfectly personified the Juche idea founded by President Kim Il Sung, gave clear answers with his energetic speculation and study to the essence of the revolutionary world outlook and the process of its formation and other theoretical and practical issues arising in educating and training the students in a revolutionary way. They stressed that the undying exploits of the Chairman, who indicated the correct orientation and way for creditably training students to shoulder the future destiny of the revolution through his energetic ideo-theoretical activities, will shine forever. They noted that under the guidance of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, a steady continuity is given to the history of prioritizing and loving the youth made by the Chairman who had always valued the youth very much and nurtured them as pillars of the revolution. Similar events were held in all provinces. Rodong Sinmun

title: His Love Touches Heartstrings of All People
body: Selfless, Devoted Efforts for the People One day in April Juche 101(2012), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un met with some officials. He taught them that they had to give priority to the people’s demands and interests in doing everything while regarding them as Heaven and respecting them, true to the noble intentions of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, who had regarded it as their motto to believe in the people as in Heaven. He told them that Party organizations should value and love the people with motherly affection and protect their political lives to the end. His words implied that our Party had to be turned into a motherly one that takes warm care of the people’s destiny and future. Looking around the officials lost in thought, the respected General Secretary continued that officials must devote their all to the people and that officials exist for the people, not vice versa. He stressed that officials must share weal and woe with the people and make selfless, devoted efforts for them. Looking up to the respected General Secretary, officials made up their minds to dedicate everything to the people. For 750 Years and Even 7 500 Years The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un expressed his heartfelt feelings for the people at the speech delivered at the military parade held in celebration of the 75th anniversary of the founding of the Workers’ Party of Korea. "Our people have always been grateful to our Party, but it is none other than themselves who surely deserve a bow of gratitude," he said. He resumed: "Seeing the images of our people who have won victory for the great October holiday overcoming all manner of hardships with boundless loyal and filial devotion, indomitable fighting spirit and sincere efforts, I feel with great pride the almighty strength with which they would follow and defend the Party for another 75 years, nay, 750 years and even 7 500 years." Indeed, the respected General Secretary is the great father of the people possessed of the warmest feelings for the people. Holding such a benevolent father of the people in high esteem, our Party remains faithful to its honorable mission as a motherly Party for the people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Seminars Abroad Mark Birth Anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il
body: Seminars on the achievements of Chairman Kim Jong Il were held in Nepal, Pakistan, France, the Czech Republic, Spain, Serbia and Algeria from February 3 to 15 to mark his birth anniversary. The general secretary of the Central Committee of the Nepal Communist Party (Marxist-Leninist) and the international secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the People of Spain praised the Chairman for successfully solving the issue of succession to the leadership. The general secretary of the Communist Party of the People of Spain, the chairperson of the Nepal Institute for the Juche Studies and the secretary of the Socialist Journalist Forum of Nepal for the Study of the Juche Idea stressed that Kim Jong Il foiled the imperialist allied forces' anti-DPRK moves and defended the destiny of the country and nation with the treasured sword of Songun and that the achievements he made by providing a powerful ideo-theoretical weapon for accomplishing the cause of socialism and vigorously advancing the world socialist movement would shine long in history. The chairperson of the Serbian National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea said that the august name of the Chairman will always be remembered by the progressives. The secretary general of the France-Korea Friendship Association said that the Chairman remarkably bolstered the national defense capabilities with his iron will and matchless pluck to champion peace and security of the Korean peninsula and the rest of the world. Only Kim Jong Il can make such gigantic achievements, he added. The chairperson of the Algeria-Korea Friendship Association praised Kim Jong Il as a true popular leader and peerless patriot, lauding his revolutionary career. The chairpersons of the Central Committee of the Worker-Peasant Party of Pakistan and the Pakistan Association for Self-Reliance Studies and the chief of a Pakistani women's organization for the study of the Juche idea recalled that Kim Jong Il clearly showed the road ahead of humankind through his energetic ideo-theoretical activities and revolutionary leadership and led the Korean people to victory and glory only. A congratulatory message to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un was adopted at the seminar in the Czech Republic. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il Praised by Foreign Figures
body: Personages of different countries released statements between February 10 and 12 to celebrate the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Boswa Isekombe Sylvere, general secretary of the Communist Party of DR Congo, stressed that Chairman Kim Jong Il would be remembered by the Korean people and other world progressives for all ages for his great exploits for the times and the history, saying that under his guidance eye-opening successes were made in socialist construction of the DPRK and a guarantee for stable improvement of the people's living standard provided. Garib Newaz, president of the Bangladesh People's League, praised the Chairman as the great leader who developed the Workers' Party of Korea into the general staff of the Korean revolution with the Juche idea as its monolithic guiding ideology. It is one of his party guidance exploits that he modeled the whole Party on the monolithic idea and firmly consolidated the cohesion and unity of the Party ranks, he added. The chief of Kim Il Sung Library in Sofia of Bulgaria lauded the Chairman as the outstanding leader who enriched the Juche idea founded by President Kim Il Sung, thoroughly applied it to all fields of the state activities and vigorously led the cause of independence against imperialism. The chairperson of the Mexican Committee for Support to Korea's Peaceful Reunification stressed that Kim Jong Il is a great elder statesman recognized by the world who turned the DPRK into an invincible socialist fortress and military power with his Songun politics. Rodong Sinmun

title: Asian Regional Internet Seminar Held
body: An Asian regional internet seminar on the immortal exploits of Chairman Kim Jong Il, who formulated the Juche idea as Kimilsungism and developed it in depth, was held on February 14 ahead of the Day of the Shining Star, his birth anniversary. Posted on a website opened for the seminar were congratulatory messages from the International Institute of the Juche Idea (IIJI), the Korean Association of Social Scientists and African, European and Latin American institutes of the Juche idea. Papers dealing with the immortal feats of the Chairman were also placed on it. Taking part in the seminar were the secretary general of the IIJI, members of the Board of Directors of the Asian Regional Institute of the Juche Idea and chiefs of Juche idea study organizations in different countries. Kenichi Ogami, secretary general of the IIJI, said that the world people recall the Chairman's exploits with ardent reverence for him on his 80th birth anniversary, praising his ideo-theoretical feats performed to enrich the Juche idea as required by the times. Subash Kaji Shrestha, deputy secretary general of the Asian Regional Institute of the Juche Idea, pointed out that the Chairman synthesized and systemized the Juche idea on the basis of comprehensive analysis and review of the revolutionary ideas of the preceding working class and ensured that its gigantic vitality was fully displayed in the practice of the Korean revolution. M. Qamrul Huda, director of the Asian Regional Institute of the Juche Idea, said that after the demise of President Kim Il Sung, the Chairman performed great achievements during his prolonged struggle for the state's development and that he was recognized as an outstanding leader by not only the world progressives but also statesmen of hostile countries. A congratulatory message to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un was adopted at the seminar. Rodong Sinmun

title: "Hwanggumbol" Website Conducive to Agricultural Production
body: "Hwanggumbol" is a website disseminating advanced farming technologies and experience of model units in the DPRK. In recent years, many units have made successes in agricultural production with the help of this website. Last year, the Anak Farm in Anak County of South Hwanghae Province markedly increased per-hectare yield by applying the agricultural science and technology information carried in the website. Enthusiasm for learning advanced technologies through the website is growing higher with each passing day among agricultural workers in the fields of stock-breeding, fruit farming and vegetable growing. The Kyenam Stock Farm made successes in raising domestic animals by introducing advanced science and technology information. Rodong Sinmun

title: Efforts Paid to Establishment of Scientific Farming Methods in DPRK
body: Officials and scientists of each provincial institute of agricultural science in the DPRK have made progress in researches for the establishment of scientific farming system and methods capable of propelling seed revolution and coping with disastrous abnormal weather. The North Hwanghae Provincial Institute of Agricultural Science bred high-yielding rice strains resistant to typhoon and a rice species whose seedlings can be cultivated without using plastic sheet. It is conducting researches for establishing their cultivation technologies in a scientific way. The Kangwon Provincial Institute of Agricultural Science directed its effort to the increase of seed productivity in order to introduce the rice species newly bred last year into the whole areas of the province. It is also striving to finish the research into breeding high-yielding autumn wheat strains and aftercrop bean strains within this year. The South Phyongan Provincial Institute of Agricultural Science made clear the biological character of rice species strongly resistant to base and has strived to establish its cultivation technology. Other provincial institutes of agricultural science, too, strive to develop growth promoter and nutritive substances with locally available raw materials and resources. Rodong Sinmun

title: Ground Excavation Accelerated at Housing Construction Site in Hwasong Area
body: Ground excavation is accelerated by the soldier- and civilian-builders at the site for construction of 10 000 flats in Hwasong area. After correctly allotting the tasks for the construction units, the construction headquarters defined the order of priority in the work as required by the conditions of weather and surroundings while meticulously conducting the operation and command. Large visual aids, boards bearing slogans and watchwords and red flags standing in the construction site encourage the soldier- and civilian-builders in their patriotic zeal to make a revolution in the construction. The soldier-builders in charge of the main front of the construction of 10 000 flats in Hwasong area started work in a daring manner. All units of the People's Army are facilitating the work by rapidly deploying excavators and trucks in the construction project and raising the utility rate of equipment. They are taking preliminary measures to readily introduce the construction equipment such as concrete mixers while carrying on the ground excavation. Civilian construction units, too, are pushing forward with the project after establishing well-regulated direction system and taking measures for the supply of equipment and materials. Several brigades finished the arrangement of area in a short period and effectively distributed equipment and forces to fit the scale while stepping up the ground excavation on schedule. Members of the High-Speed Youth Shock Brigade are fully displaying the charging spirit with a determination to give full play to the resourcefulness and gallantry of the Korean youth in the worthwhile struggle to further glorify the heyday of capital city construction. Rodong Sinmun

title: Anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's Visit to Potato-processing Factory Marked
body: A meeting to commemorate the 20th anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's visit to the Potato-processing Factory in Taehongdan County of Ryanggang Province, the DPRK, took place on the spot on Feb. 23. Attending it were Ri Thae Il, chief secretary of the Ryanggang Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), officials concerned and officials and employees of the factory. Pak Kuk Phil, manager of the factory, made a report at the meeting. The reporter said that the Chairman visited the factory on February 23, Juche 91(2002) and other occasions to clearly show the road ahead of the factory. He referred to the fact that the Chairman took measures for fully equipping the factory with modern production facilities and led it to substantially serve the people while giving instructions on goods packing and management method. He noted that the officials and employees of the factory have achieved proud successes in the production and construction in the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance over the past 20 years, true to Kim Jong Il's instructions and the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's noble intention of love for the people. He called on the officials and employees of the factory to add glory to the honor of being the unit associated with leadership exploits and make significant contribution to the improvement of the people's standard of living in the struggle for implementing the decisions made at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th WPK Central Committee. Rodong Sinmun

title: Meeting of Korean Youth League in Japan Held
body: The fifth meeting of the 24th Central Committee of the Korean Youth League in Japan was held at the Korean Hall in Tokyo of Japan on February 21. Attending it were Pak Ku Ho, first vice-chairman and concurrently director of the Organization Department of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), and Jo Myong Jin, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the Korean Youth League in Japan, Ri Kwang Il, its vice-chairperson and organizational department director, department directors, a chief instructor of the Korean University committee of the youth league and members of its Central Committee. The meeting discussed the tasks and measures for carrying through the decisions of the fifth meeting of the 24th Chongryon Central Committee and splendidly greeting the 25th Congress of Chongryon and the 25th Congress of the youth league. Jo Myong Jin made a report. He recalled that the youth league worked hard to thoroughly establish the ideological and leadership system of Juche in the league organizations, true to the important letter of congratulation to the Conference of Representatives of Branches of Chongryon-2020 (Third Conference of a New Heyday) sent by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. He vowed to give precedence to the ideological education of officials and youth league members, build lower-echelon organizations into spirited ones and firmly rally the broad sections of young compatriots around the youth league in order to glorify the coming 25th Chongryon Congress as one of leap and advance unprecedented in the history of the movement of Koreans in Japan. Speeches were made at the meeting. Pak Ku Ho concluded the meeting. Saying that a big stride should be made in the efforts for the overall development of the movement of Koreans in Japan along with the socialist construction in the homeland this year, a year of great auspicious events in national history, in hearty response to the New Year message sent by Kim Jong Un, he stressed the importance of the role of the youth league responsible for new generations. A letter to Kim Jong Un was read out at the meeting. Rodong Sinmun

title: Internet Photo Exhibition Held in Vietnam
body: An internet photo exhibition took place in Vietnam to mark the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il and the 65th anniversary of the meeting between President Kim Il Sung and President Ho Chi Minh. Posted on a website opened for the exhibition were photos of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un which show their achievements made in developing the friendly relations between the two countries together with leaders of Vietnam. The website also placed photos dealing with the happy life of the Korean children growing up with nothing to envy in the world under the warm care of the Party and the state and the development of Juche Korea. Present at the opening ceremony of the exhibition were personages from the Vietnamese government, political parties and organizations and the charge d'affaires ad interim and members of the DPRK embassy in Hanoi. A vice general director of the Viet Nam News Agency made a speech there. Saying that 2022 is a meaningful year marking the 72nd anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the two countries and the 65th anniversary of President Ho Chi Minh's visit to the DPRK, the speaker stressed that the friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries were provided and developed by President Ho Chi Minh and President Kim Il Sung. The speaker expressed the belief that the current exhibition would serve as an occasion to make lots of people get good understanding of the traditional history of friendship between the two countries and contribute to its development. Rodong Sinmun

title: Production Process of Hungnam Fertilizer Complex in Full Operation
body: The Hungnam Fertilizer Complex in the DPRK is keeping its new fertilizer production process in full operation. The complex stepped up the project for expanding its production capacity last year to succeed in trial operations. Technicians and skilled workers of the complex and relevant experts in the repairing sector fulfill their responsibility and duty. Rodong Sinmun

title: Work to Newly Set up Technical Senior Middle Schools Propelled in DPRK
body: The Education Commission, provinces, cities and counties in the DPRK have pushed ahead with the work to newly set up technical senior middle schools. Hundreds of technical senior middle schools have already come into being in different parts of the country. More than 130 technical senior middle schools, which teach technical subjects of different sectors, are to newly come into being throughout the country this year. The Education Commission organizes such works as sending textbooks and reference books to technical senior middle schools and providing conditions for educational work. The commission has amended the educational contents of technical subjects of the existing schools so that students can acquire much more professional technologies and pushed ahead with the work to establish a system which students choose technical class according to their wishes. Provinces, cities and counties take measures to turn the existing senior middle schools into the technical senior middle schools and direct efforts to building up teaching force, as well as improving the educational condition and environment of these schools. Rodong Sinmun

title: Last Year's Forest Restoration and Land Management Reviewed in DPRK
body: A video conference to review last year's work for the forest restoration campaign and the general mobilization for land management took place at the People's Palace of Culture on February 24. Attending it were Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, O Su Yong, secretary of the C.C., WPK, and cadres of the Party and government, officials of the Cabinet, commissions, ministries, national institutions, educational institutions, and provincial, city and county Party and power organs and officials in the fields of forest restoration and land and environment protection. Also present were Ri Yong Gil, minister of National Defence, and officials of the armed forces organs. The conference analyzed and reviewed successes and shortcomings in last year's work for the forest restoration campaign and the general mobilization for land management and discussed measures for building up firm foundations this year for implementing the five-year plan and bringing about a radical turn in the land management, including forest and water conservation and road management. Multimedia on last year's forest restoration campaign and general mobilization for land management were screened at the conference. The conference analyzed and reviewed the shortcomings revealed in the forest restoration and the general mobilization for land management. It called upon officials to stand in the van in this year's struggle for cementing the foundation for implementing the 5-year plan and for turning the country into a socialist fairyland and a beautiful land representing the era of the Workers' Party. Rodong Sinmun

title: African Regional Internet Seminar Held
body: An African regional internet seminar on the exploits of Chairman Kim Jong Il was held on the occasion of the Day of the Shining Star, his birth anniversary. Posted on a website opened for the seminar were congratulatory messages from the Korean Association of Social Scientists and the Asian, European and Latin American regional institutes of the Juche idea and papers of Juche idea followers in Guinea, Mali, DR Congo, Benin, Senegal, Uganda, Ethiopia and Tanzania. Present at the seminar were members of the Board of Directors of the African Regional Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea and Juche idea followers in African countries. Andre Lohekele Kalonda, secretary general of the African Regional Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea, said that the Great Leader Kim Jong Il left great exploits as a legacy and, therefore, events paying tribute to him, the Shining Star of Mt Paektu, take place on a worldwide scale every year. The general secretary of the National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of DR Congo said that the Juche idea which was comprehensively systemized by Leader Kim Jong Il is being widely studied and disseminated worldwide as a guiding idea of the present era, the era of independence. Abdoulaye Diallo, secretary general of the Guinean National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, noted that Leader Kim Jong Il always found himself among the people and devoted himself to the people in his lifetime, adding that the people had always been kept in his mind. Hessou Kohovi, chairman of the Benin National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea, said that HE Kim Jong Il is a great master of independent politics recognized by the world and a prominent leader and the eternal sun of mankind ardently revered by all people. Rodong Sinmun

title: General Secretary of Our Great Party Illuminates Road Ahead of Times and Revolution
body: Firmly Holding Fast to Helm of Times In the new century of Juche, our country always emerge victorious without any slightest stagnation under the outstanding leadership of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un who clearly illuminates the rightful lines and policies, fighting methods and goals, as well as strategic and tactical policies, in each period of the developing revolution with his extraordinary ideological and theoretical activities and prominent leadership and thus leads our revolution to victory. In his congratulatory speech made at the military parade in celebration of the 100th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, he powerfully declared that the eternal strategy of our revolution and its final victory lie in advancing along the road of independence and socialism indicated by President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. He, who provided an indestructible milestone for strengthening and developing the Workers’ Party of Korea by formulating the great Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism as the eternal guiding idea of our Party, indicated the unchangeable path of the far-reaching plan for the new century of Juche to be firmly maintained by our people at the significant celebration square. The ten years began with presentation of great idea during which the leading force of its great banner and tremendous viability were displayed. The great idea presented by the respected General Secretary made our people bring about the ten years of world-shaking miracles and changes serving as the banner leading them, essential element of their life and motive force. Our country could vigorously advance along the road of prosperity and victory overcoming difficulties and ordeals, thanks to the lofty guidance of the respected General Secretary who illuminated the way ahead with extraordinary ideological and theoretical wisdom. Bright is the future of our country and people dynamically advancing under the leadership of the great Party which unfolds designs of prosperity, firmly gripping the helm of the times and control stick of history. His Great Disposition and Limitless Passion Lying beneath the remarkable ideo-theoretical activities of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un is his great disposition including brilliant intelligence, scientific clairvoyance and exceptional faculties of inquiry. The respected General Secretary effected a fundamental change in the development of the people’s world outlook by elucidating great new ideas with original insight and wisdom. However much water may flow under the bridge, such outstanding clairvoyance and analysis, thinking and pursuit of his claim people’s admiration in terms of scope, depth, truthfulness and scientific accuracy. Our country owes its victories in revolution and construction for the past ten years without the slightest stagnation and standstill to the respected General Secretary who gave wise solutions to all the difficult and complicated problems arising in the revolutionary practices through energetic ideo-theoretical activities. The great ideas and theories of the respected General Secretary shaking the times are the fruit of his unparalleled passion. He applies himself to thinking and pursuit day and night with matchless wisdom as one of his natural gifts. That’s why he is well versed in all fields of politics, economy, science, education, literature and art, military affairs and sport as well as the preceding ideas and theories of mankind. This has enabled him to advance numbers of original ideas and theories. History has witnessed not a few thinkers, theoreticians and great persons who left indelible traces in the development of the progressive ideas of mankind. However, there has never been such a great statesman, thinker and theoretician as the respected General Secretary who has opened a broad avenue for carving out the destiny of the country and nation and left brilliant traces in the world’s history of politics. title: Elephant Rock in Monggumpho-Natural Monument
body: The DPRK has lots of natural monuments. Among them is an elephant rock over the cliff in Monggumpho, a scenic spot in the West Sea of Korea. Its shape is attributable to the sea abrasion of quartz porphyry dating back to the Cretaceous Period of the Mesozoic Era together with the weathering that happened along the vertical joint faces. The rock is 15 metres high with its trunk part 3 metres around. In high tide, the rock reminds of an elephant drinking the sea water. The rock of peculiar shape adds to the charm of the scenic lagoon, in combination with the beauty of the seaside cliff and clean seawater. The natural monument is preserved well under the Party’s policy of conserving national heritage. Rodong Sinmun

title: 2nd Conference of Secretaries of Primary Party Committees Opens
body: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Guides Conference The 2nd Conference of Secretaries of Primary Committees of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) opened here on February 26 at a time when all the Party members and other people are ushering in a new amazing era of the prosperity of the country with great confidence in victory, true to the grand blueprint unrolled by the great Party Central Committee. The conference, the second of its kind in the history of the WPK, serves as a significant occasion in accelerating the all-people general advance for bringing about the overall development of socialist construction by more firmly consolidating all the primary Party organizations into the combat ranks of loyalty and the vanguard units for carrying out the Party's policies, in which the Party's unified leadership system is thoroughly established, and by cementing the political and ideological position of our revolution in every way, in hearty response to the idea and spirit of the 8th Congress of the WPK. The proud reality, in which the might of the single-minded unity and harmonious whole formed between the leader, Party and masses are being signally increased and great creation and changes made in all sectors of socialist construction despite the severe challenges and difficulties unprecedented in history, is brilliant fruition of the idea and line of the Party Central Committee, which has steadily enhanced the fighting efficiency of the primary Party organizations, the lower-echelon organizations and main combat units of the Party, on attaching importance to and strengthening the primary Party organizations. The 2nd Conference of Secretaries of Primary Committees of the WPK is to analyze and review the achievements and experience, mistakes and their causes in the work of the primary Party organizations in the period after the First Conference of Chairpersons of the Primary Committees of the Workers' Party of Korea and to discuss the measures for further improving and strengthening the work of the primary Party organizations, as required by our revolution which entered a new period of great upsurge and turn. Attending the conference were secretaries of the primary Party committees and sub-primary Party committees of factories, enterprises and cooperative farms who distinguished themselves in carrying out the Party's policies, secretaries of the primary Party committees of ministries, national institutions and guiding organs at provincial, city and county levels, senior officials of the provincial, city and county Party committees and other Party committees playing the same function, and officials of the Party Central Committee. All the participants in the conference were full of profound reverence for and trust in the Party Central Committee which has guided the work for enhancing the fighting efficiency of the lower-echelon Party organizations, while prioritizing the work for strengthening the primary Party organizations, the political staffs of relevant units in building the Juche-oriented revolutionary party and accomplishing the cause of socialist construction. Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, came out to the platform to guide the conference. The moment, all the participants greeted him with thunderous cheers of "Hurrah!" as a token of their deep reverence for the respected General Secretary of the WPK who has led to victory and glory the sacred cause of turning the country into an ideal socialist country and the people's paradise, while demonstrating to the world the dignity and prestige of the great WPK with his outstanding ideological and theoretical wisdom and energetic leadership. The platform was taken by Jo Yong Won, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretary for Organizational Affairs of the WPK Central Committee, Ri Il Hwan, Kim Jae Ryong, O Il Jong, Kim Yong Hwan, Ju Chang Il and other senior officials of the WPK Central Committee, the provincial Party committees and the Party committees that perform the same function. The respected General Secretary made an opening address. The participants hardly repressed their excitement, looking up to the respected General Secretary who extended warm militant greeting to the secretaries of all the primary Party committees, highly praising them for making tangible contributions to the development of the Party and the vigorous advance of socialist construction at lower-echelon Party organizations over the past five years. When the respected General Secretary declared the 2nd Conference of Secretaries of Primary Committees of the WPK open, the national anthem of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea was played solemnly. Jo Yong Won made a report at the conference. He said that the 2nd Conference of Secretaries of Primary Committees of the WPK is being held at a historic time when the vigorous struggle is being waged for the prosperity and development of our great country and the people's well-being with great courage and sky-high spirit along the path of victory indicated by the 8th Congress of the WPK and the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the WPK, the important events of particular note in the history of Juche revolution. The respected General Secretary ushered in a new heyday of building basic Party organizations with his outstanding idea and energetic leadership, regarding it as fundamentals for developing the whole Party to strengthen the primary Party organizations, he noted. The original ideas and theories of the respected General Secretary, who comprehensively clarified the position and duty of the primary Party committees and the tasks and ways for strengthening them at the 1st Conference of Chairpersons of Primary Party Committees, the first of its kind in the history of our Party, and other major Party meetings, serve as the important guidelines to be adhered to in the Party building and in innovating the work of the primary Party committees, he stressed. He recalled that the respected General Secretary wisely led the primary Party committees to focus their work on thoroughly implementing the Party lines and policies and major revolutionary tasks by giving full play to the spiritual strength of the masses. The reporter recalled that during his field guidance, the respected General Secretary underlined the need for their primary Party committees to intensify the education in the leadership exploits of the Party and the five-point education, properly guide the organizational and ideological life of Party members, ensure the trinity and make devoted service for the people run through the Party work. The respected General Secretary also underlined the need to enhance the role of ri Party committees so as to train agricultural workers to be those in charge of the rural revolution and ardent patriots, he added. During his guidance to the revolution, the respected General Secretary called beside him secretaries of primary Party committees, reposed great trust in them by calling them political commissars of main combat units for the implementation of the Party policies, taught them the principle and ways of the Party work and the best methods of mobilizing the spiritual strength of the masses, he stressed, adding that thanks to the meticulous care of the great teacher, secretaries of primary Party committees have fulfilled their responsibilities. The primary Party organizations are displaying their might as the vanguard of loyalty in which the iron discipline of moving as one under the unified leadership of the Party Central Committee has been established, and as the organization thoroughly implementing the politics based on the people-first principle by responsibly taking care of the destiny and life of people and as the main fighting sub-units for devotedly implementing the lines and policies of the Party, he noted, terming it invaluable fruition of the outstanding idea and leadership of the respected General Secretary. Carrying the unanimous minds of the participants in the conference and the secretaries of all the primary Party committees, the reporter extended the highest glory and warmest greetings to Kim Jong Un, the great leader of our Party and revolution who is further strengthening the WPK into an ever-victorious guiding force and energetically leading the struggle for a fresh victory in socialist construction. The report referred to the successes and experience gained in the struggle for carrying out the militant tasks set forth at the First Conference of Chairpersons of Primary Party Committees. The report also cited in detail the achievements made by the primary Party organizations in the course of focusing the Party work on devotedly defending and thoroughly establishing the unified leadership system of the Party Central Committee, successfully implementing the strategic plans of the Party Central Committee and preparing themselves to be the vanguard of loyalty thinking and acting, true to the idea and will of the leader only. The report pointed out that a revolutionary climate of thoroughly implementing Party decisions without fail has been established in primary Party committees. The report stressed that the course of adopting Party decisions in all the primary party committees has turned into the course of mobilizing the ideological power, mapping out plans and assigning tasks and the trait of implementing Party decisions unconditionally, thoroughly and correctly has been fully displayed with the 5th Plenary Meeting of the 7th Party Central Committee and the 8th Party Congress as watersheds. The reporter referred to the valuable successes the primary Party organizations made in establishing firm links based on blood ties between a broad spectrum of people and the Party as a result of their efforts for applying the spirit of devoted service for the people to the practice of the Party work. The past five-year struggle proves that only when the primary Party organizations and the secretaries of the primary Party committees remain true to the idea and leadership of the leader, thoroughly implement the Party's decision without fail and establish the traits of making devoted service for the people as a Party climate, the political and ideological position of our Party and revolution can be further consolidated and the socialist cause be vigorously advanced in any trials and difficulties, the reporter said. The report reviewed the shortcomings in the work of some primary Party organizations which failed to fulfill the urgent requirements of the Party and the revolution. Strictly analyzed and criticized were a series of mistakes made by primary Party organizations, including the issue of failing to regard the work for establishing the unified leadership system of the Party Central Committee as the lifeline of the Party work and strongly push forward it, the issue of failing to build up the ranks of cadres and the Party ranks into an elite force and efficiently conduct the work for rallying the broad masses behind the Party and the issue of impeding the implementation of the Party policies by failing to properly provide the Party's guidance over the fulfillment of the main revolutionary tasks in the fields and units in their charge. Blaming secretaries of the primary Party committees for conducting the work without a main emphasis, forgetful of the trust and expectation of the Party which put forward them as officials responsible for the Party organizations of their units, the reporter termed it the main causes of shortcomings revealed in the work of primary Party organizations in the past. The reporter went on: The reality shows that if the secretaries of the primary Party committees fail to enhance their political awareness and executive faculty and prepare themselves to be perfect in all aspects, including working methods and working manner, it is impossible to implement the idea of the Party Central Committee giving importance to the primary Party committees and make a substantial change and improvement in the work of their units. The secretaries of primary Party committees should sternly review the past 5-year work and bring about a radical turn in the work of the primary Party committees, as required by the noble intention of the Party Central Committee and the developing revolution. Then the reporter detailed the tasks to be fulfilled in strengthening the primary Party organizations into the vanguard units sharing the idea and intention with the Party Central Committee and acting in concert with it, and into the political staffs greatly encouraging their units to implement the decisions of the Party Congress. He also underlined the need for the primary Party organizations to firmly unite the revolutionary ranks as an integral whole by developing the work for establishing the monolithic leadership system of the Party Central Committee onto a new high stage. He underscored the need to wage an intensive ideological offensive for arming officials, Party members and other working people with the revolutionary idea of the respected General Secretary and to hold fast to championing and glorifying the revolutionary relics and leadership exploits of leaders as a main task of the work of primary Party committees. He called for strengthening the ranks of party cell secretaries and making scrupulous arrangements for turning all the Party cells into healthy and viable ones closely knitted in the bonds of kinship. He said it is necessary to do work with the masses in a creative and active way in consideration of individual characters and steer the youth league and other working people's organizations to focus efforts on their internal work so as to make the officials and employees of each unit patriotic socialist workers. He called for thoroughly carrying out fighting tasks set forth by the Party by further intensifying policy-oriented guidance and political guidance to ensure that administrative and economic work is only conducted as thought and intended by the Party Central Committee. He stressed the need to firmly consolidate the revolutionary and class position of rural areas and achieve the radical development of agricultural productive forces and the fundamental change of rural living environment by increasing the function and role of the rural ri Party committees in every way and stepping up the three revolutions － ideological, technical and cultural － so as to creditably realize the Party's programme of socialist rural construction. He called on the primary Party organizations within the entire Party to regard it as an important requirement for boosting the fighting efficiency of the Party and a critical matter linked with the destiny of the socialist cause to break with formalism and an inclination towards administrative aspects, the worst anathema to Party work and to wage an intensive struggle against them. He stressed that all the secretaries of primary Party committees will have to bear in mind the noble intention of the respected General Secretary and bring about new change in their work so as to make a positive contribution to strengthening the Party and achieving the overall development of socialist construction. Then, speeches were made by Pak Song Jin, secretary of the primary Party committee at the Mangyongdae Revolutionary Museum, Kim Ju Chon, secretary of the primary Party committee at the Sinpho Fishery Station, Kim Chol Min, secretary of the primary Party committee at the Sogu Public Building Construction Company under the Pyongyang City Management Bureau for Construction, Kim Hak Jong, secretary of the primary Party committee at the Ministry of Mining Industry, Kim Man Bok, secretary of the primary Party committee of the February 20 Factory, Ryom Kyong Chun, secretary of the primary Party committee at the ammonium nitrate shop of Hungnam Fertilizer Complex, Kim Myong Il, secretary of the primary Party committee at the Sangwon Limestone Mine under the Sangwon Cement Complex, and Kim Kyong Chol, secretary of the primary Party committee at the Pyongyang Daily Necessities Factory. Speakers analyzed and reviewed in depth the achievements and experience gained by primary Party organizations for the past period. The participants were deeply moved by the experience of the primary Party committees of the Mangyongdae Revolutionary Museum and the Sinpho Fishery Station which firmly prepared their employees to be genuine loyalists and ardent revolutionaries reliably defending their honorable posts of adding luster to the revolutionary history of the great leaders, and to be standard bearers for implementing the Party's policies on fishery by intensifying the education in loyalty among them, regarding it as the very lifeline. Introduced were the experience gained by the primary Party committee of the Sangwon Limestone Mine of the Sangwon Cement Complex which has boosted the limestone production by steadily increasing the power of ideology and collectivism, and the experience of the primary Party committee of the ammonium nitrate shop of the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex which performed great miracles and innovations in implementing the Party's policies in the course of winning the title of the Twice Three-Revolution Red Flag, deeming the mass-based movement a powerful means. The participants were greatly touched by the experience of the secretaries of the primary Party committees who shared joy and sorrow with their employees at the production sites with the traits and qualifications befitting frontline political workers, always paying deep attention to their family life and solving problems with the Party's method and the political method. Speeches seriously criticized and reviewed the mistakes some primary Party organizations made by failing to push ahead with the work for implementing the Party's policies as their primary task and disturbing the development of the units in their charge by working without the Party principle. Speakers expressed their resolution to wage a dynamic struggle for bringing about the comprehensive development of socialist construction by steadily intensifying the work for transforming the primary Party committees into elite ones strong in the organizing ability, fighting efficiency and executive faculty, true to the noble intention of the respected General Secretary. The conference continues amid the high enthusiasm of the participants renewing their determination to innovate the work of their units as required by the developing reality, while listening attentively to the report and speeches. Political News Team

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Makes Opening Address at 2nd Conference of Secretaries of Primary Committees of WPK
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), made an opening address at the 2nd Conference of Secretaries of Primary Committees of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) on February 26. First, Kim Jong Un expressed his pleasure to personally extend his gratitude to the secretaries of primary committees who have taken much trouble for the Party and the state in the basic Party organizations than others over the last 5 years since the gathering of secretaries of primary committees of the WPK which was the first in the history of the Party. He said that the main secret of our Party's overcoming unprecedented challenges and ordeals and leading the revolution in a firm and correct way in recent years can be ascribed to the fact that the secretaries of primary committees discharged their duties well in the basic organizations of the Party. He extended warm greetings to the secretaries of the primary committees who took part in the conference with the pride of making a positive contribution to the development of the Party and the vigorous advance of the socialist construction, and all other secretaries of the primary committees of the entire Party who strive to implement the decisions made at the Party Congress and the plenary meetings of the Party Central Committee, being in charge of the basic fighting units implementing the Party's policies. He mentioned the purpose of the Party Central Committee giving special importance to the conference. It is stipulated that the conference of secretaries of the primary committees of the Party should be convened every 5 years in the Party rule, he said, adding that this is aimed to orientate all the activities of the primary committees of the Party towards the implementation of the fighting programme indicated by the Party Congress. He also said that the work of the basic organizations of the Party should be often appraised and reviewed so as to thoroughly ensure unity in thinking and action of the entire Party, adding that this fully conforms with the idea of attaching importance to developing the basic organizations of the Party, the line of strengthening the entire Party and the requirements of the Juche-oriented Party building and activities. The decisions made at the 8th Party Congress are immediate strategy and tactics to put the economy of the country and the people's living standard on a stable orbit and to fully display our state-first principle and people-first principle in all fabrics of social life and a supreme task that has to be achieved without fail for the future destiny of our revolution, he noted. And then he emphasized that whether these responsible and important tasks of the times are correctly implemented or not entirely depends on the role of the Party organizations, especially, the role of the organizations of primary committees of the WPK. Saying that if all the Party organizations ranging from the Party Central Committee to the lower-echelon organizations achieve unity in thinking and action and vigorously carry on the struggle as one, there would be nothing impossible, he added that this is clearly proved by the course of the last year's struggle in which the great victory was won in the unprecedented severe environments.
