Noting that though we faced graver challenge and difficulty than those in the previous period, clear and positive changes could be made in all fields as all the Party organizations were awakened and aroused last year, he highly appreciated that an important factor that led to the desired result was especially the role of the primary Party organizations which have conducted dynamic organizational and political work to unconditionally carry out the decisions and instructions of the Party Central Committee. He referred to the fact that the Party Central Committee has prioritized the work of strengthening the primary Party organizations as one of the two tasks of strengthening the entire Party along with the work of strengthening Party cells, and has directed sustained great efforts to it. Saying that it is the pride of our Party and key factor and secret of its invincibility that it has firm foundation and reliable lower-echelon organizations, he stressed that the basic Party organizations are not maintained and enhanced spontaneously and this work should continuously be deepened along with the advancing revolution and construction. He referred to the fact that the guidance of the Party Central Committee over the work of the primary Party organizations became further detailed with the First Conference of Chairpersons of the Primary Committees of the Workers' Party of Korea as the starting point. He added that last year alone, the Party Central Committee availed itself of several opportunities, including the plenary meetings, to discuss with prudence the ways of improving the work of the primary Party organizations and gave assignments as part of the work to embolden the basic Party organizations in every way. He cited the serious deviations of not meeting the requirement of the developing reality, though a lot of primary organizations of the Party underwent signal development and their position and role became further improved and activated. He stressed the need to share experience gained in improving work and learn a lesson from mistakes. The important purpose of the conference is to review the past five-year work of the primary Party organizations from a critical stand and find a major way of improving and strengthening the work of the primary Party organizations, given the remarkably high requirement of the developing revolution so as to make it known to all the secretaries of all the primary Party organizations and arouse them once again. Calling for all the participants to carry out a cool review of their units' work and actively learn from and share the experience and good methods of excellent primary Party organizations by attending the conference with high political awareness, consciousness and clear purposefulness, he underscored the need to make the conference an epochal occasion in boosting the organizing ability, fighting efficiency and activity of every primary Party organization and a turning point in raising the political and practical ability of the secretaries of primary Party organizations to a new height. Expressing the belief that the conference will be another important milestone in further strengthening the lower-echelon organizations of the Party and making innovation in Party work as required by the new stage of struggle to achieve the overall development of socialist construction, he declared the conference open. Political News Team

title: Sanatorium Service Began
body: The public health field in the DPRK began sanatorium service from January this year. The Ministry of Public Health and the officials in charge are taking well-thought-out measures to provide satisfactory conditions and environment for the provision of service to working people. In relations with competent medical teams in Pyongyang, the work has been organized carefully to enhance the qualifications of medical workers in sanatoria, while making sure that treatment methods discovered by them greatly contribute to the recuperation of those under treatment there. Lots of working people are receiving treatment thanks to dedicated staff. Rodong Sinmun

title: Socialist Emulation for 2021 Reviewed in DPRK
body: A socialist emulation in the fields of major industry, fishery and fish farming for 2021 was reviewed at the People's Palace of Culture on Friday through video-conferencing. Present there were DPRK Vice-premier Yang Sung Ho, Ri Tu Song, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials in the fields of major industry, fishery and fish farming, officials concerned at national and local levels, officials of the trade unions and officials of the units taken part in the emulation. Pak In Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea, made a report of the review. He said that all the fields and units brought about a surge in production in their efforts to attain the goals of the first year for fulfilling the five-year plan, true to the decisions made at the historic 8th Party Congress and the Second and Third plenary meetings of the Eighth Party Central Committee. He said that the major industrial fields have fulfilled their production plans by promoting various mass movements according to the realities of the units, tapping all latent reserves to the maximum, raising the quality of goods and encouraging domestic production of raw and other materials and recycling. He noted that fishery stations over-fulfilled their fishing plans through an active drive while overcoming difficulties and hardship, and fish farms attained the goals by strengthening the material and technical foundation and taking timely measures for securing breeding fish and supplying sufficient feed. Then the standings of the emulation were announced. The participants at the review shared experience, and analyzed and reviewed mistakes and causes in their works. The outline for the socialist emulation in the fields of major industry, fishery and fish farming for 2022 was read out. Rodong Sinmun

title: World Knows No Such a Man as Our General Secretary
body: All the people of South Hamgyong Province including Hamhung City and Hamju County were deeply moved at the news that the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un shoveled the first spadeful of earth in commemoration of the ground-breaking ceremony for the construction of Ryonpho Greenhouse Farm and personally pressed the button for blasting, bursting out their excitement that such a man as our respected General Secretary could not be found in the world. Everybody is moved to tears by the noble love of the respected General Secretary who took measures to build the biggest and modern greenhouse farm in our country for the people of Hamhung City and South Hamgyong Province and visited windy Ryonpho area twice in less than one month. At that time when the work was in progress to build a modern large-scale vegetable greenhouse farm in Kyongsong County, North Hamgyong Province, the respected General Secretary had already made a huger plan for the people of South Hamgyong Province and put his heart and soul into it. Personally touring the windy Ryonpho area in April Juche 108(2019), he unfolded a plan to build in the area a modern greenhouse farm conducive to the improvement of its provincial people’s standard of living. He gave important teachings related with the construction of the Ryonpho area large-scale vegetable greenhouse farm on several occasions and guided the designing. He indicated one by one the tasks and ways arising in the construction of the greenhouse farm ranging from the formation of a powerful construction headquarters for pushing forward the construction, organization of sector-specific panels, perfect designs on the highest level, priority to the provision of building materials and manufacturing of greenhouse equipment, strengthening of construction guidance and supervision. And he visited again the field in January to give detailed instructions related to the construction of greenhouse farm and personally attended its ground-breaking ceremony in February.He regarded those things as his pleasure and he smiled broadly with a thought that he would do another rewarding work for the people.Our people will travel one road forever following the respected General Secretary while displaying their honor of holding him as great father in high esteem all over the world. Rodong Sinmun

title: Preparing Themselves As Performers and Masters of Scientific and Technical Development
body: Officials of the generating shop in the Namgang Power Station strive to bring up its employees as masters and performers of scientific and technical development. Junior officials of the shop set high targets for improving the employees’ technical knowledge and skills step by step and put big efforts into intensifying the technical study. They run the sci-tech learning space in a substantial way so that all employees can carry out their tasks for technical study voluntarily and actively. The officials make the employees steadily learn the advanced science and technology at the sci-tech learning space and actively apply them to production practice. They also strengthen their own technical forces by letting able technicians and skilled workers fulfill the tasks for technical innovation together with young employees. The employees’ technical knowledge and skills improve amid the brisk campaign for swapping experience, overtaking and learning from others. They have made positive contributions to normalizing the production of electricity by introducing several technical innovations relying on their own efforts and technology. This year the generating shop of Namgang Power Station has won the title of twice exemplary technical innovation unit. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Reply Message from President Xi Jinping
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), on February 21 received a reply message from Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and president of the People's Republic of China (PRC). In the message, Xi Jinping expressed his gratitude to General Secretary Kim Jong Un for having sent a congratulatory message over the Beijing Winter Olympics Games and a verbal message of congratulation soon after the successful closing of the games. The message said this showed the friendly feelings of the General Secretary and the Korean party, government and people towards Xi Jinping and the Chinese party, government and people as well as their concern and support for the games. Under the joint support and in the eyes of the international community, the games proved to be a streamlined, safe and splendid Olympics in the world, instilled mental strength into humankind in overcoming ordeals by joint efforts and actively contributed to propagating the Olympic spirit and building a community with a shared future for humankind, it said. The Chinese side is ready to work, together with the Korean side, to steadily develop the China-DPRK relations of friendship and cooperation, provide the two countries and the two peoples with happiness and make a positive contribution to regional peace, stability, development and prosperity by creditably implementing the important shared understanding reached by both sides under a new situation, the message noted. The message wished the General Secretary good health and smoothness in his work, hoping that he would continuously make new successes in leading the Korean-style socialist cause. Rodong Sinmun

title: European Regional Internet Seminar Held
body: A European regional internet seminar was held on February 19 on the occasion of the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. It was attended by the secretary general of the International Institute of the Juche Idea (IIJI), members of the European Society for the Study of the Juche Idea and chiefs of organizations for the study of the Juche idea. Matteo Carbonelli, secretary general of the European Society for the Study of the Juche Idea, made a keynote report at the seminar. The reporter said that it was an expression of reverence for the Chairman to splendidly celebrate his birthday, pointing out that worldwide colorful celebrations were held to mark his 80th birth anniversary. Kenichi Ogami, secretary general of the IIJI, and other speakers praised the Chairman as a great master in ideology and theory who enriched the treasure house of human thought, a genuine people's leader and benevolent father who devoted his all to the country's prosperity and the people's happiness and a great sage for the century acknowledged by the world. They recalled that the Chairman clarified the position and role of the leader in the revolutionary struggle in his early years, developed in depth the Juche idea as required by the times and victoriously advanced the global socialist movement by foiling the imperialists' anti-socialist moves. They said that it is an honorable duty of the Juche idea followers to more briskly study and disseminate Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism in order to build a new world independent and peaceful. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Reply Message to Syrian President
body: Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a reply message to Bashar Al-Assad, president of the Syrian Arab Republic, on Feb. 25. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un in the message expressed deep thanks to the Syrian president for having extended warm congratulations and best wishes to him on the occasion of the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. He expressed belief that the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation between the DPRK and Syria provided in the common struggle for independence against imperialism will as ever grow stronger in line with the noble will of the preceding leaders and the desire of peoples of the two countries. Rodong Sinmun

title: NADA and Academy of Defence Science Conduct Important Test for Developing Reconnaissance Satellite
body: The DPRK National Aerospace Development Administration (NADA) and the Academy of Defence Science conducted an important test on Sunday under the plan of developing a reconnaissance satellite. The test helped the NADA and the Academy of Defence Science to confirm the characteristics and working accuracy of high definition photographing system, data transmission system and attitude control devices by conducting vertical and oblique photographing of a specific area on earth with cameras to be loaded on the reconnaissance satellite. The test is of great significance in developing the reconnaissance satellite. Rodong Sinmun

title: Second-day Sitting of 2nd Conference of Secretaries of Primary Committees of WPK Held
body: The second-day sitting of the 2nd Conference of Secretaries of Primary Committees of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) took place on February 27. Jo Yong Won, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretary for Organizational Affairs of the WPK Central Committee, guided the second-day sitting. Speeches were made there. Through the first-day sitting of the conference held in the presence of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, the participants cherished the noble intention of the Party Central Committee to make the conference a signal opportunity of raising the organizing ability, fighting efficiency and activity of all the primary Party committees and a turning point of raising the level of the political and practical qualifications of the secretaries of the primary Party committees on a new stage. They analyzed and reviewed in depth the Party work of their units after the 1st Conference of Chairpersons of Primary Committees of the Workers' Party of Korea. Speakers talked about their experience gained in successfully carrying out their tasks by focusing the work of the primary Party committees on implementing the Party's decisions and establishing the revolutionary trait of devotedly implementing them within the group. Introduced in the speeches was experience gained in enhancing the fighting efficiency of primary Party organizations and revitalizing the production by scrupulously organizing the life of Party members, guidance over it and the work for strengthening the Party cells. The speakers referred to their valuable experience gained in the course of firmly orienting the work of the primary Party committees to the struggle for implementing the Party's policies on attaching importance to talents, education, science and technology. The speakers stressed that all the achievements made in the work of the primary Party organizations in the past are the shining result of the outstanding leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un who brought about a revolutionary change in every aspect in the building of the basic Party organizations. Criticized in the speeches were a series of deviations of failing to bring the work of the primary Party organizations in step with the intention of the Party and the demand of developing revolution. Speakers reflected on the fact that they failed to do the ideological and political work positively and to fulfill the functions and role of primary Party committees satisfactorily. They also referred to the fact that they failed to make guidance based on policies and the political guidance run through Party leadership of economic work, and to strive to make officials steadily enhance their party spirit. And they analyzed and reviewed the causes and lessons of the shortcomings. Speakers vowed that they would dedicate themselves to carrying out the revolutionary tasks and do their duties of making primary Party committees the faithful vanguard acting true to the idea and intention of the Party Central Committee while always bearing in mind the great political trust and hope of the respected General Secretary on the secretaries of the primary Party committees, the chiefs of the political staffs of units. The conference discussed the ways of making all the participants improve the Party work as required by a new stage of struggle for a comprehensive development of the construction of the Korean-style socialism, keeping in mind the intention of the Party Central Committee placing great importance on the strengthening of primary Party committees as one of the two tasks for strengthening the entire Party, including the strengthening of Party cells. The conference continues. Political News Team

title: Cloth Production for School Uniforms and Bags Propelled in DPRK
body: The Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill in the DPRK has dynamically propelled the production of cloth for school uniforms and bags. The Tetron rayon fabrics shop and weaving shop No.5 of the silk-spinning combined shop are keeping the machines in full-capacity operation. Hundreds of thousands of meters of quality cloth were produced in a short period from the beginning of the production of cloth for school uniforms. Weaving shop No. 3 of the weaving combined shop in charge of the bag cloth production has increased the production. Displaying the collectivist traits, the shop opened a bright prospect to finish the bag cloth production in time. Rodong Sinmun

title: Latin American Regional On-line Seminar Held
body: The Latin American regional on-line seminar on the theme of "Career and Exploits of Comrade Kim Jong Il" took place on Feb. 19 on the occasion of his birth anniversary. Present there were personages of the Latin American Institute of the Juche Idea and political parties, groups for the study of Juche idea and organizations of friendship and solidarity with the Korean people in various countries of Latin America including Mexico, Brazil, Venezuela, Chile, Colombia, Peru, Ecuador and Costa Rica. Ramon Jimenez Lopez, director-general of the International Institute of the Juche Idea who is also director general of the Latin American Institute of the Juche Idea, made a keynote report at the seminar. The reporter said that Kim Jong Il comprehensively analyzed and reviewed 100-year history of the working class and clearly indicated the limitation of the time of the preceding theory and thus clarified the originality and validity of the Juche idea centered on man in a scientific way. Vice-Director General of the Latin American Institute of the Juche Idea Omar Lopez Perez, its Secretary General Eleazar Aldaran and its Director Roberto Carbonel Peso and Lucas Rubio, chairperson of the Brazilian Center for the Study of Songun Politics, made speeches at the seminar. The speakers praised Kim Jong Il for making a journey of patriotism and devotion till the last moment of his life. They added that Kim Jong Il made unremitting efforts for the economic development and the improvement of the people's living standard while giving field guidance to every part of the country after setting forth the slogan "We Serve the People!". A letter to the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un was adopted at the seminar. Rodong Sinmun

title: Education through Revolutionary Battle Sites and Revolutionary Sites Brisk in DPRK
body: Party organizations at all levels and working people's organizations of the DPRK make officials, working people and youth and students accept the revolutionary history as their real experience through the visit to the revolutionary battle sites and revolutionary sites. Officials of the South Hamgyong Provincial People's Committee and officials and working people of Hungnam District in Hamhung City made a study tour of the Majon Revolutionary Battle Site. Officials of the Party and power organs and youth and students of Pakchon and Unsan counties in North Phyongan Province visited the Pongrinsan and Yongungri revolutionary battle sites. Officials, working people and youth and students of Jagang Province visited Mt Jangja associated with the revolutionary relics of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Youth in different parts of the country are making study tour for arming themselves with indomitable revolutionary spirit and fighting spirit of self-reliance and fortitude displayed by the revolutionary forerunners in the battles against the Japanese imperialists. Many people have visited the revolutionary battle sites and revolutionary sites in South Phyongan Province. Students of graduating classes of senior middle schools in Ryanggang Province, too, visited revolutionary battle sites, revolutionary sites and revolutionary museums to prepare themselves as the successors to the revolution inheriting the noble spirit of the anti-Japanese revolutionary forerunners. Rodong Sinmun

title: Brisk Frontline-style Agitprop Activities Go On
body: More than 3 000 itinerant art propaganda squads across the country display feverish activities in the major domains of economic construction. The economic agitation activities of the itinerant art propaganda squads for vigorously inspiring the masses to implementing the decisions of 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea are being briskly launched in the major domains of national economy in February, in the wake of January. The Party organizations at all levels organize the work for focusing the agitating forces on the main fronts, keystone in achieving the economic revitalization and growth of production, in tactical and creative ways, and thus make over 3 000 itinerant art propaganda squads wage revolutionary ideological offensive in the major domains. The powerful agitprop forces are briskly active in the construction of 10 000 flats in Hwasong area. The itinerant art propaganda squads at districts, counties, factories and enterprises in Pyongyang are further raising the atmosphere of its construction site with high economic agitation. Field agitprop is in full swing at the steel producers and leading chemical industrial bases in the country. The itinerant art propaganda squads of cities, counties and cooperative farms across the country are also briskly conducting frontline economic agitation to vigorously goad the masses into its realization in hearty response to the Party’s socialist rural construction programme. Rodong Sinmun

title: Earnest Requests He Made to Designers
body: Go into Vibrant Reality In February, Juche 104(2015), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un inspected the Wonsan Baby Home and Orphanage under construction. He asked one of the officials if designers frequented the construction site. The official pointed to a designer not far away and told the respected General Secretary that he was staying at the construction site. The respected General Secretary personally called the designer over and learnt from him details about the situation of the designing institute he worked for. Then, the respected General Secretary said that every province must organize efficient designing and building forces and secure solid material and technological foundations of their own in order to thoroughly implement the Party’s construction policy. The designer was moved by the unfathomable love of the respected General Secretary who was anxious to improve the designers’ appreciative eyes and abilities. That day, he taught that designers must often visit the construction sites and intensify consultation with builders, that designers cannot improve their abilities if they stay at offices all the time and that designers can learn a lot from builders, and vice versa if they often have consultative meetings at construction sites. His instructions were a precious guideline that taught again the fact that the way for designers to incessantly improve their abilities exists in the vibrant reality, not in their offices. Be Patriotic Artists In March, Juche 106(2017), the respected General Secretary visited the newly-rebuilt Paektusan Institute of Architecture. After having made rounds of the exterior of the face-lifted building, the respected General Secretary said that the institute was the model designing institution in our country and that it must lead other counterparts of the country. His words pregnant with great expectations and trust touched the officials’ heartstrings. That day, the respected General Secretary stressed that designers must be patriotic artists who reflect the socialist civilization in the era of the Workers’ Party and people’s ideals and dreams in the dots and lines they draw on their blueprints. In the previous July, the respected General Secretary visited the institute and said that designers were gardeners taking care of flowers and artists drawing the rosy future of the socialist country. Patriotic artist! His precious teaching that day serves as a motive power inspiring the designers and architects to follow the single road of patriotism. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Makes Important Conclusion at 2nd Conference of Secretaries of Primary Committees of WPK
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, made an important conclusion "Secretaries of Primary Party Committees Should Become Genuine Political Workers of the Motherly Party" at the 2nd Conference of Secretaries of Primary Committees of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) on February 28. Saying that the entire Party and all the people pin very great expectations on the current conference of secretaries of the primary Party committees, the second of its kind in the history of the WPK, the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un referred to the significance of the conference convened at a crucial time of our revolution. A primary Party committee is the organization that is directly responsible for protecting the political life of the Party members and other working people and its role decides the development of a unit and improvement of the livelihood of its employees, he said, adding that's why everyone pays attention to what tasks will be set forth at the conference and what change made in the future work of the primary Party committee. Saying that it is possible to strengthen the whole Party and bring about an upswing on all fronts of socialist construction only when all the primary Party committees, the lower-echelon organizations of the Party and main fighting units for implementing the Party's policies, are well prepared and active, he stressed that in the light of that aspect it is of great significance at this crucial time to comprehensively examine and judge once again the fighting efficiency of the primary Party organizations and instill the idea and strategic intention of the Party Central Committee into the secretaries of the primary Party committees. He appreciated that the conference again established a unanimous view on the importance and urgency of improving the work of the primary Party committees, analyzed and reviewed in detail the achievements and defects in the course of strengthening the primary Party committees and deeply discussed realistic ways. He summarized the clear and positive changes made in the work of the primary Party committees in the past five years, including the fact that all the primary Party committees have focused their work on turning the units in their charge into the honest ones sharing idea and intention with the Party Central Committee and acting in concert with it, while exercising firm control and guidance over every work, ranging from the setting of goals to review and estimation, out of the firm stand that they should implement the Party's decisions and national economic plans without fail in keeping with their mission as the political staffs of the relevant units. Saying in excited tones that there are many full-time Party officials within the WPK but secretaries of the primary Party committees take the greatest trouble as they are responsible for dealing with all sorts of affairs, he stressed that the foundations for strengthening the whole Party and implementing the Party's policies have been firmly cemented and the units representing the times increase, thanks to the devoted efforts of the secretaries of the primary Party committees who more deeply awakened themselves to their mission and duty to fulfill the solemn demands of the Party and the revolution. He stressed the importance of sternly reviewing not only the past achievements but also the defects and drawing a lesson from them, for the conference is aimed at future development. Saying that the building of the Party and its activities have further intensified in recent years and fresh innovations, bold creation and steady progress formed the main current of the times, but there still exist many serious defects in the work of secretaries of primary Party committees, he pointed out their universal mistakes. Recalling that the conference rigorously reviewed the past work of secretaries of primary Party committees and discussed in depth the issues concerning the development of their work, he stressed the need for all the secretaries of the primary Party committees to innovate their work, as intended by the Party Central Committee and as required by the developing reality, while thoroughly getting rid of the negative elements latent in their work. He referred to the important tasks to be upheld and fulfilled primarily at present by the secretaries of the primary Party committees, the political officials of the Party devotedly serving the people. Saying that it is the steadfast will and the ultimate goal of the Party to consistently carry on the revolution and construction by dint of trust in and love for the people, unconditionally serve the people and build an ideal communist society for the people without fail, he stressed that our Party struggles to protect and support the people with sincerity, bring happiness to them and preserve their interests, not for any ism or prestige. He pointed out that every line and policy put forward by the Party, its tested leadership and invincible fighting efficiency and our style socialist construction powerfully led by it are all characterized by the ideals of "The People Are God" and "Devoted Service for the People's Wellbeing." He said that to be the Party of the people, the Party devotedly serving the people is the single reason of our Party's existence, its supreme symbol and permanent nature. He stressed that our Party's goal to become the true people's Party bestowing all sorts of loving care on the people and its creed to become the Party that goes to great pains for the people can never change. He said that the main purpose of building a new world on this land despite difficulties is not to demonstrate that we are capable of overcoming difficulties but to take care of the people with warmer sincerity and bring the happiest life to them. Saying that the secretaries of the primary Party committees are responsible for forming a firm link between the intention and feelings of the Party Central Committee with the minds of the employees of the units in their charge, he underscored the need for them to fervently love the people and show all sincerity for them. He noted that it is the highest honor of the secretaries of the primary Party committees to serve the people with sincerity. He mentioned that it is the invariable assignment given by the Party Central Committee to the secretaries of the primary Party committees to become the true political workers of the people's Party, the Party devotedly serving the people. He stressed that the work and humanity of primary Party committee secretaries will as ever be evaluated by how they play the role of an official of the motherly Party devotedly serving the people. Urging them to be very humble before the people, regard it as their natural gift and the most worthwhile work to go through thick and thin and devotedly work to ensure the best convenience and life of the people, he said that to do so constitutes the main attitude and traits our Party now requires the secretaries of the primary Party committees to have. Noting that it is not easy to do so, but from now on they should make a devoted forced march for the people in order to preserve the dignity and prestige of our Party, the party for the people and the party serving the people without an equal in the world, he said that it is high time for the Party officials to get closer to the people and treat them more kindly. Then he referred to the issues the secretaries of the primary Party committees should concentrate on with an emphasis put on discharging the role of true mother and faithful servant. He went on: One of them is to train officials, Party members and other working people of their units into socialist persons with fine political and moral traits and the other is to dynamically conduct the organizational and political work to implement the decisions of the Party congress and the plenary meetings of the Party Central Committee. In other words, the first thing necessary is to transform the ideological consciousness of people, and the second thing is to turn into reality our Party's policies of promoting the people's well-being. This fully complies with the true nature, mission and fighting purpose of our Party. The secretaries of all the primary Party committees should be well aware of their mission as political officials of the Party serving the people, and make the Party work serve this purpose. They should prepare the officials, Party members and other working people of their units to be politically and morally sound first of all. For mothers, nothing brings more pleasure to them than to see their sons and daughters becoming admirable persons capable of devoting themselves to the country and the people, and authentic human beings faithfully serving society and the collectives and keeping moral obligations. That's why mothers worry so much about their children and sometimes beat them to bring them up to be upright. A priority task for our Party to do for our people is to bring up all persons to be wonderful beings with the same truthful loving care as those mothers do for their children. Important here is to make people learn and embody high political awareness and the revolutionary outlook on morality. Kim Jong Un called on the secretaries of primary Party committees to direct their priority efforts to well preparing people in their units so as to fully guarantee them politically and morally before the Party and the revolution. He referred to the principled issues arising in earnestly and effectively doing education of the people to enhance their political awareness and outlook on morality. Stagnation and retreat in the economic affairs can be recovered but the stagnation and retreat in the education of people would bring irrevocable consequences, he said, stressing the need for the primary Party organizations to effectively engage in the work for enhancing the political and moral consciousness of people before getting concerned about the implementation of economic plans and the state of production. Education through revolutionary relics and the leadership feats of the Party is like the roots of our Party's ideological work and it can be called the starting point of the ideological education, he said, adding that it is entirely what the secretaries of the primary Party committees should do to make all the Party members and other working people find worth and honor of their life in the path of loyalty and patriotism and educate them to fulfill their moral obligation as human beings before society and the collective. He defined it as the core of the work of preserving the revolutionary relics to make sure that the resilient bonds between the leader and the people get stronger and our people's reverence for the leader become part of their ideological and moral traits. He underlined the need for the secretaries of the primary Party committees to give precedence to building well and managing and operating regularly the educational bases like Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism Study Hall, room for the education in the revolutionary history and room dedicated to the history of the units and thus make sure that the Party members and other working people nurture loyalty, faith and moral obligation for the Party and carry on the noble fighting spirit displayed by those of the preceding generations of the revolution. High political awareness and noble moral traits can become stronger and part of life only through organizational life and practice, he said, calling on the secretaries of the primary Party committees to set strong organizational discipline and make organizational and ideological life a regular and standardized one in all cases. He said that it is imperative to make all persons train themselves politically and morally under continued guidance of organization and support by the collective. Revolutionary practice is like a wonderful school for bringing up people, he said, stressing that the secretaries of the primary Party committees should not just wait for examples of the times to be produced from their units but purposefully organize the work to make all their employees patriotic working people and innovators who cherish love for factory, job and hometown in the revolutionary practices. The secretaries of the primary Party committees should respect and put forward before anyone else those faithfully fulfilling their own duties without wishing for any honor and appraisement, and inspire the masses with the positive example of the said persons so as to increase the ranks of faithful socialist working people, he said, stressing the need for the secretaries to lead the employees of their units to teach and learn from each other, share good experience and admonish against defects so that they would do things beneficial to the collective and display noble and beautiful moral traits. Kim Jong Un emphasized that the primary Party committee secretaries should wage dynamic organizational and political work for implementing the decisions of the 8th Party Congress and the plenary meetings of the Party Central Committee and bring about substantial achievements. He went on: The decisions of the Party Congress and the plenary meetings of the Party Central Committee reflect the firm determination and will of our Party to clear our people of their troubles at the earliest date and make them lead more stable and improved living at any cost. Therefore, our Party officials, secretaries of the primary Party committees should fulfill their responsibilities so that major decisions of the Party bear good fruit. It is important to definitely turn the struggle for implementing the Party decisions into the work of the popular masses themselves. What our Party believes most in the present struggle for winning new victory in socialist construction in defiance of unprecedented difficulties and trials is the mental power of the popular masses. Though right decisions are adopted by the Party, they will remain an empty talk if masses are not motivated. The secretaries of the primary Party committees should make the Party members and other working people turn out voluntarily in implementing the Party's policies by making them clearly understand that those policies are just for the sake of themselves and that no one can replace them in implementing the policies and that only when each unit thoroughly carries out the Party's decisions, the state affairs will be successful and the people's living will improve. The secretaries of the primary Party committees should make sure that all the employees become clearly aware of the work plans of their units in implementing the decisions of the Party Congress and the plenary meetings of the Party Central Committee, and steadily remind them of the plans, not just feeling satisfied with one or two reminding. They should be strict with the popular masses to make them review the daily implementation of the Party's decisions and get actively engaged in it, regarding them as standard and goal of their work. They should also help the employees display creativity through discussion with them of the innovative ways for the development of their units. The secretaries of the primary Party committees, bearing this in mind, have to wage effective and active political work to make sure that every worksite brims with the active drive for implementing the Party decisions and the national economic plans. In order to make the officials, Party members and other working people creditably carry out their tasks with proper stand and attitude to the implementation of the Party decisions, the secretaries of the primary Party committees should effectively do the summing-up and evaluation. The secretaries of the primary Party committees should take beforehand measures to solve problems that may arise in implementing the Party decisions and take care of bottleneck problems themselves to ensure the timely solution so as to keep the masses highly engaged. Kim Jong Un said that an important issue which the secretaries of the primary Party committees should pay heed to in implementing the Party decisions is to train scientific and technical forces of their units and deepen the Party guidance to make sure that it pays off. He continued: Whether scientific and technical talents pay off or not depends on Party officials. The secretaries of the primary Party committees who embody well the Party's idea of attaching importance to science and technology and talents and who have sizeable knowledge of science and technology about their own fields can be effective in doing the work with the talents. The secretaries of the primary Party committees should know all the technical forces and talents of their units, encourage them so that each of them could do their share and provide conditions for work and be responsible for their pursuit and results. The science and technology development plans should be included in the work plans of the primary Party committees as an important items, and through the work for implementing them, the level of the technicians and skilled workers should be raised and their ranks be expanded. The secretaries of the primary Party committees should pay deep attention to the effective operation of sci-tech dissemination bases all the time to make officials and employees strengthen scientific and technological study. Primary Party committees have to assign sci-tech study task to officials and employees and review their implementation so as to make them regard sci-tech study as the requirement under the Party policies and turn the course of study into the one of steadily raising the level of their technical skill. They should provide Party support to establish the traits of always giving precedence to science and technology in carrying out the Party decisions and the national economic plans and solving knotty problems by dint of science and technology and through mass technical innovation. Whether Party decisions given to a unit are implemented or not importantly depends on whether the Party, the administration and technical officials achieve trinity or not, Kim Jong Un said. He taught the work principles to be maintained by the secretaries of the primary Party committees, leading members in the trinity body, which include the issue of putting forward administrative and technical officials and respecting their opinions, the issue of providing Party support for the employees to accept the instructions of the administrative and technical officials as important ones and carry them out in time. He also mentioned the importance of welfare supply service in boosting the enthusiasm of the Party members and other working people who turned out in implementing the Party's decisions. Stressing the need for the secretaries of the primary Party committees to bring about evident improvement in the supply service work through strenuous efforts with firm determination to solve the problems concerning the living conditions of the employees at any cost, he said that the supply service work of each unit is what the secretaries of the primary Party committees should be responsible for from A to Z and that the supply service work must be the one from which employees can truly benefit under any conditions. Pointing out the issue of thoroughly obeying the state unified guidance and management over the economic work and the issue of improving the logistic work while putting the state interests above, he called for rejuvenating the foundation of logistic work to suit to the specific features of one's own unit and changing conditions and for setting rational logistic supply system and method. Kim Jong Un stressed the need to thoroughly prevent accidents in all units. He said that the secretaries of the primary Party committees should establish the revolutionary system and order while regularly acquainting and examining details of the state of their own units with responsibility, and ensure that all the officials, Party members and other working people work and live as required by the system and order. He also said that the secretaries of the primary Party committees should conduct in a far-sighted way the work of removing all the accident-prone elements from the stand of prioritizing security, calling for taking effective measures to settle faulty issues concerning the life and security of our people in particular. Kim Jong Un set forth the ways for making the primary Party committees the groups with strong fighting efficiency and cohesion. Whoever is the secretary of primary Party committee should throw oneself into turning it into a solid political and ideological position, vibrant combat rank of reliably standing guard over a post entrusted to them by the Party and the revolution, he said, calling for making the primary Party committees the integral whole of loyalty sharing the same thinking, intention and action with the Party Central Committee, both in name and reality. He stressed that the starting point and the general orientation of the work of primary Party committees is to help officials and Party members cherish immutable faith in keeping to the only path of following the Party Central Committee however the situation and the environment may change. The secretaries of the primary Party committees should make the officials and Party members regard it as the most sacred duty and supreme honor to follow the revolutionary idea of the Party Central Committee as the unconditional truth, to rely on it in doing everything and to unconditionally support and uphold with single mind the intention and plan of the Party Central Committee, he said. The secretaries of the primary Party committees should put efforts into staffing well the primary Party committees, political staff of their own units and enhancing the role of their members, Kim Jong Un stressed. Strengthening the primary Party committees presupposes strengthening Party cells, he said, adding: When all the Party cells in their units become healthy and vibrant cells, the primary Party committees can become vibrant groups with strong fighting efficiency and cohesion. The secretaries of the primary Party committees should keep deepening the work with the Party cell secretaries responsible for the cell work, not forgetting it even a minute. Those core members who are supported and trusted by the Party members should be made to take charge of the Party cells. The secretaries of the primary Party committees should exact high demand on the Party cell secretaries so that they can put all efforts into their work while constantly reminding themselves of the 10-point tasks and 12-point traits of Party cell secretaries, and strive to enhance the level of their working ability. In order to make the Party cells healthy and vibrant ones closely knitted in the bonds of kinship, it is necessary to create examples, generalize experience and put all the Party cells in each unit on a height required by the Party Central Committee. He said that as they are also members of the Party cells, the secretaries of the primary Party committees should give positive influence on the Party members and help the secretaries of the Party cells by setting an example in the manner of treating the Party cell secretaries and in the attitude of receiving Party assignments and executing them. Saying that the work of preparing the Party members and other working people politically and morally and the work of implementing the Party decisions depend on how the secretaries of the primary Party committees conduct the work with people, he taught the issues for the secretaries of the primary Party committees to fundamentally improve the work with the people. Saying that in order to do the work with people well, the secretaries of the primary Party committees should find themselves among the employees to correctly examine their mind and personality, he stressed that they should strive to deepen feelings with the employees and lend an ear to their honest voices and appeal while doing work together with them and talking to them all the time. He called upon the secretaries of the primary Party committees to conduct the work with people in a creative way to suit to their characters. He also called upon them to steadily search the effective ways and use them flexibly, mindful that they can not expect any achievement if they use stereotyped way in doing the work with people. He said that just as a mother speaks differently to her son and daughter and treats them differently in their growth stages, the secretaries of the primary Party committees should do the work with people creatively to suit to the characters of each person and the given situations though their employees number hundreds and thousands. He indicated in detail the ways of doing the work with different groups of people like the youth who are strong in the enterprising spirit and are always vibrant, women who are always considerate of their children and family life and those who made a mistake in their work and life. He called upon the secretaries of the primary Party committees to take warm care of their employees. He said that what is common in the work of those units in which everything goes well is that the secretaries of the primary Party committees strive to solve even one more problem arising in the living of the employees while paying deep attention to it. Saying that employees are moved when the secretaries of primary Party committees call in on them to ask about difficulties and sufferings, and they feel very grateful for the Party officials and set store by their care when they get to know that the Party officials take pains for them, he called on the secretaries of primary Party committees to take warmer care of the employees and dedicate sincerity to helping them out of difficulties, always paying deep attention to them. He said that the secretaries of primary Party committees should make it their habit to relieve the employees of their sufferings and resolve their knotty problems at any cost, conscious of their duty as the servants of the people, and kindly treat all the employees as family members, just like a mother who treats her children without discrimination. He stressed the need for the secretaries of the primary Party committees to maintain the principle while seriously and maturely doing the work with people. Saying that it is the greatest taboo to regard the words of one or two persons as absolute or thoughtlessly deal with the issues arising among people on the basis of superficial view or guess, he underlined the need for the secretaries of primary Party committees to do the work with people in an unbiased and experienced manner, never blinded by subjectivity and prejudice. He urged them to acquire a habit of repeatedly scrutinizing necessary information before making decisions on the issues related with the political destiny of people and prudently resolving them in consideration of the interests of the Party and the revolution. Saying that for them to take warm care of and respect people never means that they should remain good-natured, blindly appeasing them, overlooking their faults and currying favor with them, he called on the secretaries of the primary Party committees to treat the employees with warm humanity and educate them in a principled manner while waging a severe struggle against negative elements. He said that the secretaries of the primary Party committees should acquire high qualifications in order to do the work with people well. Stressing that today's socialist construction, whereby the grandiose goal is being accomplished in the arduous and difficult situation, requires the secretaries of primary Party committees, tasked with educating, organizing and mobilizing people, to possess high abilities as never before, he said that the main task for improving their abilities is to be well versed in the Party's line and policy and proficient in the Party work. The secretaries of the primary Party committees should put above anything else the study of the documents on the Party Congress and the plenary meetings of the Party Central Committee that comprehensively deal with the Party's line and policies, and completely grasp them by repeatedly studying them on a regular basis so that they can be able to freely explain them among the masses, he noted. He called on the secretaries of primary Party committees to make it a part of their everyday life to read the Party organ in order to steadily improve their political and practical qualifications by grasping the ideas and intentions of the Party Central Committee on a normal basis and learning the methods of implementing the Party policies. He stressed the need for them to continue intensifying the study for the Party work, learn more professional knowledge for their sectors and knowledge and technique for their units and steadily acquire lots of many-sided knowledge with the open-minded attitude as required by the developing era. He underlined the need for them to gain experience and draw lessons from their work and have meticulous organizing ability, strong control and implacable executive ability. Noting that if the secretaries of the primary Party committees are to do the work with people well, they should have noble popular traits, he said that they will be disliked by people if they have a rude style of work, although they are politically and ideologically sound and have excellent working ability. He stressed that high Party spirit, fidelity to principle and noble humanity constitute the main traits befitting the secretaries of the primary Party committees that captivate people. He called on them to have the warm heart to greatly love people and take sincere care of them and lead them with the stand to bear responsibility for the present life of the employees and their future. Noting that modesty, an unassuming character and uprightness are essential traits of the primary Party committee secretaries as they do the work with people at all times, he said that they should always treat employees courteously and in a free-hearted manner with a smile on their faces and lead a simple life, not pursuing selfish interests and desires. He said that they should keep their appearance neat and clean, use polite language and make positive efforts to have lots of cultural attainments and optimistic sentiments capable of touching people and creating an optimistic climate among them. He specially stressed the need for the Party committee secretaries of ministries and national institutions and the secretaries of ri Party committees to enhance their responsibilities and roles. Saying that the Party committee secretaries of ministries and national institutions are responsible for the Party work of the state administrative guidance institutions organizing and guiding the work for implementing the lines and policies of the Party nationwide, he called on them to lead all officials of their institutions to steadily cultivate themselves through their Party life, political life, and to properly plan and guide the work for the implementation of the Party policies, bearing in mind that they have very responsible tasks in a very responsible period. He said that the Party Central Committee attaches great significance to enhancing the role of the Party committee secretaries of ministries and national institutions at present when epochal progress should be made in the overall state work and practical successes be achieved in the development of the national economy every year. Noting that the duty of secretaries of ri Party committees is very heavy in the historic struggle for giving a complete face-lift to the countryside, he called on the secretaries of ri Party committees across the country to redouble their efforts, cherishing the high honor and sense of responsibility for conducting the Party work in the great new era for rural revolution. He also stressed the need for departments of the Party Central Committee and provincial, city and county Party committees to pay deep attention to the work for enhancing the role of the secretaries of primary Party committees. He underscored the need to direct efforts to the work for consolidating the ranks of primary Party committee secretaries and properly conduct the work for educating them and raising their practical abilities. Noting that the Party Central Committee should set it as its policy and a state policy to translate the desire of people into reality and ensure that people benefit from the policy by letting all the primary Party organizations thoroughly implement it, he said that to do so is not only the action method peculiar to our Party fully discharging its duty as the Party serving the people but also the idea on the role of the primary Party committees and the idea of attaching importance to the primary Party committees advocated by the Party Central Committee. Saying that the true appearance of the primary Party committee secretaries is characterized by the attitude of the servant who puts his heart and soul into bringing welfare to the people as much as possible, being thoughtful and meticulous like mother, he said that all the secretaries of the primary Party committees should become such servants to make sure that the Party lives up to the expectations of the people who have lavished their praise of it as the motherly Party despite the stern tempest of history and remains faithful to its political idea and historic mission as the Party serving the people. He ardently called on all secretaries of the primary Party committees to turn out in the sacred struggle for providing our people with a happy life as early as possible and turning our country into a great powerful socialist state, well aware of their duty as political officials of the Party serving the people. The important conclusion made by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un at the 2nd Conference of Secretaries of Primary Committees of the WPK serves as a powerful militant banner for turning all the basic Party organizations into the elite ranks of loyalty with the organizing ability and fighting efficiency and vitality as required by a new era of overall national prosperity and for strongly encouraging all the Party members and other working people to the drive for implementing the grandiose struggle programme indicated at the Party Congress under the uplifted banner of great Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism. Political News Team

title: Let's Remain Immensely Loyal to Political Idea and Historic Mission of People's Party, Party Serving People
body: Second Conference of Secretaries of Primary Committees of WPK Closes The Second Conference of Secretaries of Primary Committees of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) closed on Monday amid great interest and expectations of all Party members and other people across the country. The conference marked a fresh milestone in strengthening the whole Party. Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, guided the conference. The conference proceeded amid the display of all the participants' steadfast will to further consolidate the primary organizations of the Party to be a lively harmonious whole sharing the idea and will with the Party Central Committee and acting in concert with it and to devotedly serve and strive for the prosperity and development of the country and wellbeing of the people, true to the Party's idea of giving foremost importance to primary Party committees and its policy of strengthening them. Speeches were made by Choe Song Bok, secretary of the Junghung-ri Party committee of Samjiyon City, Kim Myong Chan, secretary of the Primary Party Committee of the Central Mining Research Institute of the State Academy of Sciences, Kim Jong Hun, secretary of the Primary Party Committee of the Namdok Youth Coal Mine, and others. They talked about their experience gained in training all the officials and employees of their units into fighters devotedly implementing the Party's policies by conducting intensive ideological education among them so that they would deeply grasp the greatness of the Party and invariably uphold the traditions of loyalty. Listening to the speeches that stressed the importance and significance of educating the Party members and other people to realize the greatness of the leader and remain loyal to him, the participants deeply understood that the ideological will to defend and glorify generation after generation the immortal leadership exploits of the peerlessly great men associated with their worksites is the core of the spirit to be fully displayed by them. Speeches dealt with the experience gained in training the agricultural workers to be true masters of the rural revolution as taught by the respected General Secretary and implementing the Party's policy on agriculture. Speakers said that they have exerted themselves to prepare discharged soldiers to be the hardcore for consolidating the rural position, and sincerely helped and steered the people in hardship after reading their minds, thus intensifying the campaign for the rural revolution. Such stories deeply touched the participants. They recalled that they trained researchers to be genuine scientists, who dedicate themselves to the Party and the country, and guided them to make achievements conducive to accelerating the economic development of the country by methodologically instilling into them the faith that their scientific research is for the sake of the country, regarding it as the pivot of the Party work. During those days, they realized that the real honor of the scientists of Juche Korea just lies in the pride and confidence of having given pleasure to the Party and made contributions to the development of the country and happiness of the people, and that it is the main mission of the Party organizations in the scientific research field to help the researchers carry on their research with a single mind of loyalty and patriotic enthusiasm, they noted. The speakers mentioned that they added glory to the honor of being model units by strengthening the Party committees' collective guidance and directing efforts to the work with coal miners, the work with young miners in particular. Hearing the speeches, the participants in the conference realized once again that it is the fundamental way of making radical progress in the implementation of the decisions of the Party Congress to make redoubled efforts for thoroughly applying the traditional working methods of our Party with higher political awareness, self-consciousness and clear purposefulness. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un made a historic concluding speech "Secretaries of Primary Party Committees Should Become Genuine Political Workers of the Motherly Party". Greatly excited to receive the important instructions of the General Secretary, the participants in the conference awakened themselves to their duty as political workers of the Party of the people, the Party serving them, and pledged to tangibly contribute to strengthening the whole Party and achieving the prosperity and development of our great country by dedicating themselves to implementing the far-reaching ideal and fighting programme put forward by the Party. When Kim Jong Un finished his concluding speech, all the participants broke into thunderous cheers of "Hurrah!" as a token of their highest respects and the warmest greetings to the General Secretary of our Party who clarified a clear struggle policy in the new era for enhancing the militant function and role of the primary Party organizations in every way with his profound thought and brilliant ideo-theoretical wisdom, thus bringing about a heyday of strengthening the whole Party. Citations of the General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea were conferred on exemplary secretaries of primary Party committees at the conference. The respected General Secretary said meaningful words about the conferring of citations. He referred to the Party Central Committee's intention in specially commending the secretaries of the primary Party committees for making good results with sincere attitude and working manner befitting the primary political workers of our Party on the occasion of the conference. Repeatedly stressing the position and importance of the primary Party committees in accomplishing the great cause of strengthening the whole Party, he said that he was greatly pleased to get to know the excellent party officials, honest servants of the people, who put their heart and soul into their work, well aware of their heavy mission and duty of being responsible for the main fighting units for carrying out the Party policies at a crucial time when our revolution has entered a new stage of development. Noting that the primary Party committees should become the ranks of justice that vigorously struggle for realizing the Party's programme for building socialism and communism, not the lower-echelon organizations working merely for preserving and managing Party forces, the General Secretary said that we can surely bring about a new great era, a new victory with our own efforts if the primary Party organizations of the whole Party are fully prepared and display their strong fighting efficiency. Expressing the belief that the secretaries of the primary Party committees will bear deep in mind the expectations of the Party Central Committee and the people and become genuine revolutionaries and communists who never vacillate on the sacred road of serving the Party, the revolution and people, the General Secretary proposed warmly congratulating with enthusiastic applause the Party secretaries on receiving citations at the place on which the whole Party focuses its attention. Amid the great excitement, Kim Jong Un personally presented citations to Ri Tong Chol, Paek Hak Chol, So Hyon Chol, Kang Hyon Guk, Kim Song Man, Tong Myong Hak, Pak Song Chol, Won Chol, An Chol Rim, Kim Yong Il, Ri Chi Myong, Ryom Kyong Chun, Kim Myong Gil, Kim Jong Gwan, Ri Su Nam, Kim Jong Hun, Hong Jong Guk, Kim Kwang Chol, Choe Song Bok, Kim Myong Il, Kim Ju Chon, Paek Yong Song, O Pong Chol, Kang Yong Son, Pak Sung Hak, Ri Yong Hyop, Paek Ui Sik, Kim Man Bok, Kim Yong Gyu, Jon Kyong Su, Ryu Yong Gil, Choe Jong Gil, Choe Kyong Sam, Pak Song Jin, Kim Chol Min, Ri Un Sil, Kim Myong Chan, Kim Kwang Chol, Kim Chol, Ri Sung Chol, Ho Song Chol, Kim Jin Myong, Jong Yong Hui, Jon Yong Gil, Yun Nam Chol, Paek Kyong Il, Pak Chun Il, Pak Myong Chol, Choe Song Bong and Choe Jong Su who distinguished themselves in carrying out the Party's policies, and had a photo taken with them, which will be eternally recorded in the history of the Party. Those secretaries who were honored with unforgettable high commendation from the General Secretary and other participants were full of boundless gratitude for the General Secretary who taught them principles of the Party work and the secret of it, showing warm loving care and bestowing benevolence on them repeatedly to encourage them by becoming their great teacher and tender-hearted father. The respected General Secretary made a closing address. When he declared the 2nd Conference of Secretaries of Primary Committees of the Workers' Party of Korea closed, the song "Internationale" was struck up solemnly. All the participants again raised stormy cheers of "Hurrah!" for Kim Jong Un, the great leader of our Party and revolution who develops the WPK into the ever-victorious revolutionary and militant Party. The 2nd Conference of Secretaries of Primary Committees of the Workers' Party of Korea held under the energetic guidance of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un will always go down in the history of the Party as a meaningful one which guaranteed the correct implementation of the revolutionary tasks decided at the Party Congress and dynamically propelled the drive for accomplishing the cause of modeling the whole society on Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism and for the victorious advance of our-style socialist construction by more thoroughly establishing the monolithic leadership system of the Party Central Committee throughout the Party and remarkably raising the fighting efficiency of the primary Party committees. Political News Team

title: National Sci-tech Festival to Be Held
body: The 35th National Sci-tech Festival will take place in the DPRK from April 28 to May 20 on the occasion of the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. The festival on the theme of "Preceding of Science and Technology and Innovation" is aimed to accelerate the overall development of socialist construction by positively exchanging and sharing the valuable sci-tech successes made in every sector and unit in the struggle to carry through the decisions of the 8th Party Congress. It will be held in the form of virtual exhibition, divided into such 30-odd panels as those for metal industry, chemical industry and electric power industry. And the presentation and examination into the exhibited sci-tech successes are to be conducted through video-conferencing system. Taking part in it will be organizations and scientists, technicians, teachers, postgraduate students, soldiers, workers, peasants, three-revolution team members, university students and other people who made valuable sci-tech successes. Presented to the festival will be such achievements made in various sectors as those which substantially contribute to the home-production of raw and other materials and the settlement of food, clothing and housing problems for the people and successes helpful to stepping up the development of basic science and advanced technology. The examination of the festival is to be conducted, divided into a scientific research and education sector and an industrial establishment (co-op farm) sector. Rodong Sinmun

title: Production of Major Custom-built Equipment Propelled in DPRK
body: Factories and enterprises of machine industrial sector of the DPRK have dynamically conducted a campaign to ensure the production of major custom-built equipment in time. Production units for generating equipment under the Taean Heavy Machine Complex are accelerating the production of custom-built equipment to be sent to power stations in different parts of the country and metallurgical and chemical industrial sectors. The Ryongsong Machine Complex is directing efforts to propelling the production of custom-built equipment needed for the main units of the national economy on schedule. The same is true of the Anju Pump Factory, the Pyongyang Electric Cable General Factory 326 and the Pyongyang Electromotor Factory. Rodong Sinmun

title: Ten Best Teachers for 2021 Selected in DPRK
body: Ten best teachers for 2021 were selected in the DPRK. The newly-instituted title of the Ten Best Teachers is to be awarded to the teachers and kindergarteners who have made a great contribution to the education of the rising generation, true to the Party's policy of education. The title were conferred on Kim Ok Gyong, teacher of Pyongyang Primary School No. 4, Sonu Jong Chol, chief of a department of Amnokgang Middle School No. 1, Hwang Pok Gyong, teacher of Toksong Primary School in Phyongsong City affiliated to Phyongsong Teacher Training College, Ri Myong Sun, teacher of Unha Primary School in Sariwon City, Kang Kum Sun, kindergartener of Kuje Kindergarten in Haeju City, Jo Yong Ok, teacher of Myongchon Senior Middle School in Myongchon County, Kim Myong Il, chief of a department of Hamhung Middle School No. 1, Ko Myong Suk, teacher of Junghyon Primary School in Sonbong District, Ko Song Min, teacher of Phyongsong Teacher Training College who is also head of the Education Science Research Room of the college, and Jang Kyong Il, chief of a department of Nampho University of Education. They have added luster to their life as career revolutionaries for developing the country's education with boundless loyalty to the Party, ardent patriotism, clear conscience and high qualification for educators and motherly character. Rodong Sinmun

title: Youth in North Hamgyong Province Strongly Support Farms
body: Enthusiasm for supporting the agricultural sector gains momentum among the youths in North Hamgyong Province of the DPRK. Young people in the province have prepared thousands of tons of manure and 10 000-odd small farm implements in February to be supplied to co-op farms in the province. The provincial youth league committee promoted the support for farms through an exhibition of small farm implements. The youths from the Provincial People's Committee, the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex, the Chongjin Port and the Provincial Telecommunication Management Bureau strove to find much more manure resources and prepare lots of small farm implements to be supplied to co-op farms. The youth league organizations in Phohang, Sunam and Sinam districts of Chongjin City scrupulously organized the work to secure and transport a large amount of urban manure and compost to farms. Young people in the province visited the farm fields with various farming materials and compost and worked together with agricultural workers. The agricultural workers are now channeling their efforts into the immediate farming preparations. Rodong Sinmun

title: Day of Shining Star Marked Abroad
body: Celebrations were held in Laos, Mongolia, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Syria, Thailand, India, Romania, Belarus, Guinea, Libya, Senegal and Algeria to commemorate the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il (the Day of the Shining Star). The vice-chairperson of the Commission for Propaganda and Training Affairs of the C.C., Lao People's Revolutionary Party said that the DPRK could make development in all aspects of the social life and exalt its international prestige as President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il had led the struggle for defending the country's sovereignty and building socialism. The chairperson of the C.C., Workers’ Party of Bangladesh and the chairman of the Central Executive Committee of the Bangladesh National Socialist Party praised Kim Jong Il's party-building exploits. The chairperson of the Libya-DPRK Friendship Association and the secretary general of the Sunbula International Friendship Club of Libya said that the great HE Kim Jong Il developed the DPRK into a single-heartedly united, politico-ideological and military power. The chairman of the Supreme Council of the National Socialist Party of Romania said that Kim Jong Il's exploits will shine long with the human history. The chairman of the Guinean Society for the Study of the Juche Literary Idea and the chairman of the Guinea-DPRK Friendship and Solidarity Association said that HE Kim Jong Il, who clearly showed the road ahead of mankind, is immortal. The chairperson of the Organization for the Study of the Juche Idea of Thailand, the chairperson of the Thailand-DPRK Friendship Association and a spokesman for the Workers' Party for the Independence and other personages of Senegal stressed that the Korean people would always emerge victorious as they are led by HE Kim Jong Un carrying forward the cause of HE Kim Jong Il. Congratulatory messages to the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un were adopted at the celebrations in Sri Lanka, Thailand, India and Senegal. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Exploits Praised in Nigeria and Brazil
body: Joint seminars of political parties and organizations took place in Nigeria and Brazil to mark the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il. The chairperson of the Nigerian National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism and professors of University of Abuja said that the great HE Kim Jong Il is the leader who had led the DPRK by carrying forward the cause of President Kim Il Sung. The secret that the DPRK defended its ideology and system and rose up with its own efforts in the late last century when the West talked about the "complete end of socialism" lies in the Songun politics pursued by HE Kim Jong Il, they added. Noting that socialist Korea remains unchanged despite the imperialists' moves as it has the strong national power, they stressed that HE Kim Jong Il led the country along the road of independence and victory, standing in the center of the world politics. The chairperson of the Brazilian Center for the Study of the Juche Idea and an official representative of the Brazilian Branch of the Korean Friendship Association lauded Kim Jong Il as the master of ideology and theory, experienced statesman and world elder statesman. Saying that the Korean people will demonstrate only victory and glory in the future, too, as they have the great leader, great idea and great Party, the speakers expressed their will to intensify the study and dissemination of the Juche idea and activities for solidarity with the Korean people.
