Attending the seminars were personages of political parties and organizations, including the Better Nigeria Progressive Party, the People's Progressive Party of Nigeria, the Nigerian National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, the Brazilian Center for the Study of the Juche Idea, the Brazilian Center for the Study of Songun Politics and the Brazilian Centre for Peace and Solidarity with Peoples, and popular masses. Rodong Sinmun

title: For Happy Laughter of Children
body: Touching stories are born at the Okryu Children’s Hospital which was splendidly built under the Party’s care. Medical workers of its cardiovascular surgery department have invented and introduced a new operation method to reduce the treatment period and raise the effectiveness of treatment. They make achievements in their efforts to locally produce dozens of medical supplies necessary for treatment. In the department, they have recently brought back to life a profound case whose body was necrotized by over 90% from necrotizing dermatitis due to systemic poisoning. As the reason and treatment for the disease weren’t clear yet, treatment of the little boy was no less than treading on an untrodden path. But the medical workers of the department including its chief Kim Song Nam could not give up the case. It was their unanimous will to allow no failure but miraculous vivifications at the hospital permeated with the Party’s noble love for the future generation. They applied themselves to a 24-7 treatment campaign. They devoted everything to the patient’s vivification. Their sincerity brought a bright smile back to the little patient’s face. Our people dearly love the Okryu Children’s Hospital as there are such genuine medical workers keeping children’s bright smiles in it. Rodong Sinmun

title: Short Course for Participants in 2nd Conference of Secretaries of Primary Committees of WPK Held
body: There was a short course for the participants in the 2nd Conference of Secretaries of Primary Committees of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). The course dealt with the practical issues for bringing about a revolutionary improvement by deeply studying and grasping the main spirit and main idea of the important conclusion made by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un at the conference and embodying them in the work of the primary Party committees, and for raising in every way the function and role of the primary Party organizations as the basic combat units in carrying out the decisions of the 8th Congress of the Party. The lecturers included Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Political Bureau and department director of the Central Committee of the WPK, and heads of chairs of the Central Cadres Training School of the WPK. The course stressed the issue for all primary Party organizations to continue to intensify the work of establishing the monolithic leadership system of the respected General Secretary. The ideal goal of establishing the monolithic leadership system of the Party Central Committee is to make the entire Party and the whole society become like one head and one body, the lecturers stressed. The secretaries of all primary Party committees should more firmly build their units as the ranks of single-minded unity to keep pace with the idea, intention and footstep of the General Secretary, they added. Mentioned at the short course was the issue of cementing the single-minded unity of the Party and the revolutionary ranks as firm as a rock. The lecturers said that further strengthening the single-minded unity, the cornerstone for the existence of the Party and the state and the strongest weapon of our revolution, is a decisive factor for dynamically propelling the overall development of socialism. And they called on all the participants to direct the efforts of the Party work to consolidating the single-minded unity of the Party and the revolutionary ranks. Also referred to at the course was the issue of drastically enhancing the role of primary Party organizations in the struggle to thoroughly carry out the tasks set forth at the 8th Congress of the Party. The course helped the participants bear deep in mind that the thorough-going implementation of the Party's people-oriented policies and the development of their units largely depend on the level, ability and role of the leading Party officials, and keenly realize once again with what extraordinary resolution, determination and fighting spirit the secretaries of the primary Party committees, political commissars in charge of the basic combat units should redouble their efforts in the present struggle for strengthening the whole Party and making a great upsurge in all sectors of socialist construction. Rodong Sinmun

title: Discharged Soldiers Volunteer to Work at Farms
body: More than 110 discharged soldiers volunteered to work at farms in South Hwanghae Province, the biggest agricultural province in the country, with high zeal to be a standard-bearer of the struggle for radical development of the socialist countryside. They were greeted with delight by officials and working people in the province on February 28. They presented bunches of flowers to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in Haeju City before making a bow to them. At the provincial revolutionary museum, they hardened their will to glorify with rich harvest the exploits of the peerlessly great men, who walked along the road between fields all their lives for the agricultural development of the province, and to bring earlier a fresh victory of the socialist rural construction, remaining faithful to the leadership of the Party Central Committee. A meeting of welcoming the discharged soldiers took place at the South Hwanghae Provincial Art Theatre. Present there were Kim Yong Chol, chairman of the South Hwanghae Provincial People's Committee, officials concerned and working youths in Haeju City. Pak Thae Sop, secretary of the South Hwanghae Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, made a congratulatory speech to be followed by speeches. After the meeting, officials and working youths in the province gave the discharged soldiers bunches of flowers, warmly seeing them off. Meanwhile, over 10 discharged soldiers volunteered to work at co-op farms in North Phyongan Province. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Floral Basket from Vietnamese Ambassador
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a floral basket from the Vietnamese ambassador to the DPRK on the occasion of the 3rd anniversary of his official goodwill visit to the Socialist Republic of Vietnam. Vietnamese Ambassador Le Ba Binh conveyed the floral basket to Kim Song Nam, director of the International Department of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Feb. 28. Rodong Sinmun

title: Continuous Efforts Channeled into Consolidating Production Foundation of Dairy Products
body: Officials and workers in South Phyongan Province are making endeavors to consolidate the foundation for producing dairy products true to the Party’s noble intention of loving the posterity and future. Under the guidance of the provincial Party Committee, the officials of the province set an ambitious goal to increase production of dairy products based on the detailed analysis and review of last year’s production. They see to it that the design of a new dairy cattle farm is sped up as much as possible on one hand, and push ahead with the formation of building force and supply of materials in a foresighted manner on the other. Meanwhile, they let cities and counties ensure scientific and technological manner in goat raising and anti-epizootic work and direct great efforts to solving the feed problem by expanding natural pastures and the area under cultivation of ''Aeguk'' grass. They mapped out plans to build new production bases of dairy products at co-op farms and are carrying them out one by one while pushing forward the establishment of a milk powder production line in a planned way. Along with this, they properly supply means of transportation and containers for conveyance for the smooth supply of dairy products. They also demand that officials of cities and counties stand in the van of implementation of the Party’s childcare policy and powerfully rouse the masses while drawing experiences from successes and lessons from shortcomings. They generalize experiences of cities and counties distinguishing themselves in consolidating the production foundation for dairy products. Rodong Sinmun

title: Construction of Army-People Power Stations Accelerated
body: Officials and builders in Kangwon Province actively push ahead with the construction of four army-people power stations. The building project was conducted more vigorously than before and thus the pilot tunneling was done by 99 percent and the widening by 94 percent as of Feb 24. The province pushes ahead with the construction powerfully by focusing the forces and means on waterway tunneling project and waging a three-dimensional campaign bravely. Officials found their position at the seething working spot and conduct the organization and command of construction waging a vigorous field political work to raise the enthusiasm of the masses. They ensure that the uplifted enthusiasm of the masses brings about the high record by raising the proportion of work done by machines and scrupulous organizing the work to give precedence to provision of materials like cement, gravels and sand. The province sums up the construction record meaningfully every day so as to further heighten the mental strength of the officials. It ensures that all units learn after the field command experience gained by officials of the advanced units and the project is actively propelled by arousing the zeal for emulation drive. The innovative work attitude of officials, who lead the van of struggle to conclude the construction of power stations as the standard-bearers of ranks, braces up the enthusiasm of the masses who have turned out for implementing the decisions of the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Workers’ Party of Korea Central Committee. Rodong Sinmun

title: Agricultural Sector Strives for Increased Grain Production
body: Agricultural workers in the DPRK strive for an increased yield of more than one ton of grain per hectare this year, true to the decisions of the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. After making a detailed analysis of last year's farming experience and lessons, the Agricultural Commission set such issues as introducing new high-yielding species, applying advanced farming methods in an all-round way as important links for hitting the increased production goal and has carried them into practice under a scrupulous plan. All provincial, city and county organs for agricultural guidance concentrate efforts on introducing high-yielding strains, which need less fertilizer and are short in growth term and strong in resistance to various disasters, in accordance with regional conditions. South Hwanghae Province, the biggest agricultural province in the country, set it as a vital issue for increased grain production per hectare to select good crop species and define right soil for their cultivation and has directed a primary attention to it. Farms in North Phyongan Province are pushing ahead with the work to introduce the advanced farming technology and methods. In particular, they have promoted the production of organic compound fertilizer. Agricultural workers in South Hamgyong Province are focusing efforts on acquiring new land, while restoring the damaged arable lands. Those in North Hwanghae Province, bearing deep in mind the significance and importance of increasing the fertility of soil, dig earth out of ponds and rivers around arable lands and deliver it to fields with thin soil depth and less humus content in order to improve the farm fields. Kangwon Province has directed efforts to overhauling the farm machines and manufacturing new efficient farm machines, after finding the reserves for increased grain production in raising the operation rate of farm machines. Rodong Sinmun

title: Tree-planting Brisk in DPRK
body: March 2 is the Tree-planting Day in the DPRK. On the day of 76 years ago, President Kim Il Sung climbed to Moran Hill, a scenic spot of Pyongyang, with Chairman Kim Jong Il and the anti-Japanese war heroine Kim Jong Suk. Looking at the devastated hill due to the reckless deforestation of the Japanese imperialists who had occupied Korea for 40-odd years, the President told officials that many trees and flowers should be planted on the hill to turn it into a wonderful resort for Pyongyangites. All beauty spots in the liberated country belong to the people, he said, unfolding a far-reaching blueprint for afforestation. Since then, a new history of afforestation began in the country. With the day as an occasion, a spring tree-planting campaign has been conducted across the country every year. The forestry sector secured hundreds of millions of saplings for this year's spring tree-planting campaign. Working people, servicepersons and schoolchildren in different parts of the country have turned out in the tree planting, true to the noble intention of the Workers' Party of Korea to turn all the mountains of the country into thick woodlands. Rodong Sinmun

title: Number of Young Volunteers Increases in Kangwon Province of DPRK
body: More than 160 young people in Kangwon Province of the DPRK vowed to work at difficult posts at a time when the enthusiasm to volunteer to major sites of socialist construction is running high among the youths across the country. Some of them volunteered to work on socialist farms with the resolution to bring earlier the bright future of rural development, while others volunteered to work at new revolutionary posts. A meeting to congratulate those volunteers was held at the Kangwon Provincial Art Theatre on Tuesday. Volunteer certificates were awarded and a congratulatory speech and pledge-taking speeches were made at the meeting attended by Chairman of the Kangwon Provincial People's Committee Chae Il Ryong, Secretary of the Kangwon Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea Pak Kwang Ryol, officials of the youth league and young people. There was a congratulatory art performance, and officials and young people in the province warmly saw off those volunteers with bouquets. Rodong Sinmun

title: Participants in 2nd Conference of Secretaries of Primary Committees of WPK Tour Pyongyang
body: The participants in the 2nd Conference of Secretaries of Primary Committees of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) toured different parts of Pyongyang. They visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. Looking round historic data and mementoes preserved at the President's old home and the Mangyongdae Revolutionary Museum, the visitors recollected with deep emotion the sacred revolutionary career of Kim Il Sung who built Korean-style socialism on this land where the noble idea of believing in the people as in heaven has been realized. They also visited the Party Founding Museum to deeply grasp the feats of the President who founded the WPK and strengthened it into a genuine motherly party absolutely supported and trusted by the people and a steel-strong party with invincible might, thus setting a brilliant example of revolutionary party building. At the Hall of the Great Leaders and Their Comrades-in-Arms of the Korean Revolution Museum, the participants in the conference were briefed on the revolutionary soldiers enjoying an everlasting worthwhile life under the care of the Party. And they hardened their iron will to accomplish the sacred revolutionary cause of Juche, which was started and advanced victoriously with comradeship, under the leadership of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un. Through visit to the Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery on Mt Taesong and the Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery, they cherished the immutable truth again that the glory of life lies in the road of single-heartedly and faithfully supporting and following the Party and the leader. The participants visited the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum, the Youth Movement Museum, the Central Class Education House, the Sci-Tech Complex, the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Silk Mill and Pyongyang Teachers Training College. In the period of tour they watched a documentary film showing the party building exploits of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Premier Inspects Various Sectors of South Hwanghae Province
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, inspected units of the agricultural sector and other sectors of South Hwanghae Province to learn about the implementation of major policy-oriented tasks facing the province. At the Samjigang Co-op Farm in Jaeryong County, the Sokmi Co-op Farm in Haeju City and other farms, the premier gave a pep talk to the agricultural workers exerting themselves on the farm fields to translate the Party Central Committee's grand plan for the socialist rural construction into a brilliant reality. He stressed the need to provide a sure guarantee for attaining this year's target of grain production by supplying enough farming materials in time and taking positive steps to raise the proportion of farm work done by machines, in keeping with the Party's intention to enable South Hwanghae Province, the country's biggest agricultural province to uphold the banner in the agricultural production. Going round the Jaeryong County Kindergarten, Namyon Primary School in Haeju City, the Haeju City Garment Factory and the Haeju Bag Factory, he said that the officials in the province should scrupulously organize the work to consistently keep up and thoroughly implement the Party's policy for providing the children and pupils across the country with tasty and nutritious dairy products on a normal basis and school uniforms and things. At the Haeju Port, he stressed the need to increase the cargo unloading capacity by putting harbor cranes and other equipment on a normal operation. The field consultative meetings discussed the measures for implementing the decisions of the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee, including the issues of increasing the agricultural production in the province, dynamically accelerating the city and county construction and producing and supplying dairy products and school uniforms and bags in time. Meanwhile, the premier inspected the housing construction site in the Taephyong area and the venue of farm machine show. He called for thoroughly ensuring the quality in the housing construction and positively developing and producing the efficient and modern farm machines suited to the specific conditions. Rodong Sinmun

title: Paektusan Prize Sports Contest among Officials of National Institutions Closes
body: The 25th Paektusan Prize Sports Contest among Officials of National Institutions closed in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK. The State Planning Commission, the State Commission of Science and Technology, the Taehung Trading Guidance Bureau and the Korean Central News Agency took the first place in total standings of each group. A closing ceremony took place at the Basketball Gymnasium in Chongchun Street on Mar. 1. Present there were Kim Song Ryong, vice-premier of the Cabinet, Pak In Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea, officials concerned and officials and players of commissions, ministries and national institutions that distinguished themselves in mass sports activities. At the ceremony, the total standings were announced and commendations and medals were conferred on the excellent units and players. Ri Tu Song, department director of Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and concurrently vice-chairman of the National Sports Guidance Committee, made a closing address. Rodong Sinmun

title: Paektusan Prize Sports Games Close
body: The Paektusan Prize Sports Games for celebrating the Day of the Shining Star closed with due ceremony at the Basketball Gymnasium in Chongchun Street of Pyongyang on Tuesday. Present at the ceremony were Ri Tu Song, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea who doubles as vice-chairman of the National Sports Guidance Committee, Kim Il Guk, minister of Physical Culture and Sports, officials concerned and sportspersons. At the ceremony, team standings were announced and rotating trophy cups, diplomas and medals were awarded to excellent teams and players. Rotating trophy cups went to the Taesongsan Sports Team which came first in team standings and to the April 25 Sports Team which took the first place in women's volleyball. Kim Song Ryong, vice-premier of the Cabinet, made a closing address. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Has Photo Session with Participants in 2nd Conference of Secretaries of WPK Primary Committees
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, had a photo session with the participants in the 2nd Conference of Secretaries of Primary Committees of the WPK on March 2. Present there were Jo Yong Won, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretary for Organizational Affairs of the WPK Central Committee, Ri Il Hwan, Kim Jae Ryong, O Il Jong, Kim Yong Hwan and Ju Chang Il. The venue of the photo session was filled with the emotion and joy of the participants who would have the highest honor and happiness again in the wake of receiving the great action programme for further cementing the cornerstone and fighting efficiency of our Party at the conference of secretaries of primary Party committees held in the presence of the respected General Secretary. When General Secretary Kim Jong Un arrived at the venue of the photo session, all the participants raised stormy cheers of "Hurrah!", paying the highest respects to him, the great prestige and symbol of our Party and the revolution who has strengthened the WPK into a powerful and militant general staff and a genuine people's party vigorously leading the sacred struggle for prosperity of our state and the people's well-being by brilliantly applying the Party's idea of giving importance to the strengthening of its basic organizations and line of strengthening the entire Party in the revolutionary practice. The General Secretary encouraged the participants full of enthusiasm to devote all their efforts to the work for strengthening the basic organizations of the Party into the fortress of integral whole of loyalists and harmonious whole sharing the idea, intention and action with the Party Central Committee, while deeply cherishing once again its intention and idea that the fighting efficiency of the primary Party committees means that of our Party with the conference as an occasion. Then he had a souvenir picture taken with the participants, expressing belief that the primary committee secretaries of the entire Party, who are standing at the first-line posts for developing the Party and implementing the Party's policies at a time when heavy and huge fighting tasks are raised before our revolution, would exert themselves in fulfilling their revolutionary duties with extraordinary consciousness and sense of responsibility as the frontline political workers and thus make positive contribution to bringing earlier a great new era when the people's ideal and desire would come true. All the participants hardened their strong will to remain boundlessly committed to the political idea and historic mission of the genuine people's party, their "servant" party and further strengthen the basic Party organizations into the politico-ideological positions and vibrant militant ranks reliably upholding our Party and revolution, bearing deep in mind the noble intention and trust of the Party Central Committee, and thus dynamically accelerate the overall development of socialist construction. Political News Team

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Plants Memorial Trees with Participants in 2nd Conference of Secretaries of WPK Primary Committees
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, planted memorial trees together with the participants in the 2nd Conference of Secretaries of Primary Committees of the WPK on March 2, the Tree-planting Day. Attending the tree-planting ceremony were Jo Yong Won, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretary for Organizational Affairs of the WPK Central Committee, Ri Il Hwan, Kim Jae Ryong, O Il Jong, Kim Yong Hwan, Ju Chang Il and Kim Yo Jong. The primary Party committee secretaries were filled with great excitement and delight as they came to plant memorial trees in the presence of the respected General Secretary in the Hwasong area where another ideal street symbolic of our Party's political idea of the people-first principle is being built. When the General Secretary arrived, all the participants raised stormy cheers of "Hurrah!" for him, the great teacher and benevolent father who leads them step by step to become genuine political workers of the people's party, their "servant" party, repeatedly showing warm loving care and trust for them. Jo Yong Won made an address in connection with the memorial tree-planting. The participants in the 2nd Conference of Secretaries of Primary Committees of the WPK are here to do very worthwhile work on the Tree-planting Day, he said, adding: It is very significant for us to have the honor of planting memorial trees in the presence of the respected General Secretary after receiving the new fighting programme for strengthening the primary Party committees as well as deep trust at the historic conference held amid the great attention of the Party members and other people across the country. Tree-planting is due work of all citizens in this land and sacred patriotic work of planting seeds of happiness and shaping the future with their sweat and efforts. Our primary Party committee secretaries are obliged to take the lead in this responsible work for executing the policy on the land development to which our Party attaches top priority. Today's tree-planting will be an eternally unforgettable memory in the mind of the primary Party committee secretaries, the political workers of the people's party, their "servant" party and harden their will to devote themselves to the revolutionary work of taking care of the destiny of the country and people and thus bring about good results. And it will serve as an important occasion in further inspiring patriotism throughout the country. We are here not only to plant trees but to plant our Party's policy and ardent patriotism and pure conscience that would remain unchanged forever. These trees to be planted by us today will add beauty to the landscape of the Hwasong area near the holy land of the sun and grow in thick verdure, promising the rosy future of the capital city of Pyongyang. The speaker called on all the participants to lavish their sweat and zeal on the work of lasting significance for further sprucing up the cradle of the people's life. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un broke ground first to signal the start of memorial tree-planting. While transplanting trees with the participants, he called on the primary Party committee secretaries to lavish their patriotic zeal and party conscience on the work for implementing the Party's policies. Saying that as the trees with firm roots can weather any storm, the Party that took its deep roots among the people and depends on them is invincible, he called on the secretaries of the primary Party committees to make redoubled efforts to turn our Party into a united group strong in its fighting efficiency that has taken its deep roots among the working masses. The participants with high honor and delight devoted their sincerity to planting trees, visualizing the day when those young trees would grow up into giant ones ensuring the prosperity of our socialist state. Kim Jong Un had a historic picture taken with the participants in tree-planting against the background of fir trees planted by him. The excited participants expressed their deep gratitude to the General Secretary for bestowing the warm paternal love on them while inspiring them to become genuine officials of our Party which regards the idea of "The People Are God" as its motto and the people as lifeblood. Through the memorial tree-planting, the secretaries of primary Party committees came to realize once again the fixed will of the Party Central Committee to make the revolution and construction run through with trust and love for the people, unconditionally serve them and finally build a communist society desired by all the people at any cost. All the participants renewed their firm resolution to make signal progress in carrying out the tasks set forth at the 8th WPK Congress by developing the primary Party organizations into an integral whole of loyalists sharing the idea and intention with the Party Central Committee and acting as instructed by it, always mindful of the noble intention of the respected General Secretary. The two fir trees, planted by Kim Jong Un in the Hwasong area where a new street for the people will appear, will steadily instill patriotism into all the people, adding green to socialist Korea where the people's dreams and ideal will come true. Political News Team

title: Participants in 2nd Conference of Secretaries of Primary Committees of WPK Vow Loyalty
body: Upon receiving with excitement the great programme for strengthening the basic Party organizations at the 2nd Conference of Secretaries of Primary Committees of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) which marked another milestone in our party building and activities, all its participants are filled with high revolutionary zeal for remaining intensely loyal to their mission and duty as the core of the Party and the frontline political workers. The participants in the conference met on Thursday to adopt a letter of pledge to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. A letter of pledge was read out at the meeting. In the letter all the participants made a firm pledge to further cement the basic organizations of the great WPK, true to the militant tasks set forth at the conference, recalling the glorious days of the conference honored with deep trust and love of the respected General Secretary. The letter expressed the participants' will to strengthen all the primary Party organizations into elite combat units sharing the idea, intention and action with the Party Central Committee and become true political workers of the Party devotedly serving the people, cherishing the absolute truth that the destiny and future of the Party, the country and the people are guaranteed only by the respected General Secretary. It also reflected the participants' resolution to dynamically conduct the organizational and political work for training the Party members and other working people into passionate revolutionaries faithful to the revolutionary idea and monolithic leadership of the General Secretary in keeping with the matured demand of the Party and the developing revolution and focus the activities of the primary Party organizations on materializing the fighting programme set forth by the Party Congress. The participants vowed to become competent political activists who are identical to the General Secretary in ideal, ambition, working method and way of activity, regarding the pride of learning the party work under his guidance as the most precious wealth in their life. The letter was adopted amid eruption of the participants' revolutionary faith and unshakable will to unyieldingly struggle to the end as befits the contingents of the Party Central Committee and faithful servants of the people on the road of honorable service for the Party, revolution and people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Participants in 2nd Conference of Secretaries of Primary Committees of WPK Enjoy Art Performance
body: The participants in the Second Conference of Secretaries of Primary Committees of Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) enjoyed an art performance given by major art troupes. The performers sang highly of the immortal feats of the Party which has ushered in an era of self-respect and prosperity unprecedented in the history of the Korean nation spanning five thousand years and cultivated a great flower garden of the people-first principle by dint of the single-minded unity and the harmonious whole under the uplifted red flag of Paektu representing the destiny of the people. Watching the performance, the audience deeply realized the immutable truth that the WPK carrying out the great cause of building a prosperous country and a powerful army with recourse to the absolute trust by the people represents the dignity and strength of our state and people. The audience was filled with the determination of fidelity to accelerate the advance of the Korean revolution towards the eminence of a powerful socialist country by devoting themselves to implementing the cause of further consolidating the foundation of the Party and bringing earlier the future of a prosperous and powerful country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Tree-planting Day Observed in DPRK
body: Many trees were planted in different parts of the DPRK on the occasion of the Tree-planting Day. Officials and members of working people's organizations in Pyongyang launched a tree-planting campaign. Various units including the Central Committee of the youth league and the High-Speed Youth Shock Brigade Management Bureau planted with much care more than 1 000 trees and flower shrubs of 10-odd species in the area of the Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace. Officials of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea, the Central Committee of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea and the Central Committee of the women's union conducted a tree-planting campaign at the Mangyongdae Revolutionary Site and the Central Botanical Garden. Officials and working people in various districts and counties of Pyongyang planted trees of good species in their streets, villages and workplaces. Officials of Party and power organs and working people's organizations in South Phyongan Province planted trees in the vicinity of the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in Phyongsong City and in other areas. Hundreds of thousands of trees were planted in South Hamgyong Province, including the Ryonpho area to be turned into a socialist civilized farm. Trees and flower shrubs, planted by officials and working people across the country on Wednesday, amounted to millions. Rodong Sinmun

title: Songdan, a Scenic Spot of DPRK Famous for Pine Forest
body: There is a thick forest of pine trees (Songdan) about 4 kilometers distant from the township of Riwon County in South Hamgyong Province. The Songdan has been well known among our people as a famous scenic spot since long ago. According to old history books, there were no pine trees but white sands. People in the area had planted young pine trees in the white sandy beach and tended them attentively in order to prevent the effect of sea wind. Those young pine trees grew up forming a thick forest to display a beautiful scenery. The Songdan became more attractive and famous under the warm care of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il who visited it and gave precious instructions to protect and manage it well. Now the Songdan is enjoying its fame as a beauty spot for the people thanks to the wise guidance of the Workers’ Party of Korea led by the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected General Secretary Always Takes Care of His People
body: Avalanche of Happiness One day in November, Juche 108(2019) the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited again the construction site of the Yangdok Hot Spring Resort nearing completion. That day, making round the various places of the construction site, he asked the officials if people would like having hot spring bath in indoor spas after skiing or horse-riding. An official replied that there would be an avalanche of people. Listening to his answer, he said that it would be an avalanche of happiness. He added that our people who would be glad were vivid before his eyes. Avalanche of happiness! These words fully reflect his noble world of endless love for our people. He visited the rough construction site again and again and gave detailed instructions so that all buildings could be completed on a high level. The Yangdok Hot Spring Resort is unthinkable without his energetic leadership. Indeed, the scenes of happiness unfolded on this land are the fruit of the devotion and efforts of the respected General Secretary. Standard of Evaluation The respected General Secretary loves the people most and makes officials orient all their undertakings to giving top priority to the interests and convenience of the people and regarding them as absolute. One day in January some years ago, he visited the Kumkhop General Foodstuff Factory for Sportspeople. He was very pleased with the several production processes in which various foodstuffs were produced. When he called at a workshop, an official of the factory proudly informed the General Secretary that the foodstuffs produced there were loved by people. Then he, looking at the foodstuffs satisfactorily, said that if people liked them, he was also glad and the standard of evaluation was people’s evaluation. The standard of evaluation is people’s evaluation! His sentence stirred the officials violently. The respected General Secretary gives precedence to the desire and request of people all the time and regards them as the standard of evaluation. His earnest instruction was deeply kept in minds of officials. The most strict inspectors and judges are people. Listen to the evaluation of people! Rodong Sinmun

title: Ri People’s Hospitals and Clinics Are Equipped with New Medical Appliances
body: People’s hospitals and clinics in ris are supplied with new medical appliances produced under the warm love of the motherly Party. A campaign is going on to provide hundreds of the lowest treatment and prevention units in Jagang and North Phyongan provinces with ten-odd kinds of quality medical appliances produced by the Myohyangsan Medical Appliances Factory and Huichon Hospital Bed Factory. The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un, who always pays deep attention to the improvement of people’s health, took benevolent measures to provide medical appliances produced by the Myohyangsan Medical Appliances Factory and Huichon Hospital Bed Factory to rural people’s hospitals and clinics in ris in Jagang Province, too. The people’s hospitals in Kwangyon-ri, Wiwon County and Jongpho-ri, Janggang County and Konggwi-dong Clinic in Kanggye City have been furnished with new medical appliances followed by the lowest treatment and prevention units in Manpho City and Rangrim, Sijung and Janggang counties which have been supplied with ten-odd kinds of quality medical appliances like dental instruments, high-pressure steam disinfector and lying-in beds. Besides, new medical appliances will be supplied to ri people’s hospitals and clinics in different cities and counties in North Phyongan Province including Jongju City and Unjon and Kwaksan counties in March. The above news is adding to the enthusiasm of agricultural workers all out to usher in a new era of rural rejuvenation. Rodong Sinmun

title: 5th Meeting of 30th Central Committee of UDKWJ Held
body: The 5th Meeting of the 30th Central Committee of the Union of Democratic Korean Women in Japan (UDKWJ) was held at the Korean Hall in Tokyo on Feb. 25. Present there were Pak Ku Ho, first vice-chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), Kang Chu Ryon, its vice-chairwoman and concurrently chairwoman of the Central Standing Committee of the UDKWJ, and other members of its Central Committee. The meeting discussed the issue of convening the 31st Congress of the UDKWJ and its tasks and measures for thoroughly implementing the decision made at the 5th Meeting of the 24th Central Committee of Chongryon on brilliantly greeting the 25th Congress of Chongryon, which will mark a new milestone in the Korean movement in Japan in the great era of Kim Jong Un, as the one of single-hearted unity, inheritance and innovation to accomplish the cause of Juche which has entered a new historic stage. Kang Chu Ryon made a report. She referred to the fact that the UDKWJ has conducted the work for thoroughly establishing the ideological and leadership system of Juche in the organization to carry out the decision of the 4th Meeting of the 24th Central Committee of Chongryon which embodies the main idea and main spirit of the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea and the work for thoroughly implementing the tasks indicated in the important congratulatory letter of the respected Marshal Kim Jong Un to the Conference of Representatives of Branches of Chongryon-2020 (Third Conference of a New Heyday) in the period under review. She also clarified the tasks for successfully greeting the 25th Congress of Chongryon and the 31st Congress of the UDKWJ. She stressed that the members of the Central Committee of the UDKWJ should repay the benevolence and political trust bestowed by Kim Jong Un with actual results. Then followed speeches. Pak Ku Ho concluded the meeting. A letter to Kim Jong Un was read out at the meeting. Rodong Sinmun

title: University Graduates Volunteer to Work at Ryonpho Greenhouse Farm
body: Tens of graduates of Hamhung University of Agriculture in the DPRK volunteered to work at the Ryonpho Greenhouse Farm under construction. A congratulatory meeting took place at the Hamhung Grand Theatre on Mar. 3. Present there were Om Pong Guk, secretary of the South Hamgyong Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials of the provincial youth league committee and officials and students of graduating classes of Hamhung University of Agriculture and other universities. Certificates were awarded to the volunteers at the meeting. Some volunteers made speeches, following congratulatory addresses. A speaker warmly congratulated the volunteers who take the lead in working at the places called by the Party apart from their dear old homes and city in hearty response to the Party's grand plan for socialist rural construction. The speakers expressed their will to make innovative successes by displaying the same wisdom and bravery at new revolutionary posts as the young people did in the postwar reconstruction period and the Chollima era. A resolution was adopted at the meeting. After the congratulatory art performance, officials of the province and officials and students of various universities saw off the volunteers leaving for the Ryonpho Greenhouse Farm. Rodong Sinmun

title: 3rd Enlarged Plenary Meeting of 9th UAWK Central Committee Held
body: The 3rd Enlarged Plenary Meeting of the 9th Central Committee of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea (UAWK) was held Thursday via video conferencing. Attending the meeting were members and alternate members of the UAWK Central Committee as well as UAWK officials at national and local levels as observers. Discussed at the meeting was the issue of fulfilling the important tasks set in the historic letter "Let the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea Become the Vanguard in the Struggle for Achieving Our Style of Socialist Rural Development" sent by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un to the participants in the 9th Congress of the UAWK. UAWK Central Committee Chairman Han Jong Hyok made a report. He said that the important letter sent by the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un is a militant banner to be highly upheld by all UAWK organizations and officials in the ongoing advance toward a new great era of achieving the rapid Korean-style socialist rural development. He underlined the honorable tasks for the UAWK organizations of training all their members to be rural revolutionaries and patriotic agricultural workers who materialize the socialist rural construction plan of the Party in the van and of responsibly discharging their mission and role as the scout party, the vanguard of the rural revolution of transforming the whole rural communities on the Juche idea. He called upon the UAWK organizations and officials to fully perform their responsibility and duty in the efforts for the Korean-style socialist rural development, true to the important tasks set in the respected General Secretary's historic letter, cherishing in their hearts the absolute loyalty and pure conscience and obligation to the Party and the leader. Speeches were made and an execution plan adopted at the meeting. Rodong Sinmun

title: Epidemic Prevention Campaign Intensified in DPRK
body: The emergency epidemic prevention units at all levels of the DPRK further intensify the anti-epidemic campaign. Through media, the citizens are informed of the global health crisis caused by COVID-19. Loudspeakers installed at key spots of streets inform citizens of the source of infection and symptoms of COVID-19, thus raising the public preventive atmosphere. Officials of the industrial establishments and farms take preventive measures before organizing the daily work and ensure that all the employees strictly observe the epidemic prevention rules. Agitprop activities are intensified to make sure that all the people make it a habit to observe the epidemic prevention rules and regulations, well aware that the protracted emergency epidemic prevention campaign calls for following the rules and regulations very strictly for a long time with a great awareness of the seriousness of the disease. Notice boards in the bustling construction sites help the builders have better knowledge about the preventive work. People are informed of the ways for preventing the inroad of the malignant virus at public service facilities. Information activities are meticulously conducted to let all citizens eliminate the sources of the epidemic and other diseases by properly coping with the frequent sandy dust phenomena in spring and keeping streets, villages and flats clean and tidy. Rodong Sinmun

title: NADA and Academy of Defence Science Conduct Another Important Test for Developing Reconnaissance Satellite
body: The DPRK National Aerospace Development Administration (NADA) and the Academy of Defence Science conducted another important test on Saturday under the plan of developing a reconnaissance satellite. Through the test, the NADA confirmed the reliability of data transmission and reception system of the satellite, its control command system and various ground-based control systems. Rodong Sinmun

title: Ninth Congress of KCU to Be Held
body: The Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League announced on March 5 that the Ninth Congress of the Korean Children's Union (KCU) would be held in Pyongyang in early June Juche 111 (2022). The Ninth Congress will review the five-year work of the KCU after its Eighth Congress and discuss the tasks and ways for strengthening the KCU into the children's organization of the respected Marshal Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Plans for February Carried out in Various Economic Sectors of DPRK
body: Plans for February were fulfilled in different economic sectors of the DPRK. Officials and workers at several metal factories and enterprises in charge of the iron and steel production carried out their production plans for February by giving precedence to the supply of raw and other materials and fuel, increasing the production results per shift and per charge and carrying out the daily production plan and the one for every ten days on all indices. The iron ore producers and the mines producing fire-resisting materials keep their daily production going at a high rate by waging a dynamic campaign for carrying out the national economic plans for February. Officials and workers of several units in the field of the chemical industry including the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex, the Ponghwa Chemical Factory and the Pyongyang Rubber Factory made a collective innovation in carrying out their plans for February. Those in the fields of the machine-building industry and building-materials industry including the Taean Heavy Machine Complex, the Ryongsong Machine Complex, the Sangwon Cement Complex and the Sunchon Cement Complex also fulfilled their plans for February by conducting a dynamic mass technological innovation movement. The field of the electric power industry over-fulfilled the national economic plan for February set by the Ministry of Electric Power Industry. The field of the mining industry made achievements in fulfilling the plan for February as they did in January and the fishing sector fulfilled the national economic plan for February. The fields of forestry and light industry also fulfilled their national economic plans for February. Rodong Sinmun

title: Anniversary of Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's Official Goodwill Visit to Vietnam Marked
body: An event took place at a museum in Lang Son Province of Vietnam on March 1 to commemorate the 3rd anniversary of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's official goodwill visit to the Socialist Republic of Vietnam. Displayed at the venue of the event were photos showing the immortal exploits performed by President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un during their external activities for developing the friendly relations between the DPRK and Vietnam. Attending the event were officials of the Vietnamese Foreign Ministry, the Vietnam-DPRK Friendship Association, the Lang Son Provincial People's Committee and the museum in the province and the charge d'affaires ad interim and staff members of the DPRK embassy in Hanoi. After laying a floral basket and making a bow before a photo of President Kim Il Sung meeting with President Ho Chi Minh in the section arranged for displaying the historic mementoes related to the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un's visit to Vietnam, the participants looked round the section. Then, there was a commemorative round-table talk. The DPRK charge d'affaires ad interim referred to the historic significance of the respected General Secretary's official goodwill visit to Vietnam, saying that the Korean people have made brilliant successes in the struggle for bringing about the overall development of socialism under the wise guidance of the great Party. Officials of the Vietnamese Foreign Ministry and the Lang Son Provincial People's Committee said that Kim Jong Un's visit to Vietnam was an event to be specially recorded in the development of the friendly and cooperative relations provided by President Ho Chi Minh and President Kim Il Sung and developed by successive leaders of the two countries, adding that the agreement made by General Secretary Nguyen Phu Trong and General Secretary Kim Jong Un represents the firm commitment of the two parties, two states and the peoples of the two countries to steadily consolidating and developing the bilateral relations. Since the historic meeting, the leaders of the two parties and the two states have positively propelled the development of the friendly relations by keeping close communication. They expressed belief that the event would serve as an important occasion for demonstrating the traditional friendship between the two countries. After the round-table talk, the participants toured Dong Dang Station visited by the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un. Meanwhile, a commemorative round-table talk was held at an art center of the National Song and Dance Theatre of Vietnam on February 25. Rodong Sinmun

title: ﻿Staff Members of Vietnamese Embassy Visit Korean Revolution Museum
body: Le Ba Binh, Vietnamese ambassador to the DPRK, and staff members of his embassy visited the Korean Revolution Museum on March 4 on the occasion of the 3rd anniversary of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's historic official goodwill visit to Vietnam. The visitors made a bow toward the colored statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il at the general review room of the museum. Being briefed on the friendly and cooperative relations between the DPRK and Vietnam forged and developed by the leaders of the two countries in the struggle for defending socialism and adding luster to it, they made a round of several rooms. After the visit, the Vietnamese ambassador made an entry in the visitor's book. Prior to this, staff members of the Vietnamese embassy visited the DPRK-Vietnam Friendship Kyongsang Kindergarten. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Premier Inspects Industrial Establishments
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and premier of the Cabinet, made a field survey of the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex and several units under the Salt Industry Bureau. At the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex, the premier called on its officials to push ahead with the current fertilizer production in the revolutionary working style and manner, mindful of the important position and role of the complex in implementing the strategy for rural development set forth at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee. He stressed the need to raise the productivity by strictly observing the technical rules and standard regulations in all processes of the complex and positively introducing the advanced science and technology. Learning in detail about the remodeling and updating of the Onchon Tile Factory under the Salt Industry Bureau, he said that its officials should thoroughly ensure the construction quality by scrupulously organizing and commanding the project and thus finish it without fail at the set time, as the updating of the factory is of weighty significance in the salt production. At the Kwisong Salt Works and a salt-making machine repair factory, the premier called upon their officials and workers to bring about substantial and innovative achievements in the struggle for developing the country's salt industry in the spirit of devotedly and conditionally implementing the Party's policies. The on-the-spot consultative meetings discussed the issue of giving precedence to the supply of raw and other materials for keeping the fertilizer production going at a high rate, the issue of steadily increasing the salt production of salt works and firmly cementing their material and technological foundation and the issue of making the relevant units supply the equipment necessary for the salt production in a responsible way, and took measures for doing so. Rodong Sinmun

title: Meaningful Trees Have Grown Giant
body: In April Juche 80(1991), President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il planted memorial trees at the the April 15 Children’s Flower Garden. 30-odd years have passed since the President and the Chairman planted the trees and they have grown giant. The great leaders noted that afforestation is the work for the everlasting prosperity of the country to provide the people with happy life and hand over rich forest resources and beautiful country to posterity. The two trees planted on the spring day convey their noble patriotic will. Our country will be more beautiful under the leadership of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un who is translating the great leaders’ patriotic desires for a powerful country into reality. Rodong Sinmun

title: Construction Forces Strengthened
body: Officials of cities and counties in Kangwon Province put big efforts to strengthen their own construction forces upholding our Party’s new programme of socialist rural construction. In the cities and counties, they analyze and review mistakes and shortcomings of the past and actively take measures for correcting them. They prepare officials into able ones for strengthening commanding forces of construction units. They increase ranks of skilled builders by enlisting discharged soldiers, who have been trained and have gained practical experiences in specialized construction units of the army, as the core and enhance their role in training more skilled builders. In the province, they set the goal of raising level of mechanization of construction units in the cities and counties and promote it in real earnest. They inspire the construction units to push ahead with the work for equipping enough heavy machines and tools. The brisk work for strengthening designing forces of the cities and counties is conducted on a provincial scale. They build up the designing forces by selecting those who have knowledge of specialized design and those with aptitude for design. Then they let designers broaden their outlook and develop their practical abilities. Senior officials of the province take measures for consolidating material and technical basis of designing institutes. Rodong Sinmun

title: Forest Restoration Campaign Starts Thus
body: Patriotic Appeal Aroused All People In November Juche 103(2014), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited the Central Tree Nursery. He told officials that he remembered Chairman Kim Jong Il, who had been so impatient to see bare mountains during his field guidance, and that he felt a shot of pain from failing to dispel the Chairman’s anxiety. He said that the forest resources of the country shrank in bulk during the Arduous March, the forced march and there was no space to step back, leaving bare mountains as they were. Then he ardently called on the entire Party, army and all the people to turn out for a general mobilization for recovering them, deeming this campaign a war with nature as the whole country rose from the debris during the post-war reconstruction. Actually his appeal was a mighty declaration that manifested his iron will to beautify the country into a socialist powerful country and a paradise of people. True to his ardent appeal of that day, all the people across the country turned out as one for the afforestation and protection of forests regarding it as the supreme patriotic work for the future of the country and its eternal prosperity. The Work Must Be Carried Out Vigorously and Steadily One March day a few years ago, the respected General Secretary visited a unit of the Korean People’s Army (KPA). Saying that every mountain of the country should be transfigured into golden and treasured ones in 10 years upholding the patriotic cause of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il who endlessly loved the country, he added that there was no space to step back in the forest issue and the Party had declared a war with nature regarding the forest restoration campaign as a battle with no gun fire. After a while he resumed that the officers and men of the KPA should deem the forest restoration campaign, a gigantic nature-remaking project, their combat task and vigorously carry it out till every mountain around and in the stationing area of the unit were turned into treasured and golden ones. And he stressed that they should not plant some trees only on the Tree Planting Days but do it in a constant manner. That day he spent much time planting trees with the soldiers. While planting the trees in person, he taught in detail such matters arising in planting trees to meet the scientific and technological requirement. His tree-planting that day was a meaningful lesson that implanted in people’s heart what the starting point of love for the country was. Rodong Sinmun

title: Exhibition of August 3 Consumer Goods Held
body: Some days ago, the Jagang Provincial Exhibition of August 3 Consumer Goods was held in Jonchon County. On display at the exhibition were consumer goods presented by factories, enterprises in the province and cities and counties. Through the exhibition, the province evaluated quality and diversity of the produced consumer goods necessary for the improvement of the people’s standard of living and let producers positively exchange and share good experience and technologies each other. Listening to the people’s voices on goods produced by their respective units, officials and technicians deeply kept in their minds what kinds of goods were badly needed in the people’s living and what their qualitative indices should be. Meanwhile, the province pointed out shortcomings revealed through the exhibition and urged producers to thoroughly overcome their shortcomings at next exhibition and to bring about remarkable improvement in raising quality. The exhibition served as an occasion to arouse the producers’ zeal to bringing about fresh progress in producing consumer goods and raising quality. Rodong Sinmun

title: Foundation for Milk Powder Production Being Consolidated
body: North Hamgyong Province pushes forward the consolidation of milk powder production foundation true to the noble intention of the Party which greatly loves the posterity and future generation. Orang County applies itself to producing milk powder installations in reliance on its own scientific and technological forces. Its officials roused the creative enthusiasm of technicians to the maximum and solved problems arising in installation-manufacturing in a flexible way. Therefore, a milk powder production line superior to its predecessor has been established in a short period of time. The province generalized the experience of Orang County to let other cities and counties put further spurs to manufacturing milk powder installations. The presentation held in Orang County reminded the city and county officials of the province of the fact that a marked progress can be made in the implementation of the Party’s ideas and defending of the Party’s policies when scientific and technological forces are intensified. Officials of Onsong and Kyongwon counties speed up the installation-manufacturing in high spirit by setting personal examples, mindful that the success or failure in implementation of the Party’s policies hinges on their role. In other regions including Kilju and Kyongsong counties, they push ahead with the consolidation of milk powder production foundation in close cooperation with relevant units. The province learns about the situations in cities and counties in a detailed manner and takes necessary measures on one hand and holds substantial summing-up meetings through weekly video-conferences on the other, thus more briskly pushing ahead with the consolidation of milk powder production foundation. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Greetings to Syrian President
body: Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a message of greeting to Bashar Al-Assad, president of the Syrian Arab Republic, on Tuesday. The message extended warm congratulations to the Syrian president and people on the 59th anniversary of the March 8 Revolution in Syria. It said the Korean people are very rejoiced over the fact that the Syrian people have achieved many successes in the struggle for achieving peace and development of the country despite all sorts of the hostile forces' obstructive moves for more than half a century after the March 8 Revolution. The message extended firm support and solidarity once again to the just cause of the Syrian people for the sovereignty and territorial integrity of the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Preparations for Supplying Irrigation Water Brisk in DPRK
body: In the DPRK, work is being stepped up to supply enough irrigation water needed for this year's farming. Regarding it as an essential to farming preparation to improve the conditions for irrigation water supply, North Phyongan Province launched the work to store enough water. North Hwanghae Province has concentrated efforts on repairing and reinforcing the water intakes at reservoirs, while pushing ahead with the work to store the water. The pumping equipment and facilities are also repaired and maintained well. Pyongyang City has stepped up the repair and maintenance of pumping equipment, producing many accessories. After building a reliable repair base, Nampho City has striven to finish the repair of pumping equipment ahead of schedule. Meanwhile, farms across the country are making efforts to finish the repair and reinforcement of waterways and irrigation structures before the farming season. Rodong Sinmun

title: Excellent Educators Help Rural Schools in DPRK
body: In the DPRK, competent educators go to rural schools to contribute to bridging the gap between city and rural levels in education. For the last two months alone, many excellent educators from provinces, cities and counties found themselves at rural schools to help their teachers in teaching preparation and improvement of qualifications. South Hwanghae Province planned to dispatch academic advisers to rural schools while making sure that they prepared necessary educational videos and data to help rural teachers boost their competence. In South Phyongan Province, dispatched educators have conducted such works as demonstration teaching and presentation of experience to transfer the excellent teaching achievements, experience and knowledge to the rural school teachers. Educators in other provinces, too, are endeavoring to help those teachers at rural schools further enhance their qualifications. Rodong Sinmun

title: Women's Sports and Amusement Games Mark March 8 International Women's Day
body: Officials and members of the Pyongyang City Committee of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea (SWUK) had sports and amusement games at the Handball Gymnasium in Chongchun Street of Pyongyang on Mar. 3-7 to mark the 112th anniversary of the March 8 International Women's Day. Women's union officials and members in the city competed with each other at various sporting events like volleyball, table-tennis and yut-game. The finals of each event took place on Mar. 7. The games were enjoyed by Kim Jong Sun, chairwoman of the SWUK Central Committee, officials concerned and women's union officials and members. The participants in the games fully displayed their sports technique, noble sports morals and collective organizing ability and unity. There were also amusement games, which gave a further boost to the atmosphere of the gymnasium. Through the games, the women's union officials and members showed well the cheerful and optimistic looks of the Korean women loving the worthwhile socialist life and creating happiness with their own hands. Rodong Sinmun

title: His Pleasure Found in People’s Happiness
body: The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited the then Pyongyang City Mushroom Farm in January Juche 104(2015). Enjoying a bird’s eye view of the factory, he expressed his satisfaction noting that it was built in a neat and elegant way. Recalling that he called on all provinces, cities and counties to build modern mushroom farms and Pyongyang City took the lead in implementing the Party’s policy, he praised the city for successfully building the mushroom farm as required by Juche-oriented idea of the Workers’ Party of Korea on architectural aesthetics. That day, he looked round various parts of the factory to learn in detail about its construction and production, saying earnestly that he can guess that the factory has buckled down to the work for selecting good species as a main production index and introducing advanced cultivating method for hitting the mushroom production target. Adding that he could not repress his mind to carry officials and employees on his back whenever visiting the units upholding the Party policy in practice, he gave thanks on behalf of the WPK Central Committee to the builders, scientists and technicians and officials and workers of relevant units who made contribution to the construction of the farm, asking officials to convey his regards to them. That day, he warmly said that he was very pleased to see the rare edifice provided for the people like this at the beginning of the new year and that it would be very glad to see every day of the year go like that happy day. Looking up to smiling image of the respected General Secretary, officials were determined to devote all to upholding his high intention of love for people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Subdivisions in March and Folk Customs
body: The subdivisions in March are the Kyongchip(the end of hibernation) and the Chunbun(the vernal equinox). The Kyongchip is the 3rd of the 24 seasonal divisions according to the lunar calendar that falls on about 5th or 6th of March. The Kyongchip means the end of hibernation and in this period warm weather comes, ice melts, it rains with thunder and animals and insects which have been hibernating below the surface are alarmed to wake up. The Chunbun is the 4th of the 24 seasonal divisions in lunar calendar that falls on about 21st or 22nd of March. The Chunbun means that it has entered the mid-spring and in this period the lengths of day and night become almost the same. Strong wind blows frequently but the weather gets warmer and the earth which was frozen in the winter thaws out completely. From olden times, when the Kyongchip and the Chunbun come, Korean people used to make the surrounding environment clean by repairing their fences and clearing out ditches in front of their houses in order to tidy the traces of winter away. Meanwhile they used to start spring plowing and plant various crops as well as young flowering plants and tree saplings. They used to feel the vernal fragrance by taking tasty dishes cooked with wild greens. They also used to gather herbs to store them and dance and sing wishing for good farming. Rodong Sinmun

title: Sincere Support to Coal-mining Front
body: South Phyongan Province powerfully support the coal miners who have turned out to implement the decisions made at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea. Cities and counties, factories and enterprises and other units of the province have sent various kinds of tools, materials and supplies to coal mines thus contributing to the increased coal output. Provincial officials make active efforts to solve knotty problems arising in coal production on the spot including the work of securing reserve cutting faces by prioritizing tunneling. Officials of different cities and counties such as Tokchon City and Chongnam County brought with them various tools and materials to coal mines and encouraged coal miners. Officials of the provincial organs including the Provincial People’s Committee and the Provincial Trade Administration Bureau supported coal mines in a substantial manner. The province reviewed the state of supporting coal mines meaningfully and saw to it that officials and working people of every unit supported the coal front materially and morally with correct viewpoint on and attitude towards it. In addition it gives wide publicity of the model units and makes the others follow them. The enthusiasm for supporting coal front is getting high in the province. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Inspects National Aerospace Development Administration (NADA)
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected the National Aerospace Development Administration (NADA). Accompanying him were Department Director Yu Jin and Vice Department Director Kim Jong Sik of the WPK Central Committee. The respected General Secretary was greeted on the spot by leading officials of the NADA and the Academy of Defence Science. Kim Jong Un learned in detail, from leading officials of the NADA, about the process of scientific research and development intended to hit the goals for attainment of space defence science and technology set forth at the 8th WPK Congress and the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th WPK Central Committee. After acquainting himself with the development and preparations of optical photographing equipment, video transmitter and other communication data transceivers and various kinds of sensors and devices for satellite, he heard reports on the major test results recently conducted by the NADA. He expressed his great satisfaction at the fact that they confirmed the aerospace photographing method, the operating characteristics of high-resolution photographing equipment and the reliability of image transmission system through the recent important tests. Seeing the vertical and oblique high-resolution images on specific ground regions taken through the major tests, he highly appreciated the successes the NADA has recently made in settling the image composing and processing technology, the ability of processing a large volume of data communication, the accuracy of control command system, the technology of communication encryption, etc., true to the space development policy of the Party. The development of a reconnaissance satellite takes an important share in attaining the five major goals for developing the defence power set forth at the 8th Party Congress, he said, stressing once again the strategic significance of the reconnaissance satellite in enhancing the war deterrent of the state and the capability of war preparedness. Saying that the development of reconnaissance satellite is not merely a scientific research work for the development of information-gathering means, but a work for the protection of our sovereignty and national interests, the exercise of the legitimate rights to self-defence and the elevation of national prestige, he stressed that this urgent project for perfecting the country's war preparedness capacity by improving our state's war deterrent is the supreme revolutionary task, a political and military priority task to which our Party and government attach the most importance. He called on the officials, scientists and technicians in the space and defence science research sectors to successfully accomplish the development of a Korean-style reconnaissance satellite within the period set by the Party Central Committee by getting united and closely cooperating with each other, true to the WPK's policies for aerospace development and national defence development. The General Secretary also learned about the construction of the Academy of Space Science and a cosmic environment experiment center. Noting that it is very important to lay a solid material and technical foundation for the field of space science research so as to attain the high sci-tech goal for space conquest set forth by our state, he stressed the need to give more state support to the space science research sector and examine the important measures for its steady development. He said that it is our Party's important strategic and tactical policy on bolstering the national defence capability to keep a close eye on and distinguish the character of hostile military actions against the DPRK committed by the aggression troops of the U.S. imperialism and its vassal forces in and around the Korean Peninsula and enhance the capability for controlling situation and improve the rapid counteraction capability of the armed forces of the state according to the relevant situations. And he set forth the militant goals related to the development and operation of the reconnaissance satellite in the period of the five-year plan to implement this policy. He noted that the purpose of developing and operating the military reconnaissance satellite is to provide the armed forces of the DPRK with real-time information on military actions against it by the aggression troops of the U.S. imperialism and its vassal forces in south Korea, Japan and the Pacific. And he said that the Party Central Committee fully supports the decision of the National Aerospace Development Administration on diversely putting a lot of military reconnaissance satellites into sun-synchronous polar orbit in the period of the five-year plan so as to possess the strong capability for gathering intelligence by satellites. He expressed high expectation and belief that the space and national defence scientific research sectors would demonstrate to the full the heroic mettle of the defence scientific group remaining boundlessly faithful to the Party and revolution by rising up in the scientific and research campaign to thoroughly carry out the strategic plan of the Party Central Committee and making strenuous efforts. Cherishing in their hearts the militant task set forth by the respected General Secretary, all the officials, scientists and technicians made a pledge of loyalty to defend the great dignity of our state with cutting-edge defence science, greatly encouraged by his deep trust that gives invincible strength. Political News Team

title: March 8 International Women's Day Marked in DPRK
body: The 112th anniversary of March 8 International Women's Day was splendidly marked across the DPRK. At the plaza of the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the sacred temple of Juche where President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il lie in state, the visitors looked back on the benevolence of the great leaders who built a grand flower garden, where women are prioritized and respected, regarding it as their motto to believe in the people as in heaven all their lives. People placed floral baskets, bouquets and flowers at the statues of the President and the Chairman and mosaics picturing their smiling images on Mansu Hill and in other parts of the country before making a bow toward the statues. Officials of every province, city and county and those of different institutions, industrial establishments and farms congratulated exemplary women workers. Colorful art performances and amusement games took place across the country. There was a concert by the National Symphony Orchestra at Moranbong Theatre, the drama "Devoted Service" at the National Theatre and a circus by the National Acrobatic Troupe at Pyongyang Circus Theater. The Ensemble of the Ministry of National Defence gave an outdoor performance at the Yangdok Hot Spring Resort. Art performances were given in North Phyongan Province and other provinces and cities to celebrate the holiday. Women's union members revved up the festive mood by playing diverse amusement games full of national flavor. Public catering facilities were busy serving women. Women were greatly pleased to receive gifts and flowers from their husbands and children. Rodong Sinmun

title: 2022 Horse-riding Games for March 8 International Women's Day Held
body: There were 2022 horse-riding games for marking the March 8 International Women's Day in Pyongyang on Tuesday. Among the spectators were Choe Ryong Hae, Jo Yong Won, Ri Il Hwan, Ju Chang Il, Ri Tu Song and other senior Party and government officials and their wives. Pak Myong Sun, Kim Yo Jong and other women officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials of the C.C., Socialist Women's Union of Korea and women labor innovators and merited workers watched the games together with working people, youth and students in the city. Before the opening of the games, children entered on a chariot and gave bouquets of congratulations to exemplary women officials.
