Kim Il Guk, minister of Physical Culture and Sports, made an opening address. Buglers and drummers in Koguryo warrior clothes announced the opening of the games. There were a demonstration horse-riding by horse riders of the Mirim Riding Club and a demonstration of equestrian feats by artistes of the National Acrobatic Troupe. The horse-riders formed numbers "3.8". And various equestrian feats were shown by women acrobats. Demonstration equestrian performance caught particular interest of the spectators. Such opening rite was followed by horse-riding games. Horse-riding games by couples selected in Pyongyang City and provinces drew attention of the spectators. And there were 1600m rider race, 1600m men's amateur race and 1600m women's amateur race in the outdoor horse-riding tracks. There were also other colorful games which added to the delight of the spectators. Players who came on the top standings were awarded cups, medals, certificates and prizes. The games were followed by a congratulatory art performance. Rodong Sinmun

title: Output of Their Organic Compound Fertilizer Increased
body: Cities and counties push briskly ahead with the production of organic compound fertilizers which can effectively improve the fertility of soil. Officials of agricultural guidance organs at all levels reminded themselves of the importance of the production and utilization of organic compound fertilizers in increasing the per-hectare yield of grains by over one ton this year and made scrupulous arrangements to this end. Officials and working people of the organic compound fertilizer factories in Sinuiju City and Thaechon County solve technical problems by concerted efforts and engage themselves in producing quality organic compound fertilizers and supplying them to farms. Innovations are also witnessed at the Pukchang County Organic Compound Fertilizer Factory. Its workers brace themselves up, mindful of the fact that for them to increase production of fertilizers and send them to farms is as good as contributing to filling up the country’s granary. Organic compound fertilizer producers in Phyongsong and Sunchon cities ensure production on a normal footing by improving the workers’ techniques and skills and actively tapping raw materials abundant in their localities. A production upswing is effected at the Hamju County Organic Compound Fertilizer Factory thanks to its workers’ soaring enthusiasm. Marked progress is made at organic compound fertilizer factories in Chongjin and Hoeryong cities as the workers there run equipment at full capacity and do their parts in a responsible manner, desirous to actively contribute to improving soil fertility. Workers in other organic compound fertilizer producers follow suit. Rodong Sinmun

title: AFC Women's Football Day Marked
body: An event was held at Pyongyang International Football School on March 8 to mark the AFC (Asian Football Confederation) Women's Football Day. The event was attended by officials from the DPRK Football Association, meritorious women coaches and tutors from sports teams and football teams and the sector for training young sportspersons in Pyongyang. Han Un Gyong, vice-chairwoman of the DPRK Football Association, in a speech, extended warm greetings to the women footballers and coaches across the country on the international women's day, saying that many women football coaches devote their wisdom and zeal to training women football stars of the country. Briefing the audience of the global trend in development of women's football, she expressed the belief that the current event would become a good occasion for sharing each other's good experience and opinions. Then there took place an experience-sharing meeting and a demonstration lecture on teaching and training juvenile footballers. The participants, divided into two teams, played a football match. Rodong Sinmun

title: Dancing Parties Mark International Women's Day
body: Women's union officials and members in the DPRK had a dancing party at the plaza of the Arch of Triumph on Mar. 8 to mark the 112th anniversary of March 8 International Women's Day. The dancing party began with the playing of the song "Our Leader Loved by People". The women danced to the tune of "Women Are Flowers", "Our Future Is Bright" and other songs with deep reverence for President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il who pioneered the Juche-oriented women's movement and enforced the true politics of prioritizing and respecting women. Dancers were filled with great pride and confidence of leading a happy life as flowers of the country, life and families under the care of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. The festive mood revved up when the song "I Will Live like a Star Following Party" was played. On the same day, dancing parties were held by women's union officials and members in all provinces, cities and county seats. Rodong Sinmun

title: Electricity Production Increases Day after Day
body: Officials and workers of the power industrial sector, who overfulfiled the national economic plan in January and February, strive to increase production with their redoubled responsibility and strenuous spirit. Officials, workers and technicians of hydropower stations are directing big efforts to glorifying this year when the foundation for implementing the five-year plan is to be provided, with high success in power production. Electricity producers of the thermal power stations across the country are accelerating the production by putting efforts into readjustment and repair of generating equipment. Successes are made in electricity production one after another thanks to devoted efforts of officials and workers who have turned out to implement the task set forth by the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Inspects Sohae Satellite Launching Ground
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected the Sohae Satellite Launching Ground. Accompanying him were Kim Jong Sik, Jang Chang Ha and other leading officials of the munitions industry and national defence scientific research sectors and officials concerned of the National Aerospace Development Administration. Going round different parts of the ground, the respected General Secretary set forth a target for modernizing it and the detailed orientation and ways for doing so. He learned about and evaluated the present state of the ground, and advanced the task to modernize it on an expansion basis so that various rockets could be launched to carry multi-purpose satellites, including a military reconnaissance satellite, in the future. He also set forth the task for building some facilities in the launching ground. To enable large carrier rockets to be launched there, he assigned the tasks for reconstructing on an expansion basis the launching ground zone and the facilities for the general assembly and trial gearing of rocket and for the trial gearing of satellite, establishing extra facilities for the injection and supply of fuel and modernizing parts of the launch control facility and major technical posts on an expansion basis. He also gave detailed instructions as regards the matters arising in modernizing the Sohae Satellite Launching Ground on an expansion basis, including the matters of expanding the capacity of the engine ground jet test site, ensuring the convenience of carrier rocket transport, improving the ecological environment around the launching ground and building a grandstand in the safe zone opposite to the launching ground. He said that the Sohae Satellite Launching Ground is a place associated with the desire of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il for a space power and it is a significant place where our state successfully launched artificial satellites twice with its own efforts and technology, true to the lifetime intention of the President and the Chairman. And he stressed that it is the noble duty of our Party and space scientists and technicians in our era to turn the launching ground, associated with our state's great dream and ambition for a space power, into an ultramodern advanced base and a starting line of space conquest for the future suited to the prestige of the DPRK. Encouraged by his teachings, the officials, scientists and technicians hardened their strong will to turn the Sohae Satellite Launching Ground into the best model suitable for the dignity and prestige of our state by devotedly carrying out the militant tasks set forth by the General Secretary, fully aware of their mission as space pioneers who should surely carry into practice the grand plan of the Party Central Committee for building a space power, true to the behest of the President and the Chairman. Political News Team

title: Preparations for Exhibition to Support Education Brisk in DPRK
body: Preparations for exhibition to support education are brisk in all provinces, cities and counties of the DPRK. Pyongyang City is pushing ahead with the work to provide educational information equipment, apparatuses for experiment and practice and school things badly needed for improving educational conditions and environments. Amid the hot wind for supporting education, North Hwanghae Province is preparing materials for the exhibition. North Phyongan Province is directing its efforts to securing means needed for renovating schools and kindergartens into model ones and putting the education on an IT basis and to arranging materials needed for building the educational facilities. The cities and counties of the country are carrying on the preparations for the exhibition in close combination with the model-education county movement in order to make the exhibition contribute to thoroughly establishing the trait of placing importance on education throughout the society and further strengthening the material and technical foundation of education. Rodong Sinmun

title: Strong Support to Railway
body: Support to the railway gains momentum in the DPRK. With the day of support to railways as an occasion, Pyongyang City and Kangwon Province planted good species of trees in the vicinity of railways and did gutter-cleaning and stone-breaking through a mass campaign. North Phyongan, North Hwanghae and South Hwanghae provinces readjusted a large area of incline and built retaining walls at dozens of places. Rason City overhauled railways and spruced up railway lines and station yard. Officials of North Phyongan Province took timely measures in relevant railway sections and sent trackmen's teams a large amount of steel and welding rods needed for producing railway fixtures by establishing social atmosphere of support to railways. Rodong Sinmun

title: Design He Instructed in Person Nine Times
body: The general gymnasium of Mangyongdae Revolutionary School is permeated with the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un’s love for posterity. Visiting the school in January several years ago, the respected General Secretary personally touched the chilly floor of the old gymnasium which was not properly heated and decided to provide the school with the best gymnasium in the world. Later, he assigned the relevant designing unit to design the gymnasium and made sure that all necessary data for world were supplied to that end. He looked at the mock-up of the gymnasium presented by the designers and pointed out its defects. In this way, the design of the gymnasium was completed when he gave guidance to it for the ninth time and a gymnasium was built in a peculiar style at Mangyongdae Revolutionary School. The design he gave guidance to nine times－this shows the great love of the respected General Secretary who is anxious to pick even a star from the sky if it is for the good of the children. Rodong Sinmun

title: Projects for Juche-oriented Industry Actively Pushed Ahead with
body: Officials and working people of metallurgical and chemical industry push ahead with projects for Juche-oriented industry to carry out the important tasks set forth at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea. The officials of the Ministry of Metal Industry actively strive to solve the problems arising in building structures, making accessories and assembling the equipment at the construction sites. The officials and working people of the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex step up the construction of energy-saving oxygen-blast furnace and improve the capacity of producing oxygen. Those of the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex accelerate the construction of energy-saving oxygen-blast furnace in real earnest. In the Chollima Steel Complex, the officials and working people level the ground for installing more curved type strand-casting machines and concentrate all the efforts on maintaining and reinforcing production process after scrupulously making daily plans. Those of the chemical industry also strive to make the industry Juche-oriented. Officials of the Ministry of Chemical Industry make detailed plans and meticulously organize all the work under the scientific and technological guarantee at the construction sites for developing Juche-oriented industry. Meanwhile they take measures in advance for supplying materials in liaison with relevant institutions. Officials of different units including the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex and the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex scrupulously organize the work and arouse the creative enthusiasm of working people and technicians for solving technical problems. Rodong Sinmun

title: More Young People in DPRK Volunteer to Work in Countryside
body: More than 110 young people in Paechon County, South Hwanghae Province in the DPRK volunteered to work at cooperative farms and rural construction sites in the county. Among them are young workers of the Paechon Geological Survey Team and the County Irrigation Management Station who decided to work at cooperative farms in the county including the Kumgok Co-op Farm and the Unkyo Co-op Farm. Many young people from the youth league committee, chemical factory and other factories in the county expressed their will to devote their wisdom and zeal to the struggle for transforming the farm villages in the county into the ideal ones under socialism. Young people in Hyesan City of Ryanggang Province volunteered to work at the socialist countryside. Meetings were held to congratulate the volunteers in Paechon County and Hyesan City on Thursday. Certificates were confered on them and congratulatory, oath-taking speeches were made at the meetings. Congratulatory speakers requested them to distinguish themselves in implementing the agriculutural policy and rural construction plan of the Party with loyalty and patriotism while glorifying the honor of the socialist patriotic youth at every worksite. Oath-taking speakers expressed their determination to fully display the spirit and stamina of the Korean youth in the efforts for hitting the target of grain production set by the Party and transforming the socialist countryside into the highly civilized one like the youth of the preceding generations. After the meetings, officials, young people and working people in Paechon County and Hyesan City warmly sent them off, giving bunches of flowers to them. Rodong Sinmun

title: 43rd Conference of Union of Korean Students in Japan Held
body: The 43rd Conference of the Union of Korean Students in Japan took place at the Korean Hall in Tokyo on Feb. 27. Present there were Ri Hong Yun, chairperson of the Union Central Standing Committee, and other deputies to the union. Discussed at the conference were tasks of the 43rd term of the union for putting its movement on a normal track in this significant year when the 25th Congress of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan will be held and measures for doing so. Ri Hong Yun made a report at the meeting. The reporter analyzed and reviewed the successes and lessons made in the dynamic work of the 42nd term of the union in the "movement for retaking our students", the implementation of the three patriotic tasks, etc. with the main emphasis put on defending the lives and safety of the Korean students in Japan. The reporter set it as the main tasks of the 43rd term of the union to strengthen the activities of the branches, the basic organizations of the union, intensify the work for accomplishing the three patriotic tasks and bring about a turn in the guiding work. Then speeches were made. Citations were awarded at the conference after the publication of the results for "60-day campaign of the movement for retaking our students" waged last year for the expansion of the union members. Ri Hong Yun was reelected as chairperson of the Central Standing Committee of the union at the conference. Rodong Sinmun

title: Last Year's Socialist Emulation in Agricultural Sector Reviewed
body: A meeting for reviewing a socialist emulation drive for boosting grain production and improving livestock farming in 2021 was held through video-conferencing on March 10. It was attended by Ju Chol Gyu, vice-premier of the Cabinet and chairman of the Agricultural Commission, Ri Tu Song, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials concerned and those from the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea and the units involved in the drive. Han Jong Hyok, chairman of the Central Committee of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea, made a report. Then the standings of the drive were announced. Citations in the joint name of the Central Committee of the WPK, the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK and the DPRK Cabinet and rotating silk banners were conferred on Pyongyang City and the Toksong Cooperative Farm in Anak County of South Hwanghae Province respectively. They took the first place respectively in a competition for increased production among provinces and in a competition among farms with production plans of over 10 000 tons of grain. Citations in the joint name of the Central Committee of the WPK and the DPRK Cabinet and rotating silk banners went to the Oguk Cooperative Farm in Anak County of South Hwanghae Province for winning the competition among model co-op farms, and to North Phyongan Province, the Hungju Chicken Farm and the Kanggye Pig Farm for ranking first in competitions for improving poultry and pig farming. In addition, the Cholsan County Irrigation Management Station and the Anak County Farm Machine Station were awarded citations of the Central Committee of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea and rotating silk banners. They distinguished themselves in the competitions among irrigation management stations and among farm machine stations. The outline for a socialist emulation for 2022 was read out. Rodong Sinmun

title: Vice-Chairman of SPA Standing Committee Meets Syrian Ambassador
body: Kang Yun Sok, vice-chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, had a talk with Syrian Ambassador to the DPRK Tammam Sulaiman who paid a farewell call on him at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Thursday. Present there were Yun Jong Ho, minister of External Economic Relations and chairman of the DPRK-Syria Friendship Association, officials concerned and staff members of the Syrian embassy. Prior to it, Foreign Minister Ri Son Gwon met the outgoing Syrian ambassador. On the same day, Order of DPRK Friendship Second Class was conferred on the ambassador. Rodong Sinmun

title: In Order to Put Vegetable Production on Scientific Basis
body: In hearty response to the idea and spirit of the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea, scientists of the Pyongyang Vegetable Science Institute under the Academy of Agricultural Science channel efforts into research for breeding new tasty and nutritive species with high productivity. After setting high goal to breed dozens of new species in the period of the five-year plan, officials and scientists of the institute put spurs to breeding species, which can ensure high and stable crop, and high-yield species conducive to intensification of greenhouse vegetable production despite bad conditions. And they direct efforts to the work for cultivating tasty and nutritious functional vegetable species. Amid the brisk campaign for putting the vegetable production on a higher scientific and intensive basis, the work is being accelerated to develop tens of new technologies and products including research for completing effective irrigation method and scientific growing method of young rice-plants. Meanwhile, the institute pays due attentions to the work for quickly introducing already cultivated high-yield species into reality and proving their worth. Deeply bearing in minds the task assigned to them in providing the people with fresh vegetables, scientists of the institute make positive contribution to settling the sci-tech problems arising in the construction of the Ryonpho Greenhouse Farm and preparations for its management. Rodong Sinmun

title: Director of Int'l Department of C.C., WPK Meets Syrian Ambassador
body: Kim Song Nam, director of the International Department of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, had a talk with Syrian Ambassador to the DPRK Tammam Sulaiman who paid a farewell call on him at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Thursday. Present there were officials of the International Department of the C.C., WPK and staff members of the Syrian embassy. Rodong Sinmun

title: Spring Wheat and Barley Sowing Promoted in DPRK
body: Spring wheat and barley sowing is under way in the DPRK at the final stage. Agricultural workers in Pyongyang City finished spring wheat and barley sowing till March 5. Sadong, Ryokpho and Taesong districts and Kangnam County secured high-yielding seeds with short growth term and carried out daily plans by more than 1.5 times. Agricultural workers of South Hwanghae Province rounded off the sowing in the province by making thoroughgoing preparations and concentrating efforts on increasing the fertility of soil suited to the expansion of wheat and barley cultivation areas. Those of Nampho and Kaesong cities have recorded good results every day by observing sci-tech regulations and farms in North and South Phyongan provinces mobilized manpower and means to round off the sowing. Agricultural workers of North Hwanghae and Kangwon provinces, too, have fulfilled daily plans without fail in order to qualitatively complete wheat and barley sowing in time. Rodong Sinmun

title: Giving Highest and Absolute Priority to People’s Interests and Comfort
body: Drawing He Made in Person One day the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un inspected the water park of the Rungna People’s Pleasure Park under construction. At the dressing room he told officials that the area of the room was too large and there would be much space in the center even after taking in dressing boxes. He looked around every corner of the room and added that dressing rooms must have benches to help the people put on their socks. Then he took a pen and notebook and drew in person a picture of the bench with coat hangers. And he said that on such benches the people could put on their socks and hang their clothes on the hangers and it would be convenient for the people while raising the rate of area utilization. The officials were moved by his warm care for the people and deeply grasped in their minds the precious iron will that every work for people must be done perfectly and no efforts should be spared for it. The Right of Enjoyment One September day the respected General Secretary visited the Thongil Street Fitness Centre nearing its completion. Making rounds of the physical exercise rooms for health on the 1st and 2nd floors he gave detailed instructions on distribution of apparatuses and use projects. He said that the center should help people positively apply scientific methods of using apparatuses according to the instructions of experts and rationally distribute the apparatuses. Learning in detail about the features and efficiency of the physical exercise and treatment apparatuses at every room, he earnestly instructed to make the fitness center play active role in contributing to promotion of people’s health and improvement of their life by running the center in a well-planned way with good service. That day emphasizing that our people, the creators of mental and material wealth, must enjoy the civilized life preferentially, he warmly called for operating the center well so that the happy laughter of the people may be heard from the center. Only the great fatherly leader who devotes himself to the people with the ardent love for them can give such precious instructions. Rodong Sinmun

title: University Graduates Volunteer to Be Teachers of Mountain Schools and Branch Schools
body: More than ten graduates of Chongjin O Jung Hup University of Education in the DPRK volunteered to be teachers of schools in Samjiyon City of Ryanggang Province, North Hamgyong Province and Rason City. The graduates from the Environment Science Faculty of the university vowed to become teachers of remote branch schools in Samjiyon City. One of those graduates volunteered to become a teacher of a school in a Jungphyong Vegetable Greenhouse Farm village with the resolution to repay the deep care shown by the country that let him be schooled at orphanage and primary and middle schools for orphans. The discharged-soldier Party-member graduates from the faculties of Korean linguistics, history and mathematics have decided to be teachers of mountain schools and branch schools in Hoeryong City and Kyongsong, Kyonghung, Musan, Kilju, Orang and Onsong counties. A graduate of the Faculty of Physics has vowed to be a teacher of a mountain school in Rason City. A meeting to congratulate them took place at the university on Mar. 11. The volunteer certificate was awarded to them and then congratulatory and resolution speeches were made. After the meeting the graduates appreciated a congratulatory performance and planted fir tree on the campus. Rodong Sinmun

title: Choe Ryong Hae Inspects Various Units in Pyongyang
body: Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, learned about the production at various units in Pyongyang City and the state of the legal affairs on the spots. At the Mangyongdae Vegetable Farm in Mangyongdae District, the Pyongyang Electronic Medical Appliances Factory and the Pyongyang Paint Factory, he encouraged their officials and workers striving to glorify this meaningful year as a year of great revolutionary auspicious events and fresh victory, true to the decisions of the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee. He stressed the need to vigorously carry out the three revolutions in the countryside for implementing the new socialist rural construction programme of the Party and meticulously organize the immediate spring farming work so as to make a breakthrough in attaining the grain and vegetable production goals for this year. And he called for producing many medical appliances conducive to improving the quality of medical service for the people, mindful of the Party Central Committee's noble intention to turn our public health into the most popular and advanced one, and for stepping up the modernization of the paint production process. He said that the relevant units should enhance the role of explainers of judicial affairs and conduct various forms and ways of education in law observance so as to make the masses know well the laws and regulations of the state and voluntarily abide by them. Meanwhile, he learned about the state of judicial affairs of the Mangyongdae District People's Committee and mentioned the measures for establishing the revolutionary law-observance traits by thoroughly applying the people-first principle in the organization and guidance over the law observance and enhancing the role of the socialist law-observance guidance committee. Rodong Sinmun

title: In Order to Bring Happiness to People
body: What He Paid Deep Attention to One day in October Juche 108(2019) the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un inspected the Myohyangsan Medical Appliances Factory under reconstruction. In August in the previous year he had visited the factory and given precious instructions to remodel the factory, of which President Kim Il Sung had appointed the site in person, into a model one which plays the leading role in medical appliances industry. Looking around the factory he expressed satisfaction at the fact that the factory changed its look fundamentally. And he put into operation trial medical apparatuses produced by the factory and learned in detail about their performances. After learning about a consulting bed and dentist’s unit he pointed out that their sponge seemed a little hard and tough and kindly said that they should be soft as patients would put their heads on them for a long time when they were treated. He noted that it was important to produce lots of medical apparatuses vital for protecting and promoting the people’s life but they had to be of high quality, above all, saying in earnest tone that it was precisely an issue related to the outlook on the people. Factory He Visited Out of Ardent Love In July Juche 109(2020) the respected General Secretary visited the Kwangchon Chicken Farm under construction. The Kwangchon Chicken Farm being built to be a model in the poultry field should be standard in terms of its structure, to say nothing of equipment, he said, calling for building it at the maximum level to meet the scientific and technological needs. Saying that the Party was going to send a full set of the most advanced poultry equipment with the highest level of modernity, automation and intensification to the Kwangchon Chicken Farm, he repeatedly stressed the need to thoroughly ensure the quality of the construction to suit to the modern equipment. Looking at officials from one to another he earnestly said that the construction of the chicken farm was what the Party had planned and put lots of efforts to from a long time ago, and the Party expected it to make significant contributions to the dietary life of our people, to which the Party pays deep attention. The officials were impressed again by his noble world of love for the people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Traces Adorned with Love and Trust
body: What He Repeatedly Emphasized In June, Juche 102(2013) the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex. He dropped by at a storehouse of goods of the fertilizer forwarding shop. He told officials that the agricultural front was the main thrust of socialist economic construction and that the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex was an arsenal that supplies munitions to the socialist agricultural front. Fertilizer in agricultural production is as important as munitions in a war, he added. His meaningful words reflected his great expectation for and trust in the officials and working class of the complex hoping that they would play an active part in bolstering up the country’s agricultural production by producing more fertilizer, bearing deep in their minds the importance of their duty. That day he emphasized again that the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex was the arsenal for the socialist agricultural front-the leading arsenal for defending socialism. Officials of the complex were resolved to firmly defend the leading arsenal true to the noble intention of the respected General Secretary. Adding Luster to the Feats Performed by Youths One September day in Juche 104(2015), the respected General Secretary gave field guidance to the construction site of the Paektusan Hero Youth Power Station near completion. Looking round the construction site he expressed great satisfaction at the fact that the youth shock-brigade members fulfilled the construction task which was more enormous than they did during the last ten years only in a little over four months thus completing the dam project of Power Station No. 1 on the occasion of August 28, the Youth Day. And he highly praised that a fresh miracle was created in the worksites of Mt. Paektu. As a matter of fact, the respected General Secretary had inspected the construction site in April that year, acquainted himself in detail with the state of the construction and specified tasks and ways for finishing the construction by the 70th founding anniversary of the Workers’ Party of Korea (WPK). At the time he had also taken measures for materials supply and seen to it that powerful construction forces of the Korean People’s Army were dispatched to the construction site. Indeed, the successes were unthinkable apart from his energetic leadership. Then he looked round the education room under construction. Stressing that the feats performed by the young people in the construction of the power station were the precious treasure to be specially recorded in the WPK’s history and handed down to posterity, he named the room the Exhibition of Feats of Paektusan Heroic Young People. This was manifestation of his great and deep love for and trust in the youths and of his will to add eternal shine to the heroic feats performed by them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Production of Primary School Textbooks Finished
body: The Educational Books Printing Plant has finished the production of textbooks for new pupils of primary schools. Technicians and skilled workers of the plant made auxiliary materials for the printing by themselves, thus laying a firm guarantee for increasing production. Shops of the plant successfully fulfilled their daily plans by ensuring that all production lines are dovetailed with each other. Supplying units contributed to production by ensuring smooth supply of materials. Rodong Sinmun

title: Precious Teachings to Deeply Keep in Mind
body: With a Firm Standpoint In October Juche 104(2015), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un inspected the Pyongyang Catfish Farm. During his tour of the farm, the respected General Secretary laid a special emphasis on the issue of sprucing up units associated with guidance exploits of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and putting them forward as models. Noting that to spruce up units associated with guidance exploits of the great leaders is an undertaking for defending the prestige of the President and the Chairman, he went on like this: Officials should actively help those units and put them forward with a firm standpoint to add glory to the guidance exploits of the President and the Chairman and let the units become standard-bearers and models in the struggle to build an economic power and improve the people’s living standard. His words were a precious teaching to be held fast to in defending the great leaders’ guidance exploits and adding eternal luster to them. Touch People’s Heartstrings The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un sent a letter to the participants in the Fourth Conference of Forerunners of the Three-Revolution Red Flag Movement on November 20, Juche 104(2015). In the letter he stressed the need for Party organizations to direct efforts to conducting ideological work in a fresh and lively way in conformity with their units’ characteristics and actualities. He continued that education bases like the rooms for the education in the revolutionary history and rooms dedicated to the history of the units must be nicely arranged and education through them be conducted properly to enable the officials, Party members and other working people to become well versed in the guidance exploits of the great leaders and the Party associated with their sectors and units and to learn from the excellent examples of the revolutionary forerunners who remained faithful to the Party and the leader. In this way, they can display patriotic loyalty in implementing the Party’s ideas and defending the Party’s policies, regarding their units as the courtyard of the Party Central Committee and always having a heart-to-heart talk with the Party, he noted. He went on to underline the importance of conducting ideological education and agitprop work in keeping with the employees’ occupational characteristics and readiness and of touching the people’s heartstrings through frontline-style political work on worksites. His precious words still teach the officials what must be given top priority in educating and rousing the masses. Valuable Treasures to Be Handed Down through Generations In March, Juche 106(2017), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited the Korean Revolution Museum which was remodeled with splendor as the immense edifice for the education in revolutionary tradition and a national treasure house. Learning in detail about the remodeling of the museum, he said that to remodel and open the museum at a time when one generation of the revolution was replaced by another was of mighty historic importance in carrying forward the bloodline of our revolution and that it was a powerful demonstration of how much importance our Party attached to education in revolutionary tradition. That day, the respected General Secretary stressed that now that the Korean Revolution Museum had been splendidly remodeled, it had to be run properly, that preservation of the revolutionary relics was more important than anything else, and that the revolutionary relics preserved and displayed at the Korean Revolution Museum were the most valuable treasures to be handed down through generations. The most valuable treasures to be handed down through generations! His instructions that day were a priceless guideline to be kept in hearts of officials and employees of all the units associated with guidance exploits of the great leaders, and all other people across the country as well as those in the field of preservation of revolutionary relics. Rodong Sinmun

title: Regarding It as Treasure House of Self-reliance and Self-development
body: In January Juche 107(2018), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un inspected the State Academy of Sciences. That day, he looked round the newly remodeled revolutionary museum and dropped in at the Exhibition of Scientific Research Successes. On display there were a great deal of scientific research achievements and exhibits. Looking around the officials with eyes full of trust, he said that the tour of the exhibition encouraged him so much and that it was a treasure house of self-reliance and self-development and the academy was the birthplace of self-reliance and self-development. He went on saying that the academy must serve as the birthplace of self-reliance and self-development in the future, too, and play an important role in building up our own strength in order to carve out our own future and carry out revolution and construction by our own efforts. That day, he posed for a souvenir photo for the officials and scientists of the academy to hand it down through generations. The venue of the photo session was brimming with the stormy cheers of hurrah for the respected General Secretary, the benevolent teacher and great father who takes care of every scientist. Indeed, our scientists are the happiest and most proud people treasured by the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Premier Inspects Industrial Establishments
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and premier of the Cabinet, made a field survey of the Huichon Precision Machine Plant and the February 8 Jikdong Youth Coal Mine. At the Huichon Precision Machine Plant, the premier called on its officials and workers to display high creativity and stubborn traits in the struggle for implementing the decisions of the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th WPK Central Committee, well aware of the importance of the plant's duty in developing the country's machine industry. Going round the Fuel Pump Branch Factory and other places of the plant associated with the leadership feats of the Party, he stressed the need to step up the modernization of equipment in keeping with the world development trend in the machine industry and the country's specific conditions and further raise the quality of products and productivity. At underground cutting face of the February 8 Jikdong Youth Coal Mine, the premier encouraged the coalminers in a production drive to supply enough coal to major socialist construction fronts busy with the campaign for implementing the five-year plan. And he called for steady growth of production by giving precedence to prospecting and tunneling to secure more spare cutting faces and improving the carriage capability. The field consultative meetings discussed the matters of providing materials needed for the production of accessory parts of vehicles, further enhancing the quality of steel and precision of processing, laying solid material and technical foundation of the coal mine and conducting the production and management in an innovative way. Rodong Sinmun

title: Brisk Work for Consolidating Production Foundation of Dairy Products in Cities and Counties
body: Cities and counties apply themselves to consolidating the production foundation of dairy products. The Cabinet sees to it that ministries and national institutions decide the number of goats and area of pastures according to the amount of milk needed for children in relevant areas and locate the goat farms to be newly built. Meanwhile, officials of ministries and national institutions make scrupulous preparations to lay out excellent bases of dairy products. Several ministries and national institutions have already dispatched officials to the fields, grasped the number of children in relevant areas and accordingly decided the number of goats needed. Materials needed for the construction of goat farms are supplied properly as well. Efforts are also made to build the milk powder production line on a modern footing. The layout of milk powder production equipment completed by Pyongyang Han Tok Su University of Light Industry was distributed to all the provinces not long ago. Officials of several ministries and national institutions have gone out to cities and counties in their charge. At present, they, in close contact with officials in relevant areas, are studying the layout and discussing the measures for defining the production capacity in line with the local conditions and for sufficiently providing necessary materials and equipment. The Ministry of Food Industry sent the recently manufactured milk powder production equipment to Kimhwa County a few days ago. Officials of ministries and national institutions grow ever keener in their enthusiasm to make actual contributions to implementing the Party’s childcare policy. Rodong Sinmun

title: With Affection and Pride of Their Job
body: The road keepers of Road Administration Office of Phyongchon District are adorning streets of the capital city Pyongyang beautifully with affection and pride in their job. Our life is full of joy and laughter, thanks to them who devote themselves to people’s happiness, rain or shine, whether they are recognized or not and whether they are appreciated or not. Actually, they are unassuming patriots. Rodong Sinmun

title: "Complete Collection of Kim Il Sung's Works" Published
body: The Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House brought out Vol. 18 (enlarged edition) of "Complete Collection of Kim Il Sung's Works", a library of the immortal Juche idea dealing with President Kim Il Sung's works systematically and comprehensively in chronological order. Contained in the book are 119 works such as historic speeches, talks and orders made by the President in the period from October Juche 39 (1950) to February Juche 40 (1951). Kim Il Sung in his works scientifically analyzed the prevailing political situation of the country and the current state of the People's Army and stressed the need to strengthen the Party's leading role within the army and further intensify the political education among servicepersons. He set forth the strategic tasks for turning newly-formed units into the ones with powerful combat capability in a short span of time, forming the second front to conduct a harassment operation behind enemy lines and hastening the final victory in the Fatherland Liberation War by continuously expanding the battle results. Some of the works deal with the ideas of preparing for the postwar reconstruction, including a measure for training technicians needed for it, and of constructing the cities befitting to the reality of the country and the national characteristics. They also indicate the tasks and ways for successfully ensuring the wartime broadcast, newspapers and communication and making the cultural propaganda contribute to the victory in the war. Besides, there are works giving clear-cut answers to such theoretical and practical issues arising in hastening the victory in the Fatherland Liberation War as the matters of stabilizing and improving the people's livelihood in the wartime and fulfilling the wartime production tasks without fail. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Inspects Construction Site of 10 000 Flats in Songsin and Songhwa Areas Nearing Completion
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected the construction site of 10 000 flats in the Songsin and Songhwa areas nearing completion. Accompanying him were Jo Yong Won, member of the Presidium of Political Bureau and secretary for Organizational Affairs of the Central Committee of the WPK, Ri Il Hwan and O Su Yong, secretaries of the WPK Central Committee, and vice department directors of the WPK Central Committee. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un was greeted on the spot by Kim Jong Gwan, first vice-minister of National Defence, Pak Hun, vice-premier of the Cabinet, leading officials of designing institutions at all levels and leading officials of the construction units which took part in the construction of the 10 000 flats. Nearing completion is the housing construction of 10 000 flats for the first year which has been underway in the Songsin and Songhwa areas under the grand five-year plan for capital city construction set forth at the 8th Party Congress pursuant to the far-sighted policy of our Party on developing the Juche-oriented architecture. In a brief span of just one year a world-startling miracle has been made in the construction thanks to the high political enthusiasm and efforts of the builders who turned out as one with a single mind to perform labor feats for adding luster to the great era of Kim Jong Un with pure patriotism and conscience to take responsibility for the safety of the project and guarantee its absolute quality for all eternity, true to the idea and intention of the Party Central Committee. Therefore, Pyongyang has been further spruced up as the center of Juche idea, Juche-oriented culture and our-style civilization and a great city in which the ideal of the people comes true. In the Songsin and Songhwa areas covering 56 hectares, skyscraping and high-rising apartments of various styles including the eighty-storied one of modern and distinctive shape, and public health, education and service facilities have been laid out conveniently plus several parks, overhead bridges and decorative structures of peculiar styles, all in good combination with residential districts. The project was part of the plan for 2021, the first year of the five-year plan for capital city construction set forth at the 8th Party Congress. The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un made a round of different places of the construction site to learn in detail about the actual state of the construction. He expressed satisfaction over the spectacular view of the street, saying that the Party's idea on architectural beauty calling for thoroughly embodying the Juche character, national identity and modernity has correctly been carried out. He noted with pleasure that the architecture of the country has developed onto a higher plane through the construction of 10 000 flats in the first year for implementing the five-year plan of capital city construction set forth at the Party Congress. He stressed the need to take active measures for steadily building up the construction forces on a nationwide scale and accelerating the construction speed while continuously expanding the achievements through positive popularization of the precious experience and exquisite principles gained in the huge-scale construction through which great changes were made and new edifices risen up. He said with pride that it is an obvious show of justness of our Party's idea on architectural beauty, potentiality of the Juche-based self-supporting economy and invincibility of the single-minded unity of our Party and the masses that we have successfully built 10 000 modern flats by our own efforts in a short span of time. Highly appreciating again the efforts made by the builders to ensure a high level of the design and construction of houses, he extended warm gratitude on behalf of the Party and government to all the builders for contributing to opening up a new phase of the capital city construction and demonstrating the development of the capital city to the whole world. He said with great satisfaction that we would shortly see the people cutting a ribbon themselves and moving into new houses and that his another wish would come true, calling for the perfect completion of the housing construction by the Day of the Sun (birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung). He advanced the important tasks that would serve as guidelines for more grandiosely and splendidly sprucing up the capital city as befits the political, economical and cultural centre of the powerful socialist country. He said that core in the capital city construction is to spruce up the capital city as the heart of the country and the city of the people with its own distinct characteristics by preserving the Juche character and national identity on the people-first principle. He called on designing institutions at all levels to properly do street and block layout and design of roads by giving precedence to natural and geographical conditions and the convenience of citizens so as to keep abreast of modern development trend. It is also necessary to attach importance to the artistic combination of various diversified buildings and take into full account the modernity of all elements, in particular, he said. He also stressed the importance to make effective use of decorations of buildings with visual devices to be congenial to political, ideological and cultural sentiments and to rationally arrange educational, public health, sports, cultural and welfare establishments and commercial and public catering establishments on the principle of maintaining popular character and modernity. He underlined the need for the construction field to keep paying deep attention to creating cultured environment such as urban afforestation with a main stress put on the improvement of city's ecological environment. Upon the field guidance of the respected General Secretary, all the officials and builders were filled with the determination to become great creators and pioneers of the new Pyongyang speed and construction myth in sky-high spirits. They vowed to devote themselves to the prosperity of the great capital city and the country, true to the inspiring call of the Party Central Committee for a fresh struggle and a fresh victory in creating the socialist civilization, bearing deep in their hearts the immutable faith that they are sure to win victory as long as they are led by the respected General Secretary and that when the Party is determined, we can do anything. Political News Team

title: In Days of Unfolding Blueprint of Prosperity
body: Anxious Lest There Is Any Shortcoming In April Juche 103(2014), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited the Songdowon International Children’s Camp where its remodeling project was near completion. When he was going to the newly-built outdoor playground, officials requested him to go there by car. However he walked at the head saying that he would not take the car in such a good place. When he reached the outdoor playground he enjoyed its panoramic view delightfully expressing his satisfaction at the fact that its blue pent roof tasted of the seaside camp. He added that synthetic grass, spectators’ seats and wave-style blue roof of the playground were in good harmony. Officials could not repress their surging emotion to recall the tireless efforts of the respected General Secretary made to remodel the Songdowon International Children’s Camp into the best palace of children in the world. Later the respected General Secretary personally put forward the proposal to organize children’s football match at the inaugural ceremony of the camp. And he instructed to install a floodlight tower to help children play football at night and corrected the color of the runway. Thus the Songdowon International Children’s Camp was remodeled into the palace of children thanks to the benevolent care of the respected General Secretary. To Beat the World In July Juche 101(2012), the respected General Secretary visited the Rungna People’s Pleasure Park just before the start of operation. When he reached the wading pool he examined the temperature of the water with his hand. And looking around every corner of the water park he gave detailed instructions for completion such as the shape of douche site and its volume of water. He also recollected with deep emotion the fact that he had directed designing the shape of diving board after studying scores of diving board photos. After a while he emphasized that we should build every creature to beat the world, not approximately. He added that what was important in building world-level architecture was to do so not only in style but also in its every content. Indeed under the leadership of the respected General Secretary, the great master of creation, world-startling monumental edifices are being erected like mushrooms after rain across the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Brisk Teaching Preparations for New School Year
body: Schools of common education sector put big efforts into teaching preparations for new school year with high enthusiasm for realizing our Party’s noble will to develop our education into the most advanced and ideal one for the future. The Education Commission clearly drew up the plan to make the teaching preparations for new school year run through with the work to carry out our Party’s educational policy and properly organize the work for it. In particular, it gives special attention to preparations for the start of schools such as the work for preparing teachers of specialized subjects at relevant schools and the work for equipping practical training rooms with enough experimental apparatus and materials in connection with newly setting up higher technical middle schools this year. It also lets all teachers improve their educational and practical qualifications and scrupulously makes their preparations for teaching by organizing teaching courses according to schools and subjects for implementing teaching program of new school year and the courses for raising qualifications to teach knowledge for improving biological environment and general basic knowledge about recycle. Brisk teaching preparations for new school year are being made at schools in the sector of common education. They arouse their enthusiasm for working out teaching plans, stressing on maintaining the political and ideological principles, scientific accuracy and effectiveness in contents of education and for steadily creating and introducing new teaching methods. Then they effectively accelerate the work for improving educational conditions and environment in close combination with the teaching preparations for new school year. Rodong Sinmun

title: Unforgettable Story about His Devotion to People
body: Appraisal That He Made with Pleasure One October day in Juche 103(2014), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited the completed Yonphung Scientists Holiday Camp. He expressed his satisfaction at the Yonphung Scientists Holiday Camp noting that it looked like a piece of picture when he feasted his eyes on the general view of the camp on board and that he was very pleasant to see the picturesque camp. And then he earnestly asked officials of the camp to manage it well on a regular basis so that scientists and technicians might enjoy to the full the benefit granted by the Workers’ Party of Korea. Dropping in at the souvenir stand of the general service centre, he taught that it would be good to equip stand with facility for photographic development so as to use as place for developing photos taken by vacationers. That day, he said that he had promised scientists to build the Wisong Scientists Residential District and Yonphung Scientists Holiday Camp visiting the State Academy of Sciences at the beginning of the year, noting with pleasure that the camp was likely to pass from them. Indeed, the Yonphung Scientists Holiday Camp is the happy house for scientists without an equal in the world built under the warm care of the respected General Secretary. Construction Site Visited on Midsummer Day The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited the construction site of the Mirim Riding Club one August day in Juche 102(2013). That day was muggy but he looked round the construction site for a long time despite sultriness. Guiding the building work on racing track at outdoor riding-drill ground, he assigned a task to remove the dust in the racing track including earth-sand track, and he taught one by one to frequently cut turf laid on lawn track and to plant turf in the racing track after hardening the track. And he gave detailed instructions on the issues as newly building health recovery hall helpful to relieving the fatigue after riding drill, with veterinary hospital and a breeding institute. Thanks to the respected General Secretary’s warm love for people, the Mirim Riding Club was successfully built as a base for people's cultural and emotional life. Rodong Sinmun

title: Symposium and Experience-sharing Meeting on Dry-field Rice Cultivation Technology
body: A national symposium and experience-sharing meeting on high-yielding dry-field rice cultivation technology took place at the Academy of Agricultural Science of the DPRK on Tuesday and Wednesday, under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea. The symposium and experience-sharing meeting was aimed to generalize the sci-tech successes and experience gained in cultivating high-yielding dry-field rice in the past, true to the Party's policy on increasing the grain production in a stable and sustained way while overcoming the effect of unfavorable weather conditions. Attending it through video-conferencing were scientists, technicians, teachers, researchers and field officials from more than 30 units, including the Academy of Agricultural Science and Kanggye University of Agriculture and Forestry. What drew the attention of its participants and jury were treatises and cultivation technologies, completed through repeated study and pursuit and earnest efforts out of the burning desire to vigorously lead the struggle for implementing the Party's policy on agricultural revolution by dint of science and technology. Highly appraised were treatises and experience that help increase the per-hectare yield by breeding new seeds suited to the topographical characteristics, enhancing the drought resistance of dry-field rice and minimizing the damage from cold and humidity. Rodong Sinmun

title: Technical Workshop for Sowing Held
body: A national technical workshop on sowing was held at the Oryong Cooperative Farm in Mundok County on 10th of March. Attending the workshop were officials of the Cabinet and the Agricultural Commission, chairpersons of provincial rural economy committees and other officials of the agricultural sector. The workshop stressed the need to regard it as the main link to take thorough agriculture-technical measures for each farming process in consideration of the agro-meteorological conditions of this year. It also referred to the issue of sowing rice seeds in rice nurseries and seeds of dry crops in fields on scientific and technological basis. In addition, it emphasized the issues of plowing fields in time qualitatively and taking thorough measures to exterminate noxious insects in spring. The workshop constituted an important occasion for inspiring agricultural officials across the country to fulfill their duty in the drive for increased grain production. Rodong Sinmun

title: By Teaching Principles of Self-Reliance
body: Meaning of His Priceless Appreciation In June, Juche 105(2016), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un inspected the remodeled Pyongyang Cornstarch Factory despite the rainy weather. Making rounds of the factory, he learnt in detail about its modernization and production and dropped in at the newly-arranged general analysis room. He looked around the equipment full of satisfaction and said that the general analysis room alone showed that the factory was a model of the country and that it was praiseworthy that most of the factory’s new analysis equipment had been domestically produced. Presently, he said that it is our Party’s idea and intention for factories to locally produce not only production equipment but also analysis equipment and the like. That day, the respected General Secretary praised time and again that the factory was a model that held high the banner of making the industry Juche-oriented, a worthy standard in the creation campaign of self-reliance and self-development and a textbook example of modernization. His priceless appreciation that day bears his noble intention to make progress of our own style by our own efforts and wisdom in doing everything. Promise He Made with Delight In May Juche 108(2019), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un gave field guidance to the Kumyagang Power Station No.2. It is admirable that Kumya County is set to build power stations by its own efforts and put the power production on a normal footing in hearty response to the Party’s policy on building minor hydraulic power stations suited to the specific local conditions and settling the power problem, he said, speaking highly of the praiseworthy feats performed by the people in the county who created the treasure of national value in the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance and fortitude. An official informed him of the fact that the power station, which had been built in tiers with the Kumyagang Army-people Power Station, was fed by the normally-produced waste water from the army-people power station and waters running from several valleys, which meant that it would produce electricity on a normal footing without being influenced by weather conditions even in severe drought. The respected General Secretary said that it was laudable of them to have built a power station of suitable size in a rational way based on the proper calculation of how to effectively utilize water resources. Noting that he would feel relieved only when he did something to help the people in Kumya County who had done a great job without being known to others, he promised to send a generator and transformers without fail, which had not yet been installed at the power station, on his own responsibility. This promise was as good as another valuable appreciation of the officials and workers in Kumya County who strove to better the economic life of their county with perseverance and devoted efforts. It was also a manifestation of his great expectations for them to display the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance and further transform their county into a socialist paradise where people’s dreams and ideals come into reality. Rodong Sinmun

title: Premier Kim Tok Hun Inspects Several Sectors
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, inspected several sectors. He visited the Phyongsong Artificial Leather Factory, where he called on the officials and employees to fulfill their responsibility and duty in implementing the decisions made at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the WPK, well aware of the importance of the factory's mission in the development of the light industry of the country. Priority should be given to solving the scientific and technological problems for improving the quality of products and the management and operation of the overall production process be put on a higher scientific level to produce more quality synthetic leather, he said. At the Central Industrial Art Bureau, the premier called for creating exquisite designs of practical value needed by various sectors of the national economy, true to the Party's intention for the industrial art to perform the scouting party mission in accelerating the economic development and improving the standard of people's living. He also visited the Central Light Industrial Sample Exhibition. There he stressed the need for the officials to work under a well thought-out plan with an innovative goal to produce famous goods truly contributing to the betterment of people's living. Consultative meetings held in fields pressed for measures after discussing the issue of consolidating the material and technological foundation for synthetic leather production and steadily increasing its production, the issue of constantly improving industrial art works to meet the developing trend and people's favor and the issue for consumer goods production units to conduct the competitive development of new products and further raise their quality. Earlier, the premier learned about greening in Pothong riverside area and Pipha Street. Rodong Sinmun

title: Number of Young Volunteers Grows in Capital City of DPRK
body: More youths in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, volunteered to work in Samjiyon City, the sacred place of the Korean revolution, and socialist cooperative farms. Han Kyong Nam, a worker of the Foreign Languages Publishing House, and Jong Chol, a worker of the Kyonghung Trading Bureau, volunteered to work in Samjiyon City. Kang Phyong Chol, a worker of the Hwaebul Sports Team, volunteered to work at the Oguk Co-op Farm in Anak County. Meetings were held at the relevant units to congratulate the volunteers. They were sent off by officials and young people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Boundlessly Noble Loyalty
body: One day in June some years ago, the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited the Terminal of Pyongyang International Airport which is nearing its completion. Looking down the Paekho (white tiger) pattern on the floor of its hall, he praised that the soldier-builders delicately depicted it well. And he appreciated their efforts visiting various places of the terminal including the photograph service stand. After going round the inner part of the terminal for a long time, he looked out the area of Pyongyang International Airport, which radically changed its appearance, for a long while. And he said that it was an earnest behest of Chairman Kim Jong Il to turn Pyongyang International Airport into a modern one, recalling that the Chairman gave a series of instructions to reshape Pyongyang International Airport while seeing its miniatures even in the last moments of his life. He went on that he felt remorse at the failure to show Kim Jong Il the wonderful terminal. The Chairman would have been very glad to hear that the airport was wonderfully reshaped like this by our own efforts, he noted, adding that the Chairman’s smiling image was fresh in his memory. There are words that the respected General Secretary habitually say tearfully and ardently whenever he dealt with signal successes made on this land. Had our great leaders seen it, they would have been greatly pleased. It would have been very glad if our great leaders could have seen it. The shining history of immortalizing the great leaders is flowing solemnly thanks to the respected General Secretary who regards it as the worth of making revolution to translate the desire of great leaders into reality while burning his mind with ardent loyalty to the great leaders. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Birthday Greetings to Zhang Jin-quan, Son of Zhang Weihua
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un expressed warm wishes for Zhang Jin-quan, son of martyr Zhang Weihua, a Chinese related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, on his 90th birthday. He said that the laudable deeds of martyr Zhang Weihua who risked his life to defend President Kim Il Sung in the period of the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle are kept deep in the minds of the Korean people. He hoped that Zhang's family would further credit for generations the revolutionary spirit of the martyr whom our people can never forget, and wished his family members happiness in good health. His words of warm wishes were courteously conveyed to Zhang Jin-quan and his wife by the DPRK consul-general to Shenyang of China on Thursday. Zhang Jin-quan said that he takes it as his honor to receive the kind words from respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un. He asked for conveying his heart-felt gratitude to the General Secretary. He hoped that the DPRK would be powerful and prosperous and its people would enjoy happiness under the wise leadership of the General Secretary. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Presentation and Experience-sharing Meeting Held in DPRK
body: A national presentation and experience-sharing meeting on wheat and barley cultivation technology took place at the Academy of Agricultural Science of the DPRK on Thursday and Friday under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea. The presentation and experience-sharing meeting was aimed to increase the cultivation area and production of wheat and barley and generalize the sci-tech achievements and experience helpful to minimizing the damage by abnormal weather. Attending there through video-conferencing were scientists, technicians, teachers, researchers and field officials of 40-odd units including the Academy of Agricultural Science and Wonsan University of Agriculture. More than 70 pieces of treatises were presented after full discussion and good experience on rich harvest in wheat and barley farming was introduced. What drew attention of the participants and jury were treatises and experience conducive to increasing the output per hectare like breeding of high-yielding seeds suited to the geographical characteristics, selection of the right soil and the scientific and advanced cultivation technology. Discussed there were an issue arising in expanding the area under cultivation of wheat and barley and a scientific and technological methods for increasing the output per hectare. Rodong Sinmun

title: "Complete Collection of Kim Jong Il's Works" Vol. 43 Published
body: The Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House brought out Vol. 43 of "Complete Collection of Kim Jong Il's Works", a library of the immortal Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism carrying Chairman Kim Jong Il's works in chronological order and in a systematic and comprehensive way. The volume contains 42 works published by the Chairman in the period from August to December Juche 77 (1988). The works deal with the principled issues in firmly establishing the revolutionary outlook on the leader among the officials, improving the system and method of Party work and bringing about great innovations in all fields of socialist construction. Expounded in those works are the tasks and ways for scientists and technicians to achieve greater sci-tech successes with their redoubled efforts and put the country's machine industry on a world level. Also, dealt with are the principled issues arising in providing the Korean people with modern dwelling houses, further raising the level of civilization in the dressing of working people, developing the light industry and sprucing up the public catering establishments in a hygienic and cultured way to afford convenience in Pyongyang citizens' everyday life. Reflected in some of the works are the issues of properly embodying the Party's policy on inheriting and developing the national cultural heritage in opera and of establishing a proper system of guidance over the creative wok as required by the developing situation. There are also works giving clear-cut answers to the theoretical and practical issues arising in all fields of the revolution and construction. Rodong Sinmun

title: Green Forests Convey His Love for Country
body: His Precious Time Unsparingly Dedicated The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited an unit of the Korean People’s Army (KPA) on the Tree-planting Day some years ago. He brought with him various kinds of trees and planted them with fighter pilots of the unit, saying that the KPA should take the lead in afforestation for sure. After planting the trees he said to the fighter pilots that they should tend the trees well and trim them beautifully when they grew up and added with a bright smile that the surroundings would become more tasteful when the trees grew into a thick forest. When he was about to leave the unit, commanding officers and fighter pilots were surprised by the fact that he had already spent 3 hours with them planting trees. As a matter of fact they all knew how precious his time was. However he unsparingly dedicated his precious time to tree planting with them. They could feel his lofty patriotism. Display Ardent Patriotism One March day the respected General Secretary visited Mangyongdae Revolutionary School and planted trees with its students. Before planting trees, he said that patriotism was not merely an abstract concept but a noble spirit of valuing even a single tree in the motherland and devoting one’s sweat and sincerity to tending it and that the students would keep deep in their minds Kim Jong Il’s patriotism in the course of planting trees and tending them on their own. In a little while he added that the teachers should lead the students to devote their sincerity and enthusiasm to the tree-planting with extraordinary awareness that they should display their clean conscience and ardent patriotism before planting trees and with will to take good care of woodland even if their bodies may serve as roots and base manure. His words that day are pregnant with meaning that genuine patriotism is the love for even a single blade of grass and a single tree in the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Emergency Epidemic Prevention Campaign Intensified in DPRK
body: The emergency epidemic prevention campaign to block any inroad and spread of the malignant virus has been further intensified in the DPRK, in close combination with the work for maintaining sanitary environment in spring. Emergency anti-epidemic units at all levels have launched an intensive ideological and health education as well as the organizational work to turn the sanitary environment maintenance in spring into an important occasion for cementing the epidemic prevention walls. Officials, working people and other citizens of various sectors, units and regions are taking active part in the work to maintain sanitary environment in spring, as demanded by the emergency epidemic prevention campaign. They carefully disinfect their worksites and utensils and tools before getting down to daily work and take detailed measures to prevent any possible inroad of virus. Everyone regards it as the basic requirement of work and life to strictly abide by the anti-epidemic regulations, voluntarily observing the already-made rules of behavior like wearing mask, disinfecting hands and distancing for epidemic prevention at worksites and public places. The work for ensuring better living conditions and sanitary environment by clearing the remains of winter, renovating roads, pavements and other living spaces and the interior and exterior of buildings and dwelling houses is being pushed ahead in a planned way. Rodong Sinmun

title: Revolutionary Lecture Which Redoubles Faith in Certain Victory
body: Blood Vessels Linking Generations One January day in Juche 103(2014), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un inspected the Madusan Revolutionary Battle Site and gave precious instructions to further intensify education in revolutionary traditions. That day, he said that the brilliant revolutionary traditions created by President Kim Il Sung in the period of the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle were the strong roots of our Party and revolution and the blood vessels linking generations. He emphasized that our people and army could boldly surmount every manner of hardship unprecedented in history as we had staunchly conducted education in the revolutionary traditions. Strong roots of our Party and revolution and blood vessels linking generations! These words tell us the noble intention of the respected General Secretary to let all the Party members and working people, the rising generations in particular, be well aware of the historic roots of our revolution and thereby bring them up as successors to the revolution possessed of the indomitable faith. Thanks to the wise guidance of the respected General Secretary with an unshakable will to lead our Party and revolution along the road of victory and glory by successfully carrying forward the revolutionary traditions of Paektu created by the President during the anti-Japanese struggle. Pressing and Important Issue One day in March, Juche 106(2017), the respected General Secretary gave on-the-spot guidance to the remodeled Korean Revolution Museum. A visit to the Korean Revolution Museum helps one know well about the course covered by the Korean revolution in its development and clearly visualizes the path before us, he noted, stressing that the Korean Revolution Museum serves as the greatest treasure and textbook of the revolution. He went on to say that it is a very pressing and important issue to intensify education in the revolutionary traditions and that lifeline of revolution can be steadfastly maintained when this education is intensified at a time when one generation of revolution is replaced by another and young generations present themselves as pillars of revolution. That day, he said that it is an unshakable will of our Party to usher in the golden age of education in the revolutionary traditions. His meaningful instructions that day still teach tens of millions of people the precious truth that it is important for victory of our revolution to creditably carry forward great history and traditions and herein lies the path of invincibility. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Premier Inspects Various Sectors of South Hamgyong Province
