body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, inspected various sectors of South Hamgyong Province. Learning in detail about the production at the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex, the February 8 Vinalon Complex, the Ryongsong Machine Complex and the Hungnam Pharmaceutical Factory seething with the efforts for implementing the decisions made at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th WPK Central Committee, the premier stressed the need to step up the modernization of the production lines and attain without fail the major production goals they pledged to fulfill before the Party by waging a campaign for increasing production and creating new things. Looking around the Jongphyong County Foodstuff Factory, the Jongphyong Unha Garment Factory, the Kowon County Garment Factory and other factories, he called on their officials to boost the production of dairy products and school uniforms by dint of creative and enterprising work attitude and thus fully discharge their responsibility and duty in making sure that warm loving care of the Party reach the children and students without fail. He also acquainted himself with the state of growth of autumn wheat and barley and the preparations for farming at several co-op farms of the province before inspecting grain stores in Jongphyong and Kowon counties. The field consultative meetings discussed the measures to be taken to carry out the fertilizer production plan of the manuring year, enhance the accuracy of mechanical products manufacturing and implement the Party's childcare policy and other major policy tasks. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Floral Basket to General Secretary of C.C., LPRP
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, sent a floral basket to Thongloun Sisoulith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party (LPRP), on the occasion of its 67th founding anniversary. The DPRK ambassador to Laos courteously conveyed the floral basket bearing the august name of General Secretary of the WPK Kim Jong Un to the chairperson of the Committee for External Affairs of the LPRP who is member of its Central Committee. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Greetings to General Secretary of C.C., LPRP
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, sent a message of greeting to Thongloun Sisoulith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party (LPRP), on March 22. He in the message extended warm congratulations to the general secretary, the Central Committee and all members of the LPRP on the occasion of its 67th founding anniversary. The message noted that the LPRP has achieved great successes by leading the Lao people's struggle for national liberation and the building of an independent and prosperous new society for the past 67 years since its foundation. It expressed firm belief that under the energetic guidance of the general secretary, the LPRP would further develop the people's democratic system and victoriously advance socialist construction by braving all challenges and difficulties and attaining the struggle goals set at the 11th Congress of the LPRP without fail. Expressing conviction that the good, friendly and cooperative ties between the two parties would be given steady continuity as ever on the road for accomplishing the cause of socialism, the message sincerely wished the general secretary fresh success in his responsible work for the development of the LPRP. Rodong Sinmun

title: Centenarian Receives Birthday Spread in DPRK
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un sent a birthday spread to Han Yong Phae living in Jonsan-ri, Sangwon County of North Hwanghae Province on her 100th birthday. Han Yong Phae, born into a poor peasant family in the dark period of the Japanese imperialists' colonial rule over Korea, came to enjoy her true dignity and rights in a new country governed by its people after the national liberation. She distinguished herself in assisting the frontline soldiers during the hard-fought Fatherland Liberation War. She dedicated herself to farming for decades. She, still enjoying good health under the care of the Workers' Party, asks her children and grandchildren to fulfill their duty. Rodong Sinmun

title: Youth’s Enthusiasm for Building Up Capital City
body: More than 143 000 young people positively conducted the night-work support at the construction site of 10 000 flats in Songsin and Songhwa areas as a part of youth shock brigade activities. According to data available, from April last year to February this year, over 143 000 youths carried out their assigned tasks including removing 64 000 cubic meters of earth, conveying 11 000 cubic meters of sand and readjusting over 10 000 square meters of area, thus contributing to stepping up the construction of flats. Among them are 250-odd students of 17 universities including Kim Chaek University of Technology, Pyongyang University of Foreign Studies, Pyongyang Han Tok Su University of Light Industry, Kim Chol Ju University of Education and Pyongyang University of Fine Arts, and over 50 young people of 10-odd ministries and national institutions such as the Foreign Ministry and State Academy of Sciences. Rodong Sinmun

title: Story about His Devotion to People
body: Be Faithful Servants of People One September day in Juche 104(2015), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited a newly-built shop. Looking round the shop he gave precious instructions for smooth operation of the shop. He said that commercial servants’ service for the people had direct bearings on demonstrating the superiority of our socialist system and earnestly added that every servant should make devoted efforts to serve the people being conscious that they were faithful servants of them. Officials were moved by his words. Actually they had thought that the words "devoted efforts" could be only linked with the coal miners who dig coal out of cutting face, builders who build up monumental edifices and scientists who bend themselves to researches day and night with ambition to beat the world. However the respected General Secretary called on them, the ordinary commercial workers, to devote themselves to the people. That day he expressed his belief that the employees of the shop would fully display the spirit of devotedly serving the people, cherishing deep in mind the great leaders’ noble love for them. Calling Them Treasure of Country The respected General Secretary inspected the Rangnang Disabled Soldiers’ Essential Plastic Goods Factory in May Juche 106(2017). Shaking hands with its officials, he kindly asked them about the health of all the disabled soldiers and their troubles. He said that he came to the factory to encourage the disabled soldiers reliably serving at new posts for improving the people’s standard of living with patriotism which they displayed during military service. And he warmly said that there was nothing to spare for the disabled soldiers, treasure of the country, adding officials should take good care of their life so that they might work well in good health. The treasure of the country! Nothing to spare for them! Despite his fatigue piled up on the road of continuous field guidance, he bestowed inestimable love upon the disabled soldiers. Thus, his benevolence is the greatest one which cannot be compared to anything. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Reply Message from General Secretary of C.C., LPRP
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, received a reply message from Thongloun Sisoulith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party (LPRP) on Tuesday. The general secretary in the message expressed his heartfelt thanks on behalf of the Central Committee of the LPRP and on his own behalf to Kim Jong Un for sending warm congratulations of best wishes and a beautiful floral basket on the occasion of the 67th founding anniversary of the LPRP. The message expressed the belief that the fraternal Party, government and people of the DPRK would successfully carry out the decisions made at the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea and thus build a powerful socialist country and bring happiness to the Korean people under the bold and correct leadership of the WPK led by Kim Jong Un, successor to the great cause. It wished Kim Jong Un good health and happiness and success in his ennobling work. It hoped that the long-standing, friendly and cooperative relations between the two parties, two states and two peoples would further expand and develop in line with the substantial interests of the peoples of the two countries and in conformity with the peace, friendship and cooperation of the region and the world. Rodong Sinmun

title: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un Sends Message of Sympathy to General Secretary Xi Jinping of C.C., CPC
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a message of sympathy to Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC) and president of the People's Republic of China, on March 21. Kim Jong Un in the message expressed deep sympathy and condolences to Xi Jinping and the Chinese party, government and people as well as to the bereaved families of the victims, upon hearing the sad news that heavy casualties were claimed due to a passenger airliner crash in China. He sincerely hoped that the Chinese people would eradicate the aftereffects of the accident as early as possible and the bereaved family members would overcome sorrow and lead a stabilized life, under the leadership of the CPC with the general secretary as its core. Rodong Sinmun

title: Technical Course for Production of School Uniforms Held
body: Garment researchers and technicians in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, make a round of garment factories across the country to pass their techniques on. The 1st national technical short course for producing new type of school uniforms was held in Phyongsong City of South Phyongan Province on Feb. 3, which was followed by dispatch of the groups of researchers and technicians from the Garment Institute under the Academy of Light Industry and the Pyongyang Municipal Garment Industry Management Bureau to give the technical short courses to different local areas early in March. The technical short courses are underway at tens of city and county garment production units in provinces. Those garment researchers and technicians from Pyongyang are fully displaying their high responsibility and devotion for the successful technical short courses. They have discussed practical ways for increasing the quality of school uniforms while comparing pre-produced school uniforms with samples and given practical lectures while doing cutting and sewing in person. Officials of relevant units and technicians and workers of the garment factories are striving to increase the quality of school uniforms in concerted efforts with the members of the technical short course groups. Rodong Sinmun

title: Their Sincere Devotion to Orphans
body: One day last February, officials of the North Phyongan Provincial Party Committee visited orphans at Sinuiju Primary School for Orphans who were spending the winter vacation. Some days ago the leading official of the Provincial Party Committee had been informed that the orphans' vacation was to be begun soon. Then he organized a meeting immediately to discuss issues on helping the orphans spend their vacation happily. Thus they prepared themselves school things and sporting goods and brought them with them to the school. Not only those but also other officials and people of the province are taking good care of the orphans during their winter vacation with brotherly affection. In this way the orphans are enjoying happiest life in the bosom of the socialist country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Millions of Trees Planted
body: Officials and working people of South Phyongan Province have planted millions of trees of good species including pine-nut tree, chestnut tree and Larix lepolepis in slightly over a fortnight with patriotic desire to turn all mountains into golden ones. The province held several conferences on afforestation and let cities and counties conduct the work for securing humus and materials for producing saplings after making step-by-step plans. The officials of the province learned in detail about securing saplings in tree nurseries of the cities and counties and took active measures to solve the knotty problems. In particular, they let the cities and counties have a thorough knowledge for increasing the rate of rooting of planted trees by organizing demonstration for tree planting in a meaningful way. The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un planted memorial trees together with participants in the 2nd Conference of Secretaries of Primary Committees of the WPK on the Tree-planting Day. The two fir trees planted by him make the officials and working people redouble their patriotism. The officials and working people of the province have turned out as one with high sense of civic consciousness that planting and tendering trees is noble patriotic work for the everlasting prosperity of our country. They accomplish assignments in a responsible manner thoroughly satisfying technological requirements in planting trees. Rodong Sinmun

title: Brisk River Improvement
body: True to the policy of the Workers’ Party of Korea on land administration, North Hwanghae Province has stepped up the river improvement project under its detailed plan. On the basis of seriously analyzing the mistakes and lessons revealed in the work for land administration previous year, officials of the province, under the guidance of Provincial Party Committee, set a vivid target for steadily promoting this work all the year round. First of all, they intensify the organizational work for decisively preventing damage from flooding by concentrating forces on river improvement project in the regions having many medium and small streams, while making the cities and counties substantially wage such projects as riverbed-digging, filling dike and building bank with stones. With this, the province strictly reviews the progress of river improvement project week by week so as to awaken senior officials of the counties to discharge their obligations bearing in mind that no success can be expected in their work without the land management. Amid the high emulation enthusiasm between cities and counties, a series of successes are being made. Officials of Suan County accelerate the river improvement project after setting a high target this year, too, in the wake of last year. In keeping with setting detailed daily schedule according to projects, the province intensively conducts riverbed-digging in various sections with riskiness of flood damage to increase the capacity of water passage. And it puts big efforts into planting ground covering plant and creating of bank-protecting forests while improving the river as required by the design. Yonthan County puts rivers in good order by mobilizing the manpower and means and greatly facilitates the riverbed-digging with the help of excavator and other heavy machines. Meanwhile, similar successes are witnessed in Sinphyong, Pongsan, Hwangju and other counties. Rodong Sinmun

title: Miracles and Innovations Made in Construction for Ryonpho Greenhouse Farm
body: Miracles are being wrought in the construction of the Ryonpho Greenhouse Farm in the DPRK every day. Servicepersons renovate old standards and create new construction methods, while generating the Ryonpho spirit of creation and stirring up the hot wind of Ryonpho. Displayed at the construction sites are slogans and news boards reflecting the spirit of the times and red flags, and brisk agitprop activities have been conducted. The soldier-builders have stepped up the project for earth-filling and ground-making. Officials and working people of South Hamgyong Province take active part in the construction. Officials of the province have scrupulously organized operation and direction to give precedence to the provision of gravels and sand and speed up the work for shelter belts, afforestation and greening. Officials and working people of provincial, city and county institutions carried huge amount of earth in a short period to step up the land arrangement while planting lots of trees for a windbreak. The province is now organizing such various works as securing fruit trees, flower shrubs and turf to be planted around dwelling houses and public buildings of the farm, researching into the production of nutritive liquid fertilizer and giving a short course to technicians as well as the selection of its employees. Rodong Sinmun

title: University Graduates to Devote Themselves to Socialist Construction in DPRK
body: Amid the growing enthusiasm of the youth to devote themselves to socialist construction, university graduates in Pyongyang City and Ryanggang Province of the DPRK volunteered to work at major worksites for socialist construction. A student of Pyongyang Hydro-meteorological College volunteered to work in Samjiyon City of Ryanggang Province, deeming it the greatest honor to glorify youth in the sacred land of Mt. Paektu associated with the revolutionary history and traditions of the Workers' Party of Korea. A graduate of Kim Hyong Jik University of Education in the capital city pledged to become a teacher at a rural village - Taechong-ri, Unpha County of North Hwanghae Province. Students of Kim Chaek University of Technology in the capital city expressed their determination to work at the Sunchon Cement Complex, the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex and other major industrial establishments out of their will to do their bit as patriots in the all-out drive for hastening the overall prosperity and development of Korean-style socialism. Nine university graduates in Ryanggang Province evinced their will to dedicate themselves to the education of rising generations at schools of remote mountain villages. Meetings for seeing off the volunteers took place in Pyongyang and Hyesan cities. Rodong Sinmun

title: New Historical Relics Found in Mts. Myohyang and Kumgang of DPRK
body: Precious historical relics have recently been excavated in Mts. Myohyang and Kumgang, the DPRK's famous mountains. They are a gold-silver image of Pharmacist Buddha with two Bodhisattvas on either side and a gilt-bronze image of Amitabha with two Bodhisattvas on either side. The image of Pharmacist Buddha, 8.9 cm in height and 200 grams in weight, was found in Mt Myohyang and the image of Amitabha, 16 cm in height and 900 grams in weight, in Mt Kumgang. Carved on the back side of the Amitabha image are letters reading "Kwangam Temple", which was located in front of the mausoleum of King Kyonghyo (Kongmin), the 31st king of Koryo (918-1392), in Haeson-ri of Kaesong City and then ruined in the period of the feudal Joson dynasty (1392-1910). According to an analysis the Analysis Institute of the High-Tech Development Center of Kim Il Sung University conducted by means of scanning electron microscope, the gilded Buddhist image from Mt Myohyang is made chiefly of silver and the gilded Buddhist image from Mt Kumgang is made chiefly of bronze with tin and lead. The Non-permanent Tangible Heritage Examination and Appraisal Committee, composed of officials, teachers and researchers of the Bureau for the Protection of Cultural Heritage, Kim Il Sung University, the Korean Central History Museum, the Korean Agency for National Heritage Conservation, etc., and the Archaeology Society of the DPRK had an in-depth discussion on those historical relics. In the end, they came to estimation that the relics are a sterling article of national value made in the period of Koryo and they are of high academic significance in studying the development of the then society and the depiction techniques and manufacturing methods of Buddhist images. And the relics were recognized as the outstanding ones of national value among the historical relics in the DPRK. They were donated to the state. Rodong Sinmun

title: His Devotion to Translating People’s Dream and Ideal into Reality
body: Overtake Others at a Single Leap Forward In May Juche 101(2012), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un inspected the Central Zoo and was informed in detail of the prospective plans of the zoo by its officials. Then he said that the zoo could be arranged in a more interesting way without expanding it in area. We must transfigure the Central Zoo in splendor and thus provide the people with another world-class base for cultural and emotional life, he noted. Making rounds of the zoo, he pointed out the parts where they failed to combine maximum practicality and profitability in the minimum area of plot. Then he told them about the global trend of zoo construction and taught the ways and methods to remodel the zoo. That day, he gave precious instructions to a relevant official in the designing field about remodeling the zoo nicely and said that we must overtake others at a single leap forward. Overtake others at a single leap forward! These words are pregnant with the determination and will of the respected General Secretary who is anxious to let our people enjoy happiness without envying others as soon as possible. To Be a Model of Modern Civilization In February Juche 104(2015), the respected General Secretary inspected Mirae Scientists Street under construction. He visited the construction site after having a bird’s eye view of the street by air and grasping actuality that the street was not deep enough a day before. Looking round the site, he said that only when the first-stage construction was followed by the second-stage one, could the depth of the street be ensured and the buildings of the first stage pay off. Then he continued that he was going to let the relevant officials in the construction headquarters and designing field have a view of the construction site by airplane. By doing so, the officials could feel proud of being masters of construction of monumental edifices and estimate the shortcomings of the first-stage construction while planning about the second-stage construction, he added. That day, he stressed that, as Mirae Scientists Street was what the Party engaged itself in with determination, it had to be built as a model street of modern civilization. Indeed, Mirae Scientists Street is the fruit of energetic guidance of the respected General Secretary who led the construction elaborately. A Precious Seed In March several years ago, the respected General Secretary inspected the Pyongyang Old People’s Home under construction. Touring the construction site with officials, he asked all of a sudden which unit designed the old people’s home. A designer who took part in the designing of the old people’s home answered his question. The respected General Secretary praised that the relevant designing institute did quite a good job. He said that, in the future, appreciations must be made by considering which unit and who created the prizewinning miniature when summing up the work of designing establishments and designers. He continued that this could encourage an emulation among designing institutions and designers and promote the creation of excellent miniatures. His unforgettable teaching served as a precious seed which enabled an epochal development in the country’s designing field. Rodong Sinmun

title: Active Support for Field of Railway Transport
body: In North Phyongan Province active support is given to the railway transport sector on a mass scale. Officials and working people of the province, fully aware of the importance of supporting railway sector in the struggle to attain the grand goal set forth by the 8th Congress of the Workers’ Party of Korea(WPK), display their patriotic enthusiasm in supporting the railway transport sector. Officials and employees of the provincial organs and units sent large amount of aid materials to the railway transport sector while filling up gravel, cracking gravel and cleaning out ditches in a responsible way. Sinuiju City actively supported the railway in terms of man power and materials. Officials of the city, after the on-the-spot discussion meeting, aroused masses and readjusted the surroundings of the railway in their charge and set a fine example in supporting the railway. Sakju, Pakchon and Unjon counties also sent large amount of aid materials to the railway sector thus contributing to increasing the hardness of rail. Meanwhile officials and working people of different regions including Tongrim County and Jongju City are dedicating their patriotic zeal to give support to the railway transport sector, regarding it as a work for their own units and themselves.Masses’ enthusiasm for supporting the railway are getting high in the province. Rodong Sinmun

title: Striking Demonstration of Great Military Muscle of Juche Korea: Successful Test-Launch of New-Type ICBM
body: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Guides Test Launch of ICBM Hwasongpho-17 The test-launch of a new type inter-continental ballistic missile Hwasongpho-17 of the DPRK strategic forces was conducted on March 24, Juche 111 (2022) under the direct guidance of Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un gave a written order to conduct the test-launch of the new type ICBM of the DPRK strategic forces on Wednesday. He visited the launch ground on Thursday and personally guided the overall process of the test-launch of the new type ICBM Hwasongpho-17. With his deep insight into the ever-changing international political situation, the root cause of the daily-escalating military tension in and around the Korean peninsula and the long-term demand of our revolution that stems from the inevitability of the long-standing confrontation with the U.S. imperialists accompanied by the danger of a nuclear war, the General Secretary put forward the Juche-oriented defence development strategy and the policy of bolstering in a sustained way the nuclear war deterrence at the historic 8th Congress of the WPK. Organizing and directing the crucial endeavors for bolstering the national defence capabilities to implement the strategy and policy, he, with top priority given to the development of the new-type ICBM in particular, provided detailed guidance and directions almost every day and made sure that the Hwasongpho-17 type weapon system, a symbol of Juche power and fruition of self-reliance, was completed as a core strike means and a reliable nuclear war deterrence means of the DPRK strategic forces. Fully armed with his original idea on self-reliant defence strategy, officials, scientists and technicians in the field of national defence scientific research and the heroic workers in the munitions field, under his direct guidance, vigorously waged a research and development campaign with creative wisdom and unyielding mentality, thereby producing the new-type ICBM in a short time. Kim Jong Un learned in detail about the preparations for the test-launch of the weapon at first hand on the spot on Thursday afternoon and gave an order to advance to the launching position. He went to the launching position and gave detailed guidance until the last process of the launch, giving strength and courage to the defence scientists and missile maintenance crew involved in the launch to bring about a momentous time when the epochal development of the defence capabilities of the country would be demonstrated all over the world. It was ready for the test launch, and the moment of a historic event has come. The launching ground counting down to the test-launch of the huge strategic weapon was seething with the ardent anticipation of all the defence scientists and munitions workers to inform the whole world of the production of another powerful nuclear attack means by Juche Korea and to demonstrate with pride the reliable DPRK's nuclear war deterrent force. After the General Secretary entered the general launch control center together with leading officials in the field of defence science research, a combat alarm for the launch was sounded at the launching site, test observation technical posts and relevant test research institutes. Then the launch order given by the General Secretary reached the firepower sub-unit and the commander of the Red Flag Company entrusted with the test-launch shouted the command "Fire!". That moment, brightening flame heated the earth along with a loud boom and the huge entity representing the invincible power of the DPRK soared into space. The test launch was carried out in a vertical launch mode in consideration of the security of neighboring countries. The missile, launched at Pyongyang International Airport, traveled up to a maximum altitude of 6 248.5 km and flew a distance of 1 090 km for 4 052s before accurately hitting the pre-set area in open waters of the East Sea of Korea. The test-launch clearly proved that all the parameters of the weapon system exactly met the design requirements and that its prompt operation can be guaranteed scientifically, technically and practically under wartime environment and conditions. The new type weapon system to be operated by the strategic forces of the DPRK under a plan for building up the state nuclear force will creditably perform its mission and duty as a powerful nuclear war deterrent of putting under strict control the nuclear war threats and challenges against the DPRK, taking the initiative to cope with any military crisis and defending the security of the country. Kim Jong Un remarked with pride that the emergence of the new strategic weapon of the DPRK would make the whole world clearly aware of the power of our strategic armed forces once again, adding that the event would be an occasion of convincing the world of the modern feature of our strategic forces and further consolidating the foundation of guarantee and confidence in security of the state based on it. He stressed that the successful development of the new type ICBM, a complex of ultra-modern defence science and technology, is a striking manifestation of the might of our independent defence industry that started and developed by our own strength. He said that this miraculous victory is a priceless victory won by the great Korean people who have unconditionally upheld our Party's lines for building up the self-reliant defence and the nuclear force while pooling their efforts for the security of the country and the eternal well-being of the future generations despite all kinds of difficulties. Noting that steadfast is the strategic choice and determination of our Party and government to keep bolstering the powerful nuclear war deterrence qualitatively and quantitatively so as to ensure the security of the country and cope with all kinds of potential crises in the future, he remarked that to equip with incomparably superior military attack capabilities means possessing the most reliable defence capabilities exemplified by a war deterrent. The DPRK would as ever focus all state efforts on bolstering the defence capabilities on a top priority basis, he said, declaring that this is the resolution made by our Party for the national dignity, sovereignty and peace and for the eternal well-being of the country and the future generations and a noble choice made by our people themselves. He said that any forces should be made to be well aware of the fact that they will have to pay a very dear price before daring to attempt to infringe upon the security of our country. He stressed that our national defence forces would possess formidable military and technical capabilities unperturbed by any military threat and blackmail and keep themselves fully ready for long-standing confrontation with the U.S. imperialists. He affirmed that the strategic forces of the DPRK are fully ready to thoroughly curb and contain any dangerous military attempts of the U.S. imperialists. He had a photo taken with the combatants of the Red Flag Company and major defence science officials who contributed to demonstrating the high strategic position of the DPRK to the world. All the defence scientists, who came to enjoy the greatest love and trust under the care of the General Secretary at a significant moment of strikingly demonstrating the tremendous strength of the country to the world, pledged to develop more invincible nuclear attack means for the country, the Party and the respected General Secretary in the future, too. The absolute power, the invincible nuclear war deterrence for self-defence can be secured only by the great WPK and the great Korean people. This powerful nuclear force of justice possessed by the great WPK and the great Korean people will reliably defend the victorious advance of our revolution and the eternal well-being of the future generations by humbling the U.S imperialists and their vassal forces showing off their military edge. Political News Team

title: Chinese Embassy Officials Visit Korean Revolution Museum
body: Staff members of the Chinese embassy here visited the Korean Revolution Museum on March 23 on the occasion of the anniversary of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's historic first visit to China. Charge d'Affaires ad Interim Sun Hongliang and members of the Chinese embassy went round several rooms of the museum, being briefed on the greatness of Kim Jong Un who demonstrated the dignity and might of socialist Korea before the world and opened up a turning phase in building a prosperous and powerful country with his distinguished leadership. They were deeply impressed by the photos and data showing the external revolutionary activities of Kim Jong Un who has consolidated the comradely unity and cooperation on the road of defending and advancing socialism and put the traditional DPRK-China friendship on a new high stage. That day they made a friendly visit to Changdok School. Rodong Sinmun

title: 7th April Spring People's Art Festival to Be Held in DPRK
body: The 7th April Spring People's Art Festival is to be held with splendor in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, on the occasion of the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. The festival is a grand political art festival that will display the invariable revolutionary will, pure loyalty and noble sense of moral obligation of the Korean people to add eternal glory to the undying revolutionary career, exploits and history of President Kim Il Sung. It will take place at theatres and cultural houses in Pyongyang from April 10 to 18, divided into the categories of provincial art troupes, art squads, itinerant art groups and other art groups. The art festival will also include a magic festival. The festival will bring together excellent troupes selected in provinces. Rodong Sinmun

title: Story Conveyed by Sci-tech Learning Space
body: To Install TV, Not Fish Bowl Some years ago the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited the Rungna Dolphinarium. After carefully looking at walls and cells depicting rocks in the sea, animals and plants from its entrance, he appreciated that sci-tech learning space in natural cavernous style was better arranged than that during his last visit. Then he asked accompanying officials what they would install on the outer wall of learning space. An official replied that they would install a fish bowl on the wall. The respected General Secretary said that installing a fish bowl on the wall would not befit the character of sci-tech learning space and that its character would become different. Saying that he would rather look into the fishbowl at home than seeing fish here, the respected General Secretary instructed the officials to install a TV instead of the fish bowl to show presentations on the world of sea including activities of a variety of fishes. Then he immediately took measures for the Rungna Dolphinarium to receive scientific and technological data from the organs concerned. Indeed, his words that day were precious instructions that the sci-tech learning space should be ones helpful for people to study. Way for Show Must Be Guarded against In May several years ago, the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited a factory. Going round various parts of the factory, he learned in detail about their production and level of technical equipment. When he dropped in by the sci-tech learning space, he acquainted himself with its operation and gave meaningful instructions. He said that officials should operate the sci-tech learning space in an effective way, not in a way for show, with the attitude that shortcut to implementing Party’s policy lied in sci-tech and also reserves for increased production lied in sci-tech. He added that the officials must train the employees of the factory as intelligent workers equipped with modern science and technology of their jobs to let them design many precious technical innovations and creative ideas conducive to modernization of the factory. Even though they arrange the sci-tech learning space in a modern style, it is useless if its operation does not contribute to enhancing level of scientific and technical knowledge of employees. Therefore the respected General Secretary gave instructions to the officials to effectively operate sci-tech learning space even on the road of his busy field guidance. That day, receiving his instructions, the officials kept in their minds his noble intention that operating the sci-tech learning space in a way for show must be thoroughly guarded against. Rodong Sinmun

title: Living Monument in Hongwon County
body: Hongwon Soldo(the islets of pine trees) is a living monument in the township of Hongwon County. It consists of 3 islets which lie east and west in a line. In the 3rd period of the Cenozoic era, when the Korean East Sea region subsided, low hills became the islets and rose up a little for a long period. By the action of the weather and abrasion the surroundings of the islets turned into sharp-cut cliffs. The islets are formed of grano-gneiss. The picturesque Hongwon Soldo has been designated as a living monument in the East Sea of Korea. Rodong Sinmun

title: Working People of Major Industrial Sectors Vigorously Advance with Death-defying Spirit
body: Working people of metallurgical and chemical industries, the two pillars of self-reliant economy, redouble their efforts. Those of major iron and steel complexes including Chollima Steel Complex and Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex make strenuous efforts to increase their production and carry out projects for Juche-oriented construction by taking meticulous management of equipment and technology and introducing rational working methods. The officials and working people of ironstone production units including Musan Mining Complex and several production units responsible for supplying electrodes and fireproof materials guarantee increased production of iron and steel with bold production drive. The working people of major chemical factories including the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex strive to unconditionally carry out their assignments by actively propelling the work for realizing the home-production catalysts and observing technical rules and standard regulations. Those of hydroelectric and thermal power stations across the country make efforts to increase their production focused on raising efficiency of generating equipment with enthusiasm for discharging their responsibility and duty in economic development and improvement of people’s living standard. The working people of coal industry devote their sincerity to keeping outpost for development of self-supporting economy in coal faces. The officials and working people of machine-building industry put efforts into maintaining and reinforcing existing production process with determination to unconditionally carry out the national economic plan. The workers of railway transport sector rapidly transport materials needed for major constructions and industrial sectors. The officials and working people of major industrial sectors further raise their fighting spirit for unconditionally, thoroughly and accurately carrying out the first quarterly year plan which hold a key significance in laying a board and smooth road and foundation of implementing the five-year plan. Rodong Sinmun

title: University Graduates Volunteer to Work at Schools in Forefront Areas, Island Villages and Remote Mountain Villages
body: Tens of graduates of universities of education and teacher training colleges in North and South Phyongan provinces of the DPRK volunteered to work at schools in forefront areas, island villages and remote mountain villages. Those of Sinuiju University of Education No. 2 and Sinuiju Teacher Training College pledged to become true educators who bring up students to be pillars of the country at schools of remote mountain villages. Those of Phyongsong Teacher Training College were determined to devote their youthful wisdom and passion to the educational work for children of servicemen's families and volunteered to work at schools in island posts and forefront areas. Those who graduated from Cha Kwang Su Sinuiju University of Education No. 1 through baby homes, orphanages and primary and middle schools for orphans while enjoying hope and talents without any worry under the benefit of the socialist system volunteered to work at schools in island villages and remote mountian villages. The same is true of other university graduates like Phyongsong University of Education and Sonchon Teacher Training College. Meetings to congratulate the volunteers were held on Thursday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Technical Innovation Campaign Brisk in Public Health Sector of DPRK
body: Factories in the public health sector of the DPRK have waged the positive mass technical innovation movement in order to put the production on the normal track. The Sunchon and Sinuiju pharmaceutical factories urged their technicians and skilled workers to put forward technical proposals conducive to lowering the production costs and improving the effect. The Medical Oxygen Factory ensures a full operation of the equipment by building up the technical forces and positively introducing new technologies. The Myohyangsan Medical Appliances Factory and the Huichon Hospital Bed Factory have supplied new-type medical appliances to ri people's hospitals. The Pyongyang Electronic Medical Appliances Factory makes effective use of its sci-tech learning space to enable their employees to learn lots of new technologies and apply them to production. The Phyongchon Koryo Medicine Pharmaceutical Factory, the Yonsan County Disabled Soldiers' Koryo Medicine Pharmaceutical Factory and other units concentrate their efforts on developing new products and introducing advanced technologies for increasing the variety of Koryo medicines. Rodong Sinmun

title: Versatile Classrooms Increase in DPRK
body: Primary and secondary schools in the DPRK put efforts into transforming their classrooms into versatile ones in the run-up to a new school year. North Hamgyong Province, which has held a series of conferences for improving the provincial educational conditions, pushes ahead with the work for building multi-function classrooms. Officials of the support organizations have prepared educational apparatus and school things, while acquainting themselves with problems at schools. Ryanggang Province, too, encourages support organizations to turn out in the work for further improving educational conditions of schools and the officials of the support organizations put efforts into securing necessary equipment and materials for building multi-function classrooms. Nampho City has informed officials of the support organizations of the importance and significance of educational improvement on several occasions so as to let them devote themselves to building versatile classrooms. Many classrooms are transformed into multi-function ones in different cities and counties of the DPRK. Rodong Sinmun

title: Progress Made Day after Day in Production of Cement for Large Construction Projects
body: Officials and workers of the Sangwon Cement Complex continue to increase the production. Controllers of the central control room rationally control every production process in touch with relevant workshops. Workers of the calcinating workshop have actively introduced reasonable method for operating kiln on equal terms with raw materials, fuel and electricity supply to increase clinker output. At the cement workshop of the complex skilled workers lead unskilled ones and manage equipment in a responsible way while preparing necessary spare parts. Consequently they are turning out more high-quality cement. Various units in charge of supply of raw materials and fuel for cement production also make innovations. Devoted efforts are also made at the Sunchon Cement Complex to send more cement to grand construction sites. Various workshops including controlling workshop, calcinating workshop, cement workshop and mixed raw materials workshop introduce many valuable scientific innovation schemes, thus increasing production. Supply units for the complex like the Sunchon Limestone Mine and Argillite Mine achieve successes in their production with a single desire to contribute to cement production. Production is also increased at the Chonnaeri Cement Factory. Now cement production units across the country are striving to supply much more cement to grand construction sites. Rodong Sinmun

title: Advanced Diagnosis and Treatment Methods Introduced into Local Hospitals
body: The public health sector of the DPRK actively introduces the advanced diagnosis and treatment methods into province-level treatment and prevention institutions. After grasping the conditions and environment of the province-level treatment and prevention institutions and the technical and practical skills of their medical workers, the Ministry of Public Health meticulously organized the work to introduce the advanced diagnosis and treatment methods used by the central hospitals into the relevant units. The central hospitals have made technical teaching programs with experience gained through clinical activities and image data to be distributed to the province-level treatment and prevention institutions and given lectures through telemedicine system for the medical workers in local areas. And medical workers of the central hospitals give technical instructions at the provincial hospitals. The Pyongyang University of Medicine Hospital dispatched its competent medical worker to North and South Phyongan provinces in February to help improve the abilities of medical workers in the relevant areas. The ministry also organizes a technical course to introduce a new treatment method developed at the Moranbong District People's Hospital into the provincial hospitals. Such introduction of advanced diagnosis and treatment methods contributes to getting rid of the differences in the quality of medial service between central and local hospitals. Rodong Sinmun

title: Short Course for Chairpersons of City and County Committees of Youth League Held
body: There took place a three-term short course for the chairpersons of city and county committees of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League at the training institute of the Central Committee of the youth league from Mar. 7 to 25. The short course, held in the forms of lecture and speech on experience, dealt with the practical issues for enhancing the function and role of the city and country committees of the youth league and more vigorously conducting the youth league work as required by the new era of the prosperity of the country to carry out the tasks set forth at the historic letter the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un sent to the 10th Congress of the youth league. The lecturers mentioned the tasks and ways for all the young people to prepare themselves to be ardent fighters boundlessly loyal to the idea and leadership of General Secretary Kim Jong Un, regarding the thorough establishment of his monolithic leadership system within the whole youth league as their lifeline. There were speeches on successes and experiences gained by youth league officials at all levels in guiding their units. Rodong Sinmun

title: Some Areas in Sadong District of Pyongyang Renamed
body: The Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea made a decision to rename Songsin-dong No. 1, Songsin-dong No. 2 and Songsin-dong No. 3 of Sadong District, Pyongyang City, into Sadong-dong No. 1, Sadong-dong No. 2 and Sadong-dong No. 3, and Songhwa-dong No. 1 and Songhwa-dong No. 2 in the same district into Songryu-dong No. 1 and Songryu-dong No. 2. A decree of the SPA Standing Committee on it was issued on Thursday. Rodong Sinmun

title: New Street Came into Being in Songsin and Songhwa Areas
body: An ideal street for the people came into being in the eastern gateway to Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK. Under a grand plan for the capital city construction unfolded by the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), the construction of 10 000 flats in the Songsin and Songhwa areas was successfully completed in a short period of one year. Such a startling miracle is the fruition of high loyalty and devoted efforts of the builders bearing in mind the people-first principle, the political ideal of the WPK. It is also a clear demonstration of justness of our Party's idea of architectural beauty, potentiality of the Juche-based independent economy and great might of the single-hearted unity between the Party and the masses. The Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly (SPA) of the DPRK decided as follows in relation with the formation of a grand architectural group thoroughly preserving the Juche character, national character and modernity in the Songsin and Songhwa areas: 1. A section from the Songsin Bridge to Songhwa rotary intersection is designated as Songhwa Street. 2. The dongs in the Songsin and Songhwa areas are called Songsin-dong No. 1, Songsin-dong No. 2, Songhwa-dong No. 1 and Songhwa-dong No. 2 of Sadong District, Pyongyang City. A relevant decree of the SPA Standing Committee was issued on Mar. 24. Rodong Sinmun

title: Sowing Begins at Tree Nurseries of DPRK
body: Officials and working people in the forestry sector of the DPRK have turned out as one in the work for sowing tree seeds. Officials at the Forestry General Bureau of the Ministry of Land and Environment Protection are organizing the seed-sowing in all tree nurseries of the country so that it will be finished in time. Working people of South Hwanghae Province are seeing more successes by meeting the sci-tech requirements. Ensuring appropriate temperature to prevent waste of even a single seed of trees of good species, Jangyon and Unryul counties have carried out their daily plans without fail. Working people of Kaesong City are taking measures to prevent damage by wild animals such as birds while speeding up sowing of seeds. Officials and working people of South Phyongan and Kangwon provinces are pushing ahead with the sowing of tree seeds despite bad weather conditions. Rodong Sinmun

title: General Meeting of DPRK Olympic Committee Held
body: The general meeting of the DPRK Olympic Committee for Juche 111 (2022) took place in Pyongyang Friday. Attending it were members of the committee and officials in the sports field and relevant units. The meeting reviewed the last year's work of the committee and discussed the orientation of its work for this year. Minister of Physical Culture and Sports Kim Il Guk, chairman of the committee, made a report to be followed by speeches. The reporter and speakers recalled that the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un has always paid deep attention to the sports, showing the way ahead of our sports' development and energetically guiding it. They noted that last year witnessed successes in putting the professional sports technique on a higher stage, further strengthening the forces of sportspersons worthy of representing the state and making a stride forward in training reserves. They stressed the need to put our country on the list of advanced countries in sports at an early date by steadily developing the overall sports technique through active creation and introduction of new training means and methods as required by the players' constitutional characters and the developing trend of modern sports technique. The meeting discussed the practical issues arising in putting the country's professional sports technique on a higher stage, briskly conducting the mass sports and developing the sports education and scientific researches this year. Rodong Sinmun

title: University Student Scientific Research Prize Awarded
body: The University Student Scientific Research Prize was awarded to university students who have set examples in study and scientific research. Awarding ceremonies took place in Pyongyang and provinces from March 21 to 25. More than 1 600 students across the country won the certificates of the prize and medals. There were speeches at the ceremonies. Rodong Sinmun

title: Precious Instructions Given to Officials
body: More Things Beneficial to People In May Juche 101(2012), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un met with officials and instructed that Party officials must make devoted efforts for the people. He told them that as all of us are sons and daughters of the people, we have to devote everything to the people. His teachings reminded the officials of the viewpoint and standpoint they must have toward the people and of how devotedly they must work for the people. Looking around the officials wrapped in deep emotions, the respected General Secretary said that Party officials must do more things beneficial to the people with a proper view of the people, stressing that they must share weal and woe with the people and work devotedly for them with the mindset that they are fighting in the same trench with the people. The officials kept in their hearts the profound meaning of the instructions of the respected General Secretary. Do more things beneficial to the people! Herein lie the great expectations of the respected General Secretary who wants all the Party officials to be genuine and faithful servants of the people. Standard-bearers and Locomotives In December several years ago, the First Conference of Chairpersons of the Primary Committees of the WPK was held in Pyongyang in the presence of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un. Making the historic concluding speech at the conference, he earnestly said that the chairpersons of the primary Party committees were the hardcore of our Party and political workers in the front line of the strengthening and development of the Party and implementation of the Party policies. His words greatly moved the hearts of the participants. He went on to say that they must serve as standard-bearers and locomotives making a breakthrough in the van of the masses by setting personal examples. He earnestly told them that they must possess revolutionary drive of pushing ahead with their work in a persevering manner without interruption and rouse the Party members and other working people to the implementation of the Party’s policies shouting the slogan "Follow me to make a dash!" Listening to him, the participants of the conference made up their minds to fully discharge their heavy responsibilities and missions as he wished. His great trust and expectation let all the Party officials stand in the van of the general onward march for a fresh victory of revolution. Rodong Sinmun

title: 32nd April Spring Friendship Art Festival to Be Held
body: The 32nd April Spring Friendship Art Festival is to be held in Pyongyang, the capital of the DPRK, amid the growing reverence of the Korean people and other progressives in the world for President Kim Il Sung, a peerlessly great man, on the occasion of his 110th birth anniversary. The festival will exhibit videos of art performances sent by art troupes and artistes of different countries through international communication channels. It will give an impressive artistic description of the unanimous aspiration and desire of the progressives to highly praise and eternally convey the personality of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, the peerlessly great men. It will bring together international and national concours winners of tens of countries, famous art troupes, dancing troupes and circuses of foreign countries and art troupes of overseas Koreans. The organizing committee of the festival is to examine videos of colorful art performances, including vocal music, instrumental music, dance and circus, sent by art troupes of different countries. They will be edited in forms of group, single and combined performances and broadcast on the Korean Central TV. Details of the festival and results of the jury examination will be posted on internet homepages including "Korean Art". Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Has Photo Session with Those Who Contributed to Successful Test-Fire of Hwasongpho-17 Type
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, had a photo session with the officials, scientists, technicians and workers in the field of the defence industry who contributed to the successful test-fire of new-type ICBM Hwasongpho-17. Kim Jong Sik and Jang Chang Ha were present there. The venue of the photo session was seething with the great joy and excitement of the participants who were to have a significant photo taken, which will be the one of their lifetime honor, under the loving care of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, amid the blessings of the people across the country. They are filled with the great pride and honor of having produced a core nuclear strike means representing the DPRK strategic forces, another fruition and great creation of self-reliance born of our own efforts in the course of the sacred struggle to sharpen the treasured sword for defending the dignity and sovereignty and peace of the country. As General Secretary Kim Jong Un came to the venue, all the participants broke into thunderous cheers of "hurrah!", paying highest tribute to him representing the mightiness of Juche Korea and the ever-victorious banner, who brought about the remarkable event of demonstrating once again the innovative development of the country's defence capabilities all over the world with the faith of Mt Paektu, steel-strong will and extraordinary leadership ability. He sent militant salute of warm congratulations to the reliable soldiers in the defence industrial field who made contribution to consolidating the war deterrent, more perfect and stronger, for reliably defending the security and future of the country and the people with the indomitable spirit, boundless devotion and matchless creativity whereby they have wrought unprecedented miracles to meet any demand of the Party and the revolution, unconditionally and absolutely supporting it. He also offered warm congratulations and all glory to our great people who built by their own efforts the absolute force of self-defence that can not be bartered nor be bought with anything and held it firm without the slightest vacillation in the face of harsh trials and difficulties. He said that this signal development of the Juche-based national defence would have been unthinkable without the trust and ardent patriotism of all the people who rendered unconditional and absolute support and encouragement to the indispensable sacred cause of building up the country's nuclear war deterrent. We must be strong under whatever circumstances to defend peace, accelerate socialist construction and ensure the security of the rising generations, free from any threat, he said. He expressed once again our Party's will for building the strong defence capabilities to defend the security and future of our country and people by more reliable and perfect and stronger, overwhelming strategic force. The defence capabilities in the true sense of word precisely mean the powerful striking capabilities, he said, adding that only when one is equipped with the formidable striking capabilities, overwhelming military power that cannot be stopped by anyone, is it possible for one to prevent a war, guarantee the security of the country and contain and put under control all threats and blackmails by the imperialists. He declared that we would continue to attain the defence up-building goal and develop much more powerful strike means to equip our army with them. The unyielding revolutionary spirit and exceptional patriotism displayed by the defence industry scientists and technicians and the munitions industry workers who are devotedly carrying into practice the Party's unique idea on the self-reliant defence strategy are the inexhaustible strength of our Party, he said, expressing his expectation and conviction that they would as ever strive with redoubled courage for the development and security of our great state and the victorious advance of our revolutionary cause, and thus perfect the country's nuclear war deterrent at an accelerating pace. Encouraged by his deep trust and warm benevolence, all the participants made their firm pledge to steadily and vigorously attain the ultra-modern goals for bolstering up the defence capabilities so as to make the military technological advantages, the overwhelming strength possessed by Juche Korea, further irreversible with intense loyalty to the Party Central Committee's grand plan and determination. The Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea gave a reception for the officials, scientists, technicians and workers in the field of defence industry who contributed to the successful test-fire of new-type ICBM Hwasongpho-17. Political News Team

title: New Literature Works Produced to Encourage Socialist Construction in DPRK
body: Writers in different parts of the DPRK have produced many literature works to encourage the all-people advance toward a new victory in socialist construction. The Central Committee of the Writers Union of Korea organized a literature festival and contest involving all the writers in the capital city and provinces to inspire their creative enthusiasm. Encouraged by this, writers found themselves at the bustling worksites for implementing the decisions of the recent Party Congress and plenary meetings of the Party Central Committee to produce the literature works that vividly represent the stirring reality. Among the new excellent works are those giving a full description of the noble personality of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, a great man who dedicates himself to the sake of the people, and the ones on the theme of the revolutionary traditions. Writers worked together with workers and builders at the Pyongyang Thermal Power Plant, the Jangchon Vegetable Cooperative Farm in Sadong District, the construction site for 10 000 flats in Hwasong area, the Ryonpho Greenhouse Farm under construction, etc. Writers in North Phyongan Province, South Hwanghae Province and South Hamgyong Province dedicate their wisdom and enthusiasm to writing the literature works symbolic of the spirit of the times at major factories, enterprises, construction sites and cooperative farms in the provinces. Rodong Sinmun

title: Preparations for April Spring People's Art Festival Brisk in DPRK
body: Preparations for the 7th April Spring People's Art Festival are being actively conducted in the DPRK with approach of President Kim Il Sung's birthday. The festival organizing committee took necessary measures to produce posters, diplomas and cup designs for the festival. It has also shown deep care for the professional art troupes and the itinerant art squads and art groups to further raise the ideological and artistic level of the festival. Amid the growing enthusiasm of those units to participate in the festival, such art works of diverse forms were created as the works reflecting the people's deep yearning for the President and their ardent wish for his immortality and showing his undying leadership exploits and the strong stamina of our people out in the struggle to implement the decisions of the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Many units strive to represent on a higher level those art works including vocal music, instrumental music, dances, story-telling pieces. Rodong Sinmun

title: "Complete Collection of Kim Il Sung's Works" Published
body: The Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House in the DPRK brought out Vol. 19 (enlarged edition) of "Complete Collection of Kim Il Sung's Works", a library of the immortal Juche idea dealing with President Kim Il Sung's works systematically and comprehensively in chronological order. Contained in the book are 108 works such as historic speeches, talks and concluding speeches made by the President in the period from March to August Juche 40 (1951). In those works the President put forward Juche-oriented military ideas, superb tactics and struggle orientation and ways to outstrip the numerical and technical superiority of the U.S. imperialists and open up a turning phase in the Fatherland Liberation War. He also detailed the important issues arising in further strengthening the Party organizationally and ideologically by thoroughly ensuring the purity of its ranks and improving the party political work within the People's Army. And he set forth the strategic and tactical policies on thoroughly smashing the enemy's "large-scale offensive" by bolstering defences along the east and west coasts and on waging bold and active combat activities to plunge the aggressors into uneasiness and horror. In some works he called on all the people to launch a dynamic campaign for increased production and on war writers to create more revolutionary and militant literature and art works greatly inspiring the soldiers and civilians to the final victory in the war, stressing the need to intensify education through them. Other works give perfect solution to the theoretical and practical questions arising in the efforts for the victory in the Fatherland Liberation War and preparations for postwar reconstruction, including the issues of improving the public health service in wartime, well organizing a signature-collection campaign for peace and building Pyongyang into a beautiful and fine city. Rodong Sinmun

title: Couple Innovators on Their Way to Work
body: Sin Hyok and Rim Chuk Yong, couple workers of the women’s hosiery workshop of the Pyongyang Hosiery Factory, are full of delight on the way to work. We seem to hear their words promising each other to overfulfill their daily plan and joyfully get the way back home. Making a promise of great achievements in the morning, they go to their work full of worthwhile working life. Their features reflect their intention of beautiful life to find the genuine love and hope for future in patriotic way for our country and people. They will always take their course of life together with deep love, delight and optimism, as they live with noble view of life that they regard genuine labor and feat for country and people as their happiness, not seeking personal comfort and rich wealth. Rodong Sinmun

title: 1st Workshop of Officials in Information Field of WPK Opens
body: The 1st Workshop of Officials in the Information Field of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) started at the April 25 House of Culture on Monday. The workshop will serve as an important occasion in modeling the whole society on the great revolutionary idea of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un and in strengthening the fighting efficiency of the whole Party and redoubling the motive force of advance peculiar to our style of socialism by further enhancing the militant function and role of the information sector in the responsible struggle to achieve the prosperity and development of the state and the people's happiness under the uplifted banner of the ideology-first principle. The workshop will deal with the ways for bringing about a decisive innovation in all spheres of the ideological work as demanded by the new developing stage of our revolution and the changing reality, on the basis of deep study and understanding of the immortal exploits made by Kim Jong Un in the Party's ideological work as well as of comprehensive and substantial analysis and review of the experiences and lessons in the work of the Party information sector. Attending the workshop were officials of organizational and information and publicity departments of provincial, city and county Party committees and other Party committees that perform the same function, leading party officials of ministries and national institutions, information workers of institutions, industrial establishments and co-op farms, officials in the field of the preservation of revolutionary relics and officials of relevant departments of the Party Central Committee. The workshop was opened on March 28. The platform of the workshop venue was taken by Ri Il Hwan, Kim Jae Ryong, O Il Jong, Ju Chang Il, Ri Tu Song and other leading officials of the Organizational Leadership Department, the Information and Publicity Department and relevant departments of the WPK Central Committee, information secretaries of the provincial Party committees, information officials of the Cabinet and ministries and officials of important units in the information field. Ri Il Hwan, member of the Political Bureau and secretary of the WPK Central Committee, courteously read out an important letter "On Eliminating Formalism and Bringing about a Fundamental Innovation in the Party's Ideological Work" sent by Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the WPK, to those attending the 1st Workshop of Officials in the Information Field of the WPK. Ri Il Hwan gave a report. The reporter said that the intention of the Party Central Committee in holding the workshop is to further strengthen the single-minded unity, an invincible might of our-style socialism, by making an innovation in the Party ideological work in keeping with the new demand of our developing revolution and to accelerate the victorious advance of the socialist cause by stirring up the people's enthusiasm for revolution, struggle and creation. Noting that the rapid progress in the new century of Juche put our country on the position of a superpower with tremendous might and ushered in a new era of great change and steady prosperity in which our-style socialism advances victoriously with confidence, he stressed that this proud change is a miracle of history proving the greatness of Kim Jong Un's revolutionary idea and its great vitality. Kim Jong Un put forward such unique ideas and theories as the strategy of lasting significance for our revolution, the idea on Kim Jong Il's patriotism, the politics of the people-first principle, the idea on our state-first principle and the idea on the comprehensive development of socialism, he said, adding that they serve as an invincible great programme and a powerful weapon for inspiring all the people to the historic advance for adhering to our-style socialism and achieving a fresh victory. Kim Jong Un clarified the general mission of the Party ideological work through his energetic ideo-theoretical activities and comprehensively expounded the theoretical and practical issues arising in improving the ideological work in accordance with the demand of the times and the developing revolution, the reporter said, and went on: The ideas and theories, advanced by the General Secretary, including the idea and theory of strengthening the five-point education and turning the entire Party into a studying party and the policy on setting the orientation, goal and method of the Party ideological work in a far-sighted way and thoroughly implementing them and on constantly enhancing the infiltration and effectiveness of the ideological work, are immortal important guidelines for bringing about an innovation in the Party ideological work. The General Secretary has wisely led the work to strengthen the internal strength and advance socialist construction to the victory by dint of ideology. Under his energetic and detailed guidance, a new turn was brought about in the work of preserving the revolutionary relics and education in the revolutionary traditions and a new term was opened throughout the country in arming with the revolutionary spirit. Miraculous successes have been achieved in the whole socialist construction as the information and publicity work was conducted in accurately-targeted and focused methods. The devoted leadership provided by the General Secretary, who sent open letters and passionate appeal encouraging all the people and further arousing the surging zeal of the whole Party, all the people and the entire army, was the motive force that made our people be persons strong in spirit who know no fear under any trials and our state display its dignity as one working great miracles. The reporter said that it is the traditional leadership mode of our Party to accelerate the advance of the revolution by dint of ideology and information and inspiration, and the ideological front is a frontline of the revolution and socialist construction at present and in the future, too. The reporter stressed the need to heighten the degree of ideological campaign and intensify the information and motivation offensive so as to successfully carry out challenging tasks at the present time when we are faced with the important and responsible task to model the whole society on Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism and vigorously promote the comprehensive development of the Korean-style socialist construction. Stressing it is the basic mission and general goal of our Party's ideological work at present to model the entire Party and the whole society on Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, the reporter called on the Party information workers to become vanguard fighters in carrying out the sacred cause of modeling the entire Party and the whole society on the revolutionary idea of the respected General Secretary. He said that the Party information workers should be buglers of advance of the Workers' Party of Korea who make our Party's voices incessantly resound across the country and arouse all the people to a struggle for the comprehensive development of the Korean-style socialist construction. He stressed the need to hold fast to the education in the revolutionary history of the leaders and the Party's leadership feats as the primary task of the Party work and effect a new turn in the work for defending and glorifying the revolutionary history and leadership feats, a vital issue related with the destiny of our revolution. He called for grasping the essence and contents of celebrated works of the respected General Secretary and Party literatures, regarding them as an immovable creed and the absolute standard of thinking and actions, and becoming standard-bearers of ideological work and an advanced group of the revolution who find boundless pride and worth in training all members of society into genuine Kimilsungists- Kimjongilists. The reporter pointed out that the entire country should be brought to life with the spirit of fresh progress and leaps forward by conducting the ideological work systematically, purposefully, strategically and tactically and making full use of all information and inspiration force and means. He called for smashing formalism in the ideological work, and surveying issues arising in practice of the ideological work and taking proactive measures. He stressed the importance to decisively wipe out the anti- and non- socialist practices obstructive to the modeling of the whole society on the monolithic idea through a powerful ideological offensive. The reporter called on the Party information workers to make redoubled efforts to fulfill their sacred mission before the Party, the revolution, the country and the people. Then speeches began. The workshop continues. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Important Letter to Those Attending First Workshop of Officials in Information Field of WPK
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, sent an important letter to those attending the first workshop of officials in the information field of the WPK "On Eliminating Formalism and Bringing About a Fundamental Innovation in the Party's Ideological Work" on Monday. Noting that the workshop is held at a historic time when our dignified and powerful state unfolded a grand plan for its overall development and has demonstrated its great unity and tremendous, underlying strength, the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un in his letter said: I extend greetings of enthusiastic encouragement to the participants in the workshop and all other information workers of the Party who have made significant contributions to the great work for bolstering the politico-ideological strength, the foremost power of our Party and social system, exerting efforts to make the Party and the popular masses breathe in one and the same idea. I would also like to take this opportunity to extend warm militant greetings to the primary information workers across the country who have spared no efforts for the ideological education and transformation of people, always finding themselves among the masses and in the ideological positions of the Juche revolution as well as to other comrades who are striving at such important posts of the Party's ideological front as the fields of the preservation of revolutionary relics, literature and art and media. The thought-out and bold struggle which our Party and people have been carrying on after the historic 8th Congress of the Party opened up a new victorious phase of bringing about significant changes in succession by courageously advancing in the face of the worst difficulties, and our revolution has finally and confidently reached its higher stage of achieving the comprehensive development of socialist construction. Despite continued severe hardship and challenges, our revolution is vigorously advancing. The 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee decided to surely guarantee the successful implementation of the new five-year plan set forth at the Party Congress and make substantial progress in improving the people's living standard, and put forward a grand programme for ultimate solution to the socialist rural question. To carry out such important tasks which would never be easy to fulfill owing to manifold barriers to our advance, we should regard the ideological and moral strength of the popular masses as the foremost weapon as ever and stir it up in every way. The Juche theory of giving importance to ideology, which means that ideology decides everything and there is nothing impossible to do when the people are motivated ideologically, will fully demonstrate its justness and vitality forever as our Party's principle in leading revolution and its political philosophy. For our Party constantly holding fast to the Juche theory of giving importance to ideology, the ideological work is most important among all its works.
