The ideology-first principle is just the fundamental key to emerging victorious from difficult situations and a way of revolution peculiar to the WPK. The Party Central Committee attaches the foremost importance to the ideological front in order to propel the victorious advance of the revolution and reliably guarantee it by dint of ideology. The Party information workers play a very important role in implanting the ideas and policies of the Party Central Committee deep into the mind of officials, Party members and other working people and orienting all their efforts to the one goal of implementing the Party policies and arousing them to attaining it. Not only the work for patiently and substantially educating all members of society to accept the idea of the Party Central Committee and arm themselves with it, but also huge share of the work for correctly embodying the Party Central Committee's plan and will in the whole field of the revolutionary struggle, socialist construction and social life are carried out through the operation and practice of the Party information field. Particularly important in steadily increasing the might of the single-minded unity of our revolutionary ranks and making the whole country keep strong faith and be full of vim and vigor is the duty of the Party information workers. When they are well prepared enough to fulfill their duty, ideological purity and unity of the Party and the revolutionary ranks will be ensured, and the Party's leadership over socialist construction will produce satisfactory results. It is the truth proved by history and reality that socialism remains steadfast and advances victoriously as much as the Party ideological front is solid and vibrant. The Party Central Committee convened this workshop to awaken all the Party officials to the importance of the ideological work once again and inspire the Party information workers to renewed efforts so that they can display enormous strength in their revolutionary work full of imposing dignity and honor. It is the noble title awarded to the information workers particularly among all the Party officials that they are called faithful mouthpieces of the Party Central Committee and buglers of the revolution. Our Party information workers should become powerful loudspeakers and hi-fi amplifiers in conveying and communicating the Party Central Committee's idea and intention down to the lowest unit correctly in time and arousing the entire Party, the whole country and all the people to their materialization. This is the main spirit of the workshop. Already emphasized is that the Party information field should become a hi-fi amplifier which correctly conveys the Party's idea and intention. The Party Central Committee's aim at the workshop is to further raise the output of those loudspeakers and amplifiers and, in other words, to remarkably enhance the role and might of the Party information field through the workshop. "Let the Party information workers become powerful loudspeakers and hi-fi amplifiers faithful to the Party Central Committee!", this is a slogan to be upheld by our information workers and the spirit to be fully displayed by them at present. The main mission of our Party ideological work is to model the entire Party and the whole society on the revolutionary idea of the Party Central Committee. This means, in a word, making the Party Central Committee's idea and intention dominate the struggle and life of all the members of society. In other words, it means fully arming the officials, Party members, other working people and the rising generations with the Party Central Committee's idea and policies before thoroughly and perfectly embodying them in the overall fields of Party building and activities, state affairs and social life. The cause of modeling the entire Party and the whole society on the revolutionary idea of the Party Central Committee urgently requires a great revolution in the ideological work. Now the revolution and the times demand fresh innovations, bold creation and continual advance, and for this the ideological front should make the first step and bring about fundamental changes as befits its mission of inspiring and leading all changes and development in practice. Kim Jong Un stressed in the letter that an important matter in improving the Party ideological work is to intensify the theoretical study and the work of disseminating theories. Noting that the Party building can be done without deviation and the victorious advance of socialism can be guaranteed only when precedence is given to the ideological and theoretical building, he said that to carry forward to completion the revolutionary cause of Juche generation after generation means just the inheritance of ideology and ism and traditions of struggle. Saying that the political and theoretical circles should be powerful so as to steadily develop in depth the Party's ideological work as required by the revolutionary practice, he indicated the detailed orientation and ways for raising the level and role of the political and theoretical circles. Noting it is the analysis made by the Party Central Committee at present that the revolution in the Party's ideological work should start in shattering formalism, he set forth the tasks for thoroughly eradicating formalism that remains in the Party's ideological work. In order to root out formalism, we should, first of all, make Party information workers keep as their lifeline the mission of paramount importance that they are entirely responsible for the ideological and moral life of all the people who live on this land, he said. Noting that lack of awareness of being masters of the revolution is the ideological basis of formalism, he stressed that the attitude unbecoming for masters should be no longer allowed among Party information workers. Saying that officials in the information field are the revolutionaries who are directly in charge of the Party's ideological front and the master of our Party's ideological work, he added that the Party information workers should be responsible for the ideological life of the Party members and other working people in their areas and units before the Party and guarantee the mental growth of the rising generations before the country and the revolution. Noting that if they forget such important mission even a moment, it will leave a vacuum in the brains of the people and break the Party's ideological front and such consequences can not be undone with anything, he said that the Party information workers should take charge of the ideological education among the people, be aware of their important obligations as professional revolutionaries guiding the ideological remolding and positively find and use the fresh way and the best method for information work and education. After analyzing the forms of vivid manifestation of formalism in the Party's ideological work and aftermath of them, he stressed that in order to root out formalism remaining in the sphere of the ideological work, it is necessary to make it an iron rule and strict discipline for the Party ideological field to hold fast to the important contents of the ideological work as intended and distributed by the Party Central Committee and conduct effective interactive ideological work. He emphasized that the theoretical education is the first task for inspiring all members of the society with the revolutionary idea of the Party Central Committee. He said that it is necessary to make the officials, Party members and other working people and rising generations easily realize the essence, structural system and deep contents of the Juche idea, the guiding ideology of our Party, and explain the theory of the Party's politics in combination with the actual work and life and in a proper and reasonable way so as to make them grasp the Juche idea correctly and theoretically and adopt it as part of their outlook on the world and viewpoint on life. He noted that the essence of ideological education is the education in the greatness of the Party and the education in the loyalty to it, adding that it would be no more than empty talks to call for modeling the whole society on the monolithic idea without implanting the greatness of the Party in the minds of the officials, Party members and working people and educating them to be faithful to its leadership. He said that the education in the greatness of the Party and the education in the loyalty to it are inseparable, and the aim of implanting the greatness and exploits of the Party and the leaders in the minds of the officials, Party members and working people is to make them regard the loyalty as their faith and conscience. He noted that only when they are impressed by the greatness of the Party and the leaders through their actual life experience and absolutely follow the Party and the leaders, not just based on the explanation of principles, their loyalty will certainly be honest and firm. He said that it is necessary to conduct the education methodologically so as to help the officials, Party members and working people fully understand the greatness of the Party. He said that our Party which keeps the people-first principle as its political idea has made all efforts to stabilize and improve the standard of people's living as soon as possible, adding that even on the harsh conditions, the works for realizing the Party's long-cherished desire for the people were conducted in a bold way and thus valuable fruitions have been attained and the attention of the Party and the state is focused most preferentially on protecting the people's interests and promoting their wellbeing. It is important to provide the people with a happy and highly-civilized life but it is more important to educate them on being thankful for the benefits of the Party and the state sincerely and striving to repay them, he said. He stressed the importance of effectively conducting the education through revolutionary relics in the ideological education at present. He said that ideological degeneration originates from oblivion of history and tradition, and a human being is little short of a corpse if he or she is devoid of mental source, adding that's why he prioritizes the education through revolutionary relics and leadership exploits and emphasizes several times that it should never be neglected. He noted that it can be said that the education through revolutionary relics and Party's leadership exploits is the roots of our Party's ideological work and that the ideological education originates from it. He said that the education through revolutionary relics and leadership exploits means the education in the revolutionary traditions and the education in the greatness of the leaders and the education in the loyalty to them. He stressed that it is necessary to courteously furbish the educational bases including revolutionary museums, rooms where revolutionary relics are exhibited, rooms for the education in the revolutionary history and rooms dedicated to the history of units and always pay deep attention to the education through them. He said that the education in implanting the Party's leadership exploits associated with one's field, unit and area in the minds of the people is a crucial task for every Party official, senior Party official in particular, which should be examined and disseminated by them every morning and evening and be reviewed in strong terms by them on a daily, weekly, monthly and quarterly basis. He added that all the Party officials should regard it as their habit and peculiar daily task. He stressed that it is necessary to conduct the education in patriotism steadily and effectively. He said it is necessary to make all the people across the country regard patriotism cherished and embodied by Chairman Kim Jong Il all his life as their viewpoint on life, possess the noble ideological and spiritual qualities of a socialist worker and devote themselves to socialist construction with pure and ardent patriotism. He noted that it is needed to make the people's daily life the course of nurturing, cherishing and hardening patriotism, adding that the aim of our Party in providing the rising generations with school uniforms, shoes, schoolbags, notebooks and other school things made by our own efforts at the state's expenses responsibly is to make them feel thankful to the Party and the state from childhood and acquire the nature of valuing their native home, motherland and their own things. He stressed that the Party information field should understand that the education in patriotism should be neither a lecture nor instillation in any case and only when it helps the people realize and cultivate patriotism in their daily life, can it be possible to train them to be genuine patriots in the era of our state-first principle. He said that it is essential to positively seek the methodology for bringing patriotism closer to the people's life and work and put it to practical use. He noted that the Party organizations at all levels should pay attention to preparing various political events with much care and holding them at the highest level so as to make them important occasions for education in patriotism, adding it is an opportunity of great effect to raise the people's awareness to remain faithful to their duty proper to a citizen for their great motherland shining with the august names of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and emerging victorious under the leadership of the Party while looking up to the national flag and singing the national anthem. He said that it is necessary to take initiatives in the education in collectivism in close correlation with the education in class awareness and morality on the principle of helping all members of society overcome individualism and egoism and acquire the ideological and moral qualities befitting a socialist human being. In the 1950s when the spirit of Chollima was created on the debris after the war, people regarded it as their bounden duty, honor and pride to devote themselves to the affairs of worksites and the country, overcoming hardships with confidence in the future though they lived in poverty because of tough economic conditions, he noted, saying that such a sound social trait should be carried forward as our peculiar national custom not only for today but also for the future. Consciousness that anyone can overcome the difficulties encountered and bring about prosperity and happiness when he or she creates wealth of society by industrious efforts at a factory and a worksite should be implanted, he added. Kim Jong Un stressed the need to concentrate the ideological campaign on anti-socialist and non-socialist practice in a minute way. Saying that mass oppressive offensive and social struggle atmosphere should be raised continuously and methodologically to beat all kinds of negative phenomena that gnaw away at our revolutionary position and crush them without mercy, he noted that the Party information work is a keystone in sweeping away evil spirits of anti-socialism and non-socialism finding their way into the heads of the people. Officials in the Party information field should be a skilled physician to timely, quickly and correctly give diagnosis and precise prescription for alien ideological factors and phenomena and scalpel and remove the cause of a trouble in time, he said. He stressed the need to fiercely unleash an information and agitation offensive so as to make the whole country seethe with struggle for achieving a new victory of socialism by implementing the idea and policies of the Party Central Committee. The 8th Conference of Ideological Workers of the Workers' Party of Korea put emphasis on building up the Party's ideological position in the direction of attacking formation, not defensive formation, but the Party information field failed to get down to this work positively while repeating the words of revolutionary ideological offensive and ideological position of attack formation, he pointed out, saying: Information offensive spreading the idea of the Party Central Committee to the whole country and agitation offensive stirring up a hot wind of implementation of the Party policies should be the inherent nature of the Party ideological work. When the Party Central Committee advances a new fighting programme or policy, the Party information workers exclusively appointed for the post and primary Party information workers should turn out to give lectures and conduct explanatory statement offensive in succession, media should intensively and consecutively carry articles and programs reflecting the Party policies to foster the atmosphere, and the art squads and groups for agitation for increased production should wage vigorous performing activities for increased production at major worksites of socialist construction, he said. He stressed the need to give priority to the information and inspiration by visual means in the information and publicity work and ensure the political and ideological principles and timeliness. Revolutionaries of Juche type advocating the theory of giving precedence to ideology should attach importance to the ideological content, when forming a street and building a structure, and make sure that the features of world-level political power and the spiritual development of our times are retained, he said, adding: Visual means like slogans and watchwords are important information and inspiration means and a lever of the ideological work that can never be neglected. The Party information sector should always bear this in mind. Inspiring slogans and watchwords directly and visibly reflecting the idea and policies of the Party Central Committee should be displayed everywhere, thus making the whole country a collection of slogans and an education field. Information and publicity should be the one to evoke sympathy of the masses and stir up their hearts. To this end, it is important to keenly penetrate into the people's consciousness and mentality and mobilize all the possible means and forces in keeping with circumstances and momentum and steadily improve the forms and methods. Kim Jong Un detailed the issues of making the whole country seethe with enthusiasm for revolution and struggle by producing many masterpieces suited to the requirements of the new era of change and prosperity in the literature and art field as a whole by bringing about a turn in the film creation, an ideological education means of the greatest influence, as the origin. He stressed the need to steadily improve the forms and methods of ideological work on the principle of ensuring novel and popular character and raising the cognitional and educational effect. Saying that the ideological work should be done substantially and deeply, he noted it is a consistent demand of the Party Central Committee that strict vigilance over imitation and repetition should be kept in the Party ideological work and strenuous efforts be paid to create new modality and methods suited to the new era. He said that Rodong Sinmun, organ of the Party, and other newspapers and publications should continue to renovate their styles while carrying many articles helpful to modeling the entire Party and the whole society on the monolithic idea befitting the guide of ideological revolution, and the TV and radio broadcasting sector which has gained public favor by recently producing in succession peculiar and fresh programs that give deep impression should further enhance the might of our broadcasting while valuably nurturing the already made successes. He underscored the need to stir up the wind for creating new and modern means and modes by widely introducing the latest sci-tech achievements into the information and publicity work. He expounded the ways for conducting the work in the Party information field actively and creatively while stirring up the wind for putting it on modern and IT basis, including the issue of buckling down to the wide introduction of modern science and technology and other IT means to major forms of the Party ideological work like education, lecture and agitation, regarding it as an essential revolutionary task and the issue of adopting our own style of means and methods of the ideological work in a creative way by reinforcing and putting in motion talents. Kim Jong Un stressed the need to find out deviations from the Party information field in all aspects and take proper measures to enhance the promptness and effectiveness of the ideological offensive. He also called on officials in the Party information field to raise their level and capabilities to the maximum to meet the requirement of the revolution, the desire of the times and the expectation of the people. Those officials specialize in the work of dealing with the thinking of all sorts of people and therefore, they should possess high political awareness and multi-faceted abilities, he said, adding that only when the officials in the Party information field are brought up to be perfect elite elements possessed of high insight and qualifications, is it possible to further strengthen the entire Party politically and ideologically and overcome conventional and stereotyped work style in the ideological work and effect a great turn. He called on the officials in the Party information field to create examples and set experiences in making all the members of the Party study, mindful that a main key to bringing about a fundamental change in the Party ideological work lies in improving qualifications. He detailed broad issues ranging from the issue of stirring up the revolutionary study wind throughout the Party and society, especially the issue for the officials in the Party information field to make it a rule to study in a planned and serious way on a regular basis, the issue of establishing the trait of studying the Party's idea, the actual situation and one's work while racking one's brains all the time, the issue for the Party information officials to raise their composition and presentation skills, to the issue of building up the ranks of Party information workers with talents with extensive knowledge on the principle of selecting and promoting talents. He underscored the need to enhance the key role of the Information and Publicity Department of the Party Central Committee in radically improving the Party ideological work. The Information and Publicity Department of the Party Central Committee has to be a control tower of the Party ideological front and put efforts into the work of doing the Party ideological work in a tactical way on a long-term basis, he said, adding that it should take preemptive measures and set up the traits of doing all things in a perfect way so as to defend our revolutionary and ideological position. All the officials in the Information and Publicity Department of the Party Central Committee should raise their awareness as being masters in charge of the Party ideological front and carry out tasks entrusted to them on the highest level without any defect in practice. He also called for establishing the strict discipline in the information field throughout the Party, for the Party officials to give priority to the ideological work and set up the traits of active cooperation in the information field. Saying that in our country where the Juche theory of ideology is embodied under the leadership of the Workers' Party, all the officials should conduct the ideological work characterized by the mind of the people, he noted that they have to motivate the people. He continued that they have to find out and take charge of the work from the stand of assuming responsibilities if they are to help defend and consolidate the Party ideological position. The leading officials of the Party committees at all levels including the provincial, city and county committees should show deep care for the Party information field work ranging from designing and operation to execution, give their positive opinions and take the lead in solving knotty problems and creating examples, from the firm stand of taking full responsibility for the Party ideological work in their regions, sectors and units. The working traits of the Party committees should be the ones of orientating the overall work of its departments and officials to contributing to carrying out the ideological revolution and embodying the idea-first principle and solving all problems arising in the Party work through coordinated operation with the Information and Publicity Department, he said. The officials in the Party information field are doing lots of work, in fact, he said. He spoke highly of them, remarking that our Party's ideological front is being defended thanks to the officials in the information field who render great exertions for the mass education and ideological transformation while burning their hearts with the resolution to prove themselves worthy of the expectation of the Party and the people although they are pressed for everything. Genuine information workers desired by our Party are ardent loyalists who lay down their lives in order to defend the ideology and prestige of the Party, transparent-minded revolutionaries who are only intent on doing the revolution though they might be poorly fed and conscientious and able persons who fulfill the revolutionary tasks by displaying their qualification and good working traits, rather than their rights, he said, adding that our Party regards it as a great pride and strength to have the ranks made up of tens of thousands of loyal and stalwart Party information workers. The ideological revolution in the new era will certainly emerge victorious as there are standard-bearers in the ideological front and dependable pillars inspiring the people with the idea and intention of the Party Central Committee while sounding loudly the advance trumpet century after century and generation after generation the same way it was blown by the anti-Japanese guerrillas and the great and faithful people throwing in their lot with the Party to the last, he said. He ardently appealed to all to work hard to bring earlier the new victory of Korean-style socialism on the great strength of ideology, full of courage and confidence. The important letter sent by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un to the participants in the first workshop of officials in the information field of the WPK is an inspiring banner that instilled fresh vigor into the ideological front firmly guaranteeing and spurring the advance of the new era of state prosperity, and an immortal programme enabling to open up the new stirring era of the revolution by dint of ideology. Rodong Sinmun

title: Centenarian Receives Birthday Spread in DPRK
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un sent a birthday spread to Han Hyon Sik living in Jungsan-ri, Hwadae County of North Hamgyong Province on her 100th birthday. Han Hyon Sik, born into a poor peasant family before Korea's liberation, had to undergo the miserable lot of an enslaved nation, suffering every kind of humiliation and insult. She had dedicated herself to farming for decades, out of the mind to return the benevolence of President Kim Il Sung who liberated Korea and provided its people with the foundations for worthwhile life and happiness. With tens of her descendants, she is now leading a happy life in good health while doing housework and cultivating a family garden. Rodong Sinmun

title: University Graduate Volunteers Grow in Number
body: Tens of university graduates in Kangwon Province of the DPRK volunteered to work at the revolutionary battle sites in the area of Mt Paektu and schools in the forefront area, island villages and remote mountain villages. A graduate of Wonsan University of Education expressed the will to become a lecturer of the revolutionary battle sites in the area of Mt Paektu. Tens of graduates of Wonsan University of Education and Wonsan Ri Su Dok Teacher Training College volunteered to work at schools in the forefront area, island posts and remote mountain villages. A meeting of those volunteers took place at the Songdowon Youth Open-Air Theatre on March 27. There were a congratulatory address and speeches of pledge. After a congratulatory performance, provincial and university and college officials and students sent the volunteers off. Rodong Sinmun

title: Innovation Made in Timber Production
body: Officials and workers in the forestry sector of the DPRK are accelerating the production of timber for rural construction. Jasong and Kophung forestry stations under the Jagang Provincial Forestry Management Bureau have brought good results with the efficient timber-cutting method every day, while conducting the preparations for tree planting in the areas where trees were cut down in a cycling felling method. The Ryanggang Provincial Forestry Management Bureau directed efforts to cementing its material and technological foundation and allocated manpower and means in a rational way to make signal progress in timber production. Forestry stations under the South Phyongan Provincial Forestry Management Bureau have raised the rate of mechanization in the forestry work through a mass technological innovation movement, thus considerably increasing the felling amount per hour. Timber producers under the South Hamgyong Provincial Forestry Management Bureau make an innovation every day by strengthening the cooperation among stations and work-teams. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Photo Exhibition Opens
body: A national photo exhibition "Decade of Great Victory and Change" was opened in the DPRK to mark the 10th anniversary of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's assumption of the top posts of our Party and state. On display at the exhibition venue are photos dealing with the revolutionary activities of Kim Jong Un who ushered in a new era of self-sustenance and prosperity and an era of our state-first principle to be specially recorded in the nation's history of 5 000 years. The photos instill into the minds of visitors the high pride of the nation that has demonstrated the dignity of a power under the guidance of the peerlessly great man. They also show the greatness of the respected General Secretary who has steadily strengthened the Workers' Party of Korea into the invincible guiding force and a genuine motherly party. Besides, there are photos dealing with the exploits of Kim Jong Un who provided the most powerful military force and ushered in an era of the overall development of our own-style socialist construction. An opening ceremony took place at the April 25 House of Culture on March 27. Attending it were Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the WPK Central Committee, Sung Jong Gyu, minister of Culture, party information workers and officials concerned. Ri Il Hwan made an opening address. Rodong Sinmun

title: Motherly Look Kept in People’s Hearts
body: With Love of Feeling No Satisfaction In October Juche 102(2013) the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un inspected the completed Munsu Water Park. Making rounds of different parts of the park, he corrected shortcomings one by one. After he found that the joining part of a diving water slide was not flat on account of interstice, he asked accompanying officials to make the joining part of the slide slithery so that the people might never get hurt. Hardly repressing their emotions, the officials informed him that our people liked the modern water park very much. The respected General Secretary said that the water park was merely an initial step, adding that he would provide our people with more excellent conditions for cultural rest in future. The respected General Secretary with the intention to make our people lead civilized life feels no satisfaction with the work for people. Thanks to his love and endless care for the people, our people advance towards brighter future, enjoying socialist civilization. If There Is Slightest Inconvenience The respected General Secretary visited the Songyong General Restaurant one May day. While he was coming out of the chow mein restaurant on the second floor of the general restaurant after looking round it he stopped all of a sudden. Pointing at a white mark on a clear glass door he said a white cross mark was fixed on the large-glass door between the 2nd-floor hall and the chow mein house and it would be better to engrave the glass in some patterns such as floral ones. After a while he said that the glass walls should be engraved in patterns like white line or floral ones by sandblast and that would look nicer and help people recognize the glass wall soon.Everybody remained indifferent to the mark; however, the respected General Secretary paid meticulous attention not to allow any slightest inconvenience for people. How happy our people are with the respected General Secretary as the benevolent father! Rodong Sinmun

title: First Workshop of Information Officials of WPK Continues
body: Amid the growing enthusiasm of all the participants to bring earlier a new great victory of the revolution under the uplifted banner of the ideology-first principle, cherishing the important letter sent by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, the First Workshop of Officials in the Information Field of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) continued on March 29. Speeches were made there. The participants analyzed and reviewed in depth their past work in the light of the main idea and spirit of the letter. The speakers said that the important letter of the respected General Secretary is an undying great programme as it clarifies the most correct schemes and the best ways for drastically strengthening the political and ideological power, the greatest might of the Party and social system by making a fundamental turn in the work of the information field of the Party, as required by the historic stage of switching over to the comprehensive development of Korean-style socialist construction. The speakers told about their experience in the information and publicity work, in which they trained many ardent loyalists and true patriots in the great era of Kim Jong Un by applying fresh methods and giving priority to intensifying the education in the greatness of the leaders and in fidelity in order to give steady continuity to the traditions of single mind of the Korean people who trust and follow the WPK only. They stressed that it is the mission and duty of the information officials of the Party to instill deeper into the minds of all other officials and working people the personality of the respected General Secretary, a peerlessly great man who dedicates himself to translating into reality all dreams and ideals of the people, regarding it as the supreme principle of the Party and state activities to promote the people's wellbeing. They also referred to the successes made by the units which have taken the lead in implementing the Party policies by firmly turning the ideological work into the pivot of their Party work and the one involving the Party committees and pushing ahead with it in order to give full play to the mentality of officials and working people. It is the fundamental way for developing every unit to arouse the masses to an ideological campaign for implementing the Party policies, true to the instructions of the respected General Secretary that even an egg, when charged with ideology, can break a rock, they stressed. In order to make a substantial improvement in the Party ideological work, it is necessary to build up the ranks of the Party information officials in direct charge of the information and publicity work and effectively conduct the work for enhancing their responsibility and role, they added. They said that they have made marked progress in implementing the Party policies by making every work of the Party committees consistent with the ideological work and strongly urging all officials to proactively conduct the information and publicity work as a priority, as intended by the Party Central Committee stressing that all the Party members should be information workers and agitators. The speakers also referred to the innovative working styles and methods they applied to effecting a great revolutionary upsurge by launching an ideological campaign with an unyielding offensive spirit. They said that they, regarding it as the key to success in the efforts for implementing the Party policies to wage an intensive ideological campaign, always found themselves among the masses to raise the intensity of the ideological work when they faced unfavorable conditions, burdened with difficult and huge tasks, and thus helped them perform miracles and exploits ceaselessly. They stressed that they grasped the invaluable truth that the powerful ideological work just leads to a substantial success in the implementation of the Party policies and it is amplified by the innovative and resourceful operation and revolutionary enthusiasm of the Party information officials. Sternly analyzed and reviewed at the workshop were the tendency to formalism and failures at decisively improving the ideological work and the information and publicity work as required by the radically developing revolution. The speakers expressed their determination to fulfill their role as the faithful spokesmen of the Party Central Committee and buglers of the revolution in focusing the inexhaustible mental strength of the masses on the building of a prosperous and powerful nation, bearing deep in mind the instructions of the respected General Secretary that the ideology-first principle is the fundamental key to tiding over the difficulties and achieving a new victory and the mode of revolution peculiar to the WPK. The participants in the workshop entered a technical course for deeply understanding the theoretical and practical issues arising in the future ideological work. Rodong Sinmun

title: Technical Short Course on Dry-field Irrigation Held in DPRK
body: The Rihyon Vegetable Cooperative Farm, Sadong District of Pyongyang City in the DPRK held a technical short course on dry-field irrigation for the officials of the agricultural sector across the country. Attending the short course were officials of the Cabinet and the Agricultural Commission, chairpersons of provincial rural economy committees and other officials in the agricultural field. Introduced into the short course are the experiences of Pyongyang City gained in restoring and rehabilitating areas under the dry-field irrigation. The participants learned how they should build reservoirs and waterways and what principles they should rely on to irrigate various forms of dry-fields like sprinkler and furrow types. Irrigation facilities displayed in the short course caught participants' interest as they were created to suit the prevailing demands for implementing dry-field irrigation system and the actual conditions of their units. The short course stressed the need for all regions to learn experiences from Pyongyang City in building the dry-field irrigation to lay material and technical foundations for achieving stable and sustainable development in the agricultural production and securing water pumps and other dry-field irrigation facilities. Rodong Sinmun

title: More Rural Primary Officials Enrolled in Tele-education System in DPRK
body: Ryanggang Province in the DPRK has actively pushed ahead with the work to arm the rural primary officials with the advanced scientific farming method. While conducting the work to embrace more rural primary officials into tele-education system in connection with the cooperative farm management committees of cities and counties, the provincial rural economy committee has grasped the real state of the tele-education to take due measures. Hyesan University of Agriculture and Forestry scrupulously conducts such work for raising the quality of tele-education as constantly improving the teaching programme and putting all the teaching contents on a practical, comprehensive and modern basis. Enthusiasm for studying is getting higher among the rural primary officials enrolled in the tele-education system. Those in Samjiyon City and Kapsan, Taehongdan, Paekam and other counties acquire agricultural science and technology and the advanced farming technology through tele-education with a mind to bring about innovation in the farming this year. Not only the rural primary officials but also many agricultural workers in the province have high zeal to contribute to stepping up the rural revolution and development by acquiring much knowledge. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Ambassador Presents Credentials to Ghanaian President
body: Jon Tong Chol, ambassador of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea to Ghana, presented his credentials to Nana Akufo-Addo, president of the Republic of Ghana, on March 22. The ambassador courteously conveyed the greetings from Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the DPRK, to the Ghanaian president. The president expressed deep thanks for it and asked the ambassador to convey his heartfelt warm greetings to His Excellency Kim Jong Un. He hoped that the friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries that have developed from long ago would be further expanded in various fields. Rodong Sinmun

title: Supply of School Uniforms, Bags and Shoes to New Schoolchildren Begins
body: The supply of school uniforms, bags and shoes to new schoolchildren has started with the approach of the new school year. Thanks to the deep care shown by the Party to provide schoolchildren with fine school uniforms, the first national technical short course for producing new styles of school uniforms took place, and technique-teaching groups that consist of excellent researchers and technicians of the Garment Institute under the Academy of Light Industry and the Pyongyang City Garment Industry Management Bureau were sent to different parts of the country. Officials and workers in the sector of light industry worked hard to produce school uniforms, bags and shoes for new schoolchildren, and the people in different parts of the country gave unsparing material and moral support to the producers. The workers at Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill, Sinuiju Textile Mill and other textile mills stepped up the production of textiles for school uniforms and bags. Officials and workers of school uniform production units in Pyongyang City, North and South Phyongan provinces, North Hamgyong Province, etc. devoted themselves to the production of the products. The school bags and shoes production units in different parts of the country also dedicated themselves to the production of fine products suited to the ages and mental qualities of schoolchildren. Rodong Sinmun

title: Warm Care and Attentive Motherly Love
body: Pidan Islet Conveys His Motherly Love for People One June day Juche 107(2018), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited Sindo County. That day, the respected General Secretary acquainted himself with the state of affairs in the county and worked heart and soul to make the county self-sufficient in everything necessary for the economic life with powerful living resources. Noting that primary schools and middle schools should be well built in the county to improve educational conditions and environment so that the islanders could enjoy a civilized life, he saw to it that the powerful building force of the People’s Army would be mobilized to build the county people’s hospital and schools as exemplary units and standard units in the field of public health and education in our country and took benevolent measures for supplying necessary materials. Then he said that he would send buses and other vehicles to the county to provide the people with more convenient and cultured living conditions. After receiving the news of the field guidance given by the respected General Secretary on the rainy day, the people in Sindo County rushed out in streams to the road toward the dock. The islanders broke into cheers of hurrah at the top of their voices with sudden shock, joy, glory and happiness of meeting the respected General Secretary on a remote island which was not easy to visit for not only their parents and relatives but also the officials. Indeed, they live in the warm bosom of the great father, never feeling loneliness. He Personally Sets Hostel’s Site One day in June Juche 107 (2018), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited the Sinuiju Textile Mill in the northwestern part of the country. Going round various places of the factory that day, he was deeply concerned with the problem of a hostel of the factory. He said that the hostellers of the factory were very envious of hostels of the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill and the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Silk Mill which were provided by the Party, adding that he would let them have a similar hostel. He personally chose the site for the hostel of the factory and took benevolent measures to mobilize the powerful construction forces, spending his precious time for leadership of the revolution. Thanks to the warm love of the great father for our working class, an excellent palace for the workers was built on the bank of the River Amnok. The hostellers enjoy a happy life at the workers’ palace. The love of the great motherly Party reaches everywhere of our country. Rodong Sinmun

title: First Workshop of Information Officials of WPK Closes
body: The First Workshop of Officials in the Information Field of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) closed on Wednesday. There was a short course on the theoretical and practical matters arising in deeply studying and understanding the essence of the important letter of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un and bringing about a signal innovation in all spheres of the Party ideological work under the uplifted banner of the ideological revolution in the new era. Its lecturers included Ri Il Hwan, member of the Political Bureau and secretary of the WPK Central Committee, and educational workers of the Central Cadres Training School of the WPK. There was a study for correctly understanding the intention of the Party Central Committee to prioritize the ideological work as the very core of the Party work and propel and reliably guarantee the victorious advance of the revolution by dint of ideology and for arming with our Party's theory of giving importance to ideology. The workshop called for regarding it as the general orientation and target of the Party ideological work to model the entire Party and the whole society on the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's revolutionary idea. A speaker referred to the essential content and importance of the work for modeling the entire Party and the whole society on the revolutionary idea of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un who formulated the essence of the great Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism as the people-first principle through his outstanding ideo-theoretical activities and, on this basis, expounded in an overall way the theoretical and practical matters arising in building an ideal society for the people. He gave a detailed explanation on the principles and tasks to be maintained and carried out in the Party ideological work at present. He stressed the need to adhere to the principle of monolithic guidance system of the Party Central Committee as the lifeline in the Party ideological work and wage a resolute struggle against any action contrary to it, never overlooking such practice. It was stressed at the workshop that the ideological education should be conducted in an offensive way to train all the members of society into genuine loyalists and ardent patriots possessed of the revolutionary idea of the Party Central Committee as their faith and main quality. The speaker referred to the ways for intensifying the study for making the Party Central Committee's revolutionary idea one's faith and main quality. He said that the respected General Secretary's works should be studied in a substantial way to grasp their essence and in close combination with practice to implement the Party policies. He stressed the need to steadily intensify the five-point education with an emphasis put on the education in the revolutionary traditions and loyalty and strengthen the education through ideological education centers to train all the officials, Party members and other working people to be genuine revolutionaries remaining absolutely loyal to the leadership of the Party Central Committee. He underlined the need to correctly inform in time and explain theoretically the ideas, lines and policies of the Party which comprehensively indicate the orientations and ways for the country's development and prosperity and stabilization and improvement of the people's living and to accelerate the development of units through a fierce campaign for carrying out the three revolutions. He called upon the Party information officials to concentrate all rabble-rousing forces and means on the key units for developing the national economy and improving the people's living standard and launch a dynamic, steady and proper ideological campaign and wage an ideological offensive to eradicate anti- and non-socialist practices obstructive to the development of our-style socialism. Also emphasized was an issue of fundamentally innovating styles and ways of the ideological work of the Party as required by the era of fresh progress and dynamism of our revolution. The speaker made an analysis on the expressions of formalism appearing in the present ideological work as well as their detrimental effects, causes and lessons. He again called on the Party information officials to make strenuous efforts to possess high qualifications and abilities purposefully and consciously, launch an intensive and steady ideological campaign for smashing formalism and fundamentally innovate the styles and ways of the rabble-rousing work as befits the buglers of revolution glorifying the great era of Kim Jong Un. The workshop underlined the need to prioritize the motivation with visual aids and fresh methods and make the whole country pulsate with the idea of the Party Central Committee and seethe with the revolutionary spirit. The speaker underlined the need to turn the whole country into the venue for the education in the Party policies by displaying many slogans and mottos moving and encouraging the people of the times, waging the agitprop campaign on time through posters and making various news flash boards conducive to mass education. The speakers stressed the need for the Party information officials to go all out for accomplishing the historic cause of modeling the entire Party and the whole society on the revolutionary idea of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, bearing in mind their important responsibilities and duties assigned by the times and the revolution. There was also a lecture on the reactionary nature and harmful consequences of the imperialists' moves for ideological and cultural poisoning. Through the workshop, the participants kept in their minds the intention of the Party Central Committee prioritizing the ideological front and learnt the methodology for enhancing the infiltration of ideology and the effectiveness of the ideological work in line with the requirements of the revolutionary practice, the level of the people's consciousness and their changing mental state. And they exchanged their experience and lessons. Adopted at the workshop was a letter of pledge reflecting the participants' steadfast faith and will to become standard-bearers in the ideological front who will prepare all the members of society as ardent followers, passionate supporters and creditable implementers of the revolutionary idea of the respected General Secretary, cherishing the high honor of being information officials of the WPK leading the revolution in the ideology-first principle. Rodong Sinmun

title: Big Blasting Witnessed at Sunchon Limestone Mine of DPRK
body: The Sunchon Limestone Mine in the DPRK successfully carried out the blasting of 100 000 cubic meters of earth on Tuesday. Its officials and workers are now making innovation in ore transportation. Rodong Sinmun

title: Key to Performing Miracle Lies in Motivating Masses Spiritually
body: What He Emphasized Over and Again One November day in Juche 103(2014), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un inspected the Fishery Station No. 18. The fishery station had achieved unprecedented successes in fishing and won in several socialist emulations among fishery stations in the eastern coastal area, thus receiving congratulations from the respected General Secretary. Making rounds of the fishery station, the respected General Secretary said with satisfaction that, as it was no more than the fishermen who were directly in charge of fishing, the Party organizations and working people’s organizations in the fishery sector of the Korean People’s Army must pay careful attention to the livelihood of the fishermen. When he approached the hall of culture, the officials informed him of the fact that the fishery stations of the KPA were applying themselves to a 24-7 campaign in an effort to become the winner of the socialist emulation. The respected General Secretary said contentedly that the socialist emulation not only boosted the production but also brought about a turn in the people’s working spirit. He stressed the need to intensify ideological education of the fishermen and taught that fishermen must never be regarded merely as work force and that to motivate the masses’ spirit to the maximum decides the success of every undertaking. This unforgettable story shows us that the solution to all affairs of revolution is to give precedence to ideological work. Greatest Strength One June day, the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited a remodeled factory in Pyongyang. He said he couldn’t afford time because his hands were so full and only that day he managed to find time. Looking at a production building, he said it had been nicely arranged and asked which unit had built it. An official of the factory answered it was of the employees’ own building and told him stories about the construction. In fact, it was not so easy as it sounded to build a factory by their own efforts. However, the officials and employees buckled down with an extraordinary preparedness to splendidly transfigure their factory with their own hands at any cost. When the outer walls of the building were tiled, even the female employees of the factory joined the men in the work. At first, they were afraid of helping the work on scaffolds but they did everything on their own after all. After listening to the stories, the respected General Secretary said with a broad smile that it was important to give full play to the masses’ mental strength. He noted that it was nice of them to modernize the production lines and establish cultured ways of production and life but for them to encourage the producer masses’ spirits and make the factory modern by their own efforts was even more precious and that this could serve as a strength greater than that of a nuclear weapon. From his high appreciation, the officials reminded themselves of the truth that the masses’ mental strength was the very source of miracles. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Has Photo Session with Those Attending Workshop of WPK Information Officials
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), had a photo session with the participants in the First Workshop of Officials in the Information Field of the WPK on March 31. Present there were Jo Yong Won, Ri Il Hwan, Kim Jae Ryong, O Il Jong, Ju Chang Il, Ri Tu Song, Ri Hi Yong and Kim Yong Gwang. The venue of the photo session was seething with the great joy and excitement of the participants who are to have a significant photo taken with the respected General Secretary in the wake of receiving the immortal great programme, which brightly shows the path for making an ideological revolution in the new era, at the workshop of epochal significance in bringing earlier the great new victory of Korean-style socialism under the uplifted banner of the ideology-first principle. As the General Secretary came to the venue, all the participants broke into thunderous cheers of "hurrah!", looking up to him, symbol of the dignity and glory of our Party and state and the great leader of the Juche revolution who, with his distinguished wisdom and tested leadership, sounds the bugle of advance inspiring all the people and ushers in a new period of socialist construction with the great power of ideology. He gave encouragement and warm salute to the participants who have devoted themselves to the sacred and responsible work for cementing the politico-ideological position firmly supporting our Party, revolution and social system while making the masses have the same idea and breathe the same air with the Party at every worksite and post of the country. Saying that the Party information workers should become torchlight and thunder of the WPK in strengthening in every way the politico-ideological might, the greatest national power decisive of the victorious advance of Korean-style socialism and the invincible might peculiar to Juche Korea, the General Secretary expressed belief that the participants in the workshop would hold fast to the Juche theory of giving importance to ideology as the motive force of innovation, creation and advance and dynamically accelerate our revolution through a powerful ideological offensive rocking the whole country. Then he had a souvenir picture taken with them. All the participants hardened their strong will to glorify their high honor of being the information workers of the WPK in the sacred struggle to model the entire Party and the whole society on the revolutionary idea of the Party Central Committee, the immutable truth and the ever-victorious banner of the Korean revolution, and to dynamically propel the comprehensive development of socialist construction. Political News Team

title: National Experience-sharing Meeting of Forestry Sector Held
body: The Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea sponsored a national experience-sharing meeting of the forestry sector through video-conferencing on Tuesday and Wednesday. The meeting was aimed at sharing and widely generalizing sci-tech achievements and experiences made in afforestation and conservation. Attending it were officials, scientists, technicians and members of the three-revolution teams of 40-odd units. At the meeting, more than 20 pieces of sci-tech achievements and good experiences were presented. Introduced were breeding and cultivating techniques of high-yielding wild fruit trees from the Academy of Forest Science. Officials and workers of the forestry management sector in Pyongyang and Nampho cities and South Phyongan, Jagang and South Hamgyong provinces fully exchanged their opinions with a single mind to learn from advanced technology and experiences and introduce them creatively. Rodong Sinmun

title: University Graduates Volunteered to Work at Mountain Schools
body: Upholding the Party's policy of education, eight graduates of Kanggye University of Education and Kanggye Teachers Training College volunteered to work at schools in mountain villages. Among them are young people who were schooled at primary and middle schools for orphans. At the congratulatory meetings the volunteer certificates were awarded to them and congratulatory and oath-taking speeches were made. After the congratulatory performance was given, officials, teachers and students of the university and college warmly sent them off. Rodong Sinmun

title: Posters for April Spring Friendship Art Festival Produced
body: Posters for the 32nd April Spring Friendship Art Festival were produced in the DPRK. The posters with the emblem of the festival and letters "32nd April Spring Friendship Art Festival" reflect the ardent desire of the Korean people and the world progressives to celebrate with splendor the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung as the greatest national holiday and a grand auspicious event common to mankind. A poster "Let Us Sing Loudly the Song of Independence, Peace and Friendship!" depict female artistes in various national costumes who lift the emblem of the festival with the globe as background and pigeons flying in the blue sky. Posters depicting singers, instrumentalists and dancers reflect the single mind of artistes across the world to sing songs praising Kim Il Sung forever irrespective of their difference in ideology, political view, skin and language. Posters with scenes of specific performances given by experienced art, acrobatic and dancing troupes in several countries arouse the great public expectation and interest in the festival to which colorful numbers will be presented. There are also posters categorizing the organizations to participate in the festival. Rodong Sinmun

title: Posters for 7th April Spring People's Art Festival Produced
body: Posters for the Seventh April Spring People's Art Festival, to be held with splendor on the occasion of the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, have been produced. The posters portray the ardent thoughts and feelings of the Korean people to significantly celebrate the Day of the Sun as the most auspicious national holiday. They bear the letters "7th April Spring People's Art Festival", the emblem of the festival and its period. A poster with Kim Il Sung's birthplace at Mangyongdae and magnolia, the national flower of the DPRK, as background comprehensively introduces the names of categories of the festival. It reflects the noble loyalty, morality and sense of obligation of all the people across the country to add luster to the immortal revolutionary life and exploits of Kim Il Sung forever. A poster for a magic festival was also produced. Rodong Sinmun

title: Founding Anniversary of Grand People's Study House Marked
body: The Grand People's Study House in the DPRK marked its 40th founding anniversary. President Kim Il Sung indicated the orientation and ways for building the house as a modern structure of strong national coloring in a unique way while personally appointing the site for it and examining the miniatures several times. Chairman Kim Jong Il wisely led the whole course of its construction, taking detailed measures to provide manpower, machinery and equipment and materials necessary for the construction so as to make sure that the structure is successfully built in line with the far-sighted plan of Kim Il Sung. Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il visited the house on April 1, Juche 71 (1982) to proclaim its founding and took benevolent steps for turning it into a world-level library. Under the detailed guidance and deep care of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, the house is being further developed into a grand seat of learning for all the people and a base for the spread of sci-tech knowledge which plays a pivotal role in implementing the Party's policy on making all the people well versed in science and technology. Over the past years, it has stored a lot of foreign books and sci-tech documents and offered various forms of lectures, training courses and reading service, innovating the contents and methods for teaching, to contribute to the country's economic development and the improvement of the people's living standard. A meeting was held on March 31 to mark the 40th founding anniversary of the house. Attending it were Thae Hyong Chol, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Ri Song Hak, vice-premier of the Cabinet, and officials and employees of the house. Rodong Sinmun

title: Senior Middle School Graduates Volunteer to Work in Major Economic Sectors
body: Many young people in the DPRK have volunteered to work in difficult and labor-consuming sectors of socialist construction. More than 100 senior middle school graduates in North Phyongan Province volunteered to work at difficult worksites of socialist construction. Scores of graduates in Changsong County vowed to work at a sheep range and those in Sakju County decided to work at a mine. Ten-odd graduates of Insan Senior Middle School in Tongrim County volunteered to work at youth workteams and sub-workteams out of the desire to realize their dreams and ideal on the road of consolidating the socialist rural position. Graduates in other counties volunteered to work at a textile mill, county construction brigade, etc. There were congratulatory meetings for those volunteers. Rodong Sinmun

title: Progress Made in Mushroom Cultivation
body: Mushroom farms in different parts of the DPRK have increased the production by dint of science and technology. The Pyongyang Mushroom Farm raised the scientific level in mushroom cultivation through efficient sci-tech dissemination. The Ryugyong Mushroom Farm has steadily implemented its technology development plan. The Thaechon Mushroom Farm employed peat in growing mushrooms, while the Hamhung Mushroom Farm established a new technical process for cultivating mushrooms of various species through recycling of waste substratum. Rodong Sinmun

title: Great Treasure House Comprehensively Reflecting Admiration of World People
body: People throughout the world say with admiration that the International Friendship Exhibition House is the pride of the world. Its imposing figure reminds one of the meaningful gifts presented by the heads of parties, states and governments and celebrities, bodies and organizations from lots of countries in reverence of President Kim Il Sung. As the President lives as the everlasting Sun, the gifts to the President from the progressive mankind increase in number and voices in boundless reverence for and praise of the President still shake the Earth. The International Friendship Exhibition House will shine forever as the eternal treasure of socialist Korea, teaching everyone the truth of history that only a country and nation with a great leader can be great. Rodong Sinmun

title: New School Year Starts in DPRK
body: The new school year for Juche 111 (2022) has started in the DPRK. Early on the first day of the new school year, happy pupils and students all over the country headed for their schools in new school uniforms. They included those living at the foot of Mt Paektu and those living in areas along the demarcation line as well as those on remote islands in the sea. Pervaded the whole country on the day was deep reverence for the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, who indicated the way for the revolution in education in the new century by successfully inheriting the great achievements President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il made for the Juche-based education development. At Pyongyang Secondary School No. 1, Namsan Junior Middle School in Kaesong City and other junior and senior middle schools, students were full of resolutions to work hard to become world-level scientists and inventors. Primary schoolers including those of Pyongyang Primary School No. 4, Sinyang Primary School in Sariwon City, Namsong Primary School in Sinuiju City and Pukmun Primary School in Kanggye City pledged to become knowledgeable, virtuous and healthy future pillars of the country. Teaching staff and employees of schools for orphans across the country including those in Pyongyang and Wonsan cities renewed their resolve to bring up the children to be pillars upholding the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Press Statement of Secretary of WPK Central Committee Pak Jong Chon
body: Pak Jong Chon, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, made public a press statement on Saturday which said: I open to public this press statement because it is absolutely necessary for our people and army to get to know about the south Korean military's hysteric pursuit for confrontation with the DPRK. South Korean Minister of Defense So Uk reeled off a string of rhetoric at a ceremony for the reorganization of the "ground missile strategic command" on April 1. There he bluffed that the south Korean army has lots of missiles with various missions whose firing range, accuracy and power have been dramatically improved. He, citing a sign of missile launch by the DPRK, said that the south Korean army has ability to make precision and preemptive strike at the origin of launch and command and support facilities and has adopted a posture for it. He vowed to keep developing long-range, ultra-precision, high-performance and diverse ballistic missiles capable of containing the enemy in the future, openly revealing his intent to stoke up the military stand-off with the DPRK, whom he called an enemy. He must be crazy or silly to speak of "preemptive strike" on the nuclear weapons state. He is steeped in the mindset of stand-off to the marrows of his bones. Now the Korean peninsula is technically at war. Any slight misjudgment and ill statement rattling the other party under the present situation where acute military tension persists may become a spark triggering off a dangerous conflict and a full-blown war. This is a fact known by all. The provocative rhetoric made by the Defence Minister of south Korea against the DPRK under the present situation clearly shows the anti-DPRK confrontational frenzy of the south Korean military. As he provoked us, touting a preemptive strike, I will make one short warning representing our army. If the south Korean army engages in a dangerous military action as a preemptive strike against the DPRK, being guided by misjudgment, our army will mercilessly direct all its military force into destroying major targets in Seoul and the south Korean army. The south Korean military must not ramp up the tension with its confrontational acts. We know well that they are shaking in fear and uneasiness but are bluffing and making confrontational rhetoric to relieve its people of worries. It had better not bluff any more.

title: Press Statement of Kim Yo Jong, Vice Department Director of C.C., WPK
body: Kim Yo Jong, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, issued the following statement Saturday: The south Korean Defence Minister on April 1 revealed his confrontation hysteria with the DPRK, talking about "preemptive strike" on it. The senseless and scum-like guy dare mentioned the "preemptive strike" at a nuclear weapons state, in his senseless bluster which will never be beneficial to south Korea, either. He is a confrontation maniac engrossed in the mindset of confrontation with his fellow countrymen in the north. His reckless and intemperate rhetoric about the "preemptive strike" has further worsened the inter-Korean relations and the military tension on the Korean Peninsula. Now we can not but take his confrontation hysteria seriously and reconsider a lot of things. South Korea may face a serious threat owing to the reckless remarks made by its Defence Minister. As long as the south Korean military revealed its intent to seek provocative incentive of serious level and escalate a showdown with the DPRK, I will give a serious warning upon authorization. We will reconsider a lot of things concerning south Korea. South Korea should discipline itself if it wants to stave off disaster. I hope I don't hear him blustering again.

title: Participants in Workshop of Party Information Officials Tour Pyongyang City
body: Participants in the First Workshop of Officials in the Information Field of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) toured different parts of Pyongyang City. They visited Mangyongdae, the holy land of the revolution. The visitors made a round of the historical old home at Mangyongdae and the Mangyongdae Revolutionary Museum with deep emotion. They visited the Korean Revolution Museum, the great seat for education in the revolutionary traditions. Looking around the Hall of Great Leaders and Their Comrades-in-Arms, they hardened their conviction that the life of revolutionary soldiers would be immortal along with the prosperity of the country under the warm loving care and trust of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. The participants also went round the historic data and mementoes preserved at the Party Founding Museum and visited the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill, the Pyongyang Cornstarch Factory and the Central Class Education House. During the workshop, they enjoyed an art performance of a South Hamgyong provincial organization, which won high appreciation at the First People's Art Festival for Celebrating the Day of the Shining Star, and drama "Making Selfless, Devoted Efforts" and other cultural events. Rodong Sinmun

title: Mangyongdae Prize Sports Games Open
body: The Mangyongdae Prize Sports Games opened to celebrate the Day of the Sun, the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Players and coaches of the April 25 Sports Team, the Amnokgang Sports Team, the Amnokgang Defence Sports Team and other professional sports organizations will take part in the sports games. Competitions in 470-odd categories of 27 events such as football, basketball, volleyball and weightlifting are to take place in 13 cities and counties (districts), including Pyongyang City, Sinuiju City of North Phyongan Province, Yangdok County of South Phyongan Province and Hamju County of South Hamgyong Province. There was an opening ceremony at the Basketball Gymnasium in Chongchun Street of Pyongyang on April 1. Attending it were Kim Song Ryong, vice-premier of the Cabinet, Ri Tu Song, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and vice-chairman of the National Sports Guidance Committee, officials concerned and sports persons. Kim Il Guk, minister of Physical Culture and Sports, made an opening address at the ceremony. The sports games continue till April 29. Rodong Sinmun

title: Industrial Art Works Produced in DPRK
body: The industrial art sector of the DPRK produced industrial art works to gorgeously decorate the streets of Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, on the occasion of the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Different units including the Korean Industrial Art Studio, Pyongyang University of Fine Arts and Pyongyang University of Publishing and Printing completed designs of signboards and advertisements for more than 100 public service facilities to be set up in Songhwa Street and Kyongru-dong. The units of manufacturing signboards are now pushing ahead with manufacture and installation of signboards at those public service facilities. The creators in the field of industrial art produced designs of specific flowerpots for decorating every street. The user-friendly designs for decorating bridge-railings, underground crossing railings and fences and those of flowerpots for decorating street lamps can be applied anywhere in the city. Rodong Sinmun

title: Environment for Production and Living Improved Everywhere
body: It is balmy April. Scenery of the spring in which fauna and flora thrive again is beautiful. However, more conspicuous is the looks of people making efforts to turn their streets, villages and worksites into socialist fairylands. Thanks to those who turn out as one with self-consciousness of being masters and their meticulous work attitude, the country is being transfigured day after day. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respect of Mankind for President Kim Il Sung
body: President Kim Il Sung in his lifetime brightened the 20th century as the one of independence and set world-historical examples for the revolution and construction with his rare wisdom, outstanding leadership and noble virtue. Ardent respect of the world people for the President, who founded the immortal Juche idea and illuminated the way ahead of the progressive humankind with his outstanding ideological and theoretical activities, produced many designations. Such designations as "founder of the idea for mankind", "genius of ideology in the 20th century", "outstanding philosopher" and "sun brightening the future of mankind" represent their boundless trust in the President who provided them with precious ideological and theoretical wealth. And such designations as "peerlessly great hero with wisdom of brilliant commander and extraordinary military arts", "supreme commander of mankind", "encourager of peace and friendship", "defender of justice", "great man leading the world revolution" and "popular leader recognized by all people of the world" vividly reflect the fervent respect of the mankind for the President who pioneered the era of independence, a new era of history. The designations comprehensively reflect the will of all people to hold the President, veteran of the world revolution and peerlessly great man representing the 20th century, in high esteem as the eternal sun. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Inspects Pothong Riverside Terraced Residential District
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected the Pothong Riverside Terraced Residential District built in Kyongru-dong, Central District. Accompanying him were Jo Yong Won, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretary for Organizational Affairs of the WPK Central Committee, Ri Hi Yong, first vice-department director of the WPK Central Committee, and Kim Yo Jong, Hyon Song Wol and Kim Yong Su, vice-department directors of the WPK Central Committee. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un was greeted by leading officials of the designing organ and construction unit in field. The terraced residential district built in Kyongru-dong in a unique way will be homes of working people including labor innovators in various fields, persons of distinguished services, scientists, educators and writers who devote themselves to the Party and the state, reflective of the loving care of Kim Jong Un. Kim Jong Un, who pays special attention to the provision of more affluent and wonderful living conditions to our people and signal development of the level of civilization in the capital city and the Juche-oriented architecture, mapped out a plan for building a special residential district by harmoniously arranging terraced, many-storied and low-storied dwelling houses and facilities for public service in the best place on the bank of the Pothong River flowing across the city center, a year ago. He then examined a lot of designs and layouts over the past one year and solved every problem arising in the construction with his energetic guidance. The residential district of unique form built under the direct guidance of Kim Jong Un has successfully been completed to provide the residents with the maximum convenience for their living. Luxury dwelling houses have been built in good harmony with the surrounding environment, and landscaping in the area been improved. As a result, the level of the civilization in the city and scenery of the Pothong riverside have undergone a radical change. Going around the district for a long time, he said that the builders made a lot of efforts to implement the Party's decision in the past one year, true to the Party's policy on construction, and that a model residential district of new form to which our Party's idea on architectural beauty has been thoroughly applied and wonderful combination of modernity and convenience are ensured was created in the central part of the capital city thanks to the ardent loyalty and labor efforts of the builders. He said with satisfaction that the Party Central Committee is very pleased over it.
