He stressed repeatedly that the experience gained in building the new model residential district in Kyongru-dong is of very important significance in carrying out the immediate task for construction in Pyongyang and in provinces put forward by our Party under its plan to build dwelling houses extensively across the country. He called on designing institutions at all levels in Pyongyang and in provinces to keep making exertions to widely introduce standard, achievements and experience gained in such architectural and landscaping designs, and further develop the level of designing theory for all fields to meet the daily increasing demand of our people in living. The designing institutions and educational organizations at all levels need to focus on making the detailed examination of the world level in landscaping designing in particular and actively introducing landscaping standard and methods to suit to the specific conditions of our country and taking decisive measures for establishing and developing in a unique way the landscaping designing theory of our own style. He underscored the need for the urban management field and relevant units including designing institutions to take strong measures so as to give scientific and theoretical precedence to landscaping designing for improving the environment in the capital city and seats of provinces, cities and counties across the country, and to do landscaping in the development-oriented way in conformity with the natural and geographical features of relevant regions and with the modern trend. He gave important teachings about the strategy for the development of the Juche architecture, noting that the construction is an important political work of increasing the overall power of the country and leading our people to socialist civilization of our own style. He learned about the construction, looking round interior of dwellings of various styles for hours. Saying that the interior of the houses are convenient for the living of people, he was so pleased to provide again our working people with more wonderful houses. He told officials to hand over entrance certificates to those selected in various fields and hold significant completion ceremony before the significant Day of the Sun. All the officials and builders were full of firm pledge to perform greater miracles and innovations with soaring spirit to lead the world in the worthwhile endeavors of building a civilized powerful country, bearing in mind the patriotic devotion of great efforts made by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un for the prosperity of the country and happiness of the people. Political News Team

title: Indonesian Figures Pay Congratulatory Visit to DPRK Mission
body: Figures of Parliament, government, political parties, organizations and institutions of Indonesia and the Indonesian ambassador to the DPRK paid a congratulatory visit to the DPRK mission on March 29, on the occasion of the 20th anniversary of the meeting between Chairman Kim Jong Il and Megawati Soekarnoputri, president of Indonesia. Floral baskets in the name of the Asia-Pacific and Africa of the Foreign Ministry, Central Directive Council of the Democratic Party of Struggle and the Indonesia-Korea Association for Friendship and Cultural Exchange and bouquets were laid before the art work depicting President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il standing together. The Indonesian figures looked round the photos of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il visiting Indonesia, photos of the meeting between Kim Jong Il and Megawati Soekarnoputri and photos documenting immortal feats the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un performed for strengthening the national power. They watched a DPRK film showing the historic visit of Kim Il Sung to Indonesia and a video showing socialist Korea being spruced up day by day. Rodong Sinmun

title: Young People Volunteer to Labor-Consuming Field in First Quarter of Year
body: More than 2 420 young people volunteered to work at factories, enterprises and farms in the key industrial field of the national economy and in the fields of agriculture, building and forestry and schools in mountain villages in the first quarter of this year, according to data available. The volunteering trend has gained momentum after the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Over 80 young people in the capital city volunteered to work at coal mines and farms, in hearty response to the call of the country. More than 650 volunteers were from North and South Phyongan provinces. Over 440 youngsters of South Hwanghae Province volunteered to work in the agricultural field of the province, while over 250 from North Hwanghae Province and Jagang Province vowed to work in the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex and other major fields. Those who volunteered to work on co-op farms and in pit faces of coal mines numbered over 190 in Kangwon Province. Over 210 from North Hamgyong Province pledged to work at coal mines, the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex, the Musan Mining Complex, the stock-breeding base in Sepho area and Jungphyong Vegetable Greenhouse Farm. Joining the ranks of the volunteers are over 260 officials of the youth league and young people in South Hamgyong Province. Young people of Ryanggang Province and Nampho, Rason and Kaesong cities also volunteered to work in difficult and labor-consuming fields. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Premier Inspects Different Cities and Counties in North Phyongan and North Hwanghae Provinces
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, inspected some cities and counties of North Phyongan and North Hwanghae provinces. Going round local industrial factories, an organic compound fertilizer factory and a farm in Cholsan and Sonchon counties and Jongju City of North Phyongan Province, the premier said that success in the work for implementing the decisions of the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee mainly hinges on the scrupulous and stubborn organizing ability of officials and their high creativity and devoted service. He stressed the need to provide sustained and stable conditions for improving the people's living standard and developing the local economy and agriculture by consolidating the material and technical foundations of local industrial factories and agricultural production with locally available raw materials on the principle of self-reliance and self-sufficiency. At Hwangju Primary School in Hwangju County where the new school year began, he learned about the supply of school uniforms, shoes, bags and things to the new pupils and urged the officials to devote their wisdom and ardor to the work for improving the educational conditions, true to the noble intention of the Party which regards the work for the rising generations as the most important affair. Making field survey of the construction of the Kwangchon Chicken Farm and the Hwangju-Kindung waterway and the farming situation of Yonthan County, he called for pushing ahead with the construction projects of weighty significance in the people's dietary life and the agricultural development as planned and supplying the farming materials in time. Discussed at the field consultative meetings were such issues as activating the production of organic compound fertilizer, raising the mechanization rate in farm work, doing sowing and other farm work in a scientific and technological way according to farming processes, putting the afforestation at the Kwangchon Chicken Farm in a qualitative way, providing necessary equipment and materials needed for construction projects in a responsible way, supplying quality dairy products to the children on a normal basis and scrupulously organizing the production of school uniforms. Rodong Sinmun

title: Party Information Officials Inspire Builders and Workers in Pyongyang
body: The participants in the 1st Workshop of Officials in the Information Field of the Workers' Party of Korea on Saturday conducted political activities and rabble-rousing campaigns for increased production at the construction site of 10 000 flats in the Hwasong area and at units in the capital city of Pyongyang inspected by the great leaders. They visited the bustling construction site in the Hwasong area, where they realized how great the peerlessly great man's warm love for the country and the people is in front of the two meaningful fir trees. They handed inspiring letters reflecting the warm feelings of the people across the country and aid materials they prepared for the builders. And they congratulated builders on their innovational achievements, instilling into them the honor and pride of bringing earlier the ever-changing happiness and development in our era by their own efforts. By conducting rabble-rousing campaign for increased production at the Pyongyang Thermal Power Plant, they appealed to its workers to make uninterrupted innovations and advance to attain the goal of victory set at the Party Congress, by inheriting generation after generation the fighting traditions of the preceding generations who remained faithful to the Party in the spirit of devotedly implementing its policies. At the Mangyongdae Vegetable Farm in Mangyongdae District and other farms associated with the leadership exploits of the Party, the participants helped agricultural workers with their work, while explaining the noble intention of the Party which set forth a new programme for socialist rural construction. Hearing the inspiring songs sung by Party information officials, the industrial and agricultural workers awakened themselves to their responsibility for defending the forefront, the main thrust of socialist construction and pledged to tangibly contribute to the prosperity and development of the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: His Traces of Devotion Full of Noble Love for People
body: Picturing People Full of Delight One June night, Juche 107(2018), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un inspected the Pyongyang Taedonggang Seafood Restaurant near completion. Having a view of the first floor full of indoor pools teeming with fishes, the respected General Secretary said that our people, the best people in the world who had followed Chairman Kim Jong Il alone through hardship and ordeals, must be provided with the highest civilization as early as possible. His words reflected his sincerity for the people. He pictured to himself the people full of delight looking round the pool for big hiatellas and enjoying a bird’s eye view of the Taedong River on the balcony on the first floor, which brought a smile of happiness to his face. By the time he had finished the tour of the restaurant, it was nearly the dawn of the next day. However, he was greatly satisfied with the fact that another excellent service center for the people had been provided and taught that the restaurant must win high appreciations of the people and become a wonderful service base for the people where the Party’s noble love for the people came into full bloom. As we have the respected General Secretary who regards the people’s delight and happiness as his greatest delight and pride and makes devoted efforts for the people, the epics of love for the people continue in our country. Volunteering as Honorary Manager One May day, the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un inspected the Sinpho Distant-Sea Fishery Complex. At the room dedicated to its history, he looked back upon the immortal exploits of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il who had frequently visited the complex to feed the people with fresh fishes all the year round. Then he said with deep emotions that the President and the Chairman had worked heart and soul for the development of the fishing industry sector, noting that the fishing industry had to be developed to improve the people’s dietary life. Then he said he was going to be the honorary manager of the complex and reenergize the complex first of all. The officials were touched by the fervent will of the respected General Secretary who was anxious to bring about a turn in improving the people’s dietary life by creating a new history of "gold seas" true to the intentions of the President and the Chairman. That day, he earnestly stressed the important duty of the fishing industry sector in improving the people’s living standard and their dietary life. He also took attentive care of all the problems ranging from the one of securing modern fishing vessels to the one of the fishermen’s working uniforms. Thanks to his energetic guidance, a new history of "gold seas" has been opened in our country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Sun of the Nation, Peerless Hero
body: Life of Great Sage of Mankind The people in the DPRK and the progressive peoples in the world are growing keener in their yearning and reverence for President Kim Il Sung with the approach of the 110th birth anniversary of the most distinguished thinker and theoretician, a prominent statesman and an ever-victorious iron-willed brilliant commander representing the 20th century. He, after embarking on the path of revolution in his teens, devoted everything solely to the independent cause of the popular masses for over 70 years and thus made undying revolutionary achievements. He founded the ever-lasting Juche idea and defended with honor the sovereignty of the country and the nation by defeating two imperialisms in one generation. He also established the most advanced socialist system where everything belongs to the people and everything serves the people and built a powerful socialist country, independent, self-sufficient and self-reliant in national defense. He steadfastly safeguarded the people-oriented socialism of our own style and demonstrated its might to the whole world. He is a great father who believed in the people as in heaven throughout his revolutionary career and made devotions for the people. He worked heart and soul for the country’s prosperity and the people’s happiness till the last moments of his life. He was boundlessly admired and revered by the Korean nation and the progressive peoples of the world for the remarkable exploits he performed for the independent reunification of the country and the global cause of independence. The great life of President Kim Il Sung who lives for eternity as the Sun of Juche in the hearts of mankind will shine forever in the human history. (To be continued.) Rodong Sinmun

title: Sun of the Nation, Peerless Hero
body: Sun of Mankind Has Risen With the approach of the Day of the Sun, our people visit President Kim Il Sung’s birthplace in Mangyangdae, a sacred place of revolution. President Kim Il Sung was born on April 15, Juche 1 (1912) and spent his childhood in the simple straw-thatched cottage, which could be easily found in all parts of Korea before liberation. The President’s birth brought the dawn of Korea and made our people and progressive mankind of the world greet the new era of independence. The President achieved the historic cause of national liberation through the 20-odd years of bloody anti-Japanese armed struggle after he embarked on the road of revolution. In those days he inspired our people with the hope of national rebirth and opened the era of independence with the faith that our own strength only was dependable. Our people and the progressive mankind of the world will eternally convey his immortal exploits with historic Mangyangdae and with the Day of the Sun. (To be continued.) Rodong Sinmun

title: Press Statement of Vice Department Director of C.C., WPK Kim Yo Jong
body: Kim Yo Jong, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), released the following press statement on April 4: So Uk, defense minister of south Korea, on April 1 revealed extreme uneasiness, touting a "preemptive strike" on our army's possible strike means against south Korea. His abrupt bluffing evidently showed that they are so frightened. It seems that he wanted to give impression to the public that the south Korean army is well prepared. But it was an irretrievable very big mistake that he, so-called representative of the south Korean army, talked about "preemptive strike", terming us enemy. We have already clarified that south Korea is not our principal enemy. In other words, it means that unless the south Korean army takes any military action against our state, it will not be regarded as a target of our attack. We oppose war. If the armies of the two sides fight against each other, the entire Korean nation will suffer a disaster as it did half a century ago that might be more terrible, no matter which side will win or lose in a war or combat. We are definitely against such war. That's why our Marshal clarified that our principal enemy is just war itself. However, the south Korean army, labeling us as enemy, talked about the possibility of mounting a preemptive strike on us with such a premise as in certain circumstances. Such nonsense itself is a very dangerous and nasty expression. If anyone does not provoke us, we will never strike it before anything else. But if south Korea, for any reason - whether or not it is blinded by misjudgment - opts for such military action as "preemptive strike" touted by So Uk, the situation will change. In that case, south Korea itself will become a target. Two days ago, we solemnly warned that the south Korean army will face an unimaginably terrible disaster, the worst-ever, if it violates even an inch of our territory. In case south Korea opts for military confrontation with us, our nuclear combat force will have to inevitably carry out its duty. It is the primary mission of the nuclear force to prevent such war before anything else, but in case of war, its mission will convert into the one of eliminating the enemy's armed forces at a strike. One's nuclear combat force is mobilized to take initiative at the outset of war, completely dampen the enemy's war spirits, prevent protracted hostilities and preserve one's own military muscle. If the situation reaches such phase, a dreadful attack will be launched and the south Korean army will have to face a miserable fate little short of total destruction and ruin. This is not just a threat. This is a detailed explanation of our reaction to possible reckless military action by south Korea and its consequences and, at the same time, a briefing on the reason why south Korea should not harbor such fancy as military provocation against a nuclear weapons state. But there is a way for averting such miserable end. It will be possible to avoid the above-said horrible disaster, if it refrains from making untimely provocation and dreaming a daydream and ponders over a way for protecting itself from a shower of fire, although it might not happen. "Preemptive strike" against a nuclear weapons state? … This is a fantastic daydream, and it is hysteria of a lunatic. We make it clear once again. We will not fire even a single bullet or shell toward south Korea. It is because we do not regard it as match for our armed forces. This opinion comes not from an obvious contrast with a nuclear weapons state in the light of military capabilities but from the fact that the north and the south of Korea are of the same nation who should not fight against each other. I pray that such morbid symptom as feeling threat for no ground would be cured as early as possible.

title: Pyongyang Noodle House Marks Its 30th Founding Anniversary
body: The Pyongyang Noodle House in the DPRK marked its 30th founding anniversary. Chairman Kim Jong Il took the initiative in building the largest noodle house in Thongil Street and personally named it "Pyongyang Noodle House" on April 3, Juche 81 (1992) ahead of its opening. Employees and officials of the Pyongyang Noodle House have recorded a 30 year-long history with their service activities and successes conducive to the improvement of the citizens' dietary life and the development of the country's culinary culture. A meeting was held on April 3 to convey a congratulatory letter from the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea to the employees and officials of the Pyongyang Noodle House on its 30th anniversary. Attending it were O Su Yong, secretary of the WPK Central Committee, and officials and employees of the house. O Su Yong read out the letter. The WPK Central Committee in the letter highly appreciated the employees and officials for having devoted themselves to the happiness of the people and the development of the culinary culture of our nation with boundless loyalty to the leader and the spirit of devoted service for the people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Choe Ryong Hae Inspects Phyongwon County of South Phyongan Province
body: Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, inspected Phyongwon County of South Phyongan Province. He called on the officials of the Phyongwon County People's Committee to always cogitate and strive to thoroughly embody the people-first idea of the Party, stressing that deputies to the people's assembly, in particular, should fulfill their responsibility and role as representatives and faithful servants of the people in correctly implementing the policies of the Party and the state. Inspecting the Wonhwa Co-op Farm, the mother tree nursery, the condiment factory, etc. in the county, he gave pep talks to their officials and workers going all out for making innovations at every worksite to crown this meaningful year with great auspicious events of revolution, true to the decisions of the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Party. He called for meticulously organizing the spring farming decisive of the success in this year's farming in line with the sci-tech requirements and improving the living environment of the rural inhabitants as early as possible by successfully pushing ahead with rural construction in conformity with the standard set by the Party. He also underlined the need to direct efforts to increasing the production of consumer goods by stepping up the remodeling and modernization of local industrial factories. He stressed the need to properly conduct the afforestation and conservation of forests and launch a campaign for massively propagating good species of trees like Sangwon poplar in a methodological way, well aware of the noble intention of the Party Central Committee to turn the whole country into a socialist paradise with thick forests and bequeath it to posterity. Referring to the importance of the work to establish the revolutionary law-observing climate throughout society, he urged officials to strictly observe the state laws in production and management and apply the fresh methods for intensifying the education of the masses in law-observance in various forms. Rodong Sinmun

title: Lots of Study Tour Groups Visit Revolutionary Battle Sites and Historic Sites in Mt Paektu Area
body: The revolutionary battle sites and historic sites in the area of Mt Paektu are now visited by people every day in the run-up to the Day of the Sun, the auspicious national holiday. Recent visitors included officials and working people and youth and students in Samjiyon city people's committee, Samjiyon University of Technology, city people's hospital and Junghung Farm. They paid floral tribute to the mosaic in Sobaeksu valley picturing the peerlessly great persons. Looking round the native home of Chairman Kim Jong Il in the secret camp in Mt Paektu, they recalled in deep emotion the revolutionary career of the Chairman who rose as a shining star over Mt Paektu and made great achievements for the country, people, times and history. At the headquarters log cabin by which the red flag of the revolution flutters high, they deeply grasped the undying feats of President Kim Il Sung who led the anti-Japanese revolutionary war to victory. They also toured the shore of Lake Samji and a group of subsidiary theme sculptures, being briefed about the wonderful construction of the Samjiyon Revolutionary Battle Sites as a center for education in the revolutionary traditions. They headed for Chongbong Bivouac, Konchang Bivouac and Rimyongsu Revolutionary Historic Site, recalling the great efforts exerted by our Party to turn the area into an extensive open-air museum for education in the revolutionary traditions. Rodong Sinmun

title: University Graduates Volunteer to Revolutionary Battle Sites and Mountainous Schools
body: Graduates of universities of education and a teachers training college in South Hamgyong Province volunteered to work at the revolutionary battle sites in the area of Mt Paektu and schools in remote mountain villages. They included those from Sinpho Kim Hyong Gwon University of Technology and Education, Hamhung University of Education and Hamhung Choe Hui Suk Teachers Training College. At the congratulatory meeting in which Ri Jong Nam, chief secretary of the South Hamgyong Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials concerned and youth and students took part, the volunteer certificates were awarded to them and congratulatory and oath-taking speeches were made. Officials and youth and students of the province and the universities and college sent them off. Rodong Sinmun

title: Sun of the Nation, Peerless Hero
body: 250-mile Journey for Learning Made at Age of 11 President Kim Il Sung made a 250-mile journey for learning in his teens with an ambition to win back Korea usurped by Japanese imperialists. One day in the early Juche 12(1923), Kim Hyong Jik, father of the President, said to him that it would be good to go to the homeland and continue to study there and a man born in Korea must have a good knowledge of Korea. True to his father’s intention, the President set out on a 250-mile journey for learning in March Juche 12(1923). Covering the journey, he deeply felt that our people were indeed the greatest in the world and he made a firm resolve to make a revolution for rescuing the country and nation groaning under the colonial rule of Japanese imperialism. Remembering those days, the President in his reminiscences "With the Century" wrote as follows: "The profound meaning of what my father had said to me on my departure about learning about Korea came home to me. As I remembered his instructions, I closely studied my unfortunate homeland. The 250-mile journey was, for me, a journey of learning about my homeland and my fellow countrymen." Indeed, the 250-journey for learning was, for the President, a patriotic journey to make him deeply know about the country and nation writhing in sufferings and a journey of revolution to make him cherish a high ambition to annihilate the gangster-like Japanese imperialists and surely liberate the homeland. (To be continued.) Rodong Sinmun

title: In Days of Implanting Revolutionary Spirit of Mt Paektu in People’s Mind
body: Unshakable Faith In November Juche 102(2013), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited the Samjiyon Grand Monument. He said the Samjiyon Grand Monument whose erection was initiated and guided by Chairman Kim Jong Il is a heroic epic masterpiece as it makes a profound ideological and artistic representation of the exploits President Kim Il Sung performed by leading the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle to victory and the validity of the revolutionary cause of Juche, adding that it is marvelous and spectacular to see the big open-air museum. The visit to the monument, a treasure of eternal value of the Korean revolution and a base for education in the revolutionary traditions, offers an opportunity to harden the determination and will to accomplish the revolutionary cause of Juche started in Mt. Paektu, he noted. His instructions that day were reflective of his unshakable faith to bring earlier the victory of our revolution without fail by carrying forward the revolutionary traditions created in Mt Paektu pure and clean. Effective Ideological and Spiritual Remedy In May several years ago, the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un met with officials and underlined the need to engrave the revolutionary spirit of Paektu, the spirit of the blizzards of Paektu in their hearts. He said that what urgently needed for officials who must stand in the van of the grand struggle for building a powerful socialist country today is an unyielding fighting spirit of weathering obstacles and difficulties and a staunch militant spirit of rising up no matter how often they may fall and fighting it out. He went on to say that the powerful ideological and spiritual weapon that fosters such strong faith and will is none other than the revolutionary spirit of Paektu and the spirit of the blizzards of Paektu, which serves as the most effective ideological and spiritual remedy for clearing away every backward ideological viewpoint left in officials and revolutionizing them and a precious vitamin inspiring them with ardent enthusiasm for revolution and struggle. As Mt Paektu, the sacred mountain of revolution, is everlasting, the revolutionary spirit of Paektu is the eternal ideological and spiritual source enabling one to surmount all difficulties and ordeals. Officials made up their minds to hold fast to the revolutionary spirit of Paektu, the spirit of the blizzards of Paektu as the invincible weapon, regarding the instructions of the respected General Secretary as the unchangeable guideline. Rodong Sinmun

title: Rotating Pennants Awarded to Excellent Units in DPRK
body: The Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK and the Cabinet of the DPRK decided to award rotating pennants and official commendations to 298 industrial establishments and farms that distinguished themselves in fulfilling their national economic plans for Juche 110 (2021). Those units include the Unryul Mine, the Suphung Power Station and the Jongju Engine Service Brigade. Rodong Sinmun

title: Sun of the Nation, Peerless Hero
body: With Great Ambition for National Liberation It has been 97 years since President Kim Il Sung made a 250-mile journey for national liberation. The President left alone Mangyongdae in Pyongyang for Badaogou in China at the age of 13 and the Korean people are calling this course the 250-mile journey for national liberation. True to the intention of his father that a man born in Korea must have a good knowledge of Korea, he came to Mangyongdae for learning early in the 1920s. Then, he received the news that his father had been arrested again by the Japanese police. With a firm resolve to take vengeance for his father, his family and the Korean nation, he left Mangyongdae on January 22, Juche 14 (1925). He had spent only two years back in Korea. In those days, he got a clear understanding that Japanese imperialism was the most heinous destroyer of the liberty and dignity of the Korean people and a vicious aggressor and plunderer imposing unbearable poverty and hunger upon them and came to have a firm belief that such aggressors could be driven out through a struggle only. He arrived in Phophyong after the lapse of 13 days and crossed the Amnok River with a grim resolve not to return before Korea had become independent. Thanks to his 250-mile journey for national liberation, the Korean people could greet the spring of national liberation. Indeed, this journey was what could be taken only by the President, the peerless patriot and the hero of the nation. (To be continued.) Rodong Sinmun

title: National Photo Exhibition Opens
body: A national photo exhibition "Great Father of People" was opened in the DPRK to mark the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. On display at the exhibition venue are photos dealing with revolutionary career of the President who devoted his all to the happiness of the people, always finding himself among them with the noble idea of believing in the people as in Heaven. The photos show the leadership exploits of the President who projected the working class as the eldest son of the country and the devoted efforts he made to solve the food problem for the people, giving ceaseless guidance to the countryside. They also show the loving care and trust of him who trained the intellectuals into patriots contributing to the prosperous development of the country. The photos convey the solicitude of the President who pioneered the Juche-oriented youth movement and brought up the rising generations to be the reliable pillars of the country. There are also photos showing his loving care for the anti-Japanese revolutionary veterans, war veterans and children of revolutionary martyrs and his leadership exploits in rallying all Koreans in the north and the south and abroad under the banner of great national unity. Reminding the visitors once again of the fact that they have been blessed with the illustrious leaders through generations, the photos evoke boundless thankfulness for the great motherly Party doing its utmost to translate into reality the people's beautiful dreams and ideal. A ceremony of opening the exhibition took place at the People's Palace of Culture on Wednesday. Attending it were Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), Sung Jong Gyu, minister of Culture, Choe Hui Thae, chairman of the Pyongyang City People's Committee, Ri Myong Chol, secretary of the Pyongyang City Committee of the WPK, officials concerned and working people in Pyongyang City. Ri Il Hwan made an opening address. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Industrial Art Exhibition Opens
body: A national industrial art exhibition was opened with due ceremony at the National Industrial Art Exhibition House on Wednesday to celebrate the Day of the Sun, the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. On display at the exhibition venue are photos of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un inspecting the National Industrial Art Exhibition House and guiding the industrial art work and different sectors of the national economy. Presented to the exhibition on the theme of "Proud course of the developing industrial art shining with the history of the Sun" are at least 870 pieces of various designs, models, products, etc. showing the remarkable successes made in the field of industrial art under the wise leadership of our Party over the last 70-odd years. They include designs of motor-trucks and trolley buses appreciated by President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and designs of tram-car and 110 h.p. tractor guided by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. There are also art works for decorating structures and miniatures of such edifices as the Tower of the Juche idea, the Samjiyon Grand Monument, the Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery on Mt Taesong, Ryomyong Street and the Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace well showing the development of the industrial art. And displayed are art works of various kinds of clothing and spinning and weaving together with samples. Besides, there are designs of light industrial products including school supplies, school bags and cosmetics, trademark designs and other commercial art designs and trial products. Attending the ceremony were officials of the Cabinet, commissions, ministries and national institutions and creators and teachers in the industrial art sector. Vice-Premier of the Cabinet Ri Song Hak made an opening speech. The exhibition will go on till the middle of May. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Symposium Held in DPRK
body: A national symposium was held at the People's Palace of Culture here on Wednesday in celebration of the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Attending it were Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and Party and administrative officials, officials of the working people's organizations and information workers in charge of theory from armed forces organs, the fields of science, education, literature and art, media and the preservation of revolutionary relics and party cadres training institutions in Pyongyang. Presented to the symposium were papers explaining in depth the revolutionary achievements of the President and his wise leadership and noble traits. The speakers praised the President as the sun of Juche who, with distinguished ideo-theoretical wisdom as his natural gifts, founded the immortal Juche idea through his original and energetic ideo-theoretical activities in the arduous and gigantic revolutionary practice and thus ushered in a new era of development in the history of mankind. They stressed that he is the founder of socialist Korea who built on this land socialism centered on the popular masses in which the people's long-cherished desire was realized. They explained that the President is the ever-victorious iron-willed commander who led to shining victory the two revolutionary wars with all qualifications and abilities that commander should possess on the most ideal level. And they stressed that he is an elder statesman in the world as he provided the most correct guideline for the building of an independent new world and made great contribution to the victorious advance of the human cause of independence with his noble internationalist obligation and through his energetic external activities. They called for accomplishing the revolutionary cause of Juche to the end under the guidance of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, holding the President in high esteem as the sun of Juche forever. Rodong Sinmun

title: Sun of the Nation, Peerless Hero
body: DIU Formed by President Kim Il Sung in His Teens During his revolutionary activities at Hwasong Uisuk School in the mid-1920s, President Kim Il Sung made his effort to find a new way for liberating Korea from Japan’s colonial rule. He explored the genuine path of the Korean revolution, the road of independent development, provided the hard core for it and pushed ahead with the work to form a vanguard organization of the revolution. He told the young core members sharing the intention with him: We must open up a long and thorny path in order to liberate the country and build a society in which the working people can live happily; if we build up our ranks and fight tenaciously at the cost of our blood, we shall emerge victorious; after forming an organization we should rally the masses behind it and arouse them to liberate the country by relying on their own efforts. Later, he discussed the name of the organization and its character, fighting programme and norms of activities with them. Under such detailed preparations, the President formed the Down-with-Imperialism Union (DIU), a vanguard organization of the revolution, with young communists of the new generation on October 17, Juche 15 (1926). At that time, the President was in his teens. The immediate task of the DIU was to defeat Japanese imperialism and achieve the liberation and independence of Korea, and its final objective was to build socialism and communism in Korea and, further, destroy all imperialism and build communism throughout the world. The formation of the DIU was a historic declaration heralding the new start of the Korean revolution. Since then, the Korean revolution has advanced along the road of independent development with definite fighting target and strategy. (To be continued.) Rodong Sinmun

title: Traditional Musical Instruments, Pride of Korean Nation
body: The Korean people have created a lot of excellent cultural heritages in the music sector from olden times. Among them are musical instruments, pride of the nation. Such traditional instruments as kayagum, jotae and janggu are peculiar in shape and very graceful in sound. The national musical instruments rapidly developed to be modern under the care of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. Limitations were overcome and many new aspects were introduced. Today, the national musical instruments are favored by everyone as any song popular among the people can be played freely with them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Preparation for April Spring Friendship Art Festival Goes at Final Stage
body: The preparation for the 32nd April Spring Friendship Art Festival is being stepped up at a final stage. This world festival with a long history, hosted by Pyongyang, shows the world progressives' boundless reverence and worship for President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un. The coming on-line festival will be televised on the Central TV of the DPRK with video segments of art performances sent by art troupes and artistes of different countries through international communication channels. Attendees include more than 60 art troupes, dance troupes and circuses comprising of international and national concours winners and famous artistes from at least 30 countries and art troupes of overseas Koreans. They have exerted positive efforts to ensure the forthcoming festival at the highest level. Artistes of China and other countries strove to perfectly represent in chorus the immortal revolutionary hymn "Song of General Kim Il Sung". And those of the Russian State Academy Beryozka Dancing Troupe Named after N.S. Nadezhdina created a dance to the tune of song "A Dear Name". Foreign personages of political and cultural circles and artistes have sent to the festival organizing committee recorded congratulatory speeches and words of their impressions, boosting the atmosphere of the festival. The organizing committee is now engrossed in colorful edition of the videos on art performances in cooperation with relevant units. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Art Exhibition Marks Day of Sun
body: A national art exhibition was opened in the DPRK as part of the national fine art festival "The Cause of the Sun Will Be Everlasting" to celebrate the Day of the Sun, the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. On display at the exhibition hall are art pieces showing the revolutionary career and exploits of the President. Oil paintings and other art pieces deal with the history of revolutionary activities of the President who accomplished the historic cause of Korea's liberation and built a genuine country of the people on this land. Korean paintings portray the President who made a ceaseless journey of devotion till the last moments of his life. An acryl painting reflects the deep reverence of the Korean people and the world's progressives for the President, a peerlessly great man who contributed to the socialist movement and the human cause of independence. Korean paintings and other art pieces portray Chairman Kim Jong Il, a great man who remained faithful to the President's idea and intention. Exhibited are also art pieces including oil paintings and Korean paintings reflecting the fighting spirit, traits and steadfast faith and strong stamina the Korean people have displayed in every period of the revolution. And there are art pieces of different themes showing the stirring reality of the country in which a new era of thriving nation is opened under the leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, as well as the people who turned out in implementing the decisions of the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee and the schoolchildren full of happiness. A ceremony of opening the exhibition took place at the Okryu Exhibition Hall on April 7. Attending it were Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the WPK Central Committee, officials concerned, artists and working people in Pyongyang City. Minister of Culture Sung Jong Gyu made an opening address. On the same day, similar exhibitions were opened in Pyongyang City and each province. Rodong Sinmun

title: Party, State Commendations Conferred on Persons of Merit
body: On the occasion of the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, party and state commendations were conferred on officials, working people and servicepersons who have distinguished themselves in carrying out the Party's policies. A ceremony of awarding the commendations took place at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Thursday. Attending it were Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, and persons of merit. Choe Ryong Hae read out a decree of the SPA Standing Committee of the DPRK. Order of Kim Il Sung was conferred on Ri Il Nam, Tong Hun, Yun Song Chol and Kim Tong Gil. Hong Song Sik and Ri Kwang Ho were awarded the title of DPRK Labor Hero, together with Gold Medal (Hammer and Sickle) and Order of National Flag First Class. Watches bearing the august name of Kim Il Sung were conferred on Pak Ryong Nam, Ri Suk Yong and Choe Chol Jin and the citation of Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, on Kim Song Ho, Pak Kyong Sik, Kim Jong Nam, Ri Myong Jun, Ko Yong Nam, Kim Chol Nam, O Sung Nam, Pak Myong Gon, Jon Song Ryong, Jong Jun Do, Kim Jong Gon, Jang Yong Hwan, Jo Nam Ho, Ri Yong Chun, Rim Yong Mok, Han Yong Chol and Kong Myong Bok. The title of People's Scientist went to Ri Yong Il and Kim Yong Hwang, the title of People's Teacher to Hong Mi Hyang, the title of Merited Scientist to Tu Sung Il, the title of Merited Teacher to Ju Hyang, Kim Ryong Hui, Jon Hye Son, Choe So Ik and Han Myong Suk, the title of Merited Designer to Pak Chang Son, the title of Merited Technologist to O Yong Hwan, the title of Merited Historical Site Lecturer to Jang Yong Suk and Ri Ryon Hui, the title of Merited Smelter to Kim Hyon Chol, the title of Merited Electrician to An Myong Sam, the title of Merited Coal Miner to Ri Kyong Chol, Pak Yong Bok, So Kwang Il and O Kwang Song, the title of Merited Miner to Ri Jong Hak and Mun Song Ho, the title of Merited Mechanical Engineer to Kim Jong Hak, Cha Kwon Sok and Han Un Sam, the title of Merited Engineman to Kim Su Guk, the title of Merited Builder to Ri Jong Won, the title of Merited City Caretaker to Rim Kum Chol, the title of Merited Truck Driver to Ri Man Bok, the title of Merited Doctor to Ri Kap Ryon, the title of Merited Nurse to An Kyong Sil and the title of Merited Cook to Kim Son Yong, Kim Sok and Kim Ok Gum. Rodong Sinmun

title: Foreign Diplomats Visit Schools for Orphans in Pyongyang
body: Members of the diplomatic corps here Thursday visited Pyongyang primary and middle schools for orphans on the occasion of the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. The visitors went around different parts of the schools, which have been provided with perfect educational environment and living conditions thanks to the Workers' Party of Korea's love for the younger generation and future. They were deeply moved to see the happy life of orphans who are preparing themselves to be the future masters of the country while studying to their heart's content with nothing more to desire. Rodong Sinmun

title: "Among the People" Vol. 110 Published
body: The Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House brought out Vol. 110 of a collection of memoirs "Among the People" on the occasion of the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. The book has 18 memoirs on the wise leadership and noble personality of Kim Il Sung as a great man who provided eternal foundations for the victorious advance of socialist Korea and happiness of all generations to come with his ardent love for and devotion to the country and the people all his life. Contained in it is a historic fact that the President guided photographers to take many pictures of the working people out in building an independent and prosperous new Korea so as to encourage them in their struggle for nation building. There is a memoir dealing with the immortal exploits of the President who came out to the forefront line during the Fatherland Liberation War to inspire the civilians and servicepersons with the confidence in victory and lead them to war victory. A memoir tells about the fact that the President implanted the spirit of self-reliance deeper in the mind of officials, workers and technicians during the postwar Chollima upswing. There are also memoirs telling about the devoted efforts of the President who trained the Korean women, who had been subject to humiliation and insult in the past, into heroes and officials and had dedicated his all to the agricultural development of the country till the last moments of his great life. Besides, the book carries memoirs dealing with the noble personality of the President as a great man who made a ceaseless journey of field guidance to provide the people with affluent and highly-civilized life. And contained in it are memoirs on the historic facts telling about his extraordinary leadership traits. Rodong Sinmun

title: State Commendations Awarded to Persons of Merit
body: The Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK on March 10 issued a decree on conferring Order of Kim Il Sung, the title of DPRK Labor Hero together with Gold Medal (Hammer and Sickle) and Order of National Flag First Class, titles of honor and orders on officials, working people and servicepersons on the occasion of the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. They distinguished themselves in the struggle to implement the Party's policies. According to the decree, Order of Kim Il Sung was awarded to four persons, the title of DPRK Labor Hero to two, the title of People's Scientist to two, the title of People's Teacher to one, the title of Merited Scientist to one, the title of Merited Teacher to five, the title of Merited Designer to one, the title of Merited Technologist to one, the title of Merited Historical Site Lecturer to two and the title of Merited Smelter to one. And the title of Merited Electrician went to one person, the title of Merited Coal Miner to four, the title of Merited Miner to two, the title of Merited Mechanical Engineer to three, the title of Merited Engineman to one, the title of Merited Builder to one, the title of Merited City Caretaker to one, the title of Merited Truck Driver to one, the title of Merited Doctor to one, the title of Merited Nurse to one, the title of Merited Cook to three, Order of National Flag First Class to 133, Order of Labor to 357, Order of National Flag Second Class to 3 737 and Order of National Flag Third Class to 4 511, 8 777 persons in total. Rodong Sinmun

title: Sun of the Nation, Peerless Hero
body: Declaration of Foundation of Great Juche Idea The foundation of the immortal Juche idea! This is the most brilliant one of the great exploits performed by President Kim Il Sung for the Korean revolution and mankind. Kim Il Sung, who had groped for the new guiding ideology to liberate the country and rescue the destiny of the nation from the very start of his revolutionary struggle, stiffened his profound idea that the Korean revolution must be carried out by the force of Korean people in accordance with the specific conditions of the country. On June 30, Juche 19(1930), he made a historic report "The Path of the Korean Revolution" at Kalun Meeting. In the report he advanced the unique idea that masters of the revolution are popular masses: Korean people must carry out the Korean revolution themselves keeping with the actual condition of Korea, and on this base he clearly indicated the road ahead of the Korean revolution. His report that day was the great declaration of the foundation of the immortal Juche idea and the historic declaration of birth of the new era of independence, the one of Juche in which the popular masses emerged as the legitimate master of the history. Since then the Korean revolution has advanced vigorously along the unprecedented way, the road of Juche and recorded only victories in its history despite difficulties and trials. Although it has been a long time since the President advanced the path of the Korean revolution, the great Juche idea is still shinning brilliantly as the guiding idea of socialist Korea and precious guiding principle for implementing the cause of global independence. (To be continued.) Rodong Sinmun

title: His Devotion to Development of Agriculture
body: Issue He Paid Rapt Attention to In July Juche 107(2018), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited the Junghung Farm in the then Samjiyon County. Looking round a potato field of the farm, he said what he wanted to know with utmost care was the proportion and level of mechanization of potato farming. He noted that the level of the comprehensive mechanization of the farm should be raised decisively. He added that if they take into full account how many and what kinds of farm machines are needed to do all of the farm work with the help of machines without hesitation and inform the Party of it, it will work hard to carry it into reality and that it is the Party’s firm determination to build a farm of comprehensive mechanization where farmers’ ideal has come true. His words were reflective of his noble will to comprehensively mechanize the farms in Samjiyon County, the native place of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Experimental Farm of Party Central Committee One May day in Juche 104(2015), the respected General Secretary inspected the Farm No. 1116 again. Looking round the farm, he told the officials of the farm that very important were the position and task of the farm in implementing the Party’s policy for bringing about a radical turn in seed selection and the farm was an experimental farm of the Party Central Committee, which had been under the great care of Chairman Kim Jong Il and to which he has also paid primary attention. Underlining the need to increase state investment in the farm, further consolidate its material and technical foundation and build a modern greenhouse based on cutting-edge technology as it is a combined seed research and development base, he expressed his will to make sure that the project for the construction of the greenhouse is undertaken. The officials, full of fresh conviction and courage, made up their minds to repay the endless love and trust of the respected General Secretary at any cost. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Floral Basket from Lao President
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a floral basket from Thongloun Sisoulith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party and president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic, on the occasion of the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Lao Ambassador to the DPRK Sisavath Khamsaly conveyed the floral basket to Kim Song Nam, director of the International Department of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on April 8. Rodong Sinmun

title: Seminars Held in DPRK
body: Seminars were held in provinces of the DPRK to celebrate the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Present there were Party and administrative officials, officials of working people's organizations and information workers in charge of theory from Party cadre training institutions and the fields of education, literature and arts, media and preservation of revolutionary relics in provinces. Presented to the seminars were papers explaining in depth the revolutionary achievements of the President. Speakers praised the President as the sun of Juche who founded the immortal Juche idea and thus ushered in a new era of development in the history of mankind. They lauded him as the founder of socialist Korea who built on this land a socialist country centered on the popular masses, in which the people's long-cherished desire was realized, with his noble idea of believing in the people as in heaven and leadership. They stressed that the President was an ever-victorious and iron-willed commander as he defeated the powerful Japanese and U.S. imperialists in one generation with his gifted military wisdom and stratagem and outstanding commanding art. And they explained that he was a veteran statesman recognized by the world who made immortal contributions to the human cause of independence under the banner of independence and international justice. They expressed their will to accomplish the revolutionary cause of Juche under the guidance of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, holding the President in high esteem as the sun of Juche forever. Rodong Sinmun

title: Military Attaches Corps Here Visits Mangyongdae
body: Members of the military attaches corps here visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung, Friday on the occasion of his 110th birth anniversary. They went around the Mangyongdae Revolutionary Museum where historic relics and mementoes showing the revolutionary activities of Kim Il Sung and his family members in Mangyongdae are on display. At the old home of the President, they laid a floral basket in the name of the corps and looked round the historic relics preserved there with much care, being briefed on the stories about the time-honored home. On the same day, they visited the Korean Revolution Museum. They were told about exploits of the President and the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, at its different rooms. Rodong Sinmun

title: Stamp Show Opens in DPRK
body: A stamp show opened with due ceremony at the Korean Stamp Exhibition House on Friday in celebration of the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. On display at the show venue are a photo of stamps portraying the smiling images of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and stamps dealing with the revolutionary career and exploits of the President. Also exhibited are stamps showing the successes made by the Korean people in the annals of creation and construction and those intensively showing the present reality of the country where the intention and desire of the President and the Chairman are being translated into reality. And there are stamps on different themes presented by philatelists. Attending the ceremony were Ju Chang Il, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials concerned, officials and employees of the State Stamp Bureau of the DPRK, and philatelists in Pyongyang City. Ju Chang Il made an opening address. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Art Exhibition Opens in DPRK
body: A national art exhibition opened with due ceremony at the Korean Art Gallery on Friday in celebration of the 10th anniversary of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's assumption of the top posts of our Party and state. Displayed at the venue are excellent art works depicting the traits of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il as the great men. There are also those showing the successes gained by the Korean people under the leadership of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un and the appearance of the country undergoing a dramatic change. Among the exhibits are Korean paintings, oil paintings, woodcuts and others highly praising the General Secretary's exploits. Oil paintings, sculptures and metal handicrafts on show represent the ardent admiration for the peerlessly great men. Many art works, giving ideological and artistic descriptions of happiness of our people and the fighting spirit of the working people who are performing miracles and feats at every socialist construction theater, are also on display at the exhibition hall. Attending the opening ceremony were Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials concerned, artists and working people in Pyongyang. Sung Jong Gyu, minister of Culture, made an opening address. Rodong Sinmun

title: 25th Cooking Festival Held in DPRK
body: The 25th Cooking Festival took place at the Pyongyang Noodle House here from Wednesday to Friday to mark the Day of the Sun, the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. The festival brought together more than 100 units selected from the ministries and national institutions and public catering establishments and women's union organizations in the city of Pyongyang. It was divided into exhibitions of famous dishes, specified dishes and sci-tech achievements in cooking, a cookery contest and a demonstration of famous cooks. Presented to it were over 780 foods and drinks and more than 240 sci-tech achievements made by cooks in the city, true to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's noble outlook on the people. Attending the closing ceremony on Friday were Ri Song Hak, vice-premier of the Cabinet, Minister of Commerce Pak Hyok Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the Korean Association of Cooks, Ri Yong Min, director of the Guidance Bureau of Public Catering Service, officials concerned, cooks, waitresses and women's union members. Results of jury examination were announced and the distinguished units and participants received diplomas, medals and certificates at the ceremony. Similar events took place at famous restaurants in each province. Rodong Sinmun

title: Mangyongdae Prize National Martial Art Championship Opens
body: The Mangyongdae Prize National Martial Art Championship opened here to celebrate the Day of the Sun, the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Attending it are over 600 men and women players from 40-odd organizations including Taekwon-Do teams throughout the country. They will compete in more than 60 events including Taekwon-Do, Wushu and Paduk during the championship. Its opening ceremony took place at the Taekwon-Do Hall on April 8. Present there were Ri Tu Song, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea who is also vice-chairman of the National Sports Guidance Committee, Kim Chun Sik, secretary general of the National Sports Guidance Committee, officials concerned, sports persons and Pyongyangites. Vice-Premier of the Cabinet Kim Song Ryong made an opening address. The championship will go on at the Taekwon-Do Hall and Taekwon-Do Holy House till April 18. Rodong Sinmun

title: Oratorical Meeting of Youth and Students in DPRK
body: An oratorical meeting of youth and students was held at the Central Youth Hall on Friday in celebration of the 10th anniversary of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's assumption of the top posts of our Party and state. Attending it were Ri Tu Song, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Mun Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League, youth league officials and youth and students. Those who took the stage gave speeches of passionate eloquence on such themes as "Bloodline", "Cheers of nation", "Love the future" and "Patriotic youth". They highly praised the exploits of Kim Jong Un who opened up a new era of self-sustenance and prosperity, the era of our state-first principle, unprecedented in the nation's history of 5 000 years, and put the dignity and national power of the Republic on the highest eminence. They stressed that as our Party and revolution are guided by Kim Jong Un who carries forward the intention of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, the sacred history of the people-first principle, in which all the dreams and ideals of the people will come true, is given continuity. They ardently appealed to the audience to add luster to the honor of the patriotic youth in the historic advance towards a fresh victory of the revolution under the flag of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League, bearing deep in mind the noble intention of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Efforts Put into Technical Updating of Roads and Improving Rivers
body: Technical updating of roads and river improvement to implement the decision made at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee gather momentum in Kangwon Province. Its officials go among the masses and remind them that land administration work must be pushed ahead with in a consistent manner all the year round. They also see to it that efforts and means are concentrated on land administration and socialist emulations are conducted in a brisk manner. The province takes meticulous care of ridgeways while repairing bridges in an intensive way and rectifying imperfections in consideration of the regional characteristics of having lots of mountains and rivers. Its officials go to the ridgeways to acquaint themselves with the conditions of the roads and learn about the problems and take necessary measures in time. River improvement is also in full swing. According to the plan of the province, rivers are improved in several areas including the township of Kimhwa County. Other cities and counties also take an active part in river improvement. Cities and counties actively supply materials and labor to the river improvement projects. The province regularly learns and reviews the land administration work and takes appropriate measures, thereby steadily rousing the officials. Rodong Sinmun

title: State Academic Degrees and Titles Conferred on Intellectuals in DPRK
body: State academic degrees and titles were conferred on exemplary intellectuals on the occasion of the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Those intellectuals have achieved research successes substantially conducive to the development of the national economy and the improvement of people's living standard by dedicating themselves to the scientific research for accelerating the implementation of the five-year plan set forth at the 8th Party Congress and tangibly contributed to the education of the rising generations. Professorship went to 13 persons, including Kong Yong Su, dean of a faculty of Kim Il Sung University, Jo Yong Nam, a teacher at the same university, Kim Hyo Yong, a researcher at Kim Chaek University of Technology, Choe Hye Yong, vice-director of Pyongyang University of Medicine, and Ri An Guk, a researcher at the Hamhung Branch of the State Academy of Sciences. Doctorate was conferred on 72 persons, including Ri Su Yong, vice department director of Kim Il Sung University, Ri Kum Song, head of a department of Kim Chol Ju University of Education, Kim Un Gyong, a teacher of Pyongyang University of Mechanical Engineering, Kim Jong Chol, head of a department of Korea University of Physical Education, Hwang Myong Do, vice-rector of Pyongyang University of Publishing and Printing, and Ko Hyong Son, rector of Phyongsong Teacher Training College. Associate professorship went to 102 persons and master's degree to 1 060. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Premier Makes Field Survey of Farming in South Hwanghae Province
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, made field survey of farming in South Hwanghae Province. He learned in detail about farming in Haeju City, Pongchon, Paechon, Yonan, Pyoksong, Kangryong, Ongjin and Sinchon counties, stressing that the officials should fully display the spirit of unconditionally and thoroughly implementing the Party's policies, true to the Party's intention for South Hwanghae Province to uphold the banner in the country's agricultural production. He called for meticulously organizing the farm work, being cognizant of the fact that the success of this year's farming depends on the responsibility and role of officials, and for putting priority efforts on increasing the fertility of soil and positively applying such advanced farming methods as organic farming. He stressed the need to thoroughly meet the sci-tech demand in tending wheat, barley and other earlier crops, improve their nutritive conditions and thus decisively increase the grain output. He called for making tangible contribution to increasing the agricultural production by doing well the work of learning after good experience of advanced units while building up the foundation for the production of organic compound fertilizer in the province. Field consultative meetings discussed the issues of putting the farming operation and guidance on a higher scientific level on the basis of last year's experience and lessons, correctly carrying out the plans for such immediate farming processes as sowing and ploughing and raising the actual rate of mechanization. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Meeting Held in DPRK
body: A national meeting took place at the April 25 House of Culture in Pyongyang on April 10 to commemorate the 10th anniversary of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's election as the top Party and state leader. The platform was taken by Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission (SAC) of the DPRK and chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, Jo Yong Won, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretary for Organizational Affairs of the WPK Central Committee, and Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, vice-president of the SAC and premier of the DPRK Cabinet. Attending the meeting were leading officials of the Party and the government, the chairperson of a friendly party, senior officials of the armed forces organs, members of the Party central leadership organ in Pyongyang, deputies to the Supreme People's Assembly, officials of the Party and power organs, working people's organizations, armed forces organs, ministries and national institutions, service personnel of the Korean People’s Army and the Public Security Forces, teaching staff and students of revolutionary schools, officials of institutions and industrial establishments and persons of merit in Pyongyang. Choe Ryong Hae made a report. The reporter stressed that it is the great honor and pride of the Party and the Republic and the greatest happiness of the Korean people to hold the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un in high esteem as their top leader. He said that the past 10 years, for which the Korean people have struggled under the leadership of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un, are shining as the sacred annals in which monuments to the most successful and great victories have been erected in the face of unprecedented difficulties. He noted that the respected General Secretary, by scientifically seeing through the law of the developing revolution and the demands of the times with his foresight and wisdom, clearly indicated the path to be followed by the Party and the country for their development by making clear the far-reaching strategy of the Juche revolution and laying down perfect action programmes and guidelines for victory. He added that it is the most prominent achievement of the respected General Secretary in the history of his guidance on the Korean revolution that he developed the WPK into the strong political staff of the Juche revolution with invincible leadership and fighting strength. It is the great revolutionary exploit of the respected General Secretary that he opened up a new era of a powerful socialist nation prospering and developing with self-sustenance and self-reliance by drastically increasing the national power of the DPRK, the reporter added. Recalling that the respected General Secretary placed the country on the status of a full-fledged military power equipped with all powerful physical means of self-defence, the reporter praised him as a peerless patriot and a great defender of peace to be celebrated by the Korean nation and other progressive peoples for all ages. The past decade, during which the Korean people have waged a sacred struggle for carrying on the revolution under the leadership of a gifted thinker and theoretician, outstanding statesman and peerlessly great commander, clearly proved that the absolute trust and expectations the Korean people reposed in the respected General Secretary, when they entrusted him with the destiny and future of the Korean revolution, were the inevitable and a historical choice, the reporter stressed. He called on the entire Party, all the people and the whole army to accomplish the revolutionary cause of Juche pioneered in Paektu by devotedly defending the respected General Secretary, who represents the destiny and future of Juche Korea, politically and ideologically, and remaining faithful to his idea and leadership. Saying that only victory and glory is in store on the road ahead of our Party and people advancing with redoubled courage towards the communist future following the respected General Secretary, he ardently called upon all to work hard for the great Comrade Kim Jong Un, for the cause of the great WPK and for the prosperity of our country, the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. Rodong Sinmun

title: Photo Shows Held in DPRK
body: Photo shows "Decade of great victory and change" take place in all provinces of the DPRK to celebrate the 10th anniversary of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's assumption of the top posts of our Party and state. Displayed at the venues are photos dealing with the exploits of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un. The photos show the personality of the General Secretary as the peerlessly great man who has led the revolutionary cause of Juche along the road of victory by creditably carrying forward the idea and cause of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. Reflected in them is the greatness of the leadership of the General Secretary, who has strengthened the Workers' Party of Korea into an invincible guiding force by setting forth the scientific lines and policies indicating the path ahead of our revolution. Photos of the General Secretary inspecting the Wonsan Army-People Power Station, the Changsong Foodstuff Factory, the Samjiyon Potato Farina Production Factory and others represent the sacred journey of devotion to the people made by him, a peerless patriot and great father, who brings earlier the brilliant future of a powerful socialist country, making indefatigable efforts and devotion for the economic construction and the improvement of the people's standard of living. Also on display are photos showing the looks of our people who have turned out in a general offensive for the overall development of Korean-style socialism and the stirring reality of the DPRK. Rodong Sinmun

title: Sun of the Nation, Peerless Hero
body: Rallying Whole Nation around Banner of National Liberation President Kim Il Sung in his teens when he embarked on the road of revolution put forward the idea that independence of the country should be achieved by the united efforts of the nation to defeat Japanese imperialists and wisely led the struggle for it. The President pushed ahead with preparations for forming the anti-Japanese national united front which could rally the whole nation around the banner of anti-Japanese imperialists. On May 5, Juche 25(1936), the President found the Association for the Restoration of the Fatherland, the first anti-Japanese national united front body in our national history, and published the Ten-Point Programme of the Association for the Restoration of the Fatherland in Donggang. The Association for the Restoration of the Fatherland was a permanent organization of the anti-Japanese united national front embracing all the patriotic ones, who accepted the Ten-Point Programme of the Association for the Restoration of the Fatherland, transcending differences in their political views, faith and ideologies. The Ten-Point Programme of the Association for the Restoration of the Fatherland defined the character and task of Korean revolution and strategic and tactical principles on the basis of correct analysis of the situation of revolution in the 1930s, social and economical conditions of our country, the mutual relations between classes, etc. It was an immortal programme which clarified the prospect of the Korean revolution in consideration of the interests of working masses including workers and peasants and common interests of all patriotic people and a declaration of all-people resistance calling upon the whole nation to liberate the country by strengthening the driving force of revolution. The President provided a firm guarantee for victory of all-people resistance against the Japanese imperialists by founding the Association for the Restoration of the Fatherland and publishing Ten-Point Programme of the Association for the Restoration of the Fatherland as the banner of great national unity. (To be continued.) Rodong Sinmun

title: Giving Top Priority to Interests of People
body: Newly Installed Billboards of Movie Schedule One September Day Juche 102(2013), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited the Rungna 4D Simulation Cinema in Rungna People’s Pleasure Park. When he dropped in the fifth auditorium, he expressed his satisfaction with his broad smile, seeing several stereoscopic movies for learning in detail about quality of every scene of movies and sensitives of equipment. As he reached the first auditorium, the respected General Secretary instructed accompanying officials to hang a billboard of movie schedule on the side wall of the door in order to make people see titles of movies. The officials had not paid attention to it though they had intended to arrange the cinema on the principle of offering best convenience to the people. Then the respected General Secretary said that the billboards of movie schedule should be installed for every auditorium of the cinema. Keeping in their minds his noble intention that the work for people should be always conducted on the highest level, the officials made up their minds to become genuine servants for the people. Absolute Criterion One October day Juche 104 (2015), the respected General Secretary visited Paekhak-dong in Sonbong District of Rason City, a village newly built into a socialist fairyland after eradicating the aftereffects of flood. Looking at the dwelling houses reflecting soldiers’ love and devotion for people, the respected General Secretary said to accompanying officials that they should complete the interior of buildings in a qualitative way. Then he said that they must let the people, masters of dwelling houses, appraise quality of the dwellings and public establishments and that the newly built houses could be said well done in case the people, who would live there, like them. Looking round the officials full of excitement, the respected General Secretary stressed that they should always listen to the voice of people and regard it as the criterion. They strongly felt that the absolute criterion of all works was just demand, intention, interests and convenience of people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Monumental Edifice Symbolic of New Turn in Promotion of Korean-style Socialist Civilization
body: Inauguration Ceremony of Songhwa Street Held with Splendor Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Cuts Inaugural Tape An ideal street for the people has been erected majestically in Songsin and Songhwa areas of the capital city of Pyongyang to demonstrate the high spirit and remarkable creativity of the Korean people, who are vigorously advancing toward the brighter future of Korean-style socialism under the leadership of the great Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), and to represent the rapid development of the country dashing toward the attainment of a grandiose goal.
