Songhwa Street, built in the eastern gateway to Pyongyang under the unique architectural development plan of the Party Central Committee and the plan for building 50 000 flats in Pyongyang set forth at the 8th Congress of the Party, is an outcome of the WPK's long-cherished desire to provide the people with more stable and civilized living conditions and successfully resolve the housing shortage of capital citizens. The street is, at the same time, the first entity symbolic of the new era of comprehensive development seething with great creation and changes. True to the high intention of the Party Central Committee to turn Pyongyang better into the center of disseminating the Juche idea, Juche-oriented culture and Korean-style high civilization and into the great city of the people, the soldiers and civilians involved in the project performed an eye-opening miracle of building the distinctive grand architectural group of 10 000 flats, including an 80-storeyed skyscraper, within a year by waging a strenuous onward campaign, the fierce 24/7 struggle, despite manifold challenges and trials. Through the construction of the street which opened a new turning point of development in the capital city construction, our people and servicepersons fully demonstrated the validity of the Party's Juche-oriented idea on architectural beauty, the potentiality of the self-supporting economy and the irresistible might of the single-hearted unity of the Party and the masses and vividly showed the true picture of Korean-style socialism vigorously advancing toward the bright future. An inauguration ceremony of the street was held with splendor on Monday. Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the WPK and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, attended the ceremony. When he arrived at the ceremonial venue, fireworks were set off and the participants broke into thunderous cheers of "Hurrah!" All the participants cheered enthusiastically as a token of their deep reverence for the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un who set the people-first principle as the eternal political idea and unshakable political mode of the WPK and has dedicated himself to building an ideal socialist society brimming with the laughter and happiness of the people. Present at the ceremony were Jo Yong Won, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretary for Organizational Affairs of the WPK Central Committee, and Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet. Also attending it were Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the WPK Central Committee, Kim Yong Hwan, chief secretary of the Pyongyang City Committee of the WPK, members of the headquarters for the construction of 50 000 flats in Pyongyang, officials from Party and power organs in the capital city, soldier- and civilian-builders and Pyongyangites. The participants also included the working people, students and children who are to live in the new street of the people successfully completed under the leadership of the WPK. The ceremonial ground was filled with absolute trust and fervent admiration for the Party Central Committee that vigorously leads the people to a new era of creation and miracles, bringing all their dreams and ideals into brilliant fruition. The national anthem of the DPRK was solemnly played. Kim Tok Hun addressed the ceremony. There are many splendid inauguration ceremonies recorded in our Republic's history of grand construction for promoting the well-being of the people but this event is associated with many touching stories that are really unforgettable and should not be forgotten, the speaker said, adding that the Songhwa area is the monument to the great love which was erected by the strong faith that the things desired and anticipated by the people must be done without fail in any situation. He expressed belief that the Pyongyangites moving into new houses amid the blessings of the whole country would always remember this eventful moment and dedicate their all to the prosperity of the country. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un cut the inauguration tape. Fireworks were let off and balloons released and all the participants raised stormy cheers of "Hurrah!" with deep gratitude to the respected General Secretary who builds a land of bliss for the people with his warm love, repeatedly showing great benevolence for them. The respected General Secretary warmly waved back to them, wishing them happiness in a new street and new houses. The ground of the inaugural ceremony was flooded with the great excitement of the capital citizens, who could hardly repress their deep gratitude to the tender-hearted father for his benevolence as warm as sunlight in spring, looking up to him with tears in their eyes. The respected General Secretary warmly waved back to the cheering crowds for a long time, sincerely wishing our people a happy and highly civilized life in their modern dwellings. At the end of the ceremony, Party and government cadres looked around the street. Seeing the imposing 80-storeyed sky-scraper, an elevated bridge, public catering facilities, they more keenly realized that every moment and day spent for putting great ideas into practice by the respected General Secretary, who continues his journey of devoted service for the people, unhesitatingly going through thick and thin for their sake, have resulted in providing the cornerstone of the country's prosperity and adding glory to the new era of the Workers' Party when the whole country is overflowing with the people's happiness. Walking along the new street symbolic of high civilization, the blessed citizens unanimously said our Party, state, world and policy are the best, out of their irrepressible gratitude toward the motherly Party which willingly burdens itself for the sake of the people with a heavy duty in the harshest-ever time. More deeply realizing the immutable truth that victory, glory, happiness and a rosy future are in store for them when they firmly trust and follow the respected General Secretary, they firmly pledged to take the lead in creating new things and making innovations and become the performers of feats in the honorable and proud struggle for the prosperity and development of the country. Songhwa Street, which has been erected by the noble intention of the WPK that confidently brings earlier a new world and era of a prosperous and powerful nation under the uplifted banner of "The People Are God", the single-minded unity and self-reliance, will shine forever as a monument to the warm love for the people in the great era of Kim Jong Un along with the rosy morrow of the capital city of Pyongyang which will be transformed into a more magnificent city. Political News Team

title: Collection of Short Stories Published
body: The Art and Literature Publishing House in the DPRK released a collection of short stories "Memories in History" on the occasion of the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. The book contains 17 short stories depicting the immortal revolutionary career and achievements of Kim Il Sung who devoted all his life to the country and the people. They tell about the sagacity of his leadership and his noble personality as a great man. Rodong Sinmun

title: Party Meetings of Significance for Development of Juche Revolution
body: The important historic Party meetings, held for the past ten years, provided significant turning points for development and prosperity of the Juche revolution in a new era with perfect lines, policies, strategy, tactics and goals. The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un convened a historic plenary meeting of the Party Central Committee in March Juche 102 (2013), at which he put forward a strategic line of simultaneously carrying on the building up of economy and nuclear armed forces in line with the prevailing situation and lawful demands of the Korean revolution. The enlarged meeting of the Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee in December 2013 served as a turning point for more thoroughly establishing the monolithic leadership system of the Party Central Committee in the whole Party and society and consolidating the Party into an ideological pure entity and an integral organization. With the enlarged meeting of the Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee in February 2015 as an occasion, the struggle for thoroughly applying the people-first principle to overall Party work and eradicating practices of abusing power, bureaucratism and corruption gained great momentum. The 7th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea was registered in the country's history as a glorious one as it provided strategic lines and prospective goals for the victorious advance of the revolution and construction. After the congress there have been held plenary meetings of the Party Central Committee every year to clarify tasks and ways for ensuring the implementation of the decisions of the congress and opening up a broad avenue for building a powerful socialist country. The 8th Party Congress marked as the one for struggle and progress which dynamically accelerated the historic advance for ushering in a new period of upsurge and great turn in the revolution. The congress greatly inspired the socialist construction to enter into a new stage of development. The important Party meetings including the plenary meetings and meetings of the Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee after the congress raised the people's revolutionary ardor and enthusiasm for the struggle for achieving the overall development of our style of socialism and significantly increased the motive force for the advance of our state. The First Conference of Chairpersons of the Party Primary Committees and the Second Conference of Secretaries of the Party Primary Committees were recorded as meaningful meetings as they advanced an idea that the Party primary organizations should enhance their militant function and role and all the secretaries of the Party primary committees should be honest political officials of the Party devotedly serving the people. The First Short Course for Chief Secretaries of City and County Party Committees provided a turning point for strengthening the foundations for developing cities and counties, the regional centers of socialist construction, and dynamically accelerating the building up of the Party and the overall development of the country. The First Workshop of Officials in the Information Field of the WPK served as an important occasion in bolstering the fighting efficiency of the Party and increasing the motive force peculiar to our style of socialism by enhancing the militant function and role of the information sector. Rodong Sinmun

title: Myohyangsan Medical Appliances Factory Marks Its Founding Anniversary
body: The Myohyangsan Medical Appliances Factory in the DPRK marked its 50th founding anniversary. At the ceremony for its inauguration on April 10, Juche 61 (1972), President Kim Il Sung named the factory "Myohyangsan Medical Appliances Factory" and specified the orientations and ways for medical apparatus production. Chairman Kim Jong Il wisely guided the factory to fulfill its duty and mission in promoting the people's health. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, who inspected the factory several times, saw to it that the factory was rebuilt excellently to add eternal luster to the undying leadership exploits of the President and the Chairman. The factory has turned into an icon and standard one which plays a leading role in developing the medical appliances manufacturing industry of the country, thanks to Kim Jong Un who dedicates himself to making sure that our people and younger generations enjoy good health and highly-civilized life under the socialist public healthcare system. A commemorative meeting took place on April 10. Attending it were Thae Hyong Chol, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Kim Hyong Hun, vice-minister of Public Health, Kim Jang Won, secretary of the Jagang Provincial Party Committee, and officials and employees of the factory. Rodong Sinmun

title: Many People Visit Arch of Triumph in DPRK
body: Many people visit the Arch of Triumph here with deep reverence for President Kim Il Sung, who achieved the historic cause of national liberation, in the run-up to his birth anniversary, the greatest auspicious holiday of the Korean nation. The Arch of Triumph was erected as a monumental edifice symbolic of the era of the Workers' Party in April Juche 71 (1982) in reflection of the pure loyalty of the Korean people to add eternal brilliance to the President's revolutionary exploits. For the past 40 years after its erection, it has been visited by at least 1 783 000 persons, including working people, servicepersons and schoolchildren. When visiting it, a large number of foreigners and overseas compatriots highly praised the revolutionary exploits of the President who saved the destiny of the distress-torn nation and built Juche-oriented socialism on this land. Rodong Sinmun

title: 7th April Spring People's Art Festival Opens
body: The 7th April Spring People's Art Festival was opened with due ceremony at the East Pyongyang Grand Theatre in the DPRK on April 10. The festival, attended by many artistes and working people of 20-odd units selected from different regions and units across the country, will be held at theatres and cultural houses in Pyongyang, divided into the categories of provincial art troupes, art squads, itinerant art groups and other art groups as well as a magic festival. Minister of Culture Sung Jong Gyu, chairman of the festival organizing committee, made an opening address at the ceremony. The speaker stressed that the festival to be held with splendor on the occasion of the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung is a grand political art festival peculiar to Juche Korea vividly representing with beautiful artistic scenes the firm faith and will of all the people to accomplish the revolutionary cause of Juche pioneered in Mt Paektu to the end under the leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. Then followed an opening performance. Attending the opening ceremony were Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Ri Song Hak, vice-premier of the Cabinet, officials concerned and participants in the festival. Rodong Sinmun

title: 32nd April Spring Friendship Art Festival Opens
body: The 32nd April Spring Friendship Art Festival opened here on Sunday to celebrate the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Taking part in the festival are art troupes, dance troupes, circuses of dozens of countries including China, Russia, Cuba, Vietnam, Laos, Belarus, Moldova, Hungary, Austria, France and Ethiopia and overseas Koreans' art troupes. Presented to the festival are video segments on colorful performances of world-famous art troupes and artistes praising the greatness of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un and representing the world progressive people's mind to add eternal luster to their immortal feats as well as the fine culture and tradition of different countries and nations and their building of new life. Governments, personages of various circles and artistes of different countries including China, Russia, Cuba, Vietnam, Laos, Mongolia and Tajikistan sent video segments on their congratulatory speeches representing their pride and honor of participating in the festival and wishes for its successful holding through international communication channels. The opening of the festival was televised on the Central TV of the DPRK and internet homepages including "Korean Art" by the festival organizing committee. The videos, reflecting the ideal, tradition and vitality of the April Spring Friendship Art Festival, introduced the new form and method of the current festival, its scale and the congratulatory speeches from government officials and artistes of different countries and parts of art performances. The Chinese minister of Culture and Tourism, the Russian minister of Culture and the Cuban vice-minister of Culture hoped in their congratulatory speeches that the April Spring Friendship Art Festival, promoting the friendship and cultural development among nations, would be successful. Sung Jong Gyu, DPRK minister of Culture who is chairman of the festival organizing committee, extended deep thanks to the attendees of the 32nd April Spring Friendship Art Festival and the personages and artistes of different countries who exerted great efforts for the successful holding of the festival, expressing belief that the festival would contribute to the development of cultural relationship among countries. A video on performance "Song of Peace and Friendship" by a Chinese art troupe decorated the opening of the festival. The videos on art performances presented to the festival will be televised on the Central TV of the DPRK and posted on internet homepages including "Korean Art" till April 20. Rodong Sinmun

title: New Mementoes and Records Displayed at Korean Revolution Museum
body: About 800 new mementoes and records have been displayed in the new hall of the Korean Revolution Museum for the period of struggle for bringing about a radical turn in the building of a powerful socialist country. The hall with four rooms houses mementoes and records comprehensively showing the undying feats performed by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un in five years after the 7th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea, during which he energetically conducted his revolutionary activities to effect an epoch-making turn in the development of our Party and the building of a powerful socialist country. On display at Room No. 1 are photos of Kim Jong Un wisely guiding the struggle for making the 7th Party Congress a great revolutionary event to be specially recorded in the history of our Party and for consolidating the might of the politically and ideologically strong country in every way. There are also such mementoes as the letters written by him in the days when he was accomplishing the historic great cause of completing the state nuclear force and a diorama of Ryomyong Street seen by him when guiding its construction. Exhibited at Room No. 2 are records of the activities of Kim Jong Un wisely leading the struggle for building up the national defence capabilities to reliably defend the sovereignty of the country and for creating the external atmosphere favorable for the Korean revolution. On show at Room No. 3 are records of the struggle in the period when the Korean people strengthened the independence and Juche character of the national economy in every way by their own efforts, technology and resources under the leadership of the Party. The Party put forward the self-reliance as an immovable political line and a trait of the country and, under its guidance, our people have written a proud history of achieving prosperity by dint of self-reliance, fully displaying the might of the self-supporting national economy. Room No. 4 is a collection of records of the leadership of Kim Jong Un who pushed forward with the building of socialist culture and set forth the revolutionary line on launching an offensive for making a breakthrough head-on at the 5th Plenary Meeting of the 7th Party Central Committee and led the struggle for it. Rodong Sinmun

title: Senior Party and Government Officials Visit Korean Revolution Museum
body: Senior Party and government officials of the DPRK visited the Korean Revolution Museum on Sunday on the occasion of the 10th anniversary of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's election to the top posts of the Party and the state. The visitors included Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission (SAC) of the DPRK and chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, Kim Tok Hun, Presidium member of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, vice-president of the SAC and premier of the DPRK Cabinet, and leading officials of working people's organizations, ministries and national institutions. They made a bow before the color statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il at the general review hall of the museum. After being briefed on the immortal achievements of Kim Jong Un, they looked around different rooms in the Hall of the Period of Struggle to Bring about a Radical Turn in the Building of a Powerful Socialist Country. On display there are photos and revolutionary exhibits showing the great achievements of the respected General Secretary who has made tireless and devoted efforts for the strengthening of the WPK, for the accomplishment of the great historic cause of perfecting the state nuclear force guaranteeing the dignity and safety of the nation for all ages, and for the eternal prosperity and happiness of the country and the people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Dancing Party of Youth and Students Held
body: A dancing party of youth and students in Pyongyang was held on Monday on the occasion of the 10th anniversary of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's election as the top Party and state leader. Venues for the dancing party such as the plazas of the Arch of Triumph and the Pyongyang Indoor Stadium were filled with joy and excitement of the young vanguard greeting the greatest auspicious day to be specially recorded in the history of the Party and the country. The dancing party began to the tune of the song "Glory to General Kim Jong Un". The dancers showed beautiful movements to the tune of the songs reflecting the deep gratitude towards the motherly Party. The festive atmosphere heightened when "Song of Youth" and "Young People, Be Loyal to Our Party", the songs depicting the spirit of the young vanguard, resounded. The venues were seething with enthusiasm of the dancers to glorify their youth as paragons of good virtues and traits along with the playing of the songs "We Will Go to Mt Paektu" and "I Will Live like a Star Following Party". Rodong Sinmun

title: Celebration Meetings of Working People's Organizations
body: Working people's organizations in the DPRK held meetings on Monday to celebrate the 10th anniversary of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's election to the top posts of our Party and state. A celebration meeting of workers and members of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea (GFTUK) took place at the Central Hall of Workers and a celebration meeting of agricultural workers and members of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea (UAWK) at the Saegil Cooperative Farm in Sinchon County of South Hwanghae Province. Reports and speeches were made at the meetings. The reporters and speakers stressed that Kim Jong Un's election as our top Party and state leader was a political event, in which sure guarantee was provided for the accomplishment of the revolutionary cause of Juche pioneered in Mt Paektu, and it was a great auspicious event to be specially recorded in the nation's history. They noted that he has wisely led the gigantic struggle for building a powerful socialist nation of Juche through his energetic ideo-theoretical activities and with his tested guidance, thus opening up a new era of victory and changes to be eternally recorded in the country's history. He made sure that the 9th Congress of the UAWK was convened as the first meeting of this significant year and has meticulously guided it to fulfill its role as the vanguard in the worthwhile struggle for ushering in a great new era of Korean-style socialist rural development, they noted. They called for remaining faithful to the idea and leadership of Kim Jong Un and making tangible contribution to the comprehensive development of our-style socialist construction. Those present at the meetings included Ri Tu Song, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Hong Chol Jin, secretary of the Pyongyang City Committee of the WPK, officials concerned and officials of the GFTUK and the UAWK, workers and members of the GFTUK, agricultural workers and members of the UAWK. Rodong Sinmun

title: Exhibition of Technological Innovation Achievements Opened in DPRK
body: An exhibition of technological innovation achievements by workers and trade union members across the country was opened in the DPRK on Monday under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea to celebrate the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Workers and trade union members across the country have made a lot of technological innovations and inventions to revitalize the production through a dynamic mass technological innovation movement, thus greatly contributing to the economic development and the improvement of the people's living standard. The exhibition on the theme of "Hot Wind of Technological Innovation" aims to contribute to the implementation of tasks for 2022 of the five-year plan by giving wide publicity to the technological innovation achievements made by workers and trade union members and exchanging and disseminating them. Taking part in it are workers and trade union members of different units. Exhibited there are hundreds of valuable technological innovation achievements and products. The virtual exhibition aided by technical trade service system "Jagangryok" is accessible to intranet any time. The exhibition continues until April 30. Rodong Sinmun

title: Pochonbo Revolutionary Museum Marks Its Founding Anniversary
body: The Pochonbo Revolutionary Museum marked its 70th founding anniversary. President Kim Il Sung took measures to turn the historic area of Pochonbo into a center for education in revolutionary traditions and gave solutions to the issues arising in the excavation of revolutionary relics and the education in the revolutionary traditions. Visiting the revolutionary battle site of Pochonbo several times, Chairman Kim Jong Il gave instructions to spruce up the area and intensify the education to arm Party members, working people, service personnel, youth and students with the Party's revolutionary traditions. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un set it as a strategic task facing the current stage of the Korean revolution to further intensify the education in the revolutionary traditions and laid down the tasks facing the field of preservation of revolutionary relics and the ways for carrying them out. Under the wise leadership of the peerlessly great men, the museum has registered proud achievements in education for the past 70 years. A meeting for marking its 70th founding anniversary was held on Monday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Dancing Party of Women's Union Officials and Members Held in DPRK
body: A dancing party of officials and members of the women's union was held at the plaza of the Arch of Triumph Monday on the occasion of the 10th anniversary of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's assumption of the top posts of the Party and state. Amid the playing of the song "Cheers of the People", they began to dance, extending the highest glory and warm congratulations to Kim Jong Un. They danced to the tune of "Your Embrace Is the Best", "Our Leader Loved by People" and other songs, full of confidence that Korean-style socialism will always emerge victorious and the future of Kim Il Sung's and Kim Jong Il's Korea be immensely bright as it has been guided by the great leaders generation after generation. The venue of the dancing party was full of ardent patriotism of the women who are devoting themselves to the prosperity of the country and the happiness of the great socialist family. When the songs "We Will Go to Mt Paektu" and "Glory to Our Great Party" reverberated, the festive mood was revved up as they reflected the strong will of the dancers to devote their crystal-clear conscience to upholding the idea and leadership of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, following the fighting spirit and traits of the heroines of the preceding generations. Rodong Sinmun

title: Forest Fire Breaks out in Kangwon Province
body: Hundreds of hectares of forests and facilities in the Mt Kumgang area in Kangwon Province of the DPRK were damaged by fire. A forest fire broke out on a hill near the Kuryong Pool of Mt Kumgang and the Kosong Port Golf Course in Onjong-ri, Kosong County at about 15:20 on April 9. The fire was rapidly spread by a strong wind to adjoining forests and facilities. Right after its outbreak all fire-fighting equipment and manpower available were mobilized to extinguish the fire. The Cabinet and the State Emergency Disaster Committee took emergency measures to immediately extinguish the forest fire and rehabilitate the affected area. Given the ever-changing wind direction, a firebreak was created to prevent its spread and an operation was launched to put it out. The forest fire was finally put out at about 11:20 on April 10 and surveillance for preventing its recurrence is underway. The field of land and environment protection and all institutions and units were ordered to take due measures for establishing a stricter system for monitoring and notifying forest fires and mobilizing the public to prevent it. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Book Exhibition Opens in DPRK
body: A national book exhibition opened here to celebrate the Day of the Sun (birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung), the greatest auspicious holiday of the Korean nation. On display are more than 20 000 publications of over 15 000 kinds, including works authored by President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. Among the exhibits are the books explaining the Party policies and contributing to the five-point education. Literary books and sci-tech ones and recently published ones are also on show. An opening ceremony took place at the Okryu Exhibition Hall on Monday. Attending the ceremony were Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials, journalists and editors in the publishing sector. Ri Il Hwan made an opening address. Rodong Sinmun

title: First Concert of 7th April Spring People's Art Festival Held
body: The first concert of the 7th April Spring People's Art Festival was held at theatres and cultural houses in Pyongyang on Monday. Among the audience were officials from ministries and national institutions, working people, youth and students in Pyongyang. Artistes of art troupes and members of art squads from each province and members of itinerant art squads and art groups represented in detail the revolutionary spirit and optimism of all the people out in the advance towards a fresh victory in the revolution under the leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, holding President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in high esteem as the eternal sun of Juche. Meanwhile, a magic show was given by magicians of provincial art troupes and amateur magicians at the magic theatre of the National Acrobatic Troupe. It added to the festival atmosphere as it truthfully depicted the happy life of the Korean people. The festival performances continue. Rodong Sinmun

title: Week of Film Show Opens in DPRK
body: A week of film show for celebrating the Day of the Sun was opened in the DPRK on the occasion of the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Documentary films dealing with the revolutionary career and undying feats of the President and feature films of diverse themes such as revolutionary films "Star of Korea" and "The Sun of the Nation" will be screened at cinemas and cultural houses in the capital city of Pyongyang and local areas during the week. And shown will be "One Day and One Night", a feature film created as a model in the era under the meticulous guidance of the Party. Its opening ceremony took place at the Pyongyang International Cinema House on April 11 with attendance of Secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea Ri Il Hwan, Secretary of the Pyongyang City Committee of the WPK Ri Myong Chol, officials, creators and artistes of the moviedom and working people in Pyongyang. Jong Yong Nam, director-general of the National Administration of Motion Picture Industry, made an opening address. At the end of the ceremony, its participants watched a documentary "Our Leader Praised by All People". On the same day, a week of film show was opened in all provinces of the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Oratorical Meeting of Agricultural Workers
body: A national oratorical meeting of agricultural workers was held at the North Hwanghae Provincial Art Theatre on Tuesday to celebrate the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. At the meeting, speakers highly praised the careers of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il who inspected farms ceaselessly to develop the agriculture of the country and improve the people's diet. They spoke highly of the greatness of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un ushering in a new era of agricultural development. The speakers called for bringing about a bumper harvest every year by remaining loyal to the idea and leadership of the Party Central Committee single-mindedly, never forgetting the great benevolence of Kim Jong Un who unfolded a grandiose blueprint for resolving the socialist rural question in the new century. Attending the meeting were Han Jong Hyok, chairman of the Central Committee of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea (UAWK), Pak Myong Son, chairperson of the North Hwanghae Provincial Rural Economy Committee, Ri Il Hyok, secretary of the North Hwanghae Provincial Party Committee, officials of the UAWK and agricultural workers. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Floral Baskets and Congratulatory Letters from Foreign Diplomats
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received floral baskets and congratulatory letters from the diplomatic corps and the military attaches corps here on the occasion of the Day of the Sun, the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. The floral baskets and congratulatory letters were conveyed to DPRK Foreign Minister Ri Son Gwon on Tuesday by Russian Ambassador to the DPRK Alexandr Matsegora and Cuban Ambassador to the DPRK Jesus De Los Angeles Aise Sotolongo on behalf of the diplomatic corps, and to Lieutenant General Kim Chol Gun, vice-minister of National Defence of the DPRK, by Nguyen Quoc Viet, military attache of the Vietnamese embassy here who is doyen of the military attaches corps. He also received a floral basket from the Brazilian embassy here on the same day. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Floral Basket from Palestinian President
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a floral basket from Mahmoud Abbas, president of the State of Palestine, on Tuesday on the occasion of the Day of the Sun (the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung). Rodong Sinmun

title: Concerts Given by Artistes of Russia, Mongolia, Switzerland and Singapore
body: Concerts of the 32nd April Spring Friendship Art Festival are going on in an on-line mode to rev up the festive mood of celebrating the Day of the Sun, the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. A male soloist of a Mongolian art troupe sang the immortal revolutionary hymn "Song of General Kim Il Sung" to represent the ardent reverence for him who is always alive in the hearts of all people as the sun. Artistes of a state academy art troupe of Russia's Udmurtiya Republic well represented "Ardent Desire", a song reflecting the mind of our people wishing only for good health of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. A male soloist of the Mongolian art troupe in the song "Cowboy" represented the beautiful natural scenery of his country and traditional custom of the nation through peculiar melody full of national emotion. A Russian clarinet player and a solo pianist from the symphony orchestra of Geneva Conservatory of Switzerland demonstrated their rare talents as veteran players through their elegant performance. A mixed duet and chorus "Russia is My Motherland" by the state academy art troupe of Russia's Udmurtiya Republic and a dance "Seaman's Dance" by the Chelyabinsk State Ural Dance Group of Russia reflected the ardent love for their motherland and the optimistic emotion. The song "Arirang", favored by the Korean people, was sung by a male soloist of Singapore with his rich voice and high artistic ability. Rodong Sinmun

title: Revolutionary Soldiers Enjoy Worthwhile Life in DPRK
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un sent birthday spreads to Ri Chun Gu, a writer of the Paektusan Production Company who is winner of Order of Kim Il Sung and Kim Il Sung Prize and twice DPRK Labor Hero, on his 80th birthday, and to Kim Yong Nam, department director of the Central Committee of the Cameramen's Union of Korea who is winner of Kim Il Sung Prize and People's Journalist, on his 70th birthday. Ri Chun Gu, born into the family of an ordinary worker, graduated from Kim Il Sung University and has written scripts of more than 90 revolutionary films and feature films while working as a film script writer for 50-odd years. He was awarded Order of Kim Il Sung, the highest order of the DPRK, and the title of DPRK Labor Hero, the highest honor of DPRK citizens. He still devotes his wisdom and passion to writing film scripts, always remembering the loving care shown by the peerlessly great men who made sure that he participated in the 6th Congress and 7th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea as a delegate and reposed the deepest trust on him repeatedly. Kim Yong Nam, who became a talented photographer after graduating from Pyongyang University of Dramatic and Cinematic Arts, has remained faithful to his job at every worksite for a great upsurge. He was praised by Chairman Kim Jong Il for taking photographs of high ideological and artistic value and making tangible contribution to the development of photography. He, who took many photographs reflecting the proud reality of the country, was awarded a watch bearing the august name of President Kim Il Sung. Rodong Sinmun

title: KCNA Report on Completion of 10 000 Flats in Songsin and Songhwa Areas
body: The Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) on Tuesday issued a detailed report on the successful completion of 10 000 flats in the Songsin and Songhwa areas. According to the report, the Party Central Committee made a bold decision to launch the project for building 50 000 flats in the city of Pyongyang despite the worst situation, a formidable work in common practice. It set forth the project as an important goal of the new five-year plan at the 8th Party Congress and then unfolded a grand construction operation for building 10 000 flats in the Songsin and Songhwa areas at the first step. After mapping out a grand plan for building 10 000 modern houses in Pyongyang every year, the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un, at the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee, took a substantial and innovative measure to complete the construction of 10 000 flats in the Songsin and Songhwa areas in Juche 110 (2021) without fail. He gave an order in the name of the president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea on completing the 50 000-flat construction in the capital city at the highest level through army-people coordinated operation. And he personally attended a ground-breaking ceremony for the Songsin and Songhwa areas housing project at which he made a meaningful speech. He guided the capital city construction theater to be a main offensive front, symbolic of a new period of upsurge and great turn in socialist construction. The housing construction in the Songsin and Songhwa areas was a grand campaign of creation beyond imagination in terms of architectural style and content and scale of project as it required completing in just one year more than 160 blocks of skyscraping and high-rising apartments, public buildings and service amenities with a total floor space of one million and hundreds of thousands of square meters in an area covering 56 hectares. A three-dimensional construction drive was launched all at once to finish the project within the time and at the level set by the Party. Units of the People's Army involved in the project successfully concluded in a little over 3 months the earth digging, ground concrete tamping and framework of dwelling houses. Servicepersons in charge of the construction of 80-storey skyscraper fully displayed the strenuous offensive spirit peculiar to the indomitable revolutionary army. The framework construction of the skyscraper was completed in 80 days to make a breakthrough in the grand construction project. Every unit of the People's Army removed more than 1 000 cubic meters of earth per day on an average and reduced the time of form assembly and concrete tamping from 24 and 30 hours to 6 and 10 hours, finishing the framework construction of dwelling houses ahead of schedule. The exterior wall plastering and tile-setting, estimated to take more than two months, were completed in a week. The soldier-builders raised the speed of construction by actively introducing dozens of inventions and technical innovation proposals. Civilian construction units, too, waged a campaign for creating the spirit in a new era and construction speed. Technicians and skilled workers introduced a method of building decorative structure with arched prefabricated elements at one try to shorten the period of construction by tens of days. They also realized the 3-dimensional modeling of sections assigned to them to ensure the speed and scientific accuracy in calculation of the work load and direction. They guaranteed the quality of construction while making great contribution to the economic life of the country by introducing the labor- and material-saving concrete tamping with movable frames, the method of using lighter hollow blocks and good ideas for saving foam laggings. Thanks to the devoted efforts of the soldier- and civilian-builders, the vast framework construction of dwelling houses was completed in a little over 3 months along with the road construction, power transmission line building, substructure construction and land leveling for a new street to take its magnificent shape. Officials and working people across the country made joint innovations for the completion of the project. Designers of various units including the Paektusan Institute of Architecture, the Pyongyang City Designing Institute and Pyongyang University of Architecture created peculiar model and standard designs and completed a large amount of designs in the shortest period of time to keep designing ahead of building. Workers of the Sangwon Cement Complex, the Chollima Steel Complex, the Chollima Tile Factory, the Narae Ceramic Factory and other relevant units supplied the building materials for the project on a priority basis. Those in the railway transport sector ensured the transport of the materials to the construction site as planned. Solider- and civilian-builders, though busy with a 24-7 campaign, gave sincere support to the units left behind, and they also sincerely helped farms nearby. Wives of officers helped their husbands and soldiers with all dedication while displaying warm patriotism and tough personality. All these greatly impressed the people. Stories about couples, father and son, brothers and sisters working together in the same site and other stories about the good deeds done by known and unknown volunteers, who had helped the builders after finishing their daily work, eloquently showed the heroic fighting spirit, great devotion and ardent patriotism of our people devotedly upholding the intention of the Party Central Committee. Skyscraper, high-rise apartment buildings and facilities for education, public health and welfare service amenities, etc. laid out along the broad avenue are well harmonized with each other and also with overhead bridge and decorative structures. As a result, a new street of monumental value has emerged with high-level application of formative art, interconnectivity and practicality to further spruce up Pyongyang as befits the great capital city encapsulating the people-first principle. Songhwa Street, inaugurated with splendor ahead of the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, is the first entity guaranteeing the successful implementation of the five-year plan for the capital city construction advanced at the 8th Party Congress, and it is a proud monumental edifice in the great era of Kim Jong Un in which socialist civilization is created by our own efforts, wisdom and endeavors. Rodong Sinmun

title: Second-day Performances of 7th April Spring People's Art Festival
body: The second-day performances of the 7th April Spring People's Art Festival were given at theatres and cultural houses in the capital city of Pyongyang on Tuesday. The audience included officials from ministries and national institutions and working people in the city. Put on the stage of the performances touching the audience were the songs praising President Kim Il Sung on the occasion of his 110th birth anniversary. The audience was mesmerized by unique, creative and clever magic tricks at the magic theatre of the National Acrobatic Troupe. Singing aloud the songs praising Kim Il Sung, the performers depicted in detail the unshakable faith and will of the people to accomplish the revolutionary cause of Juche under the revolutionary leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Floral Baskets from Abroad
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a floral basket in the joint name of Co-Chairman Johnny Hon and Vice-Chairman Keith Bennet of the Board of Directors of the Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation and floral baskets from its Director Jin Xian and Honorary Directors Cui Tongwen and Qiu Jianliang on Tuesday on the occasion of the Day of the Sun, the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. On the same day, he received floral baskets from Japan-Korea Cultural Interchange Association, Osaka of the Citizens Solidarity Demanding Earlier Normalization of the Relations between Japan and the DPRK, the Japan Nagano Prefectural People's Council for Supporting the Independent and Peaceful Reunification of Korea, the Japan Matsumoto Citizen's Council for Supporting the Independent and Peaceful Reunification of Korea, the Japan Kyoto Committee for Supporting the Independent and Peaceful Reunification of Korea, the Gunma Prefectural People’s Council for Japan-Korea Friendship and Solidarity and the Japan Fukuoka Prefectural Japan-DPRK Friendship Association. He also received a floral basket from Honorary Vice-Chairman Sai Tiejen of the Board of Directors of the Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation. Rodong Sinmun

title: Moving into New Houses in DPRK
body: Hundreds of households moved into cozy dwelling houses newly built in Hoesang District of Hamhung City and Sinhung County of South Hamgyong Province and Jangguk-ri, Jaeryong County of South Hwanghae Province. Amid cheerful dancing, laughter and delight, officials visited the families moving into the new houses to congratulate them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Commemorative Coins to Be Minted in DPRK
body: Commemorative coins will be minted in the DPRK on the occasion of the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. A relevant decree of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK was issued on April 13. The commemorative coins named "The 110th Birth Anniversary of the Great Leader Comrade Kim Il Sung" will be minted into gold and silver ones. Traced out in the centre of the front of each golden and silver coins is the smiling image of the President, on the upper part of the fringe the letters "The 110th Birth Anniversary of the Great Leader Comrade Kim Il Sung" and on both sides of the bottom the figures of years "1912" and "2022" as well as a magnolia blossom. Traced out in the centre of the back is the President's birthplace at Mangyongdae, on the upper part of the fringe the letters "The Central Bank of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea" and on the bottom the figures implying the fineness, weight and minting year. The size of the pure-gold coin is 35 mm in diameter and 2 mm in thickness and that of the pure-silver coin is 40 mm in diameter and 3 mm in thickness. Rodong Sinmun

title: Ecuadorian City to Confer Title of Honorary Citizen on Peerlessly Great Men of DPRK
body: Las Naves City, Bolivar Province of the Republic of Ecuador, decided to award the title of honorary citizen to President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. A decision on awarding the title of honorary citizen to the peerlessly great men was adopted on April 7 on the occasion of the 110th birth anniversary of Kim Il Sung. The written decision says that the title of honorary citizen is awarded to HE Kim Il Sung, eternal President of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, HE Kim Jong Il, eternal leader of the DPRK, and HE Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea who provides the Korean people with a brighter and more prosperous future by carrying forward the idea and cause of the preceding leaders in reflection of the will of the city government and its citizens. The mayor of the city conveyed the certificate of honorary citizen to an official concerned of the DPRK working in Ecuador. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Baskets to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il from Abroad
body: Foreign political parties, organizations, international and regional bodies and personages and overseas families of persons related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle sent floral baskets to the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on the occasion of the Day of the Sun, the birth anniversary of the President. They included the Irkutsk regional branch committee and the Nakhodka City branch committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation, the Communist Party of Great Britain (Marxist-Leninist), the Central Committee of the Algerian National Liberation Front Party, the Popular Liberation Movement of Angola, the Central Committee of the Congolese Party of Labour, the Alliance for Resurrection and Development of Guinea, the German Support Association of the Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation, the Anti-Imperialist Forum of Germany, the State Academy Beryozka Dancing Troupe of Russia Named after N. S. Nadezhdina, the Mongolian Centre for the Study of Juche, the International Institute of the Juche Idea, the International Taekwon-Do Federation, the Board of Directors of the International Martial Arts Foundation, the Asian Regional Institute of the Juche Idea, the European Society for the Study of the Juche Idea, the African Regional Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea, the Latin American Institute of the Juche Idea, a member of the Political Bureau of the Workers' Party for the Independence of Senegal, a member of the National Council of the Democratic Party of Equatorial Guinea, Thomas Karl Lichter, director of the Board of Directors of the Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation, and his wife, families of Ryang Song Ryong and Pak Kil Song, Chinese-resident Koreans related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, families of Zhou Baozhong, Chen Lei, Chai Shiying, Feng Zhongyun, Jie Qing, Hu Zhenyi, Fan Delin and Jiang Zihua, Chinese persons to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, and the family of Kim Sun Ok who is related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle. Floral baskets in the names of missions of the international organizations here and the family of Jin Yongguan, general manager of the Beijing Jinchuan Power Science and Technology Co. Ltd. of China, were laid before the statues of the President and the Chairman. Rodong Sinmun

title: Sun of the Nation, Peerless Hero
body: Historic Cause of Party Foundation Accomplished The Party Founding Museum is at the foot of Haebang Hill in the central part of Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK. The historic building conveys the immortal exploits performed by President Kim Il Sung to found the Party while implanting deeply into people’s mind how great he was. Kim Il Sung who had triumphantly returned to the homeland after defeating the gangster-like Japanese imperialists regarded it as the most urgent task to found the revolutionary Party of working class and put primary efforts into its preparation. He set forth a revolutionary line of founding the party by organizing basic organizations in every region of the country and organizing the central leadership body of the party on the basis. He dispatched anti-Japanese revolutionary fighters to every part of the country and saw to it that they explain in plain language about the Party founding line to the people at a loss under the confused situation and expand the party ranks by organizing party cells at factories, mines and coal mines, etc. On this basis the President convened the inaugural congress of the Central Organizing Committee of the Communist Party of North Korea from October 10 to 13, Juche 34(1945) in Pyongyang. At the congress he organized the Central Organizing Committee of the Communist Party of North Korea as the Party central leadership organ and declared the foundation of the Party. Consequently, the Juche-type revolutionary Party, whose guiding idea is the Juche idea and which carries forward the revolutionary tradition created during the anti-Japanese struggle, came to birth and the historic cause of Party foundation started from the formation of the Down-with-Imperialism Union was brilliantly accomplished. After the Juche-type revolutionary Party was founded, our people could carve out their own future victoriously under the leadership of the trustworthy vanguard unit, the powerful political staff of the revolution, and the new history of the revolutionary Party of the independent era began. (To be continued) Rodong Sinmun

title: Third-day Performances of 7th April Spring People's Art Festival
body: The 7th April Spring People's Art Festival is going on in the DPRK on the occasion of the greatest auspicious holiday of the Korean nation. The third-day performances were given at theaters and cultural houses in Pyongyang on Wednesday. Represented at the performances were the single-mind of the people to accomplish the cause of the sun and the revolutionary cause of Juche to the end, singing the songs of revering the leader and praising the great man in the historic advance in which they go forward confidently under the victorious leadership of the great Party Central Committee. A magic performance was given at the magic theatre of the National Acrobatic Troupe. Magicians put on the stage illusionary juggleries and functional juggleries reflecting worthwhile labor and happy life of the people with their original idea and feats. Amateur magicians also attracted the attention of the audience. Rodong Sinmun

title: Schoolchildren's Art Performance Marks Day of Sun
body: An art performance "Generalissimo Is Our Eternal Sun" was given by the art groups of the Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace and the Pyongyang Schoolchildren's Palace at the Youth Park Open-Air Theatre in Pyongyang on April 13 in celebration of the Day of the Sun (birthday of President Kim Il Sung). The performance started with prologue "The Day of the Sun Is Eternal Thanks to the Marshal" amid the ardent yearning and reverence for President Kim Il Sung overflowing at the theatre. The performers reflected their joy and pride of celebrating the auspicious holiday, the birthday of the President, in the serial songs and dance "Mangyongdae Is a Flower Garden", "Mangyongdae, the Best Pride" and "April Holiday". Put on the stage were the songs praising the exploits of the President who was born at a low-roofed thatched house in Mangyongdae, achieved the historic cause of liberating Korea by waging a long bloody war against the Japanese imperialists and dedicated his all to the happiness of the rising generations. They truthfully depicted the appearance of the younger generations, who are growing up to be robust under the care of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, and the reality of the country making leaps forward and development. The poem and chorus "Forward Following the Footstep of Marshal Kim Jong Un", which reflected the will of the schoolchildren to prepare themselves thoroughly to be reliable successors to the revolutionary cause of Juche, revved up the atmosphere of the performance. The performance which ended with the epilogue "We Are the Happiest in the World" assured the audience that a bright future is in store for the country, thanks to the great father. Among the audience were Ri Tu Song, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Mun Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League, officials concerned, youth league officials and schoolchildren in Pyongyang. Rodong Sinmun

title: Oratorical Contest of Trade Union Officials and Members Marks Day of Sun
body: A national oratorical contest of trade union officials and members was held at the Central Hall of Workers on Wednesday to mark the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Those who took the floor spoke highly of the career of the President as the noble one of a popular leader who spent lots of holidays and Sundays performing his promises of love with the people until the last day of his revolutionary life. They referred to the devoted service of the President who used to stay up all night for the country and the people and continued his field guidance despite snow and rain. Saying that the revolutionary cause of Juche pioneered by President Kim Il Sung and inherited by Chairman Kim Jong Il is being firmly carried forward by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, they stressed that socialist Korea will always shine as a country of the sun under the leadership of the peerlessly great man. Present there were Pak In Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea, trade union officials and workers and trade unionists in Pyongyang. Rodong Sinmun

title: Oath-taking Meeting of Agricultural Workers Held in DPRK
body: An oath-taking meeting of agricultural workers and members of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea (UAWK) took place in the Rihyon Co-op Farm, Sadong District of Pyongyang on Wednesday on the occasion of the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. A letter of pledge to the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un was read out by Han Jong Hyok, chairman of the UAWK Central Committee, The letter stressed that the immortal feats the President performed for the nation and mankind with his rare qualities and traits, celebrated idea and theories, outstanding leadership and enormous revolutionary practice will shine forever. The letter expressed the iron faith and will of all the agricultural workers and members of the UAWK to successfully implement the instructions of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and uphold the idea and leadership of the respected General Secretary. It also expressed the determination to transform all ris of the countryside into the ones that meet the requirements of the three revolutions and prepare themselves to be masters of rural revolution by vigorously carrying out the three revolutions-ideological, technical and cultural. It expressed the will to attain the goal for grain production by putting the whole farm work on a sci-tech footing, true to the Party's agricultural policy, and waging an intensive emulation campaign for soybean and potato farming, while developing the rice and wheat farming. Present at the meeting were Ri Tu Song, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Hong Chol Jin, secretary of the Pyongyang City Committee of the WPK, officials concerned, officials of the UAWK and agricultural workers. Rodong Sinmun

title: New Teacher Training College Inaugurated in DPRK
body: Sariwon Teacher Training College was inaugurated in the DPRK. The college, newly built in North Hwanghae Province, will provide the best conditions and environment for education and life for students as it has a school building with multi-functional rooms for experiment and practice, an e-library, gymnasium and dormitory. It will contribute to putting the education in the province on a higher level and firmly preparing students to be competent talents for revolution. An inauguration ceremony took place on April 13. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Meeting, Public Procession Mark 110th Birth Anniversary of President Kim Il Sung in DPRK
body: A national meeting and a public procession of Pyongyang City took place with splendor at Kim Il Sung Square in Pyongyang on April 15, the 110th birth anniversary of the President. Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, attended the events. When the respected General Secretary appeared in the tribune of honor of the square amid the playing of the welcome music, all the participants raised stormy cheers of "Hurrah!" for him along with fireworks let off and balloons released. He extended warm greeting to all the people celebrating the significant Day of the Sun with high political enthusiasm and proud labor successes, warmly waving back to the loudly cheering crowds. The tribune of honor were taken by Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly , Jo Yong Won, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretary for Organizational Affairs of the WPK Central Committee, and Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet. Among those at the tribune were senior officials of the Party and the government, directors and first vice-directors of departments of the WPK Central Committee, leading officials of the Cabinet, working people's organizations, ministries and national institutions, and officials and persons of merit who distinguished themselves in implementing the Party policies. Ri Yong Gil, Kwon Yong Jin, Rim Kwang Il and other leading officials of the armed forces organs appeared at the tribune. Present at the meeting were officials of the WPK Central Committee, officials of ministries and national institutions, service personnel of the Korean People's Army and the Public Security Forces, teaching staff and students of revolutionary schools, officials of institutions and industrial establishments and working people in Pyongyang. Ri Il Hwan, member of the Political Bureau and secretary of the WPK Central Committee, made a report "The great Comrade Kim Il Sung's undying revolutionary history will be immortal along with the victorious advance of the cause of Juche". The reporter recalled the noble revolutionary career of the President run through with the idea of believing in the people as in Heaven, saying that he dedicated himself to protecting the dignity and rights of the people and providing them with happiness, sharing his destiny with the people all his life. And the reporter noted that all the Korean people keep deeper in their hearts, despite shifts in generation, the truth that eternal victory and prosperity are in store for their country and the dignity, glory and happiness of the people are ensured, thanks to April 15, 1912, the birthday of the President. He stressed it is a brilliant review of 110 years of Kim Il Sung's Korea that our country will demonstrate its might as the world's most powerful one perfectly embodying the ideal of its people in the face of any storm and stress when we add eternal brilliance to the greatest exploits performed by the President generation after generation and vigorously and invariably advance along the path of Juche paved by the President. As there are encyclopedic revolutionary legacies representing the sacred careers of the President and Chairman Kim Jong Il and the tested guidance of the WPK Central Committee led by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, our state and people will always emerge victorious, he noted, appealing to the participants to make a dynamic advance to accomplish the revolutionary cause of Juche pioneered by the President and bring earlier the day when the ideal of the WPK, which regards it as the supreme principle of its activities to promote the wellbeing of the people, will be materialized perfectly. After the national meeting the procession began. A column of citizens holding a large flag of the Republic symbolic of their dignified state entered the square. They were full of pride and confidence of having adorned every decade of the revolution with victories and glory, adding luster to their national flag century after century. When a column of demonstrators escorting the cars carrying the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il entered the square, fireworks were let off and numberless balloons were released. Columns of workers, peasant dancers and others marched past the square, holding aloft the boards bearing such slogans as "Our socialist country built by the President!", "Legendary Chollima brought by the President!" and "Endless journey for people!" The respected General Secretary acknowledged the cheers of the dependable people who remain faithful to their Party and state with single-minded loyalty and revolutionary spirit. Such catchphrases symbolic of great history as "Independence in politics, self-supporting in economy and self-reliance in defence", "Chollima Korea" and "Path of Juche" were displayed on the square to represent the unshakable faith that only victory and glory are in store for the Korean people who are making a dauntless advance with firm confidence in justice and victory of their cause. Columns of youth and students, service persons' families and persons of merit and children's union members showcased their strong aspiration to fulfill their duty and mission as the descendents of the President and soldiers and disciples of the Chairman by holding the President and the Chairman in high esteem as their eternal leaders and successfully accomplishing the cause of Juche under the uplifted banner of continuous revolution. A column of demonstrators holding a large red flag bearing such catchphrases as "Powerful socialist country", "Single-hearted unity" and "Self-reliance" marched past the square to decorate the end of the procession, demonstrating the powerful spirit of the Korean people who are bringing earlier a new victory of revolution under the uplifted banner of our state-first principle, led by the respected General Secretary. The respected General Secretary warmly waved back to cheering crowds. The national meeting and the public procession of Pyongyang City fully demonstrated the revolutionary spirit and will of the Korean people to achieve the overall prosperity and development of Korean-style socialism by single-mindedly and devotedly upholding the leadership of the respected General Secretary. Political News Team

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Visits Kumsusan Palace of Sun
body: All the people in the DPRK commemorates the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, whose august name shines in the nation's history spanning 5 000 years, as the great revolutionary event, holding him in high esteem as the eternal sun of socialist Korea. They extend the highest respects towards the sacred temple of Juche with ardent yearning for him that remains unchanged, no matter how much water may flow under the bridge. Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun together with his wife Ri Sol Ju on April 15, the Day of the Sun, the greatest auspicious holiday of the Korean nation. Accompanying him were Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly , Jo Yong Won, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretary for Organizational Affairs of the WPK Central Committee, Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, and other leading officials of the Party and the government, officials of the Party Central Committee, members of the Cabinet and leading officials of the working people's organizations. Leading officials of the armed forces organs were present there. Placed at the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il was a floral basket from the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. Also laid before the statues were the floral baskets in the names of the WPK Central Committee, the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK and the Cabinet of the DPRK. The respected General Secretary and his wife, together with other visitors, paid high tribute to the statues of the great leaders. At the halls where the President and the Chairman lie in state, the respected General Secretary and his wife made deep bows to the President and the Chairman as a token of their best wishes of immortality to the great leaders who built Korean-style socialism guided by the idea of believing in the people as in Heaven on this land, made the unprecedentedly glorious history of victory and miracles and laid the eternal foundations for ensuring the dignity and prosperity of posterity. All the participants made a firm pledge to remain absolutely loyal to the idea and leadership of the respected General Secretary who adds eternal luster to the cause of the President and the Chairman and fulfill their heavy duty and responsibility entrusted with by the Party and the people by dedicating themselves to the sacred struggle for comprehensive development of socialist construction. Political News Team

title: Joint Seminar in Belarus Marks Birth Anniversary of President Kim Il Sung
body: A joint online seminar of political parties and organizations in Belarus took place to mark the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Posted on the seminar homepage were written speeches under such titles as "Comrade Kim Il Sung is the great leader of the Korean people" and "On the occasion of the 110th birth anniversary of Comrade Kim Il Sung, the eternal President of the DPRK". Attending the seminar were personages and members of the Communist Workers' Party of Belarus, the Belarus National Association of Friends of Korean People Named after Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il, the Belarus Association for the Study of Juche Idea and the Belarusian Group for Solidarity with the DPRK. The chairman of the Belarus Association for the Study of Juche Idea said that Comrade Kim Il Sung is the great leader who devoted his all to the revolutionary cause for independence of the popular masses and, thanks to his leadership, a developed socialist industrial state was built in Korea which was once in backwardness and poverty. The chief of the Belarusian Group for Solidarity with the DPRK said one of President Kim Il Sung's greatest feats is that he founded the immortal Juche idea and settled in a unique way all problems arising in every period and at every stage of the revolution and construction in conformity with the specific conditions of Korea and the people's interests. The chief stressed that the President will be always alive in the hearts of the progressive peoples as the sun of Juche for the world-historic feats he performed before mankind. The chairman of the Permanent Standing Committee of the Belarus National Association of Friends of Korean People Named after Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il expressed the belief that the Korean people would vigorously accelerate socialist construction under the uplifted banner of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, rallied close around the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Literary Works Published by Koreans in China
body: Koreans in China released literary works on the occasion of the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. They highly praise the achievements President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un made for the country and the nation. Cha Sang Bo, vice-chairman of the General Association of Koreans in China, in his article titled "Our Odes to the President Will Resound Forever" said that the Korean nation's first ode to its leader "Star of Korea" was followed by immortal revolutionary hymns "Song of General Kim Il Sung" and "Song of General Kim Jong Il", and today "Ode to General Kim Jong Un" resounds far and wide. The article noted that the song "Star of Korea" is a masterpiece reflecting the nation's joy and excitement at the President's emergence as the morning star of Korea and the bright sun of the nation for liberating the country with the historic duty for saving the destiny of the country and the nation in his teens. Kim Yong Hui, director of the Bureau of National Reunification Movement of the General Association of Koreans in China, in her article praised the President's achievements for national reunification. Pang Yong Son, vice-chairperson of the Association of Young Korean Nationals in China, and Jong Un Sim, an official of the General Association of Koreans in China, in their article and poem recollected the days when they visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of Kim Il Sung, and grand monumental edifices such as the Arch of Triumph, the Tower of the Juche Idea and the International Friendship Exhibition House in boundless reverence for him. In the literary works they expressed their determination to uphold the leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un single-mindedly. Rodong Sinmun

title: Celebration Meeting Held in Russia
body: A meeting for celebrating the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung was held in Moscow on April 9, under the co-sponsorship of the United Confederation of Koreans in Russia and the Russian Association for Friendship and Cultural Cooperation with the DPRK. Attending the meeting were officials and members of the United Confederation of Koreans in Russia, members of its art troupe, officials and members of the Russia-Korea Friendship Association, the chief of the Group for International Solidarity with the DPRK and the ambassador and staff members of the DPRK embassy in Moscow. The participants laid floral baskets and bouquets before the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and made a bow to them. Kim Chil Song, chairman of the United Confederation of Koreans in Russia, in his congratulatory speech highly praised President Kim Il Sung as a great man who embarked on the road of revolution in his teens and organized and led the anti-Japanese armed struggle to victory to achieve the historic cause of Korea's liberation and founded the DPRK after national liberation. He noted that the President reliably safeguarded the country from outsiders’ aggression, built a powerful socialist nation independent in politics, self-supporting in the economy and self-reliant in defence and put forward national reunification as the most important task for the Korean nation and had devoted all his life to implementing it. Saying the revolutionary cause of the President is being creditably carried forward under the wise leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, he emphasized that the President will always be alive in the hearts of humankind. Then speeches were made. The speakers spoke highly of the President's revolutionary life and exploits for the country and the revolution, the times and history and the development of the DPRK-Russia relations. They also lauded Kim Jong Un as a peerlessly great man who put the DPRK on the status of a power recognized by the world by successfully carrying forward the cause of the President and materializing his desire. At the end of the meeting, its participants watched an art performance. Rodong Sinmun

title: Administrative District Name of Hwasong Area in Pyongyang Set
body: An ideal street of the people is being built in the Hwasong area near the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, which turns into a hub of Korean-style socialist civilization under the grand capital city construction plan of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. The Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly (SPA) of the DPRK decided to name the Hwasong area, in which a modern urban district representing the great era of Kim Jong Un is being built, Hwasong District of Pyongyang City. A relevant decree of the SPA Standing Committee was released on April 14. Rodong Sinmun

title: Joint National Meeting of KCU Organizations Held in DPRK
body: A joint national meeting of the Korean Children's Union (KCU) organizations was held at Mangyongdae Revolutionary School on April 14 to mark the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. It was attended by students of Mangyongdae Revolutionary School, Kang Pan Sok Revolutionary School and Pyongyang Primary School for Orphans, schoolchildren in Pyongyang and pupils joining the KCU. Invited to the event were Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Kim Yong Hwan, chief secretary of the Pyongyang City Committee of the WPK, Ri Tu Song, department director of the Central Committee of the WPK, officials concerned, officials of the youth league and persons of merit in Pyongyang. Before the meeting the participants laid a floral basket and bouquets at the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il at Mangyongdae Revolutionary School and made a bow to them. Mun Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League, made a report. He said that the President, who formed the KCU, newly instituted its slogans as required by the developing revolution and led the schoolchildren to prepare themselves to be true sons and daughters remaining intensely loyal to the socialist country. He noted that the Chairman made sure that the KCU members prepared themselves to be genuine young revolutionaries being aware of the Party and loving the country and people from their childhood and to be reliable future pillars of the country, knowledgeable, virtuous and healthy. He stressed that the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un made it a tradition to celebrate the KCU birthday on a large scale every year and had a photo session with the KCU delegates at the grand meeting of the KCU members. He called on all KCU members to hold the great leaders in high esteem as the eternal sun of Juche, cherish the great love and trust of Kim Jong Un and prepare themselves to be genuine sons and daughters of the socialist country and young revolutionaries, true to the pledge they made before the KCU flag. Then, a ceremony for joining the KCU took place. Led by Secretary Ri Il Hwan, pupils joining the KCU were sworn in.
