Officials and persons of merit put red ties around their necks and pinned KCU badges on their uniforms. Congratulatory speeches were made by Kim Song Bong, rector of Mangyongdae Revolutionary School, Pak Pong Hui, principal of Okryu Primary School in Taedonggang District, and Jong Song Ok, secretary of the Korean Athletics Association. Rodong Sinmun

title: Women's Union Members Celebrate Day of Sun in DPRK
body: An art performance "Mine is always the country of President Kim Il Sung" was given by the art squad of the C.C., Socialist Women's Union of Korea (SWUK) at the plaza of the Arch of Triumph on Thursday to celebrate the 110th birth anniversary of the President. Among the audience were Kim Jong Sun, chairwoman of the SWUK Central Committee, and officials and members of the women's union in the city of Pyongyang. Put on the stage of the performance, which started with narration and chorus "Let's Sing of the Day of the Sun", were such numbers as poem story "The Leader is without Parallel in the World" and solo "We Will Never Forget All Sorts of Hardships the Leader Weathered". The performers praised the exploits of the President who built a genuine people's country governed by the working masses and provided its women with the highest dignity and happy life. In their songs and poems they expressed their will to remain faithful to the intention and cause of Chairman Kim Jong Il who protected the destiny of the country and the people and firmly consolidated the eternal foundation for building a prosperous country. The audience was greatly excited by other numbers that sang of the dignity and might of the country being fully demonstrated to the world under the guidance of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. The performance was followed by a dancing party of women's union members. The dancers hardened the faith that a rosy future is in store for the Korean nation along with prosperous socialist Korea, thanks to the greatest auspicious national holiday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Performances Given by Foreign Artistes in April Spring Friendship Festival
body: Songs of friendship and solidarity sung by foreign artistes reverberate throughout Pyongyang, the host city for the 32nd April Spring Friendship Art Festival. Videos of performances by the Chelyabinsk State Ural Dance Group of Russia, the Lao State Art Troupe, Romania's national indoor chorus and Austria's Janoska Ensemble were screened. The Russian dancing troupe is a famous traditional folk dancing troupe. Dancers of the troupe, well known in Russia and other countries, prepared various numbers such as "Floral basket of friendship" and "Return from frontline" for the festival marking the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung to represent the DPRK-Russia friendship. The performers of the world-popular Austrian ensemble, composed of international concours winners, elegantly played world famous songs through a harmonious combination of piano and other instrumental music. The Romanian chorus, known as the best one in its country, demonstrated its prestige with a unique unaccompanied chorus. Dancers of the Lao art troupe also gave an original dancing performance. The performance vividly reflected the will to develop the traditional friendly and cooperative relations between the DPRK and Laos in the struggle for the victory of the socialist cause. Its female solo "Bird of peace" and song and dance "Sound of flute in Laos" gave an artistic description of the desire of the Laotian people to lead an independent, creative and happy life in the world, free from aggression, war and subordination. Rodong Sinmun

title: Taekwon-Do Demonstration Watched by Foreigners, Overseas Koreans in DPRK
body: Members of the diplomatic corps and the military attaches corps here and foreigners and overseas compatriots staying in the DPRK watched a Taekwon-Do demonstration at the Taekwon-Do Hall on April 15, the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. The demonstration and matches of different events were highly appreciated by the spectators for fully displaying the excellence, might and development of the orthodox martial art of the Korean nation. A demonstration of self-defence art by the Vietnamese ambassador to the DPRK left a deep impression upon the watchers. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Messages of Greeting from Chongryon Organizations
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received messages of greeting from organizations and bodies under the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) on the occasion of the Day of the Sun, the greatest auspicious holiday of the Korean nation. They were from central organizations and affiliated organizations of Chongryon, including the Standing Council of the Korean Federation of Workers in Commerce in Japan, the Central Standing Committee of the Korean Youth League in Japan, the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Democratic Korean Women in Japan, the Central Standing Management Board of the Korean Youth Commercial Association in Japan, the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Korean Teachers in Japan, the Central Standing Council of the Union of Korean Educational Association in Japan, the Central Standing Council of the Korean Scientists and Technologists Association in Japan, the Central Standing Council of the Korean Social Scientists Association in Japan, the Standing Council of the Korean Sportsmen's Federation in Japan, the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Korean Writers and Artists in Japan, the Central Standing Council of the Korean Health Workers Association in Japan, the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Korean Students in Japan, the Association of Koreans in Japan for Peaceful Reunification and the Central Standing Council of the Korean Human Rights Association in Japan. They were also from the Choson Sinbo Company, the Korean News Service, the Hagu Bookshop, the Kumgang-san Opera Troupe, the Tonghae Co. Ltd., Kumgang Insurance Company and the Committee for Promoting Korea-Japan Economic Exchange and other businesses, regional headquarters of Chongryon, Korean University and Korean schools at all levels in Japan. They in their messages paid the highest respects to President Kim Il Sung, the eternal sun of Juche and savior of the destiny of Koreans in Japan as a token of their boundless reverence and best wishes of immortality for the President, and extended the greatest glory and warmest felicitations to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, who is bringing the desires and ideals of the great leaders to brilliant fruition, on the occasion of the Day of the Sun, the greatest national holiday. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Letter of Thanks from Central Standing Committee of Chongryon
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un on April 14 received a letter of thanks from the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) which received in great excitement and joy huge educational aid fund and stipends sent by him for democratic national education of children of Korean residents in Japan. The letter offered the highest glory and warmest thanks to Kim Jong Un for having bestowed great benevolence on the children of Koreans in Japan once again, never forgetting them even a moment. The precious money sent by Kim Jong Un gives redoubled strength and courage to the officials of Chongryon and Koreans in Japan going all out for a bold historic advance to bring about the overall development in the movement of Koreans in Japan and greatly encourages their patriotic movement, it noted. It evinced the will to glorify the 25th Congress of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan as the one of the single-minded unity and of succession and innovations, true to the noble intention he clarified in his New Year greetings . It stressed that the association will launch a campaign for increasing the number of students and bringing up the rising generations to be true patriots and capable talents of the nation with firm Juche-oriented outlook on the leader and life this year marking the lapse of 65 years since President Kim Il Sung sent the first educational aid fund and stipends to the children of Koreans in Japan. It expressed the pledge to devotedly defend the authority of the great leaders and Kim Jong Un and contribute to creating a favorable environment for national reunification and building a powerful socialist country. Rodong Sinmun

title: President Kim Il Sung's 110th Birth Anniversary Marked in DPRK
body: April 15, the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, was splendidly celebrated by all the people in the DPRK. Working people and servicepersons visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun with their ardent yearning for the President to pay high tribute to President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. Floral baskets, together with bouquets and flowers, were placed at the statues of the great leaders on Mansu Hill in Pyongyang and other parts of the country. Ceremonies were held in every province to award state commendations to the officials and workers who have distinguished themselves in implementing the Party's policies. Joint meetings of the Korean Children's Union organizations and celebrations of the working people's organizations were held in every province, city and county. A national art exhibition, a national book exhibition and a stamp show were held at the Okryu Exhibition Hall and the Korean Stamp Exhibition House. There took place colorful concerts in Pyongyang and local areas as well as a drama "Devoted Service" at the National Theatre and an acrobatic performance at the Pyongyang Circus Theater to rev up the festive mood of the people enjoying the holiday. Artistes and art groups at national and city levels gave outdoor performances at different places of the country. The concerts given in South Phyongan Province, South Hwanghae Province, Jagang Province, South Hamgyong Province, Ryanggang Province and Kaesong City also added to the festive atmosphere. There were football games at Kim Il Sung Stadium and the Sosan Football Ground, Taekwon-do and judo games at the Taekwon-Do Hall and the Combat Sports Gymnasium in Chongchun Street as well as various kinds of sports games at different institutions, factories, enterprises, farms and universities. The Central Zoo, Natural History Museum, Munsu Water Park and other recreation centres in the capital city of Pyongyang were overflowed with visitors. Public catering establishments and other service amenities in Pyongyang and local areas offered special holiday services to the citizens. Working people and students in seats of different provinces, cities and counties had dancing parties and evening galas to express their ardent yearning for President Kim Il Sung. Fireworks were set off in the evening of April 15 at squares, parks and recreation grounds in the seats of all provinces across the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of Great Leaders
body: All the people in the DPRK pay the highest tribute and glory to President Kim Il Sung on the occasion of the significant Day of the Sun, his birth anniversary. Working people, service personnel and schoolchildren across the country visited the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in different parts to pay floral tribute to them. Placed at the statues on Mansu Hill were floral baskets in the names of Party, power and armed forces organs, social organizations, ministries, national institutions, units of the Korean People's Army (KPA), the Public Security Forces (PSF) and institutions, industrial establishments and universities at all levels in the capital city of Pyongyang. The chief and members of the Pyongyang Mission of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front laid a floral basket before the statues. The visitors made a deep bow before the statues of the great leaders. Floral baskets in the names of institutions, enterprises, KPA and PSF units and others were laid before the statues of the great leaders and the mosaics picturing their smiling images at Kim Il Sung University, the Ministry of National Defence, the Mansudae Art Studio and other parts of Pyongyang. The statues of the great leaders and their mosaics in local areas were visited by the residents. Rodong Sinmun

title: Citizens Begin Moving to New Houses in Songhwa Street of Pyongyang
body: Songhwa Street, which has been built as the one symbolic of socialist civilization, is full of the joy and excitement of the citizens moving to new houses. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un attended the inauguration ceremony of Songhwa Street held with splendor on the occasion of the Day of the Sun, the greatest auspicious holiday of the nation. He warmly wished working people happiness in a new street and new houses and took a measure of benevolence to make sure that they would move to their new apartments at the earliest date. On April 14, the street was seething with the blessed citizens dancing in great joy of moving to new houses. The soldier- and civilian-builders presented bouquets to them and helped them carry their household goods to their houses. Officials of the headquarters for the construction of 50 000 flats in Pyongyang City and commanding officers of the units of the People's Army involved in the construction of Songhwa Street visited the families moving into the new houses to congratulate them. The delighted citizens expressed their profound gratitude to the motherly Party. Rodong Sinmun

title: April Spring People's Art Festival Celebrates Day of Sun
body: The participants in the 7th April Spring People's Art Festival gave performances in celebration of the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. The performances were given at the People's Palace of Culture, the East Pyongyang Grand Theatre, the Ponghwa Art Theatre, the Pyongyang Grand Theatre, the Central Youth Hall and the magic theatre of the National Acrobatic Troupe on Friday. The artistes praised the whole life of the President characterized by the idea "The people are my God". Songs like "Our Unforgettable Leader" helped the audiences recall the sacred revolutionary life of the matchless patriot and illustrious great sage who achieved the historic cause of Korea's liberation through protracted hard-fought anti-Japanese struggle and built a genuine people's country, an invincible socialist country on this land. Numbers like song accompanied by drum-beating "For Another Surge under the Banner of Self-reliance" and song accompanied by guitar "We Will Lead the World" showed the mental world of our people bringing forward the bright future with their own hands, out of warm love for the country, the legacy bequeathed down by President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. Odes representing reverence and trust in the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, who is brilliantly carrying forward the cause of the sun, revved up the atmosphere of the performances. The performances were culminated in poem and chorus "Our National Flag" and "People Are of a Single Mind" pulsating with the strong spirit of Juche Korea and hardening the ardent patriotic will to make sincere dedication to building a powerful and prosperous country. The magicians presented a performance with colorful numbers like illusionary jugglery, functional jugglery and common jugglery. The performances were highly acclaimed by the audiences. Rodong Sinmun

title: Celebration Meetings Held in DPRK
body: Meetings were held in every province, city and county of the DPRK to celebrate the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Officials of the regional Party and power organs, working people's organizations and industrial establishments and working people attended the meetings at which the leading officials of those units made reports. The reporters paid the highest tribute and eternal glory to President Kim Il Sung in reflection of the deep yearning and profound feelings of best wishes of all the people on the Day of the Sun, the greatest auspicious national holiday. They stressed that the whole life of the President was the revolutionary one during which he, believing in the people as in Heaven, made sincere devotion to the people and safeguarded their dignity and rights and brought about a happy life for them while sharing the same destiny with them. They noted that one of great exploits performed by the President was that he brought everything desired by the people into practice in his lifetime while paving an untrodden path with the people and opened an era centered on the popular masses. They said the President embraced all the fellow countrymen with ardent human love and great tolerance and wrote a noble history for national reunification and the great unity of the nation. He also made great contribution to safeguarding justice and peace and establishing a new international order through his energetic external activities, they noted. They said that the President put his heart and soul into steadily carrying forward the revolutionary cause of Juche pioneered in Paektu and the transparent revolutionary spirit and struggle traditions of the anti-Japanese martyrs down through generations. They added that as the exploits and achievements made by the President are of eternal and global value and his noble spirit and virtues moved all people, he is admired not only by the Korean people but by many nations of the world as the genuine leader of the people. They emphasized that the revolutionary cause of Juche pioneered by the President was invariably inherited by Chairman Kim Jong Il and it is now making steady progress on a new higher stage under the leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. They called on all the officials, Party members and working people to dedicate themselves to the all-out advance for the prosperous socialist country under the leadership of Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Performances Given by Overseas Korean and Chinese Artistes
body: Songs praising the great man President Kim Il Sung reverberate far and wide on the April spring holiday, adding to the delight of our people and the world progressive people celebrating the greatest auspicious holiday of the Korean nation, a holiday common to humankind. Music and dance performance "Under Rays of Eternal Sun" given by Koreans in Japan showed their national pride and esteem of being overseas citizens of Juche Korea. The performance began with narrative "Song of Loyalty", in which the performers extended the noblest respect and best wishes of immortality to President Kim Il Sung, founder of socialist Korea and tender-hearted father of the nation, in reflection of the ardent loyalty of all Koreans in Japan. They portrayed their strong yearnings for the President, pioneer of the overseas compatriots' movement in the era of independence, founder of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) and benefactor for the life of the Koreans in Japan. In numbers like national percussion instrument ensemble and dance "Delight of Nation" and chorus "Glory to General Kim Jong Un", the artistes of an art troupe of Koreans in Japan showed their firm faith and will to carry forward the cause of Chongryon and patriotism under the leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. A performance given by artistes of a Chinese Dongfang music group added to the festive mood of the Day of the Sun. "We Love Our Country" sung by a famous soloist portrayed the Korean people's warm love for the socialist homeland. Through a chorus "DPRK-China Friendship Will Be Everlasting", the artistes showed well ardent patriotism of the peoples of the DPRK and China and friendly feelings between them with rich voice and high artistic skill. Rodong Sinmun

title: Art Festival Full of Friendly Affection (5)
body: Performances at the 32nd April Spring Friendship Art Festival Many artistes from various countries cherish the moments of performing before the great Comrades Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il as the most glorious and happiest memory in their life. For the current festival, they rendered with splendor the immortal revolutionary hymns “Song of General Kim Il Sung”, “Song of General Kim Jong Il” and “Ode to General Kim Jong Un.” The China Oriental Performing Arts Group, the Yurlov Russian State Academic Choir, the Academic Song and Dance Ensemble of the National Guard of the Russian Federation, the Mongolian Military Song and Dance Academic Ensemble, and the State Morin Khuur Ensemble of Mongolia reflected in their choruses the noble ideological feelings of the world people who pray for the immortality of Comrades Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il with boundless reverence for them with lofty and solemn emotions full of burning passion. Their choruses portray deep fascination for the peerlessly great men with solemn and spirited, yet bright and joyous emotions, leading the audiences to emotional recollection of the unforgettable moments of the past spring festivals. Rodong Sinmun

title: Performances for April Spring Friendship Art Festival
body: The 32nd April Spring Friendship Art Festival is now going on in the DPRK with attendance of many foreign artistes, who sing loudly of the great fortune of the Korean people guided by the peerlessly great leaders through generations. Colorful numbers were presented to it by Vietnamese artistes and acrobats of different countries. The Vietnamese artistes had striven to brilliantly decorate the current festival held this significant year marking the 110th birthday of President Kim Il Sung, the 80th birthday of Chairman Kim Jong Il, the 3rd anniversary of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's official goodwill visit to Vietnam and the 65th anniversary of President Ho Chi Minh's visit to the DPRK. In their performance which started with a folk orchestra "Echo", they showed the ardent patriotism and noble mental world of the Vietnamese people and the development of their national art through various numbers. Through a mixed chorus "Cantata to Marshal Kim Il Sung", they praised the noble internationalist obligation and moral influence of Kim Il Sung. A female duet "Sing, Road to Front" praising the exploits of Kim Jong Il made the audience recall the life of the peerlessly great man with deep emotion. The performance reached its climax with a mixed chorus "Cheers of the People", which boosted the Korean people's high pride and honor of being citizens of socialist Korea where the history of the sun is given steady continuity and a new era of powerful nation is opened up under the guidance of Kim Jong Un. It ended with a song and dance "Pyongyang Is Best". Acrobatic performances by the Circus of State Acrobatic Company of Russia and circuses of Kazakhstan and Mongolia, too, added to the festive mood of celebrating the Day of the Sun, the birth anniversary of Kim Il Sung. Rodong Sinmun

title: Chongryon Hosts Lecture to Mark Birth Anniversary of President Kim Il Sung
body: A lecture was given at the Central Hall of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) in Tokyo on April 13 to celebrate the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Present there were Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, Pak Ku Ho, first vice-chairman and director of the Organizational Department of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, vice-chairpersons of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, the chairman of the Central Audit Committee of Chongryon, department directors and other officials of Chongryon. A video "With the people" was screened at the lecture. It deals with the historical data on the revolutionary career of President Kim Il Sung who put the dignity of the country and its people on the highest level for the first time in the history of the nation spanning 5 000 years and brought about great changes admired by mankind. It shows the fact that the President defeated the most formidable Japanese and U.S. imperialisms in one generation and led to victory the two stages of rehabilitation and construction and the two stages of social revolution and socialist construction by pursuing the politics centered on the popular masses. Also recorded in it are the historical data on the whole life of the President who put forward the popular masses as the driving force of revolution in the proud annals of national history and built a powerful country independent in politics, self-supporting in the economy and self-reliant in defence on their strength. Contained in it are photos of the President, a great man who devoted himself to the work for the people with his warm humanity. The video tells about the fact that the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un has taken warm care of the Chongryon and compatriots in Japan as members of the great nation living in an alien land and provided a legal guarantee for defending the rights and interests of overseas compatriots this year to protect the destiny and future of the Koreans in Japan in a responsible manner. Rodong Sinmun

title: Participants in April Spring People's Art Festival Tour Pyongyang
body: The participants in the 7th April Spring People's Art Festival toured different parts of Pyongyang. They visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the sacred temple of Juche where President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il lie in state, and paid high tribute to them. They made a bow to the portraits of the smiling President and Chairman. And they visited the President's birthplace at Mangyongdae. At his old home they saw historic mementoes preserved with much care, recollecting the revolutionary feats of the President and the career of his patriotic and revolutionary family members. At the Hall of Great Leaders and Their Comrades-in-Arms of the Korean Revolution Museum, they were briefed on the lives of the revolutionary soldiers who enjoy immortality under the care of the Workers' Party of Korea. They also visited the National Gifts Exhibition House, the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum and the Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery. Meanwhile, they watched a drama "Devoted Service" at the National Theatre. Rodong Sinmun

title: Association of Koreans in Japan for Peaceful Reunification Meets
body: The Association of Koreans in Japan for Peaceful Reunification held a meeting in Tokyo on April 13 on the occasion of the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Present there were Ri Tong Je, chairman of the Association of Koreans in Japan for Peaceful Reunification, and its vice-chairpersons and members. Videos titled "With the people" and "Feats of the leader who devoted himself to the cause of independent reunification of the country all his life" were screened at the meeting. Then speeches were made. The speakers noted that President Kim Il Sung dedicated all his life to providing our fellow countrymen with a reunified country, taking to heart the national division more than anyone else. The President laid down the three principles of national reunification, the proposal for founding the Democratic Federal Republic of Koryo, the ten-point programme of the great unity of the whole nation and other great programmes for national reunification, frustrating the obstructive moves of the separatist forces and ushering in a heyday of the nation-wide reunification movement, they said. They stressed that it is the highest honor and pride of the Korean nation and fortune of its posterity to have the President as the eternal father of the nation. They praised Chairman Kim Jong Il for opening up the June 15 era of independent reunification in the idea of By Our Nation Itself, true to the President's instructions for reunification. They said that the cause of independent reunification pioneered and led by the President and the Chairman is being successfully carried forward by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, another peerless patriot. Rodong Sinmun

title: Seminar of Korean Social Scientists in Japan Held
body: A seminar of Korean Social Scientists in Japan was held at the Central Hall of the General Association of Koreans Residents in Japan (Chongryon) in Tokyo on April 12 to celebrate the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. It was attended by Pae Jin Gu, vice-chairman and director general of the General Affairs Department of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, Chairman Ri Yong Su and members of the Korean Social Scientists Association in Japan, and officials of Chongryon in the Kanto area. Ri Yong Su made a report titled "The era of our state-first principle and period of overall development of socialism ushered in by the respected Marshal Kim Jong Un glorifying the immortal leadership exploits of the great leader Generalissimo Kim Il Sung". The reporter said the revolutionary cause of Juche, pioneered in Mt Paektu and victoriously advanced, has entered a golden age of its development, adding it is thanks to Generalissimo Kim Il Sung who provided the eternal cornerstone for the victorious advance and accomplishment of the revolutionary cause of Juche. He also referred to the Generalissimo's outstanding idea and immortal leadership feats. He mentioned in a systematic way the main characteristics of the era of our state-first principle ushered in by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un creditably carrying forward the cause of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, and the greatness of the idea of Kim Jong Un on the comprehensive development of socialism. Then, speeches were made by Kang Il Chon, vice-chairman of the Korean Social Scientists Association in Japan, and Ryom Mun Song, managing director of its Central Standing Council. Rodong Sinmun

title: Celebrations Held at DPRK Embassy in China
body: Celebrations were held at the DPRK embassy in Beijing on April 14 on the occasion of the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Present there were Ma Biao, vice-chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, officials of the Chinese party and government including the International Liaison Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC) and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and personages of various circles. They laid a floral basket in the name of the CPC Central Committee before the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and made a bow to them. They looked around the photos showing the feats made by the President through his external activities and watched a video clip recording the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's visit to China. Chinese party and government officials talked with the DPRK ambassador and members of the embassy. Vice-Chairman Ma Biao said that Comrade Kim Il Sung is the great founder and leader of the Korean party and state and that he is always alive in the mind of the two peoples as he made deep acquaintance with revolutionaries of old generation in China and devoted himself to the development of the China-DPRK friendship relations. In recent years, the China-DPRK friendship has been put on a new stage of development under the strategic guidance of the leaders of the two parties and countries, he said, adding: The Chinese side will make joint efforts with the Korean comrades to constantly develop the China-DPRK relations in keeping with the demand of the times by carrying into practice the important common understanding of the leaders of the two countries and make an active contribution to the regional peace, stability and prosperity. He expressed belief that the Korean people would make greater progress in the accomplishment of the socialist cause under the guidance of the Workers' Party of Korea headed by Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Music and Dance Performance Given by Koreans in Japan
body: A music and dance performance "Under the care of the eternal sun" was given at the Korean Hall of Culture in Tokyo on April 14 to celebrate the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Among the audience were Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), Pak Ku Ho, first vice-chairman and director of the Organizational Department of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, vice-chairpersons, advisors and department directors of the Central Standing Committee, leading officials of central leadership bodies and affiliates of Chongryon, chairpersons of the Chongryon headquarters in the Kanto area, other officials and Koreans in Japan, and students of Korean University. In the performance, a narrator referred to the excitement of Chongryon officials and compatriots celebrating the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung as a great auspicious holiday to be etched in the national history, saying that the compatriots' yearning for the President is growing deeper as the days go by. The performance began with the playing of national orchestral music of the all-people hymn "Song of Loyalty" by artistes of the Kumgang-san Opera Troupe of Chongryon and students of Korean University. In such numbers as song and dance "Let us sing and dance", solo "Do prosper, my homeland" and mixed duet "We sing of our homeland", the performers sang of the deep gratitude to the President who brought the Koreans in Japan under the care of their homeland, showed warm benevolence for them and provided them with genuine life as overseas citizens of the dignified DPRK. Put on the stage were numbers vividly showing the deep reverence of Koreans in Japan for the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un and their great honor and happiness of being blessed by the great leaders generation after generation. Other numbers represented their gratitude to the President who took warm care of Koreans in Japan and led their movement and their great joy of celebrating his anniversary as the great auspicious holiday in the nation's history. Rodong Sinmun

title: Meeting of Koreans in Japan Held
body: A meeting of Koreans in Japan was held at the Korean Hall of Culture in Tokyo on April 14 to commemorate the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Present there were Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), Pak Ku Ho, first vice-chairman and director of the Organizational Department of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, Nam Sung U, vice-chairman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, Pae Jin Gu, vice-chairman and director general of the General Affairs Department of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, Jo Il Yon, vice-chairman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, Song Kun Hak, vice-chairman and director of the Education Department of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, Kang Chu Ryon, vice-chairwoman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee and chairwoman of the Central Stranding Committee of the Union of Democratic Korean Women in Japan, Ri Myong Yu, chairman of the Central Audit Committee of Chongryon, Han Tong Song, rector of Korean University, advisors and department directors of the Chongryon Central Committee, the director of the Research Institute on History of Korean Residents in Japan, chairpersons of headquarters of Chongryon, leading officials of central leadership bodies and affiliates of Chongryon and other Koreans in Japan. Ho Jong Man in a report highly praised the great leader Generalissimo Kim Il Sung as a peerlessly great man and outstanding leader who laid solid foundations for the eternal victory and prosperity of Juche Korea by leading the unprecedentedly arduous and stern Korean revolution. The great Generalissimo is alive in the hearts of the Korean people as the tender-hearted father of the people, a peerlessly great man revered by all people, he said. He recalled that the Generalissimo formed Chongryon, a genuine national organization and compatriots' organization, on May 25, 1955, thus firmly putting the movement of Koreans in Japan on a Juche-oriented orbit and leading Chongryon to become a model organization in the world overseas compatriots movement till the last moments of his great life. Saying the feats the Generalissimo performed for the cause of Juche and the movement of Koreans in Japan were further glorified under the guidance of the great leader Generalissimo Kim Jong Il, the reporter stressed that the great leaders' desire for building a powerful nation has been translated into brilliant reality by the respected Marshal Kim Jong Un. Chongryon will greet its 25th Congress to be held this year of great auspicious events in the nation's history in a lively atmosphere of lauding the great leaders and implementing their behests, holding them in high esteem, he said. He called upon all the officials of Chongryon and other compatriots to go all out for the patriotic movement for further demonstrating the might of Chongryon, the precious patriotic legacy of Kim Il Sung, to the world and putting the movement of Koreans in Japan on the stage of overall development under the leadership of Kim Jong Un. A congratulatory letter of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee to Kim Jong Un was read out at the meeting. Rodong Sinmun

title: Participants in People's Art Festival Stage Motivation Campaign at Housing Construction Site
body: The participants in the 7th April Spring People's Art Festival conducted a motivation campaign at the construction site for 10 000 flats in the Hwasong area on April 17. They staged vigorous field performing activities, working together with builders. Members of South Hwanghae and Kangwon provincial art troupes and North Hwanghae and North Hamgyong provincial art squads performed such numbers inspiring the builders with the pride of taking part in the construction to realize the Party Central Committee's noble idea of devoted service for the people's wellbeing. Songs sung by art squad members of the railway sector boosted the soaring enthusiasm of the builders to be victors in the grand construction struggle by emulating the indomitable fighting spirit and traits of the preceding generations. Itinerant art squad members of the 216 Division, Yonsan County, the Sunchon Cement Complex and the Pyongyang Electric Cable General Factory 326 showed the enthusiastic, delightful and colorful numbers. The art group members of the Susongchon General Foodstuff Factory and the Sinchang Fishermen's Cooperative revved up the militant climate of the construction site with their inspirational art pieces and songs pulsating with the spirit of the age. Rodong Sinmun

title: Moving into Luxury Houses in Kyongru-dong
body: Citizens are moving into new houses in Kyongru-dong of Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, to boost the joy and excitement of all the people who celebrated the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung as a great revolutionary event. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un took part in the inauguration ceremony of the Pothong Riverside Terraced Residential District ahead of the Day of the Sun and saw to it that the masters of Kyongru-dong are moved into the new houses there as early as possible to lead a blessed life. On April 14, labor innovators, persons of merit, scientists, educators, writers and their families in the city began moving into the houses in Kyongru-dong. Those moving into the luxury residential district were warmly congratulated by officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials of the Party and government organs in the capital city and builders. Kyongru-dong was seething with citizens dancing in a great joy of moving into new houses. The labor innovators and persons of merit, who have settled in Kyongru-dong, hardened their resolve to dedicate themselves to the prosperity of the great country as intended by Kim Jong Un, talking about the benevolence of the Party Central Committee in tears. Rodong Sinmun

title: Internet Stage Opens to Mark 110th Birth Anniversary of President Kim Il Sung
body: An internet stage was opened on April 12 to celebrate the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, the Day of the Sun. A special website for the stage is divided into several sections under the title of "Kim Il Sung, eternal sun of humankind" against the background of a picture of his birthplace at Mangyongdae. Displayed on "Photos in celebration of Day of Sun" are the photos dealing with the undying achievements the President made in accomplishing the cause of global independence. There are also pictures showing the gifts, orders, medals and titles of honor he received from party and state leaders and personages of different circles in many countries. "Platform in congratulation of Day of Sun" shows pictures of floral baskets sent by the Organizing Committee for the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu, international democratic organizations, organizations for friendship and solidarity with the Korean people in different countries to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un and the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill on the occasion of the Day of the Sun. Posted on it were also letters and remarks, speeches in congratulation of the opening of the internet stage, videos of foreigners singing and reciting self-created songs and poems in praise of the President and photos and videos dealing with the celebrations of the Day of the Sun held in different countries. "Reverence for Great Person" carries articles of foreign personages, who had the honor of being received by the President, and programs introducing the 32nd April Spring Friendship Art Festival and the Fifth International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu. A section titled "For just cause of Korean people" shows photos and programs dealing with the worldwide solidarity events in support of the Korean people's struggle for socialist construction and peace and security of the Korean Peninsula. Present at the opening ceremony were co-chairpersons of the Organizing committee for the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu, the chairperson of the Korean Friendship Association and personages from Pakistan, the Philippines, Algeria, Egypt, Italy, Britain, Peru, Venezuela and other countries. Speeches and a briefing on the celebration stage were given there. Posted on its special website were articles representing the impressions of foreign figures who had been received by the President. Also posted were speeches and letters and videos in congratulation of the opening of the celebration stage. A letter to Kim Jong Un was adopted at the opening ceremony. Rodong Sinmun

title: Letter to Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un from Participants in Internet Celebration Stage
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a letter from the participants in an opening ceremony of an internet stage for celebrating the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung on April 12. The participants noted in the letter that they held the opening ceremony of the internet stage for celebrating the 110th birth anniversary of the President under the co-sponsorship of the Organizing Committee of the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu and the Korean Friendship Association, reflecting the unanimous desire of the world progressive people. They praised the President as a peerless politician who opened up the era of independence with the Juche idea, the great guiding ideology, and provided a model of building an independent and sovereign state in Korea. They said that he set forth the unique idea of global independence, resolutely rejected all sorts of domination and subjugation and rendered sincere support and assistance to all countries and nations in the whole period of his revolutionary life, helping them achieve common prosperity and stability on the principle of independence. They stressed that he has been admired and praised by all the people as the greatest man and sage for his outstanding ideology and theory, rare leadership and noble virtues, adding he is always alive in the hearts of the progressive people as the sun. They noted that his idea and cause were invariably carried forward by Chairman Kim Jong Il and have been further developed by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. They said that they will fulfill their responsibility and duty in conveying and adding shine to the exploits of the peerlessly great men and supporting and encouraging the Korean people's cause of justice in the rest period of this year after the Day of the Sun. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Greetings to Syrian President
body: Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a message of greeting to Bashar Al-Assad, president of the Syrian Arab Republic, on April 17. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un in the message extended warm congratulations to the president, friendly government and people of Syria on the occasion of the 76th anniversary of its independence. He said that the independence of Syria was an event of weighty significance in the struggle of the Syrian people to oppose the aggression and subordination by the imperialists and pave the way for the independent life. Expressing belief that the friendly relations between the two countries, established and developed by the preceding leaders in the protracted course of the joint struggle against imperialism, would grow stronger in keeping with requirement of the new era, he wished the Syrian people success in their struggle for defending the sovereignty of the country and hastening its reconstruction. Rodong Sinmun

title: Sun of the Nation, Peerless Hero
body: Building Up New Country of People Korean people always engrave on their minds the immortal exploits of President Kim Il Sung who founded the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea (DPRK) which demonstrates to the world its prestige and might as a powerful independent country. Kim Il Sung, in a complex situation just after the national liberation, vigorously aroused the popular masses to building up a new country. After Korea’s liberation the US imperialists occupied south Korea and reactionaries at home and abroad took to an evil course. However, he pushed forward with the construction of the country vigorously. In particular, he gave detailed guidance to adopting the name of the country, national emblem and national flag in accord with the aspiration and requirement of the people. And he laid a firm basis for foundation of the Republic through general elections throughout the north and the south. Then he formed a unified central government of Korean people, the government of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, and declared the foundation of the Republic to the world on September 9, Juche 37(1948). Kim Il Sung was elected as the head of the Republic in compliance with the unanimous will and desire of the entire Korean people. As the DPRK was founded by the President, Korean people who had lived more miserable life than a dog in a house of death, suffering sorrow of a stateless people, could become the dignified people who carve out their destiny in an independent and creative way as the genuine masters of the state and society. (To be continued) Rodong Sinmun

title: Public Procession in Celebration of Day of Sun: Pledge of Faith to Be Loyal to Leader
body: Public procession of Pyongyang citizens was held with splendor at Kim Il Sung Square in celebration of the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Kim Il Sung Square was built in the 1950s and its original name was a major square in the master plan for the reconstruction of Pyongyang which the President worked out during the Fatherland Liberation War, looking forward into the victorious morrow. On every meaningful occasion during his leadership over the post-war rehabilitation and construction, the socialist revolution and the socialist construction since then, the President warmly congratulated and encouraged our people and servicepersons from its platform, when they exalted the pride and dignity of victors. Generations have been replaced several times and the appearance of the square has changed, but one thing that remains unchanged is cheers and loyalty of the people to their leaders. In one mind to celebrate the Day of the Sun, an auspicious national holiday, a great number of people from numerous enterprises, ministries and national institutions and neighborhood units gathered there. As the public procession of Pyongyang citizens began with the solemn melody of the song "The Glorious Motherland", the square immediately seethed with passions and cheers. The people raised the stormy cheers of hurrah looking up to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un standing on the platform and proceeded past the platform with writings "Single-minded Unity" and "We'll Travel One Road Forever ". Let us be loyal to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un forever along the road of victory and glory as we remained loyal to President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. Our people will follow the great leaders to the end of the earth, with loyalty to them. The cheers of hurrah originated at Kim Il Sung Square in April reverberate far and wide with the echoes of loyalty sounding to the minds of all the people in the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Koreans in China Celebrate Birth Anniversary of President Kim Il Sung
body: There were celebrations by organizations of Koreans in China on the occasion of the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. The General Association of Koreans in China (GAKC) laid a floral basket before the art work depicting President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il at the DPRK Consulate General in Shenyang and made a bow to them on April 15. Floral tribute was paid to the portraits of smiling Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il at the DPRK embassy in Beijing and mission in Dandong by the Zhongnan Regional Association and other branch organizations of the GAKC on April 14. A celebration meeting of the GAKC was held in Dandong, China on April 15. In the report, Ri Sun Nam, vice-chairperson of the GAKC, said that they would be loyal to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, true to the noble intention of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. A congratulatory letter to Kim Jong Un was adopted at the meeting. Organizations affiliated to the GAKC took part in the meeting through video conferencing. The meeting was followed by a presentation of works praising the feats of the President, art performance and reception. A seminar on the feats of the President to celebrate his 110th birth anniversary was held through video conferencing in Shenyang, China sponsored by the GAKC on April 13. The speakers mentioned in detail the immortal feats performed by the President during the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle. Meanwhile, the Yanbian Regional Association of the GAKC watched a Korean documentary film "Our Leader" and held a seminar on the greatness and noble virtue of the President. A celebration round-table talk was held by the Jilin Province Regional Association of the GAKC through video. The Zhongnan Regional Association of the GAKC looked around the venue of a photo exhibition at the DPRK embassy in Beijing. Rodong Sinmun

title: Premier Kim Tok Hun Inspects Construction Site of 10 000 Flats in Hwasong Area and Chollima Steel Complex
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, inspected the construction site of 10 000 flats in the Hwasong area and the Chollima Steel Complex. In the housing construction site in the Hwasong area, he stressed the need for officials and builders to devote their wisdom and ardor to the construction of new modern city district on a perfect level by drawing on the achievements and experience gained in the construction of Songhwa Street, keeping in their minds the intention of the Party Central Committee pushing forward with the housing construction in the capital city every year. He emphasized the need to meticulously organize the operation and command of the construction projects under well thought-out plan in keeping with the three-dimensional speedy construction and to successfully ensure the provision of building materials in time. At the Chollima Steel Complex, he, learning in detail about the production, underscored the need to further perfect our style iron production method in a technical way to ensure satisfactory production and supply of various kinds of steel and called for taking measure for the provision of fuel, raw and other materials. The field consultative meetings discussed the issue of conducting the construction guidance in a sci-tech way in order to thoroughly guarantee the quality and speed of projects, the issue for officials to carry out without fail the monthly and quarterly production plans with unusual awareness, competent organizing ability and strenuous drive, and the issue of lowering the cost of iron production to promote the work for reinforcing the existing production foundation on a long-term basis. Rodong Sinmun

title: Foreign Art Troupes, Superstars Celebrate Day of Sun
body: The 32nd April Spring Friendship Art Festival to mark the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, the significant Day of the Sun, was performed by art troupes and famous singers of different countries, adding to the reverence of the Korean people and world progressives for the great men of the DPRK. The artistes of the Song and Dance Ensemble of the Mongolian Army enthusiastically sang the immortal revolutionary hymn "Ode to General Kim Jong Un" out of boundless reverence for the great man of the century. Male chorus "Song of Comradeship" given by the above ensemble and instrumental ensemble "Arirang" by a Mongolian state art troupe left a deep impression. The State Academy Beryozka Dancing Troupe of Russia Named after N.S. Nadezhdina gave a wonderful performance. A dance to the tune of "A Dear Name", popular Korean song, aroused great yearning and reverence for Chairman Kim Jong Il. Dances "White Birch" and "Little River" and other numbers vividly depicted the optimistic life of the people of Russia and its beautiful nature. Male quartets such as "Blue Sea" and others performed by other Russian artistes showed their national sentiments and emotions in a lyrical and elegant fashion. Male solo and chorus "New World" and female solo "The Fluttering Red Flag" given by the Chinese Dongfang music group showed the Chinese people's feelings of love for their country and their desire to dynamically advance towards a rosier future. Rodong Sinmun

title: 7th April Spring People's Art Festival Closed
body: The 7th April Spring People's Art Festival, which opened in Pyongyang on the occasion of the Day of the Sun (birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung), closed with due ceremony at the East Pyongyang Grand Theatre on April 18. Attending the closing ceremony were Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Ri Song Hak, vice-premier of the Cabinet, officials concerned and the participants in the festival. There was a prize-giving ceremony, where 3 units were awarded special prize, 14 units group prize, 3 works and 7 units prize of ensemble and 59 persons individual prize. And festival certificates and cups were conferred on seven works highly appreciated in the magic festival. A letter to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un was adopted at the ceremony. Minister of Culture Sung Jong Gyu, chairman of the festival organizing committee, made a closing address. He said that through the 7th April Spring People's Art Festival, the Korean people realized once again that the history of the sun is given steady continuity on this land as they hold another peerlessly great man in high esteem, revering the President boundlessly. Then a closing performance was given. Rodong Sinmun

title: Foreign Personages Pay Congratulatory Visits to DPRK Missions
body: Personages of various circles in different countries paid congratulatory visits to the DPRK missions in their countries on the occasion of the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung and the 10th anniversary of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's assumption of the top posts of the Party and the state. They laid floral baskets and bouquets at the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and the art pieces depicting the President and the Chairman standing together and made bows. They included personages from the Workers' Party of Bangladesh, the Bangladesh National Socialist Party, the Communist Party of Bangladesh (Marxist-Leninist), the Awami League of Bangladesh, the Bangladesh Institute of the Juche Idea, the Bangladesh-Korea Friendship and Solidarity Committee, the Socialist Party of Romania, the National Socialist Party (Romania), the Romanian Workers' Association, the Romania-Korea Friendship Association, the State Academy Beryozka Dancing Troupe of Russia Named after N. S. Nadezhdina, the Mfumalanga Provincial Committee of the South African Communist Party, the Socialist Freedom Party of Egypt and other foreign political parties and organizations. The chairperson of the Nepal Communist Party (United Socialist), the secretary general of the Nepalese Association for Supporting the Songun Politics and the general secretary of the Central Committee of the Czechoslovak Communist Party paid congratulatory visits to the DPRK missions in their countries. Rodong Sinmun

title: Mangyongdae Prize National Martial Art Championship Closes
body: The Mangyongdae Prize National Martial Art Championship for marking the Day of the Sun (birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung) closed with due ceremony at the Taekwon-Do Hall on Monday. Pyongyang City placed the first place in total standings, South Phyongan Province the second place and Jagang Province the third place. The Pyongyang City Taekwon-Do team came first in Taekwon-Do event, the South Phyongan Provincial Taekwon-Do team second and the Jagang Provincial Taekwon-Do team third. The Paduk team under the Pyongyang City Paduk Centre came first in Paduk event, and the Paduk teams under the South Phyongan Provincial Paduk Centre second and the South Hamgyong Provincial Paduk Centre third. The Pyongyang City Janggi Association won the first place in Janggi (Korean chess) event, the North Hwanghae Provincial Janggi Association the second place and the Kangwon Provincial Janggi Association the third place. Present at the closing ceremony were Ri Tu Song, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and vice-chairman of the National Sports Guidance Committee, Kim Chun Sik, secretary general of the National Sports Guidance Committee, officials concerned, sportspersons and citizens in Pyongyang. Vice-premier of the Cabinet Kim Song Ryong made a closing address. Rodong Sinmun

title: Raising Masses’ Enthusiasm
body: Officials and working people in the chemical industry put further spurs to their offensive advance. Those at the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex, mindful of the importance of their duty in constantly developing the country’s agricultural production in this meaningful year, bring about innovations in fertilizer production. They concentrate efforts on doing full justice to the newly-expanded fertilizer production lines in reliance on science and technology. They dovetail workshops and production lines with one another and tap latent reserves to the full, thereby fulfilling without fail the daily production assignments. Labor and management of the February 8 Vinalon Complex brace themselves up to increase production of various chemical goods, with immortal guidance exploits of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il performed for the Juche-oriented vinalon industry kept deep in their hearts. They focus on ensuring home production of major materials and catalysts and consolidate their own material and technological foundations despite unfavorable production conditions. In particular, they scrupulously manage equipment and technology and strictly observe the standard regulations of operation in each process, thus turning out chemical goods in larger numbers. Those at other chemical factories like the Ponghwa Chemical Factory and Sinuiju Chemical Fiber Mill make endeavors to strengthen their own technical force and strive to carry out their production plan on all indices. Rodong Sinmun

title: Pakyon Falls, Scenic Beauty of Korea
body: Korea has been widely known as a "country of scenic beauty" from early times. Among its scenic spots is Pakyon Falls, one of the three famous falls in Korea. It is located in Pakyon-ri, Kaesong City of the DPRK. The Pakyon Falls is 37 meters high and 1.5 meters wide. The water, which runs down into the ravine between Songgo and Chonma mountains and falls down a rock wall, constitutes the falls. There is a pond "Pakyon" on the top of the falls with a standing-stone in the center. At the bottom of the falls, there is another pond named "Komodam". And there is a round rock named "Ryongbawi" (dragon-shaped rock) on the border of "Komodam". The Pakyon Falls looks more beautiful in good harmony with rocks of fantastic shapes and forests around it. Rodong Sinmun

title: Better Conditions Provided for Schoolchildren in DPRK
body: South Hwanghae Province of the DPRK has provided the schoolchildren in Ungchon-ri of Pongchon County with better educational conditions and environment. More than 100 schoolchildren in this mountainous village had had difficulty in attending school because of a lake made during the waterway construction. The province drew up a project for establishing a branch school in the village for the pupils attending Ungchon Senior Middle School and building a commuter boat for the junior and senior class students, and took necessary measures to carry out the project, concentrating all efforts on it. After all, the branch school appeared in a sunny place near the village and a commuter boat was successfully built in a short period of time. On Tuesday, the branch school opened and the commuter boat started its service. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Youths and Children's Festival of Loyalty Closes
body: The 23rd National Youths and Children's Festival of Loyalty came to a close. The festival, opened on February 9, had been staged in the period from the Day of the Shining Star, the birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il, to the Day of the Sun, the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, divided into political, art, sports and economic sections. During the festival, its participants had such events as a question-and-answer study contest, a motivation contest and an oratory contest for deeply grasping the greatness and revolutionary exploits of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il and more thoroughly arming themselves with the revolutionary idea of our Party. They contributed to invigorating all the people across the country in the struggle to implement the decisions made at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee, through intensive motivation campaigns, diverse art and sports activities and brisk socialist emulation movement and do-good-thing movement. At the festival, Pyongyang City took the first place in total standings, South Hamgyong Province the second and Nampho City and South Hwanghae Province the third. Its closing ceremony took place at the Hamhung Grand Theatre on April 19. Mun Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League, made a closing address. He said that the festival served as an opportunity of demonstrating the faith and will of all the youths and children in the country to fully display their wisdom and courage in the all-people march for ushering in an era of the overall development of Korean-style socialism under the leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Centenarian Receives Birthday Spread in DPRK
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un sent a birthday spread to Yang Thae Hui living in Neighborhood Unit No. 6, Poson-dong, Kaesong City on her 100th birthday. Yang, born into a poor family, had to undergo sorrow as a stateless nation before the liberation of the country, being subject to all sorts of humiliation and insult. She could lead a happy and worthwhile life after President Kim Il Sung liberated the country. Out of her mind to repay the favors by the Party and the socialist system, she dedicated herself to the country's textile industrial sector. Even after being a pensioner, she has voluntarily done good things helpful to the country's economy. Rodong Sinmun

title: People Will Always Convey Benevolence of Motherly Party
body: Songhwa Street in Pyongyang built up as a street of socialist civilization in the era of the Workers’ Party of Korea is throbbing with strong emotion of the people. Every place is full of deep gratitude and delight of those who moved into the new houses. The new dwellers have different jobs and careers. However, our Party intends to take care of all of them and provide them with every civilization with all love and affection. Our Party believes in the people as in Heaven! It seems that the love of the motherly Party for people getting greater day after day is reflected in the magnificent apartments. The blessed dwellers will sing songs of gratitude for the motherly Party and in praise of the benevolent socialist system forever. Rodong Sinmun

title: Gifts to Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un from Chinese and Russian Figures
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received gifts from personages of China and Russia on the occasion of the Day of the Sun, the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. The gifts were conveyed to the DPRK ambassadors to those countries on April 11 and 14. The personages include Hu Deping, managing director of a Chinese biodiversity protection and green development foundation, Xiao Fei, assistant to the managing director of the Annoroad Gene Science and Technology Co., Ltd. and Roman Vasilievich Alekseyev, director for commerce of a Russian communication Co., Ltd. Rodong Sinmun

title: Luxurious Street under Socialism in Era of Workers’ Party Overflowing with People’s Joy
body: Labor innovators, persons of merit, scientists, educators and writers and their families in Pyongyang have moved into new dwelling houses in Kyongru-dong since April 14. Officials of the Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea and officials from the Party and power organs in the capital city and builders warmly congratulated the working people who move to the luxury residential district provided for the patriots who devoted themselves to prosperity of the country under the warm love of the Party Central Committee. Cheerful dancing was unfolded in several places of Kyongru-dong and happy laughter ceaselessly burst out of each house. Ri Myong Sun, a weaver of the Kim Jong Suk Pyongyang Textile Mill, who moved into Block No. 13-2 of Kyongru-dong, told that this dreamy reality of which a weaver would be owner of luxury house, is indeed, a socialist legend that could be born only in bosom of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un cultivating the grand flower garden of people-first principle. Work-team head Kim Thae Bong of the Pyongyang Thermal Power Station, driver of merit Ho Myong Gum of the Ryonmot Trolleybus Station and other labor innovators and persons of merit who moved into Kyongru-dong expressed their burning determination to dedicate all their sweats of creation and efforts to prosperity of our great country true to the intention of the respected General Secretary. Kyongru-dong, luxurious street under socialism, built on the bank of Pothong River will shine as a fairyland picturing the noble outlook on people of our Party, which put forward the promotion of people’s well-being as the supreme principle of its activities and brings a new world of civilization and prosperity where the people become its master, and tomorrow of our style socialism full of hope. Rodong Sinmun

title: Tree Saplings Produced in Scientific and Technical Way
body: Officials and employees at the Onchon County Forest Management Station strive to produce tree saplings on a scientific and technological basis. The officials have laid a nice sci-tech dissemination center and let the employees acquire useful knowledge of tree sapling production. The incessant study has improved the employees’ level of technology and skills. They also direct efforts to introducing advanced methods of tree sapling production. The employees do every piece of work in a responsible manner, bearing in mind that to grow tree saplings is the first process of afforestation and the success in forest restoration is decided by the production of tree saplings in tree nurseries. Rodong Sinmun

title: Sun of the Nation, Peerless Hero
body: By Bringing About World-startling Chollima Era The Chollima Statue in Pyongyang, the capital of the revolution, serves as a monument and a symbol of Korea demonstrating the heroic spirit displayed by the Korean people in the Chollima era under the wise leadership of President Kim Il Sung. The President decided to overcome difficulties and ordeals by believing in the people and mobilizing their strength in the difficult postwar period. He visited the then Kangson Steel Plant in December Juche 45 (1956) and inspired its workers to bring about a great revolutionary upsurge, saying that it would be good for the country if it had 10 000 tons of rolled steel in addition. The flames of self-reliance kindled by him marked the beginning of the Chollima Movement. All the people rushed ahead under the slogan "Let us advance at the speed of Chollima!" and eye-opening successes were made in different parts of the country. The first “Chollima” tractor was manufactured by our own efforts in more than 30 days and the first “Sungni-58” automobile came to Pyongyang amid the blessings of all our people. Then, our people manufactured the electric locomotive “Pulgungi” No. 1, bulldozer, large-size water pump, excavator, 8-m Turning Lathes, and a 3000-ton Press. Under the slogan “One for all and all for one!” the collectivist trait of helping and leading each other prevailed throughout the country and the spirit of Chollima Korea was fully demonstrated in sports, literature and art and other fields. Indeed, the birth of the world-startling heroic era, the Chollima era, on this land was a brilliant fruition of the unique ideas, theories, policies and outstanding and tested leadership of President Kim Il Sung who roused the working masses to socialist construction regarding them as the most powerful beings. (To be continued) Rodong Sinmun

title: President Kim Il Sung's Birth Anniversary Celebrated in Japan
body: A national meeting for the study of the Juche idea was held in Tokyo on April 9 to celebrate the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Present there were Kenichi Ogami, secretary general of the International Institute of the Juche Idea (IIJI), Takao Kamakura, director of the IIJI and adviser to the Japanese National Liaison Council of Societies for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, members of Juche idea study organizations across Japan, personages of Japan-DPRK friendship organizations and officials of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) and Korean University. Speeches were made at the meeting. Kunio Miyakawa, co-representative of the Japanese Gunma Liaison Council for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, and Fumihiro Himori, chairman of the Japan Committee for Supporting the Independent and Peaceful Reunification of Korea, called for consolidating the solidarity with the Korean people for peace in Asia and Japan after reviewing the present international situation. Pak Ku Ho, first vice-chairman and director of the Organizational Department of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, referred to President Kim Il Sung's exploits for national liberation and the victory in the Fatherland Liberation War and his noble virtues and personality and great loving care for Koreans in Japan. He stressed that the revolutionary cause of Juche, pioneered by President Kim Il Sung and vigorously advanced by Chairman Kim Jong Il, is winning victory after victory under the guidance of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. At the meeting, congratulatory messages from the Korean Association of Social Scientists and others were introduced to be followed by lectures. Adopted there was a letter to Kim Jong Un. Keizo Sumiya, chairman of the Japanese Fukushima Liaison Council for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, declared the meeting closed, calling for striving to realize independence of Japanese society by deepening the study of the Juche idea. An art performance was given on the same day. Rodong Sinmun

title: Enlarged Plenary Meeting of Cabinet
body: An enlarged plenary meeting of the DPRK Cabinet was held through video-conferencing on April 20. Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, guided the meeting. Attending the meeting were vice-premiers Pak Jong Gun and Jon Hyon Chol and other members of the Cabinet. Present as observers were officials of institutions directly under the Cabinet and ministries, chairpersons of the provincial, city and county people's committees and officials of agricultural guidance organs and major industrial establishments. The meeting reviewed the fulfillment of the national economic plan for the first quarter of the year in thoroughly implementing the decisions of the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee and discussed measures for carrying out the national economic plan for the first half of the year. Pak Jong Gun, vice-premier of the Cabinet and chairman of the State Planning Commission, made a report. He said that every sector and unit of the national economy have directed efforts to thoroughly carrying out the national economic plan with firm viewpoint on it and thus made successes in fulfilling the plan, relying on the might of talents and by dint of science and technology. Analyzing and reviewing with facts the shortcomings and deviations revealed by some units in fulfilling their plans for the first quarter of the year, he called for further intensifying the struggle against the misdeeds including formalism and self-protection in implementing the economic policy. He also called for thoroughly ensuring the fulfillment of the plan for the second quarter of the year by meticulously conducting economic operation and command to promote and amplify the achievements and experiences gained in the course of the campaign in the first quarter of the year and positively searching and mobilizing potentials for development. Speeches were made there. Referring in detail to the experiences and lessons drawn from the work in the first quarter of the year, speakers expressed their determinations to fulfill their responsibility and duty in the struggle for glorifying this year as a year of great revolutionary auspicious events to be recorded in the history of the country and a year of fresh victory dynamically advancing towards the overall development of our own style of socialism. The meeting referred to the issue of effectively pushing ahead with adjustment and reinforcement as planned and paying primary efforts to the development of science and technology, the issue of making ministries, national institutions, provincial, city and county people's committees and agricultural guidance organs mobilize all forces and means for farming including rice-transplanting and weeding and took relevant measures. Rodong Sinmun

title: Members of Lao Embassy Visit Mangyongdae
body: Members of the Lao embassy here visited Mangyongdae on April 19 to mark the 30th anniversary of President Kim Il Sung's and Chairman Kim Jong Il's meeting with Kaysone Phomvihane, former chairman of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party and president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic, on a visit to the DPRK. At the old home of President Kim Il Sung at Mangyongdae, they looked around the historic mementoes preserved with much care, being briefed on his glorious revolutionary history and the patriotic life of his family members. They had a picture taken before the old home before touring the revolutionary sites on Mangyong Hill. Sisavath Khamsaly, Lao ambassador to the DPRK, made an entry in the visitor's book that it is their honor to visit the birthplace of President Kim Il Sung. On April 20, members of the Lao embassy visited DPRK-Laos Friendship Chongryu Junior Middle School in Taedonggang District. They appreciated an art performance given by schoolchildren after going round several classrooms. They donated sports apparatuses to the school. Rodong Sinmun

title: Round-table Talk with Members of Lao Embassy Held
body: There took place a round-table talk with members of the Lao embassy here at the Taedonggang Diplomatic Club on April 20 to mark the 30th anniversary of President Kim Il Sung's and Chairman Kim Jong Il's meeting with Kaysone Phomvihane, former chairman of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party and president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic, on his visit to the DPRK. Present at the talk were Han Su Chol, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, official concerned, Sisavath Khamsaly, Lao ambassador to the DPRK, and members of his embassy. Speeches were made there. Han Su Chol said that the historic meeting between the preceding leaders of the two countries served as a signal opportunity of propelling the new development of the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation. He stressed the Korean people are convinced that the Lao party and people will certainly attain the targets set forth at the 11th Party Congress, overcoming all sorts of challenges and difficulties. He expressed the steadfast will of our Party and people to invariably strengthen and develop the friendly and cooperative relations based on comradely obligation between the two parties and peoples of the two countries as required by the new era. Ambassador Sisavath Khamsaly stressed that the long-standing relations of friendship and cooperation provided by President Kaysone Phomvihane and President Kim Il Sung would steadily grow stronger under the deep care of the top leaders of the two countries. He said that the Lao people are rejoiced over the great achievements made by the Korean people in the struggle to implement the decisions of the 8th Party Congress. Saying that Laos fully supports the DPRK's policies and the Korean people's struggle for peace, independence and development, the ambassador sincerely wished the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un good health. Rodong Sinmun

title: President Kim Il Sung Praised by Personage of Int'l Body
body: Guy Dupre, secretary general of the International Liaison Committee for Reunification and Peace in Korea and honorary chairman of the France-Korea Friendship Association, made public an article under the title of "President Kim Il Sung and Era of Independence" to mark the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung.
