Today the DPRK is vigorously advancing the socialist cause pioneered by the President despite the complicated international situation, Guy Dupre noted in the article, and went on: The President ushered in the era of independence by founding the Juche idea. This was an event of significance in human history that showed the road of freedom, liberation and independent development for the peoples suffering from the imperialists' domination and subordination. The Juche idea regards independence as the life of each country and nation. This great idea ushered in a new era of history when the popular masses emerged as the master of their destiny. On the basis of the Juche idea, President Kim Il Sung gave perfect answers to all the issues arising in the national liberation struggle and set an example of it. He defeated the two formidable U.S. and Japanese imperialists in one generation to defend freedom and the independence of the country and built a socialist society centered on the popular masses on the land of Korea. He clarified the idea on making the whole world independent and wisely led the struggle for its realization. The slogan "People of the World Advocating Independence, Unite!" set forth by the President served as an inspiring banner of ushering in a period of upsurge in the cause of anti-imperialist independence in the latter half of the 20th century. Kim Il Sung is always alive along with the era of independence. Rodong Sinmun

title: Seminar on Juche Idea Held in Nepal
body: A national seminar on the Juche idea was held in Nepal on April 10 to mark the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung and the 40th publication anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's work "On the Juche Idea". At the seminar, the secretary general of the Nepal Institute for the Juche Studies, who is a university professor, explained about the origin of the Juche idea and its essence and vitality. And then read out were a congratulatory message to the seminar from the Korean Association of Social Scientists and congratulations from the International Institute of the Juche Idea and the Asian Regional Institute of the Juche Idea. Speeches were made there. The chairman of the Nepal Women's Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea, who is member of the House of Representatives of Nepal, noted that during his visit to the DPRK he had been attracted by the profound truth of the Juche idea and deeply impressed by the reality of the DPRK undergoing a drastic change. The chairwoman of the All-Nepal Women's Association who is member of the House of Representatives of Nepal said that the immortal Juche idea still guides the Korean revolution to victory without losing its vitality although many years have passed since its foundation by President Kim Il Sung. The chairman of the Nepal Institute for the Juche Studies said that the Korean people boundlessly revere President Kim Il Sung, Leader Kim Jong Il and His Excellency Kim Jong Un who founded the Juche idea, the guiding idea in the era of independence, and have built and glorified a country where people are masters. A congratulatory message to the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un was adopted at the seminar. Meanwhile, a seminar on Kim Jong Il's work "On the Juche Idea" took place in Denmark on the occasion of the 40th anniversary of its publication. Rodong Sinmun

title: Symposium in Forestry Field Held
body: The Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea sponsored a national symposium in the field of forestry through video-conferencing on April 19 and 20. The symposium was aimed mainly to share and transfer achievements and experience made in putting on a scientific basis the work for planting trees for all seasons and to find out a rational solution to this work. Attending it were officials, scientists, technicians and three-revolution team members at scores of units, including forestry management stations in Hyongjesan District of Pyongyang City, Phyongsong and Kaechon cities of South Phyongan Province and Hochon and Yonggwang counties of South Hamgyong Province, the Academy of Forest Science, Wonsan University of Agriculture, Kanggye University of Agriculture and Forestry and Hyesan University of Agriculture and Forestry. About 40 valuable papers, completed in the course of conducting brisk scientific research work, were presented and good experiences introduced at the symposium. Exchanged there were opinions on the sci-tech problems arising in planting trees all the year round irrespective of seasonal conditions and raising the survival rate. Then speeches were made. Screened during the symposium was a video clip introducing the sci-tech data on tree planting. Rodong Sinmun

title: Precious Guideline for Leading Officials of Revolution
body: Become Masters Well Versed in Party’s Policies In March Juche 110(2021), the First Short Course for Chief Secretaries of City and County Party Committees was held for the first time in the history of our Party. It engraved on minds of our officials what kind of ideological consciousness they should have and how they should work in order to fulfill their mission and duty as leading officials of the revolution. At the short course the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un said as follows: The chief secretaries of the city and county Party committees should become masters well versed in the Party’s policies by making strenuous and purposeful efforts to have a knowledge of the idea and line of the Party, and make the whole process of organizing and reviewing the work the educational one of implanting the Party’s policies in the mind of officials as their faith. Become masters well versed in the Party’s policies! His teaching was a precious guideline that delineated the important personality and qualification which our officials must possess. Steady Learning Is Required One day in August, Juche 103(2014), the respected General Secretary visited a breeding station. Looking round many places of the breeding station he said that stockbreeding must be done in a scientific way for its development. That day he was particularly pleased by an official of the breeding station. The official had a knowledge of the state of introducing advanced technology to the station as good as the professional researchers. He praised the official for his logical explanation. After hearing that the official learnt a lot from the researchers of the Bioengineering Branch of the State Academy of Sciences, he emphasized that officials must learn steadily in order to fulfill their revolutionary tasks assigned by the Party. The official made up his mind to prepare himself as a competent one well versed in science and technology true to the noble intention of the respected General Secretary. Rodong Sinmun

title: Young People Volunteer for Posts in Difficult Fields
body: More than 2 670 young people across the country have volunteered to work at the posts in difficult and arduous fields since the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee. Young people in Pyongyang volunteered to work at labor-consuming sectors like coal mines and farms. Those in Sinuiju City, Tongrim and Pakchon Counties and other parts of North Phyongan Province volunteered for farms and major units in the province like Sinam Co-op Farm in Ryongchon County, Sokha Co-op Farm in Sinuiju City, the Kujang Area Coal-mining Complex and Rakwon General Machine Enterprise. In South Phyonan Province, youngsters in Anju City and Sukchon County volunteered to farms and those in Phyongsong, Sunchon, Kaechon and Tokchon Cities decided to work at the livestock farming base in the Sepho area and coal mines. Youths in North and South Hamgyong and Kangwon Provinces also joined the volunteers from other parts of the country. Suit is followed by officials of the youth league and university and high school graduates. Recently over 200 graduates of senior middle schools in North Hamgyong Province volunteered to work at the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex, co-op farms and coal mines. These laudable deeds are a manifestation of their noble view of life and future of regarding it as youthful honor and pride to devote themselves to the Party and revolution with firm confidence in socialism and immovable will. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Reply Message to Syrian President
body: Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), sent a reply message to Bashar Al-Assad, president of the Syrian Arab Republic, on April 20. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, in the message, expressed deep thanks to the Syrian president for sending warm greetings on the occasion of the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung always living in the hearts of the people of the DPRK and other progressive people in the world. The message expressed conviction that the ties of friendship, solidarity and cooperation between the peoples of the two countries would be further strengthened on the road of struggle for anti-imperialist independence and justice. Rodong Sinmun

title: Foreign Personages Pay Congratulatory Visits to DPRK Missions
body: Personages of various circles in different countries paid congratulatory visits to the DPRK missions in their countries on the occasion of the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung from April 5 to 15. They laid floral baskets and bouquets at the portraits of smiling President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and the art pieces depicting them standing together and made bows. Among those personages from parliaments, political parties, organizations and institutions were the princess of the Kingdom of Cambodia, the vice-chairman of the FUNCINPEC Party of Cambodia, the editor-in-chief of the organ of the People's Party of Cambodia, the managing director of a Chinese biodiversity protection and green development foundation, the chairman of the Dongfangyi Tuozhan Association of China, the assistant to the managing director of the Annoroad Gene Science and Technology Co., Ltd. of China, the deputy leader of the Democratic Party of Thailand, the chairman of the Thailand-DPRK Friendship Parliamentary Group, representatives of the Thailand-DPRK Friendship Association, the organization for the study of the Juche idea of Thailand, Thai Loxpac Co. Ltd. and Thammasat University of Thailand, the chairman of the Kuwait-DPRK Friendship Association, the editor-in-chief of Election Times in Pakistan, the vice general secretary for international affairs of the Islamic Coalition Party of Iran, members of the executive council of the Iranian Workers' House, the international secretary of the Central Committee of the South African Communist Party, the general secretary of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Cooperation of Equatorial Guinea and the second deputy general secretary of the Democratic Party of Equatorial Guinea. They also included the vice-chairman of the Committee for External Affairs of the C.C., Lao People's Revolutionary Party, the vice-chairman of the C.C., National Construction Front of Laos, the vice-president of the C.C., Lao Federation of Trade Unions, the vice-president of the Lao Veterans Federation, the director of the Lao People's Revolutionary Youth Union, the former president of the Khmer Democratic Party of Cambodia, the general secretary of the Communist Party of Switzerland, the general secretary of the Swiss Communist Youth, the chairman of the Socialist Workers’ Party of Egypt and the chairman of the Arab Information Center in China. Meanwhile, floral baskets were sent to the DPRK missions from the Committee for External Affairs of the C.C., Lao People's Revolutionary Party, the Central Committee of the National Construction Front of Laos, the Central Committee of the Lao Federation of Trade Unions, the Lao Veterans Federation, the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Youth Union, the Central Committee of the Lao Women's Union, the China Association for International Friendly Contact, the Beijing International Cultural Development Center for China-DPRK Friendship, the chairperson of the Sino-DPRK Stamp Society and others. Rodong Sinmun

title: 32nd April Spring Friendship Art Festival Closes
body: The 32nd April Spring Friendship Art Festival has closed. It was held in a special way of showing videos of performances given by art troupes and artistes of foreign countries that were sent through international communication channels. It was attended by more than 60 famous art troupes and artistes from some 30 countries. The artistes of the Chinese Dongfang music group, the Academy Ensemble of the National Guard of the Russian Federation and the Song and Dance Ensemble of the Mongolian Army passionately sang the immortal revolutionary hymns of the DPRK "Song of General Kim Il Sung", "Song of General Kim Jong Il" and "Ode to General Kim Jong Un". Vietnamese and Russian artistes sang such songs as "Cantata to Marshal Kim Il Sung" and "Ardent Desire" to highly praise the peerlessly great men for making distinguished contributions to developing the friendly relations among countries through their energetic external activities. The world-famous Chelyabinsk State Ural Dance Group of Russia, the Austrian Janoska instrumental ensemble composed of international concours winners who are family members, and a Singaporean popular singer reflected their friendship with the Korean people in dance "Floral Basket of Friendship", piano quartet "selection of famous songs" and male solo "Arirang" respectively. A Cuban soloist and a Russian guitarist deeply impressed the audience with a Korean song "We Long for You" and foreign songs. The State Academy Beryozka Dancing Troupe of Russia Named after N.S. Nadezhdina vividly depicted the Russian people's patriotism, optimistic life and the beauty of Russia's nature through dances "White Birch" and "Cabmen". The grand acrobatic drama "Railway Hero" and other physical acrobatics given by Chinese, Russian and Mongolian acrobats greatly excited the audience. The mixed chorus and dance "Let's Sing and Dance" and the male solo "Country Is Marshal" performed by an art troupe of Koreans in Japan represented the unshakable faith of the officials of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan and other compatriots in Japan to follow the road of patriotism only. The dance "Jaenggang dance", jangsaenap solo "Hot Wind" and a female folksong solo performed by an art troupe of Koreans in China revved up the festive mood. The successful festival marking the Day of the Sun, the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung, encouraged the Korean people and helped deepen the friendly feelings among foreign artistes. The Festival Organizing Committee decided to post the appraisal results on the website "Korean Art" and other websites. Rodong Sinmun

title: Birth Anniversary of President Kim Il Sung Marked Abroad
body: There took place meetings in Cuba, Laos, Myanmar, India, Pakistan, Romania, Britain, Slovakia, Kyrgyzstan and Guinea to mark the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Present at the meetings were personages of political and social circles and masses in relevant countries. Speeches were made there. The president of the Cuban Institute of Friendship with the Peoples and the first vice-chairman of the Cuban Committee for Supporting Korea's Reunification said that the friendly relations between Cuba and the DPRK were provided by the preceding leaders of the two countries in the joint struggle for independence against imperialism and for socialism. The vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the National Construction Front of Laos noted that the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation provided by President Kaysone Phomvihane, the respected leader of the Lao people, and President Kim Il Sung, the great leader of the Korean people, are developing on good terms under the deep care of the leaders of the two countries. The deputy director-general of the European Society for the Study of the Juche Idea and the chairman of the British Association for the Study of Songun Policy said that the Juche idea founded by Kim Il Sung is a valuable mental asset enabling the Korean people to dynamically accelerate socialist construction by dint of self-reliance before explaining its vitality in connection with the reality of the DPRK. At celebration meetings in India, a congratulatory message to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un was adopted and a statement issued in praise of Kim Il Sung's brilliant revolutionary career and support of the Korean people's cause of justice. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Greetings to Cuban President
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), sent a congratulatory message to Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez, first secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba and president of the Republic of Cuba, on April 20. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un in the message offered sincere comradely greetings and warm congratulations to the first secretary on his birthday. Expressing pleasure over the fact that the Communist Party of Cuba has firmly defended the gains of socialism and waged a bold struggle for implementing the decisions of its 8th Congress, while smashing the heinous anti-Cuba moves of the hostile forces by firmly rallying all the Cuban people under the energetic leadership of the first secretary, the message extended full support and solidarity to it. The message noted that it is the unshakable will of the WPK and the people of the DPRK to further develop the friendly and cooperative relations between the two parties and the two peoples, firmly forged in the struggle for accomplishing the cause of anti-imperialist independence and the cause of socialism, true to the spirit of the agreement made at the summit in Pyongyang in November 2018. Heartily wishing the first secretary bigger success in his responsible and noble work of leading the party, state and people, the message sincerely hoped that he and all his family members would enjoy good health and happiness. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Floral Basket from Lao Ambassador
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a floral basket from Lao Ambassador to the DPRK Sisavath Khamsaly on the occasion of the 90th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army. The floral basket was conveyed to an official concerned on April 21. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Floral Basket to President of Cuba
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), sent a floral basket to Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez, first secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba and president of the Republic of Cuba, on his birthday. The congratulatory floral basket bearing the august name of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un was courteously conveyed by the DPRK ambassador to Cuba to an official of the Cuban Foreign Ministry on April 20. Written on the ribbons decorating the basket were the letters reading "Warm birthday wishes to Comrade Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez, first secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba and president of the Republic of Cuba". Rodong Sinmun

title: Sun of the Nation, Peerless Hero
body: Sun of Mankind Who Illuminated Whole World The world’s progressive people still remember the undying feats performed by President Kim Il Sung for the development of the cause of global independence. The President who had already mapped out a lofty aim of destroying all imperialism and building communism throughout the world from the beginning when he had embarked on the road of revolution set forth the idea and theory of making the whole world independent, thus clearly illuminating the way to build a new independent world under the idea of independence, peace and friendship. Meanwhile he led the cause of global independence and the cause of anti-imperialist independence to the only road of victory through his energetic external activities. He passionately supported and encouraged the progressive countries and people and assisted them materially and mentally and resolutely smashed the imperialists’ and the dominationists’ manoeuvres of domination and subordination and aggression and intervention. He met in person over 70,000 foreign figures of all strata from 130-odd different countries including heads of governments and political parties and gave them precious teachings until the last moments of his life. He also visited many foreign countries through over 520,000 kilometer-long journey in total. A large number of foreign countries, international organizations and bodies highly praised the President as the most prominent leader unparalleled in the world and the great sun and awarded him their highest orders, medals and honorary titles with rare and precious gifts representing their endless admiration. Indeed Kim Il Sung is the great pioneer and outstanding leader of the cause of global independence and the sun of mankind recognized by the world. (To be continued.) Rodong Sinmun

title: Ideological and Mental Strength, Ever-victorious Weapon of Juche Korea
body: Nothing is more powerful than the ideological and mental strength of masses. The people with immense ideological and mental strength have neither difficulty insurmountable nor fortress unconquerable. The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un sent an important letter to those who attended the first workshop of officials in the information field of the Workers’ Party of Korea. In the letter, he instructed that they should regard the ideological and mental strength of the popular masses as the foremost weapon as ever and stir it up in every way for carrying out such important tasks which would never be easy to fulfill owing to manifold barriers to our advance. The course of our revolution proves the historical truth that there is nothing impossible to do and great successes can be achieved even in the severest adversity and conditions when the fighting spirit of all the people is uplifted. The ideological and mental strength of popular masses is the most powerful weapon of our revolution. One day the respected General Secretary stressed that the mental strength of masses creates miracles and the main key to opening up a new heyday of building a powerful socialist country is to inspire the masses’ enthusiasm. Even an egg, when charged with ideology, can break a rock and even a rifle, when charged with ideology, can be more powerful than any modern armed equipment. It is the cherished opinion of the respected General Secretary who attaches importance to the ideological and mental strength of masses. Remarkable development and changes made in a new century of Juche under the leadership of the respected General Secretary are the great victory achieved by giving full play to the mental strength of masses. We will always win the victory with an indomitable spirit of hard work, keeping in our minds the eternal truth that ideology decides everything and there is nothing to do when the people are motivated ideologically. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Floral Basket from Vietnamese Ambassador
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a floral basket from Le Ba Vinh, Vietnamese ambassador to the DPRK, on the occasion of the 90th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army. The floral basket was conveyed to an official concerned on April 22. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Congratulatory Messages and Letters from Overseas Compatriots
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received congratulatory messages and letters from Koreans in China and Russia on the occasion of the Day of the Sun, the birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. They included the Association of Korean Nationals in Dandong City of China, the honorary chairman of the Association of Korean Enterprisers in Beijing, the chief of Dandong Branch of the Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation, the chairman of the United Confederation of Koreans in Russia, the chairman of the Association of Koreans in the Far Eastern Region and Siberia of Russia, the secretary general of the United Confederation of Koreans in Russia and the family of DPRK Hero An Tong Su. The messages and letters wished Kim Jong Un good health, praying for the eternal life of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. Rodong Sinmun

title: Kindling Flame of Campaign to implement Behests of Leaders
body: Starting Point of All Thinking and Practice One day in October Juche 104(2015), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited the Pyongyang Catfish Farm which was rebuilt into a model and standard one in fish farming sector of the country. Looking round the newly-built room for education in the revolutionary history and room dedicated to the history of the farm, he recollected with deep emotion the course of development of the farm which was built on the initiative of Chairman Kim Jong Il and taken under the tender care of his leadership. Noting that the Farm was one to which the Chairman had paid deep attention, he earnestly said that he felt a painful stab at his heart when recalling the Chairman who had worked heart and soul for the improvement of the people’s living standard until the last moments of his life. And then he said that all the officials and employees of the farm should strive to normalize the production on a high level, thinking of the Chairman who had devoted all his life to the people. That day he stressed that they should wage a struggle with the extraordinary readiness to implement the behest of the Chairman without fail and a sense of responsibility ahead of considering possibility, while cherishing deep in their hearts that the tasks assigned by the Chairman are immutable truth and guarantee of all victory. His meaningful word was earnest one that made our officials keenly feel again how they approach the behests of great leaders and implement them. Why He Was Pleased One April day in Juche 105(2016), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited the newly-built Mindulle Notebook Factory. Halting in his stride to the sci-tech learning space after looking round different places of the factory, he said that he was filled with emotion recalling the efforts of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il for the factory and could not repress his tears of joy to realize the desires of the great leaders. At the sample display room of the factory, he warmly said that the President and the Chairman in their lifetime had given their whole mind to provide our children and pupils with quality notebooks and if they knew these facts, perhaps they would have been so pleased, adding that one of their instructions was implemented as a notebook factory was built on a modern basis. After recollecting the President and the Chairman who had been always anxious about the problem of notebooks for our children, the respected General Secretary affirmed that to solve the problem of notebook was one of the biggest successes made in the struggle for implementing the behests of the great leaders. Indeed, the respected General Secretary was concerned for supplying our children with more quality notebooks to realize the behests of great leaders without fail, true to their noble outlook on posterity. To implement the behests of great leaders is just starting point of our all thinking and practice. Rodong Sinmun

title: Sun of the Nation, Peerless Hero
body: Sun Will Shine Forever There were a lot of great and famed persons in human history, but no one found an eternal brilliant commander and legendary hero like President Kim Il Sung who turned the country, once eclipsed in the world map, into the birthplace of Juche Idea and powerful socialist country in his lifetime and shined it brilliantly in the world. The President was the matchless great man who illuminated the way ahead of humankind with ray of Juche and the great father who unfolded a grand flower garden of love for the people with his ardent enthusiasm and affection and looked after all the people with infinite attraction. World people have highly praised him "Eternal Sun of Juche", calling the 20th century "Kim Il Sung’s Century". Considering the requirement of the times and history and desire of the people, Chairman Kim Jong Il made sure that April 15, the birthday of the President, was instituted as the Day of the Sun and the Juche era with 1912 as the first year when the President was born, and let the history of sun flow constantly on this land. Thanks to the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un who is identical with the President and the Chairman in idea, leadership and personality, the lineage of the revolutionary cause of Juche pioneered by the President is being inherited invariably and the President’s desire and plan come to reality on this land. Indeed, the President will always live in the hearts of not only our people but also progressives with prosperity of Kim Il Sung’s Korea and Kim Il Sung’s nation shining as the powerful socialist country of Juche and powerful independent country blessed with the illustrious leaders generation after generation. Rodong Sinmun

title: More Trees Bearing Revolutionary Slogans Discovered
body: The first generation of the Korean revolution wrote words on the surface of barked trees not only in the vast Manchurian plain but also in different parts of the country, reflecting their absolute loyalty to President Kim Il Sung, firm faith in victory of the revolution, invincible revolutionary spirit and ardent patriotism. Thousands of trees bearing revolutionary slogans have been discovered so far across the country. Many trees bearing slogans praising President Kim Il Sung, a legendary hero acclaimed by the Korean nation, were found in the area of Mt Paektu. Discovered in the areas of Rangrim, Sinhung and Anju were trees bearing slogans dealing with revolutionary exploits of Kim Il Sung who advanced into the homeland and built up a strong revolutionary base for all-people resistance. Being preserved in Yonsa County are about 150 trees bearing slogans praising the immortal exploits performed by the President who visited the area 7 times in order to marshal a broad spectrum of the popular masses for the nation-wide struggle against the Japanese imperialists. Trees bearing slogans, discovered in different parts of Pyongyang City, including Mangyongdae and the Oun Revolutionary Site, represent the then public mindset that the destiny of the countrymen could be saved only by the President. Upon receiving the news that Chairman Kim Jong Il was born, members of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army with great excitement and joy barked big trees in forests and wrote on their surface such slogans as "O Korea, the Shining Star of Mt Paektu was born on Mt Paektu" to celebrate his birth. There are also slogans that represent the anti-Japanese revolutionary forerunners' spirit of devotedly defending the leader, indomitable revolutionary spirit, optimism and fervent patriotism. Discovered at the Madusan Revolutionary Battle Site were trees bearing slogans that serve as treasure of the Korean revolution that cannot be bartered for anything. Slogans "Keep the revolutionary faith to the death" and "Fight death-defyingly for our country and nation" serve as an eternal textbook of revolution instilling into the people the truth that one can carry on the revolution to the end and will have nothing to be ashamed of before the nation only when one firmly preserves one's revolutionary faith. Other slogans explain the President's original revolutionary idea, fighting programme and line on national liberation. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Symposium Held in DPRK
body: A national symposium to mark the 90th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army (KPRA) was held at the People's Palace of Culture here on Friday. Present there were Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), and Party and administrative officials, officials of the working people's organizations and information workers in charge of theory from armed forces organs, the fields of science, education, literature and arts, media and preservation of revolutionary relics and party cadres training institutions in Pyongyang. Presented to the symposium were papers explaining in depth the immortal feats of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un who built the Juche-oriented revolutionary armed forces and opened their brilliant heyday by O Il Jong and Ju Chang Il, department directors of the Central Committee of the WPK, Pak Yong Il, and Pak Yong Il, general officer of the Korean People's Army. The speakers praised the President as the peerlessly great man who made clear the philosophical principle that the victory of the revolutionary cause and the sovereignty, independence and prosperity of the country and nation are guaranteed by the arms of revolution and pioneered the brilliant history of building the Juche-oriented revolutionary armed forces for the first time in the national history spanning over 5 000 years. They stressed that the DPRK's revolutionary armed forces displayed its might as the heroic revolutionary ones and invincible powerful army which defeated the two imperialisms under the outstanding and seasoned leadership of the President and the glorious history of building the Juche-oriented revolutionary armed forces has been adorned with the traditions of victory. They proved that Chairman Kim Jong Il is the peerlessly illustrious commander who developed the People's Army into the one of the leader and invincible revolutionary army without an equal in other parts of the world and projected it as the pillar and main force of the revolution. They explained that the revolutionary armed forces have been in their great heyday of development, unprecedented in history, over the past decade, thanks to the outstanding military wisdom and commanding art and energetic guidance of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. They called upon all officials, party members, working people and servicepersons to faithfully uphold the leadership of Kim Jong Un and achieve a great victory in attaining the new strategic goals set by the Party. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Art Exhibition Opens
body: A national art exhibition was opened in celebration of the 90th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army (KPRA). In the centre of the exhibition hall is an art work depicting President Kim Il Sung declaring the birth of the KPRA. On display at the hall are art pieces showing the immortal exploits of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il who founded the Juche-type revolutionary armed forces and provided a powerful military guarantee for the eternal prosperity of the country and the nation with their outstanding ideas and leadership. And there are art pieces showing the development of the DPRK's armed forces, which have demonstrated the might as a matchless army possessed of the most powerful strength under the guidance of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un who adds glory to the army building exploits of the President and the Chairman. Also displayed are art pieces vividly depicting the heroic struggle of the anti-Japanese revolutionary fighters, who sacrificed their lives to safeguard the headquarters of the revolution in the snowstorm of Mt Paektu, and the Fatherland Liberation War veterans, who created a history of great victory of the country. Its opening ceremony took place at the Korean Art Gallery on Friday. Sung Jong Gyu, minister of Culture, made an opening address. He expressed the conviction that the exhibition will serve as an occasion for injecting unbounded confidence and vigor to the ranks of general onward march for implementing the decisions of the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee, closely rallied as one in mind around Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Meeting of Agricultural Workers Held
body: Officials and members of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea (UAWK) held an oath-taking meeting in the revolutionary battle site on Kuksa Peak on April 22 to mark the 90th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army. Attending the meeting were Choe Yong, secretary of the Nampho City Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and officials and members of the UAWK in Nampho City. Prior to the meeting, the participants toured the revolutionary battle site on Kuksa Peak. Han Jong Hyok, chairman of the UAWK Central Committee, read out a resolution at the meeting. He said that the founding of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army, the first revolutionary armed forces of Juche type, by President Kim Il Sung on April 25, Juche 21 (1932) was a signal event enabling the Korean people to have their real army for the first time in history and the main force of revolution capable of playing an initiative and core role in the sacred war for national liberation. He called upon the agricultural workers and members of the UAWK to conduct a dynamic socialist emulation for attaining the goal of grain production set by the Party, bearing in mind the heavy responsibility for defending the major thrust of socialist construction to guarantee the existence of the state, bolster national power and improve the people's living standard. He said that the UAWK would fully display its militant might in ushering in a new great era of socialist rural development, holding aloft the slogan "For fresh victory of socialist rural construction!" The resolution stressed that all organizations of the UAWK would faithfully uphold the idea of the Party and vigorously advance in order to add shine to the tradition of loyalty of the anti-Japanese revolutionary forerunners in the ongoing general advance for achieving the prosperity and development of our state and happiness of all generations under the leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. Speeches were made there. Rodong Sinmun

title: Concert Given by Workers and Members of GFTUK
body: Working people and members of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea (GFTUK) gave a concert at the Central Hall of Workers on April 22 to mark the 90th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army. Present there were Pak In Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the GFTUK, Hong Chol Jin, secretary of the Pyongyang City Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, trade union officials and members and workers in Pyongyang. The concert, started with chorus "Long Live Generalissimo Kim Il Sung", reflected the warm reverence for the peerlessly great men who put the dignity and status of the working masses on the highest level. A solemn atmosphere pervaded the venue of the concert along with the female chorus "Song of Anti-Japanese War", an immortal classic, and mixed quintet "Korean People's Revolutionary Army" and other numbers praising the exploits of President Kim Il Sung who embarked on the road of revolution in his early years and founded the first revolutionary armed forces of Juche type and led the hard-fought anti-Japanese war to victory to bring the dawn of national resurrection. Performers lauded the personality and undying feats of Chairman Kim Jong Il, a peerlessly great man, in songs "The General Is the Son of the Guerrillas" and "Our General Is the Best". Female duet "O My Motherland Full of Hope" and other numbers were full of ardent reverence for the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un who put the DPRK's national power and prestige on the highest level. The concert ended with chorus "Let's Support Our Supreme Commander with Arms". Rodong Sinmun

title: Continuous Efforts to Increase Production of Iron and Steel
body: Officials and working people in the metal industry make innovations in iron and steel production, resolved to do their part in the ongoing general onward march. Those at the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex kindle the flame of collective innovation while waging the mass technical innovation drive, mindful that they are in the front line of economic construction. Labor and management of the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex also strive to increase production. They actively devise and introduce technical innovation schemes and rational working methods and push ahead with the construction of the oxygen heat blast furnace. Like this, they continue to put spurs to the campaign to increase production of iron and steel. At the Chollima Steel Complex, endeavors are made to revitalize the current production and conduct maintenance and reinforcement work effectively in order to hit this year’s production target. Those at the Posan Iron Works and Chongjin Steel Plant engage themselves in a bold production drive with a zeal for fulfilling their responsibilities and duties in consolidating the independent steel industry of the country. Cognizant that the key to normalizing production lies in properly managing equipment and technology, they examine the equipment during recesses and repair it in a preventive manner on a planned basis, thereby increasing the operation rate of equipment. Officials and workers of several units like the Musan Mining Complex and Unryul, Jaeryong and Hungsan Mines also brace themselves up with high consciousness that they are defenders of lifeline of the metal industry. Rodong Sinmun

title: Witness of History Conveying Touching Story
body: There is a meaningful Metasequoia glyptostroboides in Kyongru-dong, which was planted and cultivated by President Kim Il Sung at his residence dozens of years ago. The President in his lifetime had spent more days on his field guidance for the people’s happiness than those of resting at his residence. His noble intention and wish of believing in the people as in Heaven are being translated into shining realities by the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un. The tree in Kyongru-dong conveys the President’s sacred lifetime of patriotism and the respected General Secretary’s ardent love and devotion for the people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Springtime Farming Brisk in DPRK's North Hwanghae Province
body: Agricultural workers in North Hwanghae Province of the DPRK are hastening the springtime farming. Officials in the agricultural sector in cities and counties including those of the Provincial Rural Economy Committee have conducted a political work to stir up enthusiasm of the working masses out in the farming campaign, while taking economic and technical measures for thoroughly carrying out the plans according to date and fields. Consequently, all farms in the province finished plowing in dry fields, and now concentrate all their manpower and means to tilling paddy fields. Rodong Sinmun

title: Premier Kim Tok Hun Inspects Several Sectors of National Economy
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and premier of the Cabinet, made a field survey of several sectors of the national economy. Making a round of different production sites of the Taean Heavy Machine Complex, he called upon officials and workers to carry out the task for custom-built equipment by the appointed time without fail, bearing deep in mind again their duty in implementing the decisions made at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Party. He called for increasing the operating rate of equipment, supplying materials in time to carry out the production as scheduled and putting product designs on a scientific basis and ensuring the accuracy of finishing on a high level. At the unloading shop and steel casting shop of the Pukchang Thermal Power Complex, he stressed the necessity to steadily increase the power production by pushing ahead with the work for improving the capacity of unloading and transportation of coal and increasing the generating power on a long-term basis. At the Tokchon Area Coal-Mining Complex, he called for giving priority to prospecting and tunneling to secure more reserve cutting faces and increasing the capacity of coal production through sufficient supply of equipment in cutting faces. At the Mangyongdae Aeguk Aluminum Sash Factory, he called for pushing ahead with the work to mass-produce finishing building materials of various sizes on a long-term basis. The field consultative meetings took measures after discussing the issue of further improving the officials' operation and command, the issue for relevant sectors and units to supply materials and products under contract necessary for custom-built equipment and power production, the issue of scrupulously organizing the production and management as required by the socialist system of responsible business operation and the issue of consistently accelerating the work to realize local production of finishing building materials while regarding it as an important policy-oriented task. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Visits Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), visited the Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery on Mt Taesong on April 25, the 90th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army. Accompanying him were Pak Jong Chon and Ri Pyong Chol, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretaries of the WPK Central Committee, Ri Yong Gil, minister of National Defence of the DPRK, and commanders of the large combined units of the Korean People's Army (KPA). The guard of honor of the KPA lined up at the cemetery. The national anthem of the DPRK was played there. A wreath from the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un was laid before the wreath-laying stand of the cemetery amid the playing of the wreath-laying music. Wreaths in the names of the WPK Central Military Commission and the KPA were placed at the stand. Written on the ribbons of wreaths were letters "The revolutionary martyrs will be immortal". Kim Jong Un, together with the visitors, paid a silent tribute to the anti-Japanese revolutionary martyrs who dedicated their youth and lives to accomplishing the sacred cause of national independence and emancipation of the people. There took place a march-past of the KPA guard of honor. Kim Jong Un looked round the cemetery. Recollecting the achievements and the eternal history of struggle of the anti-Japanese revolutionary forerunners who held President Kim Il Sung in high esteem as the center of unity and leadership in the period of pioneering the Korean revolution and established the revolutionary traditions of Mt Paektu, the eternal treasure of the revolution, by making a long journey of bloody battles, he placed flowers at the busts of Kim Chaek, An Kil, Ryu Kyong Su and Choe Hyon and paid high tribute to the revolutionary martyrs. Saying that the anti-Japanese revolutionary fighters, the first generation of the Korean revolution, accomplished the historic cause of national liberation by overcoming in the do-or-die spirit the worst trials baffling human imagination with the transparent faith that they would certainly win victory thanks to Kim Il Sung, the validity of their cause and the optimism about the future, he stressed that the immortal feats of the anti-Japanese guerrillas, who established the great traditions of the Korean revolution shining along with the history of succession and provided the eternal foundations of our great state, will be conveyed to posterity. He said that the revolutionary traditions of Mt Paektu serve as the firm foundations of our Party and revolution, the noble spirit to be kept by our people and service personnel forever and the most precious treasure that should never be bartered for any valuables, adding that the history of Juche-oriented army building woven with victory and glory clearly proves the inexhaustible power and everlasting viability of the spirit of Mt Paektu. Noting that thanks to the event on April 25 to remain in history forever, the revolutionary armed forces of the DPRK has developed into a world-class powerful army, socialist Korea demonstrated its might and the Korean people led an independent and happy life, he said that the revolution, given continuity by the ideological lineage and faith, will always emerge victorious. The noble souls of the anti-Japanese revolutionary forerunners will be immortal along with the glorious history of our powerful revolutionary army and the prosperous development of our great state, he stressed. Political News Team

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Meets Commanding Officers of KPA Units
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), met and warmly congratulated the commanding officers of units at all levels of the Korean People's Army (KPA) taking part in the celebrations of the 90th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army (KPRA) at the office building of the WPK Central Committee on Monday. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un invited the commanding officers of KPA units at all levels to the celebrations of the meaningful holiday in April and bestowed such profound benevolence to be conveyed generation after generation. The commanding officers were filled with great joy and excitement as they came to enjoy the great honor and happiness to be remembered throughout their lives at the supreme headquarters of revolution, which all the KPA men and officers consider as the most sacred place and defend devotedly, the courtyard of the Party Central Committee which all the people in the country regard as the very protector of their destiny. When Kim Jong Un arrived together with his wife Ri Sol Ju, all the participants broke into stormy cheers of "hurrah!" as a token of their deep reverence for him, the invincible and iron-willed commander representing the mightiness of the Party and the state who is ushering in the heyday of strengthening the national power while demonstrating to the world the dignity and prestige of the country with his faith of Paektu, great courage and outstanding leadership. He congratulated the army commanding officers who are greeting the 90th founding anniversary of the KPRA with the honor and pride of firmly consolidating the strong fortress for defending the revolution and the country with the arms of revolution handed down by the anti-Japanese forerunners. Noting that succession to the revolution doesn't simply mean handing down something from one generation to the next but means inheriting the fighting spirit and the soul immortal with fortitude, he said the revolutionary traditions of Paektu established during the anti-Japanese struggle are the main source of the spiritual strength and combat power of our army. Noting that our army has developed into an invincible army, which is capable of striking fear into any formidable enemy in the world, from two pistols, he stressed that its history is unprecedented in the world army-building history and the revolutionary army reliably carrying forward the great traditions always emerges victorious and remains unchanged in its nature in any storm and stress. Saying that our revolutionary armed forces should become the red arms and red treasured sword of the Party for defending the red flag, the red idea and the red system, he had a meaningful photo taken with his beloved soldiers who play a core role in the struggle for vigorous development of the People's Army. Following the photo session, combatants of an air-borne unit landed on the courtyard of the Party Central Committee, flying the national flag, and the commanding officers had a photo taken against the background of the office building. Amid the overflowing warm feelings of kinship forged between the leader and his soldiers in the struggle for accomplishing the great cause of building a prosperous nation with a strong army, a splendid banquet was given at the garden of the office building in the presence of Kim Jong Un and his wife Ri Sol Ju. Present at the event of honor were Jo Yong Won, Kim Tok Hun, Pak Jong Chon and Ri Pyong Chol, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, and the commanding officers. It was also attended by Ri Yong Gil, Kwon Yong Jin and Rim Kwang Il, senior officials of the armed forces organs, and O Il Jong and Kang Sun Nam, department directors of the Party Central Committee. Pak Jong Chon, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretary of the Party Central Committee, made a speech. Congratulating the participants who came to have the honor of celebrating the historic founding anniversary of the first revolutionary armed forces of the Korean people at the office building of the Party Central Committee, Pak Jong Chon recalled that the 90-year-long history of the Korean revolutionary armed forces, which set out on their struggle in the forests of Mt Paektu and always emerged victorious, has witnessed the shining achievements of the army commanding officers who upheld the guidance of the great commanders on the army with heroic fighting spirit and remarkable feats. He pointed out that the commanding officers of our revolutionary armed forces, including the first commanders and famous veteran commanders of the anti-Japanese guerrilla army, heroic commanding officers in the great anti-U.S. war and those who distinguished themselves in championing and building socialism, were all faithful and brave fighters. It is the law of growth and development unique to the KPA that such passionate revolutionaries and brave warriors trained by the great leaders and commanders have become the backbone and the engine for powerfully accelerating the efforts for turning the revolutionary armed forces into elite ones and defending the cause of the Party in the van, he stressed. He said that the peculiarities of the Korean revolution which are accompanied by constant confrontation with the strong imperialist forces clearly highlight the primary mission of the armed forces of the Republic to support the authority and leadership of the WPK with strong arms. He stressed that when commanding officers, the backbone of the revolutionary army of the Party, remain absolutely loyal to the Party Central Committee and train all officers and men to be the ones strong in ideology and faith, our revolutionary armed forces will come to have invincible power, adding the fundamentals of our revolutionary armed forces, which are strong in idea and win victory on the strength of ideology, can never change although they now have access to nuclear weaponry to contain and annihilate any formidable enemies on the earth, as was in the past when the revolutionary forerunners held aloft the banner of anti-Japanese armed struggle. Pak Jong Chon ardently called for adding glory to our Party, our people and our-style socialism with powerful revolutionary arms, vigorously advancing toward the accomplishment of the great cause of building a powerful army in the great era of Kim Jong Un with the indomitable spirit displayed in the period of pioneering the bloody Korean revolution to brave trials and death and with the wisdom and courage cultivated under the care of the legendary great men. All the participants drank toasts to the good health of Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the WPK and supreme commander of the DPRK armed forces, and to our state which will certainly prosper along with the development of the revolutionary armed forces. The commanding officers of units at all levels renewed their iron will to fulfill their mission and duty in strengthening the entire army into the first death-defying corps and the elite army that forms an indestructible bulletproof wall around the Party Central Committee, cherishing the great love and trust shown by Kim Jong Un as the greatest treasure of their lives. Political News Team

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Makes Speech at Military Parade Held in Celebration of 90th Founding Anniversary of KPRA
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un made a speech at the military parade held in celebration of the 90th anniversary of the founding of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army (KPRA) on April 25, Juche 111 (2022). The following is the full text of the speech: All the brave officers and men of the armed forces of our Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Officers and men of the units participating in the military parade, Comrade war veterans, exemplary soldiers and merited persons invited to this square of celebration, Esteemed Pyongyang citizens, Dear comrades, Today we are holding a grand military parade in celebration of an anniversary, significant and glorious for our great Party, state and people. At this moment overflowing with the glory of the long history of our army building, we are all here filled with a great pride in having the armed forces that firmly defend the Party, the revolution, the country and the people and reliably guarantee peace and stability. Seeing the dependable elite units massed in this Kim Il Sung Square with their victorious colours and feeling, through them, the level of the modern character of the armed forces of our Republic, all the people across the country will realize once again the profound and great significance the birth of their country's first genuine armed forces 90 years ago had in the history of our revolution and nation and will have in the future development of our state and people. The founding of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army was an event of national significance that declared a death-defying resistance against imperialism under the unfurled banner of winning national liberation and independence by our own efforts, as well as a historic event that ushered in a new era of the Juche revolution that relies on powerful revolutionary armed forces. The major meaning of this event is not confined only to the fact that our people, who were forced to live a pitiable life in the turmoil of history, could have their own national army and the hope of their revival; it also lies in the fact that the event declared at home and abroad the steadfast idea of anti-imperialist revolution of the Korean revolutionaries to settle accounts to the end and by force of arms with those who infringed upon the dignity and sovereignty of our nation and their unyielding will to win the people's freedom and liberation and the revolution's victory without fail by the internal forces. History has clearly proved that this determination and will the Korean revolutionaries opted for to carve out the destiny and future of their people was absolutely correct. The revolutionary weapons the fine sons and daughters of our people held aloft in the forests of Paektu were an expression of the soaring spirit of independence of the Korean nation, their hope and the great banner of their unity, as well as the force that loaded the mettle of self-dependence and Herculean strength in the tear-stained fists of the Korean people. Thanks to these armed ranks, a far-reaching plan of the Korean revolution was matured, the unyielding spirit and formidable strength with which to prevail over the imperialist tyranny were nurtured, and the great traditions, basic and everlasting in the development of our revolution, were created. The ideology, faith and traditions, which our revolutionary army cherished and succeeded from the outset of its founding, constituted the basis of the spiritual strength and ever-victorious guarantee that made it possible to display an undying heroic and self-sacrificing spirit in defending the Party, the revolution, the territory and the people in the fiercest-ever anti-imperialist confrontation, in the first line of grim class struggle and in the ever-changing circumstances of history, mindful of its intrinsic revolutionary and class nature and mission. This army achieved the great cause of the country's liberation and nation's revival through an unprecedented bloody struggle, repulsed the armed aggression by the US-led allied imperialist forces and defended with honour the sovereignty, dignity and safety of the country with an unrivalled heroic spirit; it has recorded ever-victorious feats while defending the ruling Party, the government, the territory and the people throughout the historical course of the socialist revolution and construction with an ennobling self-sacrificing spirit. Our Party and people regard it as a source of their greatest honour and pride to have such a brave, steely and loyal army. All our priceless gains, plus everything else on this land, are associated, first of all, with the services of our revolutionary army. This we should keep in mind. Not only as the main force for national defence but also as a powerful force for national development, our revolutionary army, true to the Party's intentions, has always made devoted efforts to carry out the ambitious revolutionary undertakings aimed at attaining lofty ideals. By doing so, it has performed such great exploits, which no others could do, in creating a new history of socialist construction and enhancing the dignity and honour of our great state. Regarding it as its lifeblood and top honour to be faithful to the Party, the government and the people, our revolutionary army has kept the lineage of the Korean revolution safe and sound and defended the ideology and cause of the Workers' Party of Korea resolutely, and reliably guaranteed the existence and development of our state and the welfare of our people. Thanks to these exploits of lasting value it has performed over the past 90 years, the annals of the Korean revolution spanning a century are resplendent with victory and glory. We will remember for all ages that our great armed forces have always opened up the way for advance in the vanguard at each of the difficult revolutionary stages and that the glorious and worthwhile victories of our Republic have been won at the cost of the priceless blood and sweat our revolutionary army shed and the noble self-sacrifice it made. The glorious history of our armed forces is embodied in the proud and honourable successors, that is, the officers and men from the elite units of the Republic's armed forces, who will march in fine array across this square of victors, and all other soldiers standing guard at the air, ground and naval posts and performing feats of labour at sites of grand socialist construction throughout the country. Availing myself of this meaningful opportunity, I, on behalf of our Party and government, would like to pay noble tribute to the anti-Japanese revolutionary forerunners and martyrs of the People's Army, who dedicated their precious lives in the struggle for national sovereignty and independence and the people's liberation, for the build-up of the revolutionary armed forces and for the victorious advance of the socialist cause. I also offer hearty congratulations to all the officers and men of the Korean People's Army and all other members of the armed forces of our Republic, who are making a great journey of faithful succession to their revolutionary forerunners. In addition, I would like to offer heartfelt thanks to all the families on this land, which have had their dear husbands and children stand at the forefront of national defence. Comrades, The glorious 90-year journey our revolutionary armed forces have made safeguarding the prosperity and development of the country by force of arms, should be continued for another hundred, nay a thousand years. In the era we are living in now, we should continue to exalt the glory of the powerful army and change to be more powerful at a fast speed incomparable with the past 90 years. In the present world where different forces collide fiercely with one another, a nation's dignity and sovereignty and reliable genuine peace are guaranteed by powerful defence capability that can overpower any enemy. We should continuously grow stronger. There is no satisfaction or accomplishment in cultivating strength for defending ourselves, and, whoever we confront, our military supremacy should be more secure. The revolution demands this, and the future of all the generations to come depends upon this. Our general line of building the revolutionary armed forces is to make the People's Army an ever-victorious army. An ever-victorious army–this must be the eternal name of our People's Army and shine as a priceless honour belonging only to our revolutionary armed forces. The People's Army should hold fast to our Party's orientation and general line of army building and dynamically open up a new phase of its development. To do so, it should define it as the core target to strengthen itself politically and ideologically and make itself strong in military technology, and give a stronger impetus to consolidating itself into an army, strong in ideology and faith, which is absolutely loyal to the leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea and boundlessly faithful to its revolutionary cause and into an elite force possessed of courage, capability and self-confidence for responding to any type of war and crisis without any hesitation. Strengthening it politically and ideologically is the main aspect and first strategic task of our building of the army. The political and ideological preparedness of the army and the ideological and spiritual preparedness of the masses of the soldiers, the motive force of the armed forces, are basic in the effort to make our revolutionary army fulfil its mission as the army of the Party, people and class and actively respond to any type of war and crisis. The staunch revolutionary spirit and class awareness of the army we have to further cultivate in the future will play a decisive role in building up the fighting efficiency of our army and defence capabilities of the nation. The unique character of our revolution is that one generation of the revolution is continually replaced by another and we have to face for a long period of time the imperialists who grow ever more ferocious with each passing day. This presents it as a crucial strategic task of army building and anti-imperialist struggle to stoutly carry on the baton of the great revolutionary ideology and spirit which originated in Paektu. When we carry out this task as the core in army building, we will surely be able to maintain and consolidate the qualitative supremacy of our revolutionary armed forces. All the Party organizations and political bodies of the People's Army should continue to stoke up the flames of the ideological revolution and focus their all-out effort on cultivating the revolutionary ideology and spiritual strength of the soldier masses. Regarding it as our top-priority task to develop the People's Army into an army strong in ideology and faith, we should prepare all the service personnel to be ideological guardsmen who fight only in line with the revolutionary ideology and will of the Party Central Committee, who cherish staunch class awareness and indomitable fighting spirit as part of their mental qualities, and who never allow a single misfire or an inch of deviation from the centre of the target designated by the Party Central Committee. We should also strongly push ahead with building it up into an army strong in military technology with a view to radically improving its fighting efficiency. The global trend of military development and rapidly-changing style of warfare at present demand that we modernize our army at a faster rate in terms of military technology. Holding aloft the slogan of modernizing the army, we should strive to the utmost to develop our People's Army into a powerful army equipped with highly advanced military technology. By pressing ahead with the modernization of the military talents training system, we should bring up a larger number of officers who are fully capable of commanding units of different arms and services at all levels. And we should make all the units and sub-units of the army fully ready to carry out any combat missions by modernizing their operation and combat training. The sectors of defence science and munitions industry should continue to develop and deploy for actual combat cutting-edge military hardware of new generations so as to ceaselessly increase the military power of the People's Army. In particular, the nuclear forces, the symbol of our national strength and the core of our military power, should be strengthened in terms of both quality and scale, so that they can perform nuclear combat capabilities in any situations of warfare, according to purposes and missions of different operations and by various means. The prevailing situation demands that more proactive measures be taken to provide a firm and sustained guarantee for the modern character and military technological supremacy of our Republic's armed forces. To cope with the rapidly-changing political and military situations and all the possible crises of the future, we will advance faster and more dynamically along the road of building up the self-defensive and modern armed forces, which we have followed unwaveringly, and, especially, will continue to take measures for further developing the nuclear forces of our state at the fastest possible speed. The fundamental mission of our nuclear forces is to deter a war, but our nukes can never be confined to the single mission of war deterrent even at a time when a situation we are not desirous of at all is created on this land. If any forces try to violate the fundamental interests of our state, our nuclear forces will have to decisively accomplish its unexpected second mission. The nuclear forces of our Republic should be fully prepared to fulfil their responsible mission and put their unique deterrent in motion at any time. Comrades, officers and men of the People's Army, Our armed forces are now fully prepared for any type of war. If any forces attempt military confrontation with the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, they will be perished. All the armed forces of the DPRK, with the heroic Korean People's Army as their core, should always firmly believe in their cause, march forward valiantly against all challenges filled with confidence, remain faithful to their sacred mission of defending the safety, dignity and happiness of the people, and securely guarantee the development of our socialism by maintaining their invincible military supremacy. All the officers and men of the armed forces of the Republic, As long as your hearts are pulsating with the precious blood and noble spirit of the revolutionary forerunners and as long as the revolutionary armed forces are always standing at the vanguard of the revolution as the embodiment of the ideology and will of the Workers' Party of Korea and of the strength of our state and people, the cause of socialism of our own style will be ever-victorious in the future, too. Commanding officers and men of the KPA and all other armed forces of the DPRK, For the safety and happiness of our great people, For the eternal glory and victory of our great state, Let us fight vigorously. Long live our great revolutionary armed forces! Long live our great country, the Democratic People's Republic of Korea!

title: Military Parade Marks 90th Anniversary of KPRA
body: All the civilians and service personnel in the DPRK, who have striven to fulfill the dreams and ideals of a powerful nation and accomplish the great cause of building a prosperous country with strong army under the guidance of the great Workers' Party of Korea injecting eternal lifeblood into the Juche revolution pioneered in Mt Paektu, are significantly commemorating the auspicious day of significance in the nation's history when their revolutionary armed forces took roots, full of boundless pride and confidence. A grand military parade to be specially recorded in the country’s history was held at Kim Il Sung Square in the capital city of Pyongyang on April 25, the 90th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army (KPRA), the first revolutionary armed forces of Juche type. The square, the venue for demonstrating to the world the proud history and invincible might of our revolutionary armed forces which have emerged victorious, carrying forward the great idea and spirit and the precious exploits and traditions, with their origin in Mt Paektu associated with the 5 000 years-long-cherished desire, was brightened by a great number of spotlights. The military parade began with a magnificent demonstration of skills by our dependable paratroopers who landed on the square, fluttering a large national flag. The State Merited Chorus in charge of playing music for the parade entered the square. And the combined military band entered the square, playing military music and changing formations to portray two pistols showing the origin of our revolutionary armed forces, the numbers "4.25.", "90", etc. the emblem of the Party and the letters "Ongwi" (safeguard) at the square. April 25, Juche 21 (1932) was the day when the dawn of national liberation was brought to the Korean people who had been deprived of even their language and names for having no army guarding the territory of their nation. President Kim Il Sung, the legendary hero of the anti-Japanese war, founded the KPRA on that day. The ceremonial performance of the combined military band revved up the celebration atmosphere with lively melodies and powerful rhythmic movements showing that the glorious history of a-match-for-a-hundred revolutionary army, which has emerged victorious in the confrontation with the most outrageous and formidable imperialist enemies over 90 years, and the traditions of the army strong with its idea and faith, rare to be seen in other parts of the world, the revolutionary army of the Party, began from that day. Parade columns of the powerful elite army proudly entered the square to the tune of the grand parade orchestral music for victory, demonstrating the might of the DPRK dashing ahead like the wind in the face of manifold difficulties. The revolutionary armed forces of the DPRK have accumulated the absolute power never to be overlooked by the world. The paraders were filled with the pride of defending the security of the great Party, the great country and the great people. Columns of cutting-edge military hardware were on standby on the avenues to the square. They showed well the appearance of the armed forces of the DPRK that have dramatically developed from the first armed group of Koreans who declared death-defying resistance against aggressors with only 100-odd rifles on the day 90 years ago. Air squadrons of the Air Force impregnably defending the airspace of the country with a sacred mission of safeguarding the Party and the revolution were waiting for their sorties. All the paraders were looking up to the tribune of the square with great honor and excitement as they were to be reviewed by Kim Jong Un, the outstanding leader of the Juche revolution, symbol of the mightiness of our Party and state and the representative of the great dignity. When Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, arrived at the square together with his wife Ri Sol Ju, a solemn ceremony of receiving him was held by the honor guard of the Korean People's Army (KPA). After receiving a salute from the chief of the honor guard, Kim Jong Un reviewed the honor guard and the glorious colors of the large combined units. The outstanding supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK who is an ever-victorious iron-willed brilliant commander was greeted by senior officials of the Ministry of National Defence and commanders of the large combined units and combined units of the KPA. Army commanders paid their highest respects carrying their deep gratitude to Kim Jong Un who made sure that our revolutionary armed forces, the pivot of the national defence capabilities and the strong fortress for safeguarding the revolution and the country, demonstrated their military and political might through a significant parade on their founding day. Amid the playing of the welcome music, the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, together with his wife Ri Sol Ju, took the tribune of the square. At that moment, the cheers of "Hurrah!" and chants of "Kim Jong Un" and "Kyolsaongwi" (devoted defence) rocked the square. He waved back to the enthusiastically cheering paraders and spectators. Kim Jong Un and his wife Ri Sol Ju were presented with bunches of flowers by members of the Children's Union. Taking the tribune were Pak Jong Chon, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission of the WPK and secretary of the WPK Central Committee, Ri Pyong Chol, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretary of the WPK Central Committee, and Ri Yong Gil, Kwon Yong Jin, Rim Kwang Il and other senior officials of the armed forces organs, commanders and political commissars of the large combined units and commanders of the combined units. Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, Jo Yong Won, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretary for Organizational Affairs of the WPK Central Committee, Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, took the reserved seats for VIPs. The tribune was taken by Ri Il Hwan, Jong Sang Hak, O Su Yong, Thae Hyong Chol, Kim Jae Ryong, Kim Yong Chol, Jong Kyong Thaek, Pak Jong Gun, O Il Jong, Ho Chol Man, Pak Thae Dok, Kim Hyong Sik, Yu Jin, Pak Myong Sun, Ri Chol Man, Kim Song Nam, Jon Hyon Chol, Ju Chol Gyu, Ri Son Gwon, Ri Thae Sop, U Sang Chol, Kim Yong Hwan and other senior Party and government officials. Present on invitation were Ri Myong Su, Thae Jong Su, Choe Yong Rim, Kim Kyong Ok and other veterans who had worked for a long time in the Party, the government and the military. Taking the reserved seats were the participants in the celebrations of the 90th founding anniversary of the KPRA. There was a solemn ceremony of hoisting a national flag. A column of women depicting a five-pointed star, an emblem which was shown on the anti-Japanese guerrillas' caps, entered the square to the tune of the song "Our National Flag". Drones depicted a large national flag. When the column arrived at the middle of the square, members of the KPA honor guard emerged from it and marched towards the flagstaff with a spread national flag. Amid the chorus of the national anthem of the DPRK, the national flag reflecting the invincible might of our country and all the miracles, victory and the bright future of the people was hoisted. This flag was hoisted in the sky of new Korea for the first time after President Kim Il Sung liberated the country through hard-fought anti-Japanese war.
