It is the flag of socialist Korea Chairman Kim Jong Il defended, overcoming the tempests of history, and the flag of our dignified powerful country which has grown stronger, performing the world-startling miracles and changes under the distinguished leadership of Kim Jong Un. With their hearts burning with the strong will to proudly fly the flag symbolizing the soul and stamina of Mt Paektu and the destiny of the people and to warmly love and add luster forever to most valuable our-style socialism, the genuine people's country, all the participants solemnly looked up to the national flag. Fireworks were displayed in the sky where the DPRK flag was fluttering. And a salute of 21 guns was boomed amid the playing of the song "The Glorious Country". The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un made a celebration speech. Referring to the profound and great significance of the birth of the first genuine armed forces of Korea 90 years ago in the history of our revolution and the nation and in the future development of our state and people, he said that the arms of revolution held by fine sons and daughters of the Korean people in the forest of Mt Paektu was an expression of the ever-growing Korean nation's spirit of independence, hope and the banner of great unity and the motive force that provided the Koreans with the spirit of self-respect and invincible strength. He stressed that as long as the hearts of all the officers and men of the DPRK armed forces are pulsating with the thick blood and precious soul of the revolutionary forerunners and the revolutionary armed forces always stand in the van of the revolution as the paragons of the idea and will of the Workers' Party of Korea and the power of our state and people, our socialist cause will always emerge victorious in the future, too. He ardently called for vigorously struggling for the wellbeing and happiness of our great people and the eternal glory and victory of our great state. Hearing his touching speech, all the participants burst into stormy cheers with high national pride of having the peerlessly brilliant commander and the high glory of having the revolutionary armed forces which have devotedly preserved the lineage of the Korean revolution and the idea and cause of the WPK and reliably guaranteed the existence and development of our state and the happiness of the people. Then, preparations for the parade were reviewed. Vice Marshal of the KPA Ri Yong Gil, minister of National Defence of the DPRK, made a report to KPA Marshal Pak Jong Chon, vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission of the WPK, that parade units were ready to be reviewed. Pak Jong Chon reviewed the parade units. He courteously reported to the General Secretary of the WPK that the military parade for marking the 90th founding anniversary of the KPRA was ready to start. The columns of the armed forces of the DPRK, which were founded in the flames of the anti-Japanese war and have strengthened into a matchless elite army and a revolutionary army of the Party, recording only victory and glory in its history, began marching. The column of honorary cavalrymen entered the square. Honorary cavalrymen, reminding the spectators of the spirit and mettle of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army which used to appear in the east and in the west at the same time to confuse and annihilate the enemy under the guidance of General Kim Il Sung who commanded the anti-Japanese guerilla army on a white horse, rode past the square. A column of soldiers representing the period of the anti-Japanese armed struggle, when the first generation of our revolutionary armed forces set a shining example of devotedly protecting the leader for the first time in history and established the traditions of winning victory with idea and faith, marched past the square with a red flag fluttering. Then a column of soldiers representing the period of the Fatherland Liberation War proudly marched with dignity under the colors associated with the immortal feats of the heroic soldiers in the 1950s who performed a unprecedented military miracle by defeating with rifles the enemy armed with atomic bombs, carrying forward the great traditions of victory in the anti-Japanese revolutionary war that witnessed the defeat of the gangster-like Japanese imperialists' one-million strong army which regarded the KPRA as "a drop in the ocean". Columns of marchers passed the square one after another, reminding the spectators of the great years when the soldiers of the KPA achieved miraculous victories, unheard-of in the world war history, in ground, air and sea battles of the 3-year-long hard-fought war against the barbaric aggression by the U.S. imperialists. Columns of soldiers under the Guard Office of the Party Central Committee and the Guard Department of the State Affairs Commission standing guard over the supreme staff of the Korean revolution vigorously marched past the square, vividly representing the revolutionary character of the armed forces of the Republic and the eternal mission of the nation. The columns of soldiers under the Guard Department and the Guard Command showcased their will to become the very bodyguards and bulletproof wall that devotedly defend the Party Central Committee true to the noble spirit of the bodyguards of the anti-Japanese guerilla army who devotedly defended the headquarters of revolution. The column of the First Corps, the strongest corps of the People's Army called the corps of tigers in Mt Paektu defending the eastern sector of the front, marched past the square fluttering the colors of elite divisions whose mere names strike fear into the enemies. The columns of the Second and Fourth Corps, the frontline corps in the west and the units that gave birth to the spirit of match-for-a-hundred combatants, marched in a fine array under the colors of divisions and brigades that smashed every reckless military provocation of the enemies through telling blows. The column of the Fifth Corps in charge of the central sector of the front fully represented the spirit of the frontline service personnel to annihilate the enemy, performing military exploits while standing guard over the outpost of the country and the revolution like the guardsmen who made their way through the flames of war. Marching with gallantry to the tune of song of the revolutionary army were navy and air force columns holding aloft the colors of the naval fleets, hailed as the death-defying corps of the sea and the unsinkable battleship, and of the air force divisions displaying their might as the shields in the sky and the red goshawks. Following the energetically marching missile maintenance crewmembers of the strategic force column, the symbol of the irresistible might of the DPRK armed forces, the special operations force column, always ready to deal crushing blows to the enemy in any operation space of land, sea or air when the time for a decisive battle comes, entered the square. Kim Jong Un extended a warm military salute to the service personnel in major thrusts, the core unit which acts as the backbone of the revolutionary armed forces and firmly defends the very forefront of national defence. The parade members chanted "Hurrah!" for the iron-willed commander, who ushers in a great golden age of bolstering military muscle of the country while strengthening the People's Army remarkably into invincible revolutionary vanguard ranks braving difficulties with the spirit of Mt Paektu, a revolutionary army of the Party modeled on the WPK and ultra-modern forces, holding high the banner of modeling the whole army on Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism. Columns of the Anti-aircraft Artillery Corps, the 91st Corps and the 3rd Corps of the KPA impregnably defending Pyongyang, the heart of the Korean revolution where the Party Central Committee is situated were followed by the columns of other corps defending the east and west coastal areas, the northern areas and border gateways. Then columns of tanks and armored vehicle divisions and motorized infantry divisions including the Seoul Ryu Kyong Su Guards 105th Tank Division and the 425th Motorized Infantry Division of the KPA, powerful strike groups that are prepared to immediately secure any strategic areas indicated by the Supreme Headquarters, marched proudly under the uplifted sacred colors bearing the letters "April 25", displaying the might of the invincible revolutionary Paektusan army that stoutly preserves the glorious traditions of the anti-Japanese war. Marching past the tribune of the square were columns of scouts and mountain infantry known as versatile and brave fighters, those of specialists' units such as the electronic harassment operations unit, columns of Kim Il Sung Military University which is the highest seat of military education guaranteeing the eternal might and invincibility of our revolutionary armed forces, Kim Jong Il University of Military and Politics which is a centre for training the highest-ranking military commanding officers in the country, Kim Il Sung University of Politics which greatly contributes to making the KPA politically, ideologically and morally stronger, and Kim Jong Un University of National Defence which makes a distinguished contribution to training of persons talented in the Juche-based defence science and technology, and columns of military schools at all levels. The marchers were full of the steadfast resolution to readily die a heroic death for the good of the great commander who gives ever-lasting life with warm feeling, passion, love and trust and teaches strategy of victory and exceptional bravery. The cheers, burst out by the backbone of the elite army, brave soldiers of the powerful country greatly moved to have the high honor of being reviewed by Marshal Kim Jong Un, the illustrious commander, rocked the square. Columns of students at revolutionary schools who have prepared themselves as pillars of the Juche revolution while reliably succeeding to the lineage of Mangyongdae, the lineage of Paektu at the educational seats for the sons and daughters of revolutionary martyrs associated with the idea of continuous revolution and love for the younger generation and future of the WPK went past to the tune of a march. A column of the Worker-Peasant Red Guards, which have strengthened into reliable armed forces for safeguarding the socialist country and defending hometowns by inheriting the tradition of all-people resistance created during the anti-Japanese war, marched through the square, carrying the flags of provincial worker-peasant red guards with the chief secretary of the Pyongyang City Party Committee as its head and the chief secretaries of provincial Party committees in the van. A column of the Ministry of State Security which has demonstrated its might as a dependable political security force of the Party reliably protecting the precious gains of the socialist country and the people's wellbeing and as an elite unit playing a part of the revolutionary armed forces, columns of the traffic security women, the tracker dog search party and the special mobile corps of the Public Security Forces and a column of emergency epidemic prevention workers passed the square. Kim Jong Un raised his hands to encourage the marchers who have carried forward the noble tradition of remaining faithful to their mission for defending the leader, the social system and the people in the stern annals of the revolution to reliably safeguard the outposts of class struggle. Thunderous cheers of "hurrah!" raised by parade members resounded through the sky of the square, amplifying the immutable truth that the destiny of the country and the happiness of the people and the ever-victory of the Korean revolution are guaranteed in defending the Party Central Committee. Then the flight parade of the KPA Air Force began. Air squadrons, in formations depicting the five-pointed star and laurel tree, flew past the sky above the square while letting off fireworks to brighten the sky. The spectators raised cheers, feasting their eyes on the air squadrons making zero feet flight and displaying such aeronautics as zooming. While letting off the fireworks, a squadron in a fan-shape formation left the trails reflecting the ardent will of the combat pilots to devotedly defend the Party Central Committee with fervent loyalty to it. Amid the endless expression of trust in the heroic KPA, the vanguard ranks of loyalty which follow the path indicated by the Party Central Committee after entrusting their destiny totally to it, the columns of mechanized units began their advance. The columns of latest tactical missile units entered the square in the spirit of smashing the enemy' aggression war hardware at once with high mobility and annihilating blows, fluttering their colors. The column of prototype tanks, a symbol of the strong combat power of the KPA and its iron fist, roared past the square. The square was full of strong courage and militant enthusiasm of Korean tankmen who will sweep away everything in their way and fly the flag of victory before anyone else when the moment of the decisive battle comes, following the traditions of the guard tank units that braved the flames of the Fatherland Liberation War. The reliable artillery pieces, the first arm of the People's Army and the most powerful arm in the world, moved past the square reflecting the will to reduce the enemy position into a sea of flames and set off the fireworks of victory once the Party Central Committee issues an order to fire. The great Comrade Kim Jong Un advanced the outstanding military idea and theory that the true defence capabilities precisely mean strong attack capabilities and has built up the great attack capabilities and overwhelming military capabilities for preventing war, ensuring the national security and surely containing and controlling any threats and blackmail by the imperialists. Iron-clad ranks that have developed into invincible, ultra-modern offensive strike groups under the care of the gifted military strategist and peerlessly illustrious commander appeared at the square. A column of super-large MLRS, one of absolute weaponry of the DPRK without an equal in other parts of the world that is capable of carrying out a scorched-earth operation any moment through successive strike with major targets of strike in the operational zone in its firing range roared past the square. Columns of strategic missiles entered the square, demonstrating the strong capabilities for executing a war making it possible to react to any warfare in the sky, land, sea and outer space and decisively contain and frustrate the enemy. WPK-style Juche-based weapons, our dear ones inspiring great confidence and eternal treasure of our nation never to be bartered for anything, appeared one after another. Our invincible country is demonstrating its might as a military power that had access to perfect and powerful deterrence for self-defence under the outstanding guidance of the great Comrade Kim Jong Un who accomplished the historic great cause of completing the nuclear forces by making a long journey of patriotic devotion with a death-defying will in order to make sure that the people would eternally enjoy happiness free from the horrors of war generation after generation. The spectators raised enthusiastic cheers, feasting eyes on the Juche-based weapons symbolic of the truth that a country and an army that firmly preserve, carry forward and accomplish the revolution with a great origin and history and the cause pioneered by the leader always emerge victorious, and the absolute weaponry that vividly reflects the appearance of our country as an advanced, modern, heroic and brave country. Amid the playing of solemn music and focusing of spotlights and display of fireworks, a great entity representing the strategic forces of the Republic appeared at the square. At that moment the spectators raised loud cheers, greatly excited to see the giant ICBM Hwasongpho-17 which soared into sky on March 24 to demonstrate the absolute power of Juche Korea and the strategic position of our Republic to the world. They extended highest glory to Kim Jong Un, great champion of justice and peace and peerless hero who has built up the national power, the greatest ever since the founding of the country, and ushered in the era of the most dignified powerful country in the nation's history of 5 000 years, the era of the our state-first principle by leading the country and its people with his outstanding ideology, leadership, passionate love and absolute trust. The most powerful weapons in the world that represent the soul of Juche, patriotism of all the people and the great strength eternally guaranteeing the future of the country and the nation rolled past the square, fully demonstrating the unshakable will of our Party and people to more dynamically and more vigorously accelerate the continued development of the capabilities for self-defence and war deterrence that constitute the bedrock of the existence of our state and guarantee for its development. When the military parade ended, all the participants again broke into thunderous cheers of "Hurrah!" and fireworks were let off. Spectacular fireworks let off in the middle of the Taedong River and from different parts of the square colorfully decorated the nocturnal sky of April. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un warmly waved back to the enthusiastically cheering crowds. The square was overflowing with the revolutionary enthusiasm of all the participants to remain loyal to him only with a firm faith that the Korean revolution pioneered by the President and Korean-style socialism preserved under the leadership of the Chairman remain unfazed and an immensely rosy future is in store for the country thanks to the respected General Secretary. The military parade for celebrating the 90th founding anniversary of the KPRA served as an event of great significance that demonstrated once again before the world the invincibility, mightiness and radical development of the armed forces of the Republic that guarantees the succession and implementation of the revolutionary cause of Juche, while demonstrating the might as the revolutionary army of the Party that remains absolutely loyal to the idea and leadership of the WPK and as the reliable defender of peace , and marked a historic occasion for greatly encouraging the Korean people in their heroic struggle for adding glory to the great era of Kim Jong Un and a new era of building a prosperous and powerful nation. Political News Team

title: International Online Seminar on Juche Idea Held
body: An international online seminar on "The truth and vitality of the Juche idea, the immortal banner of cause of human independence" was hosted by the International Institute of the Juche Idea from April 10 to 16 on the occasion of the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Posted on an ad hoc page of the institute's website were photos of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. Showcased under the headline "In celebration of the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung" were more than 130 written speeches presented by followers of the Juche idea and figures of political and academic circles in over 70 countries and congratulatory messages to the seminar from the Korean Association of Social Scientists, the Juche idea institutes and organizations for friendship and solidarity with the Korean people across the world. Participating in the seminar were members of the boards of directors of the International Institute of the Juche Idea and the Juche idea institutes in Asia, Africa, Europe and Latin America, delegates from groups for the study of the Juche idea and personages of various circles in each country. Ramon Jimenez Lopez, director-general of the International Institute of the Juche Idea, declared the opening of the seminar. He said that to open the seminar on the occasion of the 110th birth anniversary of the great President Kim Il Sung is a great joy of the followers of the Juche idea across the world. Sim Sung Gon, first vice-chairman of the Korean Association of Social Scientists, made a congratulatory speech. The speakers in the seminar praised Kim Il Sung as the leader of the world revolution and an ideo-theoretical genius who ushered in the era of independence for humanity, and lauded Kim Jong Il for further enriching the storehouse of human ideology by comprehensively systemizing the Juche idea. They also praised the greatness of Kim Jong Un. A letter to Kim Jong Un was adopted at the seminar. An online photo and book exhibition on the theme of "The Juche idea and socialist Korea" opened during the seminar period. Videos documenting the immortal ideo-theoretical achievements of Kim Il Sung, Kim Jong Il and Kim Jong Un, and showing the work for studying and disseminating the Juche idea that further intensifies worldwide were screened at the groups for the study of the Juche idea across the world. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Letter from Participants in International Online Seminar
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a letter from the participants in an international online seminar on "The truth and vitality of the Juche idea, the immortal banner of the cause of human independence", on April 16. In the letter, the participants offered the warmest felicitations to Kim Jong Un on the occasion of the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. The letter stressed that during the seminar they highly praised President Kim Il Sung, His Excellency Kim Jong Il and General Secretary Kim Jong Un as great thinkers and theoreticians and outstanding leaders who built and ceaselessly developed the socialist society, centered on the popular masses, which embodied the Juche idea. It said that they got to know better about the truth and vitality of the Juche idea while witnessing the proud successes being achieved by the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK). It extended warm congratulations and firm solidarity to the heroic Korean people who are building up their defence capabilities in every way, true to the decisions made at the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea. Expressing great pleasure over the fact that General Secretary Kim Jong Un is successfully carrying forward the idea and cause of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, the letter expressed conviction that Korean-style socialism would as ever advance victoriously. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Photo Show Marks 90th Birthday of KPRA
body: A national photo show opened to celebrate the 90th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army (KPRA). On display at the show venue are photos dealing with the undying feats of the peerlessly great persons who achieved the great cause of building an army by dint of self-reliance from scratch and strengthened the Korean People's Army into a matchless elite revolutionary army to provide a powerful military guarantee for the victorious advance of the socialist cause. Among them are photos showing the history of the anti-Japanese armed struggle waged by President Kim Il Sung who founded the KPRA, the first revolutionary armed forces of Juche type, to achieve the historic cause of liberating the country. Some photos show the greatness of the President who developed the KPRA into the regular revolutionary armed forces and laid a solid foundation for the self-reliant defence industry. Some photos show the patriotic efforts of Chairman Kim Jong Il who devoted himself to the country's prosperity and the wellbeing of all generations to come, pushing his way through an untrodden thorny path with his Songun revolutionary leadership. There are also photos dealing with the great achievements of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, a peerless patriot who has creditably carried forward the army-building cause of Juche to demonstrate to the full the might of the powerful revolutionary army. An opening ceremony took place at the April 25 House of Culture on April 24. Present there were Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Sung Jong Gyu, Minister of Culture, officials of Party and power organs and labor innovators. Rodong Sinmun

title: Revolutionary Battle Site Draws Endless Stream of Visitors
body: A large number of working people, servicepersons, youth and students visit the Kuksabong Revolutionary Battle Site on the occasion of the 90th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army (KPRA). Trees bearing slogans and relics preserved at the Kuksabong Revolutionary Battle Site are witnesses of history and precious treasure of the revolution showing the confidence in victory of revolution and patriotism of the anti-Japanese revolutionary fighters. The revolutionary battle site has revolutionary relics including trees bearing such slogans as "Long live General Kim" and "Hurrah for national liberation", the sites of campfire and spring, etc. The visitors hardened their faith and will to glorify the exploits of President Kim Il Sung who led the great anti-Japanese war to brilliant victory and thus saved the destiny of the country and the nation and accomplish without fail the revolutionary cause of Juche pioneered on Mt Paektu by inheriting the spirit of the forerunners. On the occasion of the founding anniversary of the KPRA the number of visitors increases. This year alone more than 80 000 people have visited it. The visitors had gatherings for hearing impressions about the reminiscences of anti-Japanese guerrillas, competitions of singing revolutionary songs in chorus and oath-taking meetings. Rodong Sinmun

title: New Stamps Issued to Mark 90th Founding Anniversary of KPRA
body: The State Stamp Bureau of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea has issued new stamps (one sheetlet and one individual) to celebrate the 90th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army (KPRA). The sheetlet contains a stamp depicting the image of President Kim Il Sung, a legendary hero of the anti-Japanese war, against the red-colored background with sunrays and a stamp showing an oil painting "The Great Leader Comrade Kim Il Sung Proclaiming the Foundation of the Anti-Japanese People's Guerrilla Army". It reminds one of the exploits of the peerlessly great man who founded the first revolutionary armed forces of Juche type. An individual stamp shows the anti-Japanese revolutionary forerunners who waged long bloody battles under the leadership of the President. Inscribed on the stamps are letters "90th Founding Anniversary of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army" and "April 25. Juche 21 (1932) - Juche 111 (2022)". Rodong Sinmun

title: 90th Birthday of KPRA Celebrated in DPRK
body: All the people in the DPRK including the service personnel significantly celebrated the 90th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army (KPRA). An endless stream of visitors flew to the sacred temple of Juche, the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun where President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il lie in state. At the plaza of the palace, the visitors paid noble tribute to the great leaders. Civilians and servicepersons offered floral tribute to the statues of the President and the Chairman and the mosaics picturing their smiling images in different parts of the country, including Mansu Hill in the capital city of Pyongyang and Samjiyon City. Bunches of flowers were laid at the Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery on Mt Taesong, the Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery and statues and cemeteries of martyrs, memorial towers for the fallen soldiers of the Korean People's Army (KPA) and cemeteries of fallen fighters of the KPA across the country. Celebration meetings and oratorical contests were held and celebration performances were given at theatres throughout the country. Outdoor performances were given in different parts of Pyongyang to rev up the festive mood. Public commercial and catering establishments in Pyongyang and local areas were busy with holiday service. Working people and schoolchildren had a nice time at the Central Zoo, Natural History Museum and Munsu Water Park. There were dancing parties of youth and students and women's union members in Pyongyang and provincial seats, cities and counties. Officials, working people and students visited the families of war veterans and disabled soldiers to congratulate them on leading a worthwhile life under the care of the Party. Celebration billboards and fantastic light decorations were displayed in streets of the capital city and local areas to add to the festive mood. Rodong Sinmun

title: Dancing Party of Women's Union Members
body: A dancing party of women's union officials and members was held at the plaza of the Arch of Triumph here Monday to celebrate the 90th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army. Amid the playing of the song "Long Live Generalissimo Kim Il Sung", its participants began to dance, extending glory to President Kim Il Sung who provided a powerful military guarantee for the victorious advance of the revolutionary cause of Juche. They danced to the tune of songs reflecting gratitude to Chairman Kim Jong Il who developed the Korean People's Army into an army of the leader and into an invincible revolutionary army. The venue of the dancing party reverberated with songs praising the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un who has demonstrated to the world the country's dignity and prestige, ushering in a heyday of the strengthening of the revolutionary armed forces. It was full of the women's patriotic enthusiasm for devoting themselves to the prosperity of the country and the happiness of the grand socialist family, following the fighting spirit and traits of the heroines of the preceding generations. Rodong Sinmun

title: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of Great Leaders
body: All the servicepersons and civilians in the DPRK greeting the 90th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army pay the highest tribute to President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il, the founder and builder of the Juche revolutionary armed forces. Many people visited the statues of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill with deep yearning for the peerlessly great men. Laid at the statues were floral baskets together with bouquets in the names of Party, power and armed forces organs, social organizations, ministries, national institutions, units of the Korean People's Army (KPA) and the Public Security Forces (PSF) and institutions and industrial establishments at all levels in Pyongyang City. The visitors made a bow to the statues of the great leaders. Bouquets and floral baskets in the names of KPA and PSF units and institutions and industrial establishments were placed before the statues of the great leaders and the mosaics picturing their smiling images at Kim Il Sung University, the Ministry of National Defence, the Ministry of Public Security, the Mansudae Art Studio and other parts of the capital city. Servicepersons, working people and schoolchildren across the country, too, visited the statues of the great leaders and their mosaics in their residential areas. Rodong Sinmun

title: Spurs Put to Diversifying Building Materials in Terms of Kind, Shape and Color
body: Jagang Province is vigorously pushing forward with the work to diversify building materials in terms of kind, shape and color. Officials of the province analyzed and reviewed in depth the successes and experiences achieved in the construction field in the past as well as deviations. Then they mapped out scrupulous plans by year and step to develop and produce more quality building materials of various kinds and ambitiously direct the realization. The Provincial Local Construction and Building Materials Management Bureau improved its role and tasks were assigned to officials in detailed way. Many building materials production units like the Huichon Tilery endeavor to turn out various kinds of building materials. The province organized a building-materials exhibition in substantial way and actively generalizes the experiences of advanced units. It also pushes ahead with the work to produce various building materials of quality with locally available materials. Rodong Sinmun

title: Precious Tradition of Powerful Revolutionary Army Started from Anti-Japanese War
body: Indomitable Revolutionary Spirit of Braving All Difficulties The victory of the revolution is just one of the indomitable fighting spirit. The indomitable revolutionary spirit unyielding even in the face of any hardships is ideological and moral qualities peculiar to our Korean People’s Army (KPA) and its brilliant tradition was established in the forest of Mt Paektu. The anti-Japanese revolutionary forerunners fought against the Japanese imperialists like a phoenix overcoming the severe hardships and ordeals, with the firm faith that the Korean revolution would surely emerge victorious as it was led by President Kim Il Sung. One indomitable fighter cut his wounded leg with his own hands for the revolution and a woman revolutionary cried out that the victory of revolution was in sight even though she was deprived of eyes by enemies. These were the first generation of the revolution. Indeed, they could win the victory in the struggle against the gangster-like Japanese imperialists armed to the teeth under the very difficult conditions because they bravely weathered all obstacles by fully displaying the fighting spirit of rising up no matter how often one may fall and fighting it out. The victorious history of our revolutionary armed forces clearly proves that there is neither difficulty insurmountable nor fortress unconquerable when one has strong revolutionary spirit. Remarkable successes made by the KPA in the proud struggle for the country’s prosperity and people’s happiness are the fruition of the indomitable revolutionary spirit of service personnel who are fearless and do not hesitate on the way of realizing the plan and determination of the leader. Even though the tradition is admirable, it cannot become a powerful strength promoting the revolution when it remains only in historical book. The revolution with the invaluable tradition created by the leader’s guidance and firmly inherited generation after generation always emerges victorious. The KPA will carry forward the indomitable revolutionary spirit of the former generation and fully display the spirit of the powerful revolutionary army which knows no impossibility. Rodong Sinmun

title: Art Performance Marks 90th Founding Anniversary of KPRA
body: A splendid art performance was given to celebrate the 90th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army (KPRA) in Pyongyang on April 26. The joint performance by the State Merited Chorus and the Ensemble of the Ministry of National Defence was enjoyed by the participants in the military parade and the celebrations marking the 90th founding anniversary of the KPRA. Choe Ryong Hae and Kim Tok Hun, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and Ri Il Hwan, Kim Jae Ryong, Kim Yong Chol, Jong Kyong Thaek, Pak Jong Gun and O Il Jong also watched the performance. Put on the stage were the hymns praising the leaders and the songs of the revolutionary army that resounded in the 90-year-long militant course of the revolutionary armed forces which have devotedly defended the bloodline of the Korean revolution and the idea and cause of the WPK. After the playing of the national anthem of the DPRK, the performance started with male trio and male chorus "Cantata to Marshal Kim Il Sung". The performers paid the highest tribute and eternal glory to President Kim Il Sung, who created a model of a revolutionary army in the era of independence during the hard-fought anti-Japanese war and brought about the precious origin of the Korean revolution that has emerged victorious on the strength of arms. Through the revolutionary hymn "Star of Korea" and such famous songs as "The Guerrilla March" and "Song of the Red Flag", they eulogized the exploits of the forerunners who established the traditions of great unity and invincibility by holding aloft the banner of devotedly defending the leader for the first time in the glorious history of the Korean revolution. They sang of the proud feats of the Korean People's Army that has remained faithful to its sacred mission of defending the security, dignity and happiness of the country and the people by braving all the challenges with absolute confidence in its cause. Military songs composed in the new century of Juche revved up the atmosphere of the performance as they inspired the audience's boundless pride in the revolutionary armed forces which have supported the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, a powerful country, with the greatest military power under the guidance of the great Party. Watching the performance, the audience hardened their conviction that the cause of Korean-style socialism will emerge victorious forever as the elite army always stands in the van of the revolution, embodying the idea and will of the great Party Central Committee and representing the power of the country and the people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Natural Monument of Mt Taesong
body: Sabina chinensis is growing at the Central Botanical Garden of the DPRK. Originally it had grown in Nampho since around the year 1600, and was replanted at the botanical garden in Juche 48 (1959). The tree is 3.2m in height, 3.3m in circumference at its base and 3.1m in circumference at its middle, 14 meters in width of its crown and some 41 meters in its circumference. The tree, covering a large area in the horizontal direction, has good appearance and fragrant scenery. The DPRK registered this tree as a natural monument in 1980 and puts it under conservation. Rodong Sinmun

title: Exhibition of Building Equipment and Tools Held
body: An exhibition of building equipment and tools for construction brigades in cities and counties was held for rural construction in South Hwanghae Province. Senior officials of the province paid due attention to making the exhibition an important occasion for construction brigades of cities and counties to exchange and share good experiences and for stepping up the development and production of building equipment and tools. The construction brigades of cities and counties presented 20-odd kinds of building equipment and various tools to the exhibition. The hollow block moulding machine and other efficient building equipment and tools presented by Paechon County drew visitors’ attention. Meanwhile, Yonan County’s horizontal vibrating compactor and several building equipment and tools were appreciated to be of high applicative value. The Anak County Construction Brigade newly devised and presented bar cutters and reinforcement correctors. Construction brigades in Haeju City and Unchon and Sinchon Counties also displayed different construction equipment and tools. Senior officials of the province pointed out the shortcomings that occurred in the exhibition and let them thoroughly be overcome in order to rouse junior officials to remain faithful to the Party’s rural construction plan with practice. They also let the units participant in the exhibition generalize valuable experiences and produce more of the construction equipment and tools which can speed up construction and improve its quality at the same time. Rodong Sinmun

title: Precious Tradition of Powerful Revolutionary Army Started from Anti-Japanese War
body: Political and Ideological Superiority Is Source of Victory During the anti-Japanese armed struggle the Japanese imperialists, boasting of their huge armed forces and equipment, thought lightly of the Korean People’s Revolutionary Army (KPRA) as "a drop in the ocean". However, the KPRA won victory after victory in the battles against the one million-strong army of the Japanese imperialists armed to the teeth. A victory in a battle does not depend on the military equipment but on the ideological consciousness of the service personnel who utilize the equipment. President Kim Il Sung, in the period of the anti-Japanese war, put primary efforts into securing the organizational and ideological purity and unity of will of the ranks of the guerilla units and equipping the guerillas with firm independent consciousness, ardent patriotism, warm revolutionary comradeship and spirit of voluntary discipline. The President used to implant genuine patriotic soul, indomitable will and strong faith in the hearts of the guerillas when he sat around campfires with them in primitive forests. Under the care of the President the KPRA was fully prepared itself politically and ideologically and strengthened into an army strong in ideology and faith with noble mentality and morality. The political and ideological superiority is the essential superiority of the revolutionary army and the source of power for defeating every aggression troop of imperialism lies in giving full play to the political and ideological superiority. The brilliant tradition of defeating the enemy’s numerical and military technical superiority by means of the political and ideological superiority is being carried through as the fundamental source of the indefatigable power of our revolutionary armed forces. Our revolutionary armed forces will further demonstrate its grandeur as an elite army and be ever-victorious by dint of the political and ideological superiority. Rodong Sinmun

title: Russian Embassy Members Visit Moranbong Secondary School No. 1
body: Alexandr Matsegora, Russian ambassador to the DPRK, and his embassy members visited DPRK-Russia Friendship Moranbong Secondary School No. 1 on April 27 on the occasion of the third anniversary of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's historic visit to the Russian Federation. Hearing the explanation about the fact that students of the school are preparing themselves to be the pillars shouldering the future of the country under the care of the socialist educational system, they went round different places of the school. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Technical Innovation Contest Reviewed
body: There took place a review of the national technical innovation contest of the April 15 technical innovation shock brigades to celebrate the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. The contest, started in April last year, was aimed to actively promote the fulfillment of the first year's tasks of the five-year plan by putting production processes on a modern basis, realizing the local production of raw and other materials and recycling and steadily improving the technical and economical indices through a brisk mass technological innovation movement. Present there were the April 15 technical innovation shock brigades organized in the fields of metal, chemical, electric power, coal and machine-building industries, agriculture, light industry and local industry. While conducting collective emulation drive, members of the shock brigades across the country carried out a lot of technological innovation goals, thus contributing to revitalization of the production and the readjustment and reinforcement of the production foundation. The meeting for reviewing the contest was held through video-conferencing at the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea on April 27. Attending it were Thae Hyong Chol, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials of ministries, national institutions and provincial people's committees, officials concerned and those of excellent units. A report was followed by the announcement of the standings of the contest. 26 units took the first place, 30 units the second place and 35 units the third place. Citations, silk banners, etc. are to be awarded to the excellent units at the review meetings of each province, city and county. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Has Photo Session with Workers of Central Broadcasting Committee of Korea
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on April 27 had a meaningful photo session with announcers, journalists, cameramen, editors and other workers of the Central Broadcasting Committee of Korea who contributed to broadcasting the military parade for celebrating the 90th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army at the highest level. He entrusted the workers of the committee with the sacred heavy task of airing to the world the historic military parade of the great revolutionary armed forces to be etched in the history of the country. As he bestowed all laurels upon them, although he led them step by step to fulfill their task with his gifted wisdom and energetic guidance, the participants in the photo session hardly repressed their gratitude resulting from their deep reverence for the benevolent father. Warmly shaking hands with the workers of the committee cheering in tears of excitement, the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un expressed thanks to the committee for successfully broadcasting the military parade at the best level as intended by the Party Central Committee. Stressing that the responsible historic duty of the TV broadcasting service is to vigorously spur fresh change and development in the van of ideological revolution in the new era, he noted that the Party Central Committee highly praises the Central Broadcasting Committee of Korea for the recent successes in its work. Expressing expectations that the workers of the committee will continue to make remarkable achievements in playing the important role of informing the world of the authority and dignity of the great Party and state and the current of the times in order to make faster development of the broadcasting service, always mindful of the trust of the Party and the people, he had a photo session with them. All the participants, upon receiving such great benevolence from the respected General Secretary, were full of strong passion to fulfill their duty as ideological vanguard and buglers of the revolution who staunchly champion our great idea, social system and cause. Political News Team

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Has Photo Session with Those in Celebrations of 90th Anniversary of KPRA
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), had a photo session with the participants in the celebrations of the 90th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army (KPRA) on April 28. Attending the session were Choe Ryong Hae, Jo Yong Won, Kim Tok Hun, Pak Jong Chon and Ri Pyong Chol, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, and Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the WPK Central Committee. Ri Yong Gil, Kwon Yong Jin and Rim Kwang Il and other leading officials of the armed forces organs were also present. The participants in the celebrations were filled with great excitement and joy over the fact that they were to have a significant photo taken with the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, the symbol of mightiness and invincibility of our dignified Party, state and armed forces, after being honored to watch in his presence a glorious parade of reviewing the powerful revolutionary army's 90-year long history woven with great victories and glory. When Kim Jong Un arrived, all the participants raised stormy cheers of "Hurrah!", extending the highest glory to him, the peerlessly brilliant commander who has reliably ensured the dignity and prosperity of our state and the eternal peace of our people with his far-sighted wisdom and distinguished leadership. Kim Jong Un extended warm greetings to the participants who are making a new, victorious history of Korean-style socialism through devoted service at their honorable and responsible posts and worksites for defending the country and the revolution, always remaining faithful to the Party's call and sharing destiny with it. He said the tremendous might and modernity of the DPRK armed forces are permeated with devoted efforts of the grateful patriots who have unconditionally and invariably supported and upheld the Party's self-reliant army-building line, those of distinguished service whom our Party values as cornerstones and pillars of the country. He stressed that the revolutionary cause of Juche started in Mt Paektu would surely emerge victorious as it is safeguarded by the revolutionary army, armed with the revolutionary idea of the Party and equipped with the latest powerful weapons associated with efforts and soul of our people, and as it is supported by the large unit of patriots dedicating themselves to reliving the country of its heavy burden. Then, he had a photo session with the participants in the celebrations, expressing his expectation and belief that they would more strikingly display the indomitable revolutionary spirit and working spirit of self-reliance and fortitude, the vitality peculiar to the Korean revolution, and become the standard-bearers and promoters of creation and innovation in the honorable struggle for the comprehensive development of Korean-style socialism as befits the descendants of Paektu who inherited the blood and soul of the anti-Japanese revolutionary forerunners. The participants, expressing their deep gratitude to Kim Jong Un for his repeated warm love and trust, hardened their will to perform greater feats in the sacred cause of bolstering up the strength of the DPRK and further exalting its dignity and bringing earlier the prosperous future of a powerful nation along the road of victorious advance indicated by the great Party Central Committee. Political News Team

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Has Photo Session with Participants in Military Parade
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, had a photo session with the officers and soldiers of the units at all levels that took part in the military parade celebrating the 90th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army (KPRA) on April 27. Present there were Pak Jong Chon, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission of the WPK and secretary of the WPK Central Committee, and Ri Pyong Chol, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretary of the WPK Central Committee. The participants were greatly excited as they came to enjoy the dreamlike moment of happiness again with the boundless pride of having staged the greatest-ever military parade of the Juche-based revolutionary armed forces under the observation of the respected Marshal Kim Jong Un, the symbol of the mightiness of our Party, state and armed forces and the banner of all victories and glory. When Kim Jong Un appeared at the venue, all the participants burst into stormy cheers of "hurrah!" for the peerlessly brilliant commander who has devotedly worked to accomplish the great cause of building a prosperous nation with a strong army while ushering in a heyday of strengthening the national power, the most brilliant one in the nation's history of more than 5 000 years, with his iron will, matchless courage and extraordinary leadership. Kim Jong Un warmly waved back to the enthusiastically cheering participants to extend his militant encouragement to the service personnel who made contributions to celebrating the glorious founding anniversary of the powerful revolutionary Paektusan army with the grand military parade. He highly praised them for fully demonstrating, through the significant and magnificent parade to be specially recorded in the army-building history, the might of the elite revolutionary army which has firmly defended with arms the Party and the revolution, the country and the people for nine decades, and the modernity, heroism and radical development of the armed forces of the Republic and their matchless military and technological superiority, and thus instilling confidence in sure victory and optimism about a rosy future deeper into the people across the country. Saying the traditions of invincibility of our revolutionary armed forces established in the sacred wars for smashing the imperialist tyranny are the sacred lineage to be carried forward and glorified forever by the heroic Korean People's Army, he underlined the need for all the service personnel of the entire army to fully cherish the soul and spirit of the DPRK and bolster up their strength in every way to annihilate the enemy and thus more firmly guarantee the accomplishment of the revolutionary cause of Juche with arms. He had a meaningful photo session with the participants holding aloft their colors associated with victory and glory. When the photo session was over, thunderous cheers of "hurrah!" and loud chants of "Kim Jong Un" and "Kyolsaongwi" (devoted defence) resounded through the sky of April. All the participants hardened their will to fully demonstrate to the world the faith in sure victory and invincible spirit of the revolutionary army of the Party remaining absolutely loyal to its revolutionary idea and leadership and vigorously struggle for the great cause of building a powerful army in the great era of Kim Jong Un. Political News Team

title: Precious Tradition of Powerful Revolutionary Army Started from Anti-Japanese War
body: For People, Mixing Himself with People The people’s army, its call reflects the true feature of our revolutionary army which fights to defend freedom, rights, dignity and happiness of people. Following is the touching instruction of President Kim Il Sung: We felt one truth intensely during the whole anti-Japanese revolution: if an army does not enjoy the support of the people, it can never be strong and win a battle. During the anti-Japanese armed struggle, we invariably maintained that “As fish cannot live without water, so guerrillas cannot live without the people.” One slogan encapsulated in a nutshell, “supporting the army and loving the people”. This means that the people should defend the army and the army should love the people.… Saying that a commander is also a son of the people, the President set practical examples to make anti-Japaneses guerrillas regard people’s trouble as their own and share bitters and sweets with people, giving priority to the interests of people. True to his noble intention, the anti-Japaneses guerrillas always gave priority to the people’s interests in any circumstances and sincerely helped them. When they took a few potatoes without the owners’ permission in an unavoidable case, they left a letter of apology and money, several times more than the prime cost. When they stayed in the village, they used to begin with the work for helping the people. The noble tradition, provided during the anti-Japaneses war, is endlessly carried forward generation after generation. The people’s army! With this call, our revolutionary armed forces will invariably carry on its revolutionary character, a reliable defender and creator of well-being and happiness of the people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Recycling Carried Out in Substantial Way
body: North Hamgyong Province built a new sewage purification plant which can produce organic fertilizers, blocks and others by recycling waste materials. The province is channeling its efforts to recycling to make it pay off in the development of the region and improving people’s living standard. As a part of the work the province established the sewage purification plant in Chongjin City, thus improving environment of the city and laying a foundation for producing different kinds of goods with waste materials. Now the plant is pushing ahead with the work to expand varieties of its output in a planned way while improving the employees’ level of technique and skills as soon as possible. Rodong Sinmun

title: President Kim Il Sung's Birth Anniversary Celebrated in Russia
body: Such events as meeting, seminar, book exhibition and film show were held by political parties, organizations and institutions in Russia to celebrate the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. Present at the events were personages of those units and other people. Screened at the film shows were Korean films and videos showing the proud history of the DPRK which has displayed its might by dint of independence in politics, self-supporting in the economy and self-reliance in defence. The chairperson and members of the Party for Peace and Unity of Russia praised Kim Il Sung as a great model state leader who perfectly personified the character and quality of a great man, saying that thanks to him, the glorious history of socialist Korea, the proud history of the working masses, was created. The chairperson of the Russian Blagobeshensk Association for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism said that the DPRK has made a series of world-startling miracles and innovations and steady development in the face of the heinous obstructions by the imperialists, adding its secret lies in the Juche idea founded by Kim Il Sung and Korean-style socialism embodying it. Expressing deep reverence for Kim Il Sung, the first secretary of the Central Committee of the Lenin Young Communist League of the Russian Federation stressed that the peerlessly great man is always alive in the hearts of not only the Korean people but also the world progressives. Congratulatory messages to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un were adopted at the events held by different units. Meanwhile, a celebration meeting was held by the Communist Party of the Soviet Union. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Meets Commanding Officers of KPA
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), met the commanding officers of the Korean People's Army (KPA), who successfully directed the military parade and other events commemorating the 90th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army (KPRA), at the office building of the WPK Central Committee to encourage them. Present on the occasion were Pak Jong Chon, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission of the WPK and secretary of the WPK Central Committee, and Minister Ri Yong Gil and other leading officials of the Ministry of National Defence and commanders of the services and the corps of the KPA. They were filled with boundless gratitude towards the respected Supreme Commander who bestows all laurels upon his soldiers, although he made the grand military parade of April a striking demonstration of the absolute strength and military technological superiority of the armed forces of our Republic capable of defeating any formidable enemy in the world and a revolutionary event giving redoubled faith in sure victory to all the people in the country. Kim Jong Un warmly shook the hands of the army commanding officers offering a salute of loyalty and highly praised their contributions to celebrating the 90th anniversary of the KPRA, a significant and glorious event in the history of the Korean revolution and the nation, with a magnificent military parade. Noting the first step taken by our revolutionary armed forces with two pistols has led to the dignified advance of the matchless revolutionary army of the Party never to be found in other parts of the world, and the Mauser shot heard in the forests of Antu has been amplified by the deafening firing sound of the Hwasongpho to humble the hostile forces bragging about their military edge, he said that such world-startling brilliant reality is a glorious history of victory of the armed forces of our Republic that will be engraved in golden letters in the history of the country. He said that in the present world, where a force clashes with another fiercely and one can preserve one's dignity, rights and interests only when one gets stronger, the tremendous offensive power, the overwhelming military muscle that no force in the world can provoke, is the lifeline guaranteeing the security of our country and people and the future of posterity. Expressing the Party Central Committee's firm will to surely maintain the absolute superiority of our revolutionary armed forces and constantly develop it to preemptively and thoroughly contain and frustrate all dangerous attempts and threatening moves, including ever-escalating nuclear threats from hostile forces, if necessary, he stressed the need for the commanding officers to boldly open up a new stage of development of the revolutionary armed forces, steadfastly adhering to the army-building orientation and general line of the Party. Then, he had a meaningful photo taken with the commanding officers of the revolutionary armed forces, expressing his expectations and belief that they would put their heart and soul, wisdom and passion entirely into the sacred cause for bolstering up the self-defence capabilities of our great state in every way with confidence in sure victory, not forgetting even a moment their noble duty for the country, the revolution and the people. The commanding officers, who received his special trust and benevolence again, extended the highest glory to the ever-victorious iron-willed commander who ushers in a new period of strengthening the national defence capabilities, developing our revolutionary armed forces that inherited the glorious traditions of the anti-Japanese revolutionary forerunners into the strongest army in the world. All the participants hardened their resolve to strive with redoubled courage to further consolidate the matchless military muscle that no one dares provoke, true to the great Party Central Committee's idea and line on building the revolutionary armed forces, and thus defend the Party and revolution impregnably and steadily display the dignity and might of the DPRK, our powerful country. Political News Team

title: Foreign Diplomats Visit National Gifts Exhibition House
body: Diplomatic envoys of Vietnam, Laos and Cambodia and members of their embassies in DPRK visited the National Gifts Exhibition House on April 28 on the occasion of the 10th anniversary of organization of the ASEAN Committee in the DPRK. They saw the gifts presented by the Korean people and overseas compatriots to President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un who have been boundlessly revered and praised by all people for their immortal contributions to the cause of socialism, the human cause of independence with their outstanding idea and energetic leadership. After the visit, Vietnamese Ambassador Le Ba Vinh, chairman of the ASEAN Committee in the DPRK, made an entry in the visitor's book. On the same day, they enjoyed a performance given by the National Symphony Orchestra at the Moranbong Theatre. Rodong Sinmun

title: 35th National Festival of Science and Technology Begins
body: The 35th National Festival of Science and Technology has begun in the DPRK under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea. The festival on the theme of "Precedence to Science and Technology and Innovation" aims at widely introducing and sharing the sci-tech achievements made by Korean scientists and technicians in their efforts to carry out the decisions of the Eighth Party Congress true to the Party's idea of prioritizing science and technology so as to powerfully propel the comprehensive development of socialist construction. Officials and working people from more than 100 units including ministries, national institutions, sci-tech and educational sectors are taking part in the festival, divided into 30-odd panels such as metal, chemical, electric power and coal industry, construction, agriculture, light industry, IT, nano-technology and biotechnology. Presented to it are 1 250 sci-tech achievements conducive to realizing the home-production of raw and other materials and recycling, developing the country's economy and improving the people's living standards. The festival is held in the form of video-conferencing and virtual exhibition. It will go on until May 20. Rodong Sinmun

title: Art Performance Celebrating 90th Birthday of KPRA Goes on in DPRK
body: The service personnel participating in the celebrations and military parade marking the 90th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army enjoyed an art performance given by the State Merited Chorus and the Ensemble of the Ministry of National Defence. Put on the stage were numbers reflecting the proud 90-year-long history and traditions of the Korean revolutionary armed forces remaining absolutely faithful to the Party and the leader and winning great victories. Serial songs of guerrilla army depicting the boundless loyalty and indomitable fighting spirit of the first generation of the revolution, who thought and acted as taught by the leader with their hearts burning with a single mind to keep the revolutionary faith to the death, moved the audience. The military songs that loudly resounded in the decades of the revolution when victories were gained following the great Party with the flag of the Workers' Party of Korea flying as the first colors, were played to rev up the atmosphere. The numbers demonstrating the epochal development made by the revolutionary armed forces in the new century of Juche when miracles and changes are witnessed under the guidance of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un and the spiritual and moral traits of the army that is politically, ideologically and morally strong, touched the audience. The performance reached its climax with a song full of militant passion of the service personnel who are ready to annihilate the enemy with the weapons of Juche symbolic of the country's tremendous strength and dignity at a strike and let off fireworks of victory once the Party Central Committee gives the order. It was enthusiastically applauded by the audience as it multiplied conviction that the cause of the great Party, the great country and the great people will be ever-victorious as the revolutionary armed forces are at the forefront of defending the country and safeguarding the revolution. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK-China Int'l Trade Fair Opens
body: A DPRK-China international trade fair for 2022 opened. The fair, to be held from April 28 to June 28, will showcase information on the commodities in agricultural, light industrial, building materials, fishery, medical and other sectors, turned out by companies of the DPRK and China, on a website established on the trade information database network and the state information communication network. During the fair, dialogue, exchange and negotiations regarding the purchase and export of products will take place via video conferencing. Rodong Sinmun

title: WPK Central Committee's Congratulatory Message to Venezuelan Party Leader
body: The Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) on April 27 sent a congratulatory message to Nicolas Maduro Moros upon his reelection as chairman of the United Socialist Party of Venezuela at the 2nd plenary meeting of its 5th term. Extending firm support and solidarity to the United Socialist Party of Venezuela in the struggle for defending the country's sovereignty and dignity and building a new independent and prosperous society, the message wished the chairman bigger success in his responsible work. Rodong Sinmun

title: Legendary Tales of Great Love
body: A Year and 10 000 Flats A year passed since there was a blasting, signaling the ground-breaking for building 10 000 flats in Songhwa Street. It was not because everything is abundant. Thanks to the ardent sincerity of the Workers’ Party of Korea considering that the misfortunes and troubles of the people should be surely healed and its noble intention that things desired and anticipated by the people must be done without fail in any situation, the grand blueprints of dwelling construction, which was inconceivable to others, could be unfolded even under the difficult conditions, and thus the distinctive grand architectural group, monument for great love for the people was built within a year. It can never be forgotten. The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un devoted his great efforts to completing Songhwa Street, carefully worrying about such issues as huge plans and drafts, organization of building force and building operation, material transport and life of builders. The people will never forget the smiling image of the respected General Secretary who personally came to Songhwa Street built in the eastern gateway to Pyongyang on April 11 to cut inaugural tape, and warmly waved back to the cheering crowds for a long time, sincerely wishing our people a happy and highly civilized life in their modern dwellings. A year and 10 000 flats. It never means the speed of construction and the number of houses. Encapsulated in Songhwa Street was world of noble love for the people shown by the respected General Secretary who turns the impossibility into possibility. Height of Civilization and Happiness When Ryomyong Street was built, the people were greatly impressed at seeing the 70-storeyed apartment, saying that it was the highest one in the country. By the way, the 80-storeyed apartment was built in Songhwa Street after five years. There is an unforgettable story. Proposing to build an 80-storyed apartment in Songhwa Street higher than the 70-storeyed apartment in Ryomyong Street, the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un saw to it that the bold plan was mapped out to build an apartment 20 floors higher than the 60-storyed one planned as symbolic building on the basis of surveying the geological state. The respected General Secretary stressed several times that relevant units should supply necessary materials to building 10 000 flats in Pyongyang in a responsible manner and took due measures, saying that he would send structural steel needed for the construction of 80-storyed apartment. Thus, the 80-storeyed apartment was built. The skyscraper is another monument built by the love of the respected General Secretary intending to put our people on the meridian of civilization and happiness. Masters of Luxurious Home Nobody imagined that the luxurious residential district would appear in the Pothong riverside area, where the residence of President Kim Il Sung had been situated, and ordinary people would become master of the district. Though he was very busy with state affairs, the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un came to the spot and gave an instruction to build a distinctive terraced residential district for working people including labor innovators in various fields, persons of distinguished services, scientists, educators and writers who devote themselves to the Party and the state. He worked heart and soul for the construction, while examining a lot of designs and miniatures and solved every problem arising in the construction. Visiting the residential district ahead of its completion, he looked round interior of dwellings of various styles for hours and expressed his satisfaction noting that the interiors of the houses were well arranged in keeping with the inhabitants’ convenience to live. Like this, the ordinary working people became master of luxurious residential district under the deep care of great father. In our country the leader devotes efforts to the people and the people lead a civilized life as master of luxurious residential district provided by the leader’s love. This reality can be seen only in our motherland. Rodong Sinmun

title: To Put Big Efforts into Land Management
body: Officials and working people of South Hamgyong Province push ahead with land management to implement the decision of the Fourth Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea. The officials of Jongphyong County vigorously accelerate the construction for remodeling bridges and installing culverts in several places while summoning up enthusiasm of the masses. Those of Kowon County improve conditions of the road. They step up the work while regularly reviewing the progress of the construction. They also pay deep attention to providing the equipment and means necessary for carrying out tasks such as rock breaking and paving the road with gravel. Those of Sinhung County and Yonggwang County push ahead with the construction for repairing embankments, while conducting the work for dredging of rivers by ensuring full operation of vehicles and introducing advanced working methods. Those of Sinpho and Riwon Counties map out the plan for river improvement in a far-sighted way and rouse the masses to get results. They give detailed assignments by units and actively promote the river improvement by increasing the use of heavy machines while constructing in a qualitative way. Those of the province learn the overall work of land management in detail and widely introduce and generalize the successes and experience of the advanced units on several occasions, including video conferences. They also take thorough measures to overcome the deflections. They work out innovative and long-term plans for making substantial progress in land management and concentrate efforts and means on its realization. Rodong Sinmun

title: Seminars Held Abroad
body: Seminars on works of President Kim Il Sung, Chairman Kim Jong Il and the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un and on the achievements of the President were held in Nepal, Mongolia, Syria, Sri Lanka, Indonesia, Pakistan, Guinea, Uganda, Germany, Romania, Bulgaria, Switzerland, Italy, Spain, the Czech Republic, France and Brazil on the occasion of the Day of the Sun, the birth anniversary of Kim Il Sung. The seminars, attended by personages of political and social circles and other people in those countries, were overflowing with profound reverence for Kim Il Sung who made immortal contributions to the cause of human independence with his great idea and theory and excellent leadership. Congratulatory messages to Kim Jong Un were adopted and statements praising Kim Il Sung's exploits and supporting the Korean people's cause of justice were released at the seminars in Nepal, Mongolia and the Czech Republic. Meanwhile, a seminar on Kim Jong Un's work "The Great Comrade Kim Il Sung Is the Eternal Leader of Our Party and Our People", celebration meetings and film shows were held by the Dandong Branch of the Kim Il Sung-Kim Jong Il Foundation in China, the China World Peace Foundation and other units. Rodong Sinmun

title: Work to Set up Ultra-Modern Goods Production Bases Brisk in DPRK
body: Kim Chaek University of Technology in the DPRK is stepping up the work to set up ultra-modern goods production bases conducive to the integration of education, scientific research and production. With more than ten ultra-modern goods production bases already in possession, the university has set a goal to build more than one ultra-modern goods production base at each faculty and research institute for development and production of new goods this year. A research group of the Nonferrous Metal Institute at the Metal Engineering Faculty laid a technical foundation for putting rare earth permanent magnet production for wind power generator on a Juche basis amid a hard push for building its production base. The Nano Physical Engineering Institute developed an ozone generator based on Nano complex material and is now engaged in solving the practical problems for its expanded introduction to various fields. Several faculties and institutes including the Machine Science Technology Faculty, the Applied Chemical Engineering Faculty and the Mirae Industrial Technology Institute are actively engaged in the creation of the production bases. The university is giving a momentum to stepping up the development and production of ultra-modern technical goods in line with the characteristics of different faculties and institutes. Rodong Sinmun

title: Seminar Held in DPRK
body: A seminar was held at the Central Youth Hall in the DPRK on Friday to mark the first anniversary of the letter "Demonstrate to the Full the Might of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League on the Historic March towards a Fresh Victory in the Revolution" sent by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un to the 10th Congress of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League (SPYL). Published at the seminar were papers giving the profound explanation of the validity and vitality of the idea and theory set forth in the historic letter. Speakers said that the programmatic letter of Kim Jong Un is the immortal militant banner to be firmly adhered to by the SPYL. They referred to the fact that his work clearly indicates the character and task of the youth movement at the present stage of the revolution and the principled matters for fully demonstrating the might of the SPYL in the historic advance towards a new victory of the revolution. They stressed that to train the young people into the honorable builders of socialism in the practical struggle for carrying out the decisions of the 8th Party Congress is an important demand for upholding our Party's plan on socialist construction in the van. They expressed their determination to prepare all the young people as the models of the era, youth heroes fully displaying the spirit and mettle of the patriotic youth in the present grand advance, regarding the programmatic letter of Kim Jong Un as the militant banner. Attending the seminar were Ri Tu Song, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials of the youth league, officials concerned, teachers and students of Kumsong University of Politics, journalists and editors in the field of education for youth and children and youth and students in Pyongyang City. Rodong Sinmun

title: Mangyongdae Prize Sports Games Close
body: The Mangyongdae Prize Sports Games for celebrating the Day of the Sun closed with due ceremony at the Basketball Gymnasium in Chongchun Street of Pyongyang on Friday. Good results were recorded in the games, in which competitions were made in more than 470 categories of 27 events including football, basketball, volleyball and weightlifting. Men and women players of the April 25, Amnokgang, Pyongyang, Kigwancha, Taesongsan and Chongchongang sports teams, the Chollima Steel Complex Sports Team, the Defence Sports Team of the Ministry of National Defence and the Amnokgang Defence Sports Team set new national records, breaking the Asian and world records in such events as weightlifting, shooting, swimming and short track speed skating. Men players of the Ryomyong Sports Team and women players of the April 25 Sports Team took the first place in the football event, and men and women players of the April 25 Sports Team in the basketball event. Present at the closing ceremony were Kim Song Ryong, vice-premier of the Cabinet, Ri Tu Song, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and vice-chairman of the National Sports Guidance Committee, officials concerned and sportspersons. New Record Medal was awarded to those players who set new national records, and trophy cups and medals to teams and players who proved successful in the events. Rodong Sinmun

title: Drought Anticipated in Some Areas of DPRK
