body: According to information from the State Hydro-meteorological Administration, the April temperature of this year was 2.3 degrees Celsius higher than the average one in the whole country and the precipitation was 44 percent of the average. In particular, some areas of North and South Hwanghae and South Hamgyong provinces had very little rain. Mostly hot and dry weather is forecast in early and late May owing to the migratory anticyclone and the weather will vary relatively in mid-May owing to an alternation of the migratory anticyclone and the low pressure trough. The nationwide forecast precipitation till early May is about 4 to 8 mm and the temperature 0.5 to 0.8 degrees higher than the average. And middle southern areas in the west coast with South and North Hwanghae provinces as the main will have little rainfall, witnessing drought. Rodong Sinmun

title: Anniversary of Meeting between Leaders of DPRK and Laos Marked
body: Lao media dedicated special write-ups to the 30th anniversary of the meeting between President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and Kaysone Phomvihane, former chairman of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party and president of Laos, during his visit to the DPRK. The Lao newspaper Pasason recalled in an article titled "Meaningful Meeting between Leaders of DPRK and Laos" that the President and the Chairman met Kaysone Phomvihane in April 1992. The article said that the Laos-DPRK friendship has steadily developed thanks to the will of the leaders of the two parties and two countries despite the lapse of time and the complicated international situations. The Korean people sincerely congratulate the Lao party and people on their successes in the work for carrying out the decisions of the 11th Party Congress in the face of challenges and ordeals, the article pointed out. Expressing the Lao people's will to dynamically step up socialist construction, a shared goal, together with the Korean people, the article stressed that the relations of friendship, unity and cooperation between Laos and the DPRK will be immortal. Other newspapers Pathet Lao and Vientiane Times and the news agency of Laos, too, carried similar articles. Rodong Sinmun

title: Joint Seminar Held in Russia
body: A joint seminar of Russian political parties and social organizations on the theme of "Building a bridge of friendship together" took place on April 25 to mark the 3rd anniversary of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's historic visit to the Russian Federation. Present there were personages from the State Duma, the Foreign Ministry, the Communist Party of the Russian Federation, the Liberal Democratic Party of Russia and the Russian Association for Friendship and Cultural Cooperation with the DPRK. Invited to it were the DPRK ambassador to Russia and members of his embassy. A report, congratulatory address and speeches were made at the seminar. The vice-chairperson of the Central Council of the Communist Parties-the Communist Party of the Soviet Union who is a member of the C.C., Communist Party of the Russian Federation said in the report that during his visit to Russia in April 2019, the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un expressed his willingness to usher in a new golden age of the DPRK-Russia relations at the meeting with President Putin. His Russia visit left a glorious chapter in the history of the two countries and placed another footstone for the bridge of decades-long friendship, the reporter added. He praised Kim Jong Un for successfully carrying forward the external policy of Chairman Kim Jong Il. Saying that the atmosphere of opposing sanctions against independent countries is growing stronger with each passing day, thanks to the DPRK's efforts and struggle for world peace, the reporter stressed that Russia and the DPRK can defend their vital and long-term interests only when they jointly fight against the hegemonic policy of the West. Hoping that the DPRK would prosper as a great country, the reporter said that the development of the Russia-DPRK friendly relations is a reliable guarantee for stability in the Asia-Pacific region. A statement was published at the seminar. It noted that the participants in the seminar emphasized the great significance of Kim Jong Un's visit to Russia in the development of the traditional friendly relations between the two countries. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Has Photo Session with Students and Working Youths
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Sunday had a photo session with the students and working youths in Pyongyang City who contributed to the successful military parade celebrating the 90th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army (KPRA). Attending the session were Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the WPK Central Committee, and Kim Yong Hwan, chief secretary of the Pyongyang City Committee of the WPK. The youths and students were filled with great excitement and joy over the fact that they were to have a significant photo taken with the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un after attending the greatest-ever political and military festival which fully demonstrated the dignity of our country and the might of its great single-minded unity. When Kim Jong Un arrived at the photo session venue, all the participants broke into stormy cheers of "hurrah!" for him who has vigorously guided Korean-style socialism only to victory and glory, always valuing the youth and regarding the youth issue as the top priority state affair to train the young people to be a huge unit of successors. He warmly waved back to the enthusiastically cheering youths and students, highly appreciating their contribution to glorifying the 90th anniversary of the KPRA as an unprecedented, grand festival of single-minded unity and as a showcase theatre of the national power. Noting that the spirit of our youths is very high, he said the rosy future of our style socialism is for the youths and it is the sacred patriotic cause that should be hastened by their efforts. Our youths have regarded the loyalty to the Party and revolution as their high honor and pride and spent their youthful days with ardent patriotism and high enthusiasm for the revolution and struggle, he said, adding it is the proud traits peculiar to the Korean youths that can neither be seen nor be imitated in any society of the world. And he extended thanks to them who rendered excellent service to the successful military parade, the largest-ever in history, with their good teamwork and artistry, strikingly displaying the sense of organization and solidarity of our society. Expressing his deep trust and expectation that our youths and students will become dependable pillars playing a leading role in the struggle for the country's prosperity by getting intent on the studies with the same high ardor and revolutionary mettle as were displayed by them in the celebration event, he had a meaningful photo session with them. When the photo session was over, loud chants of "Kim Jong Un" and "Kyolsaongwi" (devoted defence) shouted by the young vanguard of the WPK resounded throughout the sky of the capital city of Pyongyang. Encouraged by such warm love and trust of the great father, the students and working youths made their burning pledge to more vigorously advance toward the rosy future of socialism and communism, displaying to the full the strength based on loyalty of all sons and daughters in this country and the honor of being the youths of a powerful country who firmly believe in and follow only the WPK. Political News Team

title: University Students' Programming Contests Held in DPRK
body: There took place a national programming skill contest and machine designing contest of university students in the DPRK. The contests, which are held every year, are aimed to constantly increase university students' programming and designing skills and their creativity and thus prepare them to be practical talents possessed of intelligence outpacing the world. The Education Commission conducted scrupulous organizational and political work to make all contests serve as important occasions for furthering the campaign, in which one overtakes and learns from others and swaps experience with them, among universities and students, and for heightening the students' zeal for study and raising their abilities. Students from Kim Il Sung University, Kim Chaek University of Technology and University of Sciences proved successful in the contests by displaying their high abilities. Hamhung University of Chemical Engineering and Jo Kun Sil Wonsan University of Technology obtained high results in the programming contest. Students from Hamhung University of Hydraulic Engineering, Chongjin University of Mining and Metallurgy, Phyongsong University of Veterinary Science and Animal Husbandry and Kim Hyong Jik University of Education were highly appreciated as they showed their high programming skills. In the machine designing contest Pyongyang Han Tok Su University of Light Industry, Huichon University of Technology and Kusong University of Industrial Technology took the first place. Rodong Sinmun

title: Russian Personages Visit DPRK Missions in Russia
body: Personages of various circles in Russia paid congratulatory visits to the DPRK missions in Russia between April 19 and 23 on the occasion of the third anniversary of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's historic visit to the Russian Federation. They laid floral baskets and bouquets before the art work depicting President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il standing together and made bows to them. The visitors included personages from political parties, government, organizations and institutions, including the Khabarovsk Territorial Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation, the Communist Party "Russian Communists", the Vladivostok City Assembly and the Russian Association for Friendship and Cultural Cooperation with the DPRK. Rodong Sinmun

title: Exhibition of Technological Innovation Achievements Closes
body: The national exhibition of technological innovation achievements by workers and trade union members was closed. It was opened across the country on the occasion of the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung. The exhibition, sponsored by the Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea (GFTUK), held from April 11 to 30, showcased more than 280 valuable technical innovation successes and products made in the course of realizing domestic production of raw and other materials and promoting recycling. Products presented by the Cabinet of the DPRK and GFTUK committees in Pyongyang, South Hwanghae Province and Rason City attracted the attention of visitors for their tangible contributions to economic development and improvement of the people's standard of living. Technical innovations such as an active electrical boiler presented by the GFTUK committee of North Hwanghae Province and a capability evaluation system made by a worker of the Yanggakdo International Hotel were highly appreciated. Rodong Sinmun

title: New Youth Open-Air Theater Built in Nampho City
body: A new Youth Open-Air Theater was built in the area of sports village of Waudo District, Nampho City. Installed at the theater is a fountain and large-sized electric signboard and it has an art circle room, dancing circle room, dressing room and so on. It will make a positive contribution to educating working people, youth and schoolchildren of the city and their cultural and emotional life. Under the guidance of the Nampho City Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea the city organized a powerful building force and pushed ahead with its project while giving priority to designing and supply of materials to successfully build the theater. Those of the city designing institute devoted their creative wisdom to its architectural design, true to the idea of the Juche-oriented architecture and policy of construction of the Workers’ Party of Korea. Builders made successive innovation in the construction overcoming all the difficulties encountered and paid big efforts to ensuring quality of structure, while thoroughly observing the demand of construction method. Meanwhile, senior officials of the city acquainted themselves with the problems arising in the construction and solved them, while actively encouraging builders to hasten the project. The Youth Open-Air Theater could be successfully built thanks to the devoted efforts of patriotic officials, Party members and other working people of the city. Rodong Sinmun

title: May Day Marked in DPRK
body: The working people in the DPRK enjoyed May Day, the international holiday of the working people the world over. At the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the sacred temple of Juche where President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il lie in state, the visitors paid deep respects to the portraits of smiling Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il. Officials and working people laid floral baskets, bouquets and flowers at the statues of the President and the Chairman and mosaics picturing their smiling images on Mansu Hill and in other parts of the country before making bows to them. Officials of the Party and power organs across the country enjoyed May Day together with the working people. There took place colorful sports and amusement games at the industrial establishments and co-op farms, including the Pyongyang Trolley Bus Factory, the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex, the February 8 Vinalon Complex, the Jenam Coal Mine and the Unjong Vegetable Cooperative Farm in Kanggye City. A horse-riding game revved up the festive mood in Hamhung City. Colorful performances were given at theatres and outdoor stages in the capital city of Pyongyang to enhance the working people's enthusiasm for the revolution and struggle. The National Folk Art Troupe, the Phibada Opera Troupe and the Central Art Squad for Agitation for Increased Production and others gave performances in different parts of the city, including the Pyongyang Indoor Stadium, Songhwa Street and the Hwasong area where the construction of 10 000 flats is going on. Art performances were also given in North and South Hwanghae and Jagang provinces, Kaesong City and other regions. Rodong Sinmun

title: Party and Government Officials Encourage Working People on May Day
body: Senior party and government officials in the DPRK on Sunday significantly marked May Day together with the working people. Choe Ryong Hae and Kim Tok Hun, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and other leading officials of the Party and the government and officials of Party and power organs at all levels visited the State Academy of Sciences, the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex, the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex, the Kim Jong Thae Electric Locomotive Complex, the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill, the Jangchon Vegetable Cooperative Farm in Sadong District and other units to congratulate the working people on May Day. At different units including industrial establishments and co-op farms, those senior officials placed bouquets at the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and mosaics depicting their images before making a bow to them. They went round the rooms for education in the revolutionary history, the rooms dedicated to the history of relevant units, etc. At the worksites, they congratulated labor innovators and other workers on May Day. And they, together with the working people, watched sports games, including volleyball and table tennis, and performances of itinerant art squads. In the Hwasong area where the construction of 10 000 flats is going on, senior party and government officials worked together with the builders, appealing to them to further glorify the period of great prosperity in the construction of the capital city. They requested all the working people to live and work as true patriots performing fresh miracles and steady innovations in the van of the times, in hearty response to the decisions made at the 8th Party Congress and the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee. Rodong Sinmun

title: Many Labor Heroes Produced in DPRK
body: The people of the DPRK are fully displaying the heroic stamina in the ongoing historic advance for achieving the overall development of socialist construction under the leadership of the great Party. According to data available, more than 800 people have been awarded the title of Labor Hero in the new century of Juche. Among them are officials, servicepersons and workers who contributed to erecting the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il on Mansu Hill and more excellently sprucing up the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun as a sacred temple of Juche. There are also officials and builders who rendered distinguished service in major construction projects. Many labor heroes were produced in different sectors of the national economy. Among them are Party cell secretaries who contributed to enhancing the working efficiency of the Party, officials and creators who produced revolutionary and militant literature and art pieces of high ideological and artistic value, and scientists who contributed to the national economic development and the improvement of the people's living standard. Sportspersons, who proved successful in international games to give the national pride and honor and great confidence and courage to the people, joined the ranks of heroes in the recent ten-year history of the country. Those heroes include women who have distinguished themselves in the work for education of the rising generation, and assisting the army and in the agricultural production. The title of Labor Hero was also conferred on the women who have brought up many children to be the pillars for the prosperous country. Rodong Sinmun

title: More Youths Volunteer to Work at Major Fields of Socialist Construction in DPRK
body: Tens of young people in Ryanggang Province recently volunteered to work at major Fields of socialist construction. Among them are youth league officials in Samsu County. Those volunteers vowed to work at co-op farms and other major economic posts. A meeting was held at the Ryanggang Provincial Art Theatre on April 29 to congratulate the volunteers. Officials and young people of the province gave bouquets to them, warmly sending them off. Rodong Sinmun

title: 9th Sports Contest among Public Health Workers Opens
body: The 9th sports contest among public health workers began with an opening ceremony at the Basketball Gymnasium in Chongchun Street on May 3. The sports contest is to be held at different gymnasiums in Pyongyang City, divided into two groups. The participants in the sports contest will compete in basketball (men), volleyball (men and women), table-tennis, a tug of war and Taekwon-Do matches. Present at the opening ceremony were Thae Hyong Chol, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Ri Song Hak, vice-premier of the Cabinet, officials concerned, officials in the field of public health, players and workers of central hospitals and the Academy of Medical Science. Minister of Public Health Choe Kyong Chol made an opening address. The sports contest will be held till May 12. Rodong Sinmun

title: Campaign for Preventing Damage from Drought Starts in DPRK
body: Officials of the ministries and national institutions turned out as one in the campaign for preventing the damage from drought. According to data available, vehicles like truck and water-supply wagon and equipment and materials including mini-pumps and vinyl sheets were sent in time to the rural areas with vulnerability to drought. The officials dispatched to the farms in South Hwanghae Province make sure the fields damaged by or vulnerable to drought are watered first. Farms in North Hwanghae Province have launched the drought damage prevention campaign in earnest, and those of South Phyongan Province are sufficiently watering fields every day by effectively using water-supply wagons and pumping equipment. The officials of the ministries and national institutions dispatched to Nampho City are mobilizing all water transport means and providing farms with necessary equipment and materials in a responsible manner. Rodong Sinmun

title: Brisk Agitation Activities in Hwasong Area
body: Art troupes and art propaganda squads in Pyongyang briskly conduct frontline economic agitation at dwelling construction site in Hwasong area. Artistes of the Phibada Opera Troupe, National Theatrical Troupe, National Folk Art Troupe and National Acrobatic Troupe incandescent to fulfill their duty as frontline buglers in the present gigantic march are arousing masses’ enthusiasm for revolution and struggle through their powerful agitprops. Those of the Central Art Squad for Agitation for Increased Production are making the construction site seethe like a crucible with colorful and diversified programmes. Members of the art squad of the Central Committee of Socialist Patriotic Youth League actively inspire builders of the grand construction site to perform feats by giving flexible agitation combined with propagandas through loudspeaker-vans. All their agitations pulsating with vigorous breath of the times and strong in appeal and militancy stir the bloods of the builders as the frontline concerts inspired soldiers to victory during the war. In addition, agitations of the art squads of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea (GFTUK), the Socialist Women’s Union of Korea and others encourage the builders to make uninterrupted innovation and progress. Rodong Sinmun

title: Work for Transforming Village Clinics into Hospitals Brisk in DPRK
body: A work has been vigorously conducted in the public health sector of the DPRK to transform the village clinics into hospitals. This year, the Ministry of Public Health, the provincial, city and county people's committees and relevant units have put spurs to transforming the village clinics into hospitals under the detailed plans. In order to improve the medical service for rural inhabitants, officials of the ministry grasped the knotty problems on the spot and pushed ahead with the work to train competent medical workers and provide the provinces with enough medicines, medical equipment and appliances. Officials in each province have conducted the work to lay material and technical foundations for transforming the village clinics into hospitals in touch with relevant units in the field of public health. North and South Phyongan and Jagang provinces are taking the lead in this work. Meanwhile, medical workers of the clinics strive to raise their technical and practical skills. Rodong Sinmun

title: Electric-power Production Increases
body: Officials and working people of the electric-power industry overfulfilled their national economic plan for April by waging a fierce struggle with a high sense of responsibility of defending the lifeline of the national economy. The officials, working people and technicians of hydropower stations in various areas put water management on a scientific basis and made efforts to ensure a high water level running and high efficiency operation so as to increase electric-power production. The officials and working people of Suphung, Hochongang, Jangjingang and Pujongang Power Stations pushed ahead with the production on a regular basis by conducting the regular operation and repairing of hydraulic structures in a responsible manner while taking the rational load dispatch according to quantity of water. Those of different hydropower stations strictly observed the standard operating instructions and technical regulations, thereby increasing an output for each generator. Those of thermal power stations increased power production. The officials and working people of Pukchang Thermal Power Complex carried out daily power generation plan without fail by actively mobilizing latent reserves and potentialities. The officials, working people and technicians of Pyongyang, Sunchon, East Pyongyang, Chongchongang thermal power stations put spurs to electric-power production with applying technological innovations into their work to operate their generation equipment on a normal basis. The officials and working people of the electric-power industry make daily innovations in their production for implementing the national economic plan for May by maintaining the lifted spirit with which they glorified meaningful April with proud labor successes. Rodong Sinmun

title: Brisk Sci-Tech Research in Metallurgical Industrial Sector of DPRK
body: A campaign for enhancing sci-tech force of the metallurgical industry is getting brisk in the DPRK. Scientists of the Ferrous Metal Research Institute of the State Academy of Sciences push ahead in the final stage with the research to improve various technical and economic indices of the UHP electric arc furnace at the Chollima Steel Complex. They also concentrate their efforts on solving the sci-tech problems in establishing a steel production method by using multi-element mineral in the Sudong area. Scientists of the May 28 Metal Research Institute under the Ministry of Metallurgical Industry have intensified their research activities. At the Chongjin Steel Plant, scientists strive to lengthen the life of revolving furnace and increase its operating rate within this year. Through the joint and cooperative work of research groups, they step up the research to settle the problems in Juche iron production by using lignite. Scientists of the Juche iron research group of Kim Chaek University of Technology have deepened the research to confirm an operation way of energy-efficient oxygen heat blast furnace at the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex while concentrating efforts on further increasing the pig iron production by rationally fixing various indices of the existing oxygen heat blast furnace. Those of other units, too, strive to solve the sci-tech problems for further perfecting the Korean-style iron-making method in a technological way and increasing the iron and steel production. Rodong Sinmun

title: Housing Construction Accelerated in Hwasong Area of DPRK
body: Servicepersons involved in the construction of 10 000 flats in the Hwasong area of Pyongyang have finished the frame works for apartment houses one after another. Those soldier-builders displayed their ingenuity to find and introduce reasonable methods for improving the quality and speed of construction, and commanding officers made a breakthrough in the van of difficult and labor-consuming works. They improved the construction specialization by training skilled workers. They have pushed ahead with the frame construction in a three-dimensional way and at a lightning tempo while giving precedence to the supply of such building materials as gravels and sand and keeping the construction equipment in full-capacity operation. The soldier-builders who finished the frame construction put spurs to carrying out their task for the next-stage project. Rodong Sinmun

title: Foreign Political Parties Sign Historic Pyongyang Declaration
body: The Nepal Communist Party (United Socialist), the Palestinian Popular Struggle Front and the Socialist Workers' Party of Egypt signed the historic Pyongyang Declaration "Let Us Defend and Advance the Cause of Socialism". Madav Kumar Nepal, chairman of the Nepal Communist Party (United Socialist), Khalid Abdul Majid, general secretary of the Palestinian Popular Struggle Front, and Ashraf Abdullah Muhammad, chairman of the Socialist Workers' Party of Egypt, signed the declaration on behalf of their parties. Rodong Sinmun

title: News of Fulfilling Plan from Different Parts of Country
body: Factories and enterprises in different fields of the national economy fulfilled the national economic quotas for April. The Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex and Chollima Steel Complex fulfilled their production quotas through bold production drive. Meanwhile, their supply units including Unryul and Jaeryong mines reliably supported the iron and steel production with a high sense of responsibility. The February 8 Vinalon Complex increased the output amount of chemical goods like sodium hydroxide and vinyl chloride. Officials and workers of different units in chemical industry including the Ponghwa Chemical Factory, Sinuiju Chemical Fibre Mill, Wonsan Chemical Factory and Pyongyang Rubber Factory greatly boosted their production and fulfilled the economic quotas for April, fully aware of the importance of their duty for development of economy and improvement of people’s living. Coal miners of the Tokchon Area Coal Mining Complex and Sunchon Area and Pukchang Area youth coal mining complexes massively produce coal by introducing advanced blasting method in accordance with different lithology. Those of the Kaechon, Hamnam, Kujang, Kangdong and Chonnae areas coal mining complexes increased output of coal by prioritizing tunneling while raising the operation ratio of coal cutters and transport facilities. The Taean Heavy Machine Complex, Ryongsong Machine Complex and Ranam Coal-Mining Machine Complex made strenuous efforts to carry out their targets while directing their main efforts to strengthening their own technical forces. Officials, workers and technicians of the Anju Pump Factory and Anju Insulating Material Factory strived hard to increase production. In addition, many other units such as the Pyongyang General Electric Cable Factory 326 and Ryangchaek Bearing Factory fulfilled their monthly production quotas through collective innovation. Silk mills across the country such as the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Silk Mill and Kangso Silk Mill consolidated their own material and technical foundations while unfolding vigorous socialist emulation to raise quality of goods and increase production. Units in knitting industry and footwear industry and other factories like the Hamhung Disabled Soldiers’ Essential Plastic Goods Factory and Sinuiju Cosmetics Factory achieved successes in their production. Rodong Sinmun

title: All Efforts Concentrated on Securing Irrigation Water
body: The cooperative farms of North Phyongan Province have taken proper measures to prevent the crops from drought damage. Officials and working people of the province cleaned out thousands of kilometers of waterways, repaired a thousand and hundreds of pumping equipment in time and newly established and repaired more than 180 irrigation structures and groundwater tapping facilities, true to the intention of the Workers’ Party of Korea to lay the foundation for agricultural production free from crop failure by perfecting the irrigation system of the rural economy. The Rural Economy Committee of North Phyongan Province called on officials in the irrigation field of cities and counties to enhance their sense of responsibility and roles, while meticulously organizing the control and command to carry out the assigned tasks without fail. Officials of Thaechon County rationally arranged the manpower and means and completed the cleaning out of waterways covering hundreds of kilometers in quality by encouraging the mental spirit of masses with stirring agitprop activities, and have pushed ahead with the work for securing water. Farmers in such farms as the Sema Co-op Farm in Jongju City conducted the irrigation project including the project for extending waterway, thus supplying water needed for tending rice seedbed and so on. Ryongchon County consolidated the material and technical foundation of its irrigation control office to complete the repair and maintenance of pumping equipment and Kujang County has produced the efficient small water pumps by tapping and enlisting the latent reserves to send them to cooperative farms. On the basis of mapping out in detail the plans for the river improvement and waterway arrangement, officials of Unsan, Taegwan and Chonma counties improved the water passing capacity by conducting the projects for digging riverbed and building dike with stones. Meanwhile, the Paekma-Cholsan Waterway Management Station, Amnokgang Area Irrigation Management Station and others have repaired the structures including water intake tower in quality and actively launched the works for filling the reservoirs and auxiliary source of water supply. Rodong Sinmun

title: General Mobilization for Land Administration Brisk in DPRK
body: The general mobilization for land administration is brisk in the DPRK true to the Party's policy on land management. Officials and working people across the country improved the roads extending more than 200 km, dredged more than 8.3 million cubic meters of earth from river-beds and reinforced over 680 000 square meters of river banks with stones in April, thus giving a facelift to the country. Those in Pyongyang City planted trees of good species in streets and neighborhoods, created more greenery and repaired dwelling houses and remodeled parks and pleasure grounds. Those in South Phyongan Province embanked areas of over 80 000 square meters to protect tens of hectares of paddy fields from flood damage and set up more than 2 000 safety stakes to improve the roads. Those in several other provinces, too, conducted such work in a qualitative way. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Premier Inspects Several Sectors in North and South Hamgyong Provinces
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and premier of the Cabinet, made a field survey of several sectors of the national economy in North and South Hamgyong provinces. Making rounds of a large metallurgical base, a greenhouse farm and others in North Hamgyong Province, the premier inspired officials and working people implementing the decisions of the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the WPK and learnt about the problems to be solved in those units. At the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex he called for further perfecting the Korean-style iron manufacturing method and pushing ahead with the construction of an energy-efficient oxygen heat blast furnace to provide a firm foundation for production growth and increase production efficiency and thus fulfilling monthly and quarterly plans without fail. At the Jungphyong Vegetable Greenhouse Farm he stressed the need for its officials and working people to widely introduce high-yielding seeds, steadily put the production onto a high scientific level and thus make the people keenly realize in their real life the love of the mother Party that built the modern large-scale vegetable greenhouse farm. He called on the officials to push ahead with the construction of the Yombunjin seaside park area in a stepwise and planned way in the spirit of unconditionally implementing the Party's decisions. He paid attention to the work for updating farming machines supervised by the Orang County Commission of Science and Technology. He also learned about the work of several units in South Hamgyong Province. At the Tanchon Magnesia Factory and the Tanchon Smeltery he stressed the need to provide the firm material and technical foundations for keeping production going at a high rate, and called on the building units in charge of the construction of the Tanchon Power Station to ensure quality of the structures on a high level and conduct the project as scheduled. Learning about the prevention of flood damage in the Komdok area, he stressed the need to finish the construction of drain pits, dredging of river-beds, the land-sliding prevention project, etc. by the appointed time on the basis of a scientific calculation of the water flowing and volume in rainy season. The field consultative meetings took measures after discussing the issue of guiding every work in a scientific way, the issue of scrupulously organizing and commanding the projects and taking measures to supply equipment and materials in time in close cooperation with relevant sectors and units and the issue of putting the management control on a high scientific level. Rodong Sinmun

title: President Kim Il Sung's Visit to Koryo Museum Marked
body: There took place a meeting on May 6 to commemorate the 30th anniversary of President Kim Il Sung's visit to the Koryo Museum. The President visited the museum in which the building of Songgyungwan of the Koryo located on May 5, Juche 81 (1992) and indicated the problems arising in preserving and managing the national heritage. That day he said that it is necessary to preserve and manage Songgyungwan in its origin as it is a historical site of national value. His visit to the museum became an important opportunity of giving wide publicity to the prolonged history and excellent cultural heritage of the Korean nation. Chairman Kim Jong Il bestowed great love and trust on officials and employees of the museum, paying attention to the preservation of the national heritage. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un has made sure that the Party's policy on preservation of the national heritage is thoroughly implemented. The officials and employees of the museum have made a lot of achievements to add shine to the exploits of the peerless great men over the past three decades. Attending the meeting were Jang Myong Gi, secretary of the Kaesong City Party Committee, and officials and employees of the museum. Paek Sol, curator of the Koryo Museum, made a report. Rodong Sinmun

title: Unforgettable Story about His Devotion to People
body: First-aid Room and Watching Stand Newly Arranged In July Juche 101(2012) the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited the Rungna People’s Pleasure Park just before the start of operation. After exchanging warm greetings with officials he was briefed on the park before a map showing its panoramic view. Then he headed towards the wading pool. Looking round the wading pool he was so pleased to provide people with another cultural pleasure center and kept smiling all along. While going round the wading pool delightedly, he said in a prudent tone that accidents may happen at the water slide and diving tower so watchers should constantly keep their eyes on people beside the diving tower with 5 or more floats and there must be a first-aid room with a red cross on a white background in the wading pool. Then he repeatedly underscored the need to fully equip the first-aid room with necessary facilities. The officials were moved to see the respected General Secretary who paid meticulous attention lest the people should be hurt even a little although he provided them with a rare wading pool. Thus a first-aid room and watching stand appeared in the wading pool. Construction Site He Visited in Cold Rain In July Juche 102(2013) the respected General Secretary inspected the construction site of the Children’s Hospital in Munsu area. The weather was extraordinarily bad for a rainy season. Heavy rain fell from the morning and wind blew. However, he visited the hospital under construction which was just framed because he felt uneasy about an issue. At that time, officials who considered the situation of the country planned to secure ultramodern medical appliances for the hospital in two stages and to make some cases be diagnosed at the Breast Tumour Institute of the Pyongyang Maternity Hospital and be treated at the Children’s Hospital. After taking stock of the situation he instructed to equip the hospital with every facility at any cost as befits the comprehensive treatment center for children and added that there was nothing to spare for children. And he said that he would provide the ultramodern medical facilities for the children’s hospital in person. Thus the Okryu Children’s Hospital was built up with modern medical facilities thanks to the warm love and devoted efforts of the respected General Secretary. Rodong Sinmun

title: Task of Waterway Tunneling Completed
body: Feats are performed at the construction site of Hwangjugindung Waterway. Shock force members of the Hamhung City Battalion of the South Hamgyong Provincial Brigade of the Waterway Construction Division fulfilled their construction assignments ahead of schedule. Its officials and shock force members engaged themselves in the fierce campaign from the beginning under an ambitious goal of completing the waterway tunnel construction ahead of schedule. The officials roused the shock force members while taking active measures for powerfully promoting the waterway tunneling. Taking account of the fact that more than half of the members of the battalion were newcomers, they made sure that the members were taught building experiences and technologies, thus helping them play a big part in the waterway tunneling. Therefore, the battalion finished tunneling in a short period and began expanding and coating the waterway tunnel. The officials and shock force members were further encouraged by the important tasks set forth at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea. The shock force members strictly observed the demands of construction methods in order to build the waterway tunnel to remain flawless even in the distant future. Their fighting stamina is infusing all of the other waterway builders with fresh strength and courage. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Message of Sympathy to Cuban President
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Saturday sent a message of sympathy to Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez, first secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba and president of the Republic of Cuba. In the message, Kim Jong Un expressed deep sympathy to the first secretary and the Cuban party, government and people as well as to the victims and bereaved families, upon the sad news that an unexpected gas explosion at a hotel in Havana claimed big human losses. He sincerely hoped that the fraternal Cuban people would smash the hostile forces' move for building up sinister opinion over the accident and remove the aftereffect of the damage as soon as possible under the guidance of the Communist Party of Cuba led by the first secretary and that the bereaved families would lead a stabilized life, overcoming sorrow. Rodong Sinmun

title: Earnest Request of Love for People
body: On March 21, Juche 103(2014), the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited the Ryugyong Dental Hospital. Not only doctors and nurses but also people who visited the hospital for medical treatment were filled with great excitement of seeing the respected General Secretary all of a sudden. That day he urged accompanying officials to present knotty problems in the operation of hospital noting that the Party would solve all of them. Carrying the unanimous mind of the officials and employees of the hospital, an official expressed gratitude to the respected General Secretary. Then he earnestly requested that they should sincerely treat patients. When he dropped in a treatment room, a grandmother made a deep bow to him. After helping the grandmother to her feet, the respected General Secretary repeatedly requested the doctors to treat her well. When he left the hospital, he earnestly asked again them to do their jobs well in good health. Indeed, his earnest request that day was the meaningful instruction which could be given by only the respected General Secretary who always thinks about health and happiness of our people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Whole Country Mobilized in Campaign for Prevention of Drought Damage
body: All manpower and means are concentrated on a campaign for protecting crops from drought damage in the DPRK. Officials and working people of the ministries and national institutions, provinces, cities and counties have turned out to protect crops out of the mind to attain the grain production goal set forth by the Workers’ Party of Korea this year. At the farms in South and North Hwanghae provinces, officials of the Ministry of Mining Industry, the Ministry of Metallurgical Industry and the Taesongsan Management Guidance Bureau put all efforts into watering fields vulnerable to drought damage by mobilizing all vehicles, equipment and materials. The Agricultural Commission and agricultural guidance organs at all levels grasped wheat, barley and maize fields and rice-seedling beds vulnerable to drought damage before mobilizing all manpower and means for transporting water and pumping equipment. At the same time, they are positively introducing watering methods suited to regions to protect paddy and non-paddy fields from drought damage. They are also sprinkling on a regular basis various kinds of growth stimulants and bio-activators on wheat and barley fields, thus improving their nutritive conditions. The farms in South Hwanghae, South Phyongan and North Hwanghae provinces are making achievements in the campaign for preventing drought damage. Officials and agricultural workers of North Phyongan Province and Nampho City, too, have watered many paddy and non-paddy fields every day by raising the operating rate of pumping and power equipment and properly setting up the water supply system. Rodong Sinmun

title: Farming Process Accelerated As Scheduled
body: According to data available, officials and agricultural workers of the farming field have pushed ahead with tilling the paddy fields at 97 percent, while accelerating the farming process as scheduled by steadily achieving the success in preparations for supplying irrigation water and in growing of young rice-plants. In particular, South Hwanghae Province, the major granary of the country, has taken the lead in the farming preparations. Through the analysis of lessons from last year’s farming process, the province has let officials and agricultural workers in its city and counties observe the sci-tech demands arising in growing of young rice-plants, harrowing dry fields and tilling paddy fields through the analysis of lessons from last year’s farming process. Anak, Paechon and other counties have paid special efforts to controlling the temperature of rice seedbeds. On the basis of making a careful plan, North Phyongan Province has put spurs to rice-planting preparations. South Phyongan Province has directed big efforts to growing strong rice-sprouts and hastened the tilling the paddy field at final stage and the preparations for rice-transplantation has been brisk in North Hwanghae Province. Officials and agricultural workers of South and North Hamgyong and Kangwon provinces have conducted the tilling the paddy fields and harrowing dry fields simultaneously and carried out the farming process according to the timetable. Similar successes have been witnessed in other areas. Rodong Sinmun

title: More Youth Volunteer to Work at Major Sectors of National Economy
body: More than 180 young people in North Hwanghae Province volunteered to work at the major sectors of the national economy including metallurgical and coal industries. Young people in Songrim City and Sungho County volunteered to work at the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex and many graduates of Hwangju Middle School for Orphans to the major industrial establishments of the province. Young people in Sariwon City and Sangwon County also volunteered to work at the Komdok Mining Complex, the Tukjang Area Coal Mining Complex and others and those in Singye, Jangphung, Yonsan and other counties to work at cooperative farms. A meeting for congratulating the volunteers took place at the Art Theatre of North Hwanghae Province on May 3. Officials and young people in the province warmly sent them off, presenting bouquets to them. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Greetings to Russian President
body: Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a message of greeting to Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation, on May 9. The message extended the warmest congratulations and greetings to the president, friendly government and people of Russia on behalf of the government and people of the DPRK on the occasion of the anniversary of the victory in the Great Patriotic War in Russia. It said that the Russian people won a great victory in the great war of justice to destroy fascism that threatened the destiny of mankind by displaying matchless heroism and self-sacrificing spirit. The feats and achievements of the Russian people are clearly remembered by the world people who love justice and peace and will go down forever, it pointed out. It extended firm solidarity to the cause of the Russian people to root out the political and military threat and blackmail by the hostile forces and safeguard the country's dignity, peace and security by inheriting the immortal tradition of victory. It expressed belief that the strategic and traditional relations of friendship between the two countries would steadily develop in conformity with the requirements of the times and the basic interests of the two peoples. Rodong Sinmun

title: Myongthae Fry Released in DPRK
body: The Komalsan Offshore Atlantic Salmon Farm in the DPRK released 400 000 Myongthae (Alaska Pollack) fry into the sea off the farm this year. Officials and employees of the farm pooled creative wisdom with scientists and researchers to solve the technical issues arising in artificial cultivation and breeding of Myongthae fry. Sufficiently securing breeding Myongthae, they increased the artificial collection of spawn much more than last year by properly managing the nourishment of parent fish and providing good lighting and temperature. The farm increased the spawn-hatching rate by firmly establishing a material and technical foundation of the culture ground as artificial spawn collection and fertilization are stepped up as scheduled. It increased the survival rate of the fry by providing conditions favorable to their growth such as the water temperature and oxygen supply while directing efforts to the production of protein-rich assorted feed. Officials and employees of the farm set up stepwise and yearly schedules to release more fry of various species and are carrying them out. Rodong Sinmun

title: Emergency Epidemic Prevention Work in Full Swing in DPRK
body: Amid the daily-growing concern of the international community about new COVID-19 variants, the epidemic crisis is getting more serious with increased number of infections and the death toll in neighboring countries and regions. Officials of ministries, national institutions and industrial establishments in the DPRK have focused their all efforts on further intensifying the epidemic prevention campaign, fully aware that they are wholly responsible for the emergency epidemic prevention work at their units. Notifying all their officials and employees of instructions and assignments from the central emergency epidemic prevention field, ministries and national institutions have thoroughly carried out the work for implementing them while strictly reviewing the work and taking measures to prevent even the slightest gap or vulnerable point in epidemic prevention. They organize reading sessions and video shows on publicity material, common hygienic knowledge and epidemic prevention terms every day to steadily raise the epidemic prevention awareness of the masses. Properly informing travelers and those assisting farming of the code of conduct and rules in the respective areas, they have conducted the organizational political work and exercised effective control and guidance to make the travelers and volunteers observe the rules strictly. Officials and working people of industrial establishments across the country have reliably maintained a flawless epidemic prevention posture under a clear point of view that the emergency epidemic prevention work is greatly important in protecting the safety of the country and the people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Short Course for Rural Construction
body: A short course for rural construction was held in South Phyongan Province of the DPRK. Those with profound knowledge and rich experience in construction were selected as lecturers of the course. At the course, its participants, including designers and builders in the province, acquired the comprehensive knowledge for rural construction and shared their good experiences and knowledge, through lectures and question-and-answer session. Its passing-on-technique on building equipment helped the participants raise their practical ability. The short course was of significance in enhancing the working ability and technical knowledge and skills of the officials and workers in the construction field of the province out in the struggle to implement the Party's grand plan for socialist rural construction. Rodong Sinmun

title: Proactive Efforts Made in DPRK to Prevent Damage from Drought
body: Officials and working people in South Phyongan Province of the DPRK turned out in the campaign to protect crops from drought damage. The province surveyed in detail the wheat, barley and maize fields liable to drought damage. And it has scrupulously worked on to concentrate all manpower and means on combating the drought. Officials of provincial, city and county party, power and agricultural organs are now active at farms to guide the campaign against drought damage, directing primary efforts to the provision of enough pumping electric power and irrigation water. They also make sure that institutions and industrial establishments provide farms with enough means for conveying water and that efficient irrigation methods are introduced. Officials and workers of many industrial establishments and women's union members in the province, too, have turned out in the campaign for protecting crops from drought damage. Rodong Sinmun

title: Rice-Transplantation Begins in Chongsan-ri of DPRK
body: Rice-transplanting on May 9 started in Chongsan-ri of Kangso District, Nampho City of the DPRK, an area associated with the undying leadership feats of the peerlessly great men where the great Chongsan-ri spirit and Chongsan-ri method were created. The agricultural workers of the Chongsan Co-op Farm made the seeds sprout well, sowed them in the rice-seedling beds at the right time and introduced an advanced method of cultivating rice seedlings. As a result, the rice seedlings have become healthy. Measures were taken to prevent damage from drought. Farm machines were repaired in a short period and the tilling and harrowing of paddy fields was promoted in order to make full preparations for rice-transplantation in time. The farmers remove the young rice plants from the seedbed and carry them in a responsible manner so as to plant the prescribed number of seedlings per phyong, etc. Rodong Sinmun

title: Political Bureau of C.C., WPK Decides to Switch over from State Epidemic Prevention Work to Maximum Emergency Epidemic Prevention System
body: The Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) on May 12 decided as follows in connection with the grave situation such as the inroads of stealth Omicron variant into the country amid the ever-worsening worldwide public health crisis: The state epidemic prevention work shall be switched over to the maximum emergency epidemic prevention system. The state emergency epidemic prevention command shall take practical measures to switch over from the state epidemic prevention work to the maximum emergency epidemic prevention system and strictly control and command the overall epidemic prevention work of the country. The Party, administrative and economic organs, public and state security and armed forces organs and all other organs and sectors shall unconditionally accept the instructions of the state emergency epidemic prevention headquarters as the demand of the Party Central Committee and thoroughly implement them, and establish the work system in an orderly way in keeping with switching over to the maximum emergency epidemic prevention system so that the slightest deviations are not be revealed in the overall state work. Rodong Sinmun

title: Political Bureau of C.C., WPK Decides to Convene 5th Plenary Meeting of 8th Central Committee of WPK
body: The Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) decided to convene the 5th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the WPK in the first third of June to make interim review of the execution of the immediate major Party and state policies for 2022 assigned at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Party and discuss and decide a series of important issues. A relevant resolution of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK was adopted on May 12. Rodong Sinmun

title: 8th Political Bureau Meeting of 8th Central Committee of WPK Held
body: The 8th Political Bureau meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) was convened at the office building of the Party Central Committee on May 12. Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, was present at the meeting. Attending the meeting were members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, and members and alternate members of the Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee. Present there as observers were officials in the state emergency epidemic prevention sector and some commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence. The respected General Secretary presided over the meeting. First, the Political Bureau discussed an issue of convening the plenary meeting of the Party Central Committee. Adopted at the meeting with unanimous approval was a decision of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee on convening the 5th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Party in the first third of June to make interim summing-up of the execution of the Party and state policies in 2022 and discuss and decide a series of important issues. Next, the Political Bureau discussed the issue of coping with the epidemic prevention crisis state prevailing in the country. It recognized as follows: A most serious emergency case of the state occurred: A break was made on our emergency epidemic prevention front where has firmly defended for two years and three months from February, 2020. The state emergency epidemic prevention command and relevant units made deliberation of the result of strict gene arrangement analysis on the specimen from persons with fever of an organization in the capital city on May 8, and concluded that it coincided with Omicron BA.2 variant which is recently spreading worldwide rapidly. Informed at the meeting was the spread state in the whole country. Urgent measures were presented and deliberated to take the strategic initiative in the epidemic prevention campaign for the future. The Political Bureau censured the epidemic prevention sectors for their carelessness, relaxation, irresponsibility and inefficiency as they did not sensitively cope with the public health state which infectors of all kinds of variants are increasing worldwide including surrounding regions of our country. The Political Bureau recognized that it is necessary to switch over from the state epidemic prevention system to the maximum emergency epidemic prevention system to cope with the present circumstance. All measures were taken for the Party, administrative and economic organs at all levels, sectors of public and state security and national defence and all organs and sectors of the country to establish the proper work system to make the state work be done smoothly in line with the maximum emergency epidemic prevention system coming into force. Adopted at the meeting was a resolution of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK on switch over from the state emergency epidemic prevention work to the maximum emergency epidemic prevention system to cope with the prevailing epidemic prevention crisis. Concluding the meeting, Kim Jong Un raised principles to be maintained thoroughly in the emergency epidemic prevention work and tasks to do so. He outlined and analyzed the current epidemic prevention crisis of the country and noted that the maximum emergency epidemic prevention system is mainly aimed to stably contain and control the spread of COVID-19 that made inroads into the country and to quickly cure the infections in order to eradicate the source of the virus spread at an early date. Pointing out that more dangerous enemy of us than the malicious virus are unscientific fear, lack of faith and weak will, he affirmed that we will surely overcome the current sudden situation and win victory in the emergency epidemic prevention work as we have strong organizing ability with which the Party, government and people are united as one and there are high political awareness and self-consciousness of all the people that have been fostered and cemented during the prolonged emergency epidemic prevention campaign. He called on all the cities and counties of the whole country to thoroughly lock down their areas and organize work and production after closing each working unit, production unit and living unit from each other so as to flawlessly and perfectly block the spread vacuum of the malicious virus. Stressing the necessity of quickly organizing scientific and intensive examination and treatment campaign, he said that the Party and the government decided to take a measure to mobilize reserve medical supplies that have been stored up for the emergency until now. He underscored the need for the public health sector and the emergency epidemic prevention sectors to strictly conduct intensive examination of all the people, take proactive measures for medical observation and treatment, intensify disinfection of all areas ranging from workplaces to living space and thus block and terminate the source of the malicious epidemics spread. Though the epidemic prevention situation is harsh at present, it cannot block our advance toward the overall development of socialist construction, and there should be nothing missed in the planned economic work, the General Secretary said, stressing that the Cabinet and other state economic guidance organs and relevant units should conduct fuller organization, guidance and command over the economic work in conformity with switching over from state epidemic prevention system to the maximum emergency epidemic prevention system so as to speed up the immediate farming work and the production at major industrial sectors and industrial establishments to the maximum and flawlessly complete within the appointed date the cherished works of our Party for the people such as the construction of 10 000 flats in the Hwasong area and the Ryonpho Greenhouse Farm. The Party and power organs should minimize inconveniences and agonies the people would suffer under the strong blockade situation, stabilize their lives and take thoroughgoing measures so that slightest negative phenomena are not be revealed, he noted. Stressing the need to more firmly cement the outposts of the state defence and guarantee the victory of the great epidemic prevention campaign with arms, he specially emphasized that guard duty should be further strengthened on the fronts, borders, seas and air and the best measures be taken to make security vacuum not be revealed in the national defence. The people-first politics by our Party and state that have displayed the great vitality, overcoming all troubles of history, and the strength of our people who are united single-mindedly are the most powerful guarantee to win victory in the current great epidemic prevention campaign, he said, adding that all the Party organizations and power organs should prove in practice their loyalty to the Party and revolution, devotion to the people and responsibility for their duty at the present great epidemic prevention campaign to defend the lives and security of the people. He warmly appealed to all the people and officers and men of the People's Army to triumphantly conclude the great epidemic prevention campaign with firm confidence and great redoubled efforts and thus defend to the end our precious lives and future with our faith, will and unity. The Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK examined and approved the written emergency instructions of the Central Military Commission of the Party and the Cabinet and made sure that they are issued. Political News Team

title: New Cave Relics Discovered in Pyongyang
body: A study group of the History Faculty of Kim Il Sung University discovered a cave dating back to the Paleolithic Age in Rimgyong Workers' District in Kangdong County of Pyongyang City and intensified the research into the relics to scientifically unravel them in the DPRK. They discovered the natural cave and started unearthing it. They discovered seven human (Neolithic man) fossils, more than 300 fossil animal bones of nine kinds and 274 spore and pollen fossils in the cultural layer of the Paleolithic Age. They measured them by using electron spin resonance to confirm that these relics are 23 000 years old with a margin of error of 3 000 and unraveled that the human fossils belong to a woman in her thirties who lived in the latter period of the Paleolithic Age. The Archaeology Society of the DPRK examined the fossils and named the human fossils "Kangdong person" according to the name of the area. According to the examination of the Non-permanent Tangible Heritage Examination and Appraisal Committee and the decision of the Cabinet, the Rimgyong Cave relics were registered as preservation relics. The first discovery of the "Kangdong person" on a par with Neolithic man at the Kangdong area of Pyongyang, where Tangun, the ancestral father of the Korean nation, is buried, is of great significance in anthropologically clarifying that people had lived in this area since the dawn of human civilization, creating time-honored history and culture. Rodong Sinmun

title: Agitprop to Prevent Drought Damage
body: Agitprop is brisk in the DPRK to encourage agricultural officials and workers to combat drought. All provincial Party committees make sure that various forms and ways of agitprop offensives are conducted to inform the masses of the importance of the work to protect crops from drought damage. Powerful agitprop in all rural areas is encouraging the agricultural workers. Rodong Sinmun

title: Rice-transplanting Starts in Wonhwa Co-op Farm
body: Rice-transplanting started at the Wonhwa Co-op Farm in Phyongwon County, South Phyongan Province on Tuesday. President Kim Il Sung visited Wonhwa-ri on May 10, Juche 41 (1952) when the Fatherland Liberation War was at its height. Working together with peasants, he presented a bright prospect for agricultural cooperativization. After the war he said that he is also a member of the cooperative and gave important instructions arising in developing the cooperative. Chairman Kim Jong Il frequently visited the farm and made sure that it increases grain production and becomes a model of the whole country in socialist rural construction as taught by the President on the spot. The farm has the President and the Chairman as its honorary farmers. With such pride and honor the officials and agricultural workers of the farm redouble their efforts for farming preparations with ardent one mind to glorify this significant year as a year of large-scale farming. The farm started the rice-transplanting in the field where the President sowed seeds with farmers during the Fatherland Liberation War. Ju Chol Gyu, vice-premier of the Cabinet and chairman of the Agricultural Commission, An Kum Chol, chief secretary of the South Phyongan Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials of the Party and economic organs in the province transplanted rice seedlings with the farmers. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Reply Message from Syrian President
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, received a reply message from Bashar Al-Assad, president of the Syrian Arab Republic, on May 9. The message expressed gratitude to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un for sending warm congratulations and best wishes on the occasion of the national day of the Syrian Arab Republic. The Syrian president affirmed that he will strive together with Kim Jong Un to develop the relations between the two countries, strengthen negotiations and coordination and open up a new chapter of cooperation in all fields in the common interests of the two peoples. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Visits State Emergency Epidemic Prevention Headquarters
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, visited the state emergency epidemic prevention headquarters on May 12. He was accompanied by Jo Yong Won and Pak Jong Chon, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee. He was greeted by officials of the headquarters on the spot. Making rounds of the command rooms of the headquarters, he examined the epidemic prevention situation one day after the state epidemic prevention work was switched over to the maximum emergency epidemic prevention system to cope with the prevailing epidemic prevention crisis, and learned about the nationwide spread of COVID-19. A fever whose cause couldn't be identified explosively spread nationwide from late April and more than 350 000 people got fever in a short span of time and at least 162 200 out of them were healed completely. On May 12 alone, some 18 000 persons with fever occurred nationwide and as of now up to 187 800 people are being isolated and treated. Six persons died (one of them tested positive for the BA.2 sub-variant of Omicron.) The General Secretary criticized that the simultaneous spread of fever with the capital area as a centre shows that there is a vulnerable point in the epidemic prevention system we have already established. He reiterated the importance of the work of all the provinces, cities and counties of the country to take steps for isolating each working unit, production unit and residential unit from each other while locking down their areas and providing the inhabitants with every convenience in curbing the spread of the malicious virus. Noting that if we put under control the spread situation and take measures in tiding over the present crisis, in particular, we always come to stand on the defensive in the epidemic prevention work, he said that it is the top priority to block the virus spread by actively locking down areas and isolating and treating persons with fever in a responsible manner. As repeatedly stressing, the initiative in the epidemic prevention work is the life, he said, underlining the need to immediately and thoroughly carry out the articles of the decisions of the Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee for firmly taking hold on the good chance in the epidemic prevention campaign on one's own initiative and thus quickly contain the spread of epidemics. The sectors of the public health and emergency epidemic prevention should minutely observe characteristics of the course of diseases of persons with fever, set up scientific treatment methods and tactics at a lightning tempo as demanded by the specialized manuals and further strengthen the state's measures for supplying medicines, he said. He called for containing and stabilizing the spread of malicious epidemics by strictly preserving the state's emergency epidemic prevention guidelines, and for offensively conduct the political information work so that the people have a correct understanding of the state's emergency steps and display high self-consciousness in carrying them out. He put forward detailed tasks to be put into practice, including the issue for the emergency epidemic prevention units at all levels to enhance their operation and commanding capabilities for the epidemic prevention work of their regions and units and make full preparations for coping with the circumstances to be raised promptly and the issue of scrupulously forming forces to ensure the quickness and scientific accuracy in the epidemic prevention work. It is the most important challenge and supreme tasks facing our Party to reverse the immediate public health crisis situation at an early date, restore the stability of epidemic prevention and protect the health and wellbeing of our people, he said, clarifying the determination, willingness and strategy and tactics of the Party Central Committee to victoriously lead the epidemic prevention war. He expressed the expectations and conviction that the officials of the state emergency epidemic prevention headquarters would perfectly block and terminate the spread sources of malicious epidemics and take the lead in making a breakthrough of victory in the great epidemic prevention campaign with their courageous valor and practical ability as demanded by the spirit of the 8th Political Bureau Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the WPK, deeply aware of the solemn mission and responsibility and duty assigned by the Party and the revolution. Political News Team

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Birthday Spread to Centenarian
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un sent a birthday spread to Min Jong Suk, a woman centenarian who lives in Jurye-dong, Phyongsong City of South Phyongan Province, on her 100th birthday. She was born into a poor tenant's family before national liberation and lived a hard life experiencing the sorrow of being stateless. It was not until President Kim Il Sung liberated the country that she could lead a genuine life devoting herself to the building of a new country. She made sincere efforts for the prosperity of society and the happiness of family, took the lead in aiding the army and put efforts into family education to make her children live a worthwhile life at the posts to defend the country. Even after becoming a pensioner, she doesn't stop working to benefit the country and is still now leading a joyful life in good health under the care of officials, doctors in charge, villagers, family members and relatives. Saying that she enjoys a long life in good health thanks to the socialist system that makes selfless, devoted efforts for the good of the people, she always asks her children to do lots of work for the state. Rodong Sinmun

title: Organizing Committee of International Festival in Praise of Great Persons of Mt Paektu Meets
body: An enlarged meeting of the organizing committee of the International Festival in Praise of the Great Persons of Mt Paektu took place through video conferencing. It was attended by the co-chairperson, vice-chairpersons and members of the organizing committee, political and social figures from different countries, members of organizations for friendship and solidarity with the Korean people and officials of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries. Damian Ogbonna, co-chairman of the organizing committee who doubles as national chairman of the People's Progressive Party of Nigeria, made a report. He recalled that the organizing committee issued a press statement on January 7, preparations for splendidly celebrating the 110th birth anniversary of President Kim Il Sung and the 80th birth anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il as a holiday common to mankind were made from the beginning of the year and various political and cultural events and international functions were held all over the world to mark the major anniversaries. Praising the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un as a great man admired by the world, he pointed out that the international celebrations witnessed the profound reverence for the peerlessly great persons on the tenth anniversary of Kim Jong Un's assumption of the top posts of the Party and the state. Recalling that the organizing committee gained precious achievements and experience while organizing and holding the recent peculiar and meaningful international events, he called for continuing to stir up the festive mood and wage more brisk activities for praising the peerlessly great men and giving wide publicity to the reality of the DPRK as well as for supporting the Korean people in their efforts to defend peace of the Korean peninsula, the region and the rest of the world. The organizing committee was newly formed at the meeting. Madav Kumar Nepal, chairperson of the Nepal Communist Party (United Socialism), Jesus Antonio Carlos Hernandez, general secretary of the Central Committee of the People's Socialist Party of Mexico, Damian Ogbonna, national chairman of the People's Progressive Party of Nigeria, Peter Woods, ambassador of the Asia-Pacific Region of the United Cities and Local Governments, Victor Petrov, chairman of the Russian Association for Friendship and Cultural Cooperation with the DPRK, Yehia Zakaria Khairullah, vice-chairman of the Socialist Freedom Party of Egypt, Fumihiro Himori, chairman of the Japan Committee for Supporting the Independent and Peaceful Reunification of Korea, Christer Lundgren, chairman of the Sweden-Korea Friendship Association, Dogu Ferincek, chairperson of the Motherland Party of Turkey, and So Ho Won, chairman of the Korean Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries, were elected co-chairpersons of the organizing committee. Adopted at the meeting was an action program of the organizing committee. Rodong Sinmun

title: Maximum Emergency Epidemic Prevention System Comes into Force, State Emergency Measures Taken
body: The state epidemic prevention system was immediately switched over to the maximum emergency epidemic prevention system according to the decisions of the 8th Political Bureau Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Emergency measures are being taken to block all provinces, cities and counties across the country, isolate working units, production units and living unions, make a more strict concentrated medical checkup of all inhabitants to find out all persons with fever and abnormal symptoms and thoroughly isolate them and actively treat them. And practical measures are being taken to keep the production going at a high rate at the major sectors of the national economy, stabilize the life of the people to the maximum and swiftly cope with the occurrence of infections and those suspected in their regions and units. The central emergency epidemic prevention sector is immediately curbing the spread of malicious epidemics, organizing the scientific and concentrated checkup and treatment campaign to stably control the sudden situation and, at the same time, is paying primary efforts to blocking and terminating the spread source of epidemics by intensifying disinfection. The emergency epidemic prevention units at all levels are taking practical steps to urgently supply medicines needed for treatment of persons with fever, taking care of the isolated members in a responsible manner and disposing of sewages and pathogenic rubbishes as thoroughly demanded by epidemic prevention.
