title: Politburo Consultative Meeting of WPK Central Committee Held
body: The Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) convened a consultative meeting at the office building of the Party Central Committee on Saturday to discuss the matters on readjustment and reinforcement of the present state epidemic prevention capacities and preparations for the 5th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee. Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, guided the meeting. Attending the meeting were members of the Presidium of the WPK Central Committee and members and alternate members of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee. Present as observers were officials in the state emergency epidemic prevention sector and a leading official of the Ministry of Public Health. The Political Bureau heard a report of the state emergency epidemic prevention headquarters on the state of epidemic spread as of May 20. First, its consultative meeting discussed the issue of more effectively engineering and executing the anti-epidemic policies of the Party and the state in line with the overall situation in which the spread of the epidemic is being stably controlled and abated. The Political Bureau estimated the stable situation being maintained in the overall areas in which the nationwide spread of the epidemic has been gradually defused and the number of recovered has increased with the death toll sharply decreased day by day as an all-people anti-epidemic campaign was launched to display the might and spirit of heroic Korea in the combat against the malignant epidemic under the decision and instruction of the Party Central Committee on switching over from the state epidemic prevention system to the maximum emergency epidemic prevention system. The respected General Secretary outlined and analyzed the results of the epidemic prevention work of last nine days after the start of the anti-epidemic war. Appreciating the current affirmative trend in the state emergency epidemic prevention, he said the achievements made in the ongoing campaign is an outcome of our Party's correct guidance and the politico-ideological superiority of our socialist system and its peculiar organizing ability and unity. He stressed the need to maintain the current favorable turn in the overall epidemic prevention front by continually and rapidly regulating and optimizing the state epidemic prevention policy in keeping with the developments and mapping out the state strategy and tactics for its implementation and to take all possible steps for revitalizing the overall economy at the same time. He said that it is necessary to make all the Party members recollect and arm themselves once again with the overall anti-epidemic measures, taken by our Party for more than two years since the outbreak of COVID-19, guideline and regulations for statewide epidemic prevention and the experience and lessons gained in the course of implementing them and to make the Party organizations' duty and role and the Party members' mission in tiding over the current health crisis be recognized again and enhance the consciousness of all the people. He stressed the important tasks and ways for reliably safeguarding our public health defence line by continuously pushing ahead with the work for curbing the spread of the epidemic to the maximum and improving the treatment on fevered persons and those tested positive for the epidemic and consistently grasping the overall anti-epidemic principles and measures taken by our Party. Saying that it is necessary to grasp the inefficiency of the statewide work through an acute consideration and make an opportunity of achieving the signal development of the state capacity of coping with crisis, he stressed that all sectors and unit should dynamically push ahead with the strategic readjustment and reinforcement in the strategic view, not taking shortsighted and temporary measures and study and establish the action program and working system in case of emergency. He called for certainly winning great victory in the all-people campaign against the malicious virus by directing great efforts to protecting the health of medical workers and ensuring their life and developing the communist virtues and beautiful traits into the amazing style of our society and inspiring the people with patriotism, collectivism and the socialist spirit. Repeatedly stressing the duty and role of the Party and responsibility of Party workers in the current public health crisis created in the country, he said that our Party organizations and workers should stand at the places the people are afraid of, anxious about and troubled with, and become the bulletproof walls for defending the people with the boundless devotion and invariable loyalty to them. He referred to the important matters related with the role and immediate tasks for the field of jurisdiction, prosecution and public security. The consultative meeting discussed the issue of setting up district treatment centers for operating and commanding medical service to cope with the epidemic and deploying medical forces to all parts of the country in a balanced way, the issue of establishing medicine supply centers and bases in Pyongyang City, all provinces, districts and counties and improving the efficiency, speed and safety of the supply of medicines, the issue of positively using Koryo medicines with great efficiency in the treatment, the issue of enhancing the production capacity of pharmaceutical factories and increasing the variety of essential and reserve medicines and the issue of strongly taking fundamental measures for further cementing the material and technical foundations in the field of public health, and took relevant policy-oriented measures. Next, the meeting discussed the issue of dispatching technical guidance teams to each province to conduct a general survey of the execution of the Party and state policies for the first half of the year 2022 as part of the preparations for the 5th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee. Saying that the struggle to implement the Party's line for the comprehensive development of socialism should be pushed ahead persistently without interruption together with continuing to dynamically wage the state emergency epidemic prevention campaign, the respected General Secretary mentioned the need to organize the technical guiding teams for surveying, according to each region and sector, the execution of the Party and state policies assigned at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the WPK with members of the Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee. He stressed that leading officials should adopt timely measures after accurately surveying on site the situation of the execution of the emergency epidemic prevention system such as supply of medicine to residents, treatment, guaranteeing their livelihood and the realization of epidemic prevention measures, along with the production in the industrial sectors and actual conditions of the agricultural sector according to the farming processes for the implementation of major policy-oriented tasks. He said that the technical guiding teams should actively guide and help the work to enhance the function and role of local Party and power organs and working people's organizations which have to play a leading role in implementing the Party's policies in their respective areas, from a developmental point of view in compliance to the demands of the developing revolution and the changing trend of situation and environment. Saying that the leading officials, dispatched to each province, should solemnly accept the heavy responsibility given by the Party and the people and find, on the basis of accurate understanding of the actual conditions in field, innovative measures and report them to the Plenary Meeting of the Party Central Committee so that they may be reflected in relevant decisions, he indicated the ways for doing so. The consultative meeting of the Political Bureau decided to organize the technical guiding teams involving members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretaries of the Party Central Committee as the main force and officials from the relevant departments of the Party Central Committee as well as necessary persons from the Cabinet and the judicial and prosecutorial sector, and made detailed arrangements to allocate the areas where the respective teams will have to work and their duties. Political News Team

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Visits Bier of Late Hyon Chol Hae
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), visited the bier of Marshal of the Korean People's Army Hyon Chol Hae, general adviser to the DPRK Ministry of National Defence who is winner of Kim Il Sung Order and Kim Jong Il Order, on Friday to express deep condolences over his death. Accompanying him were Choe Ryong Hae, Jo Yong Won, Kim Tok Hun, Pak Jong Chon and Ri Pyong Chol, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, and members and alternate members of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, members of the WPK Central Military Commission, leading officials of the Ministry of National Defence, commanders of the KPA services and commanders and political commissars of the army corps. Amid the playing of dirge, the hall was wrapped in a bitter sorrow over the loss of a prominent political and military activist of our Party, state and revolutionary armed forces who was a soldier faithful to President Kim Il Sung and a revolutionary comrade-in-arms faithful to Chairman Kim Jong Il and the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. A wreath in the name of Kim Jong Un was laid before the bier of the deceased. Placed were also wreathes in the names of the WPK Central Committee, the WPK Central Military Commission, the Standing Committee of the DPRK Supreme People's Assembly and the DPRK Cabinet. Kim Jong Un paid a silent tribute to the memory of Hyon Chol Hae, a veteran of the armed forces organ of the DPRK and a trustworthy revolutionary who performed distinguished feats in the sacred struggle to defend the sovereignty of the nation and the supreme interests of the country with the single-hearted and boundless loyalty and the spirit of devoted service to the Party and the revolution and the country and the people all his life. With bitter grief over the loss of a precious revolutionary comrade who left an indelible and remarkable trace in the Party building and the development of the revolutionary armed forces with the absolute loyalty to the leader, the transparent revolutionary principle and uprightness, he went round the bier of Hyon Chol Hae. Noting that Hyon Chol Hae had fully displayed matchless heroism and self-sacrificing spirit in the struggle to devotedly defend President Kim Il Sung for the past decades from the glorious days of his service in the bodyguard company during the grim Fatherland Liberation War and dedicated himself to the sacred cause of strengthening the People's Army into the revolutionary armed forces faithful only to the leader's guidance while acting as a close aide to Chairman Kim Jong Il pursuing the Songun revolutionary leadership during the Arduous march, the forced march, Kim Jong Un said that his death is a great loss to our Party, army and people, that can be compensated with nothing. All the Party members, men and officers of the KPA and people should follow his loyalty and revolutionary faith, always remembering the brilliant life of the veteran revolutionary that was recorded as a gold star in the revolutionary armed forces' glorious history of feats, he stressed. He expressed his deep condolences to the bereaved family of the deceased and warmly consoled them. Political News Team

title: Active Medical Checkup and Treatment Launched in DPRK
body: Officials, teachers and students in the public health and epidemic prevention field of the DPRK are continuing their scientific and concentrated medical check-up, treatment and hygienic information service to soon stop the spread of malignant epidemic in their regions and units. According to data available, one million and hundreds of thousands of persons throughout the country, including doctors in charge of households, medical workers of hospitals at all levels, teachers and students of medical colleges, and workers in charge of hygiene at their units, have been involved in the anti-epidemic campaign to thoroughly block and eradicate the source of the malignant epidemic. A large number of doctors in charge of households and medical workers of national, provincial, city and county-level hospitals are carrying out medical check-up for the residents under their care in a responsible manner. They keep close watch on those with fever and use scientific treatment methods. Others retired from the public health sector, too, have voluntarily taken part in hygienic information service and medical check-up since the maximum emergency epidemic prevention system was set in motion. Not only the officials in the epidemic prevention sector and workers in charge of hygiene at their units but also the teachers and students of medical colleges across the country are waging a devoted struggle against the epidemic. Rodong Sinmun

body: Emergency epidemic prevention organs across the country produce and give wide publicity to various media programs to improve the masses' awareness of epidemic prevention as the state epidemic prevention work was switched over to the maximum emergency epidemic prevention system. They have produced a recorded program calling upon all citizens to abide by the epidemic prevention regulations and rules more strictly than ever before under the current health crisis. It is now used to educate those at institutions, enterprises and neighborhood units. They have also made sure that relevant units regularly disseminate epidemic prevention regulations to be observed at worksites and homes through a computer network. And they are producing programs to inform the masses of the common knowledge on prevention and treatment of the epidemic. Prints are disseminated to pharmacies across the country to inform the people of correct dosage, precaution, etc. in the treatment of the epidemic. Such programs help the people prevent and treat the malicious disease with scientific understanding. Rodong Sinmun

body: Officials and workers in Kangwon Province of the DPRK are speeding up without letup the projects planned for this year to achieve the regional development and improve the people's living standard. On the basis of deep consideration of various measures for propelling the construction projects as scheduled, they have directed continuous efforts to building several army-people power stations. Fresh spurs are also given to such construction projects as building of a teacher training college and rural dwellings. All the officials and builders in the province are striving full of optimism and confidence in sure victory in the ongoing anti-epidemic campaign. Rodong Sinmun

body: Activities of mobile service teams for minimizing inconvenience and suffering of the people and stabilizing their life have become brisk under the intensified lockdown condition in the DPRK. According to data available, at least 1 000 mobile service teams are now active in districts and counties of the capital city of Pyongyang alone. Their members are carrying daily necessities, basic foodstuff and other supplies in urgent need for the people's living to dong offices and neighborhood units (residential quarters) for distribution. In close touch with officials at dong offices and heads of neighborhood units, they made a detailed survey of the number of mouths to feed and the amount of supplies in need and have taken timely steps. Many service team members active in other parts of the country, too, have taken care of isolated inhabitants, paying primary attention to the settlement of food and cooking fuel problems. Provinces, cities and counties strive to provide the mobile service teams with favorable working conditions, properly carrying on the organization and guidance over the transport of such supplies as basic foodstuff, cooking fuel and vegetables. The number of service team members is growing with each passing day. Rodong Sinmun

body: The Cabinet and the Ministry of Public Health in the DPRK continue to supply to all parts of the country the state reserve medicines which were immediately released to quickly curb and put under the control the spread of the epidemic, true to the decisions of the Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee. After drawing up a detailed medicine distribution plan, their officials have taken thorough measures for the transport of medicines in close contact with the Party and power organs in different parts of the country. Meanwhile, senior officials and medical workers in every province are striving to promptly distribute those medicines from the state to cities and counties in their regions. Preventive and curative organs at all levels and pharmacies have taken such practical steps as arranging medicine stores and improving their service. Rodong Sinmun

title: Mausoleum of 25th King of Koryo Unearthed in DPRK
body: Recently, the mausoleum of the 25th king of Koryo (918-1392), the first unified state of the Korean nation, was unearthed in Haeson-ri, Kaesong City of the DPRK. The Archaeological Institute of the Academy of Social Sciences, the Korean Agency for National Heritage Conservation under the Bureau for the Protection of Cultural Heritage at the Ministry of Culture, and the History Faculty of Songdo University of Education conducted a joint survey and excavation of the historical relics. A mural tomb, identified as a royal-class mausoleum of the Koryo period, was found in the location about 1.2 km southwest from the seat of Haeson-ri. The mausoleum is divided into four sections by three granite embankments tiered up on top of each other. Located at the first section, which is at the highest point, are a piled-up tomb complete with stone parapet facilities and a pair of stone posts. The second and third sections, which are one tier lesser than the first, have a stone statue each and the fourth section has a place for memorial service. The size of the tomb chamber, made with elaborately cut stones piled up together nicely, is 365cm in length from north to south and 300cm in width from east to west with a height of 235cm. The eastern wall of the chamber has a hole, which can be seen in some married couple tombs, for the "soul" to move around, and its floor revealed pieces of the murals painted on the ceiling and walls of the tomb. Discovered in the tomb are various relics such as parts of a jade book, carved with words praising the moral repute of the king and queen when giving them honorific titles, and gilded ironware. The Archaeology Society of the DPRK identified the recently-unearthed tomb as a royal-class mausoleum made in the 14th century by studying its architectural style, size and relics. Over 250m away east from the tomb is the tomb of Princess An Phyong (unearthed in 1979), the wife of King Kyonghyo. And also recorded in various documents including the "Sinjungdonggukyojisungnam (Revised Handbook of Korean Geography)" are that the tomb of King Kyonghyo is about 3 miles west of the Kaesong area. With those facts in consideration, the society identified in agreement that the tomb can be seen as the mausoleum of the 25th king (1236-1308) of Koryo. The discovery of the tomb of King Kyonghyo, the 25th king of Koryo, is conducive to enriching the treasury of national cultural heritage. Rodong Sinmun

title: Epidemic Spread and Treatment Results in DPRK
body: According to information of the state emergency epidemic prevention headquarters, more than 186 090 persons with fever (more than 32 940 reduced for the previous day), over 299 180 recoveries (over 17 830 increased for the previous day) and one death were reported from 18:00 of May 20 to 18:00 of May 21 throughout the country. As of 18:00 of May 21 since late April, the total number of fevered persons is over 2 646 730, of which more than 2 067 270 (78.107%) have recovered and at least 579 390 (21.89%) are under medical treatment. The death toll stands at 67 and the fatality is 0.003%. Rodong Sinmun

title: Brisk Assistance to Co-op Farms in DPRK
body: A vigorous campaign for giving labor and material assistance to the countryside is going on in the DPRK. According to data available, hundreds of thousands of officials, working people and inhabitants across the country on a daily average have helped the agricultural workers in the immediate farming. Taking the lead in the campaign are public officials from the commissions, ministries and national institutions. Many residents in the provinces, cities and counties have turned out to assist the countryside. They are now engaged in watering farm fields to prevent drought damage, helping and leading each other forward. Rodong Sinmun

title: National Sci-Tech Presentation in Field of Land and Environmental Conservation Begins
body: The 2022 National Sci-tech Presentation in the Field of Land and Environmental Conservation began on May 19. The presentation aims at bringing about a fresh turn in the land and environmental conservation by exchanging and sharing scientific research achievements and experience made in the field of conserving forests, air, plants, gardens and animals and introducing them into practice. It is held on the website of a technical trade service system "Self-Development". Posted on the website are 70 pieces of achievements selected through sectional examinations. The presentation will continue until June 30. Rodong Sinmun

title: Anti-epidemic Campaign Intensified in DPRK
body: The spread of the malignant epidemic is now stably curbed and controlled and the national epidemic prevention foundations consolidated in the DPRK, thanks to an orderly system established to carry out the tasks set forth at the 8th Political Bureau Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and consultative meetings of the Political Bureau. After the establishment of an orderly guidance system to reverse the serious health crisis created in the country, the central emergency epidemic prevention sector has focused its efforts on curbing the spread of the epidemic and ensuring the treatment of patients while stepping up the material and technical preparations to cope with any possible future threat and challenge. It made an epidemiological survey of several districts in Pyongyang City to confirm the characteristics of the malignant virus infection prevailing in the country and establish a scientific method for controlling it. It has made some achievements, deepening the study and analysis for estimating the changes in course of disease and medicinal reactions, characters of clinical signs, etc. compared with the first stage of sudden increase of fever's. The emergency epidemic prevention sectors at all levels more strictly carry on an intensive all-people medical check-up, while directing big efforts to the medical observation with timely treatment and disinfection in keeping with completely curbing the spread of the virus. On May 19 alone, nearly two hundreds of thousands of medical workers across the country conducted an intensive disinfection of more than 100 000 objects including public places and sanitation facilities. On the basis of the precision analysis of data on the configuration of genes of the COVID-19 Omicron variants, the medical scientific research sector has enhanced the correctness and scientific accuracy of test and further perfected a treatment tactic with high efficiency by introducing Koryo medicines into the treatment. Party organizations, power organs and working people's organizations at all levels intensify the propaganda and education to raise the epidemic prevention consciousness and responsibility among officials and working people and make them sincerely fulfill their voluntary duty. All the provinces have organized emergency convoys to supply medicines on a regular basis to pharmacies and preventive and curative organs in cities and counties. And officials of the Party and power organs make a field survey of the sale of medicines every day to immediately solve knotty problems. After learning about the distribution of drugstores in Ryongsong, Ryokpho, Rangnang and Sadong districts and other surrounding areas, members of the military medical field of the Korean People's Army additionally installed more than 20 temporary mobile medicine service centers in close connection with officials of Party and power organs. And they are devoting themselves to the supply of medicines and treatment, visiting families with fevered persons. Officials of preventive and curative organs and teachers and students of medical worker training institutions across the country have conducted a 24-hour service campaign, dedicating their utmost sincerity to the protection of lives and health of the people. Meanwhile, all the people across the country fulfill their duty as citizen, fully displaying the communist virtues and traits in the anti-epidemic campaign with the noble love of the Party Central Committee for the people deeply kept in mind. Their sincere deeds greatly contribute to cementing the epidemic prevention front. Every sector of the national economy is stepping up the production and construction while strictly observing the isolation step. The chance of winning in the anti-epidemic war is improving thanks to high enthusiasm of all the officials, Party members and working people striving to tide over the public health crisis. Rodong Sinmun

title: Officials Visit Bier of Late Hyon Chol Hae
body: Officials from Party and power organs, working people's organizations, ministries and national institutions and city- and district-level institutions visited the bier of the late Korean People's Army (KPA) Marshal Hyon Chol Hae, general adviser to the Ministry of National Defence of the DPRK, on Friday to express their condolences over his death. title: Setting Goal for Breeding More Goats
body: Officials and working people of North Hamgyong Province have increased the number of goats with the will to thoroughly implement the childcare policy of the Workers’ Party of Korea. This year alone, the goat farms and cooperative farms of the cities and counties in the province secured thousands of young goats and factories and enterprises in the province have continued to increase the number of young goats. In particular, the Chongjin City Goat Farm, which is associated with the Party’s guidance feats, has conducted the work for increasing the number of goats to set an example. Officials and employees of the farm have raised the breeding rate by directing big efforts to rearing of mother goats, thus securing many young goats this year. Deeply bearing in mind that the success and failure for implementing the Party’s policy depend on themselves, the officials of Hoeryong City have taken necessary measures to solve problems arising in rearing mother goats. Meanwhile, Onsong County and other areas have increased the number of young goats by taking care of nutrition of mother goats in a responsible way. Now the province has continued to take practical measures to breed healthy young goats. Rodong Sinmun

title: Party's Policy on Epidemic Prevention Unconditionally Upheld in DPRK
body: All the people of the DPRK maintain the current favorable turn in the anti-epidemic campaign with maximum awareness, in response to the call of the Party Central Committee for defending their precious life and future with confidence in sure victory and redoubled great efforts. Amid affirmative trend shown in the nationwide situation of epidemic spread, all the officials, Party members, working people and servicepersons across the country are doing their utmost to completely block and eradicate the source of the epidemic, with higher tension and self-confidence. A dynamic ideological offensive was launched to make all the officials and working people strive with conviction that a decisive guarantee for great victory in the epidemic prevention lies in firmly arming themselves with the Party's line and policies and thoroughly implementing them. The Cabinet and public health and scientific research sectors held a consultative meeting to analyze the cause of failure to sensitively cope with the grave health crisis in the country, the experience of epidemic treatment, advantages and shortcomings and to study the rational ways for initiatively and remarkably developing the state ability to cope with crisis before stepping up the preparations. The crisis and responsibility awareness is further enhanced in every region, sector, workplace and post across the country to maintain the favorable turn in the epidemic prevention work and all inroads of the epidemic are checked through the strict execution of regional and unit lockdown and blockade measures. The emergency epidemic prevention and public health sectors more responsibly carry out checkups of such persons making contact with many residents as prevention and medical workers and mobile service team members, urging them to always maintain the perfect self-protection posture. They adopt timely relevant measures based on scientific and comprehensive analysis of the all-people intensive medical check-up by each province, city, county and subject. While finding and stamping out channels where fever patients occur, each region, sector and unit proactively carry out the work to encourage and spread methods conducive to the treatment and prevention of the epidemic to all employees and residents. Servicepersons of the Korean People's Army military medical sector steering the epidemic prevention campaign in the capital city formed dozens of mobile treatment and medicine supply teams. They visit units with a high outbreak of fever patients and actively wage a struggle for medicine supply and treatment, while fully displaying good traits of army-people unity by preparing and sending healthy foodstuffs and daily necessities to many families. Officials in the public health sector, officials, teachers and students of medical colleges and workers in charge of hygiene across the country have striven to fulfill their responsible duty in the anti-epidemic war. Dosage is properly confirmed on the basis of the close observation and detailed analysis of symptoms of fevered persons and signal progress is made in the treatment. Officials and workers of pharmaceutical factories and medical instrument production units are speeding up the production with transparent awareness that they are entirely in charge of epidemic prevention arsenal. All sectors and units of the national economy put spurs to the production and construction for accelerating the overall development of socialism while conducting a statewide anti-epidemic campaign ceaselessly and intensively. The state economic guidance organs, including the Cabinet and the Agricultural Commission, have scrupulously organized the work to mobilize manpower and means in the immediate campaign for support to the farming under the maximum emergency epidemic prevention system. Rodong Sinmun

title: Funeral Service for Late Hyon Chol Hae Held
body: A ceremony of bidding farewell to the late Marshal of the Korean People's Army Hyon Chol Hae, general adviser to the Ministry of National Defence of the DPRK, took place at the Patriotic Martyrs Cemetery in Sinmi-ri on Sunday afternoon. Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the DPRK, attended the ceremony. Present there were Choe Ryong Hae, Jo Yong Won, Kim Tok Hun, Pak Jong Chon and Ri Pyong Chol, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, members and alternate members of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, members of the WPK Central Military Commission, leading officials of the Ministry of National Defence and other members of the State Funeral Committee, officials of the WPK Central Committee, servicepersons of the KPA and the bereaved family members of the deceased. A mourning flag was hung at the cemetery and the colors and honor guards of the KPA lined up there. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received the coffin of the late Hyon Chol Hae at the entrance of the cemetery, together with members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee. He climbed the cemetery with members of the state funeral committee and bereaved family members following the remains of the deceased. Kim Jong Un paid noble tribute to the martyrs buried at the cemetery before the ceremony. With declaration of the ceremony the national anthem of the DPRK was solemnly played. Pak Jong Chon, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretary of the WPK Central Committee, made a eulogy. A ceremony for burying the remains of the late Hyon Chol Hae was held. 180 volleys for the deceased were fired out of bitterness upon parting forever from the prominent political and military activist who made an immortal contribution to the Party, revolution, country and people at a historic time when the Korean people win a great victory full of confidence and vitality. Kim Jong Un spread earth on the remains, repressing his sorrow over the last parting with a precious veteran of revolution whom he heartily respected and dearly treasured. The members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee and bereaved family members spread earth on the remains. Warmly recollecting the sincere and devoted life of the veteran revolutionary who upheld the Party and leader with faith, conscience and obligation all his life, free from affectation and inconstancy, he was overwhelmed with bitterness. A wreath in the name of Kim Jong Un was placed before the grave amid the playing of the wreath-laying music. Wreathes in the names of the WPK Central Committee, the WPK Central Military Commission, the Standing Committee of the DPRK Supreme People's Assembly and the DPRK Cabinet were laid there. Kim Jong Un, together with all the participants in the ceremony, paid a silent tribute in memory of the late Hyon Chol Hae who became the firm root of our great state with his revolutionary life and undying achievements. Saying that whenever recollecting the arduous Songun march made by Chairman Kim Jong Il, he comes to think about Hyon Chol Hae first who always remained faithful to the Chairman as his closest political and military aide, Kim Jong Un stressed that the life of a revolutionary soldier shining in the sacred history of the leader is the most vivid expression of the most worthwhile life. He said that though the veteran revolutionary passed away, the name of Hyon Chol Hae would be always remembered along with the august name of Kim Jong Il and his noble soul and spirit would be immortal along with the cause of our Party winning victory after victory with each passing day and remarkable development of our great state and armed forces of the Republic. Hyon Chol Hae, a steadfast revolutionary who remained boundlessly faithful to the revolutionary idea and cause of the Party Central Committee till the last moments of his life, will always be kept in the noble memory of the great leader and in the mind of our people and servicepersons vigorously advancing towards the final victory of the Juche revolution. Political News Team

title: Ceremony for Carrying Coffin of Late Hyon Chol Hae Held
body: A ceremony for carrying the coffin of Marshal of the Korean People's Army Hyon Chol Hae, general adviser to the Ministry of National Defence of the DPRK, was held at the April 25 House of Culture on Sunday morning. The venue of the state funeral was filled with bitter grief of bidding farewell to the distinguished political and military activist of our Party and state who followed and upheld the Party and leader single-mindedly and performed immortal achievements on the sacred road of serving the country and the people while glorifying his worthy life as a loyal revolutionary soldier of President Kim Il Sung and a steadfast comrade-in-arms of Chairman Kim Jong Il and the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), attended the state funeral. Present were members of the state funeral committee, including Choe Ryong Hae, Jo Yong Won, Kim Tok Hun, Pak Jong Chon and Ri Pyong Chol, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, members and alternate members of the Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee, members of the WPK Central Military Commission and leading officials of the Ministry of National Defence, and the bereaved family of the deceased. A mourning flag was hung at the April 25 House of Culture where the coffin of the deceased lied. The colors and guards of honor of the three services of the KPA stood near the coffin. A ceremony for carrying the coffin of the late Hyon Chol Hae out of the house took place. Amid the playing of the funeral music, Kim Jong Un, chairman of the state funeral committee, together with members of the committee, paid silent tribute to the memory of the late Hyon Chol Hae. Hardly repressing the sorrow over the great loss of a steadfast revolutionary who was the most respectful revolutionary forerunner and a veteran of the KPA, Kim Jong Un carried the coffin out of the funeral hall together with the members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee. Men and officers of the KPA lined up at the plaza of the April 25 House of Culture, expressing regret at parting from the deceased who rendered irreplaceable distinguished services to the building of the Party and armed forces and inheritance and development of the revolutionary cause for a long time spanning 60 years until today of opening up golden days of building up the national power under the leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un from the glorious days of creating a new history of socialist construction under the leadership of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. The guards of honor covered the coffin with the national flag of the DPRK, a sacred flag of honor, out of the respect of all the KPA service personnel. Kim Jong Un saw the coffin off with all the KPA service personnel who gathered at the plaza, expressing deep condolences over the deceased once again. The hearse took the street under the escort of motorcycles after passing a column of the KPA colors and the guards of honor expressing the noble respect for the deceased. On both sides of the avenues, a great many KPA service personnel and citizens gave him a send-off with deep regret over the loss of a true soldier who upheld the Party and the leader with his single mind all his life just like an unchangeable arms of revolution and a model of the patriot who devoted his all to the country and people. Political News Team

title: Struggle of Ten Days under Maximum Emergency Epidemic Prevention System
body: Ten days and ten nights have passed since the maximum emergency epidemic prevention system was set in motion in the DPRK to cope with the current health crisis. The entire Party, the whole country and all the people turned out to step up the economic construction without let-up even under the condition of unprecedented blockade and isolation, in response to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's ardent call for safeguarding our precious life and future by dint of our faith, will and unity by victoriously concluding the anti-epidemic war with firm confidence and redoubled great efforts. All the economic sectors and units in the country launched an offensive drive to win victory both in the epidemic prevention campaign and the implementation of the national economic plan for this year, true to the idea and spirit of the meeting and consultative meetings of the Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee. Detailed plans were worked out and strong action measures taken to accelerate the production and construction uninterruptedly. Officials of the state economic guidance organs have taken the lead in the economic construction to lay a solid foundation for the implementation of the five-year plan. Workers in the metallurgical industrial sector are making innovations and feats in the production. Those of the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex have over-fulfilled their plan for the production of pig iron and steel for the last ten days. A more vigorous struggle for increased production was staged at metallurgical bases in different parts of the country, and the workers of Unryul, Jaeryong and other mines in charge of the supply of iron ore have pushed ahead with the production as scheduled. Signal progress has been made in the chemical industrial sector. The February 8 Vinalon Complex and the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex stepped up the production of such chemical goods as caustic soda and vinyl chloride as planned, increasing the nitrogenous fertilizer production by 105 percent. Workers of power stations and plants across the country have additionally turned out electricity of millions of kWh more than before. Hydro-power stations carried out their daily production plans and thermal power plants considerably raised their daily production results by positively introducing the sci-tech achievements. As a result, the power production plan for the last ten days was over-fulfilled throughout the Ministry of Electric Power Industry. Admirable achievements are also reported from the coal industrial sector. The Pukchang Area Youth Coal-Mining Complex and the Kujang Area Coal-Mining Complex respectively produced hundreds of tons of more coal for ten days. The coal mines in Kaechon and Anju areas showed higher results in capital and preparatory tunnelings than the planned, while hundreds of spare cutting faces were secured throughout the Ministry of Coal Industry. The Ministry of Railways and all railway bureaus and their branches have carried out the plan for major freight transport of the ministry by exerting primary efforts to accident-free running of intensive transport trains. In the machine-building industrial sector, workers of the Pyongyang Electric Cable General Factory 326 carried on the production of various kinds of electric cables as scheduled while those of the Kusong Machine Tool Factory, Pyongyang and Ryangchaek bearing factories and the Anju Pump Factory brought about innovations in planned production of equipment and accessories. The flame of collective innovation in the key industrial sectors has spread to all other economic sectors such as agriculture, construction, building-materials industry and light industry. Amid the enthusiasm to uphold the Party and defend the revolution with increased grain production growing higher among the agricultural workers in the country, those in South Hwanghae Province have propelled all the farming processes as scheduled. They have transplanted rice seedlings in thousands of hectares of fields every day. Passing-on-technique and demonstration lectures on breeding of young rice-plants and rice-planting were organized and advanced farming methods positively introduced. Major construction projects have been accelerated at fast tempo. The framework for the construction of 10 000 flats in Hwasong area is nearing completion, during which a new Hwasong myth was created. The construction of the Ryonpho Greenhouse Farm has been sped up thanks to loyalty and patriotism of the solider-builders. The Sangwon Cement Complex carried out its ten-day production plan by 110.2 percent and similar success was reported from the Sunchon Cement Complex and the Chonnaeri Cement Factory. The Taean Friendship Glass Factory, the Pyongyang Foam Prefab Factory, the Hamhung Wood Processing Factory and other factories have carried out their daily production plans. The workers in the light industrial sector are effecting an upswing in production, encouraged by Kim Jong Un's noble love for the people. The Ryuwon Footwear Factory has registered production result of 105 percent on a daily average, and the Ryongsong Disabled Soldiers' Injection-molded Boot Factory is making a breakthrough in carrying out its monthly plan. Many factories in the local industrial sector have carried on their production without let-up in reliance on their own technology and domestic raw materials. The production plan for May was carried out at 110 percent throughout the Salt Industry Bureau. The ten days and ten nights since the start of the maximum emergency epidemic prevention system were a course of continued struggle of the producers with high patriotic zeal. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK People's Organizing Ability and Unity Displayed in Epidemic Prevention Campaign
body: The current situation of the epidemic spread in the DPRK shows a positive trend away from a rapid growth in the beginning to a decline after being stably controlled and managed, registering daily increased number of recoveries across the country. Officials of the Party and power organs in each province, city and county are fulfilling their responsibilities and duties as scouts and bulletproof walls in the van of the ongoing epidemic prevention campaign. They have scrupulously organized the work for supplying food, condiments and non-staple foods uninterruptedly to residents along with water that is perfectly safe to drink. Servicepersons from the military medical field of the Korean People's Army dispatched to hundreds of pharmacies in the capital city of Pyongyang are steering the epidemic prevention campaign in the city with patriotic devotion as befits the special detachment of the Party. Army medics, in collaboration with medical workers of the public, have carried out medical checkup and treatment of patients, needless to say of supplying medicines according to prescription, while dynamically conducting the work to publicize the validity and vitality of the epidemic prevention policies of the Party and the state and spread information by sending various kinds of audio equipment and TV sets to pharmacies. From May 17 to 19 alone, large amounts of over 70 types of medicine were supplied to more than 4 900 medicine management offices, curative and preventive organs and at least 4 300 pharmacies and medicine stands nationwide. On the basis of the data bringing together all results from all-people intensive medical check-up, the relevant sectors launched an accurate analysis according to symptom, age, sex, etc. and have accelerated in a planned way the work for establishing a further ramified statewide test network and a plan for enhancing the professional qualifications and level of skill of medical examiners. The medical scientific research sector confirmed a way of administering medication to fevered persons with special constitution and is hastening the development of new test reagent and antibody test reagent for early detection of the epidemic. According to data available, one million and hundreds of thousands of persons throughout the country, including medical workers of hospitals at all levels, teachers and students of medical colleges and workers in charge of hygiene at their units, have been involved in the ongoing campaign of medical check-up, treatment and hygienic information service to thoroughly block and eradicate the source of spread of the malignant epidemic. Many doctors in charge of households across the country have conducted a medical checkup for inhabitants in a responsible way, ensuring medical observation and treatment of fevered persons and confirmed cases. Various media programs and printed materials dealing with common knowledge on epidemic prevention and treatment were produced and distributed, under a unified guidance of the state emergency epidemic prevention headquarters, to take effect in enhancing the people's awareness in scientific epidemic prevention. Party members have cared for comrades more than for themselves and their families at every worksite, cherishing in mind the expectation of the Party Central Committee that they would play a leading role in the current severe anti-epidemic war. Their elated spirit and noble moral traits are injecting vitality into the epidemic prevention campaign. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Premier Inspects Local Areas to Learn about Farming and Epidemic Prevention
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and premier of the Cabinet, made a field survey of current farming and epidemic prevention work in North Hwanghae Province and Nampho City. Going around several farms in North Hwanghae Province and Nampho City, including the Migok Cooperative Farm in Sariwon City, the Sokjong Cooperative Farm in Hwangju County and the Chongsan Co-op Farm in Kangso District, he encouraged agricultural workers and volunteers who exert themselves in the major thrust of socialist construction, true to the decision made at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Party Central Committee, and learned about the problems arising in farming after the operation of the maximum emergency epidemic prevention system. He called upon officials in the field of agriculture to more dynamically conduct a campaign for preventing the damage from drought by making the maximum and effective use of labor power and means in line with the enduring unfavorable weather, bearing in mind that to minimize the influence of disastrous abnormal weather is of key importance in attaining the goal of grain production. He called for firmly grasping scientific farming methods including sci-tech manuring and cultivation of the earlier crops such as wheat and barley and positive introduction of advanced method to grow rice seedlings, and for finishing the ongoing rice-transplanting at the right time and in a qualitative way by decisively increasing the proportion of mechanization in farming. He inspected pharmacies in Sariwon City and Hwangju and Yonthan counties of North Hwanghae Province and Kangso and Waudo districts of Nampho City to learn about the epidemic prevention. Saying that it is necessary to unconditionally implement the line and policies of the Party Central Committee set forth at the meeting and consultative meetings of the Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee, he stressed that the medicines provided under the affection of the Party should be correctly in time supplied to inhabitants through the scrupulous organization of transportation and supply. He stressed the need to better the environment of pharmacies in a hygienic and cultured way, improve the service including kind explanation about application and usage of medicines on the principle of prioritizing the convenience of the people and enhance the role of power organs in ensuring the people's living conditions through sufficient supply of vegetables and condiments to inhabitants. At the Nampho Port, the premier urged its officials and workers to strictly observe the epidemic prevention rules and orders in keeping and handling cargos with high awareness that they defend the outpost in the epidemic prevention campaign, as required by the maximum emergency epidemic prevention system. Rodong Sinmun

title: Commemorative Events Held in Laos
body: A lecture meeting and a film show were held in Vientiane of Laos on May 19, under the sponsorship of the Laotian Foreign Ministry, to mark the 30th anniversary of the meeting between President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il and Kaysone Phomvihane, former chairman of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party (LPRP) and president of Laos, during his visit to the DPRK. Attending the events were a vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, the vice-chairperson of the Commission for Propaganda and Training Affairs of the C.C., LPRP and other officials of the Lao government, political party and friendship organizations, including the Committee for External Affairs of the LPRP, the Ministry of Industry and Commerce and the Laos-Korea Friendship Association, and the ambassador and members of the DPRK embassy in Vientiane. At the lecture meeting, the vice-minister of Foreign Affairs of Laos said that the meaningful meeting between the preceding leaders of Laos and the DPRK was a noteworthy event of significance in the development of bilateral relations. He stressed that the lecture would mark an important occasion in helping the younger generations get a better understanding of the significance of the historic meeting between the preceding leaders of the two countries and the tradition of the excellent bilateral cooperative relations. Prior to the lecture meeting, the participants watched a video dealing with the matchless military force of the DPRK and its national symbols. Rodong Sinmun

title: Epidemic Spread and Treatment Results in DPRK
body: According to information of the state emergency epidemic prevention headquarters, more than 167 650 fevered persons (about 18 440 less than the previous day), over 267 630 recoveries (about 31 550 less than the previous day) and one death were reported from 18:00 of May 21 to 18:00 of May 22 throughout the country. As of 18:00 of May 22 since late April, the total number of fevered persons is over 2 814 380, of which more than 2 334 910 (82.964%) have recovered and at least 479 400 (17.034%) are under medical treatment. The death toll stands at 68 and the fatality rate is at 0.002%. Rodong Sinmun

title: Rice-transplantation Makes Headway in South Hwanghae Province of DPRK
body: Agricultural officials and workers in South Hwanghae Province of the DPRK are making innovations in immediate rice-transplanting. The provincial Party committee launched a vigorous information and motivation work in cities and counties. The province specified the assignment of officials under the regional and unit lockdown and isolation measure, strengthening the agricultural technological guidance so that all farms thoroughly ensure the quality and speed of rice-transplanting. Its agricultural workers have transplanted rice seedlings on hundreds of hectares of paddy fields every day. Cooperative farms pay efforts to raising the mechanization rate in rice-transplanting. Rodong Sinmun

title: More Measures Taken to Keep Stable Situation of Anti-Epidemic Campaign in DPRK
body: Now underway in all sectors of the anti-epidemic front of the DPRK, where the preemptive and scientific emergency anti-epidemic policies and important measures of the Workers' Party of Korea and the state are being carried into practice invariably, is the work for continuously maintaining the stable situation and accelerating its favorable development. In a few days after the maximum emergency epidemic prevention system was activated, the nation-wide morbidity and mortality rates have drastically decreased and the number of recovered persons increased, resulting in effectively curbing and controlling the spread of the pandemic disease and maintaining the clearly stable situation. Party organizations at all levels and leading officials display their remarkable organizing ability, drive and working manner. Such revolutionary traits as strictly reviewing the anti-epidemic work of the regions, sectors and units under their charge in all categories every day and finding and tackling the shortcomings and flaws have been firmly established. The State Emergency Epidemic Prevention Headquarters and the Cabinet, on the basis of scientifically analyzing the overall anti-epidemic situation of the country in the light of the decisions of the Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee, spearhead operations and take detailed practical measures to sensitively respond to any surprising emergency situation; comprehensively revising and supplementing the action rules of each sector for the multi-faceted work for tracking down the cause of infection and bolstering the state capabilities for coping with crisis, and boosting the production capacity of the pharmaceutical industry and working out a future plan. Efforts are concentrated on studying and establishing a perfect emergency anti-epidemic system after making a stern analysis and summing-up of the deviations manifested right after the outbreak of persons with fever. Underway in the public health field and scientific research institutes is the reinvestigation for getting in further detail from fevered and recovered persons in different parts of the country such epidemiological and clinical features of the pandemic disease as latent period, clinical symptoms, recurrence rate, reaction to medicines, severity rate and progress period. They also come up with more new methods of step-by-step treatment, which are classified according to different ages, occupations, constitutions and chronic diseases of patients, while stepping up the development and production of test reagents and treatment medicines. Given that one million and hundreds of thousands of medical workers, teachers and students of the institutions for training medical workers and sanitary workers have been mobilized into medical treatment, check-ups and disinfection and some 10 000 mobile service teams are active across the country, special attention is paid to taking thoroughgoing preventive measures for ensuring their safety. An information service through media and educational networks gets more intensive to inform the citizens of the current situation of the global health crisis, dangerous newly emerging virus variants and knowledge for preventing them, hygiene know-how, effective drugs and methods of using them, treatment experiences, etc. to help them be active in the anti-epidemic campaign with fair anti-epidemic literacy and ability. The army medics of the Party Central Committee, who took their positions at the pharmacies in the capital city, are steering the emergency anti-epidemic campaign. While ensuring the supply of medicines on the basis of detailed information about residential areas, households and individuals, given the current situation of the anti-epidemic campaign, they inform not only the visitors to the pharmacies but also the patients under home treatment of the folk remedies and Koryo medical treatment methods for aftereffects of the disease. A large quantity of fresh vegetables and subsidiary foods are carried and sold to citizens every day in Pyongyang City amid the ceaseless work for ensuring the smooth supply of foodstuffs, condiments and fuel to carry out the major political task - ensuring the people's living conditions. The people across the country are striving to devotedly implement the Party policies in the anti-epidemic work as well as the socialist construction theaters, while fully displaying the virtues and beautiful traits peculiar to Korean society, whereby they share feelings and affections each other in difficult situation. Bigger successes are witnessed every day in the campaign for combating the malignant virus, thanks to the positive struggle of all the officials, Party members and other working people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Posters Encourage All People to Epidemic Prevention Campaign
body: The Mansudae Art Studio produced new posters of various themes powerfully arousing all the people to the struggle against the malignant epidemic. Reflected in poster "Let us tide over the prevailing health crisis and firmly defend the wellbeing of the country and people with our faith, will and unity!" is the intention of the Party Central Committee that calls on all the people and servicepersons to triumphantly conclude the epidemic prevention campaign with firm conviction and redoubled great efforts. Intensively carried in the posters are the steadfast readiness and will of the members of the military medical sector of the Korean People’s Army to steer the victorious epidemic prevention campaign after receiving the special order of the Party Central Military Commission, and the demand for staunchly continuing without letup the struggle for implementing the Party's line on the overall development of socialism. Some posters reflect the high enthusiasm of our people to give full play to the virtues and feelings of our society in the on-going difficult and arduous epidemic prevention campaign and the idea of adhering to the demand of the maximum epidemic prevention system. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Birthday Spread to Centenarian
body: The number of centenarians increases in the DPRK which keeps the life and safety of the people above all else and orients everything to this. The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un sent a birthday spread to Pang Jong Suk living in neighborhood unit No. 40 in Kunu-dong of Kaechon City, South Phyongan Province on her 100th birthday. With her excitement at the daily-growing benevolence of the Party despite the serious pubic health crisis, she expressed her gratitude to Kim Jong Un. Officials of the Kaechon City Party Committee visited her family to learn in detail about the health and living conditions of Pang and her family and solve the problems arising in her life, congratulating her on her birthday. Noting that the severe health crisis is being successfully defused under the anti-epidemic policy of our Party, they encouraged her family members to do their work in a responsibly way with confidence that the ongoing anti-epidemic war would be concluded victoriously under the guidance of Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Pride of Old Doctor
body: Prof. and Dr Kang Yong Chol, a researcher of Choe Kyong Thae Endocrine Institute is 80-odd years old. He made research results of significance to contribute to life and promotion of health of people and also wrote some worthy books to uphold the Party’s policy on public health. Over 50 years ago he graduated from Pyongyang University of Medicine and began to work as a researcher. He developed the blood sugar test method which is of significance in diagnosis of diabetes and the judgment of its treatment efficiency. Then he volunteered to develop the medicine based on our own material. The medicine he developed does not give negative influence to human body but heightens its treatment efficiency. He contributed to completing the multilingual medical encyclopedia and wrote over 40 books and trained some 20 degree holders. In the days of worthy research for development of the country’s public health and promotion of people’s health he was awarded with the watch bearing the august name of President Kim Il Sung and received thanks of Chairman Kim Jong Il as well as some orders and medals. Rodong Sinmun

title: Superior Heritages of National Culture on Bank of Taedong River
body: There are scenic spots and places of historic interest boasting of their old figures on the bank of the Taedong River flowing with long history of our nation. They are reflecting wisdom and talents of our ancestors. The citizens often visit the bank of the river which is beautiful for the Taedong Gate with long history, the Ryongwang Pavilion and the Pyongyang Bell. They make us feel the national pride and self-confidence. The Taedong Gate which is impressive and elegant shows the architecture of our wise and talented ancestors and the Ryongwang Pavilion adds to its beauty of scenery with its peculiar figure. The pavilion is one of the eight scenic spots in northwestern part of Korea and the pride of Pyongyang on account of its peculiar beauty of architecture and beautiful landscape of the surroundings. From the olden times the pavilion arouses the poetic sentiment of visitors with its beautiful scenery. During the Fatherland Liberation War, many relics were destroyed and reduced to ashes by the US imperialists’ indiscriminate bombings. In the days of postwar reconstruction, the relics including the Taedong Gate were restored to its original state under the wise leadership of President Kim Il Sung. Today the heritages of national culture on the bank of the Taedong River convey wisdom and talent of our nation under our Party’s policy for the protection of national heritages. Rodong Sinmun

title: Successes Made in Housing Construction Project in DPRK
body: Amid the high revolutionary enthusiasm of builders, more units have concluded the structural construction of high-rise apartment houses in their charge in the Hwasong area of the DPRK where the construction of 10 000 flats is underway. Furthermore, successes were made in plastering the interiors of the buildings. Different construction units of the Korean People's Army finished the framework of several skyscrapers after the state epidemic prevention system was switched over to the maximum emergency epidemic prevention system. Different units of the KPA involved in the project have completed the structural construction of buildings in their charge. Similar successes have been made by several units of civilian builders. Thanks to the high enthusiasm and devoted struggle of the soldier- and civilian-builders, the appearance of the Hwasong area undergoes a change every day. Rodong Sinmun

title: Birthday Spread Sent to Centenarian in DPRK
body: The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un sent a birthday spread to Ri Jong Dong who lives in Hacho-ri, Nyongbyon County of North Phyongan Province, on her 100th birthday. Officials of the County Party Committee visited her family to congratulate her on her birthday. She noted that the most advantageous Korean-style socialist system further develops, all families across the country enjoy happiness and the number of centenarians increases despite the severe health crisis under the care of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un, saying our Party and country are the best. Officials asked the families to faithfully uphold the leadership of the respected General Secretary by doing farming with sincerity in good health to live up to his benevolence with bumper harvest. Her family members expressed their will to convey the benevolence of the respected General Secretary from one generation to another and support the socialist country with increased cereal production. Rodong Sinmun

title: Construction of Dwelling Houses Proceeds in DPRK
body: Service personnel of the Korean People's Army involved in the construction of dwelling houses in the area of Komdok work hard to carry out a goal for finishing before the rainy season the framework of thousands of dwelling houses planned to be concluded this year. The construction command provides proper guidance over the operation for fulfilling the daily plans without fail, while surely maintaining the anti-epidemic posture. After finishing the framework of multi-storied apartment houses, it has given precedence to formwork assembling and reinforcement processing and made sure that the construction rules and methods are strictly observed. The soldier-builders finished the ground excavation, ground concrete tamping and framework of several low-storied apartment houses. They speed up the construction by regularly organizing a demonstration on advanced working methods and on-the-spot technical learning and launching a socialist emulation drive among sub-units. Rodong Sinmun

title: Prevention Campaign Oriented to Halting Spread of Malignant Pandemic Disease in DPRK
body: The people in the DPRK go all out for a scientific and lightening anti-epidemic campaign, full of confidence, under the experienced guidance of the Workers' Party of Korea. Working guidance teams were dispatched to every province, true to the decisions of the Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee held on May 21. They correctly grasp the situation of the activated maximum emergency epidemic prevention system and take necessary measures, while acquainting themselves with the progress made in the efforts for carrying out the Party and state policies in the first half of this year. Officials affiliated to the working teams headed by the members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretaries of the Party Central Committee inspected the local hospitals, units in charge of production and supply of medicines and pharmacies. They also meet local inhabitants to hear their opinions. Being told about the problems arising in curing fever, producing and supplying effective medicines and ensuring the people's living conditions, they discuss and take measures to make improvements and provide proper guidance over the local Party and power organs and working people's organizations so that they would scientifically ensure the victory in the anti-epidemic campaign. Gaining momentum is the work to consolidate the anti-epidemic foundations of the country and apply the most excellent and suitable treatment tactics and methods across the country. The publicity campaign is focused on teaching information about the Omicron virus variants and helping the public deeply understand various scientific treatment methods to be applied to curing patients of different ages and constitutions and the anti-epidemic regulations. The prompt collective diagnosis teams organized by the central-level hospitals keep their telemedicine service system turned on round-the-clock to provide local hospitals with timely technical assistance and help them take scientific treatment measures for the patients with abnormal symptoms. An academic study group has been formed, comprising medical officials and experts of relevant sectors. It concentrates on sternly analyzing the experiences and lessons gained and drawn in the past preventive work and the present treatment of the epidemic and on the study for furthering the state capabilities for tackling health crisis. The central emergency epidemic prevention sector and the emergency anti-epidemic units at all levels wage a campaign for curbing the spread of the pandemic disease and eliminating its root cause, while engaging in the preparatory work for reacting against any future threats and challenges. A nation-wide epidemiological reinvestigation has been launched. This is followed by substantial measures being taken on the basis of the results of the comprehensive analysis on the epidemiological features of the fevered persons and progress made in curing them, and of the detailed appraisal of the capabilities of cities, counties and units for putting under control the pandemic disease. Efforts are also directed to boosting the scientific level of the antibody test methods. Medics of the Korean People's Army put efforts into swapping experiences and effective curing methods so far gained in every post in supply of medicines, diagnosis and treatment and preventive campaign and into generalizing the reasonable ways. Every province, city and county strictly observe the hygienic requirements in storage and handling of medicines being supplied in advance and analyze the composition of herbs and other useful plants growing in their areas to use them for producing medicines. Rodong Sinmun

title: Warm Care of Respected General Secretary for People
body: Revolutionary Nature of Our Party In August, Juche 109(2020), the 16th meeting of the Political Bureau of the 7th Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea (WPK) took place under guidance of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un. At that time, inhabitants in the areas damaged by disastrous heavy rains and floods were living in the evacuated areas, undergoing great pains. Briefing on a general situation of flood damage, the respected General Secretary said that the flood-stricken people must be suffering great as they were living in temporary dwelling places with their houses and family properties lost. He earnestly said that it was a crucial time that our Party must be responsible for their living and we had to go closer to them to share the pain with them and to relieve them of their sufferings. He set forth tasks for different sectors to eradicate the damage of the flood and bring the living of the people to normal at an early date. He specified detailed ways for this. He said that through the active rehabilitation drive we had to prove in practice once again the revolutionary nature of our Party which shares misfortune and pain with the people and protects them by removing all those pains, the advantages of our social system. He repeatedly stressed the need for our Party to fulfill its sacred duty so that it would not feel ashamed of itself before the people and surely live up to the trust and expectation of the people. His instructions that day is an eruption of his ardent sincerity who regards it as the most important revolutionary work to alleviate people’s misfortune. Regarding It As Greatest Pleasure One April day in Juche 108(2019), the respected General Secretary visited the Yangdok Hot Spring Resort under construction. Looking round the construction site in which another civilization of the times was being created he was very satisfied all along. He said to the officials that however hard and difficult it might be we should continue the struggle to bring earlier such new civilizations and as long as it was the work for our people we should keep running with all burdens on our shoulders without any stop. It was a meaningful instruction which taught that the work for people’s happiness must be carried through without giving up halfway. Noting that there may be some temporary difficulties and trials in the course of struggle he earnestly said that as I kept emphasizing to officials, we should regard it as the greatest pleasure and fortune in the world to run for the people with all burdens on our shoulders and nobody could work hard for the people instead of us. Regarding it as the greatest pleasure to work hard for people! The officials engraved in their hearts again how they should serve for the people’s happiness with what preparedness and spirit. Rodong Sinmun

title: Transport Precisely Leads to Production
body: Officials and workers of the railway transport sector are increasing transport while maintaining anti-epidemic posture. Officials of the Ministry of Railways have made detailed survey into the demand of the major sectors of national economy for transport including the metal and chemical industries. On this basis they mapped out a scrupulous transport plan and strengthened the unified traffic control system to ensure the transport cargos to be carried to destinations in time. The Pyongyang Railway Bureau keeps increasing transport while giving precedence to providing locomotives and freight cars necessary for major materials transport. Those of the Kaechon Railway Bureau transport cargos to major factories and enterprises in a responsible way. The Hamhung and Chongjin railway bureaus achieve more successes day after day while strengthening material and technical foundations of the wagon-repairing bases and comprehending in detail unloading times and loading situation of wagons. Rodong Sinmun

title: Spurs Put to Production of Farming Materials and Accessories
body: Collective and collaborative innovations are being made in the sector of mechanical industry. The Anju Insulating Material Factory pushes ahead with the production of insulating paint for farms across the country. Officials and employees of the Pyongyang General Electric Cable Factory 326 record remarkable successes in production of various electric cable through brisk mass technical innovation campaign. Those of the Ryangchaek and Pyongyang bearing factories exert themselves to fulfill the step-by-step plan for realizing the localization of equipment and materials while carrying out the bearing production assignment. In addition, the Huichon Precision Machine Plant and other units in the mechanical industry continuously put spurs to production of various accessories and farming materials to be sent to the agricultural sector including tractor spare parts. Rodong Sinmun

title: Sci-Tech Competition for 2022 Opens in DPRK
body: A ceremony for declaring the sci-tech competition for the year 2022 was hosted by the State Commission of Science and Technology through video-conferencing on Tuesday. The sci-tech competition aims at contributing to the implementation of the decisions made at the 4th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea by making more sci-tech achievements conducive to promoting the independence of the country's economy and improving the people's living standard. Attending the ceremony were officials of the State Commission of Science and Technology, ministries, national institutions, scientific research institutes and universities. Ri Chung Gil, chairman of the State Commission of Science and Technology, announced the outline for the competition. According to the outline, branch institutes and institutes (over level C) under the State Academy of Sciences, ministries and national institutions, Kim Il Sung University, Kim Chaek University of Technology and other major universities will participate in the competition. The form and method, review and appraisal of the competition, including the issue of holding the competition divided into categories of branch institutes, institutes (over level C) and universities and the issue of establishing proper goals and plans of the competition and thoroughly implementing them, are reflected in detail in the outline. The competition will last from May to December and be reviewed in next January. Rodong Sinmun
