title: KPA Medics' Devoted Efforts in Emergency Anti-epidemic Campaign
body: Medics of the Korean People's Army (KPA) have waged a devoted struggle for fully discharging their mission as true servants of the people, their sons and daughters and defenders of their happiness for ten days and ten nights since they buckled down to the anti-epidemic campaign at lightning speed to devotedly protect the security of the capital city and the lives and health of its citizens, on the combat order full of great trust and expectations of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. To cope with the grave situation, caused by the inroads of the malicious pandemic virus into the country, the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un convened in succession important Party meetings including a meeting of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK). And he has guided the maximum emergency anti-epidemic campaign involving the entire Party, the whole country and all the people in its van. At a Politburo consultative meeting of the Party Central Committee held again on May 15, he issued a special order of the WPK Central Military Commission on rapidly dispatching medics of the People's Army to the emergency anti-epidemic front of the capital city to stabilize the supply of medicines in Pyongyang City at once and make a decisive turn in the overall anti-epidemic situation. The KPA committee of the WPK opened an immediate enlarged meeting of its executive committee and took revolutionary and dynamic measures for inspiring the KPA medics to the implementation of the special order. The KPA medics launched the supply of medicines right after holding an oath-taking meeting in which they received the red certificates of dispatch bearing the emblem of the WPK. The commanding group of the Ministry of National Defence has organized meticulous operations and provided scrupulous guidance to steer the anti-epidemic campaign in the capital city. It carried out a re-survey to get correct locations of the pharmacies in every district and set up 50-odd new temporary mobile medicine stands in liaison with officials of the Party and government organs in order to convey the medicines carrying benevolence of the Party to capital citizens more quickly and correctly. It took timely and practical measures to meet the demands of the citizens and fully ensure their convenience. The military medics have preserved the precious medicines with much care and proactively supplied them to citizens on the basis of detailed information about every residential area, household and individual, as required by the ever-changing anti-epidemic situation. They not only helped the visitors to pharmacies but also dedicated themselves to curing patients at home. They have taken the lead in the anti-epidemic campaign by supplying medicines, treating patients and teaching folk remedies and Koryo therapies for curing aftereffects at the industrial establishments in operation and at households in 11 districts of the city. Their devoted struggle made a great contribution to raising the awareness of the crisis and the epidemic prevention among the inhabitants in the areas under their charge and making them surely ensure their voluntary unity in thinking and action. The trucks deployed at more than 670 posts have carried necessary medicines in time. Highly displayed at every post every day are the beautiful traits of the medics doing good deeds for the people as befits the ones dispatched by the Party Central Committee. Citizens in the capital city are praising the military medics who turned out in the campaign for eliminating the malignant virus to uphold the intention of the Party Central Committee. The ten days and ten nights on the emergency anti-epidemic front in the capital city were the days and nights of ardent loyalty displayed by the revolutionary army of the Party which has dedicated itself to upholding the ardent request of the Party Central Committee for devotedly protecting the lives and safety of the people and to fulfilling the demands of the revolution for making strenuous efforts to relieve the country of its heavy burden. The days and nights also witnessed the praiseworthy feats of the revolutionary medics in the great era of Kim Jong Un. Rodong Sinmun

title: Warm Benevolence for Pyongyang Citizens
body: The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un recently sent medicine kits to the war veterans, honored disabled soldiers and households in hardship in Pyongyang City. The kits carrying his warm benevolence were conveyed to the relevant households personally by members of the commanding group of the Ministry of National Defence involved in the supply of medicines and city officials. A kit contains various fever remedies, antibiotics and other medicines and health foods. Citizens hardly repress their gratitude. Thanking the Party for repeatedly sending medicines for soothing the citizens in a sudden health crisis, a war veteran living in Songyo District said that the kit moved all his family members to tears of gratitude for the benevolence of the Party. He expressed his will to devote himself to instilling the spirit of devotedly defending the country into the rising generations till the last moments of his life, as befits a member of the generation of war victors. An honored disabled solider in Sunan District said that we remain unfazed by any malignant pandemic diseases as they are under the care of the great Workers' Party. A citizen in Mangyongdae District shouted "Hurrah!" for the Workers' Party, saying the respected General Secretary is the great father who takes care of even an ordinary family despite his busy time for steering the nation-wide anti-epidemic campaign. Others expressed their determination to do their bit as capital citizens in the on-going anti-epidemic campaign. This touching news, to be etched in the records of the grand anti-epidemic campaign, greatly encourages the Korean people's struggle for braving the current trials by dint of the single-minded unity. Rodong Sinmun

title: Brisk Campaign for Producing Medicines and Medical Appliances
body: The officials and workers of pharmaceutical, Koryo medicine pharmaceutical and medical appliances factories across the country have made strenuous efforts to the utmost in hearty response to the decisions of the 8th Political Bureau Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea. In particular, the officials and workers of the field of the pharmaceutical industry have brought about an upsurge in their production. At the Sunchon Pharmaceutical Factory, the officials have worked with workers and aroused their revolutionary enthusiasm and creative activity to normalize the production of antibiotics in hard conditions. Also the Koryo medicine pharmaceutical factories have increased their production. Bearing in mind that Koryo medicines are directly linked with life and safety of the people, the Moranbong Koryo Medicine Pharmaceutical Factory produced Koryo medicines, which are nearly equivalent to monthly output, within a few days and thus contributed to treatment of fevered persons in Moranbong District. The Koryo medicine pharmaceutical factory in Huichon City registered remarkable production results in making Koryo medicine in quantity. Meanwhile, the officials and employees of the medical appliances fields including the Nampho and Myohyangsan medical appliances factories have put spurs to producing more medical appliances. Rodong Sinmun

title: In Days of Bringing up Officials as True Servants of People
body: Important Issue He Stressed It was one day in January of Juche 101(2012). The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un taught that the officials should complete our revolution by dint of revolutionary comradeship. That day he stressed importantly that the officials should devote themselves to the people. He said that the officials should make tireless efforts for people in the spirit of plucking a star from the sky and bringing a flower into bloom even on a rock if it is desired by people. He added that officials should always think what would people like and want and should do what people like and want. The meaningful teaching made by the respected General Secretary in the first days of new century of Juche taught our officials deeply even today the way to become true servants of people. Life of Officials One day in March some years ago, an official gave a word of apology to the respected General Secretary when he visited the Central Zoo. Its content was that when the clock installed in Munsu Water Park was run down for a while some time ago, the officials in the relevant field including him put people to inconvenience because they didn’t take care of and measure for it. Looking at the official who was suffering guilty conscience, the respected General Secretary said that the issue that the clock was run down in Munsu Water Park was not merely a common issue but the issue about the ideological viewpoint and work attitude of officials. He said that the issue should be seen as the issue that the hearts of the officials who serve the people stopped the beating. His teaching carried the earnest request that the officials should regard the devotional service for people as their lifeline and become the true servant of people. Be Careful Mother In December some years ago the respected General Secretary made a historic conclusion at the First Conference of Chairpersons of the Primary Committees of the Workers’ Party of Korea. In his conclusion the respected General Secretary said that the chairpersons of the Party primary committees should personify the noble viewpoint of our Party on the people and people-oriented philosophy and become the true servant of people and mother of people. And he added that the chairpersons of the Party primary committees should put themselves in the position of being fully responsible for the living of people and that the more they devote the sincerity for the better life of people, the more deeply the people feel thankfulness to motherly Party and the more solidly the whole collective unite as one family and the people’s minds will link to the central committee of WPK. Listening to his words, the participants of the conference made a pledge to become the true Party workers of the motherly Party who take care of people and devote themselves for them upholding the noble will of the respected General Secretary. His Attentive Mind At one midnight in August of Juche 107(2018) the respected General Secretary guided the trial operation of the newly-made tramcar. During the operation an official informed the respected General Secretary that when the new tramcar went to Songsan Tramcar Station people gave the tramcar a clap with satisfaction. After a while the respected General Secretary said that people’s clap showed that our people looked forward to the day when the traffic problem would be solved and the officials in the car should be stimulated from the fact that the people gave the tramcar a clap with gladness. And he added that it was the mind of people who had been used to impatiently wait for the trolley bus or tramcar to arrive in mid-summer and mid-winter. At the moment the officials bowed their heads because they recognized the noble intention of the respected General Secretary that the officials should be thoughtful of people’s mind and solve all problems from the stand of people. Rodong Sinmun

title: To Provide Power Industrial Sector with Sufficient High-quality Coal
body: At present officials and colliers of coal mines across the country are increasing their coal output while taking strict anti-epidemic measures as intended by the Party and the state. The officials go among the coal miners and share bitters and sweets with them to open the breakthrough in increasing production with firm determination to provide thermal power stations with coal as planned without fail despite any trials. The Tokchon Area Coal Mining Complex, Jenam, Namyang, Tokchon, Hyongbong, Wolbong coal mines and Sochang Youth Coal Mine actively introduced rational way of work thus supplying coal to the Pukchang Thermal Power Complex in a responsible way. Coal miners of the Namdok, Inpho, Songnam and Phunggok youth coal mines of the Pukchang Area Youth Coal Mining Complex are pooling their energy and wisdom and fulfilling their daily production quotas without fail. Those of the Joyang and Kaechon coal mines of the Kaechon Area Coal Mining Complex and Ryongdung Coal Mine of the Kujang Area Coal Mining Complex are sending more coal to thermal power stations while securing necessary materials and equipment parts on their own. Rodong Sinmun

title: Scrupulous Operation Underway to Cope with Ever-changing Anti-epidemic Situation in DPRK
body: Now that the maximum emergency anti-epidemic posture is constantly maintained across the DPRK, gaining momentum is scrupulous guidance over the operation for promptly coping with the ever-changing anti-epidemic situation. The central emergency anti-epidemic sector has completed and put into practice the operation plan that reflects in detail the issue of flexibly adjusting the state anti-epidemic policy and scientifically setting the anti-epidemic degree in each region according to the pandemic situation in liaison with experts. In particular, it has organized a public campaign for checking the spread of the malignant pandemic and completely eliminating its source at the earliest date, while ensuring perfection in land, air and sea blockades to check the inroads of new virus variants. It further tightens the lockdown of the capital city and takes stronger measures for the closure of all regions and units. It also organized epidemiological survey groups at the emergency anti-epidemic organs at all levels, which comprise the members of rapid mobile epidemic prevention teams and rapid diagnosis and treatment teams, teachers, researchers and post graduates of medical colleges, and clinical experts of provincial curative and preventive organs. Emergency anti-epidemic sectors at all levels give precedence to the test of specimens collected in rivers and lakes, while intensifying the disinfection. They make sure that the disinfection facilities at major regions and places are repaired, readjusted, maintained and managed properly, while disinfecting hundreds of thousands of cubic meters of sewage and thousands of tons of garbage every day and examining and analyzing samples. Anti-epidemic posts were set up in more than 1 840 places to intensify disinfection of passers-by and vehicles and wild animals are under close surveillance at over 1 830 places. The guide for treating COVID-19 is being updated steadily and research and discussion is being intensified to adopt relevant treatment measures. Officials of the Party and government organs have organized and carried out the work for swiftly supplying medicines on the spot. As a result, tens of millions of medicines of over 90 kinds are supplied to different parts of the country on May 24 alone. Progress is made in the medical check-up, quarantine and treatment, thanks to the devoted efforts made by a million and hundreds of thousands of health workers, teachers and students of the medical workers training institutions and sanitary workers in cooperation with inhabitants. Special attention is paid to the children, the aged and the patients with chronic diseases and the work of informing the people of hygiene information gets further intensified. State economic guidance organs and people's committees at all levels have taken measures to stabilize the people's living and secure enough anti-epidemic materials. The Cabinet has organized non-permanent groups for commanding the supply of medicines in the capital city, provinces, cities and counties with officials in the relevant fields to resolve the pending issues. It also directs efforts into the revitalization of production at the units producing anti-epidemic materials, medicine factories and Koryo medicine pharmaceutical factories across the country. It makes sure that relevant units fully supply raw and other materials for producing anti-epidemic and medical appliances and Koryo medicines effective for treating aftereffects are massively produced and supplied. People's committees in provinces, cities and counties do their best to minimize the inconvenience and sufferings of the people and stabilize their lives by supplying clean drinking water to the households and undertaking mobile services. Hundreds of tons of vegetables and fuels have been carried and sold to hundreds of thousands of households in Pyongyang City. The Pyongyang Children's Foodstuff Factory carried out its May plan for production of baby milk powder and rice powder ahead of schedule. The commercial sector and provincial people's committees give utmost priority to the supply of baby milk powder and rice powder to the children across the country. Rodong Sinmun

title: Epidemic Spread and Treatment Results in DPRK
body: According to information of the state emergency epidemic prevention headquarters, more than 100 460 fevered persons (about 5 040 less than the previous day), with 139 180 recoveries (about 17 840 less than the previous day) and one death, were reported from 18:00 of May 25 to 18:00 of May 26 throughout the country. As of 18:00 of May 26 since late April, the total number of fevered persons is over 3 270 850, of which more than 3 037 690 (92.871%) have recovered and at least 233 090 (7.127%) are under medical treatment. The death toll stands at 69 and the fatality rate is at 0.002 percent. Rodong Sinmun

title: Eager to Produce More Cement
body: Officials and workers of the cement production units across the country continue to put spurs to production of cement for major construction sites maintaining the high-level anti-epidemic posture to meet the requirements of the maximum emergency epidemic prevention system. Officials and employees of the Sangwon Cement Complex, a leading cement producer, work at top speed. Officials of the complex, giving precedence to supplies of raw and other materials, manage the equipment and rationalize manpower allotment. They focus the efforts on solving sci-tech problems to strengthen the link between processes and raise the productivity and produce and send even one more ton of cement to the major construction sites including the construction of 10 000 flats in the Hwasong area. Officials and workers of the Sunchon Cement Complex conduct a drive for increased production with the mind to emerge victorious in not only the emergency epidemic prevention campaign but also the economic construction. Those of the major production processes like calcination shop and mixed raw material shop attain the daily production goal without fail by managing the equipment in a scientific way and displaying the trait of collectivism fully. Officials and workers of the Chonnaeri Cement Factory and Sunghori Cement Factory also solve the shortage of equipment, materials and accessories on their own and make innovation in cement production. Rodong Sinmun

title: Brisk Campaign for Increasing Consumer Goods
body: Officials and workers in the sector of light industry wage vigorous production drive to bring about victory in implementing the national economic plan under the present condition of epidemic prevention war. Those of different factories like the Pyongyang Hosiery Factory, Aeguk Knitwear Factory and Sunchon Knitwear Factory are redoubling their efforts to carry out assigned production tasks. The Ryuwon and Kangso shoes factories and Wonsan Leather Shoes Factory normalize and increase shoes production on a high level while giving precedence to the supply of raw and other materials and improving the quality of their output on the principle of giving priority to quality over quantity. Production upsurges in different units of silk, cosmetics and consumer goods industries. Officials and workers of the food industry put spurs to production offensive with high enthusiasm for contributing to improvement of the people’s living standard. Those of the Pyongyang Condiments Factory solve knotty problems arising in the production one after another and make efforts to increase the production of condiments while improving their quality. In addition the Pyongyang Cornstarch Factory and Pyongyang Children’s Foodstuff Factory normalize the production by ensuring good production conditions actively. Besides, officials, technicians and skilled workers of the Pyongyang Stevia Processing Factory and Pyongyang Beer Factory overcome difficulties and trials arising in production with their devoted efforts. Rodong Sinmun

title: Support for Rural Villages Gets Brisk in DPRK
body: Public enthusiasm for supporting the countryside gets stronger across the DPRK. South Hwanghae Province directs efforts to helping the rice-transplanting in farms. According to data available, the number of helpers is beyond 150 000 in the province. The same are true of cities and counties in North Phyongan Province. In Kwaksan and Phihyon counties, helpers have recorded high results in rice-transplanting every day. In Nampho City special attention is paid to ensuring the living conditions of volunteers. People in Kangso District sent hundreds tons of compost and water pumps to a farm while giving labor assistance to it. Rodong Sinmun

title: Officials of C.C., WPK Support Kangwon Provincial People
body: Officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and their families rendered assistance to the people of Kangwon Province in a vigorous combat against the malignant epidemic. They prepared medicines for the emergency anti-epidemic work and foodstuff and daily necessities with sincerity. Those aid materials were conveyed to households in hardship in the province on May 25 and 26. Upon receiving the materials, inhabitants in Wonsan City and Anbyon, Kimhwa, Kumgang and other counties of the province expressed their excitement in high praise of the great Party and the socialist system which regards the people-first principle as its basic programme. Rodong Sinmun

title: Production of Custom-built Equipment for Juche Orientation in Metallurgical Industry Vigorously Promoted
body: Factories and enterprises in the machine-building industry put spurs to production of the custom-built equipment for Juche Orientation in the metallurgical industry upholding the decision of the 4th plenary meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee. The Ryongsong Machine Complex gives precedence to supply of materials and tools and conducts the socialist emulation vigorously as well as organizing the alternated production scrupulously and strengthening the dovetail between processes and machines. The workers and technicians of the complex actively introduce the worthy technical innovations and the advanced casting methods in line with their reality and thus manufacture products under contract of complex interior structure in a qualitative way. The Taean Heavy Machine Complex, too, introduces the sci-tech successes to hasten the manufacturing speed of accessories and mobilizes the inner reserves to the full, thus expanding the success in production. The Ranam Coal-mining Machine Complex concluded the technical preparation for the custom-built equipment production in a short span of time and conducts the drive for production vigorously amid the fierce flame of the collective technical innovation movement. The Pyongyang General Electric Cable Factory 326 also makes progress in their production. The working people of the Songchongang Electric Appliances Factory, the Kyongsong Insulator Factory and other factories and enterprises kindle the flame of collaborative innovation in the production of the custom-built equipment and accessories with the consciousness that the development of the metallurgical industry means the development of their own units. Rodong Sinmun

title: Timber Production Increased
body: Officials and workers of every provincial forestry management bureau make innovation in production of timber necessary for the major construction projects. Officials and workers of the bureau in South Hamgyong Province concluded the production of timber to send to the construction site of the Ryonpho Greenhouse Farm by waging the campaign for increased production. Workers of the Jangjin Forestry Station and Jongphyong Mine Pillar Production Station introduce the rational and effective working method actively and setting the high record every day. The Kumya Mine Pillar Production Station focuses the efforts on transportation of timber as required by the real condition and thus hit the high production record. Officials and workers of the Jagang Provincial Forestry Management Bureau also turn out to increase the timber production. Workers of the Rangnim and Hwaphyong forestry stations make collective innovation in timber production day by day, being well aware that they stand in the same trench with builders who perform feats in the struggle to realize our Party’s plan for grand construction. Those of the other forestry stations and mine pillar production stations also conduct the vigorous offensive to complete the timber production task before schedule. Rodong Sinmun

title: Giving Precedence to Production of Steel
body: Upholding the decision of the 8th Politburo meeting of the 8th WPK Central Committee, the officials and working class of the metal industrial field put spurs to producing steel necessary for the construction of 10 000 flats in Hwasong Area and Ryonpho Greenhouse Farm. Those of the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex kindle the flame of upswing in production. Supply of steel is precisely the construction speed. Let’s uphold the Party’s great plan of construction with high production records. This is the ardent desire of the complex. Officials, technicians and workers of the various units including the oxygen heat blast furnace shop and oxygen separator shop strictly observe the technical rules and standard regulations and strive to produce even one more ton of steel. The Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex, too, wages the steel production campaign vigorously. The workers of the units responsible for pig iron production, in particular, keep close ties between the processes and between the shifts and thus making a good showing every day. Officials and workers of the Chollima Steel Complex, too, organize the management of the equipment and technology in a scrupulous way and introduce the rational working method actively. Rodong Sinmun
