title: Material and Technical Foundation Consolidated to Cope with Health Crisis
body: Greater efforts are exerted to ensuring mobility and maintaining a state of mobilization in the implementation of the state epidemic prevention policy on a nationwide scale in the DPRK. The central emergency epidemic prevention sector dynamically carries on the operation and guidance to make every field and unit ensure the material and technical supply for anti-epidemic work under the condition of a state emergency. The relevant sectors and units, including the Cabinet, the State Planning Commission and the Ministry of Public Health, propel the work to build up the foundation of pharmaceutical and medical instrument industries, produce enough materials for the epidemic prevention and satisfy the demand for equipment, reagent and expendables necessary for the test of the new strains of corona virus so as to actively cope with the health crisis. A process for production of anti-epidemic supplies has been reinforced while nationwide efforts are concentrated on enough provision of raw materials. The February 8 Vinalon Complex, the Hungnam Pharmaceutical Factory, the Kangso Sprayer Factory, the Nampho Medical Appliance Factory, etc. are revitalizing the production of various kinds of disinfectants, knapsack-style sprayers and other anti-epidemic and medical equipment and materials. The public health organs across the country have produced different kinds of antiseptic solution to be sent to the units in their regions. The academic study group is deepening the work to analyze the cause of failure to respond in time to the spread of the malignant epidemic at the beginning of its outbreak and the course of treatment of it and to rapidly cope with the changing anti-epidemic situation. The Cabinet and ministries, national institutions and emergency anti-epidemic organs do their utmost to minimize the people's inconvenience and sufferings and stabilize their living and curb and eradicate the spread of the epidemic in the shortest period. Timely measures have been adopted while reviewing the issues arising in fixing the prices of medicines, ensuring the mobility and balance of supply and guaranteeing the people's livelihood every day. Careful organization is made for the smooth supply of consumer goods, foodstuff and cooking fuel to inhabitants by enhancing the responsibility and role of tens of thousands of members involved in the mobile service teams. The Pyongyang Children's Foodstuff Factory is giving priority to the supply of raw materials to increase the production of baby milk powder, and measures for the supply of milk powder are taken in provinces, cities and counties. Rapid mobile anti-epidemic teams and rapid checkup and treatment groups are on permanent standby to ensure the proactive treatment of fever cases at the soonest time. Steps were taken for the intensive treatment of serious patients currently under treatment or for new cases, and an itemized and detailed measure for thorough quarantining, treatment and medical observation of confirmed cases and close contacts and those who did not experience the course of the malignant epidemic. Emergency anti-epidemic units at all levels are actively pushing ahead with the practical work to guarantee perfection in implementing the state epidemic prevention policy by diligently observing the change in the epidemic prevention situation. Rodong Sinmun

title: Success in Offshore Fish Farming of DPRK
body: The Komalsan Offshore Atlantic Salmon Farm in the DPRK has so far released hundreds of thousands of Myongthae (Alaska Pollack) fry into the sea off the farm this year. It released tens of thousands of fry last year as it succeeded in the artificial breeding of Myongthae. As a result, it opened up a sure prospect for putting the cyclic Myongthae-breeding system on a new scientific basis. Its officials and employees are now directing efforts to perfecting the system in cooperation with researchers of the Academy of Fishery Science under the Ministry of Fisheries. Rodong Sinmun

title: 25th Congress of Chongryon Held
body: The 25th Congress of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) took place at the Korean Hall of Culture in Tokyo on May 28 and 29. The congress was attended by Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, Pak Ku Ho, first vice-chairman and director of the Organizational Department of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, Nam Sung U, Pae Jin Gu, Jo Il Yon, Song Kun Hak and Kang Chu Ryon, vice-chairpersons of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, the chairman of the Central Audit Committee of Chongryon, members and advisers of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, the director of the Research Institute on History of Korean Residents in Japan, chairpersons of Chongryon headquarters, leading officials of the central leadership bodies and affiliates, members of the Central Audit Committee of Chongryon, and deputies chosen from the institutions, organizations and affiliates of Chongryon at all levels. Nam Sung U read out "Let Us Open a New Era of Rejuvenation of Chongryon by Enlisting the Inexhaustible Strength of the Compatriots of Various Social Strata", a letter sent by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un to the participants in the congress. At the congress a credentials report was made and the agenda items "On the report on the work of the Chongryon Central Committee presented to the 25th Congress of Chongryon", "On the settlement of accounts and draft budget" and "On the election of officials of Chongryon central body" were adopted. Pak Ku Ho made a report at the congress. The reporter reviewed the 24th-term work of Chongryon and referred to the main tasks of its 25th-term work. He stressed that Kim Jong Un's letter is an encyclopedic library for the Juche-based patriotic movement which comprehensively elucidates the general orientation and tasks of the Chongryon and the movement of Koreans in Japan and the ways to carry them out, adding that it serves as an undying banner guaranteeing the eternal victory of Chongryon. He said that the congress is the one of the single-hearted unity, succession and innovation to hold President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il in higher esteem as the eternal sun of the nation and build a new milestone for the development of the movement of Koreans in Japan under the leadership of Kim Jong Un. He called on the deputies to hold fast to the historic letter as an ever-victorious treasured sword, further consolidate the single-hearted unity of the ranks and make great innovations in the units under their charge to bring about the happiness of the compatriots and the future of the rising generations. Speeches were made on the first agenda item. The participants heard and watched congratulatory messages and videos from different institutions and organizations and officials of the homeland, overseas compatriots' organizations, Japanese organizations and personages, foreign friendly organizations and south Korean figures from all walks of life. Congratulatory speeches were made by personages of political parties, social organizations and solidarity and friendship bodies of Japan. Representatives of the Korean schoolchildren in Japan entered the venue of the congress to warmly congratulate the 25th Congress. Ri Myong Yu, chairman of the Central Audit Committee of Chongryon, made a report on the work of the committee. Under the second and third agenda items, a committee for financial settlement and budget examination and a committee of model officials of the Chongryon Central Committee were formed. The report to the congress was adopted as its resolution. A report of the committee for financial settlement and budget examination was delivered and the results of the examination were adopted with unanimous approval. Ho Jong Man was elected as chairman of the Central Standing Committee of Chongryon. Also, elected were the first vice-chairperson and vice-chairpersons of the Central Standing Committee, the director general of its General Affairs Department, and members of the Central Committee of Chongryon and members of the Central Audit Committee of Chongryon. A letter to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un was adopted at the congress. At the end of the congress, the First Meeting of the 25th Central Committee of Chongryon was held, at which the Central Standing Committee of Chongryon was formed and the chairperson and vice-chairperson of the Central Audit Committee of Chongryon elected. During the congress, there was a photo exhibition showing the undying exploits of Kim Jong Un and the stirring reality of the DPRK and the struggle of institutions at all levels under Chongryon and Koreans in Japan. A music and dance performance was given and an exhibition held to show the achievements made in developing the national education of Chongryon. Rodong Sinmun

title: Letter to Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un from Participants
body: in 25th Chongryon Congress The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a letter from the participants in the 25th Congress of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) on Sunday. The letter said the congress was successfully held as the one of the single-minded unity marking a new milestone of the movement of Koreans in Japan and the one of inheritance and innovation, thanks to the paternal love of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un. The letter praised Kim Jong Un as the peerless hero who has guided the Korean-style socialism to victory and ushered in a new golden age of prosperity unprecedented in the 5 000-year-long national history by boldly overcoming the unprecedentedly manifold severe challenges and difficulties by dint of his far-sighted wisdom, extraordinary leadership and scientific strategy and tactics. Kim Jong Un is an ever-victorious brilliant commander who bolstered up the self-defensive war deterrent of the country, a peerless patriot who put the independent dignity and might of Juche Korea on the highest level, and the loadstar of the national reunification who firmly united the patriotic reunification forces in the north and the south and overseas as one, the letter said. The letter noted that Kim Jong Un sent congratulatory letters to the participants of the 24th Congress of Chongryon and the Conference of Representatives of Branches of Chongryon-2020 (Third Conference of a New Heyday), adding that he personally guided the patriotic movement of Chongryon for bringing earlier a new golden age by sending New Year's greetings to them every year. It said that Chongryon would put the general direction of its 25th-term work into decisively strengthening the organizational and ideological might of Chongryon by implementing the important tasks set forth in the historic letter of Kim Jong Un without fail and into definitely putting the movement of Koreans in Japan on the stage of its overall development, and thus more vigorously open up a new golden age of the movement of Koreans in Japan, a new era of prosperity of Chongryon by pooling the efforts of the compatriots from all walks of life. The letter stressed that all the Chongryon officials and Koreans in Japan would make tangible contribution to the independent reunification of the country and the overall development of socialist construction in keeping with our state-first era, bearing deep in mind the pride and honor of being overseas citizens of the DPRK. Rodong Sinmun

title: With Warm Care of Motherly Party
body: The officials of Sukchon County devotedly work for bringing the warm love of the motherly Party to the people substantially. They take thoroughgoing measures to correctly supply the medicines to inhabitants in time. Reflected in their minds was the image of the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un like benevolent father, who visited pharmacies in Pyongyang City in person, just after ending the consultative meeting of the Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee, and left traces of making selfless, devoted efforts for the people. Now when every second of grand anti-epidemic war passes, they recollect what they are doing for the people loved by the respected General Secretary all day long. Their determination is to defend and uphold our people by exerting themselves true to his intention of devoted service for the people of the General Secretary who devotes his all to people’s health and their life and safety standing in the frontline for defending the people. The officials of the county always think and make strenuous efforts with the burning will to make selfless, devoted efforts for the people with warm love of motherly Party. Rodong Sinmun

title: Moral Virtue and Warm Affection
body: Sincerity of Assisters Touches Farmers At an evening several days ago some people went round the village of the 6th Workteam of the Phyongjong Co-op Farm in Anak County, visiting all houses and asking if there were patients or difficulties in the families. They are officials of the Ministry of Mining Industry. The officials of the ministry and government employees got close with the farmers during the days of struggling against the drought in the same trench of the farmers, helping the farming process sincerely, paying deep attention to the living of the farmers and solving the knotty problems of their life. They took the measure in everything including carrying the medicines and moving the fevered persons to the quarantine area and gave the farmers the reserve medicines and food without hesitation. They also did not have enough medicines and food but they thought first the farmers who devoted their sweat, conscious of being responsible for the granary of the country. How warm and beautiful their minds are! The farmers impressed by sincerity of the officials and government employees are filled with enthusiasm for guarding the forefront in defending socialism bearing their request and expectation. Night Journey Made for Five Families One day in the last mid-May two people were walking carrying burdens on their backs through the valley far from the seat of Susin-ri, Tongsin County. They were officials of the ri and they were carrying the food, essential foodstuff and daily necessities for the five households living near the sanctuary for useful animals. The case stood thus. That day they came to know the fact that the daily commodities including food were not supplied to the five families who lived farthest away from the seat of the ri. Who are the people living there and for whom are we working? We should not make even a family or a resident suffer from the inconvenience in living. They thought this and carried burdens on their backs and started their journey. The residents moved to tears seeing the officials who visited their houses while their clothes were wringing wet with sweat. Thanks to such officials, the servants of people who are eager to make a journey through a mountain path at midnight and find happiness and worth of life from the happy appearances of people, the remote mountainous village, too, is always overflowing with warm affection. Greeting of a Medical Worker in Charge of Households Pak Son Hui, a medical worker of the Inhung Polyclinic in Moranbong District, is also a mother with her child and serves her father-in-law. She used to make a phone call because of worry about her family though she was so busy with the medical examination of households in charge. Whenever she made a phone call, she was asked by her father-in-law not to worry about the family but devote herself to her work as a medical worker. She was encouraged by his words and continued her work. One of these days she was informed of the surprising fact by her family that Kim Kum Ju, a resident living in the 51st Neighborhood-unit in Inhung-dong No.1 sent Pak’s family a lot of foodstuffs. At the moment the faces of the residents in her charge came across her mind one by one. They handed over the special dishes and tonics to her. Being thankful to the residents who appreciated her service, she always used to greet them. The greeting of a medical worker in charge of households means greeting of thanks to the people who encourage her to continue the road of defending the lives of people to the end. Rodong Sinmun

title: His Image Kept in People’s Minds
body: When He Is So Pleased Among lots of stories conveying the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un’s love for people is an unforgettable fact associated with the Jungphyong Vegetable Greenhouse Farm. One day in August Juche 107(2018), the respected General Secretary visited the Jungphyong area by train all night for guiding the preparations for building the vegetable greenhouse farm after giving field guidance to the Onchon area in Yangdok County. The officials hardly repressed their warm outburst looking up to him who was anxious for providing the people of North Hamgyong Province with fresh vegetables as soon as possible. Despite the sultry weather at midday, he saw to it that the construction site of the vegetable greenhouse farm was correctly confirmed by mobilizing a plane irrespective of his labor and he indicated the orientation and ways for constructing the farm on the highest level in keeping with world sci-tech development trend and our realities. After a while, the respected General Secretary said that he was very pleased when he found the work to provide sufficient and happy life for the people. Indeed, it was strong emotion that can be burst only by our respected General Secretary who regards the pleasure and happiness of the people as his best pleasure and pride. The Way We Must Go Without Fail In August two years ago, the respected General Secretary visited the flood-hit Taechong-ri in Unpha County for the second time. After giving detailed instructions related with life of residents and construction of their dwelling houses, he signified his intention to go to severely damaged places. When the officials hastily persuaded him not to go along the way as it was rough and slippery, he got in the car saying that he would learn about the damage situation in person, though the way was so rough. He went to the places and gently asked what kind of dwelling houses the farmers want and instructed to build the farm villages desired by people. Through the image of the respected General Secretary who made the sacred journey of love for people regarding the way for people as the most worthwhile one, our people saw the noble world of devoted service for the people of the great father who has devoted all to the people. Rodong Sinmun

title: Indomitable Spirit Displayed by DPRK People in Overcoming Difficulties
body: The spread of the malignant pandemic disease brought the DPRK to the worst upheaval ever since its foundation. However, the Korean people have given full play to their indomitable spirit, the treasured sword enabling them to turn difficulties into victories, without any slightest vacillation or pessimism. There is nothing to fear and impossible to do when we fully display our indomitable spirit―this is the faith of the Korean people. The course of the Korean revolution is not smooth at all. It has been so arduous that others would not stand even a single day. But the Korean people have strenuously advanced, overcoming all difficulties. They liberated the country by waging a long bloody anti-Japanese war with the indomitable spirit. They also defeated the U.S. imperialist aggressors armed with A-bombs in the three-year-long hard-fought Fatherland Liberation War. They also overcame such hardship as the arduous march, the forced march in the 1990s when they were at a crossroads―whether to emerge victorious by remaining independent or to become colonial slaves of the imperialists. Let us fully demonstrate the power and spirit of heroic Korea with an indomitable spirit!―this is the strong fighting spirit peculiar to the Korean people pushing ahead with the anti-epidemic struggle and the economic construction simultaneously. Rodong Sinmun

title: 20th Plenary Meeting of 14th SPA Standing Committee of DPRK Held
body: The 20th Plenary Meeting of the 14th Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly (SPA) of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) was held at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on May 31. Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and chairman of the SPA Standing Committee, presided over the plenary meeting. It was attended by Kang Yun Sok and Pak Yong Il, vice-chairmen of the SPA Standing Committee, Secretary General Ko Kil Son and other members of the SPA Standing Committee. Present as observers were officials concerned of the SPA Standing Committee, the Secretariat of the Cabinet, the state emergency epidemic prevention headquarters, ministries and national institutions. Placed on its agenda were the issues of adopting the DPRK's law on the place of origin and geographical identification, law on medical examination and revised and supplemented laws on emergency anti-epidemic work and on road and recalling and electing judges of the DPRK Central Court and people's assessors. A report was made on the gist of the relevant laws and the draft amendments examined at the SPA Legislation Committee. The law on the place of origin and geographical identification has a mission to protect the interests of organs, enterprises and organizations manufacturing special products by establishing a system and order for registration, examination and protection of the place of origin and geographical identification and thus contribute to the development of the national economy. The law on medical examination specifies the principled matters arising in medical examination, the action rules of medical examination institutions, the procedures and methods for medical examination, and the guidance and control over medical examination. The law on emergency anti-epidemic work and the law on road further detail the parts on the establishment of the maximum emergency anti-epidemic system and disinfection and legal responsibilities for violation of the emergency anti-epidemic order. Supplemented to them are paragraphs for contributing to the country's economic development and the people's convenience of life and giving a face-lift to the land of the country. The plenary meeting studied and examined the presented agendas and adopted the decrees of the SPA Standing Committee "On adopting the Law of the DPRK on the Place of Origin and Geographical Identification", "On adopting the Law of the DPRK on Medical Examination", "On modifying and supplementing the Law of the DPRK on Emergency Anti-Epidemic Work" and "On modifying and supplementing the Law of the DPRK on Road". The plenary meeting recalled and elected judges and people's assessors of the Central Court of the DPRK. Rodong Sinmun

title: More Farms and Workteams Finish Rice-transplanting in DPRK
body: More farms and workteams have finished their rice-transplanting in time in the DPRK. As of May 29, at least 30 farms and some 500 workteams had finished their planned rice-transplanting in South Hwanghae Province. Cooperative farms in Anak, Sinchon and Jaeryong counties distinguished themselves in rice-transplanting. As of May 28, 56 co-op farms and more than 420 workteams in North Phyongan Province finished their rice-transplanting in the main. The same are true of farms in North Hwanghae Province and South Hamgyong Province, where a dynamic campaign for overtaking, learning about and swapping experiences one another is underway. Rodong Sinmun

body: According to information of the state emergency epidemic prevention headquarters, more than 93 180 fevered cases, with 98 350 recoveries, were reported from 18:00 of May 30 to 18:00 of May 31 throughout the country. As of 18:00 of May 31 since late April, the total number of fevered persons is over 3 738 810, of which more than 3 560 960 (95.243%) have recovered and at least 177 770 (4.755%) are under medical treatment. title: Emergency Anti-Epidemic Work Put on More Scientific and Specialized Basis in DPRK
body: The central emergency anti-epidemic sector of the DPRK is concentrating efforts on putting anti-epidemic work on a scientific and specialized basis. Being conducted across the country is the work for raising the scientific, theoretical and professional qualification of anti-epidemic workers to make them quickly and accurately cope with any public health crisis. Emergency anti-epidemic sectors at all levels are taking proactive measures for acquiring necessary knowledge under the condition that more than 300 000 public health workers, teachers and students from institutions for training medical workers across the country are involved in emergency anti-epidemic work. The system of training experts on anti-epidemic sector is being established on a higher level, and online reeducation and technical workshops are intensified. Many anti-epidemic officials have avidly studied advanced technology of anti-epidemic field while being enrolled in the reeducation system since the maximum emergency anti-epidemic system was activated. The emergency anti-epidemic sector and scientific research units are solving in time sci-tech issues arising in improving the capacity of nucleic acid tests, and taking practical measures to conduct relevant tests via air samplers at public places in Pyongyang City. The public health sector concretely shapes and issues understanding items and scrupulously organizes the work for sharing good treatment tactics and experience that reaction and adverse reaction of various medicines are detailed and diversified according to ages and physical constitutions. Public health organs in each province, city and county are deepening collective discussions and researches for rationally introducing treatment guidelines and medication instructions to suit the specific conditions in contact with central hospitals on the basis of assessment of clinical experiences made in the course of treating patients. The Cabinet and relevant sectors and units are directing efforts to improving the capability for quickly coping with the variable epidemic prevention situation while taking more thoroughgoing measures for material and technical supply to cement the anti-epidemic foundation of the state. Rodong Sinmun

title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Reply Message from Cuban President
body: Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, received a reply message from Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez, first secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba and president of the Republic of Cuba, on May 25. The message expressed thanks to Kim Jong Un for sending a message of sympathy over the accident at Saratoga Hotel in Havana on May 6 on behalf of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba and the government and people of Cuba. It said that the solidarity showed by the fraternal DPRK encourages Cuba in its efforts to eradicate the aftereffects of the heartbreaking accident and once again demonstrated that the historic ties of friendship and cooperation between the two countries are growing strong. Rodong Sinmun

title: Anti-Epidemic Campaign in Full Swing in DPRK
body: A newly organized COVID-19 treatment and research team operates in the DPRK to develop treatment methods for scientifically controlling the spread of the malignant virus. It comprises experts from educational institutions, central hospitals and hygienic and anti-epidemic organs. It orients its study on finding optimum treatment methods and confirming the days of virus-releasing by those infected and recovery time and on enhancing the efficiency of treatment medicines. Since its inauguration, the team has drawn up the treatment ways for those with fever of different degrees on the basis of the compilation of the patients' appeal, their clinical history, symptoms and test findings. By intensively using modern and traditional medication methods, it scrupulously carries on the work to confirm, revise and supplement the contents of the existing guide for treating COVID-19. Research on how long the virus survives in those infected and how to confirm the recovery time and the standard recovery index is underway. The team has also carried out the work to evaluate the rationality of various sample-collecting methods, enhance the accuracy of its test results to the maximum, assess the clinical efficiency of various treatment medicines based on the state of improvement of clinical symptoms of patients and conduct the genetic analysis of the virus. Rodong Sinmun

title: Benevolence of Party for People
body: The campaign to defend the health and living of people is being conducted in the DPRK. In those days of the war without gun report our people kept deep in their minds the warm care of our Party that does not feel easy about the precious lives of her sons and daughters and cares the whole country with ardent affection and devotion. Throughout the country a lot of vehicles are running towards the streets, villages and work sites. Officials of the Party and power organs and of relevant units are getting on the vehicles with drivers. The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un said that it is urgent to more deeply realize for what we are needed and for whom we fight at the cost of our lives. Bearing this noble consciousness taught by the respected General Secretary many officials are working hard with the firm determination to become the advancing group, shock brigade and bulletproof wall in the campaign for defending the people. People irrespective of age and sex across the country say in a unanimous voice with tears that they cannot live even a moment without the embrace of the respected General Secretary, our benevolent father. Rodong Sinmun

title: Becoming Scouts and Bulletproof Walls
body: The officials of the Sosong District Party Committee hold a serious discussion again, keeping in mind the high intention of the Workers’ Party of Korea to turn out resolutely for the campaign for defending the people with boundless devotion and invariable loyalty to them. Clearly seen on their faces is determination to stubbornly make a dash, not to fall back even a step, in the way of carrying the Party’s anti-epidemic policies into practice most thoroughly and perfectly. Let our Party officials defend the people in district to the last in the anti-epidemic campaign becoming scouts and bulletproof walls! The place of consultative meeting, full of high enthusiasm, reaches the climax of discussion as time goes by. Rodong Sinmun

title: To Put Efforts into Production of Koryo Medicines
body: Officials of North Hwanghae Province actively take measures to increase production of Koryo medicines. The officials vigorously conduct organizational work for increasing production of Koryo medicines on the basis of grasping situations of the province under the guidance of the provincial Party committee. In order to solve the shortage of materials, they put big efforts into providing medicinal plants to Koryo medicine production units by mobilizing resources to the maximum in cities and counties. They also strengthen control and guidance for making relevant units meticulously organize the production in a rational way. Tens of units including Koryo medicine factories in cities and counties have produced plenty of medicines in a short time. The province established a well-organized system of supplying produced Koryo medicines to residents for medical and preventive treatment. The province continues to intensify organizational work such as producing more efficacious Koryo medicines by actively mobilizing domestic resources of materials for ensuring the victory of anti-epidemic war. Rodong Sinmun

title: DPRK Premier Inspects Pharmaceutical Factories
body: Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and premier of the Cabinet, inspected Pyongyang and Sunchon pharmaceutical factories. Going round the Pyongyang Pharmaceutical Factory under remodeling, the premier called on its officials to display the traits of implementing the Party decisions unconditionally, thoroughly and accurately, mindful of the Party's intention to put the country's pharmaceutical industry on a new higher level, and thus tangibly contribute to consolidating the material and technical foundation of the public health sector. Sufficient production and supply of medicines serve as a prerequisite to protecting the people's lives and health in the current rigorous anti-epidemic campaign, he said, calling for turning the factory into a model and standard factory of the pharmaceutical industry, as intended by the Party, at an early date. At the Sunchon Pharmaceutical Factory, he stressed the need to put on a normal basis the production of various kinds of medicines, fit for our people's constitution and demands and for the international quality control standards, and step up the work for the home production of raw and other materials by enlisting the scientific and technological potentials to the full. On-site consultative meetings took measures after discussing the issue of extending the production capacity of pharmaceutical factories on a long-term basis, the issue of decisively raising the scientific level of production processes and the issue for the relevant sectors and units to provide in time the equipment and materials needed for the modernization of those factories. Rodong Sinmun

title: Campaign against Epidemic Spread Intensifies in DPRK
body: All provinces of the DPRK intensify the emergency anti-epidemic campaign in keeping with their respective natural and topographical features and economic conditions. The central emergency epidemic prevention sector has put forward clear orientations, which have to be taken by every region and sector in their works, on the basis of survey and analysis of the nationwide epidemic spread. It has tightened the anti-epidemic discipline by enhancing its controlling and executive abilities. The emergency epidemic prevention sectors in different parts of the country concentrate their efforts on turning their regions into epidemic-safe zones in the shortest time by increasing the ability of stably curbing and controlling the epidemic spread. North Hwanghae Province strictly enforces the lockdown measure for every region and unit, pushing ahead with the immediate farming work. Rural areas of North Hwanghae and Kangwon provinces have rationally organized the work for tightly closing workteams, sub-workteams and groups of helpers and normalized disinfection and examination of water quality so as to ensure hygienic safety. Ryanggang Province and Nampho City have produced efficient Koryo medicines to treat patients and increased the production of anti-epidemic supplies with locally available raw and other materials, contributing to the state epidemic prevention work. Rodong Sinmun

title: Big Blasting Witnessed at Sunchon Limestone Mine of DPRK
body: The Sunchon Limestone Mine in the DPRK successfully carried out the blasting of 100 000 cubic meters of earth on May 31. Its officials and workers are concentrating their efforts and means on conveying ores. Rodong Sinmun

title: Reference on Folk Remedies for Treatment of COVID-19 Distributed in DPRK
body: The DPRK Ministry of Public Health made references titled "Folk remedies for the treatment of COVID-19" to distribute them among preventive and curative institutions at all levels and relevant units in the capital city of Pyongyang and local areas. The references deal with the folk remedies for fever, cough, sputum and sore throat and relevant precautions. Rodong Sinmun

title: Achievements Made in Production of Koryo Medicines
body: Koryo medicine producers in the DPRK over-fulfilled their national economic plans for May by pushing ahead with the production of medicines contributable to the anti-epidemic campaign. Koryo medicine production units in North Hwanghae, North Phyongan and North Hamgyong provinces produced efficient traditional medicines while prioritizing the work to thoroughly ensure the hygienic safety of products and directing efforts to the improvement of their quality. Those in Ryanggang Province and Kaesong City fulfilled their plans by indices. Such progress was also witnessed at Koryo medicine producers in South Hamgyong, Kangwon, South Hwanghae and South Phyongan provinces. Rodong Sinmun

title: "We Didn’t Know All in Ordinary Days"
body: Under the difficult situation of public health crisis, our people have warmly felt the benefit of the Workers’ Party of Korea and state every day and moment, which they did not know all in ordinary days. Anybody is moved to tears by receiving even a packet of medicine and seeing food and subsidiary food put in front of door of each family after the operation of the maximum emergency epidemic prevention system. Doctors working in the Unpha County People’s Hospital say that they have never seen so many people visiting the hospital as now since its operation. They said: "It is not because the patients increase. Inhabitants do not leave the hospital after receiving medicines sent by the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un and thank us. Then, we say to them that greetings should be sent to our Party. With tears we see them making a bow before the portraits of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il. It can never be imagined in capitalist society." Through the figures of officials in different areas who strive for stabilizing the people’s life true to the Party’s intention, our people feel the love of our Party and gratitude to socialist system every moment. The realities can be seen only in our country where the officials, medical workers, heads of people’s neighborhood units and mobile servers put warm sincerity into healing the pains and troubles of the people. Therefore, now our people make a big stride for hastening the date as soon as possible for bringing great victory and successes in anti-epidemic campaign and economic construction, with the patriotic will to repay the benefit of the Party and state they receive every day and moment. Rodong Sinmun

title: Patriotism Dedicated to Enriching Long History of Our Nation
body: Discovering historical remains and relics is of significance in illustrating the eternity and good qualities of our nation. Among those who devote their all to this noble patriotic work is a study group of the History Faculty of Kim Il Sung University. Recently they discovered cave relics dating back to the Paleolithic Age in Rimgyong Workers’ District in Kangdong County and intensified the research into the relics to scientifically unravel them. In the past days the research group did a lot of works upholding the Party’s intention to enrich the treasure house of the cultural heritage of our nation by discovering more worthy historical remains and relics. In particular, the group intensified the research since tens of years ago to find the remains of the Paleolithic Age in Kangdong area where the ancestral father of the Korean nation Tangun is entombed. The research of the historical remains in the Primitive Age of no letters required more delicate and multi-faceted knowledge, strong will and fortitude than the one to recover other kinds of historical remains. However, the researchers continued the discovery without yielding despite the repeated failure and difficulties. In those days they conducted the reinvestigation of historical remains in Kangdong area and thus discovered the Juhyong-dong relics dating back to the Neolithic Age in Ransan-ri and the cave relics in Hyangmok-ri dating back to the Old Stone Age, the New Stone Age and the Bronze Age. Then followed the discovery of human fossils who lived in the latter period of the Paleolithic Age thanks to their painstaking efforts and research. The Archaeology Society of the DPRK examined the fossils discovered in the natural cave in Rimgyong Workers’ District in Kangdong County and named the human fossils "Kangdong person" according to the name of the area. The first discovery of the "Kangdong person" on a par with Neolithic man at the Kangdong area of Pyongyang, where Tangun, the ancestral father of the Korean nation, is buried, is of great significance in anthropologically clarifying that people have continuously lived in this area since the dawn of human civilization, creating time-honored history and culture. The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un highly appreciated their success made in their research, ensured that they were awarded with state commendations and let the whole country know them. Today they put much more spurs to the patriotic work without satisfaction to inspire our people with national pride and self-esteem and add more shine to the national history of 5 000 years. Rodong Sinmun

title: Moral Virtue and Warm Affection
body: Warm Affection Shared between People and Army Several days ago some women visited the Ansan Branch of Konhap Shop located in Ansan-dong No.2 in Phyongchon District. In actuality, they had already been there several times. Because they were deeply impressed by the soldiers who have devoted sincerity to the living of people and the cure of patients since they arrived upholding the special order of the chairman of the Workers’ Party of Korea Central Military Commission. They were anxious to do a good deed for soldiers. So they sent some aid materials to soldiers, but those were refused to receive by the soldiers. One day Ri Sun Ae, chairwoman of the primary women’s union in Ansan-dong No.2, saw the armband of the soldiers. She made phone calls to the union members to make armbands for soldiers. They also made thousands of medicine envelopes as well as armbands, because they had seen soldiers making medicine envelopes during the leisure time. Ri Sun Ae said earnestly handing over the armbands and medicine envelopes to the soldiers. “Soldiers, these are your sisters’ devotion to you. So please receive these things.” Our days pass with warm affection and love. Meaningful Birthday Spread It happened some days ago. Seeing the dishes prepared for employees on their birthdays, Pak Sun Ok, manager of the Unsan County Garment Factory, was lost in deep thought. (What can I do more for them?) She felt as if her sincerity was insufficient, though she did her best for employees who would mark their birthdays at the boarding house. It was not easy to arrange a rich birthday spread under the emergency epidemic situation but Pak devoted her sincerity for employees as she was an official who finds happiness in serving employees. The employees receiving the birthday spread were deeply impressed and made a determination to do more works for the factory and country keeping deep in minds the sincerity of the officials of the factory who pay deep attention to the living of the employees true to the Party’s intention. Tens of Years Reflected on a Day One day a disabled soldier Yun Jung Su resided in Kinmaul-dong No.1 in Moranbong District received aid materials from Kim Jong Hwa, who is a workshop head of the Pyongyang Footwear Factory. Yun came to know Kim 20-odd years ago. In those days Kim has devoted sincerity to Yun. Though Kim was busy due to the anti-epidemic campaign, she has always paid attention to living of Yun. She visited Yun’s home from time to time and learnt the living condition. That day was an ordinary day but Yun came to know Kim Jong Hwa again. That day reflects tens of years during which Kim has devoted herself to upholding the intention of the Party that values the disabled soldiers. Home Visit of Officials Several days ago some people visited the house of Kim Myong Hwa, tailor of Kanggye Bag Factory. They were Manager Kim Sun Hui and other officials of the factory. The family members were so moved, because the officials visited their house more frequently than ever and paid attention to their living after the state epidemic prevention work was switched over to the maximum emergency epidemic prevention system. One day when they were working under the situation in which working unit, production unit and residential unit were isolated from each other, the officials of the factory came to know the fact that 10-odd housewives including Kim Myong Hwa worried about their families. Promptly a consultative meeting was held and home visits were organized. Since then the officials have visited the houses of the women employees. The family members felt the paternal affection from the figures of the officials. Thanks to the officials who care for their employees the harmony and unity of the collective are realized and those lead to production successes. Rodong Sinmun

title: Epidemic Spread and Treatment Results in DPRK
body: According to information of the state emergency epidemic prevention headquarters, more than 82 160 fevered cases, with 93 830 recoveries, were reported from 18:00 of June 1 to 18:00 of June 2 throughout the country. As of 18:00 of June 2 since late April, the total number of fevered persons is over 3 917 580, of which more than 3 763 790 (96.074%) have recovered and at least 153 720 (3.924%) are under medical treatment. Rodong Sinmun

title: Stability of People's Life and Promotion of Their Health Prioritized in DPRK
body: All sectors and units in the DPRK are making redoubled efforts to stabilize the people's life and promote their health, regarding them as the top-priority task. The Cabinet and the central emergency anti-epidemic sector make sure that the advantage of the Korean-style socialist system centered on the popular masses is more clearly demonstrated in the emergency anti-epidemic situation by taking timely measures for executing the steps taken by the Party and the state for stabilizing the people's life without the slight deviation or fluctuation. Officials of the Party organizations, power bodies and economic guidance organs at all levels are striving to provide the people with good living and treating conditions despite difficulties. On June 1 alone, ten millions of medicines of more than 190 kinds were supplied to preventive and curative organs and every province so as to ensure the mobility and regional balance in the supply of medicines, and a progress has been made in the treatment of those with fever and aftereffects. Pharmaceutical factories are increasing the production of various injections, pills and Koryo medicines needed in the treatment of patients. The Cabinet and provincial people's committees have taken practical measures for ensuring the smooth supply and sale of food and prioritized the supply of food to quarantine places. The commercial sector has secured a large number of goods in order to supply various daily necessities to the provinces. Hundreds of tons of vegetables were supplied to inhabitants and quarantine places across the country on June 1 alone and mobile service teams are active. The public health, financial and banking sectors have taken measures for promoting the people's convenience in the purchase, sale and supply of medicines. The urban management sector supplies the quality water to the inhabitants on a regular basis. On June 1, emergency anti-epidemic units at all levels disinfected over 15 300 dumps and disposed of thousands of tons of garbage to thoroughly check and eradicate the epidemic spread and remove spaces and factors which can exercise a negative influence on ecological and living environment. The ministries, national institutions and power organs at all levels are strictly implementing the state anti-epidemic policies while continuing to pay attention to stabilizing the people's life and promoting their convenience. Rodong Sinmun

title: Measures for Stabilizing People's Life Taken in DPRK
body: The Cabinet of the DPRK has taken measures for stabilizing the people's life since the activation of the maximum emergency anti-epidemic system. It is scrupulously organizing the work for grasping the state of food supply in all provinces, cities and counties and transporting food in time. It is taking steps for increasing the output at factories and enterprises in the light industrial sector, in the agricultural sector and at the vegetable greenhouses. It is paying a great attention to the production and supply of nutritive foodstuff for children. Raw and other materials have been supplied to production units including the Pyongyang Children's Foodstuff Factory. As a result, more baby milk powder and rice powder have been produced than the plans and nutritive goods for children supplied to relevant households. The urban management sector has produced and supplied drinking water on a normal basis. Rodong Sinmun

title: Koryo and Other Medicines Produced in DPRK
body: Koryo medicine producers across the DPRK are striving to increase the production for preventive and curative units. The Yomju County Koryo Medicine Pharmaceutical Factory has supplied effective Samhyanguhwangchongsimhwan and other Koryo medicines to different units. The Kaesong City Disabled Soldiers' Koryo Medicine Pharmaceutical Factory has produced a lot of Koryo medicines, and Koryo medicines produced at the Thosong Pharmaceutical Factory have been supplied to preventive and curative units for medical service for inhabitants. The North Hwanghae Provincial People's Hospital urges its pharmacists to contribute to treatment by producing more medicines. The Rason City People's Hospital and the Ryanggang Provincial Hospital of Koryo Medicine push ahead with the work for producing medicines with their own efforts to treat patients and for supplying them to several units. The same is true of the Kyongsong County Koryo Medicine Pharmaceutical Factory, the Samjiyon City Koryo Medicine Pharmaceutical Factory, the Moranbong District People's Hospital, the Thaechon County People's Hospital. Rodong Sinmun

title: Various Economic Sectors and Units of DPRK Fulfill May Economic Plans
body: Many economic sectors and units of the DPRK have carried out their economic plans for May. After setting the dynamic and scientific goals and plans, the officials in the key industrial sectors scrupulously did the organizational and political work to implement the Party decisions. The Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex raised the level of pig iron production through the technical innovation campaign for increasing the daily output of the oxygen heat blast furnace. The Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex, Posan Iron Works and Unryul Mine exceeded their monthly plans and the Puryong Ferroalloy Factory and the Hungnam Electrode Factory increased the production of ferrosilicon, electrode and fireproof materials. In the chemical industrial sector, the officials and workers of the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex, the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex and the February 8 Vinalon Complex successfully fulfilled their plans for every day and every ten days in the severe anti-epidemic struggle. All the units under the Ministry of Electric Power Industry also overfulfilled their plans for May. In one month, more tens of millions of kWh of electricity was produced than planned. The coal industrial sector also mined more coal than scheduled. The railway transport sector carried cargoes 1.2 times more than before. The officials and workers of the machine-building industrial sector carried out their daily and weekly plans for producing equipment and accessories. The construction and building-materials industrial sector fulfilled the daily plans so as to provide lots of cement for the grand construction sites of socialism and increase the flat glass production. The forestry sector also attained the goals for timber production. Factories in the knitting industrial sector carried out the plans for the production of summer school uniforms of new forms for the pupils of primary schools. Foodstuff producers also increased the production. The Pyongyang Children's Foodstuff Factory fulfilled the May plan for the production of baby milk powder and rice powder ahead of schedule. The Salt Industry Bureau and factories in the local industrial sector strengthened their own technical forces and tapped the locally available raw and other materials so as to make progress in implementing their monthly plans. Rodong Sinmun

title: Sodium Carbonate Production Process Upgraded in DPRK
body: The Namhung Youth Chemical Complex finished the project for upgrading the production process of sodium carbonate. Officials and workers of the complex had strived to upgrade the production process of sodium carbonate to manufacture, assemble and install hundreds of equipment. Officials of the Ministry of Chemical Industry and the State Commission of Science and Technology developed new technology of upgrading the production process of sodium carbonate based on locally available raw materials in the Korean style. Workers of the complex had introduced rational construction methods to push ahead with the project as planned. The complex is making a trial operation of the production process of sodium carbonate. Rodong Sinmun

title: Touching Stories Conveyed by Monumental Edifices
body: If People Like It and If It Is in Their Interests One March day in Juche 106(2017) the respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un visited Ryomyong Street under construction. He arrived at the street construction site early in the morning. Seeing the brightly illuminated street with a broad smile, he said that the street was near completion even though its construction was discontinued for three months on account of the campaign for recovery from the damage in the northern part of the country last year. Going round various parts of the street, the respected General Secretary earnestly said that he felt as if he were seeing the happy people who would settle in Ryomyong Street and that any difficult job must be done if the people like it and if it is in their interests. Looking up to him, accompanying officials were impressed with feelings that the street could be built successfully in spite of trials and difficulties, thanks to the endless devotion and love of the benevolent father. Do Create and Develop in Our Own Style One May day several years ago, the respected General Secretary inspected the completed Koam-Tapchon Railways. Feasting his eyes on a railway bridge across the rough sea, the respected General Secretary said to accompanying officials that it was fantastic. Builders, scientists and technologists successfully built the railway bridge across the rough sea of Sokjon Bay and hewed out an unprecedented new ground in the DPRK’s history of railway construction. Noting with appreciation that they wonderfully designed the marine railway bridge in Sokjon Bay and carried out its construction qualitatively, he repeatedly expressed satisfaction at the fact that one more valuable edifice was built on the east coast of the country. Going round the railways, he instructed the officials to create and develop everything our own way by relying on our efforts, technology and resources in the future, too. The officials deeply kept in their minds his noble intention that all buildings should become precious wealth reflecting our ideal and wishes and our wisdom and enthusiasm. Grand Conception for Regional Construction One October day Juche 108(2019), the respected General Secretary visited the construction sites in the then Samjiyon County. Enjoying the panoramic view of the township whose looks changed beyond recognition, he was informed in detail of the second-phase project. All buildings in the township area reminiscent of a city were built to fully reflect the modern beauty in good harmony with the natural forests of Mt Paektu. He said to accompanying officials that valuable experience and lessons for regional construction have been gained and a precious foundation, a revolutionary springboard for successful realization of the Party’s idea of regional construction, was provided through such a gigantic campaign for creation as the remodeling of Samjiyon County. Then he added that we should continue to wage great construction campaigns of model and weighty significance, so as to develop regional construction with vivid local characters on the basis of the Juche-based architectural aesthetic idea in all parts of the country. The officials were in great excitement picturing the future of the country changed beyond recognition under the grand conception for regional construction of the respected General Secretary. Rodong Sinmun

title: Virtues and Beautiful Traits Further Displayed in Ordeal
body: A few days ago, the illness of a veteran living in Undok-dong No.2, Hanggu District, was further aggravated. At that time, the dong-officials and the head of people’s neighborhood unit visited him to learn in detail about his condition and then neighbors gave him their household medicines. And a clinic doctor in charge of households took due measures passing a night without sleep. When the veteran’s condition was improved, Jong Yon Ok, a worker of the station of supply of goods in the district and other many people sent him the materials for tonics and foodstuff for recovering his health. Here goes another story. There is a family in people’s neighborhood unit No.84, Kaeson-dong, Moranbong District, which is deeply concerned by neighbors. The family was not well-known among its people. Since the maximum emergency epidemic prevention was set, the neighbors’ sincerities began to flow into that house. Perceiving the fact that there were only brother-and-sister threesome as their parents have engaged in anti-epidemic work, the neighbors have taken care of them with parental affection. Once, they said to their mother who phoned in anxiety about housekeeping that there was no slight inconvenience in life because the neighbors like one family have looked after them, and asked her to work harder, not to worry about them. The touching stories like this are being heard everywhere in our country. The stories about communist virtue and beautiful traits that can exist only in our society have come into full bloom continuously even now. As there are virtues and beautiful traits further displayed in ordeal, we can bring the victory surely in today’s grand anti-epidemic campaign. Rodong Sinmun

title: Construction for People Is Carried Out As Planned Despite Trials
body: The flame of creating construction myth is growing fiercer in Hwasong area. Hwasong area is the epitome of our country in which the grand construction campaign is being conducted for people. The spirit of the great era of Kim Jong Un of hastening the rosier future without hesitation and standstill despite the severe trials and difficulties is pulsating here. Today our country is faced with a sudden crisis due to the spread of vicious virus. But we push forward with the gigantic construction as scheduled. The source of power is the invariable will of our Party to bring to realization the work for people in any circumstances at any cost. The flame of performing new miracle and innovation is growing in the construction site of the Ryonpho Greenhouse Farm, too, under the warm loving care of the respected General Secretary who is willing to give all blessings to our people. The builders engaged in the construction of the Ryonpho Greenhouse Farm keep deep in their minds the ardent call of the respected General Secretary who attended the ground-breaking ceremony for the construction of the Ryonpho Greenhouse Farm in February. He called for exerting ourselves to set up structures for our people as early as possible, imagining a merry laughter that will tinkle in each of our people’s houses and looking forward to the bright future of our country which will become more prosperous. Under the wise guidance of our Party that regards the construction for people as the long-cherished desire and the most important work the Komdok area is being face-lifted every day and every hour. The ardent pledge of the soldier builders shakes the Komdok area to realize the noble will of the respected General Secretary who arrived in the Komdok area far away from Pyongyang by train along the dangerous gorge railway restored temporarily and unfolded a far-reaching plan and master plan to turn the Komdok area, the country’s leading large-scale mineral production base, into the country’s model mountainous city next to Samjiyon City and a mining city by doing away with the centuries-old backwardness in Taehung, Komdok and Ryongyang and by building modern dwelling houses suited to the requirement of the new century. Indeed, the endless pride and self-esteem of our people reach the climax in our country because the far-reaching ideal of the respected General Secretary to let our people enjoy all socialist benefits as soon as possible is coming to realization. Despite the rigorous difficulties which can be called as a great upheaval in our country since the founding of the DPRK, the construction for people is being pushed ahead with as planned. This miraculous reality unfolded in the grand construction sites across the country shows how our Party serves the people and devotes itself to them. Rodong Sinmun
